CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Alloc_Rule]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @outcome_no  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @basis  int  ,
 @attr_id  int  ,
 @standard_value  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @relational_op  int  ,
 @sp_name nvarchar(40) ,
 @ent_id  int  ,
 @is_default  bit  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Job_Alloc_Rule
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--09/21/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT job_alloc_rule.wo_id
       ,job_alloc_rule.oper_id
       ,job_alloc_rule.seq_no
       ,job_alloc_rule.outcome_no
       ,job_alloc_rule.item_id
       ,job_alloc_rule.basis
       ,job_alloc_rule.attr_id
       ,job_alloc_rule.standard_value
       ,job_alloc_rule.relational_op
       ,job_alloc_rule.sp_name
       ,job_alloc_rule.ent_id
       ,job_alloc_rule.is_default
       ,job_alloc_rule.spare1
       ,job_alloc_rule.spare2
       ,job_alloc_rule.spare3
       ,job_alloc_rule.spare4
       ,job_alloc_rule.last_edit_comment
       ,job_alloc_rule.last_edit_by
       ,job_alloc_rule.last_edit_at
FROM job_alloc_rule job_alloc_rule
WHERE ((job_alloc_rule.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.outcome_no = @outcome_no OR @outcome_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.basis = @basis OR @basis IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.standard_value = @standard_value OR @standard_value IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.relational_op = @relational_op OR @relational_op IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.sp_name = @sp_name OR @sp_name IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.is_default = @is_default OR @is_default IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (job_alloc_rule.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_prod_rule_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[job_prod_rule]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_prod_rule_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on job_prod_rule table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 09/27/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE job_prod_rule SET job_prod_rule.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_prod_rule.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE job_prod_rule.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_prod_rule.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_prod_rule.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_prod_rule.outcome_no = i.outcome_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Oper_Ent_Spec]

   @step_no int,
   @ent_id int ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT oper_ent_spec.process_id
          ,oper_ent_spec.oper_id
          ,oper_ent_spec.step_no
          ,oper_ent_spec.ent_id
          ,oper_ent_spec.ver_id
          ,oper_ent_spec.spec_id

          ,oper_ent_spec.min_value
          ,oper_ent_spec.max_value
          ,oper_ent_spec.access_level
          ,oper_ent_spec.last_edit_comment
          ,oper_ent_spec.last_edit_by

          ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_spec.mod_id))) mod_id

       oper_ent_spec.ent_id = @ent_id AND
       oper_ent_spec.ver_id = @ver_id AND
       oper_ent_spec.spec_id = @spec_id)

-- Name:    SP_S_ofi_GetShiftStart
-- Description:  Get Shift Start and Job Start Time for the Complete / Stop Production
--
-- Usage: MDMAddProductionWF
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_GetShiftStart] 
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id NVARCHAR(100),
	@seq_no INT,
	@ent_id INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @shift_start_local DATETIME,
			@hour_start_local DATETIME

	-- GET job start time
	SELECT @hour_start_local = MAX(job_start_local) 
	FROM job_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id =@oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no and ent_id = @ent_id

	SET @hour_start_local = ISNULL(@hour_start_local,GETDATE())

	-- GET latest shift time
	SELECT @shift_start_local = MAX(shift_start_local) 
	FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	SET @shift_start_local = ISNULL(@shift_start_local,GETDATE())

	SELECT @hour_start_local hour_start_local, @shift_start_local shift_start_local

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Bom_Item_Subst]
  (@parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @bom_pos int ,
   @alt_no int )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_D_Bom_Item_Subst
-- Description      - Delete an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
-- 07/07/2004    Sheetal Jain  20024  (HD# 4395) Maintain BOM_ver.ver_date automatically
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @use_GMT	INT32
	,@current_time	TDATETIME

BEGIN
  DELETE bom_item_subst
    WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND
       ver_id = @ver_id AND
       bom_pos = @bom_pos AND
       alt_no = @alt_no)

  --Maintain bom version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

  UPDATE bom_ver SET ver_date = @current_time
    WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id OR @parent_item_id IS NULL) AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_AWC_Util_GetByFilter]
(
	@queryName NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
	@conditionalValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''
) AS 
BEGIN
DECLARE @dynamic_Query NVARCHAR(MAX)
SET @dynamic_Query = ''
SET @dynamic_Query = CASE @queryName
						WHEN 'GETCOUNTOFTOTALREPOSITORIES' 
							THEN 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						  WHEN 'GETALLREPOSITORYLIST'
							THEN 'SELECT UEN, MiddlewareMachineName, HostName, RepositoryName FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						  WHEN 'GETDISTINCTREPOSITORYLIST'
							THEN 'SELECT DISTINCT HostName, RepositoryName FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						  WHEN 'GETMAXPORTNUMBER'
							THEN 'SELECT MAX(ConnectionPort) FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						   WHEN 'GETCONNECTIONINFO'
							THEN 'SELECT ConnectionString FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						  WHEN 'DELETECONNECTIONINFO'
							THEN 'DELETE FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'  
						   WHEN 'CHECKEXISTANCEOFSTOREPROCEDUREANDTABLE'
							THEN 'SELECT HostName FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						  WHEN 'GETDATABASENAME'
							THEN 'SELECT DB_NAME()'
						   WHEN 'SAVECONNECTIONINFO'
							THEN 'INSERT INTO AWC_Workflowconnection(ID, UEN, MiddlewareMachineName, HostName, RepositoryName, ConnectionString, ConnectionPort)'
						   WHEN 'GETCONNECTIONINFOBYMIDDLEWARENAME'
							THEN 'SELECT ID, HostName, RepositoryName, ConnectionString FROM AWC_Workflowconnection'
						   WHEN 'SAVECONNECTIONSTATUS'
							THEN 'INSERT INTO AWC_Workflowconnection_Status(UEN, HostName, RepositoryName, MiddlewareMachineName, Action, Status) '	
						   WHEN 'ISACTIONSUCCESS'
							THEN 'SELECT Status, Description FROM AWC_Workflowconnection_Status '
						   WHEN 'UPDATECONNECTIONSTATUS'
							THEN 'UPDATE AWC_Workflowconnection_Status '	
						   WHEN 'DELETECONNECTIONSTATUS'
							THEN 'DELETE FROM AWC_Workflowconnection_Status '
						   WHEN 'ISUENALREADYPRESENT'
							THEN 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM  AWC_Workflowconnection '
						   WHEN 'ISUENPRESENTINSTATUSTABLEFORDELETE'
							THEN 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM  AWC_Workflowconnection_Status '
						   WHEN 'UPDATECONNECTIONINFO'
						   	THEN 'UPDATE AWC_Workflowconnection '
						   WHEN 'GETLASTID'
                            THEN 'SELECT MAX(ID) FROM AWC_Workflowconnection '			
						  ELSE ''
					END
					
IF @dynamic_Query = ''
BEGIN
	RETURN NULL
END

IF (@conditionalValue <> '')
BEGIN
	SET @dynamic_Query = @dynamic_Query + ' ' + @conditionalValue
END

--Command to execute the dynamic SQL query
EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @dynamic_Query

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_ofi_su_get_reclassify_status
-- Description:	This function returns Silo status for reclassification
--
-- Usage:	get_inv_details (SU Overview screen)
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-04-11			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-12-21			Changed * to 1 in exists condition, attribute checking is changed from AND to O--R 
   0.01.02	Veervar		2024-02-06			Logic comments and formatting
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_su_get_reclassify_status]
(
	@ent_id INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	--VARIABLE DECLARATION
	DECLARE @result NVARCHAR(50)
			,@attr_id INT 
			,@attr_value NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
			,@isActiveSiloCnt INT=0			
			,@flag nvarchar(50)=NULL
			,@auto_reclassify_id INT = NULL
			,@is_auto_reclassify_val nvarchar(50)='false'

	--GET AllowReclassify VALUE FOR SELECTED ENTITY
	select @attr_id=a.attr_id 
	from attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_desc like 'AllowReclassify'

	select @attr_value=ea.attr_value
	from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
	where ea.attr_id=@attr_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id

	set @result= ISNULL(@attr_value,'true');

	--GET auto_reclassify VALUE FOR SELECTED ENTITY
	select @auto_reclassify_id = a.attr_id
	from attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify'

	--0.01.01	CK
	select  @is_auto_reclassify_val = ea.attr_value  from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
	where ea.attr_id=@auto_reclassify_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id	
	
	--0.01.01	CK
	IF(@is_auto_reclassify_val ='true' )
	BEGIN
	set @result='false'
	END

	--SET RESULT TO FALSE IF SILO IS ACTIVE ON LINE
	select @isActiveSiloCnt=count(1)
	from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock)
	where oss.active_su_ent_id=@ent_id

	IF(@isActiveSiloCnt > 0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @result='false'
	END

	RETURN @result

END

-- Description: Fetch Inline data 
--
-- Usage:	Used in nice label

-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-02			Initial version.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_lm_inline_getData] 
	 
AS
BEGIN
 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

 DECLARE @cols AS NVARCHAR(MAX),
 @query  AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
    
 select @cols = STUFF((SELECT ',' + QUOTENAME(as_value) 
                     from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] lpld with(nolock)
						JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh WITH(NOLOCK) ON lpld.label_id = lplh.label_id
						JOIN ofi_lm_layout_name lln WITH(NOLOCK) ON lplh.layout_id = lln.layout_id
					 where lplh.is_active=1 and lplh.is_label_processed=0 and lplh.label_type='inline'
                     group by as_value,layout_name
                     order by as_value
					 
             FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
             ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') 
         ,1,1,'')
    
    
 set @query = N'SELECT ' + @cols + N' from 
              (
                  
				 select  ISNULL(lpld.actual_value,lpld.default_value)  as actual_value , as_value
                from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] lpld with(nolock)
					JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh WITH(NOLOCK) ON lpld.label_id = lplh.label_id
					JOIN ofi_lm_layout_name lln WITH(NOLOCK) ON lplh.layout_id = lln.layout_id
                where lplh.is_active=1 and lplh.is_label_processed=0 and lln.layout_name=layout_name and lplh.label_type='+'''inline'''+' and pattern = '+'''int'''+'
				union
				select  ISNULL(lpld.actual_value,lpld.default_value)  as actual_value , as_value
                from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] lpld with(nolock)
					JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh WITH(NOLOCK) ON lpld.label_id = lplh.label_id
					JOIN ofi_lm_layout_name lln WITH(NOLOCK) ON lplh.layout_id = lln.layout_id
                where lplh.is_active=1 and lplh.is_label_processed=0 and lln.layout_name=layout_name and lplh.label_type='+'''inline'''+' and pattern <>'+'''int'''+'
				union
				select  ISNULL(lplh.actual_value,lpld.default_value)  as actual_value , as_value
                from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] lpld with(nolock)
					JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh WITH(NOLOCK) ON lpld.label_id = lplh.label_id
					JOIN ofi_lm_layout_name lln WITH(NOLOCK) ON lplh.layout_id = lln.layout_id
                where lplh.is_active=1 and lplh.is_label_processed=0 and lln.layout_name=layout_name and lplh.label_type='+'''inline'''+' and pattern ='+'''text'''+'
             ) x
             pivot 
             (
                 max (actual_value)
                 for as_value in (' + @cols + N')
             ) p '
    
 exec sp_executesql @query;
   
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_CancelAllJobs]
(
	@wo_id STRING80
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_CancelAllJobs
-- Description			- Cancels all the jobs in a work order
-- Author				- Sheetal
-- Date Created			- 05/13/2005
-- Version				- 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 05/13/2005		Raghu			2.1.21	Renamed from sp_U_Job_CancelAllJobs
-- 07/29/2005		Raghu			2.1.25	HD# 1529, Cancel ONLY new, ready or suspended jobs
-- 08/17/2005		Raghu			2.1.26  On-Hold jobs are also cancelled.
-- 10/31/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes; Cancelling jobs should automatically set the
--											actual_finish_time for all jobs.
-- 08/09/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @current_time_local AS DATETIME
		,	@current_time_utc	AS DATETIME

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	 --Check if any of the jobs are running
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cancelling jobs for this work order has failed since some of the jobs in this work order are currently being executed.{4204}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT	@current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ),
			@current_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	 --Cancel all the jobs
	UPDATE job SET state_cd = 7, act_finish_time_utc = @current_time_utc, act_finish_time_local = @current_time_local
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND (state_cd = 1 OR state_cd = 2 OR state_cd = 5 OR state_cd = 6)

END

-- Description: Used to process the Job Complete request

--	6.1.4 (SUSPEND): Call SP_U_ofi_BinDump_operid: wo, oper, and IsActiveDump = 0. 
--	6.1.5 (SUSPEND): Check oper attr: sp_S_ofi_Get_Oper_attr: oper_id and attr_desc = 'IntakeProduceTheoraticalQty' when 1 ELSE 'Nothing'. 'Nothing' == Finished.
--  6.1.5.1 (SUSPEND-IntakeProduceTheoraticalQty): Get Intake Order details: sp_S_ofi_getBulkIntakeOrderDetail: wo, oper and ent.
--  6.1.5.2 (SUSPEND-IntakeProduceTheoraticalQty): Check if wo_qty > 0 -> 'ProducedQTY' else 'no prod'. 'no prod' == Finished.
--  6.1.5.2.1 (SUSPEND-IntakeProduceTheoraticalQty-ProducedQTY): Add prod: sp_i_item_prod_addprod: ent, item, qty_prod, to_ent_id, lot, sublot (ALL taken from 6.1.5.1) reas_cd = 2.
--  6.1.5.2.2 (SUSPEND-IntakeProduceTheoraticalQty-ProducedQTY): Update item_prod: set spare2 = 0 for all wo_id=@wo_id production. Process Completed == Finished.
--	6.2.1 (COMPLETE): Check if 5 (output.result) 5.result == 0 then 'Valid' ELSEIF 5.result == (4 or 3) then 'Warning' ELSE 'NotValid'.  'NotValid' == Finished.
--	6.2.2.1 (COMPLETE-Valid): Call SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ENDBATCHJOBS: user, ent, wo, oper, seq, check_privs = 1, check_certs = 1 and job_pos.
--	6.2.2.2 (COMPLETE-Valid): if 6.2.2.1 FAILS --> GO TO 6.2.3.1 (COMPLETE-Warning). ELSE GO TO 6.2.2.3 (COMPLETE-Valid):
--		6.2.3.1 (COMPLETE-Warning): Call sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete: wo, oper, seq, operation = Backup
--		6.2.3.2 (COMPLETE-Warning): Call SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ENDBATCHJOBS: user, ent, wo, oper, seq, check_privs = 1, check_certs = 1 and job_pos (job_pos_h).
--		6.2.3.3 (COMPLETE-Warning): Call sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete: wo, oper, seq, operation = Restore
--		6.2.3.4 (COMPLETE-Warning): Continue on --> 6.2.2.3 (COMPLETE-Valid)
--	6.2.2.3 (COMPLETE-Valid): equal to 6.1.2 (SUSPEND): Call sp_U_ofi_EndGoodPalletProd: wo, oper and seq. 
--	6.2.2.4 (COMPLETE-Valid): equal to 6.1.3 (SUSPEND): Call SP_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation: wo, oper, seq and operation = 'Stop'
--	6.2.2.5 (COMPLETE-Valid): equal to 6.1.4 (SUSPEND): Call SP_U_ofi_BinDump_operid: wo, oper, and IsActiveDump = 0.
--	6.2.2.6 (COMPLETE-Valid): call sp_U_ofi_cancelReleaseJob:  wo, oper + seq.
--	6.2.2.7 (COMPLETE-Valid): if 4 (EndOtherJobsOnJobComplete) == 1 then 'EndOtherJobs' ELSE 'No'. No ==> Go To 6.2.2.10 (COMPLETE-Valid).
--	6.2.2.8.1 (COMPLETE-Valid-EndOtherJobs): Call sp_sa_job: wo_id
--	6.2.2.8.2 (COMPLETE-Valid-EndOtherJobs): LOOP for EACH JOB
--	6.2.2.8.3.1 (COMPLETE-Valid-EndOtherJobs-ForEachJob): if wo,oper,seq == triggered data then 'SameJob' ELSEIF job_state = 5 then 'Suspendend' ELSE 'Next'
--	6.2.2.8.3.2 (COMPLETE-Valid-EndOtherJobs-ForEachJob-Suspended): Call SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ENDBATCHJOBS: user, ent, wo, oper, seq, check_privs = 1, check_certs = 1 and job_pos.
--	6.2.2.8.3.3 (COMPLETE-Valid-EndOtherJobs-ForEachJob-[Suspended, SameJob or Next]): NEXT step; when DONE Go to 6.2.2.10 (COMPLETE-Valid).
--	6.2.2.9 (COMPLETE-Valid): Call sp_S_ofi_ProcessType: wo_id
--	6.2.2.10 (COMPLETE-Valid): if process_type == "Rework" then 'Rework' ELSE 'Other'. 'Other' == Finished.
--	6.2.2.11.1 (COMPLETE-Valid-Rework): Call sp_sa_job: wo_id
--	6.2.2.11.2 (COMPLETE-Valid-Rework): Count All jobs AND Only those that job_state = 4: count_all and count_suspended as output
--	6.2.2.11.3 (COMPLETE-Valid-Rework): if count_all = count_suspended then 'UnassignHU' ELSE 'GoNext'. 'GoNext' == Finished.
--	6.2.2.11.4.1 (COMPLETE-Valid-Rework-UnassignHU): Call sp_u_ofi_AssignHUStatus: wo_id, request_type = 'Unassign'.

--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE PROD object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC   	2025-06-18   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.02	JSC		2025-07-01			Added timeout handling
-- 0.01.03  JSC		2025-07-22			Fixing timeout configuration + raise errors inner SPs
-- 0.01.04	JSc		2025-10-27			CakeBlending FAT added postprocessing for it
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE         PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJCOMData]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'JCOM',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5,
			@cfg_job_state_pause INT = 5,
			@cfg_job_state_complete INT = 4,
			@cfg_feedback_timeout INT = 30,
			@cfg_float_tolerance FLOAT = 0.00001;

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(50)),23)+ FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmssfff');
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(@TranName,29) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	--PRINT TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@TranCounter) + ' <= Tran Counter Value at the beginning'

	-- Declare MES outputs (To handle post action errors)
	DECLARE @data_job_exec_result_code INT

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		
		-- moved here
		IF @TranCounter = 0
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
		ELSE
			SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN

			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
					@debug INT = 0,
					@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no					
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',				
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME	'$.recorded_timestamp'
			);
	
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					--,@mes_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
					--,@mes_su_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT: sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT
			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = wa.output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			
			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type, @ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'				
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- Declare the outputs 
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				,@data_job_qty_prod FLOAT
				,@data_job_qty_reqd FLOAT
				,@data_process_id nvarchar(40)
				,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				--,@data_bom_pos	INT								
				--,@data_factor	FLOAT
				--,@data_thr_result	INT
				--,@data_to_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				--,@data_to_qty FLOAT
				--,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				--,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				--,@data_su_result INT
				--,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT	@data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
					,@data_process_id = process_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state, qty prod and qty req
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
					,@data_job_qty_prod = j.qty_prod
					,@data_job_qty_reqd = j.qty_reqd
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if JOB is new or ready ERROR; Else is not RUNNING (3) (nor new nor Ready) then WARNING  -- ,7,8,9
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED, 7, 8, 9 -- Avoid errors -- 4,5 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500030,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500031,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos=job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			-- Get Specific Attributes values
			-- AlwaysSuspendOnJobComplete: SuspendOnJobComplete
			-- EndOtherJObsOnJobComplete: EndOtherJobsOnJobComplete
			DECLARE @data_suspend_on_complete INT
					,@data_end_others_on_complete INT

			SELECT @data_suspend_on_complete = TRY_CONVERT(INT,REPLACE(ea.attr_value,',',''))
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
												AND a.attr_grp = 2 --  1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
			WHERE a.attr_desc = 'SuspendOnJobComplete'
				AND ea.ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id

			SELECT @data_end_others_on_complete = TRY_CONVERT(INT,REPLACE(ea.attr_value,',',''))
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
												AND a.attr_grp = 2 --  1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
			WHERE a.attr_desc = 'EndOtherJobsOnJobComplete'
				AND ea.ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id

			-- fix values in case of NULL
			SET @data_suspend_on_complete = ISNULL(@data_suspend_on_complete,0)
			SET @data_end_others_on_complete = ISNULL(@data_end_others_on_complete,0)
			

			-- Get VALIDATION DATA:  sp_S_ofi_ValidateOnJobComplete
			DECLARE  @ValidationOnJobComplete AS TABLE (
															Result INT
															,Descriptions NVARCHAR(500)
														)

			DECLARE @data_validation_result INT
					,@data_validation_description NVARCHAR(1700)

			INSERT INTO @ValidationOnJobComplete
			EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_ValidateOnJobComplete] 
				   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
				  ,@seq_no = @seq_no

			SELECT @data_validation_result = v.Result
					,@data_validation_description = v.Descriptions
			FROM @ValidationOnJobComplete v
			
			-- GET USER ID
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			-- Verify that we are not in TIMEOUT:
			
			-- Verify if we are OK within timeout margin of processing the message
			DECLARE @timeout_timestamp DATETIME
					,@curTime DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			SET @recorded_timestamp = COALESCE(@recorded_timestamp,@current_timestamp) -- MOD: v1.03 swap places
			SET @timeout_timestamp = DATEADD(SECOND, @cfg_feedback_timeout, @recorded_timestamp)
			
			
			IF @curTime > @timeout_timestamp
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500027,NULL,NULL)+' @recorded_timestamp: '+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@recorded_timestamp,121) + '; @timeout_timestamp: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@timeout_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timeout_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Verify which flow to follow SUSPEND OR COMPLETE
			IF (@data_job_qty_prod < @data_job_qty_reqd)
				OR (@data_suspend_on_complete = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- SUSPEND
				PRINT 'SUSPEND'

				-- SUSPEND JOB (only if not already suspended/stopped OR COMPLETED)
				IF (@data_job_state_cd NOT IN (@cfg_job_state_pause, @cfg_job_state_complete))
				BEGIN				
					EXEC @data_job_exec_result_code = [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs] 
							@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
							,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
							,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
							,@seq_no = @seq_no
							,@paused_job_state = @cfg_job_state_pause
							,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
							,@status_notes = NULL
							,@event_time_local = NULL
							,@job_end_utc = @recorded_timestamp -- ADDED
							,@time_zone_bias_value = NULL
								
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN

					SET @data_job_exec_result_code = 0

					-- set output message WARNING
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500032,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
					END
				END
				
				-- Verify if TheoreticalQty is needed:
				DECLARE @data_intake_prod_theo_qty INT

				SELECT @data_intake_prod_theo_qty = TRY_CONVERT(INT,REPLACE(ea.attr_value,',',''))
				FROM oper_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
					JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
													AND a.attr_grp = 7 --  1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'IntakeProduceTheoraticalQty'
					AND ea.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
					AND ea.process_id = @data_process_id

				-- fix values in case of NULL
				SET @data_intake_prod_theo_qty = ISNULL(@data_intake_prod_theo_qty,0)

				-- Check if prod needs to be done
				IF @data_intake_prod_theo_qty <> 1
				BEGIN

					-- no need to continue here, move to Finishing OK
					IF @debug = 1
					BEGIN
						PRINT 'SUSPENDED- No Prod for intake needed'
					END

					GOTO Finishing_OK;
				END


				-- no need to continue here, move to Finishing OK
				IF @debug = 1
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'SUSPENDED- PROD for intake needed'
				END

				-- Get all Intake Order details
				DECLARE @data_intake_wo_qty FLOAT
						,@data_intake_lot_no NVARCHAR(50)
						,@data_intake_item_id NVARCHAR(50)
						,@data_intake_to_ent_id INT
						,@data_intake_sublot_no NVARCHAR(50)


				-- Logic TAKEN FROM :: sp_S_ofi_getBulkIntakeOrderDetail
				
				DECLARE @curSublotTable AS TABLE (
												sublot_counter INT,
												sublot_number NVARCHAR(50)
											)

				SELECT TOP 1	@data_intake_lot_no = jb.def_lot_no,
								@data_def_reas_cd = jb.def_reas_cd ,
								@data_intake_item_id = j.item_id,							
								@data_intake_wo_qty =	CASE 
															WHEN j.qty_prod = 0
																THEN j.qty_reqd 
															ELSE 0
														END -- ADDED so we only produce the TOTAL quantity if NO-quantity has been produced on the job.
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id 
																AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id
																AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
																AND j.item_id = jb.item_id
				WHERE  j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
					AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
				ORDER BY jb.bom_pos ASC

				-- TAKEN FROM:  sp_S_ofi_dest_location
				SELECT TOP 1 @data_intake_to_ent_id =  TRY_CONVERT(INT,COALESCE(active_su_ent_id,su_ent_id))
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE dest_type = '2'  -- DESTINATION --@silo_selection
					AND wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
				ORDER BY active_su_ent_id DESC, silo_seq ASC -- Order is important (we want the active first, and failovers afters)

				
				-- FIND the current sublot number:
				INSERT INTO @curSublotTable 
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
						@wo_id=@mes_wo_id
						,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						,@seq_no = @seq_no
					
				SELECT TOP 1 @data_intake_sublot_no = sublot_number 
				FROM @curSublotTable

				-- END of Logic TAKEN FROM :: sp_S_ofi_getBulkIntakeOrderDetail
				
				SET @data_intake_wo_qty = ISNULL(@data_intake_wo_qty,0)

				-- Verify we have some quantity to produce
				IF (@data_intake_wo_qty <= 0 
					OR @data_intake_to_ent_id IS NULL 
					OR @data_intake_item_id IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					-- no need to continue here, move to Finishing OK
					IF @debug = 1
					BEGIN
						PRINT 'SUSPENDED- Prod for intake needed but found nothing'
					END

					-- set output message WARNING
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500033,NULL,NULL)+' Missing data or qty already produced for wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0))		
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
					END

					GOTO Finishing_OK;
				END		
								
				--FIx for empty def_reas_cd
				IF @data_def_reas_cd IS NULL
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@data_def_reas_cd = ISNULL(@data_def_reas_cd,def_reas_cd)
					FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
						AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
						AND seq_no = @seq_no 
						AND bom_pos = 0
				END

				-- Last Resort to get teh default of all
				SET @data_def_reas_cd = ISNULL(@data_def_reas_cd,2)

				-- Declare the outputs
				DECLARE @prod_row_id INT
					,@prod_info_sp NVARCHAR(4000)

				BEGIN TRY

					SET @recorded_timestamp = DATEADD(SECOND,-3,@recorded_timestamp) -- Added to avoid not-job-running timestamp issues

					-- add prod to other status job
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec]
								@session_id = NULL
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@qty_prod = @data_intake_wo_qty
								,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
								,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
								,@seq_no = @seq_no
								,@created_at_utc = @recorded_timestamp
							--  ,@shift_start_local
							--  ,@hour_start_local
							--  ,@shift_id
								,@item_id = @data_intake_item_id
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_intake_lot_no
								--,@rm_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @data_intake_sublot_no
							--  ,@rm_sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @data_intake_to_ent_id
								-- ,@processed
								--,@byproduct = 0
							--  ,@ext_ref
							-- ,@move_status
							-- ,@genealogy_id
							-- ,@event_id
							--,@segment_requirement_id
							--,@segment_response_id
							-- ,@comments
							--,@spare1
								,@spare2 = 0 --Bags Spare2 // INTAKE ORDER should be 0 ?
							--	,@spare3 = @data_hu_number  -- HU number
							--  ,@spare4
							--  ,@time_zone_bias_value
								,@row_id = @prod_row_id OUTPUT
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					-- Adding the extra PROD failed, so just exit
					DECLARE @error_on_jobprod NVARCHAR(4000)
					SET @error_on_jobprod = ERROR_MESSAGE();
					-- set output message WARNING
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500033,NULL,NULL) + @error_on_jobprod			
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
					END
				END CATCH;

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- COMPLETE
				PRINT 'COMPLETE'

				DECLARE @complete_fixed INT = 0;
				DECLARE @return_job_complete INT;				
				--	New JSC version: Option 0 mean sALL ok, go to COMPLETE; 1, 2, 3 or 4 means something is OFF, go to SUSPEND.
				-- ORINGINAL AVEVA: Options 0, 3 or 4 are Warning; others Don't stop. (try to spot anyway)
				IF (@data_validation_result IS NULL OR @data_validation_result NOT IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4))
				BEGIN

					PRINT 'Job not valid'
					-- use message from validation for reporting: @data_validation_description
					-- set output message ERROR
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500034,NULL,NULL) + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),ISNULL(@data_validation_result,-5)) + ' and message: ' + ISNULL(@data_validation_description,'')			
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error									

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
					END
					
					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END
				ELSE IF (@data_validation_result IN (8))-- removed 3, 4 -- Keep this logic to revert in case needed in the future!
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'Job needs fixing'
					-- In case completing the job fais come back here

					-- set output message WARNING
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500035,NULL,NULL)			
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
					END				
					
					IF (@data_job_state_cd <> @cfg_job_state_complete)
					BEGIN
						-- Fix the job in theory
						EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete] 
										@wo_id = @mes_wo_id									
										,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
										,@seq_no = @seq_no
										,@operation = 'BACKUP'
					END

					-- We need to prevent the infinite loop:
					SET @complete_fixed = 1;
				END
				ELSE IF (@data_validation_result IN (1,2,3,4)) -- Added 3 and 4; if any validation fail better to suspend.
				BEGIN

					-- Cannot COMPLETE but it can SUSPEND
					-- SUSPEND JOB (only if not already suspended/stopped OR COMPLETED)
					BEGIN TRY
						IF (@data_job_state_cd NOT IN (@cfg_job_state_pause, @cfg_job_state_complete))
						BEGIN		
							-- set output message WARNING as we didn't complete but suspended they job: Job has been set to suspend due to: 
							SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(4140,NULL,NULL) + ': ' + @data_validation_description	

							-- try to suspend
							EXEC @data_job_exec_result_code = [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs] 
									@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
									,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
									,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
									,@seq_no = @seq_no
									,@paused_job_state = @cfg_job_state_pause
									,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
									,@status_notes = NULL
									,@event_time_local = NULL
									,@job_end_utc = @recorded_timestamp -- ADDED
									,@time_zone_bias_value = NULL
								
							
							SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

							IF @debug = 1 
							BEGIN
								SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
							END

						END
					END TRY					
					BEGIN CATCH
						SET @data_job_exec_result_code = 50000
						-- If it fails then we got out
						PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE()

						-- Error message
						SET @message_output = @message_output + ' Catch message: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
						SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed									

						IF @debug = 1 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @message_output as 'job_error_round1',@status_output
						END	
					END CATCH

					-- no need of extra code, go to finish!
					GOTO Finishing_OK;
				END
				
				-- only complete the job if it is not already completed; allow to do other extra work if already completed
				IF (@data_job_state_cd <> @cfg_job_state_complete)
				BEGIN
					BEGIN TRY
						EXEC @data_job_exec_result_code = [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs] 
																   @ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
																  ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
																  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
																  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
																  ,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
																  --,@status_notes = NULL
																  ,@user_id = @mes_user_id
																  ,@check_privs = 1
																  ,@check_certs = 1
																  --,@client_type = NULL
																 -- ,@no_propogation = NULL
																  --,@check_auto_job_start = NULL
																  --,@event_time_local = @recorded_timestamp
																  ,@job_end_utc = @recorded_timestamp
																  --,@time_zone_bias_value
					END TRY					
					BEGIN CATCH
						SET @data_job_exec_result_code = 50000
						-- As first call fails, we need to run it a second time
						PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE()

						-- Error message
						SET @message_output = ERROR_MESSAGE()
						SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed									

						IF @debug = 1 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @message_output as 'job_error_round1',@status_output
						END	
					END CATCH

					IF (@data_job_exec_result_code <> 0)
					BEGIN
						--job failed, may need fixing; if not then the fixing will take us to finish line
						PRINT 'Job may need fixing'
						PRINT 'ent_id: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@mes_parent_ent_id) 
						PRINT 'mes_wo_id: ' + @mes_wo_id 
						PRINT 'mes_oper_id: ' + @mes_oper_id
						PRINT 'mes_user_id: ' + @mes_user_id
						PRINT 'data_job_pos: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@data_job_pos) 
						PRINT 'recorded_timestamp: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@recorded_timestamp) 
						PRINT 'data_validation_result: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@data_validation_result) 
						PRINT 'data_job_state_cd: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@data_job_state_cd) + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)
						-------- In case completing the job fais come back here					
						------GOTO Fix_Job;

						IF (@data_job_state_cd <> @cfg_job_state_complete)
						BEGIN
							-- Fix the job in theory
							EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete] 
											@wo_id = @mes_wo_id									
											,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
											,@seq_no = @seq_no
											,@operation = 'BACKUP'
						END

						--We need to prevent the infinite loop:
						SET @complete_fixed = 1;
					END

					IF (@complete_fixed = 1)
					BEGIN
						PRINT 'Ending after fixing'
						-- Something fail before, so try again
						EXEC @data_job_exec_result_code = [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs] 
																   @ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
																  ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
																  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
																  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
																  ,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
																  --,@status_notes = NULL
																  ,@user_id = @mes_user_id
																  ,@check_privs = 1
																  ,@check_certs = 1
																  --,@client_type = NULL
																 -- ,@no_propogation = NULL
																  --,@check_auto_job_start = NULL
																  --,@event_time_local = @recorded_timestamp
																  ,@job_end_utc = @recorded_timestamp
																  --,@time_zone_bias_value


						--we have fixed the job so we need to UNFIX it by running this
						PRINT 'Unfixing the job'

						EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete] 
									@wo_id = @mes_wo_id									
									,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
									,@seq_no = @seq_no
									,@operation = 'RESTORE'

						--we have fixed the job so we need to UNFIX it by running this
						PRINT 'After Unfixing the job'
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @data_job_exec_result_code = 0;

					-- set output message WARNING
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500032,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
					END
				END

				PRINT 'Start Cancelling other jobs'
				-- Cancel all released jobs (for operations where this is required)
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_cancelReleaseJob] 
							   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
							  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
							  ,@seq_no = @seq_no


				DECLARE @data_process_type NVARCHAR(500)

				SELECT @data_process_type = pa.attr_value
				FROM process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON pa.attr_id=a.attr_id
				WHERE pa.process_id = @data_process_id 
					AND a.attr_desc = 'ProcessType'

				-- Get all jobs, Set jobs to complete if they are suspended
				DECLARE @table_all_jobs AS TABLE (
														wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
														,oper_id NVARCHAR(80)
														,seq_no INT
														,state_cd INT
														)

				-- if end other jobs or processtype is REWORK we need to get all jobs
				IF (@data_end_others_on_complete = 1 OR @data_process_type = 'Rework')
				BEGIN
					
					-- Get all jobs for the WO with its states
					INSERT INTO @table_all_jobs
					SELECT   j.wo_id
							,j.oper_id
							,j.seq_no
							,j.state_cd
							--,je.job_pos
					FROM [dbo].[job] j WITH (NOLOCK)
						--LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[job_exec] je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = j.run_ent_id 
						--										AND je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id 
						--										AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id 
						--										AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
					WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN

					-- no need of extra code, go to finish!
					GOTO Finishing_OK;
				END

				IF (@data_end_others_on_complete = 1)
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'Ending Other jobs'

					DECLARE @pending_jobs_failed INT = 0

					-- Get all jobs, Set jobs to complete if they are suspended
					DECLARE @table_pending_jobs AS TABLE (
															wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
															,oper_id NVARCHAR(80)
															,seq_no INT
															)


					INSERT INTO @table_pending_jobs
					SELECT   j.wo_id
							,j.oper_id
							,j.seq_no
					FROM @table_all_jobs j
					WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						AND j.state_cd = @cfg_job_state_pause
						AND NOT (j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no)

					-- Complete only if we found at least 1 job
					IF  EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @table_pending_jobs)
					BEGIN
						-- at least 1 job
						PRINT 'STopping jobs'
						DECLARE @local_cur_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
								,@local_cur_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)
								,@local_cur_seq_no INT
								--,@local_cur_state_cd INT
						DECLARE @RowCount INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @table_pending_jobs);  
  
						WHILE @RowCount > 0 BEGIN  
							SELECT @local_cur_wo_id=wo_id, @local_cur_oper_id=oper_id, @local_cur_seq_no = seq_no--, @local_cur_state_cd = state_cd   
							FROM @table_pending_jobs   
							ORDER BY wo_id,oper_id,seq_no DESC OFFSET @RowCount - 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY;  
     
							PRINT 'Looping on one job' 
							PRINT @local_cur_wo_id
							PRINT @local_cur_oper_id
							PRINT @local_cur_seq_no
							-- do whatever needed, apply any logic, call stored procedures, etc.  
							BEGIN TRY
								-- Execute the calll
								PRINT 'ENDING JOB'
								-- Run the complete script for these jobs
								EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs] 
												@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
												,@wo_id = @local_cur_wo_id
												,@oper_id = @local_cur_oper_id
												,@seq_no = @local_cur_seq_no
												--,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
												--,@status_notes = NULL
												,@user_id = @mes_user_id
												,@check_privs = 1
												,@check_certs = 1
												--,@client_type = NULL
												-- ,@no_propogation = NULL
												--,@check_auto_job_start = NULL
												--,@event_time_local = @recorded_timestamp
												,@job_end_utc = @recorded_timestamp
												--,@time_zone_bias_value
							END TRY
							BEGIN CATCH
								-- if ending job fail, just go to the next
								PRINT 'Job end failed, next'
								SET @pending_jobs_failed += 1 ;
							END CATCH
  
							SET @RowCount -= 1;  
						END	-- loop through jobs and stop them 1-by-1


						-- if at least 1 job failed set a warning message but process OK
						IF (@pending_jobs_failed > 0)
						BEGIN
							-- At lesat 1 job failed; set Warning_processed and add message
							PRINT 'At least 1 job failed'

							-- set output message WARNING
							SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500037,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@mes_wo_id + '. Total extra jobs that failed: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@pending_jobs_failed)
							SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed										

							IF @debug = 1 
							BEGIN
								SELECT @message_output as 'job_warning',@status_output
							END
						END -- at least 1 job failed message
					END -- found at least 1 other job
				END -- end other jobs
	
				IF (@data_process_type = 'Rework')
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'Process type is REWORK'
					DECLARE @total_rework_jobs INT
							,@total_rework_jobs_completed INT

					SELECT @total_rework_jobs = COUNT(*)
							,@total_rework_jobs_completed = SUM( CASE 
																	WHEN j.state_cd = @cfg_job_state_complete
																		THEN 1
																	ELSE 0
																END
																)
					FROM @table_all_jobs j

					-- Check All jobs has been completed
					IF(@total_rework_jobs = @total_rework_jobs_completed)
					BEGIN
						PRINT 'Unassigning ALL pallets'
						-- Unassign ALL pallets
						EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_AssignHUStatus] 
										   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
										 -- ,@json
										  ,@type = 'Unassign'
										 -- ,@user
					END
				END

			END

			-- Do the final part prior to exiting the process
			Finishing_OK:

			PRINT 'Finishing OK'

			-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
			IF @status_output = 1 
			BEGIN
				-- SET OK
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
				SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500038,NULL,NULL)
			END

			-- 3 steps: Free Silos + Complete pallets + Close extras
			EXEC [dbo].[SP_U_ofi_EndGoodPalletProd] 
						   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no

			EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation] 
						   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  --,@old_silo_aut 
						  ,@operation = 'Stop'

			-- v2.04 Added UPDATE THe job Recipe if operation = CakeBlending
			IF @mes_oper_id = 'CakeBlending'
			BEGIN
				EXEC [dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative]
					@wo_id		 = @mes_wo_id,
					@oper_id	 = @mes_oper_id,
					@seq_no		 = @seq_no,
					@recipeGrid	 = NULL,
					@reqd_qty	 = NULL,
					@trigger_src = 'job_complete',
					@is_manual	 = 0
			END


			-- Fail safe, turn the isDumping to 0 if existing and equal to 1
			DECLARE @job_attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = 'isDumping'
					,@job_attr_id INT
					,@isDumping INT
					,@job_attr_mod_id VARCHAR(30)

			SELECT @job_attr_id = ja.attr_id
					,@isDumping = TRY_CONVERT(INT,ISNULL(ja.attr_value,'0'))
					,@job_attr_mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id)))
			FROM [dbo].[job_attr] ja WITH (NOLOCK)
				JOIN [dbo].[attr] a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ja.attr_id
			WHERE ja.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				AND ja.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
				AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no
				AND a.attr_desc = @job_attr_desc

			IF (@isDumping = 1)
			BEGIN
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Attr]
							@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  ,@attr_id = @job_attr_id
						  ,@attr_value = '0'
						  ,@notes = NULL
						  ,@last_edit_comment = 'Updated by job complete from AUT'
						  ,@mod_id = @job_attr_mod_id
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		-- Exit place
		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

		SET @TranCounter = @@TRANCOUNT

		--PRINT TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@xstate) + ' <= X STATE Value'
		--PRINT TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@TranCounter) + ' <= Tran Counter Value'
		--PRINT TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@status_output) + ' <= @status_output Value'


		IF ( @data_job_exec_result_code = 0 )
		BEGIN
			SET @message_output = 'JOB COULD HAVE BEEN COMPLETED OK BUT some extra steps failed with: ' + @message
			SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @message_output = @message_output + @message
		END

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		BEGIN TRY
			---- ADDed extras v1.03  ==> if state is -1 then we just need to rollback all
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			-- Find the last opening brace
			DECLARE @start INT = LEN(@message_output) - CHARINDEX('{', REVERSE(@message_output)) + 1;

			-- Find the corresponding closing brace
			DECLARE @end INT = CHARINDEX('}', @message_output, @start);

			-- Remove the substring if both braces are found
			IF @start > 0 AND @end > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = STUFF(@message_output, @start, @end - @start + 1, '');
			END

			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@status_output)+';message_output:'+@message_output
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
					,@status_output as status_output
					,@message_output as message_output
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Ent_Spec_GetSpecs]
(@process_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id 		NVARCHAR(80)
,@ent_id		INT
,@ver_id 		NVARCHAR(40)
,@step_no		INT
) AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Oper_Ent_Spec_GetSpecs
-- Description	      -	Returns a recordset of all specs along with the value and step number
--			if the spec if used on an entity at the operation
--			New BR reqd doc (New Supervisor Business Rules.doc) from Rich B
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	06/30/2003
-- Version	      - 1.7.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 12/02/2003	  Rich Boyle		    Added the access_level column from oper_ent_spec to the record set.
-- 04/13/2006	  Raghu		   3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 12/19/2017	  Surya		   6.0	    US:956690 As Peter I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT spec.grp_id
	,spec.spec_id
    ,spec.spec_desc
	,oper_ent_spec.spec_value
	,oper_ent_spec.step_no
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
	,oper_ent_spec.access_level
             ,spec.data_type data_type
FROM spec spec WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_spec oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON spec.spec_id = oper_ent_spec.spec_id
AND oper_ent_spec.process_id = @process_id
  AND oper_ent_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
  AND oper_ent_spec.ent_id = @ent_id
  AND oper_ent_spec.ver_id = @ver_id
  AND (oper_ent_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
ORDER BY spec.display_seq, spec.grp_id, spec.spec_id
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_i_ei_hu_stock_receipt_child
-- Description:  insert the inventory for the given Main HU and Sub HU combination
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-12-07		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Karthik		2023-07-13			Added Blend ratio. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-08-08			Handled storage locations for Melting. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ei_hu_stock_receipt_child] @order_number varchar(100),@qty float,@uom varchar(10),
@pallet_id varchar(100),@sender_plant varchar(50),@receiving_plant varchar(50),@receiving_storage_locn varchar(50),
@sender_storage_locn varchar(50),@nestdChild_HU varchar(50),@material_no_child_HU varchar(50),@batch_no_child_HU varchar(50),
@qty_child_HU varchar(50),@usage_decsn_child_HU varchar(10),@blend_ratio float
as
begin
	Declare
	@ent_id int , -- receiving storage location
	@attr_id int,
	@frm_ent_id int,	--sender storage location
	@item_id nvarchar(40),
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) , --- Batch_no_child Hu
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40) , --- generated using new sp
	@grade_cd int , --- item_grade state code 0
	@status_cd int , --- item_state normal state code
	@qty_left float ,@qty_left_erp float ,-- qty_left
	@uom_id int,@date_in_local datetime,@date_out_local datetime,@expiry_date datetime,	@last_edit_at datetime,	@row_id int,
	@RC int,@last_edit_comment varchar(100),@item_group varchar(100)

	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY

	SET @lot_no = @batch_no_child_HU
	SET @item_id = @material_no_child_HU
	SET @qty_left = @qty_child_HU
	SET @qty_left_erp = @qty_child_HU

	IF @item_id IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
			BEGIN TRANSACTION
			DECLARE @Seq varchar(100) =  NEXT VALUE FOR SequenceCounter;

			SET @sublot_no = dbo.fn_Generate_Sub_Lot_No(@Seq)
			SET @date_in_local = GETDATE()
			SET @date_out_local = GETDATE()
			SET @last_edit_at = GETDATE()
			SET @ent_id = NULL
			SET @frm_ent_id = NULL

			--SELECT @attr_id = attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation'
			--SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @receiving_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id
			--SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @sender_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id

			--(KN 8Aug23 Made the below changes to handle HU stock receipt for Melting)
			--Start of change

			IF @receiving_storage_locn <> 'MELT'
			BEGIN
				SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @receiving_storage_locn
				SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @sender_storage_locn
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				
				SELECT @item_group = attr_value from item_attr with (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
				IF @item_group like '%Liquor%' 
					SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorMelting_A'
				ELSE IF @item_group like '%Butter%' 
					SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'ButterMelting_A'
				
			END

			--End of change

			SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd from item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) where item_grade_desc = 'GOODGRADE'	---(KN 10May23 - Changed to GoodGrade from Acceptable as requested by Bussiness)

			IF LEN(@usage_decsn_child_HU) > 0 
				SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted'
			ELSE
				SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Restricted'

			SELECT @uom_id = uom_id from uom WITH (NOLOCK) where description = @uom

			IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from item_inv with (nolock) where spare2 = @pallet_id and spare3 = @nestdChild_HU)	---Pallet & sub Pallet doesn't exist in MES, then CREATE OR ALTER inventory
			BEGIN

			SET @last_edit_comment = 'HU Stock Receipt - (Inventory created - Child)'

			PRINT 'Entity ID ' + cast(@ent_id as varchar)

			Exec @RC = sp_I_Item_Inv
			@ent_id= @ent_id,@item_id = @item_id,@lot_no = @batch_no_child_HU,@sublot_no = @sublot_no,
			@grade_cd = @grade_cd,@status_cd = @status_cd,@qty_left = @qty_left,@qty_left_erp = @qty_left,@uom_id = @uom_id,
			@date_in_local = @date_in_local,@date_in_tz = NULL,@date_out_local = @date_out_local,@date_out_tz = NULL,@expiry_date = NULL,
			@wo_id = NULL, @oper_id = NULL,@seq_no = NULL,@spare1 = @usage_decsn_child_HU,@spare2 = @pallet_id,@spare3 = @nestdChild_HU,@spare4 = '',
			@spare5 = '',@spare6 = '',@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment,@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUT,@row_id = @row_id OUT

			PRINT 'Inserting ' + @nestdChild_HU + ' / SP result ' + CAST(@RC AS VARCHAR) + ' / sublot ' + @sublot_no + ' / Seq' + @Seq

			END

			--KN 13Jul23 Added logic to include blend ratio

			IF NOT ISNULL(@blend_ratio,0) = 0 
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @mod_id varchar(30)
				Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio'

				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from lot_attr with(nolock) WHERE lot_no = @batch_no_child_HU and attr_id = @attr_id)
					EXEC sp_I_Lot_Attr @item_id,@batch_no_child_HU,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id output
				ELSE
					BEGIN
					PRINT 'Updating Lot Attr'
						SELECT @mod_id = CAST(mod_id AS VARCHAR) from lot_attr with(nolock) where lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id
						PRINT  @mod_id
						--EXEC sp_U_Lot_Attr @item_id,@lot_no,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id
						Update lot_attr set attr_value = @blend_ratio, last_edit_at = GETDATE() where lot_no = @batch_no_child_HU and attr_id = @attr_id
					END			
			END

			COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH

-- =============================================
-- Name:    SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons 
-- Description:  Based on storage unit consumption type this SP will return records with quantity
--
-- Usage:  Used in SP: SP_I_ofi_Item_Cons_AddCons
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  VJ          2022-10-20      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	MP			2023-01-30		Big Fixed Equation Calculation
-- 0.03.00  YG			2023-01-30		Added Lot_threshold conversion of UoM 
-- 0.04.00  MP			2023-06-09		Added Lot_threshold, conversion of UoM, Rounding to 4 digits
-- 0.04.01	Veervar		2024-02-09		Logic comments added.
-- 0.04.02	MC			2025-07-03		Bugfix for selecting numeric data from attributes table
-- ===========================================================================================
-- EXEC SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons 437, '100000041475', 1, 'Equation'
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons]
		 @ent_id INT 
		,@item_id NVARCHAR(40) 
		,@Cons_Qty FLOAT 
		,@TypeOfCons NVARCHAR(20) = 'FIFO'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE 
		 @sum_qty FLOAT = 1
		,@full_cons_qty FLOAT
		,@threshold_qty FLOAT 
		,@cur_lot NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_sublot NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_qty FLOAT
		,@consumed_till FLOAT = 0
		,@minID INT
		,@row_id INT
		,@defaultUoM NVARCHAR(100) = 'KG'

	IF object_id('tempdb..#invlist') is not null DROP TABLE #invlist
	CREATE TABLE #invlist(id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, lot NVARCHAR(40) ,sublot NVARCHAR(40), qty FLOAT, cons_qty FLOAT,  consume_full BIT, grade_cd INT, status_cd INT, row_id INT)

	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "LIFO"
	IF @TypeOfCons = 'LIFO'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0 AS 'cons_qty', 0 AS 'consume_full', grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')
		ORDER BY row_id DESC
		SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist
		WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL AND @consumed_till < @Cons_Qty)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cur_qty = qty FROM #invlist WHERE id = @minID
			IF (@cur_qty>=(@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty =  @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = qty WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + @cur_qty
			END

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist WHERE id > @minID
		END
		SELECT * FROM #invlist  WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
	END
	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "Mixed"
	ELSE IF @TypeOfCons = 'Mixed'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0, 0,grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')

		SELECT @sum_qty = sum(qty) FROM #invlist

		PRINT @sum_qty
		IF @sum_qty >= @Cons_Qty
		--UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = qty/@sum_qty*@Cons_Qty
		UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = ROUND(qty/@sum_qty*@Cons_Qty,4)

		SELECT * FROM #invlist  WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
	END

	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "Equation"
	ELSE IF @TypeOfCons = 'Equation'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @item_UoM NVARCHAR(40)
		SELECT @item_UoM = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id)

		--GET THRESHOLD VALUE FROM CONFIGURATION
		--0.04.02 use convert and replace instructions as SQL can't use ',' as thousand separator
		SELECT @threshold_qty = CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value,',',''))
		FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'Lot_threshold')

		SET @threshold_qty = ISNULL (@threshold_qty,50)
		SELECT @threshold_qty = dbo.fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom(@item_id,@threshold_qty,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,@defaultUoM,@item_UoM) 
		print @threshold_qty
		
		--INSERT LOTS FOR ENTITY AND ITEM IN TEMP TABLE
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0, 0,grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')
			order by qty_left 

		DECLARE 
		@Inv_items int,
        @counter int=1

        SELECT @Inv_items=count(*) FROM #invlist
		
		--LOOP THROUGH EACH RECORD FROM TEMP TABLE
      	WHILE (@counter<=@Inv_items)
        BEGIN 
        	SELECT @cur_lot=lot,@cur_sublot=sublot,@cur_qty=qty, @row_id=row_id FROM #invlist WHERE id=@counter   
			
			--IF THRSHILD QUANITTY IS GREATER THAN CURRENT QTY THEN CONSUME LOT COMPLETELY
			IF (@cur_qty <= @threshold_qty AND @consumed_till <@Cons_Qty)
            BEGIN
            	UPDATE #invlist 
                SET cons_qty =CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END 
                ,consume_full=1
                WHERE row_id = @row_id

                SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END
            END
           	SET @counter=@counter+1
        END
		
		PRINT @consumed_till

		IF (@Cons_Qty -@consumed_till)>0
		BEGIN
		
			SELECT @sum_qty = sum(qty) FROM #invlist WHERE consume_full =0
					
			IF @sum_qty >= @Cons_Qty - @consumed_till
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = ROUND( qty/@sum_qty*(@Cons_Qty - @consumed_till),4) WHERE consume_full =0
			END
			
		END
		SELECT * FROM #invlist  WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
		
	END  
	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "FIFO"
	ELSE --@TypeOfCons = 'FIFO'    FIFO Or other settings - Default is FIFO
	BEGIN
	--GET LOTS FOR ITEM AND ENTITY IN ORDER BY ROW_ID
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0 AS 'cons_qty', 0 AS 'consume_full', grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')
		ORDER BY row_id

		SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist
		WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL AND @consumed_till < @Cons_Qty)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cur_qty = qty FROM #invlist WHERE id = @minID
			IF (@cur_qty>=(@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty =  @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = qty WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + @cur_qty
			END

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist WHERE id > @minID
		END
		SELECT * FROM #invlist WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
	END
END
