CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Attr]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700)  ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @mod_id  varchar(30) )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 03/15/2004     Sheetal Jain          BarberFoods MOD_ID correction
-- 09/15/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006	  Raghu		    3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 01/18/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 5

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT job_attr.wo_id
            ,job_attr.oper_id
            ,job_attr.seq_no
            ,job_attr.attr_id
            ,job_attr.attr_value
            ,job_attr.notes
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,job_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,job_attr.last_edit_by
            ,job_attr.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM job_attr job_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((job_attr.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_attr.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_attr.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (job_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (job_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
--       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, job_attr.mod_id),13) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
       (CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_job_route_aft] ON [dbo].[job_route] AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- TG_JOB_ROUTE_AFT_INS
-- Description       	-- (HD #2378) Set first job and final job flags in real time as and when the job route is drawn
-- Author	 	-- Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created      	-- 05/15/2003
-- Version (last edit) --  3.1.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 10/25/2006     SJ            3124 -  HD#9037 - CWOFP - WO State Code for Instantiation
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@last_edit_by	STRING40
BEGIN
  IF COLUMNS_UPDATED() > 0  --Insert or Update
    DECLARE cur_wo_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT j.wo_id FROM job AS j
        INNER JOIN inserted AS i ON j.wo_id = i.wo_id AND j.oper_id = i.oper_id AND j.seq_no = i.seq_no
        INNER JOIN wo AS w ON j.wo_id = w.wo_id
          WHERE w.state_cd <> -1
  ELSE  --Delete
    DECLARE cur_wo_ins CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT d.wo_id FROM deleted d
        INNER JOIN wo AS w ON d.wo_id = w.wo_id
          WHERE w.state_cd <> -1

  OPEN cur_wo_ins
  WHILE (0=0)
  BEGIN
    FETCH cur_wo_ins INTO @wo_id
    IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BREAK

    --Reset the first job and final job flags
    EXEC sp_U_Job_SetJobFlags @wo_id
  END
  CLOSE cur_wo_ins
  DEALLOCATE cur_wo_ins

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

  UPDATE job_route SET job_route.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_route.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
  FROM inserted i
  WHERE job_route.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_route.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_route.seq_no = i.seq_no
        AND job_route.input_oper_id = i.input_oper_id AND job_route.input_seq_no = i.input_seq_no
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [ufn_S_ofi_lm_GenerateSublot]
-- Description: This function will get the current sublot_no for the line that produced the paremeter's one
-- Usage:  WIP consumption report
-- SELECT * FROM [ufn_S_ofi_lm_GenerateSublot] ('100123456','Cakeblending',0,012)
-- ===========================================================================================
--  Version		Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00		AML, XPM	2026-03-23			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_lm_GenerateSublot]
    (
		@wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT,
		@sublot_int INT
    )
RETURNS @Output TABLE
    (
	   out_sublot_no 	NVARCHAR(40)
      ,out_lot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
    )
AS BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40),			
			@sublot_no     NVARCHAR(40)
				
				
	SELECT  @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
	FROM    job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			wo_id       = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND bom_pos = 0

	IF 	(@def_lot_no IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT  @def_lot_no = w.lot_no
		FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				w.wo_id = @wo_id
				AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
	END

	IF @def_lot_no LIKE '000%'
	BEGIN
	    SET @def_lot_no = STUFF(@def_lot_no, 1, 3, '')
	END

	SELECT  @sublot_no = CONCAT( @def_lot_no, (FORMAT(@sublot_int,'000','en-US')))


	INSERT INTO @output
	SELECT  
		 @sublot_no
		,@def_lot_no

	RETURN
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_bom_item_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[bom_item] AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_bom_item_aft_upd
-- Description       	--  Updates consumption/production in bom_item_oper_link table when quantity changes
--			    HD# 3908 - BOM Item Allocations
-- Author	 	--  Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created      	--  11/25/2003
-- Version (last edit)  --  2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 12/09/2003    Sheetal Jain  16036  (HD# 4206) Auto BOM item allocation should only be for a process with one op
-- 02/03/2004    Sheetal Jain  20024  (HD# 4388) Endless loop in Items window
-- 02/09/2004    Sheetal Jain  20024  (HD# 4395) Maintain BOM_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu	        20100 Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 09/26/2012	 Ravi Teja		4.6	  CR L00122689 - (Merge of CR L00122266) Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item of bom_item table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE
  @parent_item_id   STRING40,
  @ver_id           STRING40,
  @bom_pos          INT32,
  @qty		    TFLOAT,
  @oqty		    TFLOAT,
  @V_Process        STRING40,
  @V_Oper           STRING40,
  @V_Parent_Item    STRING40,
  @V_Item           STRING40,
  @V_Found          INTEGER,
  @V_Error          VARCHAR(255),
  @item_id          STRING40,
  @last_edit_by	STRING40

BEGIN
  --Select all the updated records if qty has changed
  IF UPDATE(qty_per_parent_item)
  BEGIN
    DECLARE cur_bomitem CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT i.parent_item_id, i.ver_id, i.bom_pos, i.qty_per_parent_item, o.qty_per_parent_item FROM bom_item b
        INNER JOIN INSERTED i ON b.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND b.ver_id = i.ver_id AND b.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
        INNER JOIN DELETED o ON b.parent_item_id = o.parent_item_id AND b.ver_id = o.ver_id AND b.bom_pos = o.bom_pos
          WHERE i.bom_pos <> 0 AND i.qty_per_parent_item <> o.qty_per_parent_item
    OPEN cur_bomitem
    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
      FETCH cur_bomitem INTO @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @qty, @oqty
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
        BREAK
      --Get all the processes this parent item is attached to
      DECLARE cur_process CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT b.process_id, b.oper_id FROM bom_item_oper_link b
        INNER JOIN oper p ON p.process_id = b.process_id AND p.oper_id = b.oper_id
          WHERE b.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND b.ver_id = @ver_id AND b.bom_pos = 0 AND p.first_oper = 1
            AND 1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oper a WHERE a.process_id = p.process_id)
      OPEN cur_process
      WHILE (1=1)
      BEGIN
        FETCH cur_process INTO @V_Process, @V_Oper
        IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
          BREAK
        --Update bom item oper link if all of the old qty was being consumed at a single operation
        UPDATE bom_item_oper_link SET qty_per_parent_item = @qty WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id
          AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @V_Oper AND qty_per_parent_item = @oqty
        --Update bom item oper step link if all of the old qty was being consumed at a single step
        UPDATE bom_item_oper_step_link SET qty_per_parent_item = @qty WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id
          AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @V_Oper AND qty_per_parent_item = @oqty
          AND step_no IN (SELECT s.step_no FROM oper_step_grp g INNER JOIN oper_step s
                           ON s.process_id = g.process_id AND s.oper_id = g.oper_id AND s.step_grp_id = g.step_grp_id
                  WHERE s.process_id = @V_Process AND s.oper_id = @V_Oper AND s.action_type IN (2, 3))
      END  --End of (1=1)
      CLOSE cur_process
      DEALLOCATE cur_process
    END  --End of (1=1)
    CLOSE cur_bomitem
    DEALLOCATE cur_bomitem
  END  --End of UPDATE(qty_per_parent_item)

  --Look downtree of the new component
  IF UPDATE(item_id)
  BEGIN
    DECLARE cur_item_loop CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT i.parent_item_id, i.item_id FROM inserted AS i
      INNER JOIN deleted AS d ON i.parent_item_id = d.parent_item_id AND i.item_id = d.item_id AND i.bom_pos = d.bom_pos
        WHERE i.bom_pos <> 0 AND i.item_id <> d.item_id
    OPEN cur_item_loop
    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
      FETCH cur_item_loop INTO @parent_item_id, @item_id
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
        BREAK

      SET @V_Parent_Item = NULL
      SET @V_Item = @item_id
      CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
      INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id,  status)
        SELECT b.parent_item_id, b.item_id, 0 FROM bom_item b INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON b.item_id = v.parent_item_id
          WHERE b.parent_item_id = @V_Item
      --Loop through the BOM tree and list all items with BOM
      DECLARE cur_item CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT parent_item_id, item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0
      OPEN cur_item
      FETCH cur_item INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Item
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        UPDATE #tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Parent_Item AND item_id = @V_Item
        INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id, status)
          SELECT b.parent_item_id, b.item_id, 0 FROM bom_item b INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON b.item_id = v.parent_item_id
            WHERE b.parent_item_id = @V_Item AND b.bom_pos <> 0
        FETCH cur_item INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Item
      END
      CLOSE cur_item
      DEALLOCATE cur_item
      --Check if the parent item to which this component is being added exists in the bom tree of the component
      SET @V_Found = 0
      SELECT DISTINCT @V_Found = 1 FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE item_id = @parent_item_id
      IF @V_Found = 1
      BEGIN
--        SET @V_Error = N'Looping is not allowed. Parent item#' + @parent_item_id + N' is present in the BOM tree of the component#' + @item_id
        SET @V_Error = N'Looping is not allowed. Parent item# %1 is present in the BOM tree of the component# %2{4717},' + @parent_item_id + ',' + @item_id
        RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16,1)
        RETURN
      END
      DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0
    END  --End of WHILE (1=1)
    CLOSE cur_item_loop
    DEALLOCATE cur_item_loop
  END  --End of UPDATE(item_id)

  --Maintain bom version date automatically
  UPDATE bom_ver SET ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE parent_item_id+' '+ver_id IN
    (SELECT parent_item_id+' '+ver_id FROM INSERTED)

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  UPDATE bom_item SET bom_item.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item
	,bom_item.max_qty_per_parent_item = i.max_qty_per_parent_item
	,bom_item.min_qty_per_parent_item = i.min_qty_per_parent_item
	,bom_item.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, bom_item.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
  FROM inserted i
  INNER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
  WHERE bom_item.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bom_item.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bom_item.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Bom_Ver]
  (@parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Bom_Ver
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/10/2002      Raghu		1.4	Disallow deletes if sys param is set for BOM and BOM dependent data (sys param = 193)
--12/04/2002      Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
--03/10/2004      Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
--09/01/2006      Raghu		3.1.22	HD# 8682, Preferred version should be always set for the first bom version;
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
DECLARE @disallow_delete	INT
	,@preferred_ver		LOGICAL
	,@bom_ver_count	INT32

	SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 193
	IF (@disallow_delete = 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Deleting data from %1 is not allowed{3863},Bom_Ver', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	 --Verify whether this bom version is marked as a preferred version;
	 --If yes, then do no allow this bom version to delete unless this is the only bom version.
	SELECT TOP 1 @preferred_ver = preferred_ver
	FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
	  AND ver_id = @ver_id
	 AND  (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)

	--Verify whether this bom version is marked as a preferred version
	IF (@preferred_ver = 1) BEGIN
		--Since this bom version is marked as a preferred version, then verify there are no other bom version exist
		SELECT @bom_ver_count = COUNT(*)
		FROM bom_ver
		 WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
		 AND ver_id <> @ver_id

 		--Other bom version exists; do not allow this bom version to delete unless this is the only bom version that exist.
		--disallow the deletion of a bom version where preferred_ver is true unless there is no more than one other bom version
		IF (@bom_ver_count > 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Cannot delete a preferred version. Please select another version as preferred before deleting.{1868}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE IF (@bom_ver_count = 1) BEGIN
		--Since there is only one bom version exist other than the selected bom version, automatically set the other bom version as the preferred version.
		    UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 1
		    WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
			  AND ver_id <> @ver_id
		END
	END

	DELETE bom_ver
	WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id OR @parent_item_id IS NULL)
	AND  (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
	AND  (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
	--       CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id)
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    fn_SA_ofi_cal_lch_value
-- Description:  Calculation of lch
--
-- Usage:  
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk            2022-07-20    Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE function [dbo].[fn_SA_ofi_cal_lch_value]
	(
		@value1 float = 0,@value2 float=0,@value3 float = 0,@value4 float=0,@value5 float = 0,@value6 float=0,
		@value7 float = 0,@value8 float=0,@value9 float = 0,@value10 float=0,@value11 float = 0,@value12 float=0,
		@value13 float = 0,@value14 float=0,@value15 float = 0,@value16 float=0,@value17 float = 0,@value18 float=0,
		@value19 float = 0,@value20 float=0,@value21 float = 0,@value22 float=0,@value23 float = 0,@value24 float=0,
		@value25 float = 0,@value26 float=0,@value27 float = 0,@value28 float=0,@value29 float = 0,@value30 float=0,@value31 float=0
	)
	returns @lch table
	(
		l float,
		c float,
		h float
	)
	as
	begin
		if (ISNULL(@value1,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value2,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value3,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value4,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value5,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value6,0) =0 AND 
		ISNULL(@value7,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value8,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value9,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value10,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value11,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value12,0) =0 AND 
		ISNULL(@value13,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value14,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value15,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value16,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value17,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value18,0) =0 AND 
		ISNULL(@value19,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value20,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value21,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value22,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value23,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value24,0) =0 AND 
		ISNULL(@value25,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value26,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value27,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value28,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value29,0)  = 0 AND ISNULL(@value30,0) =0 AND ISNULL(@value31,0) =0)
		BEGIN
			INSERT into @lch
			SELECT 0,0,0
			
		END
		else
		begin
			declare @xa_value float=0,@ya_value float=0,@za_value float=0,@xb_value float=0,@yb_value float=0,@zb_value float=0,@a float=0,@b float=0,@x_value float=0,@y_value float=0,@z_value float=0
			declare @power_div float=1,@power_divd float=3,@out_p1 float=0,@out_p2 float=0,@out_p3 float=0

		
			declare @sample_reflection table (sample_char varchar(10),sample_value float)
			--create table @sample_reflection(sample_char varchar(10),sample_value float)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(400,@value1)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(410,@value2)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(420,@value3)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(430,@value4)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(440,@value5)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(450,@value6)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(460,@value7)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(470,@value8)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(480,@value9)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(490,@value10)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(500,@value11)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(510,@value12)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(520,@value13)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(530,@value14)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(540,@value15)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(550,@value16)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(560,@value17)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(570,@value18)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(580,@value19)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(590,@value20)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(600,@value21)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(610,@value22)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(620,@value23)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(630,@value24)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(640,@value25)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(650,@value26)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(660,@value27)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(670,@value28)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(680,@value29)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(690,@value30)
			insert into @sample_reflection(sample_char,sample_value) values(700,@value31)

			select @xa_value= sum(isnull((xc.x_values *cl.sample_value),0)) from ofi_x_calculation as xc(nolock) inner join @sample_reflection as cl on xc.x_char=cl.sample_char
			select @ya_value= sum(isnull((yc.y_values *cl.sample_value),0)) from ofi_y_calculation as yc(nolock) inner join @sample_reflection as cl on yc.y_char=cl.sample_char
			select @za_value= sum(isnull((zc.z_values *cl.sample_value),0)) from ofi_z_calculation as zc(nolock) inner join @sample_reflection as cl on zc.z_char=cl.sample_char

			set @xb_value = @xa_value / 94.78247
			set @yb_value = @ya_value / 100
			set @zb_value = @za_value / 107.3613

			if @xb_value < 0.008856
			begin
				set @x_value = 7.787 * @xb_value + 0.138
			end
			else
			begin
				set @x_value  = power(@xb_value,@power_div/@power_divd)
			end
    
			if @yb_value < 0.008856
			begin
				set @y_value = 7.787 * @yb_value + 0.138
			end
			else
			begin
				--set @y_value = @yb_value ^ (1 / 3)
				set @y_value = power(@yb_value,@power_div/@power_divd)
			end
    
			if @zb_value < 0.008856
			begin
				set @z_value = 7.787 * @zb_value + 0.138
			end
			else
			begin
				--set @z_value = @zb_value ^ (1 / 3)
				set @z_value = power(@zb_value,@power_div/@power_divd)
			end
			set @a= 500 *(@x_value - @y_value);
			set @b = 200 * (@y_value - @z_value);
									
			set @out_p1= (116 * @y_value) - 16
			set @out_p2 = sqrt((@a * @a)+(@b *@b))
			set @out_p3 = atan(@b / @a) * 57.2957795130823
		
			insert into @lch
			select round(@out_p1,2) as [measured_l],round(@out_p2,2) as [measured_c],round(@out_p3,2) as [measured_h]			
		end
		return
	end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_Attr]

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Version        - 6.2.0
--

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver.    Changes

				FROM sfg_wo
				INTO @sfg_wo
					,@sfg_seq_no
					,@sfg_qty

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
				BEGIN
					DECLARE rm_item CURSOR
					FOR
					SELECT DISTINCT jb.item_id
						,cons.lot_no
						,SUM(cons.qty_cons)
					FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item_cons cons ON cons.wo_id = jb.wo_id
						AND cons.item_id = jb.item_id
					WHERE jb.wo_id = @sfg_wo
						AND jb.seq_no = @sfg_seq_no
						AND jb.bom_pos <> 0
					GROUP BY jb.item_id
						,cons.lot_no

					OPEN rm_item

					FETCH NEXT
					FROM rm_item
					INTO @rm_item_id
						,@rm_lot_no
						,@rm_qty

					WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @destination = @destination + 1

						SELECT @item_desc = item_desc
						FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE item_id = @rm_item_id

						SET @material = @item_desc + ' _ ' + @rm_lot_no
						SET @id = @destination

						INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation (
							material
							,qty
							,id
							,source
							,destination
							)
						VALUES (
							ISNULL(@material,'Default')
							,ISNULL(@rm_qty,0)
							,@id
							,@sfg_source
							,@destination
							)

						FETCH NEXT
						FROM rm_item
						INTO @rm_item_id
							,@rm_lot_no
							,@rm_qty
					END

					CLOSE rm_item

					DEALLOCATE rm_item

					FETCH NEXT
					FROM sfg_wo
					INTO @sfg_wo
						,@sfg_seq_no
						,@sfg_qty
				END

				CLOSE sfg_wo

				DEALLOCATE sfg_wo

				FETCH NEXT
				FROM sfg_item
				INTO @sfg_item_id
					,@sfg_lot_no
					,@sfg_qty
			END

			CLOSE sfg_item

			DEALLOCATE sfg_item

			SET @destination = @destination + 1

			FETCH NEXT
			FROM fg_wo
			INTO @fg_wo
				,@fg_seq_no
				,@fg_qty

			CLOSE fg_wo

			DEALLOCATE fg_wo
		END

		SELECT id
			,ISNULL(material,'Default') AS name
			,ISNULL(qty, 0) AS value
			,source
			,destination AS target
		FROM @childTableInvValidation
	END
END

		,	@job_pos		INT32
		,	@last_edit_at	TDATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SELECT @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value, @active = COALESCE(@active, 1)

    --Verify whether work order id and operation id are supplied; if not raise an exception.
    IF  (@wo_id IS NULL) OR (@oper_id IS NULL)  BEGIN
		RAISERROR('WO_Id or Oper_Id cannot be null or blank{3862}' , 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
    ELSE IF (@cert_name IS NULL) BEGIN

IF (@process_id IS NULL or @process_id = ' ') BEGIN

END

	--Verify whether the supplied row can be certified or not.
    EXEC sp_U_JE_CertSignoffAllowed @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @grp_id, @process_id, @cert_name, @user_id, @time_zone_bias_value

			  (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL)) AND
			  (prod_log_id = @prod_log_id OR (prod_log_id IS NULL AND @prod_log_id IS NULL)) AND
			  (cons_log_id = @cons_log_id OR (cons_log_id IS NULL AND @cons_log_id IS NULL)) AND
			  cert_name = @cert_name AND
			  cert_audit_log.user_id = @user_id AND
			 (ref_row_id = @ref_row_id OR (ref_row_id IS NULL AND @ref_row_id IS NULL))
	)
	BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 has already signed this certification. Please try another user.{4673},' + @user_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @sign_off_local = COALESCE(@sign_off_local, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)))
	SET @sign_off_utc = DATEADD(mi, @tz_temp, @sign_off_local)

	INSERT INTO cert_audit_log
	(
		wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, lot_no, sublot_no, prod_log_id, cons_log_id, grp_id,
		process_id, process_status, active, cert_name, user_id, sign_off_utc, sign_off_local,
		comments, ref_row_id, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	VALUES
	(
		@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @prod_log_id, @cons_log_id, @grp_id,
		@process_id, @process_status, @active, @cert_name, @user_id, @sign_off_utc, @sign_off_local,
		@comments, @ref_row_id, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	)

	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('SQL ERROR, inserting into cert_audit_log{3333}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
/*
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @sign_off_local, @tz_temp, @sign_off_utc OUTPUT

	IF ( @process_id IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	END

	SELECT  @in_signoff = @sign_off_local, @active = ISNULL(@active, 1)

	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '' ) OR (@oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR('WO_Id or Oper_Id cannot be null or blank{3862}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--EXECUTE @return = sp_U_JE_CertSignOffAllowed @user_id, @process_id, @oper_id, @step_no, @cert_name, @time_zone_bias_value

	--Verify whether the supplied row can be certified or not.
    EXEC sp_U_JE_CertSignoffAllowed @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @grp_id, @process_id, @cert_name, @user_id, @time_zone_bias_value

--	IF @return <> 0 BEGIN
--		--   	RAISERROR(' Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level or Certificate has expired.: %d', 16, 1, @return)
--		RETURN -1
--	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Assuming CertName is a required parameter.
	-- Value for StepNo parameter is passed, if not default step_no to 0
	IF ( @step_no is null or @step_no = '' ) SET @step_no = -1

	--Added by Raghu. If lot_no is NULL, use job_exec.def_lot_no or '-'
	IF @lot_no IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @lot_no = def_lot_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  cur_seq_no = @seq_no

		IF (@lot_no IS NULL) SET @lot_no = ''
	END

	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND
			  (step_no = @step_no OR (step_no IS NULL AND @step_no IS NULL)) AND

	BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 has already signed this certification. Please try another user.{4673},' + @user_id

	-- IF @sign_off IS NULL SET @sign_off = @last_edit_at
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value, @server_time = @sign_off OUTPUT

	(
		@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @prod_log_id, @cons_log_id,

	)

	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('SQL ERROR, inserting into cert_audit_log{3333}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
*/

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 231

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id, @job_pos = job_pos
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)

		IF EXISTS (

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJobOutData]
-- Description: Used to insert PROD interface data into the buffer table
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE PROD object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC   	2025-06-12   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC		2025-07-17			Added option to pick a specific ID
-- 0.01.02	JSC		2025-08-15			Updated for other job commands
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJobOutData]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'JOB_OUT',
	@JobPos INT = 0,
	@RowId INT = 0, -- Optional
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5,
			@cfg_feedback_timeout INT = -30 -- 30 seconds timeout

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28));
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) = CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28)) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		IF @TranCounter = 0
            BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		-- Verify if we got a value for RowId
		SET @RowId = ISNULL(@RowId,0)
	
		IF @RowId > 0 
		BEGIN
			EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextByRowId]
				@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
				@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,				
				@ID = @RowId,
				@ID_Output = @ID_local OUTPUT,
				@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
				@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetJobPosNextRow]
				@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
				@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
				@JobPos = @JobPos,
				@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
				@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
				@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;
		END
		DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
		SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

		DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
				@oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
				@seq_no INT,
				@ent_id INT,
				@job_command INT,
				@job_pos INT,
				@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
				@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE(),
				@debug INT = 1,
				@mes_wo_id_truncated INT 

		DECLARE @eventName_local NVARCHAR(50) -- v01.02; Update for other job commands

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@oper_id = oper_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@ent_id = ent_id
					,@job_command = job_command
					,@job_pos = job_pos
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				oper_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.oper_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',
				ent_id INT '$.ent_id',
				job_command INT '$.job_command',
				job_pos INT '$.job_pos',
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME	'$.recorded_timestamp'
			);

			
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE @mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)


			-- Get the AUT work order id (Truncated)
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = COALESCE(@oper_id, wa.output_operid)
					,@mes_wo_id_truncated = TRY_CONVERT(INT, wa.output_truncated_woid)
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@ObjectName)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL OR @mes_wo_id_truncated IS NULL
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Declare the outputs of the ofi_AddprodWF_data Stored Procedure plus a local variable table to pick it up
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT @data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
			FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd=state_cd					
			FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND seq_no = @seq_no

			-- if JOB is COMPLETED/NEW or RELEASED, ERROR
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,4)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED -- 4 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3178,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
										
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos=job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			

			-- Verify if we are OK within timeout margin of processing the message
			DECLARE @timeout_timestamp DATETIME

			SET @timeout_timestamp = DATEADD(SECOND, @cfg_feedback_timeout, GETUTCDATE())
			SET @recorded_timestamp = COALESCE(@recorded_timestamp,@current_timestamp)
			
			IF @timeout_timestamp > @recorded_timestamp
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500027,NULL,NULL)+' @recorded_timestamp: '+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@recorded_timestamp,121) + '; @timeout_timestamp: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@timeout_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timeout_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			DECLARE @validate_job_message NVARCHAR(2000)
					,@validate_job_status INT = -1

			-- Validate if JOB can be started or not based on JOB Command
			IF @job_command = 1
			BEGIN
				-- Only for job start
				IF @data_job_pos > -1 AND @data_job_pos = @job_pos
				BEGIN
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3565,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
										
					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_pos_error',@status_output
					END

					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END

				-- TRy to start job without actually starting
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_ValidateStart] 
						   @ent_id = @ent_id
						  ,@user_id = @mes_user_id
						  ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  ,@job_pos = @job_pos
						  ,@check_privs = 1
						  ,@check_certs = 1
						  ,@event_time_local = @current_timestamp
						  ,@job_start_utc = NULL
						  ,@time_zone_bias_value = NULL
						  ,@validation_message = @validate_job_message OUTPUT
						  ,@validation_status = @validate_job_status OUTPUT

				IF @validate_job_status <> @cfg_status_OK
				BEGIN

					SET @message_output = @validate_job_message
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'job_val_error',@status_output
					END

					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END

				--Set event name for new sublot:
				SET @eventName_local = 'StartJob'
			END
			ELSE IF @job_command = 4
			BEGIN
				
				--Set event name for new sublot:
				SET @eventName_local = 'EditRecipe'
			END
			ELSE IF @job_command IN (8, 24)
			BEGIN
				
				--Set event name for new sublot:
				SET @eventName_local = 'RSUChange'
			END
			ELSE IF @job_command IN (12, 20, 28, 40, 44, 56 , 60)
			BEGIN
				
				--Set event name for new sublot:
				SET @eventName_local = 'EditSiloRecipe'
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- Exit as not valid event requires Sublot update
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--if validation is OK we now can create a new Sublot	 -- no feedback expected			
			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Sublot_Attr] 
					@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
					,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
					,@seq_no = @seq_no
					,@ent_id = @ent_id 
					,@eventName = @eventName_local

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT   @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output
				,@wo_id as wo_id
				,@oper_id as oper_id
				,@seq_no as seq_no
				,@ent_id as ent_id
				,@job_command as job_command
				,@job_pos as job_pos
				,@mes_wo_id_truncated as wo_id_truncated
				,@current_timestamp as 'current_timestamp'
				,@mes_user_id as 'user_id'

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		PRINT 'ERROR'
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @message_output = @message
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

			--output dataset
		SELECT   @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output
				,NULL as wo_id
				,NULL as oper_id
				,-1 as seq_no
				,-1 as ent_id
				,-1 as job_command
				,-1 as job_pos
				,-1 as wo_id_truncated
				,NULL as 'current_timestamp'
				,NULL as 'user_id'

        IF @xstate = -1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
	END CATCH
END;

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_i_ei_hu_stock_receipt_main
-- Description:  insert the inventory in cases where there are no child HUs
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-12-07		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Karthik		2023-07-13			Added Blend ratio. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-08-08			Handled storage locations for Melting. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ei_hu_stock_receipt_main] @order_number varchar(100),@material_no varchar(50),
@batch_no varchar(50),@qty varchar(50),@uom varchar(50),@pallet_id varchar(50),@sender_plant varchar(50),@sender_storage_locn varchar(50),
@receiving_plant varchar(50),@receiving_storage_locn varchar(50),@usage_decsn varchar(50),@blend_ratio VARCHAR(100)
As
begin
	Declare
	@ent_id int , -- receiving storage location
	@attr_id int,
	@frm_ent_id int,	--sender storage location
	@item_id nvarchar(40),
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) , --- Batch_no_child Hu
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40) , --- generated using new sp
	@grade_cd int , --- item_grade state code 0
	@status_cd int , --- item_state normal state code
	@cur_status_cd int,
	@qty_left float ,@qty_left_erp float ,-- qty_left
	@uom_id int,@date_in_local datetime,@date_out_local datetime,@expiry_date datetime,	@last_edit_at datetime,	@row_id int,
	@RC int,@item_group varchar(100)

	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION

	SET @lot_no = @batch_no
	SET @item_id = @material_no
	SET @qty_left = @qty
	SET @qty_left_erp = @qty

	DECLARE @Seq varchar(100) =  NEXT VALUE FOR SequenceCounter;
	SET @sublot_no = dbo.fn_Generate_Sub_Lot_No(@Seq)
	SET @date_in_local = GETDATE()
	SET @date_out_local = GETDATE()
	SET @last_edit_at = GETDATE()

	--SELECT @attr_id = attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation'
	--SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @receiving_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id
	--SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @sender_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id

	--(KN 8Aug23 Made the below changes to handle HU stock receipt for Melting)
	--Start of change

	IF @receiving_storage_locn <> 'MELT'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @receiving_storage_locn
		SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @sender_storage_locn
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT @item_group = attr_value from item_attr with (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
		IF @item_group like '%Liquor%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorMelting_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Butter%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'ButterMelting_A'
		/*
		SELECT @item_group = attr_value from item_attr with (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
		IF @item_group like 'Liquor' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorButterRework_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Liquor (Packed)%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorMelting_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Butter (Packed)%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'ButterMelting_A'
		*/
	END

	--End of change

	SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd from item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) where item_grade_desc = 'GOODGRADE'	---(KN 10May23 - Changed to GoodGrade from Acceptable as requested by Bussiness)
	IF @usage_decsn IS NOT NULL AND LEN(@usage_decsn) > 0 
		SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted'
	ELSE
		SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Restricted'
	SELECT @uom_id = uom_id from uom WITH (NOLOCK) where description = @uom

	Select @cur_status_cd = status_cd from item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) where lot_no = @lot_no and sublot_no = @sublot_no and spare2 = @pallet_id
	

	PRINT 'Entity ID ' + cast(@ent_id as varchar)

	IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from item_inv with (nolock) where spare2 = @pallet_id)	---Pallet doesn't exist in MES, then CREATE OR ALTER inventory
	BEGIN
	--Call product SP to insert record in inventory
		Exec @RC = sp_I_Item_Inv
		@ent_id= @ent_id,@item_id = @item_id,@lot_no = @lot_no,@sublot_no = @sublot_no,
		@grade_cd = @grade_cd,@status_cd = @status_cd,@qty_left = @qty_left,@qty_left_erp = @qty_left,@uom_id = @uom_id,
		@date_in_local = @date_in_local,@date_in_tz = NULL,@date_out_local = @date_out_local,@date_out_tz = NULL,@expiry_date = NULL,
		@wo_id = NULL, @oper_id = NULL,@seq_no = NULL,@spare1 = @usage_decsn,@spare2 = @pallet_id,@spare3 = @pallet_id,@spare4 = '',	---(KN 27-Jan-23) spare2 and spare3 are both updated as Pallet ID. Earlier spare3 was null
		@spare5 = '',@spare6 = '',@last_edit_comment ='HU Stock Receipt - (Inventory created - Main)',@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUT,@row_id = @row_id OUT
	
		IF @RC <> 0
			PRINT 'Error in running sp_i_item_inv'
	END

	--KN 13Jul23 Added logic to include blend ratio

	SET @blend_ratio = ROUND(@blend_ratio,2)
	PRINT @blend_ratio

	PRINT 'About update blend ratio ' + CAST(ISNULL(@blend_ratio,0) AS VARCHAR)

	IF NOT ISNULL(@blend_ratio,0) = 0 
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @mod_id varchar(30)
		Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio'

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from lot_attr with(nolock) WHERE lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id)
			EXEC sp_I_Lot_Attr @item_id,@lot_no,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id output
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Updating Lot Attr'
				SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),mod_id) from lot_attr with(nolock) where lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id
				--EXEC sp_U_Lot_Attr @item_id,@lot_no,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id
				Update lot_attr set attr_value = @blend_ratio, last_edit_at = GETDATE() where lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id
			END	END


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_JobSpec]
	(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@seq_no  int  ,
	@ent_id int ,
	@step_no int,
	@spec_id  nvarchar(40) ,
	@spec_desc NVARCHAR(80),
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime)
AS
BEGIN
	--===========================================================================================
	-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_JobSpec]
	-- Description:	To fetch the spec data based on passing parameters
	-- Usage: NA
	-- ===========================================================================================
	-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
	-- 0.01.00	 DS				2024-02-09			Updated the header comments
	-- 0.01.10	 YG				2024-02-16			Check the step is available or not
	-- 0.02.00	 YG				2024-06-06			Update logic for accomodating multiple prefix order
	-- 0.03.00	 YG				2024-06-21			CR8 Major Update to follow update on the [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid] function
	-- 0.04.00  AML, XPM        2026-01-20          Addded the CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe condition
	-- ===========================================================================================
	-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--DECLARE @ent_id	INT
	--SELECT @ent_id = ent_id FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id= @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
 
	-- 0.02.00 Added 0.03.00 Disabled
	--DECLARE @truncated_mesorder NVARCHAR(40),
	--		@prefix_id INT
 
	--SELECT @wo_id= mesorder,@truncated_mesorder=truncated_mesorder,@prefix_id=prefix_id FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid] (@wo_id,@oper_id)

	-- 0.03.00 Added
	DECLARE @output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		@output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		@output_operid NVARCHAR(100),
		@output_seqno INT,
		@result INT,
		@CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe int = 0;
	SELECT @output_woid=output_woid, @output_truncated_woid=output_truncated_woid,@output_operid=output_operid,@output_seqno=output_seqno 
	FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid](@wo_id,@seq_no,@ent_id)
	SET @wo_id = ISNULL(@output_woid,@wo_id);



	SELECT  @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = TRY_CAST(oa.attr_value AS INT)
	FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe' 


	IF @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe IS NULL OR @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT job_spec.wo_id
					,job_spec.oper_id
					,job_spec.seq_no
					,job_spec.step_no
					,job_spec.spec_id
					,job_spec.spec_value
					,job_spec.act_spec_value
					,job_spec.assoc_file
					,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
					,job_spec.comments
					,job_spec.min_value
					,job_spec.max_value
					,job_spec.access_level
					,spec.spec_desc
					,spec.grp_id
					,spec.units
					,spec.spare1
					,spec.spare2
					,spec.spare3
					,spec.spare4
					,job_spec.last_edit_comment
					,job_spec.last_edit_by
					,job_spec.last_edit_at
					,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
					,spec.data_type data_type
			,spec.display_seq
		FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
			INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.wo_id = @wo_id 
													AND js.oper_id = @oper_id 
													AND js.seq_no = @seq_no 
													AND js.step_name = 'Set Parameter' -- v0.01.10	Check the step is available or not
		WHERE ((job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
			   (spec.spec_desc = @spec_desc OR @spec_desc IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
		ORDER BY spec.display_seq
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SELECT job_spec.wo_id
					,job_spec.oper_id
					,job_spec.seq_no
					,job_spec.step_no
					,job_spec.spec_id
					,job_spec.spec_value
					,job_spec.act_spec_value
					,job_spec.assoc_file
					,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
					,job_spec.comments
					,job_spec.min_value
					,job_spec.max_value
					,job_spec.access_level
					,spec.spec_desc
					,spec.grp_id
					,spec.units
					,spec.spare1
					,spec.spare2
					,spec.spare3
					,spec.spare4
					,job_spec.last_edit_comment
					,job_spec.last_edit_by
					,job_spec.last_edit_at
					,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
					,spec.data_type data_type
			,spec.display_seq
		FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
		WHERE ((job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
			   (spec.spec_desc = @spec_desc OR @spec_desc IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			   (job_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
		ORDER BY spec.display_seq
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Line_Ent_Link]
  (@line_id int ,
   @ent_id int )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Line_Ent_Link
-- Description	      - Deletes a line_ent_link record.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	02/25/2013
-- Version	      - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--02/25/2013	RaghuG		4.6	Support for line management
-- 08/14/2014	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 226242 - As Bruce, I want to indicate that a specific line position "IS" the bottleneck.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @prod_ent_id		INT32_NULL
	,@bottleneck_ent_id	INT32

-- Determine if this was the production entity for the line
SELECT @prod_ent_id = prod_ent_id, @bottleneck_ent_id = bottleneck_ent_id FROM line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id

IF (@prod_ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @prod_ent_id = @ent_id) OR (@bottleneck_ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @bottleneck_ent_id = @ent_id)
	UPDATE l SET l.prod_ent_id = CASE WHEN l.prod_ent_id = @ent_id THEN avail_ent.ent_id ELSE l.prod_ent_id END
		   , l.bottleneck_ent_id = CASE WHEN l.bottleneck_ent_id = @ent_id THEN avail_ent.ent_id ELSE l.bottleneck_ent_id END
	FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
		--Get the next available entity if the supplied entity is in parallel with other entity; otherwise, null.
		(SELECT next_ent.line_id, MIN(next_ent.ent_id) ent_id
		FROM line_ent_link next_ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Retrieve all the lines and the child order (positions) at which the supplied entity occupy
		INNER JOIN (SELECT lel.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			--Limit to the line and supplied entity
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			  AND lel.ent_id = @ent_id
			) ent_child_order ON next_ent.line_id = ent_child_order.line_id AND next_ent.child_order = ent_child_order.child_order
		--Limit to the supplied line
		WHERE next_ent.line_id = @line_id
		--Ignore the supplied entity.
		  AND next_ent.ent_id <> @ent_id
		GROUP BY next_ent.line_id
	) avail_ent ON l.line_id = avail_ent.line_id
	--Limit the lines to the supplied line ID
	WHERE l.line_id = @line_id

DELETE line_ent_link
WHERE (line_id = @line_id AND
       ent_id = @ent_id)

-- Author:		Lavkesh
-- Create date: 08-04-2024
-- Description:	Execute from Archestra to get MES inventory of an Entity
-- Version		Date			Name	Remarks
-- 0.1			08-04-2024		LP		Initial Draft
-- 0.2			13-04-2024		YG		Update the query and always send into KG
-- EXEC [sp_s_ofi_GetInv] '500BN008', 'MT'
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_GetInvV1]
	@ent_name nvarchar(100),
	@DCS_UoM nvarchar(100)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- v0.2 Disabled
	--select sum(qty_left) as qty from item_inv iv with (nolock)
	--inner join ent e with(nolock) on iv.ent_id=e.ent_id
	--inner join item i with (nolock) on iv.item_id = i.item_id
	--where e.ent_name=@ent_name

	-- v0.2 Added
	Declare @qty float,
			@factor float,
			@defaultstorageuom nvarchar(100);

	-- v0.2 Added to get the default uom
	SELECT @defaultstorageuom = ISNULL(attr_value,'KG') FROM ent_attr WITH (nolock) 
	where ent_id = (select top 1 ent_id from ent WITH (nolock) where parent_ent_id is NULL)
	and attr_id = (select top 1 attr_id from attr WITH (nolock) where attr_desc = 'DefaultStorageUOM' and attr_grp=2) -- ent_attr group

	-- v0.2 Added
	SELECT @qty = Sum([dbo].[Fn_ofi_convertqtybyitemidanduom]
       (iv.item_id, iv.qty_left, NULL, NULL, u.description, @defaultstorageuom, NULL, NULL)) -- Always Set to KG
	FROM   item_inv iv WITH (nolock)
		   INNER JOIN ent e WITH(nolock)
				   ON iv.ent_id = e.ent_id
		   INNER JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
				   ON iv.item_id = i.item_id
		   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
				   ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	WHERE  e.ent_name = @ent_name

CREATE    Trigger [tg_bom_item_oper_link_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_link]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_bom_item_oper_link_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_link table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 08/25/2003   Sheetal Jain    1.6.0   Tuned the queries
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/27/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--07/31/2019	RWB			6.2.0	Story 1204999: MOdified the trigger so that it work with multiple rows being
--									deleted from the bom_item_oper_link table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40),
  @oper_id			NVARCHAR(40),
  @attr_value		BIT,
  @process_status	INT,
  @user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
  SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207
  IF (@attr_value = 1)
  BEGIN
    --Check if the record belongs to a certified process
    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1  FROM process p INNER JOIN deleted d ON p.process_id = d.process_id WHERE p.process_status = 3)
      RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},bom_item_oper_link', 16, 1)
  END
  --Get the user who is deleting the record(s)
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
  --Update the process
  UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
    WHERE process_id IN (SELECT process_id FROM deleted d)

DELETE oper_item_spec
FROM oper_item_spec ois
JOIN deleted d ON ois.process_id = d.process_id AND ois.oper_id = d.oper_id
where
((item_id IS NOT NULL and item_id NOT IN (select item_id from bom_item_oper_link bom_item_oper_link (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN bom_item WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item.parent_item_id = bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id
							WHERE
							(
								(bom_item_oper_link.process_id = d.process_id) AND
								(bom_item_oper_link.oper_id = d.oper_id)	AND
								(bom_item.bom_pos = bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos) AND
								(bom_item.ver_id = bom_item_oper_link.ver_id)
							)))
OR (item_id IS NULL AND item_class_id not in (select item.item_class_id from bom_item_oper_link bom_item_oper_link (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN bom_item WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item.parent_item_id = bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id
							INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item.item_id = item.item_id
							WHERE
							(
								(bom_item_oper_link.process_id = d.process_id) AND
								(bom_item_oper_link.oper_id = d.oper_id)	AND
								(bom_item.bom_pos = bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos) AND
								(bom_item.ver_id = bom_item_oper_link.ver_id)
							))))

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_JobSpec_byDisplaySeq] (
            @wo_id nvarchar(40),
            @oper_id nvarchar(40),
            @seq_no int,
            @display_seq int,
            @ent_id int,
            @step_no int,
            @spec_id nvarchar(40),
            @spec_desc NVARCHAR(80),
            @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
            @last_edit_at datetime
        ) AS BEGIN --===========================================================================================
        -- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_JobSpec_byDisplaySeq]
        -- Description:	To fetch the spec data based on passing parameters and on the DisplaySeq
        -- Usage: NA
        -- ===========================================================================================
        -- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
        -- 0.01.00  AML, XPM        2026-01-20          Initial version based on sp_SA_ofi_JobSpec
        -- ===========================================================================================
        -- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
        @output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
        @output_operid NVARCHAR(100),
        @output_seqno INT,
        @result INT,
        @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe int = 0;

SELECT @output_woid = output_woid,
        @output_truncated_woid = output_truncated_woid,
        @output_operid = output_operid,
        @output_seqno = output_seqno
FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid](@wo_id, @seq_no, @ent_id)

SET @wo_id = ISNULL(@output_woid, @wo_id);

SELECT @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = TRY_CAST(oa.attr_value AS INT)
FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
AND a.attr_desc = 'CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe' 

IF @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe IS NULL OR @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = 0 
BEGIN
	SELECT job_spec.wo_id, job_spec.oper_id,
        job_spec.seq_no,
        job_spec.step_no,
        job_spec.spec_id,
        job_spec.spec_value,
        job_spec.act_spec_value,
        job_spec.assoc_file,
        dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type,

        job_spec.min_value,
        job_spec.max_value,
        job_spec.access_level,
        spec.spec_desc,
        spec.grp_id,
        spec.units,
        spec.spare1,
        spec.spare2,
        spec.spare3,
        spec.spare4,
        job_spec.last_edit_comment,
        job_spec.last_edit_by,
        job_spec.last_edit_at,
        CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(30),
            CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))
        ) mod_id,
        spec.data_type data_type,
        spec.display_seq
	FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
    INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.wo_id = @wo_id
    AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
    AND js.seq_no = @seq_no
    AND js.step_name = 'Set Parameter' 
    WHERE (
            (
                job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id
                OR @wo_id IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
                OR @oper_id IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no
                OR @seq_no IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.step_no = @step_no
                OR @step_no IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id
                OR @spec_id IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                spec.spec_desc = @spec_desc
                OR @spec_desc IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
                OR @last_edit_by IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at
                OR @last_edit_at IS NULL
            )
        )
        AND (spec.display_seq >= @display_seq)
    ORDER BY spec.display_seq
    END
    ELSE BEGIN
    SELECT job_spec.wo_id,
        job_spec.oper_id,
        job_spec.seq_no,
        job_spec.step_no,
        job_spec.spec_id,
        job_spec.spec_value,

        job_spec.assoc_file,

        job_spec.comments,
        job_spec.min_value,
        job_spec.max_value,
        job_spec.access_level,
        spec.spec_desc,
        spec.grp_id,
        spec.units,
        spec.spare1,
        spec.spare2,
        spec.spare3,
        spec.spare4,
        job_spec.last_edit_comment,
        job_spec.last_edit_by,
        job_spec.last_edit_at,
        CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(30),
            CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))
        ) mod_id,
        spec.data_type data_type,
        spec.display_seq
    FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
    WHERE (
            (
                job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id
                OR @wo_id IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
                OR @oper_id IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no
                OR @seq_no IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.step_no = @step_no
                OR @step_no IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id
                OR @spec_id IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                spec.spec_desc = @spec_desc
                OR @spec_desc IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
                OR @last_edit_by IS NULL
            )
            AND (
                job_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at
                OR @last_edit_at IS NULL
            )
        )
        AND (spec.display_seq >= @display_seq)
    ORDER BY spec.display_seq
    END
    END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_ConvertERPDateString] (@date NVARCHAR(8),
                                                       @time NVARCHAR(6))
returns DATETIME
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @dt DATETIME,
			  @t INT

	  IF Len(@time) = 4
	  BEGIN
		  SET @time=@time + '00'
	  END

	  SET @t=@time 

      SELECT @dt = Dateadd(day, Datediff(day, 0, CONVERT(DATETIME, @date)), Cast(Format(@t, '00:00:00') AS NVARCHAR(8)))

      RETURN @dt
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_Attr_AddOrUpdXML] (
@sample_attrs        nvarchar(MAX)

/*
Example XML
<sample_attributes>
 <sample_attr sample_id="10" attr_desc="Test 1" value="Green" notes="some green color" />
 <sample_attr sample_name="10" attr_desc="Test 1" value="Red" notes="some red color" />
 <sample_attr sample_name="10" attr_desc="Test 2" value="Blue" notes="some blue color" />
  <sample_attr sample_name="11" attr_desc="Test 2" value="1" notes="measured manually" />
 </sample_attributes>
*/

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                   - SP_U_SAMPLE_ATTR_FROMXML
-- Description                   - Inserts or Updates sample Attributes from xml
-- Author                        - JA
-- Date Created                  - 6/2/2011
-- Version (last edit)           - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By        Ver          Changes
--      			Ahmed			   4.5			Modified as per the changed in sp_U_Sample_Attr
-- 02/05/2020       Jim O'Hearn        6.2.0        Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
   @sample_id int ,
   @attr_id int ,
   @attr_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @notes nvarchar(max) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime,
   @doc_handle  int
BEGIN

   EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @sample_attrs

   DECLARE sample_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT   sample.sample_id, attr.attr_id, value ,notes
      FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/sample_attributes/sample_attr')
         WITH ( sample_id int,
                attr_desc nvarchar(80),
                value nvarchar(1700),
                notes NOTES
                ) s
      INNER JOIN attr ON s.attr_desc=attr.attr_desc
      -- this line will verify that the sample_id from the XML exists in the sample table
      INNER JOIN sample on s.sample_id=sample.sample_id
      WHERE attr.attr_grp=10

   OPEN sample_attr_cursor
   WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
      FETCH NEXT FROM sample_attr_cursor INTO @sample_id, @attr_id,@attr_value,@notes
      IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

      IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_attr WHERE sample_id=@sample_id AND attr_id=@attr_id)
        EXECUTE sp_U_Sample_Attr @sample_id,@attr_id,@attr_value,@notes,null,null
      ELSE
        EXECUTE sp_I_Sample_Attr @sample_id,@attr_id,@attr_value,@notes,null,@last_edit_at OUTPUT
   END
   CLOSE sample_attr_cursor
   DEALLOCATE sample_attr_cursor
   EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_certification_data]
AS
SELECT temptable.*,
       job_step.step_desc,
       ent.ent_name run_ent_name
FROM (SELECT cert_audit_log.wo_id,
             cert_audit_log.oper_id,
             cert_audit_log.seq_no,
             job.act_start_time_utc,
             job.act_start_time_local,
             job.act_finish_time_utc,
             job.act_finish_time_local,
             job.run_ent_id,
             cert_audit_log.step_no,
             cert_audit_log.lot_no,
             cert_audit_log.sublot_no,
             cert_audit_log.cert_name,
             cert_audit_log.user_id,
             user_name.user_desc,
             cert_audit_log.sign_off_utc,
             cert_audit_log.sign_off_local,
             cert_audit_log.comments,
             item_prod.shift_start_utc,
             item_prod.shift_start_local
      FROM cert_audit_log cert_audit_log
      INNER JOIN job job ON
         cert_audit_log.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
         cert_audit_log.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
         cert_audit_log.seq_no = job.seq_no
      INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
         cert_audit_log.user_id = user_name.user_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local FROM item_prod) item_prod ON
         job.wo_id = item_prod.wo_id
     ) temptable
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step job_step ON
   temptable.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
   temptable.oper_id = job_step.oper_id  AND
   temptable.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
   temptable.step_no = job_step.step_no
INNER JOIN ent ent ON temptable.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id
