/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ofi_lm_preview_nl_Query
-- Description:  This SP returns latest preview type record
--
-- Usage:  This is been used in WO managment and Job management Preview functionality
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  CK          2024-01-24          Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-04-01          Updated to use the new tables structure
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_lm_preview_nl_Query]
AS
  BEGIN
      SET nocount ON;

      DECLARE @cols         AS NVARCHAR(max),
              @query        AS NVARCHAR(max),
              @maxPreviewId NVARCHAR(100);

      SELECT @cols = Stuff((SELECT ',' + Quotename(as_value)
                            FROM   [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details]
                                   lpld WITH(NOLOCK)
								   JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh ON lpld.label_id = lplh.label_id
								   JOIN ofi_lm_layout_name lln ON lplh.layout_id = lln.layout_id
                            WHERE  lplh.is_active = 1
                                   AND lplh.is_label_processed = 0
                                   AND lplh.label_type = 'preview'
                            GROUP  BY as_value,
                                      layout_name
                            ORDER  BY as_value
                            FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'),
                     1
                     , 1,
                     '')

      SET @query = N'SELECT ' + @cols
                   +
N' from                (                  select    ISNULL(lpld.actual_value,lpld.default_value) as actual_value , as_value from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] lpld WITH(NOLOCK)  JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh ON lpld.label_id = lplh.label_id
								   JOIN ofi_lm_layout_name lln ON lplh.layout_id = lln.layout_id       
				where lplh.is_active=1 and lplh.is_label_processed=0  and lplh.label_type='
             + '''preview'''
             + ' and lln.layout_name=layout_name and lpld.label_id IN (Select max(label_id) from ofi_lm_print_label_details ld WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN ofi_lm_print_label_header lplh ON ld.label_id = lplh.label_id where lplh.label_type='
             + '''preview'''
             + ' and lplh.is_active=1 and lplh.is_label_processed=0)               ) x              pivot               (                  max (actual_value)                  for as_value in (' + @cols
             + N')              ) p '

    EXEC Sp_executesql
      @query;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_CertStartAllowed]
(@user_id 	STRING40,
@process_id 	STRING40 = Null,
@oper_id 	STRING40 = Null,
@step_no 	INT32 = Null,
@item_id 	STRING40 = Null,
@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--02/07/2006	Raghu		3.1.9	HD# 6871, Added certification name to error message.
--09/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.23	HD# 6871, Added certification name to the first error string.
--09/26/2012    Praveen kumar  4.6  Throws an error message if the user doent have the certification
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @cert_name 		STRING40,
	@reqd_level 		INT32,
	@duration 		INT32,
	@audit			LOGICAL,
	@user_cert_level	INT32,
	@expiry			TDATETIME,
	@cert_checked		LOGICAL,
	@current_time		TDATETIME,
	@err_desc		NVARCHAR(4000),
	@user_cert_name		STRING80

BEGIN
	SELECT @cert_checked = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @server_time=@current_time OUTPUT

   IF (@process_id is NOT NULL and @process_id <> '') OR (@oper_id is NOT NULL and @oper_id <> '') BEGIN
-- iF process_id and oper_id is not null, then check for step_no, depending on the values passed, frame a cursor
	IF (@step_no is NULL or @step_no = '')  BEGIN
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
			from cert_oper_link cert_oper_link, cert_type cert_type
			where cert_oper_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
					and (cert_oper_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) and cert_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id
   	END
   	ELSE IF (@step_no is NOT NULL and @step_no <> '')  BEGIN
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_step_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
			from cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type
			where cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no
/*			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_step_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.audit
			from cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type, cert_oper_link cert_oper_link
			where cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_oper_link.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = cert_oper_link.process_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = cert_oper_link.oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no*/
	END
	OPEN cert_cursor
	 --Condition added for the CRL00120133
	IF (@@CURSOR_ROWS < 1) BEGIN
		SET @cert_checked = 1
	END
   	WHILE (1=1)
   	BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT from cert_cursor into @cert_name, @reqd_level, @duration, @audit
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @cert_checked = 1
		if (@audit = 0) BEGIN
		 	SELECT @user_cert_level = cert_user_link.cert_level, @expiry =  cert_user_link.expiry
				,@user_cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			FROM cert_user_link cert_user_link
			INNER JOIN cert_type cert_type ON cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			WHERE cert_user_link.cert_name = @cert_name and user_id = @user_id
			IF (@user_cert_level is null) BEGIN
--				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a valid certification.{3327},' + @user_id
--				RAISERROR('User does not have a valid certification.{3327}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF @user_cert_level < @reqd_level BEGIN
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
--				RAISERROR('Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level.{3328}', 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF @expiry < @current_time BEGIN
--				RAISERROR('Users Certificate has expired.{3329}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE cert_cursor
	DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
   END
/*   ELSE  BEGIN
-- process_id, and oper_id is null, so frame a cursor based on user_id
   	DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		select cert_type.cert_name, cert_type.max_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.audit
		from cert_user_link cert_user_link, cert_type cert_type
		where cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		and cert_user_link.user_id = @user_id
   END
*/
   IF (@item_id is NOT NULL and @item_id <> '') BEGIN
	DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		select cert_type.cert_name, cert_type.max_level,
		cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
		from cert_item_link cert_item_link, cert_type cert_type
		where cert_item_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		and cert_item_link.item_id = @item_id
	OPEN cert_cursor
	 --Condition added for the CRL00120133
	IF (@@CURSOR_ROWS < 1) BEGIN
		SET @cert_checked = 1
	END
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
   		FETCH NEXT from cert_cursor into @cert_name, @reqd_level, @duration, @audit
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @cert_checked = 1
		if (@audit = 0) BEGIN
	 		select @user_cert_level = cert_user_link.cert_level, @expiry = cert_user_link.expiry
				,@user_cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			from cert_user_link cert_user_link
			INNER JOIN cert_type cert_type ON cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			where cert_user_link.cert_name = @cert_name and user_id = @user_id
			if (@user_cert_level is null) BEGIN
--        				RAISERROR('User does not have a valid certification{3327}', 16, 1, @@error)
--					SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a valid certification.{3327},' + @user_id
				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
        				RETURN -1
			END
			if @user_cert_level < @reqd_level BEGIN
--        				RAISERROR('Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level{3328}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
       				RETURN -1
			END
			if @expiry < @current_time BEGIN
--    				RAISERROR('Users Certificate has expired{3329}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
               			RETURN -1
			END
		END
   	END
   	CLOSE cert_cursor
   	DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
   END
   --Added for the CRL00120133
   if (@cert_checked = 0) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('No Certification{482}', 16, 1, @@error)
             	RETURN -1
   END

RETURN 0
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJRSUData]
-- Description: Used to process the Job New SU request: RSU
--
--  JOB  New SU Request: RSU - AUT to MES
--
--	STEPS:
--	1 - Get current Job Pos from JOb_EXEC: SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_GETCURRJOBPOS
--  2 - Find if there is a next silo on queue: sp_s_ofi_NextSUInQueue; if no new silo -> Exit
--  3 - Check Silo status; if not valid status -> Exit
--  4 - Check message type; if NOT IN 1, 2, 5 or 8 - Exit
--	5 - Update the Next Silo in Queu: sp_u_ofi_NextSUInQueue.

--	FINISHED...


--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE JRSU object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC   	2025-08-12   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC		2025-08-13			REMOVED the Active SU part
-- 0.01.02	JSC		2026-01-07			CR553: For CB check for Oper Attr and send warning instead of error when No Next SU is found
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE           PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJRSUData]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'JRSU',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5,
			@cfg_feedback_timeout INT = 30;

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(50)),23)+ FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmssfff');
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(@TranName,29) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		
		-- moved here
		IF @TranCounter = 0
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
		ELSE
			SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN

			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@item_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL, 
					@seq_no INT,													
					@storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
					@last_su_number NVARCHAR(40), 
					@message_type INT, 	
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,	
					@debug INT = 0,
					@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@item_id = item_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@storage_unit = storage_unit
					,@last_su_number = last_su_number
					,@message_type = message_type
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				item_id NVARCHAR(80) '$.item_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',	
				storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) '$.storage_unit',
				last_su_number NVARCHAR(40) '$.last_su_number', 
				message_type INT '$.message_type', 	
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME '$.recorded_timestamp' 
			);
	
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based) SEGMENT NAME_INTERFACETYPE_EXTRAINFO
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT: sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT
			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = wa.output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			
			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type, @ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'				
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- Declare the outputs 
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				--,@data_job_qty_prod FLOAT
				--,@data_job_qty_reqd FLOAT
				--,@data_process_id nvarchar(40)
				--,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				--,@data_bom_pos	INT								
				--,@data_factor	FLOAT
				--,@data_thr_result	INT
				--,@data_to_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				--,@data_to_qty FLOAT
				--,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				--,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				--,@data_su_result INT
				--,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT	@data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
					--,@data_process_id = process_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state, qty prod and qty req
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
					--,@data_job_qty_prod = j.qty_prod
					--,@data_job_qty_reqd = j.qty_reqd
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if JOB is new or ready ERROR; Else is not RUNNING (3) (nor new nor Ready) then WARNING  -- ,7,8,9
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED, 7, 8, 9 -- Avoid errors -- 4,5 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500030,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500031,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			IF @data_job_pos = -1
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(5438,NULL,NULL)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_pos_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- GET USER ID
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			-- Verify that we are not in TIMEOUT:
			
			-- Verify if we are OK within timeout margin of processing the message
			DECLARE @timeout_timestamp DATETIME
					,@curTime DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			SET @recorded_timestamp = COALESCE(@recorded_timestamp,@current_timestamp) -- MOD: v1.03 swap places
			SET @timeout_timestamp = DATEADD(SECOND, @cfg_feedback_timeout, @recorded_timestamp)
			
			
			IF @curTime > @timeout_timestamp
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500040,NULL,NULL)+' @recorded_timestamp: '+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@recorded_timestamp,121) + '; @timeout_timestamp: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@timeout_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timeout_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Check if there is any silo:
			DECLARE @nextSUInQueue TABLE (	last_storage_ent_id INT,
											storage_unit_ent_id INT,
											storage_unit_aut_id INT,
											silo_status INT,
											storage_unit_item_id NVARCHAR(100)
										)
			
			 DECLARE  @last_storage_ent_id INT = 0,
					  @storage_unit_ent_id INT = 0,
					  @storage_unit_aut_id INT = 0,
					  @silo_status INT = 0,
					  @storage_unit_item_id NVARCHAR(100)
			
			INSERT INTO @nextSUInQueue
			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_NextSUInQueue] 
						   @type = @message_type
						  ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  ,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
						  ,@aut_storage_id = @last_su_number

			SELECT TOP 1 
					 @last_storage_ent_id = last_storage_ent_id
					,@storage_unit_ent_id = storage_unit_ent_id
					,@storage_unit_aut_id = storage_unit_aut_id
					,@silo_status = silo_status
					,@storage_unit_item_id = storage_unit_item_id
			FROM @nextSUInQueue

			-- SILO NOT FOUND
			IF @storage_unit_aut_id <= 0 OR @storage_unit_aut_id IS NULL
			BEGIN
				
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500041,NULL,NULL)+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@last_su_number) + '; @message_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@message_type)
				
				--v1.02 MOD:
				DECLARE @OperAttrDescNoNextSUWarning NVARCHAR(80) = 'SendWarningAUTNoSecondSU'
				DECLARE @oa_value INT = 0

				SELECT @oa_value = oa.attr_value
				FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
					JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id AND a.attr_desc = @OperAttrDescNoNextSUWarning
				WHERE oa.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
			
				--failsafe
				SET @oa_value = COALESCE(@oa_value,0)

				-- When not configured or value = 0 then we send error otherwise we send warning
				IF @oa_value = 0
				BEGIN
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
				END

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'no_silo_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			IF @silo_status > 0 OR @silo_status IS NULL
			BEGIN
				
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500042,NULL,NULL)+' @storage_unit_aut_id: '+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@storage_unit_aut_id)  + '; @message_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@message_type)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'bad_Status_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			IF @message_type NOT IN (1, 2, 5, 8) --1 new source, 2 destination Main Item, 5 Destination co-product, 8 all destinations
			BEGIN
				
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500043,NULL,NULL)+ '; @message_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@message_type)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'bad_Status_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			DECLARE @result_Update_NextSU INT = 0
			EXECUTE @result_Update_NextSU = [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_NextSUInQueue] 
										   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
										  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
										  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
										  ,@message_type = @message_type
										  ,@Old_SU = @last_su_number
										  ,@New_SU = @storage_unit_aut_id

			IF @message_type = 1
			BEGIN		

				--if validation is OK we now can create a new Sublot	 -- no feedback expected			
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Sublot_Attr] 
						@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						,@seq_no = @seq_no
						,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
						,@eventName = 'RSUChange'
			END

			------ Not NEEDED to do active silo here; will be done by Job_out interface if SENT to DCS ONLY
			

			-- Do the final part prior to exiting the process
			Finishing_OK:

			PRINT 'Finishing OK'

			-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
			IF @status_output = 1 
			BEGIN
				-- SET OK
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
				SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500039,NULL,NULL)
			END

			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		-- Exit place
		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

		SET @message_output = @message_output + @message


		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		BEGIN TRY
			---- ADDed extras v1.03  ==> if state is -1 then we just need to rollback all
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			-- Find the last opening brace
			DECLARE @start INT = LEN(@message_output) - CHARINDEX('{', REVERSE(@message_output)) + 1;

			-- Find the corresponding closing brace
			DECLARE @end INT = CHARINDEX('}', @message_output, @start);

			-- Remove the substring if both braces are found
			IF @start > 0 AND @end > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = STUFF(@message_output, @start, @end - @start + 1, '');
			END

			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@status_output)+';message_output:'+@message_output
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
					,@status_output as status_output
					,@message_output as message_output
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

SELECT oper_prod_rule.process_id

       (oper_prod_rule.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.standard_value = @standard_value OR @standard_value IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.relational_op = @relational_op OR @relational_op IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.sp_name = @sp_name OR @sp_name IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.next_oper_id = @next_oper_id OR @next_oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.next_ent_id = @next_ent_id OR @next_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.is_default = @is_default OR @is_default IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_prod_rule.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_JobTabGrid]
(
	@sel_wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
) 
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_GetJobQueueByFilter
-- Description       - Return a recordset using the job filters stored in ui_config table
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 09/12/2003
-- Version           - 2.0.10
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
-- 10/27/2003    Rich Boyle 	2.0.0.6	 Added the num_decimals_h column
-- 10/29/2003	 Raghu		2.0.0.6	 Renamed to GetJobQueueByFilter from GetByFilter as this filter is specifically applied to JobQueue (Queue window in Supervisor)
-- 11/21/2003    Sheetal Jain   2.0.10   (HD#4035) New alias row_id_h for row_id
-- 03/17/2004	Raghu		2.0.29	(HD# 4600) Included Item Spare fields returned via Recordset
-- 06/24/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	changed item.units to uom.uom_description
-- 07/06/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Added edit_time as edit_time_h column in the select clause
--08/19/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Added job_pos as job_pos_h in the resultset column
--01/11/2005	Raghu		2.1.12	Changed uom_id to uom_id_h
--03/03/2005	Raghu		2.1.15	HD# 5440, Include def_lot_no for bom_pos=0
--05/26/2005	Raghu		2.1.22	HD# 4603, Included job spares 1-4
--08/10/2005	Rich Boyle	2.1.26   HD #6109, Added First_job filter
--09/09/2005	Rich Boyle	2.1.28	HD #5932, Added concurrent_link as last column returned
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/31/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 6554, Added wo_desc column.
--11/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Included queue_item_attributes and queue_job_attributes in the queue.
--02/15/2006	Rich		3.1.10	Removed ent.description as a returned column
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities; Prepend 'N' before concatenating each string.
--07/27/2006	Raghu		3.1.20	HD# 8513, Cancelled and Complete times are not calculated properly
--02/19/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--08/30/2007	Raghu		3.3.0	Part of DB Changes
--08/31/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--09/20/2011	Rupak		4.2     Modified for CR116713.
--08/14/2014    Ashwin      5.0		Modified to return 'est_prod_rate' & 'num_decimals_good_pp'
--04/26/2018	Raghu G		6.0		UserStory:1018398-As Bruce,  I want to be able to get the queue by filter which will return all jobs queued to an entity as well as jobs queued to the schedulable parents of an entity (SP)
--06/25/2020	Anwar P		6.2		UserStory:1331561- MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00158764 (HF CR 156681: When Loading the Job queue form it takes many seconds for the data to show up in the grid with only a few jobs . It is significantly slower than any other grid.).
--08/11/2023	SSB			7.0		Added wo only parameter for job_tab
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE 
 @ent_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) =null
,@job_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) =null
,@incl_sched_parents	LOGICAL=null
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 =0
DECLARE @dynamicString NVARCHAR(MAX);
SET @dynamicString = N'$$$$$$CANCELLED=0$$$$COMPLETED=0$$$$WO_ID=' + @sel_wo_id + N'$$$$OPER_ID=%%$$$$SEQ_NO=%%$$$$ITEM_ID=%%$$';
SET @job_filter=@dynamicString
DECLARE
@ent_ids 	NVARCHAR(4000) -- Modified for CR115544
	,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(50)
	,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@seq_no	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@item_desc	NVARCHAR(90)
	-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
	,@first_job          NVARCHAR(90)
	,@state_cd 	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@complete_time	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@cancel_time	NVARCHAR(40)
--	,@current_time	NVARCHAR(20)
-- CR L00108373 - Changed from NVARCHAR(4000) to NVARCHAR(max) to prevent a string truncation.
DECLARE  @selectClause NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@joinClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@sSQL 		NVARCHAR(max)
	,@temp_SQL 	NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@start		INT
	,@end		INT
	,@current_time	DATETIME
	,@cancel_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@complete_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@num_decimals_good_pp INT32
	,@param_def NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326
	SELECT @selectClause = ''
	SET @ent_ids = @ent_filter
	SET @filter = @job_filter
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF @ent_ids IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @selectClause = ';WITH c AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @ent_ids, j+1) FROM c WHERE j > i), ent_list_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@ent_ids, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@ent_ids)+1)-i-1) ent_id FROM c WHERE i >= 0), ent_list AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN ent_id = '''' THEN NULL ELSE ent_id END) ent_id FROM ent_list_abst)'
		IF (@incl_sched_parents IS NOT NULL AND @incl_sched_parents = 1) BEGIN
			SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', ents (parent_ent_id, can_sched_jobs) AS
					(select e.ent_id, e.can_sched_jobs FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ent_parent.ent_id, ent_parent.can_sched_jobs
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ents parent ON e.ent_id = parent.parent_ent_id
					INNER JOIN ent ent_parent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_parent.ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
					), distinct_ents AS (SELECT DISTINCT parent_ent_id FROM ents)
					'
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN distinct_ents de ON j.target_sched_ent_id = de.parent_ent_id'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id'
		END
	END

	IF @selectClause = '' SET @selectClause = ';WITH ' ELSE SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'a AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @state_cd, j+1) FROM a WHERE j > i), state_codes_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@state_cd, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@state_cd)+1)-i-1) state_cd FROM a WHERE i >= 0), state_codes AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN state_cd = '''' THEN NULL ELSE state_cd END) state_cd FROM state_codes_abst) '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'SELECT isnull(ent.description, ent.ent_name) as ent_name,i.item_id,i.item_desc,i.uom_id uom_id_h,uom.description uom_description,i.lifetime,i.unit_cost,i.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',p.process_id,p.process_status,wo.wo_id,wo.req_qty,wo.release_time_utc, wo.release_time_local, DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value,wo.release_time_utc) release_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',wo.wo_priority,wo.cust_info'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.state_cd,j.job_priority,j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.req_finish_time_utc) req_finish_time,j.target_sched_ent_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.qty_reqd,j.qty_prod,j.qty_rejected,j.qty_at_start,j.batch_size,j.first_job,j.final_job,j.est_prod_rate'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_start_time_utc,j.sched_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_start_time_utc) sched_start_time,j.latest_start_time_utc,j.latest_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.latest_start_time_utc) latest_start_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_finish_time_utc,j.sched_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_finish_time_utc) sched_finish_time,j.notes,j.status_notes,js.state_desc as state_desc_h, js.color color_h'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',op.oper_desc,j.act_start_time_utc,j.act_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time,j.act_finish_time_utc,j.act_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_finish_time_utc) act_finish_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ent.can_sched_jobs,wo.mo_id, j.run_ent_id, ent2.ent_name Run_Ent_name,j.row_id row_id_h,i.num_decimals num_decimals_h,COALESCE(@num_decimals_good_pp, 0) AS num_decimals_good_pp'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',i.spare1,i.spare2,i.spare3,i.spare4,j.edit_time as edit_time_h,je.job_pos job_pos_h,jb.def_lot_no '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.spare1 job_spare1,j.spare2 job_spare2,j.spare3 job_spare3,j.spare4 job_spare4,j.concurrent_link,wo.wo_desc,qia.*,qja.* '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = j.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id=j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id=j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no=j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = wo.process_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.state_cd = j.state_cd'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = wo.process_id AND op.oper_id = j.oper_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ent.ent_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ent2.ent_id '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = j.run_ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia WITH (NOLOCK) ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h=i.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja WITH (NOLOCK) ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h=j.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h=j.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h=j.seq_no'

	IF (@joinClause IS NOT NULL) SET @selectClause = @selectClause + @joinClause

	SET @sSQL = ' WHERE jb.bom_pos=0 '

	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @start = 3
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @state_cd = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			IF RIGHT(@state_cd, 1) = ',' SET @state_cd = LEFT(@state_cd, LEN(@state_cd) -1)
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @cancel_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @cancel_time = REPLACE(@cancel_time, 'CANCELLED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @complete_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @complete_time = REPLACE(@complete_time, 'COMPLETED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @wo_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @wo_id = REPLACE(@wo_id, 'WO_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @oper_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @oper_id = REPLACE(@oper_id, 'OPER_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @seq_no = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @seq_no = REPLACE(@seq_no, 'SEQ_NO=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_id = REPLACE(@item_id, 'ITEM_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_desc = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_desc = REPLACE(@item_desc, 'ITEM_DESC=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @first_job = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @first_job = REPLACE(@first_job, 'FIRST_JOB=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		IF @state_cd = '' SET @state_cd = NULL
		IF (@cancel_time = ''  OR @cancel_time = '0') SET @cancel_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @cancel_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @cancel_time)))
		ELSE SET @cancel_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @cancel_time), @current_time)

		IF (@complete_time = '' OR @complete_time = '0') SET @complete_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @complete_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @complete_time)))
		ELSE SET @complete_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @complete_time),  @current_time)

		IF @wo_id = '' SET @wo_id = NULL
		IF @oper_id = '' SET @oper_id = NULL
		IF @seq_no = '' SET @seq_no = NULL
		IF @item_id = '' SET @item_id = NULL
		IF @item_desc = '' SET @item_desc = NULL
		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		IF @first_job = '' SET @first_job = NULL

		--Work Order ID Filter
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @wo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @wo_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id LIKE @wo_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id = @wo_id '
		END
		--Oper ID Filter
		IF (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id LIKE @oper_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id = @oper_id '
		END

		--Seq No Filter
		IF (@seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @seq_no) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @seq_no) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no LIKE @seq_no '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no =  @seq_no '
		END

		--Item ID Filter
		IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id LIKE @item_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id = @item_id '
		END

		--Item Desc Filter
		IF (@item_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_desc) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc = @item_desc '
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		-- First Job Filter
		IF (@first_job is not null and @first_job = '1') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.first_job = 1'
		END

		--state_cd filter
		IF (@state_cd = '4') OR (@state_cd = '7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = @state_cd '
--			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH,j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time  + ') <= ' + @complete_time
--			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @cancel_time
			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 4 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt'
			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 7 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt'
		END
		ELSE IF (@state_cd = '4,7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND ((js.state_cd = 4 OR js.state_cd = 7) '

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				--SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (js.state_cd = CASE WHEN (js.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @complete_time + ' THEN js.state_cd END ELSE js.state_cd END)'
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ')'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN state_codes sc ON js.state_cd = sc.state_cd'
			END

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

		END
	END	-- end of filter-state_code exists to filter records

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY j.sched_start_time_utc, j.job_priority'
	--PRINT @sSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias_value INT, @num_decimals_good_pp INT, @ent_ids NVARCHAR(4000), @wo_id NVARCHAR(50), @oper_id NVARCHAR(50), @seq_no NVARCHAR(50), @item_id NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ', @item_desc NVARCHAR(90), @complete_time_dt DATETIME, @cancel_time_dt DATETIME, @state_cd NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @sSQL = @selectClause + @sSQL
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @param_def, @time_zone_bias_value, @num_decimals_good_pp, @ent_ids, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id, @item_desc, @complete_time_dt, @cancel_time_dt, @state_cd
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@wo_id		STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@seq_no	INT32
,@user_id	STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for a job (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific job)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 12/15/2004
-- Version                  - 2.1.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--06/27/2005	Raghu		2.1.23	Added restriction to filter attributes that does not have valid certifications
--10/31/2005	Raghu		2.1.31/3.1.0	HD# 6624, Sort attributes by attr_desc.
--11/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Entry_type column is included.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 5 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM job_attr WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 5 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM job_attr WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--07/27/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 4883) Validate type of specification values
--10/23/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,@assoc_file_type STRING20
	,@assoc_file STRING254

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_spec js
			INNER JOIN  inserted i ON js.wo_id = i.wo_id AND js.oper_id = i.oper_id AND js.seq_no = i.seq_no AND js.step_no = i.step_no AND js.spec_id = i.spec_id
			INNER JOIN spec ON i.spec_id = spec.spec_id
		WHERE spec.data_type =1 AND
		  (ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.spec_value, -1)) = 0 OR ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.act_spec_value, -1)) = 0 OR ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.min_value, -1)) = 0
		OR ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.max_value, -1)) = 0)) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Spec value, act_spec_value, min_value and max_value should be numeric{3185}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Make sure the assoc_file_type is set to the extension for the assoc_file
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.wo_id = d.wo_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.seq_no = d.seq_no AND i.step_no = d.step_no AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
		WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) BEGIN

		IF Exists(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM inserted i
			WHERE i.assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		UPDATE job_spec SET assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(x.assoc_file)
		FROM (SELECT i.assoc_file, i.wo_id, i.oper_id, i.seq_no, i.step_no, i.spec_id
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.wo_id = d.wo_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.seq_no = d.seq_no AND i.step_no = d.step_no AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE job_spec.wo_id = x.wo_id AND job_spec.oper_id = x.oper_id AND job_spec.seq_no = x.seq_no AND job_spec.step_no = x.step_no AND job_spec.spec_id = x.spec_id

		INSERT INTO file_type
		(file_ext, edit_level, view_level, print_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT x.file_ext, 1, 1, 1, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM (SELECT dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) as file_ext
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.wo_id = d.wo_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.seq_no = d.seq_no AND i.step_no = d.step_no AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE x.file_ext IS NOT NULL AND x.file_ext NOT IN (SELECT file_ext FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK))
	END

	UPDATE job_spec SET job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_spec.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE job_spec.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_spec.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_spec.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_spec.step_no = i.step_no AND job_spec.spec_id = i.spec_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Lot]
(@item_id nvarchar(40)
,@lot_no nvarchar(40)
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_D_lot
-- Description      - Delete an existing row in the table
-- Author			- AUTO GENERATED CLASS
-- Date Created	     -	01/01/2007
-- Version			- 3.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified		Modified_By		Version			Changes
-- 05/01/2007			Raghu			3.2.0.10		Deleting a lot should verify whether there is any inventory linked to it.
-- 06/29/2007			AML				3.2.16			HD#10102, Deleting a lot should also delete inventory where the quantity is 0.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @err_msg VARCHAR(254), @ent_name NVARCHAR(40)

	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id and lot_no = @lot_no and item_inv.qty_left > 0 ) BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name
                FROM ent e
                INNER JOIN item_inv ii ON ii.ent_id = e.ent_id
                WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id
                AND ii.lot_no = @lot_no
                AND ii.qty_left > 0

		--There are inventory record(s) for this item and lot.  Raise an exception to the caller.
		SET @err_msg = 'This lot: %1 cannot be deleted, because the inventory location: %2 has this item: %3.{5532},' + @lot_no + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + @item_id
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	DELETE FROM item_inv WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lot_no = @lot_no

	DELETE lot WHERE item_id = @item_id AND  lot_no = @lot_no
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name: [sp_SA_ofi_auto_close_check]

-- Description: Fetches Work Orders that are in Completed state where ALL their jobs 
--              are also Completed, Closed or Canceled, ready for Auto Close.
--
-- Usage:
-- EXEC [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_auto_close_check]
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version    Author       Date (yyyy-MM-dd)       Change description
-- 0.01.00    AML, XPM     2026-03-24              Initial version.
-- 0.01.01    AML, XPM     2026-04-15              Added the mod_id 
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_auto_close_check]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT 
		 w.wo_id, 
		  CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, w.mod_id))) AS 'mod_id'
	FROM wo w WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN process_attr pa WITH(NOLOCK) ON w.process_id = pa.process_id
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON pa.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'CanAutoClose'
	  AND pa.attr_value = '1'  
	  AND w.state_cd = 2       
	  AND NOT EXISTS (
		  SELECT 1 
		  FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j.wo_id = w.wo_id 
		    AND j.state_cd NOT IN (4, 7)  
	  )
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_bom_item_oper_link_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_link]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_bom_item_oper_link_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_link table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
--06/03/2005	Raghu		2.1.22	HD# 5736, num_decimals should be rounded to item_id; not to parent_item_id
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--09/26/2012	Ravi Teja	4.6	    CR L00122689 - (Merge of CR L00122266) Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item of bom_item_oper_link table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		BIT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_link a, inserted b
				WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id  AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id  AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},bom_item_oper_link', 16, 1)
				RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE bom_item_oper_link SET bom_item_oper_link.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item
		,bom_item_oper_link.last_edit_by = @user_id, bom_item_oper_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN bom_item bi ON bi.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bi.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bi.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	INNER JOIN item it ON bi.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bom_item_oper_link.ver_id = i.ver_id  AND bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	     AND bom_item_oper_link.process_id = i.process_id  AND bom_item_oper_link.oper_id = i.oper_id

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_link a, inserted b
		WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
		  AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos  AND a.process_id = b.process_id
		  AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id) biol
	WHERE process.process_id = biol.process_id

END

-- ================================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_S_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUomId
-- Description:	Returns the converted quantity of a material based on the source and destination 
--              unit of measures.
-- ================================================================================================
-- Version		By		Date			Change Description
-- 1.0			AG		2019-03-25		Initial version.
-- ================================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUomId] 
(
	@item_id     nvarchar(40)
,	@qty         float
,   @from_uom_id int
,	@to_uom_id   int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM (
		SELECT uc.item_id
		,	   @qty AS qty
		,	   (@qty * COALESCE(uc.factor, 1)) + COALESCE(uc.offset, 0) AS qty_conv
		,	   uf.uom_id AS from_uom_id
		,	   uf.description AS from_uom_desc
		,	   uf.abbreviation AS from_uom_abbr
		,	   ut.uom_id AS to_uom_id
		,	   ut.description AS to_uom_desc
		,	   ut.abbreviation AS to_uom_abbr
		,	   IIF(uc.item_id IS NULL, 1, 0) AS order_by
		FROM uom_conv uc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN uom uf WITH (NOLOCK) ON uf.uom_id = @from_uom_id AND uf.uom_id = uc.from_uom_id
		INNER JOIN uom ut WITH (NOLOCK) ON ut.uom_id = @to_uom_id   AND ut.uom_id = uc.to_uom_id
		WHERE (uc.item_id = @item_id OR uc.item_id IS NULL)

		UNION

		SELECT @item_id
		,	   @qty
		,	   @qty
		,	   u.uom_id
		,	   u.description
		,	   u.abbreviation
		,	   u.uom_id
		,	   u.description
		,	   u.abbreviation
		,	   2 AS order_by
		FROM uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE u.uom_id   = @from_uom_id
		  AND @to_uom_id = @from_uom_id
		) AS s
	ORDER BY order_by
)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_shipment_lot_shipxml]
(
	@xml_source              NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value    INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@mod_id                  INT32 OUTPUT

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_OPER_STEP_COPY_XML
-- Description          - Copies each operation/step to a new process/operation/
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 10/01/2007
-- Version              - 3.3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver        Changes
-- 10/31/2015     Srinivasa,Tentu  6.3        US#928808; Merge CR L00146847 to merge HF CR L00146333(Fixed conversion error
											  -- and XML attribute queried for)
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@cust_id			STRING80,
			@po_id              STRING80,
			@so_line_no         INT32,
			@ship_date_local    TDATETIME,
			@lot_no             STRING80,
			@sublot_no          STRING80,
			@qty_shipped        TFLOAT,
			@uom_id             INT32,
			@trans_id           INT32,
			@last_edit_comment  STRING254,
			@user_id            STRING40,
			@item_id            STRING80,
			@row_id             INT32,
			@ent_id             INT32,
			@qty_to_ship        TFLOAT,
			@grade_cd           INT32,
			@status_cd          INT32,
			@wo_id              STRING80,
			@oper_id            STRING80,
			@seq_no             INT32,
			@ret                INT32,
			@doc_handle			INT32

    --Convert the input xml to XML Type.
    EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

    --Open the xml, and read stuff...
	SELECT	@cust_id = CASE WHEN cust_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE cust_id END
		,	@po_id = CASE WHEN po_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE po_id END
		,	@so_line_no = CASE WHEN so_line_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE so_line_no END
		,	@ship_date_local = CASE WHEN ship_date_local = '' THEN NULL ELSE ship_date_local END
		,	@lot_no = CASE WHEN lot_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE lot_no END
		,	@sublot_no = CASE WHEN sublot_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE sublot_no END
		,	@qty_shipped = CASE WHEN qty_shipped = '' THEN NULL ELSE qty_shipped END
		,	@uom_id = CASE WHEN uom_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE uom_id END
		,	@trans_id = CASE WHEN trans_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE trans_id END
		,	@last_edit_comment = CASE WHEN last_edit_comment = '' THEN NULL ELSE last_edit_comment END
		,	@user_id = CASE WHEN user_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE user_id END
		,	@item_id = CASE WHEN item_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE item_id END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (	cust_id NVARCHAR(160),
			po_id NVARCHAR(160),
			so_line_no NVARCHAR(160),
			ship_date_local NVARCHAR(160),
			lot_no NVARCHAR(160),
			sublot_no NVARCHAR(160),
			qty_shipped NVARCHAR(160),
			uom_id NVARCHAR(160),
			trans_id NVARCHAR(160),
			last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(160),
			user_id NVARCHAR(160),
			item_id NVARCHAR(160)	)

    EXEC sp_i_shipment_lot	@cust_id, @po_id, @so_line_no, @ship_date_local, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @qty_shipped, @uom_id,
							@trans_id, @last_edit_comment, @time_zone_bias_value, @row_id, @mod_id


	--Get a list of nodes that contains the 'choice' element.
	DECLARE item_inv_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN ent_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE ent_id END AS ent_id
		,	CASE WHEN qty_ship = '' THEN NULL ELSE qty_ship END AS qty_to_ship
		,	CASE WHEN grade_cd = '' THEN NULL ELSE grade_cd END AS grade_cd
		,	CASE WHEN status_cd = '' THEN NULL ELSE status_cd END AS status_cd
		,	CASE WHEN wo_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE wo_id END AS wo_id
		,	CASE WHEN oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE oper_id END AS oper_id
		,	CASE WHEN seq_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE seq_no END AS seq_no
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/item_inv', 2)
	WITH (	ent_id  NVARCHAR(160),
			qty_ship  NVARCHAR(160),
			grade_cd  NVARCHAR(160),
			status_cd  NVARCHAR(160),
			wo_id  NVARCHAR(160),
			oper_id  NVARCHAR(160),
			seq_no  NVARCHAR(160)	)

    OPEN item_inv_cursor
	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

		FETCH NEXT FROM item_inv_cursor INTO @ent_id, @qty_to_ship, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		EXEC @ret = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_to_ship, @reduce_qty_erp=NULL
						, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=1, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=NULL
						, @must_consume_from_inv=NULL, @must_cons_from_wip=NULL, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
						, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=1, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL

	END

	CLOSE item_inv_cursor
	DEALLOCATE item_inv_cursor
