CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_consumption_data]
AS
SELECT distinct item_cons.row_id,
       item_cons.wo_id,
       item_cons.oper_id,
       item_cons.seq_no,
       job_route.input_oper_id,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       item_cons.shift_start_utc,
       item_cons.shift_start_local,
       item_cons.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.item_class_id,
       item_class.item_class_desc,
       item_cons.lot_no,
       item_cons.sublot_no,
       item_cons.fg_lot_no,
       item_cons.fg_sublot_no,
       item_cons.reas_cd,
       item_reas.reas_desc,
       item_reas.reas_grp_id,
       item_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,
       item_cons.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       item_cons.item_scrapped,
       item_cons.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       item_cons.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       item_cons.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_cons.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_cons.from_ent_id,
       from_ent.ent_name from_ent_name,
       item_cons.qty_cons,
       item_cons.qty_cons_erp,
       item_cons.ext_ref,
       item_cons.transaction_type,
       item_cons.spare1,
       item_cons.spare2,
       item_cons.spare3,
       item_cons.spare4,
       item_cons.last_edit_comment,
       item_cons.last_edit_by,
       item_cons.last_edit_at
FROM item_cons
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_route job_route ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job_route.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job_route.oper_id AND
   item_cons.seq_no = job_route.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   item_cons.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN item item ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas ON
   item_cons.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   item_cons.user_id = user_name.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON item_cons.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift ON
   item_cons.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
   item_cons.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
   item_cons.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent from_ent ON
   item_cons.from_ent_id = from_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON
   item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
INNER JOIN item_reas_grp item_reas_grp ON
   item_reas.reas_grp_id = item_reas_grp.reas_grp_id

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_U_EI_inv_corr_wb
-- Description:  Updates wo with qty for inventory correction of weigh bridge
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-20         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Karthik     2022-10-06         Updated values for the SPs (sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd & sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec) parameters
-- 0.01.02  Karthik     2023-01-27         Refer to comments below on the specific date
-- 0.01.03	DS			2023-09-13		   Changed the logic to update the correction qty,
-- 0.01.04	Lavkesh		2023-09-13		   Modified @total_prod_qty as float as it was wrongly taken INT
-- 0.01.05	Lavkesh		2024-06-09		   Added logic to correct inventory for bulk intake order
-- 0.01.06	Lavkesh		2024-06-10		   Old logic for correction is changed, now it will add/reduce from all the avilable lot
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_EI_inv_corr_wb] @plant_code varchar(4),@sto varchar(10),@outbound_delv varchar(10),
@weigh_bridge_id int,@process_order varchar(40),@material_no varchar(40),@batch_no varchar(40),@qty float,
@uom varchar(10),@movement_type varchar(40),@inOrOut varchar(10) as
begin

SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare @wo_id varchar(40),@error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@user varchar(4000),@oper_id varchar(40)
	Declare @total_prod_qty float,@wo_state INT,@ent_id INT,@job_pos INT,@row_id INT ,@prod_info Varchar(4000),@qty_prod float,@processid nvarchar(100),@processtype nvarchar(100)
	Declare @seq_no INT32
	declare @seq_no1 int,@wo_qty float,@id_min int,@id_max int,@qty_left float,@qty_tobereduce float
	declare @oper_id1 varchar(40),@total_inv float,@batch_no1 nvarchar(50),@diff float
	DECLARE @shift_id int, @grade_cd int, @status_cd int, @good_prod int, @shift_start_utc datetime, @shift_start_local datetime, 
		@hour_start_utc datetime, @hour_start_local datetime, @last_edit_at datetime, @created_at_utc datetime, @created_at_local datetime

	  DECLARE @temp_01 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
		ent_id int,
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
		qty_left float,
		row_id int
	)
	--- WO States (0 = Released, 1 = Started, 2 = Completed, 3 = Closed)

	BEGIN try
		print @wo_id
		if @batch_no is null
		select @batch_no=lot_no from ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where wo_id=@process_order
		
		SET @wo_id = @process_order
		SELECT @user = CURRENT_USER
		SELECT @total_prod_qty = sum(qty_prod),@ent_id = max(ent_id),@oper_id = max(oper_id), @seq_no1= max(seq_no) from item_prod with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and lot_no = @batch_no and item_id = @material_no
		SELECT @wo_state = state_cd,@processid=process_id,@wo_qty=req_qty from wo with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id
		SELECT @job_pos = max(job_pos),@seq_no = max(cur_seq_no) from job_exec with (nolock) where cur_wo_id = @wo_id and ent_id = @ent_id
		--SELECT @seq_no = cur_seq_no from job_exec where cur_wo_id = @wo_id and ent_id = @ent_id
		set @seq_no = case when @seq_no is null then @seq_no1 else @seq_no end
		--IF @total_prod_qty < @qty (KN 27/01/23 - Removed this condition as advised as part of defect D056)
		
		select  @seq_no1 = max(itp.seq_no),@oper_id1 = max(itp.oper_id),@total_prod_qty = sum(itp.qty_prod) from item_prod itp with(nolock) 
			inner join job with(nolock) on itp.wo_id = job.wo_id and itp.oper_id = job.oper_id and itp.seq_no= job.seq_no and job.final_job=1
			where itp.wo_id =@wo_id and itp.lot_no = @batch_no and itp.item_id =  @material_no

			--if(@total_prod_qty<@qty) 
			--- -ve & +ve both will be added into item prod
			begin
				set  @qty_prod =  round(@qty -@total_prod_qty,3)
			end 
			

		BEGIN
			BEGIN TRANSACTION
			
			print @qty_prod
			--SET @qty_prod = @qty - @total_prod_qty	(KN 27/01/23 - Removed this as advised as part of defect D056)

			--SET @qty_prod = @qty --(KN 27/01/23 - Added this as advised as part of defect D056)
			DECLARE @tmp DATETIME
			select @tmp = shift_start_local from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id

			insert into @temp_01 select wo_id,ent_id,oper_id,qty_prod,row_id from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id 
			select @total_prod_qty=sum(qty_left) from @temp_01
			update job set qty_prod=@qty where wo_id=@process_order

			IF @total_prod_qty-@qty>0
				BEGIN
				print 'prod'
				--Reduce from MES QTY
				set @qty_tobereduce= @total_prod_qty-@qty
				print @qty_tobereduce
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
				 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min
				 update item_prod set qty_prod=qty_prod-((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty),
				 qty_prod_erp=qty_prod-((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty)
				 where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
				ELSE IF @total_prod_qty-@qty<0
				BEGIN
				print 'prod else'
				--Add in MES Qty
				set @qty_tobereduce= @qty-@total_prod_qty
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
				 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min				 
				 update item_prod set qty_prod=qty_prod+((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty),
				 qty_prod_erp=qty_prod+((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty)
				 where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
				set @error_msg='Updated Values for WO:' +@wo_id+' and operation name:'+@oper_id+' and lot:'+@batch_no+' : ' +CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @qty) 
				exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user
				Commit Transaction
			IF @wo_state < 2			-- If WO state is running, then run sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd (Param values advised by Sudhakar)--old logic
			BEGIN
				/*EXEC sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd @session_id = -1,@event_time_local = NULL,@user_id = @user,
				@ent_id = @ent_id,@job_pos = @job_pos,@qty_prod = @qty_prod,@reas_cd = NULL,@lot_no = NULL,
				@sublot_no = NULL,@to_ent_id = NULL,@item_id = NULL,@byproduct_bom_pos = NULL,@ext_ref = NULL,
				@apply_scaling_factor = 0,@genealogy_id = NULL,@segment_requirement_id = NULL,@segment_response_id = NULL,
				@comments = 'EI Inventory Correction',@spare1 = '',@spare2 = '',@spare3 = '',@spare4 = '',@check_privs = 1,@created_at_utc = NULL,
				@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@row_id = @row_id OUT,@prod_info = @prod_info OUT*/
				select top 1 @shift_id =shift_id, @grade_cd =grade_cd, @status_cd=status_cd, @good_prod=good_prod, @shift_start_utc=shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local =shift_start_local, 
				@hour_start_utc =hour_start_utc, @hour_start_local =hour_start_local, @last_edit_at =last_edit_at, @created_at_utc =created_at_utc, @created_at_local =created_at_local
				from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id order by created_at_local desc
				/*insert into item_prod(wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,item_id,lot_no,reas_cd,user_id,ent_id,shift_id,grade_cd,status_cd,good_prod,qty_prod,last_edit_by,shift_start_utc,shift_start_local,
				hour_start_utc,hour_start_local,last_edit_at,created_at_utc,created_at_local)
				values(@wo_id,@oper_id1,@seq_no1,@material_no,@batch_no,2,@user,@ent_id,@shift_id,@grade_cd,@status_cd,@good_prod,@qty_prod,@user,@shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local,
				@hour_start_utc,@hour_start_local,@last_edit_at,@created_at_utc,@created_at_local)*/
				END
				
			ELSE	
			BEGIN-- Else run sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec (Param values advised by Sudhakar)
				/*EXEC sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec @session_id = -1,@user_id = @user,@ent_id = @ent_id,
				@qty_prod = @qty_prod,@wo_id = @wo_id,@oper_id = @oper_id,@seq_no = @seq_no,@created_at_utc = NULL,
				@shift_start_local = null,@hour_start_local = NULL,@shift_id = NULL,@item_id = NULL,@reas_cd = NULL,
				@lot_no = NULL,@rm_lot_no = NULL,@sublot_no = NULL,@rm_sublot_no =NULL,@to_ent_id = NULL,
				@processed = 0,@byproduct = 0,@ext_ref = NULL,@move_status = 0,@genealogy_id = NULL,
				@event_id = NULL,@segment_requirement_id = NULL,@segment_response_id = NULL,@comments = 'EI Inventory Correction',
				@spare1 = '',@spare2 = '',@spare3 = '',@spare4 = '',@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@row_id = @row_id OUT*/
				select top 1 @shift_id =shift_id, @grade_cd =grade_cd, @status_cd=status_cd, @good_prod=good_prod, @shift_start_utc=shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local =shift_start_local, 
				@hour_start_utc =hour_start_utc, @hour_start_local =hour_start_local, @last_edit_at =last_edit_at, @created_at_utc =created_at_utc, @created_at_local =created_at_local
				from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id order by created_at_local desc
				/*insert into item_prod(wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,item_id,lot_no,reas_cd,user_id,ent_id,shift_id,grade_cd,status_cd,good_prod,qty_prod,last_edit_by,shift_start_utc,shift_start_local,
				hour_start_utc,hour_start_local,last_edit_at,created_at_utc,created_at_local)
				values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@material_no,@batch_no,2,@user,@ent_id,@shift_id,@grade_cd,@status_cd,@good_prod,@qty_prod,@user,@shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local,
				@hour_start_utc,@hour_start_local,@last_edit_at,@created_at_utc,@created_at_local)*/
			END

			-----Logic to correct inventory for bulk intake order----
			select @processtype=attr_value from process_attr with(nolock)
			where process_id=@processid 
			and attr_id in (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='ProcessTypeForSUSelection' and attr_grp=8 )
			if(@processtype='Intake')
			BEGIN
			   delete from @temp_01
			   insert into @temp_01 select wo_id,ent_id,oper_id,qty_left,row_id from item_inv with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and lot_no=@batch_no
			   select @total_inv=sum(qty_left) from @temp_01
			    IF  @total_inv is null or @total_inv=0
				BEGIN
							  SET @error_msg = N'Inventory not avilable  in MES  for order  no:'+@process_order +' and operation name:'+@oper_id+' and lot no:'+@batch_no+''
							  exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user				  ;

							 -- THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
				 END

				IF @total_prod_qty-@qty>0
				BEGIN
					print 'inv'
				--Reduce from MES QTY
				set @qty_tobereduce= @total_prod_qty-@qty
				IF  @total_inv < @qty_tobereduce
				BEGIN
				--select @diff=@qty_tobereduce-@total_inv
							BEGIN TRANSACTION
							print 'update inv'
							delete item_inv  where wo_id=@process_order 
							
							Commit Transaction
							SET @error_msg = N'Insufficient inventory left for correction. current silo inventory is:'+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @total_inv)+'   for  operation name:'+@oper_id+' and lot no:'+@batch_no+' thus making it to 0 for order:'+@process_order
											  ;
								exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user
							 -- THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1

							-- RAISERROR(@error_msg,16,1) with nowait

							
				 END
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
			 	 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min
			  IF @total_inv>0 and @total_inv is not null
				 update item_inv set qty_left=qty_left-((@qty_tobereduce*qty_left)/@total_inv) where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
				ELSE IF @total_prod_qty-@qty<0
				BEGIN
				--Add in MES Qty
				--print 'inv else'
				set @qty_tobereduce= @qty-@total_prod_qty
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
				 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min
				 if @total_inv>0 and @total_inv is not null
				 update item_inv set qty_left=qty_left+((@qty_tobereduce*qty_left)/@total_inv) where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
			END

		--Commit Transaction
		END
		--ELSE					--(KN 27/01/23 - Removed this as advised as part of defect D056)
		--	BEGIN
		--		SET @error_msg =N'Error - sp_U_EI_inv_corr_wb - qty is not less than total production qty  ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),-1);
		--		THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
		--	END

	End Try

    BEGIN catch
     IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

     SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
     RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
   END catch
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeJobStates]
(
		@row_id					INT32
	,	@state_cd				INT32 = NULL
	,	@req_finish_time	TDATETIME = NULL
	,	@job_priority			INT32 = NULL
	,	@apply_to_all_jobs		INT32 = 0
	,	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = 0
	,	@warning_msg			STRING254 OUTPUT

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeJobStates
-- Description			- HD# 5980, Change job states for a list of jobs
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 08/29/2005
-- Version				- 2.1.26
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group PLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/23/2005		Raghu			2.1.29	Included validation check for job_state change permissions.
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/27/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 05/11/2009		Raghu			3.5		The req_finish_time was not updating correctly in the SQL Server database.
-- 07/15/2020       Sara            6.2     L00159063 Merge HF CRL00158855 - Skelta activities (update values and MES command)
--                                          are returning error message when initialize variables/start command is clicked, because
--                                          of that it is not possible to include activity in the flow
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@wo_id					STRING80
		,	@user_id				STRING80
		,	@priv_value				INT32
		,	@cur_state_cd			INT32
		,	@req_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,   @req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SELECT	@apply_to_all_jobs = ISNULL(@apply_to_all_jobs, 0)
		,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
		, @req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	IF (@state_cd IS NOT  NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@state_cd = 3 OR @state_cd = 4 OR @state_cd = 5 OR @state_cd = 8 OR @state_cd = 9) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Invalid job state change.{4202}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SELECT @wo_id = wo_id, @cur_state_cd = state_cd FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = @row_id

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
	EXEC sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, 180, @priv_value OUTPUT

	IF (@cur_state_cd = 6) BEGIN
		IF (@priv_value = 0) BEGIN
			SET @warning_msg = 'The user does not have a privilege to change the status of a job that is currently on hold.{4697}'
		    RETURN
	    END
	END

	IF (@apply_to_all_jobs = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@priv_value = 0) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 6) BEGIN
				SET @warning_msg = 'The user does not have a privilege to change the status of a job that is currently on hold.{4697}'
		        RETURN
			END
		END

		UPDATE job
		SET state_cd = CASE WHEN @state_cd IS NULL THEN state_cd
						ELSE CASE WHEN (state_cd = 6) THEN CASE WHEN (@warning_msg IS NULL) THEN @state_cd ELSE state_cd END ELSE @state_cd END
					   END,
			job_priority = CASE WHEN @job_priority IS NULL THEN job_priority
							ELSE
								CASE WHEN (state_cd = 6) THEN
									CASE WHEN (@warning_msg IS NULL) THEN @job_priority ELSE job_priority END
							ELSE @job_priority END
						END,
			req_finish_time_utc =  CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN @req_finish_time_utc
						ELSE
							CASE WHEN (state_cd = 6) THEN
								CASE WHEN (@warning_msg IS NULL) THEN @req_finish_time_utc
								 	  ELSE req_finish_time_utc END
						ELSE @req_finish_time_utc END
					END
		, req_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_local IS NULL THEN @req_finish_time_local ELSE
						CASE WHEN (state_cd = 6) THEN
							CASE WHEN (@warning_msg IS NULL) THEN @req_finish_time_local
								 	  ELSE req_finish_time_local END
						ELSE @req_finish_time_local END
					END

--CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_utc END,
			/*
			--CASE WHEN @req_finish_time IS NULL THEN req_finish_time ELSE @req_finish_time END
			CASE WHEN (state_cd = 6) THEN
				CASE WHEN (@warning_msg IS NULL) THEN DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time) ELSE req_finish_time END
			ELSE DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time) END
			*/
			--req_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_local IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_local END
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND state_cd NOT IN (3, 4, 7)

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd IN (3, 4, 7))
			IF @warning_msg IS NULL
				SET @warning_msg = 'The job state cannot be changed for some of the jobs in a work order.{4687}'
			ELSE
				SET @warning_msg = 'The job state cannot be changed for some of the jobs in a work order OR the user does not have a privilege to change the status of a job that is currently on hold.{4699}'
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = @row_id AND state_cd IN (3, 4, 7))
			SET @warning_msg = 'The job state cannot be changed for some of the jobs in a work order.{4687}'

		IF (@warning_msg IS NOT NULL) RETURN
		UPDATE job
			SET state_cd = CASE WHEN @state_cd IS NULL THEN state_cd ELSE @state_cd END,
				job_priority = CASE WHEN @job_priority IS NULL THEN job_priority ELSE @job_priority END,
				--req_finish_time_utc = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_utc END,
					--ELSE DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time) END
				--req_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_local IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_local END
			 req_finish_time_utc = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_utc ELSE @req_finish_time_utc END,
             req_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_local IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_local ELSE @req_finish_time_local END
			WHERE row_id = @row_id
	END
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_cancelReleaseJob
-- Description:	
-- 
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		DS				2023-06-27			Initial version
--												#31[BAT List] Before completing the last job (Milling\Roasting job):
												1.	There shouldn’t be any RUNNING or SUSPENDED job exists in the cake blender\BW for a given WO.
													If that exists, then MES will not allow to complete that job (last job).
												2.	If there is any NEW & RELEASED job exists in the cake blender\BW,
													then MES will CANCEL those job automatically.
												3.	If there is any other Milling\Roasting job for same WO exists (in case of split of Milling\Roasting job)
													in NEW, RELEASED, RUNNING and SUSPEND state then the MES will allow that job to be completed.
													AND if not exists then MES will do the validation as mentioned in the point number 1 & 2.
-- 0.02		AKM				2023-07-06			4.	Calling sp to update job bom based on actual consumption for cakeblender job complete so the recipe 
													cabe be used as Last Used.
--===========================================================================================*/

create Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_cancelReleaseJob_bck21_8_25]   
		 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
		,@seq_no int
		,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)

AS
BEGIN

 declare	 @CheckPreviousJobState INT = 0
			,@oper_seq INT
			,@previous_operation NVARCHAR(40)
			,@process_id NVARCHAR(40)
			,@current_time_local AS DATETIME
			,@current_time_utc	AS DATETIME
			,@IsValidSplitJobExists int = 0

	

--  changes related to #0.04  begin
			SELECT @CheckPreviousJobState=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
				AND attr_id = ( SELECT attr_id
								FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
								WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckPreviousJobState' 
									AND attr_grp = 7) --7 = Operation Group 


			if exists(  SELECT 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN  job_state js with(nolock) on job.state_cd = js.state_cd and js.state_desc in ('NEW','RELEASED','RUNNING','SUSPENDED')
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						AND seq_no<>@seq_no  -- Should not be same seq number
						AND oper_id = @oper_id ) AND (@CheckPreviousJobState = 1)
			begin
				set @IsValidSplitJobExists = 1;
			end
	
			if(@CheckPreviousJobState=1 and @IsValidSplitJobExists = 0)
			BEGIN

					SELECT @process_id = process_id, 
						@oper_seq = display_seq 
					FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE oper_id = @oper_id

								
					SELECT TOP 1 @previous_operation = oper_id 
					FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE process_id = @process_id 
						AND display_seq < @oper_seq
						AND oper_id <> @oper_id
					ORDER by display_seq DESC


					 --Check if any of the jobs are running
					--IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 3) BEGIN
					--	RAISERROR('Cancelling jobs for this work order has failed since some of the jobs in this work order are currently being executed.{4204}', 16, 1)
					--	RETURN
					--END

					SELECT	@current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ),
							@current_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

					 --Cancel all the jobs
					UPDATE job SET state_cd = 7, act_finish_time_utc = @current_time_utc, act_finish_time_local = @current_time_local
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @previous_operation
					AND (state_cd = 1 OR state_cd = 2 OR state_cd = 5 OR state_cd = 6)

			END
			
			if(@oper_id ='CakeBlending')
			begin
				exec sp_u_ofi_cb_Update_final_correction @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			end
--  changes related to #0.04  begin

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_system_attr_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[system_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_system_attr_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on tg_system_attr_aft_upd  table
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--03/26/2012	Ashish		4.2.0 Modified for Backlog CR#L00106607
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value		STRING40,
	@TotalUserPwds		INT32,
	@TotalUniquePwds	INT32,
	@last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
             --System Attribute Unique Password parameter : Attr_ID = 85
	SELECT @attr_value = b.attr_value
	FROM system_attr a, inserted b
	WHERE a.attr_id = b.attr_id
	    and  a.attr_id = 85
	--Check whether an update is made on this Attr_Value column
	--If True, check whether the attr_value is SET to 0
	IF (UPDATE(ATTR_VALUE) and (@attr_value = 0))  BEGIN
		--Find the Total No of User Passwords in the user_name table
		SELECT @TotalUserPwds = COUNT(*)
		FROM user_name
		--Find distinct passwords in the user_name table. If the count of distinct passwords matches the
		--total no of user passwords, then all passwords are unique.
		--else some of the user passwords are not unique, throw an exception
		SELECT @TotalUniquePwds = COUNT(DISTINCT(ISNULL(encrypt_pw,0)))
		FROM user_name
		IF (@TotalUserPwds <> @TotalUniquePwds) BEGIN
--			RAISERROR('Cant change the system attribute as Some of the Passwords are not unique', 16, 1)
			RAISERROR('Cannot change the system_attribute.passwords to be unique, because some of the passwords that currently exist in this database are not unique.{4740}', 16, 1)
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

SELECT @attr_value = b.attr_value
	FROM system_attr a, inserted b
	WHERE a.attr_id = b.attr_id
	    and  a.attr_id = 405
IF (UPDATE(ATTR_VALUE))  BEGIN
	IF(@attr_value = 1 OR @attr_value = 0)
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM user_grp_link  where row_id IN (SELECT ugl.row_id FROM user_grp_link ugl LEFT OUTER JOIN grp_name grp
		ON ugl.grp_id = grp.grp_id  where grp.auth_method = 2)
	--	DELETE FROM user_name where (user_id NOT IN(SELECT user_id from sessn )) AND (auth_method = 2)
	--	UPDATE user_name SET active = 0 where (user_id IN(SELECT user_id from sessn)) AND (auth_method = 2)
	END

END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE system_attr SET system_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, system_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE system_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no	INT
,@bom_pos	INT		= NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_ofi_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData
-- Description       - Return a recordset using the job filters stored in ui_config table

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			YG				2023-07-31 						Initial version, Return a recordset using the job filters stored in ui_config table
-- 0.02.00			TB				2023-09-24						Customized from standard SP sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData version 6.1. 
--																	Added total_qty to get the sum of qty_good_at_bom_pos & qty_rejected_at_bom_pos
-- 0.03.00			DS				2024-02-09						Updated the header comments
-- 0.04.00			DS				2024-03-15						updated total_qty as nvarchar for handling the decimal issue
-- 0.05.00			MC				2025-07-08						Enabling visibility of bins production in the production tab in the UI

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(10)

SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr with(nolock) WHERE attr_id = 210  -- this statement is hardcoded in STD sp as well
IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT  jb.wo_id, jb.oper_id, jb.seq_no, jb.bom_pos,
	'job_bom_subst_exist' = CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = jb.wo_id AND oper_id = jb.oper_id AND seq_no = jb.seq_no AND bom_pos = jb.bom_pos) = 1 THEN 1
				ELSE 0 END,
	jb.current_subst, jbst.pref, jbst.subst_level,
	'item_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END,
	'item_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END,
		CASE
			WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END
			WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END
			WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END + '(' + CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END + ')'
			WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END + '(' + CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END + ')'
		END AS item_display,
	'uom_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.uom_id ELSE jbst.uom_id END,
	'description' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.description ELSE jbst.description END,
	'abbreviation' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.abbreviation ELSE jbst.abbreviation END,
	'lifetime' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.lifetime ELSE jbst.lifetime END,
	'reqd_grade_cd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_grade_cd ELSE jbst.reqd_grade_cd END,
	'item_grade_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_grade_desc ELSE jbst.item_grade_desc END,
	'color' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.color ELSE jbst.color END,
	'instruction' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.instruction ELSE jbst.instruction END,
	'qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_per_parent_item ELSE jbst.qty_per_parent_item END,
	'max_qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.max_qty_per_parent_item ELSE jbst.max_qty_per_parent_item END,
	'min_qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.min_qty_per_parent_item ELSE jbst.min_qty_per_parent_item END,
	'reqd_start_val' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_start_val ELSE jbst.reqd_start_val END,
	'reqd_start_val_is_pct' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_start_val_is_pct ELSE jbst.reqd_start_val_is_pct END,
	'qty_prod' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_prod ELSE jbst.qty_prod END,
	'qty_rejected' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_rejected ELSE jbst.qty_rejected END,
	'update_inv' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.update_inv ELSE jbst.update_inv END,
	'backflush' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.backflush ELSE jbst.backflush END,
	'def_reas_cd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_reas_cd ELSE jbst.def_reas_cd END,
	'reas_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reas_desc ELSE jbst.reas_desc END,
	'def_lot_no' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_lot_no ELSE jbst.def_lot_no END,
	'def_sublot_no' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_sublot_no ELSE jbst.def_sublot_no END,
	'def_storage_ent_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_storage_ent_id ELSE jbst.def_storage_ent_id END,
	'ent_name' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.ent_name ELSE jbst.ent_name END,
	'scaling_factor' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.scaling_factor ELSE jbst.scaling_factor END,
	'must_consume_from_inv' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_from_inv ELSE jbst.must_consume_from_inv END,
	'may_choose_alt_inv_loc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.may_choose_alt_inv_loc ELSE jbst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc END,
	'may_create_new_lots' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.may_create_new_lots ELSE jbst.may_create_new_lots END,
	'must_consume_from_wip' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_from_wip ELSE jbst.must_consume_from_wip END,
	'must_consume_before_prod' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_before_prod ELSE jbst.must_consume_before_prod END,
	'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.consumed_so_far ELSE jbst.consumed_so_far END,
	'constant_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.constant_qty ELSE jbst.constant_qty END,
	'est_time' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.est_time ELSE jbst.est_time END,
	'spare1' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare1 ELSE jbst.spare1 END,
	'spare2' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare2 ELSE jbst.spare2 END,
	'spare3' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare3 ELSE jbst.spare3 END,
	'spare4' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare4 ELSE jbst.spare4 END,
	'qty_reqd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_reqd ELSE jbst.qty_reqd END,
	'qty_at_start' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_at_start ELSE jbst.qty_at_start END,
	'num_decimals' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.num_decimals ELSE jbst.num_decimals END,
	'item_spare1' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare1 ELSE jbst.item_spare1 END,
	'item_spare2' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare2 ELSE jbst.item_spare2 END,
	'item_spare3' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare3 ELSE jbst.item_spare3 END,
	'item_spare4' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare4 ELSE jbst.item_spare4 END,
	'last_edit_comment' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_comment ELSE jbst.last_edit_comment END,
	'last_edit_by' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_by ELSE jbst.last_edit_by END,
	'last_edit_at' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_at ELSE jbst.last_edit_at END,
	'qty_used_in_steps' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_used_in_steps ELSE jbst.qty_used_in_steps END,
	'mod_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.mod_id ELSE NULL END,
	'actual_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_qty ELSE jbst.actual_qty END,
	'actual_min_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_min_qty ELSE jbst.actual_min_qty END,
	'actual_max_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_max_qty ELSE jbst.actual_max_qty END,
	'qty_good_at_bom_pos' = COALESCE(jb.qty_good_at_bom_pos, 0),
	'qty_rejected_at_bom_pos' = COALESCE(jb.qty_rejected_at_bom_pos, 0),
	-- 'total_qty'= COALESCE(qty_good_at_bom_pos, 0)+ COALESCE(qty_rejected_at_bom_pos, 0)
	'total_qty'= cast( (COALESCE(jb.qty_good_at_bom_pos, 0)+ COALESCE(jb.qty_rejected_at_bom_pos, 0)) AS nvarchar(50))
	
FROM (SELECT job_bom.wo_id, job_bom.oper_id, job_bom.seq_no, job_bom.bom_pos, job_bom.current_subst, job_bom.item_id, item.item_desc,
		item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,
		job_bom.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom.instruction, job_bom.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.reqd_start_val, job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct,

		job_bom.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom.constant_qty, job_bom.est_time,
		job_bom.spare1, job_bom.spare2, job_bom.spare3, job_bom.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom.last_edit_comment, job_bom.last_edit_by, job_bom.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.qty_per_parent_item
		 ELSE CASE WHEN (job.qty_at_start IS NULL) THEN job_bom.qty_reqd
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
          END
		 END AS actual_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_min_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_max_qty
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN job_bom.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_good_at_bom_pos
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN job_bom.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_rejected_at_bom_pos
	FROM job_bom job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.seq_no = @seq_no or @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
--	  AND (job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
--	  AND (job_bom.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	UNION

	SELECT job_bom.wo_id, job_bom.oper_id, job_bom.seq_no, owie.bom_pos, NULL as current_subst, owie.item_id, owie.item_desc,
		item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,

		NULL as update_inv, NULL as backflush, job_bom.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, NULL as def_lot_no, NULL as def_sublot_no,
		NULL as def_storage_ent_id, NULL as ent_name, NULL as scaling_factor, NULL as must_consume_from_inv,
		NULL as may_choose_alt_inv_loc, NULL as may_create_new_lots, NULL as must_consume_from_wip,
		NULL as must_consume_before_prod,
	    NULL as consumed_so_far,
		NULL as constant_qty, NULL as est_time,
		NULL as spare1, NULL as spare2, NULL as spare3, NULL as spare4, 0 as qty_reqd, 0 as qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		NULL as last_edit_comment, NULL as last_edit_by, NULL as last_edit_at,
		NULL as qty_used_in_steps,
		NULL as mod_id,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	NULL AS actual_qty,
    	NULL AS actual_min_qty,

		, ROUND(CASE WHEN owie.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = owie.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = owie.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN owie.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = owie.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = owie.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_good_at_bom_pos
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN owie.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = owie.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = owie.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 1

			WHEN owie.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)

			)

	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	INNER JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id=owie.wo_id AND ip.item_id=owie.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)

	) jb LEFT OUTER JOIN

		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom_subst.last_edit_comment, job_bom_subst.last_edit_by, job_bom_subst.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom_subst.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item
		 ELSE CASE WHEN (job.qty_at_start IS NULL) THEN job.qty_reqd
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)

          END
		 END AS actual_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN

		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_min_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_max_qty
	FROM job_bom_subst job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom_subst.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom_subst.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom_subst.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom_subst.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
--	  AND (job_bom_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
--	  AND (job_bom_subst.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	) jbst
ON jb.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbst.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbst.bom_pos
AND jb.current_subst = jbst.alt_no
END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 09/22/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit

BEGIN

  cert_level,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)

   @cert_level,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Cert_Grade_Link]

   @cert_level int ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_U_Cert_Grade_Link
-- Description      - Update an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            - SP requires that all table fields be included
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--09/22/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
UPDATE cert_grade_link

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Bom]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @bom_pos  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @reqd_grade_cd  int  ,
 @update_inv  bit  ,
 @backflush  bit  ,
 @def_reas_cd  int  ,
 @def_storage_ent_id  int  ,
 @def_reject_ent_id int ,
 @current_subst int,
 @serial_no_source int,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_Bom
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/10/2002	Raghu		1.4	Added consumed_so_far column to return the total consumed
--10/30/2002     Sheetal Jain     	1.3.0	Include NOLOCK hint in the query
--07/15/2003	Raghu		1.6.14	consumed_so_far: Condition to eliminate item_scrapped was missing in wo_id IS NOT NULL category. Condition added
--09/23/2003	Rich		?	Added the num_decimals column
--04/22/2004	Rich		2.0.32	Added the qty_used_in_steps column
--02/14/2004	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5380, Exclude item_cons records that are not of type normal consumption
--09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--12/27/2007	AML			3.4.0	Added @serial_no_source to parameter list.
--10/29/2014	ErinK		5.1		Added @def_sublot_no to the returned dataset when wo id is NON NULL
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
IF (@wo_id IS NULL)
	SELECT job_bom.wo_id
		,job_bom.oper_id
		,job_bom.seq_no
		,job_bom.bom_pos
		,job_bom.item_id
		,item.item_desc
		,job_bom.reqd_grade_cd
		,item_grade.item_grade_desc
		,item_grade.color
		,job_bom.instruction
		,job_bom.qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.reqd_start_val
		,job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct
		,job_bom.update_inv
		,job_bom.backflush
		,job_bom.def_reas_cd
		,item_reas.reas_desc
		,job_bom.def_lot_no
		,job_bom.def_sublot_no
		,job_bom.def_storage_ent_id
		,job_bom.def_reject_ent_id
		,ent.ent_name
		,job_bom.scaling_factor
		,job_bom.must_consume_from_inv
		,job_bom.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
		,job_bom.may_create_new_lots
		,job_bom.must_consume_from_wip
		,job_bom.must_consume_before_prod
		,CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos > 0 THEN
			ISNULL((select sum(qty_cons) from item_cons WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id and oper_id = job_bom.oper_id and seq_no = job_bom.seq_no and item_id = job_bom.item_id and item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type=0), 0)
			ELSE 0
		 END AS consumed_so_far
		,job_bom.constant_qty
		,job_bom.est_time
		,job_bom.current_subst
		,job_bom.qty_reqd job_bom_qty_reqd
		,job_bom.serial_no_source
		,job_bom.spare1
		,job_bom.spare2
		,job_bom.spare3
		,job_bom.spare4
		,job.qty_reqd
		,job.qty_at_start
		,item.num_decimals
		,job_bom.last_edit_comment
		,job_bom.last_edit_by
		,job_bom.last_edit_at
		,(select ISNULL( SUM( ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0) ), 0 ) from job_bom_step where wo_id = job_bom.wo_id and oper_id = job_bom.oper_id and seq_no = job_bom.seq_no and bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos and bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps
	            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
		INNER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	WHERE (
		(job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.update_inv = ABS(@update_inv) OR @update_inv IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.backflush = ABS(@backflush) OR @backflush IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.def_reas_cd = @def_reas_cd OR @def_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id OR @def_storage_ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.def_reject_ent_id = @def_reject_ent_id OR @def_reject_ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.current_subst = @current_subst OR @current_subst IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.serial_no_source = ABS(@serial_no_source) OR @serial_no_source IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(job_bom.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

ELSE
	SELECT job_bom.wo_id
	            ,job_bom.oper_id
	            ,job_bom.seq_no
	            ,job_bom.bom_pos
	            ,job_bom.item_id
	            ,item.item_desc
	            ,job_bom.reqd_grade_cd
	            ,item_grade.item_grade_desc
	            ,item_grade.color
	            ,job_bom.instruction
	            ,job_bom.qty_per_parent_item
	            ,job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
	            ,job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
	            ,job_bom.reqd_start_val
	            ,job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct
	            ,job_bom.update_inv
	            ,job_bom.backflush
	            ,job_bom.def_reas_cd
	            ,item_reas.reas_desc
	            ,job_bom.def_lot_no
				,job_bom.def_sublot_no
	            ,job_bom.def_storage_ent_id
	            ,job_bom.def_reject_ent_id
	            ,ent.ent_name
	            ,job_bom.scaling_factor
	            ,job_bom.must_consume_from_inv
	            ,job_bom.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
	            ,job_bom.may_create_new_lots
	            ,job_bom.must_consume_from_wip
	            ,job_bom.must_consume_before_prod
	           ,'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos > 0 THEN
					ISNULL((select sum(qty_cons) from item_cons WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id and oper_id = job_bom.oper_id and seq_no = job_bom.seq_no and item_id = job_bom.item_id and item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
				      END
	            ,job_bom.constant_qty
	            ,job_bom.est_time
	            ,job_bom.current_subst
	            ,job_bom.qty_reqd job_bom_qty_reqd
				,job_bom.serial_no_source
	            ,job_bom.spare1
	            ,job_bom.spare2
	            ,job_bom.spare3
	            ,job_bom.spare4
	            ,job.qty_reqd
                          ,job.qty_at_start
                         ,item.num_decimals
                         ,job_bom.last_edit_comment
                         ,job_bom.last_edit_by
                         ,job_bom.last_edit_at
                         ,(select ISNULL(sum(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) from job_bom_step where wo_id = job_bom.wo_id and oper_id = job_bom.oper_id and seq_no = job_bom.seq_no and bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos and bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps
                         ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM job_bom job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	 where((job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id) AND
	       (job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.update_inv = @update_inv OR @update_inv IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.backflush = @backflush OR @backflush IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.def_reas_cd = @def_reas_cd OR @def_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id OR @def_storage_ent_id IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.def_reject_ent_id = @def_reject_ent_id OR @def_reject_ent_id IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.current_subst = @current_subst OR @current_subst IS NULL) AND
			(job_bom.serial_no_source = ABS(@serial_no_source) OR @serial_no_source IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
  	       (job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	       (job_bom.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_bom_item_oper_link_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_bom_item_oper_link_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_link table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
--06/03/2005	Raghu		2.1.22	HD# 5736, num_decimals should be rounded to item_id; not to parent_item_id
--09/26/2012	Ravi Teja	4.6	    CR L00122689 - (Merge of CR L00122266) Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item of bom_item_oper_link table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_link a, inserted b
				WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id  AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id  AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},bom_item_oper_link', 16, 1)
				RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_link a, inserted b
		WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id
		     AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id  AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos  AND a.process_id = b.process_id
		     AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id) biol
	WHERE process.process_id = biol.process_id

	UPDATE bom_item_oper_link SET bom_item_oper_link.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item
		,bom_item_oper_link.last_edit_by = @user_id, bom_item_oper_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN bom_item bi ON bi.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bi.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bi.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	INNER JOIN item it ON bi.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bom_item_oper_link.ver_id = i.ver_id  AND bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	     AND bom_item_oper_link.process_id = i.process_id  AND bom_item_oper_link.oper_id = i.oper_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Site]
  (@ent_id int,
   @site_name nvarchar(80) ,
   @corporation nvarchar(40) ,
   @division nvarchar(40) ,
   @sub_division nvarchar(40) ,
   @region_id nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare1 nvarchar(40) ,
   @spare2 nvarchar(40) ,
   @spare3 nvarchar(40) ,
   @spare4 nvarchar(40) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime OUT,
   @row_id int OUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_I_Site
-- Description	      -	Insert a row into the table
-- Author	      - AUTO GENERATED CLASS
-- Date Created	      -	01/01/2007
-- Version	      - 3.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				 3.3.4		  HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												  dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

 DECLARE @last_edit_by STRING40
DECLARE	@parent_ent_id			INT32
		,@parent_site_ent_id	INT32
		,@site					INT32
		,@ent_name				STRING80
		,@exist_site_name				STRING80
		,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)

	--Verify whether the supplied entity exists in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'An entity with the supplied entity ID does not exist.{5775}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END

    --Verify whether the designated site (ID) is the same as this entity.
    SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name, @site = e.site
    FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

	--Verify whether this entity is designated as a site.
	IF (@site IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the designated site (ID) is the same as this entity.
		IF (@site <> @ent_id) BEGIN
			--Since this is different, do not allow the child entities to configure the site information independently.
			SELECT @exist_site_name = e.site_name
			FROM site e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @site

			SET @err_msg = 'This entity %1 is already designated to a site: %2, thus a separate site information cannot be configured for this entity.{6302}' + @ent_name + ',' + @exist_site_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Verify whether any of the immediate parent above belongs to the same site,
	--or the parent does not belong to any site.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
				FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN ent site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON site_ent.ent_id = e.site
				WHERE el.child_ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN

		SELECT @site = e.site, @exist_site_name = site_ent.site_name
		FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN site site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON site_ent.ent_id = e.site
		WHERE el.child_ent_id = @ent_id

		IF (@site IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Raise an exception if the site defined for the parent entity is  the same site being attempted to the child entity.
			SET @err_msg = 'A separate site information cannot be configured for a child entity, because all the child entities inherits the site information from its designated site.{6303}'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END
	END

 EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
 SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

 INSERT INTO site
 (ent_id,
  site_name,
  corporation,
  division,
  sub_division,
  region_id,
  spare1,
  spare2,
  spare3,
  spare4,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@ent_id,
   @site_name,
   @corporation,
   @division,
   @sub_division,
   @region_id,
   @spare1,
   @spare2,
   @spare3,
   @spare4,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)


-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
select @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

EXEC sp_U_Ent_UpdateSite @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_remove_site=0

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_Final]
  (@sample_id int,
   @final bit,
   @user_id nvarchar(40) =  NULL,
   @event_date_time datetime = NULL,
   @finalized_at_utc datetime = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       -  sp_U_Sample_Final
-- Description       -  Sets the final field in the sample table to Fina. See section 4.2.3 of the SRO DFS.
-- Author         -
-- Date Created         -  06/09/2011
-- Version        -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 04/06/2012		MS								 Fix CR L00119541
-- 11/21/2019	Raghu	6.2	UserStory: 1184123-As Bruce, I want a Sample.Put web API for updating sample final and pulled settings
-- 07/01/2020	Raghu	6.2	US:1330922 - As Lenka, I want to analyze and address performance issues with QM web API methods
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @finalized_at_local TDATETIME = @event_date_time,
         @finalized_by nvarchar(40),
	@ent_id INT,
		@err_msg STRING80

BEGIN
	SELECT @ent_id = s.ent_id FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE s.sample_id = @sample_id
	IF (@ent_id IS NULL)   BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 sample does not exist<7543>,' + STR(@sample_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@final = 1) BEGIN

		IF @user_id is null
			EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @finalized_by OUTPUT, NULL
	       ELSE
			SET @finalized_by=@user_id

        	IF (@finalized_at_utc IS NULL AND @finalized_at_local IS NULL) SET @finalized_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

		IF (@finalized_at_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @finalized_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @finalized_at_utc)
		ELSE SET @finalized_at_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @finalized_at_local, GETUTCDATE())

		 UPDATE sample
		 SET
		  final = 1
		 ,finalized_by = @finalized_by
		 ,finalized_at_local = @finalized_at_local
		 ,finalized_at_utc = @finalized_at_utc
		 WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
      END
      ELSE
        UPDATE sample
        SET final = 0
        ,finalized_by = NULL
        ,finalized_at_local = NULL
        ,finalized_at_UTC = NULL
        WHERE sample_id = @sample_id;
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_cost_data]
AS
WITH util_times (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_end_time_utc) AS
(SELECT TOP 100000000 vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc, vuht.event_end_time_utc
FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
ORDER BY vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc
)
SELECT item_cons.wo_id,
       item_cons.oper_id,
       item_cons.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       NULL as step_no,
       item_cons.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       item_cons.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item_cons.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       item_cons.shift_start_utc,
       item_cons.shift_start_local,
       item.item_desc as cost_desc,
       item_cons.item_scrapped as cost_cat1,
       NULL as cost_cat2,
       item_cons.qty_cons as cost_qty,
       item.unit_cost as cost_base,
       'C' as cost_type
FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   item_cons.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   item_cons.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   item_cons.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom  WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
UNION ALL
SELECT labor_usage.wo_id,
       labor_usage.oper_id,
       labor_usage.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       labor_usage.step_no,
       labor_usage.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       labor_usage.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       labor_usage.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       labor_usage.shift_start_utc,
       labor_usage.shift_start_local,
       labor_cat.lab_desc as cost_desc,
       labor_cat.fixedtime as cost_cat1,
       labor_cat.vartime as cost_cat2,
      (labor_usage.duration * labor_usage.pct_to_apply) as
          cost_qty,
       user_name.hourly_cost as cost_base,
       'L' as cost_type
FROM labor_usage labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK)  ON
   labor_usage.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   labor_usage.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   labor_usage.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK)  ON labor_usage.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   labor_usage.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   labor_usage.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   labor_usage.lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
INNER JOIN user_name user_name  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   labor_usage.user_id = user_name.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom  WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
UNION ALL
SELECT jh.wo_id,
       jh.oper_id,
       jh.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       NULL as step_no,
       util_log.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       jh.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       util_log.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       util_log.shift_start_utc,
       util_log.shift_start_local,
       util_reas.reas_desc as cost_desc,
       util_log.runtime as cost_cat1,
       util_log.downtime as cost_cat2,
       util_log.duration as cost_qty,
       ent.hourly_cost as cost_base,
       'M' as cost_type
FROM util_log util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN util_times ut ON util_log.ent_id = ut.ent_id AND util_log.event_time_utc = ut.event_time_utc
INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON ut.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > ut.event_time_utc
	AND jh.job_start_utc < ut.event_end_time_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   jh.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   jh.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   jh.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   jh.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   item.uom_id = uom.uom_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_LoadAssignHU]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	declare @ent_id int
	SELECT @ent_id=e3.ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
	inner join ent (nolock) e1 on e1.ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e2 on e2.ent_id=e1.parent_ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e3 on e3.ent_id=e2.parent_ent_id
	WHERE  final_job=1
	AND    wo_id=@wo_id

	select  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Order by iv.row_id)as tot_rows,
				STRING_AGG(ai.wo_id,',')as wo_id,
				   iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2 as sublot_no,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc,
				  ( i.item_desc+' '+ '('+iv.item_id+')') as itConcat,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,
				  -- ai.wo_id,
				     CONVERT(varchar,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(null,iv.last_edit_at),22) as last_edit_at,
				   iv.last_edit_by
				FROM       item_inv iv with (nolock)
				INNER JOIN uom (nolock) u
				ON         u.uom_id=iv.uom_id
				INNER JOIN item (nolock) i on i.item_id=iv.item_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN  ofi_assignhuwoid ai

				ON         iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id where iv.spare2 is not null
				and iv.ent_id=@ent_id
				group by  
				   iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,           
				   iv.last_edit_at,
				    iv.last_edit_by,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc
END
