CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeWODetails]
(
		@wo_id					STRING80
	,	@wo_desc				STRING80
	,	@start_qty				TFLOAT
	,	@reqd_qty				TFLOAT
	,	@release_time_local		TDATETIME
	,	@release_time_tz		INT32 = NULL
	,	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME
	,	@req_finish_time_tz     INT32 = NULL
	,	@state_cd				INT32
	,	@wo_priority			INT32
	,	@cust_info				NVARCHAR(160)
	,	@mo_id					STRING80
	,	@notes					NOTES_NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
	,	@mod_id					NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeWODetails
-- Description			- Change WO Details. Used exclusively in SCC for WO updates (if row_exist update option is selected)
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 10/05/2004
-- Version				- 2.1.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/13/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 08/14/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 11/12/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @max_req_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@release_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@req_finish_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@diff_finish_time 			INT32
		,	@tz_temp_1					INT32
		,	@tz_temp_2					INT32
		,	@dbg_resp					INT32

	SET @release_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
	SET @release_time_local		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@release_time_local, @release_time_tz)
	SET @req_finish_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
	SET @req_finish_time_local	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@req_finish_time_local, @req_finish_time_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	 exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeWODetails', @src_key='sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeWODetails',
                                      @date_val1 = @release_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @release_time_tz,
                                      @date_val2 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val2 = @req_finish_time_tz



	SET @tz_temp_1 = - @release_time_tz
	SET @tz_temp_2 = - @req_finish_time_tz

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @release_time_local,    @tz_temp_1, @release_time_utc OUTPUT
	Exec sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp_2, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	--SELECT @release_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @release_time),  @req_finish_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time)
	IF (@start_qty IS NOT NULL) OR (@reqd_qty IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		EXEC sp_Alloc_Job_Qty  @wo_id, NULL, NULL, @reqd_qty, NULL, @start_qty, @req_finish_time_local, @req_finish_time_tz, @release_time_local, @release_time_tz
		IF @reqd_qty IS NOT NULL UPDATE wo SET req_qty = @reqd_qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	END

	IF (@wo_desc IS NOT NULL) OR (@cust_info IS NOT NULL) OR (@mo_id IS NOT NULL)
		OR (@notes IS NOT NULL) OR (@wo_priority IS NOT NULL) OR (@req_finish_time_local IS NOT NULL)
		OR (@release_time_local IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		IF (@req_finish_time_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @max_req_finish_time_utc = MAX(req_finish_time_utc) FROM JOB	WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1
			IF @max_req_finish_time_utc IS NULL SET @max_req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc
			SET @diff_finish_time = DATEDIFF(ss, @max_req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_utc)
		END

		UPDATE wo
		SET wo_desc = CASE WHEN @wo_desc IS NOT NULL THEN @wo_desc ELSE wo_desc END,
			req_finish_time_utc = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_utc IS NOT NULL THEN @req_finish_time_utc ELSE req_finish_time_utc END,
			req_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_local IS NOT NULL THEN @req_finish_time_local ELSE req_finish_time_local END,
			release_time_local = CASE WHEN @release_time_local IS NOT NULL THEN @release_time_local ELSE release_time_local END,
			release_time_utc = CASE WHEN @release_time_utc IS NOT NULL THEN @release_time_utc ELSE release_time_utc END,
			wo_priority = CASE WHEN @wo_priority IS NOT NULL THEN @wo_priority ELSE wo_priority END,
			cust_info = CASE WHEN @cust_info IS NOT NULL THEN @cust_info ELSE cust_info END,
			mo_id = CASE WHEN @mo_id IS NOT NULL THEN @mo_id ELSE mo_id END,
			notes = CASE WHEN @notes IS NOT NULL THEN @notes ELSE notes END
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	END
	IF @wo_priority IS NOT NULL UPDATE JOB SET job_priority = @wo_priority WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	IF (@req_finish_time_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		UPDATE job
		SET req_finish_time_utc		= @req_finish_time_utc,
			req_finish_time_local	= @req_finish_time_local
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1

		UPDATE job
		SET req_finish_time_utc		= DATEADD( ss, @diff_finish_time, req_finish_time_utc ),
			req_finish_time_local	= DATEADD( ss, @diff_finish_time, req_finish_time_local )
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job <> 1

	END

	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id)))
	FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetJobStateForTimestamp] 
--Create Date:        2025
--Author:             JSC
--Description:        To get a valid recorded timestamp for PROD or CONS so it will fall within a job run
--						The reason for this conversion is: 
--
/*

When a message is sent by automation it will be git the generated recorded time; it could be that in MES this timestamp a job was not running or has just finished.


*/

--Call by:            Initial idea was for PROD /CONS but not yet used.                 
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_GetJobStateForTimestamp] ('10000000','beanbulkintake',0,'2025-04-29 12:00:14.123',486)  -- EXAMPLES in create script
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2025-05-15          JSC					1.0					First version
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

create     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetJobStateForTimestamp_bck21_8_25] (
    @mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no INT,
    @recorded_timestamp DATETIME -- UTC
	,@mes_ent_id INT
)
RETURNS @Result TABLE (
	record_state_cd INT,
	record_is_initial INT,
    record_state_cd_timestamp DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN

	INSERT INTO @Result
    SELECT TOP 1
       CASE
            WHEN je.event_time_utc > @recorded_timestamp
                THEN 1
            ELSE je.value1
       END,
        CASE 
            WHEN je.event_time_utc > @recorded_timestamp
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,
       CASE 
            WHEN je.event_time_utc > @recorded_timestamp
                THEN @recorded_timestamp
            ELSE je.event_time_utc
		END
    FROM job_event je WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE je.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
        AND je.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
        AND je.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND je.event_type = 'JobStateChanged'
		AND (je.ent_id = @mes_ent_id OR (je.ent_id IS NULL))
		AND je.event_time_utc <= @recorded_timestamp
    ORDER BY je.event_time_utc DESC;

    RETURN;
END;

-- Description:	The stored procedure used to check availability of the job pos
--	
-- Usage:		ofi.ofiAssignRecipe.js
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2023-05-01			Initial version.

-- 0.03.00	YG				2024-03-05			Bug Fixes Devops #2114 : MES allowed to start more than one job for Bean Intake

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ofi_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos]
(@ent_id	INT
,@job_pos	INT OUTPUT
) AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	SET @job_pos = -1


	-- Check availability of the job pos in the ent
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 From job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id is null AND cur_oper_id is null))
	BEGIN
		SELECT @job_pos = min(job_pos) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id IS NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NULL
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @job_pos = -1 
	END

	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, -1);

	SELECT @job_pos job_pos
END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid] 
--Create Date:        2024-06-06 
--Author:             Yoga 
--Description:        <To Convert order id to Automation related order id. >
--
--Call by:            Common function; getting called from multiple SPs.                     
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid] ('81000127','BeanBulkIntake')
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2024-06-06          YG					1.0					First version
--2024-06-21		  YG					2.0					Major Update 
--																Simplest: Remove the first digit when the value is above a configured limit (2,100,000,000). And send to DCS.
--																a.	When message comes back from DCS; if the length of the value is equal to 9. You would need to query the MESDB to find the job that fits the logic:
--																	i.	_wo_id + oper + seq ran on the specific line receiving the message.
--																	ii.	If more than 1 job is found, pick the latest ran one as long as the WO is not Closed in SAP. (new)
--																	iii.	If only 1 job is found and WO is Closed in SAP; follow the current logic for that. (same as now I expect)
--																	iv.	If no job is found, give data error to DCS. (same as now I expect)
--																b.	Possible errors: that an 8 PuO and an 6 PuO contain the same 9 digits, or that new PuO contains the same 9 digits and are used in the same line. (Unlikely)
--2024-06-26		  YG					3.0					Set the @DCS_JOB_Max_Value configurable for equipment
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid_backup210125]
(    
      @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	  @seq_no INT,
	  @ent_id INT
)
	RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  result INT, 
		  output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		  output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		  output_operid NVARCHAR(100), 
		  output_seqno INT
		)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DCS_JOB_Max_Value INT = 2100000000
	,@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits INT = 10
	,@DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty INT = 1
	,@Num_DigittoKeep INT
	,@NumberOfZerotoAdd INT
	,@String_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_Truncated_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_OperId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_SeqNo INT
	,@Area_Ent_Id INT
	,@result INT = 0
	,@DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value INT = NULL
	,@DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value INT = NULL

	-- Get Max Value (Plant Level)
	SELECT @DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value, ',','')) 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AUTMaxWONumber')
	AND ent_id = (SELECT TOP 1 ent_id
					  FROM   ent (nolock)
					  WHERE  parent_ent_id IS NULL
					  ORDER  BY ent_id)

	-- Get Max Value (Segment Level)
	SELECT @DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value, ',','')) 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AUTMaxWONumber')
	AND ent_id = @ent_id

	-- Set the max value with segment value as the priority
	SET @DCS_JOB_Max_Value = COALESCE(@DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value,@DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value)

	--Get Area From Segment Id
	SELECT @Area_Ent_Id=parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)

	--#1 wo_id more than max_number and length of wo_id is equal with max_length_of_wo_id
	IF LEN(@wo_id) = @DCS_JOB_Max_Digits AND CONVERT(BIGINT,@WO_ID) > @DCS_JOB_Max_Value
	BEGIN
		--Get Right Side Digit
		SET @Num_DigittoKeep = @DCS_JOB_Max_Digits-@DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty;
		SET @String_WoId = RIGHT(@wo_id,@Num_DigittoKeep);

		--Set The Truncated Wo
		SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @String_WoId

		--Get The OperId and SeqNo
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_SeqNo = j.seq_no, @Output_OperId = j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id)
		ORDER BY row_id DESC
	END
	ELSE IF (LEN(@WO_ID)=@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty) -- #2 length of wo_id is equal with the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated 
	BEGIN
		--Manipulated String 
		SET @String_WoId = CONCAT(REPLICATE('_', @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty), @WO_ID);
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
 
		--Get The Correct Order From The List
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_WoId=j.wo_id,@Output_OperId=j.oper_id, @Output_SeqNo=j.seq_no FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		WHERE j.wo_id LIKE @String_WoId and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
		GROUP BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no
		ORDER BY max(job_start_utc) DESC
	END
	ELSE IF LEN(@WO_ID)<@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty --#3 and #4 length is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated 
	BEGIN
		--Validate SAP/MES order
		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND spare1 is NULL)) --#4 length of wo_id is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated (MES order)
		BEGIN
			--Set output wo, it is a manual order
			SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
			SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
			SET @Output_SeqNo = @seq_no

			SELECT TOP 1 @Output_OperId=j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
			ORDER BY row_id DESC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Number of 0
			SET @NumberOfZerotoAdd = (@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty) - LEN(@WO_ID) --#3 length of wo_id is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated (SAP order)

			--Manipulated String 
			SET @String_WoId = CONCAT('_',REPLICATE('0',@NumberOfZerotoAdd), @WO_ID);
			SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id

			--Get The Correct Order From The List
			SELECT TOP 1 @Output_WoId=j.wo_id,@Output_OperId=j.oper_id, @Output_SeqNo=j.seq_no FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
			WHERE j.wo_id LIKE @String_WoId and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
			GROUP BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no
			ORDER BY max(job_start_utc) DESC
		END
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		-- Get wo_id, seq_no
		SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_SeqNo = @seq_no

		-- Get oper_id
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_OperId=j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
		ORDER BY row_id DESC
	END

	IF (@Output_WoId IS NULL or @Output_OperId is NULL or @Output_SeqNo IS NULL or @Output_Truncated_WoId IS NULL)
		SET @result = 0 -- Dont continue for the next step
	ELSE
		SET @result = 1 -- continue

    INSERT INTO @Output (result, output_woid, output_truncated_woid, output_operid, output_seqno)
		VALUES (@result, @output_woid, @output_truncated_woid, @output_operid, @output_seqno) ;

    RETURN ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_dx_log]
(
	@log_id 				INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@sched_id 				STRING80_NULL = NULL,
	@logged_at 				TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@status 				INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 02/14/2005	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5258, 5367 Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time
-- 01/14/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073834; The logged at should be adjusted by minutes; was adjusting by months.
-- 12/23/2009	Ajay		4.0.0	HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @logged_at = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @logged_at)

	SELECT dx_log.log_id
		,  dx_log.sched_id
		,  dx_log.logged_at
		,  dx_log.status
		,  dx_log.triggered_by
		,  dx_log.rows_success
		,  dx_log.rows_error
		,  dx_log.comments
		,  dx_log.error_desc
	FROM dx_log dx_log
	WHERE ( (dx_log.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL) AND
			(dx_log.sched_id = @sched_id OR @sched_id IS NULL) AND
			(dx_log.logged_at >= @logged_at OR @logged_at IS NULL) AND
			(dx_log.status = @status OR @status IS NULL) )
	ORDER BY dx_log.log_id , dx_log.logged_at
END

-- Name:		fn_ofi_GetUOM
-- Description:	Function returns UOM for given entity
--
-- Usage:	this function is used in Unique Item Su and stock transfer
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK				 2024-01-11		Initial version.
 
-- ===========================================================================================

create FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_GetUOM]
(	 
	@ent_id INT
)
RETURNS  NVARCHAR(10) 
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @UOM nvarchar(10)=NULL


	select @UOM=se.spare1
	from storage_exec se with(nolock)
	where se.ent_id=@ent_id

	if(@UOM IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	select Top 1 @UOM= attr_value  
	from ent_attr  ea with(nolock) inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
	where attr_desc='DefaultStorageUOM'
	
	END

	return @UOM

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_data_log_16_data]

       data_log_grp.grp_desc,
       data_log_16.sample_time_utc,
       data_log_16.sample_time_local,
       data_log_16.wo_id,
       data_log_16.oper_id,
       data_log_16.seq_no,

       job_step.step_desc,

       data_log_16.sublot_no,
       data_log_16.shift_start_utc,
       data_log_16.shift_start_local,
       data_log_16.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       data_log_16.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       data_log_16.value1,
       data_log_16.value2,
       data_log_16.value3,
       data_log_16.value4,
       data_log_16.value5,
       data_log_16.value6,
       data_log_16.value7,
       data_log_16.value8,
       data_log_16.value9,
       data_log_16.value10,
       data_log_16.value11,
       data_log_16.value12,
       data_log_16.value13,
       data_log_16.value14,
       data_log_16.value15,
       data_log_16.value16,
       item_prod.shift_start_utc prod_shift_start_utc,
       item_prod.shift_start_local prod_shift_start_local
FROM data_log_16 data_log_16
INNER JOIN data_log_grp data_log_grp ON
   data_log_16.grp_id = data_log_grp.grp_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step job_step ON
   data_log_16.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
   data_log_16.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND
   data_log_16.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
   data_log_16.step_no = job_step.step_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item ON
   data_log_16.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN shift shift ON
   data_log_16.shift_id = shift.shift_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON
   data_log_16.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local FROM item_prod) item_prod ON
   data_log_16.wo_id = item_prod.wo_id

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_Item_Attr
-- Description:  Updates the item attributes
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-12      Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Adn          2023-12-11      Changed for item group mapping table.
-- 0.01.02  Lavkesh     2024-02-01      Modified logic for item group mapping
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_MM_Attr] (@item_id               NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @item_group            NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @item_classification   NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @language_key          NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @plant_code            NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @production_supervisor NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @legacy_code           NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @item_status           NVARCHAR(40),
										   @material_state        NVARCHAR(40),
										   @production_method     NVARCHAR(40))
AS
  BEGIN
      IF @item_status <> 'Deleted' and (dbo.fn_s_ofi_plantcode()= @plant_code)
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @attr_id1       INT=NULL,
                    @attr_id2       INT=NULL,
                    @attr_id3       INT=NULL,
                    @attr_id4       INT=NULL,
                    @attr_id5       INT=NULL,
                    @attr_id6       INT=NULL,
                    @rc             INT,
                    @error_msg      NVARCHAR(500),
                    @error_severity INT,
                    @error_state    INT,
                    @mod_id         VARCHAR(30)

            SELECT @attr_id1 = attr_id
            FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
            WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
                   AND a.attr_grp = 1

            SELECT @attr_id2 = attr_id
            FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
            WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'Classification'
                   AND a.attr_grp = 1

            SELECT @attr_id3 = attr_id
            FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
            WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'LanguageKey'
                   AND a.attr_grp = 1

            SELECT @attr_id4 = attr_id
            FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
            WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
                   AND a.attr_grp = 1

            SELECT @attr_id5 = attr_id
            FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
            WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ProductionSupervisor'
                   AND a.attr_grp = 1

            SELECT @attr_id6 = attr_id
            FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
            WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'LegacyCode'
                   AND a.attr_grp = 1

            BEGIN try
                BEGIN TRANSACTION

			-- 0.01.01 start
			DECLARE @item_group_mes NVARCHAR(80);

			SELECT @item_group_mes = item_group_mes from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_item_group_mapping] WITH (nolock)
			WHERE (item_group_sap = @item_group AND @item_group IS NOT NULL) 
			AND (item_class_sap = @item_classification AND @item_classification IS NOT NULL)
			AND ((material_state = @material_state AND @material_state IS NOT NULL) OR (material_state IS NULL))
			-- 0.01.01 end

                IF ( @attr_id1 IS NULL
                      OR @attr_id2 IS NULL
                      OR @attr_id3 IS NULL
                      OR @attr_id4 IS NULL
                      OR @attr_id5 IS NULL
                      OR @attr_id6 IS NULL )
                  BEGIN ;
                      THROW 51009,
                      'Item attribute not found - SP_U_EI_Item_Attr',
                      1
                  END

                IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                           FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                           WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                                  AND attr_id = @attr_id1)

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_Lotnumber_Check]
-- Description:	To check the lot number is assigned for all the Packaging items for Packaging order
--
-- Usage:	This will be used in the job steps display in Job queue screen
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2022-09-03		Intial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Lotnumber_Check] 
@wo_id nvarchar(80),
@oper_id nvarchar(80),
@seq_no as int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
   declare 
   @results as int,
   @process_type nvarchar(30)=(select attr_value as process_type from process_attr pa with (nolock)
	inner join attr a on pa.attr_id=a.attr_id
	where pa.process_id=(select process_id from wo with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id) and a.attr_desc='ProcessType'),
   @lot_result nvarchar(30) = (select top 1 def_lot_no from job_bom jb with (nolock)
		inner join item i on jb.item_id=i.item_id where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and item_class_id=(select item_class_id from item_class with(nolock) where item_class_desc='Raw Materials') and def_lot_no is null),
   @item_result nvarchar(30) = ((select top 1 jb.item_id from job_bom jb with (nolock)
		inner join item i on jb.item_id=i.item_id where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and item_class_id=(select item_class_id from item_class with(nolock) where item_class_desc='Raw Materials') and def_lot_no is null)),
   @step_no as int = (select step_no from job_step_data with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and step_no=(select step_no from job_step with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and step_name='Set Lot'))

	if (@process_type like '%Packing%')
		begin 
			if (@item_result is null and @lot_result is null and @step_no is null)
				begin
				select @results=0 -- Lot number assigned for all items 
				end
			  else 
				begin 
				select @results=1 --One or more items still need to assign the Lot number
				end
	    end

	  else
		begin
		select @results=2 -- this order not a Packing order
		end
select @results as return_value



END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] 
--Create Date:        2025
--Author:             JSC
--Description:        To get a valid recorded timestamp for PROD or CONS so it will fall within a job run
--						The reason for this conversion is: 
--
/*

When a message is sent by automation it will be git the generated recorded time; it could be that in MES this timestamp a job was not running or has just finished.


*/

--Call by:            Common function; getting called from multiple SPs.                     
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] ('10000000','beanbulkintake',0,'2025-04-29 12:00:14.123')
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2025-04-29          JSC					1.0					First version
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

create     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp_bck21_8_25] (
    @mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no INT,
    @recorded_timestamp DATETIME
)
RETURNS @Result TABLE (
	record_min_Diff INT,
	recorded_timestamp_case INT,
    record_selected DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME;
    DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT;
    DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT;

	INSERT INTO @Result
    SELECT TOP 1
       CASE
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN 0
            WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
                THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp))
            ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
        END,
        CASE 
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN 1
            ELSE 500017
        END,
       CASE 
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN @recorded_timestamp
            WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
                THEN DATEADD(MILLISECOND, 100, jh.job_start_utc)
            ELSE DATEADD(MILLISECOND, -100, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()))
        END
    
    FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE jh.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
        AND jh.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
        AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
            THEN 0
        WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
            THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp))
        ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
    END ASC;

    RETURN;
END;

BEGIN

        WHERE x.process_id = @process_id

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Job_GetJobQueueByFilter]
(@ent_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
--,@job_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,@woId NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
,@readyState NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
,@runningState NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
,@completeState NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
,@suspendedState NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
,@cancelledState NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
,@lastNHrs INT = NULL
,@userid nvarchar(50)
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_ofi_Job_GetJobQueueByFilter
-- Description       - Return a recordset using the job filters stored in ui_config table
-- Author	         - YG
-- Date Created      - 03/24/2003
-- Version           - 0.1
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		 Changes
-- 03/24/2023	  YG 			0.1		 Customized from standard SP sp_SA_ofi_Job_GetJobQueueByFilter version 6.2
--                                       - Added job history used to get latest start time
--										 - Added product type
--29/06/2023	  DS			0.2		- Added 2 more columns entity_type, wo_type
--13/07/2023      TB            0.3     - Added 1 more column item_grade_desc
--09/08/2023	  SSB			0.4		- Added 3 more columns split_vis_chk, isassigned, orderType
--18/12/2023	  MA			0.5		- Added 1 more column grade color.	
--08/03/2023	  DS			0.5		- Reverted the  ent_name & ent_desc related code change , now only entity_name will be shown
--22/10/2024		JSC			0.6		- Removed hardocoded domain names
--25/06/2026      AML, XPM		0.7		- Fixed duplication issue in Job Queue
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @incl_sched_parents	LOGICAL = 1
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = [dbo].[fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromServer]()

Declare @state_decl nvarchar(100),
		@job_filter nvarchar(1000),
		@woIdNr nvarchar(1000),
		@canceledHours nvarchar(100),
		@completedHours nvarchar(100)

-- ++ State Declaration
IF @readyState = 'True' 
	Set @state_decl = CONCAT(@state_decl,'2',',');
IF @runningState = 'True'
	Set @state_decl = CONCAT(@state_decl,'3',',');
IF @completeState = 'True'
    Set @state_decl = CONCAT(@state_decl,'4',',');
IF @suspendedState = 'True'
    Set @state_decl = CONCAT(@state_decl,'5',',');
IF @cancelledState = 'True'
    Set @state_decl = CONCAT(@state_decl,'7');

--Delete last comma if available
if (RIGHT(@state_decl,1)=',')
BEGIN
	DECLARE @STATE_LEN INT = LEN(@state_decl ) - 1
	SET @state_decl = LEFT(@state_decl, @STATE_LEN)
END
SET @job_filter = CONCAT('$$',@state_decl,'$$')
-- ++ State Declaration

-- ++ Cancelled Hours Declaration
SET @canceledHours = CONCAT('CANCELLED','=',CAST(@lastNHrs as VARCHAR))
SET @job_filter = CONCAT(@job_filter,'$$',@canceledHours,'$$')
-- ++ Cancelled Hours Declaration

-- ++ Completed Hours Declaration
SET @completedHours = CONCAT('COMPLETED','=',CAST(@lastNHrs as VARCHAR))
SET @job_filter = CONCAT(@job_filter,'$$',@completedHours,'$$')
-- ++ Completed Hours Declaration

-- ++ WorkOrder Declaration
SET @woIdNr = CONCAT('WO_ID','=',CAST(@woId as VARCHAR))
SET @job_filter = CONCAT(@job_filter,'$$',@woIdNr,'$$')
-- ++ WorkOrder Declaration

-- ++ Other Declaration
SET @job_filter = CONCAT(@job_filter,'$$','OPER_ID=%%$$$$SEQ_NO=%%$$$$ITEM_ID=%%','$$')
-- ++ Other Declaration



Declare @user nvarchar(50)
-- TODO FIX for DOMAIN
	DECLARE @domain NVARCHAR(100)
	SELECT @domain = DEFAULT_DOMAIN()
	set @user=@domain+'\'+@userid
	--set @user='Avevaqa\'+@userid

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi
	CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi (
	
	ent_id	INT,
	ent_name nvarchar(50),
	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
	can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
	can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
	can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
	can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
	can_stre nvarchar(5),
	can_log_data nvarchar(5),
	parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
	access int
	);
	INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi
	exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user

DECLARE  @ent_ids 	NVARCHAR(4000) -- Modified for CR115544
	,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(50)
	,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@seq_no	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@item_desc	NVARCHAR(90)
	-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
	,@first_job          NVARCHAR(90)
	,@state_cd 	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@complete_time	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@cancel_time	NVARCHAR(40)
--	,@current_time	NVARCHAR(20)
-- CR L00108373 - Changed from NVARCHAR(4000) to NVARCHAR(max) to prevent a string truncation.
DECLARE  @selectClause NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@joinClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@sSQL 		NVARCHAR(max)
	,@temp_SQL 	NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@start		INT
	,@end		INT
	,@current_time	DATETIME
	,@cancel_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@complete_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@num_decimals_good_pp INT32
	,@param_def NVARCHAR(4000)


	DECLARE @attr_id_enable_assign_job int ;
	declare @attr_id_split_vis int;
	declare @attr_id_ent_typ int;
	--1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts

	SELECT @attr_id_enable_assign_job = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where  attr_desc='enable_assign_jom' and attr_grp = 7 ;
	SELECT @attr_id_split_vis = attr_id   from attr  with (nolock) 	where attr_desc='split_visibility' and attr_grp = 7;
	SELECT @attr_id_ent_typ= attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc= 'EntityType' and attr_grp = 2;


	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326
	SELECT @selectClause = ''
	SET @ent_ids = @ent_filter
	SET @filter = @job_filter
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF @ent_ids IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @selectClause = ';WITH c AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @ent_ids, j+1) FROM c WHERE j > i), ent_list_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@ent_ids, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@ent_ids)+1)-i-1) ent_id FROM c WHERE i >= 0), ent_list AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN ent_id = '''' THEN NULL ELSE ent_id END) ent_id FROM ent_list_abst)'
		IF (@incl_sched_parents IS NOT NULL AND @incl_sched_parents = 1) BEGIN
			SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', ents (parent_ent_id, can_sched_jobs) AS
					(select e.ent_id, e.can_sched_jobs FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ent_parent.ent_id, ent_parent.can_sched_jobs
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ents parent ON e.ent_id = parent.parent_ent_id
					INNER JOIN ent ent_parent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_parent.ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
					), distinct_ents AS (SELECT DISTINCT parent_ent_id FROM ents)
					'
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN distinct_ents de ON j.target_sched_ent_id = de.parent_ent_id'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id'
		END
	END

	IF @selectClause = '' SET @selectClause = ';WITH ' ELSE SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'a AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @state_cd, j+1) FROM a WHERE j > i), state_codes_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@state_cd, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@state_cd)+1)-i-1) state_cd FROM a WHERE i >= 0), state_codes AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN state_cd = '''' THEN NULL ELSE state_cd END) state_cd FROM state_codes_abst) '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'SELECT i.item_id,i.item_desc,i.uom_id uom_id_h,uom.description uom_description,i.lifetime,i.unit_cost,i.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',p.process_id,p.process_status,wo.wo_id,wo.req_qty,wo.release_time_utc, wo.release_time_local, DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value,wo.release_time_utc) release_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',wo.wo_priority,wo.cust_info'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.state_cd,j.job_priority,j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.req_finish_time_utc) req_finish_time,j.target_sched_ent_id,ent.ent_name as ent_name' --  case when ent.description is null then ent.ent_name else ent.description end as ent_name'  -- The below line has been used from changining ent_name into ent description on 2Aug 2023
	--SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.state_cd,j.job_priority,j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.req_finish_time_utc) req_finish_time,j.target_sched_ent_id,ent.ent_name'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.qty_reqd,j.qty_prod,j.qty_rejected,j.qty_at_start,j.batch_size,j.first_job,j.final_job,j.est_prod_rate'
	--SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_start_time_utc,j.sched_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_start_time_utc) sched_start_time,j.latest_start_time_utc,j.latest_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.latest_start_time_utc) latest_start_time' --Disabled on v0.1
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_start_time_utc,j.sched_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_start_time_utc) sched_start_time,j.latest_start_time_utc,convert(varchar, jh.job_start_utc, 27) latest_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.latest_start_time_utc) latest_start_time' --Added on v0.1
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_finish_time_utc,j.sched_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_finish_time_utc) sched_finish_time,j.notes,j.status_notes,js.state_desc as state_desc_h, js.color color_h'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',op.oper_desc,j.act_start_time_utc,j.act_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time,j.act_finish_time_utc,j.act_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_finish_time_utc) act_finish_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ent.can_sched_jobs,wo.mo_id, j.run_ent_id, ent2.ent_name Run_Ent_name,j.row_id row_id_h,i.num_decimals num_decimals_h,COALESCE(@num_decimals_good_pp, 0) AS num_decimals_good_pp'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',i.spare1,i.spare2,i.spare3,i.spare4,j.edit_time as edit_time_h,je.job_pos job_pos_h,jb.def_lot_no '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.spare1 job_spare1,j.spare2 job_spare2,j.spare3 job_spare3,j.spare4 job_spare4,j.concurrent_link,wo.wo_desc,qia.*,qja.* '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',pa.attr_value process_type ' --Added on v0.1
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ea.attr_value entity_type, case when wo.spare1 = 1 then ''SAP'' ELSE ''MES'' end as  wo_type ' --Added on v0.2
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ig.item_grade_desc '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) as grade_color '  --Added on v0.5
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ISNULL(oa.enablelblPreview, 0) as enbleLblPreview ' --Updated on v0.7
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',case when opa.attr_value is null then 0 else 1 end as split_vis_chk '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',case when isa.attr_value is NULL then NULL else 1 end as isassigned'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',case when wo.spare1=''1'' then ''SAP'' else ''MES'' end as orderType'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'left join oper_attr opa with (nolock) on j.oper_id=opa.oper_id and opa.attr_id='+convert(nvarchar,@attr_id_split_vis) +'and opa.attr_value=''0'''
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'left join oper_attr isa with (nolock) on isa.oper_id=j.oper_id and isa.attr_id= ' + convert(nvarchar, @attr_id_enable_assign_job)  -- (select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where  attr_desc=''enable_assign_jom'' )'	
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = j.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id=j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id=j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no=j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = wo.process_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.state_cd = j.state_cd'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = wo.process_id AND op.oper_id = j.oper_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ent.ent_id'
	SET  @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1) as UserEntaccess on ent.ent_id=UserEntaccess.ent_id ' -- 0.01.01
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ent2.ent_id '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = j.run_ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia WITH (NOLOCK) ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h=i.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja WITH (NOLOCK) ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h=j.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h=j.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h=j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN process_attr pa  WITH (NOLOCK) ON pa.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc= ''ProcessType'' and attr_grp = 8) AND pa.process_id = wo.process_id ' --Added on v0.1
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT JOIN ent_attr ea with(NOLOCK) on ea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id and ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc= ''EntityType'' and attr_grp = 2) ' --Added on v0.2
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' OUTER APPLY (SELECT top 1 * FROM job_history jh  WITH (NOLOCK) where j.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jh.seq_no and j.run_ent_id = jh.ent_id order by job_start_utc desc) jh ' --Added on v0.1
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' OUTER APPLY (SELECT item_grade_desc, color from  item_grade ig    WITH(NOLOCK) where ig.item_grade_cd=jb.reqd_grade_cd) ig'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 oa_in.attr_value as enablelblPreview FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN oper_attr oa_in WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa_in.attr_id WHERE a.attr_desc = ''enableLablePreview'' AND oa_in.process_id = wo.process_id AND oa_in.oper_id = j.oper_id ORDER BY oa_in.last_edit_at DESC) oa' --Updated on v0.7
    	
	IF (@joinClause IS NOT NULL) SET @selectClause = @selectClause + @joinClause

	SET @sSQL = ' WHERE jb.bom_pos=0 '

	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @start = 3
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @state_cd = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			IF RIGHT(@state_cd, 1) = ',' SET @state_cd = LEFT(@state_cd, LEN(@state_cd) -1)
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @cancel_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @cancel_time = REPLACE(@cancel_time, 'CANCELLED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @complete_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @complete_time = REPLACE(@complete_time, 'COMPLETED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @wo_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @wo_id = REPLACE(@wo_id, 'WO_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @oper_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @oper_id = REPLACE(@oper_id, 'OPER_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @seq_no = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @seq_no = REPLACE(@seq_no, 'SEQ_NO=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_id = REPLACE(@item_id, 'ITEM_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_desc = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_desc = REPLACE(@item_desc, 'ITEM_DESC=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @first_job = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @first_job = REPLACE(@first_job, 'FIRST_JOB=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		IF @state_cd = '' SET @state_cd = NULL
		IF (@cancel_time = ''  OR @cancel_time = '0') SET @cancel_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @cancel_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @cancel_time)))
		ELSE SET @cancel_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @cancel_time), @current_time)

		IF (@complete_time = '' OR @complete_time = '0') SET @complete_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @complete_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @complete_time)))
		ELSE SET @complete_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @complete_time),  @current_time)

		IF @wo_id = '' SET @wo_id = NULL
		IF @oper_id = '' SET @oper_id = NULL
		IF @seq_no = '' SET @seq_no = NULL
		IF @item_id = '' SET @item_id = NULL
		IF @item_desc = '' SET @item_desc = NULL
		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		IF @first_job = '' SET @first_job = NULL

		--Work Order ID Filter
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @wo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @wo_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id LIKE @wo_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id = @wo_id '
		END
		--Oper ID Filter
		IF (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id LIKE @oper_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id = @oper_id '
		END

		--Seq No Filter
		IF (@seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @seq_no) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @seq_no) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no LIKE @seq_no '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no =  @seq_no '
		END

		--Item ID Filter
		IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id LIKE @item_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id = @item_id '
		END

		--Item Desc Filter
		IF (@item_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_desc) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc = @item_desc '
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		-- First Job Filter
		IF (@first_job is not null and @first_job = '1') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.first_job = 1'
		END

		--state_cd filter
		IF (@state_cd = '4') OR (@state_cd = '7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = @state_cd '
--			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH,j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time  + ') <= ' + @complete_time
--			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @cancel_time
			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 4 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt'
			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 7 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt'
		END
		ELSE IF (@state_cd = '4,7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND ((js.state_cd = 4 OR js.state_cd = 7) '

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				--SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (js.state_cd = CASE WHEN (js.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @complete_time + ' THEN js.state_cd END ELSE js.state_cd END)'
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ')'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN state_codes sc ON js.state_cd = sc.state_cd'
			END

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

		END
	END	-- end of filter-state_code exists to filter records

	--INSERT into Test (column1) values ( 'First test');

	--SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY j.sched_start_time_utc, j.job_priority'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY CASE j.state_cd  WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 5 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN 3 WHEN 4 THEN 4 WHEN 7 THEN 5 WHEN 1 THEN 6 END,j.sched_start_time_utc, j.job_priority'--Using order by to sort the grid on the basis of Job status
	--PRINT @sSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias_value INT, @num_decimals_good_pp INT, @ent_ids NVARCHAR(4000), @wo_id NVARCHAR(50), @oper_id NVARCHAR(50), @seq_no NVARCHAR(50), @item_id NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ', @item_desc NVARCHAR(90), @complete_time_dt DATETIME, @cancel_time_dt DATETIME, @state_cd NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @sSQL = @selectClause + @sSQL

	--PRINT @sSQL

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @param_def, @time_zone_bias_value, @num_decimals_good_pp, @ent_ids, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id, @item_desc, @complete_time_dt, @cancel_time_dt, @state_cd
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetAvailSubsts]
(@wo_id		STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@seq_no	INT32
) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetAvailSubsts
-- Description	      - HD# 8306, Add function to return substitutes for bom_pos 0
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 07/19/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.19
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Sample Procedure call - --EXEC sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetAvailSubsts 'CHD-TEST1', '30', 3
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 05/29/2018		Surya		6.0	US#1030407(As SE, I want to fix CR L00149152 so that Operator doesn't generate an unhandled exception with substitutes).
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE	@upstream_jobs		TABLE(wo_id NVARCHAR(80), oper_id NVARCHAR(80), seq_no NVARCHAR(80), job_level INT)

DECLARE	@job_level		INT32
	,@item_id		NVARCHAR(80)

	--Get the current item that is produced in this job.
	SELECT @item_id = item_id FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = 0

	--Default the current job level to 1
	SET @job_level = 1

	--Retrieve the first set of upstream job(s).
	INSERT INTO @upstream_jobs (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_level)
	SELECT @wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, @job_level
	FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no

	--Set the current upstream job level to 2.
	SET @job_level = 2

	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		--Get the next set of upstream jobs.
		INSERT INTO @upstream_jobs (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_level)
		SELECT DISTINCT @wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, @job_level
		FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN @upstream_jobs jr_next_job ON jr.wo_id = jr_next_job.wo_id
			AND jr.oper_id = jr_next_job.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = jr_next_job.seq_no
		WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr_next_job.job_level = @job_level - 1
		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK

		--Increment the job_level variable to retrieve the current set of upstream jobs from the downstream jobs.
		SET @job_level = @job_level + 1
	END

	SELECT jbs.item_id, jbs.subst_level, jbs.alt_no, i.item_desc
	FROM
		--Retrieve the set of all substitute items for the current job
		(SELECT jbs.item_id, jbs.subst_level, jbs.alt_no FROM job_bom_subst jbs WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jbs.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbs.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbs.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbs.bom_pos = 0) jbs
	INNER JOIN
		--Retrieve the set of all substitutes for all the upstream jobs in this work order
		--that produce the same item as this one.
		(SELECT jbs.item_id FROM job_bom_subst jbs WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbs.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND jbs.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND jbs.seq_no = jb.seq_no
			AND jbs.bom_pos = jb.bom_pos
		INNER JOIN @upstream_jobs upstream_jobs ON jbs.wo_id = upstream_jobs.wo_id
			AND jbs.oper_id = upstream_jobs.oper_id AND jbs.seq_no = upstream_jobs.seq_no
		WHERE jbs.bom_pos = 0 AND jb.item_id = @item_id) ups_jobs ON jbs.item_id = ups_jobs.item_id
	--Intersect the items that are produced in the upstream jobs are the same items that are used as substitutes in the current job.
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbs.item_id = i.item_id
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_step_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[job_step]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - job_step
-- Description       -   (HD# 2570) Disallows any changes are made to step_seq and step_grp
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/16/2002
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@wo_id			NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no			INT,
	@step_no		INT,
	@new_step_seq		INT,
	@new_step_grp_id	INT,
	@old_step_seq		INT,
	@old_step_grp_id	INT,
	@step_grp_seq		INT,
	@last_edit_by		STRING40

	IF UPDATE(step_seq) OR UPDATE(step_grp_id) BEGIN

		DECLARE job_step_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
			SELECT b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.step_no, b.step_seq, b.step_grp_id
			FROM job_step a, inserted b
			WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id
			    AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
			    AND a.seq_no = b.seq_no
			   AND a.step_no = b.step_no

		OPEN job_step_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM job_step_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no
				,@new_step_seq ,@new_step_grp_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			SELECT @old_step_seq = step_seq, @old_step_grp_id = step_grp_id
			FROM DELETED
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_no = @step_no

			IF (@old_step_seq <> @new_step_seq) OR (@old_step_grp_id <> @new_step_grp_id) BEGIN

				SELECT @step_grp_seq = step_grp_seq FROM job_step_grp WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_grp_id = @new_step_grp_id

				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK), job_step js WITH (NOLOCK), job_step_grp jsg
						WHERE jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND jsd.step_no = js.step_no
						  AND js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
						  AND jsd.wo_id = @wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = @seq_no
						  AND (jsg.step_grp_seq > @step_grp_seq  OR (jsg.step_grp_seq = @step_grp_seq AND jsg.step_grp_id > @new_step_grp_id))) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Steps with the lower step seq_no or step_no on this step group are already started{3892}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK), job_step js WITH (NOLOCK), job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND jsd.step_no = js.step_no
							  AND js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
							  AND jsd.wo_id = @wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = @seq_no
							  AND (jsg.step_grp_seq > @step_grp_seq  OR (jsg.step_grp_seq = @step_grp_seq AND jsg.step_grp_id >= @new_step_grp_id))
							  AND (js.step_seq > @new_step_seq  OR (js.step_seq = @new_step_seq AND js.step_no >= @step_no))) BEGIN
						RAISERROR ('Steps with the lower step seq_no or step_no on this step group are already started{3892}', 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END
				END

			END
		END
		CLOSE job_step_cursor
		DEALLOCATE job_step_cursor
	END

	UPDATE job_step SET job_step.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_step.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE job_step.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_step.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_step.step_no = i.step_no
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:                [sp_U_ofi_Sublot_Attr]
-- Description: To update the Sublot counter Attribute
-- Note : Add SublotCounter Attribute ON Line Level in MES Client
-- Conditions:
--  ► Change in recipe (change in material OR change in the ratio of existing material OR change in the product dependent recipe parameter)
--  ► Changeover in source storage unit
--  ► On start of a job
--  ► On restart of a suspended job

-- Usage:   This will be used to generate Sub Lot Number
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author          Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
-- 0.01.00   MP               2022-07-28        Intial Version
-- 0.02.00   MP               2023-01-12        Added @eventName Condition //Events:StartJob, EditRecipe, RSUChange, ShiftChange,DayChange
-- 0.03.00   SM               2023-03-13        Include the Handling unit trigger sublot counter when it trigger the workflow
-- 0.04.00   YG               2023-05-17        Added @eventName EditSiloRecipe
-- 0.05.00   MP               2023-06-20        Added Logic for Sublot will change only ON Start Job for the 1st time
-- 0.06.00   SM               2023-06-21        Include sublot counter increment during good AND reject hu trigger
-- 0.07.00   MP               2023-06-26        Added Logic for Unique sublot number for multiple lines under one Area
-- 0.08.00   MP               2023-09-14        Added Logic for Frequency based sublot change
-- 0.09.00   DS               2024-02-09        Added nolock keyword
-- 0.10.00   AML, XPM         2026-03-30        Added the new logic from CR593 
-- 0.10.01	 JSC			  2026-04-07		Updated the way the parent entity is taken to keep the aveva logic
-- 0.11.00	 JSC			  2026-04-15		CR608: Update the target instead of the actual for some cases
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Sublot_Attr] 
    @wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40),
    @oper_id AS NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no AS INT,
    @ent_id AS INT,
    @eventName AS NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

  
    DECLARE @area_ent_id INT, 
            @line_ent_id INT, 
            @parent_ent_id INT, 
            @jb_state_cd INT;
    DECLARE @attr_id_counter INT, 
            @attr_id_area_req INT, 
            @attr_id_max INT;
    DECLARE @is_req_area_level NVARCHAR(100), 
            @max_counter INT, 
            @current_counter INT;
    DECLARE @trigger_attr_desc NVARCHAR(100), 
            @is_triggered INT = 0;
    DECLARE @val_to_save NVARCHAR(10);

	-- v10.01; modified to get the top 1 ordered by job line parent instead of entity
    SELECT TOP 1 @line_ent_id = parent_ent_id 
    FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_id = target_sched_ent_id 
    WHERE ent_id = @ent_id OR (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no)
	ORDER BY CASE WHEN ent_id = @ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC;

	-- v10.01; modified to get the area from the line of the job itself by modifying the previous query.
    SELECT @area_ent_id = parent_ent_id 
    FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE ent_id = @line_ent_id;


    SELECT @attr_id_counter = attr_id 
    FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE attr_desc = 'SublotCounter'
		AND attr_grp = 2; --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
	

    SELECT @attr_id_area_req = attr_id 
    FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE attr_desc = 'isRequiredAreaSublotforMultiLine'
		AND attr_grp = 2; --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
	
    

    SELECT @is_req_area_level = attr_value 
    FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_area_req 
		AND ent_id = @area_ent_id;

    SET @parent_ent_id = CASE 
							WHEN @is_req_area_level = '1' 
								THEN @area_ent_id 
							ELSE @line_ent_id 
						 END;


    SELECT @max_counter = ISNULL(CAST(REPLACE(ea.attr_value, ',', '') AS INT), 999)
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
											AND a.attr_desc = 'MaxSublotCounter'
											AND a.attr_grp = 2 --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
    WHERE ea.ent_id = @area_ent_id;

	-- set in case attribute doesn't exists at all
	SET @max_counter = COALESCE(@max_counter,999);

    SELECT @jb_state_cd = state_cd 
    FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no);

    --  Map Events to Attributes
    SET @trigger_attr_desc = CASE 
								WHEN @eventName = 'StartJob'       THEN 'NewSublotStartJob'
								WHEN @eventName = 'EditRecipe'     THEN 'NewSublotEditRecipe'
								WHEN @eventName = 'RSUChange'      THEN 'NewSublotOnSUChange'
								WHEN @eventName = 'OnFrequency'    THEN 'NewSublotOnFrequency'
								WHEN @eventName = 'ShiftChange'    THEN 'NewSublotOnShiftChange'
								WHEN @eventName = 'EditSiloRecipe' THEN 'NewSublotOnSURecipeChange'
								WHEN @eventName = 'DayChange'      THEN 'NewSublotOnDayChange'
								WHEN @eventName = 'GOODHU'         THEN 'NewSublotOnHUChange'
								ELSE NULL 
							END;


    IF @trigger_attr_desc IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT @is_triggered = CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT)
        FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
        WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id -- Always on line entity
			AND a.attr_desc = @trigger_attr_desc;
    END

	-- v10.01 Added: fix for start job
    IF @trigger_attr_desc = 'NewSublotStartJob' AND ISNULL(@is_triggered,0) <> 1
	BEGIN
		SET @trigger_attr_desc = CASE 
								WHEN @jb_state_cd = 2              THEN 'NewSublotOnlyFirstTimeStartJob'
								ELSE NULL 
							END;
 
		IF @trigger_attr_desc IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT @is_triggered = CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT)
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id -- Always on line entity
				AND a.attr_desc = @trigger_attr_desc;
		END
	END
    
    SELECT @current_counter = ISNULL(CAST(REPLACE(attr_value, ',', '') AS INT),0)
    FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_counter 
		AND ent_id = @parent_ent_id;

    IF @is_triggered = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @current_counter = CASE 
									WHEN @current_counter >= @max_counter 
										THEN 1 
									ELSE @current_counter + 1 
								END;
        SET @val_to_save = RIGHT('000' + CAST(@current_counter AS VARCHAR), 3);

        UPDATE ent_attr 
		SET attr_value = @val_to_save
        WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_counter 
			AND ent_id = @parent_ent_id;

   
        IF @parent_ent_id = @area_ent_id
		BEGIN
            UPDATE ent_attr 
			SET attr_value = @val_to_save
            WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_counter 
				AND ent_id = @line_ent_id;
		END  


		-- MOD v0.11
		DECLARE @attr_id_save_job INT, 
				@attr_id_last_sublot INT,
				@attr_id_use_sublot_target INT,
				@attr_id_sublot_target INT,
				@target_attr_id INT,
				@update_attr_value INT = -1;
		SELECT @attr_id_save_job = attr_id 
		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE attr_desc = 'SaveJobSublotCounter'
			AND attr_grp = 7; --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
		SELECT @attr_id_last_sublot = attr_id 
		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE attr_desc = 'LastSublotCounter'
			AND attr_grp = 5; --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts

		-- ADDED v0.11
		SELECT @attr_id_use_sublot_target = attr_id 
		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE attr_desc = 'UseSublotCounterTarget'
			AND attr_grp = 7; --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
		SELECT @attr_id_sublot_target = attr_id 
		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE attr_desc = 'SublotCounterTarget'
			AND attr_grp = 5; --1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = @oper_id AND attr_id = @attr_id_save_job AND attr_value = '1')
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = @oper_id AND attr_id = @attr_id_use_sublot_target AND attr_value = '1')
			BEGIN
				-- we need to use the target
				SET @target_attr_id = @attr_id_sublot_target;
				-- check if it must be an update or an insert
				IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND attr_id = @attr_id_sublot_target)
				BEGIN
					SET @update_attr_value = 1
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @update_attr_value = 0
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- we need to use the job sublot directly
				SET @target_attr_id = @attr_id_last_sublot;
				-- check whether upate or insert
				IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND attr_id = @attr_id_last_sublot)
				BEGIN
					-- we need to update
					SET @update_attr_value = 1
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @update_attr_value = 0
				END
			END
			-- Update or insert new value into the right place
			IF (@update_attr_value = 1)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE job_attr 
				SET attr_value = @val_to_save, 
					last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND attr_id = @target_attr_id;
			END
			ELSE IF (@update_attr_value = 0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO job_attr (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, attr_id, attr_value, last_edit_at)
				VALUES (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @target_attr_id, @val_to_save, GETUTCDATE());
			END
		END
	END
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_U_ofi_UpdateCreatedDate]
-- Description:This will be used in after production and consuption successfully recorded to update the created date


-- Usage:	This will be used in MDMAddProductionJobWorkflow and MDMAddConsumptionJobWorkflow
-- Ex: EXEC [sp_U_ofi_UpdateCreatedDate] @ent_id=205,@created_at_utc='2024-05-13 04:11:00.000',@activity='PROD',@row_id=22929
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 YG            	  2024-05-13		Intial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_UpdateCreatedDate]
	@ent_id INT,
	@created_at_utc TDATETIME = NULL,
	@activity NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
	@row_id INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--SELECT @ent_id=205,@created_at_utc='2024-05-13 04:11:00.000',@activity='PROD',@row_id=22929
	
	-- Ensure created_at_utc value is filled
	IF @row_id IS NULL and @row_id > 0
	BEGIN
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Ensure created_at_utc value is filled
	IF (@created_at_utc IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- Check activity
		IF @activity = 'CONS' 
		BEGIN
			UPDATE item_cons SET created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id,@created_at_utc), created_at_utc = @created_at_utc WHERE row_id = @row_id
		END
		ELSE IF @activity = 'PROD' 
		BEGIN
			UPDATE item_prod SET created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id,@created_at_utc), created_at_utc = @created_at_utc WHERE row_id = @row_id
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		RETURN -1
	END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_bom_item_oper_spec_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_spec]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_bom_item_oper_spec_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec a, inserted b
				WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
				     AND a.spec_ver_id  = b.spec_ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},bom_item_oper_spec', 16, 1)
				RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec a, inserted b
				WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
				     AND a.spec_ver_id  = b.spec_ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id) bios
	WHERE process.process_id = bios.process_id

END
