CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_Get_Item_grade_color] 
( @grade_desc nvarchar(50)=NULL )

	DECLARE @result_grade_color nvarchar(50)=NULL,
			@grade_color INT=0

	RETURN @result_grade_color

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_Item_Master_Attr
-- Description:  Updates the item master attributes
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-12      Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_MM_Def_Attr] (@item_id     NVARCHAR(40),
                                                  @item_status NVARCHAR(40),
                                                  @item_group  NVARCHAR(40),
                                                  @plant_code  NVARCHAR(40))
AS
  BEGIN
      IF @item_status <> 'Deleted' and (dbo.fn_s_ofi_plantcode()= @plant_code)
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @rc             INT,
                    @error_msg      NVARCHAR(500),
                    @error_severity INT,
                    @error_state    INT,
                    @attr_cur       CURSOR,
                    @def_value      NVARCHAR(1700),
                    @attr_id        INT,
                    @mod_id         VARCHAR(30)

            BEGIN try
                BEGIN TRANSACTION

                SET @attr_cur= CURSOR
                FOR SELECT attr_id,
                           def_value
                    FROM   ofi_master_attr WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  attr_grp = 1
                           AND item_group = @item_group

                OPEN @attr_cur

                FETCH next FROM @attr_cur INTO @attr_id, @def_value

                WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                      IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                                 FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
                                 WHERE  a.attr_id = @attr_id
                                        AND a.attr_grp = 1)
                        BEGIN
                            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                                           FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                                           WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                                                  AND attr_id = @attr_id)
							  BEGIN
								  EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_item_attr]
									@item_id = @item_id,
									@attr_id = @attr_id,
									@attr_value = @def_value,
									@notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
									@last_edit_comment = NULL,
									@mod_id = @mod_id output

								  IF ( @rc <> 0 )
									BEGIN
										SET @error_msg =
										N'Error while creating item attribute ('
										+ @item_id
										+
										') in MES  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_MASTER_ATTR -  '
														 + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),
										@rc);

										THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
									END
							  END
                        END
                      ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SET @error_msg = N'Item attribute not found (' +
                                             @attr_id
                                             + ') in MES  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_MASTER_ATTR -  '
                                             + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

                            THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
                        END

                      FETCH next FROM @attr_cur INTO @attr_id, @def_value
                  END

                CLOSE @attr_cur

                DEALLOCATE @attr_cur

                COMMIT TRANSACTION
            END try

            BEGIN catch
                IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

                SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
                       @error_severity = Error_severity(),
                       @error_state = Error_state();

                RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
            END catch
        END
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeWOValues]
(
	@wo_id					NVARCHAR(40),
	@priority				INT = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_local	DATETIME = NULL,
	@qty_reqd				FLOAT = NULL,
	@qty_at_start			FLOAT = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT = 0,
	@mod_id					NVARCHAR(30) = NULL OUTPUT
)

AS

BEGIN
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_U_JOB_EXEC_CHANGEWOVALUES
-- Description			- Change Priority, Reqd Finish Times and allocate job qtys for all jobs
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 09/18/2002
-- Version				- 1.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2		Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/18/2004		Raghu			2.0.26		(HD# 4480) Due date changes for WO does not update properly
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 12/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.6		HD# 7057, WO required finish time should be set to NULL if NOT supplied.
-- 06/08/2007		Raghu			3.2.16		HD# 9729, Jobs window/Cloning a work order
-- 08/13/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @max_req_finish_time_utc	DATETIME
		,	@max_req_finish_time_local	DATETIME
		,	@diff_finish_time 			INT
		,	@return						INT
		,	@tz_temp					INT
		,	@req_finish_time_utc		DATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	IF @wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR('WO_Id cannot be null or empty{3199}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF @priority IS NOT NULL UPDATE JOB SET job_priority = @priority WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	IF @req_finish_time_local IS NULL BEGIN
		UPDATE wo SET req_finish_time_utc = NULL, req_finish_time_local = NULL WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		UPDATE job SET req_finish_time_utc = NULL, req_finish_time_local = NULL WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	END
	ELSE IF dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @req_finish_time_local ) <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
	BEGIN
		--Ignore updating required finish time if the required finish time value is '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
		--SELECT @req_finish_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time)
		SELECT @max_req_finish_time_utc = MAX( req_finish_time_utc ), @max_req_finish_time_local = MAX( req_finish_time_local )
		FROM JOB WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1

		SET @max_req_finish_time_utc = COALESCE( @max_req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_utc )
		--IF @max_req_finish_time_utc IS NULL SET @max_req_finish_time = @req_finish_time

		UPDATE WO
		SET req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc,
			req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		SET @diff_finish_time = DATEDIFF( mi, @max_req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_utc )

		UPDATE job
		SET req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc,
			req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1

		UPDATE JOB
		SET req_finish_time_utc = DATEADD( mi, @diff_finish_time, req_finish_time_utc ),
			req_finish_time_local = DATEADD( mi, @diff_finish_time, req_finish_time_local )
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job <> 1
	END

	IF @qty_reqd IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF (@qty_at_start IS NULL)
			SELECT @qty_at_start = SUM(qty_at_start) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1

		EXEC @return = sp_Alloc_Job_Qty @wo_id, NULL, NULL, @qty_reqd, NULL, @qty_at_start, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
		IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
	END
	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id))) FROM WO where wo_id = @wo_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Step]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @step_no  int  ,
 @step_seq  int  ,
 @step_name nvarchar(40),
 @action_type  int  ,
 @complete_cond  int  ,
 @enter_data  bit  ,
 @step_grp_id  int  ,
 @spc_char  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @data_log_grp_id int ,
 @control_type int,
 @spare1  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare5  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare6  nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	    -
-- Description	    -
-- Author			-
-- Date Created	    - 10/21/2002
-- Version			- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Changes
-- 12/18/2002		Vijay			HD 646 - Added to sort by step_seq
-- 10/30/2003		Rich			Added step_grp_seq and repeatability columns
-- 01/15/2004		Raghu			Added "can_log_data" in SELECT clause
-- 09/21/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 10/31/2007		AML				3.4.0	DB Changes
-- 12/27/2007		AML				3.4.0	Updated for periodic data collection.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@os_process_id	NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@os_oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@os_step_no		INT
		,	@can_log_data	INT

	DECLARE @os_data_log TABLE (process_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), step_no INT, can_log_data INT)

	DECLARE os_can_log_data CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT process_id, oper_id, step_no FROM oper_step WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		  AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
		  AND (step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)

	OPEN os_can_log_data
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM os_can_log_data INTO @os_process_id, @os_oper_id, @os_step_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		EXEC sp_SA_OEL_Can_Log_Data @os_process_id, @os_oper_id, @os_step_no, @can_log_data OUTPUT
		INSERT INTO @os_data_log (process_id, oper_id, step_no, can_log_data)
		VALUES (@os_process_id, @os_oper_id, @os_step_no, @can_log_data)
	END
	CLOSE os_can_log_data
	DEALLOCATE os_can_log_data

	SELECT	 oper_step.process_id
			,oper_step.oper_id
			,oper_step.step_no
			,oper_step.step_seq
			,oper_step.step_name
			,oper_step.step_desc
			,oper_step.action_type
			,oper_step.std_time
			,oper_step.complete_cond
			,oper_step.allow_bypass
			,oper_step.enter_data
			,oper_step.step_grp_id
			,oper_step_grp.step_grp_desc
			,oper_step.spc_char
			,oper_step.form_name
			,oper_step.data_log_grp_id
			,oper_step.reqd_rep_pct
			,oper_step.control_type
			,oper_step.high_limit
			,oper_step.low_limit
			,oper_step.limit_warning
			,oper_step.spare1
			,oper_step.spare2
			,oper_step.spare3
			,oper_step.spare4
			,oper_step.spare5
			,oper_step.spare6
			,oper.oper_desc
			,process.process_desc
			,oper_step_grp.step_grp_seq
			,oper_step_grp.repeatability
			,os_data_log.can_log_data
			,oper_step.last_edit_comment
			,oper_step.last_edit_by
			,oper_step.last_edit_at
			,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_step.mod_id))) mod_id
			,oper_step_grp.last_edit_at step_grp_last_edit_at
			,oper_step.row_id
	FROM oper_step oper_step WITH (NOLOCK)
	      ,process process  WITH (NOLOCK)
	      ,oper oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	     ,oper_step_grp  oper_step_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
	     ,@os_data_log os_data_log
	WHERE (
			(oper_step.process_id = oper.process_id) AND
			(oper_step.oper_id = oper.oper_id) AND
			(oper_step.process_id = process.process_id) AND
			(oper_step.process_id = oper_step_grp.process_id) AND
			(oper_step.oper_id = oper_step_grp.oper_id) AND
			(oper_step.step_grp_id = oper_step_grp.step_grp_id) AND
			(oper_step.process_id = os_data_log.process_id) AND
			(oper_step.oper_id = os_data_log.oper_id) AND
			(oper_step.step_no = os_data_log.step_no) AND
			(oper_step.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.step_seq = @step_seq OR @step_seq IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.step_name = @step_name OR @step_name IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.action_type = @action_type OR @action_type IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.complete_cond = @complete_cond OR @complete_cond IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.enter_data = ABS(@enter_data) OR @enter_data IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.step_grp_id = @step_grp_id OR @step_grp_id IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spc_char = @spc_char OR @spc_char IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.data_log_grp_id = @data_log_grp_id OR @data_log_grp_id IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.control_type = @control_type OR @control_type IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spare5 = @spare5 OR @spare5 IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.spare6 = @spare6 OR @spare6 IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(oper_step.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY oper_step.step_seq, oper_step.step_no
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Job_JobQueue] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ent_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_SA_ofi_Job_JobQueue 
-- Description:	    This SP is derived from sp- sp_SA_Job_GetJobQueueByFilter for fetching the records for job queue based on entity filter
--
-- Usage:			Used in job queue tab in the job management
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			DS				2024-02-09						Updated the header comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************


BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

Declare --@ent_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
--,
@job_filter		NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,@incl_sched_parents	LOGICAL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

--set @ent_filter = N'138'

DECLARE  @ent_ids 	NVARCHAR(4000) -- Modified for CR115544
	,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(50)
	,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@seq_no	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@item_desc	NVARCHAR(90)
	-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
	,@first_job          NVARCHAR(90)
	,@state_cd 	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@complete_time	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@cancel_time	NVARCHAR(40)
--	,@current_time	NVARCHAR(20)
-- CR L00108373 - Changed from NVARCHAR(4000) to NVARCHAR(max) to prevent a string truncation.
DECLARE  @selectClause NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@joinClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@sSQL 		NVARCHAR(max)
	,@temp_SQL 	NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@start		INT
	,@end		INT
	,@current_time	DATETIME
	,@cancel_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@complete_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@num_decimals_good_pp INT32
	,@param_def NVARCHAR(4000)

	IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..##TempjobSummary') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
	DROP TABLE ##TempjobSummary
	END
	
	CREATE TABLE ##TempjobSummary(
    item_id nvarchar(100),
    item_desc nvarchar(100),
    uom_id_h nvarchar(50),
    uom_description nvarchar(50),-- decimal (8, 2) NOT NULL,
    lifetime varchar(100),
	unit_cost nvarchar(100),
	item_class_id nvarchar(100),
	item_class_desc nvarchar(100),
	process_id nvarchar(100),
	process_status nvarchar(100),
	wo_id nvarchar(100),
	req_qty nvarchar(100),
	release_time_utc datetime,
	release_time_local datetime,
	release_time datetime,
	wo_priority nvarchar(100),
	cust_info nvarchar(100),
	oper_id nvarchar(100),
	seq_no int,
	job_desc nvarchar(100),
	state_cd int,
	job_priority nvarchar(100),
	req_finish_time_utc datetime,
	req_finish_time_local datetime,
	req_finish_time datetime,
	target_sched_ent_id nvarchar(100),
	ent_name nvarchar(100),
	qty_reqd nvarchar(100),
	qty_prod nvarchar(100),
	qty_rejected nvarchar(100),
	qty_at_start nvarchar(100),
	batch_size nvarchar(100),
	first_job nvarchar(100),
	final_job nvarchar(100),
	est_prod_rate nvarchar(100),
	sched_start_time_utc datetime,
	sched_start_time_local datetime,
	sched_start_time datetime,
	latest_start_time_utc datetime,
	latest_start_time_local datetime,
	latest_start_time datetime,
	sched_finish_time_utc datetime,
	sched_finish_local datetime,
	sched_finish_time nvarchar(100),
	notes nvarchar(100),
	status_notes nvarchar(100),
	state_desc_h nvarchar(100),
	color_h nvarchar(100),
	oper_desc nvarchar(100),
	act_start_time_utc datetime,
	act_start_time_local datetime,
	act_start_time datetime,
	act_finish_time_utc datetime,
	act_finish_time_local datetime,
	act_finish_time datetime,
	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(100),
	mo_id nvarchar(100),
	run_ent_id nvarchar(100),
	Run_Ent_name nvarchar(100),
	row_id_h nvarchar(100),
	num_decimals_h nvarchar(100),
	num_decimals_good_pp nvarchar(100),
	spare1 nvarchar(100),
	spare2 nvarchar(100),
	spare3 nvarchar(100),
	spare4 nvarchar(100),
	edit_time_h datetime,
	job_pos_h nvarchar(50),
	def_lot_no nvarchar(50),
	job_spare1 nvarchar(100),
	job_spare2 nvarchar(100),
	job_spare3 nvarchar(100),
	job_spare4 nvarchar(100),
	concurrent_link nvarchar(100),
	wo_desc nvarchar(100),
	queue_item_item_id_h nvarchar(100),
	queue_job_wo_id_h nvarchar(50),
	queue_job_oper_id_h nvarchar(50),
	queue_job_seq_no_h nvarchar(50)

	)
 

	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326
	SELECT @selectClause = ''
	SET @ent_ids = @ent_filter
	SET @filter = @job_filter
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF @ent_ids IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @selectClause = ';WITH c AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @ent_ids, j+1) FROM c WHERE j > i), ent_list_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@ent_ids, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@ent_ids)+1)-i-1) ent_id FROM c WHERE i >= 0), ent_list AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN ent_id = '''' THEN NULL ELSE ent_id END) ent_id FROM ent_list_abst)'
		IF (@incl_sched_parents IS NOT NULL AND @incl_sched_parents = 1) BEGIN
			SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', ents (parent_ent_id, can_sched_jobs) AS
					(select e.ent_id, e.can_sched_jobs FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ent_parent.ent_id, ent_parent.can_sched_jobs
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ents parent ON e.ent_id = parent.parent_ent_id
					INNER JOIN ent ent_parent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_parent.ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
					), distinct_ents AS (SELECT DISTINCT parent_ent_id FROM ents)
					'
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN distinct_ents de ON j.target_sched_ent_id = de.parent_ent_id'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id'
		END
	END

	IF @selectClause = '' SET @selectClause = ';WITH ' ELSE SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'a AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @state_cd, j+1) FROM a WHERE j > i), state_codes_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@state_cd, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@state_cd)+1)-i-1) state_cd FROM a WHERE i >= 0), state_codes AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN state_cd = '''' THEN NULL ELSE state_cd END) state_cd FROM state_codes_abst) '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'SELECT i.item_id,i.item_desc,i.uom_id uom_id_h,uom.description uom_description,i.lifetime,i.unit_cost,i.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',p.process_id,p.process_status,wo.wo_id,wo.req_qty,wo.release_time_utc, wo.release_time_local, DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value,wo.release_time_utc) release_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',wo.wo_priority,wo.cust_info'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.state_cd,j.job_priority,j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.req_finish_time_utc) req_finish_time,j.target_sched_ent_id,ent.ent_name'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.qty_reqd,j.qty_prod,j.qty_rejected,j.qty_at_start,j.batch_size,j.first_job,j.final_job,j.est_prod_rate'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_start_time_utc,j.sched_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_start_time_utc) sched_start_time,j.latest_start_time_utc,j.latest_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.latest_start_time_utc) latest_start_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_finish_time_utc,j.sched_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_finish_time_utc) sched_finish_time,j.notes,j.status_notes,js.state_desc as state_desc_h, js.color color_h'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',op.oper_desc,j.act_start_time_utc,j.act_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time,j.act_finish_time_utc,j.act_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_finish_time_utc) act_finish_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ent.can_sched_jobs,wo.mo_id, j.run_ent_id, ent2.ent_name Run_Ent_name,j.row_id row_id_h,i.num_decimals num_decimals_h,COALESCE(@num_decimals_good_pp, 0) AS num_decimals_good_pp'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',i.spare1,i.spare2,i.spare3,i.spare4,j.edit_time as edit_time_h,je.job_pos job_pos_h,jb.def_lot_no '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.spare1 job_spare1,j.spare2 job_spare2,j.spare3 job_spare3,j.spare4 job_spare4,j.concurrent_link,wo.wo_desc,qia.*,qja.* '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = j.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id=j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id=j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no=j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = wo.process_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.state_cd = j.state_cd'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = wo.process_id AND op.oper_id = j.oper_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ent.ent_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ent2.ent_id '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = j.run_ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia WITH (NOLOCK) ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h=i.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja WITH (NOLOCK) ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h=j.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h=j.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h=j.seq_no'

	IF (@joinClause IS NOT NULL) SET @selectClause = @selectClause + @joinClause

	SET @sSQL = ' WHERE jb.bom_pos=0 '

	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @start = 3
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @state_cd = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			IF RIGHT(@state_cd, 1) = ',' SET @state_cd = LEFT(@state_cd, LEN(@state_cd) -1)
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @cancel_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @cancel_time = REPLACE(@cancel_time, 'CANCELLED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @complete_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @complete_time = REPLACE(@complete_time, 'COMPLETED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @wo_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @wo_id = REPLACE(@wo_id, 'WO_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @oper_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @oper_id = REPLACE(@oper_id, 'OPER_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @seq_no = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @seq_no = REPLACE(@seq_no, 'SEQ_NO=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_id = REPLACE(@item_id, 'ITEM_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_desc = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_desc = REPLACE(@item_desc, 'ITEM_DESC=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @first_job = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @first_job = REPLACE(@first_job, 'FIRST_JOB=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		IF @state_cd = '' SET @state_cd = NULL
		IF (@cancel_time = ''  OR @cancel_time = '0') SET @cancel_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @cancel_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @cancel_time)))
		ELSE SET @cancel_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @cancel_time), @current_time)

		IF (@complete_time = '' OR @complete_time = '0') SET @complete_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @complete_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @complete_time)))
		ELSE SET @complete_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @complete_time),  @current_time)

		IF @wo_id = '' SET @wo_id = NULL
		IF @oper_id = '' SET @oper_id = NULL
		IF @seq_no = '' SET @seq_no = NULL
		IF @item_id = '' SET @item_id = NULL
		IF @item_desc = '' SET @item_desc = NULL
		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		IF @first_job = '' SET @first_job = NULL

		--Work Order ID Filter
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @wo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @wo_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id LIKE @wo_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id = @wo_id '
		END
		--Oper ID Filter
		IF (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id LIKE @oper_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id = @oper_id '
		END

		--Seq No Filter
		IF (@seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @seq_no) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @seq_no) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no LIKE @seq_no '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no =  @seq_no '
		END

		--Item ID Filter
		IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id LIKE @item_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id = @item_id '
		END

		--Item Desc Filter
		IF (@item_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_desc) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc = @item_desc '
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		-- First Job Filter
		IF (@first_job is not null and @first_job = '1') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.first_job = 1'
		END

		--state_cd filter
		IF (@state_cd = '4') OR (@state_cd = '7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = @state_cd '
--			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH,j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time  + ') <= ' + @complete_time
--			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @cancel_time
			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 4 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt'
			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 7 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt'
		END
		ELSE IF (@state_cd = '4,7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND ((js.state_cd = 4 OR js.state_cd = 7) '

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				--SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (js.state_cd = CASE WHEN (js.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @complete_time + ' THEN js.state_cd END ELSE js.state_cd END)'
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ')'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN state_codes sc ON js.state_cd = sc.state_cd'
			END

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

		END
	END	-- end of filter-state_code exists to filter records

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY j.sched_start_time_utc, j.job_priority'
	--PRINT @sSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias_value INT, @num_decimals_good_pp INT, @ent_ids NVARCHAR(4000), @wo_id NVARCHAR(50), @oper_id NVARCHAR(50), @seq_no NVARCHAR(50), @item_id NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ', @item_desc NVARCHAR(90), @complete_time_dt DATETIME, @cancel_time_dt DATETIME, @state_cd NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @sSQL = @selectClause + @sSQL
	print @sSQL
	insert into ##TempjobSummary
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @param_def, @time_zone_bias_value, @num_decimals_good_pp, @ent_ids, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id, @item_desc, @complete_time_dt, @cancel_time_dt, @state_cd

	select * from ##TempjobSummary where state_cd=3
	
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no	INT
,@bom_pos	INT		= NULL
--,@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)	= NULL
--,@last_edit_at	DATETIME	= NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData
-- Description	      - Returns all job_bom records with the filters supplied in.
--			Also, if a substitution is set to a job_bom record, then it returns the substitute record
--			for the specific bom_pos
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 07/30/2004
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--10/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.5	HD# 4979, Included uom, lifetime fields in the Select clause
--11/02/2004	Raghu		2.1.6	HD# 5104, Include bom 0 records as well (if bom_pos is not supplied) for consumed_so_far column
--02/14/2004	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5380, Exclude item_cons records that are not of type normal consumption
--03-13-2007	Raghu		3.2.3	oper_id and seq_no are made optional.
--01-22-2008	DonT		3.4.0	CR L00073771 - return qty_prod and qty_rejected in recordset
--10-31-2017    SaraR       6.0.0   US 935833 Add actual_qty to return dataset which is the calculated quantity at operation
--11-08-2017    SaraR       6.0.0   US 940476 Add actual_min_qty and actual_max_qty to return dataset which is the calculated minimum and maximum quantities at the operation
--03-13-2018    SaraR       6.0.0   US 980274 Add item_display to return dataset based on system_attr 210 value
--05/29/2018	RaghuG		6.0		US 1033968 - As Karen, I want a sum of quantities produced by the byproduct of a selected job
--10/10/2018	LorinG		6.0		US 1090919 Return def_sublot_no also
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(10)

SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT  jb.wo_id, jb.oper_id, jb.seq_no, jb.bom_pos,
	'job_bom_subst_exist' = CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = jb.wo_id AND oper_id = jb.oper_id AND seq_no = jb.seq_no AND bom_pos = jb.bom_pos) = 1 THEN 1
				ELSE 0 END,
	jb.current_subst, jbst.pref, jbst.subst_level,
	'item_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END,
	'item_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END,
		CASE
			WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END
			WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END
			WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END + '(' + CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END + ')'
			WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END + '(' + CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END + ')'
		END AS item_display,
	'uom_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.uom_id ELSE jbst.uom_id END,
	'description' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.description ELSE jbst.description END,
	'abbreviation' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.abbreviation ELSE jbst.abbreviation END,
	'lifetime' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.lifetime ELSE jbst.lifetime END,
	'reqd_grade_cd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_grade_cd ELSE jbst.reqd_grade_cd END,
	'item_grade_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_grade_desc ELSE jbst.item_grade_desc END,
	'color' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.color ELSE jbst.color END,
	'instruction' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.instruction ELSE jbst.instruction END,
	'qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_per_parent_item ELSE jbst.qty_per_parent_item END,
	'max_qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.max_qty_per_parent_item ELSE jbst.max_qty_per_parent_item END,
	'min_qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.min_qty_per_parent_item ELSE jbst.min_qty_per_parent_item END,
	'reqd_start_val' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_start_val ELSE jbst.reqd_start_val END,
	'reqd_start_val_is_pct' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_start_val_is_pct ELSE jbst.reqd_start_val_is_pct END,
	'qty_prod' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_prod ELSE jbst.qty_prod END,
	'qty_rejected' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_rejected ELSE jbst.qty_rejected END,
	'update_inv' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.update_inv ELSE jbst.update_inv END,
	'backflush' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.backflush ELSE jbst.backflush END,
	'def_reas_cd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_reas_cd ELSE jbst.def_reas_cd END,
	'reas_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reas_desc ELSE jbst.reas_desc END,
	'def_lot_no' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_lot_no ELSE jbst.def_lot_no END,
	'def_sublot_no' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_sublot_no ELSE jbst.def_sublot_no END,
	'def_storage_ent_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_storage_ent_id ELSE jbst.def_storage_ent_id END,
	'ent_name' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.ent_name ELSE jbst.ent_name END,
	'scaling_factor' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.scaling_factor ELSE jbst.scaling_factor END,
	'must_consume_from_inv' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_from_inv ELSE jbst.must_consume_from_inv END,
	'may_choose_alt_inv_loc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.may_choose_alt_inv_loc ELSE jbst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc END,
	'may_create_new_lots' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.may_create_new_lots ELSE jbst.may_create_new_lots END,
	'must_consume_from_wip' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_from_wip ELSE jbst.must_consume_from_wip END,
	'must_consume_before_prod' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_before_prod ELSE jbst.must_consume_before_prod END,
	'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.consumed_so_far ELSE jbst.consumed_so_far END,
	'constant_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.constant_qty ELSE jbst.constant_qty END,
	'est_time' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.est_time ELSE jbst.est_time END,
	'spare1' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare1 ELSE jbst.spare1 END,
	'spare2' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare2 ELSE jbst.spare2 END,
	'spare3' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare3 ELSE jbst.spare3 END,
	'spare4' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare4 ELSE jbst.spare4 END,
	'qty_reqd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_reqd ELSE jbst.qty_reqd END,
	'qty_at_start' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_at_start ELSE jbst.qty_at_start END,
	'num_decimals' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.num_decimals ELSE jbst.num_decimals END,
	'item_spare1' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare1 ELSE jbst.item_spare1 END,
	'item_spare2' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare2 ELSE jbst.item_spare2 END,
	'item_spare3' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare3 ELSE jbst.item_spare3 END,
	'item_spare4' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare4 ELSE jbst.item_spare4 END,
	'last_edit_comment' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_comment ELSE jbst.last_edit_comment END,
	'last_edit_by' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_by ELSE jbst.last_edit_by END,
	'last_edit_at' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_at ELSE jbst.last_edit_at END,
	'qty_used_in_steps' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_used_in_steps ELSE jbst.qty_used_in_steps END,
	'mod_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.mod_id ELSE NULL END,
	'actual_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_qty ELSE jbst.actual_qty END,
	'actual_min_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_min_qty ELSE jbst.actual_min_qty END,
	'actual_max_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_max_qty ELSE jbst.actual_max_qty END,
	'qty_good_at_bom_pos' = COALESCE(jb.qty_good_at_bom_pos, 0),
	'qty_rejected_at_bom_pos' = COALESCE(jb.qty_rejected_at_bom_pos, 0)
FROM (SELECT job_bom.wo_id, job_bom.oper_id, job_bom.seq_no, job_bom.bom_pos, job_bom.current_subst, job_bom.item_id, item.item_desc,
		item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,
		job_bom.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom.instruction, job_bom.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.reqd_start_val, job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct,
		job_bom.update_inv, job_bom.backflush, job_bom.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, job_bom.def_lot_no, job_bom.def_sublot_no,
		job_bom.def_storage_ent_id, ent.ent_name, job_bom.scaling_factor, job_bom.must_consume_from_inv,
		job_bom.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, job_bom.may_create_new_lots, job_bom.must_consume_from_wip,
		job_bom.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom.constant_qty, job_bom.est_time,
		job_bom.spare1, job_bom.spare2, job_bom.spare3, job_bom.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom.last_edit_comment, job_bom.last_edit_by, job_bom.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.qty_per_parent_item
		 ELSE CASE WHEN (job.qty_at_start IS NULL) THEN job_bom.qty_reqd
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
          END
		 END AS actual_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_min_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_max_qty
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN job_bom.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_good_at_bom_pos
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN job_bom.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_rejected_at_bom_pos
	FROM job_bom job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.seq_no = @seq_no or @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
--	  AND (job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
--	  AND (job_bom.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	) jb LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT job_bom_subst.wo_id, job_bom_subst.oper_id, job_bom_subst.seq_no, job_bom_subst.bom_pos, job_bom_subst.alt_no,
		job_bom_subst.pref, job_bom_subst.subst_level, job_bom_subst.item_id, item.item_desc, item.uom_id,
		uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,
		job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom_subst.instruction, job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom_subst.reqd_start_val, job_bom_subst.reqd_start_val_is_pct,
		job_bom_subst.update_inv, job_bom_subst.backflush, job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, job_bom_subst.def_lot_no, job_bom_subst.def_sublot_no,
		job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id, ent.ent_name, job_bom_subst.scaling_factor, job_bom_subst.must_consume_from_inv,
		job_bom_subst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, job_bom_subst.may_create_new_lots, job_bom_subst.must_consume_from_wip,
		job_bom_subst.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom_subst.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom_subst.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom_subst.constant_qty, job_bom_subst.est_time,
		job_bom_subst.spare1, job_bom_subst.spare2, job_bom_subst.spare3, job_bom_subst.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom_subst.last_edit_comment, job_bom_subst.last_edit_by, job_bom_subst.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom_subst.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item
		 ELSE CASE WHEN (job.qty_at_start IS NULL) THEN job.qty_reqd
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
          END
		 END AS actual_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_min_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_max_qty
	FROM job_bom_subst job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom_subst.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom_subst.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom_subst.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom_subst.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
--	  AND (job_bom_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
--	  AND (job_bom_subst.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	) jbst
ON jb.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbst.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbst.bom_pos
AND jb.current_subst = jbst.alt_no
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
-- Description:This will be used to select the Sub Lot Number
-- Note : Add SublotCounter Attribute on Line Level in MES Client
-- Usage:	This will be used to select the Sub Lot Number
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	MP     		2022-07-28			Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	YG			2022-07-28			Added separate sublot_counter and sublot_no
-- 0.03.00	MP     		2023-09-14			Added 5 digit sublot logic
-- 0.04.00	AKM			2024-02-01			coding best practice and dead code cleaning
-- 0.05.00	JSC			2025-10-22			Bring back this version on QA to use job bom/ added fail safe for not deflot found
-- 0.06.00  AML, XPM	2026-03-30          CR593: Retrieve sublot with function using job sublot counter or ent sublot counter 
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
        @wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT
AS
BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT ON;
		DECLARE @def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40),
				@parent_ent_id INT,
				@attr_id       INT,
				@sublot_no     NVARCHAR(40),
				@sublot_counter NVARCHAR(40),
				@save_job_flag INT;
				
		SELECT  @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
		FROM    job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				wo_id       = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no  = @seq_no
				AND bom_pos = 0
				
		--v0.05 added
		IF 	(@def_lot_no IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @def_lot_no = w.lot_no
			FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE
					w.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
		END
		
		SELECT  @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id
		FROM    ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
		WHERE 	wo_id  	= @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no 	= @seq_no
		
		SELECT @save_job_flag = ISNULL(oa.attr_value, '0')
		FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id AND a.attr_desc = 'SaveJobSublotCounter'


		 IF (@save_job_flag = '1')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sublot_counter = ja.attr_value 
			FROM job_attr ja WITH (NOLOCK) 
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ja.attr_id = a.attr_id
			WHERE ja.wo_id = @wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no 
			  AND a.attr_desc = 'LastSublotCounter'
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @attr_id = a.attr_id
			FROM    attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE a.attr_desc  = 'SublotCounter'
				AND a.attr_grp = 2
		
			-- 1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
			--v0.05 Added
			SELECT @sublot_counter = REPLACE (ea.attr_value,',','')
			FROM    ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE	ea.attr_id	= @attr_id
				AND ea.ent_id 	= @parent_ent_id
		END
		--v0.6 Mod
		SELECT TOP 1 @sublot_no = out_sublot_no 
		FROM [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot](@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, CAST(@sublot_counter AS INT));
		
		-- RETURN select
		SELECT  @sublot_counter sublot_counter,
				@sublot_no      sublot_no
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_S_ofi_GetEventDate
-- Description:  Get Event Date Utc If Actual Date Provided out of range use the job start time (running) or job end time (stopped/completed)
--
-- EXEC [SP_S_ofi_GetEventDate] @wo_id = '8105049024',@oper_id = 'BeanBulkIntake',@seq_no = 1,@ent_id = 205, @RecordedTimeStamp = '05/14/2024 04:15:00.000'
-- Usage: MDMAddProductionWF,MDMAddConsumptionWF
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_GetEventDate]
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id NVARCHAR(100),
	@seq_no INT,
	@ent_id INT,
	@RecordedTimeStamp NVARCHAR(40)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--SELECT @wo_id = '8105049024',@oper_id = 'BeanBulkIntake',@seq_no = 1,@ent_id = 205, @RecordedTimeStamp = '05/14/2024 04:15:00.000'

	DECLARE @latest_job_end DATETIME,
			@latest_job_start DATETIME,
			@job_state INT,
			@actual_date_utc DATETIME,
			@event_date_utc DATETIME,
			@Out INT,
			@current_utc_date DATETIME = GETUTCDATE(),
			@user_id NVARCHAR(100)
	
	-- Get User Id
	EXEC Sp_s_db_status_getaudtrailusr
		@user_id output, NULL


	-- SET Actual Date From PLC
	SET @actual_date_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, @RecordedTimeStamp)

	-- GET Job State
	SELECT @job_state=state_cd FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND seq_no=@seq_no

	IF (@job_state IN (3,4,5))
	BEGIN
		-- GET latest job start/ time
		SELECT @latest_job_start = MAX(job_start_utc) 
		FROM job_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id =@oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no and ent_id = @ent_id

		-- Job state is running
		IF (@job_state =  3)
		BEGIN
			IF  (@actual_date_utc between @latest_job_start and @current_utc_date)
			BEGIN
				SET @Out = 0
				SET @event_date_utc = @actual_date_utc

				SELECT @Out Out,@event_date_utc event_date_utc, @actual_date_utc actual_plc_date, @user_id user_id
				RETURN
			END
			ELSE IF (@actual_date_utc > @current_utc_date)
			BEGIN
				SET @Out = 1
				SET @event_date_utc = @current_utc_date

				SELECT @Out Out,@event_date_utc event_date_utc, @actual_date_utc actual_plc_date, @user_id user_id
				RETURN
			END 
			ELSE
			BEGIN 
				SET @Out = 2
				SET @event_date_utc = @latest_job_start

				SELECT @Out Out,@event_date_utc event_date_utc, @actual_date_utc actual_plc_date, @user_id user_id
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE IF (@job_state IN (4,5)) -- Job state is stopped/completed
		BEGIN
			SELECT @latest_job_end = MAX(job_end_utc) 
			FROM job_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id =@oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no and ent_id = @ent_id

			IF (@actual_date_utc BETWEEN @latest_job_start AND @latest_job_end)
			BEGIN
				SET @Out = 0
				SET @event_date_utc = @actual_date_utc

				SELECT @Out Out,@event_date_utc event_date_utc, @actual_date_utc actual_plc_date, @user_id user_id
				RETURN
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Out = 3
				SET @event_date_utc = @latest_job_end

				SELECT @Out Out,@event_date_utc event_date_utc, @actual_date_utc actual_plc_date, @user_id user_id
				RETURN
			END
		END
		

	END

	SET @Out = 4
	SELECT @Out Out,@actual_date_utc event_date_utc, @actual_date_utc actual_plc_date, @user_id user_id

END

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_bom_item_oper_spec_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver    Changes
-- 12/20/2002	  Raghu		1.5.2  (HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	  Rohit		1.5.2  Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  20024  HD# 4414 Maintain oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		20100	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Looping thru cursor is removed
--07/27/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 4883) Validate type of specification values
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/23/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	, @V_Oper_Id      	STRING40
	,@V_Spec_Ver_Id  	STRING40
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32
	,@assoc_file_type STRING20
	,@assoc_file STRING254

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec a, inserted b
				WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
				     AND a.spec_ver_id  = b.spec_ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},bom_item_oper_spec', 16, 1)
				RETURN
		END
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM bom_item_oper_spec bios
			INNER JOIN  inserted i ON bios.item_id = i.item_id AND bios.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bios.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
				AND bios.process_id = i.process_id AND bios.oper_id = i.oper_id AND bios.step_no = i.step_no
				AND bios.spec_ver_id = i.spec_ver_id AND bios.spec_id = i.spec_id
			INNER JOIN spec ON i.spec_id = spec.spec_id
		WHERE spec.data_type =1 AND
		  (ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.spec_value, -1)) = 0 OR ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.min_value, -1)) = 0 OR ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(i.max_value, -1)) = 0)) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Spec value, min_value and max_value should be numeric{3185}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

              --update spec version date automatically
	UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id, b.oper_id, b.ver_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec a, inserted b
				WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
				     AND a.spec_ver_id  = b.spec_ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id) bios
	WHERE oper_spec_ver.process_id = bios.process_id AND oper_spec_ver.oper_id = bios.oper_id AND oper_spec_ver.ver_id = bios.ver_id

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec a, inserted b
				WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				     AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
				     AND a.spec_ver_id  = b.spec_ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id) bios
	WHERE process.process_id = bios.process_id

	-- Make sure the assoc_file_type is set to the extension for the assoc_file
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.item_id = d.item_id AND i.ver_id = d.ver_id AND i.bom_pos = d.bom_pos
				AND i.process_id = d.process_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.step_no = d.step_no
				AND i.spec_ver_id = d.spec_ver_id AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
		WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) BEGIN

		IF Exists(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM inserted i
			WHERE i.assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(x.assoc_file)
		FROM (SELECT i.assoc_file, i.item_id, i.ver_id, i.bom_pos, i.process_id, i.oper_id, i.step_no, i.spec_ver_id, i.spec_id
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.item_id = d.item_id AND i.ver_id = d.ver_id AND i.bom_pos = d.bom_pos
					AND i.process_id = d.process_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.step_no = d.step_no
					AND i.spec_ver_id = d.spec_ver_id AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE bom_item_oper_spec.item_id = x.item_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id = x.ver_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.bom_pos = x.bom_pos
				AND bom_item_oper_spec.process_id = x.process_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.oper_id = x.oper_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.step_no = x.step_no
				AND bom_item_oper_spec.spec_ver_id = x.spec_ver_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id = x.spec_id

		INSERT INTO file_type
		(file_ext, edit_level, view_level, print_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT x.file_ext, 1, 1, 1, @user_id, @last_edit_at
		FROM (SELECT dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) as file_ext
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.item_id = d.item_id AND i.ver_id = d.ver_id AND i.bom_pos = d.bom_pos
						AND i.process_id = d.process_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.step_no = d.step_no
						AND i.spec_ver_id = d.spec_ver_id AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE x.file_ext IS NOT NULL AND x.file_ext NOT IN (SELECT file_ext FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK))
	END

	UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_by = @user_id, bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE bom_item_oper_spec.item_id = i.item_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	     AND bom_item_oper_spec.process_id = i.process_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.oper_id = i.oper_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.step_no = i.step_no
	     AND bom_item_oper_spec.spec_ver_id  = i.spec_ver_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id = i.spec_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Cert_Audit_Log] ( @row_id int )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Cert_Audit_Log
-- Description	      -
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/10/2002		Raghu			1.4		Disallow deletes if sys param is set for certification data (sys param = 194)
-- 05/14/2003		Raghu			1.6.7	(HD# 2498) Cascade delete job_event details when a audit logg certification is deleted
-- 09/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @disallow_delete	INT
	,	@wo_id				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@oper_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@seq_no				INT
	,	@step_no			INT
	,	@lot_no				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@cert_name			NVARCHAR(40)

SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 194

IF (@disallow_delete = 1) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Deleting data from %1 is not allowed{3863},Cert_Audit_Log', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SELECT	@wo_id = wo_id, @oper_id = oper_id, @seq_no = seq_no, @step_no = step_no
	,	@lot_no = lot_no, @cert_name = cert_name
FROM cert_audit_log
WHERE row_id = @row_id


DELETE cert_audit_log
WHERE  (cert_audit_log.row_id = @row_id OR (cert_audit_log.row_id IS NULL AND @row_id IS NULL))

DELETE FROM job_event
WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND
      oper_id = @oper_id AND
      seq_no = @seq_no AND
      step_no = @step_no AND
      lot_no = @lot_no AND
      cert_name = @cert_name AND
      UPPER(event_type) = 'CERTSIGNOFF'

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    Fn_s_ofi_get_processByCriteria
-- Description:  Returns the process order type
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  KN          2023-03-13         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  LP          2023-09-13         Added condition for butter loadout process
-- 0.01.02   LP          2023-12-06         Updated the liquor process with breaking and winowing process, commented previous code
-- 0.02.00	JSC			2025-05-28			CR-BUG:00168881 Rebuilt completely to use the Process Attributes and not the hard-coded stuff

CREATE                               FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_s_ofi_get_processByCriteria] (
		@wo_id			NVARCHAR(200), -- v2.0: never used but left to avoid extra changes
		@product_group	NVARCHAR(200),
		@prodn_method	NVARCHAR(200),
		@material_state	NVARCHAR(200),
		@order_type		NVARCHAR(200)) RETURNS NVARCHAR(40) --v2.0 changed to 40 instead of 100
AS
BEGIN
      DECLARE @process_id NVARCHAR(40)=NULL
	  
	  --,@comments NVARCHAR(40) = NULL


	  -- Get process ID based on process attributes
      SELECT @process_id = p.process_id
	  FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK)
	  
			INNER JOIN process_attr ps WITH (NOLOCK) ON ps.process_id = p.process_id
			INNER JOIN attr psa WITH (nolock) ON psa.attr_id = ps.attr_id	
												AND psa.attr_desc = 'ProductionSupervisor'
												AND psa.attr_grp = 8
			INNER JOIN process_attr pm WITH (NOLOCK) ON pm.process_id = p.process_id
			INNER JOIN attr pma WITH (nolock) ON pma.attr_id = pm.attr_id	
												AND pma.attr_desc = 'ProductionMethod'
												AND pma.attr_grp = 8
			INNER JOIN process_attr pms WITH (NOLOCK) ON pms.process_id = p.process_id
			INNER JOIN attr pmsa WITH (nolock) ON pmsa.attr_id = pms.attr_id	
												AND pmsa.attr_desc = 'MaterialState'
												AND pmsa.attr_grp = 8
			INNER JOIN process_attr pot WITH (NOLOCK) ON pot.process_id = p.process_id
			INNER JOIN attr pota WITH (nolock) ON pota.attr_id = pot.attr_id	
												AND pota.attr_desc = 'POType'
												AND pota.attr_grp = 8

	WHERE ps.attr_value = @product_group
		AND pm.attr_value = @prodn_method
		AND pms.attr_value = @material_state
		AND pot.attr_value = @order_type

	-- returning value found; NULL otherwise
	RETURN @process_id
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_Pull]
  (@sample_id int,
   @pulled_by nvarchar(40),
   @pulled_time_local datetime = NULL,
   @pulled_time_utc datetime = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -  Sp_U_Sample_Pull
-- Description	      -  Update a sample record setting the sample as pulled
-- Author	      -  Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created	      -	03/02/2011
-- Version	      -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 07/27/2012	Raghu		Update sample status
-- 11/21/2019	Raghu	6.2	UserStory: 1184123-As Bruce, I want a Sample.Put web API for updating sample final and pulled settings
-- 02/26/2020	Raghu	6.2	UserStory: 1295042-As AVEVA, I want the job_spec.row_id column to be modified from INT32 to BIGINT64, so that the ID value does not runout overtime
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @pulled_id NVARCHAR(40),
	     @V_Error	NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@ent_id INT

BEGIN

    IF EXISTS (
      -- A missed or final sample can not be pulled
      SELECT TOP 1 1
      FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE (sample_id = @sample_id) AND ((sample_status = 3) OR (final = 1))
    )
   BEGIN
         RAISERROR('Cannot pull a sample that is final or has a MISSED status.{7167}', 16, 1)
         RETURN -1
   END
   ELSE BEGIN
	  --  determine if the sample is already pulled
	     SELECT @ent_id = s.ent_id, @pulled_id = pulled_by FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
         IF (@pulled_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	         SET @V_Error = 'Sample has already been pulled by: ' + @pulled_id + '.{7272},' + @pulled_id
     		 RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
	    	 RETURN -1
         END
         ELSE BEGIN

            IF(@pulled_by IS NULL) BEGIN
                EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @pulled_by OUTPUT, NULL
            END

			IF (@pulled_time_utc IS NULL AND @pulled_time_local IS NULL) SET @pulled_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

			IF (@pulled_time_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @pulled_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @pulled_time_utc)
			ELSE SET @pulled_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @pulled_time_local, GETUTCDATE())

			UPDATE sample
			SET pulled_by = @pulled_by,
				pulled_time_local = @pulled_time_local,
				pulled_time_utc = @pulled_time_utc
			WHERE (sample_id = @sample_id)

			EXEC sp_U_Sample_UpdateStatus @sample_id = @sample_id, @sample_un_pulled=0, @sample_result=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value = NULL
         END
   END

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_downtime_data]
AS
WITH util_times (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_end_time_utc) AS
(SELECT TOP 100000000 vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc, vuht.event_end_time_utc
FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
ORDER BY vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc
)
SELECT util_log.log_id,
       util_log.event_time_utc,
       util_log.event_time_local,
       util_log.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       jh.wo_id,
       jh.oper_id,
       jh.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       jh.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       util_log.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       util_log.shift_start_utc,
       util_log.shift_start_local,
       util_log.state_cd,
       util_state.state_desc,
       util_state.color,
       util_log.reas_cd,
       util_reas.reas_desc,
       util_reas.reas_grp_id,
       util_log.reas_pending,
       util_log.runtime,
       util_log.downtime,
       util_log.setuptime,
       util_log.teardowntime,
       util_log.fixedtime,
       util_log.vartime,
       COALESCE(DATEDIFF(SS, CASE WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= util_log.event_time_utc THEN util_log.event_time_utc ELSE jh.job_start_utc END,
       				CASE WHEN COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_end_time_utc THEN util_log.event_end_time_utc ELSE COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) END)
       		, util_log.duration) AS duration,
       util_log.comments
	 ,util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
	 ,util_log.event_end_time_utc
	 ,jh.job_pos
	 ,jh.job_start_utc
	 ,jh.job_start_local
	 ,jh.job_end_utc
	 ,jh.job_end_local
FROM util_log util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN util_times ut ON util_log.ent_id = ut.ent_id AND util_log.event_time_utc = ut.event_time_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON ut.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > ut.event_time_utc
	AND jh.job_start_utc < ut.event_end_time_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   jh.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   jh.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   jh.seq_no = job.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN util_state util_state  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.state_cd = util_state.state_cd
INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_reas.reas_cd = util_log.reas_cd
INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id
WHERE util_log.runtime = 0 AND
      util_log.downtime = 1

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Storage_Exec]
(@ent_id  int  ,
 @type  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @status  int ,
 @max_capacity  float  ,
 @uom_id int,
 @tare float,
 @tare_uom_id int,
