CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_MasterJobDetails]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50),
	@seq_no int,
	@oper_id nvarchar(50),
	@type nvarchar(50)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	-- split_visibility code is checked herer
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @Oper_attr_id int   
	Declare @temp table (oper_id nvarchar(40),release_ent_type nvarchar(40))

	select @Oper_attr_id = attr_id from attr (nolock) where attr_desc ='release_ent_type'

	 insert into @temp(oper_id,release_ent_type)
	 select oper_id, attr_value from oper_attr where attr_id=@Oper_attr_id


	 	Declare @process_attr_id int   
	Declare @multiple_release_temp table (oper_id nvarchar(40),allow_multiple_release nvarchar(40))
		select @process_attr_id = attr_id from attr  (nolock) where attr_desc ='allow_multiple_release'

	 insert into @multiple_release_temp(oper_id,allow_multiple_release)
	 select o.oper_id,attr_value from process_attr  (nolock) pa
	 inner join process  (nolock) p on pa.process_id=p.process_id 
	 inner join oper  (nolock) o on p.process_id=o.process_id		
	 where attr_id=@process_attr_id
	 
	 
			declare   @operVisibilityCheck as table
                          			   (      oper_id nvarchar(200),
                                			attr_value nvarchar(20)
                          			   )	

			insert into @operVisibilityCheck
			select distinct o.oper_id,oa.attr_value from oper  (nolock) o
			left join oper_attr  (nolock) oa on o.oper_id=oa.oper_id
			left join attr  (nolock) a on a.attr_id=oa.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc='split_visibility'
			and oa.attr_value='0'

			

	--Label Overlay button code
	if @type='CheckAttrLabel'
	BEGIN
	select attr_value,* from process_attr p with (nolock)
	inner join wo  (nolock) w on w.process_id=p.process_id
	inner join attr  (nolock) a on a.attr_id=p.attr_id
	where wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='LabelOverlay'
	END

	--Get the new Seq no for the job whensplit button is clicked
	if @type='GetSeqNo'
	BEGIN
	select top 1(seq_no+1)as seq from job with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id order by seq_no desc
	END

	--Get Job for the Entity Type attribute in WOM
	if @type='GetJob'
	BEGIN
		select ea.attr_value,j.target_sched_ent_id,js.state_desc,j.state_cd,j.oper_id,j.wo_id,j.seq_no,ovc.attr_value as splitVisChck, isnull(t.release_ent_type,'Segment') release_ent_type ,isnull(mrt.allow_multiple_release,'1') as allow_multiple_release
		from job  (nolock) j  
		inner join ent  (nolock) e on e.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr  (nolock) ea on ea.ent_id=e.ent_id
		inner join attr  (nolock) a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		inner join job_state (nolock) js on js.state_cd=j.state_cd
		left join @operVisibilityCheck ovc on ovc.oper_id=j.oper_id 
		left join @temp t on j.oper_id = t.oper_id
		left join @multiple_release_temp mrt on j.oper_id = mrt.oper_id
		where a.attr_desc='EntityType' and wo_id=@wo_id
	END

	--Get Job for the Entity Type attribute in JOM
	if @type='JobQueueGetJob'
	BEGIN
		select ea.attr_value,j.target_sched_ent_id,js.state_desc,j.state_cd,j.oper_id,j.wo_id,j.seq_no,ovc.attr_value as splitVisChck, isnull(t.release_ent_type,'Segment') release_ent_type
		from job (nolock) j  
		inner join ent  (nolock) e on e.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr (nolock) ea on ea.ent_id=e.ent_id
		inner join attr  (nolock) a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		inner join job_state  (nolock) js on js.state_cd=j.state_cd
		left join @operVisibilityCheck ovc on ovc.oper_id=j.oper_id 
		inner join @temp t on j.oper_id = t.oper_id
		where a.attr_desc='EntityType' and wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id
	END
	--used for assign on job queue
	if @type='JobQueueAssign'
	BEGIN
		select ea.attr_value,j.target_sched_ent_id,js.state_desc,j.state_cd,j.oper_id,j.wo_id,j.seq_no,ovc.attr_value as splitVisChck, isnull(t.release_ent_type,'Segment') release_ent_type
		from job  (nolock) j  
		inner join ent  (nolock) e on e.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr  (nolock) ea on ea.ent_id=e.ent_id
		inner join attr  (nolock) a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		inner join job_state  (nolock) js on js.state_cd=j.state_cd
		left join @operVisibilityCheck ovc on ovc.oper_id=j.oper_id 
		inner join @temp t on j.oper_id = t.oper_id
		where a.attr_desc='EntityType' and wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no
	END

	
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_ChWOReqFinTime]
(
	@wo_id					NVARCHAR(40),
	@req_finish_time_local	DATETIME,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)

AS
BEGIN
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_U_JOB_EXEC_CHANGEWOFINISHTIME
-- Description			- Change Finish Time for all the jobs in a Work Order. Find the finish time of the final job. If more than one final job exists, then find the most finishtime of the final job,
--						  and get the diff time between the param datetime and finaljob datetime and apply the diff to all the jobs in a work order
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/31/2002
-- Version				- 1.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By     Ver		Changes
-- 02/18/2004		Raghu			2.0.26	(HD# 4480) Due date changes for WO does not update properly
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/03/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @max_req_finish_time 	DATETIME
		,	@diff_finish_time 		INT
		,	@req_finish_time_utc	DATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT @max_req_finish_time = MAX(req_finish_time_local) FROM JOB WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1

	--SET @req_finish_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time)

	IF @max_req_finish_time IS NULL SET @max_req_finish_time = @req_finish_time_local

	UPDATE wo SET req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local, req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	SET @diff_finish_time = DATEDIFF(mi, @max_req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_local)

	UPDATE job SET req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local, req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1

	UPDATE job
	SET	req_finish_time_local = DATEADD(mi, @diff_finish_time, req_finish_time_local),
		req_finish_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, @diff_finish_time, req_finish_time_utc)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job <> 1

END

-- 0.01.00  LK        2023-07-26		   Initial version.

-- 0.01.04	DS		  2023-12-18		   Added the logic to send the liquor loadout order for blending consumption if SFG consumed in privious orders. 
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_consumption_beans] 
as
--select *from item_cons where wo_id='80000195'
begin
   DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

   Declare  @storage_locn VARCHAR(100),@ent_id int,@nibsOrder nvarchar(50)
   declare @itemgrp nvarchar(40), @nibslot nvarchar(40), @nibsSublot nvarchar(40), @nibsConsQty float,@nibsTotalCons float,@rowid int
  

   BEGIN TRY
   

   select top 1 @ent_id=ent_id,@nibslot=fg_lot_no,@nibsSublot=fg_sublot_no,@nibsOrder=wo_id,@rowid=row_id 
   from item_cons with(nolock) where isnull(spare1,'0')<>'0'

   

    IF (select spare1 from wo with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)<>1    -- 0.01.02 
	   BEGIN
	   select  top 1 @nibsorder=c1.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) full outer join 
		item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.lot_no=c2.lot_no )
		where c1.lot_no=@nibslot
   END

   IF (select top 1 oper_id from item_cons with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)='ButterFiltering'    -- 0.01.02 
	   BEGIN	   
		select top 1 @nibsorder=c2.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) inner join 
		item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.fg_sublot_no=c2.sublot_no )
		where c1.wo_id=@nibsorder order by c2.created_at_local desc
   END
   IF (select top 1 oper_id from item_cons with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)='Degumming'    -- 0.01.02 
	   BEGIN	   
		select top 1 @nibsorder=c2.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) inner join 
		item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.fg_sublot_no=c2.sublot_no )
		where c1.wo_id=@nibsorder order by c2.created_at_local desc
		IF (select top 1 oper_id from item_cons with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)='Degumming'    -- 0.01.02 
	   BEGIN	   
		select top 1 @nibsorder=c2.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) inner join 
		item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.fg_sublot_no=c2.sublot_no )
		where c1.wo_id=@nibsorder order by c2.created_at_local desc
   END
   END
   IF (select top 1 oper_id from item_cons with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)='Deodorizing'    -- 0.01.02   -- 0.01.03
	   BEGIN		  
	   	select top 1 @nibsorder=c2.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) inner join 
		item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.fg_sublot_no=c2.sublot_no )
		where c1.wo_id=@nibsorder order by c2.created_at_local desc
		
		if(select top 1 oper_id from item_cons with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)='Deodorizing' 
		BEGIN
		select top 1 @nibsorder=c2.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) inner join 
		item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.fg_sublot_no=c2.sublot_no )
		where c1.wo_id=@nibsorder order by c2.created_at_local desc
		--select @nibsorder
		END
   END

   -- for liquor blending 
	if(select top 1 oper_id from item_cons with(nolock) where wo_id=@nibsorder)='LiqBlend' 
	BEGIN
	select top 1 @nibsorder=c2.wo_id from (item_cons c1 with(nolock) inner join 
	item_cons c2 with(nolock)on c1.fg_sublot_no=c2.sublot_no )
	where c1.wo_id=@nibsorder order by c2.created_at_local desc
	--select @nibsorder
	END



    print @nibsorder

   SET @storage_locn = NULL
			SELECT @storage_locn = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation')
			IF @storage_locn is NULL
				SELECT @storage_locn = ent_name from ent with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id

	       BEGIN
					
						Select top 1 @nibsOrder Order_Number,
						   [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,
						   lot_no Batch_Number,
						   IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,ic.item_id,ia.attr_value) Material, 
						   case when (ic.qty_cons_erp+ CAST(isnull(ic.spare1,0) as float)>ic.qty_cons) or (ic.qty_cons-(ic.qty_cons_erp+ CAST(isnull(ic.spare1,0) as float))<0.005)  then round((ic.qty_cons-ic.qty_cons_erp),3)
						    else CAST(isnull(ic.spare1,0) as float)  end as Quantity,
						   --qty_cons *  @NibsConsPercent Quantity,
						   --SAP use code 262 for reversal
						   u.description UOM,CASE WHEN CAST(isnull(ic.spare1,0) as float)<0 THEN '262' ELSE
						   '261' END as Movement_Type,
						   format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
							format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime,
						   @storage_locn Storage_Location,
						   '' Document_Number,
						   '' Message,
						   '' Message
					  from item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
						inner join item i WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.item_id = i.item_id and ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot
										
					  	left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
							on i.item_id = ia.item_id	
						left join uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
							on i.uom_id   = u.uom_id
						left join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
							on e.ent_id   = ic.ent_id

						where ic.row_id = @rowid 
						declare @qty_cons float, @qty_cons_erp float,@spare1 float
					 
						select @qty_cons=qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@spare1=CAST(spare1 as float) from item_cons with(nolock) where row_id=@rowid
						IF (@qty_cons_erp+ @spare1)>@qty_cons
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons,spare1='0' where row_id=@rowid
						else
						IF (@qty_cons-(@qty_cons_erp+CAST(isnull(@spare1,0) as float))<0.005)
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons,spare1='0' where row_id=@rowid
						ELSE						
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp+ ROUND(CAST(spare1 as float),3),spare1='0' where row_id=@rowid

						-----Final check----
						declare @qty_cons_finalcheck float, @qty_cons_erp_finalcheck float
						select @qty_cons_finalcheck=qty_cons ,@qty_cons_erp_finalcheck=qty_cons_erp from item_cons with(nolock)  where row_id=@rowid
						IF (@qty_cons_finalcheck<@qty_cons_erp_finalcheck)
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp=qty_cons where row_id=@rowid
						-- If there are no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty
						--Update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id = @row_id
						PRINT 'no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty'
					END
						--end of beans cons reporting
	
			

	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomSubsts]
(@user_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no	INT
,@bom_pos	INT		= NULL
,@check_privs 		INT32 = 1
--,@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)	= NULL
--,@last_edit_at	DATETIME	= NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomSubsts
-- Description	      - Returns all job_bom records with the filters supplied in.
--			Also, if there exists a substitution for a job_bom record, then this method
--			returns the substitution record as well
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 09/29/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.29
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 08/31/2007		AML		3.3.0	oper_id and seq_no are made optional.
--02/04/2008		Raghu	3.4	L00074687; The add/assign serial number dialog generates an error upon opening from the button bar. The dialog opens without error from the add production dialog.
--07/31/2014       Srinivasa Tentu   5.0.0   UserStory:345196, Added @check_privs optional input parameter to check privileges conditionally.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @user_subst_level INT

    SET @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 1)

    IF (@check_privs = 1)
    BEGIN
		EXEC sp_S_GetPriv @user_id, 94, @user_subst_level OUTPUT
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @user_subst_level = 999
	END


	SELECT job_bom.wo_id, job_bom.oper_id, job_bom.seq_no, job_bom.bom_pos, 0 'substitute_item', job_bom.current_subst,
		NULL 'alt_no', NULL pref, NULL subst_level, job_bom.item_id, item.item_desc,
		item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime, item.serial_no_lvl,
		job_bom.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom.instruction, job_bom.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.reqd_start_val, job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct,
		job_bom.update_inv, job_bom.backflush, job_bom.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, job_bom.def_lot_no, job_bom.def_sublot_no,
		job_bom.def_storage_ent_id, ent.ent_name, job_bom.scaling_factor, job_bom.must_consume_from_inv,
		job_bom.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, job_bom.may_create_new_lots, job_bom.must_consume_from_wip,
		job_bom.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom.constant_qty, job_bom.est_time,job_bom.serial_no_source,
		job_bom.spare1, job_bom.spare2, job_bom.spare3, job_bom.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom.last_edit_comment, job_bom.last_edit_by, job_bom.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM job_bom job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id
      AND (job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (job_bom.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT job_bom_subst.wo_id, job_bom_subst.oper_id, job_bom_subst.seq_no, job_bom_subst.bom_pos, 1 'substitute_item', NULL current_subst,
		job_bom_subst.alt_no, job_bom_subst.pref, job_bom_subst.subst_level, job_bom_subst.item_id, item.item_desc,
		item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,item.serial_no_lvl,
		job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom_subst.instruction, job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom_subst.reqd_start_val, job_bom_subst.reqd_start_val_is_pct,
		job_bom_subst.update_inv, job_bom_subst.backflush, job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, job_bom_subst.def_lot_no,job_bom_subst.def_sublot_no,
		job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id, ent.ent_name, job_bom_subst.scaling_factor, job_bom_subst.must_consume_from_inv,
		job_bom_subst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, job_bom_subst.may_create_new_lots, job_bom_subst.must_consume_from_wip,
		job_bom_subst.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom_subst.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom_subst.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom_subst.constant_qty, job_bom_subst.est_time, NULL 'serial_no_source',
		job_bom_subst.spare1, job_bom_subst.spare2, job_bom_subst.spare3, job_bom_subst.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom_subst.last_edit_comment, job_bom_subst.last_edit_by, job_bom_subst.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom_subst.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		NULL mod_id
	FROM job_bom_subst job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom_subst.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom_subst.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom_subst.wo_id = @wo_id
      AND (job_bom_subst.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (job_bom_subst.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL)
	  AND ((job_bom_subst.subst_level = 0) OR (job_bom_subst.subst_level > 0 AND job_bom_subst.subst_level <= @user_subst_level)))
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_fg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24         Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  Karthik     2023-05-01         Changed MainHU from Spare3 to Spare2 and SubHU from Spare2 to Spare3.
-- 0.02.01  Lavkesh     2024-05-16         For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- 0.02.02  Michal H    2024-09-02         Fix incorrect timestamp format - change the erroneous 12-hour format specifier ("hhmmss")
--                                         to the 24-hour format specifier ("HHmmss").
-- 0.03.00  AML, XPM    2025-03-30         Updated how we sent de Sublot based on CR593 and when do we update the last_edit_comment
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_fg]
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @error_msg NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        BEGIN
            IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL
                DROP TABLE #temp;

            SELECT
                ip.spare3,
                ip.sublot_no,
                ip.wo_id,
                wo.bags_per_pallet,
                qty_prod,
                qty_prod_erp,   --(KN 01May23  Changed from ip.spare2 to ip.spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
                u.description,
                ip.item_id,
                ip.created_at_local AS last_edit_at,
                ip.lot_no,
                ip.row_id,      --changed ip.last_edit_at to ip.created_at_local  0.02.01
                ip.seq_no,
                ip.oper_id
            INTO #temp
            FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN ofi_wo_ext wo WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id
                    AND wo.module <> 'PO'
                INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON w.wo_id = wo.wo_id
                    AND w.state_cd < 3   --- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
                INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
                INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
                INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id
                    AND ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id
                    AND ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no
                    AND jb.bom_pos = 0
                --AND ip.item_id = jb.item_id
            WHERE qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod
              AND i.item_class_id = 'FG'
              AND ip.spare4 = '1'   --(KN 01May23  Changed from ip.spare2 to ip.spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
            --AND ip.spare4 = '0'   --(KN 23-Apr-23  Ignoring this condition as discussed with Siva)
              AND ip.spare3 IS NOT NULL;

            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #temp)
            BEGIN
                --SELECT * FROM #temp

                DECLARE @Subhu VARCHAR(100),
                        @sublot_ext VARCHAR(100),
                        @lot_no VARCHAR(100),
                        @wo_id VARCHAR(100),
                        @item_id VARCHAR(100),
                        @item_class VARCHAR(100),
                        @row_id INT;

                DECLARE @seq_no INT,
                        @oper_id VARCHAR(100),
                        @fg_lot_no VARCHAR(100),
                        @fg_sub_lot_no VARCHAR(100);

                SELECT TOP 1
                    @Subhu = spare3,
                    @lot_no = lot_no,
                    @wo_id = wo_id,
                    @item_id = item_id,
                    @row_id = row_id,   --@subLot = ISNULL(sublot_no,'') ,
                    @seq_no = seq_no,
                    @oper_id = oper_id
                FROM #temp;

                DECLARE @sublot_flag INT = NULL;

                SET @sublot_ext = NULL;

                SELECT @sublot_ext = ip.last_edit_comment
                FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE row_id = @row_id;

                IF @sublot_ext IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    SELECT TOP 1 @fg_lot_no = ic.lot_no,
                        @fg_sub_lot_no = ic.sublot_no,   --(KN 24May23  Changed logic to pick lot_no and sub_lot of consumption)
                        @sublot_flag = ic.row_id		-- v0.03 MOD to sublotflag
                    FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
                        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
                        ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
                    WHERE ic.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
                      AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no
                      AND i.item_class_id = 'SFG'   --(KN 18May23  Added logic to pick only SFG items from consumption)
                    ORDER BY ic.created_at_local DESC;   --(KN 13Apr23  Retrieving subLot from item_cons instead of item_prod based on Bug #796)

                    -- PRINT @fg_lot_no + ' - ' + @fg_sub_lot_no;

                    SELECT TOP 1 @subLot_ext = ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, '')   --(KN 24May23  Pick only last 10 digits for Batchmaker number)
                    FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE fg_sublot_no = @fg_sub_lot_no;   --(KN 24May23  Use fg_lot details to find consumption lot details)
                        --fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no AND    --(KN 31May23  Excluding fg_lot_no as fg_sub_lot_no will contain the fg_lot_no anyways, as advised by Ajay)
                        
                END

                DECLARE @usesublotforexport INT,
                        @sublot NVARCHAR(40),
                        @process_id NVARCHAR(40);

                -- Get the process we're working with
                SELECT @process_id = process_id
                FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id;

                SELECT @usesublotforexport = pa.attr_value
                FROM process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK)
                    JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON pa.attr_id = a.attr_id
                WHERE a.attr_desc = 'UseSublotForExport'
                  AND pa.process_id = @process_id;

                IF @usesublotforexport = 1
                BEGIN
                    EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot_For_Export]
                        @sublot_number = @sublot_ext,
                        @sublot_export = @sublot OUT;
                END
                ELSE
                    SET @sublot = RIGHT(@sublot_ext, 10);
                END

                --UPDATE item_prod
                --SET last_edit_comment = @subLot,
                --    last_edit_at = GETDATE()
                --WHERE row_id = @row_id  --(KN 18May23  Added logic to store the subLot into last_edit_comment)
                SELECT @item_class = item_class_id 
                FROM item 
                WHERE item_id = @item_id

                SELECT spare3 AS Handling_Unit_Number,
                    wo_id AS Order_Number,   ---(KN 01May23  Changed from spare2 to spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
                    --sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number,    -- SAP will ignore it in SFG
                    @subLot AS Batch_Maker_Number,
                    '101' AS Movement_Type,
                    bags_per_pallet AS Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
                    SUM(qty_prod - qty_prod_erp) AS Quantity,
                    description AS Unit_of_Measure,
                    IIF(ia.attr_value IS NULL, T.item_id, ia.attr_value) AS SAP_MaterialCode_Number,   --(KN 02/02/23  Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
                    FORMAT(MIN(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') AS Production_startdate,
                    FORMAT(MIN(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') AS Production_starttime,
                    FORMAT(MAX(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') AS Production_enddate,
                    FORMAT(MAX(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') AS Production_endtime,
                    lot_no AS SAP_Batch_Number,
                    FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd') AS File_Generation_Date,
                    FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmss') AS File_Generation_Time,
                    '' AS Document_Number,
                    '' AS Message,
                    '' AS Message
                FROM #temp T
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        item_id,
                        attr_value
                    FROM item_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE attr_id = (
                        SELECT attr_id
                        FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                        WHERE attr_desc = 'sap_item_id'
                    )
                ) ia
                ON T.item_id = ia.item_id   --(KN 02/02/23  Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
                WHERE lot_no = @lot_no
                  --AND ISNULL(sublot_no,'') = ISNULL(@subLot,'')
                  AND spare3 = @Subhu
                GROUP BY wo_id,
                    bags_per_pallet,
                    description,
                    T.item_id,
                    sublot_no,
                    lot_no,
                    spare3,
                    ia.attr_value;

                UPDATE ip
                SET ip.qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod,
                    ip.last_edit_comment =
                        CASE
                            WHEN @sublot_flag IS NOT NULL THEN @subLot
                            ELSE last_edit_comment
                        END,
                    last_edit_at = GETDATE()
                FROM item_prod ip
                INNER JOIN (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM #temp
                    WHERE lot_no = @lot_no
                      AND spare3 = @Subhu
                ) t
                    ON ip.row_id = t.row_id;   ---(KN 9/Feb/23 - Removed ,ip.spare4 = 1)
            
            END

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @error_state = ERROR_STATE();

        RAISERROR(@error_msg, @error_severity, @error_state);
    END CATCH
END;

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_sa_ofi_su_inventory_report]
-- Description: get SU details for the report
--
-- Usage: get SU details in the report
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd) Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   2024-05-15   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC	2024-09-25	Update output of UOM type
-- 0.01.02	JSC	2024-12-10	Updated to avoid empty item groups
-- 0.01.03	JSC	2025-07-10	Aligned versions on PROD / QA
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_su_inventory_report] 
	@item_grp NVARCHAR(100) = NULL 

AS 
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @item_grp_id INT
	SELECT TOP 1 
		@item_grp_id = a.attr_id
	FROM
		   attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		   attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';

	DECLARE @class_id INT
	SELECT TOP 1 
		@class_id = a.attr_id
	FROM
		   attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		   attr_desc = 'Classification';

	DECLARE @SU_per_GROUP TABLE
								(
									ent_id        INT NOT NULL
								  , ent_name      NVARCHAR(80)
								  , [description] NVARCHAR(100)
								  , item_group    NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL 
								  PRIMARY KEY (ent_id,item_group)
								)
	
	-- FILL the temporary table
	INSERT INTO @SU_per_GROUP
	SELECT DISTINCT
			 ent_id
		   , ent_name
		   , description
		   , item_group
	FROM
			 (
					-- Storage configuration by user interface
					SELECT DISTINCT 
						   isl.storage_ent_id AS ent_id
						 , e.ent_name
						 , e.description
						 , isl.item_GROUP AS item_GROUP
					FROM
						   ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
						   JOIN
								  ent e with (nolock)
								  ON
										 e.ent_id = isl.storage_ent_id
					UNION ALL
					-- Storage with inventory
					SELECT DISTINCT
							   ii.ent_id
							 , e.ent_name
							 , e.description
							 , ia1.attr_value AS item_GROUP
					FROM
							   item_inv ii WITH(NOLOCK)
							   INNER JOIN
										  item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK)
										  ON
													 ia1.item_id     = ii.item_id
													 AND ia1.attr_id = @item_grp_id
							   JOIN
										  ent e with (nolock)
										  ON
													 e.ent_id = ii.ent_id
					WHERE ia1.attr_value IS NOT NULL
			 )
			 AS all_SUs
	WHERE item_GROUP in (SELECT * FROM fn_ofi_Split(@item_grp,',')) OR (@item_grp IS NULL)
	GROUP BY
			 ent_id
		   , ent_name
		   , description
		   , item_GROUP
	ORDER BY
			 ent_id ASC
	
	-- Compose the output
	SELECT DISTINCT
			   us.ent_id
			 , isnull(us.[description],us.ent_name) AS ent_desc --condition to take storage entity AS ent_desc and AS ent_name if desc is null.
			 , us.ent_name
			 , iv.item_id
			 , i.item_desc
			 , ig.item_grade_desc
			 , iv.lot_no
			 , COALESCE(SUM(iv.qty_left),0)                         AS su_qty
			 , CAST(ISNULL(u.description,dbo.fn_s_ofi_GetUOM(us.ent_id)) AS nvarchar(40)) AS UoM
			 , ia.attr_value                                        AS segr_type
			 , iss.item_status_desc
			 , MAX(iv.date_in_utc)                      AS date_in_utc
			 , dbo.fn_ofi_su_get_mes_status (us.ent_id) AS mes_status
			 , dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color)        AS grade_color --pASsing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
			 , COALESCE(ia1.attr_value,us.item_GROUP)   AS item_GROUP_final
	FROM
			   @SU_per_GROUP us
			   LEFT JOIN
						  ( item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK)
						  INNER JOIN
									 item i WITH(NOLOCK)
									 ON
												i.item_id=iv.item_id
						  INNER JOIN
									 item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK)
									 ON
												iv.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
						  INNER JOIN
									 item_state iss WITH(NOLOCK)
									 ON
												iv.status_cd= iss.item_status_cd
						  INNER JOIN
									 uom u WITH(NOLOCK)
									 ON
												u.uom_id=i.uom_id
						  LEFT JOIN
									 item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK)
									 ON
												ia1.item_id     = i.item_id
												AND ia1.attr_id = @item_grp_id -- item_GROUP of inventory	
						  LEFT JOIN
									 item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK)
									 ON
												ia.item_id     = i.item_id
												AND ia.attr_id = @clASs_id -- clASsification is used ofr seggrigation 	
						  )
						  ON
									 iv.ent_id          =us.ent_id
									 and ia1.attr_value = us.item_GROUP
	GROUP BY
			   us.ent_id
			 , us.ent_name
			 , us.description
			 , iv.item_id
			 , i.item_desc
			 , u.description
			 , iv.lot_no
			 , ia.attr_value
			 , ig.item_grade_desc
			 , iss.item_status_desc
			 , ig.color
			 , COALESCE(ia1.attr_value,us.item_GROUP)
	ORDER BY
			   us.ent_name ASC
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples]
(@ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples
-- Description			- This Stored procedure will identify the samples in sample_to_go table which needs to be READY
--							and move to sample table. The corresponding sample_char_link_to_go records also moved to
--							sample_char_link table. The corresponding qm_context_link record will be updated with
--							cur_sample_id to the sample which has been set to READY state. If the moved samples doesnt
--							have context data, then this stored procedure will create qm_context and qm_context_link data
--							for identified samples.
-- Author				- Tagore
--					- Raghu - Rewrote this stored procedure to improve performance and to fix issues.
-- Date Created				- 02/16/2011
-- Version				- 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver.		Changes
-- 02/06/2012		Raghu					Rewrote this procedure
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @samples_moved			TABLE (sample_to_go_sample_id INT)

DECLARE	 @current_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,@last_edit_by				STRING80
		,@sample_to_go_sample_id	INT32
		,@sample_id					INT32

BEGIN

	--Default the current time to UTC.
	SET @current_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()

	--Get a list of samples (sample_id) from the sample_to_go table to move them to the sample table
	--The reason for only capturing the sample_id is to improve performance as other values in the sample_to_go table are related to a sample_id
	INSERT INTO @samples_moved (sample_to_go_sample_id)
	SELECT stg.sample_id
	FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.freq_id = sample_freq.freq_id
	WHERE (stg.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND stg.requested_time_utc <= @current_time_utc AND (sample_freq.freq_type <> 3 OR stg.spare4 = '1')

	--Verify whether there are any records to be moved from the sample_to_go table to sample table.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @samples_moved)
		--If no records are found to be moved, then exit.
		RETURN

	SET @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@current_time_utc)

	--Update the last_sample_no table with the current sample no from the sample_to_go table
	UPDATE last_sample_no
	SET current_sample_no = curr.next_sample_no
	   ,last_edit_at = @current_time_utc
	FROM (SELECT stg.sample_name_template sn_template, stg.sample_name_instance sn_instance, MAX(stg.current_sample_no) next_sample_no
		FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN @samples_moved sm ON stg.sample_id = sm.sample_to_go_sample_id
		WHERE stg.sample_name_template IS NOT NULL AND stg.sample_name_instance IS NOT NULL AND stg.current_sample_no IS NOT NULL
		GROUP BY stg.sample_name_template, stg.sample_name_instance
		) curr
	WHERE last_sample_no.sample_name_template = curr.sn_template
	  AND last_sample_no.sample_name_instance = curr.sn_instance
	  AND last_sample_no.current_sample_no < curr.next_sample_no

	--Insert the ordinal numbers (if any) into last_sample_no table from the sample_to_go records if they were not already recorded.
	INSERT INTO last_sample_no (sample_name_template, sample_name_instance, current_sample_no, last_edit_at)
	SELECT stg.sample_name_template, stg.sample_name_instance, MAX(stg.current_sample_no), MAX(@current_time_utc)
	FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN @samples_moved sm ON stg.sample_id = sm.sample_to_go_sample_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN last_sample_no lsn WITH (NOLOCK) ON lsn.sample_name_template = stg.sample_name_template AND lsn.sample_name_instance = stg.sample_name_instance
	WHERE (stg.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND stg.sample_name_template IS NOT NULL AND stg.sample_name_instance IS NOT NULL AND stg.current_sample_no IS NOT NULL
	  AND lsn.sample_name_template IS NULL AND lsn.sample_name_instance IS NULL AND lsn.current_sample_no IS NULL
	GROUP BY stg.sample_name_template, stg.sample_name_instance

	--Get the user name.
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Loop through all the samples (sample IDs) captured in the temp table and create an actual sample.
	DECLARE samples_to_move_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD READ_ONLY FOR
	SELECT sm.sample_to_go_sample_id FROM @samples_moved sm

	OPEN samples_to_move_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM samples_to_move_cursor INTO @sample_to_go_sample_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Reset the sample_id to null
		SET @sample_id = NULL

		--Create a new sample from the sample_to_go table
		INSERT INTO sample (ent_id, sample_name, item_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no,
			context_ent_id, context_item_id, item_category_id, process_id, context_oper_id,
			freq_id, plan_id,
			segment_requirement_id,	segment_response_id, lot_no, sublot_no,
			requested_time_utc, requested_time_local, expiry_time_utc, expiry_time_local,
			warning_time_utc, warning_time_local, pulled_by, pulled_time_utc, pulled_time_local,
			final, finalized_by, finalized_at_utc, finalized_at_local, verified_by,	sample_status, sample_result,
			spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT stg.ent_id, stg.sample_name, j.item_id, stg.wo_id, stg.oper_id, stg.seq_no,
			stg.context_ent_id, stg.item_id, stg.item_category_id, stg.process_id, stg.context_oper_id,
			stg.freq_id, stg.plan_id,
			NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			stg.requested_time_utc, stg.requested_time_local, stg.expiry_time_utc, stg.expiry_time_local,
			stg.warning_time_utc, stg.warning_time_local, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, NULL,
			stg.spare1, stg.spare2, stg.spare3, stg.spare4, NULL, @last_edit_by, @current_time_utc
		FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.wo_id = j.wo_id AND stg.oper_id = j.oper_id AND stg.seq_no = j.seq_no
		WHERE stg.sample_id = @sample_to_go_sample_id

		--Get the current sample_id
		SET @sample_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		--If a valie sample is created, i.e. @sample_id contains non null value, then create corresponding sample_char_link records for this sample.
		--Retrieve all the sample characteristics from the sample_to_go table for this sample ID in the sample_to_go
		--and insert them in the sample_char_link table using the 'sample_id' retrieved above.
		IF (@sample_id IS NOT NULL)
			INSERT INTO sample_char_link (sample_id, char_id, qm_spec_id, note, cause_id, control_move, ignore_sample,
				 equipment, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			SELECT @sample_id, scltg.char_id, scltg.qm_spec_id, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, @current_time_utc
			FROM sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE scltg.sample_id = @sample_to_go_sample_id

	END
	CLOSE samples_to_move_cursor
	DEALLOCATE samples_to_move_cursor

	--Remove all the sample_to_go records that were moved to sample table
	DELETE FROM sample_to_go
	FROM @samples_moved sm
	WHERE sample_to_go.sample_id = sm.sample_to_go_sample_id

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ebr_summary_data]
AS
SELECT temptable.*,
       job.job_desc,
       job.qty_reqd,
       job.sched_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_start_time_local,
       job.sched_finish_time_utc,
       job.sched_finish_time_local,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       ent.ent_name
FROM (SELECT item_prod.item_id,
             item_prod.lot_no,
             item_prod.sublot_no,
             item_prod.wo_id,
             item_prod.oper_id,
             item_prod.seq_no,
             item_prod.ent_id,
             SUM(item_prod.qty_prod) AS qty_prod
      FROM item_prod item_prod
      WHERE item_prod.good_prod = 1
      GROUP BY item_prod.item_id,
               item_prod.lot_no,
               item_prod.sublot_no,
               item_prod.wo_id,
               item_prod.oper_id,
               item_prod.seq_no,
               item_prod.ent_id
     ) temptable
INNER JOIN job job ON temptable.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
                      temptable.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
                      temptable.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN item item ON temptable.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN ent ent ON temptable.ent_id = ent.ent_id

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_OBD
-- Description:  Updates OBD details to ofi_wo_ext table
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  NK          2022-08-24         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  AP          2023-11-23         Added insert for wo attribute 'NewOrderCheck'
-- 0.01.02  LK          2024-02-18         Added check to insert for wo attribute 'NewOrderCheck'
-- 0.01.03  LK          2024-02-18         Update WO QTY 
-- 0.01.04  LK          2024-02-23         added error if batch number not matching with wo
-- 0.01.05  LK          2024-05-30         Change the plant code condition check to @ship_to_party
-- 0.01.65  LK          2024-06-10         updated error message 'ship to party'
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE                 PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_OBD] (@DocNoRefDoc VARCHAR(40),@delivery VARCHAR(40),@delivery_type VARCHAR(40),@plant_gds_date VARCHAR(40),@plant_gds_time VARCHAR(40),
@load_date VARCHAR(40),@load_time VARCHAR(40),@trans_date VARCHAR(40),@trans_time VARCHAR(40),@delivery_date VARCHAR(40),@delivery_time VARCHAR(40),@delivery_no VARCHAR(40),@delivery_item VARCHAR(40),@pick_date VARCHAR(40),
@pick_time VARCHAR(40),@ship_to_party VARCHAR(40),@batch VARCHAR(40),@ship_point VARCHAR(40),@item_id VARCHAR(40),@item_group VARCHAR(40),@plant_code VARCHAR(40),
@storage_location VARCHAR(40),@delivery_qty VARCHAR(40),@base_uom VARCHAR(40),@item_no_ref VARCHAR(40))
AS
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @ErrorMessage  NVARCHAR(MAX),@ErrorSeverity INT,@ErrorState INT, @ErrMsg VARCHAR(MAX);
DECLARE @wo_id VARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @attr_id_Auto_Release        INT=NULL
DECLARE @mod_id         VARCHAR(30),
		@rc             INT

SET @wo_id = @DocNoRefDoc

BEGIN TRY

/*Begin Validations*/
BEGIN
	SET @ErrMsg = '';

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WO WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
			SET @ErrMsg = @ErrMsg + '[Invalid WO]'
		ELSE IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ofi_wo_ext WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND item_id = @item_id)
			SET @ErrMsg = @ErrMsg + ' [Invalid Item]'

		--IF(dbo.fn_S_ofi_PlantCode_2()<>@plant_code)
		IF(@ship_to_party not like '%'+dbo.fn_S_ofi_PlantCode()+'%')
			SET @ErrMsg = @ErrMsg + ' [Invalid ship to party] ' + @ship_to_party

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from ofi_wo_ext where wo_id = @wo_id and lot_no =  @batch)-- 0.01.04 
			SET @ErrMsg = @ErrMsg + ' [Batch number not valid]' +@batch

		--IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_wo_ext WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and status = 0)
		--	SET @ErrMsg = @ErrMsg + '[Invalid WO status. Must be 1 or NULL]'
--print LEN(@ErrMsg)
 BEGIN TRANSACTION
	IF LEN(@ErrMsg) > 2 
	BEGIN	  
	 THROW 51009, @ErrMsg, 1
	END
END
/*End Validations*/

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id) and LEN(@ErrMsg) =0 
	BEGIN


		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND wo_qty <> @delivery_qty)
			UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = @delivery_qty, qty_at_start = @delivery_qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			update wo set req_qty=@delivery_qty where wo_id=@wo_id --0.01.03
		UPDATE ofi_wo_ext SET 
			wo_qty = @delivery_qty,uom_desc = @base_uom,plant_code = @plant_code,
			lot_no = @batch,product_group = @item_group,
			delivery = @delivery,delivery_type = @delivery_type,plant_gds_date = @plant_gds_date,
			plant_gds_time = @plant_gds_time,load_date = @load_date,load_time = @load_time,
			trans_date = @trans_date,trans_time = @trans_time,pick_date = @pick_date,pick_time = @pick_time,
			ship_to_party = @ship_to_party,ship_point = @ship_point,storage_location = @storage_location,
			delivery_qty = @delivery_qty,delivery_date = @delivery_date,delivery_time = @delivery_time,delivery_item = @delivery_item,
			item_no_ref=@item_no_ref
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		UPDATE job_bom set def_lot_no = @batch where wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos = 0 ---(KN 11/01/23 - Added to update the def_lot_no in job_bom)

		 SELECT @attr_id_Auto_Release = attr_id
                      FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'NewOrderCheck'
                             AND a.attr_grp = 6
		if Not Exists(select 1 from wo_attr with(nolock) where attr_id=@attr_id_Auto_Release and wo_id=@wo_id)  -- 0.01.02 
		BEGIN
					  EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_wo_attr]
                        @wo_id = @wo_id,
                        @attr_id = @attr_id_Auto_Release,
                        @attr_value = 'True',
                        @notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
                        @last_edit_comment = NULL,
                        @mod_id = @mod_id output
         END
		
	END
COMMIT TRANSACTION

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
 IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
	SELECT @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),@ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),@ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();
	RAISERROR(@ErrMsg , @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);	
END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@oper_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@seq_no		INT32 = NULL
,@job_pos 		INT32 = 0
,@status_notes		STRING2000_NULL = NULL
,@user_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@check_privs 		INT32 = NULL
,@check_certs 		INT32 = NULL
,@client_type		INT32 = 37
,@no_propogation	INT32 = 0
,@check_auto_job_start	INT32 = 1
,@event_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL
,@job_end_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs
-- Description	      - End a Job/OR end a batch of jobs
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.18
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--11/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.25	HD# 9065, Completing a job is sometimes leaving the job status in the grid as running
--01/27/2016	RWB			5.0.2	For story 588630, added code to prevent a qm_context record from being created if there are no frequencies except manual frequencies defined.
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
-- 09/14/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 1082564 - As SE, I want to merge in hotfixes related to Sample Generation
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	 @Concurrent_Link		INT32
	,@current_job_pos		INT32
	,@ret				INT32
	,@current_jobs_state_cd		INT32

	,@batch_job_wo_id		STRING40
	,@batch_job_oper_id		STRING40
	,@batch_job_seq_no		INT32
	,@batch_job_state_cd		INT32
	,@batch_job_run_ent_id		INT32
	,@batch_job_concurrent_link	INT32
	,@last_edit_by			STRING80
	,@can_capture_qm_data		LOGICAL
	,@num_frequencies			INT32
	,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

BEGIN

	--Apply all defaults. Default the bias value if not supplied.
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)--, @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, 0)
		,@client_type = ISNULL(@client_type, 37), @no_propogation = ISNULL(@no_propogation, 0)
		,@check_auto_job_start = ISNULL(@check_auto_job_start, 1)

	--Apply all defaults. Default the bias value if not supplied.
	IF (@job_end_utc IS NULL AND @event_time_local IS NOT NULL)
		--Use the job_start_utc if supplied (override the event_time_local time)
		SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, @current_time_utc)

	--Default the job end utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
	SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()))

	--Verify whether the job end time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_end_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_end_utc = @current_time_utc

	--Verify whether the details of a job is supplied.
	--If details for a job is not supplied (assuming a FC is ending a job as this may not have job details),
	--then assume this job is running on the supplied entity at the supplied job position.
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL) OR (@oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Since the wo_id, oper_id is not supplied, default the job_pos to 0; IF job_pos IS NULL
		SET @job_pos = COALESCE(@job_pos, 0)
		SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
	END

	-- Check if there are any frequencies defined.  If not, then we do not need to create a qm_context record
	SELECT @num_frequencies = COUNT(sf.freq_name)
	FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN sample_plan_freq_link spfl WITH (NOLOCK) ON spfl.freq_id = sf.freq_id
	WHERE sf.freq_type <> 19 and sf.enabled = 1

	--Get the can capture flag for the entity
	SELECT @can_capture_qm_data = e.can_capture_qm_data
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

	--Retrieve the status of the current job, and concurrent link no. to identify whether the current job is linked to a batch or not.
	SELECT @current_jobs_state_cd = state_cd, @concurrent_link = concurrent_link FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	IF (@concurrent_link = 0) BEGIN
		--The supplied (identified) job is currently running on the supplied entity.
		--Retrieve the job position of the supplied job that is running.
--		EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCurrJobPos @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no,
--			@job_pos=@current_job_pos OUTPUT

		--Since the current job is not linked to a batch, just start the job that is currently supplied.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=@job_pos
			, @status_notes=@status_notes, @user_id=@user_id, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=@check_certs
			, @client_type=@client_type, @no_propogation=@no_propogation, @check_auto_job_start=@check_auto_job_start
			, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

		--If this entity is capable of capturing QM data, then log the job details in the qm table, and call the sample generation to generate/remove samples.
		IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 1 AND @num_frequencies > 0) BEGIN

			--Remove Samples (if applicable) for the job that was just paused/ended.
			EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = @ent_id, @event_time_utc = @job_end_utc
				,@event_type = 20, @freq_of_sample_update = 0
				,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value

		END -- end generating samples

		--As soon as the current job is paused, just RETURN
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied job is currently running.
	IF (@current_jobs_state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		--The supplied (identified) job is currently running on the supplied entity.
		--Retrieve the job position of the supplied job that is running.
		EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCurrJobPos @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no,
			@job_pos=@current_job_pos OUTPUT
	END

	--End the supplied job
	EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=@current_job_pos
		, @status_notes=@status_notes, @user_id=@user_id, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=@check_certs
		, @client_type=@client_type, @no_propogation=@no_propogation, @check_auto_job_start=@check_auto_job_start
		, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

	--If this entity is capable of capturing QM data, then log the job details in the qm table, and call the sample generation to generate/remove samples.
	IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 1 AND @num_frequencies > 0) BEGIN

		--Get the user who is generating samples
		EXEC SP_S_DB_STATUS_GETAUDTRAILUSR @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

		-- CR L00124785 - 03/26/2013 - RWB - Changed to inserting a NULL for the context_ent_id to distinguish
		-- this record from any legitimate qm_context record.
		INSERT INTO qm_context (context_ent_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, is_job_running, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (NULL, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 0, @last_edit_by, @job_end_utc)
		-- End CR L00124785 Changes

	END -- end generating samples

	--If the return value is not success, then return.
	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	IF (@client_type = 36)
		--Loop through all the jobs and pause all the linked jobs in a batch.
		DECLARE job_batch_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, state_cd, run_ent_id, concurrent_link
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE state_cd = @current_jobs_state_cd AND concurrent_link = @concurrent_link
	ELSE
		--Loop through all the jobs and pause all the linked jobs in a batch.
		DECLARE job_batch_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, state_cd, run_ent_id, concurrent_link
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE state_cd = @current_jobs_state_cd AND run_ent_id = @ent_id AND concurrent_link = @concurrent_link

	OPEN job_batch_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM job_batch_cursor INTO @batch_job_wo_id, @batch_job_oper_id, @batch_job_seq_no,
			@batch_job_state_cd, @batch_job_run_ent_id, @batch_job_concurrent_link
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Get the job position of this job that is currently running on this entity.
		EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCurrJobPos @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@batch_job_wo_id, @oper_id=@batch_job_oper_id,
			@seq_no=@batch_job_seq_no, @job_pos=@current_job_pos OUTPUT

		--End this job
		EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@batch_job_wo_id, @oper_id=@batch_job_oper_id, @seq_no=@batch_job_seq_no, @job_pos=@current_job_pos
			, @status_notes=@status_notes, @user_id=@user_id, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=@check_certs
			, @client_type=@client_type, @no_propogation=@no_propogation, @check_auto_job_start=@check_auto_job_start
			, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
			--If the return value is not success, then return.
		IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	END
	CLOSE job_batch_cursor
	DEALLOCATE job_batch_cursor

	--If this entity is capable of capturing QM data, call the sample generation to generate/remove samples.

-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_job_steps]
-- Description:	Get all job steps filter by wo_id and oper_id and sequence number
--
-- Usage:	This will be used in the job tab for the selected job, it displays all the steps
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2022-08-09		Intial Version
-- 0.02.00   MP               2023-04-23        Updated steps name and desc
-- 0.03.00	 MA				  2024-02-01		Changes to take ent desc instead of ent name.
-- 0.04.00	 DS				  2024-02-09		Updated the header comments
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_job_steps] 
@wo_id nvarchar(300),
@oper_id nvarchar(300),
@seq_no int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare  @useLastLot int=0
declare @lotDetails as table (item_id STRING40, item_desc STRING80, def_lot_no  STRING40_NULL,last_used_lot STRING40_NULL, attr_value STRING1700_NULL )
DECLARE @GetEntNames TABLE (ent_desc NVARCHAR(40), row_id INT);	--temp table to get individual ent names from step data
DECLARE @GetEntDesc TABLE (row_id INT, description NVARCHAR(max), step_data nvarchar(max), wo_id nvarchar(40), oper_id nvarchar(40), seq_no INT);	--temp table to store ent desc based on other parameters.



 Declare 
 @recipe nvarchar(200),
 @sourcesilo nvarchar(200),
 @destinationsilo nvarchar(200),
 @setlot nvarchar(200)
 
insert into @lotDetails
exec [dbo].[sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives] 
		@wo_id
		,@oper_id
		,@seq_no
		,@useLastLot

INSERT INTO @GetEntNames (ent_desc, row_id)
select value, row_id FROM job_step_data WITH (nolock) 
CROSS APPLY string_split(step_data, ',');

INSERT INTO @GetEntDesc (row_id, description, step_data, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no)
SELECT tmp.row_id, STRING_AGG(COALESCE(ent.description, tmp.ent_desc), ',') as description, jsd.step_data as step_data, jsd.wo_id as wo_id,
jsd.oper_id as oper_id, jsd.seq_no as seq_no
FROM @GetEntNames tmp
LEFT JOIN ent WITH (nolock) ON ent.ent_name = tmp.ent_desc
LEFT JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock) ON jsd.row_id = tmp.row_id
GROUP BY tmp.row_id,jsd.step_data, jsd.wo_id,jsd.oper_id,jsd.seq_no

Select 
  @recipe = step_data 
from 
  job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock) 
  LEFT JOIN job_step js WITH (nolock) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
  and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id 
  and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no 
  and js.step_no = jsd.step_no 
where 
  step_name like '%Set Recipe%' 
  and jsd.wo_id = @wo_id 
  and jsd.oper_id = @oper_id 
  and jsd.seq_no = @seq_no

Select 
  @sourcesilo = step_data 
from 
  job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock) 
  LEFT JOIN job_step js WITH (nolock) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
  and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id 
  and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no 
  and js.step_no = jsd.step_no 
where 
  step_name like '%Set Source%' 
  and jsd.wo_id = @wo_id 
  and jsd.oper_id = @oper_id 
  and jsd.seq_no = @seq_no

Select 
  @destinationsilo = step_data 
from 
  job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock) 
  LEFT JOIN job_step js WITH (nolock) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
  and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id 
  and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no 
  and js.step_no = jsd.step_no 
where 
  step_name like '%Set Destination%'
  and jsd.wo_id = @wo_id 
  and jsd.oper_id = @oper_id 
  and jsd.seq_no = @seq_no

Select 
  @setlot = step_data 
from 
  job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock) 
  LEFT JOIN job_step js WITH (nolock) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
  and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id 
  and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no 
  and js.step_no = jsd.step_no 
where 
  step_name like '%Set Lot%'
  and jsd.wo_id = @wo_id 
  and jsd.oper_id = @oper_id 
  and jsd.seq_no = @seq_no

Select @recipe = description from @GetEntDesc 
where step_data = @recipe 
	and wo_id = @wo_id 
	and oper_id = @oper_id 
	and seq_no = @seq_no
Select @sourcesilo = description from @GetEntDesc 
where step_data = @sourcesilo 
	and wo_id = @wo_id 
	and oper_id = @oper_id 
	and seq_no = @seq_no
Select @destinationsilo = description from @GetEntDesc 
where step_data = @destinationsilo 
	and wo_id = @wo_id 
	and oper_id = @oper_id 
	and seq_no = @seq_no
Select @setlot = description from @GetEntDesc 
where step_data = @setLot 
	and wo_id = @wo_id 
	and oper_id = @oper_id 
	and seq_no = @seq_no
	
  if exists(select 1 from @lotDetails) -- if required to set the lot then validate else leave it
		begin

		 Select  js.wo_id,js.oper_id,js.seq_no,js.step_no,js.step_name,jsd.state_cd,
			case 
			when step_name like '%Set Parameter%'
				then CONCAT(step_desc,'')
			when step_name like '%Set Recipe%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'  ','[Selected Recipe: ',@recipe,']')
			when step_name like '%Set Source%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'  ','[Selected Silo: ',@sourcesilo,']')
			when step_name like '%Set Destination%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'  ','[Selected Silo: ',@destinationsilo,']')
			when step_name like '%Set Lot%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'')
		
		end as step_result
							FROM   job_step js WITH (nolock)
					   LEFT JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock)
							   ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id and 
								  js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id and 
								  js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no and 
								  js.step_no = jsd.step_no

								WHERE  js.wo_id = @wo_id and js.oper_id = @oper_id and js.seq_no=@seq_no


		end
	else
		begin

		 Select  js.wo_id,js.oper_id,js.seq_no,js.step_no,js.step_name,jsd.state_cd,
			case 
			when step_name like '%Set Parameter%'
				then CONCAT(step_desc,'')
			when step_name like '%Set Recipe%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'  ','[Selected Recipe: ',@recipe,']')
			when step_name like '%Set Source%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'  ','[Selected Silo: ',@sourcesilo,']')
			when step_name like '%Set Destination%'
				then CONCAT(step_name,'  ','[Selected Silo: ',@destinationsilo,']')
			--when step_name like '%Set Lot%'
			--	then CONCAT(step_name,'')
		
		end as step_result
							FROM   job_step js WITH (nolock)
					   LEFT JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (nolock)
							   ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id and 
								  js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id and 
								  js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no and 
								  js.step_no = jsd.step_no

								WHERE  js.wo_id = @wo_id and js.oper_id = @oper_id and js.seq_no=@seq_no

		end
END

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_step_file_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on job_step_file table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--

--

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/01/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Makes sure the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
	UPDATE job_step_file SET assoc_file_type = x.extension
	FROM (SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(assoc_file) as extension, assoc_file_type FROM inserted) x
	WHERE job_step_file.wo_id = x.wo_id AND job_step_file.oper_id = x.oper_id AND job_step_file.seq_no = x.seq_no AND job_step_file.assoc_file = x.assoc_file AND x.extension <> x.assoc_file_type

	UPDATE job_step_file SET job_step_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_step_file.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE job_step_file.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_step_file.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_step_file.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_step_file.step_no = i.step_no AND job_step_file.assoc_file = i.assoc_file

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_U_ofi_Batchmaker_number]
-- Description:To update the Batch Maker number in Item Prod

-- Usage:	This will be used to Track the Batch maker (Cake blender) in the Cake/Powder packing
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-06-21		Intial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Batchmaker_number_old] 

@wo_id as nvarchar(40),
@oper_id as nvarchar(40),
@seq_no as int,
@row_id as int



AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

Declare 
@subLot  varchar(100),
@fg_lot_no varchar(100),
@fg_sub_lot_no varchar(100)

IF @oper_id = 'CakePowderPacking'
BEGIN
	Select top 1 @fg_lot_no = ic.lot_no,
				@fg_sub_lot_no= ic.sublot_no	
				from item_cons ic with(nolock)
				inner join item i with(nolock) on ic.item_id = i.item_id
				where ic.wo_id = @wo_id and ic.oper_id = @oper_id and ic.seq_no = @seq_no and i.item_class_id = 'SFG' 
				order by ic.created_at_local desc
				
				PRINT 'fg_lot_no' + @fg_lot_no
				PRINT 'fg_sub_lot_no' + @fg_sub_lot_no
				--ePrint @fg_lot_no + ' - ' + @fg_sub_lot_no

				Select top 1 @subLot =  iif(len(isnull(ic.sublot_no,''))>10,RIGHT(sublot_no,10),null)  
				from item_cons ic with(nolock) 
				where fg_sublot_no = @fg_sub_lot_no AND ic.oper_id = 'Milling'
				PRINT 'sublot_no' + @subLot

				select @subLot as batchmakernumber

				--update item_prod set last_edit_comment = @subLot, last_edit_at = GETDATE()  where row_id = @row_id
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	Select top 1 @fg_lot_no = ic.lot_no,
				@fg_sub_lot_no= ic.sublot_no	
				from item_cons ic with(nolock)
				inner join item i with(nolock) on ic.item_id = i.item_id
				where ic.wo_id = @wo_id and ic.oper_id = @oper_id and ic.seq_no = @seq_no and i.item_class_id = 'SFG'
				order by ic.created_at_local desc
				
				PRINT 'fg_lot_np' + @fg_lot_no
				PRINT 'fg_sub_lot_no' + @fg_sub_lot_no
				--ePrint @fg_lot_no + ' - ' + @fg_sub_lot_no

				Select top 1 @subLot =  iif(len(isnull(ic.sublot_no,''))>10,RIGHT(sublot_no,10),null)  
				from item_cons ic with(nolock) where fg_sublot_no = @fg_sub_lot_no 
				PRINT 'sublot_no' + @subLot

				--select @subLot as batchmakernumber

				update item_prod set last_edit_comment = @subLot, last_edit_at = GETDATE()  where row_id = @row_id
END
				
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_bom_item_subst_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[bom_item_subst]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_bom_item_subst_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on bom_item_subst table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 07/07/2004    Sheetal Jain  20024  	(HD# 4395) Maintain BOM_ver.ver_date automatically
--08/04/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Disallow updating any substitution items which are same the items in bom_item table
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	IF UPDATE(item_id) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM bom_item bi INNER JOIN inserted i
				ON bi.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bi.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bi.bom_pos = i.bom_pos AND bi.item_id = i.item_id) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The substitute bom item cannot be the same item as the bom item{2631}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE bom_item_subst SET bom_item_subst.qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,bom_item_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.max_qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,bom_item_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.min_qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,bom_item_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, bom_item_subst.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE bom_item_subst.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bom_item_subst.ver_id = i.ver_id
	  AND bom_item_subst.bom_pos = i.bom_pos AND bom_item_subst.alt_no = i.alt_no

	  --Maintain bom version date automatically
	  UPDATE bom_ver SET ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE parent_item_id+' '+ver_id IN
	    (SELECT parent_item_id+' '+ver_id FROM INSERTED)
END

  (@sample_id int = NULL,
   @segment_requirement_id nvarchar(254) =NULL,
   @segment_response_id nvarchar(254) = NULL,
   @lot_no nvarchar(80) = NULL,
   @sublot_no nvarchar(80) =NULL ,
   @operator nvarchar(80) =NULL,
   @priority int = NULL,
   @spare1 nvarchar(80) = NULL ,
   @spare2 nvarchar(80) = NULL,
   @spare3 nvarchar(80) = NULL,
   @spare4 nvarchar(80) = NULL,
   @event_date_time datetime = NULL,
   @event_date_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
   @samplesxml nvarchar(max) = NULL
   )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       -  sp_U_Sample_RecordSampleData
-- Description       - Record sample data. Implements section 4.2.1 in the SRO DFS.
-- Author            -     Johnny Agsalog
-- Date Created      -  6/7/2011
-- Version        -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By        Changes
-- 04/06/2012		MS				 Fix CR L00119541
-- 05/22/2014       Srinivasa Tentu  User Story#333085, As Invensys, I want to merge L00131525 (HF CR L00131288 -
--										sample_attr not being passed correctly)
-- 11/21/2019	Raghu	6.3	UserStory: 1184123-As Bruce, I want a Sample.Put web API for updating sample final and pulled settings
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
 @currdate datetime,
 @err_msg STRING80
BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id = @sample_id)
     BEGIN
       SET @err_msg = '%1 sample does not exist<7543>,' + STR(@sample_id)
       RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
       RETURN
   END

   IF @sample_id>=0
   BEGIN

      UPDATE sample
      SET
         segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id,
         segment_response_id = @segment_response_id,
         lot_no = @lot_no,

         spare2 = @spare2,
