      -- update the sample_attr with the value/notes pair

      IF @samplesxml IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          EXEC sp_U_Sample_Attr_AddOrUpdXML @samplesxml
        END

      IF @operator IS NOT NULL
         BEGIN
          -- Note: if event time and/or time zone is null, the following stored
          -- procedure will evaluate them and convert them accordingly.
           EXECUTE sp_U_Sample_Pull @sample_id=@sample_id, @pulled_by=@operator, @pulled_time_local=@event_date_time, @pulled_time_utc=NULL
         END

   END

END

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_efficiency_data
AS
SELECT
	tpm_stat.shift_start_local AS ShiftStartTime
	,tpm_stat.shift_start_utc AS ShiftStartTimeUTC
	,tpm_stat.hour_start_utc AS HourStartUTC
	,tpm_stat.hour_start_local as HourStartLocal
	,tpm_stat.shift_id AS ShiftID
	,shift.shift_desc AS ShiftDesc
	,ent.ent_name AS EntityName
	,ent.ent_id AS EntityID
	,item.item_desc AS ProductDesc
	,item.item_id AS ProductID
	,tpm_stat.seq_no AS SeqNo
	,tpm_stat.oper_id AS OperationID
	,wo.wo_desc AS WODesc
	,wo.wo_id AS WOID
	,tpm_stat.runtime+tpm_stat.downtime+tpm_stat.idletime AS IntervalSeconds
	,tpm_stat.qty_good AS GoodUnits
	,tpm_stat.qty_reject AS BadUnits
    	,tpm_stat.qty_good+tpm_stat.qty_reject AS TotalUnits
	,tpm_stat.runtime
	,tpm_stat.idletime AS Idle
	,tpm_stat.downtime AS AvailabilityLosses
	,tpm_stat.std_prod_rate
	,CASE tpm_stat.std_prod_rate
		WHEN 0 THEN 0
		ELSE 1.0*tpm_stat.batch_size/(tpm_stat.std_prod_rate*3600.0)
	END AS TheoreticalRate
	,tpm_stat.hour_end_utc
	,tpm_stat.hour_end_local
	,tpm_stat.job_start_utc
FROM [dbo].tpm_stat WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent WITH (NOLOCK)
ON tpm_stat.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].shift WITH (NOLOCK)
ON tpm_stat.shift_id = shift.shift_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item WITH (NOLOCK)
ON tpm_stat.item_id = item.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].wo WITH (NOLOCK)
ON tpm_stat.wo_id = wo.wo_id

CREATE   PROCEDURE[dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Add_BOM_Details] (@module     NVARCHAR(40),
                                             @plant_code NVARCHAR(40),
											 @wo_id      NVARCHAR(40),
											 @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
											 @parent_item_id    NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_number NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_id NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_desc NVARCHAR(80),
											 @qty  VARCHAR(50),
											 @uom_desc NVARCHAR(40),
											 @backflush BIT,
											 @by_product_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
											 @by_product BIT,
											 @co_product BIT,
											 @spare6    NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
      --SET @plant_code=@plant_code			--- (KN 10-Feb-23 - Original logic)
	  DECLARE @state_cd INT
	  SELECT @state_cd = state_cd from wo with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id

	  IF NOT @state_cd >=1		--- (KN 10-Feb-23 Don't update for work orders which are started already. Just ignore)
	  BEGIN

	  DECLARE @bom_pos		    INT,@event_time_utc   DATETIME,
				  @event_time_local DATETIME,
				  @created_by       NVARCHAR(40)

	   SELECT @bom_pos = (bom_pos)
			  FROM   ofi_wo_item_ext WITH (nolock)
			  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id and item_id = @item_id

	  SET @event_time_utc = dbo.Fn_stripmillisecsfromdatetime(Getutcdate())
		  SET @event_time_local =dbo.Fn_tz_getlocaldatefromutc(NULL, @event_time_utc)

		  IF @created_by IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SELECT @created_by = attr_value
				FROM   system_attr sa WITH (nolock)
				WHERE  sa.attr_id = 199
			END

	  Update [dbo].[ofi_wo_item_ext] SET
	  [wo_id] = @wo_id
			   ,[parent_item_id] = @parent_item_id
			   ,[bom_pos] = @bom_pos
			   ,[item_id] = @item_id
			   ,[qty] = @qty
			   ,[qty_per_parent_item] = NULL
			   ,[backflush] = @backflush
			   ,[def_lot_no] = @by_product_lot_no
			   ,[item_number] = @item_number
			   ,[item_desc] = @item_desc
			   ,[uom_desc] = @uom_desc
			   ,[by_product] = @by_product
			   ,[co_product] = @co_product
			   ,[spare6] = @spare6
			   ,[last_edit_at_utc] = @event_time_utc
			   ,[last_edit_at_local] = @event_time_local
			   ,[created_by] = @created_by
			   ,[last_edit_by] = @created_by
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and item_id = @item_id and parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
	END
  END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_master_recipe_bom]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch the recipe  details for ent_id and item_id
--				check always the preffered one if exists otherwise show the non preffered one
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	DS				2022-07-14			Initial version.
   0.01.01	CK				2023-Jan-24			Get all version , preferred will be on top
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_master_recipe]
(
 @ent_id		INT --= NULL  
,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40) --= '100001234'
) 

AS
 -- Get the recipe  details
BEGIN

declare @wo_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
declare @oper_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
declare @seq_no int
declare @spare1 nvarchar(1000) = NULL

	select top 1 @wo_id = wo_id,@oper_id = oper_id, @seq_no = seq_no from job with(nolock) where run_ent_id = @ent_id and item_id = @item_id and state_cd = 4 order by act_start_time_utc desc 
	
	if(@wo_id is not null)
	begin
		select top 1 @spare1 = spare1 from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos = 0
	end

	-- checking the spare1 column, if it is already not being saved , once saved it is getting stored in spare1 column
	if(@spare1 is null)
	begin

		SELECT [item_id]
		  ,[ent_id]
		  ,[version]
		  ,[recipe_name]
		  ,[preferred]
		  ,[is_active]
		  ,[notes]
		  ,[spare1]
		  ,[spare2]
		  ,[spare3]
		  ,[spare4]
		  ,[created_at_utc]
		  ,[created_at_local]
		  ,[created_by]
		  ,[last_edit_at_utc]
		  ,[last_edit_at_local]
		  ,[last_edit_by]
		  ,[row_id]
			FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  item_id = @item_id and ent_id =  @ent_id and is_active = 'Y'
			ORDER by CASE when preferred='Y' THEN 0 else 1 END
	  
	end
		else

		begin

		select * from (
			SELECT [item_id]
			  ,[ent_id]
			  ,[version]
			  ,[recipe_name]
			  ,[preferred]
			  ,[is_active]
			  ,[notes]
			  ,[spare1]
			  ,[spare2]
			  ,[spare3]
			  ,[spare4]
			  ,[created_at_utc]
			  ,[created_at_local]
			  ,[created_by]
			  ,[last_edit_at_utc]
			  ,[last_edit_at_local]
			  ,[last_edit_by]
			  ,[row_id]
				FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  item_id = @item_id and ent_id =  @ent_id and is_active = 'Y'
				--ORDER by CASE when preferred='Y' THEN 0 else 1 END
				union 
				SELECT 
				   @item_id as [item_id]
				  ,@ent_id as [ent_id]
				  ,-1 as [version]
				  ,'Last used recipe' as [recipe_name]
				  ,'' as [preferred]
				  ,'' as [is_active]
				  ,'' as [notes]
				  ,'' as [spare1]
				  ,'' as [spare2]
				  ,'' as [spare3]
				  ,'' as [spare4]
				  ,'' as [created_at_utc]
				  ,'' as [created_at_local]
				  ,'' as [created_by]
				  ,'' as [last_edit_at_utc]
				  ,'' as [last_edit_at_local]
				  ,'' as [last_edit_by]
				  ,'' as [row_id]
					FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  item_id = @item_id and ent_id =  @ent_id and is_active = 'Y'
					) a ORDER by CASE when a.preferred='Y' THEN 0 when a.recipe_name = 'Last used recipe' then 2  else 1 END
				--ORDER by CASE when preferred='Y' THEN 0 else 1 END
			
			end

END

	,	@J_check_inv logical

	,	@J_est_lab_rate float
	,	@J_est_setup_time float
	,	@J_est_teardown_time float
	,	@J_est_prod_rate float
	,	@J_prod_uom	int
	,	@J_est_transfer_time float
	,	@J_sched_start_time datetime
	,	@J_latest_start_time datetime
	,	@J_sched_finish_time datetime
	,	@J_act_start_time datetime
	,	@J_act_finish_time datetime
	,	@J_concurrent_link int
	,	@J_job_cost float
	,	@J_parent_contingent_job logical
	,	@J_child_contingent_job logical
	,	@J_notes nvarchar(4000)
	,	@J_assoc_file string254
	,	@J_assoc_file_type string20
	,	@J_status_notes varchar(2000)
	,	@J_edited_by string40
	,	@J_display_seq INT
	,	@J_folder_ver_id string40
	,	@J_rework logical
	,	@J_rework_cd string40
	-- variables for JOB_ROUTE table fields
	,	@JR_wo_id string40
	,	@JR_oper_id string40
	,	@JR_seq_no int
	,	@JR_input_oper_id string40
	,	@JR_input_seq_no int
	,	@JR_input_percent float
	,	@JR_mod_id timestamp
	,	@job_state_cd	INT
	,	@J_spare1	STRING80
	,	@J_spare2	STRING80
	,	@J_spare3	STRING80
	,	@J_spare4	STRING80
	,	@last_edit_by	STRING40
	,	@last_edit_at	TDATETIME
	,	@tz_temp		INT32
	,	@req_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@dbg_resp		INT32
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

	 SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
      -- TRACE
		exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob', @src_key='on_entry',
		@date_val1 = @req_finish_time_local
		IF(@dbg_resp = 1)
		RETURN

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	IF (@req_finish_time_local IS NOT NULL)
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	--Atleast one of the @new_wo_id,@new_oper_id or @new_seq_no optional parameters must be specified,
        --otherwise throw the error and exit
	IF (@new_wo_id IS NULL) And (@new_oper_id IS NULL) AND (@new_seq_no IS NULL) 	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Atleast one of the new_wo_id,new_oper_id or new_seq_no must be specified{3273}', 16, 1)		RETURN -1
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Job to be cloned does not exist{3275}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	If EXISTS(SELECT top 1 1 FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id and target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        RAISERROR('The cloned job cannot be added to a work order which is queued to a line .{7913}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
    END

--1.	Check if the new wo_id/oper_id/seq_no exist raise an error, exit proc.  If none of new.. specified, crate new_seq_no
	--check if the row exists in the JOB table
	SELECT @J_wo_id = wo_id, @J_oper_id = oper_id, @J_seq_no = seq_no, @J_job_desc = job_desc, @J_item_id = item_id,
		@J_state_cd = state_cd, @J_job_priority = job_priority, @J_req_finish_time_utc = req_finish_time_utc,
		@J_req_finish_time_local = req_finish_time_local,
		@J_init_sched_ent_id = init_sched_ent_id, @J_target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id,
		@J_run_ent_id = run_ent_id, @J_qty_reqd = qty_reqd, @J_qty_prod = qty_prod, @J_qty_prod_erp = qty_prod_erp,
		@J_qty_rejected = qty_rejected, @J_qty_rejected_erp = qty_rejected_erp, @J_qty_at_start = qty_at_start,
		@J_deviation_above = deviation_above, @J_deviation_below = deviation_below,
		@J_batch_size = batch_size, @J_first_job = first_job, @J_final_job = final_job, @J_sched_pinned = sched_pinned,
		@J_check_inv = check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab = est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate = est_lab_rate,
		@J_est_setup_time = est_setup_time, @J_est_teardown_time = est_teardown_time, @J_est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate,
		@J_prod_uom = prod_uom,
		@J_est_transfer_time = est_transfer_time, @J_sched_start_time = sched_start_time_local,
		@J_latest_start_time = latest_start_time_local, @J_sched_finish_time = sched_finish_time_local,
		@J_act_start_time = act_start_time_local, @J_act_finish_time = act_finish_time_local, @J_concurrent_link = concurrent_link,
		@J_job_cost = job_cost, @J_parent_contingent_job = parent_contingent_job, @J_child_contingent_job = child_contingent_job,
		@J_notes = notes, @J_assoc_file = assoc_file, @J_assoc_file_type = assoc_file_type,
		@J_status_notes = status_notes, @J_edited_by = edited_by, @last_edit_at = edit_time, @J_display_seq = display_seq,
		@J_folder_ver_id = folder_ver_id, @J_rework = rework,@J_rework_cd = rework_cd,
		@J_spare1 = spare1, @J_spare2 = spare2, @J_spare3 = spare3, @J_spare4 = spare4
	FROM job
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no

--2.	Check if user has permission to clone, if not,  raise an error, exit proc.
--3.	if new_wo_id is specified oper_id, seq_no will remain same for the new record being created
			--ELSE(for new_wo_id = NULL) look in the job table for wo_id and oper_id
			--and calculate next seq_no (ie. new_seq_no)
	SET @new_wo_id = ISNULL(@new_wo_id, @wo_id)
	SET @new_oper_id = ISNULL(@new_oper_id, @oper_id)

	IF @new_seq_no IS NULL BEGIN
		IF (@new_wo_id = @wo_id) AND (@new_oper_id = @oper_id)
			SELECT @new_seq_no = MAX(seq_no) + 1 FROM job
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
		ELSE SET @new_seq_no = @seq_no
	END

	--Check whether the new job is already exists, if exists throw the error
	SET @J_wo_id = NULL
	SELECT @J_wo_id = wo_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id AND oper_id = @new_oper_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no

	IF (@J_wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--means the new job is already exists, so throw the error
		RAISERROR('The new Job is already exists{3274}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--set the variables before inserting in JOB table
	--SET @new_state_cd = ISNULL(@new_state_cd, @J_state_cd)
	--For job.state_cd only the following values are allowable:
	--1(NEW),2(Ready),5(Suspended),6(OnHold). If not defined or invalid then defaults to the
	--the state of the current job, or default to 2(Ready) if the current job is any of
	--3(Running),4(Complete) or 7(Cancelled)
/*	IF NOT (@new_state_cd IS NULL OR @new_state_cd = 1 OR @new_state_cd =2 OR @new_state_cd =5 OR @new_state_cd =6)
			BEGIN
				IF (@J_state_cd= 3) OR  (@J_state_cd= 4) OR  (@J_state_cd= 7) BEGIN
					SET @J_state_cd=2        --set the status to 'Ready'
				END
			SET @new_state_cd = @J_state_cd
		END*/

	IF (@new_state_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @job_state_cd = @J_state_cd
		IF NOT (@job_state_cd = 1 OR @job_state_cd = 2) SET @job_state_cd = 1
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@new_state_cd = 3) SET @job_state_cd = 2
		ELSE SET @job_state_cd = @new_state_cd
	END

	SELECT	@req_qty = ISNULL(@req_qty, @J_qty_reqd)
		,	@start_qty = ISNULL(@start_qty, @J_qty_at_start)
		,	@req_finish_time_utc = ISNULL(@req_finish_time_utc, @J_req_finish_time_utc)
		,	@req_finish_time_local = ISNULL(@req_finish_time_local, @J_req_finish_time_local)
		,	@target_ent_id = ISNULL(@target_ent_id, @J_target_sched_ent_id)
		,	@status_notes = ISNULL(@status_notes, 'Created by Job Clone')
		,	@last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )


--	SET @req_qty = ISNULL(@req_qty, @J_qty_reqd)
--	SET @start_qty = ISNULL(@start_qty, @J_qty_at_start)
--	SET @req_finish_time_local = ISNULL(@req_finish_time_local, @J_req_finish_time)
--	SET @target_ent_id = ISNULL(@target_ent_id, @J_target_sched_ent_id)
--	SET @status_notes = ISNULL(@status_notes, 'Created by Job Clone')
--	SET @last_edit_at = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), GETUTCDATE(), 120), 120)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

--5.	calculate latest start time (JOB table) by using req_qty and req_finish_time
	SET @standard_time_to_do_this_job = @J_est_setup_time + @J_est_teardown_time + @J_est_transfer_time
			+ (dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@J_est_prod_rate, @J_prod_uom) * @start_qty)

	SET @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local =
			DATEADD(Hour, -ROUND(CONVERT(float, @standard_time_to_do_this_job), 0), @req_finish_time_local)

	SET @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc =
			DATEADD(Hour, -ROUND(CONVERT(float, @standard_time_to_do_this_job), 0), @req_finish_time_utc)

--4.	Clone JOB table row (everything but wo_id, seq_no, state_cd,  req_finish_time, run_ent_id,
	--qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start,
	--sched_pinned, sched_start_time, sched_finish_time, act_start_time,
	--act_finish_time, concurrent_link, status_notes, edited_by, edit_time
	INSERT INTO JOB (
		wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc, item_id, state_cd, job_priority, req_finish_time_utc,
		req_finish_time_local, init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_prod,
		qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start, deviation_above, deviation_below, batch_size,
		first_job, final_job, sched_pinned, check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, est_transfer_time, sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local,
		latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local, sched_finish_time_utc, sched_finish_time_local,
		act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local, act_finish_time_utc, act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link,
		job_cost, parent_contingent_job, child_contingent_job, notes, assoc_file, assoc_file_type,
		status_notes, edited_by, edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework, rework_cd, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
	)
	VALUES (
		@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @J_job_desc, @J_item_id, @job_state_cd, @J_job_priority,
		@req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_local, @J_init_sched_ent_id, @target_ent_id, NULL, @req_qty, 0, NULL, 0, NULL,
		@start_qty, @J_deviation_above, @J_deviation_below, @J_batch_size, @J_first_job, @J_final_job, 0,
		@J_check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate, @J_est_setup_time, @J_est_teardown_time,
		@J_est_prod_rate, @J_prod_uom, @J_est_transfer_time, NULL, NULL, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local,
		NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @J_job_cost, @J_parent_contingent_job, @J_child_contingent_job, @status_notes, @J_assoc_file,
		@J_assoc_file_type, NULL, @user_id, @last_edit_at, @J_display_seq, @J_folder_ver_id, @J_rework,@J_rework_cd,
		@J_spare1, @J_spare2, @J_spare3, @J_spare4
	)


	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074730 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT  (select row_id from job where wo_id = @new_wo_id and oper_id = @new_oper_id and seq_no = @new_seq_no) as key_id
		,	6 as key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period, des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq
		,	des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1, des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4
		,	des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2, des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by
		,	des.last_edit_at
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN job ON des.key_id = job.row_id
	WHERE des.key_type = 6 and job.wo_id = @wo_id and job.oper_id = @oper_id and job.seq_no = @seq_no

--8.	Clone*** JOB_STEP table row(s)*.
	EXECUTE sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Step @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

--6.	Clone JOB_BOM table row(s)* and then Clone JOB_BOM_STEP table row(s)*.
	EXECUTE sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_BOM @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

--7.	Clone*** JOB_SPEC table row(s)*.
	EXECUTE sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Spec @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

--9.	Clone JOB_ROUTE row.  Here if the new_wo_id is same as wo_id (just clone a job)
	--then insert new record with new seq_no, everything else remains same.
	--If new_wo_id is different then wo_id (clone to a new work order),
	--we have to clone the input JOB row before we can clone a row in the job_route.
	EXECUTE sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Route @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

--10     Clone Attributes
	EXECUTE sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Attr @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

	--Clone resource job link records.
	INSERT INTO res_job_link (res_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, qty_reqd, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT res_id, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, ISNULL(@req_qty, qty_reqd),
		@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM res_job_link
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	--Clone data log group records (data_log_grp_job_link)
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_link (grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, cert_name, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT grp_id, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, cert_name, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_job_link
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	--Clone job_bom_subst records.
	-- Added "def_sublot_no," 2 places in statement below 1/12/07 KRF
	INSERT INTO job_bom_subst (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, alt_no, pref, subst_level, item_id, reqd_grade_cd,
		instruction, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val,
		reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
		scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
		must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
		last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, bom_pos, alt_no, pref, subst_level, item_id, reqd_grade_cd,
		instruction, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val,
		reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
		scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
		must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
		@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM job_bom_subst
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	IF (@job_state_cd = 2) EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_ChkStat @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
@cur_wo_id      STRING40,
@cur_oper_id        STRING40,
@cur_seq_no         INT32,
@cur_step_no        INT32,
@cur_step_start     TDATETIME,
@cur_item_id        STRING40,
@process_id         STRING40,
@item_id        STRING40,
--@cur_step_no integer,
--@cur_step_start datetime,
@endjobs_priv       INT32,
@endjobs_priv_id    INT32,
@certs_ok       LOGICAL,
-- vars required for qty checks
@qty_reqd       TFLOAT,
@qty_prod       TFLOAT,
@qty_rejected       TFLOAT,
@qty_at_start       TFLOAT,
@qty_threshold      TFLOAT,
-- Vars for Step checks
@num_incompl_steps  INT32,
@instance_info      STRING254,
@cert_name      STRING40,
@return         INT32,
----Added by Raghu on 11/21/2002.  State_cd is added to check the status of the job, before getting completed from the Supervisor
@state_cd       INT32,
--Added by Raghu on 02/21/2003 for automatic Job Start and Finish
@auto_seq_start_option  INT32,
@next_job_only      INT32,
@check_steps        BIT,
@check_qtys     BIT,
@queue_detail       NVARCHAR(2000),
@row_count      INT32,
@session_id    INT32,
@row_id        INT32,
@job_end_local  TDATETIME,
@prev_job_state INT32,
@action_type INT,
@can_capture_qm_data LOGICAL,
@ent_name	NVARCHAR(80),
@error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
@job_end_reas_cd INT32
,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
,@line_id		INT32
,@last_edit_comment	STRING254_NULL

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

SET @action_type = 2 -- flag to clear the samples.

    -- Default any null input params
	SELECT @check_certs = COALESCE(@check_certs, 0), @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 0), @client_type = COALESCE(@client_type, 37)
		, @check_auto_job_start = COALESCE(@check_auto_job_start, 1), @no_propogation = COALESCE(@no_propogation, 0)
		, @job_pos = COALESCE(@job_pos, 0), @check_qtys = COALESCE(@check_qtys, 0), @check_steps = COALESCE(@check_steps, 0)
		--Default the job end utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
		, @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_end_utc, @current_time_utc))

	--Verify whether the job end time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_end_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_end_utc = @current_time_utc

	SELECT @check_qtys = CASE WHEN must_prod_reqd_qty <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		, @check_steps = CASE WHEN must_complete_steps <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND job_pos = @job_pos

	IF @check_qtys = 0 OR @check_steps = 0
		SELECT @check_qtys = CASE WHEN @check_qtys<>0 OR i.must_prod_reqd_qty<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
			, @check_steps = CASE WHEN @check_steps<>0  OR i.must_complete_steps<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

	IF(@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- Get the sessionId from the sysprocesses table
		SELECT @session_id  = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WHERE spid =  @@spid
		--Retrieve the current user from the session context.
		-- Get user id from sessn when @session_id is between -1 to -9 (reserved for custom implementations) or positive number
		if(@session_id >= -9)
		begin
			SELECT @user_id = sn.user_id FROM sessn sn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sn.session_id = @session_id
		end
		else
		begin
		    SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
		end

		--This will not help the UCO, however, since setting the operator production attribute does not set a current user
		--for the session.  It does however log that user in to the labor_usage table, and log any other user out.
		--So the next choice would be the first current  user found in the labor_usage table for the job
		--if there is one.  The �current user found in the labor_usage table� would be the one where duration was 0,
		--as terminating a labor_usage record sets the duration.
		IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id  = MAX(el.user_id)
			FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE el.session_id = @session_id
				  AND el.ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		-- If there is no current user for the job either, use the background user (identified by system attribute 199).
		IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id  = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199
		END
	END

		-- If the check_privs flag is set check that this user may end jobs
		IF (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
			-- Get this user's Priv to End Jobs here
			SET @endjobs_priv_id = 72
			EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @endjobs_priv_id, @endjobs_priv OUTPUT
			IF @endjobs_priv = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to End Jobs{3192}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END

    --First, verify which client is ending a job (Supervisor, Operator or FC)
    IF (@client_type = 36) BEGIN    -- Supervisor
        --The call is initiated from the Supervisor to complete a job.
        --Use the job details supplied by the Supervisor - ie., Supervisor must supply the job details (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no) in this case.

        --Retrieve the state_cd from the supplied job to verify whether this job can be completed successfully.
        SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @row_id = row_id
        FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

        --Do not allow this job to be completed from Supervisor; if the status of the current job is RUNNING, COMPLETE, CANCELLED, BYPASSED.
        IF (@state_cd = 3 OR @state_cd = 4 OR @state_cd = 7 OR @state_cd = 8)  BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Cannot complete this job{3193}', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END

        --Default the job details as the current job
        SELECT @cur_wo_id = @wo_id, @cur_oper_id = @oper_id, @cur_seq_no = @seq_no
    END
    ELSE IF (@client_type = 37) BEGIN   -- Operator
        --Below are the probable combinations for ending a job.
        --i) ent_id --> Default job_pos to 0; and end the job that is running on an entity at job position 0.
        --ii) ent_id, job_pos   --> End the job that is running at the supplied job position.
        --iii) ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no --> default job_pos to 0 in this case ? End the job based on the supplied job parameters.
        --iv) ent_id, job_pos, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no   --> First, verify whether the job that is running at the supplied job position is the
        --                          same job that is supplied in.

        --Get the job that is currently running on an entity.
        SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
        FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos
        --10/26/2002    Tony                    1.5.0

        IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
            --Since a job is identified, retrieve the state code for the supplied job.
            SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @row_id = row_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

            --Verify whether the supplied job is currently running on this entity
            IF (@state_cd = 3) BEGIN
                --The supplied job is currently running on the supplied entity. So, verify whether the
                --Verify the job_exec.cur_* IS NOT NULL; raise an exception if the identified job is not currently running on this entity.
                IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL OR @cur_wo_id = '') OR (@cur_oper_id IS NULL OR @cur_oper_id = '') OR (@cur_seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
                    RAISERROR('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
                    RETURN -1
                END

                --There is a job currently running on the supplied job position. So, Verify whether the
                --intended job (supplied job) is the one that is currently running at the identified job position.
                --Raise an error if the supplied job details does not match the job that is currently running on an entity.
                IF (@wo_id <> @cur_wo_id) OR (@oper_id <> @cur_oper_id) OR (@seq_no <> @cur_seq_no) BEGIN
                    RAISERROR('The supplied job is not the job that is currently running on this entity.{5139}', 16, 1)
                    RETURN -1
                END
            END
            ELSE IF (@state_cd = 4)
                --The identified job is already ended/completed (COMPLETE = 4). Should we just return in this case ?
                RETURN 0
            ELSE --IF (@state_cd = 5) - RWB 3/12/2014 - default to the supplied job information for all job states except 3 and 4
                --If the current job state is SUSPENDED, then default the current job as the supplied job.
                SELECT @cur_wo_id = @wo_id, @cur_oper_id = @oper_id, @cur_seq_no = @seq_no
        END
        ELSE BEGIN -- There are no parameters that identifies a job.
            --The supplied job is currently running on the supplied entity. So, verify whether the
            --Verify the job_exec.cur_* IS NOT NULL; raise an exception if the identified job is not currently running on this entity.
            IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL OR @cur_wo_id = '') OR (@cur_oper_id IS NULL OR @cur_oper_id = '') OR (@cur_seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
                RAISERROR('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
                RETURN -1
            END

            --A job is currently running on an entity, default the job details as the supplied job.
            SELECT @wo_id = @cur_wo_id, @oper_id = @cur_oper_id, @seq_no = @cur_seq_no, @state_cd = 3
        END -- There are no parameters that identifies a job.
    END

    -- If quantity checks are required do them now
    IF @check_qtys = 1 BEGIN
        -- Check that qty_prod + qty_rejected >= qty_at_start - threshold
        SELECT @qty_prod = qty_prod, @qty_rejected = qty_rejected
              ,@qty_at_start = qty_at_start, @qty_reqd = qty_reqd
        FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

        -- Allow for null values; Eventually read qty threshold as system parameter ?
        SELECT @qty_prod = COALESCE(@qty_prod, 0), @qty_rejected = COALESCE(@qty_rejected, 0)
            ,@qty_at_start = COALESCE(@qty_at_start, 0), @qty_threshold = 0

        --Commented out by Raghu on 08/15/2000.
        -- Check result
    /*  IF (@qty_prod + @qty_rejected) < (@qty_at_start - @qty_threshold) BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Cannot end this job as the total qty produced is less than the start qty', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END
    */
        --Added by Raghu on 08/09/2002. Ending the job is not permitted when qty_prod < qty_reqd
        IF (@qty_prod < @qty_reqd) BEGIN
            SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
            --RAISERROR('Cannot end this job as the total good quantity is less than the quantity required{3195}', 16, 1)
            SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID: %1, OperID: %2, SeqNo: %3) running on entity: %4 at job position: %5 cannot be ended, because the total good quantity is less than the quantity required for this job.{7883},' + @cur_wo_id + ',' + @cur_oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @cur_seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @job_pos)
            RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END

    --  Added by Raghu on 11/21/2002. Check for Qty Deviation Below
        SELECT @qty_threshold = CONVERT(FLOAT, attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE attr_id = 104
        IF ((@qty_prod + @qty_rejected) < (@qty_at_start - (@qty_at_start * @qty_threshold))) BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Cannot end this job as the Total Quantity Produced+ Rejected  is less than the Start Quantity - Qty_threshold{3196}', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END

    --  Added by Raghu on 11/21/2002. Check for Qty Deviation Above
        SELECT @qty_threshold = CONVERT(FLOAT, attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE attr_id = 103
        IF (@qty_threshold  >= 0.0) BEGIN
            IF ((@qty_prod + @qty_rejected) > (@qty_at_start + (@qty_at_start * @qty_threshold))) BEGIN
                RAISERROR('Cannot end this job as the Total Quantity Produced + Rejected  is greater than the Start_Qty + Qty_threshold{3197}', 16, 1)
                RETURN -1
            END
        END
    END

    -- If Step completion checks are required check that all steps have been completed for this job
    IF @check_steps = 1 BEGIN
        EXEC @return = sp_S_Job_Step_Data_StepsCompl @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no
        IF @return <> 0 BEGIN
            RETURN -1
        END
    END

    -- If certification checks are required check that all required certifications have already been signed off
    IF @check_certs = 1 BEGIN
        SELECT @process_id = process_id, @item_id = item_id
        FROM  wo WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
            SELECT a.cert_name FROM cert_oper_link a WITH (NOLOCK), cert_type b WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE a.cert_name = b.cert_name
               and b.cert_audit = 1
               and process_id = @process_id
               and oper_id = @cur_oper_id
        OPEN cert_cursor
        WHILE (1=1)
        BEGIN
            FETCH NEXT from cert_cursor into @cert_name
            if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
            EXEC sp_Cert_SignOff_Done @wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, -1, @cert_name, -1, NULL, NULL,
                NULL, NULL, NULL, @return OUTPUT
            if @return < 0 BEGIN
                RAISERROR('Some of the certificates are not signed off{3198}',16,1, @return)
                return -1
            END
        END
        CLOSE cert_cursor
        DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
    END

    -- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
    EXECUTE @return =sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,  NULL,0,1
    IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1

    --Modified by Raghu on 12/03/2002. Changed 'Idle' to NULL
    --SET @cur_wo_id = 'Idle'
    --SET @cur_oper_id = 'Idle'
    SELECT @cur_wo_id = NULL, @cur_oper_id = NULL, @cur_seq_no = 0, @cur_step_no = NULL, @cur_step_start = NULL

	--Determine the job start local time from the utc
	SET @job_end_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @job_end_utc)

    --Modified by Raghu on 11/25/2002. Update job_exec only for client_type = 3 (Operator) as Operator deals with Running jobs which will have a row in job_exec table for that entity
    --Modified by Raghu on 11/26/2002. Do only for running jobs in Operator (Job should be running)
    --Modified by KRF on 10/19/2006 ALSO do for FC (client_type 39, since it can stop a job that's running, just as Operator can - HD #9046
    IF ((@client_type = 37 OR @client_type = 39) AND @state_cd = 3) BEGIN
        -- Update the Job_Exec table
        UPDATE  job_exec
        SET     cur_wo_id = @cur_wo_id
        ,   cur_oper_id = @cur_oper_id
        ,   cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no
        ,       cur_step_no = @cur_step_no
        ,       cur_step_start = @cur_step_start
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

        --10/26/2002    Tony                    1.5.0     Include job_pos in WHERE clause
        IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
            RAISERROR('SQL Error updating current job data in job_exec table{3190}', 16, 1)
            RETURN @@error
        END
    END

	SET @prev_job_state = @state_cd --@state_cd contains the current state of job before the update.
	-- Update the Job table
    UPDATE Job
    SET state_cd = 4
		,act_finish_time_utc = @job_end_utc
		,act_finish_time_local = @job_end_local
      ,status_notes = @status_notes
      , last_edit_comment = COALESCE(last_edit_comment, '') + 'JobStartPauseEndAction'
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
      AND oper_id = @oper_id
      AND seq_no = @seq_no

    --Retrieve the no. of rows updated in the job table (include no. of rows updated by the trigger as well).
    SET @row_count = @@ROWCOUNT

    -- Return error if this was not successful
    IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
        RAISERROR('SQL Error updating job state data in job table{3191}', 16, 1)
        RETURN @@error
    END

    IF (@row_count < 1) BEGIN
        --raise an error to the caller if we cannot able to update the job table
        --to keep job_exec and job table.state_cd in sync. per HD# 9065
        --RAISERROR('Cannot able to update the job table.{9999}', 16, 1)
		--Fixed the CR L00102648 - Modified the Error Message
        RAISERROR('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
        RETURN @@error
    END

    	IF (@state_cd = 3)
    		--If the job was actually running on the entity (i.e. with the state_cd = 3), then close off the job_history records
    		--Otherwise, the job was set to be ended from ready/new, etc. states (from SetWoStatus)
		EXEC sp_U_Job_History_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc
			, @last_edit_comment = 'JobExec.EndJob', @job_pos=@job_pos

   SELECT @cur_item_id = item_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

   IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1  FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 308 AND attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id,
        bom_pos, lot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, value1, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES ( @job_end_utc,  @job_end_local,  @wo_id,  @oper_id,
         @seq_no, 'JobStateChanged',  @ent_id, NULL, NULL, @cur_item_id, @user_id, @row_id, 4,@user_id, GETUTCDATE())
   END

    -- Log this event into the error_log depending on system severity setting
    SET @instance_info = ' Job = ' + @wo_id + '/' + @oper_id + '/' + STR(@seq_no)
    EXECUTE sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 4, @instance_info, 'sp_U_Job_Exec_EndJob', '', 'Job Ended', null, null

	--Determine whether this entity is capturing utilization
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_capture_util = 1) BEGIN
		--Determine whether there is any job start reason code configured.
		SELECT @job_end_reas_cd = ue.jobend_reas_cd FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ue.ent_id = @ent_id

		IF (@job_end_reas_cd IS NOT NULL AND @prev_job_state = 3)
			--Job end reason code is configured and previous job state is RUNNING. Therefore, create a new utilization event
			EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@job_end_utc, @reas_cd=@job_end_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0
				, @comments=NULL, @raw_reas_cd=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
				, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
				, @last_edit_comment='JobExec.EndJob(job end reason code)', @update_if_exists=1
				, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=NULL
	END

    --Modified by Raghu on 11/21/2002. The below line is commented out as item_id param is carrying a Null value.
    --The below line is modified by Raghu on 11/21/2002. Changed from wo_id -> cur_wo_id, oper_id -> cur_oper_id, seq_no -> cur_seq_no, item_id -> Null
    --Also modified by Raghu on 11/26/2002. Call Labor NewJob only if client_type = 3 and state_cd <> 5 (Suspended)
    IF ((@client_type = 37 OR @client_type = 39) AND @state_cd = 3)
        EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewJob @ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no,  NULL, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @time_zone_bias_value

    -- Added by Rohit
    -- Refresh the start qty of all immediate downstream jobs
    IF @no_propogation = 0 EXECUTE @return = sp_U_UpdateFedDownStreamJobs  @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@cur_item_id,1

	-- Determine whether the entity belongs to a line and the rate change has to be logged.
	SELECT TOP 1 @line_id = lel.line_id
	FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND lel.line_is_child = 0

	-- If the entity is in a line, determine the rate change
	IF (@line_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @last_edit_comment = 'EndJob(Ent=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@ent_id, -1)) + ',Wo=' + COALESCE(@wo_id, 'null') + ',Oper=' + COALESCE(@oper_id, 'null') + ',Seq=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@seq_no, -1)) + ')'
		EXEC sp_SA_Line_GetBottleneckEnts @line_id = @line_id, @log_prod_rates = 1, @start_time_utc = @job_end_utc, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	END

    --SET @queue_detail = '<request><ent_id>' + LTRIM(STR(@ent_id)) + '</ent_id><job_pos>' + LTRIM(STR(@job_pos)) + '</job_pos>'
    --SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<user_id>' + @user_id + '</user_id><wo_id>' + @wo_id + '</wo_id>'
    --SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<oper_id>' + @oper_id + '</oper_id><seq_no>' + LTRIM(STR(@seq_no)) + '</seq_no></request>'
    SET @queue_detail = '<request><ent_id>' + LTRIM(STR(@ent_id)) + '</ent_id><parameters>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="ent_id" value="' + LTRIM(STR(@ent_id)) + '"></parameter>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="job_pos" value="' + LTRIM(STR(ISNULL(@job_pos, ''))) + '"></parameter>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="user_id" value="' + @user_id + '"></parameter>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="last_wo_id" value="' + @wo_id + '"></parameter>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="last_oper_id" value="' + @oper_id + '"></parameter>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="last_seq_no" value="' + LTRIM(STR(@seq_no)) + '"></parameter>'
    SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '</parameters></request>'

    INSERT INTO dx_queue (inserted_at, activity_type, details) VALUES (@job_end_utc, 0, @queue_detail)

    --Added by Raghu on 02/22/2003. (HD# 570) Auto Job Start after the current job is being ended
    IF (@check_auto_job_start <> 0)  EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartNextJob @user_id, @ent_id, @job_pos, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @check_privs
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_consumption
-- Description:  Returns the consumption for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  lp			2023-07-25		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  lp			2023-08-30		   Added extra condition for Liquor blend
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_consumption_BeanData] as
begin
    Declare @row_id int, @ent_id int, @storage_locn VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON


	BEGIN TRY
	declare @itemgrp nvarchar(40), @nibslot nvarchar(40), @nibsSublot nvarchar(40), @nibsConsQty float, @nibsOrder nvarchar(40),@nibsTotalCons float

	SET @ent_id = -1


	--Ap: 22-Feb-2023 - added filter for pack class, also beans are excluded, it will be reported as part of nibs.
    SELECT TOP 1	@row_id = ic.row_id,
					@ent_id = ic.from_ent_id, 
					@itemgrp=ia.attr_value, 
					@nibslot=ic.lot_no, 
					@nibsSublot=ic.sublot_no, 
					@nibsTotalCons = qty_cons,
					@nibsConsQty=qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0),
					@nibsOrder = ic.wo_id
	  
	  FROM				item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	  INNER join		item i	WITH (NOLOCK)   		on ic.item_id = i.item_id
	  INNER JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia with(nolock)			ON ia.item_id=i.item_id 
															AND ia.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
															AND ia.attr_value not like '%BEANS'
															AND (  ic.oper_id like '%Roasting') -- 0.01.01
    -- LEFT JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia1 with(nolock)			ON ia1.item_id=i.item_id	-- (KN 21Jul23 - Get only items which don't have the attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set for them)
														--	AND ia1.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting')
	 LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK)
															ON ie.item_id = i.item_id 
															AND ie.wo_id = ic.wo_id	--(KN 28Jun23 - Added join condition to return rows based on work order)

		WHERE	qty_cons_erp < qty_cons 
				AND i.item_class_id <> UPPER('PACK')
				AND (
				(UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('WIP') OR (UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('INTERMEDIATE')) AND IA.attr_VALUE LIKE '%NIBS'  or IA.attr_VALUE LIKE '%liquor' )-- 0.01.01
				--or  (UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('WIP') AND UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('INTERMEDIATE'))
				)	---Pick WIP item only if it is NIBS
				AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1  AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
				
	 
		ORDER by ic.created_at_local asc




	
			BEGIN

					print 'nibs'

					IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#beansConsRows') IS NOT NULL
						BEGIN
						DROP TABLE #beansConsRows
						END

					----------------
					--AP: 23-FEB; BEANS Reporting on nibs consumption
					------------
					DECLARE  @NibsProdQty float,@NibsConsPercent float, @beansRowId int=-1, @beansQty float,@qty_cons_erp float,@beans_already_reported float
					

					--Step 1 - find out total nibs produced in the given sublot and how much percentage nibs are getting consumed
						select @NibsProdQty = sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),  @NibsConsPercent = case when round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod),3)>1 then 1 
						else round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),3) end
						from item_prod ip with(nolock)
						where ip.lot_no=@nibslot and ip.sublot_no=@nibsSublot


					--Step 2 Find out total beans consumed, and beans to be reported based on the consumed nibs percentage

					Declare @totalBeanCons float,@created_at_local datetime, @beansQtyToBeReported float, @beansDeclared float
					set @beansDeclared=0
					select @totalBeanCons= Sum(ic.qty_cons),@beans_already_reported=sum(qty_cons_erp) from item_cons ic with(nolock) -- (KN 21-Apr Finding Beans consumption from item_cons)
					where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot--and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp

					SET @beansQtyToBeReported = round(@totalBeanCons * @NibsConsPercent,3)

					--Step 3 - Get all the relevent consumption record in temp table 

					select qty_cons,qty_cons_erp,lot_no,sublot_no,row_id,  spare1,  spare3, created_at_local,fg_lot_no, fg_sublot_no
						into #beansConsRows
					from item_cons with(nolock)

				--	where  DATEDIFF(ss,@created_at_local,created_at_local)<=60
					where fg_lot_no=@nibslot and fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp and CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float)=0
					--select @beansQtyToBeReported, @totalBeanCons, @NibsConsPercent,  @NibsProdQty
					
				--	select * from #beansConsRows
					
					While @beansQtyToBeReported > @beansDeclared AND (@beansQtyToBeReported - @beansDeclared)>0.001
					begin 

						IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#tempBeansConsRows') IS NOT NULL
						BEGIN
						DROP TABLE #tempBeansConsRows
						END
						
												SET @beansRowId = -1;

							select top 1 @beansRowId=row_id,@beansQty = qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@created_at_local=created_at_local 
							from #beansConsRows ic with(nolock)
							where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot 
							and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp and CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)=0
							and isnull(spare3,'0') <>'-1'
							order by created_at_local asc
							
							--select @beansRowId

							Declare @spare1 float;
							
							select qty_cons,qty_cons_erp,lot_no,sublot_no,row_id,  spare1   into #tempBeansConsRows
							from #beansConsRows with(nolock)
							where  DATEDIFF(ss,@created_at_local,created_at_local)<=180
							and fg_lot_no=@nibslot and fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp and CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float)=0
							and isnull(spare3,'0') <>'-1'
							 select @spare1=CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float) from #tempBeansConsRows
							 
							 IF  @spare1<>0.0
							 BEGIN
							 select * from #tempBeansConsRows 
							 END

				
							declare @totalBeansForConsRows float, @totalSAPForConsRows float, @beanreportedper float

							select @totalBeansForConsRows =sum(qty_cons), @totalSAPForConsRows=sum(qty_cons_erp) from #tempBeansConsRows
					
							--Calculate ratio for beans
							Update #tempBeansConsRows set spare1 = case when (((@beansQtyToBeReported-@beansDeclared)/@totalBeansForConsRows)*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
																			then (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
																		else (((@beansQtyToBeReported-@beansDeclared)/@totalBeansForConsRows)*qty_cons) 
																		end
													--	, spare3='-1'
							--Total how much reported 
							declare @cycleSum float
							select @cycleSum = sum(CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float)) from #tempBeansConsRows
							set @beansDeclared = @beansDeclared+@cycleSum

								update #beansConsRows
								set spare1 = s.spare1
								from #beansConsRows ic
								inner join #tempBeansConsRows s on
								ic.row_id = s.row_id
								SELECT * FROM #tempBeansConsRows
					end

					update item_cons
					set spare1 = s.spare1
					from item_cons ic with(nolock)
					inner join #beansConsRows s on
					ic.row_id = s.row_id

					UPDATE ITEM_CONS SET qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @nibsConsQty WHERE row_id = @row_id
			END



	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

-- ==========================================================================================
-- Author:		Wilwin Lewis
-- Create date: 01-09-2017
-- Description:	The SP created a session in scheduler exec for the actual Schedule and returns the session.
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Modification History
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Date			Version		Author		Change 
-- 2017-11-27	1.0			WL			First Draft

-- 2018-07-23	1.2			WL			Added @callfromscreen for call from backgroundjob or screen
--										Added [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_ExecCustomFunc] for RealTimeValidation
-- 2018-07-25	1.3			AP			Added MQTT Notification part
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CreateUpdate_Actual_Schedule]
(
@scheduledDay nvarchar(50)
,@user_name nvarchar(50)
,@callfromscreen bit null -- call session resequence only when not called from screen
,@ActualSession int output

)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @release_sessionid int,
@sessionid int,
@sessionstate int

select top 1 @release_sessionid =  (session_id), @sessionstate = [status] from sdb..scheduler_sessn where status in (3,4) and 
scheduler_date = @scheduledDay order by status desc, last_edit_date desc
-- Created a new session based on data for @session_id

IF(@sessionstate is not null)
BEGIN

		IF(@sessionstate = 3) 
			BEGIN
				insert into SDB.dbo.scheduler_sessn
										([scheduler_date]
										,[created_date]
										,[last_edit_date]
										,[last_user]
										,[status])
									VALUES
										(@scheduledDay
										,getdate()
										,getdate()
										,@user_name
										,4)

					SELECT @sessionid = max(s.session_id) FROM SDB.dbo.scheduler_sessn s WHERE s.scheduler_date = @scheduledDay


			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @sessionid = @release_sessionid
			END

				

		IF @callfromscreen = 0 or @callfromscreen is null  
		BEGIN

			-- Pass new session to the SP
			EXECUTE  [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ScheduleData]    @user_name  , @sessionid


			EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ScheduleJobDistribution_SetUpTime_ALL_RuleTypes_Integrated] 
			   @sessionid
			  ,@user_name


			EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_ExecExtendFunc] @SessionId = @sessionid   ,@User_Name = @user_name  ,@functionType = 'RealTimeValidation',  @runatloadorder = null

			DECLARE @mqttNotification as nvarchar(max)
			SELECT @mqttNotification = COALESCE( @mqttNotification + CAST(res_grp_id as nvarchar(10)) + '_' +  CAST(ValidationCount as nvarchar(10)) + ',', '') 
			from 
			(SELECT		Count(SSV.row_id) AS validationCount,  rge.res_grp_id
			FROM		[SDB].[SCH].[scheduler_session_validation] SSV with (nolock)
			INNER JOIN	[SDB].[DBO].[scheduler_exec] SE with (nolock) ON SSV.session_id = se.session_id and se.session_id=@sessionid
			AND			SE.wo_id = SSV.wo_id and se.oper_id = ssv.oper_id and se.job_seq_no = ssv.job_seq_no 
			INNER JOIN  SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent rge WITH(NOLOCK) ON rge.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
			GROUP BY	rge.res_grp_id) as a

			IF LEN(@mqttNotification) > 0
			BEGIN

				DECLARE @filePath varchar(1000)
				SET @filePath='C:\ExecutePythonFile.bat'
				--SET @result = '108'
				SET @filePath=@filePath+' "'+@mqttNotification+'"'
				exec xp_cmdshell @filePath, no_output
			END
		
		END


		 set @ActualSession =  @sessionid
		 END
		 ELSE
		 set @ActualSession =  NULL
 

 
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_step_grp_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[job_step_grp]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - job_step_grp
-- Description       -  (HD# 2570) Disallows any changes are made to step_grp_seq and repeatability
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/16/2002
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@wo_id			NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no			INT,
	@step_grp_id		INT,
	@new_step_grp_seq	INT,
	@new_repeatability	INT,
	@old_step_grp_seq	INT,
	@old_repeatability	INT,
	@last_edit_by		STRING40

	IF UPDATE(step_grp_seq) OR UPDATE(repeatability) BEGIN
		DECLARE job_step_grp_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
			SELECT b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.step_grp_id, b.step_grp_seq, b.repeatability
			FROM job_step_grp a, inserted b
			WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id
			  AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
			  AND a.seq_no = b.seq_no
			  AND a.step_grp_id = b.step_grp_id

		OPEN job_step_grp_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM job_step_grp_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_grp_id
				,@new_step_grp_seq, @new_repeatability

			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			SELECT @old_step_grp_seq = step_grp_seq, @old_repeatability = repeatability
			FROM DELETED
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_grp_id = @step_grp_id

			IF (@old_step_grp_seq <> @new_step_grp_seq) OR (@old_repeatability <> @new_repeatability) BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK), job_step js WITH (NOLOCK), job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND jsd.step_no = js.step_no
						  AND js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
						  AND jsd.wo_id = @wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = @seq_no
						  AND (jsg.step_grp_seq > @new_step_grp_seq  OR (jsg.step_grp_seq = @new_step_grp_seq AND jsg.step_grp_id >= @step_grp_id))) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Steps with the lower step grp seq_no or step_grp_id of this step group are already started{3891}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
			END
		END
		CLOSE job_step_grp_cursor
		DEALLOCATE job_step_grp_cursor
	END

	UPDATE job_step_grp SET job_step_grp.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_step_grp.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE job_step_grp.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_step_grp.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_step_grp.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_step_grp.step_grp_id = i.step_grp_id
END

CREATE     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_Sublot_For_Export]
        (@sublot NVARCHAR(50))
		RETURNS NVARCHAR(40)
AS BEGIN
    DECLARE @sublotNo NVARCHAR(10);

    IF LEN(ISNULL(@sublot, '')) <= 10
    BEGIN
        SET @sublotNo = @sublot
    END

CREATE   FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_s_ofi_processbyprodsupervisor] (@prod_supervisor
NVARCHAR(1700))
returns NVARCHAR(40)
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @process_id NVARCHAR(40)=NULL

	  -- Get Process Id for 'ProductionSupervisor' Attribute
      SELECT @process_id = pa.process_id FROM process_attr pa WITH (nolock)
      INNER JOIN attr a WITH (nolock) ON a.attr_id = pa.attr_id AND a.attr_desc = 'ProductionSupervisor'
		AND a.attr_grp = 8 AND pa.attr_value = @prod_supervisor

      RETURN @process_id
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_UnPull]
  (@sample_id int)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -  Sp_U_Sample_UnPull
-- Description	      -  Update a sample record setting the sample as not pulled
-- Author	      -  Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created	      -	03/02/2011
-- Version	      -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 07/27/2012	Raghu		Update sample status
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF EXISTS (
		 --Their are results for a characteristic of the sample collected
		  SELECT TOP 1 1
		  FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id AND superseded = 0
	)
   BEGIN
         RAISERROR('Cannot unpull the sample because it has characteristic for which results have been collected.{7165}', 16, 1)
         RETURN -1
   END
   ELSE IF Exists (
	     SELECT TOP 1 1
		 FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
		 WHERE s.sample_id = @sample_id and s.final = 1
   )
   BEGIN
         RAISERROR('Cannot unpull a sample that is final.{7166}', 16, 1)
         RETURN -1
   END
   ELSE IF Exists (
	     SELECT TOP 1 1
		 FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
		 WHERE s.sample_id = @sample_id and s.pulled_by IS NULL and s.pulled_time_utc IS NULL
   )
   BEGIN
         RAISERROR('Cannot unpull this sample because it has not been pulled.{7273}', 16, 1)
         RETURN -1
   END
   ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE sample
			SET pulled_by = null,
				pulled_time_local = null,
				pulled_time_utc = null
			WHERE 	(sample_id = @sample_id)

			EXEC sp_U_Sample_UpdateStatus @sample_id = @sample_id, @sample_un_pulled=1, @sample_result=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value = NULL
    END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_entity_status_data]
AS
SELECT util_exec.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       ent.description,
       util_exec.cur_state_cd,
       util_state.state_desc,
       util_state.color,
       util_exec.cur_reas_cd,
       util_reas.reas_desc,
       util_exec.cur_reas_start_utc,
       util_exec.cur_reas_start_local,
       curr_util.duration,
       util_exec.target_util,
       COALESCE(cur_shift_util.current_utilization, 1) current_util,
       util_exec.jobstart_reas_cd,
       util_exec.jobend_reas_cd,
       util_exec.shift_start_reas_cd,
       util_exec.shift_end_reas_cd,
       util_exec.unkn_stop_reas_cd,
       util_exec.spare1,
       util_exec.spare2,
       util_exec.spare3,
       util_exec.spare4
FROM util_exec util_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state util_state  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_exec.cur_state_cd = util_state.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_exec.cur_reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT current_util.ent_id, SUM(CASE WHEN current_util.runtime = 1 THEN current_util.duration ELSE 0 END) /
				((SUM(CASE WHEN current_util.runtime = 1 THEN current_util.duration ELSE 0 END)) + (SUM(CASE WHEN current_util.downtime = 1 THEN current_util.duration ELSE 0 END)) + 0.0 ) current_utilization
	FROM
		(SELECT vuht.ent_id, CASE WHEN vuht.event_time_utc < util_shift_events.cur_shift_start_time_utc
							THEN vuht.duration - DATEDIFF(SS, vuht.event_time_utc, util_shift_events.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
							ELSE vuht.duration END duration
			, vuht.runtime, vuht.downtime
		FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN
			(SELECT ue.ent_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
			, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = ue.ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc <= e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
				, (SELECT MIN(uh.event_time_utc) FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = ue.ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc >= e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)) event_time_utc_start
			FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT sh.ent_id, MAX(sh.shift_start_utc) cur_shift_start_time_utc
					FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL
					GROUP BY sh.ent_id) e ON ue.ent_id = e.ent_id
			) util_shift_events ON vuht.ent_id = util_shift_events.ent_id AND vuht.event_time_utc >= util_shift_events.event_time_utc_start
		WHERE vuht.runtime = 1 OR vuht.downtime = 1
		)  current_util
	GROUP BY current_util.ent_id
	) cur_shift_util ON util_exec.ent_id = cur_shift_util.ent_id
OUTER APPLY (SELECT vwh.duration
		FROM vw_util_history_times vwh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE vwh.ent_id = util_exec.ent_id
		  AND vwh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = util_exec.ent_id)) curr_util

			[reqd_grade_cd] [dbo].[INT32_NULL]            NULL,
