			[qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT]          NULL,
			[max_qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL] NULL,
			[min_qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL] NULL,
			[recipe_reqd_qty_per] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]     NULL,
			[uom_description] [dbo].[STRING80]            NULL,
			[job_qty_reqd] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]            NULL,
			[last_wo]                                     NVARCHAR(40) NULL,
			[last_oper]                                   NVARCHAR(40) NULL,
			[last_seq] [dbo].[INT32]                      NULL,
			[material_type] [dbo].[STRING40]              NULL,
			[is_cakeblender_running] [dbo].[INT32]        NULL,
			[num_decimals] [dbo].[INT32]                  NULL,
			[color]                                       NVARCHAR(40),
			[comp_item_id] [dbo].[STRING40]               NULL,
			[qty_reqd] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]                NULL
		);
	
	DECLARE @job_qty_reqd [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]
	DECLARE @AlreadyExists_mod_id           VARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @AlreadyUsed                    VARCHAR(2)
	DECLARE @lastWo_id                      NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	DECLARE @lastOper_id                    NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	DECLARE @lastSeqNo                      INT          = NULL
	DECLARE @defaultUOMID                   INT
	DECLARE @savedRecipe [STRING1000_NULL] =NULL
	DECLARE @recipeVer                      INT
	DECLARE @savedRecipeVer                 INT
	DECLARE @isCakeBlenderRunning           INT
	DECLARE @state_cd                       INT
	SELECT @recipeVer = version
	FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
	IF (@recipe_name ='Last used recipe')
	BEGIN
		SET @showLastRecipe=1
	END
	--#01.04 [changes for qty remaining]
	--select top 1 @job_qty_reqd = qty_reqd,@state_cd = state_cd from job with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and  oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no;
	SELECT TOP 1 @job_qty_reqd = CASE
									 WHEN (qty_reqd-qty_prod)<0
										 THEN 0
									 ELSE (qty_reqd-qty_prod)
								 END ,
				 @state_cd = state_cd
	FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id     =@wo_id
		AND oper_id = @oper_id
		AND seq_no  = @seq_no;
	
	SELECT @defaultUOMID = uom_id
	FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description = 'KG';
	
	IF (@oper_id      = 'CakeBlending'
		AND @state_cd = 3)
		SET @isCakeBlenderRunning = 1
	ELSE
		SET @isCakeBlenderRunning = 0;
	--fetching the saved saved recipe version from job
	SELECT @savedRecipe=spare1
	FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id            =@wo_id
		AND oper_id        =@oper_id
		AND seq_no         = @seq_no
		AND bom_pos        =0
	SELECT @savedRecipeVer = version
	FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE recipe_name = @savedRecipe
	IF (@recipeVer<>''
		AND @recipeVer IS NOT NULL )
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @bom_item_t
		EXEC sp_SA_Bom_Item @parent_item_id    =@parent_item_id,
							@ver_id            = @recipeVer,
							@bom_pos           =NULL,
							@item_id           =NULL,
							@reqd_grade_cd     =NULL,
							@update_inv        =NULL,
							@backflush         =NULL,
							@def_reas_cd       =NULL,
							@def_storage_ent_id=NULL,
							@def_reject_ent_id =NULL,
							@serial_no_source  =NULL,
							@spare1            =NULL,
							@spare2            =NULL,
							@spare3            =NULL,
							@spare4            =NULL,
							@last_edit_by      =NULL,
							@last_edit_at      =NULL
		--update b1
		--set b1.qty_per_parent_item = case when b1.uom_description = 'MT' then round(b1.qty_per_parent_item,3) else round(b1.qty_per_parent_item,2) end
		--, b1.min_qty_per_parent_item = case when b1.uom_description = 'MT' then round(b1.min_qty_per_parent_item,3) else round(b1.min_qty_per_parent_item,2) end
		--,  b1.max_qty_per_parent_item = case when b1.uom_description = 'MT' then round(b1.max_qty_per_parent_item,3) else round(b1.max_qty_per_parent_item,2) end
		--from @bom_item_t b1 where  bom_pos <>0
		INSERT INTO @bom_item2
		SELECT 	a.bom_pos,
				a.item_id,
				a.item_desc,
				a.reqd_grade_cd,
				a.item_grade_desc,
				CASE 
					WHEN a.qty_per_parent_item  < 0.00003
						THEN a.qty_per_parent_item
					ELSE
						a.qty_per_parent_item * 100
				END AS qty_per_parent_item,
				CASE
					WHEN a.max_qty_per_parent_item < 0.00003
						THEN a.max_qty_per_parent_item
					ELSE
						a.max_qty_per_parent_item * 100
				END AS max_qty_per_parent_item,
				CASE
					WHEN a.min_qty_per_parent_item < 0.00003
						THEN a.min_qty_per_parent_item
					ELSE
						a.min_qty_per_parent_item * 100
				END AS min_qty_per_parent_item,
				CASE
					WHEN a.recipe_reqd_qty_per < 0.00003
						THEN a.recipe_reqd_qty_per
					ELSE
						a.recipe_reqd_qty_per * 100
				END AS recipe_reqd_qty_per,				
				a.uom_description,
				a.job_qty_reqd,
				a.last_wo,
				a.last_oper,
				a.last_seq,
				a.material_type,
				a.is_cakeblender_running,
				a.num_decimals,
				a.color,
				a.comp_item_id,
				CASE
					WHEN a.uom_description='MT'
						THEN ROUND(((job_qty_reqd * qty_per_parent_item)/1000)/100,ISNULL(num_decimals,3)) -- Updated on v2
					ELSE
						ROUND((job_qty_reqd * qty_per_parent_item)/100,ISNULL(num_decimals,3)) -- Updated on v2
				END AS qty_reqd
		FROM (   SELECT
					--bi.parent_item_id,
					--bi.ver_id,
					bi.bom_pos,
					bi.item_id,
					bi.item_desc,
					bi.reqd_grade_cd,
					item_grade.item_grade_desc,
					ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,bi.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)     , ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,bi.max_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) , ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) max_qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,bi.min_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) , ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) min_qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,bi.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)     , ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) recipe_reqd_qty_per, -- till the time he saves this values will be same as qty_per_parent_item
					--bi.uom_id,
					bi.uom_description,
					@job_qty_reqd                                                                                                                                                              AS job_qty_reqd,
					@lastWo_id                                                                                                                                                                 AS last_wo,
					@lastOper_id                                                                                                                                                               AS last_oper,
					@lastseqNo                                                                                                                                                                 AS last_seq,
					ia.attr_value                                                                                                                                                              AS material_type,
					@isCakeBlenderRunning                                                                                                                                                      AS is_cakeblender_running,
					item.num_decimals                                                                                                                                                          AS num_decimals,
					dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color)                                                                                                                                  AS color, --01.07 passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
					CONCAT(bi.item_id,bi.reqd_grade_cd)                                                                                                                                        comp_item_id
				FROM @bom_item_t                                                                                                                                                               bi
					INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK)        ON item.item_id                  = bi.item_id
					LEFT JOIN ITEM_ATTR ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id                    = item.item_id
						AND ia.attr_value                                                = 'FERT'
					LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_grade.item_grade_cd = bi.reqd_grade_cd
				WHERE bom_pos                                                            <>0
					AND bi.spare2                                                        = 'Active' ) a
	END
	ELSE
		IF (@showLastRecipe=1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @lastWo_id = wo_id,
			@lastOper_id        = oper_id,
			@lastseqNo          = seq_no
		FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE run_ent_id = @ent_id
			AND item_id  = @parent_item_id
			AND state_cd = 4
		ORDER BY act_finish_time_utc DESC
		INSERT INTO @bom_item2
		SELECT jb.bom_pos,
			jb.item_id,
			item.item_desc,
			jb.reqd_grade_cd,
			item_grade.item_grade_desc,
			-- jb.qty_per_parent_item,
			-- need to check,whether below conversion is reqired for last saved recipe
			ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)     * multiplier.mul_qty, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) qty_per_parent_item,
			ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.max_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * multiplier.mul_max, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) max_qty_per_parent_item,
			ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.min_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * multiplier.mul_min, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) min_qty_per_parent_item,
			ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)     * multiplier.mul_qty, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) recipe_reqd_qty_per, -- till the time he saves this values will be same as qty_per_parent_item
			--item.uom_id,
			--jb.qty_per_parent_item,
			--jb.min_qty_per_parent_item,
			--jb.max_qty_per_parent_item,
			--jb.qty_per_parent_item recipe_reqd_qty_per,
			(   SELECT description
				FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE uom_id = item.uom_id)                                                                                                                                             AS uom_description,
			@job_qty_reqd                                                                                                                                                               AS job_qty_reqd,
			@lastWo_id                                                                                                                                                                  AS last_wo,
			@lastOper_id                                                                                                                                                                AS last_oper,
			@lastseqNo                                                                                                                                                                  AS last_seq,
			--ROUND(jb.qty_reqd,3) qty_reqd
			ia.attr_value                                                                                                                                                               AS material_type,
			@isCakeBlenderRunning                                                                                                                                                       AS is_cakeblender_running,
			item.num_decimals                                                                                                                                                           AS num_decimals,
			dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color)                                                                                                                                   AS color, --01.07 passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
			CONCAT(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd)                                                                                                                                         comp_item_id,
			NULL                                                                                                                                                                        AS qty_reqd -- need to calculated based on the current job,
		FROM job_bom jb WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK)             ON item.item_id             = jb.item_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_grade.item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
			LEFT JOIN ITEM_ATTR ia WITH(NOLOCK)      ON ia.item_id               = item.item_id
				AND ia.attr_value                                                = 'FERT'
			CROSS APPLY
					(   SELECT 	CASE
									WHEN ISNULL(jb.qty_per_parent_item, 0) < 0.00003
										THEN 1
									ELSE 100
								END AS mul_qty
								,CASE
									WHEN ISNULL(jb.max_qty_per_parent_item, 0) < 0.00003
										THEN 1
									ELSE 100
								END AS mul_max
								,CASE
									WHEN ISNULL(jb.min_qty_per_parent_item, 0) < 0.00003
										THEN 1
									ELSE 100
								END AS mul_min 
					) AS multiplier 
		WHERE jb.wo_id                                                           =@lastWo_id
			AND jb.oper_id                                                       =@lastOper_id
			AND jb.bom_pos                                                       <>0
			AND jb.seq_no                                                        =@lastseqNo
		-- updating the qty_required
		-- check if we need below condition
		UPDATE @bom_item2
		SET
			qty_reqd= CASE
						  WHEN uom_description='MT'
							  THEN ROUND(((job_qty_reqd * qty_per_parent_item)/1000)/100,ISNULL(num_decimals,3)) -- Updated on v2
						  ELSE
							  ROUND((job_qty_reqd * qty_per_parent_item)/100,ISNULL(num_decimals,3)) -- Updated on v2
					  END
		WHERE bom_pos <>0
	END
	--fetch the last used recipe details--
	IF (@showLastRecipe=1)
	BEGIN
		--<<fecting the wo and seq details for last used recipe for same operation >>
		-- add the code if last used recipe exists in the job bom table against that work order-- handle this
		IF EXISTS
			(   SELECT 1
			FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id     =@wo_id
				AND oper_id =@oper_id
				AND seq_no  = @seq_no
				AND bom_pos =0
				AND spare1  = @recipe_name)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 	jb.bom_pos,
					jb.item_id,
					item.item_desc,
					jb.reqd_grade_cd,
					item_grade.item_grade_desc,
					ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * multiplier.mul_qty, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) AS qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.max_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * multiplier.mul_max, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) AS max_qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.min_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * multiplier.mul_min, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) AS min_qty_per_parent_item,

					--ROUND(jb.qty_per_parent_item     * multiplier.mul_qty, ISNULL(item.num_decimals, 3)) AS qty_per_parent_item,
					--ROUND(jb.max_qty_per_parent_item * multiplier.mul_max, ISNULL(item.num_decimals, 3)) AS max_qty_per_parent_item,
					--ROUND(jb.min_qty_per_parent_item * multiplier.mul_min, ISNULL(item.num_decimals, 3)) AS min_qty_per_parent_item,
					bi.qty_per_parent_item                                                                      AS recipe_reqd_qty_per,
					(   SELECT description
						FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE uom_id = item.uom_id )                                                            AS uom_description,
					@job_qty_reqd                                                                               AS job_qty_reqd,
					@lastWo_id                                                                                  AS last_wo,
					@lastOper_id                                                                                AS last_oper,
					@lastseqNo                                                                                  AS last_seq,
					ia.attr_value                                                                               AS material_type,
					@isCakeBlenderRunning                                                                       AS is_cakeblender_running,
					item.num_decimals                                                                           AS num_decimals,
					dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color)                                                   AS color,
					CONCAT(jb.item_id, jb.reqd_grade_cd)                                                        AS comp_item_id,
					ROUND(jb.qty_reqd, ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3))                                                                      AS qty_reqd
			FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = jb.item_id
				LEFT JOIN item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_grade.item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
				LEFT JOIN @bom_item2 bi ON jb.item_id = bi.item_id
													AND ISNULL(jb.reqd_grade_cd, -1) = ISNULL(bi.reqd_grade_cd, -1)
				LEFT JOIN ITEM_ATTR ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = item.item_id
														AND ia.attr_value = 'FERT'
				CROSS APPLY
					(   SELECT 	CASE
									WHEN ISNULL(jb.qty_per_parent_item, 0) < 0.00003
										THEN 1
									ELSE 100
								END AS mul_qty
								,CASE
									WHEN ISNULL(jb.max_qty_per_parent_item, 0) < 0.00003
										THEN 1
									ELSE 100
								END AS mul_max
								,CASE
									WHEN ISNULL(jb.min_qty_per_parent_item, 0) < 0.00003
										THEN 1
									ELSE 100
								END AS mul_min 
					) AS multiplier 
					WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
						AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
						AND jb.bom_pos <> 0
						AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no		
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- fetch all the records from @bom_item2 as it is already storing the last used order details
			SELECT *
			FROM @bom_item2
		END
	END
	--if record already exists in the database
	ELSE
		IF (EXISTS
		(   SELECT 1
		FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id     =@wo_id
			AND oper_id =@oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND bom_pos <>0 )
	AND (@recipeVer = @savedRecipeVer))
	BEGIN
		--print '----1'
		--#01.04 [changes for qty remaining]
		-- required qty for component is now being calulated based on remaining required qty
		SELECT a.bom_pos,
			a.item_id,
			a.item_desc,
			a.reqd_grade_cd,
			a.item_grade_desc,
			CASE 
				WHEN a.qty_per_parent_item  < 0.00003
					THEN a.qty_per_parent_item
				ELSE
					a.qty_per_parent_item * 100
			END AS qty_per_parent_item,
			CASE
				WHEN a.max_qty_per_parent_item < 0.00003
					THEN a.max_qty_per_parent_item
				ELSE
					a.max_qty_per_parent_item * 100
			END AS max_qty_per_parent_item,
			CASE
				WHEN a.min_qty_per_parent_item < 0.00003
					THEN a.min_qty_per_parent_item
				ELSE
					a.min_qty_per_parent_item * 100
			END AS min_qty_per_parent_item,
			a.recipe_reqd_qty_per,
			a.uom_description,
			a.job_qty_reqd,
			a.last_wo,
			a.last_oper,
			a.last_seq,
			a.material_type,
			a.is_cakeblender_running,
			a.num_decimals,
			a.color,
			a.comp_item_id,
			CASE
				WHEN a.uom_description='MT'
					THEN ROUND(((job_qty_reqd * qty_per_parent_item)/1000)/100,ISNULL(num_decimals,3)) -- Updated on v2
				ELSE
					ROUND((job_qty_reqd * qty_per_parent_item)/100,ISNULL(num_decimals,3)) -- Updated on v2
			END AS qty_reqd
		FROM (   SELECT jb.bom_pos,
					jb.item_id,
					item.item_desc,
					jb.reqd_grade_cd,
					item_grade.item_grade_desc,
					ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL), ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3))     qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.max_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL), ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) max_qty_per_parent_item,
					ROUND( [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.min_qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL), ISNULL(item.num_decimals,3)) min_qty_per_parent_item,
					bi.qty_per_parent_item                                                                                                                                                recipe_reqd_qty_per,
					(   SELECT description
						FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE uom_id = item.uom_id)                                                                                                                                       AS uom_description,
					@job_qty_reqd                                                                                                                                                         AS job_qty_reqd,
					@lastWo_id                                                                                                                                                            AS last_wo,
					@lastOper_id                                                                                                                                                          AS last_oper,
					@lastseqNo                                                                                                                                                            AS last_seq,
					ia.attr_value                                                                                                                                                         AS material_type,
					@isCakeBlenderRunning                                                                                                                                                 AS is_cakeblender_running,
					item.num_decimals                                                                                                                                                     AS num_decimals,
					dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color)                                                                                                                             AS color, --01.07 passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
					CONCAT(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd)                                                                                                                                   comp_item_id
					--#01.04	--ROUND(jb.qty_reqd,3) qty_reqd
					--ROUND(bi.qty_reqd,3) qty_reqd
				FROM job_bom jb WITH(NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK)        ON item.item_id             = jb.item_id
					LEFT JOIN item_grade WITH (NOLOCK)  ON item_grade.item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
					LEFT JOIN ITEM_ATTR ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id               = item.item_id
						AND ia.attr_value                                           = 'FERT'
					LEFT JOIN @bom_item2 bi ON jb.item_id                           = bi.item_id
						AND ISNULL(jb.reqd_grade_cd,-1)                             = ISNULL(bi.reqd_grade_cd,-1) -- compare grade as well and grade is null then comparing with -1
				WHERE jb.wo_id                                                      =@wo_id
					AND jb.oper_id                                                  =@oper_id
					AND jb.bom_pos                                                  <>0
					AND jb.seq_no                                                   =@seq_no ) a
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT *
		FROM @bom_item2
	END
END

-- Procedure definition
-- this procedure is called from sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_BOM
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJobBOMStep]
	@wo_id string40,
	@oper_id string40,
	@seq_no int,
	@BOM_pos int,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@paused_job_state	INT32 = 5
,@job_pos		INT32 = 0
,@status_notes		STRING2000_NULL = NULL
,@event_time_local  	TDATETIME = NULL
,@job_end_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs
-- Description	      - Pause a Job/OR pause a batch of jobs
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.18
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 08/08/2017   Sara        5.3 Remove the event_time_utc variable as it was defined, but never assigned to.
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
-- 09/14/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 1082564 - As SE, I want to merge in hotfixes related to Sample Generation
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	 @Concurrent_Link		INT32
	,@current_job_pos		INT32
	,@ret				INT32
	,@current_jobs_state_cd		INT32

	,@batch_job_wo_id		STRING40
	,@batch_job_oper_id		STRING40
	,@batch_job_seq_no		INT32
	,@batch_job_state_cd		INT32
	,@batch_job_run_ent_id		INT32
	,@batch_job_concurrent_link	INT32
	,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

BEGIN
	--Apply all defaults. Default the bias value if not supplied.
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0), @job_pos = COALESCE(@job_pos, 0), @paused_job_state = COALESCE(@paused_job_state, 5)

	--Apply all defaults. Default the bias value if not supplied.
	IF (@job_end_utc IS NULL AND @event_time_local IS NOT NULL)
		--Use the job_start_utc if supplied (override the event_time_local time)
		SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, @current_time_utc)

	--Default the job end utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
	SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_end_utc, @current_time_utc))

	--Verify whether the job end time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_end_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_end_utc = @current_time_utc

	--Retrieve the status of the current job, and concurrent link no. to identify whether the current job is linked to a batch or not.
	--Verify whether the current job to pause is linked to a batch.
	SELECT @current_jobs_state_cd = state_cd, @concurrent_link = concurrent_link FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	IF (@concurrent_link = 0) BEGIN
		--Since the current job is not linked to a batch, just start the job that is currently supplied.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=@paused_job_state
			, @job_pos=@job_pos, @status_notes=@status_notes, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

		--Remove Samples (if applicable) for the job that was just paused/ended.
		EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = @ent_id, @event_time_utc = @job_end_utc
			,@event_type = 201, @freq_of_sample_update = 0
			,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value

		--As soon as the current job is paused, just RETURN
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied job is currently running.
	IF (@current_jobs_state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		--The supplied (identified) job is currently running on the supplied entity.
		--Retrieve the job position of the supplied job that is running.
		EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCurrJobPos @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no,
			@job_pos=@current_job_pos OUTPUT
	END

	--Pause the supplied job that is currently running.
	EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=@paused_job_state
		, @job_pos=@current_job_pos, @status_notes=@status_notes, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

	--If the return value is not success, then return.
	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	--Loop through all the jobs and pause all the linked jobs in a batch.
	DECLARE job_batch_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, state_cd, run_ent_id, concurrent_link
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE state_cd = @current_jobs_state_cd AND run_ent_id = @ent_id AND concurrent_link = @concurrent_link

	OPEN job_batch_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM job_batch_cursor INTO @batch_job_wo_id, @batch_job_oper_id, @batch_job_seq_no,
			@batch_job_state_cd, @batch_job_run_ent_id, @batch_job_concurrent_link
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Get the job position of this job that is currently running on this entity.
		EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCurrJobPos @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@batch_job_wo_id, @oper_id=@batch_job_oper_id,
			@seq_no=@batch_job_seq_no, @job_pos=@current_job_pos OUTPUT

		--If we don't find a job position, then skip this job.
		IF (@current_job_pos >= 0) BEGIN
			--Pause the current job that is currently running.
			EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@batch_job_wo_id, @oper_id=@batch_job_oper_id, @seq_no=@batch_job_seq_no
				, @paused_job_state=@paused_job_state, @job_pos=@current_job_pos, @status_notes=@status_notes
				, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

			--If the return value is not success, then return.
			IF (@ret = -1) RETURN
		END
	END
	CLOSE job_batch_cursor
	DEALLOCATE job_batch_cursor

	--Remove Samples (if applicable) for the jobs that were just paused/ended.
	EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = @ent_id, @event_time_utc = @job_end_utc
		,@event_type = 201, @freq_of_sample_update = 0
		,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_oper_step_getoperforstps]
(
	@process_id     STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id        STRING40_NULL = NULL

)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_OPER_STEP_GETOPERFORSTPS
-- Description          -  Get operation steps for a process based on various supplied filters.
-- Author          -    Raghu
-- Date Created          -    10/01/2007
-- Version          - 3.3.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver  Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

    --Verify whether a value for process_id and oper_id is supplied.
    IF (@process_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        --Return a list of processes and operations that are different than the supplied one.
        SELECT DISTINCT process_id, oper_id
        FROM oper_step
        WHERE process_id <> @process_id AND oper_id <> @oper_id
        ORDER BY process_id, oper_id
    END ELSE BEGIN
        --Either process_id, oper_id or both are null.
        IF @process_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
            --If a valid process_id is supplied, BEGIN return all processes other than the supplied process.
            SELECT DISTINCT process_id
            FROM oper_step WHERE process_id <> @process_id
            ORDER BY process_id
        END ELSE IF @oper_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
            --If a valid oper_id is supplied, BEGIN return all operations other than the supplied operation.
            SELECT DISTINCT oper_id
            FROM std_oper_step
            WHERE oper_id <> @oper_id
            ORDER BY oper_id
        END ELSE BEGIN
            --Both process_id and operation_id are null. Return an empty row to the client.
            SELECT process_id, oper_id
            FROM oper_step
            WHERE process_id IS NULL
        END
    END

END

   0.01.01	CK			2023-03-01			Added Order by , added ISNULL for updated by
   0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-03-05          Updated the substring.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_lm_customer_info] 	
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0
	, @current_time	DATETIME 
	, @counter INT
	, @attr_val NVARCHAR(40);

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 );
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	SELECT @attr_val = attr_value 
	FROM system_attr sa
	WHERE sa.grp_id = 301 AND sa.attr_desc = 'Image Path'
	SET @counter = LEN(@attr_val);

    SELECT lci.cust_row_id
		  ,lci.cust_name
		  ,lci.cust_img_path as cust_img_path_actual
		  ,lci.cust_info
		  ,CASE WHEN lci.is_active=1 THEN 'Y'
				ELSE 'N'
				END AS is_active
		  ,lci.is_deleted
		  ,ISNULL(lci.updated_on,lci.created_on) AS updated_on		 
		  ,ISNULL(lci.updated_on_utc,lci.created_on_utc) AS updated_on_utc
		  ,ISNULL(lci.updated_by,lci.created_by) AS updated_by
		  ,lci.created_by
		  ,lci.type_of_content
		  ,SUBSTRING(lci.cust_img_path, @counter+ 1, 200) as cust_img_path
	FROM ofi_lm_customer_info lci WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE lci.is_deleted=0	-- 0 Non deleted records
	ORDER BY ISNULL(updated_on_utc,created_on_utc) desc

-- ==========================================================================================
-- Author:		Wilwin Lewis
-- Create date: 01-09-2017
-- Description:	The SP created a session in scheduler exec for the actual Schedule and returns the session.
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Modification History
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Date			Version		Author		Change 
-- 2017-11-27	1.0			WL			First Draft

-- 2018-07-23	1.2			WL			Added @callfromscreen for call from backgroundjob or screen
--										Added [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_ExecCustomFunc] for RealTimeValidation
-- 2018-07-25	1.3			AP			Added MQTT Notification part
-- 2018-08-28	1.4			WL			Change SP_S_MDM_Sched_CreateUpdate_Actual_Schedule for Forecast
--										This will work with the Forecast Session created for the date
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CreateUpdate_Forecast_Schedule]
(
@scheduledDay nvarchar(50)
,@user_name nvarchar(50)
,@callfromscreen bit null -- call session resequence only when not called from screen
,@ActualSession int output

)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @release_sessionid int,
@sessionid int,
@sessionstate int

select top 1 @release_sessionid =  (session_id), @sessionstate = [status] from sdb..scheduler_sessn where status in (3,5) and 
scheduler_date = @scheduledDay order by status desc, last_edit_date desc
-- Created a new session based on data for @session_id

IF(@sessionstate is not null)
BEGIN

		IF(@sessionstate = 3) 
			BEGIN
				insert into SDB.dbo.scheduler_sessn
										([scheduler_date]
										,[created_date]
										,[last_edit_date]
										,[last_user]
										,[status])
									VALUES
										(@scheduledDay
										,getdate()
										,getdate()
										,@user_name
										,5) -- Forecast = 5

					SELECT @sessionid = max(s.session_id) FROM SDB.dbo.scheduler_sessn s WHERE s.scheduler_date = @scheduledDay


			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @sessionid = @release_sessionid
			END

				

		IF @callfromscreen = 0 or @callfromscreen is null  
		BEGIN

			-- Pass new session to the SP
			EXECUTE  [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ScheduleData_Forecast]    @user_name  , @sessionid


			EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Forecast_JobDistribution] 
			   @sessionid
			  ,@user_name


			
		
		END


		 set @ActualSession =  @sessionid
		 END
		 ELSE
		 set @ActualSession =  NULL
 

 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Can_Log_Data]
(@wo_id			NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no		INT
,@can_log_data		INT 		OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - sp_SA_Job_Can_Log_Data
-- Description	  - Given a wo_id, oper_id and seq_no, to find the init_sched entity or target sched entity
--			        (or its decendants) which can log data
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  -	01/14/2004
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @init_sched_ent_id	INT
	,@target_sched_ent_id	INT
	,@child_level		INT
	,@row_count		INT
DECLARE @ent_descents	TABLE (ent_id INT, child_level INT, parent_ent_id INT, can_log_data INT)

	SET @can_log_data = 0

	SELECT @init_sched_ent_id = init_sched_ent_id, @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM ent WHERE can_log_data = 1
			AND (ent_id = @init_sched_ent_id OR ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id)) BEGIN
		SET @can_log_data = 1
		RETURN
	END

	SET @child_level = 0

	INSERT INTO @ent_descents (ent_id, child_level, parent_ent_id, can_log_data)
	SELECT ent_id, @child_level, parent_ent_id, 0 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @init_sched_ent_id OR ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id

	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		INSERT INTO @ent_descents (ent_id, child_level, parent_ent_id, can_log_data)
		SELECT el.child_ent_id, @child_level, el.parent_ent_id, e.can_log_data FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN
			(SELECT ent_id FROM @ent_descents WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
		SET @row_count = @@rowcount
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM @ent_descents WHERE child_level = @child_level AND can_log_data = 1) BEGIN
			SET @can_log_data = 1
			RETURN
		END
		IF (@row_count <= 0) BREAK
	END
END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid] 
--Create Date:        2024-06-06 
--Author:             Yoga 
--Description:        <To Convert order id to Automation related order id. >
--
--Call by:            Common function; getting called from multiple SPs.                     
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid] ('81000127','BeanBulkIntake')
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2024-06-06          YG					1.0					First version
--2024-06-21		  YG					2.0					Major Update 
--																Simplest: Remove the first digit when the value is above a configured limit (2,100,000,000). And send to DCS.
--																a.	When message comes back from DCS; if the length of the value is equal to 9. You would need to query the MESDB to find the job that fits the logic:
--																	i.	_wo_id + oper + seq ran on the specific line receiving the message.
--																	ii.	If more than 1 job is found, pick the latest ran one as long as the WO is not Closed in SAP. (new)
--																	iii.	If only 1 job is found and WO is Closed in SAP; follow the current logic for that. (same as now I expect)
--																	iv.	If no job is found, give data error to DCS. (same as now I expect)
--																b.	Possible errors: that an 8 PuO and an 6 PuO contain the same 9 digits, or that new PuO contains the same 9 digits and are used in the same line. (Unlikely)
--2024-06-26		  YG					3.0					Set the @DCS_JOB_Max_Value configurable for equipment
--2025-02-18		  MC					3.1					New sorting way for segments handling 2 operations
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid]
(    
      @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	  @seq_no INT,
	  @ent_id INT
)
	RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  result INT, 
		  output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		  output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		  output_operid NVARCHAR(100), 
		  output_seqno INT
		)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DCS_JOB_Max_Value INT = 2100000000
	,@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits INT = 10
	,@DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty INT = 1
	,@Num_DigittoKeep INT
	,@NumberOfZerotoAdd INT
	,@String_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_Truncated_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_OperId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_SeqNo INT
	,@Area_Ent_Id INT
	,@result INT = 0
	,@DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value INT = NULL
	,@DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value INT = NULL

	-- Get Max Value (Plant Level)
	SELECT @DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value, ',','')) 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AUTMaxWONumber')
	AND ent_id = (SELECT TOP 1 ent_id
					  FROM   ent (nolock)
					  WHERE  parent_ent_id IS NULL
					  ORDER  BY ent_id)

	-- Get Max Value (Segment Level)
	SELECT @DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value, ',','')) 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AUTMaxWONumber')
	AND ent_id = @ent_id

	-- Set the max value with segment value as the priority
	SET @DCS_JOB_Max_Value = COALESCE(@DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value,@DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value)

	--Get Area From Segment Id
	SELECT @Area_Ent_Id=parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)

	--#1 wo_id more than max_number and length of wo_id is equal with max_length_of_wo_id
	IF LEN(@wo_id) = @DCS_JOB_Max_Digits AND CONVERT(BIGINT,@WO_ID) > @DCS_JOB_Max_Value
	BEGIN
		--Get Right Side Digit
		SET @Num_DigittoKeep = @DCS_JOB_Max_Digits-@DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty;
		SET @String_WoId = RIGHT(@wo_id,@Num_DigittoKeep);

		--Set The Truncated Wo
		SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @String_WoId

		--Get The OperId and SeqNo
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_SeqNo = j.seq_no, @Output_OperId = j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id)
		ORDER BY row_id DESC
	END
	ELSE IF (LEN(@WO_ID)=@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty) -- #2 length of wo_id is equal with the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated 
	BEGIN
		--Manipulated String 
		SET @String_WoId = CONCAT(REPLICATE('_', @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty), @WO_ID);
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
 
		--Get The Correct Order From The List
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_WoId=j.wo_id,@Output_OperId=j.oper_id, @Output_SeqNo=j.seq_no FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		WHERE j.wo_id LIKE @String_WoId and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
		GROUP BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no
		ORDER BY max(job_start_utc) DESC
	END
	ELSE IF LEN(@WO_ID)<@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty --#3 and #4 length is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated 
	BEGIN
		--Validate SAP/MES order
		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND spare1 is NULL)) --#4 length of wo_id is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated (MES order)
		BEGIN
			--Set output wo, it is a manual order
			SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
			SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
			SET @Output_SeqNo = @seq_no

			SELECT TOP 1 @Output_OperId=j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
			ORDER BY row_id DESC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Number of 0
			SET @NumberOfZerotoAdd = (@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty) - LEN(@WO_ID) --#3 length of wo_id is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated (SAP order)

			--Manipulated String 
			SET @String_WoId = CONCAT('_',REPLICATE('0',@NumberOfZerotoAdd), @WO_ID);
			SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id

			--Get The Correct Order From The List
			SELECT TOP 1 @Output_WoId=j.wo_id,@Output_OperId=j.oper_id, @Output_SeqNo=j.seq_no FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
			WHERE j.wo_id LIKE @String_WoId and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
			GROUP BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no
			ORDER BY max(job_start_utc) DESC
		END
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		-- Get wo_id, seq_no
		SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_SeqNo = @seq_no

		-- Get oper_id
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_OperId=j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
		ORDER BY COALESCE(jh.job_start_utc, j.act_start_time_utc) DESC --3.1 new sorting way for segments handling 2 operations
	END

	IF (@Output_WoId IS NULL or @Output_OperId is NULL or @Output_SeqNo IS NULL or @Output_Truncated_WoId IS NULL)
		SET @result = 0 -- Dont continue for the next step
	ELSE
		SET @result = 1 -- continue

    INSERT INTO @Output (result, output_woid, output_truncated_woid, output_operid, output_seqno)
		VALUES (@result, @output_woid, @output_truncated_woid, @output_operid, @output_seqno) ;

    RETURN ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_UpdateStatus]
(@sample_id				INT32 = NULL
,@sample_un_pulled		LOGICAL = 0
,@sample_result		INT32 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_U_Sample_UpdateStatus
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      	  - RaghuG
-- Date Created	      -	02/10/2011
-- Version	          - 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver.		Changes
-- 07/17/2012	  RaghuG			Re-wrote this SP.
-- 03/19/2013     Saiteja.K			Added Changes for CR L00125519
-- 07/18/2014	  Abhay Pandey   5.0		MOL: As Invensys, I want to merge L00132398 (HF CR L00132095: If Warning Time expires after a sample is generated it not changes from DUE to DUE_LATE)
-- 06/09/2016	  Varun			5.3   US#594228 : Excluded Samples that are Missed, Complete or Complete Late to improve performance
-- 07/10/2017  Srinivas    6.0   US#830369--CR#L00145808 to merge HF CR#L00145564 : Added fix for HF-L00145564, added condition for "not monitored" characteristic to update the sample result
-- 09/22/2017     Jim O'        6.0  US#838473-- modified the update statement, when processing without an initial sample id, to not override a sample whose status is completed with an in-progress status to mitigate any race condition due to a dirty read
-- 01/23/2019     Jim O'        6.1  US#1120684-- hot fix merge CR L00151781:  Anwar 6.0  HF Merge CR L00151433: As part of the fix added the code to update the sample result from OOS to Good once all its related results are in limit.
-- 06/18/2020	Raghu	6.2	US:1330922 - As Lenka, I want to analyze and address performance issues with QM web API methods
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	 @current_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@requested_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@expiry_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@warning_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@pulled_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@sample_status		INT32
	,@final			LOGICAL

BEGIN

	SELECT @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ), @sample_un_pulled = COALESCE(@sample_un_pulled, 0)

	--Verify whether a sample ID is supplied or not.
	--If not, handle the samples that are currently 'Ready', 'Ready Warning', and 'Missed'
	IF (@sample_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--2=READY WARNING: the current time is less than or equal to the expiration time, the sample pulled time is NULL,
		--the current time is greater than the sample requested time plus the warning interval (which is not null), and there are no results
		--3=MISSED: the current time is greater than the sample expiration time, the sample pulled time is NULL, and there are no results
		--5=LATE: Verify whether the sample status falls under the LATE state and update the sample status.
		--the current time is greater than the expiration time, there are not yet enough results for every characteristic,
		--and either the sample pulled time is NOT NULL or there is at least one result
		; WITH sample_status_late AS
		(SELECT DISTINCT scl.sample_id
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
			INNER JOIN sample s WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
			WHERE (s.sample_status = 1 OR s.sample_status = 2 OR s.sample_status = 4)
				AND s.final = 0
			AND COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size
		)
		, cur_sample_status AS
		(SELECT s.sample_id AS samp_id
		, CASE WHEN s.sample_status <> 4 AND s.expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc <= s.expiry_time_utc AND s.pulled_time_utc IS NULL
				AND @current_time_utc > s.requested_time_utc
				AND s.warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc >= s.warning_time_utc
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = s.sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)
			THEN 2
			  WHEN s.sample_status <> 4 AND s.expiry_time_utc IS NULL AND s.pulled_time_utc IS NULL
				AND @current_time_utc > s.requested_time_utc
				AND s.warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc >= s.warning_time_utc
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = s.sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)
			THEN 2
			 WHEN s.sample_status <> 4 AND s.expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc > s.expiry_time_utc AND s.pulled_time_utc IS NULL
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = s.sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)
			THEN 3
			 WHEN s.sample_status = 4 AND s.expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc > s.expiry_time_utc
				AND (s.pulled_time_utc IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = s.sample_id AND r.superseded = 0))
				AND sssl.sample_id IS NOT NULL
			THEN 5
		  	WHEN s.sample_status = 4 AND (s.expiry_time_utc IS NULL OR @current_time_utc < s.expiry_time_utc)
		    	THEN 4
		 	ELSE 1
			 END AS samp_status
		FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_status_late sssl ON s.sample_id = sssl.sample_id
		WHERE (s.sample_status = 1 OR s.sample_status = 2 OR s.sample_status = 4)
		  AND s.final = 0
		)
		UPDATE sample
		SET sample_status = CASE WHEN sample_status = 6 and cur_sample_status.samp_status = 4 THEN sample_status ELSE cur_sample_status.samp_status END
		FROM cur_sample_status
		WHERE sample.sample_id = cur_sample_status.samp_id
		  AND sample.sample_status <> cur_sample_status.samp_status
	END -- sample_id is NOT supplied

	-- A sample ID is supplied.
	-- Update the sample status for a sample (i.e. single sample).
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Get the requested time, expiry time, warning time and status from the supplied sample.
		SELECT @requested_time_utc = s.requested_time_utc, @warning_time_utc = s.warning_time_utc, @expiry_time_utc = s.expiry_time_utc
			, @pulled_time_utc = s.pulled_time_utc, @sample_status = s.sample_status, @final = s.final
		FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE s.sample_id = @sample_id

		IF (@final <> 1 AND @sample_status NOT IN (3, 8)) BEGIN
 	 		UPDATE sample
 	 		SET sample_result=COALESCE(@sample_result, sample_result)
 	 		WHERE sample_id=@sample_id
		END

		--Verify whether the sample is finalized, missed, complete, complete late OR cancelled, and if so, exit.
		IF (@final = 1 OR @sample_status IN (3, 6, 7, 8)) RETURN

		--Put back the sample to the appropriate sample status if the sample is un-pulled.
		IF (COALESCE(@sample_un_pulled, 0) = 1) AND @sample_status IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
			UPDATE sample
			SET sample_status = cur_sample_status.sample_status
			FROM (SELECT s.sample_id, CASE WHEN s.expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc <= s.expiry_time_utc AND s.pulled_time_utc IS NULL
							AND @current_time_utc > s.requested_time_utc
							AND s.warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc >= s.warning_time_utc
							AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = s.sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)
							THEN 2
						 WHEN s.expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc > s.expiry_time_utc AND s.pulled_time_utc IS NULL
				 			AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = s.sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)
				 			THEN 3
						 ELSE 1
						 END AS sample_status
				FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
				) cur_sample_status
			WHERE sample.sample_id = cur_sample_status.sample_id

		SET @sample_status = NULL

		--4=IN-PROGRESS
		--Verify whether the sample status falls under the IN-PROGRESS state and update the sample status
		--the current time is greater than or equal to the requested time and less than or equal to the expiration time,
		--there are not yet enough results for at least one characteristic,
		--and either the sample pulled time is NOT NULL or there is at least one result
		IF @current_time_utc >= @requested_time_utc
			AND ((@expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc <= @expiry_time_utc) OR @expiry_time_utc IS NULL)
			AND (@pulled_time_utc IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)) BEGIN

			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
					INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
					WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
					  AND COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size
				   )

				SET @sample_status = 4
		END -- IN-PROGRESS STATE

		--5=LATE
		--Verify whether the sample status falls under the LATE state and update the sample status.
		--the current time is greater than the expiration time, there are not yet enough results for every characteristic,
		--and either the sample pulled time is NOT NULL or there is at least one result
		IF (@sample_status IS NULL) BEGIN
			IF @expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc > @expiry_time_utc
				AND (@pulled_time_utc IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id AND r.superseded = 0)) BEGIN

				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
						FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
						INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
						WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
						  AND COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size
					   )
					SET @sample_status = 5
			END
		END -- LATE STATE

		--6=COMPLETE
		--Verify whether the sample status falls under the COMPLETE state and update the sample status.
		--the time at which the minimum number of original results in the sample was recorded (using the earliest created_at time for each value_no)
		--is less than or equal to the sample expiration time and there are enough results for every characteristic
		IF (@sample_status IS NULL) BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
					   FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
					   INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
					   INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
					   INNER JOIN
						   (SELECT scl.char_id, MAX(res.created_at_utc) last_orig_result, COALESCE(MAX(res.rownumb), 0) no_of_results
							FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
							INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
							LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT r.char_id, r.created_at_utc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.char_id ORDER BY r.created_at_utc) AS rownumb
										 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
										 WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id AND r.superseded = 0
									) res ON scl.char_id = res.char_id
							WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
							  AND COALESCE(res.rownumb, 0) <= COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size)
							GROUP BY scl.char_id
						   ) samp_results ON scl.char_id = samp_results.char_id
					   WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
					     AND ( (c.type = 0 AND COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > samp_results.no_of_results)
							OR (c.type <> 0 AND COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size)
						OR (samp_results.last_orig_result > @expiry_time_utc OR samp_results.last_orig_result IS NULL)
						)
				   )
				SET @sample_status = 6
		END
		-- COMPLETE STATE

		--7=COMPLETE LATE
		--Verify whether the sample status falls under the COMPLETE LATE state and update the sample status.
		--the time at which at least one original result in the sample at
		--or below the minimum number was recorded is greater than the expiration time and there are enough results for every characteristic
		IF (@sample_status IS NULL AND @expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
				   FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
				   INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
				   INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
				   INNER JOIN
					   (SELECT scl.char_id, MAX(res.created_at_utc) last_orig_result, COALESCE(MAX(res.rownumb), 0) no_of_results
						FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
						INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
						LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT r.char_id, r.created_at_utc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.char_id ORDER BY r.created_at_utc) AS rownumb
									 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
									 WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id AND r.superseded = 0
								) res ON scl.char_id = res.char_id
						WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
						  AND COALESCE(res.rownumb, 0) <= COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size)
						GROUP BY scl.char_id
					   ) samp_results ON scl.char_id = samp_results.char_id
				   WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
				     AND ((c.type = 0 AND NOT COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > samp_results.no_of_results)
				       OR (c.type <> 0 AND NOT COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size))
				     AND samp_results.last_orig_result > @expiry_time_utc
				   )

				SET @sample_status = 7
		END
		-- COMPLETE LATE STATE

		-- Update sample result if a non-null value is supplied and if the sample status does not fit into any of the categories above.
		 IF( (select count(*) from result s WITH (NOLOCK) where sample_id = @sample_id) <> 0 )
 		        UPDATE sample
 		        SET sample_status = COALESCE(@sample_status, sample_status), sample_result = COALESCE(@sample_result, sample_result)
 		        WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
 		ELSE
			UPDATE sample
			SET sample_status = COALESCE(@sample_status, sample_status), sample_result = COALESCE(@sample_result, sample_result)
			WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
			  AND (sample_status <> COALESCE(@sample_status, sample_status) OR sample_result <> COALESCE(@sample_result, sample_result))

	END -- Sample ID is supplied
END

-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-21         Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-04-27         Updated for CR588
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Check_Request_Type] (@module     NVARCHAR(40),
                                             @plant_code NVARCHAR(40),
											 @wo_id      NVARCHAR(40),
											 @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_id    NVARCHAR(40),
                                             @spare1     NVARCHAR(200),
                                             @spare2     NVARCHAR(200),
                                             @spare3     NVARCHAR(200),
                                             @spare4     NVARCHAR(200))
AS
	BEGIN
      
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
           FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
           WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND state_cd = 0
                  AND @erp_wo_status = 'CLOSED')
		BEGIN
			PRINT @wo_id
			EXEC Sp_d_wo
			@wo_id,
			NULL
		END
		-- v 0.02.00
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
           FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
           WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				EXEC dbo.sp_I_Wo_Attr

					@mod_id OUT

				UPDATE wo 
				SET state_cd = 3 
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

			END
		END 

	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Storage_Exec_GetInventry]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@include_moveable_entities	LOGICAL = 0
,@last_edit_by 			NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@last_edit_at			DATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value 		INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Storage_Exec_GetInventry
-- Description	      -	By default, this method returns all inventory rows pertained to the supplied entity.
--			If @include_moveable_entities is set to true, then the returned recordset also includes
--			the inventory row of the storage_entity of the supplied entity.
--			The loop is recursed till it finds the last storage area. (HD# 4952)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	09/15/2004
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.12
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 02/01/2005     SJ           21012    HD#5267 - Include relevant uom.description in result set
--02/11/2005	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
--02/14/2005	Raghu		2.1.13	Undo the changes done for HD# 5267 - the resultset already returns the uom.description and abbreaviation
--09/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--11/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	HD# 6192, Include inv_item_attr, inv_lot_attr columns in the recordset.
--02/08/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	HD# 8249, Part of DB Changes
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change inv_item_attr_item_id to inv_item_attr_item_id_h.
-- 12/22/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	@ent_level  INT32
DECLARE @inv_ents  TABLE (ent_id INT, ent_level INT)
BEGIN
  IF (@include_moveable_entities IS NULL)
    SET @include_moveable_entities = 0

  SET @ent_level = 1
  SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

  INSERT INTO @inv_ents (ent_id, ent_level)
    VALUES (@ent_id, @ent_level)

  IF (@include_moveable_entities = 1)
  BEGIN
    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
      SET @ent_level = @ent_level + 1
      INSERT INTO @inv_ents (ent_id, ent_level)
	SELECT storage_ent_id, @ent_level FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	  WHERE ent_id = (SELECT ent_id FROM @inv_ents WHERE ent_level = @ent_level -1)
	    AND storage_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @inv_ents) -- Use the NOT IN to ignore repeated ents
      IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0)
        BREAK
    END
  END

  SELECT item_inv.ent_id
		, ent.ent_name
		, ent.description
		, item_inv.item_id
		, item.item_desc
		, item_inv.lot_no
        , item_inv.sublot_no
		, item_inv.grade_cd
		, item_grade.item_grade_desc
		, item_grade.color AS item_grade_color
		, item_inv.status_cd
		, item_state.item_status_desc
		, item_state.color AS item_state_color
		, item_inv.qty_left
		, item_inv.qty_left_erp
		, item_inv.uom_id
		, uom.description AS uom_description
		, uom.abbreviation
        , item_inv.date_in_utc
        , item_inv.date_in_local
		, item_inv.date_in_utc as 'date_in'
		, item_inv.date_out_utc
        , item_inv.date_out_local
		, item_inv.date_out_utc as 'date_out'
		, item_inv.expiry_date
		, item_inv.wo_id
		, item_inv.oper_id
		, item_inv.seq_no
		, item_inv.spare1
		, item_inv.spare2
		, item_inv.spare3
		, item_inv.spare4
		, item_inv.spare5
		, item_inv.spare6
		, item_inv.last_edit_comment
		, item_inv.last_edit_by
		, item_inv.last_edit_at
		, item_inv.row_id
        , CASE WHEN item_inv.uom_id IS NULL THEN (SELECT description from uom with (nolock) where uom_id = item.uom_id)
             ELSE (SELECT description from uom with (nolock) where uom_id = item_inv.uom_id) END uom_desc
		, iia.*,ila.*
	FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent ent ON item_inv.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN item item ON item_inv.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON item_inv.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON item_inv.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
	INNER JOIN @inv_ents inv_ents ON item_inv.ent_id = inv_ents.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom ON item_inv.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_item_attr iia ON iia.inv_item_item_id_h=item_inv.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila ON ila.inv_lot_item_id_h=item_inv.item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h=item_inv.lot_no
	WHERE ((item_inv.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
	  AND (item_inv.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name, item.item_desc, item_grade.item_grade_desc
END
