--===========================================================================================
-- Name:      [sp_S_ofi_master_recipe_param]
-- Description:    The stored procedure fetchs the recipe parameter details from recipe name and  and item_id
--                
-- Usage:        
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version    Author            Date (yyyy-MM-dd)    Change description
-- 0.01       DS                2022-07-24           Initial version.
-- 0.02       DS                2023-04-03           Modified for new column based on the new design
-- 0.03       DS                2023-06-01           #206 -  Set up UI: Setting the target value for the default equipment parameters where no recipe is applicable
-- 0.04       DS                2023-07-06           incorporated the step completion based parameter retrival logic
-- 0.05       DS                2023-07-13           #206 - modified for fetching the recipe[default\last used] details when recipe is not applicable 
-- 0.06       MH                2025-07-09           [CR 00181477 / Changelog #68] Fix "Load default parameters" not working
-- 0.07       DD                2025-10-29           [CR 00214152 / Changelog #76] Recipe Parameters in the SETUP UI will displayed according to the display sequence as set in spec table
-- ==========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_master_recipe_param](
--declare
    @parent_item_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
, @ver_id nvarchar(40) = NULL -- now passing recipe name
, @wo_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
, @oper_id nvarchar(80) = NULL
, @seq_no int
, @ent_id int = NULL --
, @ddparam nvarchar(20)
, @recipe_name nvarchar(80)
, @load_equip_params int
, @sourceTrg nvarchar(40) -- dropdownRecipe / dropdownParam 

) AS
    --select @parent_item_id=N'100000041420', 
--@ver_id=N'LUP', 
--@wo_id=N'80000055', 
--@oper_id=N'ButterFiltering', 
--@seq_no=0, 
--@ent_id=248, 
--@ddparam=N'LUP', 
--@recipe_name=NULL, 
--@load_equip_params=1, 
--@sourcetrg=N'dropdwonParam'


DECLARE @lastWo_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
DECLARE @lastOper_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
DECLARE @lastSeqNo int = NULL
DECLARE @defaultUOMID int
DECLARE @savedRecipe [STRING1000_NULL] =NULL
DECLARE @version INT
DECLARE @recipeVer int
DECLARE @showLastRecipe bit = 0

DECLARE @isStepCompleted int =0


DECLARE @lastUsedSpec AS table (
    spec_id      STRING40,
    spec_desc    STRING80,
    min_value    STRING80   NULL,
    recipe_value STRING1700 NULL,
    target_value STRING1700 NULL,
    max_value    STRING80   NULL,
    Unit         STRING40   NULL,
    row_id       INT,
    savedRecipe  STRING80   NULL
)

BEGIN

    -- Get the recipe parameter details  

    --#0.04
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            js.step_name,
            ISNULL(jsd.state_cd, 0) AS state_cd,
            js.step_no,
            js.spare1,
            js.spare2 AS step_name_localized
        FROM job_step js WITH (NOLOCK)
            LEFT JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id
                AND js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id
                AND js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no
                AND js.step_no = jsd.step_no
        WHERE js.wo_id = @wo_id
            AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
            AND JS.seq_no = @seq_no
            AND jsd.state_cd = 4
            AND step_name = 'Set Parameter'
    )
        SET @isStepCompleted = 1 ----#0.04


    SELECT @savedRecipe = spare1
    FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        AND oper_id = @oper_id
        AND seq_no = @seq_no
        AND bom_pos = 0

    SELECT @version = version
    FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE recipe_name = @savedRecipe

    SELECT @recipeVer = version
    FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name

    IF (@recipe_name = 'Last used recipe')
    BEGIN
        SET @recipeVer = -1
        SET @showLastRecipe = 1
    END

    IF (@load_equip_params <> 1)
    BEGIN
        IF (@showLastRecipe = 1)
        BEGIN
            IF (@isStepCompleted = 1) --#0.04
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    js.spec_id,
                    spec.spec_desc,
                    js.min_value,
                    js.act_spec_value AS recipe_value,
                    js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                    js.max_value,
                    spec.units AS Unit,
                    --'' AS [product_dependent],
                    --'' AS [comments],
                    --'' AS [spare1],
                    --'' AS [spare2],
                    --'' AS [spare3],
                    --'' AS [spare4],
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                    @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
                FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] WITH (NOLOCK)
                        ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                    AND oper_id = @oper_id
                    AND seq_no = @seq_no
                    AND step_no = -1
					ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SELECT TOP 1
                    @lastWo_id = wo_id,
                    @lastOper_id = oper_id,
                    @lastseqNo = seq_no
                FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE run_ent_id = @ent_id
                    AND item_id = @parent_item_id
                    AND state_cd = 4
                ORDER BY act_finish_time_utc DESC

                SELECT 
                    js.spec_id,
                    spec.spec_desc,
                    js.min_value,
                    js.act_spec_value AS recipe_value,
                    js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                    js.max_value,
                    spec.units AS Unit,
                    --'' AS [product_dependent],
                    --'' AS [comments],
                    --'' AS [spare1],
                    --'' AS [spare2],
                    --'' AS [spare3],
                    --'' AS [spare4],
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                    @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
                FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] WITH (NOLOCK)
                        ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
                WHERE wo_id = @lastWo_id
                    AND oper_id = @lastOper_id
                    AND seq_no = @lastseqNo
                    AND step_no = -1
					ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
            END
        END
        -- [CR 00181477 / Changelog #68]
        -- - Fix 'Load default parameters' not working
        -- MH: LDP here means "load default parameters", and "LUP" means "last used parameters"
        
        -- ELSE IF (@isStepCompleted = 1) --#0.04
        ELSE IF (@isStepCompleted = 1 AND @ddparam != 'LDP') --#0.06
        -- [/CR 00181477 / Changelog #68]
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                js.spec_id,
                spec.spec_desc,
                js.min_value,
                js.act_spec_value AS recipe_value,
                js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                js.max_value,
                spec.units AS Unit,
                --'' AS [product_dependent],
                --'' AS [comments],
                --'' AS [spare1],
                --'' AS [spare2],
                --'' AS [spare3],
                --'' AS [spare4],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
            FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                 INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                AND oper_id = @oper_id
                AND seq_no = @seq_no
                AND step_no = -1
				ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
        END
        ELSE IF (@recipe_name <> 'Last used recipe' AND @sourceTrg = 'dropdwonParam' AND @ddparam = N'LUP')
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1
                @lastWo_id = wo_id,
                @lastOper_id = oper_id,
                @lastseqNo = seq_no
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE run_ent_id = @ent_id
                AND item_id = @parent_item_id
                AND state_cd = 4
            ORDER BY act_start_time_utc DESC

            SELECT
                js.spec_id,
                spec.spec_desc,
                js.min_value,
                js.act_spec_value AS recipe_value,
                js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                js.max_value,
                spec.units AS Unit,
                --'' AS [product_dependent],
                --'' AS [comments],
                --'' AS [spare1],
                --'' AS [spare2],
                --'' AS [spare3],
                --'' AS [spare4],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
            FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
            WHERE wo_id = @lastWo_id
                AND oper_id = @lastOper_id
                AND seq_no = @lastseqNo
                AND step_no = -1
				ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152

        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                mrp.[spec_id],
                spec.spec_desc AS spec_desc,
                mrp.[min_value],
                mrp.[spec_value] AS recipe_value,
                mrp.[spec_value] AS target_value,
                mrp.[max_value],
                spec.units AS Unit,
                --mrp.[product_dependent],
                --mrp.[comments],
                --mrp.[spare1],
                --mrp.[spare2],
                --mrp.[spare3],
                --mrp.[spare4],

                -- [CR 00181477 / Changelog #68]
                -- - Fix 'Load default parameters' not working; make default parameters sorted properly
                -- mrp.[row_id],
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mrp.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                -- [/CR 00181477 / Changelog #68]
                @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
            FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe_parameter] mrp WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON spec.spec_id = mrp.spec_id
            WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
                AND item_id = @parent_item_id
				ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
        END
    END
    ELSE -- case when set parameters is first tab and fetching the values from equipment attribute
    BEGIN
        --  p1 begins this section executes irrespective of any sroucetrg value
        IF (@ddparam = 'LUP' OR @savedRecipe = 'LUP')
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1
                @lastWo_id = wo_id,
                @lastOper_id = oper_id,
                @lastseqNo = seq_no
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE run_ent_id = @ent_id
                AND item_id = @parent_item_id
                AND state_cd = 4
            ORDER BY act_finish_time_utc DESC

            INSERT INTO @lastUsedSpec
            SELECT 
                js.spec_id,
                spec.spec_desc,
                js.min_value,
                js.act_spec_value AS recipe_value,
                js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                js.max_value,
                spec.units AS Unit,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
            FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
            WHERE wo_id = @lastWo_id
                AND oper_id = @lastOper_id
                AND seq_no = @lastseqNo
                AND step_no = -1
				ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
        END
        -- p1 ends

        IF (@sourcetrg = N'parametersTabIsFirstTab' AND @isStepCompleted = 1)
        BEGIN
            IF (@savedRecipe = 'LUP')
            BEGIN
                SELECT
                    js.spec_id,
                    spec.spec_desc,
                    js.min_value,
                    lup1.target_value AS recipe_value, ---  target values/act_spec_value of last used saved param will be the recipe value of current wo params
                    js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                    js.max_value,
                    spec.units AS Unit,
                    --'' AS [product_dependent],
                    --'' AS [comments],
                    --'' AS [spare1],
                    --'' AS [spare2],
                    --'' AS [spare3],
                    --'' AS [spare4],
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                    @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
                FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] spec WITH (NOLOCK)
                        LEFT JOIN @lastUsedSpec lup1
                            ON lup1.spec_id = spec.spec_id
                        ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND step_no = -1
				  ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
            END
            ELSE -- it will be default parameter
            BEGIN
                SELECT js.spec_id,
                       spec.spec_desc,
                       js.min_value,
                       spec.spare3 AS recipe_value, --- spare 3 of spec table is the target values
                       js.act_spec_value AS target_value,
                       js.max_value,
                       spec.units AS Unit,
                       --'' AS [product_dependent],
                       --'' AS [comments],
                       --'' AS [spare1],
                       --'' AS [spare2],
                       --'' AS [spare3],
                       --'' AS [spare4],
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY js.spec_id) AS [row_id],
                       @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
                FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] spec WITH (NOLOCK)
                        ON spec.spec_id = js.spec_id
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                    AND oper_id = @oper_id
                    AND seq_no = @seq_no
                    AND step_no = -1
					ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC -- 0.07 DD change CR 00214152
            END
        END
        ELSE IF (@sourcetrg = N'dropdwonParam' AND @ddparam = 'LUP')
        BEGIN
            SELECT * FROM @lastUsedSpec
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                spec_id,
                spec_desc,
                spare1 AS min_value,
                spare3 AS recipe_value,
                spare3 AS target_value, --spare 3 of spec table is the target values
                spare2 max_value,
                spec.units AS Unit,
                spec.row_id,
                @savedRecipe AS savedRecipe
            FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON attr.attr_id = ea.attr_id AND attr.attr_desc = 'EntityGroup'
                INNER JOIN [dbo].[spec] AS spec WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON ea.attr_value = spec.grp_id
            WHERE ea.ent_id = @ent_id
            ORDER BY spec.display_seq ASC
        END
    END --- case when set parameters

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob] (
  @ent_id		integer
, @wo_id		nvarchar(40)
, @oper_id		nvarchar(40)
, @seq_no		integer
, @paused_job_state     integer
, @job_pos     integer = 0
, @status_notes         string2000_null = null
, @job_end_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
, @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob
-- Description	      - Pause a Job
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version	      -  1.6.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/19/2002	Raghu		1.4	Added Factory Connector Tags for resetting the values (for newly added tags in 1.4)
--10/03/2002	Raghu		1.4	Labor_Exec_New_Job doesnot passes correct parameters for wo_id, oper_id. Fixed to cur_wo_id, cur_oper_id
--10/22/2002	TC		1.5.0	Commented out call to copy data from job_bom_exec -> job_bom
-- 10/26/2002    TC                       1.5.0     Include job_pos as parameter and use it where relevant
--11/13/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	(HD# 1869) Removed Entity, Util, OEE related FC tags as these need not to be written on Job Change
--11/21/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Changed values from wo_id -> cur_wo_id, oper_id -> cur_oper_id, seq_no -> cur_seq_no and item_id -> Null when calling labor_exec_newjob
--12/03/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	(HD# 1300) Changed Idle to Null
-- 01/08/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 04/01/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Included Update condition to check FC Tags and update only if base entity is exposed
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     	1601  	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (TOP 1 ...)
--07/29/2003	Raghu		1.6.16	Modified TPM_STAT calls. First it updates qtys, current util, captures oee for the old job and finally creates a new for the new job in tpm_stat table
--09/04/2003	Raghu		2.0	Disallow updating of FC tags if the tag is not related to Job; eg: ProdScreen, JobScreen
--12/03/2003	Raghu		2.0.13	(HD# 4135) Spec download for MinValue and MaxValues supported - FC Tags
--08/09/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	HD# 4709, 4795 Update wo_attr, job_attr and item_attr tags for FC
--08/10/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	HD# 4711 Added Lifetime Factory Connector Output tag
--09/07/2005	Raghu		2.1.28	HD# 5933, Pause a job in a batch mode
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--03/20/2006	Raghu		3.1.12	HD# 4751, Added ValueLoadedTag(s) which returns the no. of specification values available.
--09/12/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.
--10/28/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00084282: DEADLOCK: LoadTests: Recvd. deadlocks,"An error occurred in Util_Exec.SetReason. Transaction (Process ID 67) was deadlocked on lock resources with another process ...".
--03/09/2011	Ibrahim		4.1.0	Added code to clear samples by calling the SP sp_U_Sample_GenSampForJob when previous job state is running.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
-- 07/17/2019	Varun		6.2	US#1191719: Merge CR L00154068(HF L00153800)- Pausing a job does not change the utilization code to what is configured for
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @cur_wo_id 		nvarchar(40)
	,@cur_oper_id 		nvarchar(40)
	,@cur_seq_no 		integer
	,@cur_step_no 		integer
	,@cur_step_start 	datetime
	,@cur_state_cd		INT32
	,@instance_info 		STRING254
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	,@job_end_reas_cd	INT32
	,@line_id		INT32
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254_NULL

BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_end_utc, @current_time_utc))

	--Verify whether the job end time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_end_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_end_utc = @current_time_utc

	--check  @paused_job_state has valid value, else default to SUSPENDED
	IF @paused_job_state != 1 and @paused_job_state != 2 and @paused_job_state != 4 and @paused_job_state != 5 and @paused_job_state != 6
		SET @paused_job_state = 5

	-- Read the current status for this ent to verify this action
	-- 10/26/2002    TC                       1.5.0     Include job_pos as parameter
	EXECUTE sp_S_Job_Exec_Cur_Status @ent_id, @job_pos, @cur_wo_id OUTPUT, @cur_oper_id OUTPUT,
		@cur_seq_no OUTPUT, @cur_step_no OUTPUT, @cur_step_start OUTPUT
	IF COALESCE(@cur_wo_id, '-WONDERWAREMES') != @wo_id or COALESCE(@cur_oper_id, '-WONDERWAREMES') != @oper_id or COALESCE(@cur_seq_no, -9999) != @seq_no
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @cur_wo_id = NULL, @cur_oper_id = NULL, @cur_seq_no = 0, @cur_step_no = NULL, @cur_step_start = NULL

	--Get the current status of the job
	SELECT @cur_state_cd = j.state_cd
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

	-- Update the Job_Exec table
	UPDATE 	job_exec
	SET cur_wo_id = @cur_wo_id
	, cur_oper_id = @cur_oper_id
	, cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	, cur_step_no = @cur_step_no
	, cur_step_start = @cur_step_start
	WHERE	ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('SQL Error updating current job data in job_exec table{3190}', 16, 1)
		RETURN @@error
	END

	-- Update the Job table
	UPDATE Job
	SET state_cd = @paused_job_state
	, status_notes = @status_notes
	, act_finish_time_utc = @job_end_utc
	, act_finish_time_local =  dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @job_end_utc)
	, last_edit_comment = COALESCE(last_edit_comment, '') + 'JobStartPauseEndAction'
	WHERE	wo_id = @wo_id and
		oper_id = @oper_id and
		seq_no = @seq_no
	-- Return error if this was not successful
	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('SQL Error updating job state data in job table{3191}', 16, 1)
		RETURN @@error
	END

	IF (@cur_state_cd = 3)
    		--If the job was actually running on the entity (i.e. with the state_cd = 3), then close off the job_history records
    		--Otherwise, the job was set to be ended from ready/new, etc. states (from SetWoStatus)
		EXEC sp_U_Job_History_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc
			, @last_edit_comment = 'JobExec.PauseJob', @job_pos=@job_pos

	SET @instance_info = ' Job = ' + @wo_id + '/' + @oper_id + '/' + STR(@seq_no)
	EXECUTE sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 4, @instance_info, 'sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob', '', 'Job Paused', null, null

	-- Determine whether this entity is capturing utilization and use configured job end code when pausing job
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_capture_util = 1) BEGIN
		--Determine whether there is any job start reason code configured.
		SELECT @job_end_reas_cd = ue.jobend_reas_cd FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ue.ent_id = @ent_id

		IF (@job_end_reas_cd IS NOT NULL)
			--Job end reason code is configured. Therefore, create a new utilization event
			EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@job_end_utc, @reas_cd=@job_end_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0
				, @comments=NULL, @raw_reas_cd=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
				, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
				, @last_edit_comment='JobExec.PauseJob(job end reason code)', @update_if_exists=1
				, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=NULL
	END

	--Modified by Raghu on 11/21/2002. Changed values from wo_id -> cur_wo_id, oper_id -> cur_oper_id, seq_no -> cur_seq_no and item_id -> Null
	EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewJob @ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, NULL, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @time_zone_bias_value

	-- Determine whether the entity belongs to a line and the rate change has to be logged.
	SELECT TOP 1 @line_id = lel.line_id
	FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND lel.line_is_child = 0

	-- If the entity is in a line, determine the rate change
	IF (@line_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @last_edit_comment = 'PauseJob(Ent=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@ent_id, -1)) + ',Wo=' + COALESCE(@wo_id, 'null') + ',Oper=' + COALESCE(@oper_id, 'null') + ',Seq=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@seq_no, -1)) + ')'
		EXEC sp_SA_Line_GetBottleneckEnts @line_id = @line_id, @log_prod_rates = 1, @start_time_utc = @job_end_utc, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Step_Grp]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @step_grp_id  int  ,
 @step_grp_seq  int,
 @repeatability int ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/20/2003	 Vijay		Now retrieved by step group sequence and ID
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT oper_step_grp.process_id
            ,oper_step_grp.oper_id
            ,oper_step_grp.step_grp_id
            ,oper_step_grp.step_grp_desc
            ,oper_step_grp.step_grp_seq
            ,oper_step_grp.repeatability
            ,oper_step_grp.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_step_grp.last_edit_by
            ,oper_step_grp.last_edit_at
  FROM oper_step_grp oper_step_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((oper_step_grp.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_step_grp.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_step_grp.step_grp_id = @step_grp_id OR @step_grp_id IS NULL) AND

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_u_ei_get_consumption_beans
-- Description:  Returns the bean consumption for SAP,not used anywhere
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  LK        2023-07-26		   Initial version.

-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ei_get_consumption_beans] 
@rowid int
as
begin
   DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

   Declare  @storage_locn VARCHAR(100),@ent_id int,@nibsOrder nvarchar(50)
   declare @itemgrp nvarchar(40), @nibslot nvarchar(40), @nibsSublot nvarchar(40), @nibsConsQty float,@nibsTotalCons float
   BEGIN TRY
   
   select @ent_id=ent_id,@nibslot=fg_lot_no,@nibsSublot=fg_sublot_no,@nibsOrder=wo_id from item_cons with(nolock) where row_id=@rowid
   SET @storage_locn = NULL
			SELECT @storage_locn = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation')
			IF @storage_locn is NULL
				SELECT @storage_locn = ent_name from ent with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id

	       BEGIN
					
						Select top 1 @nibsOrder Order_Number,
						   [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,
						   lot_no Batch_Number,
						   IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,ic.item_id,ia.attr_value) Material, 
						   ic.spare1 Quantity,
						   --qty_cons *  @NibsConsPercent Quantity,
						   u.description UOM,
						   '261' Movement_Type,
						   format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
							format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime,
						   @storage_locn Storage_Location,
						   '' Document_Number,
						   '' Message,
						   '' Message
					  from item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
						inner join item i WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.item_id = i.item_id and ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot
										
					  	left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
							on i.item_id = ia.item_id	
						left join uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
							on i.uom_id   = u.uom_id
						left join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
							on e.ent_id   = ic.ent_id

						where ic.row_id = @rowid 

						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp+ spare1,spare1=0 where row_id=@rowid

						
						-- If there are no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty
						--Update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id = @row_id
						PRINT 'no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty'
					END
						--end of beans cons reporting
	
			

	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CUD_Attr]
(

@id NVARCHAR(50), --Autonumeric
@name NVARCHAR(50),
@desc NVARCHAR(50),
@type NVARCHAR(50), --  Taken from table [SDB].[SCH].[attr_type]
@data_type NVARCHAR(50), -- char, date, float
@default_value NVARCHAR(50),
@data NVARCHAR(50),
@user_name NVARCHAR(50),
@row_id NVARCHAR(50),
@deleteFlag bit
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @RowAvailable int
DECLARE @MaxId int

select @RowAvailable = row_id from SDB.SCH.attr with (nolock) where row_id = @row_id

if @deleteFlag = 0
BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null 
						BEGIN
						--code for insert

									select @MaxId = ISNULL(max(id),0) + 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[attr] with (nolock)

									INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[attr]
											   ([id]
											   ,[name]
											   ,[desc]
											   ,[type]
											   ,[data_type]
											   ,[default_value]
											   ,[data]
											   ,[last_edit_date]
											   ,[last_edit_by])
										 VALUES
											   (@MaxId
											   ,@name
											   ,@desc
											   ,@type
											   ,@data_type
											   ,@default_value
											   ,@data
											   ,getdate()
											   ,@user_name)
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								UPDATE [SDB].[SCH].[attr]
								   SET [name] = @name
									  ,[desc] = @desc
									  ,[type] = @type
									  ,[data_type] = @data_type
									  ,[default_value] = @default_value
									  ,[data] = @data
									  ,[last_edit_date] = getdate()
									  ,[last_edit_by] = @user_name
								 WHERE row_id = @row_id
						END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
			DELETE FROM  [SDB].[SCH].[attr] WHERE row_id = @row_id
END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Event]
(@row_id  int  ,
 @event_time_utc  datetime  ,
 @event_time_local  datetime  ,
 @wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @step_no  int  ,
 @event_type  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @ent_id  int ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @time_zone_bias_value int = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Job_Event
-- Description    - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created   - 10/17/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
-- Notes          -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
-- 08/31/2007			AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

SELECT job_event.row_id
       ,job_event.event_time_utc
	   ,job_event.event_time_local
	   ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, event_time_utc ) AS event_time
		,  job_event.wo_id
       ,job_event.oper_id
       ,job_event.seq_no
       ,job_event.step_no
       ,job_event.event_type
       ,job_event.ent_id
       ,job_event.bom_pos
       ,job_event.lot_no
       ,job_event.item_id
       ,job_event.cert_name
       ,job_event.done_by_user_id
       ,job_event.checked_by_user_id
       ,job_event.source_row_id
       ,job_event.spec_id
       ,job_event.comments
       ,job_event.value1
       ,job_event.value2
       ,job_event.value3
       ,job_event.value4
       ,job_event.value5
       ,job_event.value6
       ,job_event.value7
       ,job_event.value8
       ,job_event.value9
       ,job_event.value10
       ,job_event.last_edit_comment
       ,job_event.last_edit_by
       ,job_event.last_edit_at
FROM job_event job_event WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((job_event.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.event_time_utc >= @event_time_utc OR @event_time_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (job_event.event_time_local >= @event_time_local OR @event_time_local IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.event_type = @event_type OR @event_type IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (job_event.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
-- Description:This will be used to select the Lot Number of the job when sending it to DCS
-- Note : Used for Cake Blender or Milling or Packing ?
-- Usage:	This will be used to select the Lot Number to DCS
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC     2026-03-30			CR593: Initial version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Lot]
        @wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT
AS
BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT ON;
		DECLARE @def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40)
			
		SELECT  @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
		FROM    job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				wo_id       = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no  = @seq_no
				AND bom_pos = 0
				
		--v0.05 added
		IF 	(@def_lot_no IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @def_lot_no = w.lot_no
			FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE
					w.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
		END
		
		SELECT	@wo_id AS 'wo_id'
				,@oper_id AS 'oper_id'
				,@seq_no AS 'seq_no'
				,@def_lot_no AS 'lot_no'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Dx_Sched]
(
	@sched_id  nvarchar(40)  ,

	@enabled  bit  ,
	@trigger_option  int  ,
	@data_type  int  ,
	@query_id  int  ,

	@post_update_option  int  ,
	@post_action_option  int  ,
	@spare1  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@spare2  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@spare3  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@spare4  nvarchar(254) ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					- 10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 07/15/2005		Raghu			2.1.24		HD# 5258, 5900 Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 08/05/2005		Raghu			2.1.25		HD# 6115, Included dx_query.query_desc in the SELECT clause
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
-- 08/19/2016		Varun			5.3			CR#L00141973 Merge Changes(HF CR#L00141765): Introduced a new column
--												last_activity_local in the select query.
--04/26/2019	Raghu		6.2	US-1165998-MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00153274 (HF CR L00151799: Supply Chain Connector time based schedules not triggering for one hour after clock change in october.)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

SELECT	dx_sched.sched_id
	,	dx_sched.sched_type
	,	dx_sched.enabled
	,	dx_sched.trigger_option
	,	dx_sched.trigger_detail
	,	dx_sched.data_type
	,	dx_sched.data_detail
	,	dx_sched.query_id
	,	dx_sched.format_option
	,	dx_sched.format_detail
	,	dx_sched.transport_option
	,	dx_sched.transport_detail
	,	dx_sched.post_update_option
	,	dx_sched.post_update_detail
	,	dx_sched.post_action_option
	,	dx_sched.post_action_detail
	,	dx_sched.last_activity
	,	dx_sched.last_activity as last_activity_utc
	,	dx_sched.last_result
	,	dx_sched.spare1
	,	dx_sched.spare2
	,	dx_sched.spare3
	,	dx_sched.spare4
	,	dx_sched.last_edit_comment
	,	dx_sched.last_edit_by
	,	dx_sched.last_edit_at
	,	dx_query.query_desc
FROM dx_sched dx_sched WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dx_query dx_query WITH (NOLOCK) ON dx_sched.query_id = dx_query.query_id
WHERE (
		(dx_sched.sched_id = @sched_id OR @sched_id IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.sched_type = @sched_type OR @sched_type IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.enabled = @enabled OR @enabled IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.trigger_option = @trigger_option OR @trigger_option IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.data_type = @data_type OR @data_type IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.query_id = @query_id OR @query_id IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.format_option = @format_option OR @format_option IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.transport_option = @transport_option OR @transport_option IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.post_update_option = @post_update_option OR @post_update_option IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.post_action_option = @post_action_option OR @post_action_option IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(dx_sched.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	  )

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_SU_status]
( 
	@ent_id INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @result NVARCHAR(50)='true'			
			,@isActiveSiloCnt INT=0 
	
	select @isActiveSiloCnt=count(1)
	from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock)
	where oss.active_su_ent_id=@ent_id

	IF(@isActiveSiloCnt > 0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @result='false'
	END 
	RETURN @result

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_GenerateASample]
(@ent_name					STRING80
,@site_name					STRING80
,@qm_spec_name				STRING80
,@ver_id					STRING40 = NULL
,@sample_name				STRING80 = NULL
,@item_id					STRING80 = NULL
,@wo_id						STRING80 = NULL
,@oper_id					STRING80 = NULL
,@seq_no					INT32 = NULL
,@plan_name					STRING80 = NULL
,@requested_time_local		TDATETIME = NULL
,@requested_time_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@expiry_time				INT32 = NULL
,@warning_time				INT32 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0
,@sample_id					INT32 = 0 OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Sample_GenerateASample
-- Description		- The purpose of this stored procedure is to generate a single ad-hoc sample
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 06/01/2012
-- Version			- 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
-- 10/04/2019	RWB			6.2	US:1230274-Added a UTC version  of the requested time,
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @qm_ent_id				INT32
		,@can_capture_qm_data	LOGICAL
		,@can_capture_util		LOGICAL
		,@qm_spec_id			INT32
		,@current_datetime_utc	TDATETIME
		,@warning_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,@expiry_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,@template_sample_name	STRING80
		,@reset_option			INT32
		,@freq_id				INT32
		,@freq_name				STRING80
		,@plan_id				INT32
		,@char_name				STRING80
		,@sample_status			INT32
		,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@last_edit_by			STRING80
		,@sample_name_instance		STRING80
		,@current_sample_no		INT32

		SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0), @current_datetime_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

		--Get the entity ID using the supplied entity name and site name
		SET @qm_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

		--Verify whether the supplied entity exist in the MES database, if not raise an exception to the caller.
		IF (@qm_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied entity: %1 does not exist in the database.{7557},' + COALESCE(@ent_name, '')
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Retrieve the can_capture_* properties for utilization and qm_data
		SELECT @can_capture_util = e.can_capture_util, @can_capture_qm_data = e.can_capture_qm_data
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @qm_ent_id

		--Verify whether the supplied entity can capture QM data, if not raise an error to the caller.
		IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 0) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'This entity does not have the %1 capability flag set.{4710},can_capture_qm_data'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		END

		IF (@requested_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @requested_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @requested_time_utc)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF (@requested_time_local IS NULL) SET @requested_time_utc = @current_datetime_utc
			ELSE
				--Get the requested time in UTC to verify whether the supplied requested time is in the future or not.
				SET @requested_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@qm_ent_id, @requested_time_local, DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value, @requested_time_local))
		END

		--Get the requested time (in local) based on the requested time UTC.
		SET @requested_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @requested_time_utc)

		--Raise an error if the supplied requested time (in UTC) is greater than the current date and time (in UTC).
		IF (@requested_time_utc > @current_datetime_utc) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The sample request time cannot be in the future.{7558}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Reset the warning time and expiry time to NULL, if they have a value less than zero.
		IF (@warning_time < 0) SET @warning_time = NULL
		IF (@expiry_time < 0) SET @expiry_time = NULL

		--Determine the warning time and expiry time (relative to requested time UTC) using the supplied values
		SELECT @warning_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @warning_time, @requested_time_utc), @expiry_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @expiry_time, @requested_time_utc)

		--Raise an error if the supplied warning time is greater than or equal to the expiry time
		IF (@warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @warning_time_utc >= @expiry_time_utc) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The warning time cannot be greater than or equal to the expiry time.{7559}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Raise an error if the supplied item contains a non-null value, but the item does not exist in the database.
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The supplied item: %1 does not exist in the database.{7560},' + @item_id
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		--Verify whether this sample is generated for the job context.
		IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) OR (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN

			IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				--Raise an error if the supplied job contains a non-null value, but the job does not exist in the database.
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('The specified job does not exist in the database.{3176}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
			END

			IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				--Raise an error if the supplied job does not produce the supplied item.
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('The supplied item does not match with the existing job item{3561}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
			END
		END

		--Raise an error if the supplied QM spec does not exist in the database.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
			  AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied QM spec: %1 does not exist in the database.{7561},' + COALESCE(@qm_spec_name, '')
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Raise an error if the supplied QM spec was not active during the sample requested time.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
					  AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
					  AND start_eff_utc <= @requested_time_utc
					  AND (end_eff_utc > @requested_time_utc OR end_eff_utc IS NULL)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The supplied QM spec was not active during the requested time of a sample.{7562}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Retrieve the QM spec id, that is the most recent spec relative to the requested time.
		SELECT @qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
		FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN (SELECT qsmax.qm_spec_name, MAX(qsmax.start_eff_utc) start_eff_utc_max
					FROM qm_spec qsmax WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE qsmax.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
					  AND (qsmax.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
					  AND start_eff_utc <= @requested_time_utc
					  AND (end_eff_utc > @requested_time_utc OR end_eff_utc IS NULL)
					GROUP BY qsmax.qm_spec_name
					) max_qm_spec  ON qs.qm_spec_name = max_qm_spec.qm_spec_name AND qs.start_eff_utc = max_qm_spec.start_eff_utc_max
		WHERE qs.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name

		--Raise an error if there is not at least one characteristic that is not unused attached to the supplied QM spec.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
						WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
						  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('To generate a sample, there must be at least one characteristic that is not unused that is attached to the QM spec.{7563}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--If the supplied sample request time UTC is the same as the current time, then retrieve the jobs that are currently running on this entity
		IF (@requested_time_utc = @current_datetime_utc)
			--If an item id or the job information is supplied, then retrieve the job that is running at the least job position to fill the job details.
			SELECT @wo_id = j.wo_id, @oper_id = j.oper_id, @seq_no = j.seq_no, @item_id = j.item_id
			FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN
				(SELECT MIN(je.job_pos) job_pos
				FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
				WHERE je.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
				  AND (j.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
				  AND (j.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
				  AND (j.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
				  AND (j.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
				) runon_job_min_job_pos ON je.job_pos = runon_job_min_job_pos.job_pos
			WHERE je.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The supplied sample request time is in the PAST, therefore find the job that ran at this time on this entity.
			--If this entity is capable of capturing utilization data, then get the job information from the job_history table;
			--otherwise get the job information from the job_event table.
			IF (@can_capture_util = 1)
				SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = jull.wo_id, @oper_id = jull.oper_id, @seq_no = jull.seq_no, @item_id = jull.item_id
				FROM job_history jull WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jull.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
				  AND jull.job_start_utc <= @requested_time_utc
				  AND (jull.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
				  AND (jull.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
				  AND (jull.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
				  AND (jull.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
				ORDER BY jull.job_start_utc DESC, jull.job_pos ASC
			ELSE
				--Since this entity is not capable of capturing utilziation data, get the job information from the job_event table.
				SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = je.wo_id, @oper_id = je.oper_id, @seq_no = je.seq_no, @item_id = je.item_id
				FROM job_event je WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE je.event_time_utc <= @requested_time_utc
				  AND je.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
				  AND je.event_type = 'JobStateChanged'
				  AND (je.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
				  AND (je.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
				  AND (je.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
				  AND (je.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
				  AND (je.value1 = 3)
				ORDER BY je.event_time_utc DESC
		END

		-- Verify whether a plan name is supplied.
		IF (@plan_name IS NOT NULL)
			--The supplied plan name contains a non-null value, therefore, retrieve the plan_id from the supplied plan name.
			SELECT @plan_id = sp.plan_id FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sp.plan_name = @plan_name

		--Verify whether a valid plan ID is identified.
		IF (@plan_id IS NULL)
			--A valid plan_id could not be retrieved using the supplied plan name, therefore retrieve the plan_id using the QM spec determined.
			SELECT @plan_id = qs.plan_id FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE qs.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id

		--Get the freq ID (manual)
		SELECT @freq_id = MIN(sf.freq_id)
		FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN sample_plan_freq_link spfl WITH (NOLOCK) ON sf.freq_id = spfl.freq_id
		WHERE sf.freq_type = 19
		  AND spfl.plan_id = @plan_id

		--Get the frequency ID (manual) if none of the frequencies attached to the sample plan has a manual frequency.
		IF (@freq_id IS NULL)
			SELECT @freq_id = MIN(sf.freq_id) FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sf.freq_type = 19

		--Verify whether a sample name is supplied.
		--If a sample name is supplied, then set the plan_id as null, because we don't want to generate conflicting samples names for a plan id.
		IF (@sample_name IS NOT NULL)
			SET @plan_id = NULL

		ELSE BEGIN -- sample name is not supplied.

			--Get the frequency name using the frequency ID.
			IF (@freq_id IS NOT NULL)
				SELECT @freq_name = sf.freq_name FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sf.freq_id = @freq_id

			--Get the sample plan details
			SELECT @plan_name = sp.plan_name, @template_sample_name = sp.sample_name, @reset_option = sp.reset_option
			FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sp.plan_id = @plan_id

			--Get the first characteristic assigned for this QM spc.
			SELECT TOP 1 @char_name = c.char_name
			FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
			WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
			  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0


			-- Get the sample name for this requested time
			EXEC sp_SA_GetNextSampleName @plan_id = @plan_id, @plan_name = @plan_name, @temp_sample_name = @template_sample_name, @reset_option = @reset_option
					, @requested_time_local = @requested_time_local, @ent_name = @ent_name
					, @wo_id = @wo_id, @oper_id = @oper_id, @seq_no = @seq_no, @segment_requirement_id = NULL
					, @segment_response_id = NULL, @item_id = @item_id, @char_name = @char_name
					, @qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name, @freq_name = @freq_name, @prev_sample_name_instance = NULL
					, @next_sample_name = @sample_name OUTPUT, @sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance OUTPUT
					, @next_sample_id = @current_sample_no OUTPUT

			--If the sample instance name is empty, then there are no replaceable parameters except octothorpes, therefore replace the instance name with '-'
			IF (@sample_name_instance = '') AND (@current_sample_no IS NOT NULL AND @current_sample_no > 0) SET @sample_name_instance = '-'

			IF (@template_sample_name IS NOT NULL AND @sample_name_instance IS NOT NULL AND @current_sample_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM last_sample_no lsn WITH (NOLOCK)
					   WHERE lsn.sample_name_template = @template_sample_name
					     AND lsn.sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance)
					--Update the last_sample_no table with the current sample no from the sample_to_go table
					UPDATE last_sample_no
					SET current_sample_no = @current_sample_no
					   ,last_edit_at = @current_datetime_utc
					WHERE sample_name_template = @template_sample_name
					  AND sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance
					  AND current_sample_no < @current_sample_no
				ELSE
					--Insert the ordinal numbers (if any) into last_sample_no table from the sample_to_go records if they were not already recorded.
					INSERT INTO last_sample_no (sample_name_template, sample_name_instance, current_sample_no, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (@template_sample_name, @sample_name_instance, @current_sample_no, @current_datetime_utc)
			END

		END -- sample name is not supplied.

		--Get the warning time and the expiry time from the frquency definition if any of these values are not supplied.
		IF (@warning_time IS NULL OR @expiry_time IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @warning_time = COALESCE(@warning_time, CASE WHEN sf.warning_unit = 1 THEN sf.warning_time
								            WHEN sf.warning_unit = 2 THEN sf.warning_time * 60
								            WHEN sf.warning_unit = 3 THEN sf.warning_time * 1440
								            ELSE NULL
								            END
								            )
				, @expiry_time = COALESCE(@expiry_time, CASE WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 1 THEN sf.expiry_time
									     WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 2 THEN sf.expiry_time * 60
									     WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 3 THEN sf.expiry_time * 1440
									     ELSE NULL
									     END)
			FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sf.freq_id = @freq_id

			--Determine the warning time and expiry time (relative to requested time UTC) using the supplied values
			SELECT @warning_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @warning_time, @requested_time_utc), @expiry_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @expiry_time, @requested_time_utc)

			--Raise an error if the supplied warning time is greater than or equal to the expiry time
			IF (@warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @warning_time_utc >= @expiry_time_utc) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('The warning time cannot be greater than or equal to the expiry time.{7559}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

		--Determine the sample status (relative the requested time and the current time UTC).
		SET @sample_status = CASE WHEN @current_datetime_utc <= COALESCE(@expiry_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc+1) AND @current_datetime_utc >= COALESCE(@warning_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc+1) THEN 2
								  WHEN @current_datetime_utc > COALESCE(@expiry_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc+1) THEN 3
								  ELSE 1
							  END

		--Create an ad-hoc sample.
		INSERT INTO sample (ent_id, sample_name, item_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
			, freq_id, plan_id
			, requested_time_utc, requested_time_local
			, expiry_time_utc, expiry_time_local
			, warning_time_utc, warning_time_local
			, final, sample_status, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (@qm_ent_id, @sample_name, @item_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			, @freq_id, @plan_id
			, @requested_time_utc, @requested_time_local
			, @expiry_time_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @expiry_time_utc)
			, @warning_time_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @warning_time_utc)
			, 0, @sample_status, @last_edit_by, @current_datetime_utc)

		--Get the ID of the sample
		SET @sample_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		--Include all the sample characteristics that are NOT un-used for this sample for the supplied QM spec
		INSERT INTO sample_char_link (sample_id, char_id, qm_spec_id, control_move, ignore_sample, act_sample_size, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT @sample_id, qscl.char_id, @qm_spec_id, 0, 0, 0, @last_edit_by, @current_datetime_utc
		FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
		WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
		  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24         Initial version.
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-02-09		   Refer to the comments in the SP on this date
-- 0.01.03  Lavkesh     2024-05-16		   For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- 0.01.04  Michal H    2024-09-02         Fix incorrect timestamp format - change the erroneous 12-hour format specifier ("hhmmss")
--                                         to the 24-hour format specifier ("HHmmss").
-- 0.01.05	OT			2025-07-02			Adjustment for RM production in PRO - related to problem with production reporting to SAP on Bean Rework
-- ===========================================================================================
 
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg] as
begin
 
 
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT
 
 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
 
 
    BEGIN TRY
 
  		BEGIN

			WITH ProduceToSAPOpers as(
				Select oper_id from oper_attr with(nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP') and attr_value <> 1
				union
				Select oper_id from oper_attr with(nolock) where attr_id <> (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP')
				union 
				Select oper_id from oper with(nolock) where oper_id not in (select oper_id from oper_attr with(nolock))
			)
			
            Select  ip.spare2,ip.sublot_no,ip.wo_id,wo.bags_per_pallet,qty_prod,qty_prod_erp,u.description,ip.item_id,ip.created_at_local as last_edit_at,ip.lot_no,ip.row_id -- 0.01.03
			into #temp
            from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
            inner join ofi_wo_ext wo  with (nolock) on wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id and wo.module <> 'PO'
			inner join wo w on w.wo_id = wo.wo_id and w.state_cd < 3	--- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
            inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
            inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
			inner join job_bom jb on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
			inner join ProduceToSAPOpers oa on oa.oper_id = ip.oper_id  --(KN - 09/02/23 - Include only those operations where the NotConsumeToSAP has not been set)
            where qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod and i.item_class_id IN ('SFG', 'RM') and ip.sublot_no is not null --0.01.05
 			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL
			Begin

 			Declare @Mainhu varchar(100),@subLot varchar(100),@lot_no varchar(100),@wo_id varchar(100),@item_id varchar(100),@item_class varchar(100),@row_id INT
			Declare @sap_item_id varchar(100)

			Select top 1 @subLot = sublot_no,@lot_no = lot_no,@wo_id = wo_id,@item_id = item_id,@row_id = row_id from #temp

			PRINT @row_id

			Select @item_class = item_class_id from item with(nolock) where item_id = @item_id

				BEGIN
           			select '' Handling_Unit_Number,wo_id Order_Number,  --HU is empty for SFG
					sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number,'101' Movement_Type, bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
					sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp) Quantity, description Unit_of_Measure,
					IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,T.item_id,ia.attr_value) SAP_MaterialCode_Number,  --(KN  02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					Format(min(last_edit_at),'yyyyMMdd') Production_startdate,Format(min(last_edit_at),'HHmmss') Production_starttime,
					Format(max(last_edit_at),'yyyyMMdd') Production_enddate,Format(max(last_edit_at),'HHmmss') Production_endtime,
					lot_no SAP_Batch_Number,
					Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date,Format(GETDATE(),'HHmmss') File_Generation_Time, 
					'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
					from 
					#temp T
					left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with(nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
						on T.item_id = ia.item_id  --(KN  02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					where lot_no = @lot_no and isnull(sublot_no,'') = isnull(@subLot,'')
          		    group by wo_id,bags_per_pallet,description,T.item_id,sublot_no,lot_no,ia.attr_value

					BEGIN TRANSACTION 
 
           			Update ip set qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod from item_prod ip
					inner join (Select * from #temp where lot_no = @lot_no and sublot_no = @subLot) t on ip.row_id = t.row_id

					COMMIT TRANSACTION
				END
			End

        END
    END TRY
 
 
     BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
        RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
    END CATCH
end

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_master_recipe_preferred
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch the recipe  details for ent_id and item_id
--				check always the preffered one if exists otherwise show the non preffered one
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK				2023-Jan-24			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_master_recipe_preferred]
(
 @ent_id		INT   
,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@wo_id			NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no			INT
) 

AS
 -- Get the recipe  details
BEGIN

DECLARE	@isRecipe NVARCHAR(80) = NULL;

SELECT @isRecipe= spare1
FROM job_bom jb with(nolock)
where jb.wo_id=@wo_id and jb.oper_id=@oper_id and jb.seq_no=@seq_no and bom_pos=0

IF(@isRecipe is not null and @isRecipe<>'Last used recipe')
BEGIN
-- fetching the details from master recipe table
	SELECT [item_id]
      ,[ent_id]
      ,[version]
      ,[recipe_name]
      ,[preferred]
      ,[is_active]      
      ,[row_id]
		FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] omr WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE omr.recipe_name IN (SELECT spare1
								  FROM job_bom jb WITH(NOLOCK)
								  WHERE jb.wo_id=@wo_id and jb.oper_id=@oper_id and jb.seq_no=@seq_no and bom_pos=0)
END

ELSE IF(@isRecipe='Last used recipe')

BEGIN
	SELECT ''[item_id]
      ,''[ent_id]
      ,-1 AS [version]
      ,'Last used recipe' [recipe_name]
      ,'' [preferred]
      ,''[is_active]      
      ,''[row_id]
		
END


ELSE
BEGIN

SELECT [item_id]
      ,[ent_id]
      ,[version]
      ,[recipe_name]
      ,[preferred]
      ,[is_active]      
      ,[row_id]
		FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  item_id = @item_id and ent_id = @ent_id	
		and is_active = 'Y'
		and preferred = (CASE WHEN exists(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  item_id = @item_id and ent_id =@ent_id  and preferred ='Y' ) THEN 
				'Y'
			ELSE 'N'
			END )
END

END

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By    Ver  	Changes
-- 12/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.7	Cloning a job attribute should also clone notes.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
