CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_Job_Exec_ReadyDstrmJobs]
(@wo_id		STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@seq_no		INT32,
@user_id	NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@ent_id		INT	= -1,
@job_pos 	INT = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 03/03/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 570) 2. When downstream job is op is ready, such that, automatically start all the downstream jobs when a production is entered
--					Added @user_id, @ent_id, @job_pos parameters, also added a call statement to call sp_U_Job_Exec_StartDownstreamJobs
--10/14/2003	Raghu		2.0.0.5	Removed code which calls sp_U_Job_Exec_StartDownstreamJobs as downstream jobs should be started only when a job is ended
--03/23/2005	Raghu		2.1.17	(HD# 5415) Include items where reqd_start_val is 0.
--					Re-written this sp along with the above mod to optimize performance.
--05/05/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 4385, Special handling of production quantities for piece parts.
--05/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	Qty_Per_Parent_Item is included (was excluded) while calculating total qty required.
--09/06/2005	Raghu		2.1.28	HD# 5836, Auto Ready Jobs - Constant Qty
--11/02/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 6575, Auto Ready Next Jobs; this procedure was skipping the records which has reqd_start_val = 0; this record should also
--					be considered. This means as soon as something is produced in an op, the downstream op should be automatically readied.
--04/12/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7976, Ready downstream jobs based on the system attribute.
--12/29/2006	Raghu		3.1.26	HD# 9076, Ready downstream jobs that have input> 0
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE	 @next_oper_id			STRING40
	,@next_seq_no			INT32
	,@prev_oper_id			STRING40
	,@prev_seq_no			INT32
	,@state_cd			INT32
	,@qty_at_start			TFLOAT
	,@qty_reqd			TFLOAT
	,@bom_pos			INT32
	,@item_id			STRING40
	,@qty_per_parent_item		TFLOAT
	,@reqd_start_val		TFLOAT
	,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		LOGICAL
	,@input_percent			TFLOAT
	,@qty_prod			TFLOAT
	,@Total_Qty_Prod		TFLOAT
	,@Total_Qty_Reqd		TFLOAT
	,@Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys		LOGICAL
	,@ignore_this_item		INT32
	,@update_status_flag		INT32
	,@good_prod_num_decimals	INT32
	,@item_num_decimals		INT32
	,@downstream_jobs_attr		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@ready_downstrm_jobs_ip	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@input_percent_filter		INT32

	SET @downstream_jobs_attr = '1'
	SELECT @downstream_jobs_attr = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 342
	--Do not automatically ready the downstream job if the system attribute is set to false.
	IF (@downstream_jobs_attr = '0') RETURN 0

	--Retrieve the system_attribute "Ready downstream jobs that have input> 0" to determine whether we should ready all downstream jobs or the jobs that has input percent >0
	SELECT @ready_downstrm_jobs_ip = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 352
	--If the system attribute is set to true, then default the input percent filter to 0; otherwise default to NULL
	IF (@ready_downstrm_jobs_ip = '1') SET @input_percent_filter = 0
	ELSE SET @input_percent_filter = NULL

	--Check the system attribute to determine whether an item can produce fractional pieces.
	SELECT @good_prod_num_decimals = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(attr_value) = 1 THEN CONVERT(INT, attr_value)
					ELSE 0 END
	FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 326
	SET @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0)

	--Start cursor NextJobs to read all immediate downstream jobs for this job
	--Read next_oper_id = oper_id, next_seq_no = seq_no from job_route
	--where wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no = input params
	DECLARE next_jobs_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
	SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no
	   AND (input_percent > @input_percent_filter OR @input_percent_filter IS NULL)

	OPEN next_jobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM next_jobs_cursor INTO @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Get the state of the next job,
		--Get state_cd, qty_at_start, qty_reqd (?) from job table for given wo_id, next_oper_id and
		--next_seq_no (NextJob cursor values)
		SELECT @state_cd = state_cd,  @qty_at_start = ISNULL(qty_at_start,0), @qty_reqd = ISNULL(qty_reqd,0)
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

		-- if it is NEW continue processing, else fetch next row from NextJobs cursor
		IF (@state_cd = 1) BEGIN
			--Start cursor CheckBOMs to read all relevant BOM start qty requirements for the current NextJobs cursor row
			--Read bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val, read_start_val_is_pct from job_bom
			--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no
			--and bom_pos >= 0 and reqd_start_val > 0
			SET @update_status_flag = 0

			DECLARE job_bom_item_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT jb.item_id, jb.bom_pos, i.num_decimals
			FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no
			  AND bom_pos >= 0 AND reqd_start_val >= 0
			OPEN job_bom_item_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM job_bom_item_cursor INTO @item_id, @bom_pos, @item_num_decimals
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @ignore_this_item = 0

				--If bom_pos = 0, check the item that is being produced in this operation is the same
				-- item that is produced in the previous operation. If yes, then continue checking
				--If the item that is being produced in this operation is not produced in the upsteam
				--operation, then ignore checking this item for this bom_pos
				IF (@bom_pos = 0) BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jr.seq_no
						INNER JOIN job_bom jb_prev WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb_prev.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jb_prev.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND jb_prev.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
						  AND jb_prev.item_id = jb.item_id AND jb_prev.bom_pos = 0
						WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @next_oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @next_seq_no
						  AND jb.bom_pos = 0 AND jb.item_id = @item_id)
					SET @ignore_this_item = 1
				END

				IF (@ignore_this_item = 0) BEGIN
					SET @total_qty_reqd = 0

					--For each row in CheckBOMs cursor calculate the reqd_start_qty
					--If read_start_val_is_pct is true then reqd_start_val = reqd_start_val * job.qty_at_start * qty_per_parent_item,
					--else reqd_start_val = reqd_start_val
--					SELECT @total_qty_reqd = SUM(CASE WHEN reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1 THEN reqd_start_val * @qty_at_start * qty_per_parent_item
--							ELSE reqd_start_val END)
					SELECT @total_qty_reqd = SUM(CASE WHEN constant_qty = 1 THEN
							CASE WHEN reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1 THEN  reqd_start_val * qty_per_parent_item
							ELSE qty_per_parent_item END
						ELSE
							CASE WHEN reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1 THEN reqd_start_val * @qty_at_start * qty_per_parent_item
							ELSE reqd_start_val END
						END)
					FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no
					  AND bom_pos >= 0 AND item_id = @item_id AND reqd_start_val >= 0

					SELECT @total_qty_reqd = ISNULL(@total_qty_reqd, 0), @total_qty_prod = 0

					IF (@total_qty_reqd > 0) BEGIN
						--Calculate how much of this qty_prod will help this next job based on its input_percent value.
						SELECT @total_qty_prod = SUM(ISNULL(ip.qty_prod, 0) * ISNULL(jr.input_percent, 0))
						FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = ip.oper_id
								AND jr.input_seq_no = ip.seq_no
						WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @next_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @next_seq_no
						  AND ip.item_id = @item_id AND ip.good_prod = 1

						IF (@item_num_decimals = 0 AND @good_prod_num_decimals > 0)
							SET @total_qty_prod = CONVERT(INT, @total_qty_prod)
					END

					SET @total_qty_prod = ISNULL(@total_qty_prod, 0)

					--Determine whether previous production for this bom_pos is sufficient
					-- to make this job READY or not. Any failure means there is no point in continuing
					--to check for READY conditions for this 'next job'
					--If Cur_Bom_Pos_Qtys_OK is True then read next bom_pos from the CheckBoms cursor,
					--else proceed to close and exit the CheckBOMs cursor

					IF (@total_qty_prod >= @total_qty_reqd) SET @update_status_flag = 1
					ELSE BEGIN
						SET @update_status_flag = 0
						BREAK
					END
				END --End of ignore item checks
			END	-- Loop ends for job_bom_item cursor
			CLOSE job_bom_item_cursor
			DEALLOCATE job_bom_item_cursor
			IF (@update_status_flag = 1) BEGIN
				UPDATE JOB SET state_cd = 2
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no
			END
		END	-- Conditional entry where state_cd = NEW (1)
	END	-- Loop ends for next_jobs_cursor
	CLOSE next_jobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE next_jobs_cursor

/*
	--Start cursor NextJobs to read all immediate downstream jobs for this job
	--Read next_oper_id = oper_id, next_seq_no = seq_no from job_route
	--where wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no = input params
	Declare NextJobs_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		Select oper_id, seq_no
		FROM job_route
		where wo_id = @wo_id
		   and input_oper_id = @oper_id
		   and input_seq_no = @seq_no
	OPEN NextJobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		Fetch NEXT from NextJobs_cursor into @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		--Get the state of the next job,
		--Get state_cd, qty_at_start, qty_reqd (?) from job table for given wo_id, next_oper_id and
		--next_seq_no (NextJob cursor values)
		select @state_cd = state_cd,  @qty_at_start = isnull(qty_at_start,0), @qty_reqd = isnull(qty_reqd,0) from job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		    and oper_id = @next_oper_id
		    and seq_no = @next_seq_no
		SET @Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys = 0
		-- if it is NEW continue processing, else fetch next row from NextJobs cursor
		if (@state_cd = 1) BEGIN
			--Start cursor CheckBOMs to read all relevant BOM start qty requirements for the current NextJobs cursor row
			--Read bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val, read_start_val_is_pct from job_bom
			--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no
			--and bom_pos >= 0 and reqd_start_val > 0
			Declare  Job_BOM_Item_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
				select item_id
				from job_bom
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
				    and  oper_id = @next_oper_id
				    and  seq_no = @next_seq_no
				    and  bom_pos >= 0
				    and  reqd_start_val >= 0
			Open JOB_Bom_Item_cursor
			WHILE (1=1)
			BEGIN
				Fetch NEXT from Job_BOM_Item_cursor into @item_id
				if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @Total_Qty_Reqd = 0
				Declare CheckBOMs_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
					Select bom_pos, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct
					from job_bom
					WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
					    and  oper_id = @next_oper_id
					    and  seq_no = @next_seq_no
					    and  item_id = @item_id
					    and  bom_pos >= 0
					    and  reqd_start_val > 0
				OPEN CheckBOMs_cursor
				WHILE (1=1)
				BEGIN
					Fetch NEXT from CheckBOMs_cursor into @bom_pos, @qty_per_parent_item,
							@reqd_start_val, @reqd_start_val_is_pct

					if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--For each row in CheckBOMs cursor calculate the reqd_start_qty
				--If read_start_val_is_pct is true then reqd_start_val = reqd_start_val * job.qty_at_start * qty_per_parent_item,
				--else reqd_start_val = reqd_start_val
					if (@reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1)
						SET @Total_Qty_Reqd = @Total_Qty_Reqd + (@reqd_start_val * @qty_at_start * @qty_per_parent_item)
					ELSE
						SET @Total_Qty_Reqd = @Total_Qty_Reqd + @reqd_start_val

				END
				CLOSE CheckBOMs_cursor
				DEALLOCATE CheckBOMs_cursor
				SET @Total_Qty_Prod = 0
				Declare PrevJobs_cursor cursor STATIC for
					Select input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent
					from job_route
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					   and  oper_id = @next_oper_id
					   and seq_no = @next_seq_no
				OPEN PrevJobs_cursor
				WHILE (1=1)
				BEGIN
					Fetch NEXT from PrevJobs_cursor into @prev_oper_id, @prev_seq_no, @input_percent
					if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					--Read sum(qty_prod) from item_prod


					--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = prev_oper_id and seq_no = prev_seq_no
					--and item_id = CheckBOMs cursor item_id and good_prod = True
					select @qty_prod = isnull(sum(isnull(qty_prod,0)),0)
					from item_prod
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					    and oper_id = @prev_oper_id
					    and seq_no = @prev_seq_no
					    and item_id = @item_id
					    and good_prod = 1
					--Calculate how much of this qty_prod will help this next job based on its input_percent value.
					--Add this qty to Total_Qty_Prod local variable.
					--Total_Qty_Prod = Total_Qty_Prod + (qty_prod * input_percent from PrevJobs cursor)
					SET @Total_Qty_Prod = @Total_Qty_Prod + (@qty_prod * @input_percent)
				END
				CLOSE PrevJobs_cursor
				DEALLOCATE PrevJobs_cursor
				--Determine whether previous production for this bom_pos is sufficient
				-- to make this job READY or not. Any failure means there is no point in continuing
				--to check for READY conditions for this 'next job'
				--If Cur_Bom_Pos_Qtys_OK is True then read next bom_pos from the CheckBoms cursor,
				--else proceed to close and exit the CheckBOMs cursor
				if (@Total_Qty_Prod >= @Total_Qty_Reqd)
					SET @Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys = 1
				ELSE BEGIN
					SET @Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys = 0
					BREAK
				END
			END
			CLOSE  JOB_Bom_Item_cursor
			DEALLOCATE JOB_Bom_Item_cursor
		END
		--If Cur_Bom_Pos_Qtys_OK is still True then update the status of this next job to READY
		if (@Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys = 1) BEGIN
			--Update job set state_cd = 2 (READY)
			--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no
			UPDATE JOB set state_cd = 2
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			    and oper_id = @next_oper_id
			    and seq_no = @next_seq_no
--			Print 'Updating Job Status to New for WO ID = ' + @wo_id + ' and oper id = ' + @next_oper_id + ' and seq no = ' + str(@next_seq_no)
--			Added by Raghu on 03/03/2003. Call StartDownstreamJobs sp to start all downstream jobs automatically
--			EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartDownstreamJobs @user_id, @ent_id, @job_pos, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
		END
	END
	CLOSE NextJobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE NextJobs_cursor
*/
RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CUD_attr_rules]
(

@id int, --Autonumeric
@desc NVARCHAR(50),
@type NVARCHAR(50),
@attr_id int,
@rule_type NVARCHAR(50),
@attribute_datatype NVARCHAR(50),
@priority int,
@max bit,
@spTxt1 NVARCHAR(50),
@spTxt2 NVARCHAR(50),
@spNum1 float,
@spNum2 float,
@active bit,
@user_name NVARCHAR(50),
@deleteFlag bit
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @RowAvailable int

select @RowAvailable = id from SDB.SCH.attr_rules where id = @id

if @deleteFlag = 0
BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null 
						BEGIN
						--code for insert

									INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[attr_rules]
											   ([desc],
												[type],
												[attr_id],
												[rule_type],
												[attribute_datatype],
												[priority],
												[max],
												[spTxt1],
												[spTxt2],
												[spNum1],
												[spNum2],
											    [last_edit_date],
											    [last_edit_by],
												[active]
											    )
										 VALUES
											   (@desc,
												@type,
												@attr_id,
												@rule_type,
												@attribute_datatype,
												@priority,
												@max,
												CASE WHEN @spTxt1 = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE @spTxt1 END,
												CASE WHEN @spTxt2 = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE @spTxt2 END,
												@spNum1,
												@spNum2,
											    getdate(),
											    @user_name,
												@active)
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								UPDATE [SDB].[SCH].[attr_rules]
								   SET 
										[desc] = @desc,
										[type] = @type,
										[attr_id]= @attr_id,
										[rule_type] = @rule_type,
										[attribute_datatype] = @attribute_datatype,
										[priority] = @priority,
										[max] = @max,
										[spTxt1] = CASE WHEN @spTxt1 = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE @spTxt1 END,
										[spTxt2] = CASE WHEN @spTxt2 = ' ' THEN NULL ELSE @spTxt2 END,
										[spNum1] = @spNum1,
										[spNum2] = @spNum2,
									    [last_edit_date] = getdate(),
									    [last_edit_by] = @user_name,
										[active] = @active
								 WHERE id = @id
						END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
			DELETE FROM  [SDB].[SCH].[attr_rules] WHERE id = @id
END

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec]
(@ent_id  int  ,
 @job_pos  int  ,
 @cur_wo_id NVARCHAR(40) ,
 @cur_oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
 @cur_seq_no int ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--09/15/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--03/22/2006	Raghu		3.1.12	Added job_exec.ent_id, job_pos in the Order By clause
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--08/31/2007	Raghu       3.3.0   HD# 9389, Add apply_post_exec_fc_counts to job_exec table
--10/16/2007	AML			3.3.2	Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
--07/19/2019	RWB			6.2.0	Story 1191970 - Added a next_avail_job_pos
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SELECT	job_exec.ent_id
		,	job_exec.job_pos
		,	(SELECT min(job_pos) FROM job_exec je2 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job_exec.ent_id = je2.ent_id AND cur_wo_id IS NULL) AS next_avail_job_pos
		,	ent.ent_name
		,	job_exec.next_job_only
		,	job_exec.item_based_desc
		,	job_exec.job_end_confirm_msg
		,	job_exec.def_to_ent_id
		,	ent2.ent_name as def_to_ent_name
		,	job_exec.def_reject_ent_id
		,	ent3.ent_name as def_reject_ent_name
		,	job_exec.def_from_ent_id
		,	ent1.ent_name as def_from_ent_name
		,	job_exec.def_prod_reas_cd
		,	item_reas.reas_desc as def_prod_reas_desc
		,	job_exec.def_cons_reas_cd
		,	item_reas1.reas_desc as def_cons_reas_desc
		,	job_exec.def_lot_no
		,	job_exec.def_sublot_no
		,	job_exec.autoload_job_specs
		,	job_exec.auto_seq_start_option
		,	job_exec.auto_job_start_option
		,	job_exec.auto_job_end_option
		,	job_exec.incl_class_reas
		,	job_exec.must_complete_steps
		,	job_exec.must_prod_reqd_qty
		,	job_exec.local_movable_cons_ent
		,	job_exec.local_movable_prod_ent
		,	job_exec.run_without_operator
		,	job_exec.apply_post_exec_fc_counts
		,	job_exec.suppress_start_qty_prompt
		,	job_exec.allow_zero_qty_split
		,	job_exec.auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job
		,	job_exec.cur_wo_id
		,	job_exec.cur_oper_id
		,	job_exec.cur_seq_no
		,	job_exec.cur_step_no
		,	job_exec.cur_step_start
		,	job_exec.spare1
		,	job_exec.spare2
		,	job_exec.spare3
		,	job_exec.spare4
		,	job_exec.last_edit_comment
		,	job_exec.last_edit_by
		,	job_exec.last_edit_at
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN ent ent1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_from_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_to_ent_id = ent2.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN ent ent3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_from_ent_id = ent3.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_prod_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
		LEFT JOIN item_reas item_reas1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_cons_reas_cd = item_reas1.reas_cd
	WHERE (
			(job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos OR @job_pos IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.cur_wo_id = @cur_wo_id OR @cur_wo_id IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.cur_oper_id = @cur_oper_id OR @cur_oper_id IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no OR @cur_seq_no IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(job_exec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	)
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name, job_exec.ent_id, job_exec.job_pos

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    [ufn_S_ofi_CheckSublotChange]
-- Description:  checks if sublot change is necessary
-- =======================================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  AML, XPM	2026-04-15		Initial version for CR608
-- 0.01.1	JSC			2026-04-15			Added check for job_state_cd and mapped final output from it
-- =======================================================================================================
CREATE         FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_CheckSublotChange]
        (@job_command INT, @ent_id INT, @wo_id  NVARCHAR(40), @seq_no INT, @oper_id NVARCHAR(40))
		RETURNS INT
AS BEGIN
	DECLARE @eventName_local AS NVARCHAR(40), 
			@trigger_attr_desc AS NVARCHAR(40),
			@update_sublot AS INT = 0,
			@job_state_cd AS INT,
			@line_ent_id AS INT;
	IF @job_Command = 1--Set event name for new sublot: 
	BEGIN
		SET @eventName_local = 'StartJob' 
	END 
	ELSE IF @job_command IN (4, 20) -- Consider 20 as only edit recipe as SU change shall not be trigger with destination 
	BEGIN --Set event name for new sublot: 
		SET @eventName_local = 'EditRecipe' 
	END 
	ELSE IF @job_command IN (8, 24) 
	BEGIN --Set event name for new sublot: 
		SET @eventName_local = 'RSUChange' 
	END 
	ELSE IF @job_command IN (12, 28, 40, 44, 56 , 60) -- removed 20; as DESTINATION shall not trigger EditSiloRecipe
	BEGIN --Set event name for new sublot: 
		SET @eventName_local = 'EditSiloRecipe' 
	END 
		ELSE 
	BEGIN 
		SET @eventName_local = 'StopJob' 
	END 
 
	SELECT @job_state_cd = j.state_cd
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
		AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
		
	--  Map Events to Attributes  
    SET @trigger_attr_desc =	CASE 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'StartJob'       THEN 'NewSublotStartJob'
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'EditRecipe'     THEN 'NewSublotEditRecipe' 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'RSUChange'      THEN 'NewSublotOnSUChange' 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'OnFrequency'    THEN 'NewSublotOnFrequency' 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'ShiftChange'    THEN 'NewSublotOnShiftChange' 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'EditSiloRecipe' THEN 'NewSublotOnSURecipeChange' 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'DayChange'      THEN 'NewSublotOnDayChange' 
									WHEN @eventName_local = 'GOODHU'         THEN 'NewSublotOnHUChange' 
								ELSE NULL 
								END; 
 
	SELECT @line_ent_id = parent_ent_id 
    FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) 
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_id = target_sched_ent_id 
    WHERE ent_id = @ent_id OR (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no);


    IF @trigger_attr_desc IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN 
        SELECT @update_sublot = ISNULL(CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT),0) 
        FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
        WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id -- Always on line entity 
			AND a.attr_desc = @trigger_attr_desc; 
    END 
 -- v10.01 Added: fix for start job 
    IF @trigger_attr_desc = 'NewSublotStartJob' AND ISNULL(@update_sublot,0) <> 1 
	BEGIN 
		SET @trigger_attr_desc = CASE 
									WHEN @job_state_cd = 2  THEN 'NewSublotOnlyFirstTimeStartJob' 
									ELSE NULL
								END	
	END

	 SELECT @update_sublot = ISNULL(CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT),0) 
     FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
     WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id -- Always on line entity 
		AND a.attr_desc = @trigger_attr_desc; 

	SET @update_sublot = COALESCE(@update_sublot, 0)

    RETURN @update_sublot 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Std_Oper_Clone]
(
		@existing_oper_id	STRING80
	,	@new_oper_id		STRING80
	,	@new_oper_desc		NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
	,	@std_oper_last_edit_at	TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_I_Std_Oper_Clone
-- Description			- Clone the current standard operation to a new standard operation.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 11/07/2005
-- Version				- 3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.		Changes
-- 10/24/2006	KRF			3.1.25		HD Call 8953 - clone data_log_grp_std_oper_link records
-- 01/16/2007	KRF			3.2.1		HD# 9222 & 9226, part of DB changes - copy std_oper_step.reqd_rep_pct and handle
--										renamed fields in spc_char_std_oper_link
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1		HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 08/27/2007	AML			3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--										dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4			L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 02/05/2008	AML			3.4.0		L00074725; Added insert statement to copy std_oper_step_choice records.
-- 10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6             spc_char_std_oper_link is removed from the database
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@old_oper_id		NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@def_reject_rate	FLOAT
		,	@display_seq		INT
		,	@check_inv			BIT
		,	@sched_to_ent_id	INT
		,	@oper_type			NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@oper_cost			FLOAT
		,	@assoc_file			NVARCHAR(254)
		,	@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(20)
		,	@notes				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@data_log_grp_id	INT
		,	@spare1				NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@spare2				NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@spare3				NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@spare4				NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@last_edit_at		DATETIME
		,	@err_str			NVARCHAR(160)
		,	@deviation_above	FLOAT
		,	@deviation_below	FLOAT
		,	@created_at			DATETIME

	IF (@existing_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1  Should not be Null{3329},Existing_Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@new_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1  Should not be Null{3329},New_Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM std_oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},existing Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM std_oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = @new_oper_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 already exist in the database.{4675},new Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @created_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ) ELSE SET @created_at = @last_edit_at

	--@existing_process_id=process_id, @existing_oper_id=oper_id, @oper_desc=oper_desc, @notes=notes,
	SELECT @def_reject_rate=def_reject_rate, @check_inv=check_inv ,@sched_to_ent_id=sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type=oper_type, @oper_cost=oper_cost
		,@deviation_above=deviation_above, @deviation_below=deviation_below
		,@assoc_file=assoc_file, @assoc_file_type=assoc_file_type, @notes = notes
		,@spare1=spare1, @spare2=spare2, @spare3=spare3, @spare4=spare4
	FROM std_oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	EXEC sp_I_Std_Oper @new_oper_id, @new_oper_desc, @def_reject_rate,
		@check_inv, @sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type, @oper_cost, @deviation_above, @deviation_below, @assoc_file,
		@notes, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, null, @std_oper_last_edit_at OUTPUT

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
    SELECT DISTINCT  (select row_id from std_oper where oper_id = @new_oper_id) as key_id, 2 as key_type
		,	des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period, des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq
		,	des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1, des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3
		,	des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2, des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4
		,	des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN std_oper ON des.key_id = std_oper.row_id
	WHERE key_type = 2 and oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_attr (oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_attr
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_ent_link (oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time, init_prod_pct,
		last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time, init_prod_pct,
		@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_ent_link
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_step_grp (oper_id, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc,
		step_grp_seq, repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_grp
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added "reqd_rep_pct," 2 places in following statement KRF 1/16/07
	-- Uncommented "form_name," in 2 places in following statement RWB 07/08/2009
	INSERT INTO std_oper_step
	(
		oper_id, step_no, step_seq, step_name, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data,
		step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, /*script_id, */data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit,
		low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	SELECT	@new_oper_id, step_no, step_seq, step_name, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data,
			step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, /*script_id, */data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit,
			low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	DECLARE @each_std_oper_step_des TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime,
			step_no int
		)

	DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
			@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
			@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40),  @t_last_edit_at datetime, @t_step_no int, @i int, @max_i int

	DELETE FROM @each_std_oper_step_des

	INSERT INTO @each_std_oper_step_des
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
		step_no
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT des.key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
		des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
		des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
		des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at, sos.step_no
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN std_oper_step sos ON des.key_id = sos.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 3 AND sos.oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_std_oper_step_des

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @t_step_no = step_no FROM @each_std_oper_step_des WHERE id = @i

		SELECT @t_key_id = sos.row_id
		FROM std_oper_step sos
		WHERE sos.oper_id = @new_oper_id AND sos.step_no = @t_step_no

		SELECT	@t_key_type = 3, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
			,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
			,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
			,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
			,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
			,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
			,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		FROM @each_std_oper_step_des
		WHERE id = @i

		INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
		(
			key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
			last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
			number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
			@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
			@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
			@last_edit_by,  @last_edit_at
		)

		SET @i = (@i + 1)
	END

	-- copy std_oper_step_choice records
	INSERT INTO std_oper_step_choice ( oper_id, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT	@new_oper_id, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_choice
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_step_file (oper_id, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_file
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_step_ent_exc (oper_id, step_no, ent_id, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, step_no, ent_id, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_ent_exc
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_spec_ver (oper_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_spec_ver
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO std_oper_ent_spec (oper_id, step_no, ent_id, ver_id, spec_id, spec_value,
		assoc_file, assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_oper_id, step_no, ent_id, ver_id, spec_id, spec_value, assoc_file,
		assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_ent_spec
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO res_std_oper_link (res_id, oper_id, qty_reqd, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT res_id, @new_oper_id, qty_reqd, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM res_std_oper_link
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO cert_std_oper_link (cert_name, oper_id, cert_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @new_oper_id, cert_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_std_oper_link
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO cert_std_oper_step_link (cert_name, oper_id, step_no, cert_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @new_oper_id, step_no, cert_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_std_oper_step_link
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added 10/24/2006 to clone data_log_grp_std_oper_link records per HD call 8953
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_std_oper_link (grp_id, oper_id, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT grp_id, @new_oper_id, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_link
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added 02/05/2008 CR L00074730 to clone data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk records....
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk ( grp_id, oper_id, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT grp_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk
	WHERE oper_id = @existing_oper_id

END

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples]
(@ent_id                            INT32 = NULL
,@event_time_utc                    TDATETIME = NULL
,@event_type                        INT32 = 0
,@freq_of_sample_update             INT32 = 0
,@return_spec_plan_freq_context     LOGICAL = 0
,@time_zone_bias_value              INT = 0
,@job_pos                           INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples
-- Description    - The purpose of this stored procedure is to generate samples using the spec, sample plan frequencies.
-- Author         - Raghu G
-- Date Created       - 12/06/2011
-- Version        - 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date Change By  Ver.   Changes
-- 01/06/2014  Ibrahim    4.6    CR 128221 Fix. Added code to delete qm_context record in a scenario where samples generated are associated with QM Spec is by entity.
-- 10/10/2014  RWB        5.0    Story 401888, removed the call to sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples to eliminate deadlocks that were
--                               occuring in the production count frequency when multiple entities were producing at the same
--                               time.
-- 08/21/2015  Varun	  5.2	 CR L00137945 Merge changes (HF CR #L00137567).Long running execution with no automatic sample plans
-- 09/01/2015  Shravanthi 5.2	 CR L00137945 (HF CR #L00137567).Add a condition to that if statement that there are no future samples.
-- 06/16/2016  Malleswara 5.03	 US 619684 - As Bruce I want to redesign the code for deciding if samples need to be regenerated
--								 based on QM spec effectivity so that it runs faster.
-- 07/28/2016  Malleswara 5.03	 US#662168 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to fix MES Quality CR L00141584 (regression in shift sample generation).
-- 02/03/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 754651 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00143704 (HF CR L00143488: SR 19912585 An issue with the SRO object not connecting after a switchover of AOS.)
-- 02/07/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 928814 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00146852 (HF CR L00146752: QM auto samples not being generated randomly.)
-- 09/14/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 1082564 - As SE, I want to merge in hotfixes related to Sample Generation
-- 05/07/2019	Srinivasa	6.1	UserStory: 1165990 - Merge HF-CR L00153037: Moved freq_type up in ORDER BY to properly handle calendar and shift based frequencies.
-- 10/15/2019	RaghuG		6.2	UserStory: 1227579 - MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00155160 (HF CR L00154527: SR103161479 -  sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples generates extraneous samples)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Parameter Definitions:
-- EntID                    : The entity for which the samples are collected.  I.e. the supplied entity must be capable of collecting QM data.
--                            The purpose of this parameter is to filter out other entities that are not related to an event that occurred on this entity.
--                            For example, a job start event on an entity might only require samples to be generated only for that entity
--                            If this parameter contains a null value, then all entities that have can_capture_qm_data set to true are handled.
--                            Defaults to NULL.
--
-- EventTimeUTC             : The time of the event (in UTC).  For example, if a job is started, then the start time (in UTC) of that job is supplied
--                            to generate samples using this time.  Defaults to current datetime, if NULL is supplied.
--
-- EventType                :   0: ShiftStart (Regenerate all the samples using the shift_start_time)
--                              1: Extend Future Samples (Calendar frequency)
--                            3: Record Production
--				4: Represents shift change, but will be reset back to 0 with generate_samples_for_shifts flag set to true.
--                              6: Lot number of the main production item changes
--                              8: JobStart
--                           20: JobEnd
--                            201: JobPause. Similar to JobEnd freqency except that samples for job_end frequency won't be generated when a job is paused.
--				Clears samples related to job context and replaces with samples having entity_only context
--                            100: Regenerate all the samples as of current date time.
--                            102: Start Quantity Change
--
--                            Defaults to 1.
--
--                            The type of event that is triggered.  For example, if the type of event is job start, then the SP has to generate samples related to job(s).
--                            Similarly, if the type of event is entity runtime, then this SP has to generate samples related to entity's runtime.
--                            However, if this event type is set to 0, then regenerate all the samples for all the entities.
--
--                             0 - Regenerate All the Samples: Builds future samples from scratch. When this parameter is set to false,
--                                 it ignores the supplied event type and all the existing records in the sample_to_go and sample_char_link_to_go tables,
--                                 but builds all the future samples as if they don't exist.  This setting is normally set to 0 when this SP is called
--                                 during the shift change event and uses the shift_start_time as the trigger time to generate future samples.
--                             1 - Extend Future Samples:  The current set of existing future samples in the sample_to_go and sample_char_link_to_go are extended.
--                                 Normally, when the middleware service calls this stored procedure, this parameter is set to true to only extend
--                                 few samples.  However, when the db_status.regen_samples is set to true, then this field is
--                                 automatically reset to false after completing this SP.
--                                 The following frequencies are handled when this parameter is set to 1 and the OFFSET_END IS NOT NULL:
--                                 Calendar Time (2), Run Time (3), Production (4)
--                           3 - Update QM_Context_Link records associated with the job for all frequencies.  The production count
--                               will either be incremented if production is being added or decremented if production is being
--                               reduced.  The job_pos must be supplied in order to find the job information in the job_exec table.
--                             6 - Lot Change: One or more samples (if each sample qualify for a different sample name) are generated when the lot number of the BOM 0 record is changed.
--                             8 - Job Start: The samples are generated for the jobs that are started and they don't exist in the sample_to_go table.
--                              Any characteristic that qualifies for this job and is accounted for the entity-only context is removed from the entity-only context,
--                               and added to the job's context.
--                            20 - Job End: Removes all the records from the sample_to_go and sample_char_link tables for the jobs that no longer
--                                 run on the supplied entity. Also, creates samples for the entity-only context for the overlapping characteristics
--                               that are no longer used by any other jobs and these characteristics are configured for a spec that qualifies this entity.
--                               Creates one or more ready samples, if the job qualifies for the spec that has a job end frequency linked to it.
--                           100 - Similar to EventType 0, except that all the future samples are generated as of the current date time
--                                 Typically set to this type when the master/definition (For example, qm_spec, qm_spec_char_link, sample_plan, etc.) is changed.
--                                 When the definition data is changed in the middle of the shift, then there is no need to generate samples for the time in the past.
--                               For example, let's say the shift is between 6a - 2p, and a sample plan frequency is configured to generate samples every hour in the shift.
--                                 If the definition data is changed at 9:15, then no samples prior to 9:15 would be generated.  Therefore, the next set of samples for
--                                 this shift would be 10, 11, 12 and 13.
--                           201 - Job Pause: Removes all the records from the sample_to_go and sample_char_link tables for the jobs that no longer
--                                 run on the supplied entity. Also, creates samples for the entity-only context for the overlapping characteristics
--                               that are no longer used by any other jobs and these characteristics are configured for a spec that qualifies this entity.
--                           102 - Start Quantity Change: Regenerate the samples based on the new starting quantity.  There should be n + 1 samples
--                                 generated, where n is the number of samples needed for the start quantity.  The '+1' is for potential overproduction.
--
-- FreqOfSampleUpdate          : Represents the frequency with which the service calls this stored procedure.  If a QM spec becomes active
--                               since the service called this stored procedure last time, then the samples from all the specs that affects
--                               the entities are regenerated.  Defaults to 0.
--
-- ReturnSamplePlanFreqContext : This parameter is for debugging purposes. Since all the qm_specs, sample plan frequencies are obtained to generate samples
--                               and there can be a lot of different combinations of qm_specs (with start_eff, end_eff, context, etc.) that can be used with
--                               different sample plan frequencies, there is no easy way to determine which qm_specs are used to generate samples,
--                               unless a dataset containing the details of spec information is used to generate samples.
--                               So, when this parameter is set to true, it returns a dataset containing the following columns
--                               with all the information that is used to generate samples:
--                               ent_id, ent_name, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_end_time_utc, context_ent_id, qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, spec_priority,
--                               plan_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, process_id, item_category_id, freq_id, freq_type, sample_freq.*
--                               Defaults to 0.
--
-- The priority of the specifications are considered as follows.  The lower the priority number, the higher the spec priority is.
-- A specification related to an operation context is preferred than the specification related to an item context,
-- which is preferred than the specification related to an entity context.
-- Therefore, the characteristics related to the higher specs are accounted first before the characteristics are accounted for the lower level specs.
-- Since the calendar frequency ought to have samples for a characteristic since that characteristic was last accounted, the calendar frequency is
-- always executed at the end (i.e. the calendar frequency is accounted after generating samples using all the frequencies except calendar frequency).
--
-- Priority Group/Specification Context                              Spec Priority
--
-- oper_id (with or without process), item_id, ent_id                     1
-- oper_id (with or without process), item_category_id, ent_id            2
--
-- oper_id (with or without process), item_id                             3
-- oper_id (with or without process), item_category_id                    4
-- oper_id (with or without process), ent_id                              5
--
-- item_id, ent_id                                                        6
-- item_category_id, ent_id                                               7
--
-- oper_id                                                                8
-- item_id                                                                9
-- item_category_id                                                       10
--
-- ent_id                                                                 11

-- Flow of this Stored Procedure
--  1. Exit if a non null entity is supplied and that entity is not configured to collect QM data.
--  2. Initialize defaults.
--  3. If this SP is called from the middleware service (event_type: 1 to extend future samples),
--     verify whether the regen_samples flag in the db_status is set to true, and if yes, then reset the event_type to 0.
--     to regenerate all the future samples; otherwise only extend the future samples for which the frequency type is 2,3 or 4
--     and offsent_end is not null.
--  4. Get the QM spec for all the jobs that are currently running on the entities.
--  5. If a non null context entity is specified, then loop through the parent entities to find the matching spec for each job.
--  6. Get a list of specs from entity only context.
--  7. Retrieve all the descendant entities for which the specs obtained from the entity only context are applicable.
--  8. Retrieve all the sample plans from the characteristics that overrides the sample plans from the specs.
--  9. If the stored procedure is called to return the dataset containing all the specs, sample plans, frequencies, jobs, etc.,
--     then return the dataset and exit.
-- 10. Handle the pre-conditions for each event type, if applicable.
-- 11. Generate samples for an entity.
-- 12. Remove entries in the qm context table, if jobs are ended on this entity.
-- 13. Reset the flag in the db_status table if this flag was set to true and the regenerate_future_samples flag was set to true.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

    -- BEGIN CR L00137945 Merge changes: Check if there is at least one non-manual sample_plan_freq_link
	IF NOT EXISTS (select sf.freq_name from sample_freq sf with (nolock) join sample_plan_freq_link spfl with (nolock) on spfl.freq_id = sf.freq_id where sf.freq_type <> 19 and sf.enabled = 1) AND (select count(*) from sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)) = 0
	BEGIN
		RETURN
	END
	-- END CR L00137945 Merge changes
BEGIN

	--The purpose of this table is to hold the ent_id, ent_name, entity context where the spec is obtained from, spec_id, plan_id, priority of the spec, details of the job, etc.
	DECLARE @SpecContextSamplePlan TABLE (qm_ent_id INT, parent_ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80), preferred_parent BIT
					       , context_ent_id INT, can_capture_qm_data BIT
					       , qm_spec_id INT, qm_spec_name NVARCHAR(80), start_eff_utc DATETIME, end_eff_utc DATETIME, plan_id INT, ent_hierarchy INT, spec_priority INT
					       , wo_id NVARCHAR(80), oper_id NVARCHAR(80), seq_no INT, item_id NVARCHAR(80)
					       , spec_exists BIT, plan_override BIT, regenerate_samples BIT, active_qm_spec BIT, rownumber INT
					       --, INDEX IX_SamplePlan_qm_ent_id NONCLUSTERED(qm_ent_id)
					       )

     DECLARE @Sample_Flag TABLE (row_id int, sample_id int)

    -- The purpose of this table is to handle left-over production that should be considered for a production
    -- count frequency when a job is started
    DECLARE @left_over_production    TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INT, context_ent_id INT, context_item_id NVARCHAR(40), context_item_category_id INT, context_process_id NVARCHAR(40), context_oper_id NVARCHAR(40), freq_id INT, init_prod_count FLOAT)

    DECLARE @ent_hierarchy               INT32

           , @qm_ent_id                  INT32
           , @ent_name                      STRING80
           , @context_ent_id             INT32
           , @qm_spec_id                 INT32
           , @qm_spec_name                  STRING80
           , @spec_priority              INT32
           , @plan_id                    INT32
           , @plan_name                  STRING40
           , @reset_option                  INT32
           , @qm_spec_end_eff_utc        TDATETIME
           , @sample_name_template          STRING80
           , @wo_id                      STRING80
           , @oper_id                    STRING80
           , @seq_no                     INT32
           , @item_id                    STRING80
           , @context_item_id            STRING80
           , @item_category_id           INT32
           , @process_id                 STRING80
           , @context_oper_id            STRING80
           , @freq_id                    INT32
           , @freq_name                  STRING40
           , @freq_type                  INT32
           , @sample_interval_sec        TFLOAT
           , @interval_unit              INT32
           , @samples_per_shift          INT32
           , @user_id                    STRING80
           , @offset_start_sec              INT32
           , @offset_end_sec            INT32
           , @expiry_interval_min        INT32
           , @warning_interval_min          INT32
           , @shift_start_time_utc          TDATETIME
           , @shift_end_time_utc         TDATETIME
           , @plan_override              LOGICAL
           , @can_capture_qm_data        LOGICAL
           , @regenerate_future_samples  LOGICAL
           , @sample_start_time_utc      TDATETIME
           , @temp_event_time_utc        TDATETIME
           , @start_eff_utc              TDATETIME
           , @regenerate_samples         BIT
           , @est_prod_rate              TFLOAT
           , @prod_uom                      INT32
           , @batch_size                 TFLOAT
           , @total_prod                 TFLOAT
           , @prod_since_last_sample     TFLOAT
           , @mult_of_interval              INT32
           , @context_id                 INT32
           , @ready_prod_count_sample       BIT
           , @context_update_flag        INT32
           , @remaining_prod             TFLOAT
           , @prod_offset_end_sec        INT32
           , @first_prod_sample_sec      TFLOAT
           , @sum_prod_count             TFLOAT
           , @maximum_min_sample_size       INT32
           , @init_prod_count            TFLOAT
           , @prod_reset_option          INT32
           , @prod_item_id                  STRING40
           , @allow_sample_gen_for_ent      BIT
           , @wait_time_for_delayed_prod INT32
           ,@freq_to_call_sample_updates    INT32
           , @generate_samples_for_shift_change	BIT
           , @in_event_time_utc		TDATETIME

    SELECT @freq_to_call_sample_updates = CONVERT(INT,attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 417

    --Step  1: Exit if a non null entity is supplied and that entity is not configured to collect QM data.
    --Verify whether an entity ID is supplied
    IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
       --An entity ID is supplied, verify whether supplied entity can capture QM data.
       --If it does not, then this stored procedure does not have to perform complex queries only to find out it does not capture qm data.
       SELECT @can_capture_qm_data = e.can_capture_qm_data FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

       --If this entity is not configured to collect qm data, then return.
       IF (COALESCE(@can_capture_qm_data, 0) = 0) BEGIN
           IF (@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0) RETURN
           ELSE BEGIN
               SELECT x.
               * FROM
                  (SELECT NULL AS ent_id, NULL AS ent_name, NULL AS cur_shift_id, NULL AS cur_shift_start_time_utc, NULL AS cur_shift_start_time_local
                  , NULL AS cur_shift_end_time_utc, NULL AS cur_shift_end_time_local
                  , NULL AS context_ent_id, NULL AS qm_spec_id, NULL AS qm_spec_name
                  , NULL AS spec_priority
                  , NULL AS plan_id, NULL AS plan_override, NULL AS end_eff_utc
                  , NULL AS sample_name, NULL AS wo_id, NULL AS oper_id, NULL AS seq_no, NULL AS item_id
                  , NULL AS context_item_id, NULL AS item_category_id, NULL AS process_id, NULL AS context_oper_id
                  , NULL AS freq_id, NULL AS freq_name, NULL AS freq_type
                  , NULL AS sample_interval_sec, NULL AS interval_unit, NULL AS offset_start_unit_sec, NULL AS offset_end_unit_sec
                  , NULL AS samples_per_shift, NULL AS expiry_unit_min, NULL AS warning_unit_min) x WHERE 1 = 0
               RETURN
           END
       END
    END

    --Step  2: Initialize defaults.
    SET @event_time_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_utc, GETUTCDATE())
    SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@event_time_utc)
    SET @in_event_time_utc = @event_time_utc

    --Verify whether the supplied event time is 1 minute behind the current datetime.
    --Some of the job changes (batch jobs) or the shift changes may take close to a minute.
    --So, allow 1 minute buffer to allow the shift changes or the job changes (batch jobs) to complete.
    --However, if the event datetime is more than a minute in the past, then reset the event time to current event datetime.
    IF (@event_time_utc < DATEADD(MI, -1, GETUTCDATE()))
       SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

    --Default the event type to 1 to extend the future samples as of current date and time, unless this parameter is explicitly set to a value.
    --Similarly, default the return spec plan freq context parameter to false, unless it is explicitly set to true to return a dataset.
    SELECT @event_type = COALESCE(@event_type, 1), @return_spec_plan_freq_context = COALESCE(@return_spec_plan_freq_context, 0)
       , @freq_of_sample_update = COALESCE(@freq_of_sample_update, 30), @regenerate_future_samples = 0
       , @generate_samples_for_shift_change = COALESCE(@generate_samples_for_shift_change, 0)

	IF (@event_type = 4) SELECT @event_type = 0, @generate_samples_for_shift_change = 1

    --Step  3: If this SP is called from the middleware service (event_type: 1 to extend future samples) or in the context of shift change,
    --         verify whether the regen_samples flag in the db_status is set to true.
    --         If this flag in the db_status is true and the event_type is 1, then reset the event type to 100 to regenerate all the future samples
    --         as of current datetime; otherwise only extend the future samples for which the frequency type is 2,3 or 4
    --         and offsent_end is not null
    IF (@event_type = 0 OR @event_type = 1) BEGIN
       --Retrieve the boolean flag to determine whether or not to regenerate future samples.
       SELECT @regenerate_future_samples = ds.regen_samples FROM db_status ds WITH (NOLOCK)

       --If the flag is set to 1, reset the event type to 100 to re-generate all the future samples as of current datetime.
       IF (@regenerate_future_samples = 1 AND @event_type = 1) SET @event_type = 100
    END

    --Get the list of jobs running on an entity that can collect QM data AND verify whether those jobs (operation or item) have QM Specs attached to them.
    SET @ent_hierarchy = 1

    --Step  4: Get the QM spec for all the jobs that is running on the entities.
    --The spec_exists flag in the @SpecContextSamplePlan table determines whether the specification context has a valid context to generate samples.
    INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, parent_ent_id, ent_name, preferred_parent, context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data
       , qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc,  plan_id, ent_hierarchy
       , spec_priority
       , wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id
       , spec_exists)

    --Get the list of specifications that have the context operations matching the oper_id of the running jobs.
    SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, 0, qs.ent_id, 1
       , qs.qm_spec_id, qs.qm_spec_name, qs.start_eff_utc, qs.end_eff_utc, qs.plan_id, 1
       --Determine whether this specification is for operation only context or operation-entity context.
       , CASE WHEN qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 5 -- oper_id, ent_id context
              ELSE 8 END  -- oper_id only context
       , j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id
       --If a specification context contains a non-null entity, then verify whether the context_ent_id is same as the run_on entity.
       , CASE WHEN (qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL AND je.ent_id = qs.ent_id) OR qs.ent_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM (SELECT je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no
         FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
         WHERE (je.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
           AND ((@event_type NOT IN (6, 8, 20) AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
            OR  ((@event_type = 6 OR @event_type = 3 OR @event_type = 102) AND je.job_pos = @job_pos AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL))
          UNION
          SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id AS cur_wo_id, jh.oper_id AS cur_oper_id, jh.seq_no AS cur_seq_no
          FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = je.ent_id AND jh.job_pos = je.job_pos AND jh.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND jh.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND jh.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
          WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
            AND jh.job_start_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND @event_type = 8
          UNION
          SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id AS cur_wo_id, jh.oper_id AS cur_oper_id, jh.seq_no AS cur_seq_no
          FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
          WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
            AND jh.job_end_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND @event_type = 20) je
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
    INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
    --The operation context for a spec must match the oper_id of the running job.
    INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.oper_id = j.oper_id
    WHERE (je.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
      AND ((wo.process_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.process_id = qs.process_id)
       OR (wo.process_id IS NULL))
      AND qs.item_id IS NULL AND qs.item_category_id IS NULL
      AND e.can_capture_qm_data = 1
      AND qs.start_eff_utc <= @event_time_utc
      AND (qs.end_eff_utc > @event_time_utc OR qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL)
    UNION
    --Get the list of specifications that have the context items matching the item_id of the running jobs.
    SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, 0, qs.ent_id, 1
       , qs.qm_spec_id, qs.qm_spec_name, qs.start_eff_utc, qs.end_eff_utc, qs.plan_id, 1
       , CASE WHEN qs.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 -- oper_id, item_id, ent_id context
              WHEN qs.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.ent_id IS NULL THEN 3 -- oper_id, item_id context
              WHEN qs.oper_id IS NULL AND qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 6   -- item_id, ent_id context
              ELSE 9 END  -- item_id context
       , j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id
       --If a specification context contains a non-null entity, then verify whether the context_ent_id is same as the run_on entity.
       , CASE WHEN (qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL AND je.ent_id = qs.ent_id) OR qs.ent_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM (SELECT je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no
         FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
         WHERE (je.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
           AND ((@event_type NOT IN (6, 8, 20) AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
            OR  ((@event_type = 6 OR @event_type = 3 OR @event_type = 102) AND je.job_pos = @job_pos AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL))
	  UNION
          SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id AS cur_wo_id, jh.oper_id AS cur_oper_id, jh.seq_no AS cur_seq_no
          FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = je.ent_id AND jh.job_pos = je.job_pos AND jh.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND jh.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND jh.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
          WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
            AND jh.job_start_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND @event_type = 8
          UNION
          SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id AS cur_wo_id, jh.oper_id AS cur_oper_id, jh.seq_no AS cur_seq_no
          FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
          WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
            AND jh.job_end_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND @event_type = 20) je
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
    INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
    --The item context for a spec must match the item_id of the running job.
    INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.item_id = j.item_id
    WHERE (je.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
       AND ((wo.process_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.process_id = qs.process_id)
       OR (qs.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.process_id IS NULL) OR qs.process_id IS NULL)
       AND (j.oper_id = qs.oper_id OR qs.oper_id IS NULL)
       AND e.can_capture_qm_data = 1
       AND qs.start_eff_utc <= @event_time_utc
       AND (qs.end_eff_utc > @event_time_utc OR qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL)
    UNION
    --Get the list of specifications that have the context item category matching the items that are currently produced by the jobs running on an entity.
    SELECT e.ent_id AS qm_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, 0 AS preferred_parent, qs.ent_id AS context_ent_id, 1 AS can_capture_data
       , qs.qm_spec_id, qs.qm_spec_name, qs.start_eff_utc, qs.end_eff_utc, qs.plan_id, 1
       , CASE WHEN qs.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 2 -- oper_id, item_category_id, ent_id context
              WHEN qs.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.ent_id IS NULL THEN 4 -- oper_id, item_category_id context
              WHEN qs.oper_id IS NULL AND qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL THEN 7   -- item_category_id, ent_id context
              ELSE 10 END AS spec_priority -- item_category_id context
       , j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id
       --If a specification context contains a non-null entity, then verify whether the context_ent_id is same as the run_on entity.
       , CASE WHEN (qs.ent_id IS NOT NULL AND je.ent_id = qs.ent_id) OR qs.ent_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS spec_exists
    FROM (SELECT je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no
         FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
         WHERE (je.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
           AND ((@event_type NOT IN (6, 8, 20) AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
            OR  ((@event_type = 6 OR @event_type = 3 OR @event_type = 102) AND je.job_pos = @job_pos AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL))
	  UNION
          SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id AS cur_wo_id, jh.oper_id AS cur_oper_id, jh.seq_no AS cur_seq_no
          FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = je.ent_id AND jh.job_pos = je.job_pos AND jh.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND jh.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND jh.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
          WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
            AND jh.job_start_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND @event_type = 8
          UNION
          SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id AS cur_wo_id, jh.oper_id AS cur_oper_id, jh.seq_no AS cur_seq_no
          FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
          WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
            AND jh.job_end_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND @event_type = 20) je
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
    INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
    INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
    --The item category context for a spec must match the item category that are linked to the items that are currently produced by the jobs running on an entity.
    INNER JOIN item_category_link icl WITH (NOLOCK) ON icl.item_id = i.item_id
    INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.item_category_id = icl.category_id
    WHERE (je.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
       AND ((wo.process_id IS NOT NULL AND qs.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.process_id = qs.process_id)
       OR (qs.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.process_id IS NULL) OR qs.process_id IS NULL)
       AND (j.oper_id = qs.oper_id OR qs.oper_id IS NULL)
       AND e.can_capture_qm_data = 1
       AND qs.start_eff_utc <= @event_time_utc
       AND (qs.end_eff_utc > @event_time_utc OR qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL)

    --Step 4a: Determine active QM specification
    UPDATE @SpecContextSamplePlan SET active_qm_spec = 1
    -- Find the most recent spec for each spec name and context.
    FROM   (SELECT qs.qm_spec_name AS active_qm_spec_name, MAX(qs.start_eff_utc) AS active_start_eff_utc
           FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
           --Match the QM specifications that are currently obtained with the QM specifications in the qm_spec table
           INNER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
           --Group the qm_specifications by their respective contexts including the job details, because an item, linked to a qm_spec, can be produced my more than one job.
           --Therefore, include the job details, such as wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, to preserve the context information
           GROUP BY qs.qm_spec_name, qs.ent_id, scsp.wo_id, scsp.oper_id, scsp.seq_no, qs.item_id, qs.item_category_id, qs.process_id, qs.oper_id
           ) most_recent_specs
    WHERE qm_spec_name = most_recent_specs.active_qm_spec_name
      AND start_eff_utc = most_recent_specs.active_start_eff_utc

    --Step 4b: Remove QM Specs that are older than the most recent spec for a given spec name and context.
    DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT qs.qm_spec_name active_qm_spec_name
           FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
           INNER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
           GROUP BY qs.qm_spec_name, qs.ent_id, scsp.wo_id, scsp.oper_id, scsp.seq_no, qs.item_id, qs.item_category_id, qs.process_id, qs.oper_id
       ) specs_to_be_removed
    WHERE qm_spec_name = specs_to_be_removed.active_qm_spec_name
      AND COALESCE(active_qm_spec, 0) = 0

    SET @ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy + 1

    --Step 5: Start with all QM entities that have non-null context entity ID (specs assigned to higher level entities)
    --, and retrieve the parent entities to see if there are any QM specs assigned to them.
    INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, parent_ent_id, ent_name
       , preferred_parent
       , context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data
       , qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc, plan_id, ent_hierarchy, spec_priority
       , wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id
       , spec_exists, rownumber)
    SELECT DISTINCT order_of_specs_ent.qm_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.parent_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.ent_name
           , order_of_specs_ent.preferred_parent, order_of_specs_ent.context_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.can_capture_qm_data
           , order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_id, order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_name, order_of_specs_ent.start_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.end_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.plan_id
           , @ent_hierarchy, order_of_specs_ent.spec_priority
           , order_of_specs_ent.wo_id, order_of_specs_ent.oper_id, order_of_specs_ent.seq_no, order_of_specs_ent.item_id
           , CASE WHEN order_of_specs_ent.spec_exists = 1 AND order_of_specs_ent.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           , order_of_specs_ent.rn
    FROM
       (SELECT specs_order.qm_ent_id, specs_order.parent_ent_id, specs_order.ent_name
           , specs_order.preferred_parent, specs_order.context_ent_id, specs_order.can_capture_qm_data
           , specs_order.qm_spec_id, specs_order.qm_spec_name, specs_order.start_eff_utc, specs_order.end_eff_utc, specs_order.plan_id
           , specs_order.spec_priority
           , specs_order.wo_id, specs_order.oper_id, specs_order.seq_no, specs_order.item_id
           , specs_order.spec_exists
           , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY specs_order.qm_ent_id, specs_order.spec_priority,
               specs_order.wo_id, specs_order.oper_id, specs_order.seq_no
               ORDER BY specs_order.spec_exists DESC, specs_order.preferred_parent DESC, specs_order.ent_name) AS rn
       FROM
           (SELECT scsp.qm_ent_id, child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id, parent_ent.ent_name
               , CASE WHEN ent_child.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preferred_parent
               , spec_for_context_ents.context_ent_id, 1 AS can_capture_qm_data
