               , spec_for_context_ents.qm_spec_id, spec_for_context_ents.qm_spec_name, spec_for_context_ents.start_eff_utc, spec_for_context_ents.end_eff_utc, spec_for_context_ents.plan_id
               , spec_for_context_ents.spec_priority
               , spec_for_context_ents.wo_id, spec_for_context_ents.oper_id, spec_for_context_ents.seq_no, spec_for_context_ents.item_id
               , CASE WHEN spec_for_context_ents.qm_spec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS spec_exists
           FROM ent ent_child WITH (NOLOCK)
           INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT qm_ent_id FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE spec_exists = 0 AND context_ent_id IS NOT NULL) scsp ON ent_child.ent_id = scsp.qm_ent_id
           INNER JOIN ent_link child_ents_to_parent_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_child.ent_id = child_ents_to_parent_ents.child_ent_id
           INNER JOIN ent parent_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id
           LEFT OUTER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan spec_for_context_ents ON ent_child.ent_id = spec_for_context_ents.qm_ent_id AND parent_ent.ent_id = spec_for_context_ents.context_ent_id
           ) specs_order
       ) order_of_specs_ent

    --Step  5a: If a non null context entity is specified, then loop through the parent entities to find the matching spec for each job.
    --Loop through all the specs that have non-null context entity ID and those context entity IDs do not match the entities on which the jobs are running.
    --I.e. the context entity IDs configured for specs are parent entity IDs. Therefore, starting from the run-on entity,
    --loop through the parent entities to find an entity that match the context entity of the spec.
    --Find all the specs that are applicable to the Operation/Process AND/OR item AND/OR entity context.
    WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
       SET @ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy + 1

       DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
       WHERE spec_exists = 0
         AND ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy - 2 AND ent_hierarchy > 1

       INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, parent_ent_id, ent_name
           , preferred_parent
           , context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data
           , qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc, plan_id, ent_hierarchy, spec_priority
           , wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id
           , spec_exists, rownumber)
       SELECT DISTINCT order_of_specs_ent.qm_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.parent_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.ent_name
               , order_of_specs_ent.preferred_parent, order_of_specs_ent.context_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.can_capture_qm_data
               , order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_id, order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_name, order_of_specs_ent.start_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.end_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.plan_id
               , @ent_hierarchy, order_of_specs_ent.spec_priority
               , order_of_specs_ent.wo_id, order_of_specs_ent.oper_id, order_of_specs_ent.seq_no, order_of_specs_ent.item_id
               , CASE WHEN order_of_specs_ent.spec_exists = 1 AND order_of_specs_ent.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               , order_of_specs_ent.rn
       FROM
           (SELECT specs_order.qm_ent_id, specs_order.parent_ent_id, specs_order.ent_name
               , specs_order.preferred_parent, specs_order.context_ent_id, specs_order.can_capture_qm_data
               , specs_order.qm_spec_id, specs_order.qm_spec_name, specs_order.start_eff_utc, specs_order.end_eff_utc, specs_order.plan_id
               , specs_order.spec_priority
               , specs_order.wo_id, specs_order.oper_id, specs_order.seq_no, specs_order.item_id
               , specs_order.spec_exists
               , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY specs_order.qm_ent_id, specs_order.spec_priority,
                  specs_order.wo_id, specs_order.oper_id, specs_order.seq_no
                  ORDER BY specs_order.spec_exists DESC, specs_order.preferred_parent DESC, specs_order.ent_name) AS rn
           FROM
               (SELECT spec_for_context_ents.qm_ent_id, child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id, parent_ent.ent_name
                  , CASE WHEN ent_child.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preferred_parent
                  , spec_for_context_ents.context_ent_id, 1 AS can_capture_qm_data
                  , spec_for_context_ents.qm_spec_id, spec_for_context_ents.qm_spec_name, spec_for_context_ents.start_eff_utc, spec_for_context_ents.end_eff_utc, spec_for_context_ents.plan_id
                  , spec_for_context_ents.spec_priority
                  , spec_for_context_ents.wo_id, spec_for_context_ents.oper_id, spec_for_context_ents.seq_no, spec_for_context_ents.item_id
                  , CASE WHEN spec_for_context_ents.qm_spec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS spec_exists
               FROM ent ent_child WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT parent_ent_id FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy - 1) scsp ON ent_child.ent_id = scsp.parent_ent_id
               INNER JOIN ent_link child_ents_to_parent_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_child.ent_id = child_ents_to_parent_ents.child_ent_id
               INNER JOIN ent parent_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id
               LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE ent_hierarchy = 1) spec_for_context_ents ON parent_ent.ent_id = spec_for_context_ents.context_ent_id
               ) specs_order
           ) order_of_specs_ent

       IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0 OR @ent_hierarchy >= 25) BREAK
    END -- End of while loop

    --Remove all the jobs that do not have valid specs.
    --Similarly, remove all the specs that are assigned to an entity that is not a preferred parent or that entity does not appear first in the alphabetical order.
    DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
    WHERE spec_exists = 0

    --For story 139192, removed the restriction of not looking for an entity only context on
    --job start.
    -- Also added code to populate the job information if there is a job running on the entity
    -- and code to get the item produced by the job if one is running in the entity
    IF (@event_type <> 6) BEGIN
       --Step  6: Get a list of specs from entity only context
       --Find all the specs that are applicable to the ENTITY ONLY context
       --The records from the query below represent the specs assigned to the context entity.
       SET @ent_hierarchy = 1
       INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, parent_ent_id, ent_name, preferred_parent, context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data
           , qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc, plan_id, ent_hierarchy, spec_priority, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id)
       SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, 0, e.ent_id, e.can_capture_qm_data, qs.qm_spec_id, qs.qm_spec_name, qs.start_eff_utc, qs.end_eff_utc, qs.plan_id, 1 as ent_hierarchy, 11, job_exec.cur_wo_id, job_exec.cur_oper_id, job_exec.cur_seq_no, job.item_id
       FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = qs.ent_id
       -- Only look to the first job position for now, but we may need to look at others later
       LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id AND job_exec.job_pos = 0
       LEFT OUTER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.cur_wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_exec.cur_oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_exec.cur_seq_no = job.seq_no
       WHERE qs.start_eff_utc <= @event_time_utc
         AND (qs.end_eff_utc > @event_time_utc OR qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL)
         --Filter the specs that are only applicable to the entity only context
         AND qs.item_id IS NULL AND qs.item_category_id IS NULL AND qs.process_id IS NULL AND qs.oper_id IS NULL
               AND @event_type <> 20
        UNION
        SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, 0, e.ent_id, e.can_capture_qm_data, qs.qm_spec_id, qs.qm_spec_name, qs.start_eff_utc, qs.end_eff_utc, qs.plan_id, 1 as ent_hierarchy, 11, jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no, jh.item_id
        FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = qs.ent_id
        INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = jh.ent_id
        WHERE qs.start_eff_utc <= @event_time_utc
            AND jh.job_end_utc = @in_event_time_utc
            AND (qs.end_eff_utc > @event_time_utc OR qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL)
            --Filter the specs that are only applicable to the entity only context
            AND qs.item_id IS NULL AND qs.item_category_id IS NULL AND qs.process_id IS NULL AND qs.oper_id IS NULL
            AND @event_type = 20

       --Step 6a: Determine active QM specification
       UPDATE @SpecContextSamplePlan SET active_qm_spec = 1
       -- Find the most recent spec for each spec name and context.
       FROM   (SELECT qs.qm_spec_name AS active_qm_spec_name, MAX(qs.start_eff_utc) AS active_start_eff_utc
               FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
               --Match the QM specifications that are currently obtained with the QM specifications in the qm_spec table
               INNER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
               WHERE qs.item_id IS NULL AND qs.item_category_id IS NULL AND qs.process_id IS NULL AND qs.oper_id IS NULL
               GROUP BY qs.qm_spec_name, qs.ent_id
               ) most_recent_specs
       WHERE qm_spec_name = most_recent_specs.active_qm_spec_name
         AND start_eff_utc = most_recent_specs.active_start_eff_utc

       --Step 6b: Remove QM Specs that are older than the most recent spec for a given spec name and context.
       DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
       FROM (SELECT DISTINCT qs.qm_spec_name active_qm_spec_name
               FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
               WHERE qs.item_id IS NULL AND qs.item_category_id IS NULL AND qs.process_id IS NULL AND qs.oper_id IS NULL
               --Group the qm_specifications by their respective contexts, entity only context in this case
               GROUP BY qs.qm_spec_name, qs.ent_id
           ) specs_to_be_removed
       WHERE qm_spec_name = specs_to_be_removed.active_qm_spec_name
         AND COALESCE(active_qm_spec, 0) = 0

       SET @ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy + 1

       --Step  7: Retrieve all the parent entities of QM entities, starting with all entites that can capture QM data.
       INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, parent_ent_id, ent_name
       , preferred_parent
       , context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data
       , qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc, plan_id, ent_hierarchy, spec_priority
       , spec_exists, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, rownumber)
       SELECT order_of_specs_ent.ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.parent_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.ent_name
               , order_of_specs_ent.preferred_parent, order_of_specs_ent.context_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.can_capture_qm_data
               , order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_id, order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_name, order_of_specs_ent.start_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.end_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.plan_id
               , @ent_hierarchy, 11
               , CASE WHEN order_of_specs_ent.spec_exists = 1 AND order_of_specs_ent.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               , order_of_specs_ent.wo_id, order_of_specs_ent.oper_id, order_of_specs_ent.seq_no, order_of_specs_ent.item_id
               , order_of_specs_ent.rn
       FROM
           (SELECT specs_order.ent_id, specs_order.parent_ent_id, specs_order.ent_name
               , specs_order.preferred_parent, specs_order.context_ent_id, specs_order.can_capture_qm_data
               , specs_order.qm_spec_id, specs_order.qm_spec_name, specs_order.start_eff_utc, specs_order.end_eff_utc, specs_order.plan_id
               , specs_order.spec_exists
               , specs_order.wo_id, specs_order.oper_id, specs_order.seq_no, specs_order.item_id
               , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY specs_order.ent_id ORDER BY specs_order.spec_exists DESC, specs_order.preferred_parent DESC, specs_order.ent_name) AS rn
           FROM
               (SELECT e.ent_id, child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id, parent_ent.ent_name
                  , CASE WHEN e.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preferred_parent
                  , parent_ent.ent_id AS context_ent_id, 1 AS can_capture_qm_data
                  , scsp.qm_spec_id, scsp.qm_spec_name, scsp.start_eff_utc, scsp.end_eff_utc, scsp.plan_id
                  , CASE WHEN scsp.qm_spec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS spec_exists
                  , scsp.wo_id, scsp.oper_id, scsp.seq_no, scsp.item_id
               FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN ent_link child_ents_to_parent_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = child_ents_to_parent_ents.child_ent_id
               INNER JOIN ent parent_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id
               LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE spec_priority = 11) scsp ON parent_ent.ent_id = scsp.context_ent_id
               WHERE (e.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
                 AND e.can_capture_qm_data = 1
               ) specs_order
           ) order_of_specs_ent

       --Step  7a: Retrieve all the parent entities for which the specs obtained from the entity only context are applicable.
       --Using the context obtained from the query above, loop through all the parent entities to which this spec applies to a QM entity.
       WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
           SET @ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy + 1

           --Remove any entities that do not have specs.  Do this to improve performance as there may be lot of entities that do not have specs assigned to them.
           DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
           WHERE spec_exists = 0
             AND ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy - 2

           INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, parent_ent_id, ent_name
           , preferred_parent
           , context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data
           , qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc, plan_id, ent_hierarchy, spec_priority
           , spec_exists, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, rownumber)
           SELECT DISTINCT order_of_specs_ent.qm_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.parent_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.ent_name
                  , order_of_specs_ent.preferred_parent, order_of_specs_ent.context_ent_id, order_of_specs_ent.can_capture_qm_data
                  , order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_id, order_of_specs_ent.qm_spec_name, order_of_specs_ent.start_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.end_eff_utc, order_of_specs_ent.plan_id
                  , @ent_hierarchy, 11
                  , CASE WHEN order_of_specs_ent.spec_exists = 1 AND order_of_specs_ent.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  , order_of_specs_ent.wo_id, order_of_specs_ent.oper_id, order_of_specs_ent.seq_no, order_of_specs_ent.item_id
                  , order_of_specs_ent.rn
           FROM
               (SELECT specs_order.qm_ent_id, specs_order.parent_ent_id, specs_order.ent_name
                  , specs_order.preferred_parent, specs_order.context_ent_id, specs_order.can_capture_qm_data
                  , specs_order.qm_spec_id, specs_order.qm_spec_name, specs_order.start_eff_utc, specs_order.end_eff_utc, specs_order.plan_id
                  , specs_order.spec_exists
                  , specs_order.wo_id, specs_order.oper_id, specs_order.seq_no, specs_order.item_id
                  , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY specs_order.qm_ent_id ORDER BY specs_order.spec_exists DESC, specs_order.preferred_parent DESC, specs_order.ent_name) AS rn
               FROM
                  (SELECT e.qm_ent_id, child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id, parent_ent.ent_name
                      , CASE WHEN ent_child.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preferred_parent
                      , parent_ent.ent_id AS context_ent_id, 1 AS can_capture_qm_data
                      , scsp.qm_spec_id, scsp.qm_spec_name, scsp.start_eff_utc, scsp.end_eff_utc, scsp.plan_id
                      , CASE WHEN scsp.qm_spec_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS spec_exists
                      , scsp.wo_id, scsp.oper_id, scsp.seq_no, scsp.item_id
                  FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan e
                  INNER JOIN ent ent_child WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.context_ent_id = ent_child.ent_id
                  INNER JOIN ent_link child_ents_to_parent_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.context_ent_id = child_ents_to_parent_ents.child_ent_id
                  INNER JOIN ent parent_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON child_ents_to_parent_ents.parent_ent_id = parent_ent.ent_id
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE spec_priority = 11 AND ent_hierarchy = 1) scsp ON parent_ent.ent_id = scsp.context_ent_id
                  WHERE e.ent_hierarchy = @ent_hierarchy - 1
                  ) specs_order
               ) order_of_specs_ent

           IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0 OR @ent_hierarchy >= 25) BREAK
       END -- End of while loop
    END --Do not look for the entity only context if a job is started, paused or ended.

    -- Remove all the entities that do not capture samples.
    DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE can_capture_qm_data = 0 OR spec_exists = 0

    --Step  8: Retrieve all the sample plans from the characteristics that overrides the sample plans from the specs.
    -- Retreive the sample plans that are overridden by the characteristics and flag those plans are overridden by the characteristics.
    INSERT INTO @SpecContextSamplePlan (qm_ent_id, ent_name, preferred_parent, context_ent_id, can_capture_qm_data, parent_ent_id
       , qm_spec_id, plan_id, ent_hierarchy
       , spec_priority, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id
       , spec_exists, plan_override)
    SELECT scsp.qm_ent_id, scsp.ent_name, scsp.preferred_parent, scsp.context_ent_id, scsp.can_capture_qm_data, scsp.parent_ent_id
       , scsp.qm_spec_id, plan_overrides.plan_id, scsp.ent_hierarchy
       , scsp.spec_priority, scsp.wo_id, scsp.oper_id, scsp.seq_no, scsp.item_id
       , CASE WHEN scsp.plan_id = plan_overrides.plan_id THEN 0 ELSE  scsp.spec_exists END
       , CASE WHEN plan_overrides.plan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp
    INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT qscl.qm_spec_id, qscl.plan_id
           FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
           INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
           INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT qm_spec_id FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan) scsp_specs ON scsp_specs.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id
           --Exclude characteristics that are unused (severity = 0)
           WHERE COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0 AND qscl.plan_id IS NOT NULL
       ) plan_overrides ON scsp.qm_spec_id = plan_overrides.qm_spec_id

    -- Remove all the specs that has redundant plan overrides (i.e. spec.plan_id = char.plan_id)
    DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE spec_exists = 0

	IF (@generate_samples_for_shift_change = 0)
	    AND (@event_type IN (1, 100)) --MES Service calls either calls to extend the future samples (EventType:1) OR the system is asked to regenerate all the samples (EventTYpe:100)
		AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id >= 0 AND is_job_running = 2) --Shift change is in progress
		--Therefore, remove all the entities that are affected by the shifts, since the shift change process will regenerate all the samples
		DELETE specContexts
		FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan specContexts
		INNER JOIN (SELECT ent_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE is_job_running = 2) qm_ents
		--The QM entities that are part of the shift change will be removed, since the shift change process will regenerate samples for those entities.
		ON specContexts.qm_ent_id = qm_ents.ent_id

    -- Step  9: If the stored procedure is called to return the dataset containing all the specs, sample plans, frequencies, jobs, etc.,
    --          then return the dataset and exit.
    -- Verify whether this stored procedure is called to return a dataset containing a list of all specs, plans linked to the spec, and frequencies linked to the sample plans.
    IF (@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 1) BEGIN
       --Return a dataset containing a list of all specs, plans, sample frquencies, etc.
       SELECT qm_ent_id AS ent_id, ent_name, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local, cur_shift_end_time_utc, cur_shift_end_time_local
                  , wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, spec_priority
                  , process_id, context_oper_id, context_item_id, item_category_id, category_name
                  , context_ent_id, context_ent_name, qm_spec_id, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc, qm_spec_name
                  , end_eff_utc, plan_override, plan_id, plan_name, reset_option, sample_name
                  , freq_id, freq_name, freq_type, sample_interval_sec, interval_unit
                  , plan_override, plan_id, plan_name, reset_option, sample_name
                  , freq_id, freq_name, freq_type, sample_interval_sec, interval_unit
                  , offset_start_unit_sec, offset_end_unit_sec
                  , samples_per_shift, expiry_unit_min, warning_unit_min, spec_exists, ent_hierarchy, rownumber
       FROM
           (SELECT scsp.qm_ent_id, e.ent_name, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, e.cur_shift_end_time_utc, e.cur_shift_end_time_local
                  , scsp.context_ent_id, CASE WHEN scsp.context_ent_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE scsp.ent_name END AS context_ent_name
                  , scsp.qm_spec_id, scsp.qm_spec_name, scsp.start_eff_utc
                  , scsp.spec_priority, c.category_name
                  , sp.plan_id, sp.plan_name, sp.reset_option
                  , COALESCE(scsp.plan_override, 0) AS plan_override, qs.end_eff_utc
                  , sp.sample_name
                  , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                          ELSE scsp.wo_id
                          END AS wo_id
                  , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                          ELSE scsp.oper_id
                          END AS oper_id
                  , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                          ELSE scsp.seq_no
                          END AS seq_no
                  , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                          ELSE scsp.item_id
                          END AS item_id
                  , qs.item_id AS context_item_id, qs.item_category_id, qs.process_id, qs.oper_id AS context_oper_id
                  , sf.freq_id, sf.freq_name, sf.freq_type
                      --Scale the sample interval time to seconds
                  , CASE WHEN sf.interval_unit = 1 THEN sf.interval * 60 -- Minutes
                          WHEN sf.interval_unit = 2 THEN sf.interval * 3600 -- Hours
                          WHEN sf.interval_unit = 3 THEN sf.interval * 86400 -- Days
                          WHEN sf.interval_unit = 4 THEN sf.interval * 604800 -- Weeks
                          ELSE sf.interval END AS sample_interval_sec -- Seconds
                  , sf.interval_unit
                  , CASE WHEN sf.offset_start IS NULL OR sf.offset_start_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                          ----Scale the offset start time to seconds
                         WHEN sf.offset_start_unit = 1 THEN sf.offset_start * 60 -- Minutes
                         WHEN sf.offset_start_unit = 2 THEN sf.offset_start * 3600 -- Hours
                         ELSE NULL
                         END AS offset_start_unit_sec
                  , CASE WHEN sf.offset_end IS NULL OR sf.offset_end_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                          ----Scale the offset end time to seconds
                         WHEN sf.offset_end_unit = 1 THEN sf.offset_end * 60 -- Minutes
                         WHEN sf.offset_end_unit = 2 THEN sf.offset_end * 3600 -- Hours
                         ELSE NULL
                         END AS offset_end_unit_sec
                  , sf.samples_per_shift
                  , CASE WHEN sf.expiry_time IS NULL OR sf.expiry_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                          ----Scale the expiry time to minutes
                         WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 1 THEN sf.expiry_time -- Minutes
                         WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 2 THEN sf.expiry_time * 60 -- Hours
                         WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 3 THEN sf.expiry_time * 1440 -- Days
                         ELSE NULL
                         END AS expiry_unit_min
                  , CASE WHEN sf.warning_time IS NULL OR sf.warning_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                          ----Scale the warning time to minutes
                         WHEN sf.warning_unit = 1 THEN sf.warning_time -- Minutes
                         WHEN sf.warning_unit = 2 THEN sf.warning_time * 60 -- Hours
                         WHEN sf.warning_unit = 3 THEN sf.warning_time * 1440 -- Days
                         ELSE NULL
                         END AS warning_unit_min
                  , scsp.spec_exists, scsp.ent_hierarchy, scsp.rownumber
           FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp
           INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
           INNER JOIN sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK) ON sp.plan_id = scsp.plan_id
           INNER JOIN sample_plan_freq_link spfl WITH (NOLOCK) ON spfl.plan_id = sp.plan_id
           INNER JOIN sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) ON sf.freq_id = spfl.freq_id
           INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_ent_id = e.ent_id
           LEFT OUTER JOIN category c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.item_category_id = c.category_id
           WHERE (scsp.qm_ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
             -- If event_type is 1 (extend future samples), then the offset_end must have a valid value or the regenerate_samples flag for an entity must be turned on.
             AND --(((@event_type IN (1, 100) AND sf.freq_type IN (1,2,8) AND sf.offset_end IS NOT NULL) OR scsp.regenerate_samples = 1 OR @event_type NOT IN (1,103))
              --Frequent updates should only extend samples or re-generate samples for an entity.
              --Therefore, these type of update should exclude the job start and job end frequencies.
              (
               (((@event_type IN (1, 100) AND sf.offset_end IS NOT NULL) OR scsp.regenerate_samples = 1) AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1))
               --Allow samples to be generated at the start of the shift or the samples to be re-generated during the middle of the shift.
               --Still, do not allow the job start and job end frequencies to be used for these event types.
              --Exclude the frequencies that are not appropriate for the event types.
               OR (@event_type IN (0, 1, 100) AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1))
               --For the production count, only allow production count frequencies
               OR (@event_type IN (0, 1, 3, 100, 102) AND sf.freq_type = 3)
               --For the lot change, only allow the shift and calendar frequency type samples to be generated.
               OR (@event_type = 6 AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1, 6))
               --For the job start event, do not allow the job end frequency to be used.
               OR (@event_type = 8 AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1, 3, 8))
               --When a job is paused (event type: 201), ONLY allow specs that have entity-only context.
               --Also, do not allow the job start and job end frequencies to generate samples.
               OR (@event_type = 201 AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1))
               -- When a job is ended (event type: 20), ONLY allow specs that are linked to sample plan frequency of type 20 or the specs that have entity-only context
               --The reason for including the entity-only context specs is to recreate the overlapping characteristics that are no more used by any jobs
               --, but they are linked to specs that have entity-only context.
               OR (@event_type = 20 AND ((scsp.spec_priority < 11 AND sf.freq_type = 20) OR (scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type IN (0,1)))) )
             -- Only consider Production Count frequencies if there is a job running
             AND (sf.freq_type <> 3 OR (scsp.wo_id IS NOT NULL AND scsp.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND scsp.seq_no IS NOT NULL))
             -- Shift 0 is not a shift, therefore no samples for shift will be generated for the "no shift".
             AND NOT (e.cur_shift_id = 0 AND sf.freq_type = 0)
             --Exclude all the sample frequencies that are disabled.
             AND sf.enabled = 1) spec_freq
       --NOTE: Be careful when changing the order of columns in the order by clause, because the order listed below is very important to generate the samples
       --according to the order of specificity defined in the sample request generation DFS, section: Order of Specificity, 3.3.3
       ORDER BY spec_freq.qm_ent_id
		   , CASE
				WHEN spec_freq.freq_type = 0 THEN 99
				WHEN spec_freq.freq_type = 1 THEN 100
				ELSE spec_freq.freq_type
			 END
		   , COALESCE(spec_freq.wo_id, 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ'), COALESCE(spec_freq.oper_id, 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ')
           , COALESCE(spec_freq.seq_no, 99999999), spec_freq.spec_priority
           , spec_freq.category_name, spec_freq.ent_hierarchy, spec_freq.rownumber
           , spec_freq.start_eff_utc DESC, spec_freq.qm_spec_name
           , spec_freq.sample_interval_sec

       --The request is to return a dataset, hence exit.
       RETURN
    END

    --Step  10: Handle the pre-conditions for each event type, if applicable.
    --If the request is to regenerate all the future samples, then remove all the records from the sample_to_go table.
    IF (@event_type = 0) BEGIN -- Regenerate all the samples
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK))
		     EXEC sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples @ent_id, @time_zone_bias_value

		   --Remove all the future samples (and characteristics)
		   IF (@generate_samples_for_shift_change = 0)
		   --The call is to regenerate all the samples OR extend the future samples
			   --DELETE FROM sample_to_go
			   --WHERE ((ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND (spare4 <> '1' OR spare4 IS NULL))
			   DELETE stg
				FROM sample_to_go stg
				LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE is_job_running = 2) qm_ents
			--The QM entities that are part of the shift change will be removed, since the shift change process will regenerate samples for those entities.
			ON stg.ent_id = qm_ents.ent_id
			--Exclude the entities for which the shifts are currently being changed
			WHERE qm_ents.ent_id IS NULL
			  AND (spare4 <> '1' OR spare4 IS NULL)

			ELSE BEGIN--The call is renegenerate samples for a shift change
				DELETE stg
				FROM sample_to_go stg
				--Remove the future samples only for which the entity shift is being changed
				INNER JOIN qm_context qc WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.ent_id = qc.ent_id
				WHERE qc.is_job_running = 2

				DELETE specContexts
				FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan specContexts
				LEFT JOIN (SELECT ent_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE is_job_running = 2) qm_ents
				--The QM entities that are NOT part of the shift change will be removed, since the purpose is ONLY to generate samples for entities whose shifts are changed
				ON specContexts.qm_ent_id = qm_ents.ent_id
				--Remove the specs for entities whose shifts are not changed in this context
				WHERE qm_ents.ent_id IS NULL
			END
	END
    ELSE IF (@event_type = 1) BEGIN -- Extend Future Samples
       --The purpose is to extend the future samples - typically this call (periodic call) is made by the service.
       --However, verify whether any new spec has become active since the middleware service last called this procedure to extend the future samples.
       --If there are no new specs that became active since the midddleware last called this SP, then continue only to extend the future samples.
       --If there are NEW specs that became active since the middleware last called this SP, then regenerate all the future samples for
       --all the entities for which this spec applies.
       UPDATE @SpecContextSamplePlan SET regenerate_samples = 1
	   WHERE qm_ent_id IN (SELECT qm_ent_id
       FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
       --Allow 15 more seconds.
       --For example, let's say the middleware is setup to call this stored procedure every 30 seconds.  The first call was made at 01:00:00
       --A new spec became active at 01:00:02, but this stored procedure was called at 01:00:29 by StartJob to generate samples for the new job and took 4 seconds to complete.
       --Since the StartJob transaction was holding the sample generation for 3 seconds (i.e. upto 01:00:33), the new spec that became active at 01:00:02 would be missed.
       --Therefore, allow 15 extra seconds to catch up any spec that became active since the middleware last executed this procedure.
       WHERE (start_eff_utc >= DATEADD(SS, -@freq_of_sample_update-15, @event_time_utc)
              AND start_eff_utc <= @event_time_utc)
              OR (end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL AND end_eff_utc >= DATEADD(SS, -@freq_of_sample_update-15, @event_time_utc)
              AND end_eff_utc < @event_time_utc))


       --Remove all the future samples from all the entities for which there is a new spec (i.e. regenerate flag is set to true).
       DELETE sample_to_go
       FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp
       WHERE sample_to_go.ent_id = scsp.qm_ent_id
         AND scsp.regenerate_samples = 1
         AND (sample_to_go.spare4 <> '1' OR sample_to_go.spare4 IS NULL)

       --Remove all the future samples that is greater than the offset time.
       --For example, let's say a sample is requested every minute, and the offset end is configured as 1 minute, i.e. to project 5 samples (or 5 minutes) in the future,
       --and the system parameter is configured to call this SP every 30 seconds.
       --The service calls this SP at 10:00:00 to generate a sample, therefore the first sample is generated at 10:00:00, followed by 10:01:00, 10:02:00, 10:03:00, 10:04:00, 10:05:00
       --When the service calls this SP again at 10:00:30, remove any samples that were generated after 10:04:45 for this frequency, thefore the samples 10:05:00 will be removed and 10:05:00 will be regenerated.
       --When the service calls this SP again at 10:01:00, it removes any samples that were generated after 10:05:15, and it finds nothing, then it regenerates a sample at 10:06:00
       DELETE sample_to_go
       FROM
           (SELECT stg.sample_id
           FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
           INNER JOIN sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.freq_id = sf.freq_id
           WHERE (@event_type = 1 AND sf.freq_type IN (1,2,3) AND sf.offset_end IS NOT NULL AND offset_end_unit IS NOT NULL)
              AND stg.requested_time_utc >= DATEADD(SS, CASE WHEN sf.offset_end_unit = 1 THEN sf.offset_end * 60
                                                          WHEN sf.offset_end_unit = 2 THEN sf.offset_end * 3600
                                                          --Allow 15 more seconds to catch up incase the call to this SP was delayed by ~15 seconds.
                                                          ELSE 0 END-@freq_of_sample_update-15, @event_time_utc)
           ) fut_sampls_to_delete
       WHERE sample_to_go.sample_id = fut_sampls_to_delete.sample_id
		AND (sample_to_go.spare4 <> '1' OR sample_to_go.spare4 IS NULL)
    END

    ELSE IF (@event_type = 100) BEGIN -- Regenerate all the future samples, because the definition data is changed.
       --Remove all the future samples (and characteristics) that are greater than or equal to the supplied event_time_utc.
       DELETE FROM sample_to_go
       WHERE (ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
         AND requested_time_utc >= @event_time_utc
         AND (spare4 <> '1' OR spare4 IS NULL)
    END
    ELSE IF (@event_type = 3) BEGIN -- Main item produced
        -- Get the item that was just produced by the job specified by the supplied job position
       SELECT @prod_item_id = item_id
       FROM item_prod AS ip WITH (NOLOCK)
       INNER JOIN job_exec AS je WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND ip.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND ip.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
       WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id AND je.job_pos = @job_pos AND ip.last_edit_at = @event_time_utc

        -- Reset the production count for any qm_context_link record that has a production count frequency
        -- that resets on main item changes, the last_used_item_id is not the same as the produced item,
        -- and it is linked to a qm_context record that has a context that matches one of the qm_specs that we
        -- are considering
       UPDATE qm_context_link SET production_count = 0
       WHERE row_id in (SELECT qcl.row_id FROM sample_freq AS sf WITH (NOLOCK)
                          INNER JOIN qm_context_link as qcl WITH (NOLOCK) ON sf.freq_id = qcl.freq_id
                          WHERE sf.freq_type = 3
                              AND sf.prod_reset_option = 2
                             AND qcl.last_used_item_id <> @prod_item_id
                              AND qcl.context_id IN
                                 (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context qc WITH (NOLOCK)
                                     INNER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan AS scsp ON qc.ent_id = scsp.qm_ent_id
                                     INNER JOIN qm_spec AS qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
                                     WHERE qc.ent_id = @ent_id
                                         AND qc.is_job_running <> 2
                                         AND (qc.context_ent_id = qs.ent_id OR qs.ent_id IS NULL)
                                         AND (qc.item_id = qs.item_id OR qs.item_id IS NULL)
                                         AND (qc.item_category_id = qs.item_category_id OR qs.item_category_id IS NULL)
                                         AND (qc.process_id = qs.process_id OR qs.process_id IS NULL)
                                         AND (qc.context_oper_id = qs.oper_id OR qs.oper_id IS NULL)))

        -- No update the last_used_item_id for all qm_context_link records that are linked
        -- to a qm_context record for the job specified by the supplied job position
       UPDATE qm_context_link SET last_used_item_id = @prod_item_id
       WHERE row_id in (SELECT qcl.row_id FROM sample_freq AS sf WITH (NOLOCK)
                          INNER JOIN qm_context_link AS qcl WITH (NOLOCK) ON sf.freq_id = qcl.freq_id
                          WHERE sf.freq_type = 3
                              AND qcl.last_used_item_id <> @prod_item_id
                              AND qcl.context_id IN
                                 (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context AS qc WITH (NOLOCK)
                                     INNER JOIN job_exec AS je WITH (NOLOCK) ON qc.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND qc.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND qc.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
                                     WHERE qc.ent_id = @ent_id AND je.ent_id = @ent_id AND je.job_pos = @job_pos AND qc.is_job_running <> 2))

       -- Get rid of future samples for the frequency, we will be regenerating them
       DELETE FROM sample_to_go
       WHERE sample_id IN
               (SELECT sample_id FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
                  INNER JOIN sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.freq_id = sf.freq_id
                  INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND stg.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND stg.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
                  WHERE stg.ent_id = @ent_id
                      AND je.ent_id = @ent_id
                      AND je.job_pos = @job_pos
                      AND sf.freq_type = 3
                      AND (stg.spare4 <> '1' OR stg.spare4 IS NULL)) -- only production count frequencies
    END -- Main item produced

    ELSE IF (@event_type = 6) BEGIN -- The lot number of the main item produced changes
       --Verify whether there are QM specifications for the job context.  If not, exit.
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE qm_ent_id = @ent_id AND spec_priority < 11)
           RETURN

       --Remove all the future samples (and characteristics) related to the supplied job.
       DELETE sample_to_go
       FROM (SELECT stg.sample_id
             FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
             INNER JOIN @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp ON stg.wo_id = scsp.wo_id AND stg.oper_id = scsp.oper_id AND stg.seq_no = scsp.seq_no
             WHERE stg.ent_id = @ent_id
               AND stg.requested_time_utc >= @event_time_utc
            ) remove_samples_for_this_job
       WHERE sample_to_go.sample_id = remove_samples_for_this_job.sample_id
        AND (sample_to_go.spare4 <> '1' OR sample_to_go.spare4 IS NULL)

       --Remove all the characteristics that are accounted for entity-only context, but those are going to be accounted for at least one job.
       DELETE sample_char_link_to_go
       FROM
           (SELECT scltg.sample_id, scltg.char_id
           FROM (SELECT DISTINCT qm_spec_id FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan) scsp
           INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id
           INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
           INNER JOIN sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.char_id = c.char_id
           INNER JOIN sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.sample_id = stg.sample_id
           WHERE COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0
             AND stg.ent_id = @ent_id
             AND stg.wo_id IS NULL AND stg.oper_id IS NULL AND stg.seq_no IS NULL) remove_chars_for_ent_context
       WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.sample_id = remove_chars_for_ent_context.sample_id
         AND sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = remove_chars_for_ent_context.char_id

       --Remove future samples, if there are no characteristics linked to them.
       DELETE sample_to_go
       FROM
           (SELECT stg.sample_id
           FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
           LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.sample_id = scltg.sample_id
           WHERE stg.ent_id = @ent_id
             AND stg.wo_id IS NULL AND stg.oper_id IS NULL AND stg.seq_no IS NULL
             AND scltg.sample_id IS NULL) sampls_to_be_removed
       WHERE sample_to_go.sample_id = sampls_to_be_removed.sample_id
        AND (sample_to_go.spare4 <> '1' OR sample_to_go.spare4 IS NULL)

    END -- The lot number of the main item produced changes

    ELSE IF (@event_type = 8) BEGIN  -- Job Start
       --Event_Type 8: JobStart, Verify whether a future sample exists for a job, and if exists, then continue to the next record
       --Since the event type is 8, this stored procedure is called when one or more jobs are started on this entity.
       --Since there can be more than one jobs started on this entity and this stored procedure do not accept parameters to identify which job is started,
       --verify whether a sample for a job exist for the current specification context, and if it does (assuming a sample was already created for the context of a job)
       --then do not recreate samples for this job, therefore remove those jobs from the collection.
       -- Jobs that are started at the supplied time and it is currently running
       DELETE @SpecContextSamplePlan
       FROM
	       (SELECT running_jobs.ent_id, running_jobs.cur_wo_id, running_jobs.cur_oper_id, running_jobs.cur_seq_no
		, CASE WHEN COALESCE(stg.wo_id, s.wo_id) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END sample_exists
	       FROM
		       (SELECT je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no
		       FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		       INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = je.ent_id AND jh.job_pos = je.job_pos
			 AND jh.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND jh.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND jh.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
		       WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id AND jh.job_start_utc = @event_time_utc
		       ) running_jobs
		       LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.ent_id = running_jobs.ent_id
			AND stg.wo_id = running_jobs.cur_wo_id AND stg.oper_id = running_jobs.cur_oper_id AND stg.seq_no = running_jobs.cur_seq_no AND stg.requested_time_utc = @event_time_utc
		       LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_freq sfstg WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.freq_id = sfstg.freq_id AND sfstg.freq_type = 8
		       LEFT OUTER JOIN sample s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.ent_id = running_jobs.ent_id
		       			AND s.wo_id = running_jobs.cur_wo_id AND s.oper_id = running_jobs.cur_oper_id AND s.seq_no = running_jobs.cur_seq_no AND s.requested_time_utc = @event_time_utc
		       LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_freq sfs WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.freq_id = sfs.freq_id AND sfs.freq_type = 8
		) event_samples
       WHERE qm_ent_id = @ent_id
         AND qm_ent_id = event_samples.ent_id AND wo_id = event_samples.cur_wo_id AND oper_id = event_samples.cur_oper_id AND seq_no = event_samples.cur_seq_no
  	 AND event_samples.sample_exists = 1

       --Verify whether there are QM specifications for the job context.  If not, exit.
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan WHERE qm_ent_id = @ent_id AND spec_priority < 12)
           RETURN

       --Remove all the characteristics that are accounted for entity-only context, but those are going to be accounted for at least one job.
       DELETE sample_char_link_to_go
       FROM
           (SELECT scltg.sample_id, scltg.char_id
           FROM (SELECT DISTINCT qm_spec_id FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan) scsp
           INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id
           INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
           INNER JOIN sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.char_id = c.char_id
           INNER JOIN sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.sample_id = stg.sample_id
           WHERE COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0
             AND stg.ent_id = @ent_id
             AND stg.wo_id IS NULL AND stg.oper_id IS NULL AND stg.seq_no IS NULL) remove_chars_for_ent_context
       WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.sample_id = remove_chars_for_ent_context.sample_id
         AND sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = remove_chars_for_ent_context.char_id

       --Remove future samples, if there are no characteristics linked to them.
       DELETE sample_to_go
       FROM
           (SELECT stg.sample_id
           FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
           LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.sample_id = scltg.sample_id
           WHERE stg.ent_id = @ent_id
             AND stg.wo_id IS NULL AND stg.oper_id IS NULL AND stg.seq_no IS NULL
             AND scltg.sample_id IS NULL) sampls_to_be_removed
       WHERE sample_to_go.sample_id = sampls_to_be_removed.sample_id
        AND (sample_to_go.spare4 <> '1' OR sample_to_go.spare4 IS NULL)
    END -- Job Start

    ELSE IF (@event_type IN (20, 201)) BEGIN -- Job Pause and Job End
       -- Remove all future samples that do not conform to the current specification context (job context).
       -- I.e. remove all samples that are representing a job and a job is no longer running
       DELETE stg
       FROM sample_to_go stg
       INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = stg.ent_id AND jh.wo_id = stg.wo_id AND jh.oper_id = stg.oper_id AND jh.seq_no = stg.seq_no
       WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
         AND jh.job_end_utc = @in_event_time_utc
         AND stg.requested_time_utc >= @in_event_time_utc

       -- Continue to generate samples for the characteristics that belong to the entity-only context,
       -- if no other qm specifications linked to other jobs that are running on this entity have the characteristics linked to them.
       --verify whether a sample for a job exist for the current specification context, and if it does (assuming a sample was already created for the context of a job)
       --then do not recreate samples for this job, therefore remove those jobs from the collection.
       IF (@event_type = 201)
	       DELETE FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
	       WHERE qm_ent_id = @ent_id
		 AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL AND seq_no IS NOT NULL
    END  -- Job Pause and Job End

    ELSE IF (@event_type = 102) BEGIN -- Start quantity changed
       -- Get rid of future samples for the frequency, we will be regenerating them
       DELETE FROM sample_to_go
       WHERE sample_id IN
               (SELECT sample_id FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
                  INNER JOIN sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.freq_id = sf.freq_id
                  INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON stg.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND stg.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND stg.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
                  WHERE stg.ent_id = @ent_id
                      AND je.ent_id = @ent_id
                      AND je.job_pos = @job_pos
                      AND sf.freq_type = 3
                      AND (stg.spare4 <> '1' OR stg.spare4 IS NULL)) -- only production count frequencies
    END -- Start quantity changed

    --There are no rows in the specification collection to process.  Therefore, exit.
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan) BEGIN
       -- CR L00124785 - 03/26/2013 - RWB - If there are no QM Specifications for the job,
       -- delete the qm_context record that was created in sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs.  The
       -- qm_context record is record with no context to distinguish it from any legitimate
       -- qm_context record.
       IF (@event_type = 20) BEGIN -- End Job
           DELETE qm_context WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND context_ent_id IS NULL AND item_id IS NULL AND
               item_category_id IS NULL AND process_ID IS NULL AND context_oper_id IS NULL
       END
       -- End CR L00124785 Changes

        RETURN
    END

    --Get the user who is generating samples
    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

    --Step 11: Generate samples for an entity.

    SELECT @wait_time_for_delayed_prod = CONVERT(INT,attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 414

    IF (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod IS NULL) BEGIN
       RAISERROR('The %1 is not defined in the %2{4694},
           sample wait time for delayed production,
           System Attribute table.', 16, 1, @@error)
       RETURN -1
    END


    DECLARE generate_sample_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT qm_ent_id, ent_name, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_end_time_utc
               , context_ent_id, qm_spec_id, qm_spec_name, start_eff_utc, spec_priority
               , plan_id, plan_name, reset_option
               , plan_override, end_eff_utc, sample_name, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id
               , context_item_id, item_category_id, process_id, context_oper_id
               , freq_id, freq_name, freq_type, prod_reset_option, sample_interval_sec, interval_unit
               , offset_start_unit_sec, offset_end_unit_sec
               , samples_per_shift, expiry_unit_min, warning_unit_min
               , regenerate_samples
    FROM
       (SELECT scsp.qm_ent_id, e.ent_name, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
               , scsp.context_ent_id, scsp.qm_spec_id, scsp.qm_spec_name, scsp.start_eff_utc
               , scsp.spec_priority, c.category_name
               , sp.plan_id, sp.plan_name, sp.reset_option
               , COALESCE(scsp.plan_override, 0) AS plan_override, qs.end_eff_utc
               , sp.sample_name
               , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                      ELSE scsp.wo_id
                      END AS wo_id
               , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                      ELSE scsp.oper_id
                      END AS oper_id
               , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                      ELSE scsp.seq_no
                      END AS seq_no
               , CASE WHEN scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type <> 3 THEN NULL
                      ELSE scsp.item_id
                      END AS item_id
               , qs.item_id AS context_item_id, qs.item_category_id, qs.process_id, qs.oper_id AS context_oper_id
               , sf.freq_id, sf.freq_name, sf.freq_type, sf.prod_reset_option
                  --Scale the sample interval time to seconds
               , CASE WHEN sf.interval_unit = 1 THEN sf.interval * 60 -- Minutes
                      WHEN sf.interval_unit = 2 THEN sf.interval * 3600 -- Hours
                      WHEN sf.interval_unit = 3 THEN sf.interval * 86400 -- Days
                      WHEN sf.interval_unit = 4 THEN sf.interval * 604800 -- Weeks
                      ELSE sf.interval END AS sample_interval_sec -- Seconds
               , sf.interval_unit
               , CASE WHEN sf.offset_start IS NULL OR sf.offset_start_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                      ----Scale the offset start time to seconds
                     WHEN sf.offset_start_unit = 1 THEN sf.offset_start * 60 -- Minutes
                     WHEN sf.offset_start_unit = 2 THEN sf.offset_start * 3600 -- Hours
                     ELSE NULL
                     END AS offset_start_unit_sec
               , CASE WHEN sf.offset_end IS NULL OR sf.offset_end_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                      WHEN sf.offset_end = 0 AND sf.freq_type = 1 THEN @freq_to_call_sample_updates
                      ----Scale the offset end time to seconds
                     WHEN sf.offset_end_unit = 1 THEN sf.offset_end * 60 -- Minutes
                     WHEN sf.offset_end_unit = 2 THEN sf.offset_end * 3600 -- Hours
                     ELSE NULL
                     END AS offset_end_unit_sec
               , sf.samples_per_shift
               , CASE WHEN sf.expiry_time IS NULL OR sf.expiry_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                      ----Scale the expiry time to minutes
                     WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 1 THEN sf.expiry_time -- Minutes
                     WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 2 THEN sf.expiry_time * 60 -- Hours
                     WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 3 THEN sf.expiry_time * 1440 -- Days
                     ELSE NULL
                     END AS expiry_unit_min
               , CASE WHEN sf.warning_time IS NULL OR sf.warning_unit IS NULL THEN NULL
                      ----Scale the warning time to minutes
                     WHEN sf.warning_unit = 1 THEN sf.warning_time -- Minutes
                     WHEN sf.warning_unit = 2 THEN sf.warning_time * 60 -- Hours
                     WHEN sf.warning_unit = 3 THEN sf.warning_time * 1440 -- Days
                     ELSE NULL
                     END AS warning_unit_min
               , scsp.ent_hierarchy, scsp.rownumber, scsp.regenerate_samples
       FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan scsp
       INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
       INNER JOIN sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK) ON sp.plan_id = scsp.plan_id
       INNER JOIN sample_plan_freq_link spfl WITH (NOLOCK) ON spfl.plan_id = sp.plan_id
       INNER JOIN sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK) ON sf.freq_id = spfl.freq_id
       INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON scsp.qm_ent_id = e.ent_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN category c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.item_category_id = c.category_id
       WHERE (scsp.qm_ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
         -- For now, we do not support production frequency on a multiple job exec machine
         AND (e.identical_job_execs = 0 OR e.identical_job_execs = 1 OR sf.freq_type <> 3)
         -- If event_type is 1 (extend future samples), then the offset_end must have a valid value or the regenerate_samples flag for an entity must be turned on.
         AND --(((@event_type IN (1, 100) AND sf.freq_type IN (1,2,8) AND sf.offset_end IS NOT NULL) OR scsp.regenerate_samples = 1 OR @event_type NOT IN (1,103))
              --Frequent updates should only extend samples or re-generate samples for an entity.
              --Therefore, these type of update should exclude the job start and job end frequencies.
              (
               (((@event_type IN (1, 100) AND sf.offset_end IS NOT NULL) OR scsp.regenerate_samples = 1) AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1))
               --Allow samples to be generated at the start of the shift or the samples to be re-generated during the middle of the shift.
               --Still, do not allow the job start and job end frequencies to be used for these event types.
              --Exclude the frequencies that are not appropriate for the event types.
               OR (@event_type IN (0, 1, 100) AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1))
               --For production count frequencies, only support extending future samples and updating qm_context_link records
               OR (@event_type IN (0, 1, 3, 100, 102) AND sf.freq_type = 3)
               --For the lot change, only allow the shift and calendar frequency type samples to be generated.
               OR (@event_type = 6 AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1, 6))
               --For the job start event, do not allow the job end frequency to be used.
               OR (@event_type = 8 AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1, 3))
               OR (@event_type = 8 AND sf.freq_type = 8 AND scsp.spec_priority < 11)
               --When a job is paused (event type: 201), ONLY allow specs that have entity-only context.
               --Also, do not allow the job start and job end frequencies to generate samples.
               OR (@event_type = 201 AND sf.freq_type IN (0, 1))
               -- When a job is ended (event type: 20), ONLY allow specs that are linked to sample plan frequency of type 20 or the specs that have entity-only context
               --The reason for including the entity-only context specs is to recreate the overlapping characteristics that are no more used by any jobs
               --, but they are linked to specs that have entity-only context.
               OR (@event_type = 20 AND ((scsp.spec_priority < 11 AND sf.freq_type = 20) OR (scsp.spec_priority = 11 AND sf.freq_type IN (0,1)))) )
         -- Only consider Production Count frequencies if there is a job running
         AND (sf.freq_type <> 3 OR (scsp.wo_id IS NOT NULL AND scsp.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND scsp.seq_no IS NOT NULL))
         -- Shift 0 is not a shift, therefore no samples for shift will be generated for the "no shift".
         AND NOT (e.cur_shift_id = 0 AND sf.freq_type = 0)
         --Exclude all the sample frequencies that are disabled.
         AND sf.enabled = 1) spec_freq
    --NOTE: Be careful when changing the order of columns in the order by clause, because the order listed below is very important to generate the samples
    --according to the order of specificity defined in the sample request generation DFS, section: Order of Specificity, 3.3.3
    ORDER BY spec_freq.qm_ent_id
		   , CASE
				WHEN spec_freq.freq_type = 0 THEN 99
				WHEN spec_freq.freq_type = 1 THEN 100
				ELSE spec_freq.freq_type
			 END
		   , COALESCE(spec_freq.wo_id, 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ'), COALESCE(spec_freq.oper_id, 'ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ')
           , COALESCE(spec_freq.seq_no, 99999999), spec_freq.spec_priority
           , spec_freq.category_name, spec_freq.ent_hierarchy, spec_freq.rownumber
           , spec_freq.start_eff_utc DESC, spec_freq.qm_spec_name
           , spec_freq.sample_interval_sec

    OPEN generate_sample_cursor
    WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
       SET @allow_sample_gen_for_ent = 1;

       FETCH NEXT FROM generate_sample_cursor INTO @qm_ent_id, @ent_name, @shift_start_time_utc, @shift_end_time_utc
               , @context_ent_id, @qm_spec_id, @qm_spec_name, @start_eff_utc, @spec_priority
               , @plan_id, @plan_name, @reset_option
               , @plan_override, @qm_spec_end_eff_utc, @sample_name_template, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id
               , @context_item_id, @item_category_id, @process_id, @context_oper_id
               , @freq_id, @freq_name, @freq_type, @prod_reset_option, @sample_interval_sec, @interval_unit
               , @offset_start_sec, @offset_end_sec
               , @samples_per_shift, @expiry_interval_min, @warning_interval_min, @regenerate_samples

       IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

       -- Copy the event time UTC into the te
       SET @temp_event_time_utc = @event_time_utc

       --Verify whether this is a shift change event.
       IF (@event_type = 0 AND DATEDIFF(SS, @shift_start_time_utc, @event_time_utc) <= 300
           --If the frequency is calendar, production or utilization and an offset end is not null for that frequency,
           --then that frequency was already covered by the minutely task that extends the number of hours in the future.
           --If not, set the event time to be shift start time.
           AND NOT (@freq_type IN (1,2,3) AND @offset_end_sec IS NOT NULL))
           --Since shifts are not changed right at the beginning of the shift, allow 5 minutes to go back in the shift to generate samples,
           --if the current time is 5 minutes within the shift.
           SELECT @temp_event_time_utc = @shift_start_time_utc, @sample_start_time_utc = @shift_start_time_utc
       ELSE BEGIN
           IF (@freq_type = 0)  -- Shift Start Event
               --Generate all the future samples using the shift start time as the start time.
               SET @sample_start_time_utc  = @shift_start_time_utc
           ELSE IF (@event_type = 1 AND @freq_type <> 3 AND COALESCE(@regenerate_samples, 0) <> 1) -- Extend Future Samples
               --Set the start time as the next extended start time.
               --For example, let's say a sample is requested for every 30 mins starting at 10a extended upto 2 hours.
               --Therefore, samples upto 2 hours are covered on the first pass.
               --When the service requests to extend the future samples at 10:01a (i.e. for the time period 10:01 to 12:01),
               --it is only required to verify whether any samples to extended between 12:00 and 12:01.  So, set the starting time of the sample to 12:00.
               --Allow 15 more seconds, in case if this SP call was delayed by 15 seconds.
               SET @sample_start_time_utc = DATEADD(SS, @offset_end_sec-@freq_of_sample_update-15, @event_time_utc)
           ELSE  -- Generate all the future samples using the supplied event datetime
               SET @sample_start_time_utc = @event_time_utc
       END -- Event Type = 0 AND Frequency Type <> 1 (Calendar), 2 (Run Time), or 3 (Production Count)

       IF (@freq_type = 3)
       BEGIN
           -- For shift change, regeneration, or starting quantity change, we must regenerate production count samples
           IF (@event_type = 0 OR @event_type = 100 OR @event_type = 102)
           BEGIN
               IF (@event_type = 0 AND @prod_reset_option = 3)
               -- Reset production counts for all matching context's if the production
               -- reset option is set to shift change
               BEGIN
                  UPDATE qm_context_link SET production_count = 0
                  WHERE context_id IN
                      (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context
                      WHERE ent_id = @qm_ent_id
                          AND (context_ent_id = @context_ent_id OR @context_ent_id IS NULL)
                          AND (item_id = @context_item_id OR @context_item_id IS NULL)
                          AND (item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
                          AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
                          AND (context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR @context_oper_id IS NULL))
               END -- Reset production counts on shift change

               -- Get the current production count for the frequency so that we can regenerate the
              -- samples
               SELECT @prod_since_last_sample = production_count FROM qm_context_link AS qcl WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN qm_context AS qc WITH (NOLOCK) ON qcl.context_id = qc.context_id
               WHERE qcl.freq_id = @freq_id
                  AND qc.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
                  AND qc.wo_id = @wo_id AND qc.oper_id = @oper_id AND qc.seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND ((qc.context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (qc.context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL))
                  AND ((qc.item_id = @context_item_id) OR  (qc.item_id IS NULL AND @context_item_id IS NULL))
                  AND ((qc.item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (qc.item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL))
                  AND ((qc.context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (qc.context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL))
                  AND ((qc.process_id = @process_id) OR (qc.process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))

               -- Set up to regenerate sample
               -- Get the production rate information for the job and the remaining quantity which we want to
               -- consider for samples.  That would be the starting quantity minus the amount already produced
               -- (qty_good + qty_rejected) plus one extra intervals worth
               SELECT @est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate, @prod_uom = prod_uom, @batch_size = batch_size, @remaining_prod = (qty_at_start - (qty_prod + qty_rejected)) + @sample_interval_sec
               FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
               WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
               -- Determine how many seconds it will take to produce the first future sample.  This will the
               -- frequencies interval minus the amount of production since the last sample.  If we are readying
               -- a sample, this value will be used to calculate how long after the ready sample should the next
               -- sample be created.  If we are not readying a sample, this value will be used to determine the
               -- start time for the first sample.
               SET @first_prod_sample_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @sample_interval_sec - @prod_since_last_sample)
               -- @sample_interval_sec is currently expressed in terms of production units not time.  Call fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt
               -- to use the production rate information to convert the production units to a seconds-based time
               SET @sample_interval_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @sample_interval_sec)
               -- Add the time it will take to produce enough units for the first sample to the event time
               -- to get the time when the first sample will be generated
               SET @sample_start_time_utc = DATEADD(ss, @first_prod_sample_sec, @event_time_utc)
               -- Now that we used it to calculate the sample start time, clear the first production sample
               -- seconds so the next sample will happen at the correct sample interval.
               SET @first_prod_sample_sec = NULL
               -- Calculate the number of seconds that it will take to make the remaining production
               -- plus one samples worth more
               IF @remaining_prod < 0 SET @prod_offset_end_sec = 0
               ELSE SET @prod_offset_end_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @remaining_prod)
           END -- @event_type = 0 OR @event_type = 102
           ELSE IF (@event_type = 1)
           BEGIN
               -- If the system parameter 'Sample wait time for delayed production' is set to zero,
               -- delete the oldest future sample, if there are two future samples in the past.
               -- Also, prevent generate samples for an ent from executing.
               IF (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod = 0)
               BEGIN
                  DELETE FROM sample_to_go
                  WHERE requested_time_utc < @event_time_utc
					AND (spare4 <> '1' OR spare4 IS NULL)
                    AND requested_time_utc <>
                      (SELECT MAX(requested_time_utc) FROM sample_to_go
                        WHERE requested_time_utc < @event_time_utc
                          AND ent_id = @qm_ent_id
                          AND freq_id = @freq_id
                          AND item_id = @item_id
                          AND ((context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL))
                          AND ((item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL))
                          AND ((context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL))
                          AND ((process_id = @process_id) OR (process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL)))
               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                  -- If we find any sample for the current frequency matching the current context that are in
                  -- the past, push the request times by the value in system parameter 414.
                  UPDATE sample_to_go SET requested_time_utc = DATEADD(ss, (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod * 60), requested_time_utc)
                                         , requested_time_local = DATEADD(ss, (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod * 60), requested_time_local)
                                         , expiry_time_utc = DATEADD(ss, (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod * 60), expiry_time_utc)
                                         , expiry_time_local = DATEADD(ss, (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod * 60), expiry_time_local)
                                         , warning_time_utc = DATEADD(ss, (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod * 60), warning_time_utc)
                                         , warning_time_local = DATEADD(ss, (@wait_time_for_delayed_prod * 60), warning_time_local)
                  WHERE ent_id = @qm_ent_id
                      AND freq_id = @freq_id
                      AND item_id = @item_id
                      AND ((context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL))
                      AND ((item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL))
                      AND ((context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL))
                      AND ((process_id = @process_id) OR (process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))
                      AND EXISTS (SELECT top 1 1 FROM sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)
                                 WHERE ent_id = @qm_ent_id
                                     AND requested_time_utc < @event_time_utc
                                     AND freq_id = @freq_id
                                     AND item_id = @item_id
                                     AND ((context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL))
                                     AND ((item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL))
                                     AND ((context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL))
                                     AND ((process_id = @process_id) OR (process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL)))
               END

               -- If samples are being generated to the end of the shift, delete all future samples which
               -- lie past the end of the shift.
               IF (@offset_end_sec IS NULL)
               BEGIN
                  DELETE FROM sample_to_go
                      WHERE requested_time_utc > @shift_end_time_utc
                        AND ent_id = @qm_ent_id
                        AND freq_id = @freq_id
                        AND item_id = @item_id
                        AND ((context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL))
                        AND ((item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL))
                        AND ((context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL))
                        AND ((process_id = @process_id) OR (process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))
                        AND (spare4 <> '1' OR spare4 IS NULL)
               END

               SET @allow_sample_gen_for_ent = 0
           END -- Extend Future Sample Event
           ELSE IF (@event_type = 3) -- Item Production
           BEGIN
               -- Get the total produced by the job
               SELECT @total_prod = (qty_prod + qty_rejected), @prod_since_last_sample = ((qty_prod + qty_rejected) -  last_production_count) + production_count, @context_id = qm_context.context_id, @context_update_flag = COALESCE(sf.sample_id, 0)
                  FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                  INNER JOIN qm_context WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_context.wo_id = job.wo_id AND qm_context.oper_id = job.oper_id AND qm_context.seq_no = job.seq_no
                  INNER JOIN qm_context_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_context.context_id = qm_context_link.context_id
                  LEFT OUTER JOIN @Sample_Flag sf ON qm_context_link.row_id = sf.row_id
                  WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND job.oper_id = @oper_id AND job.seq_no = @seq_no AND freq_id = @freq_id AND
                      (qm_context.ent_id = @ent_id) AND
                      ((qm_context.context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (qm_context.context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL)) AND
                      ((qm_context.item_id = @context_item_id) OR  (qm_context.item_id IS NULL AND @context_item_id IS NULL)) AND
                      ((qm_context.item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (qm_context.item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL)) AND
                      ((qm_context.context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (qm_context.context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL)) AND
                      ((qm_context.process_id = @process_id) OR (qm_context.process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))

               -- If we do not find a context ID above, that means that another QM Spec is being used to generate
               -- the samples.
               IF (@context_id IS NOT NULL)
               BEGIN
                  -- If the context update flag is zero, we have not addressed the add production
                  -- for this frequency yet.
                  IF (@context_update_flag = 0)
                  BEGIN
                      -- Calculate the multiple of the interval that we has produced since the last time quantities were reported
                      SELECT @mult_of_interval = (CONVERT(INT, @prod_since_last_sample / @sample_interval_sec))
                      -- Check to see if we have produced enough to ready a sample
                      IF (@prod_since_last_sample >= @sample_interval_sec)
                      BEGIN
                          -- Indicate that we need to ready a sample
                          SET @ready_prod_count_sample = 1
                      END
                      ELSE
                      BEGIN
                          -- Indicate that we do not need to ready a sample
                          SET @ready_prod_count_sample = 0
                      END
                      -- We only want to save the amount of production that is greater than the amount required
                      -- to produce one sample
                      SET @prod_since_last_sample = @prod_since_last_sample - (@sample_interval_sec * @mult_of_interval)
                      -- Set the last_production_count to the total produced and the production count to the production
                      -- since the last time knocking off any quantity 2 times or greater than the production count
                      -- for the frequency
                      UPDATE qm_context_link
                      SET last_production_count = @total_prod
                          , production_count = @prod_since_last_sample
                          --, cur_sample_id = CASE @ready_prod_count_sample
                          --                WHEN 1 THEN 2
                          --                ELSE 1
                          --                END
                      WHERE context_id = @context_id AND freq_id = @freq_id

                      UPDATE @Sample_Flag SET sample_id = CASE @ready_prod_count_sample
                                            WHEN 1 THEN 2
                                            ELSE 1
                                            END
                      WHERE row_id IN (SELECT row_id FROM qm_context_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE context_id = @context_id AND freq_id = @freq_id)
                      INSERT INTO @Sample_Flag (row_id, sample_id)
                          SELECT qm_context_link.row_id, CASE @ready_prod_count_sample
                                            WHEN 1 THEN 2
                                            ELSE 1
                                            END
                          FROM qm_context_link WITH (NOLOCK)
                          LEFT OUTER JOIN @Sample_Flag sf ON qm_context_link.row_id = sf.row_id
                          WHERE context_id = @context_id AND freq_id = @freq_id AND sf.row_id IS NULL

                  END
                  -- If we have addressed the add production for this frequency, check to see if
                  -- we should generate a ready sample for the frequency
                  ELSE IF (@context_update_flag = 2)
                  BEGIN
                      SET @ready_prod_count_sample = 1
                  END
               END
               -- Set up to regenerate sample
               -- Get the production rate information for the job and the remaining quantity which we want to
               -- consider for samples.  That would be the starting quantity minus the amount already produced
               -- (qty_good + qty_rejected) plus one extra intervals worth
               SELECT @est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate, @prod_uom = prod_uom, @batch_size = batch_size, @remaining_prod = (qty_at_start - (qty_prod + qty_rejected)) + @sample_interval_sec
               FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
               WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
               -- Determine how many seconds it will take to produce the first future sample.  This will the
               -- frequencies interval minus the amount of production since the last sample.  If we are readying
