               -- a sample, this value will be used to calculate how long after the ready sample should the next
               -- sample be created.  If we are not readying a sample, this value will be used to determine the
               -- start time for the first sample.
               SET @first_prod_sample_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @sample_interval_sec - @prod_since_last_sample)
               -- @sample_interval_sec is currently expressed in terms of production units not time.  Call fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt
               -- to use the production rate information to convert the production units to a seconds-based time
               SET @sample_interval_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @sample_interval_sec)
               -- If we are readying samples, then we need to set up the start time and the
               -- sample interval in seconds
               IF (@ready_prod_count_sample = 1)
               BEGIN
                  -- The first sample will be generated now
                  SET @sample_start_time_utc = @event_time_utc
               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                  -- Add the time it will take to produce enough units for the first sample to the event time
                  -- to get the time when the first sample will be generated
                  SET @sample_start_time_utc = DATEADD(ss, @first_prod_sample_sec, @event_time_utc)
                  -- Now that we used it to calculate the sample start time, clear the first production sample
                  -- seconds so the next sample will happen at the correct sample interval.
                  SET @first_prod_sample_sec = NULL
               END
               -- Calculate the number of seconds that it will take to make the remaining production
               -- plus one samples worth more
               IF @remaining_prod < 0 SET @prod_offset_end_sec = 0
               ELSE SET @prod_offset_end_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @remaining_prod)
           END -- Add Production Event
           ELSE IF (@event_type = 8) -- Create production count on job start
           BEGIN
               -- If the reset option for the production count frequency is set to "The job changes", the production counts in the
               -- qm_context_link table should be set to zero for all qm_context records that match the current
               -- context for the entity
               IF (@prod_reset_option = 1)
               BEGIN
                  UPDATE qm_context_link SET production_count = 0
                  WHERE context_id IN
                      (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK)
                      WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (wo_id <> @wo_id OR oper_id <> @oper_id OR seq_no <> @seq_no)
                          AND (context_ent_id = @context_ent_id OR @context_ent_id IS NULL)
                          AND (item_id = @context_item_id OR @context_item_id IS NULL)
                          AND (item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
                          AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
                          AND (context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR @context_oper_id IS NULL))
              END
               -- If the reset option for the production count frequency is set to "The main item changes", the production
               -- counts in the qm_context_link table should be set to zero for all qm_context records that match the
               -- current context for the entity.
               ELSE IF (@prod_reset_option = 2)
               BEGIN
                  UPDATE qm_context_link SET production_count = 0
                  WHERE last_used_item_id <> @item_id AND context_id IN
                      (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK)
                      WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
                          AND (context_ent_id = @context_ent_id OR @context_ent_id IS NULL)
                          AND (item_id = @context_item_id OR @context_item_id IS NULL)
                          AND (item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
                          AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
                          AND (context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR @context_oper_id IS NULL))
               END

               -- Sum up the prod_count for all qm_context_link records for this frequency that match the current context.
               SELECT @sum_prod_count = COALESCE(SUM(pc.prod_count),0) FROM
               (SELECT max(production_count) prod_count FROM qm_context_link qcl WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN qm_context qc WITH (NOLOCK) ON qc.context_id = qcl.context_id
               WHERE (qc.ent_id = @ent_id)
               AND (qc.context_ent_id = @context_ent_id OR @context_ent_id IS NULL)
               AND (qc.item_id = @context_item_id OR @context_item_id IS NULL)
               AND (qc.item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
               AND (qc.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
               AND (qc.context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR @context_oper_id IS NULL)
               group by  wo_id, oper_id, seq_no) pc
               -- Determine the maximum min sample size for the characteristics linked to the qm_spec being considered.
               -- Note: the minimum sample size can be overridden by the qm_spec_char_link table.
               SELECT @maximum_min_sample_size = MAX(COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size)) FROM characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
               WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id

               -- If the sum of the production counts is greater than the frequency interval minus the maximum min sample size,
               -- use the interval minus the maximum min sample size ast the initial prod count.
               -- Otherwise, use the summed value as the initial prod count.
               IF (@sum_prod_count > @sample_interval_sec - @maximum_min_sample_size)
                  SET @init_prod_count = @sample_interval_sec - @maximum_min_sample_size
               ELSE
                  SET @init_prod_count = @sum_prod_count

               -- If we have carry-over production from previous jobs, record the initial production that we
               -- will use for this frequency in the temporary table recording the job and context information.
               -- After the loop, we will use the temporary table to update the qm_context_link records.
               IF (@init_prod_count <> 0)
                  INSERT INTO @left_over_production
                      (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, context_ent_id, context_item_id, context_item_category_id, context_process_id, context_oper_id, freq_id, init_prod_count)
                      VALUES
                          (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @context_ent_id, @context_item_id, @item_category_id, @process_id, @context_oper_id, @freq_id, @init_prod_count)

               -- Get the production rate information for the job and the remaining quantity which we want to
               -- consider for samples.  That would be the starting quantity minus the amount already produced
               -- (qty_good + qty_rejected) plus one extra intervals worth
               SELECT @est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate, @prod_uom = prod_uom, @batch_size = batch_size, @remaining_prod = (qty_at_start - (qty_prod + qty_rejected)) + @sample_interval_sec
               FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
               WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

               -- If the initial prod count is not zero, calculate the time when the first sample should be taken
               IF (@init_prod_count <> 0)
               BEGIN
                  SET @first_prod_sample_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size,
                      @sample_interval_sec - @init_prod_count)
               END

               -- @sample_interval_sec is currently expressed in terms of production units not time.  Call fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt
               -- to use the production rate information to convert the production units to a seconds-based time
               SET @sample_interval_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @sample_interval_sec)

               -- The first sample will be generated @sample_interval_sec after the start period
               IF @first_prod_sample_sec IS NOT NULL
               BEGIN
                  SET @sample_start_time_utc = DATEADD(SS, @first_prod_sample_sec, @event_time_utc)
                  SET @first_prod_sample_sec = NULL
               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                  SET @sample_start_time_utc = DATEADD(SS, @sample_interval_sec, @event_time_utc)
               END
               -- Calculate the number of seconds that it will take to make the remaining production
               -- plus one samples worth more
               IF @remaining_prod < 0 SET @prod_offset_end_sec = 0
               ELSE SET @prod_offset_end_sec = dbo.fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom, @batch_size, @remaining_prod)
           END -- Start Job Event
       END -- Frequency Type = 3 (Production Count)

       IF (@allow_sample_gen_for_ent <> 0)
           EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenSamplesForAnEnt @qm_ent_id = @qm_ent_id, @ent_name = @ent_name, @event_time_utc = @temp_event_time_utc
                      , @spec_priority = @spec_priority
                      , @sample_start_time_utc = @sample_start_time_utc, @shift_end_time_utc = @shift_end_time_utc
                      , @context_ent_id = @context_ent_id
                      , @qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id, @qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name, @plan_id = @plan_id
                      , @plan_name = @plan_name, @reset_option = @reset_option
                      , @plan_override = @plan_override
                      , @qm_spec_end_eff_utc = @qm_spec_end_eff_utc, @sample_name_template = @sample_name_template
                      , @wo_id = @wo_id, @oper_id = @oper_id, @seq_no = @seq_no, @item_id = @item_id
                      , @context_item_id = @context_item_id, @item_category_id = @item_category_id
                      , @process_id = @process_id, @context_oper_id = @context_oper_id
                      , @freq_id = @freq_id, @freq_name = @freq_name, @freq_type = @freq_type, @sample_interval_sec = @sample_interval_sec, @interval_unit = @interval_unit
                      , @offset_start_sec = @offset_start_sec, @offset_end_sec = @offset_end_sec, @samples_per_shift = @samples_per_shift
                      , @expiry_interval_min = @expiry_interval_min, @warning_interval_min = @warning_interval_min, @user_id = @user_id
                      , @ready_prod_count_sample = @ready_prod_count_sample, @prod_offset_end_sec = @prod_offset_end_sec
                      , @first_prod_sample_sec = @first_prod_sample_sec
    END
    CLOSE generate_sample_cursor
    DEALLOCATE generate_sample_cursor

    --UPDATE qm_context_link SET cur_sample_id = NULL WHERE cur_sample_id IS NOT NULL


    --Step 12: Remove the entries in QM context table, if jobs are ended on this entity.
    IF (@event_type = 20)
    BEGIN
       -- CR L00128221 Fix. Delete the qm_context record that was created in sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs.
       -- The job generating the samples being associated with QM specification is by Entity context.
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan  WHERE qm_ent_id = @ent_id
               AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL)
       BEGIN
           DELETE qm_context WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND context_ent_id IS NULL AND item_id IS NULL AND
                  item_category_id IS NULL AND process_ID IS NULL AND context_oper_id IS NULL
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           DELETE qm_context
           FROM (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
                 FROM @SpecContextSamplePlan
                 WHERE qm_ent_id = @ent_id
                  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL) job_contexts
           WHERE qm_context.wo_id = job_contexts.wo_id
             AND qm_context.oper_id = job_contexts.oper_id
             AND qm_context.seq_no = job_contexts.seq_no
             AND qm_context.context_ent_id IS NULL
             AND qm_context.item_id IS NULL
             AND qm_context.item_category_id IS NULL
             AND qm_context.process_ID IS NULL
             AND qm_context.context_oper_id IS NULL
       END
    END
    -- Step 13: Update the qm_context_link records with carry-over production when the job is started
    IF (@event_type = 8)
    BEGIN
       -- Remove any temporary records from qm_specs that did not get considered because their characteristics
       -- where handled by other qm_specs
       DELETE FROM @left_over_production
           WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_context_link qcl WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN qm_context qc WITH (NOLOCK)  ON qc.context_id = qcl.context_id
               WHERE freq_id = qcl.freq_id
                  AND @ent_id = qc.ent_id
                  AND wo_id = qc.wo_id
                  AND oper_id = qc.oper_id
                  AND seq_no = qc.seq_no
                  AND (context_ent_id = qc.context_ent_id OR (context_ent_id IS NULL AND qc.context_ent_id IS NULL))
                  AND (context_item_id = qc.item_id OR (context_item_id IS NULL AND qc.item_id IS NULL))
                  AND (context_item_category_id = qc.item_category_id OR (context_item_category_id IS NULL AND qc.item_category_id IS NULL))
                  AND (context_process_id = qc.process_id OR (context_process_id IS NULL AND qc.process_id IS NULL))
                  AND (context_oper_id = qc.context_oper_id OR (context_oper_id IS NULL AND qc.context_oper_id IS NULL)))

       IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @left_over_production)) BEGIN
           DECLARE left_over_production_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
           SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, context_ent_id, context_item_id, context_item_category_id
               , context_process_id, context_oper_id, freq_id, init_prod_count
           FROM @left_over_production

           OPEN left_over_production_cursor
           WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
               FETCH NEXT FROM left_over_production_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @context_ent_id
                  , @context_item_id, @item_category_id, @process_id, @context_oper_id, @freq_id, @init_prod_count

               IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

               -- Update the qm_context link record for the current job with the initial production that we are
               -- carrying over
               UPDATE qm_context_link SET production_count = @init_prod_count
              WHERE freq_id = @freq_id AND context_id =
                  (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK)
                  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
                      AND (context_ent_id = @context_ent_id OR (context_ent_id IS NULL AND @context_ent_id IS NULL))
                      AND (item_id = @context_item_id OR (item_id IS NULL AND @context_item_id IS NULL))
                      AND (item_category_id = @item_category_id OR (item_category_id IS NULL AND @item_category_id IS NULL))
                      AND (process_id = @process_id OR (process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))
                      AND (context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR (context_oper_id IS NULL AND @context_oper_id IS NULL)))

               -- Update all qm_context_link records that belong to a context that matches the
               -- current context but is not linked to the current job.
               UPDATE qm_context_link SET production_count = 0
               WHERE context_id IN
                  (SELECT context_id FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK)
                  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (wo_id <> @wo_id OR oper_id <> @oper_id OR seq_no <> @seq_no)
                      AND (context_ent_id = @context_ent_id OR @context_ent_id IS NULL)
                      AND (item_id = @context_item_id OR @context_item_id IS NULL)
                      AND (item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
                      AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
                      AND (context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR @context_oper_id IS NULL))
           END
           CLOSE left_over_production_cursor
           DEALLOCATE left_over_production_cursor
       END
    END

    -- Step 14: Ready the samples if applicable.
 --   IF (@event_type <> 1) BEGIN
	--	IF (@event_type = 3)
	--		EXEC sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples @ent_id, @time_zone_bias_value
	--	ELSE
 --      --Only required if this stored procedure is called in the context of ShiftStart, Definition Data is changed or in the context of JobStart.
 --      EXEC sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples NULL, @time_zone_bias_value
	--END
	IF (@event_type = 0 AND @generate_samples_for_shift_change = 1)
		EXEC sp_U_Sample_ReadySamples NULL, @time_zone_bias_value

    --Step 14: Reset the flag in the db_status table if this flag was set to true and the regenerate_future_samples flag was set to true.
    --If the flag to regenerate future samples is set to true, then reset it back to false.
    IF (@regenerate_future_samples = 1)
       --Reset the flag back to false.
       UPDATE db_status SET regen_samples = 0
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_genealogy_data]
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version     Changes
-- 02/28/2008		DianaI			3.4.0		Fix for CR75505, need cons_from_ent_name field
-- 09/26/2008		DonT			3.5.0		Fix for L00082537

       fg_item_grade.item_grade_desc fg_item_grade_desc,
       fg_item_grade.color fg_grade_color,
       item_prod.status_cd fg_status_cd,
       fg_item_state.item_status_desc fg_item_status_desc,
       fg_item_state.color fg_status_color,
       item_prod.to_ent_id,
       to_ent.ent_name to_ent_name,

       item_prod.qty_prod,
       item_prod.byproduct,
       item_cons.item_id rm_item_id,
       item_cons.lot_no rm_lot_no,
       item_cons.item_scrapped,
       item_cons.from_ent_id,
	   cons_from_ent.ent_name cons_from_ent_name,

      item_prod.wo_id = item_cons.wo_id AND
      item_prod.oper_id = item_cons.oper_id AND
      item_prod.seq_no = item_cons.seq_no AND
      item_prod.lot_no = item_cons.fg_lot_no AND
	fg_item.uom_id = uom.uom_id AND
	item_cons.item_id = consumed_item_details.item_id

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_Wo
-- Description:  Updates the work order details if exist
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-26         Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_Wo] (@module        NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @plant_code    NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @wo_id         NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @spare1        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare2        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare3        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare4        NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
	PRINT @erp_wo_status
      IF @erp_wo_status = 'ACTIVE'
         AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                    FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                           AND state_cd = 0)
         AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                    FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                           AND ( status = 1
                                  OR status IS NULL ))
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @rc                    INT,
                    @error_msg             NVARCHAR(500),
                    @error_severity        INT,
                    @error_state           INT,
                    @wo_desc               NVARCHAR(80),
                    @req_qty               FLOAT,
                    @req_finish_time_local DATETIME,
                    @item_id               NVARCHAR(80),
					@sched_start_time_local DATETIME,
					@from_uom_id INT,
					@to_uom_id INT,
					@conv_factor FLOAT,
					@cur_jobs CURSOR,
					@process_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@init_prod_pct FLOAT,
					@oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@init_sched_ent_id INT,
					@job_qty FLOAT,
					@seq_no INT

            BEGIN try
                BEGIN TRANSACTION

                SELECT @wo_desc = wo_desc,
                       @req_qty = wo_qty,
                       @req_finish_time_local = dbo.Fn_s_ofi_converterpdatestring(req_finish_date,req_finish_time),
					   @sched_start_time_local=dbo.Fn_s_ofi_converterpdatestring(sched_start_date, sched_start_time)
                FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				PRINT @req_qty

				SELECT @item_id = item_id,
					   @process_id=process_id
                      FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id


				SELECT @to_uom_id = u.uom_id
				FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
					   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
							   ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
								  AND i.item_id = @item_id

				SELECT @from_uom_id = u.uom_id
				FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock)
						INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
								ON u.description = owe.uom_desc
									AND owe.wo_id = @wo_id

				IF @from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @conv_factor=factor
					FROM   uom_conv WITH (nolock)
					WHERE  from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
						   AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
						   AND ( @item_id IS NULL
								  OR @item_id = item_id )
					ORDER  BY item_id DESC

					SET @req_qty=@req_qty * @conv_factor
				END

                UPDATE wo
                SET    wo_desc = @wo_desc,
                       req_qty = @req_qty,
                       req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local
                WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				SET @cur_jobs= CURSOR FOR
				SELECT init_sched_ent_id,
				oper_id,
				seq_no
				FROM   job WITH (nolock)
				where wo_id=@wo_id

				OPEN @cur_jobs

				FETCH next FROM @cur_jobs INTO @init_sched_ent_id, @oper_id,@seq_no

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				  BEGIN
					  SELECT @init_prod_pct = init_prod_pct
					  FROM   oper_ent_link WITH (nolock)
					  WHERE  oper_id = @oper_id
							 AND ent_id = @init_sched_ent_id
							 AND process_id = @process_id

					  SET @job_qty=@init_prod_pct * @req_qty

					  UPDATE job
					  SET    qty_reqd = @job_qty, qty_at_start=@job_qty
					  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no 

					  FETCH next FROM @cur_jobs INTO @init_sched_ent_id, @oper_id,@seq_no
				  END

				CLOSE @cur_jobs

				DEALLOCATE @cur_jobs


				UPDATE job
				SET    sched_start_time_local = @sched_start_time_local
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
				--AND first_job = 1 --(KN 27-Jan-23 - Updated this as part of the same discussion on local vs utc time to be used and advised)

                IF ( EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                            FROM   item_attr ia WITH (nolock)
                                   INNER JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
                                           ON i.item_id = ia.item_id
                                              AND i.item_id = @item_id
                                   INNER JOIN attr a WITH (nolock)
                                           ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
                                              AND a.attr_desc = 'RecipeToUse'
                                              AND a.attr_grp = 1
                                              AND ia.attr_value = 'ERP')
                     AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                                FROM   job_bom WITH (nolock)
                                WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                                       AND bom_pos <> 0) )
                  BEGIN
                     
                      DELETE job_bom
                      WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                             AND bom_pos <> 0

                      EXEC @rc=Sp_i_ei_pro_create_bom
                        @module,
                        @plant_code,
                        @wo_id,
                        @erp_wo_status,
                        @item_id,
                        @spare1,
                        @spare2,
                        @spare3,
                        @spare4

                      IF ( @rc <> 0 )
                        BEGIN
                            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating BOM (' +  @wo_id + ') in MES  - SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_BOM -  '   + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
                            THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
                        END
                  END

                COMMIT TRANSACTION
            END try

            BEGIN catch
                IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

                SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
                       @error_severity = Error_severity(),
                       @error_state = Error_state();

                RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
            END catch
        END
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Storage_Exec_GetLocEnts] (@ent_id int32_null = null) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_STORAGE_EXEC_GETLOCENTS
-- Description          - Returns a list of entities that are located at a different entity.
-- Author          -       Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/06/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/07/2007		AML		3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

    DECLARE @temp_storage_ents TABLE (
		t_ent_id			int,
		t_ent_name			nvarchar(80),
		t_storage_ent_id	int,
		t_storage_ent_name	nvarchar(80),
		t_child_level		int
	)

	DECLARE @level AS INT
	SET @level = 1

	INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
	SELECT se.ent_id, e.ent_name, se.storage_ent_id, e2.ent_name AS storage_ent_name, @level
	FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = e2.ent_id
	WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id

	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
		SELECT se.ent_id, e.ent_name, se.storage_ent_id, e2.ent_name AS storage_ent_name, @level + 1
		FROM @temp_storage_ents t
			INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = e2.ent_id


		IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

		SET @level = @level + 1

	END

	SELECT t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_storage_ent_id, t_storage_ent_name, t_child_level
	FROM @temp_storage_ents
	ORDER BY t_storage_ent_id

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_fg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24         Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  Karthik     2023-05-01         Changed MainHU from Spare3 to Spare2 and SubHU from Spare2 to Spare3.
-- 0.02.01  Lavkesh     2024-05-16         For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- 0.02.02  Michal H    2024-09-02         Fix incorrect timestamp format - change the erroneous 12-hour format specifier ("hhmmss")
--                                         to the 24-hour format specifier ("HHmmss").
-- ===========================================================================================
 
 
CREATE                PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_fg] as
begin
 
 
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT
 
 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
 
 
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION 
 
          BEGIN
            
            IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #temp

            Select  ip.spare3, ip.sublot_no, ip.wo_id, wo.bags_per_pallet, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp,   --(KN 01May23  Changed from ip.spare2 to ip.spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
                    u.description, ip.item_id, ip.created_at_local as last_edit_at, ip.lot_no, ip.row_id,  --changed ip.last_edit_at to ip.created_at_local  0.02.01
                    ip.seq_no, ip.oper_id
            into #temp
            from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
            inner join ofi_wo_ext wo with (nolock) on wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id and wo.module <> 'PO'
            inner join wo w on w.wo_id = wo.wo_id and w.state_cd < 3    --- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
            inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
            inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
            inner join job_bom jb on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 
            --and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
            where qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod and i.item_class_id = 'FG'
            and ip.spare4 = '1'  --(KN 01May23  Changed from ip.spare2 to ip.spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
            --and ip.spare4 = '0'  --(KN 23-Apr-23  Ignoring this condition as discussed with Siva)
            and ip.spare3 is not null
             
            IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #temp)
            BEGIN
                --Select * from #temp

                Declare @Subhu varchar(100), @subLot varchar(100),
                @lot_no varchar(100), @wo_id varchar(100), @item_id varchar(100), @item_class varchar(100), @row_id INT
                Declare @seq_no int, @oper_id varchar(100), @fg_lot_no varchar(100), @fg_sub_lot_no varchar(100)

                Select top 1 @Subhu = spare3, @lot_no = lot_no, @wo_id = wo_id, @item_id = item_id, @row_id = row_id,  --@subLot = isnull(sublot_no,'') ,
                @seq_no = seq_no, @oper_id = oper_id
                from #temp

                Declare @row INT

                Set @subLot = null

                
                Select top 1 @fg_lot_no = ic.lot_no, @fg_sub_lot_no = ic.sublot_no,  --(KN 24May23  Changed logic to pick lot_no and sub_lot of consumption)
                @row = ic.row_id from item_cons ic 
                inner join item i on ic.item_id = i.item_id
                where ic.wo_id = @wo_id and ic.oper_id = @oper_id and ic.seq_no = @seq_no and i.item_class_id = 'SFG'  --(KN 18May23  Added logic to pick only SFG items from consumption)
                order by ic.created_at_local desc  --(KN 13Apr23  Retrieving subLot from item_cons instead of item_prod based on Bug #796)

                Print @fg_lot_no + ' - ' + @fg_sub_lot_no

                Select top 1 @subLot =  iif(len(isnull(ic.sublot_no, '')) > 10, RIGHT(sublot_no, 10), null)  --(KN 24May23  Pick only last 10 digits for Batchmaker number)
                from item_cons ic where --fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no and    --(KN 31May23  Excluding fg_lot_no as fg_sub_lot_no will contain the fg_lot_no anyways, as advised by Ajay)
                fg_sublot_no = @fg_sub_lot_no  --(KN 24May23  Use fg_lot details to find consumption lot details)


                --Update item_prod set last_edit_comment = @subLot, last_edit_at = GETDATE()  where row_id = @row_id  --(KN 18May23  Added logic to store the subLot into last_edit_comment)

                Select @item_class = item_class_id from item where item_id = @item_id
             
                    BEGIN
                        select spare3 Handling_Unit_Number, wo_id Order_Number,        ---(KN 01May23  Changed from spare2 to spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
                        --sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number,    -- SAP will ignore it in SFG
                        @subLot Batch_Maker_Number,
                        '101' Movement_Type, bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
                        sum(qty_prod - qty_prod_erp) Quantity, description Unit_of_Measure,
                        IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL, T.item_id, ia.attr_value) SAP_MaterialCode_Number,  --(KN 02/02/23  Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
                        Format(min(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') Production_startdate, Format(min(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') Production_starttime,
                        Format(max(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') Production_enddate,   Format(max(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') Production_endtime,
                        
                        lot_no SAP_Batch_Number,
                        Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date, Format(GETDATE(),'HHmmss') File_Generation_Time,
                        '' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
                        from 
                        #temp T
                        left join (Select item_id, attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia
                            on T.item_id = ia.item_id  --(KN 02/02/23  Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
                        where lot_no = @lot_no 
                        --and isnull(sublot_no,'') = isnull(@subLot,'') 
                        and spare3 = @Subhu 
                         group by wo_id, bags_per_pallet, description, T.item_id, sublot_no, lot_no, spare3, ia.attr_value
 
 
                           Update ip set ip.qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod, last_edit_comment = @subLot, last_edit_at = GETDATE() from item_prod ip    ---(KN 9/Feb/23 - Removed ,ip.spare4 = 1)
                        inner join (Select * from #temp where lot_no = @lot_no and spare3 = @Subhu) t on ip.row_id = t.row_id
                    END
                END

        END
 
 

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
 
 
     BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
        RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
    END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_NamePlate_Speed]
	@ent_id INT = NULL,
	@item_id NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
	-- Module Name      - sp_S_ofi_NamePlate_Speed
	-- Description      - Get the details fro nameplate speed screen grid.
	-- Date Created     - 02/08/2022
	-- Version          - 1
	-- Notes            -
	--
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
	--02/08/2022              JN		   Initial Draft
	--28/01/2023			  YG		   V0.02.00 Added desc for p.description
	--30/01/2023			  YG		   Add parameter used for deviation logic
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	
	-- used for debugging
	--SET @ent_id  = 319
	--SET @item_id = '100000041590'
	
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_nameplate_speed WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND item_id = @item_id) AND (@item_id IS NOT NULL AND @ent_id IS NOT NULL))
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			e.ent_id
		  , e.ent_name
		  , e.description
		  , i.item_id
		  , i.item_desc
		  , 12 AS ItemDetail
		  , n.nameplate_speed
		  , n.threshold_speed
		  , n.prod_uom
		  , n.batch_size
		  , p.description prod_uom_desc --v0.02.00
		  , n.last_edit_at_local
		FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ofi_nameplate_speed n WITH(NOLOCK) ON E.ent_id = N.ent_id
		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = N.item_id
		INNER JOIN ofi_prod_uom p WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.prod_uom = n.prod_uom
		WHERE E.can_run_jobs = '1'
		AND (e.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			e.ent_id
		  , e.ent_name
		  , e.description
		  , i.item_id 
		  , i.item_desc
		  , i.item_desc +' - '+ i.item_id	 AS ItemDetail--i.item_id +' - '+ i.item_desc
		  , n.nameplate_speed
		  , n.threshold_speed
		  , n.prod_uom
		  , n.batch_size
		  , p.description prod_uom_desc --v0.02.00
		  , n.last_edit_at_local
		FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ofi_nameplate_speed n WITH(NOLOCK) ON E.ent_id = N.ent_id
		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = N.item_id
		INNER JOIN ofi_prod_uom p WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.prod_uom = n.prod_uom
		WHERE E.can_run_jobs = '1'
		AND (e.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) 
		AND (i.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		ORDER BY n.last_edit_at_local DESC
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_SetCurLotData]
(
		@ent_id					INT32
	,	@job_pos         		INT32
	,	@bom_pos         		INT32
	,	@cur_item_id     		STRING40
	,	@cur_lot_no      		STRING40
	,	@cur_sublot_no			STRING40
	,	@cur_reas_cd      		INT32
	,	@cur_storage_ent_id		INT32
	,	@cur_update_inv			LOGICAL
	,	@cur_backflush   		LOGICAL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_SetCurLotData
-- Description          -
-- Author				-
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/03/2002		Raghu			1.4	    Removed Cont_id
-- 09/27/2002		KRF             1.4     Write changes to job_bom as well as job_bom_exec
-- 10/18/2002		KRF             1.4     Read old values from job_bom, not job_bom_exec,
--                                          and if bom_pos = 0, start new util_log and/or labor_usage
--                                          rows if needed
-- 10/23/2002		TC              1.5.0   Remove references to job_bom_exec - renamed to sp_U_Job_Exec_SetCurLotData
-- 10/26/2002		TC              1.5.0   Include job_pos as parameter and use it where relevant
-- 01/08/2003		Rohit			1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/25/2003		Nagaraju        1.5.2   made the changes to allow to save the null lot number in job_bom
-- 01/28/2003		Nagaraju        1.5.2   fixed the help desk #2355
-- 01/29/2003		Nagaraju        1.5.2   Fixed the help desk #2379
-- 06/16/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included NULL param to be passed to sp_I_Util_Log and sp_I_Labor_Usage for last_edit_comment field
-- 10/15/2004		Raghu			2.1.4	HD# 5072, Update all the defaults to job_bom_subst, if job_bom.current_subst is non null, else update job_bom
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/24/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 08/13/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
--01/16/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00071065; Unhandled exception when setting current lot data.
--01/07/2010		Kishore		4.0			HF1432.
--07/31/2015                             Neeraja                     5.2           sp_U_Job_Exec_SetCurLotData is modified to pass the time zone bias value to SP_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @can_run_jobs     	LOGICAL
		,	@old_item_id     	STRING40
		,	@old_lot_no     	STRING40
		,	@old_sublot_no		STRING40
		,	@old_cont_id     	STRING40
		,	@old_reas_cd     	INT32
		,	@old_storage_ent_id INT32
		,	@old_update_inv     LOGICAL
		,	@old_backflush     	LOGICAL
		,	@cur_wo_id			STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id		STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no			INT32
		,	@log_id				INT32
		,	@labor_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_local	TDATETIME
		,	@user_id			STRING40
		,	@wo_id				STRING40_NULL
		,	@oper_id			STRING40_NULL
		,	@seq_no				INT32_NULL
		,	@lab_cd				STRING40
		,	@dept_id			STRING40
		,	@shift_id			INT32
		,	@shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_local	TDATETIME
		,	@pct_to_apply		TFLOAT
		,	@active				LOGICAL
		,	@mod_id				VARCHAR(30)
		,	@event_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@event_time_local	TDATETIME
		,	@step_no			INT32
		,	@state_cd			INT32
		,	@reas_cd			INT32
		,	@reas_pending		LOGICAL
		,   @runtime			LOGICAL
		,	@downtime			LOGICAL
		,	@setuptime			LOGICAL
		,	@teardowntime		LOGICAL
		,	@fixedtime			LOGICAL
		,	@vartime			LOGICAL
		,	@lotchanged			LOGICAL
		,	@current_subst		INT32
		,	@tz_temp			INT32
		,	@shift_start_tz		INT32
		,	@dbg_resp			INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	SET @event_time_local = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @event_time_utc)

	-- If the ent_id is not defined or does not have the can_run_jobs capability return error
	SELECT @can_run_jobs = ( SELECT can_run_jobs FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id )
	IF (@can_run_jobs = 0) OR (@can_run_jobs IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This entity does not have the can_run_jobs capability set{3184}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Init the Values and Set defaults if not defined
	SELECT	@bom_pos = COALESCE(@bom_pos, 0)
		,	@old_item_id = NULL

	SELECT  @wo_id = jb.wo_id
		,	@oper_id = jb.oper_id
		,	@seq_no = jb.seq_no
		,	@old_item_id =  CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.item_id ELSE jb.item_id END
		,	@old_lot_no = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.def_lot_no ELSE jb.def_lot_no END
		,	@old_sublot_no = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.def_sublot_no ELSE jb.def_sublot_no END
		,	@old_reas_cd = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.def_reas_cd ELSE jb.def_reas_cd END
		,	@old_storage_ent_id = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.def_storage_ent_id ELSE jb.def_storage_ent_id END
		,	@old_update_inv = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.update_inv ELSE jb.update_inv END
		,	@old_backflush = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NOT NULL THEN jbst.backflush ELSE jb.backflush END
		,	@current_subst	= jb.current_subst
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)  ON
			jb.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND
			jb.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND
			jb.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK)  ON
			jb.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND
			jb.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND
			jb.seq_no = jbst.seq_no AND
			jb.bom_pos = jbst.bom_pos AND
			jb.current_subst = jbst.alt_no
	WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id AND
		  je.job_pos = @job_pos AND
		  jb.bom_pos = @bom_pos

	-- 10/26/2002    TC      1.5.0         Include job_pos in WHERE clause
	DECLARE @x NVARCHAR(5)

	-- Added following 10/18/02 KRF
	IF @bom_pos = 0 BEGIN
	-- if item being produced changed, close off current util_log record and start a new one

		--below 4 lines added by Nagaraju on 01-28-03. since lot number can be null
		SET @lotchanged = 0
		IF (@cur_lot_no IS NULL ) AND NOT (@old_lot_no IS NULL) SET @lotchanged = 1
		IF NOT (@cur_lot_no IS NULL ) AND  (@old_lot_no IS NULL) SET @lotchanged = 1
		IF @cur_lot_no <> @old_lot_no  SET @lotchanged = 1
		-- it item or lot being produced changed, close off current labor_usage records and start new ones
		--   IF @cur_item_id <> @old_item_id OR @cur_lot_no <> @old_lot_no BEGIN
		--above line is commented by Nagaraju on 01-28-03 and added the below line
		IF @cur_item_id <> @old_item_id OR @lotchanged = 1 BEGIN
		  --Create cursor to read all active rows from labor_usage for this ent that are not associated with a step (since these are already lot- and thus item-specific)
		  --Where ent_id = input param and active = 1
			DECLARE labor_usage_cursor CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
				SELECT log_id, labor_start_local, user_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id,
					   shift_start_local, pct_to_apply
				FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ( ent_id = @ent_id and active = 1 and step_no IS NULL )

			OPEN labor_usage_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				--Read all fields for this row into local variables
				FETCH NEXT FROM labor_usage_cursor INTO @log_id, @labor_start_local, @user_id, @wo_id, @oper_id,
						@seq_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, @pct_to_apply
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				SET @shift_start_tz = NULL
				EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @ent_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz OUTPUT

				--Update current duration and Close off this row in the labor_usage table.
				--Call SP_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents (log_id = cursor value, user_id, ent_id, event_time = null)
				EXEC SP_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents @log_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value
				--Insert a new row in the labor_usage table . Same values as existing row except null comments, duration = 0, active = 1
				EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage @log_id OUTPUT, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id,
					@seq_no, NULL, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id,
					@shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz, @pct_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id OUTPUT
				--Find the associated row in ent_logon and update its cur_lab_usage_log_id with the new log_id.
				UPDATE ent_logon
				SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and user_id = @user_id
			END -- While there's a labor usage record to read

			CLOSE labor_usage_cursor
			DEALLOCATE labor_usage_cursor

		END -- item or lot changed
	END -- BOM_pos = 0
	-- End 10/18/02 addition

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Job_Exec_SetCurLotData_1', @src_key='part two'
	IF ( @dbg_resp = 1 ) RETURN

	--if the row already exists, then update the fields that have been specified
	IF @old_item_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	   --If any of the parameter values are NULL, then replace with existing values
		IF @cur_item_id IS NULL SET @cur_item_id = @old_item_id
		IF @cur_update_inv IS NULL SET @cur_update_inv = @old_update_inv
		IF @cur_backflush IS NULL SET @cur_backflush = @old_backflush

		-- Now update the existing row
		-- 1.5.0 TC Commented this code block out
		--   UPDATE job_bom_exec
		--   SET  cur_item_id = @cur_item_id
		--       ,cur_lot_no = @cur_lot_no
		--       ,cur_reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd
		--       ,cur_storage_ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id
		--       ,cur_update_inv = @cur_update_inv
		--       ,cur_backflush = @cur_backflush
		--   WHERE ( ent_id = @ent_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos )

		--   IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		--     RAISERROR('SQL Error updating job_bom_exec table: %d', 16, 1, @@error)
		--     RETURN -1
		--   END
		-- Added 9/27/02 to update job_bom also
		SELECT	@cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id
			,	@cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id
			,	@cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

		-- 10/26/2002    TC      1.5.0         Include job_pos in WHERE clause
		IF ( @cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @cur_seq_no IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			IF ( @current_subst IS NULL ) BEGIN
				UPDATE job_bom
				SET item_id = @cur_item_id,
					def_lot_no = @cur_lot_no,
					def_sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no,
					def_reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd,
					def_storage_ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id,
					update_inv = @cur_update_inv,
					backflush = @cur_backflush
				WHERE (wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos )

				IF ( @@error <> 0 ) BEGIN
					RAISERROR( 'SQL Error updating job_bom table: %d{3187}', 16, 1, @@error )
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				UPDATE job_bom_subst
				SET item_id = @cur_item_id,
					def_lot_no = @cur_lot_no,
					def_reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd,
					def_storage_ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id,
					update_inv = @cur_update_inv,
					backflush = @cur_backflush
				WHERE (wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst)

				IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
					RAISERROR('SQL Error updating job_bom_subst table: %d{3187}', 16, 1, @@error)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
	   END
	-- End 9/27/02 addition
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Return error as this row should be created when Job is started
		RAISERROR('job_bom row does not exist to update current data{3188}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_PA_GetAvailAttrs]
(@process_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_PA_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for a Process (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific process)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2005-
-- Version                  - 2.1.23
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--10/31/2005	Raghu		2.1.31/3.1.0	HD# 6624, Sort attributes by attr_desc.
--11/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Entry_type column is included.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 8 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM process_attr WHERE process_id = @process_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 8 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM process_attr WHERE process_id = @process_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_CalcProdTgt]
(
 		@session_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@target_quantity		TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@target_rate			TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@target_rate_units		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@batch_size				TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32_NULL = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Job_Exec_CalcProdTgt
-- Description			- See Middleware DFS, Sidus 2 Broadway
-- Author				- AML
-- Date Created			- 08/04/2008
-- Version				- 3.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 10/16/2008		AML				3.5		L00085631: Modified the calculation for TargetQuantity and TargetRate to use the
--											difference between the end of the shift and the start time of the job or the
--											start time of the shift, whichever is later.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

--	DECLARE @current_prod AS TFLOAT
	DECLARE	@projected_prod AS TFLOAT
		,	@run_ent_id AS INT32
		,	@shift_start AS TDATETIME
		,	@shift_end AS TDATETIME
		,	@shift_dur AS TFLOAT
		,	@start_day AS INT32
		,	@current_rate AS TFLOAT
		,	@now_to_end AS TFLOAT
		,	@quantity_or_rate AS LOGICAL
		,	@temp_target_rate AS TFLOAT
		,	@temp_target_quantity AS TFLOAT
		,	@can_sched_shifts AS LOGICAL
		,	@act_start_time_utc AS TDATETIME

	IF ( @target_quantity IS NOT NULL AND @target_quantity > -1 ) BEGIN
		--We're calculating the rate...
		SET @quantity_or_rate = 1
	END ELSE BEGIN
		--We're calculating the the quantity...
		SET @quantity_or_rate = 0
	END

	IF ( @wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid Work Order ID for the job must be provided to retrieve current and projected production.{5790}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '' ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid Operation ID for the job must be provided to retrieve current and projected production.{5791}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @seq_no IS NULL OR @seq_no < 0 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid Sequence Number for the job must be provided to retrieve current and projected production.{5792}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @batch_size IS NULL OR @batch_size < 1 ) BEGIN
		SELECT @batch_size = batch_size
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  job.oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  job.seq_no = @seq_no
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON
				job_exec.cur_wo_id = job.wo_id AND
				job_exec.cur_oper_id = job.oper_id AND
				job_exec.cur_seq_no = job.seq_no
		WHERE job_exec.cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  job_exec.cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  job_exec.cur_seq_no = @seq_no AND
			  job.state_cd = 3
	) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @target_rate_units IS NULL OR ( @target_rate_units < 0 OR @target_rate_units > 5 ) ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid unit of measure must be provided for the target rate.{5805}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (( @target_quantity IS NULL OR @target_quantity < 0 ) AND ( @target_rate IS NULL OR @target_rate < 0 )) OR
	   (( @target_quantity IS NOT NULL ) AND ( @target_rate IS NOT NULL )) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'Please provide either a target rate or a target quantity.{5806}', 16, 1 );
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT 	@run_ent_id = job.run_ent_id
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND
		  job.oper_id = @oper_id and
		  job.seq_no = @seq_no

	-- CR L00123552.
	SELECT	@start_day = DATEPART( dw, ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc ) - 1,
			@shift_start = ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent.ent_id = @run_ent_id

	IF ( EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND ent.can_sched_shifts = 1 ) AND
		 EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_sched WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id AND start_day = @start_day ) ) BEGIN

		SELECT 	@shift_dur = DATEDIFF( ss, ss.start_time, ss.end_time )
		FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ss.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE ss.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
			  ss.start_day = @start_day AND
			  ss.shift_id = e.cur_shift_id

	END ELSE BEGIN

		DECLARE @tree_level AS INT
		DECLARE @shift_entities	TABLE (
			ent_id INT,
			parent_ent_id INT,
			can_sched_shifts BIT,
			cur_shift_id INT,
			tree_level INT
		)

		SET @tree_level = 1

		INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, tree_level)
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id

		SET @tree_level = 2

		WHILE ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @shift_entities se WHERE se.can_sched_shifts = 1) < 1 ) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, can_sched_shifts, cur_shift_id, tree_level )
			SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, can_sched_shifts, cur_shift_id, @tree_level
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id IN (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM @shift_entities WHERE tree_level = @tree_level - 1)

			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
		END

		SELECT 	@shift_dur = DATEDIFF( ss, ss.start_time, ss.end_time )
		FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @shift_entities se ON ss.ent_id = se.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent e ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE se.can_sched_shifts = 1 AND ss.start_day = @start_day AND ss.shift_id = se.cur_shift_id

	END

	IF ( @shift_dur IS NULL ) OR ( @shift_dur <= 0 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'No shift schedule found for the selected entity.{3084}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @shift_end = DATEADD( ss, @shift_dur, @shift_start )

	SELECT @act_start_time_utc = act_start_time_utc
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND job.oper_id = @oper_id AND job.seq_no = @seq_no

	IF ( @act_start_time_utc >= @shift_start ) BEGIN
		SELECT @now_to_end = DATEDIFF( ss, @act_start_time_utc, @shift_end )
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @now_to_end = DATEDIFF( ss, @shift_start, @shift_end )
	END


--	declare @error varchar(20)
--	set @error = '***' + convert( varchar, @now_to_end ) + '***'
--	raiserror( @error, 16, 1 )

--	SELECT @current_prod = item_prod.qty_prod
--	FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
--	WHERE item_prod.wo_id = @wo_id AND
--		  item_prod.oper_id = @oper_id AND
--		  item_prod.seq_no = @seq_no AND
--		  item_prod.good_prod = 1 AND
--		  item_prod.shift_start_utc = @shift_start AND
--		  (item_prod.last_edit_at between @shift_start and @shift_end)

	IF ( @quantity_or_rate = 0 ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@temp_target_rate =
			CASE @target_rate_units
				WHEN 5 THEN (@target_rate/1)
				WHEN 4 THEN (@target_rate/60)
				WHEN 3 THEN (@target_rate/3600)
				WHEN 2 THEN (1/@target_rate)
				WHEN 1 THEN (1/(@target_rate * 60))
				WHEN 0 THEN (1/(@target_rate * 3600))
			END

--		SET @target_quantity = (((@temp_target_rate * @now_to_end) * COALESCE( @batch_size, 1 )) + ISNULL( @current_prod, 0 ) )
		SET @target_quantity = (((@temp_target_rate * @now_to_end) * COALESCE( @batch_size, 1 )) )

	END ELSE BEGIN

--		SET @temp_target_rate = ((@target_quantity - ISNULL( @current_prod, 0 ))/((@now_to_end * COALESCE( @batch_size, 1 ))))
		SET @temp_target_rate = ((@target_quantity)/((@now_to_end * COALESCE( @batch_size, 1 ))))

		SELECT @target_rate =
			CASE @target_rate_units
				WHEN 5 THEN (@temp_target_rate * 1)
				WHEN 4 THEN (@temp_target_rate * 60)
				WHEN 3 THEN (@temp_target_rate * 3600)
				WHEN 2 THEN (1/@temp_target_rate)
				WHEN 1 THEN ((1/@temp_target_rate)/60)
				WHEN 0 THEN ((1/@temp_target_rate)/3600)
			END

	END

	SELECT 	ISNULL( CONVERT( DECIMAL(10,3), round(@target_quantity, 3) ), 0 ) AS TargetQuantity
			, 	ISNULL( CONVERT( DECIMAL(10,3), round(@target_rate, 3) ), 0 ) AS TargetRate
			,	ISNULL( @target_rate_units, 0 ) AS TargetRateUnits

END

	@sender  nvarchar(80)  ,

	@recipient  nvarchar(40)  ,

	@file_name  nvarchar(254) ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime,
	@time_zone_bias_value int = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-	10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version     Changes
-- 10/06/2005		Raghu			2.1.30		Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

		(emailatt.recipient = @recipient OR @recipient IS NULL) AND
		(emailatt.path = @path OR @path IS NULL) AND
		(emailatt.file_name = @file_name OR @file_name IS NULL) AND
		(emailatt.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(emailatt.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	  )
