--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_S_ofi_NextSUInQueue
-- Description:  Return the next available storage unit (applies for source and destination storage unit) in queue
--
-- Usage:  From Automation to MES
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk            2023-01-12      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  MP            2023-02-10      Adding New Silo request logic (@type = 1-Source,2-Destination,3-DestinationFlushTail,4-DestinationFlushHead)
-- 0.03.00	YG			  2023-02-18	  Update major on silo item_id
-- 0.04.00  YG			  2023-03-15      Update for Milling Destination Bug #177
-- 0.05.00  YG			  2023-04-26	  Update to get destination based on filter item
-- 0.06.00  YG			  2023-05-22	  Refine : Update to get destination based on filter item
-- 0.07.00  MP			  2023-06-09	  Added interlock for silo status (Lock for input,Lock for output and Block for quality)
-- 0.08.00  YG			  2023-06-12	  Update prev silo destination is_chk, active_su_ent_id, silo_seq
-- 0.09.00  YG			  2023-06-15	  Added logic automatic source silo selection
-- 0.10.00  YG			  2024-01-09	  Fixed bug for automatic destination silo, couldnt get next silo when old silo provided
-- 0.11.00  YG			  2024-01-17	  Set ratio into null and give pratio into null since it is not needed for destination
-- 0.12.00  DS			  2024-02-02	  destination silo selection based on ent_name sequence
-- 0.13.00	JSC			2025-09-22			CR512: Fixed the useless INSERT INTO @result table as it is not needed. Extra fixes
-- 0.13.01	JSC			2025-09-22			LInked to new sp_U_ofi_su_selection_rsu procedure instead.
-- 0.13.02	JSC			2025-10-30		  As Secondary Silo column is never NULL but empty string needed to fix it
-- 0.13.03	JSC			2025-11-17			Fix for Source selection when the last_sU_value is not known it should return a valid SU
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_NextSUInQueue]
	(   @type           INT,
		@wo_id          NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,
		@oper_id        NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,
		@seq_no         INT         =NULL,
		@ent_id         INT         =NULL,
		@aut_storage_id INT         =NULL )
AS
BEGIN
	SET nocount ON;
	-- v0.13: Added:
	-- Get the MES work order id and OPER if missing
	SELECT @wo_id = wa.output_woid ,
		@oper_id  = ISNULL(@oper_id,wa.output_operid)
	FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@ent_id) wa
	DECLARE @RESULT TABLE
		(
			iStatus            INT,
			sStatusDescription NVARCHAR(100)
		)
	DECLARE @last_storage_ent_id       INT,
	@storage_unit_ent_id               INT,
	@storage_unit_aut_id               INT=0,
	@storage_unit_ent_name             NVARCHAR(40),
	@storage_unit_item_id              NVARCHAR(100),
	@storage_unit_item_group           NVARCHAR(40),
	@storage_unit_grade_cd             INT,
	@parent_item_id                    NVARCHAR(40),
	@silo_status                       INT =0, -- if @silo_status=0 then no lock/block
	@IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically   INT = 0,
	@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0,
	@target_sched_ent_id               INT,
	@UserId                            NVARCHAR(40),
	@attr_id_itemgroup                 INT,
	@attr_id_sunumberinaut             INT;
	-- v0.13.1 added output params
	DECLARE @out_result     INT ,
			@out_resultCode NVARCHAR(500)
	SET @UserId = SUSER_NAME();
	SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id
	FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
		AND oper_id = @oper_id
		AND seq_no  = @seq_no
	--To get the ent_id for the Last Storage Unit
	SELECT @last_storage_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc                           = 'SUNumberInAUT'
			AND a.attr_grp                            = 2
			AND ea.attr_value                         = CAST(@aut_storage_id AS NVARCHAR)
	-- get attribute id
	SELECT @attr_id_sunumberinaut = attr_id
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc           = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND attr_grp          = 2;
	SELECT @attr_id_itemgroup = attr_id
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc  = 'ItemGroup'
		AND attr_grp = 1;
	--To get the secondary SU name
	IF @type=1
	BEGIN
		SELECT @storage_unit_ent_name = TRIM(secondary_silo), --v13.02 Added TRIM -- Change to ent_id
			@storage_unit_item_id     = jb_item_id
		FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id    =@wo_id
			AND oper_id=@oper_id
			AND seq_no =@seq_no
			--AND silo_item_id=@item_id
			AND dest_type =@type
			AND su_ent_id = @last_storage_ent_id
			AND is_chk    =1
		-- Added check for empty string
		IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NULL
			OR @storage_unit_ent_name = '')
		BEGIN
			-- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
			SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value
			FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
					AND a.attr_desc                          = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
					AND a.attr_grp                           = 7
			WHERE oa.oper_id                                 = @oper_id
			IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @storage_unit_ent_name = e.ent_name,
					@storage_unit_ent_id            = e.ent_id,
					@storage_unit_item_id           = jb.item_id,
					@storage_unit_grade_cd          = jb.reqd_grade_cd,
					@storage_unit_item_group        = ia.attr_value,
					@parent_item_id                 = j.item_id
				FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Source'
						AND oea.ent_id                                                 = j.target_sched_ent_id
					INNER JOIN ent E WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id               = e.ent_id
					INNER JOIN job_bom jb          ON jb.wo_id                         = j.wo_id
						AND jb.oper_id                                                 = j.oper_id
						AND jb.seq_no                                                  = j.seq_no
						AND jb.bom_pos                                                 > 0
					OUTER APPLY
						(
							SELECT TOP 1 *
							FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id
								AND item_id          = jb.item_id
							ORDER BY date_in_local ASC
						) iv
					INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = jb.item_id
						AND ia.attr_id                                  = @attr_id_itemgroup
					INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id         = iv.wo_id
						AND cj.oper_id                                  = iv.oper_id
						AND cj.seq_no                                   = iv.seq_no
					CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oea.storage_ent_id,'source',iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id,NULL)
				WHERE j.wo_id         = @wo_id
					AND j.oper_id     = @oper_id
					AND j.seq_no      = @seq_no
					AND isNotValidEnt = 0			
					AND (
						e.ent_id <> @last_storage_ent_id
						OR @last_storage_ent_id IS NULL ) -- MOD on v 0.13.03
				ORDER BY cj.act_finish_time_local,
					iv.date_in_local ASC
				-- If record founded
				IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'RECORD FOUNDED'
					UPDATE ofi_su_selection
					SET
						is_chk           = 0,
						active_su_ent_id = NULL,
						silo_seq         = NULL
					WHERE wo_id          = @wo_id
						AND oper_id      = @oper_id
						AND seq_no       = @seq_no
						AND dest_type    = 1
					-- v0.13: Removed the INSERT into the @result table
					--INSERT @result
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_selection_rsu] @pwo_id           = @wo_id,
														   @poper_id         = @oper_id,
														   @pseq_no          = @seq_no,
														   @pitem_id         = @parent_item_id,
														   @pent_id          = @target_sched_ent_id,
														   @precipe_id       = NULL,
														   @pversion_id      = NULL,
														   @pdest_type       = 1, --Source
														   @pis_chk          = 1,
														   @pstorage_ent_id  = @storage_unit_ent_id,
														   @psilo_grade_cd   = @storage_unit_grade_cd,
														   @psilo_item_id    = @storage_unit_item_id,
														   @psilo_item_group = @storage_unit_item_group,
														   @pdsc_qty         = NULL,
														   @pmes_qty         = NULL,
														   --@pstatus					[dbo].[INT32]	 NULL,
														   @psecondary_silo        = NULL,
														   @psecondary_silo_ent_id = NULL,
														   @pratio                 = 100,
														   @pis_disabled           = 0,
														   @psilo_automation_status= NULL,
														   @psilo_seq              = NULL, -- SOURCE seq is always NULL
														   --@pspare1					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
														   --@pspare2					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
														   --@pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
														   --@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
														   @pcreated_by= @UserId,
														   --@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
														   --@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
														   @plast_edit_by =NULL ,
														   @pResult       = @out_result OUTPUT ,
														   @pResultCode   = @out_resultCode OUTPUT
					PRINT '@@out_result = '    + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@out_result)
					PRINT '@out_resultCode = ' + @out_resultCode
				END
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @storage_unit_ent_name = E.ent_name,
			@storage_unit_item_id           = jb_item_id
		FROM ofi_su_selection OSU WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN ENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON OSU.su_ent_id=E.ent_ID
		WHERE wo_id                                  =@wo_id
			AND oper_id                              =@oper_id
			AND seq_no                               =@seq_no
			AND jb_item_id                           =
			(   SELECT jb_item_id
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id       =@wo_id
					AND oper_id   =@oper_id
					AND seq_no    =@seq_no
					AND dest_type =@type
					AND su_ENT_ID = @last_storage_ent_id)
			AND dest_type=@type
			AND silo_SEQ >
			(   SELECT silo_SEQ
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id    =@wo_id
					AND oper_id=@oper_id
					AND seq_no =@seq_no
					--AND item_id=@item_id
					AND dest_type =@type
					AND su_ENT_ID = @last_storage_ent_id)
			AND is_chk=1
		ORDER BY OSU.silo_seq
		IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			-- Get Attribute IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically
			SELECT @IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value
			FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
					AND a.attr_desc                          = 'IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically'
					AND a.attr_grp                           = 7
			WHERE oa.oper_id                                 = @oper_id
			IF (@IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @currentID INT = 0,
						@NextID    INT
				--DECLARE @result Table (iStatus int, sStatusDescription NVARCHAR(100))
				SELECT TOP 1 @storage_unit_ent_name = e.ent_name,
					@storage_unit_ent_id            = e.ent_id,
					@storage_unit_item_id           = jb.item_id,
					@storage_unit_grade_cd          = jb.reqd_grade_cd,
					@storage_unit_item_group        = ia.attr_value,
					@parent_item_id                 = j.item_id
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Destination'
						AND oea.ent_id                                                 = j.target_sched_ent_id
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK)      ON oea.storage_ent_id          =e.ent_ID
					INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id                    = j.wo_id
						AND jb.oper_id                                                 = j.oper_id
						AND jb.seq_no                                                  = j.seq_no
						AND jb.bom_pos                                                 = 0          -- v0.06.00 Added => Get only for the end product
					LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv ivc WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id   = ivc.ent_id --Disabled on v 0.06.00 -- Enabled on v 0.10.00
					OUTER APPLY
						(   SELECT item_id,
								grade_cd,
								ent_id,
								SUM(qty_left) qty_left
							FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id
								AND grade_cd         = jb.reqd_grade_cd
							GROUP BY item_id,
								grade_cd,
								ent_id) iv -- v0.06.00 Added
					INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id             = jb.item_id
						AND ia.attr_id                                              = @attr_id_itemgroup
					LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id
						AND ea.attr_id                                              = @attr_id_sunumberinaut
						--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Destination', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) --Disabled on v0.06.00
					CROSS APPLY dbo.fn_chKDestinationValidity(oea.storage_ent_id,ivc.item_id,ivc.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id) -- v0.06.00 Added
				WHERE j.wo_id     = @wo_id
					AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
					AND j.seq_no  = @seq_no
					AND (
						e.ent_id <> @last_storage_ent_id
						OR @last_storage_ent_id IS NULL ) -- Added on v 0.10.00
					AND isNotValidEnt=0
					--AND (oea.storage_ent_id <> @last_storage_ent_id OR @last_storage_ent_id is NULL) -- v0.06.00 Added checking if automation not giving any old silo
					--AND (iv.ent_id IS NULL OR iv.qty_left = 0.00) --Disabled on v0.06.00 because handled by silo function validity
					--ORDER by oea.created_at_utc ASC
				ORDER BY e.ent_name ASC
				PRINT @STORAGE_UNIT_ENT_NAME
				SELECT @currentID = silo_SEQ
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id    =@wo_id
					AND oper_id=@oper_id
					AND seq_no =@seq_no
					--AND item_id=@item_id
					AND dest_type =@type
					AND su_ent_id = @last_storage_ent_id
				SET @NextID = @currentID+1;
				-- If record founded
				IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'RECORD FOUNDED'
					UPDATE ofi_su_selection
					SET
						is_chk           = 0,
						active_su_ent_id = NULL,
						silo_seq         = NULL,
						ratio            = NULL,
						is_active        =0 -- v 0.11 set ratio into NULL
					WHERE wo_id          = @wo_id
						AND oper_id      = @oper_id
						AND seq_no       = @seq_no
						AND dest_type    = 2
					-- v0.13: Removed the INSERT into the @result table
					--INSERT @result
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_selection_rsu] @pwo_id           = @wo_id,
														   @poper_id         = @oper_id,
														   @pseq_no          = @seq_no,
														   @pitem_id         = @parent_item_id,
														   @pent_id          = @target_sched_ent_id,
														   @precipe_id       = NULL,
														   @pversion_id      = NULL,
														   @pdest_type       = 2, --Destination
														   @pis_chk          = 1,
														   @pstorage_ent_id  = @storage_unit_ent_id,
														   @psilo_grade_cd   = @storage_unit_grade_cd,   -- v0.06.00 Added
														   @psilo_item_id    = @storage_unit_item_id,    -- v0.06.00 Added
														   @psilo_item_group = @storage_unit_item_group, -- v0.06.00 Added
														   @pdsc_qty         = NULL,
														   @pmes_qty         = NULL,
														   --@pstatus					[dbo].[INT32]	 NULL,
														   @psecondary_silo        = NULL,
														   @psecondary_silo_ent_id = NULL,
														   @pratio                 = NULL, -- v 0.11 make it NULL
														   @pis_disabled           = 0,
														   @psilo_automation_status= NULL,
														   @psilo_seq              = @NextID,
														   --@pspare1					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
														   --@pspare2					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
														   --@pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
														   --@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
														   @pcreated_by= @UserId,
														   --@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
														   --@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
														   @plast_edit_by =NULL ,
														   @pResult       = @out_result OUTPUT ,
														   @pResultCode   = @out_resultCode OUTPUT
				END
			END
		END
	END
	--To get the secondary SU ent_id
	--print @storage_unit_ent_name
	SELECT @storage_unit_ent_id=ent_id
	FROM ent
	WHERE ent_name              =@storage_unit_ent_name
	SELECT @storage_unit_item_id=aut_item_id
	FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(@storage_unit_item_id,1);
	--To Check the Silo status
	DECLARE @lockforoutput   NVARCHAR(20) ,
			@blockforquality NVARCHAR(20) ,
			@lockforinput    NVARCHAR(20)
	SELECT @lockforinput = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc                           = 'Lockforinput'
			AND a.attr_grp                            = 2
	WHERE ea.ent_id                                   = @storage_unit_ent_id
	SELECT @lockforoutput                             = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc                           = 'LockForOutput'
			AND a.attr_grp                            = 2
	WHERE ea.ent_id                                   = @storage_unit_ent_id
	SELECT @blockforquality                           = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc                           = 'BlockForQuality'
			AND a.attr_grp                            = 2
	WHERE ea.ent_id                                   = @storage_unit_ent_id
	IF (@lockforinput ='1'
		AND @type     =2)
	BEGIN
		SET @silo_status=1 --Will not allow to select the new Destination
	END
	IF (@lockforoutput ='1'
		AND @type      =1)
	BEGIN
		SET @silo_status=2 --Will not allow to select the new Source
	END
	IF (@blockforquality ='1')-- and (@type=1 or @type=2))
	BEGIN
		SET @silo_status=3 --Will not allow to select the new Source or Destination
	END
	--To get the secondary SU Aut_id
	IF (@silo_status =0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @storage_unit_aut_id = attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
				AND a.attr_desc                           = 'SUNumberInAUT'
				AND a.attr_grp                            = 2
				AND ea.ent_id                             = @storage_unit_ent_id
	END
	IF @storage_unit_ent_id IS NULL
		SET @storage_unit_ent_id=0
	SELECT @last_storage_ent_id AS Last_Storage_Ent_Id,
		@storage_unit_ent_id    AS Storage_Unit_Ent_Id,
		@storage_unit_aut_id    AS Storage_Unit_Aut_Id,
		@silo_status            AS Silo_Status,
		@storage_unit_item_id   AS Storage_Unit_Item_Id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_ChkStat]
(@new_wo_id	STRING80
,@new_oper_id	STRING80
,@new_seq_no	INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_ChkStat
-- Description	      -	HD# 5674, Allows the cloned job to ready ONLY if it is truly ready;
--			otherwise it will automatically changed back to NEW.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	05/16/2005
-- Version	      - 2.1.21
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver   Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @prev_wo_id	STRING80
	,@prev_oper_id	STRING80
	,@prev_seq_no	INT32
	,@prev_item_id	STRING80

	DECLARE prev_jobs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id
	FROM job j
	INNER JOIN job_route jr ON j.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND j.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
	WHERE jr.wo_id = @new_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @new_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @new_seq_no

	OPEN prev_jobs_cursor
	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM prev_jobs_cursor INTO @prev_wo_id, @prev_oper_id, @prev_seq_no, @prev_item_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_UnreadyDstrmJobs @prev_wo_id, @prev_oper_id, @prev_seq_no, @prev_item_id, 1
	END
	CLOSE prev_jobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE prev_jobs_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueue]
(
		@wo_id					STRING40
	,	@oper_id				STRING40
	,	@seq_no					INT32
	,	@state_cd				INT32 = NULL
	,	@job_priority			INT32 = NULL
	,	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL
	,	@target_sched_ent_id	INT32 = NULL
	,	@concurrent_link		INT32 = NULL
	,	@status_notes			STRING1700 = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
	,	@run_ent_id				INT32 OUTPUT
	,	@edit_time				TDATETIME OUTPUT
	,	@refresh_all			INT32 OUTPUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueue
-- Description			- HD# 5932, Batch Processing
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 09/13/2005
-- Version				- 2.1.29
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 09/23/2005		Raghu			2.1.29		Included validation check for job_state change permissions.
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 07/11/2006		Raghu			3.1.19		HD# 8434, Strip the milli-seconds by converting the datetime value to a character
--												type and then convert it back to a datetime datatype
-- 07/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.19		HD# 7281, Do not change the job state when the jobs are not actually queued or not
--												part of a same batch.
-- 04/20/2007		Raghu			3.2.9		HD# 9742, Error when changing paused state of job
-- 08/15/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @prev_concur_link_no			INT32
		,	@in_state_cd					INT32
		,	@prev_state_cd					INT32
		,	@user_id						STRING80
		,	@priv_to_change_from_on_hold	INT32
		,	@act_finish_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@act_finish_time_local			TDATETIME
		,	@child_level					INT32
		,	@entity_level					INT32
		,	@req_finish_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp						INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	DECLARE @entities_can_sched TABLE (ent_id int, child_level INT)

	--Verify whether the supplied job (information) exists in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},job', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	/*
	--Adjust required finish time depending upon the datetime storage (system_attr = 323)
	SET @req_finish_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @req_finish_time)
	*/
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @server_time=@act_finish_time OUTPUT

	SET @act_finish_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @act_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @act_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	--Store the requested state_cd in a separate variable.
	SET @in_state_cd = @state_cd

	IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Set the supplied state_cd to NULL if the supplied state is RUNNING, COMPLETE OR SUSPENDED
		--meaning, ignore changing job states.
		IF (@state_cd = 3 OR @state_cd = 4 OR @state_cd = 5) SET @state_cd = NULL
	END

	--Get the current job state, concurrent link no for the supplied job.
	--If the job is linked to a batch, then we may need to change the properties for all the jobs in a batch that are scheduled to a preferred ancestor.
	SELECT @prev_state_cd = state_cd, @prev_concur_link_no = concurrent_link FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no

	--Get the user id who is accessing the system.
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	--Verify whether the user has a privilege to change the ON-HOLD jobs (incase if the current job is on hold)
	EXEC sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, 180, @priv_to_change_from_on_hold OUTPUT
	IF (@prev_state_cd = 6) BEGIN
		--IF this user does not have a privilege to change the ON-HOLD jobs, then raise an exception to the caller.
		IF (@priv_to_change_from_on_hold = 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The user does not have a privilege to change the status of a job that is currently on hold.{4697}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Verify whether this job is linked to a batch.
	IF (@concurrent_link IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@concurrent_link = 0) AND (@prev_concur_link_no > 0) BEGIN
			--Since the request is to link the supplied job to a new batch,
			--Check whether any jobs in the current batch is currently running. If yes, then return an error to the caller.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE state_cd = 3 AND concurrent_link = @prev_concur_link_no) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Job(s) are already running on this batch.{4698}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE IF (@concurrent_link > 0) BEGIN
			--check whether any jobs in the requested (new) batch is currently running. If yes, then return an error.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE state_cd = 3 AND concurrent_link = @concurrent_link) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Job(s) are already running on this batch.{4698}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	--Update the requested changes.
	UPDATE job
	SET state_cd = CASE WHEN @state_cd IS NULL THEN state_cd ELSE @state_cd END,
		job_priority = CASE WHEN @job_priority IS NULL THEN job_priority ELSE @job_priority END,
		req_finish_time_utc = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_utc ELSE @req_finish_time_utc END,
		req_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN @req_finish_time_local IS NULL THEN req_finish_time_local ELSE @req_finish_time_local END,
		target_sched_ent_id = CASE WHEN @target_sched_ent_id IS NULL THEN target_sched_ent_id ELSE @target_sched_ent_id END,
		act_finish_time_utc = CASE WHEN (@state_cd IS NOT NULL AND @state_cd = 7) THEN @act_finish_time_utc ELSE act_finish_time_utc END,
		act_finish_time_local = CASE WHEN (@state_cd IS NOT NULL AND @state_cd = 7) THEN @act_finish_time_local ELSE act_finish_time_local END,
		concurrent_link = CASE WHEN @concurrent_link IS NULL THEN concurrent_link ELSE @concurrent_link END,
		status_notes = CASE WHEN @status_notes IS NULL THEN status_notes ELSE @status_notes END
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no

	--Retrieve the target sched entity id
	SELECT	@run_ent_id = CASE WHEN run_ent_id IS NULL THEN target_sched_ent_id ELSE run_ent_id END
		,	@concurrent_link = concurrent_link
		,	@edit_time = edit_time
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no

	SET @refresh_all = 0
	--SET the refresh flag to true if the supplied state is COMPLETE OR SUSPENDED
	IF (ISNULL(@in_state_cd, -1) = 4 OR ISNULL(@in_state_cd, -1) = 5) AND @concurrent_link > 0 SELECT @refresh_all = 1, @edit_time = NULL
	ELSE BEGIN

		IF (@concurrent_link > 0) BEGIN
			IF (@in_state_cd = 1 OR @in_state_cd = 6) BEGIN

				--Default the current entity level to 1
				SELECT @entity_level = NULL, @child_level = 1

				--Insert the curent entity into the temporary table.
				INSERT INTO @entities_can_sched (ent_id, child_level)
				SELECT e.ent_id, @child_level
				FROM ent e
				WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id

				--Set the child level to 2.
				SET @child_level = 2

				--Loop through all the ancestor entities till we find the root entity (or no more parents)
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @entities_can_sched (ent_id, child_level)
					SELECT e.parent_ent_id, @child_level
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE e.can_sched_jobs = 1
					  AND ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @entities_can_sched WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
					  AND e.parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL
					IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
					SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
				END

				--Loop through all the descendent entities till we find the terminal entity
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @entities_can_sched (ent_id, child_level)
					SELECT e.ent_id, @child_level
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE e.can_sched_jobs = 1
					  AND parent_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @entities_can_sched WHERE child_level = ISNULL(@entity_level, 2) -1)
					IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
					SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
					SET @entity_level = @child_level
				END

				IF (@priv_to_change_from_on_hold = 0) AND (ISNULL(@in_state_cd, -1) = 1) BEGIN
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE concurrent_link = @concurrent_link AND state_cd = 6
						  AND target_sched_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @entities_can_sched)) BEGIN
						RAISERROR('The user does not have a privilege to change the status of a job that is currently on hold.{4697}', 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END
				END

				UPDATE job SET state_cd = @state_cd
				WHERE concurrent_link = @concurrent_link
				  AND NOT state_cd IN (3, 4, 7)
				  AND target_sched_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @entities_can_sched)
				SET @refresh_all = 1
			END
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Po]
(@po_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @vend_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seller_id  int  ,
 @ship_to  int  ,
 @date_issued_utc  datetime  ,
 @date_issued_local  datetime  ,
 @state_cd  int  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Po
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 09/04/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

SELECT po.po_id
       ,po.vend_id
       ,po.seller_id
       ,po.ship_to
	   ,po.date_issued_utc
	   ,po.date_issued_local
       ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, po.date_issued_utc) AS date_issued
       ,po.state_cd
       ,po.notes
       ,po.spare1
       ,po.spare2
       ,po.spare3
       ,po.spare4
       ,po.last_edit_comment
       ,po.last_edit_by
       ,po.last_edit_at

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_CertSignOffDone](
@wo_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@oper_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@seq_no     INT32_NULL = NULL,
@step_no     INT32_NULL = NULL,
@cert_name     STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@lot_no        STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@sublot_no     STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@prod_log_id    INT32_NULL = NULL,
@cons_log_id    INT32_NULL = NULL,
@process_id    STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@process_status    INT32_NULL = NULL,
@active        INT32_NULL = NULL,
@Success     INT32 OUT
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -
-- Description          -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created          -    10/21/2002
-- Version              - 2.0.0.33
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 11/20/2002    Rohit               Added logic to identify Oper or Step level certification
-- 01/09/2003    Rohit        1.5.2    Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/06/2003    Rohit        1.5.2    changed logic to handle '' lot no for non repeatable steps
-- 03/25/2004      Raghu      2.0.30   Changed IN OUT to OUT parameter
-- 04/30/2004      Sheetal Jain    2033    Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
-- 09/22/2004    Raghu        2.1.0    Included prod_log_id AND cons_log_id to find the no of certification sign offs.
--10/03/2005    Raghu        3.1.0    Part of DB Changes
--01/24/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes; renamed this sp from SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_CERTSIGNOFFDONE
--08/31/2007	AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
--02/26/2008    Lorin       3.4     Changed @Success to INT32 datatype since can be set to -1
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE @TotalCertificates		INT32
	,	@NumberOfSignOff		INT32
	,	@bStep					LOGICAL

BEGIN
-- Assuming cert_name is a required parameter.
-- Find the no. of entries in cert_audit_log based on the parameters passed.
-- If records exist, then the Cert_name is already signed off.
-- If records doesnot exist, then itz not yet signed off.
--If step level make sure both step/lot is supplied

  IF  ( @step_no is NOT NULL AND @lot_no is NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'Lot No cannot be null{3331}', 16, 1 );
        RETURN
  END

  --01/24/2007; RG; Verify lot_no and sublot_no implementation with Keith.
  IF  ( @lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
          AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

    IF  ( @lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
      SET @lot_no = '-'
    END
  END

  --Check if oper/step level
  IF ( @step_no IS NOT NULL AND @lot_no is NOT NULL) BEGIN
            SET @bStep = 1
  END
  ELSE BEGIN
          -- Get the number of SignOff required for the Certification
            SET @bStep = 0
  END

  SELECT @NumberOfSignOff = num_signoffs_reqd FROM cert_type WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cert_name = @cert_name

  IF  ( @NumberOfSignOff IS NULL OR @NumberOfSignOff = 0) BEGIN
	--Add step/lot_no parameter only if it's step level certification
	SET @NumberOfSignOff = 1
  END

  IF  @bStep = 1 BEGIN
    SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*) FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
            AND (cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
            AND (step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
            AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
            AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
            AND (prod_log_id = @prod_log_id OR @prod_log_id IS NULL)
            AND (cons_log_id = @cons_log_id OR @cons_log_id IS NULL)
            AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
            AND (process_status = @process_status OR @process_status IS NULL)
            AND (active = ABS(@active) OR @active IS NULL)
  END
  ELSE BEGIN
    SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*) FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
             AND (cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
  END

  IF  (@TotalCertificates >= @NumberOfSignOff ) BEGIN
       SET @Success = 0
  END
  ELSE BEGIN
       SET @Success  = -1
  END

END

--       CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id)

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_AUT_Details_ByJobCommand
-- Description:	Get the all the details related to the supplied job which will be sent to the automation
--				•	Get the job details from the job table
--              •	Get the storage unit information from ofi_SU_selection table
--              •	Return all the above information as the output.
-- Usage:		System Platform Aut
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AML, XPM        2026-04-15          Initial Version for CR608
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2026-04-15			MOD to use only one read of sp_S_ofi_Sublot
-- 0.01.02	JSC				2026-04-16			Fixed the name of the UseSublotCounterTarget
-- 0.01.03  AML, XPM        2026-04-17          Updated output to return update_sublot
--===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_AUT_Details_ByJobCommand]
	@wo_id       NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
	@oper_id     NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
	@seq_no      INT          = NULL,
	@ent_id      INT          = NULL,
	@job_command INT          = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- 0.10.00 Added
	DECLARE @output_woid           NVARCHAR(40),
			@output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
			@output_operid         NVARCHAR(100),
			@output_seqno          INT,
			@result                INT;

	SELECT	@output_woid       = output_woid,
			@output_truncated_woid = output_truncated_woid,
			@output_operid        = output_operid,
			@output_seqno         = output_seqno
	FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid](@wo_id,@seq_no,@ent_id);

	SET @wo_id = @output_woid;

	-- Get the latest sublot no for selected order
	DECLARE @sublot_counter    INT ,
			@layout_name       NVARCHAR(50)  =NULL ,
			@printer_id        NVARCHAR(200) =NULL ,
			@layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100) = NULL ,
			@splitCount        INT           = 0 ,
			@defaultUoMDesc    NVARCHAR(20)  = 'KG' ,
			@defaultUoMId      INT
	SELECT @defaultUoMId = uom_id
	FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description = @defaultUoMDesc;

	DECLARE @LAYOUTTABLE TABLE
		(
			row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,
			value  NVARCHAR(50)
		);
	
	SELECT @printer_id = [dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterName] (@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no);
	--GET LAYOUT INFO
	SELECT @layout_ofi_wo_ext=owe.layout_name
	FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE owe.wo_id   =@wo_id;

	SELECT @splitCount=COUNT(value)
	FROM string_split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-');
	
	IF (@layout_ofi_wo_ext IS NOT NULL
		AND @splitCount > 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @layoutTable
		SELECT value
		FROM string_split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-')
		SELECT @layout_name=value
		FROM @layoutTable
		WHERE row_id=1
	END
	DECLARE @SUBLOTTABLE TABLE
		(
			sublot_counter INT,
			sublot_no      NVARCHAR(40)
		)
	-- New Sublot Logic
	IF @job_command >= 1
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @SaveLastSublot INT,
		@UseSublotCounter       INT,
		@update_sublot          INT;
		
		SELECT @SaveLastSublot = ISNULL(oa.attr_value, '0')
		FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE oa.oper_id    = @oper_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'SaveJobSublotCounter';

		SELECT @UseSublotCounter = ISNULL(oa.attr_value, '0')
		FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE oa.oper_id    = @oper_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'UseSublotCounterTarget'
		IF (@SaveLastSublot = 1
				AND @UseSublotCounter = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @update_sublot = [dbo].[ufn_s_ofi_CheckSublotChange](@job_command, @ent_id, @wo_id, @seq_no, @oper_id)
			IF @update_sublot  = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @sublot_counter = ja.attr_value
				FROM job_attr ja
					INNER JOIN attr a ON ja.attr_id = a.attr_id
				WHERE wo_id         = @wo_id
					AND oper_id     = @oper_id
					AND seq_no      = @seq_no
					AND a.attr_desc = 'SublotCounterTarget'
			END
		END
	END
	IF (@update_sublot = 0
			OR @update_sublot = NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT @sublotTable
		EXEC sp_S_ofi_Sublot @wo_id,
							 @oper_id,
							 @seq_no
		SELECT TOP 1 @sublot_counter = sublot_counter
		FROM @sublotTable
	END
	--SELECT FINAL DATA SET
	SELECT
		--case when left(j.wo_id,1) ='8' then  RIGHT(j.wo_id,9) else j.wo_id end wo_id,																				-- 0.09.00 Disabled
		--CASE WHEN @prefix_id > 2 THEN @truncated_mesorder ELSE @wo_id END wo_id,																						-- 0.09.00 Added -- 0.10.00 Disabled
		@output_truncated_woid                                                                                              wo_id,-- 0.10.00 Added
		j.oper_id,
		j.seq_no,
		i.item_desc,
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id,j.qty_reqd,i.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)              qty_reqd,
		GETUTCDATE()                                                                                                        current_times,
		@sublot_counter                                                                                                     sublot_no,
		ISNULL(ia.attr_value,'')                                                                                            segregation_type,
		@layout_name                                                                                                        layout_name,
		@printer_id                                                                                                         printer_id,
		ig.item_grade_desc                                                                                                  item_grade, -- v0.08.00 Added	
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](j.item_id,(j.qty_reqd-j.qty_prod),i.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) remaining_qty,
		@update_sublot update_sublot

	FROM [dbo].job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN [dbo].item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN [dbo].job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id
														AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
														AND jb.seq_no  = j.seq_no
														AND jb.item_id = j.item_id
														AND jb.bom_pos = 0                -- v0.08.00 Added
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ig.item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd -- v0.08.00 Added -- 0.09.00 Update from INNER JOIN into LEFT OUTER JOIN
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)  ON ia.item_id= j.item_id
																AND ia.attr_id =
																(   SELECT attr_id
																	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
																	WHERE attr_desc  = 'Classification'
																		AND attr_grp = 1) -- Add attribute group =1 (item)
	WHERE j.wo_id     = @wo_id
		AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND j.seq_no  = @seq_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Process_Attr]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,

select [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_getLangString] ()
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_getLangString] 
(
	 
	 @string_id INT
	 ,@lang_id INT =NULL
	 ,@lang_grp INT=NULL
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(1700)
AS
BEGIN
	 
	DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(1700)='Key not defined in language table',
			@lang_val INT
			   
		SELECT  @lang_val=sa.attr_value
		FROM system_attr sa WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE sa.attr_desc = 'Default language<4983>'
		 
		SELECT @Result=l.string
		FROM language l WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE l.string_id=@string_id AND l.lang_id= ISNULL(@lang_id,@lang_val) AND (@lang_grp is NULL or l.grp_id=@lang_grp ) 
		 
	RETURN @Result 

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Std_Oper_Ent_Spec]
  (@oper_id nvarchar(40),
   @step_no int,
   @ent_id int ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40),
   @spec_id nvarchar(40),
   @spec_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @assoc_file nvarchar(254) ,
   @comments nvarchar(1700) ,
   @min_value nvarchar(80) ,
   @max_value nvarchar(80) ,
   @access_level int ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime OUTPUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_I_Std_Oper_Ent_Spec
-- Description      - Insert a row into the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 11/08/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Maintain std_oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
-- 10/25/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084807 - added a check for a null assoc_file and only added the file type to the file_type table if the assoc_file is not null----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

DECLARE  	@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@current_time	TDATETIME
		,@use_GMT	INT32
		,@ftle		DATETIME
		,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(254)

IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	SET @assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(@assoc_file)
	EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
		, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
		, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
END

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

 INSERT INTO std_oper_ent_spec
 (oper_id,
  step_no,
  ent_id,
  ver_id,
  spec_id,
  spec_value,
  assoc_file,
  assoc_file_type,
  comments,
  min_value,
  max_value,
  access_level,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@oper_id,
   @step_no,
   @ent_id,
   @ver_id,
   @spec_id,
   @spec_value,
   @assoc_file,
   @assoc_file_type,
   @comments,
   @min_value,
   @max_value,
   @access_level,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

	--update standard oper spec version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )

	UPDATE std_oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @current_time, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id  AND ver_id = @ver_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_SCL_CalcStatsAndVerifyCRs]
(@sample_id				INT32
,@char_id 				INT32
,@operator				STRING80 = NULL
,@projected_result_data_xml		NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
,@control_rule_violations 		NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_SCL_CalcStatsAndVerifyCRs: Calculate Statistics and Verify Control Rule Violations
-- Description	      - The purpose of this stored procedure is to calculate statistics and verify the control limits and rules against the
--			chart point.
-- Author	      - Raghu G
-- Date Created	      -	09/27/2011
-- Version	      -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Changed By	Ver.	Changes
-- 08/20/2012	RaghuG			L00121918: Evaluate control rule violations when there are no results in the future for the supplied characteristic.
-- 04/17/2014	Ibrahim		 5.0	UserStory: 195827 - As Joe, I want to be notified of Control Rule Violations through the SRO even when I enter results manually in the Sample Viewer
-- 07/09/2014	Abhay Pandey	 5.0	UserStory: 367586 - As Invensys, I want to merge L00132266 (HF L00311920:  miss flagging a violation if there are intermediate missed samples)[Introduced a condition in where clause to exclude missed samples in case of XBar + Range Chart]
-- 12/11/2018	Raghu		 6.1	UserStory: 1094946 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00150997 (HF CR L00150485: SR35313512 - Deadlock messages with the update sample procedure.2014 R2.)
-- 09/25/2019	Srinivas	 6.2	UserStory: 1227595 - Merge CR#L00155163 for HF#CR#L00154651 , Added temporary table to improve the performance.)
-- 10/10/2019	Srinivas	 6.2	UserStory: 1227528 - Merge L00155155 (HF CR L00154191: SR 48912603:Very slow performance from Result.Add() call.).
-- 06/18/2020	Raghu		6.2	US:1330922 - As Lenka, I want to analyze and address performance issues with QM web API methods
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A temporary table is used to store all the chart points calculated for a chart type that is configured for a characteristic.
-- The structure of the  temporary table is defined below:
-- Structure of the @chart_points temporary table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Chart_Type		ChartType for	Chart_Point_First_Chart		Chart_Point_Second_Chart		Sample_Size	Lower_Sigma_Level_First_Chart	Upper_Sigma_Level_First_Chart	Lower_Sigma_Level_Second_Chart	Upper_Sigma_Level_Second_Chart
--			@chart_points
--			temporary table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  1: IX		1		IX
--  2: XBar + Range	2		XBar (xbar from a sample)	Range (range from a sample)
--  3: xBar + Sigma	3		XBar (xbar from a sample)	Sigma (population sigma from a sample)
--  5: IX + MR		5		IX				MR (moving range value)
--  7: MA + Range	7		MA				Moving Range
--  8: MA + Sigma	8		MA				Moving Sigma
-- 16: p		16		p
-- 17: np		17		np
-- 18: u		18		u
-- 19: c		19		c
-- 20: DPMO		20		DPMO
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Chart_Type			: Indicates the type of chart associated to the characteristic.
-- Chart_Label			: The ascending sequence of chart points.
-- chart_point_first_chart	: The chart point derived for the first chart.
-- chart_point_second_chart	: The chart point derived for the second chart.
-- Sample_Size			: The sample size for the chart point, if the chart type is XBar + Range (2) or XBar + Sigma (3).
-- Lower_Sigma_Level_First_Chart: A value indicating the number of standard deviations this chart point for the first chart is away from the mean.
-- Upper_Sigma_Level_First_Chart: A value indicating the number of standard deviations this chart point for the first chart is away from the mean.
-- Lower_Sigma_Level_Second_Chart: A value indicating the number of standard deviations this chart point for the second chart is away from the mean.
-- Upper_Sigma_Level_Second_Chart: A value indicating the number of standard deviations this chart point for the second chart is away from the mean.
--					For example, +2 indicates that the chart point is 2 standard deviations away from the mean,
--						     -4 indicates that the chart point is -4 standard deviations away from the mean.
-- Control_Move			: Indicates that at least one sample that makes up the chart point has been marked as a control move.
-- Second_Chart_Control_Move	: Indicates that one of the two samples that make up the moving range for an IX+MR chart has been marked as a control move.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The individual chart points are retrieved after applying the filter on the sample table and stored in this temporary table
-- with the chart_type indicating 1 (IX) for the individual values.  Using these individual values, the other chart points
-- are calculated using the data stored in this temporary table.
-- The purpose of storing the chart points in this temporary table is that the result values for some of the charts cannot be used
-- directly when calculating statistics and when evaluating control rule violations.  So, these modified values (chart points) ought to be stored
-- somewhere, so that it can be re-used for calculating statistics and evaluating control rule violations without reapplying the filters
-- over and over against the millions of samples in the sample table.  In addition to this, when a rule has its APPLICABLE property
-- for the default chart is turned on, then the chart points for the first chart and the second chart are required to validate
-- the control rule violations.

-- For the variable-type characteristics, the chart_point_first_chart column indicates the chart points derived for the first chart,
-- and the chart_point_second_chart column indicates the chart points derived for the second chart.

-- For example, when the default chart type for a charteristic is 7 (MA + MR), then the moving averages are calculated using the
-- individual values (chart type = 1) and stored in the chart_point_first_chart column, and the moving ranges are calculated using the
-- individual values (chart type = 1) and stored in the chart_point_second_chart column with both chart points can be identified
-- with the chart type 7.

-- A temporary table is used to log all the rule violations.  The rule violations logged in the temporary table is copied to the
-- sample_char_rule_link table when all the validations for the rule violations are completed.  The reason behind this approach is to
-- improve performance in logging the results one-by-one to the sample_char_rule_link table.  Since there may be millions of rule violations
-- in the sample_char_rule_link table and millions of samples, there may be a performance hit if the code checks
-- whether the sample_id, char_id and rule_id exist for each rule violation.  So, it is better to collect all the rule violations
-- in a temporary table and log all the rule violations in the sample_char_rule_link table one time.

-- Flow of this stored procedure.
------------------------------------------------------------------
--  1. Read characteristic settings, control limits configured for the characteristic.
--  2. Read QM Spec settings and override characteristic settings, if applicable.
--  3. Create individual chart points (1=IX) in the temporary table - filtered data with entity, item contexts, etc.
--  4. Update common statistics in the stats table, such as mean, act_percent_out_of_spec, no_of_results, etc, using the individual chart points.
--  5. Based on the chart type configured for the characteristic,
--	create chart points (chart_point_first_chart and chart_point_second_chart) specific to the chart type
--  6. Calculate Estimated Sigma based on the chart type, if required; otherwise, default to population sigma.
--  7. Remove all the chart points for chart type = 1, as they are not required anymore.
--  8. Calculate and update stats table for Cp, CpK, Pp, PpK values.
--  9. Calculate CL, LCL and UCL for the first chart and second chart using the corresponding chart_point_*_charts
--	for the default chart type linked to the characteristic.
-- 10. Remove all the chart points except last 14 (that maximum of last 14 chart points is what required to validate a run rule for a chart)
-- 	I.e. the temporary table should not contain no more than 14 rows.
-- 11. Calculate LowerSigma and UpperSigma for the first chart and the second chart using the control limits obtained above.
-- 12. Update the sigma level in the temporary table for the first chart and the second chart based on the LowerSigma and UpperSigma calculated above.
-- 13. Loop through each rule for the first chart and evaluate the rule, and log the rule violation in the sample_char_rule_link table if necessary.
-- 14. Loop through each rule for the second chart and evaulate the rule, and log the rule violation in the sample_char_rule_link table if necessary.
-- 15. Log the control rule violations in the sample_char_rule_link table, if they do not exist and the result data is not the projected data.
------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Please refer to the Sample Recording Object DFS in the location below that describes how to calculate sigma,
-- control limits and validate control rule violations, etc.
-- http://epm/sites/PAR/DFS%20Library/Wonderare%20Factelligence/MES%20QM/Sample%20Recording%20Object.docx
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	 @most_recent_sample_requested_utc	TDATETIME
	,@type					INT32
	,@ent_id				INT32
	,@severity_cd				INT32
	,@requested_time_utc			TDATETIME
	,@default_chart				INT32
	,@minimum_sample_size			INT32
	,@normal_sample_size		INT32
	,@num_defect_opp			INT32
	,@mov_avg_span				INT32
	,@sigma_est				INT32
	,@cl_source				INT32
	,@samples_for_cl			INT32
	,@samples_before_cl			INT32
	,@std_avg				TFLOAT
	,@std_deviation				TFLOAT
	,@target				TFLOAT
	,@std_avg_is_target		BIT
	,@lsl					TFLOAT
	,@usl					TFLOAT
	,@cl					TFLOAT
	,@lcl					TFLOAT
	,@ucl					TFLOAT

	,@qm_spec_id				INT32
	,@rule_id				INT32

	-- Sigma and control limits for the first chart and the second chart
	,@std_dev_lower_first_chart		TFLOAT
	,@std_dev_upper_first_chart		TFLOAT
	,@lcl_first_chart			TFLOAT
	,@cl_first_chart			TFLOAT
	,@ucl_first_chart			TFLOAT
	,@std_dev_lower_second_chart		TFLOAT
	,@std_dev_upper_second_chart		TFLOAT
	,@lcl_second_chart			TFLOAT
	,@cl_second_chart			TFLOAT
	,@ucl_second_chart			TFLOAT

	-- variables for estimated sigma and population sigma
	,@calc_moving_chart_points		INT32
	,@estimated_sigma			TFLOAT
	,@population_sigma			TFLOAT
	,@population_mean			TFLOAT
	,@adjusted_std_dev			TFLOAT

	,@last_chart_label			INT32
	,@last_chart_point_first_chart		TFLOAT
	,@last_chart_point_second_chart		TFLOAT
	,@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_fc		TFLOAT
	,@last_cp_upper_sigma_level_fc		TFLOAT
	,@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_sc		TFLOAT
	,@last_cp_upper_sigma_level_sc		TFLOAT
	,@chart_position			INT32
	,@chart_name_first_chart	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@chart_name_second_chart	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@max_chart_label			INT32
	,@max_control_move_label	INT32
	,@rule_desc					NVARCHAR(80)
	,@num_points				INT32
	,@of_points					INT32
	,@test1						INT32
	,@test2						INT32
	,@and_not_or				LOGICAL
	,@sigma_limits_for_test1	TFLOAT
	,@sigma_limits_for_test2	TFLOAT

	,@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
	,@test1_result				INT32
	,@test2_result				INT32

	-- Variables to determine whether or not the samples should be filtered by some criterias
	,@filter_by_ent_id				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_item_id				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_wo_id				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_oper_id				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_process_id				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_segment_req_id			LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_segment_resp_id			LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_spare1				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_spare2				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_spare3				LOGICAL
	,@filter_by_spare4				LOGICAL

	--Variables holding the data from the most recent sample to filter the data from other samples
	,@item_id					STRING40
	,@wo_id						STRING40
	,@oper_id					STRING40
	,@process_id				STRING40
	,@segment_requirement_id	STRING80
	,@segment_response_id		STRING80
	,@spare1					STRING80
	,@spare2					STRING80
	,@spare3					STRING80
	,@spare4					STRING80

	,@filter_ent_id			INT32
	,@stats_char_id			INT32
	,@stats_ent_id			INT32
	,@stats_item_id			STRING40
	,@stats_wo_id			STRING40
	,@stats_oper_id			STRING40
	,@stats_process_id		STRING40
	,@stats_segment_requirement_id	STRING40
	,@stats_segment_response_id	STRING40
	,@stats_spare1			STRING80
	,@stats_spare2			STRING80
	,@stats_spare3			STRING80
	,@stats_spare4			STRING80
	,@act_percent_out_of_sl		TFLOAT
	,@cp				TFLOAT
	,@cpk				TFLOAT
	,@max_result_value		TFLOAT
	,@mean_result_value		TFLOAT
	,@min_result_value		TFLOAT
	,@pp				TFLOAT
	,@ppk				TFLOAT
	,@range				TFLOAT
	,@rbar				TFLOAT
