	,@msbar				TFLOAT
	,@num_results			INT32
	,@num_samples			INT32
	,@total					INT32
	,@cutoffDaysForStats	INT32
	,@samplesForStats		INT32
	,@cutoffDateForStats	DATETIME
	,@p_or_u_Bar					TFLOAT
	,@SampleSize			INT32


DECLARE	@chart_points				TABLE (chart_type INT NOT NULL, chart_label INT NOT NULL, chart_point_first_chart FLOAT, chart_point_second_chart FLOAT
								, sample_size INT, lower_sigma_level_first_chart FLOAT, upper_sigma_level_first_chart FLOAT, lower_sigma_level_second_chart FLOAT, upper_sigma_level_second_chart FLOAT
								, sample_id INT, control_move BIT, second_chart_control_move BIT
								PRIMARY KEY (chart_type, chart_label))
DECLARE @rule_violations			TABLE (sample_id INT NOT NULL, char_id INT NOT NULL, rule_id INT NOT NULL, chart_pos INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY (sample_id, char_id, rule_id, chart_pos))

BEGIN

	--Retrieve the sample requested time and spec ID for the supplied sample
	SELECT @ent_id = s.ent_id, @requested_time_utc = s.requested_time_utc, @qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id
	, @item_id = s.item_id, @wo_id = s.wo_id, @oper_id = s.oper_id, @process_id = s.process_id
	, @segment_requirement_id = s.segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id = s.segment_response_id
	, @spare1 = s.spare1, @spare2 = s.spare2, @spare3 = s.spare3, @spare4 = s.spare4
	FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
	WHERE s.sample_id = @sample_id
	  AND scl.char_id = @char_id

	  DECLARE @tmp_future_samples		TABLE ( sample_id INT PRIMARY KEY)
         INSERT INTO @tmp_future_samples
           SELECT s.sample_id FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
                 INNER JOIN sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
                       WHERE s.requested_time_utc > @requested_time_utc AND scl.char_id = @char_id;

	--Verify whether there are no results for the samples in the future.
	--If there are results for the samples in the future, then exit.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN @tmp_future_samples s ON r.sample_id = s.sample_id
			WHERE r.char_id = @char_id
			  AND r.superseded = 0)
		--There are newer result data than this sample.
		--Therefore, do not calculate the statistics and verify the control limits against the chart points for this sample.
		RETURN

	--Step  1: Read characteristic settings, control limits configured for the characteristic.
	--Retrieve the characteristic properties, such as type, minimum sample size, etc.
	--Retrieve the control limits configured for a chart.  If the default chart supports two charts, then retrieve the control limits for both the charts.
	--For example, if the default chart type for a characteristic is MA + MR (7), then the control limits for the first chart is stored in the *_first_chart variables (lcl_first_chart, cl_first_chart and ucl_first_chart)
	--the control limits for the second chart is stored in the *_second_chart variables (lcl_second_chart, cl_second_chart and ucl_second_chart).
	SELECT @type = c.type, @default_chart = c.default_chart, @minimum_sample_size = c.minimum_sample_size
		,@normal_sample_size = c.normal_sample_size, @severity_cd = c.severity_cd
		,@num_defect_opp = CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.num_defect_opp, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE c.num_defect_opp END
		,@mov_avg_span = COALESCE(c.mov_avg_span, 2), @sigma_est = c.sigma_est, @cl_source = c.cl_source, @samples_for_cl = c.samples_for_cl
		,@samples_before_cl = c.samples_before_cl, @std_avg = c.std_avg /*std_avg*/, @std_deviation = c.std_deviation
		,@std_avg_is_target = c.std_avg_is_target

		-- Retrieve the control limits for the first chart
		,@lcl_first_chart = CASE WHEN (c.default_chart = 2 OR c.default_chart = 3) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_xbar
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 5 AND c.cl_source = 2) THEN c.lcl_ix
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 7 OR c.default_chart = 8) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_ma
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 16 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_p
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 17 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_np
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 18 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_u
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 19 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_c
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 20 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_u * (1000000 / COALESCE(c.num_defect_opp, 1.0))
		      END

		,@ucl_first_chart = CASE WHEN (c.default_chart = 2 OR c.default_chart = 3) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_xbar
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 5 AND c.cl_source = 2) THEN c.ucl_ix
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 7 OR c.default_chart = 8) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_ma
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 16 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_p
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 17 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_np
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 18 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_u
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 19 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_c
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 20 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_u * (1000000 / COALESCE(c.num_defect_opp, 1.0))
		      END

		,@cl_first_chart = CASE WHEN (c.default_chart = 2 OR c.default_chart = 3) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_xbar
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 5 AND c.cl_source = 2) THEN c.cl_ix
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 7 OR c.default_chart = 8) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_ma
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 16 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_p
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 17 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_np
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 18 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_u
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 19 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_c
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 20 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_u * (1000000 / COALESCE(c.num_defect_opp, 1.0))
		      END

		-- Retrieve the control limits for the second chart
		,@lcl_second_chart = CASE WHEN c.default_chart = 2 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_range
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 3 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_sigma
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 5 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_imr
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 7 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_mr
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 8 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.lcl_ms
		      END

		,@ucl_second_chart = CASE WHEN c.default_chart = 2 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_range
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 3 OR c.default_chart = 8) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_sigma
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 5 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_imr
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 7 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_mr
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 8 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.ucl_ms
		      END

		,@cl_second_chart = CASE WHEN c.default_chart = 2 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_range
		      WHEN (c.default_chart = 3 OR c.default_chart = 8) AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_sigma
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 5 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_imr
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 7 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_mr
		      WHEN c.default_chart = 8 AND c.cl_source = 2 THEN c.cl_ms
		      END

		,@filter_by_ent_id = c.filter_by_ent_id, @filter_by_item_id = c.filter_by_item_id, @filter_by_wo_id = c.filter_by_wo_id
		,@filter_by_oper_id = c.filter_by_oper_id, @filter_by_process_id = c.filter_by_process_id
		,@filter_by_segment_req_id = c.filter_by_segment_req_id, @filter_by_segment_resp_id = c.filter_by_segment_resp_id
		,@filter_by_spare1 = c.filter_by_spare1, @filter_by_spare2 = c.filter_by_spare2
		,@filter_by_spare3 = c.filter_by_spare3, @filter_by_spare4 = c.filter_by_spare4

	FROM characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE c.char_id = @char_id

	--Step 2: Read QM Spec settings and override characteristic settings, if applicable.
	--Retrieve the QM spec overrides such as minimum sample size, cl_source, etc. from the characteristic.
	--Retrieve the control limits configured for a chart.  If the default chart supports two charts, then retrieve the control limits for both the charts.
	--For example, if the default chart type for a characteristic is MA + MR (7), then the control limits for the first chart is stored in the *_first_chart variables (lcl_first_chart, cl_first_chart and ucl_first_chart)
	--the control limits for the second chart is stored in the *_second_chart variables (lcl_second_chart, cl_second_chart and ucl_second_chart).
	--If the overridden value is null, then use the value retrieved from the characteristic.
	SELECT @default_chart = COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart)
		,@minimum_sample_size = COALESCE(spcl.minimum_sample_size, @minimum_sample_size)
		,@normal_sample_size = COALESCE(spcl.normal_sample_size, @normal_sample_size)
		,@severity_cd = COALESCE(spcl.severity_cd, @severity_cd)
		,@std_avg = COALESCE(/*spcl.std_avg*/ spcl.std_avg, @std_avg)
		,@std_deviation = COALESCE(spcl.std_deviation, @std_deviation)
		,@target = spcl.target, @lsl = spcl.lsl, @usl = spcl.usl
		,@std_avg_is_target = COALESCE(spcl.std_avg_is_target, @std_avg_is_target)
		,@cl_source = COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source)
		,@samples_for_cl = COALESCE(spcl.samples_for_cl, @samples_for_cl)
		,@samples_before_cl = COALESCE(spcl.samples_before_cl, @samples_before_cl)
		,@lcl_first_chart = CASE WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) IN (2,3) AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_xbar, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 5 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_ix, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) IN (7,8) AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_ma, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 16 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_p, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 17 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_np, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 18 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_u, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 19 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_c, @lcl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 20 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_u * (1000000 / COALESCE(@num_defect_opp, 1.0)), @lcl_first_chart)
		      END

		,@ucl_first_chart = CASE WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) IN (2,3) AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_xbar, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 5 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_ix, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) IN (7,8) AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_ma, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 16 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_p, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 17 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_np, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 18 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_u, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 19 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_c, @ucl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 20 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_u * (1000000 / COALESCE(@num_defect_opp, 1.0)), @ucl_first_chart)
		      END

		,@cl_first_chart = CASE WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) IN (2,3) AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_xbar, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 5 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_ix, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) IN (7,8) AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_ma, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 16 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_p, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 17 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_np, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 18 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_u, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 19 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_c, @cl_first_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 20 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_u * (1000000 / COALESCE(@num_defect_opp, 1.0)), @cl_first_chart)
		      END

		-- Retrieve the control limits for the second chart
		,@lcl_second_chart = CASE WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 2 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_range, @lcl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 3 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_sigma, @lcl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 5 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_imr, @lcl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 7 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_mr, @lcl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 8 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.lcl_ms, @lcl_second_chart)
		      END

		,@ucl_second_chart = CASE WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 2 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_range, @ucl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 3 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_sigma, @ucl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 5 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_imr, @ucl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 7 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_mr, @ucl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 8 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.ucl_ms, @ucl_second_chart)
		      END

		,@cl_second_chart = CASE WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 2 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_range, @cl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 3 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_sigma, @cl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 5 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_imr, @cl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 7 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_mr, @cl_second_chart)
		      WHEN COALESCE(spcl.default_chart, @default_chart) = 8 AND COALESCE(spcl.cl_source, @cl_source) = 2 THEN COALESCE(spcl.cl_ms, @cl_second_chart)
		      END

	FROM qm_spec_char_link spcl WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE spcl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
	  AND spcl.char_id = @char_id

	-- If the standard values are being used to calculate control limits and the target is being used
	-- for the standard average assign the target to the standard average
	IF (@cl_source = 1 AND @std_avg_is_target = 1)
		SET @std_avg = @target

	IF (@operator IS NULL)
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @operator OUTPUT, NULL

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	-- Get the cut-off time in days and the number of samples to use for calculating statistics
	-- from the system_attr table.  If the cut-off time is zero, then all samples are considered.
	-- Any sample older than the cut-off time in days will be ignored when calculating statistics.
	-- The number of samples specifies the maximum number of sample to consider when calculating
	-- statistics.
	SELECT @cutoffDaysForStats = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 434
	IF (@cutoffDaysForStats IS NULL) SET @cutoffDaysForStats = 0
	SELECT @samplesForStats = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 436
	IF (@samplesForStats IS NULL) SET @samplesForStats = 200
	SET @cutoffDateForStats = DATEADD(dd, -1 * @cutoffDaysForStats, getutcdate())

	-- For story 35170, if the samples_for_cl value is not zero and is less than the value for system attribute
	-- 436, which is the number of samples to use for statistics, we will use the samples_for_cl value to limit
	-- the number of samples for statistics and to calculate the number of control rules.  If the value in
	-- samples_for_cl is greater than the value for system attribute 436, then we will use the value in system
	-- attribute 436 to limit the number of samples used to calculate statistics and to calculate the control limits.
	IF (@samples_for_cl <> 0 AND @samples_for_cl < @samplesForStats)
		SET @samplesForStats = @samples_for_cl

	DECLARE @tmp_filtered_samples TABLE ( sample_id INT PRIMARY KEY)
	INSERT INTO @tmp_filtered_samples
	 SELECT TOP(@samplesForStats) s.sample_id
			FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qmscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qmscl.qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND qmscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			WHERE scl.char_id = @char_id
			--Ignore samples that are marked to ignore the samples.
			  AND scl.ignore_sample = 0
			  -- Only consider samples that have sufficient results entered for them
			  AND scl.act_sample_size >= COALESCE(qmscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size)
			--Apply all the filters
			  AND ((@filter_by_ent_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_ent_id = 1 AND s.ent_id = @ent_id))
			  AND ((@filter_by_item_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_item_id = 1 AND (s.item_id = @item_id OR (s.item_id IS NULL AND @item_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_wo_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_wo_id = 1 AND (s.wo_id = @wo_id OR (s.wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_oper_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_oper_id = 1 AND (s.oper_id = @oper_id OR (s.oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_process_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_process_id = 1 AND (s.process_id = @process_id OR (s.process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_segment_req_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_req_id = 1 AND (s.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (s.segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 1 AND (s.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (s.segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare1 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare1 = 1 AND (s.spare1 = @spare1 OR (s.spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare2 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare2 = 1 AND (s.spare2 = @spare2 OR (s.spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare3 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare3 = 1 AND (s.spare3 = @spare3 OR (s.spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare4 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare4 = 1 AND (s.spare4 = @spare4 OR (s.spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL))))
			  AND (@cutoffDaysForStats = 0 OR s.requested_time_utc >= @cutoffDateForStats)
			ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc DESC, s.sample_id

			--Step 3: Create individual chart points (1=IX) in the temporary table - filtered data with entity, item contexts, etc.
	-- Regardless of how control rules are validated, for the case of calculating statistics, all chart points are required.
	-- Find out all the chart points after applying the filter and store them in the temporary table for faster access.
	INSERT INTO @chart_points (chart_type, chart_label, chart_point_first_chart, sample_size, sample_id, control_move)
	SELECT CASE WHEN @default_chart IN (2,3,5,7,8,16) THEN 1 ELSE @default_chart END
		, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc, r.value_no)
		,r.result_value
		, scl.act_sample_size
		, s.sample_id
		, scl.control_move
	FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON r.sample_id = scl.sample_id AND r.char_id = scl.char_id
	INNER JOIN sample s WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
	-- Do not select more records than specified in system attr = 436 which specifies the maximum number
	-- of samples to use when calculating statistics.  Also, do not fetched any sample that is older than
	-- the number of days specified in system attr = 434 which specifies the cut-off date for samples.
	INNER JOIN @tmp_filtered_samples tfs ON tfs.sample_id = s.sample_id
	WHERE scl.char_id = @char_id
	  AND r.superseded = 0
	ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc, r.value_no
	--DROP TABLE #tmp_filtered_samples

	IF (@projected_result_data_xml IS NULL) BEGIN

		-- Create statistics record, if a record for this statistics does not exist.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM stats WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE char_id = @char_id AND ent_id = @ent_id)
			INSERT INTO stats (char_id, ent_id, act_percent_out_of_sl, max_result_value, mean_result_value, min_result_value, num_results, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			VALUES (@char_id, @ent_id, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, @operator, @last_edit_at)

		--Step 4: Update common statistics in the stats table, such as mean, act_percent_out_of_spec, no_of_results, etc, using the individual chart points.
		--This is not the projected data, so update the stats table.
		--Calculate Statistics using the chart points.

		SELECT @mean_result_value = COALESCE(stats_value.mean_value, 0), @max_result_value = COALESCE(stats_value.max_value, 0)
			,@min_result_value = COALESCE(stats_value.min_value, 0), @range = COALESCE(stats_value.range_value, 0)
			,@num_results = COALESCE(stats_value.number_of_ind_readings, 0)
			,@total = COALESCE(stats_value.number_of_samples, 0)
			,@act_percent_out_of_sl = COALESCE(stats_value.act_percent_out_of_sl, 0)
			,@filter_ent_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_ent_id = 1 THEN @ent_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_item_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_item_id = 1 THEN @item_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_wo_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_wo_id = 1 THEN @wo_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_oper_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_oper_id = 1 THEN @Oper_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_process_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_process_id = 1 THEN @process_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_segment_requirement_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_segment_req_id = 1 THEN @segment_requirement_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_segment_response_id = CASE WHEN @filter_by_segment_resp_id = 1 THEN @segment_response_id ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_spare1 = CASE WHEN @filter_by_spare1 = 1 THEN @spare1 ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_spare2 = CASE WHEN @filter_by_spare2 = 1 THEN @spare2 ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_spare3 = CASE WHEN @filter_by_spare3 = 1 THEN @spare3 ELSE NULL END
			,@stats_spare4 = CASE WHEN @filter_by_spare4 = 1 THEN @spare4 ELSE NULL END
			,@population_mean = COALESCE(stats_value.mean_value, 0)
			,@population_sigma = stats_value.std_dev_value
			,@p_or_u_Bar = stats_value.p_or_u_bar
		FROM
			(SELECT
				  CASE @default_chart
					WHEN 16 THEN SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 18 THEN SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 20 THEN SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size) * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
					ELSE AVG(cp.chart_point_first_chart)
				  END AS mean_value
				, CASE @default_chart
					WHEN 16 THEN SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) *
									  ((1 - (SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)))) / @normal_sample_size)
					WHEN 17 THEN @normal_sample_size * (SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) *
									  ((1 - (SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)))) / @normal_sample_size))
					WHEN 18 THEN SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) * @normal_sample_size) / @normal_sample_size
					WHEN 19 THEN SQRT(SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size) * @normal_sample_size)
					WHEN 20 THEN SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) * @normal_sample_size) / @normal_sample_size * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
					ELSE STDEV(cp.chart_point_first_chart)
				  END AS std_dev_value
				, MAX(cp.chart_point_first_chart)-MIN(cp.chart_point_first_chart) AS range_value
				, MIN(cp.chart_point_first_chart) AS min_value, MAX(cp.chart_point_first_chart) AS max_value
				, COUNT(*) AS number_of_ind_readings
				, SUM(CASE WHEN (cp.chart_point_first_chart < @lsl OR cp.chart_point_first_chart > @usl) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(*) AS act_percent_out_of_sl
				, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.sample_id) AS number_of_samples
				,CASE @default_chart
					WHEN 17 THEN  SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 19 THEN  SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 20 THEN  SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					ELSE NULL
				 END AS p_or_u_bar

			 FROM @chart_points cp
			 WHERE cp.chart_type IN (1, 17, 18, 19, 20)
			) stats_value
	END
	ELSE
		-- This is the projected data.  Do not update the stats table, but calculate the population mean and sigma and store them in the appropriate variables.
		SELECT @population_mean =
				CASE @default_chart
					WHEN 16 THEN SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 18 THEN SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 20 THEN SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size) * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
					ELSE AVG(cp.chart_point_first_chart)
				END
			,@population_sigma =
				CASE @default_chart
					WHEN 16 THEN SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) *
									  (1 - (SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size))) / @normal_sample_size)
					WHEN 17 THEN @normal_sample_size * (SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) *
									  (1 - (SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size))) / @normal_sample_size))
					WHEN 18 THEN SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) * @normal_sample_size) / @normal_sample_size
					WHEN 19 THEN SQRT(SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size) * @normal_sample_size)
					WHEN 20 THEN SQRT((SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)) * @normal_sample_size) / @normal_sample_size * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
					ELSE STDEV(cp.chart_point_first_chart)
				END
			,@p_or_u_Bar =
				CASE @default_chart
					WHEN 17 THEN  SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 19 THEN  SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					WHEN 20 THEN  SUM(cp.chart_point_first_chart)/SUM(cp.sample_size)
					ELSE NULL
				END
		FROM @chart_points cp
		WHERE cp.chart_type IN (1, 17, 18, 19, 20)

	-- Step 5: Based on the chart type configured for the characteristic,
	-- create chart points (chart_point_first_chart and chart_point_second_chart) specific to the chart type
	--2:XBar + Range OR 3:XBar + Sigma
	IF (@default_chart = 2 OR @default_chart = 3)
		INSERT INTO @chart_points (chart_type, chart_label, chart_point_first_chart, chart_point_second_chart, sample_size, control_move)
		SELECT @default_chart, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc), scl.mean
			--IF the default chart is 2, then the range value from a sample is populated in the chart_point_second_chart column
			--Else (default chart is 3) the sigma value from a sample is populated in the chart_point_second_chart column
			,CASE WHEN @default_chart = 2 THEN scl.range
			 ELSE scl.standard_dev END
			,scl.act_sample_size
			,scl.control_move
		FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
		-- As per conversation with JeffB on 10/18/2011, the number of records should not be more than 3000 most recent records after applying all the filters to calculate statistics.
		INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP(@samplesForStats) s.sample_id
			FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = s.sample_id
			WHERE scl.char_id = @char_id
			--Ignore samples that are marked to ignore the samples.
			  AND scl.ignore_sample = 0
			-- CRL00132266 : Introduced a condition in where clause to exclude missed samples in case of XBar + Range Chart.
			  AND s.sample_status <>3
			--Apply all the filters
			  AND ((@filter_by_ent_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_ent_id = 1 AND s.ent_id = @ent_id))
			  AND ((@filter_by_item_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_item_id = 1 AND (s.item_id = @item_id OR (s.item_id IS NULL AND @item_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_wo_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_wo_id = 1 AND (s.wo_id = @wo_id OR (s.wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_oper_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_oper_id = 1 AND (s.oper_id = @oper_id OR (s.oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_process_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_process_id = 1 AND (s.process_id = @process_id OR (s.process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_segment_req_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_req_id = 1 AND (s.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (s.segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 1 AND (s.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (s.segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare1 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare1 = 1 AND (s.spare1 = @spare1 OR (s.spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare2 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare2 = 1 AND (s.spare2 = @spare2 OR (s.spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare3 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare3 = 1 AND (s.spare3 = @spare3 OR (s.spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))))
			  AND ((@filter_by_spare4 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare4 = 1 AND (s.spare4 = @spare4 OR (s.spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL))))
			  AND (@cutoffDaysForStats = 0 OR s.requested_time_utc >= @cutoffDateForStats)
			ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc DESC, s.sample_id) filtered_samples ON filtered_samples.sample_id = s.sample_id
		WHERE scl.char_id = @char_id
		  AND scl.ignore_sample = 0
		ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc

	--Initialize the moving variables
	SELECT @calc_moving_chart_points = 0

	--5: IX + MR
	--Verify whether this characteristic is configured to use standard deviation (0)
	--OR, a rule is linked to this spec AND this characteristic is not excluded from validating the rules and the rule is no longer obsolete
	IF (@default_chart = 5) BEGIN
		IF (@sigma_est = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_spec_rule_link qsrl WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON qsrl.rule_id = sr.rule_id
					LEFT OUTER JOIN char_rule_exc cre WITH (NOLOCK) ON cre.rule_id = sr.rule_id AND cre.char_id = @char_id
					WHERE (qsrl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND cre.rule_id IS NULL)
					  AND sr.obsolete = 0 AND sr.use_for_mr = 1))
			--Set the moving average span to 2.
			SELECT @mov_avg_span = 2, @calc_moving_chart_points = 1
	END

	--7: MA + Range  OR 8: MA + Sigma
	IF (@default_chart = 7) OR (@default_chart = 8)
		--These charts require customized chart points at least to calculate statistics, regardless of whether a control rule
		--is attached to this or not, so turn on this flag by default.
		SELECT @calc_moving_chart_points = 1

	IF (@calc_moving_chart_points = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@default_chart = 5) -- 5:IX + MR
			INSERT INTO @chart_points (chart_type, chart_label, chart_point_first_chart, chart_point_second_chart, control_move, second_chart_control_move)
			--The first chart point for the second chart (MR) is always NULL
			SELECT @default_chart, cp1.chart_label, cp1.chart_point_first_chart, NULL, control_move, control_move
			FROM @chart_points cp1 WHERE cp1.chart_label = 1
			UNION
			--The chart point for the first chart is the IX value, and the chart point for the second chart is the difference between the previous value and the first value
			SELECT @default_chart, cp1.chart_label, cp1.chart_point_first_chart, ABS(cp1.chart_point_first_chart - cp2.chart_point_first_chart), cp1.control_move, CASE WHEN cp1.control_move IS NULL OR cp1.control_move = 0 THEN cp2.control_move ELSE cp1.control_move END
			FROM @chart_points cp1
			INNER JOIN (SELECT cp.chart_label+1 AS chart_label, cp.chart_point_first_chart, cp.control_move
						FROM @chart_points cp) cp2 ON cp1.chart_label = cp2.chart_label
		ELSE IF (@default_chart = 7 OR @default_chart = 8) BEGIN --7:MA+MR (Moving Average and Moving Range), 8:MA+Sigma (Moving Average and Moving Sigma)
			INSERT INTO @chart_points (chart_type, chart_label, chart_point_first_chart, chart_point_second_chart, control_move)
			SELECT @default_chart, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY moving_chart_points.chart_label) AS chart_label
				,moving_chart_points.chart_point_first_chart
				,moving_chart_points.chart_point_second_chart
				,moving_chart_points.control_move
			FROM
				(SELECT cp1.chart_label,
						-- The moving average for the first chart (MA) for the chart points that are less than the moving average span are always NULL.
						CASE WHEN cp1.chart_label < @mov_avg_span THEN NULL
						--Calculate the moving average
							ELSE AVG(cp2.chart_point_first_chart) END AS chart_point_first_chart
					--7: MA + MR (Moving Average and Moving Range) - calculate the moving range
					,CASE WHEN @default_chart = 7 AND cp1.chart_label >= @mov_avg_span THEN MAX(cp2.chart_point_first_chart) - MIN(cp2.chart_point_first_chart)
					--8: MA + Ms (Moving Average and Moving Sigma) - calculate the moving sigma
						WHEN @default_chart = 8 AND cp1.chart_label >= @mov_avg_span THEN STDEV(cp2.chart_point_first_chart)
						 ELSE NULL END AS chart_point_second_chart
					, MAX(CAST(cp2.control_move AS INT)) as control_move
				FROM @chart_points cp1
				INNER JOIN @chart_points cp2 ON cp2.chart_label <= cp1.chart_label AND cp2.chart_label > cp1.chart_label - @mov_avg_span
				WHERE cp1.chart_type = 1
				GROUP BY cp1.chart_label
				) moving_chart_points
			WHERE moving_chart_points.chart_point_first_chart IS NOT NULL
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@default_chart = 5) -- IX + MR, but only IX
			UPDATE @chart_points SET chart_type = @default_chart
	END

	-- 16: p Chart
	-- 18: u chart
	-- Create the chart points by updating the chart_type from 1 to 16 for p chart or 18 for u chart and create the chart points
	-- by dividing the raw value by the sample size.
	IF (@default_chart = 16 OR @default_chart = 18) BEGIN
		UPDATE @chart_points SET chart_type = @default_chart, chart_point_first_chart = chart_point_first_chart/CASE WHEN sample_size = 0 THEN 1 ELSE sample_size END
	END -- p or u Chart
	ELSE IF (@default_chart = 20) BEGIN
		UPDATE @chart_points SET chart_type = @default_chart, chart_point_first_chart = (chart_point_first_chart/sample_size) * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
	END -- DPMO chart

	--  Step 6: Calculate Estimated Sigma based on the chart type, if required; otherwise, default to population sigma.
	IF (@sigma_est = 0) BEGIN -- Use Factor Table
		-- Calculate estimated sigma based on the chart type linked to this characteristic
		IF (@default_chart = 2)  --2:XBar + Range
			SELECT @estimated_sigma = SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart/f.d_2)/COUNT(*)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			INNER JOIN factor f WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.sample_size = f.sample_size
			WHERE cp.chart_type = @default_chart
			  AND cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL
		ELSE IF (@default_chart = 3) --3:XBar + Sigma
			SELECT @estimated_sigma = SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart/f.c_4)/COUNT(*)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			INNER JOIN factor f WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.sample_size = f.sample_size
			WHERE cp.chart_type = @default_chart
			  AND cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL
		ELSE IF (@default_chart = 5) --5:IX + MR (Individual and Moving Range)
			SELECT @estimated_sigma = (SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart)/COUNT(*))/(SELECT d_2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_size = 2)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			WHERE cp.chart_type = @default_chart
			  AND cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL
		ELSE IF (@default_chart = 7) --7:MA + MR (Moving Average and Moving Range)
			SELECT @estimated_sigma = (SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart)/COUNT(*))/(SELECT d_2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			WHERE cp.chart_type = @default_chart
			  AND cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL
		ELSE IF (@default_chart = 8)  --8:MA + MS (Moving Average and Moving Sigma)
			SELECT @estimated_sigma = (SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart)/COUNT(*))/(SELECT c_4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			WHERE cp.chart_type = @default_chart
			  AND cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL
	END
	-- If sigma estimate is set to use the factor tables (0), then the calculated estimated sigma (calculated above) is used to calculate control limits
	-- otherwise; the population sigma is used to calculate the control limits.
	-- So, a value from the population sigma variable is copied to the estimated sigma variable if the sigma estimation is set to use population sigma.
	ELSE SET @estimated_sigma = @population_sigma  -- Use Overall Standard Deviation

	-- Step 6a: Calculate the rbar value
	SELECT @rbar = SUM(RANGE)/COUNT(*)
	FROM sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE range IS NOT NULL and act_sample_size > 1
		AND char_id = @char_id
		AND sample_id in (SELECT DISTINCT(sample_id) FROM @chart_points)

	-- Step 6b: Calculate the mrbar and msbar values
	IF (@default_chart = 7)
		SELECT @mrbar = SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart)/COUNT(*)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			WHERE cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL

	IF (@default_chart = 8)
		SELECT @msBar = SUM(cp.chart_point_second_chart)/COUNT(*)
			FROM @chart_points cp
			WHERE cp.chart_point_second_chart IS NOT NULL

	--Default the sigma values to 1 to prevent divide by zero error while calculating Cp, CpK, Pp and PpK.
	SELECT @estimated_sigma = COALESCE(@estimated_sigma, 99999), @population_sigma = COALESCE(@population_sigma, 99999)
	IF (@estimated_sigma = 0) SET @estimated_sigma = 99999
	IF (@population_sigma = 0) SET @population_sigma = 99999

	-- Determine the total number of samples.  This is used to verify that samples_before_cl has been met.
	SELECT @num_samples = COUNT(DISTINCT(sample_id))
	FROM @chart_points

	--  Step 7: Remove all the chart points for chart type = 1, as they are not required anymore.
	--Delete all the individual chart points, as they are not required anymore.
	DELETE FROM @chart_points WHERE chart_type = 1

	--  Step 8: Calculate and update stats table for Cp, CpK, Pp, PpK values.
	-- Update the calc statistics in the stats table
	IF (@projected_result_data_xml IS NULL AND @default_chart IN (2, 3, 5, 7, 8)) BEGIN
		--This is not the projected data, so update the stats table.
		SELECT @cp = cap_perf_stats.cp
			,@cpk = CASE WHEN (@lsl IS NOT NULL AND @usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl END
				    WHEN (@usl IS NOT NULL AND @lsl IS NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
				    WHEN (@usl IS NULL AND @lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
				    ELSE 0
				END
			,@pp = cap_perf_stats.pp
			,@ppk = CASE WHEN (@lsl IS NOT NULL AND @usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl END
				    WHEN (@usl IS NOT NULL AND @lsl IS NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
				    WHEN (@usl IS NULL AND @lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
				    ELSE 0
				END
		FROM
			(SELECT CASE WHEN @lsl IS NULL OR @usl IS NULL THEN COALESCE(@usl, @target) - COALESCE(@lsl, @target)/(3 * @estimated_sigma)
					ELSE (@usl - @lsl) / (6 * @estimated_sigma) END AS cp
				,(@usl - @population_mean) / (3 * @estimated_sigma) AS cpk_usl
				,(@population_mean - @lsl) / (3*@estimated_sigma) AS cpk_lsl
				, CASE WHEN @lsl IS NULL OR @usl IS NULL THEN COALESCE(@usl, @target) - COALESCE(@lsl, @target)/(3 * @population_sigma)
					ELSE (@usl - @lsl) / (6 * @population_sigma) END AS pp
				,(@usl - @population_mean) / (3 * @population_sigma) AS ppk_usl
				,(@population_mean - @lsl) / (3 * @population_sigma) AS ppk_lsl
			) cap_perf_stats
	END

	-- If the characteristic is not configured to validate control rules, the characteristic is excluded,
	-- or the samples_before_cl has not been met and we are calculating control limits from the data
	-- , then do not validate control rules.
	IF (@severity_cd < 2 OR (@cl_source = 0 AND @num_samples < @samples_before_cl)) BEGIN
		SELECT @stats_ent_id = s.ent_id, @stats_char_id = s.char_id
		FROM stats s WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (char_id = @char_id
		  AND ent_id = @ent_id)
		  OR (@filter_by_ent_id = 0 AND char_id = @char_id
		  --Apply all the filters
		  AND ((@filter_by_item_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_item_id = 1 AND (s.item_id = @item_id OR (s.item_id IS NULL AND @item_id IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_wo_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_wo_id = 1 AND (s.wo_id = @wo_id OR (s.wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_oper_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_oper_id = 1 AND (s.oper_id = @oper_id OR (s.oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_process_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_process_id = 1 AND (s.process_id = @process_id OR (s.process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_segment_req_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_req_id = 1 AND (s.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (s.segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 1 AND (s.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (s.segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_spare1 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare1 = 1 AND (s.spare1 = @spare1 OR (s.spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_spare2 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare2 = 1 AND (s.spare2 = @spare2 OR (s.spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_spare3 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare3 = 1 AND (s.spare3 = @spare3 OR (s.spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))))
		  AND ((@filter_by_spare4 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare4 = 1 AND (s.spare4 = @spare4 OR (s.spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL)))))

		UPDATE stats WITH (UPDLOCK)

			INNER JOIN spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON qsrl.rule_id = sr.rule_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN char_rule_exc cre WITH (NOLOCK) ON cre.rule_id = sr.rule_id AND cre.char_id = @char_id
			--Verify this rule is attached to the spec and this characteristic is not excluded from this rule.
			WHERE (qsrl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND cre.rule_id IS NULL)
			--Verify this rule is not obsolete and it is linked to the 'DPMO' chart.
			  AND sr.obsolete = 0 AND sr.use_for_attr = 1) BEGIN

			SELECT @adjusted_std_dev = CASE WHEN @cl_source = 0 THEN SQRT(@p_or_u_bar/act_sample_size) * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
							WHEN @cl_source = 1 THEN SQRT(@std_avg/act_sample_size) * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
							ELSE NULL END
				,@cl_first_chart = CASE WHEN @cl_source = 0 THEN @population_mean
							WHEN @cl_source = 1 THEN @std_avg * (1000000.0/@num_defect_opp)
							ELSE NULL END
			FROM sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sample_id = @sample_id AND char_id = @char_id

			-- Calculate the lower control limit and the upper control limit from the center line.
			SELECT @lcl_first_chart = @cl_first_chart - (3 * @adjusted_std_dev)
				, @ucl_first_chart = @cl_first_chart + (3 * @adjusted_std_dev)
		END
	END

	-- Step 10: Remove all the chart points except last 14 (that maximum of last 14 chart points is what required to validate a run rule for a chart)
	-- 	I.e. the temporary table should not contain no more than 14 rows.
	-- Remove all the chart points except the last 14 chart points.  There wouldn't be no more than 14 points required to calculate the rule violations.
	-- In other words, restrict the number of records returned from the result, as we are not going to use more than 14 points anyway (12 of 14 on one side is the max rule)
	-- to evaluate the control rule violations.
	-- Do the deletion here, because the at least one of the chart (MA+Range) requires all the chart points to calculate the moving average.
	SELECT @max_chart_label = MAX(chart_label) FROM @chart_points WHERE chart_type = @default_chart

	-- Also we do not want control rule violations to cross control move boundries.  If a point is marked as a
	-- control move control rules that point and any points before it cannot be used in the calculation of control
	-- violations for the current point.  So we can delete the latest point that is marked as a control move and
	-- all the points before it.
	SELECT @max_control_move_label = MAX(chart_label)
	FROM @chart_points
	WHERE chart_type = @default_chart
		AND control_move = 1

	DELETE FROM @chart_points
	FROM (SELECT MAX(@default_chart) AS un_chart_type, MAX(sr.of_points) as max_of_points
		FROM spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ((@default_chart IN (2,3) AND sr.use_for_xbar = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart = 5 AND sr.use_for_ix = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart IN (7,8) AND sr.use_for_ma = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart IN (16,17,18,19,20) AND sr.use_for_attr = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart = 2 AND sr.use_for_range = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart IN (3,8) AND sr.use_for_sigma = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart IN (5,7) AND sr.use_for_mr = 1))
		  AND sr.obsolete = 0
		) unneeded_chart_points
	WHERE chart_type = COALESCE(unneeded_chart_points.un_chart_type, @default_chart)
		AND (chart_label <= @max_chart_label - COALESCE(unneeded_chart_points.max_of_points, 0)
		OR (@max_control_move_label IS NOT NULL AND chart_label <= @max_control_move_label))

	-- Step 11: Calculate LowerSigma and UpperSigma for the first chart and the second chart using the control limits obtained above.
	--Calculate the Lower Sigma and Upper Sigma for the first chart, and calculate the Lower Sigma and Upper Sigma for the second chart
	SELECT @std_dev_lower_first_chart = (@cl_first_chart - @lcl_first_chart) / 3, @std_dev_upper_first_chart = (@ucl_first_chart - @cl_first_chart) / 3
		,@std_dev_lower_second_chart = (@cl_second_chart - @lcl_second_chart) / 3, @std_dev_upper_second_chart = (@ucl_second_chart - @cl_second_chart) / 3

	--Update sigma level
	IF (@std_dev_lower_first_chart = 0) SET @std_dev_lower_first_chart = NULL
	IF (@std_dev_upper_first_chart = 0) SET @std_dev_upper_first_chart = NULL
	IF (@std_dev_lower_second_chart = 0) SET @std_dev_lower_second_chart = NULL
	IF (@std_dev_upper_second_chart = 0) SET @std_dev_upper_second_chart = NULL

	-- Step 12: Update the sigma level in the temporary table for the first chart and the second chart based on the LowerSigma and UpperSigma calculated above.
	--Update the chart points in the temporary table with appropriate sigma limits.
	UPDATE @chart_points
	SET lower_sigma_level_first_chart = (chart_point_first_chart - @cl_first_chart)/@std_dev_lower_first_chart
		,upper_sigma_level_first_chart = (chart_point_first_chart - @cl_first_chart)/@std_dev_upper_first_chart
		,lower_sigma_level_second_chart = (chart_point_second_chart - @cl_second_chart)/@std_dev_lower_second_chart
		,upper_sigma_level_second_chart = (chart_point_second_chart - @cl_second_chart)/@std_dev_upper_second_chart

	--Determine the side of the last chart point for the first chart and the last chart point for the second chart.
	--The purpose of determining side to which the chart point belongs is to verify whether the preceding chart points belong on the same side
	--For example, if the definition of the rule is 2 out 3 are outside 2 standard deviation, then it is required to know whether
	--the current chart point is above the mean or below the mean, so that the preceding chart points can be evalated on the same side that the last chart point belongs.
	--Select the last chart label, and the last chart points for the first chart and the second chart
	SELECT @last_chart_label = cp.chart_label
		,@last_chart_point_first_chart = cp.chart_point_first_chart
		,@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_fc = cp.lower_sigma_level_first_chart, @last_cp_upper_sigma_level_fc = cp.upper_sigma_level_first_chart
		,@last_chart_point_second_chart = cp.chart_point_second_chart
		,@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_sc = cp.lower_sigma_level_second_chart, @last_cp_upper_sigma_level_sc = cp.upper_sigma_level_second_chart
	FROM @chart_points cp
	WHERE cp.chart_type = @default_chart
	  AND cp.chart_label = @max_chart_label

	--Set up the chart name to be returned as a string message for the clients.
	SELECT @chart_name_first_chart = CASE WHEN @default_chart IN (2, 3) THEN 'XBar Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart = 5 THEN 'Individual X (IX) Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart IN (7, 8) THEN 'Moving Average (MA) Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart = 16 THEN 'p Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart = 17 THEN 'np Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart = 18 THEN 'u Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart = 19 THEN 'c Chart'
				WHEN @default_chart = 20 THEN 'DPMO Chart'
			ELSE '' END

	SELECT @chart_name_second_chart = CASE WHEN @default_chart = 2 THEN 'Range Chart'
						  WHEN @default_chart = 3 THEN 'Sigma Chart'
						  WHEN @default_chart IN (5, 7) THEN 'Moving Range Chart'
						  WHEN @default_chart = 8 THEN 'Moving Sigma Chart'
						ELSE '' END

	SELECT @chart_name_first_chart = '  [' + @chart_name_first_chart + ']: ', @chart_name_second_chart = '  [' + @chart_name_second_chart + ']: '
		, @control_rule_violations = ' '

	--Remove all the control rule violations for this sample
	DELETE FROM sample_char_rule_link
	WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
	  AND char_id = @char_id

	CREATE TABLE #chart_points (chart_type INT NOT NULL, chart_label INT NOT NULL, chart_point_first_chart FLOAT, chart_point_second_chart FLOAT,
		sample_size INT, lower_sigma_level_first_chart FLOAT, upper_sigma_level_first_chart FLOAT, lower_sigma_level_second_chart FLOAT, upper_sigma_level_second_chart FLOAT, sample_id INT
		PRIMARY KEY (chart_type, chart_label))

	INSERT INTO #chart_points (chart_type, chart_label, chart_point_first_chart, chart_point_second_chart, sample_size,
		lower_sigma_level_first_chart, upper_sigma_level_first_chart, lower_sigma_level_second_chart, upper_sigma_level_second_chart, sample_id)
	SELECT chart_type, chart_label, chart_point_first_chart, chart_point_second_chart, sample_size,
		lower_sigma_level_first_chart, upper_sigma_level_first_chart, lower_sigma_level_second_chart, upper_sigma_level_second_chart, sample_id
	FROM @chart_points

	-- Step 13 and Step 14: Loop through each rule for the first chart and the second chart to evaluate a rule violation, and log the rule violation in the sample_char_rule_link table if necessary.
	-- Verify control rule violations
	DECLARE spec_rule_cursor CURSOR READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT rules.rule_id, rules.chart_position, 'ID(' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(rules.rule_id))) + '): ' + rules.rule_desc + ';'
		,rules.test1, rules.test2, rules.and_not_or, rules.num_points
		,rules.of_points, rules.sigma_limits_for_test1, rules.sigma_limits_for_test2

		--Rule 2: 	     3					     of 7			outside 2 standard deviations
		--Example: 	     3 AS no_of_chart_points_beyond_limits    7 AS no_of_chart_points	2 AS sigma_limit1; -2 AS sigma_limit2
	FROM
		--1 as chart_position represents the rule is attached for the first chart.
		(SELECT qsrl.rule_id, sr.rule_desc, 1 AS chart_position
		,sr.test1, sr.test2, sr.and_not_or, sr.num_points
		,sr.of_points,  sr.level1 as sigma_limits_for_test1, sr.level2 as sigma_limits_for_test2
		FROM qm_spec_rule_link qsrl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON qsrl.rule_id = sr.rule_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN char_rule_exc cre WITH (NOLOCK) ON cre.rule_id = sr.rule_id AND cre.char_id = @char_id
		--Verify this rule is attached to the spec and this characteristic is not excluded from this rule.
		WHERE (qsrl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND cre.rule_id IS NULL)
		--Verify this rule is not obsolete
		  AND sr.obsolete = 0
		--Perform the rule evaluations on the first chart first, and then perform the rule violations on the second chart.
		--For example, if the default chart for this characteristic is 7:MA+MR (Moving Average and Moving Range)
		--then, all the control rules are evaluated againts the MA (Moving Average) first, and then all the control rules are evaluated against the MR (Moving Range).
		  AND (((@default_chart = 2 OR @default_chart = 3) AND sr.use_for_xbar = 1)
		   OR (@default_chart = 5 AND sr.use_for_ix = 1)
		   OR ((@default_chart = 7 OR @default_chart = 8) AND sr.use_for_ma = 1)
		   OR ((@default_chart = 16 OR @default_chart = 17 OR @default_chart = 18 OR @default_chart = 19 OR @default_chart = 20) AND sr.use_for_attr = 1))
		--2 as chart_position represents the rule is attached for the second chart.
		UNION ALL
		SELECT qsrl.rule_id, sr.rule_desc, 2 AS chart_position
		,sr.test1, sr.test2, sr.and_not_or, sr.num_points
		,sr.of_points,  sr.level1 as sigma_limits_for_test1, sr.level2 as sigma_limits_for_test2
		FROM qm_spec_rule_link qsrl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON qsrl.rule_id = sr.rule_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN char_rule_exc cre WITH (NOLOCK) ON cre.rule_id = sr.rule_id AND cre.char_id = @char_id
		--Verify this rule is attached to the spec and this characteristic is not excluded from this rule.
		WHERE (qsrl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND cre.rule_id IS NULL)
		--Verify this rule is not obsolete
		  AND sr.obsolete = 0
		  AND ((@default_chart = 2 AND sr.use_for_range = 1)
		   OR ((@default_chart = 3 OR @default_chart = 8) AND sr.use_for_sigma = 1)
		   OR ((@default_chart = 5 OR @default_chart = 7) AND sr.use_for_mr = 1))
		) rules
	ORDER BY rules.chart_position, rules.rule_id

	OPEN spec_rule_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

		FETCH NEXT FROM spec_rule_cursor INTO @rule_id, @chart_position, @rule_desc
			, @test1, @test2, @and_not_or, @num_points
			, @of_points, @sigma_limits_for_test1, @sigma_limits_for_test2
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		SELECT @test1_result = 0, @test2_result = 0

		IF (@chart_position = 1) BEGIN -- First/Top Chart
			--Validate for control rule violations, only if test1 contains a non null value
			IF (@test1 IS NOT NULL)
				EXEC sp_S_SCL_IsThisTestViolated @chart_position=@chart_position, @last_chart_label=@last_chart_label
					, @last_chart_point=@last_chart_point_first_chart
					, @last_cp_lower_sigma_level=@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_fc
					, @last_cp_upper_sigma_level=@last_cp_upper_sigma_level_fc
					, @lcl=@lcl_first_chart, @cl=@cl_first_chart, @ucl=@ucl_first_chart, @test_id = @test1
					, @num_points=@num_points, @of_points=@of_points
					, @sigma_limits = @sigma_limits_for_test1, @test_result = @test1_result OUTPUT

			--Perform test2 only if the test2 contains a non null value, the previous result is not violated, or the and_not_or is set to true.
			IF (@test2 IS NOT NULL) AND ((@test1_result = 0 AND @and_not_or = 0) OR @and_not_or = 1)
				EXEC sp_S_SCL_IsThisTestViolated @chart_position=@chart_position, @last_chart_label=@last_chart_label
					, @last_chart_point=@last_chart_point_first_chart
					, @last_cp_lower_sigma_level=@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_fc
					, @last_cp_upper_sigma_level=@last_cp_upper_sigma_level_fc
					, @lcl=@lcl_first_chart, @cl=@cl_first_chart, @ucl=@ucl_first_chart, @test_id = @test2
					, @num_points=@num_points, @of_points=@of_points
					, @sigma_limits = @sigma_limits_for_test2, @test_result = @test2_result OUTPUT

			IF ((@test1_result = 1 OR @test2_result = 1) AND @and_not_or = 0)
			OR (@test1_result = 1 AND @test2_result = 1 AND @and_not_or = 1) BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @rule_violations (sample_id, char_id, rule_id, chart_pos) VALUES (@sample_id, @char_id, @rule_id, 1)
				SELECT @control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations + @chart_name_first_chart, @chart_name_first_chart = ' '
				SET @control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations + @rule_desc
			END
		END
		ELSE IF (@chart_position = 2) BEGIN -- Second/Bottom Chart
			IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @chart_points WHERE second_chart_control_move = 1 AND chart_label <= @num_points)) BEGIN
				--Validate for control rule violations, only if test1 contains a non null value
				IF (@test1 IS NOT NULL)
					EXEC sp_S_SCL_IsThisTestViolated @chart_position=@chart_position, @last_chart_label=@last_chart_label
						, @last_chart_point=@last_chart_point_second_chart
						, @last_cp_lower_sigma_level=@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_sc
						, @last_cp_upper_sigma_level=@last_cp_upper_sigma_level_sc
						, @lcl=@lcl_second_chart, @cl=@cl_second_chart, @ucl=@ucl_second_chart, @test_id = @test1
						, @num_points=@num_points, @of_points=@of_points
						, @sigma_limits = @sigma_limits_for_test1, @test_result = @test1_result OUTPUT

				--Perform test2 only if the test2 contains a non null value, the previous result is not violated, or the and_not_or is set to true.
				IF (@test2 IS NOT NULL) AND ((@test1_result = 0 AND @and_not_or = 0) OR @and_not_or = 1)
					EXEC sp_S_SCL_IsThisTestViolated @chart_position=@chart_position, @last_chart_label=@last_chart_label
						, @last_chart_point=@last_chart_point_second_chart
						, @last_cp_lower_sigma_level=@last_cp_lower_sigma_level_sc
						, @last_cp_upper_sigma_level=@last_cp_upper_sigma_level_sc
						, @lcl=@lcl_second_chart, @cl=@cl_second_chart, @ucl=@ucl_second_chart, @test_id = @test2
						, @num_points=@num_points, @of_points=@of_points
						, @sigma_limits = @sigma_limits_for_test2, @test_result = @test2_result OUTPUT

				IF ((@test1_result = 1 OR @test2_result = 1) AND @and_not_or = 0)
				OR (@test1_result = 1 AND @test2_result = 1 AND @and_not_or = 1) BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @rule_violations (sample_id, char_id, rule_id, chart_pos) VALUES (@sample_id, @char_id, @rule_id, 2)
					SELECT @control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations + @chart_name_second_chart, @chart_name_second_chart = ' '
					SET @control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations + @rule_desc
				END
			END
		END

	END
	CLOSE spec_rule_cursor
	DEALLOCATE spec_rule_cursor

	DROP TABLE #chart_points

	-- Step 15: Log the control rule violations in the sample_char_rule_link table, if they do not exist and the result data is not the projected data.
	--Verify whether the supplied data is not the projected data
	IF (@projected_result_data_xml IS NULL)
		INSERT INTO sample_char_rule_link (sample_id, char_id, rule_id, chart_pos, last_edit_at)
		SELECT rv.sample_id, rv.char_id, rv.rule_id, SUM(rv.chart_pos), @last_edit_at
		FROM @rule_violations rv GROUP BY rv.sample_id, rv.char_id, rv.rule_id
		ORDER BY rv.sample_id, rv.char_id, rv.rule_id
	--Return the control rule violations
	SET @control_rule_violations = LTRIM(RTRIM(@control_rule_violations))

	--Update statistics
	SELECT @stats_ent_id = s.ent_id, @stats_char_id = s.char_id
	FROM stats s WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (s.char_id = @char_id
	  AND s.ent_id = @ent_id)
	  OR (@filter_by_ent_id = 0 AND s.char_id = @char_id
	  --Apply all the filters
	  AND ((@filter_by_item_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_item_id = 1 AND (s.item_id = @item_id OR (s.item_id IS NULL AND @item_id IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_wo_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_wo_id = 1 AND (s.wo_id = @wo_id OR (s.wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_oper_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_oper_id = 1 AND (s.oper_id = @oper_id OR (s.oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_process_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_process_id = 1 AND (s.process_id = @process_id OR (s.process_id IS NULL AND @process_id IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_segment_req_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_req_id = 1 AND (s.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (s.segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 0) OR (@filter_by_segment_resp_id = 1 AND (s.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (s.segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_spare1 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare1 = 1 AND (s.spare1 = @spare1 OR (s.spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_spare2 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare2 = 1 AND (s.spare2 = @spare2 OR (s.spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_spare3 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare3 = 1 AND (s.spare3 = @spare3 OR (s.spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))))
	  AND ((@filter_by_spare4 = 0) OR (@filter_by_spare4 = 1 AND (s.spare4 = @spare4 OR (s.spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL)))))

	IF (@stats_char_id IS NOT NULL AND @stats_ent_id IS NOT NULL)
		UPDATE stats WITH (UPDLOCK)
		SET mean_result_value = @mean_result_value, max_result_value = @max_result_value
			,min_result_value = @min_result_value, range = @range, rbar = @rbar, mrbar = @mrbar, msbar = @msbar
			,std_dev = @population_sigma, num_results = @num_results, total = @total
			,act_percent_out_of_sl = @act_percent_out_of_sl
			,est_sigma = @estimated_sigma, cp = @cp, cpk = @cpk, pp = @pp, ppk = @ppk
			,filter_ent_id = @filter_ent_id, item_id = @stats_item_id, wo_id = @stats_wo_id, oper_id = @stats_oper_id
			,process_id = @stats_process_id, segment_requirement_id = @stats_segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id = @stats_segment_response_id
			,spare1 = @stats_spare1, spare2 = @stats_spare2, spare3 = @stats_spare3, spare4 = @stats_spare4
			,last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		WHERE stats.char_id = @stats_char_id
		  AND stats.ent_id = @stats_ent_id
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_inventory_level_data]
AS
SELECT item_inv.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.auto_reorder,
       item.min_inv_level,
       item.reorder_amt,
       item.purchased,
       item.sold,
       item_inv.lot_no,
       item_inv.sublot_no,
       item_inv.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_inv.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_inv.qty_left,
       item_inv.date_in_utc,
       item_inv.date_in_local,
       item_inv.date_out_utc,
       item_inv.date_out_local,
       item_inv.expiry_date,
       item_inv.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       storage_exec.type,
       storage_exec.status
FROM item_inv item_inv
INNER JOIN item item ON item_inv.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
   item_inv.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
   item_inv.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
INNER JOIN ent ent ON item_inv.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN storage_exec storage_exec ON
   item_inv.ent_id = storage_exec.ent_id
WHERE item.min_inv_level > 0

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sublot]
(
		@item_id             		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no           		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@parent              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@lvl                 		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@grade_cd            		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@status_cd           		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@expiry_date         		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@is_serial_no        		LOGICAL
	,	@spare1              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare2              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare3              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare4              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare5              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare6              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by        		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at        		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
