CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@user_id 		STRING40
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@job_pos		INT32 = 0
,@status_notes		STRING2000_NULL = NULL
,@check_privs		INT32 = NULL
,@check_certs		INT32 = NULL
,@event_time_local  	TDATETIME = NULL
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJob
-- Description	      - Start a Job/OR a batch of jobs
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.18
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver			Changes
-- 07/21/2006		Raghu		3.1.0.20	If job_pos is not supplied (NULL), then find the available job position for this job.
--02/08/2007		Raghu		3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 09/12/2016		Raghu		5.3			UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 08/22/2017		RWB			6.0			User Story 811325 - Modified sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetQueueSQL to return parameterized SQL
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		    6.0	        US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
-- 02/12/2020	Srinivas	    6.2	        US:1194084-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00154001 so that API to start a job returns better error messages
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	 @Concurrent_Link		INT32
	,@available_job_pos		INT32
	,@ret				INT32
	,@GetQueueSQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@param_def				NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@cancel_time			DATETIME
	,@complete_time			DATETIME
	,@state_cd_xml			XML
	,@wo_id_filter			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@oper_id_filter		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@seq_no_filter			INT
	,@item_id_filter		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_desc_filter		NVARCHAR(400)

	,@batch_job_wo_id		STRING40
	,@batch_job_oper_id		STRING40
	,@batch_job_seq_no		INT32
	,@batch_job_state_cd		INT32
	,@batch_job_run_ent_id		INT32
	,@batch_job_concurrent_link	INT32
	,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	 ,@err_str    NVARCHAR(400)

BEGIN
	--Apply all defaults. Default the bias value if not supplied.
	IF (@job_start_utc IS NULL AND @event_time_local IS NOT NULL)
		--Use the job_start_utc if supplied (override the event_time_local time)
		SET @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, @current_time_utc)

	--Default the job start utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
	SET @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_start_utc, @current_time_utc))

	--Verify whether the job start time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_start_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_start_utc = @current_time_utc

    IF NOT EXISTS (select * from ent (NOLOCK) where ent_id= @ent_id)
    BEGIN
	 SET @err_str = 'The supplied entity:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id) + ' does not exist in the database.{7557},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id)
     RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
     RETURN
    END

	--Retrieve the status of the current job, and concurrent link no.  to identify whether the current job is linked to a batch or not.
	--Verify whether the current job to start is linked to a batch.
	SELECT @concurrent_link = concurrent_link
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	if(@concurrent_link is null)
	BEGIN
	  SET @err_str = 'The specified job does not exist in the database.(wo-id'+COALESCE(@wo_id,'')+';oper_id='+COALESCE(@oper_id,'')+';seq_no='+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) +'){3176},(wo_id='+ COALESCE(@wo_id,'') + ';oper_id=' + COALESCE(@oper_id,'') + ';seq_no='+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) +')'
	  RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
	  RETURN
	END

	IF (@concurrent_link = 0) BEGIN
		SET @available_job_pos = @job_pos

		IF (@available_job_pos IS NULL) BEGIN
			--If the supplied job pos is null, then determine the available job position to start this job.
			EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos @ent_id, @available_job_pos OUTPUT

			--If job positions are NOT available, then raise an error.
			IF (@available_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		--Since the current job is not linked to a batch, just start the job that is currently supplied.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
			,@job_pos=@available_job_pos, @status_notes=@status_notes, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=@check_certs
			,@job_start_utc=@job_start_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value


		--Generate Samples (if applicable) for the job that was just started
		EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = @ent_id, @event_time_utc = @job_start_utc
			,@event_type = 8, @freq_of_sample_update = 0
			,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value

		--As soon as the current job is started, just RETURN
		RETURN
	END

	--If we get here, the current job is linked to a batch. Start all the linked jobs in a batch.
	--Get the minimum available (unused) job position for this entity, where we can start this job in a batch.
	EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos @ent_id, @available_job_pos OUTPUT

	--If job positions are NOT available, then raise an error.
	IF (@available_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Start the supplied job in the identified job position.
	EXEC @ret =  sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
		,@job_pos=@available_job_pos, @status_notes=@status_notes, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=@check_certs
		,@job_start_utc=@job_start_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

	--If the return value is not success, then return.
	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	--Get the GetQueue() SQL.
	EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetQueueSQL @ent_id=@ent_id, @concurrent_link=@concurrent_link, @use_for_getqueue_rset=0
		, @SQL = @GetQueueSQL OUTPUT, @cancel_time = @cancel_time OUTPUT, @complete_time = @complete_time OUTPUT
		, @state_cd_xml = @state_cd_xml OUTPUT, @wo_id = @wo_id_filter OUTPUT, @oper_id = @oper_id_filter OUTPUT, @seq_no = @seq_no_filter OUTPUT
		, @item_id = @item_id_filter OUTPUT, @item_desc = @item_desc_filter OUTPUT

	--Loop through all the queue records and start all the linked jobs in this batch.
	SET @GetQueueSQL = 'DECLARE job_batch_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR ' + @GetQueueSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias INT, @cancel_time DATETIME, @complete_time DATETIME, @state_cd_xml XML, @wo_id NVARCHAR(400), @oper_id NVARCHAR(400), @seq_no INT, @item_id NVARCHAR(400), @item_desc NVARCHAR(400), @ent_id INT, @concurrent_link INT'
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @GetQueueSQL, @param_def, @time_zone_bias_value, @cancel_time, @complete_time, @state_cd_xml, @wo_id_filter, @oper_id_filter, @seq_no_filter, @item_id_filter, @item_desc_filter, @ent_id, @concurrent_link

	OPEN job_batch_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM job_batch_cursor INTO @batch_job_wo_id, @batch_job_oper_id, @batch_job_seq_no,
			@batch_job_state_cd, @batch_job_run_ent_id, @batch_job_concurrent_link
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@batch_job_state_cd<> 4 AND @batch_job_state_cd <>7 AND @batch_job_state_cd<>3) AND @batch_job_concurrent_link=@concurrent_link BEGIN

			--Get the minimum available (unused) job position for this entity, where we can start this job in a batch.
			EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos @ent_id, @available_job_pos OUTPUT
			IF (@available_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('There are no available job positions to start all the jobs in a batch.{4689}', 16, 1)
				RAISERROR('You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			--Start the supplied job at the identified job position (or at the available job position).
			EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@batch_job_wo_id, @oper_id=@batch_job_oper_id
				, @seq_no=@batch_job_seq_no, @job_pos=@available_job_pos, @status_notes=@status_notes
				, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=@check_certs
				, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

			--If the return value is not success, then return.
			IF (@ret = -1) RETURN
		END
	END
	CLOSE job_batch_cursor
	DEALLOCATE job_batch_cursor

	--Generate Samples (if applicable) for the jobs that were just started
	EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = @ent_id, @event_time_utc = @job_start_utc
		,@event_type = 8, @freq_of_sample_update = 0
		,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionToReport
-- Description:  Returns the bean consumption for SAP
--
-- Note : Only BEANs has been tested
--
-- Runs after: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
-- 0.01.00  JSC         2024-07-25          Initial Version
-- 0.01.01  JSC         2025-02-06          Removed the limitation for only BEANs and Added restriction on quantity to be reported
-- 0.01.02  JSC         2025-05-19          Added limitation to only process those with spare1 > 0 even after the first select.
-- 0.01.03  MC          2025-09-15          Added data aggregation for cosumable items and frequency for batch considering
-- 0.01.04  MC          2025-11-20          Modify notation if there is no possible spend whole 
--                                          awaiting cons - to be able calculate reported qty
-- 0.01.05  AML, XPM    2026-06-29          Filter out 'T' traceability sublots and added oper_id grouping and filtering
-- ===========================================================================================
--exec [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport]
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport] AS BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

-- Declare variables    
DECLARE @error_msg         NVARCHAR(MAX)
    ,@error_severity       INT
    ,@error_state          INT
DECLARE @row_id            INT = -1
    ,@ent_id               INT = -1
    ,@oper_id              NVARCHAR(40) -- V0.01.05
    --,@item_grp             NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@item_id              NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cons_lot             NVARCHAR(40)
    --,@cons_sublot          NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@wip_wo_id            NVARCHAR(40)
    --,@wip_table_row_id     INT
    --,@wip_table_wo_id      NVARCHAR(40)
    --,@wip_reported_created_at DATETIME
    ,@cur_cons_qty         DECIMAL(18,3) --0.01.03 change FLOAT to DECIMAL --cursor variable for cur_cons_qty
    ,@cur_cons_qty_sent     DECIMAL(18,3) --0.01.03 change FLOAT to DECIMAL --cursor variable for cur_cons_qty_erp
    --,@cur_pending_cons_qty FLOAT
    ,@cons_spare1          DECIMAL(18,3) --0.01.03 change FLOAT to DECIMAL --cursor variable for cons_spare
    ,@cons_created_at      DATETIME

    ,@storage_locn         NVARCHAR(100)
    --,@cons_fg_lot          NVARCHAR(40)
    --,@cons_fg_sublot       NVARCHAR(40)
    --,@reporting_precision  INT = 3

    --0.01.03
    ,@attr_item_group       INT
    ,@attr_skip_consumption INT
    ,@attr_not_produce_to_sap INT
    ,@attr_sap_location     INT
    ,@sendable_qty          DECIMAL(18,3)
    --,@to_consume          DECIMAL(18,3)
    
    -- Run-level accumulator of the quantity reported in this execution (sum of per-row deltas).
    -- Returned as the final 'Quantity' in the SAP output row.
    ,@sent_qty_total        DECIMAL(18,3) --initial value must be 0


    ,@frequency_hours INT = 1   --  report data every X hours for each batch
    ,@interface NVARCHAR(40) = 'CONS_DETAIL_REPORTBEANS' --ei interface name
    ,@interface_row_id INT --ofi_ei_interface_last_execution table row id

DECLARE @consumption TABLE (
    ent_id INT,
    item_grp NVARCHAR(40),
    item_id NVARCHAR(40),
    cons_lot NVARCHAR(40),
    cur_cons_qty DECIMAL(18,3),
    cur_total_cons_qty_sent DECIMAL(18,3),
    cur_pending_cons_qty DECIMAL(18,3),
    wip_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    cons_spare1 DECIMAL(18,3),
    cur_prod_qty_erp DECIMAL(18,3),
    cons_created_at DATETIME
)
DECLARE @item_cons_wip_reported TABLE (
    row_id INT,
    item_cons_row_id INT,
    lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
    cons_to_report DECIMAL(18,3),
    sap_reported_wip_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    sap_reported_created_at_utc DATETIME
)
BEGIN TRY

    -- 0.01.03 Add applock to avoid race with ToReport SP
    DECLARE @rc INT;
    EXEC @rc = sys.sp_getapplock
         @DbPrincipal = N'dbo',
         @Resource    = N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK',
         @LockMode    = N'Exclusive',
         @LockOwner   = N'Session',
         @LockTimeout = 5000;

    IF (@rc < 0)
    BEGIN
        PRINT 'Skipped: another session holds CONS_REPORT_LOCK.';
        RETURN;
    END


    --0.01.03 collecting id for all used attributes
    SELECT @attr_item_group = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';
    SELECT @attr_skip_consumption = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting';
    SELECT @attr_sap_location = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'SAPLocation';

    SET @sent_qty_total = 0 --safety reset for final sent_qty

    --00.01.03 insert into temp table all possible records to update from ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported to have a mirror for updateing the table later
    INSERT INTO @item_cons_wip_reported(row_id, item_cons_row_id, lot_no, cons_to_report, sap_reported_wip_wo_id, sap_reported_created_at_utc)
    (
    SELECT row_id, item_cons_row_id, lot_no, ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,3),spare1),0), sap_reported_wip_wo_id, sap_reported_created_at_utc
    FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported
    WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
    )

    /* STEP 1: Pick the oldest eligible batch and compute sendable_qty in one statement. */

    ;WITH staging_agg AS (
        -- aggregate the in-memory staging mirror
        SELECT
            cwr.item_cons_row_id,
            cwr.lot_no,
            cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id,
            SUM(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,3), cwr.cons_to_report), 0)) AS cons_to_report,
            MAX(cwr.sap_reported_created_at_utc) AS max_created_at_utc
        FROM @item_cons_wip_reported AS cwr
        GROUP BY cwr.item_cons_row_id, cwr.lot_no, cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id
    ),
    total_cons AS (
        -- total consumption already sent per (lot_no, item_id)
        SELECT
            ic.lot_no,
            ic.oper_id, -- V0.01.05
            ia2.attr_value AS item_group,
            CAST(SUM(ic.qty_cons_erp) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS total_cons_sent
        FROM dbo.item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
        JOIN dbo.item i2 ON i2.item_id = ic.item_id
        JOIN dbo.item_attr ia2 ON ia2.item_id = i2.item_id AND ia2.attr_id = @attr_item_group
        WHERE RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.05
        GROUP BY ic.lot_no, ic.oper_id, ia2.attr_value -- V0.01.05
    ),
    total_prod AS (
        -- total production sent per (lot_no, ItemGroup)
        SELECT
            ip.lot_no,
            ia2.attr_value AS item_group,
            CAST(SUM(ip.qty_prod_erp) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS total_prod_sent
        FROM dbo.item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
        JOIN dbo.item i2 ON i2.item_id = ip.item_id
        JOIN dbo.item_attr ia2 ON ia2.item_id = i2.item_id AND ia2.attr_id = @attr_item_group
        WHERE i2.item_class_id NOT IN (UPPER('WIP'), UPPER('INTERMEDIATE')) AND ip.good_prod=1
        GROUP BY ip.lot_no, ia2.attr_value
    ),
    candidates AS (
        /* Build candidates at the target granularity: */
        SELECT
            ic.from_ent_id                                                   AS ent_id,
            ic.oper_id                                                       AS oper_id, -- V0.01.05
            ia.attr_value                                                    AS item_grp,
            ic.item_id,
            sa.lot_no                                                        AS cons_lot,
            CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tc.total_cons_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))         AS cur_total_cons_qty,
            sa.sap_reported_wip_wo_id                                        AS wip_wo_id,
            CAST(SUM(sa.cons_to_report) AS DECIMAL(18,3))                    AS cons_spare1,
            CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tp.total_prod_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))         AS cur_prod_qty_erp,
            MIN(sa.max_created_at_utc)                                       AS cons_created_at
        FROM staging_agg sa
        JOIN dbo.item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.row_id = sa.item_cons_row_id
        JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)       ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
        JOIN dbo.item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @attr_item_group
        LEFT JOIN dbo.item_attr ia_skip WITH (NOLOCK)
             ON ia_skip.item_id = i.item_id AND ia_skip.attr_id = @attr_skip_consumption
        LEFT JOIN total_cons tc
             ON tc.lot_no = sa.lot_no AND tc.item_group = ia.attr_value AND tc.oper_id = ic.oper_id -- V0.01.05
        LEFT JOIN total_prod tp
             ON tp.lot_no = sa.lot_no AND tp.item_group = ia.attr_value
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution ile
             ON ile.wo_id = sa.sap_reported_wip_wo_id AND ile.lot_no = ic.lot_no AND ile.item_id = ic.item_id
            AND ile.interface = @interface
        WHERE
            sa.cons_to_report <> 0
            AND i.item_class_id NOT IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
            AND (ISNULL(ia_skip.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
            AND (ile.last_sent_at IS NULL OR ile.last_sent_at < DATEADD(hour, -@frequency_hours, GETDATE()))
            AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.05
        GROUP BY ic.from_ent_id, ic.oper_id, ia.attr_value, ic.item_id, sa.lot_no, sa.sap_reported_wip_wo_id -- V0.01.05
        HAVING
            CAST(SUM(ic.qty_cons - ISNULL(ic.qty_cons_erp,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) > 0
            AND CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tp.total_prod_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) > CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tc.total_cons_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))
    ),
    final AS (
        -- Compute sendable_qty from candidate columns (readability + reuse)
        SELECT
            ent_id, oper_id, item_grp, item_id, cons_lot, wip_wo_id, cons_created_at, -- V0.01.05
            cur_total_cons_qty, cons_spare1, cur_prod_qty_erp,
            CAST(CASE
                WHEN cur_prod_qty_erp >= cons_spare1 + cur_total_cons_qty
                     THEN cons_spare1
                ELSE cur_prod_qty_erp - cur_total_cons_qty
            END AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS sendable_qty
        FROM candidates
    )
    SELECT TOP (1)
         @wip_wo_id       = f.wip_wo_id
        ,@oper_id         = f.oper_id -- V0.01.05
        ,@cons_lot        = f.cons_lot
        ,@item_id         = f.item_id
        ,@ent_id          = f.ent_id
        ,@cons_created_at = f.cons_created_at
        ,@sendable_qty    = f.sendable_qty
    FROM final AS f
    WHERE f.sendable_qty > 0
    ORDER BY f.cons_created_at;


    -- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
    IF ( @ent_id IS NULL
            OR @ent_id = -1)
    BEGIN
        --0.01.03 release applock
        EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
        RETURN;
    END
    -- STEP 2: Get Storage Location
    SET @storage_locn = NULL
    SELECT
        @storage_locn = attr_value
    FROM
        ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE
        ent_id      = @ent_id
        AND attr_id = @attr_sap_location

    IF @storage_locn IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @storage_locn = ent_name
        FROM
            ent WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE
            ent_id = @ent_id
    END
    -- STEP 2.1: Start Transaction:
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    -- Declare Variables for this step
    DECLARE @processed_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID()

    --0.01.03 Add CURSOR
    
    DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT
        cwr.item_cons_row_id,
        ic.qty_cons,
        ic.qty_cons_erp,
        SUM(cwr.cons_to_report)
    FROM @item_cons_wip_reported AS cwr
    JOIN item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK) ON ic.row_id = cwr.item_cons_row_id
    WHERE cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id = @wip_wo_id
      AND ic.lot_no = @cons_lot
      AND ic.item_id = @item_id
      AND ic.from_ent_id = @ent_id
      AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id -- V0.01.05
    GROUP BY cwr.item_cons_row_id, ic.qty_cons, ic.qty_cons_erp
    ORDER BY cwr.item_cons_row_id


    OPEN cur;
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @row_id, @cur_cons_qty, @cur_cons_qty_sent, @cons_spare1;
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @sendable_qty > 0
    BEGIN
        -- Declare variables for the step
        DECLARE
            --@qty_erp_total FLOAT         = 0.0
            --,@qty_reported     FLOAT         = 0.0
            @comment_reported NVARCHAR(400) = ''

        -- STEP 3: Get the extra information from the staging TABLE - needs to be moved after item_cons update
        --00.01.03 Disablet as we don't need to select the wip_table_row_id now
        /*
        SELECT
            TOP 1 @wip_table_row_id = icr.row_id
          ,@wip_table_wo_id         = icr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id
          ,@wip_reported_created_at = icr.sap_reported_created_at_utc
        FROM
            ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported icr WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE
            icr.item_cons_row_id                    = @row_id
            AND icr.spare1                          = @cons_spare1
            AND icr.sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
        ORDER BY
            icr.created_at_utc DESC
        */
        -- STEP 3.1: Calculate and update consumable quantity record by record
        IF @sendable_qty >= @cons_spare1 --Update only if sendable_qty is bigger than current cons_spare.
        BEGIN
            IF ((@cur_cons_qty_sent+@cons_spare1) <= @cur_cons_qty) --check if we can send whole requested cons
            BEGIN
                SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Last quantity reported to SAP: ' + CAST((@cons_spare1) AS NVARCHAR(1000)) -- v1.02 MOD
                
                UPDATE item_cons
                SET qty_cons_erp = @cur_cons_qty_sent + @cons_spare1
                ,spare1 = NULL --00.01.03 as spare1 in item_cons is not used
                ,last_edit_comment = @comment_reported
                WHERE row_id = @row_id;

                SET @sendable_qty   = @sendable_qty - @cons_spare1;
                SET @sent_qty_total = @sent_qty_total + @cons_spare1;

            END
            ELSE --if we can't send whole requested we update it anyway using left quantity
            BEGIN   
                SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Total consumption went above of qty_cons. Total extra was: ' + CAST((@cur_cons_qty_sent + @cons_spare1 - @cur_cons_qty) AS NVARCHAR(1000))
                
                UPDATE item_cons
                SET qty_cons_erp = @cur_cons_qty
                ,spare1 = NULL --00.01.03 as spare1 in item_cons is not used
                ,last_edit_comment = @comment_reported
                WHERE row_id = @row_id;

                SET @sendable_qty   = @sendable_qty - @cons_spare1;
                SET @sent_qty_total = @sent_qty_total + @cur_cons_qty - @cur_cons_qty_sent;
            END
            -- STEP 4: Update staging table     
            --IF (@wip_table_row_id IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                UPDATE cwr
                SET [last_edit_comment]        = 'Data processed and sent to SAP'
                    ,[last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
                    ,[sap_reported_processed_id] = @processed_id
                FROM [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported] cwr
                JOIN @item_cons_wip_reported cwr2 ON cwr2.row_id=cwr.row_id
                WHERE cwr2.item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id
            END
        END
        ELSE -- partly consumption for the record because insufficient production. Record is still waiting to be consumed in its entirety.
        BEGIN
            SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Last quantity reported to SAP: ' + CAST((@sendable_qty) AS NVARCHAR(1000)) -- v1.02 MOD
                
            UPDATE item_cons
            SET qty_cons_erp = @cur_cons_qty_sent + @sendable_qty
            ,spare1 = NULL --00.01.03 as spare1 in item_cons is not used
            ,last_edit_comment = @comment_reported
            WHERE row_id = @row_id;

            --IF (@wip_table_row_id IS NOT NULL)
            --0.01.03 update the newest record with left value
            BEGIN
            --0.01.03 set rest records as processed
                UPDATE cwr
                SET [last_edit_comment]        = 'Data processed and sent to SAP (partly branch)'
                ,[last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
                ,[spare1]                    = '0'
                ,[sap_reported_processed_id] = @processed_id
                FROM [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported] cwr
                JOIN @item_cons_wip_reported cwr2 ON cwr2.row_id=cwr.row_id
                WHERE cwr2.item_cons_row_id=@row_id
                AND cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id
                --0.01.04 set all record as processed and rest spare1 from them
                --AND cwr.row_id not in (SELECT MAX(row_id) FROM @item_cons_wip_reported WHERE item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id)
            
            --0.01.04 update first row to actual qty sent
                UPDATE
                    [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported]
                SET [last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
                    ,[spare1] = CAST((@sendable_qty) AS NVARCHAR(40))
                WHERE
                    [row_id] = (SELECT MIN(row_id) FROM @item_cons_wip_reported WHERE item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id)
            END

            --0.01.04 add new record for rest awaiting consumprion to report
                INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported]
                (
                    item_cons_row_id,
                    lot_no,
                    fg_lot_no,
                    sublot_no,
                    fg_sublot_no,
                    qty_cons,
                    qty_cons_erp,
                    spare1,
                    spare3,
                    last_edit_comment,
                    last_edit_at,
                    created_at_utc,
                    sap_reported_intermediate_item_cons_row_id,
                    sap_reported_wip_row_id,
                    sap_reported_wip_wo_id,
                    sap_reported_created_at_utc,
                    sap_reported_processed_id
                )
                SELECT TOP(1) 
                    item_cons_row_id,
                    lot_no,
                    fg_lot_no,
                    sublot_no,
                    fg_sublot_no,
                    qty_cons,
                    @cur_cons_qty_sent + @sendable_qty,
                    CAST((@cons_spare1 - @sendable_qty) AS NVARCHAR(40)),
                    spare3,
                    'INSERTED for EI Report of WIPs',
                    GETUTCDATE(),
                    GETUTCDATE(),
                    sap_reported_intermediate_item_cons_row_id,
                    sap_reported_wip_row_id,
                    sap_reported_wip_wo_id,
                    sap_reported_created_at_utc,
                    NULL
                FROM [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported]
                WHERE item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id


            SET @sent_qty_total = @sent_qty_total + @sendable_qty
            SET @sendable_qty=0
            
        END
        FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @row_id, @cur_cons_qty, @cur_cons_qty_sent, @cons_spare1;

        -- 0.01.03 update history execution table
        SELECT @interface_row_id=id from ofi_ei_interface_last_execution WHERE interface = @interface AND wo_id=@wip_wo_id AND lot_no=@cons_lot AND item_id=@item_id

        IF @interface_row_id IS NOT NULL --if already exist update timestamp
            UPDATE dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution
            SET last_sent_at = GETDATE()
            WHERE id = @interface_row_id;
        ELSE -- else create new record
            INSERT INTO ofi_ei_interface_last_execution (wo_id, lot_no, item_id, interface, last_sent_at)
            VALUES (@wip_wo_id, @cons_lot, @item_id, @interface, GETDATE())

    END
    CLOSE cur;
    DEALLOCATE cur;
    
    -- STEP 6.1: Commit transaction.
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    SELECT
        @wip_wo_id                              Order_Number --0.01.03
        ,[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]()           Plant
        ,@cons_lot                              Batch_Number
        ,@item_id                               Material
        ,@sent_qty_total                        Quantity --0.01.03
        ,u.description                          UOM
        ,CASE
            WHEN @sent_qty_total < 0.0
                THEN '262'
                ELSE '261'
        END                                AS Movement_Type
        ,FORMAT(@cons_created_at,'yyyyMMdd')    Posting_Date
        ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd')          File_GenerationDate
        ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')            File_GenerationTime
        ,@storage_locn                          Storage_Location
        ,''                                     Document_Number
        ,''                                     Message
        ,''                                     Message
    FROM
        item i WITH (NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN
            uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON
                i.uom_id = u.uom_id
    WHERE
        i.item_id = @item_id
    
    --0.01.03 release applock
    EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        --0.01.03 release applock
        EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

        SELECT
            @error_msg     = ERROR_MESSAGE()
          ,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
          ,@error_state    = ERROR_STATE()
        ;
        
        RAISERROR( @error_msg ,@error_severity ,@error_state )
    END CATCH
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_user_name_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[user_name]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name
-- Description
-- Author
-- Date Created
-- Version (last edit)
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  	Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 07/06/2004    KRF                    2.1.0     Enforce uniqueness and non-nullability of user_desc if used 1st when displaying users
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value		STRING40,
	@encrypt_pwd		STRING40,
	@TotalUserPwd		INT32,
	@TotalUserDesc	INT32  -- Added 7/6/04
BEGIN
             --System Attribute Unique Password parameter : Attr_ID = 85
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 85

	IF (@attr_value = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @encrypt_pwd = b.encrypt_pw FROM user_name a, inserted b
		WHERE a.user_id = b.user_id

		SELECT @TotalUserPwd = COUNT(encrypt_pw) FROM user_name
		WHERE user_name.encrypt_pw = @encrypt_pwd
		IF (@TotalUserPwd > 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Cannot insert. Password is already used.{3407}', 16, 1)
			ROLLBACK TRAN
		END
	END
	-- Begin 7/6/04 addititon
	-- User display parameter : Attr_ID = 10
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 10

	IF (@attr_value = 1 OR @attr_value = 3)  BEGIN  -- If User display = User Desc or User Desc/User ID
		-- Disallow null user_desc
		SELECT @TotalUserDesc = COUNT(*) FROM inserted WHERE [user_desc] IS NULL
		IF (@TotalUserDesc > 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Cannot insert. User description must not be empty.{407}', 16, 1)
			ROLLBACK TRAN
		END
		-- Disallow non-unique user_desc
		SELECT @TotalUserDesc = COUNT(*) FROM [user_name] u, inserted i WHERE i.user_desc = u.user_desc and i.[user_id] <> u.[user_id]
		IF (@TotalUserDesc > 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Cannot insert. User description must be unique.{270}', 16, 1)
			ROLLBACK TRAN
		END
	END
	-- End 7/6/04 addition
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_CertSignOffReqd]
(@process_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@step_no     INT32_NULL = NULL
,@sign_off_reqd  LOGICAL OUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_CERTSIGNOFFREQD
-- Description          -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created          -    10/21/2002
-- Version          - 2.0.0.33
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 04/30/2004      Sheetal Jain    2033    Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
-- 01/24/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes; renamed from SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_CERTSIGNOFFREQD
-- 08/31/2007	AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @TotalCertificates AS INT

    SET @sign_off_reqd = 0

    IF (@process_id IS NOT NULL AND @process_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

        --Frame the query depending on the Step_No
        IF  (@step_no IS NULL) BEGIN
            SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*)
            FROM cert_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN cert_type WITH (NOLOCK) ON cert_oper_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
            WHERE cert_oper_link.process_id = @process_id
              AND cert_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id
		END
        ELSE BEGIN
            SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*)
            FROM cert_oper_step_link WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN cert_type WITH (NOLOCK) ON cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
            WHERE cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id
              AND cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
              AND cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no
        END
    END

    --TotalCertificates holds the total no of certificates to be signed off. If any certification exist, then exit
    -- and return True else return False.
    IF  (@TotalCertificates > 0) BEGIN
        SET @sign_off_reqd = 1
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        SET @sign_off_reqd = 0
    END

END

-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on labor_exec table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields

--

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @step_no int,
   @ent_id int ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Oper_Ent_Spec
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version            - 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver    Changes
-- 09/10/2002	  Raghu		1.4    Disallow deletes if sys param is set for oper ent spec data (sys param = 195)
-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0  Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  20024  HD# 4414 Maintain oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
--03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @disallow_delete	INT
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32
BEGIN

  SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 195
  IF (@disallow_delete = 1) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Deleting %1 data is not allowed.{4713},oper_ent_spec record', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
  END

  DELETE oper_ent_spec
  WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)

--       CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id)

  UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @current_time WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
    AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [fn_lm_getDatePartFromLifetime] 
-- Description: Calculate the expiration date by deducing if the original Master Data came 
--				in Years, Months, or Days to avoid discrepancies due to leap years.
-- Usage: Labeling integration
-- ===========================================================================================
--  Version		Author  Date	(yyyy-MM-dd)		Change description
--  0.01.00		AML, XPM		2026-05-05			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_lm_getDatePartFromLifetime] 
(
    @prod_date DATETIME,
    @lifetime INT
)
RETURNS DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Calculated_DatePart DATETIME;

    IF (@prod_date IS NULL OR @lifetime IS NULL)
        RETURN NULL;

    IF (@lifetime % 365 = 0 AND @lifetime > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @Calculated_DatePart = DATEADD(YEAR, (@lifetime / 365), @prod_date);
		END
    ELSE IF (@lifetime % 30 = 0 AND @lifetime > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @Calculated_DatePart = DATEADD(MONTH, (@lifetime / 30), @prod_date);
		END
    ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @Calculated_DatePart = DATEADD(DAY, @lifetime, @prod_date);
		END

    RETURN @Calculated_DatePart;
END

CREATE   Trigger [tg_cert_audit_log_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[cert_audit_log]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - tg_cert_audit_log_aft_upd
-- Description       - Whenever the signoff_time is edited (via DataEditor etc...), update the signoff_time
--			in job_event table too.
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/14/2003
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 20100	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	 @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no	INT
	,@step_no	INT
	,@lot_no	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@cert_name	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@user_id	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@sign_off_utc	DATETIME
	,@sign_off_local DATETIME
	,@attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@last_edit_by	STRING40
	,@row_id	INT

	IF UPDATE(sign_off_utc) BEGIN
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 231
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			DECLARE cert_audit_log_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
				SELECT b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.step_no, b.lot_no, b.cert_name,
				b.user_id, b.sign_off_utc, b.sign_off_local, b.row_id
			FROM cert_audit_log a, inserted b
			WHERE a.row_id = b.row_id
/*			WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id
			  AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
			  AND a.seq_no = b.seq_no
			  AND a.step_no = b.step_no
			  AND a.lot_no = b.lot_no
			  AND a.cert_name = b.cert_name
			  AND a.user_id = b.user_id*/

			OPEN cert_audit_log_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM cert_audit_log_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no,
					@lot_no, @cert_name, @user_id, @sign_off_utc, @sign_off_local, @row_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job_event
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND step_no = @step_no
							AND lot_no = @lot_no
							AND cert_name = @cert_name
							AND UPPER(event_type) = 'CERTSIGNOFF')
					UPDATE job_event SET event_time_utc = @sign_off_utc, event_time_local = @sign_off_local
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND step_no = @step_no
							AND lot_no = @lot_no
							AND cert_name = @cert_name
							AND UPPER(event_type) = 'CERTSIGNOFF'

				EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

				UPDATE cert_audit_log SET last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
				WHERE row_id = @row_id
			END
			CLOSE cert_audit_log_cursor
			DEALLOCATE cert_audit_log_cursor
		END
	END
END

-- Name            : sp_U_ofi_LIMS_Limits_MasterData
-- Description     : Upsert limits masterdata for 'Cake blend' products.
--                   Uses table variables (no temp tables) and no sp_executesql.
-- Author          : JSC (extended)
-- Creation date   : 2026-01-21 (mod)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Author				Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change Description
-- 01.00			JSC					2026-01-21				Initial draft
-- 01.01			JSC					2026-01-29				Changed the stage for source label to update the limits. 
-- 01.02			JSC					2026-01-29				Removed all selects that are not necessary here
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *****************************************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_LIMS_Limits_MasterData]
    @sample_plan_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @product_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @level NVARCHAR(20),
    @stage NVARCHAR(20),
    @source_label NVARCHAR(80),
    @customer NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
    @Count INT = NULL,
    @location_label NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
    @samplePlanType INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(4000) = N'';
    DECLARE @msg_output NVARCHAR(4000) = N'';
    DECLARE @now DATETIME = GETDATE();
    DECLARE @spare1 NVARCHAR(80) = @sample_plan_id;
    DECLARE @spare2 NVARCHAR(80) = @level + '|' + @stage; -- combination of level and stage
    DECLARE @spare3 NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@customer, '') + '|' + @source_label + '|' + ISNULL(@product_id, ''); -- combination of customer, frequency and product
    DECLARE @qm_spec_id INT;

    -- v1 Review for specific stage 
	-- v1.01 Modified for source label instead of stages
    DECLARE @allowed_src_lbls TABLE (source_label NVARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY);
    INSERT INTO @allowed_src_lbls (source_label)
    VALUES ('VOLUME_5_MT'); -- until actual logic is defined, only process this stage

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @allowed_src_lbls WHERE source_label = @source_label)
    BEGIN
        SET @msg_output = '{"code": 404, "status": "NotFound", "message": "Stage not allowed."}';
        SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
        RETURN 0;
    END

    -- identify qm_spec
    IF (@samplePlanType = 0)
    BEGIN
        SET @spare2 = @spare2 + '|' + CONVERT(nvarchar, ISNULL(@Count, 0));

        SELECT  @qm_spec_id = q.qm_spec_id
        FROM qm_spec q
            INNER JOIN sample_plan p ON q.plan_id = p.plan_id
        WHERE p.plan_name LIKE @sample_plan_id + '%'
            AND p.spare1 = @spare1
            AND p.spare2 = @spare2
            AND p.spare3 = @spare3
            AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @spare3 = ISNULL(@customer, '') + '|' + @source_label + '|' + ISNULL(@location_label, '');

        SELECT  @qm_spec_id = q.qm_spec_id
        FROM qm_spec q
        INNER JOIN sample_plan p ON q.plan_id = p.plan_id
        WHERE p.spare1 = @sample_plan_id
            AND p.spare3 = @spare3
            AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL;
    END

    BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @ItemGroup NVARCHAR(40) = 'PRODUCT';
        SELECT @ItemGroup = ia.attr_value
        FROM item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.attr_id = a.attr_id
        WHERE ia.item_id = @product_id
          AND a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';

        IF @ItemGroup <> 'CAKE BLEND'
        BEGIN
            SET @msg_output = '{"code": 204, "status": "NoAction", "message": "Item group is not CAKE BLEND; no action taken."}';
            SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
            RETURN 0;
        END

        IF @qm_spec_id IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @msg_output = '{"code": 404, "status": "NotFound", "message": "qm_spec not found for sample plan."}';
            SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
            RETURN 0;
        END

        -- staging: table variable
        DECLARE @spec TABLE (
            item_id NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
            spare1 NVARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
            target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            lsv DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            usv DECIMAL(10,7) NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO @spec (item_id, spare1, target, lsv, usv)
        SELECT
            LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), qm.item_id))), 40) AS item_id,
            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.spare1, '')))) AS spare1,
            TRY_CAST(qscl.target AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS target,
            TRY_CAST(qscl.lsv AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS lsv,
            TRY_CAST(qscl.usv AS DECIMAL(10,7)) AS usv
        FROM dbo.qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN dbo.characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.char_id = qscl.char_id
        INNER JOIN dbo.qm_spec qm WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id
        WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
          AND qm.item_id = @product_id
          AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(c.spare1, '')))) <> ''
          -- Exclude links where target, lsv and usv are all explicit zero values
          AND NOT (
                TRY_CAST(qscl.target AS DECIMAL(10,7)) = 0
            AND TRY_CAST(qscl.lsv    AS DECIMAL(10,7)) = 0
            AND TRY_CAST(qscl.usv    AS DECIMAL(10,7)) = 0
          );

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @spec)
        BEGIN
            SET @msg_output = '{"code": 204, "status": "NoContent", "message": "No characteristic links found for qm_spec."}';
            SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
            RETURN 0;
        END

        -- create table variable @src with fixed columns (same as cakeblend.blend_masterdata)
        DECLARE @src TABLE (
            item_id NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            l_target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, l_min DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, l_max DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            c_target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, c_min DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, c_max DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            h_target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, h_min DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, h_max DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            ph_target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, ph_min DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, ph_max DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            moisture_target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, moisture_min DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, moisture_max DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            fat_target DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, fat_min DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, fat_max DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            ph_tolerance DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            wl DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, wc DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, wh DECIMAL(10,7) NULL,
            minimize_x BIT NULL, minimize_x_l DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, minimize_x_c DECIMAL(10,7) NULL, minimize_x_h DECIMAL(10,7) NULL
        );

        INSERT INTO @src (
            item_id,
            l_target, l_min, l_max,
            c_target, c_min, c_max,
            h_target, h_min, h_max,
            ph_target, ph_min, ph_max,
            moisture_target, moisture_min, moisture_max,
            fat_target, fat_min, fat_max,
            ph_tolerance,
            wl, wc, wh,
            minimize_x, minimize_x_l, minimize_x_c, minimize_x_h
        )
        SELECT
            item_id,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - L' THEN target END)               AS l_target,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - L' THEN lsv END)                  AS l_min,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - L' THEN usv END)                  AS l_max,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - C' THEN target END)               AS c_target,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - C' THEN lsv END)                  AS c_min,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - C' THEN usv END)                  AS c_max,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - H' THEN target END)               AS h_target,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - H' THEN lsv END)                  AS h_min,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'Intrinsic color - H' THEN usv END)                  AS h_max,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('PH','PH_VALUE') THEN target END)AS ph_target,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('PH','PH_VALUE') THEN lsv END)   AS ph_min,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('PH','PH_VALUE') THEN usv END)   AS ph_max,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('MOIST','MOISTURE') THEN target END) AS moisture_target,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('MOIST','MOISTURE') THEN lsv END)    AS moisture_min,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('MOIST','MOISTURE') THEN usv END)    AS moisture_max,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('FAT') THEN target END)          AS fat_target,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('FAT') THEN lsv END)             AS fat_min,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('FAT') THEN usv END)             AS fat_max,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('PH_TOLERANCE','PHTOLERANCE','PH_TOL') THEN target END) AS ph_tolerance,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('WL') THEN target END)           AS wl,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('WC') THEN target END)           AS wc,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 IN ('WH') THEN target END)           AS wh,
            CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'MINIMIZE_X' THEN target END) IS NOT NULL
                 THEN CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'MINIMIZE_X' THEN target END) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 ELSE NULL END                                           AS minimize_x,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'MINIMIZE_X_L' THEN target END)    AS minimize_x_l,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'MINIMIZE_X_C' THEN target END)    AS minimize_x_c,
            MAX(CASE WHEN spare1 = 'MINIMIZE_X_H' THEN target END)    AS minimize_x_h
        FROM @spec
        GROUP BY item_id;

        ---- debug output for inspection
        --SELECT * FROM @src ORDER BY item_id;

        -- perform UPDATE (only rows that exist and only when source has at least one non-null)
        DECLARE @updated_count INT = 0;
        UPDATE tgt
        SET
            tgt.l_target = CASE WHEN src.l_target IS NOT NULL THEN src.l_target ELSE tgt.l_target END,
            tgt.l_min    = CASE WHEN src.l_min    IS NOT NULL THEN src.l_min    ELSE tgt.l_min    END,
            tgt.l_max    = CASE WHEN src.l_max    IS NOT NULL THEN src.l_max    ELSE tgt.l_max    END,
            tgt.c_target = CASE WHEN src.c_target IS NOT NULL THEN src.c_target ELSE tgt.c_target END,
            tgt.c_min    = CASE WHEN src.c_min    IS NOT NULL THEN src.c_min    ELSE tgt.c_min    END,
            tgt.c_max    = CASE WHEN src.c_max    IS NOT NULL THEN src.c_max    ELSE tgt.c_max    END,
            tgt.h_target = CASE WHEN src.h_target IS NOT NULL THEN src.h_target ELSE tgt.h_target END,
            tgt.h_min    = CASE WHEN src.h_min    IS NOT NULL THEN src.h_min    ELSE tgt.h_min    END,
            tgt.h_max    = CASE WHEN src.h_max    IS NOT NULL THEN src.h_max    ELSE tgt.h_max    END,
            tgt.ph_target = CASE WHEN src.ph_target IS NOT NULL THEN src.ph_target ELSE tgt.ph_target END,
            tgt.ph_min    = CASE WHEN src.ph_min    IS NOT NULL THEN src.ph_min    ELSE tgt.ph_min    END,
            tgt.ph_max    = CASE WHEN src.ph_max    IS NOT NULL THEN src.ph_max    ELSE tgt.ph_max    END,
            tgt.moisture_target = CASE WHEN src.moisture_target IS NOT NULL THEN src.moisture_target ELSE tgt.moisture_target END,
            tgt.moisture_min    = CASE WHEN src.moisture_min    IS NOT NULL THEN src.moisture_min    ELSE tgt.moisture_min    END,
            tgt.moisture_max    = CASE WHEN src.moisture_max    IS NOT NULL THEN src.moisture_max    ELSE tgt.moisture_max    END,
            tgt.fat_target = CASE WHEN src.fat_target IS NOT NULL THEN src.fat_target ELSE tgt.fat_target END,
            tgt.fat_min    = CASE WHEN src.fat_min    IS NOT NULL THEN src.fat_min    ELSE tgt.fat_min    END,
            tgt.fat_max    = CASE WHEN src.fat_max    IS NOT NULL THEN src.fat_max    ELSE tgt.fat_max    END,
            tgt.ph_tolerance = CASE WHEN src.ph_tolerance IS NOT NULL THEN src.ph_tolerance ELSE tgt.ph_tolerance END,
            tgt.wl = CASE WHEN src.wl IS NOT NULL THEN src.wl ELSE tgt.wl END,
            tgt.wc = CASE WHEN src.wc IS NOT NULL THEN src.wc ELSE tgt.wc END,
            tgt.wh = CASE WHEN src.wh IS NOT NULL THEN src.wh ELSE tgt.wh END,
            tgt.minimize_x = CASE WHEN src.minimize_x IS NOT NULL THEN src.minimize_x ELSE tgt.minimize_x END,
            tgt.minimize_x_l = CASE WHEN src.minimize_x_l IS NOT NULL THEN src.minimize_x_l ELSE tgt.minimize_x_l END,
            tgt.minimize_x_c = CASE WHEN src.minimize_x_c IS NOT NULL THEN src.minimize_x_c ELSE tgt.minimize_x_c END,
            tgt.minimize_x_h = CASE WHEN src.minimize_x_h IS NOT NULL THEN src.minimize_x_h ELSE tgt.minimize_x_h END
        FROM cakeblend.blend_masterdata AS tgt
        INNER JOIN @src AS src
            ON LTRIM(RTRIM(tgt.item_id)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(src.item_id))
        WHERE
            src.l_target IS NOT NULL OR src.l_min IS NOT NULL OR src.l_max IS NOT NULL OR
            src.c_target IS NOT NULL OR src.c_min IS NOT NULL OR src.c_max IS NOT NULL OR
            src.h_target IS NOT NULL OR src.h_min IS NOT NULL OR src.h_max IS NOT NULL OR
            src.ph_target IS NOT NULL OR src.ph_min IS NOT NULL OR src.ph_max IS NOT NULL OR
            src.moisture_target IS NOT NULL OR src.moisture_min IS NOT NULL OR src.moisture_max IS NOT NULL OR
            src.fat_target IS NOT NULL OR src.fat_min IS NOT NULL OR src.fat_max IS NOT NULL OR
            src.ph_tolerance IS NOT NULL OR src.wl IS NOT NULL OR src.wc IS NOT NULL OR src.wh IS NOT NULL OR
            src.minimize_x IS NOT NULL OR src.minimize_x_l IS NOT NULL OR src.minimize_x_c IS NOT NULL OR src.minimize_x_h IS NOT NULL;

        SET @updated_count = @@ROWCOUNT;

        -- After Update then get defaults and add them to the query:
        -- Define the default values table
        
        DECLARE @blend_MD_Defaults TABLE (
            item_id NVARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
			--l_target DECIMAL(10,7),
			--l_min DECIMAL(10,7),
			--l_max DECIMAL(10,7),
			--c_target DECIMAL(10,7),
			--c_min DECIMAL(10,7),
			--c_max DECIMAL(10,7),
			--h_target DECIMAL(10,7),
			--h_min DECIMAL(10,7),
			--h_max DECIMAL(10,7),
			--ph_target DECIMAL(10,7),
			--ph_min DECIMAL(10,7),
			--ph_max DECIMAL(10,7),
			--moisture_target DECIMAL(10,7),
			--moisture_min DECIMAL(10,7),
			--moisture_max DECIMAL(10,7),
			--fat_target DECIMAL(10,7),
			--fat_min DECIMAL(10,7),
			--fat_max DECIMAL(10,7),
            ph_tolerance DECIMAL(10,7),
            wl DECIMAL(10,7),
            wc DECIMAL(10,7),
            wh DECIMAL(10,7),
            minimize_x BIT,
            minimize_x_l DECIMAL(10,7),
            minimize_x_c DECIMAL(10,7),
            minimize_x_h DECIMAL(10,7)
        );

		INSERT INTO @blend_MD_Defaults (
            item_id,
			--l_target,
			--l_min,
			--l_max,
			--c_target,
			--c_min,
			--c_max,
			--h_target,
			--h_min,
			--h_max,
			--ph_target,
			--ph_min,
			--ph_max,
			--moisture_target,
			--moisture_min,
			--moisture_max,
			--fat_target,
			--fat_min,
			--fat_max,
            ph_tolerance,
            wl,
            wc,
            wh,
            minimize_x,
            minimize_x_l,
            minimize_x_c,
            minimize_x_h
		)
		SELECT 
				item_id = @product_id,
				--l_target = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'l_target' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--l_min    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'l_min'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--l_max    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'l_max'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--c_target = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'c_target' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--c_min    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'c_min'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--c_max    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'c_max'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--h_target = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'h_target' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--h_min    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'h_min'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--h_max    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'h_max'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--ph_target= MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'ph_target' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--ph_min   = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'ph_min'   THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--ph_max   = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'ph_max'   THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--moisture_target = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'moisture_target' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--moisture_min    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'moisture_min'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--moisture_max    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'moisture_max'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--fat_target = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'fat_target' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--fat_min    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'fat_min'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				--fat_max    = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'fat_max'    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				ph_tolerance = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'ph_tolerance' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				wl = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'wl' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				wc = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'wc' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				wh = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'wh' THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				minimize_x     = CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'minimize_x'THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS INT) ELSE NULL END) AS BIT),
				minimize_x_l   = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'minimize_x_l'   THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				minimize_x_c   = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'minimize_x_c'   THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END),
				minimize_x_h   = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name = 'minimize_x_h'   THEN CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(', ''), ')', '') AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ELSE NULL END)
		FROM sys.columns c
		JOIN sys.default_constraints dc
			ON dc.object_id = c.default_object_id
		WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID('cakeblend.blend_masterdata');


        -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Apply defaults to @src where values are NULL
        -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE s
        SET
            --l_target = COALESCE(s.l_target, d.l_target),
            --l_min    = COALESCE(s.l_min, d.l_min),
            --l_max    = COALESCE(s.l_max, d.l_max),
            --c_target = COALESCE(s.c_target, d.c_target),
            --c_min    = COALESCE(s.c_min, d.c_min),
            --c_max    = COALESCE(s.c_max, d.c_max),
            --h_target = COALESCE(s.h_target, d.h_target),
            --h_min    = COALESCE(s.h_min, d.h_min),
            --h_max    = COALESCE(s.h_max, d.h_max),
            --ph_target = COALESCE(s.ph_target, d.ph_target),
            --ph_min    = COALESCE(s.ph_min, d.ph_min),
            --ph_max    = COALESCE(s.ph_max, d.ph_max),
            --moisture_target = COALESCE(s.moisture_target, d.moisture_target),
            --moisture_min    = COALESCE(s.moisture_min, d.moisture_min),
            --moisture_max    = COALESCE(s.moisture_max, d.moisture_max),
            --fat_target = COALESCE(s.fat_target, d.fat_target),
            --fat_min    = COALESCE(s.fat_min, d.fat_min),
            --fat_max    = COALESCE(s.fat_max, d.fat_max),
            ph_tolerance = COALESCE(s.ph_tolerance, d.ph_tolerance),
            wl = COALESCE(s.wl, d.wl),
            wc = COALESCE(s.wc, d.wc),
            wh = COALESCE(s.wh, d.wh),
            minimize_x = COALESCE(s.minimize_x, d.minimize_x),
            minimize_x_l = COALESCE(s.minimize_x_l, d.minimize_x_l),
            minimize_x_c = COALESCE(s.minimize_x_c, d.minimize_x_c),
            minimize_x_h = COALESCE(s.minimize_x_h, d.minimize_x_h)
        FROM @src AS s
            JOIN @blend_MD_Defaults d ON s.item_id = d.item_id;


        -- perform INSERT for rows that do not exist
        DECLARE @inserted_count INT = 0;
        INSERT INTO cakeblend.blend_masterdata (
            item_id, l_target, l_min, l_max, c_target, c_min, c_max, h_target, h_min, h_max,
            ph_target, ph_min, ph_max, moisture_target, moisture_min, moisture_max,
            fat_target, fat_min, fat_max, ph_tolerance, wl, wc, wh,
            minimize_x, minimize_x_l, minimize_x_c, minimize_x_h
        )
        SELECT
            s.item_id, s.l_target, s.l_min, s.l_max, s.c_target, s.c_min, s.c_max, s.h_target, s.h_min, s.h_max,
            s.ph_target, s.ph_min, s.ph_max, s.moisture_target, s.moisture_min, s.moisture_max,
            s.fat_target, s.fat_min, s.fat_max, s.ph_tolerance, s.wl, s.wc, s.wh,
            s.minimize_x, s.minimize_x_l, s.minimize_x_c, s.minimize_x_h
        FROM @src AS s
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM cakeblend.blend_masterdata t WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(t.item_id)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(s.item_id))
        );

        SET @inserted_count = @@ROWCOUNT;

        ---- diagnostics
        --SELECT 'UPDATED' AS action, @updated_count AS rows_affected
        --UNION ALL
        --SELECT 'INSERTED', @inserted_count;

        SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200, "status": "OK", "message": "Cake blend limits upsert completed.","updated": ' 
            + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @updated_count) + ', "inserted": ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @inserted_count) + '}';

        --SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        SET @msg = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500, "status": "Error", "message": "' + REPLACE(@msg, '"', '\"') + '"}';
        SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
        RETURN -1;
    END CATCH
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_gr_against_obd
-- Description:  Returns GR against OBD for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-06		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Karthik     2022-09-07		   Updated the logic to pull data from item_prod
-- 0.01.02  Karthik     2022-09-08		   Updated the logic for Delivery completed indicator
-- 0.01.02  Karthik     2022-09-16		   Updated the logic to send only for materials of type "Raw materials" and introduced gr_count to track the gr_against_obd_messages
-- ===========================================================================================


create         PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_gr_against_obd_GT] as
begin

	Declare @row_id int,@wo_id varchar(100),@state_cd int,@qty_prod float,@qty_prod_erp float,@gr_count int,@ent_id int,@to_ent_id int, @good_prod BIT
	Declare  @error_msg NVARCHAR(500), @error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@attr_id INT,@mod_id varchar(30),@storage_locn VARCHAR(100)
	Declare @plant_code varchar(100),@reas_cd INT,@mov_type varchar(10)

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN Transaction

		--[WO state] 0 = Released, 1 = Started, 2 = Completed, 3 = Closed

		SET @row_id = -1;
		SET @ent_id = -1;
		SET @plant_code = ''

		Select top 1 @row_id = ip.row_id, @wo_id = ip.wo_id,@ent_id = ip.ent_id,@to_ent_id = ip.to_ent_id, @reas_cd = ip.reas_cd,
		@good_prod = ip.good_prod from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
		inner join ofi_wo_ext wo_ext with (nolock) on ip.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id and wo_ext.module = 'PO'
		inner join wo w with (nolock) on w.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id
		where ip.qty_prod > ip.qty_prod_erp  

		if @ent_id <> -1 and @ent_id is not NULL
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = NULL
			SELECT @storage_locn = attr_value from ent_attr with (nolock) where ent_id = @to_ent_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation')
			IF @storage_locn is NULL
				SELECT @storage_locn = ent_name from ent with (nolock) where ent_id = CASE WHEN @good_prod = 0 THEN @to_ent_id ELSE @ent_id END

			SET @mov_type = '101'
		End

		SELECT @plant_code = attr_value from system_attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
		
		if @reas_cd = (Select top 1 reas_cd from item_reas with (nolock) where reas_desc = 'Transit Loss')
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = 'TL01'
			SET @mov_type = 'Z03' ---(KN - 20Feb23 - SAP confirmed that the movement type for Transit Loss is z03)
		End
		
		IF @row_id <> -1 and @row_id is not nULL
		Begin
			Select @state_cd = state_cd from wo with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id
			Select @qty_prod = sum(qty_prod), @qty_prod_erp = sum(qty_prod_erp) from item_prod with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and row_id <> @row_id group by wo_id
			Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'GR_Against_OBD_Messages_Count'

			Select Format((GETDATE()),'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date, Format(ip.last_edit_at,'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date,
			'000000' File_Generation_Time, --Format((ip.last_edit_at),'hhmmss')
			ip.wo_id Document_Number,'' Message,ip.item_id Material_Number,
			
			--wo_ext.delivery_item Delivery_Item,
			RIGHT(wo_ext.delivery_item,len(wo_ext.delivery_item)-2) Delivery_Item, --KN 15/02/23 Updated to send only last 4 digits of delivery item as requested by SAP team + confirmed by AVEVA
			
			wo_ext.delivery Delivery_Number,
			--iif(@qty_prod = @qty_prod_erp and @state_cd >= 2,0,@qty_prod - @qty_prod_erp) Delivery_Quantity, --If Completed then send 0, else send the quantity produced
			--qty_prod Delivery_Quantity,-- (KN 20-Feb-23 - Since the above condn is not handling waste reporting)
			qty_prod - qty_prod_erp Delivery_Quantity, -- (KN 12-Apr-23 - Modified to report only the diff. Decision based on testing with Yoga/Mahesh)
			u.description BaseUnit_of_Measure,wo_ext.lot_no Batch_Number, ip.wo_id DocumentNumber_of_TheReferenceDocument,
			wo_ext.item_no_puo_doc ItemNumber_of_TheReferenceItem,
			@plant_code Plant,@storage_locn Storage_Location, @mov_type Movement_Type,
			'B' Movement_Indicator, -- KN 03/01/23 Changed from L to B as requested by SAP team -- KN 15/02/23 Changed from B to L, again L to B as requested by SAP team									
			iif(@storage_locn = 'TL01','C','') DeliveryCompleted_Indicator
			from item_Prod  ip with (nolock)
			inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id = i.item_id
			inner join item_class ic with (nolock) on ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id
			left join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id = u.uom_id
			left join ofi_wo_ext wo_ext with (nolock) on wo_ext.wo_id = ip.wo_id
			where ip.row_id = @row_id and ic.item_class_desc = 'Raw Materials' --Send only raw materials as this interface is sent for Liquid liquor intake, Liquid butter intake and Additive intake

			--Now increase the GR_Against_OBD_Messages_Count attribute value

			If not exists(SELECT wo_id FROM wo_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND attr_id = @attr_id)
				Exec sp_I_Wo_Attr @wo_id,@attr_id,1,'','',@mod_id OUT
			else
				begin
					Select @gr_count = attr_value,@mod_id = mod_id from wo_attr with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attr_id
					Set @gr_count = @gr_count + 1

					update wo_attr set attr_value = @gr_count where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attr_id

					--Exec sp_U_Wo_Attr @wo_id,@attr_id,@gr_count,'','',@mod_id
				end

			Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = qty_prod where row_id = @row_id
		End

		Commit Transaction

	End TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Std_Oper_Spec_Ver]
  (@oper_id nvarchar(40),
   @ver_id nvarchar(40),
   @ver_date datetime ,
   @ver_comments nvarchar(80) ,
   @preferred_ver bit ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0 ,
   @last_edit_at datetime OUTPUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_I_Std_Oper_Spec_Ver
-- Description      - Insert a row into the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/03/2006	Raghu		3.1.7	Updating preferred_ver ought to update std_oper_spec_ver and not oper_spec_ver
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = @last_edit_at
ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @ver_date)
SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @ver_date )

IF @preferred_ver IS NULL SET @preferred_ver = 0

 INSERT INTO std_oper_spec_ver
 (oper_id,
  ver_id,
  ver_date,
  ver_comments,
  preferred_ver,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@oper_id,
   @ver_id,
   @ver_date,
   @ver_comments,
   @preferred_ver,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

--Only one can be a preferred version
IF @preferred_ver = 1
BEGIN
	UPDATE std_oper_spec_ver
	SET preferred_ver = 0, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id
END

END

CREATE       FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_GetDefReasCdFromId]
    (
		@wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT,
		@cons_reas_id INT -- ideally, shall be the cons_reas_dcd already
    )
RETURNS @Output TABLE
    (
	   def_reas_cd 	INT
      ,def_grade_cd		INT
	  ,def_status_cd INT
    )
AS BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @def_reas_cd    INT,			
			@def_grade_cd    INT,
			@def_status_cd INT
				
	
	-- DEFINE based on Operation at this moment
	IF (@oper_id = 'CakeBlending')
	BEGIN
		SELECT	@def_reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
				,@def_grade_cd = ir.item_grade_cd
				,@def_status_cd = ir.item_status_cd
		FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ir.reas_desc = CASE @cons_reas_id
								WHEN 0
									THEN 'Base Dosing'
								ELSE

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @def_reas_cd = -1
		SET @def_grade_cd = -1
		SET @def_status_cd = -1
	END
	

	-- STEP 3: Insert results into output table
	INSERT INTO @output
	SELECT  
		 @def_reas_cd
		,@def_grade_cd
		,@def_status_cd

	-- exit
	RETURN
END
