CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Route]
	@wo_id string40,
	@oper_id string40,
	@seq_no int,
	@new_wo_id string40,
	@new_oper_id string40,
	@new_seq_no int
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 11/03/2003	Sheetal Jain		(HD#3688) Job route input percent adjustments
-- 06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @l_oper_id string40,
  @l_seq_no int,
  @l_wo_id string40,
  @l_input_percent int,
  @V_Parent_Qty TFLOAT,
  @V_Clone_Qty  TFLOAT,
  @last_edit_by	STRING40,
  @last_edit_at	DATETIME

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

--8.	Clone*** job_route table row(s)*.
  --Clone all job route records for which the parent sequence is the input
  DECLARE JOB_Cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND	input_seq_no = @seq_no
  OPEN JOB_Cursor
  FETCH NEXT FROM JOB_Cursor INTO @l_oper_id,@l_seq_no
  IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    SELECT @l_wo_id = wo_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id AND oper_id =@l_oper_id AND seq_no = @l_seq_no
    IF NOT (@l_wo_id  IS NULL)
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO job_route (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, input_percent, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no
    END
  END
  CLOSE JOB_Cursor
  DEALLOCATE JOB_Cursor

  --Clone all job route records for which the parent sequence is the output
  SELECT @l_input_percent = ISNULL(SUM(input_percent),0) FROM job_route
    WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @new_oper_id AND input_seq_no=@new_seq_no
  IF @l_input_percent = 0  --not sure why this is here????
  BEGIN
    --Adding to existing logic since I'm not sure what was accomplished by existing code
    IF @wo_id = @new_wo_id AND @oper_id = @new_oper_id
    BEGIN
      SELECT @V_Parent_Qty = qty_reqd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
      SELECT @V_Clone_Qty = qty_reqd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no
      INSERT INTO job_route (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id,input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
        SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no,
               input_percent*@V_Clone_Qty/(@V_Parent_Qty+@V_Clone_Qty), @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
      UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = input_percent*@V_Parent_Qty/(@V_Parent_Qty+@V_Clone_Qty)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO job_route (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id,input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
        SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no,input_percent, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
    END
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO job_route (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id,input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
      SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no,0, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
  END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_job_exec_startdownstreamj]
(
	@user_id 	STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@ent_id 	INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@job_pos 	INT32_NULL = 0,
	@wo_id 		STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@oper_id 	STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@seq_no 	INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_StartDownstreamJobs
-- Description	      - (HD# 570) 2)  Automatically start the downstream jobs
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 02/26/2003
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.33
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 04/30/2004	  Sheetal Jain	2033	Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @tempVar3					INT32,
			@tempVar4 					INT32,
			@StoO_error 				INT32,
			@StoO_fetchstatus			INT32,
			@StoO_errmsg				STRING254,
			@next_oper_id 				STRING40,
			@next_seq_no 				INT32,
			@state_cd 					INT32,
			@sched_ent_id 				INT32,
			@run_ent_id 				INT32,
			@can_run_jobs 				LOGICAL,
			@child_level 				INT32,
			@next_job_only 				LOGICAL,
			@auto_job_start_option 		INT32,
			@cur_wo_id 					STRING40,
			@cur_oper_id 				STRING40,
			@tempVar1 					INT32,
			@tempVar2 					INT32,
			@V_Count					INT32,
			@V_Return					INT32

	DECLARE @next_job TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY,
		oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
		seq_no INT
	)

	DECLARE @nj_i			INT32,
			@nj_max_i		INT32,
			@nj_oper_id		STRING40,
			@nj_seq_no		INT32

	INSERT INTO @next_job ( oper_id, seq_no )
	SELECT oper_id, seq_no
	FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT @nj_i = MIN( id ), @nj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @next_job

	DECLARE @run_entities TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY,
		ent_id INT,
		ent_name NVARCHAR(40),
		child_level INT,
		can_run_jobs BIT
	)

	DECLARE @re_ent_id			INT,
			@re_ent_name		NVARCHAR(40),
			@re_child_level		INT,
			@re_can_run_jobs	BIT,
			@re_i				INT,
			@re_max_i			INT


	SELECT  @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no

	--If only one downstream job, donot open the cursor
	IF 1 = @V_Count BEGIN

		SELECT @next_oper_id = oper_id, @next_seq_no = seq_no
		FROM job_route
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no

		--Get the current state of the job
		SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id, @run_ent_id = run_ent_id
		FROM job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

		--If state_cd is not null which means, a downstream job exist
		IF  ( @state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Check the job is not running, and it should be in NEW, READY OR SUSPENDED state
			IF ( @state_cd <> 3) AND ( @state_cd = 1 OR @state_cd = 2 OR @state_cd = 5) BEGIN
				IF  @run_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
					SET @run_ent_id = @sched_ent_id
				END

				SELECT @can_run_jobs = can_run_jobs
				FROM ent
				WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

				--Check if the entity can run jobs, if it is not, BEGIN loop thru all the descendant entities and find the entity which can run jobs
				IF  ( @can_run_jobs = 0) BEGIN

					SET @child_level = 0

					INSERT INTO @run_entities ( ent_id, ent_name, child_level, can_run_jobs )
					SELECT ent_id, ent_name, @child_level, can_run_jobs
					FROM ent
					WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

					SET @run_ent_id = NULL

					WHILE ( 1 = 1) BEGIN

						SET @child_level = @child_level + 1

						INSERT INTO @run_entities ( ent_id, ent_name, child_level, can_run_jobs )
						SELECT  ent_id, ent_name, @child_level, can_run_jobs
						FROM ent
						WHERE parent_ent_id IN (
							SELECT  ent_id
							FROM @run_entities
							WHERE child_level = @child_level - 1
							)

						IF  ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BEGIN
							BREAK
						END
					END

					DELETE FROM @run_entities WHERE can_run_jobs = 0

					--Check if there is ONLY one descendant entity which can run jobs, if it is, BEGIN pick up the entity else do nothing
					SELECT @V_Count = count(*) FROM @run_entities
					IF  1 = @V_Count BEGIN
						SELECT @run_ent_id = @ent_id
						FROM @run_entities
					END
				END

				IF ( @run_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

					SELECT	@next_job_only = next_job_only
						,	@auto_job_start_option = auto_job_start_option
						,	@cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id
						,	@cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id
					FROM job_exec
					WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

					--if next_job_only is false and auto job start option is set to 1 and there is no job running on this entity, BEGIN start the downstream job
					IF ((@cur_wo_id IS NULL OR @cur_wo_id IS NULL) AND (@cur_oper_id IS NULL OR @cur_oper_id IS NULL)) AND ( @next_job_only = 0 AND @auto_job_start_option = 1) BEGIN

						EXEC @V_Return = sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob	@run_ent_id,
																@user_id,
																@wo_id,
																@next_oper_id,
																@next_seq_no,
																@job_pos,
																NULL,
																tempVar1,
																tempVar2
					END
				END
	--End of (@state_cd <> 3) AND (@state_cd = 1 OR @state_cd = 2 OR @state_cd = 5)
			END
	--@state_cd is not null, next job exists
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN
	-- only 1 record or only one descendant job, check for 1 record to avoid cursor
	-- more than one descendant job, use cursor to loop thru all descendant jobs
	-- Open a cursor to loop thru all descendant jobs

		WHILE ( @nj_i <= @nj_max_i ) BEGIN

			SELECT @next_oper_id = oper_id, @next_seq_no = seq_no FROM @next_job WHERE id = @nj_i

			IF ((@next_oper_id IS NULL) OR (@next_seq_no IS NULL)) BEGIN

				SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id, @run_ent_id = run_ent_id
				FROM job
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					AND oper_id = @next_oper_id
					AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

			END
			--If state_cd is not null which means, a downstream job exist
			IF ( @state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Check the job is not running, and it should be in NEW, READY OR SUSPENDED state
				IF  ( @state_cd <> 3) AND ( @state_cd = 1 OR @state_cd = 2 OR @state_cd = 5) BEGIN

					IF @run_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
						SET @run_ent_id = @sched_ent_id
					END

					SELECT @can_run_jobs = can_run_jobs
					FROM ent
					WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

					--Check if the entity can run jobs, if it is not, BEGIN loop thru all the descendant entities and find the entity which can run jobs
					IF ( @can_run_jobs = 0) BEGIN

						SET @child_level = 0

						INSERT INTO @run_entities
						SELECT  ent_id, ent_name, @child_level, can_run_jobs
						FROM ent
						WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

						SET @run_ent_id = NULL

						WHILE(1 = 1) BEGIN

							SET @child_level = @child_level + 1

							INSERT INTO @run_entities
							SELECT  ent_id, ent_name, @child_level, can_run_jobs
							FROM ent
							WHERE parent_ent_id  IN (
								SELECT  ent_id
								FROM @run_entities
								WHERE child_level = @child_level - 1
								)

							IF( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BEGIN
								BREAK
							END

						END

						DELETE FROM @run_entities WHERE can_run_jobs = 0

						--Check if there is ONLY one descendant entity which can run jobs, if it is, BEGIN pick up the entity else do nothing
						SELECT @V_Count = count(*) FROM @run_entities

						IF  1 = @V_Count BEGIN
							SELECT @run_ent_id = @ent_id
							FROM @run_entities
						END
					END

					IF( @run_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

						SELECT	@next_job_only = next_job_only
							,	@auto_job_start_option = auto_job_start_option
							,	@cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id
						FROM job_exec
						WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

						--if next_job_only is false and auto job start option is set to 1 and there is no job running on this entity, BEGIN start the downstream job
						IF ( ( @cur_wo_id IS NULL OR   @cur_wo_id IS NULL) AND ( @cur_oper_id IS NULL OR @cur_oper_id IS NULL)) AND ( @next_job_only = 0 AND @auto_job_start_option = 1) BEGIN

							EXEC @V_Return = sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob @run_ent_id, @user_id, @wo_id, @next_oper_id,
																	@next_seq_no, @job_pos, NULL, tempVar3, tempVar4

						END
					END
	--End of (@state_cd <> 3) AND (@state_cd = 1 OR @state_cd = 2 OR @state_cd = 5)
				END
	--@state_cd is not null, next job exists
			END

			SET @nj_i = (@nj_i + 1)
	--End of cursor loops thru all descendant jobs
		END
	-- more than one descendant job if condition, use cursor to loop thru all descendant jobs
	END

END

/******************************************************************************************
 Name:         sp_S_ei_prodn_co_by_product_new
 Description:  Returns the production for co / by product
 Usage:        This will be used by EI
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Version	Author  Date        Change description
 0.01.00	Karthik 2022-09-30  Initial version.
 0.02.00	Lavkesh 2023-06-22  added extra condition bom_pos < 0
 0.02.01	Veervar 2024-06-05  Updated for BY-P class production reporting for BINs items
 0.03.00	MC      2025-09-15  Rebuild timing and selecting data to be reported - aggregation by lot number
 0.03.01	MC		2025-10-28	Additional safeguard to not report prod from MES wo
******************************************************************************************/
--execute [dbo].[sp_S_ei_prodn_co_by_product_new]
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ei_prodn_co_by_product]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Declarations
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE
            @wo_id				NVARCHAR(40),
            @lot_no				NVARCHAR(40),
            @item_id			NVARCHAR(40),
            @error_msg			NVARCHAR(500),
            @error_severity		INT,
            @error_state		INT,
            @delay_hours		INT          = 1778,                           -- report data older than @delay_hours (UTC)
            @cutoff_date		DATETIME,                                   -- computed from @delay_hours
			@last_edit_at		DATETIME,
            @frequency_hours	INT          = 1,                           -- minimum resend interval per batch
            @interface			NVARCHAR(40) = N'PROD_CO_BY_DETAILS',
            @row_id				INT;

        -- Temporary table to store production data
        DECLARE @productionCO TABLE
        (
            row_id          INT,
            wo_id           NVARCHAR(40),
            lot_no          NVARCHAR(40),
            item_id         NVARCHAR(40),
            qty_prod        DECIMAL(18,3),
            qty_prod_erp    DECIMAL(18,3),
            co_product      BIT,
			last_edit_at	DATETIME,
            created_at_utc  DATETIME
        );

        -- Calculate cutoff time (UTC, zaokrąglone do pełnej godziny w dół)
        SET @cutoff_date = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -@delay_hours, GETUTCDATE())), 0);

        ;WITH co_by_prod AS
        (
            SELECT
                ip.wo_id,
                ip.row_id,
                ip.lot_no,
                ip.item_id,
                ip.qty_prod,
                ip.qty_prod_erp,
                1 AS co_product,
				ip.last_edit_at,
                ip.created_at_utc
            FROM dbo.item_prod AS ip WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN dbo.item AS i WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
            INNER JOIN dbo.job_bom AS jb WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON ip.wo_id   = jb.wo_id
               AND ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id
               AND ip.seq_no  = jb.seq_no
               AND jb.bom_pos < 0
               AND ip.item_id = jb.item_id
            INNER JOIN
            (
                SELECT wo_id
                FROM dbo.wo WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE state_cd < 3
				AND ISNULL(spare1,'0')='1' --0.03.01
            ) AS w
                ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
            WHERE
                CAST(ip.qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,3)) <> CAST(ip.qty_prod_erp AS DECIMAL(18,3))
                AND i.item_class_id <> N'BY-P'
        ),
        bins_prod AS
        (
            SELECT
                ip.wo_id,
                ip.row_id,
                ip.lot_no,
                ip.item_id,
                ip.qty_prod,
                ip.qty_prod_erp,
                CAST(0 AS BIT) AS co_product,
				ip.last_edit_at,
                ip.created_at_utc
            FROM dbo.item_prod AS ip WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN dbo.item AS i WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
            INNER JOIN dbo.ofi_wo_item_ext AS ow WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON ip.wo_id   = ow.wo_id
               AND ip.item_id = ow.item_id
               AND ow.bom_pos < 0
            INNER JOIN
            (
                SELECT wo_id
                FROM dbo.wo WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE state_cd < 3
				AND ISNULL(spare1,'0')='1' --0.03.01
            ) AS w
                ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
            WHERE
                CAST(ip.qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,3)) <> CAST(ip.qty_prod_erp AS DECIMAL(18,3))
                AND i.item_class_id = N'BY-P'
        )
        -- Inserting unique records from co_by_prod and bins_prod
        INSERT INTO @productionCO (row_id, wo_id, lot_no, item_id, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, co_product, last_edit_at, created_at_utc)
        SELECT
            combined.row_id,
            combined.wo_id,
            combined.lot_no,
            combined.item_id,
            combined.qty_prod,
            combined.qty_prod_erp,
            combined.co_product,
			combined.last_edit_at,
            combined.created_at_utc
        FROM
        (
            SELECT * FROM co_by_prod
            UNION
            SELECT * FROM bins_prod
        ) AS combined
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution AS ile
            ON ile.wo_id     = combined.wo_id
           AND ile.lot_no    = combined.lot_no
           AND ile.item_id   = combined.item_id
           AND ile.interface = @interface  -- 0.02.10 join with execution history table
        WHERE
            combined.created_at_utc < @cutoff_date
            AND (ile.last_sent_at IS NULL OR ile.last_sent_at < DATEADD(HOUR, -@frequency_hours, GETDATE()));

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @productionCO)
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            SELECT TOP (1)
                   @wo_id   = p.wo_id,
                   @lot_no  = p.lot_no,
                   @item_id = p.item_id
            FROM @productionCO AS p
            ORDER BY p.created_at_utc;

            -- Generate report (aggregation by lot/material)
            SELECT
                p.wo_id                                  AS Order_Number,
                dbo.fn_S_ofi_PlantCode()                 AS Plant,
                p.lot_no                                 AS Batch_Number,
                p.item_id                                AS Material,
                SUM(p.qty_prod - p.qty_prod_erp)         AS Quantity,
                CASE WHEN p.co_product = 1 THEN '101' ELSE '531' END AS Movement_Type,
                FORMAT(MAX(p.last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd')  AS Posting_Date,
                FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd')            AS File_GenerationDate,
                '000000'                                 AS File_GenerationTime,
                'SF01'                                   AS Storage_Location,
                IIF(p.co_product = 1, 'X', '')           AS CoProduct_Indicator,
                ''                                       AS Document_Number,
                ''                                       AS Message,
                ''                                       AS Message
            FROM @productionCO AS p
            WHERE p.wo_id = @wo_id
              AND p.lot_no = @lot_no
              AND p.item_id = @item_id
            GROUP BY
                p.wo_id, p.lot_no, p.item_id, p.co_product;

            -- Reflect reported qty in source table
            UPDATE ip
            SET ip.qty_prod_erp = t.qty_prod
            FROM dbo.item_prod AS ip
            INNER JOIN
            (
                SELECT row_id, qty_prod
                FROM @productionCO
                WHERE wo_id  = @wo_id
                  AND lot_no = @lot_no
                  AND item_id = @item_id
            ) AS t
                ON ip.row_id = t.row_id;

            -- 0.03.00 update history execution table
            SELECT @row_id = ile.id
            FROM dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution AS ile
            WHERE ile.interface = @interface
              AND ile.wo_id     = @wo_id
              AND ile.lot_no    = @lot_no
              AND ile.item_id   = @item_id;

            IF @row_id IS NOT NULL -- if already exists update timestamp
            BEGIN
                UPDATE dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution
                SET last_sent_at = GETDATE()
                WHERE id = @row_id;
            END
            ELSE -- else create new record
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution (wo_id, lot_no, item_id, interface, last_sent_at)
                VALUES (@wo_id, @lot_no, @item_id, @interface, GETDATE());
            END

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            @error_msg      = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @error_state    = ERROR_STATE();

        RAISERROR (@error_msg, @error_severity, @error_state);
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Po_Line]
(@po_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @po_line_no  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @vendor_item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @uom_id  int  ,
 @reqd_by_utc  datetime  ,
 @reqd_by_local datetime,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Po_Line
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--09/04/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--01/16/2019	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1129387 - As Bruce, I want to return the vendor id and the uom description with the PO Line information in order to display as much informatin of the PO as I can
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--SET @reqd_by = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @reqd_by)

SELECT po_line.po_id
       ,po_line.po_line_no
       ,po.vend_id
       ,po_line.item_id
       ,item.item_desc
       ,item.num_decimals
       ,item.uom_id AS item_uom_id
       ,item_uom.description AS item_uom_description
       ,po_line.vendor_item_id
       ,po_line.quantity
       ,po_line.uom_id
       ,uom.description
       ,COALESCE(po_line.uom_id, item.uom_id) AS po_line_uom_id
       ,COALESCE(uom.description, item_uom.description) AS po_line_uom_description
       ,po_line.min_qty
       ,po_line.max_qty
       ,po_line.line_price
	   ,po_line.reqd_by_utc
	   ,po_line.reqd_by_local
       ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, po_line.reqd_by_utc) AS reqd_by
       ,po_line.spare1
       ,po_line.spare2
       ,po_line.spare3
       ,po_line.spare4
       ,po_line.last_edit_comment
       ,po_line.last_edit_by
       ,po_line.last_edit_at
FROM po_line WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN po WITH (NOLOCK) ON po_line.po_id = po.po_id
INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON po_line.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom item_uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = item_uom.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON po_line.uom_id = uom.uom_id
WHERE ((po_line.po_id = @po_id OR @po_id IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.po_line_no = @po_line_no OR @po_line_no IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.vendor_item_id = @vendor_item_id OR @vendor_item_id IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.reqd_by_utc <= @reqd_by_utc OR @reqd_by_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (po_line.reqd_by_local <= @reqd_by_local OR @reqd_by_local IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (po_line.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_user_name_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[user_name]
FOR UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_user_name_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on this table
-- Author             -
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 07/06/2004    KRF                    2.1.0     Enforce uniqueness and non-nullability of user_desc if used 1st when displaying users
-- 09/22/2008      AML         3.5       CR L00076701 - Added a check before updating last_edit_at to make sure we don't
--                                       update it after a change to last_login, last_pw_change, or failed_logins.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE 	 @attr_value		STRING40
		,@encrypt_pwd		STRING40
		,@TotalUserPwd	INT32
		,@last_edit_by		STRING40
		,@TotalUserDesc	INT32  -- Added 7/6/04

BEGIN
             --System Attribute Unique Password parameter : Attr_ID = 85
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 85
	IF (@attr_value = '0') BEGIN
		IF (UPDATE(encrypt_pw)) BEGIN
			DECLARE user_name_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
				SELECT b.encrypt_pw
				FROM user_name a, INSERTED b
				WHERE a.user_id = b.user_id

			OPEN user_name_cursor
			WHILE (1=1)
			BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM user_name_cursor INTO @encrypt_pwd
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SELECT @TotalUserPwd = count(encrypt_pw) FROM user_name
				WHERE user_name.encrypt_pw = @encrypt_pwd
				IF (@TotalUserPwd > 1) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Cant Update. Password is already selected{3407}', 16, 1)
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END
			END
			CLOSE user_name_cursor
			DEALLOCATE user_name_cursor
		END
	END


	-- Begin 7/6/04 addititon
	-- User display parameter : Attr_ID = 10
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 10

	IF (@attr_value = 1 OR @attr_value = 3)  BEGIN  -- If User display = User Desc or User Desc/User ID
		IF UPDATE(user_desc) BEGIN
			-- Disallow null user_desc
			SELECT @TotalUserDesc = COUNT(*) FROM inserted WHERE [user_desc] IS NULL
			IF (@TotalUserDesc > 1) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Cannot insert. User description must not be empty.{407}', 16, 1)
				ROLLBACK TRAN
			END
			-- Disallow non-unique user_desc
			SELECT @TotalUserDesc = COUNT(*) FROM [user_name] u, inserted i WHERE i.user_desc = u.user_desc and i.[user_id] <> u.[user_id]
			IF (@TotalUserDesc > 1) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Cannot insert. User description must be unique.{270}', 16, 1)
				ROLLBACK TRAN
			END
		END
	END
	-- End 7/6/04 addition

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	IF ( UPDATE([user_id]) OR UPDATE([user_desc]) OR UPDATE([encrypt_pw]) OR UPDATE([active]) OR UPDATE([hourly_cost]) OR
		 UPDATE([email_address]) OR UPDATE([lang_id]) OR UPDATE([def_dept_id]) OR UPDATE([auth_method]) OR UPDATE([def_lab_cd]) OR
		 UPDATE([smtp_server]) OR UPDATE([pop3_server]) OR UPDATE([email_account]) OR UPDATE([email_pw]) OR UPDATE([spare1]) OR
		 UPDATE([spare2]) OR UPDATE([spare3]) OR UPDATE([spare4]) ) BEGIN

		UPDATE user_name SET user_name.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, user_name.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		FROM inserted i
		WHERE user_name.user_id = i.user_id
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos]
(@ent_id	INT
,@job_pos	INT OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos
-- Description	      -	HD# 5933, Get the available job position that is not used by any jobs for this entity.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	09/07/2005
-- Version	      - 2.1.28.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 08/04/2017	Raghu		6.0		UserStory:716502 - Added nolock hints
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE @identical_job_execs	INT32

	SET @job_pos = -1
	SELECT @identical_job_execs = identical_job_execs FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	--If the entity cannot run multiple jobs then always default the job position to 0
	IF (@identical_job_execs <= 1) SET @job_pos = 0
	ELSE
		--Entity can run multiple jobs. Get the available job position
		SELECT @job_pos = MIN(job_pos) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id IS NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NULL

	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, -1)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_Attr]
(
	@ent_id  int  = NULL,
	@ent_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
	@site_name NVARCHAR(80)  = NULL,
	@attr_id  int  = NULL,
	@attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
	@attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-	10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 09/15/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.14		HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 01/18/2018	    Surya		    6.0         US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	    Eswar H	        6.2         US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 2

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

  IF (@ent_id IS NULL AND @ent_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SET @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

    IF (@ent_id IS NULL)
	    SET @ent_id = -1
  END

SELECT	ent_attr.ent_id
	,	ent.ent_name
	,	ent_attr.attr_id
	,	ent_attr.attr_value
	,	ent_attr.notes
	,	attr.attr_desc
	,	attr.predefined
	,	attr.data_type
	,	attr.entry_type
	,	attr.visible_in_queue
	,	attr.visible_in_inv
	,	ent_attr.last_edit_comment
	,	ent_attr.last_edit_by
	,	ent_attr.last_edit_at
FROM ent_attr ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_attr.ent_id = ent.ent_id
WHERE (
		(ent_attr.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(ent_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
		(ent_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
		(ent_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(ent_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	  )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link]
  (@parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @bom_pos int ,
   @process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @qty_per_parent_item float ,
   @reqd_start_pct float ,
   @def_reas_cd int,
   @def_lot_no nvarchar(40),
   @def_sublot_no nvarchar(40) = NULL,
   @def_storage_ent_id int,
   @def_reject_ent_id int,
   @update_inv bit,
   @backflush bit,
   @must_consume_from_inv  bit,
   @may_choose_alt_inv_loc bit,
   @may_create_new_lots bit,
   @must_consume_from_wip bit,
   @must_consume_before_prod bit,
   @constant_qty bit,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_I_BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2023 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0   Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/04/2007	KRF			3.2.1   HD# 8314 - Added @def_sublot_no argument
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 08/05/2015	RWB			5.2.0	Story 481280 - remove a produced item from an operation when replacing it with a new
--									produced item
-- 07/26/2019	Srinivasa T	6.2		US#1170542,L00152738 to merge CR -L00152245 Introduced Temp table in order to get TOP 1 record instead of directly to get from CTE.
-- 07/25/2019	RWB			6.2.0	Story 1165973 - Added code to prevent an item from being added if the item is not
--									produced by the process or does not belong to the BOM of an item produced by the
--									process. 
-- 06/06/2023				6.2		HF_IMS_2482803 : Introduced additional filter to address the issue of cannot create new BOM version: MES Client time out.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
		 ,@old_ver_id	NVARCHAR(40)
		 ,@old_item_id	NVARCHAR(40)
		 ,@allow_insert BIT

	-- Determine if this is an item that is made by the process or is in the BOM
	-- of an item made by the process
	;WITH bom_data
	AS 
	(
			SELECT item_id
			FROM item_process_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE process_id = @process_id
			UNION ALL
			SELECT bom_item.item_id
			FROM bom_item WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN bom_data ON bom_item.parent_item_id = bom_data.item_id
			WHERE bom_pos <> 0
	)
	SELECT @allow_insert = 1 WHERE @parent_item_id IN (SELECT * FROM bom_data)
	IF COALESCE(@allow_insert, 0) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The item must be made by the process or belong to the BOM of an item made by the process{1614}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF  @reqd_start_pct IS null SET  @reqd_start_pct = 0
	IF @bom_pos = 0 SET @qty_per_parent_item = 1

	-- Determine if this is a newly produced item
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id))
	BEGIN
		-- Decide if there are any other items that share a BOM with this item
		-- Check to see if the item belongs to any BOMs where the ancestor or descendants of the item are being made by the
		-- process.  If there are any, raise an error.
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpJoinedTables', 'U') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpJoinedTables
		;
		WITH
		bom_ancestor AS (
			SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @parent_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0

			UNION ALL

			SELECT bi.parent_item_id, bi.ver_id FROM bom_item bi WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN bom_ancestor ba ON bi.item_id = ba.parent_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0
		),

		bom_descendant AS (
			SELECT item_id, ver_id FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0 AND ver_id = @ver_id

			UNION ALL

			SELECT bi.item_id, bi.ver_id FROM bom_item bi WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN bom_descendant bd ON bi.parent_item_id = bd.item_id AND bi.bom_pos <> 0
		)

		SELECT biol.ver_id, biol.parent_item_id INTO #tmpJoinedTables
		FROM bom_item_oper_link biol WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN bom_ancestor ba ON biol.ver_id = ba.ver_id AND biol.parent_item_id = ba.parent_item_id
		LEFT JOIN bom_descendant bd ON biol.ver_id = bd.ver_id AND biol.parent_item_id = bd.item_id
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND (ba.parent_item_id IS NOT NULL OR bd.item_id IS NOT NULL)

		SELECT TOP 1 @old_ver_id = ver_id, @old_item_id = parent_item_id  FROM #tmpJoinedTables
		-- If we found a match, then we need to call Change Produced Item to switch out the old item for the new item
		IF (@old_item_id IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			EXEC sp_U_BOM_Item_Oper_Link_ChPrIt @process_id, @oper_id, @old_item_id, @old_ver_id, @parent_item_id, @ver_id
			-- Get the mod_id for the record being added so that we can update it
			SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
			FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND
			ver_id = @ver_id AND
			bom_pos = @bom_pos AND
			process_id = @process_id AND
			oper_id = @oper_id)
			-- The Change Produce Item puts in the records for the new BOM, so update with the information passed in
			EXEC sp_U_Bom_Item_Oper_Link @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @process_id, @oper_id,  @qty_per_parent_item, @reqd_start_pct, @def_reas_cd,
				@def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id, @update_inv, @backflush, @must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
				@may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip, @must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id
			-- We are done so we can exit
			RETURN
		END


	END

	-- If we did not find an old item to replace, then we just want to insert the new item
	IF (@old_item_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_link
			(parent_item_id,
			ver_id,
			bom_pos,
			process_id,
			oper_id,
			qty_per_parent_item,
			reqd_start_pct,
			def_reas_cd,
			def_lot_no,
			def_sublot_no, -- Added 07/28/2009 RWB
			def_storage_ent_id,
			def_reject_ent_id,
			update_inv,
			backflush,
			must_consume_from_inv,
			may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
			may_create_new_lots,
			must_consume_from_wip,
			must_consume_before_prod,
			constant_qty,
			last_edit_comment,
			last_edit_by,
			last_edit_at)
		VALUES
			(@parent_item_id,
			@ver_id,
			@bom_pos,
			@process_id,
			@oper_id,
			@qty_per_parent_item,
			@reqd_start_pct,
			@def_reas_cd,
			@def_lot_no,
			@def_sublot_no, -- Added 07/28/2009 RWB
			@def_storage_ent_id,
			@def_reject_ent_id,
			@update_inv,
			@backflush,
			@must_consume_from_inv,
			@may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
			@may_create_new_lots,
			@must_consume_from_wip,
			@must_consume_before_prod,
			@constant_qty,
			@last_edit_comment,
			@last_edit_by,
			@last_edit_at)
	END

	-- Return timestamp
	--SET @mod_id = (SELECT CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
	FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND
	ver_id = @ver_id AND
	bom_pos = @bom_pos AND
	process_id = @process_id AND
	oper_id = @oper_id)

CREATE   VIEW dbo.vw_inventory_status_data
AS

WITH Consumption AS
(
    SELECT
        ic.from_ent_id AS ent_id,
        SUM(ic.qty_cons) AS qty_consumed_last_30_days,
        MAX(ic.created_at_local) AS last_consumption_date
    FROM dbo.item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ic.created_at_local >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE())
    GROUP BY ic.from_ent_id
),

Production AS
(
    SELECT
        ip.to_ent_id AS ent_id,
        SUM(ip.qty_prod) AS qty_produced_last_30_days,
        MAX(ip.created_at_local) AS last_production_date
    FROM dbo.item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ip.created_at_local >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE())
    GROUP BY ip.to_ent_id
)

SELECT
    se.ent_id,
    e.ent_name,

    se.type,
    se.status,
    se.max_capacity,

    ii.item_id,
    i.item_desc,
    u.abbreviation AS units,

    ii.lot_no,
    ii.sublot_no,

    ii.qty_left AS current_inventory,

    ii.date_in_local,
    ii.date_out_local,
    ii.expiry_date,

    ISNULL(c.qty_consumed_last_30_days,0) AS qty_consumed_last_30_days,
    c.last_consumption_date,

    ISNULL(p.qty_produced_last_30_days,0) AS qty_produced_last_30_days,
    p.last_production_date

FROM dbo.storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)

INNER JOIN dbo.ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id

LEFT JOIN dbo.item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON se.ent_id = ii.ent_id

LEFT JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON ii.item_id = i.item_id

LEFT JOIN dbo.uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id

LEFT JOIN Consumption c
    ON se.ent_id = c.ent_id

LEFT JOIN Production p
    ON se.ent_id = p.ent_id

-- Name:  [ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot]
-- Description: This function will get the current sublot_no for the line that produced the paremeter's one
-- Usage:  WIP consumption report
-- SELECT * FROM [ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot] ('100123456','Cakeblending',0,012)
-- ===========================================================================================
--  Version Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00 JSC		2025-10-23			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot]
    (
		@wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT,
		@sublot_int INT
    )
RETURNS @Output TABLE
    (
	   out_sublot_no 	NVARCHAR(40)
      ,out_lot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
    )
AS BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40),			
			@sublot_no     NVARCHAR(40)
				
				
	SELECT  @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
	FROM    job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			wo_id       = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND bom_pos = 0
				
	--v0.05 added
	IF 	(@def_lot_no IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT  @def_lot_no = w.lot_no
		FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				w.wo_id = @wo_id
				AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
	END
		
			
	--v0.5 Mod
	SELECT  @sublot_no = CONCAT( @def_lot_no, (FORMAT(@sublot_int,'00000','en-US')))

	-- STEP 3: Insert results into output table
	INSERT INTO @output
	SELECT  
		 @sublot_no
		,@def_lot_no

	-- exit
	RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sublot_Attr_GetAttrs]
(
    @item_id            STRING40,
	@lot_no             STRING40,
	@sublot_no          STRING40,
    @user_id	        STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Sublot_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description			- Get all attributes that are associated to a sublot
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT sublot_attr.item_id
    ,sublot_attr.lot_no
    ,sublot_attr.sublot_no
    ,sublot_attr.attr_id
    ,attr.attr_desc
	,attr.predefined
    ,attr.data_type
    ,attr.entry_type
    ,attr.visible_in_queue
    ,attr.visible_in_inv
    ,sublot_attr.attr_value
    ,sublot_attr.notes
	,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id) <=
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.cert_name = cul.cert_name
			WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id AND cul.user_id = @user_id AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level)
		THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		editable
            ,sublot_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,sublot_attr.last_edit_by
            ,sublot_attr.last_edit_at
  FROM sublot sublot WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN sublot_attr sublot_attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON
    sublot.item_id = sublot_attr.item_id AND
    sublot.lot_no = sublot_attr.lot_no AND
    sublot.sublot_no = sublot_attr.sublot_no
  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON sublot_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE sublot_attr.item_id = @item_id  AND
    sublot_attr.lot_no = @lot_no  AND
    sublot_attr.sublot_no = @sublot_no  AND
    attr.attr_grp = 9
ORDER BY attr.attr_desc

------Author: Ajeet Kumar Mandal--
------Inital version : 1.0-------------
------Date:27/01/2023------------------
------[dbo].[sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives]--
------Description: Fetch the all lot and last used of the item --------
-- -- Usage:		sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author							Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		Ajeet Kumar Mandal				2023-01-27			Initial version.
-- 0.02		DS								2023-05-02			Modified for the duplicate bom 
-- 0.03		AML, XPM						2026-05-08			Prevent duplicate rows when copying last sublot
/**********************************************************************/

---  exec sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives '1001016982','CakePowderPacking',0,0

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives] 
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no INT,
	@useLastLot INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @temp TABLE
	(
		item NVARCHAR(40),
		last_lot NVARCHAR(40)
	)

	DECLARE @job_bom_count INT,
			@counter INT = 1,
			@item_id NVARCHAR(40),
			@last_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)

	DECLARE @attr_id INT,
			@lot_mand_attr_id INT

	DECLARE @result TABLE
	(
		item_id NVARCHAR(40),
		item_desc NVARCHAR(40),
		def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
		last_used_lot NVARCHAR(40),
		attr_value NVARCHAR(40)
	)

	SET @job_bom_count = (
		SELECT COUNT(*)
		FROM job_bom(NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND bom_pos <> 0
	)

	WHILE @counter <= @job_bom_count
	BEGIN
		SELECT @item_id = item_id
		FROM job_bom(NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND bom_pos = @counter

		SET @last_lot_no = (
			SELECT TOP 1 lot_no
			FROM item_cons(NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			ORDER BY last_edit_at DESC
		)

		IF @last_lot_no IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @temp
			(
				item,
				last_lot
			)
			SELECT TOP 1
				@item_id,
				lot_no
			FROM item_cons(NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM @temp t
					WHERE t.item = @item_id
			  )
			ORDER BY last_edit_at DESC
		END

		SET @counter = @counter + 1;
	END;

	--  0.02		DS
	-- Insert items without last lot only if they were not already inserted in @temp.
	INSERT INTO @temp
	(
		item,
		last_lot
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT
		jb.item_id,
		NULL
	FROM job_bom(NOLOCK) jb
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND jb.bom_pos <> 0
	  AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM @temp t
			WHERE t.item = jb.item_id
	  )

	SELECT @lot_mand_attr_id = attr_id
	FROM attr(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'IsLotMandatory'

	SELECT @attr_id = attr_id
	FROM attr(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'

	-- fetching the only records FROM BOM which are packmat or additives and WHERE is lot mandatory flag exists
	;WITH cte AS
	(
		SELECT DISTINCT
			jb.item_id AS item_id,
			i.item_desc,
			CASE
				WHEN @useLastLot = 0 THEN jb.def_lot_no
				WHEN @useLastLot = 1 THEN ISNULL(t.last_lot, jb.def_lot_no)
			END AS def_lot_no,
			t.last_lot AS last_used_lot,
			ia.attr_value
		FROM job_bom(NOLOCK) jb
		JOIN item_attr(NOLOCK) ia
			ON jb.item_id = ia.item_id
		   AND  ia.attr_id = @attr_id		  
		JOIN item(NOLOCK) i
			ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
		JOIN @temp t
			ON t.item = jb.item_id
		WHERE jb.bom_pos <> 0
		  AND (
				ia.attr_value = 'Packmat'
				OR ia.attr_value = 'Additives'
		  )
		   AND jb.wo_id = @wo_id
		   AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
		   AND seq_no = @seq_no
	)

	INSERT INTO @result
	--SELECT
	--	item_id,
	--	item_desc,
	--	def_lot_no,
	--	last_used_lot,
	--	attr_value
	--FROM cte

	--EXCEPT -- excluding the rows which doesn't haven't lot mandatory

	SELECT
		c.item_id,
		c.item_desc,
		c.def_lot_no,
		c.last_used_lot,
		c.attr_value
	FROM cte c
	JOIN item_attr(NOLOCK) ia
		ON c.item_id = ia.item_id
	WHERE ia.attr_id = @lot_mand_attr_id
	  AND ia.attr_value = 1

	SELECT
		c.item_id,
		c.item_desc,
		c.def_lot_no,
		MAX(c.last_used_lot) AS last_used_lot,
		c.attr_value
	FROM @result c
	GROUP BY
		item_id,
		item_desc,
		def_lot_no,
		attr_value
END

--05/08/2007	Raghu		3.1.15	Error string 3175 is modified.
--09/12/2007	AML		3.3.0	DB Changes
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.
--03/09/2011	Ibrahim		4.1.0	Added code to generate samples by calling the SP sp_U_Sample_GenSampForJob on job start.
--09/02/2012    praveen kumar 4.0 SP2 Added code to get the correct event_time_utc and event_time_local in job_event table.
--02/24/2012	Ashish		4.0 SP2		Fix for L00119134
--05/14/2012    SLR         4.0 SP2  Fixes made for CR 113244/CR L00119134 were incorrectly updating the act_start_time_local
--                                   and act_start_time_utc of the job record.  Change is that the event_time_local and
--                                   event_time_utc were being setting incorrectly off of the act_start_time_local instead
--                                   of the input parameter act_start_time.
--   04/22/2013    Saiteja		  4.6       CR L00125914 - Code Changes added to update duration correctly in Job_Util_Log_Link table.
--08/22/2014	Srinivasa Tentu 5.0		UserStry#381635(As Lenka, I want to modify the stored procedures to determine the correct use of session IDs)
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
-- 08/04/2016		Raghu G			5.3		UserStory: 668382 - As Lenka, I want a job starting/suspending/ending on an entity to be updated in the job_history table
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @cur_state_cd 		INT32
	,@process_id 		STRING40
	,@wo_item_id		STRING40
	,@job_item_id		STRING40
	,@certs_ok 		INT32
	,@runjobs_priv 		INT32
	,@runjobs_priv_id	INT32
	,@newjob_priv_id	INT32
	,@uncompletejob_priv_id	INT32
    	,@row_id                INT32
	,@session_id            INT32
	,@log_job_event		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@job_start_local	TDATETIME
	,@job_start_reas_cd	INT32
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	,@line_id		INT32
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254_NULL

BEGIN
	-- Default any null input params
	SELECT @check_certs = COALESCE(@check_certs, 0), @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 0)
	--Default the job start utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
		, @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_start_utc, @current_time_utc))

	--Verify whether the job start time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_start_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_start_utc = @current_time_utc

	--Modified by Raghu on 08/28/2003. (HD# 3575). Disallow starting of any work order's job if the work order state is closed.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot start the job from the closed work order{4109}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF(@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- Get the sessionId from the sysprocesses table
		SELECT @session_id  = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WHERE spid =  @@spid
		--Retrieve the current user from the session context.
		-- Get user id from sessn when @session_id is between -1 to -9 (reserved for custom implementations) or positive number
			IF(@session_id >= -9) BEGIN
				SELECT @user_id = s.user_id
				FROM sessn s WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE s.session_id = @session_id
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
			    SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
			END

		--This will not help the UCO, however, since setting the operator production attribute does not set a current user
		--for the session.  It does however log that user in to the labor_usage table, and log any other user out.
	    --So the next choice would be the first current  user found in the labor_usage table for the job
		--if there is one.  The �current user found in the labor_usage table� would be the one where duration was 0,
		--as terminating a labor_usage record sets the duration.
		IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id  = MAX(el.user_id)
			FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE el.session_id = @session_id
		      AND el.ent_id = @ent_id
	    END
		-- If there is no current user for the job either, use the background user (identified by system attribute 199).
		IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id  = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199
	    END
	END

	-- If the check_privs flag is set check that this user may start a job
	IF (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
		-- Get this user's Priv to Run Jobs here
		SET @runjobs_priv_id = 62
		EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @runjobs_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
		IF @runjobs_priv = 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to Run Jobs{3174}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	-- Check that a job is NOT already running on the entity
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id AND je.job_pos = @job_pos
			  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @cur_state_cd = NULL, @job_item_id = NULL
	SELECT @cur_state_cd = state_cd, @job_item_id = item_id
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	IF (@cur_state_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified job does not exist in the database{3176}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Get the process_id and item_id values from the WO table if certification checks are required
	IF @check_certs = 1 BEGIN
		SET @certs_ok = 1
		SELECT @process_id = process_id, @wo_item_id = item_id FROM wo  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		-- Now call SP to check if this user is certified to start this job (oper and item checks only)
		-- Need to get back @certs_ok here
		EXECUTE @certs_ok = sp_Cert_Start_Allowed @user_id, @process_id, @oper_id, NULL, @wo_item_id, @time_zone_bias_value

		-- Check result - passed as output parameter ?
		IF @certs_ok <> 0 BEGIN
	--		RAISERROR('This user is not certified to run this job', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	-- Check that the job's state makes it startable
	IF @cur_state_cd = 4
	BEGIN
	  IF @check_privs = 1
	  BEGIN
	    SET @uncompletejob_priv_id = 41
	    EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @uncompletejob_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
	    IF (@runjobs_priv = 0) BEGIN
	      RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to Uncomplete a job{3177}', 16, 1)
	      RETURN -1
	    END
	  END  --End of @check_privs = 1
	END  --End of @cur_state_cd = 4
	ELSE IF @cur_state_cd = 6
	BEGIN
	  IF @check_privs = 1  --on-hold job
	  BEGIN  -- check for on-hold job privs 01/30/03 - SJ
	    SET @uncompletejob_priv_id = 180  -- May Change Hold Status<1861>
	    EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @uncompletejob_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
	    IF (@runjobs_priv = 0) BEGIN
	      RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to start a job that is on hold{3525}', 16, 1)
	      RETURN -1
	    END  END  --End of @check_privs = 1
	END  --  End of @cur_state_cd = 6
	ELSE IF @cur_state_cd NOT IN (1,2,5)
	BEGIN
	  RAISERROR('The specified job must be NEW or READY or SUSPENDED for it to be started{3178}', 16, 1)
	  RETURN -1
	END

	--Below line is modified by Raghu on 12/23/2002. @cur_state_cd <> 1 is changed to @cur_state_cd = 1. The below check needs to be done only for the NEW job
	-- If the job's state is NEW and the check_privs flag is set check that this user may start a NEW job
	IF (@cur_state_cd = 1) AND (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
		-- Check this user's Priv to start a NEW job here
		SET @newjob_priv_id = 64
		EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @newjob_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
		IF @runjobs_priv = 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to start a NEW job{3179}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no) BEGIN

		UPDATE job_exec
		SET cur_wo_id = @wo_id, cur_oper_id = @oper_id, cur_seq_no = @seq_no, cur_step_no = NULL, cur_step_start = NULL
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		AND job_pos = @job_pos AND cur_wo_id IS NULL

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('SQL Error updating current job start data in job_exec table{3181}', 16, 1)
			RETURN @@error
		END

		 -- Verify than the update was successful
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND job_pos = @job_pos
			  AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
	  		  AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('SQL Error updating current job start data in job_exec table{3181}', 16, 1)
			RETURN @@error
		END
	END

	--Determine the job start local time from the utc
	SET @job_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @job_start_utc)

	-- Update the Job table - only set the act_start_time fields if this is its first start
	UPDATE Job
	SET state_cd = 3,run_ent_id = @ent_id
	  , act_start_time_utc = CASE WHEN act_start_time_utc IS NULL THEN @job_start_utc ELSE act_start_time_utc END
	  , act_start_time_local = CASE WHEN act_start_time_local IS NULL THEN @job_start_local ELSE act_start_time_local END
	  , status_notes = @status_notes
	  , last_edit_comment = COALESCE(last_edit_comment, '') + 'JobStartPauseEndAction'
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no

	-- Return error if this was not successful
	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('SQL Error updating job start data in job table{3180}', 16, 1)
		RETURN @@error
	END

	--Create job history record, and job_hour_history if the entity is capturing oee.
	EXEC sp_I_Job_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc
		, @job_pos=@job_pos, @item_id=@job_item_id
		, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
		, @last_edit_comment='JobExec.StartJob', @last_edit_at=NULL, @row_id=NULL

	--Determine whether the job start event should be logged.
	SELECT @log_job_event= attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 308
	IF (@log_job_event = '1')
		INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id,
			bom_pos, lot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, value1, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (@job_start_utc, @job_start_local, @wo_id,  @oper_id, @seq_no, 'JobStateChanged',
			@ent_id,NULL, NULL, @job_item_id,  @user_id,  @row_id, 3,  @user_id, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()))

	--Modified by Raghu on 08/28/2003. (HD# 3565). If any job is running on an entity, ie state_cd=3, then the  WO.state_cd must be set to 1
	UPDATE wo SET state_cd = 1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	--Determine whether this entity is capturing utilization
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_capture_util = 1) BEGIN
		--Determine whether there is any job start reason code configured.
		SELECT @job_start_reas_cd = ue.jobstart_reas_cd FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ue.ent_id = @ent_id

		IF (@job_start_reas_cd IS NOT NULL)
			--Job start reason code is configured. Therefore, create a new utilization event
			EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@job_start_utc, @reas_cd=@job_start_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0
				, @comments=NULL, @raw_reas_cd=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
				, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
				, @last_edit_comment='JobExec.StartJob(job start reason code)', @update_if_exists=1
				, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=NULL
	END

	EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewJob @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @job_item_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value

	-- Determine whether the entity belongs to a line and the rate change has to be logged.
	SELECT TOP 1 @line_id = lel.line_id
	FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND lel.line_is_child = 0

	-- If the entity is in a line, determine the rate change
	IF (@line_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @last_edit_comment = 'StartJob(Ent=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@ent_id, -1)) + ',Wo=' + COALESCE(@wo_id, 'null') + ',Oper=' + COALESCE(@oper_id, 'null') + ',Seq=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@seq_no, -1)) + ')'
		EXEC sp_SA_Line_GetBottleneckEnts @line_id = @line_id, @log_prod_rates = 1, @start_time_utc = @job_start_utc, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	END
RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_PO_Line_GetAllByFilter]
(
		@user_id 	STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@cust_id 	STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@po_id 		STRING40_NULL = NULL
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_PO_Line_GetAllByFilter
-- Description	      -	Returns a recordset of line items filtered by the users current filter settings
--			New BR reqd doc (Customer Window Business Rules.doc) from Rich B
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	08/20/2003
-- Version	      - 2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
--10/27/2003	  Raghu		   2.0.0.6	Defaulted filter values to 0; (if not found from ui_config)
--				  			   			Also, modified to execute with partial filter options, eg., Open, Complete
-- 09/04/2007	  AML			3.3.0	Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @config_value 		VARCHAR(160)
		,	@open_filter 		VARCHAR(40)
		,	@partial_filter 	VARCHAR(40)
		,	@complete_filter 	VARCHAR(40)
		,	@start_ 			INT
		,	@end_ 				INT
		,	@sSQL 				VARCHAR(4000)
		,	@temp_sSQL 			VARCHAR(4000)


    SELECT @config_value = Convert( varchar, valu ) FROM ui_config WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE UPPER(config_id) = UPPER(@user_id) AND UPPER(screen) = 'CUSTOMER'
	AND UPPER(sectn) = 'CUSTOMERTREEVIEW' AND UPPER(parameter) = 'FILTERS'


	SELECT @open_filter = '0', @partial_filter = '0', @complete_filter = '0'

	IF  ( @config_value IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Open=', ':', @open_filter
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Partial=', ':', @partial_filter
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Complete=', ':', @complete_filter

	END

	SET @sSQL = 'SELECT pl.po_line_no, pl.item_id, i.item_desc FROM po_line pl WITH (NOLOCK) '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON pl.item_id = i.item_id '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN po WITH (NOLOCK) ON pl.po_id = po.po_id '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN cust WITH (NOLOCK) ON po.vend_id = cust.cust_id '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE	cust.cust_id = @cust_id AND '
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'pl.po_id = @po_id '


	IF  ( ( @open_filter = '1') OR ( @partial_filter = '1') OR ( @complete_filter = '1') ) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND ('
		IF  ( @open_filter = '1' ) BEGIN
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM shipment_lot WITH (NOLOCK) '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' WHERE cust_id = ''' + @cust_id + ''' and po_id = ''' + @po_id + ''''
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' and po_line_no = pl.po_line_no)'
		END

		IF  ( @partial_filter = '1') BEGIN
			IF ( @temp_sSQL IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' OR '
			END

			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' quantity > (SELECT sum(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot WITH (NOLOCK) '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' WHERE cust_id = ''' + @cust_id + ''' and po_id = ''' + @po_id + ''''
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' and po_line_no = pl.po_line_no)'
		END

		IF  ( @complete_filter = '1') BEGIN
			IF  ( @temp_sSQL IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' OR '
			END

			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' quantity <= (SELECT sum(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot WITH (NOLOCK) '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' WHERE cust_id = ''' + @cust_id + ''' and po_id = ''' + @po_id + ''''
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' and po_line_no = pl.po_line_no)'
		END

		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_sSQL + ') '

	END

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY pl.po_line_no'

	EXEC( @sSQL )

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_util_exec_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[util_exec]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_util_exec_aft_upd
-- Description            -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on util_exec to update FC Tags
-- Author	      - Author
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/04/2003       Raghu		2.0	Updates FC Tags ONLY if the column value is update; otherwise NOT
--					Also included NOLOCK hint while updating FC Tags
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 07/11/2006	Raghu		3.1.19	HD# 8434, Strip the milli-seconds by converting the datetime value to a character type and then convert it back to a datetime datatype
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.
--10/09/2007	Raghu		3.3.2	Changed parameter type from int to float.
--01/16/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00071022; Number values are recorded in scientific notation.
--08/27/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00082530; The SQL Server is setting "Util.ReasStart" tag as UTC time; Issue fixed to store reas_start in local time.
--09/08/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00082530; The SQL Server is setting "Util.ReasStart" tag as UTC time; Issue fixed to store reas_start in local time.
--09/25/2008	Raghu 	    3.5	L00082286, L00083732, L00084282, L00084592 ; UCO State Change and deadlock resolution
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@ent_id	INT32,
			@state_cd	INT32,
			@state_desc	STRING80,
			@reas_cd	INT32,
			@reas_desc	STRING80,
			@reas_start_utc	TDATETIME,
			@reas_start_local	TDATETIME,
			@reas_reqd	LOGICAL,
			@target_util	TFLOAT,
			@current_util	TFLOAT,
			@last_edit_by	STRING40,
			@line_id	INT32,
			@last_edit_comment	STRING254_NULL

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	DECLARE @t_util_exec TABLE (
		id int identity,
		ent_id int,
		cur_state_cd int,
		cur_reas_cd int,
		reas_desc nvarchar(80),
		cur_reas_start_utc datetime,
		cur_reas_start_local datetime,
		state_desc nvarchar(80),
		reas_reqd bit,
		target_util float,
		current_util float
	)

	-- If the ent_enabled field for the new reason code has a different value than for the original reason code,
	-- update the prod_rate_history and bottleneck_history tables.
	-- This should only be done if the entity is part of a line
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.ent_id = d.ent_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = d.ent_id
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.cur_reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.cur_reas_cd = ur2.reas_cd
		WHERE (i.cur_reas_cd <> d.cur_reas_cd AND ur.ent_enabled <> ur2.ent_enabled))) BEGIN

		DECLARE util_exec_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT lel.line_id, lel.ent_id
		FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.ent_id = d.ent_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = i.ent_id
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.cur_reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.cur_reas_cd = ur2.reas_cd
		WHERE (i.cur_reas_cd <> d.cur_reas_cd AND ur.ent_enabled <> ur2.ent_enabled)
		OPEN util_exec_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM util_exec_cursor INTO @line_id, @ent_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @last_edit_comment = 'UtilExec.Update(Ent=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@ent_id, -1)) + ')'
			EXEC sp_SA_Line_GetBottleneckEnts @line_id = @line_id, @log_prod_rates = 1, @start_time_utc = NULL, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
		END
		CLOSE util_exec_cursor
		DEALLOCATE util_exec_cursor
	END

	INSERT INTO @t_util_exec (
		ent_id, cur_state_cd, cur_reas_cd, reas_desc, cur_reas_start_utc, cur_reas_start_local,
		state_desc, reas_reqd, target_util, current_util
	)
	SELECT	b.ent_id, b.cur_state_cd, b.cur_reas_cd, c.reas_desc, b.cur_reas_start_utc, b.cur_reas_start_local, d.state_desc,
			b.reas_reqd, b.target_util, b.current_util
	FROM util_exec a WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN inserted b ON a.ent_id = b.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas c WITH (NOLOCK) ON b.cur_reas_cd = c.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state d WITH (NOLOCK) ON b.cur_state_cd = d.state_cd

	DECLARE @max_id AS INT, @count AS INT
	SELECT @max_id = MAX( id ), @count = MIN( id ) FROM @t_util_exec

	WHILE ( @count <= @max_id ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@ent_id = ent_id, @state_cd = cur_state_cd, @reas_cd = cur_reas_cd
			,	@reas_desc = reas_desc, @reas_start_utc = cur_reas_start_utc
			,	@reas_start_local = cur_reas_start_local, @state_desc = state_desc
			,	@reas_reqd = reas_reqd, @target_util = target_util, @current_util = current_util
		FROM @t_util_exec tuc
		WHERE tuc.id = @count

/* RWB: This change was made for CR L00085757, but it is being rolled back until Sidus 3 Rewire.
		IF UPDATE(target_util) OR UPDATE(jobstart_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(jobend_reas_cd) OR
		   UPDATE(shift_start_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(shift_end_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(unkn_stop_reas_cd) OR
		   UPDATE(break_start_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(break_end_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(inherit_from_parent) OR
		   UPDATE(spare1) OR UPDATE(spare2) OR UPDATE(spare3) OR UPDATE(spare4) BEGIN
*/
			UPDATE util_exec SET util_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, util_exec.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
/*
		END
*/

		SET @count = @count + 1
	END


END
