CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailLots]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@seq_no	INT
,@ent_id	INT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailLots
-- Description	      -	HD# 5484, Returns all eligible lots for a job running on the supplied entity.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	03/11/2005
-- Version	      - 2.1.16.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 06/09/2005      KRF                  Changed first section to only return lots where item made in predecessor job is the same as that made by the current job.
--                                                    Had been fetching the predecessor job in j, instead of the current one, so ip.item_id = j.item_id clause did no good.
--04/17/2007    Raghu       3.2.9   HD# 9240, Limit lots presented in steps control if must_consume_from_wip is true (V. 3.2)
--05/14/2007    Raghu       3.2.12  HD# 9845, Return all lot nos. related to assigned_lot.
--09/07/2007	AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
--08/24/2008    Raghu       3.5.  L00075704; GE - Job Based Serialization - provide the ability to turn off item serialization at the work order level. Hotfix Request ID 887
--06/01/2012    Arun       4.0 SP3  Fix for the CR L00119691
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @item_id				STRING80
		,	@must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL
		,	@user_id                STRING80
		,	@client_info            STRING80
		,	@may_override_route     INT32
		,	@parent_ent_id          INT32
		,	@serial_no_lvl          INT32
		,	@filter_oper_id         STRING80
		,	@filter_seq_no          INT32
		,	@override_serialization	BIT


    --Verify whether the current job has must_consume_from_wip flag turned on.
    SELECT @item_id = jb.item_id, @must_consume_from_wip = jb.must_consume_from_wip, @serial_no_lvl = i.serial_no_lvl
    FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
      AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
      AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
      AND jb.bom_pos = 0

    SELECT @override_serialization = wo.override_serialization
    FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

	IF (@override_serialization = 1) SET @serial_no_lvl = -1

    --Verify whether the must_consume_from_wip flag is turned on for the supplied job.
    IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
        --Verify whether this work order has a may override route is turned on.
        SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
        FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		IF ( @may_override_route IS NULL ) BEGIN
            --A valid work order cannot be identified; just default the may override route to 0.
            SET @may_override_route = 0
		END

		IF (@may_override_route = 0) BEGIN
			--Since the user is trying to locate the lots where the must_consume_from_wip is set to true.
			--Retrieve the user_id to see whether this user has a privilege to override the route.
			EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id, @client_info

			--The work order flag for may_override_route is set to false.
			--But, verify whether this user has a privilege to override the route.
			SELECT @may_override_route = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
			FROM grp_priv_link gpl WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
			WHERE gpl.priv_id = 261 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

			IF ( @may_override_route IS NULL ) BEGIN
				--The privilege to override the work order route is not found for this user;
				--default this user to NOT to override the route.
				SET @may_override_route = 0
			END
		END

		--Retrieve the immediate parent entity where we need to find the inventory.
		SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Verify whether it is a serialized part
		--IF (@serial_no_lvl > -1) BEGIN
			--This is a serialized part. If the part is serialized (serial_no_lvl> -1) do not include the
			--SELECT clause dealing with lots produced in an upstream operation.
			--SELECT	@may_override_route = 1, @filter_oper_id = @oper_id, @filter_seq_no = @seq_no
		--END


		DECLARE @temp_se_ids TABLE (
			t_id int identity,
			t_ent_id int
		)

		INSERT INTO @temp_se_ids
			SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)

		DECLARE @temp_storage_ents TABLE (
			tse_ent_id int,
			tse_parent_ent_id int,
			tse_child_level int
		)

		DECLARE @level AS INT
		SET @level = 1

		---Modified for the CR L00119691
		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents ( tse_ent_id, tse_parent_ent_id, tse_child_level )
		SELECT se.ent_id, se.storage_ent_id, @level
		FROM storage_exec se
		WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id OR se.storage_ent_id = @parent_ent_id


		WHILE ( 1 = 1 )	BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents( tse_ent_id, tse_parent_ent_id, tse_child_level )
				SELECT tse.tse_ent_id, s.storage_ent_id, @level + 1
				FROM @temp_storage_ents tse
					INNER JOIN storage_exec s WITH (NOLOCK) ON tse.tse_ent_id = s.storage_ent_id
				WHERE tse.tse_child_level = @level AND s.storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL

			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1
		END

		--Verify whether the work order route can be overridden.
		IF (@may_override_route > 0) BEGIN
			--Either the work order route can be overridden; or the user has a privilege to override the work order route.
			--Only lots of this item produced by the same work order should be included.
			SELECT DISTINCT ip.lot_no
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND ip.item_id = @item_id
			UNION
			--Only lots of this item produced by the same work order should be included.
			SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id
			  AND ii.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND (ii.oper_id = @filter_oper_id OR @filter_oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND (ii.seq_no = @filter_seq_no OR @filter_seq_no IS NULL)
			  --SELECT from item_inv not only the current entity but also any immediate parent entities
			  --that can_store, and any movable storage entities that are located at (directly or indirectly)
			  --either the current entitiy or its immediate parents.
			  AND ii.ent_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tse.tse_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ents tse )
				--include serial numbers in the dropdown on step control
                --that do not have any users actively logged in to any steps for them on a different work center
                AND (ii.item_id )
               NOT IN ---Added
                  (SELECT lu.item_id FROM labor_usage lu
                  WHERE lu.wo_id = @wo_id AND lu.oper_id = @oper_id
                    AND lu.ent_id <> @ent_id AND lu.active = 1
                    AND lu.lot_no IS NOT NULL)
			AND (ii.lot_no)
               NOT IN ---Added
                  (SELECT lu.lot_no FROM labor_usage lu
                  WHERE lu.wo_id = @wo_id AND lu.oper_id = @oper_id
                    AND lu.ent_id <> @ent_id AND lu.active = 1
                    AND lu.lot_no IS NOT NULL)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT lot_no FROM assigned_lot WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id =  @wo_id
				--The lot numbers to be added are those in the assigned_lot table that are unstarted,
				--are for the current work order, and are not for a different operation or sequence number than the current job.
			  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
					OR oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND ((seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
				OR seq_no IS NULL)
			  AND status = 0;
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The may_override_route flag for the work order is set to false; and as well as the
			--user does not have a privilege to override the route.
			--If the new may_override_route flag is false, include the operation number of the job upstream
			--from the current one that produces the same item in the WHERE clause when fetching lots from
			--inventory.
			SELECT DISTINCT ip.lot_no
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND ip.item_id = @item_id
			UNION
			--If the new may_override_route flag is false, include the operation number of the job upstream
			--from the current one that produces the same item in the WHERE clause when fetching lots from
			--inventory.
			SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = ii.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = ii.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = ii.seq_no
			WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND ii.item_id = @item_id
			  --SELECT from item_inv not only the current entity but also any immediate parent entities
			  --that can_store, and any movable storage entities that are located at (directly or indirectly)
			  --either the current entitiy or its immediate parents.
			  AND ii.ent_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT tse.tse_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ents tse)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT lot_no FROM assigned_lot WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id =  @wo_id
				--The lot numbers to be added are those in the assigned_lot table that are unstarted,
				--are for the current work order, and are not for a different operation or sequence number than the current job.
			  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) OR oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND ((seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) OR seq_no IS NULL)
			  AND status = 0
		END
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        --If the part is serialized (serial_no_lvl> -1) do not include the
        --SELECT clause dealing with lots produced in an upstream operation.
    	SELECT DISTINCT ip.lot_no FROM item_prod ip,
    	  (SELECT wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
    	     WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    	       AND seq_no = @seq_no ) jr, job j WITH (NOLOCK)
    	  WHERE ip.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
    	    AND ip.wo_id = j.wo_id AND ip.item_id = j.item_id AND j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
    	    AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
            AND @serial_no_lvl = -1
        UNION
        --If the part is serialized (serial_no_lvl> -1) do not include the
        --SELECT clause dealing with lots produced in an upstream operation.
        SELECT DISTINCT ip.lot_no FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no
          AND ip.item_id = @item_id
          AND @serial_no_lvl > -1
    	UNION
    	SELECT DISTINCT fg_lot_no FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
    	  WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    	    AND seq_no = @seq_no )
    	UNION
    	SELECT DISTINCT lot_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
    	  WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    	    AND seq_no = @seq_no )
    	UNION
    	SELECT DISTINCT lot_no FROM item_inv ii, job j WITH (NOLOCK)
    	  WHERE (ii.ent_id = @ent_id AND ii.item_id = j.item_id
    	    AND j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
    	    AND j.seq_no = @seq_no)
    	UNION
    	SELECT DISTINCT def_lot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
    	  WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    	    AND seq_no = @seq_no)
    	    AND (def_lot_no IS NOT NULL ) AND bom_pos = 0
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT lot_no FROM assigned_lot WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id =  @wo_id
            --The lot numbers to be added are those in the assigned_lot table that are unstarted,
            --are for the current work order, and are not for a different operation or sequence number than the current job.
          AND ((oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
                OR oper_id IS NULL)
          AND ((seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
            OR seq_no IS NULL)
          AND status = 0
		UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT al.lot_no
        FROM assigned_lot al
        WHERE al.wo_id =  @wo_id
            --The lot numbers to be added are those in the assigned_lot table that are unstarted or started
            --for this work order
          AND ((al.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
                OR al.oper_id IS NULL)
          AND al.status <> 2
          --include serial numbers in the dropdown on step control
          --that do not have any users actively logged in to any steps for them on a different work center
          AND (al.item_id) NOT IN
          (SELECT lu.item_id FROM labor_usage lu
          WHERE lu.wo_id = @wo_id AND lu.oper_id = @oper_id
            AND lu.ent_id <> @ent_id AND lu.lot_no IS NOT NULL
            AND lu.active = 1)
		AND (al.lot_no) NOT IN
          (SELECT  lu.lot_no FROM labor_usage lu
          WHERE lu.wo_id = @wo_id AND lu.oper_id = @oper_id
            AND lu.ent_id <> @ent_id AND lu.lot_no IS NOT NULL
            AND lu.active = 1)

    END
END

-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Oper_Spec_Ver

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_QM_Context_GetContext]
(
@ent_id INT32,
@wo_id STRING40,
@oper_id STRING40,
@seq_no INT32,
@context_ent_id INT32_NULL,
@item_id STRING40_NULL,
@item_category_id INT32_NULL,
@context_oper_id STRING40_NULL,
@process_id STRING40_NULL,
@context_id INT32 OUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_S_QM_Context_GetContext
-- Description	      - Return the context_id of the qm_context record that matches
--                    - the supplied context for the specified entity running
--                    - the supplied job.  If no such qm_context record exists,
--                    - create a record and return the context_id of that new record.
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -	01/25/2013
-- Version	          -	1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 09/14/2018		Raghu			6.0		UserStory: 1082564 - As SE, I want to merge in hotfixes related to Sample Generation
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @context INT32,
        @state_cd INT32,
        @is_job_running INT32

SELECT @context_id = context_id
FROM qm_context with (nolock)
WHERE
(qm_context.ent_id = @ent_id) AND
((qm_context.context_ent_id = @context_ent_id) OR (qm_context.context_ent_id is null AND @context_ent_id is null)) AND
((qm_context.item_id = @item_id) OR  (qm_context.item_id is null AND @item_id is null)) AND
((qm_context.item_category_id = @item_category_id) OR (qm_context.item_category_id is null AND @item_category_id IS NULL)) AND
((qm_context.context_oper_id = @context_oper_id) OR (qm_context.context_oper_id is null AND @context_oper_id is null)) AND
((qm_context.process_id = @process_id) OR (qm_context.process_id is null AND @process_id is null)) AND
(qm_context.wo_id = @wo_id AND qm_context.oper_id = @oper_id AND qm_context.seq_no = @seq_no)

if (@context_id is null)
	BEGIN
	-- Determine if the supplied job is currently running
	SELECT @state_cd=state_cd from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND seq_no=@seq_no

	if @state_cd = 3
		SET @is_job_running = 1
	else
		SET @is_job_running = 0

	-- Create a new QM_Context record
	EXECUTE sp_I_Qm_Context @context_ent_id, @item_id, @item_category_id, @process_id, @context_oper_id, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id,
	@seq_no, @is_job_running, null, null, null, null, null, null, @context_id OUTPUT
	END
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_inventory_transfer_data]
AS
SELECT item_transfer.trans_id,
       item_transfer.transfer_time_utc,
       item_transfer.transfer_time_local,
       item_transfer.transfer_by,
       user_name.user_desc,
       item_transfer.wo_id,
       item_transfer.oper_id,
       item_transfer.seq_no,
       item_transfer.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item_transfer.lot_no,
       item_transfer.sublot_no,
       item_transfer.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_transfer.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_transfer.expiry_date expiry_date,
       item_transfer.from_ent_id,
       from_ent.ent_name from_ent_name,
       item_transfer.to_ent_id,
       to_ent.ent_name to_ent_name,
       item_transfer.from_item_id,
       from_item.item_desc from_item_desc,
       from_item.num_decimals
       from_num_decimals,from_uom.abbreviation from_units,
       item_transfer.from_lot_no,
       item_transfer.from_sublot_no,
       item_transfer.from_grade_cd,
       from_item_grade.item_grade_desc from_grade_desc,
       from_item_grade.color from_grade_color,
       item_transfer.from_status_cd,
       from_item_state.item_status_desc from_status_desc,
       from_item_state.color from_status_color,
       item_transfer.from_expiry_date from_expiry_date,
       item_transfer.qty_txd,
       item_transfer.from_qty_txd,
       item_transfer.goods_received,
       item_transfer.goods_shipped,
       item_transfer.comments
FROM item_transfer item_transfer
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   item_transfer.transfer_by = user_name.user_id
INNER JOIN item item ON
   item_transfer.item_id = item.item_id

INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id

   item_transfer.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state item_state ON
   item_transfer.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade from_item_grade ON
   item_transfer.from_grade_cd =
   from_item_grade.item_grade_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state from_item_state ON
   item_transfer.from_status_cd =
   from_item_state.item_status_cd

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PUO_Create_Wo] (@module        NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @plant_code    NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @wo_id         NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @spare1        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare2        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare3        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare4        NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
	        BEGIN
            DECLARE @rc                    INT,
                    @error_msg             NVARCHAR(500),
                    @error_severity        INT,
                    @error_state           INT,
                    @wo_desc               NVARCHAR(80),
                    @req_qty               FLOAT,
                    @req_finish_time_local DATETIME,
                    @item_id               NVARCHAR(80),
					@sched_start_time_local DATETIME,
					@from_uom_id INT,
					@to_uom_id INT,
					@conv_factor FLOAT,
					@cur_jobs CURSOR,
					@process_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@init_prod_pct FLOAT,
					@oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@init_sched_ent_id INT,
					@job_qty FLOAT,
					@seq_no INT,
					@batch varchar(50)

            BEGIN try
                BEGIN TRANSACTION

                SELECT @wo_desc = wo_desc,
                       @req_qty = wo_qty,
                       @req_finish_time_local = dbo.Fn_s_ofi_converterpdatestring(req_finish_date,req_finish_time),
					   @sched_start_time_local=dbo.Fn_s_ofi_converterpdatestring(sched_start_date, sched_start_time),
					   @batch=lot_no
                FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				SELECT @item_id = item_id,
					   @process_id=process_id
                      FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id


				SELECT @to_uom_id = u.uom_id
				FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
					   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
							   ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
								  AND i.item_id = @item_id

				SELECT @from_uom_id = u.uom_id
				FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock)
						INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
								ON u.description = owe.uom_desc
									AND owe.wo_id = @wo_id

				IF @from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @conv_factor=factor
					FROM   uom_conv WITH (nolock)
					WHERE  from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
						   AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
						   AND ( @item_id IS NULL
								  OR @item_id = item_id )
					ORDER  BY item_id DESC

					SET @req_qty=@req_qty * @conv_factor
				END

				IF @req_qty is NULL SET @req_qty = 0

                UPDATE wo
                SET    wo_desc = @wo_desc,
                       req_qty = @req_qty,
                       req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local
					   
                WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				SET @cur_jobs= CURSOR FOR
				SELECT init_sched_ent_id,
				oper_id,
				seq_no
				FROM   job WITH (nolock)
				where wo_id=@wo_id

				OPEN @cur_jobs

				FETCH next FROM @cur_jobs INTO @init_sched_ent_id, @oper_id,@seq_no

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				  BEGIN
					  SELECT @init_prod_pct = init_prod_pct
					  FROM   oper_ent_link WITH (nolock)
					  WHERE  oper_id = @oper_id
							 AND ent_id = @init_sched_ent_id
							 AND process_id = @process_id

					  SET @job_qty=@init_prod_pct * @req_qty

					  UPDATE job
					  SET    qty_reqd = @job_qty, qty_at_start=@job_qty
					  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no 

					  FETCH next FROM @cur_jobs INTO @init_sched_ent_id, @oper_id,@seq_no
				  END

				CLOSE @cur_jobs

				DEALLOCATE @cur_jobs


				UPDATE job
				SET    sched_start_time_local = @sched_start_time_local
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
				--AND first_job = 1 --(KN 27-Jan-23 - Updated this as part of the same discussion on local vs utc time to be used and advised)

                IF ( EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                            FROM   item_attr ia WITH (nolock)
                                   INNER JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
                                           ON i.item_id = ia.item_id
                                              AND i.item_id = @item_id
                                   INNER JOIN attr a WITH (nolock)
                                           ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
                                              AND a.attr_desc = 'RecipeToUse'
                                              AND a.attr_grp = 1
                                              AND ia.attr_value = 'ERP')
                     AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                                FROM   job_bom WITH (nolock)
                                WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                                       AND bom_pos <> 0) )
                  BEGIN
                     
                      DELETE job_bom
                      WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                             AND bom_pos <> 0

                      EXEC @rc=Sp_i_ei_pro_create_bom
                        @module,
                        @plant_code,
                        @wo_id,
						'', --@erp_wo_status,
                        @item_id,
                        @spare1,
                        @spare2,
                        @spare3,
                        @spare4

                      IF ( @rc <> 0 )
                        BEGIN
                            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating BOM (' +  @wo_id + ') in MES  - SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_BOM -  '   + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
                            THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
                        END
                  END

                COMMIT TRANSACTION
            END try

            BEGIN catch
                IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

                SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
                       @error_severity = Error_severity(),
                       @error_state = Error_state();

                RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
            END catch
        END
  END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetNoSublotWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
-- Description: This is used to prepare the RM/SFG/FG materials report based on WIP consumptions
-- Note : Only for materials without sublot connection between cons and prod
--
-- Runs before: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport; 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	MC            	2025-11-06			Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================
--EXEC sp_S_ofi_EI_GetNoSublotWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetNoSublotWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- SP NAME: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetNoSublotWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork

	-- Declare general variables 
	DECLARE     
		@debug            		BIT   = 0 -- Used for internal DEBUG -- SET to zero before deployment
		,@cutoff_date			DATETIME
		,@delay_hours			INT = 4
		,@error_msg           	NVARCHAR(MAX) -- Error handling
		,@error_severity      	INT           -- Error handling
		,@error_state         	INT           -- Error handling
	--	Declare attribute id variables
	DECLARE
		@notConsumeToSap_id		INT
		,@skipConsReporting_id	INT
	-- Declare STEP1 variables
	DECLARE
		@fg_lot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@process_id	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@seq_no		INT

	DECLARE @cons_records AS TABLE(
	cons_row_id INT,
	fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
	oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
	process_id NVARCHAR(40),
	item_id NVARCHAR(40),
	seq_no INT,
	qty_cons FLOAT,
	qty_cons_erp FLOAT,
	last_edit_at DATETIME,
	created_at_utc DATETIME
	)
	-- 0.01.09 Calculate cutoff date for eligible records
    SET @cutoff_date = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -@delay_hours, GETUTCDATE())), 0);

	-- 0.01.09 Add applock to avoid race with ToReport SP
	DECLARE @rc INT;
	EXEC @rc = sys.sp_getapplock
		 @DbPrincipal = N'dbo',
		 @Resource    = N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK',
		 @LockMode    = N'Exclusive',
		 @LockOwner   = N'Session',
		 @LockTimeout = 5000;

	IF (@rc < 0)
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Skipped: another session holds WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK.';
		RETURN;
	END

	SELECT @skipConsReporting_id = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting' AND attr_grp = 1
	SELECT @notConsumeToSap_id = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE attr_desc = 'NotConsumeToSAP' AND attr_grp = 7

	-- STEP 1: Get TOP 1 oldest consumption sublot without connection to production
	-- Verify if exists lot connection to production and WIP/INTERMEDIATE is produced
	-- Verify current sublot number running on the WIP production line
	
	INSERT INTO @cons_records(
		cons_row_id,
		fg_lot_no,
		oper_id,
		process_id,
		item_id,
		seq_no,
		qty_cons,
		qty_cons_erp,
		last_edit_at,
		created_at_utc
		)
	SELECT
		ic.row_id,
		ic.fg_lot_no,
		ic.oper_id,
		w.process_id,
		ic.item_id,
		ic.seq_no,
		ic.qty_cons,
		ic.qty_cons_erp,
		ic2.last_edit_at,
		ic2.created_at_utc
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ia.item_id = i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @skipConsReporting_id
	LEFT JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON oa.process_id = w.process_id
		AND oa.oper_id = ic.oper_id
		AND oa.attr_id = @notConsumeToSap_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT DISTINCT item_cons_row_id
		FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported
		WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
	) cwr ON cwr.item_cons_row_id=ic.row_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT lot_no, oper_id, process_id, MAX(ic2.last_edit_at) AS last_edit_at, MAX(ic2.created_at_utc) AS created_at_utc
		FROM item_cons ic2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN wo w2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON w2.wo_id = ic2.wo_id
		WHERE ic2.qty_cons_erp>0 AND w2.state_cd <> 3
		GROUP BY lot_no, oper_id, process_id
		) ic2 ON ic2.oper_id <> ic.oper_id
		AND ic2.process_id = w.process_id
		AND ic2.lot_no = ic.fg_lot_no
	WHERE
		ic2.last_edit_at < @cutoff_date
		AND ic.last_edit_at < DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -1, GETUTCDATE())), 0) --delay after source cons was midified
		AND ic2.last_edit_at > '2025-11-01 00:00:00.000'
		AND NOT EXISTS ( --there is no conncetion between cons and prod on same operation by sublot
			SELECT 1
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = ip.sublot_no
			AND ic.oper_id = ip.oper_id
			AND ic.seq_no = ip.seq_no
		)
		AND EXISTS ( --there is connection between cons and prod on same operation by lot
			SELECT 1
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN item i2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON i2.item_id=ip.item_id
			WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = ip.lot_no
			AND ic.oper_id = ip.oper_id
			AND ic.seq_no = ip.seq_no
			AND i2.item_class_id IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE'))
		AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp --there is something to report
		AND cwr.item_cons_row_id IS NULL --do not take records already awaiting for processing
		AND i.item_class_id NOT IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
		AND ISNULL(ia.attr_value,'0') = '0'
		AND ISNULL(oa.attr_value,'0') = '0'
	ORDER BY last_edit_at

	SELECT TOP(1)
		@fg_lot_no=fg_lot_no,
		@oper_id=oper_id,
		@process_id = process_id,
		@seq_no = seq_no
	FROM @cons_records
	ORDER BY last_edit_at ASC

	-- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
	IF (@fg_lot_no IS NULL)
	BEGIN		
		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		--release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END
	
	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT
		@fg_lot_no AS fg_lot_no,
		@oper_id AS oper_id
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --
	-- STEP 2: Calculate yield for selected lot_no
	-- Declare variables for STEP 2
	DECLARE
		@total_src_lot_cons_qty				FLOAT
		,@total_src_lot_cons_qty_pending	FLOAT
		,@total_wip_lot_prod_qty			FLOAT
		,@total_wip_lot_cons_qty_erp		FLOAT
		,@total_src_lot_cons_qty_erp		FLOAT
		,@ratio								FLOAT
		,@uom_kg_id							INT
		,@target_src_lot_cons_qty			FLOAT
		,@total_src_lot_cons_nonsublot		FLOAT
		,@can_be_reported_qty				FLOAT
		,@can_be_reported_ratio				FLOAT
	
	SELECT TOP(1)
		@uom_kg_id = uom_id
	FROM uom
	WHERE description = 'KG'

	SELECT
		@total_src_lot_cons_qty = SUM(ic.qty_cons*uc.factor)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no
	AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
	AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT
		@total_wip_lot_prod_qty = SUM(ip.qty_prod*uc.factor)
	FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ip.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE ip.lot_no = @fg_lot_no
	AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id
	AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no
	AND ip.good_prod = 1

	SET @ratio = @total_src_lot_cons_qty/@total_wip_lot_prod_qty
	
	-- STEP 2.1: Calculate reported consumption qty for WIP and source material
	SELECT @total_wip_lot_cons_qty_erp = SUM(qty_cons_erp*uc.factor)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON o.oper_id = ic.oper_id
	WHERE ic.lot_no = @fg_lot_no
		AND o.oper_id <> @oper_id
		AND o.process_id = @process_id

	SELECT @total_src_lot_cons_qty_pending = ISNULL(SUM(CAST(wr.spare1 AS FLOAT) * uc.factor),0)
	FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported wr WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ic.row_id = wr.item_cons_row_id
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
		AND wr.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no
		AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT @total_src_lot_cons_qty_erp = SUM(qty_cons_erp*uc.factor)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON o.oper_id = ic.oper_id
	WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no
		AND o.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

	SET @total_src_lot_cons_qty_erp = @total_src_lot_cons_qty_erp + @total_src_lot_cons_qty_pending

	-- STEP 2.2: Calculate target possible consumption of source material
	SET @target_src_lot_cons_qty = @total_wip_lot_cons_qty_erp * @ratio

	SET @can_be_reported_qty = @target_src_lot_cons_qty - @total_src_lot_cons_qty_erp
	
	-- Update fg_lot_no records in item_cons to set current last_edit_at if can_be_reported_qty < 0
	IF @can_be_reported_qty <= 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ic
		SET last_edit_at = GETDATE()
		FROM item_cons ic
		JOIN @cons_records cr
			ON cr.cons_row_id=ic.row_id
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no
		--AND fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no

		--release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END

	-- STEP2.3: Calculate all possible to report nosublot items
	SELECT
    @total_src_lot_cons_nonsublot = SUM(cr.qty_cons * uc.factor) - SUM(cr.qty_cons_erp * uc.factor)
	FROM @cons_records cr
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = cr.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE
	  cr.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND cr.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND cr.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no;

	-- STEP 2.4 Calculate ratio for src reporting ratio if we can't report everything
	SET @can_be_reported_ratio = CASE WHEN @can_be_reported_qty >= @total_src_lot_cons_nonsublot
								THEN 1
								ELSE @can_be_reported_qty / @total_src_lot_cons_nonsublot
								END

	-- STEP 3.0:
	-- Select orders that consumed selected lot_no and calculate ratio
	-- Select source cons record to report
	-- Calculate qty to report for each source cons row and insert to temp table
	DECLARE @cons_rows_to_report AS TABLE
	(
		src_cons_row_id INT
		,src_cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_cons_fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_cons_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_cons_fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_qty_cons FLOAT
		,src_qty_cons_erp FLOAT
		,src_cons_created_at_local DATETIME
		,spare1 NVARCHAR(40)
		,wip_wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
		,wip_created_at_utc DATETIME
	);

	WITH WoRatios AS (
    SELECT
        ic.wo_id,
        (SUM(qty_cons_erp) / @total_wip_lot_cons_qty_erp)
        / SUM((SUM(qty_cons_erp) / @total_wip_lot_cons_qty_erp)) OVER () AS ratio_norm
    FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.oper_id = ic.oper_id
	JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
    WHERE ic.lot_no = @fg_lot_no
      AND o.oper_id <> @oper_id
      AND o.process_id = @process_id
	  AND w.state_cd <> 3
    GROUP BY ic.wo_id
	HAVING SUM(qty_cons_erp)>0
	),
	ConsDetails AS (
		SELECT
        cr.cons_row_id,
        (cr.qty_cons - cr.qty_cons_erp) * @can_be_reported_ratio AS qty_cons,
		cr.created_at_utc
    FROM @cons_records cr
    WHERE
		cr.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND cr.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND cr.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no
	),
	Allocations AS (
		SELECT
			cd.cons_row_id,
			wr.wo_id,
			cd.qty_cons * wr.ratio_norm AS allocated_qty,
			created_at_utc
		FROM ConsDetails cd
		CROSS JOIN WoRatios wr
	)
	INSERT INTO @cons_rows_to_report(
		src_cons_row_id
		,src_cons_lot_no
		,src_cons_fg_lot_no
		,src_cons_sublot_no
		,src_cons_fg_sublot_no
		,src_qty_cons
		,src_qty_cons_erp
		,src_cons_created_at_local
		,spare1
		,wip_wo_id
		,wip_created_at_utc
	)
	SELECT
		a.cons_row_id,
		ic.lot_no,
		ic.fg_lot_no,
		ic.sublot_no,
		ic.fg_sublot_no,
		ic.qty_cons,
		ic.qty_cons_erp,
		ic.created_at_local,
		ROUND(allocated_qty, 3) AS allocated_qty,
		a.wo_id,
		a.created_at_utc
	FROM Allocations a
	JOIN item_cons ic
		ON ic.row_id=a.cons_row_id
	WHERE ROUND(allocated_qty, 3)>0
	ORDER BY row_id, wo_id;

	--If there is nothing to report (quantities are too small) postpone for next delay time
	IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @cons_rows_to_report) = 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ic
		SET last_edit_at = GETDATE()
		FROM item_cons ic
		JOIN @cons_records cr
			ON cr.cons_row_id=ic.row_id
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no
		--AND fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no

		--release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END

	-- STEP 4.0: Insert data into staging table
	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

		INSERT INTO ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported(
			[item_cons_row_id]
           ,[lot_no]
           ,[fg_lot_no]
           ,[sublot_no]
           ,[fg_sublot_no]
           ,[qty_cons]
           ,[qty_cons_erp]
           ,[spare1]
           ,[spare3]
           ,[last_edit_comment]
           ,[last_edit_at]
           ,[created_at_utc]
           ,[sap_reported_intermediate_item_cons_row_id]
           ,[sap_reported_wip_row_id]
           ,[sap_reported_wip_wo_id]
           ,[sap_reported_created_at_utc]
           ,[sap_reported_processed_id])
		SELECT 	 src_cons_row_id
				,src_cons_lot_no
				,src_cons_fg_lot_no
				,src_cons_sublot_no
				,src_cons_fg_sublot_no
				,src_qty_cons
				,src_qty_cons_erp
				,spare1
				,NULL
				,'INSERTED for EI Report of no sublot WIPs'						
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,0
				,NULL
				,wip_wo_id
				,wip_created_at_utc
				,NULL
		FROM @cons_rows_to_report
		
		DECLARE @output_rows INT

		-- STEP 4.1: Select as OUTPUT
		SELECT DISTINCT	 src_qty_cons
				,src_qty_cons_erp
				,src_cons_lot_no
				,src_cons_sublot_no
				,src_cons_row_id
				,spare1
				,NULL
				,src_cons_created_at_local
				,src_cons_fg_lot_no
				,src_cons_fg_sublot_no
		FROM @cons_rows_to_report

		SET @output_rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF @output_rows <= 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		END

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	--release applock
	EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
	IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		
	--release applock
	EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

	SELECT 	 @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE()
			,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
			,@error_state = ERROR_STATE();
				
	RAISERROR(   @error_msg
				,@error_severity
				,@error_state
			)
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sublot_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(
    @item_id             STRING40,
	@lot_no              STRING40,
	@sublot_no           STRING40,
    @user_id	         STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Sublot_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description			- Get Available attributes for a sublot
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 9 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM sublot_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
        item_id = @item_id  AND
        lot_no = @lot_no  AND
        sublot_no = @sublot_no)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 9 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM sublot_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
            item_id = @item_id  AND
            lot_no = @lot_no  AND
            sublot_no = @sublot_no)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tgeb_kpi_data_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[kpi_data]
AFTER DELETE
AS

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [Sp_S_ofi_Pack_Additives_BOM_Corr]
-- Description: Get all thos additives that need lot number
--
-- Usage: 	
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		Ajeet	2022-12-07			Initial version.
-- 2.00		JSC		2025-11-18			REFACTOR - Fixed Last_used_lot
-- 2.01		JSC		2025-11-19			Fix for intial run
-- 2.02		JSC		2025-12-08			Fixed to get last typed lot
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_S_ofi_Pack_Additives_BOM_Corr]
	@wo_id      NVARCHAR (40),
	@oper_id    NVARCHAR (40),
	@seq_no     INT,
	@is_manual  INT=0, -- 0:system, 1-Manual
	@useLastLot INT=0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @last_cons_lots TABLE
		(
			item_id    NVARCHAR(40),
			last_cons_lot NVARCHAR(40)
		)
		DECLARE @job_bom_lots TABLE
		(
			item_id    NVARCHAR(40),
			def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		)
	
	DECLARE @ItemGroup_attr_id INT
		,@MandatoryLot_attr_id INT
	DECLARE @result TABLE
		(
			item_id       NVARCHAR(40),
			item_desc     NVARCHAR(40),
			def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40),
			last_used_lot NVARCHAR(40),
			attr_value    NVARCHAR(40)
		)
	
	-- MOD v2.00
	DECLARE @PHCORRECTIONT TABLE 
		(
			item_id NVARCHAR(40)
		)
	
	--1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
	SELECT @ItemGroup_attr_id = a.attr_id
	FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
		AND a.attr_grp = 1
	
	-- added v2.00
	SELECT @MandatoryLot_attr_id = a.attr_id
	FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'IsLotMandatory'
		AND a.attr_grp = 1

	-- fix for missing @useLastLot
	SET @useLastLot = COALESCE(@useLastLot,0)
	
	-- added v2.00 get Max Correction step for this job
	DECLARE @MaxCorrStep INT
	SELECT @MaxCorrStep =  MAX(cb.correction_step)
	FROM ofi_cb_sample_results cb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE cb.wo_id = @wo_id
		AND cb.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND cb.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND cb.is_manual = @is_manual

		--insert into table variable 
	INSERT INTO @PHCORRECTIONT
	SELECT DISTINCT i.item_id		
	FROM cakeblend.Additives a WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ofi_cb_sample_results cb WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.Component IN (cb.phCorrectionType1, cb.phCorrectionType2, cb.phCorrectionType3, cb.phCorrectionType4)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = a.item_id 
	WHERE cb.wo_id = @wo_id
		AND cb.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND cb.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND cb.is_manual = @is_manual
		AND cb.correction_step = @MaxCorrStep

	-- v2.02 Modified to get the last TYPED lot number
	-- get the last lots for each correction item
	INSERT INTO @last_cons_lots (item_id, last_cons_lot)
	SELECT p.item_id, jb.def_lot_no
	FROM @PHCORRECTIONT p
	OUTER APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 jb.def_lot_no,jb.last_edit_at
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE p.item_id = jb.item_id
			AND jb.def_lot_no IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY jb.last_edit_at DESC
	) jb



	INSERT INTO @job_bom_lots
	SELECT DISTINCT p.item_id
		,jb.def_lot_no
	FROM @PHCORRECTIONT p
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = p.item_id
	WHERE jb.bom_pos <> 0
		AND jb.wo_id = @wo_id
		AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no

	--Only PIck thoses items from the correction
	INSERT INTO @result
	SELECT	p.item_id AS item_id,
			i.item_desc AS item_desc,
			CASE
				WHEN @useLastLot = 0
					THEN jb.def_lot_no
				WHEN @useLastLot = 1
					THEN ISNULL(t.last_cons_lot,jb.def_lot_no)
			END           AS def_lot_no,
			t.last_cons_lot    AS last_used_lot,
			ia2.attr_value AS attr_value
	FROM @PHCORRECTIONT p 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN @job_bom_lots jb ON p.item_id = jb.item_id												
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id 
													AND ia.attr_id = @MandatoryLot_attr_id
		INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id 
													AND ia2.attr_id = @ItemGroup_attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN @last_cons_lots t ON t.item_id = p.item_id
	WHERE ia.attr_value = 1 -- to be reviewed

	-- OUTPUT
	SELECT DISTINCT r.*
	FROM @result r


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Step]
	@wo_id string40,
	@oper_id string40,
	@seq_no int,
	@new_wo_id string40,
	@new_oper_id string40,
	@new_seq_no int
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_Step
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.35
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By		Ver.	Changes
-- 12/10/2003	Sheetal Jain	16035	(HD# 4219) Clone WO/Step Grp Repeatability
-- 06/16/2004	Raghu			2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 05/18/2005	Raghu			2.1.11	HD# 5673, Cloning a job_bom does not copy script or any other fields.
-- 09/30/2005	Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/15/2007	KRF				3.2.1	HD# 9222, part of DB changes - copy reqd_rep field when cloning record
-- 01/18/2007	KRF				3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 02/07/2007	KRF				3.2.1	HD# 9410, part of DB changes - commented out copying job_step.script_id
-- 10/24/2007	AML				3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--										dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/09/2008	Raghu			3.4.0	L00073400: Error when trying to clone a work order
-- 02/05/2008	AML				3.4.0	L00074730: Added insert statement to copy job_step_choice records.
-- 02/28/2008	AML				3.4.0	L00075483: Added js.wo_id = @new_wo_id to where clause for selected new key_id for
--												   steps in data_entry_sched.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	STRING40
	,@last_edit_at	DATETIME

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

BEGIN
--8.	Clone*** JOB_STEP table row(s)*.
	--copy JOB_STEP_GRP data
	INSERT INTO JOB_STEP_GRP(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq,repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM JOB_STEP_GRP
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	-- Adde "reqd_rep," 2 places in following sttatement 1/15/07 KRF
	INSERT INTO JOB_STEP (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time,
		complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, -- script_id,  Commented out 2/7/07 KRF
		data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep,
		control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning,
		spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time,
		complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, -- script_id,  Commented out 2/7/07 KRF
		data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep,
		control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning,
		spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM JOB_STEP
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	-- Added 02/05/2008 CR L00074730 to clone data_log_grp_job_step_link records....
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_step_link ( grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT grp_id, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_job_step_link
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074730 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	DECLARE @each_job_step_des TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime,
			step_no int
		)

	DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
			@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
			@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40), @t_last_edit_at datetime, @t_step_no int, @i int, @max_i int

	DELETE FROM @each_job_step_des

	INSERT INTO @each_job_step_des
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
		step_no
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT des.key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
		des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
		des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
		des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at, js.step_no
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN job_step js ON des.key_id = js.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 7 AND js.wo_id = @new_wo_id and js.oper_id = @new_oper_id

	SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_job_step_des

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @t_step_no = step_no FROM @each_job_step_des WHERE id = @i

		SELECT @t_key_id = js.row_id
		FROM job_step js
		WHERE js.wo_id = @new_wo_id AND js.oper_id = @new_oper_id AND js.step_no = @t_step_no

		SELECT	@t_key_type = 7, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
			,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
			,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
			,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
			,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
			,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
			,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		FROM @each_job_step_des
		WHERE id = @i

		INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
		(
			key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
			last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
			number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
			@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
			@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
			@last_edit_by,  @last_edit_at
		)

		SET @i = (@i + 1)
	END

	--copy the job_step_choice records
	INSERT INTO job_step_choice ( wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	FROM job_step_choice
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	--copy JOB_STEP_FILE data
	INSERT INTO JOB_STEP_FILE(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM JOB_STEP_FILE
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob_Qty] (
  @P_ent_id	   INT32,
  @P_user_id 	   STRING40,
  @P_wo_id	   STRING40,
  @P_oper_id	   STRING40,
  @P_seq_no	   INT32,
  @P_job_pos	   INT32 = 0,
  @P_status_notes  STRING2000_NULL = NULL,
  @P_check_privs   INT32 = NULL,
  @P_check_certs   INT32 = NULL,
  @P_Start_Qty     TFLOAT,
  @P_Qty_Reqd      TFLOAT_NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob_Qty
-- Description	      - HD#4932 - Create "StartSome" method.
--                      Start Job with only some of the quantities available. This is achieved by first splitting the job to the
--                      new required and start quantities and then starting that split job leaving behind the remainder of the
--                      quantities in the old job.
-- Author	      - SJ
-- Date Created	      - 11/05/2004
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.8
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @V_Qty_Reqd  TFLOAT,
  @V_Seq_No    INT32
BEGIN
  --Set required quantity to start quantity if null
  SET @V_Qty_Reqd = ISNULL(@P_Qty_Reqd, @P_Start_Qty)
  --Make sure that only valid values are processed
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  BEGIN
    --Split the job for the new start and required quantities
    --Get the next job sequence no
    EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_SplitJob @P_wo_id, @P_oper_id, @P_seq_no, @P_user_id, @V_Qty_Reqd, @V_Seq_No OUTPUT, @P_start_qty, NULL, NULL, @P_ent_id, NULL
    --Start the newly created job
    EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob @P_ent_id, @P_user_id, @P_wo_id, @P_oper_id, @V_Seq_No, @P_job_pos, @P_status_notes, @P_check_privs, @P_check_certs
  END
END

(
	@cust_id 		STRING40_NULL = NULL,

	@po_line_no 	INT32 OUTPUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_SA_PO_Line_GetNextPOLineNo
-- Description	  -	Returns the next available line number for a sales order
--			        New BR reqd doc (Customer Window Business Rules.doc) from Rich B
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  -	08/20/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 09/04/2007	  AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SELECT @po_line_no = ISNULL( MAX( po_line_no ), 0 ) + 1
	FROM po_line WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN po WITH (NOLOCK) ON po_line.po_id = po.po_id
	--WHERE cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id
	WHERE vend_id = @cust_id and po_line.po_id = @po_id

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:	[sp_sa_ofi_lm_printer_name]
-- Description: Get all printer value,displayText
--
-- Usage:	Get all printer value,displayText in printer information page
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-10-28			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-03-10			Added [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_getLangString] for lang localization
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_lm_printer_name] 
	 @printer_id NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
	,@in_use bit = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	 
		
		SELECT	 lpi.printer_row_id
				,lpi.printer_id
				,lpi.printer_desc
				,lpi.printer_status
				, case when lpi.printer_error='1' then [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100001 ,NULL,NULL)
					  else [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100006 ,NULL,NULL) END	--100006
					  as printer_error
				,case when lpi.printer_offline='0' then [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100002 ,NULL,NULL)--100002
					 else [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100007 ,NULL,NULL)END	--100007
					 as printer_offline
				,case when lpi.printer_driver_paused='0' then [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100003 ,NULL,NULL) --100003
					else [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100008 ,NULL,NULL) END --100008
					as printer_driver_paused
				,lpi.printer_niceLabel_driver
				,lpi.printer_spooler_status
				,lpi.printer_spooler_status_id
				,lpi.printer_no_of_jobs_spooler
				,lpi.printer_niceLabel_driver_ext_status
				,lpi.printer_inUse
				,case when lpi.printer_type=0 then [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100004 ,NULL,NULL)--100004
					  when lpi.printer_type=1 then [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100005 ,NULL,NULL)	--100005
					  END as printer_type
				--,lpi.printer_type as printer_type_id
		FROM [dbo].[ofi_lm_printer_information] lpi WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE (lpi.printer_id = @printer_id OR @printer_id IS NULL)
	AND (lpi.printer_inUse = @in_use OR @in_use IS NULL)

END

(

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CUD_item_grp_item]
(
@id NVARCHAR(50), --Autonumeric
@ItemGrpId NVARCHAR(50),
@ItemId NVARCHAR(50),
@order NVARCHAR(50),
@user_name NVARCHAR(50),
@deleteFlag bit
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @RowAvailable int

select @RowAvailable = id from SDB.SCH.item_grp_item where id = @id

if @deleteFlag = 0
BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null 
						BEGIN
						--code for insert

									INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_item]
											   ([ItemGrpId]
											   ,[ItemId]
											   ,[order]
											   ,[last_edit_date]
											   ,[last_edit_by]

										 VALUES
											   (@ItemGrpId
											   ,@ItemId
											   ,@order
											   ,getdate()
											   ,@user_name)

						BEGIN
								UPDATE [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_item]
								   SET [ItemGrpId] = @ItemGrpId
									  ,[ItemId] = @ItemId
									  ,[order] = @order
									  ,[last_edit_date] = getdate()
									  ,[last_edit_by] = @user_name
								 WHERE id = @id
						END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
			DELETE FROM  [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_item] WHERE id = @id
END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetBatchOfJobs]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@concurrent_link	INT32 = 0
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetBatchOfJobs
-- Description       - HD# 7764, Returns a recordset containing a batch of jobs
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/03/2006
-- Version           - 3.1.15
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--07/19/2017	Lorin		6.0		No modifications needed to fix SQL injection since all params are INT32 and used through CONVERT
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @sSQL 		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@sSQL_WHERE	NVARCHAR(4000)
/*	,@temp_SQL 	NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@sort_order	NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@order_by	NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@end		INT32*/

DECLARE  @temp_ent_id	INT32
	,@ent_list	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@parent_ent_id	INT32
	,@current_time	TDATETIME

/*DECLARE  @state_cd 	STRING80
	,@filter_value	STRING80*/

	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0), @concurrent_link = ISNULL(@concurrent_link, 0)
	IF (@concurrent_link = 0) SET @concurrent_link = NULL

	SET @sSQL = 'SELECT j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.item_id,j.state_cd,j.job_priority, j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @time_zone_bias_value) + ',j.req_finish_time_utc) req_finish_time,j.init_sched_ent_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.target_sched_ent_id,j.run_ent_id,j.qty_reqd,j.qty_prod,j.qty_prod_erp,j.qty_rejected,j.qty_rejected_erp,j.qty_at_start'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.deviation_above,j.deviation_below,j.batch_size,j.first_job,j.final_job,j.sched_pinned,j.check_inv,j.est_fixed_lab'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.est_lab_rate,j.est_setup_time,j.est_teardown_time,j.est_prod_rate,j.prod_uom,j.est_transfer_time,j.sched_start_time_utc, j.sched_start_time_local, DATEADD(mi,' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @time_zone_bias_value) + ',j.sched_start_time_utc) sched_start_time'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.latest_start_time_utc, j.latest_start_time_local, DATEADD(mi,' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @time_zone_bias_value) + ',j.latest_start_time_utc) latest_start_time, j.sched_finish_time_utc, j.sched_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @time_zone_bias_value) + ',j.sched_finish_time_utc) sched_finish_time'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.act_start_time_utc, j.act_start_time_local, DATEADD(mi,' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @time_zone_bias_value) + ',j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time,j.act_finish_time_utc, j.act_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @time_zone_bias_value) + ',j.act_finish_time_utc) act_finish_time,j.concurrent_link,j.job_cost'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.parent_contingent_job,j.child_contingent_job,j.notes,j.assoc_file,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(j.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type,j.status_notes,j.display_seq'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',j.folder_ver_id,j.rework,j.spare1,j.spare2,j.spare3,j.spare4,j.last_edit_comment,j.edited_by,j.edit_time,j.row_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',WO.wo_desc,WO.req_qty,WO.mo_id,I.item_desc,JS.state_desc,JS.color,E.ent_name'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',runent.ent_name as run_ent_name,i.spare1 item_spare1,i.spare2 item_spare2,i.spare3 item_spare3,i.spare4 item_spare4'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',i.lifetime,uom.description,uom.abbreviation,jb.def_lot_no,wo.process_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=wo.wo_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id=i.item_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd=js.state_cd'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id=e.ent_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN ent runent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id=runent.ent_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id=jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no=jb.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos=0'

--	SET @filter = '$$1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8$$$$CANCELLED=0$$$$COMPLETED=0$$$$WO_ID=$$$$OPER_ID=$$$$SEQ_NO=$$$$ITEM_ID=$$$$ITEM_DESC=$$'

	SET @ent_list = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id)

	SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	SET @temp_ent_id = @parent_ent_id
	IF (@parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL) SET @ent_list = @ent_list + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @parent_ent_id)

	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @temp_ent_id
		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) OR (@parent_ent_id IS NULL) BREAK
		IF @ent_list <> '' SET @ent_list = @ent_list + ','
		SET @ent_list = @ent_list + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @parent_ent_id)
		SET @temp_ent_id = @parent_ent_id
	END

	SET @sSQL_WHERE = ' WHERE'
	SET @sSQL_WHERE = @sSQL_WHERE + ' (j.target_sched_ent_id IN (' +  @ent_list + ') OR j.run_ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @ent_id) + ')'
	SET @sSQL_WHERE = @sSQL_WHERE + ' AND wo.state_cd<>3 AND (j.state_cd<>4 AND j.state_cd<>7)'
	SET @sSQL_WHERE = @sSQL_WHERE + ' AND j.concurrent_link=' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @concurrent_link), 'NULL')

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @sSQL_WHERE
--	PRINT @sSQL
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@ent_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Ent_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for a Entity (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific Entity)
-- Author	      - Rich
-- Date Created	      - 12/03/2009
-- Version                  - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 2 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM ent_attr WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 2 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM ent_attr WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Characteristic]
(
	@char_id INT32
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Characteristic
-- Description	      - Deletes a row of the table characteristic based on the char_id column value
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -	10/5/2010
-- Version	          - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--   24-Feb-2012   Ahmed		4.5		regen_samples flag of db_status has to be set when a future characteristic has to be deleted
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF EXISTS(SELECT top 1 sample_char_link_to_go.char_id FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = @char_id) AND (EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0))
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link_to_go.sample_id = sample_to_go.sample_id
						INNER JOIN sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_to_go.plan_id = sample_plan.plan_id
						INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = sample_char_link_to_go.char_id
						WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = @char_id
						AND CHARINDEX(characteristic.char_name, sample_to_go.sample_name, 1) > 0)
							BEGIN
								UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
							END
		END

	DELETE characteristic
	WHERE (char_id = @char_id OR @char_id IS NULL)

END
