----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--08/15/2003	Raghu		2.0.0	Included check for authenticating users with the session
--06/29/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed GetDate() to GMT Date and Time
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--04/13/2007    Raghu       	3.2.7   HD# 6590, Set the user_id in the session table to a null value; if a valid user_id is not supplied.
--01/08/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073497; Switch User does not switch to another user.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @num_ent_logons integer
	,@last_heartbeat TDATETIME

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X'  FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @session_id) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('The supplied Session ID is not valid{3448}', 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

IF (@user_id = '') SET @user_id = NULL

-- If authentication not done by calling method then we must check if this user has
-- logged onto any entities for this session or not
IF @auth_done = 0 BEGIN
	IF (@user_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @num_ent_logons = COUNT(*)
		FROM ent_logon
		WHERE session_id = @session_id AND user_id = @user_id
		IF (@num_ent_logons <= 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('This User has not logged onto any entities on this session{3236}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
END

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @time_zone_bias_value = 0 SET @last_heartbeat = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @last_heartbeat = GETUTCDATE()

-- Only get here if we CAN update the user_id for the session - ie. authentication has been done
UPDATE sessn
SET user_id = @user_id,
    last_heartbeat = @last_heartbeat
WHERE  (session_id = @session_id)

IF (@log_in = 1)	BEGIN
	UPDATE user_name SET last_login = @last_heartbeat , failed_logins = 0
	WHERE user_id = @user_id
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_job_data]
AS
SELECT job.wo_id,
       wo.wo_desc,
       wo.state_cd wo_state,
       job.oper_id,
       job.seq_no,
       job.job_desc,
       job.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.auto_reorder,
       job.state_cd,
       job_state.state_desc,
       job_state.color,
       job.job_priority,
       job.req_finish_time_utc,
       job.req_finish_time_local,
       job.init_sched_ent_id,
       sched_ent.ent_name sched_ent_name,
       sched_ent.description sched_ent_desc,
       job.target_sched_ent_id,
       target_ent.ent_name target_ent_name,
       target_ent.description target_ent_desc,
       job.run_ent_id,
       ent.ent_name run_ent_name,
       ent.description run_ent_desc,
       job_exec.job_pos,
       job.qty_reqd,
       job.qty_prod,
       job.qty_rejected,
       job.qty_at_start,
       job.batch_size,
       job.est_setup_time,
       job.est_teardown_time,
	CASE job.est_prod_rate
	   WHEN 0 THEN 0
	   ELSE
		   CASE job.prod_uom
			  WHEN 1 THEN job.est_prod_rate/60.0
			  WHEN 2 THEN job.est_prod_rate/3600.0
			  WHEN 3 THEN 1.0/job.est_prod_rate
			  WHEN 4 THEN (1.0/job.est_prod_rate)/60.0
			  WHEN 5 THEN (1.0/job.est_prod_rate)/3600.0
			  ELSE job.est_prod_rate
		   END
	END AS est_prod_rate,
       job.est_transfer_time,
       job.sched_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_start_time_local,
       job.latest_start_time_utc,
       job.latest_start_time_local,
       job.sched_finish_time_utc,
       job.sched_finish_time_local,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.notes,
       job.status_notes,
       job.rework,
       wo.process_id,
       wo.cust_info,
       item_prod.shift_start_utc,
       item_prod.shift_start_local
FROM job job
INNER JOIN item item ON job.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN job_state job_state ON
   job.state_cd = job_state.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON job.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent sched_ent ON
   job.init_sched_ent_id = sched_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent target_ent ON
   job.target_sched_ent_id = target_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN wo wo ON job.wo_id = wo.wo_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec job_exec ON
   job.run_ent_id = job_exec.ent_id AND
   job.wo_id = job_exec.cur_wo_id AND
   job.oper_id = job_exec.cur_oper_id AND
   job.seq_no = job_exec.cur_seq_no
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local FROM item_prod) item_prod ON
   job.wo_id = item_prod.wo_id

CREATE              PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Press_Theoretical_Prod] @wo_id as varchar(40), @oper_id as varchar(40),@seq_no int

  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_Press_Theoretical_Prod  -
-- Description:	    Return Theoretical press Production Quantity
--
-- Usage:			Sending Productioncake and ButterCake information to DCS 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-09-30						Find the  destination information
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
		Declare @cakefatperc float, @liquorfatperc float, @cons_liquor float, @prod_cake float, @buttercake float,
		@butterliquor float, @prod_butter float, @attr_grp_id int, @default_cakefatper float=0.5, @default_liquorfatper float=23,@default_cons_liquor float=1000

		select @attr_grp_id=grp_id from system_attr_grp with(nolock) where grp_desc='Custom App Setting'

		select @default_cakefatper=attr_value from system_attr with(nolock) where grp_id= @attr_grp_id and attr_desc='Cake Fat Percentage'
		select @default_liquorfatper=attr_value from system_attr with(nolock) where grp_id= @attr_grp_id and attr_desc='Liquor Fat Percentage'
		select @default_cons_liquor=attr_value from system_attr with(nolock) where grp_id= @attr_grp_id and attr_desc='Consumed Liquor'

		select @cakefatperc = @default_cakefatper,@liquorfatperc=@default_liquorfatper,@cons_liquor=@default_cons_liquor

		--Cake FAT Percentage -Calculated theoretical production quantity of cake 
		IF EXISTS(select 1 from sample s with(nolock)
		inner join result r with(nolock) on r.sample_id = s.sample_id
		inner join characteristic c with(nolock) on c.char_id = r.char_id
		where  s.wo_id=@wo_id  and s.oper_id=@oper_id and  s.seq_no=@seq_no and char_name='Moisture')
		Begin
		select @cakefatperc=r.result_value from sample s with(nolock)
		inner join result r with(nolock) on r.sample_id = s.sample_id
		inner join characteristic c with(nolock) on c.char_id = r.char_id
		where  s.wo_id=@wo_id  and s.oper_id=@oper_id and  s.seq_no=@seq_no and char_name='Moisture'
		End
		

		--Butter FAT Percentage -Calculated theoretical production quantity of butter 
		IF EXISTS(select 1 from sample s with(nolock)
		inner join result r with(nolock) on r.sample_id = s.sample_id
		inner join characteristic c with(nolock) on c.char_id = r.char_id
		where  s.wo_id=@wo_id  and s.oper_id=@oper_id and  s.seq_no=@seq_no and char_name='fat')
		BEGIN
		select @liquorfatperc=r.result_value from sample s with(nolock)
		inner join result r with(nolock) on r.sample_id = s.sample_id
		inner join characteristic c with(nolock) on c.char_id = r.char_id
		where  s.wo_id=@wo_id  and s.oper_id=@oper_id and  s.seq_no=@seq_no and char_name='fat'
		END
		
		

		--Get the quantity of consumed production from the liquor entity
		IF EXISTS(select 1 from item_cons ic 
		with(nolock) where ic.wo_id=@wo_id and ic.oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no)
		BEGIN
		select @cons_liquor=sum(qty_cons) from item_cons ic 
		with(nolock) where ic.wo_id=@wo_id and ic.oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no
		END
		
		

		--set @cons_liquor = 1000
		--set @cakefatperc = 0.5
		--set @liquorfatperc=23

		--Calculate the producted quantity of the cake
		set @prod_cake = (@cons_liquor-(@liquorfatperc/100 * @cons_liquor))/(1-(@cakefatperc/100))
		print @prod_cake
		set @buttercake = ( @prod_cake * (@cakefatperc/100))
		print @buttercake
		set @butterliquor = (@liquorfatperc * @cons_liquor/100)
		print @butterliquor
		--Calculate the producted quantity of the butter
		set @prod_butter = (@butterliquor - @buttercake)

		select @prod_cake as 'Produced_Cake', @prod_butter as 'Produced_Butter'

END

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneWO]
(
	@new_wo_id				STRING40,
	@existing_wo_id			STRING40,
	@user_id				STRING40,
	@req_qty				TFLOAT_NULL = NULL,
	@wo_desc				STRING80_NULL = NULL,
	@release_time_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@release_time_tz		INT32 = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_tz		INT32 = NULL,
	@wo_priority			INT32 = NULL,
	@cust_info				STRING80_NULL = NULL,
	@mo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@notes					NOTES_NULL = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneWO
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 2.1.0.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.--
-- 10/20/2004	SJ			2.1.5	HD#5061 Cannot clone a Work Order
-- 10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 12/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.7	Cloning a work order attribute should clone notes as well.
-- 09/15/2006	Raghu		3.1.22	HD# 8676, Jobs window/cloning a wo or a job
-- 01/15/2006	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8424, 9224, & 9248, part of DB changes - copy new fields when cloning.  Also
--									copy existing not_deletable and disassembly fields instead of setting both to false.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/10/2008	DRT			3.4.0	Changed a cut/paste error. Switched @release_time_utc to @req_finish_time_utc
-- 11/11/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- variables for WO table fields
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @l_wo_id				STRING40,
			@l_process_id			STRING40,
			@l_item_id				STRING40,
			@l_req_qty				TFLOAT,
			@l_wo_priority			INT32,
			-- variables for Job table fields
			@l_oper_id				STRING40,
			@l_seq_no				INT32,
			--variable to check user privileges
			@priv_id				INT32,
			@last_edit_by			STRING40,
			@last_edit_at			TDATETIME,
			@V_Seq					INT32,
			@V_Seq_Chk				INT32,
			@V_Oper_Id				STRING40,
			@V_Seq_No				INT32,
			@V_Feed_Seq				INT32,
			@current_time_utc		TDATETIME,
			@current_time_local		TDATETIME,
			-- Added following 9 lines 1/15/07
			@bom_ver_id				STRING40,
			@spec_ver_id			STRING40,
			@not_deletable			LOGICAL,
			@disassembly			LOGICAL,
			@may_override_route		LOGICAL,
			@spare1					STRING80,
			@spare2					STRING80,
			@spare3					STRING80,
			@spare4					STRING80,
			@release_time_utc		TDATETIME,
			@req_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME,
			@tz_temp				INT32,
			@dbg_resp				INT32

	  SET @release_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
	  SET @release_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@release_time_local, @release_time_tz)

      SET @req_finish_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
      SET @req_finish_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@req_finish_time_local, @req_finish_time_tz)

      SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneWO', @src_key='on_entry', @date_val1 = @release_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @release_time_tz
	, @date_val2 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val2 = @req_finish_time_tz

	--cehck whether @new_wo_id already exists
	SELECT @l_wo_id = wo_id FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id

	IF NOT(@l_wo_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--means @new_wo_id  found, so raise the error
		RAISERROR('The new Work Order already exists{3271}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	--TODO for @time_zone_bias_value (HF1432)
	SELECT	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
		,	@current_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @current_time_local, @tz_temp, @current_time_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@release_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @release_time_local, @tz_temp, @release_time_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@req_finish_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	-- Added "bom_ver_id, spec_ver_id," and
	-- ", not_deletable, disassembly, may_override_route, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4"
	-- to following statement 1/15/07 KRF
	DECLARE WO_Cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT	process_id, bom_ver_id, spec_ver_id, item_id, req_qty, wo_priority, not_deletable, disassembly,
				may_override_route, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
		FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id

	OPEN WO_Cursor
	-- Added "@bom_ver_id, @spec_ver_id," and
	-- ", @not_deletable, @disassembly, @may_override_route, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4"
	-- to following statement 1/15/07 KRF
	FETCH NEXT FROM WO_Cursor
	INTO	@l_process_id, @bom_ver_id, @spec_ver_id, @l_item_id, @l_req_qty, @l_wo_priority,
			@not_deletable, @disassembly, @may_override_route, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4

	IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		--before inserting into wo table, set the default values
		IF @req_qty IS NULL SET @req_qty = @l_req_qty
		IF @wo_desc IS NULL SET @wo_desc = @new_wo_id
		IF @release_time_utc IS NULL SET @release_time_utc = @current_time_utc
		IF @release_time_local IS NULL SET @release_time_local = @current_time_local
		IF @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL SET @req_finish_time_utc = DATEADD( DAY, 1, @current_time_utc )
		IF @req_finish_time_local IS NULL SET @req_finish_time_local = DATEADD( DAY, 1, @current_time_local )
		IF @wo_priority IS NULL SET @wo_priority = @l_wo_priority

		--insert the row into wo table
		-- Added bom_ver_id, spec_ver_id, may_override_route, spare1-4, @bom_ver_id, @spec_ver_id, @not_deletable,
		-- @disassembly, @may_override_route, and @spare1-4 in following statement 1/15/07 KRF
		INSERT INTO WO
		(
			wo_id, wo_desc, process_id, bom_ver_id, spec_ver_id, item_id, req_qty, release_time_utc, release_time_local,
			req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local, wo_priority, cust_info, mo_id, notes, not_deletable, disassembly,
			may_override_route, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@new_wo_id, @wo_desc, @l_process_id, @bom_ver_id, @spec_ver_id, @l_item_id, @req_qty, @release_time_utc,
			@release_time_local, @req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_local, @wo_priority, @cust_info, @mo_id, @notes,
			0, 0, @may_override_route, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		)

		--clone the work order attributes
		INSERT INTO wo_attr ( wo_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
		SELECT @new_wo_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM wo_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id

		--Clone Work Order File ONLY if the work order file does not exist for the destination work order.
		INSERT INTO wo_file ( wo_id, file_path, file_desc, file_type, last_modified, file_size, author, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
		SELECT @new_wo_id, file_path, file_desc, file_type, last_modified, file_size, author, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM wo_file WITH( NOLOCK )
		WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id AND file_path NOT IN (SELECT file_path FROM wo_file WITH( NOLOCK ) WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id)

		--sequence the operations and entities and store in add temporary table
		CREATE TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), ent_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER)

		SET @V_Seq = 0

		--Select all the operations and entities for the process and insert into temporary table
		DECLARE cur_ins_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id
			ORDER BY oper_id, seq_no  -- Added a.oper_id to ORDER BY clause 1/24/03 SJ

		OPEN cur_ins_ops
		FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @l_oper_id,@l_seq_no
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			SET @V_seq = @V_seq + 1
			INSERT INTO #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id, oper_id, ent_id, seq_no) VALUES(@existing_wo_id, @l_oper_id, @l_seq_no, @V_seq)
			FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @l_oper_id,@l_seq_no
		END

		CLOSE cur_ins_ops
		DEALLOCATE cur_ins_ops

		SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1

		WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1 BEGIN
			SET @V_Seq_Chk = 0

			DECLARE cur_seq_ops CURSOR DYNAMIC LOCAL FOR
				SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no
				FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
				WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id
				ORDER BY seq_no DESC

			OPEN cur_seq_ops
			FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @l_oper_id, @l_seq_no, @V_seq
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
				--check if any of the feeding operations are ahead in the sequence
				DECLARE cur_feeding_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR
					SELECT input_oper_id, input_seq_no
					FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id AND oper_id = @l_oper_id AND seq_no = @l_seq_no
					ORDER BY input_seq_no  -- Added ORDER BY clause 1/2/03 KRF

				OPEN cur_feeding_ops
				FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @V_oper_id, @V_Seq_No
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
					--get the feeding op's seq and compare
					SELECT @V_Feed_Seq = seq_no
					FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
					WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id AND oper_id = @V_oper_id AND ent_id = @V_seq_no

					--if feeding op's seq lesser interchange the sequence nos
					IF @V_Feed_Seq > @V_seq	BEGIN
						UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @V_seq WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id AND oper_id = @V_oper_id AND ent_id = @V_seq_no
						UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @V_Feed_Seq WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id AND oper_id = @l_oper_id AND ent_id = @l_Seq_No
						SET @V_seq = @V_Feed_Seq
						SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
					END  --End of @V_Feed_Seq > @seq_no

					FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @V_oper_id, @V_Seq_No
				END

				CLOSE cur_feeding_ops
				DEALLOCATE cur_feeding_ops

				FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @l_oper_id,@l_seq_no, @V_seq

			END

			CLOSE cur_seq_ops
			DEALLOCATE cur_seq_ops
		END  --End of WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1

		--clone the job and dependent rows
		DECLARE JOB_Cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT oper_id, ent_id
			FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
			WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo_id
			ORDER BY seq_no

		OPEN JOB_Cursor
		FETCH NEXT FROM JOB_Cursor INTO @l_oper_id,@l_seq_no
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			EXECUTE sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob @existing_wo_id,@l_oper_id,@l_seq_no,@user_id,@new_wo_id,@l_oper_id,@l_seq_no, @req_qty
			FETCH NEXT FROM JOB_Cursor INTO @l_oper_id,@l_seq_no
		END

		CLOSE JOB_Cursor
		DEALLOCATE JOB_Cursor

	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--means @existing_wo_id not found, so raise the error
		RAISERROR('The Work Order to be cloned does not exist{3272}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	CLOSE WO_Cursor
	DEALLOCATE WO_Cursor

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Pred_Msg]
(@id  int  ,
 @subject  nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Pred_Msg
-- Description    - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created   - 4/2/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
-- Notes          -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 01/19/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT pred_msg.id
       ,pred_msg.recipients
       ,pred_msg.subject
       ,pred_msg.message
       ,pred_msg.last_edit_comment
       ,pred_msg.last_edit_by
       ,pred_msg.last_edit_at
FROM pred_msg pred_msg WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((pred_msg.id = @id OR @id IS NULL) AND
       (pred_msg.subject = @subject OR @subject IS NULL) AND
       (pred_msg.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (pred_msg.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on util_raw_reas table to update

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE util_raw_reas SET util_raw_reas.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, util_raw_reas.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE @last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
	, @sample_time_local	TDATETIME2
	, @shift_id		INT32
	, @shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	, @shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	, @created_at_utc	TDATETIME
	, @created_at_local	TDATETIME

BEGIN
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	SELECT @sample_time_utc = COALESCE(@sample_time_utc, @last_edit_at), @created_at_utc = @last_edit_at
	SELECT @sample_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @sample_time_utc), @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)

	IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC

		SELECT @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0), @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01'))
			, @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01'))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CUD_Line_Speed]
(
@user_name nvarchar(50),
@item_id nvarchar(50),
@ent_id int,
@line_Speed int,
@row_id int,
@deleteFlag bit
)
AS
BEGIN

	declare @RowAvailable int
	select @RowAvailable = row_id from SDB.SCH.item_ent_speed where row_id = @row_id
	
	if @deleteFlag = 0
	BEGIN 
		if @RowAvailable is null 
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO SDB.SCH.item_ent_speed

				line_speed)

		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	DELETE FROM  [SDB].[SCH].[item_ent_speed] WHERE row_id = @row_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCertsByJob]
(@wo_id		STRING80 = NULL
,@oper_id	STRING80 = NULL
,@seq_no	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCertsByJob
-- Description       - Returns a recordset of all sign off certifications that are required for the supplied job.
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 04/22/2005
-- Version           - 2.1.20
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 04/06/2006	Raghu		3.1.14		HD# 7951, Item certifications always checked for final product, not intermediate ones
-- 12/07/2017	Varun		6.0			Merge CR L00147330 (HF L00146188): Added union to cert_job_link.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	SELECT x.* FROM
	(SELECT col.cert_name, col.cert_level, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), NULL) audited_by,
		CONVERT(DATETIME, NULL) audit_date, ct.signoff_notes,
		ISNULL(ct.num_signoffs_reqd, 1) num_signoffs_reqd, ct.comments_reqd,
		CONVERT(NVARCHAR(254), NULL) comments
	FROM cert_oper_link col
	INNER JOIN cert_type ct ON col.cert_name = ct.cert_name
	INNER JOIN wo ON wo.process_id = col.process_id
	INNER JOIN job j ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id AND col.oper_id = j.oper_id
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND col.cert_level > 0 AND ct.cert_audit = 1
	UNION
	SELECT cjl.cert_name, cjl.cert_level, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), NULL) audited_by,
		CONVERT(DATETIME, NULL) audit_date, ct.signoff_notes,
		ISNULL(ct.num_signoffs_reqd, 1) num_signoffs_reqd, ct.comments_reqd,
		CONVERT(NVARCHAR(254), NULL) comments
	FROM cert_job_link cjl
	INNER JOIN cert_type ct ON cjl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
	WHERE cjl.wo_id = @wo_id AND cjl.oper_id = @oper_id AND cjl.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND cjl.cert_level > 0 AND ct.cert_audit = 1
	UNION
	SELECT cil.cert_name, cil.cert_level, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), NULL) audited_by,
		CONVERT(DATETIME, NULL) audit_date, ct.signoff_notes,
		ISNULL(ct.num_signoffs_reqd, 1) num_signoffs_reqd, ct.comments_reqd,
		CONVERT(NVARCHAR(254), NULL) comments
	FROM cert_item_link cil
	INNER JOIN cert_type ct ON cil.cert_name = ct.cert_name
	INNER JOIN job ON job.item_id = cil.item_id
--	INNER JOIN wo ON wo.item_id = cil.item_id
	WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND job.oper_id = @oper_id AND job.seq_no = @seq_no
--	WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND cil.cert_level > 0 AND ct.cert_audit = 1) x
	ORDER BY x.cert_name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_File]
(
	@ent_id  int  ,
	@file_path  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@file_desc  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@file_type  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@last_modified  datetime  ,
	@file_size  int  ,
	@author  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@last_edit_at  datetime ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Ent_File
-- Description			- Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created			- 10/17/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
-- Notes				-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 09/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/31/2007		AML				3.2.0		DB Changes
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @last_modified IS NOT NULL SET @last_modified = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @last_modified)

SELECT	ent_file.ent_id
	,	ent_file.file_path
	,	ent_file.file_desc
	,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(ent_file.file_path) AS file_type
	,	ent_file.last_modified
	,	ent_file.file_size
	,	ent_file.author
	--	Added 07/31/2007 AML
	,	ent_file.spare1
	,	ent_file.spare2
	,	ent_file.spare3
	,	ent_file.spare4
	--
	,	ent_file.last_edit_comment
	,	ent_file.last_edit_by
	,	ent_file.last_edit_at
FROM ent_file ent_file	WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((ent_file.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.file_path = @file_path OR @file_path IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.file_desc = @file_desc OR @file_desc IS NULL) AND
       (dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(ent_file.file_path) = @file_type OR @file_type IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.last_modified = @last_modified OR @last_modified IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.file_size = @file_size OR @file_size IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.author = @author OR @author IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (ent_file.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_job_event_data]
AS
SELECT job_event.event_time_utc,
       job_event.event_time_local,
       job_event.wo_id,
       job_event.oper_id,
       job_event.seq_no,
       job_event.step_no,
       job_step.step_desc,
       job_event.event_type,
       job_event.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       ent.description,
       job_event.bom_pos,
       job_event.lot_no,
       job_event.sublot_no,
       job_event.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       job_event.cert_name,
       job_event.done_by_user_id,
       done_by_user.user_desc done_by_user_desc,
       job_event.checked_by_user_id,
       checked_by_user.user_desc checked_by_user_desc,
       job_event.source_row_id,
       job_event.spec_id,
       job_event.comments,
       job_event.value1,
       job_event.value2,
       job_event.value3,
       job_event.value4,
       job_event.value5,
       job_event.value6,
       job_event.value7,
       job_event.value8,
       job_event.value9,
       job_event.value10,
       item_prod.shift_start_utc,
       item_prod.shift_start_local
FROM job_event job_event
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step job_step ON
   job_event.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
   job_event.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND
   job_event.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
   job_event.step_no = job_step.step_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON job_event.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item ON job_event.item_id = item.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name done_by_user ON
   job_event.done_by_user_id = done_by_user.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name checked_by_user ON
   job_event.checked_by_user_id = checked_by_user.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local FROM item_prod) item_prod ON
	item_prod.wo_id = job_event.wo_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_MDM_Sched_GenResItemFromSession]
	
	@sessionID int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @item_id varchar(50)

	Declare @ent_id int

	

	DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR  
	SELECT item_id,job_sched_entity_id
		FROM sdb..scheduler_exec 
			WHERE session_id=@sessionID  

	OPEN db_cursor   
	FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @item_id,@ent_id

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
	BEGIN   
		if not exists(select * from [SDB].[SCH].[res_item] where item_id=@item_id and ent_id=@ent_id)
		BEGIN

			-- Script to add entities based on Job Positions -- Working Script -- Parent Child relationships
					--insert into  sdb.sch.shared_ent (ent_id, alt_ent_id, last_edit_at, last_edit_by)
					--select e.parent_ent_id, ia.ent_id, getdate(), 'dbo' from ent_attr ia
					--inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id and attr_desc like '%jobpositions%' 
					--inner join ent e on e.ent_id = ia.ent_id
					--where not exists (select 1 from sdb.sch.shared_ent where ent_id = e.parent_ent_id and alt_ent_id = ia.ent_id)

			insert into [SDB].[SCH].[res_item] ( [ent_id],[item_id],[last_edit_at],[last_edit_by]) values(@ent_id,@item_id,getdate(),'autogen')


		END
	   

	   
			-- Insert the records for all shared entities from the table SDB.SCH.shared_ent
			Insert into [SDB].[SCH].[res_item]  ( [ent_id],[item_id],[last_edit_at],[last_edit_by]) 
			select alt_ent_id, @item_id, getdate(),'autogen' from SDB.SCH.shared_ent SE where ent_id = @ent_id and 
				not exists (select 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[res_item] RI where RI.ent_id =  SE.alt_ent_id 
																				and RI.item_id = @item_id)
					
			-- Added 15022018 to insert parent child entities
			Insert into [SDB].[SCH].[res_item]  ( [ent_id],[item_id],[last_edit_at],[last_edit_by])
			select ia.ent_id, @item_id, getdate(), 'autogen' from ent_attr ia
			inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id and attr_desc like '%jobpositions%' 
			inner join ent e on e.ent_id = ia.ent_id
			where e.parent_ent_id = @ent_id and 
			not exists (select 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[res_item] RI where RI.ent_id =  ia.ent_id 
																		and RI.item_id = @item_id)


       FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @item_id,@ent_id  
	END   

	CLOSE db_cursor   
	DEALLOCATE db_cursor 
END

									  , lot_no
									--  , row_id
										, prod.item_id
										, i.item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(prod.lot_no, 0) as item_desc
									  
									  , @sfg_source --source
									  , @destination
									  , @id -- id
									  , 0 as 'processed'
								FROM item_prod prod WITH(NOLOCK)
								inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on prod.item_id=i.item_id
								WHERE prod.item_id = @sfg_item_id and prod.lot_no=@sfg_lot_no

								--AND jb.aaObsolete=0
								GROUP BY
									prod.wo_id
								  , prod.seq_no
								  , prod.lot_no
								  , prod.oper_id
								  , prod.item_id
								  , item_Desc
							SET @destination = @destination + 1
							
						FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
													, @sfg_lot_no
													, @sfg_qty
													, @sfg_oper_id
				END --end while cursor

						CLOSE sfg_item
						DEALLOCATE sfg_item

						
				END -- end while #fg_wo
				
				
			END -- end else FG
		END	
			SELECT DISTINCT
				id
			  , material AS       name
			  , ISNULL(qty, 0) AS value
			  , source
			  , destination AS    target
			FROM @childTableInvValidation
			WHERE material IS NOT NULL

		
end

          EXECUTE SP_Build_Alt_BOM @session_id, @wo_id, @process_id, @item_id, @req_qty, @start_qty, @req_finish_time, @oper_id, @seq_no

        CLOSE stack_cursor

        DROP TABLE #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK

--      DROP TABLE #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty
      --Allocate job quantities based on BOM

      --Determine finish and latest start time for each job

--    Create all possible entity substitutions
    END  -- of "if sp_build_job_nonalphabetical succeeds"
  END -- of "if it's a valid process"
  SET @done_one_process = 1
  IF @defined_process = 0  FETCH process_cur INTO @process_id -- Fetch next process if not defined for this WO
END -- of " WHILE(@defined_process = 1 AND @done_one_process = 0) OR @@FETCH_STATUS = 0"
IF @defined_process = 0 BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT OFF
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_StartSome]
(@session_id	INT32
,@user_id	STRING40
,@ent_id	INT32
,@wo_id		STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@seq_no	INT32 OUTPUT
,@qty_at_start	TFLOAT
,@status_notes	VARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,@check_privs	INT32 = NULL
,@check_certs	INT32 = NULL
,@job_pos	INT32 = NULL
,@qty_reqd	TFLOAT = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32
,@new_seq_no	INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Job_Exec_StartSome
-- Description	      - Splits the supplied job and starts the split job in the current transaction.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 07/18/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.19
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 07/21/2006	  Raghu			3.1.20	Supply the job_pos as NULL; let the SP_U_JOB_EXEC_STARTBATCHJOBS determine the available job position.
--04/26/2007      Raghu         3.2.9   HD# 9770; Start Some not logging user into Job
--01/06/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073510; Error while using StartSome
--02/08/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074688; BETA2: Auto-job split is not allocating quantities from the parent job to the split upon entering production, therefore generating an error
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @job_based_login		INT32
		,@allow_zero_qty_split	INT32
		,@ignore_zero_start_qty_check INT32

BEGIN
	--Apply all defaults.
	SELECT @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 0), @check_certs = COALESCE(@check_certs, 0)
		,@job_pos = COALESCE(@job_pos, 0), @qty_at_start = COALESCE(@qty_at_start, 0)
		,@qty_reqd = COALESCE(@qty_reqd, 0), @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,@ignore_zero_start_qty_check = 0

	--Default qty_reqd to qty_at_start if qty_reqd is 0.
	IF (@qty_reqd = 0) SET @qty_reqd = @qty_at_start

	--Verify whether the qty_at_start is zero.
	IF (@qty_at_start <= 0)  BEGIN
		--The supplied qty_at_start is zero. Verify whether the job_exec entity allows a qty of zero to be splitted
		--among verious jobs.
		SELECT @allow_zero_qty_split = je.allow_zero_qty_split
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND je.job_pos = 0

		IF (@allow_zero_qty_split = 0) BEGIN
			--The job_exec entity does not allow jobs to be splitted with start_qty zero.
			--Raise an exception to the caller.
			RAISERROR ('The start quantity can not be less than zero.{5609}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE SET @ignore_zero_start_qty_check = 1
	END

	--Call split job to split the job with the supplied parameters.
	EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_SplitJob @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @orig_seq_no=@seq_no,
		@user_id=@user_id, @split_qty=@qty_reqd, @new_seq_no=@new_seq_no OUTPUT,
		@split_start_qty=@qty_at_start, @new_state_cd=NULL, @req_finish_time=NULL,
		@target_ent_id=NULL, @status_notes=@status_notes, @ignore_zero_start_qty_check=@ignore_zero_start_qty_check,
		@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

	--Some of the calling application is looking for the seq_no variable; Additionally return the seq_no value via seq_no variable
	SET @seq_no = @new_seq_no

	--Start the split job automatically.
	EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
		@seq_no=@new_seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=@status_notes, @check_privs=@check_privs,
		@check_certs=@check_certs, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

	--Verify whether this user is logged in using job based login.
	SELECT @job_based_login = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
	FROM grp_priv_link gpl
	INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
	WHERE gpl.priv_id = 92 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

	IF (@job_based_login = 1)
	    --This user belongs to job based login group. Log this user to this job automatically.
		EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_LogonJob @session_id=@session_id, @user_id=@user_id,
			@ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id,
			@oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@new_seq_no,
			@status_notes=@status_notes, @cur_lab_cd=NULL,
			@cur_lab_dept_id=NULL, @pct_lab_to_apply=NULL,
			@logon_time=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetComplsNos]
(
		@wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no          STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL

) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_GETCOMPLSNOS
-- Description    - Case: 7.4.1 - Available to produce SNO's. Returns a list of completed serial nos.
--                  7.4.3.1 - Show Completed SNO's
--                  When the second (Completed) is selected, only those serial numbers that have been
--                  completed at the current operation (i.e. have item_prod records totaling 1 for the
--                  current work order and operation) will be shown.  Additionally, if "linear flow" is true
--                  for this work order, serial numbered completed at the current operation are not shown
--                  when the "Completed" button is selected if they have already been consumed
--                  at the next downstream operation, since the user would not be allowed
--                  to uncomplete these even if he had the "uncomplete" privilege.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 03/06/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 08/31/2007		AML		3.3.0	Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @may_override_route AS BIT

    --Verify whether the linear flow is enabled for this work order.
    SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
    FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

    IF (@may_override_route = 1) BEGIN
        --Returns a list of completed serial nos where the qty equals 1.
        SELECT completed_snos.serial_no
            ,last_modified_item_prod.reas_cd
            ,ir.reas_desc
            ,completed_snos.qty_prod
        FROM
            (SELECT ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, ip.item_id, ip.lot_no AS serial_no
                ,ISNULL(SUM(qty_prod), 0) AS qty_prod
            FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
              AND oper_id = @oper_id
              AND seq_no = @seq_no
              AND item_id = @item_id
            GROUP BY ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, ip.item_id, ip.lot_no
            ) AS completed_snos
            INNER JOIN
                (SELECT ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, ip.item_id, ip.lot_no AS serial_no, ip.reas_cd
                FROM item_prod ip
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND item_id = @item_id
                  AND ip.last_edit_at = (SELECT MAX(last_edit_at) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = ip.wo_id AND oper_id = ip.oper_id  AND seq_no = ip.seq_no AND item_id = ip.item_id AND lot_no = ip.lot_no)
                ) AS last_modified_item_prod
            ON completed_snos.wo_id = last_modified_item_prod.wo_id
            AND completed_snos.oper_id = last_modified_item_prod.oper_id
            AND completed_snos.seq_no = last_modified_item_prod.seq_no
            AND completed_snos.item_id = last_modified_item_prod.item_id
            AND completed_snos.serial_no = last_modified_item_prod.serial_no
        INNER JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON last_modified_item_prod.reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
        WHERE completed_snos.qty_prod = 1
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        --The may_override_route is set to false; or the user does not have a privilege to uncomplete a completed serial no.
        --Returns a list of completed serial nos where the qty equals 1.
        SELECT completed_snos.serial_no
            ,last_modified_item_prod.reas_cd
            ,ir.reas_desc
            ,completed_snos.qty_prod
        FROM
            (SELECT ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, ip.item_id, ip.lot_no AS serial_no
                ,ISNULL(SUM(qty_prod), 0) AS qty_prod
             FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
             WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
              AND oper_id = @oper_id
              AND seq_no = @seq_no
              AND item_id = @item_id
			  --Additionally, if "linear flow" is true for this work order, serial numbered completed at the current operation are not shown
              --when the "Completed" button is selected if they have already been consumed
              --at the next downstream operation, since the user would not be allowed
              --to uncomplete these even if he had the "uncomplete" privilege.
			  AND NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_route jr ON ic.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ic.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND ic.seq_no = jr.seq_no
					WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
					  AND jr.input_oper_id = @oper_id
					  AND jr.input_seq_no = @seq_no
					  AND ic.item_id = @item_id
					GROUP BY ic.wo_id, ic.oper_id, ic.seq_no, ic.item_id, ic.lot_no
					HAVING ISNULL(SUM(qty_cons), 0) = 1
			  )
			  GROUP BY ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, ip.item_id, ip.lot_no
			  HAVING ISNULL(SUM(qty_prod), 0) = 1
            ) AS completed_snos
            INNER JOIN
                (SELECT ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, ip.item_id, ip.lot_no AS serial_no, ip.reas_cd
                FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND item_id = @item_id
                  AND ip.last_edit_at = (
					SELECT MAX(last_edit_at)
					FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = ip.wo_id AND oper_id = ip.oper_id AND
						  seq_no = ip.seq_no AND item_id = ip.item_id AND lot_no = ip.lot_no
				  )
                ) AS last_modified_item_prod
            ON completed_snos.wo_id = last_modified_item_prod.wo_id
            AND completed_snos.oper_id = last_modified_item_prod.oper_id
            AND completed_snos.seq_no = last_modified_item_prod.seq_no
            AND completed_snos.item_id = last_modified_item_prod.item_id
            AND completed_snos.serial_no = last_modified_item_prod.serial_no
        INNER JOIN item_reas ir ON last_modified_item_prod.reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
        WHERE completed_snos.qty_prod = 1
    END

END

CREATE FUNCTION crc16(@data VARCHAR(MAX))
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @crc INT = 0xFFFF
    DECLARE @len INT = LEN(@data)
    DECLARE @i INT = 1
    DECLARE @ch CHAR(1)
    
    WHILE @len > 0
    BEGIN
        SET @ch = SUBSTRING(@data, @i, 1)
        SET @crc = @crc ^ ASCII(@ch)
        
        DECLARE @j INT = 0
        WHILE @j < 8
        BEGIN
            IF (@crc & 1) = 1
            BEGIN
                SET @crc = (@crc / POWER(2, 1)) ^ 0xA001
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                SET @crc = (@crc / POWER(2, 1))
            END
            SET @j = @j + 1
        END
        
        SET @len = @len - 1
        SET @i = @i + 1
    END
    
    RETURN @crc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetAvailableLineEnts]
(@ent_name	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@description	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@can_store	BIT = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_SA_Ent_GetAvailableLineEnts
-- Description		- UserStory: 355404 - The purpose of this stored procedure is to return entities that can be added to a line.
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 07/10/2014
-- Version			- 5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
--08/14/2014	Raghu		5.0	UserStory:381930 - [Stored Proc] As Michelle I want to enforce constraints for entities assigned to a Line: require a default production rate and Identical Job Positions<=1 so the user does not config a line with illegal entities (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	SELECT ents.*
	FROM
	(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description, el.parent_ent_id
		, CASE WHEN e.parent_ent_id = el.parent_ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preferred_parent
		, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_capture_util, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_do_dnc, e.can_track_oee, e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_store
		, e.can_log_data, e.can_ship, e.can_receive, e.can_copy_folders, e.can_capture_qm_data
		, e.spare1, e.spare2, e.spare3, e.spare4, e.identical_job_execs, e.last_edit_at
		, CASE WHEN e.can_sched_jobs = 1 AND e.can_run_jobs = 1 AND e.can_capture_util = 1 AND e.can_track_oee = 1 AND e.identical_job_execs <= 1
			    AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oee_exec oee WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oee.ent_id = e.ent_id AND oee.def_prod_rate IS NOT NULL)
			    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.ent_id = e.ent_id)
			    AND ((@ent_name IS NOT NULL AND e.ent_name LIKE @ent_name) OR @ent_name IS NULL)
			    AND ((@description IS NOT NULL AND e.description LIKE @description) OR @description IS NULL)
			    AND ((@can_store IS NOT NULL AND e.can_store = @can_store) OR @can_store IS NULL)
			   THEN 1
			   ELSE 0
			   END exact_match
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.child_ent_id) ents
	WHERE ents.exact_match = 1
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_oper_link_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[cert_oper_link]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_cert_oper_link_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on cert_oper_link table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/16/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--03/03/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 2527). Donot allow to delete a certificate attached to a running job
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process p INNER JOIN deleted d ON p.process_id = d.process_id
				WHERE process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},cert_oper_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo INNER JOIN job j ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id
		INNER JOIN deleted d ON d.oper_id = j.oper_id AND d.process_id = wo.process_id WHERE j.state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Cannot delete this certificate, because a job attached to this certificate is currently running.{4735}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	WHERE process_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT process_id FROM deleted)

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_job_status_data]
AS
SELECT job.wo_id,
       wo.wo_desc,
       wo.state_cd wo_state,
       wo.mo_id,
       wo.process_id,
       process.process_desc,
       wo.cust_info,
       job.oper_id,
       oper.oper_desc,
       job.seq_no,
       job.job_desc,
       job.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.auto_reorder,
       job.state_cd,
       job_state.state_desc,
       job_state.color,
       job.job_priority,
       job.req_finish_time_utc,
       job.req_finish_time_local,
       job.init_sched_ent_id,
       sched_ent.ent_name sched_ent_name,
       sched_ent.description sched_ent_desc,
       job.target_sched_ent_id,
       target_ent.ent_name target_ent_name,
       target_ent.description target_ent_desc,
       job.run_ent_id,
       ent.ent_name run_ent_name,
       ent.description run_ent_desc,
       job_exec.job_pos,
       job.qty_reqd,
       job.qty_prod,
       job.qty_rejected,
       job.qty_at_start,
       job.batch_size,
       job.sched_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_start_time_local,
       job.latest_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_finish_time_local,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.notes,
       job.status_notes,
       job.rework
FROM job job
INNER JOIN wo wo ON job.wo_id = wo.wo_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN process process ON
   wo.process_id = process.process_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN oper oper ON
   job.oper_id = oper.oper_id AND
   wo.process_id = oper.process_id
INNER JOIN item item ON job.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN job_state job_state ON
   job.state_cd = job_state.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON job.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent sched_ent ON
   job.init_sched_ent_id = sched_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent target_ent ON
   job.target_sched_ent_id = target_ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec job_exec ON
   job.run_ent_id = job_exec.ent_id AND
   job.wo_id = job_exec.cur_wo_id AND
   job.oper_id = job_exec.cur_oper_id AND
   job.seq_no = job_exec.cur_seq_no

(

	,	@std_oper_id	 		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id		 		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no		 			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_desc	 			STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id		 		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@state_cd	 			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@ent_id		 			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@qty_reqd	 			TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@qty_at_start 			TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@display_seq			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_I_Job_Exec_CrtJobsFromStdOp
-- Description	      - HD# 7793 Creates jobs from a standard operation.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 07/11/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.19
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--02/15/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--03/01/2007	Raghu		3.2.2	HD# 9469, Jobs window/ adding std op's to work orders
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change *_time with *_utc and *_local.
--01/09/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073663; Issue while creating jobs from a standard operation.
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 11/11/2009   Kishore  4.1   HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
--01/18/2010	Vinit		4.1.0	HF1432 Fix/changes
--10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6       spc_char_job and spc_char_std_oper_link are removed from the database
--02/17/2012	Srinivasa    5.3       US#731911-Converted the ent_id and seq_no fields into nvarchar while forming the error message
-- 12/07/2017	Varun		6.0		Merge CR L00147330 (HF L00146188): Added inserts to cert_job_link and cert_job_step_link.
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @err_msg				STRING254_NULL
		,	@check_inv				LOGICAL
		,	@deviation_above		TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@deviation_below		TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@assoc_file				STRING254_NULL
		,	@assoc_file_type		STRING80_NULL
		,	@est_fixed_lab			TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@est_lab_rate			TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@est_setup_time			TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@est_teardown_time		TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@est_prod_rate			TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@prod_uom			INT32
		,	@batch_size				TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@est_transfer_time		TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@init_prod_pct			TFLOAT_NULL
		,	@row_cnt				INT32_NULL
		,	@last_edit_at 			TDATETIME_NULL
		,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL
		,	@V_Client_Info			STRING40_NULL
		,	@created_at				TDATETIME_NULL

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	--Verify whether the supplied work order already exists. If not raise an error to the caller.
	IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'Work Order Id: ' + COALESCE(@wo_id, '')
		RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied standard oper entity already exists for the supplied standard operation.
	--If not, raise an error to the caller.
	IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM std_oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id ) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566}, Entity Id: ' + COALESCE(CAST(@ent_id as nvarchar(25)), '') + ' for the standard operation Id: ' + COALESCE(@std_oper_id, '')
		RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied job already exist in the database. If yes, then throw an error to the caller.
	IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no ) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 already exist in the database.{4675},job (wo_id: ' + COALESCE(@wo_id, '') + ', oper_id: ' + COALESCE(@oper_id, '') + ', seq_no: ' + COALESCE(CAST(@seq_no as nvarchar(80)), '')  + ')'
		RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Retrieve defaults from std_oper (related to an operation)
	SELECT	@check_inv = check_inv, @deviation_above = deviation_above, @deviation_below = deviation_below
		,	@assoc_file = assoc_file, @assoc_file_type = assoc_file_type
	FROM std_oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	--Retrieve defaults from std_oper_ent_link
	SELECT	@est_fixed_lab = est_fixed_lab, @est_lab_rate = est_lab_rate, @est_setup_time = est_setup_time
		,	@est_teardown_time = est_teardown_time, @est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate, @prod_uom = prod_uom
		,	 @batch_size = batch_size
		,	@est_transfer_time = est_transfer_time, @init_prod_pct = init_prod_pct
	FROM std_oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id

	--Create a job using possible defaults
        --07/17/2009 RWB Added null values for the new seqgment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters.
        --CR L00098022 - remove segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters.  Pass 0 for rework bit
    EXEC sp_I_Job @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
              @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_desc=@job_desc,
              @item_id=@item_id, @state_cd=@state_cd, @job_priority=1, @req_finish_time_local=NULL, @req_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @init_sched_ent_id=@ent_id, @target_sched_ent_id=@ent_id, @run_ent_id=NULL,
              @qty_reqd=@qty_reqd, @qty_prod=NULL, @qty_prod_erp=NULL, @qty_rejected=NULL, @qty_rejected_erp=NULL,
              @qty_at_start=@qty_at_start, @deviation_above=@deviation_above,
              @deviation_below=@deviation_below, @batch_size=NULL,
              @first_job=NULL, @final_job=NULL, @sched_pinned=NULL, @check_inv=@check_inv, @est_fixed_lab=@est_fixed_lab, @est_lab_rate=@est_lab_rate,
              @est_setup_time=@est_setup_time, @est_teardown_time=@est_teardown_time, @est_prod_rate=@est_prod_rate,
              @prod_uom=@prod_uom, @est_transfer_time=@est_transfer_time, @sched_start_time_local=NULL, @sched_start_time_tz=NULL,
              @latest_start_time_local=NULL, @latest_start_time_tz=NULL, @sched_finish_time_local=NULL, @sched_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @act_start_time_local=NULL, @act_start_time_tz=NULL,  @act_finish_time_local=NULL,  @act_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @concurrent_link=NULL, @job_cost=NULL, @parent_contingent_job=NULL, @child_contingent_job=NULL, @notes=NULL,
              @assoc_file=@assoc_file, @status_notes=NULL, @display_seq=@display_seq,
              @folder_ver_id=NULL, @rework=0, @rework_cd=NULL, @rework_process_id=NULL,
              @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
              @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value,
              @create_job_bom=1, @edit_time=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, @V_Client_Info OUTPUT

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
   	SELECT	(select row_id from job where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id) as key_id, 6 as key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type,
			des.trigger_period, des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
			des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2, des.number_spare3,
			des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
    FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN std_oper so ON des.key_id = so.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 2 AND so.oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Create job attributes from standard operation attribute
	INSERT INTO job_attr (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, attr_id, attr_value, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, ja.attr_id, soa.attr_value, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_attr soa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			soa.attr_id = a.attr_id
		INNER JOIN attr ja WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			ja.attr_desc = a.attr_desc AND
			a.data_type = ja.data_type AND
			a.entry_type = ja.entry_type AND
			a.predefined = ja.predefined
	WHERE soa.oper_id = @std_oper_id AND ja.attr_grp = 5

	--Update job_attribute notes from standard oper attr notes - as Oracle does not allow NOTES to be updated dynamically.
	DECLARE @tt_std_oper_attr TABLE ( t_oper_id nvarchar(40), t_attr_id int, t_notes nvarchar(4000) )

	INSERT INTO @tt_std_oper_attr
		SELECT oper_id, attr_id, notes
		FROM std_oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	UPDATE job_attr SET job_attr.notes = t.t_notes
	FROM @tt_std_oper_attr t
	WHERE job_attr.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_attr.oper_id = t.t_oper_id AND job_attr.seq_no = @seq_no AND job_attr.attr_id = t.t_attr_id

	--Create job_step group from std_oper step_grp
	INSERT INTO job_step_grp (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	--Create job_step from standard oper step
	INSERT INTO job_step (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond, allow_bypass,
		   enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, data_log_grp_id, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning,
			spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6,
		   last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond, allow_bypass
		  ,enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, data_log_grp_id, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning
		,spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6
		  ,@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id


	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	DECLARE @each_std_oper_step_des TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime,
			step_no int
		)

	DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
			@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
			@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40),  @t_last_edit_at datetime, @t_step_no int, @i int, @max_i int

	DELETE FROM @each_std_oper_step_des

	INSERT INTO @each_std_oper_step_des
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
		step_no
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT des. key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
		des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
		des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
		des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at, sos.step_no
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN std_oper_step sos ON des.key_id = sos.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 3 AND sos.oper_id = @std_oper_id

	SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_std_oper_step_des

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @t_step_no = step_no FROM @each_std_oper_step_des WHERE id = @i

		SELECT @t_key_id = js.row_id
		FROM job_step js
		WHERE js.wo_id = @wo_id AND js.oper_id = @oper_id AND js.step_no = @t_step_no

		SELECT	@t_key_type = 7, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
			,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
			,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
			,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
			,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
			,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
			,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		FROM @each_std_oper_step_des
		WHERE id = @i

		INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
		(
			key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
			last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
			number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
			@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
			@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
			@last_edit_by,  @last_edit_at
		)

		SET @i = (@i + 1)
	END


	INSERT INTO job_step_choice ( wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_choice
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	--Create job_step_file from std_oper_step_file
	INSERT INTO job_step_file (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	--Create job specifications from std_oper_specifications
	INSERT INTO job_spec(
		wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, spec_id, spec_value, act_spec_value, assoc_file,
		assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	SELECT	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, spec_id, spec_value, NULL, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, comments,
			min_value, max_value, access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_ent_spec soes WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id AND
		  ent_id = @ent_id AND
		  ver_id = (SELECT TOP 1 ver_id FROM std_oper_spec_ver WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1)

	--Create res_job_link from res_std_oper_link
	INSERT INTO res_job_link (res_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, qty_reqd, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT res_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, qty_reqd, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM res_std_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	--Create data_log_grp_job_link from data_log_grp_std_oper_link
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_link (grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT grp_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	--Create data_log_grp_job_link from data_log_grp_std_oper_link
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_step_link (grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT grp_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Create cert_job_link from cert_std_oper_link
	INSERT INTO cert_job_link (cert_name, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, cert_level, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, cert_level, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_std_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Create cert_job_step_link from cert_std_oper_step_link
	INSERT INTO cert_job_step_link (cert_name, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, cert_level, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, cert_level, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_std_oper_step_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	where oper_id = @std_oper_id

	SET @created_at = @last_edit_at

END
