CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @process_class_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @process_ver_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @process_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @process_level  int  ,
 @process_status  int  ,
 @creator  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @approver  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @created_at  datetime  ,
 @created_at_tz  INT32 = NULL  ,
 @last_user_to_change_status  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_status_change_at  datetime  ,
 @last_status_change_at_tz  INT32 = NULL  ,
 @checked_out_by  nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_instantiated datetime ,
 @last_instantiated_tz INT32 = NULL,
 @disassembly bit,
 @may_override_route bit,
 @rework bit,
 @last_editor  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Process
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 3.2.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   	Ver      	Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  	1.6.22 	(HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--03/11/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 4569) Added user_desc for all user_id columns
--09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--11/15/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	HD# 6785, Created_at, last_status_change_at, last_instantiated does not convert its values from GMT.
--01/25/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 05/18/2007     SJ            3.2.1   Tyson Supervisor freeze - Include NOLOCK hint, Change query back to user_name
-- 07/16/2007  Raghu           3.3.1   HD# 10048, Add rework before notes...
-- 11/26/2009	Kishore		4.1		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
--12/22/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
  SET @created_at_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_tz)
  SET @last_status_change_at_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_status_change_at_tz)
  SET @last_instantiated_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_instantiated_tz)

  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32
  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Process', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @created_at, @numeric_val1 = @created_at_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @last_status_change_at, @numeric_val2 = @last_status_change_at_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @last_instantiated, @numeric_val3 = @last_instantiated_tz


  IF @created_at IS NOT NULL SET @created_at = DATEADD(mi, -@created_at_tz, @created_at)
  IF @last_status_change_at IS NOT NULL SET @last_status_change_at = DATEADD(mi, -@last_status_change_at_tz, @last_status_change_at)
  IF @last_instantiated IS NOT NULL SET @last_instantiated = DATEADD(mi, -@last_instantiated_tz, @last_instantiated)

  SELECT process.process_id
            ,process.process_class_id
            ,process.process_ver_id
            ,process.process_desc
            ,process.process_level
            ,process.process_status
       ,process.creator
       ,process.approver
       ,process.created_at as created_at
       ,process.last_user_to_change_status
       ,process.last_status_change_at as last_status_change_at
       ,process.checked_out_by
       ,process.last_instantiated as last_instantiated
       ,process.disassembly
		,process.may_override_route
		,process.rework
            ,process.notes
	,CASE WHEN creator IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT user_desc FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = process.creator) END creator_desc
	,CASE WHEN approver IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT user_desc FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = process.approver) END approver_desc
	,CASE WHEN last_editor IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT user_desc FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = process.last_editor) END last_editor_desc
	,CASE WHEN last_user_to_change_status IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT user_desc FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = process.last_user_to_change_status) END last_user_to_change_status_des
	,CASE WHEN checked_out_by IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT user_desc FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = process.checked_out_by) END checked_out_by_desc
       ,process.spare1
       ,process.spare2
       ,process.spare3
       ,process.spare4
	   ,process.last_edit_comment
       ,process.last_editor
       ,process.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM process WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ((process.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (process.process_class_id = @process_class_id OR @process_class_id IS NULL) AND
       (process.process_ver_id = @process_ver_id OR @process_ver_id IS NULL) AND
       (process.process_desc = @process_desc OR @process_desc IS NULL) AND
       (process.process_level = @process_level OR @process_level IS NULL) AND
       (process.process_status = @process_status OR @process_status IS NULL) AND
       (process.creator = @creator OR @creator IS NULL) AND
       (process.approver = @approver OR @approver IS NULL) AND
       (process.created_at >= @created_at OR @created_at IS NULL) AND
       (process.last_user_to_change_status = @last_user_to_change_status OR @last_user_to_change_status IS NULL) AND
       (process.last_status_change_at >= @last_status_change_at OR @last_status_change_at IS NULL) AND
       (process.checked_out_by = @checked_out_by OR @checked_out_by IS NULL) AND
       (process.last_instantiated = @last_instantiated OR @last_instantiated IS NULL) AND
       (process.disassembly = @disassembly OR @disassembly IS NULL) AND
	   (process.may_override_route = ABS(@may_override_route) OR @may_override_route IS NULL) AND
	   (process.rework = ABS(@rework) OR @rework IS NULL) AND
       (process.last_editor = @last_editor OR @last_editor IS NULL) AND
       (process.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY process.process_id
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_util_reas_grp_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[util_reas_grp]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_util_reas_grp_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on util_reas_grp table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 03/08/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:786573 - As SE, I want to fix CR L00144714 so that I cannot create a scenario that causes 100% CPU in MES Web Portal
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@reas_grp_id		INT
		,@parent_reas_grp_id	INT

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	IF UPDATE(PARENT_REAS_GRP_ID) BEGIN
		DECLARE util_reas_grp_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
		SELECT i.reas_grp_id, i.parent_reas_grp_id
		FROM util_reas_grp urg WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN inserted i ON urg.reas_grp_id = i.reas_grp_id

		OPEN util_reas_grp_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

			FETCH NEXT FROM util_reas_grp_cursor INTO @reas_grp_id, @parent_reas_grp_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			IF UPDATE(PARENT_REAS_GRP_ID)
				EXEC sp_U_Util_Reas_Grp_Validate @reas_grp_id=@reas_grp_id, @parent_reas_grp_id=@parent_reas_grp_id

		END -- End of While (1=1)
		CLOSE util_reas_grp_cursor
		DEALLOCATE util_reas_grp_cursor
	END

	UPDATE util_reas_grp SET util_reas_grp.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, util_reas_grp.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = i.reas_grp_id
END

-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_ManageInterlock]
-- Description:	Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Usage: It is being used in the interlock management screen
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 JN				2022-08-01			Initial Draft
-- 0.01.00	 Girish Arer	2022-10-12			Added Ent Name in the select clause.
-- 0.02.00	 DS				2024-02-09			Updated the header comments & nolock
-- ===========================================================================================
-- *************************************************************************************************************************


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_ManageInterlock]
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT e.ent_id
		,e.ent_name
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 1
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Idle
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 2
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Filling
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 3
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Filled
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 4
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Cleaning
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 5
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Filling_Emptying
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 6
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Released
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 7
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Cleaned
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 8
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS In_Quarantine
		,Sum(CASE 
				WHEN su_status_cd = 9
					THEN su_status_value
				END) AS Emptying
	FROM ent e with(nolock)
	LEFT JOIN ofi_su_mes_states_mapping map with(nolock) ON e.ent_id = map.su_ent_id
	GROUP BY e.ent_id
		,e.ent_name

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetConsEnts]
(@ent_id	INT32
,@bom_pos	INT32
,@job_pos	INT32 = 0
,@wo_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@oper_id	STRING40 = NULL
,@seq_no	INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetConsEnts
-- Description	      -	HD# 5296, When consuming, if the From Storage Location list is not limited by must_consume_from_wip being true,
--			any non-movable storage entity which does not appear in the job_exec_storage_exec_link table will be eliminated
--			if it would otherwise be in the list. And if local_movable_cons_ent is true, likewise exclude any movable storage entity
--			that is not located "at" the job_exec entity. "at" in this case means that either its storage_ent_id is that of the job_exec entity,
--			or that it it located in a storage entity that is located "at" the job_exec entity - i.e. a recursive test. If producing,
--			exclude from the To Storage Location list any non-movable storage entity which does not appear in the job_exec_storage_exec_link
--			table if it would otherwise be in the list.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	10/09/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.23
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	@local_movable_cons_ent		INT32
	,@tree_level			INT32
	,@ent_name			STRING80
	,@must_consume_from_wip		LOGICAL
	,@item_id			STRING80

DECLARE  @storage_entities	TABLE (storage_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, tree_level INT)

BEGIN
	--Default the job_pos to 0; if not supplied.
	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, 0)

	--First, identify whether details about the job is supplied or we need to identify the job details from the job_exec.
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND job_pos = @job_pos
	END

	--Read the item that is being consumed and the must_consume_from_wip flag to determine the type of filters
	--we need to apply for the consumption entity list.
	SELECT @item_id = item_id, @must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
	FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos

	--Verify whether the current entity used to consume is a movable storage entity or a non-movable storage entity.
	SELECT @local_movable_cons_ent = local_movable_cons_ent FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND job_pos = @job_pos

	--Default the storage type setting to 0; if job_exec entity is not found above; Anyway, this will return an empty recordset instead of returning an error.
	SELECT @local_movable_cons_ent = COALESCE(@local_movable_cons_ent, 0),  @must_consume_from_wip = COALESCE(@must_consume_from_wip, 0)

	IF (@local_movable_cons_ent = 0) BEGIN

		--The entity that runs a job DOES NOT support any movable storage entities.
		IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 0) BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_name = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

			--Return storage entities that are configured for this entity (the entity that runs a job)
			SELECT jesel.ent_id, e.ent_name run_ent_name,
				jesel.storage_ent_id, se.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
				NULL AS located_at_ent_id, NULL AS located_at_ent_name, NULL AS tree_level
			FROM job_exec_storage_exec_link jesel WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e ON jesel.ent_id = e.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent se ON jesel.storage_ent_id = se.ent_id
			WHERE jesel.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND jesel.apply_to_cons = 1
			UNION
			--Additionally return all the entities; where the same item is produced in the previous job(s) and stored in this entity.
			SELECT DISTINCT @ent_id AS ent_id, @ent_name AS run_ent_name,
				ip.to_ent_id storage_ent_id, e.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
				NULL AS located_at_ent_id, NULL AS located_at_ent_name, NULL AS tree_level
			FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.to_ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no AND ip.item_id = @item_id
		END
		ELSE IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1)  BEGIN

			--Return storage entities that are configured for this entity (the entity that runs a job)
			SELECT jesel.ent_id, e.ent_name run_ent_name,
				jesel.storage_ent_id, se.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
				NULL AS located_at_ent_id, NULL AS located_at_ent_name, NULL AS tree_level
			FROM job_exec_storage_exec_link jesel WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e ON jesel.ent_id = e.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent se ON jesel.storage_ent_id = se.ent_id
				--Filter the entities; where the same item is produced in the previous job(s) and stored in this entity.
			INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ip.to_ent_id
					FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.to_ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no AND ip.item_id = @item_id) prev_job_ent_id
				ON jesel.storage_ent_id = prev_job_ent_id.to_ent_id
			WHERE jesel.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND jesel.apply_to_cons = 1
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@local_movable_cons_ent = 1) BEGIN

		--This entity that runs a job does support movable storage entities.
		--return only the entities that are located at this entity (location).
		SELECT @tree_level = 0

		--Insert the current storage entity to the temp table.
		INSERT INTO @storage_entities(ent_id, storage_ent_id, tree_level)
		VALUES(@ent_id, @ent_id, @tree_level)

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			--Loop through the temp table and find all the entities that is located at this entity.
			INSERT INTO @storage_entities(ent_id, storage_ent_id, tree_level)
			SELECT s.ent_id, t.ent_id, @tree_level+1 FROM @storage_entities t
			INNER JOIN storage_exec s ON t.ent_id = s.storage_ent_id
			--Loop through all the entities till we reach the terminal entity.
			WHERE t.tree_level = @tree_level AND s.storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK
			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
		END

		--Retrieve the entity name that is running a job.
		SELECT @ent_name = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 0) BEGIN
			--Retrieve all storage entities that is located at this entity.
			SELECT @ent_id AS ent_id, @ent_name run_ent_name,
				se.ent_id AS storage_ent_id, se1.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
				se.storage_ent_id located_at_ent_id, located_at_ent.ent_name AS located_at_ent_name,
				se.tree_level AS tree_level
			FROM @storage_entities se
			INNER JOIN ent se1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = se1.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent located_at_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = located_at_ent.ent_id
			UNION
			--Additionally return all the storage locations from the previous job that produce the same item.
			SELECT DISTINCT @ent_id AS ent_id, @ent_name AS run_ent_name,
				ip.to_ent_id storage_ent_id, e.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
				NULL AS located_at_ent_id, NULL AS located_at_ent_name, NULL AS tree_level
			FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.to_ent_id = e.ent_id
--			INNER JOIN @storage_entities available_ents ON ip.to_ent_id <> available_ents.ent_id
			WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no AND ip.item_id = @item_id
			  AND ip.to_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @storage_entities)
		END
		ELSE IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1)
			--Return storage entities that are configured for this entity (the entity that runs a job)
			--Retrieve all storage entities that is located at this entity.
			SELECT @ent_id AS ent_id, @ent_name run_ent_name,
				se.ent_id AS storage_ent_id, se1.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
				se.storage_ent_id located_at_ent_id, located_at_ent.ent_name AS located_at_ent_name,
				se.tree_level AS tree_level
			FROM @storage_entities se
			INNER JOIN ent se1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = se1.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent located_at_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = located_at_ent.ent_id
				--Filter the entities; where the same item is produced in the previous job(s) and stored in this entity.
			INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ip.to_ent_id
					FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.to_ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no AND ip.item_id = @item_id) prev_job_ent_id
				ON se.ent_id = prev_job_ent_id.to_ent_id
	END
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        sp_SA_ofi_Get_SU_Details_ByJobCommand
-- Description: Get storage unit information from ofi_SU_selection table.
--              This version controls automatic Source/Destination silo selection
--              based on the received job command.
--
-- Usage:       System Platform AUT
-- Example:     EXEC [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Get_SU_Details_ByJobCommand]
--                  @wo_id = '105048842',
--                  @oper_id = 'BeanBulkIntake',
--                  @seq_no = 0,
--                  @ent_id = NULL,
--                  @job_command = 16
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  AML, XPM    2026-05-21			CR622: Created ByJobCommand version to control auto silo selection by job command.
-- 0.01.01	AML, XPM    2026-05-25			CR622: Updated the destination selection  
--===========================================================================================*/
 
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Get_SU_Details_ByJobCommand] 
        @wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
        @oper_id AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
        @seq_no AS INT = NULL,
        @ent_id AS INT = NULL,
        @job_command AS INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN

    -- Only for Debugging
    -- SELECT @wo_id = '80000005', @oper_id = 'Milling', @seq_no = 0, @ent_id = NULL, @job_command = 1

  
    DECLARE @output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
            @output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
            @output_operid NVARCHAR(100),
            @output_seqno INT,
            @result INT;
 
    SELECT @output_woid = output_woid,
            @output_truncated_woid = output_truncated_woid,
            @output_operid = output_operid,
            @output_seqno = output_seqno
    FROM [dbo].[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid](@wo_id, @seq_no, @ent_id);

    SET @wo_id = ISNULL(@output_woid, @wo_id);


    DECLARE @AllowSourceAutoSelection BIT = 0,
            @AllowDestinationAutoSelection BIT = 0;


    IF (@job_command IN (1, 24, 28, 56, 60))
    BEGIN
        SET @AllowSourceAutoSelection = 1;
        SET @AllowDestinationAutoSelection = 1;
    END
    ELSE IF (@job_command IN (8, 12, 40, 44))
    BEGIN
        SET @AllowSourceAutoSelection = 1;
        SET @AllowDestinationAutoSelection = 0;
    END
    ELSE IF (@job_command IN (16, 20, 48, 52))
    BEGIN
        SET @AllowSourceAutoSelection = 0;
        SET @AllowDestinationAutoSelection = 1;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @AllowSourceAutoSelection = 0;
        SET @AllowDestinationAutoSelection = 0;
    END

    DECLARE @defaultUoMDesc NVARCHAR(20) = 'KG',
            @defaultUoMId INT,
            @IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0,
            @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0,
            @UserId NVARCHAR(100);
 
    DECLARE @id INT,
            @dest_type INT,
            @storage_ent_id INT,
            @ratio FLOAT,
            @silo_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
            @parent_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
            @jb_grade_cd INT,
            @silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100),
            @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT INT = 0; 
 
    DECLARE @target_sched_ent_id INT,
            @minID INT = 1;
 
    SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id
    FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
      AND oper_id = @oper_id
      AND seq_no = @seq_no;
 
    SELECT @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = attr_value
    FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE attr_id = (
                        SELECT attr_id
                        FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                        WHERE attr_desc = 'ShareCoProdSiloToAUT'
                          AND attr_grp = 2
                    )
      AND ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id;
 
    SET @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = ISNULL(@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT, 0);
    

    SET @UserId = SUSER_NAME();
 
    DECLARE @DestSilos TABLE
    (
        id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        dest_type INT,
        storage_ent_id INT,
        mes_ent_id INT,
        parent_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
        silo_item_id INT,
        mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
        ratio FLOAT,
        silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL, 
        bom_pos INT NULL
    );

    INSERT @DestSilos
    SELECT 
        dest_type,
        ea.attr_value AS aut_silo_id,
        osu.su_ent_id AS storage_ent_id, 
        j.item_id,
        aut_item_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN jb_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN jb_item_id
            ELSE j.item_id
        END,
        0.00 AS ratio,
        NULL,
        jb.bom_pos
    FROM ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id
       AND osu.oper_id = j.oper_id
       AND osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
    INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id
       AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
       AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
       AND jb.item_id = jb_item_id 
       AND jb.bom_pos IN (
                            SELECT CASE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT
                                        WHEN 1 THEN bom_pos
                                        WHEN 0 THEN 0
                                   END
                            FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
                            WHERE wo_id = j.wo_id
                              AND oper_id = j.oper_id
                              AND seq_no = j.seq_no
                              AND item_id = jb_item_id
                              AND bom_pos <= 0
                         ) 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON osu.su_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
       AND ea.attr_id = (
                            SELECT attr_id
                            FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
                            WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
                              AND attr_grp = 2
                        )
    CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN jb_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN jb_item_id
                        ELSE j.item_id
                    END,
                    1
                )
    WHERE osu.wo_id = @wo_id
      AND osu.oper_id = @oper_id
      AND osu.seq_no = @seq_no
      AND osu.dest_type = 2
      AND is_chk = 1
      AND ( ((osu.latest_aut_silo = 0 OR osu.latest_aut_silo IS NULL) AND @AllowDestinationAutoSelection = 1) -- Only Pick new ones when new Dest is allowed
				OR (osu.latest_aut_silo = 1 AND @AllowDestinationAutoSelection = 0))  -- Only Pick old actives ones when new Dest is not allowed
    ORDER BY jb.bom_pos DESC, silo_seq; 


    SELECT @defaultUoMId = uom_id
    FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE description = @defaultUoMDesc;
 
    DECLARE @SourceSilos TABLE
    (
        id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        dest_type INT,
        storage_ent_id INT,
        mes_silo_id NVARCHAR(50),
        parent_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
        silo_item_id INT,
        mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
        ratio FLOAT,
        silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        bom_pos INT NULL
    );
 
    DECLARE @Jb_Corr_Details TABLE
    (
        [wo_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
        [oper_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
        [seq_no] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
        [bom_pos] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
        [item_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
        [qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT] NOT NULL,
        [qty_reqd] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL] NULL,
        [reqd_grade_cd] [dbo].[INT32] NULL
    );
 
    -- Job Bom Correction Detail table will have data on job_start or bom_correction step
    IF (
            @oper_id = 'CakeBlending'
            AND EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK)
                            WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id
                              AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id
                              AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no
                       )
       )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @CurrentDosingStep INT =
        (
            SELECT MAX(dosing_step)
            FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id
              AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id
              AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no
        );
 
        INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
        SELECT 
            jbc.wo_id,
            jbc.oper_id,
            jbc.seq_no,
            jbc.bom_pos,
            jbc.item_id,
            jbc.qty_per_parent_item,
            jbc.qty_reqd,
            jb.reqd_grade_cd
        FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON jb.wo_id = jbc.wo_id
           AND jb.oper_id = jbc.oper_id
           AND jb.seq_no = jbc.seq_no
           AND jb.item_id = jbc.item_id
        WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no
          AND jbc.dosing_step = @CurrentDosingStep;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
        SELECT 
            wo_id,
            oper_id,
            seq_no,
            bom_pos,
            item_id,
            qty_per_parent_item,
            qty_reqd,
            reqd_grade_cd
        FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
          AND oper_id = @oper_id
          AND seq_no = @seq_no;
    END;

    INSERT @SourceSilos
    SELECT 
        dest_type,
        ea.attr_value AS aut_silo_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN (osu.dest_type = 1 AND latest_aut_silo = 0) THEN osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
            WHEN (osu.dest_type = 2) THEN osu.su_ent_id 
            ELSE osu.su_ent_id 
        END,
        j.item_id,
        aut_item_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN jb_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN jb_item_id
            ELSE j.item_id
        END,
        CASE dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](
                    osu.jb_item_id,
                    jb.qty_per_parent_item,
                    jbi.uom_id,
                    @defaultUoMId,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL,
                    NULL
             ) * (osu.ratio / 100)
            WHEN 1000.00 THEN 1
            ELSE ISNULL(
                    dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](
                        osu.jb_item_id,
                        jb.qty_per_parent_item,
                        jbi.uom_id,
                        @defaultUoMId,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL,
                        NULL
                    ) * (osu.ratio / 100),
                    1
                 )
        END AS ratio,
        NULL,
        NULL
    FROM ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id
       AND osu.oper_id = j.oper_id
       AND osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
    LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id
       AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
       AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
       AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id
       AND jb.reqd_grade_cd = jb_grade_cd
       AND jb.bom_pos > 0
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item jbi WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON jb.item_id = jbi.item_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON CASE 
                WHEN (osu.dest_type = 1 AND latest_aut_silo = 0) THEN osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
                WHEN (osu.dest_type = 2) THEN osu.su_ent_id 
                ELSE osu.su_ent_id 
           END = ea.ent_id
       AND ea.attr_id = (
                            SELECT attr_id
                            FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
                            WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
                              AND attr_grp = 2
                        ) -- Add attribute group =2 (entity)
    CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN jb_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN jb_item_id
                        ELSE j.item_id
                    END,
                    1
                )
    WHERE osu.wo_id = @wo_id
      AND osu.oper_id = @oper_id
      AND osu.seq_no = @seq_no
      AND osu.dest_type = 1
      AND is_chk = 1
    ORDER BY created_at_utc;

    -- PRINT @oper_id;

  
    IF (
            NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @SourceSilos)
            AND @AllowSourceAutoSelection = 1
       )
    BEGIN
        -- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
        SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = oa.attr_value
        FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
           AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
        WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id;
 
        -- PRINT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically;

        IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
        BEGIN
            SET @minID = 1;
 
            SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
              AND oper_id = @oper_id
              AND seq_no = @seq_no;
 
            INSERT @SourceSilos
            SELECT TOP 1
                1 AS dest_type,
                ea.attr_value AS aut_silo_id,
                oea.storage_ent_id,
                j.item_id,
                aut_item_id,
                jb.item_id,
                1.0 AS ratio,
                oea.item_group,
                jb.bom_pos
            FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON oea.type = 'Source'
               AND oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
            INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id
               AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
               AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
               AND jb.bom_pos > 0 -- Get only for the consumable material
            OUTER APPLY (
                SELECT TOP 1 *
                FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id
                  AND item_id = jb.item_id
                ORDER BY date_in_local ASC
            ) iv 
            INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id
               AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id
               AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id
               AND ea.attr_id = (
                                    SELECT attr_id
                                    FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
                                    WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
                                      AND attr_grp = 2
                                )
            CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(jb.item_id, 1)
            CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](
                            oea.storage_ent_id,
                            'source',
                            iv.item_id,
                            iv.grade_cd,
                            jb.item_id,
                            jb.reqd_grade_cd,
                            @wo_id,
                            @oper_id,
                            @seq_no,
                            j.target_sched_ent_id,
                            NULL
                        )
            WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
              AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
              AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
              AND isNotValidEnt = 0
            ORDER BY cj.act_finish_time_local, iv.date_in_local ASC;

            SELECT @minID = MIN(id)
            FROM @SourceSilos;
 
            DECLARE @Len INT;

            SELECT @Len = COUNT(*)
            FROM @SourceSilos;
 
            UPDATE @SourceSilos
            SET ratio = ratio / @Len; -- Update ratio
 
            WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL)
            BEGIN
                SELECT 
                    @id = id,
                    @dest_type = dest_type,
                    @storage_ent_id = mes_silo_id,
                    @parent_item_id = parent_item_id,
                    @ratio = ratio,
                    @silo_item_group = silo_item_group,
                    @silo_item_id = mes_item_id
                FROM @SourceSilos
                WHERE id = @minID;

                PRINT '@storage_ent_id';
                PRINT @storage_ent_id;

                SELECT @jb_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
                FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND item_id = @silo_item_id;

                INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
                (
                    [wo_id],
                    [oper_id],
                    [seq_no],
                    [parent_item_id],
                    [ent_id],
                    [jb_item_id],
                    [jb_item_group],
                    [jb_grade_cd],
                    [dest_type],
                    [is_chk],
                    [su_ent_id],
                    [is_active],
                    [ratio],
                    [created_at_utc],
                    [created_at_local],
                    [created_by],
                    [last_edit_at_utc],
                    [last_edit_at_local],
                    [last_edit_by],
                    [active_su_ent_id],
                    [silo_seq]
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    @wo_id,
                    @oper_id,
                    @seq_no,
                    @parent_item_id,
                    @target_sched_ent_id,
                    @silo_item_id,
                    @silo_item_group,
                    @jb_grade_cd,
                    1,
                    1,
                    @storage_ent_id,
                    1,
                    @ratio * 100.00,
                    GETUTCDATE(),
                    GETDATE(),
                    @UserId,
                    GETUTCDATE(),
                    GETDATE(),
                    @UserId,
                    @storage_ent_id,
                    1
                );

                SELECT @minID = MIN(id)
                FROM @SourceSilos
                WHERE id > @minID;
            END
        END
    END
    
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
          AND attr_id IN (
                            SELECT attr_id
                            FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                            WHERE attr_desc = 'def_source_su'
                         )
    )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @mes_ent_id INT;

        SELECT 
            @storage_ent_id = ea.attr_value,
            @mes_ent_id = ea.ent_id
        FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
        INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
        WHERE e.ent_name IN (
                                SELECT attr_value
                                FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
                                INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
                                    ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
                                WHERE attr_desc = 'def_source_su'
                                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                            )
          AND attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT';

        INSERT INTO @SourceSilos
        (
            dest_type,
            storage_ent_id,
            mes_silo_id,
            ratio
        )
        VALUES
        (
            1,
            @storage_ent_id,
            @mes_ent_id,
            1
        );
    END

    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM @DestSilos
    WHERE bom_pos = 0

    UNION

    SELECT TOP 1 *
    FROM @DestSilos
    WHERE bom_pos < 0

    UNION 

    SELECT *
    FROM @SourceSilos
    WHERE ratio > 0;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetByFilter]
(
@xml_source    NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Ent_GetByFilter
-- Description    -
-- Date Created   - 09/24/2010
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--  11/18/2013         SLR             Add field 'exact_match' to the return dataset and set to true for entities that are
--                                     selected because they meet the filter criteria.  Used by MES Web Client when presenting
--                                     entities as tiles.
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
--07/06/2020		Eswar Hemadri	6.2 US 1330203 - Performance improvement changes.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @ent_name STRING80
,@description STRING80
,@can_sched_jobs LOGICAL
,@can_run_jobs LOGICAL
,@can_capture_util LOGICAL
,@can_capture_labor LOGICAL
,@can_do_dnc LOGICAL
,@can_track_oee LOGICAL
,@can_sched_shifts LOGICAL
,@can_store LOGICAL
,@can_log_data LOGICAL
,@can_ship LOGICAL
,@can_receive LOGICAL
,@can_copy_folders LOGICAL
,@can_capture_qm_data LOGICAL
,@can_ent_class LOGICAL
,@empty_parent_list INT32


SET @empty_parent_list = NULL
-- Parse the XML Input String
DECLARE @doc_handle			INT32,
		@parent_ent_name		STRING80,
        @parent_ent_id INT32

DECLARE  @parentRootEntList TABLE (parent_ent_id INT)

--Convert the input xml to XML Type.
    EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source


--Open the xml, and read the ent_name, description and all entities capabilities
	SELECT	@ent_name = CASE WHEN ent_name = '' THEN NULL ELSE ent_name END
		,	@description = CASE WHEN description = '' THEN NULL ELSE description END
		,	@can_sched_jobs = CASE WHEN can_sched_jobs = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_sched_jobs END
		,	@can_run_jobs = CASE WHEN can_run_jobs = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_run_jobs END
		,	@can_capture_util = CASE WHEN can_capture_util = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_capture_util END
		,	@can_capture_labor = CASE WHEN can_capture_labor = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_capture_labor END
		,	@can_do_dnc = CASE WHEN can_do_dnc = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_do_dnc END
        ,	@can_track_oee = CASE WHEN can_track_oee = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_track_oee END
        ,	@can_sched_shifts = CASE WHEN can_sched_shifts = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_sched_shifts END
        ,	@can_store = CASE WHEN can_store = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_store END
        ,	@can_log_data = CASE WHEN can_log_data = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_log_data END
        ,	@can_ship = CASE WHEN can_ship = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_ship END
        ,	@can_receive = CASE WHEN can_receive = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_receive END
        ,	@can_copy_folders = CASE WHEN can_copy_folders = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_copy_folders END
        ,   @can_capture_qm_data = CASE WHEN can_capture_qm_data = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_capture_qm_data END
        ,   @can_ent_class = CASE WHEN can_ent_class = '' THEN NULL ELSE can_ent_class END



	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
		WITH (	ent_name NVARCHAR(80)
		,description STRING80
		,can_sched_jobs LOGICAL
		,can_run_jobs LOGICAL
		,can_capture_util LOGICAL
		,can_capture_labor LOGICAL
		,can_do_dnc LOGICAL
		,can_track_oee LOGICAL
		,can_sched_shifts LOGICAL
		,can_store LOGICAL
		,can_log_data LOGICAL
		,can_ship LOGICAL
		,can_receive LOGICAL
		,can_copy_folders LOGICAL
		,can_capture_qm_data LOGICAL
		,can_ent_class LOGICAL	)


--Open the xml, and read the parent_ent_name
    DECLARE parent_entlist_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN parent_ent_name = '' THEN NULL ELSE parent_ent_name END AS parent_ent_name
    FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/parentlist', 2)
	WITH (parent_ent_name NVARCHAR(160))

    OPEN parent_entlist_cursor
	--Loop through each source node to create a parent_entlist copy.
	WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM parent_entlist_cursor INTO @parent_ent_name

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

        SELECT @parent_ent_id = e.ent_id FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_name = @parent_ent_name
        INSERT INTO @parentRootEntList(parent_ent_id)
        SELECT @parent_ent_id
        SET @empty_parent_list = 1
		END

CLOSE parent_entlist_cursor
	DEALLOCATE parent_entlist_cursor

	--Destroy the instance.
	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

SET @can_ent_class = ISNULL(@can_ent_class,0)

-- @entities Logic Starts Here
DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),description NVARCHAR(80),
	site INT, hourly_cost FLOAT,
	can_sched_jobs BIT, can_run_jobs BIT, can_capture_util BIT, can_capture_labor BIT,
    can_do_dnc BIT, can_track_oee BIT, can_sched_shifts BIT, can_store BIT, can_log_data BIT,
    can_ship BIT, can_receive BIT, can_copy_folders BIT, can_capture_qm_data BIT,
    can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy BIT, can_run_jobs_from_galaxy BIT, can_capture_util_from_galaxy BIT,
     can_track_oee_from_galaxy BIT, can_store_from_galaxy BIT, entity_from_galaxy BIT,
     cur_shift_id INT, cur_shift_start_time_utc DATETIME, cur_shift_start_time_local DATETIME,
     shift_desc NVARCHAR(80),last_domain_change DATETIME, tree_icon NVARCHAR(80),
     flow_diag_img NVARCHAR(80), identical_job_execs INT, show_in_dsp_tree BIT,ent_class BIT,
     spare1 NVARCHAR(1000),spare2 NVARCHAR(1000),spare3 NVARCHAR(1000),spare4 NVARCHAR(1000),
     last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(80), last_edit_by NVARCHAR(80), last_edit_at DATETIME,
     parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000), delete_me BIT, exact_match BIT,
	 INDEX IX_TempEntities CLUSTERED (root_ent_id, ent_id))

DECLARE  @qualifiers TABLE (ent_id INT, parent_ent_id INT, root_ent_id INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000), INDEX IX_TempQualifiers CLUSTERED (root_ent_id, ent_id))


DECLARE  @child_level			INT32
	,@ent_id			INT32
	,@root_ent_id  			INT32
	,@process_id			STRING80
	,@limit_schedulable_ents	NVARCHAR(1)


	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		IF @can_ent_class = 0 BEGIN			-- get only entity classes
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, site, description, hourly_cost, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs,
			 can_capture_util, can_capture_labor, can_do_dnc, can_track_oee, can_sched_shifts, can_store, can_log_data,
			 can_ship, can_receive, can_copy_folders, can_capture_qm_data, can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
			 can_capture_util_from_galaxy, can_track_oee_from_galaxy, can_store_from_galaxy, entity_from_galaxy,
			 cur_shift_id,cur_shift_start_time_utc,cur_shift_start_time_local, last_domain_change,
			 tree_icon, flow_diag_img, identical_job_execs, show_in_dsp_tree, ent_class, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
			 last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, parent_ent_id, child_level,  delete_me, exact_match)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name,e.site, e.description, e.hourly_cost, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs,
			 e.can_capture_util, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_do_dnc, e.can_track_oee, e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_store, e.can_log_data,
			 e.can_ship, e.can_receive, e.can_copy_folders, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, e.can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
			 e.can_capture_util_from_galaxy, e.can_track_oee_from_galaxy, e.can_store_from_galaxy, e.entity_from_galaxy,
			 e.cur_shift_id,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc,e.cur_shift_start_time_local,e.last_domain_change,
			 e.tree_icon, e.flow_diag_img, e.identical_job_execs, e.show_in_dsp_tree, e.ent_class, e.spare1, e.spare2, e.spare3, e.spare4,
			 e.last_edit_comment, e.last_edit_by, e.last_edit_at, NULL, @child_level, 1, 0 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id AND e.ent_class = @can_ent_class
		END
		ELSE BEGIN			-- get all entities
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, site, description, hourly_cost, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs,
			 can_capture_util, can_capture_labor, can_do_dnc, can_track_oee, can_sched_shifts, can_store, can_log_data,
			 can_ship, can_receive, can_copy_folders, can_capture_qm_data, can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
			 can_capture_util_from_galaxy, can_track_oee_from_galaxy, can_store_from_galaxy, entity_from_galaxy,
			 cur_shift_id,cur_shift_start_time_utc,cur_shift_start_time_local, last_domain_change,
			 tree_icon, flow_diag_img, identical_job_execs, show_in_dsp_tree, ent_class, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
			 last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, parent_ent_id, child_level,  delete_me, exact_match)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name,e.site, e.description, e.hourly_cost, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs,
			 e.can_capture_util, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_do_dnc, e.can_track_oee, e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_store, e.can_log_data,
			 e.can_ship, e.can_receive, e.can_copy_folders, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, e.can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
			 e.can_capture_util_from_galaxy, e.can_track_oee_from_galaxy, e.can_store_from_galaxy, e.entity_from_galaxy,
			 e.cur_shift_id,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc,e.cur_shift_start_time_local,e.last_domain_change,
			 e.tree_icon, e.flow_diag_img, e.identical_job_execs, e.show_in_dsp_tree, e.ent_class, e.spare1, e.spare2, e.spare3, e.spare4,
			 e.last_edit_comment, e.last_edit_by, e.last_edit_at, NULL, @child_level, 1, 0 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
		END

		SET @child_level = 2

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name,site, description, hourly_cost, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs,
		 can_capture_util, can_capture_labor, can_do_dnc, can_track_oee, can_sched_shifts, can_store, can_log_data,
		 can_ship, can_receive, can_copy_folders, can_capture_qm_data, can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
		 can_capture_util_from_galaxy, can_track_oee_from_galaxy, can_store_from_galaxy, entity_from_galaxy,
		 cur_shift_id,cur_shift_start_time_utc,cur_shift_start_time_local, last_domain_change,
		 tree_icon, flow_diag_img, identical_job_execs, show_in_dsp_tree, ent_class, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
		 last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree, delete_me, exact_match)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.site, e.description, e.hourly_cost, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs,
		 e.can_capture_util, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_do_dnc, e.can_track_oee, e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_store, e.can_log_data,
		 e.can_ship, e.can_receive, e.can_copy_folders, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, e.can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
		 e.can_capture_util_from_galaxy, e.can_track_oee_from_galaxy, e.can_store_from_galaxy, e.entity_from_galaxy,
		 e.cur_shift_id,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc,e.cur_shift_start_time_local,e.last_domain_change,
		 e.tree_icon, e.flow_diag_img, e.identical_job_execs, e.show_in_dsp_tree, e.ent_class, e.spare1, e.spare2, e.spare3, e.spare4,
		 e.last_edit_comment, e.last_edit_by, e.last_edit_at, el.parent_ent_id, @child_level, x.ent_tree, 1, 0
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END
	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor



-- Recursively retreiving the entities (Parent Entities) and insert into temp table - @parententIdlist1, if user selects the root entity from Filter Tree view
DECLARE @parentEntCount INT
DECLARE  @tempEntities TABLE (ent_id INT, parent_ent_id INT)

INSERT INTO @tempEntities(ent_id, parent_ent_id)
SELECT e1.ent_id, e1.parent_ent_id FROM @entities e1

WHILE (1=1)
BEGIN
SELECT @parentEntCount = Count (*) from @tempEntities e1 where  e1.parent_ent_id IN (select p1.parent_ent_id from @parentRootEntList p1)

IF( @parentEntCount = 0) BREAK

DELETE @tempEntities WHERE  parent_ent_id IN (select p1.parent_ent_id from @parentRootEntList p1)

INSERT INTO @parentRootEntList(parent_ent_id)
      SELECT e1.ent_id  from @entities e1 INNER JOIN @parentRootEntList p1 ON e1.parent_ent_id = p1.parent_ent_id
         WHERE e1.ent_id NOT IN (select p2.parent_ent_id from @parentRootEntList p2)

END

-- Getting the Qualified Data based on filter
INSERT INTO @qualifiers(ent_id, parent_ent_id, root_ent_id,ent_tree)
SELECT  e1.ent_id, e1.parent_ent_id, e1.root_ent_id, e1.ent_tree FROM @entities e1 WHERE (e1.ent_name LIKE @ent_name OR @ent_name IS NULL)
	  AND (e1.description LIKE @description OR @description IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_sched_jobs = @can_sched_jobs OR @can_sched_jobs IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_run_jobs = @can_run_jobs OR @can_run_jobs IS NULL)
	  AND (e1.can_capture_util = @can_capture_util OR @can_capture_util IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_capture_labor = @can_capture_labor OR @can_capture_labor IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_do_dnc = @can_do_dnc OR @can_do_dnc IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_track_oee = @can_track_oee OR @can_track_oee IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_sched_shifts = @can_sched_shifts OR @can_sched_shifts IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_store = @can_store OR @can_store IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_log_data = @can_log_data OR @can_log_data IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_ship = @can_ship OR @can_ship IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_receive = @can_receive OR @can_receive IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_copy_folders = @can_copy_folders OR @can_copy_folders IS NULL)
      AND (e1.can_capture_qm_data = @can_capture_qm_data OR @can_capture_qm_data IS NULL)
      AND (e1.parent_ent_id IN (select e2.parent_ent_id from @parentRootEntList e2)OR @empty_parent_list IS NULL)

-- Mark the entities that are selected because they match the filters for use in the MES Web Client
UPDATE @entities  SET exact_match = 1
  FROM @entities e1
  INNER JOIN @qualifiers q1 ON q1.ent_id = e1.ent_id AND q1.root_ent_id = e1.root_ent_id


-- Parsing the Ent_Tree from the Qualified Data
DECLARE @Delimeter char(1)
SET @Delimeter = '-'
DECLARE @StartPos int, @Length int
DECLARE @temp_ent_id int
DECLARE @ent_tree VARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @qualifier_ent_id INT
DECLARE @qualifier_root_ent_id INT
DECLARE @multiplePathCount INT


DECLARE  @entTreeIdList TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT)

DECLARE qualified_ent_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_tree, ent_id, root_ent_id FROM @qualifiers


OPEN qualified_ent_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM qualified_ent_cursor INTO @ent_tree, @qualifier_ent_id, @qualifier_root_ent_id
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

    WHILE LEN(@ent_tree) > 0
    BEGIN
    SET @StartPos = CHARINDEX(@Delimeter, @ent_tree)
    IF @StartPos < 0 SET @StartPos = 0
    IF @StartPos > 0
      BEGIN
        SET @temp_ent_id = SUBSTRING(@ent_tree, 1, @StartPos - 1)
		INSERT @entTreeIdList (root_ent_id, ent_id) VALUES(@qualifier_root_ent_id, @temp_ent_id)
        SET @ent_tree = SUBSTRING(@ent_tree, @StartPos + 1, LEN(@ent_tree) - @StartPos)
      END
    ELSE
      BEGIN
        SET @temp_ent_id = @ent_tree
		INSERT @entTreeIdList (root_ent_id, ent_id) VALUES(@qualifier_root_ent_id, @temp_ent_id)
        INSERT @entTreeIdList (root_ent_id, ent_id) VALUES(@qualifier_root_ent_id, @qualifier_ent_id)
        SET @ent_tree = ''
      END

   END --WHILE (1 = 1)

   IF(@ent_tree IS NULL)  -- For root entity ID
     INSERT @entTreeIdList (root_ent_id, ent_id) VALUES(@qualifier_root_ent_id, @qualifier_ent_id)

 END -- Cursor End
CLOSE qualified_ent_cursor
DEALLOCATE qualified_ent_cursor

UPDATE @entities  SET delete_me = 0
  FROM @entities e1
  INNER JOIN (SELECT distinct root_ent_id, ent_id FROM @entTreeIdList) et ON et.ent_id = e1.ent_id AND et.root_ent_id = e1.root_ent_id

--RETURN ALL COLUMNS of @entities along with site.site_name and shidt.shift_desc
SELECT e1.root_ent_id, e1.ent_id, e1.ent_name, e1.description,e1.site,site.site_name, e1.hourly_cost, e1.can_sched_jobs, e1.can_run_jobs, e1.can_capture_util, e1.can_capture_labor,
	e1.can_do_dnc, e1.can_track_oee, e1.can_sched_shifts, e1.can_store, e1.can_log_data, e1.can_ship, e1.can_receive, e1.can_copy_folders, e1.can_capture_qm_data,
	e1.can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy, e1.can_run_jobs_from_galaxy, e1.can_capture_util_from_galaxy, e1.can_track_oee_from_galaxy, e1.can_store_from_galaxy,
	e1.entity_from_galaxy,e1.cur_shift_id,e1.cur_shift_start_time_utc,e1.cur_shift_start_time_local,shift.shift_desc, e1.last_domain_change, e1.tree_icon, e1.flow_diag_img, e1.identical_job_execs, e1.show_in_dsp_tree, e1.ent_class, e1.spare1,
	e1.spare2, e1.spare3, e1.spare4, e1.last_edit_comment, e1.last_edit_by, e1.last_edit_at, e1.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name AS parent_ent_name,e1.child_level, e1.ent_tree, e1.exact_match from @entities e1
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = e1.parent_ent_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN site site WITH (NOLOCK) ON e1.site = site.ent_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON e1.cur_shift_id = shift.shift_id
  WHERE e1.delete_me = 0

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_oper_link_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[cert_oper_link]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_cert_oper_link_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on cert_oper_link table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process p INNER JOIN inserted i ON p.process_id = i.process_id
			INNER JOIN cert_oper_link a ON a.cert_name = i.cert_name AND a.process_id = i.process_id AND a.oper_id = i.oper_id
			WHERE p.process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},cert_oper_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i, cert_oper_link a
	WHERE a.cert_name = i.cert_name AND a.process_id = i.process_id AND a.oper_id = i.oper_id
	  AND process.process_id = i.process_id

END

-- Description: This is used to summarize the consumption details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AML,XPM			2026-02-06			Initial Version

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_cb_cons_per_step]
AS
SELECT 
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_id,
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR), 'DS', CAST(cd.dosing_step AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_step_id,
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR), 'S', CAST(cb.sample_id AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_sample_id,
	j.wo_id, 
	j.oper_id, 
	j.seq_no,
	cd.item_id,
	cd.qty_reqd, 
	cd.actual_cons, 
	cd.dosing_step,
	ac.is_manual,
	cb.sample_id,
	( SELECT TOP 1 def_reas_cd FROM ufn_S_ofi_GetDefReasCdFromId(j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, cd.dosing_step) ) AS reas_cd,
	j.act_finish_time_local, 
	j.act_finish_time_utc,
	ic.from_ent_id

	
	

	FROM job j
		JOIN job_bom_correction_details cd ON j.wo_id = cd.wo_id AND j.oper_id = cd.oper_id AND j.seq_no = cd.seq_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_cb_approved_correction ac ON j.wo_id = ac.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ac.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ac.seq_no AND cd.dosing_step = ac.correction_step 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_CBamqp_Resp cb ON  j.wo_id = cb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = cb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = cb.seq_no AND cd.dosing_step = cb.curr_correction_step AND ac.is_manual = cb.isManual 
		LEFT JOIN item_cons ic ON j.wo_id = ic.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ic.oper_id AND  j.seq_no = ic.seq_no AND cd.item_id = ic.item_id

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_kanban_job_data]
AS
SELECT job.wo_id,
       wo.wo_desc,
       wo.state_cd wo_state,
       wo.release_time_utc,
       wo.release_time_local,
       wo.process_id,
       wo.cust_info,
       job.oper_id,
       job.seq_no,
       job.job_desc,
       job.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       job.state_cd,
       job_state.state_desc,
       job_state.color,
       job.job_priority,
       job.req_finish_time_utc,
       job.req_finish_time_local,
       job.init_sched_ent_id,
       sched_ent.ent_name sched_ent_name,
       sched_ent.description sched_ent_desc,
       job.target_sched_ent_id,
       target_ent.ent_name target_ent_name,
       target_ent.description target_ent_desc,
       job.run_ent_id,
       ent.ent_name run_ent_name,
       ent.description run_ent_desc,
       job_exec.job_pos,
       job.qty_reqd,
       job.qty_prod,
       job.qty_rejected,
       job.qty_at_start,
       job.batch_size,
       job.est_setup_time,
       job.est_teardown_time,
       CASE job.prod_uom
          WHEN 1 THEN job.est_prod_rate/60.0
          WHEN 2 THEN job.est_prod_rate/3600.0
          WHEN 3 THEN 1.0/job.est_prod_rate
          WHEN 4 THEN (1.0/job.est_prod_rate)/60.0
          WHEN 5 THEN (1.0/job.est_prod_rate)/3600.0
          ELSE job.est_prod_rate
       END AS est_prod_rate,
       job.est_transfer_time,
       job.sched_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_start_time_local,
       job.latest_start_time_utc,
       job.latest_start_time_local,
       job.sched_finish_time_utc,
       job.sched_finish_time_local,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.notes,
       job.status_notes,
       job.rework
FROM job job
INNER JOIN wo wo ON job.wo_id = wo.wo_id
INNER JOIN item item ON job.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN job_state job_state ON
   job.state_cd = job_state.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON job.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent sched_ent ON
   job.init_sched_ent_id = sched_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent target_ent ON
   job.target_sched_ent_id = target_ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec job_exec ON
   job.run_ent_id = job_exec.ent_id AND

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_MDM_SCHED_Wo_Attr_CompleteBeforeAfter]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @beforeAfter int,
   @beforeAfterTime nvarchar(40))
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-	sp_U_MDM_SCHED_Wo_Attr_CompleteBeforeAfter
-- Description			-	This SP will add a wo attr for complete before or complete after to a wo.
-- Author				-	Wilwin
-- Date Created			-	06/27/2018
-- Version				-	1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2015 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
--	06/27/2018		Wilwin			1.0.0.0		Initial Draft

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
declare @attrid int,@attrid_other int, @attrdesc nvarchar(20), @last_edit_at datetime


if @beforeAfter = 1 
begin
select @attrid = attr_id, @attrdesc = attr_desc from attr where attr_desc like 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr'
			if @attrid is null
			begin
			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_Attr] 
			   @attr_id = @attrid 
			  ,@predefined = null
			  ,@data_type = null
			  ,@attr_desc =  'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr'
			  ,@attr_grp = 6
			  ,@filtr = null
			  ,@entry_type = null
			  ,@visible_in_queue = null
			  ,@visible_in_inv = null
			  ,@last_edit_comment = 'admin entry'
			  ,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
  
			SET @attrdesc = 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr'
			
			end
			select @attrid_other = attr_id from attr where attr_desc like 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft'
end
else if @beforeAfter = 2
begin
select @attrid = attr_id, @attrdesc = attr_desc from attr where attr_desc like 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft'
			if @attrid is null
			begin
			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_Attr] 
			   @attr_id = @attrid 
			  ,@predefined = null
			  ,@data_type = null
			  ,@attr_desc =  'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft'
			  ,@attr_grp = 6
			  ,@filtr = null
			  ,@entry_type = null
			  ,@visible_in_queue = null
			  ,@visible_in_inv = null
			  ,@last_edit_comment = 'admin entry'
			  ,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
  
			SET @attrdesc = 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft'
			
			end
			select @attrid_other = attr_id from attr where attr_desc like 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr'
end
else
begin

if exists ( select * from wo_attr where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id in (select attr_id from attr where attr_desc in ('MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr', 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft')))
	delete from wo_attr where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id in (select attr_id from attr where attr_desc in ('MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr', 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft'))
end


if exists (select * from wo_attr where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attrid)
begin
update wo_attr
set attr_value = @beforeAfterTime
where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attrid
end
else
begin
--if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 and @@ERROR = 0
if @attrid is not null
	begin
	EXECUTE  [dbo].[sp_I_Wo_Attr] 
	   @wo_id = @wo_id
	  ,@attr_id = @attrid
	  ,@attr_value = @beforeAfterTime
	  ,@notes = @attrdesc 
	  ,@last_edit_comment = @attrdesc
	  ,@mod_id = 'test'
	end
end

delete from wo_attr where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attrid_other
