--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_recipeinfo_siloselec]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch recipe details for source/destination 
--
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		DS				2022-08-16			Initial version.
-- 0.02		DS				2023-03-29			incorporating the item grade column	
-- 0.03		DS				2023-04-10			backflush and qty_reqd is >0 conditions are added
-- 0.04		DS				2023-09-27			#279_1 related changes, added 2 more columns for batch process, specifically for liquor blending
-- 0.05		DS				2023-10-10			#279_1 fetching the susbtitute material
-- 0.06		MA				2024-01-02			Added grade color column
-- 0.07		DS				2024-04-04			Added composite item it with combination of grade_cd
-- 0.08		DS				2024-07-10			Added composite item it for subs_itemList
-- 0.09		DS				2024-07-11			setting the composite item id as item id in case of bypass grade validation
-- 1.00		AML, XPM		2026-07-30			Update uom conversion
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_recipeinfo_siloselec]
(
	--declare
	 @silo_selection		int = 1   -- 1 for source , 2 from destination
	,@ver_id				nvarchar(40) = NULL
	,@wo_id					nvarchar(40) = NULL
	,@oper_id				nvarchar(80) = NULL
	,@seq_no				int = NULL
	,@ent_id				int = NULL  --
	,@recipeId				nvarchar(80) =NULL
)AS

--select @silo_selection=1,@ver_id=N'BreakingWinnowing_S-500000041590-5',@wo_id=N'1001016150',@oper_id=N'BreakingWinnowing',@seq_no=0,@ent_id=208,@recipeid=NULL

declare @process nvarchar(80)
,@job_state_cd int
,@jobrequiredQty float
,@qty_prod float
,@isbatchprocess int
,@bypass_grade_validation int


BEGIN
DECLARE @defaultUOMID int

select @defaultUOMID = uom_id from uom with(nolock) where description = 'KG';

-- v1.00
DECLARE @wo_uom_id int; 

SELECT @wo_uom_id = i.uom_id
FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = owe.item_id
WHERE owe.wo_id = @wo_id;


			select @job_state_cd = state_cd,@jobrequiredQty = qty_reqd ,@qty_prod = qty_prod,@isbatchprocess = isnull(oa.attr_value,0)
			,@bypass_grade_validation = isnull(ola.attr_value,0)
			from job with(nolock) 
			left join  oper_attr oa with(nolock) on job.oper_id = oa.oper_id and oa.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc ='IsBatchProcess' )
			left join  oper_attr ola with(nolock) on job.oper_id = ola.oper_id and ola.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc ='bypass_grade_validation' ) --0.09
			where job.wo_id = @wo_id and job.oper_id = @oper_id and job.seq_no = @seq_no
			
			set @jobrequiredQty = case when (@jobrequiredQty-@qty_prod)>0 then (@jobrequiredQty-@qty_prod) else 0 end

			-- handling the intake process
			--IF not exists(select 1 from wo with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and ((process_id like '%intake%') or( process_id like '%liquorButterRework%' )))
	IF not exists(select 1 from wo with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and process_id like '%intake%')
		begin
					IF(@silo_selection=1)  -- source silo selection
					BEGIN


						select jb.bom_pos
						,jb.item_id
						,item.item_desc
						--,jb.qty_per_parent_item
						,ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, ISNULL(@wo_uom_id, @defaultUOMID),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * 100, 2) qty_per_parent_item -- v1.00
						,jb.reqd_grade_cd AS grade_code
						,item_grade.item_grade_desc AS grade_desc
						,jb.qty_reqd  -- this has to be changed ds comment on 27-Sep-2023; this should be same as item_qty_required
						,(select description from uom with(nolock) where uom_id = item.uom_id) as uom_description
						,jb.spare1 as recipe_id
						,ia.attr_value AS item_group
						,ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,(jb.qty_per_parent_item*@jobrequiredQty),item.uom_id, ISNULL(@wo_uom_id, @defaultUOMID),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL), 2) item_qty_required -- v1.00
						,@isbatchprocess is_batchprocess
						,'' selected_item_qty
						,'' selected_percentage
						,'' selection_complete
						,'' silo_selected
						,subs_itemlist  AS subs_itemlist
						--@job_qty_reqd as job_qty_reqd
						,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color) as grade_color			--0.06  passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
						,case when @bypass_grade_validation = 1 then jb.item_id				--0.09
						else concat(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd) end as comp_item_id
						from job_bom jb with(nolock)  inner join  item with(nolock) on item.item_id = jb.item_id
						left join item_grade with(nolock)  on item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
						left join item_attr ia with(nolock)  on ia.item_id = item.item_id 
						inner join attr a with(nolock)  on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' 
						--left join (
						--	  SELECT distinct  -- distinct is required because multiple entries exist against orig_item_id in table -item_subst;
						--						--	here we are fecthing the list of substitute material based on original material
						--		orig_item_id,
						--		STUFF((SELECT ',' + is2.item_id FROM item_subst is2 WHERE is2.orig_item_id = is1.orig_item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
						--	  FROM item_subst is1
						--	) AS subs ON  subs.orig_item_id = jb.item_id
						left join (
								-- distinct is required because multiple entries can exist item_id in table -item_subst - item can be substitue 2 for 2 parent(orig) material;
												--	here we are fecthing the list of substitute material based on original material
							  SELECT distinct
								is1.item_id
								--STUFF((SELECT ',' + is2.orig_item_id FROM item_subst is2 WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
								,STUFF((SELECT ',' + concat(is2.orig_item_id,is2.reqd_grade_cd) FROM item_subst  is2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
							  FROM item_subst is1  
							) AS subs ON  subs.item_id = jb.item_id

						where jb.wo_id =@wo_id and jb.oper_id =@oper_id and seq_no =@seq_no and jb.bom_pos >0
					--	and jb.qty_reqd>0
						and jb.backflush <>1

					END 
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						select jb.bom_pos
							,jb.item_id
							,item.item_desc
							--,jb.qty_per_parent_item
							,ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, ISNULL(@wo_uom_id, @defaultUOMID),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * 100, 2) qty_per_parent_item -- v1.00
							,jb.reqd_grade_cd AS grade_code
							,item_grade.item_grade_desc AS grade_desc
							,jb.qty_reqd
							,(select description from uom with(nolock) where uom_id = item.uom_id) as uom_description
							,jb.spare1 as recipe_id
							,ia.attr_value AS item_group
							,@isbatchprocess is_batchprocess
							,'' selected_percentage
							,'' selection_complete
							,'' silo_selected
							,subs_itemlist  AS subs_itemlist
							--@job_qty_reqd as job_qty_reqd
							,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color) as grade_color			--0.06  passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
							,case when @bypass_grade_validation = 1 then jb.item_id				--0.09
							else concat(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd) end as comp_item_id

							from job_bom jb with(nolock)  inner join  item with(nolock) on item.item_id = jb.item_id
							left join item_grade with(nolock)  on item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
							left join item_attr ia with(nolock)  on ia.item_id = item.item_id 
							inner join attr a with(nolock)  on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' 
							left join (
								-- distinct is required because multiple entries can exist item_id in table -item_subst - item can be substitue 2 for 2 parent(orig) material;
												--	here we are fecthing the list of substitute material based on original material
							  SELECT distinct
								is1.item_id
								--STUFF((SELECT ',' + is2.orig_item_id FROM item_subst is2 WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
								,STUFF((SELECT ',' + concat(is2.orig_item_id,is2.reqd_grade_cd) FROM item_subst  is2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
							  FROM item_subst is1  
							) AS subs ON  subs.item_id = jb.item_id
							where jb.wo_id =@wo_id and jb.oper_id =@oper_id and seq_no =@seq_no and jb.bom_pos <= 0
					END

			end

			else
			begin
			----- handle the intake process
			IF(@silo_selection=1)
			 begin
				select jb.bom_pos
							--,jb.item_id
							,concat(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd) item_id
							,item.item_desc
							,jb.qty_per_parent_item
							--,ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * 100, 3) qty_per_parent_item
							,jb.reqd_grade_cd AS grade_code
							,item_grade.item_grade_desc AS grade_desc
							,jb.qty_reqd
							,(select description from uom with(nolock) where uom_id = item.uom_id) as uom_description
							,jb.spare1 as recipe_id
							,ia.attr_value AS item_group
							,@isbatchprocess is_batchprocess
							,'' selected_percentage
							,'' selection_complete
							,'' silo_selected
							--@job_qty_reqd as job_qty_reqd
							,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color) as grade_color			--0.06  passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
							,case when @bypass_grade_validation = 1 then jb.item_id				--0.09
							else concat(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd) end as comp_item_id
							from job_bom jb with(nolock)  inner join  item with(nolock) on item.item_id = jb.item_id
							left join item_grade with(nolock)  on item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
							left join item_attr ia with(nolock)  on ia.item_id = item.item_id 
							inner join attr a with(nolock)  on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' 
							where jb.wo_id =@wo_id and jb.oper_id =@oper_id and seq_no =@seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0

					end

					else
					begin
							select jb.bom_pos
										,jb.item_id
										--,concat(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd) item_id
										,item.item_desc
										,jb.qty_per_parent_item
										--,ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,item.uom_id, @defaultUOMID,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) * 100, 3) qty_per_parent_item
										,jb.reqd_grade_cd AS grade_code
										,item_grade.item_grade_desc AS grade_desc
										,jb.qty_reqd
										,(select description from uom with(nolock) where uom_id = item.uom_id) as uom_description
										,jb.spare1 as recipe_id
										,ia.attr_value AS item_group
										,@isbatchprocess is_batchprocess
										,'' selected_percentage
										,'' selection_complete
										,'' silo_selected
										--@job_qty_reqd as job_qty_reqd
										,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color) as grade_color			--0.06  passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
										--,concat(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd) as comp_item_id
										from job_bom jb with(nolock)  inner join  item with(nolock) on item.item_id = jb.item_id
										left join item_grade with(nolock)  on item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
										left join item_attr ia with(nolock)  on ia.item_id = item.item_id 
										inner join attr a with(nolock)  on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' 
										where jb.wo_id =@wo_id and jb.oper_id =@oper_id and seq_no =@seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0

					end

			end
			
END

,@return_message          STRING254 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name           - SP_I_JOB_EXEC_CRWFP

-- Author                - Lorin Grubb
-- Date Created          -
-- Version (last edit)   - 6.2.0
--

--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 02/21/2008		AML				3.4.0		L00075076: 378, 382, and 398 depend on 377.
-- 03/05/2008	    Raghu		    3.4			L00075524; Load Test: Receiving a series of exceptions (similar to"Conversion failed when converting the nvarchar value 'u7-' to datatype int") when running a load test with a series of logon, add productions and logoffs.
-- 11/13/2009	    Kishore		    4.0			HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes

-- 02/09/2012		Ashish			4.0 SP1	    Changes done for HF#CRL00118955

-- 11/16/2016		Raghu		    5.3		    UserStory: 678824 - Added nolock hints
-- 02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	        UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
-- 02/04/2020       Jim O'Hearn     6.2.0       Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES_NULL; see US 1232760
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN


	--  Local variables to hold system attribute values.
	DECLARE @separate_wo     STRING40,
	@rework_wo_desc          STRING80,
	@modify_lot              STRING40,
	@redo_original_work      STRING40,
	@modify_ops              STRING40,
	@copy_wo_at_end          STRING40,

	--  Local variables for existing wo to add the rework to.
	@existing_wo             STRING40,
	@existing_process_id     STRING40,
	@current_start_qty       TFLOAT,
	@current_req_qty         TFLOAT,
    @wo_req_qty              TFLOAT,
    @current_seq_no          INT32,

	--  Local variables for managing the count table.
	@count_woid              STRING40,
	@count_opid              STRING40,
	@count_seq               STRING40,
	@count_reason            STRING40,
	@count_process           STRING40,
	@count_sublot            STRING40,
	@rework_count            INT32,
	@max_times_rework        INT32,
	@count_date              TDATETIME,
	@count_row               INT32,

	--  Local variables for handling the sixth system attribute (copy parent jobs after rework jobs).
	@next_oper_id            STRING40,
	@next_seq_no             STRING40,
	@next_state_cd           INT32,
	@next_req_finish_time_local TDATETIME,
	@next_target_sched_ent_id INT32,
	@next_status_notes       NVARCHAR(1700),
	@first_job_found         INT32,
	@old_oper_id             STRING40,
	@old_seq_no              STRING40,

	--  Local variables for handling the fifth system attribute (rename oper ids).
	@next_oper_number        INT32,

	--  Local variables for handling the first system attribute (merge work order into parent work order).
	@max_seq_no              INT32,
	@reentry_oper_id         STRING40,
	@reentry_seq_no          STRING40,
	@out_mod_id              STRING40,
	@orig_display_seq        INT32,
	@input_percent			 TFLOAT,
    @input_total             TFLOAT,
    @non_rework_jobs         INT32,

	--  Local variables for handling the third system attribute (change lot INT32).
	@total_lot_qty           TFLOAT,
	@inv_item_row_id         INT32,
	@inv_item_last_edit      TDATETIME,
	@new_lot_no              STRING40,

	--  Local variables for generating return message.
	@first_oper_id           STRING40,
	@err_msg                 NVARCHAR(4000),
	@from_ent_id             INT32

	SET @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 1)

	DECLARE @final_job TABLE (
		id int identity,
		oper_id nvarchar(40),
		seq_no INT
	)

	DECLARE @fj_i INT, @fj_max_i INT, @fj_oper_id NVARCHAR(40), @fj_seq_no INT

	DECLARE @next_job TABLE (
		id int identity,
		oper_id nvarchar(40),
		seq_no int,
		qty_reqd int,
		qty_at_start int,
		state_cd int,
		req_finish_time_local datetime,
		target_sched_ent_id int,
		status_notes nvarchar(4000)
	)

	DECLARE @nj_i INT, @nj_max_i INT, @nj_oper_id nvarchar(40), @nj_seq_no int, @nj_qty_reqd int, @nj_qty_at_start int
		,	@nj_state_cd int, @nj_req_finish_time_local datetime, @nj_target_sched_ent_id int, @nj_status_notes nvarchar(4000)
		,	@dbg_resp INT32


    SELECT	@init_wo_state = COALESCE(@init_wo_state, 1),
			@wo_priority = COALESCE(@wo_priority, 1),
			@for_first_op = COALESCE(@for_first_op, 0)

	  SET @release_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
	  SET @release_time = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@release_time, @release_time_tz)
      SET @req_finish_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
      SET @req_finish_time = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_tz)

      SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

      EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_i_job_exec_crwfp', @src_key='on_entry', @date_val1 = @release_time, @numeric_val1 = @release_time_tz
	, @date_val2 = @req_finish_time, @numeric_val2 = @req_finish_time_tz

    SET @return_message = NULL

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo.wo_id = @parent_wo_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg =  'The source row does not exist for wo_id = %1 {3203},' + @parent_wo_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		return
	END

    --Retrieve the process_id if the process_id is not supplied.
    IF (@parent_process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT @parent_process_id = process_id
        FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
    END

    --  Obtain the rework process id from the rework_process_usage table.
    SET @rework_process_id = NULL

    SELECT @rework_process_id = rework_process_id, @max_times_rework = max_times_rework, @reentry_rework_cd = reentry_rework_cd
    FROM Rework_Process_Usage WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE reas_cd = @rework_reas_cd AND
        orig_rework_cd = @orig_rework_cd AND
        orig_process_id = @parent_process_id AND
        item_id = @item_id

    IF @rework_process_id IS NULL BEGIN

        SELECT @rework_process_id = rework_process_id, @max_times_rework = max_times_rework, @reentry_rework_cd = reentry_rework_cd
        FROM Rework_Process_Usage WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE	reas_cd = @rework_reas_cd AND
				orig_rework_cd = @orig_rework_cd AND
				orig_process_id = @parent_process_id AND
				item_id IS NULL

    END

    IF @rework_process_id IS NULL BEGIN

        SELECT @rework_process_id = rework_process_id, @max_times_rework = max_times_rework, @reentry_rework_cd = reentry_rework_cd
        FROM Rework_Process_Usage WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE	reas_cd = @rework_reas_cd AND
				orig_rework_cd = @orig_rework_cd AND
                item_id = @item_id AND
                orig_process_id IS NULL
    END
    --CR 101895 SLR
    IF @rework_process_id IS NULL BEGIN

        SELECT @rework_process_id = rework_process_id, @max_times_rework = max_times_rework, @reentry_rework_cd = reentry_rework_cd
        FROM Rework_Process_Usage WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE	reas_cd = @rework_reas_cd AND
				orig_rework_cd = @orig_rework_cd AND
                item_id IS NULL AND
                orig_process_id IS NULL
    END

    IF (@rework_process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
         set @return_message = 'Cannot find rework process. Rework not initiated.{5621}'
         RETURN
    END

    --  Read all relevant system attributes.
    SELECT @separate_wo = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 377

	IF ( @separate_wo = '1' ) BEGIN -- L00075076: 378, 382, and 398 depend on 377.

		SELECT @rework_wo_desc = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 378
		SELECT @copy_wo_at_end = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 382
		SELECT @combine_rework = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 398

	END ELSE BEGIN

		SELECT @rework_wo_desc = NULL, @copy_wo_at_end = '0', @combine_rework = '0'

	END

    SELECT @modify_lot = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 379
    SELECT @redo_original_work = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 380
    SELECT @modify_ops = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 381
    SELECT @count_use_woid = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 383
    SELECT @count_use_opid = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 384
    SELECT @count_use_seq = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 385
    SELECT @count_use_reason = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 386
    SELECT @count_use_process = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 387

    --  Validate input parameters and system attributes.
    IF (@parent_wo_id IS NULL) OR (@parent_oper_id IS NULL) OR (@parent_seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Parent work order id, operation id, and sequence no cannot be NULL. Rework not initiated.{9999}', 16, 1)
    END

    IF (@copy_wo_at_end = '1') AND (@separate_wo <> '1') BEGIN
        RAISERROR('System attribute 382 is set when system attribute 377 is not set. Rework not initiated.{9999}', 16, 1)
    END

    --  Generate a new work order ID (which may only be temporarily used depending on
    --  how the system is configured).
    IF ((@modify_ops = '1') AND (@separate_wo = '1')) BEGIN
        --  Determine the next INT32 for the new work order.

		SET @next_wo_number = 0
        SELECT @next_wo_number = MAX(value1)
        FROM
			(SELECT substring(wo_id, CHARINDEX( '-', wo_id ) + len(@rework_wo_desc) + 1, len(wo_id))  as value1
                FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id LIKE ('%' + '-' + @rework_wo_desc + '%')) AS nextwo
		WHERE ISNUMERIC(nextwo.value1) = 1


        SET @next_wo_number = ISNULL( @next_wo_number, 0 ) + 1

        --  Construct the next rework work order id.
        SET @rework_wo_id = @parent_wo_id + '-' + @rework_wo_desc + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @next_wo_number )
    END ELSE BEGIN
        EXEC sp_SA_WO_GetNextWoId @rework_wo_id OUTPUT
    END

    --  Determine if rework count has been exceeded.
    IF (@count_use_woid = '1') BEGIN
		SET @count_woid = @parent_wo_id
    END ELSE BEGIN
        SET @count_woid = ''
    END

    IF (@count_use_opid = '1') BEGIN
        SET @count_opid = @parent_oper_id
    END ELSE BEGIN
        SET @count_opid = ''
    END

    IF (@count_use_seq = '1') BEGIN
        SET @count_seq = @parent_seq_no
    END ELSE BEGIN
        SET @count_seq = ''
    END

    IF (@count_use_reason = '1') BEGIN
        SET @count_reason = @rework_reas_cd
    END ELSE BEGIN
		SET @count_reason = ''
    END

    IF (@count_use_process = '1') BEGIN
        SET @count_process = @parent_process_id
    END ELSE BEGIN
        SET @count_process = ''
    END

    SELECT @rework_count = times_rework, @count_row = row_id
    FROM rework_count WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE item_id = @item_id
      AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
      AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
      AND wo_id = @count_woid
      AND oper_id = @count_opid
      AND seq_no = @count_seq
      AND reas_cd = @count_reason
      AND process_id = @count_process

	IF ( @rework_count IS NULL ) BEGIN

        SET @rework_count = 0
        EXEC sp_I_Rework_Count	@item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @count_woid, @count_opid, @count_seq,
								@count_reason, @count_process, @rework_count, NULL, @count_date, @count_row
    END

    IF (@max_times_rework IS NOT NULL) AND (@rework_count >= @max_times_rework) BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Maximum rework count has been exceeded. Rework not initiated.{5622}', 16, 1)
    END

    --  Determine if there is an existing work order with all of the new jobs that will be created
    --    for this rework work order.
    SET @existing_wo = NULL

    -- CR L00075592 SLR 08/2009
    -- Existing work order only matters when using separate work orders for rework and the combine rework is true
	-- CR L00115914 - added rework process id and item id to query to find existing WO in order to find based on correct context
    IF (@combine_rework = '1' ) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @existing_wo = wo_id
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT oper_id
						  FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
						  WHERE process_id = @rework_process_id AND item_id = @item_id AND
								oper_id NOT IN (
									SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job.wo_id = wo.wo_id AND job.act_start_time_local IS NULL AND process_id = @rework_process_id AND item_id = @item_id
								)
						  )
		AND process_id = @rework_process_id AND item_id = @item_id
    END
    -- else if not using separate work order, see if there is an unstarted job for this rework
    ELSE if(@separate_wo = '0')BEGIN
       SELECT TOP 1 @existing_wo = wo_id
       FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
       WHERE job.wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND job.rework_process_id = @rework_process_id AND job.act_start_time_local IS NULL
    END

    --  If an existing work order is found, just add this new rework to the existing work order . . .
    IF (@existing_wo IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        IF(@separate_wo = '0') BEGIN
            --  Determine start quantity of existing job
            SELECT @current_start_qty = qty_at_start, @current_req_qty = qty_reqd, @current_seq_no = seq_no
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo
               AND rework_process_id = @rework_process_id
               AND oper_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oper_id FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @rework_process_id)

   			--  Update quantities in existing Job.
			DECLARE @temp1 AS TFLOAT, @temp2 AS TFLOAT
			SET @temp1 = (@current_req_qty + @reqd_qty)
			set @temp2 = (@current_start_qty + @start_qty)

            UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = @temp2, qty_reqd = @temp1
            WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo
               AND rework_process_id = @rework_process_id AND seq_no = @current_seq_no

            --  Calculate input percent for first job in new rework jobs.
            SELECT @input_percent = (@temp1 / qty_reqd)
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id = @parent_oper_id

           --  Update percentage for first job of rework
            UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = @input_percent
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id = (SELECT TOP 1 oper_id FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE process_id = @rework_process_id)
            AND seq_no = @current_seq_no AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id

            -- determine the number of non rework jobs going into the same job as the rework job
            SELECT @non_rework_jobs = count(*)
              FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
              WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
              AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
                                   FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
                                 )

            -- determine reentry operation of rework back into job
            SELECT @reentry_oper_id = oper_id, @reentry_seq_no = seq_no
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_cd = @reentry_rework_cd

            IF @reentry_oper_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
            -- if reentry is not back into next job, quantities must be recalculated for jobs rework skips over
               IF(@reentry_oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
                                            FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
                                            WHERE input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
                                            AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
                                                                 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                                                 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
                                                               )
                                          )
                 )
               BEGIN
                   DECLARE @startSub TFLOAT
                   DECLARE @reqSub   TFLOAT

                   SET @old_oper_id = @parent_oper_id
                   SET @old_seq_no = @parent_seq_no

				   SET @startSub = @start_qty/@non_rework_jobs
				   SET @reqSub = @reqd_qty/@non_rework_jobs

                   WHILE(@old_oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id)
                   BEGIN
					   --Check if the required quantity is a whole number
					   IF (SELECT num_decimals FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE item_id = @item_id) = 0
					   BEGIN
						   -- update using closest whole number
						   UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (qty_at_start - FLOOR(@startSub)),
									  qty_reqd = (qty_reqd - FLOOR(@reqSub))
						   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id
						   AND oper_id in ( SELECT oper_id
											FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
											WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
											AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
																 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
																 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
															   )
										  )
						   AND seq_no in ( SELECT seq_no
										   FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
										   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
										   AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
																FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
																WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
															  )
										 )
						   -- if there was a decimal portion, add to first job
						   IF (@startSub <> FLOOR(@startSub) OR @reqSub <> FLOOR(@reqSub))
						   BEGIN
							   -- apply one to first job
                               DECLARE @first_seq_no INT32
							   SELECT TOP 1 @first_oper_id = oper_id, @first_seq_no = seq_no
							   FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
							   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id in (SELECT oper_id
																		   FROM job_route  WITH (NOLOCK)
																		   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
																		   AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
																							   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
																							   )
																		   )
                               IF(@first_oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id)
                               BEGIN
								   IF (@startSub <> FLOOR(@startSub))
										SET @startSub = 1
								   ELSE
										SET @startSub = 0

								   If (@reqSub <> FLOOR(@reqSub))
										SET @reqSub = 1
								   ELSE
										SET @reqSub = 0

								   UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (qty_at_start - @startSub), qty_reqd = (qty_reqd - @reqSub)
								   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id = @first_oper_id AND seq_no = @first_seq_no
                               END
						  END
					   END
					   ELSE
					   -- quantities have decimals so use quantity
					   BEGIN
						   UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (qty_at_start - @startSub),
									  qty_reqd = (qty_reqd - @reqSub)
						   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id
                           AND oper_id in ( SELECT oper_id
										    FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
											WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
											AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
																 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
															   )
										  )
						   AND seq_no in ( SELECT seq_no
										   FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
										   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
										   AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
															    WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
															  )
										 )
					   END
                       -- reset the oper_id and seq_no to next job
                       SELECT @old_oper_id = oper_id, @old_seq_no = seq_no
                       FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
                       WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
                       AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL)

                  END -- END WHILE LOOP

				  --  Update percentages for routes leaving the parent job.
				  UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = (( SELECT qty_reqd
				   										  FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
														  WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and rework_process_id IS NULL
														  AND oper_id IN ( SELECT oper_id
														   				   FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
																		   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id and input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no)
														) /
														( SELECT qty_reqd
														  FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
														  WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and oper_id = @parent_oper_id
														))
				  WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id
				  AND oper_id IN ( SELECT oper_id
								   FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
								   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and rework_process_id IS NULL
                                 )

               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                  --  Calculate input percent for first job in rework jobs before add new amount.
                  SELECT @input_percent = (@input_percent - (@current_req_qty / qty_reqd))
			      FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                  WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id = @parent_oper_id

    			   -- update the input percent for all other jobs going into the same job as this rework job that are not rework
				   UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = (input_percent - (@input_percent/@non_rework_jobs))
				   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id and input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
				   AND oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id
				    			   FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
								   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and rework_process_id IS NULL)
               END
            END
       END ELSE BEGIN
			--  Determine start quantity of existing WO.
			SELECT @current_start_qty = sum(qty_at_start)
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo
			  AND first_job = 1

			--  Retrieve other parameters that do not change in existing wo but are needed for quantity update call.
			SELECT @current_req_qty = req_qty, @existing_process_id = process_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo

			--  Blank-out the process id temporarily so update works properly.
			UPDATE wo SET process_id = NULL WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo

			--  Update quantities in existing WO.
--			DECLARE @temp1 AS TFLOAT, @temp2 AS TFLOAT
			SET @temp1 = (@current_req_qty + @reqd_qty)
			set @temp2 = (@current_start_qty + @start_qty)


			EXEC sp_Alloc_Job_Qty	@existing_wo, NULL, @item_id, @temp1, @user_id, @temp2,
									@req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_tz, @release_time, @release_time_tz, NULL

			--  Now update the wo record itself with new quantities and correct process id.
			UPDATE wo SET process_id = @existing_process_id, req_qty = (@current_req_qty + @reqd_qty)
			WHERE wo_id = @existing_wo
        END
        --  . . . otherwise, call the stored procedure to create a wo from a process (in this case, the rework process).

    END ELSE BEGIN
        --  Create a new wo.
        EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CWOFP_Stack	@rework_wo_id, @rework_process_id, @item_id, @reqd_qty, @user_id, @start_qty,
										@init_wo_state, @rework_wo_desc, @release_time, @release_time_tz, @req_finish_time,
										@req_finish_time_tz, @wo_priority, @cust_info, @mo_id, NULL, @notes, @bom_ver_id, @for_first_op,
										@spec_ver_id, @may_override_route, @parent_wo_id, @parent_oper_id, @parent_seq_no,
										NULL, NULL, @check_privs


        --  Get the first operator id for use in the return message.
        SELECT TOP 1 @first_oper_id = oper_id
        FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id
          AND first_job = 1

        --  If the fourth system attribute indicates that the original job should be repeated at
        --    the end of the rework, BEGIN copy an instance of this job to the end of the rework jobs.
        IF (@redo_original_work = '1') BEGIN
            -- Copy the job without copying the routings.
            EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_NoRoute	@parent_wo_id, @parent_oper_id, @parent_seq_no, @user_id, @rework_wo_id, @parent_oper_id,
												@parent_seq_no, @reqd_qty, @start_qty, NULL, @req_finish_time, NULL, NULL, @req_finish_time_tz

            -- Mark the new job as non-final and link from the final jobs to this job.
            UPDATE job SET final_job = 0
            WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id
              AND oper_id = @parent_oper_id
              AND seq_no = @parent_seq_no


			INSERT INTO @final_job ( oper_id, seq_no )
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id and final_job = 1

			SELECT @fj_i = MIN( id ), @fj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @final_job

            WHILE ( @fj_i <= @fj_max_i ) BEGIN

				SELECT @fj_oper_id = oper_id, @fj_seq_no = seq_no FROM @final_job WHERE id = @fj_i
				EXEC sp_I_Job_Route	@rework_wo_id, @parent_oper_id, @parent_seq_no, @fj_oper_id, @fj_seq_no, 1.00, NULL, @out_mod_id OUTPUT

				SET @fj_i = (@fj_i + 1)

            END

            -- Make the new job the final job of the route.
            UPDATE job SET final_job = 0
            WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id
              AND final_job = 1

            UPDATE job SET final_job = 1
            WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id
              AND oper_id = @parent_oper_id
              AND seq_no = @parent_seq_no
        END

        --  If the sixth system attribute indicates that the remaining jobs in the parent wo should be
        --    replicated at the end of the rework, BEGIN copy all those jobs to the end of the rework.
        IF (@copy_wo_at_end = '1') BEGIN
            --  Determine next job using job route from originating job.
            SELECT	@next_oper_id = NULL
				,	@next_seq_no = NULL

            SELECT TOP 1 @next_oper_id = oper_id, @next_seq_no = seq_no
            FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
              AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id
              AND input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no

            --  Traverse the job routes starting from the parent job initiating the re-work and
            --  clone them into the rework.  Terminate when the last job is encountered.
            SET @first_job_found = NULL

            WHILE (@next_oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
                --  Read the next job data.
                SELECT	@next_state_cd = state_cd, @next_req_finish_time_local = req_finish_time_local
					,	@next_target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id, @next_status_notes = status_notes
                FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @next_oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

                --  Clone the job.
                IF (@first_job_found IS NULL) BEGIN
                    EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_NoRoute	@parent_wo_id, @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no, @user_id, @rework_wo_id,
														@next_oper_id, @next_seq_no, @reqd_qty, @start_qty, @next_state_cd,
														@next_req_finish_time_local, @next_target_sched_ent_id, @next_status_notes,
														@time_zone_bias_value

                END ELSE BEGIN
                    EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob	@parent_wo_id, @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no, @user_id, @rework_wo_id, @next_oper_id,
												@next_seq_no, @reqd_qty, @start_qty, @next_state_cd, @next_req_finish_time_local,
												@next_target_sched_ent_id, @next_status_notes, @time_zone_bias_value
                END

                --  Link the final jobs of the rework into the first job of the jobs to be copied.
                IF (@first_job_found IS NULL) BEGIN

					DELETE FROM @final_job

					INSERT INTO @final_job ( oper_id, seq_no )
					SELECT oper_id, seq_no
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id AND final_job = 1 AND NOT(oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no)

					SELECT @fj_i = MIN( id ), @fj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @final_job

					WHILE ( @fj_i <= @fj_max_i ) BEGIN
				                        SELECT @fj_oper_id = oper_id, @fj_seq_no = seq_no FROM @final_job WHERE id = @fj_i
						EXEC sp_I_Job_Route	@rework_wo_id, @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no, @fj_oper_id, @fj_seq_no, 1.00, NULL,
											@out_mod_id OUTPUT

						SET @fj_i = (@fj_i + 1)

                    END

                    SET @first_job_found = 1

                END

                -- Determine the next job using job route from originating job.
                SELECT	@old_oper_id = @next_oper_id
					,	@old_seq_no = @next_seq_no
					,	@next_oper_id = NULL
					,	@next_seq_no = NULL


                SELECT TOP 1 @next_oper_id = oper_id, @next_seq_no = seq_no
                FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
                  AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id
                  AND input_seq_no = @old_seq_no

            END
        END

        --  If the fifth system attribute indicates that the oper_id's should be unique,
        --  BEGIN change the oper_id's of all new jobs.
        If ((@modify_ops = '1') AND (@separate_wo = '0')) BEGIN
            --  Determine the next INT32 for the new operations.
            SET @next_oper_number = 0
            SELECT @next_oper_number = MAX(value_.value)
            FROM (SELECT CAST (SUBSTRING(oper_id, CHARINDEX(oper_id,'-',1) + LEN(@rework_wo_desc) + 1, LEN(oper_id)) AS INT) as value
                    FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE oper_id LIKE ( '%' + '-' + @rework_wo_desc + '%' )
                ) AS value_

            SET @next_oper_number = COALESCE(@next_oper_number, 0) + 1

			DELETE FROM @next_job

			INSERT INTO @next_job ( oper_id, seq_no, qty_reqd, qty_at_start, state_cd, req_finish_time_local, target_sched_ent_id, status_notes )
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no, qty_reqd, qty_at_start, state_cd, req_finish_time_local, target_sched_ent_id, status_notes
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id

			SELECT @nj_i = MIN( id ), @nj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @next_job

			DECLARE @temp AS NVARCHAR(1000)

            --  Clone each job using a new operator id and delete the old job
            WHILE ( @nj_i <= @nj_max_i ) BEGIN

				SELECT	@nj_oper_id = oper_id, @nj_seq_no = seq_no, @nj_qty_reqd = qty_reqd, @nj_qty_at_start = qty_at_start
					,	@nj_state_cd = state_cd, @nj_req_finish_time_local = req_finish_time_local
					,	@nj_target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id, @nj_status_notes = status_notes
				FROM @next_job
				WHERE id = @nj_i

				SET @temp1 = ( @nj_oper_id + '-' + @rework_wo_desc + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @next_oper_number ) )

                EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob	@rework_wo_id, @nj_oper_id, @nj_seq_no, @user_id, @rework_wo_id, @temp1,
											@nj_seq_no, @nj_qty_reqd, @nj_qty_at_start, @nj_state_cd, @nj_req_finish_time_local,
											@nj_target_sched_ent_id, @nj_status_notes, @time_zone_bias_value

                EXEC sp_D_Job @rework_wo_id, @nj_oper_id, @nj_seq_no

				SET @nj_i = (@nj_i + 1)

            END
        END

        --  If the first system attribute indicates that rework jobs should be added to
        --  the existing parent WO, BEGIN do so.
        IF (@separate_wo = '0') BEGIN
            --  Find the display sequence in the originating job from the parent.
            SELECT @orig_display_seq = display_seq
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
              AND oper_id = @parent_oper_id
              AND seq_no = @parent_seq_no

            --  Update the display sequence in all jobs in the re-work, before adding
            --    them to the parent.
            UPDATE job SET display_seq = display_seq + @orig_display_seq
            WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id

            --  Find the job in the parent wo where the re-work re-enters the wo.
            SELECT @reentry_oper_id = NULL, @reentry_seq_no = NULL

            SELECT @reentry_oper_id = oper_id, @reentry_seq_no = seq_no
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_cd = @reentry_rework_cd

            IF @reentry_oper_id IS NULL BEGIN
                SELECT TOP 1 @reentry_oper_id = oper_id, @reentry_seq_no = seq_no
                FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
                  AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id
                  AND input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
            END

            --  Get one more than the maximum sequence INT32 of the jobs in the existing WO.
            SELECT @max_seq_no = ( MAX(seq_no) + 1 )
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id

			DELETE FROM @next_job

            INSERT INTO @next_job ( oper_id, seq_no, qty_reqd, qty_at_start, state_cd, req_finish_time_local, target_sched_ent_id, status_notes )
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no, qty_reqd, qty_at_start, state_cd, req_finish_time_local, target_sched_ent_id, status_notes
			FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id

			SELECT @nj_i = MIN( id ), @nj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @next_job

			--  Clone all the jobs into the parent work order (with no routes).
            WHILE ( @nj_i <= @nj_max_i ) BEGIN

				SELECT	@nj_oper_id = oper_id, @nj_seq_no = seq_no, @nj_qty_reqd = qty_reqd, @nj_qty_at_start = qty_at_start
					,	@nj_state_cd = state_cd, @nj_req_finish_time_local = req_finish_time_local
					,	@nj_target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id, @nj_status_notes = status_notes
				FROM @next_job
				WHERE id = @nj_i

				EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CloneJob_NoRoute	@rework_wo_id, @nj_oper_id, @nj_seq_no, @user_id, @parent_wo_id, @nj_oper_id,
													@max_seq_no, @nj_qty_reqd, @nj_qty_at_start, @nj_state_cd, @nj_req_finish_time_local,
													@nj_target_sched_ent_id, @nj_status_notes, @time_zone_bias_value

				SET @nj_i = (@nj_i + 1)

            END

            --  Transfer all of the job route records to the parent work order.
            UPDATE job_route SET wo_id = @parent_wo_id, seq_no = @max_seq_no, input_seq_no = @max_seq_no
            WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id

            --  Calculate input percent for first job in new rework jobs.
            SELECT @input_percent = (@reqd_qty / qty_reqd)
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id = @parent_oper_id

            --  Update percentages for routes leaving the parent job.
            --UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = 1.00 - @input_percent
            --WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id

            -- determine the number of non rework jobs going into the same job as the rework job
            SELECT @non_rework_jobs = count(*)
              FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
              WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
              AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
                                   FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
                                 )

            -- Update quantities of jobs if rework doesn't return to next job in 'normal' job
            IF (@reentry_oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
               IF(@reentry_oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
                                            FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
                                            WHERE input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
                                            AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
                                                                 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                                                 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
                                                               )
                                          )
                 )
               BEGIN
                   -- reentry is not at the next job so have to update quantities
                   SET @old_oper_id = @parent_oper_id
                   SET @old_seq_no = @parent_seq_no

                   SET @startSub = @start_qty/@non_rework_jobs
                   SET @reqSub = @reqd_qty/@non_rework_jobs

                   WHILE(@old_oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id)
                   BEGIN
					   --Check if the required quantity is a whole number
					   IF (SELECT num_decimals FROM item  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id) = 0
					   BEGIN
						   -- update using closest whole number
				 		   UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (qty_at_start - FLOOR(@startSub)),
									  qty_reqd = (qty_reqd - FLOOR(@reqSub))
						   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id
						   AND oper_id IN ( SELECT oper_id
											FROM job_route  WITH (NOLOCK)
											WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
											AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
																 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
									       						 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
																)
										  )
						   AND seq_no in ( SELECT seq_no
										   FROM job_route  WITH (NOLOCK)
										   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
										   AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id
																FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
									 							WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
															  )
										 )

						   -- if there was a decimal portion, add to first job
						   IF (@startSub <> FLOOR(@startSub) OR @reqSub <> FLOOR(@reqSub))
						   BEGIN
							  -- apply one to first job
							   SELECT TOP 1 @first_oper_id = oper_id, @first_seq_no = seq_no
							   FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
							   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
                               AND oper_id in ( SELECT oper_id
												FROM job_route  WITH (NOLOCK)
												WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
												AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
																	 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
																   )
											  )
                               IF(@first_oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id)
                               BEGIN
								   IF (@startSub <> FLOOR(@startSub))
										SET @startSub = 1
								   ELSE
										SET @startSub = 0

								   If (@reqSub <> FLOOR(@reqSub))
										SET @reqSub = 1
								   ELSE
										SET @reqSub = 0

								   UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (qty_at_start - @startSub), qty_reqd = (qty_reqd - @reqSub)
								   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id = @first_oper_id AND seq_no = @first_seq_no
                               END
						  END
					   END
					   ELSE
					   -- quantities have decimals so use quantity
					   BEGIN
						   UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (qty_at_start - @startSub),
									  qty_reqd = (qty_reqd - @reqSub)
						   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND oper_id <> @reentry_oper_id
						   AND oper_id in (SELECT oper_id
																	   FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
																	   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
																	   AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
																						   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
																						   )
																	   )
						   AND seq_no in (SELECT seq_no
										  FROM job_route  WITH (NOLOCK)
										  WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
										  AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
															  WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL
															 )
										 )
					   END
					   -- reset the oper_id and seq_no to next job
					   SELECT @old_oper_id = oper_id, @old_seq_no = seq_no
					   FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
					   WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and input_oper_id = @old_oper_id and input_seq_no = @old_seq_no
                       AND oper_id NOT IN ( SELECT oper_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND rework_process_id IS NOT NULL)

                    END -- END OF WHILE LOOP

					--  Update percentages for routes leaving the parent job.
					UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = (( SELECT qty_reqd
															FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
															WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and rework_process_id IS NULL
															AND oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id
																			FROM job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
																			WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id and input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no)
														   ) /
														   ( SELECT qty_reqd
															 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
															 WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and oper_id = @parent_oper_id
														   )
														 )
					WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id
					AND oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id
									FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and rework_process_id IS NULL)

               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                    -- update the input percent for all other jobs going into the same job as the rework
                    UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = (input_percent - (@input_percent/@non_rework_jobs))
                    WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND input_oper_id = @parent_oper_id and input_seq_no = @parent_seq_no
                    AND oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id
                                    FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
                                    WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id and rework_process_id IS NULL)
               END
            END

			DELETE FROM @next_job

			INSERT INTO @next_job ( oper_id )
			SELECT oper_id FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id AND first_job = 1

			SELECT @nj_i = MIN( id ), @nj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @next_job

            --  Link from the parent job to the first job of the new rework jobs.
            WHILE ( @nj_i <= @nj_max_i ) BEGIN

				SELECT @nj_oper_id = oper_id FROM @next_job WHERE id = @nj_i

                EXEC sp_I_Job_Route	@parent_wo_id, @nj_oper_id, @max_seq_no, @parent_oper_id, @parent_seq_no,
									@input_percent, NULL, @out_mod_id OUTPUT

                SET @first_oper_id = @nj_oper_id

				SET @nj_i = ( @nj_i + 1 )
            END


			DELETE FROM @next_job

			INSERT INTO @next_job ( oper_id )
			SELECT oper_id FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @rework_wo_id AND final_job = 1

			SELECT @nj_i = MIN( id ), @nj_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @next_job

            --  Link from the final jobs of the new rework jobs to the job in the parent wo
            --  that has the appropriate rework code.
            WHILE ( @nj_i <= @nj_max_i ) BEGIN

				SELECT @nj_oper_id = oper_id FROM @next_job WHERE id = @nj_i

                EXEC sp_I_Job_Route	@parent_wo_id, @reentry_oper_id, @reentry_seq_no, @nj_oper_id, @max_seq_no, 1.00,
									NULL, @out_mod_id OUTPUT

				SET @nj_i = (@nj_i + 1)

            END


           --  Determine start quantity of parent WO.
            SELECT @current_start_qty = sum(qty_at_start)
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND final_job = 1

            --  Retrieve other parameters that do not change in existing wo but are needed for quantity update call.
            SELECT @current_req_qty = req_qty
            FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id

            --  Blank-out the process id temporarily so update works properly.
            UPDATE wo SET process_id = NULL WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id

            --  Update quantities in existing WO.
            EXEC sp_Alloc_Job_Qty	@parent_wo_id, NULL, @item_id, @current_req_qty, @user_id, @current_start_qty, @req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_tz,
									@release_time, @release_time_tz, NULL

            --  Now update the wo record itself with correct process id.
            UPDATE wo SET process_id = @parent_process_id
              WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id

            --  Delete the new rework work order (since it is no longer needed).
            EXEC sp_D_WO @rework_wo_id, null
       END
       ELSE BEGIN -- separate wo
       -- update quantities of parent work order
           --  Determine start quantity of parent WO.
            SELECT @current_start_qty = sum(qty_at_start)
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id AND final_job = 1

            --  Retrieve other parameters that do not change in existing wo but are needed for quantity update call.
            SELECT @current_req_qty = req_qty
            FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id

            -- preportion required amount
            SET @temp1 = @current_req_qty/@current_start_qty;

   			--  Update quantities in existing Job.
			set @temp2 = (@current_start_qty - @start_qty)
			SET @temp1 = (@temp2 * @temp1)

            --  Blank-out the process id temporarily so update works properly.
            UPDATE wo SET process_id = NULL WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id

            --  Update quantities in existing WO.
            EXEC sp_Alloc_Job_Qty	@parent_wo_id, NULL, @item_id, @temp2, @user_id, @temp1, @req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_tz,
									@release_time, @release_time_tz, NULL

            --  Now update the wo record itself with correct process id.
            UPDATE wo SET process_id = @parent_process_id
              WHERE wo_id = @parent_wo_id
       END
    END

    --  Split the rework into a new lot depending upon the third system attribute.
    IF (@modify_lot = '2') BEGIN
        -- Generate a new lot id.

        EXEC sp_SA_Lot_GetNextLotNo	@item_id, @new_lot_no OUTPUT

        -- Get row id and edit time from inventory record.
        SELECT TOP 1 @from_ent_id = ent_id, @inv_item_last_edit = last_edit_at, @inv_item_row_id = row_id
        FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE item_id = @item_id
          AND lot_no = @lot_no
          AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))

		-- Split the rework into a new lot.
        EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Split	@inv_item_row_id, @inv_item_last_edit, @reqd_qty, @from_ent_id, @item_id, @new_lot_no,
									@sublot_no, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value

    END ELSE IF (@modify_lot = '3') BEGIN

        --  Determine the total lot quantity in inventory.
        SELECT @total_lot_qty = SUM(qty_left)
        FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE lot_no = @lot_no

        --  Only create a new lot if the rework is less than the inventory left.
        IF (@reqd_qty < @total_lot_qty) BEGIN
            -- Generate a new lot id.
            EXEC sp_SA_Lot_GetNextLotNo	@item_id, @new_lot_no OUTPUT

            -- Get row id and edit time from inventory record.
            SELECT TOP 1 @from_ent_id = ent_id, @inv_item_last_edit = last_edit_at, @inv_item_row_id = row_id
            FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE item_id = @item_id
              AND lot_no = @lot_no
              AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))

            -- Split the rework into a new lot.
            EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Split	@inv_item_row_id, @inv_item_last_edit, @reqd_qty, @from_ent_id, @item_id, new_lot_no,
										@sublot_no, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value
        END
    END

    --  Update the rework count in the table.
    SET @rework_count = @rework_count + 1
    EXEC sp_U_Rework_Count	@count_row, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @count_woid, @count_opid, @count_seq, @count_reason, @count_process,
							@rework_count, NULL, NULL

    --  Generate return message.
    IF (@separate_wo = '0') BEGIN
        IF (@modify_ops = '0') BEGIN
            SET @return_message = 'One or more rework jobs starting at operation %1 has been added to this work order for this production.<5619>,' + @first_oper_id
        END ELSE BEGIN
            SET @return_message = 'A rework quantity of %1 has been added to rework jobs starting at operation %2 of this work order.<5617>,' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @reqd_qty ) + ',' + @first_oper_id
        END
    END ELSE BEGIN
        IF (@modify_ops = '0') BEGIN
            SET @return_message = 'Rework work order %1 has been created for this production.<5620>,' + @rework_wo_id
        END ELSE BEGIN
            SET @return_message = 'A rework quantity of %1 has been added to rework jobs starting at operation %2 of work order %3.<5618>,' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @reqd_qty ) + ',' + @first_oper_id + ',' + @rework_wo_id
        END
    END


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_StrtDataEntryJob]
(
		@user_id				STRING40
	,	@ent_id					INT32
	,	@wo_id					STRING40
	,	@oper_id				STRING40
	,	@item_id				STRING40
	,	@est_prod_rate			TFLOAT
	,	@prod_uom				INT32
	,	@uom_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare1					NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
	,	@spare2					NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
	,	@spare3					NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
	,	@spare4					NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value  	INT32 = NULL
	,	@seq_no					INT32_NULL OUTPUT

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_StrtDataEntryJob
-- Description			- (HD# 4913) Start Data Entry Job
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 08/17/2004
-- Version				- 2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/22/2004		Raghu			2.1.1	Included new spare1-4, seq_no parameters in the sp list
--											Also, sp is changed to return the current seq_no for a job
-- 10/22/2004		Raghu			2.1.5	HD# 5055, Added flag to propogate downstream jobs
-- 09/28/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/05/2006		Raghu			3.1.7	sp_I_Wo was not supplying time_zone_bias_value. Issue fixed.
-- 07/21/2006		Raghu			3.1.20	HD# 8487, Delegate to startBatchJobs; Also, supply time_zone_bias_value to batch jobs.
-- 											let the SP_U_JOB_EXEC_STARTBATCHJOBS determine the available job position.
-- 03/23/2007    	Raghu     		3.1.27  HD# 9624, The job.act_finish_time is not correctly adjusted w.r.t bias value;
--											causes negative duration in util_log.
-- 05/23/2007    	Raghu       	3.2.29  Start data entry job must default create_job_bom flag to true. A job should
--                                  		always have job_bom 0 record; unless otherwise it is instructed not to.
--01/21/2008		Raghu			3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--07/17/2009        SARA                    4.0.0   Part of DB Changes
--08/20/2009        SARA			4.0     L00075592 Added null for rework_process_id parameter to SP_I_JOB
--08/21/2009        Raghu			4.0     Added null for production_schedule_id param while calling sp_I_Wo
-- 12/12/2009		AJAY			4.0.0   H1423 FIX/Changes
--10/03/2011        Praveen P       4.0 SP2 CR #L00116938 Clone CR-L00111906 HF2468
-- 04/01/2016		Abhay Pandey	5.03		US #615667 (CR-L00140560): Changes done in order to update the job table with supplied est_prod_rate instead
--											of existing one when supplied and exisiting est_prod_rate values are different for an existing job.(While calling an API -JobExec.StartDataEntryJob)
-- 08/04/2016		Raghu G			5.3		UserStory: 668382 - As Lenka, I want a job starting/suspending/ending on an entity to be updated in the job_history table
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@item_class_id			STRING40
		,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME
		,	@state_cd				INT32
		,	@uom_id_temp			INT32
		,	@mod_id					NVARCHAR(30)
		,	@ent_can_sched			INT32
		,	@display_seq			INT32
		,	@est_prod_rate_temp		TFLOAT
		,	@prod_uom_temp		INT32
		,	@cur_wo_id				STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id			STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no				INT32
		,	@ret					INT32
		,	@cur_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@cur_shift_start_local	TDATETIME
		,	@deviation_above		STRING40
		,	@deviation_below		STRING40

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_run_jobs = 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The supplied entity cannot run jobs{3293}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SET @uom_id_temp = -1
	SELECT @uom_id_temp = uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id
--	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
	IF (@uom_id_temp = -1) BEGIN
		IF (@uom_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The Uom_Id must be supplied to create a new item{3318}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_class WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE produced = 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('There are no item classes for which produced is true{3457}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT TOP 1 @item_class_id = item_class_id FROM item_class WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE produced = 1

		EXEC sp_I_Item	@item_id, @item_id, @item_class_id, @uom_id, 0, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 1, 7, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, -1, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						NULL, @last_edit_at OUTPUT
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@uom_id IS NOT NULL AND @uom_id <> @uom_id_temp) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The supplied measurement(uom) does not match with the existing measurement of an item (uom){3458}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SET @state_cd = -1
	SELECT @state_cd = state_cd FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	IF (@state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The supplied work order is closed{3560}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@state_cd = -1) BEGIN
		-- 07/17/2009 SLR Added null values for the input_wo_id, input_oper_id and input_seq_no parameters
		EXEC sp_I_Wo    @wo_id, @wo_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, @item_id, 0, NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @mod_id OUTPUT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND run_ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @seq_no = -1
		SELECT TOP 1 @seq_no = seq_no, @est_prod_rate_temp = est_prod_rate, @prod_uom = prod_uom FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND item_id = @item_id AND run_ent_id = @ent_id

		IF (@seq_no = -1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The supplied item does not match with the existing job item{3561}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (@est_prod_rate <> @est_prod_rate_temp OR @prod_uom <> @prod_uom_temp) BEGIN
			UPDATE job
			SET est_prod_rate = CASE WHEN @est_prod_rate <> ISNULL(@est_prod_rate_temp, @est_prod_rate) THEN @est_prod_rate ELSE @est_prod_rate_temp END,
				prod_uom = CASE WHEN @prod_uom <> ISNULL(@prod_uom_temp, @prod_uom) THEN @prod_uom_temp ELSE @prod_uom END,
				spare1 = CASE WHEN @spare1 IS NULL THEN spare1 ELSE @spare1 END,
				spare2 = CASE WHEN @spare2 IS NULL THEN spare2 ELSE @spare2 END,
				spare3 = CASE WHEN @spare3 IS NULL THEN spare3 ELSE @spare3 END,
				spare4 = CASE WHEN @spare4 IS NULL THEN spare4 ELSE @spare4 END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

			--The job_hour_history (tpm_stat) record will be created for a job when the job is started
		END
		ELSE
			UPDATE job
			SET spare1 = CASE WHEN @spare1 IS NULL THEN spare1 ELSE @spare1 END,
				spare2 = CASE WHEN @spare2 IS NULL THEN spare2 ELSE @spare2 END,
				spare3 = CASE WHEN @spare3 IS NULL THEN spare3 ELSE @spare3 END,
				spare4 = CASE WHEN @spare4 IS NULL THEN spare4 ELSE @spare4 END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @ent_can_sched = @ent_id
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_sched_jobs = 1) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetSchedulableEntity @ent_can_sched OUTPUT
		END
		IF (@ent_can_sched IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Neither the supplied entity nor any of its ancestor entities are schedulable{3564}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @seq_no = MAX(seq_no), @display_seq = MAX(display_seq) FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
		SELECT @seq_no = ISNULL(@seq_no, -1) + 1, @display_seq = ISNULL(@display_seq, -1) + 1, @last_edit_at = NULL

		SELECT @deviation_above = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 103
		SELECT @deviation_below = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 104
		-- 07/17/2009 RWB Added null values for the segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters
		-- 08/20/2009 SLR Added null value for the rework_process_id parameter and removed null values for segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters
		EXEC sp_I_Job @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_desc=NULL, @item_id=@item_id, @state_cd=2, @job_priority=1, @req_finish_time_local=NULL, @req_finish_time_tz=NULL, @init_sched_ent_id=@ent_can_sched, @target_sched_ent_id=@ent_can_sched,
			@run_ent_id=@ent_id, @qty_reqd=0, @qty_prod=0, @qty_prod_erp=0, @qty_rejected=0, @qty_rejected_erp=0, @qty_at_start=0, @deviation_above=@deviation_above, @deviation_below=@deviation_below, @batch_size=1, @first_job=0, @final_job=0, @sched_pinned=0, @check_inv=0, --check_inv
			@est_fixed_lab=NULL, @est_lab_rate=NULL, @est_setup_time=NULL, @est_teardown_time=NULL, @est_prod_rate=@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom=@prod_uom, @est_transfer_time=NULL, @sched_start_time_local=NULL, @sched_start_time_tz=NULL, @latest_start_time_local=NULL, @latest_start_time_tz=NULL, @sched_finish_time_local=NULL,
			@sched_finish_time_tz=NULL, @act_start_time_local=NULL, @act_start_time_tz=NULL, @act_finish_time_local=NULL, @act_finish_time_tz=NULL, @concurrent_link=0, -- concurrent_link
			@job_cost=NULL, @parent_contingent_job=0, @child_contingent_job=0, @notes=NULL, @assoc_file=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @display_seq=@display_seq, @folder_ver_id=NULL, @rework=0, --rework
			@rework_cd=NULL, @rework_process_id=NULL, @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @create_job_bom=1, @edit_time=@last_edit_at OUTPUT
	END

	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
	)
	BEGIN
--		RAISERROR('The specified job is already running on the specified entity{3565}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = 0
		SET @ret = 0
		IF ((@cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL))  BEGIN
			EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @user_id=@user_id
				, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @client_type=37, @no_propogation=0, @check_auto_job_start=1
				, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END

		IF (@ret <> -1) EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL
			, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_start_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process_Attr]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40),
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @mod_id  varchar(30)
 )
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Process_Class
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 09/19/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	 Part of DB Changes
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0      US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2      US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 8

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT process_attr.process_id
            ,process_attr.attr_id
            ,process_attr.attr_value
            ,process_attr.notes
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,process_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,process_attr.last_edit_by
            ,process_attr.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM process_attr process_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON process_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((process_attr.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (process_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (process_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY process_attr.process_id, attr.attr_desc
END
