--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_MasterRecipeBoMByFilter
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch all the list of BoM configured against the selected master recipe
--
-- Usage:		BoMRecipeOverview
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-06-08			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  YG				2022-09-11			Add spare1 column as byproduct information
-- 0.03.00  TB              2023-07-31          Returning isActive and preferred
-- 0.04.00  MA				2024-01-02			Adding grade color column
-- 0.05.00  DS				2024-04-23			updated the rounding precision from 5 to 8
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_MasterRecipeBoMByFilter]
(@item_id			NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@recipe_version	INT = NULL
) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strMaterialTypeDesc NVARCHAR(12) = 'MaterialType',
			@iMaterialTypeId INT,
			@strDefaultUoM NVARCHAR(40) = 'KG'

	-- Get materialtype attr id
    SELECT @iMaterialTypeId = attr_id
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = @strMaterialTypeDesc
		AND attr_grp = 1

	-- Fetch data from parameter sent by The Form
	SELECT 
		omr.recipe_name,
		bi.parent_item_id,
		bi.ver_id,
		i.item_id,
		i.item_desc,
		i.num_decimals,
		ISNULL(ia.attr_value,'') material_type,
		bi.reqd_grade_cd,
		ig.item_grade_desc,
		
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id, case when bi.min_qty_per_parent_item <= 0.00000001 and u.description = 'MT' then 0 
		when bi.min_qty_per_parent_item <= .00001 and u.description = 'KG' then 0 
		else ROUND((bi.min_qty_per_parent_item)*100,8) end
		,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM) min_qty,
		
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id, case when bi.qty_per_parent_item <= 0.00000001 and u.description = 'MT' then 0 
		when bi.qty_per_parent_item <= .00001 and u.description = 'KG' then 0 
		else ROUND((bi.qty_per_parent_item)*100,8) end,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM) qty,
		
		
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id, case when bi.max_qty_per_parent_item <= 0.00000001 and u.description = 'MT' then 0 
		when bi.max_qty_per_parent_item <= .00001 and u.description = 'KG' then 0 
		else ROUND((bi.max_qty_per_parent_item)*100,8) end,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM) max_qty,
		

		--dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id, case when bi.min_qty_per_parent_item <= 0.000001 then 0 else ROUND((bi.min_qty_per_parent_item)*100,6) end,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM) min_qty,
		--dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id, case when bi.qty_per_parent_item <= 0.000001 then 0 else ROUND((bi.qty_per_parent_item)*100,6) end,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM) qty,
		--dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](i.item_id, case when bi.max_qty_per_parent_item <= 0.000001 then 0 else ROUND((bi.max_qty_per_parent_item)*100,6) end,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM) max_qty,
		u.abbreviation,
		ISNULL(bi.spare1,'N') byproduct, -- Used to save byproduct
		ISNULL(bi.bom_pos,'') position,
		bi.last_edit_comment,
		--CONVERT(datetime, SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(DATETIMEOFFSET, bi.last_edit_at),DATENAME(TZOFFSET, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()))) last_edit_at,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), bi.last_edit_at, 101) + ' '+ LTRIM(RIGHT(CONVERT(CHAR(20),  bi.last_edit_at, 22), 11)) last_edit_at,
		bi.last_edit_by,
		omr.is_active,
		omr.preferred,
		dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) as color --0.04 passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
	FROM bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	INNER JOIN ofi_master_recipe omr WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.parent_item_id = omr.item_id AND bi.ver_id = omr.version
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @iMaterialTypeId
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.reqd_grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
	WHERE
		bi.parent_item_id = @item_id
		AND bi.ver_id = @recipe_version
		AND (bi.spare2 is NULL OR bi.spare2 <> 'InActive')
		AND (bi.bom_pos > 0 OR bi.bom_pos < 0)

END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

 (grp_desc,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetConsItems]
(@wo_id		STRING40
,@oper_id	STRING40
,@seq_no	INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetConsItems
-- Description	      -	Retrieve items that are consumed by a job
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	01/16/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.27
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	SELECT ic.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc, i.item_id, i.item_desc, i.num_decimals, i.uom_id, uom.description
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	UNION
	SELECT ic.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc, i.item_id, i.item_desc, i.num_decimals, i.uom_id, uom.description
	FROM job_bom_subst jbs WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbs.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	WHERE jbs.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbs.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbs.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbs.bom_pos > 0
	UNION
	SELECT ic.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc, i.item_id, i.item_desc, i.num_decimals, i.uom_id, uom.description
	FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	WHERE i.item_id IN
		(SELECT j.item_id
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
		INNER JOIN job prev_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = prev_job.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = prev_job.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = prev_job.seq_no
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no AND j.item_id = prev_job.item_id
		)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_QM_Spec_GetStatus]
(
@qm_spec_id INT32,
@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0,
@status LOGICAL OUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_S_QM_Spec_GetStatus
-- Description	      - Stored procedure to find whether the given QM spec is obsolete or not.
--						If OUT parameter @status = 1 then input qm spec is obsolete.
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -	03/29/2011
-- Version	          -	1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @current_utc DATETIME
			,@qm_spec_start_eff_utc DATETIME
			,@qm_spec_end_eff_utc DATETIME
			,@qm_spec_name STRING40
			,@ver_id STRING40
			,@qmspec_ent_id INT32
			,@qmspec_item_id STRING40
			,@qmspec_item_category_id INT32
			,@qmspec_process_id STRING40
			,@qmspec_oper_id STRING40
			,@nullcount INT32
			,@temp_qm_spec_id INT32
			,@temp_start_eff_utc DATETIME
			,@temp_end_eff_utc DATETIME
			,@final_end_eff_utc DATETIME  -- Collective end effective time of the qm_spec versions
			,@firstrow LOGICAL -- flag to indicate the first row in the qm_spec version list.
			,@noofqmspecs INT32
			,@noofqms INT32
			,@active  INT32

	DECLARE @qmspeclist TABLE (qm_spec_id INT32, start_eff_utc DATETIME,end_eff_utc DATETIME)

	SET @current_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	SET @status = 0
	SET @firstrow = 0
	SET @active = 0
	SET @final_end_eff_utc = NULL

	--Get the input qm_spec details.
	SELECT @qm_spec_name = qm_spec_name,
		   @ver_id = ver_id,
		   @qm_spec_start_eff_utc = start_eff_utc,
		   @qm_spec_end_eff_utc = end_eff_utc,
		   @qmspec_ent_id = ent_id,
		   @qmspec_item_id  = item_id,
		   @qmspec_item_category_id = item_category_id,
		   @qmspec_process_id = process_id,
		   @qmspec_oper_id = oper_id
	FROM qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE qm_spec.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id

	--End effective is in past then the given qm_spec is obsolete.
	IF ((@qm_spec_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL) AND (@qm_spec_end_eff_utc <= @current_utc))
	BEGIN
		SET @status = 1 -- INPUT QM_SPEC IS Obsolete.
		RETURN
	END
	-- Get All QM spec version having same qm_spec_name and same context and
	-- start_eff > input qm_spec start_eff and
	-- end_eff  > current Utc time or end_eff is NULL.
	INSERT INTO @qmspeclist(qm_spec_id, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc)
	SELECT qm_spec_id, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc from qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE qm_spec.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name AND
		  ((qm_spec.ent_id = @qmspec_ent_id) OR (qm_spec.ent_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_ent_id IS NULL))AND
		  ((qm_spec.item_id = @qmspec_item_id) OR (qm_spec.item_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_item_id IS NULL))AND
		  ((qm_spec.item_category_id = @qmspec_item_category_id) OR (qm_spec.item_category_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_item_category_id IS NULL)) AND
		  ((qm_spec.process_id = @qmspec_process_id) OR (qm_spec.process_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_process_id IS NULL)) AND
		  ((qm_spec.oper_id = @qmspec_oper_id) OR (qm_spec.oper_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_oper_id IS NULL)) AND
		  qm_spec.start_eff_utc > @qm_spec_start_eff_utc AND
		  (qm_spec.end_eff_utc > @current_utc OR qm_spec.end_eff_utc IS NULL) AND
		  qm_spec.qm_spec_id != @qm_spec_id
	ORDER BY qm_spec.start_eff_utc

	SELECT @noofqmspecs = COUNT(*) FROM @qmspeclist
	--No of other qm version which have start eff utc > start eff utc of the input qm spec version
	--but start eff utc < current utc. This is used to find whether input qm version is superseded
	-- by other qm spec version between the time gap of input qmspec start eff utc and current utc.
	SELECT @noofqms = COUNT(*) from qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE qm_spec.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name AND
		  ((qm_spec.ent_id = @qmspec_ent_id) OR (qm_spec.ent_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_ent_id IS NULL))AND
		  ((qm_spec.item_id = @qmspec_item_id) OR (qm_spec.item_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_item_id IS NULL))AND
		  ((qm_spec.item_category_id = @qmspec_item_category_id) OR (qm_spec.item_category_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_item_category_id IS NULL)) AND
		  ((qm_spec.process_id = @qmspec_process_id) OR (qm_spec.process_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_process_id IS NULL)) AND
		  ((qm_spec.oper_id = @qmspec_oper_id) OR (qm_spec.oper_id IS NULL AND @qmspec_oper_id IS NULL)) AND
		  qm_spec.start_eff_utc > @qm_spec_start_eff_utc AND
		  qm_spec.start_eff_utc <= @current_utc AND
		  (qm_spec.end_eff_utc > @current_utc OR qm_spec.end_eff_utc IS NULL) AND
		  qm_spec.qm_spec_id != @qm_spec_id

	IF (@noofqmspecs > 0)
	BEGIN
		-- IF input QM spec end_effectivity is NULL
		IF (@qm_spec_end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nullcount=COUNT(*) FROM @qmspeclist WHERE end_eff_utc IS NULL
			--IF all QM spec versions have end_effective NOT NULL then input QM spec is not Obsolete.
			IF (@nullcount = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @status = 0 -- Input QM spec is not Obsolete.
				RETURN
			END
		END
		BEGIN
			-- Cursor to get all QM spec versions having same qm_spec_name and same context and
			-- start_eff_utc > input qm_spec start_eff_utc and
			-- end_eff_utc  > current utc time or end_eff_utc is NULL.
			DECLARE qmspec_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT qm_spec_id, start_eff_utc, end_eff_utc FROM @qmspeclist ORDER BY start_eff_utc

			OPEN qmspec_cursor
			WHILE(1 = 1)
			BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM qmspec_cursor INTO @temp_qm_spec_id, @temp_start_eff_utc, @temp_end_eff_utc
				IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Compare the other qm spec versions and get the collective end effective utc.
				BEGIN
					IF (@firstrow = 0 ) --First row of the list.
					BEGIN
						IF @temp_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL
						BEGIN
							SET @final_end_eff_utc = @temp_end_eff_utc
							SET @firstrow = 1
							--If collective end effective time > input qm spec end eff time
							--then no need to continue further with next other qm spec version
							IF (@qm_spec_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL)
							BEGIN
								IF ( @final_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL AND @final_end_eff_utc > @qm_spec_end_eff_utc)
								BEGIN
									BREAK
								END
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							--QM spec version end eff time is NULL so collective end time will be endless
							--therefore no need to continue further with other qm spec versions and
							--input qm spec version can never be active again.
							SET @final_end_eff_utc = NULL
							BREAK
						END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						--The collectively end time is greater than start eff time i.e. overlapping the start eff time of next qm_spec
						IF @final_end_eff_utc >= @temp_start_eff_utc
						BEGIN
							IF @temp_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL
							BEGIN

								IF @final_end_eff_utc < @temp_end_eff_utc
								BEGIN
									SET @final_end_eff_utc = @temp_end_eff_utc
								END
								--If collective end effective time > input qm spec end eff time
								--then no need to continue further with next other qm spec version
								IF (@qm_spec_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL)
								BEGIN
									IF (@final_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL AND @final_end_eff_utc > @qm_spec_end_eff_utc)
									BEGIN
										BREAK
									END
								END
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								--QM spec version end eff time is NULL so collective end time will be endless
								--therefore no need to continue further with other qm spec versions and
								--input qm spec version can never be active again.
								SET @final_end_eff_utc = NULL
								BREAK
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							 --The collectively end time is less than start eff time of the next qm spec
							 -- i.e. there is a time gap between qm_spec versions in which the input qm_spec can become active.
							SET @active = 1
							SET @status = 0 --Input Qm spec is not Obsolete.
							BREAK
						END
					END
				END
			END
			--If there are no gaps between other qm_spec version such that input qm_spec can become active
			IF (@active = 0)
			BEGIN
				--If the collective end eff time of all qm versions is NULL (i.e endless) OR
				-- collective end eff time of all qm versions > end eff time of the input qm spec
				-- then input qm spec will never be active again as other qm spec versions supersede it.
				IF (@final_end_eff_utc IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					--If there are some other qm spec version which have start eff utc before the current utc but
					-- after the start eff utc of the input qm_spec version.
					IF (@noofqms > 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @status = 1 -- Input Qm spec is Obsolete.
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @status = 0 --Input Qm spec is not Obsolete.
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					--IF the input qm version end eff utc is not null.
					IF(@qm_spec_end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL)
					BEGIN
						IF (@final_end_eff_utc > @qm_spec_end_eff_utc)
						BEGIN
							--If there are some other qm spec version which have start eff utc before the current utc but
							-- after the start eff utc of the input qm_spec version.
							IF (@noofqms > 0)
							BEGIN
								SET @status = 1 -- Input Qm spec is Obsolete.
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @status = 0 --Input Qm spec is not Obsolete.
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF(@final_end_eff_utc = @qm_spec_end_eff_utc)
							BEGIN
								--If there are some other qm spec version which have start eff utc before the current utc but
								-- after the start eff utc of the input qm_spec version.
								IF (@noofqms > 0)
								BEGIN
									SET @status = 1 -- Input Qm spec is Obsolete.
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									SET @status = 0 --Input Qm spec is not Obsolete.
								END
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @status = 0	--Input Qm spec is not Obsolete.
							END
						END
					END
				END
			END
			CLOSE qmspec_cursor
			DEALLOCATE qmspec_cursor
		END
	END
END

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
--
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT Off

	DECLARE @site_id AS INT32
		,	@ent_id AS INT32

	IF( @entity_name IS NULL OR @entity_name = '' ) BEGIN
		--SET @ent_id = -1
		SELECT -1 AS ent_id
		RETURN
	END

	IF( @site IS NULL OR @site = '' ) BEGIN
		IF ( SELECT COUNT(ent.ent_id) FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_name = @entity_name ) > 1 BEGIN
			SELECT -1 AS ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_id = ent.ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_name = @entity_name
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF ( SELECT COUNT( site.ent_id ) FROM site WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE site.site_name = @site ) > 1 BEGIN
			SELECT -1 AS ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @site_id = site.ent_id FROM site WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE site.site_name = @site
			IF ( SELECT COUNT(ent.ent_id) FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_name = @entity_name AND ent.site = @site_id ) > 1 BEGIN
				SELECT -1 AS ent_id
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @ent_id = ent.ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_name = @entity_name AND ent.site = @site_id
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @ent_id AS ent_id
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_oper_link_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[cert_oper_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_cert_oper_link_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on cert_oper_link table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/16/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.0	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process p INNER JOIN inserted i ON p.process_id = i.process_id
			INNER JOIN cert_oper_link a ON a.cert_name = i.cert_name  AND a.process_id = i.process_id AND a.oper_id = i.oper_id
			WHERE p.process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},cert_oper_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM cert_oper_link a, inserted b
				WHERE a.cert_name = b.cert_name  AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id) col
	WHERE process.process_id = col.process_id

	UPDATE cert_oper_link SET cert_oper_link.last_edit_by = @user_id, cert_oper_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE cert_oper_link.cert_name = i.cert_name  AND cert_oper_link.process_id = i.process_id AND cert_oper_link.oper_id = i.oper_id

END

-- Name:		[vw_cb_sample_data]
-- Description: This is used to summarize the SAMPLE data details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AML,XPM			2026-02-05			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2026-03-05			Added Sample LIMS id into the view
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE       VIEW [dbo].[vw_cb_sample_data]
AS



SELECT DISTINCT
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_id,
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR), 'DS', CAST(ar.correction_step AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_step_id,
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR), 'S', CAST(cb.sample_id AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_sample_id,
	j.wo_id, 
	j.oper_id, 
	j.seq_no,
	j.item_id,
	cb.isManual,
	cb.sample_id,
	s.spare1 AS 'lims_sample_id',
	s.sublot_no,
	cb.curr_correction_step,
	bm.h_min,
	bm.h_target, 
	bm.h_max,
	sr.h AS h_predicted,
	ISNULL(MAX(CASE c.spare1 WHEN 'Intrinsic color - H' THEN scl.mean END) , sr.h_base)
	as h_measured,
	bm.l_min,
	bm.l_target,
	bm.l_max,
	sr.l AS l_predicted,
	ISNULL(MAX(CASE c.spare1 WHEN 'Intrinsic color - L' THEN scl.mean END) , sr.l_base)
	as l_measured,
	bm.c_min, 
	bm.c_target, 
	bm.c_max,
	sr.c AS c_predicted,
	ISNULL(MAX(CASE c.spare1 WHEN 'Intrinsic color - C' THEN scl.mean END) , sr.c_base)
	as c_measured,
	bm.ph_min, 
	bm.ph_target,
	bm.ph_max,
	sr.pH AS ph_predicted,
	MAX(CASE c.spare1 WHEN 'pH' THEN scl.mean END) as pH_measured,
	bm.moisture_min, 
	bm.moisture_target, 
	bm.moisture_max, 
	sr.moist_per AS moisture_predicted,
	MAX(CASE c.spare1 WHEN 'Moisture' THEN scl.mean END) as moisture_measured,
	bm.fat_min, 
	bm.fat_target, 
	bm.fat_max,
	sr.fat AS fat_predicted,
	MAX(CASE c.spare1 WHEN 'Fat' THEN scl.mean END) as fat_measured,
	sr.moist_water AS water_target,	
	sr.phCorrectionType1, 
	sr.phCorrectionValue1 AS additive_target1,
	sr.phCorrectionType2,
	sr.phCorrectionValue2 AS additive_target2,
	sr.phCorrectionType3,
	sr.phCorrectionValue3 AS additive_target3,
	j.act_finish_time_utc, 
	j.act_finish_time_local

	FROM [dbo].[job] AS j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[ofi_cb_approved_correction] ar WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ar.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ar.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ar.seq_no 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[ofi_CBamqp_Resp] cb WITH (NOLOCK) ON  j.wo_id = cb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = cb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = cb.seq_no AND ar.correction_step = cb.curr_correction_step AND ar.is_manual = cb.isManual   
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[ofi_cb_sample_results] sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = sr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = sr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = sr.seq_no AND j.item_id = sr.item_id AND ar.correction_step = sr.correction_step AND ar.is_manual = sr.is_manual
		--Removed for now 
		--LEFT OUTER JOIN [cakeblend].[Additives] a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.component IN (sr.phCorrectionType1,sr.phCorrectionType2,sr.phCorrectionType3,sr.phCorrectionType4)
		--INNER JOIN [dbo].[vw_ofi_item] oi WITH (NOLOCK) ON oi.item_id = a.item_id AND j.edit_time > oi.valid_from AND j.edit_time <= valid_to
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [cakeblend].[blend_masterdata] bm WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = bm.item_id 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[sample] s WITH (NOLOCK) ON cb.sample_id = s.sample_id AND j.wo_id = s.wo_id ANd j.oper_id =s.oper_id AND j.seq_no = s.seq_no
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[sample_char_link] scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.sample_id = scl.sample_id
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[characteristic] c WITH (NOLOCK) on scl.char_id = c.char_id
	WHERE  j.oper_id LIKE 'CakeBlend%' 

	GROUP BY 
    j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id,
    ar.correction_step, ar.is_manual,
    cb.isManual, cb.sample_id, cb.curr_correction_step,
    bm.h_min, bm.h_target, bm.h_max, sr.h,
    bm.l_min, bm.l_target, bm.l_max, sr.l,
    bm.c_min, bm.c_target, bm.c_max, sr.c,
    bm.ph_min, bm.ph_target, bm.ph_max, sr.pH,
    bm.moisture_min, bm.moisture_target, bm.moisture_max, sr.moist_per,
    bm.fat_min, bm.fat_target, bm.fat_max, sr.fat,
    sr.moist_water, sr.phCorrectionType1, sr.phCorrectionValue1,
    sr.phCorrectionType2, sr.phCorrectionValue2,
    sr.phCorrectionType3, sr.phCorrectionValue3,
	j.act_finish_time_local,
	j.act_finish_time_utc,
	s.sublot_no
	,sr.c_base
	,sr.h_base
	,sr.l_base
	,s.spare1 -- added

--

--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--07/17/2007  Raghu           3.3.1   HD# 10047, Add spare1-spare4

--12/22/2009	Eswar		4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

SELECT folder_file.item_id
          ,folder_file.oper_id
          ,folder_file.ent_id
          ,folder_file.ver_id
          ,folder_file.file_path
          ,folder_file.file_desc
          ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(folder_file.file_path) AS file_type

          ,folder_file.file_size

          ,folder_file.spare4
          ,folder_file.last_edit_comment
          ,folder_file.last_edit_by
          ,folder_file.last_edit_at
	,  CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, folder_file.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM folder_file folder_file WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (folder_file.item_id = @item_id AND
       folder_file.oper_id = @oper_id AND
       folder_file.ent_id = @ent_id AND
       folder_file.ver_id = @ver_id AND

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_kanban_job_frequency_data]
AS
SELECT job.wo_id,
       wo.state_cd wo_state,
       wo.release_time_utc,
       wo.release_time_local,
       job.oper_id,
       job.seq_no,
       job.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       job.state_cd,
       job_state.state_desc,
       job.job_priority,
       job.req_finish_time_utc,
       job.req_finish_time_local,
       job.qty_reqd,
       job.qty_prod,
       job.qty_rejected,
       job.sched_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_start_time_local,
       job.latest_start_time_utc,
       job.latest_start_time_local,
       job.sched_finish_time_utc,
       job.sched_finish_time_local,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.target_sched_ent_id,
       target_ent.ent_name target_sched_ent_name
FROM job job
INNER JOIN wo wo ON job.wo_id = wo.wo_id
INNER JOIN item item ON job.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN job_state job_state ON
   job.state_cd = job_state.state_cd
INNER JOIN ent target_ent ON
   job.target_sched_ent_id = target_ent.ent_id
WHERE item.auto_reorder = 1

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Transfer_List]
(@transfer_type  int  ,
 @cust_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @order_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @line_no  int  ,
 @date_of_shipment_utc  datetime  ,
 @date_of_shipment_local  datetime  ,
 @date_of_shipment_tz INT32 = NULL  ,
 @wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @bom_pos int,
 @to_ent_id  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @sublot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @grade_cd  int  ,
 @status_cd  int  ,
 @uom_id_store int ,
 @expiry_date  datetime  ,
 @expiry_date_tz INT32 = NULL,
 @from_ent_id  int  ,
 @from_item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @from_lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @from_sublot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @from_grade_cd  int  ,
 @from_status_cd  int  ,
 @uom_id_pick int ,
 @from_expiry_date  datetime  ,
 @from_expiry_date_tz INT32 =NULL,
 @trans_id  int  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime  ,
 @row_id  int ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Transfer_List
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--09/22/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--01/30/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--09/05/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 11/27/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
-- 12/22/2009	Kishore		4.1		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************


	SET @date_of_shipment_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_of_shipment_tz)


	SET @expiry_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@expiry_date_tz)
	SET @from_expiry_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@from_expiry_date_tz)

    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32
  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Transfer_List', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @date_of_shipment_local, @numeric_val1 = @date_of_shipment_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @expiry_date, @numeric_val2 = @expiry_date_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @from_expiry_date, @numeric_val3 = @from_expiry_date_tz

IF @expiry_date IS NOT NULL SET @expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@expiry_date_tz, @expiry_date)
IF @from_expiry_date IS NOT NULL SET @from_expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@from_expiry_date_tz, @from_expiry_date)

SELECT transfer_list.transfer_type,
	transfer_list.cust_id,
	transfer_list.order_id,
	transfer_list.line_no,
    transfer_list.date_of_shipment_utc,
	transfer_list.date_of_shipment_local,
	transfer_list.wo_id,
	transfer_list.oper_id,
	transfer_list.seq_no,
	transfer_list.bom_pos,
	transfer_list.to_ent_id,
	transfer_list.item_id,
	transfer_list.lot_no,
    transfer_list.sublot_no,
	transfer_list.grade_cd,
	transfer_list.status_cd,
	transfer_list.qty_to_store,
	transfer_list.uom_id_store,
	transfer_list.expiry_date as expiry_date,
	transfer_list.from_ent_id,
	transfer_list.from_item_id,
	transfer_list.from_lot_no,
    transfer_list.from_sublot_no,
	transfer_list.from_grade_cd,
	transfer_list.from_status_cd,
	transfer_list.qty_to_pick,
	transfer_list.uom_id_pick,
	transfer_list.from_expiry_date as from_expiry_date,
	transfer_list.trans_id,
	transfer_list.spare1,
	transfer_list.spare2,
	transfer_list.spare3,
	transfer_list.spare4,
	transfer_list.last_edit_comment,
	transfer_list.last_edit_by,
	transfer_list.last_edit_at
FROM transfer_list transfer_list WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((transfer_list.transfer_type = @transfer_type OR @transfer_type IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.cust_id = @cust_id OR @cust_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.order_id = @order_id OR @order_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.line_no = @line_no OR @line_no IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.date_of_shipment_utc = @date_of_shipment_utc OR @date_of_shipment_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (transfer_list.date_of_shipment_local = @date_of_shipment_local OR @date_of_shipment_local IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR @to_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
	   (transfer_list.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.uom_id_store = @uom_id_store OR @uom_id_store IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.expiry_date = @expiry_date OR @expiry_date IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.from_item_id = @from_item_id OR @from_item_id IS NULL) AND
       (transfer_list.from_lot_no = @from_lot_no OR @from_lot_no IS NULL) AND

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_job_exec_CWOFP_Qty]
(
  @wo_id           STRING40,
  @process_id      STRING40,
  @item_id         STRING40,
  @req_qty         TFLOAT OUTPUT,
  @start_qty       TFLOAT_NULL OUTPUT,
  @for_first_op    LOGICAL = 0
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_I_JOB_EXEC_CWOFP_QTY
-- Description	      - HD#4974 Create new method to allow start or target qty. to be passed for CWOFP.
--                      Determines the quantities to be passed onto CWOFP based off the flag @first_last_op.
--                      When the flag is true quantity calculation for the final operation will be done taking the passed in
--                      start and reqd quantities as the quantities required in the first operation.
-- Author	      - SJ
-- Date Created	      - 11/02/2004
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 02/03/2006     SJ           3109    Parameters changed. CWOFP calls this procedure now.
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE
  @V_Qty_Reqd  TFLOAT,
  @V_Start_Qty  TFLOAT,
  @O_oper_id  STRING40,
  @O_sched_to_ent_id  INT32,
  @seq_no  INT32,
  @V_Seq_Chk  INT,
  @OEL_oper_id  STRING40,
  @OEL_ent_id  INT32,
  @V_Feed_Seq  INT32,
  @V_Rej_Rate  TFLOAT,
  @V_Count  INT,
  @V_Reqd_Qty  TFLOAT,
  @V_Integer  INT,
  @V_Input_Oper_Id  STRING40,
  @V_Input_Ent_Id  STRING40
BEGIN
  --Qty supplied to CWOFP as is
  SET @V_Qty_Reqd = @req_qty
  SET @V_Start_Qty = @start_qty

  IF @for_first_op = 1  --If the qty supplied is for the first op
  BEGIN
    --sequence the operations and entities and store in add temporary table
    CREATE TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), ent_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER)
    SET @seq_no = 0
    --Select all the operations and entities for the process and insert into temporary table
    DECLARE cur_ins_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT a.oper_id, a.ent_id FROM oper_ent_link a, ent b WHERE a.ent_id = b.ent_id
      AND a.process_id = @process_id ORDER BY a.oper_id, b.ent_name  -- Added a.oper_id to ORDER BY clause 1/24/03 SJ
    OPEN cur_ins_ops
    FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @seq_no = @seq_no + 1
      INSERT INTO #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id, oper_id, ent_id, seq_no) VALUES(@wo_id, @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no)
      FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id
    END
    CLOSE cur_ins_ops
    DEALLOCATE cur_ins_ops
    SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
    WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Seq_Chk = 0
      DECLARE cur_seq_ops CURSOR DYNAMIC LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no DESC
      OPEN cur_seq_ops
      FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        --check if any of the feeding operations are ahead in the sequence
        DECLARE cur_feeding_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT input_oper_id, input_ent_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id
          AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id ORDER BY input_ent_id  -- Added ORDER BY clause 1/2/03 KRF
        OPEN cur_feeding_ops
        FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @OEL_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          --get the feeding op's seq and compare
          SELECT @V_Feed_Seq = seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OEL_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id
          --if feeding op's seq lesser interchange the sequence nos
          IF @V_Feed_Seq > @seq_no
          BEGIN
            UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @seq_no WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OEL_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id
            UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @V_Feed_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id
            SET @seq_no = @V_Feed_Seq
            SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
          END  --End of @V_Feed_Seq > @seq_no
          FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @OEL_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id
        END
        CLOSE cur_feeding_ops
        DEALLOCATE cur_feeding_ops
        FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no
      END
      CLOSE cur_seq_ops
      DEALLOCATE cur_seq_ops
    END  --End of WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1

    --Determine if only whole item can be produced
    IF (SELECT num_decimals FROM item WHERE item_id = @item_id) > 0
      SET @V_Integer = 0
    ELSE
      SET @V_Integer = 1

    --Now apply the reject rate starting from the first op and forward
    DECLARE cur_temp_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no
    OPEN cur_temp_seq
    FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @O_oper_id, @seq_no
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SELECT @V_Rej_Rate = ISNULL(def_reject_rate, 0)/100 FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id
      --Check if same operation exists below this level, if so skip
      SELECT @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND seq_no < @seq_no
      --if reject rate present apply qty to all ops before this op
      IF @V_Count = 0 AND @V_Rej_Rate > 0
      BEGIN
        --Get the reject quantity
        SET @V_Rej_Rate = @V_Qty_Reqd * @V_Rej_Rate

        --If whole piece to be produced
        IF @V_Integer = 1
          SET @V_Rej_Rate = CEILING(@V_Rej_Rate)

        --Update quantities in this op
        SET @V_Start_Qty = @V_Start_Qty + @V_Rej_Rate
        SET @V_Qty_Reqd = @V_Qty_Reqd + @V_Rej_Rate
      END  --End of @V_Count = 0 AND @V_Rej_Rate > 0
      FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @O_oper_id, @seq_no
    END
    CLOSE cur_temp_seq
    DEALLOCATE cur_temp_seq
  END

  --CWOFP by passing the newly determined final job quantities
END

CREATE PROCEDURE SP_U_JOB_EXEC_STRTNEXTJOBVIAFC
(@in_user_id			STRING80 = NULL
,@in_ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_job_pos			INT32 = NULL
,@event_time_local   TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_U_JOB_EXEC_STRTNEXTJOBVIAFC
-- Description          - Ends the current job that is running on the supplied job position, and starts
--                          the next job from the queue.
-- Author               - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 02/09/2008
-- Version          - 3.4
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
-- 08/22/2017		RWB			6.0		User Story 811325 - Modified sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetQueueSQL to return parameterized SQL
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @job_pos			INT32
	,@cur_wo_id			STRING80
	,@cur_oper_id			STRING80
	,@cur_seq_no			INT32

	,@GetQueueSQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@param_def				NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@cancel_time			DATETIME
	,@complete_time			DATETIME
	,@state_cd_xml			XML
	,@wo_id_filter			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@oper_id_filter		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@seq_no_filter			INT
	,@item_id_filter		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_desc_filter		NVARCHAR(400)

	,@available_job_pos		INT32

	,@batch_job_wo_id		STRING80
	,@batch_job_oper_id		STRING80
	,@batch_job_seq_no		INT32
	,@batch_job_state_cd		INT32
	,@batch_job_run_ent_id		INT32
	,@batch_job_concurrent_link	INT32

BEGIN

	SET @job_pos = COALESCE(@in_job_pos, 0)

	--Verify whether a job is running on the supplied entity.
	--End the job only if a job is running on an entity.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE je.ent_id = @in_ent_id
			  AND je.job_pos = @job_pos
			  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		--There is currently a job running at this job position.
		--Retrieve the current job details.
		SELECT @cur_wo_id = je.cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = je.cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		  AND je.job_pos = @job_pos

		--End the current job. End this job (and other jobs if they are running in a batch).
		EXEC SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ENDBATCHJOBS @ent_id=@in_ent_id,
		    @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
		    @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
		    @job_pos=@job_pos,
		    @status_notes=NULL,
		    @user_id=@in_user_id,
		    @check_privs=0, @check_certs=0,
		    @client_type=37, @no_propogation=0,
		    @check_auto_job_start=NULL,
			@event_time_local= @event_time_local,
			@time_zone_bias_value=@in_time_zone_bias_value
	END

	EXEC SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_GETQUEUESQL @ent_id=@in_ent_id,
		@concurrent_link=NULL, @use_for_getqueue_rset=NULL,
		@SQL=@GetQueueSQL OUT, @cancel_time = @cancel_time OUTPUT,
		@complete_time = @complete_time OUTPUT, @state_cd_xml = @state_cd_xml OUTPUT,
		@wo_id = @wo_id_filter OUTPUT, @oper_id = @oper_id_filter OUTPUT,
		@seq_no = @seq_no_filter OUTPUT, @item_id = @item_id_filter OUTPUT,
		@item_desc = @item_desc_filter OUTPUT

	SET @GetQueueSQL = 'DECLARE next_job_batch_cursor CURSOR FOR ' + @GetQueueSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias INT, @cancel_time DATETIME, @complete_time DATETIME, @state_cd_xml XML, @wo_id NVARCHAR(400), @oper_id NVARCHAR(400), @seq_no INT, @item_id NVARCHAR(400), @item_desc NVARCHAR(400), @ent_id INT'
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @GetQueueSQL, @param_def, @in_time_zone_bias_value, @cancel_time, @complete_time, @state_cd_xml, @wo_id_filter, @oper_id_filter, @seq_no_filter, @item_id_filter, @item_desc_filter, @in_ent_id

	OPEN next_job_batch_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM next_job_batch_cursor INTO @batch_job_wo_id, @batch_job_oper_id, @batch_job_seq_no,
			@batch_job_state_cd, @batch_job_run_ent_id, @batch_job_concurrent_link

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF (@batch_job_state_cd = 2) BEGIN

			--Get the minimum available (unused) job position for this entity, where we can start this job in a batch.
			EXEC SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_GETAVAILJOBPOS @in_ent_id, @available_job_pos OUTPUT

			--If job positions are NOT available, then raise an error.
			IF (@available_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			--Start the supplied job in the identified job position.
			EXEC SP_U_JOB_EXEC_STARTBATCHJOBS @ent_id=@in_ent_id, @user_id=@in_user_id
				,@wo_id=@batch_job_wo_id, @oper_id=@batch_job_oper_id, @seq_no=@batch_job_seq_no
				,@job_pos=@available_job_pos, @status_notes=NULL
				,@check_privs=NULL, @check_certs=NULL
				,@event_time_local = @event_time_local
				,@time_zone_bias_value=@in_time_zone_bias_value

			CLOSE next_job_batch_cursor
			DEALLOCATE next_job_batch_cursor

			RETURN
		END
	END
	CLOSE next_job_batch_cursor
	DEALLOCATE next_job_batch_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process_Attr_GetAttrs]
(@process_id	STRING80

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Process_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description	      - Raghu
-- Author	      - Get all attributes that are associated to a process.
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  SELECT process_attr.process_id
            ,process_attr.attr_id
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,process_attr.attr_value
            ,process_attr.notes
            ,process_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,process_attr.last_edit_by
            ,process_attr.last_edit_at

		editable
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM process process WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN process_attr process_attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON process.process_id = process_attr.process_id

  ORDER BY attr.attr_desc, process.process_desc

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_MasterRecipeByFilter
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch all the master recipes configured in the system
--
-- Usage:		MasterRecipeOverview
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-06-08			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  DS				2023-01-08			Added WIP item condition
-- 0.03.00	DS				2023-01-11			Logic changed for  
-- 0.04.00	YG				2023-01-24			Update strMaterial only showing item_desc
-- 0.05.00	YG				2023-04-05			Added order
-- 0.06.00	SM				2023-08-04			Added on v0.4 to inculde the ent description if description is empty then ent name is displayed
-- 0.06.01	Veervar			2024-02-09			Cleanup and Logic comments added.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE    Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_MasterRecipeByFilter]
(
@ent_id			INT = NULL
,@item_id			NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@recipe_id			INT = NULL
,@recipe_version	INT = NULL	
,@recipe_preferred	NVARCHAR(1) = NULL
,@recipe_active		NVARCHAR(1) = NULL
,@wo_id				NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@oper_id			NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@type				int = NULL
) AS
BEGIN

declare @iswip int = 0
declare @wip_item_prefix nvarchar(10) = '';


	-- step 1: build the wip item code

	IF (@type = 1)
		BEGIN
				select @iswip = attr_value from oper_attr with(nolock) where  oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id in(select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'produce_wip')

				if(@iswip=1)
					begin
						select @wip_item_prefix = isnull(spare2,'50')  from item_class with(nolock) where item_class_id ='SFG' 
						set @item_id =  SUBSTRING(@item_id,3,len(@item_id)) 
						set @item_id = CONCAT(@wip_item_prefix,@item_id)

					end

				-- step 2:  

				-- Fetch data from parameter sent by The Form
				SELECT 
					omr.ent_id,
					e.ent_name,	
					--isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_name,				---- v0.06.00 Update ent description and it its' empty  ent name is displayed. old code e.ent_name
					omr.item_id,
					i.item_desc,					
					i.item_desc strMaterial,
					omr.recipe_name,
					omr.version,
					omr.is_active,
					omr.preferred,
					omr.notes,
					ISNULL(omr.last_edit_at_utc, omr.created_at_utc) last_edit_at_local,
					ISNULL(omr.last_edit_by, omr.created_by) last_edit_by,
					omr.row_id recipe_id
				FROM ofi_master_recipe omr WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON omr.item_id = i.item_id
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON omr.ent_id = e.ent_id
				WHERE 
					(omr.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) 
					AND (omr.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL OR @item_id = '')
					AND (omr.row_id = @recipe_id OR @recipe_id IS NULL)
					AND (omr.version = @recipe_version OR @recipe_version IS NULL)
					AND (omr.preferred = @recipe_preferred OR @recipe_preferred IS NULL OR @recipe_preferred = '')
					AND (omr.is_active = @recipe_active OR @recipe_active IS NULL OR @recipe_active = '')
				ORDER By ISNULL(omr.last_edit_at_utc, omr.created_at_utc) DESC
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT 
						omr.ent_id,
						e.ent_name,
						--isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_name,				---- v0.06.00 Update ent description and it its' empty  ent name is displayed. old code e.ent_name
						omr.item_id,
						i.item_desc,
						--CONCAT(omr.item_id,'-',i.item_desc) strMaterial,
						i.item_desc strMaterial,omr.recipe_name,
						omr.version,
						omr.is_active,
						omr.preferred,
						omr.notes,
						ISNULL(omr.last_edit_at_utc, omr.created_at_utc) last_edit_at_local,
						ISNULL(omr.last_edit_by, omr.created_by) last_edit_by,
						omr.row_id recipe_id
					FROM ofi_master_recipe omr WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON omr.item_id = i.item_id
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON omr.ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE 
						(omr.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) 
						AND (omr.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL OR @item_id = '')
						AND (omr.row_id = @recipe_id OR @recipe_id IS NULL)
						AND (omr.version = @recipe_version OR @recipe_version IS NULL)
						AND (omr.preferred = @recipe_preferred OR @recipe_preferred IS NULL OR @recipe_preferred = '')
						AND (omr.is_active = @recipe_active OR @recipe_active IS NULL OR @recipe_active = '')
					ORDER By ISNULL(omr.last_edit_at_utc, omr.created_at_utc) DESC

			END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_data_log_grp_addsample]
(
	@grp_id      INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id      INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@job_pos     INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no     INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no      STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no   STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @shift_id		INT32
	, @shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	, @shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	, @sample_time_local	TDATETIME2

BEGIN
	SET @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, 'DataLog.Update')
	-- Get the sample_time_local
	SET @sample_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @sample_time_utc)

	IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		-- Determine the shift information if ent_id is supplied, since shifts are related to an entity
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
		FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND shift_start_utc <= @sample_time_utc
		ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC

		-- Reset shift information to no shift, when a shift is not found for an entity
		SELECT @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0), @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01'))
			, @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01'))
	END
	ELSE SELECT @shift_id = NULL, @shift_start_local = NULL, @shift_start_utc = NULL

	-- Update the data_log
	UPDATE data_log
	SET ent_id = @ent_id
	  , sample_time_utc = @sample_time_utc
	  , sample_time_local = @sample_time_local
	  , wo_id = @wo_id
	  , oper_id = @oper_id

BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_line_ent_link_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[line_ent_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_line_ent_link_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on line_ent_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields.  Also updates the shifts from entities in the line
--			 when the line_is_child flag is modified
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	02/25/2013
-- Version	      - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--02/25/2013	RaghuG		4.6	Support for line management
--04/05/2013	RaghuG		4.6	UserStories: 165903, 165492 - Assign an entity in a line as a bottleneck, assign parallel entity segments to a single position in a line
--11/12/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 259170 - Update shift information for the entities when the entities are added or removed from a line.
--					Removed the code that call "sp_U_LEL_FixShiftsAfterIns" and "sp_U_LEL_FixShiftsAfterDel" when an update is made on the line_ent_link table,
--					since entities can be added only through sp_I_Line_Ent_Link_AddEntities (from web client) and that SP takes care of updating the shift schedules to all the entities in a line.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE  @last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	IF UPDATE(LINE_IS_CHILD) OR UPDATE(SEGMENT_NO)
		--Update the segment_no to null for this row in the line_ent_link table, if the line_is_child is changed from false to true
		UPDATE line_ent_link SET segment_no = NULL
		FROM inserted i, deleted d
		WHERE line_ent_link.line_id = i.line_id AND line_ent_link.ent_id = i.ent_id
		  AND line_ent_link.line_id = d.line_id AND line_ent_link.ent_id = d.ent_id
		  AND ((d.line_is_child = 0 AND i.line_is_child = 1) OR i.line_is_child = 1)

	UPDATE line_ent_link SET line_ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, line_ent_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE line_ent_link.line_id = i.line_id AND line_ent_link.ent_id = i.ent_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetNominalShiftSched]
(
	@ent_id					INT32
,	@start_time				TDATETIME
,	@start_time_tz			INT32 = NULL
,	@end_time				TDATETIME
,	@end_time_tz			INT32 = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetNominalShiftSched
-- Description					- Return shift schedule (shift_sched records) for the date range (and entitiy) specified
--								  This returns the template shifts configured in the shift_sched table.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 01/17/2006
-- Version						- 3.1.6.27
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 11/28/2009		Eswar			4.0.0	HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @sched int
DECLARE @parent_ent_id int
DECLARE @temp_date datetime
DECLARE @day_cntr int
DECLARE @sys_first_day int
DECLARE @temp_ent_id int
DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32

DECLARE @shift_sched_temp TABLE (
	ent_id INT,
	start_day INT,
	shift_id INT,
	start_time DATETIME,
	end_time DATETIME,
	break1_start DATETIME,
	break1_end DATETIME,
	break2_start DATETIME,
	break2_end DATETIME,
	break3_start DATETIME,
	break3_end DATETIME,
	last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(254),
	last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40),
	last_edit_at DATETIME,
	row_id INT
)

SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
SET @end_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)
SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

-- TRACE
EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Ent_GetNominalShiftSched', @src_key='on_entry', @date_val1 = @start_time, @numeric_val1 = @start_time_tz,
				 @date_val2 = @end_time, @numeric_val2 = @end_time_tz
IF ( @dbg_resp = 1 )
	RETURN


IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@start_time_tz, @start_time)
IF @end_time IS NOT NULL SET @end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@end_time_tz, @end_time)

set @sys_first_day = @@datefirst
SET DATEFIRST 7	--will set sunday as first day of the week
SELECT @temp_ent_id = @ent_id
-- create the IN TABLE FOR THE ent_id s
CREATE TABLE #EntityIDs (ent_id int)
if @temp_ent_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
	--find the ent_id with can_sched_shifts <> 0
SET @sched = (SELECT can_sched_shifts from ent WHERE ent_id = @temp_ent_id )
	WHILE @sched = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @parent_ent_id = (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @temp_ent_id)
		SET @sched = (SELECT can_sched_shifts from ent WHERE ent_id = @parent_ent_id )
		SELECT @temp_ent_id = @parent_ent_id
		-- WHILE loop breaks even without this IF @ent_id = NULL, but ...
		IF @temp_ent_id IS NULL BREAK
	END --WHILE @sched = 0
END
IF @temp_ent_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #EntityIDs VALUES (@temp_ent_id)
END
ELSE-- @temp_ent_id IS NULL
BEGIN
	IF @ent_id IS NULL	-- Get all ent_ids which can schedule shifts
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #EntityIDs SELECT ent_id from ent WHERE can_sched_shifts = 1
	END
END
-- select * from #EntityIDs
-- create the IN TABLE FOR THE START_DAY
CREATE TABLE #start_days (day_no int)
-- put the week days 0,1,2,3,4,5,6 into the temp table - only those needed for the date range specified
SET @temp_date = @start_time
SET @day_cntr = 0

WHILE (@temp_date <= @end_time) and (@day_cntr <= 6)
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #start_days VALUES (STR(DATEPART(dw, @temp_date)-1, 1, 0)) -- Get this day's day of the week
	SET @day_cntr = @day_cntr + 1
	SET @temp_date = DATEADD(d, 1, @temp_date)
END
--SELECT * FROM #start_days

--SET NOCOUNT OFF
SET DATEFIRST @sys_first_day

--HF1432 - TODO
IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #start_days) > 0)
INSERT INTO @shift_sched_temp (ent_id, start_day, shift_id, start_time, end_time, break1_start, break1_end,
	break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
SELECT   ent_id
	,start_day
	,shift_id
	,shift_sched.start_time
	,shift_sched.end_time
	,shift_sched.break1_start
	,shift_sched.break1_end
	,shift_sched.break2_start

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_oper_step_link_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[cert_oper_step_link]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_cert_oper_step_link_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on cert_oper_step_link table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/16/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--03/10/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 2527). Donot allow to delete a certificate attached to a running job/step
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process p INNER JOIN deleted d ON p.process_id = d.process_id
				WHERE process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},cert_oper_step_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM wo INNER JOIN job_step_data jsd ON wo.wo_id = jsd.wo_id
		INNER JOIN deleted d ON d.oper_id = jsd.oper_id AND d.process_id = wo.process_id WHERE jsd.state_cd = 3) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Cannot delete this certificate, because a job attached to this certificate is currently running.{4735}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	WHERE process_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT process_id FROM deleted)

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[[vw_ofi_item]]
-- Description: This is used to get basic job's details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2024-09-23			Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_ofi_item]
AS


 WITH ranked_duplicated_items AS (           
            SELECT  Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY i.item_id, i.last_edit_at) ix,
                    i.last_edit_at,
                    i.item_id 
					,i.item_desc
					,i.row_id
            FROM    [dbo].[item] i WITH (NOLOCK) 
			
        ),
        ranged_valid_items AS (             
            SELECT  
					CASE 
						WHEN rdi3.ix IS NULL 
							THEN CAST('1753-01-01' AS datetime) 
						ELSE rdi.last_edit_at 
					END valid_from
					,CASE 
						WHEN rdi2.ix IS NULL 
							THEN CAST('3000-01-01' AS datetime) 
						ELSE COALESCE(rdi2.last_edit_at, GETDATE())
					END valid_to
                    ,rdi.item_id 
					,rdi.item_desc
					,rdi.row_id
            FROM    ranked_duplicated_items rdi 
            LEFT JOIN ranked_duplicated_items rdi2 ON rdi.ix+1 = rdi2.ix 
													AND rdi.item_id = rdi2.item_id
			LEFT JOIN ranked_duplicated_items rdi3 ON rdi.ix-1 = rdi3.ix 
													AND rdi.item_id = rdi3.item_id

        )
		SELECT DISTINCT rvi.*
		FROM ranged_valid_items rvi
		WHERE rvi.item_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_labor_data]
AS
SELECT labor_usage.log_id,
       labor_usage.labor_start_utc,
       labor_usage.labor_start_local,
       labor_usage.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       labor_usage.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       ent.description,
       labor_usage.wo_id,
       labor_usage.oper_id,
       labor_usage.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.sched_start_time_utc,
       job.sched_start_time_local,
       job.sched_finish_time_utc,
       job.sched_finish_time_local,
       job.qty_prod,
       job.qty_rejected,
       job.batch_size,
       job.est_fixed_lab,
       CASE job.prod_uom
          WHEN 1 THEN job.est_lab_rate/60.0
          WHEN 2 THEN job.est_lab_rate/3600.0
          WHEN 3 THEN job.est_lab_rate
          WHEN 4 THEN job.est_lab_rate/60.0
          WHEN 5 THEN job.est_lab_rate/3600.0
          ELSE job.est_lab_rate
       END AS est_lab_rate,
       job.est_setup_time,
       job.est_teardown_time,
       labor_usage.step_no,
       labor_usage.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       labor_usage.lot_no,
       labor_usage.sublot_no,
       labor_usage.lab_cd,
       labor_cat.lab_desc,
       labor_cat.fixedtime,
       labor_cat.vartime,
       labor_cat.color,
       labor_usage.dept_id,
       labor_dept.dept_desc,
       labor_usage.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       labor_usage.shift_start_utc,
       labor_usage.shift_start_local,
       labor_usage.pct_to_apply,
       labor_usage.active,
      (CASE WHEN labor_usage.active = 1
                   THEN DATEDIFF(s,
                                 labor_usage.labor_start_utc,
                                 GETUTCDATE())
       ELSE labor_usage.duration
       END) AS duration,
       labor_usage.comments
FROM labor_usage labor_usage
INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   labor_usage.user_id = user_name.user_id
INNER JOIN ent ent ON labor_usage.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
   labor_usage.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   labor_usage.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   labor_usage.seq_no = job.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item ON
   labor_usage.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat ON
   labor_usage.lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
INNER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept ON
   labor_usage.dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
INNER JOIN shift shift ON
   labor_usage.shift_id = shift.shift_id

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_silo_dropdown]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch silo details for source/destination in the columns's dropdwon
--
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	DS				2022-08-18			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00 DS				2023-01-26			Handled empty silos in the caee of destination 
-- 0.03.00 AKM				2024-02-01			script level comment
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_silo_dropdown]
(
	--declare
	 @silo_selection		int = 1   -- 1 for source , 2 from destination
	,@wo_id					nvarchar(40) = NULL
	,@oper_id				nvarchar(80) = NULL
	,@seq_no				int = NULL
	,@ent_id				int = NULL  --
	--,@recipeId				nvarchar(80) =NULL
	,@storageUnitId			int  =NULL
	,@itemDesc nvarchar(40)=  NULL
) 

AS
BEGIN

	   IF(@silo_selection =1) -- Source silo selection
	   BEGIN

		 SELECT secondary_silo,secondary_silo_ent_id from (
				SELECT distinct ent.description as secondary_silo ,oei.storage_ent_id as secondary_silo_ent_id,
				case when ((select isNotValidEnt FROM [dbo].[fn_chkStorageValidity](oei.storage_ent_id,'source',NULL,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no))=1) then 1 
				--(oei.storage_ent_id,'source',jb_item_id,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no)
													else 0 end as is_disabled
		
				FROM [dbo].ofi_ent_item_storage_link oei WITH(NOLOCK) inner join ent with(nolock) on ent.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id 
				inner join [dbo].[storage_exec] se with(nolock) on oei.storage_ent_id = se.ent_id
				inner join [dbo].item_inv inv with(nolock) on inv.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id --and inv.item_id = oei.item
				inner join [dbo].item with(nolock) on inv.item_id = item.item_id and item.item_desc=@itemDesc
				inner join  [dbo].item_attr ia with(nolock) on item.item_id = ia.item_id  AND ia.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaterialType') --and ia.attr_value = 'FERT'
				inner join [dbo].job_bom jb with(nolock) on jb.item_id = inv.item_id and inv.qty_left <>0 and jb.wo_id = @wo_id
				WHERE oei.ent_id = @ent_id and oei.[type]= 'source'
				and ent.ent_id <>isnull(@storageUnitId,0)
		 ) a where a.is_disabled=0

	  END
	  ELSE
	  BEGIN
	  --- Destination silo selection
		 SELECT secondary_silo,secondary_silo_ent_id from (
				SELECT distinct ent.description as secondary_silo ,oei.storage_ent_id as secondary_silo_ent_id,
				case when ((select isNotValidEnt FROM [dbo].[fn_chkStorageValidity](oei.storage_ent_id,'destination',NULL,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no) )=1) then 1 
				
													else 0 end as is_disabled
				FROM [dbo].ofi_ent_item_storage_link oei WITH(NOLOCK) inner join ent with(nolock) on ent.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id 
				inner join [dbo].[storage_exec] se with(nolock) on oei.storage_ent_id = se.ent_id
				inner join [dbo].item_inv inv with(nolock) on inv.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id --and inv.item_id = oei.item
				inner join [dbo].item with(nolock) on inv.item_id = item.item_id and item.item_desc=@itemDesc
				inner join  [dbo].item_attr ia with(nolock) on item.item_id = ia.item_id  AND ia.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaterialType') --and ia.attr_value = 'FERT'
				inner join [dbo].job_bom jb with(nolock) on jb.item_id = inv.item_id and inv.qty_left <>0 and jb.wo_id = @wo_id
				WHERE oei.ent_id = @ent_id and oei.[type]= 'destination'
				and ent.ent_id <>isnull(@storageUnitId,0)
		 ) a where a.is_disabled=0


		UNION 

		  SELECT secondary_silo,secondary_silo_ent_id from (
				  SELECT ent.description as secondary_silo ,oei.storage_ent_id as secondary_silo_ent_id,
				  case when ((select isNotValidEnt FROM [dbo].[fn_chkStorageValidity](oei.storage_ent_id,'destination',NULL,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no))=1) then 1 
													else 0 end as is_disabled
  
				  FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link oei WITH(NOLOCK) 
				  inner join ent on ent.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id
				  WHERE oei.ent_id =  @ent_id and oei.type = 'destination'
				  and not exists (select 1 from item_inv iv where iv.ent_id =oei.storage_ent_id )
				  and ent.ent_id <>isnull(@storageUnitId,0)
		  ) a where a.is_disabled=0
		  
	  
	  END
END
