-- 02/09/2015	Varun		5.2	CR L00137959 Merge changes (HF CR #L00137705) : Merged fix for HF# CR122578 and
--								temporarily set the preferred bom_ver before calling verify process
-- 03/24/2016	Ibrahim		5.3 US#594193: CR L00130425: Removed the IF condition @for_first_op=2 block which is never executed.
-- 11/27/2018	Raghu		6.1 US-1102377-As AVEVA, I want to refactor the CWOFP SPs to not recalculate the routings when associating to a line
-- 05/08/2019	Varun	    6.1 US#1165985: CR L00153270 Merge changes (HF CR #L00152761)- Added Fast forward to three
--								cursor to improve the performance.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @system_severity      INT,
  @char_start_qty       NVARCHAR(20),
  @return               INT,
  @recursion            INT,
  @oper_id              STRING40,
  @seq_no               INT,
  @stack_index          INT,
  @V_Reqd_Qty           FLOAT,
  @V_Start_Qty          FLOAT,
  @V_Req_Fin_Time       DATETIME,
  @V_Tmp                INT,
  @O_oper_id            STRING40,
  @O_sched_to_ent_id    INT32,
  @OEL_oper_id          STRING40,
  @OEL_ent_id           INT32,
  @V_Feed_Seq           INTEGER,
  @V_Seq_Chk            CHAR(1),
  @V_Mod_Id             NVARCHAR(30),
  @V_Bom_Ver            STRING40_NULL,
  @dbg_resp				INT32
BEGIN
  IF (@wo_id = '' OR @wo_id IS NULL) BEGIN
    RAISERROR('WO_Id cannot be null or empty.{3199}', 16, 1)
    RETURN
  END
  --Check if start qty is atleast equal to the reqd qty
  IF @req_qty > ISNULL(@start_qty, 0)
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Starting quantity must atleast be equal to the required quantity.{4100}', 16, 1)
    RETURN
  END

  SET @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 1)

  SET @release_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
  SET @req_finish_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

   EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_job_exec_CWOFP_stack_1', @src_key='on_entry', @date_val1 = @release_time, @numeric_val1 = @release_time_tz
	, @date_val2 = @req_finish_time, @numeric_val2 = @req_finish_time_tz

  SET @may_override_route = isnull( @may_override_route, 0 )

  SET @recursion = 0
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  IF (@init_wo_state IS NULL) SET @init_wo_state = 2

  SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @req_qty
  SET @V_Start_Qty = @start_qty
  SET @V_Req_Fin_Time = @req_finish_time
  -- Call the stored procedure to check the user's privilege to create WO
  --  EXECUTE sp_chk_user_priv @user_id, @P_priv_id, @ret_status = @priv_status OUTPUT
  IF @check_privs = 1
  BEGIN
	EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_UserHasPriv @V_User_Id = @user_id, @V_Priv_Status = @return  OUTPUT
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
     SET @return =1
  END
  --If user has privilege
  IF @return = 1
  BEGIN
    --Check the process out if its already not checked out
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id AND checked_out_by IS NULL)
    BEGIN
      --Directly checkout to avoid any errors caused by the checks done in the checkout method
      UPDATE process SET checked_out_by = @user_id WHERE process_id = @process_id
      SET @V_Mod_Id = 'X'
    END
    -- First check that the process is valid - returns exception if not
    -- EXEC @return = sp_S_job_exec_VerifyProcess @process_id = @process_id, @parent_item_id = @item_id, @wo_id = @wo_id -- Merge CR L00137959 HF L00137705
    -- BEGIN: Merge CR L00137959 HF L00137705
		--If the bom version passed is not the preferred one set it as preferred temporarily
		IF @bom_ver_id IS NOT NULL AND @bom_ver_id <> ''
		BEGIN
		  SELECT @V_Bom_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
		  IF @V_Bom_Ver <> @bom_ver_id
		  BEGIN
			UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 0 WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
			UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id
		  END  --End of @V_Bom_Ver <> @bom_ver_id
		END  --End of @bom_ver IS NOT NULL

		-- Check to see if process is valid
		EXEC @return = sp_S_job_exec_VerifyProcess @process_id = @process_id, @parent_item_id = @item_id, @wo_id = @wo_id

		--If the preferred bom version is changed in CWFP set it back the it was
		  IF @return = -1 AND @bom_ver_id IS NOT NULL
		  BEGIN
			IF @V_Bom_Ver <> @bom_ver_id AND @bom_ver_id <> ''
			BEGIN
			  UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 0 WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
			  UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver
			END  --End of @V_Bom_Ver <> @bom_ver_id
		  END  --End of @bom_ver IS NOT NULL

    -- END: Merge CR L00137959 HF L00137705

  END
  ELSE
    SET @return = -1
  -- If its a valid process
  IF @return <> -1
  BEGIN
    --Make sure that the temporary table is not created in sp_I_job_exec_CWOFP_Qty procedure
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq') IS NULL
    BEGIN
      --sequence the operations and entities and store in add temporary table
      CREATE TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), ent_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER)
      SET @seq_no = 0
      --Select all the operations and entities for the process and insert into temporary table
      DECLARE cur_ins_ops CURSOR LOCAL fast_forward  FOR SELECT a.oper_id, a.ent_id FROM oper_ent_link a, ent b WHERE a.ent_id = b.ent_id
        AND a.process_id = @process_id ORDER BY a.oper_id, b.ent_name  -- Added a.oper_id to ORDER BY clause 1/24/03 SJ
      OPEN cur_ins_ops
      FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        SET @seq_no = @seq_no + 1
        INSERT INTO #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id, oper_id, ent_id, seq_no) VALUES(@wo_id, @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no)
        FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id
      END
      CLOSE cur_ins_ops
      DEALLOCATE cur_ins_ops
      SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
      WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Seq_Chk = 0
        DECLARE cur_seq_ops CURSOR DYNAMIC LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
          WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no DESC
        OPEN cur_seq_ops
        FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          --check if any of the feeding operations are ahead in the sequence
          DECLARE cur_feeding_ops CURSOR LOCAL fast_forward  FOR SELECT input_oper_id, input_ent_id FROM oper_ent_route oer join ent e on e.ent_id = oer.input_ent_id WHERE process_id = @process_id
            AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND oer.ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id ORDER BY e.ent_name  -- Added ORDER BY clause 1/2/03 KRF
          OPEN cur_feeding_ops
          FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @OEL_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
          BEGIN
            --get the feeding op's seq and compare
            SELECT @V_Feed_Seq = seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OEL_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id
            --if feeding op's seq lesser interchange the sequence nos
            IF @V_Feed_Seq > @seq_no
            BEGIN
              UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @seq_no WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OEL_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id
              UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @V_Feed_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id
              SET @seq_no = @V_Feed_Seq
              SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
            END  --End of @V_Feed_Seq > @seq_no
            FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @OEL_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id
          END
          CLOSE cur_feeding_ops
          DEALLOCATE cur_feeding_ops
          FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no
        END
        CLOSE cur_seq_ops
        DEALLOCATE cur_seq_ops
      END  --End of WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1
    END  --End of OBJECT_ID(#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq) IS NULL

    EXEC sp_S_system_attr_GetSevLevel @system_severity
    SET @char_start_qty = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @start_qty)
    --POPULATE THE JOB TABLES
    EXECUTE @return = sp_build_job_nonalphabetical	@wo_id = @wo_id,
													@process_id = @process_id,
													@item_id = @item_id,
													@req_qty = @req_qty,
													@user_id = @user_id,
													@start_qty = @start_qty,
													@init_wo_state = @init_wo_state,
													@wo_desc = @wo_desc,
													@release_time_local = @release_time,
													@release_time_tz = @release_time_tz,
													@req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time,
													@req_finish_time_tz = @req_finish_time_tz,
													@wo_priority = @wo_priority,
													@cust_info = @cust_info,
													@mo_id = @mo_id,
													@production_schedule_id = @production_schedule_id,
													@notes = @notes,
													@spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id,
													@may_override_route = @may_override_route,
                                                    @parent_wo_id = @parent_wo_id,
                                                    @parent_oper_id = @parent_oper_id,
                                                    @parent_seq_no = @parent_seq_no,
													@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
    IF @return <> -1
    BEGIN
      --POPULATE THE BOM TABLES
      --TEMP TABLE #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty WILL BE USED KEEP THE ACCOUNT OF USED QTY WHEN A START QTY IS SPLIT AMONG THE JOBS
      CREATE TABLE #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), consuming_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        producing_oper_count INT, qty_used_so_far FLOAT, processed_oper_count INT, total_qty FLOAT)
      IF @recursion = 1
      BEGIN
		  -- HF1432 - TODO - no TZ bias passed. May be OK.
          EXECUTE SP_Build_BOM_stack	@wo_id = @wo_id,
										@process_id = @process_id,
										@parent_item_id = @item_id,
										@req_qty = @req_qty,
										@char_start_qty = @char_start_qty,
										@req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time,
										@oper_id = @oper_id,
										@seq_no = @seq_no,
										@spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
        --Create temporary table to hold bom item data for comparison
        --L00131526 Added 2 new columns 'item_ver_id' and 'actual_parent_item_id'
        CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), bom_pos INT, oper_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT, item_ver_id NVARCHAR(40), actual_parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40))
        -- Create call stack
        CREATE TABLE #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), process_id NVARCHAR(40), parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), req_qty FLOAT(8),
          char_start_qty NVARCHAR(20), req_finish_time DATETIME, oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INT, stack_index INT)
        -- Push parameters for initial call onto it
        INSERT INTO #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK (wo_id, process_id, parent_item_id, req_qty, char_start_qty, req_finish_time, stack_index)
          VALUES (@wo_id, @process_id, @item_id, @req_qty, @char_start_qty, @req_finish_time, 1)
        -- Pop from the stack and execute till empty
        DECLARE stack_cursor CURSOR  LOCAL fast_forward  FOR SELECT * FROM #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK ORDER BY stack_index DESC
        OPEN stack_cursor
        FETCH NEXT FROM stack_cursor INTO @wo_id, @process_id, @item_id, @req_qty, @char_start_qty, @req_finish_time, @oper_id, @seq_no, @stack_index
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN	--FETCH NEXT FROM job_cursor
          CLOSE stack_cursor
          DELETE FROM #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK WHERE stack_index = @stack_index

		  EXECUTE SP_Build_BOM_stack	@wo_id = @wo_id,
										@process_id = @process_id,
										@parent_item_id = @item_id,
										@req_qty = @req_qty,
										@char_start_qty = @char_start_qty,
										@req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time,
										@oper_id = @oper_id,
										@seq_no = @seq_no,
										@spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id
          OPEN stack_cursor
          FETCH NEXT FROM stack_cursor INTO @wo_id, @process_id, @item_id, @req_qty, @char_start_qty, @req_finish_time, @oper_id, @seq_no, @stack_index
        END
        CLOSE stack_cursor
        DEALLOCATE stack_cursor

        DROP TABLE #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK
        SET @V_Tmp = 1
      END  --End of @recursion = 1
      DROP TABLE #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty
      --Allocate job quantities based on BOM

      EXEC sp_Alloc_Job_Qty @wo_id = @wo_id, @process_id = @process_id, @item_id = @item_id, @req_qty = @V_Reqd_qty, @user_id = @user_id,
                            @start_qty = @V_Start_Qty, @req_finish_time = @V_Req_Fin_Time, @req_finish_time_tz = @req_finish_time_tz, @release_time = @release_time, @release_time_tz = @release_time_tz
      --Determine finish and latest start time for each job
      -- EXEC sp_Calculate_Times @wo_id, @process_id, @V_Req_Fin_Time
      --Drop the temporary table used for finding item in parent item's tree
      IF @V_Tmp = 1
        DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item

      -- Record BOM version used in new wo.bom_ver_id field - added 1/24/07 KRF
      UPDATE wo SET bom_ver_id = (SELECT ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

      --If the preferred bom version is changed in CWFP set it back the it was
      IF @bom_ver_id IS NOT NULL
      BEGIN
        IF @V_Bom_Ver <> @bom_ver_id AND @bom_ver_id <> ''
        BEGIN
          UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 0 WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
          UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver
        END  --End of @V_Bom_Ver <> @bom_ver_id
      END  --End of @bom_ver IS NOT NULL
    END  --End of @return <> -1
    ELSE
      --Drop the temporary table
--      DROP TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq  --droppped in sp_alloc_job_qty
--	  RETURN
	SET @V_Mod_Id = @V_Mod_Id
  END --End of @return <> -1 (Verify process)

  --Check the process back in if checked out by CWFP

  IF @V_Mod_Id IS NOT NULL
    UPDATE process SET checked_out_by = NULL WHERE process_id = @process_id

  --Set the workorder state code back to the default
  UPDATE wo SET state_cd = 0 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
  --Reset the first job and final job flags
  EXEC sp_U_Job_SetJobFlags @wo_id = @wo_id

 --If the target_sched_line_id is supplied, then automatically assign the work order to a line.
 IF (@target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL)
	 EXEC sp_U_Wo_AssgnOrUnassgnToALine @wo_id = @wo_id, @assign = 1, @line_id = @target_sched_line_id, @queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no, @new_wo = 1

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq') IS NULL RETURN

  --Update reqd_rep percentage for all job_steps.
  DECLARE @each_job_step TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY
	,	woId NVARCHAR(40)
	,	operId NVARCHAR(40)
	,	seqNo INT
	,	stepNo INT
	,	reqdRepPct FLOAT
	,	stepGrpId INT
	,	qtyAtStart FLOAT
  )

  INSERT INTO @each_job_step ( woId, operId, seqNo, stepNo, reqdRepPct, stepGrpId, qtyAtStart )
  SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, os.step_no, os.reqd_rep_pct, jsg.step_grp_id, j.qty_at_start
  FROM oper_step os
	INNER JOIN #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq t_op_seq ON t_op_seq.oper_id = os.oper_id
	INNER JOIN job j ON t_op_seq.wo_id = j.wo_id AND t_op_seq.oper_id = j.oper_id --AND t_op_seq.seq_no = j.seq_no
	INNER JOIN item i ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg ON jsg.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jsg.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jsg.seq_no = j.seq_no
  WHERE os.process_id =  @process_id
	AND t_op_seq.wo_id = @wo_id
	--Calculate the reqd_rep ONLY for the serialized items.
	AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
	AND jsg.repeatability > 0

  UPDATE job_step SET job_step.reqd_rep = ROUND(qtyAtStart * reqdRepPct, 0)
  FROM @each_job_step
    WHERE wo_id = woId
      AND job_step.oper_id = operId
      AND job_step.seq_no = seqNo
      AND job_step.step_no = stepNo
      AND job_step.step_grp_id = stepGrpId

 DROP TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq  --droppped in sp_alloc_job_qty

  SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_TransQtyToCurJob]
(@ent_id	INT
,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@seq_no	INT
,@qty_at_start	FLOAT
,@qty_reqd	FLOAT
,@status_notes	STRING2000_NULL = NULL
,@job_pos	INT	= NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_U_Job_Exec_TransQtyToCurJob
-- Description       - HD# 5053, Transfer Qtys to a running job.
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 10/19/2004
-- Version           - 2.1.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @cur_wo_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@cur_oper_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@cur_seq_no	INT

	IF @status_notes IS NULL SET @status_notes = ''
	IF @job_pos IS NULL SET @job_pos = 0

	SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

	IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL) AND (@cur_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@wo_id = @cur_wo_id) AND (@oper_id = @cur_oper_id) AND (@seq_no = @cur_seq_no) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot transfer the quantity to itself', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified job does not exist in the database.{3176}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = qty_reqd + @qty_reqd, qty_at_start = qty_at_start + @qty_at_start
		, status_notes = status_notes + @status_notes
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

	UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = qty_reqd - @qty_reqd, qty_at_start = qty_at_start - @qty_at_start
		, status_notes = status_notes + @status_notes
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

END

 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Process_Class
-- Description    - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created   - 10/17/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT process_class.process_class_id
            ,process_class.last_edit_comment
            ,process_class.last_edit_by
            ,process_class.last_edit_at
FROM process_class process_class WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((process_class.process_class_id = @process_class_id OR @process_class_id IS NULL) AND
       (process_class.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (process_class.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_util_state_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on util_state table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE util_state SET util_state.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, util_state.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_MasterRecipeParamByFilter
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch all the list of Parameters configured against the selected master recipe
--
-- Usage:		MRM_FX_ParameterRecipe
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-07-01			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  TB              2023-07-31          Returning isActive and preferred
-- 0.03.00	SSB				2023-10-18			Added num_decimals
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_MasterRecipeParamByFilter]
(@recipe_name	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
) AS
BEGIN
	-- Fetch data from parameter sent by The Form
	SELECT
		omr.recipe_name,
		omr.version,
		omr.ent_id,
		e.ent_name,
		omrp.item_id,
		i.item_desc,
		i.num_decimals,
		s.spec_id,
		s.spec_desc,
		CAST(omrp.min_value AS DECIMAL(16,4)) min_value,
		CAST(omrp.spec_value AS DECIMAL(16,4)) spec_value,
		CAST(omrp.max_value AS DECIMAL(16,4)) max_value,
		s.spare1 min_ent_spec,
		s.spare2 max_ent_spec,
		s.units,
		omrp.product_dependent,
		omrp.comments,
		--omrp.last_edit_at_local,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), omrp.last_edit_at_local, 101) + ' '+ LTRIM(RIGHT(CONVERT(CHAR(20),  omrp.last_edit_at_local, 22), 11)) last_edit_at_local,
		omrp.last_edit_by,
		omr.is_active,
		omr.preferred
	FROM ofi_master_recipe_parameter omrp WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ofi_master_recipe omr WITH (NOLOCK) ON omrp.recipe_name = omr.recipe_name
	INNER JOIN spec s WITH (NOLOCK) ON omrp.spec_id = s.spec_id
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON omr.ent_id = e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON omr.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE
		omr.recipe_name = @recipe_name
		AND omr.item_id = @item_id
	ORDER by s.display_seq asc

END

 @oper_id  nvarchar(40) = NULL,

 @process_id  nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @attr_id  int = NULL,

 )

-- Description	      -

,@include_subst bit   = 0
) AS
--***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetCurJobBOM
-- Description        - To return the job_BOM data for the job(s) currently
--                                   running on a given. entity, optionally filtered by job_pos and bom_pos
-- Author	     - KRF
-- Date Created      - 02/15/2006
-- Version                 - 3.1.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 2006-05-18     KRF           3.1.2           Added optional @include_subst flag to include job_bom_spare records.
--                                              Fields in job_bom_subst not in job_bom show up as zeros in job_bom
--                                              records; fields in job_bom not in job_bom_subst show up as nulls
--                                              in job_bom_subst records, as this seems to best preserve their usage.
--                                              Also added est_time, current_subst, and qty_reqd fields and swapped
--						positions of row_id and mod_id to agree with DB field order.
-- 2006-08-30     SJ            3.1.22          HD#7487 - New SP to return job_bom row(s) given ent_id
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
------
IF COALESCE(@include_subst, 0) = 0
SELECT
	 job_bom.wo_id
	,job_bom.oper_id
	,job_bom.seq_no
	,job_bom.bom_pos
	,0 as alt_no
	,0 as pref
	,0 as subst_level
	,job_bom.item_id
	,job_bom.reqd_grade_cd
	,job_bom.instruction
	,job_bom.qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.reqd_start_val
	,job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct
	,job_bom.update_inv

	,job_bom.def_storage_ent_id

	,job_bom.last_edit_at
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id
	,job_bom.row_id
FROM	job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN
	job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.cur_wo_id = job_bom.wo_id
                          AND job_exec.cur_oper_id = job_bom.oper_id
                          AND job_exec.cur_seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
WHERE  (job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id)
   AND (job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos OR @job_pos IS NULL)

	,job_bom.scaling_factor

	,job_bom.may_create_new_lots
	,job_bom.must_consume_from_wip
	,job_bom.must_consume_before_prod

	,job_bom.qty_reqd

	,job_bom.last_edit_comment

	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id

FROM	job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN
	job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.cur_wo_id = job_bom.wo_id
                         AND job_exec.cur_oper_id = job_bom.oper_id
                        AND job_exec.cur_seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
WHERE  (job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id)
   AND (job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos OR @job_pos IS NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_lot_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[lot]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- [tg_lot_aft_upd]
-- Description			- This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on [lot] table to update
--						  last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author				- AML
-- Date Created         - 12/31/2007
-- Version (last edit)  - 3.4.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 04/23/2007       Raghu           3.2.9       HD# 9732, Verifies the lot_no, and sublot_no formats.
--01/29/2008	Raghu		3.4.	L00074459; Adding serial number - Enter Starting Serial no.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@item_id	NVARCHAR(80)
		,@lot_no	NVARCHAR(80)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	DECLARE lot_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT item_id, lot_no FROM inserted

	OPEN lot_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM lot_cursor INTO @item_id, @lot_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		EXEC sp_U_Lot_VerifyLotSublotFormat @item_id, @lot_no, NULL
	END
	CLOSE lot_cursor
	DEALLOCATE lot_cursor

	UPDATE lot
	SET lot.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by,
		lot.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE lot.item_id = i.item_id and lot.lot_no = i.lot_no
END

  @sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
  @row_id int,
  @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_S_Receipt_Lot
-- Description      - Select a single existing row identified by the primary key
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

       ,receipt_lot.date_rcvd_utc
       ,receipt_lot.date_rcvd_local
       ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, receipt_lot.date_rcvd_utc) date_rcvd
       ,receipt_lot.item_id
       ,receipt_lot.lot_no

       ,receipt_lot.last_edit_comment
       ,receipt_lot.last_edit_by
       ,receipt_lot.last_edit_at
       ,receipt_lot.row_id
FROM receipt_lot receipt_lot with (nolock)
WHERE (receipt_lot.row_id = @row_id) OR
	 (receipt_lot.po_id = @po_id AND
	 receipt_lot.date_rcvd_utc = @date_rcvd AND
	 receipt_lot.item_id = @item_id AND
	(receipt_lot.lot_no = @lot_no OR (receipt_lot.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL)) AND
    (receipt_lot.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (receipt_lot.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL)));

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[[vw_ofi_item_attr]]
-- Description: This is used to get basic job's details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2025-02-18			Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_ofi_item_attr]
AS


	WITH ranked_duplicated_items_attr AS (           
		SELECT  Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY ia.item_id,ia.attr_id , ia.last_edit_at) ix
				,ia.last_edit_at
				,ia.item_id 
				,ia.attr_id
				,ia.attr_value
				,ia.notes
				,ia.row_id
		FROM    [dbo].[item_attr] ia WITH (NOLOCK) 
		
	),
	ranged_valid_items_attr AS (             
		SELECT  
				CASE 
					WHEN rdi3.ix IS NULL 
						THEN CAST('1753-01-01' AS DATETIME) 
					ELSE rdi.last_edit_at 
				END valid_from
				,CASE 
					WHEN rdi2.ix IS NULL 
						THEN CAST('3000-01-01' AS DATETIME) 
					ELSE COALESCE(rdi2.last_edit_at, GETDATE())
				END valid_to
				,rdi.item_id 
				,rdi.attr_id
				,rdi.attr_value
				,rdi.notes
				,rdi.row_id
		FROM    ranked_duplicated_items_attr rdi 
		LEFT JOIN ranked_duplicated_items_attr rdi2 ON rdi.ix+1 = rdi2.ix 
												AND rdi.item_id = rdi2.item_id
												AND rdi.attr_id = rdi2.attr_id
		LEFT JOIN ranked_duplicated_items_attr rdi3 ON rdi.ix-1 = rdi3.ix 
												AND rdi.item_id = rdi3.item_id
												AND rdi.attr_id = rdi3.attr_id

	)
	SELECT DISTINCT 
			rvi.attr_id
			,rvi.attr_value
			,rvi.item_id
			,CAST(rvi.notes AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) as notes
			,rvi.row_id
			,rvi.valid_from
			,rvi.valid_to
	FROM ranged_valid_items_attr rvi
	WHERE rvi.item_id IS NOT NULL AND rvi.attr_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GEL_GetEntAccByGroups]
  (@sids_xml	nvarchar(max),
   @ent_id		INT = NULL)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_S_GEL_GetEntAccByGroups
-- Description	  -	This method accepts a list of SIDs in an xml string that represent the OS groups to which the user
--					belongs and optionally an entity ID.  It looks up the SIDs in the Grp_Name table and returns
--					the maximum access in the Grp_Ent_Link table for the groups that match the supplied SIDs.  If
--					none of the SIDs match a group, then 0 is returned for the access.  If an ent_id is supplied then
--					a single row for that entity is returned, else a row for each entity.
--					EXAMPLE XML:
--					<sids>
--						<sid id="S-1-1-123"/>
--						<sid id="S-1-1-456"/>
--					</sids>
--
-- Author		  -	Rich Boyle
-- Date Created	  -	08/12/2014
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By     Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@doc_handle					INT32

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @sids_xml

	SELECT grp_ent_link.ent_id
		,ent.ent_name
		,ent.can_sched_jobs
		,ent.can_run_jobs
		,ent.can_capture_util
		,ent.can_capture_labor
		,ent.can_do_dnc
		,ent.can_store
		,ent.can_log_data
		,ent.parent_ent_id
		, COALESCE(max(CAST(x.accss AS Int)), 0) access
	FROM grp_ent_link grp_ent_link
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_ent_link.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT grp_ent_link.ent_id, grp_ent_link.accss
		FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/sids/sid',2) WITH (id nvarchar(68) '@id') grp_sids
		INNER JOIN grp_name group_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_sids.id = group_name.sid
		INNER JOIN grp_ent_link grp_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON group_name.grp_id = grp_ent_link.grp_id
		WHERE ((grp_ent_link.ent_id = @ent_id)OR (@ent_id IS NULL))) x ON grp_ent_link.ent_id = x.ent_id
	WHERE ((grp_ent_link.ent_id = @ent_id)OR (@ent_id IS NULL))
	GROUP BY grp_ent_link.ent_id, ent.ent_name, ent.can_sched_jobs, ent.can_run_jobs, ent.can_capture_util, ent.can_capture_labor, ent.can_do_dnc, ent.can_store, ent.can_log_data, ent.parent_ent_id
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_labor_status_data]
AS
SELECT labor_usage.log_id,
       labor_usage.labor_start_utc,
       labor_usage.labor_start_local,
       labor_usage.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       labor_usage.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       ent.description,
       labor_usage.wo_id,
       labor_usage.oper_id,
       labor_usage.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       labor_usage.step_no,
       labor_usage.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       labor_usage.lot_no,
       labor_usage.sublot_no,
       labor_usage.lab_cd,
       labor_cat.lab_desc,
       labor_cat.fixedtime,
       labor_cat.vartime,
       labor_cat.color,
       labor_usage.dept_id,
       labor_dept.dept_desc,
       labor_usage.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       labor_usage.shift_start_utc,
       labor_usage.shift_start_local,
       labor_usage.pct_to_apply,
       labor_usage.active,
       DATEDIFF(SS,
                labor_usage.labor_start_utc,
                GETUTCDATE())
          AS duration,
       labor_usage.comments
FROM labor_usage labor_usage
INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   labor_usage.user_id = user_name.user_id
INNER JOIN ent ent ON labor_usage.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
   labor_usage.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   labor_usage.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   labor_usage.seq_no = job.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item ON
   labor_usage.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat ON
   labor_usage.lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
INNER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept ON
   labor_usage.dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
INNER JOIN shift shift ON
   labor_usage.shift_id = shift.shift_id
WHERE labor_usage.active = 1

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_UE_GetEvntStrtForAShift]
(@ent_id					INT32
,@shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL
,@use_previous_shift		INT32 = 0
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0
,@event_start_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_UE_GetEvntStrtForAShift
-- Description	      -	Gets the first utilization event (start) time that is captured for an entity.
--			If an optional shift_start_time is supplied, then the first event_time on the supplied shift is returned.
--			If an optional use_previous_shift parameter is turned on; then the first event start time from the
--			previous shift is returned.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	10/02/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
-- 09/05/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@prev_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@prev_shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME
	,	@event_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@tz_temp				INT32

BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	--Default the time_zone_bias_value parameter to 0; if not supplied.
	SELECT	@use_previous_shift = COALESCE(@use_previous_shift, 0)
		,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_time_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_time_utc OUTPUT

	--Verify whether the supplied start time is not null
	--If a shift start time is supplied, then get the previous shift start time from the supplied shift start time.
	IF (@shift_start_time_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The supplied shift start time is NULL;
		--default to the current shift start as the start time from the supplied entity.
		SELECT @shift_start_time_local = cur_shift_start_time_local, @shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Verify whether the current shift_start_time IS NOT NULL for the supplied entity.
		--If still NULL, then default to the current datetime.
		SELECT	@shift_start_time_utc = COALESCE( @shift_start_time_utc, GETUTCDATE() )
			,	@shift_start_time_local = COALESCE( @shift_start_time_local, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	END

	IF (@shift_start_time_utc IS NULL) AND (@use_previous_shift = 1) BEGIN
		EXEC sp_SA_Util_Exec_GetPrvShftStrt @ent_id, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @prev_shift_start_time_local OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @prev_shift_start_time_local, @tz_temp, @prev_shift_start_time_utc OUTPUT
	END
	ELSE
		--The supplied shift start time paramter does not contain a null value; and the caller is not looking for a previous shift
		IF (@shift_start_time_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT	@prev_shift_start_time_local = @shift_start_time_local
				,	@prev_shift_start_time_utc = @shift_start_time_utc
		END

	--Get the first event start time from the identified shift
	SELECT TOP 1 @event_start_time_local = MIN(event_time_local)
	FROM util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND shift_start_utc >= @prev_shift_start_time_utc
	  AND shift_id > 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_Job_Exec_UnreadyDstrmJobs]
(@wo_id		STRING40
,@oper_id	STRING40
,@seq_no	INT32
,@old_item_id	STRING40
,@ignore_err	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/08/2003	Rohit		1.5.0	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--05/05/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 4385, Special handling of production quantities for piece parts.
--					Re-written this sp along with the above mods to optimize performance.
--05/17/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	Added new ignore_err param to ignore errors returning "some of the jobs
--					cannot be unreadied, etc..' An error should not be raised while cloning a job
--					to a ready state which is truly not in a ready state.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE	@next_oper_id		STRING40,
	@next_seq_no		INT32,
	@prev_oper_id		STRING40,
	@prev_seq_no		INT32,
	@state_cd		INT32,
	@qty_at_start		TFLOAT,
	@qty_reqd		TFLOAT,
	@bom_pos		INT32,
	@item_id		STRING40,
	@qty_per_parent_item	TFLOAT,
	@reqd_start_val		TFLOAT,
	@reqd_start_val_is_pct	LOGICAL,
	@input_percent		TFLOAT,
	@qty_prod		TFLOAT,
	@Total_Qty_Prod	TFLOAT,
	--@Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys	LOGICAL,
	@Total_Qty_Reqd	TFLOAT,
	@errMsg		STRING80,
	@errflag		LOGICAL,
	@good_prod_num_decimals	INT32,
	@item_num_decimals	INT32

	SET @ignore_err = ISNULL(@ignore_err, 0)
	SELECT @item_num_decimals = 0, @good_prod_num_decimals = 0
	SELECT @item_num_decimals = num_decimals FROM item WHERE item_id = @old_item_id

	--Check the system attribute to determine whether an item can produce fractional pieces.
	IF (ISNULL(@item_num_decimals, 0) = 0)
	SELECT @good_prod_num_decimals = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(attr_value) = 1 THEN CONVERT(INT, attr_value)
					ELSE 0 END
	FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 326

	SELECT @item_num_decimals = ISNULL(@item_num_decimals, 0), @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0)

	--Start cursor NextJobs to read all immediate downstream jobs for this job
	--Read next_oper_id = oper_id, next_seq_no = seq_no from job_route
	--where wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no = input params
	SET @errflag = 0
	SET @total_qty_prod = 0

	DECLARE nextjobs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM job_route
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no

	OPEN nextjobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM nextjobs_cursor INTO @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Get the state of the next job,
		--Get state_cd, qty_at_start, qty_reqd (?) from job table for given wo_id, next_oper_id and
		--next_seq_no (NextJob cursor values)
		SELECT @state_cd=state_cd, @qty_at_start=ISNULL(qty_at_start,0), @qty_reqd=ISNULL(qty_reqd,0)
		FROM job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

		-- if it is NEW or CANCELLED continue processing, else fetch next row from NextJobs cursor
		IF (@state_cd > 1 AND @state_cd <> 7) BEGIN
			--Start cursor CheckBOMs to read all relevant BOM start qty requirements for the current NextJobs cursor row
			--Read bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val, read_start_val_is_pct from job_bom
			--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no
			--and bom_pos >= 0 and reqd_start_val > 0 and item_id = what this job made
			SET @total_qty_reqd = 0

			SELECT @total_qty_reqd = SUM(CASE WHEN reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1 THEN reqd_start_val * @qty_at_start * qty_per_parent_item
					ELSE reqd_start_val END)
			FROM job_bom
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no
			  AND bom_pos >= 0 AND item_id = @old_item_id AND reqd_start_val > 0

			SELECT @total_qty_reqd = ISNULL(@total_qty_reqd, 0), @total_qty_prod = 0

			IF (@total_qty_reqd > 0) BEGIN
				--Calculate how much of this qty_prod will help this next job based on its input_percent value.
				SELECT @total_qty_prod = SUM(ISNULL(ip.qty_prod, 0) * ISNULL(jr.input_percent, 0))
				FROM item_prod ip
				INNER JOIN job_route jr ON jr.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = ip.oper_id
						AND jr.input_seq_no = ip.seq_no
				WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @next_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @next_seq_no
				  AND ip.item_id = @old_item_id AND ip.good_prod = 1

				IF (@item_num_decimals = 0 AND @good_prod_num_decimals > 0)
					SET @total_qty_prod = CONVERT(INT, @total_qty_prod)
			END

			SET @total_qty_prod = ISNULL(@total_qty_prod, 0)

			--Determine whether  production for this item is sufficient
			-- to make this job READY or not.
			IF (@total_qty_prod < @total_qty_reqd) BEGIN
				IF (@state_cd = 2) BEGIN
					--Update job set state_cd = 1 (READY)
					--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no
					UPDATE job SET state_cd = 1
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  AND oper_id = @next_oper_id  AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

				END
				ELSE SET @errflag = 1
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE nextjobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE nextjobs_cursor

/*
	--Start cursor NextJobs to read all immediate downstream jobs for this job
	--Read next_oper_id = oper_id, next_seq_no = seq_no from job_route
	--where wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no = input params
	SET @errflag = 0
	SET @Total_Qty_Prod = 0

	DECLARE nextjobs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM job_route
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no

	OPEN nextjobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM nextjobs_cursor INTO @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Get the state of the next job,
		--Get state_cd, qty_at_start, qty_reqd (?) from job table for given wo_id, next_oper_id and
		--next_seq_no (NextJob cursor values)
		SELECT @state_cd=state_cd, @qty_at_start=ISNULL(qty_at_start,0), @qty_reqd=ISNULL(qty_reqd,0)
		FROM job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

		-- if it is NEW or CANCELLED continue processing, else fetch next row from NextJobs cursor
		IF (@state_cd > 1 AND @state_cd <> 7) BEGIN
			--Start cursor CheckBOMs to read all relevant BOM start qty requirements for the current NextJobs cursor row
			--Read bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val, read_start_val_is_pct from job_bom
			--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no
			--and bom_pos >= 0 and reqd_start_val > 0 and item_id = what this job made
			SELECT @Cur_BOM_Pos_Qtys = 0, @Total_Qty_Reqd = 0

			DECLARE CheckBOMs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct
			FROM job_bom
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no
			  AND bom_pos >= 0 AND reqd_start_val > 0 AND item_id = @old_item_id

			SET @Total_Qty_Reqd = 0
			OPEN CheckBOMs_cursor
			WHILE (1=1)
			BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM CheckBOMs_cursor INTO @bom_pos, @item_id, @qty_per_parent_item,
						@reqd_start_val, @reqd_start_val_is_pct
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				--For each row in CheckBOMs cursor calculate the reqd_start_qty
				--If read_start_val_is_pct is true then increment requirement by reqd_start_val * job.qty_at_start * qty_per_parent_item,
				--else increment it by reqd_start_val
				IF (@reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1)
					SET @Total_Qty_Reqd = @Total_Qty_Reqd + (@reqd_start_val * @qty_at_start * @qty_per_parent_item)
				ELSE
					SET @Total_Qty_Reqd = @Total_Qty_Reqd + @reqd_start_val

				--start a PrevJobs cursor to read all prior operation jobs that produce the item
				--we are consuming at this operation
				--Read prev_oper_id = input_oper_id, prev_seq_no = input_seq_no, input_percent
				--from job_route where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id
				--and seq_no = next_seq_no (from NextJobs cursor) and
			END
			CLOSE CheckBOMs_cursor
			DEALLOCATE CheckBOMs_cursor

			SET @Total_Qty_Prod = 0

			DECLARE PrevJobs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent
			FROM job_route
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @next_oper_id AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

			OPEN PrevJobs_cursor
			WHILE (1=1)
			BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM PrevJobs_cursor INTO @prev_oper_id, @prev_seq_no, @input_percent
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Read sum(qty_prod) from item_prod
				--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = prev_oper_id and seq_no = prev_seq_no
				--and item_id = CheckBOMs cursor item_id and good_prod = True
				SELECT @qty_prod = ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_prod,0)),0)
				FROM item_prod
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				    AND oper_id = @prev_oper_id
				    AND seq_no = @prev_seq_no
				    AND item_id = @old_item_id
				    AND good_prod = 1
				--Calculate how much of this qty_prod will help this next job based on its input_percent value.
				--Add this qty to Total_Qty_Prod local variable.
				--Total_Qty_Prod = Total_Qty_Prod + (qty_prod * input_percent from PrevJobs cursor)
				IF @qty_prod IS NULL SET @qty_prod = 0
				SET @Total_Qty_Prod = @Total_Qty_Prod + (@qty_prod * @input_percent)
			END
			CLOSE PrevJobs_cursor
			DEALLOCATE PrevJobs_cursor
			--Determine whether  production for this item is sufficient
			-- to make this job READY or not.
			if (@Total_Qty_Prod < @Total_Qty_Reqd) BEGIN
				if (@state_cd = 2) BEGIN
					--Update job set state_cd = 1 (READY)
					--where wo_id = input param, oper_id = next_oper_id and seq_no = next_seq_no

					UPDATE JOB SET state_cd = 1
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					    AND oper_id = @next_oper_id
					    AND seq_no = @next_seq_no

				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					SET @errflag = 1
				END
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE nextjobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE nextjobs_cursor

*/

IF (@errflag = 1 AND @ignore_err = 0) BEGIN
	SET @errMsg =  'Some of the ops could not be un-readied, because it was already started'
	RAISERROR('Some of the ops could not be un-readied, because it was already started.{3173}', 16, 1, @@error)
END
RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process_GetByFilter]
(@filter_option		INT
,@process_filters	NVARCHAR(MAX)
,@criteria		NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Process_GetByFilter
-- Description       - Return a recordset using the process filters passed in
--			filter_options: 0, 1, 2 3, 100, 101, 102;
--			Supervisor Tab Filters: 0-Item, 1-Level, 2-Status, 3: process_class
--			100 - Filter based on item_id passed in along with other filters
--			101 - Filter based on process_id passed in along with other filters
--			102 - Filter based on process_class_id passed in along with other filters
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 10/01/2003
-- Version           - 2.0.4
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--10/28/2003	Raghu		2.0.6	Added code to support Sub Tree Level in Supervisor
--06/18/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed i.units to uom.description
--08/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.26	HD# 5745, Added operation attribute filters
--08/11/2005	Raghu		2.1.26	HD# 6195, Filter option 101 was filtering way too much.
--09/27/2005	Raghu		2.1.29	HD# 6452, Process window does not filter when there are no attributes
--11/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.4	HD# 6474, Attributes should be ANDed instead of ORed.
--					The SQL construction logic is changed in this version.
--12/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.5	HD# 6975, Applying filters for ByLevel and ByStatus tab does not work.
--04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.13	HD# ?, Process filters does not work when filter option = 100.
--					Code modified to include process filters for filter options >= 100
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities; Prepend 'N' before concatenating each string.
--05/05/2006	Raghu		3.1.15	HD# 8173, 8174, Supply time_zone_bias_value to sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter
--06/08/2006	Raghu		3.1.17	HD# 8166, 8167, Process filter fixes.
--08/01/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   Added filter_option 1001 to return processes that has an item linked to it.
--09/12/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00075683: Supervisor's Process window filter cannot handle ui_config.valu string longer than 4000 chars - shows an empty process tree.  CR 74059 corrected this problem for Supervisor's Jobs window filter.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @SQL 		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@start			INT
	,@end			INT
	,@pos			INT
	,@disp_order		NVARCHAR(1)

DECLARE  @temp_filter		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@attr_filter		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@temp_WHERE		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@temp_SQL 		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@temp_SUBSQL		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@temp_SUBSQL_Where	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@value			NVARCHAR(80)
	,@sub_SQL_Exist	INT
	,@incl_brace		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@attr_SQL		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@sSQLWhere		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@filter			NVARCHAR(MAX)

	,@item_class_filter	LOGICAL
	,@item_filter		LOGICAL
	,@param_def			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@item_class_id		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_class_desc	NVARCHAR(400)
	,@ic_produced		BIT
	,@ic_consumed		BIT
	,@ic_obsolete		BIT
	,@item_id			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_desc			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@uom_desc			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@uom_id			INT
	,@template			BIT
	,@lifetime			INT
	,@unit_cost			FLOAT
	,@i_obsolete		BIT
	,@num_decimals		INT
	,@spare1			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@spare2			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@spare3			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@spare4			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@process_id		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@oper_id			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@ent_id			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@process_level		INT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@creator			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@approver			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@last_editor		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@check_out_by		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@rework			BIT
	,@separator			NVARCHAR(2)
	,@attr_counter			INT
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	CREATE TABLE #attr_filter (filter_count INT, attr_id INT, attr_value NVARCHAR(100))

	SET @separator = '$$'
	SET @attr_counter = 1

	SELECT @SQL = '', @filter = @process_filters, @item_class_filter = 0, @item_filter = 0


	IF (@filter_option IS NULL) SET @filter_option = 0
	IF (@criteria IS NULL) SET @criteria = ''

	IF (@filter_option = 0) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc,i.item_id,i.item_desc,p.process_id,p.process_desc,p.checked_out_by '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE ic.produced=1 AND ic.obsolete<>1 AND i.obsolete<>1 '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 1) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT p.process_level,p.process_id,p.process_desc,p.checked_out_by,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON oel.process_id=op.process_id AND oel.oper_id=op.oper_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 2) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT p.process_status,p.process_id,p.process_desc,p.checked_out_by,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON oel.process_id=op.process_id AND oel.oper_id=op.oper_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 3) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT pc.process_class_id,p.process_id,p.process_desc,p.checked_out_by '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM process_class pc WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON pc.process_class_id=p.process_class_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 100) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT ipl.item_id,p.process_id,p.process_desc,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc,op.display_seq, p.checked_out_by '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=op.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=ipl.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oel.process_id AND op.oper_id=oel.oper_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=pa.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oa.process_id AND op.oper_id=oa.oper_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE ipl.item_id= @criteria '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 101) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT op.process_id,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc,oel.ent_id,e.ent_name,op.display_seq '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM oper op WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oel.process_id AND op.oper_id=oel.oper_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON oel.ent_id=e.ent_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=pa.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oa.process_id AND op.oper_id=oa.oper_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE p.process_id=@criteria '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 102) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT p.process_id,p.process_desc,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc,op.display_seq '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=op.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oel.process_id AND op.oper_id=oel.oper_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=pa.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oa.process_id AND op.oper_id=oa.oper_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE p.process_class_id=@criteria '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 1001) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc,i.item_id,i.item_desc,p.process_id,p.process_desc,p.checked_out_by ';
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM item_class ic '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN item i ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN item_process_link ipl ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN process p ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = 'WHERE ic.produced=1 AND ic.obsolete<>1 AND i.obsolete<>1 '
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT p.process_id FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON oel.process_id=op.process_id AND oel.oper_id=op.oper_id '
		SET @sSQLWhere = ' WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
	END

	SELECT @temp_filter = '', @temp_SQL = '',  @temp_SUBSQL = ''
	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@filter_option = 0 OR @filter_option = 1001 OR @filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) BEGIN
	--		START of extracting Item Class Filters and frame the query
			SET @start = 1
			SET @end = 0
			SET @start = CHARINDEX('ICF:', @filter, @start)
			IF @start > 0 SET @end = CHARINDEX('IF:', @filter, @start) ELSE SET @end = LEN(@filter)
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
				EXEC sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter @temp_filter=@temp_filter, @filter_id='ICF:', @time_zone_bias_value=0, @SQL_OUT=@temp_SQL OUTPUT
					, @item_class_id=@item_class_id OUTPUT, @item_class_desc=@item_class_desc OUTPUT, @ic_produced=@ic_produced OUTPUT, @ic_consumed=@ic_consumed OUTPUT
					, @ic_obsolete=@ic_obsolete OUTPUT
				IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
					IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) BEGIN
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
						SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
						SELECT @item_class_filter = 1, @item_filter = 1
					END
					ELSE
						SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
				END

				SET @temp_SQL = ''
				SET @start = CHARINDEX('ICA:$$($$', @temp_filter, 1)  --Get Attribute ( starting position
				IF @start > 0 BEGIN
					SET @start = @start + 4 -- Get rid of ICA:
					SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @temp_filter, @start)
					IF @end = 0 SET @end = LEN(@temp_filter) ELSE SET @end = @end + 5
				END
				ELSE SET @end = 0	-- Get Attribute ) End Position
				IF @end > 0 BEGIN
					SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
					SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
					SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
					IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) AND @item_class_filter = 0 BEGIN
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
						SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
						SELECT @item_class_filter = 1, @item_filter = 1
					END
					WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
						SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
						SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
						SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

						IF @value <> '' BEGIN
							INSERT INTO #attr_filter VALUES(@attr_counter, CAST(LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) AS INT), UPPER(@value))

						END
						SET @start = @end + 4
						SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
					END
				END
				IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
					IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) BEGIN
						IF (@item_class_filter = 0) BEGIN
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '

						SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
					END
					ELSE
						SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
				END
			END --end of filter found ie, filter string >0
	--		End of extracting Item Class Filters

	--		START of extracting Item Filters and frame the query---------------------------------------------
			SELECT @temp_filter = '', @temp_SQL = '', @start = 1, @end = 0
			SET @start = CHARINDEX('IF:', @filter, @start)
			IF @start > 0 BEGIN
				SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @filter, @start)
