--				IF @end = 0 SET @end = LEN(@filter) + 1
			END
			ELSE SET @end = 0
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
				EXEC sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter @temp_filter=@temp_filter, @filter_id='IF:', @time_zone_bias_value=0, @SQL_OUT=@temp_SQL OUTPUT, @item_id=@item_id OUTPUT
					, @item_desc=@item_desc OUTPUT, @uom_desc=@uom_desc OUTPUT, @uom_id=@uom_id OUTPUT, @template=@template OUTPUT, @lifetime=@lifetime OUTPUT, @unit_cost=@unit_cost OUTPUT
					, @i_obsolete=@i_obsolete OUTPUT, @num_decimals=@num_decimals OUTPUT, @spare1=@spare1 OUTPUT, @spare2=@spare2 OUTPUT, @spare3=@spare3 OUTPUT, @spare4=@spare4 OUTPUT
				IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
					IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) BEGIN
						IF (@item_filter = 0) BEGIN
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
							SET @item_filter = 1
						END
						SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
					END
					ELSE SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
				END

				SET @temp_SQL = ''
				SET @start = CHARINDEX('IA:$$($$', @temp_filter, 1)  --Get Attribute ( starting position
				IF @start > 0 BEGIN
					SET @start = @start + 3 -- Get rid of IA:
					SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @temp_filter, @start)
					IF @end = 0 SET @end = LEN(@temp_filter) ELSE SET @end = @end + 5
				END
				ELSE SET @end = 0	-- Get Attribute ) End Position
					IF @end > 0 BEGIN
					SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
					SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
					SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
					IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) AND @item_filter = 0 BEGIN
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
						SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
						SET @item_filter = 1
					END
					WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
						SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
						SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
						SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

						IF @value <> '' BEGIN
							INSERT INTO #attr_filter VALUES(@attr_counter, CAST(LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) AS INT), UPPER(@value))

							SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN #attr_filter af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' ON af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.filter_count = ' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10))
							SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN item_attr ia' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.item_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id = ia' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value = ia' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value '
							SET @attr_counter = @attr_counter + 1
						END
						SET @start = @end + 4
						SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
					END
				END
				IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
					IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) BEGIN
						IF (@item_filter = 0) BEGIN
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipl.process_id=p.process_id '
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ipl.item_id '
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
							SET @item_filter = 1
						END
						SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
					END
					ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
				END
			END
		END	-- End of item_class or item_filters (mode = 0)

--		START of extracting Process Filters and frame the query-------------------------------------------
		SET @start = 1
		IF @start > 0 SET @end = CHARINDEX('ICF:', @filter, @start) ELSE SET @end = LEN(@filter)
		IF @end > 0 BEGIN
			SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
			SET @attr_filter = @temp_filter
			SET @start = 3
			SET @temp_SQL = ''

			SET @sub_SQL_Exist = 0
			--SET @temp_SUBSQL = ''
			IF ((@filter_option = 0) OR (@filter_option = 3) OR (@filter_option = 1001)) BEGIN
				SET @temp_SUBSQL = ' AND p.process_id IN ('
				SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + 'SELECT DISTINCT p.process_id FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) '
				SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
				SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id=pa.process_id '
				SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=oa.process_id AND op.oper_id=oa.oper_id '
				SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON oel.process_id=op.process_id AND oel.oper_id=op.oper_id '
				SET @temp_SUBSQL_Where = 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter @temp_filter=@temp_filter, @filter_id='PF:', @time_zone_bias_value=0, @SQL_OUT=@temp_SQL OUTPUT, @process_id=@process_id OUTPUT
				,@oper_id=@oper_id OUTPUT, @ent_id=@ent_id OUTPUT, @process_level=@process_level OUTPUT, @process_status=@process_status OUTPUT, @creator=@creator OUTPUT
				,@approver=@approver OUTPUT, @last_editor=@last_editor OUTPUT, @check_out_by=@check_out_by OUTPUT, @rework=@rework OUTPUT

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
				IF (@filter_option = 0) OR (@filter_option = 3) OR (@filter_option = 1001) BEGIN
					SET @sub_SQL_Exist = 1
					SET @temp_SUBSQL_Where = @temp_SUBSQL_Where + @temp_SQL

				END
				ELSE IF (@filter_option = 1 OR @filter_option = 2 OR @filter_option >= 100)
					SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
			END
		END
--		SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
--		End of extracting Process Filters-----------------------------------------------------------------

--		Start extracting process attribute Filters and frame the query-------------------------------------
		IF ((@filter_option = 0) OR (@filter_option = 3) OR (@filter_option = 1001)
			OR (@filter_option >=100 AND @filter_option <= 102) OR (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202)) BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			SET @start = CHARINDEX('PA:$$($$', @filter, 1)	--Get Attribute ( starting position
			IF @start > 0 BEGIN
				SET @start = @start + 3 -- Get rid of PA:
				SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @filter, @start)
				IF @end > 0 SET @end = @end + 5 ELSE SET @end = LEN(@temp_filter)
			END
			ELSE SET @end = 0	-- Get Attribute ) End Position
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
				SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
				SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
				WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
					SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
					SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
					SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

					IF @value <> '' BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #attr_filter VALUES(@attr_counter, CAST(LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) AS INT), UPPER(@value))

						SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN #attr_filter af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' ON af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.filter_count = ' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10))
						SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN process_attr pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.process_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id = pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value = pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value '
						SET @attr_counter = @attr_counter + 1
					END
					SET @start = @end + 4
					SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
				END
			END
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' BEGIN
				IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202)
					SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF (@sub_SQL_Exist = 1) SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + @temp_SQL
					ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
				END
			END

			SET @start = CHARINDEX('OA:$$($$', @filter, 1)	--Get Attribute ( starting position
			--SET @start = CHARINDEX('$$($$', @attr_filter, @start+5)	--Get Attribute ( starting position
			SELECT @attr_SQL = '', @temp_SQL = ''
			IF @start > 0 BEGIN
				SET @start = @start + 3 -- Get rid of OA:
				SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @filter, @start)
				IF @end > 0 SET @end = @end + 5 ELSE SET @end = LEN(@temp_filter)
			END
			ELSE SET @end = 0	-- Get Attribute ) End Position
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
				SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
				SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
				IF @filter_option = 0 OR @filter_option = 3 OR @filter_option = 1001 BEGIN
					SET @SQL = @SQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
				END
				WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
					SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
					SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
					SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

					IF @value <> '' BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #attr_filter VALUES(@attr_counter, CAST(LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) AS INT), UPPER(@value))

						SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN #attr_filter af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' ON af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.filter_count = ' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10))
						SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN oper_attr oa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = oa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.process_id AND op.oper_id = oa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.oper_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id = oa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value = oa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value '
						SET @attr_counter = @attr_counter + 1
					END
					SET @start = @end + 4
					SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
				END
			END

			IF @temp_SQL <> '' BEGIN
				IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202)
					SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF (@sub_SQL_Exist = 1) SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + @temp_SQL
					ELSE BEGIN
						IF (@filter_option = 0) OR (@filter_option = 3) OR (@filter_option = 1001) BEGIN
							SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id=p.process_id '
							SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
						END
					END
				END
			END

			--IF NOT (@filter_option >= 100 AND @filter_option <= 102) SET @incl_brace = ')' ELSE SET @incl_brace = ''
			IF (@sub_SQL_Exist = 1) SET @temp_SUBSQL = @temp_SUBSQL + @temp_SUBSQL_Where + ')'
		END--		End of extracting process attribute
		IF (@sub_SQL_Exist = 0) SET @temp_SUBSQL = ''

	END-- End of filter in NOT NULL situation

	IF (@filter_option = 201 OR @filter_option = 202) SET @SQL = @SQL + @sSQLWhere
	ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + @sSQLWhere + @temp_SUBSQL

	SET @temp_SQL = ''
	IF (@filter_option = 0) OR (@filter_option = 1001) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ' ORDER BY '
		SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 208 	--208 - Item_Class display order
		IF (@disp_order = '0')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_id'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '1')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '2')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '3')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_desc,ic.item_class_id'
		ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_id'

		SET @disp_order = NULL
		SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210	--210 - Item Display order
		IF (@disp_order = '0')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ',i.item_id'		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '1')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ',i.item_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '2')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ',i.item_id, i.item_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '3')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ',i.item_desc, i.item_id'
		ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ',i.item_id'

		SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ',p.process_id'
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 1) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ' GROUP BY p.process_level,p.process_id,p.process_desc,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc,op.display_seq,p.checked_out_by'
		SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' ORDER BY p.process_level,p.process_id,op.display_seq,op.oper_id'
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 2) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ' GROUP BY p.process_status,p.process_id,p.process_desc,op.oper_id,op.oper_desc,op.display_seq,p.checked_out_by'
		SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' ORDER BY p.process_status,p.process_id,op.display_seq,op.oper_id'
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 3) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' ORDER BY pc.process_class_id,p.process_id'
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 100) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = 'SELECT * FROM (' + @SQL + ') x ORDER BY process_id,display_seq'
		SET @SQL = ''
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 101) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = 'SELECT * FROM (' + @SQL + ') x ORDER BY display_seq,oper_id,ent_id'
		SET @SQL = ''
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 102) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = 'SELECT * FROM (' + @SQL + ') x ORDER BY process_id,display_seq'
		SET @SQL = ''
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 201) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = 'SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, p.mod_id))) mod_id, p.* FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE p.process_id IN (' + @SQL + ')'
		SET @SQL = ''
	END
	ELSE IF (@filter_option = 202) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = 'SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, op.mod_id))) mod_id, op.* FROM oper op WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE op.process_id IN (' + @SQL + ')'
		SET @SQL = ''
	END

	SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
	--PRINT @SQL
	SET @param_def = '@criteria NVARCHAR(40),@item_class_id NVARCHAR(400),@item_class_desc NVARCHAR(400),@ic_produced BIT,@ic_consumed BIT,@ic_obsolete BIT,@item_id NVARCHAR(400),@item_desc NVARCHAR(400),@uom_desc NVARCHAR(400)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@uom_id INT,@template BIT,@lifetime INT,@unit_cost FLOAT,@i_obsolete BIT,@num_decimals INT,@spare1 NVARCHAR(400),@spare2 NVARCHAR(400),@spare3 NVARCHAR(400),@spare4 NVARCHAR(400)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@process_id NVARCHAR(400),@oper_id NVARCHAR(400),@ent_id NVARCHAR(400),@process_level INT,@process_status INT,@creator NVARCHAR(400),@approver NVARCHAR(400),@last_editor NVARCHAR(400)'
	Set @param_def = @param_def + ',@check_out_by NVARCHAR(400),@rework BIT'

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, @param_def, @criteria, @item_class_id, @item_class_desc, @ic_produced, @ic_consumed, @ic_obsolete, @item_id, @item_desc, @uom_desc, @uom_id, @template, @lifetime, @unit_cost
		,@i_obsolete, @num_decimals, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @process_id, @oper_id, @ent_id, @process_level, @process_status, @creator, @approver, @last_editor, @check_out_by, @rework

	DROP TABLE #attr_filter
END

-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on vendor_item_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE vendor_item_link SET vendor_item_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, vendor_item_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_MasterSiloConfigData]
AS
BEGIN
	WITH Grid_rec as(
SELECT isl.ent_id
        ,e.ent_name
        ,e.description 
        ,isl.storage_ent_id
        ,isnull(e2.description,e2.ent_name) as StorageEntity  --condition to take storage entity as ent_desc and as ent_name if desc is null
        ,isl.type
        ,isl.item_group
        ,isl.last_edit_by
        ,isl.last_edit_at_local
        ,isl.last_edit_at_utc
        ,isl.row_id

    FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = isl.ent_id
    INNER JOIN ent e2 WITH(NOLOCK)ON e2.ent_id = isl.storage_ent_id),

	Inv_with_Qty as(
	--select distinct ent_id, 1 as [Disable] from item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) where qty_left > 0
	select su_ent_id as ent_id, 1 as [Disable] from job j
	inner join ofi_su_selection ss on j.wo_id=ss.wo_id and j. oper_id=ss. oper_id and j.seq_no=ss.seq_no
	where j.state_cd= (SELECT
	state_cd
	FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE LOWER(state_desc) LIKE LOWER('%RUNNING%'))
	)


   select  --gr.*, 
   GR.ent_id
        ,GR.ent_name
        ,GR.description

   @new_grp_desc nvarchar(80),
   @cur_grp_id int,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 06/15/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_at, last_edit_by and obsolete fields for Insert Statement
-- 10/03/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	 @last_edit_by	STRING40
		,@last_edit_at	DATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

INSERT INTO data_log_grp (grp_desc, max_value, trigger_type, trigger_detail, obsolete,

FROM data_log_grp

 INSERT INTO data_log_grp_ent_link (grp_id, ent_id, last_edit_comment,  last_edit_by,  last_edit_at)

SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
FROM data_log_grp
WHERE (grp_id = @new_grp_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Data_Log_16_AddPEMData]
(@in_grp_desc		STRING80
,@in_sample_time_local datetime
,@in_sample_time_tz INT32 = NULL
,@in_wo_id nvarchar(40)
,@in_oper_id nvarchar(40)
,@in_seq_no int
,@in_step_no int
,@in_item_id nvarchar(40)
,@in_lot_no nvarchar(40)
,@in_sublot_no nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@in_shift_start_local datetime
,@in_shift_start_tz INT32 = NULL
,@in_shift_id int
,@in_ent_name	STRING80 = NULL
,@in_site_name	STRING80 = NULL
,@in_genealogy_id	nvarchar(254) = NULL
,@in_segment_requirement_id nvarchar(254) = NULL
,@in_segment_response_id nvarchar(254) = NULL
,@in_value1 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value2 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value3 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value4 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value5 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value6 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value7 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value8 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value9 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value10 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value11 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value12 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value13 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value14 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value15 nvarchar(80)
,@in_value16 nvarchar(80)
,@in_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254)
,@in_extended_attrs	NVARCHAR(MAX)
,@in_time_zone_bias_value int = NULL
,@last_edit_at datetime = NULL OUT
,@row_id INT = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_I_Data_Log_16_AddPEMData
-- Description					- Creates a new data log group if the supplied data log group does not exists in the database,
--									and adds the data log data to the data_log_16 table.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 10/20/2009
-- Version (last edit)			- 4.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @grp_id				INT32
		,@ent_id				INT32
		,@mod_id				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@sample_time_local		DATETIME
		,@sample_time_utc		DATETIME
		,@last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)
		,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32

		,@doc_handle			INT32
		,@name					NVARCHAR(255)
		,@value					NVARCHAR(255)
		,@datatype				NVARCHAR(255)

		,@event_type			NVARCHAR(80)
		,@dbg_resp				INT

BEGIN

	SET @in_sample_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_sample_time_tz)
	SET @in_sample_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_sample_time_local, @in_sample_time_tz)
	SET @in_shift_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_shift_start_tz)
	SET @in_shift_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_shift_start_local, @in_shift_start_tz)
	SET @in_time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_time_zone_bias_value)

	-- Trace
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Data_Log_16_AddPEMData', @src_key='sp_U_Data_Log_16_AddPEMData',
									 @date_val1 = @sample_time_local,  @numeric_val1 = @in_sample_time_tz,
									 @date_val2 = @in_shift_start_local, @numeric_val2 = @in_shift_start_tz


	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE dlg.grp_desc = @in_grp_desc)
		EXEC sp_I_Data_Log_Grp @grp_id OUT, @in_grp_desc, 16, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id OUT
	ELSE
		SELECT @grp_id = dlg.grp_id FROM data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE dlg.grp_desc = @in_grp_desc

	SET @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@in_ent_name, @in_site_name)

	EXEC sp_I_Data_Log_16 @grp_id, @in_sample_time_local, @in_sample_time_tz, @in_wo_id, @in_oper_id, @in_seq_no, @in_step_no, @in_item_id, @in_lot_no,
		@in_sublot_no, @in_shift_start_local, @in_shift_start_tz, @in_shift_id, @ent_id, @in_genealogy_id, @in_segment_requirement_id, @in_segment_response_id,
		@in_value1, @in_value2, @in_value3, @in_value4, @in_value5, @in_value6, @in_value7, @in_value8, @in_value9, @in_value10,
		@in_value11, @in_value12, @in_value13, @in_value14, @in_value15, @in_value16,
		@in_last_edit_comment, @time_zone_bias_value, @last_edit_at OUT, @row_id OUT

	IF (@in_extended_attrs IS NULL)
		RETURN

	IF (@in_grp_desc = 'PEM Production Data') SET @event_type = 'ExtnProdData'
	ELSE IF (@in_grp_desc = 'PEM Personnel Data') SET @event_type = 'ExtnLaborData'
	ELSE IF (@in_grp_desc = 'PEM Equipment Data') SET @event_type = 'ExtnEquipmentData'
	ELSE RETURN

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = -@in_sample_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @in_sample_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @sample_time_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT	@sample_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @in_sample_time_local )
		,@sample_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sample_time_utc )


	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @in_extended_attrs

	-- Inserting the fileds into job_event table
	INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, event_type, ent_id,
		bom_pos, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, cert_name, done_by_user_id, checked_by_user_id, source_row_id, spec_id,
		segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, subsegment_id, comments,
		value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6,
		value7, value8, value9, value10, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @sample_time_utc, @sample_time_local, COALESCE(@in_wo_id, '-'), COALESCE(@in_oper_id, '-'), COALESCE(@in_seq_no, 0), NULL, @event_type, @ent_id,
		NULL, @in_lot_no, @in_sublot_no, @in_item_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, @row_id, NULL,
		@in_segment_requirement_id, @in_segment_response_id, @in_value5, @in_value4,
		name, datatype, value, NULL, NULL, NULL,
		NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/ea/attribute', 1)
	WITH ( name NVARCHAR(256),
		   value NVARCHAR(256),
	       datatype NVARCHAR(256) )

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CUD_res_grp]
(

 @res_grp_id			NVARCHAR(50) 
,@res_grp_desc			NVARCHAR(50)
,@loc_id				NVARCHAR(50)
,@order					int			= 0
,@is_moveable			bit			= null
,@allow_dynamic_res		bit			= null
,@user_name				NVARCHAR(50)
,@row_id				NVARCHAR(50)
,@deleteFlag			bit
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @RowAvailable int
DECLARE @MaxId int
DECLARE @Return int = 0
select @RowAvailable = row_id from SDB.SCH.res_grp where row_id = @row_id

if @deleteFlag = 0
BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null 
						BEGIN
									--code for insert
									if (@res_grp_id is null)
												select @MaxId = ISNULL(max([res_grp_id]),0) + 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[res_grp]
									else
												set @MaxId = @res_grp_id



									INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[res_grp]
											   ([res_grp_id]
											   ,[res_grp_desc]
											   ,[loc_id]
											   ,[order]
											   ,[is_moveable]
											   ,[allow_dynamic_res]
											   ,[last_edit_date]
											   ,[last_edit_by])
										 VALUES
											   (@MaxId
											   ,@res_grp_desc
											   ,@loc_id
											   ,@order
											   ,@is_moveable
											   ,@allow_dynamic_res
											   ,getdate()
											   ,@user_name)
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								UPDATE [SDB].[SCH].[res_grp]
								   SET [res_grp_desc] = @res_grp_desc
									  ,[loc_id] = @loc_id
									  ,[order] = @order
									  ,[is_moveable]=@is_moveable
									  ,[allow_dynamic_res]=@allow_dynamic_res
									  ,[last_edit_date] = getdate()
									  ,[last_edit_by] = @user_name
								 WHERE row_id = @row_id
						END
						SET @Return =  1;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
			DECLARE @isDataAvailable int
			SELECT @isDataAvailable = count(res_grp_id) FROM SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
			IF (@isDataAvailable = 0 )
			BEGIN
				SELECT @isDataAvailable = count(res_grp_id) FROM SDB.SCH.res_grp_res where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
				IF (@isDataAvailable = 0 )
					BEGIN
						DELETE FROM  [SDB].[SCH].[res_grp] WHERE row_id = @row_id
						SET @Return =  1;
					END
			END
			

			



			
END
SELECT @Return as OutputVal
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [vw_ofi_wip_composition]
-- Description: This is used to summarize the composition of the WIP production against
--    its consumption for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
--
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
-- 0.01.00  JSC      2024-08-14       Initial Version
-- 0.02.00 JSC  2025-01-29   Updated it using aggregated temp tables
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_ofi_wip_composition_v2] AS
WITH aggregated_prod AS
	( SELECT DISTINCT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),iprod.row_id),',') AS 'row_id'
	  ,iprod.item_id
	  ,i.item_desc
	  ,ia.attr_value AS 'prod_item_group'
	  ,iprod.lot_no
	  ,iprod.sublot_no
	  ,SUM(iprod.qty_prod) AS 'qty_prod'
	  ,SUM(iprod.qty_prod_erp) AS 'qty_prod_erp'
	  ,i.uom_id
	  ,u.abbreviation AS 'uom_abbreviation'
	  ,u.description AS 'uom_description' 
	  ,0 AS 'spare3'
	  ,CASE WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS 'is_wip'
	  ,MAX(iprod.created_at_local) AS 'created_at_local'
	 -- ,MIN(iprod.created_at_local) AS 'min_created_at_local'
	  ,iprod.wo_id
	  ,iprod.oper_id
	  ,iprod.seq_no
	FROM dbo.item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)               ON iprod.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.uom AS u WITH (NOLOCK)        ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_attr AS ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = ( SELECT TOP 1 attr_id
		FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
			AND attr_grp = 1 )
	GROUP BY iprod.item_id ,i.item_desc ,ia.attr_value ,iprod.lot_no ,iprod.sublot_no ,i.uom_id ,u.abbreviation ,u.description ,i.item_class_id ,iprod.wo_id ,iprod.oper_id ,iprod.seq_no
	)
  , aggregated_cons AS
	( SELECT DISTINCT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),ic_rm.row_id),',') AS 'rm_row_id'
	  ,ic_rm.item_id AS 'rm_item_id'
	  ,ia2.attr_value AS 'rm_item_group'
	  ,ic_rm.lot_no AS 'rm_lot_no'
	  ,ic_rm.sublot_no AS 'rm_sublot_no'
	  ,ic_rm.fg_lot_no AS 'rm_fg_lot_no'
	  ,ic_rm.fg_sublot_no AS 'rm_fg_sublot_no'
	  ,SUM(ic_rm.qty_cons) AS 'rm_qty_cons' ,0 AS 'rm_qty_cons_totals'
	  ,SUM(ic_rm.qty_cons_erp) AS 'rm_qty_cons_erp' ,0 AS 'rm_qty_cons_totals_erp'
	  ,STRING_AGG(ic_rm.wo_id ,',') AS 'rm_wo_id'
	  ,CASE WHEN i2.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS 'rm_is_wip'
	FROM dbo.item_cons ic_rm WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item i2 WITH (NOLOCK)          ON ic_rm.item_id = i2.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_attr AS ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i2.item_id = ia2.item_id AND ia2.attr_id = ( SELECT TOP 1 attr_id
		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
			AND attr_grp = 1 )
	GROUP BY i2.item_class_id ,ic_rm.item_id ,ia2.attr_value ,ic_rm.lot_no ,ic_rm.sublot_no ,ic_rm.fg_lot_no ,ic_rm.fg_sublot_no
	)
SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM aggregated_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN aggregated_cons ic_rm WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.lot_no = ic_rm.rm_fg_lot_no AND iprod.sublot_no = ic_rm.rm_fg_sublot_no

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_lot_attr_aft_add] ON [dbo].[lot_attr]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_lot_attr_aft_add
-- Description        -  Update inv_lot_attr table automatically if the attribute is visible in inventory.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 11/17/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @item_id		STRING80
		,@lot_no		STRING80
		,@attr_id		INT32

	DECLARE lot_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT i.item_id, i.lot_no, i.attr_id FROM  inserted i
	INNER JOIN attr a ON i.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.visible_in_inv = 1

	OPEN lot_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM lot_attr_cursor INTO @item_id, @lot_no, @attr_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		EXEC sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr @item_id, @lot_no, @attr_id
	END
	CLOSE lot_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE lot_attr_cursor
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_D_ofi_DeleteBoMRecipe
-- Description:	The stored procedure will delete the bom component that called from the WF
--	
-- Usage:		DeleteBoMRecipe
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-08-01			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2022-10-24			Add flag for audit trail in the parameter
-- 0.03.00	DS				2024-04-17			Delete issue has been resolved
-- 0.03.01	MC				2024-08-30			Adding removing only Acive BoM position
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_D_ofi_DeleteBoMRecipe] 
		@parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@recipe_version INT = NULL,
		@item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL ,
		@comments NVARCHAR(250) = NULL,
		@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
		@grade_cd INT,
		@audit_trail BIT = 1 -- 1=Save to audit trail 0=Not Save to Audit Trail
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @iBomPos INT,
			@Mod NVARCHAR(30),
			@iErrorValue INT,
			@iRecipeUsed INT = 0,
			@iRowId INT,
			@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'MRM_BoMRecipe',
			@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI',
			@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = 'delete',
			@dataRecord XML,
			@auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS;
			SET @comments = NULL;
						

	-- Set default value if no value entered
	IF (@audit_trail is NULL or @audit_trail = '')
	BEGIN 
		SET @audit_trail = 1;
	END

	-- Interlock #1 - Check Mandatory Parameter 
	IF (@parent_item_id IS NULL OR @recipe_version IS NULL OR @item_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @iErrorValue = -1

		-- Set Error Message 'Parameters are not completed'
		RAISERROR ('@@MRBWFErrorParameterNotCompleted@@', -- Message text.  
               16, -- Severity.  
               1 -- State.  
               );
			   
		RETURN @iErrorValue
	END

	-- Retrieve data are needed for next execution
	SELECT @iBomPos = bom_pos,
		@iRowId = row_id,
		@Mod = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
	FROM bom_item WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
		AND ver_id = @recipe_version
		AND item_id = @item_id
		AND reqd_grade_cd = @grade_cd
		AND spare2 <> 'InActive' -- 0.03.01 - Can only remove record which is Active
	
	-- Interlock #2 - Validate if recipe is being used
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 
				FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE already_used = 'Y'
					AND item_id = @parent_item_id
					AND version = @recipe_version))
	BEGIN
		SET @iRecipeUsed = 1
	END

	-- Retrieve datas and set into xml format
	-- Currently only those data are logged, It can enabled in the future
	SET @dataRecord = (
			SELECT 
				[parent_item_id],
				[ver_id],
				[bom_pos],
				[item_id],
				[reqd_grade_cd],
				[instruction],
				[qty_per_parent_item],
				[max_qty_per_parent_item],
				[min_qty_per_parent_item],
				[update_inv],
				--[backflush],
				--[def_reas_cd],
				--[def_lot_no],
				--[def_sublot_no],
				--[def_storage_ent_id],
				--[def_reject_ent_id],
				[scaling_factor],
				--[must_consume_from_inv],
				--[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],
				[may_create_new_lots],
				--[must_consume_from_wip],
				--[must_consume_before_prod],
				--[constant_qty],
				--[est_time],
				--[serial_no_source],
				[spare1],
				[spare2],
				[spare3],
				[spare4],
				[last_edit_comment],
				[last_edit_by],
				[last_edit_at],
				[row_id]
			FROM [dbo].bom_item WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
				AND ver_id = @recipe_version
				AND bom_pos = @iBomPos
				AND reqd_grade_cd= @grade_cd
			FOR XML RAW('data')
			);

	-- Validate if recipe was never used 
	-- then delete bom component
	IF (@iRecipeUsed = 0)
	BEGIN
		--EXEC sp_D_Bom_Item 
		--	@parent_item_id = @parent_item_id,
		--	@ver_id = @recipe_version,
		--	@bom_pos = @iBomPos,
		--	@mod_id = @Mod


		
				SET XACT_ABORT ON
				DECLARE    @disallow_delete	INT
					,@current_time	TDATETIME
					,@use_GMT	INT32

				
				  SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 193
				  IF (@disallow_delete = 1)
				  BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Deleting data from %1 is not allowed{3863}, Bom_Item', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				  END

				  DELETE bom_item
				  WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id OR @parent_item_id IS NULL)
					AND (ver_id = @recipe_version OR @recipe_version IS NULL)
					AND (bom_pos = @iBomPos OR @iBomPos IS NULL)
					AND (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @Mod OR @Mod IS NULL)
					AND (reqd_grade_cd=@grade_cd)
				--       CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id)

				  --Maintain bom version date automatically
					EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
					IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

				  UPDATE bom_ver SET ver_date = @current_time
				  WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id OR @parent_item_id IS NULL)
				AND (ver_id = @recipe_version OR @recipe_version IS NULL)
				


		IF (@audit_trail = 1)
		BEGIN
		  

			-- At least one record with the row_id is required for storing the deleted record in the audit_trail table.	
			DELETE @auditTrailParameters
			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (
				row_id
				,field_name
				,field_value
				)
			VALUES 
				(
				@iRowId
				,'@row_id'
				,NULL
				)

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail 
				@module_id = @strModuleName,
				@function_id = @strFunctionName,
				@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters,
				@xmlDeletedRow = @dataRecord,
				@deletedRowSourceTable = '[dbo].[bom_item]',
				@user_id = @user_name,
				@activity = @strActivityMsg,
				@audit_category = 'Info',
				@comments = @comments
		END
	END

	-- If Recipe was used then set bom component to be inactive
	IF (@iRecipeUsed = 1)
	BEGIN
		 
		-- Update spare2
		UPDATE bom_item
		SET spare2 = 'InActive',
			last_edit_comment = @comments,
			last_edit_by = @user_name,
			last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
		WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
			AND ver_id = @recipe_version
			AND bom_pos = @iBomPos

		IF (@audit_trail = 1)
		BEGIN
			-- Set audit trail
			DELETE @auditTrailParameters
			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (
				row_id
				,field_name
				,field_value
				)
			VALUES 
				(
				@iRowId
				,'@Active'
				,'InActive'
				)

			SET @strActivityMsg = 'update'

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail 
				@module_id = @strModuleName,
				@function_id = @strFunctionName,
				@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters,
				@user_id = @user_name,
				@activity = @strActivityMsg,
				@audit_category = 'Info',
				@comments = @comments
		END
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetParentEntities]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - sp_SA_Ent_GetParentEntities
-- Description    - Get all Parent Entities
-- Author	 	  - Pradeep Shenoy
-- Date Created   - 11/26/2010
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		can_sched_jobs BIT, can_run_jobs BIT, can_store BIT, parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))

	DECLARE  @child_level INT
		,@ent_id       INT
		,@root_ent_id  INT

	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs, can_store, parent_ent_id, child_level)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_store, NULL, @child_level FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @child_level = 2

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs, can_store, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_store, el.parent_ent_id, @child_level
				,x.ent_tree
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END


	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

-- Get the Parent Entities into @Parententities table
DECLARE  @Parententities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		 parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))

		INSERT INTO @Parententities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level,ent_tree)
		SELECT e.root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.parent_ent_id, e.child_level,e.ent_tree FROM @entities e
		WHERE e.ent_id IN(SELECT parent_ent_id from @entities)


	SELECT el.root_ent_id, el.ent_id, el.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id,
		e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.child_level, el.ent_tree FROM @Parententities el
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
	ORDER BY el.child_level, e.ent_name, el.ent_name

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_oper_step_link_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[cert_oper_step_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_cert_oper_step_link_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on cert_oper_step_link table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/16/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/16/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM cert_oper_step_link a, inserted b
				WHERE a.cert_name = b.cert_name AND a.process_id = b.process_id
				     AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id  AND a.step_no = b.step_no)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},cert_oper_step_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM cert_oper_step_link a, inserted b
				WHERE a.cert_name = b.cert_name AND a.process_id = b.process_id
				     AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id  AND a.step_no = b.step_no) cert_oper_step_link
	WHERE process.process_id = cert_oper_step_link.process_id

	UPDATE cert_oper_step_link SET cert_oper_step_link.last_edit_by = @user_id, cert_oper_step_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = i.cert_name AND cert_oper_step_link.process_id = i.process_id
	     AND cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = i.oper_id  AND cert_oper_step_link.step_no = i.step_no

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_lot_split_combine_data]
AS
SELECT item_cons.wo_id,
       item_cons.oper_id,
       item_cons.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       item_cons.shift_start_utc,
       item_cons.shift_start_local,
       item_cons.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.item_class_id,
       item_class.item_class_desc,
       item_cons.lot_no,
       item_cons.sublot_no,
       item_cons.fg_lot_no,
       item_cons.fg_sublot_no,
       item_cons.reas_cd,
       item_reas.reas_desc,
       item_reas.reas_grp_id,
       item_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,
       item_cons.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       item_cons.item_scrapped,
       item_cons.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       item_cons.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       item_cons.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_cons.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_cons.from_ent_id,
       from_ent.ent_name from_ent_name,
       item_cons.qty_cons,
       item_cons.transaction_type,
       item_cons.spare1,
       item_cons.spare2,
       item_cons.spare3,
       item_cons.spare4
FROM item_cons item_cons
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   item_cons.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN item item ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas ON
   item_cons.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   item_cons.user_id = user_name.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON item_cons.ent_id = ent.ent_id LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift ON
   item_cons.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
   item_cons.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
   item_cons.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent from_ent ON
   item_cons.from_ent_id = from_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON
   item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
INNER JOIN item_reas_grp item_reas_grp ON
   item_reas.reas_grp_id = item_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
WHERE item_cons.transaction_type > 0

-- 0.02.00			AKM				2024-02-01						cleaned dead code from sp
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	print @process_ent_id 
	print @ent_id
	Declare @item_seg_type varchar(150), @process_name varchar(150)
	
	
	select distinct e.ent_id,e.ent_name, iv.lot_no as lot_no, sum(iv.qty_left) as mes_qty,sl.ent_id as process_ent_id,iv.item_id as item_id,sl.item_group as item_group,
	iis.item_status_desc,ig.item_grade_desc from ent e with(nolock)	 
	 inner join ent_attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id=e.ent_id and ea.attr_value='StorageUnit'
	 inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id= ea.attr_id
	 inner join ofi_ent_item_storage_link sl with(nolock) on sl.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id and sl.type='source'
	 inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.ent_id =sl.storage_ent_id --and iv.item_id = sl.item

	 inner join uom u with(nolock) on u.uom_id= iv.uom_id
	 inner join item_state iis with(nolock) on iis.item_status_cd= iv.status_cd
	  inner join item_grade ig with(nolock) on ig.item_grade_cd= iv.grade_cd
	 where  sl.ent_id=@process_ent_id and sl.storage_ent_id=@ent_id and iv.item_id=@item_id and sl.item_group=@item_group and iis.item_status_desc = @item_status

	 group by e.ent_id,e.ent_name, iv.lot_no,sl.ent_id,iv.item_id,sl.item_group,iis.item_status_desc,ig.item_grade_desc


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_VerifyMinMaxQtys] (
  @wo_id		STRING40
, @oper_id		STRING40
, @seq_no		INT32 = NULL
, @item_id		STRING40 = NULL
, @cur_qty_prod		TFLOAT
, @bStopJob		LOGICAL = 0  -- flag use to identify the sp is called from stop job or not.
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed
-- Description       -	Check Max/Min Qty while Production
-- Author	      - Rohit Pandya
-- Date Created       - 12/20/02
-- Version (last edit)   -  1.5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/20/2002	Rohit		1.5.2	min/max qty is checked based on item cons qty.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/30/2003    Sheetal Jain  	1.5.3 	Item consumption checked against min qty
-- 04/28/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Changed Where clause while summing up @pre_qty_prod. changed lot_no = @lot_no to (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
--					Lot No may be passed as NULL and if lot_no is NULL and include the check with @lot_no IS NULL to give correct @pre_qty_prod
--04/30/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Error Message Text changed. 3269 to 3771
--05/05/2003	Raghu		1.6.4	Removed Lot_No as Total Consumption should be check for the job, not for the individual lot
--05/07/2003	Raghu		1.6.4	Ignored qty_rejected in summing up with total production in job table
--07/30/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 1001) Handle substitute items while checking consumption quantities
--01/24/2007    Raghu        3.2.0    Part of DB Changes; renamed from sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed
-- 08/02/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:716502 - Renamed the cursor name
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

DECLARE  @qty_per_parent_item		TFLOAT
	,@max_qty_for_item		TFLOAT
	,@min_qty_for_item		TFLOAT
	,@cur_wo_id			STRING40
	,@cur_oper_id			STRING40
	,@job_qty_start			TFLOAT
	,@fg_lot_no			STRING40
	,@total_item_cons_qty		TFLOAT
	,@bom_item_id			STRING40
	,@must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL
	,@pre_qty_prod			TFLOAT
	,@constant_qty			LOGICAL
	,@bom_pos			INT

-- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
IF @bStopJob = 0
	--  SELECT @pre_qty_prod = isnull(sum(isnull(qty_prod,0)),0) FROM item_prod
	 SELECT @pre_qty_prod = SUM(ISNULL(qty_prod, 0)) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		AND  item_id = @item_id AND good_prod = 1 --AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
ELSE
  	SELECT @pre_qty_prod = ISNULL(qty_prod,0) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) --+ ISNULL(qty_rejected,0) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

IF @pre_qty_prod IS NULL SET @pre_qty_prod = 0
IF @cur_qty_prod IS NULL SET @cur_qty_prod = 0

IF @bStopJob = 0
	DECLARE job_bom_cursor_verify_min_max CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT bom_pos, ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item, 0), ISNULL(max_qty_per_parent_item,0) , ISNULL(min_qty_per_parent_item,0) , item_id, constant_qty
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos > 0 AND must_consume_before_prod = 1
ELSE
	DECLARE job_bom_cursor_verify_min_max CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT bom_pos, ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item, 0), ISNULL(max_qty_per_parent_item,0) , ISNULL(min_qty_per_parent_item,0) , item_id, constant_qty
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos > 0

OPEN job_bom_cursor_verify_min_max
WHILE (1=1)
BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM job_bom_cursor_verify_min_max INTO @bom_pos, @qty_per_parent_item, @max_qty_for_item, @min_qty_for_item,
					@bom_item_id, @constant_qty
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
	SET @total_item_cons_qty = 0
	--Get the total qty consumed from item_cons for the given item
/*	IF @constant_qty = 0 AND @bStopJob = 0
		IF @lot_no IS NULL
			SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(isnull(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @bom_item_id  AND item_scrapped = 0 --AND fg_lot_no IS NULL
		ELSE
			SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @bom_item_id AND item_scrapped = 0 -- AND fg_lot_no = @lot_no
	ELSE
		SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @bom_item_id AND item_scrapped = 0
*/
	SET @total_item_cons_qty = 0

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos) BEGIN

		SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(qc.qty_cons), 0) FROM (
			SELECT SUM(ic.qty_cons) / (AVG(jbst.qty_per_parent_item)/@qty_per_parent_item) qty_cons
			FROM job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.wo_id = ic.wo_id AND jbst.oper_id = ic.oper_id
			  AND jbst.seq_no = ic.seq_no AND jbst.item_id = ic.item_id
			WHERE jbst.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbst.oper_id= @oper_id AND jbst.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbst.bom_pos = @bom_pos
			  AND ic.item_scrapped = 0 GROUP BY jbst.item_id) qc
	END

	SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = @total_item_cons_qty + ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND item_id = @bom_item_id AND item_scrapped = 0

	IF @bStopJob = 0 BEGIN
		IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND ISNULL(@total_item_cons_qty,0) < @min_qty_for_item  BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Finished goods Lot No does not match with Production Lot OR Total consumed quantity is less than the minimum consumption quantity{3771}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE
			IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND (@total_item_cons_qty IS NULL OR @total_item_cons_qty =0)  BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Finished good Lot no does not match with Production Lot or No Consumption Entered{3269}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
		END
	END

	--print '@total_item_cons_qty = ' + convert(nvarchar,@total_item_cons_qty) +  'Current @pre_qty_prod = ' + convert(nvarchar,@pre_qty_prod) + 'max_qty_for_item = ' + convert(nvarchar,@max_qty_for_item)	+ + 'min_qty_for_item = ' + convert(nvarchar,@min_qty_for_item)
	IF @constant_qty = 0  BEGIN
	        	IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF NOT (( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @min_qty_for_item) <= @total_item_cons_qty AND  (( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @max_qty_for_item) >= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			 END
		END
		ELSE IF @min_qty_for_item = 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF NOT  (( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @max_qty_for_item) >= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			 END
		END
		ELSE IF @max_qty_for_item = 0 AND @min_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF NOT (( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @min_qty_for_item) <= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
		 	END
		END
	END	--constant qty = 0
	ELSE BEGIN	-- constaint qty = 1
		IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF  NOT (@min_qty_for_item <= @total_item_cons_qty AND   @max_qty_for_item >= @total_item_cons_qty) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
		ELSE IF @min_qty_for_item = 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			IF NOT  @max_qty_for_item >= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
		 	END
		END
		ELSE IF @max_qty_for_item = 0 AND @min_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			IF NOT  @min_qty_for_item <= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			  END
		END
	END -- constant qty = 1

END	-- End of BOM Item Cursor
CLOSE job_bom_cursor_verify_min_max
DEALLOCATE job_bom_cursor_verify_min_max
RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process_GetDynRtsByFiltr]
(
 @xml_source		NVARCHAR(4000)
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Process_GetDynamicRoutesByFilter
-- Description					- Returns all dynamic route records for supplied process, filtered by supplied filter values
-- Author						- Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created					- 07/06/2009
-- Version (last edit)			- 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries.  All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Version  Changes
-- 05/25/2017	  RWB			6.0.0	 For story 782078, parameterized the dynamic query.  Also, selected the item_id
--										 rework_cd, and reas_cd lists into a temporary table to parameterize them.
-- 02/04/2020     Jim O'Hearn   6.2.0    Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT  ON

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @doc_handle          INT32
             ,@orig_process_id     NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@orig_oper_id        NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@item_id             NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@rework_cd           NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@reas_cd             NVARCHAR(40)
	CREATE TABLE #itemIDFilters(item_id NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #reworkCdFilters(rework_cd NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #reasCdFilters(reas_cd INT NOT NULL)


	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml
	SELECT @orig_process_id = CASE WHEN orig_process_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE orig_process_id END
	, @orig_oper_id = CASE WHEN orig_oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE orig_oper_id END
    FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (orig_process_id  NVARCHAR(160),
          orig_oper_id NVARCHAR(160))

	INSERT INTO #itemIDFilters (item_id)
		SELECT * FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, 'request/items/item_id', 1) WITH (reas_cd  nvarchar(max) 'text()')

	INSERT INTO #reworkCdFilters (rework_cd)
		SELECT * FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, 'request/rework_cds/rework_cd', 1) WITH (reas_cd  nvarchar(max) 'text()')

	INSERT INTO #reasCdFilters (reas_cd)
		SELECT * FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, 'request/item_reasons/reas_cd', 1) WITH (reas_cd  int 'text()')

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

    DECLARE @sSQL NVARCHAR(MAX)
    --Select the rework records that are possible for this process
	SET @sSQL = 'SELECT rw.rework_process_id, op.oper_id, op.oper_desc, rw.orig_rework_cd, rw.orig_process_id, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'rw.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc, ir.reas_grp_id, rw.item_id, rw.max_times_rework, rw.reentry_rework_cd, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'op.display_seq, rw.last_edit_comment, rw.last_edit_by, rw.last_edit_at '
    IF(@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ', op2.oper_id as orig_oper_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM rework_process_usage rw WITH (NOLOCK) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN process pr with (NOLOCK) ON rw.rework_process_id = pr.process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN oper op with (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = pr.process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_reas ir with (NOLOCK)ON ir.reas_cd = rw.reas_cd '
    IF(@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN oper op2 with (NOLOCK) ON op2.process_id = @orig_process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE (rw.orig_process_id IS NULL OR rw.orig_process_id = @orig_process_id) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND (rw.item_id IS NULL OR rw.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_process_link '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE process_id = @orig_process_id))'
    IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #itemIDFilters)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #itemIDFilters) '
    IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #reworkCdFilters)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd FROM #reworkCdFilters) '
    ELSE IF (@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd from oper where process_id = @orig_process_id) '
    ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd from oper where process_id  = @orig_process_id AND oper_id = @orig_oper_id) '
    IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #reasCdFilters)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.reas_cd IN (SELECT reas_cd FROM #reasCdFilters) '

	DECLARE @paramDef NVARCHAR(MAX)
	SET @paramDef = '@orig_process_id NVARCHAR(40), @orig_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)'
    EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @paramDef, @orig_process_id = @orig_process_id, @orig_oper_id = @orig_oper_id

	DROP TABLE #itemIDFilters
	DROP TABLE #reworkCdFilters
	DROP TABLE #reasCdFilters
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_wo_aft_ins] ON [dbo].[wo]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_aft_ins
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any insert is made on wo table
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 05/12/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.21
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	UPDATE wo SET wo.req_qty = ROUND(i.req_qty, it.num_decimals)
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE wo.wo_id = i.wo_id

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_MaterialTemplateByFilter
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch all the material templates configured in the system
--
-- Usage:		MaterialTemplateOverview
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-06-08			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_MaterialTemplateByFilter]
	@template_name NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
	@attr_id INT =  NULL,
	@data_type INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--Retrieve Data From ofi_material_template
	SELECT omt.item_group template_name,
		a.attr_id,
		a.attr_desc,
		--0=string, 1=drop down from values defined in attr_set table, 2=integer, 3=currency, 4=color, 5=datetime, 6=floating point number, 7=percent, 8=checkbox, 9=non-editable, 10=time of day
		CASE 
			WHEN a.data_type = 0 THEN 'String'
			WHEN a.data_type = 1 THEN 'Drop down'
			WHEN a.data_type = 2 THEN 'Integer'
			WHEN a.data_type = 3 THEN 'Currency'
			WHEN a.data_type = 4 THEN 'Color'
			WHEN a.data_type = 5 THEN 'DateTime'
			WHEN a.data_type = 6 THEN 'Float'
			WHEN a.data_type = 7 THEN 'Percent'
			WHEN a.data_type = 8 THEN 'Check Box'
			WHEN a.data_type = 9 THEN 'Non-Editable'
			WHEN a.data_type = 10 THEN 'Time of Day'
		END data_type,
		omt.def_value default_value,
		ISNULL(omt.last_edit_at_utc,omt.created_at_utc) last_edit_at_utc,
		omt.last_edit_by,
		omt.row_id
	FROM ofi_master_attr omt WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON omt.attr_id = a.attr_id and a.attr_grp = 1 -- Item Attribute Group = 1
	WHERE 
		(omt.item_group = @template_name OR @template_name IS NULL)
		AND (omt.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL)
		AND (a.data_type = @data_type OR @data_type IS NULL)
		AND (omt.process_id IS NULL AND omt.oper_id IS NULL)
	ORDER BY omt.item_group, a.attr_desc

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Data_Log_Grp_CloneByName]
(@new_grp_desc nvarchar(80)
,@cur_grp_name nvarchar(80)
,@new_grp_id  int OUT
,@mod_id varchar(30) OUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_I_Data_Log_Grp_CloneByName
-- Description					- Creates new data log group from an existing data log group.
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Author			 - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetJBStepQuants]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no	INT
,@step_no	INT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetJobBOMStepQuantities
-- Description       - To return a single recordset
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/13/2003
-- Version           - 1.6.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--07/02/2003	Raghu		1.7.0		Renamed sp_name from "sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetJobBOMStepQuantities"
-- 07/10/2003   Rich Boyle   	1.6.14		Remaining was being calculated incorrectly.  It  was not taking other steps into account.
-- 09/24/2003	Rich Boyle	?		Added a check to make sure that BOM 0 is not included.
--10/06/2003	Raghu		2.0.0.4		Changed the join and removed the dynamic SQL
--04/21/2005	Raghu		2.1.20		HD# 5575, bom_pos 0 records are included in the returned resultset
--05/12/2005	Raghu		2.1.21		HD# 5661, Bom 0 records are shown if and only if the operation is the fist
--						operation and there are no components.
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--05/14/2007    Raghu       3.2.12  HD# 9871, Jobs window-Cannot consume at all steps
--01/11/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073490; BOM Components do not show up.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN

DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@ssql		NVARCHAR(2000)

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210

	SELECT jb.bom_pos,
		'item' = CASE 	WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN i.item_id
	      			WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN i.item_desc
				WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN i.item_id + ' (' + ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ')'
				WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ' (' + i.item_id + ')'
				ELSE i.item_id + ' (' + ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ')'
	 		END,
		 jb.qty_per_parent_item quantity, ISNULL(jbs.qty_per_parent_item,0) qty_at_step,
 		(jb.qty_per_parent_item - (select ISNULL(sum(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) from job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = jb.wo_id and oper_id = jb.oper_id and seq_no = jb.seq_no and bom_pos = jb.bom_pos)) remaining,
		 0 changed, i.num_decimals,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, jbs.mod_id))) mod_id
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom_step jbs WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jbs.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbs.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbs.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbs.bom_pos AND jbs.step_no = @step_no
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jb.bom_pos <> 0
	UNION
	SELECT jb.bom_pos,
		'item' = CASE 	WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN i.item_id
	      			WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN i.item_desc
				WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN i.item_id + ' (' + ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ')'
				WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ' (' + i.item_id + ')'
				ELSE i.item_id + ' (' + ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ')'
	 		END,
		 jb.qty_per_parent_item quantity, ISNULL(jbs.qty_per_parent_item,0) qty_at_step,
 		(jb.qty_per_parent_item - (select ISNULL(sum(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) from job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = jb.wo_id and oper_id = jb.oper_id and seq_no = jb.seq_no and bom_pos = jb.bom_pos)) remaining,
		 0 changed, i.num_decimals,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, jbs.mod_id))) mod_id
		 FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
		 INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = jb.seq_no
		 INNER JOIN job_bom jb_prev WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb_prev.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jb_prev.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id
			AND jb_prev.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no AND jb_prev.item_id = jb.item_id AND jb_prev.bom_pos = 0
		 LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom_step jbs WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jbs.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbs.oper_id
			AND jb.seq_no = jbs.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbs.bom_pos AND jbs.step_no = @step_no
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jb.bom_pos = 0
		  AND (jbs.step_no = @step_no OR jbs.step_no IS NULL)
	UNION
	SELECT jb.bom_pos,
		'item' = CASE 	WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN i.item_id
	      			WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN i.item_desc
				WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN i.item_id + ' (' + ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ')'
				WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ' (' + i.item_id + ')'
				ELSE i.item_id + ' (' + ISNULL(i.item_desc, '') + ')'
	 		END,
		 jb.qty_per_parent_item quantity, ISNULL(jbs.qty_per_parent_item,0) qty_at_step,
 		(jb.qty_per_parent_item - (select ISNULL(sum(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) from job_bom_step where wo_id = jb.wo_id and oper_id = jb.oper_id and seq_no = jb.seq_no and bom_pos = jb.bom_pos)) remaining,
		 0 changed, i.num_decimals,
		 CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, jbs.mod_id))) mod_id
		 FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
		 INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
		 LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom_step jbs WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jbs.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbs.oper_id
			AND jb.seq_no = jbs.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbs.bom_pos AND jbs.step_no = 1
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
--		  AND jbs.step_no = @step_no
		  AND jb.bom_pos = 0
		  AND j.first_job = 1
		  AND 1 =  ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 2 FROM job_bom jbom WHERE jbom.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND jbom.oper_id = jb.oper_id
					AND jbom.seq_no = jb.seq_no AND jbom.bom_pos > 0), 1)
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_lot_attr_aft_del] ON [dbo].[lot_attr]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_lot_attr_aft_del
-- Description        -  Update inv_lot_attr table automatically if the attribute is visible in the inventory.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 11/17/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @item_id		STRING80
		,@lot_no		STRING80
		,@attr_id		INT32

	DECLARE lot_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT d.item_id, d.lot_no, d.attr_id FROM deleted d
	INNER JOIN attr a ON d.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.visible_in_inv = 1

	OPEN lot_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM lot_attr_cursor INTO @item_id, @lot_no, @attr_id
