	END
	CLOSE lot_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE lot_attr_cursor
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_D_ofi_DeleteMasterRecipe
-- Description:	The stored procedure will delete master recipe that called from the WF
--	
-- Usage:		DeleteMasterRecipe
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-07-19			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2022-10-24			Add flag for audit trail in the parameter
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_D_ofi_DeleteMasterRecipe]
	@recipe_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
	@comments NVARCHAR(250) = NULL,
	@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
	@audit_trail BIT = 1 -- 1=Save to audit trail 0=Not Save to Audit Trail

AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @iErrorValue INT = 0,
			@strRecipePreferred NVARCHAR(1),
			@iRecipeCount INT,
			@iRecipeVersion INT,
			@iRecipeId INT,
			@iEntId INT,
			@iRecipeUsed INT = 0,
			@strItemid NVARCHAR(40),
			@mod NVARCHAR(30) = NULL,
			@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'MRM_MasterRecipe',
			@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI',
			@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = 'delete',
			@dataRecord XML,
			@auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS;

	-- Set default value if no value entered
	IF (@audit_trail is NULL or @audit_trail = '')
	BEGIN 
		SET @audit_trail = 1;
	END

	-- retrieve data are needed for next execution
	SELECT TOP 1 @strRecipePreferred = preferred, 
				@iRecipeVersion = version, 
				@strItemid = item_id, 
				@iEntId = ent_id, 
				@iRecipeId = row_id
	FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name

	-- retrieve datas and set into xml format
	SET @dataRecord = (
			SELECT 
				row_id,
				ent_id,
				item_id,
				recipe_name,
				version,
				preferred,
				is_active,
				created_at_local,
				created_at_utc,
				created_by,
				last_edit_at_local,
				last_edit_at_utc,
				@user_name AS last_edit_by
			FROM [dbo].ofi_master_recipe WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
			FOR XML RAW('data')
			);

	-- Interlock #1 - Validate if recipe is being used
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 
				FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE already_used = 'Y'
					AND version = @iRecipeVersion
					AND item_id = @strItemid))
	BEGIN
		SET @iRecipeUsed = 1
	END

	-- Interlock #2 - Master Recipe Can't Delete if BoM Item(s) still available
	/* Disabled
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bom_item WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE parent_item_id = @strItemid AND ver_id = @iRecipeVersion AND bom_pos > 0))
	BEGIN
		SET @iErrorValue = -1

		RAISERROR ('@@MRWFErrorBoMItemsAreExist@@', -- Message text.  
               16, -- Severity.  
               1 -- State.  
               );

		RETURN -1
	END
	*/

	-- check if recipe marked as a preferred version
	IF (@strRecipePreferred = 'Y') BEGIN
		--Since this recipe is marked as a preferred version, then verify there are no other version exist
		SELECT @iRecipeCount = COUNT(*)
		FROM ofi_master_recipe
		WHERE item_id = @strItemid
		AND ent_id = @iEntId
		AND version <> @iRecipeVersion

 		-- Interlock #3 - Set Error Message 'Cannot delete a preferred version. Please select another version as preferred before deleting.'
		IF (@iRecipeCount > 1) 
		BEGIN
			SET @iErrorValue = -1

			RAISERROR ('@@MRWFErrorPreferredRecipeCantDelete@@', -- Message text.  
               16, -- Severity.  
               1 -- State.  
               );

			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE IF (@iRecipeCount = 1) BEGIN
			--Since there is only one version exist other than the selected version, automatically set the other version as the preferred version.
		    UPDATE ofi_master_recipe 
			SET preferred = 'Y', 
				last_edit_at_local = GETDATE(), 
				last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE item_id = @strItemid
			  AND ent_id = @iEntId
			  AND version <> @iRecipeVersion
		END
	END

	IF (@iErrorValue >= 0)
	BEGIN		
		-- If recipe haven't used in the process then allow to delete
		IF (@iRecipeUsed = 0)
		BEGIN 
			-- delete parameter recipe 
			DELETE ofi_master_recipe_parameter
			WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name AND item_id = @strItemid

			-- validate if the prefered in the bom_ver as preferred then update as not preferred
			-- bom_ver cannot delete if it is preferred
			IF (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE parent_item_id = @strItemid AND ver_id = @iRecipeVersion AND preferred_ver = 1))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 0
				WHERE parent_item_id = @strItemid
					AND ver_id = @iRecipeVersion
					AND CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod
			END

			-- delete bom version and bom item
			EXEC sp_D_Bom_Ver
				@parent_item_id = @strItemid , 
				@ver_id = @iRecipeVersion,
				@mod_id = @mod

			-- delete master recipe
			DELETE ofi_master_recipe 
			WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
				AND item_id = @strItemid
				AND ent_id = @iEntId
				AND version = @iRecipeVersion

			IF (@audit_trail = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- At least one record with the row_id is required for storing the deleted record in the audit_trail table.
				DELETE @auditTrailParameters
				INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (
					row_id
					,field_name
					,field_value
					)
				VALUES 
					(
					@iRecipeId
					,'@row_id'
					,NULL
					)

				EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail 
					@module_id = @strModuleName,
					@function_id = @strFunctionName,
					@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters,
					@xmlDeletedRow = @dataRecord,
					@deletedRowSourceTable = '[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe]',
					@user_id = @user_name,
					@activity = @strActivityMsg,
					@audit_category = 'Info',
					@comments = @comments
			END

		END
		-- If recipe used in the process then don't allow to delete only put as inactive
		ELSE IF (@iRecipeUsed = 1)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ofi_master_recipe 
			SET is_active = 'N', 
				preferred = 'N',
				last_edit_at_local = GETDATE(), 
				last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
				AND item_id = @strItemid
				AND version = @iRecipeVersion

			IF (@audit_trail = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- Set audit trail
				DELETE @auditTrailParameters
				INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (
					row_id
					,field_name
					,field_value
					)
				VALUES 
					(
					@iRecipeId
					,'@Active'
					,'N'
					),
					(
					@iRecipeId
					,'@Preferred'
					,'N'
					)

				SET @strActivityMsg = 'update'

				EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail 
					@module_id = @strModuleName,
					@function_id = @strFunctionName,
					@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters,
					@user_id = @user_name,
					@activity = @strActivityMsg,
					@audit_category = 'Info',
					@comments = @comments
			END
		END
	END
END

-- Description: This is used to summarize the consumption details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2024-08-13			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2024-09-23			Updated link to item view
-- 0.01.02  JSC				2024-10-24			Updated it to have also Latest creation time
-- 0.01.03	JSC				2025-02-18			Fix for duplicated item_attr
-- 0.01.04	JSC				2025-02-18		    Added finish good sublot and reason cd

CREATE       VIEW [dbo].[vw_job_cons_details]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT	 j.wo_id
				,j.oper_id
				,j.seq_no
				,CONCAT(j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no) AS 'job_id'
				,j.job_desc
				,j.state_cd
				,js.state_desc
				,j.item_id AS 'job_item_id'
				,icons.item_id AS 'cons_item_id'
				,i.item_desc AS 'cons_item_desc'
				,oia.attr_value AS 'cons_item_group'
				,icons.ent_id
				,icons.from_ent_id
				,icons.lot_no
				,icons.sublot_no
				,icons.fg_sublot_no
				,SUM(icons.qty_cons)  AS 'total_qty_cons'
				,SUM(icons.qty_cons_erp)  AS 'total_qty_cons_erp'
				,icons.grade_cd
				,igra.item_grade_desc
				,'#' + CONVERT(char(6), CONVERT(BINARY(3), igra.color), 2) AS 'item_grade_color'
				,u.abbreviation AS 'uom_abbreviation'
				,u.description AS 'uom_description'	
				,i.uom_id
				,icons.reas_cd
				,ir.reas_desc AS 'cons_item_reason'	
				,COALESCE(e2.description,e1.description,e2.ent_name,e1.ent_name) AS 'line_description'				
				,MAX(icons.created_at_local) AS 'latest_icons_created_at_local'
FROM  dbo.job AS j WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.init_sched_ent_id = e1.ent_id 
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = e2.ent_id 
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.job_state AS js WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd = js.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_cons AS icons WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = icons.wo_id 
														AND j.oper_id = icons.oper_id 
														AND j.seq_no = icons.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.vw_ofi_item AS oi WITH (NOLOCK) ON icons.item_id = oi.item_id AND icons.last_edit_at > oi.valid_from AND icons.last_edit_at <= valid_to
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item AS i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = oi.item_id AND i.row_id = oi.row_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_grade AS igra WITH (NOLOCK) ON icons.grade_cd = igra.item_grade_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_reas AS ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON icons.reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.uom AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.vw_ofi_item_attr AS oia WITH (NOLOCK) ON icons.item_id = oia.item_id 			-- v.1.03: Added vw_ofi_item_attr view instead of table
																		AND icons.last_edit_at > oia.valid_from 
																		AND icons.last_edit_at <= oia.valid_to 
																		AND oia.attr_id = ( 	SELECT TOP 1 attr_id 
																		FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
																			AND attr_grp = 1
																	)
GROUP BY j.wo_id
		,j.oper_id
		,j.seq_no
		,j.job_desc
		,j.state_cd
		,js.state_desc
		,j.item_id
		,icons.item_id
		,i.item_desc
		,oia.attr_value
		,icons.ent_id
		,icons.from_ent_id
		,icons.lot_no
		,icons.sublot_no
		,icons.fg_sublot_no
		,icons.grade_cd
		,igra.item_grade_desc
		,igra.item_grade_desc
		,igra.color
		,u.abbreviation
		,u.description
		,i.uom_id
		,icons.reas_cd
		,ir.reas_desc
		,COALESCE(e2.description,e1.description,e2.ent_name,e1.ent_name)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_matl_reconciliation_data]
AS
SELECT item_cons.wo_id,
       item_cons.oper_id,
       item_cons.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.qty_prod,
       item_cons.shift_start_utc,
       item_cons.shift_start_local,
       item_cons.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.item_class_id,
       item_class.item_class_desc,
       job_bom.qty_per_parent_item,
       job_bom.constant_qty,
       item_cons.lot_no,
       item_cons.sublot_no,
       item_cons.fg_lot_no,
       item_cons.fg_sublot_no,
       item_cons.reas_cd,
       item_reas.reas_desc,
       item_reas.reas_grp_id,
       item_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,
       item_cons.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       item_cons.item_scrapped,
       item_cons.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       item_cons.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       item_cons.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_cons.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_cons.from_ent_id,
       from_ent.ent_name from_ent_name,
       item_cons.qty_cons,
       item_cons.spare1,
       item_cons.spare2,
       item_cons.spare3,
       item_cons.spare4
FROM item_cons
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   item_cons.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN item item ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas ON
   item_cons.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   item_cons.user_id = user_name.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON item_cons.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift ON
   item_cons.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
   item_cons.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
   item_cons.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent from_ent ON
   item_cons.from_ent_id = from_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON
   item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
INNER JOIN item_reas_grp item_reas_grp ON
   item_reas.reas_grp_id = item_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom job_bom ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND
   item_cons.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND
   item_cons.item_id = job_bom.item_id
WHERE (job_bom.bom_pos > 0) AND
      (item_cons.transaction_type = 0)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_History_EndJob]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		STRING40
,@job_end_utc		DATETIME
,@last_edit_comment	STRING254
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@job_pos		INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_History_EndJob
-- Description          -
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @can_track_oee		LOGICAL
	,@hour_bucket_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,@hour_bucket_end_utc	TDATETIME
	,@row_id		INT32
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	,@error_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@ent_name		STRING80
	,@ent_name_vio		STRING80
	,@wo_id_vio		STRING80
	,@oper_id_vio		STRING80
	,@seq_no_vio		STRING40
	,@job_pos_vio		STRING40
	,@job_start_utc_vio	NVARCHAR(20)
	,@job_end_utc_vio	NVARCHAR(20)

BEGIN
	--Exit, if the job end time is not supplied
	IF (@job_end_utc IS NULL) RETURN

	--Strip out the milliseconds
	SELECT @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@job_end_utc)
		, @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, 'JobHistory.EndJob')

	--Retrieve the closest job start time relative to the supplied end time
	SELECT @job_start_utc = MAX(jh.job_start_utc)
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND (jh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc OR @job_start_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (jh.job_pos = @job_pos OR @job_pos IS NULL)
	  --Get the closest start time from the supplied end time
	  AND jh.job_start_utc <= @job_end_utc

	--Verify whether there is a start time for the job to be ended.
	IF (@job_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @error_msg = 'The supplied job cannot be paused or ended because there is no start time prior to the supplied end time(UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ' for the job.{7992},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120)
		RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Retrieve the job position related to the job
	SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name, @can_track_oee = e.can_track_oee
		, @job_pos = jh.job_pos, @row_id = jh.row_id
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = e.ent_id
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND jh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc

	--Ensure the runtime of the job is not overlapping with another runtime
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
			--There are jobs started between the start and end time of the supplied job
			  AND jh.job_start_utc < @job_end_utc
			--There are jobs ended between the start and end time of the supplied job
			  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, @current_time_utc) > @job_start_utc
			--Jobs running on the same job position
			  AND jh.job_pos = @job_pos
			--Exclude the supplied job
			  AND jh.row_id <> @row_id) BEGIN

		SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id_vio = jh.wo_id, @oper_id_vio = jh.oper_id, @seq_no_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), jh.seq_no)
			, @job_start_utc_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_start_utc, 120)
			, @job_end_utc_vio = COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_end_utc, 120), 'Running')
		FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
		--There are jobs started between the start and end time of the supplied job
		  AND jh.job_start_utc < @job_end_utc
		--There are jobs ended between the start and end time of the supplied job
		  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, @current_time_utc) > @job_start_utc
		--Jobs running on the same job position
		  AND jh.job_pos = @job_pos
		--Exclude the supplied job
		  AND jh.row_id <> @row_id

		--The same job or another job was running at the job position during the runtime of the supplied job.
		SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:'+ @wo_id + ', OperID:' + @oper_id + ', SeqNo:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ') running on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' and end time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ' cannot be ended,
			because it overlaps with another job (WoID:'+ @wo_id_vio + ', OperID:' + @oper_id_vio + ', SeqNo:' + @seq_no_vio + ') on the same entity at the same job position with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and end time (UTC):' + @job_end_utc_vio + '.{7993},'
			+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ','
			+ @wo_id_vio + ',' + @oper_id_vio + ',' + @seq_no_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio

		RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Ensure the runtime of the job is not overlapping with another runtime
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
			--Limit to the current job
			  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND jh.job_start_utc >= @job_start_utc
			--There are jobs started between the start and end time of the supplied job
			  AND jh.job_start_utc < @job_end_utc
			--There are jobs ended between the start and end time of the supplied job
			  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, @current_time_utc) > @job_start_utc
			--Jobs running on the same job position
			  AND jh.job_pos <> @job_pos
			--Exclude the supplied job
			  AND jh.row_id <> @row_id) BEGIN

		SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id_vio = jh.wo_id, @oper_id_vio = jh.oper_id, @seq_no_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), jh.seq_no)
			, @job_start_utc_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_start_utc, 120)
			, @job_end_utc_vio = COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_end_utc, 120), 'Running')
			, @job_pos_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), jh.job_pos)

		FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
		--Limit to the current job
		  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jh.job_start_utc >= @job_start_utc
		--There are jobs started between the start and end time of the supplied job
		  AND jh.job_start_utc < @job_end_utc
		--There are jobs ended between the start and end time of the supplied job
		  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, @current_time_utc) > @job_start_utc
		--Jobs running on the same job position
		  AND jh.job_pos <> @job_pos
		--Exclude the supplied job
		  AND jh.row_id <> @row_id

		--The same job was running on a different job position during the runtime of the supplied job.
		SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:'+ @wo_id + ', OperID:' + @oper_id + ', SeqNo:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ') running on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' and end time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ' cannot be ended,
			because it overlaps with another job (WoID:' + @wo_id_vio + ', OperID:' + @oper_id_vio + ', SeqNo:' + @seq_no_vio + ') on the same entity at the job position:' + @job_pos_vio + ' with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and end time (UTC):' + @job_end_utc_vio + '.{7995},'
			+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ','
			+ @wo_id_vio + ',' + @oper_id_vio + ',' + @seq_no_vio + ',' + @job_pos_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio

		RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Ensure the runtime of the job is not overlapping with another runtime in another entity
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jh.ent_id <> @ent_id --Exclude the suppplied entity
			--Limit to the current job
			  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
			--There are jobs started between the start and end time of the supplied job
			  AND jh.job_start_utc < @job_end_utc
			--There are jobs ended between the start and end time of the supplied job
			  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, @current_time_utc) > @job_start_utc) BEGIN

		SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name_vio = e.ent_name
			, @job_start_utc_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_start_utc, 120)
			, @job_end_utc_vio = COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_end_utc, 120), 'Running')
			, @job_pos_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), jh.job_pos)
		FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE jh.ent_id <> @ent_id
		--Limit to the current job
		  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
		--There are jobs started between the start and end time of the supplied job
		  AND jh.job_start_utc < @job_end_utc
		--There are jobs ended between the start and end time of the supplied job
		  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, @current_time_utc) > @job_start_utc

		--The same job or another job was running at the job position during the runtime of the supplied job.
		SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:'+ @wo_id + ', OperID:' + @oper_id + ', SeqNo:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ') running on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' and end time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ' cannot be ended,
			because it overlaps with the runtime on another entity:'+ @ent_name_vio + ' at the job position:' + @job_pos_vio + ' with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and end time (UTC):' + @job_end_utc_vio +'.{7994},'
			+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_end_utc, 120) + ','
			+ @ent_name_vio + ',' + @job_pos_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio

		RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Update the job end time
	UPDATE job_history
	SET job_end_utc = @job_end_utc
	, job_end_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @job_end_utc)
	, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND job_start_utc = @job_start_utc

	--Exit, if the entity does not track oee
	IF (COALESCE(@can_track_oee, 0) = 0) RETURN

	--Remove any erroneous buckets that were created for the current job and job start time, if any.
	DELETE FROM job_hour_history
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
	  AND hour_start_utc > @job_end_utc

	--Create and refresh the times and quantities for the hour bucket
	EXEC sp_U_Job_Hour_History_CreateBucketsUpdateStats @start_utc_range=@job_start_utc, @end_utc_range=@job_end_utc
		, @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc
		, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process_GetItmProdAtOper]
(@process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@item_produced		INT = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_SA_Process_GetItmProdAtOper
-- Description	  -	Given a process_id, oper_id, ent_id and item_id - this method lists all the item specs and entity specs
-- Author	      - Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created	  -	05/12/2004
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 03/24/2005     SJ            2117 -  Exit condition for #tmp_bom_item0 changed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @parent_item_id STRING40,
  @BV_ver_id      STRING40,
  @V_Item0        STRING40,
  @V_PVer         STRING40,
  @V_Ver0         STRING40,
  @V_Id0          STRING40,
  @J_oper_id      STRING40,
  @V_Sub_Item     STRING40,
  @V_Sub_Ver      STRING40,
  @V_Sub_Bom_Pos  INT32,
  @V_Sub_Oper     STRING40,
  @V_Count        INT

DECLARE @tmp_bom_item0 TABLE (parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), parent_ver_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
DECLARE @tmp_bom_item TABLE (parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), parent_ver_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), bom_pos INT, oper_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
DECLARE @tmp_bom_item1 TABLE (parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), parent_ver_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_comments NVARCHAR(80), item_prod INT)

BEGIN

  SET @J_oper_id = @oper_id
  SET @parent_item_id = @item_id

  IF @item_produced = 0
  BEGIN
    SET @item_produced= NULL
    DECLARE cur_bom_ver CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    DECLARE cur_bom_ver CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
  END

  OPEN cur_bom_ver
  WHILE (1=1)
  BEGIN
    SET @V_Count = 0
    FETCH cur_bom_ver INTO @BV_ver_id
    IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BREAK
        INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, status)
        SELECT @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, 0
	FROM item_process_link
            WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id = @parent_item_id
        DECLARE cur_item0 CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, ver_id, item_id FROM @tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0
        OPEN cur_item0
        FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_PVer, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE @tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item0 AND parent_ver_id = @V_PVer AND item_id = @V_Id0 AND ver_id = @V_Id0
          INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, status)
            SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.ver_id, a.item_id, b.ver_id, 0 FROM bom_item a
              INNER JOIN bom_ver b ON a.item_id = b.parent_item_id
                WHERE a.parent_item_id = @V_Id0 AND a.ver_id = @V_Ver0 AND b.preferred_ver = 1 AND item_id <> @V_Id0
          FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_PVer, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
        END
        CLOSE cur_item0
        DEALLOCATE cur_item0

        INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
          SELECT @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, 0, @J_oper_id, 0 FROM item_process_link
            WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id = @parent_item_id
        WHILE @V_Count = 0
        BEGIN
          --Recursively get into item-subitems
          DECLARE cur_sub_item CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id FROM @tmp_bom_item
            WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND status = 0
          OPEN cur_sub_item
          FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
          BEGIN
            UPDATE @tmp_bom_item SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND ver_id = @V_Sub_Ver
              AND bom_pos = @V_Sub_Bom_Pos AND oper_id = @V_Sub_Oper
            SET @V_Count = 1
            IF @V_Sub_Item = @parent_item_id
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
                SELECT @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @J_oper_id, 0 FROM bom_item a, bom_item_oper_link b
                  WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos AND b.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND b.bom_pos = 0
                    AND b.process_id = @process_id AND a.parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM @tmp_bom_item0) AND a.item_id <> @parent_item_id
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
                SELECT @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @J_oper_id, 0 FROM bom_item a, bom_item_oper_link b
                  WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos AND b.bom_pos = 0
                    AND b.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND a.parent_item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND a.item_id <> @V_Sub_Item
            END
            FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
          END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS
          CLOSE cur_sub_item
          DEALLOCATE cur_sub_item
          IF @V_Count = 1
            SET @V_Count = 0
          ELSE
            SET @V_Count = 1
        END  --End of @v_Count = 0

    IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id <> item_id)
    BEGIN
      IF @item_produced = 1
        INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item1(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, ver_comments, item_prod)
          SELECT t.parent_item_id, t.parent_ver_id, t.item_id, t.ver_id, v1.ver_comments, 1 'item_prod' FROM @tmp_bom_item t
            INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON t.item_id = v.parent_item_id AND t.ver_id = v.ver_id AND v.preferred_ver = 1
            INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON t.parent_item_id = v1.parent_item_id AND t.parent_ver_id = v1.ver_id AND v1.preferred_ver = 1
              WHERE t.parent_item_id <> t.item_id
      ELSE
        INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item1(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, ver_comments, item_prod)
          SELECT parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, ver_comments, item_prod FROM
            (SELECT t.parent_item_id, t.parent_ver_id, t.item_id, t.ver_id, v1.ver_comments, v1.preferred_ver 'item_prod' FROM @tmp_bom_item t
               INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON t.item_id = v.parent_item_id AND t.ver_id = v.ver_id
               INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON t.parent_item_id = v1.parent_item_id AND t.parent_ver_id = v1.ver_id
                 WHERE t.parent_item_id <> t.item_id
             UNION
             SELECT t.parent_item_id, t.parent_ver_id, b.parent_item_id item_id, b.ver_id, v1.ver_comments, 0 'item_prod' FROM bom_item_oper_link b
	       INNER JOIN @tmp_bom_item t ON b.parent_item_id = t.item_id AND b.ver_id = t.ver_id
	       INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON t.parent_item_id = v1.parent_item_id AND t.parent_ver_id = v1.ver_id
	         WHERE b.bom_pos = 0 AND b.process_id = @process_id AND b.oper_id = @oper_id AND t.parent_item_id <> t.item_id
	           AND (b.parent_item_id+' '+b.ver_id) NOT IN (select item_id+' '+ver_id from @tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id <> item_id)) a
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @item_produced = 1
        INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item1(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, ver_comments, item_prod)
          SELECT t.parent_item_id, t.parent_ver_id, t.item_id, t.ver_id, v1.ver_comments, 1 'item_prod' FROM @tmp_bom_item t
            INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON t.parent_item_id = v1.parent_item_id AND t.parent_ver_id = v1.ver_id AND v1.preferred_ver = 1
      ELSE
        INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item1(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, ver_comments, item_prod)
          SELECT parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, ver_comments, item_prod FROM
           (SELECT t.parent_item_id, t.parent_ver_id, t.item_id, t.ver_id, v1.ver_comments, v1.preferred_ver 'item_prod' FROM @tmp_bom_item t
              INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON t.item_id = v.parent_item_id AND t.ver_id = v.ver_id
              INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON t.parent_item_id = v1.parent_item_id AND t.parent_ver_id = v1.ver_id
            UNION
            SELECT t.parent_item_id, t.parent_ver_id, b.parent_item_id item_id, b.ver_id, v1.ver_comments, 0 'item_prod' FROM bom_item_oper_link b
	      INNER JOIN @tmp_bom_item t ON b.parent_item_id = t.item_id AND b.ver_id = t.ver_id
	      INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON t.parent_item_id = v1.parent_item_id AND t.parent_ver_id = v1.ver_id
                WHERE  b.bom_pos = 0 AND b.process_id = @process_id AND b.oper_id = @oper_id
	          AND (b.parent_item_id+' '+b.ver_id) NOT IN (select item_id+' '+ver_id from @tmp_bom_item)) a
    END
    --Clear the temp tables
    DELETE @tmp_bom_item0
    DELETE @tmp_bom_item
  END
  CLOSE cur_bom_ver
  DEALLOCATE cur_bom_ver
  --select the required
  SELECT * FROM @tmp_bom_item1
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_wo_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[wo]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on wo table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE wo SET wo.req_qty = ROUND(i.req_qty, it.num_decimals)
		,wo.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, wo.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE wo.wo_id = i.wo_id
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		Sp_sa_ofi_notification_list
-- Description:	Gets all the list of users or role to be notified
--
-- Usage:	This will be used in template workflow for sending notifiations
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Sk				 2022-09-02  		 Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  MP				 2023-02-14			 Retriving the group Name with domain
-- 0.02.01 Veervar			 2024-02-01			 Logic comments and cleanup.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_sa_ofi_notification_list] 
@workflow_name NVARCHAR(254),
@ent_id INT =NULL,
@ent_name nvarchar(80)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
SET NOCOUNT ON;

SET @ent_id=NULLIF(@ent_id,'')
SET @ent_name=NULLIF(@ent_name,'')

--IF @ent_id IS NULL SEARCH ID BY NAME
IF @ent_id IS NULL 
   AND @ent_name IS NOT NULL 
  BEGIN 
      SELECT @ent_id = ent_id 
      FROM   ent WITH (nolock) 
      WHERE  ent_name = @ent_name 
  END 

  --GET FINAL DATASET FROM ofi_notification
  SELECT grp_desc,  -- 0.02.00
	   assign_to, 
       type, 
       spare1, 
       spare2, 
       spare3, 
       spare4 
   FROM   ofi_notification onf WITH (nolock) 
   INNER JOIN grp_name gn  WITH (nolock)  on gn.grp_desc like '%'+onf.assign_to+'%'  --0.02.00
   WHERE  workflow = @workflow_name 
       AND  (( @ent_id IS NULL 
               AND ent_id IS NULL) OR ent_id=@ent_id)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Data_Log_Grp_CollctSample]
(
	@grp_id      INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id      INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id       STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no      INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no     INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no      STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no   STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_DATA_LOG_GRP_ADDSAMPLE
-- Description          - Adds a data log sample.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 12/17/2007
-- Version				- 3.4.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By     Ver        Changes
-- 12/22/2007		AML				3.4.1		Initial Version
--01/11/2008		Raghu	3.4	L00073614; Error while adding a data log row.
--01/24/2008		Raghu	3.4	L00074339; BLOCKING - Periodic Data Collection is n...
--01/28/2008		Raghu	3.4	L00074426; When editting a value for a datalog 48,
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @max_value				INT32
		,	@shift_id				INT32
		,	@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_local		TDATETIME
		,	@sample_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@sample_time_local		TDATETIME
		,	@table_name				STRING80
		,	@col_names				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@col_values				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@InsertSQL				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@last_edit_comment		NVARCHAR(508)
		,	@last_edit_by			STRING80
		,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME
		,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32
		,	@V_Client_Info			STRING40
		,	@i						INT32
		,	@max_i					INT32
		,	@value_index			INT32
		,	@cur_value				STRING80
		,	@spec_id				STRING40
		,	@item_id				STRING40

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	--Retrieve the ent_id and max_value if unknown.
    SELECT @max_value = dlg.max_value
    FROM data_log_grp dlg
    WHERE grp_id = @grp_id

	IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        RAISERROR( 'Entity Id should be supplied OR entity should be assigned to a data log group{4197}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN
    END

	IF (@wo_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL) OR (@step_no IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT @step_no = -1, @lot_no = NULL, @sublot_no = NULL
    END

	SELECT @wo_id = COALESCE(@wo_id, '-'), @oper_id = COALESCE(@oper_id, '-'), @seq_no = COALESCE(@seq_no, 0)

	IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT @item_id = wo.item_id
        FROM wo
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
    END

	SET @item_id = COALESCE(@item_id, '-')

	--Get ShiftID, Shift Start Time from ent
	SELECT @shift_id = cur_shift_id, @shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc, @shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
    FROM ent
    WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	IF @shift_start_utc IS NULL BEGIN
        RAISERROR( 'Shift Start Time is not found for this entity{4198}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN
    END

	SET @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, @V_Client_Info OUTPUT

    SET @col_names = NULL

	--Loop thru all data_log_values for this group id and frame SQL for Insert Column name and Column Value
    SET @col_values = NULL

	DECLARE @each_value_index TABLE (
		id int identity,
		value_index int,
		cur_value nvarchar(80),
		spec_id nvarchar(40)
	)

	INSERT INTO @each_value_index ( value_index, cur_value, spec_id )
	SELECT dlv.value_index, dlv.cur_value, dlv.spec_id
    FROM data_log_value dlv
    WHERE dlv.grp_id = @grp_id
    ORDER BY dlv.value_index

	SELECT @i = MIN( id ), @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @each_value_index

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@value_index = value_index
			,	@cur_value = cur_value
			,	@spec_id = spec_id
		FROM @each_value_index
		WHERE id = @i

		IF (@col_names IS NOT NULL)            SET @col_names = @col_names + ','
		ELSE SET @col_names = ''
                IF (@col_values IS NOT NULL)             SET @col_values = @col_values + ','
	ELSE SET @col_values  = ''

        SET @col_names = @col_names + 'value' + RTRIM( LTRIM( CONVERT( nvarchar, @value_index)))
        --SET @cur_value = @cur_value

        IF (@spec_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

			SELECT @cur_value = js.spec_value
			FROM job_spec js
			WHERE js.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND js.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND js.step_no = @step_no
			  AND js.spec_id = @spec_id

        END

--        SET @col_values = @col_values + ( COALESCE( dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@cur_value), 'NULL'))
	IF @cur_value IS NULL SET @col_values = @col_values + 'NULL'
	ELSE SET @col_values = @col_values + ( dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@cur_value))

		SET @i = (@i + 1)
	END

	--If no data_log_values found in this value, which means there is no default values found.
    IF  RTRIM(LTRIM(@col_names)) IS NULL BEGIN
--        RAISERROR('Sample Values not found{3346}', 16, 1)
        RETURN
    END

	-- get sample time as entity local
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @sample_time_utc OUTPUT, @sample_time_local OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @sample_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sample_time_utc )
    SET @sample_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sample_time_local )

    IF (@max_value = 16) BEGIN
        SET @table_name = 'data_log_16'
    END ELSE BEGIN
        SET @table_name = 'data_log_48'
    END

    SET @InsertSQL = ''
    SET @InsertSQL = 'INSERT INTO ' + @table_name
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + ' (grp_id,'
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + 'sample_time_utc,sample_time_local,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,sublot_no,shift_start_utc,shift_start_local,shift_id,ent_id,'
  IF (@col_names IS NULL OR @col_names = '')
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'last_edit_by,last_edit_at) values '
  ELSE
	SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + @col_names + ',last_edit_by,last_edit_at) values '

    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + '(' + LTRIM(CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @grp_id)) + ',';

   SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'CONVERT(DATETIME,''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @sample_time_utc, 120) + ''',120),'

   SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'CONVERT(DATETIME,''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @sample_time_LOCAL, 120) + ''',120),'
	IF @wo_id IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@wo_id) + ','
	IF @oper_id IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE  SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@oper_id) + ','
    	IF @seq_no IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @seq_no) + ','
   	IF @step_no IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE  SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @step_no) + ','
	IF @item_id IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE  SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@item_id) + ','
	IF @lot_no IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE  SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@lot_no) + ','
   	IF @sublot_no IS NULL SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'NULL,'
	ELSE SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@sublot_no) + ','
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'CONVERT(DATETIME,''' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_utc, 120) + ''',120),'
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'CONVERT(DATETIME,''' +  CONVERT( NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_local, 120) + ''',120),'
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @shift_id) + ','
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @ent_id) + ','
  IF NOT (@col_names IS NULL OR @col_names = '')   SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + @col_values + ','
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@last_edit_by) + ','
    SET @InsertSQL = @InsertSQL +  'CONVERT(DATETIME,''' +  CONVERT( NVARCHAR(19), @last_edit_at,120) + ''',120))'
    EXECUTE( @InsertSQL )
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [vw_ofi_wip_composition]
-- Description: This is used to summarize the composition of the WIP production against
--    its consumption for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
--
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
-- 0.01.00  JSC      2024-08-14       Initial Version
-- 0.02.00 JSC  2025-01-29   Updated it using aggregated temp tables
-- 0.03.00	JSC	2025-01-30				Addap it to get sums on LOT level only
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE    VIEW [dbo].[vw_ofi_wip_composition_v3] AS
WITH aggregated_prod AS
	( SELECT DISTINCT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),iprod.row_id),',') AS 'row_id'
	  ,iprod.item_id
	  ,i.item_desc
	  ,ia.attr_value AS 'prod_item_group'
	  ,iprod.lot_no
	  , STRING_AGG(CAST(iprod.sublot_no AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',') AS 'sublot_n'
	  ,SUM(iprod.qty_prod) AS 'qty_prod'
	  ,SUM(iprod.qty_prod_erp) AS 'qty_prod_erp'
	 -- ,i.uom_id
	  ,u.abbreviation AS 'uom_abbreviation'
	--  ,u.description AS 'uom_description' 
	--  ,0 AS 'spare3'
	  ,CASE WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS 'is_wip'
	  ,MAX(iprod.created_at_local) AS 'created_at_local'
	 -- ,MIN(iprod.created_at_local) AS 'min_created_at_local'
	  ,iprod.wo_id
	  ,iprod.oper_id
	  ,iprod.seq_no
	FROM dbo.item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)               ON iprod.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.uom AS u WITH (NOLOCK)        ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_attr AS ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = ( SELECT TOP 1 attr_id
		FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
			AND attr_grp = 1 )
	GROUP BY iprod.item_id ,i.item_desc ,ia.attr_value ,iprod.lot_no   ,u.abbreviation ,i.item_class_id ,iprod.wo_id ,iprod.oper_id ,iprod.seq_no
	)
  , aggregated_cons AS
	( SELECT DISTINCT STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(15),ic_rm.row_id),',') AS 'rm_row_id'
	  ,ic_rm.item_id AS 'rm_item_id'
	  ,i2.item_desc AS 'rm_item_desc'
	  ,ia2.attr_value AS 'rm_item_group'
	  ,ic_rm.lot_no AS 'rm_lot_no'
	  , STRING_AGG(CAST(ic_rm.sublot_no AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',') AS 'rm_sublot_no'
	  ,ic_rm.fg_lot_no AS 'rm_fg_lot_no'
	  , STRING_AGG(CAST(ic_rm.fg_sublot_no AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',') AS 'rm_fg_sublot_no'
	  ,SUM(ic_rm.qty_cons) AS 'rm_qty_cons' ,0 AS 'rm_qty_cons_totals'
	  ,SUM(ic_rm.qty_cons_erp) AS 'rm_qty_cons_erp' ,0 AS 'rm_qty_cons_totals_erp'
	--  ,STRING_AGG(ic_rm.wo_id ,',') AS 'rm_wo_id'
	  ,CASE WHEN i2.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS 'rm_is_wip'
	 -- ,STRING_AGG(ic_rm.oper_id,',') AS 'rm_oper_id'
	 ,ic_rm.wo_id AS 'rm_wo_id'
	 ,ic_rm.oper_id AS 'rm_oper_id'
	FROM dbo.item_cons ic_rm WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.item i2 WITH (NOLOCK)          ON ic_rm.item_id = i2.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_attr AS ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i2.item_id = ia2.item_id AND ia2.attr_id = ( SELECT TOP 1 attr_id
		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
			AND attr_grp = 1 )
	GROUP BY i2.item_class_id ,ic_rm.item_id,i2.item_desc ,ia2.attr_value ,ic_rm.lot_no ,ic_rm.fg_lot_no ,ic_rm.oper_id ,ic_rm.wo_id
	)
SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM aggregated_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
FULL OUTER JOIN aggregated_cons ic_rm WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.lot_no = ic_rm.rm_fg_lot_no AND iprod.oper_id = ic_rm.rm_oper_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetJobQueue]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@item_id	NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_GetJobQueue
-- Description       - Return a recordset of all jobs with its state and color, etc.. for a specific Work Order
--			with optionally filtered by item_id
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/10/2004
-- Version           - 2.0.34
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--05/01/2007    Raghu       3.2.10  HD# 9776; Sort records returned by JobExec.GetJobQueue
--08/31/2007    Raghu       3.3.0   DB Changes
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--12/22/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT j.wo_id
	            ,j.oper_id
	            ,j.seq_no
	            ,j.job_desc
	            ,j.item_id
	            ,j.state_cd
	            ,j.job_priority
				,j.req_finish_time_utc
				,j.req_finish_time_local
				,j.req_finish_time_utc AS req_finish_time
	            ,j.init_sched_ent_id
	            ,j.target_sched_ent_id
	            ,j.run_ent_id
	            ,j.qty_reqd
	            ,j.qty_prod
	            ,j.qty_prod_erp
	            ,j.qty_rejected
	            ,j.qty_rejected_erp
	            ,j.qty_at_start
	            ,j.deviation_above
	            ,j.deviation_below
	            ,j.batch_size
	            ,j.first_job
	            ,j.final_job
		    ,j.sched_pinned
	            ,j.check_inv
		,j.est_fixed_lab
		,j.est_lab_rate
		,j.est_setup_time
		,j.est_teardown_time
		,j.est_prod_rate
		,j.prod_uom
		,j.est_transfer_time
			,j.sched_start_time_utc
			,j.sched_start_time_local
		    ,j.sched_start_time_utc AS sched_start_time
			,j.latest_start_time_utc
			,j.latest_start_time_local
		    ,j.latest_start_time_utc AS latest_start_time
			,j.sched_finish_time_utc
			,j.sched_finish_time_local
		    ,j.sched_finish_time_utc AS sched_finish_time
			,j.act_start_time_utc
			,j.act_start_time_local
		    ,j.act_start_time_utc AS act_start_time
			,j.act_finish_time_utc
			,j.act_finish_time_local
		    ,j.act_finish_time_utc AS act_finish_time
	            ,j.concurrent_link
	            ,j.job_cost
	            ,j.parent_contingent_job
	            ,j.child_contingent_job
	            ,j.notes
	            ,j.assoc_file
	            ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(j.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
	            ,j.status_notes
	            ,j.display_seq
	            ,j.folder_ver_id
	            ,j.rework
		,j.sched_pinned
		,j.spare1
		,j.spare2
		,j.spare3
		,j.spare4
		,j.last_edit_comment
	            ,j.edited_by
	            ,j.edit_time
		, wo.wo_desc, wo.req_qty, wo.mo_id, i.item_desc, js.state_desc, js.color,
		e.ent_name, (SELECT ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = j.run_ent_id) run_ent_name,
		i.spare1, i.spare2, i.spare3, i.spare4
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd = js.state_cd
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = e.ent_id
	WHERE wo.state_cd <> 3
	  AND wo.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (j.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
	ORDER BY j.display_seq, j.oper_id, j.seq_no
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_lot_attr_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[lot_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_lot_attr_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on lot_attr table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Update queue_item_attr table automatically
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@item_id		STRING80
		,@lot_no		STRING80
		,@attr_id		INT32

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE lot_attr SET lot_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, lot_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE lot_attr.item_id = i.item_id AND lot_attr.lot_no = i.lot_no AND lot_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id

	IF UPDATE(attr_value) BEGIN
		DECLARE lot_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT i.item_id, i.lot_no, i.attr_id FROM  inserted i
		INNER JOIN attr a ON i.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.visible_in_inv = 1

		OPEN lot_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM lot_attr_cursor INTO @item_id, @lot_no, @attr_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			EXEC sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr @item_id, @lot_no, @attr_id
		END
		CLOSE lot_attr_cursor
		DEALLOCATE lot_attr_cursor
	END
END

-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_ofi_DeleteMasterSiloConfigData] @rowID INT
	,@comments NVARCHAR(250) = NULL
	,@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
	,@audit_trail BIT = 1 -- 1=Save to audit trail 0=Not Save to Audit Trail
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @iErrorValue INT = 0
		,@strRecipePreferred NVARCHAR(1)
		,@iRecipeId INT
		,@iEntId INT
		,@iRecipeUsed INT = 0
		,@strItemid NVARCHAR(40)
		,@mod NVARCHAR(30) = NULL
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'MRM_MasterSiloConfig'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = 'delete'
		,@dataRecord XML
		,@auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS;


			
IF EXISTS (SELECT
				   o.jb_item_id				 
			   FROM ofi_su_selection o WITH(NOLOCK)
			   INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = o.su_ent_id
			   INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON
				   j.wo_id = o.wo_id
				   AND j.oper_id = o.oper_id
				   AND j.seq_no = o.seq_no
			   WHERE
				   e.ent_id = (SELECT 
				storage_ent_id
				
			FROM [dbo].ofi_ent_item_storage_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE row_id = @rowID)
				   AND j.state_cd = (SELECT
										 state_cd
									 FROM job_state WITH(NOLOCK)
									 WHERE LOWER(state_desc) LIKE LOWER('%RUNNING%')) )
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This storage unit is being used and can’t be modified now', 16, 1);--('@@ErrorStorageUnitUsed@@',16,1);
		-- Retrieve datas used on update execution
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN

	-- Set default value if no value entered
	IF (
			@audit_trail IS NULL
			OR @audit_trail = ''
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @audit_trail = 1;
	END

	-- retrieve datas and set into xml format
	SET @dataRecord = (
			SELECT row_id
				,ent_id
				,storage_ent_id
				,type
				,item_group
				,created_at_local
				,created_at_utc
				,created_by
				,last_edit_at_local
				,last_edit_at_utc
				,@user_name AS last_edit_by
			FROM [dbo].ofi_ent_item_storage_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE row_id = @rowID
			FOR XML RAW('data')
			);

	DELETE
	FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link
	WHERE row_id = @rowID

	IF (@audit_trail = 1)
	BEGIN
		-- At least one record with the row_id is required for storing the deleted record in the audit_trail table.
		DELETE @auditTrailParameters

		INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (
			row_id
			,field_name
			,field_value
			)
		VALUES (
			@rowID
			,'@row_id'
			,NULL
			)

		EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
			,@function_id = @strFunctionName
			,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
			,@xmlDeletedRow = @dataRecord
			,@deletedRowSourceTable = '[dbo].[ofi_ent_item_storage_link]'
			,@user_id = @user_name
			,@activity = @strActivityMsg
			,@audit_category = 'Info'
			,@comments = @comments
	END

		;WITH LatestDelete AS (
    SELECT TOP 1 at.*
    FROM audit_trail AS at
    INNER JOIN ofi_audit_trail_ext AS ate ON at.log_id = ate.log_id
    WHERE ate.activity = 'delete'
    ORDER BY at.log_id DESC
)
	UPDATE LatestDelete
	SET column_name = 'ent_id';
END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetProjtdShiftSched]
(
	@in_ent_id					INT32 = NULL
,	@in_start_time				TDATETIME = NULL
,	@in_days_ahead				INT32 = 7
,	@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetProjtdShiftSched
-- Description					- Refreshes the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--								  Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity along with shift exceptions
--								  Finally, returns a shift template after applying all the shift exceptions.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Version						- 3.1.2.27
-- Date Created					- 01/17/2007
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 12/23/2009	  Ajay			4.0.0	HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value	INT32

BEGIN
	--Create a temporary table for template shifts; if a temporary table does not exist in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[#shift_to_go_template]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISUSERTABLE') = 1)
		CREATE TABLE #shift_to_go_template (ent_id INT, start_day INT, shift_id INT
						,start_date DATETIME, end_date DATETIME
						,break1_start DATETIME, break1_end DATETIME
						,break2_start DATETIME, break2_end DATETIME
						,break3_start DATETIME, break3_end DATETIME
						,row_id INT IDENTITY (1,1))

	--Call the refresh shift sched procedure to populate all template shifts for an entity.
	EXEC sp_U_Ent_RefreshShiftSched @in_ent_id = @in_ent_id, @in_start_time = @in_start_time
		, @in_days_ahead = @in_days_ahead, @in_time_zone_bias_value = 0

	--Default the time zone bias value to 0 if not supplied.
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	--Return all template shifts that are used to create shifts.
	SELECT ent_id, start_day, shift_id
--		start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end, break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end
	          ,start_date AS start_time
	          ,end_date AS end_time
	          ,break1_start
	          ,break1_end
	          ,break2_start
	          ,break2_end
	          ,break3_start
	          ,break3_end
	FROM #shift_to_go_template
	ORDER BY ent_id, start_time, end_time, shift_id, start_day

	--Drop the temporary table as we don't need anymore.
	DROP TABLE #shift_to_go_template
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GetPrivByUser]
  (@user_id 	nvarchar(80),
   @session_id 	int32)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/06/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1779) Client Types are changed to Cimlic Product Codes
-- 12/09/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	Messenger doesnot require any privileges, if client_type = 55, Bypass checking and authenticate to run the apps
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 09/11/2014	Jim		4.6.0	HF L00132295: Added NOLOCK hint to sessn query
-- 10/24/2014	Ashish		5.1.0	Megre CR-L00133676 cloned from HF L00132295: Added NOLOCK hint to sessn query
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
Declare @client_type	INT32,
	@local_priv_id	INT32,
	@priv_value	INT32
	select @client_type = client_type from sessn WITH (NOLOCK) where session_id = @session_id
	if @client_type = 35 SET @local_priv_id = 1
	if @client_type = 36 SET @local_priv_id = 20
	if @client_type = 37 SET @local_priv_id = 60
	if @client_type = 38 SET @local_priv_id = 100
	SELECT 	 @priv_value = MAX(priv_value)
	FROM 	grp_priv_link gpl, user_grp_link ugl, priv p
	WHERE 	ugl.user_id = @user_id AND
		gpl.priv_id = p.priv_id AND
		ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id and
		p.priv_id in (@local_priv_id)
	GROUP BY gpl.priv_id, p.priv_desc
	ORDER BY gpl.priv_id
	IF @client_type = 55 SET @priv_value = 1

	if @priv_value <> 1 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('User does not have the required privilege to run this application{3575}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_oee_data]
AS
SELECT tpm_stat.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       tpm_stat.wo_id,
       tpm_stat.oper_id,
       tpm_stat.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       tpm_stat.shift_start_utc,
       tpm_stat.shift_start_local,
       tpm_stat.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       tpm_stat.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       uom.abbreviation,
       tpm_stat.qty_good,
       tpm_stat.qty_reject,
       tpm_stat.std_prod_rate,
       tpm_stat.runtime,
       tpm_stat.downtime,
       tpm_stat.idletime,
       tpm_stat.batch_size,
       tpm_stat.hour_end_utc,
       tpm_stat.hour_end_local,
	tpm_stat.job_start_utc
FROM tpm_stat tpm_stat WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   tpm_stat.item_id = item.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom  WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   tpm_stat.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   tpm_stat.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
   tpm_stat.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON tpm_stat.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON tpm_stat.shift_id = shift.shift_id

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_SourceInvSummary] @ent_id as int, @item_group as varchar(100)

  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_SourceInvSummary  -
-- Description:	    Get the summation of the source inv summary
--
-- Usage:			InventorySummary (01.00.00) from used to display the source destination details
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-24						Find the source destination information
-- 0.02.00			AKM				2024-02-02						script level comment added
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

Declare @item_id varchar(150), @item_seg_type varchar(150), @process_id varchar(150), @pent_id as int, @chil_ent_id as int, @line_ent_id as int,
@seg_ent_id as int, @ent_type as varchar(40), @area_ent_id as int
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#line_ent_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #line_ent_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#seg_ent_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #seg_ent_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#line_seg_ent_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #line_seg_ent_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#item_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #item_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpsilos') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpsilos 

Create table #tmpsilos(process_ent_id nvarchar(100), st_ent_id nvarchar(100),  item_group nvarchar(100),storage_unit nvarchar(100), item_id nvarchar(100),
item_desc nvarchar(100), mes_qty nvarchar(100), dcs_qty nvarchar(100), uom nvarchar(100), item_status nvarchar(100), mes_status nvarchar(100),
 dcs_status nvarchar(100), item_grade nvarchar(100), segeration_type nvarchar(100)) 

print @ent_id

  

--get the attribute value for entity if it is set to Area, line or segment
select @ent_type=attr_value from ent_Attr ea with(nolock)  where  ea.ent_id=@ent_id and ea.attr_value in ('Area','Line','Segment')

print @ent_type
If @ent_type = 'Area'
begin

select e.ent_id into #line_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Line'  and e.parent_ent_id in (@ent_id)
select @line_ent_id=ent_id from #line_ent_id
select e.ent_id into #seg_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Segment'  and e.parent_ent_id in (select * from #line_ent_id)
select @seg_ent_id=ent_id from #seg_ent_id

set @area_ent_id =@ent_id 
print @seg_ent_id
print @line_ent_id
print @area_ent_id
end
if @ent_type = 'Line' 
begin
print 'Line'


select @seg_ent_id=e.ent_id  from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Segment'  and e.parent_ent_id in (@ent_id)

--select @seg_ent_id=ent_id from #seg_ent_id

--print @ent_id
set @line_ent_id =@ent_id 
select @area_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id  from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Line' and e.ent_id in (@line_ent_id)
print @seg_ent_id
--set @line_ent_id =@ent_id 
print @line_ent_id
print @area_ent_id
end
else if @ent_type = 'Segment'
begin
print 'Segment'
select @line_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Segment'  and e.ent_id in (@ent_id)
select @area_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Line'  and e.ent_id in (@line_ent_id)
	set @seg_ent_id =@ent_id
	print @line_ent_id
	print @seg_ent_id
	print @area_ent_id
end


--print 'Area' 
--print @area_ent_id
select distinct iel.item_id,oe.process_id into #item_id from oper_ent_link oe with(nolock)
inner join item_process_link iel with(nolock) on iel.process_id = oe.process_id
inner join item_attr ia with(nolock) on ia.item_id = iel.item_id 
where oe.ent_id=@seg_ent_id 
--where oe.ent_id=@area_ent_id 
select @item_seg_type=(case when ia.attr_value='' then '' else ia.attr_value end) from item_attr ia with(nolock) 
where item_id in (select item_id from #item_id)  and attr_id in (select ar.attr_id from attr ar with(nolock) where ar.attr_desc='Classification')

-- If entity type is set to Segment
if @ent_type = 'Segment'
begin
	 insert into #tmpsilos 
 			select sl.ent_id as process_ent_id,sl.storage_ent_id as st_ent_id,sl.item_group as item_group, e.ent_name as storage_unit,iv.item_id as item_id,
i.item_desc as item_desc,sum(iv.qty_left) as mes_qty,'' as dcs_qty,u.abbreviation as uom,iis.item_status_desc as item_status,
--iis.item_status_desc as mes_status,
(select  aa.attr_desc from ent_attr eaa  with(nolock)

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_wo_attr_aft_del] ON [dbo].[wo_attr]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_attr_aft_del
-- Description        -  This trigger removes the selected wo_attr values from the fc_namesp_tag table.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 04/06/2006
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7931, Updated wo_attr value to null when an work order attribute is removed.
-- 26/02/2013	Srinu		4.6.0	(CR# L00119884)
-- 12/11/2014	Abhay Pandey	5.0 (CR# L00132120)Introduced a cursor to read the attribute Ids and supply it to update the table one by one. Code was written after assuming to have
--									only one attribute id and hence execution used to fail while deleting multiple wo_attr entries (such as when deleting a wo).
--05/02/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE  @user_id NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id INT, @err_msg STRING254

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE wo_attrs CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
SELECT attr_id FROM deleted
OPEN wo_attrs FETCH wo_attrs INTO @attr_id
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT attr_id  FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name
	AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level WHERE cul.user_id = @user_id AND cal.attr_id = @attr_id) AND NOT EXISTS
	(SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM cert_attr_link) AND attr_id = @attr_id)
 BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 does not have required certifications.{7612}' + @user_id
 		            RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
 	 	            RETURN
 END
FETCH wo_attrs INTO @attr_id
END
CLOSE wo_attrs
DEALLOCATE wo_attrs
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Oper_Attr]
(
 @wo nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @seq_no int = NULL,
 @process_id  nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
 )
  AS
--===========================================================================================  
-- Name:  [sp_SA_ofi_Oper_Attr]  
-- Description: This sp provides the silo details for the consumption 
--  
-- Usage: It is being used in the AddCons WF
-- ===========================================================================================  
-- Version	Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description  
-- 0.01.00  DS		2023-08-31			Changes done for #279 - Liquor blending , to find the destination silo
-- ===========================================================================================  


BEGIN

declare @dest_su nvarchar(80)
declare @active_su_ent_id int


		begin
			select top 1 @active_su_ent_id = active_su_ent_id 
			from ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 
			select @dest_su = ent_name  from ent with(nolock) where ent_id = @active_su_ent_id
		end

		 if(@dest_su is null)
		 begin

				SELECT top 1
						@dest_su = 	oper_attr.attr_value 
				FROM oper_attr oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
				WHERE (oper_attr.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
					   (oper_attr.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
					   (oper_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) 
				
		 end
	
		select @dest_su as ent_name

END
