-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](447, 'source', '500000041625', 146, '500000041625', 146, '1001476306', 'Milling', 0, 469, NULL)
CREATE     FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity]
(@storage_ent_id INT
,@silo_type STRING80 -- Source or Destination
,@inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- inventory item id
,@inv_grade_cd int		-- inv grade cd
,@jb_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- job bom item id
,@jb_grade_cd int			-- jb grade cd
,@wo_id  nvarchar(40) 
,@oper_id nvarchar(80) 
,@seq_no	int
,@job_ent_id int
,@subs_parentlist nvarchar(300) NULL
) 

--RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable

RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  isNotValidEnt int
		  ,notValidDescDetails nvarchar(max)
		  ,storage_ent_id int
		)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_chkSiloValidity
-- Description       - Returns the silo validity based on dIFferent parameters
-- Author			 - DS
-- Date Created      - 14/09/2022
-- Version			 - 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_ModIFied  ModIFied_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 14/09/2022     DS 			 1.0		Initial version
-- 19/05/2023	  YG		     2.0		Added Batch Validation and ItemGroup
-- 12/06/2023	  SV		     3.0		Added checkin on the jobstate
-- 25/09/2023     MP 			 4.0		Substitute item will consume from the silos in setup UI
-- 03/10/2023     DS 			 5.0		Changes related to substitute material as it was not enabling the matching material[shown issue to Mahesh]
-- 15/01/2024     DS 			 6.0		Changes related to db localization
-- 06/03/2024     DS 			 7.0		Changes minimum dosing qty issue
-- 14/04/2024	  YG			 8.0		Changes on the 'active source silo' validation logic
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
declare	  @su_status_cd	   INT32
			,@isNotValidEnt int = 0
			,@notValidDescDetails nvarchar(max) = ''
			,@item_state_cd int
			,@cfg_act_line_cnt int -- configured active line count in the silo attribute
			,@act_line_count int  --silo which is used in the other lines at present
			,@min_dosing_qty_kg int	-- minimum dosing qty
			,@silo_qty float
			,@uom_id int
			,@uom_desc nvarchar(20)
			,@su_bypass_validation int
			,@AllowOnlySameSource int -- v0.02 Added
			,@AllowOnlySameItemGroup int -- v0.02 Added
			,@chkJobstateoftheInv int
			,@substitute_item_validation int
			,@su_inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80)
			,@su_inv_grade_cd int
			,@su_inv_state_cd int
			,@job_bom_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
			,@job_bom_grade_cd int
			,@bypass_grade_validation int =0

declare	  @su_attr as table(attr_desc nvarchar(80),attr_value STRING1700_NULL)



			select @su_bypass_validation =  ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
			where ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
			and a.attr_desc = 'su_bypass_validation' 

			set @su_bypass_validation = ISNULL(@su_bypass_validation,0)
			
			SELECT @substitute_item_validation=oa.attr_value
					FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
							AND a.attr_desc = 'substitute_mainconsitem_to_wip'
							AND a.attr_grp = 7
						WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
			
			SELECT @bypass_grade_validation=oa.attr_value
					FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
							AND a.attr_desc = 'bypass_grade_validation'
							AND a.attr_grp = 7
						WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

			set @substitute_item_validation = ISNULL(@substitute_item_validation,0)
			set @bypass_grade_validation = ISNULL(@bypass_grade_validation,0)
			
			IF (@substitute_item_validation=1 and @silo_type='source')
			BEGIN
				SELECT @item_state_cd = item_status_cd from item_state with(nolock) where item_status_desc = 'UNRESTRICTED'

				IF(@subs_parentlist IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
				SELECT top 1 @job_bom_item_id= item_id,@job_bom_grade_cd=reqd_grade_cd FROM job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and bom_pos >0 and item_id in (select value from fn_Split(@subs_parentlist,',')) -- if the multiple parent exists in the BOM then it may fail, but chances of having that is near 0
				END 
				SELECT @su_inv_item_id=item_id,@su_inv_grade_cd=grade_cd,@su_inv_state_cd=status_cd from item_inv where ent_id=@storage_ent_id

				--Item Validation with Substitute Item
				
				--#5.0
				IF(@jb_item_id IS  NULL)
				BEGIN
						if(@subs_parentlist is null) or not exists(select 1 from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and bom_pos >0 and item_id in (select value from fn_Split(@subs_parentlist,','))) 
							BEGIN 
								SET @isNotValidEnt = 1 
								SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails +  dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Item is not matching.',NULL) 
							END
				END
				--ELSE
				BEGIN
					--Grade Validation
					IF (@bypass_grade_validation = 0 and @subs_parentlist IS NOT NULL and (@su_inv_grade_cd <> isnull(@job_bom_grade_cd,-1)))
					BEGIN 
						set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
						set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Grade is not matching.',NULL) 
					END
					IF (@bypass_grade_validation = 0 and @subs_parentlist IS NULL and (@inv_grade_cd <> isnull(@jb_grade_cd,-1)) and @jb_grade_cd is not null)
					BEGIN 
						set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
						set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Grade is not matching.',NULL) 
					END


					--State Validation
					IF (@su_inv_state_cd <> @item_state_cd)
					BEGIN 
						set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
						set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails +  dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Item state is not unrestricted',NULL) 
					END
				END
				--Attribute Level validation
				IF(@silo_type='source' AND @isNotValidEnt = 0)  -- [@isNotValidEnt = 0] execute only when it is valid till this point
				BEGIN

							insert into @su_attr
							select a.attr_desc, ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
							where ea.ent_id=@storage_ent_id
							and attr_desc  in ('LockForOutput', 'BlockForQuality','active_lines_as_source')

								IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='LockForOutput')=1)
									BEGIN
										set @isNotValidEnt=1
										set @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage unit is locked for output.',NULL) 
									END
								IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='BlockForQuality')=1)
									BEGIN
										set @isNotValidEnt=1
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage unit is blocked for quality.',NULL) 
									END
								----
								IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='active_lines_as_source')>0) -- 0/ not configured means it can be selected as source on multiple number of lines
									BEGIN
											select @cfg_act_line_cnt = attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='active_lines_as_source'
											select @act_line_count = count(1) from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) 
																				where dest_type =1 and active_su_ent_id = @storage_ent_id 
																				and (oss.ent_id) <> (@job_ent_id) -- @seq_no  --> same work order , dIFferent sequence will be ignored
																
																			-------------
																			-- system won't check for the same work order, even though it is selected against multiple job of same work order, do we need to consider the entity as well.
																			-- 
																			-- need to check whether needs to put the entity id
					
											--IF(isnull(@act_line_count,0)+1 >=@cfg_act_line_cnt) -- v8.0 disabled
											IF(isnull(@act_line_count,0) >=@cfg_act_line_cnt) -- v8.0 Added
											BEGIN
												set @isNotValidEnt=1
												set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage unit is already active on maximum configured lines.',NULL) 
											END
									 END 


									/* Checking the minimum dosing qty */
									IF (@isNotValidEnt=0)
									BEGIN
												select  @min_dosing_qty_kg = eam.attr_value		--cast(replace(eam.attr_value, ',', '') as decimal(18,3))
												from ent_attr ea with(nolock) 
												inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
												inner join ent_attr eam with(nolock) on eam.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
												where a.attr_desc = 'EntityType' and ea.attr_value = 'Site'
												and eam.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'min_dosing_qty_kg')
											
											
											IF(@min_dosing_qty_kg is not null)
											BEGIN
														select  @silo_qty = sum(qty_left *isnull(uc.factor,1) ) 
													from item_inv inv with(nolock)
													inner join item i on inv.item_id = i.item_id and inv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
													left join uom_conv uc on i.uom_id = uc.from_uom_id and (uc.item_id is null) 
													and uc.to_uom_id =(select top 1 uom_id from uom where description ='KG')
																			
											IF(@silo_qty<@min_dosing_qty_kg)
												BEGIN
												set @isNotValidEnt=1
												set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage qty is less then minimun dosing qty. qty: ',NULL) + LTRIM(STR(@silo_qty, 25, 1)) ++' '+ isnull(@uom_desc,'')
												END
											END
								
									 END 
				END


		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF(@su_bypass_validation =0) -- 
			BEGIN

							select @item_state_cd = item_status_cd from item_state with(nolock) where item_status_desc = 'UNRESTRICTED'
		
							IF(@jb_item_id IS  NULL)
							BEGIN
									BEGIN 
										set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Item is not matching.',NULL) 
									END
							END
							ELSE
								BEGIN 
									--checking grade
									IF ((@inv_grade_cd <> isnull(@jb_grade_cd,-1)) and (@jb_grade_cd is not null))
									BEGIN 
										set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Grade is not matching.',NULL) 
									END
					

					
									IF exists (select 1 from  item_inv with(nolock) where ent_id =@storage_ent_id and item_id = @jb_item_id and status_cd <>@item_state_cd)
									BEGIN 
										set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Item state is not unrestricted',NULL) 
									END
								END
		
						--attribute validation

						-- 0.02 Batch No/ Lot No Validation
							SELECT @AllowOnlySameSource = attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AllowSourceWithSameBatch' AND attr_grp = 7)
																										AND oper_id = @Oper_Id

							SET @AllowOnlySameSource = ISNULL(@AllowOnlySameSource,0)

							IF(@AllowOnlySameSource = 1 and @inv_item_id is not null)
							BEGIN
								IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) 
												INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id  AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no AND jb.item_id = iv.item_id 
																						AND jb.def_lot_no = iv.lot_no AND iv.grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
												WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id AND iv.item_id = @inv_item_id ))
								BEGIN 
										set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Lot no is not matching.',NULL)  
								END
								
							END

							-- AllowOnlySameItemGroup
							SELECT @AllowOnlySameItemGroup = attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AllowOnlySameItemGroup' AND attr_grp = 7)
																											AND oper_id = @Oper_Id

							SET @AllowOnlySameItemGroup = ISNULL(@AllowOnlySameItemGroup,0)

							IF(@AllowOnlySameItemGroup = 1 and @inv_item_id is not null)
							BEGIN
								IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) 
												INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id 
																						AND oea.ent_id = @job_ent_id AND oea.type = 'Source'
												INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = iv.item_id 
																						AND ia.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																										  FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																										  WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' AND attr_grp = 1)
																						AND ia.attr_value= oea.item_group
												WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id AND iv.item_id = @inv_item_id ))
								BEGIN
								--set @isNotValidEnt=0
									set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
									set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Item group is not matching.',NULL) 
								END
							END
							
							--code added on 6thJune 2023 for inventory exists with same wo_id,operId,seq_no and job-state is 4
							--select  qty_left from item_inv with(nolock) where ent_id= @storage_ent_id order by date_in_local ASC
							SELECT @chkJobstateoftheInv = attr_value 
							FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
							WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id 
											FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
											WHERE attr_desc = 'chkJobstateoftheInv' AND attr_grp = 7)
								AND oper_id = @oper_id
	
							SET @chkJobstateoftheInv = ISNULL(@chkJobstateoftheInv,0)

							----select qty_left from item_inv iv with(nolock)
							----where ent_id= @storage_ent_id order by date_in_local ASC

							IF (@chkJobstateoftheInv = 1)
							BEGIN
								IF (NOT EXISTS(
										SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK)
										INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=iv.wo_id AND j.oper_id=iv.oper_id AND j.seq_no=iv.seq_no
										WHERE iv.ent_id= @storage_ent_id AND j.state_cd=4 ))
									BEGIN
										SET @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails +  dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Job state is not matching.',NULL) 
								END																	
							END
							--ELSE IF(@chkJobstateoftheInv > 0)
							--BEGIN
							--	IF (NOT EXISTS(
							--		select * from item_inv iv with(nolock)
							--		inner join job j with(nolock) on j.wo_id=iv.wo_id and j.oper_id=iv.oper_id and j.seq_no=iv.seq_no
							--		where iv.ent_id= @storage_ent_id and j.state_cd=4 ))
							--	BEGIN
							--		set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
							--		set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + ' Job state is not matching.'
							--	END
							--END	
							---code ended on 6th june 2023
						-- 0.02 Batch No/ Lot No Validation
		
						IF(@silo_type='source' AND @isNotValidEnt = 0)  -- [@isNotValidEnt = 0] execute only when it is valid till this point
							BEGIN

							insert into @su_attr
							select a.attr_desc, ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
							where ea.ent_id=@storage_ent_id
							and attr_desc  in ('LockForOutput', 'BlockForQuality','active_lines_as_source')

								IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='LockForOutput')=1)
									BEGIN
										set @isNotValidEnt=1
										set @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage unit is locked for output.',NULL) 
									END
								IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='BlockForQuality')=1)
									BEGIN
										set @isNotValidEnt=1
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage unit is blocked for quality.',NULL) 
									END
								----
								IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='active_lines_as_source')>0) -- 0/ not configured means it can be selected as source on multiple number of lines
									BEGIN
											select @cfg_act_line_cnt = attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='active_lines_as_source'
											select @act_line_count = count(1) from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) 
																				where dest_type =1 and active_su_ent_id = @storage_ent_id 
																				and (oss.ent_id) <> (@job_ent_id) -- @seq_no  --> same work order , dIFferent sequence will be ignored
																
																			-------------
																			-- system won't check for the same work order, even though it is selected against multiple job of same work order, do we need to consider the entity as well.
																			-- 
																			-- need to check whether needs to put the entity id
					
											--IF(isnull(@act_line_count,0)+1 >=@cfg_act_line_cnt) -- 7/17/2024 disabled like on PROD
											IF(isnull(@act_line_count,0) >=@cfg_act_line_cnt) -- 7/17/2024 added like on PROD
											BEGIN
												set @isNotValidEnt=1
												set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage unit is already active on maximum configured lines.',NULL) 
											END
									END 


									/* Checking the minimum dosing qty */
									IF (@isNotValidEnt=0)
									BEGIN
												select  @min_dosing_qty_kg = eam.attr_value		--cast(replace(eam.attr_value, ',', '') as decimal(18,3))
												from ent_attr ea with(nolock) 
												inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
												inner join ent_attr eam with(nolock) on eam.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
												where a.attr_desc = 'EntityType' and ea.attr_value = 'Site'
												and eam.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'min_dosing_qty_kg')
											
											
											IF(@min_dosing_qty_kg is not null)
											BEGIN
												--select @silo_qty = sum(qty_left)--,@uom_id = max(uom_id) 
												--from item_inv with(nolock) 
												--where ent_id =@storage_ent_id --and item_id = @inv_item_id and status_cd = @item_state_cd
								
												--select @uom_desc = description 
												--from uom with(nolock) where uom_id = @uom_id
												
												--set @uom_desc = isnull(@uom_desc,'MT');

													select  @silo_qty = sum(qty_left *isnull(uc.factor,1) ) 
													from item_inv inv with(nolock)
													inner join item i on inv.item_id = i.item_id and inv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
													left join uom_conv uc on i.uom_id = uc.from_uom_id and (uc.item_id is null) and uc.to_uom_id =(select top 1 uom_id from uom where description ='KG')
												
												
												--IF(@uom_desc ='MT') BEGIN set @silo_qty = @silo_qty*1000 END
								
												IF(@silo_qty<@min_dosing_qty_kg)
												BEGIN
												set @isNotValidEnt=1
												set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails +  dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg(' Storage qty is less then minimun dosing qty. qty: ',NULL) + LTRIM(STR(@silo_qty, 25, 1)) ++' '+ isnull(@uom_desc,'')
												END
											END
								
									END 

					
					

							END
		
				END  -- end of su_bypass_validation=0
		
		END

		insert into @Output
		select @isNotValidEnt,@notValidDescDetails,@storage_ent_id
  	RETURN ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetProdEnts]
(@ent_id	INT32
,@item_id	STRING80 = NULL
,@lot_no	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetProdEnts
-- Description	      -	HD#, 5491; If producing, exclude from the To Storage Location list any non-movable storage entity
--			which does not appear in the job_exec_storage_exec_link table if it would otherwise be in the list.
--			And if local_movable_prod_ent is true, likewise exclude any movable storage entity that is not located "at" the job_exec entity.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	10/06/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.23
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	@local_movable_prod_ent		INT32
	,@tree_level			INT32
	,@ent_name			STRING80

DECLARE  @storage_entities TABLE (ent_id INT, storage_ent_id INT, tree_level INT)

BEGIN
	--Verify whether the current entity used to produce is a movable storage entity or a non-movable storage entity.
	SELECT @local_movable_prod_ent = local_movable_prod_ent FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND job_pos = 0

	--If we could not identify a job_exec record, then default the local_movable_prod_ent to 0;
	--which will return an empty recordset.
	SET @local_movable_prod_ent = ISNULL(@local_movable_prod_ent, 0)

	IF (@local_movable_prod_ent = 0)
		--The entity that runs a job does not support any movable storage entities.
		--Return storage entities that are configured for this entity (the entity that runs a job)
		SELECT jesel.ent_id, e.ent_name run_ent_name,
			jesel.storage_ent_id, se.ent_name storage_ent_name,
			NULL AS located_at_ent_id, NULL AS located_at_ent_name, NULL AS tree_level
		FROM job_exec_storage_exec_link jesel WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e ON jesel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent se ON jesel.storage_ent_id = se.ent_id
		INNER JOIN
			--If the item_id or lot_no filter is supplied, then verify whether the storage entity
			--handles multiple items and multiple lots. If any of these two is false, then remove the entity
			--from the list.
			(SELECT st_ent.ent_id
			FROM storage_exec st_ent WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE st_ent.allow_multiple_items = CASE WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_items = 1 THEN 1
							WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_items = 0 AND @item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
								--This entity does not allow multiple items.
								--Verify whether we already have any other item apart from the supplied item
								--If so, exclude this entity from the list.
								(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = st_ent.ent_id AND item_id <> @item_id)
							ELSE st_ent.allow_multiple_items
							END
			  AND st_ent.allow_multiple_lots = CASE WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_lots = 1 THEN 1
							WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_lots = 0 AND @lot_no IS NOT NULL THEN
								--This entity does not allow multiple lots.
								--Verify whether we already have any other lot apart from the supplied lot
								--If so, exclude this entity from the list.
								(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = st_ent.ent_id AND COALESCE(lot_no, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@lot_no, '987654321CIMNET'))
							ELSE st_ent.allow_multiple_lots
							END) storage_exec_filters
			ON jesel.storage_ent_id = storage_exec_filters.ent_id
		WHERE jesel.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND jesel.apply_to_prod = 1
	ELSE IF (@local_movable_prod_ent = 1) BEGIN
		--This entity that runs a job does support movable storage entities.
		--return only the entities that are located at this entity (location).
		SELECT @tree_level = 0

		--Insert the current storage entity to the temp table.
		INSERT INTO @storage_entities(ent_id, storage_ent_id, tree_level)
		VALUES(@ent_id, @ent_id, @tree_level)

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			--Loop through the temp table and find all the entities that is located at this entity.
			INSERT INTO @storage_entities(ent_id, storage_ent_id, tree_level)
			SELECT s.ent_id, t.ent_id, @tree_level+1 FROM @storage_entities t
			INNER JOIN storage_exec s ON t.ent_id = s.storage_ent_id
			--Loop through all the entities till we reach the terminal entity.
			WHERE t.tree_level = @tree_level AND s.storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK
			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
		END

		--Retrieve the entity name that is running a job.
		SELECT @ent_name = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Retrieve all storage entities that is located at this entity.
		SELECT @ent_id AS ent_id, @ent_name AS run_ent_name,
			se.ent_id AS storage_ent_id, se1.ent_name AS storage_ent_name,
			se.storage_ent_id located_at_ent_id, located_at_ent.ent_name AS located_at_ent_name,
			se.tree_level AS tree_level
		FROM @storage_entities se
		INNER JOIN ent se1 ON se.ent_id = se1.ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent located_at_ent ON se.storage_ent_id = located_at_ent.ent_id
		INNER JOIN (
			--If the item_id or lot_no filter is supplied, then verify whether the storage entity
			--handles multiple items and multiple lots. If any of these two is false, then remove the entity
			--from the list.
			SELECT st_ent.ent_id
			FROM storage_exec st_ent WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE st_ent.allow_multiple_items = CASE WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_items = 1 THEN 1
							WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_items = 0 AND @item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
								--This entity does not allow multiple items.
								--Verify whether we already have any other item apart from the supplied item
								--If so, exclude this entity from the list.
								(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = st_ent.ent_id AND item_id <> @item_id)
							ELSE st_ent.allow_multiple_items
							END
			  AND st_ent.allow_multiple_lots = CASE WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_lots = 1 THEN 1
							WHEN st_ent.allow_multiple_lots = 0 AND @lot_no IS NOT NULL THEN
								--This entity does not allow multiple lots.
								--Verify whether we already have any other lot apart from the supplied lot
								--If so, exclude this entity from the list.
								(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = st_ent.ent_id AND COALESCE(lot_no, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@lot_no, '987654321CIMNET'))
							ELSE st_ent.allow_multiple_lots
							END
			) storage_exec_filters ON se.ent_id = storage_exec_filters.ent_id
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Process]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - sp_D_Process
-- Description            - Delete an existing row in the table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created         - 10/17/2002
-- Version                  - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes                     -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)--
--01/02/2003	Raghu		1.5.2	Deleting oper_ent_route or oper_ent_spec changes mod_id in Process table. Get latest mod_id from Process table
--03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--02/20/2008	AML			3.4.0	Delete any rework processes related to this process.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
--VRB Added this condition where if a process is in use by a running WorkOrder, it cant be deleted
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		AND wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE state_cd=3))
BEGIN
  RAISERROR ('A work order associated to this process is currently running and hence this process cannot be deleted.{4715}.', 16, 1)
  RETURN -1
END

-- First delete dependent rows not reached by cascade delete
DELETE oper_ent_route
WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)

DELETE oper_ent_spec
WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)

IF (@mod_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process.mod_id)))
	FROM  process WHERE  process_id =  @process_id
END

--Delete all rework processes that are related to the supplied process.
DELETE FROM rework_process_usage
WHERE rework_process_id IN (
	SELECT process_id FROM process
    WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
		  (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
)

-- Now delete row in process
DELETE process
WHERE ((process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))

CREATE       VIEW [dbo].[vw_job_details]
AS

		 j.wo_id
		,j.oper_id
		,j.seq_no
		,CONCAT(j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no) AS 'job_id'
		,j.job_desc
		,j.item_id
		,i.item_desc
		,j.state_cd
		,js.state_desc
		,js.color AS 'job_state_color_raw'
		,'#' + CONVERT(char(6), CONVERT(BINARY(3), js.color), 2) AS 'job_state_color'
		,j.job_priority
		,j.req_finish_time_utc
		,j.req_finish_time_local
		,j.init_sched_ent_id
		,j.target_sched_ent_id
		,j.run_ent_id
		,j.qty_reqd
		,j.qty_prod
		,j.qty_prod_erp
		,j.qty_rejected
		,j.qty_rejected_erp
		,j.qty_at_start
		,j.deviation_above
		,j.deviation_below
		,j.batch_size
		,j.uom_id
		,j.first_job
		,j.final_job
		,j.est_prod_rate
		,j.prod_uom
		,j.sched_start_time_utc
		,j.sched_start_time_local
		,j.latest_start_time_utc
		,j.latest_start_time_local
		,j.sched_finish_time_utc
		,j.sched_finish_time_local
		,j.act_start_time_utc
		,j.act_start_time_local
		,j.act_finish_time_utc
		,j.act_finish_time_local
		,j.status_notes
		,j.display_seq
		,j.rework
		,j.rework_cd
		,j.rework_process_id
		,j.spare1
		,j.spare2
		,j.spare3
		,j.spare4
		,j.last_edit_comment
		,j.edited_by
		,j.edit_time
		,u.abbreviation
		,u.description	
		,COALESCE(e1.description,e1.ent_name,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6),j.init_sched_ent_id)) AS 'sched_line_description'
		,COALESCE(e2.description,e2.ent_name,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6),j.target_sched_ent_id)) AS 'target_line_description'
		,COALESCE(e3.description,e3.ent_name,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6),j.run_ent_id)) AS 'run_line_description'
FROM
		dbo.job AS j WITH (nolock)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.job_state AS js WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd = js.state_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.vw_ofi_item AS oi WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = oi.item_id AND j.edit_time > oi.valid_from AND j.edit_time <= valid_to
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item AS i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = oi.item_id AND i.row_id = oi.row_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.uom AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.init_sched_ent_id = e1.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = e2.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = e3.ent_id

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_GetServerTime]
(@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
,@server_time	DATETIME OUT
,@db_local_time	DATETIME OUT
,@db_gmt_time	DATETIME OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver		Changes
-- 06/24/2004	Raghu			2.1.0	Changed GetDate() to GMT Date
--04/19/2005	Raghu			2.1.19	HD# 5551, Return server time (local time or UTC time) depending on bias value
--05/05/2005	Raghu			2.1.21	HD# 5551, Time difference should be calculated based on UTC Time;
--										NOT ON local time (GetDate())
--01/18/2007    Raghu			3.2.0   Additionally return database local time and database gmt time.
-- 10/24/2007	AML				3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @server_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	SELECT @db_local_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL), @db_gmt_time = GETUTCDATE()

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_SOSC_AddOrUpdatChoicesXML]
(@xml_source              NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value    INT32_NULL = NULL
)  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_U_SOSC_AddOrUpdatChoicesXML
-- Description          - L00073778; Add or Update choices
-- Author              - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 01/14/2008
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver        Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE  @doc_handle	INT32
	,@oper_id       STRING40
	,@step_no	INT32
	,@choice_no     INT32
	,@choice_label  STRING40
	,@last_edit_at  TDATETIME
	,@row_id        INT32
	,@delete_all    LOGICAL

	--Convert the input xml to XML Type.
	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml, and read the target_process_id, target_oper_id and target_step_no
	SELECT	 @oper_id = CASE WHEN oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE oper_id END
		,@step_no = CASE WHEN step_no = '' THEN 0 ELSE step_no END
		,@delete_all = CASE WHEN delete_all = '' THEN NULL ELSE delete_all END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (oper_id NVARCHAR(160),
			step_no NVARCHAR(160),
			delete_all NVARCHAR(160)	)

    IF (@delete_all = 1)
        DELETE FROM std_oper_step_choice
        WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
          AND step_no = @step_no

	--Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
	DECLARE choice_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN choice_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE choice_no END AS choice_no
		,	CASE WHEN choice_label = '' THEN NULL ELSE choice_label END AS choice_label
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/choice', 2)
	WITH (choice_no  NVARCHAR(160), choice_label NVARCHAR(160))

	--Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
	OPEN choice_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM choice_cursor INTO @choice_no, @choice_label

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM std_oper_step_choice WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
				AND step_no = @step_no
				AND choice_no = @choice_no) BEGIN
			IF (@choice_label IS NULL)
				DELETE FROM std_oper_step_choice
				WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND step_no = @step_no
				  AND choice_no = @choice_no
			ELSE
				UPDATE std_oper_step_choice
				SET choice_label = @choice_label
				WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND step_no = @step_no
				  AND choice_no = @choice_no
			END
		ELSE
			EXEC sp_I_Std_Oper_Step_Choice @oper_id, @step_no, @choice_no, @choice_label, NULL,
										@last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id OUTPUT


	 END
	CLOSE choice_cursor
	DEALLOCATE choice_cursor

    --Destroy the instance.
    EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_UE_SetRawReasonByName]
(@ent_name		STRING80
,@site_name		STRING80
,@raw_reas_cd		STRING40
,@new_reas_start	TDATETIME2
,@comments		STRING2000_NULL
,@spare1		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare2		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare3		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare4		STRING80 = NULL
,@new_reas_start_utc	TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_UE_SetRawReasonByName
-- Description	      -
-- Author				- Raghu
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
--	06/25/2015		RWB			5.02		For story 465621, added a new @new_reas_start_utc parameter.  If a value is supplied for this parameter,
--											its value will be used instead of the @new_reas_start value.  If a null is supllied for this parameter,
--											the value in @new_reas_start will be used.
--	11/18/2015		RWB			5.02		For story 558869 made a change to set the time_zone_bias_value based on the difference between the UTC time and
--											the local time if the UTC time is passed into the SP.
-- 08/17/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 675688-As Lenka, I want the Raw Reason from UCO and New Reason from Operator to be logged
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @ent_id		INT32
	,@def_reas_cd		INT32
	,@prompt		LOGICAL
	,@cur_reas_cd		INT32
	,@cur_raw_reas_cd	STRING80
	,@unkn_reas_cd		INT32
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'UtilExec.SetRawReason'

	SET @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

	SET @cur_reas_cd = -1

	--Retrieve the current raw reason code and verify whether the current utilization has the same raw reason.
	--If the current utilization event has the same raw reason as the new supplied raw reason code, then exit.
	--otherwise, set the new raw reason code.
	SELECT @cur_reas_cd = cur_reas_cd, @cur_raw_reas_cd = cur_raw_reas_cd, @unkn_reas_cd = unkn_stop_reas_cd
	FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	IF @cur_reas_cd = -1 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('A row does not exist in util_exec for this entity{3243}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- If the raw reason has NOT changed do nothing and exit
	IF @cur_raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd RETURN 0

	--Determine the reason start UTC
	IF (@new_reas_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The new reason start UTC is null
		--Determine if the local time is supplied
		IF @new_reas_start IS NOT NULL
			SET @new_reas_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @new_reas_start, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	-- Read def_reas_cd and prompt values from util_raw_reas table for this ent and raw_reas_cd
	SET @def_reas_cd = -1

	SELECT @def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd, @prompt = prompt
	FROM util_raw_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd

	-- If the no def_reas_cd is defined apply the unknown reas_cd and set prompt = True
	IF @def_reas_cd = -1 SELECT @def_reas_cd = @unkn_reas_cd, @prompt = 1

	--Added by Raghu on 08/04/2003. Defaulted to current reason code ONLY if def_reas_cd for the raw_reason OR unknown stop reason code is not found
	--When this calls NewEvent, and if def_reas_cd is null, it automatically updates the reason with current reason from util_exec and stays with old state_cd and old cur_reas_start.
	--To overcome this problem, if cur_reas_cd is passed (the same reason is updated anyway even if it is not passed), it automatically updates reas_cd, cur_reas_start and state_cd
	SET @def_reas_cd = COALESCE(@def_reas_cd, @cur_reas_cd)

	-- Call the sp_u_util_exec_setreason stored procedure to apply the default final reas_cd
	--Raghu 02/11/2003. Below line is modified by Raghu to pass cur_wo_id, oper_id, seq_no and step_no
	--RWB 11/18/2015 CR L00138701 - Modified the code to pass @time_zone_bias_value instead of NULL for the time_zone_bias_value parameter
	EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@new_reas_start_utc
		, @reas_cd=@def_reas_cd, @reas_pending=@prompt, @comments=@comments, @raw_reas_cd=@raw_reas_cd
		, @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4
		, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
		, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @update_if_exists=1, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Route]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @input_oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @input_seq_no int ,
   @input_percent float ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.12
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 01/18/2005	SJ		2112	HD#HD#1441 - Oper_ent_route and job_route Validation
-- 10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--07/02/2014	Raghu		5.0	Userstory: 325629 - As Jack, I want to prohibit MES client from making changes to work orders assigned to lines that would make them incompatible with the line to which they were assigned so that I do not create a problem for the Web client (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE
  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
 ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
 ,@upstream_ent_name	NVARCHAR(80)
 ,@downstream_ent_name	NVARCHAR(80)
 ,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)
,@line_name		NVARCHAR(80)

BEGIN
  --Check if the input oper_id and input seq_no are the same as this oper_id and seq_no
  IF @oper_id = @input_oper_id AND @seq_no = @input_seq_no
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Source operation and the job sequence must be different than the destination operation and the job sequence.{4532}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  IF @input_percent IS null SET @input_percent = 1
  INSERT INTO job_route
 (wo_id,
  oper_id,
  seq_no,
  input_oper_id,
  input_seq_no,
  input_percent,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
  VALUES
  (@wo_id,
   @oper_id,
   @seq_no,
   @input_oper_id,
   @input_seq_no,
   @input_percent,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

EXEC sp_U_Wo_ValJobRteWithLineRte @wo_id = @wo_id, @upstream_ent_name = @upstream_ent_name OUTPUT, @downstream_ent_name	= @downstream_ent_name OUTPUT

IF (@upstream_ent_name IS NOT NULL OR @downstream_ent_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @line_name = l.line_name
	FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
	WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

	SET @err_msg = 'The work order: %1 is currently assigned to line: %2. The new job route cannot be added, because the sequence of entities (upstream entity: %3, downstream entity: %4) in the job route do not match with the sequence of entities in the line route.{7914},' + @wo_id + ',' + @line_name + ',' + @upstream_ent_name + ',' + @downstream_ent_name
	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

  --* Return timestamp
  --SET @mod_id = (SELECT CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM job_route
    WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
      AND input_oper_id = @input_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @input_seq_no)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys] (
-- This SP only used to update qty_prod and qty_rejected fields in Job table from item_prod
  @wo_id		STRING40
, @oper_id		STRING40
, @seq_no		INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1600  Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
 @total_qty_good 	TFLOAT
,@total_qty_rejected 	TFLOAT
SELECT @total_qty_good = SUM(qty_prod) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and
				seq_no = @seq_no and good_prod = 1 and byproduct = 0
SELECT @total_qty_rejected = SUM(qty_prod) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and
				seq_no = @seq_no and good_prod = 0 and byproduct = 0
-- Change any nulls to zero's - This was hard to take care of with above queries as subqueries ?
IF @total_qty_good IS NULL SET @total_qty_good = 0
IF @total_qty_rejected IS NULL SET @total_qty_rejected = 0
-- Now update the Job table with these values
UPDATE 	job
SET 	qty_prod = @total_qty_good,
	qty_rejected = @total_qty_rejected
WHERE 	wo_id = @wo_id and
	oper_id = @oper_id and
	seq_no = @seq_no

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Process_GetProducedItems]
(@item_id	NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@process_id	NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@oper_exist	INT = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Program Name       - sp_SA_Process_GetProducedItems
-- Description	      -	Get all produced items for a given process
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	04/15/2004
-- Version	      - 2.31
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--07/28/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	If oper_exist flag is set to true, then return those processes which has atleast 1 operation exist
--03/21/2006	Raghu		3.1.12	Added item_class.item_class_id, item_class_desc in the resultset.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF (ISNULL(@oper_exist, 0) <> 1) SET @oper_exist = 0

	IF (@oper_exist = 1)
		SELECT item_process_link.process_id, item_process_link.item_id, item.item_desc, item_class.item_class_id, item_class.item_class_desc
		FROM item_process_link item_process_link
		INNER JOIN item item ON item_process_link.item_id = item.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
		WHERE (item_process_link.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		  AND (item_process_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		  AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper WHERE process_id = item_process_link.process_id)
		UNION
		SELECT bom_item_oper_link.process_id, bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id, item.item_desc, item_class.item_class_id, item_class.item_class_desc
		FROM bom_item_oper_link bom_item_oper_link
		INNER JOIN item item ON bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = item.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
		WHERE (bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		  AND (bom_item_oper_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		  AND (bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos = 0)
		  AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = bom_item_oper_link.process_id)
	ELSE
		SELECT item_process_link.process_id, item_process_link.item_id, item.item_desc, item_class.item_class_id, item_class.item_class_desc
		FROM item_process_link item_process_link
		INNER JOIN item item ON item_process_link.item_id = item.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
		WHERE (item_process_link.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		  AND (item_process_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		UNION
		SELECT bom_item_oper_link.process_id, bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id, item.item_desc, item_class.item_class_id, item_class.item_class_desc
		FROM bom_item_oper_link bom_item_oper_link
		INNER JOIN item item ON bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = item.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
		WHERE (bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		  AND (bom_item_oper_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		  AND (bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos = 0)
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_wo_attr_aft_ins] ON [dbo].[wo_attr]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_attr_aft_insert
-- Description        -  Propogate the attribute value to fc_namesp_tag table
--			HD# 7931, Updated wo_attr value not updated in FC
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 04/07/2006
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 07/02/2013	Srinu		4.6.0	(CR# L00119884)
-- 10/28/2013	Raghu		4.6	CR 129114 - When there is more than one attribute linked to a work order, cloning a work order from MES Client crashes
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE @user_id NVARCHAR(40), @err_msg STRING254

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	--Verify the identified user is a valid MES user
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
		--Verify whether the modified attribute has a certification linked
	 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN inserted i ON cal.attr_id = i.attr_id) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT i.attr_id FROM inserted i
				--Verify whether the modified attributes have valid certification attached to them, if any attribute remains,
				--then it means that the user does not have a valid certification.  Therefore, raise an exception
				EXCEPT
				SELECT DISTINCT i.attr_id
				FROM inserted i
				--Limit to the attributes that are modified
				INNER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.attr_id = cal.attr_id
				--Limit to the certifications that are linked to the modified attribute
				INNER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.cert_name = cul.cert_name
				--Limit to the identified user
				WHERE cul.user_id = @user_id
					--Verfiy whether the user's certification level is greater than the attribute certificaiton level
				  AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level
				  --Verify whether the user's certification is not expired
				  AND (cul.expiry IS NULL OR cul.expiry > GETUTCDATE())
			) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = '%1 does not have required certifications.{7612}' + @user_id
 			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
 	 		RETURN
		END
	END

END

	DECLARE @pallet_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @pallet_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sfg_wo NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sfg_seq_no INT
	DECLARE @sfg_qty FLOAT
	DECLARE @sfg_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @sfg_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_source INT
	DECLARE @sfg_source INT
	DECLARE @rm_item NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @item_desc NVARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @rm_wo NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_seq_no INT
	DECLARE @rm_wo_qty FLOAT
	DECLARE @rm_cons_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_cons_qty FLOAT
	DECLARE @rm_cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @item_class_id NVARCHAR(10)
	DECLARE @rm_cons_int_wo NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_cons_int_seq_no INT
	DECLARE @rm_cons_raw_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_cons_raw_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @rm_cons_raw_qty FLOAT
	DECLARE @rm_cons_int_qty FLOAT
	DECLARE @APOPER_ID NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @APRMOPER_ID NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @sfg_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @fg_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @pallet_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @item_id = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@item_id, 0, CHARINDEX(' | ', @item_id))))

	IF(@type = 'downstream') --RAW->SFG->FG
	BEGIN

	--	DECLARE @sfg_source INT

				SET @sfg_source = 1
				SET @destination = @sfg_source + 1
				SET @sfg_source = @source
				SET @id = 1
									

					--RETRIEVE THE QTY_CONS DETAIL RECORDS FROM ITEM_CONS FOR SELECTED ITEM					
					 SELECT 
							wo_id
						  , seq_no
						  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] (ic.item_id, SUM(qty_cons),i.uom_id) as 'qty_cons'--
						  , OPER_ID
						  , lot_no
						--  , row_id
							, ic.item_id
						  , i.item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(ic.lot_no, 0) as item_desc
						  , @sfg_source as source
						  , @destination as destination
						  , @id as id
						  , 0 as 'processed'						  
						  into #sfg_wo
						FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK) 
						inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on ic.item_id=i.item_id
						WHERE
							ic.item_id = @item_id
							AND lot_no = @lot_no
							AND
							(
								@wo_id IS NULL
								OR wo_id = @wo_id
							)
							
						GROUP BY
							wo_id
						  , lot_no
						  , seq_no
						  , OPER_ID
						  , ic.ITEM_ID
						  , item_desc
						  ,	i.uom_id
						  order by id-- desc
					select *from #sfg_wo
					declare @prod_row_id int
					select top 1 @material=item_Desc, @sfg_qty=qty_cons,  @source=source, @destination=destination, @prod_row_id=id ,
					@fg_wo=wo_id, @fg_oper_id=oper_id, @sfg_seq_no=seq_no,@lot_no=lot_no

					from #sfg_wo
					where processed=0 
					order by ID 
					INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
					(
						material
						, qty
						, id
						, source
						, destination
						,lot
					)
					VALUES
					(
							@material
							, @sfg_qty
							, @prod_row_id
							, isnull(@source,1)
							, @destination
							,@lot_no
					)
					--LOOP THROUGH EACH RECORD FROM #sfg_wo
					While (Select Count(*) From #sfg_wo Where Processed = 0) > 0
					BEGIN					
						select top 1 @material=item_Desc, @sfg_qty=qty_cons,  @source=source,  @prod_row_id=id ,
						@sfg_wo=wo_id, @sfg_oper_id=oper_id, @sfg_seq_no=seq_no,@lot_no=lot_no

						from #sfg_wo
						where processed=0 
						order by ID 

						update #sfg_wo set processed=1 where ID=@prod_row_id

						--CURSOR TO LOOP EACH FG LOT RECORD FOUND MATCHING CONSUPTION WO FETHED ABOVE
						DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
						FOR SELECT 
								ip.item_id
							  , ip.lot_no
							  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] ( ip.item_id, SUM(qty_prod),i.uom_id) as 'qty_prod' --SUM(ip.qty_prod)
							  , oper_id
							FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
							inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
							WHERE
								ip.wo_id = @sfg_wo
								AND ip.seq_no = @sfg_seq_no
								AND ip.oper_id = @sfg_oper_id
							GROUP BY
								ip.lot_no
							  , ip.item_id
							  , ip.oper_id
							  , i.uom_id

						OPEN sfg_item

						FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
													, @sfg_lot_no
													, @sfg_qty
													, @sfg_oper_id

						WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
						BEGIN
							SET @sfg_source = @prod_row_id
							SET @id = @destination
							
							SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
												  item_desc
											  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
											  WHERE item_id = @sfg_item_id)

							SET @material = @item_desc
							
							INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
							(
								material
							  , qty
							  , id
							  , source
							  , destination
							  ,lot
							)
							VALUES
							(
								   @material
								 , @sfg_qty
								 , @id
								 , @sfg_source
								 , @destination
								 ,@lot_no
							)


							-- RETRIEVE THE SFG PRODUCED WORK ORDER BASED ON THE SFG ITEM
							declare @maxid int
							select @maxid=max(id) from #sfg_wo
							insert into #sfg_wo
							 SELECT
								wo_id
								, seq_no
								, [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] ( ic.item_id, SUM(qty_cons),i.uom_id) as 'qty_cons'--SUM(qty_cons) as 'qty_cons'
								, OPER_ID
								, lot_no								
								, ic.item_id
								, i.item_desc  as item_desc									  
								, @sfg_source --source
								, @sfg_source-- @destination
								, row_number() over (order by (select null))+@maxid --NEXT VALUE FOR id_seq)--@id -- id
								, 0 as 'processed'
							FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
							inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on ic.item_id=i.item_id
							WHERE ic.item_id = @sfg_item_id and ic.lot_no=@sfg_lot_no								
							GROUP BY
								ic.wo_id
								, ic.seq_no
								, ic.lot_no
								, ic.oper_id
								, ic.item_id
								, item_Desc
								, i.uom_id
							
							set @destination =  @destination + 1 --NEXT VALUE FOR id_seq
							
						FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
													, @sfg_lot_no
													, @sfg_qty
													, @sfg_oper_id
					END --end while cursor

					CLOSE sfg_item
					DEALLOCATE sfg_item
						
				END -- end while #sfg_wo			
				

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@type = 'upstream') --FG->SFG->RAW 
		BEGIN

			SELECT
				@produce = produced
			  , @consume = consumed
			FROM item_class
			WHERE item_class_id = @item_class
			
			DECLARE @fg_seq_no INT
			DECLARE @fg_qty FLOAT
			DECLARE @fg_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_seq_no INT
			DECLARE @cons_qty FLOAT
			DECLARE @cons_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_wo_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @fg_source INT

			SET @source = 1
			SET @destination = @source + 1
			SET @fg_source = @source
			SET @id = 1

			SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
									item_desc
								FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
								WHERE item_id = @item_id)

			SET @material = @item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(@lot_no, 0);


			--RETRIEVE THE FINISH FINISHED-GOOD WORK ORDER
					
				SELECT 
					wo_id
					, seq_no
					,[dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] (p.item_id, SUM(qty_prod),i.uom_id) as 'qty_prod'--SUM(qty_prod)
					, OPER_ID
					, lot_no				
					, p.item_id
					, i.item_desc  as item_desc
					, @source as source
					, @destination as destination
					, @id as id
					, 0 as 'processed'						  
					into #fg_wo
				FROM item_prod p WITH(NOLOCK) 
				inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on p.item_id=i.item_id						
                       
				WHERE
					p.item_id = @item_id
					AND lot_no = @lot_no
					AND
					(
						@WO_ID IS NULL
						OR wo_id = @wo_id
					)
							
				GROUP BY
					wo_id
					, lot_no
					, seq_no
					, OPER_ID
					, p.ITEM_ID
					, item_desc
					,  item_desc
					,i.uom_id
					order by id-- desc

						
					select top 1 @material=item_Desc, @fg_qty=qty_prod,  @source=source, @destination=destination, @prod_row_id=id ,
					@fg_wo=wo_id, @fg_oper_id=oper_id, @fg_seq_no=seq_no,@lot_no=lot_no

					from #fg_wo
					where processed=0 
					--order by ID 
					order by seq_no asc
					INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
					(
						material
						, qty
						, id
						, source
						, destination
						,lot
					)
					VALUES
					(
							@material
							, @fg_qty
							, @prod_row_id
							, @source
							, @destination
							,@lot_no
					)
					
					--LOOP THROUGH EACH RECORD FROM FINISHED GOOD TEMP TABLE
					While (Select Count(*) From #fg_wo Where Processed = 0) > 0
					BEGIN					
						select top 1 @material=item_Desc, @fg_qty=qty_prod,  @source=source,  @prod_row_id=id ,
						@fg_wo=wo_id, @fg_oper_id=oper_id, @fg_seq_no=seq_no,@lot_no=lot_no
						from #fg_wo
						where processed=0 						
						order by seq_no asc
					
						update #fg_wo set processed=1 where ID=@prod_row_id	
						--CURSOR TO GET ALL RECORD FOR FG LOT FROM CONSUMPTION TABLE
						DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
						FOR SELECT 
								cons.item_id
							  , cons.lot_no
							  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] (cons.item_id,SUM(cons.qty_cons),i.uom_id) as 'qty_cons' --SUM(cons.qty_cons)
							  , oper_id
							FROM item_cons cons WITH(NOLOCK)
							inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on cons.item_id=i.item_id	
							WHERE
								cons.wo_id = @fg_wo
								AND cons.seq_no = @fg_seq_no
								AND cons.oper_id = @fg_oper_id
							GROUP BY
								cons.lot_no
							  , cons.item_id
							  , cons.oper_id
							  ,i.uom_id

						OPEN sfg_item
					
						FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
													, @sfg_lot_no
													, @sfg_qty
													, @sfg_oper_id
					
						WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
						BEGIN
						
							SET @sfg_source = @prod_row_id
							SET @id = @destination
							
							SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
												  item_desc
											  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
											  WHERE item_id = @sfg_item_id)

							SET @material = @item_desc 
							
							INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
							(
								material
							  , qty
							  , id
							  , source
							  , destination
							  ,lot
							)
							VALUES
							(
								   @material
								 , @sfg_qty
								 , @id
								 , @sfg_source
								 , @destination
								 ,@sfg_lot_no
							)
						
							insert into #fg_wo
							 SELECT
								wo_id
								, seq_no
								, [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] (prod.item_id, SUM(qty_prod),i.uom_id) as 'qty_prod'--SUM(qty_prod)
								, OPER_ID
								, lot_no							
								, prod.item_id
								, i.item_desc  as item_desc									  
								, @sfg_source --source
								, @destination
								, @id -- id
								, 0 as 'processed'
								FROM item_prod prod WITH(NOLOCK)
								inner join item i WITH(NOLOCK) on prod.item_id=i.item_id
								WHERE prod.item_id = @sfg_item_id and prod.lot_no=@sfg_lot_no
								GROUP BY
									prod.wo_id
								  , prod.seq_no
								  , prod.lot_no
								  , prod.oper_id
								  , prod.item_id
								  , item_Desc
								  , i.uom_id
							SET @destination = @destination + 1
							
						FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
													, @sfg_lot_no
													, @sfg_qty
													, @sfg_oper_id
					END --end while cursor

					CLOSE sfg_item
					DEALLOCATE sfg_item						
				END -- end while #fg_wo						
			END -- end else FG
		END	
					
		DECLARE @temp_id  INT

		SELECT TOP 1 @temp_id=id 			  
		FROM @childTableInvValidation
		WHERE material IS NOT NULL
		ORDER BY id		
	
		IF( @temp_id is not null)
		BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			id as id 
			, material AS       name
			, qty AS value
			, source
			, destination AS    target
			, lot
		FROM @childTableInvValidation
		WHERE material IS NOT NULL
		END

		
		
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_CUD_shared_ent]
(
@ent_id NVARCHAR(50), --Autonumeric
@alt_ent_id NVARCHAR(50),
@user_name NVARCHAR(50),
@row_id NVARCHAR(50),
@deleteFlag bit
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @RowAvailable int


select @RowAvailable = row_id from SDB.SCH.shared_ent where row_id = @row_id

if @deleteFlag = 0
BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null 
						BEGIN
						--code for insert

							

							if not exists (select * from [SDB].[SCH].[shared_ent] where ent_id = @ent_id and	alt_ent_id = @alt_ent_id)

									  ,[last_edit_at] = getdate()

BEGIN
			DELETE FROM  [SDB].[SCH].[movable_res] WHERE row_id = @row_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetProdItems]
(@wo_id		STRING40
,@oper_id	STRING40
,@seq_no	INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetProdItems
-- Description	      -	Retrieve items that are produced by a job
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	01/16/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.27
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	SELECT ic.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc, i.item_id, i.item_desc, i.num_decimals, i.uom_id, uom.description
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no AND jb.bom_pos <= 0
	UNION
	SELECT ic.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc, i.item_id, i.item_desc, i.num_decimals, i.uom_id, uom.description
	FROM job_bom_subst jbs WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbs.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	WHERE jbs.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbs.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbs.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbs.bom_pos <= 0
END

AS

-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on oee_exec table to update
-- Author             - Raghu

--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 04/18/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# ?, Verify OEE_EXEC.job_ent_id and .util_ent_id
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.

--01/18/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074104; Current OEE does not display correctly.
--02/01/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074540; Target Util does not get updated correctly.
--09/25/2008	Raghu 	    3.5	L00082286, L00083732, L00084282, L00084592 ; UCO State Change and deadlock resolution
--06/20/2014	Rich		5.0	UserStory: 296332 - Prevent setting def_prod_rate to null if the entity is in a line
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
   @ent_id		INT32,
   @util_ent_id		INT32,
   @current_util		TFLOAT,
   @target_util		TFLOAT,
   @target_perf		TFLOAT,
   @current_perf	TFLOAT,
   @target_qual		TFLOAT,
   @current_qual	TFLOAT,
   @target_oee		TFLOAT,
   @current_oee		TFLOAT,
   @last_edit_by	STRING40,
   @ent_name		STRING80,
   @msg			NVARCHAR(400),
   @line_id		INT32,
   @last_edit_comment	STRING254_NULL

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- If the def_prod_rate has been set to null and the entity is in a line, raise an
	-- error.  Exclude the parent of the line from the check.
	IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = i.ent_id
		WHERE lel.line_is_child = 0 AND i.def_prod_rate IS NULL)) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This entity belongs to a line so the Default Production Rate cannot be empty.<7905>', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- If the def_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, or std_item_id field has changed,
	-- update the prod_rate_history and bottleneck_history tables.
	-- This should only be done if the entity is part of a line.
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.ent_id = d.ent_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = d.ent_id
		WHERE (i.def_prod_rate IS NOT NULL AND d.def_prod_rate IS NULL)
		OR (i.def_prod_rate IS NULL AND d.def_prod_rate IS NOT NULL)
		OR (i.std_item_id IS NOT NULL AND d.std_item_id IS NULL)
		OR (i.std_item_id IS NULL AND d.std_item_id IS NOT NULL)
		OR i.def_prod_rate <> d.def_prod_rate
		OR i.prod_uom <> d.prod_uom
		OR i.batch_size <> d.batch_size
		OR i.std_item_id <> d.std_item_id)) BEGIN

		DECLARE oee_exec_cursor CURSOR STATIC for

		SELECT lel.line_id, i.ent_id
		FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.ent_id = d.ent_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = i.ent_id
		WHERE (i.def_prod_rate IS NOT NULL AND d.def_prod_rate IS NULL)
		OR (i.def_prod_rate IS NULL AND d.def_prod_rate IS NOT NULL)
		OR (i.std_item_id IS NOT NULL AND d.std_item_id IS NULL)
		OR (i.std_item_id IS NULL AND d.std_item_id IS NOT NULL)
		OR i.def_prod_rate <> d.def_prod_rate
		OR i.prod_uom <> d.prod_uom
		OR i.batch_size <>d.batch_size
		OR i.std_item_id <> d.std_item_id

		OPEN oee_exec_cursor

		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM oee_exec_cursor INTO @line_id, @ent_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @last_edit_comment = 'OeeExec.Update(Ent=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), COALESCE(@ent_id, -1)) + ')'
			EXEC sp_SA_Line_GetBottleneckEnts @line_id = @line_id, @log_prod_rates = 1, @start_time_utc = NULL, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
		END

		CLOSE oee_exec_cursor
		DEALLOCATE oee_exec_cursor
	END

	IF UPDATE(JOB_ENT_ID) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inserted i INNER JOIN ent job_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.job_ent_id = job_ent.ent_id WHERE can_run_jobs = 0) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name = ent_name FROM inserted i
			INNER JOIN ent job_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.job_ent_id = job_ent.ent_id WHERE can_run_jobs = 0
			SET @msg = 'The entity %1 must able to %2 so that %3 and reported to this entity.{4950},' + @ent_name + ',run jobs,performance and quality can be obtained'
			RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF UPDATE(UTIL_ENT_ID) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inserted i INNER JOIN ent util_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.util_ent_id = util_ent.ent_id WHERE can_capture_util = 0) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name = ent_name FROM inserted i
			INNER JOIN ent util_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.util_ent_id = util_ent.ent_id WHERE can_capture_util = 0
			SET @msg = 'The entity %1 must able to %2 so that %3 and reported to this entity.{4950},' + @ent_name + ',capture utilization,utilization can be measured'
			RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	DECLARE @t_oee_exec TABLE (
		id int identity,
		ent_id int,
		util_ent_id int,
		target_perf float,
		current_perf float,
		target_qual float,
		current_qual float,
		target_oee float,
		current_oee float,
		current_util float,
		target_util float
	)

	INSERT INTO @t_oee_exec (
		ent_id, util_ent_id, target_perf, current_perf, target_qual,
		current_qual, target_oee, current_oee, current_util, target_util
	)
	SELECT	b.ent_id, b.util_ent_id, b.target_perf, b.current_perf, b.target_qual,
			b.current_qual, b.target_oee, b.current_oee, c.current_util, c.target_util
	FROM oee_exec a WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN inserted b ON a.ent_id = b.ent_id
		INNER JOIN util_exec c WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.util_ent_id = c.ent_id

	DECLARE @max_id AS INT, @count AS INT
	SELECT @max_id = MAX( id ), @count = MIN( id ) FROM @t_oee_exec

	WHILE ( @count <= @max_id ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@ent_id = ent_id, @util_ent_id = util_ent_id, @target_perf = target_perf,
				@current_perf = current_perf, @target_qual = target_qual, @current_qual = current_qual,
				@target_oee = target_oee, @current_oee = current_oee, @current_util = current_util,
				@target_util = target_util
		FROM @t_oee_exec toe
		WHERE toe.id = @count

/* RWB: This change was made for CR L00085757, but it is being rolled back until Sidus 3 Rewire.
		IF UPDATE(job_ent_id) OR UPDATE(util_ent_id) OR UPDATE(target_perf) OR UPDATE(target_qual) OR
		   UPDATE(def_prod_rate) OR UPDATE(prod_uom) OR UPDATE(target_oee) OR UPDATE(basis) BEGIN
*/
		   UPDATE oee_exec
			SET oee_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by,
				oee_exec.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			WHERE oee_exec.ent_id = @ent_id
/*
		END
*/

		SET @count = @count + 1
	END

END
