CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetRefrshdShiftSched]
(
	@in_ent_id					INT32 = NULL
,	@in_start_time				TDATETIME = NULL
,	@in_days_ahead				INT32 = 7
,	@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetRefrshdShiftSched
-- Description					- Refreshes the shift schedules for the supplied entity.  Apparently, verifies and adjusts
--								  the shift along with the exceptions for the supplied entity.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 01/17/2007
-- Version						- 3.1.6.27
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32
,@end_time		TDATETIME
BEGIN

	EXEC sp_U_Ent_ScheduleShifts @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id, @in_start_time=@in_start_time
		, @in_days_ahead=@in_days_ahead, @in_time_zone_bias_value=0

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)
      SET @in_days_ahead = COALESCE(@in_days_ahead, 0)

      SET @end_time = DATEADD(d, @in_days_ahead, @in_start_time)


	--Return all shifts that are used to create shifts.
	SELECT ent_id, shift_id
		,start_time, end_time, break1_start, break1_end, break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end
/*	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, start_time) AS start_time
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, end_time) AS end_time
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, break1_start) AS break1_start
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, break1_end) AS break1_end
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, break2_start) AS break2_start
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, break2_end) AS break2_end
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, break3_start) AS break3_start
	          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, break3_end) AS break3_end*/
	FROM shift_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE (ent_id = @in_ent_id OR @in_ent_id IS NULL)
        AND (start_time >= @in_start_time OR @in_start_time IS NULL)
        AND (end_time <= @end_time OR @end_time IS NULL)
	ORDER BY ent_id, start_time, end_time, shift_id
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_type_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[cert_type]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_cert_type_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on cert_type table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 		Changes
-- 05/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.2.15		HD# 6521, Delete dependent records when cert_type.available_to_* reset
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE cert_type SET cert_type.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, cert_type.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE cert_type.cert_name = i.cert_name

	IF UPDATE(AVAIL_TO_OPER)
		DELETE FROM cert_oper_link WHERE cert_name IN
			(SELECT ct.cert_name FROM cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN inserted i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			INNER JOIN deleted d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.cert_name = i.cert_name
			WHERE i.avail_to_oper = 0 AND d.avail_to_oper = 1)

	IF UPDATE(AVAIL_TO_OPER_STEP)
		DELETE FROM cert_oper_step_link WHERE cert_name IN
			(SELECT ct.cert_name FROM cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN inserted i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			INNER JOIN deleted d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.cert_name = i.cert_name
			WHERE i.avail_to_oper_step = 0 AND d.avail_to_oper_step = 1)

	IF UPDATE(AVAIL_TO_PROD_ITEM) OR UPDATE(AVAIL_TO_CONS_ITEM)
		DELETE FROM cert_item_link WHERE cert_name IN
			(SELECT ct.cert_name FROM cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN inserted i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			INNER JOIN deleted d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.cert_name = i.cert_name
			WHERE ((d.avail_to_prod_item=1 OR d.avail_to_cons_item = 1) AND  (ct.avail_to_prod_item = 0 AND ct.avail_to_cons_item = 0)))

	IF UPDATE(AVAIL_TO_ATTR)
		DELETE FROM cert_attr_link WHERE cert_name IN
			(SELECT ct.cert_name FROM cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN inserted i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			INNER JOIN deleted d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.cert_name = i.cert_name
			WHERE i.avail_to_attr = 0 AND d.avail_to_attr = 1)
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[vw_cb_step_details]
-- Description: This is used to summarize the consumption details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AML,XPM			2026-02-06			Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================



CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_cb_step_details]
AS
SELECT 
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_id,
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR), 'DS', CAST(cd.dosing_step AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_step_id,
	CONCAT(CAST(j.wo_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.oper_id AS NVARCHAR), CAST(j.seq_no AS NVARCHAR), 'S', CAST(cb.sample_id AS NVARCHAR)) AS job_sample_id,
	j.wo_id, 
	j.oper_id, 
	j.seq_no,
	cd.item_id,
	cd.qty_reqd, 
	cd.dosing_step,
	ac.is_manual,
	cb.sample_id,
	s.sublot_no,
	( SELECT TOP 1 def_reas_cd FROM ufn_S_ofi_GetDefReasCdFromId(j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, cd.dosing_step) ) AS reas_cd,
	j.act_finish_time_local, 
	j.act_finish_time_utc

	
	

	FROM job j
		JOIN job_bom_correction_details cd ON j.wo_id = cd.wo_id AND j.oper_id = cd.oper_id AND j.seq_no = cd.seq_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_cb_approved_correction ac ON j.wo_id = ac.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ac.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ac.seq_no AND cd.dosing_step = ac.correction_step 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_CBamqp_Resp cb ON  j.wo_id = cb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = cb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = cb.seq_no AND cd.dosing_step = cb.curr_correction_step AND ac.is_manual = cb.isManual 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN [sample] s ON cb.sample_id = s.sample_id AND j.wo_id = s.wo_id ANd j.oper_id =s.oper_id AND j.seq_no = s.seq_no

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GetUtcDate]
(
	@in_date	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL OUTPUT
,	@tz_bias	INT32 = 0
,	@out_date	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL OUTPUT

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_S_GetUtcDate
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version				-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver  Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    IF ( @in_date IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @out_date = NULL
		RETURN
	END

	IF ( @tz_bias <> 0 ) BEGIN
		SET @out_date = DATEADD( mi, @tz_bias, @in_date )
	END
	ELSE if (@tz_bias = 0) BEGIN
        SET @out_date = @in_date
    END
	ELSE if (@tz_bias IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @out_date = NULL
		EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @out_date OUTPUT, @in_date, NULL
	END
END

(
	@cust_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@po_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@so_line_no int ,
	@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@customer_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@quantity float ,
	@uom_id int ,
	@min_qty float,
	@max_qty float,
	@line_price float ,
	--@reqd_by datetime ,
	@reqd_by_local datetime, -- Added 08/02/2007 AML
	@spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
	@mod_id varchar(30) ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					- 10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version     Changes
-- 02/03/2004		KRF				2.1.0		Changed name because table_name changed, and po_line_no to so_line_no
-- 10/11/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 07/10/2006		Raghu			3.1.19		Changed code not to double update the reqd_by value.
-- 08/02/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN


SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--IF @reqd_by IS NOT NULL SET @reqd_by = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @reqd_by)


DECLARE @reqd_by_utc	DATETIME
	,	@tz_temp		INT

SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @reqd_by_local, @tz_temp, @reqd_by_utc OUTPUT

UPDATE so_line
SET item_id = @item_id,
    customer_item_id = @customer_item_id,
    quantity = @quantity,
    uom_id = @uom_id,
    min_qty = @min_qty,
    max_qty = @max_qty,
    line_price = @line_price,
    --reqd_by = @reqd_by,
	reqd_by_local = @reqd_by_local,	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
	reqd_by_utc = @reqd_by_utc,		-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
    spare1 = @spare1,
    spare2 = @spare2,
    spare3 = @spare3,
    spare4 = @spare4,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(cust_id = @cust_id AND
        po_id = @po_id AND
        so_line_no = @so_line_no AND
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id)
END

       item_reas.reas_desc,
       item_reas.reas_grp_id,
       item_prod.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       item_prod.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
	 ent.description AS ent_description,
       item_prod.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       item_prod.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_prod.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_prod.to_ent_id,
       to_ent.ent_name to_ent_name,
       item_prod.good_prod,
       item_prod.qty_prod,
       item_prod.processed_flag,
       item_prod.byproduct,
       item_prod.move_status,
       item_prod.spare1,
       item_prod.spare2,
       item_prod.spare3,
       item_prod.spare4
FROM item_prod item_prod
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent to_ent ON
   item_prod.to_ent_id = to_ent.ent_id,
     job job,
     item item,
     item_reas item_reas,
     user_name user_name,
     ent ent,
     shift shift,
     item_grade item_grade,
     item_state item_state,
     uom
WHERE item_prod.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
      item_prod.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
      item_prod.seq_no = job.seq_no AND
      item_prod.item_id = item.item_id AND
      item_prod.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd AND
      item_prod.user_id = user_name.user_id AND
      item_prod.ent_id = ent.ent_id AND
      item_prod.shift_id = shift.shift_id AND
      item_prod.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd AND
      item_prod.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd AND
      item.uom_id = uom.uom_id

BEGIN

/*

-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch silo details for source
--
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01 	DS				2022-08-16			Initial version.
-- 0.02 	DS				2023-05-27			Added a new column UOM in the grid , refer bug number #168
-- 0.03		DS				2023-06-03			Bean intake specific validation #221- BeanIntake: Changing Source silo should not allow for Running Jobs
-- 0.04 	DS				2023-08-29			#279 changes related to liquor blending
-- 0.05		DS				2023-09-16			#279_1 changes related to get the details of reqd_qty for item from job bom
-- 0.06		DS				2023-10-03			#279_1 changes related to get the details of reqd_qty for item from job bom
-- 0.07		SSB				2023-10-18			Added num_decimals
-- 0.08     MA				2024-01-02			adding grade color column
-- 0.09		CK				2024-01-11			Added GetUOM function
-- 0.10		DS				2024-02-05			Added NOLOCK
-- 0.11		DS				2024-02-21			Added is_active = 1 for silo status ofi_su_mes_states_mapping
-- 0.12		DS				2024-03-29			Added the logic to handle  duplicate item in BOM
-- 0.14		DS				2024-04-04			Added composite item it with combination of grade_cd
-- 0.15		DS				2024-07-11			setting the composite item id as item id in case of bypass grade validation[deoderising, and butter loadout]
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_source_selection]
(
	-- declare
	 --@silo_selection		int    -- 1 for source , 2 from destination
	 @ver_id				nvarchar(40) 
	,@wo_id					nvarchar(40) 
	,@oper_id				nvarchar(80) 
	,@seq_no				int 
	,@job_ent_id				int  -- entity id
	,@recipeId				nvarchar(80)
	,@item_id				nvarchar(80)
) 
AS

--select @ver_id=NULL,@wo_id=N'1001066484',@oper_id=N'LiqBlend',@seq_no=0,@job_ent_id=488,@recipeid=NULL,@item_id=N'500000041973';


begin

declare @invtable table (rowid INT identity, ent_id INT,inv_item_id nvarchar(80),inv_item_desc nvarchar(80), mes_qty TFLOAT, date_in_utc datetime, max_capacity TFLOAT, jb_item_id nvarchar(80),uom_id int, grade_desc nvarchar(40),inv_grade_cd int, jb_grade_cd int,uom_desc STRING40,item_required_qty float NULL,subs_parentlist nvarchar(300),item_required_qty_for_subs float NULL, color nvarchar(40), subs_parentlist_fnv nvarchar(300)); --0.08
declare @duplicateIteminBOM table (ent_id INT,d1_jb_item_id nvarchar(80))

declare @var_su_selected table (rowid INT identity, is_chk bit null, storage_ent_id int not null , secondary_silo STRING40 null,secondary_silo_ent_id INT null,ratio TFLOAT null,abs_selected_qty TFLOAT null, silo_seq INT null,jb_item_id [dbo].[STRING40] ,jb_item_group [dbo].[STRING40] ,jb_grade_cd [int]);
declare @su_mes_states as table (su_ent_id int,su_status_str nvarchar(max))
declare @min_dosing_qty_kg int	-- minimum dosing qty
declare @is_running_disabled int =0  -- disable silo for bean intake running job, process spcecific check
declare @job_state_cd int
declare @jobrequiredQty float
declare @qty_prod float
declare @isbatchprocess int  -- is batch process
declare @isSubstiteMainConsItemToWIP int  -- substitue maine cons item to WIP  substitute_mainconsitem_to_wip
declare @bypass_grade_validation int =0
declare @compBI_item_id nvarchar(80) -- bean intake composite item id

  begin

			select @job_state_cd = state_cd,@jobrequiredQty = qty_reqd ,@qty_prod = qty_prod,@isbatchprocess = isnull(oa.attr_value,0)
			from job with(nolock) 
			left join  oper_attr oa with(nolock) on job.oper_id = oa.oper_id and oa.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc ='IsBatchProcess' )
			where job.wo_id = @wo_id and job.oper_id = @oper_id and job.seq_no = @seq_no

			--for the bean intake
			select @compBI_item_id = concat(item_id,reqd_grade_cd) from job_bom jb with(nolock) where jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos =0

			SELECT @bypass_grade_validation=oa.attr_value
					FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
							AND a.attr_desc = 'bypass_grade_validation'
							AND a.attr_grp = 7
						WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
			set @bypass_grade_validation = ISNULL(@bypass_grade_validation,0)

			

			select
			@isSubstiteMainConsItemToWIP = isnull(oa.attr_value,0)
			from job with(nolock) 
			left join  oper_attr oa with(nolock) on job.oper_id = oa.oper_id and oa.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc ='substitute_mainconsitem_to_wip' )
			where job.wo_id = @wo_id and job.oper_id = @oper_id and job.seq_no = @seq_no


			select
			@is_running_disabled = isnull(oa.attr_value,0)
			from job with(nolock) 
			left join  oper_attr oa with(nolock) on job.oper_id = oa.oper_id and oa.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc ='disable_src_silo_sel_for_running_job' )
			where job.wo_id = @wo_id and job.oper_id = @oper_id and job.seq_no = @seq_no
			
			if (@job_state_cd=3 and @is_running_disabled=1 )
			begin  set @is_running_disabled=1  end
			else
			begin  set @is_running_disabled=0  end
			

			set @jobrequiredQty = case when (@jobrequiredQty-@qty_prod)>0 then (@jobrequiredQty-@qty_prod) else 0 end

			--- #0.03 process specific check , only for running job
			



			
			select  @min_dosing_qty_kg = eam.attr_value		--cast(replace(eam.attr_value, ',', '') as decimal(18,3))
												from ent_attr ea with(nolock) 
												inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
												inner join ent_attr eam with(nolock) on eam.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
												where a.attr_desc = 'EntityType' and ea.attr_value = 'Site'
												and eam.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'min_dosing_qty_kg')
	
			
			-- if already silos are selected against - work order,oper, seq
					insert into @var_su_selected
					select is_chk , su_ent_id as  storage_ent_id, secondary_silo ,secondary_silo_ent_id ,ratio,abs_selected_qty,silo_seq
					,jb_item_id
					,jb_item_group
					,jb_grade_cd
					FROM  ofi_su_selection oss  with(nolock)  where oss.wo_id = @wo_id and oss.oper_id = @oper_id and oss.seq_no = @seq_no and oss.dest_type=1

			
		  
					INSERT INTO @invtable 
					SELECT inv.ent_id, inv.item_id,max(item.item_desc) item_desc, sum(isnull(inv.qty_left,0)) mes_qty,min(inv.date_in_utc) date_in_utc,  
					max(se.max_capacity)max_capacity, max(jb.item_id) jb_item_id,max(inv.uom_id) uom_id, ig.item_grade_desc grade,
					inv.grade_cd inv_grade_cd, jb.reqd_grade_cd jb_grade_cd,  -- fetching the inventory and job_bom grade code
					max(uom.description) uom_desc
					, min(@jobrequiredQty*jb.qty_per_parent_item)   item_required_qty
					--, STRING_AGG(is1.item_id,',')  subs_itemlist  --#0.05
					--,max(STUFF((SELECT ', ' + is2.item_id FROM item_subst is2 WHERE is2.orig_item_id = jb.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '')) AS subs_itemlist
					,MAX(subs_parentlist)  AS subs_parentlist

					,case when MAX(subs_parentlist) is not null 
						then ((select top 1 qty_per_parent_item from job_bom where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and item_id = MAX(subs_parentlist_fnv))*@jobrequiredQty)
						--min(@jobrequiredQty*jb.qty_per_parent_item)
						else
							min(@jobrequiredQty*jb.qty_per_parent_item)
							end as item_required_qty_for_subs
					,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) as color --0.08	passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code
					,MAX(subs_parentlist_fnv)  AS subs_parentlist_fnv 
					FROM item_inv inv with(nolock)  
					inner join item with(nolock) on inv.item_id = item.item_id
					inner join uom with(nolock) on item.uom_id = uom.uom_id 
					inner join ofi_ent_item_storage_link eisl with(nolock) on inv.ent_id  =  eisl.storage_ent_id  and eisl.type ='source' and eisl.ent_id = @job_ent_id  
					left join storage_exec se with(nolock) on inv.ent_id = se.ent_id
					left join job_bom jb with(nolock) on inv.item_id = jb.item_id  and inv.grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd 
					and  jb.wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos> 0 and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no
					left join item_grade ig with(nolock) ON inv.grade_cd=ig.item_grade_cd
					left join (
								-- distinct is required because multiple entries can exist item_id in table -item_subst - item can be substitue 2 for 2 parent(orig) material;
												--	here we are fecthing the list of substitute material based on original material
							  SELECT distinct
								is1.item_id
								,STUFF((SELECT ',' + concat(is2.orig_item_id,is2.reqd_grade_cd) FROM item_subst  is2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_parentlist
								,STUFF((SELECT ',' + is2.orig_item_id FROM item_subst  is2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_parentlist_fnv
							  FROM item_subst is1  WITH(NOLOCK)
							) AS subs ON  subs.item_id = inv.item_id
					
					group by inv.ent_id, inv.item_id,ig.item_grade_desc,ig.color,inv.grade_cd,jb.reqd_grade_cd;

				
				;with cte1  (is_chk,storage_ent_id,item_group,ent_name,silo,item_id,item_desc,inv_grade_cd,grade,dsc_qty,mes_qty,secondary_silo,secondary_silo_ent_id,
				ratio,abs_selected_qty,jb_item_id,jb_item_group,jb_grade_cd,wo_id,oper_id,ent_id,seq_no,min_dosing_qty_kg,silo_status_auto,info,is_disabled,maxBlendRatio,uom_desc,item_required_qty,item_qty_per_in_silo, isbatchprocess,isSubsMainConsItemToWIP,subs_parentlist,color) as (
									SELECT 
									isNull(oss.is_chk,0) is_chk ,
									oei.storage_ent_id,
									oei.item_group,
									ent_name,
									ent.description as silo,
									invt.inv_item_id item_id,
									--case when invt.item_id is null then
									--	(select top 1 item_id from item_inv with(nolock) where ent_id =oei.storage_ent_id)								
									--	else invt.item_id end as item_id,
									invt.inv_item_desc as item_desc,
									invt.inv_grade_cd as inv_grade_cd,
									invt.grade_desc as grade,  --INV GRADE
									--(invt.max_capacity)/1000  as silo_capacity,
									'' dcs_qty
									--,invt.mes_qty as mes_qty,
									--,case when(invt.uom_id =23) then (invt.mes_qty)/1000 
									--else invt.mes_qty end as mes_qty
									,invt.mes_qty as mes_qty
									,oss.secondary_silo  secondary_silo
									,oss.secondary_silo_ent_id  secondary_silo_ent_id
									,oss.ratio  ratio
									,oss.abs_selected_qty
									,oss.jb_item_id
									,oss.jb_item_group
									,oss.jb_grade_cd
									,@wo_id as wo_id,@oper_id as oper_id,@job_ent_id as ent_id,@seq_no as seq_no
									,@min_dosing_qty_kg as min_dosing_qty_kg
									,(select  STRING_AGG( su_status_cd,',') from ofi_su_mes_states_mapping with(nolock) where su_ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id and interlock_type = 'source' and is_Active=1) silo_status_auto
									, fcsv.notValidDescDetails
									, fcsv.isNotValidEnt
									,(select maxBlendRatio FROM [dbo].[fn_maxBlendRatio](oei.storage_ent_id,'source',invt.inv_item_id,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no)) as maxBlendRatio
									,ISNULL(invt.uom_desc,dbo.fn_s_ofi_GetUOM(oei.storage_ent_id)) as uom_desc
									,invt.item_required_qty
									--,round((invt.mes_qty/invt.item_required_qty)*100,2) item_qty_per_in_silo1  --qty percentage in silo against the required item
									,case when invt.item_required_qty is not null and invt.item_required_qty>0  then 
										round((invt.mes_qty/invt.item_required_qty)*100,2)
										else
										case when(item_required_qty_for_subs>0) then round((invt.mes_qty/invt.item_required_qty_for_subs)*100,2) else 0 end -- handling the devide by 0 error
										end as item_qty_per_in_silo
									,@isbatchprocess isbatchprocess
									,@isSubstiteMainConsItemToWIP isSubsMainConsItemToWIP
									,invt.subs_parentlist  subs_parentlist  -- susbtitute item 
									,color --0.08
									FROM  ofi_ent_item_storage_link oei WITH(NOLOCK) inner join  ent with(nolock) on oei.storage_ent_id =  ent.ent_id
									left join @invtable  invt  on invt.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id 
									cross apply [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oei.storage_ent_id,'source',invt.inv_item_id,invt.inv_grade_cd,invt.jb_item_id,invt.jb_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@job_ent_id,invt.subs_parentlist_fnv) as fcsv

									left join @var_su_selected oss on oss.storage_ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id
									WHERE oei.ent_id = @job_ent_id and oei.[type]= 'source'									
									--order by invt.date_in_utc asc  
									)
									
									select is_chk,storage_ent_id,item_group,ent_name,silo,cte1.item_id,cte1.item_desc,grade,inv_grade_cd,dsc_qty,mes_qty,isnull(secondary_silo,'') as secondary_silo
									, secondary_silo_ent_id,ratio,abs_selected_qty,jb_item_id,jb_item_group,jb_grade_cd,wo_id,oper_id,ent_id,seq_no,min_dosing_qty_kg,silo_status_auto
									,is_disabled
									,@is_running_disabled as is_running_disabled
									
									,maxBlendRatio,uom_desc
									,item_qty_per_in_silo, isbatchprocess,isSubsMainConsItemToWIP,subs_parentlist
									,@bypass_grade_validation as bypass_grade_validation
									,color --0.08
									,CASE	WHEN 
											(is_disabled =0) THEN  (select blendRatio_info FROM [dbo].[fn_maxBlendRatio](storage_ent_id,'source',cte1.item_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no)) 
											ELSE info
											END  AS info,
											i.num_decimals
											,case when oper_id = 'BeanBulkIntake' then @compBI_item_id
											when @bypass_grade_validation=1 then cte1.item_id
											else 
											concat(cte1.item_id,inv_grade_cd) end  as comp_item_id
											from cte1 
											left join item i on i.item_id=cte1.item_id
											order by ent_name 

			end

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_Job_Refresh_StartQty]
(@wo_id	STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@seq_no	INT32,
@cur_item_id	STRING40 = NULL,
@bInteger	LOGICAL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -	Refreshes the start_qty for Down stream jobs feded by the current job.
-- Author	      - Rohit
-- Date Created	  - 11/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver.      Changes
-- 06/23/2005     KRF                        @prev_total_val was INT32, but since it is adding up quantities, must be a TFLOAT
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.
--10/12/2011	Rupak				4.1		Changes done related to CR116973.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE
@qty_at_start		TFLOAT,
@qty_reqd		TFLOAT,
@item_id		STRING40,
@reqd_start_val_is_pct	LOGICAL,
@input_percent		TFLOAT,
@qty_prod		TFLOAT,
@Total_Qty_Prod	TFLOAT,
@Total_Qty_Cur		TFLOAT,
@ds_oper_id		STRING40,
@ds_seq_no		INT32,
@prev_oper_id		STRING40,
@prev_seq_no		INT32,
@bFededJob		LOGICAL,
@prev_total		INT32,
@prev_total_val		TFLOAT,
@bFinalJob		LOGICAL,
@next_oper_id		STRING40,
@next_seq_no		INT32,
@next_level_oper_id	STRING40,
@next_level_seq_no	INT32,
@job_state			INT32,
@ds_sequence_no		INT32
SET @bFinalJob  = 1
SET @Total_Qty_Prod = 0
SET @prev_total_val = 0
	--Before propogating the start Qty, Check that all the job at same level, having
	-- non zero qty_at_start, qty_reqd, are completed
	select @next_oper_id = oper_id, @next_seq_no = seq_no from job_route WITH (NOLOCK)  where wo_id = @wo_id
	and input_oper_id = @oper_id
	and input_seq_no = @seq_no
	Declare NextLevelJobs_cursor cursor LOCAL  for
	Select oper_id, seq_no
		from job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		   and  oper_id = @next_oper_id
		   --and seq_no  @next_seq_no
	OPEN NextLevelJobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		Fetch NEXT from NextLevelJobs_cursor into @next_level_oper_id, @next_level_seq_no
		--print 'Next level Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_level_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_level_seq_no)
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		Declare PrevJobs_cursor cursor LOCAL  for
		Select input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent
			from job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			   and  oper_id = @next_oper_id
			   and seq_no = @next_seq_no

		OPEN PrevJobs_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			Fetch NEXT from PrevJobs_cursor into @prev_oper_id, @prev_seq_no, @input_percent
			--print 'Prev Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_seq_no)

			if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			--print 'Prev Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_oper_id) + + convert(nvarchar,@pro_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_seq_no) + convert(nvarchar,@pro_seq_no)
			Select @prev_total = count(*)from #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				   and oper_id = @prev_oper_id
				   and seq_no = @prev_seq_no

			IF @prev_total = 0 BEGIN
				--print 'Check Prev Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_seq_no)
				Select @qty_reqd = isnull(qty_reqd,0), @qty_at_start = qty_at_start, @job_state = state_cd from job  WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				   and oper_id = @prev_oper_id
				   and seq_no = @prev_seq_no
				--print 'QTY Reqd = ' + convert(nvarchar,@qty_reqd) + '@qty_at_start = ' + convert(nvarchar,@qty_at_start) + 'status = ' + convert(nvarchar,@job_state)

				--Update only if the item produced are same
				IF (@qty_reqd <> 0 OR @qty_at_start <> 0) AND @job_state <> 4 BEGIN
					--print 'Job is  not yet completed ' + convert(nvarchar,@job_state)
					CLOSE PrevJobs_cursor
					DEALLOCATE PrevJobs_cursor
					CLOSE NextLevelJobs_cursor
					DEALLOCATE NextLevelJobs_cursor
					RETURN 0
				END
			END
		END
		CLOSE PrevJobs_cursor
		DEALLOCATE PrevJobs_cursor
	END
	CLOSE NextLevelJobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE NextLevelJobs_cursor

	-- Start propogating if same level jobs are completed
	-- Get the total qty for the current job
	Select @Total_Qty_Cur = isnull(qty_prod,0) from job  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
	--print @Total_Qty_Cur
	--print 'wo = ' + convert(nvarchar,@wo_id) +  'Current Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@seq_no)

	--create a cursor for all downstream jobs
	Declare AllDSJobs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL  for
		--Select DISTINCT oper_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq --ORDER BY sequence_no
		SELECT DISTINCT oper_id, seq_no, sequence_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq ORDER BY sequence_no -- Modified for CR11697
	OPEN AllDSJobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		Fetch NEXT from AllDSJobs_cursor into @ds_oper_id, @ds_seq_no, @ds_sequence_no
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		--print '----------------------------------------------------------'
		IF @ds_oper_id <> @oper_id OR @ds_seq_no <> @seq_no BEGIN

		Select @input_percent = input_percent from job_route  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @ds_oper_id  and seq_no = @ds_seq_no

		--Get the item_id for this job
		Select @qty_prod = isnull(qty_prod,0), @item_id = item_id from job  WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @ds_oper_id  and seq_no = @ds_seq_no
		--print 'Down Steam oper_id = ' + convert(nvarchar,@ds_oper_id) + 'SeqNo = ' + convert(nvarchar,@ds_seq_no)  + convert(nvarchar,@input_percent)
		--print '@ Cur qty_prod = ' + convert(nvarchar,@Total_Qty_Cur) + '@item_id = ' + convert(nvarchar,@item_id)  + convert(nvarchar,@cur_item_id)
		--Update only if the item produced are same
		IF @item_id = @cur_item_id BEGIN
			--print @Total_Qty_Prod
			IF @bInteger = 1 SET @Total_Qty_Prod = FLOOR(@Total_Qty_Prod)
			SET @Total_Qty_Prod =@Total_Qty_Prod + @Total_Qty_Cur * @input_percent
			SET @bFinalJob = 0
--
			Declare PrevJobs_cursor cursor LOCAL  for
			Select input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent
				from job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				   and  oper_id = @ds_oper_id
				   and seq_no = @ds_seq_no

			OPEN PrevJobs_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) 	BEGIN
			Fetch NEXT from PrevJobs_cursor into @prev_oper_id, @prev_seq_no, @input_percent
			--print @input_percent

			if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			--print 'Prev Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_seq_no)

			--IF @prev_oper_id <> @oper_id and @prev_seq_no <> @seq_no BEGIN
			--SET @Total_Qty_Prod = 0
			--IF @prev_total = 0 BEGIN
			IF @prev_oper_id = @oper_id
				Select @qty_at_start = isnull(qty_prod,0), @item_id = item_id from job  WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				   and oper_id = @prev_oper_id
				   and seq_no = @prev_seq_no
			ELSE

				Select @qty_at_start = isnull(qty_at_start,0), @item_id = item_id from job  WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				   and oper_id = @prev_oper_id
				   and seq_no = @prev_seq_no

			--print @prev_total
			--Update only if the item produced are same
			IF @item_id = @cur_item_id BEGIN
				IF @bInteger = 1  SET @Total_Qty_Prod = FLOOR(@Total_Qty_Prod)
				SET @prev_total_val = @prev_total_val + (@qty_at_start * @input_percent)
				--print '*Prev total = ' + convert(nvarchar,@prev_total) + ' IP = ' + convert(nvarchar,@input_percent) + ' qty_at_start = ' + convert(nvarchar,@qty_at_start)
			END
			--END
			END
			CLOSE PrevJobs_cursor
			DEALLOCATE PrevJobs_cursor
			--print @prev_total_val
			--print @Total_Qty_Prod
			IF @prev_total_val > 0 SET @Total_Qty_Prod = @prev_total_val
			SET @prev_total_val = 0
			--print @Total_Qty_Prod

				--print 'Updated Job'


			--Update the total quantity to this downstream job
			Update job
			SET qty_at_start =  @Total_Qty_Prod
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			and oper_id = @ds_oper_id
			and seq_no = @ds_seq_no

			--print '@Total_Qty_Prod = ' + convert(nvarchar,@Total_Qty_Prod) + '= '+ '@Total_Qty_Cur = ' + convert(nvarchar,@Total_Qty_Cur)  + ' input'+ convert(nvarchar,@input_percent)
			SET @Total_Qty_Prod = 0
		END
		ELSE SET @bFinalJob = 1

	    END
	END
	CLOSE AllDSJobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE AllDSJobs_cursor
	DROP TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
Return @bFinalJob
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:     	sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_GetValidJobPos
-- Description:	The stored procedure finds the current or an empty job position based on input
--	
-- Usage:		StartJob_ofi / UpdateJob_ofi WFs
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC				2025-08-15			Initial version.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *******************************************************************************************
-- exec [sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_GetValidJobPos] 	208, '1001258838', 'BreakingWinnowing', 0, 0
Create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_GetValidJobPos_bck_18_09_25]
(@ent_id	INT
,@cur_wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@cur_oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@cur_seq_no INT = 0
,@job_pos	INT OUTPUT
) AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	-- Get either the first empty one or the current one
	SELECT TOP 1 @job_pos = je.job_pos
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
			AND( je.cur_wo_id = @cur_wo_id 
					AND je.cur_oper_id = @cur_oper_id
					AND je.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				)
			OR ( je.ent_id = @ent_id
				AND je.cur_wo_id IS NULL
				AND je.cur_oper_id IS NULL
				)
	-- ORDER BY je.cur_wo_id DESC  NOTE: issue with job_pos selection during tests [OT]

	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, -1);

	SELECT @job_pos job_pos
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Prod_Rate_History]
(
	@line_id INT32 = NULL,
	@ent_id INT32 = NULL,
	@start_time TDATETIME = NULL,
	@start_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@end_time TDATETIME = NULL,
	@end_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@std_item_id STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@last_edit_by STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@last_edit_at TDATETIME = NULL,
	@row_id INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Prod_Rate_History
-- Description	      - Return the requested prod_rate_history records.
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @start_time_utc		TDATETIME;
DECLARE @end_time_utc		TDATETIME;
DECLARE @item_display_attr_val	NVARCHAR(10);

SET @start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
SET @end_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)

SELECT @start_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@start_time_tz, @start_time),
	@end_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@end_time_tz, @end_time)

SELECT @item_display_attr_val = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210

IF (@item_display_attr_val IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@item_display_attr_val) = 0) SET @item_display_attr_val = '0'

SELECT  prod_rate_history.line_id
	,line.line_name
	,prod_rate_history.ent_id
	,ent.ent_name
	,prod_rate_history.start_time_utc
	,prod_rate_history.start_time_local
	,prod_rate_history.start_time_utc as start_time
	,prod_rate_history.end_time_utc
	,prod_rate_history.end_time_local
	,prod_rate_history.end_time_utc as end_time
	,prod_rate_history.est_prod_rate
	,prod_rate_history.prod_uom
	,uom.description as uom_description
	,prod_rate_history.batch_size
	,prod_rate_history.std_item_id
	,item.item_desc
	,	CASE
			WHEN @item_display_attr_val = '0' THEN item.item_id
			WHEN @item_display_attr_val = '1' THEN item.item_desc
			WHEN @item_display_attr_val = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
			WHEN @item_display_attr_val = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
		END AS item_display

	,prod_rate_history.last_edit_comment
	,prod_rate_history.last_edit_by
	,prod_rate_history.last_edit_at
	,prod_rate_history.row_id
FROM prod_rate_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_rate_history.line_id = line.line_id
	INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_rate_history.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_rate_history.prod_uom = uom.uom_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_rate_history.std_item_id = item.item_id
WHERE (
	(prod_rate_history.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.start_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.end_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.std_item_id = @std_item_id OR @std_item_id IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
	(prod_rate_history.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
      )
ORDER BY line.line_name, ent.ent_name

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_wo_attr_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[wo_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_attr_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on wo_attr table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7931, Updated wo_attr value not updated in FC
-- 07/02/2013	Srinu		4.6.0	(CR# L00119884)
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),@wo_id NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id INT, @err_msg STRING254

	SET @attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM INSERTED)
	SET @wo_id = (SELECT wo_id FROM INSERTED)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT wo_id FROM wo_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND attr_id = @attr_id)
    BEGIN

		RAISERROR('The specified row was not found in the database{3440}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
     END

IF EXISTS (SELECT attr_id  FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name
	AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level WHERE cul.user_id = @last_edit_by AND cal.attr_id = @attr_id) OR EXISTS
	(SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM cert_attr_link) AND attr_id = @attr_id)
 BEGIN
	UPDATE wo_attr SET wo_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, wo_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE wo_attr.wo_id = i.wo_id AND wo_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id
 END
ELSE
 BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 does not have required certifications.{7612}' + @last_edit_by
 		            RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
 	 	            RETURN
 END
END

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_MDM_SCHED_CUD_User_Preferences]
  (
    @config_id			nvarchar(40)		= 'MDCC.Scheduler'
   ,@screen				nvarchar(40)		= 'Scheduler'
   ,@sectn				nvarchar(40) 
   ,@parameter			nvarchar(80) 
   ,@isdefault			BIT
--   @valu nvarchar(2000) 
   ,@valu				ntext
   ,@last_edit_comment	nvarchar(254)		= 'Scheduler User Preferences' 
   ,@last_edit_at		DATETIME OUT
   ,@deleteFlag			BIT
   )
AS


DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
Declare @lastEditAt datetime


IF( @deleteFlag = 0)
BEGIN
 IF (@config_id is null)
	BEGIN
		SET @config_id  = 'MDCC.Scheduler'   
		SET @screen = 'Scheduler' 
		SET @last_edit_comment  = 'Scheduler User Preferences'
	END

SELECT @lastEditAt = last_edit_at from dbo.ui_config where  sectn = @sectn and config_id = @config_id and screen = @screen 

IF exists(select 1 from ui_config with(nolock) where sectn = @sectn and config_id =  @config_id and screen = @screen)-- @last_edit_at is not null
	  BEGIN
					/*EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_Ui_Config] 
					   @config_id
					  ,@screen
					  ,@sectn
					  ,@parameter
					  ,@valu
					  ,@last_edit_comment
					  ,@lastEditAt*/
				IF(@parameter is NOT null and @isdefault = 1)
					 BEGIN
		 

					 -- Reset the default for user id passed
							  UPDATE ui_config
							  SET  
								   parameter =  ISNULL((select top 1 STUFF ( ( SELECT ','+InrTab.value
																	  FROM  fn_Split(parameter,',') InrTab
																	  where value <> @parameter
																	  ORDER BY InrTab.value
																	  FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE 
																	  ).value('.','VARCHAR(MAX)') 
																	 , 1,1,SPACE(0))  from fn_Split(parameter,',') OutTab),''),
								   last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
								   FROM ui_config
							  WHERE (config_id = @config_id AND
									screen = @screen)

									Select @lastEditAt = last_edit_at from dbo.ui_config where  sectn = @sectn and config_id = @config_id and screen = @screen 
								-- Set default for the selected user id

							UPDATE ui_config
							  SET  valu = @valu,
								   parameter= ISNULL((select top 1 STUFF ( ( SELECT ','+InrTab.value
																	  FROM  fn_Split(parameter,',') InrTab
																	  where value <> @parameter
																	  ORDER BY InrTab.value
																	  FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE 
																	  ).value('.','VARCHAR(MAX)') 
																	 , 1,1,SPACE(0))  from fn_Split(parameter,',') OutTab),'')+ ',' + @parameter ,
								   last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
							  WHERE (config_id = @config_id AND
									screen = @screen AND
									sectn = @sectn AND
									last_edit_at = @lastEditAt)

		
				 
					 END
					 ELSE
					 BEGIN
							 UPDATE ui_config
							  SET  valu = @valu,
								   last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
							  WHERE (config_id = @config_id AND
									screen = @screen AND
									sectn = @sectn AND
									last_edit_at = @lastEditAt)
					 END


		END
ELSE

	BEGIN
		/*EXECUTE  [dbo].[sp_I_Ui_Config] 
		   @config_id
		  ,@screen
		  ,@sectn
		  ,@parameter
		  ,@valu
		  ,@last_edit_comment
		  ,@last_edit_at OUTPUT*/

		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
		SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

		IF(@parameter is null)
		 BEGIN
		 SET @parameter=''
		 END
		 INSERT INTO ui_config	
 (config_id,
  screen,
  sectn,
  parameter,
  valu,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@config_id,
   @screen,
   @sectn,
   @parameter,
   @valu,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

	END


	select 'mdcc.scheduler'

END

ELSE

BEGIN
 
 DELETE FROM ui_config
 WHERE sectn = @sectn

 select 'Preference Deleted'

END

--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2024-06-06          YG					1.0					First version
--2024-06-21		  YG					2.0					Major Update 
--																Simplest: Remove the first digit when the value is above a configured limit (2,100,000,000). And send to DCS.
--																a.	When message comes back from DCS; if the length of the value is equal to 9. You would need to query the MESDB to find the job that fits the logic:
--																	i.	_wo_id + oper + seq ran on the specific line receiving the message.
--																	ii.	If more than 1 job is found, pick the latest ran one as long as the WO is not Closed in SAP. (new)
--																	iii.	If only 1 job is found and WO is Closed in SAP; follow the current logic for that. (same as now I expect)
--																	iv.	If no job is found, give data error to DCS. (same as now I expect)
--																b.	Possible errors: that an 8 PuO and an 6 PuO contain the same 9 digits, or that new PuO contains the same 9 digits and are used in the same line. (Unlikely)
--2024-06-26		  YG					3.0					Set the @DCS_JOB_Max_Value configurable for equipment
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid_orig]
(    
      @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	  @seq_no INT,
	  @ent_id INT
)
	RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  result INT, 
		  output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		  output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		  output_operid NVARCHAR(100), 
		  output_seqno INT
		)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DCS_JOB_Max_Value INT = 2100000000
	,@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits INT = 10
	,@DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty INT = 1
	,@Num_DigittoKeep INT
	,@NumberOfZerotoAdd INT
	,@String_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_Truncated_WoId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_OperId NVARCHAR(100)
	,@Output_SeqNo INT
	,@Area_Ent_Id INT
	,@result INT = 0
	,@DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value INT = NULL
	,@DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value INT = NULL

	-- Get Max Value (Plant Level)
	SELECT @DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value, ',','')) 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AUTMaxWONumber')
	AND ent_id = (SELECT TOP 1 ent_id
					  FROM   ent (nolock)
					  WHERE  parent_ent_id IS NULL
					  ORDER  BY ent_id)

	-- Get Max Value (Segment Level)
	SELECT @DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLACE(attr_value, ',','')) 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'AUTMaxWONumber')
	AND ent_id = @ent_id

	-- Set the max value with segment value as the priority
	SET @DCS_JOB_Max_Value = COALESCE(@DCS_JOB_Segment_Max_Value,@DCS_JOB_Plant_Max_Value)

	--Get Area From Segment Id
	SELECT @Area_Ent_Id=parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)

	--#1 wo_id more than max_number and length of wo_id is equal with max_length_of_wo_id
	IF LEN(@wo_id) = @DCS_JOB_Max_Digits AND CONVERT(BIGINT,@WO_ID) > @DCS_JOB_Max_Value
	BEGIN
		--Get Right Side Digit
		SET @Num_DigittoKeep = @DCS_JOB_Max_Digits-@DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty;
		SET @String_WoId = RIGHT(@wo_id,@Num_DigittoKeep);

		--Set The Truncated Wo
		SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @String_WoId

		--Get The OperId and SeqNo
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_SeqNo = j.seq_no, @Output_OperId = j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id)
		ORDER BY row_id DESC
	END
	ELSE IF (LEN(@WO_ID)=@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty) -- #2 length of wo_id is equal with the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated 
	BEGIN
		--Manipulated String 
		SET @String_WoId = CONCAT(REPLICATE('_', @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty), @WO_ID);
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
 
		--Get The Correct Order From The List
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_WoId=j.wo_id,@Output_OperId=j.oper_id, @Output_SeqNo=j.seq_no FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		WHERE j.wo_id LIKE @String_WoId and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
		GROUP BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no
		ORDER BY max(job_start_utc) DESC
	END
	ELSE IF LEN(@WO_ID)<@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty --#3 and #4 length is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated 
	BEGIN
		--Validate SAP/MES order
		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND spare1 is NULL)) --#4 length of wo_id is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated (MES order)
		BEGIN
			--Set output wo, it is a manual order
			SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
			SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
			SET @Output_SeqNo = @seq_no

			SELECT TOP 1 @Output_OperId=j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
			ORDER BY row_id DESC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--Number of 0
			SET @NumberOfZerotoAdd = (@DCS_JOB_Max_Digits - @DCS_JOB_Remove_Char_Qty) - LEN(@WO_ID) --#3 length of wo_id is less than the subtraction of max_length_of_wo_id and number_of_digit_truncated (SAP order)

			--Manipulated String 
			SET @String_WoId = CONCAT('_',REPLICATE('0',@NumberOfZerotoAdd), @WO_ID);
			SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id

			--Get The Correct Order From The List
			SELECT TOP 1 @Output_WoId=j.wo_id,@Output_OperId=j.oper_id, @Output_SeqNo=j.seq_no FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
			WHERE j.wo_id LIKE @String_WoId and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
			GROUP BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no
			ORDER BY max(job_start_utc) DESC
		END
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		-- Get wo_id, seq_no
		SET @Output_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_Truncated_WoId = @wo_id
		SET @Output_SeqNo = @seq_no

		-- Get oper_id
		SELECT TOP 1 @Output_OperId=j.oper_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id and j.oper_id = jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id and j.oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id or ent_id = @Area_Ent_Id) and j.seq_no = @seq_no
		ORDER BY COALESCE(jh.job_start_utc, j.act_start_time_utc) DESC
	END

	IF (@Output_WoId IS NULL or @Output_OperId is NULL or @Output_SeqNo IS NULL or @Output_Truncated_WoId IS NULL)
		SET @result = 0 -- Dont continue for the next step
	ELSE
		SET @result = 1 -- continue

    INSERT INTO @Output (result, output_woid, output_truncated_woid, output_operid, output_seqno)
		VALUES (@result, @output_woid, @output_truncated_woid, @output_operid, @output_seqno) ;

    RETURN ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetProduction]
(
 		@session_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32_NULL = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetProduction
-- Description			- See Middleware DFS, Sidus 2 Broadway
-- Author				- AML
-- Date Created			- 07/28/2008
-- Version				- 3.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
--
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @current_prod AS TFLOAT
		,	@projected_prod AS TFLOAT
		,	@run_ent_id AS INT32
		,	@shift_start AS TDATETIME
		,	@shift_end AS TDATETIME
		,	@shift_dur AS TFLOAT
		,	@to_now AS INT32
		,	@start_day AS INT32
		,	@current_rate AS TFLOAT
		,	@now_to_end AS INT32
		,	@batch_size AS TFLOAT
		,	@job_start AS TDATETIME

	IF ( @wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid Work Order ID for the job must be provided to retrieve current and projected production.{5790}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '' ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid Operation ID for the job must be provided to retrieve current and projected production.{5791}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @seq_no IS NULL OR @seq_no < 0 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid Sequence Number for the job must be provided to retrieve current and projected production.{5792}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON
				job_exec.cur_wo_id = job.wo_id AND
				job_exec.cur_oper_id = job.oper_id AND
				job_exec.cur_seq_no = job.seq_no
		WHERE job_exec.cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  job_exec.cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  job_exec.cur_seq_no = @seq_no AND
			  job.state_cd = 3
	) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1 )
		return -1
	END

	SELECT 	@run_ent_id = job.run_ent_id
		,	@batch_size = job.batch_size
		,	@job_start = job.act_start_time_utc
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND
		  job.oper_id = @oper_id and
		  job.seq_no = @seq_no

	-- CR L00123552.
	SELECT	@start_day = DATEPART( dw, ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc ) - 1,
			@shift_start = ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent.ent_id = @run_ent_id

	IF ( EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND ent.can_sched_shifts = 1 ) AND
		 EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ss.ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
				  start_day = @start_day AND
				  ss.shift_id = e.cur_shift_id) ) BEGIN

		SELECT 	@shift_dur = DATEDIFF( ss, ss.start_time, ss.end_time )
		FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ss.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE ss.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
			  ss.start_day = @start_day AND
			  ss.shift_id = e.cur_shift_id

	END ELSE BEGIN

		DECLARE @tree_level AS INT
		DECLARE @shift_entities	TABLE (
			ent_id INT,
			parent_ent_id INT,
			can_sched_shifts BIT,
			cur_shift_id INT,
			tree_level INT
		)



		SET @tree_level = 1

		INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, tree_level)
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id

		SET @tree_level = 2

		WHILE ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @shift_entities se WHERE se.can_sched_shifts = 1) < 1 ) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, can_sched_shifts, cur_shift_id, tree_level )
			SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, can_sched_shifts, cur_shift_id, @tree_level
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id IN (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM @shift_entities WHERE tree_level = @tree_level - 1)

			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
		END

		SELECT 	@shift_dur = DATEDIFF( ss, ss.start_time, ss.end_time )
		FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @shift_entities se ON ss.ent_id = se.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent e ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE se.can_sched_shifts = 1 AND ss.start_day = @start_day AND ss.shift_id = se.cur_shift_id

	END

	IF ( @shift_dur IS NULL ) OR ( @shift_dur <= 0 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'No shift schedule found for the selected entity.{3084}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @shift_end = DATEADD( ss, @shift_dur, @shift_start );

	IF (@job_start > @shift_start) BEGIN
		SELECT @to_now = DATEDIFF( ss, @job_start, GETUTCDATE() ), @now_to_end = DATEDIFF( ss, GETUTCDATE(), @shift_end)
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @to_now = DATEDIFF( ss, @shift_start, GETUTCDATE() ), @now_to_end = DATEDIFF( ss, GETUTCDATE(), @shift_end)
	END

	SELECT @current_prod = SUM(item_prod.qty_prod)
	FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_prod.wo_id = @wo_id AND
		  item_prod.oper_id = @oper_id AND
		  item_prod.seq_no = @seq_no AND
		  item_prod.good_prod = 1 AND
		  item_prod.shift_start_utc = @shift_start AND
		  (item_prod.last_edit_at between @shift_start and @shift_end)

	SET @current_rate = (@current_prod/@to_now)
	SET @projected_prod = (@current_rate * @now_to_end) + @current_prod

	SELECT 	ISNULL( CONVERT( DECIMAL(10,2), @current_prod ), 0 ) AS current_prod
		, 	ISNULL( CONVERT( DECIMAL(10,2), @projected_prod ), 0 ) AS projected_prod

END

CREATE Trigger [tg_oper_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2030) Update first_oper and final_oper flags in this table
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--01/17/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073953; Deletes corresponding entries from Data_Entry_Sched
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
--		EXEC sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags @process_id
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_cursor

	DELETE FROM data_entry_sched
	WHERE key_id IN (SELECT d.row_id FROM deleted d)
	  AND key_type = 4
	  AND category = 'Datalog Group'
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_cert_user_link_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[cert_user_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_cert_user_link_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on cert_user_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Name:		[vw_job_prod_details]
-- Description: This is used to summarize the production details for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2024-08-13			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2024-09-23			Updated link to item view
-- 0.01.02  JSC				2024-10-24			Updated it to have also Latest creation time
-- 0.01.03	JSC				2025-02-18			Fix for duplicated item_attr
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE     VIEW [dbo].[vw_job_prod_details]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT	 j.wo_id
				,j.oper_id
				,j.seq_no
				,CONCAT(j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no) AS 'job_id'
				,j.job_desc
				,j.state_cd
				,js.state_desc
				,j.item_id AS 'job_item_id'
				,ipro.item_id AS 'prod_item_id'
				,i.item_desc AS 'prod_item_desc'
				,oia.attr_value AS 'prod_item_group'
				,ipro.ent_id
				,ipro.to_ent_id
				,ipro.lot_no
				,ipro.sublot_no
				,SUM(ipro.qty_prod)  AS 'total_qty_prod'
				,SUM(ipro.qty_prod_erp)  AS 'total_qty_prod_erp'
				,ipro.grade_cd
				,igra.item_grade_desc
				,'#' + CONVERT(char(6), CONVERT(BINARY(3), igra.color), 2) AS 'item_grade_color'
				,u.abbreviation AS 'uom_abbreviation'
				,u.description AS 'uom_description'
				,i.uom_id
				,ir.reas_desc AS 'prod_item_reason'
				,COALESCE(e2.description,e1.description,e2.ent_name,e1.ent_name) AS 'line_description'
				,MAX(ipro.created_at_local) AS 'latest_prod_created_at_local'
FROM
		dbo.job AS j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.init_sched_ent_id = e1.ent_id 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ent AS e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = e2.ent_id 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.job_state AS js WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd = js.state_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_prod AS ipro WITH (NOLOCK) ON  j.wo_id =ipro.wo_id 
															AND  j.oper_id = ipro.oper_id 
															AND  j.seq_no = ipro.seq_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.vw_ofi_item AS oi WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipro.item_id = oi.item_id AND ipro.last_edit_at > oi.valid_from AND ipro.last_edit_at <= valid_to
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item AS i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = oi.item_id AND i.row_id = oi.row_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_grade AS igra WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipro.grade_cd = igra.item_grade_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_reas AS ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipro.reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.uom AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.vw_ofi_item_attr AS oia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ipro.item_id = oia.item_id 			-- v.1.03: Added vw_ofi_item_attr view instead of table
																		AND ipro.last_edit_at > oia.valid_from 
																		AND ipro.last_edit_at <= oia.valid_to 
																		AND oia.attr_id = ( 	SELECT TOP 1 attr_id 
																		FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
																			AND attr_grp = 1
																	)
GROUP BY j.wo_id
		,j.oper_id
		,j.seq_no
		,j.job_desc
		,j.state_cd
		,js.state_desc
		,j.item_id
		,ipro.item_id
		,i.item_desc
		,oia.attr_value
		,ipro.ent_id
		,ipro.to_ent_id
		,ipro.lot_no
		,ipro.sublot_no
		,ipro.grade_cd
		,igra.item_grade_desc
		,igra.item_grade_desc
		,igra.color
		,u.abbreviation
		,u.description
		,i.uom_id
		,ir.reas_desc
		,COALESCE(e2.description,e1.description,e2.ent_name,e1.ent_name)

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GLL_GetLineAccByGroups]
  (@sids_xml	nvarchar(max),
   @line_id		INT = NULL)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_S_GLL_GetLineAccByGroups
-- Description	  -	This method accepts a list of SIDs in an xml string that represent the OS groups to which the user
--					belong and optionally a line ID.  It looks up the SIDs in the Grp_Name table and returns
--					the maximum access in the Grp_Line_Link table for the groups that match the supplied SIDs.  If
--					none of the SIDs match a group, then 0 is returned for the priv_value..  If a line_id is supplied
--					then a single row for that entity is returned, else a row for each line.
--					EXAMPLE XML:
--						<sids>
--							<sid id="S-1-1-123"/>
--							<sid id="S-1-1-456"/>
--						</sids>

-- Author		  -	Rich Boyle
-- Date Created	  -	08/12/2014
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By     Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@doc_handle					INT32

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @sids_xml

	SELECT grp_line_link.line_id
		,line.line_name
		,COALESCE(max(CAST(x.accss AS Int)), 0) access
	FROM grp_line_link grp_line_link
	INNER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.line_id = line.line_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT grp_line_link.line_id, grp_line_link.accss
		FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/sids/sid',2) WITH (id nvarchar(68) '@id') grp_sids
		INNER JOIN grp_name group_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_sids.id = group_name.sid
		INNER JOIN grp_line_link grp_line_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON group_name.grp_id = grp_line_link.grp_id
		WHERE ((grp_line_link.line_id = @line_id)OR (@line_id IS NULL))) x ON grp_line_link.line_id = x.line_id
	WHERE ((grp_line_link.line_id = @line_id)OR (@line_id IS NULL))
	GROUP BY grp_line_link.line_id, line.line_name
	ORDER BY line.line_name

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_prod_events]
AS
SELECT
	util_log.log_id AS ID
	,CONVERT(INT,NULL) AS NoGroup
	,util_log.event_time_local AS StartDateTime
	,DATEADD(ss,util_log.duration,util_log.event_time_local) AS EndDateTime
	,util_log.event_time_utc AS StartDateTimeUTC
	,DATEADD(ss,util_log.duration,util_log.event_time_utc) AS EndDateTimeUTC
	,util_log.duration AS Duration
	,util_log.shift_start_local AS ShiftStartDateTime
	,util_log.shift_start_utc AS ShiftStartDateTimeUTC
	,util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc AS ReasonGrpDesc
	,util_reas.reas_desc AS ReasonDesc
	,util_state.state_desc AS UtilStateDesc
    ,ent.ent_name AS EntityName
	,shift.shift_desc AS ShiftDesc
	,item.item_desc AS ProductDesc
	,item.item_id AS ProductID
	,job_hist.seq_no AS SeqNo
	,job_hist.oper_id AS OperationID
	,job_hist.wo_id AS WOID
	,util_log.last_edit_by AS UserID
	,util_log.comments AS UserNotes
	,util_state.color AS ColorCode
	,CASE
		WHEN util_log.downtime = 1 THEN N'Availability Loss'
		WHEN util_log.runtime = 1  THEN N'Performance Loss'
		ELSE N'Idle'
	 END AS LossType
	,util_log.raw_reas_cd as RawReasCd
	,util_log.ent_id as EntId
	,util_log.category1 as Category1
	,util_log.category2 as Category2
	,util_log.category3 as Category3
	,util_log.category4 as Category4
	,util_log.reas_cd as ReasonCd
	,util_reas.reas_grp_id as ReasonGrpId
	,util_log.event_end_time_utc
	,job_hist.job_pos
	,job_hist.job_start_utc
	,job_hist.job_start_local
	,job_hist.job_end_utc
	,job_hist.job_end_local
FROM [dbo].util_log util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN [dbo].ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.ent_id = ent.ent_id
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no, jh.item_id, jh.job_pos, jh.job_start_utc, jh.job_start_local, jh.job_end_utc, jh.job_end_local
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
	  AND jh.job_start_utc = (SELECT MIN(jh1.job_start_utc)
	  			FROM job_history jh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	  			WHERE jh1.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
	  			  AND COALESCE(jh1.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_time_utc
				  AND jh1.job_start_utc < util_log.event_end_time_utc)
	  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_time_utc) job_hist
LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
	job_hist.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN [dbo].shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
	util_log.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN [dbo].util_state util_state  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
	util_log.state_cd = util_state.state_cd
INNER JOIN [dbo].util_reas util_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
	util_log.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
INNER JOIN [dbo].util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON
	util_reas.reas_grp_id = util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id

-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_step_details]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch the steps details against the work order
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		DS				2022-12-14			Initial version.
-- 0.02		DS				2023-05-17			Changes made for set lot
-- 0.03		DS				2024-02-05			Comments added
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_step_details]
(
  @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
 ,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
 ,@seq_no		INT
 ,@ent_id		INT --= NULL  
 ,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40) --= '100001234'
) 

AS

declare  @useLastLot int=0
declare @lotDetails as table (item_id STRING40, item_desc STRING80, def_lot_no  STRING40_NULL,last_used_lot STRING40_NULL, attr_value STRING1700_NULL )

begin

--TO HANDLE THE STEPS
	insert into @lotDetails
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives] 
	   @wo_id
	  ,@oper_id
	  ,@seq_no
	  ,@useLastLot



	if exists(select 1 from @lotDetails) -- Show the steps if required to set the lot else hide it
	begin

		select distinct js.step_name,isnull(jsd.state_cd,0) state_cd ,js.step_no, js.spare1,js.spare2 as step_name_localized
		from job_step js  with(nolock)
		left join job_step_data jsd with(nolock) on js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
		and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no and js.step_no = jsd.step_no
		where js.wo_id = @wo_id and js.oper_id = @oper_id and JS.seq_no = @seq_no
		order by js.step_no asc
	end
	else
	begin

		
		select distinct js.step_name,isnull(jsd.state_cd,0) state_cd ,js.step_no, js.spare1,js.spare2 as step_name_localized
		from job_step js  with(nolock)
		left join job_step_data jsd with(nolock) on js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
		and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no and js.step_no = jsd.step_no
		where js.wo_id = @wo_id and js.oper_id = @oper_id and JS.seq_no = @seq_no
		and step_name<>'Set Lot'
		order by js.step_no asc

	end 

end
