CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Spec]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @step_no int,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @act_spec_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @assoc_file nvarchar(254) ,
   @comments nvarchar(2000) ,
   @min_value nvarchar(80),
   @max_value nvarchar(80),
   @access_level int,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_I_Job_Spec
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1600  Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
--07/27/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 4883) Validate type of specification values
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
-- 10/25/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084807 - added a check for a null assoc_file and only added the file type to the file_type table if the assoc_file is not null----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
	    ,@data_type		INT
	    ,@ftle		DATETIME
	    ,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(254)

SELECT @data_type = data_type FROM spec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spec_id = @spec_id

IF (@data_type = 1) BEGIN
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@spec_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},spec_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@min_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},min_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@max_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},max_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@act_spec_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},act_spec_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
END

if @assoc_file IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	SET @assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(@assoc_file)
	EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
			, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
			, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
END

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

INSERT INTO job_spec
 (wo_id,
  oper_id,
  seq_no,
  step_no,
  spec_id,
  spec_value,
  act_spec_value,
  assoc_file,
  assoc_file_type,
  comments,
  min_value,
  max_value,
  access_level,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@wo_id,
   @oper_id,
   @seq_no,
   @step_no,
   @spec_id,
   @spec_value,
   @act_spec_value,
   @assoc_file,
   @assoc_file_type,
   @comments,
   @min_value,
   @max_value,
   @access_level,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Return timestamp
--SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
from job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id AND
oper_id = @oper_id AND
seq_no = @seq_no AND
spec_id = @spec_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Qm_Spec]
(@qm_spec_id INT32 = NULL,
@qm_spec_name STRING40 = NULL,
@qm_spec_desc STRING80_NULL = NULL,
@edit_level INT32 = NULL,
@ver_id STRING40 = NULL,
@start_eff_utc TDATETIME = NULL,
@start_eff_local TDATETIME = NULL,
@end_eff_utc TDATETIME = NULL,
@end_eff_local TDATETIME = NULL,
@ent_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
@item_id STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@item_category_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
@process_id STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@oper_id STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@category_id INT32 = NULL,
@plan_id INT32 = NULL,
@num_pts_per_page INT32 = NULL,
@spare1 STRING80_NULL = NULL,
@spare2 STRING80_NULL = NULL,
@spare3 STRING80_NULL = NULL,
@spare4 STRING80_NULL = NULL,
@last_edit_by STRING40_NULL = NULL,
@last_edit_at TDATETIME = NULL
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Qm_Spec
-- Description       - returns rows of the table qm_spec based on input parameters.
-- Author           -
-- Date Created         -  10/5/2010
-- Version            - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 07/28/2011     Johnny               Added num_pts_per_page column
-- 04/13/2020     Sara          6.2    Added display_seq column
-- 05/07/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1302835 - As Bruce, I want the QMSpec Web APIs to pass Date/Times in UTC so that the user doesn't need to convert to entity local time
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
   SET NOCOUNT ON

   DECLARE @attr_value  NVARCHAR(10)

   SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 210
   IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

SELECT qm_spec.qm_spec_id
   ,qm_spec.qm_spec_name
   ,qm_spec.qm_spec_desc
   ,qm_spec.edit_level
   ,qm_spec.ver_id
   ,qm_spec.start_eff_utc
   ,qm_spec.start_eff_local
   ,qm_spec.start_eff_utc AS start_eff
   ,qm_spec.end_eff_utc
   ,qm_spec.end_eff_local
   ,qm_spec.end_eff_utc AS end_eff
   ,qm_spec.ent_id
   ,ent.ent_name
   ,qm_spec.item_id
   ,item.item_desc
   ,CASE
      WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
      WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
      WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
      WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
   END AS item_display
   ,qm_spec.item_category_id
   ,category.category_name AS item_category_name
   ,qm_spec.process_id
   ,qm_spec.oper_id
   ,qm_spec.category_id
   ,qm_spec.plan_id
   ,qm_spec.num_pts_per_page
   ,qm_spec.display_seq
   ,qm_spec.spare1
   ,qm_spec.spare2
   ,qm_spec.spare3
   ,qm_spec.spare4
   ,qm_spec.last_edit_comment
   ,qm_spec.last_edit_by
   ,qm_spec.last_edit_at
FROM qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.item_id = item.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN category WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.item_category_id = category.category_id
WHERE (
      (qm_spec.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id OR @qm_spec_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name OR @qm_spec_name IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.qm_spec_desc = @qm_spec_desc OR @qm_spec_desc IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.edit_level = @edit_level OR @edit_level IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.start_eff_utc >= @start_eff_utc OR @start_eff_utc IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.start_eff_local >= @start_eff_local OR @start_eff_local IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.end_eff_utc <= @end_eff_utc OR @end_eff_utc IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.end_eff_local <= @end_eff_local OR @end_eff_local IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.ent_id= @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.category_id = @category_id OR @category_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.plan_id = @plan_id OR @plan_id IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.num_pts_per_page = @num_pts_per_page OR @num_pts_per_page IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
      (qm_spec.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
     )
ORDER BY qm_spec.display_seq, qm_spec.qm_spec_name

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_wo_file_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[wo_file]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_file_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on wo_file table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE wo_file SET wo_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, wo_file.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

AS
BEGIN
	declare	@message nvarchar(max)

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2030) Update first_oper and final_oper flags in this table
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		INT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	IF @attr_value IS NULL SET @attr_value = 0
	DECLARE oper_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		    AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
	OPEN oper_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
--		EXEC sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags @process_id
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_d_ofi_lm_customer_info]  
	@row_id INT
	,@user NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_Customerinfo'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Printer'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@l INT =0
			,@smeRcdCnt INT=0
			,@new_cust_id  NVARCHAR(100)
			,@new_cust_path NVARCHAR(200)
			,@new_cust_info NVARCHAR(200)
			,@new_is_active INT
			,@new_content_type INT
			,@new_row_id INT			 
			,@resultset INT=1
			,@resultcode NVARCHAR(200)

	declare @custInfo as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	cust_name nvarchar(100),
	cust_path nvarchar(1000),
	cust_info nvarchar(1000),
	is_active int,
	type_of_content INT
	);

	declare @custInfo1 as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	cust_name nvarchar(100),
	cust_path nvarchar(1000),
	cust_info nvarchar(1000),
	is_active int,
	type_of_content INT
	);

	insert into @custInfo (row_id,cust_name,cust_path,cust_info,is_active,type_of_content)
	select ci.cust_row_id,ci.cust_name,ci.cust_img_path,ci.cust_info,ci.is_active,ci.type_of_content
	from ofi_lm_customer_info ci with(nolock)
	where cust_row_id=@row_id

   delete from ofi_lm_customer_info   
   WHERE cust_row_id=@row_id

   insert into @custInfo1 (row_id,cust_name,cust_path,cust_info,is_active,type_of_content)
	select ci.cust_row_id,ci.cust_name,ci.cust_img_path,ci.cust_info,ci.is_active,ci.type_of_content
	from ofi_lm_customer_info ci with(nolock)
	where cust_row_id=@row_id

	
	 --delete record
	select @delCnt=count(t1.cust_name) 
	from @custInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @custInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							from @custInfo1 t2 )
	while (@k < @delCnt)
	 BEGIN
	 SELECT  @new_row_id=t1.row_id
			,@new_cust_id=t1.cust_name
			,@new_cust_path=ISNULL(t1.cust_path,'-')
			,@new_cust_info=ISNULL(t1.cust_info,'-')
			,@new_is_active=t1.is_active
			,@new_content_type=t1.type_of_content
	from @custInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @custInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							from @custInfo1 t2 )
	order by t1.row_id
	OFFSET @k ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY	
	Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'cust_row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_name',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg))							

	set @strCommentMsg='For '+@new_cust_id+' _ ';
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @k = @k + 1;
	 END

END

-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Qm_Spec
-- Description	      - Deletes a row of the table qm_spec based on the qm_spec_id
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -	10/5/2010
-- Version	          - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--	04/04/2012		Ahmed		4.5	   When a QM_Spec is deleted set the regen_samples flag of db_status table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
IF EXISTS (SELECT top 1 sample_char_link.qm_spec_id FROM sample_char_link WHERE sample_char_link.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id)
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('There exist samples that use this QM specification so it may not be deleted.{7564}', 16, 1, @@error)
	RETURN -1
END
IF EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (select top 1 sample_char_link_to_go.qm_spec_id from sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) where sample_char_link_to_go.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
				END
	END

DELETE qm_spec
WHERE (qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetRunnableEntities]
(
	@ent_id	INT
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name						- sp_SA_Ent_GetRunnableEntities
-- Description						- Get Runnable Entities. Get a list of all runnable ent_id descendants in the entity tree,
--									  including the one passed in
-- Author							- Raghu
-- Date Created						- 10/02/2002
-- Version							-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 5/12/04			RG, KRF						Was only considering children of preferred parent
-- 07/11/07			AML				3.2.0		HD# 10033, Sort entity name across generations.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE	@child_level	INT
	SET @child_level = 0
	CREATE TABLE #tmp_tbl_runnableentities (ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80), child_level INT, can_run_jobs BIT)
	INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_runnableentities
		SELECT ent_id, ent_name, @child_level, can_run_jobs FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_runnableentities
			SELECT ent_id, ent_name, @child_level, can_run_jobs FROM ent e
			INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON  el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM #tmp_tbl_runnableentities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	END
	DELETE FROM #tmp_tbl_runnableentities WHERE can_run_jobs = 0
	SELECT ent_id, ent_name FROM #tmp_tbl_runnableentities ORDER BY ent_name -- 07/11/07 Added order by, AML
	DROP TABLE #tmp_tbl_runnableentities
END

CREATE Trigger [dbo].[tg_char_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[characteristic]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_char_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on characteristic table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Rich
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -  4.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--   06-Apr-2012   Ahmed		4.5		regen_samples flag of db_status has to be set when a future characteristic is updated
-- 06/27/2012	Prashanth		4.5	L00121066 - default sigma_est to 0
-- 07/05/2012	Manaswini		4.5		CRL00120951(set the regen flag upon the charname change)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE characteristic SET characteristic.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, characteristic.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE characteristic.char_id = i.char_id

	UPDATE characteristic SET characteristic.sigma_est = 0
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE characteristic.char_id = i.char_id AND characteristic.type = 0 AND characteristic.sigma_est IS NULL

	IF EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0)
		BEGIN
			--if the severity_cd is updating
			IF UPDATE(severity_cd)
			AND (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 inserted.severity_cd,deleted.severity_cd from INSERTED inner join DELETED ON(inserted.char_id=deleted.char_id)
															WHERE inserted.severity_cd <> 0 AND deleted.severity_cd = 0))
			OR (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 inserted.severity_cd,deleted.severity_cd from INSERTED inner join DELETED ON(inserted.char_id=deleted.char_id)
															WHERE inserted.severity_cd = 0 AND deleted.severity_cd <> 0 )
			AND EXISTS(SELECT top 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.char_id IN (select char_id from inserted)))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
			END

			--if the char_name changed or severity_cd changed from non-zero to zero set the regen_samples of db_status
			IF (UPDATE(char_name) AND (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 INSERTED.char_id from INSERTED INNER JOIN DELETED
			ON (INSERTED.char_id = DELETED.char_id) WHERE INSERTED.char_name <> DELETED.char_name)))
			BEGIN
					IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link_to_go.sample_id = sample_to_go.sample_id
						INNER JOIN sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_to_go.plan_id = sample_plan.plan_id
						WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.char_id IN (select char_id from inserted)
						AND CHARINDEX((SELECT char_name from deleted), sample_to_go.sample_name, 1) > 0)

						BEGIN
							UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
						END
				END
		END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GPL_GetPrivByGroups] (
@sids_xml 	nvarchar(max),
@priv_id 	INT32 = NULL
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_S_GPL_GetPrivByGroups
-- Description	  -	This method accepts a list of SIDs in an xml string that represent the OS groups to which the user
--					belong and optionally a privilege ID.  It looks up the SIDs in the Grp_Name table and returns
--					the maximum value in the Grp_Priv_Link table for the groups that match the supplied SIDs.  If
--					none of the SIDs match a group, then 0 is returned for the priv_value.  If a priv_id is supplied
--					then a single row for that privilege is returned, else a row for each
--					privilege.
--					EXAMPLE XML:
--						<sids>
--							<sid id="S-1-1-123"/>
--							<sid id="S-1-1-456"/>
--						</sids>
-- Author		  -	Rich Boyle
-- Date Created	  -	08/12/2014
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@doc_handle					INT32

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @sids_xml

	SELECT 	grp_priv_link.priv_id,
			COALESCE(MAX(x.priv_value), 0) AS priv_value
	FROM grp_priv_link grp_priv_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT priv_id, priv_value
		FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/sids/sid',2) WITH (id nvarchar(68) '@id') grp_sids
		INNER JOIN grp_name grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_sids.id = grp_name.sid
		INNER JOIN grp_priv_link grp_priv_link1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_priv_link1.grp_id = grp_name.grp_id
		WHERE ((grp_priv_link1.priv_id = @priv_id) OR (@priv_id IS NULL))) x ON grp_priv_link.priv_id = x.priv_id
	WHERE ((grp_priv_link.priv_id = @priv_id) OR (@priv_id IS NULL))
	GROUP BY grp_priv_link.priv_id

-- ==========================================================================================												
-- Name:			sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry									
-- Description:		Insert into MESDB.dbo.user_name and/or user_grp_link table										
-- Author:			AKM/AKP												
-- Usage:			Add the user if not avaialbe in the table 
-- V.1              Removed grp_id from filtering the sp
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry]	
	@user_id NVARCHAR(40) OUT
AS												
BEGIN			
	SET NOCOUNT ON;			
 
	DECLARE @mod_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @last_edit_at DATETIME
	DECLARE @grp_id INT
 
	DECLARE @grp_name TABLE
	(
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		grp_id INT,
		grp_desc NVARCHAR(80),
		auth_method INT
	)
 
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_User_Name] 
		   @user_id
		  ,NULL
		  ,'N.A.'
		  ,1
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,@mod_id OUTPUT
		  ,@last_edit_at OUTPUT
	END
 
	-- Get all the stored AD groups in MES and use it to loop thru and determine if the user is assigned to the group.
	-- In the case the user is assigned to the AD group it must exist in MES as well
	--IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @grp_id AND user_id = @user_id)
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  user_id = @user_id)
	BEGIN
			EXECUTE AS LOGIN = @user_id
			INSERT INTO @grp_name
			SELECT
				grp_id,
				grp_desc,
				auth_method
			FROM [dbo].grp_name(NOLOCK)
			WHERE auth_method = 2
			AND IS_MEMBER (grp_desc) = 1
			REVERT
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE AS LOGIN = @user_id
			INSERT INTO @grp_name
			SELECT
				grp_id,
				grp_desc,
				auth_method
			FROM [dbo].grp_name(NOLOCK)
			WHERE auth_method = 2
			AND IS_MEMBER (grp_desc) = 1
			REVERT
		delete from user_grp_link where user_id = @user_id and grp_id not in (select grp_id from @grp_name)
 
						
	END
 
	DECLARE 
		@max_rows INT,
		@cur_row INT = 1
 
	-- Loop the MES groups and insert if not linked in MES
--	SET @max_rows = @@ROWCOUNT			@@ROWCOUNT is always 1, count the rows in the table instead
	SELECT @max_rows = count(*) from @grp_name
 
  	WHILE (@cur_row <= @max_rows)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @grp_id = grp_id FROM @grp_name WHERE id = @cur_row
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @grp_id AND user_id = @user_id)
		BEGIN
		print @grp_id
		print @user_id
			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_User_Grp_Link] 
			   @grp_id
			  ,@user_id
			  ,NULL
			  ,@last_edit_at OUTPUT
		END
		SET @cur_row = @cur_row + 1
	END
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_RDBHourlyUtilization] AS
WITH SplitEvents (EventId, EventStart, EventSplitStart, EventSplitEnd, EventEnd, Eventtype, TotalEventDuration, shift_id, ent_id, shift_start_local, shift_start_utc, RunTime, DownTime, EventStartUtc, EventSplitStartUtc, EventSplitEndUtc) AS
	(SELECT [log_id]
		   ,[event_time_local]
		   ,[event_time_local]
		   ,DATEADD(hour,1,DATEADD(hour,DATEPART(hour,[event_time_local]),CAST(CAST([event_time_local] AS DATE) AS DATETIME2)))
		   ,DATEADD(second,[duration],[event_time_local])
		   ,case WHEN RunTime =1 and DownTime=0 THEN 'RunTime' WHEN DownTime=1 and RunTime=0 THEN 'DownTime' WHEN RunTime=0 and DownTime=0 then 'IdleTime' END as EventType
		   ,[duration]
		   ,shift_id
		   ,ent_id
		   ,shift_start_local
		   ,shift_start_utc
		   ,RunTime
		   ,DownTime
		   ,event_time_utc
		   ,event_time_utc
		   ,DATEADD(hour,1,DATEADD(hour,DATEPART(hour,[event_time_utc]),CAST(CAST([event_time_utc] AS DATE) AS DATETIME2)))
		FROM util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE duration < 100*60*60 -- Maximum duration is 100 hours (100 level of recursivity)
	 UNION ALL
	 SELECT EventId
		   ,EventStart
		   ,EventSplitEnd
		   ,DATEADD(hour,1,EventSplitEnd)
		   ,EventEnd
		   ,EventType
		   ,TotalEventDuration
		   ,SE.shift_id
		   ,Se.ent_id
		   ,Se.shift_start_local
		   ,Se.shift_start_utc
		   ,SE.RunTime
		   ,Se.DownTime
		   ,EventStartUtc
		   ,EventSplitEndUtc
		   ,DATEADD(hour,1,EventSplitEndUtc)
		FROM SplitEvents SE
			INNER JOIN util_log UL  WITH (NOLOCK) ON SE.ent_id = ul.ent_id AND se.EventStartUtc = ul.event_time_utc
		WHERE EventSplitEnd < EventEnd
	),
	SplitEvents2 AS
	(SELECT EventId
		  ,EventStart
		  ,EventEnd
		  ,TotalEventDuration
		  ,EventSplitStart
		  ,EventType
		  ,CASE WHEN EventSplitEnd > EventEnd THEN EventEnd ELSE EventSplitEnd END AS EventSplitEnd
		  ,shift_id
		   ,ent_id
		   ,shift_start_local
		   ,shift_start_utc
		   ,RunTime
		   ,DownTime
		   ,EventStartUtc
		   ,EventSplitStartUtc
		   ,EventSplitEndUtc
		FROM SplitEvents
	)
	SELECT EventId
		  ,EventStart
		  ,EventEnd
		  ,TotalEventDuration
		  ,EventSplitStart
		  ,EventSplitEnd
		  ,EventType
		   ,s2.shift_id Util_shift_id
  		 , case when s2.EventSplitStart > s2.shift_start_local then sh.shift_id else s2.shift_id end as shift_id
		   ,s2.ent_id
		   , CASE WHEN s2.EventSplitStart > s2.shift_start_local THEN sh.shift_start_local ELSE s2.shift_start_local END AS shift_start_local
		   , CASE WHEN s2.EventSplitStart > s2.shift_start_local THEN sh.shift_start_utc ELSE s2.shift_start_utc END AS shift_start_utc
		  ,DATEDIFF(second,EventSplitStart,EventSplitEnd) AS EventSplitDuration
		  ,CASE WHEN EventStart = EventSplitStart THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EventStarted
		  ,CASE WHEN EventEnd = EventSplitEnd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EventEnded
		  ,case WHEN RunTime =1 and DownTime=0 THEN DATEDIFF(second,EventSplitStart,EventSplitEnd) ELSE 0 END RunTimeDuration
		  ,case WHEN DownTime=1 and RunTime=0 THEN DATEDIFF(second,EventSplitStart,EventSplitEnd) else 0 end DownTimeDuration
		  ,case WHEN RunTime=0 and DownTime=0 then DATEDIFF(second,EventSplitStart,EventSplitEnd) else 0 end IdleTimeDuration
		  ,RunTime
		  ,DownTime
		  , lel.line_id
		  ,EventStartUtc
		  ,EventSplitStartUtc
		  ,EventSplitEndUtc
		FROM SplitEvents2 s2
		left outer join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)  on s2.ent_id=e.ent_id
		left outer join line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) on lel.ent_id=e.ent_id
		left outer join shift_history sh  WITH (NOLOCK) on s2.ent_id=sh.ent_id and
		s2.EventSplitStart between sh.shift_start_local and ISNULL(sh.shift_end_local, GETDATE())
		--ORDER By EventId, EventSplitStart

-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch silo details for source/destination for stock
--				Trasfer--

--EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_step_details_stock_trasfer] 541,1

-- 0.01 	AP				2022-12-22			Initial version.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_step_details_stock_trasfer]
(
	@ent_id INT --= NULL  
  , @row_id INT
  , @tabindex INT
)
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @set_source      INT = 0
		  , @set_destination INT = 0
		  , @set_quantity    NVARCHAR(40) ='0'

SELECT
		@set_source = ISNULL(src_su_ent_id, 0)
	  , @set_destination = ISNULL(dest_su_ent_id, 0)
	  , @set_quantity =ISNULL(st_transfer_type, '0')
	FROM Ofi_st_trans_selection
	WHERE
		ent_id = @ent_id
		AND row_id = @row_id;
		if(@tabindex=0 or @tabindex=1)
		begin
		set @set_destination=0;
		set @set_quantity=0;
		end
		if( @tabindex=2)
		begin		
		set @set_quantity=0;
		end

	SELECT
		@set_source = ISNULL(src_su_ent_id, 0)
	  , @set_destination = ISNULL(@set_destination, 0)
	  , @set_quantity =ISNULL(@set_quantity, '0')
	FROM Ofi_st_trans_selection
	WHERE
		ent_id = @ent_id
		AND row_id = @row_id;	
		
	WITH cte
		 AS (SELECT
				 'Set Source' AS    step_name
			   , CASE
					 WHEN @set_source = 0
					 THEN 0
					 ELSE 4
				 END AS             state_cd
			   , 1 AS               step_no
			   , 0 AS               spare1
			   , '@@SetSource@@' AS step_name_localized
			 UNION
			 SELECT
				 'Set Destination' AS    step_name
			   , CASE
					 WHEN @set_destination = 0
					 THEN 0
					 ELSE 4
				 END AS                  state_cd
			   , 2 AS                    step_no
			   , 1 AS                    spare1
			   , '@@SetDestination@@' AS step_name_localized
			 UNION
			 SELECT
				 'Set Quantity' AS    step_name
			   , CASE
					 WHEN @set_quantity = '0'
					 THEN 0
					 ELSE 4
				 END AS               state_cd
			   , 3 AS                 step_no
			   , 2 AS                 spare1
			   , '@@SetQuantity@@' AS step_name_localized)
		 SELECT
			 *
		 FROM cte
		 ORDER BY
			 step_no

END

CREATE   Trigger [tg_oper_item_spec_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_item_spec]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_item_spec_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_item_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
-- Author	 	        -- Sara
-- Date Created      	-- 12/01/2009
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_item_spec_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_item_spec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_item_spec_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_item_spec', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_item_spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_item_spec_cursor
END

-- Author:		PG
-- Create date: 06-JAN-2023
-- Description:	Get stock transfer mapping list for a given line.
--				This SP is using/calling from ArchestrA stock transfer object.
--
--	EXEC sp_SA_ofi_stock_transfer_data 'NT_BMO_ST',-1
-- =======================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_stock_transfer_data] 
	@line_name nvarchar(80),
	@storage_unit_type int = -1		-- -1 = retrieves all source and destination.  0 = get all source units.  1 = get all destination units
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON ;

  DECLARE @line_ent_id AS int ;

  SELECT
    @line_ent_id = ent_id
  FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_name = @line_name ;

  SELECT
    @line_ent_id AS line_id,
    st.storage_ent_id AS su_id,
	e.ent_name AS ent_name,
    [type] AS ent_type
  FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping st WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e  WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = st.storage_ent_id
  WHERE st.ent_id = @line_ent_id
  AND LOWER([type]) =
                     CASE
                       WHEN @storage_unit_type = -1 THEN LOWER([type])
                       WHEN @storage_unit_type = 0 THEN 'source'
                       WHEN @storage_unit_type = 1 THEN 'destination'
                     END ;

 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetReqdSignoffs]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(80),
 @oper_id	NVARCHAR(80),
 @step_no	INT = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetReqdCertSignoffs
-- Description    - To return a recordset containing details of all certifications
--			        that require signoff for a given job and / or step.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 01/03/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/15/2004	Raghu		2.1.1	If step_no = -1, then it returns all certifications available for a step
--05/07/2014	Ibrahim		5.0		User Story# 316395: As Invensys, I want to merge L00130974 (HF CR L00129625 certs and standard operations).
--12/07/2017	Varun		6.0		Merge CR L00147330 (HF L00146188): Reverted HF L00129625 merge and added union to cert_job_step_link.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE	@process_id		NVARCHAR(40)

	SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	IF (@step_no IS NULL)
		SELECT a.process_id, a.oper_id, b.cert_name, NULL 'step_no', b.num_signoffs_reqd
			, b.signoff_notes, b.comments_reqd, b.avail_to_oper, b.avail_to_oper_step
		FROM cert_oper_link a WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN cert_type b WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.cert_name = b.cert_name
			AND a.process_id = @process_id
			AND a.oper_id = @oper_id
	ELSE IF (@step_no = -1)
		SELECT cosl.process_id, cosl.oper_id, ct.cert_name, cosl.step_no, ct.num_signoffs_reqd
			, ct.signoff_notes, ct.comments_reqd, ct.avail_to_oper, ct.avail_to_oper_step
		FROM cert_oper_step_link cosl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cosl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
		INNER JOIN wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON cosl.process_id = wo.process_id
		WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id AND cosl.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND ct.cert_audit = 1
	UNION
		SELECT @process_id, cjsl.oper_id, ct.cert_name, cjsl.step_no, ct.num_signoffs_reqd
			, ct.signoff_notes, ct.comments_reqd, ct.avail_to_oper, ct.avail_to_oper_step
		FROM cert_job_step_link cjsl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cjsl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
		WHERE cjsl.wo_id = @wo_id AND cjsl.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND ct.cert_audit = 1
	ELSE
		SELECT cosl.process_id, cosl.oper_id, ct.cert_name, cosl.step_no, ct.num_signoffs_reqd
			, ct.signoff_notes, ct.comments_reqd, ct.avail_to_oper, ct.avail_to_oper_step
		FROM cert_oper_step_link cosl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cosl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
		WHERE cosl.process_id = @process_id
			AND cosl.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND cosl.step_no = @step_no
END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2030) Update first_oper and final_oper flags in this table
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--10/23/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,@assoc_file_type STRING20
	,@assoc_file STRING254
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF @attr_value IS NULL SET @attr_value = 0

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper op, inserted i WHERE op.process_id = i.process_id AND op.oper_id = i.oper_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Make sure the assoc_file_type is set to the extension for the assoc_file
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.process_id = d.process_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id
		WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) BEGIN

		IF Exists(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM inserted i
			WHERE i.assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		UPDATE oper SET assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(x.assoc_file)
		FROM (SELECT i.assoc_file, i.process_id, i.oper_id
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.process_id = d.process_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE oper.process_id = x.process_id AND oper.oper_id = x.oper_id

		INSERT INTO file_type
		(file_ext, edit_level, view_level, print_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT x.file_ext, 1, 1, 1, @user_id, @last_edit_at
		FROM (SELECT dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) as file_ext
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.process_id = d.process_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE x.file_ext IS NOT NULL AND x.file_ext NOT IN (SELECT file_ext FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK))
	END

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper op, inserted i WHERE op.process_id = i.process_id AND op.oper_id = i.oper_id) opr
	WHERE process.process_id = opr.process_id

	UPDATE oper SET oper.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper.process_id = i.process_id AND oper.oper_id = i.oper_id

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_d_ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping
-- Description:	Delete mapping record
--
-- Usage:	Delete mapping record
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-01			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-09-11			Audit trail 
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_d_ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@row_id int
	,@user_id NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_LayoutMapping'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = ''
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@layout_name NVARCHAR(100)

	declare @new_record_title nvarchar(200),
			@new_actual_value nvarchar(200),
			@new_default_value nvarchar(200),
			@new_min_length INT,
			@new_max_length INT,
			@new_pattern nvarchar(200),
			@new_editable bit,
			@new_as_value nvarchar(200),
			@new_tableName nvarchar(200),
			@new_row_id INT

			declare @layouttableinfo as table (
			rowSeq int identity(1,1),
			row_id INT,
			record_title nvarchar(200),
			actual_value nvarchar(200),
			default_value nvarchar(200),
			min_length INT,
			max_length INT,
			pattern nvarchar(200),
			editable bit,
			as_value nvarchar(200),
			tableName nvarchar(200),
			layoutName nvarchar(200)
			);

			declare @layouttableinfo1 as table (
			rowSeq int identity(1,1),
			row_id INT,
			record_title nvarchar(200),
			actual_value nvarchar(200),
			default_value nvarchar(200),
			min_length INT,
			max_length INT,
			pattern nvarchar(200),
			editable bit,
			as_value nvarchar(200),
			tableName nvarchar(200),
			layoutName nvarchar(200)
			);

	select @layout_name= ollam.layout_name
	from ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping ollam with(nolock)
	where ollam.row_id=@row_id

	insert into @layouttableinfo (row_id,record_title,actual_value,default_value,min_length,max_length,pattern,editable,as_value,tableName,layoutName)
	select ollam.row_id,ollam.record_title,ollam.actual_value,ollam.default_value,ollam.min_length,ollam.max_length,ollam.pattern,ollam.editable,ollam.as_value,ollam.tableName,ollam.layout_name
	from ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping ollam with(nolock)
	where ollam.layout_name=@layout_name


	
	
	DELETE FROM ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping
	WHERE row_id=@row_id

	insert into @layouttableinfo1 (row_id,record_title,actual_value,default_value,min_length,max_length,pattern,editable,as_value,tableName,layoutName)
	select ollam.row_id,ollam.record_title,ollam.actual_value,ollam.default_value,ollam.min_length,ollam.max_length,ollam.pattern,ollam.editable,ollam.as_value,ollam.tableName,ollam.layout_name
	from ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping ollam with(nolock)
	where ollam.layout_name=@layout_name


	
 --delete record
 select @delCnt=count(t1.layoutName) 
from @layouttableinfo t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @layouttableinfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						from @layouttableinfo1 t2 )
while (@k < @delCnt)
 BEGIN
 SELECT  @new_row_id=t1.row_id
		from @layouttableinfo t1
		FULL OUTER JOIN @layouttableinfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @layouttableinfo1 t2 )
 order by t1.row_id
 OFFSET @k ROWS   
 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

 Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
 set @strCommentMsg='For '+@layout_name+' _ ';
 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id))							
							,(@new_row_id,'record_title',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg))
	
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @k = @k + 1;
 END




END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Result_Attr]
  (@sample_id int ,
   @char_id int,
   @value_no int,
   @attr_id  int = NULL,
   @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
  )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    -
-- Description    - Selects a row in the table.
-- Author         -
-- Date Created   -  4/26/2011
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 01/22/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 11

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT result_attr.sample_id
    ,result_attr.char_id
    ,result_attr.value_no
    ,result_attr.attr_id
    ,result_attr.attr_value
    ,result_attr.notes
    ,result_attr.last_edit_comment
    ,result_attr.last_edit_by
    ,result_attr.last_edit_at
FROM result_attr result_attr
WHERE (result_attr.sample_id = @sample_id AND
       result_attr.char_id = @char_id AND
       result_attr.value_no =@value_no AND
       result_attr.attr_id = @attr_id);
END

BEGIN
	DECLARE @ent_id				INT32

	EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetSchedulableEntity @ent_id OUTPUT

	SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name, @site_name = ste.site_name
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	--ID of ancestor entity that defines site of this entity; if = ent_id, this entity is a site.
	--Null for entities above sites, or for single-site systems
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.site = site_ent.ent_id
	--Name of this site
	LEFT OUTER JOIN site ste WITH (NOLOCK) ON ste.ent_id = site_ent.ent_id
	WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

END

-- ===================================================================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_SA_ofi_GetEntitiesForPalletCons]
-- Description:Handheld Pallet Consumption
-- ===================================================================================================================================
-- Version	Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change Description
-- 0.0.1    AML, XPM    2026-02-09           Initial version
-- 0.0.2    AML, XPM    2026-02-10           Updated the domain for the user 
-- ===================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetEntitiesForPalletCons]
    @user nvarchar(100),
    @type nvarchar(20),
    @ent_id int = NULL 
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
    DECLARE @domain NVARCHAR(100)
    SELECT @domain = DEFAULT_DOMAIN()
    
   
    IF @user NOT LIKE '%\%'
        SET @user = @domain + '\' + @user;

    DECLARE  @UserAccess TABLE (ent_id INT, ent_name nvarchar(100), can_sched INT, can_run INT, can_util INT, can_labor INT, can_dnc INT, can_stre INT, can_log INT, parent_id INT, access_lvl INT);
    
    INSERT INTO @UserAccess
    EXEC sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id = @user;

    
    IF @type = 'GetEntities'
    BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT
            e.ent_id, 
            e.ent_name AS display_name,
            ea.attr_value AS scannable_id 
        FROM ent e
        INNER JOIN @UserAccess ua ON e.ent_id = ua.ent_id
        INNER JOIN ent_attr ea ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
        INNER JOIN attr a_ent ON ea.attr_id = a_ent.attr_id
        INNER JOIN job j ON j.run_ent_id = e.ent_id 
        INNER JOIN wo w ON w.wo_id = j.wo_id 
        INNER JOIN process_attr pa ON pa.process_id = w.process_id
        INNER JOIN attr a_proc ON pa.attr_id = a_proc.attr_id
        WHERE a_ent.attr_desc = 'ScannableId'        
          AND a_proc.attr_desc = 'AllowPalletConsumption' 
          AND pa.attr_value = '1'                                         
          AND ua.access_lvl = 1;       
    END

    -- 3. GET WOs 
    IF @type = 'GetWOs'
    BEGIN
        SELECT 
            j.wo_id, 
            j.wo_id + ' (' + i.item_desc + ')' AS wo_display
        FROM job j
        INNER JOIN item i ON j.item_id = i.item_id
        WHERE j.run_ent_id = @ent_id 
          AND j.state_cd = 3; 
    END
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_RDBUtilization] AS
SELECT util_log.log_id
      , util_log.event_time_utc
	  , util_log.event_time_local
	  , util_log.ent_id
	  , util_log.shift_id
	  , util_log.shift_start_utc
      , util_log.shift_start_local
	  , util_log.state_cd
	  , util_log.reas_cd
	  , util_log.reas_pending
	  , util_log.runtime
	  , util_log.downtime
      , util_log.setuptime
	  , util_log.teardowntime
	  , util_log.fixedtime
	  , util_log.vartime
      , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime =1 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN 'RunTime' WHEN util_log.downtime=1 and util_log.runtime=0 THEN 'DownTime'
             WHEN util_log.runtime=0 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN 'IdleTime' END AS EventType
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime=1 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN util_log.duration ELSE 0 END RuntimeDuration
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime=0 and util_log.downtime=1 THEN util_log.duration ELSE 0 END DowntimeDuration
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime=0 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN util_log.duration ELSE 0 END IdletimeDuration
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.downtime = 1 THEN N'Availability Loss'
			 WHEN util_log.runtime = 1  THEN N'Performance Loss'
			 ELSE N'Idle' END AS LossType
      , util_log.category1,  util_log.category2, util_log.category3, util_log.category4, util_log.failure, util_reas.reas_grp_id, util_reas.ent_enabled
      , util_log.raw_reas_cd, util_log.duration AS duration, util_log.last_edit_by, util_log.comments
      , job.wo_id, job.oper_id,job.seq_no
      , item.item_id, item.num_decimals, item.uom_id
	  , l.line_id, l.line_name
	  , prh.est_prod_rate prod_rate,  ue.target_util
	  , oe.std_item_id ,oe.target_oee ,oe.target_perf,oe.target_qual
	  , util_log.last_edit_at
	  , ent.ent_name
	  , ent.description
FROM util_log util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no, jh.item_id
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
	  AND jh.job_start_utc = (SELECT MIN(jh1.job_start_utc)
	  			FROM job_history jh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	  			WHERE jh1.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
	  			  AND COALESCE(jh1.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_time_utc
				  AND jh1.job_start_utc < util_log.event_end_time_utc)
	  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_time_utc) jull
LEFT OUTER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON jull.wo_id = job.wo_id AND  jull.oper_id = job.oper_id AND jull.seq_no = job.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON  jull.item_id = item.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON  util_log.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN prod_rate_history prh WITH (NOLOCK) on prh.ent_id=util_log.ent_id and util_log.event_time_local >= prh.start_time_local and util_log.event_time_local < ISNULL(prh.end_time_local,GETDATE())
LEFT OUTER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) on util_log.ent_id=lel.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN line l WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id=lel.line_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON  ue.ent_id= util_log.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.util_ent_id=util_log.ent_id

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_item_spec_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_item_spec]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		    -- tg_oper_item_spec_aft_ins
-- Description          -- Trigger on oper_item_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
-- Author	 	        -- Sara
-- Date Created      	-- 12/01/2009
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_item_spec_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_item_spec a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		      AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		      AND a.step_no = b.step_no
		      AND a.item_id = b.item_id
              AND a.item_class_id = b.item_class_id
		      AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
		      AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id
	OPEN oper_item_spec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_item_spec_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_item_spec', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_item_spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_item_spec_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_stock_transfer_overview] 
	 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--VARIABLE DECLARATION
	DECLARE @enableTransferAttr varchar(80)='Enable_stock_transfer'
	DECLARE @transferRunning varchar(80)='RUNNING'
	DECLARE @transferStatusCdRunning INT=0

	--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE
	SELECT @transferStatusCdRunning=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@transferRunning

	--GET MAPPING DATA INTO CTE
 ;WITH Grid_rec as(
SELECT stm.ent_id
        ,e.ent_name
        ,ISNULL(e.description,e.ent_name) AS description
        ,stm.storage_ent_id
        ,e2.ent_name as StorageEntity
        ,stm.type
        ,stm.item_group
        ,stm.last_edit_by
        ,stm.last_edit_at_local

        ,stm.row_id
    FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping stm WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = stm.ent_id
    INNER JOIN ent e2 WITH(NOLOCK)ON e2.ent_id = stm.storage_ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea with(nolock) on e.ent_id=ea.ent_id
	INNER JOIN attr a with(nolock) on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
	where a.attr_desc=@enableTransferAttr and ea.attr_value='1'),

	--CHECK LINE STATUS AND ATTACH TO GRID DATASET
	cte_status as ( select distinct ent_id, 1 as [RowDisable] from Ofi_st_trans_selection WITH(NOLOCK) where transfer_status_cd=@transferStatusCdRunning and is_active=1 )
	
    
	--SELECT FINAL DATA SET
   select 
		 GR.ent_id
        ,GR.ent_name
        ,GR.description 
        ,GR.storage_ent_id
        ,GR.StorageEntity 
        ,GR.type
        ,GR.item_group
        ,GR.last_edit_by
        ,GR.last_edit_at_local
        ,GR.last_edit_at_utc
        ,GR.row_id
        , ISNULL(SC.[RowDisable],0) as rowDisable
   from Grid_rec GR
   left join cte_status SC on GR.ent_id=SC.ent_id
  


 END

-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 10/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/02/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8314 & 9154, part of DB changes - set sublot_no to job_exec's default, and extract
--									info about job differently due to fields removed from util_log.  Ignore step - HD# 5111
--									does not require it.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 08/09/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @wo_id 					NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@oper_id				NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@seq_no					INT
	--	,	@step_no				INT
		,	@item_id				NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@lot_no					NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@sublot_no				NVARCHAR(40)

		,	@event_time_utc			DATETIME

	SELECT	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
		,	@event_time_local = COALESCE( @event_time_local, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
		,	@current_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

	--EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_local, @tz_temp, @event_time_utc OUTPUT


	SELECT @util_event_time_utc = MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK)

	SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = jh.wo_id, @oper_id = jh.oper_id, @seq_no = jh.seq_no, @item_id = jh.item_id
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)

	WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id

			shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, shift_id, ent_id, value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6,

			@shift_start_local, @shift_id, @ent_id, @value1, @value2, @value3, @value4, @value5, @value6, @value7,

			@last_edit_at

	ELSE

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetRunningJobs]
(@ent_id		INT32
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetRunningJobs
-- Description       - UserStory: 245880 - Return the jobs that are running on this entity.
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 10/23/2013
-- Version           - 5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
--  2/26/2014      SLR          5.0  Add num_decimals and num_decimal_good_pp to the return dataset
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	SELECT j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.item_id,j.state_cd,j.job_priority
		,j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, j.req_finish_time_utc AS req_finish_time
		,j.init_sched_ent_id
		,j.target_sched_ent_id,j.run_ent_id,j.qty_reqd,j.qty_prod,j.qty_prod_erp,j.qty_rejected,j.qty_rejected_erp,j.qty_at_start
		,j.deviation_above,j.deviation_below,j.batch_size,j.first_job,j.final_job,j.sched_pinned,j.check_inv,j.est_fixed_lab
		,j.est_lab_rate,j.est_setup_time,j.est_teardown_time,j.est_prod_rate,j.est_transfer_time
		,j.sched_start_time_utc,j.sched_start_time_local, j.sched_start_time_utc AS sched_start_time
		,j.latest_start_time_utc,j.latest_start_time_local,j.latest_start_time_utc AS latest_start_time
		,j.sched_finish_time_utc,j.sched_finish_time_local, j.sched_finish_time_utc AS sched_finish_time
		,j.act_start_time_utc,j.act_start_time_local, j.act_start_time_utc AS act_start_time
		,j.act_finish_time_utc,j.act_finish_time_local, j.act_finish_time_utc AS act_finish_time
		,j.concurrent_link,j.job_cost,j.parent_contingent_job,j.child_contingent_job,j.notes,j.assoc_file,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(j.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
		,j.status_notes,j.display_seq,j.folder_ver_id,j.rework,j.spare1,j.spare2,j.spare3,j.spare4,j.last_edit_comment
		,j.edited_by,j.edit_time,j.row_id,wo.wo_desc,wo.req_qty,wo.mo_id,i.item_desc,js.state_desc,js.color,e.ent_name
		,runent.ent_name as run_ent_name,i.spare1 item_spare1,i.spare2 item_spare2,i.spare3 item_spare3,i.spare4 item_spare4
		,i.lifetime,i.num_decimals
		,(SELECT CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr where attr_id = 326) as num_decimals_good_pp
        ,uom.description,uom.abbreviation,jb.def_lot_no,wo.process_id
		,qia.*, qja.*
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=wo.wo_id
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id=i.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd=js.state_cd
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id=e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent runent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id=runent.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id=jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no=jb.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos=0
	LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia WITH (NOLOCK) ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h=j.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja WITH (NOLOCK) ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h=j.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h=j.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h=j.seq_no
	WHERE j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND j.state_cd = 3
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetSchedParents]
(
	@ent_id int
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetSchedParents
-- Description					- Base Procedure copied from sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetQueue
-- Date Created					- 3/13/2003
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 09/05/2003		Raghu			1.6.22		(HD# 386) Re-written this sp to cater different groups with same entities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @child_level INT

CREATE TABLE #Ent_IDs
(
	ent_id int,
	ent_name varchar(80),
	description varchar(80),
	child_level INT
)

SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @child_level = 1
INSERT INTO #ent_ids SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description, @child_level FROM ent e WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
SET @child_level = 2

WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #ent_ids
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description, @child_level
		FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE  e.can_sched_jobs = 1  AND el.child_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM #ent_ids WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
	IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
END
SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ent_name, description, child_level FROM #Ent_IDs ORDER BY child_level
DROP TABLE #Ent_IDs
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_reject_data]
AS
SELECT item_prod.wo_id,
       item_prod.oper_id,
       item_prod.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.qty_reqd,
       item_prod.shift_start_utc,
       item_prod.shift_start_local,
       item_prod.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       item.item_class_id,
       item_class.item_class_desc,
       item_prod.lot_no,
       item_prod.sublot_no,
       item_prod.reas_cd,
       item_reas.reas_desc,
       item_reas.reas_grp_id,
       item_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,
       item_prod.user_id,
       user_name.user_desc,
       item_prod.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       item_prod.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       item_prod.grade_cd,
       item_grade.item_grade_desc,
       item_grade.color grade_color,
       item_prod.status_cd,
       item_state.item_status_desc,
       item_state.color status_color,
       item_prod.to_ent_id,
       to_ent.ent_name to_ent_name,
       item_prod.good_prod,
       item_prod.qty_prod,
       item_prod.processed_flag,
       item_prod.byproduct,
       item_prod.move_status,
       item_prod.spare1,
       item_prod.spare2,
       item_prod.spare3,
       item_prod.spare4
FROM item_prod item_prod
INNER JOIN job job ON item_prod.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
                    item_prod.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
                    item_prod.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN item item ON item_prod.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas ON
   item_prod.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
   item_prod.user_id = user_name.user_id
INNER JOIN ent ent ON item_prod.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN shift shift ON item_prod.shift_id = shift.shift_id INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
   item_prod.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
   item_prod.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent to_ent ON
   item_prod.to_ent_id = to_ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON
   item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
INNER JOIN item_reas_grp item_reas_grp ON
   item_reas.reas_grp_id = item_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
WHERE item_prod.good_prod = '0'

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ui_conf_getconfordefdata]
(
	@screen          STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@sectn           STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@parameter       STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@config_id       STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by    STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at    TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_UI_CONF_GETCONFORDEFDATA
-- Description          - Returns the ui_config data if exists for the supplied config id; otherwise return the
                        -- data from ui_config_default
-- Author          -    Raghu
-- Date Created          -   05/11/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.12
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Version Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @row_count AS INT

    --Verify whether a valid config_id is supplied.
    IF (@config_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --The supplied config_id is null; move to no_data_found block to retrieve ui_config_default value.
        SELECT @row_count = 1 FROM job_state WHERE state_cd = -98765
    END

    --Verify whether there are any configuration data for the supplied config_id.
    SELECT @row_count = 1 FROM ui_config
    WHERE config_id = @config_id
      AND screen = @screen
      AND sectn = @sectn
      AND parameter = @parameter
      AND (last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
      AND (last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)

    IF ( ( @row_count IS NOT NULL ) AND ( @row_count > 0 ) ) BEGIN

		--Yes, we do find a valid ui_config record for the supplied configuration id.
		--Return a dataset of all ui_config values for the supplied config_id.
		SELECT	ui_config.config_id
			,	ui_config.screen
			,	ui_config.sectn
			,	ui_config.parameter
			,	ui_config.valu
			,	ui_config.last_edit_comment
			,	ui_config.last_edit_by
			,	ui_config.last_edit_at
		FROM ui_config WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE config_id = @config_id
		  AND screen = @screen
		  AND sectn = @sectn
		  AND parameter = @parameter
		  AND (last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
		  AND (last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)

    END ELSE BEGIN

        --The ui_config data for the supplied config_id is not found.
        --Return a dataset of default ui_config data.
		SELECT	ui_config_default.screen
            ,	ui_config_default.sectn
            ,	ui_config_default.parameter
            ,	ui_config_default.valu
            ,	ui_config_default.last_edit_comment
            ,	ui_config_default.last_edit_by
            ,	ui_config_default.last_edit_at
        FROM ui_config_default ui_config_default
        WHERE screen = @screen
          AND sectn = @sectn
          AND parameter = @parameter
          AND (last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
          AND (last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	END

END
