CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_job_setconcurrentlnknoxml]
(
	@xml_source			NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,	@concurrent_link_no int32 OUTPUT

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_U_JOB_SETCONCURRENTLNKNOXML
-- Description          - Raghu
-- Author          - HD# 5933, Set the concurrent link no for the supplied job and return the last edit at date and time
-- Date Created          - 09/06/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.28
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver    Changes
-- 01/17/2008		aml			3.4.0	Converted to Sql Server from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @doc_handle AS INT32, @row_id AS INT32

	--DECLARE @xml_source NVARCHAR(4000)

	EXEC sp_sa_job_getavailconcurlinkno @concurrent_link_no OUTPUT

	--Convert the input xml to XML Type.
	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Get a list of nodes that contains the 'row_id' element.
	DECLARE row_id_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN row_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE row_id END AS row_id
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/row_id', 2)
	WITH (row_id INT '.')

	OPEN row_id_cursor
	--Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

		FETCH NEXT FROM row_id_cursor INTO @row_id

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--SELECT @row_id

		EXEC sp_u_job_setconcurrentlinkno @row_id, @concurrent_link_no

	END

	CLOSE row_id_cursor
	DEALLOCATE row_id_cursor

    --Destroy the instance.
    EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_item_spec_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_item_spec]
AFTER UPDATE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_item_spec_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_item_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
-- Author	 	-- Sara
-- Date Created      	-- 12/01/2009
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@step_no		INT
	,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40)
        ,@item_class_id         NVARCHAR(40)
	,@spec_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@spec_value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@min_value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@max_value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@data_type		INT
	,@V_Oper_Id      STRING40
	,@V_Spec_Ver_Id  STRING40
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32
	,@assoc_file		STRING254
	,@assoc_file_type STRING20
	,@ftle				DATETIME

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	DECLARE oper_item_spec_cursor CURSOR LOCAL for
	  SELECT b.process_id, b.oper_id, b.step_no, b.item_id, b.item_class_id, b.ver_id, b.spec_id, spec.data_type, b.spec_value, b.min_value, b.max_value, b.assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(b.assoc_file)
	   FROM oper_item_spec a, inserted b, spec spec
	    WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
	      AND ISNULL(a.item_id, '') = ISNULL(b.item_id, '') AND ISNULL(a.item_class_id, '') = ISNULL(b.item_class_id, '') AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id
	     AND b.spec_id = spec.spec_id
	OPEN oper_item_spec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_item_spec_cursor INTO @process_id, @V_Oper_Id, @step_no, @item_id, @item_class_id, @V_Spec_Ver_Id, @spec_id,
				@data_type, @spec_value, @min_value, @max_value, @assoc_file, @assoc_file_type

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_item_spec', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF (@data_type = 1) BEGIN
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@spec_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},spec_value', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@min_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},min_value', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@max_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},max_value', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND @assoc_file_type IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

                --update spec version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF (@use_GMT = 1) SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

                UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )
WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND ver_id = @V_Spec_Ver_Id

	  UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id

	  UPDATE oper_item_spec SET assoc_file_type = @assoc_file_type, oper_item_spec.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_item_spec.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	  WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND step_no = @step_no AND (item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND (item_class_id = @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL)
	        AND ver_id = @V_Spec_Ver_Id AND spec_id = @spec_id

	IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
			, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
			, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
	END

	END
	CLOSE oper_item_spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_item_spec_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Data_Log_Value]
  (@grp_id int ,
   @value_index int ,
   @value_name nvarchar(80) ,
   @value_type int ,
   @editable bit ,
   @cur_value nvarchar(80) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40),
   @meaning int,
   @meaning_to_value_index int,
   @spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
UPDATE data_log_value
SET value_name = @value_name,
    value_type = @value_type,
    editable = @editable,
    cur_value = @cur_value,
    spec_id = @spec_id,
    meaning = @meaning,
    meaning_to_value_index = @meaning_to_value_index,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Delete_Resource_Group]  -- obsolete
(
@res_grp_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @res_grp_desc nvarchar(50),
	@message nvarchar(max)
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @res_grp_desc = res_grp_desc from sdb.SCH.res_grp
		delete from sdb.SCH.res_grp where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
		set @message = CONCAT('successfully deleted location ' , @res_grp_desc)

	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to delete location ' , @res_grp_desc)
		
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'

(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@window_id	INT = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-- sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetSchedulableEntities
-- Description       		-- (HD# 2012, 2030). Get all descendant Schedulable Entities
-- Author	 		-- Raghu
-- Date Created      		-- 12/12/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 08/22/2005	Raghu		2.1.26	HD# 6203, Limit Schedulable entities depending upon system parameter.
-- 08/23/2005	Raghu		2.1.26	HD# ?, Limit Schedulable entities depending upon system parameter.
--					Added window_id (defaults to 0, jobs window) to limit schedulable entities.
-- 09/16/2005	Rich			Added order by ent_name to the query
--01/20/2006	Raghu		3.1.8	Modified to return the complete entity tree and its tree path for Supervisor
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
	can_sched_jobs BIT, parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))

DECLARE @tbl_schedparents TABLE(ent_id INT, can_sched_jobs INT, child_level INT)

DECLARE  @child_level			INT32
	,@ent_id			INT32
	,@root_ent_id  			INT32
	,@process_id			STRING80
	,@limit_schedulable_ents	NVARCHAR(1)

	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_sched_jobs, parent_ent_id, child_level)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_sched_jobs, NULL, @child_level FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @child_level = 2

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_sched_jobs, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_sched_jobs, el.parent_ent_id, @child_level
				,x.ent_tree
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END
	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

	IF (@window_id = 0)
		SELECT @limit_schedulable_ents = attr_value FROM system_attr
		WHERE attr_id = 218
	ELSE
		SELECT @limit_schedulable_ents = attr_value FROM system_attr
		WHERE attr_id = 328

	IF (@limit_schedulable_ents = '1') BEGIN

		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id) BEGIN
			UPDATE @entities SET can_sched_jobs = 0

			DECLARE cursor_schedentities CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT ent_id FROM oper_ent_link  WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id

			SET @child_level = 0
			OPEN cursor_schedentities
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_schedentities INTO @ent_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				INSERT INTO @tbl_schedparents (ent_id, can_sched_jobs, child_level)
				SELECT ent_id, can_sched_jobs, @child_level FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
					INSERT INTO @tbl_schedparents (ent_id, can_sched_jobs, child_level)
					SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.can_sched_jobs, @child_level
					FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
					INNER JOIN @tbl_schedparents parent_ents ON el.parent_ent_id = parent_ents.ent_id
					WHERE child_level = @child_level -1
					IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
				END
			END
			CLOSE cursor_schedentities
			DEALLOCATE cursor_schedentities

			UPDATE @entities SET can_sched_jobs = 1
			FROM @entities e, @tbl_schedparents sched_parents
			WHERE e.ent_id = sched_parents.ent_id AND sched_parents.can_sched_jobs = 1
--			WHERE ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @tbl_schedparents WHERE can_sched_jobs = 1)
		END
	END

	SELECT el.root_ent_id, el.ent_id, el.ent_name, el.can_sched_jobs, el.parent_ent_id,
		e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.child_level, el.ent_tree FROM @entities el
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
	ORDER BY el.child_level, e.ent_name, el.ent_name

/*
DECLARE @tmp_tbl_schedentities TABLE (ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80), description NVARCHAR(80),
			parent_ent_id INT, can_sched_jobs INT, child_level INT, parent_ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
			parent_description NVARCHAR(80))
DECLARE @tbl_schedparents TABLE(ent_id INT, can_sched_jobs INT, child_level INT)

DECLARE	 @child_level			INT32
	,@ent_id			INT32
	,@process_id			STRING80
	,@limit_schedulable_ents	NVARCHAR(1)

	SELECT @child_level = 0, @window_id = ISNULL(@window_id, 0)
	DECLARE cursor_schedentities CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL

	OPEN cursor_schedentities
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

				parent_ent_name, parent_description)
			SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description, el.parent_ent_id, e.can_sched_jobs, @child_level,
				ep.ent_name, ep.description
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id

			WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN

			IF (@@rowcount <= 0) BREAK
		END
	END
	CLOSE cursor_schedentities
	DEALLOCATE cursor_schedentities

	IF (@window_id = 0)

	IF (@limit_schedulable_ents = '1') BEGIN

		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)

			UPDATE @tmp_tbl_schedentities SET can_sched_jobs = 0

			DECLARE cursor_schedentities CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT ent_id FROM oper_ent_link  WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id

			SET @child_level = 0
			OPEN cursor_schedentities
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_schedentities INTO @ent_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				INSERT INTO @tbl_schedparents (ent_id, can_sched_jobs, child_level)
				SELECT ent_id, can_sched_jobs, @child_level FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					SET @child_level = @child_level + 1

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_attr_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_attr table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE oper_attr_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
			SELECT b.process_id
			FROM deleted b

		OPEN oper_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM oper_attr_cursor INTO @process_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
--				RAISERROR ('Cannot delete the oper_attr of a certified process', 16, 1)
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_attr', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
			EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
			UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
		END
		CLOSE oper_attr_cursor
		DEALLOCATE oper_attr_cursor
	END
END

/*

-- Name:		sp_d_ofi_lm_printer_name
-- Description:	Delete printer record
--
-- Usage:	Delete printer record
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-02			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-09-11			Audit trail
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_d_ofi_lm_printer_name]
	 @row_id int
	 ,@user_id NVARCHAR(100)

AS
BEGIN	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @new_printer_desc NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@old_printer_id NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@new_printer_inUse NVARCHAR(50)
			,@new_printer_type NVARCHAR(50)
			,@new_row_id INT
			,@resultset INT=1
			,@resultcode NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
			,@printer_id NVARCHAR(200)


declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_PrinterInfo'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Printer'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@l INT =0
			,@smeRcdCnt INT=0

	DECLARE @printerInfo as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	printer_id NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_desc NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_inUse INT,
	printer_type INT
	);

	DECLARE @printerInfo1 as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	printer_id NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_desc NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_inUse INT,
	printer_type INT
	);


	insert into @printerInfo (row_id,printer_id,printer_desc,printer_inUse,printer_type)
	select olpi.printer_row_id,olpi.printer_id,olpi.printer_desc,olpi.printer_inUse,olpi.printer_type
	from [ofi_lm_printer_information]  olpi WITH(NOLOCK)

		DELETE FROM [dbo].[ofi_lm_printer_information] 
		WHERE printer_row_id=@row_id

		insert into @printerInfo1 (row_id,printer_id,printer_desc,printer_inUse,printer_type)
	select olpi.printer_row_id,olpi.printer_id,olpi.printer_desc,olpi.printer_inUse,olpi.printer_type
	from [ofi_lm_printer_information]  olpi WITH(NOLOCK)

		--delete record
 select @delCnt=count(t1.printer_desc) 
from @printerInfo t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						from @printerInfo1 t2 )
while (@k < @delCnt)
 BEGIN
 SELECT @new_printer_desc= t1.printer_desc 
		,@new_printer_inUse=case when t1.printer_inUse=1 then 'Inuse'
							else 'NotInUse'
							end
		,@new_printer_type= CASE when t1.printer_type= 0 then 'Manual'
							ELSE 'In-Line'
							end
		,@new_row_id=t1.row_id
		,@printer_id=t1.printer_id
		from @printerInfo t1
		FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @printerInfo1 t2 )
 order by t1.row_id
 OFFSET @k ROWS   
 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

 Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
 set @strCommentMsg='For '+@printer_id+' _ '
 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id))							
							,(@new_row_id,'printer_desc',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg))
	
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @k = @k + 1;
 END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_UL_GetCountsAndDuration]
(@in_session_id				INT32 = NULL
,@in_ent_id					INT32 = NULL
,@in_type					INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_state_cd				int32 = null
,@in_reas_grp_cd			INT32 = NULL
,@runtime					LOGICAL
,@downtime					LOGICAL
,@setuptime					LOGICAL
,@teardowntime				LOGICAL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_UL_GETCOUNTSANDDURATION
-- Description    - Get Utilization counts and duration
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   -    17/18/2008
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 08/09/2008       Raghu           3.5   L00082460 - The GetCountsAndDurations method needs to allow reason groups to be filtered by a utilization state to allow drilling down from a utilization state to a reason group.
--	10/09/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00085379; Filter start and end times for OEE_Exec.GetValue and Util_Log.GetCountsAndDuration need special interpretation when time unit is other than hours.
--	01/16/2015		RWB				5.1	L00134653: Fixed a problem where utilization events that either ended right at the start of the filter time period or began right at the end of the filter time period where being included in the calculation of counts and durations.
-- 02/19/2015		Raghu	5.1	UserStory: 446972 - [I-CR 135660] Entity Util States (Counts and Durarions) data is missing for Current Shift
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@type					INT32
		,@state_cd				INT32
		,@reas_grp_cd			INT32
		,@util_start_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2
		,@curr_code				INT32
		,@start				TDATETIME2
		,@end				TDATETIME2
		,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = GETUTCDATE()
		,@ret				INT32

BEGIN
	SELECT @type = @in_type, @state_cd = @in_state_cd, @reas_grp_cd = @in_reas_grp_cd

	IF (@in_type IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},TYPE'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	 ELSE IF (@in_type < 0 OR @in_type > 2) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The %1 must be in the range %2-%3{3356},TYPE,0,2'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC @ret = sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes @ent_id=@in_ent_id, @filter_time_unit=@in_filter_time_unit
			, @filter_start_time=@in_filter_start_time, @filter_end_time=@in_filter_end_time
			, @start_time_utc=@start OUTPUT, @end_time_utc=@end OUTPUT

	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	--Get the starting event from the start time
	SELECT @util_start_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @in_ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc <= @start

	SET @util_start_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@util_start_event_time_utc, @start)

	IF (@in_type = 0) BEGIN
		--Utilization States
		SELECT @curr_code = uh.state_cd
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id)

		SELECT us.state_cd, us.state_desc, us.color
			, SUM(ul.duration - CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < @start THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ul.event_time_utc, @start) ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > @end THEN DATEDIFF(SS, @end, ul.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END) AS duration
			, COUNT(*) AS util_count
			, MAX(CASE WHEN ul.state_cd = @curr_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
		FROM vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
		WHERE ul.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		  -- An event should be considered ends after the start of the time period
		  -- and it begins before the end of the time period
		  AND ul.event_time_utc >= @util_start_event_time_utc
		  AND ul.event_time_utc < @end
		  AND (ul.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL)
		GROUP BY us.state_cd, us.state_desc, us.color

	END
	ELSE IF (@in_type = 1) BEGIN
		--Utilization Reason Groups
		SELECT @curr_code = ur.reas_grp_id
		FROM util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) ON uh.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id)

		-- CR #L00111319 (Hotfix 2419) - RWB 03/08/2011 - For some reason, the join with the util_reas_grp table is very slow,
		-- so the query has been restructured to eliminate the join.
		SELECT x.reas_grp_id, (SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc FROM util_reas_grp WHERE util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = x.reas_grp_id) as reas_grp_desc,
			   x.duration, x.util_count, x.active
		FROM
		(SELECT ur.reas_grp_id
			, SUM(ul.duration - CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < @start THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ul.event_time_utc, @start) ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > @end THEN DATEDIFF(SS, @end, ul.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END) AS duration
			, COUNT(*) AS util_count
			, MAX(CASE WHEN ur.reas_grp_id = @curr_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
		FROM vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		WHERE ul.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		   AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
		  -- An event should be considered ends after the start of the time period
		  -- and it begins before the end of the time period
		   AND ul.event_time_utc >= @util_start_event_time_utc
		  AND ul.event_time_utc < @end
		  --AND (urg.reas_grp_id = @in_reas_grp_id OR @in_reas_grp_id IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL)
		GROUP BY ur.reas_grp_id) x
		-- CR #L00111319 (Hotfix 2419) - RWB 03/08/2011 - End of changes

	END
	ELSE BEGIN
	--Utilization Reasons
		SELECT @curr_code = uh.reas_cd
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id)

		SELECT ur.reas_cd, ur.reas_desc, ur.state_cd, us.state_desc, us.color
			, SUM(ul.duration - CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < @start THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ul.event_time_utc, @start) ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > @end THEN DATEDIFF(SS, @end, ul.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END) AS duration
			, COUNT(*) AS util_count
			, MAX(CASE WHEN ul.reas_cd = @curr_code THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
		FROM vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ur.state_cd = us.state_cd
		WHERE ul.ent_id = @in_ent_id
		   AND (ur.reas_grp_id = @reas_grp_cd OR @reas_grp_cd IS NULL)
		   AND (ur.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
		  -- An event should be considered ends after the start of the time period
		  -- and it begins before the end of the time period
		  AND ul.event_time_utc >= @util_start_event_time_utc
		  AND ul.event_time_utc < @end
		  AND (ul.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL)
		GROUP BY ur.reas_cd, ur.reas_desc, ur.state_cd, us.state_desc, us.color
	END
END

-- Name:		sp_S_ofi_st_RegisterTrasnferQty
-- Description:	The stored procedure require to run update from middleware

-- Usage:		Stock Transfer Workflow

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_SetJobFlags] (@wo_id	NVARCHAR(40))
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_U_JOB_SETJOBFLAGS
-- Description	      - (HD #2378) Sets the First job and Final job flags in job table based on job route
-- Author	      - Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created	      - 05/15/2003
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.27
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/03/2007     SJ           31027    Performance improvements
-- 02/11/2009	  DonT			3.4		CR L00089175 (HF 1275) - Performance issues and Deadlocks on a large system.
--										previous deadlock fix with a better performance fix.
--										Also added indexes FK_JOB_ROUTE_JOB_INPUT_X and FK_JOB_ROUTE_JOB_X
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
  UPDATE job with (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK)
    SET first_job = COALESCE((SELECT DISTINCT 0 FROM job_route r2 with (NOLOCK) WHERE r2.wo_id = job.wo_id AND r2.oper_id = job.oper_id AND r2.seq_no = job.seq_no), 1),
        final_job = COALESCE((SELECT DISTINCT 0 FROM job_route r2 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r2.wo_id = job.wo_id AND r2.input_oper_id = job.oper_id AND r2.input_seq_no = job.seq_no), 1)
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_QM_Spec_Rule_Link]
(@qm_spec_id int = NULL ,
 @rule_id int = NULL ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @last_edit_at datetime = NULL)
 AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_QM_Spec_Rule_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author         -
-- Date Created     - 08/26/2011
-- Version          -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

SELECT QM_Spec_Rule_Link.qm_spec_id
    ,QM_Spec_Rule_Link.rule_id
    ,Spc_Rule.rule_desc
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_ix
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_mr
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_xbar
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_range
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_sigma
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_ma
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_ewmaix
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_run
    ,Spc_Rule.use_for_attr
    ,Spc_Rule.test1
    ,Spc_Rule.test2
    ,Spc_Rule.and_not_or
    ,Spc_Rule.level1
    ,Spc_Rule.level2
    ,Spc_Rule.num_points
    ,Spc_Rule.of_points
    ,Spc_Rule.priority
    ,Spc_Rule.obsolete
    ,QM_Spec_Rule_Link.last_edit_comment
    ,QM_Spec_Rule_Link.last_edit_by

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_db_maint_job]
  (@db_maint_job_id nvarchar(40)
  ,@description  nvarchar(80)
  ,@actiontype int
  ,@event_type_details  NOTES
  ,@date_range_type int
  ,@start_date_local datetime
  ,@start_date_utc datetime
  ,@start_date_tz INT32 = NULL
  ,@end_date_local datetime
  ,@end_date_utc datetime
  ,@end_date_tz INT32 = NULL
  ,@relative_offset int
  ,@relative_offset_units int
  ,@data_set_path  nvarchar(1000)
  ,@conflict_option int
  ,@last_exec_date_local datetime
  ,@last_exec_date_utc datetime
  ,@last_exec_date_tz INT32 = NULL
  ,@last_exec_userid  nvarchar(40)
  ,@cur_event_count int
  ,@cur_error_count int
  ,@cur_status int
  ,@last_edit_comment  nvarchar(254)
  ,@last_edit_at datetime
  ,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    -
-- Description    -
-- Author         -
-- Date Created   - 10/2/2009
-- Version        - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver.     Changes
-- 02/04/2020     Jim O'Hearn   6.2.0    Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SET @start_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_date_tz)
SET @end_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_date_tz)
SET @last_exec_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_exec_date_tz)
SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

 --create utc values
IF @start_date_local IS NOT NULL SET @start_date_utc =  DATEADD(mi, -@start_date_tz, @start_date_local)
IF @end_date_local IS NOT NULL SET @end_date_utc =  DATEADD(mi, -@end_date_tz, @end_date_local)
IF @last_exec_date_local IS NOT NULL SET @last_exec_date_utc =  DATEADD(mi, -@last_exec_date_tz, @last_exec_date_local)


UPDATE db_Maint_Job
SET db_maint_job_id = @db_maint_job_id
  ,description = @description
  ,actiontype = @actiontype
  ,event_type_details = @event_type_details
  ,date_range_type = @date_range_type

  ,end_date_utc = @end_date_utc
  ,relative_offset = @relative_offset
  ,relative_offset_units = @relative_offset_units
  ,data_set_path = @data_set_path
  ,conflict_option = @conflict_option
  ,last_exec_date_local = @last_exec_date_local
  ,last_exec_date_utc = @last_exec_date_utc
  ,last_exec_userid = @last_exec_userid
  ,cur_event_count = @cur_event_count
  ,cur_error_count = @cur_error_count
  ,cur_status = @cur_status
  ,last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE (db_maint_job_id = @db_maint_job_id AND last_edit_at = @last_edit_at)

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_attr_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_attr]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_attr_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_attr table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_attr_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_attr a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		     AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		     AND a.attr_id = b.attr_id
	OPEN oper_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_attr_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_attr', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_attr_cursor
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_D_ofi_st_trans_mapping
-- Description:	The stored procedure will delete transfer mapping configuration, called from the WF.
--	
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer Configuration 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi	2023-12-22			Initial version.
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_ofi_st_trans_mapping] @rowID INT
	,@comments NVARCHAR(250) = NULL
	,@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
	,@audit_trail BIT = 1 -- 1=Save to audit trail 0=Not Save to Audit Trail
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 			
		 @strItemid NVARCHAR(40)
		,@Equipment_ID int
		,@StorageEntID int
		,@mod NVARCHAR(30) = NULL
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'StockTransferMapping'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = 'delete'
		,@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL
		,@dataRecord XML
		,@auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS;

		DECLARE @transferStatus VARCHAR(80) = 'RUNNING'
		DECLARE @transferStatusCd INT=0

	--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE
	SELECT @transferStatusCd=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@transferStatus

	-- SET DEFAULT VALUES
	IF (
			@audit_trail IS NULL
			OR @audit_trail = ''
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @audit_trail = 1;
	END

	-- RETRIEVE DATA FOR AUDIT TRAIL XML
	SET @dataRecord = (
			SELECT row_id
				,ent_id
				,storage_ent_id
				,type
				,item_group
				,created_at_local
				,created_at_utc
				,created_by
				,last_edit_at_local
				,last_edit_at_utc
				,@user_name AS last_edit_by
			FROM [dbo].ofi_st_trans_mapping WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE row_id = @rowID
			FOR XML RAW('data')
			);	
	
	--GET SELECTED RECORD
	SELECT @Equipment_ID=ent_id, @StorageEntID=storage_ent_id FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping WHERE row_id=@rowID

	--CHECK IF TRANSFER IS RUNNING FOR SELECTED LINE AND STORAGE UNIT
	IF EXISTS (
			SELECT ent_id
			FROM ofi_st_trans_selection st
			WHERE st.ent_id = @Equipment_ID
				AND (ST.src_su_ent_id=@StorageEntID OR st.dest_su_ent_id= @StorageEntID)				   
				AND st.transfer_status_cd = @transferStatusCd
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400008,NULL,NULL)
		RAISERROR (	@errorMessage,16,1);
			RETURN -1
	END

	--DELETE RECORD BY ROWID
	DELETE
	FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping
	WHERE row_id = @rowID


	--INSERT AUDIT TRAIL LOG
	IF (@audit_trail = 1)
	BEGIN
		-- At least one record with the row_id is required for storing the deleted record in the audit_trail table.
		DELETE @auditTrailParameters

		INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (
			row_id
			,field_name
			,field_value
			)
		VALUES (
			@rowID
			,'@row_id'
			,NULL
			)

		EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
			,@function_id = @strFunctionName
			,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
			,@xmlDeletedRow = @dataRecord
			,@deletedRowSourceTable = '[dbo].[ofi_st_trans_mapping]'
			,@user_id = @user_name
			,@activity = @strActivityMsg
			,@audit_category = 'Info'
			,@comments = @comments
	END


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_QM_Context_CleanUp]
(
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_D_QM_CONTEXT_CLEANUP
-- Description			- This SP triggered by SQL Server Agent Service (or our background service) every day.
--						  Clean Up old context information periodically:
--						  When a record in the qm_context table is older than the current datetime minus the configured
--						  system attribute, then those records are considered obsolete.
-- Author				- Raghavender M
-- Date Created			- 02/14/2011
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @iDays				INT32
	,   @obsolete_time_value TDATETIME


BEGIN

	SELECT @iDays = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 416

	IF @iDays > 0
	BEGIN

		SET @obsolete_time_value = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())  - @iDays

		--First delete the qm_context_link records whose last_edit_at value is older than the cut-off time
		DELETE FROM qm_context_link
		WHERE last_edit_at < @obsolete_time_value
            IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
                  EXECUTE sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 2,'Stored Procedure', 'Context CleanUp Stored Procedure - sp_D_QM_Context_CleanUp','qm_context_link',
                        'Err Occurred while purging qm_context_link table',NULL
            END

        --Next delete the records from the qm_context table if the corresponding context (context_id) has no matching dependant records in the qm_context_link table
		DELETE FROM qm_context
		WHERE NOT EXISTS
		( SELECT context_id
		  FROM qm_context_link
		  WHERE qm_context.context_id = qm_context_link.context_id )
		AND ( is_job_running <> 1 AND last_edit_at < @obsolete_time_value )
            IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
                        EXECUTE sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 2,'Stored Procedure', 'Context CleanUp Stored Procedure - sp_D_QM_Context_CleanUp','qm_context',
                              'Err Occurred while purging qm_context table',NULL
            END
	 END
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetSchedulableEntity]
(
	@ent_id	INT OUTPUT
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetSchedulableEntity
-- Description					- Get Schedulable Entity. Get a list of all parent ent_ids and find the first parent schedulable entity
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 10/02/2002
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 08/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		HD# 4913, Changed this sp to return the first preferred ancestor entity via OUTPUT parameter
--												(also supports recordset which contains the first preferred parent schedulable entity)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @can_sched_jobs 	BIT,
	@parent_ent_id		INT,
	@curr_ent_id		INT
BEGIN
	SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id, @can_sched_jobs = can_sched_jobs FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	IF (@can_sched_jobs = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_id 'ent_id'
		RETURN 0
	END
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		SET @curr_ent_id = @parent_ent_id
		SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id, @can_sched_jobs = can_sched_jobs
		FROM ent
		WHERE ent_id = @curr_ent_id
		IF (@can_sched_jobs = 1) BEGIN
			SET @ent_id = @curr_ent_id
			SELECT @ent_id 'ent_id'
			RETURN 0
		END
		IF ((@parent_ent_id IS NULL) OR (@parent_ent_id = -1))BREAK
	END
	SET @ent_id = NULL
	SELECT @ent_id 'ent_id'
	RETURN 0
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:             sp_S_ofi_GetAssignPalletGrid -
-- Description:     To get the assign HU grid for the selected wo
--
-- Usage:            
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version          Authour         Date (yyyy-MM-dd)               Change Description
-- 0.01.00         AML, XPM            2026-02-11                      Initial Version
-- 0.01.01         AML, XPM            2026-02-19                      Added UD logic imitating GetPalletConsScan
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Desktop_GetAssignPalletGrid]
    @wo_id nvarchar(50),        
    @batch_no nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @item_id nvarchar(50) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    DECLARE @ent_id_segment int
    SELECT @ent_id_segment = target_sched_ent_id 
    FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

    IF @ent_id_segment IS NULL RETURN;

    DECLARE @areas_names nvarchar(max)
    SELECT @areas_names = ea.attr_value 
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
    WHERE a.attr_desc = 'PalletConsumptionAreas' AND ea.ent_id = @ent_id_segment

    DECLARE @ent_table TABLE (ent_id int);

    IF @areas_names IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @ent_table (ent_id)
        SELECT e.ent_id FROM ent e WHERE e.ent_name IN (SELECT items FROM dbo.fn_ofi_Split(@areas_names, ','));
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO @ent_table (ent_id)
        SELECT e3.ent_id 
        FROM ent e1 WITH (NOLOCK) 
        INNER JOIN ent e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON e2.ent_id = e1.parent_ent_id 
        INNER JOIN ent e3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON e3.ent_id = e2.parent_ent_id 
        WHERE e1.ent_id = @ent_id_segment
    END

 
    DECLARE @process_attr_id INT

    DECLARE @temp TABLE (
        process_id NVARCHAR(40),
        disable_ud  NVARCHAR(40)
    )

    SELECT @process_attr_id = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'Disable_UD'

    INSERT INTO @temp (process_id, disable_ud)
    SELECT process_id, attr_value FROM process_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = @process_attr_id

    DECLARE @Disable_UD NVARCHAR(40) = '0'
    DECLARE @current_process_id NVARCHAR(40)

 
    SELECT 
        @Disable_UD = ISNULL(mrt.disable_ud, '0'),
        @current_process_id = p.process_id
    FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.oper_id = j.oper_id
    INNER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = o.process_id
    LEFT JOIN @temp mrt ON p.process_id = mrt.process_id
    WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id

  
    DECLARE @allowed_ud_table TABLE (ud_code nvarchar(100))

    IF @Disable_UD = '0'
    BEGIN

        INSERT INTO @allowed_ud_table (ud_code)
        SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(Split.items))
        FROM process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = pa.attr_id
        CROSS APPLY dbo.fn_ofi_Split(pa.attr_value, ',') AS Split
        WHERE a.attr_desc = 'Allowed_UD' AND pa.process_id = @current_process_id
    END

    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY iv.last_edit_at DESC) as Id,
        iv.spare2 as HU,                
        iv.lot_no as Batch,  
        iv.sublot_no as Sublot, 
        iv.grade_cd as grade,
        

        ISNULL(iv.spare1,'Unknown') as UD_Code, 
        
        iv.item_id as Material,
        i.item_desc as Description,
        CAST(iv.qty_left AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as Qty,
        u.abbreviation as UOM,
        
        'Available' as Status,
        
        iv.ent_id,
        e.ent_name as Location,
        dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(NULL, iv.last_edit_at) as LastUpdated
        
    FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = iv.item_id
    INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = iv.uom_id
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = iv.ent_id
    LEFT JOIN ofi_assignhuwoid ai WITH (NOLOCK) ON iv.spare2 = ai.pallet_id 

    WHERE 
        iv.ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @ent_table)
        AND iv.spare2 IS NOT NULL
        AND iv.qty_left > 0
        AND (@batch_no IS NULL OR iv.lot_no LIKE '%' + @batch_no + '%')
        AND ai.wo_id IS NULL
        
        AND (
            @Disable_UD = '1' 
            OR 
            ISNULL(iv.spare1, 'Unknown') IN (SELECT ud_code FROM @allowed_ud_table)
        )
    
    ORDER BY 
        iv.last_edit_at DESC;

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_specification_data]
AS
SELECT temptable.*,
       spec.units,
       spec.grp_id,
       spec.display_seq,
       job_step.step_desc
FROM (SELECT job.wo_id,
             job.oper_id,
             job.seq_no,
             job.job_desc,
             job.act_start_time_utc,
             job.act_start_time_local,
             job.act_finish_time_utc,
             job.act_finish_time_local,
             job.item_id,
             item.item_desc,
             job.run_ent_id,
             ent.ent_name,
             job_spec.step_no,
             job_spec.spec_id,
             job_spec.spec_value,
             job_spec.act_spec_value,
             job_spec.comments,
             job_spec.min_value,
             job_spec.max_value,
             item_prod.shift_start_utc,
             item_prod.shift_start_local
      FROM job job
      LEFT OUTER JOIN item item ON
         job.item_id = item.item_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON
         job.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id
      INNER JOIN job_spec job_spec ON
         job.wo_id = job_spec.wo_id AND
         job.oper_id = job_spec.oper_id AND
         job.seq_no = job_spec.seq_no
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local FROM item_prod) item_prod ON
         job.wo_id =item_prod.wo_id
     ) temptable
LEFT OUTER JOIN spec spec ON
   temptable.spec_id = spec.spec_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step job_step ON
   temptable.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
   temptable.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND
   temptable.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
   temptable.step_no = job_step.step_no

BEGIN

	@grpId as NVARCHAR(10)

(value1 NVARCHAR(40),
grp_id INT,
Value_Name NVARCHAR(40),
Row_id INT,

	SELECT grp_id FROM data_log_value

	FETCH NEXT FROM grpId_cursor INTO @grpId

DECLARE @ColName as NVARCHAR(10)

 SET @whereCondition = ' je.Row_Id='+ CAST(@RowId as NVARCHAR) + 'AND '

SET @strSelected = @strSelected + 'where '+@whereCondition+' je.value6 = tblTemp.row_id order by tblTemp.Row_id '

EXEC(@strSelected)

DROP TABLE #tblInsert

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Qm_Spec_GetByFilter]
(@qm_spec_name			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@qm_spec_desc			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@ver_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@start_eff_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@start_eff_utc			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@end_eff_local			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@end_eff_utc			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@ent_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
,@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@item_category_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@process_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@active_specs			LOGICAL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Qm_Spec_GetByFilter
-- Description      - The purpose of this method is to list the qm specifications, optionally filtered by the qm spec name,
--						qm spec description, qm spec version, qm spec start date, qm spec end date, entity with capability
--						of capturing qm data, item/item class/parent item class, process and operation. If active_specs is true
--						it will return active specs otherwise it will return all specs
-- Date Created     - 01/27/2011
-- Version          - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--  04/13/2020        Sara Reynolds    Added display_seq column
-- 05/07/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1302835 - As Bruce, I want the QMSpec Web APIs to pass Date/Times in UTC so that the user doesn't need to convert to entity local time
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
	DECLARE @attr_value			NVARCHAR(10)
		,	@attr_value_class 	NVARCHAR(10)

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 210
	IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

	SET @active_specs = COALESCE(@active_specs, 0)
	IF ( @active_specs = 0) BEGIN

		SELECT	qm_spec.qm_spec_name
			,qm_spec.qm_spec_desc
			,qm_spec.edit_level
			,qm_spec.ver_id
			,qm_spec.start_eff_utc
			,qm_spec.start_eff_local
			,qm_spec.start_eff_utc AS start_eff
			,qm_spec.end_eff_utc
			,qm_spec.end_eff_local
			,qm_spec.end_eff_utc AS end_eff
			,qm_spec.ent_id
			,ent.ent_name
			,qm_spec.item_id
			,item.item_desc
			,CASE
				WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
				WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
				WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
				WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
			END AS item_display
			,qm_spec.item_category_id
			,category.category_name as item_category_name
			,qm_spec.process_id
			,qm_spec.oper_id
			,qm_spec.category_id
			,qm_spec.plan_id
			,qm_spec.num_pts_per_page
			,qm_spec.display_seq
			,qm_spec.spare1
			,qm_spec.spare2
			,qm_spec.spare3
			,qm_spec.spare4
			,qm_spec.last_edit_comment
			,qm_spec.last_edit_by
			,qm_spec.last_edit_at
			,qm_spec.qm_spec_id
		FROM qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.item_id = item.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN category WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.item_category_id = category.category_id
		WHERE (qm_spec.qm_spec_name LIKE @qm_spec_name OR @qm_spec_name IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.qm_spec_desc LIKE @qm_spec_desc OR @qm_spec_desc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.ver_id LIKE @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.start_eff_utc>= @start_eff_utc OR @start_eff_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.start_eff_local>= @start_eff_local OR @start_eff_local IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.end_eff_utc <= @end_eff_utc OR @end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.end_eff_local <= @end_eff_local OR @end_eff_local IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
--		  AND (qm_spec.item_class_id LIKE @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL)
--		  AND (qm_spec.parent_item_class_id LIKE @parent_item_class_id OR @parent_item_class_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.process_id LIKE @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
          ORDER BY qm_spec.display_seq, qm_spec.qm_spec_name --  Fix For CR L00112574 - Added ORDER BY Clause on qm_spec_name
		END

	ELSE BEGIN

		SELECT	qm_spec.qm_spec_name
			,qm_spec.qm_spec_desc
			,qm_spec.edit_level
			,qm_spec.ver_id
			,qm_spec.start_eff_utc
			,qm_spec.start_eff_local
			,qm_spec.start_eff_utc AS start_eff
			,qm_spec.end_eff_utc
			,qm_spec.end_eff_local
			,qm_spec.end_eff_utc AS end_eff
			,qm_spec.ent_id
			,ent.ent_name
			,qm_spec.item_id
			,item.item_desc
			,CASE
				WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
				WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
				WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
				WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
			END AS item_display
			,qm_spec.item_category_id
			,category.category_name as item_category_name
			,qm_spec.process_id
			,qm_spec.oper_id
			,qm_spec.category_id
			,qm_spec.plan_id
			,qm_spec.num_pts_per_page
			,qm_spec.display_seq
			,qm_spec.spare1
			,qm_spec.spare2
			,qm_spec.spare3
			,qm_spec.spare4
			,qm_spec.last_edit_comment
			,qm_spec.last_edit_by
			,qm_spec.last_edit_at
			,qm_spec.qm_spec_id
		FROM qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.item_id = item.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN category WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.item_category_id = category.category_id
		WHERE (qm_spec.qm_spec_name LIKE @qm_spec_name OR @qm_spec_name IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.qm_spec_desc LIKE @qm_spec_desc OR @qm_spec_desc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.ver_id LIKE @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.start_eff_utc>= @start_eff_utc OR @start_eff_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.start_eff_local>= @start_eff_local OR @start_eff_local IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.end_eff_utc <= @end_eff_utc OR @end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.end_eff_local <= @end_eff_local OR @end_eff_local IS NULL)
		  AND ((qm_spec.end_eff_utc  IS NOT NULL AND qm_spec.end_eff_utc > GETUTCDATE()) OR qm_spec.end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
--		  AND (qm_spec.item_class_id LIKE @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL)
--		  AND (qm_spec.parent_item_class_id LIKE @parent_item_class_id OR @parent_item_class_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.process_id LIKE @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		  AND (qm_spec.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
          ORDER BY qm_spec.display_seq, qm_spec.qm_spec_name --  Fix For CR L00112574 - Added ORDER BY Clause on qm_spec_name
		END
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_st_GetLines]
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @enableTransferAttr VARCHAR(80) = 'Enable_stock_transfer'

	SELECT e.ent_id
		,e.description
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Data_Log_Value]
  (@grp_id int ,
   @value_index int = NULL OUTPUT,
   @value_name nvarchar(80) ,
   @value_type int ,
   @editable bit ,
   @cur_value nvarchar(80) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40),
   @meaning int,
   @meaning_to_value_index int,
   @spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 07/24/2017	RWB		6.0			Story 809811 - made null the default value for the @value_index parameter and added code
--									to set the @value_index parameter to the next highest number in the data log group or
--									to 1 if the data log group is empty.  Also added a new output parameter @new_value_index
--									to return the value.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

IF @value_index IS NULL BEGIN
	SELECT @value_index =  MIN(dlv.value_index+1)
	FROM data_log_value dlv WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlv.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
	WHERE dlv.grp_id = @grp_id AND
		dlv.value_index < dlg.max_value AND
		NOT EXISTS(SELECT dlv2.value_index FROM data_log_value dlv2 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE dlv2.grp_id = @grp_id AND dlv2.value_index = dlv.value_index + 1)


	IF @value_index IS NULL BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_value WHERE grp_id = @grp_id) BEGIN
			SET @value_index = 1
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			RAISERROR('There are no more defined data log values for this group.{1831}', 16, 1)
			return
		END
	END
END

INSERT INTO data_log_value
 (grp_id,
  value_index,
  value_name,
  value_type,
  editable,
  cur_value,
  spec_id,
  meaning,
  meaning_to_value_index,
  spare1,
  spare2,
  spare3,
  spare4,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@grp_id,
   @value_index,
   @value_name,
   @value_type,
   @editable,
   @cur_value,
   @spec_id,
   @meaning,
   @meaning_to_value_index,
   @spare1,
   @spare2,
   @spare3,
   @spare4,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Return timestamp
--SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
select @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
from data_log_value
WHERE (grp_id = @grp_id AND
value_index = @value_index)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetStepBOMData]
(@wo_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@seq_no	INT
,@step_no	INT = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetStepBOMData
-- Description    - To return a single recordset containing details of all step data for a given job,
--			        including any BOM data IF a BOM item is linked to this step.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 01/06/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT   job_step.wo_id
	,job_step.oper_id
	,job_step.seq_no
	,job_step.step_no
	,job_step.step_desc
	,job_step.action_type
	,job_step.std_time
	,job_step.complete_cond
	,job_step.allow_bypass
	,job_step.enter_data
	,job_step.step_grp_id
	,job_step.spc_char
	,job_step.form_name
	,job_step.spare1 js_spare1
	,job_step.spare2 js_spare2
	,job_step.spare3 js_spare3
	,job_step.spare4 js_spare4
	,job_step.spare5 js_spare5
	,job_step.spare6 js_spare6
	,job_bom_step.bom_pos
	,job_bom_step.qty_per_parent_item jbs_qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.bom_pos
	,job_bom.item_id
	,job_bom.reqd_grade_cd
	,job_bom.instruction
	,job_bom.qty_per_parent_item jb_qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
	,job_bom.update_inv
	,job_bom.backflush
	,job_bom.def_reas_cd
	,job_bom.def_lot_no
	,job_bom.def_storage_ent_id
	,job_bom.scaling_factor
	,job_bom.must_consume_from_inv
	,job_bom.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
	,job_bom.may_create_new_lots
	,job_bom.must_consume_from_wip
	,job_bom.must_consume_before_prod
	,job_bom.constant_qty
	,job_bom.spare1 jb_spare1
	,job_bom.spare2 jb_spare2
	,job_bom.spare3 jb_spare3
	,job_bom.spare4 jb_spare4
FROM         job_step WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN
	      job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_step.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND job_step.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no LEFT OUTER JOIN
              job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_step.wo_id = job_bom_step.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = job_bom_step.oper_id AND
              job_step.seq_no = job_bom_step.seq_no AND job_step.step_no = job_bom_step.step_no AND job_bom.wo_id = job_bom_step.wo_id AND
              job_bom.oper_id = job_bom_step.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job_bom_step.seq_no AND job_bom.bom_pos = job_bom_step.bom_pos
WHERE  (job_step.wo_id = @wo_id)
   AND (job_step.oper_id = @oper_id)
   AND (job_step.seq_no = @seq_no)
   AND (job_step.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
ORDER BY job_step.step_seq, job_step.step_no, job_bom.bom_pos

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_attr_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_attr_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_attr table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_attr oa, inserted i WHERE oa.process_id = i.process_id AND oa.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oa.attr_id = i.attr_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_attr', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_attr oa, inserted i WHERE oa.process_id = i.process_id AND oa.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oa.attr_id = i.attr_id) opattr
	WHERE process.process_id = opattr.process_id

	UPDATE oper_attr SET oper_attr.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_attr.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_attr.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oper_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_IU_ofi_AddParamRecipe
-- Description:	The stored procedure will create new parameter recipe 
--	
-- Usage:		sp_I_ImportParamRecipe
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_IU_ofi_AddParamRecipe] 
		@recipe_name NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@spec_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@spec_group NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,-- v0.03
		@spec_value FLOAT = NULL,
		@min_value FLOAT = NULL,
		@max_value FLOAT = NULL,
		@product_dependent NVARCHAR(1) = NULL,
		@comments NVARCHAR(250) = NULL,
		@display_seq INT = NULL,
		@user_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
		@row_id INT = NULL OUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Initialize variable
	DECLARE @strParameterDefined NVARCHAR(10) = 'NO'

	-- Get information about parameter availability
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 
				FROM ofi_master_recipe_parameter WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
					AND item_id = @item_id
					AND spec_id = @spec_id
					AND spare2 = @spec_group))-- v0.03
	BEGIN
		-- Set availability parameter in to the variable
		SET @strParameterDefined = 'YES'

	END

	-- If parameter is available then update the parameter properties 
	-- Still need to discuss what kind of properties. 0.1 Set to disable
	-- Enabled on v 0.03.00
	IF (@strParameterDefined = 'YES')
	BEGIN
		PRINT @strParameterDefined
		PRINT @spec_group
		-- Retrieve row id to update the parameter
		SELECT @row_id = row_id
		FROM ofi_master_recipe_parameter WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name
			AND item_id = @item_id
			AND spare2 = @spec_group -- v0.03
			AND spec_id = @spec_id
		
		-- Update the parameter 
		UPDATE ofi_master_recipe_parameter 
		SET --spec_id = @spec_id,
			min_value= @min_value,
			max_value= @max_value,
			spec_value= @spec_value,
			spare1 = @display_seq,
			last_edit_at_local = GETDATE(),
			last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(),
			last_edit_by = @user_name
		WHERE row_id = @row_id
	END
	
	IF (@strParameterDefined = 'NO')
	BEGIN
		-- Insert on ofi_master_recipe_parameter table
		INSERT INTO ofi_master_recipe_parameter
		(
			recipe_name,
			item_id,
			spec_id,
			spare2, -- v0.03
			spec_value,
			min_value,
			max_value,
			product_dependent,
			comments,
			spare1,
			last_edit_at_local,
			last_edit_at_utc,
			last_edit_by
		) 
		values
		(
			@recipe_name,
			@item_id,
			@spec_id,
			@spec_group, -- v0.03
			@spec_value,
			@min_value,
			@max_value,
			@product_dependent,
			@comments,
			@display_seq,
			GETDATE(),
			GETUTCDATE(),
			@user_name
		)

		SET @row_id = @@IDENTITY

		SELECT @row_id
	END

END
