CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks]
(
	@in_start_date		TDATETIME
,	@in_end_date		TDATETIME
,	@break_time			TDATETIME OUTPUT

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks
-- Description					- Refresh the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--								  Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 08/23/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	@start_time_time	DATETIME
	,	@end_time_time		DATETIME
	,	@in_break_time		DATETIME

BEGIN
	SELECT	@start_time_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_start_date, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,	@end_time_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_end_date, 120), 12, 9), 120)

	IF (@break_time IS NULL)  RETURN

	SET @in_break_time = @break_time

	SET @break_time = NULL

	--Verify whether the supplied start date and the supplied end date are same
	IF (DATEDIFF(d, @in_start_date, @in_end_date) = 0) BEGIN
		--The supplied start date and the end date are same.
		--The supplied start date and the end date are same. The break time falls on the same day.
		--Verify whether the break time falls entirely within the shift.
		IF (@start_time_time <= @in_break_time)
		AND (@end_time_time >= @in_break_time)
			--The break time falls on the same day and falls entirely within the shift.
			SET @break_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_break_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
	ELSE
		--Either the shift has started on the previous day or the shift is ending on the next day
		--Verify whether the shift has started on the previous day
		IF (@start_time_time <= @in_break_time)
			--The shift has started on the previous day, because the break_time falls on the next day.
			SET @break_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_break_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		ELSE --IF (@end_time_time >= @break_time)
			--The shift ends on the next day.
			SET @break_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_end_date, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_break_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
	END
END

--10/11/2006	Raghu		3.1.24	HD ?, The above change is rolled back.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @parent_ent_id int
	,@level int

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

--@level variable is used as dummy in order to use existing stored procedure, which populates
--the temporary table with the child entities for given ent_id
SET @level =1
---create the temporary table to store the ent id

/*	CREATE TABLE #temp_ent_child(ent_id int,child_level int)

	Declare tem_cur  CURSOR LOCAL FOR

	BEGIN

		--call sp_SA_Ent_Get_Status_Sub which loads recursively all childs in to temporary table
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_Get_Status_Sub @parent_ent_id,@level
		FETCH FROM tem_cur INTO @parent_ent_id

	CLOSE tem_cur
	DEALLOCATE tem_cur
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	--populating all childs into #temp_ent_child is done
	SELECT a.grp_id,a.access_status ent_access,b.max_child_access max_subtree_access
		,b.min_child_access min_subtree_access, a.last_edit_by, a.last_edit_at
	FROM
		(SELECT grp_id,accss access_status, last_edit_by, last_edit_at FROM grp_ent_link WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) a,
		(SELECT grp_id,MAX(CAST(accss AS int)) max_child_access,MIN(CAST(accss AS int)) min_child_access
		FROM grp_ent_link
		WHERE ent_id in(SELECT ent_id FROM  #temp_ent_child)

--Drop the temporary table

           DECLARE  @entities     TABLE (tree_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, child_level INT)

                        WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

                                    WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN

                                    SET @child_level = @child_level + 1

            DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

/*	SELECT a.grp_id,a.access_status ent_access,b.max_child_access max_subtree_access
		,b.min_child_access min_subtree_access, a.last_edit_by, a.last_edit_at

		(SELECT grp_id,MAX(CAST(accss AS int)) max_child_access,MIN(CAST(accss AS int)) min_child_access

	WHERE a.grp_id *= b.grp_id*/
	SELECT a.grp_id,a.access_status ent_access, b.max_child_access max_subtree_access

	FROM

		LEFT OUTER JOIN
		(SELECT grp_id,MAX(CAST(accss AS int)) max_child_access,MIN(CAST(accss AS int)) min_child_access
		FROM grp_ent_link, @entities e
		WHERE grp_ent_link.ent_id = e.ent_id
		GROUP BY grp_id) b ON a.grp_id = b.grp_id

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_step_status_data]
AS
SELECT job_step_data.wo_id,
       wo.wo_desc,
       job_step_data.oper_id,
       job_step_data.seq_no,
       job_step_data.step_no step_no,
       jstate.state_desc,
       job_step_data.state_cd,
       job_step_data.act_start_time_utc,
       job_step_data.act_start_time_local,
       job_step_data.act_finish_time_utc,
       job_step_data.act_finish_time_local,
       job_step_data.step_data,
       ent.ent_name,
       ent.description,
       item.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       start_user.user_desc start_user,
       data_user.user_desc data_user,
       finish_user.user_desc finish_user,
       job_step_data.lot_no
FROM job_step_data job_step_data
INNER JOIN job job ON
   job.wo_id = job_step_data.wo_id AND
   job.oper_id = job_step_data.oper_id AND
   job.seq_no = job_step_data.seq_no
INNER JOIN item item ON job.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN wo ON wo.wo_id = job_step_data.wo_id
INNER JOIN job_state jstate ON
   job_step_data.state_cd = jstate.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name start_user ON
   start_user.user_id = job_step_data.start_user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name data_user ON
   data_user.user_id = job_step_data.data_user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name finish_user ON
   finish_user.user_id = job_step_data.finish_user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent ON job.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id

	-- 0.01.03 Add applock to avoid race with ToReport SP
	DECLARE @rc INT;
	EXEC @rc = sys.sp_getapplock
		 @DbPrincipal = N'dbo',
		 @Resource    = N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK',
		 @LockMode    = N'Exclusive',
		 @LockOwner   = N'Session',
		 @LockTimeout = 5000;  -- no wait; return immediately

	IF (@rc < 0)
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Skipped: another session holds CONS_REPORT_LOCK.';
		RETURN;
	END


	--0.01.03 collecting id for all used attributes
	SELECT @attr_item_group = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';
	SELECT @attr_skip_consumption = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting';
	SELECT @attr_sap_location = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'SAPLocation';

	SET @sent_qty_total = 0 --safety reset for final sent_qty

	-- 0.01.03 insert into temp table all possible records to update from ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported to have a mirror for updateing the table later
    INSERT INTO @item_cons_wip_reported(row_id, item_cons_row_id, lot_no, cons_to_report, sap_reported_wip_wo_id, sap_reported_created_at_utc)
	(
	SELECT cwr.row_id, item_cons_row_id, cwr.lot_no, ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,3),cwr.spare1),0), sap_reported_wip_wo_id, sap_reported_created_at_utc
	FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported cwr
	JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.sublot_no = cwr.sublot_no
	JOIN ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (NOLOCK) ON owe.wo_id = ip.wo_id
	WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
		AND (owe.delivery IS NOT NULL OR owe.module <> 'PO') -- 0.01.04 exclude records related to production without delivery
	)

    /* STEP 1: Pick the oldest eligible batch and compute sendable_qty in one statement. */

	;WITH staging_agg AS (
		-- aggregate the in-memory staging mirror
		SELECT
			cwr.item_cons_row_id,
			cwr.lot_no,
			cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id,
			SUM(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,3), cwr.cons_to_report), 0)) AS cons_to_report,
			MIN(cwr.sap_reported_created_at_utc) AS min_created_at_utc
		FROM @item_cons_wip_reported AS cwr
		GROUP BY cwr.item_cons_row_id, cwr.lot_no, cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id
	),
	total_cons AS (
		-- total consumption already sent per (lot_no, ItemGroup)
		SELECT
			ic.lot_no,
			LTRIM(RTRIM(ia2.attr_value)) AS item_group,
			CAST(SUM(ic.qty_cons_erp) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS total_cons_sent
		FROM dbo.item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN dbo.item i2 ON i2.item_id = ic.item_id
		JOIN dbo.item_attr ia2 ON ia2.item_id = i2.item_id AND ia2.attr_id = @attr_item_group
		GROUP BY ic.lot_no, LTRIM(RTRIM(ia2.attr_value))
	),
	total_prod AS (
		-- total production sent per (lot_no, ItemGroup)
		SELECT
			ip.lot_no,
			LTRIM(RTRIM(ia2.attr_value)) AS item_group,
			CAST(SUM(ip.qty_prod_erp) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS total_prod_sent
		FROM dbo.item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN dbo.item i2 ON i2.item_id = ip.item_id
		JOIN dbo.item_attr ia2 ON ia2.item_id = i2.item_id AND ia2.attr_id = @attr_item_group
		WHERE i2.item_class_id NOT IN (UPPER('WIP'), UPPER('INTERMEDIATE')) AND ip.good_prod=1
		GROUP BY ip.lot_no, LTRIM(RTRIM(ia2.attr_value))
	),
	candidates AS (
		/* Build candidates at the target granularity: */
		SELECT
			ic.from_ent_id                                                   AS ent_id,
			LTRIM(RTRIM(ia.attr_value))                                      AS item_grp,
			ic.item_id,
			sa.lot_no                                                        AS cons_lot,
			CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tc.total_cons_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))         AS cur_total_cons_qty,
			sa.sap_reported_wip_wo_id                                        AS wip_wo_id,
			CAST(SUM(sa.cons_to_report) AS DECIMAL(18,3))                    AS cons_spare1,
			CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tp.total_prod_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))         AS cur_prod_qty_erp,
			MIN(sa.min_created_at_utc)                                       AS cons_created_at
		FROM staging_agg sa
		JOIN dbo.item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.row_id = sa.item_cons_row_id
		JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)       ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
		JOIN dbo.item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @attr_item_group
		LEFT JOIN dbo.item_attr ia_skip WITH (NOLOCK)
			 ON ia_skip.item_id = i.item_id AND ia_skip.attr_id = @attr_skip_consumption
		LEFT JOIN total_cons tc
			 ON tc.lot_no = sa.lot_no AND tc.item_group = LTRIM(RTRIM(ia.attr_value))
		LEFT JOIN total_prod tp
			 ON tp.lot_no = sa.lot_no AND tp.item_group = LTRIM(RTRIM(ia.attr_value))
		LEFT JOIN dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution ile
			 ON ile.wo_id = sa.sap_reported_wip_wo_id AND ile.lot_no = ic.lot_no AND ile.item_id = ic.item_id
			AND ile.interface = @interface
		WHERE
			sa.cons_to_report <> 0
			AND i.item_class_id NOT IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
			AND (ISNULL(ia_skip.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
			AND (ile.last_sent_at IS NULL OR ile.last_sent_at < DATEADD(hour, -@frequency_hours, GETDATE()))
		GROUP BY ic.from_ent_id, LTRIM(RTRIM(ia.attr_value)), ic.item_id, sa.lot_no, sa.sap_reported_wip_wo_id
		HAVING
			CAST(SUM(ic.qty_cons - ISNULL(ic.qty_cons_erp,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) > 0
			AND CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tp.total_prod_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) > CAST(ISNULL(MAX(tc.total_cons_sent),0) AS DECIMAL(18,3))
	),
	final AS (
		-- Compute sendable_qty from candidate columns (readability + reuse)
		SELECT
			ent_id, item_grp, item_id, cons_lot, wip_wo_id, cons_created_at,
			cur_total_cons_qty, cons_spare1, cur_prod_qty_erp,
			CAST(CASE
				WHEN cur_prod_qty_erp >= cons_spare1 + cur_total_cons_qty
					 THEN cons_spare1
				ELSE cur_prod_qty_erp - cur_total_cons_qty
			END AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS sendable_qty
		FROM candidates
	)
	SELECT TOP (1)
		 @wip_wo_id       = f.wip_wo_id
		,@cons_lot        = f.cons_lot
		,@item_id         = f.item_id
		,@ent_id          = f.ent_id
		,@cons_created_at = f.cons_created_at
		,@sendable_qty    = f.sendable_qty
	FROM final AS f
	WHERE f.sendable_qty > 0
	ORDER BY f.cons_created_at;


    -- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
    IF ( @ent_id IS NULL
			OR @ent_id = -1)
    BEGIN
		--0.01.03 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
        RETURN;
    END
    -- STEP 2: Get Storage Location
    SET @storage_locn = NULL
    SELECT
        @storage_locn = attr_value
    FROM
        ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE
        ent_id      = @ent_id
        AND attr_id = @attr_sap_location

    IF @storage_locn IS NULL
    BEGIN
		SELECT
			@storage_locn = ent_name
        FROM
            ent WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE
            ent_id = @ent_id
    END
    -- STEP 2.1: Start Transaction:
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    -- Declare Variables for this step
    DECLARE @processed_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID()

	--0.01.03 Add CURSOR
	
	DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT
		cwr.item_cons_row_id,
		ic.qty_cons,
		ic.qty_cons_erp,
		SUM(cwr.cons_to_report)
	FROM @item_cons_wip_reported AS cwr
	JOIN item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK) ON ic.row_id = cwr.item_cons_row_id
	WHERE cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id = @wip_wo_id
	  AND ic.lot_no = @cons_lot
	  AND ic.item_id = @item_id
	  AND ic.from_ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND ic.qty_cons_erp < ic.qty_cons
	GROUP BY cwr.item_cons_row_id, ic.qty_cons, ic.qty_cons_erp
	ORDER BY cwr.item_cons_row_id


	OPEN cur;
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @row_id, @cur_cons_qty, @cur_cons_qty_sent, @cons_spare1;
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @sendable_qty > 0
	BEGIN
		-- Declare variables for the step
		DECLARE
			--@qty_erp_total FLOAT         = 0.0
			--,@qty_reported     FLOAT         = 0.0
			@comment_reported NVARCHAR(400) = ''

		-- STEP 3: Get the extra information from the staging TABLE - needs to be moved after item_cons update
		--00.01.03 Disablet as we don't need to select the wip_table_row_id now
		/*
		SELECT
			TOP 1 @wip_table_row_id = icr.row_id
		  ,@wip_table_wo_id         = icr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id
		  ,@wip_reported_created_at = icr.sap_reported_created_at_utc
		FROM
			ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported icr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
			icr.item_cons_row_id                    = @row_id
			AND icr.spare1                          = @cons_spare1
			AND icr.sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
		ORDER BY
			icr.created_at_utc DESC
		*/
		-- STEP 3.1: Calculate and update consumable quantity record by record
        IF @sendable_qty >= @cons_spare1 --Update only if sendable_qty is bigger than current cons_spare.
        BEGIN
			IF ((@cur_cons_qty_sent+@cons_spare1) <= @cur_cons_qty) --check if we can send whole requested cons
			BEGIN
				SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Last quantity reported to SAP: ' + CAST((@cons_spare1) AS NVARCHAR(1000)) -- v1.02 MOD
				
				UPDATE item_cons
				SET qty_cons_erp = @cur_cons_qty_sent + @cons_spare1
				,spare1 = NULL --00.01.03 as spare1 in item_cons is not used
				,last_edit_comment = @comment_reported
				WHERE row_id = @row_id;

				SET @sendable_qty   = @sendable_qty - @cons_spare1;
				SET @sent_qty_total = @sent_qty_total + @cons_spare1;

			END
			ELSE --if we can't send whole requested we update it anyway using left quantity
			BEGIN	
				SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Total consumption went above of qty_cons. Total extra was: ' + CAST((@cur_cons_qty_sent + @cons_spare1 - @cur_cons_qty) AS NVARCHAR(1000))
				
				UPDATE item_cons
				SET qty_cons_erp = @cur_cons_qty
				,spare1 = NULL --00.01.03 as spare1 in item_cons is not used
				,last_edit_comment = @comment_reported
				WHERE row_id = @row_id;

				SET @sendable_qty   = @sendable_qty - @cons_spare1;
				SET @sent_qty_total = @sent_qty_total + @cur_cons_qty - @cur_cons_qty_sent;
			END
			-- STEP 4: Update staging table		
			--IF (@wip_table_row_id IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE cwr
				SET [last_edit_comment]        = 'Data processed and sent to SAP'
					,[last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
					,[sap_reported_processed_id] = @processed_id
				FROM [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported] cwr
				JOIN @item_cons_wip_reported cwr2 ON cwr2.row_id=cwr.row_id
				WHERE cwr2.item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id
			END
        END
		ELSE -- partly consumption for the record because insufficient production. Record is still waiting to be consumed in its entirety.
		BEGIN
			SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Last quantity reported to SAP: ' + CAST((@sendable_qty) AS NVARCHAR(1000)) -- v1.02 MOD
				
			UPDATE item_cons
			SET qty_cons_erp = @cur_cons_qty_sent + @sendable_qty
			,spare1 = NULL --00.01.03 as spare1 in item_cons is not used
			,last_edit_comment = @comment_reported
			WHERE row_id = @row_id;

			--IF (@wip_table_row_id IS NOT NULL)
			--0.01.03 update the newest record with left value
			BEGIN
				UPDATE
					[dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported]
				SET [last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
					,[qty_cons_erp] = @cur_cons_qty_sent + @sendable_qty
					,[spare1] = CAST((@cons_spare1 - @sendable_qty) AS NVARCHAR(40))
				WHERE
					[row_id] = (SELECT MAX(row_id) FROM @item_cons_wip_reported WHERE item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id)
			--0.01.03 set rest records as processed
				UPDATE cwr
				SET [last_edit_comment]        = 'Data processed and sent to SAP'
				,[last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
				,[sap_reported_processed_id] = @processed_id
				FROM [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported] cwr
				JOIN @item_cons_wip_reported cwr2 ON cwr2.row_id=cwr.row_id
				WHERE cwr2.item_cons_row_id=@row_id
				AND cwr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id
				AND cwr.row_id not in (SELECT MAX(row_id) FROM @item_cons_wip_reported WHERE item_cons_row_id=@row_id AND sap_reported_wip_wo_id=@wip_wo_id)
			END

			SET @sent_qty_total = @sent_qty_total + @sendable_qty
			SET @sendable_qty=0
			
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @row_id, @cur_cons_qty, @cur_cons_qty_sent, @cons_spare1;

		-- 0.01.03 update history execution table
		SELECT @interface_row_id=id from ofi_ei_interface_last_execution WHERE interface = @interface AND wo_id=@wip_wo_id AND lot_no=@cons_lot AND item_id=@item_id

		IF @interface_row_id IS NOT NULL --if already exist update timestamp
			UPDATE dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution
			SET last_sent_at = GETDATE()
			WHERE id = @interface_row_id;
		ELSE -- else create new record
			INSERT INTO ofi_ei_interface_last_execution (wo_id, lot_no, item_id, interface, last_sent_at)
			VALUES (@wip_wo_id, @cons_lot, @item_id, @interface, GETDATE())

    END
	CLOSE cur;
    DEALLOCATE cur;
	
	-- STEP 6.1: Commit transaction.
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    SELECT
        @wip_wo_id								Order_Number --0.01.03
        ,[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]()			Plant
        ,@cons_lot								Batch_Number
        ,@item_id								Material
        ,@sent_qty_total						Quantity --0.01.03
        ,u.description							UOM
        ,CASE
            WHEN @sent_qty_total < 0.0
                THEN '262'
                ELSE '261'
        END                                AS Movement_Type
        ,FORMAT(@cons_created_at,'yyyyMMdd')    Posting_Date
        ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd')           File_GenerationDate
        ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')             File_GenerationTime
        ,@storage_locn                          Storage_Location
        ,''                                     Document_Number
        ,''                                     Message
        ,''                                     Message
    FROM
        item i WITH (NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN
            uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON
                i.uom_id = u.uom_id
    WHERE
        i.item_id = @item_id
	
	--0.01.03 release applock
	EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

		--0.01.03 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

        SELECT
            @error_msg     = ERROR_MESSAGE()
          ,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
          ,@error_state    = ERROR_STATE()
        ;
        
        RAISERROR( @error_msg ,@error_severity ,@error_state )
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Uom]
(@uom_id  int ,
 @description  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @abbreviation  nvarchar(20)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Uom
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT  uom.uom_id
       ,uom.description
       ,uom.abbreviation
       ,uom.last_edit_comment
       ,uom.last_edit_by
       ,uom.last_edit_at
FROM uom uom
WHERE ((uom.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (uom.description = @description OR @description IS NULL) AND
       (uom.abbreviation = @abbreviation OR @abbreviation IS NULL) AND
       (uom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (uom.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Step_Grp]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @step_grp_id int ,
   @step_grp_desc nvarchar(80) ,
   @step_grp_seq int,
   @repeatability int,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 05/16/2003	Raghu		 (HD# 2570) Disallow insertion of a step having a seq_no less than or equal to any existing step in job_step_data for this job.
-- 06-06-2003   Sheetal Jain     1600  Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )


IF EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK), job_step js WITH (NOLOCK), job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND jsd.step_no = js.step_no
		  AND js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
		  AND jsd.wo_id = @wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND (jsg.step_grp_seq > @step_grp_seq  OR (jsg.step_grp_seq = @step_grp_seq AND jsg.step_grp_id >= @step_grp_id))) BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('Steps with the lower step grp seq_no or step_grp_id of this step group are already started{3891}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

INSERT INTO job_step_grp
 (wo_id,
  oper_id,
  seq_no,
  step_grp_id,
  step_grp_desc,
  step_grp_seq,
  repeatability,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@wo_id,
   @oper_id,
   @seq_no,
   @step_grp_id,
   @step_grp_desc,
   @step_grp_seq,
   @repeatability,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Spec]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @step_no int,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @act_spec_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @assoc_file nvarchar(254) ,
   @assoc_file_type nvarchar(254) ,
   @comments nvarchar(2000) ,
   @min_value nvarchar(80),
   @max_value nvarchar(80),
   @access_level int,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
UPDATE job_spec
SET spec_value = @spec_value,
    act_spec_value = @act_spec_value,
    assoc_file = @assoc_file,
    assoc_file_type = @assoc_file_type,
    comments = @comments,
    min_value = @min_value,
    max_value = @max_value,
    access_level = @access_level,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(wo_id = @wo_id AND
        oper_id = @oper_id AND
        seq_no = @seq_no AND
        step_no = @step_no AND
        spec_id = @spec_id AND
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Qm_Spec_GetFilterCount]
(@qm_spec_name          STRING40_NULL =NULL
,@qm_spec_desc          STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@ver_id                STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@start_eff_local       TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@start_eff_local_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@end_eff_local         TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@end_eff_local_tz		INT32 = NULL
,@ent_id                INT32_NULL = NULL
,@item_id               STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@item_category_id      INT32 = NULL
,@process_id            STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id               STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@active_specs			LOGICAL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL
,@no_of_rows            INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - SP_SA_QM_SPEC_GetCount
-- Description      - The purpose of this method is to count the number of rows in the QM_Spec filter so that dialog
--						can be displayed if the count is <= what is configured in the system attribute.
--					 If active_specs is true it will return active specs otherwise it will return all specs
-- Date Created     - 05/05/2011
-- Version          - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @tz_temp		INT32
		,	@start_eff_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@end_eff_utc	TDATETIME

	SET @start_eff_local_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_eff_local_tz)
	SET @end_eff_local_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_eff_local_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SET @tz_temp = -@start_eff_local_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @start_eff_local, @tz_temp, @start_eff_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@end_eff_local_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @end_eff_local, @tz_temp, @end_eff_utc OUTPUT

	SET @active_specs = COALESCE(@active_specs, 0)
	IF (@active_specs = 0) BEGIN

	  SELECT @no_of_rows = COUNT(*)
	   FROM qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	   WHERE (qm_spec.qm_spec_name LIKE @qm_spec_name OR @qm_spec_name IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.qm_spec_desc LIKE @qm_spec_desc OR @qm_spec_desc IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.ver_id LIKE @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.start_eff_utc >= @start_eff_utc OR @start_eff_utc IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.end_eff_utc <= @end_eff_utc OR @end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.item_category_id LIKE @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.process_id LIKE @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL);
	  END
	  ELSE  BEGIN
	  SELECT  @no_of_rows = COUNT(*)
	   FROM qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	   WHERE (qm_spec.qm_spec_name LIKE @qm_spec_name OR @qm_spec_name IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.qm_spec_desc LIKE @qm_spec_desc OR @qm_spec_desc IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.ver_id LIKE @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.start_eff_utc >= @start_eff_utc OR @start_eff_utc IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.end_eff_utc <= @end_eff_utc OR @end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		 AND ((qm_spec.end_eff_utc IS NOT NULL AND qm_spec.end_eff_utc > GETUTCDATE()) OR qm_spec.end_eff_utc IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.item_category_id LIKE @item_category_id OR @item_category_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.process_id LIKE @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		 AND (qm_spec.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL);
	END
END

-- ===========================================================================================

-- 0.01.00		AP				2024-01-10			Initial version.
-- 0.01.10	Veervar Joshi		2024-01-24			Select entity description/name changes.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_st_trans_dest]
(	
	@ent_id INT
	,@src_ent_id int
	,@src_item_id NVARCHAR(80)
	,@src_grade_cd INT

)
AS
	
BEGIN

	DECLARE @invtable TABLE
	(
		rowid           INT IDENTITY
	  , ent_id          INT
	  , item_id         NVARCHAR(80)
	  , item_desc       NVARCHAR(80)
	  , mes_qty         TFLOAT
	  , date_in_utc     DATETIME
	  , uom_id          INT
	  , grade_desc      NVARCHAR(40)
	  , inv_grade_cd    INT
	  , uom_desc        STRING40	 
	  , color           NVARCHAR(40)
	); -- 0.09
	DECLARE @var_su_selected TABLE
	(
		rowid                 INT IDENTITY
	  , is_chk                BIT NULL
	  , storage_ent_id        INT NOT NULL
	  , secondary_silo        STRING40 NULL
	  , secondary_silo_ent_id INT NULL
	  , ratio                 TFLOAT NULL
	  , silo_seq              INT NULL
	  , jb_item_id            [dbo].[STRING40]
	  , jb_item_group         [dbo].[STRING40]
	  , jb_grade_cd           [INT]
	);

	DECLARE @is_running_disabled INT = 0  -- disable silo for bean intake running job, process spcecific check
	DECLARE @job_state_cd INT
	DECLARE @jobrequiredQty FLOAT
	DECLARE @qty_prod FLOAT
	DECLARE @isbatchprocess INT = 0 -- is batch process
	----------  for destination silos
	--DECLARE @src_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- src bom item id
	--DECLARE @src_grade_cd INT			-- src grade cd 
	
	DECLARE @srcItemGroup NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
	DECLARE @itegGrpAttrId INT=0
BEGIN

--SELECT
--		@src_grade_cd = src_grade_cd
--	  , @src_item_id = src_item_id
--	  --, @dest_su_ent_id = dest_su_ent_id
--	FROM ofi_st_trans_selection
--	WHERE
--		ent_id = @ent_id
--		AND is_active = 1
	
	--fetch source item group
	SELECT	@itegGrpAttrId = attr_id	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' AND	 a.attr_grp = 1

	SELECT @srcItemGroup = ia.attr_value FROM item_attr  ia
	inner join item i on i.item_id= ia.item_id
	where ia.attr_id=@itegGrpAttrId and ia.item_id=@src_item_id
	
	--INSERT SELECTION INTO TEMP TABLE
	INSERT INTO @invtable
	SELECT
		inv.ent_id
	  , inv.item_id
	  , MAX(item.item_desc)                  item_desc
	  , SUM(ISNULL(inv.qty_left, 0))         mes_qty
	  , MIN(inv.date_in_utc)                 date_in_utc	
	  , MAX(inv.uom_id)                      uom_id
	  , ig.item_grade_desc                   grade
	  , inv.grade_cd                         inv_grade_cd	 
	  , MAX(uom.description)                 uom_desc	 
	  , dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) AS color --0.09
	FROM item_inv inv WITH(NOLOCK) --left join storage_exec se with(nolock) on inv.ent_id = se.ent_id
	INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON inv.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom WITH(NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id	
	LEFT JOIN item_grade ig ON inv.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd	
	WHERE inv.ent_id IN (SELECT	storage_ent_id
						 FROM Ofi_st_trans_mapping WITH(NOLOCK)--ofi_ent_item_storage_link
						 WHERE	 ent_id = @ent_id AND type = 'destination')
	GROUP BY
		inv.ent_id
	  , inv.item_id
	  , ig.item_grade_desc
	  , ig.color
	  , inv.grade_cd


	SELECT		
		0 as is_chk_dest
	  , oei.storage_ent_id
	  , oei.item_group
	  , ent_name
	  , ISNULL(ent.description,ent.ent_name) AS              silo		
	  , invt.item_id AS                                    item_id
	  , invt.item_desc AS                                  item_desc
	  , ISNULL(i.num_decimals, 3) AS                       num_decimals		
	  , invt.inv_grade_cd AS                               inv_grade_cd
	  , invt.grade_desc AS                                 grade
	  , store_exe.max_capacity AS                          silo_capacity
	  , ''                                                 dsc_qty
	  , ISNULL(invt.mes_qty, 0) AS                         mes_qty	
	  , NULL AS                                            wo_id
	  , NULL AS                                            oper_id
	  , @ent_id AS                                         ent_id
	  , NULL AS                                            seq_no
	  , fcdv.notValidDescDetails AS                        info--fcdv.notValidDescDetails
	  , fcdv.isNotValidEnt AS                              is_disabled--fcdv.isNotValidEnt		 
	  , ISNULL(invt.uom_desc,dbo.[fn_s_ofi_GetUOM](oei.storage_ent_id)) AS  uom_desc
	  , ISNULL( (SELECT
					 attr_value
				 FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
				 INNER JOIN attr WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
				 AND attr.attr_desc = 'BiDirectionalSilo'
				 WHERE ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id), 0) AS BiDirectionalSilo
	  , @is_running_disabled AS                            is_running_disabled	 
	  , @isbatchprocess                                    isbatchprocess
	  , color	  	  
	  , (select  STRING_AGG( su_status_cd,',')  from ent e inner join  ofi_su_mes_states_mapping om with(nolock) on e.ent_id=om.su_ent_id where 
			 su_ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id and
			 interlock_type = 'destination' and om.is_Active=1) as silo_status_auto
	FROM Ofi_st_trans_mapping oei WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent WITH(NOLOCK) ON oei.storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN storage_exec store_exe WITH(NOLOCK) ON oei.storage_ent_id = store_exe.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN @invtable invt ON invt.ent_id = oei.storage_ent_id
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_st_chKDestinationValidity(oei.storage_ent_id, invt.item_id, invt.inv_grade_cd, @src_item_id, @src_grade_cd, @ent_id,@src_ent_id ) AS fcdv -- fucntion check destination validation
	LEFT JOIN uom WITH(NOLOCK) ON uom.uom_id = invt.uom_id
	LEFT JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = invt.item_id
	WHERE
		oei.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND oei.[type] = 'destination' AND oei.item_group=@srcItemGroup
	ORDER BY
		 invt.date_in_utc ASC

END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_ExecExtendFunc]
(
@SessionId int
,@User_Name nvarchar(50)
,@functionType nvarchar(50) = 'SessionValidation'
,@runatloadorder int = null
--@scheduleDay datetime = '2017-02-15',
)
AS
BEGIN
declare  @ent_name NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @SQLString nvarchar(max);  
DECLARE @ParmDefinition nvarchar(max); 
DECLARE @rowid int
Declare @I_SPNAME NVARCHAR(max)
Declare @FunctionToExecute Table( rowid int, spname nvarchar(max))

Insert into @FunctionToExecute (rowid,spname)
select RunAtLoadOrder, StoredProcedure from [SDB].[dbo].[Scheduler_Custom_Functions] with (nolock)  where case when ISNUMERIC(RunAtLoadOrder) = 1 then RunAtLoadOrder else 0 end > 0 and FunctionType = isnull(@functiontype,FunctionType) and RunAtLoadOrder =  isnull(@runatloadorder,RunAtLoadOrder) order by RunAtLoadOrder

SET @rowid = (select top 1 (rowid) from @FunctionToExecute) 

while  @rowid is not null
BEGIN

	select @I_SPNAME = spname from @FunctionToExecute where rowid = @rowid

SET @SQLString = N'exec ' + @I_SPNAME + ' @SessionId, @user_name, @functionType'		
	SET @ParmDefinition = N'@SessionId int, @user_name  nvarchar(50), @functionType nvarchar(50)';
--print cast(cast(getdate() as datetime2(3)) as varchar(100)) + '   start autorun ' + @SQLString;
EXECUTE sp_executesql @SQLString, @ParmDefinition,  
                     @SessionId = @SessionId, @user_name = @User_Name, @functionType = @functionType;

						delete from @FunctionToExecute where rowid = @rowid
						SET @rowid = (select top 1(rowid) from @FunctionToExecute) 
--print cast(cast(getdate() as datetime2(3)) as varchar(100)) + '   end autorun ' + @SQLString;
END
	

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetUncompLsNos]
(
		@ent_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no          STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@hard_pegged     LOGICAL = 0

) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_GETUNCOMPLSNOS
-- Description    - Case: 7.4.1 - Available to produce SNO's. Returns a list of available uncompleted serial nos.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 03/06/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
--04/19/2007    Raghu           3.2.9   HD# 9733, SNo's transferring to the next operation
--05/31/2007    Raghu           3.2.15  Per KRF's mail 05/30/2007 - changes related to assinged_lot query.
--08/31/2007	AML				3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @parent_ent_id		INT32
		,	@may_override_route LOGICAL

    SET @hard_pegged = ISNULL( ABS( @hard_pegged ), 0 )


    --Retrieve the parent entity id from the supplied entity where the job is currently running.
    SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id
    FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

    --Verify whether the linear flow is enabled on this work order.
    SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
    FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

    --Since the item_inv, wo and job table may grow bigger, and for better performance
    --handle the may_override_route flag (linear_flow) as a separate case
    --which will eliminate an unncessary join to the wo and job_route tables.
    IF (@may_override_route = 1) BEGIN
        IF (@hard_pegged = 1) BEGIN
            SELECT available_lots_for_ser_items.serial_no
                    ,last_modified_item_prod.reas_cd
                    ,last_modified_item_prod.reas_desc
                    ,available_lots_for_ser_items.qty_prod
            FROM (
                SELECT available_lots.lot_no AS serial_no, COALESCE(item_prod_job_lot.qty_prod, 0) AS qty_prod
                FROM
                (   --those in inventory located at the run on entity.
                    SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no
                    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE ii.ent_id = @ent_id
                      AND ii.item_id = @item_id
                      AND ii.qty_left > 0
                    --or its immediate parent that have a work order matching that of the running job ,
                    --and an item matching the item selected in the drop down
                    UNION
                    SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no
                    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE ii.ent_id = @parent_ent_id
                      AND ii.item_id = @item_id
                      AND ii.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND ii.qty_left > 0
                    --those in the assigned lot table that are unstarted,
                    --or that are in process for the current job, that have an item matching the item
                    --selected in the dropdown, and that are assigned to the current work order and have either
                    --a null operation or an operation matching the current operation
                    UNION
                    SELECT DISTINCT al.lot_no AS lot_no
                    FROM assigned_lot al WITH (NOLOCK)
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK) ON al.wo_id = jsd.wo_id AND al.lot_no = jsd.lot_no
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = ip.oper_id AND
                                                    jsd.seq_no = ip.seq_no AND jsd.lot_no = ip.lot_no
                    WHERE al.item_id = @item_id
                      AND al.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND (al.oper_id = @oper_id OR al.oper_id IS NULL)
                      AND (al.status = 0 OR (al.status = 1 AND jsd.lot_no IS NOT NULL
                      AND jsd.state_cd <> 9 AND (ip.qty_prod < 1 OR ip.qty_prod IS NULL)))
                    --those in the inventory for the component part from which the serial number is to be inherited
                    UNION
                    SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no
                    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = ii.item_id
                    WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
                      AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
                      AND jb.bom_pos > 0
                      AND jb.serial_no_source = 1
                    --or its substitutes that are located at the run on entity; or its immediate parent
                    UNION
                    SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no
                    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.item_id = ii.item_id
                    INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND jbst.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND jbst.seq_no = jb.seq_no
                        AND jbst.bom_pos = jb.bom_pos AND jbst.alt_no = jb.current_subst
                    WHERE jbst.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND jbst.oper_id = @oper_id
                      AND jbst.seq_no = @seq_no

-- Name:    sp_IU_ofi_InterlockManagement
-- Description:  Update Interlock Managamenet destination
--
-- Usage:  
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  DS           2022-08-17    Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_IU_ofi_InterlockManagement] @su_source NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
	,@su_destination NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
	,@su_ent_id INT = NULL
	,@inerted_by NVARCHAR(40) =NULL
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @source NVARCHAR(40)
		,@destination NVARCHAR(40)
		,@source_count INT
		,@destination_count INT

	SET @source = REPLACE(@su_source, ';#', ',');
	SET @destination = REPLACE(@su_destination, ';#', ',');

	DECLARE @sourcetable TABLE (row_id INT identity(1,1),source_val INT)
	DECLARE @destinationtable TABLE (row_id INT identity(1,1),destination_val INT)
	

	INSERT INTO @sourcetable
	SELECT value
	FROM STRING_SPLIT(@source, ',');

	INSERT INTO @destinationtable
	SELECT value
	FROM STRING_SPLIT(@destination, ',');

	IF((SELECT count(source_val) FROM @sourcetable)>0)
	BEGIN
	--Remove previous data 
		DELETE ofi_su_mes_states_mapping FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm
		LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss ON sm.su_status_cd =ss.su_status_cd
		WHERE sm.su_ent_id =@su_ent_id and interlock_type ='Source'

		DECLARE @sourcecounter int

		SET @sourcecounter = 1

		WHILE(@sourcecounter <= (SELECT count(source_val)
			FROM @sourcetable))
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @sel_sourceval INT

			SELECT @sel_sourceval = source_val FROM @sourcetable WHERE row_id = @sourcecounter

			INSERT INTO ofi_su_mes_states_mapping (
			su_ent_id
			,su_status_cd
			,last_edit_at_utc
			,last_edit_at_local
			,su_status_value
			,interlock_type
			,last_edit_by
			)
			VALUES(
			@su_ent_id
			,@sel_sourceval
			,GETDATE()
			,GETDATE()
			,1
			,'Source'
			,@inerted_by)

			SET @sourcecounter = @sourcecounter + 1
		END
		END
		IF((SELECT count(destination_val) FROM @destinationtable)>0)
		BEGIN
			DELETE ofi_su_mes_states_mapping FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm
			LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss ON sm.su_status_cd =ss.su_status_cd
			WHERE sm.su_ent_id =@su_ent_id and interlock_type ='Destination'
			--Insert destination status
			DECLARE @destcounter int

			SET @destcounter = 1

			WHILE(@destcounter <= (SELECT count(destination_val)
				FROM @destinationtable))
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @sel_destval INT

				SELECT @sel_destval = destination_val FROM @destinationtable WHERE row_id = @destcounter

				INSERT INTO ofi_su_mes_states_mapping (
				su_ent_id
				,su_status_cd
				,last_edit_at_utc
				,last_edit_at_local
				,su_status_value
				,interlock_type
				,last_edit_by
				)
				VALUES(
				@su_ent_id
				,@sel_destval
				,GETDATE()
				,GETDATE()
				,1
				,'Destination'
				,@inerted_by)

				SET @destcounter = @destcounter + 1
			END
		END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftSchedEnts]
(
	@ent_id INT
,	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftSchedEntities
-- Description					- Get Shift Schedulable Entities. Loops down thru all the child entities and returns a
--								  recordset contains all of its child entities which can schedule shifts
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 05/20/2003
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	DECLARE	@parent_ent_id	INT
		,	@ent_list		NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@ent_temp_list	NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@sSQL			NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @ent_list = @ent_id
	SET @ent_temp_list = @ent_id

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
		IF @ent_temp_list = '' BREAK
		SET @sSQL = 'DECLARE ent_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (parent_ent_id IN (' + @ent_temp_list
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ') AND NOT ent_id IN (' + @ent_temp_list + ')) AND can_sched_shifts = 0'
		EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL
		SET @ent_temp_list = ''
		OPEN ent_cursor
		WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM ent_cursor INTO @parent_ent_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			IF @ent_temp_list <> '' SET @ent_temp_list = @ent_temp_list + ','
			SET @ent_temp_list = @ent_temp_list + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @parent_ent_id)
		END
		CLOSE ent_cursor
		DEALLOCATE ent_cursor
		IF @ent_temp_list <> '' SET @ent_list = @ent_list + ',' + @ent_temp_list
	END
	SET @sSQL =
			'SELECT ent_id, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local, DATEADD(mi, ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @time_zone_bias_value) +
			', cur_shift_start_time_utc) cur_shift_start_time
			FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id IN (' + @ent_list + ')'

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL
END

--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--10/12/2006	Raghu		3.1.24	List all users irrespective whether a user has an access or not.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
@parent_ent_id int,
@level int
--@level variable is used as dummy in order to use existing stored procedure, which populates
--the temporary table with the child entities for given ent_id
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
/*
SET @level =1
---create the temporary table to store the ent id

	 CREATE TABLE #temp_ent_child(ent_id int,child_level int)
	INSERT INTO #temp_ent_child VALUES (@ent_id,@level)
	Declare tem_cur  CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WHERE parent_ent_id = @ent_id
	OPEN tem_cur
	FETCH FROM tem_cur INTO @parent_ent_id
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #temp_ent_child VALUES(@parent_ent_id,@level)
		--call sp_SA_Ent_Get_Status_Sub which loads recursively all childs in to temporary table
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_Get_Status_Sub @parent_ent_id,@level
		FETCH FROM tem_cur INTO @parent_ent_id
	END
	CLOSE tem_cur
	DEALLOCATE tem_cur
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	--populating all childs into #temp_ent_child is done
	--return the results
	SELECT result.user_id,MAX(result.access_status)ent_access,MAX(result.max_child_access) max_subtree_access,MIN(result.min_child_access) min_subtree_access
	FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT(a.user_id),a.access_status,b.max_child_access,b.min_child_access
		FROM
			(SELECT a.grp_id,b.user_id,cast(accss AS int) access_status

			  FROM grp_ent_link a,user_grp_link b
			  WHERE a.ent_id in(SELECT ent_id FROM  #temp_ent_child)
			    AND a.grp_id = b.grp_id
			  GROUP BY a.grp_id,b.user_id) b
		WHERE a.user_id *= b.user_id AND
		      a.grp_id *= b.grp_id)result
	GROUP BY result.user_id
	ORDER BY result.user_id
--Drop the temporary table
	DROP TABLE #temp_ent_child
*/
         DECLARE  @entities     TABLE (tree_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, child_level INT)
            DECLARE  @child_level INT
                        ,@tree_ent_id    INT

            DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
            SELECT ent_id FROM ent WHERE parent_ent_id = @ent_id

            OPEN ent_tree_cursor
            WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
                        FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @tree_ent_id
                        IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
                        SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @tree_ent_id
                        INSERT INTO @entities (tree_ent_id, ent_id, child_level)
                        SELECT @tree_ent_id, e.ent_id, @child_level FROM ent e WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

                        SET @child_level = 2
                        WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
                                    INSERT INTO @entities (tree_ent_id, ent_id, child_level)
                                    SELECT @tree_ent_id, el.child_ent_id, @child_level
                                    FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
                                    WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
                                                (SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND tree_ent_id = @tree_ent_id)
                                    IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
                                    SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
                        END
            END
            CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
            DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

/*	SELECT result.user_id,MAX(result.access_status)ent_access,MAX(result.max_child_access) max_subtree_access,MIN(result.min_child_access) min_subtree_access
	FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT(a.user_id),a.access_status,b.max_child_access,b.min_child_access
		FROM
			(SELECT a.grp_id,b.user_id,cast(accss AS int) access_status
			  FROM grp_ent_link a,user_grp_link b WHERE a.ent_id =
                    		  @ent_id AND a.grp_id = b.grp_id) a,
			(SELECT a.grp_id,b.user_id,MAX(cast(a.accss AS int)) max_child_access,MIN(cast(a.accss AS int)) min_child_access
			  FROM grp_ent_link a,user_grp_link b, @entities e
--			  WHERE a.ent_id in(SELECT ent_id FROM  @entities)
			  WHERE a.ent_id = e.ent_id
			    AND a.grp_id = b.grp_id
			  GROUP BY a.grp_id,b.user_id) b
		WHERE a.user_id *= b.user_id AND
		      a.grp_id *= b.grp_id)result
	GROUP BY result.user_id
	ORDER BY result.user_id
*/

/*SELECT result.user_id,MAX(result.access_status)ent_access,MAX(result.max_child_access) max_subtree_access,MIN(result.min_child_access) min_subtree_access
	FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT(a.user_id),a.access_status,b.max_child_access,b.min_child_access
		FROM
			(SELECT a.grp_id,b.user_id,cast(accss AS int) access_status
			  FROM grp_ent_link a,user_grp_link b WHERE a.ent_id =
                    		  @ent_id AND a.grp_id = b.grp_id) a
			LEFT OUTER JOIN
			(SELECT a.grp_id,b.user_id,MAX(cast(a.accss AS int)) max_child_access,MIN(cast(a.accss AS int)) min_child_access
			  FROM grp_ent_link a,user_grp_link b, @entities e
--			  WHERE a.ent_id in(SELECT ent_id FROM  @entities)
			  WHERE a.ent_id = e.ent_id
			    AND a.grp_id = b.grp_id
			  GROUP BY a.grp_id,b.user_id) b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.grp_id = b.grp_id
	)result
	GROUP BY result.user_id
	ORDER BY result.user_id*/

	SELECT DISTINCT un.user_id, ISNULL(ent_access_for_supplied_ent.ent_access, 0) ent_access
		,ent_access_for_child_ent.max_subtree_access, ent_access_for_child_ent.min_subtree_access
	FROM user_name un WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
		(SELECT DISTINCT ugl.user_id, MAX(CAST(gel.accss AS INT)) ent_access
		FROM user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN grp_ent_link gel WITH (NOLOCK) ON gel.grp_id = ugl.grp_id
		WHERE gel.ent_id = @ent_id
		GROUP BY ugl.user_id) ent_access_for_supplied_ent ON un.user_id = ent_access_for_supplied_ent.user_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN
		(SELECT DISTINCT ugl.user_id, MAX(CONVERT(INT, gel.accss)) AS max_subtree_access
			, MIN(CONVERT(INT, gel.accss)) AS min_subtree_access
		FROM grp_ent_link gel
		INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ugl.grp_id = gel.grp_id
		INNER JOIN @entities e ON gel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		GROUP BY ugl.user_id) ent_access_for_child_ent ON un.user_id = ent_access_for_child_ent.user_id
	ORDER BY un.user_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_User_Name_CloneUser]
(
        @session_id             INT32_NULL = NULL
    ,   @source_user_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
    ,   @new_user_id            STRING40_NULL = NULL
    ,   @encrypted_password     STRING254_NULL = NULL
    ,   @time_zone_bias_value   INT32 = 0
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_I_User_Name_CloneUser
-- Description          - Creates a new user based on the given user.
-- Author               - Aaron Lightfoot
-- Date Created         - 08/01/2008
-- Version              - 3.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By     Ver     Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET XACT_ABORT ON

    IF ( @source_user_id IS NULL OR @source_user_id = '' ) BEGIN
        RAISERROR( 'To clone a user, a source user must be selected.{5793}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN -1
    END

    IF ( @new_user_id IS NULL OR @new_user_id = '' ) BEGIN
        RAISERROR( 'To clone a user, a new user ID must be provided.{5794}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN -1
    END

    IF ( @encrypted_password IS NULL OR @encrypted_password = '' ) BEGIN
        RAISERROR( 'To clone a user, a password for the new user must be provided.{5795}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN -1
    END

    DECLARE @user_desc AS STRING80
        ,   @active AS LOGICAL
        ,   @hourly_cost AS TFLOAT
        ,   @email_address AS STRING80
        ,   @lang_id AS INT32
        ,   @def_dept_id AS STRING40
        ,   @last_login AS TDATETIME
        ,   @last_pw_change AS TDATETIME
        ,   @failed_logins AS INT32
        ,   @auth_method AS INT32
        ,   @def_lab_cd AS STRING40
        ,   @smtp_server AS STRING80
        ,   @pop3_server AS STRING80
        ,   @email_account AS STRING80
        ,   @email_pw AS STRING20
        ,   @spare1 AS STRING1000_NULL
        ,   @spare2 AS STRING1000_NULL
        ,   @spare3 AS STRING1000_NULL
        ,   @spare4 AS STRING1000_NULL
        ,   @last_edit_comment AS STRING254
        ,   @last_edit_by AS STRING40
        ,   @last_edit_at AS TDATETIME
        ,   @mod_id AS VARCHAR(30)
        ,   @V_Last_Edit_At as TDATETIME

    EXECUTE sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
    SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

    SELECT  @user_desc = [user_desc], @active = [active], @hourly_cost = [hourly_cost]
        ,   @email_address = null, @lang_id = [lang_id], @def_dept_id = [def_dept_id]
        ,   @last_login = null, @last_pw_change = null, @failed_logins = 0
        ,   @auth_method = [auth_method], @def_lab_cd = [def_lab_cd], @smtp_server = [smtp_server]
        ,   @pop3_server = [pop3_server], @email_account = null, @email_pw = null
        ,   @spare1 = null, @spare2 = null, @spare3 = null, @spare4 = null
    FROM [user_name] WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE [user_id] = @source_user_id

    DECLARE @user_groups TABLE ( id int identity, grp_id int )

    INSERT INTO @user_groups ( grp_id )
    SELECT grp_id
    FROM user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE [user_id] = @source_user_id

    DECLARE @err AS VARCHAR(200)

    IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @new_user_id ) BEGIN
        SET @err = @new_user_id + ' is already in use as a user name.{1877}'
        RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1 )
        RETURN -1
    END

    BEGIN TRY
        EXECUTE sp_I_User_Name  @new_user_id, @user_desc, @encrypted_password, @active, @hourly_cost
                            ,   @email_address, @lang_id, @def_dept_id, @last_pw_change, @auth_method
                            ,   @def_lab_cd, @smtp_server, @pop3_server, @email_account, @email_pw
                            ,   @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment, @time_zone_bias_value
                            ,   @mod_id OUTPUT, @V_Last_Edit_At OUTPUT
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        RAISERROR( 'Creation of new user failed.{5800}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN -1
    END CATCH

    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT INTO user_grp_link ( grp_id, user_id, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
        SELECT ug.grp_id, @new_user_id, null, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
        FROM @user_groups ug
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        RAISERROR( 'Creation of user group link failed.{5799}', 16, 1 )
        RETURN -1
    END CATCH

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Std_Oper_Spec_Ver]
  (@oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_date datetime ,
   @ver_comments nvarchar(80) ,
   @preferred_ver bit ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_U_Std_Oper_Spec_Ver
-- Description      - Update an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            - SP requires that all table fields be included
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
UPDATE std_oper_spec_ver
SET ver_date = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @ver_date),
    ver_comments = @ver_comments,
    preferred_ver = @preferred_ver,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(oper_id = @oper_id AND
        ver_id = @ver_id AND
    last_edit_at = @last_edit_at)


	--Unset the preferrred versions for other versions under this parent item
	-- if this version set as the preferred version.

--Only one can be a preferred version
IF @preferred_ver = 1
BEGIN
	UPDATE std_oper_spec_ver
	SET preferred_ver = 0, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Uom_Conv]
(@from_uom_id  int  ,
 @to_uom_id  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @factor  float  ,
 @offset  float  ,
 @spare1 nvarchar(80),
 @spare2 nvarchar(80),
 @spare3 nvarchar(80),
 @spare4 nvarchar(80),
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime  ,
 @row_id  int )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Uom_Conv
-- Description    - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created   - 10/17/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
-- Notes          -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By  Version    Changes
-- 12/06/2004         KRF                     Included descriptiona and abbriation for returned units of measure, both from and to
--01/09/2017          Srinivasa     6.0       US#923870(Added spares columns to the select query)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT uom_conv.from_uom_id
       ,from_uom.description as from_description
       ,from_uom.abbreviation as from_abbreviation
       ,uom_conv.to_uom_id
       ,to_uom.description as to_description
       ,to_uom.abbreviation as to_abbreviation
       ,uom_conv.item_id
       ,uom_conv.factor
       ,uom_conv.offset
	   ,uom_conv.spare1
	   ,uom_conv.spare2
	   ,uom_conv.spare3
       ,uom_conv.spare4
       ,uom_conv.last_edit_comment
       ,uom_conv.last_edit_by
       ,uom_conv.last_edit_at
       ,uom_conv.row_id
FROM uom_conv uom_conv
       JOIN uom from_uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON uom_conv.from_uom_id = from_uom.uom_id
       JOIN uom to_uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON uom_conv.to_uom_id = to_uom.uom_id
WHERE ((uom_conv.from_uom_id = @from_uom_id OR @from_uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.to_uom_id = @to_uom_id OR @to_uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.factor = @factor OR @factor IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.offset = @offset OR @offset IS NULL) AND
	   (uom_conv.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
	   (uom_conv.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
	   (uom_conv.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
	   (uom_conv.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (uom_conv.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL))

-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_S_ofi_st_trans_selection]
(
	-- declare
	@ent_id INT    
  ,@src_item_id NVARCHAR(80)
  ,@src_su_ent_id INT
  ,@src_grade_cd INT
  ,@dest_item_id NVARCHAR(80)=NULL
  ,@dest_su_ent_id INT=NULL
  ,@dest_grade_cd INT=NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @minattrDesc NVARCHAR(40)='Min_Dosing_Qty'
	DECLARE @minDosQty FLOAT
	DECLARE @srcQty FLOAT
	DECLARE @destQty FLOAT
	DECLARE @invt TABLE (ent_id INT, qty_left FLOAT, grade_cd INT, item_id NVARCHAR(80))
	DECLARE @tblent TABLE (ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(40), ent_desc NVARCHAR(80))
	DECLARE @stselection TABLE (src_su_ent_id INT, dest_su_ent_id INT, src_item_id NVARCHAR(80), dest_item_id NVARCHAR(80), src_grade_cd INT,dest_grade_cd INT)
	
	INSERT INTO @invt SELECT ent_id,qty_left,grade_cd, item_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)  where ent_id in (@src_su_ent_id,@dest_su_ent_id)

	INSERT INTO @tblent SELECT ent_id,ent_name, description FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) where ent_id in (@src_su_ent_id,@dest_su_ent_id)
		
	INSERT INTO @stselection select @src_su_ent_id,@dest_su_ent_id, @src_item_id,@dest_item_id, @src_grade_cd, @dest_grade_cd
	
				
	SELECT @srcQty=ISNULL(SUM(qty_left),0) FROM @invt WHERE ent_id=@src_su_ent_id GROUP BY ent_id, item_id 
	SELECT top 1 @minDosQty=ea.attr_value FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id=a.attr_id where a.attr_desc = @minattrDesc
	 
		
	IF(@dest_item_id IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @destQty=ISNULL(SUM(qty_left),0) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id=@dest_su_ent_id AND  item_id=@dest_item_id 		
		SELECT TOP 1 @dest_grade_cd=grade_cd FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id=@dest_su_ent_id AND  item_id=@dest_item_id 		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @destQty=0
		SET @dest_item_id=@src_item_id
		SET @dest_grade_cd=@src_grade_cd

	END
		
		SELECT 
			
			   e1.ent_name AS         src_su_ent_name
			  , e2.ent_name AS         dest_su_ent_name
			  , i1.item_desc AS        src_item_desc
			  , i1.item_desc AS        dest_item_desc
			  , ig1.item_grade_desc AS src_grade_cd_desc
			  , ig2.item_grade_desc AS dest_grade_cd_desc
			  , u1.description AS      scr_uom
			  , u1.description AS      dest_uom
			  , @srcQty as				src_qty
			  , @destQty as				dest_qty
			  , @minDosQty as			mindosing_qty
			  , src_su_ent_id
			  , dest_su_ent_id			
			  , src_item_id
			  , i1.num_decimals	 
			  , src_grade_cd
			  , dest_item_id			 
			  , dest_grade_cd			
		FROM 
		@stselection ts		
		LEFT JOIN @tblent e1 ON ts.src_su_ent_id = e1.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN @tblent e2  ON ts.dest_su_ent_id = e2.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN item i1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON i1.item_id = ts.src_item_id
		LEFT JOIN item i2 WITH(NOLOCK) ON i2.item_id = ts.dest_item_id
		LEFT JOIN item_grade ig1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ts.src_grade_cd = ig1.item_grade_cd
		LEFT JOIN item_grade ig2 WITH(NOLOCK) ON @dest_grade_cd = ig2.item_grade_cd
		LEFT JOIN uom u1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON i1.uom_id = u1.uom_id
		LEFT JOIN uom u2 WITH(NOLOCK) ON i2.uom_id = u2.uom_id
		
END
