CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Hour_History]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id 		nvarchar(40)
,@oper_id 		nvarchar(40)
,@seq_no 		int
,@job_start_utc		tdatetime
,@hour_start_utc	tdatetime
,@item_id 		nvarchar(40)
,@std_prod_rate 	float
,@batch_size 		float
,@qty_good 		float
,@qty_reject 		float
,@runtime 		float
,@downtime 		float
,@idletime 		float
,@last_edit_at 		datetime OUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_I_Job_Hour_History
-- Description			-
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @hour_end_utc 		DATETIME
	,@hour_start_local	DATETIME
	,@hour_end_local	DATETIME
BEGIN

	SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @hour_start_utc),0)
	SET @hour_end_utc = DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc)
	SELECT @hour_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_start_utc), @hour_end_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_end_utc)
		, @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	INSERT INTO job_hour_history (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc
			, hour_start_utc, hour_start_local
			, hour_end_utc, hour_end_local
			, item_id, std_prod_rate, batch_size
			, qty_good, qty_reject, runtime, downtime, idletime
		, last_edit_at)
	VALUES
	(@ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @job_start_utc
		, @hour_start_utc, @hour_start_local
		, @hour_end_utc, @hour_end_local
		, @item_id, @std_prod_rate, @batch_size
		, @qty_good, @qty_reject, @runtime, @downtime, @idletime
		, @last_edit_at)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Spec_ChangeSpecValue]
(@user_id		NVARCHAR(40),
 @ent_id		INT,
 @spec_id		NVARCHAR(40),
 @new_spec_value	NVARCHAR(40),
 @update_template	BIT,
 @bom_pos		INT = 0,
 @bom_ver_id		NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @comments		NVARCHAR(4000),
 @job_pos		INT = 0,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Description	      -	To change a specific spec parameter's value for the current running job
--			and optionally the Operation from which this job was created (if defined).
--			This allows for runtime changing of spec values by users with appropriate privileges
--			based on the job currently running on an entity.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	01/07/2003
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 01/08/2003	Rohit		1.5.0	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--05/14/2003	Raghu		1.6.7	(HD# 2498). Auto Populating of Job Event table when spec changes
--					Code mods to populate job_event table
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included NULL param for last_edit_comment while calling sp_I_Job_Event
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--08/25/2009	Raghu		4.0.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE  @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id       NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no	INT
	,@count		INT
	,@priv_id	INT
	,@priv_value	INT
	,@process_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@ver_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@step_no	INT
	,@attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SET @priv_id = 24
	EXEC sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @priv_id, @priv_value OUTPUT
	IF (@priv_value = 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to Edit Specs{3172}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	--Get WO_Id, Oper_ID, Seq_No from Job_exec for the input ent_id
	SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos
-- 10/26/2002      TC                     Included job_pos in WHERE clause
	--Raise Error if wo_id is null or IDLE
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR('There is no job running on this entity or the Work Order may not exist{3169}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	IF UPPER(@wo_id) = 'IDLE' BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The job is currently IDLE{3170}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	--Raise Err if spec_id doesnot exist in job_spec for the current wo_id, oper_id and seq_no
	--If Exist, Update actual_spec_value for the input wo_id, oper_id, seq_no and spec_id
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM job_spec
		         WHERE job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id
			and job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
			and job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no
			and job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id
		        ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Spec doesnot exist for this job{3171}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT step_no) FROM job_spec
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	      AND oper_id = @oper_id
	      AND seq_no = @seq_no
	      AND spec_id = @spec_id
	IF (@count = 1) BEGIN --spec_id is defined only once for this job (not repeated for different steps).  update job_spec irrespective of which steps are running
		UPDATE job_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
		    AND seq_no = @seq_no
		    AND spec_id = @spec_id

		--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 235
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @step_no = step_no FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
		  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, @step_no, 'SpecChanged', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, @user_id, NULL, NULL, @spec_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,	NULL, NULL,NULL,NULL,
				NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN -- spec_id is defined for multiple steps in this job then it will only update the actual spec value for currently running step(s)
		UPDATE job_spec SET act_spec_value = @new_spec_value
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
		    AND seq_no = @seq_no
		    AND spec_id = @spec_id
		    AND step_no IN
			(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data
			 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
				    AND seq_no = @seq_no
				    AND state_cd = 3)

		--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 235
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @step_no = MIN(step_no) FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  AND  oper_id = @oper_id  AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND step_no IN
				(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data
				 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)
		  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, @step_no, 'SpecChanged', NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL,
				NULL, @user_id, NULL, NULL, @spec_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL,'More than 1 step may be running on this entity',
				NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END

	END
	IF (@update_template = 1) BEGIN
		--Get Process_Id
		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM WO WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		--Find no. of distinct oper_ent_spec versions
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT ver_id) FROM oper_ent_spec
		WHERE process_id = @process_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		IF (@count = 1) --Only one oper_ent_spec version found and pick up the same
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_ent_spec
			WHERE process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- More than 1 oper_ent_spec version exist, pick up the preferred version
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver
			WHERE process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND preferred_ver = 1
		--Get No of steps (distinct multiple steps) defined for this spec
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT step_no) FROM oper_ent_spec
		WHERE process_id = @process_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND ver_id = @ver_id
		  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		IF (@count = 1) --Only one matching step found and update the spec value for the step
			UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
			WHERE process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND ver_id = @ver_id
			  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- More than 1 step found for this specs..Update all running steps for the oper spec
			UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
			WHERE process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND ver_id = @ver_id
			  AND spec_id = @spec_id
			  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data
					 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
					    AND seq_no = @seq_no
					    AND state_cd = 3)
		SELECT @item_id = item_id FROM job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		      AND oper_id = @oper_id
		      AND seq_no = @seq_no
		--If bom_ver_id is null, get the preferred bom_version from bom_ver table
		IF @bom_ver_id IS NULL SELECT @bom_ver_id = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
		--Find no. of distinct bom_item_oper_spec versions
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT spec_ver_id) FROM bom_item_oper_spec
		WHERE item_id = @item_id
		  AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id
		  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
		  AND process_id = @process_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		IF (@count = 1) --Only one spec version found and pick up the same
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id
			  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
			  AND process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- More than 1 oper_ent_spec version exist, pick up the preferred version from oper_spec_ver
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver
			WHERE process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND preferred_ver = 1
		--Get No of steps (distinct multiple steps) defined for this spec
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT step_no) FROM bom_item_oper_spec
		WHERE item_id = @item_id
		  AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id
		  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
		  AND process_id = @process_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id
		  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		IF (@count = 1)  --Only one matching step found and update the spec value for the step
			UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id
			  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
			  AND process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id
			  AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- More than 1 step found for this specs..Update all running steps for the bom item oper spec
			UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id
			  AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
			  AND process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id
			  AND spec_id = @spec_id
			  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data
					 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
					    AND seq_no = @seq_no
					    AND state_cd = 3)
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_RDBHourlyUtilization]
(@EventHourStartUtc			DATETIME2
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_RDBHourlyUtilization
-- Description	      - The purpose is to slice and dice the utilization events for a given boundary
-- Author             - Raghu G
-- Date Created	      -	05/04/2018
-- Version			  - 6.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver			Changes
-- 01/22/2019	  Eswar Hemadri	   6.01.0001	US 1048413 -  Fixed issue with associating right shift context to the bucket
--												when a shift starts at the top of an hour and the length is < an hour.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @EventHourEndUtc      DATETIME2
	,@MaxDuration		INT32 = 1296000 -- (in seconds for 15 days.  3600 seconds for 1 hr * 24 for 1 day * 15 days)
SET NOCOUNT ON
               SET @EventHourStartUtc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @EventHourStartUtc),0)
               SET @EventHourEndUtc = DATEADD(HH, 1, @EventHourStartUtc)

               DECLARE                            @util_temp TABLE (event_time_utc DATETIME2, ent_id int, event_end_time_utc DATETIME2, log_id INT, duration INT, EventSplitEndUtc DATETIME2
                                                                                                                        , EventEnded INT, EventType NVARCHAR(20), runtime BIT, downtime BIT, event_time_local DATETIME2, last_edit_at DATETIME
                                                                                                                        )

               INSERT INTO @util_temp (event_time_utc, ent_id, event_end_time_utc, log_id, duration, EventSplitEndUtc, EventEnded, EventType
                              , runtime, downtime, event_time_local, last_edit_at)
               SELECT ul.event_time_utc
                              , ul.ent_id
                              , ul.event_end_time_utc
                              , ul.log_id
                              , ul.duration
                              , CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > DATEADD(HH, 1, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, ul.event_time_utc),0)) THEN DATEADD(HH, 1, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, ul.event_time_utc),0)) ELSE ul.event_end_time_utc END AS EventSplitEndUtc
                              , CAST(CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc >  DATEADD(HH, 1, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, ul.event_time_utc),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS INT) EventEnded
                              , CASE WHEN ul.runtime = 1 AND ul.downtime = 0 THEN 'RunTime'
                                     WHEN ul.downtime = 1 AND ul.runtime = 0 THEN 'DownTime'
                                                WHEN ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 THEN 'IdleTime' END AS EventType
                              , ul.runtime
                              , ul.downtime
                              , ul.event_time_local
                              , ul.last_edit_at
               FROM vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK)
               WHERE ((ul.event_time_utc < @EventHourEndUtc AND ul.event_end_time_utc > @EventHourStartUtc)
                 OR (last_edit_at >= @EventHourStartUtc AND last_edit_at <= @EventHourEndUtc))
                 AND duration < @MaxDuration

               ;WITH UtilizationChanges (log_id, event_time_utc, event_end_time_utc, duration, EventSplitStartUtc, EventSplitEndUtc, EventStarted, EventEnded, EventType, ent_id, runtime, downtime, event_time_local, last_edit_at) AS
               (SELECT ul.log_id
                              , ul.event_time_utc
                              , ul.event_end_time_utc
                              , ul.duration
                              , ul.event_time_utc AS EventSplitStartUtc
                              , ul.EventSplitEndUtc
                              , CAST(1 AS INT) EventStarted
                              , ul.EventEnded
                              , ul.EventType
                              , ul.ent_id
                              , ul.runtime
                              , ul.downtime
                              , ul.event_time_local
                              , ul.last_edit_at
               FROM @util_temp ul
               UNION ALL
               SELECT ul.log_id
                              , ul.event_time_utc
                              , ul.event_end_time_utc
                              , ul.duration
                              , EventSplitEndUtc
                              , CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > DATEADD(HH, 1, EventSplitEndUtc) THEN DATEADD(HH, 1, EventSplitEndUtc) ELSE ul.event_end_time_utc END AS EventSplitEndUtc
                              , CAST(0 AS INT) EventStarted
                              , CAST(CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > DATEADD(HH, 1, EventSplitEndUtc) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS INT) EventEnded
                              , CASE WHEN ul.runtime = 1 AND ul.downtime = 0 THEN CAST('RunTime' AS NVARCHAR(20))
                                     WHEN ul.downtime = 1 AND ul.runtime = 0 THEN CAST('DownTime'  AS NVARCHAR(20))
                                                WHEN ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 THEN CAST( 'IdleTime'  AS NVARCHAR(20)) END AS EventType
                              , ul.ent_id
                              , ul.runtime
                              , ul.downtime
                              , ul.event_time_local
                              , ul.last_edit_at
               FROM UtilizationChanges ul
               WHERE EventSplitEndUtc < event_end_time_utc
               )
               , UtilWithShifts AS
               (SELECT us.log_id
                                             , us.event_time_utc
                                             , us.event_end_time_utc
                                             , us.duration
                                             , us.EventSplitStartUtc
                                             , shiftinfo.shift_start_utc AS EventSplitEndUtc
                                             , us.EventStarted
                                             , us.EventEnded
                                             , us.EventType
                                             , us.ent_id
                                             , us.runtime
                                             , us.downtime
                                             , shiftstart.shift_id
                                             , shiftstart.shift_start_utc
                                             , shiftstart.shift_start_local
                                             , us.event_time_local
                                             , us.last_edit_at
                              FROM UtilizationChanges us
                              OUTER APPLY (SELECT sh.shift_start_utc
                                             FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
                                             WHERE sh.ent_id = us.ent_id
                                                AND sh.shift_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(sh1.shift_start_utc)
                                                                                                         FROM shift_history sh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
                                                                                                         WHERE sh1.ent_id = us.ent_id
                                                                                                            AND sh1.shift_start_utc < us.EventSplitEndUtc)) shiftinfo
                              OUTER APPLY (SELECT sh.shift_id, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local
                                             FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
                                             WHERE sh.ent_id = us.ent_id
                                                AND sh.shift_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(sh1.shift_start_utc)
                                                                                                         FROM shift_history sh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
                                                                                                         WHERE sh1.ent_id = us.ent_id
                                                                                                            AND sh1.shift_start_utc <= us.EventSplitStartUtc)) shiftstart
                              WHERE shiftinfo.shift_start_utc > us.EventSplitStartUtc AND shiftinfo.shift_start_utc < us.EventSplitEndUtc
               UNION ALL
               SELECT us.log_id
                                             , us.event_time_utc
                                             , us.event_end_time_utc
                                             , us.duration
                                             , CASE WHEN us.EventSplitStartUtc < shiftinfo.shift_start_utc THEN shiftinfo.shift_start_utc ELSE us.EventSplitStartUtc END AS EventSplitStartUtc --us.EventSplitStart
                                             , us.EventSplitEndUtc
                                             , us.EventStarted
                                             , us.EventEnded
                                             , us.EventType
                                             , us.ent_id
                                             , us.runtime
                                             , us.downtime
                                             , shiftinfo.shift_id
                                             , shiftinfo.shift_start_utc
                                             , shiftinfo.shift_start_local
                                             , us.event_time_local
                                             , us.last_edit_at
                              FROM UtilizationChanges us
                              OUTER APPLY (SELECT sh.shift_id, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local
                                             FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
                                             WHERE sh.ent_id = us.ent_id
                                                AND sh.shift_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(sh1.shift_start_utc)
                                                                                                         FROM shift_history sh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
                                                                                                         WHERE sh1.ent_id = us.ent_id
                                                                                                            AND sh1.shift_start_utc < us.EventSplitEndUtc)) shiftinfo
               )
               , util AS
               (SELECT uws.log_id AS EventId
                              , uws.event_time_utc AS EventStartUtc
                              , uws.event_end_time_utc AS EventEndUtc
                              , uws.duration AS TotalEventDuration
                              , uws.EventSplitStartUtc
                              , uws.EventSplitEndUtc
                              , DATEDIFF(SS, uws.EventSplitStartUtc, uws.EventSplitEndUtc) AS EventSplitDuration
                              , uws.event_time_local AS EventStart
                              , dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(uws.ent_id, uws.event_end_time_utc) AS EventEnd
                              , dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(uws.ent_id, uws.EventSplitStartUtc) AS EventSplitStart
                              , dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(uws.ent_id, uws.EventSplitEndUtc) AS EventSplitEnd
                              , uws.EventStarted
                              , uws.EventEnded
                              , uws.EventType
                              , uws.ent_id
                              , uws.runtime AS RunTime
                              , uws.downtime AS DownTime
                              , uws.shift_id
                              , uws.shift_start_utc
                              , uws.shift_start_local
                              , uws.last_edit_at
               FROM UtilWithShifts uws
               )
               SELECT u.EventId
                              , u.EventStartUtc
                              , u.EventEndUtc
                              , u.TotalEventDuration
                              , u.EventSplitStartUtc
                              , u.EventSplitEndUtc
                              , u.EventSplitDuration
                              , u.EventStart
                              , u.EventEnd
                              , u.EventSplitStart
                              , u.EventSplitEnd
                              , u.EventStarted
                              , u.EventEnded
                              , u.EventType
                              , u.ent_id
                              , u.RunTime
                              , u.DownTime
                              , CASE WHEN RunTime = 1 AND DownTime = 0 THEN u.EventSplitDuration ELSE 0 END RunTimeDuration
                              , CASE WHEN RunTime = 0 AND DownTime = 1 THEN u.EventSplitDuration ELSE 0 END DownTimeDuration
                              , CASE WHEN RunTime = 0 AND DownTime = 0 THEN u.EventSplitDuration ELSE 0 END IdleTimeDuration
                              , u.shift_id
                              , u.shift_start_utc
                              , u.shift_start_local
                              , lel.line_id
                              , u.last_edit_at
               FROM util u
               LEFT OUTER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = u.ent_id
		OPTION (MAXRECURSION 362) -- 24 hours each day * 15 days = 360 + 2 hours extra incase if the event started and ended in the middle of the hour
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_st_trans_queue
-- Description:	The stored procedure will select transfer line info with execution details

-- Usage:		Stock Transfer overview
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)			Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi			2023-12-25			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	LK						2024-01-23			added logic for item grade for src
-- 0.01.02	LK						2024-01-29			added logic for item grade for dest
-- 0.01.03	VJ						2024-03-21			updated for duplicate lines issue
-- 0.01.43	LK						2024-05-21			Added inner join with user_grp_link table and used @grpName parameter as user_id
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_st_trans_queue] 
	 @grpName NVARCHAR(80) ----this paramter used as user_id
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- VARIABLE DECLARATION
	DECLARE @enableTransferAttr varchar(80)='Enable_stock_transfer'
	DECLARE @TransferRunning varchar(80)='RUNNING'
	DECLARE @TransferIdledesc varchar(80)='STOPPED'
	DECLARE @TransferIdle varchar(80)='IDLE'
	DECLARE @IdleColorcode varchar(80)
	
	DECLARE @transferStatusCdIdle INT=0
	DECLARE @transferStatusCdRunning INT=0

	--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE
	SELECT @transferStatusCdRunning=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@TransferRunning

	SELECT @transferStatusCdIdle=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@TransferIdledesc

	--GET COLOR CODE FOR IDLE
	SELECT @IdleColorcode=color FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@TransferIdledesc
	   
	--GET TRANSFER LINES FROM ENT TABLE BY Enable_stock_transfer ATTRIBUTE
 ;WITH cte_stLines as(
SELECT distinct e.ent_id
		,e.description
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	INNER JOIN grp_ent_link gel WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = gel.ent_id
	INNER JOIN grp_name gn WITH(NOLOCK) ON gn.grp_id = gel.grp_id	
	INNER join user_grp_link ugl with(NOLOCK) on ugl.grp_id=gn.grp_id
	WHERE a.attr_desc = @enableTransferAttr
		AND ea.attr_value = '1'		
		--AND (gn.grp_desc is null or gn.grp_desc LIKE '%'+@grpName+'%')	
		AND ugl.grp_id in (select grp_id from user_grp_link with(nolock) where user_id like '%'+ @grpName+'%' )
		AND gel.accss = 1
  ),

  --GET TRANSFER EXECUTION DETAILS FOR RUNNING TRANSFER LINES
  cte_stExc as( 
  SELECT sl.ent_id, sl.description,  transfer_status_cd,st_transfer_type, src_su_ent_id, dest_su_ent_id, src_item_id, src_grade_cd, dest_item_id, dest_grade_cd, target_qty
  , qty_transferred, last_edit_at_utc, created_by, row_id
  FROM ofi_st_trans_selection sts WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN cte_stLines sl on sts.ent_id=sl.ent_id
  WHERE  sts.is_active=1 and transfer_status_cd = @transferStatusCdRunning

  )

 
  --GET FINAL DATA SET
  SELECT SL.ent_id,
  sl.description,
  ISNULL(SE.transfer_status_cd,@transferStatusCdIdle) AS transfer_status_cd,
  CASE 
	  WHEN job_state.state_desc=@TransferIdledesc THEN @TransferIdle 
	  WHEN job_state.state_desc=@TransferRunning THEN @TransferRunning
	  ELSE @TransferIdle  
  END as TransferStatus,
  ISNULL(job_state.color,@IdleColorcode)AS color, 
  ISNULL(ent.description, ent.ent_name) AS SrcEntity,
  ISNULL(entN.description, entN.ent_name) as DestEntity,
  src_su_ent_id, 
  item.item_desc as SrcItemDesc,
  SE.src_grade_cd, 
  ig.item_grade_desc as SourceItemGrade,
  dest_su_ent_id, 
  it.item_desc as DestItemDesc,
  se.dest_grade_cd,
  igd.item_grade_desc as DestItemGrade, 
  ig.color as srcgdcolor, --0.01.02
  igd.color as gradecolor,  --0.01.01	
  CASE 
  WHEN job_state.state_desc=@TransferRunning THEN concat(ISNULL(ROUND(qty_transferred,ISNULL(item.num_decimals,99)),''),'') 
  ELSE '' END qty_transferred,
  uom.description as uom,
  st_transfer_type,
  CASE 
  WHEN st_transfer_type=1 THEN  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400016,NULL,NULL)--EMPTY SILO
  WHEN st_transfer_type=2 THEN  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400006,NULL,NULL)--CONTINUOUS
  WHEN (st_transfer_type=3 AND ISNULL(target_qty,0) > 0) THEN concat(ISNULL(target_qty,''),'')--MANUAL
  else '' END AS target_qty,
  SE.last_edit_at_utc as last_edit_at_local,
  
  SE.created_by, 
  SE.row_id
  FROM  cte_stLines SL
  LEFT JOIN cte_stExc SE ON SL.ent_id=SE.ent_id
  LEFT JOIN job_state ON SE.transfer_status_cd=job_state.state_cd
  LEFT JOIN item ON SE.src_item_id=ITEM.item_id
  LEFT JOIN uom ON item.uom_id=uom.uom_id
  LEFT JOIN ent ON SE.src_su_ent_id=ent.ent_id
  LEFT JOIN ent entN ON SE.dest_su_ent_id=entN.ent_id
  LEFT JOIN item it on SE.dest_item_id=it.item_id
  LEFT JOIN item_grade ig on se.src_grade_cd=ig.item_grade_cd
  left join item_grade igd ON SE.dest_grade_cd=igd.item_grade_cd
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN SE.transfer_status_cd = @transferStatusCdRunning THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,  SL.description asc


	
  
 END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_Dir_Change_Seq](@ent_id  int, @ori_seq_no int, @new_seq_no int)
--*********************************************************************
--* Version 01.00.0000
--* This stored function walks through the directories for the
--* specified entity and makes sure that the original sequence number is updated with the
--* new sequence number thus allowing the a seq_no to be moved up or down to
--* any other position in the sequence.returns 0 if successful, or the error value if not.
--*********************************************************************
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 09/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.1	Error occurred while changing sequence greater than 2
--					Also included SET NOCOUNT ON
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @seq_no int
DECLARE @error int
DECLARE @count int
DECLARE @flag int
DECLARE @num int
DECLARE @no int
DECLARE @check int
--* Call the reseqdir procedure to be sure that the resequencing can be done.
EXEC sp_U_Dir_ReSeq @ent_id
--* Now count the no of rows for the given ent_id
DECLARE count_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
SELECT count(*) FROM dir WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
	CLOSE count_cursor
	DEALLOCATE count_cursor
	RETURN -101
END

OPEN count_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM count_cursor INTO @count
IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
	CLOSE count_cursor
	DEALLOCATE count_cursor
END
----*   check if the original seq no and the new seq no are with in the count
IF (@ori_seq_no !< @count) AND (@new_seq_no !< @count) BEGIN
	return -102
END
IF @ori_seq_no < @new_seq_no SET @flag = 1
ELSE SET @flag = 0
IF  @flag = 1  BEGIN
   SELECT @check= COUNT(seq_no) FROM dir Where ent_id =@ent_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no
   IF @check = 1 BEGIN
	DECLARE sta_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
	SELECT seq_no FROM dir WHERE ent_id = @ent_id ORDER BY seq_no ASC
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
	      CLOSE sta_cursor
	      DEALLOCATE sta_cursor
	      RETURN -103
	END

	OPEN sta_cursor

	WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM sta_cursor INTO @seq_no
		IF @seq_no = @ori_seq_no BEGIN

 -------* at first replace the original seq no by count+1 to avoid duplicate values
			  UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @count+1  WHERE seq_no = @seq_no AND ent_id = @ent_id
			  IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
				  CLOSE  sta_cursor
				  DEALLOCATE sta_cursor
			          RETURN -104
			   END

   	                   WHILE @seq_no <> @new_seq_no BEGIN
		            	   FETCH NEXT FROM sta_cursor INTO @seq_no
                          	   UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @seq_no - 1 WHERE seq_no = @seq_no AND ent_id = @ent_id
                                   IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
					  CLOSE sta_cursor
					  DEALLOCATE sta_cursor
					  RETURN -105
				   END
		           END

                           UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @new_seq_no  WHERE  seq_no = @count + 1 AND ent_id = @ent_id
                           IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
                                RETURN -106
                           END

		END
	END
	CLOSE sta_cursor
	DEALLOCATE sta_cursor
	SET  @error = @@ERROR
	IF @error != 0 BEGIN
		return @@ERROR
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
	   return 0
	END
    END
    ELSE BEGIN
      return -107
    END
END
ELSE BEGIN ---* if flag is 0 (original seq no is greater than the new seq no)
      SELECT @no= COUNT(seq_no) FROM dir WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no
      IF @no = 1 BEGIN
	----* select the seqnos from the dir table in reverse order  to get the original seq no first
	DECLARE revdir_cursor CURSOR STATIC  FOR
	SELECT seq_no FROM dir WHERE ent_id = @ent_id  ORDER BY  seq_no DESC
	OPEN revdir_cursor
	WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
	       FETCH NEXT FROM revdir_cursor INTO @seq_no
               IF @seq_no = @ori_seq_no BEGIN

                      UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @count+1  WHERE seq_no = @seq_no AND ent_id = @ent_id
		      IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
		         CLOSE  revdir_cursor
		         DEALLOCATE revdir_cursor
		         RETURN -108
		      END

   	              WHILE @seq_no <> @new_seq_no BEGIN
		             FETCH NEXT FROM  revdir_cursor INTO @seq_no
                             UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @seq_no + 1 WHERE seq_no = @seq_no AND ent_id = @ent_id
                             IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
			            CLOSE  revdir_cursor
			            DEALLOCATE revdir_cursor
				    RETURN -109
			     END
		      END

                      UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @new_seq_no  WHERE  seq_no = @count + 1 AND ent_id = @ent_id
                      IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
                           return -110
                      END

               END
       END
   END
   ELSE BEGIN
    return -111
   END
END
CLOSE  revdir_cursor
DEALLOCATE revdir_cursor
SET  @error = @@ERROR
IF @error != 0
	RETURN @@ERROR
ELSE
	RETURN 0

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_link_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_link]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_ent_link_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_link table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_ent_link_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_ent_link_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_link_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_ent_link', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_link_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_link_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_IU_ofi_Item_Inv_Move]
(@from_row_id			INT32
,@from_last_edit_at		TDATETIME = NULL
,@from_ent_id           INT32 = NULL
,@transfer_qty   		TFLOAT = NULL
,@transfer_qty_erp		TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_to_ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_item_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_lot_no			STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_sublot_no		STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_grade_cd		INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_status_cd		INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_uom_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date		TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_wo_id			STRING80 = NULL
,@in_to_oper_id			STRING80 = NULL
,@in_to_seq_no			INT32 = NULL
,@in_transfer_option	INT32 = NULL
,@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job	INT32 = NULL
,@in_transfer_comments	STRING254 = NULL
,@in_log_transfer	INT32 = 1
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - [sp_IU_ofi_Item_Inv_Move]
-- Description	      - HD# 3596, Allows multiple lots for an item to be combined into a new lot or added to an existing lot
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 02/23/2005
-- Version	      - 2.1.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--10/03/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--01/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.8	HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
--05/17/2006	Raghu		3.1.16	Handle UOM_ID conversions in terms of destination measurements
--05/24/2006	Raghu		3.1.17	HD# 3654, Handle Indistinguishable lots and delegate this call to sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty
--01/23/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--03/30/2007    Raghu       3.2.5   HD# 9287, Inventory Unique By Job
                                    --If the item is hard pegged, and a user has the privilege to override this,
                                    --the fields in the inventory table identifying which job produced this serial number will be updated
                                    --to match those of any job immediately preceeding the first job identified by the work order
                                    --and operation on the ?To? side of the transfer screen, that produces the item being transferred.
                                    --If there is no such ?upstream? job, these fields are left unchanged.
--06/15/2007    Raghu       3.2.16  Move inventory to downstream job ONLY if it is instructed to do so.
--11/26/2009	AJAY		4.0.0	H1423 FIX
-- 03/19/2018   Srinivasa   6.0     US#804232(Handled null value for @from_row_id).
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
	 @from_ent_name			STRING80
	,@to_ent_id				INT32
	,@to_ent_name			STRING80
	,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@can_store				INT32
	,@from_ent_indistinct	INT32
	,@to_ent_indistinct		INT32
	,@dbg_resp				INT32
	--Added missing parameter into update inventory transfer quantity sp
	,@in_to_expiry_date_utc TDATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	SET @in_to_expiry_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_to_expiry_date_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

      -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Inv_Move_t', @src_key='sp_U_Item_Inv_Move_t',
									 @date_val1 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val1 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz,
									 @date_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz

    if ( @dbg_resp = 1 )
		RETURN


SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	--Retrieve the source inventory row.
	SELECT @from_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @from_row_id
	  AND (last_edit_at = @from_last_edit_at OR @from_last_edit_at IS NULL)

	--Check whether we found a source inventory row.
	IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Check whether the inventory row exist, but the qty is modified by the time this call is initiated.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WHERE row_id = @from_row_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified row was not found in the database, or it has been modified by someone else since you retrieved it for the row_id = %%1 {3441},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_row_id, -1))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The supplied inventory source row does not exist in the database.
			SET @err_msg = 'The source row does not exist for row_id = %%1 {3203},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_row_id, -1))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Get the source entity name for the source inventory location.
	--Also, check if the source entity has the can_store capability set to true.
	SELECT @from_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

	IF (@from_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @from_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SET @to_ent_id = ISNULL(@in_to_ent_id, @from_ent_id)

	--Check whether the can store capability for the destination entity is turned on;
	--otherwise raise an error.
	SELECT @to_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id
	IF (@to_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @to_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify if the source entity and the target entity are same.
	IF (@from_ent_id <> @to_ent_id) BEGIN
		--The source entity and the target entity are different. Verify whether the source entity and the destination entity are configured as indistinguishable lots.
		SELECT @from_ent_indistinct = 0, @to_ent_indistinct = 0

		--Get the indistinguishable_lots capability for the source entity.
		SELECT @from_ent_indistinct = indistinguishable_lots FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

		--Get the indistinguishable_lots capability for the destination entity.
		SELECT @to_ent_indistinct = indistinguishable_lots FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id

		--Verify if both the source and the destination entities are configured as indishtinguishable lots
		--If yes, then prorate the quantity in the source inventory location
		--and transfer the prorated quantity to the destination location.
		IF (@from_ent_indistinct = 1 AND @to_ent_indistinct = 1) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots  @from_row_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
												NULL, @to_ent_id, NULL, @in_to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd, @from_ent_id, @transfer_qty,
												@transfer_qty_erp, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
												@in_to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no, @time_zone_bias_value, 1, @in_to_uom_id, @in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz,
												@in_transfer_option, @in_transfer_comments
		END
		-- Fix for CR L00096446/HF-1602
		-- ELSE IF (@from_ent_indistinct <> @to_ent_indistinct) BEGIN
		ELSE IF (@from_ent_indistinct = 1 AND @to_ent_indistinct = 0) BEGIN
			--One of the entity here is configured as  indistinguishable lots and the other is not configured as indistinguishable lots.
			--Do not allow inventory transfers if both does not have the same configuration, throw an error.
			--SET @err_msg = 'The item(s) cannot be transferred to the destination entity, because the source entitity''s:%1 setup for indistinguishable lots is different than the destination entity''s:%2 setup.{5009},' + @from_ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
			SET @err_msg = 'The item(s) cannot be transferred to the destination entity, because lots or items stored in/on the source entity (%1) are indistinguishable whereas lots/items stored in/on the destination entity (%2) are distinguishable.{5009},' + @from_ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE
			--The source and the destination entities are not configured as indistinguishable lots,
			--delegate to this 'sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty' stored procedure which does the inventory transfer.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty	@from_row_id, @from_last_edit_at, @transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp, @in_to_ent_id,
											@in_to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no, @in_to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd,
											@in_to_uom_id, @in_to_expiry_date,@in_to_expiry_date_tz,@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no,
											@in_transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job, @in_transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer,
											@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	ELSE	-- The source and the destination entity are same.
		--just delegate to this 'sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty' stored procedure which does the inventory transfer.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty  @from_row_id, @from_last_edit_at, @transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp, @in_to_ent_id,
											@in_to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no, @in_to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd,
											@in_to_uom_id, @in_to_expiry_date,@in_to_expiry_date_tz,@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no,
											@in_transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job, @in_transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer,
											@time_zone_bias_value

		--Updating same location with multiple lots
			UPDATE item_inv
			SET grade_cd = @in_to_grade_cd,
				status_cd = @in_to_status_cd,
				expiry_date = @in_to_expiry_date,
				wo_id = @in_to_wo_id,
				oper_id = @in_to_oper_id,
				seq_no = @in_to_seq_no
			WHERE item_id = @in_to_item_id
				AND ent_id = @in_to_ent_id
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_traceability_data]
AS
SELECT temptable.*,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job_step.step_desc,
       job_state.state_desc,
       job_state.color state_color,
       start_user_name.user_desc start_user_desc,
       finish_user_name.user_desc finish_user_desc,
       data_user_name.user_desc data_user_desc
FROM (SELECT t1.*,
             job_step_data.step_no,
             job_step_data.state_cd,
             job_step_data.act_start_time_utc
                step_act_start_time,
             job_step_data.act_finish_time_utc
                step_act_finish_time,
             job_step_data.step_data,
             job_step_data.step_data_time_utc
                step_data_time,
             job_step_data.start_user_id,
             job_step_data.finish_user_id,
             job_step_data.data_user_id,
             job_step_data.row_id
      FROM (SELECT item_prod.wo_id,
                   item_prod.oper_id,
                   item_prod.seq_no,
                   item_prod.item_id,
                   item.item_desc,
                   item.num_decimals,
                   uom.abbreviation units,
                   item_prod.lot_no,
                   item_prod.sublot_no,
                   item_prod.ent_id,
                   ent.ent_name,
                   item_prod.grade_cd,
                   item_grade.item_grade_desc,
                   item_grade.color grade_color,
                   item_prod.status_cd,
                   item_state.item_status_desc,
                   item_state.color status_color,
                   item_prod.to_ent_id,
                   to_ent.ent_name to_ent_name,
                   Sum(item_prod.qty_prod) qty_prod,
                   item_prod.shift_start_utc,
                   item_prod.shift_start_local
            FROM item_prod item_prod
            INNER JOIN item item ON
               item_prod.item_id = item.item_id
            INNER JOIN ent ent ON
               item_prod.ent_id = ent.ent_id
            INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
               item_prod.grade_cd =
                  item_grade.item_grade_cd
            INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
               item_prod.status_cd =
                  item_state.item_status_cd
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ent to_ent ON
               item_prod.to_ent_id = to_ent.ent_id
            INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
            WHERE item_prod.good_prod = 1
            GROUP BY item_prod.wo_id,
                     item_prod.oper_id,
                     item_prod.seq_no,
                     item_prod.item_id,
                     item.item_desc,
                     item.num_decimals,
                     uom.abbreviation,
                     item_prod.lot_no,
                     item_prod.sublot_no,
                     item_prod.ent_id,
                     ent.ent_name,
                     item_prod.grade_cd,
                     item_grade.item_grade_desc,
                     item_grade.color,
                     item_prod.status_cd,
                     item_state.item_status_desc,
                     item_state.color,
                     item_prod.to_ent_id,
                     to_ent.ent_name,
                     item_prod.shift_start_utc,
                     item_prod.shift_start_local
           ) t1
      INNER JOIN job_step_data job_step_data ON
         t1.wo_id = job_step_data.wo_id AND
         t1.oper_id = job_step_data.oper_id AND
         t1.seq_no = job_step_data.seq_no AND
         t1.lot_no = job_step_data.lot_no AND
         t1.sublot_no = job_step_data.sublot_no
     ) temptable
INNER JOIN job job ON temptable.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
                      temptable.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
                      temptable.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN job_step job_step ON
   temptable.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
   temptable.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND
   temptable.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
   temptable.step_no = job_step.step_no
INNER JOIN job_state job_state ON
   temptable.state_cd = job_state.state_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name start_user_name ON
   temptable.start_user_id = start_user_name.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name finish_user_name ON
   temptable.finish_user_id = finish_user_name.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name data_user_name ON
   temptable.data_user_id = data_user_name.user_id

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_User_Grp_Link]
(@grp_id  int  ,
 @user_id  nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

  SELECT user_grp_link.grp_id,user_grp_link.user_id,grp_name.grp_desc,user_name.user_desc
            ,user_grp_link.last_edit_comment
            ,user_grp_link.last_edit_by
            ,user_grp_link.last_edit_at
    FROM user_grp_link user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN grp_name grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON user_grp_link.grp_id = grp_name.grp_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name user_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON user_grp_link.user_id = user_name.user_id
      WHERE ((user_grp_link.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND (user_grp_link.user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL) AND
       (user_grp_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (user_grp_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
        ORDER BY grp_name.grp_desc, user_grp_link.user_id
END
