/*
--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_s_ofi_st_trans_source]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch silo details for source/destination for stock Trasfer
--
-- Usage: Stock Transfer Setup UI
--EXEC [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_st_trans_source] 2,541,'Beans'
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01 	AP				2022-12-22			Initial version.
-- 0.02 	DS				2024-01-07			Added ent_name column
-- 0.03 	LK				2024-01-23			Added silo_status_auto column
-- ===========================================================================================
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_st_trans_source]
(	
	@silo_selection INT    -- 1 for source , 2 from destination
  , @line_id        INT
  , @item_group     NVARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF @silo_selection = 1
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @src_su_ent_id INT = NULL
		SELECT
			@src_su_ent_id = src_su_ent_id
		FROM ofi_st_trans_selection
		WHERE
			ent_id = @line_id
			AND is_active = 1

;WITH ctesrcQty AS (SELECT SUM(qty_left) as srcQty ,SUM(qty_left_erp) AS  qty_erp, ent_id, inv.item_id,inv.grade_cd,ia.attr_value FROM item_inv inv
				INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON inv.item_id = item.item_id
				INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = item.item_id
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON
							a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
							AND a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
							AND a.attr_grp = 1--Item group
				GROUP BY ent_id, inv.item_id,ia.attr_value,grade_cd )

	

		SELECT
			CASE
				WHEN e.ent_id = @src_su_ent_id
				THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END                                  is_chk
		  , ISNULL(e.description, e.ent_name) AS  silo
		  , e.ent_id AS                          silo_ent_id
		  , e.ent_name AS                        ent_name
		  , item.item_id
		  , item.item_desc
		  , ISNULL(ct.attr_value, tm.item_group) AS                     item_group
		  , ig.item_grade_desc AS                grade
		  , ig.item_grade_cd
		  , ct.srcQty             AS			  qty_mes
		  , ct.qty_erp				 AS             qty_erp
		  , ISNULL(uom.description,dbo.fn_s_ofi_GetUOM(e.ent_id)) as    uom
		  , fcsv.notValidDescDetails AS          info
		  , fcsv.isNotValidEnt AS                 is_disabled--  1 AS is_disabled fcsv.isNotValidEnt
		  , dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) AS color
		, (select  STRING_AGG( su_status_cd,',')  from ent e inner join  ofi_su_mes_states_mapping om with(nolock) on e.ent_id=om.su_ent_id where 
			 su_ent_id = tm.storage_ent_id and
			 interlock_type = 'source' and is_Active=1) as silo_status_auto
		FROM Ofi_st_trans_mapping tm WITH(NOLOCK)				
		LEFT JOIN ctesrcQty ct ON tm.storage_ent_id=ct.ent_id
		LEFT JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON ct.item_id = item.item_id
		LEFT JOIN item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK) ON ct.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
		LEFT JOIN uom WITH(NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id				
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = tm.storage_ent_id		
		CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_st_chKSourceValidity]( tm.storage_ent_id, 'source', ct.item_id, ct.grade_cd, tm.ent_id) AS fcsv
		WHERE tm.type = 'source'
			AND tm.ent_id = @line_id
		GROUP BY
		e.ent_name
		,e.description
		,ct.srcQty        
		, ct.qty_erp	
		,tm.item_group
		, e.ent_id		  
		, item.item_id
		, item.item_desc
		, ct.attr_value
		, ig.item_grade_desc
		, ig.item_grade_cd
		, ig.color
		, tm.storage_ent_id
		, uom.description
		, fcsv.notValidDescDetails
		, fcsv.isNotValidEnt
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			e.ent_name AS                        silo
		  , e.ent_id AS                          silo_ent_id
		  , e.ent_name AS                        ent_name
		  , item.item_id
		  , item.item_desc
		  , ia.attr_value AS                     item_group
		  , ig.item_grade_desc AS                grade
		  , ig.item_grade_cd
		  , SUM(inv.qty_left) AS                 qty_mes
		  , SUM(inv.qty_left_erp) AS             qty_erp
		  , uom.description AS                   uom
		  , fcsv.notValidDescDetails AS          info
		  , 0 AS                                 is_disabled--  1 AS is_disabled fcsv.isNotValidEnt
		  , dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) AS color
		  , (select  STRING_AGG( su_status_cd,',')  from ent e inner join  ofi_su_mes_states_mapping om with(nolock) on e.ent_id=om.su_ent_id where 
			 su_ent_id = tm.storage_ent_id and
			 interlock_type = 'source' and is_Active=1) as silo_status_auto
		FROM item_inv inv WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON inv.item_id = item.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = item.item_id		
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON
			a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
			AND a.attr_grp = 1--Item group
		INNER JOIN item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK) ON inv.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
		INNER JOIN uom WITH(NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		INNER JOIN Ofi_st_trans_mapping tm WITH(NOLOCK) ON
			inv.ent_id = tm.storage_ent_id
			AND tm.type = 'Destination'
			AND tm.ent_id = @line_id
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = tm.storage_ent_id
		CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_st_chKSourceValidity](tm.ent_id, 'source', item.item_id, ig.item_grade_cd, e.ent_id) AS fcsv
		GROUP BY
			e.ent_name
		  , e.ent_id
		  , item.item_id
		  , item.item_desc
		  , ia.attr_value
		  , ig.item_grade_desc
		  , ig.item_grade_cd
		  , ig.color
		  , uom.description
		  , tm.storage_ent_id
		  , fcsv.notValidDescDetails
		  , fcsv.isNotValidEnt

	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Job_History]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME
,@job_pos		INT32
,@item_id		STRING40
,@spare1		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare2		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare3		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare4		STRING80 = NULL
,@last_edit_comment	STRING80 = NULL
,@last_edit_at 		DATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
,@row_id		INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -    sp_I_Job_History
-- Description          -    Insert a row into the table
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 08/04/2016		Raghu G			5.3		UserStory: 668382 - As Lenka, I want a job starting/suspending/ending on an entity to be updated in the job_history table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE @job_start_local	TDATETIME
	,@last_edit_by		STRING40

	,@can_track_oee		LOGICAL
	,@batch_size		TFLOAT
	,@est_prod_rate		TFLOAT
	,@prod_uom		INT32
	,@hour_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,@hour_end_utc		TDATETIME

	,@error_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@ent_name		STRING80
	,@ent_name_vio		STRING80
	,@wo_id_vio		STRING80
	,@oper_id_vio		STRING80
	,@seq_no_vio		STRING40
	,@job_pos_vio		STRING40
	,@job_start_utc_vio	NVARCHAR(20)
	,@job_end_utc_vio	NVARCHAR(20)

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	SET @job_start_utc = COALESCE(@job_start_utc, @last_edit_at)
	SET @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@job_start_utc)

	SET @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, 'JobHistory.Add')

	--Determine whether this entity can track oee
	SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name, @can_track_oee = e.can_track_oee
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Verify whether a job history record exists, if not, create a new job history record
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND jh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
			  --The job has started and stopped at the same second
			  AND jh.job_end_utc = @job_start_utc) BEGIN

		--Clear the job_end_* times since the job has started and stopped at the same second before
		UPDATE job_history
		SET job_end_utc = NULL
		  , job_end_local = NULL
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND job_start_utc = @job_start_utc

		--Return the row_id of the job_history record
		SELECT @row_id = jh.row_id
		FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Verify no other jobs are running at this job position
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id  --Limit to the supplied entity
				--A job started earlier than the supplied start time of the job
				  AND jh.job_start_utc <= @job_start_utc
				  --A job running on the same job position
				  AND jh.job_pos = @job_pos
				  --A job that is currently running or the job ended later than this start time
				  AND (jh.job_end_utc > @job_start_utc OR jh.job_end_utc IS NULL)) BEGIN

			SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id_vio = jh.wo_id, @oper_id_vio = jh.oper_id, @seq_no_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), jh.seq_no)
				, @job_start_utc_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_start_utc, 120)
				, @job_end_utc_vio = COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_end_utc, 120), 'Running')
			FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id  --Limit to the supplied entity
				--A job started earlier than the supplied start time of the job
				  AND jh.job_start_utc <= @job_start_utc
				  --A job running on the same job position
				  AND jh.job_pos = @job_pos
				  --A job that is currently running or the job ended later than this start time
				  AND (jh.job_end_utc > @job_start_utc OR jh.job_end_utc IS NULL)

			--Another job was running at the same job position during the time specified.
			IF(@job_end_utc_vio = 'Running') BEGIN
			SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:'+ @wo_id + ', OperID:'+ @oper_id +', SeqNo:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) +') on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' cannot be started,'
				+ ' because it overlaps with another job (WoID:' + @wo_id_vio + ', OperID:' + @oper_id_vio + ', SeqNo:' + @seq_no_vio + ') on the same entity at the same job position with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and the job is still running on the entity.{7999},'
				+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ','
				+ @wo_id_vio + ',' + @oper_id_vio + ',' + @seq_no_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
			SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:'+ @wo_id + ', OperID:'+ @oper_id +', SeqNo:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) +') on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' cannot be started,'
				+ ' because it overlaps with another job (WoID:' + @wo_id_vio + ', OperID:' + @oper_id_vio + ', SeqNo:' + @seq_no_vio + ') on the same entity at the same job position with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and end time (UTC):' + @job_end_utc_vio +'.{7991},'
				+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ','
				+ @wo_id_vio + ',' + @oper_id_vio + ',' + @seq_no_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio
			END

			RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify this job was not running on another entity at the same time
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jh.ent_id <> @ent_id  --Exclude the supplied entity
				--Limit to the current job
				  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
				--A job started earlier than the supplied start time of the job
				  AND jh.job_start_utc <= @job_start_utc
				   --A job that is currently running or the job ended later than this start time
				  AND (jh.job_end_utc > @job_start_utc OR jh.job_end_utc IS NULL)) BEGIN

			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name_vio = e.ent_name, @job_pos_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), jh.job_pos)
				, @job_start_utc_vio = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_start_utc, 120)
				, @job_end_utc_vio = COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), jh.job_end_utc, 120), 'Running')
			FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE jh.ent_id <> @ent_id  --Exclude the supplied entity
			--Limit to the current job
			  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
			--A job started earlier than the supplied start time of the job
			  AND jh.job_start_utc <= @job_start_utc
			   --A job that is currently running or the job ended later than this start time
			  AND (jh.job_end_utc > @job_start_utc OR jh.job_end_utc IS NULL)

			--The same job was running on different entity at the supplied start time.
			IF(@job_end_utc_vio = 'Running') BEGIN
			SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:' + @wo_id + ', OperID:' + @oper_id + ', SeqNo: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ') on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' cannot be started,'
				+ ' because it overlaps with the runtime on another entity:'+ @ent_name_vio + ' at the job position:' + @job_pos_vio + ' with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and the job is still running on the entity.{8000},'
				+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ','
				+ @ent_name_vio + ',' + @job_pos_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
			SET @error_msg = 'The job (WoID:' + @wo_id + ', OperID:' + @oper_id + ', SeqNo: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ') on entity:' + @ent_name + ' at job position:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ' with start time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ' cannot be started,'
				+ ' because it overlaps with the runtime on another entity:'+ @ent_name_vio + ' at the job position:' + @job_pos_vio + ' with start time (UTC):' + @job_start_utc_vio + ' and end time (UTC):' + @job_end_utc_vio +'.{7998},'
				+ @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(12), @job_pos) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @job_start_utc, 120) + ','
				+ @ent_name_vio + ',' + @job_pos_vio + ',' + @job_start_utc_vio + ',' + @job_end_utc_vio
			END

			RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Determine the local time for the job start
		SET @job_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @job_start_utc)

		-- A job history record does not exist, create a new record
		INSERT INTO job_history (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc, job_start_local, job_pos
			, item_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment
			, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES
			(@ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @job_start_utc, @job_start_local, @job_pos
			, @item_id, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment
			, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

		SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END


	--Exit, if the entity is not tracking oee
	IF (COALESCE(@can_track_oee, 0) = 0) RETURN

	--Determine the hour start bucket based on the job start UTC
	SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @job_start_utc),0)
	SET @hour_end_utc = DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc)

	--Verify whether a job_hour_history record exists for the start time and hour bucket for the job
	--If not, create a new record
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jhh.ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND jhh.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND jhh.oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND jhh.seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND jhh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
				  AND jhh.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc) BEGIN

		--Retrieve the batch size, prod_uom, and the production rate of the job
		SELECT @batch_size = j.batch_size, @est_prod_rate = j.est_prod_rate, @prod_uom = j.prod_uom
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

		--Create a new job hour history record for this job
		INSERT INTO job_hour_history (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc
			, hour_start_utc, hour_start_local
			, hour_end_utc, hour_end_local
			, item_id, std_prod_rate, batch_size
			, qty_good, qty_reject, runtime, downtime, idletime
			, last_edit_comment, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (@ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @job_start_utc
			, @hour_start_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_start_utc)
			, @hour_end_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_end_utc)
			, @item_id, dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(@est_prod_rate, @prod_uom), @batch_size
			, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
			, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_at)
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Spec_ChangeSpecValues]
(@session_id		INT
,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@ent_id		INT
,@spec_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@new_spec_value	NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@new_min_value		NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@new_max_value		NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@update_template	BIT = 0
,@check_privs		INT = 0
,@bom_pos		INT = 0
,@bom_ver_id		NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@comments		NVARCHAR(4000)
,@job_pos		INT = 0
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Description	      -	Change spec_values (if NOT Missing), min_value (if NOT missing), max_value (if NOT missing)
--			for a specific spec
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	12/08/2003
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.15
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--06/17/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included NULL param for last_edit_comment while calling sp_I_Job_Event
--					Commented out code which creates a temporary table to insert comments for audit trail
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID changes..
--08/22/2014	Srinivasa Tentu 5.0		UserStry#381635(As Lenka, I want to modify the stored procedures to determine the correct use of session IDs)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id       NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no	INT
	,@count		INT
	,@priv_id	INT
	,@priv_value	INT
	,@process_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@ver_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@step_no	INT
	,@attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@access_level	INT
	,@cur_user	NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	IF (@check_privs IS NULL) SET @check_privs = 0
	IF (@bom_pos IS NULL) SET @bom_pos = 0
	IF (@job_pos IS NULL) SET @job_pos = 0
	IF (@new_spec_value IS NULL) AND (@new_min_value IS NULL) AND (@new_max_value IS NULL) RETURN

	IF ((@user_id IS NULL OR  @user_id = '') AND @session_id < -9 ) BEGIN
	 SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
	END

	IF (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @priv_id = 24
			EXEC sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @priv_id, @priv_value OUTPUT
			IF (@priv_value = 0) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to Edit Specs{3172}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL) OR (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @priv_id = 182
			EXEC sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @priv_id, @priv_value OUTPUT
			IF (@priv_value = 0) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to edit min/max specifications.{4709}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 235

	SELECT @access_level = MAX(priv_value) FROM grp_priv_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE priv_id = 181 AND grp_id IN
		(SELECT grp_id FROM user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
	SET @access_level = ISNULL(@access_level, 0)

/*	SELECT @cur_user = user_id FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @session_id
	IF (@cur_user <> @user_id) UPDATE sessn SET user_id = @user_id WHERE session_id = @session_id*/

	SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '' OR @oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR('There is no job running on this entity or the Work Order may not exist{3169}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

/*	IF (@comments IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #changecomment (session_id INT, user_id NVARCHAR(40), comments NVARCHAR(254))
		INSERT INTO #changecomment (session_id, user_id, comments) VALUES (@session_id, @user_id, @comments)
	END*/

	SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT step_no) FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id

	IF (@count = 1) BEGIN --spec_id is defined only once for this job (not repeated for different steps).  update job_spec irrespective of which steps are running
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
		    	  AND (ISNULL(access_level, 0) > @access_level AND ISNULL(access_level, 0) <> 0)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Users access level is less than the required access level.{4731}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value, last_edit_comment = comments
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value

		IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job_spec SET min_value = @new_min_value, last_edit_comment = comments
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND ISNULL(min_value,' ') <> @new_min_value

		IF (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job_spec SET max_value = @new_max_value, last_edit_comment = comments
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND ISNULL(max_value,' ') <> @new_max_value

		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @step_no = step_no FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
		  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, @step_no, 'SpecChanged', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, @user_id, NULL, NULL, @spec_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@count > 1) BEGIN -- spec_id is defined for multiple steps in this job then it will only update the actual spec value for currently running step(s)
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
		    AND (ISNULL(access_level, 0) > @access_level AND ISNULL(access_level, 0) <> 0)
		    AND step_no IN
			(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
			 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Users access level is less than the required access level.{4731}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job_spec SET act_spec_value = @new_spec_value, last_edit_comment = comments
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND ISNULL(act_spec_value,' ') <> @new_spec_value
			    AND step_no IN
				(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
				 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

		IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job_spec SET min_value = @new_min_value, last_edit_comment = comments
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND ISNULL(min_value,' ') <> @new_min_value
			    AND step_no IN
				(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
				 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

		IF (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job_spec SET max_value = @new_max_value, last_edit_comment = comments
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND ISNULL(max_value,' ') <> @new_max_value
			    AND step_no IN
				(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
				 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @step_no = MIN(step_no) FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  AND  oper_id = @oper_id  AND seq_no = @seq_no AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND step_no IN
				(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
				 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)
		  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, @step_no, 'SpecChanged', NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL,
				NULL, @user_id, NULL, NULL, @spec_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'More than 1 step may be running on this entity',
				NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END
	END --multiple step_nos exist for job_spec

	IF (@update_template = 1) BEGIN
		--Get Process_Id
		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM WO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		--Find no. of distinct oper_ent_spec versions
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT ver_id) FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND spec_id = @spec_id

		IF (@count = 1) --Only one oper_ent_spec version found and pick up the same
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- More than 1 oper_ent_spec version exist, pick up the preferred version
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

		--Get No of steps (distinct multiple steps) defined for this spec
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT step_no) FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id

		IF (@count = 1) BEGIN--Only one matching step found and update the spec value for the step
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    	  AND (ISNULL(access_level, 0) > @access_level AND ISNULL(access_level, 0) <> 0)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Users access level is less than the required access level.{4731}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value

			IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET min_value = @new_min_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(min_value, ' ') <> @new_min_value

			IF (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET max_value = @new_max_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(max_value, ' ') <> @new_max_value
		END
		ELSE IF (@count > 1) BEGIN-- More than 1 step found for this specs..Update all running steps for the oper spec
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    	  AND (ISNULL(access_level, 0) > @access_level AND ISNULL(access_level, 0) <> 0)
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Users access level is less than the required access level.{4731}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

			IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET min_value = @new_min_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(min_value, ' ')  <> @new_min_value
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

			IF (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET max_value = @new_max_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(max_value, ' ')  <> @new_max_value
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)
		END

		SELECT @item_id = item_id FROM job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

		--If bom_ver_id is null, get the preferred bom_version from bom_ver table
		IF (@bom_ver_id IS NULL) SELECT @bom_ver_id = ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1

		--Find no. of distinct bom_item_oper_spec versions
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT spec_ver_id) FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_id = @spec_id

		IF (@count = 1) --Only one spec version found and pick up the same
			SELECT @ver_id = spec_ver_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec
			WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- More than 1 oper_ent_spec version exist, pick up the preferred version from oper_spec_ver
			SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

		--Get No of steps (distinct multiple steps) defined for this spec
		SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT step_no) FROM bom_item_oper_spec
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
		  AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id

		IF (@count = 1) BEGIN  --Only one matching step found and update the spec value for the step
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    	  AND (ISNULL(access_level, 0) > @access_level AND ISNULL(access_level, 0) <> 0)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Users access level is less than the required access level.{4731}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value

			IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET min_value = @new_min_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(min_value, ' ') <> @new_min_value

			IF (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET max_value = @new_max_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(max_value, ' ') <> @new_max_value
		END -- ONLY one step found for this spec in bom_item_oper_spec
		ELSE IF (@count > 1) BEGIN-- More than 1 step found for this specs..Update all running steps for the bom item oper spec
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    	  AND (ISNULL(access_level, 0) > @access_level AND ISNULL(access_level, 0) <> 0)
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Users access level is less than the required access level.{4731}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			IF (@new_spec_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

			IF (@new_min_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET min_value = @new_min_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(min_value, ' ') <> @new_min_value
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)

			IF (@new_max_value IS NOT NULL)
				UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET max_value = @new_max_value, last_edit_comment = comments
				WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND ISNULL(max_value, ' ') <> @new_max_value
				  AND step_no IN (SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND state_cd = 3)
		END --More than 1 step found for this specs in bom_item_oper_spec table
	END

/*	IF (@cur_user <> @user_id) UPDATE sessn SET user_id = @cur_user WHERE session_id = @session_id
	IF (@comments IS NOT NULL) DROP TABLE #changecomment*/

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_RDBUtilization]
(@EventModStart			DATETIME2
,@EventModEnd			DATETIME2
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_RDBUtilization
-- Description	      - The purpose is to slice and dice the utilization events for a given boundary
-- Author                   - Raghu G
-- Date Created	      -	05/04/2018
-- Version	      - 6.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 10/11/2019	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1227617 - MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00155170 (HF CR L00154870 - SR#103162065 - Problem with Intelligence reports)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SELECT util_log.log_id
      , util_log.event_time_utc
	  , util_log.event_time_local
	  , util_log.ent_id
	  , util_log.shift_id
	  , util_log.shift_start_utc
      , util_log.shift_start_local
	  , util_log.state_cd
	  , util_log.reas_cd
	  , util_log.reas_pending
	  , util_log.runtime
	  , util_log.downtime
      , util_log.setuptime
	  , util_log.teardowntime
	  , util_log.fixedtime
	  , util_log.vartime
      , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime =1 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN 'RunTime' WHEN util_log.downtime=1 and util_log.runtime=0 THEN 'DownTime'
             WHEN util_log.runtime=0 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN 'IdleTime' END AS EventType
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime=1 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN util_log.duration ELSE 0 END RuntimeDuration
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime=0 and util_log.downtime=1 THEN util_log.duration ELSE 0 END DowntimeDuration
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.runtime=0 and util_log.downtime=0 THEN util_log.duration ELSE 0 END IdletimeDuration
	  , CASE WHEN util_log.downtime = 1 THEN N'Availability Loss'
			 WHEN util_log.runtime = 1  THEN N'Performance Loss'
			 ELSE N'Idle' END AS LossType
      , util_log.category1,  util_log.category2, util_log.category3, util_log.category4, util_log.failure, util_reas.reas_grp_id, util_reas.ent_enabled
      , util_log.raw_reas_cd, util_log.duration AS duration, util_log.last_edit_by, util_log.comments
      , jull.wo_id, jull.oper_id,jull.seq_no
      , jull.item_id, jull.num_decimals, jull.uom_id
	  , l.line_id, l.line_name
	  , jull.prod_rate,  ue.target_util
	  , oe.std_item_id ,oe.target_oee ,oe.target_perf,oe.target_qual
	  , (select max(v) from (VALUES (util_log.last_edit_at), (CASE WHEN util_log.event_end_time_utc > @EventModEnd THEN DATEADD(SS,-1, @EventModEnd) ELSE util_log.event_end_time_utc END )) AS value(v)) last_edit_at
	  , ent.ent_name
	  , ent.description
FROM util_log util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no
			, dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j.est_prod_rate, j.prod_uom) prod_rate
			, i.item_id, i.num_decimals, i.uom_id
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jh.seq_no
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON  j.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE jh.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
	  AND ((jh.job_start_utc <= util_log.event_time_utc AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_time_utc)
	     OR (jh.job_start_utc >= util_log.event_time_utc AND jh.job_start_utc < util_log.event_end_time_utc))) jull
LEFT OUTER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = util_log.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON  util_log.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
LEFT OUTER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) on util_log.ent_id=lel.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN line l WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id=lel.line_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON  ue.ent_id= util_log.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.ent_id=util_log.ent_id
WHERE
(util_log.event_time_utc < @EventModEnd AND util_log.event_end_time_utc > @EventModStart) OR
(util_log.last_edit_at  >= @EventModStart AND util_log.last_edit_at < @EventModEnd)

END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/10/2019	RWB		6.1.0		Story 1127527: Removed the returning of result code and added the raising of an error
--									when the directory being added is already assigned to the entity.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE   @dir_exists 		INT
	  ,@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
  -- TC Prevent the same download directory from being used more than once for same entity
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  SELECT @dir_exists = COUNT(seq_no) FROM dir WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND directory = @directory AND seq_no >= 0

  IF @dir_exists > 0 BEGIN
	RAISERROR('You are attempting to assign a directory that is already assigned to the entity.< 584>', 16, 1)
	RETURN
  END

  IF @seq_no IS NULL SELECT @seq_no = COALESCE(MAX(seq_no)+1, 0) FROM dir WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

  -- TC If this seq_no already exists shuffle existing seq_no's down 1
  UPDATE dir SET seq_no = seq_no + 1 WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND seq_no >= @seq_no
  INSERT INTO dir (ent_id, seq_no, directory, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    VALUES (@ent_id, @seq_no, @directory, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

  -- TC Call ReSeq SP to get dir sequence correct - in case new seq_no was high
  EXEC sp_U_Dir_Reseq @ent_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Dir_ReSeq](@entID int)
--*********************************************************************
--* Version 01.00.0000
--* This stored function walks through the directories for the
--* specified entity and makes sure that the sequence numbers start at
--* either negative one or zero, and are in contiguous order.  It
--* returns 0 if successful, or the error value if not.
--*********************************************************************
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
AS
DECLARE  @seq_no   int
DECLARE  @memSeqNo int
DECLARE  @error    int
--* Get the directories as they currently exist in seq_no order.
DECLARE dir_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
SELECT seq_no FROM dir WHERE ent_id = @entID ORDER BY seq_no ASC
IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
	CLOSE dir_cursor
	DEALLOCATE dir_cursor
	RETURN @@ERROR
END

OPEN dir_cursor
--* If the seq_no of the first directory is negative, treat it as the upload directory
FETCH NEXT FROM dir_cursor INTO @seq_no
IF (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
	IF @seq_no < 0
	   SET @memSeqNo = -1
        ELSE
	   SET @memSeqNo = 0
END
ELSE BEGIN
	DEALLOCATE dir_cursor
	RETURN 0
END
WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
	IF @memSeqNo <> @seq_no BEGIN
		UPDATE dir WITH (ROWLOCK) SET seq_no = @memSeqNo WHERE seq_no = @seq_no AND ent_id = @entID
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 BEGIN
			CLOSE dir_cursor
			DEALLOCATE dir_cursor
			RETURN @@ERROR
		END
	END
	FETCH NEXT FROM dir_cursor INTO @seq_no
	SET @memSeqNo = @memSeqNo + 1
END
CLOSE dir_cursor
DEALLOCATE dir_cursor
SELECT @error = @@ERROR
IF @error != 0
   RETURN @@ERROR
ELSE
   RETURN 0

        Isnull(e.parent_ent_id, je.value10)

                       INNER JOIN ent eJ WITH(nolock)
                               ON eJ.ent_id = ea.ent_id
                    ON ea.ent_id = je.value10

								) A

                                          FROM

                           res_grp_id
                                              FROM
                           #res_grp)) )) SDTable where @lastupdatetime is null --WHERE RankSessionRelease = 1

                      [process_id],
                      
                      parent_ent_id,

					  segmentType,

					  ,Scheduler_DisplayEnt
					  ,prog_percent
					  , UE.cur_state_cd statecode 
					  , US.state_desc statedesc
					  FROM


					  (

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_GetAvailConcurLinkNo]
(@available_link_no	INT32 OUTPUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_GetAvailConcurLinkNo
-- Description	      - Raghu
-- Author	      - HD# 5933, Get the available concurrent link no for a batch job
-- Date Created	      - 09/06/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.28
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--11/08/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	HD# 6593, Generate the next available concurrent link no. depending upon the system parameter.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @current_link_no	INT32
	,@prev_link_no		INT32
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 329

	--Check the system_attr "re-use concurrent link no." If this parameter is set to 1,
	--then reuse concurrent link no; else create the next max concurrent link no.
	IF (@attr_value != '1')
		SELECT @prev_link_no = ISNULL(MAX(concurrent_link), 0) FROM job
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @available_link_no = 0, @current_link_no = 0, @prev_link_no = 0

		DECLARE next_concurrent_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT DISTINCT concurrent_link FROM job WHERE state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7
		ORDER BY concurrent_link

		OPEN next_concurrent_link_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM next_concurrent_link_cursor INTO @current_link_no
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			IF (@current_link_no - @prev_link_no) > 1 BREAK
			SET @prev_link_no = @current_link_no
		END
		CLOSE next_concurrent_link_cursor
		DEALLOCATE next_concurrent_link_cursor
	END

	SET @available_link_no = @prev_link_no + 1
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_link_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_link]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_ent_link_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_link table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_ent_link_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_ent_link a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		      AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		     AND a.ent_id = b.ent_id
	OPEN oper_ent_link_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_link_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_ent_link', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_link_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_link_cursor
END

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver	Changes
-- 08/17/2016		Raghu			5.3	UserStory: 676234-As Lenka, I want the utilization events to be merged if adjacent events have the same reason codes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu			5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
-- 06/27/2018		RWB				6.0	US 1044158: Added code to use the categories for util_reas if no value is passed in for the categories
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT OFF--XACT_ABORT must be off for this stored procedure execution, since it is using a try..catch block to update if a record exist
BEGIN

DECLARE @event_time_local	TDATETIME
	,@last_edit_by		STRING40
  	,@state_cd		INT32
	,@runtime		LOGICAL
	,@downtime		LOGICAL
	,@setuptime		LOGICAL
	,@teardowntime		LOGICAL
	,@fixedtime		LOGICAL
	,@failure		LOGICAL
	,@vartime		LOGICAL

	,@pre_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@next_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	, @reas_desc nvarchar(40)
	SET @last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
	SET @event_time_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_utc, @last_edit_at)

	--If the supplied event time is greater than the UTC time, default to the current UTC time
	IF (@event_time_utc > GETUTCDATE())
		SET @event_time_utc = @last_edit_at

	--Strip out the milliseconds
	SELECT @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@event_time_utc), @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@last_edit_at)
		, @reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, 0), @update_if_exists = COALESCE(@update_if_exists, 0) -- Defaults to false to raise primary key error when an attempt is made to insert an existing record
		--default to insert, if no context is supplied
		, @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, 'UtilHistory.Add')

	SELECT	@state_cd = state_cd, @runtime = runtime, @downtime = downtime,
		@setuptime = setuptime, @teardowntime = teardowntime, @fixedtime = fixedtime,
		@failure = failure, @vartime = vartime,
		@category1 = COALESCE(@category1, category1),
		@category2 = COALESCE(@category2, category2),
		@category3 = COALESCE(@category3, category3),
		@category4 = COALESCE(@category4, category4)
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd

	--code change
	select @reas_desc=reas_desc from util_reas where reas_cd=@reas_cd
	if (@reas_desc ='Slow Running' or @reas_desc ='Unknown Downtime')
	begin
		set @reas_pending = 1
	end
	

	IF (@state_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677}, reason code, to insert a new utilization event.', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)

	--Since 99% of the time the inserts will succeed. There is 1% of the chance that an event has to be updated.
	--There is only a 1% chance that UCO and Operator are sending an event precisely at the same time.
	--I.e. The raw reason from UCO may get stuck in the MSMQ and processed later, while the new event is set from the operator at the exact same time; vice-versa
	--Therefore, instead of checking whether an event exist or not, attempt to do an insert, if an event exist, it will raise a primary key error, then call an update if the request is to update if an event exist
	BEGIN TRY
		--Insert the record
		INSERT INTO util_history (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_time_local, state_cd, reas_cd, reas_pending
			, runtime, downtime, setuptime, teardowntime, fixedtime, vartime, failure, comments, raw_reas_cd
			, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, category1, category2, category3, category4
			, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES
			(@ent_id, @event_time_utc, @event_time_local, @state_cd, @reas_cd, @reas_pending
			, @runtime, @downtime, @setuptime, @teardowntime, @fixedtime, @vartime, @failure, @comments, @raw_reas_cd
			, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @category1, @category2, @category3, @category4
			, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

		-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
		SELECT @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY(), @records_affected = COALESCE(@records_affected, 0) + @@ROWCOUNT
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627 --primary key error
		  AND @update_if_exists = 1 BEGIN --and the request is to update an existing event
			--An event exist at this time, therefore, update the existing event
			SET @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment + '(update)'
			EXEC sp_U_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@event_time_utc, @reas_cd=@reas_cd, @reas_pending=@reas_pending
				, @comments=@comments, @raw_reas_cd=@raw_reas_cd, @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4
				, @category1=@category1, @category2=@category2, @category3=@category3, @category4=@category4
				, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=@log_id OUTPUT, @records_affected=@records_affected OUTPUT

			--Exit, since the event's properties are updated and merged.
			RETURN

		  END
		  ELSE --Raise the primary key error or any other error that matters;
		  	THROW;
	END CATCH

	--Retrieve the start time of the previous event
	SELECT @pre_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc < @event_time_utc

	--Retrieve the start time of the next event
	SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc > @event_time_utc

	--Default to the supplied event time utc, if there are no future events
	SET @next_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@next_event_time_utc, @event_time_utc)

	--Determine whether any events to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id = @ent_id
		, @event_time_utc_start_range = @pre_event_time_utc, @event_time_utc_end_range = @next_event_time_utc
		, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @records_affected = @records_affected OUTPUT
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_usage_data]
AS
SELECT temptable.*,
       item_class.item_class_desc,
       item_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
FROM (SELECT item_cons.wo_id,
             item_cons.oper_id,
             item_cons.seq_no,
             job.act_start_time_utc,
             job.act_start_time_local,
             job.act_finish_time_utc,
             job.act_finish_time_local,
             item_cons.shift_start_utc,
             item_cons.shift_start_local,
             item_cons.item_id,
             item.item_desc,
             item.num_decimals,
             uom.abbreviation units,
             item.item_class_id,
             item_cons.lot_no,
             item_cons.sublot_no,
             item_cons.fg_lot_no,
             item_cons.fg_sublot_no,
             item_cons.reas_cd,
             item_reas.reas_desc,
             item_reas.reas_grp_id,
             item_cons.user_id,
             user_name.user_desc,
             item_cons.item_scrapped,
             item_cons.ent_id,
             ent.ent_name,
             item_cons.shift_id,
             shift.shift_desc,
             item_cons.grade_cd,
             item_grade.item_grade_desc,
             item_grade.color grade_color,
             item_cons.status_cd,
             item_state.item_status_desc,
             item_state.color status_color,
             item_cons.from_ent_id,
             from_ent.ent_name from_ent_name,
             item_cons.qty_cons,
             item_cons.spare1,
             item_cons.spare2,
             item_cons.spare3,
             item_cons.spare4
      FROM item_cons
      LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
         item_cons.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
         item_cons.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
         item_cons.seq_no = job.seq_no
      INNER JOIN item item ON
         item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
      INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas ON
         item_cons.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
      INNER JOIN user_name user_name ON
         item_cons.user_id = user_name.user_id
      INNER JOIN ent ent ON item_cons.ent_id = ent.ent_id
      INNER JOIN shift shift ON
         item_cons.shift_id = shift.shift_id
      INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade ON
         item_cons.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
      INNER JOIN item_state item_state ON
         item_cons.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
      LEFT OUTER JOIN ent from_ent ON
         item_cons.from_ent_id = from_ent.ent_id
      INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
     ) temptable
INNER JOIN item_class item_class ON
   temptable.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
INNER JOIN item_reas_grp item_reas_grp ON
   temptable.reas_grp_id = item_reas_grp.reas_grp_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_User_Name]

 @user_desc			nvarchar(80)  ,
 @active			logical,
 @hourly_cost		float  ,
 @lang_id			int  ,
 @def_dept_id		nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_login		datetime,
 @last_login_tz		INT32 = NULL,
 @last_pw_change	datetime  ,
 @last_pw_change_tz INT32 =NULL  ,
 @auth_method		int ,
 @def_lab_cd		nvarchar(40) ,
 @spare1			nvarchar(1000) ,
 @spare2			nvarchar(1000) ,
 @spare3			nvarchar(1000) ,
 @spare4			nvarchar(1000),
 @last_edit_by		nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at		datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL)
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_User_Name
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version            - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
-- 09/09/2002	  Raghu		1.4	 Added active condition for user
--					 If @active = 0, get all active and inActive, else if @active =1, then get only active
-- 04/23/2003	  Raghu		1.6.0	 (HD# 1651) User sort should depend on system_attr = 10
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--04/27/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Removed the if condition for Order By clause and changed to a case statement in Order By clause
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 11/28/2009	Ajay		4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
-- 12/22/2009	Kishore		4.1		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
-- 09/03/2014	Raghu		5.0	UserStory: 391495 - As Lenka, I want to know who made the change in the MES system
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	DECLARE   @attr_value		NVARCHAR(10)
	DECLARE   @dbg_resp			NVARCHAR(10)
			 ,@temp_tz			INT32



	SET @last_login_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_login_tz)
	SET @last_pw_change_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_pw_change_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_User_Name', @src_key='sp_SA_User_Name',
					@date_val1 = @last_login, @numeric_val1 = @last_login_TZ,
					@date_val2 = @last_pw_change, @numeric_val2 = @last_pw_change_tz

	if (@dbg_resp=1)
	return 1


  IF @active IS NULL  SET @active = 1
  IF @active = 0  SET @active = NULL

  SET @temp_tz = -@last_login_TZ
  IF @last_login IS NOT NULL SET @last_login = DATEADD(mi, @temp_tz, @last_login)

  SET @temp_tz = -@last_pw_change_tz
  IF @last_pw_change IS NOT NULL SET @last_pw_change = DATEADD(mi, @temp_tz, @last_pw_change)

  SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 10
  IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0)     SET @attr_value = '2'

  SET @auth_method = NULL
  IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 405 )BEGIN
	SELECT @auth_method = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 405
  END
IF @auth_method = 0
  SELECT user_name.user_id
	            ,user_name.user_desc
	--            ,user_name.encrypt_pw
	            ,user_name.active
	            ,user_name.hourly_cost
	            ,user_name.email_address
	            ,user_name.lang_id
	            ,user_name.def_dept_id
	            ,labor_dept.dept_desc
				,user_name.last_login as last_login
				,user_name.last_pw_change as last_pw_change
	            ,user_name.auth_method
	            ,user_name.def_lab_cd
	            ,user_name.smtp_server
	            ,user_name.pop3_server
	            ,user_name.email_account
	            ,user_name.email_pw
	            ,user_name.spare1
	            ,user_name.spare2
	            ,user_name.spare3
	            ,user_name.spare4
	            ,user_name.last_edit_comment
	            ,user_name.last_edit_by
	            ,user_name.last_edit_at
	            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, user_name.mod_id))) mod_id
	            ,user_name.row_id
	  FROM user_name user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK) ON user_name.def_dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
	    WHERE ((user_name.user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.user_desc = @user_desc OR @user_desc IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.active = @active OR @active IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.hourly_cost = @hourly_cost OR @hourly_cost IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.lang_id = @lang_id OR @lang_id IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.def_dept_id = @def_dept_id OR @def_dept_id IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_login = @last_login OR @last_login IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_pw_change <= @last_pw_change OR @last_pw_change IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.auth_method = @auth_method) AND
	       (user_name.def_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd OR @def_lab_cd IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	       ORDER BY CASE WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN user_id
	 		WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN user_desc
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN user_id
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN user_desc
			END,
			CASE	WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN user_id
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN user_desc
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN user_desc
	 		WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN user_id
			END

ELSE

	SELECT user_name.user_id
	            ,user_name.user_desc
	--            ,user_name.encrypt_pw
	            ,user_name.active
	            ,user_name.hourly_cost
	            ,user_name.email_address
	            ,user_name.lang_id
	            ,user_name.def_dept_id
	            ,labor_dept.dept_desc
				,user_name.last_login as last_login
				,user_name.last_pw_change as last_pw_change
	            ,user_name.auth_method
	            ,user_name.def_lab_cd
	            ,user_name.smtp_server
	            ,user_name.pop3_server
	            ,user_name.email_account
	            ,user_name.email_pw
	            ,user_name.spare1
	            ,user_name.spare2
	            ,user_name.spare3
	            ,user_name.spare4
	            ,user_name.last_edit_comment
	            ,user_name.last_edit_by
	            ,user_name.last_edit_at
	            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, user_name.mod_id))) mod_id
	  FROM user_name user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK) ON user_name.def_dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
	    WHERE ((user_name.user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.user_desc = @user_desc OR @user_desc IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.active = @active OR @active IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.hourly_cost = @hourly_cost OR @hourly_cost IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.lang_id = @lang_id OR @lang_id IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.def_dept_id = @def_dept_id OR @def_dept_id IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_login = @last_login OR @last_login IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_pw_change <= @last_pw_change OR @last_pw_change IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.auth_method = 1 OR user_name.auth_method = 2) AND
	       (user_name.def_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd OR @def_lab_cd IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	       (user_name.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	       ORDER BY CASE WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN user_id
	 		WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN user_desc
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN user_id
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN user_desc
			END,
			CASE	WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN user_id
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN user_desc
		 	WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN user_desc
	 		WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN user_id
			END
