--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_s_ofi_st_trans_status
-- Description:	The stored procedure will get trasnfer status of the line

--Usage : Stock Transfer
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2023-12-12		Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_st_trans_status] @lineid INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @transferRunning VARCHAR(80) = 'RUNNING' --- To compare Line status running
	DECLARE @transferStatusCdRunning INT
	DECLARE @TransferIdle VARCHAR(80) = 'IDLE'

	--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE
	SELECT @transferStatusCdRunning=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@transferRunning

	

	;WITH CTE_st
	AS (
		SELECT count(ent_id) AS CNT
		FROM [dbo].[ofi_st_trans_selection] st
		WHERE st.ent_id = @lineid
			AND transfer_status_cd = @transferStatusCdRunning
		)
	SELECT CASE 
			WHEN CNT > 0
				THEN @TransferRunning
			ELSE @TransferIdle
			END as lineStatus
	FROM CTE_st
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Jull_AddJobUtilEvent]
(@log_id                  INT32_NULL = NULL
,@wo_id                   STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@seq_no                  INT32_NULL = NULL
,@item_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@job_start_local         TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@duration                INT32_NULL = NULL
,@last_edit_comment       STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value    INT32_NULL = NULL
,@job_pos                 INT32 OUT
,@last_edit_at            TDATETIME OUT
,@row_id                  INT32 OUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_JULL_ADDJOBUTILEVENT
-- Description          - Adds a new job util log event if applicable; otherwise updates an existing job util log event.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 03/15/2007
-- Version				- 3.2.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 05/16/2007       Raghu           3.2.8		HD# 9689, Job_Pos in this method is optional. If a user does not supply the job_pos;
--                                              then the middleware automatically retrieves the job_pos from job_exec table.
-- 06/14/2007		AML				3.2.8		Ported to Sql Server 2000.
-- 08/15/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 01/28/2008		AML				3.4.0		Modified datatype of parameters @log_id, @seq_no, and @duration from float to int.
-- 01/05/2010		Eswar			4.0			HF1432 - Bring HF Forward changes.
-- 08/17/2016		Raghu			5.3	UserStory: 675693 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @ent_id		INT32
	,@event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@event_end_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME
	,@job_end_utc		TDATETIME
	,@err_str		NVARCHAR(2000)

	SET @duration = ISNULL( @duration, 0 )

	--First, retrieve the entity where the utilization was captured.
	SELECT	@ent_id = uh.ent_id
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.log_id = @log_id

	IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566}, util_history.log_id=' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @log_id )
		RAISERROR( @err_str, 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @job_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

	--Calculate the job event's end time.
	SET @job_end_utc = DATEADD(SS, @duration, @job_start_utc)

	IF ( @job_start_utc >= @job_end_utc ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'The job start time cannot be later than the job end time.{5511}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Default job_pos to 0, if null
	SET @job_pos = COALESCE(@job_pos, 0)

	EXEC sp_I_Job_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
		, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc, @job_pos=@job_pos, @item_id=@item_id
		, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
		, @last_edit_comment='JobUtilLogLink.AddJobUtilEvent', @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Spec_SetActSpecValue]
(@session_id	INT32,
 @ent_id             INT32,
 @spec_id	STRING40,
 @act_spec_value	STRING40,
 @job_pos             INT32 = 0,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      - 	Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 10/26/2002     TC                     		Included job_pos as parameter
-- 12/03/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	(HD# 1300) Changed Idle to Null
-- 01/07/2003	Raghu		1.5.2	Modified as per latest spec (Middleware User Manual  - Set Actual Spec Value)
-- 01/08/2003	Rohit		1.5.0	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	   ,@oper_id           	NVARCHAR(40)
	   ,@seq_no		INT
	   ,@count		INT
	--Get WO_Id, Oper_ID, Seq_No from Job_exec for the input ent_id
	SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos
-- 10/26/2002      TC                     Included job_pos in WHERE clause
	--Raise Error if wo_id is null or IDLE
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR('There is no job running on this entity or the Work Order may not exist{3167}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	IF UPPER(@wo_id) = 'IDLE' BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The job is currently IDLE{3170}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	--Raise Err if spec_id doesnot exist in job_spec for the current wo_id, oper_id and seq_no
	--If Exist, Update actual_spec_value for the input wo_id, oper_id, seq_no and spec_id
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM job_spec
		         WHERE job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id
			and job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
			and job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no
			and job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id
		        ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Spec doesnot exist for this job{3171}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @count = count(DISTINCT step_no) FROM job_spec
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		      AND oper_id = @oper_id
		      AND seq_no = @seq_no
		      AND spec_id = @spec_id
		IF (@count = 1) --spec_id is defined only once for this job (not repeated for different steps).  update job_stept irrespective of which steps are running
			UPDATE job_spec SET act_spec_value = @act_spec_value
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
			    AND seq_no = @seq_no
			    AND spec_id = @spec_id
		ELSE -- spec_id is defined for multiple steps in this job then it will only update the actual spec value for currently running step(s)
			UPDATE job_spec SET act_spec_value = @act_spec_value
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
			    AND seq_no = @seq_no
			    AND spec_id = @spec_id
			    AND step_no IN
				(SELECT step_no FROM job_step_data
				 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					    AND  oper_id = @oper_id
					    AND seq_no = @seq_no
					    AND state_cd = 3)
	END
END

/*

-- Name:		fn_st_chKSourceValidity
-- Description:	Returns the silo validity based on dIFferent parameters for stock transfer
--
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer - Destination silo selection

-- EXEC [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_st_trans_dest] 790
--select * from [fn_st_chKSourceValidity](477,'source',NULL,NULL,790)
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00		AP				2023/12/24		Initial version.
--0.01.10		Veervar Joshi	2024/01/26		Localization added.
--0.01.20		Veervar Joshi	2024/02/02		Active on max line logic changes.

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_st_chKSourceValidity] (
	@storage_ent_id INT
	, @silo_type NVARCHAR(80) -- Source or Destination
	, @inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- inventory item id
	, @inv_grade_cd INT -- inv grade cd	
	, @job_ent_id INT	
	)
	--RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable
RETURNS @Output TABLE (
	isNotValidEnt INT
	, notValidDescDetails NVARCHAR(max)
	, storage_ent_id INT
	)

BEGIN
	DECLARE @su_status_cd INT32
		, @isNotValidEnt INT = 0
		, @notValidDescDetails NVARCHAR(max) = ''
		, @item_state_cd INT
		, @cfg_act_line_cnt INT -- configured active line count in the silo attribute
		, @act_line_count INT --silo which is used in the other lines at present
		, @min_dosing_qty_kg INT -- minimum dosing qty
		, @silo_qty FLOAT
		, @uom_id INT
		, @uom_desc NVARCHAR(20)
		, @su_bypass_validation INT
		, @AllowOnlySameSource INT -- v0.02 Added
		, @AllowOnlySameItemGroup INT -- v0.02 Added
		, @chkJobstateoftheInv INT
		, @substitute_item_validation INT
		, @su_inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80)
		, @su_inv_grade_cd INT
		, @su_inv_state_cd INT
		, @job_bom_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
		, @job_bom_grade_cd INT
		, @bypass_grade_validation INT = 0
		,@srcQtyleft FLOAT=0
	DECLARE @su_attr AS TABLE (
		attr_desc NVARCHAR(80)
		, attr_value STRING1700_NULL
		
		)

	SELECT @su_bypass_validation = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
	WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'su_bypass_validation'

	SET @su_bypass_validation = ISNULL(@su_bypass_validation, 0)
	
	
	
IF (@silo_type = 'source')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @item_state_cd = item_status_cd
		FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_status_desc = 'UNRESTRICTED'
		
		IF (@su_inv_state_cd <> @item_state_cd)
		BEGIN
			SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
			SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300036,NULL,NULL) 
		END		

		--Attribute Level validation
		IF (@silo_type = 'source'	AND @isNotValidEnt = 0) -- [@isNotValidEnt = 0] execute only when it is valid till this point
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @su_attr
				SELECT a.attr_desc
					, ea.attr_value
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
					AND attr_desc IN (
						'LockForOutput'
						, 'BlockForQuality'		
						,'active_lines_as_source'
						)
				--CHECK IF SILO LOCKED FOR OUTPUT
				IF ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr	WHERE attr_desc = 'LockForOutput') = 1)
				BEGIN
					SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
					SET @notValidDescDetails =dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300037,NULL,NULL) 
				END

				--CHECK IF SILO BLOCKED FOR QUALITY
				IF ((SELECT attr_value	FROM @su_attr	WHERE attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'	) = 1)
				BEGIN
					SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
					SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL) 
				END
				
				--CHECK FOR ACTIVE ON MAXIMUM LINES AS SOURCE
				select @cfg_act_line_cnt = attr_value	FROM @su_attr where attr_desc='active_lines_as_source'
				select @act_line_count = count(1) from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) 
													where dest_type =1 and active_su_ent_id = @storage_ent_id														
			
				IF(@act_line_count >= ISNULL(@cfg_act_line_cnt,1)) 
				BEGIN
					set @isNotValidEnt=1
					set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300034,NULL,NULL) 
				END
				
			END
			--CHECK SOURCE SILO EMPTY
			SELECT @srcQtyleft=SUM(qty_left) FROM item_inv inv WHERE ent_id=@storage_ent_id
			IF(ISNULL(@srcQtyleft,0) <= 0 )
			BEGIN
			set @isNotValidEnt=1
			set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400015,NULL,NULL)
			END
				
		
	END
ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@su_bypass_validation = 0) -- 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @item_state_cd = item_status_cd
			FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_status_desc = 'UNRESTRICTED'

			
			IF (
					@silo_type = 'source'
					AND @isNotValidEnt = 0
					) -- [@isNotValidEnt = 0] execute only when it is valid till this point
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @su_attr
				SELECT a.attr_desc
					, ea.attr_value
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
					AND attr_desc IN (
						'LockForInput'
						, 'BlockForQuality'	
						,'active_lines_as_source'
						)

				IF (
						(
							SELECT attr_value
							FROM @su_attr
							WHERE attr_desc = 'LockForInput'
							) = 1
						)
				BEGIN
					SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
					SET @notValidDescDetails =dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300037,NULL,NULL)  
				END

				IF (
						(
							SELECT attr_value
							FROM @su_attr
							WHERE attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
							) = 1
						)
				BEGIN
					SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
					SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL) 
				END

				--CHECK FOR ACTIVE ON MAXIMUM LINES AS SOURCE
				select @cfg_act_line_cnt = attr_value	FROM @su_attr where attr_desc='active_lines_as_source'
				select @act_line_count = count(1) from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) 
													where dest_type =1 and active_su_ent_id = @storage_ent_id														
			
				IF(@act_line_count >= ISNULL(@cfg_act_line_cnt,1)) 
				BEGIN
					set @isNotValidEnt=1
					set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300034,NULL,NULL) 
				END

				
				IF (@isNotValidEnt=0)
					BEGIN
								select  @min_dosing_qty_kg = eam.attr_value		--cast(replace(eam.attr_value, ',', '') as decimal(18,3))
								from ent_attr ea with(nolock) 
								inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
								inner join ent_attr eam with(nolock) on eam.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
								where a.attr_desc = 'EntityType' and ea.attr_value = 'Site'
								and eam.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'min_dosing_qty_kg')
											
											
							IF(@min_dosing_qty_kg is not null)
							BEGIN						

								select  @silo_qty = sum(qty_left *isnull(uc.factor,1) ) 
								from item_inv inv with(nolock)
								inner join item i on inv.item_id = i.item_id and inv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
								left join uom_conv uc on i.uom_id = uc.from_uom_id and (uc.item_id is null) and uc.to_uom_id =(select top 1 uom_id from uom where description ='KG')
								
								
								IF(@silo_qty<@min_dosing_qty_kg)
								BEGIN
								set @isNotValidEnt=1
								set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails +  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300039,NULL,NULL) + LTRIM(STR(@silo_qty, 25, 1)) ++' '+ @uom_desc 
								END
							END
								
					END 

			--CHECK SOURCE SILO EMPTY
			SELECT @srcQtyleft=SUM(inv.qty_left) FROM item_inv inv WHERE ent_id=476
			IF(ISNULL(@srcQtyleft,0) <= 0 )
			BEGIN
			set @isNotValidEnt=1
			set @notValidDescDetails =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400015,NULL,NULL)		
			END

			END
			
		END -- end of su_bypass_validation=0
	END
	
	INSERT INTO @Output
	SELECT @isNotValidEnt
		, @notValidDescDetails
		, @storage_ent_id

	RETURN;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Receipt]
(@po_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @po_line_no  int  ,
 @date_rcvd_utc  datetime  ,
 @date_rcvd_local  datetime  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @vend_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @invoice  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @rcvd_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @rcvd_at  int  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Receipt
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--07/12/2006	Raghu	3.1.19		HD# 8460, Include receipt entity name in the return recordset.
--09/04/2007	AML		3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--IF @date_rcvd IS NOT NULL SET @date_rcvd = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @date_rcvd)

SELECT receipt.po_id
       ,receipt.po_line_no
	   ,receipt.date_rcvd_utc
	   ,receipt.date_rcvd_local
       ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, receipt.date_rcvd_utc) AS date_rcvd
       ,receipt.item_id
       ,receipt.vend_id
       ,receipt.invoice
       ,receipt.rcvd_by
       ,receipt.rcvd_at
       ,receipt_entity.ent_name receipt_ent_name
       ,receipt.spare1
       ,receipt.spare2
       ,receipt.spare3
       ,receipt.spare4
       ,receipt.last_edit_comment
       ,receipt.last_edit_by
       ,receipt.last_edit_at
FROM receipt WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent receipt_entity WITH (NOLOCK) ON receipt.rcvd_at = receipt_entity.ent_id
WHERE ((receipt.po_id = @po_id OR @po_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.po_line_no = @po_line_no OR @po_line_no IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.date_rcvd_utc = @date_rcvd_utc OR @date_rcvd_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (receipt.date_rcvd_local = @date_rcvd_local OR @date_rcvd_local IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.vend_id = @vend_id OR @vend_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.invoice = @invoice OR @invoice IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.rcvd_by = @rcvd_by OR @rcvd_by IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.rcvd_at = @rcvd_at OR @rcvd_at IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (receipt.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_sa_ofi_su_get_inv_details
-- Description:	to get the inventory details based on the group, it is being used in SU overview screen
--
-- Usage:	to get the inventory details based on the group, it is being used in SU overview screen
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-03-24			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00	DS			2024-02-06			Updated header comments
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_sa_ofi_su_get_inv_details] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @grp_desc NVARCHAR(100)=NULL,
			@uom NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	

    SELECT isl.item_group,i.item_id,i.item_desc
		,SUM(qty_left) as mes_qty
		,u.description as uom 
	FROM item_inv oss WITH(NOLOCK) -- inventory table
	LEFT JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK) ON isl.storage_ent_id= oss.ent_id  -- entity storage link table
	LEFT JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) on i.item_id= oss.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=oss.uom_id
	WHERE (isl.item_group like @grp_desc) AND u.description=@uom
	GROUP BY isl.item_group,u.description,i.item_id,i.item_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_DLG_SaveSampleByName]
(@grp_desc		STRING80 = NULL
,@ent_name		STRING80 = NULL
,@site_name		STRING80 = NULL
,@job_pos     INT32_NULL = NULL
,@step_no     INT32_NULL = NULL
,@lot_no      STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@sublot_no   STRING40_NULL = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_I_DLG_SaveSampleByName
-- Description          - Adds a data log sample.
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Author			 - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ent_id		INT32
			,@grp_id	INT32
			,@wo_id		STRING40
			,@oper_id	STRING40
			,@seq_no	INT32

	SELECT @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)
			, @grp_id = dbo.fn_GetDataLogGroupID(@grp_desc)

	IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Entity Id should be supplied OR entity should be assigned to a data log group{4197}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

    --Get wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no from job_exec for the current entity
    SELECT @wo_id = je.cur_wo_id, @oper_id = je.cur_oper_id, @seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
    FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
      AND je.job_pos = @job_pos

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ActualJob]  --obsolete
(
@wo_id NVARCHAR(max),
@res_grp_id NVARCHAR(max),
@item_id NVARCHAR(max),
@user_name NVARCHAR(50),
@session_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare  @sSQL NVARCHAR(max) 
	,@sessoId  NVARCHAR(10)
	,@session_date date
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--select top 1 @sessoId = session_id from SDB..scheduler_sessn where cast(scheduler_date as Date) = cast(@scheduledate as Date) 
	select top 1 @session_date = scheduler_date from SDB..scheduler_sessn where session_id = @session_id
	order by session_id desc

	

select w.wo_id, w.mo_id, w.release_time_local [wo_release_time], w.req_finish_time_local [wo_req_finish_time],
					w.wo_priority,  
					--j.sched_start_time_local [job_latest_start_time], j.req_finish_time_local [job_req_finished_time],
					CASE WHEN j.state_cd >=3 THEN j.act_start_time_local ELSE  j.sched_start_time_local END AS job_latest_start_time
					,CASE WHEN j.state_cd >3 THEN j.act_finish_time_local ELSE  j.req_finish_time_local END AS job_req_finished_time,
					j.qty_reqd, j.job_priority,  j.job_desc, j.oper_id, j.item_id,
					i.item_desc, j.init_sched_ent_id [job_sched_entity_id], e.description [job_sched_entity_name],j.sched_pinned [job_sched_pinned],
					j.seq_no,w.state_cd [wo_state] ,j.state_cd [job_state],j.first_job,j.final_job

		,'User' [checkedout_by],1 [is_validated],1 [is_downtime_exists],'User'  [validated_by],getdate() [validated_at],1 [is_released],'User'  [released_by],getdate() [released_at],@session_id [session_id] , [res_grp_id]

) AS

-- Author	      - Raghu

BEGIN

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_link_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_ent_link_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_link table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1  FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT oel.process_id FROM oper_ent_link oel
				 INNER JOIN  inserted i ON oel.process_id = i.process_id AND oel.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oel.ent_id = i.ent_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_ent_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT oel.process_id FROM oper_ent_link oel
				 INNER JOIN inserted i ON oel.process_id = i.process_id AND oel.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oel.ent_id = i.ent_id) oelink
	WHERE process.process_id = oelink.process_id

	UPDATE oper_ent_link SET oper_ent_link.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_ent_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_ent_link.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_ent_link.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oper_ent_link.ent_id = i.ent_id

END

-- Name:    sp_I_ofi_Additive_AddCons 
-- Description:  Add consumption for Additives which doesn't have Physical silo 
--
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00   MP            2023-07-03      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00   DS            2024-01-31      Added nolock & inline comments

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Additive_AddCons]
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(40) 
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) 
	,@seq_no INT 
	,@qty FLOAT 
	,@ent_id INT 
	,@aut_storage_id INT 
	,@item_id  NVARCHAR(40) = NULL 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @storage_ent_id INT
			,@cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
			,@cons_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
			,@date_time_UTC datetime =  GETUTCDATE()
			,@return_value int
			,@row_id INT32 =0
			,@minID INT
			,@prod_date_time_UTC datetime
			,@grade_cd int
			,@status_cd int
			,@is_bom_item int = 1
			,@shift_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
			,@shift_start_utc_act	TDATETIME
			,@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
			,@shift_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
			,@shift_start_tz	    INT32
			,@state_cd int
			,@error_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL

	--GETS Required Data
	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ent_id
	--FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_name='900VR001'  -- Virtual Silo for all the Additives
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_name='PSA'  

	SELECT  @item_id= i.item_id FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) 
						INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)  ON i.item_id=ia.item_id 
						INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id=ia.attr_id
						WHERE i.item_id LIKE '%'+(RIGHT (@aut_storage_id,5))
						AND a.attr_desc='ItemGroup'
						AND ia.attr_value='Additives'

	SELECT @state_cd= state_cd FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT @cons_lot_no=def_lot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id
	
	-- fetching respective codes
	SELECT @grade_cd= item_grade_cd from item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_desc='GOODGRADE'
	SELECT @status_cd= item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc='UNRESTRICTED'

	--Get the shift details
		-- Verify whether a shift start UTC time is supplied
	IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- shift start time UTC is not supplied
		IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL) SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	-- Default the shift times to null
	SELECT @shift_start_local = NULL, @shift_id = NULL

	-- Verify the shift actually exist
	SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_start_utc_act = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_id = sh.shift_id
        FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
        AND shift_start_utc <= COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, GETUTCDATE()) -- Default to the current date time, if no shift start utc/local is supplied to identify the current shift
	ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC

	-- Default the shift times to 1900 when a reliable shift cannot be found in the database
	IF (@shift_start_utc_act IS NULL) SET @shift_start_tz = 0
	SELECT @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc_act, '1900-01-01'), @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, '1900-01-01'), @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

IF(@item_id is not null)
	BEGIN
	--CHECK WO Running Or Completed
	IF(@state_cd in (3,4))
	BEGIN

	-- executing the STD sp

			EXEC	@return_value = [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Cons]
						@wo_id=@wo_id, 
						@oper_id=@oper_id, 
						@seq_no=@seq_no, 
						@shift_start_local=@shift_start_local , 
						@item_id=@item_id, 
						@lot_no=@cons_lot_no, 
						@fg_lot_no=NULL, 
						@sublot_no=NULL,
						@fg_sublot_no=NULL,
						@reas_cd=1, 
						@user_id=NULL,
						@item_scrapped=NULL, 
						@ent_id=@ent_id, 
						@shift_id=@shift_id, 
						@grade_cd=@grade_cd, 
						@status_cd=@status_cd, 
						@from_ent_id=@storage_ent_id,  --No inventory creation
						@qty_cons=@qty, 
						@qty_cons_erp=NULL,  
						@ext_ref=NULL, 
						@transaction_type=NULL,
						@genealogy_id=NULL, 
						@upstream_event_id=NULL, 
						@segment_requirement_id=NULL, 
						@segment_response_id=NULL, 
						@comments=NULL,  
						@spare1=NULL, 
						@spare2=NULL, 
						@spare3=NULL,  
						@spare4=NULL,
						@last_edit_at=NULL,
						@last_edit_comment=NULL,
						@row_id =@row_id output
		 END

	


	
 END	
 ELSE
 BEGIN
	SET @error_desc = 'Item Id is not available in MES for this Additive'
 END
END
SELECT @row_id AS row_id, @error_desc as error_desc

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_GetStatus]
(@ent_id int
,@child_levels int
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/27/2002		TC			1.5.0		Include job_exec.job_pos field in returned RS
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.14		HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--01/31/2008		Raghu			3.4		L00074254; Included job.qty_reqd, job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected to be returned via select clause.
--10/20/2008		Raghu			3.5		L00085798; The stored procedure sp_SA_Ent_GetStatus needs to have a column added to return the current job state code.
--07/11/2013        	Arun			4.6		Modified Sp to return uom details and item_display
--08/26/2013        Pradeep/Raghu   4.6     L00114385: Allow OCO to report Job Status updates related to changes of the Jobs triggered outside the Object.
--                                          user Story #213599 implementation.
--  2/26/2014      SLR          5.0  Add num_decimals and num_decimal_good_pp to the return dataset
--  7/14/2014      SLR          5.0  Add qty_remaining to the return dataset
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	@parent_ent_id	int,
	@level		int,
	@disp_order	NVARCHAR(10),
	@num_decimals_good_pp INT
BEGIN
SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 210
SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  where attr_id = 326

IF (@disp_order IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@disp_order) = 0) SET @disp_order = '0'

	IF (COALESCE(@ent_id, -1) <> -1) BEGIN
		SELECT @level = 1, @child_levels = COALESCE(@child_levels, 0)
		IF @child_levels > 0 BEGIN

			---create the temporary table to store the ent id
			CREATE TABLE #temp_ent_child(ent_id int,child_level int)
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			INSERT INTO #temp_ent_child VALUES (@ent_id,@level)
			Declare tem_cur  CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT ent_id FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_ent_id = @ent_id
			OPEN tem_cur
			FETCH FROM tem_cur INTO @parent_ent_id
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #temp_ent_child VALUES(@parent_ent_id,@level)
				--call sp_SA_Ent_Get_Status_Sub which loads recursively all childs in to temporary table
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_Get_Status_Sub @parent_ent_id,@level
				FETCH FROM tem_cur INTO @parent_ent_id
			END
			CLOSE tem_cur
			DEALLOCATE tem_cur
			--SET NOCOUNT OFF
			--populating all childs into #temp_ent_child is done, return the records for levels of @child_levels
		--	SELECT a.* FROM ent a,#temp_ent_child b
		--	WHERE a.ent_id = b.ent_id AND b.child_level <= @child_levels
		--	ORDER BY a.ent_id
			SELECT a.ent_id,a.ent_name,a.cur_shift_id,c.shift_desc cur_shift_desc,
				--DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, a.cur_shift_start_time) cur_shift_start_time
				a.cur_shift_start_time_utc, a.cur_shift_start_time_local,
				a.tree_icon,
				d.job_pos,d.cur_wo_id,d.cur_oper_id,d.cur_seq_no,d.cur_step_no,d.spare1,d.spare2,d.spare3,d.spare4,
				g.state_cd AS job_state_cd,
				e.target_perf,e.current_perf,e.target_qual,e.current_qual,e.target_oee,e.current_oee,
				f.mo_id,f.cust_info,g.item_id,
				CASE
				WHEN @disp_order = '0' THEN it.item_id
				WHEN @disp_order = '1' THEN it.item_desc
				WHEN @disp_order = '2' THEN it.item_id + '(' + it.item_desc + ')'
				WHEN @disp_order = '3' THEN it.item_desc + '(' + it.item_id + ')'
				END AS item_display,
				g.job_priority, u.uom_id, u.description AS uom_desc, u.abbreviation AS uom_abbr, it.num_decimals,
				@num_decimals_good_pp as num_decimals_good_pp,
				g.req_finish_time_utc, g.req_finish_time_local,
				g.qty_reqd, g.qty_prod, g.qty_rejected,
				g.qty_at_start,g.sched_start_time_utc, g.sched_start_time_local ,g.sched_finish_time_utc, g.sched_finish_time_utc,
				h.cur_state_cd,h.cur_reas_cd,h.target_util,h.current_util,
				--DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, h.cur_reas_start) cur_reas_start,
				h.cur_reas_start_utc, h.cur_reas_start_local,
				g.qty_reqd - g.qty_prod qty_to_do,
                CASE WHEN ROUND(g.qty_at_start - g.qty_prod - g.qty_rejected, it.num_decimals) <= 0 then 0
                else ROUND(g.qty_at_start - g.qty_prod - g.qty_rejected, it.num_decimals) end AS qty_remaining
			FROM ent a WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN shift c WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.cur_shift_id = c.shift_id
			INNER JOIN job_exec d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.ent_id = a.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = d.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN wo f WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.wo_id = d.cur_wo_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN job g WITH (NOLOCK) ON g.wo_id = d.cur_wo_id AND g.oper_id = d.cur_oper_id AND g.seq_no = d.cur_seq_no
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON it.item_id= g.item_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = COALESCE(g.uom_id, it.uom_id)
      			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec h WITH (NOLOCK) ON h.ent_id = d.ent_id
			INNER JOIN #temp_ent_child i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.ent_id = a.ent_id
			WHERE  i.child_level <= @child_levels
			ORDER BY a.ent_id
			DROP TABLE #temp_ent_child
		END
		ELSE
		SELECT a.ent_id,a.ent_name,a.cur_shift_id,c.shift_desc cur_shift_desc,
			--,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, a.cur_shift_start_time) cur_shift_start_time
			a.cur_shift_start_time_utc, a.cur_shift_start_time_local,
			a.tree_icon,
			d.job_pos,d.cur_wo_id,d.cur_oper_id,d.cur_seq_no,d.cur_step_no,d.spare1,d.spare2,d.spare3,d.spare4,g.state_cd AS job_state_cd,
			e.target_perf,e.current_perf,e.target_qual,e.current_qual,e.target_oee,e.current_oee,
			f.mo_id,f.cust_info,g.item_id,
			CASE
			WHEN @disp_order = '0' THEN it.item_id
			WHEN @disp_order = '1' THEN it.item_desc
 			WHEN @disp_order = '2' THEN it.item_id + '(' + it.item_desc + ')'
			WHEN @disp_order = '3' THEN it.item_desc + '(' + it.item_id + ')'
			END AS item_display,
			g.job_priority, u.uom_id, u.description AS uom_desc, u.abbreviation AS uom_abbr, it.num_decimals,
			@num_decimals_good_pp as num_decimals_good_pp,
			g.req_finish_time_utc, g.req_finish_time_local,
			g.qty_reqd, g.qty_prod, g.qty_rejected,
			g.qty_at_start,g.sched_start_time_utc, g.sched_start_time_local, g.sched_finish_time_utc, g.sched_finish_time_local,
			h.cur_state_cd,h.cur_reas_cd,h.target_util,h.current_util,
			--DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, h.cur_reas_start) cur_reas_start,
			h.cur_reas_start_utc, h.cur_reas_start_local,
			g.qty_reqd - g.qty_prod qty_to_do,
            CASE WHEN ROUND(g.qty_at_start - g.qty_prod - g.qty_rejected, it.num_decimals) <= 0 then 0
            else ROUND(g.qty_at_start - g.qty_prod - g.qty_rejected, it.num_decimals) end AS qty_remaining
		--FROM ent a WITH (NOLOCK),shift c WITH (NOLOCK),job_exec d WITH (NOLOCK),oee_exec e WITH (NOLOCK),wo f WITH (NOLOCK),job g WITH (NOLOCK),util_exec h WITH (NOLOCK)
			FROM ent a WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN shift c WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.cur_shift_id = c.shift_id
			INNER JOIN job_exec d WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.ent_id = a.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = d.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN wo f WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.wo_id = d.cur_wo_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN job g WITH (NOLOCK) ON g.wo_id = d.cur_wo_id AND g.oper_id = d.cur_oper_id AND g.seq_no = d.cur_seq_no
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON it.item_id= g.item_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = COALESCE(g.uom_id, it.uom_id)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec h WITH (NOLOCK) ON h.ent_id = d.ent_id
		WHERE  a.ent_id = @ent_id
	END
	ELSE
	SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.cur_shift_id, s.shift_desc, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, e.tree_icon,
		je.job_pos, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no, je.cur_step_no, je.spare1, je.spare2, je.spare3, je.spare4,
		j.state_cd AS job_state_cd,
		oe.target_perf, oe.current_perf, oe.target_qual, oe.current_qual, oe.target_oee, oe.current_oee,
		wo.mo_id, wo.cust_info, j.item_id,
		CASE
		WHEN @disp_order = '0' THEN it.item_id
		WHEN @disp_order = '1' THEN it.item_desc
		WHEN @disp_order = '2' THEN it.item_id + '(' + it.item_desc + ')'
		WHEN @disp_order = '3' THEN it.item_desc + '(' + it.item_id + ')'
		END AS item_display,
		j.job_priority, u.uom_id, u.description AS uom_desc, u.abbreviation AS uom_abbr, it.num_decimals,
		@num_decimals_good_pp as num_decimals_good_pp,
        j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local,
		j.qty_reqd, j.qty_prod, j.qty_rejected,
		j.qty_at_start, j.sched_start_time_utc, j.sched_start_time_local, j.sched_finish_time_utc, j.sched_finish_time_local,
		ue.cur_state_cd, ue.cur_reas_cd, ue.target_util, ue.current_util, ue.cur_reas_start_utc, ue.cur_reas_start_local,
		j.qty_reqd - j.qty_prod qty_to_do,
       CASE WHEN ROUND(j.qty_at_start - j.qty_prod - j.qty_rejected, it.num_decimals) <= 0 then 0
       else ROUND(j.qty_at_start - j.qty_prod - j.qty_rejected, it.num_decimals) end AS qty_remaining
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN shift s WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.cur_shift_id = s.shift_id
	INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON it.item_id= j.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = COALESCE(j.uom_id, it.uom_id)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = oe.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ue.ent_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_User_Name_ValidPwdExpiry]
(@user_id 		NVARCHAR(80)
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
,@login_errcode		INT = -3 OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_SA_User_Name_ValidPwdExpiry
-- Description            	- Checks whether the user password has expired
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created   	- 08/15/2003
-- Version (last edit)   	- 2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver    		Changes
--01/23/2006	Raghu		3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @lDaysOfPwdExpiry	INT
	    ,@last_pw_change	DATETIME
	,@current_time		TDATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @login_errcode = 0

	SELECT @lDaysOfPwdExpiry = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 206
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

	IF @lDaysOfPwdExpiry > 0 BEGIN
		SELECT @last_pw_change = last_pw_change FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id
		IF (@last_pw_change IS NULL) OR (DATEADD(dd, @lDaysOfPwdExpiry, @last_pw_change) < @current_time)
			SET @login_errcode = -3
	END

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
-- Description:This will be used to select the Sub Lot Number
-- Note : Add SublotCounter Attribute on Line Level in MES Client
-- Usage:	This will be used to select the Sub Lot Number
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	MP     	2022-07-28			Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	YG     	2022-07-28			Added separate sublot_counter and sublot_no
-- 0.03.00	MP     	2023-09-14			Added 5 digit sublot logic
-- 0.04.00	AKM		2024-02-01			coding best practice and dead code cleaning
-- 0.05.00	JSC		2025-10-22			Bring back this version on QA to use job bom/ added fail safe for not deflot found
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
        @wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT
AS
BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT ON;
		DECLARE @def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40),
				@parent_ent_id INT,
				@attr_id       INT,
				@sublot_no     NVARCHAR(40),
				@sublot_counter NVARCHAR(40)
				
		SELECT  @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
		FROM    job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				wo_id       = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no  = @seq_no
				AND bom_pos = 0
				
		--v0.05 added
		IF 	(@def_lot_no IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @def_lot_no = w.lot_no
			FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE
					w.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
		END
		
		SELECT  @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id
		FROM    ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
		WHERE 	wo_id  	= @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no 	= @seq_no
			
		SELECT  @attr_id = a.attr_id
		FROM    attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE a.attr_desc  = 'SublotCounter'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2

		-- 1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
		--v0.05 Added
		SELECT @sublot_counter = REPLACE (ea.attr_value,',','')
		FROM    ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	ea.attr_id	= @attr_id
			AND ea.ent_id 	= @parent_ent_id
		
		--v0.5 Mod
		SELECT  @sublot_no = CONCAT( @def_lot_no, (FORMAT(CAST(@sublot_counter AS INT),'00000','en-US')))
		
		-- RETURN select
		SELECT  @sublot_counter sublot_counter,
				@sublot_no      sublot_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Spec_UpdTemplSpecVals]
(@session_id		INT
,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@ent_id		INT
,@check_privs		INT = 0
,@job_pos		INT = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Description	      -	Change spec_values (if NOT Missing), min_value (if NOT missing), max_value (if NOT missing)
--			for a specific spec
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	12/08/2003
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.15
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id       NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no	INT
	,@count		INT
	,@priv_id	INT
	,@priv_value	INT
	,@process_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@ver_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@step_no	INT
	,@attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@spec_id	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@spec_exist	INT
	,@new_spec_value	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@bom_ver_id		NVARCHAR(80)
BEGIN
  IF (@check_privs IS NULL) SET @check_privs = 0
  IF (@job_pos IS NULL) SET @job_pos = 0

  IF (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
    SET @priv_id = 24
    EXEC sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @priv_id, @priv_value OUTPUT
    IF (@priv_value = 0) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('This user does not have the privilege to Edit Specs{3172}', 16, 1)
	RETURN
    END
  END

  SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 235

  SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

  IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '') BEGIN
	RAISERROR('There is no job running on this entity or the Work Order may not exist{3169}', 16, 1)
	RETURN
  END

  DECLARE job_spec_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT step_no, spec_id, spec_value FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

  OPEN job_spec_csr
  WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

    FETCH NEXT FROM job_spec_csr INTO @step_no, @spec_id, @new_spec_value
    IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

    SET @spec_exist	= 0
    --Get Process_Id
    SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM WO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
    --Find no. of distinct oper_ent_spec versions
    SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT ver_id) FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND spec_id = @spec_id

    IF (@count = 1) --Only one oper_ent_spec version found and pick up the same
      SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
    ELSE -- More than 1 oper_ent_spec version exist, pick up the preferred version
      SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no
		  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id) BEGIN
      SET @spec_exist = 1
      UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value
    END

    SELECT @item_id = item_id FROM job
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

    --If bom_ver_id is null, get the preferred bom_version from bom_ver table
    IF (@bom_ver_id IS NULL)
      SELECT @bom_ver_id = ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1

    --Find no. of distinct bom_item_oper_spec versions
    SELECT @count = COUNT(DISTINCT spec_ver_id) FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0 AND process_id = @process_id
	AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no AND spec_id = @spec_id

    IF (@count = 1) --Only one spec version found and pick up the same
      SELECT @ver_id = spec_ver_id FROM bom_item_oper_spec
	WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0 AND process_id = @process_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
    ELSE -- More than 1 oper_ent_spec version exist, pick up the preferred version from oper_spec_ver
      SELECT @ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0 AND process_id = @process_id
	  	  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id) BEGIN
      IF (@spec_exist = 1) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('There are multiple specs exists for this job specification.{4732}', 16, 1)
	RETURN
      END

      UPDATE bom_item_oper_spec SET spec_value = @new_spec_value
	WHERE item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @bom_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0 AND process_id = @process_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no AND spec_ver_id = @ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id
	  AND spec_value <> @new_spec_value
    END
  END
  CLOSE job_spec_csr
  DEALLOCATE job_spec_csr
END

/*
--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_st_chKDestinationValidity
-- Description:	- Returns the silo validity based on diFferent parameters
--
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer destination selection

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version		Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00		AP				26/12/2023			Initial version.
-- 0.01.10		LK				19/01/2024			Select entity description/name changes.
-- 0.01.20		VeervarJ		24/01/2024			Localization function added
-- 0.01.30		Veervar			03-Mar-2024			Parameter added @src_ent_id
-- 0.01.40		MH				2025-10-23			Skip validating destination item if source item has the AllowReclassInTransfer attribute set
-- ===========================================================================================
*/

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_st_chKDestinationValidity](
    @storage_ent_id INT
    , @inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- inventory item 
    , @inv_grade_cd INT -- inv grade cd
    , @src_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- src bom item id
    , @src_grade_cd INT -- src grade cd 
    , @line_ent_id INT
    , @src_ent_id int
)

--RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable
    RETURNS @Output TABLE (
        isNotValidEnt       INT,
        notValidDescDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),
        storage_ent_id      INT,
        item_attr_id        NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        item_attr_value     NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        grade_cd            INT           NULL,
        grade_desc          NVARCHAR(50)  NULL
    )


BEGIN
    DECLARE @su_status_cd INT,
        @isNotValidEnt INT = 0,
        @notValidDescDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
        @item_state_cd INT,
        @cfg_act_line_cnt INT, -- configured active line count in the silo attribute
        @act_line_count INT, --silo which is used in the other lines at present
        @act_line_count_press INT,
        @allow_same_po_flag INT,
        @active_lines_as_dest INT,
        @active_lines_as_dest_flag INT = 0,
        @AllowOnlyEmptySilo INT = 0,
        @EnableDestOnSrcSelection INT

    --DECLARE @src_ent_id int
    DECLARE @nos_src_selected INT
    DECLARE @total_mes_qty FLOAT
    DECLARE @final_item_qty_reqd FLOAT
    DECLARE @final_item_min_qty_reqd FLOAT
    DECLARE @final_item_max_qty_reqd FLOAT
    DECLARE @mes_qty FLOAT
    DECLARE @absolute_qty FLOAT
    DECLARE @unq_item_su_msg NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @unq_item_su_active INT = 1
    DECLARE @auto_reclass_attr_id INT = NULL
    DECLARE @auto_reclass_attr_value NVARCHAR(50) = 'false'
    DECLARE @bfq_id INT
    DECLARE @bfq_desc NVARCHAR(10) = 'false'
    DECLARE @def_grd_attr_id INT
    DECLARE @def_grd_attr_value NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
    DECLARE @def_grd_code INT = 0
    DECLARE @unq_item_attr_id INT
    DECLARE @unq_item_attr_value NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
    DECLARE @check_inv NVARCHAR(50) = 'false'
    DECLARE @item_description NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
    DECLARE @item_attr_id NVARCHAR(100)
    DECLARE @item_attr_value NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
    DECLARE @grade_cd INT = 0
    DECLARE @grade_desc NVARCHAR(50)
    DECLARE @reqd_grade_cd INT = -1
    DECLARE @reqd_item_id NVARCHAR(100)
    DECLARE @sutype NVARCHAR(100) = 'NotBlocked'
    DECLARE @srcItemGroup NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
    DECLARE @itegGrpAttrId INT=0

    DECLARE @su_attr AS TABLE (
        attr_desc  NVARCHAR(80),
        attr_value STRING1700_NULL
    )

    --SELECT @src_ent_id=src_su_ent_id from Ofi_st_trans_selection with(nolock) where is_active=1 and ent_id=@line_ent_id --1.1

    INSERT INTO @su_attr
    SELECT a.attr_desc, ea.attr_value
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
    WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
        AND a.attr_desc IN ('LockForInput', 'BlockForQuality', 'BiDirectionalSilo', 'active_lines_as_dest')

    -- get ID for all attributes 
    SELECT @auto_reclass_attr_id = a.attr_id
    FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE a.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify'
        AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- Entity
        
    -- fetch id
    SELECT @bfq_id = attr_id
    FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE a.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
        AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- Entity

    SELECT @def_grd_attr_id = attr_id
    FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE a.attr_desc = 'default_grade'
        AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- Entity

    SELECT @unq_item_attr_id = attr_id
    FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE a.attr_desc = 'unique_item_id'
        AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- Entity

    SELECT @itegGrpAttrId = attr_id
    FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
        AND a.attr_grp = 1 -- Item

    -- [0.01.40 - CR 00203562]
    -- Skip validating destination item if source item has AllowReclassInTransfer attribute
    DECLARE @AllowReclassInTransferAttrId AS int;
    SELECT @AllowReclassInTransferAttrId = [attr_id]
    FROM [attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE [attr_desc] = 'AllowReclassInTransfer'
        AND [attr_grp] = 1 -- Item
    -- [/0.01.40 - CR 00203562]

    -- fetch values
    -- get @auto_reclass_attr_value value
    SELECT @auto_reclass_attr_value = ea.attr_value
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
        AND ea.attr_id = @auto_reclass_attr_id

    -- get bfq block for quality
    SELECT @bfq_desc = ea.attr_value
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ea.attr_id = @bfq_id
        AND ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id

    -- get grade code 
    --fetch configured default grade desc from entity
    SELECT @def_grd_attr_value = ea.attr_value
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
        AND ea.attr_id = @def_grd_attr_id

    --fetch configured default grade ID from entity 
    SELECT @def_grd_code = ig.item_grade_cd
    FROM item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ig.item_grade_desc = @def_grd_attr_value
        AND @def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL

    -- get unique item value 
    SELECT @unq_item_attr_value = ea.attr_value
    FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
        AND ea.attr_id = @unq_item_attr_id

    --fetch source item group
    SELECT @srcItemGroup = ia.attr_value
    FROM item_attr ia
        INNER JOIN item i
            ON i.item_id = ia.item_id
    -- [0.01.40 - CR 00203562]
    -- Fix hardcoded attribute ID
    -- WHERE ia.attr_id = 13
    WHERE ia.attr_id = @itegGrpAttrId
    -- [/0.01.40 - CR 00203562]
        AND ia.item_id = @src_item_id


    -- if @unq_item_attr_value and @def_grd_attr_value is not null then its unique Item SU
    -- for unique Item SU only check if SU holds any inventory then it goes into else part but if its empty them its SU will return as active and with info as 
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ii.ent_id = @storage_ent_id)
    BEGIN
        SET @check_inv = 'true'
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @check_inv = 'false'
    END

    -- check if silo is blocked 
    IF (
        ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'BiDirectionalSilo') <> 1)
        OR ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'LockForInput') = 1)
        OR ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality') = 1)
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @sutype = 'blocked'
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @sutype = 'NotBlocked'
    END

    --check if item inv is having value for that silo
    IF (
        @unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
        AND @def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL
        AND @check_inv = 'false'
    )
    BEGIN

        -- get item grade from src item grade
        SET @reqd_grade_cd = @src_grade_cd

        IF (@reqd_grade_cd <> -1)
        BEGIN
            -- set values for unique if item and grade matches else set as inactive
            DECLARE @dblocalMsg1 nvarchar(80), @dblocalMsg2 nvarchar(80)
            SELECT @dblocalMsg1 = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300022, NULL, NULL);
            SELECT @dblocalMsg2 = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300023, NULL, NULL);
            IF (@unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
                AND @reqd_grade_cd = @def_grd_code
                AND @sutype = 'NotBlocked'
                AND @unq_item_attr_value = @src_item_id)
            BEGIN
                -- set values are the same, SU is active, and set SU is configured for item and grade in msg
                SELECT @item_description = i.item_desc
                FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE i.item_id = @unq_item_attr_value

                SELECT @isNotValidEnt = 0,
                     @notValidDescDetails = CONCAT(@dblocalMsg1, @item_description, @dblocalMsg2, @def_grd_attr_value),
                     @storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id,
                     @item_attr_id = @unq_item_attr_value,
                     @item_attr_value = @item_description,
                     @grade_cd = @def_grd_code,
                     @grade_desc = @def_grd_attr_value
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- set values are different, SU inactive and set SU is configured for item and grade in msg
                SELECT @item_description = i.item_desc
                FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE i.item_id = @unq_item_attr_value
                SELECT @isNotValidEnt = 1,
                     @notValidDescDetails = CONCAT(@dblocalMsg1, @item_description, @dblocalMsg2, @def_grd_attr_value),
                     @storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id,
                     @item_attr_id = @unq_item_attr_value,
                     @item_attr_value = @item_description,
                     @grade_cd = @def_grd_code,
                     @grade_desc = @def_grd_attr_value

            END

            IF ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'BiDirectionalSilo') <> 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300028, NULL, NULL)
            END
            --CHECK LOCK FOR INPUT
            IF ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'LockForInput') = 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300024, NULL, NULL)
            END
            --CHECK BLOCK FOR QUALITY
            IF ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality') = 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025, NULL, NULL)
            END
            --CHECK SAME SILO SELECTED AS SOURCE
            IF (@storage_ent_id = @src_ent_id) --1.1
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400012, NULL, NULL)
            END
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
            SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300027, NULL, NULL)
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        BEGIN
            --CHECK ITEM MATCH
            -- [0.01.40 - CR 00203562]
            -- Skip validating destination item if the source item has AllowReclassInTransfer attribute
            --IF(@src_item_id IS NOT NULL AND (@src_item_id <>@inv_item_id AND @inv_item_id IS NOT NULL))
            DECLARE @AllowReclassInTransfer AS char(1);
            SELECT @AllowReclassInTransfer = attr_value
            FROM item_attr
            WHERE item_id = @src_item_id
                AND attr_id = @AllowReclassInTransferAttrId

            IF (
                @src_item_id IS NOT NULL AND @inv_item_id IS NOT NULL
                AND @src_item_id <> @inv_item_id
                AND (@AllowReclassInTransfer IS NULL OR @AllowReclassInTransfer != '1')
            )
            -- [/0.01.40 - CR 00203562]
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300026, NULL, NULL)
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                --CHECK GRADE MATCH
                IF (@inv_item_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@src_grade_cd IS NOT NULL)
                BEGIN
                    IF (@inv_grade_cd <> ISNULL(@src_grade_cd, -1))
                    BEGIN
                        SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                        SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300027, NULL, NULL)
                    END
                END

            END
            --SOURCE ITEM NULL
            IF (@src_item_id IS NULL)
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300030, NULL, NULL)
            END
        END

        IF (@isNotValidEnt = 0) -- [@isNotValidEnt = 0] execute only when it is valid till this point
        BEGIN
            IF ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'LockForInput') = 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300024, NULL, NULL)
            END
            IF ((SELECT attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality') = 1)
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025, NULL, NULL)
            END

            IF (@storage_ent_id = @src_ent_id) --1.1
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400012, NULL, NULL)
            END


            --CHECK FOR ACTIVE ON MAXIMUM LINES AS SOURCE
            SELECT @cfg_act_line_cnt = attr_value FROM @su_attr WHERE attr_desc = 'active_lines_as_dest'
            SELECT @act_line_count = COUNT(1)
            FROM ofi_su_selection oss WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE dest_type = 2
                AND active_su_ent_id = @storage_ent_id

            IF (@act_line_count >= ISNULL(@cfg_act_line_cnt, 1))
            BEGIN
                SET @isNotValidEnt = 1
                SET @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300034, NULL, NULL)
            END

        END

    END
    INSERT INTO @Output
    SELECT @isNotValidEnt,
         @notValidDescDetails,
         @storage_ent_id,
         @item_attr_id,
         @item_attr_value,
         @grade_cd,
         @grade_desc
    RETURN;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Receipt_Lot]
(@po_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @date_rcvd_utc  datetime  ,
 @date_rcvd_local  datetime  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @sublot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @uom_id  int  ,
 @trans_id  int  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime  ,
 @row_id  int ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Receipt_Lot
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--09/04/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

SELECT receipt_lot.po_id
       ,receipt_lot.date_rcvd_utc
	   ,receipt_lot.date_rcvd_local
       ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, receipt_lot.date_rcvd_utc) AS date_rcvd
       ,receipt_lot.item_id
       ,receipt_lot.lot_no
       ,receipt_lot.sublot_no
       ,receipt_lot.quantity
       ,receipt_lot.uom_id
       ,receipt_lot.trans_id
       ,receipt_lot.last_edit_comment
       ,receipt_lot.last_edit_by
       ,receipt_lot.last_edit_at
       ,receipt_lot.row_id
FROM receipt_lot receipt_lot
WHERE ((receipt_lot.po_id = @po_id OR @po_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.date_rcvd_utc = @date_rcvd_utc OR @date_rcvd_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (receipt_lot.date_rcvd_local = @date_rcvd_local OR @date_rcvd_local IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
	   (receipt_lot.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.trans_id = @trans_id OR @trans_id IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (receipt_lot.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL))

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_sa_ofi_su_item_grade
-- Description:	to get item grade from item group (passing parameter)
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-04-16			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00	DS			2024-02-06			Updated header comments
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_su_item_grade]
	@item_grp NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @SearchWord NVARCHAR(30) ;
	
	IF((@item_grp is not null) AND (@item_grp <> N''))
	BEGIN
	SET @SearchWord = N'%'+ @item_grp +'%'  
	SELECT ig1.item_grade_desc		  
			,ig1.item_grade_cd  
			,ig1.good_prod
			,ig1.scrapped
			,ig1.color
			,ig1.pref
			,ig1.last_edit_comment
			,ig1.last_edit_by
			,ig1.last_edit_at
	FROM dbo.item_grade  as ig1 WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  ig1.item_grade_desc like @SearchWord
	UNION ALL
	SELECT ig2.item_grade_desc		  
			,ig2.item_grade_cd  
			,ig2.good_prod
			,ig2.scrapped
			,ig2.color
			,ig2.pref
			,ig2.last_edit_comment
			,ig2.last_edit_by
			,ig2.last_edit_at 
	FROM dbo.item_grade as ig2 WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ig2.last_edit_comment='generic'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT ig3.item_grade_desc		  
			,ig3.item_grade_cd  
			,ig3.good_prod
			,ig3.scrapped
			,ig3.color
			,ig3.pref
			,ig3.last_edit_comment
			,ig3.last_edit_by
			,ig3.last_edit_at  
		FROM dbo.item_grade as ig3 WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ig3.last_edit_comment='generic'
	END

END

CREATE Trigger [tg_oper_ent_route_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_route]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_ent_route_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_route table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2030) Update first_oper and final_oper flags in this table
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_ent_route_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_ent_route', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags @process_id
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_route_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_route_cursor
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_data_log_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[data_log]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - tg_data_log_aft_upd (Trigers after an update is made to the data_log table)
-- Author	      - Raghu G
-- Date Created	      -	2020/01/21
-- Version	      - 6.3
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE data_log
	SET data_log.grp_id = d.grp_id -- Update the existing data log grp ID; that is, ignore the update to grp_id
	  , data_log.sample_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(i.ent_id, i.sample_time_utc)
	  , data_log.shift_id = CASE WHEN i.ent_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(shift_info.shift_id, 0) END
	  , data_log.shift_start_utc = CASE WHEN i.ent_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(shift_info.shift_start_utc, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01')) END
	  , data_log.shift_start_local = CASE WHEN i.ent_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(shift_info.shift_start_local, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01')) END
	  , data_log.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
	  , data_log.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	  , data_log.created_at_local = d.created_at_local -- Update the existing create time; that is, ignore the update to create local time
	  , data_log.created_at_utc = d.created_at_utc -- Update the existing create time; that is, ignore the update to utc time
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.row_id = d.row_id
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local, sh.shift_id
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = i.ent_id
			  AND shift_start_utc <= i.sample_time_utc
			ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC) shift_info
	WHERE data_log.row_id = i.row_id
END
