CREATE  PROC [dbo].[sp_I_Util_Raw_Reas_AddReasXML]
(
	@ent_id	int,
	@raw_reasons_xml NVARCHAR(MAX)
/**************************
Sample Xml format:
<raw_reasons>
	<raw_reas_cd name="RRC1" def_reas_cd="5" prompt="0" last_edit_comment="comment1">
		<reas_link>3</reas_link>
		<reas_link>4</reas_link>
		<reas_link>5</reas_link>
	</raw_reas_cd>
	<raw_reas_cd name="RRC2" def_reas_cd="4" prompt="1" last_edit_comment="comment2">
		<reas_link>4</reas_link>
		<reas_link>5</reas_link>
		<reas_link>6</reas_link>
	</raw_reas_cd>
</raw_reasons>
**************************/
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - sp_I_Util_Raw_Reas_AddReasXML
-- Description	  - inserts utilization raw reason and reason link records
-- Author	      - Raghunath Kothamasu, Sravan Aitha
-- Date Created	  -	02/26/2014
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 01/05/2016	Raghu		5.2	UserStory: 575757 - As Lenka, I want the EMB to export the raw reason code faster so that it does not hold locks on the database
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE  @doc_handle int
		,@raw_reas_cd nvarchar(80)
		,@last_edit_at DATETIME
		,@reas_cd int
		,@prompt bit
		,@last_edit_comment nvarchar(80)
		,@err_msg NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@last_edit_by      NVARCHAR(160)

       IF (@raw_reasons_xml IS NULL) BEGIN
             RAISERROR('The %1 Should not be null{3339},Raw Reasons Xml', 16, 1)
             RETURN
       END

       IF (@raw_reasons_xml = '') BEGIN
             RAISERROR('The %1 Should not be blank{3340},Raw Reasons Xml', 16, 1)
             RETURN
       END

       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
             SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'EntityID:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @ent_id)
             RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
             RETURN
       END

       EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
       SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

       EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @raw_reasons_xml

       INSERT INTO util_raw_reas (ent_id, raw_reas_cd, def_reas_cd, prompt, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
       SELECT @ent_id, raw_reas_cd, reas_cd, COALESCE(prompt, 0), last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
       FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/raw_reasons/raw_reas_cd', 1)
       WITH (  raw_reas_cd nvarchar(80) '@name',
                    reas_cd int '@def_reas_cd',
                    prompt bit '@prompt',
                    last_edit_comment nvarchar(80) '@last_edit_comment')

       INSERT INTO util_reas_link (ent_id, raw_reas_cd, reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
       SELECT @ent_id, raw_reas_cd, reas_cd, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
             FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/raw_reasons/raw_reas_cd/reas_link', 1)
             WITH (  raw_reas_cd nvarchar(80) '../@name',
                           reas_cd int '.')

       EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_utilization_data]
AS
WITH util_times (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_end_time_utc) AS
(SELECT TOP 100000000 vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc, vuht.event_end_time_utc
FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
ORDER BY vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc
)
SELECT util_log.log_id,
       util_log.event_time_utc,
       util_log.event_time_local,
       util_log.ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       jh.wo_id,
       wo.wo_desc,
       jh.oper_id,
       jh.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.qty_prod,
       job.qty_rejected,
       CASE job.est_prod_rate
	   WHEN 0 THEN 0
	   ELSE
		   CASE job.prod_uom
			  WHEN 1 THEN job.est_prod_rate/60.0
			  WHEN 2 THEN job.est_prod_rate/3600.0
			  WHEN 3 THEN 1.0/job.est_prod_rate
			  WHEN 4 THEN (1.0/job.est_prod_rate)/60.0
			  WHEN 5 THEN (1.0/job.est_prod_rate)/3600.0
			  ELSE job.est_prod_rate
		   END
       END AS est_prod_rate,
       job.batch_size,
       jh.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       util_log.shift_id,
       shift.shift_desc,
       util_log.shift_start_utc,
       util_log.shift_start_local,
       util_log.state_cd,
       util_state.state_desc,
       util_state.color,
       util_log.reas_cd,
       util_reas.reas_desc,
       util_reas.reas_grp_id,
       util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,
       util_log.reas_pending,
       util_log.runtime,
       util_log.downtime,
       util_log.setuptime,
       util_log.teardowntime,
       util_log.fixedtime,
       util_log.vartime,
       COALESCE(DATEDIFF(SS, CASE WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= util_log.event_time_utc THEN util_log.event_time_utc ELSE jh.job_start_utc END,
              				CASE WHEN COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > util_log.event_end_time_utc THEN util_log.event_end_time_utc ELSE COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) END)
       		, util_log.duration) AS duration
       ,util_log.comments
       ,util_log.event_end_time_utc
       	 ,jh.job_pos
       	 ,jh.job_start_utc
       	 ,jh.job_start_local
       	 ,jh.job_end_utc
	 ,jh.job_end_local
FROM util_log util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN util_times ut ON util_log.ent_id = ut.ent_id AND util_log.event_time_utc = ut.event_time_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON ut.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > ut.event_time_utc
	AND jh.job_start_utc < ut.event_end_time_utc
INNER JOIN ent ent  WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.ent_id = ent.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN wo wo  WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.wo_id = wo.wo_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK)  ON jh.wo_id = job.wo_id AND jh.oper_id = job.oper_id AND jh.seq_no = job.seq_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK)  ON jh.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN shift shift  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN util_state util_state  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.state_cd = util_state.state_cd
INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_log.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp  WITH (NOLOCK) ON
   util_reas.reas_grp_id = util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom  WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Exec]
(@ent_id  int  ,
 @cur_state_cd  int  ,
 @cur_reas_cd  int  ,
 @reas_reqd  bit  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @get_current_util LOGICAL = 1,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver      		Changes
-- 12/09/2002	  Raghu		1.5.2		 Included Shift_Start_Reason Description and Shift End Reason Description
-- 02/18/2003	  Raghu		1.5.9	 	Included Current Raw Reason Code Description to return in select statement
-- 07/07/2003	  Raghu		1.6.13	 	Changed the reas_desc to raw_reas_desc
-- 08/26/2003       Sheetal Jain  	1.6.0.22 	(HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 09/22/2003	Raghu		2.0.0.3		(HD# 2493, 2441) Retrieve curret reason duration to sync with client pc clocks.
-- 12/15/2004	Raghu		2.1.9		(HD# 5168). Commented out the reas_desc for a raw_reason; raw reason will never have a description
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--01/30/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--09/06/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
--05/16/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 676788 - As Lenka, I want statistics to be optionally calculated when sp_SA_Oee_Exec, sp_S_Oee_Exec, sp_SA_Util_Exec, and sp_S_Util_Exec is called
--06/07/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 816528 - As Lenka, I want statistics to be optionally calculated and defaulted to TRUE when sp_SA_Oee_Exec, sp_S_Oee_Exec, sp_SA_Util_Exec, and sp_S_Util_Exec is called
--09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:909263 - As Lenka, I don't want to have primary key violations running the UCO (CR L00146469)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @current_utilizations	TABLE(ent_id INT, current_util FLOAT)

DECLARE @util_ent_id	INT32
	,@current_util	FLOAT

BEGIN

SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	, @get_current_util = COALESCE(@get_current_util, 1) --Default to 1, current utilization will be calculated by default.

	IF (@get_current_util = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE utils_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
    		SELECT util_exec.ent_id
    		FROM util_exec util_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ((util_exec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.cur_state_cd = @cur_state_cd OR @cur_state_cd IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.cur_reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd OR @cur_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.reas_reqd = @reas_reqd OR @reas_reqd IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(util_exec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

		OPEN utils_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM utils_cursor INTO @util_ent_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			--Default the KPIs to null
			SELECT @current_util = NULL

			-- Call the SP to return the KPI values
			EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetValue @in_session_id=-1, @in_ent_id=@util_ent_id, @in_kpi_type=2
				, @in_filter_time_unit=1, @in_filter_start_time=1, @in_filter_end_time=0
				, @availability=@current_util OUTPUT

			--Insert the record into the temporary table
			INSERT INTO @current_utilizations (ent_id, current_util) VALUES (@util_ent_id, @current_util)
		END
		CLOSE utils_cursor
		DEALLOCATE utils_cursor
	END

	SELECT util_exec.ent_id
		    ,ent.ent_name
		    ,util_exec.cur_state_cd
		    ,util_state.state_desc
		    ,util_state.color
		    ,util_exec.cur_reas_cd
		    ,util_reas.reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.cur_reas_start_utc
		    ,util_exec.cur_reas_start_local
		    ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, util_exec.cur_reas_start_utc) as cur_reas_start
		    ,util_exec.cur_raw_reas_cd
	--            ,util_reas6.reas_desc as raw_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.reas_reqd
		    ,util_exec.cur_log_id
		    ,util_exec.target_util
		    ,curr_util.current_util
		    ,util_exec.jobstart_reas_cd
		    ,util_reas1.reas_desc as jobstart_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.jobend_reas_cd
		    ,util_reas2.reas_desc as jobend_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.shift_start_reas_cd
		    ,util_reas4.reas_desc as shift_start_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.shift_end_reas_cd
		    ,util_reas5.reas_desc as shift_end_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.unkn_stop_reas_cd
		    ,util_reas3.reas_desc as unkn_stop_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.break_start_reas_cd
		    ,break_start_reas.reas_desc as break_start_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.break_end_reas_cd
		    ,break_end_reas.reas_desc as break_end_reas_desc
		    ,util_exec.inherit_from_parent
		    ,util_exec.spare1
		    ,util_exec.spare2
		    ,util_exec.spare3
		    ,util_exec.spare4
		    ,'cur_reas_duration' = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (vw_util_history.duration/3600)) + ':' +
				 CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (vw_util_history.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
				    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (vw_util_history.duration%3600)%60)
		    ,util_exec.last_edit_comment
		    ,vw_util_history.event_time_utc
		    ,vw_util_history.event_time_local
		    ,util_exec.last_edit_by
		    ,util_exec.last_edit_at
	  FROM util_exec util_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	       INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.cur_state_cd = util_state.state_cd
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.cur_reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.jobstart_reas_cd = util_reas1.reas_cd
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.jobend_reas_cd = util_reas2.reas_cd
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.unkn_stop_reas_cd = util_reas3.reas_cd
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas4 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.shift_start_reas_cd = util_reas4.reas_cd
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.shift_end_reas_cd = util_reas5.reas_cd
		   LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas break_start_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.break_start_reas_cd = break_start_reas.reas_cd
		   LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas break_end_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.break_end_reas_cd = break_end_reas.reas_cd
	--       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas6 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.cur_raw_reas_cd = util_reas6.reas_cd
	      OUTER APPLY (SELECT * FROM vw_util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE vuh.ent_id = util_exec.ent_id
			  AND vuh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = util_exec.ent_id)) vw_util_history
	      LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, MAX(current_util) AS current_util
	      			FROM @current_utilizations
	      			GROUP BY ent_id) curr_util ON util_exec.ent_id = curr_util.ent_id
	    WHERE ((util_exec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.cur_state_cd = @cur_state_cd OR @cur_state_cd IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.cur_reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd OR @cur_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.reas_reqd = @reas_reqd OR @reas_reqd IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		   (util_exec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	      ORDER BY ent.ent_name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Rejected_Message]
(@rejected_message_local	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@message_status			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@object_name				STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@object_section			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@message_region			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@message_locale			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@message_version			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@row_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_SA_REJECTED_MESSAGE
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
@rejected_message_utc	TDATETIME

BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SET @rejected_message_utc = DATEADD(mi,-@time_zone_bias_value, @rejected_message_local)

	SELECT rm.rejected_message_utc
		,rm.rejected_message_local
		,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,rm.rejected_message_utc) rejected_message
		,rm.xml_message
		,rm.xml_error_message
		,rm.message_status
		,rm.object_name
		,rm.object_section
		,rm.message_region
		,rm.message_locale
		,rm.message_version
		,rm.last_edit_comment
		,rm.last_edit_by
		,rm.last_edit_at
		,rm.row_id
	FROM rejected_message rm
	WHERE (rm.rejected_message_utc >= @rejected_message_utc OR @rejected_message_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.message_status = @message_status OR @message_status IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.object_name = @object_name OR @object_name IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.object_section = @object_section OR @object_section IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.message_region = @message_region OR @message_region IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.message_locale = @message_locale OR @message_locale IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.message_version = @message_version OR @message_version IS NULL)
	  AND (rm.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL);

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_sa_ofi_su_item_grp]
-- Description: get item group details 
-- exec [sp_sa_ofi_su_item_grp] 'admin'
-- Usage:	get item group details
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-03-24			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-04-26			Added order by attr_value
   0.01.02  LK          2023-06-12          Round off the sum
   0.01.03  LK          2023-07-17          Added user Role Parameter to show the record to limited user
   0.01.04  DS          2024-02-06			Added nolock
   0.01.05	VJ			2024-07-04			Updated for hide virtual SU
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_su_item_grp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@userRole nvarchar(20)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @item_grp_id INT;
	DECLARE @tblhiddenSU AS TABLE
	( 
	ent_id	INT		
	)
	--0.01.05
	INSERT INTO @tblhiddenSU SELECT ea1.ent_id from ent_attr ea1 where  
	ea1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='HideSUOnUI') 
	AND ISNULL(ea1.attr_value,'0')='1'

	
	SELECT @item_grp_id = a.attr_id 
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'


	--fetching the details from inventory table
	(SELECT ia.attr_value as item_grp
		--,ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left),0) as mes_qty
			,ISNULL(CASE WHEN SUM(ii.qty_left)>0 THEN  ROUND(SUM(ii.qty_left), 3)  ELSE 0 END ,0) as mes_qty
		,u.description as uom ,@userRole as UserRole
	FROM item_inv ii WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = ia.item_id and ia.attr_id=@item_grp_id	
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ia.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=i.uom_id
	where ii.ent_id not in (SELECT ent_id FROM @tblhiddenSU)--0.01.05
	GROUP BY ia.attr_value ,u.description 
	)

	UNION ALL

	(select distinct isl.item_group , 0 as mes_qty, 'KG' as UOM,@userRole as UserRole --fetching details from entity storage link table
	from ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
	where isl.item_group NOT IN (SELECT ia.attr_value							
							FROM item_inv ii WITH(NOLOCK)	
							INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = ia.item_id and ia.attr_id=@item_grp_id	
							INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=ia.item_id
							INNER JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=i.uom_id	
							where ii.ent_id not in (SELECT ent_id FROM @tblhiddenSU)--0.01.05
							GROUP BY ia.attr_value  
							)
							and  isl.storage_ent_id not in (SELECT ent_id FROM @tblhiddenSU)--0.01.05
							)
							
	ORDER BY ia.attr_value asc



END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
UPDATE dx_log

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_GetJobPath]
(@wo_id		nvarchar(40),
 @sort_order	bit = 1
) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
Begin
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_S_JOB_Path
-- Description	      - To get a list of jobs for a work order in the order the jobs should be run based on the
--			sort order specified.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 08/19/2002
-- Version	      - 1.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
--09/10/2002	Raghu		1.4	Modified code to get the job path from job_route
--09/16/2002	Raghu		1.4	Once the job path is constructed, remove the duplicates and adjust the max path len towards the final nodes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
Declare	@oper_id	nvarchar(40),
	@seq_no		int,
	@max_path_len	int,
	@row_count	int
	IF @wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 Should not be Null{3339},Wo_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @max_path_len = 0
	IF @sort_order IS NULL SET @sort_order = 1
	SET @row_count = 1
	CREATE TABLE #tbl_job_path (wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER, max_path_len int, row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1))
	INSERT INTO #tbl_job_path (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no , max_path_len)
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, @max_path_len FROM JOB
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and final_job = 1
	WHILE (@row_count > 0) BEGIN
		DECLARE cur_job CURSOR STATIC FOR
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_job_path
			WHERE max_path_len = @max_path_len
		OPEN cur_job
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur_job into @oper_id, @seq_no
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			INSERT INTO #tbl_job_path (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, max_path_len)
			SELECT @wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, @max_path_len + 1 FROM job_route
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
--			SELECT @input_oper_id = input_oper_id, @input_seq_no = input_seq_no, @row_id = row_id FROM job_route
--			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
--			INSERT INTO #tbl_job_path (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, max_path_len)
--				VALUES (@wo_id, @input_oper_id, @input_seq_no, @max_path_len + 1)
--			PRINT 'W ID = ' + @wo_id + ', oper_id = ' + @input_oper_id + ', seq_no = ' + str(@input_seq_no) + ', Row Id = ' + str(@row_id)
		END
		CLOSE cur_job
		DEALLOCATE cur_job
		SET @max_path_len = @max_path_len + 1
		SELECT @row_count = count(*) FROM job_route
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM #tbl_job_path WHERE max_path_len = @max_path_len)
		IF @row_count = 0 BREAK
	END
	DELETE #tbl_job_path FROM #tbl_job_path a,
	(SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, max(max_path_len) max_path_len FROM #tbl_job_path
	GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
	HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) b
	WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id and a.oper_id = b.oper_id and a.seq_no = b.seq_no and a.max_path_len <> b.max_path_len
	DELETE #tbl_job_path FROM #tbl_job_path a,
	(SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, max(row_id) row_id FROM #tbl_job_path
	GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
	HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) b
	WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id and a.oper_id = b.oper_id and a.seq_no = b.seq_no and a.row_id <> b.row_id
	IF @sort_order = 1 SELECT *  FROM #tbl_job_path
	ELSE SELECT * FROM #tbl_job_path ORDER BY max_path_len DESC, seq_no DESC
	DROP TABLE #tbl_job_path
End

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_route_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_route]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_ent_route_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_route table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2030) Update first_oper and final_oper flags in this table
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_ent_route a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		     AND  a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		    AND	 a.ent_id = b.ent_id
		    AND a.input_oper_id = b.input_oper_id
		    AND a.input_ent_id = b.input_ent_id
	OPEN oper_ent_route_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_ent_route', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags @process_id
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_route_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_route_cursor
END

SELECT            e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.cur_shift_id, s.shift_desc AS cur_shift_desc

            --,         DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, e.cur_shift_start_time) AS cur_shift_start_time

            ,           e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local

            ,           e.tree_icon, je.job_pos, je.cur_wo_id, wo.wo_desc AS cur_wo_desc, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no

            ,           job.job_desc AS cur_job_desc, job.notes AS cur_job_notes, job.batch_size, job.state_cd AS job_state_cd

            ,           je.cur_step_no, je.next_job_only, je.spare1, je.spare2, je.spare3, je.spare4, oee.target_perf

            ,           oee.current_perf, oee.target_qual, oee.current_qual, oee.target_oee, oee.current_oee, wo.mo_id

            ,           wo.cust_info, job.item_id, job.job_priority

            --,         DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, job.req_finish_time) AS req_finish_time

            ,           job.req_finish_time_utc, job.req_finish_time_local

            ,           job.qty_reqd, job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected, job.qty_at_start

            --,         DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, job.sched_start_time) AS sched_start_time

            ,           job.sched_start_time_utc, job.sched_start_time_local

            --,         DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, job.sched_finish_time) AS sched_finish_time

            ,           job.sched_finish_time_utc, job.sched_finish_time_local

            ,           ue.cur_state_cd AS util_cur_state_cd, ue.cur_reas_cd, ue.target_util, ue.current_util

            --,         DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ue.cur_reas_start) AS cur_reas_start

            ,           ue.cur_reas_start_utc, ue.cur_reas_start_local,    ue.reas_reqd

            ,           (job.qty_reqd - job.qty_prod) AS qty_to_do, je.def_lot_no, je.def_prod_reas_cd

            ,           je.def_cons_reas_cd, je.def_to_ent_id, je.def_from_ent_id , e.hourly_cost

            ,           def_to_ent.ent_name AS def_to_ent_name, je.def_reject_ent_id, def_reject_ent.ent_name AS def_reject_ent_name

            ,           def_from_ent.ent_name AS def_from_ent_name, def_prod_reas.reas_desc AS def_prod_reas_desc

            ,           def_cons_reas.reas_desc AS def_cons_reas_desc, je.run_without_operator

FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)

            INNER JOIN ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN        util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ue.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)

            INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id

            INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON

                        je.cur_wo_id = job.wo_id AND

                        je.cur_oper_id = job.oper_id AND

                        je.cur_seq_no = job.seq_no

                        ON  e.ent_id = je.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec oee WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = oee.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN shift s ON e.cur_shift_id = s.shift_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN ent def_to_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_to_ent_id = def_to_ent.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN ent def_reject_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_reject_ent_id = def_reject_ent.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN ent def_from_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_from_ent_id = def_from_ent.ent_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas def_prod_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_prod_reas_cd = def_prod_reas.reas_cd

            LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas def_cons_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_cons_reas_cd = def_cons_reas.reas_cd

WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND el.session_id = @session_id



SELECT            temptable.*, item.item_desc, item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.serial_no_lvl

            ,           util_state.state_desc AS util_state_desc, util_state.color AS util_color, util_reas.reas_desc

            ,           js.state_desc AS job_state_desc, js.color AS job_color

FROM @temp_ent_status_By_User temptable

            LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.item_id = item.item_id

            LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.util_cur_state_cd = util_state.state_cd

            LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.cur_reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd

            LEFT OUTER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.job_state_cd = js.state_cd

            LEFT OUTER JOIN uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id

ORDER BY temptable.ent_id

*/

 --drop the temporary table

-- DROP TABLE  #temp_ent_status_By_User

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Exec_GetAvailReasns]
(
	@in_ent_id 			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@in_raw_reas_cd 	STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	  Changes
-- 05/01/2003	  Raghu		1.6.0.3	  Included AND reas_reqd = 1 in the select clause of util_exec. Allows the flexibility to select all the reasons, after the pending reason is set.
--					  If reas_reqd is set to true, then it only allows to select the associated reasons for the raw reason
-- 07/22/2003	  Raghu		1.6.0.15  (HD# 3423) Removed reas_reqd = 1 in WHERE clause as this may not require a prompt, and raw_reas is set in db, and still needs to filter the reasons with raw reason code
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22  (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 01/30/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 08/19/2009	RWB			4.0.0	Added support for multi-level reason groups by returning the tree information as part of the
--									returned recordset.  The root of the tree is denoted as l0_reas_grp_id and lo_reas_grp_desc,
--									the next level is l1_reas_grp_id and l1_reas_grp_desc, and so on until the 10th level of the
--									tree which is L9_reas_grp_id and L9_reas_grp_desc.  The reason group for the reason is
--									included in the tree information as well as being returned as a reas_grp_id and reas_grp_desc\
--									which are expected by existing applications.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @ent_id				INT32
		,	@raw_reas_cd 		STRING40
		,	@can_capture_util 	LOGICAL
		,	@StoO_selcnt		INT32


	SET @ent_id = @in_ent_id
	SET @raw_reas_cd = @in_raw_reas_cd

	IF @raw_reas_cd IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @raw_reas_cd = cur_raw_reas_cd
		FROM util_exec
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	IF ( @raw_reas_cd IS NULL ) BEGIN
	--Modified by Raghu on 08/14/2002. Order By clause modified. Changed to display_seq, description
		SET @raw_reas_cd = -1
	END


	SELECT @StoO_selcnt = 1
	FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link, util_reas util_reas,
		 util_reas_grp util_reas_grp
	WHERE (util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd) AND
		  (util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id) AND
		  ( ( (util_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id) AND (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd)))

	IF ( @StoO_selcnt <> 1 ) BEGIN
		SET @StoO_selcnt = 0
	END

DECLARE @reasons	TABLE(reas_grp_id int, reas_grp_desc nvarchar(80), reas_grp_display_seq int
						, reas_cd int, reas_desc nvarchar(80), reas_display_seq int, state_cd int, color int
						, p1_grp_id int, p1_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p1_grp_disp_seq int
						, p2_grp_id int, p2_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p2_grp_disp_seq int
						, p3_grp_id int, p3_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p3_grp_disp_seq int
						, p4_grp_id int, p4_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p4_grp_disp_seq int
						, p5_grp_id int, p5_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p5_grp_disp_seq int
						, p6_grp_id int, p6_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p6_grp_disp_seq int
						, p7_grp_id int, p7_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p7_grp_disp_seq int
						, p8_grp_id int, p8_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p8_grp_disp_seq int
						, p9_grp_id int, p9_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p9_grp_disp_seq int)
	IF @StoO_selcnt <> 0 BEGIN

		insert into @reasons
		(reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc, reas_grp_display_seq
		, reas_cd, reas_desc, reas_display_seq, state_cd, color
		, p1_grp_id, p1_grp_desc, p1_grp_disp_seq
		, p2_grp_id, p2_grp_desc, p2_grp_disp_seq
		, p3_grp_id, p3_grp_desc, p3_grp_disp_seq
		, p4_grp_id, p4_grp_desc, p4_grp_disp_seq
		, p5_grp_id, p5_grp_desc, p5_grp_disp_seq
		, p6_grp_id, p6_grp_desc, p6_grp_disp_seq
		, p7_grp_id, p7_grp_desc, p7_grp_disp_seq
		, p8_grp_id, p8_grp_desc, p8_grp_disp_seq
		, p9_grp_id, p9_grp_desc, p9_grp_disp_seq)
		SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
			,  util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
			,  util_reas_grp.display_seq
			,  util_reas.reas_cd
			,  util_reas.reas_desc
			,  util_reas.display_seq
			,  util_reas.state_cd
			,  util_state.color
			,  parent_urg1.reas_grp_id as p1_grp_id, parent_urg1.reas_grp_desc as p1_grp_desc, parent_urg1.display_seq as p1_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg2.reas_grp_id as p2_grp_id, parent_urg2.reas_grp_desc as p2_grp_desc, parent_urg2.display_seq as p2_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg3.reas_grp_id as p3_grp_id, parent_urg3.reas_grp_desc as p3_grp_desc, parent_urg3.display_seq as p3_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg4.reas_grp_id as p4_grp_id, parent_urg4.reas_grp_desc as p4_grp_desc, parent_urg4.display_seq as p4_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg5.reas_grp_id as p5_grp_id, parent_urg5.reas_grp_desc as p5_grp_desc, parent_urg5.display_seq as p5_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg6.reas_grp_id as p6_grp_id, parent_urg6.reas_grp_desc as p6_grp_desc, parent_urg6.display_seq as p6_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg7.reas_grp_id as p7_grp_id, parent_urg7.reas_grp_desc as p7_grp_desc, parent_urg7.display_seq as p7_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg8.reas_grp_id as p8_grp_id, parent_urg8.reas_grp_desc as p8_grp_desc, parent_urg8.display_seq as p8_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg9.reas_grp_id as p9_grp_id, parent_urg9.reas_grp_desc as p9_grp_desc, parent_urg9.display_seq as p9_grp_disp_seq
		FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
			INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id
			INNER JOIN util_state util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_state.state_cd = util_reas.state_cd
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg1.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg1.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg2.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg2.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg3.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg4 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg3.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg4.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg4.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg5.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg6 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg5.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg6.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg7 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg6.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg7.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg8 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg7.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg8.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg9 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg8.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg9.reas_grp_id
		WHERE (((util_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id) AND (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd)))

	END ELSE BEGIN

		insert into @reasons
		(reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc, reas_grp_display_seq
		, reas_cd, reas_desc, reas_display_seq, state_cd, color
		, p1_grp_id, p1_grp_desc, p1_grp_disp_seq
		, p2_grp_id, p2_grp_desc, p2_grp_disp_seq
		, p3_grp_id, p3_grp_desc, p3_grp_disp_seq
		, p4_grp_id, p4_grp_desc, p4_grp_disp_seq
		, p5_grp_id, p5_grp_desc, p5_grp_disp_seq
		, p6_grp_id, p6_grp_desc, p6_grp_disp_seq
		, p7_grp_id, p7_grp_desc, p7_grp_disp_seq
		, p8_grp_id, p8_grp_desc, p8_grp_disp_seq
		, p9_grp_id, p9_grp_desc, p9_grp_disp_seq)
		SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
			,  util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc

			,  util_reas.reas_cd

			,  parent_urg4.reas_grp_id as p4_grp_id, parent_urg4.reas_grp_desc as p4_grp_desc, parent_urg4.display_seq as p4_grp_disp_seq

			,  parent_urg7.reas_grp_id as p7_grp_id, parent_urg7.reas_grp_desc as p7_grp_desc, parent_urg7.display_seq as p7_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg8.reas_grp_id as p8_grp_id, parent_urg8.reas_grp_desc as p8_grp_desc, parent_urg8.display_seq as p8_grp_disp_seq

		FROM util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id

			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg1.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg2.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg2.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg3.reas_grp_id

			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg4.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg5.reas_grp_id

			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg9 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg8.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg9.reas_grp_id

	END

-- Description: The stored procedure will fetch the last edited comment for silo status.  
--  
-- Usage:    
-- ===========================================================================================  
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description  
-- 0.01.00 GA       2022-10-27			Initial version.  
-- ===========================================================================================  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_SU_Status_Comment]
(  
	@ent_id INT = NULL
)   
AS
BEGIN
	-- Get the storage unit status of selected storage unit   
	
	BEGIN
		SELECT j.last_edit_comment
		FROM attr i WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr j WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.attr_id = j.attr_id
		WHERE j.ent_id = @ent_id AND i.attr_desc IN('LockForOutput','LockForQuality','LockForInput')
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Rejected_Message_GetByFilter]
(@filter_list				NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-	SP_SA_REJECTED_MESSAGE_GetByFilter
-- Description			-	Returns the rejected messages that match the supplied filters.  The @filter_list parameter is
--						-	an XML string, an example is shown below:
--							<filters>
--								<filter ent_name="Mixing" msg_type="OCO" rejected_message_utc="2015-10-14 08:00:00"/>
--								<filter ent_name="Filler1" msg_type="UCO Messages" rejected_message_utc="2015-10-14 08:30:15"/>
--								<filter ent_name="Filler2" msg_type="SRO Messages" rejected_message_utc="2015-10-14 09:10:20"/>
--								<filter ent_name="StorageEnt" msg_type="" rejected_message_utc="2015-10-14 07:00:00"/>
--								<filter ent_name="" msg_type="SRO Messages" rejected_message_utc="2015-10-14 08:11:11"/>
--							</filters>
--							This parameter is required.  The ent_name and msg_type portion of a filter can be left blank if
--							the filter applies to all entities or all msg_types.  The rejected_message_utc portion of the filter
--							is required.
-- Author				-	Rich BOyle
-- Date Created			-	10/1/2015
-- Version				-	5.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By 	Ver    Changes
-- 02/09/2016	Raghu		5.2	UserStory: 594658 - CR L00140022 - The stored procedure "sp_SA_Rejected_Message_GetByFilter" is opening an XML document, but never closes it.
-- 06/24/2016	  Raghu G	5.3	US 135517, As Bruce, I want to establish a Rejected Messages Subscription specific to an Entity/TimePeriod/OCOAsyncMessages, so that I can be notified when there are new rejected messages matching my filter
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	@curr_utc TDATETIME
	, @filter_doc_handle INT
	, @SQL1 NVARCHAR(MAX)
	, @param_def NVARCHAR(MAX)

BEGIN
	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @filter_doc_handle OUTPUT, @filter_list

	SELECT DISTINCT rm.rejected_message_local
		,rm.xml_error_message
		,rm.xml_message
		,rm.rejected_message_utc
		,rm.message_status
		,rm.object_name AS ent_name
		,rm.object_section
		,rm.message_region
		,rm.message_locale
		,rm.message_version
		,rm.last_edit_comment
		,rm.last_edit_by
		,rm.last_edit_at
		,rm.row_id
		,CASE WHEN filter.msg_type = ''
			THEN NULL
			ELSE filter.msg_type
		 END AS msg_type
	FROM rejected_message rm WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN OPENXML (@filter_doc_handle, '/filters/filter',2)
					WITH  (ent_name NVARCHAR(80)   '@ent_name', msg_type NVARCHAR(MAX)	'@msg_type', rejected_message_utc NVARCHAR(MAX)	'@rejected_message_utc'
				) filter ON (rm.rejected_message_utc >= dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(CONVERT(DATETIME, filter.rejected_message_utc, 120))) AND
							(rm.object_name = filter.ent_name OR filter.ent_name = '') AND
							((rm.xml_message LIKE '%' + filter.msg_type + '%')
							-- The filter.msg_type 'OCO' should return all the messages related to OCO.
							 OR (rm.object_section = filter.msg_type))
	WHERE (rm.message_status = 0)
	ORDER BY rm.object_name, rm.rejected_message_utc;

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @filter_doc_handle
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_sa_ofi_su_item_inv
-- Description:	to get the inventory details against item group, it is being used in the SU overview screen
--
-- 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-03-24			Initial version. 
-- 0.01.01  DS          2024-02-07			Added nolock & comments
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_sa_ofi_su_item_inv] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @item_grp  NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
			
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	 
	   
declare @item_grp_id INT
			SELECT @item_grp_id = a.attr_id 
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#unique_SU') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #unique_SU
	CREATE TABLE #unique_SU (
	 row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY
	,ent_id	INT
	,item_grp NVARCHAR(100)
	);

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#additional_SU') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #additional_SU
	CREATE TABLE #additional_SU  (
	 row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY
	,ent_id	INT	
	,item_grp NVARCHAR(100)
	);

	-- fetching data from work center silo mapping table
	INSERT INTO #additional_SU
	SELECT DISTINCT isl.storage_ent_id as ent_id,isl.item_group
	FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE isl.item_group=@item_grp
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT iv.ent_id as ent_id,ia1.attr_value
	FROM item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=iv.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia1.item_id= i.item_id AND ia1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='ItemGroup') AND ia1.attr_value=@item_grp
	
	INSERT INTO #unique_SU
	SELECT DISTINCT ent_id,item_grp FROM #additional_SU
 
	--fetching inventory details
	SELECT iv.item_id,i.item_desc,SUM(iv.qty_left) AS su_qty,i.uom_id,u.description AS uom
	FROM #unique_SU us 
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id=us.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN (item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=iv.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK) ON iv.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
	INNER JOIN item_state iss WITH(NOLOCK) ON iv.status_cd= iss.item_status_cd
	INNER JOIN uom u  WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=i.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia1.item_id= i.item_id AND ia1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='ItemGroup') AND ia1.attr_value=@item_grp
	LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id= i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='Classification')	-- classification is used ofr seggrigation 
	
	) ON iv.ent_id=us.ent_id
	--where (iv.item_id IS NOT NULL)

	group by  iv.item_id,i.item_desc ,i.uom_id,u.description 



END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_DL_CollectPeriodicData] AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_DL_COLLECTDATAPERIODIC
-- Description          - Collect data periodically by minutely task.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 12/12/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver	Changes
-- 12/12/2007		AML			3.4.1	Initial Sql Server Version
--01/24/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00074339; Collect Periodic data
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @timenow		TDATETIME
	,@min_offset		INT32
	,@data_collection_due	TDATETIME
	,@grp_id		INT32
	,@row_count		INT32
	,@key_id		INT32
	,@key_type		INT32
	,@category		STRING40
	,@value_name		STRING40
	,@trigger_type		INT32
	,@trigger_period	INT32
	,@last_trigger_at	TDATETIME
	,@wo_id			STRING40
	,@oper_id		STRING40
	,@seq_no		INT32
	,@item_id		STRING40
	,@run_ent_id		INT32
	,@step_no		INT32
	,@lot_no		STRING40
	,@sublot_no		STRING40

	DECLARE each_jobs_to_collect_data CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT des.key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type,
                                        des.trigger_period, des.last_trigger_at,
                                        j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id, j.run_ent_id
                                     FROM data_entry_sched des WITH (NOLOCK)
                                     INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON des.key_id = j.row_id
                                     WHERE j.state_cd = 3
                                       AND des.key_type = 6 -- job
                                       AND (des.trigger_type = 2 OR des.trigger_type = 5)-- hours or minutes
                                       AND des.category = 'Datalog Group'

	OPEN each_jobs_to_collect_data
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM each_jobs_to_collect_data INTO @key_id, @key_type, @category, @value_name
			,@trigger_type, @trigger_period, @last_trigger_at, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			,@item_id, @run_ent_id

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--If trigger_type is 2 (hours), then set the minute offset to 60.
		IF (@trigger_type = 2) SET @min_offset = 60
		ELSE --trigger_type is 5 (minutes), set the minute offset to 1.
			SET @min_offset = 1

		--Find the next data collection due time by adding the last_triggered_at time + the trigger period.
		SET @data_collection_due = DATEADD(mi, @min_offset * @trigger_period, COALESCE(@last_trigger_at, GETUTCDATE()-25000))

		--Get the current time.
		SET @timenow = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

		--Verify whether the data collection is due now.
		IF (@data_collection_due <= @timenow) BEGIN
			--Verify whether this job is tied to this entity.
			IF (@run_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				--Retrieve the max_value to determine whether we need to collect data for data_log_16 OR data_log_48.
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_desc = @value_name) BEGIN
					SELECT @grp_id = grp_id FROM data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE grp_desc = @value_name

						@ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id,
						@oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no,
						@step_no=NULL, @lot_no=NULL, @sublot_no=NULL

                    			--Record the current time the data is collected for the data_log table.
					UPDATE data_entry_sched
					SET data_entry_sched.last_trigger_at = @timenow
					WHERE data_entry_sched.key_id = @key_id
					  AND data_entry_sched.key_type = @key_type
					  AND data_entry_sched.category = @category
					  AND data_entry_sched.value_name = @value_name
				END
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE each_jobs_to_collect_data
	DEALLOCATE each_jobs_to_collect_data

	DECLARE each_job_step_to_collect_data CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT des.key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type,
                                        des.trigger_period, des.last_trigger_at,
                                        j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id, j.run_ent_id, js.step_no, jsd.lot_no, jsd.sublot_no
                                     FROM data_entry_sched des WITH (NOLOCK)

                                     INNER JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND jsd.step_no = js.step_no
                                     WHERE j.state_cd = 3

                                       AND des.key_type = 7 -- job_step
                                       AND (des.trigger_type = 2 OR des.trigger_type = 5)-- hours or minutes
                                       AND des.category = 'Datalog Group'

	OPEN each_job_step_to_collect_data
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

			,@trigger_type, @trigger_period, @last_trigger_at, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no

						@ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id,
						@oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no,
						@step_no=@step_no, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no

                    			--Record the current time the data is collected for the data_log table.

				END

	END

--01/11/2005	Raghu		2.1.12	Changed uom_id to uom_id_h
--03/03/2005	Raghu		2.1.15	HD# 5440, Include def_lot_no for bom_pos=0
--05/26/2005	Raghu		2.1.22	HD# 4603, Included job spares 1-4
--08/10/2005	Rich Boyle	2.1.26   HD #6109, Added First_job filter
--09/09/2005	Rich Boyle	2.1.28	HD #5932, Added concurrent_link as last column returned
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/31/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 6554, Added wo_desc column.
--11/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Included queue_item_attributes and queue_job_attributes in the queue.
--02/15/2006	Rich		3.1.10	Removed ent.description as a returned column
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities; Prepend 'N' before concatenating each string.
--07/27/2006	Raghu		3.1.20	HD# 8513, Cancelled and Complete times are not calculated properly
--02/19/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--08/30/2007	Raghu		3.3.0	Part of DB Changes
--08/31/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--09/20/2011	Rupak		4.2     Modified for CR116713.
--08/14/2014    Ashwin      5.0		Modified to return 'est_prod_rate' & 'num_decimals_good_pp'
--04/26/2018	Raghu G		6.0		UserStory:1018398-As Bruce,  I want to be able to get the queue by filter which will return all jobs queued to an entity as well as jobs queued to the schedulable parents of an entity (SP)
--06/25/2020	Anwar P		6.2		UserStory:1331561- MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00158764 (HF CR 156681: When Loading the Job queue form it takes many seconds for the data to show up in the grid with only a few jobs . It is significantly slower than any other grid.).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @ent_ids 	NVARCHAR(4000) -- Modified for CR115544
	,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(50)
	,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@seq_no	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@item_id	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@item_desc	NVARCHAR(90)
	-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
	,@first_job          NVARCHAR(90)
	,@state_cd 	NVARCHAR(50)
	,@complete_time	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@cancel_time	NVARCHAR(40)
--	,@current_time	NVARCHAR(20)
-- CR L00108373 - Changed from NVARCHAR(4000) to NVARCHAR(max) to prevent a string truncation.
DECLARE  @selectClause NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@joinClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@sSQL 		NVARCHAR(max)
	,@temp_SQL 	NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@start		INT
	,@end		INT
	,@current_time	DATETIME
	,@cancel_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@complete_time_dt	DATETIME
	,@num_decimals_good_pp INT32
	,@param_def NVARCHAR(4000)

	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326
	SELECT @selectClause = ''
	SET @ent_ids = @ent_filter
	SET @filter = @job_filter
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF @ent_ids IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @selectClause = ';WITH c AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @ent_ids, j+1) FROM c WHERE j > i), ent_list_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@ent_ids, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@ent_ids)+1)-i-1) ent_id FROM c WHERE i >= 0), ent_list AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN ent_id = '''' THEN NULL ELSE ent_id END) ent_id FROM ent_list_abst)'
		IF (@incl_sched_parents IS NOT NULL AND @incl_sched_parents = 1) BEGIN
			SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', ents (parent_ent_id, can_sched_jobs) AS
					(select e.ent_id, e.can_sched_jobs FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT ent_parent.ent_id, ent_parent.can_sched_jobs
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ents parent ON e.ent_id = parent.parent_ent_id
					INNER JOIN ent ent_parent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_parent.ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
					), distinct_ents AS (SELECT DISTINCT parent_ent_id FROM ents)
					'
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN distinct_ents de ON j.target_sched_ent_id = de.parent_ent_id'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @joinClause = ' INNER JOIN ent_list el ON el.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id'
		END
	END

	IF @selectClause = '' SET @selectClause = ';WITH ' ELSE SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ', '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'a AS (SELECT n=0, i=-1, j=0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1, j, CHARINDEX('','', @state_cd, j+1) FROM a WHERE j > i), state_codes_abst AS (SELECT n, SUBSTRING(@state_cd, i+1, IIF(j>0, j, LEN(@state_cd)+1)-i-1) state_cd FROM a WHERE i >= 0), state_codes AS (SELECT CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN state_cd = '''' THEN NULL ELSE state_cd END) state_cd FROM state_codes_abst) '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + 'SELECT i.item_id,i.item_desc,i.uom_id uom_id_h,uom.description uom_description,i.lifetime,i.unit_cost,i.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',p.process_id,p.process_status,wo.wo_id,wo.req_qty,wo.release_time_utc, wo.release_time_local, DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value,wo.release_time_utc) release_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',wo.wo_priority,wo.cust_info'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.job_desc,j.state_cd,j.job_priority,j.req_finish_time_utc, j.req_finish_time_local, DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.req_finish_time_utc) req_finish_time,j.target_sched_ent_id,ent.ent_name'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.qty_reqd,j.qty_prod,j.qty_rejected,j.qty_at_start,j.batch_size,j.first_job,j.final_job,j.est_prod_rate'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_start_time_utc,j.sched_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_start_time_utc) sched_start_time,j.latest_start_time_utc,j.latest_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.latest_start_time_utc) latest_start_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.sched_finish_time_utc,j.sched_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.sched_finish_time_utc) sched_finish_time,j.notes,j.status_notes,js.state_desc as state_desc_h, js.color color_h'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',op.oper_desc,j.act_start_time_utc,j.act_start_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time,j.act_finish_time_utc,j.act_finish_time_local,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,j.act_finish_time_utc) act_finish_time'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',ent.can_sched_jobs,wo.mo_id, j.run_ent_id, ent2.ent_name Run_Ent_name,j.row_id row_id_h,i.num_decimals num_decimals_h,COALESCE(@num_decimals_good_pp, 0) AS num_decimals_good_pp'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',i.spare1,i.spare2,i.spare3,i.spare4,j.edit_time as edit_time_h,je.job_pos job_pos_h,jb.def_lot_no '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ',j.spare1 job_spare1,j.spare2 job_spare2,j.spare3 job_spare3,j.spare4 job_spare4,j.concurrent_link,wo.wo_desc,qia.*,qja.* '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = j.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id=j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id=j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no=j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = wo.process_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.state_cd = j.state_cd'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = wo.process_id AND op.oper_id = j.oper_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ent.ent_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ent2.ent_id '
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = j.run_ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia WITH (NOLOCK) ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h=i.item_id'
	SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja WITH (NOLOCK) ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h=j.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h=j.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h=j.seq_no'

	IF (@joinClause IS NOT NULL) SET @selectClause = @selectClause + @joinClause

	SET @sSQL = ' WHERE jb.bom_pos=0 '

	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @start = 3
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @state_cd = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			IF RIGHT(@state_cd, 1) = ',' SET @state_cd = LEFT(@state_cd, LEN(@state_cd) -1)
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @cancel_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @cancel_time = REPLACE(@cancel_time, 'CANCELLED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @complete_time = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @complete_time = REPLACE(@complete_time, 'COMPLETED=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @wo_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @wo_id = REPLACE(@wo_id, 'WO_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @oper_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @oper_id = REPLACE(@oper_id, 'OPER_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @seq_no = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @seq_no = REPLACE(@seq_no, 'SEQ_NO=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_id = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_id = REPLACE(@item_id, 'ITEM_ID=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @item_desc = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @item_desc = REPLACE(@item_desc, 'ITEM_DESC=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$', @filter, @start)
		IF (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @first_job = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))
			SET @first_job = REPLACE(@first_job, 'FIRST_JOB=', '')
			SET @start = @end + 4
		END

		IF @state_cd = '' SET @state_cd = NULL
		IF (@cancel_time = ''  OR @cancel_time = '0') SET @cancel_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @cancel_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @cancel_time)))
		ELSE SET @cancel_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @cancel_time), @current_time)

		IF (@complete_time = '' OR @complete_time = '0') SET @complete_time = NULL
--		ELSE SET @complete_time =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, @complete_time)))
		ELSE SET @complete_time_dt = DATEADD(hh, -CONVERT(INT, @complete_time),  @current_time)

		IF @wo_id = '' SET @wo_id = NULL
		IF @oper_id = '' SET @oper_id = NULL
		IF @seq_no = '' SET @seq_no = NULL
		IF @item_id = '' SET @item_id = NULL
		IF @item_desc = '' SET @item_desc = NULL
		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		IF @first_job = '' SET @first_job = NULL

		--Work Order ID Filter
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @wo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @wo_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id LIKE @wo_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.wo_id = @wo_id '
		END
		--Oper ID Filter
		IF (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id LIKE @oper_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.oper_id = @oper_id '
		END

		--Seq No Filter
		IF (@seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @seq_no) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @seq_no) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no LIKE @seq_no '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.seq_no =  @seq_no '
		END

		--Item ID Filter
		IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_id) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id LIKE @item_id '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.item_id = @item_id '
		END

		--Item Desc Filter
		IF (@item_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_desc) > 0) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc '
			ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND i.item_desc = @item_desc '
		END

		-- Added by Rich Boyle 08/10/2005
		-- First Job Filter
		IF (@first_job is not null and @first_job = '1') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND j.first_job = 1'
		END

		--state_cd filter
		IF (@state_cd = '4') OR (@state_cd = '7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = @state_cd '
--			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH,j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time  + ') <= ' + @complete_time
--			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @cancel_time
			IF ((@state_cd = '4') AND (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 4 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt'
			IF ((@state_cd = '7') AND (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND js.state_cd = 7 AND j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt'
		END
		ELSE IF (@state_cd = '4,7') BEGIN
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND ((js.state_cd = 4 OR js.state_cd = 7) '

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				--SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (js.state_cd = CASE WHEN (js.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  DATEDIFF(HH, j.act_finish_time,' + @current_time + ') <= ' + @complete_time + ' THEN js.state_cd END ELSE js.state_cd END)'
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ')'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @selectClause = @selectClause + ' INNER JOIN state_codes sc ON js.state_cd = sc.state_cd'
			END

			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			IF (@complete_time IS NOT NULL)
				SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 4) THEN CASE WHEN  j.act_finish_time_utc>=@complete_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@cancel_time IS NOT NULL )
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd = CASE WHEN (j.state_cd = 7) THEN CASE WHEN j.act_finish_time_utc>=@cancel_time_dt THEN j.state_cd END ELSE j.state_cd END)'

			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

		END
	END	-- end of filter-state_code exists to filter records

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY j.sched_start_time_utc, j.job_priority'
	--PRINT @sSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias_value INT, @num_decimals_good_pp INT, @ent_ids NVARCHAR(4000), @wo_id NVARCHAR(50), @oper_id NVARCHAR(50), @seq_no NVARCHAR(50), @item_id NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ', @item_desc NVARCHAR(90), @complete_time_dt DATETIME, @cancel_time_dt DATETIME, @state_cd NVARCHAR(50)'
	SET @sSQL = @selectClause + @sSQL
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @param_def, @time_zone_bias_value, @num_decimals_good_pp, @ent_ids, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id, @item_desc, @complete_time_dt, @cancel_time_dt, @state_cd
END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_route_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_route]
AFTER UPDATE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_ent_route_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_route table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2030) Update first_oper and final_oper flags in this table
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@ent_id		INT
	,@input_oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@input_ent_id		INT
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id, b.oper_id, b.ent_id, b.input_oper_id, b.input_ent_id
		FROM oper_ent_route a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		     AND  a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		    AND	 a.ent_id = b.ent_id
		    AND a.input_oper_id = b.input_oper_id
		    AND a.input_ent_id = b.input_ent_id

	OPEN oper_ent_route_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor INTO @process_id, @oper_id, @ent_id, @input_oper_id, @input_ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_ent_route', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		EXEC sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags @process_id

		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id

		UPDATE oper_ent_route SET oper_ent_route.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_ent_route.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND input_oper_id = @input_oper_id AND input_ent_id = @input_ent_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_route_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_route_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Res_Std_Oper_Link]
  (@res_id int ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_D_Res_Std_Oper_Link
-- Description      - Delete an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
