CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Exec_GetOldAvalReas]
( @ent_id   INT32
 ,@reas_cd  INT32 )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_SA_Util_Exec_GetOldReasons
-- Description	  -	To retrieve the set of possible final reason codes for a given entity. The final reasons list is selected for old non final reason
--			        which requires a possible final reason to be set which may override the current reason for the selected activity.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  -	08/21/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	     Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain     1.6.0.22  (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 08/19/2009	RWB			4.0.0	Added support for multi-level reason groups by returning the tree information as part of the
--						returned recordset.  The root of the tree is denoted as l0_reas_grp_id and lo_reas_grp_desc,
--						the next level is l1_reas_grp_id and l1_reas_grp_desc, and so on until the 10th level of the
--						tree which is L9_reas_grp_id and L9_reas_grp_desc.  The reason group for the reason is
--						included in the tree information as well as being returned as a reas_grp_id and reas_grp_desc\
--						which are expected by existing applications.
-- 08/06/2015   Varun M		5.2		CR L00137570 Merge changes (HF CR #L00137417). Modified datatype(varchar to nvarchar)
--						in temp table to support Chinese characters
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

DECLARE @reasons    TABLE(reas_grp_id int, reas_grp_desc nvarchar(80), reas_grp_display_seq int
						, reas_cd int, reas_desc nvarchar(80), reas_display_seq int
						, p1_grp_id int, p1_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p1_grp_disp_seq int
						, p2_grp_id int, p2_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p2_grp_disp_seq int
						, p3_grp_id int, p3_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p3_grp_disp_seq int
						, p4_grp_id int, p4_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p4_grp_disp_seq int
						, p5_grp_id int, p5_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p5_grp_disp_seq int
						, p6_grp_id int, p6_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p6_grp_disp_seq int
						, p7_grp_id int, p7_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p7_grp_disp_seq int
						, p8_grp_id int, p8_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p8_grp_disp_seq int
						, p9_grp_id int, p9_grp_desc nvarchar(80), p9_grp_disp_seq int)

  IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
               INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
--	       INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id
	       WHERE ((util_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id) AND (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd IN
		  (SELECT raw_reas_cd FROM util_raw_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND def_reas_cd = @reas_cd))))

		insert into @reasons
		(reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc, reas_grp_display_seq
		, reas_cd, reas_desc, reas_display_seq
		, p1_grp_id, p1_grp_desc, p1_grp_disp_seq
		, p2_grp_id, p2_grp_desc, p2_grp_disp_seq
		, p3_grp_id, p3_grp_desc, p3_grp_disp_seq
		, p4_grp_id, p4_grp_desc, p4_grp_disp_seq
		, p5_grp_id, p5_grp_desc, p5_grp_disp_seq
		, p6_grp_id, p6_grp_desc, p6_grp_disp_seq
		, p7_grp_id, p7_grp_desc, p7_grp_disp_seq
		, p8_grp_id, p8_grp_desc, p8_grp_disp_seq
		, p9_grp_id, p9_grp_desc, p9_grp_disp_seq)
    SELECT reas.reas_grp_id, reas.reas_grp_desc, reas.reas_grp_display_seq
			,  reas.reas_cd, reas.reas_desc, reas.reas_display_seq
			,  reas.p1_grp_id, reas.p1_grp_desc, reas.p1_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p2_grp_id, reas.p2_grp_desc, reas.p2_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p3_grp_id, reas.p3_grp_desc, reas.p3_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p4_grp_id, reas.p4_grp_desc, reas.p4_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p5_grp_id, reas.p5_grp_desc, reas.p5_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p6_grp_id, reas.p6_grp_desc, reas.p6_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p7_grp_id, reas.p7_grp_desc, reas.p7_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p8_grp_id, reas.p8_grp_desc, reas.p8_grp_disp_seq
			,  reas.p9_grp_id, reas.p9_grp_desc, reas.p9_grp_disp_seq
	FROM
        (SELECT DISTINCT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id,util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,util_reas.reas_cd,
		         util_reas.reas_desc,util_reas_grp.display_seq reas_grp_display_seq,util_reas.display_seq reas_display_seq
			,  parent_urg1.reas_grp_id as p1_grp_id, parent_urg1.reas_grp_desc as p1_grp_desc, parent_urg1.display_seq as p1_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg2.reas_grp_id as p2_grp_id, parent_urg2.reas_grp_desc as p2_grp_desc, parent_urg2.display_seq as p2_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg3.reas_grp_id as p3_grp_id, parent_urg3.reas_grp_desc as p3_grp_desc, parent_urg3.display_seq as p3_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg4.reas_grp_id as p4_grp_id, parent_urg4.reas_grp_desc as p4_grp_desc, parent_urg4.display_seq as p4_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg5.reas_grp_id as p5_grp_id, parent_urg5.reas_grp_desc as p5_grp_desc, parent_urg5.display_seq as p5_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg6.reas_grp_id as p6_grp_id, parent_urg6.reas_grp_desc as p6_grp_desc, parent_urg6.display_seq as p6_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg7.reas_grp_id as p7_grp_id, parent_urg7.reas_grp_desc as p7_grp_desc, parent_urg7.display_seq as p7_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg8.reas_grp_id as p8_grp_id, parent_urg8.reas_grp_desc as p8_grp_desc, parent_urg8.display_seq as p8_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg9.reas_grp_id as p9_grp_id, parent_urg9.reas_grp_desc as p9_grp_desc, parent_urg9.display_seq as p9_grp_disp_seq
	   FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
		INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg1.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg1.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg2.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg2.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg3.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg4 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg3.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg4.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg4.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg5.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg6 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg5.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg6.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg7 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg6.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg7.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg8 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg7.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg8.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg9 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg8.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg9.reas_grp_id
	     WHERE ((util_reas_link.ent_id =  @ent_id) AND (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd IN
		    (SELECT raw_reas_cd FROM util_raw_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND def_reas_cd = @reas_cd)))) reas
  ELSE
		insert into @reasons
		(reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc, reas_grp_display_seq
		, reas_cd, reas_desc, reas_display_seq
		, p1_grp_id, p1_grp_desc, p1_grp_disp_seq
		, p2_grp_id, p2_grp_desc, p2_grp_disp_seq
		, p3_grp_id, p3_grp_desc, p3_grp_disp_seq
		, p4_grp_id, p4_grp_desc, p4_grp_disp_seq
		, p5_grp_id, p5_grp_desc, p5_grp_disp_seq
		, p6_grp_id, p6_grp_desc, p6_grp_disp_seq
		, p7_grp_id, p7_grp_desc, p7_grp_disp_seq
		, p8_grp_id, p8_grp_desc, p8_grp_disp_seq
		, p9_grp_id, p9_grp_desc, p9_grp_disp_seq)
    SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id, util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc, util_reas_grp.display_seq
			,  util_reas.reas_cd, util_reas.reas_desc, util_reas.display_seq
			,  parent_urg1.reas_grp_id as p1_grp_id, parent_urg1.reas_grp_desc as p1_grp_desc, parent_urg1.display_seq as p1_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg2.reas_grp_id as p2_grp_id, parent_urg2.reas_grp_desc as p2_grp_desc, parent_urg2.display_seq as p2_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg3.reas_grp_id as p3_grp_id, parent_urg3.reas_grp_desc as p3_grp_desc, parent_urg3.display_seq as p3_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg4.reas_grp_id as p4_grp_id, parent_urg4.reas_grp_desc as p4_grp_desc, parent_urg4.display_seq as p4_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg5.reas_grp_id as p5_grp_id, parent_urg5.reas_grp_desc as p5_grp_desc, parent_urg5.display_seq as p5_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg6.reas_grp_id as p6_grp_id, parent_urg6.reas_grp_desc as p6_grp_desc, parent_urg6.display_seq as p6_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg7.reas_grp_id as p7_grp_id, parent_urg7.reas_grp_desc as p7_grp_desc, parent_urg7.display_seq as p7_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg8.reas_grp_id as p8_grp_id, parent_urg8.reas_grp_desc as p8_grp_desc, parent_urg8.display_seq as p8_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg9.reas_grp_id as p9_grp_id, parent_urg9.reas_grp_desc as p9_grp_desc, parent_urg9.display_seq as p9_grp_disp_seq
      FROM util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
           INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg1.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg1.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg2.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg2.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg3.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg4 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg3.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg4.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg4.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg5.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg6 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg5.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg6.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg7 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg6.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg7.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg8 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg7.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg8.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg9 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg8.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg9.reas_grp_id




	SELECT x.reas_grp_id, x.reas_grp_desc, x.reas_cd, x.reas_desc
			, x.l0_grp_id, x.l0_grp_desc
			, x.l1_grp_id, x.l1_grp_desc
			, x.l2_grp_id, x.l2_grp_desc
			, x.l3_grp_id, x.l3_grp_desc
			, x.l4_grp_id, x.l4_grp_desc
			, x.l5_grp_id, x.l5_grp_desc
			, x.l6_grp_id, x.l6_grp_desc
			, x.l7_grp_id, x.l7_grp_desc
			, x.l8_grp_id, x.l8_grp_desc
			, x.l9_grp_id, x.l9_grp_desc

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT]
-- Description:This will be used in Add production workflow during trigger form DCS


-- Usage:	This will be used in MDMAddProductionJobWorkflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2022-09-22		Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	 YG				  2023-01-24		Adding conversion for consumption
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT] 
@item_id AS nvarchar(40),
@ent_id AS int,
@interface AS nvarchar(40)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @to_uom_id int,
			@from_uom_id int,
			@factor as float,
			@default_uom as nvarchar(40) = 'KG'
		
	SET @interface = ISNULL(@interface,'CONS');


	SELECT @default_uom = uom_id
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_value = u.abbreviation
									AND a.attr_desc = 'AUTDefaultUOM'
									AND a.attr_grp = 2
									AND ent_id=@ent_id


	IF (@interface = 'PROD')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @from_uom_id = uom_id
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_value = u.abbreviation
									AND a.attr_desc = 'ProdUOM'
									AND a.attr_grp = 2
									AND ent_id=@ent_id
	END
	ELSE IF (@interface = 'CONS') 
	BEGIN
		SELECT @from_uom_id = uom_id
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_value = u.abbreviation
									AND a.attr_desc = 'ConsUOM'
									AND a.attr_grp = 2
									AND ent_id=@ent_id
	END

	SET @from_uom_id = ISNULL(@from_uom_id,(SELECT uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) Where abbreviation = @default_uom))

	SELECT @to_uom_id = uom_id
	FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_id = @item_id

	IF EXISTS (SELECT item_id FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id 
									AND from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
									AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id)
	BEGIN
		SET @factor=(SELECT factor
		FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
			AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
			AND item_id = @item_id)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @factor=(SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
			AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id)
	END

	SELECT @factor as factor
END

SELECT res.res_id
       ,res.res_desc
       ,res.res_class
       ,res.qty_avail
       ,res.allow_neg_bal
       ,res.num_decimals
       ,res.spare1
       ,res.spare2
       ,res.spare3
       ,res.spare4
       ,res.last_edit_comment

       ,res.last_edit_at

       (res.res_desc = @res_desc OR @res_desc IS NULL) AND

       (res.allow_neg_bal = @allow_neg_bal OR @allow_neg_bal IS NULL) AND

       (res.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_sa_ofi_su_overview]
-- Description: get SU details 
--
-- Usage:	get SU details
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-03-26			Initial version. 
-- 0.01.01	LK			2023-07-17			added parameter @userRole to get the record for user has permisison on entities
-- 0.01.02	MA			2023-12-18			Changes to add grade color column.
-- 0.01.03	CK			2024-01-11			Added Get UOM function for empty silo and added function su status
-- 0.01.04  DS          2024-02-07			Added nolock & comments & remove commented code
-- 0.01.05  MA			2024-01-17			Added condition to take storage entity as ent desc.
-- 0.01.06	VJ			2024-07-03			Added condition to hide virtual silos based on attribute
-- 0.01.07	JSC			2024-10-22			Removed HARDCODED domains
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_su_overview] 
	 @item_grp NVARCHAR(100),
	 @userRole nvarchar(20)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @item_grp_id INT
			SELECT @item_grp_id = a.attr_id 
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#unique_SU') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #unique_SU
	CREATE TABLE #unique_SU (
	 row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY
	,ent_id	INT
	,item_grp NVARCHAR(100)
	);

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#additional_SU') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #additional_SU
	CREATE TABLE #additional_SU  (
	 row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY
	,ent_id	INT	
	,item_grp NVARCHAR(100)
	);
	
	-- 0.01.01
	-- v0.01.07 Fix for domain
	Declare @user nvarchar(50)
	DECLARE @domain NVARCHAR(100)
	SELECT @domain = DEFAULT_DOMAIN()
	set @user=@domain+'\'+@userRole
	--set @user='AvevaQA\'+@userRole
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi
	CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi (
	
	ent_id	INT,
	ent_name nvarchar(50),
	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
	can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
	can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
	can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
	can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
	can_stre nvarchar(5),
	can_log_data nvarchar(5),
	parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
	access int
	);
	INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi
	exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user


	--INSERT INTO #unique_SU
	INSERT INTO #additional_SU
	SELECT DISTINCT isl.storage_ent_id,isl.item_group
	FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE isl.item_group=@item_grp
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT iv.ent_id,ia1.attr_value
	FROM item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=iv.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia1.item_id= i.item_id AND ia1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='ItemGroup') AND ia1.attr_value=@item_grp
	--INNER JOIN (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1) as UserEntaccess on iv.ent_id=UserEntaccess.ent_id  -- 0.01.01
	--where iv.ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	INSERT INTO #unique_SU
    SELECT DISTINCT asu.ent_id,item_grp 
	FROM #additional_SU asu  -- MOD v0.01.06
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr eal WITH (NOLOCK) ON asu.ent_id = eal.ent_id
													AND eal.attr_id = (	SELECT attr_id 
																		FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'HideSUOnUI'
																	)
	WHERE ISNULL(eal.attr_value,'0') = '0'
	--where ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	--INNER JOIN (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1) as UserEntaccess on iv.ent_id=UserEntaccess.ent_id  -- 0.01.01
	
	SELECT us.ent_id
		  ,isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_desc	--condition to take storage entity as ent_desc and as ent_name if desc is null.
		  ,e.ent_name
		  ,iv.item_id
		  ,i.item_desc
		  ,ig.item_grade_desc
		  ,SUM(iv.qty_left) AS su_qty
		  ,ISNULL(u.description,dbo.fn_s_ofi_GetUOM(us.ent_id)) as description
		  ,ia.attr_value AS segr_type
		  ,i.uom_id 
		  ,iv.grade_cd
		  ,iss.item_status_desc
		  ,iv.status_cd
		  ,max(iv.date_in_utc) as date_in_utc   
		  ,dbo.fn_ofi_su_get_mes_status (us.ent_id) as mes_status
		  ,dbo.fn_ofi_su_get_reclassify_status (us.ent_id) as reclassify
		  ,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) as grade_color	--passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
		  ,dbo.fn_s_ofi_SU_status (us.ent_id) as su_status
	FROM #unique_SU us 
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id=us.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN (item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=iv.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK) ON iv.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
	INNER JOIN item_state iss WITH(NOLOCK) ON iv.status_cd= iss.item_status_cd
	INNER JOIN uom u  WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=i.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia1.item_id= i.item_id AND ia1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='ItemGroup') AND ia1.attr_value=@item_grp
	LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id= i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='Classification')	-- classification is used ofr seggrigation 	
	) ON iv.ent_id=us.ent_id

	group by us.ent_id,e.ent_name,e.description,iv.item_id,i.item_desc ,i.uom_id,u.description,ia.attr_value,ig.item_grade_desc,iv.grade_cd
	, iss.item_status_desc,iv.status_cd,ig.color--,iv.date_in_utc
	ORDER by e.ent_name asc


END

CREATE FUNCTION fn_GetSublot_TotalProd
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@sublot_no NVARCHAR(80)
)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ResultVar as FLOAT
	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	SELECT @ResultVar = SUM(pp.qty_prod) OVER()
	from item_prod pp WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE pp.sublot_no = @sublot_no;

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @ResultVar

END

-- Description	      -	Returns the record set needed to build the routing (diagram) for a work order
-- Author	      - Raghu

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT 	 job.wo_id
	,job.oper_id
	,job.seq_no
	,job.run_ent_id
	,ent.ent_name 'run_ent_name'
	,job.qty_prod
	,job.qty_reqd
	,job.target_sched_ent_id

CREATE   Trigger [tg_oper_ent_spec_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_spec]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_ent_spec_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_ent_spec_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_ent_spec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_spec_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_ent_spec', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_spec_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_SCL_IsThisTestViolated]
(@chart_position				INT32
,@last_chart_label				INT32
,@last_chart_point				TFLOAT
,@last_cp_lower_sigma_level			TFLOAT
,@last_cp_upper_sigma_level			TFLOAT
,@lcl						TFLOAT
,@cl						TFLOAT
,@ucl						TFLOAT
,@test_id					INT32
,@num_points					INT32
,@of_points					INT32
,@sigma_limits					TFLOAT
,@test_result					INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - fn_SCL_IsThisTstViolatsTheRule
-- Description	      - The purpose of this stored procedure is to test a rule against chart point(s).
-- Author	      - Raghu G
-- Date Created	      -	11/11/2011
-- Version	      -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Refer to the stord procedure for sp_U_SCL_CalcStatsAndVerifyCRs for more details.
-- This stored procedure should not be called directly, as this should be called only via sp_U_SCL_CalcStatsAndVerifyCRs.

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
	SET @test_result = 0

	IF (@test_id = 1) BEGIN 	-- Trend Up
		IF (@num_points > 2 AND @of_points > 2) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM
					(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp1.chart_point_first_chart ELSE cp1.chart_point_second_chart END) >
									cp2.chart_point THEN 1
							ELSE 0 END) AS no_of_cp_trending_up
					FROM #chart_points cp1 WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN (SELECT cp.chart_label+1 AS chart_label, (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.chart_point_first_chart ELSE cp.chart_point_second_chart END) AS chart_point
							FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK) ) cp2 ON cp1.chart_label = cp2.chart_label
					WHERE cp1.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
					) no_of_trend_up
					-- The chart points are trending up
					WHERE no_of_trend_up.no_of_cp_trending_up >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
	END

	ELSE IF (@test_id = 2) BEGIN	-- Trend Down
		IF (@num_points > 2 AND @of_points > 2) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM
					(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp1.chart_point_first_chart ELSE cp1.chart_point_second_chart END) <
									cp2.chart_point THEN 1
							ELSE 0 END) AS no_of_cp_trending_down
					FROM #chart_points cp1 WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN (SELECT cp.chart_label+1 AS chart_label, (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.chart_point_first_chart ELSE cp.chart_point_second_chart END) AS chart_point
							FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK) ) cp2 ON cp1.chart_label = cp2.chart_label
					WHERE cp1.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
					) no_of_trend_down
					-- The chart points are trending up
					WHERE no_of_trend_down.no_of_cp_trending_down >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
	END

	ELSE IF (@test_id = 3) BEGIN	-- Run Above
		IF (@num_points = 1 AND @sigma_limits IS NULL)	BEGIN	-- Check whether the last chart point is outside of upper control limit
			IF @last_chart_point > @ucl
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@num_points > 1 AND @of_points > 0 AND ABS(@sigma_limits) > 0 -- Check whether the Number Points of Of Points ouside +Sigma Limit
				-- Verify whether the last chart point is above or equal to the sigma limit.
				AND @last_cp_upper_sigma_level >= @sigma_limits) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT cp.chart_type FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE cp.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
					-- Chart Points for the chart falling above the sigma limits
					  AND (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.upper_sigma_level_first_chart ELSE cp.upper_sigma_level_second_chart END) >= @sigma_limits
					GROUP BY cp.chart_type
					HAVING COUNT(*) >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@num_points > 1 AND @of_points > 0 AND @sigma_limits = 0 -- Check whether the Number Points of Of Points is on the upper side of the centerline
				-- Verify whether the last chart point is above the center line
				AND @last_chart_point > @cl) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM
		 			(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.chart_point_first_chart ELSE cp.chart_point_second_chart END) > @cl AND @last_chart_point > @cl THEN 1  -- upper side of the center line for the second chart
								   ELSE 0
						  END) AS no_of_chart_point_limits
		  			FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK)
		  			WHERE cp.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
					) no_of_one_side_of_centerline
				  WHERE no_of_one_side_of_centerline.no_of_chart_point_limits >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
	END

	ELSE IF (@test_id = 4) BEGIN 	-- Run Below
		IF (@num_points = 1 AND @sigma_limits IS NULL) BEGIN  -- Check whether the last chart point is outside of lower control limit)
			IF (@last_chart_point < @lcl)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@num_points > 1 AND @of_points > 0 AND ABS(@sigma_limits) > 0 -- Check whether the Number Points of Of Points ouside -Sigma Limit
			-- Verify whether the last chart point is below or equal to the sigma limits.
			AND @last_cp_lower_sigma_level <= @sigma_limits) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT cp.chart_type FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE cp.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
							-- Chart Points for the chart falling on the lower side of the sigma limits
							  AND (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.lower_sigma_level_first_chart ELSE cp.lower_sigma_level_second_chart END) <= @sigma_limits
							GROUP BY cp.chart_type
							HAVING COUNT(*) >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@num_points > 1 AND @of_points > 0 AND @sigma_limits = 0 -- Check whether the Number Points of Of Points is on the lower side of the centerline
			-- Verify whether the last chart point is below the center line
				AND @last_chart_point < @cl) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM
					(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.chart_point_first_chart ELSE cp.chart_point_second_chart END) < @cl AND @last_chart_point < @cl THEN 1  -- upper side of the center line for the second chart
						   ELSE 0
						  END) AS no_of_chart_point_limits
					FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE cp.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
					) no_of_one_side_of_centerline
				WHERE no_of_one_side_of_centerline.no_of_chart_point_limits >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
	END

	ELSE IF (@test_id = 6) BEGIN	-- Run Beyond
		IF (@num_points > 0 AND @of_points > 0 AND @sigma_limits <> 0 -- Check whether the Number Points of Of Points ouside +/- Sigma Limit
			-- Verify whether the last chart point is beyond the lower sigma or the upper sigma
			AND (@last_cp_lower_sigma_level <= -@sigma_limits OR @last_cp_upper_sigma_level >= @sigma_limits)) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT cp.chart_type FROM #chart_points cp WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE cp.chart_label > @last_chart_label - @of_points
							  AND ((CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.lower_sigma_level_first_chart ELSE cp.lower_sigma_level_second_chart END) <= -@sigma_limits
								OR (CASE WHEN @chart_position = 1 THEN cp.upper_sigma_level_first_chart ELSE cp.upper_sigma_level_second_chart END) >= @sigma_limits)
							GROUP BY cp.chart_type
							HAVING COUNT(*) >= @num_points)
				SET @test_result = 1
		END
	END

	-- None of the cases met, so there are no rule violations.
	SET @test_result = COALESCE(@test_result, 0)
END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  DECLARE @mw_db_user STRING40	-- Added 9/28/04 KRF

  SELECT DISTINCT @V_Priv_Status = g.priv_value FROM grp_priv_link g, user_grp_link u WHERE g.grp_id = u.grp_id AND u.user_id = @V_User_Id

  IF @V_Priv_Status IS NULL
    SET @V_Priv_Status = 0

  SELECT @mw_db_user = mw_db_user FROM db_status WITH (NOLOCK)-- Added 9/28/04 KRF -- Updated JSC 01/22/2025.
  IF @V_User_Id = @mw_db_user SET @V_Priv_Status = 1 -- Added 9/28/04 KRF

  IF (@V_Priv_Status <> 1 OR @@ERROR <> 0)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@qty_left			TFLOAT
,@add_to_inv		INT32 = 1
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus
-- Description        - Updates the storage_exec.status based on the inventory transaction.
-- Author	      -		 Raghu
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   - 2.0.0.33
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
--                      in_add_to_inv = 1 --> An item is added to the inventory.
--                      in_add_to_inv = 0 --> An item is reduced from the inventory.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--08/29/2002	Raghu		1.4	Remove Cont_id
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--08/08/2003	Raghu		1.6.19	(HD# 3508) Entity is changing to dirty state even if an item is available
--					Included "NoLock" hint in select queries. Also, status update logic modified
-- 04/30/2004	  Sheetal Jain	2033	Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
--03/29/2007    Raghu       3.2.0.5 Changed as a procedure (from function)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	 @current_storage_status		INT32
		,@itemlotcount					INT32
		,@allow_dirty_state				LOGICAL
		,@allow_multiple_items			INT32
		,@allow_multiple_lots			LOGICAL
		,@ent_name						STRING80
		,@err_msg						NVARCHAR(4000)

BEGIN

	--Default the add_to_inv = 1 (if not supplied) as we are adding quantities to inventory.
	SET @add_to_inv = COALESCE(@add_to_inv, 1)

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist{4261},' + LTRIM(STR(@ent_id))
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Retrieve the entity's name to identify this storage location
	SELECT @ent_name = ent_name
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		--Retrieve the entity's name to identify this storage location is not capable of storing inventory.
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Retrieve the storage properties for the supplied entity.
	SELECT @current_storage_status = status, @allow_dirty_state = allow_dirty_state,
		@allow_multiple_items = allow_multiple_items, @allow_multiple_lots = allow_multiple_lots
	FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	--Now, verify whether the intention is to ADD items to inventory or reduce items from inventory.
	IF (@add_to_inv = 1) BEGIN
		--The intention is to add items to the inventory.
		--Verify whether the current storage location is dirty state.
		IF  (@current_storage_status = 2) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'This storage entity: %1 is currently in the dirty state and hence cannot add items to this storage location.{3239},' + @ent_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		--Verify whether this storage location allows multiple items to be stored.
		IF (@allow_multiple_items = 0) BEGIN
			--This storage location does not allow multiple items to be stored.
			SELECT @itemlotcount = COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT item_id), 0)
			FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

			IF  (@itemlotcount > 1) BEGIN
				--The user is attempting to store multiple items in this storage location which is not allowed.
				--raise an exception to the caller.
				SET @err_msg = 'This storage location: %1 does not allow multiple items to be stored.{3237},' + @ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END

		--Verify whether this storage location allows multiple lots to be stored.
		IF (@allow_multiple_lots = 0) BEGIN
			--This storage location does not allow multiple lots to be stored.
			SELECT @itemlotcount = COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT lot_no), 0)
			FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

			IF  (@itemlotcount > 1) BEGIN
				--The user is attempting to store the item in multiple lots in this storage location which is not allowed.
				--raise an exception to the caller.
				SET @err_msg = 'This storage location: %1 does not allow items to be stored in multiple lots.{3238},' + @ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END

	--Get the sum of total quantities that exist in this storage location.
	SELECT @qty_left = COALESCE(SUM(qty_left), 0)
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	--Use the total quantities in this storage location to set the storage status appropriately.
	IF (@qty_left <= 0) BEGIN
		--Set the storage location to dirty state if allowed.
		IF (@allow_dirty_state = 1) BEGIN
			--This storage entity allows dirty state.  Set the entity's state to DIRTY state.
			--Status:2 indicates DIRTY state.
			IF (@current_storage_status <> 2)
				UPDATE storage_exec SET status = 2
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--This storage entity does not allow dirty state.
			--Set the storage status to AVAILABLE (status = 0)
			IF (@current_storage_status <> 0)
				UPDATE storage_exec SET status = 0
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Set the storage status to 1 (USED state)
		IF (@current_storage_status <> 1)
			UPDATE storage_exec SET status = 1
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Exec_GetPrvShftStrt]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@shift_start_time	TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
,@prev_shift_start_time	TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Util_Exec_GetPrvShftStrt
-- Description	      -	Get the previous shift start time for an entity from the supplied shift start time.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	09/22/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @shift_start_time_utc AS DATETIME
	--Default the time_zone_bias_value parameter to 0; if not supplied.
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		, @shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_time)

	--Verify whether the supplied start time is not null
	--If a shift start time is supplied, then get the previous shift start time from the supplied shift start time.
	IF (@shift_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The supplied shift start time is NULL;
		--default to the current shift start as the start time from the supplied entity.
		SELECT @shift_start_time = cur_shift_start_time_local, @shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Verify whether the current shift_start_time IS NOT NULL for the supplied entity.
		--If still NULL, then default to the current datetime.
		--If datetimes are not stored in GMT, then default the shift start time to current time
		SET @shift_start_time = COALESCE(@shift_start_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))
		--If datetimes are stored in GMT, then default the shift start time to GMT time
		SET @shift_start_time_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_time_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	--Get the previous shift start time
	SELECT TOP 1 @prev_shift_start_time = MAX(DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_start_utc))
	FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND shift_start_utc < @shift_start_time_utc
	  AND shift_id > 0
END

/******************************************************************************************
Procedure:   [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_ValidateOnJobComplete]
Purpose:     Validation before completing the job
             1. Previous job must be completed
             2. Previous intra-material must be consumed
             3. Production target must be ≤ actual production

Usage:       JobManagement

Version History:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Version   Author   Date         Description
0.01      YG       2023-03-16   Initial version
0.02      YG       2023-04-28   Added consumption range check
0.03      YG       2023-05-10   Updated consumption check
0.04      DS       2023-06-26   #31 BAT List logic for last job validation
0.05      DS       2023-08-01   #177 Changed "Suspended" to "Stopped"
0.06      AKM      2024-02-02   Code cleanup and best practices
0.07      JSC      2025-07-30   CR512: Handle zero consumption case
0.08      AML, XPM 2026-03-24   CR585: Handle no OBD being received when required.
0.09      AML, XPM 2026-05-20   CR623: Added ProductionDeviationAllowance validation for OBD transit loss.
1.00	  AML,XPM  2026-06-17	CR623: Handled ProductionDeviationAllowance as String
******************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_ValidateOnJobComplete]  
    @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @oper_id NVARCHAR(100),
    @seq_no INT
AS
BEGIN
    ----------------------------------------
    -- Variable Declarations
    ----------------------------------------
    DECLARE 
        @process_id NVARCHAR(100),
        @CheckPreviousJobState INT = 0,
        @CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed INT = 0,
        @oper_seq INT,
        @previous_operation NVARCHAR(100),
        @prev_prod_item_group NVARCHAR(40),
		@NewState INT,
        @Released INT,
        @Running INT,
        @Suspended INT,
        @def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
        @CheckTargetVsActualProd INT = 0,
        @IsValidSplitJobExists INT = 0,
		@DeviationAllowanceStr NVARCHAR(15) = NULL, -- V1.0 CR623
		@DeviationAllowance FLOAT = NULL -- CR623

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Operation Attribute Checks
    ----------------------------------------
    SELECT @CheckPreviousJobState = attr_value
    FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
      AND attr_id = (
            SELECT attr_id
            FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckPreviousJobState'
              AND attr_grp = 7
        )

    SELECT @CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed = attr_value
    FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
      AND attr_id = (
            SELECT attr_id
            FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed'
              AND attr_grp = 7
        )

    SELECT @CheckTargetVsActualProd = attr_value
    FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
      AND attr_id = (
            SELECT attr_id
            FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckTargetVsActualProd'
              AND attr_grp = 7
        )

	-- v 0.08 added
	DECLARE @canautoclose INT;
	SELECT @canautoclose = pa.attr_value FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK) 
			  INNER JOIN process_attr pa WITH(NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id = pa.process_id 
			  INNER JOIN attr a ON pa.attr_id = a.attr_id
			  WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id AND a.attr_desc = 'CanAutoClose'

	IF @canautoclose = 1
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @gragainstobd NVARCHAR(5),
				@delivery NVARCHAR(20);

		SELECT @gragainstobd = pa.attr_value FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN process_attr pa WITH(NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id = pa.process_id
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON pa.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id AND a.attr_desc='GRAgainstOBD'

		SELECT @delivery=delivery FROM ofi_wo_ext WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		IF (@gragainstobd ='1' AND @delivery IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 2 AS Result, dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300054, NULL, 10) AS Descriptions
			RETURN
		END 
	END 



	-- FIX any non existing parameter
	SET @CheckPreviousJobState = COALESCE(@CheckPreviousJobState,0)
	SET @CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed = COALESCE(@CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed,0)
	SET @CheckTargetVsActualProd = COALESCE(@CheckTargetVsActualProd,0)

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Get Process and Previous Operation
    ----------------------------------------
    SELECT 
        @process_id = process_id,
        @oper_seq = display_seq
    FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE oper_id = @oper_id

    SELECT TOP 1 @previous_operation = oper_id
    FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE process_id = @process_id
      AND display_seq < @oper_seq
      AND oper_id <> @oper_id
    ORDER BY display_seq DESC

    ----------------------------------------
    -- BOM Consumption Check
    ----------------------------------------
	BEGIN TRY

		 DECLARE @item_id NVARCHAR(40)
		 SELECT @item_id = j.item_id
		 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		 WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

		-- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
		DECLARE @ConsCheckReturn INT
		EXECUTE @ConsCheckReturn = sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,  NULL,0,1

		IF @ConsCheckReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT 4 AS Result, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(200004, NULL, 10), @item_id) AS Descriptions
            RETURN
        END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SELECT 4 AS Result, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(200004, NULL, 10), @item_id) AS Descriptions
		RETURN
	END CATCH

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Job State Mapping
    ----------------------------------------
    SELECT 
		@NewState   = MAX(CASE WHEN state_cd = 1 THEN state_cd END),
        @Released   = MAX(CASE WHEN state_cd = 2 THEN state_cd END),
        @Running    = MAX(CASE WHEN state_cd = 3 THEN state_cd END),
        @Suspended  = MAX(CASE WHEN state_cd = 5 THEN state_cd END)
    FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE state_cd IN (1, 2, 3, 5)

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Get Default Lot No -- For cancel job scenario
    ----------------------------------------
    SELECT @def_lot_no = jb.def_lot_no
    FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id 
		AND jb.oper_id = @previous_operation 
		AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
		AND jb.bom_pos = 0

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Validation Logic -- Should not be same seq number
    ----------------------------------------
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON job.state_cd = js.state_cd 
										AND js.state_cd IN (@NewState, @Released, @Running, @Suspended) --(1,2,3,5)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND seq_no <> @seq_no 
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
    ) AND @CheckPreviousJobState = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @IsValidSplitJobExists = 1
    END

    IF 	EXISTS 	(		
					SELECT 1
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						AND oper_id = @previous_operation 
						AND state_cd IN (@Running, @Suspended)
				) 	
		AND @CheckPreviousJobState = 1 
		AND @IsValidSplitJobExists = 0
    BEGIN
        SELECT 1 AS Result, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(200001, NULL, 10),'; 0: ',@wo_id,'; 1: ',@oper_id,'; 2: ',TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2),@seq_no)) AS Descriptions
        RETURN
    END

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Check WIP Consumption from Previous Operation == checking for the last job
    ----------------------------------------
    IF 	@CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed = 1
		AND @IsValidSplitJobExists = 0
        AND EXISTS (
						SELECT TOP 1 1
						FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE iv.wo_id = @wo_id
							AND iv.oper_id = @previous_operation
							AND iv.qty_left > 0
							AND iv.lot_no = @def_lot_no
					)
    BEGIN
        SELECT 2 AS Result, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(200002, NULL, 10),'; 0: ',@wo_id,'; 1: ',@oper_id,'; 2: ',TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2),@seq_no))  AS Descriptions
        RETURN
    END

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Check Production Target vs Actual
    ----------------------------------------
    IF (@CheckTargetVsActualProd = 1)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE 
            @ProdReqd FLOAT,
            @GoodProd FLOAT

        SELECT 
            @ProdReqd = qty_reqd,
            @GoodProd = qty_prod
        FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no

        IF (@ProdReqd > @GoodProd)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 3 AS Result, dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(200003, NULL, 10) AS Descriptions
            RETURN
        END
    END


	----------------------------------------
    -- CR623: Transit Loss Validation
    ----------------------------------------
	SELECT  @DeviationAllowanceStr = oa.attr_value
    FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
    WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
      AND a.attr_desc = 'ProductionDeviationAllowance'
      AND a.attr_grp = 7

	IF (@DeviationAllowanceStr IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@DeviationAllowanceStr)) <> '')
    BEGIN
        
        SET @DeviationAllowance = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, REPLACE(@DeviationAllowanceStr, ',', '.'));

		IF (@DeviationAllowance IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE 
				@OpenJobExists INT = 0,
				@TransitLoss FLOAT,
				@OBDQty FLOAT,
				@TotalGoodProd FLOAT;
			IF EXISTS
			(
				SELECT 1
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND j.seq_no <> @seq_no
				  AND j.state_cd IN (@NewState, @Released, @Running, @Suspended) --(1,2,3,5)
			)
			BEGIN
				SET @OpenJobExists = 1
			END

			IF (@OpenJobExists = 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @OBDQty = TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, ext.wo_qty)
				FROM ofi_wo_ext ext WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ext.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND ext.module = 'PO'

				-- Total qty produced per WO
				SELECT  @TotalGoodProd = ISNULL(SUM(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, ip.qty_prod)), 0)
				FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id

				IF (@OBDQty > @TotalGoodProd)
				BEGIN
					SET @TransitLoss = ((@OBDQty - @TotalGoodProd) / @OBDQty) * 100.0;

					IF (@TransitLoss > @DeviationAllowance)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 
							2 AS Result,
							CONCAT('@@TransitLossExceeded@@: Transit loss (', FORMAT(@TransitLoss, 'N2'), '%) is above the configured allowance of ', @DeviationAllowanceStr, '%.') AS Descriptions
						RETURN
					END
				END
            END
        END
    END
           

    ----------------------------------------
    -- Final Success Response
    ----------------------------------------
    SELECT 0 AS Result, '@@Success@@' AS Descriptions
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_Data]
(
	@row_id int ,
	@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@seq_no int ,
	@step_no int ,
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40),
	@state_cd int ,
	--@act_start_time datetime ,
	@act_start_time_local datetime ,	-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	@act_start_time_tz INT32 = NULL ,
	--@act_finish_time datetime ,
	@act_finish_time_local datetime ,	-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	@act_finish_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@step_data nvarchar(254) ,
	--@step_data_time datetime ,
	@step_data_time_local datetime ,
	@step_data_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@start_user_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@finish_user_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@data_user_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@form_done bit ,
	@spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare5 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare6 nvarchar(80) ,
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
	@last_edit_at datetime ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				-
-- Description				-
-- Author					-
-- Date Created				- 10/21/2002
-- Version					- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.1	Changed last_edit_at to accept NULL values passed in, such that this can be updated via StartStep
-- 10/12/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/26/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 03/15/2007		Raghu			3.2.3   Adjust act_start_time, act_finish_time and step_data_time wrt GMT.
-- 07/30/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 11/22/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
DECLARE	@act_start_time_utc		TDATETIME_NULL
	,	@act_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME_NULL
	,	@step_data_time_utc		TDATETIME_NULL
	,	@dbg_resp				INT32
	,	@tz_temp				INT32

	SET @act_start_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@act_start_time_tz)
	SET @act_start_time_local	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@act_start_time_local, @act_start_time_tz)
	SET @act_finish_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@act_finish_time_tz)
	SET @act_finish_time_local	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@act_finish_time_local, @act_finish_time_tz)
	SET @step_data_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_data_time_tz)
	SET @step_data_time_local	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@step_data_time_local, @step_data_time_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
    exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Job_Step_Data', @src_key='sp_U_Job_Step_Data',
					@date_val1 = @act_start_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @act_start_time_tz,
					@date_val2 = @act_finish_time_local, @numeric_val2 = @act_finish_time_tz
	IF ( @dbg_resp = 1 ) RETURN


	SET @tz_temp = - @act_start_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @act_start_time_local, @tz_temp, @act_start_time_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = - @act_finish_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @act_finish_time_local,@tz_temp, @act_finish_time_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = - @step_data_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_data_time_local, @tz_temp, @step_data_time_utc OUTPUT
--

UPDATE job_step_data
SET	wo_id = @wo_id,
	oper_id = @oper_id,
	seq_no = @seq_no,
	step_no = @step_no,
	lot_no = @lot_no,
	sublot_no = @sublot_no,
	state_cd = @state_cd,
	--act_start_time = DATEADD(SS, -@time_zone_bias_value, @act_start_time),
	act_start_time_local = @act_start_time_local,	-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	act_start_time_utc = @act_start_time_utc,		-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	--act_finish_time = DATEADD(SS, -@time_zone_bias_value, @act_finish_time),
	act_finish_time_local = @act_finish_time_local,	-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	act_finish_time_utc	= @act_finish_time_utc,		-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	step_data = @step_data,
	--step_data_time = DATEADD(SS, -@time_zone_bias_value, @step_data_time),
	step_data_time_local = @step_data_time_local,	-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	step_data_time_utc = @step_data_time_utc,		-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
	start_user_id = @start_user_id,
	finish_user_id = @finish_user_id,
	data_user_id = @data_user_id,
	form_done = @form_done,
	spare1 = @spare1,
	spare2 = @spare2,
	spare3 = @spare3,
	spare4 = @spare4,
	spare5 = @spare5,
	spare6 = @spare6,
	last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	-- last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
WHERE 	(row_id = @row_id AND
        state_cd <> 9 AND
        (last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Res_Exc]
(@res_id  int  ,
 @start_time  datetime  ,
 @start_time_tz	INt32 = NULL,
 @end_time  datetime  ,
 @end_time_tz	INt32 = NULL,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Res_Exc
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 11/27/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
--12/22/2009	Kishore		4.1		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

  SET @start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
  SET @end_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)

  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32
  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Res_Exc', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @start_time, @numeric_val1 = @start_time_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @end_time, @numeric_val2 = @end_time_tz

IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@start_time_tz, @start_time)
IF @end_time IS NOT NULL SET @end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@end_time_tz, @end_time)

SELECT res_exc.res_id
       ,res_exc.start_time as start_time
       ,res_exc.end_time as end_time
       ,res_exc.qty_unavail
       ,res_exc.comments
       ,res_exc.last_edit_comment
       ,res_exc.last_edit_by
       ,res_exc.last_edit_at
       ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, res_exc.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM res_exc res_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((res_exc.res_id = @res_id OR @res_id IS NULL) AND
       (res_exc.start_time >= @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL) AND
       (res_exc.end_time <= @end_time OR @end_time IS NULL) AND
       (res_exc.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (res_exc.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

	BEGIN
		SELECT ent.ent_id
		,ent_name
		FROM ent with(nolock)
		inner join ent_attr ea with(nolock) on ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id and ea.attr_value='StorageUnit'

-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Job_GetByFilter
-- Description       - Return a recordset using the job filters passed in
-- Author	     - Raghu

--

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--11/12/2003	Raghu		2.0.8	If sort order is specified in system_attr table for item_class or item, then it uses the same sort order
--11/20/2003	Raghu		2.0.11	Attribute filters are getting ignored in the select statement and still returns a complete recordset - Issue Fixed
--02/27/2004	Raghu		2.0.26	Modified to improve performance
--06/18/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed i.units to uom.description
--08/25/2004	Raghu		2.1.1	Changed reference from 'po' to 'so'
--03/02/2005	Raghu		2.1.15	(HD# 5337). Included item_produced filter in the where clause
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--11/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.4	HD# 6474, Attributes should be ANDed instead of ORed.
--04/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD#, 6971, Allow item classes filters to filter item_class values
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities; Prepend 'N' before concatenating each string.
--05/05/2006	Raghu		3.1.15	HD# 8173, 8174, Supply time_zone_bias_value to sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter
--06/08/2006	Raghu		3.1.17	HD# 8342, uom_id filter does not work.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @sSQL		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@sSQLWhere		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@temp_filter		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@temp_SQL		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@temp_subSQL	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@start		INT
	,@end			INT
	,@disp_order		NVARCHAR(2)

	,@item_class_filter	INT

	,@wo_id				NVARCHAR(400)

	,@release_date_utc	DATETIME
	,@req_finish_time_utc	DATETIME
	,@priority			INT

	,@job_oper_id		NVARCHAR(400)

	,@last_run_on_ent_id	INT

	,@oper_id			NVARCHAR(400)

	,@pos INT
	CREATE TABLE #attr_filter (filter_count INT, attr_id INT, attr_value NVARCHAR(100))

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @separator = '$$'

	IF (@filter_option IS NULL) SET @filter_option = 0
	IF (@criteria IS NULL) SET @criteria = ''

	SELECT @item_class_filter = 0, @item_filter = 0, @job_filter = 0, @process_filter = 0

	IF (@filter_option = 0) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_id,c.cust_name,so.po_id,sl.so_line_no,sl.quantity,sl.item_id,sl.reqd_by_utc, sl.reqd_by_local, DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value,sl.reqd_by_utc) reqd_by,wo.wo_id,wo.wo_desc '

				,@approver=@approver OUTPUT, @last_editor=@last_editor OUTPUT, @check_out_by=@check_out_by OUTPUT, @rework=@rework OUTPUT
			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
				SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id=p.process_id '
				IF (CHARINDEX('op.oper_id', @temp_SQL) > 0) BEGIN
					SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = op.process_id '
				END
				IF (CHARINDEX('oel.ent', @temp_SQL) > 0) BEGIN
					IF (CHARINDEX('oper op', @sSQL, 0) = 0) BEGIN
						SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' JOIN oper op WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = op.process_id '
					END
					SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' JOIN oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = oel.process_id AND op.oper_id = oel.oper_id '
				END
				SET @process_filter = 1
				SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
			END

			-- Get Process Attribute Filters
			SET @temp_SQL = ''
			SET @start = CHARINDEX('PA:$$($$', @temp_filter, 1)  --Get Attribute ( starting position
			IF @start > 0 BEGIN
				SET @start = @start + 3 -- Get rid of PA:
				SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @temp_filter, @start)
				IF @end = 0 SET @end = LEN(@temp_filter) ELSE SET @end = @end + 5
			END
			ELSE SET @end = 0	-- Get Attribute ) End Position
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
				SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
				SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
				IF @process_filter = 0 BEGIN
					SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id=p.process_id '
					SET @process_filter = 1
				END
				WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
					SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
					SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
					SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

					IF @value <> '' BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #attr_filter VALUES(@attr_counter, CAST(LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) AS INT), UPPER(@value))

						SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' JOIN #attr_filter af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' ON af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.filter_count = ' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10))
						SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' JOIN process_attr pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.process_id = pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.process_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id = pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id AND af' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value = pa' + CAST(@attr_counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value '
						SET @attr_counter = @attr_counter + 1
					END
					SET @start = @end + 4
					SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
				END
			END
			IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
--				SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN process_attr pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON pa.process_id=wo.process_id '
--				SET @sSQLWhere = @sSQLWhere + @temp_SQL
				IF (@process_filter = 0) BEGIN
					SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN process p WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id=p.process_id '
					SET @process_filter = 1
				END
				SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL
			END
		END --end of job filter found ie, filter string >0

	END	--end for filter (IS NOT NULL)

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @sSQLWhere

	IF (@filter_option = 0)
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY c.cust_id,so.po_id,sl.so_line_no,wo.wo_id'

	IF (@filter_option = 1) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY '
		SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 208 	--208 - Item_Class display order
		IF (@disp_order = '0')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'ic.item_class_id'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '1')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'ic.item_class_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '2')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '3')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'ic.item_class_desc,ic.item_class_id'
		ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'ic.item_class_id'

		SET @disp_order = NULL
		SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210	--210 - Item Display order
		IF (@disp_order = '0')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',i.item_id'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '1')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',i.item_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '2')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',i.item_id,i.item_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '3')
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',i.item_desc,i.item_id'
		ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',i.item_id'

		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ',wo.wo_id'
--		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY ic.item_class_id,i.item_id,wo.wo_id'
	END

	IF (@filter_option = 2)
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY wo.mo_id,wo.wo_id,wo.wo_desc'

	IF (@filter_option = 100) OR (@filter_option = 101) OR (@filter_option = 102)
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY wo.wo_id,j.display_seq,j.oper_id,j.seq_no'

	IF (@filter_option = 103)
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,jb.bom_pos'

	IF (@filter_option = 201)
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY,wo.mod_id))) mod_id,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty_at_start) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE final_job = 1 AND wo_id = wo.wo_id), 0) as calc_start_qty,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty_reqd) FROM job job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE final_job = 1 AND wo_id = wo.wo_id), 0) as calc_reqd_qty,wo.* FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo.wo_id IN (' + @sSQL + ') ORDER BY wo.wo_id'

	IF (@filter_option = 202)
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT j.* FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE j.wo_id IN (' + @sSQL + ')'

--	PRINT @sSQL
	SET @param_def = '@time_zone_bias_value INT,@wo_id NVARCHAR(400),@reqd_qty FLOAT,@release_date_utc DATETIME,@req_finish_time_utc DATETIME,@priority INT,@customer NVARCHAR(400),@mo_id NVARCHAR(400)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@job_wo_id NVARCHAR(400),@job_oper_id NVARCHAR(400),@init_shed_ent_id INT,@sched_ent_id INT,@last_run_on_ent_id INT'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@item_class_id NVARCHAR(400),@item_class_desc NVARCHAR(400),@ic_produced BIT,@ic_consumed BIT,@ic_obsolete BIT'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@item_id NVARCHAR(400),@item_desc NVARCHAR(400),@uom_desc NVARCHAR(400),@uom_id INT,@template BIT,@lifetime INT,@unit_cost FLOAT,@i_obsolete BIT,@num_decimals INT'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@spare1 NVARCHAR(400),@spare2 NVARCHAR(400),@spare3 NVARCHAR(400),@spare4 NVARCHAR(400)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@process_id NVARCHAR(400),@oper_id NVARCHAR(400),@ent_id NVARCHAR(400),@process_level INT,@process_status INT,@creator NVARCHAR(400),@approver NVARCHAR(400)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ',@last_editor NVARCHAR(400),@check_out_by NVARCHAR(400),@rework BIT, @criteria NVARCHAR(40)'

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @param_def, @time_zone_bias_value, @wo_id,@reqd_qty,@release_date_utc,@req_finish_time_utc,@priority,@customer,@mo_id
		,@job_wo_id,@job_oper_id,@init_shed_ent_id,@sched_ent_id,@last_run_on_ent_id,@item_class_id,@item_class_desc,@ic_produced,@ic_consumed,@ic_obsolete	,@item_id,@item_desc,@uom_desc
		,@uom_id,@template,@lifetime,@unit_cost,@i_obsolete,@num_decimals,@spare1,@spare2,@spare3,@spare4,@process_id,@oper_id,@ent_id,@process_level,@process_status,@creator,@approver
		,@last_editor,@check_out_by,@rework, @criteria


	DROP TABLE #attr_filter
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_spec_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_spec]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_ent_spec_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_ent_spec_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_ent_spec a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		      AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		      AND a.step_no = b.step_no
		     AND a.ent_id = b.ent_id
		     AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
		     AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id
	OPEN oper_ent_spec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_spec_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_ent_spec', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_spec_cursor
END

AS

--

-- 06/30/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Added last_edit_at column as 'ent_last_edit_at' for child_ent_id
-- 04/06/2005		Raghu			2.1.18		Added can_capture_util, can_do_dnc, can_log_data columns to the resultset
-- 04/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.14		HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
/*SELECT  ent_link.parent_ent_id
            ,ent_link.child_ent_id
            ,ent.ent_name as parent_ent_name
            ,ent1.ent_name as child_ent_name
            ,ent1.can_sched_jobs
            , ent1.can_run_jobs
            ,ent1.can_store
            ,ent1.can_capture_labor
	    ,ent1.can_capture_util
	    ,ent1.can_do_dnc
	    ,ent1.can_log_data
            ,ent.description as parent_ent_description
            ,ent1.description as child_ent_description
            ,ent_link.last_edit_comment
            ,ent_link.last_edit_by
            ,ent_link.last_edit_at
	,ent1.last_edit_at as ent_last_edit_at
FROM ent_link ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,ent ent WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,ent ent1  WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (ent_link.parent_ent_id *= ent.ent_id AND
       ent_link.child_ent_id *= ent1.ent_id AND
       (ent_link.parent_ent_id = @parent_ent_id OR @parent_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (ent_link.child_ent_id = @child_ent_id OR @child_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (ent_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent1.ent_name				-- RWB

	,	ent_link.last_edit_at

	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_link.parent_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent ent1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_link.child_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
WHERE (
		(ent_link.parent_ent_id = @parent_ent_id OR @parent_ent_id IS NULL) AND

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_data_log_grp_oper_link_aft_del] ON dbo.data_log_grp_oper_link
AFTER DELETE
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- [tg_data_log_grp_oper_link_aft_del]
-- Description			- Deletes corresponding entries from Data_Entry_Sched
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 01/02/2008
-- Version				- 3.4.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM data_entry_sched
	WHERE key_id IN (SELECT o.row_id FROM oper o WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN deleted d ON o.process_id = d.process_id
				  AND o.oper_id = d.oper_id)

-- Module Name	      - sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams
-- Description	      - This stored procedure retrieves the factor and offset used by fn_ConvertQty to convert from one unit of measure to another
-- Author				- Nicky
--
-- Date Created      - 03/05/2010
-- Version			 - 4.0
