CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams]
(
	@factor TFLOAT	output,
	@offset TFLOAT output,
	@qty_uom_id	INT32,
	@dest_uom_id	INT32,
	@dest_item_id  STRING80
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE
	@from_uom_desc STRING80
	,@to_uom_desc STRING80
	,@err_msg NVARCHAR(2000)

	SELECT @factor = 1, @offset = 0

	 IF(@qty_uom_id = @dest_uom_id)
	 BEGIN
		--No conversion necessary - use the default factor=1 offset = 0.
       RETURN
    END

	select @dest_item_id = item.item_id from item  WITH (NOLOCK) where item.item_id = @dest_item_id

	if(@dest_item_id is NULL AND (@qty_uom_id IS NULL OR @dest_uom_id IS NULL))
	BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566}, item' + @dest_item_id
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	END

	IF (@qty_uom_id IS NULL AND @dest_uom_id IS NULL)
		RETURN

	IF (@qty_uom_id IS NULL)
		SELECT @qty_uom_id = item.uom_id FROM item  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @dest_item_id

	IF (@dest_uom_id IS NULL)
		SELECT @dest_uom_id = item.uom_id FROM item  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @dest_item_id

	IF @qty_uom_id <> @dest_uom_id
	BEGIN
		--The unit of measurements are not same between the source inventory row and the destination inventory row.
		--Get the conversion factor between two units.
		set @factor = NULL
		SELECT TOP 1 @factor = factor, @offset = offset
		FROM uom_conv
		WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE from_uom_id = @qty_uom_id AND to_uom_id = @dest_uom_id
		  AND (item_id = @dest_item_id OR item_id IS NULL)
		ORDER BY item_id DESC

		IF (@factor IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			--Since we don't find the conversion factor between two units, raise an error.
			SELECT @from_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @qty_uom_id
			IF (@from_uom_desc IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'uom:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @qty_uom_id) + ' used by the source inventory item'
				RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
				return -1
			END

			SELECT @to_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @dest_uom_id
			IF (@to_uom_desc IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'uom:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @dest_uom_id) + ' for the destination inventory item'
				RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
				return -1
			END

			--Revise error message - catch in parent and reraise there with extra info
			--SET @err_msg = 'A conversion factor between %1 and %2 is required to convert this item into destination units, because the item: %3 stored in the inventory location:%4, lot: %5 uses a different unit of measurement than the item: %6 stored in the inventory location:%7, lot: %8. Pl add a conversion factor between two units.{4990},'
			SET @err_msg = 'A conversion factor between %1 and %2 is required to convert this item into destination units.{6832},'
								+ @from_uom_desc + ','+@to_uom_desc
			RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
			return -1
		END

		RETURN
	END
	ELSE
		select @factor = 1, @offset = 0

	return
END

       item_grade.item_grade_desc,

       item_cons.spare1,
       item_cons.spare2,
       item_cons.spare3,

LEFT OUTER JOIN job job ON
   item_cons.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
   item_cons.oper_id = job.oper_id AND

INNER JOIN item item ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_History]
(@ent_id int = NULL,
@event_time_utc		datetime2 = NULL,
@event_time		datetime2 = NULL,
@shift_id		nvarchar(40) = NULL,
@shift_start_utc	datetime = NULL,
@shift_start		datetime = NULL,
@state_cd		int = NULL,
@reas_cd		int = NULL,
@reas_pending	bit = NULL,
@runtime		bit = NULL,
@downtime		bit = NULL,
@setuptime		bit = NULL,
@teardowntime	bit = NULL,
@fixedtime		bit = NULL,
@vartime		bit = NULL,
@failure        bit = NULL,
@raw_reas_cd	nvarchar(40) = NULL,
@last_edit_by	nvarchar(40) = NULL,
@last_edit_at	datetime = NULL,
@log_id int = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Util_History
-- Description	      -
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 07/18/2017		Raghu			6.0		UserStory:716502 - As SE development, I want to address all the failures in the stateless API to make it compatible with the new schema
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE @event_start_times	TABLE (ent_id INT, event_time_utc DATETIME2)

	--If event time utc is not supplied, but a local event time is supplied, then convert the local time to the utc time
	--for backward compatibility
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NULL AND @event_time IS NOT NULL)
		SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time, GETUTCDATE())

	IF (@event_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
		INSERT INTO @event_start_times (ent_id, event_time_utc)
		SELECT uh.ent_id, MAX(uh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (uh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND uh.event_time_utc <= @event_time_utc
		GROUP BY uh.ent_id

	--If shift start utc is not supplied, but a local shift start is supplied, then convert the shift start local time to the utc time
	--for backward compatibility
	IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL AND @shift_start IS NOT NULL)
		SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start, GETUTCDATE())

	SELECT	util_log.log_id
		, util_log.event_time_utc
		, util_log.event_time_local
		, util_log.ent_id
		,	ent.ent_name
		, util_log.shift_id
		,	shift.shift_desc
		, util_log.shift_start_utc
		, util_log.shift_start_local
		, util_log.state_cd
		, util_state.state_desc
		, util_state.color
		, util_log.reas_cd
		, util_log.reas_pending
		, util_log.runtime
		, util_log.downtime
		, util_log.setuptime
		, util_log.teardowntime
		, util_log.fixedtime
		, util_log.vartime
		, util_log.failure
		,	'duration' = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (util_log.duration/3600)) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (util_log.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (util_log.duration%3600)%60)
		, util_log.comments
		, util_log.raw_reas_cd
		, util_log.spare1
		, util_log.spare2
		, util_log.spare3
		, util_log.spare4
		, util_log.category1
		, util_log.category2
		, util_log.category3
		, util_log.category4
		, util_log.last_edit_comment
		, util_log.last_edit_by
		, util_log.last_edit_at
		FROM util_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.state_cd = util_state.state_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_log.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN @event_start_times est ON util_log.ent_id = est.ent_id
	WHERE ( (util_log.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.event_time_utc >= est.event_time_utc OR @event_time_utc IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.reas_pending = ABS(@reas_pending) OR @reas_pending IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.runtime = ABS(@runtime) OR @runtime IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.downtime = ABS(@downtime) OR @downtime IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.setuptime = ABS(@setuptime) OR @setuptime IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.teardowntime = ABS(@teardowntime) OR @teardowntime IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.fixedtime = ABS(@fixedtime) OR @fixedtime IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.vartime = ABS(@vartime) OR @vartime IS NULL) AND
            (util_log.failure = ABS(@failure) OR @failure IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(util_log.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY util_log.event_time_utc DESC, util_log.ent_id
END

-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_ValidateSiloOnJobStart] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50),
@oper_id nvarchar(50),
@seq_no int,
@type nvarchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

if @type='Silo'
BEGIN
					DECLARE @avd INT=null
					DECLARE @avs INT=null
					DECLARE @avr INT=null
					DECLARE @souAndDes int =null



					IF EXISTS(SELECT attr_value
							  FROM   oper_attr oa with (nolock)
									 INNER JOIN attr a with (nolock)
											 ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
                 
									 INNER JOIN job(nolock) j
											 ON j.oper_id = oa.oper_id 
											  WHERE  j.wo_id =@wo_id
									 AND j.oper_id =@oper_id
									 AND seq_no =@seq_no
									 AND a.attr_desc = 'dest_storage_reqd'
									 and oa.attr_value<>'0')
					  BEGIN
						  SET @avd=1
						  print 'avd'
						  print @avd
					  END

					IF EXISTS(SELECT attr_value
							  FROM   oper_attr oa with (nolock)
									 INNER JOIN attr a with (nolock)
											 ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
                 
									 INNER JOIN job j with (nolock)
											  ON j.oper_id = oa.oper_id
											  WHERE  j.wo_id =@wo_id
									 AND j.oper_id =@oper_id
									 AND seq_no =@seq_no
									 AND a.attr_desc = 'src_storage_reqd'
									 and oa.attr_value<>'0')
					  BEGIN
						  SET @avs=1
						   print 'avs'
						  print @avs
					  END

					IF EXISTS(SELECT attr_value
							  FROM   oper_attr oa with (nolock)
									 INNER JOIN attr a with (nolock)
											 ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
                 
									 INNER JOIN job j with (nolock)
											 ON j.oper_id = oa.oper_id
											  WHERE  j.wo_id =@wo_id
									 AND j.oper_id =@oper_id
									 AND seq_no =@seq_no
									 AND a.attr_desc = 'recipe_reqd'
									 and oa.attr_value<>'0')-- if exists and its value is 1
					  BEGIN
						  SET @avr=1
						   print 'avr'
						  print @avr
					  END

					IF( @avs = 1
						 OR @avd = 1
						 OR @avs = 1 )
					  BEGIN


						  IF( @avd = 1 and @avs is null)
							BEGIN

								IF EXISTS(SELECT * from job_step_data jsd with (nolock)
											inner join job_step js with (nolock) on jsd.wo_id=js.wo_id
											and jsd.oper_id=js.oper_id
											and jsd.seq_no=js.seq_no
											and jsd.step_no=js.step_no
											 WHERE  jsd.wo_id =@wo_id
											 AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id
											 AND jsd.seq_no =@seq_no
											 AND js.step_name='Set Destination')
								  BEGIN
									select 1 as output
									  PRINT '2. Destination silo is available'
								  END
								ELSE
								  BEGIN
								  select 2 as output
									  PRINT 'Destination Silo is not selected so unable to start the job'
								  END
							END
							IF( @avs = 1 and @avd is null  )
							BEGIN
								IF EXISTS(SELECT * from job_step_data jsd with (nolock)
											inner join job_step js with (nolock) on jsd.wo_id=js.wo_id
											and jsd.oper_id=js.oper_id
											and jsd.seq_no=js.seq_no
											and jsd.step_no=js.step_no
											 WHERE  jsd.wo_id =@wo_id
											 AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id
											 AND jsd.seq_no =@seq_no
											 AND js.step_name='Set Source')
								  BEGIN
									 select 3 as output
									  PRINT '2. Source silo is available'
								  END
								ELSE
								  BEGIN
									 select 4 as output
									  PRINT 'Source is not selected so unable to start the job'
								  END
							END		
							IF( @avs = 1 and @avd=1 )
							BEGIN

								IF EXISTS(SELECT * from job_step_data jsd with (nolock)
											inner join job_step js with (nolock) on jsd.wo_id=js.wo_id
											and jsd.oper_id=js.oper_id
											and jsd.seq_no=js.seq_no
											and jsd.step_no=js.step_no
											 WHERE  jsd.wo_id =@wo_id
											 AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id
											 AND jsd.seq_no =@seq_no
											 AND js.step_name='Set Destination') 
											 and 
											 exists(SELECT * from job_step_data jsd with (nolock)
											inner join job_step js with (nolock) on jsd.wo_id=js.wo_id
											and jsd.oper_id=js.oper_id
											and jsd.seq_no=js.seq_no
											and jsd.step_no=js.step_no
											 WHERE  jsd.wo_id =@wo_id
											 AND jsd.oper_id = @oper_id
											 AND jsd.seq_no =@seq_no
											 AND js.step_name='Set Source')
								  BEGIN
									  set @souAndDes =1
									  select 5 as output
									print 'Source and Destination are already mapped'
								  END
								ELSE
								  BEGIN
									  set @souAndDes=0
										select 6 as output
									  PRINT 'Source or Destination Silos are not selected so unable to start the job'
								  END
							END

			   		 
					  END
					ELSE
					  BEGIN
						 select 7 as output
					  END 
	END

if @type='Nameplate'
	BEGIN
					declare @item nvarchar(50),
					@ent_id int

					select @item=item_id,@ent_id=target_sched_ent_id  from job with (nolock)
					where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no

					BEGIN
						IF EXISTS(select * from ofi_nameplate_speed with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id and item_id=@item)
						BEGIn
								select 11 as output
								print 'in'
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								select 12 as output
								print 'Namplate Speed is not configured' 
						END
					END
					

	


	END
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_U_EI_inv_corr_wb
-- Description:  Updates wo with qty for inventory correction of weigh bridge
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-20			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Karthik     2022-10-06			Updated values for the SPs (sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd & sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec) parameters
-- 0.01.02  Karthik     2023-01-27			Refer to comments below on the specific date
-- 0.01.03	DS			2023-09-13			Changed the logic to update the correction qty,
-- 0.01.04	Lavkesh		2023-09-13			Modified @total_prod_qty as float as it was wrongly taken INT
-- 0.01.05	Lavkesh		2024-06-09			Added logic to correct inventory for bulk intake order
-- 0.01.06	Lavkesh		2024-06-10			Old logic for correction is changed, now it will add/reduce from all the avilable lot
-- 0.01.07	MC			2025-03-07			Added logic to take only final job of given wo for calculation
-- 0.01.08	MC			2025-04-03			Added verification if batch number from SAP is corresponding with batch number of the wo
-- 0.01.09	MC			2025-04-04			Complete or cancel all jobs related to workorder unless are in running state
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_EI_inv_corr_wb] @plant_code varchar(4),@sto varchar(10),@outbound_delv varchar(10),
@weigh_bridge_id int,@process_order varchar(40),@material_no varchar(40),@batch_no varchar(40),@qty float,
@uom varchar(10),@movement_type varchar(40),@inOrOut varchar(10) as
begin

SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare @wo_id varchar(40),@error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@user varchar(4000),@oper_id varchar(40)
	Declare @total_prod_qty float,@wo_state INT,@ent_id INT,@job_pos INT,@row_id INT ,@prod_info Varchar(4000),@qty_prod float,@processid nvarchar(100),@processtype nvarchar(100)
	Declare @seq_no INT32
	declare @seq_no1 int,@wo_qty float,@id_min int,@id_max int,@qty_left float,@qty_tobereduce float
	declare @oper_id1 varchar(40),@total_inv float,@batch_no1 nvarchar(50),@diff float
	DECLARE @shift_id int, @grade_cd int, @status_cd int, @good_prod int, @shift_start_utc datetime, @shift_start_local datetime, 
		@hour_start_utc datetime, @hour_start_local datetime, @last_edit_at datetime, @created_at_utc datetime, @created_at_local datetime

	  DECLARE @temp_01 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
		ent_id int,
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
		qty_left float,
		row_id int
	)
	DECLARE @temp_02 TABLE
	(
		oper_id nvarchar(40)
	)

	--- WO States (0 = Released, 1 = Started, 2 = Completed, 3 = Closed)

	BEGIN try
		print @wo_id
		IF @batch_no is null
			select @batch_no=lot_no from ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where wo_id=@process_order
		ELSE -- 0.01.08 verification if batch_no passed by SAP 
		BEGIN
			IF @batch_no not in (SELECT lot_no FROM ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where wo_id=@process_order)
				RAISERROR('batch_no passed from SAP is not matching with workored number',16,1);
		END

		
		SET @wo_id = @process_order
		SELECT @user = CURRENT_USER
		SELECT @total_prod_qty = sum(qty_prod),@ent_id = max(ent_id),@oper_id = max(oper_id), @seq_no1= max(seq_no) from item_prod with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and lot_no = @batch_no and item_id = @material_no
		SELECT @wo_state = state_cd,@processid=process_id,@wo_qty=req_qty from wo with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id
		SELECT @job_pos = max(job_pos),@seq_no = max(cur_seq_no) from job_exec with (nolock) where cur_wo_id = @wo_id and ent_id = @ent_id
		--SELECT @seq_no = cur_seq_no from job_exec where cur_wo_id = @wo_id and ent_id = @ent_id
		set @seq_no = case when @seq_no is null then @seq_no1 else @seq_no end
		--IF @total_prod_qty < @qty (KN 27/01/23 - Removed this condition as advised as part of defect D056)
		
		select  @seq_no1 = max(itp.seq_no),@oper_id1 = max(itp.oper_id),@total_prod_qty = sum(itp.qty_prod) from item_prod itp with(nolock) 
			inner join job with(nolock) on itp.wo_id = job.wo_id and itp.oper_id = job.oper_id and itp.seq_no= job.seq_no and job.final_job=1
			where itp.wo_id =@wo_id and itp.lot_no = @batch_no and itp.item_id =  @material_no

			--if(@total_prod_qty<@qty) 
			--- -ve & +ve both will be added into item prod
			begin
				set  @qty_prod =  round(@qty -@total_prod_qty,3)
			end 
			

		BEGIN
			BEGIN TRANSACTION
			
			print @qty_prod
			--SET @qty_prod = @qty - @total_prod_qty	(KN 27/01/23 - Removed this as advised as part of defect D056)

			--SET @qty_prod = @qty --(KN 27/01/23 - Added this as advised as part of defect D056)
			DECLARE @tmp DATETIME
			select @tmp = shift_start_local from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id

			-- 0.01.07 exclude operations with skipCorrFromSAP attribute
			--insert into @temp_01 select ip.wo_id,ip.ent_id,ip.oper_id,ip.qty_prod,ip.row_id from item_prod ip with(nolock) where ip.wo_id=@wo_id

			insert into @temp_02
			SELECT oper_id FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipInvCorrFromSAP' AND attr_grp = 7)
			AND attr_value='1'


			insert into @temp_01 select DISTINCT wo_id,ent_id,oper_id,qty_prod,row_id
			from item_prod with(nolock)
			where wo_id=@wo_id
			and oper_id not in (SELECT oper_id FROM @temp_02) --0.01.07 exclude operation with skip correction
			and lot_no=@batch_no --0.01.07 - exclude records with different batch number
			
			--and j.final_job=1

			select @total_prod_qty=sum(qty_left) from @temp_01;

			-- 0.01.07 update qty_prod for last operation with respecting for possible split jobs
			--update job set qty_prod=@qty where wo_id=@process_order
			
			WITH ratios AS (
			SELECT row_id, qty_prod, oper_id,
			CASE 
				WHEN (SELECT SUM(qty_prod) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @process_order AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @temp_02)) = 0 
				THEN 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seq_no) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @process_order AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @temp_02)) --0.01.07 - if there were no production on any job seq
				ELSE qty_prod / (SELECT SUM(qty_prod) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @process_order AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @temp_02)) 
			END AS ratio
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @process_order AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @temp_02)
			)
			UPDATE job SET qty_prod = @qty*ratio FROM ratios WHERE job.row_id=ratios.row_id

			IF @total_prod_qty-@qty>0
				BEGIN
				print 'prod'
				--Reduce from MES QTY
				set @qty_tobereduce= @total_prod_qty-@qty
				print @qty_tobereduce
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
				 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min
				 update item_prod set qty_prod=qty_prod-((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty),
				 qty_prod_erp=qty_prod-((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty)
				 where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
				ELSE IF @total_prod_qty-@qty<0
				BEGIN
				print 'prod else'
				--Add in MES Qty
				set @qty_tobereduce= @qty-@total_prod_qty
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
				 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min				 
				 update item_prod set qty_prod=qty_prod+((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty),
				 qty_prod_erp=qty_prod+((@qty_tobereduce*qty_prod)/@total_prod_qty)
				 where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
				set @error_msg='Updated Values for WO:' +@wo_id+' and operation name:'+@oper_id+' and lot:'+@batch_no+' : ' +CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @qty) 
				exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user
				Commit Transaction
			IF @wo_state < 2			-- If WO state is running, then run sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd (Param values advised by Sudhakar)--old logic
			BEGIN
				/*EXEC sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd @session_id = -1,@event_time_local = NULL,@user_id = @user,
				@ent_id = @ent_id,@job_pos = @job_pos,@qty_prod = @qty_prod,@reas_cd = NULL,@lot_no = NULL,
				@sublot_no = NULL,@to_ent_id = NULL,@item_id = NULL,@byproduct_bom_pos = NULL,@ext_ref = NULL,
				@apply_scaling_factor = 0,@genealogy_id = NULL,@segment_requirement_id = NULL,@segment_response_id = NULL,
				@comments = 'EI Inventory Correction',@spare1 = '',@spare2 = '',@spare3 = '',@spare4 = '',@check_privs = 1,@created_at_utc = NULL,
				@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@row_id = @row_id OUT,@prod_info = @prod_info OUT*/
				select top 1 @shift_id =shift_id, @grade_cd =grade_cd, @status_cd=status_cd, @good_prod=good_prod, @shift_start_utc=shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local =shift_start_local, 
				@hour_start_utc =hour_start_utc, @hour_start_local =hour_start_local, @last_edit_at =last_edit_at, @created_at_utc =created_at_utc, @created_at_local =created_at_local
				from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id order by created_at_local desc
				/*insert into item_prod(wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,item_id,lot_no,reas_cd,user_id,ent_id,shift_id,grade_cd,status_cd,good_prod,qty_prod,last_edit_by,shift_start_utc,shift_start_local,
				hour_start_utc,hour_start_local,last_edit_at,created_at_utc,created_at_local)
				values(@wo_id,@oper_id1,@seq_no1,@material_no,@batch_no,2,@user,@ent_id,@shift_id,@grade_cd,@status_cd,@good_prod,@qty_prod,@user,@shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local,
				@hour_start_utc,@hour_start_local,@last_edit_at,@created_at_utc,@created_at_local)*/
				END
				
			ELSE	
			BEGIN-- Else run sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec (Param values advised by Sudhakar)
				/*EXEC sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec @session_id = -1,@user_id = @user,@ent_id = @ent_id,
				@qty_prod = @qty_prod,@wo_id = @wo_id,@oper_id = @oper_id,@seq_no = @seq_no,@created_at_utc = NULL,
				@shift_start_local = null,@hour_start_local = NULL,@shift_id = NULL,@item_id = NULL,@reas_cd = NULL,
				@lot_no = NULL,@rm_lot_no = NULL,@sublot_no = NULL,@rm_sublot_no =NULL,@to_ent_id = NULL,
				@processed = 0,@byproduct = 0,@ext_ref = NULL,@move_status = 0,@genealogy_id = NULL,
				@event_id = NULL,@segment_requirement_id = NULL,@segment_response_id = NULL,@comments = 'EI Inventory Correction',
				@spare1 = '',@spare2 = '',@spare3 = '',@spare4 = '',@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@row_id = @row_id OUT*/
				select top 1 @shift_id =shift_id, @grade_cd =grade_cd, @status_cd=status_cd, @good_prod=good_prod, @shift_start_utc=shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local =shift_start_local, 
				@hour_start_utc =hour_start_utc, @hour_start_local =hour_start_local, @last_edit_at =last_edit_at, @created_at_utc =created_at_utc, @created_at_local =created_at_local
				from item_prod with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id order by created_at_local desc
				/*insert into item_prod(wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,item_id,lot_no,reas_cd,user_id,ent_id,shift_id,grade_cd,status_cd,good_prod,qty_prod,last_edit_by,shift_start_utc,shift_start_local,
				hour_start_utc,hour_start_local,last_edit_at,created_at_utc,created_at_local)
				values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@material_no,@batch_no,2,@user,@ent_id,@shift_id,@grade_cd,@status_cd,@good_prod,@qty_prod,@user,@shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local,
				@hour_start_utc,@hour_start_local,@last_edit_at,@created_at_utc,@created_at_local)*/
			END

			-----Logic to correct inventory for bulk intake order----
			select @processtype=attr_value from process_attr with(nolock)
			where process_id=@processid 
			and attr_id in (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='ProcessTypeForSUSelection' and attr_grp=8 )
			if(@processtype='Intake')
			BEGIN
			   delete from @temp_01
			   insert into @temp_01 select wo_id,ent_id,oper_id,qty_left,row_id from item_inv with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and lot_no=@batch_no
			   select @total_inv=sum(qty_left) from @temp_01
			    IF  @total_inv is null or @total_inv=0
				BEGIN
							  SET @error_msg = N'Inventory not avilable  in MES  for order  no:'+@process_order +' and operation name:'+@oper_id+' and lot no:'+@batch_no+''
							  exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user				  ;

							 -- THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
				 END

				IF @total_prod_qty-@qty>0
				BEGIN
					print 'inv'
				--Reduce from MES QTY
				set @qty_tobereduce= @total_prod_qty-@qty
				IF  @total_inv < @qty_tobereduce
				BEGIN
				--select @diff=@qty_tobereduce-@total_inv
							BEGIN TRANSACTION
							print 'update inv'
							delete item_inv  where wo_id=@process_order 
							
							Commit Transaction
							SET @error_msg = N'Insufficient inventory left for correction. current silo inventory is:'+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @total_inv)+'   for  operation name:'+@oper_id+' and lot no:'+@batch_no+' thus making it to 0 for order:'+@process_order
											  ;
								exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user
							 -- THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1

							-- RAISERROR(@error_msg,16,1) with nowait

							
				 END
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
			 	 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min
			  IF @total_inv>0 and @total_inv is not null
				 update item_inv set qty_left=qty_left-((@qty_tobereduce*qty_left)/@total_inv) where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
				ELSE IF @total_prod_qty-@qty<0
				BEGIN
				--Add in MES Qty
				--print 'inv else'
				set @qty_tobereduce= @qty-@total_prod_qty
				 SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
				 WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
				 BEGIN
				 select @qty_left=qty_left ,@row_id=row_id from @temp_01 where id=@id_min
				 if @total_inv>0 and @total_inv is not null
				 update item_inv set qty_left=qty_left+((@qty_tobereduce*qty_left)/@total_inv) where row_id=@row_id
				 set @id_min=@id_min+1
				 END
				END
			END

			--0.01.09 - verification the job status and close/cancel it if it isn't running
			--Cursor declaration
			DECLARE JobCursor CURSOR FOR
			SELECT DISTINCT j.row_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.state_cd, COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id=@wo_id and j.state_cd in (1,2,5)
			--open cursor through all jobs in wo_id
			OPEN JobCursor
			FETCH NEXT FROM JobCursor INTO
			@row_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @status_cd, @ent_id;

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				--complete job is is in stopped state
				IF @status_cd IS NOT NULL AND @status_cd in (5) AND @ent_id IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					exec sp_U_job_exec_EndJob
					@ent_id=@ent_id,
					@wo_id=@wo_id,
					@oper_id=@oper_id,
					@seq_no=@seq_no,
					@job_pos=NULL,
					@status_notes='Completed by inventory correction',
					@user_id=@user,
					@check_privs=1,
					@check_certs=1,
					@client_type=NULL,
					@no_propogation=NULL,
					@check_auto_job_start=NULL,
					@job_end_utc=NULL,
					@time_zone_bias_value=NULL

					exec sp_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation
					@wo_id=@wo_id,
					@oper_id=@oper_id,
					@seq_no=@seq_no,
					@old_silo_aut=NULL,
					@operation='Stop'

					set @error_msg='Due to inventory correction job has been complete for WO:' +@wo_id+' and operation name:'+@oper_id+' and sequence: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4),@seq_no) 
					exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user

				END
				--cancel job is is in released or new state
				ELSE IF @status_cd IS NOT NULL AND @status_cd in (1,2)
				BEGIN
					SET @error_msg=NULL

					exec sp_U_Job_Exec_ChangeJobStates
					@row_id=@row_id,
					@state_cd=7,
					@req_finish_time=NULL,
					@job_priority=NULL,
					@apply_to_all_jobs=0,
					@time_zone_bias_value=NULL,
					@warning_msg=@error_msg

					IF @error_msg IS NULL
						set @error_msg='Due to inventory correction job has been cancelled for WO:' +@wo_id+' and operation name:'+@oper_id+' and sequence: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4),@seq_no) 
					exec sp_i_ofi_inv_corr_audittrail @wo_id=@process_order,@lot_no=@batch_no, @qty_prod=@total_prod_qty,@qty_corr=@qty,@err_message=@error_msg,@user_name=@user

				END

				FETCH NEXT FROM JobCursor INTO
				@row_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @status_cd, @ent_id;
			END
			CLOSE JobCursor
			DEALLOCATE JobCursor


		--Commit Transaction
		END
		--ELSE					--(KN 27/01/23 - Removed this as advised as part of defect D056)
		--	BEGIN
		--		SET @error_msg =N'Error - sp_U_EI_inv_corr_wb - qty is not less than total production qty  ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16),-1);
		--		THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
		--	END

	End Try

    BEGIN catch
     IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

     SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
     RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
   END catch
end

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_ent_spec_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_ent_spec]
AFTER UPDATE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_ent_spec_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_ent_spec table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  20024  HD# 4414 Maintain oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--07/27/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 4883) Validate type of specification values
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/23/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@step_no		INT
	,@ent_id		INT
	,@spec_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@spec_value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@min_value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@max_value		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@data_type		INT
	,@V_Oper_Id      STRING40
	,@V_Spec_Ver_Id  STRING40
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32
	,@assoc_file		STRING254
	,@assoc_file_type	STRING20
	,@ftle				DATETIME

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL


	DECLARE oper_ent_spec_cursor CURSOR LOCAL for
	  SELECT b.process_id, b.oper_id, b.step_no, b.ent_id, b.ver_id, b.spec_id, spec.data_type, b.spec_value, b.min_value, b.max_value, b.assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(b.assoc_file)
	   FROM oper_ent_spec a, inserted b, spec spec
	    WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no
	      AND a.ent_id = b.ent_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id
	     AND b.spec_id = spec.spec_id
	OPEN oper_ent_spec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_spec_cursor INTO @process_id, @V_Oper_Id, @step_no, @ent_id, @V_Spec_Ver_Id, @spec_id,
				@data_type, @spec_value, @min_value, @max_value, @assoc_file, @assoc_file_type

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_ent_spec', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF (@data_type = 1) BEGIN
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@spec_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},spec_value', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@min_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},min_value', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
			IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@max_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},max_value', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND @assoc_file_type IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
                --update spec version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF (@use_GMT = 1) SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

                UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )
WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND ver_id = @V_Spec_Ver_Id

	  UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id

	  UPDATE oper_ent_spec SET assoc_file_type = @assoc_file_type, oper_ent_spec.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_ent_spec.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	  WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND step_no = @step_no AND ent_id = @ent_id
	        AND ver_id = @V_Spec_Ver_Id AND spec_id = @spec_id

	IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		  EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
				, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
				, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
	END

	END
	CLOSE oper_ent_spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_ent_spec_cursor

END

-- Name:		sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail
-- Description:To insert audit trail information in the corresponding table(s).
--	
-- Usage:Insert data in audit_trail, ofi_audit_trail_ext		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	DS				2022-07-20			Initial version.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail]
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@module_id             NVARCHAR(80)
  , @function_id           NVARCHAR(80)
  , @auditTrailParameters  ofi_audittrailparameters READONLY
  , @xmlDeletedRow         XML                       = NULL
  , @deletedRowSourceTable NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
  , @keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL/*store PO#*/
  , @keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL/*store Batch#*/
  , @keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL/*store item_id/ent_id/wo_id etc...*/
  , @keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL/*store attr_id*/
  , @keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
  , @keyField6             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
  , @origin                NVARCHAR(40)              = 'UI'
  , @user_id               NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
  , @activity              NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
  , @audit_category        NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL/*Warning, Info, Error*/
--  , @comments              NVARCHAR(254)             = NULL
 , @comments              NVARCHAR(max)             = NULL -- v1.5
 ,@replace_string			NVARCHAR(max)	=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	

	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value INT = 0;
	DECLARE @audit_local DATETIME
		  , @audit_utc   DATETIME
		  , @tz_temp     DATETIME;
	DECLARE @min_i INT;
	DECLARE @max_i INT;
	DECLARE @log_id INT;
	DECLARE @moduleId NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @sourceTable NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @sourceColumn NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @itemLabel NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @fieldValue NVARCHAR(1700);
	DECLARE @rowId INT;
	DECLARE @strErrorMessage AS NVARCHAR(1000);
	DECLARE @table_name NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @row_id INT;
	DECLARE @column_name NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @old_value NVARCHAR(2000);
	DECLARE @new_value NVARCHAR(2000);
	DECLARE @newValue NVARCHAR(1700);
	DECLARE @filter_value NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @source_value_filter NVARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(1000);
	DECLARE @delete_detail NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @change_type INT = 2;
	--DECLARE @org_comments nvarchar(254)  = ISNULL(@comments, '') ;
	DECLARE @org_comments nvarchar(max)  = ISNULL(@comments, '') ; -- v1.5

	/* 0 = delete; 1 = insert; 2 = update  */

	DECLARE @logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @module_id + '$' + @function_id;	--'from ' + @module_id + ' - ' + @function_id ;
	DECLARE @tt_audit_data TABLE
	(
		row_id              INT IDENTITY(0, 1) NOT NULL
	  , module_id           NVARCHAR(80)
	  , function_id         NVARCHAR(80)
	  , source_table        NVARCHAR(80)
	  , source_column       NVARCHAR(80)
	  , field_value         NVARCHAR(1700)
	  , source_row_id       INT
	  , source_value_filter NVARCHAR(80)
	);

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0);
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value;
	
	IF
		(@audit_local IS NULL
		)
	BEGIN
		SET @audit_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL);
	END
	--EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @audit_local, @tz_temp, @audit_utc OUTPUT ;
	IF(@user_id = '')
	BEGIN
		SET @strErrorMessage = N'ERROR - Error occurred during the execution of the SP sp_I_GMES_AuditTrail. UserId cannot be equal be blank = "' + @user_id + '".';
		THROW 51000, @strErrorMessage, 1;
	END;


	IF
		(@xmlDeletedRow IS NOT NULL
		)
	BEGIN

			SELECT TOP (1)
			@row_id = row_id
		FROM @auditTrailParameters;

		set @replace_string= CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), @xmlDeletedRow);
		set @replace_string=REPLACE(@replace_string,'<',' ');
		set @replace_string=REPLACE(@replace_string,'/>',' ');

		SELECT
			@change_type = 0
		  , @table_name = @deletedRowsourceTable
		  , @column_name = NULL
		  , @old_value = NULL
		  , @new_value = NULL
		  , @delete_detail =CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), @xmlDeletedRow)
		  ,@comments='Comments:'+@comments+' ,'+@replace_string;



				DECLARE @position INT = CHARINDEX('created_at_local', @comments);

			DECLARE @new_comments NVARCHAR(MAX) = LEFT(@comments, @position - 1);

			set @comments=@new_comments



		EXEC sp_I_Audit_Trail
			 @log_id OUTPUT
		   , @logged_at
		   , @user_id
		   , @change_type
		   , @table_name
		   , @row_id
		   , @column_name
		   , @old_value
		   , @new_value
		   , @audit_comments
		   , @delete_detail;

		UPDATE audit_trail
		SET
			origin = @origin
		WHERE
			log_id = @log_id;


		
		INSERT INTO ofi_audit_trail_ext
		(
			log_id
		  , keyField1
		  , keyField2
		  , keyField3
		  , keyField4
		  , module_id
		  , function_id
		  , spare1
		  , spare2
		  , spare3
		  , spare4
		  , spare5
		  , spare6
		  , audit_category
		  , activity
		  , comments
		  , created_at_utc
		  , created_at_local
		  , created_by
		)
		VALUES
		(
			   @log_id
			 , @keyField1
			 , @keyField2
			 , @keyField3
			 , @keyField4
			 , @module_id
			 , @function_id
			 , @keyField1
			 , @keyField2
			 , @keyField3
			 , @keyField4
			 , @keyField5
			 , @keyField6
			 , @audit_category
			 , @activity
			 , @comments
			 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
			 , @audit_local
			 , @user_id
		);

		RETURN;
	END;

	-- in case insertion/updation 
	INSERT INTO @tt_audit_data
	(
		module_id
	  , function_id
	  , source_table
	  , source_column
	  , field_value
	  , source_row_id
	  , source_value_filter
	)
	SELECT
		module_id
	  , function_id
	  , source_table
	  , source_column
	  , field_value
	  , p.row_id
	  , p.source_value_filter
	FROM ofi_audit_trail_cfg a WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN @auditTrailParameters p ON
		a.source_parameter = p.field_name
		AND a.module_id = @module_id
		--AND a.function_id = @function_id
		AND
		(
			a.source_value_filter = p.source_value_filter
			OR a.source_value_filter IS NULL
		);

	SELECT
		@min_i = MIN(row_id)
	  , @max_i = MAX(row_id)
	FROM @tt_audit_data;
	WHILE(@min_i <= @max_i)
	BEGIN
		SET @comments = @org_comments ;  --

		SELECT
			@sourceTable = source_table
		  , @sourceColumn = source_column
		  , @fieldValue = field_value
		  , @rowId = source_row_id
		  , @newValue = NULL
		  , @log_id = NULL
		  , @source_value_filter = source_value_filter
		FROM @tt_audit_data
		WHERE row_id = @min_i;

		-- Retrieves the last modification
		SELECT TOP 1
			@newValue = new_value
		  , @log_id = log_id
		FROM dbo.audit_trail WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE
			table_name = @sourceTable
			AND column_name = @sourceColumn
			AND row_id = @rowId
		ORDER BY
			logged_at DESC;
			
			
		IF
			(
				(
					@log_id IS NULL
					AND @fieldValue IS NOT NULL
				)			-- The row_id was never inserted in the audit trial table and the field mapping is NOT NULL
				OR (ISNULL(@newValue, '') <> ISNULL(@fieldValue, ''))
			)
		BEGIN
		
			-- Update is the default value
			SET @change_type = 2 --0 = delete; 1 = insert; 2 = update
			IF
				(@log_id IS NULL
				)
			BEGIN
				SET @change_type = 1;
			END -- insert
			SELECT
				@table_name = @sourceTable
			  , @row_id = @rowId
			  , @column_name = @sourceColumn
			  , @old_value = @newValue
			  , @new_value = @fieldValue
			  , @delete_detail = NULL;

			EXEC dbo.sp_I_Audit_Trail
				 @log_id OUTPUT
			   , @logged_at
			   , @user_id
			   , @change_type
			   , @table_name
			   , @row_id
			   , @column_name
			   , @old_value
			   , @new_value
			   , @audit_comments
			   , @delete_detail;

			-- set the origin field
			UPDATE audit_trail
			SET
				origin = @origin
			WHERE
				log_id = @log_id;
			
			IF(		UPPER(@activity) != 'ADD' 
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'UPLOAD TO SAP' 
				--AND UPPER(@activity) != 'EDIT' 
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'CREATE'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'LOGIN MES SYSTEM'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'LOGOUT MES SYSTEM' 
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'LOGIN FAILED'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'EDIT BATCH CONSUMPTION'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'EDIT BATCH PRODUCTION'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'ADD BATCH CONSUMPTION'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'ADD BATCH PRODUCTION'
				AND UPPER(@activity) != 'STATUS CHANGE'
				
				) BEGIN
		 
				SET @comments = ISNULL(@comments, '') + ' ' +  
							ISNULL(@column_name, '') +  ' field change.  ' + 
							CASE WHEN (ISNULL(@old_value, '') != '' AND ISNULL(@new_value, '') != '') THEN 
								'Old value: ' + ISNULL(@old_value, '') + ' -> New value: ' + ISNULL(@new_value, '')
							ELSE '' END ; 
							
			END ;

			INSERT INTO ofi_audit_trail_ext
			(
				log_id
			  , keyField1
			  , keyField2
			  , keyField3
			  , keyField4
			  , module_id
			  , function_id
			  , spare1
			  , spare2
			  , spare3
			  , spare4
			  , spare5
			  , spare6
			  --, source_value_filter
			  , audit_category
			  , activity
			  , comments
			  , created_at_utc
			  , created_at_local
			  , created_by
			)
			VALUES
			(
				   @log_id
				 , @keyField1
				 , @keyField2
				 , @keyField3
				 , @keyField4
				 , @module_id
				 , @function_id
				 , @keyField1
				 , @keyField2
				 , @keyField3
				 , @keyField4
				 , @keyField5
				 , @keyField6
				 --, @source_value_filter
				 , @audit_category
				 , @activity
				 , @comments
				 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
				 , @audit_local
				 , @user_id
			);

		END;

		SET @min_i = @min_i + 1;
	END;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Log_ByPeriod]
(@ent_id			INT32  ,
 @start_time_local		TDATETIME2  ,
 @end_time_local		TDATETIME2 )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	 Changes
-- 11/25/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0	 Calculates labor duration and converts into hh:mm:ss format for client apps
--					 Modified temp table duration int field to varchar(15) to store hh:mm:ss value
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal jain  1.6.0.22  Removed the temporary table, tuned the code, Oracle change
--                                       (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--07/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.19	Return shift_start_time in local time.
--02/08/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
--09/05/2007    AML         3.3.0   HD# 10081, DB Changes
--11/28/2009	Ajay		4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
--01/13/2010    SLR         4.0.0   Added fields for enhanced calculations
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- Set default values
BEGIN
DECLARE @start_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@end_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@util_start_utc	TDATETIME2

	IF (@start_time_local IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Determine the utc time
		SET @start_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @start_time_local, GETUTCDATE())

		--Determine the starting event at this time
		SELECT @util_start_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc <= @start_time_utc

		--Default to the start time, if there is no event prior to the start time.
		SET @start_time_utc = COALESCE(@util_start_utc, @start_time_utc)
	END
	ELSE SET @start_time_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120) --Default to the earliest date, so all utilization records will be returned

	IF (@end_time_local IS NOT NULL) SET @end_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @end_time_local, GETUTCDATE())
	ELSE SET @end_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()

-- Make the final selection including all the temporary table data and extra joins
SELECT	temptable.log_id,temptable.event_time_utc, temptable.event_time_local
	,	temptable.event_time_utc as event_time
	,	temptable.ent_id, ent.ent_name, ent.description, temptable.shift_id
	,	shift.shift_desc, temptable.shift_start_utc, temptable.shift_start_local
	,	temptable.shift_start_utc as shift_start
	,	temptable.state_cd, util_state.state_desc, util_state.color, temptable.reas_cd
	,	util_reas.reas_desc, util_reas.reas_grp_id, temptable.reas_pending, temptable.runtime
	,	temptable.downtime, temptable.setuptime, temptable.teardowntime, temptable.fixedtime
	,	temptable.vartime, temptable.failure
	--,       temptable.duration
	,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (temptable.duration/3600)) + ':' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (temptable.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
		   CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (temptable.duration%3600)%60) AS duration
	,       temptable.comments, util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
    	,   temptable.category1, temptable.category2, temptable.category3, temptable.category4
FROM util_log temptable WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.shift_id = shift.shift_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.state_cd = util_state.state_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON temptable.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas.reas_grp_id = util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
  WHERE temptable.ent_id = @ent_id
    AND temptable.event_time_utc >= @start_time_utc
    AND temptable.event_time_utc < @end_time_utc
  ORDER BY temptable.ent_id, temptable.event_time_utc DESC
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_valSteps -
-- Description:	   To validate job steps
--
-- Usage:			 To validate job steps
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Shuvam SB		2022-10-10					Validate job steps
-- 0.02.00			AKM				2024-02-02					Coding best practice
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_valSteps]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50),
	@oper_id nvarchar(50),
	@seq_no int
AS
declare  @useLastLot int=0
declare @lotDetails as table (item_id STRING40, item_desc STRING80, def_lot_no  STRING40_NULL,last_used_lot STRING40_NULL, attr_value STRING1700_NULL )



BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
		insert into @lotDetails
		exec [dbo].[sp_S_OFI_Pack_Additives] 
		   @wo_id
		  ,@oper_id
		  ,@seq_no
		  ,@useLastLot

	if exists(select 1 from @lotDetails) -- if required to set the lot then validate else leave it
		begin

			select jd.state_cd,j.step_name from job_step(nolock) j
			left join job_step_data(nolock) jd on jd.step_no=j.step_no
			where
			(jd.state_cd!=4 or jd.state_cd is null)
			and j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no
	
		end
	else
		begin

			select jd.state_cd,j.step_name from job_step(nolock) j
			left join job_step_data(nolock) jd on jd.step_no=j.step_no
			where
			(jd.state_cd!=4 or jd.state_cd is null) and step_name <> 'Set Lot'
			and j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no

		end 
END

  (@ent_id int ,
   @dept_id nvarchar(40) ,

   @last_edit_at datetime OUT)

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod]
(@ent_id					INT32 = NULL
,@durationsecout        int32 out
,@filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
,@shift_id	  			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@min_duration			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@max_duration			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@reas_cd				INT32_NULL = NULL
,@state_cd				INT32_NULL = NULL
,@reas_pending			LOGICAL = NULL --default starts here till end
,@runtime				LOGICAL = NULL
,@downtime				LOGICAL = NULL
,@comments		  		STRING4000_NULL = NULL
,@raw_reas_cd         	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@last_n_events			INT32 = NULL
,@wocheck               INT32=null
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - [sp_SA_ofi_ul_GetUtilByTimePeriod]	
-- Description	      -	This sp is derived from STD SP-sp_SA_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod in the order to retrieve utilization records based on the supplied filters
-- Author			  -	Siva
-- Usage 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version		Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)			Change description  
-- 0.01.00		Siva		2022-12-19					Initial version.  
-- 0.01.01		DS			2024-02-07					Updated the header comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@start				TDATETIME2
		,@end				TDATETIME2
		,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = GETUTCDATE()
		,@util_start_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
		,@SQL1				NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@SQL2				NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@whereClause			NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@ret				INT32--,@downtime1 NVARCHAR(80)
		--,@durationSecout              INT32 
		

BEGIN
	EXEC @ret = sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes @ent_id=@ent_id, @filter_time_unit=@filter_time_unit
		, @filter_start_time=@filter_start_time, @filter_end_time=@filter_end_time
		, @start_time_utc=@start OUTPUT, @end_time_utc=@end OUTPUT

	--set @downtime1='Unknown Downtime'
	--,ul.reas_pending, ul.runtime, ul.downtime, ul.setuptime, ul.teardowntime, ul.fixedtime code changes on 5thMay2023
	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	--Get the starting event from the start time
	SELECT @util_start_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc <= @start

	SET @util_start_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@util_start_event_time_utc, @start)

	SET @last_n_events = COALESCE(@last_n_events, 10000000)

	SET @SQL1 = N' SELECT TOP(@last_n_events) @durationsec=sum(u.duration)
	FROM (
	SELECT ul.log_id
    ,CASE WHEN @start IS NULL THEN ul.event_time_utc
			  WHEN (ul.event_time_utc < @start) THEN @start
	  ELSE ul.event_time_utc
     END AS event_time_utc
    ,CASE WHEN @start IS NULL THEN ul.event_time_local
			  WHEN (ul.event_time_utc < @start) THEN dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(ul.ent_id, @start)
	  ELSE ul.event_time_local
     END AS event_time_local
		,ul.ent_id
		,e.ent_name
		,ul.shift_id, shift.shift_desc
		,ul.shift_start_utc
		,ul.shift_start_local
		,ul.shift_start_utc as shift_start
		,ul.state_cd
		,us.state_desc, us.color, ul.reas_cd
		,ur.reas_desc
		,CASE WHEN ul.log_id = ue.cur_log_id THEN
			CASE WHEN ur.max_duration IS NOT NULL AND @current_time_utc > DATEADD(ss, ur.max_duration, ul.event_time_utc) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		      ELSE
			CASE WHEN ur.max_duration IS NOT NULL AND ul.duration > ur.max_duration THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		      END AS ''severe''
		, ur.standard_time
		,ul.reas_pending, ul.runtime, ul.downtime, ul.setuptime, ul.teardowntime, ul.fixedtime
		,ul.vartime, ul.failure
    ,ul.duration - CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < @start THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ul.event_time_utc, @start) ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > @end THEN DATEDIFF(SS, @end, ul.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END
     AS duration
    ,ul.event_time_utc as act_event_time_utc
    ,ul.event_time_local as act_event_time_local
    ,ul.event_time_utc as act_event_time
    ,ul.duration as act_duration
		,ul.comments
		,ul.raw_reas_cd, jull.wo_id, jull.oper_id, jull.seq_no, ul.category1, ul.category2, ul.category3, ul.category4
		,ul.last_edit_comment, ul.last_edit_by, ul.last_edit_at,ur.reas_grp_id, urg.reas_grp_desc,ul.event_end_time_utc '

	SET @SQL2 = 'FROM util_log ul WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.shift_id = shift.shift_id
	INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
	INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
	INNER JOIN util_reas_grp urg WITH (NOLOCK) ON ur.reas_grp_id = urg.reas_grp_id
	INNER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = ue.ent_id
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no
				FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jh.ent_id = ul.ent_id
				  AND jh.job_start_utc < ul.event_end_time_utc
				  AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > ul.event_time_utc
		) jull
	'

	SET @whereClause = ''

	IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL ) SET @whereClause = 'ul.ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id)

	IF (@shift_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.shift_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @shift_id)
	END

	IF (@util_start_event_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @end IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' (ul.event_time_utc BETWEEN @util_start_event_time_utc AND @end) '
	END

	IF (@reas_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.reas_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @reas_cd)
	END

	IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.state_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @state_cd)
	END

	IF (@reas_pending IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.reas_pending=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @reas_pending)
	END

	IF (@runtime IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.runtime=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @runtime)
	END

	IF (@downtime IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.downtime=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @downtime)
	END

	IF (@comments IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.comments LIKE N' + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@comments)
	END

	IF (@raw_reas_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'ul.raw_reas_cd LIKE N' + dbo.fn_ReplaceQuoteAndAddQuote(@raw_reas_cd)
	END

	IF (@wocheck IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'jull.wo_id is not null' 
	END

	IF (@whereclause <> '') SET @whereclause = ' WHERE ' + @whereClause

	SET @whereclause = @whereClause + ') u '

	SET @SQL1 = @SQL1 + @SQL2 + @whereClause

	SET @whereClause = ''

	IF (@min_duration IS NOT NULL ) SET @whereClause = 'u.duration>=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @min_duration)

	IF (@max_duration IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@whereClause <> '' ) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND '
		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + 'u.duration<=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @max_duration)
	END
	
	IF (@whereclause <> '') SET @whereclause = ' WHERE ' + @whereclause
	
	SET @SQL1 = @SQL1 + @whereclause --+ ' ORDER BY u.ent_id, u.event_time_utc DESC'
	print @sql1
	EXEC sp_executesql @SQL1, N'@util_start_event_time_utc DATETIME2, @start DATETIME2, @end DATETIME2
				, @current_time_utc DATETIME2, @last_n_events INT,@durationSec int out'
			, @util_start_event_time_utc, @start, @end
			, @current_time_utc, @last_n_events,@durationSecout out
   select @durationSecout=isnull(@durationsecout,0)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_GetSchedEntsForQueue]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-- sp_SA_Job_GetSchedEntsForQueue
-- Description       		-- Get all Schedulable Entities
-- Author	 		-- Raghu
-- Date Created      		-- 01/18/2006
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 3.1.8
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--02/09/2006	Raghu		3.1.10	Included can_run_jobs parameter to the resultset.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		can_sched_jobs BIT, can_run_jobs BIT, can_store BIT, parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))

	DECLARE  @child_level INT
		,@ent_id       INT
		,@root_ent_id  INT

	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs, can_store, parent_ent_id, child_level)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_store, NULL, @child_level FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @child_level = 2

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
/*			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, description, can_sched_jobs, parent_ent_id, child_level)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description, e.can_sched_jobs, el.parent_ent_id, @child_level
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
--			INNER JOIN ent elp WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = elp.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)*/
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_sched_jobs, can_run_jobs, can_store, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_sched_jobs, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_store, el.parent_ent_id, @child_level
				,x.ent_tree
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END

/*		SET @child_level = @child_level - 1
		WHILE (@child_level > 0) BEGIN
			DELETE FROM @entities
			WHERE (child_level = @child_level AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) AND (can_sched_jobs = 0
			  AND  ent_id NOT IN (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level + 1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id))
			SET @child_level = @child_level - 1

		END*/

	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

	SELECT el.root_ent_id, el.ent_id, el.ent_name, el.can_sched_jobs, el.can_run_jobs, el.can_store, el.parent_ent_id,
		e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.child_level, el.ent_tree FROM @entities el
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
	ORDER BY el.child_level, e.ent_name, el.ent_name
END

	@oper_id nvarchar(100),
	@seq_no int,

AS
BEGIN

	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure heredeclare @e int,
				declare @countLine as int,
				@countSegment as int,
				@e int



				select @countLine=COUNT(e.ent_id) from ent e 
				inner join ent_attr ea on ea.ent_id =e.ent_id
				inner join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_ID
				where e.parent_ent_id=@init_ent_id and ea.attr_value='Line'

				if(@countLine=1)
				BEGIN

						select @e=e.ent_id from ent e 
						inner join ent_attr ea on ea.ent_id =e.ent_id
						inner join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_ID
						where e.parent_ent_id=@init_ent_id and ea.attr_value='Line'

						select @countSegment=COUNT(e.ent_id) from ent e 
						inner join ent_attr ea on ea.ent_id =e.ent_id
						inner join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_ID
						where e.parent_ent_id=@e and ea.attr_value='Segment'
		
				END
				if(@countSegment=1)
				BEGIN
					select @e=e.ent_id from ent e 
						inner join ent_attr ea on ea.ent_id =e.ent_id
						inner join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_ID
						where e.parent_ent_id=@e and ea.attr_value='Segment'


					update job set target_sched_ent_id=@e where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no --seq_no (KN - 18/01/23 - This should be @seq_no and not just seq_no, I presume)
				END
				

			
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_Logn_GetUtilExecEnts]
(
	@session_id				INT32
,	@user_id				STRING80
,	@start_time				TDATETIME = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_Logn_GetUtilExecEnts
-- Description					- Gets a list of util_exec entities to which the user has logged in.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 12/20/2006
-- Version						- 3.1.2.26
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
--05/16/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserStory: 711571 - As Lenka, I want the stored procedures related to utilization to use util_history table rather than util_log table (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @current_utils	TABLE(ent_id INT PRIMARY KEY, current_util FLOAT)

DECLARE @util_ent_id	INT32
	,@current_util	FLOAT
BEGIN

	--Default the time zone bias value to 0
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	--Adjust the start time if supplied.
	IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time)

	DECLARE utils_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT util_exec.ent_id
	FROM util_exec util_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE	el.session_id = @session_id
		AND el.user_id = @user_id
		--If the start time is not specified, then default to all entities.
	  AND	(el.start_time > @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL)

	OPEN utils_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM utils_cursor INTO @util_ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Default the KPIs to null
		SELECT @current_util = NULL

		-- Call the SP to return the KPI values
		EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetValue @in_session_id=-1, @in_ent_id=@util_ent_id, @in_kpi_type=2
			, @in_filter_time_unit=1, @in_filter_start_time=1, @in_filter_end_time=0
			, @availability=@current_util OUTPUT

		--Insert the record into the temporary table
		INSERT INTO @current_utils (ent_id, current_util) VALUES (@util_ent_id, @current_util)
	END
	CLOSE utils_cursor
	DEALLOCATE utils_cursor

	SELECT	util_exec.ent_id
		,	ent.ent_name
		,	util_exec.cur_state_cd
		,	util_state.state_desc
		,	util_state.color
		,	util_exec.cur_reas_cd
		,	util_reas.reas_desc
		,	util_exec.cur_reas_start_utc
		,	util_exec.cur_reas_start_local
		,	util_exec.cur_raw_reas_cd
		,	util_exec.reas_reqd
		,	util_exec.cur_log_id
		,	util_exec.target_util
		,	curr_util.current_util
		,	util_exec.jobstart_reas_cd
		,	util_reas1.reas_desc as jobstart_reas_desc
		,	util_exec.jobend_reas_cd
		,	util_reas2.reas_desc as jobend_reas_desc
		,	util_exec.shift_start_reas_cd
		,	util_reas4.reas_desc as shift_start_reas_desc
		,	util_exec.shift_end_reas_cd
		,	util_reas5.reas_desc as shift_end_reas_desc
		,	util_exec.unkn_stop_reas_cd
		,	util_reas3.reas_desc as unkn_stop_reas_desc
		,	util_exec.spare1
		,	util_exec.spare2
		,	util_exec.spare3
		,	util_exec.spare4
		,	'cur_reas_duration' = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (util_dur.duration/3600)) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (util_dur.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (util_dur.duration%3600)%60)
		,	util_exec.last_edit_comment
		,	util_exec.last_edit_by
		,	util_exec.last_edit_at
	FROM util_exec util_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.cur_state_cd = util_state.state_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.cur_reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.jobstart_reas_cd = util_reas1.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.jobend_reas_cd = util_reas2.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.unkn_stop_reas_cd = util_reas3.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas4 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.shift_start_reas_cd = util_reas4.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_exec.shift_end_reas_cd = util_reas5.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN @current_utils curr_util ON util_exec.ent_id = curr_util.ent_id
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT vuh.duration
				FROM vw_util_history_times vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE vuh.ent_id = util_exec.ent_id
				AND vuh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = util_exec.ent_id)) util_dur
	WHERE	el.session_id = @session_id
		AND el.user_id = @user_id
	--If the start time is not specified, then default to all entities.
		AND	(el.start_time > @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL)
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_IRG_Ent_Link_Get_Reasons]
(@ent_id int,
 @item_class_id nvarchar(40),
 @reas_grp_type int )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver      	Changes
-- 12/19/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	Input parameter @item_class_id should be treated as item_id
--					Implemented filtering on reas_grp_type when passed. Results all rows when no rows exist
--07/08/2003	Raghu		1.7.0	Included @@rowcount in the while clause to do only if any rows are found
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @parent_ent_id integer
IF (@reas_grp_type = -1) SET @reas_grp_type = NULL
-- create the IN TABLE FOR THE START_DAY
CREATE TABLE #Ent_IDs (ent_id int)
SET NOCOUNT ON
-- put ent_ids in the temp table, start from the current and go all the way upto the top level
SET @parent_ent_id = @ent_id
WHILE (@parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL)  AND (@@ROWCOUNT > 0)
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #Ent_IDs VALUES (@parent_ent_id)
	SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @parent_ent_id
END
SET NOCOUNT OFF
--SELECT * FROM #Ent_IDs
-- Select all reasons for all ent_ids in the #ent_ids table
IF EXISTS (
	SELECT  irg.reas_grp_id, irg.reas_grp_desc, irg.reas_grp_type
			, ir.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc
	FROM  item_reas_grp irg, item_reas_grp_ent_link irgel, item_reas ir
	WHERE irgel.ent_id IN (SELECT * FROM #Ent_IDs)
		AND irgel.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
		AND irg.reas_grp_id = ir.reas_grp_id
		AND (irg.reas_grp_type = @reas_grp_type OR @reas_grp_type IS NULL)
	UNION -- combine these reasons with the item class reasons,
	SELECT  irg.reas_grp_id, irg.reas_grp_desc, irg.reas_grp_type
		, ir.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc
	FROM  item_reas_grp irg, item_reas_grp_class_link irgcl, item_reas ir
	WHERE irgcl.item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM item WHERE item_id = @item_class_id)
		AND irgcl.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
		AND irgcl.reas_grp_id = ir.reas_grp_id
		AND (irg.reas_grp_type = @reas_grp_type OR @reas_grp_type IS NULL)
)
	SELECT x.reas_grp_id, x.reas_grp_desc, x.reas_grp_type, x.reas_cd, x.reas_desc FROM
	(SELECT  irg.reas_grp_id, irg.reas_grp_desc, irg.reas_grp_type
			, ir.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc
	FROM  item_reas_grp irg, item_reas_grp_ent_link irgel, item_reas ir
	WHERE irgel.ent_id IN (SELECT * FROM #Ent_IDs)
		AND irgel.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
		AND irg.reas_grp_id = ir.reas_grp_id
		AND (irg.reas_grp_type = @reas_grp_type OR @reas_grp_type IS NULL)
	UNION -- combine these reasons with the item class reasons,
	--if item_class_id is passed null, the select bellow will return an empty recordset
	--   which when combined with the result of the SELECT above, will carry the total records
	SELECT  irg.reas_grp_id, irg.reas_grp_desc, irg.reas_grp_type
		, ir.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc
	FROM  item_reas_grp irg, item_reas_grp_class_link irgcl, item_reas ir
	WHERE irgcl.item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM item WHERE item_id = @item_class_id)
		AND irgcl.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
		AND irgcl.reas_grp_id = ir.reas_grp_id
		AND (irg.reas_grp_type = @reas_grp_type OR @reas_grp_type IS NULL)
	)  X
	ORDER BY x.reas_grp_id
ELSE
	SELECT x.reas_grp_id, x.reas_grp_desc, x.reas_grp_type, x.reas_cd, x.reas_desc FROM
	(SELECT irg.reas_grp_id, irg.reas_grp_desc, irg.reas_grp_type,
		ir.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc
	FROM item_reas_grp irg, item_reas ir
	WHERE ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
	     AND (irg.reas_grp_type = @reas_grp_type OR @reas_grp_type IS NULL)
	) X
	ORDER BY x.reas_grp_id
DROP TABLE #Ent_IDs
