CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_yield_data]
AS
SELECT job_bom.wo_id,
       wo.wo_desc,
       job_bom.oper_id,
       job_bom.seq_no,
       job.act_start_time_utc,
       job.act_start_time_local,
       job.act_finish_time_utc,
       job.act_finish_time_local,
       job.run_ent_id,
       ent.ent_name,
       job_bom.bom_pos,
       job_bom.item_id,
       item.item_desc,
       item.num_decimals,
       uom.abbreviation units,
       job_bom.qty_per_parent_item,
       ISNULL(ipgb.qty_prod_good, 0) qty_prod_good,
       ISNULL(ipgb.qty_prod_bad, 0) qty_prod_bad,
       ISNULL(icgb.qty_cons_good, 0) qty_cons_good,
       ISNULL(icgb.qty_cons_bad, 0) qty_cons_bad,
       CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos <> 0
            THEN job_bom.bom_pos + 100
            ELSE NULL
            END bom_sort,
      (SELECT item_id
       FROM job_bom jb
       WHERE jb.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND
             jb.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND
             jb.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND
             jb.bom_pos = 0) primary_item,
       item_prod.shift_start_utc,
       item_prod.shift_start_local
FROM job_bom job_bom
INNER JOIN job job ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
                      job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
                      job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
INNER JOIN wo wo ON job.wo_id = wo.wo_id
INNER JOIN ent ent ON job.run_ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN item item ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN uom uom ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT item_prod.wo_id,
                        item_prod.oper_id,
                        item_prod.seq_no,
                        item_prod.item_id,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN item_prod.good_prod =
                                      1
                                 THEN qty_prod
                                 ELSE 0
                                 END) qty_prod_good,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN item_prod.good_prod =
                                      0
                                 THEN qty_prod
                                 ELSE 0
                                 END) qty_prod_bad
                 FROM item_prod item_prod
                 GROUP BY item_prod.wo_id,
                          item_prod.oper_id,
                          item_prod.seq_no,
                          item_prod.item_id) ipgb
   ON ipgb.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND
      ipgb.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND
      ipgb.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND
      ipgb.item_id = job_bom.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT item_cons.wo_id,
                        item_cons.oper_id,
                        item_cons.seq_no,
                        item_cons.item_id,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN
                               item_cons.item_scrapped = 0
                                 THEN qty_cons
                                 ELSE 0
                                 END) qty_cons_good,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN
                               item_cons.item_scrapped = 1
                                 THEN qty_cons
                                 ELSE 0
                                 END) qty_cons_bad
                 FROM item_cons item_cons
                 GROUP BY item_cons.wo_id,
                          item_cons.oper_id,
                          item_cons.seq_no,
                          item_cons.item_id) icgb
   ON icgb.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND
      icgb.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND
      icgb.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND
      icgb.item_id = job_bom.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local FROM item_prod) item_prod ON
   item_prod.wo_id = job.wo_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Log_GetEditData]
(
	@log_id int
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Util_Log_GetEditData
-- Description	      - This method takes a util log ID and returns the utilization data for that log entry and the log
--						entry immediately before and immediately after the specified entry.
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -	07/20/2011
-- Version			  - 4.0.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		 Ver		Changes
-- 07/19/2013       srinivasa tentu  4.6        Added new columns(ent_id,event_time_utc,shift_start_utc,last_edit_at) to select statement
-- 07/30/2013       Adam Haskell     4.6        Added new columns(shift_desc, state_desc, reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc) to select statement
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @event_time_utc		DATETIME
			,@ent_id			INT
			,@prev_event_time_utc	DATETIME
			,@next_event_time_utc	DATETIME

		SELECT @ent_id = uh.ent_id, @event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.log_id = @log_id

		SELECT @prev_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc < @event_time_utc

		SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(uh.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc > @event_time_utc

		SELECT util_log.log_id,
		       util_log.event_time_utc,
		       util_log.event_time_local,
		       util_log.ent_id,
		       util_log.shift_id,
		       shift.shift_desc,
		       util_log.shift_start_utc,
		       util_log.shift_start_local,
		       util_state.state_cd,
		       util_state.state_desc,
		       util_state.color,
		       util_reas.reas_cd,
		       util_reas.reas_desc,
		       util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id,
		       util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc,
		       util_log.reas_pending,
		       util_log.raw_reas_cd,
		       util_log.duration,
		       util_log.comments,
		       util_log.last_edit_at
		FROM util_log with (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas with (NOLOCK) ON util_reas.reas_cd = util_log.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp with (NOLOCK) ON util_reas.reas_grp_id = util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state with (NOLOCK) ON util_state.state_cd = util_reas.state_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN shift with (NOLOCK) ON util_log.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		WHERE util_log.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND (util_log.event_time_utc = @prev_event_time_utc
		  	OR util_log.event_time_utc = @event_time_utc OR util_log.event_time_utc = @next_event_time_utc)
	ORDER BY util_log.event_time_utc
END

-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_Waste_last_declared_at -
-- Description:		 Get the the date for shift start and waste declared
--
-- Usage:			 To validate job steps
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			MP				2023-03-22					Initial version
-- 0.02.00			AKM				2024-02-05					Coding best practice
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Waste_last_declared_at] 
(@ent_id int,
 @reas_cd int)

AS


BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE
  @declared_on_utc datetime,
  @shift_start_utc datetime



  SELECT TOP 1
    @declared_on_utc = declared_on_utc
  FROM ofi_Waste WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd
  ORDER BY declared_on_utc DESC


  SELECT TOP 1
    @shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc
  FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
  ORDER BY row_id DESC


  SELECT
    @declared_on_utc AS declared_on_utc,
    @shift_start_utc AS shift_start_utc


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_StartStep]
(
		@session_id				INT32
	,	@user_id				STRING40
	,	@ent_id					INT32
	,	@job_pos				INT32 = 0
	,	@step_no				INT32
	,	@lot_no					STRING40
	,	@sublot_no				STRING40
	,	@state_cd				INT32 = NULL
	,	@check_cert				LOGICAL = NULL
	,	@labor_option			LOGICAL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      	- sp_U_Job_Step_StartStep
-- Description	      	- Start a Step
-- Author	      		-
-- Date Created	      	-
-- Version	      		- 1.6.0.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 09/19/2002		Raghu			1.4			Added new Tags for FC related to Steps and BOMItemCurrentSteps
-- 10/22/2002		Tony			1.5.0		Changed Tag output values to read from job_bom not job_bom_exec
-- 10/26/2002		Tony			1.5.0		Include job_pos as parameter and use it where relevant
-- 12/03/2002		Raghu			1.5.0		(HD# 1300) Changed Idle to check for Null
-- 01/08/2003		Rohit			1.5.0		Added string Id reference to the err message.
-- 02/07/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		(HD# 1757) Log step_no in util_log when step is started or ended
-- 04/07/2003		Raghu			1.6.0		Update FC Tags only if tags are exposed
-- 04/10/2003		Raghu			1.6.0		Update job_exec.cur_step_no when the step starts. job_exec.cur_step_no will
--												have the last step started
-- 04/10/2003		Raghu			1.6.0		Included 'With NOLOCK' hint in FC Update statements
-- 05/20/2003		Raghu			1.6.8		Code mods for handling Superseded steps
-- 06/06/2003     	Sheetal Jain    1.6.8  		Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 11/20/2003		Raghu			2.0.0.11	(HD# 4106) Default lot_no to "-" if NULL as null lot_no is not allowed in
--												job_step_data
-- 12/03/2003		Raghu			2.0.13		(HD# 4135) Spec download for MinValue and MaxValues supported - FC Tags
-- 06/16/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Included NULL params for last_edit_comment while calling sp_I_Job_Step_Data and
--												sp_U_Job_Step_Data
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/03/2006		Raghu			3.1.7		HD# 7189,  Part of the problem; search for step_no in the where clause was not
--												included while searching for records in the job_step_data table.
-- 01/24/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 05/15/2007   	Raghu       	3.2.12  	HD# 9845, Modifications to steps methods for serialization
-- 01/10/2008		Raghu			3.4			L00073693; Starting a step fails in Operator.
-- 02/01/2008		Raghu			3.4			L00074508; Std Tags: The incorrect value is set for the min_qty_per_parent_item
--08/24/2008    Raghu       3.5.  L00075704; GE - Job Based Serialization - provide the ability to turn off item serialization at the work order level. Hotfix Request ID 887
--05/10/2011		Praveen 		4.0 SP1 	Modified for CR116974.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@cur_wo_id			STRING40,
			@cur_oper_id		STRING40,
			@cur_seq_no			INT32,
			@cur_step_no		INT32,
			@return				INT32,
			@step_grp_id		INT32,
			@step_seq			INT32,
			@istepcount			INT32,
			@cur_state_cd		INT32,
			@process_id			STRING40,
			@item_id			STRING40,
			@cur_datetime		TDATETIME,
			@start_time 		TDATETIME,
			@last_edit_at		TDATETIME,
			@row_id				INT32,
			@run_ent_id 		INT32,
			@serial_no_lvl		INT32,
			@inv_lot_no			STRING80,
			@inv_sublot_no		STRING80,
			@cur_datetime_utc	TDATETIME,
			@cur_datetime_tz	INT32,
			@tz_temp			INT32,
			@override_serialization	BIT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	IF @state_cd IS NULL SET @state_cd = 3
	IF @check_cert IS NULL SET @check_cert = 0
	IF @labor_option IS NULL SET @labor_option = 0
	IF @job_pos IS NULL SET @job_pos = 0

	SELECT	@cur_wo_id = job_exec.cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = job_exec.cur_oper_id,
			@cur_seq_no = job_exec.cur_seq_no, @cur_step_no = job_exec.cur_step_no
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id and job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos

-- 10/26/2002    Tony     1.5.0     Include job_pos in WHERE clause
	-- Proceed only when Step is defined, else throw the error.
	IF  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM job_step
			WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
			   AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
			   AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			   AND step_no = @step_no) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Step is not defined{3166}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END
--	if (@state_cd {> 3 and @state_cd {> 8) BEGIN
--		RAISERROR('Cannot Start a Step mode other than Running or Bypassed', 16, 1, @return)
--		return -1
--	end
	--Check that a job IS already running on this entity.cur_oper_id <> "Idle"
	IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL OR @cur_oper_id IS NULL) OR (@cur_wo_id =  '' AND @cur_oper_id = '') BEGIN
	   	RAISERROR('Cant Start the Step as there is no job currently running on this entity{3167}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END
	--Check certification of this user against Operation Step.
	IF @check_cert = 1 BEGIN
		--Get current wo_id from job_exec. For this wo_id, get process_id and item_id from wo
		--check this with Tony
		SELECT @process_id = process_id, @item_id = item_id
		FROM wo
		WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_CertStartAllowed @user_id, @process_id, @cur_oper_id, @step_no, @item_id, @time_zone_bias_value
		IF @return <> 0 BEGIN
--	   		RAISERROR('This user is not allowed to start the step: %d', 16, 1, @return)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	--Default the current date and time based on the client local region. Get all 3 values
	SET @cur_datetime_utc = NULL
	SET @cur_datetime = NULL
	SET @cur_datetime_tz = NULL
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @cur_datetime_utc OUTPUT, @cur_datetime OUTPUT, @cur_datetime_tz OUTPUT

	--SELECT @lot_no = COALESCE(@lot_no, '-'), @sublot_no = COALESCE(@sublot_no, '-')

	--Check if this Step and Lot combination has been started previously or not.
	--Read state_cd from job_step_data table for given input params - no row means never been started before.
	--Verify whether the step has already started.
	SET @row_id = NULL

	SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_state_cd = jsd.state_cd, @start_time = jsd.act_start_time_local
	FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jsd.row_id = (SELECT MAX(row_id) FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
                            WHERE jsd.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
                              AND jsd.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
                              AND jsd.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
                              AND jsd.step_no = @step_no
                              AND (jsd.lot_no = @lot_no OR (jsd.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
                              AND (jsd.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (jsd.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
                              AND jsd.state_cd <> 9)

	IF (@start_time IS NOT NULL) BEGIN -- Modified for CR116974
	--There step has already started
		--If it HAS been started before then check that the existing state_cd = COMPLETED or BYPASSED.
		IF (@cur_state_cd <> 4 AND @cur_state_cd <> 8 AND @cur_state_cd <> 9) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Step is already started: %d{3168}', 16, 1, @return)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF (@state_cd IS NOT NULL) SET @cur_state_cd = @state_cd

		--A valid job step data record is found. Update the existing record.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Step_Data @row_id=@row_id, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
			@step_no=@step_no, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @state_cd=@state_cd,
			@act_start_time_local=@cur_datetime,@act_start_time_tz=@cur_datetime_tz, @act_finish_time_local=NULL,@act_finish_time_tz=NULL, @step_data=NULL, @step_data_time_local=NULL,
			@step_data_time_tz=NULL,@start_user_id=@user_id, @finish_user_id=NULL, @data_user_id=NULL, @form_done=0,
			@spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL,
			@last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	ELSE
		--The step has not started, because there was no entry in the job_step_data table.
		EXEC sp_I_Job_Step_Data @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @step_no=@step_no,
			@lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @state_cd=@state_cd, @act_start_time_local=@cur_datetime,
			@act_start_time_tz=@cur_datetime_tz, @act_finish_time_local=NULL, @act_finish_time_tz=NULL,
            @step_data=NULL, @step_data_time_local=NULL, @step_data_time_tz=NULL, @start_user_id=@user_id,
			@finish_user_id=NULL, @data_user_id=NULL, @form_done=0, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL,
			@spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
			@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at,
			@row_id=NULL


	--Update job_exec with the current step no. and the step start time.
	UPDATE job_exec SET cur_step_no = @step_no, cur_step_start = @cur_datetime_utc
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

	--Update assigned_lot related to the current job.
	UPDATE assigned_lot
	SET status = 1
		,oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		,seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	WHERE lot_no = @lot_no
	  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id
	  AND (oper_id = @cur_oper_id OR oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (seq_no = @cur_seq_no OR seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND status = 0

	SELECT @override_serialization = wo.override_serialization
	FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo.wo_id = @cur_wo_id

	IF (@override_serialization = 1) SET @serial_no_lvl = -1

    --Also, specifically for serialized items, if the serial number is located in or at
    --(i.e. in a movable storage entity located directly or indirectly at) a parent of the entity
    --running the job, it should be moved to the entity running the job.
	SELECT @item_id = j.item_id, @run_ent_id = j.run_ent_id, @serial_no_lvl = i.serial_no_lvl
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE j.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
	  AND j.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
	  AND j.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	  AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
	  AND @serial_no_lvl <> -1

	IF (@serial_no_lvl IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--This is a serialized item.
		--Since this is a serialized item; there should be only one item on this lot/sublot.
		SELECT @run_ent_id = parent_ent_id
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id

		DECLARE inventory_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
		SELECT ii.row_id, ii.item_id, ii.lot_no, ii.sublot_no
		FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = se.ent_id
		INNER JOIN fn_SA_SE_GetMovableEnts(@run_ent_id) movable_ents ON se.ent_id = movable_ents.ent_id
		WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id
		  AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR (@lot_no IS NULL AND ii.lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (@sublot_no IS NULL AND ii.sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND ii.qty_left > 0

		OPEN inventory_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM inventory_cursor INTO @row_id, @item_id, @inv_lot_no, @inv_sublot_no
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			--Transfer the quantity from the source location to this entity that is running this job.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty @in_from_row_id=@row_id, @in_from_last_edit_at=NULL, @in_transfer_qty=1, @in_transfer_qty_erp=NULL
				, @in_to_ent_id=@run_ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@inv_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@sublot_no
				, @in_to_grade_cd=NULL, @in_to_status_cd=NULL, @in_to_uom_id=NULL, @in_to_expiry_date=NULL, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=NULL, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=NULL
				, @in_to_wo_id=NULL, @in_to_oper_id=NULL, @in_to_seq_no=NULL, @in_transfer_option=3, @in_mov_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=0, @in_transfer_comments=NULL, @in_log_transfer=1, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
		CLOSE inventory_cursor
		DEALLOCATE inventory_cursor
	END

	--If RUNNING and Labor_option (input parameter) call StepLogin() to capture labor to this step
	IF ((@state_cd = 3) and (@labor_option = 1))
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogin @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @step_no, @lot_no, @sublot_no, NULL, NULL, NULL,  @job_pos, @time_zone_bias_value

RETURN 0
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Util_AllowReas]
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - [sp_SA_ofi_Util_AllowReas]	
-- Description	      -	Fetching all util reasons from the table
-- Author			  -	Siva
-- Usage

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_GetSRCoper]
(
		@wo_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id    STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id    STRING40_NULL = NULL
)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_JOB_GETSRCOPER
-- Description    - Returns a list of work orders that have jobs that produce a serialied item that is still in the inventory.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 03/06/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 08/31/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @may_override_route  BIT


    --Verify whether the route can be overriden for this work order.
    SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
    FROM wo	WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	IF ( @may_override_route IS NULL ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The supplied work order does not exist in the database.{9999}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
    END;

    --Verify whether a valid operation is identified.
    IF (@oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Since, the operation id is not identified; we have no way to filter all the operations that exist
        --before this operation. Return all operations.
        SET @may_override_route = 1
    END

    IF (@may_override_route = 1) BEGIN
        SELECT j.oper_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND (j.oper_id <> @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
          AND (j.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
        ORDER BY j.oper_id
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        SELECT jr.input_oper_id AS oper_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id
        WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND (j.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
          AND (j.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
        ORDER BY jr.input_oper_id
    END

END

CREATE   Trigger [tg_oper_spec_ver_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_spec_ver]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_spec_ver_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_spec_ver table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_spec_ver_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_spec_ver_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_spec_ver_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_spec_ver', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_spec_ver_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_spec_ver_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Shift_Attr]
  (@shift_id int = NULL,
   @shift_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
   @attr_id  int = NULL,
   @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
  )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_S_Shift_Attr
-- Description			- Gets shift attributes
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	    Changes
-- 01/22/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 03/09/2018	  Srinivasa     6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 03/23/2018	  Surya			6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 13

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

  IF (@shift_id IS NULL AND @shift_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @shift_id = shift.shift_id FROM shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE shift.shift_desc= @shift_desc

	IF (@shift_id IS NULL)
		SET @shift_id = -1
  END

SELECT shift_attr.shift_id
          ,shift_attr.attr_id
          ,shift_attr.attr_value
          ,shift_attr.notes
          ,shift_attr.last_edit_comment
          ,shift_attr.last_edit_by
          ,shift_attr.last_edit_at
	FROM shift_attr shift_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (shift_attr.shift_id = @shift_id AND
       shift_attr.attr_id = @attr_id)
END

-- Module Name          - sp_S_IsCompatibleDatabase
-- Description          - This stored procedure will be passed a version number from the Middleware
--						  and will return a 1(True) or 0(False) in the parameter IsCompatibleDatabase. The stored
--						  procedure will use the sp_version field in the db_status table to determine if the
--						  Middleware version is compatible. In version 3.05 of Factelligence the sp_Version field
--						  will be changed to have 4 version numbers for example 3.05.0001.0001. However the
--						  compatibility will be determined using the first 3 version numbers for example 3.05.0001.
-- Date Created         -
-- Author               -
-- Version              -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver	Changes
-- 05/14/2015	KRF			5.02	User story 470542.  Accommodate new structure of db_status table, which now doesn't have
--									an sp_version field.  Use db_version instead of sp_version.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_IsCompatibleDatabase]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@CompatibleDatabaseVersions nvarchar(2000),
	@IsCompatibleDatabase numeric(1) output
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @DBVersion nvarchar(40) -- @DBVersion was @SPVersion, user story 470542

	-- Set the default to 0 which is false.
    set @IsCompatibleDatabase = 0

	-- Get the DB version that will be used to check to see if the database is Compatible.
	select @DBVersion = db_version from db_status WITH (NOLOCK) -- db_version was sp_version, added NOLOCK hint, user story 470542

	-- Remove the last 5 characters from the DB version. These last 5 characeters only reflect
	-- small changes to database which shouldn't affect compatability.
	select @DBVersion = Substring(@DBVersion, 0, Len(@DBVersion) - 4)

	select @IsCompatibleDatabase = 1 from db_status WITH (NOLOCK) where @CompatibleDatabaseVersions like '%' + @DBVersion + '%' -- added NOLOCK hint, user story 470542
END

-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 10/06/2009            SLR            4.0.0       Check for sublot was using a Not Exists rather then Exists
-- 10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6       spc_sample is removed from the database
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @err_str		NVARCHAR(4000)

BEGIN
	--Verify whether the existing sublot exist in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sublot WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE item_id = @in_item_id AND lot_no = @in_lot_no AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},sublot_no:' + @in_old_sublot_no
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the new sublot already exist in the database.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sublot WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE item_id = @in_item_id AND lot_no = @in_lot_no AND sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 already exist in the database.{4675},new sublot_no:' + @in_new_sublot_no
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--The new lot_no does not exist in the database. Update the existing sublot no to this new sub lot_no.
	--Start renaming all the old_sublot_no to a new sublot_no.
	--Rename old_sublot_no to a new sublot_no in sublot table.
	UPDATE sublot
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot parent to a new sublot_no parent.
	UPDATE sublot
	SET parent = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND parent = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the sublot_attr table.
	UPDATE sublot_attr
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the assigned_lot table.
	UPDATE assigned_lot
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the item_inv table.
	UPDATE item_inv
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the item_prod table.
	UPDATE item_prod
	SET sublot_no = CASE WHEN sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no THEN @in_new_sublot_no ELSE sublot_no END,
	rm_sublot_no = CASE WHEN rm_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no THEN @in_new_sublot_no ELSE rm_sublot_no END
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND (sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no OR rm_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no)

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the job_event table.
	UPDATE job_event
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the item_cons table.
	UPDATE item_cons
	SET sublot_no = CASE WHEN sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no THEN @in_new_sublot_no ELSE sublot_no END,
	fg_sublot_no = CASE WHEN fg_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no THEN @in_new_sublot_no ELSE fg_sublot_no END
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND (sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no OR fg_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no)

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the job_step_data table.
	UPDATE job_step_data
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_step_data.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_step_data.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_step_data.seq_no = j.seq_no
	  AND j.item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the item_transfer table.
	UPDATE item_transfer
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the item_transfer table.
	UPDATE item_transfer
	SET from_sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE from_item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND from_lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND from_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the transfer_list table.
	UPDATE transfer_list
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the transfer_list table.
	UPDATE transfer_list
	SET from_sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE from_item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND from_lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND from_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the labor_usage table.
	UPDATE labor_usage
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the cert_audit_log table.
	UPDATE cert_audit_log
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE cert_audit_log.wo_id = j.wo_id AND cert_audit_log.oper_id = j.oper_id AND cert_audit_log.seq_no = j.seq_no
	  AND j.item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the data_log_16 table.
	UPDATE data_log_16
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the data_log_48 table.
	UPDATE data_log_48
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the shipment_lot table.
	UPDATE shipment_lot
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	FROM (SELECT s.cust_id, s.po_id, s.so_line_no, s.ship_date_utc
	 FROM shipment s WITH (NOLOCK)
	 INNER JOIN so_line sl WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.cust_id = sl.cust_id AND s.po_id = sl.po_id AND s.so_line_no = sl.so_line_no
	  WHERE sl.item_id = @in_item_id) cust_shipment
	WHERE shipment_lot.cust_id = cust_shipment.cust_id AND shipment_lot.po_id = cust_shipment.po_id
	  AND shipment_lot.so_line_no = cust_shipment.so_line_no AND shipment_lot.ship_date_utc = cust_shipment.ship_date_utc
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the receipt_lot table.
	UPDATE receipt_lot
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	/*    --Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the job_exec table.
	UPDATE job_exec
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no */

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the bom_item table.
	UPDATE bom_item
	SET def_sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE parent_item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND def_lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND def_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the bom_item_subst table.
	UPDATE bom_item_subst
	SET def_sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE parent_item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND def_lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND def_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the job_bom table.
	UPDATE job_bom
	SET def_sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND def_lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND def_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no

	--Rename old sublot no to a new sublot no in the job_bom_subst table.
	UPDATE job_bom_subst
	SET def_sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND def_lot_no = @in_lot_no
	  AND def_sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Log_GetJobUtil]
(
		@ent_id              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_start    		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_start_tz   		INT32 = NULL
	,	@event_time_end      		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_end_tz     		INT32 = NULL
	,	@shift_id            		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_start   		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_start_tz  		INT32 = NULL
	,	@shift_start_end     		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_end_tz    		INT32 = NULL
	,	@min_duration        		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@max_duration        		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@state_cd            		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@reas_cd             		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@reas_pending        		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@runtime		     		LOGICAL
	,	@downtime		    		LOGICAL
	,	@setuptime		    		LOGICAL
	,	@teardowntime				LOGICAL
	,	@time_category_none			LOGICAL
	,	@fixedtime		    		LOGICAL
	,	@vartime		        	LOGICAL
	,	@time_type_neither   		LOGICAL
    ,   @failure                    LOGICAL
	,	@comments            		STRING4000_NULL = NULL
	,	@raw_reas_cd         		STRING40_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category1                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category2                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category3                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category4                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@log_id              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_pos             		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id               		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id             		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id             		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_start_start     		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_start_start_tz     	INT32 = NULL
	,	@job_start_end       		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_start_end_tz       	INT32 = NULL
	,	@min_job_duration    		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@max_job_duration    		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@row_id              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value    	INT32_NULL = 0

) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -    SP_SA_UTIL_LOG_GETJOBUTIL
-- Description          -    Retrieve utilization records and job utilization records based on the supplied filters
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/02/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright � 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By			Ver     Changes
--07/04/2007		Raghu		       3.2.8	HD# 9716, Added time filters.
--07/24/2007		Raghu			   3.3.1	HD# 10081, Change shift_start with *_utc and *_local, etc.
--09/06/2007		AML				   3.3.0	Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
--11/27/2009		Ajay			   4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
--01/13/2010        Sara               4.0.0    Added fields for enhanced calculations
--05/25/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserStory: 711576 - As Lenka, I want the stored procedures related to utilization to use util_history table rather than util_log table (Part 2)
--02/06/2019		Raghu			6.1	UserStory:1116862-As AVEVA, I want to investigate CR L00151416 so that I understand if splitting an event after the time change is an issue in MES 6.0 and consider some options
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

	DECLARE @event_time_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@event_time_end_utc     TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_start_utc  TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@job_start_start_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@job_start_end_utc      TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT32
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32


	SET @event_time_start_tz	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@event_time_start_tz)
	SET @event_time_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@event_time_end_tz)
	SET @shift_start_start_tz	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
	SET @job_start_start_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@job_start_start_tz)
	SET @job_start_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@job_start_end_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetJobUtil', @src_key='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetJobUtil',
					@date_val1 = @event_time_start, @numeric_val1 = @event_time_start_tz,
					@date_val2 = @job_start_end,     @numeric_val2 = @job_start_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@event_time_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_start, @tz_temp, @event_time_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@event_time_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_end, @tz_temp, @event_time_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start, @tz_temp, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@job_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @job_start_start, @tz_temp, @job_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@job_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @job_start_end, @tz_temp, @job_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT	@time_category_none = ABS(@time_category_none)
		,	@time_type_neither = ABS(@time_type_neither)

	IF (@time_category_none = 0) BEGIN
	   SET @time_category_none = NULL
	END

	IF (@time_type_neither = 0) BEGIN
	   SET @time_type_neither = NULL
	END


    SELECT ul.log_id ul_log_id
        ,ul.event_time_utc
        ,ul.event_time_local
        ,ul.event_time_utc AS event_time
        ,ul.duration AS ul_duration
        ,ul.event_end_time_utc
        ,ul.event_end_time_utc AS event_end_time
        ,ul.ent_id
        ,e.ent_name
        ,ul.shift_id, shift.shift_desc
        ,ul.shift_start_utc
        ,ul.shift_start_local
        ,ul.shift_start_utc AS shift_start
        ,ul.state_cd
        ,us.state_desc, us.color
        ,ul.reas_cd
        ,ur.reas_desc
        ,ul.reas_pending, ul.runtime, ul.downtime, ul.setuptime, ul.teardowntime, ul.fixedtime
        ,ul.vartime, ul.failure
        ,ul.comments, ul.raw_reas_cd, ul.category1, ul.category2, ul.category3, ul.category4
        ,ul.last_edit_comment AS ul_last_edit_comment, ul.last_edit_by AS ul_last_edit_by, ul.last_edit_at AS ul_last_edit_at
        ,ul.log_id jull_log_id
        ,jull.job_pos
        ,jull.wo_id
        ,jull.oper_id
        ,jull.seq_no
        ,jull.item_id
        ,i.item_desc
        ,jull.job_start_utc
        ,jull.job_start_local
        ,jull.job_start_utc AS job_start
        ,DATEDIFF(SS, jull.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) AS jull_duration
        ,DATEDIFF(SS, jull.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()))  AS job_runtime
	,COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) AS job_end_utc
	,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(jull.ent_id, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) AS job_end_local
	,COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) AS job_end
        ,jull.last_edit_comment AS jull_last_edit_comment
        ,jull.last_edit_by AS jull_last_edit_by
        ,jull.last_edit_at AS jull_last_edit_at
        ,jull.row_id AS jull_row_id
    FROM util_log ul WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = e.ent_id
    INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.shift_id = shift.shift_id
    INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
    INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
    LEFT OUTER JOIN job_history jull WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = jull.ent_id
    	AND jull.job_start_utc >= ul.event_time_utc AND (jull.job_end_utc <= ul.event_end_time_utc OR jull.job_end_utc IS NULL)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jull.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE (ul.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ul.event_time_utc >= @event_time_start_utc OR @event_time_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.event_time_utc <= @event_time_end_utc OR @event_time_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.duration >= @min_duration OR @min_duration IS NULL)
      AND (ul.duration <= @max_duration OR @max_duration IS NULL)
      AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
	  AND ((ul.runtime = @runtime AND @runtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.downtime = @downtime AND @downtime IS NOT NULL)
		OR (ul.setuptime = @setuptime AND @setuptime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime AND @teardowntime IS NOT NULL)
		OR (@time_category_none = 1 AND @time_category_none IS NOT NULL AND (ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 AND ul.setuptime = 0 AND ul.teardowntime = 0))
		OR (@runtime IS NULL AND @downtime IS NULL AND @setuptime IS NULL AND @teardowntime IS NULL AND @time_category_none IS NULL))
	  AND ((ul.fixedtime = @fixedtime AND @fixedtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.vartime = @vartime AND @vartime IS NOT NULL)
		OR (@time_type_neither = 1 AND @time_type_neither IS NOT NULL AND (ul.fixedtime = 0 AND ul.vartime = 0))
		OR (@fixedtime IS NULL AND @vartime IS NULL AND @time_type_neither IS NULL))
      AND (ul.failure = @failure OR @failure IS NULL)
      AND (ul.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
      AND (ul.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category1 LIKE @category1 OR @category1 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category2 LIKE @category2 OR @category2 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category3 LIKE @category3 OR @category3 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category4 LIKE @category4 OR @category4 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.job_pos = @job_pos OR @job_pos IS NULL)
      AND (jull.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
      AND (jull.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.job_start_utc >= @job_start_start_utc OR @job_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (jull.job_start_utc <= @job_start_end_utc OR @job_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (DATEDIFF(SS, jull.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) >= @min_job_duration OR @min_job_duration IS NULL)
      AND (DATEDIFF(SS, jull.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) <= @max_job_duration OR @max_job_duration IS NULL)
      AND (jull.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
    ORDER BY ul.ent_id, ul.event_time_utc, jull.job_start_utc

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tgeb_oper_step_grp_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_grp]
AFTER DELETE
AS

BEGIN

-- Name:			[sp_S_ofi_Waste_validate]
-- Description:		Validate waste
--
-- Usage:			validate waste
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  MP            2023-03-23      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	AKM			  2024-02-02	  header comment updated
