CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_waste_validation] (@ent_id AS int,
@qty AS float,
@date_from AS nvarchar(40),
@date_to AS nvarchar(40))
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  DECLARE
  @result int = 1,
  @maxqty float = 100.00, --in case plant and Equip is not configured
  @plantmaxqty float,
  @equiptmaxqty float,
  @datefrom datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @date_from),
  @dateto datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @date_to)

  SELECT @plantmaxqty = cast (replace(attr_value,',','') as float)
  FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = (SELECT ent_id
  FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_name = 'KOOG')
  AND attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
  FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE attr_desc = 'MaxWasteQty'
  AND attr_grp = 2)

  SELECT @equiptmaxqty = cast (replace(attr_value,',','') as float)
  FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
  AND attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
  FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE attr_desc = 'MaxWasteQty'
  AND attr_grp = 2)

  IF (@equiptmaxqty IS NULL)
    SET @maxqty = @plantmaxqty
  ELSE
    SET @maxqty = @equiptmaxqty
  --print @maxqty

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1   1 
		   FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
			  ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			  ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id
			  AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id
			  AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no

			WHERE (ip.created_at_utc BETWEEN @datefrom AND @dateto)
			AND ip.ent_id = @ent_id
			AND ip.good_prod = 1
			AND w.state_cd IN (1, 2) --(WO_state : Started, Completed)
			AND j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
			AND j.state_cd IN (3, 4, 5) --(Job Status: Running, Completed, Suspended)

			)
  BEGIN
    SET @result = 2
    SELECT @result AS result
    RETURN
  END

  ELSE
  IF (@maxqty < @qty)

	  BEGIN
		--print @maxqty
		SET @result = 3
		SELECT @result AS result
		RETURN
	  END

  SELECT @result AS result
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Labor_Exec_AddLabor]
(
	@in_labor_start	        	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@in_labor_start_tz			INT32 = NULL
,	@in_user_id 		    	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_ent_id 		        	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@in_wo_id               	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_oper_id             	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_seq_no 		        	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@in_step_no 		    	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@in_item_id 		    	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_lot_no 		        	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_sublot_no           	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_lab_cd 		        	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_dept_id 		    	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_shift_id 	        	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@in_shift_start 	    	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@in_shift_start_tz 	    	INT32 = NULL
,	@in_pct_to_apply        	TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
,	@in_active              	LOGICAL = 0
,	@in_duration 	        	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@in_comments 	        	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_raw_reas_cd         	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_last_edit_comment   	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@in_time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = NULL

)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.33
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By Ver  Changes
-- 10/22/2002	  Tony		 	   Read current lot_no from job_bom not job_bom_exec
-- 10/26/2002      Tony     1.5.0  Use job_pos = 0 to get current wo running on an entity
-- 11/18/2002      Rohit    1.5.0  Added @lab_split parameter for MW compatiblity.
-- 11/13/2003	Raghu		2.0.9  (HD# 3929) Default job values if oper_id is not supplied (=" ") else updated with the values whatever is passed in
-- 04/30/2004	  Sheetal Jain	2033	Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
--12/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.6	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--12/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.6	Language string ID added.
--					Also, the last raiserror statement in this procedure is commented out.
--					This should not override the errors that are coming from the database and should
--					the error message as it is...
--05/08/2007    Raghu       3.2.11  HD# 9824, Modified to add a record only when all conditions are satisfied.
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change shift_start with *_utc and *_local.
--10/11/2007    Raghu       3.3.2   This method was always defaulting the shift_id to current shift id; instaad of the supplied shift id.
--                                  Also, the supplied labor_start was not defaulting correctly.
-- 02/11/2008	AML			3.4.0	Updated to reflect changes made in the Oracle version.
-- 02/13/2008	AML			3.4.0	L00074849
-- 11/11/2009   Eswar       4.0		HF 1432 - datetime changes.
-- 12/31/2009	Ajay		4.0.0	HF 1432 Bring Hotfix forward
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value        INT32,
			@labor_start_utc             TDATETIME,
			@labor_start_local           TDATETIME,
			@last_edit_at                TDATETIME,
			@can_capture_labor           LOGICAL,
			@err_msg                     NVARCHAR(4000),
			@lab_cd                      STRING40,
			@dept_id                     STRING40,
			@cur_shift_id                INT32,
			@cur_shift_start_utc         TDATETIME,
			@cur_shift_start_local       TDATETIME,
			@shift_id                    INT32,
			@shift_start_local           TDATETIME,
			@shift_start_utc             TDATETIME,
			@wo_id                       STRING40,
			@oper_id                     STRING40,
			@seq_no                      INT32,
			@item_id                     STRING40,
			@lot_no                      STRING40,
			@sublot_no                   STRING40,
			@step_no                     INT32,
			@pct_to_apply                TFLOAT,
			@last_edit_by                STRING40,
			@v_client_info               STRING40,
			@tz_temp					 INT32,
			@ent_tz_bias_value			 INT32,
			@dbg_resp					 INT32

    SET @in_labor_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_labor_start_tz)
    SET @in_labor_start = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_labor_start, @in_labor_start_tz)

    SET @in_shift_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_shift_start_tz)
    SET @in_shift_start = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_shift_start, @in_shift_start_tz)

    SET @in_time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Labor_Exec_AddLabor', @src_key='on_entry', @date_val1 = @in_labor_start, @numeric_val1 = @in_labor_start_tz, @date_val2 = @in_shift_start, @numeric_val2 = @in_shift_start_tz

    --Default time zone bias value to 0; if not supplied.
    SELECT	@time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,	@lab_cd = @in_lab_cd
		,	@dept_id = @in_dept_id
		,	@shift_id = @in_shift_id
		,	@shift_start_local = @in_shift_start
		,	@wo_id = @in_wo_id
		,	@oper_id = @in_oper_id
		,	@seq_no = @in_seq_no
		,	@item_id = @in_item_id
		,	@lot_no = @in_lot_no
		,	@sublot_no = @in_sublot_no
		,	@step_no = @in_step_no
		,	@pct_to_apply = COALESCE(@in_pct_to_apply, 0)

	SET @tz_temp = -@in_shift_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT

    --Verify for all non-null values.
    IF (@in_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Since the entity id is not supplied; raise an error to the caller.
        RAISERROR( 'The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},entity id,to add a new labor usage record', 16, 1 )
    END

    IF (@in_user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Since the user id is not supplied; raise an error to the caller.
        RAISERROR( 'The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},user id,to add a new labor usage record', 16, 1)
    END

    IF (@in_duration IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Since the duration is not supplied; raise an error to the caller.
        RAISERROR('The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},duration,to add a new labor usage record', 16, 1)
    END


	IF EXISTS ( select top 1 1 from ent where ent_id = @in_ent_id ) BEGIN

		--Verify whether the supplied entity can capture labor.
		SELECT	@can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor,
				@cur_shift_id = cur_shift_id,
				@cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
				@cur_shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
		FROM ent
		WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

	END ELSE BEGIN

		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for an entity id: ' + @in_ent_id
		RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )

	END


    IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN
        --This entity is not capable of capturing labor.
        SET @err_msg = 'This entity does not have the %1 capability flag set.{4710},can_capture_labor'
        RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )
    END

    --If the supplied labor_code is null; then default the labor_cd from the user;
    IF (@lab_cd IS NULL OR @dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN

		IF EXISTS ( select top 1 1 from user_name where user_id = @in_user_id ) BEGIN

			SELECT @lab_cd = COALESCE(@lab_cd, def_lab_cd), @dept_id = COALESCE(@dept_id, def_dept_id)
			FROM user_name
			WHERE user_id = @in_user_id

		END ELSE BEGIN

            SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for an user id: ' + @in_user_id
            RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )

        END
    END

    --If the supplied labor_code is null; then default the labor_cd from entity.
    IF (@lab_cd IS NULL OR @dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN

		IF EXISTS ( select top 1 1 from labor_exec where ent_id = @in_ent_id ) BEGIN

			SELECT @lab_cd = COALESCE(@lab_cd, def_lab_cd), @dept_id = COALESCE(@dept_id, def_dept_id)
			FROM labor_exec
			WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

		END ELSE BEGIN

            SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for an entity id: ' + @in_ent_id + ' in the labor_exec'
            RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )

		END
    END

    IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
        --A valid labor code is not identified; raise an error in this case.
        RAISERROR( 'The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},labor code,to add a new labor usage record', 16, 1 )
    END

    IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --A valid dept code is not identified; raise an error in this case.
        RAISERROR( 'The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},department code,to add a new labor usage record', 16, 1 )
    END

    --Verify whether we can identify a valid shift.
    SET @shift_id = COALESCE( @shift_id, @cur_shift_id)
    SET @shift_start_utc = COALESCE( @shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_utc )
    SET @shift_start_local = COALESCE( @shift_start_local, @cur_shift_start_local )


	EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo  @in_ent_id, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local OUTPUT,  @ent_tz_bias_value OUTPUT

   -- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Labor_Exec_AddLabor', @src_key='GetDateInfo', @date_val1 = @shift_start_local,@date_val2 = @shift_start_utc


	SET @shift_start_local = DATEADD(mi, @ent_tz_bias_value, @shift_start_utc)

    --Verify whether a valid labor start time is supplied.
    IF (@in_labor_start IS NULL) BEGIN
        --The labor start time is not supplied; defaul the labor start time depending upon the supplied bias value.
        SET @labor_start_utc = GETUTCDATE()
    END ELSE BEGIN
        --The labor start time is supplied; adjust the labor start time with the supplied bias value.
        SET @labor_start_local = @in_labor_start
		SET @tz_temp = -@in_labor_start_tz
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_utc OUTPUT
    END
	SET @labor_start_local = DATEADD(mi, @ent_tz_bias_value, @labor_start_utc)

    SET @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

    IF (@wo_id = ' ' OR @oper_id = ' ') BEGIN

        SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no, @step_no = COALESCE(@step_no, cur_step_no)
        FROM job_exec
        WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id AND job_pos = 0

    END

    IF (@item_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

        SELECT @item_id = item_id
        FROM job
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

    END

    IF ((@lot_no IS NULL OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

        SELECT @lot_no = COALESCE(@lot_no, def_lot_no), @sublot_no = COALESCE(@sublot_no, def_sublot_no)
        FROM job_bom
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0

    END

    EXEC sp_s_db_status_getaudtrailusr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, @V_Client_Info OUTPUT

    INSERT INTO labor_usage
	(
		labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no,
        sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments,
        raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
    VALUES
	(
		@labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local, @in_user_id, @in_ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @item_id,
    	@lot_no, @sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local, @pct_to_apply,
		ISNULL( ABS(@in_active), 0 ), @in_duration, @in_comments, @in_raw_reas_cd, @in_last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
	)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogin]
(
		@session_id				INT32
	,	@user_id				STRING40
	,	@ent_id					INT32
	,	@step_no				INT32
	,	@lot_no					STRING40
	,	@sublot_no				STRING40
	,	@lab_cd					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@dept_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_pos				INT32 = 0
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				-
-- Description				-
-- Author					- Raghu
-- Date Created				- 10/21/2002
-- Version					- 1.6.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 02/06/2003 		Rohit		  			Check if the entity can capture labor,if not then exit without doing anything.
-- 04/15/2003		Raghu			1.6.0	Removed cursor which loops thru labor records (To improve performance).
--											Included NoLock hint in all selection of labor_usage records and create new row when lot changes for the step as steps are lot specific
--											If the same step is logged into multiple lots, split the pct among all the lots.
-- 06-06-2003		Sheetal Jain	1601  	Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 12/01/2003		Raghu			2.0.13	(HD# 3879) Handling steps with multiple job execs.
-- 06/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included NULL value for last_edit_comment field while calling sp_I_Labor_Usage.
--											Also added last_edit_by and last_edit_at in insert statements
-- 06/09/2005		Raghu			2.1.23	HD# 5762, Changed labor percentage from 100% to 0 for labor records that are not licensed.
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
-- 05/15/2007		Raghu			3.2.12  HD# 9857, When starting a step, not able to complete
-- 08/15/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--01/10/2009		Raghu			3.4	73693;  Cannot start a step.
--01/07/2010		Kishore			4.0		HF1432
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @cur_lab_cd					STRING40
		,	@cur_dept_id				STRING40
		,	@log_id						INT32
		,	@labor_start_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_local			TDATETIME
		,	@cur_user_id				STRING40
		,	@cur_ent_id					INT32
		,	@cur_step_no				INT32
		,	@item_id					STRING40
		,	@cur_lot_no					STRING40
		,	@cur_sublot_no				STRING40
		,	@shift_id					INT32
		,	@shift_start_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_local			TDATETIME
		,	@pct_to_apply				TFLOAT
		,	@active						LOGICAL
		,	@duration					INT32
		,	@comments					STRING254
		,	@mod_id						VARCHAR(30)
		,	@ent_pct_to_apply			TFLOAT
		,	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply 		TFLOAT
		,	@total_pct_lab_to_apply 	TFLOAT
		,	@act_cur_tot_pct_to_apply	TFLOAT
		,	@return						INT32
		,	@can_capture_labor 			LOGICAL
		,	@cur_wo_id					STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id				STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no					INT32
		,	@no_jobs					INT32
		,	@last_edit_by				STRING40
		,	@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,	@event_time_utc				TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp					INT32
		,	@shift_start_tz				INT32

	IF @job_pos IS NULL SET @job_pos = 0
	set @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @ent_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz OUTPUT

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Check if the entity can capture labor,if not then exit without doing anything
	--SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor FROM ent  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	--If lab_cd, dept_id not included read them from ent_logon table for this session, ent and user (New DB)
	SELECT	@cur_lab_cd = ent_logon.cur_lab_cd, @cur_dept_id = ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id
		,	@ent_pct_to_apply = ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply
	FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE session_id = @session_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id

	SELECT	@can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor
		,	@shift_id = cur_shift_id
		,	@shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
		,	@shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	IF (@lab_cd IS NULL OR @dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		IF @lab_cd  IS NULL SET @lab_cd = @cur_lab_cd
		IF @dept_id IS NULL SET @dept_id = @cur_dept_id
	END

	IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) SELECT @lab_cd = MIN(lab_cd) FROM labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK)
	IF (@dept_id IS NULL) SELECT @dept_id = MIN(dept_id) FROM labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK)

	SELECT @cur_wo_id = je.cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = je.cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = je.cur_seq_no, @item_id=job.item_id
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = job.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = job.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = job.seq_no
	WHERE je.ent_id= @ent_id AND je.job_pos = @job_pos

	IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @event_time_local = @event_time_utc
		ELSE SET @event_time_local= DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @event_time_utc)
	END
	ELSE SET @event_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value, @event_time_local)


	IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
				  ent_id = @ent_id AND
				  active = 1 AND
				  step_no = @step_no AND
				  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
				  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
				  seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
				  (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
		)
		BEGIN
            EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage @log_id OUTPUT, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_wo_id,
				@cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @step_no, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id,
				@shift_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz, 0, 1, 0, @comments, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id
		END

		RETURN 0
	END

	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 'X'
		FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
			  ent_id = @ent_id AND
			  active = 1 AND
			  step_no IS NULL AND
			  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
			  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
			  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	)
	BEGIN

		SELECT	@log_id = labor_usage.log_id
			,	@shift_id = labor_usage.shift_id
			,	@shift_start_utc = labor_usage.shift_start_utc
			,	@shift_start_local = labor_usage.shift_start_local
			,	@pct_to_apply = labor_usage.pct_to_apply
			,	@comments = labor_usage.comments
		FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
			  ent_id = @ent_id AND
			  active = 1 AND
			  step_no IS NULL AND
			  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
			  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
			  seq_no = @cur_seq_no

		UPDATE labor_usage
		SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc),
			active = 0
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
			  ent_id = @ent_id AND
			  active = 1 AND
			  step_no IS NULL AND
			  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
			  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
			  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
        EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage	@log_id OUTPUT, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no,
								@step_no, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz, @pct_to_apply,
								1, 0, @comments, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id

		UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 'X'
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
				  ent_id = @ent_id AND
				  active = 1 AND
				  step_no = @step_no AND
				  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
				  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
				  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		)
		BEGIN

			SELECT	@total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(pct_to_apply)
				,	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply = AVG(pct_to_apply)
			FROM	(
					SELECT SUM(pct_to_apply) AS pct_to_apply
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
						  ent_id = @ent_id AND
						  active = 1 AND
						  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
						  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
						  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
					GROUP BY step_no
					) AS x

			SET @act_cur_tot_pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply + @total_pct_lab_to_apply
			SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = (@cur_pct_lab_to_apply/ @act_cur_tot_pct_to_apply) * @total_pct_lab_to_apply

			INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd, dept_id,
				shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			SELECT	@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id,
					lot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
					(
						CASE WHEN (@act_cur_tot_pct_to_apply = 0) THEN 0
						ELSE (pct_to_apply/@act_cur_tot_pct_to_apply)*@total_pct_lab_to_apply
						END
					 ) AS pct_to_apply,
					active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) AS last_edit_at
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
				  labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
				  labor_usage.active = 1 AND
				  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
				  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
				  seq_no = @cur_seq_no

			UPDATE labor_usage
			SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
				  ent_id = @ent_id AND
				  active = 1 AND
				  labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc AND
				  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
				  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
				  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
            EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage	@log_id OUTPUT, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no,
									@step_no, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz,
									@cur_pct_lab_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id

			UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id

		END
		ELSE BEGIN --Check if the user is trying to log into step in a different lot; as steps are lot specific. If it is different lot, then close the current row and create new labor row else exit
			IF (@lot_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 'X'
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
						  ent_id = @ent_id AND
						  active = 1 AND
						  step_no = @step_no AND
						  lot_no = @lot_no AND
						  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
						  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
						  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				)
				BEGIN

					SELECT	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply = AVG(pct_to_apply)
						,	@total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(pct_to_apply)
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
						  ent_id = @ent_id AND
						  active = 1 AND
						  step_no = @step_no AND
						  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
						  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
						  seq_no = @cur_seq_no

					IF (@cur_pct_lab_to_apply + @total_pct_lab_to_apply = 0) BEGIN
                        SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = 0
                    END
                    ELSE BEGIN
                        SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = (@cur_pct_lab_to_apply/ (@cur_pct_lab_to_apply + @total_pct_lab_to_apply)) * @total_pct_lab_to_apply;
                    END
					INSERT INTO labor_usage
					(
						labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id,
						lot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration,
						comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
					)
					SELECT	@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
							dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
							(
								CASE WHEN pct_to_apply + @total_pct_lab_to_apply = 0 THEN 0
								ELSE (pct_to_apply/(pct_to_apply + @total_pct_lab_to_apply))*@total_pct_lab_to_apply
								END
							) AS pct_to_apply,
							active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
						  labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
						  labor_usage.active = 1 AND
						  step_no = @step_no AND
						  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
						  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
						  seq_no = @cur_seq_no

					UPDATE labor_usage
					SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc),
						active = 0
					WHERE user_id = @user_id AND
						  ent_id = @ent_id AND
						  active = 1 AND
						  step_no = @step_no AND
						  labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc AND
						  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
						  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
						  seq_no = @cur_seq_no
                    EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage	@log_id OUTPUT, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no,
											@step_no, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz,
											@cur_pct_lab_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id

					UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
					WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				END -- Step does not exist for the specified lot
			END -- Step Exists and lot_no should be NULL - should specify a valid lot no
		END -- Step is logged into a different lot - as steps are lot specific
	END	-- Step Exists (based on log_id)
RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Result]
(
   @sample_id           INT32_NULL = NULL
,  @char_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
,  @value_no            INT32_NULL = NULL
,  @result_value        float = NULL
,  @act_sample_size     INT32_NULL = NULL
,  @created_by          STRING40_NULL = NULL
,  @created_at          TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,  @created_at_tz          INT32_NULL = NULL
,  @created_at_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,  @superseded          INT32_NULL = NULL
,  @last_edit_by        STRING40_NULL = NULL
,  @last_edit_at        TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,  @row_id              INT32_NULL = NULL
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name             - SP_SA_Result
-- Description             -
-- Author                  -
-- Date Created               -
-- Version                 -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver         Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

   SET NOCOUNT ON

   DECLARE @tz_temp            int

   IF (@created_at_utc IS NULL)
   BEGIN
	   SET @created_at_tz    = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_tz)
	   SET @created_at = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@created_at, @created_at_tz)
	   SET @tz_temp = -@created_at_tz
	   IF (@created_at IS NOT NULL) EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at, @tz_temp, @created_at_utc OUTPUT
	END

   SELECT result.sample_id
          ,sample.sample_name
         ,result.char_id
          ,characteristic.char_name
          ,result.value_no
          ,result.result_value
          ,sample_char_link.act_sample_size
          ,result.created_by
          ,result.created_at_utc
          ,result.created_at_local
          ,result.created_at_utc as created_at
          ,result.superseded
          ,result.last_edit_comment
          ,result.last_edit_by
          ,result.last_edit_at
          ,result.row_id
   FROM result WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id=result.sample_id AND sample_char_link.char_id=result.char_id
    INNER JOIN sample WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.sample_id = result.sample_id
    INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = result.char_id
   WHERE (
            (result.sample_id = @sample_id OR @sample_id IS NULL) AND
            (result.char_id = @char_id OR @char_id IS NULL) AND
            (result.value_no = @value_no OR @value_no IS NULL) AND
            (result.result_value = @result_value OR @result_value IS NULL) AND
            (sample_char_link.act_sample_size = @act_sample_size OR @act_sample_size IS NULL) AND
            (result.created_by = @created_by OR @created_by IS NULL) AND
            (result.created_at_utc >= @created_at_utc OR @created_at_utc IS NULL) AND
            (result.superseded = @superseded OR @superseded IS NULL) AND
            (result.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
            (result.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
            (result.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
        )
   ORDER BY result.sample_id, result.char_id, result.value_no

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_JOB_GETTGTOPRCONTNSERITM]
(
		@wo_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id    STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id    STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@mo_id      STRING40_NULL = NULL
)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_JOB_GETTGTOPRCONTNSERITM
-- Description          -  7.3.3.8  To Oper Id
--                          If the dialog is opened in the context of a job, the operation of that job
--                          will be the only choice in this dropdown, and the dropdown will be disabled.
--                          Other wise this dropdown will contain all operations for the selected job.
--                          If the item is specified in the filter, the operations listed will be limited
--                          to those having a job that consumes that item.  This must include those that
--                          consume the item in position 0 of the job BOM, if that item is produced in a
--                          preceding job.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/13/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 08/31/2007		AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

    --Split the retrieval based on the item_id for better performance. This will reduce the join with the job_bom table.
    IF (@item_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT j.oper_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
        --Limit to the supplied work order id, if a work order id is supplied.
        WHERE (j.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
        --Limit to the supplied oper_id, if an operation d is supplied.
          AND (j.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
          --Limit to the supplied mo_id, if a mo_id is supplied.
          AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
          --work orders not completed or closed
          AND wo.state_cd < 2
          --that produces a serialized item
          AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT j.oper_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
        INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
        --Limit to the supplied work order id, if a work order id is supplied.
        WHERE (j.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
        --Limit to the supplied oper_id, if an oper id is supplied.
          AND (j.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
        --Limit to the supplied item_id, if an item_id is supplied.
        --and the operations listed will be limited to those having a job that consumes that item
          AND (jb.item_id = @item_id AND jb.bom_pos > 0)
          --Limit to the supplied mo_id, if a mo_id is supplied.
          AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
          --work orders not completed or closed
          AND wo.state_cd < 2
          --that produces a serialized item
          AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT j.oper_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
        INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
        --Limit to the supplied work order id, if a work order id is supplied.
        WHERE (j.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
            --Limit to the supplied oper_id, if an oper id is supplied.
          AND (j.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
          --Limit to the supplied item_id, if an item_id is supplied.
          --This must include those that consume the item in position 0 of the job BOM,
          --if that item is produced in a  preceding job.
          AND (jb.item_id = @item_id AND jb.bom_pos = 0)
          --Limit to the supplied mo_id, if a mo_id is supplied.
          AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
          --work orders not completed or closed
          AND wo.state_cd < 2
          --that produces a serialized item
          AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
    END

END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_spec_ver_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_spec_ver]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_spec_ver_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_spec_ver table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_spec_ver_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_spec_ver a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		     AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		    AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
	OPEN oper_spec_ver_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_spec_ver_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_spec_ver', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_spec_ver_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_spec_ver_cursor
END

-- Description: Create Request to pass to window service through  amqp and get the response and update response in table.

-- 0.01.00      AKM			2022-12-08			Initial version.

-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_CBamqp_resp]
	(   @response             NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@request              NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@is_accessed          INT          = NULL,
		@wo_id                NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id              NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@seq_no               INT          = NULL,
		@curr_correction_step INT          = NULL,
		@correlation_id       NVARCHAR(MAX)= NULL,
		@sample_id            NVARCHAR(50) = NULL )
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @corr_id            NVARCHAR(40),
			@is_manual          INT = 0,
			@is_req_toBeUpdated INT = 1 -- default is to update request
	DECLARE @TEMP TABLE
		(
			id   NVARCHAR(40),
			val  NVARCHAR(40),
			type INT
		)
	-- Verify if we have a wo_id
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @is_req_toBeUpdated = 0
	END
	-- check if we have correlation or request
	IF (@correlation_id IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @temp
		SELECT *
		FROM OpenJson(@correlation_id);	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @temp
		SELECT *
		FROM OpenJson(@request);	
	END

	SELECT @corr_id = val
	FROM @temp
	WHERE id     ='corrId'
	SELECT @wo_id=val
	FROM @temp
	WHERE id        ='wo_id'
	SELECT @oper_id = val
	FROM @temp
	WHERE id       ='oper_id'
	SELECT @seq_no = val
	FROM @temp
	WHERE id                    ='seq_no'
	SELECT @curr_correction_step=val
	FROM @temp
	WHERE id='curr_step'
	--check if manual
	IF (@corr_id LIKE '%_m%')
	BEGIN
		SET @is_manual = 1
	END
	-- check if response is already recorded then update else insert.
	IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1
				FROM ofi_CBamqp_Resp(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id                  = @wo_id
					AND Oper_id              = @oper_id
					AND seq_no               = @seq_no
					AND curr_correction_step = @curr_correction_step
					AND isManual             = @is_manual )
	BEGIN
		IF (@is_req_toBeUpdated = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ofi_CBamqp_Resp
			SET response =	CASE
								WHEN @is_manual = 1
									THEN @response
								ELSE ISNULL(@response, response)
							END,
				correlation_id = @corr_id,
				last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE wo_id                  = @wo_id
				AND Oper_id              = @oper_id
				AND seq_no               = @seq_no
				AND curr_correction_step = @curr_correction_step
				AND isManual             = @is_manual
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ofi_CBamqp_Resp
			SET response = CASE
								WHEN @is_manual = 1
									THEN @response
								ELSE ISNULL(@response, response)
							END,
				correlation_id = @corr_id,
				request = @request,
				sample_id = ISNULL(@sample_id, sample_id),
				last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE wo_id                  = @wo_id
				AND Oper_id              = @oper_id
				AND seq_no               = @seq_no
				AND curr_correction_step = @curr_correction_step
				AND isManual             = @is_manual
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO ofi_CBamqp_Resp
			(   response,
				request,
				is_accessed,
				wo_id,
				oper_id,
				seq_no,
				curr_correction_step,
				correlation_id,
				isManual,
				sample_id
			)
		VALUES
			(   @response,
				@request,
				@is_accessed,
				@wo_id ,
				@oper_id ,
				@seq_no ,
				@curr_correction_step ,
				@corr_id,
				@is_manual,
				@sample_id
			)
	END
END

/*
--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_Check_RSSU_Disabling]
-- Description:	Evaluates if a source silo is selected for the active job
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01 	AML, XPM		2026-07-02			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Check_RSSU_Disabling]
(
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no INT,
	@ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
	@job_status INT,
	@request_flag INT OUTPUT
) 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SET @request_flag = 1;
	DECLARE @ent_id INT;
	DECLARE @oper_id NVARCHAR(80);

	IF @job_status IN (1, 2, 3, 31, 5)
	BEGIN

		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id 
		FROM ent WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_name = @ent_name;

		SELECT TOP 1 @oper_id = oper_id 
		FROM job WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
		  AND seq_no = @seq_no 
		  AND run_ent_id = @ent_id;

		IF @oper_id IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (
				SELECT 1 
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id 
				  AND seq_no = @seq_no 
				  AND dest_type = 1 
				  AND is_chk = 1
				  AND secondary_silo_ent_id IS NOT NULL
				  AND secondary_silo_ent_id <> 0
				  AND secondary_silo_ent_id <> active_su_ent_id
			)
			BEGIN
				
				SET @request_flag = 0;
			END
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ent_Logon_GetEnts]
(
	@session_id				INT32
,	@user_id				STRING80
,	@start_time_local		TDATETIME = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Ent_Logon_GetEnts
-- Description					- Get a list entities to which the user has logged in.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 12/20/2006
-- Version						- 3.1.2.26
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 07/11/2007		AML				3.2.0		HD# 8856, Order by site_name first.
-- 08/07/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 08/28/2008		Raghu			3.4			L00077938; Logon Error in Version 3.4 Release 223
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN
	--Default the time zone bias value to 0
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	--Adjust the start time if supplied.
	IF @start_time_local IS NOT NULL SET @start_time_local = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time_local)

	SELECT	ent.ent_id
		,	ent.ent_name
		,	ent.description
		,	ent.parent_ent_id
		,	ent.site
	--	,	site_ent.ent_name AS site_name -- 07/11/2007 AML
		,	site.site_name -- 07/11/2007 AML
		,	ent.hourly_cost
		,	ent.can_sched_jobs
		,	ent.can_run_jobs
		,	ent.can_capture_util
		,	ent.can_capture_labor
		,	ent.can_do_dnc
		,	ent.can_track_oee
		,	ent.can_sched_shifts
		,	ent.can_store
		,	ent.can_log_data
		,	ent.can_ship
		,	ent.can_receive
		,	ent.can_copy_folders
        ,   ent.can_capture_qm_data --04/19/2011 SLR
		,	ent.cur_shift_id
		--,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ent.cur_shift_start_time) AS cur_shift_start_time
		,	ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		,	ent.cur_shift_start_time_local
		,	shift.shift_desc
		,	ent.last_domain_change
		,	ent.tree_icon
		,	ent.flow_diag_img
		,	ent.identical_job_execs
		,	ent.spare1
		,	ent.spare2
		,	ent.spare3
		,	ent.spare4
		,	ent.last_edit_comment
		,	ent.last_edit_by
		,	ent.last_edit_at
	FROM ent ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.cur_shift_id = shift.shift_id
	--	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent site_ent ON ent.site = site_ent.ent_id -- 07/11/2007 AML
		LEFT OUTER JOIN site site ON ent.site = site.ent_id
	WHERE	el.session_id = @session_id
		AND el.user_id = @user_id
		--If the start time is not specified, then default to all entities.
		AND (el.start_time > @start_time_local OR @start_time_local IS NULL)
	--ORDER BY site_ent.ent_name, ent.ent_name
	ORDER BY site.site_name, ent.parent_ent_id, ent.ent_name --07/11/2007 AML
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_data_log_value_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[data_log_value]
AFTER DELETE
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - tg_data_log_value_aft_del
-- Description	      -	(HD# 3657) 2. Default data_log_16 or _48 values to NULL, if a data_log_value is deleted
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 08/24/2004
-- Version	      - 2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--06/06/2005	Raghu		2.1.22	HD# 5735, Datalog values referential integrity. Remove all dependant FC values
--10/27/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Delete FC tags if a data log value is deleted.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @grp_id		INT32
	,@value_index	INT32
	,@max_value	INT32
	,@ent_id	INT32
	,@table_name	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@col_name	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@SQL		NVARCHAR(400)

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	--Open a cursor to fetch all the rows, one at a time
	DECLARE data_log_value_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
--SJ		SELECT d.grp_id, dlg.ent_id, d.value_index, dlg.max_value FROM deleted d
		SELECT d.grp_id, dlgel.ent_id, d.value_index, dlg.max_value FROM deleted d
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON d.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp_ent_link dlgel ON dlg.grp_id = dlgel.grp_id
	OPEN data_log_value_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM data_log_value_cursor INTO @grp_id, @ent_id, @value_index, @max_value
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF @max_value = 16 SET @table_name = 'data_log_16' ELSE SET @table_name = 'data_log_48'
		SET @col_name = 'VALUE' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), @value_index)

		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE ' + @table_name + ' SET ' + @col_name + ' = NULL WHERE grp_id = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @grp_id)
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
	END
	CLOSE data_log_value_cursor
	DEALLOCATE data_log_value_cursor

END

	   -- TRACE
    exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetJobUtilCount', @src_key='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetJobUtilCount',
					@date_val1 = @shift_start_start, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_start_tz,
					@date_val2 = @job_start_end,     @numeric_val2 = @job_start_end_tz


	SET @tz_temp = -@event_time_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_start, @tz_temp, @event_time_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@event_time_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_end, @tz_temp, @event_time_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start, @tz_temp, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@job_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @job_start_start, @tz_temp, @job_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@job_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @job_start_end, @tz_temp, @job_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT	@time_category_none = ABS(@time_category_none)
		,	@time_type_neither = ABS(@time_type_neither)

	IF (@time_category_none = 0) BEGIN
	   SET @time_category_none = NULL
	END

	IF (@time_type_neither = 0) BEGIN
	   SET @time_type_neither = NULL
	END

    SELECT @no_of_job_util_events = COUNT(*)
    FROM util_log ul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = e.ent_id
		INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_history jull WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = jull.ent_id
		    	AND jull.job_start_utc >= ul.event_time_utc AND (jull.job_end_utc <= ul.event_end_time_utc OR jull.job_end_utc IS NULL)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jull.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE (ul.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ul.event_time_utc >= @event_time_start_utc OR @event_time_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.event_time_utc <= @event_time_end_utc OR @event_time_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.duration >= @min_duration OR @min_duration IS NULL)
      AND (ul.duration <= @max_duration OR @max_duration IS NULL)
      AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
	  AND ((ul.runtime = @runtime AND @runtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.downtime = @downtime AND @downtime IS NOT NULL)
		OR (ul.setuptime = @setuptime AND @setuptime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime AND @teardowntime IS NOT NULL)
		OR (@time_category_none = 1 AND @time_category_none IS NOT NULL AND (ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 AND ul.setuptime = 0 AND ul.teardowntime = 0))
		OR (@runtime IS NULL AND @downtime IS NULL AND @setuptime IS NULL AND @teardowntime IS NULL AND @time_category_none IS NULL))
	  AND ((ul.fixedtime = @fixedtime AND @fixedtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.vartime = @vartime AND @vartime IS NOT NULL)
		OR (@time_type_neither = 1 AND @time_type_neither IS NOT NULL AND (ul.fixedtime = 0 AND ul.vartime = 0))
		OR (@fixedtime IS NULL AND @vartime IS NULL AND @time_type_neither IS NULL))
	  AND (ul.failure = @failure OR @failure IS NULL)
      AND (ul.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
      AND (ul.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category1 LIKE @category1 OR @category1 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category2 LIKE @category2 OR @category2 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category3 LIKE @category3 OR @category3 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category4 LIKE @category4 OR @category4 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.job_pos = @job_pos OR @job_pos IS NULL)
      AND (jull.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (jull.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
      AND (jull.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
       AND (jull.job_start_utc >= @job_start_start_utc OR @job_start_start_utc IS NULL)
    AND (jull.job_start_utc <= @job_start_end_utc OR @job_start_end_utc IS NULL)
    AND (DATEDIFF(SS, jull.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) >= @min_job_duration OR @min_job_duration IS NULL)
      AND (DATEDIFF(SS, jull.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jull.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) <= @max_job_duration OR @max_job_duration IS NULL)
      AND (jull.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation
-- Description:	Used to update active_su_ent_id by operation
--
-- Usage:		MDMStartJobWorkflow, MDMEndJobWorkflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2023-04-30			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2023-05-23			Update Bug Fix #38 (Second Pre-BAT)
-- 0.03.00	YG				2023-05-26			Added new operations DownloadDestination and DownloadSource
--												Call logic for bom correction
-- 0.04.00	YG				2023-06-05			Set silo_seq to be null if the destinasion silo requested by the automations
-- 0.05.00	JSC				2025-08-18			CR512: Updated to align it with NextSUinQueue and GetSUDetails sent to AUT
--===========================================================================================*/

CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation] 
		@wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
		@seq_no AS INT = NULL,
		@old_silo_aut AS INT = NULL,
		@operation AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	-- Used for debugger
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 , @operation = 'Start'
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 , @operation = 'Stop'
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 ,@old_silo_aut = 500012, @operation = 'NextSource'
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 ,@old_silo_aut = 500031, @operation = 'NextDestination'

	--SELECT * FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
	--		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
	--		return

	DECLARE @Len INT,
			@Counter INT,
			@MinSeq INT,
			@SiloSeq INT,
			@JBItemId NVARCHAR(100),
			@SiloEntId INT, -- Primary Silo,
			@RowId INT,
			@SecondarySiloEntId INT,
			@SecondarySiloName NVARCHAR(100)

	-- v 0.05.00 added
	DECLARE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT INT = 0

	-- Get Minimum Sequence used for Start and Download Destination operation
	DECLARE @MinSeqList TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		silo_seq INT,
		jb_item_id NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	-- Get Source Silo used for Start and Download Source operation
	DECLARE @SourceList TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		su_ent_id INT,
		jb_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
		row_id INT
	)
		
	IF (@operation = 'Start' or @operation = 'DownloadSilo')
	BEGIN
		---------- For Destination ----------------------
		-- Dest Change ::  Set the SENT destination to DCS as 'active'
		-- v 0.05.00 added
		SELECT @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = ea.attr_value 
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		WHERE ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'ShareCoProdSiloToAUT' and attr_grp=2)
			AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
 
		SET @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT  = ISNULL(@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT,0);

		WITH RankedSilos AS (
			SELECT	osu.row_id,
					osu.silo_seq,
					osu.jb_item_id,
					osu.latest_aut_silo,
					osu.su_ent_id,
				   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY osu.jb_item_id ORDER BY osu.jb_item_id DESC, osu.silo_seq ASC) AS order_number
			FROM ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id AND osu.oper_id = j.oper_id AND osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no AND jb.item_id = jb_item_id -- v 0.06.00 added
														AND jb.bom_pos IN (SELECT CASE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT WHEN 1 THEN bom_pos WHEN 0 THEN 0 END FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = j.wo_id AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND seq_no = j.seq_no AND item_id = jb_item_id AND bom_pos <= 0 ) -- v 0.06.00 added
			LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.su_ent_id = ea.ent_id -- v0.11 Updated as CASE was not needed
															   AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																				 FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																				 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id IS NOT NULL then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
			WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id 
				AND osu.oper_id = @oper_id 
				AND osu.seq_no = @seq_no 
				AND osu.dest_type = 2 
				AND is_chk = 1
		)
		UPDATE ofi_su_selection
		SET active_su_ent_id =   CASE 
									WHEN r.latest_aut_silo = 0
										THEN r.su_ent_id --valid
									WHEN r.latest_aut_silo IS NULL AND r.order_number = 1 
										THEN r.su_ent_id
									ELSE NULL 
								END 
		FROM RankedSilos r
		WHERE ofi_su_selection.row_id = r.row_id;
		---------- End Logic For Destination ----------------------
		---------- For Source ----------------------
		INSERT @SourceList
		SELECT su_ent_id,jb_item_id,row_id 
		FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1 AND is_chk = 1 
		-- AND active_su_ent_id is null -- v0.5: REMOVED we should always update all silos

		SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceList

		SET @Counter = 1

		WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SiloEntId=su_ent_id, @JBItemId = jb_item_id, @RowId = row_id 
			FROM @SourceList
			WHERE id = @Counter

			-- v0.05.00 Updated to align it with NextSUinQueue and GetSUDetails sent to AUT:
			--case 
			--when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
			SET active_su_ent_id =	CASE 
										WHEN (dest_type = 1 AND latest_aut_silo = 0)
											THEN secondary_silo_ent_id
										ELSE su_ent_id
									END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and row_id=@RowId

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
		END
	END
	IF (@operation = 'Stop')
	BEGIN
		---------- For Destination and Source ----------------------
		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = NULL
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null
		END
	END
	IF (@operation = 'NextSource')
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @SiloEntId = ent_id FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' and attr_grp = 2)
			  AND attr_value = CAST(@old_silo_aut as NVARCHAR(100))

		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId))
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SecondarySiloEntId=secondary_silo_ent_id, @SecondarySiloName = secondary_silo FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId

			IF NOT (@SecondarySiloEntId = 0 AND (@SecondarySiloName = '' OR @SecondarySiloName IS NULL))
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Silo Source Available'

				UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = @SecondarySiloEntId
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Secondary Silo Source Not Available'
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			PRINT 'Silo Source Not Registered'
		END
	END
	IF (@operation = 'NextDestination')
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @SiloEntId = ent_id FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' and attr_grp = 2)
			  AND attr_value = CAST(@old_silo_aut as NVARCHAR(100))

		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId))
		BEGIN
			SELECT @JBItemId=jb_item_id, @SiloSeq = silo_seq FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq > @SiloSeq and jb_item_id =@JBItemId )
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Silo Dest Available'
				SELECT TOP 1 @SecondarySiloEntId = su_ent_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq > @SiloSeq and jb_item_id =@JBItemId

				SELECT @MinSeq = min(silo_seq) FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and jb_item_id =@JBItemId

				-- Disable previous silo v0.02.00
				UPDATE ofi_su_selection
				SET active_su_ent_id = NULL, is_chk = NULL
				, silo_seq = NULL --0.04.00
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 
				and jb_item_id = @JBItemId 
				and su_ent_id = @SiloEntId

				-- Enable next silo v0.02.00
				UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
				SET active_su_ent_id = @SecondarySiloEntId
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
				--and silo_seq = @MinSeq 
				and su_ent_id = @SecondarySiloEntId
				and jb_item_id = @JBItemId
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Secondary Silo Destination N\A'

			END
		END
	END

	IF (@operation = 'DownloadDestination')
	BEGIN
		-- Dest Change ::  Set the SENT destination to DCS as 'active'

		SELECT @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = ea.attr_value 
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		WHERE ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'ShareCoProdSiloToAUT' and attr_grp=2)
			AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
 
		SET @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT  = ISNULL(@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT,0);

		WITH RankedSilos AS (
			SELECT	osu.row_id,
					osu.silo_seq,
					osu.jb_item_id,
					osu.latest_aut_silo,
					osu.su_ent_id,
				   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY osu.jb_item_id ORDER BY osu.jb_item_id DESC, osu.silo_seq ASC) AS order_number
			FROM ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id AND osu.oper_id = j.oper_id AND osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no AND jb.item_id = jb_item_id -- v 0.06.00 added
														AND jb.bom_pos IN (SELECT CASE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT WHEN 1 THEN bom_pos WHEN 0 THEN 0 END FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = j.wo_id AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND seq_no = j.seq_no AND item_id = jb_item_id AND bom_pos <= 0 ) -- v 0.06.00 added
			LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.su_ent_id = ea.ent_id -- v0.11 Updated as CASE was not needed
															   AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																				 FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																				 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id IS NOT NULL then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
			WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id 
				AND osu.oper_id = @oper_id 
				AND osu.seq_no = @seq_no 
				AND osu.dest_type = 2 
				AND is_chk = 1
		)
		UPDATE ofi_su_selection
		SET active_su_ent_id =   CASE 
									WHEN r.latest_aut_silo = 0
										THEN r.su_ent_id --valid
									WHEN r.latest_aut_silo IS NULL AND r.order_number = 1 
										THEN r.su_ent_id
									ELSE NULL 
								END 
		FROM RankedSilos r
		WHERE ofi_su_selection.row_id = r.row_id;
	END

	IF (@operation = 'DownloadSource')
	BEGIN
		INSERT @SourceList
		SELECT su_ent_id,jb_item_id,row_id 
		FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1 AND is_chk = 1 
		-- AND active_su_ent_id is null -- v0.5: REMOVED we should always update all silos

		SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) 
		FROM @SourceList

		SET @Counter = 1

		WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SiloEntId=su_ent_id, @JBItemId = jb_item_id, @RowId = row_id 
			FROM @SourceList
			WHERE id = @Counter

			-- v0.05.00 Updated to align it with NextSUinQueue and GetSUDetails sent to AUT:
			--case 
			--when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
			SET active_su_ent_id =	CASE 
										WHEN (dest_type = 1 AND latest_aut_silo = 0)
											THEN secondary_silo_ent_id
										ELSE su_ent_id
									END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and row_id=@RowId

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
		END

	END

	IF (@operation = 'DownloadSilo')
	BEGIN
		INSERT @SourceList
		SELECT su_ent_id,jb_item_id,row_id 
		FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1 AND is_chk = 1 
		-- AND active_su_ent_id is null -- v0.5: REMOVED we should always update all silos

		SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceList

		SET @Counter = 1

		WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SiloEntId=su_ent_id, @JBItemId = jb_item_id, @RowId = row_id 
			FROM @SourceList
			WHERE id = @Counter

			-- v0.05.00 Updated to align it with NextSUinQueue and GetSUDetails sent to AUT:
			--case 
			--when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
			SET active_su_ent_id =	CASE 
										WHEN (dest_type = 1 AND latest_aut_silo = 0)
											THEN secondary_silo_ent_id
										ELSE su_ent_id
									END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and row_id=@RowId

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
		END

		-- Dest Change ::  Set the SENT destination to DCS as 'active'
		-- v 0.05.00 added
		SELECT @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = ea.attr_value 
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		WHERE ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'ShareCoProdSiloToAUT' and attr_grp=2)
			AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
 
		SET @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT  = ISNULL(@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT,0);

		WITH RankedSilos AS (
			SELECT	osu.row_id,
					osu.silo_seq,
					osu.jb_item_id,
					osu.latest_aut_silo,
					osu.su_ent_id,
				   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY osu.jb_item_id ORDER BY osu.jb_item_id DESC, osu.silo_seq ASC) AS order_number
			FROM ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id AND osu.oper_id = j.oper_id AND osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no AND jb.item_id = jb_item_id -- v 0.06.00 added
														AND jb.bom_pos IN (SELECT CASE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT WHEN 1 THEN bom_pos WHEN 0 THEN 0 END FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = j.wo_id AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND seq_no = j.seq_no AND item_id = jb_item_id AND bom_pos <= 0 ) -- v 0.06.00 added
			LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.su_ent_id = ea.ent_id -- v0.11 Updated as CASE was not needed
															   AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																				 FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																				 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id IS NOT NULL then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
			WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id 
				AND osu.oper_id = @oper_id 
				AND osu.seq_no = @seq_no 
				AND osu.dest_type = 2 
				AND is_chk = 1
		)
		UPDATE ofi_su_selection
		SET active_su_ent_id =   CASE 
									WHEN r.latest_aut_silo = 0
										THEN r.su_ent_id --valid
									WHEN r.latest_aut_silo IS NULL AND r.order_number = 1 
										THEN r.su_ent_id
									ELSE NULL 
								END 
		FROM RankedSilos r
		WHERE ofi_su_selection.row_id = r.row_id;
	END
	
	IF(@oper_id = 'cakeblending' and @operation = 'Start') --- This is to maintain history of base dosing to use in BOM Correction and update Job_bom cumulative on every correction
    BEGIN
        EXEC Sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,null,null,'setup',0
    END
END
