CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogout]
(
		@session_id				INT
	,	@user_id				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@ent_id					INT
	,	@step_no				INT
	,	@lot_no					NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@sublot_no				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@event_time_local		DATETIME = NULL
	,	@job_pos				INT = 0
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.6.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 01/08/2003		Rohit			1.5.0	Added string Id reference to the err message.
-- 02/06/03 		Rohit		  			Check if the entity can capture labor,if not then exit without doing anything.
-- 04/17/2003		Raghu			1.6.0 	Steps are lot specific. If user logs out from a step, adjust the percentage among
--											all the steps.
--											If the user logs out from a specific lot (if the user has logged into multiple lots,
--											then adjust the pct for all lots within the step)
-- 06-06-2003		Sheetal Jain	1.6.0.1 Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 12/01/2003		Raghu			2.0.13	(HD# 3879) Handling steps with multiple job execs.
-- 06/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included NULL value for last_edit_comment field while calling sp_I_Labor_Usage.
--											Also added last_edit_by and last_edit_at in insert statements
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/13/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--01/17/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00073994; Cannot logout from a step.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @log_id					INT
		,	@return					INT
		,	@can_capture_labor		BIT
		,	@ent_pct_to_apply		FLOAT
		,	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply 	FLOAT
		,	@total_pct_lab_to_apply	FLOAT
		,	@cur_wo_id				NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_oper_id			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_seq_no				INT
		,	@last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@event_time_utc			DATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value


	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Check if the entity can capture labor,if not then exit without doing anything
	SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor FROM ent WHERE ent_id =@ent_id
	IF (@job_pos IS NULL) SET @job_pos = 0

	SELECT @cur_wo_id = je.cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = je.cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE je.ent_id= @ent_id AND je.job_pos = @job_pos

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND step_no = @step_no AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot Logout as step is not logged on by this user: %d{3159}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value,  @server_time = @event_time OUTPUT
	IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) 	SELECT @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL), @event_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()
	ELSE SET @event_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @event_time_local)

	IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN
		UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND step_no = @step_no
		  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
		  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
		RETURN 0
	END

	SELECT @ent_pct_to_apply = ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply
	FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE session_id = @session_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id

	--Check if the steps are logged in Multiple lots, if yes, logout the step from that lot and adjust the
	--percentage for that step within that lot.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND step_no = @step_no AND lot_no <> @lot_no
			  AND sublot_no <> @sublot_no) BEGIN

		SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(pct_to_apply) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
		  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND step_no = @step_no

		SELECT @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = pct_to_apply FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
		  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND step_no = @step_no AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)

		INSERT INTO labor_usage
		(
			labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
			dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		SELECT	@event_time_utc
			,	@event_time_local
			,	user_id
			,	ent_id
			,	wo_id
			,	oper_id
			,	seq_no
			,	step_no
			,	item_id
			,	lot_no
			,	lab_cd
			,	dept_id
			,	shift_id
			,	shift_start_utc
			,	shift_start_local
			,	(	CASE WHEN (@total_pct_lab_to_apply - @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = 0) THEN 0
					ELSE (pct_to_apply/(@total_pct_lab_to_apply - @cur_pct_lab_to_apply))*@total_pct_lab_to_apply
					END
				) As pct_to_apply
			,	active
			,	0
			,	comments
			,	@last_edit_by
			,	dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
				labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
				wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
				oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
				seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
				labor_usage.active = 1 AND
				step_no = @step_no AND
				lot_no <> @lot_no

		SET @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
		WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND step_no = @step_no
		  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc)

		UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id

	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Steps are not logged into multiple lots. Hence remove the step from this lot and adjust
		--the step percentage among all the other steps
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
				  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				  AND step_no <> @step_no) BEGIN

			SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(pct_to_apply) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

			SELECT @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = pct_to_apply FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND step_no = @step_no

			INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
				dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			SELECT	@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
					dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
					(
						CASE WHEN (@total_pct_lab_to_apply - @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = 0) THEN 0
						ELSE (pct_to_apply/(@total_pct_lab_to_apply - @cur_pct_lab_to_apply))*@total_pct_lab_to_apply
						END
					) As pct_to_apply,
					active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id
				AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				AND labor_usage.active = 1 AND step_no <> @step_no

			SET @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
			WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc)
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

			UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
		--User has logged out from all the steps, but may still working on this entity, in this case default to NULL
		--default to NULL ONLY if there were no concurrent jobs else close this labor record

			INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
				dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			SELECT	@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, NULL, item_id, NULL, lab_cd,
					dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by,
					dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_usage.active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

			SET @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
			WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc
			  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no)

			UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
		END
	END

RETURN 0
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
-- Description: This is used to prepare the RM/SFG/FG materials report based on WIP consumptions
-- Note : Only NIBs has been tested
--			Liquor Loadout testing now
--
-- Runs before: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport; 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2024-07-25			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2025-02-06			Removed the filter for the ONLY NIBS
-- 0.01.02	JSC				2025-02-10			Fixed wrong link for INTERMEDIATE wip reports
-- 0.01.03	JSC				2025-02-10			Added the STRING_AGG function to avoid duplicates in ofi table
-- 0.01.04	JSC				2025-02-12			Added fix to prevent miss reporting WIP composition if another is still pending
-- 0.01.05	JSC				2025-02-13			Added fix to allow reblend in reblended liquors
-- 0.01.06  JSC				2025-06-30			Added fix to STRING_AGG to limit it to max size of column in target 80 chars
-- 0.01.07	JSC				2025-07-02			Added default output when info is empty
-- 0.01.08	JSC				2025-07-02			Added check for SkipConsumptionReporting in TO BE reported RM or SFG
-- 0.01.09	MC				2025-09-23			Added configurable delay for WIP consumption and make possible to prepwork more than one WIP cons record
-- 0.01.10	MC				2025-10-28			Exclude MES worokres to be prepared for reporting
-- 0.01.11  AML, XPM	    2026-06-29          Filter out 'T' traceability sublots 
-- ===========================================================================================
--EXEC sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- SP NAME: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork
	-- Declare general variables 
	DECLARE     
		 @internal_precision  	INT   = 7     -- Used for rounding of values to use in internal calculations
		,@reporting_precision 	INT   = 3     -- Used for rounding of values to use in reporting output
		,@to_report_perc      	FLOAT = 1  	-- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_cons	  	FLOAT = 1   -- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_cons_erp  	FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_total_cons	FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
		,@error_msg           	NVARCHAR(MAX) -- Error handling
		,@error_severity      	INT           -- Error handling
		,@error_state         	INT           -- Error handling
		,@debug            		BIT   = 0 -- Used for internal DEBUG -- SET to zero before deployment
		,@pending_cons  		FLOAT = 0 -- UPDATED to FLOAT
		-- 0.01.09 new variables
		,@cutoff_date			DATETIME
		,@delay_hours			INT = 4
	
	-- Declare variables for STEP 1
	DECLARE @row_id				INT = -1
		,@ent_id				INT
		,@item_grp				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cons_lot				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cons_sublot			NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty	FLOAT
		,@cur_wo_id          	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_cons_qty 			FLOAT
		,@parent_ent_id			INT
		,@sublotcounter_attr_id INT
		,@cur_ent_sublot_no 	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_created_at		DATETIME

	
	-- 0.01.09 Calculate cutoff date for eligible records
    SET @cutoff_date = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -@delay_hours, GETUTCDATE())), 0);

	-- 0.01.09 Add applock to avoid race with ToReport SP
	DECLARE @rc INT;
	EXEC @rc = sys.sp_getapplock
		 @DbPrincipal = N'dbo',
		 @Resource    = N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK',
		 @LockMode    = N'Exclusive',
		 @LockOwner   = N'Session',
		 @LockTimeout = 5000;  -- no wait; return immediately

	IF (@rc < 0)
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Skipped: another session holds WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK.';
		RETURN;
	END


	-- STEP 1: Get TOP 1 oldest WIP/INTERMEDIATE Consumption record with quantity left to be reported
	-- Verify current sublot number running on the WIP production line
	SELECT TOP 1 
		 @row_id        		= ic.row_id
		,@ent_id            	= ic.from_ent_id
		,@item_grp          	= ia.attr_value
		,@cons_lot          	= ic.lot_no
		,@cons_sublot       	= ic.sublot_no
		,@cur_cons_qty 			= qty_cons
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty 		= qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0)
		,@cur_wo_id 			= ic.wo_id
		,@cur_created_at		= ic.created_at_utc
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
											AND ia.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.process_id = w.process_id 
												AND oa.oper_id = ic.oper_id
												AND oa.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'NotConsumeToSAP'
																	AND attr_grp = 7
															)																
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ie.item_id
												AND ic.wo_id = ie.wo_id
	CROSS APPLY
		[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_ValidateWIPReportSublot] (ic.lot_no, ic.sublot_no) AS vs 
	WHERE qty_cons_erp < qty_cons
		-- Retreive only consumption records older than 20 minutes
		--AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,COALESCE(ic.last_edit_at,ic.created_at_utc),GETUTCDATE())>=20  
		---- 0.01.09 Retrive only consumption records olther than cutoff date
		AND COALESCE(ic.last_edit_at, ic.created_at_utc) < @cutoff_date
		-- INTERMEDIATE material class consumptions
		AND i.item_class_id IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
		-- Get only NIBs -- or Liquor (TO BE CHECKED)
		--AND ( ia.attr_value LIKE '%NIBS')   -- v1.01 REMOVED!
			 --OR ia.attr_VALUE  LIKE '%liquor')
		-- Prevent items to be reported when SkipConsumptionReporting is set
		AND ( ISNULL(ia2.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
		-- Prevent BACKFLUSH to be reported to SAP
		AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1
		-- Only consumptions with source entity are allowed
		AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
		-- Prevent reporting from Operations configured with NotConsumeToSAP
		AND ( ISNULL(oa.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
		-- Validate that sublot_no is not the current sublot being produced and if it was, wait at least 20 minutes
		AND ( 
				( 
					vs.prod_sublot_no <> ic.sublot_no 				 
					OR
					( vs.prod_sublot_no = ic.sublot_no
						AND vs.prod_job_state_cd <> 3  -- 3 means RUNNING
					)
				)
				AND vs.cons_sublot = ic.sublot_no
				AND vs.cons_lot = ic.lot_no
				AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,COALESCE(vs.prod_last_edit_at,GETUTCDATE()-100),GETUTCDATE())>=20  
			)
		-- Prevent 'non-traceable' consumptions to lock the reporting
		AND ic.wo_id IS NOT NULL 
		AND ISNULL(w.spare1,'0') = '1' --0.01.10 take only SAP wo
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.11
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.fg_sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.11
	ORDER BY ic.last_edit_at ASC

	-- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
	IF (@row_id IS NULL OR @row_id = -1)
	BEGIN		
		-- v0.01.07
		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		--0.01.09 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END
	
	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 @row_id AS 'row_id'
				,@ent_id AS '@ent_id'
				,@item_grp AS '@item_grp'
				,@cons_lot AS '@cons_lot'
				,@cons_sublot AS '@cons_sublot'
				,@cur_cons_qty AS '@cur_cons_qty'
				,@cur_pending_cons_qty AS '@cur_pending_cons_qty'
				,@cur_wo_id AS '@cur_wo_id'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Declare variables for STEP 2
	DECLARE @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
		
	-- Declare variables for STEP 3
	DECLARE  @total_wip_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT

	-- Declare variables for STEP 4
	DECLARE @final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	-- Declare variables for STEP 5
	DECLARE  @cur_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			
	-- STEPs 2 - 5: Added into a Function:
	SELECT   @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio = wip_cons_qty_ratio
			,@final_cons_declaration = final_cons_declaration
			,@cur_rm_cons_to_report = cur_rm_cons_to_report
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
	FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (@cons_lot,@cons_sublot,@cur_pending_cons_qty)


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 2'
				,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty AS '@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty'
				,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp AS '@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp'

	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 3'
				,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty AS '@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty'
				,@wip_cons_qty_ratio AS '@wip_cons_qty_ratio'

	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 4'
				,@final_cons_declaration AS '@final_cons_declaration'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 5'
				,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty AS '@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty'
				,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp AS '@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp'
				,@cur_rm_cons_to_report AS '@cur_rm_cons_to_report'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --


	-- Declare variables for STEP 6
	DECLARE @cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio FLOAT

	-- STEP 6: Calculate the ratio of RM/SFG/FG to be reported on current row versus the total consumed for the sublot
	SET @cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio = @cur_rm_cons_to_report/@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 6'
				,@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio AS '@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Declare variables for STEP 7
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows AS TABLE ( 	 qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 
										,spare3 NVARCHAR(80) 
										,intermediate INT
										,intermediate_processed INT
										,created_at_local DATETIME 
										,fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,intermediate_row_id INT
										,SkipConsumptionReporting INT
									--	,PRIMARY KEY (row_id)
									)



	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows

	-- STEP 7: Get all rows from RM/SFG/FG related to the cur sublot to be reported on
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows
	SELECT 	ic.qty_cons
			,ic.qty_cons_erp
			,ic.lot_no
			,ic.sublot_no
			,ic.row_id
			,ic.spare1
			,ic.spare3
			,CASE 
				WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
					THEN 1
				ELSE 0
				END 
			,0
			,ic.created_at_local
			,ic.fg_lot_no
			,ic.fg_sublot_no
			,0
			,ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,ia2.attr_value),0) -- ADDED: v1.08
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id   --- ADDED: v1.08
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cons_lot 
		AND ic.fg_sublot_no=@cons_sublot
		AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.11
	--	AND CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)=0  --  v1.04: Removed so we can findout if something is pending

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 'STEP 7',*,qty_cons_erp/qty_cons as 'ratio' FROM @rm_cons_rows ORDER BY row_id asc
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Added v1.04: Verify if there is any pending consumption to be reported and abort this one.
	-- Calculate the amount of pending consumption quantity

	--00.01.09 skipped as we want to handle pending messages
	/*
	SELECT @pending_cons = ISNULL(SUM(CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)),0.0)
	FROM @rm_cons_rows ic
	WHERE ic.SkipConsumptionReporting = 0
		AND ic.[intermediate] = 0
	*/
	-- STEP 7.1: Verify if we have any pending consumptions quantity the expected materials, and skip this round if so.
	-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
	IF (@debug = 0 AND @pending_cons > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
		SET [last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work: SKIP (Consumptions PENDING)'
		,[last_edit_at]=DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, [last_edit_at])
		WHERE [row_id] = @row_id
		
		--0.01.09 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
		-- exit SP
		RETURN;
	END
	-- preSTEP8: Update rm_cons_row with all pending qty in ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported table
	UPDATE rcr
	SET rcr.qty_cons_erp = rcr.qty_cons_erp + ISNULL(cwr.pending_cons,0)
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rcr
	JOIN (
		SELECT item_cons_row_id, SUM(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,3),spare1),0)) as pending_cons
		FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
		GROUP BY item_cons_row_id
		) cwr ON rcr.row_id=cwr.item_cons_row_id

	-- STEP 8: Calculate for each consumption row of RM/SFG/FG that belongs to the sublot the spare1 (qty to report)
	UPDATE @rm_cons_rows 
	SET spare1 = CASE 
					WHEN (@final_cons_declaration = 1)
						THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
					WHEN (@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
					ELSE ROUND(((@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio)*qty_cons),@reporting_precision,2)
				 END
				 

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 'STEP 8',*,spare1/qty_cons as 'ratio',(spare1+qty_cons_erp)/qty_cons as 'ratio' FROM @rm_cons_rows ORDER BY row_id asc
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END--

	-- Declare variables for STEP 9
	DECLARE  @total_processed_intermediate INT = 0
			,@total_intermediate INT = 0

	DECLARE @cur_wip_row_id      		INT
			,@cur_wip_cons_lot_no       NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_fg_lot_no 	    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_fg_sublot_no	    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_cons_spare1		NVARCHAR(80)
			,@total_step_cons_qty		FLOAT
			,@total_step_cons_qty_erp 	FLOAT
			,@intermediate_row_id 		INT -- v1.05: Added to follow up sources
			
	-- Declare variables for STEP 9.4
	DECLARE  @total_step_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_step_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			
	DECLARE  @total_step_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@step_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT
			
	DECLARE  @step_final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	DECLARE  @step_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			



	-- STEP 9: While WIPs are found in the table from [6] and not rechecked completely; we should search upstream for RM/SFG/FG,
	--	    add any found consumptions in the table variable and mark the WIP as 'processed'.

	-- STEP 9.1:  Get the total intermedia WIP to be checked (WIP consumed to produce WIP)
	SELECT 	 @total_processed_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate_processed,0))									
			,@total_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate,0))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 1

	-- 9.1.1 prepare verification of pending reports
	SET @pending_cons = 0

	-- STEP 9.2: Start the WHILE loop 
	WHILE @total_intermediate > @total_processed_intermediate
	BEGIN
		
		-- STEP 9.3:  Get one WIP consumption from those to be reported and go upstream
		SELECT TOP 1
			 @cur_wip_row_id      		= rc.row_id
			,@cur_wip_cons_lot_no       = rc.lot_no
			,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no    = rc.sublot_no
			,@cur_wip_fg_lot_no 	    = rc.fg_lot_no
			,@cur_wip_fg_sublot_no	    = rc.fg_sublot_no
			,@cur_wip_cons_spare1		= rc.spare1
			,@intermediate_row_id		= rc.intermediate_row_id  -- v1.05: Added
		FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
		WHERE rc.intermediate = 1 and rc.intermediate_processed = 0
		
		-- STEP 9.4: Calculate ratio of reporting WIP consumption of the step
		SELECT   @total_step_sublot_cons_qty = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
				,@total_step_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp
				,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
				,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp
				,@step_cons_qty_ratio = wip_cons_qty_ratio
				,@step_final_cons_declaration = final_cons_declaration
				,@step_rm_cons_to_report = cur_rm_cons_to_report
				,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty
				,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
		FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (@cur_wip_cons_lot_no,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no,@cur_wip_cons_spare1)
			

		-- STEP 9.5: Insert the new consumptions from WIP
		INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows
		SELECT 	ic.qty_cons
				,ic.qty_cons_erp + ISNULL(cwr.pending_cons,0)	-- 0.01.09 - to consider pending spare1
				,ic.lot_no
				,ic.sublot_no
				,ic.row_id
				,CASE											-- 0.01.09 - to consider pending spare1
						WHEN (@step_final_cons_declaration = 1)
							THEN (qty_cons-(qty_cons_erp + ISNULL(cwr.pending_cons,0))) 
						WHEN (@step_cons_qty_ratio*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-(qty_cons_erp + ISNULL(cwr.pending_cons,0))) 
							THEN (qty_cons-(qty_cons_erp + ISNULL(cwr.pending_cons,0))) 
						ELSE ROUND(((@step_cons_qty_ratio)*qty_cons),@reporting_precision,2)
					 END
				,ic.spare3
				,CASE 
					WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
						THEN 1
					ELSE 0
					END 
				,0
				,ic.created_at_local
				,ic.fg_lot_no
				,ic.fg_sublot_no
				,CASE											-- v1.05: Modified to include parent
						WHEN (@intermediate_row_id = 0)
							THEN @cur_wip_row_id         --from WIP
						ELSE
							@intermediate_row_id		-- from PARENT WIP
					END
				,ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,ia2.attr_value),0) -- ADDED: v1.08
		FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = ic.item_id   --- ADDED: v1.08
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
		LEFT JOIN (											-- 0.01.09 - to consider pending spare1
			SELECT item_cons_row_id, SUM(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,3),spare1),0)) as pending_cons
			FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
			GROUP BY item_cons_row_id
		) cwr ON ic.row_id=cwr.item_cons_row_id
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no 
			AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
			AND CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)=0
			AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.11

		-- STEP 9.6: Verify that we don't have any pending consumptions for this set:
		-- Calculate the amount of pending consumption quantity
		-- 0.01.09 - disable as we want to handle pending ones
		/*
		SELECT @pending_cons = @pending_cons + ISNULL(SUM(CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)),0.0)
		FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = ic.item_id   --- ADDED: v1.08
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no 
			AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
			-- Prevent items to be reported when SkipConsumptionReporting is set   -- ADDED v1.08
			AND ( ISNULL(ia2.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
	
		*/
		-- STEP 9.7:  Update the current row as processed
		UPDATE @rm_cons_rows
		SET intermediate_processed = 1
		WHERE intermediate = 1
			AND lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no
			AND sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_fg_lot_no
			AND fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_fg_sublot_no -- v.1.02 FIXED was pointing to cons sublot
			AND row_id = @cur_wip_row_id
			AND spare1 = @cur_wip_cons_spare1 -- v1.05 Added to prevent marking duplicates as processed

		-- STEP 9.8: Set the current values for this loop
		SELECT   @total_processed_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate_processed,0))									
				,@total_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate,0))
		FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
		WHERE rc.intermediate = 1
	END

	-- Added v1.04: Verify if there is any pending consumption to be reported and abort this one.
	-- STEP 9.8: Verify if we have any pending consumptions quantity the expected materials, and skip this round if so.
	-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
	IF (@debug = 0 AND @pending_cons > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
		SET [last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work: SKIP (WIP Consumptions PENDING)'
		,[last_edit_at]=DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, [last_edit_at])
		WHERE [row_id] = @row_id
		
		--0.01.09 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
		-- exit SP
		RETURN;
	END


	-- Declare variables for STEP 10
	DECLARE  @rm_total_spare1 FLOAT
			,@wip_total_reported_ratio FLOAT
			,@wip_total_reported FLOAT

	-- STEP 10: Calculate actuals to be reported from spare1 in table variable
	SELECT @rm_total_spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) 
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0

	SET @wip_total_reported_ratio = @rm_total_spare1/@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty

	SET @wip_total_reported = @wip_total_reported_ratio*@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty

	-- Aggregate any repeating row_ids
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows_to_report AS TABLE (								
										qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 								
									)

	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report

	
	-- Insert aggregated
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows_to_report
	SELECT   rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
			,spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0
		AND rc.SkipConsumptionReporting = 0 -- ADDED: v0.01.08
	GROUP BY  rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
	HAVING SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) <> 0.000

	-- ADDED v1.08
	
	-- Aggregate any repeating row_ids
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report AS TABLE (								
										qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 								
									)

	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report

	-- Insert aggregated
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report
	SELECT   rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
			,spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0
		AND rc.SkipConsumptionReporting = 1 
	GROUP BY  rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
	HAVING SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) <> 0.000

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 	 @rm_total_spare1 AS '@rm_total_spare1'
				,@wip_total_reported_ratio AS '@wip_total_reported_ratio'
				,@wip_total_reported as '@wip_total_reported'
				
		SELECT * FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report

		SELECT * FROM @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END--
		
	BEGIN TRY
	
		-- STEP 10.1: Start Transaction:
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;


		-- STEP 11: Add values to staging table, including the wo_id variable
		INSERT INTO ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported
		SELECT 	 rcr1.row_id
				,rcr1.lot_no
				,rc.fg_lot_no
				,rcr1.sublot_no
				,rc.fg_sublot_no
				,rcr1.qty_cons
				,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
				,rcr1.spare1
				,rc.spare3
				,'INSERTED for EI Report of WIPs'						
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,RIGHT(STRING_AGG(rc.intermediate_row_id,','),80)
				,@row_id
				,@cur_wo_id
				,@cur_created_at
				,NULL
		FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report rcr1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @rm_cons_rows rc ON rcr1.row_id = rc.row_id
		GROUP BY  	 rcr1.row_id
					,rcr1.lot_no
					,rc.fg_lot_no
					,rcr1.sublot_no
					,rc.fg_sublot_no
					,rcr1.qty_cons
					,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
					,rcr1.spare1
					,rc.spare3
		
		-- v 0.01.07 Get default output if no row is found:
		DECLARE @output_rows INT


		-- STEP 11.1: Select as OUTPUT
		SELECT DISTINCT	 rcr1.qty_cons
				,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
				,rcr1.lot_no
				,rcr1.sublot_no
				,rcr1.row_id
				,rcr1.spare1
				,rc.spare3
				,rc.created_at_local
				,rc.fg_lot_no
				,rc.fg_sublot_no
		FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report rcr1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @rm_cons_rows rc ON rcr1.row_id = rc.row_id

		SET @output_rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF @output_rows <= 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		END

		-- STEP 12: Update the item_cons table spare1 based on the values from [11] table variable
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		-- 0.01.09 -- skipped as we dont know to update item_cons until it is processed on ToReport
		/*
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ic
			SET ic.spare1 = rc.spare1
				,ic.last_edit_comment = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work'
			FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @rm_cons_rows_to_report rc ON ic.row_id = rc.row_id			
		END
		*/
		-- ADDED v1.08
		-- STEP 12.1 Update item_cons for those 'skipconsumptionreport' rows
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ic
			SET  ic.[qty_cons_erp] = ic.[qty_cons_erp] + rc.spare1
				,ic.spare1 = NULL
				,ic.last_edit_comment = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work + Skipped by attribute'
			FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report rc ON ic.row_id = rc.row_id			
		END

		-- STEP 13: Update the item_cons table on WIPs reported erp column value with the 'theoretical' value
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
			SET [qty_cons_erp] = [qty_cons_erp] + @cur_pending_cons_qty 
				,[last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work'
			WHERE [row_id] = @row_id

		END
	
		-- STEP 13.1: Commit transaction.
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		--0.01.03 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		
		--0.01.09 release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		SELECT 	 @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE()
				,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
				,@error_state = ERROR_STATE();
				
		RAISERROR(   @error_msg
					,@error_severity
					,@error_state
				)
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Result_Attr]
(@sample_id int,
 @char_id int,
 @value_no int,
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime
)
 AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Sample_Class
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author         -
-- Date Created     - 04/26/2011
-- Version          -
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 01/22/2018	  Surya		    6.0      US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2      US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 11

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT result_attr.sample_id
    ,result_attr.char_id
    ,result_attr.value_no
    ,result_attr.attr_id
    ,result_attr.attr_value
    ,result_attr.notes
    ,attr.attr_desc
    ,attr.predefined
    ,attr.data_type
    ,attr.entry_type
    ,attr.visible_in_queue
    ,attr.visible_in_inv
    ,result_attr.last_edit_comment
    ,result_attr.last_edit_by
    ,result_attr.last_edit_at
FROM result_attr result_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON result_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((result_attr.sample_id = @sample_id OR @sample_id IS NULL) AND
       (result_attr.char_id = @char_id OR @char_id IS NULL) AND
       (result_attr.value_no = @value_no OR @value_no IS NULL) AND
       (result_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (result_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL)  AND
       (result_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (result_attr.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
      )
ORDER BY result_attr.sample_id, attr.attr_desc;
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_spec_ver_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_spec_ver]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_spec_ver_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_spec_ver table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id 	FROM oper_spec_ver osv
				INNER JOIN inserted i ON osv.process_id = i.process_id AND osv.oper_id = i.oper_id  AND osv.ver_id = i.ver_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_spec_ver', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_spec_ver osv
				INNER JOIN inserted i ON osv.process_id = i.process_id AND osv.oper_id = i.oper_id  AND osv.ver_id = i.ver_id) opersv
	WHERE process.process_id = opersv.process_id

	UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET oper_spec_ver.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_spec_ver.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_spec_ver.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_spec_ver.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oper_spec_ver.ver_id = i.ver_id

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        sp_I_OFI_CB_Correction_recipe
-- Description: Insert the BOM correction predicted recipe in DB based on correction step.
--
-- Usage:       From which object this script is called.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author                  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)       Change description
-- 0.01.00      AKM                       2022-12-08            Initial version.
-- 0.02.00      JSC                       2025-11-04            CakeBlending fixed udpates.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_OFI_CB_Correction_recipe]
	@wo_id               NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id             NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no              INT,
	@item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
	@qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
	@spare1              NVARCHAR(40), -- correlation id
	@corr_step           INT =NULL
AS
	BEGIN
		-- Check if already recipe has been predicted and insterted in table for current step or not. if not then inster else update.
		IF NOT EXISTS
			(   SELECT 1
				FROM ofi_correction_recipe(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id         =@wo_id
					AND oper_id     =@oper_id
					AND seq_no      =@seq_no
					AND item_id     = @item_id
					AND corr_counter=@corr_step )
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO ofi_correction_recipe
				(   wo_id,
					oper_id,
					seq_no,
					item_id,
					qty_per_parent_item,
					corr_counter,
					spare1
				)
			VALUES
				(   @wo_id,
					@oper_id,
					@seq_no,
					@item_id,
					@qty_per_parent_item,
					@corr_step,
					@spare1
				)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ofi_correction_recipe
			SET
				qty_per_parent_item= @qty_per_parent_item,
				spare1             = @spare1,
				last_edit_at_local = GETDATE(),
				last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE wo_id            = @wo_id
				AND oper_id        = @oper_id
				AND seq_no         = @seq_no
				AND item_id        = @item_id
				AND corr_counter   = @corr_step
		END
	END

--                               crossing the boundary of the time period
-- 12/09/2002 CHD - Added the line "IF @shift_exc_table_name IS NULL SET @shift_exc_table_name =  'shift_exc'"
--			The optional 4th parameter @shift_exc_table_name is defaulted to  'shift_exc'.

--05/07/2004	Raghu	2.0.34 Changed Temp_Shift_Exc table name to appropriate session_id - where the temporary records are identified by its session
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
--03/25/2013	Ravi Teja	4.6		CR L00112664 - Added code to handle when null value is passed for @shift_exc_table_name

--IF @start_date IS NOT NULL SET @start_date = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_date)

--IF @shift_exc_table_name IS NULL  SET @shift_exc_table_name = 0

if @EntIDs IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
	--find the ent_id with can_sched_shifts <> 0
	SET @sched = (SELECT can_sched_shifts from ent WHERE ent_id = @EntIDs )

	WHILE @sched = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @parent_ent_id = (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @EntIDs)
		SET @sched = (SELECT can_sched_shifts from ent WHERE ent_id = @parent_ent_id )
		SELECT @EntIDs = @parent_ent_id
		-- WHILE loop breaks even without this IF @EntIDs = NULL, but ...
		IF @EntIDs IS NULL BREAK
	END --WHILE @sched = 0
END
IF @EntIDs IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO #EntityIDs VALUES (@EntIDs)
END
ELSE--IF @EntIDs IS NOT NULL
BEGIN	--GET ALL ent_ids for which can_sched_shifts <> 0
	INSERT INTO #EntityIDs SELECT ent_id from ent WHERE can_sched_shifts = 1
END

--select * from #EntityIDs

SET @SQLString = @SQLString + @shift_exc_table_name
SET @SQLString = @SQLString + N'  WHERE ent_id IN (SELECT * FROM #EntityIDs)'
SET @SQLString = @SQLString + N' AND start_time < ''' + @end_date_string + N''''
SET @SQLString = @SQLString + N' AND end_time > ''' + @start_date_string + N''''
EXEC sp_executesql @SQLString
*/

IF @shift_exc_table_name = 'shift_exc'
SELECT * FROM shift_exc WHERE ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM #EntityIds)
    AND start_time < @end_date
   AND end_time > @start_date
ELSE
SELECT * FROM temp_shift_exc
WHERE session_id = @shift_exc_table_name
AND ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM #EntityIds)
    AND start_time < @end_date
   AND end_time > @start_date

	,job_exec.suppress_start_qty_prompt
	,job_exec.allow_zero_qty_split
	,job_exec.auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job
            ,job_exec.cur_wo_id
            ,job_exec.cur_oper_id
            ,job_exec.cur_seq_no
            ,job_exec.cur_step_no
            ,job_exec.cur_step_start
            ,job_exec.spare1
            ,job_exec.spare2
            ,job_exec.spare3
            ,job_exec.spare4
            ,job_exec.last_edit_comment
            ,job_exec.last_edit_by
            ,job_exec.last_edit_at
  FROM job_exec job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
  INNER JOIN ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = ent.ent_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_from_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_to_ent_id = ent2.ent_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_reject_ent_id = ent3.ent_id
  INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas  WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_prod_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
  LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas1  WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_exec.def_cons_reas_cd = item_reas1.reas_cd
	WHERE el.session_id = @session_id
	  AND el.user_id = @user_id
	  --If the start time is not specified, then default to all entities.
	  AND (el.start_time > @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL)
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, job_exec.ent_id, job_exec.job_pos
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_data_log_value_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[data_log_value]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - tg_data_log_value_aft_upd
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 01/21/2003
-- Version	      - 1.5.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 01/21/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 1725) When data logs are attached at the operation level, then ent_id may be NULL
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 08/24/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 3657) 1. Disallow updates to the name or type of data_log_value if there is already
--					data collected for a data_log_value
-- 10/27/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Changed to look for ent_id in data_log_grp_ent_link table.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
	@ent_id		INT32,
	@grp_id		INT32,
	@value_index		INT32,
	@cur_value		STRING80,
	@last_edit_by		STRING40,
	@val_exists		INT

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Open a cursor to fetch all the rows, one at a time
	DECLARE data_log_value_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT b.grp_id, b.value_index, b.cur_value
		FROM data_log_value a, inserted b
		WHERE a.grp_id = b.grp_id
		  and a.value_index = b.value_index
	OPEN data_log_value_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM data_log_value_cursor INTO @grp_id, @value_index, @cur_value

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF (UPDATE(VALUE_NAME) OR UPDATE(VALUE_TYPE)) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_IsValExists @grp_id, @value_index, @val_exists OUTPUT

			IF (@val_exists = 1) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Cannot update value_name or value_type as data has been collected for this group and value index{3568}', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		UPDATE data_log_value SET data_log_value.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, data_log_value.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		WHERE data_log_value.grp_id = @grp_id AND data_log_value.value_index = @value_index
	END
	CLOSE data_log_value_cursor
	DEALLOCATE data_log_value_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilByFilter]
(
		@ent_id		  			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_id	  			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_start 		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_start_tz	INT32 = NULL
	,	@shift_start_end		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_end_tz		INT32 = NULL
	,	@event_time_start 		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_start_tz 	INT32 = NULL
	,	@event_time_end			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_end_tz		INT32 = NULL
	,	@min_duration			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@max_duration			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@reas_cd				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@state_cd				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@reas_pending			LOGICAL
	,	@runtime				LOGICAL
	,	@downtime				LOGICAL
	,	@setuptime				LOGICAL
	,	@teardowntime			LOGICAL
	,	@time_category_none		LOGICAL
	,	@fixedtime				LOGICAL
	,	@vartime				LOGICAL
	,	@time_type_neither 		LOGICAL
    ,   @failure                LOGICAL
	,	@comments		  		STRING4000_NULL
	,	@raw_reas_cd         	STRING40_NULL
    ,   @category1              STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category2              STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category3              STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category4              STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_filter_type		INT32 = NULL
	,	@last_n_value			INT32 = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL

) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilByFilter
-- Description	      -	Retrieve utilization records based on the supplied filters
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	11/10/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.25
--
-- Copyright � 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/05/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
--07/21/2008		Raghu			3.5     Sidus 2 Broadway - Middleware DFS; 4.2.2 Util_log.GetUtilByFilter changes.
--09/10/2008		Raghu			3.5		L00083421: Utilization control grid should display raw reason code.
--11/27/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
--01/13/2010        SLR             4.0.0   Added new fields for enhanced calculations
--05/25/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserStory: 711576 - As Lenka, I want the stored procedures related to utilization to use util_history table rather than util_log table (Part 2)
--02/06/2019		Raghu			6.1	UserStory:1116862-As AVEVA, I want to investigate CR L00151416 so that I understand if splitting an event after the time change is an issue in MES 6.0 and consider some options
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @event_time_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@event_time_end_utc     TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_start_utc  TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT32
		,	@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@current_type_time		TDATETIME
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32


    SET @shift_start_start_tz	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
	SET @event_time_start_tz	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@event_time_start_tz)
	SET @event_time_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@event_time_end_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilByFilter', @src_key='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilByFilter',
					@date_val1 = @event_time_start, @numeric_val1 = @event_time_start_tz,
					@date_val2 = @event_time_end,	@numeric_val2 = @event_time_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@event_time_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_start, @tz_temp, @event_time_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@event_time_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_end, @tz_temp, @event_time_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start, @tz_temp, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT


	SELECT @time_category_none = ABS(@time_category_none)
		,@time_type_neither = ABS(@time_type_neither)

	IF (@time_category_none = 0) SET @time_category_none = NULL
	IF (@time_type_neither = 0) SET @time_type_neither = NULL
	SET @time_filter_type = COALESCE(@time_filter_type, 12)

	IF (@time_filter_type IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@time_filter_type < 0 OR @time_filter_type > 12) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg =  'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},TIME_FILTER_TYPE,0,12'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF (@time_filter_type <> 12) BEGIN
		IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},ENT_ID'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
    END

	IF (@time_filter_type = 0 OR @time_filter_type = 4) BEGIN
		IF (@last_n_value IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},LAST_N_VALUE'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF (@time_filter_type = 0) BEGIN
        	--Last N Events
		SELECT @current_type_time = MIN(event_time_utc)
		FROM
			(SELECT ul.event_time_utc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ul.event_time_utc DESC)-1 AS rowiden
				FROM util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ul.ent_id = @ent_id
			) AS last_n_events
		WHERE last_n_events.rowiden <= @last_n_value

		SET @event_time_start_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_start_utc, @current_type_time)
		IF (@event_time_start_utc < @current_type_time) SET @event_time_start_utc = @current_type_time

		SET @event_time_end_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	END
	ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 1) BEGIN
        --Current Shift
        SELECT @shift_start_start_utc = e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
        FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @event_time_start_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_start_utc, @shift_start_start_utc)
		IF (@event_time_start_utc < @shift_start_start_utc)
			SET @event_time_start_utc = @shift_start_start_utc

		SET @event_time_end_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	END
    ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 2) BEGIN
        --Last Shift
		SELECT @shift_start_end_utc = e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		SELECT @shift_start_start_utc = MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
		FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND sh.shift_start_utc < @shift_start_end_utc

		SET @event_time_start_utc = COALESCE(@event_time_start_utc, @shift_start_start_utc)

		IF (@event_time_start_utc < @shift_start_start_utc)
			SET @event_time_start_utc = @shift_start_start_utc

		SET @event_time_end_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	END
    ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 3)
        --This Hour
		SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(13), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00:00', 120)
				,@event_time_end_utc = GETUTCDATE()

	ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 4)
		--Last N Hours
		SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(13), DATEADD(HH, -@last_n_value, GETUTCDATE()), 120) + ':00:00', 120)
				,@event_time_end_utc = GETUTCDATE()

	ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 5)
        --Current day
		SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120)
				, @event_time_end_utc = GETUTCDATE()

	ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 6)
        --Yesterday
		SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE()-1, 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120)
			, @event_time_end_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE()-1, 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120)

    ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 7)
        --Current Week
		SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE() - DATEPART(dw, GETUTCDATE()) + 1, 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120)
			, @event_time_end_utc = GETUTCDATE()

    ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 8)
        --Last Week
        SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE()-7 - DATEPART(dw, GETUTCDATE()-7) + 1, 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120)
			, @event_time_end_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE() - DATEPART(dw, GETUTCDATE()) , 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120)

    ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 9)
        --Current Month
        SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE() - DATEPART(dd, GETUTCDATE()) + 1, 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120)
			, @event_time_end_utc = GETUTCDATE()

    ELSE IF (@time_filter_type = 10)
        --Last Month
        SELECT @event_time_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(mm, -1, GETUTCDATE()) - DATEPART(DD, DATEADD(mm, -1, GETUTCDATE()))+ 1, 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120)
			, @event_time_end_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETUTCDATE()- DATEPART(DD, GETUTCDATE()), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120)

	SELECT @event_time_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@event_time_start_utc)
		, @event_time_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@event_time_end_utc)
		, @shift_start_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@shift_start_start_utc)
		, @shift_start_end_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@shift_start_end_utc)

    IF (@time_filter_type = 12)
		SELECT ul.log_id
			,ul.event_time_utc
			,ul.event_time_local
			,ul.event_time_utc as event_time
			,ul.ent_id
			,e.ent_name
			,ul.shift_id, shift.shift_desc
			,ul.shift_start_utc
			,ul.shift_start_local
			,ul.shift_start_utc as shift_start
			,ul.state_cd
			,us.state_desc, us.color, ul.reas_cd
			,ur.reas_desc
			,ul.reas_pending, ul.runtime, ul.downtime, ul.setuptime, ul.teardowntime, ul.fixedtime
			,ul.vartime, ul.failure, ul.duration AS duration_in_seconds
			,'duration' = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (ul.duration/3600)) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (ul.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (ul.duration%3600)%60)
			,ul.comments
			,ul.raw_reas_cd, ul.category1, ul.category2, ul.category3, ul.category4
            ,jull.wo_id, jull.oper_id, jull.seq_no
			,ul.last_edit_comment, ul.last_edit_by, ul.last_edit_at
		FROM util_log ul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = e.ent_id
		INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 jh.* FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jh.ent_id = ul.ent_id
				  AND jh.job_start_utc = (SELECT MIN(jh1.job_start_utc) FROM job_history jh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
				  			  WHERE jh1.ent_id = ul.ent_id
				  			    AND jh1.job_start_utc < ul.event_end_time_utc
				  			    AND COALESCE(jh1.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > ul.event_time_utc)) jull
		WHERE (ul.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.event_time_utc >= @event_time_start_utc OR @event_time_start_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.event_time_utc <= @event_time_end_utc OR @event_time_end_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.duration >= @min_duration OR @min_duration IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.duration <= @max_duration OR @max_duration IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
		  AND ((ul.runtime = @runtime AND @runtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.downtime = @downtime AND @downtime IS NOT NULL)
			OR (ul.setuptime = @setuptime AND @setuptime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime AND @teardowntime IS NOT NULL)
			OR (@time_category_none = 1 AND @time_category_none IS NOT NULL AND (ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 AND ul.setuptime = 0 AND ul.teardowntime = 0))
			OR (@runtime IS NULL AND @downtime IS NULL AND @setuptime IS NULL AND @teardowntime IS NULL AND @time_category_none IS NULL))
		  AND ((ul.fixedtime = @fixedtime AND @fixedtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.vartime = @vartime AND @vartime IS NOT NULL)
			OR (@time_type_neither = 1 AND @time_type_neither IS NOT NULL AND (ul.fixedtime = 0 AND ul.vartime = 0))
			OR (@fixedtime IS NULL AND @vartime IS NULL AND @time_type_neither IS NULL))
		  AND (ul.failure = @failure OR @failure IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category1 LIKE @category1 OR @category1 IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category2 LIKE @category2 OR @category2 IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category3 LIKE @category3 OR @category3 IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category4 LIKE @category4 OR @category4 IS NULL)
	ELSE
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT u.log_id, u.event_time_utc, u.event_time_local, u.event_time, u.ent_id, u.ent_name, u.shift_id, u.shift_desc,
			u.shift_start_utc, u.shift_start_local, u.shift_start, u.state_cd, u.state_desc, u.color, u.reas_cd, u.reas_desc,
			u.reas_desc, u.reas_pending, u.runtime, u.downtime, u.setuptime, u.teardowntime, u.fixedtime, u.vartime, u.failure,
			u.duration AS duration_in_seconds
			,'duration' = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (u.duration/3600)) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (u.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (u.duration%3600)%60),
			u.comments, u.category1, u.category2, u.category3, u.category4, u.last_edit_comment, u.last_edit_by, u.last_edit_at
		FROM (
		SELECT ul.log_id
            ,CASE WHEN (ul.event_time_utc < @event_time_start_utc) THEN @event_time_start_utc
                  ELSE ul.event_time_utc
             END AS event_time_utc
            ,CASE WHEN (ul.event_time_utc < @event_time_start_utc) THEN dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(ul.ent_id, @event_time_start_utc)
                  ELSE ul.event_time_local
             END AS event_time_local
            ,CASE WHEN (ul.event_time_utc < @event_time_start_utc) THEN @event_time_start_utc
                  ELSE ul.event_time_utc
             END AS event_time
			,ul.ent_id
			,e.ent_name
			,ul.shift_id, shift.shift_desc
			,ul.shift_start_utc
			,ul.shift_start_local
			,ul.shift_start_utc as shift_start
			,ul.state_cd
			,us.state_desc, us.color, ul.reas_cd
			,ur.reas_desc
			,ul.reas_pending, ul.runtime, ul.downtime, ul.setuptime, ul.teardowntime, ul.fixedtime
			,ul.vartime, ul.failure
            ,CASE WHEN (ul.event_time_utc < @event_time_start_utc) AND (DATEADD(ss, ul.duration, ul.event_time_utc) > @event_time_end_utc) THEN DATEDIFF(ss, @event_time_start_utc, @event_time_end_utc)
                  WHEN ul.event_time_utc <= @event_time_start_utc AND DATEADD(ss, ul.duration, ul.event_time_utc) <= @event_time_end_utc THEN ul.duration - DATEDIFF(ss, ul.event_time_utc, @event_time_start_utc)
                  WHEN ul.event_time_utc >= @event_time_start_utc AND DATEADD(SS, ul.duration, ul.event_time_utc) >= @event_time_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ul.event_time_utc, @event_time_end_utc)
                  ELSE ul.duration
             END AS duration
			,ul.comments
			,ul.raw_reas_cd, ul.category1, ul.category2, ul.category3, ul.category4
            ,jull.wo_id, jull.oper_id, jull.seq_no
			,ul.last_edit_comment, ul.last_edit_by, ul.last_edit_at
		FROM util_log ul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = e.ent_id
		INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
		INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 jh.* FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jh.ent_id = ul.ent_id
				  AND jh.job_start_utc = (SELECT MIN(jh1.job_start_utc) FROM job_history jh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
							  WHERE jh1.ent_id = ul.ent_id
							    AND jh1.job_start_utc < ul.event_end_time_utc
					    AND COALESCE(jh1.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > ul.event_time_utc)) jull
		WHERE (ul.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
          AND ((ul.event_time_utc BETWEEN @event_time_start_utc AND @event_time_end_utc)
            OR (DATEADD(SS, ul.duration-1, ul.event_time_utc) BETWEEN @event_time_start_utc AND @event_time_end_utc)
            OR (ul.event_time_utc <= @event_time_start_utc AND DATEADD(SS, ul.duration, ul.event_time_utc) >= @event_time_end_utc))
		  AND (ul.duration >= @min_duration OR @min_duration IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.duration <= @max_duration OR @max_duration IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
		  AND ((ul.runtime = @runtime AND @runtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.downtime = @downtime AND @downtime IS NOT NULL)
			OR (ul.setuptime = @setuptime AND @setuptime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime AND @teardowntime IS NOT NULL)
			OR (@time_category_none = 1 AND @time_category_none IS NOT NULL AND (ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 AND ul.setuptime = 0 AND ul.teardowntime = 0))
			OR (@runtime IS NULL AND @downtime IS NULL AND @setuptime IS NULL AND @teardowntime IS NULL AND @time_category_none IS NULL))
		  AND ((ul.fixedtime = @fixedtime AND @fixedtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.vartime = @vartime AND @vartime IS NOT NULL)
			OR (@time_type_neither = 1 AND @time_type_neither IS NOT NULL AND (ul.fixedtime = 0 AND ul.vartime = 0))
			OR (@fixedtime IS NULL AND @vartime IS NULL AND @time_type_neither IS NULL))
		  AND (ul.failure LIKE @failure OR @failure IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category1 LIKE @category1 OR @category1 IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category2 LIKE @category2 OR @category2 IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category3 LIKE @category3 OR @category3 IS NULL)
		  AND (ul.category4 LIKE @category4 OR @category4 IS NULL)
		) u
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH
			SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS ErrorNumber;
			SELECT ERROR_MESSAGE()
		END CATCH;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_AssignHUStatus]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(30),
	@json nvarchar(MAX)=null,
	@type nvarchar(20),
	@user nvarchar(50)=null
AS
BEGIN
       -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
       -- interfering with SELECT statements.
       SET NOCOUNT ON;

       -- Insert statements for procedure here
      -- print @json
       --creating temporary table to convert json to a temp table
       declare   @assignHU_var as table
                           (      row_id int identity(0,1),
                                  row_no    nvarchar(200) ,  
                                  assign_status     bit  ,
                                  pallet_id nvarchar(200),
                                  lot_no nvarchar(200),
                                  wo_id varchar(200) 
                           )
       insert into @assignHU_var

       SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(@json)with ( Row   nvarchar(200) '$.tot_rows' ,  
                           assign_status     bit     '$.assign_status',
                           pallet_id nvarchar(200) '$.sublot_no' ,
                            lot_no nvarchar(200) '$.lot_no' ,
                           wo_id varchar(200) '$.wo_id' )


       
       select * from @assignHU_var
       --using cursor to check whether pallet is there or not for the @wo_id and then assigning 1 if true or 0 if false.
	   	
	
	  DECLARE @Spallet NVARCHAR(50)
       DECLARE @Slot_no NVARCHAR(50)
       
       DECLARE @Sstatus bit
       DECLARE @Swo NVARCHAR(50)
     DECLARE @A_row int =0
	
	declare @k int, @k_min int ,@k_max int 

	   while(@k_min<=@k_max)
       BEGIN
			
			 select @Sstatus = assign_status,@Spallet = pallet_id,@Slot_no = lot_no,@Swo = wo_id from @assignHU_var where row_id = @k_min;
             -- print('@j_min- '+ CONVERT(varchar(10),@k_min)  +'  @@Apallet-'+@Spallet)

			 IF EXISTS(select * from @assignHU_var where wo_id=@wo_id and pallet_id=@Spallet and assign_status=@Sstatus)
                     BEGIN 
                           SET @A_row=1
                     END
              ELSE
                     BEGIN
                           SET @A_row=0                      
                     END
              

              set @k_min = @k_min+1
              
       END 

	
	 


       DECLARE @Apallet NVARCHAR(50)
       DECLARE @Alot_no NVARCHAR(50)
     
       DECLARE @Astatus bit
       DECLARE @Awo NVARCHAR(50)
       


	 
      

       declare @i int, @i_min int ,@i_max int 

       select @i_min =  min(row_id),@i_max =max(row_id) from @assignHU_var
       --print @A_row
       while(@i_min<=@i_max)
       begin
       
              select @Astatus = assign_status,@Apallet = pallet_id,@Alot_no = lot_no,@Awo = wo_id from @assignHU_var where row_id = @i_min;
            --  print('@i_min- '+ CONVERT(varchar(10),@i_min)  +'  @@Apallet-'+@Apallet)

			 -- print 'Arow'+CONVERT(varchar(10),@A_row)
			 -- print 'status'+CONVERT(varchar(10),@Astatus)
              if (@A_row =1 and @Astatus=0 )or(@A_row =1 and @Astatus=1)
              begin 
                     -- do update
                     update ofi_AssignHuWoId set assign_status=1 where pallet_id=@Apallet and wo_id=@wo_id
					 update item_inv set last_edit_at=GETUTCDATE() where spare2=@Apallet
              end 
              else if((@A_row =1 and @Astatus is null) or (@A_row =0) )
			 
              begin 
                     -- do insert
					 if not exists(select * from ofi_AssignHuWoId with(nolock) where pallet_id=@Apallet and wo_id=@wo_id)
					 BEGIN
						 insert into   ofi_AssignHuWoId(pallet_id,assign_status,wo_id)       values(@Apallet,1,@wo_id)
						 update item_inv set last_edit_at=GETUTCDATE() where spare2=@Apallet
					END
              end 

              set @i_min = @i_min+1
              
       end 


       
              
              

	if (@type='Unassign' and @json is not null)
	BEGIN
	

	
	DECLARE @Ustatus bit
	  DECLARE @UApallet NVARCHAR(50)
       DECLARE @UAlot_no NVARCHAR(50)
     
       DECLARE @UAstatus bit
       DECLARE @UAwo NVARCHAR(50)
       
	
	
	 declare @j int, @j_min int ,@j_max int 

       select @j_min =  min(row_id),@j_max =max(row_id) from @assignHU_var
		 while(@j_min<=@j_max)
       BEGIN
			
			 select @UAstatus = assign_status,@UApallet = pallet_id,@UAlot_no = lot_no,@UAwo = wo_id from @assignHU_var where row_id = @j_min;
              print('@j_min- '+ CONVERT(varchar(10),@j_min)  +'  @@Apallet-'+@UApallet)

			delete ofi_AssignHuWoId where pallet_id=@UApallet and wo_id=@wo_id	
			update item_inv set last_edit_at=GETUTCDATE() where spare2=@Apallet
              

              set @j_min = @j_min+1
              
       END 
	
	END
	if (@type='Unassign' and @json is null )
	BEGIN
		delete ofi_AssignHuWoId where wo_id=@wo_id
		
	END 
	if (@json is null and @type='delOtherWo')
	BEGIN
		declare @pallet nvarchar(50)
		select @pallet=pallet_id from ofi_AssignHuWoId with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id
		delete  ofi_AssignHuWoId where wo_id<>@wo_id and pallet_id=@pallet
		
	END 


END
