CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogoutByJob]
(		@session_id				INT
	,	@user_id				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@ent_id					INT
	,	@wo_id					STRING80
	,	@oper_id				STRING80
	,	@seq_no					INT
	,	@step_no				INT
	,	@lot_no					NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@sublot_no				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@event_time_local		DATETIME = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.6.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 01/08/2003		Rohit			1.5.0	Added string Id reference to the err message.
-- 02/06/03 		Rohit		  			Check if the entity can capture labor,if not then exit without doing anything.
-- 04/17/2003		Raghu			1.6.0 	Steps are lot specific. If user logs out from a step, adjust the percentage among
--											all the steps.
--											If the user logs out from a specific lot (if the user has logged into multiple lots,
--											then adjust the pct for all lots within the step)
-- 06-06-2003		Sheetal Jain	1.6.0.1 Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 12/01/2003		Raghu			2.0.13	(HD# 3879) Handling steps with multiple job execs.
-- 06/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included NULL value for last_edit_comment field while calling sp_I_Labor_Usage.
--											Also added last_edit_by and last_edit_at in insert statements
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/13/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--01/17/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00073994; Cannot logout from a step.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @log_id					INT
		,	@return					INT
		,	@can_capture_labor		BIT
		,	@ent_pct_to_apply		FLOAT
		,	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply 	FLOAT
		,	@total_pct_lab_to_apply	FLOAT
		,	@last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@event_time_utc			DATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value


	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Check if the entity can capture labor,if not then exit without doing anything
	SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor FROM ent WHERE ent_id =@ent_id

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND step_no = @step_no AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot Logout as step is not logged on by this user: %d{3159}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value,  @server_time = @event_time OUTPUT
	IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) 	SELECT @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(@time_zone_bias_value), @event_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()
	ELSE SET @event_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @event_time_local)

	IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN
		UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND step_no = @step_no
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
		  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
		RETURN 0
	END

	SELECT @ent_pct_to_apply = ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply
	FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE session_id = @session_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id

	--Check if the steps are logged in Multiple lots, if yes, logout the step from that lot and adjust the
	--percentage for that step within that lot.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND step_no = @step_no AND lot_no <> @lot_no
			  AND sublot_no <> @sublot_no) BEGIN

		SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(pct_to_apply) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND step_no = @step_no

		SELECT @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = pct_to_apply FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND step_no = @step_no AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)

		INSERT INTO labor_usage
		(
			labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
			dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		SELECT	@event_time_utc
			,	@event_time_local
			,	user_id
			,	ent_id
			,	wo_id
			,	oper_id
			,	seq_no
			,	step_no
			,	item_id
			,	lot_no
			,	lab_cd
			,	dept_id
			,	shift_id
			,	shift_start_utc
			,	shift_start_local
			,	(pct_to_apply/(@total_pct_lab_to_apply-@cur_pct_lab_to_apply)) * @total_pct_lab_to_apply
			,	active
			,	0
			,	comments
			,	@last_edit_by
			,	dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
				labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
				wo_id = @wo_id AND
				oper_id = @oper_id AND
				seq_no = @seq_no AND
				labor_usage.active = 1 AND
				step_no = @step_no AND
				lot_no <> @lot_no

		SET @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
		WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND step_no = @step_no
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc)

		UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id

	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Steps are not logged into multiple lots. Hence remove the step from this lot and adjust
		--the step percentage among all the other steps
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
				  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND step_no <> @step_no) BEGIN

			SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(pct_to_apply) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

			SELECT @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = pct_to_apply FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND step_no = @step_no

			INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
				dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			SELECT	@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
					dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
					(pct_to_apply/(@total_pct_lab_to_apply-@cur_pct_lab_to_apply))*@total_pct_lab_to_apply,
					active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id
				AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
				AND labor_usage.active = 1 AND step_no <> @step_no

			SET @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
			WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc)
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

			UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
		--User has logged out from all the steps, but may still working on this entity, in this case default to NULL
		--default to NULL ONLY if there were no concurrent jobs else close this labor record

			INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, lab_cd,
				dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			SELECT	@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, NULL, item_id, NULL, lab_cd,
					dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by,
					dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_usage.active = 1
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

			SET @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
			WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1 AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no)

			UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
		END
	END

RETURN 0
END

CREATE   procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_selection_rsu]

	@plast_edit_by				[NVARCHAR]	(40) =NULL

AS
BEGIN

declare @pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME],	
		@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME],

		@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME],

set @pcreated_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(); set  @plast_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE();
set @pcreated_at_local = GETDATE(); set @plast_edit_at_local = GETDATE();
--select @silo_item_id = item_id from item where  item_desc =@psilo_item_id  --- Get the Silo item id
IF(@psecondary_silo IS NULL ) SET @psecondary_silo = '';

	---- 0.01.02 Start
		-- If destination type is 2 (destination storage unit)
		if(TRIM(@pdest_type) = '2')
		BEGIN
			DECLARE 
				@MaxDestAllAttrID INT,
				@MaxAllowedEntity INT = 99999,
				@ConfiguredEntity INT,
				@ExistingStorgeUnit bit;

		
			if exists (select wo_id from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] with (nolock) where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id )

			else

			--Skip the maximum allowed storage unit check if modifying an existing  storage unit
			if(@ExistingStorgeUnit = 0)
			BEGIN

				select @MaxDestAllAttrID = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaxDestinationSUAllowed' and attr_grp = 8

				select @MaxAllowedEntity = pa.attr_value 
				from process_attr pa with (nolock) 
				INNER JOIN wo with (nolock) on pa.process_id = wo.process_id
				WHERE
					wo.wo_id = @pwo_id
					and pa.attr_id = @MaxDestAllAttrID

				select @ConfiguredEntity = count(*) 
				from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] with (nolock)
				where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id <> @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id ;

				if(@ConfiguredEntity >= @MaxAllowedEntity)
				begin

					SET @pResult = 0
					SET @pResultCode = '@@MoreThanMaxAllowedDest@@'

					return;
				end
			END

			
		END
	---- 0.01.02 END


	BEGIN TRY

	--IF( @pwo_id IS NOT NULL OR @poper_id IS NOT  NULL )

	---Remove this receipt ID because it is coming Null  - Praveen
    --if exists (select * from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and storage_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id )
				if exists (select * from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id )
				BEGIN

				select @iRowId = row_id from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id
				UPDATE [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
				SET 
				 [is_chk]					= @pis_chk
				,[secondary_silo]			= @psecondary_silo
				,[secondary_silo_ent_id]	= @psecondary_silo_ent_id
				,[ratio]					= @pratio
				,[last_edit_at_utc]			= @plast_edit_at_utc
				,[last_edit_at_local]		= @plast_edit_at_local
				,[last_edit_by]				= @plast_edit_by
				,[active_su_ent_id]			=@pstorage_ent_id
				,[silo_seq]	        		=@psilo_seq

				---Remove this receipt ID because it is coming Null  - Praveen
				--where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and storage_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id
				where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id 
				--SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
				END
		else if(@pis_chk =1)
				BEGIN
					
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
							  ([wo_id]
							   ,[oper_id]
							   ,[seq_no]
							   ,[parent_item_id]
							   ,[ent_id]
							   ,[jb_item_id]
							   ,[jb_item_group]
							   ,[jb_grade_cd]
							   ,[recipe_id]
							   ,[version_id]
							   ,[dest_type]
							   ,[is_chk]
							   ,[su_ent_id]
							   ,[secondary_silo]
							   ,[secondary_silo_ent_id]
							   ,[ratio]
							   ,[is_active]
							   ,[created_at_utc]
							   ,[created_at_local]
							   ,[created_by]
							   ,[last_edit_at_utc]
							   ,[last_edit_at_local]
							   ,[last_edit_by]
							   ,[active_su_ent_id]
							   ,[silo_seq]						
							   )
					VALUES
						   (
							   
								 @pwo_id	                    						
								,@poper_id
								,@pseq_no
								,@pitem_id
								,@pent_id
								,@psilo_item_id
								,@psilo_item_group
								,@psilo_grade_cd
								,@precipe_id
								,@pversion_id
								,@pdest_type
								,@pis_chk
								,@pstorage_ent_id
								,@psecondary_silo
								,@psecondary_silo_ent_id
								,@pratio
								,1
								,@pcreated_at_utc
								,@pcreated_at_local
								,@pcreated_by
								,@plast_edit_at_utc
								,@plast_edit_at_local
								,@plast_edit_by
								,@pstorage_ent_id  -- Keep NULL ?
								,@psilo_seq
							)
				   END																

			SET @pResult = 1
			SET @pResultCode = 'updated successfully '


	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH

			SET @pResult = 0
			SET @pResultCode = ERROR_MESSAGE()

	END CATCH

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Rework_Count]

	,	@reas_cd             INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@process_id          STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by        STRING40_NULL = NULL

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_Assigned_Lot

-- Date Created   - 07/25/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/04/2007		AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

    SELECT rework_count.item_id
        ,rework_count.lot_no
        ,rework_count.sublot_no
        ,rework_count.wo_id
        ,rework_count.oper_id
        ,rework_count.seq_no
        ,rework_count.reas_cd
        ,rework_count.process_id

        ,rework_count.last_edit_comment
        ,rework_count.last_edit_by
        ,rework_count.last_edit_at
        ,rework_count.row_id
      FROM rework_count WITH (NOLOCK)
     WHERE (rework_count.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
           (rework_count.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)

END

-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Author:    Gines
-- Create date: November 2016
-- Description:  This SP is used to validate Job Movement accross Resources.
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Modification History
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
-- Date			Version		Author		Change 
-- 10/4/2017	1.1			Wilwin		Modification made to check job move accross Segment Type
--										Added @orig_ent_id for original ent id for the job
-- ============================================= -- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_JobMove_Valid]
(
@ent_id NVARCHAR(50)
, @item_id  NVARCHAR(50)
, @orig_ent_id NVARCHAR(50) = null
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare  @resGrpId NVARCHAR(50)
	declare @origSegment nvarchar(50)
	declare @newSegment nvarchar(50)
	declare @tSegment table (ent_id nvarchar(50), parent_ent_id nvarchar(50), segmentType nvarchar(50));

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	;WITH segmentparent AS 
			( 
           			   SELECT     e.ent_id 
                      			  ,p.ent_id      parent_ent_id
								  ,ea.attr_value segmenttype 
           			   FROM       ent e with (nolock)
           			   INNER JOIN ent p with (nolock) 
           			   ON         e.parent_ent_id =p.ent_id
           			   LEFT JOIN  ent_attr ea  with (nolock)
           			   INNER JOIN attr a with (nolock) 
           			   ON         a.attr_id = ea.attr_id 
           			   AND        a.attr_desc = 'SegmentType' 
           			   ON         ea.ent_id = e.ent_id ) , segmentchild AS 
			( 
          			  SELECT    c.ent_id, 
                    			c.parent_ent_id, 
                    			c.segmenttype , 
                    			p.segmenttype AS pseg 
          			  FROM      segmentparent c 
          			  LEFT JOIN segmentparent p 
          			  ON        c.parent_ent_id = p.ent_id) , segmentall AS 
			( 
         			 SELECT   ent_id, 
                  			  parent_ent_id, 
                  			  Isnull(segmenttype,Isnull(pseg,'NOIDEA')) segmenttype 
         			 FROM     segmentchild 
         			) 
		insert into @tSegment ( ent_id, 
                  			  parent_ent_id,segmenttype)
		select ent_id, 
                  			  parent_ent_id,segmenttype from segmentall
		
		select @origSegment = segmenttype from @tSegment where ent_id = @orig_ent_id
		select @newSegment = segmenttype from @tSegment where ent_id = @ent_id

		if (@origSegment = @newSegment)
		begin
			select item_id from SDB.SCH.res_item with (nolock) where ent_id  = @ent_id and item_id = @item_id
		end
		else
		begin
			select item_id from SDB.SCH.res_item with (nolock) where  item_id = 'does not exist'

		end
		
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Route]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @input_oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @input_seq_no  int  ,
 @input_percent  float  ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @mod_id  varchar(30) )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT job_route.wo_id
            ,job_route.oper_id
            ,job_route.seq_no
            ,job_route.input_oper_id
            ,job_route.input_seq_no
            ,job_route.input_percent
            ,job_route.last_edit_comment
            ,job_route.last_edit_by
            ,job_route.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_route.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM job_route job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((job_route.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_route.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_route.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_route.input_oper_id = @input_oper_id OR @input_oper_id IS NULL) AND

CREATE    Trigger [tg_oper_step_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_step]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_step_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.6.0.26
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769) Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--03/17/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 2155) Deleting a step should remove all the entries in oper_ent_spec
--10/03/2003    Sheetal Jain    1.6.26  (HD# 3563) Cascade delete to bom_item_oper_step_link removed and implemented here
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--01/17/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073953; Deletes corresponding entries from Data_Entry_Sched
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@step_no		INT
BEGIN
  SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207
  DECLARE oper_step_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT b.process_id, b.oper_id, b.step_no FROM deleted b
  OPEN oper_step_cursor
  WHILE (1=1)
  BEGIN
    FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_cursor INTO @process_id, @oper_id, @step_no
    IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)
      BREAK
    IF (@attr_value = 1)
    BEGIN
      SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
      IF (@process_status = 3)
      BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_step', 16, 1)
	BREAK
      END
    END
    DELETE FROM oper_ent_spec WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no
    DELETE FROM bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no
    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
    UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
  END
  CLOSE oper_step_cursor
  DEALLOCATE oper_step_cursor

	DELETE FROM data_entry_sched
	WHERE key_id IN (SELECT d.row_id FROM deleted d)
	  AND key_type = 5
	  AND category = 'Datalog Group'
END

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Ent_Logon_GetLastLogTime
-- Description	      -	This method returns the last login time by a user for a session.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	12/07/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.25
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.

SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN
	--Default the time zone bias value to 0.
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SET @last_ent_logon_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @last_ent_logon_time )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@event_time_utc	TDATETIME
,@last_edit_comment	STRING254
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Program Name			- FACETLLIGENCE
-- Module Name			- sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys
-- Description          - Update TPM_STAT quantities for the given job and the hour bucket
-- Author				- RaghuG
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  - 5.03
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 08/02/2016		RaghuG			5.3	UserStory: 668392 - As Lenka, I want the quantity modifications (after-the-fact) to be updated in the correct hour bucket
--							Rewrote this stored procedure to work with the new design
--09/13/2017	Raghu				6.0	UserStory:909264 - As Lenka, I don't want to have primary key violations reporting production(CR L00146480)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @job_start_utc		TDATETIME
	,@job_end_utc		TDATETIME
	,@can_track_oee		LOGICAL
	,@hour_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME

BEGIN

	--Exit, if the supplied event time is null
	--Or, the production is reported for the current top of the hour - the service will create the hour bucket for the current hour, so there is no need to create by the prod transaction
	--return
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NULL) OR (DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_time_utc),0) = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()))
		RETURN

	--Verify whether the entity is tracking OEE, if not exit
	SELECT @can_track_oee = e.can_track_oee
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

	--Exit, if the entity is not tracking oee
	IF (@can_track_oee = 0) RETURN

	--Determine the hour start bucket based on the job start UTC
	SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_time_utc),0)

	--Get the job start time to identify the closest start time of the job.
	SELECT @job_start_utc = MAX(jh.job_start_utc)
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND jh.job_start_utc <= @event_time_utc

	--If there is no job start utc, statistics for this hour cannot be calculated, therefore, exit.
	--There was no job running prior to the production event
	IF (@job_start_utc IS NULL)
		RETURN

	--Get the end time of the job
	SELECT @job_end_utc = jh.job_end_utc
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND jh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc

	SELECT @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		, @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, '') + '(RefreshQuantities)'

	--Determine whether the supplied production event falls within the job runtime
	--Exit, if the event is not within the job runtime
	IF NOT (@event_time_utc BETWEEN @job_start_utc AND COALESCE(@job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()))
		--The production event is outside of the job runtime, exit
		RETURN

	--Verify whether a record for the production event hour exist
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jhh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND jhh.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jhh.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jhh.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND jhh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
			  AND jhh.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc) BEGIN

		--Call the SP that determines whether a bucket should be created and fills in the statistics automatically if needed
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Hour_History_CreateBucketsUpdateStats @start_utc_range=@event_time_utc, @end_utc_range=@event_time_utc
			, @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
			, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment

		--Exit, since the sp would have created the bucket (if needed) and filled in the stats
		RETURN
	END

	--If the event is within the last 2 hours from the top of the hour, then exit.
	IF (@event_time_utc >= DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @last_edit_at),0)))
		RETURN

	--The production was added 2 hours (from the top of the current hour) in the past within a valid time when the job ran.
	--Therefore, update the production quantities for this hour.
	  ;WITH boundaries AS
	(SELECT jhh.ent_id, jhh.wo_id, jhh.oper_id, jhh.seq_no, jhh.job_start_utc, jhh.hour_start_utc
		, CASE WHEN jhh.job_start_utc < jhh.hour_start_utc THEN jhh.hour_start_utc ELSE jhh.job_start_utc END boundary_start_utc
		, CASE WHEN COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > jhh.hour_end_utc THEN jhh.hour_end_utc ELSE COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) END boundary_end_utc
		, jhh.hour_end_utc
		FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = jh.seq_no AND jhh.job_start_utc = jh.job_start_utc
		--Limit to the supplied job and the hour bucket
		WHERE jhh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND jhh.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jhh.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jhh.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jhh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
		  AND jhh.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc
		)
	, tpm_stat_data AS
	(SELECT jhh.ent_id, jhh.wo_id, jhh.oper_id, jhh.seq_no, jhh.job_start_utc
		, jhh.hour_start_utc
		, qtys.qty_prod, qtys.qty_reject
	FROM boundaries jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 1 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) AS qty_prod
			, SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 0 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) AS qty_reject
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
			  AND ip.wo_id = jhh.wo_id
			  AND ip.oper_id = jhh.oper_id
			  AND ip.seq_no = jhh.seq_no
			  AND ip.byproduct = 0
			  AND ip.created_at_utc >= jhh.boundary_start_utc
			  --Must have <= AND < hour_end_utc since there are two cases to handle
			  --(i) A production accounted precisely at the end time of the job must be accounted.
			  --For example, if there is a production at 7:30:30 and the end time of the job is 7:30:30, then that production must be included
			  --(ii) However, if the production is at 8:00:00 and the end time of the job is 8:00:00, then the production must be included for this hour (excluding the production from the previoius hour)
			  --The created_at_utc <= boundar_end_utc includes all the production including the end time of the job, but the created_at_utc < hour_end_utc determines which hour the production should be included.
			  AND ip.created_at_utc <= jhh.boundary_end_utc AND ip.created_at_utc < jhh.hour_end_utc
		) qtys
		)
	UPDATE job_hour_history
	SET job_hour_history.qty_good = COALESCE(ts.qty_prod, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.qty_reject = COALESCE(ts.qty_reject, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	FROM tpm_stat_data ts WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_hour_history.ent_id = ts.ent_id
	  AND job_hour_history.wo_id = ts.wo_id
	  AND job_hour_history.oper_id = ts.oper_id
	  AND job_hour_history.seq_no = ts.seq_no
	  AND job_hour_history.job_start_utc = ts.job_start_utc
	  AND job_hour_history.hour_start_utc = ts.hour_start_utc
END

	,	@reas_pending        	LOGICAL
	,	@runtime        		LOGICAL
	,	@downtime        		LOGICAL
	,	@setuptime        		LOGICAL
	,	@teardowntime        	LOGICAL
	,	@time_category_none    	LOGICAL
	,	@fixedtime        		LOGICAL
	,	@vartime        		LOGICAL
    ,   @failure                LOGICAL
	,	@time_type_neither 		LOGICAL
	,	@comments          		STRING4000_NULL = NULL
	,	@raw_reas_cd     		STRING40_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category1              STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category2              STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category3              STRING80_NULL = NULL
    ,   @category4              STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value   INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@no_of_util_events 		INT32_NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilCount
-- Description	      -	Returns a count of utilization records
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	12/20/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.26
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 09/06/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 11/27/2009		Ajay		4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
-- 01/13/2010       SARA        4.0.0   Added fields for enhanced calculations
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @event_time_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@event_time_end_utc     TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_start_utc  TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@dbg_resp				INT
		,	@temp_tz				INT32


	SET @shift_start_start_tz	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
	SET @event_time_start_tz	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@event_time_start_tz)
	SET @event_time_end_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@event_time_end_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilCount', @src_key='sp_SA_Util_Log_GetUtilCount',
					@date_val1 = @shift_start_start, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_start_tz,
					@date_val2 = @event_time_end,    @numeric_val2 = @event_time_end_tz



	SET	@temp_tz	= -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_start, @temp_tz, @event_time_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @temp_tz	= -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time_end,	@temp_tz, @event_time_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @temp_tz	= -@event_time_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start,@temp_tz, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET	@temp_tz	= -@event_time_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end,  @temp_tz, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	IF @time_category_none = 0 SET @time_category_none = NULL
	IF @time_type_neither = 0 SET @time_type_neither = NULL

	SELECT @no_of_util_events = COUNT(*)
	FROM util_log ul WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE (ul.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ul.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.event_time_utc >= @event_time_start_utc OR @event_time_start_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (ul.event_time_utc <= @event_time_end_utc OR @event_time_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ul.duration >= @min_duration OR @min_duration IS NULL)
      AND (ul.duration <= @max_duration OR @max_duration IS NULL)
      AND (ul.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.reas_pending = @reas_pending OR @reas_pending IS NULL)
      AND ((ul.runtime = @runtime AND @runtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.downtime = @downtime AND @downtime IS NOT NULL)
        OR (ul.setuptime = @setuptime AND @setuptime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime AND @teardowntime IS NOT NULL)
        OR (@time_category_none = 1 AND @time_category_none IS NOT NULL AND (ul.runtime = 0 AND ul.downtime = 0 AND ul.setuptime = 0 AND ul.teardowntime = 0))
        OR (@runtime IS NULL AND @downtime IS NULL AND @setuptime IS NULL AND @teardowntime IS NULL AND @time_category_none IS NULL))
      AND ((ul.fixedtime = @fixedtime AND @fixedtime IS NOT NULL) OR (ul.vartime = @vartime AND @vartime IS NOT NULL)
        OR (@time_type_neither = 1 AND @time_type_neither IS NOT NULL AND (ul.fixedtime = 0 AND ul.vartime = 0))
        OR (@fixedtime IS NULL AND @vartime IS NULL AND @time_type_neither IS NULL))
      AND (ul.failure LIKE @failure OR @failure IS NULL)
      AND (ul.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
      AND (ul.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category1 LIKE @category1 OR @category1 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category2 LIKE @category2 OR @category2 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category3 LIKE @category3 OR @category3 IS NULL)
      AND (ul.category4 LIKE @category4 OR @category4 IS NULL);


END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- 0.04   AML, XPM    2026-01-16        Added Packing Without Recipe Logic
-- 0.05     JSC       2026-04-20        Added the item grade call for Packing (CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe)

-- *************************************************************************************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_AssignJobValidation] -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
 -- @json nvarchar(MAX)=null
 @wo_id         NVARCHAR(80),
 @oper_id       NVARCHAR(80),
 @seq_no        INT,
 @target_ent_id INT,
 @isUpdate      INT = 0 --,@parent_item_id nvarchar(80) = NULL
 --,@recipe_name nvarchar(80) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON;
 DECLARE @Counter INT,
   @iterate INT = 1
 DECLARE @CTE_TEMP TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(50))
 DECLARE @item_id NVARCHAR(50),
 @missingBOM      NVARCHAR(100),
 @is_wip_oper     NVARCHAR(50),
 @wip_item        NVARCHAR(50),
 @sap_target_item NVARCHAR(50),
 @wip_item_prefix NVARCHAR(40) = '',
 @wip_target_item NVARCHAR(40) = '',
 @ent_id          INT,
 @bom_item_cnt    NVARCHAR(50),
 @recipe_version  INT,
 @ritem_id        NVARCHAR(40),
 @rname           NVARCHAR(100),
 @rver            NVARCHAR(40),
 @isRecipeNull    INT = 0,
 @lastWo_id       NVARCHAR(80),
 @lastOper_id     NVARCHAR(80),
 @lastseqNo       INT
 DECLARE @SAP_BOM TABLE
  (
   row_id  INT identity(1, 1),
   item_id NVARCHAR(50)
  )
 DECLARE @row_min      INT
 DECLARE @row_max      INT
 DECLARE @sap_bom_item NVARCHAR(40)
 DECLARE @MES_BOM TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(50))
 DECLARE @RESULT_TEMP TABLE
  (
   wo_id       NVARCHAR(20),
   oper_id     NVARCHAR(30),
   seq_no      INT,
   result_code INT,
   failed_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
   bom_item    NVARCHAR(MAX)
  )
 DECLARE @msgCode        NVARCHAR(MAX)
 DECLARE @recipe_name    NVARCHAR(80)
 DECLARE @parent_item_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
 
 SET @isRecipeNull = 0
 SET @missingBOM = NULL
 -- clean variables
 DELETE @sap_bom
 DELETE @mes_bom --this if condition will work only for the process for the wo only where set recipe step is applicable
 -- v 0.04
 -- Check if operation works without recipe
 DECLARE @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe INT = 0
 SELECT @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe      = TRY_CAST(oa.attr_value AS INT)
 FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
 WHERE oa.oper_id                                 = @oper_id
  AND a.attr_desc                              = 'CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe'
 IF (ISNULL(@CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe, 0) = 1)
 BEGIN
  IF (@isUpdate = 1)
  BEGIN -- Set specs for Packing before assignment
   -- updated v0.05
   EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_ItemGrade] @wo_id,
          @oper_id,
          @seq_no
   
   ----EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_set_Job_spec]  @wo_id,
   --         @oper_id,
   --         @seq_no,
   --         'User'
  END
  RETURN 0
 END 
 SELECT @parent_item_id = item_id
 FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
 WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
  AND seq_no  = @seq_no
  AND oper_id = @oper_id
 -- #0.02.00 -------------------
 -- Changes related to find out the WIP material if wip is producing --
 SET @is_wip_oper = NULL -- it will only fetch the wip materials // comment from Ajay
 -- find if wip
 SELECT TOP 1 @is_wip_oper = oa.oper_id
 FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.oper_id = j.oper_id
 WHERE wo_id                                     = @wo_id
  AND oa.oper_id                              = @oper_id
  AND seq_no                                  = @seq_no
  AND attr_id IN
  (   SELECT attr_id
   FROM attr WITH(NOLOCK)
   WHERE attr_desc = 'produce_wip' )
 IF (@is_wip_oper IS NOT NULL)
 BEGIN --print 'if'+ @oper_id
  SELECT @sap_target_item = item_id
  FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
  WHERE wo_id             = @wo_id
   AND oper_id         = @is_wip_oper
   AND seq_no          = @seq_no -- add '50' prefix before item_id for the intermetiate material
  SELECT @wip_item_prefix = ISNULL(spare2, '50')
  FROM item_class WITH(NOLOCK)
  WHERE item_class_id         = 'SFG' --and attr_id  = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc =  'wip_item_prefix')
  SET @sap_target_item        = SUBSTRING(@sap_target_item, 3, LEN(@sap_target_item))
   SET @wip_target_item    = CONCAT(@wip_item_prefix, @sap_target_item)
    SET @parent_item_id = @wip_target_item
 END
 SELECT DISTINCT @recipe_name = recipe_name,
  @rver                    = version
 FROM ofi_master_recipe omr WITH(NOLOCK)
 WHERE omr.item_id     = @parent_item_id
  AND omr.ent_id    = @target_ent_id
  AND omr.is_active = 'Y'
  AND omr.preferred = 'Y' -- select @recipe_name, @parent_item_id,@target_ent_id
 IF (@recipe_name IS NOT NULL)
 BEGIN
  INSERT @result_temp
  EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp] @wo_id,
  @oper_id,
  @seq_no,
  @ent_id,
  @parent_item_id,
  @recipe_name
 END
 IF (@recipe_name IS NULL)
 BEGIN
  RAISERROR( 'Recipe is not defined for this entity and item', 16, 1 )
  RETURN -1
 END
 IF EXISTS
 (   SELECT 1
  FROM @result_temp
  WHERE result_code = 2 )
 BEGIN
  SELECT TOP 1 @msgCode = bom_item
  FROM @result_temp
  WHERE result_code = 2
  RAISERROR(@msgCode, 16, 1)
  RETURN -1
 END
 IF ( @recipe_name IS NOT NULL AND @isUpdate = 1 )
 BEGIN
  UPDATE job_bom
  SET
   spare1      = @recipe_name
  WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
   AND seq_no  = @seq_no
   AND oper_id = @oper_id
  EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertRecipeBOM]  @wo_id,
            @oper_id,
            @seq_no,
            @parent_item_id,
            @rver,
            NULL
  EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_ItemGrade] @wo_id,
          @oper_id,
          @seq_no
  EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_set_Job_spec]  @wo_id,
           @oper_id,
           @seq_no,
           'User'
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_StopStep]
(
		@session_id				INT32
	,	@user_id				STRING40
	,	@ent_id					INT32
	,	@job_pos				INT32 = 0
	,	@step_no				INT32
	,	@lot_no					STRING40
	,	@sublot_no				STRING40
	,	@state_cd				INT32 = NULL
	,	@check_cert				LOGICAL = NULL
	,	@labor_option			LOGICAL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = 0

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      	- sp_U_Job_Step_StopStep
-- Description	      	- Stop a Step
-- Author	      		-
-- Date Created	      	-
-- Version	      		- 1.6.0.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/19/2002		Raghu			1.4		Reset Factory Connector Tags (for the newly added)
-- 10/26/2002   	Tony            1.5.0   Include job_pos as parameter and use it where relevant
-- 01/08/2003		Rohit			1.5.0	Added string Id reference to the err message.
-- 02/07/2003		Raghu			1.5.5	(HD# 1757) Log step_no in util_log when step is started or ended
 --04/09/2003		Raghu			1.6.0	Update FC Tags only if any steps related tag is exposed
-- 04/10/2003		Raghu			1.6.0	If the current step is same as the job_exec.cur_step_no, then update cur_step_no and cur_step_start to NULL
-- 04/10/2003		Raghu			1.6.0	Included 'With NoLock' hint in FC Update statements
-- 05/14/2003		Raghu			1.6.7	(HD# 2498). Auto Populating of Job Event table when a step is completed and sys attr is set to true
-- 05/20/2003		Raghu			1.6.8	Code mods for handling Superseded steps
-- 06/06/2003     	SJ				1.6.9  	Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 11/20/2003		Raghu			2.0.11	(HD# 4106) Default lot_no to "-" if NULL as null lot_no is not allowed in job_step_data
-- 12/03/2003		Raghu			2.0.13	(HD# 4135) Spec download for MinValue and MaxValues supported - FC Tags
-- 06/15/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included prod_log_id, cons_log_id parameters while calling sp_Cert_SignOff_Done
-- 06/16/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included NULL params for last_edit_comment field while calling sp_I_Job_Event
-- 10/03/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 02/08/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 08/27/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--02/11/2008		Raghu       		3.4     L00074324; 'Std Time elasped' action for a step
--01/31/2013		Saiteja.K		4.6		Passed value for lot number as NULL if the field is  null for CRL00124563.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@cur_wo_id			STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id		STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no			INT32
		,	@cur_step_no		INT32
		,	@return				INT32
		,	@step_grp_id		INT32
		,	@step_seq			INT32
		,	@istepcount			INT32
		,	@cur_state_cd		INT32
		,	@cur_step_data		STRING254
		,	@cur_data_user_id	STRING40
		,	@enter_data			LOGICAL
		,	@form_name			STRING254
		,	@form_done			LOGICAL
		,	@cur_datetime_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@cur_datetime_local	TDATETIME
		,	@process_id			STRING40
		,	@cert_name			STRING40
		,	@attr_value			NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@row_id				INT32
		,	@tz_temp			INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	IF @state_cd IS NULL SET @state_cd = 4
	IF @check_cert IS NULL SET @check_cert = 0
	IF @labor_option IS NULL SET @labor_option = 0
	IF @lot_no IS NULL SET @lot_no = NULL
	IF @job_pos IS NULL SET @job_pos = 0

	-- Read job data for current job running on this entity
	SELECT	@cur_wo_id = job_exec.cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = job_exec.cur_oper_id,
			@cur_seq_no = job_exec.cur_seq_no, @cur_step_no = job_exec.cur_step_no
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id AND job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos

	EXEC SP_U_JOB_STEP_STOPSTEPBYJOB @in_user_id=@user_id,
		@in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_job_pos=@job_pos,
		@in_wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @in_oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
		@in_seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @in_step_no=@step_no,
		@in_lot_no=@lot_no, @in_sublot_no=@sublot_no,
		@in_state_cd=@state_cd, @in_check_cert=@check_cert,
		@in_labor_option=@labor_option, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value


	IF (@labor_option = 1) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lu.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
                              AND lu.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
                              AND lu.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
                              AND lu.step_no = @step_no
                              AND lu.lot_no = @lot_no
                              AND lu.user_id <> @user_id
                              AND lu.active = 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Steps are currently used by another users:{3156}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		EXEC sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogout @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @step_no, @lot_no, NULL,
			NULL, @job_pos, @time_zone_bias_value
	END

/*

	-- Proceed only when Step is defined, else throw the error.
	IF NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
			  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
			  seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
			  step_no = @step_no
	)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Step is not defined{3166} ', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@state_cd <> 4 AND @state_cd <> 8 AND @state_cd <> 9) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot Stop the Step other than Complete or Bypassed or Superseded{3366}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END
	-- Check that this Step IS currently running. If False Return Error, else continue
	-- a row exists in job_step_data (need current job data read above)
	SELECT @row_id = MAX(row_id) FROM job_step_data
	WHERE job_step_data.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
	  AND job_step_data.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
	  AND job_step_data.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	  AND job_step_data.step_no = @step_no
	  AND job_step_data.lot_no = @lot_no

	SELECT @cur_state_cd = job_step_data.state_cd, @cur_step_data = job_step_data.step_data,
		@form_done = job_step_data.form_done
	FROM job_step_data job_step_data
	WHERE row_id = @row_id

	IF @cur_state_cd is NOT NULL BEGIN
--		IF (@state_cd <> 9) BEGIN
		IF (@cur_state_cd <> 3 AND @cur_state_cd <> 4 AND @cur_state_cd <> 8 AND @cur_state_cd <> 9) BEGIN
	   		RAISERROR('Cant Stop the Step as it is not currently running: %d{3154}', 16, 1, @return)
			RETURN -1
		END
--		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Step is not Started: %d{3155}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--If Labor option is licensed check for rows in labor_usage table for current step_no
	--and lot_no but a different user_id. If any such rows exist return error
	--as other users are still working on the step, else continue.

	IF (@labor_option = 1) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				AND step_no = @step_no AND lot_no = @lot_no AND user_id <> @user_id
				AND active = 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Steps are currently used by another users: %d{3156}', 16, 1, @return)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	SELECT @enter_data = job_step.enter_data, @form_name = job_step.form_name
	FROM job_step WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE  job_step.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
	  AND job_step.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
	  AND job_step.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	  AND job_step.step_no = @step_no

	--If new_state_cd = COMPLETE then Check that step data has been entered if required.
	--If False Return Error with appropriate description, else continue
	IF (@state_cd = 4  OR @state_cd = 8 OR @state_cd = 9) BEGIN
		IF (@state_cd = 4 AND @enter_data = 1) BEGIN
			IF @cur_step_data IS NULL BEGIN
	   			RAISERROR('Step data not found: %d{3157}', 16, 1, @return)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	--If new_state_cd = COMPLETE then Check that step form data has been entered if required.
	--If False Return Error with appropriate description, else continue
	--If job_step.form_name is NOT Null then must have job_step_data.form_done = 1.
		IF (@state_cd = 4 AND @form_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF @form_done <> 1 BEGIN
	   			RAISERROR('Form Done should be true: %d{3158}', 16, 1, @return)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	--If new_state_cd = COMPLETE then If CheckCert (input parameter) is True
	--check if this user is certified to Signoff this step. If False Return Error, else continue
	--Check certification of this user against Operation Step. Call CertSignoffAllowed() with step parameter.
	--Then call CertSignoff()

		IF ((@state_cd = 4 OR @state_cd = 8) AND @check_cert = 1) BEGIN
			--Get process id for this Work Order from WO table
			SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM wo
			WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
--			EXECUTE @return = sp_Cert_SignOff_Allowed @user_id, @process_id, @cur_oper_id, @step_no
--			if @return <> 0 BEGIN
--	   			RAISERROR('Sign Off Not Allowed for this user: %d', 16, 1, @return)
--				return -1
--			END
			--Get the Certificate name from Cert_Oper_Step_Link
			--Check this with Tony: What happens if there are more certificates defined for the same process, operation and step no ?
			--Sign Off for all the certificates ?
			DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
				SELECT a.cert_name FROM cert_oper_step_link a, cert_type b
				WHERE a.cert_name = b.cert_name
				  AND process_id = @process_id
				   AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
				   AND step_no = @step_no
				   AND b.cert_audit = 1

			OPEN cert_cursor
			WHILE (1=1)
			BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM cert_cursor INTO @cert_name
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
--				EXECUTE @return = sp_Cert_SignOff @user_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @step_no, @cert_name
				EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_CertSignOffDone @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @step_no, @cert_name, @lot_no,
					NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @return OUTPUT
				IF @return < 0 BEGIN
--	   				RAISERROR('Sign Off Not Allowed for this user: %d', 16, 1, @return)
					RAISERROR('Some of the certificates are not signed off{3198}',16,1, @return)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
			CLOSE cert_cursor
			DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
		END

		--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @server_time=@cur_datetime OUTPUT
		SET @cur_datetime_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @cur_datetime_local, @tz_temp, @cur_datetime_utc OUTPUT

	--Update this row in Job_Step_Data table, state_cd, finish_user_id from input parameters,
	--act_finish_time, last_edit_at = Now
		UPDATE JOB_STEP_DATA
			SET state_cd = @state_cd,
			    finish_user_id = @user_id,
			    act_finish_time_utc = @cur_datetime_utc,
				act_finish_time_local = @cur_datetime_local
--			    last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
		WHERE row_id = @row_id

		--Added by Raghu on 04/10/2003. If the current step is the same in job_exec, then update the current step and step start to null for that entity.
		IF (@cur_step_no IS NOT NULL AND @step_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (@cur_step_no = @step_no) UPDATE job_exec SET cur_step_no = NULL, cur_step_start = NULL WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
		END

		IF (@state_cd = 4) BEGIN
			SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 234
			IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event	@ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, @step_no, 'StepCompleted', NULL, @lot_no, NULL,
									NULL, NULL, @user_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
									NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Step state is not completed %d{3367}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--If Labor_option (input param) call StepLogout() to end labor capture for this step / lot
	IF (@labor_option = 1) EXEC sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogout @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @step_no, @lot_no, NULL, NULL, @job_pos, @time_zone_bias_value

	--Added by Raghu on 04/09/2003. Update FC Tags only if any steps releated tag is exposed.
	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT 'X' FROM fc_namesp_tag a WITH (NOLOCK), fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE a.node_id = b.node_id AND b.ent_id = @ent_id AND
			  (UPPER(b.node_desc) = N'STEPS' OR UPPER(b.node_desc) = N'BOMITEMCURSTEP' OR UPPER(node_level3) = N'SPECS')
	)
	BEGIN
		--Added by Raghu on 07/26/2002. When the step is stopped, Update the Factory Connector Tags to clear the step details and job spec details
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPNO'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPSEQ'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPDESC'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'ACTIONTYPE'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STDTIME'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'COMPLETECOND'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'ALLOWBYPASS'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'ENTERDATA'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SPCCHAR'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'FORMNAME'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPGRPID'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPGRPDESC'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPGRPSEQ'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'STEPGRPREPEATABILITY'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SPARE1'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SPARE2'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SPARE3'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1
		FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SPARE4'

		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1

		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1

		WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'MINQTYREQD' and upper(b.node_desc) = 'BOMITEMCURSTEP'

		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = '', new_value = 1

		UPDATE fc_namesp_tag set last_value = 0, new_value = 1

		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'FROMENTID' and upper(b.node_desc) = 'BOMITEMCURSTEP'

		  and upper(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'CONSCD' and upper(b.node_desc) = 'BOMITEMCURSTEP'
		  and b.ent_id = @ent_id
	END
*/

	RETURN 0

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Rework_Process_Usage]
(
		@reas_cd             INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@orig_rework_cd      STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@orig_process_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id             STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@rework_process_id   STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@reentry_rework_cd   STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by        STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at        TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@row_id              INT32_NULL = NULL

)

AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_REWORK_PROCESS_USAGE
-- Description    - Select row(s) from the rework_process_usage table.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   -    07/25/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/04/2007		AML		  3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

    SELECT rework_process_usage.reas_cd
        ,rework_process_usage.orig_rework_cd
        ,rework_process_usage.orig_process_id
        ,rework_process_usage.item_id
        ,rework_process_usage.rework_process_id
        ,rework_process_usage.max_times_rework
        ,rework_process_usage.reentry_rework_cd
        ,rework_process_usage.last_edit_comment
        ,rework_process_usage.last_edit_by
        ,rework_process_usage.last_edit_at
        ,rework_process_usage.row_id
      FROM rework_process_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
     WHERE (rework_process_usage.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.orig_rework_cd = @orig_rework_cd OR @orig_rework_cd IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.orig_process_id = @orig_process_id OR @orig_process_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.rework_process_id = @rework_process_id OR @rework_process_id IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.reentry_rework_cd = @reentry_rework_cd OR @reentry_rework_cd IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
           (rework_process_usage.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tgeb_cert_item_link_aft_del]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Emailatt]
  (@sender nvarchar(80) ,
   @sent datetime ,
   @recipient nvarchar(40) ,
   @path nvarchar(254) ,
   @file_name nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value int ,
   @last_edit_at DATETIME OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 10/06/2005	Raghu		2.1.30	Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF (@sent IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @sent = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @sent = @last_edit_at
ELSE SET @sent =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sent)
SET @sent = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sent )

 IF @recipient IS null SET @recipient = 0
 INSERT INTO emailatt
 (sender,
  sent,
  recipient,
  path,
  file_name,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@sender,
   @sent,
   @recipient,
   @path,
   @file_name,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_Wo
-- Description:  Updates the work order details if exist
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-26         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  OT			2025-03-20		   Added filtering in DELETE statement to prevent from deleting BOM in job in RUNNING, STOPPED, COMPLETED state
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-05-14         Updated how get the @to_uom_id to convert correctly the qtys
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_Wo] (@module        NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @plant_code    NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @wo_id         NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @spare1        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare2        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare3        NVARCHAR(200),
                                               @spare4        NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
	PRINT @erp_wo_status
      IF @erp_wo_status = 'ACTIVE'
         AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                    FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                           AND state_cd = 0)
         AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                    FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                           AND ( status = 1
                                  OR status IS NULL ))
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @rc                    INT,
                    @error_msg             NVARCHAR(500),
                    @error_severity        INT,
                    @error_state           INT,
                    @wo_desc               NVARCHAR(80),
                    @req_qty               FLOAT,
                    @req_finish_time_local DATETIME,
                    @item_id               NVARCHAR(80),
					@sched_start_time_local DATETIME,
					@from_uom_id INT,
					@to_uom_id INT,
					@conv_factor FLOAT,
					@cur_jobs CURSOR,
					@process_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@init_prod_pct FLOAT,
					@oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@init_sched_ent_id INT,
					@job_qty FLOAT,
					@seq_no INT

            BEGIN try
                BEGIN TRANSACTION

                SELECT @wo_desc = wo_desc,
                       @req_qty = wo_qty,
                       @req_finish_time_local = dbo.Fn_s_ofi_converterpdatestring(req_finish_date,req_finish_time),
					   @sched_start_time_local=dbo.Fn_s_ofi_converterpdatestring(sched_start_date, sched_start_time)
                FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				PRINT @req_qty

				SELECT @item_id = item_id,
					   @process_id=process_id
                      FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id


				SELECT @to_uom_id = u.uom_id
				FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
				   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
						   ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
							  AND i.item_id = @item_id


				SELECT TOP 1  @from_uom_id = u.uom_id
				FROM uom u WITH (nolock)
					INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.description = ea.attr_value
					JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
					JOIN site s WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = s.ent_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'SAPPROUOM'


				IF @from_uom_id IS NULL
				BEGIN 
					SELECT @from_uom_id = u.uom_id
					FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock)
						INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
								ON u.description = owe.uom_desc
									AND owe.wo_id = @wo_id
				END

				IF @from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @conv_factor=factor
					FROM   uom_conv WITH (nolock)
					WHERE  from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
						   AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
						   AND ( @item_id IS NULL
								  OR @item_id = item_id )
					ORDER  BY item_id DESC

					SET @req_qty=@req_qty * @conv_factor
				END

                UPDATE wo
                SET    wo_desc = @wo_desc,
                       req_qty = @req_qty,
                       req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local
                WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

				SET @cur_jobs= CURSOR FOR
				SELECT init_sched_ent_id,
				oper_id,
				seq_no
				FROM   job WITH (nolock)
				where wo_id=@wo_id

				OPEN @cur_jobs

				FETCH next FROM @cur_jobs INTO @init_sched_ent_id, @oper_id,@seq_no

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				  BEGIN
					  SELECT @init_prod_pct = init_prod_pct
					  FROM   oper_ent_link WITH (nolock)
					  WHERE  oper_id = @oper_id
							 AND ent_id = @init_sched_ent_id
							 AND process_id = @process_id

					  SET @job_qty=@init_prod_pct * @req_qty

					  UPDATE job
					  SET    qty_reqd = @job_qty, qty_at_start=@job_qty
					  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no 

					  FETCH next FROM @cur_jobs INTO @init_sched_ent_id, @oper_id,@seq_no
				  END

				CLOSE @cur_jobs

				DEALLOCATE @cur_jobs


				UPDATE job
				SET    sched_start_time_local = @sched_start_time_local
				WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
				--AND first_job = 1 --(KN 27-Jan-23 - Updated this as part of the same discussion on local vs utc time to be used and advised)

                IF ( EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                            FROM   item_attr ia WITH (nolock)
                                   INNER JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
                                           ON i.item_id = ia.item_id
                                              AND i.item_id = @item_id
                                   INNER JOIN attr a WITH (nolock)
                                           ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
                                              AND a.attr_desc = 'RecipeToUse'
                                              AND a.attr_grp = 1
                                              AND ia.attr_value = 'ERP')
                     AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                                FROM   job_bom WITH (nolock)
                                WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                                       AND bom_pos <> 0) )
                  BEGIN
                     
					  --0.01.01 commented
                      --DELETE job_bom
                      --WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                      --       AND bom_pos <> 0
					  
					  DELETE jb -- 0.01.01
					  FROM job_bom jb with (nolock)
					  inner join job j with (nolock) on j.wo_id = jb.wo_id and j.oper_id=jb.oper_id and j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
					  where j.state_cd < = 1 and jb.wo_id=@wo_id and jb.bom_pos<>0

                      EXEC @rc=Sp_i_ei_pro_create_bom
                        @module,
                        @plant_code,
                        @wo_id,
                        @erp_wo_status,
                        @item_id,
                        @spare1,
                        @spare2,
                        @spare3,
                        @spare4

                      IF ( @rc <> 0 )
                        BEGIN
                            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating BOM (' +  @wo_id + ') in MES  - SP_U_EI_PRO_Create_BOM -  '   + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
                            THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
                        END
                  END

                COMMIT TRANSACTION
            END try

            BEGIN catch
                IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

                SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
                       @error_severity = Error_severity(),
                       @error_state = Error_state();

                RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
            END catch
        END
  END
