	,@process_id		STRING80
	,@cur_step_no		INT32
	,@cur_step_data		NVARCHAR(508)
	,@cur_form_done		NVARCHAR(508)
	,@cur_state_cd		INT32
	,@act_finish_time_local TDATETIME
	,@act_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@log_job_event		INT32
	,@cert_name		NVARCHAR(254)
	,@row_count		INT32

	SELECT @state_cd = COALESCE(@in_state_cd, 4), @check_cert = COALESCE(@in_check_cert, 0)
		,@labor_option = COALESCE(@labor_option, 0), @lot_no = COALESCE(@in_lot_no, '-')

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_step js WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE js.wo_id = @in_wo_id
			  AND js.oper_id = @in_oper_id
			  AND js.seq_no = @in_seq_no
			  AND js.step_no = @in_step_no) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Step is not defined{3166}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @enter_data = js.enter_data, @form_name = js.form_name
	FROM job_step js WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE js.wo_id = @in_wo_id
	  AND js.oper_id = @in_oper_id
	  AND js.seq_no = @in_seq_no
	  AND js.step_no = @in_step_no


	IF (@state_cd <> 4 AND @state_cd <> 8 AND @state_cd <> 9) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cannot set the state of the step to other than Complete, Bypassed, or Superseded{3366}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Check that this Step IS currently running. If False Return Error, else continue
	-- a row exists in job_step_data (need current job data read above)
	SELECT @row_id = MAX(row_id) FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_step_data.wo_id = @in_wo_id
	  AND job_step_data.oper_id = @in_oper_id
	  AND job_step_data.seq_no = @in_seq_no
	  AND job_step_data.step_no = @in_step_no
	  AND (job_step_data.lot_no = @in_lot_no OR (job_step_data.lot_no IS NULL AND @in_lot_no IS NULL))

	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Cant Stop the Step as it is not currently running:{3154}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @cur_state_cd = job_step_data.state_cd, @cur_step_data = job_step_data.step_data,
		@cur_form_done = job_step_data.form_done
	FROM job_step_data job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @row_id

	IF (@cur_state_cd <> 3 AND @cur_state_cd <> 4 AND @cur_state_cd <> 8 AND @cur_state_cd <> 9) BEGIN
   		RAISERROR('Cant Stop the Step as it is not currently running: %d{3154}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@state_cd = 4  OR @state_cd = 8 OR @state_cd = 9) BEGIN
		IF (@state_cd = 4 AND @enter_data = 1) BEGIN
			IF @cur_step_data IS NULL BEGIN
	   			RAISERROR('Step data not found: %d{3157}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END

		IF (@state_cd = 4 AND @form_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF @cur_form_done <> 1 BEGIN
	   			RAISERROR('Form Done should be true: %d{3158}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END

	IF ((@state_cd = 4 OR @state_cd = 8) AND @check_cert = 1) BEGIN
		--Get process id for this Work Order from WO table
		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @in_wo_id

		--Get the Certificate name from Cert_Oper_Step_Link
		--Check this with Tony: What happens if there are more certificates defined for the same process, operation and step no ?
		--Sign Off for all the certificates ?
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT cosl.cert_name
                        FROM cert_oper_step_link cosl  WITH (NOLOCK)
                        INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cosl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
                        WHERE cosl.process_id = @process_id
                          AND cosl.oper_id = @in_oper_id
                          AND cosl.step_no = @in_step_no
                          AND ct.cert_audit = 1

		OPEN cert_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM cert_cursor INTO @cert_name
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_CertSignOffDone @in_wo_id, @in_oper_id, @in_seq_no, @in_step_no, @cert_name, @lot_no,
				NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @row_count OUTPUT

			IF @row_count < 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Some of the certificates are not signed off{3198}',16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
		CLOSE cert_cursor
		DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
	END

	SELECT @act_finish_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(@in_time_zone_bias_value) )
		,@act_finish_time_utc =  dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	UPDATE job_step_data
	SET state_cd = @state_cd,
		finish_user_id = @in_user_id,
		act_finish_time_utc = @act_finish_time_utc,
		act_finish_time_local = @act_finish_time_local
	WHERE row_id = @row_id

        SELECT @log_job_event = sa.attr_value
        FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sa.attr_id = 234

	IF (@log_job_event = '1')
	  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @in_ent_id, NULL, @in_job_pos, @in_step_no, 'StepCompleted', NULL, @in_lot_no, NULL,
			NULL, NULL, @in_user_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			NULL, @in_time_zone_bias_value, NULL

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		        WHERE je.cur_wo_id = @in_wo_id
			  AND je.cur_oper_id = @in_oper_id
			  AND je.cur_seq_no = @in_seq_no
			  AND je.cur_step_no = @in_step_no) BEGIN
		UPDATE job_exec
		SET cur_step_no = NULL, cur_step_start = NULL
		WHERE cur_wo_id = @in_wo_id
		  AND cur_oper_id = @in_oper_id
		  AND cur_seq_no = @in_seq_no
		  AND cur_step_no = @in_step_no

	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_RPU_GetByFilter]
(
		@reas_grp_id         INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@reas_cd             INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@orig_rework_cd      STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@orig_process_id     STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id             STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_RPU_GETBYFILTER
-- Description    - Select row(s) from the rework_process_usage table.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 07/25/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/04/2007		AML		3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

    SELECT ir.reas_cd
          ,ir.reas_desc
          ,ir.reas_grp_id
          ,rpu.orig_rework_cd
          ,rpu.orig_process_id
          ,rpu.item_id
          ,rpu.rework_process_id
          ,rpu.max_times_rework
          ,rpu.reentry_rework_cd
          ,rpu.last_edit_comment
          ,rpu.last_edit_by
          ,rpu.last_edit_at
          ,rpu.row_id
      FROM rework_process_usage rpu WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON rpu.reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
      WHERE (ir.reas_grp_id = @reas_grp_id OR @reas_grp_id IS NULL) AND
           (rpu.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
           (rpu.orig_rework_cd LIKE @orig_rework_cd OR @orig_rework_cd IS NULL) AND
           (rpu.orig_process_id LIKE @orig_process_id OR @orig_process_id IS NULL) AND
           (rpu.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)

END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

	,	@dept_id					STRING40

	,	@def_cons_reas_cd			STRING40

	,   @cur_shift_end_time_local   TDATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	  SET @cur_shift_start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@cur_shift_start_time_tz)

				,@cur_shift_start_time_local = @cur_shift_start_local, @cur_shift_end_time_utc = @cur_shift_end_utc, @cur_shift_end_time_local = @cur_shift_end_local

		END

		INSERT INTO @parent_ent (ent_Id, parent_ent_id, can_sched_shifts, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_local, cur_shift_start_time_utc, parent_level)
		VALUES (@ent_id_temp, @parent_ent_id_temp, @can_sched_shifts_temp, @cur_shift_id_temp, @cur_shift_start_local, @cur_shift_start_utc, @parent_level)
	END
END

IF (@cur_shift_id IS NULL ) SET @cur_shift_id = 0

SET @cur_shift_start_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @cur_shift_start_time_local )*/

IF (@parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL)
	--If this is NOT a parent entity, copy the site information from the parent entity.
        SELECT @site = e.site
        FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE e.ent_id = @parent_ent_id

--- get entity local UTC value from shift local value or current time. If site is NULL, it will create client local outputs
EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @site, @cur_shift_start_time_utc OUTPUT, @cur_shift_start_time_local OUTPUT,  @cur_shift_start_time_tz OUTPUT
SET @cur_shift_start_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @cur_shift_start_time_local )
SET @cur_shift_start_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @cur_shift_start_time_utc )


INSERT INTO ent
(
	ent_name,
	description,
	parent_ent_id,
	site,
	hourly_cost,
	can_sched_jobs,
	can_run_jobs,
	can_capture_util,
	can_capture_labor,
	can_do_dnc,
	can_track_oee,
	can_sched_shifts,
	can_store,
	can_log_data,
	can_ship,
	can_receive,
	can_copy_folders,
	can_capture_qm_data,
	can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy,
	can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
	can_capture_util_from_galaxy,
	can_track_oee_from_galaxy,
	can_store_from_galaxy,
	entity_from_galaxy,
	cur_shift_id,
	--cur_shift_start_time, 07/25/2007 AML
	cur_shift_start_time_utc,
	cur_shift_start_time_local,
	cur_shift_end_time_utc,
	cur_shift_end_time_local,
	last_domain_change,
	tree_icon,
	flow_diag_img,
	identical_job_execs,
	show_in_dsp_tree,
    ent_class,
    def_std_oper_id,
    equipment_type,
	spare1,
	spare2,
	spare3,
	spare4,
	last_edit_comment,
	last_edit_by,
	last_edit_at
)
VALUES
(
	@ent_name,
	@description,
	@parent_ent_id,
	@site,
	@hourly_cost,
	@can_sched_jobs,
	@can_run_jobs,
	@can_capture_util,
	@can_capture_labor,
	@can_do_dnc,
	@can_track_oee,
	@can_sched_shifts,
	@can_store,
	@can_log_data,
	@can_ship,
	@can_receive,
	@can_copy_folders,
	@can_capture_qm_data,
	@can_sched_jobs_from_galaxy,
	@can_run_jobs_from_galaxy,
	@can_capture_util_from_galaxy,
	@can_track_oee_from_galaxy,
	@can_store_from_galaxy,
	@entity_from_galaxy,
	@cur_shift_id,
	--@cur_shift_start_time, -- 07/25/2007 AML

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_AddShiftsForTheDay]
(@in_ent_id			INT32
,@in_start_date_time		TDATETIME
,@in_first_start_day		INT32
,@in_first_end_day		INT32
,@in_second_start_day		INT32
,@in_second_end_day		INT32
,@day_indicator			INT32
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_AddShiftsForTheDay
-- Description		- Refresh the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 08/23/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--02/27/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00075055; On change of shift got "No Shift" despit...
--12/10/2012    Saiteja     4.6 Added changes for CR L00121362
-- 03/17/17     Srinivasa   6.0  US#803703- Merge L00145120 (HF CR L00144586): Added check for first day of week and modified the day offset accordingly
--                                for those languages which have a day of week start of Monday.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @ent_id			INT32
	,@start_day			INT32
	,@shift_id			INT32
	,@start_time_time		TDATETIME
	,@end_time_time			TDATETIME
	,@break1_start_time		TDATETIME
	,@break1_end_time		TDATETIME
	,@break2_start_time		TDATETIME
	,@break2_end_time		TDATETIME
	,@break3_start_time		TDATETIME
	,@break3_end_time		TDATETIME

	--Represents the order of day where the shift schedules to be applied.
	,@day_order			INT32
	,@current_day_day		INT32
	,@start_date_time		TDATETIME
	,@end_date_time			TDATETIME
	,@start_time			TDATETIME
	,@end_time				TDATETIME


BEGIN

     -- Set @firstdayOffset according to the start day of the week (1 or 7) for current SQL Server language
 	 DECLARE @firstdayOffset INT;
 	 SET @firstdayOffset = 1
 	  IF @@DATEFIRST = 1 BEGIN SET @firstdayOffset = 0 END

	SELECT @ent_id = @in_ent_id
		,@current_day_day =
		            CASE
					    WHEN @@DATEFIRST = 1 AND DATEPART(dw, @in_start_date_time) - @firstdayOffset = 7 THEN 0
 		                ELSE DATEPART(dw, @in_start_date_time) - @firstdayOffset
 		            END

	DECLARE shift_sched_templates_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id, start_day, shift_id, start_time, end_time
		--Remove the date part from the shift breaks.
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.start_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.end_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.break1_start, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.break1_end, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.break2_start, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.break2_end, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.break3_start, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), shift_sched.break3_end, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		,CASE WHEN (start_day >= @in_first_start_day AND start_day <= @in_first_end_day) THEN 0
			ELSE 1
		END day_order
	FROM shift_sched WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (ent_id = @in_ent_id OR @in_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (start_day = @current_day_day)
--	  AND ((start_day >= @in_first_start_day AND start_day <= @in_first_end_day)
--	    OR (start_day >= @in_second_start_day AND start_day <= @in_second_end_day))
	ORDER BY day_order, start_day, start_time

	OPEN shift_sched_templates_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_sched_templates_cursor INTO @ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id, @start_time, @end_time
			,@start_time_time, @end_time_time
			,@break1_start_time, @break1_end_time, @break2_start_time, @break2_end_time
			,@break3_start_time, @break3_end_time, @day_order
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--First verify whether the shift sched is for the previous day from the supplied date
		IF (@day_indicator <= 0) BEGIN
			--The current shift template is for the previous day.
			--Verify if the template shift start time is greater than the supplied start time.
			--meaning we are only interested in the shifts that starts after the template start time (future shifts).
			--ie., template shift = 10:00 AM and the current time is 09:00 AM
			IF (CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_start_date_time, 120), 12, 9), 120) <= @start_time_time) BEGIN
				--Verify whether the shift ends on the same day.
				IF (@start_time_time < @end_time_time)
					--Since the start time is less than the end time, the current shift ends on the same day.
					SET @end_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
					ELSE IF (@start_time_time = @end_time_time)-- Added condition for 121362
                        BEGIN
                              -- Since the start time is equal to the end time, the current shift ends on the next day
                              SET @end_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
                              SET @end_date_time = DATEADD(DD,1,@end_date_time)
                        END
				ELSE
					--The shift ends on the next day
					SET @end_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time + 1, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)

				SET @start_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @start_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)

				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break1_start_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break1_end_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break2_start_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break2_end_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break3_start_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break3_end_time OUTPUT

				IF DAY(@start_time) = 31 SET @start_date_time = DATEADD(DD, 1, @start_date_time)
				IF (@end_date_time < @start_date_time) SET @end_date_time = DATEADD(DD, 1, @end_date_time)

				INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
					,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
					,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
				VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id
					,@start_date_time, @end_date_time, @break1_start_time, @break1_end_time
					,@break2_start_time, @break2_end_time, @break3_start_time, @break3_end_time)
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The current shift template is for the last day.
			--Verify any shift that ends before the supplied datetime to capture the end time of the last shift.
			IF (CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @in_start_date_time, 120), 12, 9), 120) >= @start_time_time) BEGIN
				IF (@start_time_time >= @end_time_time) -- Changed condition to >= for 121362
					--The shift ends on the next day
					SET @end_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time + 1, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
				ELSE
					SET @end_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)

				SET @start_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @in_start_date_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @start_time_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)

				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break1_start_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break1_end_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break2_start_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break2_end_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break3_start_time OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@start_date_time, @in_end_date=@end_date_time, @break_time=@break3_end_time OUTPUT

				IF DAY(@start_time) = 31 SET @start_date_time = DATEADD(DD, 1, @start_date_time)
				IF (@end_date_time < @start_date_time) SET @end_date_time = DATEADD(DD, 1, @end_date_time)

				INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
					,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
					,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
				VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id
					,@start_date_time, @end_date_time, @break1_start_time, @break1_end_time
					,@break2_start_time, @break2_end_time, @break3_start_time, @break3_end_time)
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE shift_sched_templates_cursor
	DEALLOCATE shift_sched_templates_cursor
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_SaveAssignRecipe_v0.06]

declare		  @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
             ,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_AssignRecipe'

		declare @cte table ( rowId int identity(1,1)

							,reqd_grade_cd int
							,item_desc  varchar(120)

							,last_oper		varchar(80)
							,last_seq		varchar(80)
							,material_type		varchar(80)
							,is_cakeblender_running  int
							,qty_reqd  float

		declare @result_temp table
						(
							wo_id nvarchar(20),
							oper_id nvarchar(30),
							seq_no int,
							result_code int,
							failed_msg nvarchar(MAX),
							bom_item nvarchar(MAX)
						)

INSERT INTO @cte(bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
				,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
				,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
				,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd) 
SELECT bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
				,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
				,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
				,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd  FROM  
 OPENJSON ( @grid )  
WITH (        
			 -- rowId  int '$.row_id',
			  bom_pos  int  '$.bom_pos' ,
              item_id   varchar(80) '$.item_id' ,  
              --item_desc  varchar(120) '$.item_desc', 
			  reqd_grade_cd   int  '$.reqd_grade_cd' ,
			  item_grade_desc   varchar(120) '$.item_grade_desc', 
			  qty_per_parent_item float  '$.qty_per_parent_item',
			  min_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.min_qty_per_parent_item',
			  max_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.max_qty_per_parent_item',
			  recipe_reqd_qty_per float  '$.recipe_reqd_qty_per',
			  uom_description  varchar(40)  '$.uom_description',
			  job_qty_reqd float  '$.job_qty_reqd',
			  last_wo		varchar(80) '$.last_wo' ,
			  last_oper		varchar(80) '$.last_oper' ,
			  last_seq		varchar(80) '$.last_seq' ,
			  material_type		varchar(80) '$.material_type' ,
			  is_cakeblender_running  int  '$.is_cakeblender_running' ,
			  qty_reqd  float  '$.qty_reqd'
	);

	update @cte set reqd_grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
	from item_grade ig inner join @cte c1 on ig.item_grade_desc = c1.item_grade_desc and ig.good_prod =1


	 if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe')
	 begin
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LastjobBOMRecipe') Is Not Null BEGIN DROP TABLE #LastjobBOMRecipe; END
		 SELECT top 1 @lastWo_id = wo_id,@lastOper_id = oper_id, @lastseqNo = seq_no from job with(nolock) where run_ent_id = @ent_id and item_id = @parent_item_id and state_cd = 4 order by act_finish_time_utc desc 
		 SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #LastjobBOMRecipe FROM  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id=@lastWo_id and oper_id = @lastOper_id and seq_no = @lastseqNo and bom_pos<>0
	 end
	 else 
		 begin
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BOMRecipe') Is Not Null BEGIN DROP TABLE #BOMRecipe; END
			select @bomItem = item_id, @bomVersion = version from ofi_master_recipe with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name;
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #BOMRecipe FROM  bom_item with(nolock) where parent_item_id = @bomItem and ver_id = @bomVersion and bom_pos <>0

		 end

		 --select @bomItem ,@bomVersion
		 --select * from @cte
		 --select * from #BOMRecipe


	--	 validation 
		--begin
		--	select 0 as result, '@@CakeBlenderCompenentIsNotPresent@@' as resultCode;  
		--	--select 1 as result,'updated successfully ' as resultCode
		--	return;
		--end

		--BOM Compare
		-- same SP can't be used as we have to pass the selected parameter
		
		
		begin
				insert into @result_temp
							exec [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp] 
							   @wo_id
							  ,@oper_id
							  ,@seq_no
							  ,@ent_id
							  ,@parent_item_id
							  ,@recipe_name
			
			if ((select top 1 result_code from @result_temp)<>1)
			begin
				select @resultset = 0 ,@resultCode =  (select top 1  CONCAT(failed_msg,'- ',bom_item) from @result_temp); 
				return;
			end

		end 


	 
	 if(@saveRecords=1) 
	 begin

			-- populating the audit table
			 insert into @jobBomAudit select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0

			 --update job_bom set 
			 delete from jb
			 from job_bom jb --inner join @cte  c1 on jb.item_id = c1.item_id and jb.reqd_grade_cd =c1.reqd_grade_cd
			 where jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and jb.bom_pos<>0 --and jb.item_id not in( select item_id from @cte)

			 update job_bom set qty_per_parent_item = case  when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			 ,min_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			 ,max_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			 ,qty_reqd = ct.qty_reqd
			 ,reqd_grade_cd =  isnull(ct.reqd_grade_cd,(select item_grade_cd from item_grade with(nolock) where item_grade_desc = ct.item_grade_desc))
			 ,bom_pos = ct.bom_pos
			 from job_bom jb with(nolock) inner join @cte ct on jb.item_id = ct.item_id
			 and jb.wo_id =  @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no

			 select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @cte
			--select * from @cte

		WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
					BEGIN


								
								BEGIN
										-- updating variables from @cte 
									select @bom_pos = bom_pos, @item_id = item_id
									,@qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
									,@max_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
									,@min_qty_per_parent_item =  case when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
									,@qty_reqd =qty_reqd 
									,@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
									from @cte as ct where rowId =@row_cnt 
			    
									if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe') -- updating values here
									begin
										select top 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
													,@reqd_start_val				= reqd_start_val           
													,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		= reqd_start_val_is_pct    
													,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
													,@backflush                  = backflush                
													,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
													--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
													--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
													,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
													,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
													,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
													,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
													,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
													,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
													,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
													,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
													,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
													,@est_time                   = est_time                 
													,@current_subst              = current_subst         from #LastjobBOMRecipe where item_id = @item_id   and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd  
									end
									else
										begin
											select top 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
													,@reqd_start_val				= 0           
													,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		=	0    
													,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
													,@backflush                  = backflush                
													,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
													--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
													--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
													,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
													,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
													,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
													,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
													,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
													,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
													,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
													,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
													,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
													,@est_time                   = est_time                 
													,@current_subst              = NULL         from #BOMRecipe where item_id = @item_id   and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd 

										end

										-- checking if it is existing in the job bom
								IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos <>0 and item_id = @item_id and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd)
								begin
								 --select @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
									--0.06 
									if(@bom_pos<0)
										begin
											select @maxBomPos =  min(bom_pos)-1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
										end 
										else
										begin
											select @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
										end
								-- inserting values in job bom
									exec 
										 [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Bom] @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@maxBomPos
										,@item_id
										,@reqd_grade_cd
										,@instruction
										,@qty_per_parent_item
										,@max_qty_per_parent_item
										,@min_qty_per_parent_item
										,@reqd_start_val
										,@reqd_start_val_is_pct
										,@update_inv
										,@backflush
										,@def_reas_cd
										,@def_lot_no
										,@def_sublot_no
										,@def_storage_ent_id
										,@def_reject_ent_id
										,@scaling_factor
										,@must_consume_from_inv
										,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc
										,@may_create_new_lots
										,@must_consume_from_wip
										,@must_consume_before_prod
										,@constant_qty
										,@est_time
										,@current_subst
										,@qty_reqd
										,@serial_no_source
										,@spare1
										,@spare2
										,@spare3
										,@spare4
										,@last_edit_comment
										,@mod_id OUTPUT

										SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
									end
								END
							set @row_cnt = @row_cnt+1
					END
				
				-- inserting the values for audit trail
				insert into @jobBomAudit1 select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] 
				 from job_bom with(nolock) 
				 where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0


				select @already_used = [already_used] from  [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name
				
				if(@recipe_name is not null and @already_used = 'N' and @recipe_name <>'Last used recipe')
				BEGIN
					-- updating ofi master 
					UPDATE [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] SET already_used = 'Y',last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(),last_edit_at_local = GETDATE(),last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
					where  recipe_name = @recipe_name
				END

				if(@recipe_name <> (select isnull(spare1,'') from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no))
				begin
					update job_bom set spare1 = @recipe_name where  wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no;
				end


				-- invalidating the applicable subsequent steps
				exec [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
				   @wo_id
				  ,@oper_id
				  ,@seq_no
				  ,@step_name
				  ,@step_data = @recipe_name

				  
				  if(@invalidateSteps=1)
				  begin
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_invalidate_steps]  @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@ent_id,@item_id,@step_name=NULL
				  end
			

			set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
			select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode

	end
	else
		begin
				
				set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@RecordsValidatedSuccessfully@@'
				select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
		end 

END TRY

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Spec]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @step_no int,
 @spec_id  nvarchar(40) ,
 @spec_desc NVARCHAR(80),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 06/16/2003	 Rich Boyle	Appended the grp_id and units columns to the
--                                                   returned record set.
-- 12/02/2003	Rch Boyle	Appended the spare field from spec to the record set
-- 02/07/2005	Raghu		Added 'setspecvaluetagexist' column to return whether 'changespecvalue' tag exists or not
-- 11/03/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:933266 - As Bruce I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @ent_id	INT

SELECT @ent_id = ent_id FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id= @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

SELECT job_spec.wo_id
            ,job_spec.oper_id
            ,job_spec.seq_no
            ,job_spec.step_no
            ,job_spec.spec_id
            ,job_spec.spec_value
            ,job_spec.act_spec_value
            ,job_spec.assoc_file
            ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
            ,job_spec.comments
            ,job_spec.min_value
            ,job_spec.max_value
            ,job_spec.access_level
            ,spec.spec_desc
            ,spec.grp_id
            ,spec.units
            ,spec.spare1
            ,spec.spare2
            ,spec.spare3
            ,spec.spare4
            ,job_spec.last_edit_comment
            ,job_spec.last_edit_by
            ,job_spec.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
            ,spec.data_type data_type
	,spec.display_seq
FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
WHERE ((job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
       (job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
       (spec.spec_desc = @spec_desc OR @spec_desc IS NULL) AND
       (job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (job_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY job_spec.spec_id

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_step_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_step]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_step_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_step os INNER JOIN inserted i
				 ON os.process_id = i.process_id AND os.oper_id = i.oper_id AND os.step_no = i.step_no)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_step', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_step os INNER JOIN inserted i
				 ON os.process_id = i.process_id AND os.oper_id = i.oper_id AND os.step_no = i.step_no) ostep
	WHERE process.process_id = ostep.process_id

	UPDATE oper_step SET oper_step.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_step.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_step.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_step.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oper_step.step_no = i.step_no

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Sample_Plan]
  (@plan_id int)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	09/21/2010
-- Version	      -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

IF EXISTS (
     --The current spec is overridden by the spec_char_link, and the link uses the supplied plan_id
        SELECT TOP 1 1
      FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN
            (SELECT qs.qm_spec_name, ent_id, item_id, item_category_id, process_id, oper_id, MAX(start_eff_utc) highest_spec_eff
            FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE qs.start_eff_utc <= CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00', 120)
              AND (qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL OR qs.end_eff_utc > CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00', 120))
            GROUP BY qs.qm_spec_name, ent_id, item_id, item_category_id, process_id, oper_id) specs_not_to_be_deleted
                  ON qs.qm_spec_name = specs_not_to_be_deleted.qm_spec_name AND qs.start_eff_utc = specs_not_to_be_deleted.highest_spec_eff
      INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qmscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.qm_spec_id = qmscl.qm_spec_id
      WHERE qmscl.plan_id = @plan_id
        UNION
      --The current spec is NOT overridden by the spec_char_link, and the parent spec uses the supplied plan id
      SELECT TOP 1 2
      FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN
            (SELECT qs.qm_spec_name, ent_id, item_id, item_category_id, process_id, oper_id, MAX(start_eff_utc) highest_spec_eff
            FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE qs.start_eff_utc <= CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00', 120)
              AND (qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL OR qs.end_eff_utc > CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00', 120))
            GROUP BY qs.qm_spec_name, ent_id, item_id, item_category_id, process_id, oper_id) specs_not_to_be_deleted
                  ON qs.qm_spec_name = specs_not_to_be_deleted.qm_spec_name AND qs.start_eff_utc = specs_not_to_be_deleted.highest_spec_eff
      LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qmscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.qm_spec_id = qmscl.qm_spec_id
      WHERE (qmscl.plan_id IS NOT NULL AND qmscl.plan_id = @plan_id)
          OR (qs.plan_id = @plan_id AND qmscl.plan_id IS NULL)
        UNION
      --One or more future specs are overrideen by the spec_char_links
      SELECT TOP 1 3
      FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qmscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.qm_spec_id = qmscl.qm_spec_id
      WHERE qs.start_eff_utc > CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00', 120)
        AND qmscl.plan_id = @plan_id
      UNION
      --The future specs are NOT overridden by the spec_char_link for the supplied plan_id
      SELECT TOP 1 4
      FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qmscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.qm_spec_id = qmscl.qm_spec_id
      WHERE qs.plan_id = @plan_id
        AND qs.start_eff_utc > CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), GETUTCDATE(), 120) + ':00', 120)
        AND qmscl.plan_id IS NULL
      )
   BEGIN
         RAISERROR('Cannot delete the sample plan because it is linked to a currently effective QM specification.{6932}', 16, 1)
         RETURN -1
   END
ELSE BEGIN
	-- Changes for CR #L00121941
	-- Moved the following lines from after the Delete statement
      UPDATE qm_spec SET plan_id = NULL WHERE plan_id = @plan_id
      UPDATE qm_spec_char_link SET plan_id = NULL WHERE plan_id = @plan_id
	-- End changed for CR #L00121941

   DELETE sample_plan
   WHERE (plan_id = @plan_id)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Ent_Access] (@V_Grp INT32, @V_User STRING40 = NULL, @V_Ent INT32 = NULL)
AS
-- ******************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Ent_Access
-- Description	      - Removes entity from the saved logon list for a user or for all the users in a group.
--                      For the variable @V_Grp_OR_Usr values - 0 = User, 1 = Group.
--                      HD#4654 - Removing access to entity doesn't remove from default or last saved list
-- Author             - Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created	      - 07/16/2004
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.38
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Version  Changes
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *******************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
  --Delete the entity access for this user
  IF @V_User IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
    --Get all the entities this group has access to
    DELETE ent_logon_list WHERE user_id = @V_User AND ent_id IN
      (SELECT ent_id FROM grp_ent_link WHERE grp_id = @V_Grp AND accss = 1)
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    --Delete the entity access for all the users in this user group
    DELETE ent_logon_list WHERE ent_id = @V_Ent AND user_id IN
      (SELECT user_id FROM user_grp_link WHERE grp_id = @V_Grp)
  END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE USP_SETADMIN
(
	 @RepoName as Varchar(250),
	 @UserId as UniqueIdentifier
)
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @Id as UniqueIdentifier
	set @Id = NEWID()
	
	Declare @TableId as UniqueIdentifier
	Select @TableId = Id from SKEVirtualTable where PhysicalTable='SKESGResourceMapping' AND Application=@RepoName
	
	Declare @SGId as UniqueIdentifier
	SELECT @SGId=Id from SKESecurityGroup where Title='Administrator' AND Application=@RepoName
	
	IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT Id FROM SKESGResourceMapping where SecurityGroupId = @SGId AND UserId=@UserId AND Application=@RepoName AND ListID IS NULL ) 
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO SKESGResourceMapping 
		VALUES 
		(@Id,@SGId,@UserId,NULL,NULL,0,NULL,@RepoName,@UserId,GETDATE(),GETDATE(),'Repository',NULL,0,NULL,@Id,NULL,NULL,@TableId,0,1,NULL,'|',
		3,NULL,NULL,NULL,@Id,1,NULL,@UserId,@UserId,NULL,NULL,0,NULL,'',NULL,NULL)
	END
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_U_Job_Step_StopStepWhenElap
(@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      	- sp_U_Job_Step_StopStepWhenElap
-- Description	      	- L00074324; Stop a step when elapsed
-- Author	      	- sp_U_Job_Step_StopStepWhenElap
-- Date Created	      	- 02/08/2008
-- Version	      	- 3.4
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	 @current_time		TDATETIME
	,@job_step_ent_id	INT32
	,@job_step_job_pos	INT32
	,@user_id		STRING80
	,@wo_id			STRING80
	,@oper_id		STRING80
	,@seq_no		INT32
	,@step_no		INT32
	,@lot_no		STRING80
	,@sublot_no		STRING80
	,@act_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@std_time		TFLOAT
	,@job_step_tran		NVARCHAR(1800)
	,@return		INT32
	,@session_id		INT32
	,@sessn_user_id		STRING80
	,@sessn_ent_id		INT32

SET NOCOUNT OFF
BEGIN
	SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	DECLARE each_job_step_elap CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT jsd.wo_id, jsd.oper_id, jsd.seq_no, jsd.step_no, jsd.lot_no, jsd.sublot_no, jsd.act_start_time_utc, js.std_time
	FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no AND js.step_no = jsd.step_no
	WHERE jsd.state_cd = 3
	  AND js.std_time > 0

	OPEN each_job_step_elap
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM each_job_step_elap INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @lot_no, @sublot_no,
			@act_start_time_utc, @std_time

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF (DATEADD(mi, @std_time*60, @act_start_time_utc) <= @current_time) BEGIN
			SELECT @job_step_ent_id = NULL, @job_step_job_pos = NULL

			SELECT @job_step_ent_id = je.ent_id, @job_step_job_pos = je.job_pos
			FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND je.cur_seq_no = @seq_no

			SET @job_step_tran = @wo_id + '-' + @oper_id + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @seq_no)
				+ '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @step_no) + '-' + COALESCE(@lot_no, '-')
				+ '-' + COALESCE(@sublot_no, '-')

			--SAVE TRANSACTION @job_step_tran

			-- get entity local offset to pass as time zone bias value
			SET @in_time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc( @job_step_ent_id, GetUtcDate() )

			--Assuming there are no users logged into this step, STOP this step as the time for this step is elapsed.
			EXEC @return = SP_U_JOB_STEP_STOPSTEPBYJOB @in_user_id=@user_id,
	                    @in_ent_id=@job_step_ent_id, @in_job_pos=@job_step_job_pos,
	                    @in_wo_id=@wo_id, @in_oper_id=@oper_id, @in_seq_no=@seq_no,
	                    @in_step_no=@step_no, @in_lot_no=@lot_no,
	                    @in_sublot_no=@sublot_no, @in_state_cd=4,
	                    @in_check_cert=1, @in_labor_option=1, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@in_time_zone_bias_value

--			IF (@return = -1) ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @job_step_tran
			IF (@return <> -1) BEGIN
				DECLARE each_sessn_ent_user CURSOR LOCAL FOR
				SELECT el.session_id, el.user_id, el.ent_id FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)

				OPEN each_sessn_ent_user
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM each_sessn_ent_user INTO @session_id, @sessn_user_id, @sessn_ent_id
					IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE lu.user_id = @sessn_user_id
							  AND lu.ent_id =  @sessn_ent_id
							  AND lu.active = 1
							  AND lu.wo_id = @wo_id
							  AND lu.oper_id = @oper_id
							  AND lu.seq_no = @seq_no
							  AND lu.step_no = @step_no
							  AND lu.lot_no = @lot_no) BEGIN

						-- get entity local offset to pass as time zone bias value
						SET @in_time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc( @sessn_ent_id, GetUtcDate() )

						EXEC sp_U_Job_Step_StepLogoutByJob @session_id, @sessn_user_id, @sessn_ent_id,
							@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @lot_no, NULL,
									NULL, @in_time_zone_bias_value
					END
				END
				CLOSE each_sessn_ent_user
				DEALLOCATE each_sessn_ent_user
			END
		END

	END
	CLOSE each_job_step_elap
	DEALLOCATE each_job_step_elap

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_RPU_GetDynamicRoutesForWO]
(
 @xml_source		NVARCHAR(4000)
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_RPU_GetDynamicRoutesForWO
-- Description					- Returns all dynamic route records for supplied wo, filtered by supplied filter values
-- Author						- Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created					- 07/06/2009
-- Version (last edit)			- 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries.  All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 02/04/2020       Jim O'Hearn     6.2.0       Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT  ON

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE   @itemIDFilters	   NVARCHAR(4000)
             ,@reworkCdFilters     NVARCHAR(4000)
             ,@reasCdFilters       NVARCHAR(4000)
             ,@doc_handle          INT32
             ,@orig_wo_id          NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@orig_oper_id        NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@item_id             NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@rework_cd           NVARCHAR(40)
             ,@reas_cd             NVARCHAR(40)
  	CREATE TABLE #itemIDFilters(item_id NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #reworkCdFilters(rework_cd NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)
	CREATE TABLE #reasCdFilters(reas_cd INT NOT NULL)


	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml
	SELECT @orig_wo_id = CASE WHEN orig_wo_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE orig_wo_id END
	, @orig_oper_id = CASE WHEN orig_oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE orig_oper_id END
    FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (orig_wo_id  NVARCHAR(160),
          orig_oper_id NVARCHAR(160))

	INSERT INTO #itemIDFilters (item_id)
		SELECT * FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, 'request/items/item_id', 1) WITH (reas_cd  nvarchar(max) 'text()')

	INSERT INTO #reworkCdFilters (rework_cd)
		SELECT * FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, 'request/rework_cds/rework_cd', 1) WITH (reas_cd  nvarchar(max) 'text()')

	INSERT INTO #reasCdFilters (reas_cd)
		SELECT * FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, 'request/item_reasons/reas_cd', 1) WITH (reas_cd  int 'text()')

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

    DECLARE @sSQL NVARCHAR(MAX)
    --Select the rework records that are possible for this wo.  For jobs that have already completed, only
    --those rework that did occur will be shown.
	SET @sSQL = '(SELECT rw.rework_process_id, op.oper_id, op.oper_desc, rw.orig_rework_cd, rw.orig_process_id, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'rw.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc, ir.reas_grp_id, rw.item_id, rw.max_times_rework, rw.reentry_rework_cd, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'op.display_seq, rw.last_edit_comment, rw.last_edit_by, rw.last_edit_at '
    IF(@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ', op2.oper_id as orig_oper_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM rework_process_usage rw WITH (NOLOCK) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN process pr with (NOLOCK) ON rw.rework_process_id = pr.process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN oper op with (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = pr.process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_reas ir with (NOLOCK)ON ir.reas_cd = rw.reas_cd '
    IF(@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN oper op2 with (NOLOCK) ON op2.oper_id in (Select oper_id from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @orig_wo_id and state_cd NOT IN (4,7)) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE (rw.orig_process_id IS NULL OR rw.orig_process_id in (Select process_id from wo WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @orig_wo_id)) '
    IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #itemIDFilters)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #itemIDFilters) '
    ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND (rw.item_id IS NULL OR rw.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @orig_wo_id))'
    IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #reworkCdFilters)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd FROM #reworkCdFilters) '
    ELSE IF (@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @orig_wo_id and state_cd NOT IN (4,7)) '
    ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id  = @orig_wo_id AND oper_id = @orig_oper_id and state_cd NOT IN (4,7)) '
    IF (@reasCdFilters IS NOT NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.reas_cd IN (' + @reasCdFilters + ') '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ') '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'UNION (SELECT rw.rework_process_id, op.oper_id, op.oper_desc, rw.orig_rework_cd, rw.orig_process_id, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'rw.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc, ir.reas_grp_id, rw.item_id, rw.max_times_rework, rw.reentry_rework_cd, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'op.display_seq, rw.last_edit_comment, rw.last_edit_by, rw.last_edit_at '
    IF(@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ', op2.oper_id as orig_oper_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM rework_process_usage rw WITH (NOLOCK) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN process pr with (NOLOCK) ON rw.rework_process_id = pr.process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN oper op with (NOLOCK) ON op.process_id = pr.process_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_reas ir with (NOLOCK)ON ir.reas_cd = rw.reas_cd '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN wo wo with (NOLOCK) ON wo.input_wo_id = @orig_wo_id '
    IF(@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN oper op2 with (NOLOCK) ON op2.oper_id in (Select oper_id from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @orig_wo_id and state_cd IN (4,7)) AND wo.input_oper_id = op2.oper_id '
    ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND wo.input_oper_id = @orig_oper_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE (rw.orig_process_id IS NULL OR rw.orig_process_id in (Select process_id from wo WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @orig_wo_id)) '
    IF (@itemIDFilters IS NOT NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.item_id IN (' + @itemIDFilters + ') '
    ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND (rw.item_id IS NULL OR rw.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @orig_wo_id)) '
    IF (@reworkCdFilters IS NOT NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (' + @reworkCdFilters + ') '
    ELSE IF (@orig_oper_id IS NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @orig_wo_id and state_cd IN (4,7) and oper_id = op2.oper_id) '
    ELSE SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND rw.orig_rework_cd IN (SELECT rework_cd from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id  = @orig_wo_id AND oper_id = @orig_oper_id and state_cd IN (4,7)) '
    IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #reasCdFilters)) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND rw.reas_cd IN (SELECT reas_cd FROM #reasCdFilters) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ')'


	DECLARE @paramDef NVARCHAR(MAX)
	SET @paramDef = '@orig_wo_id NVARCHAR(40), @orig_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)'
    EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @paramDef, @orig_wo_id = @orig_wo_id, @orig_oper_id = @orig_oper_id

	DROP TABLE #itemIDFilters
	DROP TABLE #reworkCdFilters
	DROP TABLE #reasCdFilters
END

-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_Wastejobs_ratio]
-- Description:	Get all the jobs which can have job state 3,4,& 5 and wo state 1,2 based on Entity with in time range

-- Usage:	This will be used in the Waste Management
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description

   0.02.02	 CK				  2024-03-01		Added logic for item (bom_pos=0) and equipment in case where WO is not null
-- 0.03.00	 DS				  2024-03-14		Modified the waste recording based on the design enhancement document, considering all the production for calculating ratio

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Wastejobs_ratio] 
--DECLARE 

@ent_id AS int,
@qty AS float,
@datefrom AS nvarchar(40),
@dateto AS nvarchar(40),
@wo_id AS nvarchar(40)

--SELECT  @ent_id=205,@qty=400, @datefrom=N'03/14/2024 07:09:15 AM',@dateto=N'03/14/2024 07:12:32 PM',@wo_id= null --N'8505048942'

AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE
  @total AS float,
  @id_min int,
  @id_max int,
  @split_qty DECIMAL(10, 3),
  @ratio_qty float,
  @date_from datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @datefrom),
  @date_to datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @dateto)

  --SET FROM DATE AND TO DATE IF NULL
    IF (@date_from is null or @date_to is null)
	BEGIN
		SET @date_from =(SELECT DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()))  -- Last 30 days from current time
		SET @date_to  =GETDATE()
	END

--TABLE DECLARATION
  DECLARE
  @jobprod TABLE 
  (
    id int IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    wo_id nvarchar(40),
    oper_id nvarchar(40),
    seq_no int,
    state_cd int,
    item_id nvarchar(40),
    total_qtyprod float,
    --split_qty float,
	split_qty  DECIMAL(10, 3),
    def_lot_no nvarchar(40),
    shift_start_local datetime,
    hour_start_local datetime,
    created_at_utc datetime
  )

  --GET RESULT SET FOR TIME RANGE
 IF (@wo_id IS NULL)   -- To record waste between time range
  BEGIN
  INSERT @jobprod
    SELECT ip.wo_id,
           ip.oper_id,
           ip.seq_no,
           j.state_cd,
           --ip.item_id,
		   j.item_id,  -- now only item to be produced will be considered
           SUM(ip.qty_prod),
           NULL,
           MAX(ip.lot_no) as lot_no,
           MAX(ip.shift_start_local),
           MAX(ip.hour_start_local),
           MAX(ip.created_at_utc)

    FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id
      AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id
      AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no
	 --INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)	-- 0.02.02 considered bom_pos 0
	 -- ON ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id
  --    AND ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id
  --    AND ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no
	 -- AND ip.item_id = jb.item_id
	 -- AND jb.bom_pos=0

    WHERE (ip.created_at_utc BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to)
    AND ip.ent_id = @ent_id
    --AND ip.good_prod = 1
    AND w.state_cd IN (1, 2) --(WO_state : Started, Completed)
    AND j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
    AND j.state_cd IN (3, 4, 5) --(Job Status: Running, Completed, Suspended)
    GROUP BY ip.wo_id,
             ip.oper_id,
             ip.seq_no,
             j.item_id,
            -- ip.lot_no,
             j.state_cd

	SELECT @total = SUM(total_qtyprod)  FROM @jobprod

    UPDATE @jobprod
    SET split_qty = ((total_qtyprod * @qty) / @total)

END

--GET RESULT SET FOR SELECTED WO_ID
IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL)   -- To record waste for a Workorder
BEGIN

print 'agaisnt wo '

  INSERT @jobprod
    SELECT ip.wo_id,
           ip.oper_id,
           ip.seq_no,
           j.state_cd,
           --ip.item_id,
		   j.item_id,  -- now only item to be produced will be considered
           SUM(ip.qty_prod),
           NULL,
           MAX(ip.lot_no) as lot_no,
           MAX(ip.shift_start_local),
           MAX(ip.hour_start_local),
           MAX(ip.created_at_utc)

    FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id
      AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id
      AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no
	  --AND ip.good_prod = 1 -- need to check whether we should be including the past waste recording or not, currently excluding

	  --INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)	-- 0.02.02 considered bom_pos 0
	  --ON ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id						--0.03.00 /14-Mar-2024	The system will calculate total produced qty (regardless of item) and split the waste quantity in the ratio of total produced qty. 
   --   AND ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id						-- hence excluding the job bom , here now the system will consider the non BOM production as well.
   --   AND ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no
	  --AND ip.item_id = jb.item_id
	  --AND jb.bom_pos=0

    WHERE ip.wo_id=@wo_id and ip.ent_id=@ent_id	--0.02.02 considered equipment in item_prod
    GROUP BY ip.wo_id,
             ip.oper_id,
             ip.seq_no,
             j.item_id,
             --ip.lot_no,
             j.state_cd

			-- select * from @jobprod
			 

  SELECT @total = SUM(total_qtyprod)  FROM @jobprod

   UPDATE @jobprod
    SET split_qty = ((total_qtyprod * @qty) / @total)

END


  SELECT id,
         wo_id,
         oper_id,
         seq_no,
         state_cd,
         item_id,
         total_qtyprod,
         split_qty,
         def_lot_no,
         shift_start_local,
         hour_start_local,
         created_at_utc
  FROM @jobprod
END
