CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_ApplyAdditiveShiftExc]
(@in_ent_id			INT32
,@in_exc_start_time		TDATETIME
,@in_exc_start_time_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@in_exc_end_time		TDATETIME
,@in_exc_end_time_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@in_shift_id			INT32
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 =NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_ApplyAdditiveShiftExc
-- Description		- Refresh the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 08/23/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.

-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 11/22/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
-- 02/15/2013    Ashish             4.6     Added fix for Merge CR-L00124791 cloned from Hotfix CR-L00124575
-- 02/27/2020    Anwarpasha         6.2     Added fix for Merge CR-L00156320 cloned from Hotfix CR-L00155629
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @ent_id		INT32
	,@exc_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@exc_end_time		TDATETIME
	,@shift_id		INT32

	,@start_day		INT32
	,@shift_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@shift_end_time	TDATETIME
	,@break1_start		TDATETIME
	,@break1_end		TDATETIME
	,@break2_start		TDATETIME
	,@break2_end		TDATETIME
	,@break3_start		TDATETIME
	,@break3_end		TDATETIME
	,@row_id		INT32

	,@start_day_temp	INT32
	,@shift_start_time_temp	TDATETIME
	,@shift_end_time_temp	TDATETIME
	,@shift_id_temp INT32
	,@break1_start_temp	TDATETIME
	,@break1_end_temp	TDATETIME
	,@break2_start_temp	TDATETIME
	,@break2_end_temp	TDATETIME
	,@break3_start_temp	TDATETIME
	,@break3_end_temp	TDATETIME
	,@dbg_resp			INT


	SET @in_exc_start_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_exc_start_time_tz)
	SET @in_exc_start_time			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_exc_start_time, @in_exc_start_time_tz)

	SET @in_exc_end_time_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_exc_end_time_tz)
	SET @in_exc_end_time			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_exc_end_time, @in_exc_end_time_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Ent_ApplyAdditiveShiftExc_temp', @src_key='sp_U_Ent_ApplyAdditiveShiftExc_temp',
					@date_val1 = @in_exc_start_time, @numeric_val1 = @in_exc_start_time_tz,
					@date_val2 = @in_exc_end_time, @numeric_val2 = @in_exc_end_time_tz

	IF (@dbg_resp=1)
	RETURN

	SELECT @ent_id = @in_ent_id, @exc_start_time = @in_exc_start_time, @exc_end_time = @in_exc_end_time
		,@shift_id = @in_shift_id

	--i) Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
	--ii) Determine whether the additive exception falls entirely within the shift.
	--iii) Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
	--iv) Determine whether the exception ends atleast after the shift end time.

	--i) Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
	SELECT TOP 1  @row_id = row_id
	FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
	WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
	--The shift exception starts on or before the shift start time.
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time)
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date <= @exc_end_time)

	 IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

	DECLARE shift_exceptions_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT shift_to_go_template.start_date
		, shift_to_go_template.end_date
		, shift_to_go_template.break1_start
		, shift_to_go_template.break1_end
		, shift_to_go_template.break2_start
		, shift_to_go_template.break2_end
		, shift_to_go_template.break3_start
		, shift_to_go_template.break3_end
		, row_id
	FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
	WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
	--The shift exception starts on or before the shift start time.
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time)
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date <= @exc_end_time)

	OPEN shift_exceptions_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_exceptions_cursor INTO @shift_start_time,@shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_start,
			@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start,@break3_end, @row_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
	IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--The exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
		SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1
			, @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time
			, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time

		--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT


		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL)
		--Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
		DELETE FROM #shift_to_go_template WHERE row_id = @row_id
		END
		END
		CLOSE shift_exceptions_cursor
	    DEALLOCATE shift_exceptions_cursor


		update #shift_to_go_template
			SET end_date = @exc_start_time
			, break1_start = @break1_start
			, break1_end = @break1_end
			, break2_start = @break2_start
			, break2_end = @break2_end
			, break3_start = @break3_start
			, break3_end = @break3_end
			WHERE start_date <= @exc_start_time AND end_date >= @exc_start_time
				AND ent_id = @ent_id

			update #shift_to_go_template
			SET start_date = @exc_end_time
				, break1_start = @break1_start
				, break1_end = @break1_end
				, break2_start = @break2_start
				, break2_end = @break2_end
				, break3_start = @break3_start
				, break3_end = @break3_end
			WHERE start_date <= @exc_end_time AND end_date >= @exc_end_time
				AND ent_id = @ent_id

		--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
					,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
					,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
				VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id --@shift_end_time_temp
					,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
					,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)


	END

	--ii) Determine whether the additive exception falls entirely within the shift.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--ii) Determine whether the additive exception falls entirely within the shift.
		SELECT TOP 1 @start_day = shift_to_go_template.start_day
			, @shift_start_time = shift_to_go_template.start_date
			, @shift_end_time = shift_to_go_template.end_date
			, @break1_start = shift_to_go_template.break1_start
			, @break1_end = shift_to_go_template.break1_end
			, @break2_start = shift_to_go_template.break2_start
			, @break2_end = shift_to_go_template.break2_end
			, @break3_start = shift_to_go_template.break3_start
			, @break3_end = shift_to_go_template.break3_end
			, @row_id = row_id
			, @shift_id_temp = shift_to_go_template.shift_id
		FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
		WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
		--The exception falls entirely within the shift
		--ie., the exception start time and end time falls within the shift start time and end time.
		  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time
		  AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_end_time)

		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Store the original data in a temporary variables.
			SELECT @start_day_temp = @start_day
				, @shift_start_time_temp = @shift_start_time, @shift_end_time_temp = @shift_end_time
				, @break1_start_temp = @break1_start, @break1_end = @break1_end
				, @break2_start_temp = @break2_start, @break2_end_temp = @break2_end
				, @break3_start_temp = @break3_start, @break3_end_temp = @break3_end

			--The exception falls entirely within the shift.
			--Split the current shift into 3 shifts if shift start time is not the exception start time
			--and shift end time is not exception the same as exception end time
			--otherwise; split the exception into 2 shifts.

			--The shift start time is same as the exception, but the shift end time is different than the exception end time
			--split this into 2 shifts; first shift being the exception shift and the second one being the regular shift

			IF (@shift_start_time = @exc_start_time) BEGIN
				--This shift starts at the exception start time
				--First, update the current shift, then insert a new exception shift
				SET @shift_start_time = @exc_end_time

				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

				--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
				SET start_date = @exc_end_time
					, break1_start = @break1_start
					, break1_end = @break1_end
					, break2_start = @break2_start
					, break2_end = @break2_end
					, break3_start = @break3_start
					, break3_end = @break3_end
				WHERE row_id = @row_id

				--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
				SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time
					, @break1_start = @break1_start_temp, @break1_end = @break1_end_temp
					, @break2_start = @break2_start_temp, @break2_end = @break2_end_temp
					, @break3_start = @break3_start_temp, @break3_end = @break3_end_temp
			END
			ELSE IF (@shift_end_time = @exc_end_time) BEGIN
				--This shift ends at the exception end time.
				--First, update the current shift, then insert a new exception shift
				SET @shift_end_time = @exc_start_time

				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

				--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
				SET end_date = @exc_start_time
					, break1_start = @break1_start
					, break1_end = @break1_end
					, break2_start = @break2_start
						, break2_end = @break2_end
					, break3_start = @break3_start
					, break3_end = @break3_end
				WHERE row_id = @row_id

				--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
				SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time
					, @break1_start = @break1_start_temp, @break1_end = @break1_end_temp
					, @break2_start = @break2_start_temp, @break2_end = @break2_end_temp
					, @break3_start = @break3_start_temp, @break3_end = @break3_end_temp
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				--The exception falls entirely within the shift start time and the shift end time.
				--Split this into 3 shifts.
				--First, update the current shift.
				SET @shift_end_time = @exc_start_time

				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

				--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
				SET end_date = @exc_start_time
					, break1_start = @break1_start
					, break1_end = @break1_end
					, break2_start = @break2_start
					, break2_end = @break2_end
					, break3_start = @break3_start
					, break3_end = @break3_end
				WHERE row_id = @row_id
				--Create a second part for the current shift.
				SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_end_time
					, @shift_end_time = @shift_end_time_temp
					, @break1_start = @break1_start_temp
					, @break1_end = @break1_end_temp
					, @break2_start = @break2_start_temp
					, @break2_end = @break2_end_temp
					, @break3_start = @break3_start_temp
					, @break3_end = @break3_end_temp

				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

				--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
					,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
					,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
				VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id_temp --@shift_end_time_temp
					,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
					,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)

				--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
				SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time
					, @break1_start = @break1_start_temp, @break1_end = @break1_end_temp
					, @break2_start = @break2_start_temp, @break2_end = @break2_end_temp
					, @break3_start = @break3_start_temp, @break3_end = @break3_end_temp
			END


			SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1

			--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

			INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
				,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
				,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id
				,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
				,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)
		END
	END

	--iii) Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
		--and ends at the shift end time or ends before the shift end time.
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_time = shift_to_go_template.start_date
			, @shift_end_time = shift_to_go_template.end_date
			, @break1_start = shift_to_go_template.break1_start
			, @break1_end = shift_to_go_template.break1_end
			, @break2_start = shift_to_go_template.break2_start
			, @break2_end = shift_to_go_template.break2_end
			, @break3_start = shift_to_go_template.break3_start
			, @break3_end = shift_to_go_template.break3_end
			, @row_id = row_id
		FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
		WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
		--The exception starts early; ie., the exception starts before the shift start time
		  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time
		--The exception ends on the shift end time; or atleast before shift end time
		  AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_end_time)

		-- Verify whether we identified any shift that falls on this exception category.
		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Store the original data in a temporary variables.
			SELECT @start_day_temp = @start_day
				, @shift_start_time_temp = @shift_start_time, @shift_end_time_temp = @shift_end_time
				, @break1_start_temp = @break1_start, @break1_end = @break1_end
				, @break2_start_temp = @break2_start, @break2_end_temp = @break2_end
				, @break3_start_temp = @break3_start, @break3_end_temp = @break3_end

			--CASE 1: the exception starts and ends exactly at the shift start time and shift end time; ALREADY HANDLED IN ii)
			--CASE 2: the exception ends exactly at the shift end time, but the exception starts after the shift start time ; ALREADY HANDLED IN ii)
			--CASE 3: the excaption starts earlier than the shift start time, but the exception ends exactly on the shift end time; ALREADY HANDLED IN i)
			--We only need to handle cases where exception starts earlier than the shift start time
			--and exception ends before the shift end time.

			--The exception falls within the shift. Split this shift into 2 shifts.
			--First, update the second part of the shift.
			SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_end_time) -1
				, @shift_start_time = @exc_end_time

			--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

			--This exception starts before the shift start time and ends on the shift end time or ends before the shift end time.
			UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
			SET start_date = @shift_start_time
				, break1_start = @break1_start
				, break1_end = @break1_end
				, break2_start = @break2_start
				, break2_end = @break2_end
				, break3_start = @break3_start
				, break3_end = @break3_end
			WHERE row_id = @row_id


			update #shift_to_go_template
			SET end_date = @exc_start_time
				, break1_start = @break1_start
				, break1_end = @break1_end
				, break2_start = @break2_start
				, break2_end = @break2_end
				, break3_start = @break3_start
				, break3_end = @break3_end

			WHERE start_date <= @exc_start_time AND end_date >= @exc_start_time


			--Create a new exception shift which starts at exception start time and ends at exception end time
			--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
			SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time
				, @break1_start = @break1_start_temp, @break1_end = @break1_end_temp
				, @break2_start = @break2_start_temp, @break2_end = @break2_end_temp
				, @break3_start = @break3_start_temp, @break3_end = @break3_end_temp
				, @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1

			--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

			INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
				,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
				,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id
				,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
				,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)
		END
	END

	--iv) Determine whether the exception ends atleast after the shift end time.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
		--and ends at the shift end time or ends after the shift end time.
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_time = shift_to_go_template.start_date
			, @shift_end_time = shift_to_go_template.end_date
			, @break1_start = shift_to_go_template.break1_start
			, @break1_end = shift_to_go_template.break1_end
			, @break2_start = shift_to_go_template.break2_start
			, @break2_end = shift_to_go_template.break2_end
			, @break3_start = shift_to_go_template.break3_start
			, @break3_end = shift_to_go_template.break3_end
			, @row_id = row_id
		FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
		WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
		--The exception starts after the shift start time;
		  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time
		--The exception ends on the shift end time; or atleast on the shift end time
		  AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date <= @exc_end_time)

		-- Verify whether we identified any shift that falls on this exception category.
		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

			--Store the original data in a temporary variables.
			SELECT @start_day_temp = @start_day
				, @shift_start_time_temp = @shift_start_time, @shift_end_time_temp = @shift_end_time
				, @break1_start_temp = @break1_start, @break1_end = @break1_end
				, @break2_start_temp = @break2_start, @break2_end_temp = @break2_end
				, @break3_start_temp = @break3_start, @break3_end_temp = @break3_end

			--CASE 1: the exception starts and ends exactly at the shift start time and end time; ALREADY HANDLED IN ii)
			--CASE 2: the exception ends exactly at the shift end time and the exception starts after the shift start time; ALREADY HANDLED IN ii)
			--CASE 3: the exception starts exactly on the shift start time and exception ends after the shift end time; ALREADY HANDLED IN i)
			--We only need to handle cases where exception ends after the shift end time
			--and the exception starts after the shift start time.

			--Only adjust the shift end time
			SET @shift_end_time = @exc_start_time

			--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

			--This exception starts before the shift start time and ends on the shift end time or ends before the shift end time.
			UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
			SET end_date = @exc_start_time
				, break1_start = @break1_start
				, break1_end = @break1_end
				, break2_start = @break2_start
				, break2_end = @break2_end
				, break3_start = @break3_start
				, break3_end = @break3_end
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			--Create a new exception shift which starts at exception start time and ends at exception end time
			--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
			SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time
				, @break1_start = @break1_start_temp, @break1_end = @break1_end_temp
				, @break2_start = @break2_start_temp, @break2_end = @break2_end_temp
				, @break3_start = @break3_start_temp, @break3_end = @break3_end_temp
				, @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1

			--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

			INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
				,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
				,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id
				,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
				,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)
		END
	END

	--v) The exception starts and ends before the shift start time OR starts and ends after the shift end time.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1   FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
			WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
			--The exception starts before the shift start time and the exception ends before the shift start time;
			  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_end_time
			--The exception falls on the same day with regards to some shift.
			  AND CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(mi, @in_exc_start_time_tz, shift_to_go_template.start_date), 120), 120) = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(mi, @in_exc_start_time_tz, @exc_start_time), 120), 120)
			  AND CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(mi, @in_exc_end_time_tz, shift_to_go_template.start_date), 120), 120) = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(mi, @in_exc_end_time_tz, @exc_end_time), 120), 120))
			  AND (@exc_start_time BETWEEN shift_to_go_template.start_date AND shift_to_go_template.end_date OR @exc_end_time BETWEEN shift_to_go_template.start_date AND shift_to_go_template.end_date))

			SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1

			INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id, start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
				,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id, @exc_start_time, @exc_end_time, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_Location]
(
@scheduleDate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
declare  @sSQL NVARCHAR(max) 
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	;with AllEnt as (
			select ea.attr_value JobPosition, ea.attr_desc JPDesc,eaM.attr_value EntManaged, eaM.attr_desc EntManagedDesc, e.ent_id,e.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description from ent e with (nolock)
			left join (select ea.attr_value, a.attr_desc, ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea with (nolock) 
			inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'JobPositions' ) ea on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
			left join (select ea.attr_value, a.attr_desc, ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea with (nolock)
			inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'MDM_Sched_EntManaged') eaM on eaM.ent_id = e.ent_id
			)
			, AllEntManagedParent as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntParent.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from AllEnt
			left join AllEnt AllEntParent on AllEnt.parent_ent_id = AllEntParent.ent_id)
			,AllEntManagedChildren as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntChild.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from AllEnt
			left join AllEnt AllEntChild on AllEntChild.parent_ent_id = AllEnt.ent_id)
			, AllEntManaged as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntParent.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from  AllEntManagedChildren AllEnt
			left join AllEntManagedParent AllEntParent on AllEnt.parent_ent_id = AllEntParent.ent_id)
	select distinct l.loc_id, l.loc_desc 
	from job j
	inner join SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent rge with (nolock) on rge.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
	inner join SDB.SCH.res_grp rg with (nolock) on rg.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id
	inner join SDB.SCH.loc l with (nolock) on l.loc_id = rg.loc_id
	inner join wo w with (nolock) on w.wo_id = j.wo_id
	inner join AllEntManaged AE on AE.ent_id = j.init_sched_ent_id and AE.EntManaged = 1
	--where CAST(w.release_time_local as date) = CAST(@scheduleDate as date) or CAST(w.req_finish_time_local as date) = CAST(@scheduleDate as date)


EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL

END

/*

-- Usage:	get SU details
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-03-26			Initial version. 
-- 0.01.01	LK			2023-07-17			added parameter @userRole to get the record for user has permisison on entities
-- 0.01.02	MA			2023-12-18			Changes to add grade color column.
-- 0.01.03	CK			2024-01-11			Added Get UOM function for empty silo and added function su status

-- 0.01.05  MA			2024-01-17			Added condition to take storage entity as ent desc.
-- 0.01.06  VJ			2024-07-03			Added condition to hide virtual silos based on attribute
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_su_overview_TEST_DD] 
	 @item_grp NVARCHAR(100),
	 @userRole nvarchar(20)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @item_grp_id INT
			SELECT @item_grp_id = a.attr_id 
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup';

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#unique_SU') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #unique_SU
	CREATE TABLE #unique_SU (
	 row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY
	,ent_id	INT
	,item_grp NVARCHAR(100)
	);

	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#additional_SU') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #additional_SU
	CREATE TABLE #additional_SU  (
	 row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY
	,ent_id	INT	
	,item_grp NVARCHAR(100)
	);
	
	-- 0.01.01
	Declare @user nvarchar(50)
	set @user='AvevaQA\'+@userRole
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi
	CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi (
	
	ent_id	INT,
	ent_name nvarchar(50),
	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
	can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
	can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
	can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
	can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
	can_stre nvarchar(5),
	can_log_data nvarchar(5),
	parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
	access int
	);
	INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi
	exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user


	--INSERT INTO #unique_SU
	INSERT INTO #additional_SU
	SELECT DISTINCT isl.storage_ent_id,isl.item_group
	FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE isl.item_group=@item_grp
	UNION ALL
	SELECT DISTINCT iv.ent_id,ia1.attr_value
	FROM item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=iv.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia1.item_id= i.item_id AND ia1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='ItemGroup') AND ia1.attr_value=@item_grp
	--INNER JOIN (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1) as UserEntaccess on iv.ent_id=UserEntaccess.ent_id  -- 0.01.01
	--where iv.ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	INSERT INTO #unique_SU
    SELECT DISTINCT ent_id,item_grp FROM #additional_SU
	where ent_id not in (SELECT ea1.ent_id from ent_attr ea1 where  
	ea1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='HideSUOnUI') 
	AND ISNULL(ea1.attr_value,'0')='1') -- 0.01.06
	--where ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	--INNER JOIN (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1) as UserEntaccess on iv.ent_id=UserEntaccess.ent_id  -- 0.01.01
	
	SELECT us.ent_id
		  ,isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_desc	--condition to take storage entity as ent_desc and as ent_name if desc is null.
		  ,e.ent_name
		  ,iv.item_id
		  ,i.item_desc
		  ,ig.item_grade_desc
		  ,SUM(iv.qty_left) AS su_qty
		  ,ISNULL(u.description,dbo.fn_s_ofi_GetUOM(us.ent_id)) as description
		  ,ia.attr_value AS segr_type
		  ,i.uom_id 
		  ,iv.grade_cd
		  ,iss.item_status_desc
		  ,iv.status_cd
		  ,max(iv.date_in_utc) as date_in_utc   
		  ,dbo.fn_ofi_su_get_mes_status (us.ent_id) as mes_status
		  ,dbo.fn_ofi_su_get_reclassify_status (us.ent_id) as reclassify
		  ,dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(ig.color) as grade_color	--passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
		  ,dbo.fn_s_ofi_SU_status (us.ent_id) as su_status
	FROM #unique_SU us 
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id=us.ent_id	
	LEFT JOIN (item_inv iv WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=iv.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK) ON iv.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
	INNER JOIN item_state iss WITH(NOLOCK) ON iv.status_cd= iss.item_status_cd
	INNER JOIN uom u  WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=i.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia1.item_id= i.item_id AND ia1.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='ItemGroup') AND ia1.attr_value=@item_grp
	LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id= i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = (select attr_id  from attr with(nolock)	where attr_desc='Classification')	-- classification is used ofr seggrigation

	) ON iv.ent_id=us.ent_id

	group by us.ent_id,e.ent_name,e.description,iv.item_id,i.item_desc ,i.uom_id,u.description,ia.attr_value,ig.item_grade_desc,iv.grade_cd
	, iss.item_status_desc,iv.status_cd,ig.color--,iv.date_in_utc
	ORDER by e.ent_name asc


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_clone_Job]
(
	@wo_id					STRING40,
	@oper_id				STRING40,
	@seq_no					INT32,
	@user_id				STRING40,
	@new_wo_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@new_oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@new_seq_no				INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@req_qty				TFLOAT_NULL  = NULL,
	@start_qty				TFLOAT_NULL  = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL,
	@state_cd				INT	= 2,
	@notes					NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0
)

AS
/*-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author               -
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/03/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes - I don't think this procedure is used.
-- 08/17/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 28/11/2022		CK				3.3.1		Takem from sp_clone_Job and edited as per requirement ************************************************************************************************************************/
BEGIN

	DECLARE @row_count INT32
		,	@standard_time_to_do_this_job TFLOAT
		,	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc TDATETIME
		,	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_wo_id STRING40
		,	@J_oper_id STRING40
		,	@J_seq_no INT32
		,	@J_job_desc string80
		,	@J_item_id STRING40
		,	@J_state_cd INT32
		,	@J_job_priority INT32
		,	@J_req_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_req_finish_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_init_sched_ent_id INT32
		,	@J_target_sched_ent_id INT32
		,	@J_run_ent_id INT32
		,	@J_qty_reqd TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_prod TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_prod_erp TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_rejected TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_rejected_erp TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_at_start TFLOAT
		,	@J_batch_size TFLOAT
		,	@J_first_job logical
		,	@J_final_job logical
		,	@J_sched_pinned logical
		,	@J_check_inv logical
		,	@J_est_fixed_lab TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_lab_rate TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_setup_time TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_teardown_time TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_prod_rate TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_transfer_time TFLOAT
		,	@J_sched_start_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_sched_start_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_latest_start_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_latest_start_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_sched_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_sched_finish_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_start_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_start_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_finish_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_concurrent_link INT32
		,	@J_job_cost TFLOAT
		,	@J_notes nvarchar(4000)
		,	@J_assoc_file string254
		,	@J_assoc_file_type string20
		,	@J_status_notes varchar(2000)
		,	@J_edited_by STRING40
		,	@J_edit_time TDATETIME
		,	@J_display_seq INT32
		,	@J_data_log_grp_id INT32
		,	@J_folder_ver_id STRING40
		,	@J_rework logical
		-- variables for JOB_ROUTE table fields
		,	@JR_wo_id STRING40
		,	@JR_oper_id STRING40
		,	@JR_seq_no INT32
		,	@JR_input_oper_id STRING40
		,	@JR_input_seq_no INT32
		,	@JR_input_percent TFLOAT
		,	@JR_mod_id timestamp
		,	@req_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp INT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

--1.	Check if the new wo_id/oper_id/seq_no exist raise an error, exit proc.  If none of new.. specified, crate new_seq_no
	--check if the row exists in the JOB table
	DECLARE JOB_cursor CURSOR LOCAL
	FOR SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc,
			item_id, state_cd, job_priority, req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local,
			init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd,
			qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp,
			qty_at_start, batch_size, first_job, final_job,
			sched_pinned, check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate,
			est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, est_transfer_time,
			sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local, latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local,
			sched_finish_time_utc, sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local,
			act_finish_time_utc, act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link, job_cost, notes,
			assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes, edited_by,
			edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework
	FROM JOB
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no

	OPEN JOB_cursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM JOB_cursor
	INTO	@J_wo_id, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @J_job_desc,
			@J_item_id, @J_state_cd, @J_job_priority, @J_req_finish_time_utc, @J_req_finish_time_local,
			@J_init_sched_ent_id, @J_target_sched_ent_id, @J_run_ent_id, @J_qty_reqd,
			@J_qty_prod, @J_qty_prod_erp, @J_qty_rejected, @J_qty_rejected_erp,
			@J_qty_at_start, @J_batch_size, @J_first_job, @J_final_job,
			@J_sched_pinned, @J_check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate,
			@J_est_setup_time, @J_est_teardown_time, @J_est_prod_rate, @J_est_transfer_time,
			@J_sched_start_time_utc, @J_sched_start_time_local, @J_latest_start_time_utc, @J_latest_start_time_local,
			@J_sched_finish_time_utc, @J_sched_finish_time_local, @J_act_start_time_utc, @J_act_start_time_local,
			@J_act_finish_time_utc, @J_act_finish_time_local, @J_concurrent_link, @J_job_cost, @J_notes,
			@J_assoc_file, @J_assoc_file_type, @J_status_notes, @J_edited_by,
			@J_edit_time, @J_display_seq, @J_folder_ver_id, @J_rework


	IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
--2.	Check if user has permission to clone, if not,  raise an error, exit proc.
--3.	if new_wo_id is specified oper_id, seq_no will remain same for the new record being created
			--ELSE(for new_wo_id = NULL) look in the job table for wo_id and oper_id
			--and calculate next seq_no (ie. new_seq_no)
		if @new_wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @new_wo_id = @wo_id
		END
		if @new_oper_id IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @new_oper_id = @oper_id
		END
		if @new_seq_no IS NULL BEGIN
			if (@new_wo_id = @wo_id) AND (@new_oper_id = @oper_id) BEGIN
				SELECT @new_seq_no = max(seq_no) + 1
				FROM JOB WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @new_seq_no = @seq_no
			END
		END
		--set the variables before inserting in JOB table
		if @req_qty IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @req_qty = @J_qty_reqd
		END
		if (@start_qty IS NULL )
		BEGIN
			SET @start_qty = @J_qty_at_start	
			SELECT @start_qty
		END
		if @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL BEGIN
			SELECT	@req_finish_time_utc = @J_req_finish_time_utc
				,	@req_finish_time_local = @J_req_finish_time_local
		END
		SET @J_edit_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
--5.		calculate latest start time (JOB table) by using req_qty and req_finish_time
		SET @standard_time_to_do_this_job = @J_est_setup_time + @J_est_teardown_time + @J_est_transfer_time
			+ (@J_est_prod_rate * @start_qty)

		SET @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local =
			DATEADD(Hour, -ROUND(CONVERT(float, @standard_time_to_do_this_job), 0), @req_finish_time_local)

		
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, @tz_temp, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc OUTPUT

		EXEC sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 1, 'sp_Clone_Job', 'sp_Clone_Job', 'Before inserting into JOB', 'INSERT INTO JOB', ''
--4.		Clone JOB table row (everything but wo_id, seq_no, state_cd,  req_finish_time, run_ent_id,
			--qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start,
			--sched_pinned, sched_start_time, sched_finish_time, act_start_time,
			--act_finish_time, concurrent_link, status_notes, edited_by, edit_time
		INSERT INTO JOB
		(
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc, item_id, state_cd, job_priority,
			req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local, init_sched_ent_id,
			target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp,
			qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start, batch_size, first_job,
			final_job, sched_pinned, check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate,
			est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, est_transfer_time,
			sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local,
			latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local, sched_finish_time_utc,
			sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local,
			act_finish_time_utc, act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link, job_cost,
			notes, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes,
			edited_by, edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework
		)
		VALUES	--state_cd=1-NEW,2-Released
		(
			@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @J_job_desc,@J_item_id, @state_cd, @J_job_priority
			,@req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_local,@J_init_sched_ent_id,
			@J_target_sched_ent_id, NULL, @req_qty,0, NULL,
			0, NULL, @start_qty, @J_batch_size, @J_first_job
			, @J_final_job,0, @J_check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate
			, @J_est_setup_time,@J_est_teardown_time, @J_est_prod_rate, @J_est_transfer_time,
			NULL, NULL, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc,@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, NULL
			, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @J_job_cost,
			@notes, @J_assoc_file, @J_assoc_file_type, NULL, @user_id,
			@J_edit_time, @J_display_seq, @J_folder_ver_id, @J_rework
		)
--6.	Clone JOB_BOM table row(s)* and then Clone JOB_BOM_STEP table row(s)*.
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_BOM @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
--7.	Clone*** JOB_SPEC table row(s)*.
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_spec @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
--8.	Clone*** JOB_STEP table row(s)*.
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_step @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
--9.	Clone JOB_ROUTE row.  Here if the new_wo_id is same as wo_id (just clone a job)
			--then insert new record with new seq_no, everything else remains same.
			--If new_wo_id is different then wo_id (clone to a new work order),
			--we have to clone the input JOB row before we can clone a row in the job_route.
		if @new_wo_id = @wo_id BEGIN
			EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_route @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
		END

		SELECT @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @J_job_desc,@J_item_id, @state_cd, @J_job_priority
			,@req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_local,@J_init_sched_ent_id,
			@J_target_sched_ent_id, NULL, @req_qty,0, NULL,
			0, NULL, @start_qty, @J_batch_size, @J_first_job
			, @J_final_job,0, @J_check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate
			, @J_est_setup_time,@J_est_teardown_time, @J_est_prod_rate, @J_est_transfer_time,
			NULL, NULL, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc,@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, NULL
			, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @J_job_cost,
			@notes, @J_assoc_file, @J_assoc_file_type, NULL, @user_id,
			@J_edit_time, @J_display_seq, @J_folder_ver_id, @J_rework
		CLOSE JOB_cursor
		DEALLOCATE JOB_cursor
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Oper_Item_Spec]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @step_no int = -1,
   @item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @item_class_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @assoc_file nvarchar(254) ,
   @comments nvarchar(2000) ,
   @min_value nvarchar(80),
   @max_value nvarchar(80),
   @access_level int,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @last_edit_at datetime OUTPUT,
   @row_id int OUTPUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 10/25/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084807 - added a check for a null assoc_file and only added the file type to the file_type table if the assoc_file is not null----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	    ,@data_type		INT
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32
	,@ftle		DATETIME
	,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(254)

SELECT @data_type = data_type FROM spec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spec_id = @spec_id

IF (@data_type = 1) BEGIN
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@spec_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},spec_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@min_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},min_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@max_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},max_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
END

IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	SET @assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(@assoc_file)
	EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
		, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
		, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
END

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

BEGIN
  INSERT INTO oper_item_spec
 (process_id,
  oper_id,
  step_no,
  item_id,
  item_class_id,
  ver_id,
  spec_id,
  spec_value,
  assoc_file,
  assoc_file_type,
  comments,
  min_value,
  max_value,
  access_level,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
  VALUES
  (@process_id,
   @oper_id,
   @step_no,
   @item_id,
   @item_class_id,
   @ver_id,
   @spec_id,
   @spec_value,
   @assoc_file,
   @assoc_file_type,
   @comments,
   @min_value,
   @max_value,
   @access_level,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

  --update spec version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

  UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @current_time, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND ver_id = @ver_id

   SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

END

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_Reas]
(@reas_cd  int  ,
 @reas_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @reas_grp_id  int  ,
 @state_cd  int  ,
 @runtime  bit  ,
 @downtime  bit  ,
 @setuptime bit ,
 @teardowntime bit ,
 @fixedtime  bit  ,
 @vartime  bit  ,
 @failure  bit ,
 @def_lab_cd  nvarchar(40) ,
 @priority int,
 @new_reas_cd int,
 @ent_enabled BIT = NULL,
 @spare1 nvarchar(80),
 @spare2 nvarchar(80),
 @spare3 nvarchar(80),
 @spare4 nvarchar(80),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 12/11/2006	Raghu		3.1.25	Included util_state.color column to be returned via the recordset.
-- 01/12/2010     Sara          4.0.0     Added fields for enhanced calculations
-- 04/22/2013	Raghu		4.6.	UserStory: 169932 - Changes related to line management.
-- 06/12/2013	Raghu		4.6		UserStory: 178626 - Changes related to ent_enabled
-- 10/14/2019	Surya		6.2		UserStory: 1123783 - Added spare fields
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT util_reas.reas_cd
            ,util_reas.reas_desc
            ,util_reas.reas_grp_id
            ,util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
            ,util_reas.state_cd
            ,util_state.state_desc
	        ,util_state.color
            ,util_reas.runtime
            ,util_reas.downtime
            ,util_reas.setuptime
            ,util_reas.teardowntime
            ,util_reas.fixedtime
            ,util_reas.vartime
            ,util_reas.failure
            ,util_reas.def_lab_cd
            ,labor_cat.lab_desc
            ,util_reas.display_seq
            ,util_reas.priority
            ,util_reas.max_duration
            ,util_reas.new_reas_cd
            ,util_reas.standard_time
            ,util_reas.min_time
            ,util_reas.max_time
            ,util_reas.ent_enabled
            ,util_reas.category1
            ,util_reas.category2
            ,util_reas.category3
            ,util_reas.category4
			,util_reas.spare1
			,util_reas.spare2
			,util_reas.spare3
			,util_reas.spare4
            ,util_reas.last_edit_comment
            ,util_reas.last_edit_by
            ,util_reas.last_edit_at
  FROM util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas.reas_grp_id = util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_state util_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas.state_cd = util_state.state_cd
       LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas.def_lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
WHERE ((util_reas.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.reas_desc = @reas_desc OR @reas_desc IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.reas_grp_id = @reas_grp_id OR @reas_grp_id IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.fixedtime = @fixedtime OR @fixedtime IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.vartime = @vartime OR @vartime IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.failure = @failure OR @failure IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.def_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd OR @def_lab_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.priority = @priority OR @priority IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.new_reas_cd = @new_reas_cd OR @new_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.ent_enabled = @ent_enabled OR @ent_enabled IS NULL) AND
	   (util_reas.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
	   (util_reas.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
	   (util_reas.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
	   (util_reas.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
	   (util_reas.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
Order By util_reas_grp.display_seq, util_reas.display_seq

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_cancelReleaseJob
-- Description:	
-- 
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		DS				2023-06-27			Initial version
--												#31[BAT List] Before completing the last job (Milling\Roasting job):
												1.	There shouldn’t be any RUNNING or SUSPENDED job exists in the cake blender\BW for a given WO.
													If that exists, then MES will not allow to complete that job (last job).
												2.	If there is any NEW & RELEASED job exists in the cake blender\BW,
													then MES will CANCEL those job automatically.
												3.	If there is any other Milling\Roasting job for same WO exists (in case of split of Milling\Roasting job)
													in NEW, RELEASED, RUNNING and SUSPEND state then the MES will allow that job to be completed.
													AND if not exists then MES will do the validation as mentioned in the point number 1 & 2.
-- 0.02		AKM				2023-07-06			4.	Calling sp to update job bom based on actual consumption for cakeblender job complete so the recipe 
													cabe be used as Last Used.
-- 0.03		JSC				2025-07-30			Removed the cancelling of RAN jobs state_cd = 5; and set those to 'completed = 4' 
--===========================================================================================*/

CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_cancelReleaseJob]   
		 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
		,@seq_no int
		,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)

AS
BEGIN

 declare	 @CheckPreviousJobState INT = 0
			,@oper_seq INT
			,@previous_operation NVARCHAR(40)
			,@process_id NVARCHAR(40)
			,@current_time_local AS DATETIME
			,@current_time_utc	AS DATETIME
			,@IsValidSplitJobExists int = 0

	

--  changes related to #0.04  begin
			SELECT @CheckPreviousJobState=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
				AND attr_id = ( SELECT attr_id
								FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
								WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckPreviousJobState' 
									AND attr_grp = 7) --7 = Operation Group 


			if exists(  SELECT 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN  job_state js with(nolock) on job.state_cd = js.state_cd and js.state_desc in ('NEW','RELEASED','RUNNING','SUSPENDED')
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						AND seq_no<>@seq_no  -- Should not be same seq number
						AND oper_id = @oper_id ) AND (@CheckPreviousJobState = 1)
			begin
				set @IsValidSplitJobExists = 1;
			end
	
			if(@CheckPreviousJobState=1 and @IsValidSplitJobExists = 0)
			BEGIN

					SELECT @process_id = process_id, 
						@oper_seq = display_seq 
					FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE oper_id = @oper_id

								
					SELECT TOP 1 @previous_operation = oper_id 
					FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE process_id = @process_id 
						AND display_seq < @oper_seq
						AND oper_id <> @oper_id
					ORDER by display_seq DESC


					 --Check if any of the jobs are running
					--IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 3) BEGIN
					--	RAISERROR('Cancelling jobs for this work order has failed since some of the jobs in this work order are currently being executed.{4204}', 16, 1)
					--	RETURN
					--END

					SELECT	@current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ),
							@current_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

					 --Cancel all the jobs -- UPDATED v0.03
					UPDATE job 
					SET state_cd = CASE WHEN state_cd = 5
											THEN 4
										ELSE 7
									END
					,act_finish_time_utc = @current_time_utc
					,act_finish_time_local = @current_time_local
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						AND oper_id = @previous_operation
						AND (state_cd = 1 OR state_cd = 2 OR state_cd = 5 OR state_cd = 6)		

			END
			
			if(@oper_id ='CakeBlending')
			begin
				exec sp_u_ofi_cb_Update_final_correction @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			end
--  changes related to #0.04  begin

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Step_UpdateStepData]
(
	@session_id				INT32,
	@user_id				STRING40,
	@ent_id					INT32,
	@job_pos				INT32 = 0,
	@step_no				INT32,
	@lot_no					STRING40,
	@sublot_no				STRING40,
	@data					STRING254,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version			Changes
-- 10/26/2002		Tony            1.5.0			Include job_pos as parameter and use it where relevant
-- 11/25/2002		Raghu			1.5.0			HD# 1899. 8) If lot_no is null, get from job_exec.def_lot_no, if still null, use lot_no = '-'
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2			Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0			HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 04/26/2007		Raghu			3.1.15			Added SET NoCount On and Set XAct_Abort On statements
-- 02/15/2007		Raghu			3.2.0			Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@cur_wo_id				STRING40,
			@cur_oper_id			STRING40,
			@cur_seq_no				INT32,
			@cur_step_no			INT32,
			@return					INT32,
			@cur_state_cd			INT32,
			@cur_step_data			STRING254,
			@cur_data_user_id		STRING40,
			@cur_datetime_utc		TDATETIME,
			@cur_datetime_local		TDATETIME,
			@def_lot_no				STRING40,
			@tz_temp				INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	-- Read job data for current job running on this entity
	-- job_exec.cur_wo_id, cur_oper_id, cur_seq_no where ent_id = input parameter
	SELECT	@cur_wo_id = job_exec.cur_wo_id
		,	@cur_oper_id = job_exec.cur_oper_id
		,	@cur_seq_no = job_exec.cur_seq_no
		,	@cur_step_no = job_exec.cur_step_no
		,	@def_lot_no = job_exec.def_lot_no
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id and job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos

	-- 10/26/2002    Tony                   1.5.0     Include job_pos in WHERE clause
	--Added by Raghu on 11/25/2002. If lot_no is null, use job_exec.def_lot_no, if still null, use lot_no = '-'
	IF (@lot_no IS NULL OR @lot_no = '') SET @lot_no = @def_lot_no
	IF (@lot_no IS NULL OR @lot_no = '') SET @lot_no = '-'

	SELECT	@cur_state_cd = job_step_data.state_cd
		,	@cur_step_data = job_step_data.step_data
		,	@cur_data_user_id = job_step_data.data_user_id
	FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_step_data.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		AND job_step_data.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		AND job_step_data.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		AND job_step_data.step_no = @step_no
		AND job_step_data.lot_no = @lot_no

	-- If row does not exist or step is NOT currently RUNNING (Step ID 3) then Return Error, else continue
	IF @cur_state_cd <> 3 BEGIN
	   	RAISERROR('Step is currently not running: %d{3228}', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value, @server_time = @cur_datetime OUTPUT
	SET @cur_datetime_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @cur_datetime_local, @tz_temp, @cur_datetime_utc OUTPUT

	--Check that this user_id is SAME user_id as currently in data_user_id field
	--if it is NOT null (which it is for 1st time data entry)
	IF @cur_data_user_id is NOT NULL begin
		IF LOWER(@user_id) <> LOWER(@cur_data_user_id) BEGIN
	   		RAISERROR('Step Data cannot be updated by another user: %d{3229}', 16, 1, @return)
			return -1
		END
	END

	--Update this row in Job_Step_Data table
	--with step_data, data_user_id = input params, step_data_time, last_edit_at = Now
	UPDATE JOB_STEP_DATA
	SET step_data = @data,
	    step_data_time_utc = @cur_datetime_utc,
		step_data_time_local = @cur_datetime_local,
	    data_user_id = @user_id,
	    last_edit_at = @cur_datetime_utc
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		AND step_no = @step_no
		AND lot_no = @lot_no

RETURN 0
END

/*
=============================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_NextSUInQueue
-- Description:	

-- Usage:		NewStorageUnitRequest WF - RSU interface
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2023-02-19			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2023-05-23			Disable checking on the old silo
-- 0.03.00	JSC				2025-10-07			CR512: Avoid missing secondary silo on Pressing
==============================================================================================
*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_NextSUInQueue]
		@wo_id nvarchar(100) = NULL,
		@oper_id nvarchar(100) =NULL,
		@seq_no int = NULL,
		@message_type int = NULL,
		@Old_SU nvarchar(40) = NULL,
		@New_SU nvarchar(40) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @Result_Desc NVARCHAR(100),
			@New_Mes_Ent_Id INT,
			@Old_Mes_Ent_Id INT

	IF (@New_SU is null OR @New_SU = 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @Result_Desc = 'Error: New storage unit is not getting the value';

		SELECT 0 AS result, @Result_Desc AS result_desc
		RETURN;
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SELECT @New_Mes_Ent_Id = ea.ent_id 
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'	
			AND ea.attr_value = @New_SU
	END

	-- MOD on v0.03
	SELECT @Old_Mes_Ent_Id = ea.ent_id 
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'	
		AND ea.attr_value = @Old_SU

	-- Used for debugger
	PRINT @New_Mes_Ent_Id 
	PRINT @Old_Mes_Ent_Id	

	if (@message_type = 2)
	Begin
		-- Clear the old one for the same item group (we only produce against 1 silo for each item group)
		DECLARE @jb_item_id NVARCHAR(40)

		-- ADDED v0.03. Avoid clearing non-requested SUs
		SELECT TOP 1 @jb_item_id = su.jb_item_id
		FROM ofi_su_selection su WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
			AND dest_type = @message_type
			AND su_ent_id = @Old_Mes_Ent_Id 

		UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
		SET latest_aut_silo = 1
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
			AND dest_type = @message_type
			AND jb_item_id = @jb_item_id -- ADDED v0.03. Avoid clearing non-requested SUs by item_group

		-- Update the current 
		UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
		SET latest_aut_silo = 0
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
			AND dest_type = @message_type
			AND su_ent_id = @New_Mes_Ent_Id
	END
	IF(@message_type = 1)
	BEGIN
		-- Update the current 
		Update ofi_su_selection 
		set latest_aut_silo = 0
		where wo_id = @wo_id 
			and oper_id = @oper_id
			and seq_no = @seq_no
			and dest_type = @message_type
			and su_ent_id = @Old_Mes_Ent_Id
			and secondary_silo_ent_id = @New_Mes_Ent_Id
	END

End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_ApplyShiftExceptions]
(
 @in_ent_id					INT32
,@in_start_date_time		TDATETIME
,@in_start_date_time_tz		INT32 = NULL
,@in_end_date_time			TDATETIME
,@in_end_date_time_tz		INT32 =NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 =NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_ApplyShiftExceptions
-- Description		- Refresh the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 08/23/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 11/22/2009	Aay			4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE	 @ent_id		INT32
	,@exc_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@exc_end_time		TDATETIME
	,@shift_id		INT32
	,@additive		INT32
	,@row_id		INT32
	,@dbg_resp		INT32

	SET @in_start_date_time_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_start_date_time_tz)
	SET @in_start_date_time				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_start_date_time, @in_start_date_time_tz)

	SET @in_end_date_time_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_end_date_time_tz)
	SET @in_end_date_time				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_end_date_time, @in_end_date_time_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	   -- TRACE
		EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Ent_ApplyShiftExceptions', @src_key='sp_U_Ent_ApplyShiftExceptions',
					@date_val1 = @in_start_date_time, @numeric_val1 = @in_start_date_time_tz,
					@date_val2 = @in_end_date_time, @numeric_val2 = @in_end_date_time_tz


	DECLARE shift_exceptions_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id, start_time, end_time, shift_id, additive, row_id
	FROM shift_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (ent_id = @in_ent_id OR @in_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (shift_exc.start_time >= @in_start_date_time AND shift_exc.start_time <= @in_end_date_time
	  AND shift_exc.end_time >= @in_start_date_time AND shift_exc.end_time <= @in_end_date_time)
		--OR (shift_exc.start_time <= @in_start_date_time AND shift_exc.end_time <= @in_end_date_time)
--		OR (shift_exc.end_time >= @in_end_date_time AND shift_exc.start_time BETWEEN @in_start_date_time AND @in_end_date_time))
--	  AND (shift_exc.start_time < @in_end_date_time)
--	   AND (shift_exc.end_time > @in_start_date_time)
	--First handle subtractive shift exceptions, so that a set of free times could be collected
	--and the same could be adjusted with the subsequent shift.
	ORDER BY ent_id, additive DESC, shift_id, start_time, end_time

	OPEN shift_exceptions_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_exceptions_cursor INTO @ent_id, @exc_start_time, @exc_end_time
			, @shift_id, @additive, @row_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--First handle subtractive shift exceptions, so that a set of free times can be collected
		--and the same times can be adjusted with the subsequent shift.
		IF (@additive = 0)
			--i) Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
			--ii) Determine whether the subtractive exception falls entirely within the shift.
			--iii) Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
			--iv) Determine whether the exception ends atleast after the shift end time.

			EXEC sp_U_Ent_ApplySubShiftExc  @in_ent_id = @ent_id, @in_exc_start_time = @exc_start_time,@in_exc_start_time_tz= @in_start_date_time_tz
				, @in_exc_end_time = @exc_end_time,@in_exc_end_time_tz=@in_end_date_time_tz, @in_shift_id = @shift_id
				, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
			-- End of subtractive exceptions
		ELSE BEGIN	-- Begin verifying additive exceptions

			--i) Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
			--ii) Determine whether the additive exception falls entirely within the shift.
			--iii) Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
			--iv) Determine whether the exception ends atleast after the shift end time.

			EXEC sp_U_Ent_ApplyAdditiveShiftExc  @in_ent_id = @ent_id, @in_exc_start_time = @exc_start_time,@in_exc_start_time_tz= @in_start_date_time_tz
				, @in_exc_end_time = @exc_end_time,@in_exc_end_time_tz=@in_end_date_time_tz, @in_shift_id = @shift_id
				, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
		END
	END
	CLOSE shift_exceptions_cursor
	DEALLOCATE shift_exceptions_cursor
END
