CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Spec_GetJobSpecs]
(@ent_id   int ,
 @wo_id	    nvarchar(80),
 @oper_id   nvarchar(80),
 @seq_no    int ,
 @step_no  int ,
 @spec_id  nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -	Returns a list of job specifications for the supplied job
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	02/07/2004
-- Version	      - 2.1.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

SELECT job_spec.wo_id, job_spec.oper_id, job_spec.seq_no, job_spec.step_no, job_spec.spec_id, job_spec.spec_value
,job_spec.act_spec_value, job_spec.assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type, job_spec.comments
,job_spec.min_value, job_spec.max_value, job_spec.access_level, spec.grp_id, spec.units
,spec.spare1, spec.spare2, spec.spare3, spec.spare4, job_spec.last_edit_comment, job_spec.last_edit_by
,job_spec.last_edit_at, spec.data_type data_type, spec.display_seq
, CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
WHERE (job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
  AND  job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no
  AND (job_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
  AND (job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL)
  AND (job_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
  AND (job_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY job_spec.spec_id
END

CREATE Trigger [tg_oper_step_ent_exc_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_ent_exc]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_step_ent_exc_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_ent_exc table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_step_ent_exc_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_step_ent_exc_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_ent_exc_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_step_ent_exc', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_step_ent_exc_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_step_ent_exc_cursor
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Version			  - 1.5.0.0

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver		Changes
-- 05/10/2007     Raghu              3.2.3	Adjust labor usage records when a session is deleted.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @client_type AS INT
		,@user_id AS NVARCHAR(80)

BEGIN
	SELECT @client_type = client_type, @user_id = user_id
	FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE session_id = @session_id

	IF (@client_type IS NOT NULL)
		--Call the SP below to deal with all ent log offs for this session at once.
		EXEC sp_D_Ent_LogOn_LogOffEnts @session_id, @user_id, @client_type, NULL, NULL, NULL

	--Not sure the statement below is required -- the cascade delete trigger on session to ent_logon
	--should automatically adjust all the labor usage records.
	DELETE ent_logon
	WHERE (session_id = @session_id)

	DELETE sessn
	WHERE (session_id = @session_id)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Shift_To_Go_GetSched]

   @start_time datetime,
   @end_time datetime ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--10/26/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
--IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time)
--IF @end_time IS NOT NULL SET @end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @end_time)

IF @ent_id IS NULL
BEGIN
	SELECT shift_to_go.ent_id
		  ,shift_to_go.start_time, shift_to_go.end_time, shift_to_go.shift_id
		  ,shift_to_go.break1_start, shift_to_go.break1_end, shift_to_go.break2_start, shift_to_go.break2_end
		  ,shift_to_go.break3_start, shift_to_go.break3_end
	FROM shift_to_go
	WHERE
		(start_time >= @start_time AND start_time <= @end_time)
		OR (end_time >= @start_time AND end_time <= @end_time)
END
ELSE BEGIN
	SELECT shift_to_go.ent_id
		  ,shift_to_go.start_time, shift_to_go.end_time, shift_to_go.shift_id
		  ,shift_to_go.break1_start, shift_to_go.break1_end, shift_to_go.break2_start, shift_to_go.break2_end
	FROM shift_to_go WHERE
		ent_id = @ent_id AND
		((start_time >= @start_time AND start_time <= @end_time)
		OR (end_time >= @start_time AND end_time <= @end_time))
END

CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[sp_I_Add_MESTableMethodParam] @location varchar(100), @sp_name varchar(100),@objectid varchar(10),@dbName varchar(100) AS
Begin
DECLARE @param_name varchar(100),@sql nvarchar(MAX),@sp_ref nvarchar(MAX),@MESTableObjectId varchar(100)

--SET @sp_name = 'SP_U_EI_PRO_Add_Details';
--SET @objectid = '761'
--SET @dbName = 'EI_DEMO'

Set @sp_ref = RIGHT(@sp_name,Len(@sp_name) - 8)
Print @sp_ref


--MESTable

SET @sql = 'insert into ' + @dbName +  '.dbo.MESTable (Name,AssemblyName,ClassName) values (''' + @location + ''',''' + 'STORED_PROCEDURE' + ''',''' + 'STORED_PROCEDURE' + '''' + ')' 
Print @sql
execute dbo.sp_executesql @sql
SET @sql = N'SELECT @MESTableObjectId = ObjectID from ' + @dbName + '.dbo.MESTable where Name = ''' + @location + ''''
Print @sql
execute dbo.sp_executesql @sql,@MESTableObjectId out

Print @MESTableObjectId

--MESTableMethod

DECLARE Param_Cur CURSOR for 

WITH SPs AS(
SELECT 
   SCHEMA_NAME(SCHEMA_ID) AS [Schema]
  ,SO.name AS [ObjectName]			   
  ,SO.Type_Desc AS [ObjectType (UDF/SP)]
  ,P.parameter_id AS [ParameterID]
  ,RIGHT(P.name,IIF(LEN(P.name) > 2,LEN(P.name)-1,LEN(P.name))) AS [ParameterName]
  ,TYPE_NAME(P.user_type_id) AS [ParameterDataType]
  ,P.max_length AS [ParameterMaxBytes]
  ,P.is_output AS [IsOutPutParameter]
FROM sys.objects AS SO
INNER JOIN sys.parameters AS P ON SO.OBJECT_ID = P.OBJECT_ID
WHERE SO.Type_Desc = 'SQL_STORED_PROCEDURE' and SO.name = @sp_name
)
Select ParameterName from SPs ORDER BY [Schema], [ObjectName], [ParameterID]

OPEN Param_Cur
FETCH NEXT FROM Param_Cur INTO @param_name

WHile @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
Begin

SET @sql = 'insert into ' + @dbName +  '.dbo.MESTableMethodParam (MESTableMethodObjectId,ParamName,IsRequired,IsIncluded) values (' + @objectid + ',''' +  @param_name + '''' + ',1,1)'
Print @sql

FETCH NEXT FROM Param_Cur INTO @param_name
end

CLOSE Param_Cur
DEALLOCATE Param_Cur
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Error_Log]
(@log_id  int  ,
 @logged_at  datetime  ,
 @severity  int  ,
 @instance_info  nvarchar(254)  ,
 @object_name  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @object_section  nvarchar(80) ,
 @time_zone_bias_value int = 0)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By		Ver		Changes
--10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @logged_at IS NOT NULL SET @logged_at = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logged_at)

SELECT error_log.log_id
            ,error_log.logged_at
            ,error_log.severity
            ,error_log.instance_info
            ,error_log.object_name
            ,error_log.object_section
            ,error_log.description
            ,error_log.system_msg
  FROM error_log error_log WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((error_log.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL) AND
       (error_log.logged_at >= @logged_at OR @logged_at IS NULL) AND
       (error_log.severity = @severity OR @severity IS NULL) AND
       (error_log.instance_info = @instance_info OR @instance_info IS NULL) AND
       (error_log.object_name = @object_name OR @object_name IS NULL) AND
       (error_log.object_section = @object_section OR @object_section IS NULL)  )
ORDER BY error_log.description

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ofi_cb_Update_final_correction]

@wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = null,
@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = null,
@seq_no INT = null
AS
BEGIN

	declare @temp_cons table(itemid nvarchar(40), qty_con float)
	declare @total_cons float

	select @total_cons = sum(qty_cons) from item_cons ic with(nolock)
		right join item_attr ia with(nolock) on ic.item_id = ia.item_id and ia.attr_value='FERT'
		where ic.wo_id=@wo_id and ic.seq_no=@seq_no and ic.oper_id=@oper_id

	insert into @temp_cons
	select item_id,sum(qty_cons) from item_cons jb with(nolock)
	where jb.wo_id=@wo_id and  jb.oper_id=@oper_id and jb.seq_no=@seq_no
	group by item_id

	UPDATE jb 
			set jb.qty_reqd = tc.qty_con,
				jb.qty_per_parent_item = round(tc.qty_con/@total_cons,3)
			
			from job_bom jb
				 join @temp_cons tc ON jb.item_id = tc.itemid
				 join item_attr ia on tc.itemid=ia.item_id and ia.attr_value='FERT' 
			where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and bom_pos >0

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_Waste_record_jobs]
-- Description:	Get all the jobs which can have job state 3,4,& 5 and wo state 1,2 based on Entity with in time range
--
-- Usage:	This will be used in the Waste Management
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-03-23		Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	 MP            	  2023-07-06		Adding logic for work order based waste recording
-- 0.02.01	Veervar			  2024-02-02		Logic comments and Cleanup.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Waste_record_jobs] 
@ent_id AS int


AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE
  @date_from datetime,
  @date_to datetime
  
 SET @date_from =(SELECT DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE()))  -- Last 30 days from current time
 SET @date_to  =GETDATE()

  DECLARE
  @jobprod TABLE 
  (
    id int IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
    wo_id nvarchar(40),
    oper_id nvarchar(40),
    seq_no int,
    state_cd int,
    item_id nvarchar(40),
    total_qtyprod float,
    split_qty float,
    def_lot_no nvarchar(40),
    shift_start_local datetime,
    hour_start_local datetime,
    created_at_utc datetime
  ) 
 --INSERT GOOD PROD DATA INTO TEMP TABLE FOR ENTITY
  INSERT @jobprod
    SELECT w.wo_id,
           ip.oper_id,
           ip.seq_no,
           j.state_cd,
           ip.item_id,
           SUM(ip.qty_prod),
           NULL,
           ip.lot_no,
           MAX(ip.shift_start_local),
           MAX(ip.hour_start_local),
           MAX(ip.created_at_utc)
    FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
    INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id
      AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id
      AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no
    WHERE (ip.created_at_utc BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to)
		AND ip.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND ip.good_prod = 1
		AND w.state_cd IN (1, 2) --(WO_state : Started, Completed)
		AND j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
		AND j.state_cd IN (3, 4, 5) --(Job Status: Running, Completed, Suspended)
    GROUP BY w.wo_id,
        ip.oper_id,
        ip.seq_no,
        ip.item_id,
        ip.lot_no,
        j.state_cd

--GET DISTINCT WO_ID IN FINAL DATASET FROM TEMP TABLE
  SELECT wo_id FROM @jobprod
				GROUP BY wo_id


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_ApplySubShiftExc]
(@in_ent_id			INT32
,@in_exc_start_time		TDATETIME
,@in_exc_start_time_tz	INT32= NULL
,@in_exc_end_time		TDATETIME
,@in_exc_end_time_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@in_shift_id			INT32
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 =NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_ApplySubShiftExc
-- Description		- Refresh the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 08/31/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 02/15/2013    Ashish        4.6     Added fix for Merge CR-L00124791 cloned from Hotfix CR-L00124575
-- 03/18/2015    Sara Reynolds  5.2    Added fix for Merge CR-L00135726 cloned from Hotfix CR-L00135125
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @ent_id		INT32
	,@exc_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@exc_end_time		TDATETIME
	,@shift_id			INT32
	,@start_day			INT32
	,@shift_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@shift_end_time	TDATETIME
	,@break1_start		TDATETIME
	,@break1_end		TDATETIME
	,@break2_start		TDATETIME
	,@break2_end		TDATETIME
	,@break3_start		TDATETIME
	,@break3_end		TDATETIME
	,@row_id			INT32
	,@dbg_resp			INT32

	,@shift_temp_id     INT32
	,@start_day_temp	INT32
	,@shift_start_time_temp	TDATETIME
	,@shift_end_time_temp	TDATETIME


	SET @in_exc_start_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_exc_start_time_tz)
	SET @in_exc_start_time			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_exc_start_time, @in_exc_start_time_tz)
	SET @in_exc_end_time_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_exc_end_time_tz)
	SET @in_exc_end_time			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_exc_end_time, @in_exc_end_time_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Ent_ApplySubShiftExc_temp', @src_key='sp_U_Ent_ApplySubShiftExc_temp',
					@date_val1 = @in_exc_start_time, @numeric_val1 = @in_exc_start_time_tz,
					@date_val2 = @in_exc_end_time, @numeric_val2 = @in_exc_end_time_tz

	if (@dbg_resp=1)
	return

	SELECT @ent_id = @in_ent_id, @exc_start_time = @in_exc_start_time, @exc_end_time = @in_exc_end_time
		,@shift_id = @in_shift_id

	--i) Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
	--ii) Determine whether the subtractive exception falls entirely within the shift.
	--iii) Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
	--iv) Determine whether the exception ends atleast after the shift end time.

	--i)Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
	SELECT TOP 1  @row_id = row_id
	FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
	WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
	--The shift exception starts on or before the shift start time.
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time)
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date <= @exc_end_time)

	 IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

	DECLARE shift_exceptions_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT shift_to_go_template.start_date
		, shift_to_go_template.end_date
		, row_id
	FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
	WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
	--The shift exception starts on or before the shift start time.
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time)
	  AND (shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date <= @exc_end_time)
          AND shift_to_go_template.row_id = @row_id
	OPEN shift_exceptions_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_exceptions_cursor INTO @shift_start_time,@shift_end_time,@row_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--The exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
		SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1
			, @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time
			, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time


	IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL)
		--Determine whether the exception overlaps/covers the entire shift.
		DELETE FROM #shift_to_go_template WHERE row_id = @row_id
		END
		END
		CLOSE shift_exceptions_cursor
	    DEALLOCATE shift_exceptions_cursor

		update #shift_to_go_template
			SET end_date = @exc_start_time
			WHERE start_date <= @exc_start_time AND end_date >= @exc_start_time AND row_id = @row_id

			update #shift_to_go_template
			SET start_date = @exc_end_time
			WHERE start_date <= @exc_end_time AND end_date >= @exc_end_time AND row_id = @row_id
		END
	--ii)Verify whether the previous case for exception is handled.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Determine whether the subtractive exception falls entirely within the shift.
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_time = shift_to_go_template.start_date
			, @shift_end_time = shift_to_go_template.end_date
			, @break1_start = shift_to_go_template.break1_start
			, @break1_end = shift_to_go_template.break1_end
			, @break2_start = shift_to_go_template.break2_start
			, @break2_end = shift_to_go_template.break2_end
			, @break3_start = shift_to_go_template.break3_start
			, @break3_end = shift_to_go_template.break3_end
			, @row_id = row_id
			,@shift_temp_id = shift_id
		FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
		WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
		--The exception falls entirely within the shift
		--ie., the exception start time and end time falls within the shift start time and end time.
		  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time
		  AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_end_time)

		IF (@shift_start_time IS NOT NULL AND @row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--The exception falls entirely within the shift.
			--Split the current shift into 2 shifts
			IF (@shift_start_time = @exc_start_time) BEGIN
				--This shift starts at the exception start time
				--First, update the current shift, then insert a new exception shift
				SET @shift_start_time = @exc_end_time


				--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
				SET start_date = @exc_end_time
				WHERE row_id = @row_id

				--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
				SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time

			END
			ELSE IF (@shift_end_time = @exc_end_time) BEGIN
				--This shift ends at the exception end time.
				--First, update the current shift, then insert a new exception shift
				SET @shift_end_time = @exc_start_time

				--First update the current shift to start at the exception end time
				UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
				SET end_date = @exc_start_time
				WHERE row_id = @row_id

				--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
				SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time

			END
			ELSE BEGIN
			--First update the current shift to end at the exception start time
			UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
			SET end_date = @exc_start_time
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_end_time) -1
				, @shift_start_time = @exc_end_time

			--Create another shift with the same shift_id which starts with the exception end time.
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break1_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break2_end OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_start OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_SA_Ent_GetShiftBreaks @in_start_date=@shift_start_time, @in_end_date=@shift_end_time, @break_time=@break3_end OUTPUT

			INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
				,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
				,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_temp_id
				,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
				,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)
		END
		END
	END

		--iii) Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
		--and ends at the shift end time or ends before the shift end time.
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_time = shift_to_go_template.start_date
			, @shift_end_time = shift_to_go_template.end_date
			, @row_id = row_id
		FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
		WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
		--The exception starts early; ie., the exception starts before the shift start time
		  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time
		--The exception ends on the shift end time; or atleast before shift end time
		  AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_end_time)

		-- Verify whether we identified any shift that falls on this exception category.
		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Store the original data in a temporary variables.
			SELECT @start_day_temp = @start_day
				, @shift_start_time_temp = @shift_start_time, @shift_end_time_temp = @shift_end_time

			--CASE 1: the exception starts and ends exactly at the shift start time and shift end time; ALREADY HANDLED IN ii)
			--CASE 2: the exception ends exactly at the shift end time, but the exception starts after the shift start time ; ALREADY HANDLED IN ii)
			--CASE 3: the excaption starts earlier than the shift start time, but the exception ends exactly on the shift end time; ALREADY HANDLED IN i)
			--We only need to handle cases where exception starts earlier than the shift start time
			--and exception ends before the shift end time.

			--The exception falls within the shift. Split this shift into 2 shifts.
			--First, update the second part of the shift.
			SELECT @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_end_time) -1
				, @shift_start_time = @exc_end_time


			--This exception starts before the shift start time and ends on the shift end time or ends before the shift end time.
			UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
			SET start_date = @shift_start_time
			WHERE row_id = @row_id


			update #shift_to_go_template
			SET end_date = @exc_start_time
			WHERE start_date <= @exc_start_time AND end_date >= @exc_start_time AND ent_id=@ent_id


			--Create a new exception shift which starts at exception start time and ends at exception end time
			--Now, set the exception shift start time and exception end time to insert a new exception shift.
			SELECT @shift_start_time = @exc_start_time, @shift_end_time = @exc_end_time
				, @start_day = DATEPART(dw, @exc_start_time) -1

			INSERT INTO #shift_to_go_template (ent_id, start_day, shift_id
				,start_date, end_date, break1_start, break1_end
				,break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id
				,@shift_start_time, @shift_end_time, @break1_start, @break1_end
				,@break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end)
		END
	END

	--iv)Determine whether the exception starts after the shift start time
	--and ends at the shift end time or ends after the shift end time.
	IF (@row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Determine whether the exception starts before the shift start time.
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_time = shift_to_go_template.start_date
			, @shift_end_time = shift_to_go_template.end_date
			, @row_id = row_id
		FROM #shift_to_go_template shift_to_go_template
		WHERE shift_to_go_template.ent_id = @ent_id --AND shift_to_go_template.shift_id = @shift_id
		--The exception starts after the shift start time;
		  AND (shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.start_date <= @exc_end_time
		--The exception ends on the shift end time; or atleast on the shift end time
		  AND shift_to_go_template.end_date >= @exc_start_time AND shift_to_go_template.end_date <= @exc_end_time)

		-- Verify whether we identified any shift that falls on this exception category.
		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL)
			--This exception starts after the shift has started and ends on the shift end time or ends after the shift end time.
			UPDATE #shift_to_go_template SET end_date = @exc_start_time
			WHERE row_id = @row_id
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_Material_Forcast]
(
@scheduleDate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select  jb.item_id as item_id, i.item_desc as item_desc , 
	case when jb.bom_pos > 0 then SUM(jb.qty_per_parent_item*w.req_qty) end as 'qty_req', 
	case when jb.bom_pos = 0 then ISNULL(SUM(jb.qty_per_parent_item*w.req_qty),0) end as 'qty_prod', 
	ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left),0) as 'qty_stock', 
	(ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left),0) - ISNULL(SUM(jb.qty_per_parent_item*w.req_qty),0)) as 'qty_diff',
	'' as comment
	from job_bom jb inner join wo w on jb.wo_id = w.wo_id
	inner join item i on i.item_id = jb.item_id
	left outer join item_prod ip on ip.item_id = jb.item_id and ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id
	left outer join item_inv ii on ii.item_id = i.item_id
	where CAST(w.release_time_local as date) = CAST(@scheduleDate as date)
	group by jb.item_id, i.item_desc,jb.bom_pos


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Spec_GetJSByFilter]
(@wo_id 	NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no	NVARCHAR(40)
,@step_no	NVARCHAR(40)
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_Job_Spec_GetJSByFilter
-- Description    - Returns a recordset of all specs with its associated job_spec (if any)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 11/06/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved..
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	SELECT * FROM (
	SELECT spec.grp_id, spec.spec_id, job_spec.step_no,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))) mod_id, job_spec.access_level, spec.data_type
	FROM spec spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON spec.spec_id = job_spec.spec_id
	WHERE job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id AND job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND job_spec.step_no = @step_no
	UNION
	SELECT spec.grp_id, spec.spec_id, NULL 'step_no', NULL 'mod_id', NULL 'access_level', spec.data_type
	FROM spec spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE spec_id NOT IN (SELECT spec_id FROM job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no AND job_spec.step_no = @step_no)
	) x
	ORDER BY grp_id, spec_id
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_step_ent_exc_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_ent_exc]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_step_ent_exc_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_ent_exc table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_step_ent_exc_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_step_ent_exc a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		      AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		    AND a.step_no = b.step_no
		    AND a.ent_id = b.ent_id
	OPEN oper_step_ent_exc_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_ent_exc_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_step_ent_exc', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_step_ent_exc_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_step_ent_exc_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals]
(@filter		NVARCHAR(MAX)
,@criteria		NVARCHAR(MAX)
,@filter_style		NVARCHAR(10)
,@criteria_value	NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -  sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals
-- Description	      - Used to extract filter value based on the filter specified
--			@filter - Specifies the complete filter string; for eg., $$item_id=bevcolapk$$$$item_desc=beverage cola pack$$
--			@criteria- Specifies the criteria value to be searched for for eg., item_desc
--			@filter_style - Specifies the style of the filter; for eg., $ or ; etc...
-- Author	      -  Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 10/15/2003
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--08/05/2005	Raghu		2.1.25	HD# 6089, Increased the criteria value from 80 to 4000
--09/12/2008    Raghu        3.5    L00075683: Supervisor's Process window filter cannot handle ui_config.valu string longer than 4000 chars - shows an empty process tree.  CR 74059 corrected this problem for Supervisor's Jobs window filter.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @iStart		INT
	,@iEnd			INT

	SET @filter = UPPER(@filter)
	SET @criteria = UPPER(@criteria)

	SET @criteria_value = ''
	SET @istart = CHARINDEX(@criteria, @filter, 1)

	IF (@istart > 0) BEGIN
		SET @iEnd = CHARINDEX(@filter_style, @filter, @iStart + 1)

		IF (@iEnd > 0)
			SET @criteria_value = SUBSTRING(@filter, @istart, (@iend - @istart))
		ELSE
			SET @criteria_value = RIGHT(@filter, (LEN(@filter) - @istart) + 1)

		SET @criteria_value = REPLACE(@criteria_value, @criteria, '')

	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Assigned_Lot_GetByFilter]
(
	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0

)

AS

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- SP_SA_ASSIGNED_LOT_GETBYFILTER_GETBYFILTER
-- Description					- Returns a recordset from assigned_lot table with the supplied filters.
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 03/19/2007
-- Version						- 3.2.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes						-
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified		Modified_By     Version		Changes
-- 07/02/2007			AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- 12/23/2009			Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	SELECT	assigned_lot.item_id
        ,	i.item_desc
        ,	assigned_lot.lot_no
        ,	assigned_lot.sublot_no
        ,	assigned_lot.wo_id
        ,	assigned_lot.oper_id
        ,	assigned_lot.seq_no
        ,	assigned_lot.status
        ,	assigned_lot.spare1
        ,	assigned_lot.spare2
        ,	assigned_lot.spare3
        ,	assigned_lot.spare4
        ,	assigned_lot.last_edit_comment
        ,	assigned_lot.last_edit_by
        ,	assigned_lot.created_by
        ,	assigned_lot.last_edit_at
        ,	assigned_lot.created_at
        ,	assigned_lot.row_id
        ,	ila.*
     FROM assigned_lot WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON assigned_lot.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila WITH (NOLOCK) ON ila.inv_lot_item_id_h = assigned_lot.item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h = assigned_lot.lot_no
     WHERE (assigned_lot.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)  AND
           (assigned_lot.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)  AND
           (assigned_lot.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)  AND
           (assigned_lot.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)  AND
           (assigned_lot.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)

END

   @screen nvarchar(40) ,

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_Personnel]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT value4 AS Personnel
FROM [dbo].[job_event]

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetPostWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
-- Description: This is used to prepare the RM/SFG/FG materials report based on WIP consumptions
-- Note : For unreported items created after all corresponding WIP consumption has already been reported
--
-- Runs before: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport; 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	MC            	2025-11-10			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01  AML, XPM	    2026-06-29          Filter out 'T' traceability sublots 
-- ===========================================================================================
--EXEC sp_S_ofi_EI_GetPostWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetPostWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- SP NAME: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetPostWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork

	-- Declare general variables 
	DECLARE     
		@debug            		BIT   = 0 -- Used for internal DEBUG -- SET to zero before deployment
		,@cutoff_date			DATETIME
		,@delay_hours			INT = 4
		,@error_msg           	NVARCHAR(MAX) -- Error handling
		,@error_severity      	INT           -- Error handling
		,@error_state         	INT           -- Error handling
	--	Declare attribute id variables
	DECLARE
		@notConsumeToSap_id		INT
		,@skipConsReporting_id	INT
	-- Declare STEP1 variables
	DECLARE
		@fg_lot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@fg_sublot_no	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@process_id	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@seq_no		INT
	DECLARE @cons_records AS TABLE(
		cons_row_id INT,
		fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
		fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40),
		oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
		process_id NVARCHAR(40),
		item_id NVARCHAR(40),
		seq_no INT,
		qty_cons FLOAT,
		qty_cons_erp FLOAT,
		last_edit_at DATETIME,
		created_at_utc DATETIME
	)
	-- 0.01.09 Calculate cutoff date for eligible records
    SET @cutoff_date = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -@delay_hours, GETUTCDATE())), 0);

	-- 0.01.09 Add applock to avoid race with ToReport SP
	DECLARE @rc INT;
	EXEC @rc = sys.sp_getapplock
		 @DbPrincipal = N'dbo',
		 @Resource    = N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK',
		 @LockMode    = N'Exclusive',
		 @LockOwner   = N'Session',
		 @LockTimeout = 5000;

	IF (@rc < 0)
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Skipped: another session holds WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK.';
		RETURN;
	END

	SELECT @skipConsReporting_id = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting' AND attr_grp = 1
	SELECT @notConsumeToSap_id = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE attr_desc = 'NotConsumeToSAP' AND attr_grp = 7

	-- STEP 1: Get TOP 1 oldest consumption sublot without connection to production
	-- Verify if exists lot connection to production and WIP/INTERMEDIATE is produced
	-- Verify current sublot number running on the WIP production line
	
	INSERT INTO @cons_records(
		cons_row_id,
		fg_lot_no,
		fg_sublot_no,
		oper_id,
		process_id,
		item_id,
		seq_no,
		qty_cons,
		qty_cons_erp,
		last_edit_at,
		created_at_utc
		)
	SELECT
		ic.row_id,
		ic.fg_lot_no,
		ic.fg_sublot_no,
		ic.oper_id,
		w.process_id,
		ic.item_id,
		ic.seq_no,
		ic.qty_cons,
		ic.qty_cons_erp,
		ic2.last_edit_at,
		ic2.created_at_utc
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ia.item_id = i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @skipConsReporting_id
	LEFT JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON oa.process_id = w.process_id
		AND oa.oper_id = ic.oper_id
		AND oa.attr_id = @notConsumeToSap_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT DISTINCT item_cons_row_id
		FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported
		WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
		) cwr ON cwr.item_cons_row_id=ic.row_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT lot_no, sublot_no, oper_id, process_id, MAX(ic2.last_edit_at) AS last_edit_at, MAX(ic2.created_at_utc) AS created_at_utc
		FROM item_cons ic2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN wo w2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON w2.wo_id = ic2.wo_id
		WHERE ic2.qty_cons_erp>0 AND w2.state_cd <> 3
		GROUP BY lot_no, sublot_no, oper_id, process_id
		) ic2 ON ic2.oper_id <> ic.oper_id
		AND ic2.process_id = w.process_id
		AND ic2.sublot_no = ic.fg_sublot_no
	WHERE
		ic2.last_edit_at < @cutoff_date
		AND ic.last_edit_at < DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -1, GETUTCDATE())), 0)
		--AND ic.fg_sublot_no='000116518600884'
		AND ic2.created_at_utc > '2025-11-01 00:00:00.000'
		AND EXISTS ( --there is connection between cons and prod on same operation by sublot
			SELECT 1
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = ip.sublot_no
			AND ic.oper_id = ip.oper_id
			AND ic.seq_no = ip.seq_no
		)
		AND NOT EXISTS ( --there isn;t exists any unreported qty for WIP consumption
			SELECT 1
			FROM item_cons ic3 WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN wo w3 WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON w3.wo_id = ic3.wo_id
			JOIN item i3 WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON i3.item_id=ic3.item_id
			WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = ic3.sublot_no
				AND w.process_id = w3.process_id
				AND ic.oper_id <> ic3.oper_id
				AND ic3.qty_cons_erp<ic3.qty_cons
				AND i3.item_class_id IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
		)
		AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp
		AND cwr.item_cons_row_id IS NULL --do not take records already awaiting for processing
		AND i.item_class_id NOT IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
		AND ISNULL(ia.attr_value,'0') = '0'
		AND ISNULL(oa.attr_value,'0') = '0'
		AND ic.comments IS NOT NULL
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.01
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(ic.fg_sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- V0.01.01
	ORDER BY ic2.last_edit_at ASC

	SELECT TOP(1)
		@fg_lot_no=fg_lot_no,
		@fg_sublot_no=fg_sublot_no,
		@oper_id=oper_id,
		@process_id = process_id,
		@seq_no = seq_no
	FROM @cons_records
	ORDER BY last_edit_at ASC

	-- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
	IF (@fg_sublot_no IS NULL)
	BEGIN		
		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		--release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END
	
	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT
		@fg_lot_no AS fg_lot_no,
		@fg_sublot_no AS fg_sublot_no,
		@oper_id AS oper_id
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --
	-- STEP 2: Calculate yield for selected lot_no
	-- Declare variables for STEP 2
	DECLARE
		@total_src_sublot_cons_qty			FLOAT
		,@total_src_sublot_cons_qty_pending	FLOAT
		,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty			FLOAT
		,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp		FLOAT
		,@total_src_sublot_cons_qty_erp		FLOAT
		,@ratio								FLOAT
		,@uom_kg_id							INT
		,@target_src_sublot_cons_qty		FLOAT
		,@total_src_sublot_cons_nonsublot	FLOAT
		,@can_be_reported_qty				FLOAT
		,@can_be_reported_ratio				FLOAT
	
	SELECT TOP(1)
		@uom_kg_id = uom_id
	FROM uom
	WHERE description = 'KG'

	SELECT
		@total_src_sublot_cons_qty = SUM(ic.qty_cons*uc.factor)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
	AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
	AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT
		@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty = SUM(ip.qty_prod*uc.factor)
	FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ip.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE ip.sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
	AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id
	AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no
	AND ip.good_prod = 1

	SET @ratio = @total_src_sublot_cons_qty/@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
	
	-- STEP 2.1: Calculate reported consumption qty for WIP and source material
	SELECT @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp = SUM(qty_cons_erp*uc.factor)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON o.oper_id = ic.oper_id
	WHERE ic.sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND o.oper_id <> @oper_id
		AND o.process_id = @process_id

	SELECT @total_src_sublot_cons_qty_pending = ISNULL(SUM(CAST(wr.spare1 AS FLOAT) * uc.factor),0)
	FROM ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported wr WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ic.row_id = wr.item_cons_row_id
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
		AND wr.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT @total_src_sublot_cons_qty_erp = SUM(qty_cons_erp*uc.factor)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = ic.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON o.oper_id = ic.oper_id
	WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND o.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

	SET @total_src_sublot_cons_qty_erp = @total_src_sublot_cons_qty_erp + @total_src_sublot_cons_qty_pending

	-- STEP 2.2: Calculate target possible consumption of source material
	SET @target_src_sublot_cons_qty = @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp * @ratio

	SET @can_be_reported_qty = @target_src_sublot_cons_qty - @total_src_sublot_cons_qty_erp
	
	-- Update fg_sublot_no records in item_cons to set current last_edit_at if can_be_reported_qty < 0
	IF @can_be_reported_qty <= 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ic
		SET last_edit_at = GETDATE()
		FROM item_cons ic
		JOIN @cons_records cr
			ON cr.cons_row_id=ic.row_id
		WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no

		--release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END

	-- STEP2.3: Calculate all possible to report nosublot items
	SELECT
    @total_src_sublot_cons_nonsublot = SUM(cr.qty_cons * uc.factor) - SUM(cr.qty_cons_erp * uc.factor)
	FROM @cons_records cr
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON i.item_id = cr.item_id
	CROSS APPLY (
		SELECT TOP 1 factor
		FROM uom_conv
		WHERE from_uom_id = i.uom_id
		  AND to_uom_id = @uom_kg_id
	) uc
	WHERE
	  cr.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND cr.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND cr.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no;

	-- STEP 2.4 Calculate ratio for src reporting ratio if we can't report everything
	SET @can_be_reported_ratio = CASE WHEN @can_be_reported_qty >= @total_src_sublot_cons_nonsublot
								THEN 1
								ELSE @can_be_reported_qty / @total_src_sublot_cons_nonsublot
								END

	-- STEP 3.0:
	-- Select orders that consumed selected lot_no and calculate ratio
	-- Select source cons record to report
	-- Calculate qty to report for each source cons row and insert to temp table
	DECLARE @cons_rows_to_report AS TABLE
	(
		src_cons_row_id INT
		,src_cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_cons_fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_cons_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_cons_fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
		,src_qty_cons FLOAT
		,src_qty_cons_erp FLOAT
		,src_cons_created_at_local DATETIME
		,spare1 NVARCHAR(40)
		,wip_wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
		,wip_created_at_utc DATETIME
	);

	WITH WoRatios AS (
    SELECT
        ic.wo_id,
        (SUM(qty_cons_erp) / @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp)
        / SUM((SUM(qty_cons_erp) / @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp)
        ) OVER () AS ratio_norm
    FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.oper_id = ic.oper_id
	JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
    WHERE ic.sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
      AND o.oper_id <> @oper_id
      AND o.process_id = @process_id
	  AND w.state_cd <> 3
    GROUP BY ic.wo_id
	HAVING SUM(qty_cons_erp)>0
	),
	ConsDetails AS (
		SELECT
			cr.cons_row_id,
			(cr.qty_cons - cr.qty_cons_erp) * @can_be_reported_ratio AS qty_cons_kg,
			created_at_utc
		FROM @cons_records cr
		WHERE
			cr.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND cr.seq_no = @seq_no
			AND cr.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
	),
	Allocations AS (
		SELECT
			cd.cons_row_id,
			wr.wo_id,
			cd.qty_cons_kg * wr.ratio_norm AS allocated_qty,
			created_at_utc
		FROM ConsDetails cd
		CROSS JOIN WoRatios wr
	)
	INSERT INTO @cons_rows_to_report(
		src_cons_row_id
		,src_cons_lot_no
		,src_cons_fg_lot_no
		,src_cons_sublot_no
		,src_cons_fg_sublot_no
		,src_qty_cons
		,src_qty_cons_erp
		,src_cons_created_at_local
		,spare1
		,wip_wo_id
		,wip_created_at_utc
	)
	SELECT
		a.cons_row_id,
		ic.lot_no,
		ic.fg_lot_no,
		ic.sublot_no,
		ic.fg_sublot_no,
		ic.qty_cons,
		ic.qty_cons_erp,
		ic.created_at_local,
		ROUND(allocated_qty, 3) AS allocated_qty,
		a.wo_id,
		a.created_at_utc
	FROM Allocations a
	JOIN item_cons ic
		ON ic.row_id=a.cons_row_id
	WHERE ROUND(allocated_qty, 3)>0
	ORDER BY row_id, wo_id;

	--If there is nothing to report (quantities are too small) postpone for next delay time
	IF (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @cons_rows_to_report) = 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ic
		SET last_edit_at = GETDATE()
		FROM item_cons ic
		JOIN @cons_records cr
			ON cr.cons_row_id=ic.row_id
		WHERE ic.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no
		AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ic.seq_no = @seq_no

		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no

		--release applock
		EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

		RETURN;
	END
	
	-- STEP 4.0: Insert data into staging table
	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

		INSERT INTO ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported(
			[item_cons_row_id]
           ,[lot_no]
           ,[fg_lot_no]
           ,[sublot_no]
           ,[fg_sublot_no]
           ,[qty_cons]
           ,[qty_cons_erp]
           ,[spare1]
           ,[spare3]
           ,[last_edit_comment]
           ,[last_edit_at]
           ,[created_at_utc]
           ,[sap_reported_intermediate_item_cons_row_id]
           ,[sap_reported_wip_row_id]
           ,[sap_reported_wip_wo_id]
           ,[sap_reported_created_at_utc]
           ,[sap_reported_processed_id])
		SELECT 	 src_cons_row_id
				,src_cons_lot_no
				,src_cons_fg_lot_no
				,src_cons_sublot_no
				,src_cons_fg_sublot_no
				,src_qty_cons
				,src_qty_cons_erp
				,spare1
				,NULL
				,'INSERTED for EI Report of no sublot WIPs'						
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,NULL
				,NULL
				,wip_wo_id
				,wip_created_at_utc
				,NULL
		FROM @cons_rows_to_report
		
		DECLARE @output_rows INT

		-- STEP 4.1: Select as OUTPUT
		SELECT DISTINCT	 src_qty_cons
				,src_qty_cons_erp
				,src_cons_lot_no
				,src_cons_sublot_no
				,src_cons_row_id
				,spare1
				,NULL
				,src_cons_created_at_local
				,src_cons_fg_lot_no
				,src_cons_fg_sublot_no
		FROM @cons_rows_to_report

		SET @output_rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF @output_rows <= 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		END

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	--release applock
	EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
	IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		
	--release applock
	EXEC sys.sp_releaseapplock @DbPrincipal=N'dbo', @Resource=N'WIP_CONS_REPORT_LOCK', @LockOwner=N'Session';

	SELECT 	 @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE()
			,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
			,@error_state = ERROR_STATE();
				
	RAISERROR(   @error_msg
				,@error_severity
				,@error_state
			)
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_GetByFilter]
	@item_id  nvarchar(40) = null ,
	@item_desc  nvarchar(80)  = null ,
	@item_class_id  nvarchar(40)  = null ,
	@item_class_desc  nvarchar(80)  = null ,
	@class_produced bit  = null   ,
	@class_consumed bit  = null,
	@class_obsolete bit  = null,
	@uom_id int = null,
	@template  bit   = null,
	@lifetime  int   = null,
	@unit_cost  float  = null ,
	@obsolete bit = null,
	@purchased bit  = null,
	@sold bit  = null,
	@num_decimals int = null,
	@must_complete_steps bit  = null,
	@must_prod_reqd_qty bit  = null,
	@min_grade int  = null,
	@min_state int  = null,
	@min_inv_level float  = null,
	@auto_reorder bit  = null,
	@lot_no_format string80  = null,
	@last_lot_no string80  = null,
	@max_lot_size tfloat = null,
	@sublot_no_format string40 = null,
	@last_sublot_no   string40 = null,
	@serial_no_lvl    int32 = null,
	@max_sublot_size  tfloat = null,
	@max_order_size tfloat = null,
	@min_trace_inv  tfloat = null,
	@inv_unique_by_job logical = null,
	@spare1  nvarchar(80)   = null,
	@spare2  nvarchar(80)   = null,
	@spare3  nvarchar(80)   = null,
	@spare4  nvarchar(80)   = null,
	@max_rows int32 = null
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Item_GetByFilter
-- Description       - Return a recordset using the item and item class filters passed in
-- Author	     - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created      - 06/25/2009
-- Version           - 4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2014	Prashanth	5.0	US#378756: Added ability to return top N Rows and return item_display/item_class_display based on system_attribute values
-- 5/25/2017		RWB			6.0.0		For story 782078, parameterized the dynamic query
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE  @SQL 			NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@SelectClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@FromClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@JoinClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@WhereClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@OrderbyClause	NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@ParmDef		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@CharIndex		INT
		,@AttrValue		NVARCHAR(10)

	-- set up the select portion of the SQL statement.  This will not change based on the filter settings.
	SET @SelectClause = 'SELECT '

	-- adding the max_rows to the select clause
	IF (@max_rows IS NOT NULL) SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + 'TOP(@max_rows) '

	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + 'i.item_id, i.item_desc, '

	-- adding the item_display to the select clause
	SET @AttrValue = NULL
	SELECT @AttrValue = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210	--210 - Item Display order
	IF (@AttrValue IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@AttrValue) = 0) SET @AttrValue = '0'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause +
	CASE @AttrValue
	  WHEN '0' THEN 'i.item_id as item_display'
	  WHEN '1' THEN 'i.item_desc as item_display'
	  WHEN '2' THEN 'i.item_id + ''('' + i.item_desc + '')'' as item_display'
	  WHEN '3' THEN 'i.item_desc + ''('' + i.item_id + '')'' as item_display'
	END

	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc, '

	-- adding the item_class_display to the select clause
	SET @AttrValue = NULL
	SELECT @AttrValue = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 208 	--208 - Item_Class display order
	IF (@AttrValue IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@AttrValue) = 0) SET @AttrValue = '0'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause +
	CASE @AttrValue
	  WHEN '0' THEN 'ic.item_class_id as item_class_display'
	  WHEN '1' THEN 'ic.item_class_desc as item_class_display'
	  WHEN '2' THEN 'ic.item_class_id + ''('' + ic.item_class_desc + '')'' as item_class_display'
	  WHEN '3' THEN 'ic.item_class_desc + ''('' + ic.item_class_id + '')'' as item_class_display'
	END

	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.uom_id, uom.description uom_description, i.template, i.lifetime'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.unit_cost, i.obsolete, i.purchased, i.sold, i.num_decimals, i.must_complete_steps'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.must_prod_reqd_qty, i.min_grade, i.min_state, i.min_inv_level, i.reorder_amt'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.auto_reorder, i.lot_no_format, i.last_lot_no, i.max_lot_size, i.sublot_no_format'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.last_sublot_no, i.serial_no_lvl, i.max_sublot_size, i.max_order_size, i.min_trace_inv'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.inv_unique_by_job, i.notes, i.spare1, i.spare2, i.spare3, i.spare4'
	SET @SelectClause = @SelectClause + ', i.last_edit_comment, i.last_edit_by, i.last_edit_at'

	-- set up the from portion of the SQL statement.
	SET @FromClause = ' FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)'

	-- set up the join portion of the SQL statement.
	SET @JoinClause = ' inner join item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) on i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id'
	SET @JoinClause = @JoinClause + ' inner join uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id'

	-- set up the where portion of the SQL statment.  Initialize if to an empty string and add to it based on the
	SET @WhereClause = ''

	-- check if there is an item ID filter
	IF @item_id is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.item_id', '@item_id', @item_id)
	END

	-- check if there is an item description filter
	IF @item_desc is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.item_desc', '@item_desc', @item_desc)
	END

	-- check if there is an item class ID filter
	IF @item_class_id is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.item_class_id', '@item_class_id', @item_class_id)
	END

	-- check if there is an item class ID filter
	IF @item_class_desc is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'ic.item_class_desc', '@item_class_desc', @item_class_desc)
	END

	-- check if there is an item class produced filter
	IF @class_produced is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'ic.produced', '@class_produced', CAST(@class_produced as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an item class consumed filter
	IF @class_consumed is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'ic.consumed', '@class_consumed', CAST(@class_consumed as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an item class consumed filter
	IF @class_obsolete is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'ic.obsolete', '@class_obsolete', CAST(@class_obsolete as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is a uom_id filter
	IF @uom_id is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.uom_id', '@uom_id', @uom_id)
	END

	-- check if there is an template filter
	IF @template is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.template', '@template', CAST(@template as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an lifetime filter
	IF @lifetime is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.lifetime', '@lifetime', @lifetime)
	END

	-- check if there is an unit_cost filter
	IF @unit_cost is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.unit_cost', '@unit_cost', @unit_cost)
	END

	-- check if there is an obsolete filter
	IF @obsolete is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.obsolete', '@obsolete', CAST(@obsolete as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an purchased filter
	IF @purchased is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.purchased', '@purchased', CAST(@purchased as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an sold filter
	IF @sold is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.sold', '@sold', CAST(@sold as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an num_decimals filter
	IF @num_decimals is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.num_decimals', '@num_decimals', @num_decimals)
	END

	-- check if there is an must_complete_steps filter
	IF @must_complete_steps is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.must_complete_steps', '@must_complete_steps', CAST(@must_complete_steps as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an must_produce_reqd_qty filter
	IF @must_prod_reqd_qty is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.must_prod_reqd_qty', '@must_prod_reqd_qty', CAST(@must_prod_reqd_qty as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an minimum_grade filter
	IF @min_grade is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.min_grade', '@min_grade', @min_grade)
	END

	-- check if there is an min_state filter
	IF @min_state is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.min_state', '@min_state', @min_state)
	END

	-- check if there is an min_inv_level filter
	IF @min_inv_level is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.min_inv_level', '@min_inv_level', @min_inv_level)
	END

	-- check if there is an auto_reorder filter
	IF @auto_reorder is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.auto_reorder', '@auto_reorder', CAST(@auto_reorder as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is an lot_no_format filter
	IF @lot_no_format is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.lot_no_format', '@lot_no_format', @lot_no_format)
	END

	-- check if there is an last_lot_no filter
	IF @last_lot_no is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.last_lot_no', '@last_lot_no', @last_lot_no)
	END

	-- check if there is an max_lot_size filter
	IF @max_lot_size is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.max_lot_size', '@max_lot_size', @max_lot_size)
	END

	-- check if there is an sublot_no_format filter
	IF @sublot_no_format is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.sublot_no_format', '@sublot_no_format', @sublot_no_format)
	END

	-- check if there is an last_sublot_no filter
	IF @last_sublot_no is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.last_sublot_no', '@last_sublot_no', @last_sublot_no)
	END

	-- check if there is an serial_no_lvl filter
	IF @serial_no_lvl is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.serial_no_lvl', '@serial_no_lvl', @serial_no_lvl)
	END

	-- check if there is an max_sublot_size filter
	IF @max_sublot_size is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.max_sublot_size', '@max_sublot_size', @max_sublot_size)
	END

	-- check if there is an max_order_size filter
	IF @max_order_size is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.max_order_size', '@max_order_size', @max_order_size)
	END

	-- check if there is an min_trace_inv filter
	IF @min_trace_inv is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.min_trace_inv', '@min_trace_inv', @min_trace_inv)
	END

	-- check if there is an inv_unique_by_job filter
	IF @inv_unique_by_job is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.inv_unique_by_job', '@inv_unique_by_job', CAST(@inv_unique_by_job as NVARCHAR(MAX)))
	END

	-- check if there is a spare1 filter
	IF @spare1 is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.spare1', '@spare1', @spare1)
	END

	-- check if there is a spare2 filter
	IF @spare2 is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.spare2', '@spare2', @spare2)
	END

	-- check if there is a spare3 filter
	IF @spare3 is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.spare3', '@spare3', @spare3)
	END

	-- check if there is a spare4 filter
	IF @spare4 is not null BEGIN
		Set @WhereClause = dbo.fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause(@WhereClause, 'i.spare4', '@spare4', @spare4)
	END

	IF @WhereClause <> '' BEGIN
		SET @WhereClause = ' WHERE ' + @WhereClause
	END

	SET @OrderbyClause = ' ORDER BY item_display'

	SET @SQL = @SelectClause + @FromClause + @JoinClause + @WhereClause + @OrderbyClause
	 SET @ParmDef = '@max_rows INT, @item_id STRING40, @item_desc STRING80, @item_class_id STRING40, @item_class_desc STRING80, @class_produced BIT, @class_consumed BIT, @class_obsolete BIT'
	 SET @ParmDef = @ParmDef + ', @uom_id INT32, @template BIT, @lifetime INT32, @unit_cost FLOAT, @obsolete  BIT, @purchased BIT, @sold BIT, @num_decimals INT'
	 SET @ParmDef = @ParmDef + ', @must_complete_steps BIT, @must_prod_reqd_qty BIT, @min_grade INT32, @min_state INT32, @min_inv_level FLOAT, @auto_reorder BIT, @lot_no_format STRING80'
	 SET @ParmDef = @ParmDef + ', @last_lot_no STRING80, @max_lot_size FLOAT, @sublot_no_format STRING40, @last_sublot_no STRING40, @serial_no_lvl  INT32, @max_sublot_size FLOAT'
	 SET @ParmDef = @ParmDef + ', @max_order_size FLOAT, @min_trace_inv FLOAT, @inv_unique_by_job	LOGICAL, @spare1 STRING80'
	 SET @ParmDef = @ParmDef + ', @spare2 STRING80, @spare3 STRING80, @spare4 STRING80'
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, @ParmDef, @max_rows = @max_rows, @item_id = @item_id, @item_desc = @item_desc, @item_class_id = @item_class_id, @item_class_desc = @item_class_desc, @class_produced = @class_produced,
		 @class_consumed = @class_consumed, @class_obsolete = @class_obsolete, @uom_id = @uom_id, @template = @template, @lifetime = @lifetime, @unit_cost = @unit_cost, @obsolete = @obsolete,
		 @purchased = @purchased, @sold = @sold, @num_decimals = @num_decimals, @must_complete_steps = @must_complete_steps, @must_prod_reqd_qty = @must_prod_reqd_qty, @min_grade = @min_grade,
		 @min_state = @min_state, @min_inv_level = @min_inv_level, @auto_reorder = @auto_reorder, @lot_no_format = @lot_no_format, @last_lot_no = @last_lot_no, @max_lot_size = @max_lot_size,
		 @sublot_no_format = @sublot_no_format, @last_sublot_no = @last_sublot_no, @serial_no_lvl = @serial_no_lvl, @max_sublot_size = @max_sublot_size, @max_order_size = @max_order_size,
		 @min_trace_inv = @min_trace_inv, @inv_unique_by_job = @inv_unique_by_job, @spare1 = @spare1, @spare2 = @spare2, @spare3 = @spare3, @spare4 = @spare4

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_confirmDownload]
-- Description: this SP inserts the records into database when order is running, this sp is for saving all the steps in confirm & download
--
-- Usage: 	
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		DS			2023-04-13			Initial version.
-- 0.02		DS			2023-04-24			Modified for updated JSON
-- 0.03		DS			2023-07-18			Added 2 more parameters in sp_U_ofi_SaveAssignRecipeParam
-- 0.03		DS			2024-02-08			Added inline comments
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_confirmDownload]
                 ( 	  @wo_id [dbo].[STRING40]					--Common
					, @parent_item_id [dbo].[STRING40]			--Common
					, @oper_id [dbo].[STRING40]					--Common
					, @seq_no [dbo].[INT32]						--Common
					, @ent_id [dbo].[INT32]						--Common
					, @last_edit_by [dbo].[STRING40]			--Common
					, @saveRecords  [dbo].[INT32] = NULL		--Common
					, @recipe_name [dbo].[STRING40]				-- Set Recipe
					, @grid_recipe nvarchar(max)				-- Set Recipe
					, @ver_id [dbo].[STRING40]					--Set Parameter
					, @grid_Param nvarchar(max)					--Set Parameter
					, @dest_grid nvarchar(max)					-- Set Destination
					, @bom_grid nvarchar(max)					-- Set Source
					, @source_grid nvarchar(max)				-- Set Source
					, @lot_grid nvarchar(max)					-- Set Lot
					, @resultset int output						-- Common output parameter
					, @resultcode nvarchar(250) output			-- Common output parameter
				 ) AS 

BEGIN


declare @result_tbl table
						(   step_details nvarchar(80)
						   ,resultset int
						   ,resultcode nvarchar(250)
						)

SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

		BEGIN TRANSACTION

	
			if(@grid_recipe is not null)
				begin
					-- 'Set Recipe'
								exec	[dbo].[sp_U_ofi_SaveAssignRecipe] 
									@wo_id
									,@parent_item_id
									,@oper_id
									,@seq_no
									,@ent_id
									,@recipe_name
									,@saveRecords
									,@last_edit_by
									,@grid_recipe
									,@resultset OUTPUT
									,@resultcode OUTPUT

							insert into @result_tbl values('Set Recipe',@resultset,@resultcode)
			
				end 
		
		 if(@grid_Param is not null) and not exists(select 1 from @result_tbl where @resultset=0)
			begin
					-- 'Set Parameter'
								 exec [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_SaveAssignRecipeParam] 
									   @wo_id
									  ,@parent_item_id
									  ,@oper_id
									  ,@seq_no
									  ,@ent_id
									  ,@ver_id
									  ,@saveRecords
									  ,@last_edit_by
									  ,NULL--,@load_equip_params int =  NULL
									  ,NULL--,@ddParam [dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
									  ,@grid_Param
									  ,@resultset OUTPUT
									  ,@resultcode OUTPUT

								insert into @result_tbl values('Set Parameters',@resultset,@resultcode)

						--print 'Set Parameter ends here'
			end
			if(@dest_grid is not null) and not exists(select 1 from @result_tbl where @resultset=0)
			begin

				-- 'Set Destination'
							
									exec  [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_set_destination] 
										   @wo_id
										  ,@oper_id
										  ,@seq_no
										  ,@parent_item_id
										  ,@ent_id
										  ,@recipe_name   --@recipe_id
										  ,@ver_id			--@version_id
										  ,@dest_grid
										  ,@last_edit_by
										  ,@saveRecords
										  ,@resultset OUTPUT
										  ,@resultcode OUTPUT

										insert into @result_tbl values('Set Destination',@resultset,@resultcode)


			end
			
			if(@bom_grid is not null and @source_grid is not null) and not exists(select 1 from @result_tbl where @resultset=0)
			begin

				-- 'Set Source'

					
									exec [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_source_selection] 
										   @wo_id
										  ,@oper_id
										  ,@seq_no
										  ,@parent_item_id
										  ,@ent_id
										  ,@recipe_name		 --@recipe_id
										  ,@ver_id			 --@version_id
										  ,@bom_grid
										  ,@source_grid
										  ,@last_edit_by
										  ,@saveRecords
										  ,@resultset OUTPUT
										  ,@resultcode OUTPUT

										insert into @result_tbl values('Set Source',@resultset,@resultcode)
			end
			if(@lot_grid is not null) and not exists(select 1 from @result_tbl where @resultset=0)
				begin

					-- 'Set Lot'

										exec[dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_Pack_Additives] 
										   @wo_id
										  ,@oper_id
										  ,@seq_no
										  ,@lot_grid
										  ,@last_edit_by
										  ,@saveRecords
										  ,@resultset OUTPUT
										  ,@resultcode OUTPUT

										  insert into @result_tbl values('Set Lot',@resultset,@resultcode)

				end



				--select * from @result_tbl

				if exists(select 1 from @result_tbl where @resultset=0)
				begin
					-- 'ROLLBACK here'
					select top 1 @resultset = resultset,@resultcode = resultcode  from @result_tbl where @resultset=0
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
				end 
				else
				begin
					-- 'COMMIT here'

					 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
					 set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
				end 
			

			
			--select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode
			 
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH

			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
			set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
		
	END CATCH


END
