   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Hour_History_CreateBucketsUpdateStats]
(@start_utc_range	TDATETIME2
,@end_utc_range		TDATETIME2
,@ent_id		INT32 = NULL
,@wo_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@oper_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@seq_no		INT32 = NULL
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Program Name			- FACETLLIGENCE
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Hour_History_CreateBucketsUpdateStats
-- Description          - User Story: 711590 - As Lenka, I want the end time of a job_history record to be modified
-- Author				- RaghuG
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  - 5.03
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver	Changes
-- 12/13/2018		Raghu G			6.1	UserStory: 1094273
--							The db fit test: WonderwareMesTests.SqlServerTests.JobHistory.UpdateEndTime was occassionally failing with times in the job_hour_history are not properly updated
--							when the job end time is manually altered.  This was because this stored procedure limits the number of records to be updated in the job_hour_history table, though
--							the limitation is bit too restrictive for the case of job_history.update.  Since the job end time can be reduced or increased, and a job is identified with the
--							instance that the job ran, clearing the current_time_utc will force all the job_hour_history records for the job instance to be revalidated and updated.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @hour_start_utc_start	TDATETIME
	,@hour_start_utc_end	TDATETIME
	,@hour_end_utc		TDATETIME
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	,@lec_missing_buckets	STRING254

DECLARE @hourly_buckets TABLE (hour_start_utc datetime PRIMARY KEY, hour_end_utc datetime)

BEGIN
	--If the ending time is not supplied, exit
	IF (@end_utc_range IS NULL) RETURN

	--Default the start time of the range as same as the end time
	SET @start_utc_range = COALESCE(@start_utc_range, @end_utc_range)

	--Determine the hour start bucket based on the start event time
	SET @hour_start_utc_start = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @start_utc_range),0)

	--Verify whether the end utc is greater than the current hour
	IF (@end_utc_range > DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @current_time_utc),0))
		--The supplied end utc is greater than the current hour; therefore, default the end time to end at the end of the current hour (which is the beginning of the next hour bucket)
		SET @end_utc_range = DATEADD(HH, 1, @current_time_utc)

	--Determine the hour end bucket based on the end event time
	SET @hour_start_utc_end = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @end_utc_range),0)

 	--Default the last_edit_comment if not supplied
 	SET @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, '')

 	--Default the comment for the missing buckets
 	SET @lec_missing_buckets = @last_edit_comment + '(CreateMissingBucketsAndUpdateStats)'

	WHILE (@hour_start_utc_start <= @hour_start_utc_end) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @hourly_buckets (hour_start_utc, hour_end_utc) VALUES (@hour_start_utc_start, DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc_start))
		SET @hour_start_utc_start = DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc_start)
	END

	--Update the hour buckets that does not exist.  If a bucket exist, then that bucket would have been updated by the hourly task
	--Determine any jobs ran during this hour bucket
	INSERT INTO job_hour_history (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc
			, hour_start_utc, hour_start_local
			, hour_end_utc, hour_end_local
			, item_id, std_prod_rate, batch_size
			, qty_good, qty_reject, runtime, downtime, idletime
			, last_edit_comment, last_edit_at)
	SELECT jh.ent_id, jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no
		, jh.job_start_utc
		, hb.hour_start_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(jh.ent_id, hb.hour_start_utc)
		, hb.hour_end_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(jh.ent_id, hb.hour_end_utc)
		, j.item_id, dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j.est_prod_rate, j.prod_uom), j.batch_size
		, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		, @lec_missing_buckets, @current_time_utc
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jh.seq_no
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN @hourly_buckets hb ON  hb.hour_start_utc >= jh.job_start_utc AND hb.hour_start_utc <= COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = jh.seq_no AND jhh.job_start_utc = jh.job_start_utc
		AND jhh.hour_start_utc = hb.hour_start_utc
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT MIN(jh_overlap.job_start_utc) next_job_start_utc
		     FROM job_history jh_overlap WITH (NOLOCK)
		     WHERE --A job running on the same entity on the same job position at a later time
		       (jh_overlap.ent_id = jh.ent_id  -- A job running on the same entity
		       AND jh_overlap.job_start_utc > jh.job_start_utc -- A job started at a later time on the same entity
		       AND jh_overlap.job_pos = jh.job_pos) -- A job started on the same job position
		       --The same job was running on the same entity but on a different job position
		       OR (jh_overlap.ent_id = jh.ent_id
		       AND jh_overlap.wo_id = jh.wo_id
		       AND jh_overlap.oper_id = jh.oper_id
		       AND jh_overlap.seq_no = jh.seq_no
		       AND jh_overlap.job_start_utc > jh.job_start_utc
		       AND jh_overlap.job_pos <> jh.job_pos)
		       --The same job was running on another entity at a later time
		       OR (jh_overlap.ent_id <> jh.ent_id
		       AND jh_overlap.wo_id = jh.wo_id
		       AND jh_overlap.oper_id = jh.oper_id
		       AND jh_overlap.seq_no = jh.seq_no
		       AND jh_overlap.job_start_utc > jh.job_start_utc)
		      ) overlapping_job
	WHERE e.can_track_oee = 1
	  AND (jh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (jh.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	  AND (jh.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (jh.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (jh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc OR @job_start_utc IS NULL)
	 AND jhh.ent_id IS NULL -- exclude the jobs that are already added to tpm_stat
	  --Exclude the hour buckets that were used by other jobs in the same job position or the job ran on another entity
	  --For example, the jobA was started on EntityA at 6a in job position 0. JobB was running on EntityA from 10:30a in job position 0.
	  --Therefore, the buckets for JobA should not be created after 10 clock buckets. End Job/Pause job will prevent JobA to be ended after 10a anyway, so there is no point in creating errorneous buckets
	  AND (overlapping_job.next_job_start_utc IS NULL OR hb.hour_end_utc <= DATEADD(HH, 1, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, overlapping_job.next_job_start_utc),0)))

	--If job details are supplied, force the hour bucket for the job start time to be updated.
	--The hour bucket for the job start time will be automatically created when job is started, but would have never updated when the service was not running
	IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL AND @job_start_utc IS NOT NULL)
		--Limit to the job start hour bucket and limit to the pause/end job command
		AND @last_edit_comment IN ('JobExec.PauseJob', 'JobExec.EndJob')
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Hour_History_RefreshQtysAndTimes @start_utc_range=@job_start_utc, @end_utc_range=@job_start_utc
			--Limit to the supplied job
			, @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc
			, @created_at_utc=NULL, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment

	--Job start time is supplied and the job start hour is the same as the start utc range
	--AND @last_edit_comment IN ('JobExec.PauseJob', 'JobExec.EndJob'), then the job start bucket is already updated above
	--Increment the start time by one hour
	IF @job_start_utc IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @job_start_utc),0) = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @start_utc_range),0)
	AND @last_edit_comment IN ('JobExec.PauseJob', 'JobExec.EndJob')
		SET @start_utc_range = DATEADD(HH, 1, @start_utc_range)

	--If the service is creating the missing buckets or the job end time is altered, let it go through all the missing buckets to determine whether they should be updated or not.
	IF @last_edit_comment LIKE ('MESServiceStartup%') OR @last_edit_comment = 'JobHistory.Update' SET @current_time_utc = NULL

	--Since the buckets are created, update the buckets optionally filtered by the supplied parameters
	EXEC sp_U_Job_Hour_History_RefreshQtysAndTimes @start_utc_range=@start_utc_range, @end_utc_range=@end_utc_range
		, @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_start_utc=@job_start_utc
		--Limit to the job hour buckets only that were created now (i.e. the buckets that were not created during normal hourly tasks)
		, @created_at_utc=@current_time_utc, @last_edit_comment=@lec_missing_buckets
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_Item_Attr
-- Description:  Updates the item attributes
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-12      Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Adn         2023-12-11      Changed for item group mapping table.
-- 0.01.02  Lavkesh     2024-02-01      Modified logic for item group mapping
-- 0.01.03	MC			2025-10-08		Considering MaterialType = 'FERT' to automatically crating for every item
-- 0.02.00	AML, XPM	2026-06-29		CR635: Automatically create 'Category' attribute based on the item

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_MM_Attr] (@item_id       NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @item_group            NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @item_classification   NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @language_key          NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @plant_code            NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @production_supervisor NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @legacy_code           NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @item_status           NVARCHAR(40),
										   @material_state        NVARCHAR(40),
										   @production_method     NVARCHAR(40))
AS
BEGIN
	IF @item_status <> 'Deleted' and (dbo.fn_s_ofi_plantcode()= @plant_code)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @attr_id1       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id2       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id3       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id4       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id5       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id6       INT=NULL,
				@attr_id7		INT=NULL, -- 0.01.03
				@attr_id8		INT=NULL,
                @rc             INT,
                @error_msg      NVARCHAR(500),
                @error_severity INT,
                @error_state    INT,
                @mod_id         VARCHAR(30)

        SELECT @attr_id1 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id2 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'Classification'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id3 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'LanguageKey'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id4 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id5 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ProductionSupervisor'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id6 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'LegacyCode'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

		SELECT @attr_id7 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'MaterialType'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

		SELECT @attr_id8 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'Category'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1
		

		BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION

		-- 0.01.01 start
		DECLARE @item_group_mes NVARCHAR(80);

		SELECT @item_group_mes = item_group_mes from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_item_group_mapping] WITH (nolock)
		WHERE (item_group_sap = @item_group AND @item_group IS NOT NULL) 
		AND (item_class_sap = @item_classification AND @item_classification IS NOT NULL)
		AND ((material_state = @material_state AND @material_state IS NOT NULL) OR (material_state IS NULL))
		-- 0.01.01 end

        IF ( @attr_id1 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id2 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id3 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id4 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id5 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id6 IS NULL )
		BEGIN ;
			THROW 51009,
			'Item attribute not found - SP_U_EI_Item_Attr',
            1
        END

        IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                    FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                            AND attr_id = @attr_id1)
        BEGIN
			UPDATE item_attr
			SET    attr_value = @item_group_mes -- 0.01.01
			WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id1
					AND item_id = @item_id
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
			SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
							+ @item_id
							+ ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
							+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
			THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
		END
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                 FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                 WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                        AND attr_id = @attr_id2)
        BEGIN
		print 'classification'
           /* UPDATE item_attr
            SET    attr_value = @item_classification
            WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id2
                   AND item_id = @item_id*/
        END
		ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
                            + @item_id
                            + ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
							+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

			THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
        END

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                 FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                 WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                        AND attr_id = @attr_id3)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE item_attr
            SET    attr_value = @language_key
            WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id3
                   AND item_id = @item_id
        END
		ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
                            + @item_id
                            + ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
						    + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

			THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
        END

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                 FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                 WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                        AND attr_id = @attr_id4)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE item_attr
            SET    attr_value = @plant_code
            WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id4
                   AND item_id = @item_id
        END
		ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
                            + @item_id
                            + ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
						    + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

			THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
        END

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                 FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                 WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                        AND attr_id = @attr_id5)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE item_attr
            SET    attr_value = @production_supervisor
            WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id5
                   AND item_id = @item_id
        END
		ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
                            + @item_id
                            + ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
							+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

			THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
        END

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                 FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                 WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                        AND attr_id = @attr_id6)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE item_attr
            SET    attr_value = @legacy_code
            WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id6
                   AND item_id = @item_id
        END
		ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
                            + @item_id
                            + ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
							+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
		END
		-- 0.01.03
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                    AND attr_id = @attr_id7)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE item_attr
			SET    attr_value = 'FERT', notes='ADDED BY MES'
			WHERE  attr_id = @attr_id7
					AND item_id = @item_id
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @error_msg =N'Error while updating item attribute ('
							+ @item_id
							+ ') in MES. Item attribute mapping not exists  - SP_U_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
							+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

			THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
		END

		--0.02.00
		IF @item_group_mes = 'Cake'
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @item_desc NVARCHAR(254);
			DECLARE @category_code NVARCHAR(10);
			DECLARE @category_value NVARCHAR(80);
			DECLARE @category_pos INT;

			SELECT @item_desc = item_desc
			FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id;

			SET @category_pos = PATINDEX('%[A-Za-z][0-9][0-9]%', @item_desc);

			IF @category_pos > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @category_code = SUBSTRING(@item_desc, @category_pos + 1, 2);

				IF @category_code = '23'
					SET @category_value = 'FAT';

				IF @category_code = '11'
					SET @category_value = 'NON FAT';
			END


			IF @category_value IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM item_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE item_id = @item_id
					  AND attr_id = @attr_id8
				)
				BEGIN
					EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_item_attr]
						@item_id = @item_id,
						@attr_id = @attr_id8,
						@attr_value = @category_value,
						@notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
						@last_edit_comment = NULL,
						@mod_id = @mod_id OUTPUT;

					IF (@rc <> 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @error_msg =
							N'Error while creating Category item attribute ('
							+ @item_id
							+ ') in MES - SP_I_EI_MM_Attr - '
							+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

						THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE item_attr
					SET attr_value = @category_value
					WHERE attr_id = @attr_id8
					  AND item_id = @item_id
				END
			END
		END



    COMMIT TRANSACTION
END TRY

BEGIN catch
	IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

      SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
             @error_severity = Error_severity(),
             @error_state = Error_state();

      RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
  END catch
        END
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Rule_Group_Link]

      @rule_group_id INT ,

      @last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40) ,
      @last_edit_at DATETIME
    )
AS --- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Rule_Group_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author         -
-- Date Created     - 009/15/2011
-- Version          -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET XACT_ABORT ON
    BEGIN
        SELECT  rule_group_link.rule_group_id ,
                rule_group_link.rule_id ,
                rule_group.rule_group_name ,
                spc_rule.rule_desc ,
                rule_group_link.last_edit_comment ,
                rule_group_link.last_edit_by ,
                rule_group_link.last_edit_at
        FROM    rule_group_link rule_group_link WITH ( NOLOCK )
                INNER JOIN spc_rule WITH ( NOLOCK ) ON rule_group_link.rule_id = spc_rule.rule_id
                INNER JOIN rule_group WITH ( NOLOCK ) ON rule_group_link.rule_group_id = rule_group.rule_group_id
        WHERE   ( ( rule_group_link.rule_group_id = @rule_group_id
                    OR @rule_group_id IS NULL
                  )
                  AND ( rule_group_link.rule_id = @rule_id
                        OR @rule_id IS NULL
                      )
                  AND ( rule_group_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
                        OR @last_edit_by IS NULL
                      )
                  AND ( rule_group_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
                        OR @last_edit_at IS NULL
                      )
                )
        ORDER BY rule_group_link.rule_group_id ,
                spc_rule.priority asc;
    END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_WO_GetByFilter]
(
	@wo_id 						STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@item_id 					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@target_sched_line_id       INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@wo_status_filter			NVARCHAR(MAX),

	@include_from_process	LOGICAL = 0,

/*
Example XML

	<status code="2" />
	<status code="3" />
	<status code="4" />
	<status code="5" />
	<status code="6" />
</wo_status>
*/
)

AS
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-	sp_SA_WO_GetByFilter
-- Description		-	Selects the rows from the work order table that match the supplied filters
--						The quantities for the work orders will be calculated in the following manner:
--						There are 4 cases:
--						1. A work order is being run on a line (where it is required that all needed conversions exist or an
--						   error is returned)
--						2. A work order is not being run on a line, there is a single first operation, and the needed
--						   conversions exist
--						3. A work order is not being run on a line, there is more than one first operation, and the needed
--						   conversions exist (this is the least likely case)
--						4. A work order is not being run on a line, and at least one needed conversion does not exist
--
--						Note that what conversions are "needed" may differ from value to value, so the same case may not
--						apply to all values (for example, when conversions for the UOMs of the items reported as good
--						production exist, but not for all rejects).  Also, a conversion is needed only for non-zero values.
--						There may be rejects but no good production, or vice versa.  The required quantity (qty_reqd) is
--						always the sum of the qty_reqd of the last jobs in the work order (those where final_job is true),
--						and the remaining required quantity (def_reqd_qty) is always the greater of 0 or the required
--						quantity (qty_reqd) minus the good production quantity (qty_prod), however they were calculated.
--						The rest can vary for each case:
--
--						Case 1 (A work order is being run on a line)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the first jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item
--						qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the jobs at the production position, converted to the UOM of the final item (the production position is the last position if no production entity is identified)
--						qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of the jobs at the production position and before, each converted to the UOM of the final item before summing
--						qty_remaining = the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - qty_rejected)
--
--						Case 2 (A work order is not being run on a line, there is a single first operation, and the needed conversions exist)
--						qty_at_start = same as Case 1
--						qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the last jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item
--						qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of each job, each converted to the UOM of the final item before summing
--						qty_remaining = same as Case 1
--
--						Case 3 (A work order is not being run on a line, there is more than one first operation, and the needed conversions exist)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the last jobs
--						qty_prod = same as Case 2
--						qty_rejected = same as Case 2
--						qty_remaining = the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - sum of the qty_rejected fields of the last jobs)
--
--						Case 4 (A work order is not being run on a line, and at least one needed conversions does not exist)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the last jobs
--						qty_prod = same as Case 2
--						qty_rejected = 0
--						qty_remaining = same as Case 3
--
--						Note that while in cases 1 and 2 that the qty_remaining is given as "same as Case 1", since it's
--						always equal to the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - qty_rejected), nevertheless what 2 of
--						these 3 components are varies from case to case, so how the value of qty_remaining is derived may
--						not be the same if the "final" values for each aren't directly used.  This is also true of the
--						calculation of def_reqd_qty.

-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--  08/22/2014		SLR			5.0		added input filter for target_sched_line_id, number_of_wos parameter to limit the
--										number of rows to be returned, and changed the order by to work order id.
--  09/05/2014		SLR			5.0		update select to retrieve work orders based on filters ordered by row_id desc to get
--										the most resently created work orders, then select and return the top N order by
--										the work order id
--  09/08/2014		JEO			5.0		update interpretation of the target_sched_line_id parameter value as the following:
--										>= 0 -- return work orders scheduled to a particular line
--										NULL -- return work orders that are not schedule to any line
--										-1   -- Return work orders without regard to a line
--  09/08/2014		RWB			5.0		For CR L00133799, removed the pre-calculation of the work order status.  Calculating
--										the status of every work slows down the SP when the number of work orders exceeds
--										the number of work orders requested.
--	02/05/2015		RWB			5.0.1	For story 439593, made changes to account for different items being produced at
--										different jobs in the work order.  This involves calculating all quantity information
--										to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
--	04/28/2016		Surya		5.0.3	For story 594231, made changes to improve the performance by removing the row number check,
--										and using TOP to retrieve top most work orders.
--	05/20/2016		RWB			5.0.3	For story 59231, added a temporary table to hold the work order ID and status of each
--										work order.  Also, changed the order of the inner select from row_id to row_id DESC.
-- 06/08/2016	Raghu G		5.3	UserStory: 594231 - As Bruce I want the WO collection page to load quicker so that it takes less time (CR L00135959)
--					Modified this stored procedure to improve the performance significantly.
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
-- 10/05/2017	RaghuG		6.0	UserStory: 921577 - As Bruce, I want to be able to use filters to get a list of work orders from the MES database, including work orders created from a process.
-- 11/29/2018	Srinivas	6.01	UserStory: 1031503 - Made changes to return the work orders created from process and assigned to line.
--  07/10/2022		MP			7.0	Added the Time filter and Replaced xml input to wofliter with WO Status table. Now we can see only Work Order Status (0-Released, 1-Started, 2-Completed, 3-Closed)

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @num_decimals_good_pp	INT,
		@doc_handle				INT,
		@min_factor				INT,
		@wo_limit				INT,
		@no_conv_wo_id			NVARCHAR(40),
		@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000),
		@delimiter NVARCHAR(5)
DECLARE @wo_status_tbl			TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(40) primary key, status_cd INT, wo_uom_id INT, target_sched_line_id INT, num_op INT, row_id INT)
DECLARE @wo_qtys TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY
	, fj_qty_at_start FLOAT, fj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_at_start FLOAT, lj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_prod FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)
DECLARE @line_prod_ent_qty TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, qty_prod FLOAT, qty_reqd FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)

BEGIN
	

	set @delimiter = ','
	DECLARE @textXML XML;
	SELECT @textXML = CAST('<d>' + REPLACE(@process, @delimiter, '</d><d>') + '</d>' AS XML);

	declare @temp table (process NVARCHAR(MAX))
	insert into @temp
	SELECT T.split.value('.', 'nvarchar(max)') AS data
	FROM @textXML.nodes('/d') T (split)



	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @wo_limit = COALESCE(@number_of_wos, 999999999)
	SET @include_from_process = COALESCE(@include_from_process, 0)

	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326

	--EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @wo_status_filter

	; WITH wo_statuses (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id) AS
		(SELECT wo.wo_id, wo.state_cd, i.uom_id, wo.target_sched_line_id, first_job_counts.num_op, wo.row_id
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = i.item_id
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(oper_id)) num_op
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
			  AND j.first_job = 1) first_job_counts
		WHERE (wo.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			(wo.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			--When include from process is true, then the SP returns all work orders, whether they are related to process or not.
			((@include_from_process = 0 AND wo.process_id IS NULL) OR (@include_from_process = 1) OR (wo.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.target_sched_line_id is not null)) AND
			((wo.target_sched_line_id = @target_sched_line_id) OR (wo.target_sched_line_id IS NULL AND @target_sched_line_id IS NULL) OR (@target_sched_line_id = -1))
		)
		, wo_for_filter (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id) AS
		(
		--SELECT TOP (@wo_limit) wst.wo_id, wst.status_cd, wst.wo_uom_id, wst.target_sched_line_id, wst.num_op, wst.row_id
		--FROM wo_statuses wst
		---- Join with the supplied XML which contains the work order statuses that we are interested in
		--JOIN OPENXML(@doc_handle, '/wo_status/status',2) WITH (code int '@code') on wst.status_cd = code
		--ORDER BY wst.row_id DESC
		SELECT TOP (@wo_limit) wst.wo_id, wst.status_cd, wst.wo_uom_id, wst.target_sched_line_id, wst.num_op, wst.row_id
		FROM wo_statuses wst with(nolock) JOIN (SELECT REPLACE(ITEMS,'#','') AS code FROM [dbo].fn_ofi_Split(@wo_status_filter,';')) as spl on wst.status_cd = spl.code
		ORDER BY wst.row_id DESC
		)
		INSERT INTO @wo_status_tbl (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id)
		SELECT wff.wo_id, wff.status_cd, wff.wo_uom_id, wff.target_sched_line_id, wff.num_op, wff.row_id
		FROM wo_for_filter wff with(nolock)

		--EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle


	-- Check if there are any work orders matching the filter that are assigned to lines
	-- and do not have the necessary UOM conversions.
	; WITH
	-- Get the conversion factors for all jobs that produce an item that uses a different UOM than the item produced
	-- by the work order.  If there is no conversion factor between the UOM of the item produced by a job and the
	-- the UOM of the item produced by the work order, default to zero.  Since we are only looking for necessary
	-- conversions, we can ignore any job after the production entities, any jobs that have no reject quantity, or
	-- the jobs on the production entity if they have no production quantity.
	factors (wo_id, factor) AS (
		-- Get the conversions related to reject production items at or before the production position if defined
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
			WHERE lel.ent_id = COALESCE(l.prod_ent_id, (select MIN(COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)) last_ent_id
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.final_job = 1 AND j.wo_id = wo.wo_id))
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order >= prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_rejected <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions related to good production items at the production position if defined, or from the last jobs if not
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id
				AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND l.line_id = lel.line_id
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order = prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_prod <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions for the first operation to see if the start quantity can be converted to the
		-- work orders item.
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.first_job = 1 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
	)
	-- Get one of the work orders where there is no conversion
	SELECT TOP 1 @no_conv_wo_id = wo_id from factors with(nolock)
	WHERE factors.factor = 0
	IF @no_conv_wo_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		  SET @err_msg = 'There is a quantity of an item for a job of work order %1 having a unit of measure for which there is no conversion to that of the final item for the work order, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{3005},' + @no_conv_wo_id
		  RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		  RETURN
	END

	INSERT INTO @wo_qtys (wo_id, fj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_reqd, lj_qty_prod, qty_rejected)
	SELECT j.wo_id
	-- Get the starting quantity by summing up the starting quantities of all the first jobs.  The jobs starting
	-- quantity will be converted to the work order's UOM if possible.  If no conversion exists, starting quantity
	-- returned by this CTE will be null, so it will not be used.  This quantity will also not be used if the
	-- number of first operations in the work order is greater than one.
	, SUM(CASE WHEN j.first_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id
		THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END)
	-- Get the starting quantity, quantity produced, and quantity rejected at the last operation in the work order
	-- by summing up those values at the jobs marked as the final job for the work order.  There is no need to
	-- convert the values to the UOM of the item produced by the work order as the last operation must make the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This starting quantity will be used if there are more than one first operation or
	-- if the UOM of the item produced by the first operation cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced by
	-- the work order.  This quantity produced will be used if the work order is not run on a line.  This quantity
	-- rejected will be used if any item rejected in a job running before the final jobs cannot be converted to the UOM
	-- of the item produced by the work order.
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start ELSE 0 END) as qty_at_start
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_reqd ELSE 0 END) as qty_reqd
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) as qty_prod
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_rejected ELSE 0 END) as qty_rejected
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	WHERE j.first_job = 1 OR j.final_job = 1
	GROUP BY j.wo_id;

	-- Get the quantity produced on a line by adding up the quantity produced by jobs running at the production entity.
	-- The UOM of the item produced by the jobs running on the production entities is converted to the UOM of the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This quantity will be null if the work order is not run on a line.  Also get the sum
	-- of the required quantities of the jobs running on the production entities.  This quantity will be null if the work
	-- order is not run on a line.
	INSERT INTO @line_prod_ent_qty (wo_id, qty_prod, qty_reqd, qty_rejected)
		SELECT j.wo_id
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order = prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_prod * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order = prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_reqd * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order <= prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wfp ON wfp.wo_id = j.wo_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_ents.line_id = wfp.target_sched_line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
				SELECT l.line_id, COALESCE(MAX(lel.child_order)
							, (SELECT MAX(lel_max.child_order) FROM line_ent_link lel_max WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel_max.line_id = l.line_id AND lel_max.line_is_child = 0)) child_order_prod
				 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id AND lel.ent_id = l.prod_ent_id
				GROUP BY l.line_id
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents.line_id = prod_ents_in_line.line_id AND prod_ents.child_order <= prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		GROUP BY j.wo_id

	-- Get the rejected quantity of a work order that is not run on a line by adding up the total number of rejects
	-- in the work order.  The UOM of each rejected item is converted to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
	-- This quantity will be null if the UOM of any rejected item cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	;WITH nonline_total_rej_prod (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT x.wo_id, CASE WHEN (x.rejected = x.ignore_missed_conv) THEN x.rejected ELSE NULL END
		FROM
			(SELECT j.wo_id
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END)) AS rejected
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)) AS ignore_missed_conv
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wfp ON wfp.wo_id = j.wo_id
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
			GROUP BY j.wo_id) x
	),
	-- Get the total good and rejected for a work order.  The total good will either come from the quantity produced at the
	-- production entities if the work order is run on a line, will come from the quantity produced at the final
	-- operation in the work order if the work order is not run on a line, or will be zero if the work order has no
	-- jobs.  The total rejected will come from the quantity rejected at or
	-- before the production entities if the work order is run on a line, the quantity rejected at or before the final
	-- jobs if the work order is not run on a line and the the UOM of the rejected items can be converted to the UOM of
	-- the item produced by the work order, or the quantity rejected at the final jobs if the work order is not run on
	-- a line and one of more the UOMs from the rejected quantity cannot be converted into the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	total_prod (wo_id, qty_good, qty_rejected) AS
	(
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_prod, ljq.lj_qty_prod, 0), COALESCE(lpeq.qty_rejected, nltrp.qty, 0)
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wff.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod nltrp ON wff.wo_id = nltrp.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the start quantity for the work order.  The starting quantity will either be the sum of the start quantities
	-- from the first operation if there is only one first operation and the UOM of the item produced at the first
	-- operation can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order and the UOMs of all the rejects
	-- can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order or it will be the sum of the starting
	-- quantity of the final operation in the work order.
	start_qty (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, CASE WHEN (wff.num_op = 1) THEN COALESCE(jq.fj_qty_at_start, jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) ELSE COALESCE(jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) END
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys jq ON wff.wo_id = jq.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the qty_reqd for the work order.  This is either the sum of the required quantities of the jobs running at
	-- the production entities if the work order is run on a line or by the sum of the required quantities of the final
	-- jobs.
	qty_reqd (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_reqd, ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0)
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON ljq.wo_id = wff.wo_id
	)

	
	 SELECT 
	  wo.wo_id
		,	wo.wo_desc
		,	wo.process_id
		,	process.process_desc
		,	(select attr_value  from  process_attr wa with(nolock) LEFT JOIN attr a with(nolock) on wa.attr_id=a.attr_id where a.attr_desc='ProcessType' and wa.process_id =wo.process_id) as attr_value
		,	(select attr_value  from  process_attr wa with(nolock) LEFT JOIN attr a with(nolock) on wa.attr_id=a.attr_id where a.attr_desc='Allowed_UD' and wa.process_id =wo.process_id) as UD_type
		,    (select oa.attr_value from wo woo (nolock)
				inner join oper o (nolock) on o.process_id=woo.process_id
				inner join oper_attr oa (nolock) on oa.oper_id=o.oper_id
				inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=oa.attr_id
				where attr_desc='AllowBinConsumption' and wo.wo_id=woo.wo_id )as chkABA
		,	 (select wa.attr_value from wo_attr wa
			inner join wo w on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
			inner join attr a on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=wo.wo_id) as chckCurABA
		,	wo.bom_ver_id
		,	wo.spec_ver_id
		,	wo.item_id
		,	item.item_desc
		,	('('+item.item_desc+')'+' '+wo.item_id) as itConcat
		,	item.serial_no_lvl
		,   item.uom_id
		,	uom.description AS uom_desc
		,   item.num_decimals
		,	@num_decimals_good_pp num_decimals_good_pp
		,	wo.req_qty
		,	wo.release_time_utc
		,	wo.release_time_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, wo.release_time_utc) as release_time
		,	wo.req_finish_time_utc
		,	wo.req_finish_time_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, wo.req_finish_time_utc) as req_finish_time
		,	wo.state_cd
		,	wo.wo_priority
		,	wo.cust_info
		,	wo.mo_id
		,	wo.production_schedule_id
		,	wo.notes
		,	wo.not_deletable
		,	wo.disassembly
		,	wo.may_override_route
		,	wo.override_serialization
		,   wo.input_wo_id
		,   wo.input_oper_id
		,   wo.input_seq_no
		,	wo.target_sched_line_id
		,   line.line_name as target_sched_line_name
		,	wo.queue_seq_no
		,	wff.status_cd as wo_status
		,	js.state_desc AS wo_status_desc
		,	js.color
		,	ROUND(qr.qty,3) AS qty_reqd
		,	ROUND(sq.qty,3) AS qty_at_start
		,	ROUND(tp.qty_good,3) AS qty_prod
		,	tp.qty_rejected AS qty_rejected
		-- The quantity remaining is the start quantity - (good production + rejected production).
		,     CASE  -- Added "AND fo.num = 1" to the WHEN and THEN clauses so work orders with >1 1st operation use rejected quantities from last jobs only
			   WHEN (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(sq.qty,3) ELSE ROUND(ljq.lj_qty_at_start,3) END)
					- (ROUND(tp.qty_good,3) + CASE WHEN tp.qty_rejected <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN ROUND(tp.qty_rejected,3) ELSE ROUND(ljq.qty_rejected,3) END) > 0
			   THEN ROUND((CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(sq.qty,3) ELSE ROUND(ljq.lj_qty_at_start,3) END)
					- (ROUND(tp.qty_good,3) + CASE WHEN tp.qty_rejected <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN ROUND(tp.qty_rejected,3) ELSE ROUND(ljq.qty_rejected,3) END),3)
			   ELSE 0
		   END AS qty_remaining
		-- The def_reqd_qty is the required quantity - good production
		,	CASE
				WHEN qr.qty - tp.qty_good > 0 THEN ROUND(qr.qty,3) - ROUND(tp.qty_good,3)
				ELSE 0
			END AS def_reqd_qty
		,	case when wo.spare1=1 then 'SAP' else 'MES' end spare1 --,	wo.spare1
		,	wo.spare2
		,	wo.spare3
		,	wo.spare4
		,	wo.last_edit_comment
		,	wo.last_edit_by
		,	wo.last_edit_at
		,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id))) mod_id
		,	COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) as calc_start_qty
		,	COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0) as calc_reqd_qty
		,	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wo.row_id DESC) row_num
	    ,   wo.row_id
		--,   jb.def_lot_no
	
	   FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	   --left join to add Rework attribute
	   

		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wff ON wo.wo_id = wff.wo_id 
		--JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON wff.status_cd = js.state_cd
		JOIN ofi_wo_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON wff.status_cd = js.state_cd
		LEFT JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id = process.process_id
		JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = item.item_id
		JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON  item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		LEFT JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.target_sched_line_id = line.line_id
		JOIN start_qty sq ON wo.wo_id = sq.wo_id
		JOIN total_prod tp ON wo.wo_id = tp.wo_id
		JOIN qty_reqd qr ON wo.wo_id = qr.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wo.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod ntrp ON wo.wo_id = ntrp.wo_id
		--JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) on wo.wo_id=jb.wo_id and jb.bom_pos=0 and jb.seq_no=0
		where  (wo.process_id in(select process from @temp) or @process is NULL or @process='') 
		AND
		((WO.state_cd = 3 AND @lastNhours IS NOT NULL AND (WO.last_edit_at >= DATEADD(HOUR, -@lastNhours, GETUTCDATE()) and WO.last_edit_at <= GETUTCDATE()))
		 OR
		(@lastNhours IS not NULL and wo.state_cd <> 3)
		--))
		or ( @lastNhours IS NULL))
		--ORDER BY wo.wo_id 
		--ORDER BY wo.release_time_utc desc
		ORDER BY wo.last_edit_at desc
		
END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_step_ent_exc_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_ent_exc]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_step_ent_exc_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_ent_exc table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_step_ent_exc osee INNER JOIN  inserted i
					ON osee.process_id = i.process_id AND osee.oper_id = i.oper_id
					AND osee.step_no = i.step_no AND osee.ent_id = i.ent_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_step_ent_exc', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_step_ent_exc osee INNER JOIN  inserted i
					ON osee.process_id = i.process_id AND osee.oper_id = i.oper_id
					AND osee.step_no = i.step_no AND osee.ent_id = i.ent_id) oseexc
	WHERE process.process_id = oseexc.process_id

	UPDATE oper_step_ent_exc SET oper_step_ent_exc.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_step_ent_exc.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_step_ent_exc.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_step_ent_exc.oper_id = i.oper_id
	      AND oper_step_ent_exc.step_no = i.step_no AND oper_step_ent_exc.ent_id = i.ent_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Cycle_Start_Event] 
( @ent_id int,
  @raw_reas_cd nvarchar(40) )

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @result int = 1,
			@event_time_utc datetime = GETUTCDATE(),

	-- Get latest utilization on the equipment

	SELECT

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_GetHierarchy]
(
	@category_id INT32 = NULL,
	@obsolete bit = NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - sp_SA_Item_GetHierarchy
-- Description    - This procedure will return category and its related items in an hierarchical order to build a items tree.
-- Author	 	  - Ibrahim Mohammed
-- Date Created   - 03/02/2011
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 05/04/2012	  Ibrahim		4.5	Removed the Parent_item_class, item_class and added category.
-- 05/16/2012	  Rupak         4.5 Added valdation item_class.produced
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON


BEGIN
	DECLARE @attr_value       NVARCHAR(10)

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 210
	IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

	IF @category_id IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT category.category_name
				  ,item_category_link.category_id
				  ,CASE
						WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
						WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
						WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
						WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
				   END AS item_display
				  ,item_category_link.item_id
				  ,item.item_desc
				  ,item.obsolete
			FROM item_category_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN category WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_category_link.category_id = category.category_id
			INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_category_link.item_id = item.item_id
			WHERE ((item_category_link.category_id = @category_id) AND
					(item.obsolete = @obsolete OR @obsolete IS NULL))
			ORDER BY category.category_name, item_display
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT null as category_name
				  ,null as category_id
				  ,CASE
						WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
						WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
						WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
						WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
				   END AS item_display
				  ,item_id
				  ,item_desc
				  ,item.obsolete
			FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item_class WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_class.item_class_id = item.item_class_id
			WHERE ((item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_category_link WITH(NOLOCK))) AND
					(item.obsolete = @obsolete OR @obsolete IS NULL)AND
					(item_class.produced = 1))
			ORDER BY category_name, item_display
		END
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [Sp_u_ofi_correction_recipe]
-- Description:To correct the  recipe
-- Usage: This will be used to correct the recipe
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  MP      2023-06-21			Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	JSC		2025-10-01			CakeBlender FATs Save cur correction step into job spec
-- 0.02.01	JSC		2025-10-16			Removed DIV by zero posibility
-- 0.02.02	JSC		2025-10-21			Verify job.spare1 value to prevent creating new step when not needed
-- 0.02.03	JSC		2025-10-27			Updated the call to cumulative script
-- 0.02.04	JSC		2025-11-24			Fix the case the item was found for a temporary correction values but never saved
-- 0.02.05	JSC		2025-12-08			Always force an update on the additives job-specs as if not allowed the value should be always zero, lecithine shall go to zero always
-- 0.02.06	JSC		2026-01-26			Changed CB_Batch weight
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_correction_recipe]
        @wo_id     NVARCHAR ( 40 ),
        @oper_id   NVARCHAR ( 40 ),
        @seq_no    INT,
        @result    NVARCHAR ( MAX ),
        @is_manual INT= 0
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @CTE TABLE
			(
					id                  INT identity(1,1) NOT NULL,
					item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
					item_desc           NVARCHAR(40),
					qty_percent         FLOAT,
					qty_reqd            FLOAT,
					qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
					man_qty_percent     FLOAT,
					man_qty_reqd        FLOAT,
					row_id              INT
			)
	DECLARE @curr_correction_step INT = 1,
	@is_success                   INT = 0,
	@water                        FLOAT
	DECLARE @Counter              INT,
	@iterate                      INT=1,
	@item_id                      NVARCHAR(40),
	@bom_pos                      INT,
	@qty_per_parent_item          FLOAT
	DECLARE @Qty_reqd             FLOAT,
	@base_dose_param              FLOAT,
	@correction_step              FLOAT,
	@Qty_reqd_item                FLOAT
	DECLARE @corrType1            NVARCHAR(40),
	@corrVal1                     FLOAT,
	@corrType2                    NVARCHAR(40),
	@corrVal2                     FLOAT,
	@corrType3                    NVARCHAR(40),
	@corrVal3                     FLOAT,
	@corrType4                    NVARCHAR(40),
	@corrVal4                     FLOAT
	-- v2.01 Added
	DECLARE @job_spare1 INT = 0
	SELECT  @job_spare1     = ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,j.spare1),0)
	FROM    job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			j.wo_id          = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id    = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no     = @seq_no
	SELECT  @base_dose_param = act_spec_value
	FROM    job_spec WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			wo_id           =@wo_id
			AND oper_id     =@oper_id
			AND seq_no      =@seq_no
			AND spec_id     ='CB_Dosing weight'
	SELECT  @correction_step= act_spec_value
	FROM    job_spec WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			wo_id      =@wo_id
			AND oper_id=@oper_id
			AND seq_no =@seq_no
			AND spec_id='CB_Number of corrections'
	IF @job_spare1     <= 2 
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS
		(       SELECT  1
				FROM    job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE
						wo_id      =@wo_id
						AND oper_id=@oper_id
						AND seq_no =@seq_no
						AND spec_id = 'CB_Current correction step')
		BEGIN
				SELECT  @curr_correction_step = MAX(act_spec_value)+1
				FROM    job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE
						wo_id       = @wo_id
						AND oper_id = @oper_id
						AND seq_no  = @seq_no
						AND spec_id = 'CB_Current correction step'
				GROUP BY
						wo_id ,
						oper_id,
						seq_no,
						spec_id

				-- v2.01 MOVED HERE
				UPDATE  job_spec
				SET
						act_spec_value = @curr_correction_step
				WHERE
						wo_id       = @wo_id
						AND oper_id = @oper_id
						AND seq_no  = @seq_no
						AND spec_id = 'CB_Current correction step'
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT  @curr_correction_step = js.act_spec_value
		FROM    job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				js.wo_id       = @wo_id
				AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
				AND js.seq_no  = @seq_no
				AND js.spec_id = 'CB_Current correction step'
	END
	INSERT INTO @cte
			(
					item_id,
					item_desc,
					qty_percent,
					qty_reqd,
					qty_per_parent_item,
					man_qty_percent,
					man_qty_reqd,
					row_id
			)
	SELECT  item_id,
			item_desc,
			qty_percent,
			qty_reqd,
			qty_per_parent_item,
			man_qty_percent,
			man_qty_reqd,
			row_id
	FROM    OPENJSON ( @result ) WITH ( item_id VARCHAR(200) '$.item_id', item_desc VARCHAR(200) '$.item_desc', qty_percent FLOAT '$.qty_percent', qty_reqd FLOAT '$.qty_reqd', qty_per_parent_item FLOAT '$.qty_per_parent_item', man_qty_percent FLOAT '$.man_qty_percent', man_qty_reqd FLOAT '$.man_qty_reqd', row_id INT '$.row_id' )

	UPDATE  ocr
	SET
			ocr.qty_per_parent_item = CASE
												WHEN    @is_manual =0
												THEN    ISNULL(cte.qty_percent,0)/100
												WHEN    @is_manual =1
												THEN    ISNULL(cte.man_qty_percent,0)/100
										END
	FROM    ofi_correction_recipe ocr WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN
			@cte cte
	ON
			ocr.row_id = cte.row_id


	-- This is not needed here
	----SELECT  @Qty_reqd  = qty_reqd
	----FROM    job WITH(NOLOCK)
	----WHERE
	----		wo_id      =@wo_id
	----		AND oper_id=@oper_id
	----		AND seq_no =@seq_no

	-- v2.0 UDPATED
	EXEC Sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative @wo_id,
			@oper_id,
			@seq_no,
			@result,
			NULL,
			'correction_step',
			@is_manual

	SET @Counter = ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @cte )
	WHILE ( @iterate <= @Counter)
	BEGIN
		SELECT  @item_id             = jb.item_id,
				@bom_pos             = jb.bom_pos,
				@qty_per_parent_item = ISNULL( CASE
													WHEN    @is_manual = 0
														THEN    ct.qty_per_parent_item
													WHEN    @is_manual = 1
														THEN    ct.man_qty_percent/100
												END,0),
				@Qty_reqd_item		= ISNULL( CASE
													WHEN    @is_manual = 0
														THEN    ct.qty_reqd
													WHEN    @is_manual = 1
														THEN    ct.man_qty_reqd
												END,0)
		FROM    @cte ct
		JOIN
				job_bom jb
		ON
				jb.item_id = ct.item_id
		WHERE
				jb.wo_id      = @wo_id
				AND jb.oper_id= @oper_id
				AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
				AND ct.id     = @iterate

		--v0.02.04 Added check for bom_pos being NULL
		IF @bom_pos IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			EXEC sp_i_ofi_job_bom_correction_details @wo_id,
													@oper_id,
													@seq_no,
													@item_id,
													@bom_pos,
													@Qty_reqd_item,
													@qty_per_parent_item,
													@curr_correction_step
		END

		SET @iterate = @iterate + 1
	END

	-- v2.05 Update for job_attr validations
	DECLARE @PHCORRECTIONT TABLE
		(
			item_desc		NVARCHAR(80),
			item_id			NVARCHAR(40),
			correctionVal	FLOAT,
			spec_id			NVARCHAR(40) -- added v2.05
		)
	DECLARE @cbSampleResultRow INT

	-- Updating the process parameter for the water, O-Salt, B-Salt Powder, B-Salt Liquid
	SELECT TOP 1 @water = moist_water,			
				@cbSampleResultRow = r.row_id
	FROM    ofi_cb_sample_results r WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			wo_id         = @wo_id
			AND oper_id   = @oper_id
			AND seq_no    = @seq_no
			AND is_manual = @is_manual
			AND correction_step = @curr_correction_step -- Added v2.05
	ORDER BY
			row_id DESC

	-- v2.05 fix for correction of PH
	INSERT INTO @PHCORRECTIONT
	SELECT   i.item_desc
			,i.item_id
		   ,CASE 
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType1 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue1
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType2 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue2
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType3 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue3
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType4 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue4
				ELSE 0
			END
			,CASE a.component 
				WHEN 'CitricAcid'
					THEN 'CB_O-Salt'
				WHEN 'PotassiumCarbonate'
					THEN 'CB_B-Salt_Powder'
				WHEN 'PotassiumLiquid'
					THEN 'CB_B-Salt_Liquid'
			END
	FROM cakeblend.Additives a WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = a.item_id 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_cb_sample_results cb WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.Component IN (cb.phCorrectionType1, cb.phCorrectionType2, cb.phCorrectionType3, cb.phCorrectionType4)
																	AND cb.row_id = @cbSampleResultRow -- done like this so we ALWAYS get ALL Additives in the result


	-- Update for Water
	UPDATE  job_spec
	SET
			act_spec_value = @water
	WHERE
			wo_id       =@wo_id
			AND oper_id =@oper_id
			AND seq_no  =@seq_no
			AND spec_id = 'CB_Water'

	-- Updated v2.05: Update the 3 additives, will be set to zero when not found
	UPDATE js
	SET act_spec_value = p.correctionVal
	FROM job_spec js
		JOIN @PHCORRECTIONT p ON p.spec_id = js.spec_id
	WHERE js.wo_id = @wo_id
		AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND js.seq_no = @seq_no

	-- Added v2.05: Update for Lecithine
	UPDATE  job_spec
	SET
			act_spec_value = '0'
	WHERE
			wo_id       =@wo_id
			AND oper_id =@oper_id
			AND seq_no  =@seq_no
			AND spec_id = 'CB_Lecithine'


	DECLARE @row_id_ac INT
	SELECT  @row_id_ac = ISNULL(o.row_id,-1)
	FROM    ofi_cb_approved_correction o WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE
			o.wo_id               = @wo_id
			AND o.oper_id         = @oper_id
			AND o.seq_no          = @seq_no
			-- AND o.is_manual       = @is_manual  --v2.05 if something fail and they approve a new one for the same step, then we need to update it
			AND o.correction_step = @curr_correction_step
	IF @row_id_ac                 >= 0
	BEGIN
			UPDATE  ofi_cb_approved_correction
			SET
					recipe_json  = @result,
					is_manual = @is_manual, -- v2.05 Added
					last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
			WHERE
					row_id = @row_id_ac
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			INSERT INTO ofi_cb_approved_correction
					(
							wo_id,
							oper_id,
							seq_no,
							recipe_json,
							is_manual,
							correction_step
					)
			VALUES
					(
							@wo_id,

							@seq_no,
							@result,
							@is_manual,
							@curr_correction_step
					)
	END

	UPDATE  Job
	SET
			spare1 = 3
	WHERE
			wo_id       = @wo_id

			AND seq_no  = @seq_no

	SELECT 1 AS row_id
END
