CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Hour_History_RefreshQtysAndTimes]
(@start_utc_range	TDATETIME2
,@end_utc_range		TDATETIME2
,@ent_id		INT32 = NULL
,@wo_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@oper_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@seq_no		INT32 = NULL
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@created_at_utc	TDATETIME = NULL
,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Program Name			- FACETLLIGENCE
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Hour_History_RefreshQtysAndTimes
-- Description          - Updates the times and quantities column in the job hour history table for the given time range
--			User Story: 679407 - As Lenka, I want the utilization events in the past (older than 2 hrs) should be updated in job_hour_history
-- Author				- RaghuG
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  - 5.03
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver	Changes
-- 09/27/2016		Raghu			5.3	User Story: 711590 - As Lenka, I want the end time of a job_history record to be modified
-- 11/07/2019		Raghu G			6.2	UserStory: 1240920 - MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00155617 (HF CR L00155116: SR 402110181 data issues with the Job_hour_history table.)
-- 06/17/2020		Raghu G			6.2	UserStory: 1316334 - As AVEVA, I want to fix CRs L00158081 so that MES Service call to update job_hour_history quantity and times does not timeout
-- 07/15/2020		Raghu G			6.2	UserStory: 1338528 - MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00159064 (HF CR L00159062: Long running jobs takes a long time to close and times out)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @hour_start_utc_start	TDATETIME
	,@hour_end_utc		TDATETIME
	,@hour_start_utc_end	TDATETIME
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

DECLARE @buckets		TABLE (ent_id INT, wo_id NVARCHAR(80), oper_id NVARCHAR(80), seq_no INT, job_start_utc DATETIME, hour_start_utc DATETIME
					, qty_prod FLOAT, qty_reject FLOAT, runtime INT, downtime INT, idletime INT
					PRIMARY KEY (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc, hour_start_utc))

DECLARE @util_times 		TABLE (ent_id INT, event_time_utc DATETIME2, event_end_time_utc DATETIME2, duration INT, runtime BIT, downtime BIT
					PRIMARY KEY (ent_id, event_time_utc))

BEGIN
	--If the ending time is not supplied, exit
	IF (@end_utc_range IS NULL) RETURN

	--Default the start time of the range as same as the end time
	SET @start_utc_range = COALESCE(@start_utc_range, @end_utc_range)

	--Determine the hour start bucket based on the start event time
	SET @hour_start_utc_start = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @start_utc_range),0)

	--Determine the hour end bucket based on the end event time
	SET @hour_start_utc_end = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @end_utc_range),0)

 	--Verify whether the hour end is within the last 2 hour boundary
 	IF (@hour_start_utc_end >= DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @current_time_utc),0)))
 	 	--This stored procedure is to update job_hour_history (tpm_stat) for the supplied range
	 	--If the modifications are within last 2 hours from the top of the current hour, there is no need to update the job_hour_history, since the hourly task will catch up later
	 	--For example, current time is 4:15p.  If the end range is 4:15, the top of the hour is 4p.
 		--Since the end range is is greater than or equal to 2p, the end range is set back to 1p
 		--If the start range is greater than 1p, then the update will be skipped; otherwise, the range will be updated
 		SET @hour_start_utc_end = DATEADD(HH, -3, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @current_time_utc),0))

 	--Exit, if the start range is later than the end range
 	IF (@hour_start_utc_start > @hour_start_utc_end) RETURN

	--If the event is within the last 2 hours from the top of the hour, then exit.
	IF (@hour_start_utc_start >= DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @current_time_utc),0))
		AND @hour_start_utc_end >= DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @current_time_utc),0)))
		--The start UTC range and end UTC range are within 2 hours from the current time.  Exit
		RETURN

	;WITH ent_start_times AS
	(SELECT uh.ent_id, MAX(uh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc
	 FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	 WHERE (uh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	   AND uh.event_time_utc < @hour_start_utc_start
	 GROUP BY uh.ent_id
	 )
	INSERT INTO @util_times (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_end_time_utc, duration, runtime, downtime)
	SELECT vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc, vuht.event_end_time_utc, vuht.duration, vuht.runtime, vuht.downtime
	FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_start_times est ON est.ent_id = vuht.ent_id AND est.start_event_time_utc = vuht.event_time_utc
	UNION
	SELECT vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc, vuht.event_end_time_utc, vuht.duration, vuht.runtime, vuht.downtime
	FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (vuht.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND vuht.event_time_utc >= @hour_start_utc_start
	  AND vuht.event_time_utc <= DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc_end)

	WHILE (@hour_start_utc_start <= @hour_start_utc_end) BEGIN

		SET @hour_end_utc = DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc_start)

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_hour_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc_start) BEGIN
			SET @hour_start_utc_start = @hour_end_utc
			CONTINUE
		END

		; WITH util_events (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_end_time_utc, duration, runtime, downtime) AS
		(SELECT vuht.ent_id, vuht.event_time_utc, vuht.event_end_time_utc, vuht.duration, vuht.runtime, vuht.downtime
		FROM @util_times vuht
		INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT jhh.ent_id, COALESCE(util_start.event_time_utc, @hour_start_utc_start) start_event_time_utc
				FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
				OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) event_time_utc FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc <= @hour_start_utc_start) util_start
				WHERE (jhh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
				  AND (jhh.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
				  AND (jhh.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
				  AND (jhh.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
				  AND (jhh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc OR @job_start_utc IS NULL)
				  AND jhh.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc_start
				) ents ON vuht.ent_id = ents.ent_id AND vuht.event_time_utc >= ents.start_event_time_utc AND vuht.event_time_utc < @hour_end_utc
		)
		, boundaries (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc, hour_start_utc, hour_end_utc, boundary_start_utc, boundary_end_utc) AS
		(SELECT jhh.ent_id, jhh.wo_id, jhh.oper_id, jhh.seq_no, jhh.job_start_utc, jhh.hour_start_utc, jhh.hour_end_utc
			, CASE WHEN jhh.job_start_utc < jhh.hour_start_utc THEN jhh.hour_start_utc ELSE jhh.job_start_utc END boundary_start_utc
			, CASE WHEN COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > jhh.hour_end_utc THEN jhh.hour_end_utc ELSE COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) END boundary_end_utc
			FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = jh.seq_no AND jhh.job_start_utc = jh.job_start_utc
			WHERE (jhh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
			  AND (jhh.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
			  AND (jhh.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND (jhh.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
			  AND (jhh.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc OR @job_start_utc IS NULL)
			  AND jhh.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc_start
			  AND (jhh.last_edit_at = @created_at_utc OR @created_at_utc IS NULL)
		)
		, tpm_stat_data (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc, qty_prod, qty_reject, runtime, downtime, idletime) AS
		(SELECT b.ent_id, b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.job_start_utc
			, MAX(qtys.qty_prod) AS qty_prod, MAX(qtys.qty_reject) AS qty_reject
			, SUM(CASE WHEN ue.runtime = 1 AND NOT (ue.event_end_time_utc <= b.boundary_start_utc OR ue.event_time_utc >= b.boundary_end_utc)
					THEN COALESCE(ue.duration, 0) - CASE WHEN ue.event_time_utc < b.boundary_start_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ue.event_time_utc, b.boundary_start_utc) ELSE 0 END
							- CASE WHEN ue.event_end_time_utc > b.boundary_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, b.boundary_end_utc, ue.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END
					ELSE 0 END)	AS runtime
			, SUM(CASE WHEN ue.downtime = 1 AND NOT (ue.event_end_time_utc <= b.boundary_start_utc OR ue.event_time_utc >= b.boundary_end_utc)
					THEN COALESCE(ue.duration, 0) - CASE WHEN ue.event_time_utc < b.boundary_start_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ue.event_time_utc, b.boundary_start_utc) ELSE 0 END
							- CASE WHEN ue.event_end_time_utc > b.boundary_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, b.boundary_end_utc, ue.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END
					ELSE 0 END)	AS downtime
			, SUM(CASE WHEN ue.runtime = 0 AND ue.downtime = 0 AND NOT (ue.event_end_time_utc <= b.boundary_start_utc OR ue.event_time_utc >= b.boundary_end_utc)
					THEN COALESCE(ue.duration, 0) - CASE WHEN ue.event_time_utc < b.boundary_start_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, ue.event_time_utc, b.boundary_start_utc) ELSE 0 END
							- CASE WHEN ue.event_end_time_utc > b.boundary_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, b.boundary_end_utc, ue.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END
					ELSE 0 END)
				AS idletime
		FROM boundaries b WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN util_events ue ON b.ent_id = ue.ent_id AND ue.event_time_utc < b.boundary_end_utc
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 1 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) AS qty_prod
			, SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 0 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) AS qty_reject
			FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.ent_id = b.ent_id
			  AND ip.wo_id = b.wo_id
			  AND ip.oper_id = b.oper_id
			  AND ip.seq_no = b.seq_no
			  AND ip.byproduct = 0
			  AND ip.created_at_utc >= b.boundary_start_utc
			  --Must have <= AND < hour_end_utc since there are two cases to handle
			  --(i) A production accounted precisely at the end time of the job must be accounted.
			  --For example, if there is a production at 7:30:30 and the end time of the job is 7:30:30, then that production must be included
			  --(ii) However, if the production is at 8:00:00 and the end time of the job is 8:00:00, then the production must be included for this hour (excluding the production from the previoius hour)
			  --The created_at_utc <= boundar_end_utc includes all the production including the end time of the job, but the created_at_utc < hour_end_utc determines which hour the production should be included.
			  AND ip.created_at_utc <= b.boundary_end_utc AND ip.created_at_utc < b.hour_end_utc
			  ) qtys
		GROUP BY b.ent_id, b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.job_start_utc
		)
		INSERT INTO @buckets (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc, hour_start_utc, qty_prod, qty_reject, runtime, downtime, idletime)
		SELECT ts.ent_id, ts.wo_id, ts.oper_id, ts.seq_no, ts.job_start_utc, @hour_start_utc_start, ts.qty_prod, ts.qty_reject, ts.runtime, ts.downtime, ts.idletime
		FROM tpm_stat_data ts

		SET @hour_start_utc_start = DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc_start)
	END

	UPDATE job_hour_history
	SET job_hour_history.qty_good = COALESCE(b.qty_prod, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.qty_reject = COALESCE(b.qty_reject, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.runtime = COALESCE(b.runtime, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.downtime = COALESCE(b.downtime, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.idletime = COALESCE(b.idletime, 0)
	   ,job_hour_history.last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	FROM @buckets b
	WHERE job_hour_history.ent_id = b.ent_id
	AND job_hour_history.wo_id = b.wo_id
	AND job_hour_history.oper_id = b.oper_id
	AND job_hour_history.seq_no = b.seq_no
	AND job_hour_history.job_start_utc = b.job_start_utc
	AND job_hour_history.hour_start_utc = b.hour_start_utc
	--Make sure there is a change in quantities OR times; otherwise there is no point to update
	AND (job_hour_history.qty_good <> COALESCE(b.qty_prod, 0) OR job_hour_history.qty_reject <> COALESCE(b.qty_reject, 0)
	OR job_hour_history.runtime <> COALESCE(b.runtime, 0) OR job_hour_history.downtime <> COALESCE(b.downtime, 0) OR job_hour_history.idletime <> COALESCE(b.idletime, 0))
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_I_EI_MM_Attr
-- Description:  Inserts the item attributes
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-12      Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Adn         2023-12-11      Changed for item group mapping table
-- 0.01.02  Lavkesh     2024-02-01      Modified logic for item group mapping
-- 0.01.03	MC			2025-02-18		Handling Item_gropu for WIP items other than 'NIBS'
-- 0.01.04	MC			2025-10-08		Considering MaterialType = 'FERT' to automatically crating for every item
-- 0.02.00	AML, XPM	2026-06-29		CR635: Automatically create 'Category' attribute based on the item
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_EI_MM_Attr] (@item_id       NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @item_group            NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @item_classification   NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @language_key          NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @plant_code            NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @production_supervisor NVARCHAR(80),
                                           @legacy_code           NVARCHAR(40),
                                           @item_status           NVARCHAR(40),
										   @material_state        NVARCHAR(40),
										   @production_method     NVARCHAR(40))
AS
BEGIN
	IF @item_status <> 'Deleted' and (dbo.fn_s_ofi_plantcode()= @plant_code)
	BEGIN
        DECLARE @attr_id1       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id2       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id3       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id4       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id5       INT=NULL,
                @attr_id6       INT=NULL,
				@attr_id7		INT=NULL,
				@attr_id8		INT=NULL, -- 0.01.04
				@attr_id9		INT=NULL, -- 0.02.00
                @rc             INT,
                @error_msg      NVARCHAR(500),
                @error_severity INT,
                @error_state    INT,
                @mod_id         VARCHAR(30)

        SELECT @attr_id1 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id2 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'Classification'	---- (KN - 02/02/23 - to identify if the item is seggregated (non null node) or non-seggregated (null node)
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id3 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'LanguageKey'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id4 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id5 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ProductionSupervisor'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id6 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'LegacyCode'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

        SELECT @attr_id7 = attr_id
        FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
        WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'AutomationItemID'
                AND a.attr_grp = 1

		SELECT @attr_id8 = attr_id
		FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE a.attr_desc = 'MaterialType' AND a.attr_grp=1

		SELECT @attr_id9 = attr_id
		FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE a.attr_desc = 'Category' AND a.attr_grp = 1

        BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION
		-- 0.01.01 start

		DECLARE @item_group_mes NVARCHAR(80);
		-- 0.01.02
		--IF @item_group<>'NIBS'
		--0.01.03
		IF EXISTS(SELECT item_group_sap FROM [dbo].[ofi_item_group_mapping] WITH (nolock) where item_group_sap=@item_group)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @item_group_mes = item_group_mes from [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_item_group_mapping] WITH (nolock)
			WHERE (item_group_sap = @item_group AND @item_group IS NOT NULL) 
			AND (item_class_sap = @item_classification AND @item_classification IS NOT NULL)
			AND ((material_state = @material_state AND @material_state IS NOT NULL) OR (material_state IS NULL))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--SET @item_group_mes='NIBS'
			--0.01.03
			SET @item_group_mes=@item_group
		END
		print @item_group_mes
		-- 0.01.01 end
        IF ( @attr_id1 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id2 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id3 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id4 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id5 IS NULL
                OR @attr_id6 IS NULL
				OR @attr_id7 IS NULL)
        BEGIN ;
            THROW 51009,
            'Item attribute not found - SP_I_EI_Item_Attr',
            1
        END

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                        FROM   item_attr WITH (nolock)
                        WHERE  item_id = @item_id
                                AND attr_id = @attr_id1)
        BEGIN
			select @item_group_mes
				EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_item_attr]
				@item_id = @item_id,
				@attr_id = @attr_id1,
				@attr_value = @item_group_mes,-- 0.01.01
				@notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
				@last_edit_comment = NULL,
				@mod_id = @mod_id output

            IF ( @rc <> 0 )
            BEGIN
                SET @error_msg =
                N'Error while creating item attribute ('
                + @item_id
                + ') in MES  - SP_I_EI_ITEM_ATTR -  '
                + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);

                THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
            END
		END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
			print 'else'

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample]
(@sample_id INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@sample_name STRING80_NULL = NULL
 ,@ent_id INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@item_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@wo_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@oper_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@seq_no INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@context_ent_id INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@context_item_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@item_category_id INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@process_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@context_oper_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@freq_id INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@plan_id INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@segment_requirement_id STRING80_NULL = NULL
 ,@segment_response_id STRING80_NULL = NULL
 ,@lot_no STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@sublot_no STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@requested_time_start TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@requested_time_start_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@requested_time_end TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@requested_time_end_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@expiry_time TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@expiry_time_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@warning_time TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@warning_time_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@pulled_by STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@pulled_time_start TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@pulled_time_start_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@pulled_time_end TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@pulled_time_end_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@final INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@finalized_by STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@finalized_at TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@finalized_at_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
 ,@verified_by STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@sample_status INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@sample_result INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@spare1  STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@spare2  STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@spare3  STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@spare4  STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@priority INT32_NULL = NULL
 ,@last_edit_by STRING40_NULL = NULL
 ,@last_edit_at TDATETIME_NULL = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_Sample
-- Description    - Get all sample records using any supplied filters
-- Author         -  Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created   -  02/01/2011
-- Version        -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group, PLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6/7/2011       Johnny Agsalog   Added priority column
-- 5/6/2020       Jim O'Hearn      Added UTC input parameters and removed time zone parameters (US 1302836)
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

   SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT sample.sample_id
          ,sample.sample_name
          ,sample.ent_id
          ,sample.item_id
          ,sample.wo_id
        ,sample.oper_id
        ,sample.seq_no
          ,sample.context_ent_id
          ,sample.context_item_id
          ,sample.item_category_id
          ,sample.process_id
          ,sample.context_oper_id
          ,sample.freq_id
          ,sample.plan_id
        ,sample.segment_requirement_id
        ,sample.segment_response_id
        ,sample.lot_no
        ,sample.sublot_no
        ,sample.requested_time_utc
        ,sample.requested_time_local
          ,sample.requested_time_utc as requested_time
        ,sample.expiry_time_utc
        ,sample.expiry_time_local
          ,sample.expiry_time_utc as expiry_time
        ,sample.warning_time_utc
        ,sample.warning_time_local
          ,sample.warning_time_utc as warning_time
        ,sample.pulled_by
        ,sample.pulled_time_utc
        ,sample.pulled_time_local
          ,sample.pulled_time_utc as pulled_time
        ,sample.final
        ,sample.finalized_by
        ,sample.finalized_at_utc
        ,sample.finalized_at_local
          ,sample.finalized_at_utc as finalized_at
        ,sample.verified_by
        ,sample.sample_status
        ,sample.sample_result
        ,sample.spare1
        ,sample.spare2
        ,sample.spare3
        ,sample.spare4
        ,sample.priority
          ,sample.last_edit_comment
          ,sample.last_edit_by
          ,sample.last_edit_at
  FROM sample sample WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ((sample.sample_id = @sample_id OR @sample_id IS NULL) AND
         (sample.sample_name = @sample_name OR @sample_name IS NULL) AND
         (sample.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
         (sample.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
         (sample.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
         (sample.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (sample.item_category_id = @item_category_id OR @item_Category_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.context_oper_id = @context_oper_id OR @context_oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.freq_id = @freq_id OR @freq_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.plan_id = @plan_id OR @plan_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
       (sample.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
       (sample.requested_time_utc >= @requested_time_start_utc OR @requested_time_start_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (sample.requested_time_local >= @requested_time_start OR @requested_time_start IS NULL) AND
       (sample.requested_time_utc <= @requested_time_end_utc OR @requested_time_end_utc IS NULL) AND
       (sample.requested_time_local <= @requested_time_end OR @requested_time_end IS NULL) AND
       (sample.expiry_time_utc >= @expiry_time_utc OR @expiry_time_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (sample.expiry_time_local >= @expiry_time OR @expiry_time IS NULL) AND
       (sample.warning_time_utc >= @warning_time_utc OR @warning_time_utc IS NULL) AND
       (sample.warning_time_local >= @warning_time OR @warning_time IS NULL) AND
       (sample.pulled_by = @pulled_by OR @pulled_by IS NULL) AND
       (sample.pulled_time_utc >= @pulled_time_start_utc OR @pulled_time_start_utc IS NULL) AND
       (sample.pulled_time_local >= @pulled_time_start OR @pulled_time_start IS NULL) AND
       (sample.pulled_time_utc <= @pulled_time_end_utc OR @pulled_time_end_utc IS NULL) AND
       (sample.pulled_time_local <= @pulled_time_end OR @pulled_time_end IS NULL) AND
       (sample.final = @final OR @final IS NULL) AND
       (sample.finalized_by = @finalized_by OR @finalized_by IS NULL) AND
       (sample.finalized_at_utc >= @finalized_at_utc OR @finalized_at_utc IS NULL) AND
       (sample.finalized_at_local >= @finalized_at OR @finalized_at IS NULL) AND
       (sample.verified_by = @verified_by OR @verified_by IS NULL) AND
       (sample.sample_status = @sample_status OR @sample_status IS NULL) AND
       (sample.sample_result = @sample_result OR @sample_result IS NULL) AND
       (sample.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (sample.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (sample.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (sample.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (sample.priority = @priority OR @priority IS NULL) AND
         (sample.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
         (sample.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY sample_name


END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_WO_GetByFilterbAK]
(
	@wo_id 						STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@item_id 					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@target_sched_line_id       INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@wo_status_filter			NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@number_of_wos              INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@include_from_process	LOGICAL = 0,
	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0,
	@lastNhours			INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@process			 NVARCHAR(MAX)
/*
Example XML
<wo_status>
	<status code="1" />
	<status code="2" />
	<status code="3" />
	<status code="4" />
	<status code="5" />
	<status code="6" />
</wo_status>
*/
)

AS
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-	sp_SA_WO_GetByFilter
-- Description		-	Selects the rows from the work order table that match the supplied filters
--						The quantities for the work orders will be calculated in the following manner:
--						There are 4 cases:
--						1. A work order is being run on a line (where it is required that all needed conversions exist or an
--						   error is returned)
--						2. A work order is not being run on a line, there is a single first operation, and the needed
--						   conversions exist
--						3. A work order is not being run on a line, there is more than one first operation, and the needed
--						   conversions exist (this is the least likely case)
--						4. A work order is not being run on a line, and at least one needed conversion does not exist
--
--						Note that what conversions are "needed" may differ from value to value, so the same case may not
--						apply to all values (for example, when conversions for the UOMs of the items reported as good
--						production exist, but not for all rejects).  Also, a conversion is needed only for non-zero values.
--						There may be rejects but no good production, or vice versa.  The required quantity (qty_reqd) is
--						always the sum of the qty_reqd of the last jobs in the work order (those where final_job is true),
--						and the remaining required quantity (def_reqd_qty) is always the greater of 0 or the required
--						quantity (qty_reqd) minus the good production quantity (qty_prod), however they were calculated.
--						The rest can vary for each case:
--
--						Case 1 (A work order is being run on a line)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the first jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item
--						qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the jobs at the production position, converted to the UOM of the final item (the production position is the last position if no production entity is identified)
--						qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of the jobs at the production position and before, each converted to the UOM of the final item before summing
--						qty_remaining = the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - qty_rejected)
--
--						Case 2 (A work order is not being run on a line, there is a single first operation, and the needed conversions exist)
--						qty_at_start = same as Case 1
--						qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the last jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item
--						qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of each job, each converted to the UOM of the final item before summing
--						qty_remaining = same as Case 1
--
--						Case 3 (A work order is not being run on a line, there is more than one first operation, and the needed conversions exist)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the last jobs
--						qty_prod = same as Case 2
--						qty_rejected = same as Case 2
--						qty_remaining = the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - sum of the qty_rejected fields of the last jobs)
--
--						Case 4 (A work order is not being run on a line, and at least one needed conversions does not exist)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the last jobs
--						qty_prod = same as Case 2
--						qty_rejected = 0
--						qty_remaining = same as Case 3
--
--						Note that while in cases 1 and 2 that the qty_remaining is given as "same as Case 1", since it's
--						always equal to the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - qty_rejected), nevertheless what 2 of
--						these 3 components are varies from case to case, so how the value of qty_remaining is derived may
--						not be the same if the "final" values for each aren't directly used.  This is also true of the
--						calculation of def_reqd_qty.

-- Author			-
-- Date Created		- 05/06/2014
-- Version			- 5.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--  08/22/2014		SLR			5.0		added input filter for target_sched_line_id, number_of_wos parameter to limit the
--										number of rows to be returned, and changed the order by to work order id.
--  09/05/2014		SLR			5.0		update select to retrieve work orders based on filters ordered by row_id desc to get
--										the most resently created work orders, then select and return the top N order by
--										the work order id
--  09/08/2014		JEO			5.0		update interpretation of the target_sched_line_id parameter value as the following:
--										>= 0 -- return work orders scheduled to a particular line
--										NULL -- return work orders that are not schedule to any line
--										-1   -- Return work orders without regard to a line
--  09/08/2014		RWB			5.0		For CR L00133799, removed the pre-calculation of the work order status.  Calculating
--										the status of every work slows down the SP when the number of work orders exceeds
--										the number of work orders requested.
--	02/05/2015		RWB			5.0.1	For story 439593, made changes to account for different items being produced at
--										different jobs in the work order.  This involves calculating all quantity information
--										to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
--	04/28/2016		Surya		5.0.3	For story 594231, made changes to improve the performance by removing the row number check,
--										and using TOP to retrieve top most work orders.
--	05/20/2016		RWB			5.0.3	For story 59231, added a temporary table to hold the work order ID and status of each
--										work order.  Also, changed the order of the inner select from row_id to row_id DESC.
-- 06/08/2016	Raghu G		5.3	UserStory: 594231 - As Bruce I want the WO collection page to load quicker so that it takes less time (CR L00135959)
--					Modified this stored procedure to improve the performance significantly.
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
-- 10/05/2017	RaghuG		6.0	UserStory: 921577 - As Bruce, I want to be able to use filters to get a list of work orders from the MES database, including work orders created from a process.
-- 11/29/2018	Srinivas	6.01	UserStory: 1031503 - Made changes to return the work orders created from process and assigned to line.
--  07/10/2022		MP			7.0	Added the Time filter and Replaced xml input to wofliter with WO Status table. Now we can see only Work Order Status (0-Released, 1-Started, 2-Completed, 3-Closed)	
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @num_decimals_good_pp	INT,
		@doc_handle				INT,
		@min_factor				INT,
		@wo_limit				INT,
		@no_conv_wo_id			NVARCHAR(40),
		@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000),
		@delimiter NVARCHAR(5)
DECLARE @wo_status_tbl			TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(40) primary key, status_cd INT, wo_uom_id INT, target_sched_line_id INT, num_op INT, row_id INT)
DECLARE @wo_qtys TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY
	, fj_qty_at_start FLOAT, fj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_at_start FLOAT, lj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_prod FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)
DECLARE @line_prod_ent_qty TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, qty_prod FLOAT, qty_reqd FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)

BEGIN
	

	set @delimiter = ','
	DECLARE @textXML XML;
	SELECT @textXML = CAST('<d>' + REPLACE(@process, @delimiter, '</d><d>') + '</d>' AS XML);

	declare @temp table (process NVARCHAR(MAX))
	insert into @temp
	SELECT T.split.value('.', 'nvarchar(max)') AS data
	FROM @textXML.nodes('/d') T (split)



	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @wo_limit = COALESCE(@number_of_wos, 999999999)
	SET @include_from_process = COALESCE(@include_from_process, 0)

	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326

	--EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @wo_status_filter

	; WITH wo_statuses (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id) AS
		(SELECT wo.wo_id, wo.state_cd, i.uom_id, wo.target_sched_line_id, first_job_counts.num_op, wo.row_id
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = i.item_id
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(oper_id)) num_op
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
			  AND j.first_job = 1) first_job_counts
		WHERE (wo.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			(wo.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			--When include from process is true, then the SP returns all work orders, whether they are related to process or not.
			((@include_from_process = 0 AND wo.process_id IS NULL) OR (@include_from_process = 1) OR (wo.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.target_sched_line_id is not null)) AND
			((wo.target_sched_line_id = @target_sched_line_id) OR (wo.target_sched_line_id IS NULL AND @target_sched_line_id IS NULL) OR (@target_sched_line_id = -1))
		)
		, wo_for_filter (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id) AS
		(
		--SELECT TOP (@wo_limit) wst.wo_id, wst.status_cd, wst.wo_uom_id, wst.target_sched_line_id, wst.num_op, wst.row_id
		--FROM wo_statuses wst
		---- Join with the supplied XML which contains the work order statuses that we are interested in
		--JOIN OPENXML(@doc_handle, '/wo_status/status',2) WITH (code int '@code') on wst.status_cd = code
		--ORDER BY wst.row_id DESC
		SELECT TOP (@wo_limit) wst.wo_id, wst.status_cd, wst.wo_uom_id, wst.target_sched_line_id, wst.num_op, wst.row_id
		FROM wo_statuses wst JOIN (SELECT REPLACE(ITEMS,'#','') AS code FROM [dbo].fn_ofi_Split(@wo_status_filter,';')) as spl on wst.status_cd = spl.code
		ORDER BY wst.row_id DESC
		)
		INSERT INTO @wo_status_tbl (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id)
		SELECT wff.wo_id, wff.status_cd, wff.wo_uom_id, wff.target_sched_line_id, wff.num_op, wff.row_id
		FROM wo_for_filter wff

		--EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle


	-- Check if there are any work orders matching the filter that are assigned to lines
	-- and do not have the necessary UOM conversions.
	; WITH
	-- Get the conversion factors for all jobs that produce an item that uses a different UOM than the item produced
	-- by the work order.  If there is no conversion factor between the UOM of the item produced by a job and the
	-- the UOM of the item produced by the work order, default to zero.  Since we are only looking for necessary
	-- conversions, we can ignore any job after the production entities, any jobs that have no reject quantity, or
	-- the jobs on the production entity if they have no production quantity.
	factors (wo_id, factor) AS (
		-- Get the conversions related to reject production items at or before the production position if defined
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
			WHERE lel.ent_id = COALESCE(l.prod_ent_id, (select MIN(COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)) last_ent_id
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.final_job = 1 AND j.wo_id = wo.wo_id))
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order >= prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_rejected <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions related to good production items at the production position if defined, or from the last jobs if not
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id
				AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND l.line_id = lel.line_id
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order = prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_prod <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions for the first operation to see if the start quantity can be converted to the
		-- work orders item.
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.first_job = 1 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
	)
	-- Get one of the work orders where there is no conversion
	SELECT TOP 1 @no_conv_wo_id = wo_id from factors
	WHERE factors.factor = 0
	IF @no_conv_wo_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		  SET @err_msg = 'There is a quantity of an item for a job of work order %1 having a unit of measure for which there is no conversion to that of the final item for the work order, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{3005},' + @no_conv_wo_id
		  RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		  RETURN
	END

	INSERT INTO @wo_qtys (wo_id, fj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_reqd, lj_qty_prod, qty_rejected)
	SELECT j.wo_id
	-- Get the starting quantity by summing up the starting quantities of all the first jobs.  The jobs starting
	-- quantity will be converted to the work order's UOM if possible.  If no conversion exists, starting quantity
	-- returned by this CTE will be null, so it will not be used.  This quantity will also not be used if the
	-- number of first operations in the work order is greater than one.
	, SUM(CASE WHEN j.first_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id
		THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END)
	-- Get the starting quantity, quantity produced, and quantity rejected at the last operation in the work order
	-- by summing up those values at the jobs marked as the final job for the work order.  There is no need to
	-- convert the values to the UOM of the item produced by the work order as the last operation must make the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This starting quantity will be used if there are more than one first operation or
	-- if the UOM of the item produced by the first operation cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced by
	-- the work order.  This quantity produced will be used if the work order is not run on a line.  This quantity
	-- rejected will be used if any item rejected in a job running before the final jobs cannot be converted to the UOM
	-- of the item produced by the work order.
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start ELSE 0 END) as qty_at_start
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_reqd ELSE 0 END) as qty_reqd
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) as qty_prod
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_rejected ELSE 0 END) as qty_rejected
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	WHERE j.first_job = 1 OR j.final_job = 1
	GROUP BY j.wo_id;

	-- Get the quantity produced on a line by adding up the quantity produced by jobs running at the production entity.
	-- The UOM of the item produced by the jobs running on the production entities is converted to the UOM of the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This quantity will be null if the work order is not run on a line.  Also get the sum
	-- of the required quantities of the jobs running on the production entities.  This quantity will be null if the work
	-- order is not run on a line.
	INSERT INTO @line_prod_ent_qty (wo_id, qty_prod, qty_reqd, qty_rejected)
		SELECT j.wo_id
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order = prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_prod * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order = prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_reqd * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order <= prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wfp ON wfp.wo_id = j.wo_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_ents.line_id = wfp.target_sched_line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
				SELECT l.line_id, COALESCE(MAX(lel.child_order)
							, (SELECT MAX(lel_max.child_order) FROM line_ent_link lel_max WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel_max.line_id = l.line_id AND lel_max.line_is_child = 0)) child_order_prod
				 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id AND lel.ent_id = l.prod_ent_id
				GROUP BY l.line_id
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents.line_id = prod_ents_in_line.line_id AND prod_ents.child_order <= prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		GROUP BY j.wo_id

	-- Get the rejected quantity of a work order that is not run on a line by adding up the total number of rejects
	-- in the work order.  The UOM of each rejected item is converted to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
	-- This quantity will be null if the UOM of any rejected item cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	;WITH nonline_total_rej_prod (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT x.wo_id, CASE WHEN (x.rejected = x.ignore_missed_conv) THEN x.rejected ELSE NULL END
		FROM
			(SELECT j.wo_id
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END)) AS rejected
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)) AS ignore_missed_conv
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wfp ON wfp.wo_id = j.wo_id
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
			GROUP BY j.wo_id) x
	),
	-- Get the total good and rejected for a work order.  The total good will either come from the quantity produced at the
	-- production entities if the work order is run on a line, will come from the quantity produced at the final
	-- operation in the work order if the work order is not run on a line, or will be zero if the work order has no
	-- jobs.  The total rejected will come from the quantity rejected at or
	-- before the production entities if the work order is run on a line, the quantity rejected at or before the final
	-- jobs if the work order is not run on a line and the the UOM of the rejected items can be converted to the UOM of
	-- the item produced by the work order, or the quantity rejected at the final jobs if the work order is not run on
	-- a line and one of more the UOMs from the rejected quantity cannot be converted into the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	total_prod (wo_id, qty_good, qty_rejected) AS
	(
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_prod, ljq.lj_qty_prod, 0), COALESCE(lpeq.qty_rejected, nltrp.qty, 0)
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wff.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod nltrp ON wff.wo_id = nltrp.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the start quantity for the work order.  The starting quantity will either be the sum of the start quantities
	-- from the first operation if there is only one first operation and the UOM of the item produced at the first
	-- operation can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order and the UOMs of all the rejects
	-- can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order or it will be the sum of the starting
	-- quantity of the final operation in the work order.
	start_qty (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, CASE WHEN (wff.num_op = 1) THEN COALESCE(jq.fj_qty_at_start, jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) ELSE COALESCE(jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) END
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys jq ON wff.wo_id = jq.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the qty_reqd for the work order.  This is either the sum of the required quantities of the jobs running at
	-- the production entities if the work order is run on a line or by the sum of the required quantities of the final
	-- jobs.
	qty_reqd (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_reqd, ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0)
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON ljq.wo_id = wff.wo_id
	)

	
	 SELECT 
	  wo.wo_id
		,	wo.wo_desc
		,	wo.process_id
		,	process.process_desc
		,	proA.attr_value
		,	wo.bom_ver_id
		,	wo.spec_ver_id
		,	wo.item_id
		,	item.item_desc
		,	item.serial_no_lvl
		,   item.uom_id
		,	uom.description AS uom_desc
		,   item.num_decimals
		,	@num_decimals_good_pp num_decimals_good_pp
		,	wo.req_qty
		,	wo.release_time_utc
		,	wo.release_time_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, wo.release_time_utc) as release_time
		,	wo.req_finish_time_utc
		,	wo.req_finish_time_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, wo.req_finish_time_utc) as req_finish_time
		,	wo.state_cd
		,	wo.wo_priority
		,	wo.cust_info
		,	wo.mo_id
		,	wo.production_schedule_id
		,	wo.notes
		,	wo.not_deletable
		,	wo.disassembly
		,	wo.may_override_route
		,	wo.override_serialization
		,   wo.input_wo_id
		,   wo.input_oper_id
		,   wo.input_seq_no
		,	wo.target_sched_line_id
		,   line.line_name as target_sched_line_name
		,	wo.queue_seq_no
		,	wff.status_cd as wo_status
		,	js.state_desc AS wo_status_desc
		,	js.color
		,	qr.qty AS qty_reqd
		,	sq.qty AS qty_at_start
		,	tp.qty_good AS qty_prod
		,	tp.qty_rejected AS qty_rejected
		-- The quantity remaining is the start quantity - (good production + rejected production).
		,   CASE  -- Added "AND fo.num = 1" to the WHEN and THEN clauses so work orders with >1 1st operation use rejected quantities from last jobs only
			   WHEN (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN sq.qty ELSE ljq.lj_qty_at_start END)
					- (tp.qty_good + CASE WHEN tp.qty_rejected <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN tp.qty_rejected ELSE ljq.qty_rejected END) > 0
			   THEN (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN sq.qty ELSE ljq.lj_qty_at_start END)
					- (tp.qty_good + CASE WHEN tp.qty_rejected <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN tp.qty_rejected ELSE ljq.qty_rejected END)
			   ELSE 0
		   END AS qty_remaining
		-- The def_reqd_qty is the required quantity - good production
		,	CASE
				WHEN qr.qty - tp.qty_good > 0 THEN qr.qty - tp.qty_good
				ELSE 0
			END AS def_reqd_qty
		,	wo.spare1
		,	wo.spare2
		,	wo.spare3
		,	wo.spare4
		,	wo.last_edit_comment
		,	wo.last_edit_by
		,	wo.last_edit_at
		,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id))) mod_id
		,	COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) as calc_start_qty
		,	COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0) as calc_reqd_qty
		,	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wo.row_id DESC) row_num
	    ,   wo.row_id
		--,   jb.def_lot_no
	
	   FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	   --left join to add Rework attribute
	   left join process_attr proA on wo.process_id=proA.process_id and wo.process_id in  
		(select process_id from process_attr p left join attr a on p.attr_id=a.attr_id where a.attr_desc='ProcessType') and
		proA.attr_value='Rework'

		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wff ON wo.wo_id = wff.wo_id 
		--JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON wff.status_cd = js.state_cd
		JOIN ofi_wo_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON wff.status_cd = js.state_cd
		LEFT JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id = process.process_id
		JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = item.item_id
		JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON  item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		LEFT JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.target_sched_line_id = line.line_id
		JOIN start_qty sq ON wo.wo_id = sq.wo_id
		JOIN total_prod tp ON wo.wo_id = tp.wo_id
		JOIN qty_reqd qr ON wo.wo_id = qr.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wo.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod ntrp ON wo.wo_id = ntrp.wo_id
		--JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) on wo.wo_id=jb.wo_id and jb.bom_pos=0 and jb.seq_no=0
		where ( (wo.process_id in(select process from @temp) or @process is NULL or @process='') AND
		(((release_time_local >= DATEADD(HOUR, -@lastNhours, GETDATE()) and release_time_local <= GETDATE()) AND @lastNhours IS NOT NULL) OR
		(@lastNhours IS NULL) ))
		--AND (1=1 AND @lastNhours IS NULL)
		ORDER BY wo.wo_id 
		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Link]
  (@parent_ent_id int ,
   @child_ent_id int,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at DATETIME OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@site_ent_id	INT32
	,@err_msg	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@child_ent_name NVARCHAR(80)
	,@parent_ent_name NVARCHAR(80)

	-- Check to see if we are insterting a child entity under an entity that is already the parent of an ancestor
	-- or descendent of the child entity
	DECLARE  @temp_entities TABLE (ent_id INT,
		parent_ent_id INT)
	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id)
     SELECT child_ent_id, parent_ent_id from ent_link
	 WHERE child_ent_id = @child_ent_id
	-- If the were no insertions, this is a top-level entity, so insert it and skip to inserting children
	IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id)
			VALUES (@child_ent_id, null)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-- Loop through all the entities in the temporary table looking for parent entities that are not listed as
		-- child entities in the temporary table but are listed as child entities in the ent_link table.
		-- Do this until no more entities are found.
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id)
			SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, el.parent_ent_id FROM @temp_entities te
			INNER JOIN ent_link el on el.child_ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
			WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
		END
		-- Add in the root entities
		INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id)
		SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, null FROM @temp_entities te
		WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)
	END
	-- Loop through all the entities in the temporary table looking for children of the entities that are not listed as
	-- parent entities in the the temporary table but are listed as parent entities in the ent_link table
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id)
		SELECT distinct el.child_ent_id, te.ent_id FROM @temp_entities te
		INNER JOIN ent_link el on el.parent_ent_id = te.ent_id
		WHERE te.ent_id NOT IN (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM @temp_entities WHERE parent_ent_id IS NOT null)
		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_link
		WHERE parent_ent_id = @parent_ent_id AND child_ent_id in (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities))
	BEGIN
		SELECT @child_ent_name = ent_name from ent where ent_id = @child_ent_id
		SELECT @parent_ent_name = ent_name from ent where ent_id = @parent_ent_id
		SET @err_msg = 'Cannot create this link as either an ancestor or descendent of %%1 is already a child of %%2.{6880},' + @child_ent_name + ',' + @parent_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

INSERT INTO ent_link
 (parent_ent_id,
  child_ent_id,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@parent_ent_id,
   @child_ent_id,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at);

IF ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.site)
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE el.child_ent_id = @child_ent_id
			  AND e.site IS NOT NULL) > 1) BEGIN
	SET @err_msg = 'There are many parent entities which belongs to different sites, hence this entity link cannot be added.{6306}';
	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
	RETURN
END

	SELECT @site_ent_id = e.site
	FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = e.ent_id
	WHERE el.child_ent_id = @child_ent_id
	  AND e.site IS NOT NULL;

--Update all the decendants (including this entity) with the site information.
WITH child_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
	(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @child_ent_id
		UNION ALL
		SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
		INNER JOIN child_ents ce ON ce.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
	)
UPDATE ent
SET site = @site_ent_id
FROM ent e
INNER JOIN child_ents AS ce ON e.ent_id = ce.ent_id;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_ClearBreaksAnd0Shifts]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_ClearBreaksAnd0Shifts
-- Description		- Clears 0 shifts and applies breaks to the template shifts.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 10/13/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	--Clear the zero shifts as this is not required for scheduling shifts.
	DELETE FROM #shift_to_go_template WHERE shift_id = 0

	UPDATE #shift_to_go_template
	SET break1_start = CASE WHEN (break1_start IS NULL OR break1_end IS NULL) THEN NULL
				ELSE CASE WHEN break1_start >= start_date AND break1_start <= end_date
						AND break1_end >= start_date AND break1_end <= end_date THEN
					break1_start
					ELSE NULL END
				END
		, break1_end = CASE WHEN (break1_start IS NULL OR break1_end IS NULL) THEN NULL
				ELSE CASE WHEN break1_start >= start_date AND break1_start <= end_date
						AND break1_end >= start_date AND break1_end <= end_date THEN
					break1_end
					ELSE NULL END
				END
		, break2_start = CASE WHEN (break2_start IS NULL OR break2_end IS NULL) THEN NULL
				ELSE CASE WHEN break2_start >= start_date AND break1_start <= end_date
						AND break2_end >= start_date AND break2_end <= end_date THEN
					break2_start
					ELSE NULL END
				END
		, break2_end = CASE WHEN (break2_start IS NULL OR break2_end IS NULL) THEN NULL
				ELSE CASE WHEN break2_start >= start_date AND break2_start <= end_date
						AND break2_end >= start_date AND break2_end <= end_date THEN
					break2_end
					ELSE NULL END
				END
		, break3_start = CASE WHEN (break3_start IS NULL OR break3_end IS NULL) THEN NULL
				ELSE CASE WHEN break3_start >= start_date AND break3_start <= end_date
						AND break3_end >= start_date AND break3_end <= end_date THEN
					break3_start
					ELSE NULL END
				END
		, break3_end = CASE WHEN (break3_start IS NULL OR break3_end IS NULL) THEN NULL
				ELSE CASE WHEN break3_start >= start_date AND break3_start <= end_date
						AND break3_end >= start_date AND break3_end <= end_date THEN
					break3_end
					ELSE NULL END
				END
END
