							,qty_reqd  float
							);

		declare @result_temp table
						(
							wo_id nvarchar(20),
							oper_id nvarchar(30),
							seq_no int,
							result_code int,
							failed_msg nvarchar(MAX),
							bom_item nvarchar(MAX)
						)

		INSERT INTO @cte(bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
					,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
					,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
					,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd) 
		SELECT bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
					,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
					,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
					,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd  FROM  
		OPENJSON ( @grid )  
		WITH (        
				 -- rowId  int '$.row_id',
				  bom_pos  int  '$.bom_pos' ,
				  item_id   varchar(80) '$.item_id' ,  
				  --item_desc  varchar(120) '$.item_desc', 
				  reqd_grade_cd   int  '$.reqd_grade_cd' ,
				  item_grade_desc   varchar(120) '$.item_grade_desc', 
				  qty_per_parent_item float  '$.qty_per_parent_item',
				  min_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.min_qty_per_parent_item',
				  max_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.max_qty_per_parent_item',
				  recipe_reqd_qty_per float  '$.recipe_reqd_qty_per',
				  uom_description  varchar(40)  '$.uom_description',
				  job_qty_reqd float  '$.job_qty_reqd',
				  last_wo		varchar(80) '$.last_wo' ,
				  last_oper		varchar(80) '$.last_oper' ,
				  last_seq		varchar(80) '$.last_seq' ,
				  material_type		varchar(80) '$.material_type' ,
				  is_cakeblender_running  int  '$.is_cakeblender_running' ,
				  qty_reqd  float  '$.qty_reqd'
		);

		update @cte set reqd_grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
		from item_grade ig inner join @cte c1 on ig.item_grade_desc = c1.item_grade_desc and ig.good_prod =1


		if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe')
		begin
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LastjobBOMRecipe') Is Not Null 
			BEGIN 
				DROP TABLE #LastjobBOMRecipe; 
			END
			SELECT top 1 @lastWo_id = wo_id,@lastOper_id = oper_id, @lastseqNo = seq_no from job with(nolock) where run_ent_id = @ent_id and item_id = @parent_item_id and state_cd = 4 order by act_finish_time_utc desc 
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #LastjobBOMRecipe FROM  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id=@lastWo_id and oper_id = @lastOper_id and seq_no = @lastseqNo and bom_pos<>0
		end
		else 
		begin
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BOMRecipe') Is Not Null 
			BEGIN 
				DROP TABLE #BOMRecipe; 
			END
			select @bomItem = item_id, @bomVersion = version from ofi_master_recipe with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name;
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #BOMRecipe FROM  bom_item with(nolock) where parent_item_id = @bomItem and ver_id = @bomVersion and bom_pos <>0
		end

			 --select @bomItem ,@bomVersion
			 --select * from @cte
			 --select * from #BOMRecipe


		--	 validation 
			--begin
			--	select 0 as result, '@@CakeBlenderCompenentIsNotPresent@@' as resultCode;  
			--	--select 1 as result,'updated successfully ' as resultCode
			--	return;
			--end

			--BOM Compare
			-- same SP can't be used as we have to pass the selected parameter
			

		insert into @result_temp
			exec [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp] 
			   @wo_id
			  ,@oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@ent_id
			  ,@parent_item_id
			  ,@recipe_name

		if ((select top 1 result_code from @result_temp)<>1)
		begin
			select @resultset = 0 
			,@resultCode =  (select top 1  CONCAT(failed_msg,'- ',bom_item) from @result_temp); 
			return;
		end




		IF(@saveRecords=1) 
		BEGIN

			-- populating the audit table
			INSERT INTO @jobBomAudit select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0

			--update job_bom set 
			delete from jb
			from job_bom jb --inner join @cte  c1 on jb.item_id = c1.item_id and jb.reqd_grade_cd =c1.reqd_grade_cd
			where jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and jb.bom_pos<>0 --and jb.item_id not in( select item_id from @cte)

			update job_bom set qty_per_parent_item = case  when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			,min_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			,max_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			,qty_reqd = ct.qty_reqd
			,reqd_grade_cd =  isnull(ct.reqd_grade_cd,(select item_grade_cd from item_grade with(nolock) where item_grade_desc = ct.item_grade_desc))
			,bom_pos = ct.bom_pos
			from job_bom jb with(nolock) inner join @cte ct on jb.item_id = ct.item_id
			and jb.wo_id =  @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no

			select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @cte
			--select * from @cte

			WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
			BEGIN
			--BEGIN -- v0.07 DELETED
				-- updating variables from @cte 
				SELECT @bom_pos = bom_pos, @item_id = item_id
				,@qty_per_parent_item = case 	when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 
													then  0 
												when ct.uom_description = 'MT' 
													then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 
												else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 
										end 
				,@max_qty_per_parent_item = case 	when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 
														then  0 
													when ct.uom_description = 'MT' 
														then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 
													else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 
											end 
				,@min_qty_per_parent_item = case 	when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 
														then  0 
													when ct.uom_description = 'MT' 
														then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 
													else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 
											end 
				,@qty_reqd =qty_reqd 
				,@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
				from @cte as ct 
				where rowId =@row_cnt 

				-- Update the remaining values based on last recipe or new one
				if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe') -- updating values here
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
								,@reqd_start_val				= reqd_start_val           
								,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		= reqd_start_val_is_pct    
								,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
								,@backflush                  = backflush                
								,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
								--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
								--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
								,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
								,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
								,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
								,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
								,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
								,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
								,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
								,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
								,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
								,@est_time                   = est_time                 
								,@current_subst              = current_subst         
					from #LastjobBOMRecipe 
					where item_id = @item_id   
						and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd  
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
							,@reqd_start_val				= 0           
							,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		=	0    
							,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
							,@backflush                  = backflush                
							,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
							--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
							--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
							,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
							,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
							,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
							,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
							,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
							,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
							,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
							,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
							,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
							,@est_time                   = est_time                 
							,@current_subst              = NULL         
					from #BOMRecipe 
					where item_id = @item_id   
						and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd 
				END

				-- v0.07 CRXXX fix for by-prods
				SELECT TOP 1 @def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd              
					,@def_lot_no = def_lot_no
				FROM @jobBomAudit jb
				JOIN @cte ct ON ct.item_id = jb.item_id 
				WHERE ct.rowId = @row_cnt 

				-- checking if it is existing in the job bom
				IF NOT EXISTS	(	SELECT 1 
									from job_bom with(nolock) 
									where wo_id = @wo_id 
										and oper_id = @oper_id 
										and seq_no = @seq_no 
										and bom_pos <>0 
										and item_id = @item_id 
										and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
								)
				BEGIN
					--select @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					--0.06 
					IF(@bom_pos<0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT @maxBomPos =  min(bom_pos)-1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					END 
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					END
					
					-- inserting values in job bom
					EXEC 
						 [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Bom] @wo_id
						,@oper_id
						,@seq_no
						,@maxBomPos
						,@item_id
						,@reqd_grade_cd
						,@instruction
						,@qty_per_parent_item
						,@max_qty_per_parent_item
						,@min_qty_per_parent_item
						,@reqd_start_val
						,@reqd_start_val_is_pct
						,@update_inv
						,@backflush
						,@def_reas_cd
						,@def_lot_no
						,@def_sublot_no
						,@def_storage_ent_id
						,@def_reject_ent_id
						,@scaling_factor
						,@must_consume_from_inv
						,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc
						,@may_create_new_lots
						,@must_consume_from_wip
						,@must_consume_before_prod
						,@constant_qty
						,@est_time
						,@current_subst
						,@qty_reqd
						,@serial_no_source
						,@spare1
						,@spare2
						,@spare3
						,@spare4
						,@last_edit_comment
						,@mod_id OUTPUT

					SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
				END
			-- END -- v0.07 DELETED
				SET @row_cnt = @row_cnt+1
			END
		
			-- inserting the values for audit trail
			insert into @jobBomAudit1 select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] 
			from job_bom with(nolock) 
			where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0


			select @already_used = [already_used] from  [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name
			
			if(@recipe_name is not null and @already_used = 'N' and @recipe_name <>'Last used recipe')
			BEGIN
				-- updating ofi master 
				UPDATE [ofi_master_recipe] 
				SET already_used = 'Y'
					,last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE()
					,last_edit_at_local = GETDATE()
					,last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
				where  recipe_name = @recipe_name
			END

			if(@recipe_name <> (select isnull(spare1,'') from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no))
			BEGIN
				update job_bom 
				set spare1 = @recipe_name 
				where  wo_id =@wo_id 
					and oper_id =@oper_id 
					and bom_pos = 0 
					and seq_no  = @seq_no;
			END


			-- invalidating the applicable subsequent steps
			EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
			   @wo_id
			  ,@oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@step_name
			  ,@step_data = @recipe_name

			  
			IF(@invalidateSteps=1)
			BEGIN
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_invalidate_steps]  @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@ent_id,@item_id,@step_name=NULL
			END

			-- SET THE OUTPUT of this SP here 
			set @resultset =1; 
			set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
			select 	@resultset as resultset
					,@resultcode as resultcode

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN			
			-- SET THE OUTPUT of this SP here 
			SET @resultset =1; 
			set @resultcode='@@RecordsValidatedSuccessfully@@'
			select 	@resultset as result
					,@resultcode as resultcode
		END
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		
		-- SET THE OUTPUT of this SP here 	 (On error only)
		set @resultset =0; 
		set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
		select 	@resultset as result
				,@resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH

	BEGIN TRY				   

		SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.qty_per_parent_item)
		FROM @jobBomAudit t1
			FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		WHERE 	(t1.qty_per_parent_item <> t2.qty_per_parent_item) 
			OR (t1.min_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.min_qty_per_parent_item) 
			OR (t1.max_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.max_qty_per_parent_item)
			OR (t1.reqd_grade_cd <> t2.reqd_grade_cd)
			
		WHILE (@i < @modCnt)
		BEGIN			   

			SELECT @jobBomRow=t2.row_id
			 ,@item_id_a1=t2.item_id
			 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.qty_per_parent_item
			 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.min_qty_per_parent_item
			 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.max_qty_per_parent_item
			 ,@grade_cd= cast(t2.reqd_grade_cd as nvarchar(50))
			from @jobBomAudit t1
			FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
			where (t1.qty_per_parent_item <> t2.qty_per_parent_item) 
				OR (t1.min_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.min_qty_per_parent_item) 
				OR (t1.max_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.max_qty_per_parent_item)
				OR (t1.reqd_grade_cd <> t2.reqd_grade_cd)
			ORDER BY t2.row_id
			OFFSET @i ROWS   
			FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

			select @grade_cd= ig.item_grade_desc
			from item_grade ig with(nolock)
			where ig.item_grade_cd=@grade_cd

			Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
			Select @strCommentMsg = 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';
			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
									 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)),
									(@jobBomRow,'spare1',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name))
									,(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1))
									,(@jobBomRow,'reqd_grade_cd',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@grade_cd))
									,(@jobBomRow,'qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
									,(@jobBomRow,'min_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
									,(@jobBomRow,'max_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
									,@function_id = @strFunctionName
									,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
									,@keyField1 = @wo_id
									,@keyField2 = @oper_id
									,@keyField3 = @seq_no
									,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
									,@keyField5 = NULL
									,@user_id = @last_edit_by
									,@activity = @strActivityMsg
									,@audit_category = 'Info'
									,@comments = @strCommentMsg

			 SET @i = @i + 1;
		 
		END  -- for WHILE (@i < @modCnt)
		 
		-- added new record
		select @newCnt= count(t2.qty_per_parent_item)
		from @jobBomAudit t1
			FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @jobBomAudit t2 )
								
		WHILE (@j < @newCnt)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @jobBomRow=t2.row_id
				 ,@item_id_a1=t2.item_id
				 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.min_qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.max_qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@grade_cd= cast(t2.reqd_grade_cd as nvarchar(50))
			from @jobBomAudit t1
				FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
			where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
									from @jobBomAudit t2 )
			order by t2.row_id
			OFFSET @j ROWS   
			FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY


			Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
			Select @strCommentMsg ='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';;

			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	
			VALUES 
				(@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)),
				--(@jobBomRow,'wo_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@wo_id))
				--,(@jobBomRow,'oper_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@oper_id))
				--,(@jobBomRow,'seq_no',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no)),
				--	(@jobBomRow,'recipe_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name)),
				(@jobBomRow,'spare1',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name)),							
				(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1))							
				,(@jobBomRow,'reqd_grade_cd',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@grade_cd))
				,(@jobBomRow,'qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
				,(@jobBomRow,'min_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
				,(@jobBomRow,'max_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
									,@function_id = @strFunctionName
									,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
									,@keyField1 = @wo_id
									,@keyField2 = @oper_id
									,@keyField3 = @seq_no
									,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
									,@keyField5 = NULL
									,@user_id = @last_edit_by
									,@activity = @strActivityMsg
									,@audit_category = 'Info'
									,@comments = @strCommentMsg

			SET @j = @j + 1;
		END -- FOR: WHILE (@j < @newCnt)

		-- removed record
		select @delCnt=count(t1.qty_per_parent_item) 
		from @jobBomAudit t1
		FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @jobBomAudit1 t2 )
								
		WHILE (@k < @delCnt)
		BEGIN
		  

			SELECT   @jobBomRow=t1.row_id,
				  @item_id_a1=t1.item_id
				 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.min_qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.max_qty_per_parent_item
			from @jobBomAudit t1
				FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
			where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
									from @jobBomAudit1 t2 )
			order by t1.row_id
			OFFSET @k ROWS   
			FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

			Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
			Select @strCommentMsg =' Removed row_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)+' in '+@recipe_name+' for item: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1)+', '+' in wo: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@wo_id)+' in oper: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@oper_id)+' in seq: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no)+' _ '
			delete from @auditTrailParameters
			
			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
									 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow))
									,(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg ))
									
							   
												 
								   

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
									,@function_id = @strFunctionName
									,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
									--,@xmlDeletedRow = @xmlDeletedRow
									,@keyField1 = @wo_id
									,@keyField2 = @oper_id
									,@keyField3 = @seq_no
									,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
									,@keyField5 = NULL
									,@user_id = @last_edit_by
									,@activity = @strActivityMsg
									,@audit_category = 'Info'
									,@comments = @strCommentMsg

			

			SET @k = @k + 1;
		END -- FOR: WHILE (@k < @delCnt)

		-- records where only recipe is changed , check for recipe change 
		select @old_recipe_name=jb.spare1
		from job_bom jb with(nolock)
		where jb.bom_pos=0 and jb.item_id=@item_id


	END TRY 
	BEGIN CATCH
		set @resultset =0; 
		set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
		select	 @resultset as result
				,@resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH
END

CREATE   Trigger [tg_oper_step_file_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_file]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_oper_step_file_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_file table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_step_file_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN oper_step_file_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_file_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},oper_step_file', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_step_file_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_step_file_cursor
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios]
-- Description: This function will get the complete consumption BOM from WIP sublot (item_cons.row_id)
-- Usage:		WIP consumption report
-- SELECT * FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (15106,123,'NIBs','000012345678','0000123456780001',1.0,'10000001',1.0)
-- ===========================================================================================
-- 	Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00	J. Sukerman		2024-07-23			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE   FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] 
(	
     @cons_lot           	NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cons_sublot         	NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cur_pending_cons_qty  FLOAT
)
RETURNS 
@Output TABLE
(
	 total_wip_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
	,total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
	,total_wip_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
	,total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
	,wip_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT
	,final_cons_declaration BIT
	,cur_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT
	,total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
	,total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT  
)

AS
BEGIN


	-- Declare variables for STEP 2
	DECLARE @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@debug BIT = 0
			,@to_report_perc      FLOAT = 1  	-- Used for internal test
			,@to_reduce_cons	  FLOAT = 1   -- Used for internal test
			,@to_reduce_cons_erp  FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
			,@to_reduce_total_cons FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
			,@internal_precision  INT   = 7     -- Used for rounding of values to use in internal calculations
			,@reporting_precision INT   = 3     -- Used for rounding of values to use in reporting output

	-- STEP 2: Calculate how much WIP has been consumed on this sublot_no
	SELECT   @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty = CASE
												WHEN @debug = 1
													THEN SUM(ic.qty_cons)*@to_reduce_total_cons
													ELSE SUM(ISNULL(ic.qty_cons,0))
												END
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp = CASE
												WHEN @debug = 1
													THEN SUM(ic.qty_cons)-SUM(ic.qty_cons)*@to_reduce_cons_erp
													ELSE SUM(ISNULL(ic.qty_cons_erp,0))
												END
	FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE 	ic.lot_no = @cons_lot 
		AND ic.sublot_no = @cons_sublot

			
	-- Declare variables for STEP 3
	DECLARE  @total_wip_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT


	-- STEP 3: Calculate how much WIP has been produced for this sublot_no
	SELECT	@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty = SUM(qty_prod), 
			@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp = SUM(qty_prod_erp),
			@wip_cons_qty_ratio =	CASE 
										WHEN ROUND(@cur_pending_cons_qty/SUM(qty_prod),@internal_precision)>1 
											THEN 1 
										ELSE ROUND(@cur_pending_cons_qty/SUM(qty_prod),@internal_precision) 
										END
	FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE   ip.lot_no = @cons_lot 
		AND ip.sublot_no = @cons_sublot
		
	
	-- Declare variables for STEP 4
	DECLARE @final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	-- STEP 4: Verify if the amount left to report is the final consumption report to complete the WIP consumptions
	IF (ROUND(@cur_pending_cons_qty+@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp,@reporting_precision) = ROUND(@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty,@reporting_precision))
	BEGIN
		SET @final_cons_declaration = 1
	END
	
	-- Declare variables for STEP 5
	DECLARE  @cur_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
		
	-- STEP 5: Calculate how much RM(/SFG/FG) needs to be reported based on ratio/yield to report
	SELECT   @total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = SUM(ic.qty_cons)
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = SUM(ISNULL(ic.qty_cons_erp,0))
	FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE 	ic.fg_lot_no = @cons_lot 
		AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cons_sublot
		
	
	SET @cur_rm_cons_to_report = @total_rm_sublot_cons_qty*@wip_cons_qty_ratio
	
	INSERT INTO @Output
	SELECT 	 @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp 
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty 
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp 
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio 
			,@final_cons_declaration 
			,@cur_rm_cons_to_report 
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty 
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
	RETURN 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Folder]
(@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @ent_id  int  ,
 @ver_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @udf1  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @udf2  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @preferred_ver  bit,
 @design_hold bit ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 04/01/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Included field design_hold - Part of DB Changes V1.6.0
--03/08/2006	Raghu		3.1.11	HD# 7604, Sort folder versions depending upon system settings.
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE	 @justification		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@max_len_ver_id	INT32
	,@item_display		NVARCHAR(1)

	SELECT @justification = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 81
	--If revision justification is null, default to left justification, so that we don't need to do anything.
	SET @justification = ISNULL(@justification, '1')

	IF (@justification = '0') BEGIN --RIGHT justification
		SELECT @max_len_ver_id = MAX(LEN(ver_id)) FROM folder
	END
	SET @max_len_ver_id = ISNULL(@max_len_ver_id, 0)

	SELECT @item_display = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
	IF (@item_display IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@item_display) = 0) SET @item_display = '0'

/*SELECT folder.item_id
	    ,CASE WHEN @item_display = '0' THEN item.item_id
		  WHEN @item_display = '1' THEN item.item_desc
		  WHEN @item_display = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
		  WHEN @item_display = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
	   END item_display
            ,folder.oper_id
            ,folder.ent_id
            ,folder.ver_id
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,item.item_desc
            ,folder.oper_desc
            ,folder.notes
            ,folder.udf1
            ,folder.udf2
            ,folder.preferred_ver
            ,folder.design_hold
            ,folder.last_edit_comment
            ,folder.last_edit_by
            ,folder.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, folder.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM folder folder WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,ent ent WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,item item  WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((folder.item_id *= item.item_id)AND
       (folder.ent_id *= ent.ent_id)AND
       (folder.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.udf1 = @udf1 OR @udf1 IS NULL) AND
       (folder.udf2 = @udf2 OR @udf2 IS NULL) AND
       (folder.preferred_ver = @preferred_ver OR @preferred_ver IS NULL) AND
       (folder.design_hold = @design_hold OR @design_hold IS NULL) AND
       (folder.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (folder.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
--ORDER BY item.item_desc, folder.oper_desc, ent.ent_name, folder.ver_id
ORDER BY CASE  WHEN (@item_display = '0') THEN item.item_id
		WHEN (@item_display = '1') THEN item.item_desc
		WHEN (@item_display = '2') THEN item.item_id
		WHEN (@item_display = '3') THEN item.item_desc
		ELSE item.item_id
	END,
	CASE   WHEN (@item_display = '2') THEN item.item_desc
	       WHEN (@item_display = '3') THEN item.item_id
	END,
	folder.oper_desc, ent.ent_name,
	CASE WHEN (@justification = '1') THEN folder.ver_id
	ELSE REPLICATE(' ', @max_len_ver_id-LEN(ver_id)) + ver_id
	END
*/
SELECT folder.item_id
	    ,CASE WHEN @item_display = '0' THEN item.item_id
		  WHEN @item_display = '1' THEN item.item_desc
		  WHEN @item_display = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
		  WHEN @item_display = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
	   END item_display
            ,folder.oper_id
            ,folder.ent_id
            ,folder.ver_id
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,item.item_desc
            ,folder.oper_desc
            ,folder.notes
            ,folder.udf1
            ,folder.udf2
            ,folder.preferred_ver
            ,folder.design_hold
            ,folder.last_edit_comment
            ,folder.last_edit_by
            ,folder.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, folder.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM folder folder WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON folder.ent_id = ent.ent_id
  INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON folder.item_id = item.item_id
WHERE ((folder.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder.udf1 = @udf1 OR @udf1 IS NULL) AND
       (folder.udf2 = @udf2 OR @udf2 IS NULL) AND
       (folder.preferred_ver = @preferred_ver OR @preferred_ver IS NULL) AND
       (folder.design_hold = @design_hold OR @design_hold IS NULL) AND
       (folder.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (folder.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
--ORDER BY item.item_desc, folder.oper_desc, ent.ent_name, folder.ver_id
ORDER BY CASE  WHEN (@item_display = '0') THEN item.item_id
		WHEN (@item_display = '1') THEN item.item_desc
		WHEN (@item_display = '2') THEN item.item_id
		WHEN (@item_display = '3') THEN item.item_desc
		ELSE item.item_id
	END,
	CASE   WHEN (@item_display = '2') THEN item.item_desc
	       WHEN (@item_display = '3') THEN item.item_id
	END,
	folder.oper_desc, ent.ent_name,
	CASE WHEN (@justification = '1') THEN folder.ver_id
	ELSE REPLICATE(' ', @max_len_ver_id-LEN(ver_id)) + ver_id
	END
END

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 11-19-2002       Adam Ressler    when @ent_id is passed before deleting the check will be made to find
--                                                     record exists.  if record does't exists the error will be raised
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language ID changes
--02/08/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--07/31/2015              Neeraja                    5.2           sp_D_Ent_Logon is changed to pass the local time and the time zone bias value to sp_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
@error nvarchar(255),
@user_name nvarchar(50)
SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

--Added by Raghu. If logoff_time is passed, then close the laborevents for this user and entity with the logoff_time
IF @logoff_time IS NOT NULL  BEGIN
	-- SET @logoff_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logoff_time)
	EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents Null, @user_id, @ent_id, @logoff_time, @time_zone_bias_value
END

-- If ent_id is null then delete all rows for this user, else only the specified row
IF @ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
            DELETE ent_logon
            WHERE (session_id = @session_id AND
                   user_id = @user_id)
END
ELSE BEGIN
            IF exists (SELECT user_id FROM ent_logon WHERE(session_id = @session_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id))
                        DELETE ent_logon
                        WHERE (session_id = @session_id AND
                              ent_id = @ent_id AND
                              user_id = @user_id)
            ELSE BEGIN
                        SELECT @user_name = user_desc FROM user_name WHERE user_id = @user_id
                        SET @error = '' + @user_name + ' has already moved.  The user is no longer in the current entity.{2885}'
                        RAISERROR(@error, 16, 1)
            END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Line_Ent_Link_AddEntities]
(@line_id		INT32
,@line_entities_xml	NVARCHAR(MAX)
) AS
/*
Notes: The line_id must be supplied to identify the line

Example XML
'<line_entities>
	<ent ent_id="22" child_order="1" input_pct="0.6" line_is_child="0" segment_no="1" can_be_bottleneck="1" />
	<ent ent_id="41" child_order="0" input_pct="0.1" line_is_child="1" segment_no="1" can_be_bottleneck="1" />
	<ent ent_id="57" child_order="1" input_pct="0.9" line_is_child="0" segment_no="1" can_be_bottleneck="1" />
</line_entities>'

*/
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_I_Line_Ent_Link_AddEntities
-- Description		-
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 04/10/2013
-- Version			- 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
--06/17/2013	RaghuG		4.6	UserStory: 196762 - I need existing functionality to be retrofitted to detect a disabled entity on a line.
--08/14/2014	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 226242 - As Bruce, I want to indicate that a specific line position "IS" the bottleneck.
--08/29/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserSTory: 216159 - As Michelle, I want to be able to define shifts for lines
--11/12/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 259170 - Update shift information for the entities when the entities are added or removed from a line.
--06/02/2014	Rich		5.0	UserStory: 341543 - Update to prevent change in line if running work orders are queued or if work orders created
--													from a process are queued and not complete.  Also added code to fix up the work orders to
--													match the new line structure.
--06/09/2014	Rich		5.0	UserStory: 341543 - Updated to allow quantities information used to reassign work orders to the line to be gotten
--													for lines that do not have a production entity defined.
--06/20/2014	Rich		5.0 UserStory: 348580 - Updated to eliminate warning messages from being generated if a segment starts or ends a line
--													and to produce a more user friendly error message if segments are not properly configured
--06/20/2014	Rich		5.0	UserStory: 296332 - Updated to prevent entities that do not have a default production rate or allow for multiple
--													job execs from being added to a line.
--09/04/2014	Rich		5.0 UserStory: 390755 - Changed the error message returned for an invalid line configuration to include text indicating
--													that consecutive segments are not supported.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
-- Added to suppress a warning about null is aggregates which is being issued for no reason we can see
DECLARE	@doc_handle					INT32
		,@ent_id				INT32
		,@ent_name				STRING80
		,@last_edit_by				STRING80
		,@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@segment_no				INT32
		,@child_order				INT32
		,@col_position				INT32
		--Number of distinct segments within a child order
		,@segment_count				INT32
		,@max_ents_in_segment			INT32
		,@sum_of_ents_in_parallel_segments	INT32
		--Total number of distinct segments between two child order positions
		,@no_of_segments			INT32
		,@segment_begin_child_order		INT32
		,@segment_end_child_order		INT32
		,@first_child_order_no			INT32
		,@prod_ent_id				INT32
		,@bottleneck_ent_id			INT32
		,@wo_id						STRING40
		,@wo_desc					STRING80
		,@item_id					STRING40
		,@reqd_qty					TFLOAT
		,@start_qty					TFLOAT
		,@release_time_local		TDATETIME
		,@release_time_local_tz		INT32
		,@req_finish_time_local		TDATETIME
		,@req_finish_time_local_tz	INT32

DECLARE @line_ent_link		TABLE(child_order INT, segment_no INT, ent_id INT, input_pct FLOAT, line_is_child BIT, can_be_bottleneck bit, scale_input_pct bit)
DECLARE @initial_ents_in_line TABLE(ent_id INT)
DECLARE @QueuedWos			TABLE(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), reqd_qty float, start_qty FLOAT)

BEGIN

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'LineID:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @line_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id AND line_class = 1) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The entities cannot be added to the line class.{7635}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	-- If there are any running jobs, the line cannot be changed.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
				FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = job.wo_id
				WHERE job.state_cd = 3 AND wo.target_sched_line_id = @line_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The line cannot be modified because there is at least one work order running on the line.{7888}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- Get all the work orders for this line that are not already completed for use in later queries
	INSERT INTO @QueuedWos (wo_id, reqd_qty, start_qty)
		SELECT wo.wo_id,
			CASE WHEN wo_qtys.def_reqd_qty IS NOT NULL AND wo_qtys.def_reqd_qty < 0
				THEN 0
				ELSE wo_qtys.def_reqd_qty
				END AS reqd_qty,
			CASE WHEN (wo_qtys.qty_at_start - wo_qtys.qty_prod - wo_qtys.qty_rejected - COALESCE(wo_qtys2.qty_rejected, 0)) IS NOT NULL AND (wo_qtys.qty_at_start - wo_qtys.qty_prod - wo_qtys.qty_rejected - COALESCE(wo_qtys2.qty_rejected, 0)) < 0 THEN 0
				ELSE (wo_qtys.qty_at_start - wo_qtys.qty_prod - wo_qtys.qty_rejected - COALESCE(wo_qtys2.qty_rejected, 0))
				END AS start_qty
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		-- We need to get the required quantity remaining, start quantity, good production, and the rejected production
		-- at the production entities.  The sum of the start quantities
		-- from the jobs running at the production entity are reported as the required and start quantity of the
		-- work order.  The sum of the good production and the sum of the rejected quantity are used to calculate
		-- the remaining required quantity and remaining start quantity for the work order.  The remaining required
		-- quantity is the sum of the required quantity for the jobs at the production entities minus the sum of the
		-- good production at the production entities.  The sum of the rejected production for the jobs running at the
		-- production entities is used to calculate the remaining quantity as defined above.
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, SUM(j.qty_at_start) AS qty_at_start, COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_prod), 0) AS qty_prod
								, COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_rejected), 0) as qty_rejected, COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_reqd) - SUM(j.qty_prod), 0) AS def_reqd_qty
				  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				  INNER JOIN wo wo2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo2.wo_id
				  --Limit the lines (line_id's) that have work orders assigned to them, and the entities in the line on which the jobs ran.
				  --This join should return the list of lines and the corresponding entities identified as the source of production.
				  --If a job hasn't started on the entity (or entities identified as the source of production, then use target_sched_ent_id to determine the entities linked to a line to determine the quantities.
				  INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo2.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
				  INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			  			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
						FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
								AND ((l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id) OR
									 (l.prod_ent_id IS NULL AND lel.ent_id = (SELECT MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND
										child_order = (SELECT MAX(child_order) FROM line_ent_link WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND line_is_child = 0))))
						) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
							ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order = prod_ents.child_order
				  WHERE wo2.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
				  GROUP BY j.wo_id
				  --Limit the work orders to the set of work orders returned by the main query
				) wo_qtys ON wo.wo_id = wo_qtys.wo_id
		-- Get the total number of rejects from jobs that are still running.  To do this
		-- we need to sum up the rejectd from all jobs running on the production entities
		-- and all jobs running on any entity upstream from the production entities.
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_rejected), 0) AS qty_rejected
			  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			  INNER JOIN wo wo2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo2.wo_id
			  --Limit the lines (lin_id's) that have work orders assigned to them, and the entities in the line on which the jobs ran.
			  --This join should return the list of lines and the corresponding entities identified being prior to the source of production in the line.
			  --If a job hasn't started on the entity (or entities identified as the source of production, then use target_sched_ent_id to determine the entities linked to a line to determine the quantities.
			  INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo2.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
			  INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
					SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
					FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
							AND ((l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id) OR
								 (l.prod_ent_id IS NULL AND lel.ent_id = (SELECT MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND
									child_order = (SELECT MAX(child_order) FROM line_ent_link WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND line_is_child = 0))))
					) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
						ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order > prod_ents.child_order
			  WHERE wo2.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL AND j.state_cd <> 4
			  GROUP BY j.wo_id
			  --Limit the work orders to the set of work orders returned by the main query
			) wo_qtys2 ON wo.wo_id = wo_qtys2.wo_id
		WHERE target_sched_line_id = @line_id AND dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(wo.wo_id) <> 4

	-- If there are any work orders created from a process that have not been completed, the line cannot be changed.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
				FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM @QueuedWos)
					AND process_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The line cannot be modified because there is at least one work order created from a process queued to the line.{7889}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @line_entities_xml

	INSERT INTO @line_ent_link (ent_id, child_order, input_pct, line_is_child, segment_no, can_be_bottleneck)
	SELECT  line_ents.ent_id, line_ents.child_order, line_ents.input_pct, COALESCE(line_ents.line_is_child, 0)
	, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(line_ents.line_is_child, 0) = 1) THEN NULL ELSE line_ents.segment_no END
	, COALESCE(line_ents.can_be_bottleneck, 1)
	FROM   OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/line_entities/ent',2)
	WITH  (ent_id int   '@ent_id'
		,child_order  int '@child_order'
		,input_pct  float '@input_pct'
		,line_is_child  bit '@line_is_child'
		,segment_no  int '@segment_no'
		,can_be_bottleneck  bit '@can_be_bottleneck'
	      ) line_ents

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @line_ent_link lel WHERE lel.child_order IS NULL AND lel.line_is_child = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The %1  should not be null.{339},' + 'child_order'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @line_ent_link lel WHERE lel.ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The %1  should not be null.{339},' + 'ent_id'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @line_ent_link lel WHERE lel.line_is_child = 1) > 1) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'A line can at most have one parent entity assigned to it.{7635}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- Raise an error if any of the entities do not have the default production rate set or if any entities
	-- allow for multiple job execs.  Exclude the parent of the line from the check.
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM @line_ent_link lel
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = lel.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.ent_id = lel.ent_id
		WHERE lel.line_is_child = 0 AND oe.def_prod_rate IS NULL OR e.identical_job_execs > 1) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'Entities must have a default production rate set and may not allow for multiple jobs in order to be assigned to a line.<7903>'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

/*
	--Verify the supplied input percentages do not contain a negative value.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @line_ent_link lel WHERE lel.input_pct IS NOT NULL AND lel.input_pct < 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'An input percentage cannot have a negative value.{9999}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
*/

	CLOSE wo_for_line

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_History]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME
,@item_id		STRING40
,@job_end_utc		TDATETIME
,@spare1		STRING80
,@spare2		STRING80
,@spare3		STRING80
,@spare4		STRING80
,@last_edit_at 		DATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
,@row_id		INT32 =NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Job_History
-- Description				- Insert a row into the table
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @orig_job_end_utc	TDATETIME
	,@dummy_time		TDATETIME = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1901-01-01', 120)
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'JobHistory.Update'
BEGIN
	--Verify whether the job end time is being modified.
	SELECT @orig_job_end_utc = jh.job_end_utc
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND job_start_utc = @job_start_utc

	--Determine whether the job end time need to be validated
	IF @job_end_utc IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(@orig_job_end_utc, @dummy_time) <> @job_end_utc BEGIN
		--A job end time is supplied and that is different than what is recorded in the database
		EXEC sp_U_Job_History_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc
			, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, @job_start_utc = @job_start_utc

		--The last_edit_at may have changed because the end job sp would have updated time caused it to change the last_edit_at
		--Default to null
		SET @last_edit_at = NULL
	END

	UPDATE job_history
	SET item_id = @item_id
	   , job_end_utc = CASE WHEN @job_end_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE job_end_utc END
	   , job_end_local = CASE WHEN @job_end_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE job_end_local END
	   , spare1 = @spare1
	   , spare2 = @spare2
	   , spare3 = @spare3
	   , spare4 = @spare4
	   , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND job_start_utc = @job_start_utc
	  AND (last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
END

-- Name:    SP_S_EI_Item_Attr
-- Description:  Selects the item attributes
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-12      Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	MC			2025-10-08		Adding MaterialType attr
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_EI_MM_Attr] (@item_id NVARCHAR(40))
AS
  BEGIN
      SELECT TOP 1 1
      FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia1.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a1 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a1.attr_id = ia1.attr_id
                        AND a1.attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
                        AND a1.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a2 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a2.attr_id = ia2.attr_id
                        AND a2.attr_desc = 'Classification'
                        AND a2.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia3 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia3.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a3 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a3.attr_id = ia3.attr_id
                        AND a3.attr_desc = 'LanguageKey'
                        AND a3.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia4 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia4.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a4 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a4.attr_id = ia4.attr_id
                        AND a4.attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
                        AND a4.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia5 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia5.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a5 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a5.attr_id = ia5.attr_id
                        AND a5.attr_desc = 'ProductionSupervisor'
                        AND a5.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia6 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia6.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a6 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a6.attr_id = ia6.attr_id
                        AND a6.attr_desc = 'LegacyCode'
                        AND a6.attr_grp = 1
			INNER JOIN item_attr ia7 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia6.item_id = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a7 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a7.attr_id = ia7.attr_id
                        AND a7.attr_desc = 'MaterialType'
                        AND a7.attr_grp = 1
      WHERE  i.item_id = @item_id
  END

	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 10

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT sample_attr.sample_id
    ,sample_attr.attr_id
    ,sample_attr.attr_value
    ,sample_attr.notes
    ,attr.attr_desc
    ,attr.predefined
    ,attr.data_type
    ,attr.entry_type
    ,attr.visible_in_queue
    ,attr.visible_in_inv
    ,sample_attr.last_edit_comment
    ,sample_attr.last_edit_by
    ,sample_attr.last_edit_at
    FROM sample_attr sample_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((sample_attr.sample_id = @sample_id OR @sample_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (sample_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (sample_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (sample_attr.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
      )
ORDER BY sample_attr.sample_id, attr.attr_desc;
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:     	sp_S_ofi_AddJobMessageLog
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch Job and Stock transfer transaction information from Message Log Table 
--	
-- Usage:		Message Log Board 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP				2022-16-12			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Veervar Joshi   2024-01-02			Added @ent_id parameter to accomodate transfer messages logs.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_AddJobMessageLog] @wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@seq_no INT = NULL	
	,@ent_id INT = NULL -- V0.01.01
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--Maximum number of messages to display on screen is limited to 6.

	SELECT Top 6 * from
	(SELECT top 6 logged_at
		,[description]
		,(
			CASE 
				WHEN [type] = 'START'
					THEN 'on START Request'
				ELSE 'on STOP Request'
				END
			) AS [Type]
	FROM ofi_Job_Message_log WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE 
	 (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
		AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id is NULL)
		AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR ISNULL(@seq_no,0) =0)
		AND (ent_id= @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)-- V0.01.01		
		ORDER by logged_at desc) sub
		ORDER by sub.logged_at 
		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_CopyShifts]
(
 		@session_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@source_ent_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@dest_ent_list			STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_id_list			STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Ent_CopyShifts
-- Description			- See Middleware DFS, Sidus 2 Broadway
-- Author				- AML
-- Date Created			- 07/15/2008
-- Version				- 3.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
--09/03/2008		Raghu			3.5		Nimish mail dated09/03/2008; authorized by Steve W; the break times are not correctly carried over.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @temp_dest_ent 		INT32
		,	@result				INT32
		,	@err				varchar(200)
		,	@temp_shift_pair	varchar(10)
		,	@temp_start_day		INT32
		,	@temp_shift_id		INT32
		,	@last_edit_at		TDATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()

	IF ( @source_ent_id IS NULL ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'The ID for the entity from which shifts are being copied was not passed to the method.{5784}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN
	END

	IF ( @dest_ent_list IS NULL ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A destination entity ID must be provided in order to copy shifts.{5785}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @dest_ents TABLE ( id int identity, ent_id int )

	WHILE LEN( @dest_ent_list ) > 0 BEGIN
		SET @result = CHARINDEX( ',', @dest_ent_list )

		IF ( @result > 0 ) BEGIN
			SET @temp_dest_ent = CONVERT( INT, SUBSTRING( @dest_ent_list, 1, (@result - 1) ) )
			SET @dest_ent_list = SUBSTRING( @dest_ent_list, (@result + 1), LEN( @dest_ent_list ) )
		END ELSE BEGIN
			SET @temp_dest_ent = CONVERT( INT, @dest_ent_list )
			SET @dest_ent_list = ''
		END

		INSERT INTO @dest_ents ( ent_id ) VALUES ( @temp_dest_ent )
	END

	IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @dest_ents de INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON de.ent_id = ent.ent_id WHERE ent.can_sched_shifts = 0 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'One or more destination entities cannot schedule shifts.{5789}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	DECLARE @shifts_to_copy TABLE ( id int identity, ent_id int, start_day int, shift_id int )

	IF ( @shift_id_list IS NOT NULL ) AND ( @shift_id_list <> '' ) BEGIN

		WHILE LEN( @shift_id_list ) > 0 BEGIN
			SET @result = CHARINDEX( ',', @shift_id_list )

			IF ( @result > 0 ) BEGIN
				SET @temp_shift_pair = SUBSTRING( @shift_id_list, 1, (@result - 1) )
				SET @shift_id_list = SUBSTRING( @shift_id_list, (@result + 1), LEN( @shift_id_list ) )
			END ELSE BEGIN
				SET @temp_shift_pair = @shift_id_list
				SET @shift_id_list = ''
			END

			IF ( LEFT( @temp_shift_pair, 1 ) = ':' ) BEGIN

				SET @temp_shift_id = CONVERT( INT, RIGHT( @temp_shift_pair, 1 ) )

				IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id AND ss.shift_id = @temp_shift_id ) BEGIN
					SET @err = 'Shift ID %1 does not exist on the source entity.{5787}, ' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @temp_shift_id )
					RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1 )
					RETURN -1
				END

				INSERT INTO @shifts_to_copy ( ent_id, start_day, shift_id )
				SELECT DISTINCT de.ent_id AS ent_id, ss.start_day AS start_day, @temp_shift_id AS shift_id
				FROM @dest_ents de, shift_sched ss
				WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id

			END ELSE IF ( RIGHT( @temp_shift_pair, 1 ) = ':' ) BEGIN

				SET @temp_start_day = CONVERT( INT, LEFT( @temp_shift_pair, 1 ) )

				IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id AND ss.start_day = @temp_start_day ) BEGIN
					SET @err = 'Start day %1 does not exist on the source entity.{5788}, ' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @temp_start_day )
					RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1 )
					RETURN -1
				END

				INSERT INTO @shifts_to_copy ( ent_id, start_day, shift_id )
				SELECT DISTINCT de.ent_id AS ent_id, @temp_start_day AS start_day, ss.shift_id AS shift_id
				FROM @dest_ents de, shift_sched ss
				WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id

			END ELSE BEGIN

				SET @temp_start_day = CONVERT( INT, LEFT( @temp_shift_pair, 1 ) )
				SET @temp_shift_id = CONVERT( INT, RIGHT( @temp_shift_pair, 1 ) )

				IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id AND ss.shift_id = @temp_shift_id AND ss.start_day = @temp_start_day ) BEGIN
					SET @err = 'Shift ID %1 does not exist on the source entity.{5787}, ' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @temp_shift_id )
					RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1 )
					RETURN -1
				END

				INSERT INTO @shifts_to_copy ( ent_id, start_day, shift_id )
				SELECT DISTINCT de.ent_id AS ent_id, @temp_start_day AS start_day, @temp_shift_id AS shift_id
				FROM @dest_ents de

			END

		END

	END ELSE BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @shifts_to_copy ( ent_id, start_day, shift_id )
		SELECT DISTINCT de.ent_id AS ent_id, ss.start_day AS start_day, ss.shift_id AS shift_id
		FROM @dest_ents de, shift_sched ss
		WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id

	END

	DELETE FROM shift_sched WHERE ent_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT de.ent_id FROM @dest_ents de )


	DECLARE @counter AS INT32
		,	@max_id AS INT32
		,	@temp_ent AS INT32
		,	@temp_start_time AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_end_time AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_break1_start AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_break1_end AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_break2_start AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_break2_end AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_break3_start AS TDATETIME
		,	@temp_break3_end AS TDATETIME


	SELECT @counter = 1, @max_id = MAX( stc.id ) FROM @shifts_to_copy stc

	WHILE (@counter <= @max_id) BEGIN

		SELECT @temp_ent = stc.ent_id, @temp_start_day = stc.start_day, @temp_shift_id = stc.shift_id
		FROM @shifts_to_copy stc
		WHERE stc.id = @counter

		SELECT 	@temp_start_time = ss.start_time
			,	@temp_end_time = ss.end_time
			,	@temp_break1_start = ss.break1_start
			,	@temp_break1_end = ss.break1_end
			,	@temp_break2_start = ss.break2_start
			,	@temp_break2_end = ss.break2_end
			,	@temp_break3_start = ss.break3_start
			,	@temp_break3_end = ss.break3_end
		FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ss.ent_id = @source_ent_id AND
			  ss.start_day = @temp_start_day AND
			  ss.shift_id = @temp_shift_id


		EXEC sp_I_Shift_Sched 	@temp_ent, @temp_start_day, @temp_shift_id, @temp_start_time, @temp_end_time,
								@temp_break1_start, @temp_break1_end, @temp_break2_start, @temp_break2_end,
								@temp_break3_start, @temp_break3_end, '', @time_zone_bias_value, @last_edit_at OUTPUT


		SET @counter = (@counter + 1)

	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Step]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @step_no  int  ,
 @step_name nvarchar(40),
 @step_seq  int  ,
 @action_type  int  ,
 @complete_cond  int  ,
 @enter_data  bit  ,
 @step_grp_id  int  ,
 @spc_char  nvarchar(40),
 @data_log_grp_id int ,
 @control_type int,
 @spare1  nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(80),
 @spare5  nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare6  nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified		Modified_By	Changes
-- 12/18/2002	  	Vijay		HD  646 - Added to sort by step_seq
-- 2/12/2002		Chandresh	Added job_step_grp table in the SELECT, FROM and WHERE clause
-- 04/01/2003		Raghu		Included Script_Name field - Part of DB Changes V1.6.0
-- 01/15/2004	  	Raghu		Added "can_log_data" in SELECT clause
--09/21/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--04/20/2007    Raghu       3.2.9   Per BradJ's email: Modified code to return serial_no_lvl in the select clause.
--04/24/2007    Raghu       3.2.9   Per BradJ's email: Would it be difficult to add a new column, executions, to
--									Job_Step.GetAll?  The number of executions is the number of completed (step state 4)
--                                  Job_Step_Data records for the wo_id, oper_id, seq_no and step_no.
--                                  This would only apply to Job_Step records which are repeatable
--10/31/2007		AML		3.4.0	DB Changes
--12/19/2007		AML     3.4.0   Return row_id in the select clause to set the row_id in data_entry_sched (Periodic Data Collection).
-- 01/30/2008		AML		3.4.0	Added certify and collect_data columns to select along with left outer join to job_step_data.
-- 01/30/2008		AML		3.4.0	Commented out the previous change.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @js_wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@js_oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@js_seq_no		INT
		,	@js_step_no		INT
		,	@can_log_data	INT
		,	@cur_job		NVARCHAR(254)
		,	@last_job		NVARCHAR(254)

	DECLARE @js_data_log TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INT, step_no INT, can_log_data INT)

	DECLARE js_can_log_data CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no FROM job_step WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	     AND  (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	     AND  (seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	     AND  (step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
	ORDER BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no

	SET @cur_job = ' '
	SET @last_job = ' '
	OPEN js_can_log_data
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM js_can_log_data INTO @js_wo_id, @js_oper_id, @js_seq_no, @js_step_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @cur_job = @js_wo_id + ' ' + @js_oper_id + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@js_seq_no)))
		IF (@cur_job <> @last_job) BEGIN
			SET @last_job = @cur_job
			EXEC sp_SA_Job_Can_Log_Data @js_wo_id, @js_oper_id, @js_seq_no, @can_log_data OUTPUT
		END
		INSERT INTO @js_data_log (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, can_log_data)
		VALUES (@js_wo_id, @js_oper_id, @js_seq_no, @js_step_no, @can_log_data)
	END
	CLOSE js_can_log_data
	DEALLOCATE js_can_log_data

	SELECT job_step.wo_id
		,  job_step.oper_id
		,  job_step.seq_no
		,  job_step.step_no
		,  job_step.step_seq
		,  job_step.step_name
		,  job_step.step_desc
		,  job_step.action_type
		,  job_step.std_time
		,  job_step.complete_cond
		,  job_step.allow_bypass
		,  job_step.enter_data
		,  job_step.step_grp_id
		,  job_step.spc_char
		,  job_step.form_name
		,  job_step.reqd_rep
		,  job_step.control_type
		,  job_step.high_limit
		,  job_step.low_limit
		,  job_step.limit_warning
		,  job_step.spare1
		,  job_step.spare2
		,  job_step.spare3
		,  job_step.spare4
		,  job_step.spare5
		,  job_step.spare6
		,  JSG.step_grp_desc
		,  JSG.step_grp_seq
		,  JSG.repeatability
		,  js_data_log.can_log_data
		,  i.serial_no_lvl
		, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_step_data jsd
			WHERE jsd.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = job_step.seq_no
			  AND jsd.step_no = job_step.step_no AND jsd.state_cd = 4 AND jsg.repeatability = 1) AS executions
		,	job_step.last_edit_comment
		,	job_step.last_edit_by
		,	job_step.last_edit_at
		,	JSG.last_edit_comment step_grp_last_edit_comment
		,	JSG.last_edit_by step_grp_last_edit_by
		,	JSG.last_edit_at step_grp_last_edit_at
		,	job_step.row_id
--		,	dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisStep(job_step.row_id, JSD.row_id, JSD.state_cd) AS collect_data
--		,	dbo.fn_DL_IsCertReqdForThisStep(JSD.wo_id, JSD.oper_id, JSD.seq_no, JSD.step_no, JSD.lot_no, JSD.sublot_no, JSD.state_cd) AS certify
		,	(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_log_grp_job_step_link jsl WHERE jsl.wo_id = job_step.wo_id
				AND jsl.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND jsl.seq_no = job_step.seq_no
				AND jsl.step_no = job_step.step_no) AS data_log_groups
	FROM job_step WITH (NOLOCK)
--		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step_data JSD WITH (NOLOCK) ON
--			job_step.wo_id = JSD.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = JSD.oper_id AND job_step.seq_no = JSD.seq_no AND job_step.step_no = JSD.step_no
		INNER JOIN job_step_grp JSG WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			job_step.wo_id = JSG.wo_id AND
			job_step.oper_id = JSG.oper_id AND
			job_step.seq_no = JSG.seq_no AND
			job_step.step_grp_id = JSG.step_grp_id
		INNER JOIN @js_data_log js_data_log ON
			job_step.wo_id = js_data_log.wo_id AND
			job_step.oper_id = js_data_log.oper_id AND
			job_step.seq_no = js_data_log.seq_no AND
			job_step.step_no = js_data_log.step_no
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			JSG.wo_id = j.wo_id AND
			JSG.oper_id = j.oper_id AND
			JSG.seq_no = j.seq_no
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE
		((job_step.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.step_name = @step_name OR @step_name IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.step_seq = @step_seq OR @step_seq IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.action_type = @action_type OR @action_type IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.complete_cond = @complete_cond OR @complete_cond IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.enter_data = ABS(@enter_data) OR @enter_data IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.step_grp_id = @step_grp_id OR @step_grp_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spc_char = @spc_char OR @spc_char IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.data_log_grp_id = @data_log_grp_id OR @data_log_grp_id IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.control_type = @control_type OR @control_type IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spare5 = @spare5 OR @spare5 IS NULL) AND
		(job_step.spare6 = @spare6 OR @spare6 IS NULL) AND
	    (job_step.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	    (job_step.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY JSG.step_grp_seq , job_step.step_seq , job_step.step_no
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_step_file_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_file]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_step_file_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_file table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE oper_step_file_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM oper_step_file a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		     AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		    AND a.step_no = b.step_no
		   AND a.assoc_file = b.assoc_file
	OPEN oper_step_file_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_file_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_step_file', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_step_file_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_step_file_cursor
END
