CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Session_KillStaleSessions]
(@cutoff_time TDATETIME
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright © 2024 AVEVA Group Limited and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  	Modified_By     Changes
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 09/05/2008    	AML             3.5		 	L00075948, L00076913: Added code to pause jobs that can't run without an 
--												operator if nobody is logged into an ent.
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 06/21/2024	Abhay Pandey		6.2			HF : IMS_3381278 : Changed the data type of table variable (i.e. @temp_jobs) from NOTES to NOTES_NULL.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	-- This must cascade delete to relevant rows in ent_logon
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF @cutoff_time IS NOT NULL SET @cutoff_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @cutoff_time)
	

	--DELETE sessn WHERE last_heartbeat < @cutoff_time
	DECLARE @temp_stale_sessions TABLE ( 
		id int identity, 
		session_id int 
		)
		
	INSERT INTO @temp_stale_sessions ( session_id )
	SELECT session_id 
	FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE sessn.last_heartbeat < @cutoff_time
	
	DECLARE @temp_ents TABLE ( id int identity, ent_id int, session_id int )
	
	INSERT INTO @temp_ents ( ent_id, session_id )
	SELECT ent_id, session_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE ent_logon.session_id in ( SELECT tss.session_id FROM @temp_stale_sessions tss )
	
	DECLARE @temp_jobs TABLE ( 
		id int identity, 
		wo_id nvarchar(40), 
		oper_id nvarchar(40), 
		seq_no int, 
		job_pos int, 
		notes NOTES_NULL
	)
	
	DECLARE	@cur_session INT32
		,	@session_count INT32
		,	@max_id_session INT32
		, 	@ent_count INT32
		, 	@cur_ent INT32
		, 	@max_id_ent INT32
		, 	@job_count INT32
		, 	@cur_wo_id STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no INT32
		,	@cur_job_pos INT32
		,	@cur_notes nvarchar(MAX)
		, 	@max_id_job INT32	
		
	SELECT @ent_count = min( id ), @max_id_ent = max( id ) FROM @temp_ents
	
	WHILE ( @ent_count <= @max_id_ent ) BEGIN
	
		SELECT @cur_ent = te.ent_id, @cur_session = te.session_id 
		FROM @temp_ents te 
		WHERE @ent_count = te.id
	
		IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_logon.ent_id = @cur_ent AND ent_logon.session_id <> @cur_session ) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @temp_jobs ( wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_pos, notes )
			SELECT job.wo_id, job.oper_id, job.seq_no, job_exec.job_pos, job.notes
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					job.wo_id = job_exec.cur_wo_id AND
					job.oper_id = job_exec.cur_oper_id AND
					job.seq_no = job_exec.cur_seq_no
			WHERE job_exec.ent_id = @cur_ent AND job_exec.run_without_operator = 0
			ORDER BY job.wo_id, job.oper_id, job.seq_no, job_exec.job_pos
			
			SELECT @job_count = MIN( id ), @max_id_job = MAX( id ) FROM @temp_jobs
			
			WHILE ( @job_count <= @max_id_job ) BEGIN
			
				SELECT 	@cur_wo_id = tj.wo_id, @cur_oper_id = tj.oper_id, @cur_seq_no = tj.seq_no
					, 	@cur_job_pos = tj.job_pos, @cur_notes = tj.notes
				FROM @temp_jobs tj
				WHERE tj.id = @job_count

				EXEC sp_u_job_exec_pausejob 	@ent_id = @cur_ent,
												@wo_id = @cur_wo_id,
												@oper_id = @cur_oper_id,
												@seq_no = @cur_seq_no,
												@paused_job_state = 5,
												@job_pos = @cur_job_pos,
												@status_notes = @cur_notes,
												@job_end_utc = NULL,
												@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
												
				SET @job_count = ( @job_count + 1 )												
				
			END
		END
		
		DELETE FROM @temp_jobs
		SET @ent_count = ( @ent_count + 1 )
	END
		
	SELECT @session_count = MIN( tss.id ), @max_id_session = MAX( tss.id ) FROM @temp_stale_sessions tss
	WHILE ( @session_count <= @max_id_session ) BEGIN
	
		SELECT @cur_session = tss.session_id 
		FROM @temp_stale_sessions tss
		WHERE tss.id = @session_count 
		
		EXEC sp_D_Session @cur_session
		
		SET @session_count = ( @session_count + 1 )
		
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_jsc_addorupdatechoicesxml]
(
	@xml_source              NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value    INT32_NULL = NULL

)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_U_JSC_ADDORUPDATECHOICESXML
-- Description          - Add or Update choices
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 12/01/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver        Changes
--01/11/2008	Raghu		3.4	73760; AddOrUpdateChoices does not work.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @doc_handle			INT32,
			@wo_id				STRING40,
			@oper_id			STRING40,
			@seq_no             INT32,
			@step_no            INT32,
			@choice_no          INT32,
			@choice_label       STRING80,
			@row_count          INT32,
			@last_edit_at       TDATETIME,
			@row_id             INT32,
			@delete_all         LOGICAL

    --Convert the input xml to XML Type.
    EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml, and read the target_process_id, target_oper_id and target_step_no
	SELECT	@wo_id = CASE WHEN wo_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE wo_id END
		,	@oper_id = CASE WHEN oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE oper_id END
		,	@seq_no = CASE WHEN seq_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE seq_no END
		,	@step_no = CASE WHEN step_no = '' THEN 0 ELSE step_no END
		,	@delete_all = CASE WHEN delete_all = '' THEN NULL ELSE delete_all END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (	wo_id NVARCHAR(160),
			oper_id NVARCHAR(160),
			seq_no NVARCHAR(160),
			step_no NVARCHAR(160),
			delete_all NVARCHAR(160)	)

    IF (@delete_all = 1)
        DELETE FROM job_step_choice
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
          AND oper_id = @oper_id
          AND seq_no = @seq_no
          AND step_no = @step_no

	--Get a list of nodes that contains the 'choice' element.
	DECLARE choice_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN choice_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE choice_no END AS choice_no
		,	CASE WHEN choice_label = '' THEN NULL ELSE choice_label END AS choice_label
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/choice', 2)
	WITH (choice_no  NVARCHAR(160), choice_label NVARCHAR(160))

    --Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
	OPEN choice_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM choice_cursor INTO @choice_no, @choice_label

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_step_choice WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
			AND step_no = @step_no
			AND choice_no = @choice_no) BEGIN
			IF (@choice_label IS NULL)
		            DELETE FROM job_step_choice
		            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		              AND oper_id = @oper_id
		              AND seq_no = @seq_no
		              AND step_no = @step_no
		              AND choice_no = @choice_no
			ELSE
		            UPDATE job_step_choice
		            SET choice_label = @choice_label
		            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		              AND oper_id = @oper_id
		              AND seq_no = @seq_no
		              AND step_no = @step_no
		              AND choice_no = @choice_no
		END
		ELSE
			EXEC sp_i_job_step_choice @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @choice_no, @choice_label, NULL,
				@last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id OUTPUT
	END
	CLOSE choice_cursor
	DEALLOCATE choice_cursor

	--Destroy the instance.
	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_AddprodWF_data]
-- Description:This will be used in Add production workflow during trigger form DCS


-- Usage:	This will be used in MDMAddProductionJobWorkflow for the below conditions
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-03-09		Intial Version
-- 0.01.01	 MP            	  2023-05-02		Incase Cons & Prod item is same so taking top-1 record (ex:Filtering)
-- 0.02.00	 MP            	  2023-05-02		Adding the condition if Max storage capacity is not set for the Silo & Check the status

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_AddprodWF_data] 
 @ent_id	INT
,@wo_id		nvarchar(40)
,@oper_id	nvarchar(40)
,@seq_no	INT
,@item_id   nvarchar(40)=NULL
,@su_ent_id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE	
		 @wo_status INT
		,@state_cd	INT
		,@job_pos	INT 
		,@bom_pos	INT
		,@def_lot_no nvarchar(40)
		,@def_reas_cd INT
		,@factor	FLOAT
		,@result	INT
		,@to_item_id nvarchar(40)
		,@lot_no nvarchar(40)
		,@sublot_no nvarchar(40)	
		,@to_qty FLOAT
		,@edit_time datetime
		,@max_capacity FLOAT
		,@su_result INT
		,@su_status nvarchar(40)
		

--Get Current wo_state
SELECT @wo_status=state_cd FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

--Get Current job_state
SELECT @state_cd=state_cd,@edit_time=edit_time FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

--Get Current job_pos
SELECT @job_pos=job_pos FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, -1)

--Get Current Storage unit status V.0.02.00
SELECT @max_capacity=max_capacity
						FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE ent_id = @su_ent_id

IF (@max_capacity = 0)
	BEGIN
	SET @su_result=1
	END
  ELSE
	BEGIN
	SET @su_result=0
	END
--Check the SU have 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
SELECT TOP 1 @su_status=attr_desc 
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
			inner join attr a WITH (NOLOCK) 
			ON ea.attr_id=a.attr_id 
			WHERE ent_id=@su_ent_id 
			AND attr_desc in ('LockForOutput','BlockForQuality','LockForInput') 
			AND attr_value='1'

--Get Lot number and bom_pos for normal production and item_id for bag Prodution
IF (@item_id is null or @item_id ='0')
		BEGIN
		SELECT @def_lot_no=def_lot_no, @bom_pos=bom_pos,@item_id=item_id, @def_reas_cd=def_reas_cd FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos=0
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT top 1 @def_lot_no=def_lot_no, @bom_pos=bom_pos, @def_reas_cd=def_reas_cd FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no and item_id=@item_id
		END

--Get UOM factor 
Declare @UOM_factor table(
factor float)
insert @UOM_factor
Execute sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT @item_id,@ent_id,'PROD' 

select @factor=factor from @UOM_factor

--Get item_inv for threshold
Declare @item_inv_threshold table(
result int,
item_id nvarchar(30),
to_item_id nvarchar(30),
lot_no nvarchar(30),
sublot_no nvarchar(30),
to_qty float
)
insert @item_inv_threshold
Execute sp_S_ofi_iteminv_AUT @item_id,@su_ent_id

SELECT @result=result,@item_id=item_id,@to_item_id=to_item_id,@lot_no=lot_no,@sublot_no=sublot_no,@to_qty=to_qty from @item_inv_threshold

--Select The required data here
SELECT @wo_status AS wo_status,@state_cd AS state_cd, @edit_time AS edit_time, @job_pos AS job_pos,@bom_pos AS bom_pos, @def_lot_no AS def_lot_no, @def_reas_cd AS def_reas_cd, @factor AS factor, 
		@result AS thr_result,@item_id AS item_id,@to_item_id AS to_item_id,@lot_no AS lot_no,@sublot_no AS sublot_no,@to_qty AS to_qty,@su_result AS su_result,@su_status AS su_status
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon]
(@session_id  		INT32
,@user_id   		STRING40
,@ent_id   		INT32
,@cur_lab_cd   		STRING40_NULL	= NULL
,@cur_lab_dept_id 	STRING40_NULL	= NULL
,@pct_lab_to_apply  	TFLOAT_NULL	= NULL
,@logon_time		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 10/26/2002	TC		1.5.0	Assume job_pos=0 when getting wo data for logged on entity
-- 12/03/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Added condition to check wo_id	is not null along with 'IDLE'
-- 01/21/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	FC Labor Tags Included
-- 02/14/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 1499).  IF allow multiple operators is set to a valid numeric value, then only those many users are allowed to login into that entity
-- 03/27/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	Included NO LOCK hint in FC Tags Update statement
-- 03/28/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	Included a check for FC tags whether a node exist for that entity
-- 03/31/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	Ent Logon After insert trigger is removed.  Accounting the labor is done in sp_I_Ent_Logon_Account_Labor to improve performance
-- 06-06-2003   Sheetal Jain     1600  Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
--12/05/2003	Raghu		2.0.14	(HD# 4156) Changes included to handle Multi-Job Execs
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--03/20/2007    Raghu       3.2.0.3 Call changed from  'SP_I_ENT_LOGON_ACCOUNT_LABOR' to SP_I_ENT_LOGON_APPLYLABOR
--04/04/2007    Raghu       3.2.0.6 HD# 9288, Logon a user to a job.
--05/09/2007    Raghu       3.2.11  Per KRF,BN email dated 05/08/2007; Loging an entity should automatically create a labor_usage record
--                                  			even though the user uses job-based login.
--01/07/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073446; Error when a job is attempted to start from FactOperator
--08/13/2012    Saiteja		4.1 L00122083 Passed variables @wo_id,@Oper_id,@seq_no to Sp_I_Ent_Logon_ApplyLabor.
--10/29/2012    Saiteja		4.6 L00122327 Passed variables @wo_id,@Oper_id,@seq_no to Sp_I_Ent_Logon_ApplyLabor.
--07/28/2015     Neeraja	5.2	 L00137568 (Merged from HF-L00137241): ent_logon.start_time,  labor_usage.labor_start_utc,labor_usage.labor_start_local and duration
--											are saved incorrectly. The @logon_time was getting converted twice [In the beginning of the sp and again below].
--											Removed the line which was responsible for converting the time in the beginning of the SP.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604492-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @cur_active_user 		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@user_name_lab_cd		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@user_name_dept_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@wo_id				NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no			INT
	,@process_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@item_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@allow_lt_cenpercent		INT
	,@return			INT
	,@desc				NVARCHAR(80)
  	,@user_count			INT
	,@allow_multi_ops		INT
	,@log_id			INT
	,@no_running_jobs		INT
	,@job_pos			INT
	,@counter			INT
	,@job_based_login		INT

	--Adjust logon_time if supplied.
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)


	-- Verify the supplied user has privilages to logon the entity
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM (SELECT grp_ent_link.ent_id,(MAX(CAST(grp_ent_link.accss AS INT))) access
					FROM grp_ent_link grp_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_ent_link.ent_id = ent.ent_id
					WHERE (grp_ent_link.grp_id IN (SELECT grp_id FROM user_grp_link WHERE user_id = @user_id))
					  AND (ent.can_run_jobs = 1 OR ent.can_capture_util = 1 OR ent.can_capture_labor = 1 OR ent.can_do_dnc = 1 OR ent.can_store = 1 OR ent.can_log_data = 1)
					GROUP BY grp_ent_link.ent_id, ent.ent_name, ent.can_run_jobs, ent.can_capture_util, ent.can_capture_labor, ent.can_do_dnc, ent.can_store, ent.can_log_data, ent.parent_ent_id
					) ent_access WHERE (ent_access.access = 1 AND ent_id = @ent_id))
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('You do not have access to login on this entity. {5310}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1;
	END

	SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)

	IF (@no_running_jobs >= 1) BEGIN
		SET @counter = 1
		SET @job_pos = -1
		WHILE (@counter <= @no_running_jobs) BEGIN
			SELECT @job_pos = job_pos, @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
			FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			 AND job_pos = (SELECT MIN(job_pos) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
					  AND job_pos > @job_pos)

			SELECT @process_id = process_id, @item_id = item_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

			--Call Start Allowed to check whether is entity is allowed to start the job
			EXEC @return = SP_U_JOB_EXEC_CERTSTARTALLOWED @user_id=@user_id, @process_id=@process_id,
				@oper_id=@oper_id, @step_no=NULL, @item_id=@item_id,
				@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			SET @counter = @counter + 1
		END
	END

	SET @pct_lab_to_apply = COALESCE(@pct_lab_to_apply, 1)

	--Verify whether this user is part of a job based login group.
	SELECT @job_based_login = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
	FROM grp_priv_link gpl
	INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
	WHERE gpl.priv_id = 92 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

	EXEC SP_I_ENT_LOGON_APPLYLABOR @in_session_id=@session_id, @in_ent_id=@ent_id,
		@in_user_id=@user_id, @in_start_time=@logon_time,
		@in_job_based_login=@job_based_login, @in_wo_id=@wo_id, @in_oper_id=@oper_id, @in_seq_no=@seq_no, --Passed @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no for CR L00122083.
		@in_skip_to_verify_exist_pct=0,
		@in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value,
		@def_lab_cd=@cur_lab_cd OUTPUT,  @def_dept_id=@cur_lab_dept_id OUTPUT,
		@pct_to_apply=@pct_lab_to_apply OUTPUT, @lab_usage_log_id=@log_id OUTPUT

	IF (@logon_time IS NULL)
		IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @logon_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @logon_time = GETUTCDATE()
	ELSE SET @logon_time =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logon_time)

	INSERT INTO ent_logon (session_id, ent_id, user_id, start_time, cur_lab_cd, pct_lab_to_apply,
		cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_usage_log_id)
	VALUES  (@session_id, @ent_id, @user_id, @logon_time, @cur_lab_cd, @pct_lab_to_apply,
		@cur_lab_dept_id, @log_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftsToGo]
(@in_ent_id			INT32
,@in_start_date_time		TDATETIME
,@in_start_date_time_tz		INT32 = NULL
,@in_end_date_time			TDATETIME
,@in_end_date_time_tz		INT32 = NULL
,@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftToGo
-- Description		- Refresh the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 08/23/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 03/17/17         Srinivasa   6.0     US#803703- Merge L00145120 (HF CR L00144586): Added check for first day of week and modified the day offset accordingly
--                                      for those languages which have a day of week start of Monday.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	 @time_zone_bias_value	INT32
	,@current_time		TDATETIME
	--Represents the time in terms of 'hh:mm:ss'
	,@current_time_time	TDATETIME
	--Identifies the filter criteria to select the corresponding days.
	,@first_start_day	INT32
	,@first_end_day		INT32
	,@second_start_day	INT32
	,@second_end_day	INT32
	--No. of days to look on the shift schedule. And, the same schedules can be replicated for all other weeks.
	,@no_of_days_reqd	INT32
	--Represents the day ends after adding the no. of days required to the starting day.
	,@end_day		INT32
	--Represents the start time of the shift schedule.
	,@start_date_time	TDATETIME
	,@curr_cntr_date_time	TDATETIME
	,@end_date		TDATETIME
	,@dbg_resp		INT32

	-- Set @firstdayOffset according to the start day of the week (1 or 7) for current SQL Server language
 	DECLARE @firstdayOffset INT

BEGIN

	-- this is typically called with NULL TZ offsets, but with local dates
	-- time_zone_bias_value is usually 0
	-- so, make them match
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset NULL, @in_start_date_time, @in_start_date_time_tz OUTPUT
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset NULL, @in_end_date_time, @in_end_date_time_tz OUTPUT
	SET @time_zone_bias_value		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftsToGo_t', @src_key='sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftsToGo_t',
					@date_val1 = @in_start_date_time, @numeric_val1 = @in_start_date_time_tz,
					@date_val2 = @in_end_date_time, @numeric_val2 = @in_end_date_time_tz
	if (@dbg_resp=1)
		return

	--Get the current time based on the bias value
	EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @server_time=@current_time OUTPUT

	--Default the start time to the current time, if the supplied start time is null.
	SELECT @start_date_time = COALESCE(@in_start_date_time, @current_time) - 1
--		,@end_time = COALESCE(@in_end_time, @current_time)
--		default the no of days reqd to 7 to apply the shift schedules for the next 7 days.
		,@no_of_days_reqd = 7
		,@current_time_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @current_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)

	SET @firstdayOffset = 1
	IF @@DATEFIRST = 1 BEGIN SET @firstdayOffset = 0 END


	--Add the no. of days to the start day to find the end day
	--Subtract the final day by 1, because Day 1 is Monday in terms of Factelligence;
	--whereas Day 1 is Sunday in terms of SQL Server.
	SET @end_day = DATEPART(dw, @start_date_time) - @firstdayOffset + @no_of_days_reqd

	--Get the first day from the supplied start day
	SELECT @first_start_day = DATEPART(dw, @start_date_time) - @firstdayOffset
		--If the end day is > 6, then default the end day to 6; as there are only 7 days in a week (0..6)
		, @first_end_day = CASE WHEN (@end_day > 6) THEN 6
		 	ELSE @end_day END
		--If the end day falls beyond the day range (>6), then reset the start day to 0
		, @second_start_day = CASE WHEN (@end_day > 6) THEN 0
			ELSE DATEPART(dw, @start_date_time) - @firstdayOffset END
		--If the end day falls beyond the day range, then find the difference between the end day and the start day to
		--find the second end day range.
		--eg., if the start day is 4 and if the request is to find the shifts for the next 5 days including the current day
		--then this should result Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday
		--In this case, the first_start day will be Thursday (4) and the first_end_day will be Saturday (6)
		--the second_start day will be Sunday (0) and the second end day will be Monday (1)
		, @second_end_day = CASE WHEN (@end_day > 6 ) THEN @end_day - 7
			ELSE @end_day END

	--Prepare shift templates for the shifts that starts on the previous day.
	--because some shifts might start on the previous day
	EXEC sp_U_Ent_AddShiftsForTheDay @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id, @in_start_date_time=@start_date_time
		,@in_first_start_day=@first_start_day, @in_first_end_day=@first_end_day
		,@in_second_start_day=@second_start_day, @in_second_end_day=@second_end_day
		,@day_indicator=-1

	SET @curr_cntr_date_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @start_date_time, 120), 120)
	SELECT @curr_cntr_date_time = DATEADD(d, 1, @curr_cntr_date_time)
		, @end_date = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @in_end_date_time, 120), 120)

	WHILE (@curr_cntr_date_time < @end_date) BEGIN
		EXEC sp_U_Ent_AddShiftsForTheDay @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id, @in_start_date_time=@curr_cntr_date_time
			,@in_first_start_day=@first_start_day, @in_first_end_day=@first_end_day
			,@in_second_start_day=@second_start_day, @in_second_end_day=@second_end_day
			,@day_indicator=0
		SET @curr_cntr_date_time = DATEADD(d, 1, @curr_cntr_date_time)
	END

	--Prepare shift templates for the shifts that starts on the previous day.
	--because some shifts might start on the previous day
	EXEC sp_U_Ent_AddShiftsForTheDay  @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id, @in_start_date_time=@end_date
		,@in_first_start_day=@first_start_day, @in_first_end_day=@first_end_day
		,@in_second_start_day=@second_start_day, @in_second_end_day=@second_end_day
		,@day_indicator=1

	--Apply exceptioins to the shifts.
	EXEC sp_U_Ent_ApplyShiftExceptions  @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id,
										@in_start_date_time=@in_start_date_time,@in_start_date_time_tz=@in_start_date_time_tz,
										@in_end_date_time=@in_end_date_time,@in_end_date_time_tz=@in_end_date_time_tz,
										@time_zone_bias_value=@in_time_zone_bias_value

	--Clear breaks and 0 shifts
	EXEC sp_U_Ent_ClearBreaksAnd0Shifts
END

-- Author:		Gines
-- Create date: 05-06-2017
-- Description:	SP used for get all Resource-Ent mapping in SDB.SCH.movable_res Table via the Config Front End Page

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_movable_res_config](
@row_id NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


SELECT R.[res_id]  --Autogenerate
      ,R.[res_desc] -- Display Name
      ,MR.[ent_id] -- Passed Value
	  ,E.ent_name as [Entity_Name] -- Display -- User Defined

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_oper_step_file_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_file]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_step_file_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_file table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--11/01/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id 	FROM oper_step_file osf
				INNER JOIN inserted i ON osf.process_id = i.process_id AND osf.oper_id = i.oper_id
				AND osf.step_no = i.step_no  AND osf.assoc_file = i.assoc_file)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_step_file', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	-- Makes sure the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
	UPDATE oper_step_file SET assoc_file_type = x.extension
	FROM (SELECT oper_id, assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(assoc_file) as extension, assoc_file_type FROM inserted) x
	WHERE oper_step_file.oper_id = x.oper_id AND oper_step_file.assoc_file = x.assoc_file AND x.extension <> x.assoc_file_type

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id 	FROM oper_step_file osf
				INNER JOIN inserted i ON osf.process_id = i.process_id AND osf.oper_id = i.oper_id
				AND osf.step_no = i.step_no  AND osf.assoc_file = i.assoc_file) osfile
	WHERE process.process_id = osfile.process_id

	UPDATE oper_step_file SET oper_step_file.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_step_file.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_step_file.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_step_file.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oper_step_file.step_no = i.step_no  AND oper_step_file.assoc_file = i.assoc_file

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:     	sp_I_ofi_InsertRecipeBOM
-- Description:	The stored procedure will insert job bom
--	
-- Usage:		Insert Job Bom
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB				2022-09-30			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  SM				2022-12-16			Update job_bom table set may_choose_alt_inv_loc=1 when bom_pos>0
-- 0.01.02	DS				2023-01-08			update intermediate material if operation is producing WIP/ Delete by products which are part of the SAP bom but produced in other operation or not part of the recipe.
-- 0.01.03	DS				2023-01-28			Modified for setting the def lot
-- 0.02.00	JSC				2026-01-13			Refactored removed comments fixeed links etc.
-- 0.02.01	JSC				2026-01-20			Added some Debug and checks on usage for Milling
-- 0.02.02	JSC				2026-01-21			Fixed join for def_lot_no
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertRecipeBOM]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id             NVARCHAR(40) ,
	@oper_id           NVARCHAR(40) ,
	@seq_no            INT ,
	@parent_item_id    NVARCHAR(50),
	@ver_id            INT ,
	@last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(254)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @bom_pos                          INT ,
			@item_id                          NVARCHAR(40) ,
			@reqd_grade_cd                    INT ,
			@instruction                      NVARCHAR(2000) ,
			@qty_per_parent_item              FLOAT,
			@max_qty_per_parent_item          FLOAT,
			@min_qty_per_parent_item          FLOAT,
			@reqd_start_val                   FLOAT ,
			@reqd_start_val_is_pct            BIT ,
			@update_inv                       BIT ,
			@backflush                        BIT ,
			@def_reas_cd                      INT ,
			@def_lot_no                       NVARCHAR(40) ,
			@def_sublot_no                    NVARCHAR(40) ,
			@def_storage_ent_id               INT ,
			@def_reject_ent_id                INT ,
			@scaling_factor                   FLOAT ,
			@must_consume_from_inv            BIT,
			@may_choose_alt_inv_loc           BIT,
			@may_create_new_lots              BIT,
			@must_consume_from_wip            BIT,
			@must_consume_before_prod         BIT,
			@constant_qty                     BIT,
			@est_time                         FLOAT,
			@current_subst                    INT,
			@qty_reqd                         FLOAT,
			@serial_no_source                 BIT,
			@spare1                           NVARCHAR(1000) ,
			@spare2                           NVARCHAR(1000) ,
			@spare3                           NVARCHAR(1000) ,
			@spare4                           NVARCHAR(1000) ,
			@cnt                              INT        =1,
			@mod_id                           VARCHAR(36)=NULL,
			@row_cnt                          INT,
			@iswip                            INT ,
			@job_reqd_qty                     FLOAT ,
			@defaultLotNo                     NVARCHAR(10) ,
			@recipe_name                      NVARCHAR(80) ,
			@req_track_no                     NVARCHAR(40) = NULL, --for checking grade from SAP
			@target_sched_ent_id              INT ,
			@def_reas_desc_ent                NVARCHAR(40) ,
			@def_reas_cd_ent                  INT ,
			@uom_desc                         NVARCHAR(20)
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temptable') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #temptable
	END
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#jobBOMtemp') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #jobBOMtemp
	END
	--
	-- Get temp table (MES BOM)
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (   ORDER BY row_id)AS rows,
		*
	INTO #temptable
	FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE parent_item_id     = @parent_item_id
		AND ver_id           = @ver_id
		AND bom_pos          <> 0
		AND ISNULL(spare2,0) <> 'InActive'
	--
	-- Get Recipe Name
	SELECT @recipe_name = recipe_name
	FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_id   = @parent_item_id
		AND version = @ver_id
	--
	-- count number of row on temp table
	SELECT @row_cnt=COUNT(0)
	FROM #temptable
	--
	-- insert values into job BOM temp
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (   ORDER BY row_id)AS rows,
		*
	INTO #jobBOMtemp
	FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id    =@wo_id
		AND seq_no = @seq_no -- seq number becasue cake blender having multiple jobs -- and ver_id=@ver_id and bom_pos <>0

	--
	-- get job qty_required and target ent	
	SELECT TOP 1 @job_reqd_qty = qty_reqd,
		@target_sched_ent_id   = target_sched_ent_id
	FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
		AND oper_id = @oper_id
		AND seq_no  = @seq_no
	-- before inserting deleting the job_bom
	IF (@row_cnt<>0)
	BEGIN
		DELETE
		FROM job_bom
		WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND bom_pos <> 0
	END
	-- While there are rows
	WHILE(@row_cnt<>0)
	BEGIN
		-- SELECT from BOM_ITEM table (MES BOM)
		SELECT @bom_pos              =bom_pos,
			@item_id                 =item_id,
			@qty_per_parent_item     =qty_per_parent_item,
			@max_qty_per_parent_item =max_qty_per_parent_item,
			@min_qty_per_parent_item =min_qty_per_parent_item,
			@update_inv              =update_inv,
			@backflush               =backflush,
			@scaling_factor          =scaling_factor,
			@must_consume_from_inv   =must_consume_from_inv,
			@may_choose_alt_inv_loc  =may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
			@may_create_new_lots     =may_create_new_lots,
			@must_consume_from_wip   =must_consume_from_wip,
			@must_consume_before_prod=must_consume_before_prod,
			@constant_qty            =constant_qty,
			@reqd_grade_cd           =reqd_grade_cd,
			@instruction             =instruction,
			@def_reas_cd             =def_reas_cd,
			@def_lot_no              =def_lot_no,
			@def_sublot_no           =def_sublot_no,
			@def_storage_ent_id      =def_storage_ent_id,
			@def_reject_ent_id       =def_reject_ent_id,
			@est_time                =est_time,
			@serial_no_source        =serial_no_source,
			@spare1                  =spare1,
			@spare2                  =spare2,
			@spare3                  =@spare3,
			@spare4                  =spare4
		FROM #temptable
		WHERE rows=@cnt
		--
		--Comments of the below condtion on 16-DEC-2022 for bug 452 to enable storage location
		IF (@bom_pos >0)
		BEGIN
			SET @may_choose_alt_inv_loc = 1
		END
		-- get Uom desc
		SELECT @uom_desc = uom.description
		FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN uom WITH(NOLOCK) ON uom.uom_id = item.uom_id
				AND item_id                           = @item_id
		--
		-- get qty reqt
		SET @qty_reqd = ROUND((
					CASE
					WHEN (@qty_per_parent_item < 0.001)
					AND @uom_desc = 'KG'
					THEN 0
					ELSE @qty_per_parent_item
					END ) *@job_reqd_qty, 4);
		
		SET @qty_per_parent_item = CASE
			WHEN (@qty_per_parent_item < 0.001)
				AND @uom_desc = 'KG'
				THEN 0
			ELSE
				@qty_per_parent_item
		END;
		DECLARE @p36 VARCHAR(30)
		SET @p36 =   NULL
		IF (@qty_per_parent_item <= 0.00001)
		BEGIN
			SET @qty_per_parent_item = 0
		END
		IF (@max_qty_per_parent_item <= 0.00001)
		BEGIN
			SET @max_qty_per_parent_item = 0
		END
		IF (@min_qty_per_parent_item <= 0.00001)
		BEGIN
			SET @min_qty_per_parent_item = 0
		END
		-- insert job bom record
		EXEC SP_I_JOB_BOM @wo_id                   =@wo_id,
						  @oper_id                 =@oper_id,
						  @seq_no                  =@seq_no,
						  @bom_pos                 =@bom_pos,
						  @item_id                 =@item_id,
						  @reqd_grade_cd           =@reqd_grade_cd,
						  @instruction             =@instruction,
						  @qty_per_parent_item     =@qty_per_parent_item,
						  @max_qty_per_parent_item =@max_qty_per_parent_item,
						  @min_qty_per_parent_item =@min_qty_per_parent_item,
						  @reqd_start_val          =NULL,
						  @reqd_start_val_is_pct   =NULL,
						  @update_inv              =@update_inv,
						  @backflush               =@backflush,
						  @def_reas_cd             =@def_reas_cd,
						  @def_lot_no              =@def_lot_no,
						  @def_sublot_no           =@def_sublot_no,
						  @def_storage_ent_id      =@def_storage_ent_id,
						  @def_reject_ent_id       =@def_reject_ent_id,
						  @scaling_factor          =@scaling_factor,
						  @must_consume_from_inv   =@must_consume_from_inv,
						  @may_choose_alt_inv_loc  =@may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
						  @may_create_new_lots     =@may_create_new_lots,
						  @must_consume_from_wip   =@must_consume_from_wip,
						  @must_consume_before_prod=@must_consume_before_prod,
						  @constant_qty            =@constant_qty,
						  @est_time                =@est_time,
						  @current_subst           =NULL,
						  @qty_reqd                =@qty_reqd,
						  @serial_no_source        =@serial_no_source,
						  @spare1                  =@spare1,
						  @spare2                  =@spare2,
						  @spare3                  =@spare3,
						  @spare4                  =@spare4,
						  @last_edit_comment       =@last_edit_comment,
						  @mod_id                  =@p36 output
		--select @p36
		DELETE
		FROM #temptable
		WHERE rows = @cnt
		--
		-- get next rows
		SELECT @row_cnt = COUNT(0)
		FROM #temptable
		
		SET @cnt=@cnt+1
		PRINT @ROW_CNT
	END
	-- v2.01 UPDATED
	-- update intermediate material if operation is producing WIP
	SELECT @iswip = oa.attr_value
	FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
	WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'produce_wip'
	--
	--select top 1 @job_reqd_qty = qty_reqd,@target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id  from job with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
	IF (@iswip=1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE job_bom
		SET
			item_id     = @parent_item_id,
			qty_reqd    = @job_reqd_qty,
			spare1      = @recipe_name
		WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND bom_pos = 0
	END
	ELSE -- this part is to update reqd_qty to the job_bom position 0
	BEGIN
		UPDATE job_bom
		SET
			qty_reqd    = @job_reqd_qty,
			spare1      = @recipe_name
		WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND bom_pos = 0
	END
	--
	-- Delete by products which are part of the SAP bom but produced in other operation or not part of the recipe.
	IF EXISTS
		(   SELECT item_id
			FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
				AND ver_id       = @ver_id )
	BEGIN
		DELETE
		FROM job_bom
		WHERE wo_id     =@wo_id
			AND oper_id =@oper_id
			AND seq_no  = @seq_no
			AND item_id NOT IN
			(   SELECT item_id
				FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK) -- Added Nolock
				WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
					AND ver_id       = @ver_id )
	END
	--
	------- updating the required qty in the job_bom
	UPDATE jb
	SET qty_reqd = ROUND((jb.qty_per_parent_item * j.qty_reqd), i.num_decimals)
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id    = j.wo_id
			AND jb.oper_id                           = j.oper_id
			AND jb.seq_no                            = j.seq_no
		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE jb.wo_id                                   = @wo_id
		AND jb.oper_id                               = @oper_id
		AND jb.seq_no                                = @seq_no
	--	
	
	-- setting the def lot number in case def lot number is null for the by product[setting the target product def_lot_number to by product]
	SELECT @defaultLotNo = def_lot_no
	FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
		AND oper_id = @oper_id
		AND seq_no  = @seq_no
		AND bom_pos = 0

	-- AllowSourceWithSameBatch
	-- Verify if bom_pos > 0 needs to get same batch
	DECLARE @SetSameBatch INT = 0
	SELECT @SetSameBatch = oa.attr_value
	FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
	WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'AllowSourceWithSameBatch'

	SET @SetSameBatch = COALESCE(@SetSameBatch,0)
	-- Update def_lot_No  get the previous value if existing jb1.def_lot_no not null,
	-- Get the wo_id for any MES order
	-- Get the @def_lot_no for bom_pos = 0 for AllowSourceWithSameBatch operations
	UPDATE jb
	SET def_lot_no = CASE 
							WHEN ISNULL(w.spare1,0) = 0 -- v2.00 Changed it
								THEN jb.wo_id
							WHEN ISNULL(@SetSameBatch,0) = 1
								THEN @defaultLotNo
							WHEN ISNULL(jb1.def_lot_no,-1) = -1
								THEN jb.def_lot_no
							ELSE
								jb1.def_lot_no
					 END
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)		
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #jobBOMtemp jb1 ON jb.wo_id     = jb1.wo_id -- v2.02 Modified to be LEFT OUTER so we update even i fthe job_bom was empty before.
			AND jb.oper_id                         = jb1.oper_id 
			AND jb.seq_no                          = jb1.seq_no
			AND jb.item_id                         = jb1.item_id
		INNER JOIN wo w ON w.wo_id = jb.wo_id     -- v2.00 Changed it
	WHERE jb.wo_id                                 = @wo_id
		AND jb.oper_id                             = @oper_id
		AND jb.seq_no                              = @seq_no
		AND jb.bom_pos <> 0 -- v2.01 Added to avoid updating the bom_pos 0

	-- update default for byproducts that has no value
	UPDATE job_bom
	SET
		def_lot_no = CASE
						 WHEN def_lot_no IS NULL
							 THEN @defaultLotNo
						 ELSE
							 def_lot_no
					 END
	WHERE wo_id     = @wo_id
		AND oper_id = @oper_id
		AND seq_no  = @seq_no
		AND bom_pos < 0


	-- Get the default cons reas_cd from job_exec for this ent
	DECLARE @def_cons_reas_cd INT
	-- get it from job_exec
	SELECT @def_cons_reas_cd = je.def_cons_reas_cd
	FROM job_exec je WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE je.ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id

	SELECT @def_cons_reas_cd = COALESCE(@def_cons_reas_cd,ir.reas_cd)
	FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ir.reas_desc = 'Good Consumption' 

	-- SAP will not tell batch number to consume and automation will not give to consumption qty for backflush qty
	UPDATE job_bom
	SET
		def_reas_cd = @def_cons_reas_cd
	WHERE wo_id       = @wo_id
		AND oper_id   = @oper_id
		AND seq_no    = @seq_no
		AND bom_pos   > 0
		AND backflush = 1
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [fn_S_ofi_ValidateWIPReportSublot]
-- Description: This function will get the current sublot_no for the line that produced the paremeter's one
-- Usage:  WIP consumption report
-- SELECT * FROM [fn_S_ofi_ValidateWIPReportSublot] ('000012345678','0000123456780001')
-- ===========================================================================================
--  Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd) Change description
--  0.01.00 J. Sukerman  2024-07-25   Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE   FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_ValidateWIPReportSublot]
    (
        @cons_lot   NVARCHAR(40)
      ,@cons_sublot NVARCHAR(40)
    )
RETURNS @Output TABLE
    (
       --prod_sublot_counter   NVARCHAR(1700)
      --,
	   prod_sublot_no 		NVARCHAR(40)
      ,prod_last_edit_at    DATETIME
      ,prod_job_state_cd    INT
      ,cons_lot             NVARCHAR(40)
      ,cons_sublot          NVARCHAR(40)
    )
AS BEGIN
	-- Declare variables
	DECLARE @prod_wo_id     	NVARCHAR(40)
			,@prod_oper_id      NVARCHAR(40)
			,@prod_seq_no       INT
			,@prod_last_edit_at DATETIME
			,@prod_job_state_cd INT
			,@prod_sublot_no	NVARCHAR(40)
			
	--DECLARE @cur_sublots_table AS TABLE ( sublot_counter NVARCHAR(1700) ,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) )
	
	-- STEP 1: Find the production job of the consumed WIP
	SELECT
		TOP 1 @prod_wo_id = iip.wo_id
	  ,@prod_oper_id      = iip.oper_id
	  ,@prod_seq_no       = iip.seq_no
	  ,@prod_last_edit_at = iip.last_edit_at
	  ,@prod_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
	FROM item_prod iip WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = iip.wo_id
									AND j.oper_id = iip.oper_id
									AND j.seq_no  = iip.seq_no
	WHERE	iip.lot_no = @cons_lot
		AND iip.sublot_no = @cons_sublot
	ORDER BY iip.last_edit_at DESC	
	
	-- Declare next step variables
	DECLARE  @def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
			,@parent_ent_id as INT
			,@attr_id as INT
			--,@sublot_no as NVARCHAR(40)

	-- Get lot from SAP information
	SELECT @def_lot_no = lot_no 
	FROM ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE wo_id = @prod_wo_id
	
	-- Get parent entity for current sublot counter
	SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id 
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id 
	WHERE  	wo_id = @prod_wo_id 
		AND oper_id = @prod_oper_id 
		AND seq_no = @prod_seq_no 
	
	SELECT @attr_id = attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE attr_desc = 'SublotCounter'

	-- Get sublot number calculated
	SELECT @prod_sublot_no = CONCAT(@def_lot_no,(SELECT FORMAT(CAST(REPLACE (attr_value,',','') AS INT),'00000','en-US') 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  
	WHERE attr_id = @attr_id 
		AND ent_id = @parent_ent_id))

	--
	--SELECT REPLACE (attr_value,',','') sublot_counter, @sublot_no sublot_no 
	--FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	--WHERE attr_id=@attr_id 
--		AND ent_id=@parent_ent_id
	-- STEP 2: Find the sublot_no which would be the current one
	
--	INSERT INTO @cur_sublots_table
	--EXEC sp_S_ofi_Sublot
--		@wo_id    =@prod_wo_id
		--, @oper_id=@prod_oper_id
		--, @seq_no =@prod_seq_no
	
	-- STEP 3: Insert results into output table
	INSERT INTO @output
	SELECT TOP 1 
		 @prod_sublot_no
		,@prod_last_edit_at
		,@prod_job_state_cd
		,@cons_lot
		,@cons_sublot

	-- exit
	RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Folder_File]
(
	@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@ent_id  int  ,
	@ver_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@file_path  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@file_type  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@last_modified  datetime  ,
	@author  nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/11/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 03/27/2006		Raghu			3.1.12		Added URL column to the select clause
-- 04/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.14		HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 07/31/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @last_modified IS NOT NULL SET @last_modified = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @last_modified)

SELECT	folder_file.item_id
	,	folder_file.oper_id
	,	folder_file.ent_id
	,	folder_file.ver_id
	,	folder_file.file_path
	,	ent.ent_name
	,	item.item_desc
	,	folder_file.file_desc
	,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(folder_file.file_path) AS file_type
	,	folder_file.last_modified
	,	folder_file.file_size
	,	folder_file.author
	--	Added 07/31/2007 AML
	,	folder_file.spare1
	,	folder_file.spare2
	,	folder_file.spare3
	,	folder_file.spare4
	--
	,	user_name.user_desc
	,       0 AS download
	,	ft.edit_level edit_level_h
	,	ft.view_level view_level_h
	,	ft.print_level print_level_h
	,	0 AS down_level_h
	,	NULL AS viewer_h
	,	NULL AS editor_h
	,	0 AS url
	,	folder_file.last_edit_comment
	,	folder_file.last_edit_by
	,	folder_file.last_edit_at
	,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, folder_file.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM folder_file folder_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name user_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON folder_file.author = user_name.user_id
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON folder_file.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON folder_file.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN file_type ft WITH (NOLOCK) ON ft.file_ext = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(folder_file.file_path)
WHERE ((folder_file.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.file_path = @file_path OR @file_path IS NULL) AND
       (dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(folder_file.file_path) = @file_type OR @file_type IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.last_modified >= @last_modified OR @last_modified IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.author = @author OR @author IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (folder_file.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY folder_file.file_desc

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Ent_LogOn_LogOffEnts]
(
		@in_session_id				INT32
	,	@in_user_id					STRING80
	,	@in_client_type				INT32
	,	@in_ent_id					INT32
	,	@in_pct_lab_to_apply		TFLOAT
	,	@in_cur_labor_usage_log_id	INT32
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       -  SP_D_ENT_LOGON_LOGOFFENTS
-- Description       -  Adjust labor usage records during the entity log off.
-- Author           - Raghu
-- Date Created         -  03/15/2007
-- Version        -       3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver     Changes
-- 07/24/2007     Raghu          3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change labor_start with labor_start_utc and labor_start_local.
--02/15/2008	Raghu	        3.4		L00075126,	Load Test: Receiving deadlocks when runn...
--02/27/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00075471; oad Test: Receiving deadlocks on Session
--09/16/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00084286; LoadTests: Event Viewer application log ...
--04/29/2016   Malleswara Rao 5.03  US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want remove Factory Connector stored procedures, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @last_edit_by					STRING80
	,	@client_info					STRING80
	,	@use_gmt						INT32
	,	@v_current_time_utc				TDATETIME
	,	@v_current_time_local			TDATETIME
	,	@lt_cenpercent					NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@mt_cenpercent					NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@current_total_labor_pct		TFLOAT
	,	@no_of_logout_entities			INT32
	,	@user_logged_into_diff_sessn	INT32
	,	@labor_pct_to_reduce			TFLOAT
	,	@total_pct						TFLOAT
	,	@cur_log_id						INT32
	,	@can_capture_labor				LOGICAL
	,	@user_id						STRING80
	,	@tz_temp						INT32

BEGIN
	--the user is logging out of a session; or the user is logging off from an entity.

	--Verify whether a client_type is supplied for this log off.
	--The client_type ought to be supplied ONLY if a session is killed; OR a record is deleted from the session table.
	IF (@in_client_type IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Now, verify whether the current client is an Operator
		IF (@in_client_type <> 37 OR @in_user_id IS NULL)
			--The supplied client type is NOT operator. Exit now.
			RETURN
	END

	IF (@in_user_id IS NULL) SET @last_edit_by = SYSTEM_USER
	ELSE SET @last_edit_by = @in_user_id

	--Determine whether this database instance of Factelligence uses GMT or local time.
	--EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_gmt

	SELECT	@v_current_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()
		,	@v_current_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

	--Check 'Allow user to account for less than 100% of his time<1108>'
	SELECT @lt_cenpercent = COALESCE(attr_value, '0')
	FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 188;

	SET @lt_cenpercent = COALESCE(@lt_cenpercent, '0')

	--Check 'Allow user to account for more than 100% of his time<1109>'
	SELECT @mt_cenpercent = COALESCE( attr_value, '0')
	FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 189

	SET @mt_cenpercent = COALESCE(@mt_cenpercent, '0')

	IF (@in_client_type IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--The client_type is Operator; meaning the user is logging out of a session.
		--If the user is logging out of a session, adjust the labor usage records at once.
		--otherwise, adjust the labor usage records for an entity.

		--If the user has logged into the same entity other than the current session, then leave the labor_usage records.
		--And, delete all the labor usage records to which the user(s) has logged into this session and the entities to which a user has not logged in another session.
		--Adjust the duration on all cases.
		--Now, adjust all the durations for all the users in this session (the supplied session)
		--on all the entities to which the user has not logged on in another session.
		UPDATE labor_usage
		SET duration = DATEDIFF(SS, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc), active = 0
		FROM (SELECT el.user_id, el.ent_id
				FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
				  AND (user_id + '-' + CAST(ent_id AS NVARCHAR)) NOT IN
						(SELECT el.user_id + '-' + CAST(el.ent_id AS NVARCHAR)
						FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id)
				) logged_in_users
		WHERE labor_usage.active = 1
			--All users logged on to this session
		  AND labor_usage.user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @in_session_id)
		  AND logged_in_users.user_id = labor_usage.user_id AND logged_in_users.ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id

		--Set the current labor usage log_id to NULL. When ent_logon delete trigger executes this procedure
		--to adjust the labor_usage for a specific entity, we can bypass that call as we know that
		--the current labor usage log id is set to null.
		UPDATE ent_logon
		SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = NULL
		FROM (SELECT el.user_id, el.ent_id
				FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
				  AND (user_id + '-' + CAST(ent_id AS NVARCHAR)) NOT IN
						(SELECT el.user_id + '-' + CAST(el.ent_id AS NVARCHAR)
						FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id)
				) logged_in_users
		WHERE logged_in_users.user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND logged_in_users.ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id

		--Delete all labor usage records that are inactive and has a duration of 0.
		DELETE FROM labor_usage
		FROM (SELECT el.user_id, el.ent_id
				FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
				  AND (user_id + '-' + CAST(ent_id AS NVARCHAR)) NOT IN
						(SELECT el.user_id + '-' + CAST(el.ent_id AS NVARCHAR)
						FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id)
				) logged_in_users
		WHERE labor_usage.user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @in_session_id)
		  AND logged_in_users.user_id = labor_usage.user_id AND logged_in_users.ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id
		  AND labor_usage.active = 0
		  AND labor_usage.duration = 0

		--Verify if any other parameters is turned on; if yes, then we need to adjust the labor;
		IF (@mt_cenpercent = '0' OR @lt_cenpercent = '0') BEGIN
			--Adjust the duration in labor_usage and ent_logon for all the users on all entities on this session.
			DECLARE ent_logon_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
			SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE session_id = @in_session_id

			OPEN ent_logon_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

				FETCH NEXT FROM ent_logon_cursor INTO @user_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				SET @user_logged_into_diff_sessn = 0

				--Verify whether this user has logged into any entities on a different session.
				IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
                                    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
                                    WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id
                                      AND el.user_id = @user_id
                                      AND e.can_capture_labor = 1)
					SET @user_logged_into_diff_sessn = 1

				--Default that this user has NOT logged into any other session.
				SET @user_logged_into_diff_sessn = COALESCE(@user_logged_into_diff_sessn, 0)

				--This user has logged on some entities on a different session.
				IF (@user_logged_into_diff_sessn = 1) BEGIN
					SET @current_total_labor_pct = 0

					--Calculate the total labor percentage that is used by this user; before the entity log off.
					SELECT @current_total_labor_pct = COALESCE(SUM(entity_percentage.pct_lab_to_apply), 0)
					FROM
					    (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, COALESCE( pct_lab_to_apply, 0) pct_lab_to_apply
					    FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
					    WHERE user_id = @user_id) entity_percentage

					--Calculate the percentage to reduce for this user.
					SELECT @labor_pct_to_reduce = COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(el.pct_lab_to_apply, 0)), 0)
					FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN (SELECT el.user_id, el.ent_id
								FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
								INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
								WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
								  AND e.can_capture_labor = 1
								  AND el.user_id = @user_id
								  AND (el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)) NOT IN
									(SELECT DISTINCT el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)
										FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
										INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.ent_id
										WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id
										  AND e.can_capture_labor = 1
										  AND el.user_id = @user_id)) logged_in_users ON el.user_id = logged_in_users.user_id AND el.ent_id = logged_in_users.ent_id
					WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
					  AND el.user_id = @user_id

					--First verify whether the system parameter allows the labor to be accounted for 100%.
					IF (@current_total_labor_pct - @labor_pct_to_reduce < 1 AND @lt_cenpercent = '0')
						OR (@current_total_labor_pct - @labor_pct_to_reduce > 1 AND @mt_cenpercent = '0') BEGIN
						--If we subtract the current percentage  (from entities where the user is being logged off)
						-- from the total percentage; it falls below 1
						--and the system attribute does not allow to account the labor below 100%.
						--Adjust the remaining entities; so that it total to 100%
						SET @total_pct = @current_total_labor_pct - @labor_pct_to_reduce

						--For all the entities to which this user has logged on;
						--create a new set of labor_usage records
						INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
						    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
						    active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
						    last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
						SELECT @v_current_time_utc, @v_current_time_local, @user_id, labor_usage.ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
						    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
						    CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pct_to_apply/@total_pct END,
						    1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
						    @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
						FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, ent_id
									FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
									  AND el.user_id = @user_id
									  AND (el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)) NOT IN
										(SELECT el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)
										 FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
										WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id
										  AND el.user_id = @user_id)
									) logged_in_users ON labor_usage.user_id = logged_in_users.user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = logged_in_users.ent_id
						WHERE labor_usage.active = 1

						--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
						UPDATE labor_usage
						SET duration = DATEDIFF(SS, labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc)
						   ,active = 0
						FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, ent_id
									FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
									  AND el.user_id = @user_id
									  AND (el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)) NOT IN
										(SELECT el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)
										 FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
										WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id
										  AND el.user_id = @user_id)
									) logged_in_users
						WHERE active = 1
						 AND labor_usage.user_id = logged_in_users.user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = logged_in_users.ent_id
						 AND labor_start_utc <> @v_current_time_utc

						--Update the ent_logon record with the current percentage and the labor usage log id.
						UPDATE ent_logon
						SET pct_lab_to_apply = CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct END
						 ,cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id AND active = 1)
						FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, ent_id
									FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE el.session_id = @in_session_id
									  AND el.user_id = @user_id
									  AND (el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)) NOT IN
										(SELECT el.user_id + '-' + STR(el.ent_id)
										 FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
										WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id
										  AND el.user_id = @user_id)
									) logged_in_users
						WHERE ent_logon.user_id = logged_in_users.user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = logged_in_users.ent_id
					END --Verify the system attribute whether it can account less than or greater than 100%
				END -- User has logged into a different session.;
			END
			CLOSE ent_logon_cursor
			DEALLOCATE ent_logon_cursor -- Looping on all the users who are logged into this session.;
        END -- Verify whether any of the system_parameter is turned on.
        --User has logged off from a session.
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

		SELECT @can_capture_labor = COALESCE(@can_capture_labor, 0)
			,@cur_log_id = @in_cur_labor_usage_log_id

		--First, verify whether this user has logged onto this entity on a different session.
		SET @user_logged_into_diff_sessn = 0

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE el.session_id <> @in_session_id AND el.user_id = @in_user_id
					  AND el.ent_id = @in_ent_id
					  AND e.can_capture_labor = 1)
			SET @user_logged_into_diff_sessn = 1

		--Default that this user has NOT logged into any other session.
		SET @user_logged_into_diff_sessn = COALESCE(@user_logged_into_diff_sessn, 0)

		--If this user has logged on to this entity on a different session; then do not do any labor adjustments.
		IF (@user_logged_into_diff_sessn = 1) RETURN

		--If the labor adjustments are handled already (ie., the cur_log_id is set to null)
		--or the entity does not capture labor; then just return.
		--OR this user has logged into an entity using indirect labor (although this user is setup to use job based login)
		--then the pct_lab_to_apply is defaulted to 0.
		IF (@cur_log_id IS NULL OR @can_capture_labor = 0 OR @in_pct_lab_to_apply = 0) BEGIN
			--Either the current log id for this entity is null (ie. user has logged in using indirect labor);
			--or this entity does not seem to capture labor; or the percentage is not applied (user has logged in using indirect labor)
			UPDATE labor_usage
			SET active = 0
			WHERE active = 1
			  AND user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id

			--Delete all labor usage records that are inactive and has a duration of 0.
			DELETE FROM labor_usage
			WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
			  AND active = 0 AND duration = 0
		    RETURN
		END
		ELSE
			--Now, calculate the time he spent on this entity.
            UPDATE labor_usage
            SET duration = DATEDIFF(SS, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc), active = 0
            WHERE active = 1
              AND user_id = @in_user_id
              AND ent_id = @in_ent_id

		--Delete all labor usage records that are inactive and has a duration of 0.
		DELETE FROM labor_usage
		WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
		  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
		  AND active = 0 AND duration = 0

		--Verify if the system attribute is turned on; if yes, then we need to adjust the labor;
        IF (@mt_cenpercent = '0' OR @lt_cenpercent = '0') BEGIN
			--Calculate the total labor percentage that is used by this user; before the entity log off.
			SELECT @current_total_labor_pct = COALESCE(SUM(entity_percentage.pct_lab_to_apply), 0)
			FROM
			    (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, COALESCE( pct_lab_to_apply, 0) pct_lab_to_apply
			    FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
			    WHERE user_id = @in_user_id) entity_percentage

			--Since the ent_logon record for this entity and the user is deleted, add the current percentage
			--to the current total to get a total percentage that was allocated for all the entities.
			SELECT @current_total_labor_pct = @current_total_labor_pct + @in_pct_lab_to_apply
				,@labor_pct_to_reduce = @in_pct_lab_to_apply

			--First verify whether the system parameter allows the labor to be accounted for 100%.
			IF (@current_total_labor_pct - @labor_pct_to_reduce <= 1 AND @lt_cenpercent = '0')
			OR (@current_total_labor_pct - @labor_pct_to_reduce >= 1 AND @mt_cenpercent = '0') BEGIN
				--If we subtract the current percentage  (from entities where the user is being logged off)
				-- from the total percentage; it falls below 1
				--and the system attribute does not allow to account the labor below 100%.
				--Adjust the remaining entities; so that it total to 100%
				SET @total_pct = @current_total_labor_pct - @labor_pct_to_reduce

				--For all the entities to which this user has logged on;
				--create a new set of labor_usage records
				INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
				    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
				    active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
				    last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
				SELECT @v_current_time_utc, @v_current_time_local, @in_user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
				    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
				    CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pct_to_apply/@total_pct END,
				    1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
				    @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
				FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
                  AND (ent_id) IN
                    (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
                      AND (ent_id) IN (SELECT el.ent_id FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
										WHERE el.user_id = @in_user_id AND el.pct_lab_to_apply > 0))
                  AND active = 1

				--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
				--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
				UPDATE labor_usage
				SET duration = DATEDIFF(SS, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc)
				   ,active = 0
				FROM (SELECT DISTINCT el.user_id, el.ent_id FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
					      AND (ent_id) IN
					            (SELECT el.ent_id
					             FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
					             WHERE el.user_id = @in_user_id
					               AND el.pct_lab_to_apply > 0)
					) elogon
				WHERE active = 1
				 AND labor_usage.user_id =  elogon.user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = elogon.ent_id
				  AND labor_start_utc <> @v_current_time_utc

				--Update the ent_logon record with the current percentage and the labor usage log id.
				UPDATE ent_logon
				SET pct_lab_to_apply = CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct END
				 ,cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id AND active = 1)
				WHERE (user_id + '-' + STR(ent_id)) IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT user_id + '-' + STR(ent_id)
				FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
				  AND (ent_id) IN
				        (SELECT el.ent_id
				         FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
				         WHERE el.user_id = @in_user_id
				           AND el.pct_lab_to_apply > 0)
				)
            END --Verify the system attribute whether it can account less than or greater than 100%
		END
	END
END
