--Procedure:          dbo.sp_S_GMES_DM_Addition_Definition_isDeletable
--Create Date:		  2022-07-20
--Author:             RANGA
--Description:        to check if the ADDITION DEFINITION is deletable
--
--Call by:            DM_lkup_Addition_DefinitionIsDeletable
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area: 	 Additions definition - Additions definition
--
--	EXEC dbo.sp_S_GMES_DM_Addition_Definition_isDeletable ''
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver		Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2022-07-20         RANGA					1.0		First version
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GMES_DM_Addition_Definition_isDeletable]
	@row_id INT,
	@prod_id NVARCHAR(40)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @rec_count INT = 0;
	DECLARE @result INT
	SET @rec_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GMES_calculation_addition cc WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN GMES_Addition_Definition ad WITH(NOLOCK)  on ad.formula_id = cc.formula_id
	INNER JOIN GMES_Addition_Formula af  WITH(NOLOCK)  on af.formula_name = ad.formula_name
	WHERE cc.formula_id = @row_id AND addition_status <> 'CANCELED' and ad.active=1 and af.active=1 and ad.prod_id=@prod_id)
	IF(@rec_count > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 0;
	END;
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1;
	END;
	SELECT @result [allow]
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_BIOL_GetBomOperInfo]
(@parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
,@ver_id NVARCHAR(40)
,@process_id NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id NVARCHAR(80)
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_BIOL_GetBomOperInfo
-- Description	      -	Returns a record set of all the components used in and by-products produced by an operation
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	06/27/2003
-- Version	      - 1.7.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
--03/22/2005	Raghu		2.1.17	HD# 5487, bom_pos 0 records are included in the returned resultset
--05/12/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5661, Bom 0 records are shown if and only if the operation is the fist
--					operation and there are no components.
--04/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--06/05/2006	Raghu		3.1.17	HD# ?, Issue with Hutchinson, reported by JS.
--					The where clause in the first query ought to use null while checking for process and oper in bom_item_oper_link table.
--08/09/2006	Raghu		3.1.21	The last operation does not show consumption items.
--09/21/2012    Ashish      4.5 Modified for CRL00122931 cloned from CRL00122632
--04/04/2019    Surya		6.1 MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00150363 (HF CR L00149834: MES configure BOM using MES client. update_inv = 1 with SSC import, = 0 with MES client)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT 	 bom_item.bom_pos
	,item.item_desc
	,bom_item.parent_item_id
	,bom_item.ver_id
	,bom_item.item_id
	,bom_item.backflush
	,bom_item.constant_qty
	,bom_item.def_reas_cd
	,bom_item.def_lot_no
	,bom_item.def_sublot_no
	,bom_item.def_storage_ent_id
	,bom_item.def_reject_ent_id
	,bom_item.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
	,bom_item.may_create_new_lots
	,bom_item.must_consume_from_inv
	,bom_item.must_consume_from_wip
	,bom_item.must_consume_before_prod
	,bom_item.update_inv
	,(ISNULL(bom_item_oper_link.reqd_start_pct,0) * 100) reqd_start_pct
	,(SELECT SUM(qty_per_parent_item) FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id= @process_id AND ver_id=bom_item.ver_id AND parent_item_id=bom_item.parent_item_id AND bom_pos=bom_item.bom_pos) 'QTY_CONS_ITM'
	,CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,7),bom_item.qty_per_parent_item) 'TOT_QTY_AVL'
	, ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,7),bom_item_oper_link.qty_per_parent_item), 0) 'QTY_CONS_AT_OPER'
	,bom_item_oper_link.process_id
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, bom_item_oper_link.mod_id)))  mod_id
	,item.num_decimals
FROM bom_item bom_item WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN  bom_item_oper_link bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = bom_item.parent_item_id
  AND bom_item_oper_link.ver_id = bom_item.ver_id AND bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos = bom_item.bom_pos
  AND (bom_item_oper_link.process_id = @process_id OR bom_item_oper_link.process_id IS NULL)  AND (bom_item_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id OR bom_item_oper_link.oper_id IS NULL)
INNER JOIN item item  WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = bom_item.item_id
WHERE bom_item.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
  AND bom_item.ver_id = @ver_id
--  AND (bom_item_oper_link.process_id = @process_id OR bom_item_oper_link.process_id IS NULL)
--  AND (bom_item_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id OR bom_item_oper_link.oper_id IS NULL)
  AND bom_item.bom_pos<>0
UNION
SELECT   bi.bom_pos
	,i.item_desc
	,bi.parent_item_id
	,bi.ver_id
	,bi.item_id
	,bi.backflush
	,bi.constant_qty
	,bi.def_reas_cd
	,bi.def_lot_no
	,bi.def_sublot_no
	,bi.def_storage_ent_id
	,bi.def_reject_ent_id
	,bi.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
	,bi.may_create_new_lots
	,bi.must_consume_from_inv
	,bi.must_consume_from_wip
	,bi.must_consume_before_prod
	,bi.update_inv
	,(ISNULL(biol.reqd_start_pct,0) * 100) reqd_start_pct
	,(SELECT SUM(qty_per_parent_item) FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE parent_item_id=bi.parent_item_id AND ver_id=bi.ver_id AND bom_pos=bi.bom_pos AND process_id=@process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id) 'QTY_CONS_ITM'
	,CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,7),bi.qty_per_parent_item) 'TOT_QTY_AVL'
	, ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,7),biol.qty_per_parent_item), 0) 'QTY_CONS_AT_OPER'
	,biol.process_id
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, biol.mod_id)))  mod_id
	,i.num_decimals
FROM bom_item bi
INNER JOIN item i ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol ON biol.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND biol.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
INNER JOIN oper_ent_route oer ON biol.process_id = oer.process_id AND biol.oper_id = oer.oper_id
INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol_prev ON biol_prev.process_id = oer.process_id AND biol_prev.oper_id = oer.input_oper_id
	AND biol_prev.parent_item_id = biol.parent_item_id AND biol_prev.ver_id = biol.ver_id AND biol_prev.bom_pos = biol.bom_pos
WHERE bi.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
  AND bi.ver_id = @ver_id
  AND bi.bom_pos = 0
  AND biol.process_id = @process_id
  AND biol.oper_id = @oper_id
UNION
SELECT   bi.bom_pos
	,i.item_desc
	,bi.parent_item_id
	,bi.ver_id
	,bi.item_id
	,bi.backflush
	,bi.constant_qty
	,bi.def_reas_cd
	,bi.def_lot_no
	,bi.def_sublot_no
	,bi.def_storage_ent_id
	,bi.def_reject_ent_id
	,bi.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
	,bi.may_create_new_lots
	,bi.must_consume_from_inv
	,bi.must_consume_from_wip
	,bi.must_consume_before_prod
	,bi.update_inv
	,(ISNULL(biol.reqd_start_pct,0) * 100) reqd_start_pct
	,(SELECT SUM(qty_per_parent_item) FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE parent_item_id=bi.parent_item_id AND ver_id=bi.ver_id AND bom_pos=bi.bom_pos AND process_id=@process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id) 'QTY_CONS_ITM'
	,CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,7),bi.qty_per_parent_item) 'TOT_QTY_AVL'
	, ISNULL(CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,7),biol.qty_per_parent_item), 0) 'QTY_CONS_AT_OPER'
	,biol.process_id
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, biol.mod_id)))  mod_id
	,i.num_decimals
FROM bom_item bi
INNER JOIN item i ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol ON biol.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND biol.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
INNER JOIN oper op ON biol.process_id = op.process_id AND biol.oper_id = op.oper_id
WHERE bi.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
  AND bi.ver_id = @ver_id
  AND bi.bom_pos = 0
  AND biol.process_id = @process_id
  AND biol.oper_id = @oper_id
  AND op.first_oper = 1
  AND 1 = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 2 FROM bom_item_oper_link biol_bp WHERE biol_bp.parent_item_id = biol.parent_item_id
		  AND biol_bp.ver_id = biol.ver_id AND biol_bp.bom_pos > 0 AND biol_bp.process_id = biol.process_id
		  AND biol_bp.oper_id = biol.oper_id), 1)
END

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_UpdateFedDownStreamJobs]
(@cur_wo_id		STRING40
,@cur_oper_id		STRING40
,@cur_seq_no		INT32
,@cur_item_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@bInteger		LOGICAL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -	Refreshes the start_qty for Down stream jobs feded by the current job.
--                      This SP only used to update qty_prod and qty_rejected fields in Job table from item_prod
-- Author	      - Rohit
-- Date Created	      - 01/16/2003
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.13
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver.   Changes
-- 02/03/2005     SJ            2113   Redundant code commented out, to be removed when confirmed this is unnecessary
-- 09/09/2014	Raghu		5.0	UserStory: 384707, As Lenka, I want the starting quantities for the downstream entities (jobs) to be accurate when upstream jobs that contain rejected quantites are completed.
--					This version of the SP was completely re-written.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

--The routing structure depicted below is used for explaining the flow of this stored procedure.
-- Job Route
--
--	   |-B-----
--	   |	   |-----F-----|
--	   |-C-----|	       |
--	A--|		       |-----H
--	   |-D-----|           |
--	   |	   |-----G-----|
--	   |-E-----
--
-- INPUT_OPER_ID	OPER_ID
-- 	A		B
--	A		C
--	A		D
--	A		E
--	B		F
--	C		F
--	D		G
--	E		G
--	F		H
--	G		H
--
--This logic of this stored procedure is described as below:
-- 1. From the current one or more operations, determine all the downstream operations that are immediately following the current operation.
-- 2. For each operation in upstream or downstream, use a unique number to identify the operations respective to their positions.
-- 3. Calculate the quantities to be propagated to the downstream operations using the input percentages.
-- 4. Calculate the pro-rated (ajustment) quantities for each downstream operation.
-- 5. Determine the quantities to be added to the downstream operation that are not in the current path/route.
-- 6. Sum up all the quatities (quantities based on input percent + even splits + overages/insufficient quantities) for each downstream operation.
-- 7. Store the quantities in the temporary table to propagate downstream.
-- 8. Using the downstream jobs and quantities identified in the temporary table, update the downstream jobs with the right quantities.

DECLARE @downstream_jobs	TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80), oper_id NVARCHAR(80), seq_no INT, state_cd INT, item_id NVARCHAR(80), qty_at_start_to_prop FLOAT, operation_num INT, position INT)

DECLARE  @position		INT32
	,@num_decimals		INT32

BEGIN

	--This SP should be called only when the current job is completed.
	--Verify whether the job is completed.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
			  AND j.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
			  AND j.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND j.state_cd = 4)
		--If the job is not completed, exit.
		RETURN

	--Verify whether an item is supplied
	IF (@cur_item_id IS NULL)
		--If an item is not supplied, retrieve the item from the current job.
		SELECT @cur_item_id = j.item_id
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND j.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND j.seq_no = @cur_seq_no

	--Retrieve the number of decimals places used by this item
	SELECT @num_decimals = i.num_decimals FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @cur_item_id

	--Default to position 1.
	SET @position = 1

	--Add the current job information
	INSERT INTO @downstream_jobs (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, state_cd, item_id, qty_at_start_to_prop, operation_num, position)
	SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.state_cd, j.item_id, j.qty_prod, 1, @position
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE j.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
	  AND j.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
	  AND j.seq_no = @cur_seq_no

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN

		--Increment the position by 1.
		SET @position = @position + 1

		--Determine the downstream jobs that immediately follow the jobs in the previous position.
		--For example, if the job in the previous position is A, then the immediate downstream jobs would be B, C, D, and E
		--		if the job in the previous position is B, then the immedidate downstream job would be F.
		--The purpose of determining the jobs that are immediately downstream to the previous position is calculate how much of starting quantities need to be propagated.
		;WITH immediate_downstream_jobs
		AS
		(SELECT  --Jobs in the upstream position
			downstrm_jobs.wo_id, downstrm_jobs.input_oper_id, downstrm_jobs.input_seq_no
			--Jobs in the downstream position
			, downstrm_jobs.oper_id, downstrm_jobs.seq_no
			--Job state code from the downstream job
			, downstrm_job.state_cd
			--Item ID from the downstream job
			, downstrm_job.item_id

			--A unique operation number from the upstream job.
			--The purpose of using a unique operation number instead of operation IDs is to identify a unique job in a column position.
			--For example, the operations B, C, D, and E are separate jobs with sequence number 0, but the operation ID could be the same with different sequence numbers representing different jobs
			--Filling with sequence 0, Filling with sequence 1, Filling with sequence 2, and Filling with sequence 3.
			--If operation IDs are different, later in the code it is difficult to identify which operation feeds to the downstream jobs and how much it feeds to the downstream jobs.
			--So, representing each operation (oper_id + seq_no or input_oper_id + input_seq_no) in a unique number makes it easy to identify the upstream and downstream operations.
			, upstrm_jobs.operation_num

			--A unique operation number from the downstream job.
			--Represent a unique number for each combination of downstream operation ID and sequence number.
			--When a job is ended in operation A, then B, C, D, and E would be the immediate downstream jobs.
			--Operation B will have the job_sequence 1, C will have the job_sequence 2, D will have the job_sequence 3, and E will have the job_sequence 4.
			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY upstrm_jobs.operation_num ORDER BY downstrm_jobs.oper_id, downstrm_jobs.seq_no) AS job_sequence

			--Determine the quantity from the upstream job to propagate to the downstream jobs
			, upstrm_jobs.qty_at_start_to_prop AS qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop

			--The proposed quantity to propagate for each downstream job
			--When number of decimals is set to 0, use the whole number; otherwise round the quantities to the nearest digit.
			--For example, if A has a starting quantity of 50 and the job on E was ended.
			--When number of decimals = 0, then B, C, and D would get 16 each.  I.e., 50/3 operations (excluding E) = 16.666666 = 16 each
			--When number of decimals = 2, then B, C, and D would get 16.67 each.  I.e., 50/3 operations (excluding E) = 16.666666 = 16.67 each
			, CASE WHEN @num_decimals = 0 THEN FLOOR(upstrm_jobs.qty_at_start_to_prop * downstrm_jobs.input_percent)
				   ELSE ROUND((upstrm_jobs.qty_at_start_to_prop * downstrm_jobs.input_percent), @num_decimals)
				   END AS qty_at_start_to_prop

		 FROM @downstream_jobs upstrm_jobs
		 --Joining the upstream jobs to the input_oper_id and input_seq_no in the job_route table should return the immediate downstream jobs.
		 INNER JOIN job_route downstrm_jobs WITH (NOLOCK)ON upstrm_jobs.wo_id = downstrm_jobs.wo_id AND upstrm_jobs.oper_id = downstrm_jobs.input_oper_id AND upstrm_jobs.seq_no = downstrm_jobs.input_seq_no
		 INNER JOIN job downstrm_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON downstrm_jobs.wo_id = downstrm_job.wo_id AND downstrm_jobs.oper_id = downstrm_job.oper_id AND downstrm_jobs.seq_no = downstrm_job.seq_no
		 --Exclude jobs that are completed/ended.
		 --For example, if the upstream job is A and the downstream job E was already completed, then the final list could contain B, C, and D.
		 WHERE downstrm_job.state_cd <> 4
		 --Limit to the jobs in the previous position.
		   AND upstrm_jobs.position = @position - 1
		)

		--Adjust the quantities determined for the downstream jobs
		, adjust_qtys_for_curr_downstrm_jobs
		AS
		(SELECT --A unique downstream operation number.
			qtys_to_split.operation_num
			--The first operation in the downstream for each upstream operation.
			, qtys_to_split.first_job_seq_in_oper
			--The quantity from each upstream job to propagate.
			, qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop
			--The quantity from each upstream job to propagate.
			, qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop
			--The total number of operations in downstream for each upstream operation.
			, qtys_to_split.no_of_downstrm_jobs

			--Determine how much quantity needs to be evenly distributed to all downstream jobs
			, CASE WHEN @num_decimals = 0 THEN
					--If the quantity to be propagated from the upstream job is equivalent to the sum of quantities in the downstream job, then the distribution is 0; otherwise 1 for each operation downstream.
					--For example, if operation A has 100 quantities and none of the job downstream is ended, then operations B, C, D, and E get 25 each, and no distribution is necessary.
					--I.e., 100 - (25 + 25 + 25 + 25 = 100) = 0 distribution.
					--if operation A has 50 quantities and none of the job downstream is ended, then B, C, D, and E get 12 each, but 2 quantities are left to be distributed.
					--I.e., 50 - (12 + 12 + 12 + 12 = 48) = 2 quantities to be distributed to B, C, D, E.
					--Since the number of decimal places is 0, each operation will get 1 full quantity.
					CASE WHEN qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop - qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

				ELSE
					--If the quantity to be propagated from the upstream job is equivalent to the sum of quantities in the downstream job, then the overage or insufficient is 0
					CASE WHEN qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop - qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop = 0 THEN 0

					--The quantity to be propagated from the upstream job IS NOT equivalent to the sum of quantities in the downstream job.
					--For example, operation A is ended with a quantity of 50 and the downstream operation E was already ended before operation A was ended.
					--Number of decimal places = 2
					--Therefore, operations B, C, and D get 12.5 each = (12.5 from B + 12.5 from C + 12.5 from D) = 37.5 quantities proposed for downstream operation.
					--(50 quantities from upstream to be propagated - 37.5 total from downstream jobs) divided by the number of downstream operations (i.e. 3)  = 4.17 quantities to be distributed for each operation downstream
					ELSE ROUND((qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop - qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop)/qtys_to_split.no_of_downstrm_jobs, @num_decimals)
					END
				END qty_distribution

			, CASE WHEN @num_decimals = 0 THEN
					--Determine when to stop the distribution.
					--Total quantities to be propagated from the upstream operation minus the total quantities (whole number) quantities to be propagated at the downstream operations
					--For example, there are 3 operations downstream
					--if the starting quantity is 10, 10 - (3 * 3 = 9) = 1; stop at the first operation
					--if the starting quantity is 11, 11 - (3 * 3 = 9) = 2; stop at the second operation
					qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop - qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop
				ELSE
					--Determine the overage or the insufficient quantity that needs to be adjusted.
					CASE
						--If the quantity from the upstream job is equivalent to the sum of quantities in the downstream job, then no adjustment is necessary.
						WHEN qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop - qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop = 0 THEN 0
					ELSE
						--The quantity from the upstream job is NOT equivalent to the sum of quantities in the downstream job.
						--Quantity reduction due to overage quantities propagated to downstream jobs:
						--For example, operation A is ended with 50 quantities and the downstream operation E was already ended before operation A was ended.
						--Number of decimal places = 2
						--Therefore, operations B, C, and D get 12.5 each = (12.5 from B + 12.5 from C + 12.5 from D) = 37.5 quantities proposed for downstream operation.
						--(50 quantities from upstream to be propagated - 37.5 total from downstream jobs) divided by the number of downstream operations (i.e. 3)  = 4.17 quantities to be adjusted for each downstream job
						--4.17 quantity distribution * 3 operations = 12.51
						-- (37.5 + 12.51) = 50.01, whereas the quantity from the upstream operation to be propagated is 50.
						--There is an overage of (50 - 50.01) = -0.01 quantity, which needs to be reduced at the last downstream operation.

						--Quantity addition due to insufficient quantities propagated to downstream jobs:
						--For example, operation A is ended with 10 quantities and there is no operation called E in downstream.  I.e. there are only 3 downstream operations B, C, and D from A.
						--Number of decimal places = 2
						--Therefore, operations B, C, and D get 3.33 each = (3.33 from B + 3.33 from C + 3.33 from D) = 9.99 quantities proposed for downstream operation.
						--(50 quantities from upstream to be propagated - 37.5 total from downstream jobs) divided by the number of downstream operations (i.e. 3)  = 4.17 quantities to be adjusted for each downstream job
						--3.33 quantity distribution * 3 operations = 9.99
						--There is an insufficient 0.01 quantity, which needs to be added to the first downstream operation.

						--Using the examples above,
						--upstream starting quantity 50 - (3 * 12.5 = 37.5 total allocation for downstream) - (12.5/3 = 4.17 * 3 = 12.51) = -0.01 (negative 0.01) to be reduced.
						--upstream starting quantity 10 - (3 * 3.33 = 9.99 total allocation for downstream) - (0.01/3 = 0 = 0 = +0.01 to be added.
						ROUND(qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop --Quantity from the upstream operation (using the examples above, 50 or 10)
						- qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop --Total quantity in downstream jobs (using the examples abov, 37.5 or 9.99)
						--Using the examples above, (50 - 37.5 = 12.5) / 3 = 4.17 (rounded to two decimal places)
						--(10 - 9.99 = 0.01) / 3 = 0.00
						- ROUND((qtys_to_split.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop - qtys_to_split.qty_at_start_to_prop)/qtys_to_split.no_of_downstrm_jobs, @num_decimals)
						--Using the examples above, 4.17 * 3 = 12.51
							* qtys_to_split.no_of_downstrm_jobs, @num_decimals)
					END
				END overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op
		FROM
			(SELECT --A unique downstream operation number.
				--For example, if job A is ended and operation E was already completed, operation B will have operation number 1, C will have operation number 2, and D will have operation number 3.
				idj.operation_num

				--The first operation in the downstream for each upstream operation.
				, MIN(idj.job_sequence) first_job_seq_in_oper

				--The quantity from each upstream job to propagate.
				, MIN(idj.qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop) AS qty_from_upstrm_job_to_prop

				--The sum of proposed quantities in downstream for each upstream operation.
				, SUM(idj.qty_at_start_to_prop) AS qty_at_start_to_prop

				--The total number of operations in downstream for each upstream operation.
				, MAX(idj.job_sequence) no_of_downstrm_jobs
			 FROM immediate_downstream_jobs idj
			 GROUP BY idj.operation_num
			 ) qtys_to_split
		 )

		 --Retrieve quantities from jobs that are not in the current route.
		 --For example, when a job in operation F is ended, then the good quantities from operations F and quantities (qty_good if this job is completed or qty_at_start - qty_rejected) from G must be propagated to operation H.
		 , upstrm_jobs_not_in_this_route
		 AS
		 (SELECT upstrm_job.wo_id, upstrm_job.oper_id AS input_oper_id, upstrm_job.seq_no AS input_seq_no
			, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no
			--Determine the state of the upstream job
			, CASE WHEN upstrm_job.state_cd = 4 THEN upstrm_job.qty_prod * jr.input_percent --if the upstream job is completed, use the qty produced.
				ELSE (upstrm_job.qty_at_start - upstrm_job.qty_rejected) * jr.input_percent --if the upstream job is not completed, use the qty_at_start - qty_rejected
				END AS qty_at_start_to_prop
		  FROM
			 (--Return all the upstream operation
			 --Operations F and G are immediately upstream to the downstream operation H.
			  SELECT DISTINCT jr.wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no
			  FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
			  --Using the downstream operation identified earlier, return all the upstream jobs
			  --Using the example above for this CTE, ending a job on operation F would result returning the downstream job H.
			  INNER JOIN immediate_downstream_jobs idj ON jr.wo_id = idj.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = idj.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = idj.seq_no
			  --Limit to the current work order
			  WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
			  EXCEPT
			  --Exclude the upstream operations that are in this route.
			  --Using this example, exclude the operation F.
			  SELECT idj.wo_id, idj.input_oper_id, idj.input_seq_no, idj.oper_id, idj.seq_no
			  FROM immediate_downstream_jobs idj
			 ) upstrm_jobs --This query should return ONLY jobs that are not in the current route, for example, operation G.
		 INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = upstrm_jobs.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = upstrm_jobs.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = upstrm_jobs.seq_no AND jr.input_oper_id = upstrm_jobs.input_oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = upstrm_jobs.input_seq_no
		 INNER JOIN job upstrm_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = upstrm_job.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = upstrm_job.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = upstrm_job.seq_no
		 )

		--Setup the right quantities to allocate for downstream jobs
		 , total_qtys_for_imm_downstrm_jobs
		 AS
		 (SELECT downstrm_jobs.wo_id, downstrm_jobs.oper_id, downstrm_jobs.seq_no
		 	--Quantity to be allocated from the upstream job
			, downstrm_jobs.qty_at_start_to_prop
			 + CASE WHEN @num_decimals = 0 THEN
				--Allocate the remaining quantities (in whole) till the quantities ran out.
				--Using the example above with 10 starting quantities and 3 downstream operations, allocate the remaining 1 quantity to the first first operation in the downstream operation.
				--If the starting quantity in the upstream job has 11 quantities, allocate the remaining 2 quantities to the first two downstream operations with 1 each.
				--The aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op represents the remaining quantities to be allocated.
			 	CASE WHEN downstrm_jobs.job_sequence <= COALESCE(aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op, -1) THEN COALESCE(aqcdj.qty_distribution, 0) ELSE 0 END
			   ELSE
			   	--Determine whether the quantity proposed for downstream is insufficient
			   	--The quantity is insufficient (9.99 for example, 0.01 less from the total quantity of 10)
			   	--If 0.01 is a positive number (aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op will be > 0), and aqcdj.first_job_seq_in_ope is equivalent to the first job sequence in the opertion
			   	--add the insufficient quantity to the distribution.  Therefore, the first operation will end up with 3.34
			   	CASE WHEN COALESCE(aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op, 0) > 0 AND downstrm_jobs.job_sequence = COALESCE(aqcdj.first_job_seq_in_oper, -1) THEN COALESCE(aqcdj.qty_distribution, 0) + COALESCE(aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op, 0)

			   	--Determine whether the quantity proposed for downstream is in excess.
			   	--The quantity is in excess of 50.01
			   	--If -0.01 is a negative number (aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op will be < 0), and aqcdj.job_sequence is equivalent to the last job in the job sequence (no_of_downstrm_jobs)
			   	--add the insufficient quantity to the distribution.  Therefore, the last operation should be reduced by 0.01
			   		WHEN COALESCE(aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op, 0) < 0 AND downstrm_jobs.job_sequence = COALESCE(aqcdj.no_of_downstrm_jobs, -1) THEN COALESCE(aqcdj.qty_distribution, 0) + COALESCE(aqcdj.overage_or_insuff_qty_for_downstrm_op, 0)
			   		ELSE aqcdj.qty_distribution
			   	END
			   END qty_at_start_to_prop
		 FROM immediate_downstream_jobs downstrm_jobs
		 --Include any operations that need quantities to be adjusted.
		 LEFT OUTER JOIN adjust_qtys_for_curr_downstrm_jobs aqcdj ON downstrm_jobs.operation_num = aqcdj.operation_num
		 UNION ALL
		 --Include quantities from the upstream operations that are not in this route
		 --For example, when ending a job on F, include the quantities from the upstream operation G
		 SELECT ujnr.wo_id, ujnr.oper_id, ujnr.seq_no, ujnr.qty_at_start_to_prop
		 FROM upstrm_jobs_not_in_this_route ujnr
		 )

		--Add the next immediate downstream jobs to the list, along with the quantities that need to be propagated to those jobs.
		INSERT INTO @downstream_jobs (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, state_cd, item_id, qty_at_start_to_prop, operation_num, position)
		SELECT tqdj.wo_id, tqdj.oper_id, tqdj.seq_no, j.state_cd, j.item_id
			--SUM up all the quantities for the operation in the downstream job
			, ROUND(SUM(tqdj.qty_at_start_to_prop), @num_decimals)
			--Create a unique operation number for each job in the downstream
			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tqdj.oper_id, tqdj.seq_no)
			--Include the current position
			, @position
		FROM total_qtys_for_imm_downstrm_jobs tqdj
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON tqdj.wo_id = j.wo_id AND tqdj.oper_id = j.oper_id AND tqdj.seq_no = j.seq_no
		--Limit to the downstream jobs that have the same produced item
		--If any one of the downstream job produces different item, then stop propagting the quantities to the downstream jobs
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM immediate_downstream_jobs WHERE item_id <> @cur_item_id)
		--Limit to the upstream jobs that have the same produced item
		  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		  		  INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND j.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
		  		  INNER JOIN immediate_downstream_jobs idj ON jr.wo_id = idj.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = idj.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = idj.seq_no
		  		  WHERE j.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  		    AND j.item_id <> @cur_item_id)
		GROUP BY tqdj.wo_id, tqdj.oper_id, tqdj.seq_no, j.state_cd, j.item_id

		--If there are no more downstream jobs or the iteration has reached 50 cycles (due to misconfiguration leading to infinite cycles), then exit.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @downstream_jobs WHERE position = @position) OR (@position >= 50)
			BREAK;
	END

	--Update the starting quantities to the downstream jobs
	UPDATE job
	SET qty_at_start = ds.qty_at_start_to_prop
	FROM @downstream_jobs ds
	WHERE job.wo_id = ds.wo_id
	  AND job.oper_id = ds.oper_id
	  AND job.seq_no = ds.seq_no
	  --Exclude the job that is currently ended.
	  AND ds.position > 1
END

create view vw_MaterialProducedActual as
select ip.item_id as MaterialId,
--item_reas.reas_desc as MaterialType,
je.Value9 as MaterialType,
je.value3 as EventName,
je.event_type as EventType,
je.lot_no as Lot,
je.Value2 as Location,
je.segment_requirement_id as SegmentRequirementId,
ip.wo_id as ProductionRequestId,
ip.oper_id as ProcessSegmentId,
ip.segment_response_id as SegmentResponseId,
ip.qty_prod as Quantity,
je.value7 as QuantityUnitOfMeasure,
ip.sublot_no as Sublot,
je.event_time_utc as EventDateUtc,
je.subsegment_id as SubsegmentId,
je.value4 as Personnel,
je.value5 as SerialNumber,
je.row_id as EventGlobId,
ip.event_id as EventId,

(@ent_id  int  ,
 @raw_reas_cd  NVARCHAR(40)  ,
 @reas_cd  int ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--07/16/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00080625: util/Util_Reas_Link.cls middleware code has several references to raw_reas_cd as an integer instead of string
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT util_reas_link.ent_id
            ,util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd
            ,util_reas_link.reas_cd
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,util_reas.reas_desc
            ,util_reas_link.last_edit_comment
            ,util_reas_link.last_edit_by
            ,util_reas_link.last_edit_at
  FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_link.ent_id = ent.ent_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
WHERE ((util_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas_link.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (util_reas_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_EditMasterSiloConfigData]
	@Equipment_ID          INT
  , @EquipmentName         NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
  , @StorageEquipment_ID   INT
  , @StorageEquipment_Name NVARCHAR(100)
  , @type                  NVARCHAR(50)
  , @item_group            NVARCHAR(50)
  , @user_name             NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
  , @RowID                 INT
AS
BEGIN

select @Equipment_ID,@EquipmentName,@StorageEquipment_ID,@StorageEquipment_Name,@type,@item_group,@RowID,@user_name

	IF EXISTS (SELECT
				   o.jb_item_id				 
			   FROM ofi_su_selection o WITH(NOLOCK)
			   INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = o.su_ent_id
			   INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON
				   j.wo_id = o.wo_id
				   AND j.oper_id = o.oper_id
				   AND j.seq_no = o.seq_no
			   WHERE
				   e.ent_id = @StorageEquipment_ID
				   AND j.state_cd = (SELECT
										 state_cd
									 FROM job_state WITH(NOLOCK)
									 WHERE LOWER(state_desc) LIKE LOWER('%RUNNING%')) )
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This storage unit is being used and can’t be modified now', 16, 1);--('@@ErrorStorageUnitUsed@@',16,1);
		-- Retrieve datas used on update execution
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_UpdateSiloConfig]
			 @Equipment_ID = @Equipment_ID
		   , @EquipName = @EquipmentName
		   , @StorageEntID = @StorageEquipment_ID
		   , @StorageEquipName = @StorageEquipment_Name
		   , @type = @type
		   , @item_group = @item_group
		   , @RowID = @RowID
		   , @user_name = @user_name
		--RAISERROR('This storage unit is being used and can’dsfsdfsdfsdfsdfsfdsdfsdfsdfsdft be modified now', 16, 1);
	END
END

		<parameter>Red value</parameter>
		<condition>Pass</condition>
		<displayValue>201</displayValue>
		<displayUnits/>
		<limitType>InSpec</limitType>
		<modDate>2023-08-19T19:58:23</modDate>
	</LIMSResults>
	<LIMSResults>
		<limssampleid>S-230818-00221</limssampleid>
		<remarks>Damaged bag does not affect results</remarks>
		<disclaimer>The sample bag was damaged</disclaimer>
		<testmethod>Color Tests</testmethod>
		<testcompleted>2023-08-19T20:58:24</testcompleted>

		<datasetcompleted>2023-08-19T21:58:24</datasetcompleted>

	<LIMSResults>
		<limssampleid>S-230818-00221</limssampleid>
		<remarks>Damaged bag does not affect results</remarks>
		<disclaimer>The sample bag was damaged</disclaimer>
		<testmethod>Color Tests</testmethod>
		<testcompleted>2023-08-19T20:58:24</testcompleted>
		<datasetName>Color</datasetName>
		<datasetinstance>1</datasetinstance>
		<variant>Lovibond</variant>
		<datasetcompleted>2023-08-19T21:58:24</datasetcompleted>
		<parameter>Yellow value</parameter>
		<condition>Pass</condition>
		<displayValue>310</displayValue>
		<displayUnits/>
		<limitType>InSpec</limitType>

	-- ' (apostrophe or single quote) REPLACE WITH ' 
	SET @xml_data_in = REPLACE(@xml_data_in, '''', ''');

	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(254) = '';
	DECLARE @msg_output NVARCHAR(500) = '';
	DECLARE @cur_sys_local_time DATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @converted_data_xml XML = CONVERT(XML, @xml_data_in);
	DECLARE @i_min INT;
	DECLARE @i_max INT;
	DECLARE @char_id INT32 = NULL;-- default value
	DECLARE @sample_id INT32 = NULL;-- default value
	DECLARE @value_no INT32_NULL = NULL;
	DECLARE @result_value TFLOAT;
	DECLARE @act_sample_size INT32_NULL = NULL;
	DECLARE @created_by STRING80_NULL = 'MES-LIMS interface';
	DECLARE @created_at_utc TDATETIME = NULL;
	DECLARE @created_at_local TDATETIME;
	DECLARE @created_at_tz INT32 = NULL;
	DECLARE @superseded INT32_NULL = NULL;
	DECLARE @last_edit_comment NOTES_NULL = 'inserted through MES-LIMS interface';
	DECLARE @validate_control_rules LOGICAL = 1;
	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL;
	DECLARE @last_edit_at DATETIME = NULL;
	DECLARE @row_id INT = NULL;
	DECLARE @control_rule_violations NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL;
	DECLARE @attr_id_lims_value INT;
	DECLARE @result_value_for_non_numeric_type FLOAT = - 999999;	-- default value in case if the result value is not numeric. 
	DECLARE @limssampleid NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @remarks NVARCHAR(254);
	DECLARE @disclaimer NVARCHAR(254);
	DECLARE @testmethod NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @testcompleted DATETIME;
	DECLARE @datasetName NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @datasetinstance INT;
	DECLARE @variant NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @datasetcompleted DATETIME;
	DECLARE @parameter NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @condition NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @displayValue NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @displayUnits NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @limitType NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @modDate DATETIME;
	DECLARE @tbl_ResultData TABLE (
		row_id INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
		,limssampleid NVARCHAR(40)
		,remarks NVARCHAR(254)
		,disclaimer NVARCHAR(254)
		,testmethod NVARCHAR(40)
		,testcompleted DATETIME
		,datasetName NVARCHAR(80)
		,datasetinstance INT
		,variant NVARCHAR(40)
		,datasetcompleted DATETIME
		,parameter NVARCHAR(40)
		,condition NVARCHAR(20)
		,displayValue NVARCHAR(40)
		,displayUnits NVARCHAR(40)
		,limitType NVARCHAR(40)
		,modDate DATETIME
		);

	INSERT INTO @tbl_ResultData (
		limssampleid
		,remarks
		,disclaimer
		,testmethod
		,testcompleted
		,datasetName
		,datasetinstance
		,variant
		,datasetcompleted
		,parameter
		,condition
		,displayValue
		,displayUnits
		,limitType
		,modDate
		)
	SELECT C.value('limssampleid[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS limssampleid
		,C.value('remarks[1]', 'nvarchar(254)') AS remarks
		,C.value('disclaimer[1]', 'nvarchar(254)') AS disclaimer
		,C.value('testmethod[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS testmethod
		,C.value('testcompleted[1]', 'datetime') AS testcompleted
		,C.value('datasetName[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS datasetName
		,C.value('datasetinstance[1]', 'int') AS datasetinstance
		,C.value('variant[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS variant
		,C.value('datasetcompleted[1]', 'datetime') AS datasetcompleted
		,C.value('parameter[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS parameter
		,C.value('condition[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS condition
		,C.value('displayValue[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS displayValue
		,C.value('displayUnits[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS displayUnits
		,C.value('limitType[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS limitType
		,C.value('modDate[1]', 'datetime') AS modDate
	FROM @converted_data_xml.nodes('/ArrayOfLIMSResults/LIMSResults') AS T(C);

	SELECT @i_min = MIN(row_id)
		,@i_max = MAX(row_id)
	FROM @tbl_ResultData;

	SELECT @attr_id_lims_value = attr_id
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'lims_value'
		AND attr_grp = 11;-- attr_grp = 11 means result_attr

	SELECT @limssampleid = limssampleid
	FROM @tbl_ResultData
	WHERE row_id = @i_min;

	SELECT @sample_id = sample_id
	FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE spare1 = @limssampleid;-- sample.spare1 field stores lims sample id

	-- check the sample exist in mes or not; if not throw an error
	IF (@sample_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- string_id 500006 = 'The given LIMS sample not exist in MES DB.  LIMS Sample id: '
		SELECT  @msg = CONCAT (dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500006, NULL, NULL), @limssampleid) ;
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';

		RAISERROR (
				@msg_output
				,16
				,1
				);

		Return -1 ;
	END;

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;

		WHILE (@i_min <= @i_max)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @limssampleid = limssampleid
				,@remarks = remarks
				,@disclaimer = disclaimer
				,@testmethod = testmethod
				,@testcompleted = testcompleted
				,@datasetName = datasetName
				,@datasetinstance = datasetinstance
				,@variant = variant
				,@datasetcompleted = datasetcompleted
				,@parameter = parameter
				,@condition = condition
				,@displayValue = displayValue
				,@displayUnits = displayUnits
				,@limitType = limitType
				,@modDate = modDate
			FROM @tbl_ResultData
			WHERE row_id = @i_min;

			-- get the characterstic(parameter) id from MES characterstic table.  spare1 = parameter name, spare2 = test method and spare3 = variant in characterstic table.
			SELECT @char_id = char_id
			FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE spare1 = @parameter
				AND spare2 = @testmethod
				AND spare3 = @variant;

			-- if the given characterstic exist in MESDB, set its value against the given sample id
			IF (@char_id IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				-- use the std. SP sp_I_result to create results
				-- if numeric result, add directly in result table using std SP with actual value; otherwise set result attr with non-numeric value what we have.
				-- for non-numeric type result, first create a record in result table with value as -999999, and then set the actual value in result_attr table.  
				-- the value -999999 indicates its actual value present in result_attr table.
				SET @result_value = @result_value_for_non_numeric_type;-- default initialization 

				IF (ISNUMERIC(@displayValue) = 1)
				BEGIN
					SET @result_value = CONVERT(FLOAT, @displayValue);
				END;

				EXEC sp_I_Result 
					@sample_id = @sample_id
					,@char_id = @char_id
					,@value_no = @value_no OUTPUT
					,@result_value = @result_value
					,@act_sample_size = @act_sample_size
					,@created_by = @created_by
					,@created_at_utc = @created_at_utc
					,@created_at_local = @cur_sys_local_time
					,@created_at_tz = @created_at_tz
					,@superseded = @superseded
					,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
					,@validate_control_rules = @validate_control_rules
					,@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
					,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT
					,@row_id = @row_id OUTPUT
					,@control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations OUTPUT;

				IF (ISNUMERIC(@displayValue) = 0)
				BEGIN
					EXEC sp_I_Result_Attr 
						@sample_id = @sample_id
						,@char_id = @char_id
						,@value_no = @value_no
						,@attr_id = @attr_id_lims_value
						,@attr_value = @displayValue
						,@notes = NULL
						,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
						,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT;
				END;
			END;

			--ELSE BEGIN
			--	-- check need to insert characteristic or not.  at moment not inserting the missing characteristic in mes table.
			--END ;	
			
			-- reset @char_id
			SELECT @char_id = NULL;

			-- increment the row id
			SET @i_min = @i_min + 1;
		END;

		-- If the SPs execution  succeeds, commit the transaction.  
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'LIMS Sample Id: ' + @limssampleid + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';

		SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @msg = ERROR_MESSAGE();
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';

		-- XACT_STATE:  
		-- If 1, the transaction is committable.  
		-- If -1, the transaction is uncommittable and should be rolled back.  
		-- XACT_STATE = 0 means that there is no transaction and  
		--     a commit or rollback operation would generate an error.  
		-- Test whether the transaction is uncommittable.  
		IF (XACT_STATE()) = - 1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

			RAISERROR (
					@msg_output
					,16
					,1
					);

			Return -1 ;
		END;

		-- Test whether the transaction is committable.
		-- You may want to commit a transaction in a catch block if you want to commit changes to statements that ran prior to the error.
		--IF (XACT_STATE()) = 1
		--BEGIN
		--	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

		--	SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'LIMS Sample Id: ' + @limssampleid + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';			
		--END;

		SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
	END CATCH
END

-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch the information for label printing 
--				used in auto v validation

-- ===========================================================================================

-- 0.01.00	AP							2023-11-14			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM					2026-04-23			Updated to get the overlay type
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_auto_release_check_LM]
	@wo_id   NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
  , @oper_id NVARCHAR(500) = NULL
  , @seq_no  INT           = 0
  , @user_id NVARCHAR(100) = 'AutoRelease'
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Overlay_Data  NVARCHAR(MAX)
		  , @content_Type  NVARCHAR(100)
		  , @costumer_info NVARCHAR(MAX)
		  , @result        NVARCHAR(MAX)
		  SET @user_id  = 'AutoRelease'

	DECLARE @labeldetailsTable TABLE
	(
		Overlay_Data  NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , content_Type  NVARCHAR(100)
	  , costumer_info NVARCHAR(MAX)
	)

	DECLARE @labelJobdetailsTable TABLE
	(
		jobdetailsattrid  NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , contenttypeattrid  NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  
	)

	INSERT INTO @labeldetailsTable
	(
		Overlay_Data
	  , content_Type
	  , costumer_info
	)
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_lm_get_preoverlayConfig]
		 @wo_id = @wo_id
	   , @oper_id = @oper_id
	   , @seq_no = @seq_no
  --To get the label data  
	SELECT TOP 1
		@Overlay_Data = Overlay_Data
	  , @content_Type = content_Type
	  , @costumer_info = costumer_info
	FROM @labeldetailsTable
	ORDER BY
		Overlay_Data
	
	DECLARE @label_overlay NVARCHAR(40),
			@process_id NVARCHAR(40); 

	SELECT @process_id = process_id 
	FROM oper 
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id

	SELECT @label_overlay = p.attr_value 
	FROM process_attr p 
		JOIN  attr a ON p.attr_id = a.attr_id 
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'LabelOverlay'
	AND p.process_id = @process_id 


	IF	( (	@costumer_info = 'Absent'
			OR @costumer_info = 'Absent'
			OR @costumer_info IS NULL)
			AND
		 (  @Overlay_Data = 'NoData'
			OR @Overlay_Data = 'Absent'
			OR @Overlay_Data IS NULL )
		)
		OR 
		@label_overlay = 'Manual'
		
	BEGIN
		SET @result =[dbo].[fn_s_ofi_getLangString]  (300052,null,10)  --Error code--Error code
	
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
	INSERT INTO @labelJobdetailsTable
	(
		jobdetailsattrid
	  ,contenttypeattrid
	)
		EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_saveOverlayData]--Insert data for label printing 
			 @wo_id = @wo_id
		   , @oper_id = @oper_id
		   , @seq_no = @seq_no
		   , @overlayData = @Overlay_Data
		   , @contentType = @content_Type
		   , @user_id = @user_id
		SET @result = 'Successful'
	END
	SELECT
		@result AS resultOut
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_Account_Labor]
(
	@session_id				INT,
	@ent_id					INT,
	@user_id				NVARCHAR(40),
	@start_time				DATETIME,
	@lab_cd					NVARCHAR(40),
	@dept_id				NVARCHAR(40),
	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = 0,
	@pct_to_apply			FLOAT OUTPUT,
	@lab_usage_log_id		INT OUTPUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_I_Ent_Logon_Account_Labor
-- Description	      -	After every insert into ent_logon table via sp_I_Ent_Logon causes this sp to account
--						labor usage for the user using this entity.  Consolidated code from sp_ent_logon_aft_ins sp
--						and ent_logon_after insert trigger to improve performance.
-- Author			  - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	03/31/2003
-- Version			  - 1.5.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 05/09/2003		Raghu						Call sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor to crete duplicate records for other
--												entities as labor_start doesnot vary in milli seconds with other previous records.
-- 11/13/2003		Raghu			2.0.9		While deleting labor_usage where duration < 2 secs, included labor_start to check
--												for last 2 minutes - as all the labor transactions will be finished in a minute or
--												two - For performance improvement
-- 12/05/2003		Raghu			2.0.14		(HD# 4156) Changes included to handle Multi-Job Execs
-- 08/07/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE	@labor_start			DATETIME
	,	@event_time				DATETIME
	,	@def_lab_cd				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@def_dept_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@shift_id				INT
	,	@shift_start			DATETIME
	,	@log_id					INT
	,	@can_capture_labor		BIT
	,	@total_pct_lab_to_apply	FLOAT
	,	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply	FLOAT
	,	@LT_cenpercent			BIT
	,	@MT_cenpercent 			BIT
	,	@current_time			DATETIME

BEGIN

	--shift_id, shift_start read from ent table for this ent_id. If null set id = 0 and start = Now
	SELECT @shift_id = ent.cur_shift_id, @shift_start = ent.cur_shift_start_time_local, @can_capture_labor = ent.can_capture_labor
	FROM ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @ent_id

	--Insert a new row into the labor_usage table for each new row in ent_logon with
	--active flag set to indicate that labor collection is occurring.
	IF @can_capture_labor = 0 BEGIN
		SET @pct_to_apply = 0
		SET @lab_usage_log_id = NULL
		RETURN
	END

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

	--If no active labor sessions are found for the entity, user
	-- IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM labor_usage WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id
			AND labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_usage.active = 1) BEGIN

		--If null set id = 0 and start = Now
		IF @shift_id IS NULL SET @shift_id = 0
		IF @shift_start IS NULL SET @shift_start = @current_time
		IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )

		--If cur_lab_cd and cur_dept_id NOT included set them to the default values from the user_name table for this user.
		--If user_name table doesnt have these values, get the default values from labor_exec
		IF (@lab_cd IS NULL OR @dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @def_lab_cd = CASE WHEN user_name.def_lab_cd IS NULL THEN
							(SELECT MIN(lab_cd) FROM labor_cat)
						ELSE user_name.def_lab_cd
						END,
				@def_dept_id = CASE WHEN user_name.def_dept_id IS NULL THEN
							(SELECT MIN(dept_id) FROM labor_dept)
						ELSE user_name.def_dept_id
						END
			FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id
		END  --End of (@lab_cd IS NULL OR @dept_id IS NULL)

		IF @lab_cd IS NULL SET @lab_cd = @def_lab_cd
		IF @dept_id IS NULL  SET @dept_id = @def_dept_id

		--Needs to be removed/changed in future
		IF @lab_cd IS NULL SELECT @lab_cd = MIN(lab_cd) FROM labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK)
		IF @dept_id IS NULL SELECT @dept_id = MIN(dept_id) FROM labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK)

		--Check 'Allow user to account for less than 100% of his time<1108>'
		SELECT @LT_cenpercent = ISNULL(attr_value,0) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 188
		--Check 'Allow user to account for more than 100% of his time<1109>'
		SELECT @MT_cenpercent = ISNULL(attr_value,0) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 189

		SELECT @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = AVG(pct_lab_to_apply) FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id <> @ent_id AND ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply <> 0

		IF @cur_pct_lab_to_apply IS NULL SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = 1

		SET @event_time = @start_time
		SET @labor_start = @event_time

		IF (@LT_cenpercent = 0) AND (@MT_cenpercent = 0) BEGIN

			SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(a.total_pct_lab_to_apply) FROM
				(SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ISNULL(pct_lab_to_apply,0) total_pct_lab_to_apply FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id) a

			IF @total_pct_lab_to_apply IS NULL SET @total_pct_lab_to_apply = 0
			SET @total_pct_lab_to_apply = @total_pct_lab_to_apply + @cur_pct_lab_to_apply

			--Insert a set of labor records for this user who logged into other entities
/*			INSERT INTO labor_usage(labor_start,user_id, ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
				  dept_id, shift_id,shift_start,pct_to_apply,active,duration,comments)
			SELECT @event_time,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
				dept_id, shift_id,shift_start, pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply ,active,0,comments
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

			--Close all the old labor records after breaking the percentage for this user who logged into other entities
			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start, @event_time), active = 0
			WHERE active = 1 AND (user_id = @user_id AND labor_start <> @event_time)*/

			SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply / @total_pct_lab_to_apply

			--Insert a new labor record for this user for the current entity
			EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor @user_id, @ent_id, @labor_start, @lab_cd, @dept_id
				, @shift_id, @shift_start, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, @total_pct_lab_to_apply, 1
				, 0, @log_id OUTPUT

			--For all the entities, Update ent_logon with the current labor usage log_id for this user
			UPDATE ent_logon SET pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply,
				ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id = labor_usage.log_id FROM labor_usage
			WHERE ent_logon.user_id = labor_usage.user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id
			  AND ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

			SET @pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply
			SET @lab_usage_log_id = @log_id

		END  --End of (@LT_cenpercent = 0) AND (@MT_cenpercent = 0)
		ELSE IF (@LT_cenpercent = 1) AND (@MT_cenpercent = 1) BEGIN
			SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = ISNULL(@pct_to_apply, 1)

			EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor @user_id, @ent_id, @labor_start, @lab_cd, @dept_id
				, @shift_id, @shift_start, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, 0
				, 0, @log_id OUTPUT

			SET @pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply
			SET @lab_usage_log_id = @log_id

		END  --End of (@LT_cenpercent = 1) AND (@MT_cenpercent = 1)
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(a.total_pct_lab_to_apply) FROM
			  (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ISNULL(pct_lab_to_apply,0) total_pct_lab_to_apply FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id) a

			IF @total_pct_lab_to_apply IS NULL SET @total_pct_lab_to_apply = 0
			IF (@pct_to_apply IS NULL) OR (@pct_to_apply = 0) SET @pct_to_apply = 1
			SET @total_pct_lab_to_apply = @total_pct_lab_to_apply + @pct_to_apply

			IF ((@LT_cenpercent = 0 AND @total_pct_lab_to_apply < 1) OR (@MT_cenpercent = 0 AND @total_pct_lab_to_apply > 1)) BEGIN
				SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = @pct_to_apply

/*				INSERT INTO labor_usage(labor_start,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
					  dept_id, shift_id,shift_start,pct_to_apply,active,duration,comments)
				SELECT @event_time,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
				   dept_id, shift_id,shift_start,pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply,active,0,comments
				FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

				UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start, @event_time), active = 0
				WHERE active = 1 AND (user_id = @user_id and labor_start <> @event_time)*/

				SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply / @total_pct_lab_to_apply

				EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor @user_id, @ent_id, @labor_start, @lab_cd, @dept_id
					, @shift_id, @shift_start, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, @total_pct_lab_to_apply, 1
					, 0, @log_id OUTPUT

				UPDATE ent_logon SET pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply,
					ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id = labor_usage.log_id
				FROM labor_usage
				WHERE ent_logon.user_id = labor_usage.user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id
				  AND ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

			  	SET @pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply
				  SET @lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			END  --End of ((@LT_cenpercent = 0 AND @total_pct_lab_to_apply < 1) OR (@MT_cenpercent = 0 AND @total_pct_lab_to_apply > 1))
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = ISNULL(@pct_to_apply, 1)

				EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor @user_id, @ent_id, @labor_start, @lab_cd, @dept_id
					, @shift_id, @shift_start, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, 0
					, 0, @log_id OUTPUT

				SET @pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply

				SET @lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
			END  --End of ELSE
		END  --End of (@LT_cenpercent <> 1) AND (@MT_cenpercent <> 1)

	END  --End of NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM labor_usage WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id ....
	ELSE BEGIN --User already logged on to this entity in different session
		SELECT @cur_pct_lab_to_apply = MIN(pct_lab_to_apply), @log_id = MAX(cur_lab_usage_log_id) FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND session_id <> @session_id

		SET @pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply
		SET @lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
	END

	DELETE FROM labor_usage WHERE user_id = @user_id AND active = 0 AND duration < 2 AND labor_start_local >= DATEADD(mi, -2, @current_time)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_DoAutoShiftChanges]
(@ent_id		INT32 = NULL
,@current_local_time TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Ent_DoAutoShiftChanges
-- Description				- Change the shifts for all the entities.
-- Author					- Raghu
-- Date Created				- 10/13/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
--09/25/2008	Raghu 	    3.5	L00082286, L00083732, L00084282, L00084592 ; UCO State Change and deadlock resolution
--01/25/2012	Raghu		Generate samples for the shift start
--11/19/2014	Abhay Pandey 5.0 CR#L00124219 - Changes done in order to populate a sample lot instead of the last in lot in case of a particular
--								scenario.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
-- 02/07/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 928814 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00146852 (HF CR L00146752: QM auto samples not being generated randomly.)
-- 04/01/2019	Surya		6.1	UserStory: 1120674 - MOL: As AVEVA, I want to merge L00151773 (HF CR L00150908: SP DoAutoShiftChanges to investigate inefficiency with the query.)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	 @current_time_utc		TDATETIME
	,@current_time_local		TDATETIME
	,@start_time			TDATETIME
	,@end_time			TDATETIME
	,@shift_id			INT32
	,@break1_start			TDATETIME
	,@break1_end			TDATETIME
	,@break2_start			TDATETIME
	,@break2_end			TDATETIME
	,@break3_start			TDATETIME
	,@break3_end			TDATETIME
	,@cur_shift_id			INT32
	,@cur_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@cur_shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME
	,@tz_temp			INT32
	,@in_ent_id			INT32
	,@hie_level			INT32
	,@ent_time_zone_bias_value INT32
	,@start_time_utc TDATETIME
    ,@end_time_utc TDATETIME
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value), @in_ent_id = @ent_id

	DECLARE @shift_ents	TABLE(
		ent_id INT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
		cur_shift_id INT,
		cur_shift_start_time_utc DATETIME,
		cur_shift_start_time_local DATETIME,
        cur_shift_end_time_utc DATETIME,
		shift_started INT,
		hie_level	INT,
		act_shift_id	INT,
		act_shift_start_time_utc	DATETIME)

	IF (@current_local_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @current_local_time = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, GETUTCDATE())
		SET @current_local_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_local_time )
	END
	ELSE
		SET @time_zone_bias_value = DATEDIFF(MI, GETUTCDATE(), @current_local_time)

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @current_local_time, @tz_temp, @current_time_utc OUTPUT

	--The purpose of this insertion is to indicate the shift change process is started;
	--so that other transactions running on different threads can be put on hold till the shift change process is complete
	INSERT INTO qm_context (context_ent_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, is_job_running, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES (NULL, -1, NULL, NULL, NULL, 2, 'admin', @current_time_utc)

	/* Retain client time zone offset as this will be needed when comparing against shift_to_go values */
	SET @current_time_local = @current_local_time

	--Retrieve alll entities that can schedule shifts and default all entities shift_processed flag to 0.
	INSERT INTO @shift_ents (ent_id, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local,cur_shift_end_time_utc, shift_started)
	SELECT ent_id, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local, cur_shift_end_time_utc, 0
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (ent_id = @in_ent_id OR @in_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND can_sched_shifts = 1

	DECLARE shift_sched_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT	ent_id, start_time, end_time, shift_id, break1_start, break1_end
			,	break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end
		FROM shift_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (ent_id = @in_ent_id OR @in_ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (start_time <= @current_time_local AND end_time > @current_time_local)
		ORDER BY ent_id, shift_id, start_time, end_time

	OPEN shift_sched_csr
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_sched_csr
		INTO @ent_id, @start_time, @end_time, @shift_id, @break1_start, @break1_end,
			 @break2_start, @break2_end, @break3_start, @break3_end

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		-- You are looping through entities, and both @ent_time_zone_bias_value and thus @current_local_time are Entity Local
		-- Clear vars out so they won't be treated as inputs
		-- SET @current_local_time = NULL
		-- EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @current_time_utc, @current_local_time OUTPUT, NULL

		-- Get Client Local start_time from shift_to_go and adjust it to be Entity Local
		-- SET @start_time_utc = NULL
		-- EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @start_time_utc OUTPUT, @start_time, NULL
		-- SET @start_time = NULL
		-- SET @ent_time_zone_bias_value = NULL
		-- EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @start_time_utc, @start_time OUTPUT, @ent_time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT

		--Retrieve the shift start time for this entity.
		SELECT	@cur_shift_id = cur_shift_id
			,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
			,	@cur_shift_start_time_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
		FROM @shift_ents
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Start the shift for this entity ONLY if any of the below is true.
		IF (ISNULL(@cur_shift_id, -999) <> @shift_id OR ISNULL(@cur_shift_start_time_local, @current_local_time - 365) <> @start_time)
		  AND (ISNULL(@cur_shift_start_time_local, @current_local_time - 365) <= @current_local_time
				OR DATEADD(mi, -90, @cur_shift_start_time_local) <= @current_local_time
				) BEGIN

			--Start the shift for this entity.
			EXEC sp_U_Ent_StartShift @ent_id, @shift_id, @start_time, @end_time, @ent_time_zone_bias_value
			UPDATE @shift_ents SET shift_started = 1, hie_level = 1, act_shift_id = @shift_id, act_shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@ent_time_zone_bias_value, @start_time) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		ELSE
			UPDATE @shift_ents SET shift_started = 2, hie_level = 1, act_shift_id = @shift_id, act_shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@ent_time_zone_bias_value, @start_time) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END
	CLOSE shift_sched_csr
	DEALLOCATE shift_sched_csr

	DECLARE shift_end_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT ent_id, cur_shift_id FROM @shift_ents
		WHERE (ent_id = @in_ent_id OR @in_ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND shift_started = 0 AND cur_shift_id <> 0 -- Only include entities that are not already on (No Shift)

	OPEN shift_end_csr
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_end_csr INTO @ent_id, @cur_shift_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		-- You are looping through entities, and both @ent_time_zone_bias_value and thus @current_local_time are Entity Local
		-- Clear vars out so they won't be treated as inputs
		SET @ent_time_zone_bias_value = NULL
		SET @current_local_time = NULL
		EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @current_time_utc, @current_local_time OUTPUT, @ent_time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT
		-- Calculate next start time if it has not already been calculated.
		SELECT @end_time = MIN(start_time) FROM SHIFT_TO_GO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  start_time >= @current_local_time
		EXEC sp_U_Ent_StartShift @ent_id, 0, @current_local_time,@end_time, @ent_time_zone_bias_value
		UPDATE @shift_ents SET shift_started = 3, hie_level = 1, act_shift_id = 0, act_shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@ent_time_zone_bias_value, @current_local_time) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END
	CLOSE shift_end_csr
	DEALLOCATE shift_end_csr

	--If a new shift is started (1) for an entity OR the current shift is ended (3) for an entity,
	--then generate samples for that entity using all the frequencies.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM qm_context WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id >= 0 AND is_job_running = 2)
		EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = NULL, @event_time_utc = NULL
				,@event_type = 4, @freq_of_sample_update = NULL
				,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value

	DELETE FROM qm_context WHERE is_job_running = 2;

    --CR#L00124219 - Changes done for populating sample lot in sample_to_go table instead of the last in lot. The lot is to be populated only when we are in shift
    -- 0, the frequency type is Calendar type and the "Future Sample Generation" field has been set some value.
     IF((SELECT  COUNT(sf.offset_end) FROM qm_spec qs WITH(NOLOCK)
						 INNER JOIN sample_plan_freq_link spfl WITH(NOLOCK) on qs.plan_id=spfl.plan_id
						 INNER JOIN sample_freq sf WITH(NOLOCK) on spfl.freq_id = sf.freq_id WHERE qs.ent_id = @in_ent_id AND sf.freq_type = 1 AND sf.offset_end is not NULL) > 0
						 AND @cur_shift_id = 0)
	BEGIN
		--Changing the regen_samples field value from 0 to 1 in order to populate a sample lot instead of the last in the lot to sample_to_go table.
		UPDATE db_status SET regen_samples = 1
		EXEC sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id = NULL, @event_time_utc = NULL
				,@event_type = 0, @freq_of_sample_update = NULL
				,@return_spec_plan_freq_context = 0, @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Step_Data]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @step_no  int  ,
 @lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
 @state_cd  int  ,
 @act_start_time_utc  datetime  ,
 @act_start_time_local  datetime  ,
 @act_finish_time_utc  datetime  ,
 @act_finish_time_local  datetime  ,
 @start_user_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @finish_user_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @data_user_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @form_done  bit  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare5  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare6  nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @row_id int ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 04/01/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Included row_id param - Part of DB Changes V1.6.0
--12/02/2003	Raghu		2.0.13	Included job_step, job_step_grp in the FROM clause to get job_step_grp.repeatability
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--08/31/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--12/27/2007	AML			3.4.0	Added collect_data and certify to select statement for periodic data collection
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--IF @act_start_time IS NOT NULL SET @act_start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @act_start_time)
--IF @act_finish_time IS NOT NULL SET @act_finish_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @act_finish_time)

SELECT jsd.wo_id
    ,jsd.oper_id
    ,jsd.seq_no
    ,jsd.step_no
    ,jsd.lot_no
    ,jsd.sublot_no
    ,jsd.state_cd
    ,dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisStep(js.row_id, jsd.row_id, jsd.state_cd) AS collect_data
    ,dbo.fn_DL_IsCertReqdForThisStep(jsd.wo_id, jsd.oper_id, jsd.seq_no, jsd.step_no, jsd.lot_no, jsd.sublot_no, jsd.state_cd) AS certify
    ,jsd.act_start_time_utc
    ,jsd.act_start_time_local
    ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, jsd.act_start_time_utc ) act_start_time
    ,jsd.act_finish_time_utc
    ,jsd.act_finish_time_local
    ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, jsd.act_finish_time_utc ) act_finish_time
    ,jsd.step_data
    ,jsd.step_data_time_utc
    ,jsd.step_data_time_local
    ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, jsd.step_data_time_utc ) step_data_time
    ,jsd.start_user_id
    ,jsd.finish_user_id
    ,jsd.data_user_id
    ,jsd.form_done
    ,jsd.spare1
    ,jsd.spare2
    ,jsd.spare3
    ,jsd.spare4
    ,jsd.spare5
    ,jsd.spare6
    ,jsd.last_edit_comment
    ,jsd.last_edit_by
    ,jsd.last_edit_at
    ,jsd.row_id
    ,jsg.repeatability
FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no AND js.step_no = jsd.step_no
	INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsg.wo_id = js.wo_id AND jsg.oper_id = js.oper_id AND jsg.seq_no = js.seq_no AND jsg.step_grp_id = js.step_grp_id
WHERE (
		(jsd.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.act_start_time_utc >= @act_start_time_utc OR @act_start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.act_start_time_local >= @act_start_time_local OR @act_start_time_local IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.act_finish_time_utc >= @act_finish_time_utc OR @act_finish_time_utc IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.act_finish_time_local >= @act_finish_time_local OR @act_finish_time_local IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.start_user_id = @start_user_id OR @start_user_id IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.finish_user_id = @finish_user_id OR @finish_user_id IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.data_user_id = @data_user_id OR @data_user_id IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.form_done = ABS(@form_done) OR @form_done IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.spare5 = @spare5 OR @spare5 IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.spare6 = @spare6 OR @spare6 IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
		(jsd.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
	)

	FROM deleted d
	WHERE process.process_id = d.process_id

		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN

			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Cannot delete the oper_step_grp of a certified process<3400>', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), GETUTCDATE(), 120) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE oper_step_grp_cursor

END
