CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_Folder_GetFiles]
(
	@item_id				NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,	@oper_id				NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,	@ent_id					INT = NULL
,	@ver_id					NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,	@wo_id					NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,	@run_ent_id				INT = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - SP_SA_Folder_GetFiles
-- Description      - Select files ......
-- Author			- Raghu
-- Date Created     -
-- Version          -
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 09/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 04/09/2007		Raghu           3.2.6		Included entity_file records on the return recordset.
-- 05/25/2007		Raghu           3.2.1		Included run_on_ent parameter to return all the entity files from the run on entity.
-- 07/11/2007		AML				3.2.1		Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SELECT	file_path
		,	item_file.file_desc
		,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(item_file.file_path) AS file_type
		,	last_modified
		,	file_size
		,	author
		,	null AS downl_dir
		,	0 AS from_id_h
		,	edit_level AS edit_level_h
		,	view_level AS view_level_h
		,	print_level AS print_level_h
		,	0 AS download_h
		,	0 AS down_level_h
		,	view_args AS viewer_h
		,	edit_args AS editor_h
	FROM item_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN file_type ft WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(item_file.file_path) = ft.file_ext
	WHERE item_id = @item_id
	UNION
	SELECT	file_path
		,	wo_file.file_desc
		,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(wo_file.file_path) AS file_type
		,	last_modified
		,   file_size
		,	author
		,	null AS downl_dir
		,	1 AS from_id_h
		,	edit_level AS edit_level_h
		,	view_level AS view_level_h
		,	print_level AS print_level_h
		,	0 AS download_h
		,	0 AS down_level_h
		,	view_args AS viewer_h
		,	edit_args AS editor_h
	FROM wo_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN file_type ft WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(wo_file.file_path) = ft.file_ext
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	UNION
	SELECT	file_path
		,	folder_file.file_desc
		,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(folder_file.file_path) AS file_type
		,	last_modified
		,	file_size
		,	author
		,	(SELECT TOP 1 downl_dir FROM folder_distr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
				AND ver_id = @ver_id)
			AS downl_dir
		,	2 AS from_id_h
		,	edit_level AS edit_level_h
		,	view_level AS view_level_h
		,	print_level AS print_level_h
		,	0 AS download_h
		,	0 AS down_level_h
		,	view_args AS viewer_h
		,	edit_args AS editor_h
	FROM folder_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN file_type ft WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(folder_file.file_path) = ft.file_ext
	WHERE	item_id = @item_id
		AND oper_id = @oper_id
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
		AND ver_id = @ver_id
    UNION
    SELECT	file_path
		,	ent_file.file_desc
		,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(ent_file.file_path) AS file_type
		,	last_modified
		,	file_size
		,	author
		,	null AS downl_dir
		,	3 AS from_id_h
		,	edit_level AS edit_level_h
		,	view_level AS view_level_h
		,	print_level AS print_level_h
		,	0 AS download_h
		,	0 AS down_level_h
		,	view_args AS viewer_h
		,	edit_args AS editor_h
	FROM ent_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN file_type ft WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(ent_file.file_path) = ft.file_ext
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND ent_id <> @run_ent_id
    UNION
    SELECT	file_path
		,	ent_file.file_desc
		,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(ent_file.file_path) AS file_type
		,	last_modified
		,	file_size
		,	author
		,	null AS downl_dir
		,	4 AS from_id_h
		,	edit_level AS edit_level_h
		,	view_level AS view_level_h
		,	print_level AS print_level_h
		,	0 AS download_h
		,	0 AS down_level_h
		,	view_args AS viewer_h
		,	edit_args AS editor_h
	FROM ent_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN file_type ft WITH (NOLOCK) ON dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(ent_file.file_path) = ft.file_ext
	WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Ent_LogOn_LogOffJob]
(@in_session_id              INT32
,@in_user_id                 STRING80
,@in_ent_id                  INT32
,@in_job_pos                 INT32
,@in_paused_job_state        INT32
,@in_status_notes            STRING80
,@in_logoff_time             TDATETIME
,@in_logoff_ent              INT32
,@in_time_zone_bias_value    INT32 = NULL
,@logoff_error_msg        NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_D_ENT_LOGON_LOGOFFJOB
-- Description			- HD# 9682, Logoff user from a job.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 04/11/2007
-- Version				- 3.2.0.7
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By     Ver		Changes
-- 08/20/2007		AML			3.3.0
--02/08/2008		Raghu	3.4		L00074690; BETA2: Job based login - the job remains running after logging out "pause" or logging out "finish"
-- 01/12/2010		Vinit	4.0		HF1432 change
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

DECLARE  @paused_job_state		INT32
	,@logoff_ent			INT32
	,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32

	,@state_desc              	STRING80
	,@cur_wo_id               	STRING80
	,@cur_oper_id             	STRING80
	,@cur_seq_no              	INT32

	,@err_str                 	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@row_count               	INT32
	,@labor_start_utc           	TDATETIME
	,@labor_start_local		TDATETIME
	,@ent_pct_to_apply        	TFLOAT
	,@no_running_jobs         	INT32
	,@cur_job_pct_to_apply    	TFLOAT
	,@tot_pct_to_apply        	TFLOAT
	,@lab_cd			STRING80
	,@dept_id                 	STRING80
	,@state_cd                	INT32
	,@last_edit_by            	STRING80
	,@V_Client_Info           	STRING80
	,@last_edit_at            	TDATETIME
	,@logged_into_other_ses   	INT32
	,@log_id                  	INT32
	,@shift_id                	INT32
	,@shift_start_utc           	TDATETIME
	,@shift_start_local         	TDATETIME
	,@mod_id                  	INT32
	,@tz_temp			        INT32
	,@err_msg			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@def_lab_cd			STRING80
	,@def_dept_id			STRING80
	,@run_without_operator		BIT
	,@labor_start_local_tz		INT32
	,@shift_start_local_tz		INT32


	SET @in_time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_time_zone_bias_value)
	--Default the paused_job_state to suspended if not supplied or null.
	SELECT @paused_job_state = @in_paused_job_state, @logoff_ent = COALESCE(@in_logoff_ent, 1)
		, @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	IF (COALESCE(@in_logoff_ent, 0) = 0) BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT ON
		SET XACT_ABORT ON
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT OFF
		SELECT dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	END

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	--The below print command is necessary to prevent middleware (COM+) from rolling back from the set of entities
	--to which he has logged off
	--SELECT 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id IS NULL

	--Verify whether the supplied session is value.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @in_session_id) BEGIN
		--Raise an exception to the caller since the supplied session does not exist in the database.
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'session_id=' + STR(@in_session_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied user has logged into this entity.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
			          AND user_id = @in_user_id)
		--This user has not logged on to this job/entity. Anyway he is trying to logoff from the entity.
		--Just return without doing anything.
		RETURN

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'No labor_exec record found for ent_id =,' + 'ent_id=' + STR(@in_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd, @def_dept_id = def_dept_id
	FROM labor_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

	SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = (SELECT jobend_reas_cd FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id)
	  AND def_lab_cd IS NOT NULL

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id AND job_pos = @in_job_pos
		  AND cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
		GOTO NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR

	SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
	  AND job_pos = @in_job_pos
	  AND cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL

	IF (COALESCE(@paused_job_state, 3) <> 3) BEGIN --Verify whether the supplied job is running.
		--There is a job running on this entity.
		--Verify whether the supplied paused_job_state is valid.
		IF NOT (@paused_job_state = 1 OR @paused_job_state = 4
		    OR @paused_job_state = 5 OR @paused_job_state = 6) BEGIN

			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE state_cd = @paused_job_state) BEGIN
				--Raise an exception to the caller since the supplied job state is not valid.
				SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'job state code=' + STR(@paused_job_state)
				GOTO OTHER_ERR
			END

			--Raise an exception to the caller; since the supplied job state is not valid.
			SELECT @state_desc = state_desc
			FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE state_cd = @paused_job_state

			SET @err_str = 'The supplied %1 is not correct while logging off from a job.{5435},' + 'job state=' + @state_desc
			GOTO OTHER_ERR
		END

		--User has supplied a valid job state code. Determine whether we are ending a job or pausing a job.
		IF (@paused_job_state = 4) BEGIN
		    --User is trying to end a job.
			EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs @ent_id = @in_ent_id,
			        @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
			        @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
			        @job_pos=@in_job_pos,
			        @status_notes=@in_status_notes,
			        @user_id=@in_user_id,
			        @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1,
			        @client_type=37, @no_propogation=0,
			        @check_auto_job_start=1,@event_time_local=@in_logoff_time,@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

			IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
	                        --This user could not end the job before logging out of the entity.
	                        --Verify whether this entity can run jobs without any user being logged into it.
				IF (@run_without_operator = 1) GOTO OTHER_ERR

				SET @logoff_error_msg = @@ERROR
				--No, this entity cannot run jobs without operator being logged into it.
				--Verify whether any other user has logged into this entity
				SELECT @row_count = COUNT(*)
				FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE user_id <> @in_user_id
				  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id
				  AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
				  AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				  AND active = 1

				IF (@row_count = 0)
					--There are no other users who have logged into this entity on this job.
					--Pause this job for now; as we cannot end this job.
					EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@in_ent_id,
					    @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
					    @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
					    @paused_job_state=5,
					    @job_pos=@in_job_pos,
					    @status_notes=@in_status_notes,
						@event_time_local= @in_logoff_time,
					    @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

				--As the job_exec entity does not allow to run jobs without users being logged into it,
				--and since we cannot end or pause a job on this entity; raise an exception to the caller
				-- and do not allow the user to be logged off from the entity.
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
					SET @logoff_ent = 0
					GOTO OTHER_ERR
				END
			END
		END
		ELSE
			--User is trying to pause a job or putting a job on hold.
			EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@in_ent_id,
			        @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
			        @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
			        @paused_job_state=@paused_job_state,
			        @job_pos=@in_job_pos,
			        @status_notes=@in_status_notes,
					@event_time_local=@in_logoff_time,
			        @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--This user just wants to log out off this job but keeping other users to work on the same job.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		            WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
		              AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
		              AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		              AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		              AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		              AND active = 1)
			GOTO NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR

		--Default the labor start time depending upon the bias settings.
		EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @in_ent_id, @labor_start_utc OUTPUT, @labor_start_local OUTPUT, NULL

		--Verify whether this user has logged on to this entity on any other session.
		SELECT @logged_into_other_ses = COUNT(*)
		FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE session_id <> @in_session_id
		  AND user_id = @in_user_id
		  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id

		IF (@logged_into_other_ses = 0 AND @logoff_ent = 0) BEGIN
			--This user has not logged onto this entity on any other session.
			--Now, verify whether this user has logged onto any other job
			--and we are NOT logging out of the entity.
			--There are other jobs to which this user has logged into.
			--So, we have to adjust the labor usage for all the other jobs to which this user has logged in.
			--Logout this user from the supplied job.
			SELECT @cur_job_pct_to_apply = SUM(lu.pct_to_apply)
			FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lu.user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND lu.ent_id = @in_ent_id
			  AND lu.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
			  AND lu.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
			  AND lu.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND lu.active = 1

			--Get the MAXimum percentage that was applied to this entity.
			SELECT @ent_pct_to_apply = MAX(pct_lab_to_apply), @lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd),
				@dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id)
			FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
			  AND user_id = @in_user_id

			--Duplicate the labor usage records ONLY if this user has logged into a job on any other session.
			--Calculate the percentage to apply from the total percentage applied for the entity.
			SET @tot_pct_to_apply = @ent_pct_to_apply - @cur_job_pct_to_apply
			SET @tot_pct_to_apply = COALESCE(@tot_pct_to_apply, 1)

			--create a new set of labor_usage records
			INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
				item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
				active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
				last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			SELECT @labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
			    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
			    CASE WHEN @tot_pct_to_apply = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (pct_to_apply/@tot_pct_to_apply)*@ent_pct_to_apply END,
			    1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
			    @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
			  AND active = 1
			  AND (wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + STR(seq_no)) NOT IN (SELECT @cur_wo_id + '-' + @cur_oper_id + '-' + STR(@cur_seq_no))
			  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL

			--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
			UPDATE labor_usage
			SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @labor_start_utc),
				active = 0
			WHERE active = 1
			  AND user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
			  AND labor_start_utc <> @labor_start_utc

			--Get a count of jobs to which this user has logged into.
			SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*)
			FROM (SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
			    FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			    WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
			      AND user_id = @in_user_id
			      AND (wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + STR(seq_no) )
				  NOT IN (SELECT @cur_wo_id + '-' + @cur_oper_id + '-' + STR(@cur_seq_no))
			      AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL
			      AND active = 1
			    GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
			) AS no_of_job_count


			IF (@no_running_jobs = 0) BEGIN
				--Do not duplicate the NULL job entry if such an entry already exist in the labor_usage table.
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id AND
						  user_id = @in_user_id AND
						  active = 1 AND
						  wo_id IS NULL AND oper_id IS NULL)
					)
					GOTO NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR

				--Insert a labor usage record with NULL job details.
				--Retrieve a default labor code and dept ID for this user and the entity.
				SELECT @lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd), @dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id)
				FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND user_id = @in_user_id

				-- Following added 6/29/07 KRF
				IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
					-- See if the user has a default labor code
					SELECT @lab_cd = def_lab_cd
					FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_id = @in_user_id

					-- If still null use the default labor code from the entity
					IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) SET @lab_cd= @def_lab_cd

					-- If still null look up labor code for most recent inactive labor_usage record for this user and entity
					IF (@lab_cd IS NULL)
						SELECT TOP 1 @lab_cd = lab_cd
						FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @in_user_id
						  AND labor_usage.ent_id = @in_ent_id
						  AND labor_usage.active = 0
						ORDER BY labor_start_utc DESC
				END

				IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
					-- See if the user has a default dept ID
					SELECT @dept_id = def_dept_id
					FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_id = @in_user_id

					-- If still null use the default dept ID from the entity
					IF (@dept_id IS NULL) SET @dept_id= @def_dept_id

					-- If still null look up dept ID for most recent inactive labor_usage record for this user and entity
					IF (@dept_id IS NULL)
						SELECT TOP 1 @dept_id = dept_id
						FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @in_user_id
						  AND labor_usage.ent_id = @in_ent_id
						  AND labor_usage.active = 0
						ORDER BY labor_start_utc DESC
				END

				SELECT @shift_id = cur_shift_id, @shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
					,@shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
				FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

				--Create a new labor usage record for the new job.
				SET @labor_start_local_tz=NULL
				SET @shift_start_local_tz=NULL
				EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @in_ent_id, @labor_start_local,@labor_start_local_tz OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @in_ent_id, @shift_start_local,@shift_start_local_tz OUTPUT
				EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage	@log_id, @labor_start_local, @labor_start_local_tz, @in_user_id, @in_ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL,
					NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, @shift_start_local_tz,
					@ent_pct_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id
			END
			IF (@no_running_jobs = 1) BEGIN
				SELECT @lab_cd = lab_cd, @dept_id = dept_id
				FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND user_id = @in_user_id
				  AND (wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + STR(seq_no)) NOT IN
				    (SELECT @cur_wo_id + '-' + @cur_oper_id + '-' + STR(@cur_seq_no))
				  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL
				  AND active = 1

				UPDATE ent_logon
				SET cur_lab_cd = @lab_cd, cur_lab_dept_id = @dept_id
				WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND user_id = @in_user_id
			END

			--Update ent_logon with the current logid
			UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @in_user_id AND ent_id = @in_ent_id)
			WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
		END
	END--Verify whether the supplied job is running.

	OTHER_ERR:
		IF (@logoff_ent = 1)
			IF @logoff_error_msg IS NULL SET @logoff_error_msg = @@ERROR
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF @logoff_error_msg IS NULL SET @logoff_error_msg = @@ERROR
			RAISERROR(@logoff_error_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR:

	IF (@logoff_ent = 1) BEGIN
		--The log off ent is turned on; log off this user from the entity.
		--Log off this user from all the sessions?
		DELETE FROM ent_logon
		WHERE session_id = @in_session_id
		AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
		AND user_id = @in_user_id

		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			IF @logoff_error_msg IS NULL SET @logoff_error_msg = @@ERROR
		SET NOCOUNT ON
		SET XACT_ABORT ON
	END
	SET @logoff_error_msg = NULL

/*
	SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
	  AND job_pos = @in_job_pos
	  AND cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL

		IF (COALESCE(@paused_job_state, 3) <> 3) BEGIN
			--Verify whether the supplied job is running.

			--There is a job running on this entity.
			--Verify whether the supplied paused_job_state is valid.
			IF NOT (@paused_job_state = 1 OR @paused_job_state = 4
			    OR @paused_job_state = 5 OR @paused_job_state = 6) BEGIN

				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE state_cd = @paused_job_state) BEGIN
					--Raise an exception to the caller since the supplied job state is not valid.
					SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'job state code=' + STR(@paused_job_state)
					GOTO OTHER_ERR
				END

				--Raise an exception to the caller; since the supplied job state is not valid.
				SELECT @state_desc = state_desc
				FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE state_cd = @paused_job_state
				SET @err_str = 'The supplied %1 is not correct while logging off from a job.{5435},' + 'job state=' + @state_desc
				GOTO OTHER_ERR
			END

			--User has supplied a valid job state code. Determine whether we are ending a job or pausing a job.
			IF (@paused_job_state = 4) BEGIN
			    --User is trying to end a job.
				EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs @in_ent_id = @in_ent_id,
				        @in_wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @in_oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
				        @in_seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
				        @in_job_pos=@job_pos,
				        @in_status_notes=@in_status_notes,
				        @in_user_id=@in_user_id,
				        @in_check_privs=1, @in_check_certs=1,
				        @in_client_type=37, @in_no_propogation=0,
				        @in_check_auto_job_start=1, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

				IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
		                        --This user could not end the job before logging out of the entity.
		                        --Verify whether this entity can run jobs without any user being logged into it.
					IF (@run_without_operator = 1) GOTO OTHER_ERR

					SET @logoff_error_msg = @@ERROR
					--No, this entity cannot run jobs without operator being logged into it.
					--Verify whether any other user has logged into this entity
					SELECT @row_count = COUNT(*)
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_id <> @in_user_id
					  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
					  AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id
					  AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
					  AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
					  AND active = 1

					IF (@row_count = 0)
						--There are no other users who have logged into this entity on this job.
						--Pause this job for now; as we cannot end this job.
						EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id,
						    @in_wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @in_oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
						    @in_seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
						    @in_paused_job_state=5,
						    @in_job_pos=@in_job_pos,
						    @in_status_notes=@in_status_notes,
						    @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

					--As the job_exec entity does not allow to run jobs without users being logged into it,
					--and since we cannot end or pause a job on this entity; raise an exception to the caller
					-- and do not allow the user to be logged off from the entity.
					IF (@@ERROR <> 0) BEGIN
						SET @logoff_ent = 0
						GOTO OTHER_ERR
					END
				END
			END
			ELSE
				--User is trying to pause a job or putting a job on hold.
				EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @in_ent_id=@in_ent_id,
			        @in_wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @in_oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
			        @in_seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
			        @in_paused_job_state=@paused_job_state,
			        @in_job_pos=@in_job_pos,
			        @in_status_notes=@in_status_notes,
			        @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
        	ELSE BEGIN
			--This user just wants to log out off this job but keeping other users to work on the same job.
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			            WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
			              AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
			              AND wo_id = @cur_wo_id
			              AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
			              AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			              AND active = 1)
				GOTO NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR

			--Default the labor start time depending upon the bias settings.
			SELECT @labor_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL), @labor_start_utc = GETUTCDATE()

			--Verify whether this user has logged on to this entity on any other session.
			SELECT @logged_into_other_ses = COUNT(*)
			FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE session_id <> @in_session_id
			  AND user_id = @in_user_id
			  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id

			IF (@logged_into_other_ses = 0 AND @logoff_ent = 0) BEGIN
				--This user has not logged onto this entity on any other session.
				--Now, verify whether this user has logged onto any other job
				--and we are NOT logging out of the entity.
				--There are other jobs to which this user has logged into.
				--So, we have to adjust the labor usage for all the other jobs to which this user has logged in.
				--Logout this user from the supplied job.
				SELECT @cur_job_pct_to_apply = SUM(lu.pct_to_apply)
				FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE lu.user_id = @in_user_id
				  AND lu.ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND lu.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
				  AND lu.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
				  AND lu.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				  AND lu.active = 1

				--Get the MAXimum percentage that was applied to this entity.
				SELECT @ent_pct_to_apply = MAX(pct_lab_to_apply), @lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd),
					@dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id)
				FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND user_id = @in_user_id

				--Duplicate the labor usage records ONLY if this user has logged into a job on any other session.
				--Calculate the percentage to apply from the total percentage applied for the entity.
				SET @tot_pct_to_apply = @ent_pct_to_apply - @cur_job_pct_to_apply
				SET @tot_pct_to_apply = COALESCE(@tot_pct_to_apply, 1)

				--create a new set of labor_usage records
				INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
					item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
					active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
					last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
				SELECT @labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
				    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
				    CASE WHEN @tot_pct_to_apply = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (pct_to_apply/@tot_pct_to_apply)*@ent_pct_to_apply END,
				    1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
				    @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
				FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
				  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND active = 1
				  AND (wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + STR(seq_no)) NOT IN (SELECT @cur_wo_id + '-' + @cur_oper_id + '-' + STR(@cur_seq_no))
				  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL

				--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
				UPDATE labor_usage
				SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @labor_start_utc),
					active = 0
				WHERE active = 1
				  AND user_id = @in_user_id
				  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
				  AND labor_start_utc <> @labor_start_utc

				--Get a count of jobs to which this user has logged into.
				SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*)
				FROM (SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
				    FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				    WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
				      AND user_id = @in_user_id
				      AND (wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + STR(seq_no) )
					  NOT IN (SELECT @cur_wo_id + '-' + @cur_oper_id + '-' + STR(@cur_seq_no))
				      AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL
				      AND active = 1
				    GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
				) AS no_of_job_count

				IF (@no_running_jobs = 0) BEGIN
					--Do not duplicate the NULL job entry if such an entry already exist in the labor_usage table.
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id AND
							  user_id = @user_id AND
							  active = 1 AND
							  wo_id IS NULL AND oper_id IS NULL)
						)
						GOTO NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR

					--Insert a labor usage record with NULL job details.
					--Retrieve a default labor code and dept ID for this user and the entity.
					SELECT @lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd), @dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id)
					FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
					  AND user_id = @in_user_id

					-- Following added 6/29/07 KRF
					IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
						-- See if the user has a default labor code
						SELECT @lab_cd = def_lab_cd
						FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE user_id = @in_user_id

						-- If still null use the default labor code from the entity
						IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) SET lab_cd= @def_lab_cd

						-- If still null look up labor code for most recent inactive labor_usage record for this user and entity
						IF (@lab_cd IS NULL)
							SELECT TOP 1 @lab_cd = lab_cd
							FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @in_user_id
							  AND labor_usage.ent_id = @in_ent_id
							  AND labor_usage.active = 0
							ORDER BY labor_start_utc DESC
					END
					IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
						-- See if the user has a default dept ID
						SELECT @dept_id = def_dept_id
						FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE user_id = @in_user_id

						-- If still null use the default dept ID from the entity
						IF (@dept_id IS NULL) SET @dept_id= @def_dept_id

						-- If still null look up dept ID for most recent inactive labor_usage record for this user and entity
						IF (@dept_id IS NULL)
							SELECT TOP 1 @dept_id = dept_id
							FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @in_user_id
							  AND labor_usage.ent_id = @in_ent_id
							  AND labor_usage.active = 0 AND rownum < 2
							ORDER BY labor_start_utc DESC
					END
					-- End 6/29/07 addition

					SELECT @shift_id = cur_shift_id, @shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
						,@shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
					FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

					--Create a new labor usage record for the new job.
					EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage	@log_id, @labor_start_local, @user_id, @ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local,
						@ent_pct_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @mod_id

				END --There are no more running jobs on this entity; log this user out of the job and leave the user on the entity.

				IF (@no_running_jobs = 1) BEGIN
					SELECT @lab_cd = lab_cd, @dept_id = dept_id
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
					  AND user_id = @in_user_id
					  AND (wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + STR(seq_no)) NOT IN
					    (SELECT @cur_wo_id + '-' + @cur_oper_id + '-' + STR(@cur_seq_no))
					  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL
					  AND active = 1

					UPDATE ent_logon
					SET cur_lab_cd = @lab_cd, cur_lab_dept_id = @dept_id
					WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
					  AND user_id = @in_user_id
				END

				--Update ent_logon with the current logid
				UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id)
				WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
				  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
			END -- There is a job running on this entity other than the current job.
		END -- This user has not logged into other entitieis
	END --This user just wants to log out off this job but keeping other users to work on the same job.
		END

		OTHER_ERR:
		NO_DATA_FOUND_ERR:
			--There are no jobs running at the identified job position.

	END -- A job is running on this entity.

	--Verify whether we should log off this user from the entity.
	IF (@logoff_ent = 1)
		--The log off ent is turned on log off this user from the entity.
		--Log off this user from all the sessions?
		DELETE FROM ent_logon
		WHERE session_id = @session_id
		  AND ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND user_id = @user_id
*/
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_BIOSL_GetBomOperStepInfo]
(@parent_item_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@ver_id 		NVARCHAR(40)
,@process_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id 		NVARCHAR(80)
,@step_no 		INT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_BIOSL_GetBomOperStepInfo
-- Description	      -	Returns the record set of all the components used in and by-products produced by a step.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	06/27/2003
-- Version	      - 1.7.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 09/23/2003     Rich               ?           Added the item table to the query so that num_decimals could be returned.
--                                                            Made the outer join between bom_item_oper_link and bom_item a standard join.
--                                                            Fixed the query to get the qty_at_all_steps, it did not include the oper_id in the where clause.
-- 09/29/2003     Rich                ?         Fixed the queries to get the qty_at_step and mod_id, it did not include the oper_id in the where clause.
--03/22/2005	Raghu		2.1.17	HD# 5487, bom_pos 0 records are included in the returned resultset
--05/12/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5661, Bom 0 records are shown if and only if the operation is the fist
--					operation and there are no components.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT   a.bom_pos
	,a.parent_item_id
	,a.ver_id
	, b.item_id
	,item.item_desc
	,CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,7),a.qty_per_parent_item) qty_per_parent_item
	,ISNULL((SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,7),qty_per_parent_item) FROM bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE a.process_id = process_id and a.bom_pos = bom_pos AND a.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=a.oper_id AND step_no = @step_no), 0)qty_at_step
	,(SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) From bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE a.process_id = process_id and a.bom_pos = bom_pos AND a.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=a.oper_id AND step_no = @step_no) mod_id
	,(SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(11, 7), ISNULL(SUM(qty_per_parent_item), 0)) From bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE a.process_id = process_id and a.bom_pos = bom_pos AND a.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=a.oper_id)qty_at_all_steps
	,item.num_decimals
FROM bom_item_oper_link a WITH (NOLOCK), bom_item b WITH (NOLOCK), item item WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE a.process_id= @process_id
AND a.ver_id= @ver_id
AND a.parent_item_id= @parent_item_id
AND a.oper_id= @oper_id
AND a.bom_pos<>0
AND a.bom_pos=b.bom_pos
AND a.parent_item_id=b.parent_item_id
AND a.ver_id =b.ver_id
AND item.item_id = b.item_id
UNION
SELECT   biol.bom_pos
	,biol.parent_item_id
	,biol.ver_id
	, bi.item_id
	,i.item_desc
	,CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,7),biol.qty_per_parent_item) qty_per_parent_item
	,ISNULL((SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,7),qty_per_parent_item) FROM bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE biol.process_id = process_id and biol.bom_pos = bom_pos AND biol.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id= biol.oper_id AND step_no = @step_no), 0)qty_at_step
	,(SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) From bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE biol.process_id = process_id and biol.bom_pos = bom_pos AND biol.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=biol.oper_id AND step_no = @step_no) mod_id
	,(SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(11, 7), ISNULL(SUM(qty_per_parent_item), 0)) From bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE biol.process_id = process_id and biol.bom_pos = bom_pos AND biol.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=biol.oper_id)qty_at_all_steps
	,i.num_decimals
FROM bom_item bi
INNER JOIN item i ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol ON biol.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND biol.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
INNER JOIN oper_ent_route oer ON biol.process_id = oer.process_id AND biol.oper_id = oer.oper_id
INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol_prev ON biol_prev.process_id = oer.process_id AND biol_prev.oper_id = oer.input_oper_id
	AND biol_prev.parent_item_id = biol.parent_item_id AND biol_prev.ver_id = biol.ver_id AND biol_prev.bom_pos = biol.bom_pos
WHERE biol.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
  AND biol.ver_id = @ver_id
  AND biol.bom_pos = 0
  AND biol.process_id = @process_id
  AND biol.oper_id = @oper_id
UNION
SELECT   biol.bom_pos
	,biol.parent_item_id
	,biol.ver_id
	, bi.item_id
	,i.item_desc
	,CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,7),biol.qty_per_parent_item) qty_per_parent_item
	,ISNULL((SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,7),qty_per_parent_item) FROM bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE biol.process_id = process_id and biol.bom_pos = bom_pos AND biol.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id= biol.oper_id AND step_no = @step_no), 0)qty_at_step
	,(SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) From bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE biol.process_id = process_id and biol.bom_pos = bom_pos AND biol.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=biol.oper_id AND step_no = @step_no) mod_id
	,(SELECT CONVERT(DECIMAL(11, 7), ISNULL(SUM(qty_per_parent_item), 0)) From bom_item_oper_step_link WHERE biol.process_id = process_id and biol.bom_pos = bom_pos AND biol.parent_item_id = parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = ver_id AND oper_id=biol.oper_id)qty_at_all_steps
	,i.num_decimals
FROM bom_item bi
INNER JOIN item i ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol ON biol.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND biol.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
INNER JOIN oper op ON biol.process_id = op.process_id AND biol.oper_id = op.oper_id
WHERE biol.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
  AND biol.ver_id = @ver_id
  AND biol.bom_pos = 0
  AND biol.process_id = @process_id
  AND biol.oper_id = @oper_id
  AND op.first_oper = 1
  AND 1 = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 2 FROM bom_item_oper_link biol_bp WHERE biol_bp.parent_item_id = biol.parent_item_id
		  AND biol_bp.ver_id = biol.ver_id AND biol_bp.bom_pos > 0 AND biol_bp.process_id = biol.process_id
		  AND biol_bp.oper_id = biol.oper_id), 1)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_User_Name]
  (@user_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @user_desc nvarchar(80) ,
--   @encrypt_pw nvarchar(40) ,
   @active logical,
   @hourly_cost float ,
   @email_address nvarchar(80) ,
   @lang_id int ,
   @def_dept_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @last_pw_change datetime ,
   @auth_method int ,
   @def_lab_cd nvarchar(40) ,
   @smtp_server nvarchar(80) ,
   @pop3_server nvarchar(80) ,
   @email_account nvarchar(80) ,
   @email_pw nvarchar(20) ,
   @spare1 nvarchar(1000) ,
   @spare2 nvarchar(1000) ,
   @spare3 nvarchar(1000) ,
   @spare4 nvarchar(1000) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @mod_id varchar(30) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_User_Name
-- Description	      - Update User Details
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version	      - 2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Util_State]
(@state_cd  int  = NULL,
 @state_desc  nvarchar(80)  = NULL,
 @color  int = NULL,
 @runtime  INT = NULL  ,
 @downtime  INT = NULL  ,
 @setuptime INT = NULL,
 @teardowntime INT = NULL,
 @fixedtime  INT = NULL  ,
 @vartime  INT = NULL  ,
 @failure  INT = NULL,
 @def_lab_cd  nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @priority INT = NULL,
 @new_reas_cd INT = NULL,
 @ent_enabled INT = NULL,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @last_edit_at datetime = NULL)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 04/22/2013	Raghu		4.6.	UserStory: 169932 - Changes related to line management.
-- 06/12/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 178626 - Changes related to ent_enabled
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT util_state.state_cd
            ,util_state.state_desc
            ,util_state.color
            ,util_state.runtime
            ,util_state.downtime
            ,util_state.setuptime
            ,util_state.teardowntime
            ,util_state.fixedtime
            ,util_state.vartime
            ,util_state.failure
            ,util_state.def_lab_cd
            ,util_state.priority
            ,util_state.max_duration
            ,util_state.new_reas_cd
            ,util_state.standard_time
            ,util_state.min_time
            ,util_state.max_time
            ,util_state.ent_enabled
            ,util_state.category1
            ,util_state.category2
            ,util_state.category3
            ,util_state.category4
            ,util_state.last_edit_comment
            ,util_state.last_edit_by
            ,util_state.last_edit_at
  FROM util_state util_state WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((util_state.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.state_desc = @state_desc OR @state_desc IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.color = @color OR @color IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.fixedtime = @fixedtime OR @fixedtime IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.vartime = @vartime OR @vartime IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.failure = @failure OR @failure IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.def_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd OR @def_lab_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.priority = @priority OR @priority IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.new_reas_cd = @new_reas_cd OR @new_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.ent_enabled = @ent_enabled OR @ent_enabled IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (util_state.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY util_state.state_desc

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_S_prodn_co_by_product
-- Description:  Returns the production for co / by product
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-30         Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  Lavkesh     2023-06-22         added extra condition bom_pos<0
-- 0.02.01  Veervar		2024-06-05			Updated for BY-P class production reporting for BINs items
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ei_prodn_co_by_product] as
begin
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN try
		Declare @wo_id varchar(40),@row_id int,@lot_no varchar(40),@qty_prod float
		Declare @ent_id int,@ent_name varchar(100),@co_product bit
		Declare @error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT

		SET @wo_id = NULL

		;WITH co_by_prod  as(Select  ip.wo_id, ip.row_id,lot_no, qty_prod,
		 ent_id,
		case when jb.spare4 = '1' or jb.bom_pos<0 then 1 else 0 end as co_product
		from item_prod ip  with(nolock)
		inner join item i with(nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
		inner join job_bom jb with(nolock) on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos < 0 and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
		inner join (Select wo_id from wo  with(nolock) where state_cd <3) wo on ip.wo_id = wo.wo_id -- (KN 02-01-23 - To prevent clashing with close pro / close puo)
		where  qty_prod <> qty_prod_erp and i.item_class_id<>'BY-P')
		, 
		bins_prod AS (
		Select  ip.wo_id, ip.row_id,lot_no, qty_prod,
		 ent_id,
		 0  as co_product
		from item_prod ip  with(nolock)
		INNER JOIN item i on ip.item_id=i.item_id
		INNER JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ow on ip.wo_id=ow.wo_id and ip.item_id=ow.item_id and ow.bom_pos < 0
		inner join (Select wo_id from wo  with(nolock) where state_cd <3) wo on ip.wo_id = wo.wo_id -- (KN 02-01-23 - To prevent clashing with close pro / close puo)
		where  qty_prod <> qty_prod_erp and i.item_class_id='BY-P'
		)

		Select top 1 @wo_id = wo_id,@row_id = row_id,@lot_no = lot_no,@qty_prod = qty_prod,	@ent_id = ent_id,		@co_product=co_product FROM (
			SELECT wo_id, row_id,lot_no, qty_prod,ent_id, co_product FROM co_by_prod
			UNION
			SELECT wo_id, row_id,lot_no, qty_prod,ent_id, co_product  FROM bins_prod)
		AS XP
		--Print @wo_id
		
		if @wo_id is not null
		Begin
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
			Select @ent_name = ent_name from ent where ent_id = @ent_id

			set @ent_name = 'SF01';	--(KN 18May21 - SAP confirmed this will be SF01 for both co-product & by-product at all times)

			Select  wo_id Order_Number,[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,@lot_no Batch_Number, 
			item_id Material,(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp) Quantity ,

			Case when
			@co_product = 1 then '101' else '531' end
			Movement_Type,
		
			format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date, --format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd')
			format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,'000000' File_GenerationTime, --format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')
			@ent_name Storage_Location,iif(@co_product =1,'X','') CoProduct_Indicator, '' Document_Number,'' Message, '' Message
			from item_prod where row_id = @row_id


			Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = qty_prod where row_id = @row_id
		Commit Transaction
		end
	End Try

	BEGIN catch
     IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

     SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
     RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
   END catch

end

-- =============================================
-- Name:    [SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty] 
-- Description:  Determine the type of consumption qty based on the actual qty and requested qty
--
-- Usage:  MDMAddConsumptionWF
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  YG            2023-01-24      Initial version.
-- 0.01.10  YG            2024-02-07      Add script body comment update header 
-- 0.01.20	JSC				2025-07-31		FIX the different type of outputs (missing one columnn at the end)
-- =============================================
-- EXEC [SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty] '100000041475', 500004, 50000, 0.001
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty] 
		@item_id nvarchar(40),
		@to_ent_id int,
		@qty_cons float,
		@conv_factor float
AS
BEGIN
	-- Init
	DECLARE @qty_left FLOAT,
			@qty_to_consume FLOAT,
			@storage_ent_id int

	-- Get the entity id from the automation silo id
	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@to_ent_id AS NVARCHAR)

	-- Get the qty left from the silo inventory
	SELECT @qty_left = ISNULL(SUM(qty_left),0.00) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id 
		AND item_id = @item_id
		AND status_cd = (SELECT item_status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')

	-- Convert the qty into destination uom
	SET @qty_to_consume = ROUND(@qty_cons * @conv_factor,4)
	PRINT @qty_to_consume
	PRINT @qty_left

	-- Defining type of consumption
	IF (@qty_left < @qty_to_consume AND @qty_left > 0.00)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 1 Type,@qty_left qty_to_consume; -- Consumption with qty which currently available in the inventory
	END
	ELSE IF (@qty_left >= @qty_to_consume)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0 Type,@qty_to_consume qty_to_consume;  -- Consumption with requested qty
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT -1 Type , 0 qty_to_consume; -- No inventory in the silo  -- FIX v1.20
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_AdjustJobPct]
(
		@user_id					STRING40
	,	@ent_id						INT32
	,	@wo_id						STRING40
	,	@oper_id					STRING40
	,	@seq_no						INT32
	,	@cur_lab_cd					STRING40
	,	@cur_lab_dept_id			STRING40
	,	@logon_time_utc				TDATETIME
	,	@logon_time_local			TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_id				INT32
	,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME
	,	@ent_pct_to_apply			TFLOAT_NULL
	,	@lab_usage_log_id			INT32_NULL OUTPUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - SP_I_ENT_LOGON_ADJUSTJOBPCT
-- Description        - HD# 9288, Logon a user to a job.
--                      Adjust the percentage of labor to be applied for this user; since this user
--                      has now logged into a new job (this sp ought to be used only for job based login).
-- Author			  - Raghu
-- Date Created       - 04/09/2007
-- Version            - 3.2.0.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 05/15/2007		AML		3.2.0.6		Converted from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
-- 05/24/2007		Raghu				Re-structured again.
-- 08/20/2007		AML		3.3.0		DB Changes
--01/11/2008		Raghu		3.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @total_run_jobs_on_ent		INT32
		,	@job_count					INT32
		,	@concurrent_link			INT32
		,	@avg_pct_for_job			TFLOAT
		,	@total_pct					TFLOAT
		,	@last_edit_by				STRING80
		,	@v_client_info				STRING80

	--Get the number of running jobs this user is logged on to.
	SELECT @job_count = COUNT(*)
	FROM (	SELECT DISTINCT lu.wo_id, lu.oper_id, lu.seq_no
			FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lu.user_id = @user_id
				AND lu.ent_id = @ent_id
				AND lu.wo_id = @wo_id
				AND lu.active = 1
				AND lu.wo_id IS NOT NULL AND lu.oper_id IS NOT NULL AND lu.seq_no IS NOT NULL
			GROUP BY lu.wo_id, lu.oper_id, lu.seq_no
	) job_count

	--Get the total jobs for this entity onto which the user is logged.
	SET @total_run_jobs_on_ent = @job_count

	IF (@total_run_jobs_on_ent > 0)
		--Since there are other jobs this user has logged on to, calculate the average
		--percentage that must be applied for a job.
		SET @avg_pct_for_job = @ent_pct_to_apply/@total_run_jobs_on_ent
	ELSE
		--The user isn't logged on to any jobs; apply the entity percentage to the first job.
		SET @avg_pct_for_job = @ent_pct_to_apply

	--Verify whether the supplied job is linked to a batch.
	SELECT @concurrent_link = concurrent_link
	FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no

	IF (@concurrent_link > 0)
		--The supplied job is linked to a batch.
		--Get a count of jobs that were started in a batch.
		SELECT @job_count = COUNT(*)
		FROM job_exec  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND (cur_wo_id + '-' + cur_oper_id  + '-' +  STR(cur_seq_no))
			IN (SELECT wo_id  + '-' +  oper_id  + '-' + STR(seq_no)
				FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE concurrent_link = @concurrent_link)
	ELSE
		--This job is not linked to a batch.
		SELECT @job_count = COUNT(*)
		FROM job_exec  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

	--Get the total jobs for this entity that the user is logged on to.
	SET @total_run_jobs_on_ent = @total_run_jobs_on_ent + @job_count

	SET @total_pct = @avg_pct_for_job * COALESCE(@total_run_jobs_on_ent, 1)

	--Retrieve the actual user who is making these changes.
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, @v_client_info

	--Duplicate the current labor records that exist now.
	--For all the entities the user has logged onto,
	--create a new set of labor_usage records.
	INSERT INTO labor_usage
	(
		labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
		item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
		pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	SELECT	@logon_time_utc, @logon_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no,
			sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
			CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((pct_to_apply/@total_pct) * @ent_pct_to_apply) END,
			1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
	FROM labor_usage  WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE user_id = @user_id
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL	AND oper_id IS NOT NULL	AND seq_no IS NOT NULL
	  AND active = 1

	--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
	UPDATE labor_usage
	SET	 duration = DATEDIFF(s, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @logon_time_utc), active = 0
	WHERE active = 1
	  AND user_id = @user_id
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND labor_start_utc <> @logon_time_utc

	--Calculate the average percentage that must be applied while logging this user to a job.
	SET @avg_pct_for_job = @ent_pct_to_apply/COALESCE(@total_run_jobs_on_ent, 1)

	--The entity login is based on the job.
	--The labor percentage is attributed ONLY to the jobs the user has logged in to.
	INSERT INTO labor_usage
	(
		labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no,
		sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration,
		comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	SELECT	@logon_time_utc, @logon_time_local, @user_id, @ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no,
			NULL, je.item_id, je.def_lot_no, je.def_sublot_no, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_lab_dept_id, @cur_shift_id,
			@cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @avg_pct_for_job, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			@last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
    FROM ent e  WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (
		SELECT  je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no, jb.item_id,
				jb.def_lot_no, jb.def_sublot_no
        FROM job_exec je  WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb  WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = jb.wo_id AND
					   je.cur_oper_id = jb.oper_id AND
					   je.cur_seq_no = jb.seq_no AND
					   jb.bom_pos = 0
		WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND (je.cur_wo_id + '-' + je.cur_oper_id  + '-' +  STR(je.cur_seq_no))
		  IN (SELECT wo_id  + '-' +  oper_id  + '-' +  STR(seq_no)
				FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
                --Return all the batch jobs ONLY if the supplied job is linked to a batch.
                WHERE concurrent_link = @concurrent_link
                  AND @concurrent_link > 0
                UNION
                --Return the selected job only if this job is not linked to a batch.
                SELECT wo_id  + '-' +  oper_id  + '-' +  STR(seq_no) FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @seq_no
              )
        )  je ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
    WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

    --Retrieve the last log id for this user and ent.
    SELECT @lab_usage_log_id = MAX(log_id)
    FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE user_id =  @user_id
      AND ent_id = @ent_id
      AND active = 1

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job
-- Description:  Splits the Jobs for the given order
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-01-29			Initial version.
-- 0.01.02  MC			2025-04-25			adding condition to add job bom pos 0 to ext table only if all jobs are in new state
-- 0.01.03	OT			2025-07-02			Fix for splitting job based on BatchSize - correct process_id selection
-- ===========================================================================================
-- exec SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job 1001475998 
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job] @wo_id VARCHAR(100) AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @attr_id INT,@process_id VARCHAR(100),@oper_id VARCHAR(100),@qty_reqd FLOAT,@seq_no INT,
@error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@material_grp VARCHAR(100)

BEGIN TRY

	DECLARE @event_time_utc DATETIME,@event_time_local DATETIME,@created_by NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @event_time_utc = dbo.Fn_stripmillisecsfromdatetime(Getutcdate())
	SET @event_time_local =dbo.Fn_tz_getlocaldatefromutc(NULL, @event_time_utc)

	SELECT @created_by = attr_value FROM   system_attr sa WITH (nolock) WHERE  sa.attr_id = 199

	IF (SELECT COUNT(row_id) FROM job with (nolock) WHERE wo_id=@wo_id and state_cd>1)=0 --0.01.02 - verification if all jobs are in new state
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_wo_item_ext](					-- (KN 18/02/23 - Added logic to copy the bom_pos 0 item from job_bom to ofi_wo_item_ext as requested by AVEVA)
		[wo_id],[parent_item_id],[bom_pos],[item_id],[qty],[qty_per_parent_item],[backflush],[def_lot_no],
		[item_number],[item_desc],[uom_desc],[by_product],[co_product],[spare6],[created_at_utc],[created_at_local],
		[last_edit_at_utc],[last_edit_at_local],[created_by],[last_edit_by])
		SELECT 
		wo_id,NULL,bom_pos,item_id,qty_reqd,qty_per_parent_item,backflush,def_lot_no,
		NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,
		@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,@created_by,@created_by
		FROM job_bom with(nolock) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos = 0
	END

	DECLARE oper_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR Select oper_id, qty_reqd, seq_no from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id and seq_no = 0	--Get all jobs with operations and qty_reqd  for the work order

	Open oper_cur

	Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0								-- For each of that job (operation)
    BEGIN

		DECLARE @batch_size varchar(10),@new_seq_no int,@target_ent_id int,@split_cnt float
		SET @attr_id = -1
		select @attr_id =  attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'BatchSize'

		-- 0.01.03
		--Select @material_grp = product_group from ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id
		--Select @process_id = process_id from process_attr with (nolock) where attr_value = @material_grp
		SELECT @process_id = process_id from wo where wo_id = @wo_id

		IF EXISTS(select 1 from oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id)
		BEGIN
			
			Select @batch_size = attr_value from oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id			-- Get the batch size
			Select @target_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id from job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = 0 and oper_id = @oper_id

			-- 0.01.03 adjustment in conversion BatchSize value to float to eliminate conversion error
			--SET @split_cnt = (@qty_reqd / convert(float, @batch_size))-1
			Declare @temp_batch_size FLOAT
			SET @temp_batch_size = CONVERT(FLOAT, REPLACE(@batch_size, ',', ''))
			SET @split_cnt = (@qty_reqd / @temp_batch_size)-1

				WHILE @split_cnt > 0
				BEGIN
					BEGIN TRANSACTION

					SELECT @new_seq_no = max(seq_no) from JOB WITH (NOLOCK) where oper_id = @oper_id and wo_id = @wo_id

					SET @new_seq_no = @new_seq_no + 1

					exec SP_I_JOB_EXEC_SPLITJOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@orig_seq_no=0,@user_id=NULL,@split_qty=@temp_batch_size,
					@new_seq_no=@new_seq_no output,@split_start_qty=NULL,@new_state_cd=1,@req_finish_time=NULL,@req_finish_time_utc=NULL,@target_ent_id=@target_ent_id,
					@status_notes=NULL,@ignore_zero_start_qty_check=NULL,@time_zone_bias_value=60

					Update job set last_edit_comment = 'EI SPLIT JOB' WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no

					COMMIT TRANSACTION

					SET @split_cnt = @split_cnt - 1;
				END

		END

		Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no
	END

Close oper_cur
Deallocate oper_cur

END try

BEGIN catch
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();

    RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END catch


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Step_Data_GetByFiltr]
(
		@wo_id               		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id             		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_no             		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no              		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no           		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@state_cd            		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_start_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_start_start_tz		INT32 = NULL
	,	@step_start_end_local 		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_start_end_tz	 		INT32 = NULL

	,	@step_finish_start_tz		INT32 = NULL

	,	@step_finish_end_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@start_user_id       		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@start_user_desc     		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@finish_user_id      		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@finish_user_desc    		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data_start_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@step_data_end_local  		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data_end_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@data_user_id        		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@data_user_desc      		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data           		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@form_done           		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare1              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare2              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare3              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare4              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare5              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare6              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by        		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at        		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@row_id              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value 		INT32 = NULL

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_JOB_STEP_DATA_GETBYFILTR
-- Description          - Get job_step_data based on the supplied fiters.
-- Author          -    Raghu
-- Date Created          -   03/05/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change step_start, etc. with *_utc and *_local.
--08/31/2007	AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server from Oracle.
--01/17/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073983; When selecting the Steps tab in Data Editor..
--01/28/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074416; JobStepDataEditor - Error when loading job_step_data editor
--11/30/2009	Eswar		4.0	HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @step_start_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@step_start_end_utc         TDATETIME
		,	@step_finish_start_utc      TDATETIME
		,	@step_finish_end_utc        TDATETIME
		,	@step_data_start_utc        TDATETIME
		,	@step_data_end_utc          TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp					INT32
		,	@dbg_resp					INT32

	SET @step_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_start_start_tz)
	SET @step_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_start_end_tz)
	SET @step_finish_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_finish_start_tz)
	SET @step_finish_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_finish_end_tz)
	SET @step_data_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_data_start_tz)
	SET @step_data_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_data_end_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Job_Step_Data_GetByFiltr', @src_key='on_entry',
					@date_val1 = @step_start_start_local, @numeric_val1 = @step_start_start_tz,
					@date_val2 = @step_start_end_local, @numeric_val2 = @step_start_end_tz,
					@date_val3 = @step_finish_start_local, @numeric_val3 = @step_finish_start_tz,
					@date_val4 = @step_finish_end_local, @numeric_val4 = @step_finish_end_tz,
					@date_val5 = @step_data_start_local, @numeric_val5 = @step_data_start_tz,
					@date_val6 = @step_data_end_local, @numeric_val6 = @step_data_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@step_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_start_start_local, @tz_temp, @step_start_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_start_end_local, @tz_temp, @step_start_end_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_finish_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_finish_start_local, @tz_temp, @step_finish_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_finish_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_finish_end_local, @tz_temp, @step_finish_end_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_data_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_data_start_local, @tz_temp, @step_data_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_data_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_data_end_local, @tz_temp, @step_data_end_utc OUTPUT

	--HF1432 - TODO
    SELECT   jsd.wo_id
            ,jsd.oper_id
            ,jsd.seq_no
            ,jsd.step_no
            ,jsd.lot_no
            ,jsd.sublot_no
            ,jsd.state_cd
            ,js.state_desc
            ,js.color
            ,jsd.act_start_time_utc
            ,jsd.act_start_time_local
            ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, jsd.act_start_time_utc ) AS act_start_time
            ,jsd.act_finish_time_utc
            ,jsd.act_finish_time_local
            ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, jsd.act_finish_time_utc ) AS act_finish_time
            ,jsd.step_data
            ,jsd.step_data_time_utc
            ,jsd.step_data_time_local
            ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, jsd.step_data_time_utc ) AS step_data_time
            ,jsd.start_user_id AS start_user_id
            ,start_user.user_desc AS start_user_desc
            ,jsd.finish_user_id AS finish_user_id
            ,finish_user.user_desc AS finish_user_desc
            ,jsd.data_user_id AS data_user_id
            ,data_user.user_desc AS data_user_desc
            ,jsd.form_done
            ,jsp.control_type
            ,jsp.high_limit
            ,jsp.low_limit
            ,jsp.limit_warning
            ,jsd.spare1, jsd.spare2, jsd.spare3, jsd.spare4, jsd.spare5, jsd.spare6
            ,jsd.last_edit_comment
            ,jsd.last_edit_by
            ,jsd.last_edit_at
            ,jsd.row_id
   FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job_step jsp ON jsd.wo_id = jsp.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = jsp.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = jsp.seq_no AND jsd.step_no = jsp.step_no
	INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.state_cd = js.state_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name start_user WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.start_user_id = start_user.user_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name finish_user WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.finish_user_id = finish_user.user_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name data_user WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.data_user_id = data_user.user_id
   WHERE (jsd.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.act_start_time_utc >= @step_start_start_utc OR @step_start_start_utc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.act_start_time_utc <= @step_start_end_utc OR @step_start_end_utc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.act_finish_time_utc >= @step_finish_start_utc OR @step_finish_start_utc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.act_finish_time_utc <= @step_finish_end_utc OR @step_finish_end_utc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.start_user_id = @start_user_id OR @start_user_id IS NULL)
     AND (start_user.user_desc = @start_user_desc OR @start_user_desc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.finish_user_id = @finish_user_id OR @finish_user_id IS NULL)
     AND (finish_user.user_desc = @finish_user_desc OR @finish_user_desc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.step_data LIKE @step_data OR @step_data IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.step_data_time_utc >= @step_data_start_utc OR @step_data_start_utc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.step_data_time_utc <= @step_data_end_utc OR @step_data_end_utc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.data_user_id = @data_user_id OR @data_user_id IS NULL)
     AND (data_user.user_desc = @data_user_desc OR @data_user_desc IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.form_done = @form_done OR @form_done IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.spare5 LIKE @spare5 OR @spare5 IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.spare6 LIKE @spare6 OR @spare6 IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
     AND (jsd.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)

END

			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN

	CLOSE oper_step_grp_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_step_grp_cursor*/

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Item_Cons_AddConsDirect_beans]
