,@item_scrapped			INT32 = 0
,@ent_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@shift_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@qty_cons_erp			TFLOAT_NULL= 0
,@ext_ref			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@transaction_type		INT32 = 0
,@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
,@segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@comments			STRING254 = ' ' -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
,@spare1			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare2			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare3			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare4			STRING40 = ' '
,@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value  	INT32 = NULL
,@row_id			INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      	- sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsDirect
-- Description	      	- HD# 3690. This method is used to add a direct consumption record and reduce the qty from inventory
-- Author	      		- Raghu
-- Date Created	      	- 08/20/2004
-- Version	      		- 2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 01/11/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.11  HD# 5285, Handle storage_exec properties while handling inventory
-- 02/09/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.13  HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 03/15/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.16  HD# 5474, Maintain distinct consumption records
-- 09/06/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.28  HD# ?, Return row_id for the currently added row
-- 10/13/2005      	Raghu         	3.1.0   HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/25/2006      	Raghu         	3.1.8   HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
-- 03/09/2006      	Raghu         	3.1.11  HD# 7650, Allow updates to item_prod and item_cons spares
-- 01/09/2007     	KRF           	3.2.1   HD# 8314, part of DB changes - added @sublot_no and @fg_sublot_no arguments
-- 08/27/2007		AML		3.3.0	DB Changes
--01/24/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00074045; Do not add a waste consumption to inventory if the update_inventory is unchecked for a BOM consumption.
--01/25/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00074045; Verify update_inv flag only if it is related to a job
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu		4.0		DB Changes
-- 01/07/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HF 1432 Bring Hotfix forward
--06/05/2012		Saiteja		4.2		Added Changes for the Merge of CR120590
--07/27/2012        Ashish      4.5     Reverting back the code changes as the HF CR120590 rejected.
--11/28/2016        Mallesh     5.03    US#734692:Merge L00143083(HF CR L00142363-sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce: incorrectly logs consumptions into item_transfer table).
--11/06/2018        SLR         6.1     US#1103745:Update to handle scrap for an entire location indicated when item_id and lot information are null
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @last_edit_at	datetime
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @item_cons_row_id 	INT32
		,@distinct_cons		    NVARCHAR(1)
		,@item_inv_row_id	    INT32
		,@tz_temp		        INT32
		,@update_inv		    INT32
		,@ent_tz_bias_value     INT32
		,@shift_start_tz	    INT32
		,@dbg_resp			    INT32
		,@log_transfer		    INT32 = 0	-- L00143083
		,@cur_auto_del_zero_inv LOGICAL
		,@date_out_utc		TDATETIME
		,@date_out_local	TDATETIME
		,@shift_start_utc_act	TDATETIME

	-- Verify whether a shift start UTC time is supplied
	IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- shift start time UTC is not supplied
		IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL) SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	-- Default the shift times to null
	SELECT @shift_start_local = NULL, @shift_id = NULL

	-- Verify the shift actually exist
	SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_start_utc_act = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_id = sh.shift_id
        FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
        AND shift_start_utc <= COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, GETUTCDATE()) -- Default to the current date time, if no shift start utc/local is supplied to identify the current shift
	ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC

	-- Default the shift times to 1900 when a reliable shift cannot be found in the database
	IF (@shift_start_utc_act IS NULL) SET @shift_start_tz = 0
	SELECT @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc_act, '1900-01-01'), @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, '1900-01-01'), @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

	IF (@item_scrapped IS NULL) SET @item_scrapped = 0
	IF (@qty_cons IS NULL) SET @qty_cons = 0
	IF (@qty_cons_erp IS NULL) SET @qty_cons_erp = 0
	IF (@transaction_type IS NULL) SET @transaction_type = 0
	SET @update_inv = 1

	IF (@item_id IS NULL) BEGIN -- removing inventory for entire location
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id) BEGIN
		-- there is at least one item inventory at this location
			SELECT @item_cons_row_id = -1, @distinct_cons = '0'
			SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
			SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')

 			--loop through all item inventory records and update the item_cons
			DECLARE scrap_inv_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd, qty_left
			FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

			OPEN scrap_inv_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM scrap_inv_cursor INTO @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @grade_cd, @status_cd,	@qty_cons
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @item_cons_row_id = -1
				declare @AggregateConsRow bit
			set @AggregateConsRow =1
				IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @item_cons_row_id = row_id FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
						AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
						AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
			            AND (shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR (shift_start_utc IS NULL AND @shift_start_utc IS NULL))
						AND (item_id = @item_id)
						AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			            AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
						AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		                AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
        				AND (reas_cd = @reas_cd) AND (user_id = @user_id) AND (item_scrapped = @item_scrapped)
			            AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR (ent_id IS NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL))
			            AND (shift_id = @shift_id OR (shift_id IS NULL AND @shift_id IS NULL))
						AND (grade_cd = @grade_cd) AND (status_cd = @status_cd) AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id)
						AND (transaction_type = @transaction_type)
         			    AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (@genealogy_id IS NULL AND genealogy_id IS NULL))
			            AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
			            AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			            AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			            AND (spare1 = @spare1 OR (spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))
			            AND (spare2 = @spare2 OR (spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))
			            AND (spare3 = @spare3 OR (spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))
			            AND (spare4 = @spare4 OR (spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL))
						AND (DATEDIFF(MM, created_at_local, getdate())<5 or @AggregateConsRow = 0)
				END

				IF (@item_cons_row_id = -1) BEGIN
						-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/20/2009 RWB
					EXEC sp_I_Item_Cons	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_local , @item_id, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no, @sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no,
										@reas_cd, @user_id, @item_scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id,
										@qty_cons, @qty_cons_erp, @ext_ref, @transaction_type,
										@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
										@comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
										NULL, @shift_start_tz , @last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id OUTPUT
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					UPDATE item_cons
					SET qty_cons = qty_cons + @qty_cons,
						qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @qty_cons_erp,
						comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END, -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
						spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END,
						spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END,
						spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END,
						spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
					WHERE row_id = @item_cons_row_id
				END

	        END -- End of While (1=1)
	        CLOSE scrap_inv_cursor
	        DEALLOCATE scrap_inv_cursor
		    -- remove all inventory for specified location
	        SELECT @cur_auto_del_zero_inv = auto_del_zero_inv FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
		    IF (@cur_auto_del_zero_inv = 1) BEGIN
		         DELETE FROM item_inv where ent_id = @from_ent_id
		         IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		              RAISERROR('SQL Error deleting zero quantity from item_inv table: %d{3223}', 16, 1, @@error)
			          RETURN
		         END
		    END
		    ELSE BEGIN
		    	SET @date_out_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		    	SET @date_out_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @date_out_utc)
		         UPDATE item_inv SET qty_left = 0, date_out_utc = @date_out_utc, date_out_local = @date_out_local
                 WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
			     IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			          RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating item_inv table: %d{3224}', 16, 1, @@error)
				      RETURN
			     END
		    END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN	-- removing inventory for single item
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL AND @item_id IS NOT NULL)
			SELECT @update_inv = update_inv
			FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND item_id = @item_id


		IF (@update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id AND
					  ((lot_no = @lot_no) OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL)) AND
					  ((sublot_no = @sublot_no) OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},inventory row', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		SELECT @item_cons_row_id = -1, @distinct_cons = '0'
		SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
		SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')

		IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @item_cons_row_id = row_id FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
			  AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
			  AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
			  AND (shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR (shift_start_utc IS NULL AND @shift_start_utc IS NULL))
			  AND (item_id = @item_id)
			  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (reas_cd = @reas_cd) AND (user_id = @user_id) AND (item_scrapped = @item_scrapped)
			  AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR (ent_id IS NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL))
			  AND (shift_id = @shift_id OR (shift_id IS NULL AND @shift_id IS NULL))
			  AND (grade_cd = @grade_cd) AND (status_cd = @status_cd) AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id)
			  AND (transaction_type = @transaction_type)
			  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (@genealogy_id IS NULL AND genealogy_id IS NULL))
			  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			  AND (spare1 = @spare1 OR (spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))
			  AND (spare2 = @spare2 OR (spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))
			  AND (spare3 = @spare3 OR (spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))
			  AND (spare4 = @spare4 OR (spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL))
        END


		IF (@item_cons_row_id = -1) BEGIN
			 -- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/20/2009 RWB
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Cons	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_local , @item_id, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no, @sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no,
								@reas_cd, @user_id, @item_scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id,
								@qty_cons, @qty_cons_erp, @ext_ref, @transaction_type,
								@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
								@comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
								NULL, @shift_start_tz , @last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id OUTPUT
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE item_cons
			SET qty_cons = qty_cons + @qty_cons,
				qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @qty_cons_erp,
				comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END, -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
				spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END,
				spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END,
				spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END,
				spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
			WHERE row_id = @item_cons_row_id

			SET @row_id = @item_cons_row_id
		END

	--	Shouldn't the following update should use sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce ? May be in the future ??
	/*	UPDATE item_inv SET qty_left = qty_left - @qty_cons, qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp - @qty_cons_erp
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id
		  AND ((lot_no = @lot_no) OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))*/

		IF (@update_inv = 1)
		BEGIN
			-- L00143083: Pass @log_transfer which defaults to false
			IF (@item_scrapped = 1) SET @log_transfer = 1
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=@qty_cons_erp
				, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
				, @must_consume_from_inv=1, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=1, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
				, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=@log_transfer, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@ent_tz_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Shift_To_Go_DelBetwDates]
  (@ent_id int ,
   @start_time datetime,
   @start_time_tz INT32=NULL,
   @end_time datetime ,
   @end_time_tz INT32=NULL ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver.       Changes
-- 11/11/2002		KRF					1.5.0.0 Also delete old records (those prior to now)
-- 10/26/2005		Raghu				3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 11/16/2009		Ajay				4.0.0	HD# 1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @current_time	TDATETIME
DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32

SET @start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
SET @end_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)


SET @time_zone_bias_value =  dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

-- TRACE
exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_D_Shift_To_Go_DelBetwDates', @src_key='sp_D_Shift_To_Go_DelBetwDates', @date_val1 = @start_time, @numeric_val1 = @start_time_tz, @date_val2 = @end_time, @numeric_val2 = @end_time_tz

-- NOTE: shift_to_go uses local times, so this code below relies on the TZ offsets being 0
SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@start_time_tz, @start_time)
SET @end_time   = DATEADD(mi, -@end_time_tz, @end_time)

-- This must stay as time_zone_bias_value = 0 - special case
IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

if @ent_id IS NULL
BEGIN
	DELETE shift_to_go WHERE
		start_time >= @start_time AND end_time <= @end_time
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	DELETE shift_to_go WHERE
		ent_id = @ent_id AND
		start_time >= @start_time AND end_time <= @end_time
END
DELETE from shift_to_go where end_time <  @current_time --GETDATE () -- 11/11/02 Addition KRF

-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--09/26/2005   Raghu    3.1.0 Part of DB Changes
--02/02/2007   Raghu    3.2.0 Part of DB Changes
--12/23/2009   Ajay     4.0.0 HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
    SET NOCOUNT ON

        FROM    spc_rule spc_rule WITH ( NOLOCK )
        WHERE   ( spc_rule.rule_id = @rule_id )

    END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Folder_GetFolderEntities]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-- sp_SA_Folder_GetFolderEntities
-- Description       			-- Build a list of entities to build a folder.
-- Author	 					-- Raghu
-- Date Created      			-- 12/04/2006
-- Version (last edit)   		-- 3.1.2.25
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
	can_run_jobs BIT, can_do_dnc BIT, can_capture_util BIT, can_capture_labor BIT,
	parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))

DECLARE  @child_level			INT32
	,@ent_id			INT32
	,@root_ent_id  			INT32

	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_run_jobs, can_do_dnc, can_capture_util
			, can_capture_labor, parent_ent_id, child_level)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_do_dnc, e.can_capture_util, e.can_capture_labor, NULL, @child_level FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @child_level = 2

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, can_run_jobs, can_do_dnc, can_capture_util, can_capture_labor, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.can_run_jobs, e.can_do_dnc, e.can_capture_util, e.can_capture_labor, el.parent_ent_id, @child_level
				,x.ent_tree
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END
	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

	SELECT @child_level = MAX(child_level) FROM @entities

	DELETE FROM @entities
	WHERE child_level = @child_level
	  AND (can_run_jobs = 0 AND can_do_dnc = 0 AND can_capture_util = 0 AND can_capture_labor = 0)

	SET @child_level = @child_level - 1

	WHILE (@child_level > 0) BEGIN
		DELETE FROM @entities
		WHERE child_level = @child_level
		  AND (can_run_jobs = 0 AND can_do_dnc = 0 AND can_capture_util = 0 AND can_capture_labor = 0)
		  AND ent_id NOT IN (SELECT parent_ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level + 1)
		SET @child_level = @child_level - 1
	END

	SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ent_name FROM @entities el ORDER BY ent_name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_User_Name_ChangePassword]
(@user_id   nvarchar(80),
 @password  nvarchar(254),
 @target_user_id nvarchar(80),
 @new_password  nvarchar(254),
 @last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(254),
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_U_User_Name_ChangePassword
-- Description            - Change Password for the supplied user or for the target user
-- Author         -
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver         Changes
-- 01/09/2003   Rohit       1.5.2   Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/29/2004    Raghu       2.1.0   Changed GetDate to GMT Date and Time
--10/10/2005    Raghu       3.1.0   HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @priv_value     INT32
    ,   @last_pw_change DATETIME
    ,   @old_pw         NVARCHAR(254)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

--  SET @last_pw_change = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), GETUTCDATE(), 120)
    IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @last_pw_change = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @last_pw_change = GETUTCDATE()

    --check user_id and target_user_id are same. If not, the administrator is trying to change the users password
    --If admin, then check the admin  has the valid priv to change the users password
    IF (@user_id <> @target_user_id) BEGIN

        SELECT  @priv_value = MAX(priv_value) FROM grp_priv_link gpl, user_grp_link ugl, priv p
        WHERE ugl.user_id = @user_id AND gpl.priv_id = p.priv_id AND ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id AND p.priv_id = 4
        GROUP BY gpl.priv_id, p.priv_desc
        ORDER BY gpl.priv_id

        IF @priv_value is NULL SET @priv_value = 0

        IF @priv_value <> 1 BEGIN
            RAISERROR('User does not have the required privilege to change the password{3240}', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END

        SELECT @old_pw = encrypt_pw FROM USER_NAME
        WHERE user_id = @target_user_id

        IF @old_pw = @new_password BEGIN
            RAISERROR('User cannot have the same old password{3242}', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END
--      Admin is authenticated, update the new password, and the last pwd change for the target user
        UPDATE user_name SET encrypt_pw = @new_password, last_pw_change = @last_pw_change
        WHERE user_id = @target_user_id
    END
    ELSE BEGIN
        SELECT @old_pw = encrypt_pw FROM USER_NAME
        WHERE user_id = @user_id
        IF @old_pw = @new_password BEGIN
            RAISERROR('User cannot have the same old password{3242}', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END
        UPDATE user_name SET encrypt_pw = @new_password, last_pw_change = @last_pw_change
        WHERE user_id = @user_id
    END
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Job_Attr_SetFromTarget]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @attr_desc nvarchar(80) ,-- target description
   @attr_desc_target nvarchar(80)
   )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  [sp_U_ofi_Job_Attr_SetFromTarget]
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver.      Changes
--09/15/2005	  JSC		   1.0.0	 Part of Wet rEwork
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE @attr_id INT = 0
		,@attr_id_target INT  = 0
		,@attr_value NVARCHAR(1700)
		,@mod_id NVARCHAR(30)

-- 1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts

SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id 
FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE a.attr_desc= @attr_desc
	AND a.attr_grp = 5 -- job

SELECT @attr_value  = ja.attr_value
FROM job_attr ja WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ja.attr_id = a.attr_id
WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc_target
	AND ja.wo_id = @wo_id
	AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id
	AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no

IF @attr_value IS NULL
BEGIN
	RETURN 1
END

SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) 
	FROM job_attr ja WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE ja.attr_id = @attr_id
					AND ja.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id
					AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no

IF @mod_id IS NULL
BEGIN

	EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Attr]
		@wo_id =@wo_id,
		@oper_id =@oper_id,
		@seq_no = @seq_no,
		@attr_id = @attr_id,
		@attr_value = @attr_value,
		@notes = NULL,
		@last_edit_comment = 'Inserted by sp_U_ofi_Job_Attr_SetFromTarget',
		@mod_id = @mod_id OUTPUT

END
ELSE
BEGIN

	UPDATE job_attr
	SET attr_value = @attr_value
	WHERE 	(wo_id = @wo_id AND
			oper_id = @oper_id AND
			seq_no = @seq_no AND
			attr_id = @attr_id )
	
END

RETURN 0

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_S_ofi_AUT_st_Validate
-- Description:  Validate the data sent from the automation during the stock transfer handshake
--
-- Usage:  Always gets called from the ArchestrA scripts under $AUT_Interfaces instances for Stock transfer
-- EXCE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_AUT_st_Validate] 'STCOMP', 500003 , 500004, 541, NULL
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Veervar Joshi    2024-01-10      Initial version.
-- 0.01.00 Veervar Joshi	2024-02-14		row_id parameter added.
-- 0.01.01	MC				2025-03-03		CR:00137179 - No validation for source/dest silo configuration in STQTY interface
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_AUT_st_Validate] (
	@interface NVARCHAR(40)
	,@ssu_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@dsu_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@line_ent_id INT = NULL
	,@qty FLOAT =NULL
	,@row_id INT =NULL
	
	)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @result INT = 0
		,@mesSSU_id NVARCHAR(40)
		,@mesDSU_id NVARCHAR(40)

	--GET MES ENTITY ID
	SELECT @mesSSU_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@ssu_id AS NVARCHAR)

	SELECT @mesDSU_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@dsu_id AS NVARCHAR)

	--REGISTER QUANTITY EVENT
	IF @interface = 'STQTY'
		AND EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM ofi_st_trans_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE 
				/* 0.01.01 -- disable verification for source/dest silo matching
				src_su_ent_id = @mesSSU_id
				AND dest_su_ent_id = @mesDSU_id
				AND*/
				ent_id=@line_ent_id
				AND is_active=1
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1
	END

	--COMPLETE TRANSFER EVENT
	IF @interface = 'STCOMP'
		AND EXISTS (
			SELECT  TOP 1 1
			FROM ofi_st_trans_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE row_id = @row_id				
				AND ent_id=@line_ent_id
				--[y2025-m02-d14] MH: The line below has been disabled in favor of the ResultCode 100 implementation when stopping an already stopped job.
				--AND is_active=1
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1
	END

	
	SELECT @result AS result
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_AllAccessible]
(@session_id		INT32
,@user_id   		STRING40
,@logon_time		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_I_Ent_Logon_AllAccessible
-- Description	      -	This module will log the user into all accessible entities
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 11/20/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.25
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @access_ent_id	INT32
BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	--The below print command is necessary to prevent middleware (COM+) from rolling back from the set of entities
	--to which he has logged into due to no valid certification, etc.
	--PRINT 'LOGIN INTO ALL ENTITES TO WHICH THIS USER HAS AN ACCESS'
	SELECT 1 FROM user_name WHERE user_id IS NULL

	--Open a cursor and loop through the list of accessible entities for the supplied user.
	DECLARE entity_access_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_access.ent_id FROM (SELECT grp_ent_link.ent_id
					--,ent.can_sched_jobs,ent.can_run_jobs,ent.can_capture_util,ent.can_capture_labor,ent.can_do_dnc,ent.can_store,ent.can_log_data
					--,ent.parent_ent_id
					,(MAX(CAST(grp_ent_link.accss AS INT))) access
					FROM grp_ent_link grp_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_ent_link.ent_id = ent.ent_id
					WHERE (grp_ent_link.grp_id IN (SELECT grp_id FROM user_grp_link WHERE user_id = @user_id))
					  AND (ent.can_run_jobs = 1 OR ent.can_capture_util = 1 OR ent.can_capture_labor = 1 OR ent.can_do_dnc = 1 OR ent.can_store = 1 OR ent.can_log_data = 1)
					GROUP BY grp_ent_link.ent_id, ent.ent_name, ent.can_run_jobs, ent.can_capture_util, ent.can_capture_labor, ent.can_do_dnc, ent.can_store, ent.can_log_data, ent.parent_ent_id
					) ent_access
	WHERE ent_access.access = 1
	OPEN entity_access_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM entity_access_cursor INTO @access_ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Call the ent_logon method to log in all the entities for which the user has access.
		EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon @session_id=@session_id, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@access_ent_id
			,@cur_lab_cd=NULL, @cur_lab_dept_id=NULL, @pct_lab_to_apply=NULL
			,@logon_time=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	CLOSE entity_access_cursor
	DEALLOCATE entity_access_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Step_Data_GetCount]
(
		@wo_id               		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id             		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_no             		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no              		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no           		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@state_cd            		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_start_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_start_start_tz		INT32 = NULL
	,	@step_start_end_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_start_end_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@step_finish_start_local	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_finish_start_tz		INT32 = NULL
	,	@step_finish_end_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_finish_end_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@start_user_id       		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@start_user_desc     		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@finish_user_id      		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@finish_user_desc    		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data_start_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@step_data_end_local   		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data_end_tz	   		INT32 = NULL
	,	@data_user_id        		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@data_user_desc      		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_data           		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@form_done           		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare1              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare2              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare3              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare4              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare5              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@spare6              		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by        		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at        		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@row_id              		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value 		INT32 = NULL
	,	@no_of_rows             	INT32 OUTPUT

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_JOB_STEP_DATA_GETBYFILTR
-- Description          - Returns a count of job_step_data records based on the supplied fiters.
-- Author          -    Raghu
-- Date Created          -   03/05/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change step_start, etc. with *_utc and *_local.
--11/30/2009	Eswar		4.0		HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @step_start_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@step_start_end_utc         TDATETIME
		,	@step_finish_start_utc      TDATETIME
		,	@step_finish_end_utc        TDATETIME
		,	@step_data_start_utc        TDATETIME
		,	@step_data_end_utc          TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp					INT32
		,	@dbg_resp					INT32

	SET @step_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_start_start_tz)
	SET @step_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_start_end_tz)
	SET @step_finish_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_finish_start_tz)
	SET @step_finish_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_finish_end_tz)
	SET @step_data_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_data_start_tz)
	SET @step_data_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@step_data_end_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Job_Step_Data_GetCount', @src_key='on_entry',
					@date_val1 = @step_start_start_local, @numeric_val1 = @step_start_start_tz,
					@date_val2 = @step_start_end_local, @numeric_val2 = @step_start_end_tz,
					@date_val3 = @step_finish_start_local, @numeric_val3 = @step_finish_start_tz,
					@date_val4 = @step_finish_end_local, @numeric_val4 = @step_finish_end_tz,
					@date_val5 = @step_data_start_local, @numeric_val5 = @step_data_start_tz,
					@date_val6 = @step_data_end_local, @numeric_val6 = @step_data_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@step_start_start_tz
    EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_start_start_local, @tz_temp, @step_start_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_start_end_local, @tz_temp, @step_start_end_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_finish_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_finish_start_local, @tz_temp, @step_finish_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_finish_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_finish_end_local, @tz_temp, @step_finish_end_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_data_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_data_start_local, @tz_temp, @step_data_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@step_data_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @step_data_end_local, @tz_temp, @step_data_end_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT  @no_of_rows = COUNT(*)
	FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.state_cd = js.state_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name start_user WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.start_user_id = start_user.user_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name finish_user WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.finish_user_id = finish_user.user_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name data_user WITH (NOLOCK) ON jsd.data_user_id = data_user.user_id
	WHERE (jsd.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.act_start_time_utc >= @step_start_start_utc OR @step_start_start_utc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.act_start_time_utc <= @step_start_end_utc OR @step_start_end_utc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.act_finish_time_utc >= @step_finish_start_utc OR @step_finish_start_utc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.act_finish_time_utc <= @step_finish_end_utc OR @step_finish_end_utc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.start_user_id = @start_user_id OR @start_user_id IS NULL)
		AND (start_user.user_desc = @start_user_desc OR @start_user_desc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.finish_user_id = @finish_user_id OR @finish_user_id IS NULL)
		AND (finish_user.user_desc = @finish_user_desc OR @finish_user_desc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.step_data LIKE @step_data OR @step_data IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.step_data_time_utc >= @step_data_start_utc OR @step_data_start_utc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.step_data_time_utc <= @step_data_end_utc OR @step_data_end_utc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.data_user_id = @data_user_id OR @data_user_id IS NULL)
		AND (data_user.user_desc = @data_user_desc OR @data_user_desc IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.form_done = @form_done OR @form_done IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.spare5 LIKE @spare5 OR @spare5 IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.spare6 LIKE @spare6 OR @spare6 IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		AND (jsd.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)

END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_oper_step_grp_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[oper_step_grp]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_oper_step_grp_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on oper_step_grp table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_step_grp osg INNER JOIN  inserted i
				ON osg.process_id = i.process_id AND osg.oper_id = i.oper_id AND osg.step_grp_id = i.step_grp_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4738},oper_step_grp', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM oper_step_grp osg INNER JOIN  inserted i
				ON osg.process_id = i.process_id AND osg.oper_id = i.oper_id AND osg.step_grp_id = i.step_grp_id) osgrp
	WHERE process.process_id = osgrp.process_id

	UPDATE oper_step_grp SET oper_step_grp.last_edit_by = @user_id, oper_step_grp.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE oper_step_grp.process_id = i.process_id AND oper_step_grp.oper_id = i.oper_id AND oper_step_grp.step_grp_id = i.step_grp_id

END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE	@cur_qty_cons 			TFLOAT
	,	@cur_wo_id 				STRING40
	,	@cur_oper_id 			STRING40
	,	@cur_seq_no 			INT32
	,	@cur_shift_id 			INT32
	,	@cur_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_item_id 			STRING40
	,	@cur_lot_no 			STRING40
	,	@cur_sublot_no 			STRING40
	,	@cur_cont_id 			STRING40
	,	@cur_fg_lot_no 			STRING40
	,	@cur_fg_sublot_no		STRING40
	,	@cur_reas_cd 			INT32
	,	@cur_storage_ent_id 	INT32
	,	@grade_cd 				INT32
	,	@status_cd 				INT32
	,	@scrapped 				INT32
	,	@cur_update_inv 		INT32
	,	@cur_backflush 			INT32
	,	@cur_spare1 			STRING40
	,	@cur_spare2 			STRING40
	,	@cur_spare3 			STRING40
	,	@cur_spare4 			STRING40
	,	@LotChanged 			INT32
	,	@reas_desc 				STRING40
	,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME
	,	@expiry_date			TDATETIME
	-- 10/26/2002	TC	1.5.0	Include row_id as an output parameter to return the ID of the row updated or inserted
	--,  @row_id		INT32
	,	@return           		INT32
	,	@must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@bgood_prod				LOGICAL
	,	@inv_status_cd			INT32
	--Added by Raghu on 12/03/2002.
	,	@scaling_factor			TFLOAT
	-- Added by Rohit
	,	@must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL
	,	@inv_wo_id 				STRING40
	,	@attr_value				NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@prev_inv_ent_id		INT32
	,	@prev_inv_lot_no		STRING40
	,	@prev_oper_id			STRING40
	,	@cur_qty_left			TFLOAT
	,	@reqd_grade_cd			INT32
	,	@checkGrade				LOGICAL
	,	@last_edit_by			STRING40
	,	@current_subst			INT32
	,	@def_lot_no				STRING40
	,	@def_sublot_no			STRING40
	,	@distinct_cons			NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@inv_row_id				INT32
	,	@current_time			TDATETIME
	--,	@use_gmt				INT32
	,	@tz_temp				INT32
	,	@tempvar4				INT32
	,	@stoo_selcnt			INT32
	,	@inv_oper_id			STRING40
	,	@inv_seq_no				INT32
--RaghuK CR L00088636 Start
	,	@temp_flag				LOGICAL
	,	@temp_inv_oper_id		STRING40
	,	@temp_inv_seq_no		INT32
	,	@temp_inv_qty_left		TFLOAT
	,	@temp_qty_cons			TFLOAT
	,	@qty_to_be_consumed		TFLOAT
	,	@required_qty_consumed	LOGICAL
--RaghuK CR L00088636 End
	,	@cur_subsegment_id		STRING80 -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
	,	@cur_comments			STRING254 -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
	,	@event_time_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_local_tz		INT32
	,	@inv_unique_by_job		INT -- Added 05/20/2015 - CR:L00136813

	SET @tempvar4 = 0
    SET @temp_flag = 0		--RaghuK CR L00088636

SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

-- Init the values
SELECT	@LotChanged = 0
	,	@cur_wo_id = NULL
	,	@cur_oper_id = NULL
	,	@cur_seq_no = 0
	,	@grade_cd = NULL
	,	@status_cd = NULL
	,	@scrapped = NULL
	,	@cur_shift_id = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	, 	@event_time_utc = @created_at_utc

	--Verify whether an event time is supplied
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) BEGIN
			--Event time is not supplied, therefore, default to the current utc time
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
			--Determine the local time using the utc time
			SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
		END
		ELSE --an event time is supplied
			--Determine the utc time from the supplied local time
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE())
	END

-- Read current job data from the job_exec table
SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

-- 10/26/2002	TC		1.5.0		Include job_pos in WHERE clause
-- If NO job is running return an error
IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL) OR (@cur_wo_id = 'Idle') OR (@cur_wo_id = '') BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END


SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @cur_shift_id=sh.shift_id
FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
AND shift_start_utc =
(SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
	FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
	--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
	AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @event_time_utc)

SET @cur_shift_id = COALESCE(@cur_shift_id, 0)
SET @cur_shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@cur_shift_start_utc, @event_time_utc)
SET @cur_shift_start_local = COALESCE(@cur_shift_start_local, @event_time_local)

-- If values where not returned default them to Null shift and Now

SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

--Read current item_id and lot details from the job_bom table for the given job and bom_pos
SELECT	@cur_item_id = item_id
	,	@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
	,	@cur_lot_no = def_lot_no
	,	@cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no
	--      ,@cur_cont_id = cur_cont_id
	,	@cur_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
	,	@cur_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
	,	@cur_update_inv = update_inv
	,	@cur_backflush = backflush
	,	@scaling_factor = scaling_factor
	,	@must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
	,	@must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
	,	@current_subst = current_subst
	,	@cur_spare1 = spare1
	,	@cur_spare2 = spare2
	,	@cur_spare3 = spare3
	,	@cur_spare4 = spare4
FROM  job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos

IF (@current_subst IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst) BEGIN
		SELECT	@cur_item_id = item_id
			,	@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
			,	@cur_lot_no = def_lot_no
			,	@cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no
			,	@cur_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
			,	@cur_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			,	@cur_update_inv = update_inv
			,	@cur_backflush = backflush
			,	@scaling_factor = scaling_factor
			,	@must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
			,	@must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
			,	@cur_spare1 = spare1
			,	@cur_spare2 = spare2
			,	@cur_spare3 = spare3
			,	@cur_spare4 = spare4
		FROM  job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst
	END
END

--Added by Raghu on 12/03/2002.  Apply Scaling Factor
IF (@apply_scaling_factor  = 1) BEGIN
	IF (@scaling_factor IS NULL OR @scaling_factor = 0) SET @scaling_factor = 1
	SET @qty_cons = @qty_cons * @scaling_factor
END

--Read the FG lot_no from job_bom where bom_pos = 0
--SELECT @cur_fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_bom WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
IF (@fg_lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
	IF (@fg_lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @def_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
		SET @fg_lot_no = @def_lot_no
	END
END
SET @cur_fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no

--Pick the fg_lot_no from job_exec if null SJ 1/30/03
--IF @cur_fg_lot_no IS NULL  SELECT @cur_fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

IF (@fg_sublot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @fg_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
	IF (@fg_sublot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @def_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
		SET @fg_sublot_no = @def_sublot_no
	END
END
SET @cur_fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no

-- If any parameter lot values are NOT null, and are different to the current values, then update the current values
IF NOT ((@item_id IS NULL) OR (@item_id = '')) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_item_id IS NULL SET @cur_item_id = @item_id
	IF (@cur_item_id <> @item_id) BEGIN
		SET @cur_item_id = @item_id
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END

--Added by Raghu on 07/01/2003. Check for bom_pos = 0. If it is..then get the previous inventory location and lot_no
-- Undone the above change HD# 3303, Replaced by 5097

IF NOT ((@lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no = '')) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_lot_no IS NULL SET @cur_lot_no = @lot_no
	IF (@cur_lot_no <> @lot_no) BEGIN
		SET @cur_lot_no = @lot_no
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END

-- Added 1/9/07 KRF
IF NOT ((@sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@sublot_no = '')) BEGIN
	IF @cur_sublot_no IS NULL SET @cur_sublot_no = @sublot_no
	IF (@cur_sublot_no <> @sublot_no) SET @cur_sublot_no = @sublot_no
END

IF NOT (@reas_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	IF (@cur_reas_cd <> @reas_cd) BEGIN
		SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END
IF NOT (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_storage_ent_id IS NULL SET @cur_storage_ent_id = @from_ent_id
	IF (@cur_storage_ent_id <> @from_ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @cur_storage_ent_id = @from_ent_id
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END

--Added by Raghu on 11/23/2004 for HD# 5161
IF @spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' '  SET @cur_spare1 = @spare1
IF @spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' '  SET @cur_spare2 = @spare2
IF @spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' '  SET @cur_spare3 = @spare3
IF @spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' '  SET @cur_spare4 = @spare4

 -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
IF @comments != ' ' BEGIN
	SET @cur_comments = @comments
END
ELSE BEGIN
	SET @cur_comments = NULL
END

-- If any of the parameter values have changed then do NOT update the current lot data in the job_bom table..
--Added by Raghu on 07/31/2002. HD #933. Check the Expiry date of the item in inventory before consuming it.
--Modified by Raghu on 10/03/2002. The below check is moved down. As it raises the error for manual consumption
IF @cur_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
	SELECT @expiry_date = expiry_date FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id AND item_id = @cur_item_id AND (lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
	AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Clasue added 1/9/07 KRF
	IF @expiry_date IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @expiry_date < @current_time BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Item is expired and cannot be consumed{3303}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
END
--below line is added by Nagaraju on 01/02/03 for  HD #2051
--IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL AND NOT @reas_cd IS NULL SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
--below 2 conditions are added by Nagaraju on 12/10/02
IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL SELECT @cur_reas_cd = def_cons_reas_cd FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)  Where ent_id = @ent_id
IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Default Consumption Code is not defined{3304}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get good_prod flag
SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd,@status_cd = item_status_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd
IF @grade_cd IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	-- reas_cd is defined, grade and status loaded - now get good_prod flag
	SELECT @scrapped = scrapped	FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
	-- Return error if this was not successful
	IF @scrapped IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid scrapped flag{3299}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END
ELSE BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
	--Retrieve the user_id from the session table with the supplied session_id
	-- Get user id from sessn when @session_id is between -1 to -9 (reserved for custom implementations) or positive number
		IF(@session_id >= -9) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id = s.user_id
			FROM sessn s WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE s.session_id = @session_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
		    SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
		END
	--This will not help the UCO, however, since setting the operator production attribute does not set a current user
	--for the session.  It does however log that user in to the labor_usage table, and log any other user out.
	--So the next choice would be the first current  user found in the labor_usage table for the job
	--if there is one.  The �current user found in the labor_usage table� would be the one where duration was 0,
	--as terminating a labor_usage record sets the duration.
	IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @user_id = MAX(lu.user_id) FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE lu.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND lu.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND lu.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND lu.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND lu.duration = 0
		  AND lu.active = 1
	END
    -- If there is no current user for the job either, use the background user (identified by system attribute 199).
    IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT @user_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199
    END
    --Raise a custom error, otherwise the database is going to throw a system generated error complaining about the user_id cannot be null.
    IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        RAISERROR('%1 may not be empty{5413},user_id',16,1);
    END
END


-- If FG lot_no changed DON't write it back ?
-- @cur_fg_lot_no
-- Added by Rohit to check for work order if must_consume_from_wip is set to true
-- CHD added the '@qty_cons > 0' check, KRF's recomendation (because if you're putting back, needn't match)
/*IF @cur_update_inv = 1 and @must_consume_from_wip = 1 and @qty_cons > 0 BEGIN
	SELECT @inv_wo_id = wo_id FROM item_inv	WHERE ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id AND item_id = @cur_item_id AND lot_no = @cur_lot_no
	IF @cur_wo_id <> @inv_wo_id BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Work Order for consumptiom does not match with inventory{3300}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END*/

--Added by Raghu on 08/06/2003. Required grade_cd does not match with inventory; if update_inv flag is turned on
--Checks if update_inventory flag is set to true, and reqd_grade code is not null. If true, then checks the current reason which falls under waste category,
--If the current reason is waste reason, proceed as it is, if it is not a waste reason, then the grade code in inventory should match. So, set the grade_cd to reqd_grade_cd
IF (@cur_update_inv = 1) AND (@reqd_grade_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK), item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id AND irg.reas_grp_type = 3 	AND ir.reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd)  BEGIN
		SET @checkGrade = 1
		SET @grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
	END
END

SELECT @inv_unique_by_job = inv_unique_by_job from item WITH(NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id

--If must_consume_from_wip is true; verify whether the current item has sufficient quantities in the inventory.
IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN

    SELECT @stoo_selcnt = 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		AND first_job != 1

	IF ( @stoo_selcnt <> 1 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1 )
	END
	--RaghuK L00088636 Start
	ELSE IF (@bom_pos = 0 AND @cur_backflush = 1 ) BEGIN
		SET @temp_flag = 1
		DECLARE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor1 CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT ii.oper_id, ii.seq_no, ii.qty_left
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)  ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
		WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND ii.ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id
		  AND ii.item_id = @cur_item_id
		  AND (ii.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
	END
	--RaghuK L00088636 End

    ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @inv_oper_id = ii.oper_id, @inv_seq_no = ii.seq_no
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)  ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
		WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND ii.ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id
		  AND ii.item_id = @cur_item_id
		  AND (ii.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ii.qty_left >= @qty_cons)
	END
END
ELSE IF @inv_unique_by_job = 1
BEGIN
	SELECT @inv_oper_id = @cur_oper_id, @inv_seq_no = @cur_seq_no

END

--HD# 5474, Raghu - Maintain distinct consumption records
SELECT @cur_qty_cons = NULL, @distinct_cons = '0'
SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')
declare @AggregateConsRow bit
set @AggregateConsRow =1
IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
	SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_qty_cons = qty_cons FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	  AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( shift_start_utc ) = @cur_shift_start_utc
	  AND item_id = @cur_item_id
	  AND (lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (fg_lot_no = @cur_fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_fg_lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (fg_sublot_no = @cur_fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
	  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
	  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
	  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
	  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
	  AND (DATEDIFF(mi, created_at_local, getdate())<2 or @AggregateConsRow = 0)
END

IF @cur_qty_cons IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	-- Row does exist - add the qty_consumed and update it
	-- Do NOT update dependent fields for this row ???
	UPDATE 	item_cons
	SET 	 qty_cons = @cur_qty_cons + @qty_cons
		,comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END
		,spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END
		,spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END
		,spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END
		,spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
		,last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	WHERE row_id = @row_id
--since we got the row_id, discard join with other fields and update on row_id. Even if multiple rows returned for the above join, it always updates with single row.
/*	wo_id = @cur_wo_id and
		oper_id = @cur_oper_id and
		seq_no = @cur_seq_no and
		convert(varchar(20), shift_start, 113) = @cur_shift_start and
		item_id = @cur_item_id and
		lot_no = @cur_lot_no and
		cont_id = @cur_cont_id and
		fg_lot_no = @cur_fg_lot_no and
		reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd and
		user_id = @user_id*/
	-- Return error if this was not successful
	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('SQL Error updating item_cons table{3301}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END
ELSE BEGIN
	-- Row does NOT exist - insert a new one
	--rohit
	Select @bgood_prod = g.good_prod From item_reas r WITH (NOLOCK),item_grade g WITH (NOLOCK) Where r.item_grade_cd = g.item_grade_cd and r.reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd
	IF @cur_update_inv = 1 and @bgood_prod = 1 BEGIN
--		Select @inv_status_cd = status_cd from item_inv Where ent_id = @from_ent_id and item_id = @cur_item_id and lot_no = @cur_lot_no
--		Modified by Raghu on 04/23/2003. from_ent_id is changed to @cur_storage_ent_id
		SELECT @inv_status_cd = status_cd FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id AND item_id = @cur_item_id
		AND lot_no = @cur_lot_no AND sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no
		SET @status_cd = ISNULL(@inv_status_cd,@status_cd)
	END

	-- Now insert the new row
	--Modified by Raghu on 04/23/2003. from_ent_id is changed to @cur_storage_ent_id
	INSERT INTO item_cons
	(
		wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no,
		reas_cd, user_id, item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, ext_ref,
		transaction_type, genealogy_id, upstream_event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,comments,
		spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local
	)
	VALUES
	(
		@cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_local, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no,
		@cur_fg_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_sublot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id, @scrapped, @ent_id, @cur_shift_id, @grade_cd,
		@status_cd, @cur_storage_ent_id, @qty_cons, 0, @ext_ref, 0, @genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id,
		@segment_response_id, @cur_comments, @cur_spare1, @cur_spare2, @cur_spare3, @cur_spare4, @last_edit_by,
		@last_edit_at, @event_time_utc, @event_time_local
	)

 	-- Return error if this was not successful
	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('SQL Error inserting into item_cons table{3302}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	-- 10/26/2002	TC	1.5.0	Set row_id = ID of inserted row
	select @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
END
--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 233

IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
  	EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @ent_id, @event_time_local, @job_pos, NULL, 'AddCons', @bom_pos, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_item_id,
		NULL, @user_id, NULL, @row_id, NULL,@genealogy_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, NULL, @qty_cons,NULL,
		NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
END

-- Check whether we should update inventory with this consumption quantity
IF @cur_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
	--EXECUTE SP_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_cont_id, @qty_cons, 0, @last_edit_at, 0, 0
              --above line is commented by Nagaraju on 05-09-02 and below  lines added
	IF @from_ent_id IS NULL SET @from_ent_id=@cur_storage_ent_id
	IF NOT @from_ent_id IS NULL  BEGIN
                  --HD#3303, 3304
                  --When deviation is allowed above start qty check if the feeding job's produced qty is not lesser than produced here
	SET @cur_shift_start_local_tz=NULL
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @ent_id, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz OUTPUT
	IF  @bom_pos = 0  BEGIN
		IF @qty_cons = 0  RETURN 0
		  ELSE BEGIN

--			EXECUTE @return = SP_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @from_ent_id, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @qty_cons, 0, NULL, 0
--						, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @cur_reas_cd, @must_consume_from_inv
--						, @must_consume_from_wip, @checkGrade, NULL, NULL, 0, @time_zone_bias_value
--			RaghuK CR L00088636 Pass the @cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_lot_no in the correct order
			IF (@temp_flag = 1) BEGIN
				SET @required_qty_consumed = 0
				SET @qty_to_be_consumed = @qty_cons
				OPEN Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor1
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor1 INTO @temp_inv_oper_id, @temp_inv_seq_no, @temp_inv_qty_left
					IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 BREAK
					IF (@qty_to_be_consumed > @temp_inv_qty_left) BEGIN
						SET @temp_qty_cons = @temp_inv_qty_left
						SET @qty_to_be_consumed = @qty_to_be_consumed - @temp_qty_cons
					END
					ELSE BEGIN
						SET @temp_qty_cons = @qty_to_be_consumed
						SET @required_qty_consumed = 1
					END
					EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots	@row_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz,@cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no,
												@cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_lot_no, @cur_fg_sublot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id, @scrapped, @ent_id,
												@cur_shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id, @temp_qty_cons, @tempvar4, @ext_ref, 0,
												@spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @must_consume_from_wip,
												@must_consume_from_inv, @checkgrade, @temp_inv_oper_id, @temp_inv_seq_no, @time_zone_bias_value, 0
					IF (@required_qty_consumed = 1) BREAK
				END
				CLOSE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor1
				DEALLOCATE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor1
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
--			RaghuK CR L00088636 Pass the @cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_lot_no in the correct order
				EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots	@row_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no,
												@cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_lot_no, @cur_fg_sublot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id, @scrapped, @ent_id,
												@cur_shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id, @qty_cons, @tempvar4, @ext_ref, 0,
												@spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @must_consume_from_wip,
												@must_consume_from_inv, @checkgrade, @inv_oper_id, @inv_seq_no, @time_zone_bias_value, 0
			END
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END

	END --end of bom_pos =0
	ELSE BEGIN -- bom_pos <> 0
--		EXECUTE @return = SP_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @from_ent_id, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @qty_cons, 0, NULL, 0, @grade_cd, @status_cd
--				, @cur_reas_cd, @must_consume_from_inv, @must_consume_from_wip, @checkGrade, NULL, NULL, 0, @time_zone_bias_value
--			RaghuK  CR L00088636 Pass the @cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_lot_no in the correct order
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots	@row_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz, @cur_item_id,
												@cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_fg_lot_no, @cur_fg_sublot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id,
												@scrapped, @ent_id, @cur_shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id, @qty_cons,
												@tempvar4, @ext_ref, 0, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at,
												@must_consume_from_wip, @must_consume_from_inv, @checkgrade, @inv_oper_id, @inv_seq_no,
												@time_zone_bias_value, 0

		IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
	END --end of bom_pos <> 0
       END-- end of from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
END
