--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_I_EI_PRO_Add_BOM_Details
-- Description:  Inserts the BOM details
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-21         Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_EI_PRO_Add_BOM_Details] (@module     NVARCHAR(40),
                                             @plant_code NVARCHAR(40),
											 @wo_id      NVARCHAR(40),
											 @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
											 @parent_item_id    NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_number NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_id NVARCHAR(40),
											 @item_desc NVARCHAR(80),
											 @qty  VARCHAR(50),
											 @uom_desc NVARCHAR(40),
											 @backflush BIT,
											 @by_product_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
											 @by_product BIT,
											 @co_product BIT,
											 @spare6    NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
      IF @erp_wo_status = 'ACTIVE'
	  BEGIN
		  DECLARE @event_time_utc   DATETIME,
				  @event_time_local DATETIME,
				  @created_by       NVARCHAR(40),
				  @rc               INT,
				  @error_msg        NVARCHAR(500),
				  @error_severity   INT,
				  @error_state      INT,
				  @bom_pos		    INT

		  --SET @qty = TRIM(@qty)

		  --IF RIGHT(@qty,1) = '-'			---To deal with quantities from SAP where the -ve sign is at the end of qty e.g. (252-)
		  --BEGIN
				--SET @qty = '-' + LEFT(@qty,LEN(@qty)-1)
		  --END
				--PRINT 'QTY (' + @qty + ')'

		  --SET @co_product = 0;				--- (KN - 11-Dec-22. As discussed with AVEVA team, disabled co-product & by-product)
		  --SET @by_product = 0;				--- (This needs to be clarified further.)

		  PRINT 'ERP WO status is ACTIVE'

		  IF @co_product = 1
			OR @by_product = 1
		  BEGIN
				PRINT 'BY PRODUCT'
			  SELECT @bom_pos = Min(bom_pos)
			  FROM   ofi_wo_item_ext WITH (nolock)
			  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

			  SET @bom_pos= Isnull(@bom_pos, 0) - 1
			  IF @bom_pos=0
				SET @bom_pos=-1
		  END
		ELSE
		  BEGIN
			  SELECT @bom_pos = Max(bom_pos)
			  FROM   ofi_wo_item_ext WITH (nolock)
			  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id

			  IF @bom_pos = -1 
				SET @bom_pos = 1
			  ELSE
				SET @bom_pos= Isnull(@bom_pos, 0) + 1
		  END

		  SET @event_time_utc = dbo.Fn_stripmillisecsfromdatetime(Getutcdate())
		  SET @event_time_local =dbo.Fn_tz_getlocaldatefromutc(NULL, @event_time_utc)

		  IF @created_by IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SELECT @created_by = attr_value
				FROM   system_attr sa WITH (nolock)
				WHERE  sa.attr_id = 199
			END
		
		  BEGIN try
			  BEGIN TRANSACTION
  				



				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_wo_item_ext]
			   ([wo_id]
			   ,[parent_item_id]
			   ,[bom_pos]
			   ,[item_id]
			   ,[qty]
			   ,[qty_per_parent_item]
			   ,[backflush]
			   ,[def_lot_no]
			   ,[item_number]
			   ,[item_desc]
			   ,[uom_desc]
			   ,[by_product]
			   ,[co_product]
			   ,[spare6]
			   ,[created_at_utc]
			   ,[created_at_local]
			   ,[last_edit_at_utc]
			   ,[last_edit_at_local]
			   ,[created_by]
			   ,[last_edit_by])
		       VALUES
			   (@wo_id
			   ,@parent_item_id
			   ,@bom_pos
			   ,@item_id
			   ,@qty
			   ,NULL
			   ,@backflush
			   ,@by_product_lot_no
			   ,@item_number
			   ,@item_desc
			   ,@uom_desc
			   ,@by_product
			   ,@co_product
			   ,@spare6
			   ,@event_time_utc
			   ,@event_time_local
			   ,@event_time_utc
			   ,@event_time_local
			   ,@created_by
			   ,@created_by)



			 

			  COMMIT TRANSACTION
		  END try

		  BEGIN catch
			  IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

			  SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
					 @error_severity = Error_severity(),
					 @error_state = Error_state();


			  RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
		  END catch
	  END 
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Folder_GetFolders]
(@filter_option		INT
,@folder_filters		NVARCHAR(4000)
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Folder_GetFolders
-- Description       - Return a recordset using folder filters passed in
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 11/06/2003
-- Version           - 2.0.7
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--02/24/2004	Raghu		2.0.26	Added item_id to folder filters (Filter Option = 100)
--06/18/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed i.units to uom.description
--07/13/2005	Raghu		2.1.24	Included table alias for item_class filters
--03/08/2006	Raghu		3.1.11	HD# 7604, Sort folder versions depending upon system settings.
--05/05/2006	Raghu		3.1.15	HD# 8173, 8174, Supply time_zone_bias_value to sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter
--03/08/2006	Raghu		3.1.18	HD# 7604, Reverse the folder settings while right padding the characters.
--07/20/2006	Raghu		3.1.20  HD# ?, Changed the filter parameter to folder_filters
--08/02/2006	Raghu		3.1.21	HD#, Do not apply entity filters for folders. if restrict_to_ent is set to false;
-- 08/22/2006	Raghu		3.1.22	HD# ?, Added Design Hold column to be returned via select clause for filter option = 102 (per Rich.B Email)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE	 @sSQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@temp_filter		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@temp_SQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@item_class_id		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_class		NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_class_desc	NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_id			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@item_desc			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@oper_id			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@revision			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@udf1				NVARCHAR(400)
	,@udf2				NVARCHAR(400)
	,@file				NVARCHAR(400)
	,@oper_desc			NVARCHAR(400)
	,@value			STRING80
	,@start			INT32
	,@end			INT32
	,@disp_order		NVARCHAR(2)
	,@separator		NVARCHAR(4)
	,@justification		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@max_len_ver_id	INT32
	,@filter		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@restrict_to_entity	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@ent_id		INT32
	,@child_level		INT32
	,@ent_list		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@param_def		NVARCHAR(4000)

DECLARE @entity_tree TABLE (ent_id int, child_level INT)

	SET @filter = @folder_filters
/*DECLARE @filter_option	INT
	,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	SET @filter_option = 100
	SET @filter = '$$FF:$$$$ITEM_CLASS=$$$$ITEM_ID=$$$$OP_NUMBER=$$$$ENTITY=$$$$REVISION=$$$$UDF1=$$$$UDF2=$$$$FILE=$$'
*/
	IF (@filter_option IS NULL) SET @filter_option = 0

	IF (@filter_option = 0) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT i.item_id,i.item_desc,ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=i.item_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN folder_file ff WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=ff.item_id AND f.oper_id=ff.oper_id AND f.ent_id=ff.ent_id AND f.ver_id=ff.ver_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE i.obsolete<>1 '
	END
	IF (@filter_option = 1) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT i.item_id,i.item_desc,ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN folder f ON i.item_id=f.item_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN folder_file ff WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=ff.item_id AND f.oper_id=ff.oper_id AND f.ent_id=ff.ent_id AND f.ver_id=ff.ver_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE i.obsolete<>1 '
	END
	IF (@filter_option = 100) BEGIN	-- Item Level
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT(f.oper_id),f.oper_desc,i.item_id,i.item_desc '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=i.item_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN folder_file ff WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=ff.item_id AND f.oper_id=ff.oper_id AND f.ent_id=ff.ent_id AND f.ver_id=ff.ver_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE i.obsolete<>1 '
	END
	IF (@filter_option = 101) BEGIN	--Oper Level
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT(f.ent_id),e.ent_name,f.oper_id,f.oper_desc '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN folder_file ff WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=ff.item_id AND f.oper_id=ff.oper_id AND f.ent_id=ff.ent_id AND f.ver_id=ff.ver_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=i.item_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.ent_id=e.ent_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
	END
	IF (@filter_option = 102) BEGIN	--Ent Level
		SET @sSQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT(f.ver_id) ver_id,f.preferred_ver,f.design_hold, '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY,f.mod_id))) mod_id,f.ent_id,e.ent_name '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=i.item_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id=uom.uom_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN folder_file ff WITH (NOLOCK) ON f.item_id=ff.item_id AND f.oper_id=ff.oper_id AND f.ent_id=ff.ent_id AND f.ver_id=ff.ver_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN ent e ON f.ent_id=e.ent_id '
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL) '
	END
	SET @temp_filter = ''
	SET @temp_SQL = ''
	SET @separator = '$$'

	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @start = 1
		SET @end = 0
		SET @start = CHARINDEX('FF:', @filter, @start)
		IF @start > 0 BEGIN
			SET @temp_filter = @filter

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_CLASS_ID=', @separator, @item_class_id OUTPUT
			IF (@item_class_id <> '') BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(ic.item_class_id)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_class_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_class_id) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_class_id'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_class_id'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_CLASS=', @separator, @item_class OUTPUT
			IF (@item_class <> '') BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(ic.item_class_desc)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_class_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_class) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_class'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_class'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_CLASS_DESC=', @separator, @item_class_desc OUTPUT
			IF (@item_class_desc <> '') BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(ic.item_class_desc)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_class_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_class_desc) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_class_desc'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_class_desc'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_ID=', @separator, @item_id OUTPUT
			IF (@item_id <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.item_id)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_id) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_id'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_id'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_DESC=', @separator, @item_desc OUTPUT
			IF (@item_desc <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.item_desc)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_desc) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_desc'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_desc'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'OP_NUMBER=', @separator, @oper_id OUTPUT
			IF (@oper_id <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(f.oper_id)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_id) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @oper_id'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @oper_id'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'REVISION=', @separator, @revision OUTPUT
			IF (@revision <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(f.ver_id)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @revision) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @revision) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @revision'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @revision'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'UDF1=', @separator, @udf1 OUTPUT
			IF (@udf1 <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(f.udf1)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @udf1) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @udf1) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @udf1'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @udf1'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'UDF2=', @separator, @udf2 OUTPUT
			IF (@udf2 <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(f.udf2)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @udf2) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @udf2) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @udf2'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @udf2'
			END

			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'FILE=', @separator, @file OUTPUT
			IF (@file <> '')  BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(ff.file_path)'
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @file) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @file) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @file'
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @file'
			END



			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

			SET @temp_SQL = ''

			--Get the entity filter
			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ENTITY=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
			IF (@value <> '')  SET @ent_id = CONVERT(INT, @value)

			--Verify whether we need to restrict the folders to the supplied entity
			--or we need to bring all the entities.
			EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'RESTRICT_TO_ENT=', @separator, @restrict_to_entity OUTPUT
			IF (@restrict_to_entity = '0')  AND (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@filter_option <> 102) BEGIN
				--Default the level to the bottom most entity
				SELECT @ent_list = '', @child_level = 1

				--Insert the curent entity into the temporary table.
				INSERT INTO @entity_tree (ent_id, child_level)
				SELECT e.ent_id, @child_level
				FROM ent e
				WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

				--Set the child level to 2.
				SET @child_level = 2

				--Loop through all the ancestor entities till we find the root entity (or no more parents)
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @entity_tree (ent_id, child_level)
					SELECT e.ent_id, @child_level
					FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE  el.child_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @entity_tree WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
					IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
					SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
				END

				DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
				SELECT DISTINCT ent_id
				FROM @entity_tree

				OPEN ent_tree_cursor
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @ent_id
					IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					IF (@ent_list <> '') SET @ent_list = @ent_list + ','
					SET @ent_list = @ent_list + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @ent_id)
				END
				CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
				DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND f.ent_id IN (' + @ent_list + ')'
			END
			ELSE
				IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND f.ent_id=@ent_id'
			SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL

			IF (@filter_option = 102) BEGIN  --OR (@filter_option = 101) BEGIN
				SET @temp_SQL = ''
				EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'OPER_DESC=', @separator, @oper_desc OUTPUT
				IF (@oper_desc <> '') BEGIN
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(f.oper_desc)'
					IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_desc) > 0)
						SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @oper_desc'
					ELSE
						SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @oper_desc'
				END
				ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND f.oper_desc IS NULL'
				SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL
			END
		END --end of filter found ie, filter string >0
	END	--end for filter (IS NOT NULL)

	IF (@filter_option = 0) OR (@filter_option = 1) OR (@filter_option = 100) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ' ORDER BY '
		SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 208 	--208 - Item_Class display order
		IF (@disp_order = '0')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_id'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '1')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '2')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_id,ic.item_class_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '3')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_desc,ic.item_class_id'
		ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'ic.item_class_id'

		IF (@filter_option = 100)
			SET @temp_SQL = ' ORDER BY '
		ELSE
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ','

		SET @disp_order = NULL
		SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210	--210 - Item Display order
		IF (@disp_order = '0')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'i.item_id'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '1')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'i.item_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '2')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'i.item_id,i.item_desc'
		ELSE IF (@disp_order = '3')
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'i.item_desc,i.item_id'
		ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + 'i.item_id'
	END

	IF (@filter_option = 100) SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL  + ',f.oper_id'

	IF (@filter_option = 101) SET @temp_SQL = ' ORDER BY f.oper_id,f.oper_desc,f.ent_id'

	IF (@filter_option = 102) BEGIN
		SELECT @justification = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 81
		--If revision justification is null, default to left justification, so that we don't need to do anything.
		SET @justification = ISNULL(@justification, '1')

		IF (@justification = '0') BEGIN --RIGHT justification
			SELECT @max_len_ver_id = MAX(LEN(ver_id)) FROM folder
			SET @max_len_ver_id = ISNULL(@max_len_ver_id, 0)
			--SET @temp_SQL = ' ORDER BY f.ent_id,e.ent_name,REPLICATE('' '', ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @max_len_ver_id) + '-LEN(f.ver_id))+f.ver_id'
			SET @sSQL = 'SELECT x.* FROM (' + @sSQL + ') x ORDER BY x.ent_id,x.ent_name,REVERSE(REPLICATE('' '', ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @max_len_ver_id) + '-LEN(x.ver_id))+x.ver_id)'
			SET @temp_SQL = ''
		END
		ELSE	-- Left justification
			SET @temp_SQL = ' ORDER BY f.ent_id,e.ent_name,f.ver_id'
	END

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_SQL
--PRINT @sSQL
	SET @param_def = '@item_class_id NVARCHAR(400), @item_class NVARCHAR(400), @item_class_desc NVARCHAR(400), @item_id NVARCHAR(400), @item_desc NVARCHAR(400), @oper_id NVARCHAR(400)'
	SET @param_def = @param_def + ', @revision NVARCHAR(400), @udf1 NVARCHAR(400), @udf2 NVARCHAR(400), @file NVARCHAR(400), @ent_id INT, @oper_desc NVARCHAR(400)'
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, @param_def, @item_class_id, @item_class, @item_class_desc, @item_id, @item_desc, @oper_id, @revision, @udf1, @udf2, @file, @ent_id, @oper_desc

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_dx_map_exp_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[dx_map_exp]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on dx_map_exp table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE dx_map_exp SET dx_map_exp.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, dx_map_exp.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE dx_map_exp.mapping_id = i.mapping_id AND dx_map_exp.internal_id = i.internal_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_d_ent_logon_setjstatonlogof]
(
	@session_id		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@user_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id			INT32_NULL = NULL

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_D_ENT_LOGON_SETJSTATONLOGOF
-- Description          - HD# 9682, Logoff user from a job.
--                      Sets the job_state during log off.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 04/11/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.7
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.

-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 01/05/2008		AML				3.4.0	Initial Sql Version
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @run_without_operator	LOGICAL
		,	@row_count				INT32
		,	@curr_state_cd			INT32
		,	@i						INT32
		,	@max_i					INT32
		,	@v_ent_id				INT32
		,	@v_user_id				STRING40


	DECLARE @each_user_in_ent TABLE (
		id int identity,
		ent_id int,
		user_id nvarchar(40)
	)

	INSERT INTO @each_user_in_ent ( ent_id, user_id )
	SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, user_id
	FROM ent_logon
	WHERE session_id = @session_id AND
		  ( ent_id = @ent_id or @ent_id IS NULL ) AND
		  ( user_id = @user_id or @user_id IS NULL )

	SELECT @i = MIN( id ), @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @each_user_in_ent

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @v_ent_id = ent_id, @v_user_id = user_id FROM @each_user_in_ent WHERE id = @i

		SELECT TOP 1 @run_without_operator = run_without_operator
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @v_ent_id

		SET @run_without_operator = ISNULL( @run_without_operator, 1 )

		IF ( @run_without_operator = 0 ) BEGIN
			--This entity cannot run jobs without an operator being logged into it.
            --Loop through all the jobs on this entity and pause the job if a job is currently running on this entity
            --provided that there are no users logged into this job.
			DECLARE @each_job TABLE (
				id int identity,
				job_pos int,
				cur_wo_id nvarchar(40),
				cur_oper_id nvarchar(40),
				cur_seq_no int
			)

			DECLARE @v_job_pos INT
				,	@v_cur_wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
				,	@v_cur_oper_id NVARCHAR(40)
				,	@v_cur_seq_no INT
				,	@ej_i INT
				,	@ej_max_i INT

			INSERT INTO @each_job ( job_pos, cur_wo_id, cur_oper_id, cur_seq_no )
			SELECT job_pos, cur_wo_id, cur_oper_id, cur_seq_no
            FROM job_exec
            WHERE ent_id = @v_ent_id
              AND cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL

			SELECT @ej_i = MIN( id ), @ej_max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @each_job

			--Verify any other user other than this session has logged into this job.
			WHILE ( @ej_i <= @ej_max_i ) BEGIN

				SELECT @v_job_pos = job_pos, @v_cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @v_cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @v_cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
				FROM @each_job
				WHERE id = @ej_i

				--Get the current state of the job.
                --By the time the next job is retrieved using this cursor; the same job would have been paused
                --by the batch job. For optimal performance, re-retrieve the job state each time.
                --which prevents re-adjusting the labor records every time.
                SELECT @curr_state_cd = state_cd
				FROM job
                WHERE wo_id = @v_cur_wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @v_cur_oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @v_cur_seq_no

				--Valid job information cannot be identified.
                --Anyway, the user is trying to log off; just go to next job.
				SET @curr_state_cd = ISNULL( @curr_state_cd, 4 )

				IF (@curr_state_cd = 3) BEGIN
					--Verify any other user has logged into this job; ONLY if the current job is in the running state.
					SELECT @row_count = 1
					FROM labor_usage
					WHERE ent_id = @v_ent_id
					  AND wo_id = @v_cur_wo_id
					  AND oper_id = @v_cur_oper_id
					  AND seq_no = @v_cur_seq_no
					  AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WHERE session_id = @session_id)
				END

				IF ( @row_count <> 1 ) BEGIN
					--There are no other users other than this session has logged into this job.
					--As this entity cannot run jobs without a user being logged into it.
					--Pause this job.
					EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@v_ent_id, @wo_id=@v_cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@v_cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@v_cur_seq_no, @paused_job_state=5
						, @job_pos=@v_job_pos, @status_notes=NULL, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL
				END

				SET @ej_i = (@ej_i + 1)
			END
		END

		SET @i = ( @i + 1 )
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_User_Name_DeActivateUser]
(@user_id 		NVARCHAR(80)
,@session_id		INT = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
,@login_errcode		INT = -2 OUTPUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - sp_U_User_Name_DeActivateUser
-- Description            - If the users login attempts crossed the no of allowable limits, then deactivate the user
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Author	      - Raghu
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver    	Changes
--06/29/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed GetDate to GMT Date and Time
--04/13/2005	Raghu		2.1.19	Changed error severity code from "100" to "1"
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
Declare  @unique_pwds		INT
	,@login_attempts	INT
	,@login_time		INT
	,@last_login		DATETIME
	,@last_pw_change	DATETIME
	,@failed_logins		INT
	,@no_failures		INT
	,@active		BIT
	,@client_type		INT
	,@instance_info		NVARCHAR(254)
	,@object_name		NVARCHAR(254)
	,@current_time		TDATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SET @login_errcode = -2

	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()
	SELECT @unique_pwds = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 85
	IF (@unique_pwds = 1) BEGIN	--Do only for NON-Unique passwords, ie, Unique password is NOT set

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id AND active =1)  BEGIN

			SELECT @login_attempts = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 204
			SELECT @login_time = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 205
			SET @no_failures = 0

			SELECT @active = active, @last_login = last_login, @last_pw_change =last_pw_change, @failed_logins = failed_logins
			FROM user_name WHERE user_id = @user_id
			IF (@login_attempts > 0) BEGIN
				IF (@last_login IS NOT NULL) AND (DATEADD(n, @login_time, @last_login) > @current_time)
					SET @no_failures = @failed_logins + 1
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF (@login_time = 0) SET @no_failures = @failed_logins + 1 ELSE SET @no_failures = 1
				END
			END
			ELSE SET @no_failures = 0

			IF (@login_attempts > 0 AND @no_failures = @login_attempts -1) SET @login_errcode = -5
			IF (@login_attempts > 0) AND (@no_failures >= @login_attempts)
				UPDATE user_name SET last_login = @current_time, failed_logins = @no_failures, active = 0
				WHERE user_id = @user_id
			ELSE
				UPDATE user_name SET active = @active, last_login = @current_time, failed_logins = @no_failures
				WHERE user_id = @user_id
		END	--End of User Exist and Active
		ELSE 	SET @login_errcode = -4	--End of User does not exist or may not be active

		SELECT @client_type = client_type FROM SESSN WHERE session_id = @session_id
		IF @client_type = 35 SET @instance_info = 'Configurator'
		IF @client_type = 36 SET @instance_info = 'Supervisor'
		IF @client_type = 37 SET @instance_info = 'Operator'
		IF @client_type = 38 SET @instance_info = 'Manager'
		IF @client_type = 39 SET @instance_info = 'Factory Connector'
		IF @client_type = 53 SET @instance_info = 'Background Tasks'
		IF @client_type = 54 SET @instance_info = 'Data Editor'
		IF @client_type = 55 SET @instance_info = 'Messenger'
		IF @client_type = 56 SET @instance_info = 'Report Designer'
		IF @client_type = 57 SET @instance_info = 'Scheduler'

		SET @object_name = 'Session ID = ' + rtrim(ltrim(str(@session_id))) + ' , User ID = ' + @user_id
		INSERT INTO error_log (logged_at, severity, instance_info, object_name, object_section, description)
			VALUES (@current_time, 1, @instance_info, @object_name, 'Log In', 'Login Failed. Invalid User Id or Password or User may not be Active')
	END	--Unique Password is NOT set
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_WO]
(
	@wo_id 						STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@wo_desc 					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@process_id 				STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@bom_ver_id   				STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@spec_ver_id  				STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@item_id 					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@release_time_utc 			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@release_time_local 		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_utc 		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_local 		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@state_cd 					INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@wo_priority 				INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@cust_info 					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@mo_id 						STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@production_schedule_id			STRING80_NULL = NULL,
	@disassembly 				LOGICAL,
	@may_override_route 			LOGICAL,
	@override_serialization			LOGICAL,
    	@input_wo_id                		STRING40_NULL = NULL,
    	@input_oper_id              		STRING40_NULL = NULL,
    	@input_seq_no               		INT32_NULL = NULL,
    	@target_sched_line_id			INT32_NULL = NULL,
    	@queue_seq_no				INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@last_edit_by  				STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@last_edit_at  				TDATETIME_NULL = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value 			INT32_NULL = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 5.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 04/01/2003	  Raghu		1.6.0	Included state_cd field - part of V1.6 DB Changes
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--01/23/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--03/07/2007    Raghu       3.2.3   MO_ID filter was not applied correctly.
--07/16/2007  Raghu           3.3.1   HD# 10081, Replace release_time, req_finish_time with *_utc, *_local.
--09/06/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--10/31/2007	AML			3.4.0	DB Changes
--01/04/2007	Raghu			L00073441, L00073464 - Mod_Id was not converted properly.
--07/15/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00078351 - Jobs Window- Item, Starting Quantity and Required Quantity not displayingAdded serial_no_lvl column to the select clause.
--07/17/2009    SLR                     4.0.0   DB Changes
--08/22/2009    Raghu                     4.0.0   DB Changes
-- 05/03/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 158300 - Return the new target_sched_line_id and queue_seq_no columns from the wo table.
--05/31/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 179529 - Return the production counts for the line, if the work order is assigned to a line.
-- 2/26/2014      SLR          5.0  Add num_decimals and num_decimal_good_pp to the return dataset
--05/30/2014	Abhay Pandey   5.0  UserStory: 337095 - Merged the changes done against HF#L00131571 for HF#L00131616 - @last_edit_at was not declared properly
--07/15/2014	Raghu		5.0	UserStory: 367649 - [CR] L00131475 -  [PSR] Returning a single workorder for a line takes up to 2 seconds for the WebAPI to return.
--02/2015       Sara        5.0.1 User Story:439593 - Update calculation of quantities using conversions if necessary so displayed consistently and meaningfully
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @num_decimals_good_pp INT32
	,@no_conv_wo_id			NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@ncw					INT32
	,@err_msg NVARCHAR(4000)

DECLARE @wo TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, wo_status_cd INT, wo_uom_id INT, target_sched_line_id INT, num_op INT)
DECLARE @wo_qtys TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY
	, fj_qty_at_start FLOAT, fj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_at_start FLOAT, lj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_prod FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)

DECLARE @line_prod_ent_qty TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, qty_prod FLOAT, qty_reqd FLOAT)

DECLARE @line_total_rej_prod TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, qty FLOAT)

BEGIN
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326

INSERT INTO @wo (wo_id, wo_status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op)
SELECT DISTINCT wo.wo_id, dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(wo.wo_id) as status_cd
	-- Get the UOM for the item produced by the work order.
	, i.uom_id, wo.target_sched_line_id
	-- Get the count of the number of first operations in the work order.  If there is only one first operation in
	-- the work order, we can may be able to get the starting quantity by summing up the starting quantity of each
	-- job in the first operation provided that the UOM for the item produced by the first operation can be converted
	-- the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
	, first_job_counts.num_op
FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = wo.item_id
OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(oper_id)) num_op
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
			  AND j.first_job = 1) first_job_counts
WHERE (wo.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.wo_desc = @wo_desc OR @wo_desc IS NULL)
  AND (wo.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.bom_ver_id = @bom_ver_id OR @bom_ver_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR @spec_ver_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.release_time_utc >= @release_time_utc OR @release_time_utc IS NULL)
  AND (wo.release_time_local >= @release_time_local OR @release_time_local IS NULL)
  AND (wo.req_finish_time_utc <= @req_finish_time_utc OR @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL)
  AND (wo.req_finish_time_local <= @req_finish_time_local OR @req_finish_time_local IS NULL)
  AND (wo.state_cd = @state_cd OR @state_cd IS NULL)
  AND (wo.wo_priority = @wo_priority OR @wo_priority IS NULL)
  AND (wo.cust_info = @cust_info OR @cust_info IS NULL)
  AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.production_schedule_id = @production_schedule_id OR @production_schedule_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.disassembly = @disassembly OR @disassembly IS NULL)
  AND (wo.may_override_route = @may_override_route OR @may_override_route IS NULL)
  AND (wo.override_serialization = @override_serialization OR @override_serialization IS NULL)
  AND (wo.input_wo_id = @input_wo_id OR @input_wo_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.input_oper_id = @input_oper_id OR @input_oper_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.input_seq_no = @input_seq_no OR @input_seq_no IS NULL)
  AND (wo.target_sched_line_id = @target_sched_line_id OR @target_sched_line_id IS NULL)
  AND (wo.queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no OR @queue_seq_no IS NULL)
  AND (wo.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
  AND (wo.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
  AND (wo.override_serialization = @override_serialization OR @override_serialization IS NULL)


-- Check if there are any work orders matching the filter that are assigned to lines
---- and do not have the necessary UOM conversions.
	;WITH
	factors (wo_id, factor) AS (
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo wo1 ON wo1.wo_id = j.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
        INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id
				WHERE lel.ent_id = COALESCE(l.prod_ent_id, (select MIN(COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)) last_ent_id
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.final_job = 1 AND j.wo_id = wo.wo_id))
			) prod_ents_in_line
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order >= prod_ents.child_order
        LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_rejected <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id
		UNION
        SELECT wsu.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo wsu ON wsu.wo_id = j.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wsu.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id
				AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
    	INNER JOIN   (
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			    ON lel.line_id = l.line_id AND l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id
			) prod_ents_in_line
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order = prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wsu.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wsu.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wsu.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wsu.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_prod <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wsu.wo_uom_id
		UNION
		SELECT wol.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo wol ON j.wo_id = wol.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wol.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wol.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE wol.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.first_job = 1 AND i.uom_id <> wol.wo_uom_id
	)
    SELECT TOP 1 @no_conv_wo_id=wo_id from factors WHERE factors.factor = 0

    --EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL3, N'@ncw NVARCHAR(40) OUTPUT', @no_conv_wo_id OUTPUT
    --SELECT @no_conv_wo_id  --This causes no columns when no error so don't do.

	IF  (@no_conv_wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		  SET @err_msg = 'There is a quantity of an item for a job of work order %1 having a unit of measure for which there is no conversion to that of the final item for the work order, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{3005},' + @no_conv_wo_id
		  RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		  RETURN
	END

	INSERT INTO @wo_qtys (wo_id, fj_qty_at_start, fj_qty_reqd, lj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_reqd, lj_qty_prod, qty_rejected)
	SELECT j.wo_id
 	-- Get the starting quantity and quantity required by summing up the starting quantities and quantity required of all the first jobs.
 	-- The jobs starting quantity will converted to the work order''s UOM if possible.  If no conversion exists, starting quantity
	-- returned by this CTE will be null, so it will not be used.  This quantity will also not be used if the
	-- number of first operations in the work order is greater than one.
		, SUM(CASE WHEN j.first_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0) ELSE 0 END)
		, SUM(CASE WHEN j.first_job = 1 THEN j.qty_reqd * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0) ELSE 0 END)
	-- Get the starting quantity, quantity required, quantity produced, and quantity rejected at the last operation in the work order
	-- by summing up those values at the jobs marked as the final job for the work order.  There is no need to
	-- convert the values to the UOM of the item produced by the work order as the last operation must make the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This starting quantity will be used if there are more than one first operation or
	-- if the UOM of the item produced by the first operation cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced by
	-- the work order.  This quantity produced will be used if the work order is not run on a line or if the work order
	-- is run on a line but the UOM of the item produced at the production entities cannot be converted to the UOM of
	-- item produced by the work order.  This quantity rejected will be used if any item rejected in a job running
	-- at or before the production entities in the case where the work order is run on a line or the final jobs
	-- in the case where the work order is not run on a line cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced by the
	-- work order.
		,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start ELSE 0 END) as qty_at_start
		,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_reqd ELSE 0 END) as qty_reqd
		,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) as qty_prod
		,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_rejected ELSE 0 END) as qty_rejected
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN @wo wo ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	WHERE j.first_job = 1 OR j.final_job = 1
	GROUP BY j.wo_id;

	-- To make the query more manageable, divide it into a series of CTEs.

	-- Get the quantity produced on a line by adding up the quantity produced by jobs running at the production entity.
	-- The UOM of the item produced by the jobs running on the production entities is converted to the UOM of the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This quantity will be null if the work order is not run on a line or if the UOM of
	-- the item produced at the production entities cannot be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work
	-- order.  Also get the sum of the required quantities of the jobs running on the production entities.  This
	-- quantity will be null if the work order is not run on a line or if the UOM of the item produced at the production
	-- entities cannot be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
    INSERT INTO @line_prod_ent_qty (wo_id, qty_prod, qty_reqd)
	SELECT wo.wo_id, COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_prod * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)),0),
		COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_reqd * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)),0)
	FROM @wo wo
	JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
             ON wo.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id
             AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
        INNER JOIN   (
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN @wo wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON lel.line_id = l.line_id
			WHERE lel.ent_id = COALESCE(l.prod_ent_id, (select MIN(COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)) last_ent_id
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.final_job = 1 AND j.wo_id = wo.wo_id))
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
               ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order = prod_ents.child_order
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	GROUP BY wo.wo_id

	-- Get the quantity rejected on a line by adding up the quantity rejected in all jobs running at or before the
	-- production entities.  The UOM of each rejected item is converted to the UOM of the item produced by the
	-- work order.  This quantity will be null if the work order is not run on an line or if the UOM of any rejected
	-- item at or before the production entities cannot be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work
	-- order.
	INSERT INTO @line_total_rej_prod (wo_id, qty)
		SELECT wo.wo_id, COALESCE(SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END)),0)
		FROM @wo wo
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
		     ON wo.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id
		     AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON lel.line_id = l.line_id
			WHERE lel.ent_id = COALESCE(l.prod_ent_id, (select MIN(COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)) last_ent_id
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.final_job = 1 AND j.wo_id = wo.wo_id))
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order >= prod_ents.child_order
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		GROUP BY wo.wo_id

	-- Get the rejected quantity of a work order that is not run on a line by adding up the total number of rejects
	-- in the work order.  The UOM of each rejected item is converted to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
	-- This quantity will be null if the UOM of any rejected item cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	;WITH nonline_total_rej_prod (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT x.wo_id, CASE WHEN (x.rejected = x.ignore_missed_conv) THEN x.rejected ELSE NULL END
		FROM
			(SELECT wo.wo_id
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END)) AS rejected
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, COALESCE(uc_generic.factor, 1)) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, COALESCE(uc_generic.offset, 0))) AS ignore_missed_conv
			FROM @wo wo
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id
			JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
			GROUP BY wo.wo_id) x
    ),
  	-- Get the total good for a work order.  The total good will either come from the quantity produced at the
	-- production entities if the work order is run on a line and the UOM of the item produced at the production
	-- entities can be converted to the UOM of the item produced by the work order or it will come from the quantity
	-- produced at the final operation in the work order.
	total_good_prod (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wo.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_prod, wff.lj_qty_prod, 0)
		FROM @wo wo
		LEFT OUTER JOIN @wo_qtys wff ON wo.wo_id = wff.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the quantity rejected for the work order.  The total rejected will come from the quantity rejected at or
	-- before the production entities if the work order is run on a line and the UOM of the rejected items can be
	-- converted to the UOM of the item produced by the work order, the quantity rejected at or before the final jobs
	-- if the work order is not run on a line and the the UOM of the rejected items can be converted to the UOM of the
	-- item produced by the work order, or the quantity rejected at the final jobs if the first two fail to return the
	-- quantity rejected.
	total_reject_prod (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wo.wo_id, COALESCE(ltrp.qty, nltrp.qty, 0)
		FROM @wo wo
		LEFT OUTER JOIN @wo_qtys wff  ON wo.wo_id = wff.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @line_total_rej_prod ltrp ON wff.wo_id = ltrp.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod nltrp ON wff.wo_id = nltrp.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the start quantity for the work order.  The starting quantity will either be the sum of the start quantities
	-- from the first operation if there is only one first operation and the UOM of the item produced at the first
	-- operation can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order or it will be the sum of the starting
	-- quantity of the final operation in the work order.
	start_qty (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, CASE WHEN (wff.num_op = 1) THEN COALESCE(jq.fj_qty_at_start, jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) ELSE COALESCE(jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) END
		FROM @wo wff
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys jq ON wff.wo_id = jq.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the qty_reqd for the work order.  This is either the sum of the required quantities of the jobs running at
	-- the production entities if the work order is run on a line and the UOM of the item produced by the jobs running
	-- at the production entity can be converted into the UOM of the item produed by the work order or by the sum of
	-- the required quantities of the final jobs.
	qty_reqd (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_reqd, ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0)
		FROM @wo wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON ljq.wo_id = wff.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the def_reqd_qty for the work order.  This is either the sum of the required quantities - sum of the quantity good
	-- produced of the jobs running at the production entities if the work order is run on a line and the UOM of the item
	-- produced by the jobs running at the production entity can be converted into the UOM of the item produed by the work
	-- order or by the sum of the required quantities of the final jobs - the sum of the quantity good produced of the final jobs.
	def_reqd_qty (wo_id, qty) AS (
        SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(CASE WHEN lpeq.qty_reqd - lpeq.qty_prod < 0 THEN 0 ELSE lpeq.qty_reqd - lpeq.qty_prod END, CASE WHEN ljq.lj_qty_reqd - ljq.lj_qty_prod < 0 THEN 0 ELSE ljq.lj_qty_reqd - ljq.lj_qty_prod END, 0) as qty
		FROM @wo wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wff.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
	)
	SELECT wo.wo_id
	,wo.wo_desc
	,wo.process_id
	,process.process_desc
	,wo.bom_ver_id
	,wo.spec_ver_id
	,wo.item_id
	,item.item_desc
	,item.serial_no_lvl
	,item.uom_id
	,uom.description AS uom_desc
	,item.num_decimals
    ,  COALESCE(@num_decimals_good_pp, 0) AS num_decimals_good_pp
	,wo.req_qty
	,wo.release_time_utc
	,wo.release_time_local
	,wo.release_time_utc as release_time
	,wo.req_finish_time_utc
	,wo.req_finish_time_local
	,wo.req_finish_time_utc as req_finish_time
	,wo.state_cd
	,wo.wo_priority
	,wo.cust_info
	,wo.mo_id
	,wo.production_schedule_id
	,wo.notes
	,wo.not_deletable
	,wo.disassembly
	,wo.may_override_route
	,wo.override_serialization
    ,wo.input_wo_id
    ,wo.input_oper_id
    ,wo.input_seq_no
    ,wo.target_sched_line_id
    ,line.line_name as target_sched_line_name
    ,wo.queue_seq_no
	,wff.wo_status_cd as wo_status
	--If the work order is not assigned to a line, then return the quantities from the last job in the work order.
   , qr.qty AS qty_reqd
	,sq.qty AS qty_at_start
	,tgp.qty AS qty_prod
	,trp.qty AS qty_rejected
	 --For a work order running on a line the remaining quantity is calculated by subtracting the good production from
	 --the jobs running at the production entity, the rejected production from the jobs running at the production entity,
	 --and the rejected production from jobs that have not been completed and are running on entities upstream from the
	 --production entities from the start quantity of the jobs running at the production entity.  For work order not running
	 --on a line the remaining quantity is calculated by subtracting the good quantity for the final jobs and the
	 --rejected quantity for the final jobs from the start quantity for final jobs.
	, CASE
           WHEN
           (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN sq.qty ELSE ljq.lj_qty_at_start END) -
           (tgp.qty + CASE WHEN trp.qty <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN trp.qty ELSE ljq.qty_rejected END) > 0
           THEN
           (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN sq.qty ELSE ljq.lj_qty_at_start END) -
           (tgp.qty + CASE WHEN trp.qty <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN trp.qty ELSE ljq.qty_rejected END)
		   ELSE 0
       END AS qty_remaining
	-- For a work order running on a line, the required quantity remaining is calculated by subtracting the good
	-- production for the jobs running at the production entities from the required quantity for the jobs running
	-- at the production entity. For a work order not running on a line the required quantity remaining is
	-- calculated by subtracting the good production for the final jobs from the required quantity for the final
	-- jobs.
	,drq.qty as def_reqd_qty
	,wo.spare1
	,wo.spare2
	,wo.spare3
	,wo.spare4
	,wo.last_edit_comment
	,wo.last_edit_by
	,wo.last_edit_at
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id))) mod_id
	,COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_at_start, (SELECT SUM(qty_at_start) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE final_job = 1 AND wo_id = wo.wo_id), 0) as calc_start_qty
	,COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_reqd, (SELECT SUM(qty_reqd) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE final_job = 1 AND wo_id = wo.wo_id), 0) as calc_reqd_qty
    FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT OUTER JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id = process.process_id
    INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = item.item_id
    INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON  item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.target_sched_line_id = line.line_id
	INNER JOIN @wo wff ON wo.wo_id = wff.wo_id
	JOIN start_qty sq ON wff.wo_id = sq.wo_id
	JOIN total_good_prod tgp ON wff.wo_id = tgp.wo_id
	JOIN total_reject_prod trp ON wff.wo_id = trp.wo_id
	JOIN qty_reqd qr ON wff.wo_id = qr.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wo.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
	JOIN def_reqd_qty drq ON wff.wo_id = drq.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod ntrp ON wff.wo_id = ntrp.wo_id
	ORDER BY wo.wo_desc
END

SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
FROM mail_grp_member
WHERE (id = @id AND
address = @address)

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_S_rpt_GetItemClassList]

-- Description: Get Item Class list for Sankey Report in the Item_Class filter Dropdown based on the selected Wo_id
-- 
-- Usage: Sankey Chart Report
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author					Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change Description
-- 0.01		Bharath Kumar(BK)			2021-01-22			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_rpt_GetItemClassList] 
@wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL

AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
		
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @tempWODetails TABLE
	(
		wo_id   NVARCHAR(40)
	  , item_id NVARCHAR(40)
	)
	INSERT INTO @tempWODetails
	(
		wo_id
	  , item_id
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT
			wo.wo_id,jb.item_id  	
		FROM  dbo.wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)ON wo.wo_id=jb.wo_id 
	WHERE
		(
			jb.wo_id = @wo_id
			OR @wo_id IS NULL
		)
	UNION--Union with arch db
	
		SELECT DISTINCT
			wo.wo_id,jb.item_id  
		FROM   [ARCHIVEDB].[OFI_MESDB_Archive].[dbo].wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN  [ARCHIVEDB].[OFI_MESDB_Archive].[dbo].job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)ON wo.wo_id=jb.wo_id 
	WHERE
		(
			jb.wo_id = @wo_id
			OR @wo_id IS NULL
		)
	
		SELECT DISTINCT
			ic.item_class_id   	
		FROM  dbo.wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)ON wo.wo_id=jb.wo_id 
		INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id=jb.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_class_id =item.item_class_id 
		WHERE (jb.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)

END

(@freq_name		STRING40_NULL
,@freq_desc		STRING40_NULL
,@freq_type		INT32_NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Sample_Freq_GetByFilter
-- Description      - The purpose of this method is to list the sample frequency, optionally filtered by the freq name, freq
--					  description and freq type.
-- Date Created     - 09/24/2010
-- Version          - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
	SELECT	sf.freq_id
	,sf.freq_name
	,sf.freq_desc
	,sf.freq_type
	,sf.interval
	,sf.interval_unit
	,sf.prod_reset_option
	,sf.offset_start
	,sf.offset_start_unit
	,sf.offset_end
	,sf.offset_end_unit
	,sf.samples_per_shift
	,sf.multiplier
	,sf.enabled
	,sf.expiry_time
	,sf.expiry_unit
	,sf.warning_time
	,sf.warning_unit
