CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_ApplyLabor]
(
		@in_session_id 					INT32
	,	@in_ent_id 		        		INT32
	,	@in_user_id						STRING80
	,	@in_start_time 					TDATETIME
	,	@in_job_based_login				INT32 = 0
	,	@in_wo_id						STRING80 = NULL
	,	@in_oper_id						STRING80 = NULL
	,	@in_seq_no						INT32 = NULL
	,	@in_skip_to_verify_exist_pct	INT32 = NULL
	,	@in_time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0
	,	@def_lab_cd 		        	STRING80 OUTPUT
	,	@def_dept_id 		        	STRING80 OUTPUT
	,	@pct_to_apply 	                TFLOAT OUTPUT
	,	@lab_usage_log_id				INT32 OUTPUT
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_I_ENT_LOGON_APPLYLABOR
-- Description			- After every insert into ent_logon table via sp_I_Ent_Logon causes this sp to account
--						  labor usage for the user using this entity
--						  Consolidated code from sp_ent_logon_aft_ins sp and ent_logon_after insert trigger to
--						  improve performance.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 03/31/2003
-- Version				- 2.0.0.33
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By				Changes
-- 05/09/2003		Raghu					Call sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor to crete duplicate records for other entities
--											as labor_start doesnot vary in milli seconds with other previous records
-- 11/13/2003		Raghu		2.0.9		While deleting labor_usage where duration < 2 secs, included labor_start to check
--											for last 2 minutes - as all the labor transactions will be finished in a minute or
--											two - For performance improvement
-- 11/26/2003		Raghu		2.0.0.12	Default job_pos to 0
-- 12/05/2003		Raghu		2.0.14		(HD# 4156) Changes included to handle Multi-Job Execs
-- 04/30/2004		SJ			2.0.33		Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
-- 12/20/2005		Raghu		3.1.6		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 03/20/2007		Raghu       3.2.0.3		Renamed from 'SP_I_ENT_LOGON_ACCOUNT_LABOR'
-- 04/04/2007		Raghu       3.2.0.6		HD# 9288, Logon a user to a job.
-- 05/09/2007		Raghu       3.2.11		Per KRF,BN email dated 05/08/2007 Loging an entity should automatically create a
--											labor_usage record even though the user uses job-based login.
-- 08/13/2007		AML			3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 06/12/2012		Ashish		4.0 SP1		Code merged from 3.5 P01 for HF CR L00120885
--10/29/2012		Saiteja		4.6			Added Chages for CR L00121381.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @session_id					INT32
	,	@ent_id 					INT32
	,	@user_id 					STRING80
	,	@start_time 				TDATETIME
	,	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32
	,	@job_based_login			INT32
	,	@skip_to_verify_exist_pct	LOGICAL
	,	@v_current_time_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@v_current_time_local		TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_id				INT32
	,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME
	,	@can_capture_labor 			LOGICAL
	,	@ent_name					STRING80
	,	@err_msg					NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@total_recs					INT32
	,	@allow_LT_cenpercent		NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@allow_MT_cenpercent		NVARCHAR(1)
--def_dept_id             STRING80
--def_lab_cd              STRING80
	,	@multiple_operators			INT32
	,	@logged_on_users			INT32
	,	@current_total_labor_pct	TFLOAT
	,	@total_pct					TFLOAT
	,	@v_client_info				STRING80
	,	@last_edit_by				STRING80
	,	@concurrent_link			INT32
	,	@job_count					INT32
	,	@total_run_jobs_on_ent		INT32
	,	@avg_pct_for_job			TFLOAT
	,	@tz_temp					INT32
	,	@client_type				INT32

BEGIN
	--Apply all defaults
	SELECT	@time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,	@session_id = @in_session_id
		,	@ent_id = @in_ent_id
		,	@user_id = @in_user_id
		,	@start_time = @in_start_time
		,	@job_based_login = COALESCE(@in_job_based_login, 0)
		,	@skip_to_verify_exist_pct = COALESCE(@in_skip_to_verify_exist_pct, 0)
		,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	--Retrieve the can_capability and the shift details for the supplied entity.
	SELECT	@cur_shift_id = cur_shift_id,
			@cur_shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
			@cur_shift_start_time_local = cur_shift_start_time_local,
			@can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor
	FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	SELECT @client_type = client_type FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sessn.session_id = @session_id

    --Verify whether th supplied entity can capture labor.
    IF  (COALESCE(@can_capture_labor, 0) = 0) BEGIN
        --The supplied entity cannot capture labor. Default the pct_to_apply to 0 and the labor usage log id to NULL.
		SELECT @pct_to_apply = 0, @lab_usage_log_id = NULL
    	RETURN
    END

    --If the entity has a capability to capture labor, and if a shift has not started on this entity, then raise an error.
	IF (@cur_shift_id IS NULL OR @cur_shift_start_time_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Retrieve the entity name based on the supplied entity id.
        SELECT @ent_name = ent_name
        FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @err_msg = 'You are attempting to log into this entity: %1 where a shift is not started on this entity. Pl start a shift before you log into this entity.{9999},' + @ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
    END


	SET @v_current_time_local = COALESCE( @start_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @v_current_time_local, @tz_temp, @v_current_time_utc OUTPUT

    --Verify whether this user has logged onto this entity on any other session.
    --ONLY if we need to apply the labor percentage (ie., labor_percentage is not 0)
    IF (@skip_to_verify_exist_pct <> 1) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK)
	                            WHERE session_id <> @session_id
	                              AND ent_id = @ent_id
	                              AND user_id = @user_id)
			--This user has logged on to the supplied entity on a different session.
			--Use the same labor percentage and log_id for this session as well.
			SELECT @def_lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd), @pct_to_apply = MAX(pct_lab_to_apply),
					@def_dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id), @lab_usage_log_id = MAX(cur_lab_usage_log_id)
	        FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK)
	        WHERE session_id <> @session_id
	          AND ent_id = @ent_id
	          AND user_id = @user_id
    END


    --Determine the allowable percentage while logging user into an entity.
    --Check 'Allow user to account for less than 100% of his time<1108>'
	SELECT @allow_LT_cenpercent = attr_value
	FROM system_attr  WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 188

	SET @allow_LT_cenpercent = COALESCE(@allow_LT_cenpercent, '0')

	--Check 'Allow user to account for more than 100% of his time<1109>'
	SELECT @allow_MT_cenpercent = attr_value
	FROM system_attr  WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 189

	SET @allow_MT_cenpercent = COALESCE(@allow_MT_cenpercent, '0')

    --Default def_lab_cd and def_dept_id if the supplied value is null.
    IF (@def_lab_cd IS NULL OR @def_dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT @def_lab_cd = COALESCE(@def_lab_cd, un.def_lab_cd),
               @def_dept_id = COALESCE(@def_dept_id, un.def_dept_id)
        FROM user_name un  WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE un.user_id = @user_id
    END

    --Verify whether this entity allows multiple users to login into this entity.
    SELECT @def_lab_cd = COALESCE(@def_lab_cd, le.def_lab_cd)
        , @def_dept_id = COALESCE(@def_dept_id, le.def_dept_id)
        ,@multiple_operators = COALESCE(le.multiple_operators, 0)
    FROM labor_exec le  WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE le.ent_id = @ent_id


    IF (@multiple_operators > 0) BEGIN
        --Assume there are no users logged on to this entity.
		SET @logged_on_users = 0

        --Get the no. of users logged on to this entity.
        SELECT @logged_on_users = COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
        FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

        --raise an error if the allowable maximum login limit has reached on this entity.
        IF (@logged_on_users >= @multiple_operators) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The number of operator logins for this entity has reached the maximum limit.{4718}',16,1)
			RETURN
        END
    END

    --Verify whether we should apply a valid percentage for a labor If yes, then we need to adjust the labor otherwise not.
    IF (COALESCE(@pct_to_apply, -1) = 0) BEGIN
        --If a user is part of a job based login group and if the user logs in using indirect labor
        --then the user's percentage is supplied as 0 meaning we should not collect any labor for this user on this entity.
        --On all other cases the percentage would be either a positive value or NULL.
		SELECT @pct_to_apply = 0, @lab_usage_log_id = NULL
    	RETURN
    END

	--Calculate the current average percentage to apply for each entity logon.
    SELECT @pct_to_apply = AVG(COALESCE(entity_percentage.pct_lab_to_apply, 0))
    FROM
        (SELECT ent_id, COALESCE(pct_lab_to_apply, 0) pct_lab_to_apply
        FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND pct_lab_to_apply <> 0) entity_percentage

    --Default the average percentage to apply to 1 if the user has not logged into any of the entities.
	SET @pct_to_apply = COALESCE(@pct_to_apply, 1)

    --Retrieve the actual user who is making these changes
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

    IF (@allow_LT_cenpercent = '0' OR @allow_MT_cenpercent = '0') BEGIN
        --Calculate the total labor percentage that is used by this user before the entity log off.
        SELECT @current_total_labor_pct = COALESCE(SUM(entity_percentage.pct_lab_to_apply), 0)
        FROM
            (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, COALESCE(pct_lab_to_apply, 0) pct_lab_to_apply
            FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE el.user_id = @user_id) entity_percentage


        --First verify whether the system parameter allows the labor to be accounted for 100%.
        IF (@current_total_labor_pct + @pct_to_apply <= 1 AND @allow_LT_cenpercent = '0')
        OR (@current_total_labor_pct + @pct_to_apply > 1 AND @allow_MT_cenpercent = '0') BEGIN
            --If we ADD the current percentage  (to the entity which this user is being logged on
            -- from the total percentage it falls below 1
            --and the system attribute does not allow to account the labor below 100%.
            --Adjust the remaining entities so that it total to 100%
			SET @total_pct = @current_total_labor_pct + @pct_to_apply
			SET @pct_to_apply = @pct_to_apply/@total_pct

            --Duplicate the current labor records that exists now.
            --For all the entities to which this user has logged on
            --create a new set of labor_usage records
            INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd,
				dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments,
				raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
            SELECT @v_current_time_utc, @v_current_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
                item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
                CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pct_to_apply/@total_pct END,
                1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
                @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
            FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE lu.user_id = @user_id
              AND lu.ent_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
              AND lu.active = 1

			--Close all the non-newly-duplicated current active labor_usage records
			--NOTE: lu.labor_start_utc <> @v_current_time_utc check below was not enough to find original records. Sometimes original and duplicated have same time.
            UPDATE labor_usage
            SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc)
               ,active = 0
            WHERE log_id IN (
				SELECT lu.log_id FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE lu.active = 1
				  AND lu.user_id = @user_id
				  AND lu.ent_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lu.user_id = @user_id)
				  AND (lu.labor_start_utc <> @v_current_time_utc OR lu.log_id NOT IN (
					SELECT max(lu2.log_id) FROM labor_usage lu2 WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE lu2.ent_id = lu.ent_id
								AND lu2.labor_start_utc = lu.labor_start_utc
								AND lu2.user_id = lu.user_id
								AND (lu2.wo_id = lu.wo_id OR (lu2.wo_id is NULL AND lu.wo_id is NULL))
								AND (lu2.oper_id = lu.oper_id OR (lu2.oper_id is NULL AND lu.oper_id is NULL))
								AND (lu2.seq_no = lu.seq_no OR (lu2.seq_no is NULL AND lu.seq_no is NULL))
					))
			)

			--Update ent_logon
			UPDATE ent_logon
            SET pct_lab_to_apply = CASE WHEN @total_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct END
               ,cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage  WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id AND active = 1)
            WHERE ent_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
				AND user_id = @user_id

        END --Verify the system attribute whether it can account less than or greater than 100%
    END

    --Verify whether entity login is based on the job.
    IF (@job_based_login = 0) BEGIN
        --The entity login is NOT based on the job.
        --Insert new labor usage records for all entities where a job(s) is running on an entity.

		 INSERT INTO labor_usage
		(
			labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no,
			sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration,
			comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
        SELECT	@v_current_time_utc, @v_current_time_local, @user_id, @ent_id,
				je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no, NULL, je.item_id,
				je.def_lot_no, je.def_sublot_no, @def_lab_cd, @def_dept_id,
				@cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local,
				(@pct_to_apply)/(COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(*) END FROM job_exec  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = e.ent_id AND cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL), 1)),
				1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
        FROM ent e  WITH (NOLOCK)
        LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no, jb.item_id, jb.def_lot_no, jb.def_sublot_no
                            FROM job_exec je  WITH (NOLOCK)
                            INNER JOIN job_bom jb  WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = jb.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = jb.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = jb.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = 0
                            WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL
                            )  je ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
        WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

    END ELSE BEGIN

        --Verify whether a valid job details are supplied.
        --If not, just log this user into an entity.
        IF (@in_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @in_oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
            --The entity login is based on the job.
            --Verify whether the supplied job is linked to a batch.
            SELECT @concurrent_link = concurrent_link
            FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE wo_id = @in_wo_id
              AND oper_id = @in_oper_id
              AND seq_no = @in_seq_no

            IF (@concurrent_link > 0)
                --The supplied job is linked to a batch.
                --Get a count of jobs that was started in a batch.
                SELECT @total_run_jobs_on_ent = COUNT(*)
                FROM job_exec je  WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
                  AND (cur_wo_id + '-' + cur_oper_id + '-' + convert( nvarchar, cur_seq_no )) IN
                    (SELECT wo_id + '-' + oper_id + '-' + convert( nvarchar, seq_no ) FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE concurrent_link = @concurrent_link)
            ELSE
                --This job is not linked to a batch.
                SELECT @total_run_jobs_on_ent = COUNT(*)
                FROM job_exec je  WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id
                  AND cur_wo_id = @in_wo_id
                  AND cur_oper_id = @in_oper_id
                  AND cur_seq_no = @in_seq_no

			SET @pct_to_apply = @pct_to_apply / COALESCE(@total_run_jobs_on_ent, 1)

            --The labor percentage is attributed ONLY to those jobs where the user has logged into a job.
            INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no,
                step_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc,
				shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd,
				last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
            SELECT	@v_current_time_utc, @v_current_time_local,	@user_id, @ent_id, je.cur_wo_id,
					je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no, NULL, je.item_id, je.def_lot_no, je.def_sublot_no,
					@def_lab_cd, @def_dept_id, @cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_utc,
					@cur_shift_start_time_local, @pct_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
            FROM ent e  WITH (NOLOCK)
            LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT je.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no, jb.item_id, jb.def_lot_no, jb.def_sublot_no
                                FROM job_exec je  WITH (NOLOCK)
                                INNER JOIN job_bom jb  WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = jb.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = jb.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = jb.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = 0
                                WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
                                  AND (je.cur_wo_id + '-' +  je.cur_oper_id + '-' +  STR(je.cur_seq_no)) IN
                                    (SELECT wo_id + '-' +  oper_id + '-' +  STR(seq_no) FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
                                    --Return all the batch jobs ONLY if the supplied job is linked to a batch.
                                    WHERE concurrent_link = @concurrent_link
                                      AND @concurrent_link > 0
                                    UNION
                                    --Return the selected job only if this job is not linked to a batch.
                                    SELECT wo_id + '-' +  oper_id + '-' +  STR(seq_no) FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK)
                                    WHERE wo_id = @in_wo_id
                                      AND oper_id = @in_oper_id
                                      AND seq_no = @in_seq_no
                                    )
                                )  je ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
            WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
		END
        ELSE
            --Just log this user into the entity since this user is using indirect labor to login to the entity.
            --Insert new labor usage record.
            INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no,
				sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration,
				comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
            VALUES
			(
				@v_current_time_utc, @v_current_time_local, @user_id, @ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				@def_lab_cd, @def_dept_id, @cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @pct_to_apply,
                1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, GETUTCDATE()
			)
    END

    --Retrieve the last log id for this user and ent.
    SELECT @lab_usage_log_id = MAX(log_id)
    FROM labor_usage  WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE user_id =  @user_id
      AND ent_id = @ent_id
      AND active = 1
END

-- =============================================
-- Name:    SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons 
-- Description:  Based on storage unit consumption type this SP will return records with quantity
--
-- Usage:  Used in SP: SP_I_ofi_Item_Cons_AddCons
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  VJ            2022-10-20      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	MP			  2023-01-30	  Big Fixed Equation Calculation
-- 0.03.00  YG			  2023-01-30	  Added Lot_threshold conversion of UoM 
-- 0.04.00  MP			  2023-06-09	  Added Lot_threshold, conversion of UoM, Rounding to 4 digits
-- 0.04.01	Veervar		  2024-02-09	  Logic comments added.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- EXEC SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons_copy_07_05_2025 363, '100000107893', 200, 'Equation'
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons_copy_07_05_2025]
		 @ent_id INT 
		,@item_id NVARCHAR(40) 
		,@Cons_Qty FLOAT 
		,@TypeOfCons NVARCHAR(20) = 'FIFO'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE 
		 @sum_qty FLOAT = 1
		,@full_cons_qty FLOAT
		,@threshold_qty FLOAT 
		,@cur_lot NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_sublot NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_qty FLOAT
		,@consumed_till FLOAT = 0
		,@minID INT
		,@row_id INT
		,@defaultUoM NVARCHAR(100) = 'KG'

	IF object_id('tempdb..#invlist') is not null DROP TABLE #invlist
	CREATE TABLE #invlist(id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, lot NVARCHAR(40) ,sublot NVARCHAR(40), qty FLOAT, cons_qty FLOAT,  consume_full BIT, grade_cd INT, status_cd INT, row_id INT)

	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "LIFO"
	IF @TypeOfCons = 'LIFO'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0 AS 'cons_qty', 0 AS 'consume_full', grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')
		ORDER BY row_id DESC
		SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist
		WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL AND @consumed_till < @Cons_Qty)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cur_qty = qty FROM #invlist WHERE id = @minID
			IF (@cur_qty>=(@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty =  @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = qty WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + @cur_qty
			END

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist WHERE id > @minID
		END
		SELECT * FROM #invlist  WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
	END
	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "Mixed"
	ELSE IF @TypeOfCons = 'Mixed'
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0, 0,grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')

		SELECT @sum_qty = sum(qty) FROM #invlist

		PRINT @sum_qty
		IF @sum_qty >= @Cons_Qty
		--UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = qty/@sum_qty*@Cons_Qty
		UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = ROUND(qty/@sum_qty*@Cons_Qty,4)

		SELECT * FROM #invlist  WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
	END

	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "Equation"
	ELSE IF @TypeOfCons = 'Equation'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @item_UoM NVARCHAR(40)
		SELECT @item_UoM = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id)

		--GET THRESHOLD VALUE FROM CONFIGURATION
		SELECT @threshold_qty = attr_value FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'Lot_threshold')
		SET @threshold_qty = ISNULL (@threshold_qty,50)
		SELECT @threshold_qty = dbo.fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom(@item_id,@threshold_qty,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,@defaultUoM,@item_UoM) 
		print @threshold_qty
		
		--INSERT LOTS FOR ENTITY AND ITEM IN TEMP TABLE
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0, 0,grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')
			order by qty_left 
		
		DECLARE 
		@Inv_items int,
        @counter int=1

        SELECT @Inv_items=count(*) FROM #invlist
		
		--LOOP THROUGH EACH RECORD FROM TEMP TABLE
      	WHILE (@counter<=@Inv_items)
        BEGIN
        	SELECT @cur_lot=lot,@cur_sublot=sublot,@cur_qty=qty, @row_id=row_id FROM #invlist WHERE id=@counter   
			
			--IF THRSHILD QUANITTY IS GREATER THAN CURRENT QTY THEN CONSUME LOT COMPLETELY
			IF (@cur_qty <= @threshold_qty AND @consumed_till <@Cons_Qty)
            BEGIN
				print 'threshold greater then qty in silo'
            	UPDATE #invlist 
                SET cons_qty =CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END 
                ,consume_full=1
                WHERE row_id = @row_id

                SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END
            END
           	SET @counter=@counter+1
        END
		
		PRINT @consumed_till

		IF (@Cons_Qty -@consumed_till)>0
		BEGIN
			print 'not consumed completely'
			SELECT @sum_qty = sum(qty) FROM #invlist WHERE consume_full =0
					
			IF @sum_qty >= @Cons_Qty - @consumed_till
			BEGIN
				print 'qty available in silo greater then or equal to qty to consume'
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = ROUND( qty/@sum_qty*(@Cons_Qty - @consumed_till),4) WHERE consume_full =0
			END
			
		END
		SELECT * FROM #invlist  WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
		
	END  
	--GET LOTS FOR TYPE CONSUPTION "FIFO"
	ELSE --@TypeOfCons = 'FIFO'    FIFO Or other settings - Default is FIFO
	BEGIN
	--GET LOTS FOR ITEM AND ENTITY IN ORDER BY ROW_ID
		INSERT INTO #invlist
		SELECT  lot_no, sublot_no, qty_left, 0 AS 'cons_qty', 0 AS 'consume_full', grade_cd, status_cd, row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
			AND item_id = @item_id 
			AND status_cd = (SELECT status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')
		ORDER BY row_id

		SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist
		WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL AND @consumed_till < @Cons_Qty)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @cur_qty = qty FROM #invlist WHERE id = @minID
			IF (@cur_qty>=(@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty =  @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + CASE WHEN @cur_qty<= (@Cons_Qty-@consumed_till) THEN @cur_qty ELSE @Cons_Qty-@consumed_till END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #invlist SET cons_qty = qty WHERE id = @minID
				SET @consumed_till = @consumed_till + @cur_qty
			END

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM #invlist WHERE id > @minID
		END
		SELECT * FROM #invlist WHERE cons_qty >0
		DROP TABLE #invlist
	END
END

-- Description: Get user tables (schema + name) from current database
--
-- Usage:       Used to populate table selector in Layout mapping configuration form
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  AML, XPM      2026-02-20          Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_lm_list_tables]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT t.name AS table_name
    FROM sys.tables  t WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN sys.schemas s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
    WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0		
		AND (t.name like 'job%' OR t.name like '%wo%' OR t.name like 'item%')
    ORDER BY s.name, t.name;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Wo_Attr]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40),
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @mod_id  varchar(30)
 )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 09/15/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	 Part of DB Changes
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0      US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2      US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 6

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT wo_attr.wo_id
            ,wo_attr.attr_id
            ,wo.wo_desc
            ,wo_attr.attr_value
	    ,wo_attr.notes
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,wo_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,wo_attr.last_edit_by
            ,wo_attr.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM wo_attr wo_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo_attr.wo_id = wo.wo_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((wo_attr.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (wo_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (wo_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (wo_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (wo_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY wo.wo_desc, attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Message]
  (@sender nvarchar(80) ,
   @subject nvarchar(80) ,
   @sent datetime ,
   @sent_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @recipient nvarchar(40) ,
   @rcvd datetime ,
   @rcvd_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @message NOTES ,
   @ver_recpt bit ,
   @cc bit ,
   @category int ,
   @priority int,
   @save_till datetime,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value int = NULL ,
   @last_edit_at DATETIME OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver      Changes
-- 10/06/2005	  Raghu		   2.1.30	Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.
-- 05/02/2006	  Raghu		   3.1.15	HD# 5678, Store all tdatetime per system attribute 323 (V. 3.1)
-- 01/18/2007	  KRF		   3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	  AML		   3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									    dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/11/2009     Eswar        4.0		HF 1432 - datetime changes.
-- 02/04/2020     Jim O'Hearn  6.2.0    Removed ntext in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	STRING40
	,@current_time	TDATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

SET @sent_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@sent_tz)
SET @sent = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@sent, @sent_tz)

SET @rcvd_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@rcvd_tz)
SET @rcvd = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@rcvd, @rcvd_tz)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = @last_edit_at

 IF @sender IS NULL SET @sender = 0
-- IF @sent IS NULL SET @sent = @last_edit_at
 IF @recipient IS NULL SET @recipient = 0
 IF @ver_recpt IS NULL SET @ver_recpt = 0
 IF @cc IS NULL SET @cc = 0
 IF @category IS NULL SET @category = 2
 IF @priority IS NULL SET @priority = 2
--SET @sent = CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), @sent, 120)

  IF (@sent IS NULL)
	SET @sent = @current_time
  ELSE SET @sent =  DATEADD(mi, -@sent_tz, @sent)
  SET @sent = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sent )
  SET @rcvd = @current_time

 INSERT INTO message
 (sender,
  subject,
  sent,
  recipient,
  rcvd,
  message,
  ver_recpt,
  cc,
  category,
  priority,
  save_till,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@sender,
   @subject,
   @sent,
   @recipient,
   @rcvd,
   @message,
   @ver_recpt,
   @cc,
   @category,
   @priority,
   @save_till,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

	  , item_id NVARCHAR(40)

		wo_id
	  , item_id

		wo_id
	  , ITem_id

			wo_id = @wo_id

	FROM item_prod

		(
			wo_id = @wo_id
			OR @wo_id IS NULL
		)

		(

CREATE      PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_AUT_Validate] (
	@interface NVARCHAR(40)
	,@wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@seq_no INT = NULL
	,@qty FLOAT = NULL
	,@ent_id INT = NULL

	)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @result INT = 0
		,@storage_ent_id INT

	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2

	BEGIN

			SELECT TOP 1 1

				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no

			AND a.attr_desc = 'Lockforinput'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2

						FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id

		SELECT @qty_left= isnull(Sum(qty_left),0)
						FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id

			--	AND 
			--	(@lockforquality IS NULL OR @lockforquality != '1')
			--	)
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 1
		END
	END

				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no
			)
	BEGIN
		Declare @process_id nvarchar(40), @attr_id int,@attr_value nvarchar(20)
		select @attr_id=attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='CalculateButter'
		select @process_id=process_id from wo with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id
		SELECT @attr_value=attr_value FROM process_attr with (nolock) WHERE process_attr.process_id = @process_id and attr_id=@attr_id
		IF @attr_value = '0'
		BEGIN
		 SET @result = 1
		END
		--SET @result = 1
	END

	IF @interface = 'SUBLOT'
	BEGIN
		IF (
				SELECT count(ea.attr_value)
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'InterfaceWithAUT'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND ea.ent_id = (
						SELECT run_ent_id
						FROM job
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
						)
				) = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (
				SELECT ea.attr_value
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'InterfaceWithAUT'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND e.ent_id = (
						SELECT run_ent_id
						FROM job
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
						)
				) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (
				SELECT ea.attr_value
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'InterfaceWithAUT'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND e.ent_id = (
						SELECT run_ent_id
						FROM job
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
						)
				) = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 0
		END
	END

	SELECT @result AS result
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_DuplicateLabor]
(
		@user_id				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@ent_id					INT
	,	@labor_start_local		DATETIME
	,	@cur_lab_cd				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@cur_dept_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@cur_shift_id			INT
	,	@cur_shift_start_local	DATETIME
	,	@cur_pct_lab_to_apply	FLOAT
	,	@total_pct_lab_to_apply	FLOAT
	,	@duplicate_labor		INT
	--,	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = NUll
	,	@log_id					INT OUTPUT

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_I_Ent_Logon_Duplicate_Labor
-- Description			- When a new user logged into this entity, then closes the old active records on other
--						  entities and creates a new active row for all the entities with the new percentage
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 05/09/2003
-- Version				- 1.5.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 12/05/2003		Raghu	        2.0.14  (HD# 4156) Changes included to handle Multi-Job Execs
-- 06/15/2004		Raghu	        2.1.0   Modified to accomodate new param 'last_edit_comment while calling sp_I_Labor_Usage
-- 01/08/2006		KRF				3.2.1   HD# 8314 & 8605, part of DB changes - handle sublot_no and raw_reas_cd in labor_usage
-- 08/07/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 11/10/2009	    Kishore			4.0		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
-- 01/18/2010		Vinit			4.1		HF1432 Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @cur_log_id			INT
		,	@cur_wo_id			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_seq_no			INT
		,	@cur_lot_no			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_sublot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_item_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_ent_id			INT
		,	@cur_pct_to_apply	FLOAT
		,	@cur_step_no		INT
		,	@cur_comments		NVARCHAR(254)
		,	@no_running_jobs	INT
		,	@job_pct_to_apply	FLOAT
		,	@job_pos			INT
		,	@counter			INT
		,	@cur_raw_reas_cd	NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@labor_start_local_tz		INT32
		,	@cur_shift_start_local_tz		INT32
	IF (@duplicate_labor IS NULL) SET @duplicate_labor = 0
	--SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

    IF (@duplicate_labor = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE labor_usage_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
			SELECT	log_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id,
					shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, comments, raw_reas_cd
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id AND active = 1

		OPEN labor_usage_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

			FETCH NEXT FROM labor_usage_cursor INTO @cur_log_id, @cur_ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id,
				@cur_seq_no, @cur_step_no, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_item_id, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_dept_id,
				@cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_local, @cur_pct_to_apply, @cur_comments, @cur_raw_reas_cd

			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_local, @labor_start_local), active = 0
			  WHERE active = 1 AND user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @cur_ent_id AND log_id = @cur_log_id

			SET @cur_pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply

--			SET @labor_start =  DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @labor_start)

			SET @labor_start_local_tz=NULL
			SET @cur_shift_start_local_tz=NULL
			EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @cur_ent_id, @labor_start_local,@labor_start_local_tz OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @cur_ent_id, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage @cur_log_id OUTPUT, @labor_start_local, @labor_start_local_tz, @user_id, @cur_ent_id, @cur_wo_id,
				@cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_step_no, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_lab_cd,
				@cur_dept_id, @cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_local, @cur_shift_start_local_tz, @cur_pct_to_apply, 1, 0,
				@cur_comments, @cur_raw_reas_cd, NULL, 0, NULL

/*			UPDATE ent_logon SET pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply,
				cur_lab_usage_log_id = @cur_log_id
			  WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @cur_ent_id*/
		END
		CLOSE labor_usage_cursor
		DEALLOCATE labor_usage_cursor
	END

	SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)

--	Insert a new labor record for this user for the current entity
	SET @labor_start_local_tz=NULL
	SET @cur_shift_start_local_tz=NULL
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @ent_id, @labor_start_local,@labor_start_local_tz OUTPUT
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset @ent_id, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz OUTPUT
	IF (@no_running_jobs = 0) BEGIN
        EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage @cur_log_id OUTPUT, @labor_start_local, @labor_start_local_tz, @user_id, @ent_id, NULL, NULL,
        	NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_dept_id, @cur_shift_id,
			@cur_shift_start_local, @cur_shift_start_local_tz, @cur_pct_lab_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @job_pct_to_apply = @cur_pct_lab_to_apply/@no_running_jobs
		SET @counter = 1
		SET @job_pos = -1
		WHILE (@counter <= @no_running_jobs) BEGIN

			SELECT @job_pos = job_pos, @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
			FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			 AND job_pos = (SELECT MIN(job_pos) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
					  AND job_pos > @job_pos)

			--read def_lot_no and def_sublot_no FROM job_bom
			SELECT @cur_lot_no = def_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0

		      	--read item_id from job table for this wo, oper and seq_no
			SELECT @cur_item_id = job.item_id FROM job job  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND job.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND job.seq_no = @cur_seq_no

			EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage @cur_log_id OUTPUT, @labor_start_local, @labor_start_local_tz, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_wo_id,
				@cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, NULL, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_lab_cd,
				@cur_dept_id, @cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_local, @cur_shift_start_local_tz, @job_pct_to_apply, 1, 0,
				NULL, NULL, 0, NULL

			SET @counter = @counter + 1
		END
	END
	SET @log_id = @cur_log_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_Resource_Calendar](
@res_grp_id NVARCHAR(max),
@session_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
Declare @scheduledate date
select @scheduledate=scheduler_date from sdb..scheduler_sessn where session_id=@session_id

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--set @scheduledate=isnull(@scheduledate,'2017-11-10')

SELECT RPA.[res_id]
	  ,R.res_desc as res_name
      ,RPA.[ent_id]
	  ,E.ent_name as ent_name
      ,[start_time]
      ,[end_time]
      ,[session_id]
      ,[last_edit_time]

      ,[comment]

  INNER JOIN ENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.ent_id = RPA.ent_id
  INNER JOIN SDB.SCH.RES R WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.res_id = RPA.res_id
	where RGE.res_grp_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@res_grp_id, ',')) and (CAST(start_time as date) = @scheduledate or cast(end_time as date) = @scheduledate)


END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] 
--Create Date:        2025
--Author:             JSC
--Description:        To get a valid recorded timestamp for PROD or CONS so it will fall within a job run
--						The reason for this conversion is: 
--
/*

When a message is sent by automation it will be git the generated recorded time; it could be that in MES this timestamp a job was not running or has just finished.


*/

--Call by:            Common function; getting called from multiple SPs.                     
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] ('10000000','beanbulkintake',0,'2025-04-29 12:00:14.123')
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2025-04-29          JSC					1.0					First version
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] (
    @mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no INT,
    @recorded_timestamp DATETIME
)
RETURNS @Result TABLE (
	record_min_Diff INT,
	recorded_timestamp_case INT,
    record_selected DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME;
    DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT;
    DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT;

	INSERT INTO @Result
    SELECT TOP 1
       CASE
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN 0
            WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
                THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp))
            ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
        END,
        CASE 
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN 1
            ELSE 500017
        END,
       CASE 
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN @recorded_timestamp
            WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
                THEN DATEADD(MILLISECOND, 100, jh.job_start_utc)
            ELSE DATEADD(MILLISECOND, -100, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()))
        END
    
    FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE jh.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
        AND jh.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
        AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
            THEN 0
        WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
            THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp))
        ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
    END ASC;

    RETURN;
END;
