BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @cur_qty_prod				TFLOAT
		,  	@cur_wo_id 					STRING40
		,  	@cur_oper_id 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_seq_no 				INT32
		,  	@cur_shift_id 				INT32
		,  	@cur_shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@cur_shift_start_local		TDATETIME
        ,   @cur_hour_start_utc         TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
        ,   @cur_hour_start_local      TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
		,  	@cur_item_id 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_lot_no 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_sublot_no 				STRING40 -- added 1/10/2007 KRF
		--,  @cur_cont_id 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_reas_cd 				INT32
		,  	@cur_storage_ent_id 		INT32
		,  	@grade_cd 					INT32
		,  	@status_cd 					INT32
		,  	@good_prod 					INT32
		,  	@cur_update_inv 			INT32
		,  	@cur_backflush 				INT32
		,	@cur_material_type			STRING80 -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_subsegment_id			STRING80 -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_comments				STRING254 -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,  	@cur_spare1 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_spare2 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_spare3 				STRING40
		,  	@cur_spare4 				STRING40
		--,  @LotChanged 				INT32
		,  	@reas_desc 					STRING40
		,  	@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,  	@expiry_date				TDATETIME
		,  	@processed 					INT32
		,  	@byproduct 					INT32
		,  	@move_status 				INT32
		,   @return             		INT32
		,  	@pct_deviation				TFLOAT
		,  	@tot_qty_prod				TFLOAT
		,  	@qty_rejected				TFLOAT
		,  	@qty_at_start				TFLOAT
		,   @cur_to_ent_id      		INT32
		,   @cur_uom_id         		INT32
		,   @cur_bom_pos        		INT32
		--, @row_id						INT32
		-- 10/26/2002	TC	1.5.0	Include row_id as an output parameter to return the ID of the row updated or inserted
		, 	@inv_row_id					INT32
		-- 10/26/2002	TC	1.5.0	Call to Update Inv now returns its row_id
		, 	@max_qty_per_parent_item	TFLOAT
		, 	@min_qty_per_parent_item    TFLOAT
		, 	@must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL
		, 	@constant_qty				LOGICAL
		, 	@total_item_cons_qty		TFLOAT
		, 	@bFinalJob					LOGICAL
		, 	@totalFedJob				INT32
		--Added by Raghu on 12/03/2002.
		, 	@scaling_factor				TFLOAT
		--Added by Raghu on 03/05/2003
		, 	@qty_reqd					TFLOAT
		, 	@auto_job_end_option 		INT32
		, 	@attr_value					NVARCHAR(1)
		, 	@must_complete_steps		LOGICAL
		,	@last_edit_by				STRING40
		,	@running_job				LOGICAL
		,	@distinct_reject_prod		NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@good_prod_num_decimals		INT32
		,	@cur_int_qty_prod			TFLOAT
		,	@current_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@current_time_local			TDATETIME
		,	@auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job	INT32
		,	@sched_job_seq_no			INT32
		,	@sched_job_qty_at_start		INT32
		,	@parent_level				INT32
		,	@rework_cd					STRING40
		,	@overage_qty				TFLOAT
		,	@num_decimals				INT32 -- Fix for CR L00108169/HF 2188
		,	@override_serialization		BIT
		,	@serial_no_lvl				INT32,
		@t_wo_id 					nvarchar(40),
		@t_oper_id 					nvarchar(40),
		@t_seq_no 					int,
		@t_step_no 					int,
		@t_step_desc 				nvarchar(1700),
		@t_reqd_rep 				int,
		@t_qty_at_start 			float,
		@t_qty_prod 				float,
		@v_sql						NVARCHAR(4000),
		@state_cd					int32,
		@stoo_selcnt				int32
		,	@distinct_good_prod			NVARCHAR(1)
		,@current_subst		 INT32
		,@event_time_utc        TDATETIME
		,@rework_cutoff_mins    INT32
		,@qty_temp TFLOAT
		,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'JobExec.AddProd'
		,@err_msg				STRING254

	SELECT	@cur_wo_id = NULL
		,	@cur_seq_no = 0
		,	@grade_cd = NULL
		,	@status_cd = NULL
		,	@good_prod = NULL
		,	@cur_shift_id = NULL
		,	@last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		,	@running_job = 1
		,	@good_prod_num_decimals = 0
		, @event_time_utc = @created_at_utc

	SET @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 1)

	DECLARE @parent_ent TABLE(ent_id INT, can_sched_jobs INT, parent_level INT)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SELECT @cur_bom_pos = COALESCE(@byproduct_bom_pos, 0)

	IF (@cur_bom_pos < 0 )
        SELECT @byproduct = 1
    ELSE IF(@cur_bom_pos = 0)
       SELECT @byproduct = 0
    ELSE
	BEGIN
	   RAISERROR ('Please select a valid BOM Position.{1026}', 16, 1)
	  RETURN -1
	END

	--Verify whether an event time is supplied
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) BEGIN
			--Event time is not supplied, therefore, default to the current utc time
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
			--Determine the local time using the utc time
			SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
		END
		ELSE --an event time is supplied
			--Determine the utc time from the supplied local time
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	--Determine whether the supplied event time is greater than the current time
	IF (@event_time_utc > GETUTCDATE()) BEGIN
		--Default to the current datetime
		SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		--Determine the local time using the utc time
		SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
	END

	-- Make sure that @job_pos is not set to NULL.
	SET @job_pos = COALESCE (@job_pos, 0)

	-- Read current job data from the job_exec table
	SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no,
		@must_complete_steps = must_complete_steps, @auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job = auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job
	  FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos
	-- 10/26/2002	TC		1.5.0		Include job_pos in WHERE clause

	IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL) AND (@cur_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Fix for CR L00097025 (HF-1629)
		DECLARE @attr_val INT32

		SET @attr_val = 0
		--Read the value of "Factory Connector counts when no job is running" setting (Apply to last job run on entity/Do not apply to any job)
		SELECT @attr_val = CAST(attr_value AS INT) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_id = 365

		-- (@attr_val = 0 "Apply to last job run on entity" and @attr_val = 1 means "Do not apply to any job")
		IF @attr_val = 0
			SELECT TOP 1 @cur_wo_id = jh.wo_id, @cur_oper_id = jh.oper_id, @cur_seq_no = jh.seq_no
			FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON jh.ent_id = je.ent_id AND jh.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id
				AND jh.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND jh.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
			WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND je.ent_id IS NULL
			  AND jh.job_end_utc IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY jh.job_end_utc DESC
		ELSE
			RETURN --ignoring the factory connector counts as "Factory Connector counts when no job is running" is set to "Do not apply to any job"

		SET @running_job = 0
	END

	-- If NO job is running return an error-- raise the error if no utilization found for this job ?
	IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL) OR (@cur_wo_id = 'Idle') OR (@cur_wo_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@user_id IS NULL OR @user_id = '') BEGIN
		--Retrieve the user_id from the session table with the supplied session_id
		-- Get user id from sessn when @session_id is between -1 to -9 (reserved for custom implementations) or positive number
		IF(@session_id >= -9) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id = s.user_id
			FROM sessn s WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE s.session_id = @session_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
		    SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
		END

		--This will not help the UCO, however, since setting the operator production attribute does not set a current user
		--for the session.  It does however log that user in to the labor_usage table, and log any other user out.
		--So the next choice would be the first current  user found in the labor_usage table for the job
		--if there is one.  The �current user found in the labor_usage table� would be the one where duration was 0,
		--as terminating a labor_usage record sets the duration.
		IF (@user_id IS NULL OR @user_id = '')
			SELECT @user_id = MAX(lu.user_id)
			FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lu.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND lu.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
			  AND lu.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
			  AND lu.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND lu.duration = 0
			  AND lu.active = 1

		-- If there is no current user for the job either, use the background user (identified by system attribute 199).
		IF (@user_id IS NULL OR @user_id = '')
			SELECT @user_id = sa.attr_value
			FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sa.attr_id = 199

		--Raise a custom error, otherwise the database is going to throw a system generated error complaining about the user_id cannot be null.
		IF (@user_id IS NULL OR @user_id = '') BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('%1 may not be empty{5413},user_id', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @cur_shift_id=sh.shift_id
	FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
	AND shift_start_utc =
	(SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
		FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
		--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
		AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @event_time_utc)

	-- If values where not returned default them to Null shift and Now

	SET @cur_shift_id = COALESCE(@cur_shift_id, 0)
	SET @cur_shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@cur_shift_start_utc, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120))
	SET @cur_shift_start_local = COALESCE(@cur_shift_start_local, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120))

	SET @cur_hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_time_utc),0)
	SET @cur_hour_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @cur_hour_start_utc)

    SELECT @override_serialization = wo.override_serialization
    FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
--End of OEE Changes
	--Read current item_id and lot details from the job_bom table for the specified bom_pos
	--The 'where clause' is changed by Nagaraju on 08-12-02
	--this change is done to read the byproducts default values
	-- TC 10/22/2002 - Changed SQL to read from job_bom table
	--Raghu 12/03/2002. Added scaling_factor to read from the table
	SELECT	@cur_item_id = item_id
		,	@cur_lot_no = def_lot_no
		,	@cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no -- added 1/10/07 KRF
		,	@cur_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
		,	@cur_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
		,	@cur_update_inv = update_inv
		,	@cur_backflush = backflush
		,	@max_qty_per_parent_item = max_qty_per_parent_item
		,	@min_qty_per_parent_item = min_qty_per_parent_item
		,	@scaling_factor = scaling_factor
		,	@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod
		,	@constant_qty = constant_qty
		,	@current_subst = current_subst
		,	@cur_spare1 = spare1
		,	@cur_spare2 = spare2
		,	@cur_spare3 = spare3
		,	@cur_spare4 = spare4
	FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @cur_bom_pos

	IF(@cur_item_id IS NULL or @cur_item_id = '')
	BEGIN
	  SET @err_msg = 'The supplied woId:'+ @cur_wo_id + '; operId:' + @cur_oper_id + '; seqNo:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @cur_seq_no) + '; bomPos:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @cur_bom_pos) + ' does not exist.{4261},woId:'+ @cur_wo_id + '; operId:' + @cur_oper_id + '; seqNo:'  + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @cur_seq_no) + '; bomPos:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @cur_bom_pos)
	  RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16, 1)
	  RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@current_subst IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jbst.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
				  AND jbst.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
				  AND jbst.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				  AND jbst.bom_pos = @cur_bom_pos
				  AND jbst.alt_no = @current_subst)
		SELECT	@cur_item_id = item_id
			,	@cur_lot_no = def_lot_no
			,	@cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no -- added 1/10/07 KRF
			,	@cur_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
			,	@cur_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			,	@cur_update_inv = update_inv
			,	@cur_backflush = backflush
			,	@max_qty_per_parent_item = max_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@min_qty_per_parent_item = min_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@scaling_factor = scaling_factor
			,	@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod
			,	@constant_qty = constant_qty
			,	@cur_spare1 = spare1
			,	@cur_spare2 = spare2
			,	@cur_spare3 = spare3
			,	@cur_spare4 = spare4
		FROM job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jbst.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND jbst.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND jbst.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND jbst.bom_pos = @cur_bom_pos
		  AND jbst.alt_no = @current_subst
	END

	--Added by Raghu on 12/03/2002.  Apply Scaling Factor
	IF (@apply_scaling_factor  = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@scaling_factor IS NULL OR @scaling_factor = 0) SET @scaling_factor = 1
		SET @qty_prod = @qty_prod * @scaling_factor
	END

	--Check for Qty Deviation above Start Quantity
	IF @byproduct = 0 BEGIN  --means it's not a byproduct. so check for the qty devations
		SELECT @pct_deviation = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 103

		SELECT	@tot_qty_prod = isnull( qty_prod, 0 )
			,	@qty_rejected = isnull( qty_rejected, 0 )
			,	@qty_at_start = isnull( qty_at_start, 0 )
			,	@rework_cd = rework_cd
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id and oper_id = @cur_oper_id and seq_no = @cur_seq_no

		--Verify whether the current quantity reported + the quantities reported early exceeds the starting quantity of this job.
		IF (@qty_prod + @tot_qty_prod > @qty_at_start) BEGIN
			IF (@auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job = 1) BEGIN
				--Find a job (that has a mininum seq_no) that was never ran/started and is scheduled to a group entity
				--and has sufficient qty_at_start.
				SET @overage_qty = (@qty_prod + @tot_qty_prod) - @qty_at_start

				SET @parent_level = 1
				INSERT INTO @parent_ent (ent_Id, can_sched_jobs, parent_level)
				SELECT parent_ent_id, can_sched_jobs, @parent_level
				FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					SET @parent_level = @parent_level + 1

					INSERT INTO @parent_ent (ent_id, can_sched_jobs, parent_level)
					SELECT parent_ent_id, can_sched_jobs, @parent_level
					FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @parent_ent WHERE parent_level = @parent_level - 1)

					IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
				END

				SELECT @sched_job_seq_no = MIN(seq_no)
				FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
				AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
				--Jobs that are scheduled to a group entity.
				AND target_sched_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id
				                            FROM @parent_ent
				                            WHERE can_sched_jobs = 1)
				AND run_ent_id IS NULL
				AND qty_at_start >=  @overage_qty

				--Verify whether we found such a job.
				IF (@sched_job_seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
					--Yes, a job is found. Retrieve the stealing job's quantity at start.
					SELECT @sched_job_qty_at_start = qty_at_start
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
					  AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
					  AND seq_no = @sched_job_seq_no

					--Verify whether the scheduled job's quantity at start falls below zero, if the quantities are stealed.
					IF (@sched_job_qty_at_start - @overage_qty <= 0)
					    --The quantity falls below 0, update the qty_at_start to 0; and complete the other job.
					    UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = 0, state_cd = 4
					    WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
					      AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
					      AND seq_no = @sched_job_seq_no
					ELSE
					    --The quantity does not falls below 0, reduce the quantity.
					    UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start - @overage_qty
					    WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
					      AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
					      AND seq_no = @sched_job_seq_no

					--Add the quantity to the current job.
					UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start + @overage_qty
					WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
					  AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
					  AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

					--Reset the qty_at_start value with the current adjusted quantities.
					SET @qty_at_start = @qty_at_start + @overage_qty
				END
			END
		END

		--below condition is added by Nagaraju on 09-18-02
		IF @pct_deviation >= 0 BEGIN
			IF @pct_deviation > 0 BEGIN
				IF ((@tot_qty_prod + @qty_rejected + @qty_prod) > (@qty_at_start + (@qty_at_start * @pct_deviation))) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('The quantity good plus the quantity rejected is greater than the start quantity + deviation %{3286}', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF ((@tot_qty_prod + @qty_rejected + @qty_prod) > @qty_at_start) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('The quantity good plus the quantity rejected is greater than the start quantity{3287}', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
		END

	END

	-- If any parameter lot values are NOT null, and are different to the current values, then update the current values
	IF NOT ((@item_id IS NULL) OR (@item_id = '')) BEGIN
			SET @cur_item_id = @item_id
	END

	IF NOT ((@lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no = '')) BEGIN
			SET @cur_lot_no = @lot_no
	END

	--Added by Raghu on 12/11/2002. If lot_no is null, get from job_bom.lot_no, it still null, get from job_exec.def_lot_no
	IF (@cur_lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @cur_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos
	END

	-- Added following 1/10/07 KRF
	IF NOT ((@sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@sublot_no = '')) SET @cur_sublot_no = @sublot_no
	IF (@cur_sublot_no IS NULL) SELECT @cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos
	-- End 1/10/07 addition


	IF NOT (@reas_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	END

	IF NOT (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @cur_storage_ent_id = @to_ent_id
	END


	IF @comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' '
	BEGIN
		SET @cur_comments = @comments
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @cur_comments = NULL
	END
	--Added by Raghu on 11/23/2004 for HD# 5161
	IF @spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' '  SET @cur_spare1 = @spare1
	IF @spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' '  SET @cur_spare2 = @spare2
	IF @spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' '  SET @cur_spare3 = @spare3
	IF @spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' '  SET @cur_spare4 = @spare4

	--Modified by Raghu on 04/28/2003. Moved down below to check max min qty with cur_lot_no and cur_item_id
	-- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
	EXECUTE @return =sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no,  @cur_item_id, @qty_prod
	 -- Removed "@cur_lot_no," as this SP doesn't use it anymore 1/10/07 KRF
	IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1

	--below 2 conditions are added by Nagaraju on 12/10/02
	IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @cur_reas_cd = def_prod_reas_cd
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
	END

	IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Default Production Code is not defined{3288} ', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @reas_desc = reas_desc, @grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @status_cd = item_status_cd
	FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd

	-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get good_prod flagSELECT 	@reas_desc = reas_desc,	@grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @status_cd = item_status_cd FROM	item_reas WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd
	IF @grade_cd IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- reas_cd is defined, grade and status loaded - now get good_prod flag
		SELECT 	@good_prod = good_prod FROM	item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @good_prod IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid good_prod flag{3283}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

    SELECT @serial_no_lvl = i.serial_no_lvl
    FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE i.item_id = @cur_item_id

    IF (@override_serialization = 1) SET @serial_no_lvl = -1

	/*
	--Added by Raghu on 05/16/2003. Check for Repeatable steps
	IF (@must_complete_steps = 1 OR @serial_no_lvl = -1) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 'X'
			FROM job_step js WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND
					js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND
					js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND
					js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
			WHERE js.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND js.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND js.seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND jsg.repeatability = 1
		)
		BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 'X'
				FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON
						jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND
						jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND
						jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND
						jsd.step_no = js.step_no
					INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON
						js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND
						js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND
						js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND
						js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
				WHERE jsd.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
					AND (jsd.lot_no = ISNULL(@cur_lot_no, '') OR jsd.lot_no = ISNULL(@cur_lot_no, '-')) AND jsg.repeatability = 1
			)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('There are repeatable steps, and step data is not entered for this lot{3860}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END
	*/

	DECLARE @results AS INT32
	SET @results = 0

	IF (@must_complete_steps = 0 OR @serial_no_lvl = -1) BEGIN
    	--Verify whether there are any repeatable steps.
        IF EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 'X'
			FROM job_step js WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND
					js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND
					js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND
					js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
			WHERE js.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND js.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND js.seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND jsg.repeatability = 1
		)
		BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 'X'
				FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON
						jsd.wo_id = js.wo_id AND
						jsd.oper_id = js.oper_id AND
						jsd.seq_no = js.seq_no AND
						jsd.step_no = js.step_no
					INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON
						js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND
						js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND
						js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND
						js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
				WHERE jsd.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
					AND (jsd.lot_no = ISNULL(@cur_lot_no, '') OR jsd.lot_no = ISNULL(@cur_lot_no, '-')) AND jsg.repeatability = 1
			)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('There are repeatable steps, and step data is not entered for this lot{3860}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END

  	END ELSE BEGIN

		IF (@must_complete_steps = 1 AND @serial_no_lvl > -1) BEGIN
			--The steps must be completed before a production is reported.
			DECLARE @each_job_step TABLE (
				id int identity,
				wo_id nvarchar(40),
				oper_id nvarchar(40),
				seq_no int,
				step_no int,
				step_desc nvarchar(1700),
				reqd_rep int,
				qty_at_start float,
				qty_prod float
			)

			INSERT INTO @each_job_step ( wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, step_desc, reqd_rep, qty_at_start, qty_prod )
			SELECT js.wo_id, js.oper_id, js.seq_no, js.step_no, js.step_desc, js.reqd_rep, j.qty_at_start, j.qty_prod
			FROM job_step js WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					js.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND
					js.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND
					js.seq_no = jsg.seq_no AND
					js.step_grp_id = jsg.step_grp_id
				INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					jsg.wo_id = j.wo_id AND
					jsg.oper_id = j.oper_id AND
					jsg.seq_no = j.seq_no
			WHERE js.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND js.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND js.seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND jsg.repeatability = 1
			ORDER BY js.step_seq, js.step_no

			DECLARE @max_id AS INT32, @count AS INT32
			SELECT @max_id = MAX( id ), @count = MIN( id ) FROM @each_job_step

			WHILE ( @count <= @max_id ) BEGIN

				SELECT 	@t_wo_id = wo_id, @t_oper_id = oper_id, @t_seq_no = seq_no, @t_step_no = step_no
					, 	@t_step_desc = step_desc, @t_reqd_rep = reqd_rep, @t_qty_at_start = qty_at_start, @t_qty_prod = qty_prod
				FROM @each_job_step ejs
				WHERE ejs.id = @count

				--Verify whether the step occurrence is set to 0.
				IF (@t_reqd_rep = 0) BEGIN
					--When reqd_rep=0, steps must be completed for each serial number before production of the serial number is allowed
					IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1
						 FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
						 WHERE jsd.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
						 	   jsd.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
							   jsd.seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
							   jsd.step_no = @t_step_no AND
							   ( jsd.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (jsd.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL) OR (jsd.lot_no = COALESCE(@cur_lot_no, '-'))) AND jsd.state_cd <> 9 )
					BEGIN
	  					--This step was never started before. Raise an exception to the caller to star this step before reporting a production.
						SET @v_sql = 'The step: %1 (%2) has not started for the lot: %3.{5524}, ' + convert(varchar, @t_step_no) + ', ' + @t_step_desc + ',' + COALESCE(@cur_lot_no, 'NULL')
						RAISERROR( @v_sql, 16, 1 )
						RETURN -1

					END ELSE BEGIN

						SELECT TOP 1 @state_cd = jsd.state_cd
						FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE jsd.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
							  jsd.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
							  jsd.seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
							  jsd.step_no = @t_step_no AND
							  (jsd.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR
							  	(jsd.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL) OR
								(jsd.lot_no = COALESCE(@cur_lot_no, '-'))
							  ) AND jsd.state_cd <> 9

						IF (@state_cd <> 4) BEGIN
							--This step was started; but was not completed. Raise an exception to the caller to complete the step before reporting production.
							SET @v_sql = 'The step: %1 (%2) has not completed for the lot: %3.{5523},' + STR(@t_step_no) + ',' + @t_step_desc + ',' + COALESCE(@cur_lot_no, 'NULL')
							RAISERROR( @v_sql, 16, 1 )
							RETURN -1
						END
					END

				END ELSE BEGIN
					IF (@t_reqd_rep > 0) BEGIN
						--The step occurrence is > 0.
						--when the reqd_rep > 0, steps for an equal number of produced serial numbers must be completed,
						--and they would need completed prior to the start quantity going below the occurrence,
						--as we don't care which serial numbers the steps are completed for,
						--just that steps are completed for a number of serial numbers equal to occurrence
						--before production of the remaining quantity is allowed.
						SELECT @stoo_selcnt = COUNT(*)
						FROM job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE jsd.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
							  jsd.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
							  jsd.seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
							  jsd.step_no = @t_step_no AND
							  jsd.state_cd = 4

						--Per BN/KRF discussion on email SUB: RE: 3.2 Release, dated 06/13/2007 3:05 AM, the production can be reported till the qty_prod <= job.qty_at_start-job_step.reqd_rep
						--But, if any further production is being attempted, BEGIN the user must first complete the step before adding production.
						IF (@t_qty_prod - @stoo_selcnt) >= (@t_qty_at_start - @t_reqd_rep) BEGIN
							SET @v_sql = 'You have not completed step: %1 (%2) enough times in order to report production for serial no: %3.{5525},' + STR(@t_step_no) + ',' + @t_step_desc + ',' + COALESCE(@cur_lot_no, 'NULL')
							RAISERROR( @v_sql, 16, 1 )
							RETURN -1
						END
					END
				END

				SET @count = @count + 1
			END
		END
  	END

	-- Do NOT update the current lot data in the job_bom table If any of the parameter values have changed
	-- Find out if row exists for this PK - if so read current qty_prod value for it
	SELECT @distinct_reject_prod = '0', @distinct_good_prod = '0', @cur_qty_prod = NULL, @good_prod_num_decimals = 0
	SELECT @distinct_reject_prod = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 309
	SELECT @distinct_good_prod = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 362

	EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis	@cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_storage_ent_id, -- Added "@cur_sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
										@qty_prod OUTPUT, @cur_int_qty_prod OUTPUT, @good_prod_num_decimals OUTPUT

	SELECT @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0), @cur_int_qty_prod = ISNULL(@cur_int_qty_prod, 0)

	IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod = 0) BEGIN
		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod != 0) SET @cur_qty_prod = @cur_int_qty_prod
		ELSE SET @cur_qty_prod = @qty_prod
		IF @byproduct = 0 BEGIN
			IF (@running_job = 1)
				-- Added "@cur_sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
				-- Added one parameter i.e. @check_privs while calling the below procedure in order to resolve the issue of created_at_local and created_at_utc fields getting same value saved in item_cons table.[Abhay]
				EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlush	@session_id, @event_time_local,@user_id, @ent_id, @job_pos, @cur_qty_prod,
															NULL, NULL, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @genealogy_id, @check_privs, @time_zone_bias_value
			ELSE
				-- Added "@cur_sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
                ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
				EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlshPstExec	@session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_qty_prod,
																	@cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_hour_start_local,

																	@cur_shift_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no,
																	NULL
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END
	--Retrieve the system attribute to determine whether or not to kick off the rework process.
    SELECT @rework_cutoff_mins = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 410
    IF @@ROWCOUNT <1 BEGIN
       SET @rework_cutoff_mins = 0
	END

	IF ((@rework_cutoff_mins = 0)
    --If the cut off time is 0, always verify whether this job needs to be reworked or not.
    --otherwise verify whether the supplied local time falls within the cut off time.
    OR (@event_time_utc >= DATEADD(mm, -@rework_cutoff_mins, GETUTCDATE())))
	BEGIN
		--Verify whether this job needs to be reworked.
	EXEC sp_I_Job_Exec_CRWFP	@cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, NULL, @cur_reas_cd, @rework_cd, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no,
								@cur_sublot_no, @qty_prod, @user_id, @qty_prod, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
								NULL, NULL, @check_privs, NULL, @prod_info OUTPUT

	END

	--Do NOT update the current lot data in the job_bom table If any of the parameter values have changed
	--Find out if row exists for this PK - if so read current qty_prod value for it

	--Modified by Raghu on 12/18/2002. lot_no is changed to allow NULL values.
	--Changed @cur_lot_no check - SJ 1/30/03
	--HD# 5087, Raghu - Maintain distinct Reject Production
	SET @cur_qty_prod = NULL
	IF NOT (@distinct_reject_prod = '1' AND @good_prod = 0 AND @qty_prod > 0)
		AND NOT (@distinct_good_prod = '1' AND @good_prod = 1 AND @qty_prod > 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_qty_prod = qty_prod, @cur_to_ent_id = to_ent_id
		FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(shift_start_utc) = @cur_shift_start_utc
            AND hour_start_utc = @cur_hour_start_utc---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			AND item_id = @cur_item_id
			AND (lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
			AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
			AND reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
			AND (to_ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @cur_storage_ent_id IS NULL))
			AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
			AND (event_id = @event_id OR (event_id IS NULL AND @event_id IS NULL))
			AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	IF @cur_qty_prod IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Do NOT update dependent fields for this row ???
		--Since we got the row_id, update directly
		-- Added suport for the new material_type, subsegment_id, and comments columns
		UPDATE 	item_prod
		SET qty_prod = @cur_qty_prod + @qty_prod,
			comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END,
			spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END,
			spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END,
			spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END,
			spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END,
			last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
		WHERE row_id = @row_id

		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('SQL Error updating item_prod table{3284}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

	SET @qty_temp = @cur_qty_prod+@qty_prod
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		-- Assign other defaults if not included
		SELECT	@processed = 0,	@move_status = 0

		-- Now insert the new row
		-- Added suport for the new material_type, subsegment_id, and comments columns
		INSERT INTO item_prod
		(
			-- Added ", created_at" 1/10/07 KRF
			-- Added "sublot_no," 1/10/07
            ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,hour_start_utc, hour_start_local, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no,
			reas_cd, user_id, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, to_ent_id, good_prod, qty_prod,
			qty_prod_erp, processed_flag, byproduct, ext_ref, move_status,genealogy_id, event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
			comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
			last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local
		)
		VALUES
		(
			-- Added ", @created_at" 1/10/07 KRF
			-- Added "@cur_sublot_no," 1/10/07
           ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			@cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_hour_start_utc, @cur_hour_start_local, @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no,
			@cur_sublot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @cur_storage_ent_id, @good_prod,
			@qty_prod, 0, @processed, @byproduct, @ext_ref, @move_status, @genealogy_id, @event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
			@cur_comments, @cur_spare1, @cur_spare2, @cur_spare3, @cur_spare4,
			@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @event_time_utc, @event_time_local
		)

		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('SQL Error inserting into item_prod table{3285}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		SELECT @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY(), @qty_temp = @qty_prod
	END

	IF (@byproduct = 0) BEGIN
		EXECUTE sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no

		--Create the bucket only if the production time is older than 3 hours from the current time
		IF (@event_time_utc IS NOT NULL AND @event_time_utc < DATEADD(HH, -3, GETUTCDATE()))
			-- Update the job_hour_history if needed
			EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @event_time_utc=@event_time_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment
	END

        --Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
	    EXEC sp_u_assigned_lot_updatestatus @item_id=@cur_item_id,
		    @lot_no=@cur_lot_no, @sublot_no=@cur_sublot_no,
	        @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id,
		    @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
			@total_qty_prod=@qty_temp


	EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @current_time_utc OUTPUT, @current_time_local OUTPUT, NULL

	--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 232

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		-- Added "sublot_no," and "@cur_sublot_no," to statement below 1/10/07 KRF
		INSERT INTO job_event
		(
			event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id,
			done_by_user_id, source_row_id, genealogy_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity,last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, 'AddProd', @ent_id, @cur_bom_pos, @cur_lot_no,
			@cur_sublot_no, @cur_item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @genealogy_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_prod, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		)
	END
   ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
   -- Modified for merge CR 121835 - needs to check if byproduct flag is false before calling sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys



	-- RWB - 02/01/2013 - Check if the entity can collect QM Data.  If so, call the sample generation stored
	-- procedure with an add prod event
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_capture_qm_data = 1) AND @byproduct = 0)
		EXECUTE sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id, @last_edit_at, 3, 0, 0, @time_zone_bias_value, @job_pos

	IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod = 0) BEGIN
		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod != 0) SET @cur_qty_prod = @cur_int_qty_prod
		ELSE SET @cur_qty_prod = @qty_prod

		-- Call SP to update Job table with total good and reject prod qty's from item_prod
		-- Refresh the start qty of all immediate downstream jobs
		IF @byproduct = 0 EXECUTE @bFinalJob =sp_S_Check_Item_FinalJob @cur_wo_id,@cur_oper_id,@cur_seq_no,@cur_item_id

		--Also update the TPM_Stat table with summarized data for this ent, job and shift---Calling this sp "sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys" is commented out. As we use a seperate trigger to update the quantities in TPM_Stat table. Below line is commented out by Raghu
		--EXECUTE sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start
		--Call SP to check whether to make any downstream jobs READY or not
		--Added by Raghu on 03/03/2003.  Added user_id, ent_id, job_pos parameters to be passed into sp_U_Job_Exec_ReadyDownstreamJobs
		EXECUTE SP_U_Job_Exec_ReadyDstrmJobs @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @user_id, @ent_id, @job_pos
		IF @to_ent_id IS NULL SET @to_ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id
		--@bFinalJob condition added by Rohit, to update inventory only for final job
		--for HD#-919
		--Check whether we should update inventory with this production quantity
		--Modified by Raghu on 06/19/2003 for HD# 3303. Commented the above line to include the below line. Need to test this
		IF @cur_update_inv = 1  BEGIN
			SET @expiry_date = NULL

			-- 11/03/04 SJ Lifetime from item used
			SELECT @expiry_date = @current_time_local + lifetime FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @cur_item_id AND lifetime > 0

			SET @cur_uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @cur_item_id)

			-- 10/26/2002	TC	Call to SP_I_Item_Inv_Add now returns its row_id so add it as a parameter
			-- Added "@cur_sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			EXECUTE @return = SP_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@cur_item_id, @lot_no=@cur_lot_no, @sublot_no=@cur_sublot_no, @grade_cd=@grade_cd, @status_cd=@status_cd
				, @add_qty=@cur_qty_prod, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=@event_time_local, @date_in_tz=@time_zone_bias_value, @expiry_date=@expiry_date
				, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @from_ent_id=@cur_storage_ent_id, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id
				, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL, @goods_received=0
				, @checkgradestatus=0 -- Ofi Update 
				, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @date_in_utc=@event_time_utc, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id OUTPUT
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END

		-- Check whether we should log this event or not
		--Added by Raghu on 03/05/2003. If qty_prod >= qty_reqd and if auto job end option is true, then end the job automatically.
		IF @running_job = 0 RETURN 0

		SET NOCOUNT OFF

		SELECT	@auto_job_end_option = auto_job_end_option
			,	@cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id
			,	@cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id
			,	@cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

		IF (@auto_job_end_option = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @qty_prod = qty_prod, @qty_reqd = qty_reqd FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no

			IF (@qty_prod >= @qty_reqd) BEGIN
				SELECT dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
				EXEC @return = sp_U_Job_Exec_EndJob @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @job_pos=@job_pos, @status_notes=NULL, @user_id=@user_id
						, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=0, @client_type=NULL, @no_propogation=0, @check_auto_job_start=1, @job_end_utc=@event_time_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

				IF @return = 0 RETURN 1
			END
		END
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON

RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Genealogy_Hierarchy_Rep] (
   @Start_Time DATETIME
  ,@End_Time DATETIME
  ,@Entity NVARCHAR(2000)
  ,@Item NVARCHAR(2000)
  ,@Work_Order NVARCHAR(2000)
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      sp_SA_Genealogy_Hierarchy_Rep
-- Description      Retrieve hierarchical genealogy data for the Genealogy By Item report
-- Date Created     13-Jan-2005
-- Version          3.1.0
-- Notes
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By    Ver                  Changes
-- 13-Jan-2005         GPK        2.1.2      Original version created
-- 17-Jan-2005         GPK        2.1.2      Added filter parameters
-- 28-Dec-2005         GPK        3.1.0      Compatible with version 3.1
-- 13-Mar-2005       Kishore      3.1.1      Compatibility for Local Timing
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
-- Create temporary tables for parameter lists
CREATE TABLE #tmp_tbl_ent_list (ent_id INT)
CREATE TABLE #tmp_tbl_item_list (item_id NVARCHAR(40))
CREATE TABLE #tmp_tbl_wo_list (wo_id NVARCHAR(40))
DECLARE @value NVARCHAR(400)
  ,@start INT
  ,@end INT
-- Extract the item IDs from the parameter list and insert the values into temporary ent_list table
SET @start = 1
SET @end = CHARINDEX(',', @Entity, 1)
WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
  SET @value = SUBSTRING(@Entity, @start, @end - @start)
  INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_ent_list (ent_id) VALUES (@value)
  SET @start = @end + 1
  SET @end = CHARINDEX(',', @Entity, @start)
END
IF LEN(SUBSTRING(@Entity, @start, LEN(@Entity) - @start + 1)) > 0 BEGIN
  SET @value = SUBSTRING(@Entity, @start, LEN(@Entity) - @start + 1)
  INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_ent_list (ent_id) VALUES (@value)
END
-- Extract the item IDs from the parameter list and insert the values into temporary item_list table
SET @start = 1
SET @end = CHARINDEX(',', @Item, 1)
WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
  SET @value = SUBSTRING(@Item, @start, @end - @start)
  INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_item_list (item_id) VALUES (@value)
  SET @start = @end + 1
  SET @end = CHARINDEX(',', @Item, @start)
END
IF LEN(SUBSTRING(@Item, @start, LEN(@Item) - @start + 1)) > 0 BEGIN
  SET @value = SUBSTRING(@Item, @start, LEN(@Item) - @start + 1)
  INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_item_list (item_id) VALUES (@value)
END
-- Extract the item IDs from the parameter list and insert the values into temporary wo_list table
SET @start = 1
SET @end = CHARINDEX(',', @Work_Order, 1)
WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
  SET @value = SUBSTRING(@Work_Order, @start, @end - @start)
  INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_wo_list (wo_id) VALUES (@value)
  SET @start = @end + 1
  SET @end = CHARINDEX(',', @Work_Order, @start)
END
IF LEN(SUBSTRING(@Work_Order, @start, LEN(@Work_Order) - @start + 1)) > 0 BEGIN
  SET @value = SUBSTRING(@Work_Order, @start, LEN(@Work_Order) - @start + 1)
  INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_wo_list (wo_id) VALUES (@value)
END
-- Create temporary table to hold the genealogy data
CREATE TABLE #tmp_tbl_genealogy (
   gen_item NVARCHAR(40)
  ,gen_lot NVARCHAR(40)
  ,gen_job NVARCHAR(100)
  ,gen_level INT
  ,wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
  ,oper_id NVARCHAR(40)
  ,seq_no INT
  ,fg_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
  ,fg_item_desc NVARCHAR(80)
  ,fg_num_decimals INT
  ,fg_units NVARCHAR(40)
  ,fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40) NULL
  ,fg_ent_name NVARCHAR(80)
  ,qty_prod FLOAT
  ,rm_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
  ,rm_item_desc NVARCHAR(80)
  ,rm_num_decimals INT
  ,rm_units NVARCHAR(40)
  ,rm_lot_no NVARCHAR(40) NULL
  ,qty_cons FLOAT
)
-- Populate the table with data as per the standard genealogy query
-- Add flags to indicate the produced items are the "top level" (level 1)
-- items in the genealogy hierarchy that we are creating
INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_genealogy
SELECT gen.*
  ,item_cons.item_id rm_item_id
  ,item.item_desc rm_item_desc
  ,item.num_decimals rm_num_decimals
  ,uom.abbreviation rm_units
  ,item_cons.lot_no rm_lot_no
  ,SUM(item_cons.qty_cons) AS qty_cons
FROM ( SELECT item_prod.item_id AS gen_item
         ,item_prod.lot_no AS gen_lot
         ,(item_prod.wo_id + ' ' + item_prod.oper_id + ' ' + CAST(item_prod.seq_no AS NVARCHAR)) AS gen_job
         ,1 AS gen_level
         ,item_prod.wo_id
         ,item_prod.oper_id
         ,item_prod.seq_no
         ,item_prod.item_id fg_item_id
         ,item.item_desc fg_item_desc
         ,item.num_decimals fg_num_decimals
         ,uom.abbreviation fg_units
         ,item_prod.lot_no fg_lot_no
         ,ent.ent_name fg_ent_name
         ,SUM(item_prod.qty_prod) AS qty_prod
       FROM system_attr sa, item_prod item_prod with (nolock)
         INNER JOIN item item with (nolock) ON item_prod.item_id = item.item_id
         INNER JOIN uom uom with (nolock) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
         LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent with (nolock) ON item_prod.ent_id = ent.ent_id
       WHERE sa.attr_id=324 And (item_prod.shift_start_utc+sa.attr_value/1440. >= @Start_Time OR @Start_Time IS NULL) AND
         (item_prod.shift_start_utc+sa.attr_value/1440.0 < @End_Time OR @End_Time IS NULL) AND
         ((@Entity IS NULL) OR item_prod.ent_id IN (SELECT * FROM #tmp_tbl_ent_list)) AND
         ((@Item IS NULL) OR item_prod.item_id IN (SELECT * FROM #tmp_tbl_item_list)) AND
         ((@Work_Order IS NULL) OR item_prod.wo_id IN (SELECT * FROM #tmp_tbl_wo_list))
       GROUP BY item_prod.wo_id,item_prod.oper_id,item_prod.seq_no,item_prod.item_id,item.item_desc,item.num_decimals,uom.abbreviation,item_prod.lot_no,ent.ent_name
  ) gen
  INNER JOIN item_cons item_cons with (nolock) ON gen.wo_id = item_cons.wo_id AND gen.oper_id = item_cons.oper_id AND gen.seq_no = item_cons.seq_no AND gen.fg_lot_no = item_cons.fg_lot_no
  INNER JOIN item item with (nolock) ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
  INNER JOIN uom uom with (nolock) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
GROUP BY gen.gen_item,gen.gen_lot,gen.gen_job,gen.gen_level,gen.wo_id,gen.oper_id,gen.seq_no,gen.fg_item_id,gen.fg_item_desc,gen.fg_num_decimals,gen.fg_units,gen.fg_lot_no,gen.fg_ent_name,gen.qty_prod,item_cons.item_id,item.item_desc,item.num_decimals,uom.abbreviation,item_cons.lot_no
-- Now parse through the records and for each given level 1 produced item (parent item)
-- use the same query to insert records relating to produced genealogy for it's consumed items
-- These records are inserted as part of the parent item's hierarchical genealogy but at level 2
-- Repeat until no further genealogy is found
DECLARE @gen_item AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@gen_lot AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@gen_job AS NVARCHAR(100)
  ,@gen_level AS INT
  ,@wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@oper_id AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@seq_no AS INT
  ,@fg_item_id AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@fg_item_desc AS NVARCHAR(80)
  ,@fg_num_decimals AS INT
  ,@fg_units AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@fg_lot_no AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@fg_ent_name AS NVARCHAR(80)
  ,@qty_prod AS FLOAT
  ,@rm_item_id AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@rm_item_desc AS NVARCHAR(80)
  ,@rm_num_decimals AS INT
  ,@rm_units AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@rm_lot_no AS NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@qty_cons AS FLOAT
  ,@cur_level AS INT
  ,@gen_exists AS BIT
-- Start at level 1 items
SET @cur_level = 1
SET @gen_exists = 1
-- Repeat until no further genealogy found
WHILE @gen_exists = 1
  BEGIN
    SET @gen_exists = 0
    -- Parse the records for the current level
    DECLARE gen_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT * FROM #tmp_tbl_genealogy
    OPEN gen_cursor
    FETCH NEXT FROM gen_cursor INTO @gen_item,@gen_lot,@gen_job,@gen_level,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@fg_item_id,@fg_item_desc,@fg_num_decimals,@fg_units,@fg_lot_no,@fg_ent_name,@qty_prod,@rm_item_id,@rm_item_desc,@rm_num_decimals,@rm_units,@rm_lot_no,@qty_cons
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        IF @gen_level = @cur_level
          -- Check for further genealogy of each consumed item at the current level
          IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_prod WHERE item_prod.item_id = @rm_item_id AND item_prod.lot_no = @rm_lot_no) > 0
            BEGIN
              SET @gen_exists = 1
              -- Insert records related to consumed item genealogy
              INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_genealogy
              SELECT gen.*
                ,item_cons.item_id rm_item_id
                ,item.item_desc rm_item_desc
                ,item.num_decimals rm_num_decimals
                ,uom.abbreviation rm_units
                ,item_cons.lot_no rm_lot_no
                ,SUM(item_cons.qty_cons) AS qty_cons
              FROM ( SELECT  @gen_item AS gen_item
                       ,@gen_lot AS gen_lot
                       ,@gen_job AS gen_job
                       ,(@gen_level + 1) AS gen_level    -- These records are at the next level of the hierarchy
                       ,item_prod.wo_id
                       ,item_prod.oper_id
                       ,item_prod.seq_no
                       ,item_prod.item_id fg_item_id
                       ,item.item_desc fg_item_desc
                       ,item.num_decimals fg_num_decimals
                       ,uom.abbreviation fg_units
                       ,item_prod.lot_no fg_lot_no
                       ,ent.ent_name fg_ent_name
                       ,SUM(item_prod.qty_prod) AS qty_prod
                     FROM item_prod item_prod with (nolock)
                       INNER JOIN item item with (nolock) ON item_prod.item_id = item.item_id
                       INNER JOIN uom uom with (nolock) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
                       LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent with (nolock) ON item_prod.ent_id = ent.ent_id
                     WHERE item_prod.item_id = @rm_item_id AND item_prod.lot_no = @rm_lot_no
                     GROUP BY item_prod.wo_id,item_prod.oper_id,item_prod.seq_no,item_prod.item_id,item.item_desc,item.num_decimals,uom.abbreviation,item_prod.lot_no,ent.ent_name
                ) gen
                INNER JOIN item_cons item_cons with (nolock) ON gen.wo_id = item_cons.wo_id AND gen.oper_id = item_cons.oper_id AND gen.seq_no = item_cons.seq_no AND gen.fg_lot_no = item_cons.fg_lot_no
                INNER JOIN item item with (nolock) ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
                INNER JOIN uom uom with (nolock) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
              GROUP BY gen.gen_item,gen.gen_lot,gen.gen_job,gen.gen_level,gen.wo_id,gen.oper_id,gen.seq_no,gen.fg_item_id,gen.fg_item_desc,gen.fg_num_decimals,gen.fg_units,gen.fg_lot_no,gen.fg_ent_name,gen.qty_prod,item_cons.item_id,item.item_desc,item.num_decimals,uom.abbreviation,item_cons.lot_no
            END
        FETCH NEXT FROM gen_cursor INTO @gen_item,@gen_lot,@gen_job,@gen_level,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@fg_item_id,@fg_item_desc,@fg_num_decimals,@fg_units,@fg_lot_no,@fg_ent_name,@qty_prod,@rm_item_id,@rm_item_desc,@rm_num_decimals,@rm_units,@rm_lot_no,@qty_cons
      END
    CLOSE gen_cursor
    DEALLOCATE gen_cursor
    -- Repeat for the next level of the hierarchy
    SET @cur_level = @cur_level + 1
  END
-- Return the data from the genealogy table
SELECT * FROM #tmp_tbl_genealogy with (nolock)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Bom_Item_Oper_Link
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					- 10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4/13/2004		Rich Boyle		2.0.31	Added the oper_desc column
-- 09/19/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/25/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id
		,	bom_item_oper_link.ver_id
		,	bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos
		,	bom_item_oper_link.process_id
		,	bom_item_oper_link.oper_id
		,	item.item_desc
		,	bom_item_oper_link.qty_per_parent_item
		,	bom_item_oper_link.reqd_start_pct
		,	(SELECT oper_desc FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = bom_item_oper_link.process_id AND oper_id = bom_item_oper_link.oper_id) AS oper_desc
		,	bom_item_oper_link.def_reas_cd
		,	bom_item_oper_link.def_lot_no
		,	bom_item_oper_link.def_sublot_no
		,	bom_item_oper_link.def_storage_ent_id
		,	bom_item_oper_link.def_reject_ent_id
		,	bom_item_oper_link.update_inv
		,	bom_item_oper_link.backflush
		,	bom_item_oper_link.must_consume_from_inv
		,	bom_item_oper_link.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
		,	bom_item_oper_link.may_create_new_lots

	FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id = item.item_id

		(bom_item_oper_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_Exec_NewReason]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@user_id		STRING40
,@new_reas_cd		INT32
,@comments		STRING2000 	= NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
-- Only one new event is handled at a time - only set parameters for this event, others = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 10/26/2002    Tony                   1.5.0    	Use job_pos = 0 for Util calcs on an entity
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 04/29/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	(HD# 3000) Donot duplicate rows in util_log if new_reas_cd and comments are same.
-- 12/03/2003	Raghu		2.0.13		(HD# 4214, 1322) Default job_pos = 0 IF NULL; else use lowest job_pos where job is running
-- 10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 07/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.19	Added a check to convert cur_comments to an empty string; if cur_comments is NULL; ISNULL(@cur_comments, '')
-- 01/30/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/11/2008	AML			3.4.0	Commented out the check for @reas_reqd = 1.
--09/25/2008	Raghu 	    3.5	L00082286, L00083732, L00084282, L00084592 ; UCO State Change and deadlock resolution
--11/18/2009    Eswar			HF1432 - Part of Date/time changes.
-- 08/17/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 675688-As Lenka, I want the Raw Reason from UCO and New Reason from Operator to be logged
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @cur_reas_cd		INT32
	,@cur_comments		NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@def_lab_cd		STRING40
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'UtilExec.SetReason'

	--Verify whether the entity captures utilization
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('A row does not exist in util_exec for this entity{3243}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Get the current reason code and the current comments
	SELECT @cur_reas_cd = uh.reas_cd, @cur_comments = uh.comments
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc) FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)

	--Default the reason code to the current reason code if not supplied
	SET @new_reas_cd = COALESCE(@new_reas_cd, @cur_reas_cd)

	--Verify whether the current reason and comments are exactly same as the new reason and the comments
	IF (@cur_reas_cd = @new_reas_cd AND COALESCE(@cur_comments, '') = COALESCE(@comments, ''))
		--The new reason and the comments are the same; therefore exit.
		RETURN

 	--Retreive the default labor code for the reason
	SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @new_reas_cd

	--Log a new labor event if there is a default labor code associated to it.
	IF @def_lab_cd IS NOT NULL
		EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor @user_id=NULL, @ent_id=@ent_id, @step_no=NULL, @lot_no=NULL, @sublot_no=NULL,
			@lab_cd=@def_lab_cd, @dept_id=NULL, @pct_to_apply=NULL, @comments=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

	--Create a new utilization event
	EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=NULL
		, @reas_cd=@new_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0, @comments=@comments, @raw_reas_cd=NULL
		, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
		, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
		, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @update_if_exists=1, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL
END

  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE wo_attr.wo_id = @wo_id AND attr.attr_grp = 6

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Message_SendEmail]
(@sender	NVARCHAR(80)
,@subject	NVARCHAR(80)
,@sent		DATETIME
,@sent_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@recipient	NVARCHAR(4000)
,@rcvd		DATETIME
,@rcvd_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@message	NOTES
,@ver_recpt	BIT
,@cc		BIT
,@category	INT
,@priority	INT
,@save_till	DATETIME
,@file_path1	NVARCHAR(4000)
,@file_path2	NVARCHAR(4000)
,@file_path3	NVARCHAR(4000)
,@file_path4	NVARCHAR(4000)
,@time_zone_bias_value INT = NULL
) AS

BEGIN
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_I_Message_SendEmail
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	04/29/2004
-- Version	      - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver	    Changes
-- 10/06/2005	    Raghu		2.1.30	Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.
-- 05/02/2006	    Raghu		3.1.15	HD# 5678, Store all tdatetime per system attribute 323 (V. 3.1)
-- 01/18/2007	    KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	    AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									    dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/25/2009	    Eswar		4.0		HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
-- 02/04/2020       Jim O'Hearn 6.2.0   Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @start			INT
	,@end			INT
	,@temp_recip		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@temp_path		NVARCHAR(254)
	,@temp_file_name	NVARCHAR(254)
	,@counter		INT
	,@temp_file_path	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@last_edit_by		STRING40
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,@current_time		TDATETIME
	,@dbg_resp			INT32

DECLARE  @recipients	TABLE(recipient NVARCHAR(80))
DECLARE	 @file_path	TABLE(path NVARCHAR(254), file_name NVARCHAR(254))

	SET @sent_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@sent_tz)
	SET @sent = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@sent, @sent_tz)

	SET @rcvd_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@rcvd_tz)
	SET @rcvd = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@rcvd, @rcvd_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Message_SendEmail', @src_key='post_validate', @date_val1 = @sent, @numeric_val1 = @sent_tz,
						@date_val2 = @rcvd, @numeric_val2 = @rcvd_tz

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = @last_edit_at

	IF CHARINDEX('::', @recipient) > 0 BEGIN
		SET @start = 3
		SET @end = NULL
		WHILE (@end > 0 OR @end IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @end = CHARINDEX('::', @recipient, @start)
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_recip = SUBSTRING(@recipient, @start, (@end - @start))
				INSERT INTO @recipients (recipient) VALUES (@temp_recip)
				SET @start = @end + 4
			END
		END
	END

	SET @counter = 4
	WHILE (@counter > 0) BEGIN
		IF (@counter = 4 AND @file_path1 IS NULL) OR (@counter = 3 AND @file_path2 IS NULL)
	 	OR (@counter = 2 AND @file_path3 IS NULL) OR (@counter = 1 AND @file_path4 IS NULL)
			SET @end = -1
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @end = NULL
			IF (@counter = 4) SET @temp_file_path = @file_path1
			IF (@counter = 3) SET @temp_file_path = @file_path2
			IF (@counter = 2) SET @temp_file_path = @file_path3
			IF (@counter = 1) SET @temp_file_path = @file_path4
		END
		SET @start = 3
		WHILE (@end > 0 OR @end IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @end = CHARINDEX('::', @temp_file_path, @start)
			IF @end > 0 BEGIN
				SET @temp_path = SUBSTRING(@temp_file_path, @start, (@end - @start))
				SET @start = @end + 4
				SET @end = CHARINDEX('::', @temp_file_path, @start)
				IF @end > 0 BEGIN
					SET @temp_file_name = SUBSTRING(@temp_file_path, @start, (@end - @start))
				END
				INSERT INTO @file_path (path, file_name) VALUES (@temp_path, @temp_file_name)
				SET @start = @end + 4
				SET @temp_path = NULL
				SET @temp_file_name = NULL
			END
		END
		SET @counter = @counter - 1
	END

	IF @sender IS NULL SET @sender = 0
--	IF @sent IS NULL SET @sent = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), GETUTCDATE(), 120)
	IF @recipient IS NULL SET @recipient = 0
	IF @ver_recpt IS NULL SET @ver_recpt = 0
	IF @cc IS NULL SET @cc = 0
	IF @category IS NULL SET @category = 2
	IF @priority IS NULL SET @priority = 2

--	SET @rcvd = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), GETUTCDATE(), 120)
	IF (@sent IS NULL)
		SET @sent = @current_time
	ELSE SET @sent =  DATEADD(mi, -@sent_tz, @sent)
	SET @sent = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sent )
	SET @rcvd = @current_time

	INSERT INTO message (sender, subject, sent, recipient, rcvd, message, ver_recpt, cc,
				category, priority, save_till, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @sender, @subject, @sent, recipient, @rcvd, @message, @ver_recpt, @cc,
		@category, @priority, @save_till, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM @recipients

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM @file_path)  BEGIN
		INSERT INTO emailatt (sender, sent, recipient, path, file_name, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT @sender, @sent, x.recipient, y.path, y.file_name, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at FROM
			(SELECT DISTINCT recipient FROM @recipients) x,
			(SELECT path, file_name FROM @file_path) y
		ORDER BY x.recipient, y.path, y.file_name
	END
END

-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_rpt_GetLotList] 
 @item_id NVARCHAR(1000),
 @wo_id  NVARCHAR(1000)= NULL
 
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--select DISTINCT lot_no from item_prod
	DECLARE @item_class_id NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @item_id = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@item_id, 0, CHARINDEX(' | ', @item_id))));
	
	SET @item_class_id = (SELECT DISTINCT
							  item_class_id
						  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
						  WHERE item_id = @item_id);
	WITH cte
		 AS ( (SELECT DISTINCT
				   lot_no
			   FROM item_prod WITH(NOLOCK)
			   WHERE
				   item_id = @item_id
				   AND
				   (
					   wo_id = @wo_id
					   OR @wo_id IS NULL
				   )
			   UNION--Union with archive DB
			   SELECT DISTINCT
				   lot_no
			   FROM  [ARCHIVEDB].[OFI_MESDB_Archive].[dbo].item_prod WITH(NOLOCK)
			   WHERE
				   item_id = @item_id
				   AND
				   (
					   wo_id = @wo_id
					   OR @wo_id IS NULL
				   ))
			  UNION
			  (SELECT DISTINCT
				   (lot_no)
			   FROM item_cons WITH(NOLOCK)
			   WHERE
				   item_id = @item_id
				   AND
				   (
					   wo_id = @wo_id
					   OR @wo_id IS NULL
				   )
			   UNION--Union with archive DB
			   SELECT DISTINCT
				   lot_no
			   FROM  [ARCHIVEDB].[OFI_MESDB_Archive].[dbo].item_cons WITH(NOLOCK)
			   WHERE
				   item_id = @item_id
				   AND
				   (
					   wo_id = @wo_id
					   OR @wo_id IS NULL
				   )) )
		 SELECT
			 *
		 FROM cte
		 WHERE
			 lot_no IS NOT NULL
			 AND lot_no <> ''
END

--            UNION
--            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0  AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id

            UNION
            SELECT (lrv * ((SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION

	      ,(SELECT urv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id

                   - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as urv
	      ,NULL
	      ,scltg.last_edit_comment

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ofi_AUT_ValidateTimeComplete
-- Description:  Validate the time complete if aut request
--
-- Usage:  Always gets called from the ArchestrA scripts under $AUT_Interfaces instances
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  YG            2023-07-30      Initial version.
--
-- EXEC [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_AUT_ValidateTimeComplete] @wo_id = '8105041851', @oper_id = 'BeanBulkIntake' , @seq_no = 0, @job_status = 5
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_AUT_ValidateTimeComplete] (
		@wo_id NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
		,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
		,@seq_no INT = NULL
		,@job_status INT = 0
	)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--SELECT @wo_id = '8105041851', @oper_id = 'BeanBulkIntake' , @seq_no = 0, @job_status = 1

	DECLARE @result INT = 0,
			@range INT = 10 -- in minutes

	-- Check Job Status AND Check Time Complete and Status (Completed / Suspended)
	IF (
		@job_status > 0
		)
		AND
		(
		EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no )--and DATEDIFF(minute, act_finish_time_utc, getutcdate()) <= @range and state_cd IN (4,5))
		)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1
	END

	SELECT @result AS result --> 1 is OK, 0 is ERROR
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_FromSavedList]
(@session_id   INT32
,@user_id   STRING40
,@list_id  STRING40
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--06/15/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed GetDate() to GETUTCDATE()
--12/21/2005	Raghu		3.1.6	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE	@current_time	DATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

	-- First delete (logoff) all rows for this session for this user
	DELETE Ent_Logon  WHERE session_id = @session_id AND user_id = @user_id
	--If cur_lab_cd and cur_dept_id NOT included set them to the default values
	--from the user_name table for this user.
	-- Then insert into saved list all current entities for this user
	INSERT INTO Ent_Logon  (session_id, ent_id, user_id, start_time, cur_lab_cd, pct_lab_to_apply,
					cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_usage_log_id)
	SELECT @session_id, ent_id, @user_id, @current_time,
		'cur_lab_cd' = CASE WHEN cur_lab_cd IS NULL THEN
				(select 'def_lab_cd' = CASE WHEN def_lab_cd IS NULL THEN
					(select min(lab_cd) from labor_cat)
				ELSE
					def_lab_cd
				END
				from user_name where user_id = ent_logon_list.user_id)
				ELSE
					cur_lab_cd
 		END,
		pct_lab_to_apply,
		'cur_lab_dept_id' = CASE WHEN cur_lab_dept_id IS NULL THEN
				(select 'def_dept_id' = CASE WHEN def_dept_id IS NULL THEN
					(select min(dept_id) from labor_dept)
				ELSE
					def_dept_id
				END
				from user_name where user_id = ent_logon_list.user_id)
				ELSE
					cur_lab_dept_id
 		END,
		null
	FROM Ent_Logon_List  ent_logon_list
	WHERE user_id = @user_id AND list_id = @list_id
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_chkSiloValidity]
(@ent_id STRING80
,@site_name STRING80 = NULL
,@silo_type STRING80 -- Source or Destination
) RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_chkSiloValidity
-- Description       - Returns the silo validity based on different parameters
-- Author			 - DS
-- Date Created      - 14/09/2022
-- Version			 - 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 14/09/2022     DS 			 1.0		Initial version

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	 @su_status_cd			INT32,
		@isNotValidEnt int
		
		if(@silo_type='source')
		BEGIN
			if((select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea
				join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
				where attr_desc='LockForOutput' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1 OR 
				(select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea
				join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
				where attr_desc='LockForQuality' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1)
			BEGIN
				set @isNotValidEnt=1
			END

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			set @isNotValidEnt=0
		END

		if(@silo_type='destination')
		BEGIN
			if((select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea
				join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
				where attr_desc='LockForInput' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1 OR 
				(select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea
				join attr a on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
				where attr_desc='LockForQuality' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1)
			BEGIN
				set @isNotValidEnt=1
			END

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			set @isNotValidEnt=0
		END

		select @su_status_cd =  su_status_cd from ofi_su_mes_states_mapping where su_ent_id =@ent_id and interlock_type= @silo_type
		
		
		if(@su_status_cd = 4)
		begin
			set @isNotValidEnt = 1
		end
		else
		begin
			set @isNotValidEnt = 0
		end


	--Return the @isValidEnt to the caller.
	RETURN @isNotValidEnt
END

-- Create date: 10 April 2017
-- Description:	This SP is used to get all resource group from [SDB].[SCH].[res_grp] table based on scheduler selection
-- =======================================================================================================================================
-- Change Date		Change By		Version			Changes
-- =======================================================================================================================================
-- Change Date		Change By		Version			Changes
-- 10/4/2017		GHe				1.0				original version

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ResourceGroup](
@loc_id NVARCHAR(max),
@scheduleDate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
declare  @sSQL NVARCHAR(max) 
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	;with AllEnt as (
			select ea.attr_value JobPosition, ea.attr_desc JPDesc,eaM.attr_value EntManaged, eaM.attr_desc EntManagedDesc, e.ent_id,e.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description from ent e with (nolock) 
			left join (select ea.attr_value, a.attr_desc, ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea with (nolock) 
			inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'JobPositions' ) ea   on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
			left join (select ea.attr_value, a.attr_desc, ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea with (nolock)  
			inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'MDM_Sched_EntManaged') eaM on eaM.ent_id = e.ent_id
			)
			, AllEntManagedParent as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntParent.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from AllEnt
			left join AllEnt AllEntParent on AllEnt.parent_ent_id = AllEntParent.ent_id)
			,AllEntManagedChildren as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntChild.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from AllEnt
			left join AllEnt AllEntChild on AllEntChild.parent_ent_id = AllEnt.ent_id)
			, AllEntManaged as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntParent.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from  AllEntManagedChildren AllEnt
			left join AllEntManagedParent AllEntParent on AllEnt.parent_ent_id = AllEntParent.ent_id)
	select distinct rg.res_grp_id, rg.res_grp_desc 
	 from SDB.SCH.res_grp rg  with (nolock) 
	 inner join SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent rge with (nolock) on rg.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id
	 --inner join job j with (nolock) on j.init_sched_ent_id = rge.ent_id
	 --inner join wo w with (nolock) on w.wo_id = j.wo_id
	 --inner join AllEntManaged AE on AE.ent_id = j.init_sched_ent_id and AE.EntManaged = 1
	 inner join AllEntManaged AE on AE.ent_id = rge.ent_id and AE.EntManaged = 1
	 where (@loc_id is null or rg.loc_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@loc_id, ',')))
	 --rg.loc_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@loc_id, ','))
	-- and cast(w.release_time_local as Date) = cast(@scheduledate as Date)

END
