CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Job_Hour_History]
(@ent_id  int  ,
 @wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @job_start_utc datetime,
 @hour_start_utc datetime,
 @shift_start_utc datetime,
 @shift_id  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @runtime  int  ,
 @downtime  int  ,
 @idletime  int ,
 @batch_size float,
 @last_edit_at datetime
)   AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Job_Hour_History
-- Description	      -
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

  SELECT tpm_stat.*
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,shift.shift_desc
            ,tpm_stat.item_id
            ,item.item_desc
    FROM tpm_stat tpm_stat WITH (NOLOCK)
         LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON tpm_stat.ent_id = ent.ent_id
         LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON tpm_stat.shift_id = shift.shift_id
         LEFT OUTER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON tpm_stat.item_id = item.item_id
      WHERE ((tpm_stat.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.job_start_utc = @job_start_utc OR @job_start_utc IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (tpm_stat.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc OR @hour_start_utc IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.idletime = @idletime OR @idletime IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.batch_size = @batch_size OR @batch_size IS NULL) AND
       (tpm_stat.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_po_line_aft_ins] ON [dbo].[po_line]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_po_line_aft_ins
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any insert is made on po_line
--			HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 05/18/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.21
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	UPDATE po_line SET po_line.quantity = ROUND(po_line.quantity, ISNULL(it.num_decimals, 7))
	FROM inserted i
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE po_line.po_id = i.po_id AND po_line.po_line_no = i.po_line_no
END

-- Description:	Insert approved Correction history on each dosing step approval
-- Usage: This will be used to save the approved correction recipe per bom_pos
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Ajeet   2023-05-23			Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	JSC		2025-12-08			CakeBlender FATs Fixed the update statement

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_job_bom_correction_details]
	@wo_id               NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id             NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no              INT,
	@item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
	@bom_pos             INT,
	@qty_reqd            FLOAT,
	@qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
	@dosing_step         INT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40),
			@last_edit_at DATETIME
			
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	
	IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
					FROM job_bom_correction_details jb WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE jb.wo_id      = @wo_id
						AND jb.oper_id  = @oper_id
						AND jb.seq_no   = @seq_no
						AND jb.item_id  = @item_id
						AND jb.dosing_step = @dosing_step
					)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO job_bom_correction_details
			(   wo_id,
				oper_id,
				seq_no,
				bom_pos,
				item_id,
				qty_per_parent_item,
				qty_reqd,
				actual_cons,
				dosing_step,
				last_edit_by,
				last_edit_at
			)
		SELECT @wo_id,
			@oper_id,
			@seq_no,
			@bom_pos,
			@item_id,
			@qty_per_parent_item,
			@qty_reqd,
			NULL,
			@dosing_step,
			@last_edit_by,
			@last_edit_at
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE job_bom_correction_details
		SET
			qty_per_parent_item = @qty_per_parent_item,
			qty_reqd            = @qty_reqd,
			last_edit_at        = @last_edit_at,
			last_edit_by        = @last_edit_by
		WHERE wo_id             = @wo_id
			AND oper_id         = @oper_id
			AND seq_no          = @seq_no
			AND item_id			= @item_id -- v2.00 Added missing in the where
			AND dosing_step     = @dosing_step
	END
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
-- Description: This is used to prepare the RM/SFG/FG materials report based on WIP consumptions
-- Note : Only NIBs has been tested
--			Liquor Loadout testing now
--
-- Runs before: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport; 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2024-07-25			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2025-02-06			Removed the filter for the ONLY NIBS
-- 0.01.02	JSC				2025-02-10			Fixed wrong link for INTERMEDIATE wip reports
-- 0.01.03	JSC				2025-02-10			Added the STRING_AGG function to avoid duplicates in ofi table
-- 0.01.04	JSC				2025-02-12			Added fix to prevent miss reporting WIP composition if another is still pending
-- 0.01.05	JSC				2025-02-13			Added fix to allow reblend in reblended liquors
-- 0.01.06  JSC				2025-06-30			Added fix to STRING_AGG to limit it to max size of column in target 80 chars
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- SP NAME: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork
	-- Declare general variables 
	DECLARE     
		 @internal_precision  	INT   = 7     -- Used for rounding of values to use in internal calculations
		,@reporting_precision 	INT   = 3     -- Used for rounding of values to use in reporting output
		,@to_report_perc      	FLOAT = 1  	-- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_cons	  	FLOAT = 1   -- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_cons_erp  	FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_total_cons	FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
		,@error_msg           	NVARCHAR(MAX) -- Error handling
		,@error_severity      	INT           -- Error handling
		,@error_state         	INT           -- Error handling
		,@debug            		BIT   = 0 -- Used for internal DEBUG -- SET to zero before deployment
		,@pending_cons  		INT = 0 -- Added v1.04: Used to prevent missing consumptions due to pending report
	
	
	-- Declare variables for STEP 1
	DECLARE @row_id				INT = -1
		,@ent_id				INT
		,@item_grp				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cons_lot				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cons_sublot			NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty	FLOAT
		,@cur_wo_id          	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_cons_qty 			FLOAT
		,@parent_ent_id			INT
		,@sublotcounter_attr_id INT
		,@cur_ent_sublot_no 	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_created_at		DATETIME

		
	-- STEP 1: Get TOP 1 oldest WIP/INTERMEDIATE Consumption record with quantity left to be reported
	-- Verify current sublot number running on the WIP production line
	SELECT TOP 1 
		 @row_id        		= ic.row_id
		,@ent_id            	= ic.from_ent_id
		,@item_grp          	= ia.attr_value
		,@cons_lot          	= ic.lot_no
		,@cons_sublot       	= ic.sublot_no
		,@cur_cons_qty 			= qty_cons
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty 		= qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0)
		,@cur_wo_id 			= ic.wo_id
		,@cur_created_at		= ic.created_at_utc
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
											AND ia.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.process_id = w.process_id 
												AND oa.oper_id = ic.oper_id
												AND oa.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'NotConsumeToSAP'
																	AND attr_grp = 7
															)																
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ie.item_id
												AND ic.wo_id = ie.wo_id
	CROSS APPLY
		[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_ValidateWIPReportSublot] (ic.lot_no, ic.sublot_no) AS vs 
	WHERE qty_cons_erp < qty_cons
		-- Retreive only consumption records older than 20 minutes
		AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,COALESCE(ic.last_edit_at,ic.created_at_utc),GETUTCDATE())>=20  
		-- INTERMEDIATE material class consumptions
		AND i.item_class_id IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
		-- Get only NIBs -- or Liquor (TO BE CHECKED)
		--AND ( ia.attr_value LIKE '%NIBS')   -- v1.01 REMOVED!
			 --OR ia.attr_VALUE  LIKE '%liquor')
		-- Prevent items to be reported when SkipConsumptionReporting is set
		AND ( ISNULL(ia2.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
		-- Prevent BACKFLUSH to be reported to SAP
		AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1
		-- Only consumptions with source entity are allowed
		AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
		-- Prevent reporting from Operations configured with NotConsumeToSAP
		AND ( ISNULL(oa.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
		-- Validate that sublot_no is not the current sublot being produced and if it was, wait at least 20 minutes
		AND ( 
				( 
					vs.prod_sublot_no <> ic.sublot_no 				 
					OR
					( vs.prod_sublot_no = ic.sublot_no
						AND vs.prod_job_state_cd <> 3  -- 3 means RUNNING
					)
				)
				AND vs.cons_sublot = ic.sublot_no
				AND vs.cons_lot = ic.lot_no
				AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,COALESCE(vs.prod_last_edit_at,GETUTCDATE()-100),GETUTCDATE())>=20  
			)
		-- Prevent 'non-traceable' consumptions to lock the reporting
		AND ic.wo_id IS NOT NULL 
	ORDER BY ic.created_at_local ASC

	-- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
	IF (@row_id IS NULL OR @row_id = -1)
	BEGIN		
			
		RETURN;
	END
	
	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 @row_id AS 'row_id'
				,@ent_id AS '@ent_id'
				,@item_grp AS '@item_grp'
				,@cons_lot AS '@cons_lot'
				,@cons_sublot AS '@cons_sublot'
				,@cur_cons_qty AS '@cur_cons_qty'
				,@cur_pending_cons_qty AS '@cur_pending_cons_qty'
				,@cur_wo_id AS '@cur_wo_id'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Declare variables for STEP 2
	DECLARE @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
		
	-- Declare variables for STEP 3
	DECLARE  @total_wip_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT

	-- Declare variables for STEP 4
	DECLARE @final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	-- Declare variables for STEP 5
	DECLARE  @cur_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			
	-- STEPs 2 - 5: Added into a Function:
	SELECT   @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio = wip_cons_qty_ratio
			,@final_cons_declaration = final_cons_declaration
			,@cur_rm_cons_to_report = cur_rm_cons_to_report
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
	FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (@cons_lot,@cons_sublot,@cur_pending_cons_qty)


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 2'
				,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty AS '@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty'
				,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp AS '@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp'

	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 3'
				,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty AS '@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty'
				,@wip_cons_qty_ratio AS '@wip_cons_qty_ratio'

	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 4'
				,@final_cons_declaration AS '@final_cons_declaration'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 5'
				,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty AS '@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty'
				,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp AS '@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp'
				,@cur_rm_cons_to_report AS '@cur_rm_cons_to_report'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --


	-- Declare variables for STEP 6
	DECLARE @cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio FLOAT

	-- STEP 6: Calculate the ratio of RM/SFG/FG to be reported on current row versus the total consumed for the sublot
	SET @cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio = @cur_rm_cons_to_report/@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 6'
				,@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio AS '@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Declare variables for STEP 7
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows AS TABLE ( 	 qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 
										,spare3 NVARCHAR(80) 
										,intermediate INT
										,intermediate_processed INT
										,created_at_local DATETIME 
										,fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,intermediate_row_id INT
									--	,PRIMARY KEY (row_id)
									)



	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows

	-- STEP 7: Get all rows from RM/SFG/FG related to the cur sublot to be reported on
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows
	SELECT 	ic.qty_cons
			,ic.qty_cons_erp
			,ic.lot_no
			,ic.sublot_no
			,ic.row_id
			,ic.spare1
			,ic.spare3
			,CASE 
				WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
					THEN 1
				ELSE 0
				END 
			,0
			,ic.created_at_local
			,ic.fg_lot_no
			,ic.fg_sublot_no
			,0			
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cons_lot 
		AND ic.fg_sublot_no=@cons_sublot
		AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
	--	AND CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)=0  --  v1.04: Removed so we can findout if something is pending

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 'STEP 7',*,qty_cons_erp/qty_cons as 'ratio' FROM @rm_cons_rows ORDER BY row_id asc
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Added v1.04: Verify if there is any pending consumption to be reported and abort this one.
	-- Calculate the amount of pending consumption quantity
	SELECT @pending_cons = ISNULL(SUM(CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)),0.0)
	FROM @rm_cons_rows ic

	-- STEP 7.1: Verify if we have any pending consumptions quantity the expected materials, and skip this round if so.
	-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
	IF (@debug = 0 AND @pending_cons > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
		SET [last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work: SKIP (Consumptions PENDING)'
		,[last_edit_at]=DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, [last_edit_at])
		WHERE [row_id] = @row_id
		
		-- exit SP
		RETURN;
	END

	-- STEP 8: Calculate for each consumption row of RM/SFG/FG that belongs to the sublot the spare1 (qty to report)
	UPDATE @rm_cons_rows 
	SET spare1 = CASE 
					WHEN (@final_cons_declaration = 1)
						THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
					WHEN (@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
					ELSE ROUND(((@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio)*qty_cons),@reporting_precision,2)
				 END
				 

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 'STEP 8',*,spare1/qty_cons as 'ratio',(spare1+qty_cons_erp)/qty_cons as 'ratio' FROM @rm_cons_rows ORDER BY row_id asc
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END--

	-- Declare variables for STEP 9
	DECLARE  @total_processed_intermediate INT = 0
			,@total_intermediate INT = 0

	DECLARE @cur_wip_row_id      		INT
			,@cur_wip_cons_lot_no       NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_fg_lot_no 	    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_fg_sublot_no	    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_cons_spare1		NVARCHAR(80)
			,@total_step_cons_qty		FLOAT
			,@total_step_cons_qty_erp 	FLOAT
			,@intermediate_row_id 		INT -- v1.05: Added to follow up sources
			
	-- Declare variables for STEP 9.4
	DECLARE  @total_step_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_step_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			
	DECLARE  @total_step_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@step_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT
			
	DECLARE  @step_final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	DECLARE  @step_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			



	-- STEP 9: While WIPs are found in the table from [6] and not rechecked completely; we should search upstream for RM/SFG/FG,
	--	    add any found consumptions in the table variable and mark the WIP as 'processed'.

	-- STEP 9.1:  Get the total intermedia WIP to be checked (WIP consumed to produce WIP)
	SELECT 	 @total_processed_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate_processed,0))									
			,@total_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate,0))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 1

	-- 9.1.1 prepare verification of pending reports
	SET @pending_cons = 0

	-- STEP 9.2: Start the WHILE loop 
	WHILE @total_intermediate > @total_processed_intermediate
	BEGIN
		
		-- STEP 9.3:  Get one WIP consumption from those to be reported and go upstream
		SELECT TOP 1
			 @cur_wip_row_id      		= rc.row_id
			,@cur_wip_cons_lot_no       = rc.lot_no
			,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no    = rc.sublot_no
			,@cur_wip_fg_lot_no 	    = rc.fg_lot_no
			,@cur_wip_fg_sublot_no	    = rc.fg_sublot_no
			,@cur_wip_cons_spare1		= rc.spare1
			,@intermediate_row_id		= rc.intermediate_row_id  -- v1.05: Added
		FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
		WHERE rc.intermediate = 1 and rc.intermediate_processed = 0
		
		-- STEP 9.4: Calculate ratio of reporting WIP consumption of the step
		SELECT   @total_step_sublot_cons_qty = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
				,@total_step_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp
				,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
				,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp
				,@step_cons_qty_ratio = wip_cons_qty_ratio
				,@step_final_cons_declaration = final_cons_declaration
				,@step_rm_cons_to_report = cur_rm_cons_to_report
				,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty
				,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
		FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (@cur_wip_cons_lot_no,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no,@cur_wip_cons_spare1)
			

		-- STEP 9.5: Insert the new consumptions from WIP
		INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows
		SELECT 	ic.qty_cons
				,ic.qty_cons_erp
				,ic.lot_no
				,ic.sublot_no
				,ic.row_id
				,CASE 
						WHEN (@step_final_cons_declaration = 1)
							THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						WHEN (@step_cons_qty_ratio*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
							THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						ELSE ROUND(((@step_cons_qty_ratio)*qty_cons),@reporting_precision,2)
					 END
				,ic.spare3
				,CASE 
					WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
						THEN 1
					ELSE 0
					END 
				,0
				,ic.created_at_local
				,ic.fg_lot_no
				,ic.fg_sublot_no
				,CASE											-- v1.05: Modified to include parent
						WHEN (@intermediate_row_id = 0)
							THEN @cur_wip_row_id         --from WIP
						ELSE
							@intermediate_row_id		-- from PARENT WIP
					END	
		FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no 
			AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
			AND CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)=0 
		
		-- STEP 9.6: Verify that we don't have any pending consumptions for this set:
		-- Calculate the amount of pending consumption quantity
		SELECT @pending_cons = @pending_cons + ISNULL(SUM(CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)),0.0)
		FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no 
			AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
		
		-- STEP 9.7:  Update the current row as processed
		UPDATE @rm_cons_rows
		SET intermediate_processed = 1
		WHERE intermediate = 1
			AND lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no
			AND sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_fg_lot_no
			AND fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_fg_sublot_no -- v.1.02 FIXED was pointing to cons sublot
			AND row_id = @cur_wip_row_id
			AND spare1 = @cur_wip_cons_spare1 -- v1.05 Added to prevent marking duplicates as processed

		-- STEP 9.8: Set the current values for this loop
		SELECT   @total_processed_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate_processed,0))									
				,@total_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate,0))
		FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
		WHERE rc.intermediate = 1
	END

	-- Added v1.04: Verify if there is any pending consumption to be reported and abort this one.
	-- STEP 9.8: Verify if we have any pending consumptions quantity the expected materials, and skip this round if so.
	-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
	IF (@debug = 0 AND @pending_cons > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
		SET [last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work: SKIP (WIP Consumptions PENDING)'
		,[last_edit_at]=DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, [last_edit_at])
		WHERE [row_id] = @row_id
		
		-- exit SP
		RETURN;
	END


	-- Declare variables for STEP 10
	DECLARE  @rm_total_spare1 FLOAT
			,@wip_total_reported_ratio FLOAT
			,@wip_total_reported FLOAT

	-- STEP 10: Calculate actuals to be reported from spare1 in table variable
	SELECT @rm_total_spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) 
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0

	SET @wip_total_reported_ratio = @rm_total_spare1/@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty

	SET @wip_total_reported = @wip_total_reported_ratio*@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty

	-- Aggregate any repeating row_ids
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows_to_report AS TABLE (								
										qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 								
									)

	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report

	
	-- Insert aggregated
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows_to_report
	SELECT   rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
			,spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0
	GROUP BY  rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
	HAVING SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) <> 0.000


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 	 @rm_total_spare1 AS '@rm_total_spare1'
				,@wip_total_reported_ratio AS '@wip_total_reported_ratio'
				,@wip_total_reported as '@wip_total_reported'
				
		SELECT * FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END--
		
	BEGIN TRY
	
		-- STEP 10.1: Start Transaction:
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;


		-- STEP 11: Add values to staging table, including the wo_id variable
		INSERT INTO ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported
		SELECT 	 rcr1.row_id
				,rcr1.lot_no
				,rc.fg_lot_no
				,rcr1.sublot_no
				,rc.fg_sublot_no
				,rcr1.qty_cons
				,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
				,rcr1.spare1
				,rc.spare3
				,'INSERTED for EI Report of WIPs'						
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,RIGHT(STRING_AGG(rc.intermediate_row_id,','),80)
				,@row_id
				,@cur_wo_id
				,@cur_created_at
				,NULL
		FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report rcr1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @rm_cons_rows rc ON rcr1.row_id = rc.row_id
		GROUP BY  	 rcr1.row_id
					,rcr1.lot_no
					,rc.fg_lot_no
					,rcr1.sublot_no
					,rc.fg_sublot_no
					,rcr1.qty_cons
					,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
					,rcr1.spare1
					,rc.spare3
		
		-- STEP 11.1: Select as OUTPUT
		SELECT DISTINCT	 rcr1.qty_cons
				,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
				,rcr1.lot_no
				,rcr1.sublot_no
				,rcr1.row_id
				,rcr1.spare1
				,rc.spare3
				,rc.created_at_local
				,rc.fg_lot_no
				,rc.fg_sublot_no
		FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report rcr1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @rm_cons_rows rc ON rcr1.row_id = rc.row_id

		-- STEP 12: Update the item_cons table spare1 based on the values from [11] table variable
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ic
			SET ic.spare1 = rc.spare1
				,ic.last_edit_comment = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work'
			FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @rm_cons_rows_to_report rc ON ic.row_id = rc.row_id
			
		END

		-- STEP 13: Update the item_cons table on WIPs reported erp column value with the 'theoretical' value
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
			SET [qty_cons_erp] = [qty_cons_erp] + @cur_pending_cons_qty 
				,[last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work'
			WHERE [row_id] = @row_id

		END
	
		-- STEP 13.1: Commit transaction.
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		
	END TRY
	
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		
		SELECT 	 @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE()
				,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
				,@error_state = ERROR_STATE();
				
		RAISERROR(   @error_msg
					,@error_severity
					,@error_state
				)
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_GetNextSampleName]
( @plan_id                   INT32
  ,@plan_name				  STRING80 = NULL
  ,@temp_sample_name	      STRING80 = NULL
  ,@reset_option          INT32 = 0
  ,@requested_time_local      TDATETIME=NULL
  ,@ent_name                  STRING80 = NULL
  ,@wo_id                     STRING40_NULL = NULL
  ,@oper_id                   STRING40_NULL =NULL
  ,@seq_no                    INT32=NULL
  ,@segment_requirement_id    STRING80_NULL=NULL
  ,@segment_response_id       STRING80_NULL=NULL
  ,@item_id                   STRING40_NULL=NULL
  ,@char_name					STRING80 = NULL
  ,@qm_spec_name				STRING80 = NULL
  ,@freq_name					STRING80 = NULL
  ,@prev_sample_name_template	STRING80 = NULL
  ,@prev_sample_name_instance	STRING80 = NULL
  ,@prev_sample_no				INT32 = NULL
  ,@next_sample_name           STRING80 OUTPUT
  ,@sample_name_instance		NVARCHAR(80) = NULL OUTPUT
  ,@next_sample_id				INT = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_GetNextSampleName
-- Description       - Generates a sample name based on sample_plan. sample_name
-- Author            - Johnny
-- Date Created      - 12/16/2011
-- Version     -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By Ver      Changes/Comments
-- 01/15/2012	Raghu			Changed the ID parameters (ent_id, char_id, spec_id and freq_id) to names.
-- 08/09/2012	Raghu			Code mods related to last_sample_no to improve performance
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  SET XACT_ABORT ON

  DECLARE
   -- @plan_name             STRING80
   --,@reset_option          INT32
   --,@next_sample_name      STRING80
  -- Octothorpe variables
     @oct                  STRING80
   , @has_oct              INT
   , @oct_start            INT
   , @oct_end              INT
   , @ctr                  INT
   , @oct_len              INT
   , @cur_char             char(1)
   , @max_sample_no        INT
   , @max_sample_to_go_no  INT
   , @next_sample_no       STRING80

   , @sample_param         VARCHAR(20)
   , @start_param          INT
   , @end_param            INT

   SET @requested_time_local=COALESCE(@requested_time_local,GETDATE());

   IF (@plan_name IS NULL OR @temp_sample_name IS NULL)
   SELECT
       @plan_name=plan_name
      ,@next_sample_name=sample_name
      ,@temp_sample_name = sample_name
      ,@reset_option =reset_option
    FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE plan_id=@plan_id;
   ELSE
	SET @next_sample_name = @temp_sample_name

	SET @sample_name_instance = @temp_sample_name

   -- Dates
		-- Year
	  SET @sample_param = '[YYYY]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
		  IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[YYYY]'
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,DATEPART(YYYY,@requested_time_local));
	  END

		-- Year
	  SET @sample_param = '[YY]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
		  IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[YY]'
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,DATEPART(YY,@requested_time_local));
	  END

      --Month of the year (integer) 01-12
	  SET @sample_param = '[MM]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Month of the year (integer) 01-12
		  IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[MM]'
		     SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,dbo.fn_PadNumber(DATEPART(MM,@requested_time_local),2,'0'));
	  END

      --Name of the month (January-December), depends on the locale
	  SET @sample_param = '[MONTH]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Name of the month (January-December), depends on the locale
	      IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[MONTH]'
	         SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,DATENAME(MM,@requested_time_local));
	  END

      --Day of the month   01-31
	  SET @sample_param = '[DD]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Day of the month   01-31
	      IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[DD]'
             SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,dbo.fn_PadNumber(DATENAME(DD,@requested_time_local),2,'0'));
	  END

      -- Week of the year 01-53
	  SET @sample_param = '[WW]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Day of the month   01-31
	      IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[WW]'
	         SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,dbo.fn_PadNumber(DATENAME(WW,@requested_time_local),2,'0'));
	  END

      -- Day name of the week (Monday, Tuesday, etc)
	  SET @sample_param = '[DAY]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Day of the month   01-31
	      IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[DAY]'
             SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,DATENAME(weekday,@requested_time_local));
	  END

      --Day of the week	(1-7), depends on the locale's first day of the week
	  SET @sample_param = '[WD]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Day of the month   01-31
	      IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[WD]'
	         SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,DATEPART(DW,@requested_time_local));
	  END

     --Day of the year, 01-366
	  SET @sample_param = '[DY]'
      SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param >0 BEGIN
          SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
          SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);
	      --Day of the month   01-31
	      IF UPPER(@sample_param)= '[DY]'
	        SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,dbo.fn_PadNumber(DATEPART(DY,@requested_time_local),3,'0'));
	  END

   IF @reset_option=1 SET @sample_name_instance=@next_sample_name;
   ELSE BEGIN
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[YYYY]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[YY]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[MM]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[MONTH]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[DD]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[WW]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[DAY]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[WD]', '')
	SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, '[DY]', '')
   END

	  -- Find the occurence in the sample_name, case insensitive
	  SET @sample_param = '[ENTITYNAME]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[ENTITYNAME]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@ent_name,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@ent_name,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[WORKORDERID]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[WORKORDERID]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@wo_id,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@wo_id,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[OPERATIONID]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[OPERATIONID]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@oper_id,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@oper_id,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[SEQUENCENUMBER]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[SEQUENCENUMBER]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @seq_no),@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @seq_no),@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[ITEMID]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[ITEMID]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@item_id,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@item_id,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[CHARACTERISTICNAME]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[CHARACTERISTICNAME]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@char_name,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@char_name,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[QMSPECNAME]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[QMSPECNAME]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@qm_spec_name,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@qm_spec_name,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[FREQUENCYNAME]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[FREQUENCYNAME]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@freq_name,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@freq_name,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[SAMPLEPLANNAME]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[SAMPLEPLANNAME]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@plan_name,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@plan_name,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[SEGMENTREQUIREMENTID]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[SEGMENTREQUIREMENTID]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@segment_requirement_id,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@segment_requirement_id,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	  SET @sample_param = '[SEGMENTRESPONSEID]'
	  SET @start_param=CHARINDEX (@sample_param, UPPER(@next_sample_name));
      IF @start_param > 0 BEGIN
         SET @end_param=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@start_param);
          -- Replace the parameter with what is in the sample_name parameters
         SET @sample_param=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@start_param,@end_param-@start_param+1);

		 IF  UPPER(@sample_param) = '[SEGMENTRESPONSEID]' BEGIN
			 SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@sample_param,COALESCE(@segment_response_id,@sample_param));
			 SET @sample_name_instance=REPLACE(@sample_name_instance,@sample_param,COALESCE(@segment_response_id,@sample_param));
		 END
	  END

	--Octothorpes section
	SET @has_oct=1;
	-- An octotorpe starts with [, has some # and closes with ]
	SET @oct_start=PATINDEX('%[[]#%]%',@next_sample_name);
	IF @oct_start=0 SET @has_oct=0;

	IF @has_oct=1 BEGIN
		--Find the char that closes the octothorpe
		SET @oct_end=CHARINDEX(']',@next_sample_name,@oct_start);

		-- Length of the octothorpe
		SET @oct_len=@oct_end-@oct_start+1;

		--The octotorpe
		SET @oct=SUBSTRING(@next_sample_name,@oct_start,@oct_len);

		--Validate the oct
		-- The oct must contain all #
		  IF '[' + REPLICATE('#', @oct_len-2) + ']' <> @oct
			SET @has_oct = 0
	END

	-- If octothorpe is valid, then create a search pattern to find out the next number.
	IF @has_oct=1 BEGIN
		--Remove the octothorpes from the sample name instance
		SET @start_param = PATINDEX('%[[]#%]%',@sample_name_instance)
		IF (@start_param > 0)
			SET @sample_name_instance = REPLACE(@sample_name_instance, @oct, '')

		IF @sample_name_instance IS NULL OR @sample_name_instance = '' SET @sample_name_instance = '-'

		IF (@prev_sample_name_template IS NULL OR @prev_sample_name_instance IS NULL OR @prev_sample_no IS NULL
			OR COALESCE(@prev_sample_name_template, '') <> @temp_sample_name
			OR COALESCE(@prev_sample_name_instance, '') <> @sample_name_instance) BEGIN

			--Retrieve the current maximum number from the last_sample_no table
			SELECT @max_sample_no = lsn.current_sample_no
			FROM last_sample_no lsn WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lsn.sample_name_template = @temp_sample_name
			  AND lsn.sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance

			--Retrieve the current maximum number from the sample_to_go table
			SELECT @max_sample_to_go_no = MAX(stg.current_sample_no)
			FROM sample_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE stg.sample_name_template = @temp_sample_name
			  AND stg.sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance
		END
		ELSE
			--The current sample name template and the current sample name instance is same as the
			--previous sample name template and instance, therefore, use the previous sample no to increment by 1.
			SET @max_sample_to_go_no = @prev_sample_no

           --Choose the greater number between sample and sample_to_go table
           IF COALESCE(@max_sample_to_go_no,0)>COALESCE(@max_sample_no,0)
             SET @max_sample_no=@max_sample_to_go_no

           -- Test for maximum number for the octothorpe
           -- If the number exceeds the max, use the max number
           IF @max_sample_no>=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLICATE('9',@oct_len-2))
             SET @next_sample_id=CONVERT(BIGINT,REPLICATE('9',@oct_len-2))
           ELSE
             SET @next_sample_id = COALESCE(@max_sample_no,0) + 1

           -- Pad with leading zeroes
           SET @next_sample_no=dbo.fn_PadNumber(@next_sample_id,@oct_len-2,'0');

           -- Replace the octothorpe with the next sample_no
           SET @next_sample_name=REPLACE(@next_sample_name,@oct,@next_sample_no);
	END
 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Folder]
  (@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) = NULL,
   @ent_id int = NULL,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) = NULL,
   @mod_id varchar(30) = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Folder
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/10/2002	Raghu		1.4	Disallow deletes if syst param is set for folder data (sys param = 196)
--09/26/2002	Raghu		1.4	All the input parameters except item_id is defaulted to NULL.. If the folder data needs to be deleted on item_id, the client apps used to call
--					deleteAll method in middleware which frames a dynamic sql for deletion. By using this, which prevents checking on disallow delete
--					parameters in system attribute table. Since now, the client apps calls sp_D_Folder, disallow delete validation can be performed in this sp
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
--03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
--09/01/2006	Raghu		3.1.22	HD# 8682, Preferred version should be always set for the first folder;
--						and when there are no folders
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
DECLARE @disallow_delete	INT32
	, @preferred_ver	LOGICAL
	, @folder_count		INT32

	SET @preferred_ver = 0

	SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 196

	IF (@disallow_delete = 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Deleting data from %1 is not allowed{3863},Folder', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether this folder is marked as a preferred version; If yes, then do no allow this folder to delete unless this is the only folder remain.
	SELECT TOP 1 @preferred_ver = preferred_ver FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_id = @item_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id = @ver_id
	  AND (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)

	--Verify whether this folder is marked as a preferred version
	IF (@preferred_ver = 1) BEGIN
		--Since this folder is marked as a preferred version, then verify there are no other folder exist
		SELECT @folder_count = COUNT(*) FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id

		--Other folder exists; do not allow this folder to delete unless this is the only folder that exist.
		--disallow the deletion of a folder where preferred_ver is true unless there is no more than one other folder for the given item, operation, and entity
		IF (@folder_count > 1) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Cannot delete a preferred version. Please select another version as preferred before deleting.{1868}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE IF (@folder_count = 1)
			--Since there is only one folder exist other than the selected folder, automatically set the other folder as the preferred version.
			UPDATE folder SET preferred_ver = 1
			WHERE item_id = @item_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id
	END

	DELETE folder
	WHERE (item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
	       (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
	       (ent_id = @ent_id  OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
	       (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)  AND
	       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
	--       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Bom_Item_Oper_Spec]
(
	@item_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ver_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@bom_pos			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@process_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL

,	@spec_ver_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@spec_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL

,	@grp_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					- 10/21/2002
-- Version						- 2.0.0.35
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 02/03/2003		Raghu			1.5.8	Added spec.grp_id in select clause
-- 12/02/2003		Rich Boyle				Appended the spare field from spec to the record set
-- 12/10/2003		Sheetal Jain	20035	Fixes similar to HD# 4241
-- 10/17/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 04/04/2006		Raghu	 		3.1.13	HD# 7577, Join syntax in certain SPs incompatible with
-- 07/02/2007		AML				3.2.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- 12/19/2017		Surya			6.0	    US:956690 As Peter I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	bom_item_oper_spec.item_id
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.bom_pos
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.process_id
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.oper_id
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.step_no
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.spec_ver_id
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.spec_value
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.assoc_file
		,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(bom_item_oper_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.comments
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.min_value
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.max_value
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.access_level
		,	item.item_desc
		,	process.process_desc
		,	spec.grp_id
        ,   spec.spec_desc
		,	spec.units
		,	spec.spare1
		,	spec.spare2
		,	spec.spare3
		,	spec.spare4
        ,	bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_comment
        ,	bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_by
		,	bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_at
        ,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, bom_item_oper_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
        ,	spec.data_type data_type
	FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = bom_item_oper_spec.item_id
		INNER JOIN process WITH (NOLOCK) ON process.process_id = bom_item_oper_spec.process_id
		INNER JOIN spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON spec.spec_id = bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id
	WHERE (
			(bom_item_oper_spec.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR @spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.spec_value = @spec_value OR @spec_value IS NULL) AND
			(spec.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_oper_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
END

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 10/17/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/16/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 01/12/2010       SLR             4.0.0   Added fields for enhanced calculations
--12/10/2012		Saiteja.K       4.6.0	Passed state_cd value to update Util_log for CR L00123864.
--12/21/2015		Tentu			5.2		Story 569840: To address CR L00139311 updated the @comments parameter type to STRING2000
-- 08/17/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 675688-As Lenka, I want the Raw Reason from UCO and New Reason from Operator to be logged
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
-- 07/07/2017		Raghu	6.1	UserStory: 716502 - As SE development, I want to address all the failures in the stateless API to make it compatible with the new schema
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @old_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@old_event_end_time_utc TDATETIME2
	,@old_duration		INT32
	,@old_reas_cd		INT32
	,@old_reas_pending	LOGICAL
	,@old_comments		STRING2000
	,@old_category1		STRING80
	,@old_category2		STRING80
	,@old_category3		STRING80
	,@old_category4		STRING80
	,@old_spare1		STRING80
	,@old_spare2		STRING80
	,@old_spare3		STRING80
	,@old_spare4		STRING80
	,@old_raw_reas_cd	STRING80

	,@new_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@new_state_cd		INT32
	,@new_runtime		LOGICAL
	,@new_downtime		LOGICAL
	,@new_setuptime		LOGICAL
	,@new_teardowntime	LOGICAL
	,@new_fixedtime		LOGICAL
	,@new_failure		LOGICAL
	,@new_vartime		LOGICAL
	,@new_category1		STRING80
	,@new_category2		STRING80
	,@new_category3		STRING80
	,@new_category4		STRING80
	,@last_edit_by		STRING40
	,@last_edit_at		TDATETIME
	,@next_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2

	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'UtilExec.SetChunkPendingReason'

	--Verify whether this entity captures utilization
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('A row does not exist in util_exec for this entity{3243}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the reason code exist in the database
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @final_reas_cd) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified final reason is not defined in the util_reas table{3246}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the event time of the log id
	SELECT @old_event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.log_id = @log_id

	--Verify whether the supplied event exist
	IF (@old_event_time_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The Source Row does not exist for the specified entity and event_time{3251}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the details of the current event
	SELECT @old_event_end_time_utc = vuh.event_end_time_utc, @old_duration = vuh.duration, @old_reas_cd = vuh.reas_cd
		, @old_reas_pending = vuh.reas_pending, @old_comments = vuh.comments, @old_raw_reas_cd = vuh.raw_reas_cd
		, @old_spare1 = vuh.spare1, @old_spare2 = vuh.spare2, @old_spare3 = vuh.spare3, @old_spare4 = vuh.spare4
		, @old_category1 = vuh.category1, @old_category2 = vuh.category2, @old_category3 = vuh.category3, @old_category4 = vuh.category4
	FROM vw_util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE vuh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND vuh.event_time_utc = @old_event_time_utc

	--Verify whether the duration is entirely within the event
	IF (@new_duration > @old_duration) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The new_duration should be less than the duration of the source row{3265}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the reason details
	SELECT @new_state_cd = state_cd, @new_runtime = runtime, @new_downtime = downtime, @new_setuptime = setuptime
		, @new_teardowntime = teardowntime, @new_fixedtime = fixedtime, @new_vartime = vartime, @new_failure = failure
		, @new_category1 = category1, @new_category2 = category2, @new_category3 = category3, @new_category4 = category4
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @final_reas_cd

	--Update the util_history event
	UPDATE util_history
	SET state_cd = @new_state_cd, reas_cd = @final_reas_cd, reas_pending = 0, runtime = @new_runtime, downtime = @new_downtime
		, setuptime = @new_setuptime, teardowntime = @new_teardowntime, fixedtime = @new_fixedtime, vartime = @new_vartime, failure = @new_failure
		, comments = COALESCE(@comments, comments), category1 = @new_category1, category2 = @new_category2, category3 = @new_category3, category4 = @new_category4
		, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	AND event_time_utc = @old_event_time_utc

	--Do not attempt to create a new utilization record:
	--if the new duration is 0, meaning, the attempt is to update the existing event with a different reason code
	--if the new duration is the same as the existing duration, then the attempt is to update the existing event with a different reason code
	IF NOT (COALESCE(@new_duration, 0) <= 0 OR (@new_duration = @old_duration)) BEGIN
		--Determine the new event time
		SET @new_event_time_utc = DATEADD(SS, @new_duration, @old_event_time_utc)

		--Get the reason details for the previous reason
		SELECT @new_state_cd = state_cd, @new_runtime = runtime, @new_downtime = downtime, @new_setuptime = setuptime
			, @new_teardowntime = teardowntime, @new_fixedtime = fixedtime, @new_vartime = vartime, @new_failure = failure
			, @new_category1 = category1, @new_category2 = category2, @new_category3 = category3, @new_category4 = category4
		FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE reas_cd = @old_reas_cd

		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
		SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

		--Insert a new utilization event for the second half
		INSERT INTO util_history (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_time_local, state_cd, reas_cd, reas_pending
			, runtime, downtime, setuptime, teardowntime, fixedtime, vartime, failure, comments, raw_reas_cd
			, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, category1, category2, category3, category4
			, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (@ent_id, @new_event_time_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_time_utc)
			, @new_state_cd, @old_reas_cd, @old_reas_pending
			, @new_runtime, @new_downtime, @new_setuptime, @new_teardowntime, @new_fixedtime, @new_vartime, @new_failure
			, COALESCE(@comments, @old_comments), @old_raw_reas_cd
			, @old_spare1, @old_spare2, @old_spare3, @old_spare4, @old_category1, @old_category2, @old_category3, @old_category4
			, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
	END

	--Default the new event time to the old event time if the update is on a single record
	SET @new_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@new_event_time_utc, @old_event_time_utc)

	--Get the preceding event
	SELECT @old_event_time_utc = MAX(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc < @old_event_time_utc

	--Get the next event
	SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc > @new_event_time_utc

	--Default to the current event if there is no following event
	SET @next_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@next_event_time_utc, @new_event_time_utc)

	--Merge events if they need to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id = @ent_id
		, @event_time_utc_start_range = @old_event_time_utc, @event_time_utc_end_range = @next_event_time_utc
		, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, @records_affected = NULL

END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ProcessSegment]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT oper_id AS ProcessSegmentId FROM
(SELECT DISTINCT oper_id FROM [dbo].[oper]
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT oper_id FROM [dbo].[job_event]
WHERE oper_id IS NOT NULL)
AS Source

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Wo_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@wo_id		STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Wo_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for a wo (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific wo)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 12/15/2004
-- Version                  - 2.1.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--06/27/2005	Raghu		2.1.23	Added restriction to filter attributes that does not have valid certifications
--10/31/2005	Raghu		2.1.31/3.1.0	HD# 6624, Sort attributes by attr_desc.
--11/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Entry_type column is included.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 6 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM wo_attr WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 6 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM wo_attr WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_InterlockManagement]
	@su_source      NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
  , @su_destination NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
  , @su_ent_id      INT          = NULL
  , @inerted_by     NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
  , @sourceString   NVARCHAR(MAX)
  , @destString NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS

BEGIN
	DECLARE @source            NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @destination       NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @source_count      INT
		  , @destination_count INT

		-----AUDIT TRAIL DECLARE--

		declare
			 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleNameSource nvarchar(80) = 'MRM_SU_Interlock_SRC'
			,@strModuleNameDestination nvarchar(80) = 'MRM_SU_Interlock_DES'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@delete_detail nvarchar(50)=NULL
		
			--,@saveFlag int=1			-- it will pass from UI
			
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField6             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
		

declare
 @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) 
			,@column_name NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
			,@log_id INT
			,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
			,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			,@user_id	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@user_name	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@change_type INT = 2
			,@table_name NVARCHAR(80)              = '[dbo].[ofi_su_mes_states_mapping]'
			,@row_id INT
			,@audit_category        NVARCHAR(80)              = 'Info'
			, @oldSource NVARCHAR(MAX)
		, @oldDestination NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@su_status_insert_desc NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
		,@su_status_insert_desc_dest NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
		,@flagSource nvarchar(50)
		,@flagDest nvarchar(50)



			--------get old source and old dest----------------------------------
		select @oldSource=STRING_AGG(su_status_desc,',')
						FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
						LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss ON sm.su_status_cd = ss.su_status_cd
						WHERE
							sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
							AND interlock_type = 'Source' and sm.is_Active=1

		select @oldDestination=STRING_AGG(su_status_desc,',')
						FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
						LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss ON sm.su_status_cd = ss.su_status_cd
						WHERE
							sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
							AND interlock_type = 'Destination' and sm.is_Active=1


	SET @source = REPLACE(@su_source, ';#', ',');
	SET @destination = REPLACE(@su_destination, ';#', ',');


	DECLARE @sourcetable TABLE
	(
		row_id     INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
	  , source_val INT
	)
	DECLARE @destinationtable TABLE
	(
		row_id          INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
	  , destination_val INT
	)

	INSERT INTO @sourcetable
	SELECT
		value
	FROM STRING_SPLIT(@source, ',');

	INSERT INTO @destinationtable
	SELECT
		value
	FROM STRING_SPLIT(@destination, ',');
	
	IF( (SELECT
			 COUNT(source_val)
		 FROM @sourcetable) >= 0)
	BEGIN
		--Remove previous data 
		--DELETE ofi_su_mes_states_mapping
		--FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm
		--LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss ON sm.su_status_cd = ss.su_status_cd
		--WHERE
		--	sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
		--	AND interlock_type = 'Source'


		--Update the row isACtive to 0 since these values are unchecked

		
		 

		----AUDIT TRAIL for UPDATE-----


	

		if exists(select 1 FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
		LEFT JOIN @sourcetable sct ON sm.su_status_cd = sct.source_val
		WHERE sct.source_val IS NULL AND sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id AND interlock_type = 'Source')

		BEGIN


			
					--get old source
					

						select top 1 @row_id=row_id  FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
						LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss with (nolock) ON sm.su_status_cd = ss.su_status_cd
						WHERE
							sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
							AND interlock_type = 'Source' and sm.is_Active=1

						if @row_id is NULL
						BEGIN
							select top 1 @row_id=row_id  FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
							LEFT JOIN ofi_su_states ss with (nolock) ON sm.su_status_cd = ss.su_status_cd
							WHERE
							sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
							AND interlock_type = 'Source' and sm.is_Active=0
						END

						
							select @keyfield1=ent_name from ent with(nolock) where ent_id=@su_ent_id

		
						

					--audit trail
							SET @column_name  = 'su_status_cd'
							SET  @audit_comments = @strModuleNameSource + '$' + @strFunctionName
							EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @inerted_by, 2, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, @oldSource,@sourceString , @audit_comments, @delete_detail;
															 
				 															  

								UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
								SET
									 origin = @strFunctionName
									 ,user_id=@inerted_by
								WHERE
									log_id = @log_id;
							
							
							select @strCommentMsg= 'Source Changes:Updated From [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_InterlockManagement] [su_status_cd] field change. Old value: '+
							CASE 
                            WHEN @oldSource IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
                            ELSE @oldSource
							END+' -> New value: '+
							CASE 
                            WHEN @sourceString IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
                            ELSE  @sourceString
							END+''
							 set @strActivityMsg='UPDATED'
			
							set @flagSource='Update'
							INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
								(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
								VALUES
								(
									   @log_id, @keyField1, 'Source', @keyField3, @keyField4, @strModuleNameSource, @strFunctionName, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @keyField5, @keyField6, @audit_category, @strActivityMsg, @strCommentMsg
									 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE()), @logged_at, @inerted_by
								);



			END

		
		UPDATE sm
		SET is_Active = 0
		,last_edit_by=@inerted_by
		FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
		LEFT JOIN @sourcetable sct ON sm.su_status_cd = sct.source_val
		WHERE sct.source_val IS NULL AND sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id AND interlock_type = 'Source' 



	



	



		DECLARE @sourcecounter INT

		SET @sourcecounter = 1

		WHILE(@sourcecounter <= (SELECT
									 COUNT(source_val)
								 FROM @sourcetable) )
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @sel_sourceval INT

			SELECT
				@sel_sourceval = source_val
			FROM @sourcetable
			WHERE row_id = @sourcecounter

			--INSERT INTO ofi_su_mes_states_mapping
			--(
			--	su_ent_id
			--  , su_status_cd
			--  , last_edit_at_utc
			--  , last_edit_at_local
			--  , su_status_value
			--  , interlock_type
			--  , last_edit_by
			--)
			--VALUES
			--(
			--	   @su_ent_id
			--	 , @sel_sourceval
			--	 , GETDATE()
			--	 , GETDATE()
			--	 , 1
			--	 , 'Source'
			--	 , @inerted_by
			--)

			--Added logic change if exist then update isActive to 1 or else insert new record

				
						if exists(
						SELECT 1 FROM @sourcetable st
						INNER JOIN ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock) ON REPLACE(sm.su_status_cd, ' ', '') = st.source_val
						WHERE
									sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
									AND interlock_type = 'Source' and  st.row_id = @sourcecounter)
									BEGIN 
			
			

									update ofi_su_mes_states_mapping 
									set is_Active=1 
									,last_edit_by =@inerted_by
									where su_ent_id = @su_ent_id
								AND interlock_type = 'Source'
								AND su_status_cd=@sel_sourceval

		
			
						END
						else BEGIN 
			
						





						--get new source
						--if not exists( select 1  FROM ofi_su_mes_states_mapping sm with (nolock)
						--	WHERE
						--	sm.su_ent_id = @su_ent_id AND interlock_type = 'Source')
						--	BEGIN

						--			select @row_id=max(row_id)+1 from  ofi_su_mes_states_mapping

												
						--			select @keyfield1=ent_name from ent where ent_id=@su_ent_id

						--			select @su_status_insert_desc=su_status_desc from ofi_su_states where su_status_cd=@sel_sourceval


						--		--audit trail
						--				SET @column_name  = '[su_status_cd]'
						--				EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @inerted_by, @change_type, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, NULL,@su_status_insert_desc , @audit_comments, @delete_detail;
															 
				 															  

						--					UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
						--					SET
						--						 origin = @strFunctionName			
						--					WHERE
						--						log_id = @log_id;
							
							
						--				select @strCommentMsg= 'Source Changes:Inserted into [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_InterlockManagement] [su_status_cd] field change. New value: '+
						--				CASE 
						--				WHEN @su_status_insert_desc IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
						--				ELSE  @su_status_insert_desc
						--				END+''
						--				 set @strActivityMsg='INSERTED'
			

						--				INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
						--					(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
