CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtDataByFilt]
(
      @char_id                 INT32
   ,  @ent_id                  INT32 = NULL
   ,  @item                    STRING40_NULL = NULL
   ,  @item_category_id        INT32 = NULL
   ,  @wo_id                   STRING40_NULL = NULL
   ,  @oper_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
   ,  @process_id              STRING40_NULL = NULL
   ,  @segment_requirement_id  STRING80_NULL = NULL
   ,  @segment_response_id     STRING80_NULL = NULL
   ,  @spare1                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
   ,  @spare2                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
   ,  @spare3                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
   ,  @spare4                  STRING80_NULL = NULL
   ,  @start_time              DATETIME = NULL
   ,  @start_time_tz           INT32_NULL = NULL
   ,  @end_time                DATETIME = NULL
   ,  @end_time_tz             INT32_NULL = NULL
   ,  @num_points              INT32_NULL = NULL
   ,  @chart_type              INT32
   ,  @last_created_at_utc     DATETIME = NULL
   ,  @x_axis_label			   INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -  sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtDataByFilt
-- Description          -  Get the measurements for each sample that matches the filter and the characteristic.  Also gets the
--                   centerline, lower control limits, and the upper control limits for each point based on the
--                   chart type.  The center line, and control limit values come from either the qm_spec_char_link record
--                   with the qm_spec_id coming from the sample_char_link table or from the characteristic table.
-- Author          - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created          -    03/22/2011
-- Version          - 4.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version	Changes
-- 04/04/2013		Ibrahim			4.6		Added cause_id to the return select query
-- 05/22/2013		Arun			4.6		Added cause_desc to the return select query
-- 07/29/2013		Arun			4.6     Added ignore_sample and control_move to the return select query
-- 08/02/2013		Arun			4.6		Commented the sample_char_link.ignore_sample from the where clause
-- 12/02/2014		Ibrahim			5.0		Story#241203. Returns the x_axis label field value as part of the query
--                                              based on the x-axis label input.
--09/02/2014		RaghuG			5.0		UserStory: 377565 - L00132537: Cannot plot SPC chart when Sample Plan has both calendar and production count frequencies defined
--02/03/2016		RWB				5.0.2	UserStory: 592938 - For CR L00139945, fixed the query for getting the ignored sample into the #RawResults temporary table to eliminate
--											a violation of the primary key error.
-- 09/01/2016		RWB				5.0.3	UserStory 696603 - Added code to multiply the fixed limits for p and u charts by 100 so they appear properly on the chart.
-- 02/04/2020       Jim O'Hearn     6.2.0   Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

   SET NOCOUNT ON

   DECLARE @start_time_utc    DATETIME,
         @end_time_utc     DATETIME,
         @temp_tz       int
         ,@dbgmsg	nvarchar(100)

   SET @start_time_tz    = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
   SET @temp_tz = -@start_time_tz
   EXEC SP_S_GetUtcDate @start_time, @temp_tz, @start_time_utc OUTPUT
   SET @end_time_tz   = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)
   SET @temp_tz = -@end_time_tz
   EXEC SP_S_GetUtcDate @end_time, @temp_tz, @end_time_utc OUTPUT

	CREATE TABLE #RawResults (sample_id int, requested_time_utc datetime, requested_time_local datetime, char_id int, cause_id int, ignore_sample bit, control_move bit,
	             standard_dev float, mean float, [range] float, act_sample_size int, [target] float, value_no int, result_value float,
	             sample_char_link_row_id int, qm_spec_id int, sample_note nvarchar(max), default_chart_id int, created_at_utc datetime, x_axis_label nvarchar(80), rnum int, indx int,
		CONSTRAINT [PK_dbug] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED
		(
			char_id ASC, requested_time_utc DESC, sample_id DESC, value_no DESC
		)WITH (PAD_INDEX  = OFF, STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE  = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS  = ON, ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS  = ON, FILLFACTOR = 90))

 	DECLARE @SampleControlLimits TABLE
	(
		sample_id INT,
		sample_time DATETIME,
		char_id INT,
		Primary_target float,
		Primary_lcl float,
		Primary_ucl float,
		Secondary_target float,
		Secondary_lcl float,
		Secondary_ucl float,
		indx INT,
		points_per_page INT,
		-- Added following field to allow control limits for Xbar charts to be adjusted
		-- once final values for x_bar and est_std_dev are known KRF 5/20/12
		-- This could be gotten from #RawResults but adding it here saves joining
		-- to that table, which may be bigger
		act_sample_size INT
	)

	-- Only fill the #RawResults table if the last_created_at_utc is null or there exists a sample that matches the filter
	-- and has a result that was created after the supplied last_created_at_utc value.  If either are true, get all the
	-- samples that are not ignored (we will fetch the ignored samples later) and results that match the filter.
	if (@last_created_at_utc is NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
		  INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id = sample.sample_id
		  INNER JOIN result WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = sample.sample_id AND result.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
		  INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.char_id = characteristic.char_id AND qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = sample_char_link.qm_spec_id
		  WHERE sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND result.char_id = @char_id AND
			 COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.minimum_sample_size, characteristic.minimum_sample_size) <= sample_char_link.act_sample_size AND
			 -- sample_char_link.ignore_sample = 0 AND
			 result.superseded = 0 AND
			 (sample.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.item_id = @item OR @item IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.item_id IN (select item_id from item_category_link where category_id = @item_category_id) OR @item_category_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.requested_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.requested_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL) AND
			 ((@last_created_at_utc IS NULL) OR (result.created_at_utc > @last_created_at_utc))))
	BEGIN
		-- Filled the #RawResults table with the results from the samples that match the supplied filters
		-- If the num_points filter is supplied, then we need to get to limit the number of samples returned
		IF (@num_points IS NULL)
		BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #RawResults (sample_id , requested_time_utc, requested_time_local, char_id, cause_id, ignore_sample, control_move,
					 standard_dev, mean, [range], act_sample_size, [target], value_no, result_value,
					 sample_char_link_row_id, qm_spec_id, sample_note, default_chart_id, created_at_utc, x_axis_label, rnum, indx)
		  SELECT sample.sample_id,
			 sample.requested_time_utc,
			 sample.requested_time_local,
			 sample_char_link.char_id,
			 sample_char_link.cause_id,
			 sample_char_link.ignore_sample,
			 sample_char_link.control_move,
			 sample_char_link.standard_dev,
			 sample_char_link.mean,
			 sample_char_link.[range],
			 sample_char_link.act_sample_size,
			 qm_spec_char_link.[target],
			 result.value_no,
			 result.result_value,
			 sample_char_link.row_id,
			 sample_char_link.qm_spec_id,
			 sample_char_link.note,
			 @chart_type,
			 result.created_at_utc,
			 CASE @x_axis_label
			 WHEN 0 THEN NULL
			 WHEN 4 THEN sample.sample_name
			 WHEN 5 THEN ent.ent_name
			 WHEN 6 THEN item.item_desc
			 WHEN 7 THEN sample.wo_id
			 WHEN 8 THEN sample.oper_id
			 WHEN 9 THEN sample_freq.freq_name
			 WHEN 10 THEN sample_plan.plan_name
			 WHEN 11 THEN sample.segment_requirement_id
			 WHEN 12 THEN sample.segment_response_id
			 WHEN 13 THEN sample.lot_no
			 WHEN 14 THEN sample.sublot_no
			 WHEN 15 THEN sample.pulled_by
			 WHEN 16 THEN CAST(sample.pulled_time_local AS NVARCHAR(80))
			 WHEN 17 THEN sample.verified_by
			 WHEN 18 THEN sample.spare1
			 WHEN 19 THEN sample.spare2
			 WHEN 20 THEN sample.spare3
			 WHEN 21 THEN sample.spare4
			 WHEN 22 THEN qm_spec.qm_spec_name
			 WHEN 23 THEN sample_char_link.equipment
			 ELSE NULL
			 END AS x_axis_label,
			 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY characteristic.char_id ORDER BY sample.requested_time_utc DESC, sample.sample_id desc, value_no desc),
			 NULL
		  FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
		  		  INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		  		  INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id = sample.sample_id
		  		  INNER JOIN result WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = sample_char_link.sample_id AND result.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
		  		  INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
		  		  LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.char_id = characteristic.char_id AND qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = sample_char_link.qm_spec_id
		  		  LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.item_id = item.item_id
		  		  LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = qm_spec.qm_spec_id
		  		  LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.plan_id = sample_plan.plan_id
				  LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.freq_id = sample_freq.freq_id
		  WHERE sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND result.char_id = @char_id AND
			 COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.minimum_sample_size, characteristic.minimum_sample_size) <= (SELECT scl.act_sample_size FROM sample_char_link scl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE scl.sample_id = sample.sample_id AND scl.char_id = @char_id) AND
			 sample_char_link.ignore_sample = 0 AND
			 result.superseded = 0 AND
			 (sample.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.item_id = @item OR @item IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.item_id IN (select item_id from item_category_link where category_id = @item_category_id) OR @item_category_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.requested_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
			 (sample.requested_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL)
		  ORDER BY sample.requested_time_utc desc, sample.sample_id desc, result.value_no desc
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		  INSERT INTO #RawResults (sample_id , requested_time_utc, requested_time_local, char_id, cause_id, ignore_sample, control_move,
					 standard_dev, mean, [range], act_sample_size, [target], value_no, result_value,
					 sample_char_link_row_id, qm_spec_id, sample_note, default_chart_id, created_at_utc, x_axis_label, rnum, indx)
		  SELECT x.sample_id,
			 x.requested_time_utc,
			 x.requested_time_local,
			 x.char_id,
			 x.cause_id,
			 x.ignore_sample,
			 x.control_move,
			 x.standard_dev,
			 x.mean,
			 x.[range],
			 x.act_sample_size,
			 x.[target],
			 result.value_no,
			 result.result_value,
			 x.row_id,
			 x.qm_spec_id,
			 x.note,
			 @chart_type,
			 result.created_at_utc,
			 x.x_axis_label,
			 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY characteristic.char_id ORDER BY x.requested_time_utc DESC, x.sample_id desc, value_no desc),
			 NULL
		  FROM (SELECT TOP(@num_points)
				sample.sample_id,
				sample_char_link.char_id,
				sample_char_link.qm_spec_id,
				sample_char_link.cause_id,
				sample_char_link.ignore_sample,
				sample_char_link.control_move,
				sample.requested_time_local,
				sample.requested_time_utc,
				sample_char_link.note,
				sample_char_link.standard_dev,
				sample_char_link.mean,
				sample_char_link.[range],
				sample_char_link.act_sample_size,
				sample_char_link.row_id,
				qm_spec_char_link.[target],
				CASE @x_axis_label
				 WHEN 0 THEN NULL
				 WHEN 4 THEN sample.sample_name
				 WHEN 5 THEN ent.ent_name
				 WHEN 6 THEN item.item_desc
				 WHEN 7 THEN sample.wo_id
				 WHEN 8 THEN sample.oper_id
				 WHEN 9 THEN sample_freq.freq_name
				 WHEN 10 THEN sample_plan.plan_name
				 WHEN 11 THEN sample.segment_requirement_id
				 WHEN 12 THEN sample.segment_response_id
				 WHEN 13 THEN sample.lot_no
				 WHEN 14 THEN sample.sublot_no
				 WHEN 15 THEN sample.pulled_by
				 WHEN 16 THEN CAST(sample.pulled_time_local AS NVARCHAR(80))
				 WHEN 17 THEN sample.verified_by
				 WHEN 18 THEN sample.spare1
				 WHEN 19 THEN sample.spare2
				 WHEN 20 THEN sample.spare3
				 WHEN 21 THEN sample.spare4
				 WHEN 22 THEN qm_spec.qm_spec_name
				 WHEN 23 THEN sample_char_link.equipment
				 ELSE NULL
				END AS x_axis_label
			 FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
			 INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.ent_id = ent.ent_id
			 INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id = sample.sample_id
			 LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = sample_char_link.qm_spec_id
			 LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.item_id = item.item_id
		     LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.qm_spec_id = qm_spec.qm_spec_id
		     LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.plan_id = sample_plan.plan_id
             LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.freq_id = sample_freq.freq_id
			 WHERE sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND
			 COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.minimum_sample_size, (SELECT minimum_sample_size FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE char_id = @char_id)) <= (SELECT scl.act_sample_size FROM sample_char_link scl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE scl.sample_id = sample.sample_id AND scl.char_id = @char_id) AND
				sample_char_link.ignore_sample = 0 AND
				(sample.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.item_id = @item OR @item IS NULL) AND
				(sample.item_id IN (select item_id from item_category_link where category_id = @item_category_id) OR @item_category_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.requested_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
				(sample.requested_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL)
			 ORDER BY sample.requested_time_utc desc) x
		  INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = x.char_id
		  INNER JOIN result WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = x.sample_id
		  INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = sample_char_link.sample_id AND result.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
		  WHERE x.char_id = @char_id AND
				result.char_id = @char_id AND
				result.superseded = 0

		  ORDER BY x.requested_time_utc desc, x.sample_id desc, result.value_no desc
		END


		-- Use cursor to update @SampleControlLimits fields: target, lsl, usl, index
		DECLARE @sample_Id INT,
		@indx INT, -- @indx is the "point number" on the graph, from right to left
		@temp_char_id INT
		SET @indx = 1
		SET @temp_char_id = -1

		-- Replaced block above with block below in order to calculate control limits.
		-- KRF 5/20/12
		-- Move through #RawResults joined to @MostRecentSamplePerChar in descending
		-- order of value_no, temporal order, characteristic reading sample_id,
		-- char_id, standard_dev, mean, act_sample_size, default_chart, and fields
		-- from @MostRecentSamplePerChar.
		-- If a new characteristic is encountered and not the first characteristic,
		-- reset @indx
		-- If you have not yet gotten beyond num_pts_per_page and it's the last result
		-- for this sample (per default_chart), calculate control limits for this sample
		-- and add to @SampleControlLimits
		DECLARE @requested_time_utc DATETIME
			  , @value_no INT
			  , @result_value FLOAT
			  , @standard_dev FLOAT
			  , @mean FLOAT
			  , @range FLOAT
			  , @act_sample_size INT
			  --, @default_chart INT
			  , @cl_source INT
			  , @samples_for_cl INT
			  , @samples_before_cl INT
			  , @std_avg FLOAT
			  , @std_avg_is_target INT
			  , @std_deviation FLOAT
			  , @target FLOAT
			  , @lcl_xbar FLOAT
			  , @cl_xbar FLOAT
			  , @ucl_xbar FLOAT
			  , @lcl_range FLOAT
			  , @cl_range FLOAT
			  , @ucl_range FLOAT
			  , @lcl_sigma FLOAT
			  , @cl_sigma FLOAT
			  , @ucl_sigma FLOAT
			  , @lcl_ix FLOAT
			  , @cl_ix	FLOAT
			  , @ucl_ix FLOAT
			  , @lcl_imr FLOAT
			  , @cl_imr FLOAT
			  , @ucl_imr FLOAT
			  , @lcl_ma FLOAT
			  , @cl_ma FLOAT
			  , @ucl_ma FLOAT
			  , @lcl_mr FLOAT
			  , @cl_mr FLOAT
			  , @ucl_mr FLOAT
			  , @lcl_ms FLOAT
			  , @cl_ms FLOAT
			  , @ucl_ms FLOAT
			  , @lcl_p FLOAT
			  , @cl_p FLOAT
			  , @ucl_p FLOAT
			  , @lcl_np FLOAT
			  , @cl_np FLOAT
			  , @ucl_np FLOAT
			  , @lcl_u FLOAT
			  , @cl_u FLOAT
			  , @ucl_u FLOAT
			  , @lcl_c FLOAT
			  , @cl_c FLOAT
			  , @ucl_c FLOAT
			  , @num_defect_opp INT
			  , @mov_avg_span INT
			  , @sigma_est INT
			  , @rnum INT
			  , @d_2 FLOAT
			  , @d_3 FLOAT
			  , @d1 FLOAT
			  , @d2 FLOAT
			  , @c_4 FLOAT
			  , @b1 FLOAT
			  , @b2 FLOAT
			  , @b3 FLOAT
			  , @b4 FLOAT
			  , @est_std_dev FLOAT -- The estimate of the standard deviation
			  , @est_std_dev_sum FLOAT -- The sum of sample S. D./c_4 or sample range/d_2
			  , @x_bar FLOAT -- The best current estimate of the overall average
			  , @num_samp INT -- The number of samples so far for the current characteristic; checked against samples_for_cl
			  , @not_enough_samples INT -- 1 if already determined there are less than sample_for_cl qualifying samples, else 0
			  , @temp_sample_id INT -- The last sample ID that was read
			  , @sum_x FLOAT -- The sum of the result_values read so far
			  , @sum_x_squared FLOAT -- The sum of the squares of the result_values read so far
			  , @x_squared_diff FLOAT -- The value resulting from subtracting the square of X-bar sum divided by the number of samples from the sum of square of X-bar values
			  , @samp_used INT -- The number of samples actually used to calculate @est_std_dev (= @num_samp less samples of 1 when chart is x bar)
			  , @temp_default_chart INT -- The chart type of the last characteristic

		-- First get the information for the most recent sample
		SELECT TOP 1
		 --, @mrs_sample_interval = -1
		--  Added following 47 lines 5/17/12 KRF Needed for calculating control limits
		  @cl_source = COALESCE(qscl.cl_source,c.cl_source)
		, @samples_for_cl = COALESCE(qscl.samples_for_cl,c.samples_for_cl)
		, @samples_before_cl = COALESCE(qscl.samples_before_cl,c.samples_before_cl)
		, @std_avg = COALESCE(qscl.std_avg,c.std_avg)
		, @std_avg_is_target = COALESCE(qscl.std_avg_is_target,c.std_avg_is_target)
		, @std_deviation = COALESCE(qscl.std_deviation,c.std_deviation)
		, @target = qscl.target
		, @lcl_xbar = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_xbar, c.lcl_xbar)
		, @cl_xbar = COALESCE(qscl.cl_xbar, c.cl_xbar)
		, @ucl_xbar = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_xbar, c.ucl_xbar)
		, @lcl_range = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_range, c.lcl_range)
		, @cl_range = COALESCE(qscl.cl_range, c.cl_range)
		, @ucl_range = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_range, c.ucl_range)
		, @lcl_sigma = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_sigma, c.lcl_sigma)
		, @cl_sigma = COALESCE(qscl.cl_sigma, c.cl_sigma)
		, @ucl_sigma = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_sigma, c.ucl_sigma)
		, @lcl_ix = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_ix, c.lcl_ix)
		, @cl_ix = COALESCE(qscl.cl_ix, c.cl_ix)
		, @ucl_ix = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_ix, c.ucl_ix)
		, @lcl_imr = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_imr, c.lcl_imr)
		, @cl_imr = COALESCE(qscl.cl_imr, c.cl_imr)
		, @ucl_imr = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_imr, c.ucl_imr)
		, @lcl_ma = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_ma, c.lcl_ma)
		, @cl_ma = COALESCE(qscl.cl_ma, c.cl_ma)
		, @ucl_ma = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_ma, c.ucl_ma)
		, @lcl_mr = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_mr, c.lcl_mr)
		, @cl_mr = COALESCE(qscl.cl_mr, c.cl_mr)
		, @ucl_mr = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_mr, c.ucl_mr)
		, @lcl_ms = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_ms, c.lcl_ms)
		, @cl_ms = COALESCE(qscl.cl_ms, c.cl_ms)
		, @ucl_ms = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_ms, c.ucl_ms)
		, @lcl_p = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_p, c.lcl_p) * 100
		, @cl_p = COALESCE(qscl.cl_p, c.cl_p) * 100
		, @ucl_p = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_p, c.ucl_p) * 100
		, @lcl_np = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_np, c.lcl_np)
		, @cl_np = COALESCE(qscl.cl_np, c.cl_np)
		, @ucl_np = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_np, c.ucl_np)
		, @lcl_u = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_u, c.lcl_u)
		, @cl_u = COALESCE(qscl.cl_u, c.cl_u)
		, @ucl_u = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_u, c.ucl_u)
		, @lcl_c = COALESCE(qscl.lcl_c, c.lcl_c)
		, @cl_c = COALESCE(qscl.cl_c, c.cl_c)
		, @ucl_c = COALESCE(qscl.ucl_c, c.ucl_c)
		, @num_defect_opp = c.num_defect_opp
		, @mov_avg_span = CASE WHEN c.mov_avg_span > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #RawResults)
						  THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #RawResults)
						  ELSE COALESCE(c.mov_avg_span,2) -- Default to 2 if null
						  END
		, @sigma_est = c.sigma_est
		--, @scl_row_id = a.sample_char_link_row_id
		FROM #RawResults a
		INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl ON qscl.qm_spec_id = a.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = a.char_id
		INNER JOIN characteristic c ON c.char_id = a.char_id
		ORDER BY requested_time_local

		-- If we are calculating control limits, then get the value for system_attribure 436
		-- and check it against samples_for_cl.  If samples_for_cl is 0 or is greater than the
		-- system attribute, we use the value for the system attribute which is the number of
		-- samples to use for calculating statistics.
		IF @cl_source = 0 BEGIN
			DECLARE @samples_for_stats INT

			SELECT @samples_for_stats = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 436
			IF (@samples_for_stats IS NULL)
				SET @samples_for_stats = 200

			IF (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR @samples_for_cl > @samples_for_stats)
				SET @samples_for_cl = @samples_for_stats
		END

		--Test
		--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES ('E','About to declare curRR',NULL,NULL)

		DECLARE curRR CURSOR LOCAL
			FOR SELECT rr.sample_id, requested_time_utc, value_no, result_value,
			standard_dev, mean, range, act_sample_size, rnum
			FROM #RawResults rr
			ORDER BY rr.char_id, rr.requested_time_utc DESC, rr.sample_id DESC, rr.value_no DESC
			FOR UPDATE OF indx

		--Test
		--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES ('F','DECLAREd curRR',NULL,NULL)

		-- If we are calculating control limits, make a pass through the raw results that contain only samples
		-- that are not ignored to calculate the values that will be used to set the control limits.
		IF @cl_source = 0 BEGIN
			OPEN curRR

			--Test
			--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES ('G','OPENd curRR',NULL,NULL)

			FETCH curRR INTO @sample_Id, @requested_time_utc, @value_no,
				@result_value, @standard_dev, @mean, @range, @act_sample_size, @rnum
			WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0 BEGIN
			--Test
			--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES ('H','Starting loop',NULL,@rnum)

				IF @char_Id <> @temp_char_id BEGIN -- If a new characteristic
					SET @not_enough_samples = 0 -- Start by assuming there are enough
												-- samples to satisfy samples_before_cl
					SET @num_samp = 1 -- Only have to count samples when calculating
									  -- limits from data
					SET @samp_used = 0
					SET @sum_x = 0
					SET @sum_x_squared = 0
					SET @x_bar = 0
					SET @est_std_dev = 0
					SET @est_std_dev_sum = 0
					-- If xbar (and est_std_dev if variable) can be gotten right away
					-- for the new characteristic do it now
					IF @chart_type > 4 BEGIN -- each result is a sample, so we can
												-- count #RawResults records to know
												-- how many to include
						SELECT @num_samp = COUNT(*) FROM #RawResults
							WHERE char_id = @char_id
						IF @num_samp < @samples_before_cl SET @not_enough_samples = 1
						ELSE BEGIN -- There are enough samples
							-- Limit number of samples to samples_for_cl
							IF @num_samp > @samples_for_cl and @samples_for_cl > 0
								SET @num_samp = @samples_for_cl
							-- A variable using population S.D.
							IF @chart_type < 9 AND @sigma_est = 1
								SELECT @x_bar = AVG(result_value),
									   @est_std_dev = STDEV(result_value)
									FROM #RawResults
									WHERE char_id = @char_id
									AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
							-- IX + MR using sample S.D.
							IF @chart_type = 5 AND @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
								SELECT @x_bar = AVG(rr1.result_value),
									   @est_std_dev = CASE WHEN @num_samp = 1 THEN 0
													  ELSE SUM(ABS(rr1.result_value -
														   COALESCE(rr2.result_value,
															   rr1.result_value)))/
													  ((@num_samp - 1)* 1.128379168)
													  END
									FROM #RawResults rr1
									LEFT OUTER JOIN #RawResults rr2
										ON rr1.char_id = rr2.char_id
										AND rr1.rnum = rr2.rnum + 1
									WHERE rr1.char_id = @char_id
										AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
											 rr1.rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
							END
							-- MA + MR using sample S.D.
							IF @chart_type = 7 AND @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
								SELECT @x_bar = AVG(result_value)
									FROM #RawResults
									WHERE char_id = @char_id
										AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
											 rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
								SELECT @d_2 = d_2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
								SELECT @est_std_dev = SUM(mr)/
													  ((@num_samp-@mov_avg_span+1)*@d_2)
									FROM (
										SELECT MAX(rr2.result_value) -
											   MIN(rr2.result_value) AS mr
											FROM #RawResults rr1
											LEFT OUTER JOIN #RawResults rr2
												ON rr1.char_id = rr2.char_id
													AND rr2.rnum >= rr1.rnum
													AND rr2.rnum < rr1.rnum +
														@mov_avg_span
										WHERE rr1.char_id = @char_Id
											AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
												 rr1.rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
										GROUP BY rr1.rnum
										HAVING COUNT(rr2.rnum) = @mov_avg_span) ranges
							END
							-- MA + MS using sample S.D.
							IF @chart_type = 8 AND @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
								SELECT @x_bar = AVG(result_value)
									FROM #RawResults
									WHERE char_id = @char_id
										AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
											 rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
								SELECT @c_4 = c_4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
								SELECT @est_std_dev = SUM(ms)/
													  ((@num_samp-@mov_avg_span+1)*@c_4)
									FROM (
										SELECT STDEV(rr2.result_value) AS ms
											FROM #RawResults rr1
											LEFT OUTER JOIN #RawResults rr2
												ON rr1.char_id = rr2.char_id
													AND rr2.rnum >= rr1.rnum
													AND rr2.rnum < rr1.rnum +
														@mov_avg_span
										WHERE rr1.char_id = @char_Id
											AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
												rr1.rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
										GROUP BY rr1.rnum
										HAVING COUNT(rr2.rnum) = @mov_avg_span) sigmas
							END
						IF @chart_type >= 9 -- An attribute
							SELECT @x_bar = SUM(result_value)/SUM(act_sample_size)
								FROM #RawResults
								WHERE char_id = @char_id
									AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
						END -- "Else" (there are enough samples)
					END -- of "@chart_type > 4"
				END -- of "IF @char_Id <> @temp_char_id" (if a new characteristic)

				-- Only increment the number of samples if we are calculating control limits
				-- from the data and we are using a variable chart
				IF (@chart_type <= 4) BEGIN
					IF @sample_Id <> @temp_sample_id -- If a new sample
						SET @num_samp = @num_samp + 1
				END

				-- Calculate est_std_dev or population S.D. if calculating from data, and
				-- it's a variable, and each result is not its own sample, and either
				-- samples_for_cl is 0 or you have not yet reached samples_for_cl samples
				IF (@chart_type <= 4
					AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR @num_samp <= @samples_for_cl)) BEGIN
					-- Also need to calculate x_bar because it too depends on the right set
					-- of samples
					SET @sum_x = @result_value + @sum_x
					SET @x_bar = @sum_x / @rnum -- Current best estimate for x_bar
					IF @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
						-- Accumulate sample range or S. D. to enable calculation of
						-- est_std_dev one all applicable samples are read
						IF @chart_type = 2 AND @value_no = 1
							AND @act_sample_size > 1 BEGIN -- Xbar + R
							SELECT @d_2 = d_2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
							SET @samp_used = @samp_used + 1
							SET @est_std_dev_sum = @range/@d_2 + @est_std_dev_sum
						END
						IF @chart_type = 3 AND @value_no = 1
							AND @act_sample_size > 1 BEGIN -- Xbar + S
							SELECT @c_4 = c_4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
							SET @samp_used = @samp_used + 1
							SET @est_std_dev_sum = @standard_dev/@c_4 + @est_std_dev_sum
						END
						-- We have already gotten x_bar and est_std_dev for all other
						-- chart types so don't need cases for them here
					END -- of "IF @sigma_est = 0"
					-- Calculate est_std_dev from population S.D. using the right samples
					IF @sigma_est = 1 BEGIN
						SET @sum_x_squared = (@result_value*@result_value) + @sum_x_squared
						-- Calculate current best estimate for est_std_dev
						SET @x_squared_diff = @sum_x_squared - (@sum_x * @sum_x / @rnum)
						IF (@x_squared_diff < 0) SET @x_squared_diff = 0
						SET @est_std_dev = CASE @rnum
												WHEN 1 THEN 0 -- use 0 for 1st result in
															  -- case 1st sample has only
															  -- 1 result
												ELSE SQRT((1.0/(@rnum-1))*@x_squared_diff)
												END
					END -- of "IF @sigma_est = 1"
				END	-- of "IF (@chart_type <= 4
					--     AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR @num_samp <= @samples_for_cl))"

				-- Update info on last result, before next one fetched
				SELECT @temp_char_id = @char_Id
				SET @temp_sample_id = @sample_Id
				SET @temp_default_chart = @chart_type
				FETCH curRR INTO @sample_Id, @requested_time_utc, @value_no,
					@result_value, @standard_dev, @mean, @range, @act_sample_size, @rnum
			END -- of "WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0"
			CLOSE curRR
		END -- IF cl_source = 0

		-- Now put the ignored samples into the raw results before updating all the samples with their control limits
		INSERT INTO #RawResults (sample_id , requested_time_utc, requested_time_local, char_id, cause_id, ignore_sample, control_move,
				 standard_dev, mean, [range], act_sample_size, [target], value_no, result_value,
				 sample_char_link_row_id, qm_spec_id, sample_note, default_chart_id, created_at_utc, x_axis_label, rnum, indx)
		SELECT sample.sample_id,
		 sample.requested_time_utc,
		 sample.requested_time_local,
		 sample_char_link.char_id,
		 sample_char_link.cause_id,
		 sample_char_link.ignore_sample,
		 sample_char_link.control_move,
		 sample_char_link.standard_dev,
		 sample_char_link.mean,
		 sample_char_link.[range],
		 sample_char_link.act_sample_size,
		 qm_spec_char_link.[target],
		 result.value_no,
		 result.result_value,
		 sample_char_link.row_id,
		 sample_char_link.qm_spec_id,
		 sample_char_link.note,
		 @chart_type,
		 result.created_at_utc,
		 CASE @x_axis_label
		  WHEN 0 THEN NULL
		  WHEN 4 THEN sample.sample_name
		  WHEN 5 THEN ent.ent_name
		  WHEN 6 THEN item.item_desc
		  WHEN 7 THEN sample.wo_id
		  WHEN 8 THEN sample.oper_id
		  WHEN 9 THEN sample_freq.freq_name
		  WHEN 10 THEN sample_plan.plan_name
		  WHEN 11 THEN sample.segment_requirement_id
		  WHEN 12 THEN sample.segment_response_id
		  WHEN 13 THEN sample.lot_no
		  WHEN 14 THEN sample.sublot_no
		  WHEN 15 THEN sample.pulled_by
		  WHEN 16 THEN CAST(sample.pulled_time_local AS NVARCHAR(80))
		  WHEN 17 THEN sample.verified_by
		  WHEN 18 THEN sample.spare1
		  WHEN 19 THEN sample.spare2
		  WHEN 20 THEN sample.spare3
		  WHEN 21 THEN sample.spare4
		  WHEN 22 THEN qm_spec.qm_spec_name
		  WHEN 23 THEN sample_char_link.equipment
		  ELSE NULL
		 END AS x_axis_label,
		 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY characteristic.char_id ORDER BY sample.requested_time_utc DESC, sample.sample_id desc, value_no desc),
		 NULL
		FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id = sample.sample_id
		INNER JOIN result WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = sample.sample_id
		INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.char_id = characteristic.char_id AND qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = sample_char_link.qm_spec_id
	    LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.item_id = item.item_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.qm_spec_id = qm_spec.qm_spec_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.plan_id = sample_plan.plan_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.freq_id = sample_freq.freq_id
		WHERE sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND result.char_id = @char_id AND
		 COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.minimum_sample_size, characteristic.minimum_sample_size) <= (SELECT scl.act_sample_size FROM sample_char_link scl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE scl.sample_id = sample.sample_id AND scl.char_id = @char_id) AND
		 sample_char_link.ignore_sample = 1 AND
		 result.superseded = 0 AND
		 (sample.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.item_id = @item OR @item IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.item_id IN (select item_id from item_category_link where category_id = @item_category_id) OR @item_category_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.requested_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
		 (sample.requested_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL)
		ORDER BY sample.requested_time_utc desc, sample.sample_id desc, result.value_no desc

		-- Open the cursor again and loop through all the points calculating their control limits
		OPEN curRR

		--Test
		--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES ('G','OPENd curRR',NULL,NULL)

		-- Loop through all the raw results and update the samples with their control limits.
		FETCH curRR INTO @sample_Id, @requested_time_utc, @value_no,
			@result_value, @standard_dev, @mean, @range, @act_sample_size, @rnum
		WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0 BEGIN

			-- If you have not yet gotten beyond num_pts_per_page and it's the last
			-- result for this sample (per default_chart), calculate control limits
			-- for this sample and add it to @SampleControlLimits
			IF @indx <= @num_points OR @num_points IS NULL BEGIN
				UPDATE #RawResults SET indx = @indx WHERE CURRENT OF curRR
				IF ((@chart_type > 4 AND @chart_type < 9) OR @value_no = 1) BEGIN -- New sample
		--		IF ((@chart_type > 4 AND @chart_type < 9) OR @value_no = 1) BEGIN
		--			IF @indx <= @num_points OR @num_points IS NULL BEGIN
		--				UPDATE #RawResults SET indx = @indx WHERE CURRENT OF curRR
					IF @cl_source = 0 BEGIN -- Calculate from data
						IF @chart_type = 2 OR @chart_type = 3 -- Xbar + R or S
							-- No need to figure out targets or limits now, they will
							-- be set later once final values for x_bar and est_std_dev
							-- are known; for now just record act_sample_size
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								NULL, NULL,	NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
								@indx, @num_points, @act_sample_size)
						IF @chart_type = 5 -- IX + MR
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*1.128379168 ELSE NULL END,
								NULL, -- No LCL for the MR part of an IX + MR chart
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*3.6858865724 ELSE NULL END,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 7 BEGIN -- MA + MR
							SELECT @d_2 = d_2, @d1 = d1, @d2 = d2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@d_2 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@d1 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@d2 ELSE NULL END,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						END -- of "IF @chart_type = 7"
						IF @chart_type = 8 BEGIN -- MA + MS
							SELECT @c_4 = c_4, @b3 = b3, @b4 = b4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar-@est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar+@est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@c_4 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@c_4*@b3 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@c_4*@b4 ELSE NULL END,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						END -- of "IF @chart_type = 8"
						IF @chart_type = 16 -- p
							-- To make the control limits show up correctly on the
							-- chart, we need to multiply the values by 100 to
							-- convert the limits to percentages.
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar * 100 ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN
										CASE WHEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/
												@act_sample_size) > 0
											THEN (@x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/
												@act_sample_size)) * 100
											ELSE 0
										END
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN (@x_bar+3*
												SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/@act_sample_size)) * 100
									ELSE NULL END,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 17 -- np
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN
										CASE WHEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)-(3*SQRT(
												@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size)) > 0
											THEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)-(3*SQRT(
												@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size))
											ELSE 0
										END
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)+(3*
												SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size))
									ELSE NULL END,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 18 -- u
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN
										CASE WHEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
												  > 0
											THEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
											ELSE 0
										END
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar+3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
									ELSE NULL END,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 19 -- c
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN
										CASE WHEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)-(3*SQRT(
												  @x_bar*@act_sample_size)) > 0
											THEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)-(3*SQRT(
												 @x_bar*@act_sample_size))
											ELSE 0
										END
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)+
										(3*SQRT(@x_bar*@act_sample_size))
									ELSE NULL END,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 20 -- DPMO
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar * 1000000/@num_defect_opp
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN
										CASE WHEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
												> 0
											THEN (@x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size))
												*1000000/@num_defect_opp
											ELSE 0
										END
									ELSE NULL END,
								CASE @not_enough_samples
									WHEN 0 THEN (@x_bar+3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size))
												*1000000/@num_defect_opp
									ELSE NULL END,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
					END -- of "IF @cl_source = 0"
					IF @cl_source = 1 BEGIN -- Compute from standard values
						IF @std_avg_is_target = 1 SET @std_avg = @target
						IF @chart_type = 2 BEGIN-- Xbar + R
							IF @act_sample_size = 1
								INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
									@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
									@std_avg,
									@std_avg - @std_deviation*3,
									@std_avg + @std_deviation*3,
									NULL,
									NULL,
									NULL,
									@indx, @num_points, NULL)
							ELSE BEGIN
								SELECT @d_2 = d_2, @d1 = d1, @d2 = d2
									FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
								INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
									@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
									@std_avg,
									@std_avg - @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
									@std_avg + @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
									@std_deviation*@d_2,
									@std_deviation*@d1,
									@std_deviation*@d2,
									@indx, @num_points, NULL)
							END
						END
						IF @chart_type = 3 BEGIN-- Xbar + S
							IF @act_sample_size = 1
								INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
									@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
									@std_avg,
									@std_avg - @std_deviation*3,
									@std_avg + @std_deviation*3,
									NULL,
									NULL,
									NULL,
									@indx, @num_points, NULL)
							ELSE BEGIN
								SELECT @c_4 = c_4, @b1 = b1, @b2 = b2
									FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size

								INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
									@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
									@std_avg,
									@std_avg - @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
									@std_avg + @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
									@std_deviation*@c_4,
									@std_deviation*@b1*SQRT(CONVERT(FLOAT, @act_sample_size)/
															(@act_sample_size-1)),
									@std_deviation*@b2*SQRT(CONVERT(FLOAT, @act_sample_size)/
															(@act_sample_size-1)),
									@indx, @num_points, NULL)
							END
						END
						IF @chart_type = 5 -- IX + MR
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								 @requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								 @std_avg,
								 @std_avg - @std_deviation*3,
								 @std_avg + @std_deviation*3,
								 @std_deviation*1.128379168,
								 NULL,
								 @std_deviation*3.6858865724,
								 @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 7 BEGIN -- MA + MR
							SELECT @d_2 = d_2, @d1 = d1, @d2 = d2
								FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								@std_avg - @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
								@std_avg + @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
								@std_deviation*@d_2,
								@std_deviation*@d1,
								@std_deviation*@d2,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						END
						IF @chart_type = 8 BEGIN -- MA + MS
							SELECT @c_4 = c_4, @b1 = b1, @b2 = b2
								FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								@std_avg-@std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
								@std_avg+@std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
								@std_deviation*@c_4,
								@std_deviation*@b1*SQRT(CONVERT(FLOAT, @mov_avg_span)/(@mov_avg_span-1)),
								@std_deviation*@b2*SQRT(CONVERT(FLOAT, @mov_avg_span)/(@mov_avg_span-1)),
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						END
						IF @chart_type = 16 -- p
							-- 12/17/2013 - RWB - CR L00128691 - Multiply the values by 100.
							-- The code was returning the CL, LCL, and UCL between 0 and 1, but
							-- the SPC Chart expects the value to be a percentage.
							-- To make the control limits show up correctly on the
							-- chart, we need to multiply the values by 100 to
							-- convert the limits to percentages.
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg * 100,
								CASE WHEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)/
										  @act_sample_size) > 0
									THEN (@std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)/
										 @act_sample_size)) * 100
									ELSE 0
								END,
								(@std_avg+3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)/@act_sample_size)) * 100,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
							-- End Changes for CR L00128691
						IF @chart_type = 17 -- np
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg*@act_sample_size,
								CASE WHEN @std_avg*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)*
										  @act_sample_size) > 0
									THEN @std_avg*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)*
										 @act_sample_size)
									ELSE 0
								END,
								@std_avg*@act_sample_size+3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)*@act_sample_size),
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 18 -- u
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								CASE WHEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size) > 0
									THEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size)
									ELSE 0
								END,
								@std_avg+3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size),
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 19 -- c
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg*@act_sample_size,
								CASE WHEN @std_avg*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(@std_avg*@act_sample_size) > 0
									THEN @std_avg*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(@std_avg*@act_sample_size)
									ELSE 0
								END,
								@std_avg*@act_sample_size+3*SQRT(@std_avg*@act_sample_size),
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 20 -- DPMO
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg * 1000000/@num_defect_opp,
								CASE WHEN (@std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size))
										  *1000000/@num_defect_opp > 0
									THEN (@std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size))
										 *1000000/@num_defect_opp
									ELSE 0
								END,
								(@std_avg+3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size))
									*1000000/@num_defect_opp,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
					END -- of "IF @cl_source = 1"
					IF @cl_source = 2 BEGIN -- Use preset values
						IF @chart_type = 2 -- Xbar + R
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_xbar, @lcl_xbar,
								@ucl_xbar, @cl_range, @lcl_range, @ucl_range,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 3 -- Xbar + S
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_xbar, @lcl_xbar,
								@ucl_xbar, @cl_sigma, @lcl_sigma, @ucl_sigma,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 5 -- IX + MR
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_ix, @lcl_ix,
								@ucl_ix, @cl_imr, @lcl_imr, @ucl_imr,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 7 -- MA + MR
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_ma, @lcl_ma,
								@ucl_ma, @cl_mr, @lcl_mr, @ucl_mr,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 8 -- MA + MS
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_ma, @lcl_ma,
								@ucl_ma, @cl_ms, @lcl_ms, @ucl_ms,
								@indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 16 -- p
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_p, @lcl_p, @ucl_p,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 17 -- np
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_np, @lcl_np, @ucl_np,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 18 -- u
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_u, @lcl_u, @ucl_u,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 19 -- c
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_c, @lcl_c, @ucl_c,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
						IF @chart_type = 20 -- DPMO
							INSERT INTO @SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_u*1000000/
								@num_defect_opp, @lcl_u*1000000/@num_defect_opp,
								@ucl_u*1000000/@num_defect_opp, NULL, NULL,
								NULL, @indx, @num_points, NULL)
					END -- of "IF @cl_source = 2"
		--			END -- of "IF @indx <= @num_points OR @num_points IS NULL"
		--			SELECT @indx = @indx + 1 -- Increment if new sample
		--		END -- of "IF (@chart_type > 4 AND @chart_type < 9) OR @value_no = 1"
					SELECT @indx = @indx + 1 -- Increment if new sample
				END -- of "IF (@chart_type > 4 AND @chart_type < 9) OR @value_no = 1"
			END -- of "IF @indx <= @num_points OR @num_points IS NULL"
			-- Update info on last result, before next one fetched
			SELECT @temp_char_id = @char_Id
			SET @temp_sample_id = @sample_Id
			SET @temp_default_chart = @chart_type
			FETCH curRR INTO @sample_Id, @requested_time_utc, @value_no,
				@result_value, @standard_dev, @mean, @range, @act_sample_size, @rnum
		END -- of "WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0"
		CLOSE curRR
		DEALLOCATE curRR
			-- Adjust last characteristic's control limits if needed
			-- given final x_bar and est_std_dev if there were enough samples
		IF @temp_default_chart = 2 AND @cl_source = 0 AND @num_samp >= @samples_before_cl
			AND (@samp_used > 0 OR @sigma_est = 1) BEGIN
			IF @sigma_est = 0 SET @est_std_dev = @est_std_dev_sum/@samp_used
			UPDATE @SampleControlLimits
				SET Primary_target = @x_bar,
					Primary_lcl = @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
					Primary_ucl = @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
					Secondary_target = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
											ELSE @est_std_dev*d_2 END,
					Secondary_lcl = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
										 ELSE @est_std_dev*d1 END,
					Secondary_ucl=  CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
										 ELSE @est_std_dev*d2 END
				FROM @SampleControlLimits s
				LEFT OUTER JOIN factor f WITH (NOLOCK)
					ON s.act_sample_size = f.sample_size
				WHERE char_id = @temp_char_id AND s.char_id = char_id
		END
		IF @temp_default_chart = 3 AND @cl_source = 0 AND @num_samp >= @samples_before_cl
			AND (@samp_used > 0 OR @sigma_est = 1) BEGIN
			IF @sigma_est = 0 SET @est_std_dev = @est_std_dev_sum/@samp_used
			UPDATE @SampleControlLimits
				SET Primary_target = @x_bar,
					Primary_lcl = @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
					Primary_ucl = @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
					Secondary_target = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
											ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4 END,
					Secondary_lcl = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
										 ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4*b3 END,
					Secondary_ucl=  CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
										 ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4*b4 END
				FROM @SampleControlLimits s
				LEFT OUTER JOIN factor f WITH (NOLOCK)
					ON s.act_sample_size = f.sample_size
				WHERE char_id = @temp_char_id AND s.char_id = char_id
		END
		-- End of 5/20/12 addition

	END -- IF last_created_at_utc is NULL or at least one sample exists for the filter with a result created after the supplied last_created_at_utc value

	SELECT #RawResults.sample_id
		,ROUND(primary_target, 10) AS primary_cl
		,ROUND(primary_lcl, 10) AS primary_lcl
		,ROUND(primary_ucl, 10) AS primary_ucl
		,ROUND(secondary_target, 10) AS secondary_cl
		,ROUND(secondary_lcl, 10) AS secondary_lcl
		,ROUND(secondary_ucl, 10) AS secondary_ucl
		,requested_time_local
		,requested_time_utc
		,requested_time_utc AS requested_time
		,sample_note AS note
		,value_no
		,result_value
		,#RawResults.act_sample_size
		,created_at_utc
		,#RawResults.cause_id
		,cause.cause_desc
		,#RawResults.ignore_sample
		,#RawResults.control_move
		,#RawResults.x_axis_label
	FROM #RawResults WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN @SampleControlLimits scl ON #RawResults.sample_id = scl.sample_id AND #RawResults.indx = scl.indx
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cause WITH (NOLOCK) ON cause.cause_id = #RawResults.cause_id
	ORDER BY requested_time_utc, sample_id, value_no

	DROP TABLE #RawResults
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_BOMComparison -
-- Description:	   To compare MES BOM with SAP
--
-- Usage:			
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			DS				2023-02-12						To compare MES BOM with SAP
-- 0.02.00			SSB				2023-03-23						Compare MES BOM with SAP, not allow Release if MES has different items
-- 0.03.00			LK				2023-08-03						added extra condition to eliminate shell burning process def_lot_no
-- 0.04.00			DS				2024-08-28						@missingBOM changed to max
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompares]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @json nvarchar(MAX)=null
	 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Counter INT, @iterate int=1
	declare @cte_temp table
	(
				item_id nvarchar(50)
	)

	declare @item_id nvarchar(50),
	@missingBOM nvarchar(max),
	@is_wip_oper nvarchar(50),
	@wip_item  nvarchar(50),
	@sap_target_item nvarchar(50),
	@wip_item_prefix nvarchar(40) = '',
	@wip_target_item nvarchar(40) = '',
	@target_ent_id int,
	@recipe_name nvarchar(80),
	@bom_item_cnt nvarchar(50),
	@recipe_version int,
	@ritem_id nvarchar(40),
	@rname nvarchar(100),
	@rver nvarchar(40),
	@isRecipeNull int=0
	declare @counter_ int

	declare @sap_bom table
	(   
		row_id int identity(1,1),
		item_id nvarchar(50)
	)
	declare @row_min int 
	declare @row_max int 
	declare @sap_bom_item nvarchar(40)

	declare @mes_bom table
	(
		item_id nvarchar(50)
	)
	declare @result_temp table
	(
		wo_id nvarchar(20),
		oper_id nvarchar(30),
		seq_no int,
		result_code int,
		failed_msg nvarchar(MAX),
		bom_item nvarchar(MAX)
	)

	declare @wo_id nvarchar(20),
	@oper_id nvarchar(30),
	@seq_no int




	  declare   @allWo as table
								   (  ID INT IDENTITY(1, 1) primary key,
											wo_id NVARCHAR(50),
											oper_id NVARCHAR(50),
											seq_no int										
								   )
						  INSERT INTO @allWo
					SELECT *
					FROM OPENJSON(@json) 
					WITH (
						wo_id NVARCHAR(50),
						oper_id NVARCHAR(50),
						seq_no int	
					);

	
--SET @Counter=(select count(1) from @allWo)
--WHILE ( @iterate <= @Counter)		
WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @allWo)
BEGIN
	set @isRecipeNull=0
	set @missingBOM = null
  select top 1 @wo_id=wo_id,@seq_no=seq_no,@oper_id=oper_id from @allWo
   
   
	if  exists (select 1 from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos = 0 and def_lot_no is null and oper_id not like '%shell%')
	begin
		
		insert into @result_temp
		values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,3,'Lot number is not updated for wo',null)
		select * from @result_temp
		return;
	end

	
	delete @sap_bom
	delete @mes_bom
	--this if condition will work only for the process for the wo only where set recipe step is applicable
	if exists(select 1 from job j with(nolock)
		inner join oper o with(nolock) on o.oper_id=j.oper_id
		inner join oper_step os with(nolock) on o.process_id=os.process_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and step_name='Set Recipe')
		BEGIN
						if ((select spare1 from wo with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id) is not null) -- checking for the SAP order
						begin
								-- fetching the sap bom
								insert into @sap_bom
								select item_id from ofi_wo_item_ext with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos <>0

								
								-- fetching the MES bom 
								set @is_wip_oper= null
								-- it will only fetch the wip materials // comment from Ajay
								select TOP 1 @is_wip_oper = oa.oper_id from oper_attr oa with(nolock) inner join   job j with(nolock) 
								on oa.oper_id=j.oper_id  where wo_id =@wo_id and oa.oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no
								and attr_id in(select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'produce_wip')
				
								
			
								print @is_wip_oper + @oper_id
								print '@is_wip_oper'
									if(@is_wip_oper is not null)
										begin
											--print 'if'+ @oper_id
											select @sap_target_item = item_id, @target_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id from job with(nolock)
											where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @is_wip_oper and seq_no = @seq_no
											--print @sap_target_item
											--print '@sap_target_item'
										
										-- add '50' prefix before item_id for the intermetiate material
												select @wip_item_prefix = isnull(spare2,'50')  from item_class with(nolock) where item_class_id ='SFG' --and attr_id  = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc =  'wip_item_prefix')
						
												
												set @sap_target_item =  SUBSTRING(@sap_target_item,3,len(@sap_target_item)) 
												set @wip_target_item = CONCAT(@wip_item_prefix,@sap_target_item)
											

												

												--take the preferred recipe
												select  distinct @ritem_id=omr.item_id,@rname=recipe_name, @rver=version from ofi_master_recipe omr with(nolock) 
												--inner join job with(nolock) on omr.item_id = job.item_id and omr.ent_id = job.target_sched_ent_id
												where omr.item_id = @wip_target_item and omr.ent_id = @target_ent_id
												and omr.is_active = 'Y' and omr.preferred = 'Y'

												

												--taking mes for not wip and intermediate materials
												insert into @mes_bom 
												select bi.item_id from bom_item bi with(nolock)												
												inner join item with(nolock) on item.item_id =bi.item_id
												inner join item_class ic  with(nolock) on item.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
												and ic.item_class_id not in ('INTERMEDIATE', 'WIP')
												where bi.bom_pos<>0 and bi.parent_item_id=@ritem_id and bi.ver_id=@rver
												and bi.spare2 = 'Active'

												-- if there are no preferred recipe
												if not exists(select * from @mes_bom )
												BEGIN
													insert into @result_temp
													values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,4,'NoPreferredRecipe',@missingBOM)
													set @isRecipeNull=1
												END
											end

										else-- if not intermediate 
											begin
												set @ritem_id=null
												set @rname=null
												set @rver=null
												print 'else'+ @oper_id
											-- Assuming that both the jobs will have same item id
											
												select  distinct @ritem_id=omr.item_id,@rname=recipe_name, @rver=version from ofi_master_recipe omr with(nolock) 
												inner join job with(nolock) on omr.item_id = job.item_id and omr.ent_id = job.target_sched_ent_id
												where job.wo_id = @wo_id and seq_no = @seq_no and oper_id=@oper_id
												and omr.is_active = 'Y' and omr.preferred = 'Y'

																							
											-- Fetching the bom components from master recipe
												insert into @mes_bom 
												select bi.item_id from bom_item bi with(nolock)
												inner join item with(nolock) on item.item_id =bi.item_id
												inner join item_class ic  with(nolock) on item.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id 
												and ic.item_class_id not in ('INTERMEDIATE', 'WIP')
												where bi.bom_pos<>0 and bi.parent_item_id=@ritem_id and bi.ver_id=@rver
												and bi.spare2 = 'Active'

												-- if there are no preferred recipe
												if not exists(select bi.item_id from bom_item bi with(nolock)
												inner join item with(nolock) on item.item_id =bi.item_id
												inner join item_class ic  with(nolock) on item.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id 
												--and ic.item_class_id not in ('INTERMEDIATE', 'WIP')
												where bom_pos<>0 and bi.parent_item_id=@ritem_id and bi.ver_id=@rver
												and bi.spare2 = 'Active'
												)
												
												
												BEGIN
													insert into @result_temp
													values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,4,'NoPreferredRecipe',@missingBOM)
													set @isRecipeNull=1
												END
											end

											-- comparison starts
								if(@isRecipeNull=0)
								BEGIN
										
										;with cte as(
										 
											select item_id from @mes_bom
	
											except
											
												select item_id from @sap_bom)
											insert into @cte_temp
											select item_id from cte			
											select @bom_item_cnt=count(1) from @cte_temp
						
					
								SELECT @missingBOM=STUFF((SELECT ', ' + i.item_desc +'('+o.item_id+')'
								  FROM @cte_temp o
								  inner join item i on i.item_id=o.item_id
								  FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 2, '') 
								  delete @cte_temp

								 
								 -- ALLOWED TO SHOW ERROR AND NOT WARNING if the set recipe is applicaple and prefereed recipe is not found against the item and entity then the job should not get released //comment from AJAY	

										if (@bom_item_cnt>0 )
											begin 
												insert into @result_temp
												values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,2,'Extra BOM',@missingBOM)
											end
											else 
											begin 
												insert into @result_temp
												values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,1,'Success',null)
											end
									END--@isRecipeNull=1
					
						end

					print @oper_id
						
						delete  @allWo where wo_id=@wo_id and seq_no=@seq_no and oper_id=@oper_id
							--SET @iterate  = @iterate  + 1

	END
	else -- if there is no preferred recipe
	begin
		insert into @result_temp
		values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,5,'NotSetRecipe',null)
		delete  @allWo where wo_id=@wo_id and seq_no=@seq_no and oper_id=@oper_id
	end



END
select * from @result_temp


END
