CREATE       FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_Generate_Sub_Lot_No] (@Seq varchar(100)) Returns VARCHAR(50) AS
Begin
	DECLARE @sub_lot varchar(50)
	SET @sub_lot = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'ddMMyyhhmmss') + @Seq
	RETURN @sub_lot 
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_PrepProdAttributes]
(
 		@session_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@event_time_local		Datetime = NULL
	,	@event_time_utc			DATETIME = NULL
 	,	@ent_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_class_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_uom_desc			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@mo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@production_schedule_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@target_prod_rate		TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@prod_uom				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@batch_size				TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@start_quantity			TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@user_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@reqd_quantity			TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	,	@update_inventory		LOGICAL = 0
	,	@inv_unique_by_job		LOGICAL = 0
	,	@process_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@bom_ver_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value  	INT32 = NULL
	,	@auto_start_job			INT32 = 1
	,	@warning_messages		STRING4000_NULL OUTPUT


)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Ent_PrepProdAttributes, based on sp_U_Job_Exec_StrtDataEntryJob written by Raghu.
-- Description			- See Middleware DFS, Sidus 2 Broadway
-- Author				- AML
-- Date Created			- 06/25/2008
-- Version				- 3.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/22/2008		AML				3.5		L00082756 - Made some modifications to prevent deadlocks.
-- 10/23/2008		AML				3.5		L00082756 - Switched to job-based login to streamline the capturing of labor_usage
--														data to avoid deadlocks on the labor_usage table.
-- 07/17/2009       SLR			    4.0     Database changes changed insert parameter list
-- 08/20/2009       SLR				4.0     L00075592  Added null value for rework_process_id parameter to SP_I_JOB
-- 08/21/2009		Raghu			4.0		DB Changes
-- 12/12/2009		AJAY			4.0.0	H1423 FIX/Changes
-- 08/30/2013		Raghu			4.6	    UserStory: 232693 - As Bruce, I want an appropriate error message to be returned to the client when creating a job (using PrepareProductionAttributes) with a target production rate of zero
--08/22/2014	Srinivasa Tentu     5.0	    UserStry#381635(As Lenka, I want to modify the stored procedures to determine the correct use of session IDs)
--04/11/2016	Srinivasa Tentu     5.03	User story 594198.  Removed the tz_bias, std_time input parameters from sp_i_session stored procedure. Updated its call in SP.
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- 06/23/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserSTory:829053-As SE, I want an overloaded version of the stateless API method FactMES.API.Core.Ent.PrepareProductionAttributesByEntName in order to support UTC timestamps
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,	@state_cd					INT32
		,	@item_uom					INT32_NULL
		,	@uom_id_temp				INT32
		,	@mod_id						NVARCHAR(30)
		,	@ent_can_sched				INT32
		,	@display_seq				INT32
		,	@est_prod_rate_temp			TFLOAT
		,	@prod_uom_temp				INT32
		,	@cur_wo_id					STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id				STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no					INT32
		,	@cur_item_id				STRING40
		,	@ret						INT32
		,	@cur_shift_id				INT32
		,	@cur_shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@cur_shift_start_local		TDATETIME
		,	@deviation_above			STRING40
		,	@deviation_below			STRING40
		,	@seq_no						INT32
		,	@log_id						INT32
		,	@def_lab_cd					STRING80
		,	@def_dept_id				STRING80
		,	@pct_labor_to_apply			TFLOAT
		,	@cur_date_time				TDATETIME
		,	@cur_prod_uom				INT32
		,	@cur_prod_rate				TFLOAT
		,	@cur_start_quantity			TFLOAT
		,	@cur_reqd_quantity			TFLOAT
		,	@cur_batch_size				TFLOAT
		,	@cur_job_pos				INT32
		,	@junk1						STRING40
		,	@junk2						STRING40
		,	@junk3						STRING40
		,	@err						NVARCHAR(1000)
		,	@retry						INT32
		,	@end						LOGICAL
		,	@job_based_login			LOGICAL
		,	@blank_item_uom_passed		LOGICAL
		,	@blank_item_class_passed	LOGICAL
		,	@can_capture_labor			LOGICAL
		,	@default_user				STRING40
		,	@error_msg_tmp				STRING254
		,	@dbg_resp					INT32


	SELECT @warning_messages = '', @blank_item_uom_passed = 0, @blank_item_class_passed = 0, @update_inventory = COALESCE(@update_inventory, 0), @inv_unique_by_job = COALESCE(@inv_unique_by_job, 0)
	SELECT @default_user = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_id = 199

	SELECT @cur_date_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL), @last_edit_at = getutcdate()

	IF(@session_id >= -9) BEGIN
	 IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WHERE user_id = @user_id ) OR ( @user_id IS NULL ) OR ( @user_id = '' ) BEGIN
		SET @user_id = @default_user
	 END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
	  SELECT @user_id = COALESCE(user_id, @default_user) FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @ent_id) or (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'An entity with the supplied entity ID does not exist.{5775}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_run_jobs = 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The supplied entity cannot run jobs{3293}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (COALESCE(@target_prod_rate, 0) <= 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 must be greater than zero.{3224},target_prod_rate', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- If the event time UTC is supplied, use that since UTC is more reliable
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
		SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)

	-- The supplied event time utc is null but the local time is not null
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NULL)
		--Since UTC time is not supplied; use the supplied local time to determine the UTC time
		--This case is for backward compatibility
		AND (@event_time_local IS NOT NULL)
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE())

	-- Obtain UOM ID
	-- Handle cases where no description is provided.
	IF (@item_uom_desc IS NULL OR @item_uom_desc = '') BEGIN
		--  If item exists, then use UOM from the item
		set @blank_item_uom_passed = 1

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
			SELECT @item_uom_desc = uom.description, @item_uom = uom.uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK), uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id AND uom.uom_id = item.uom_id
		END
		--  Otherwise, use the default in the system attribute and create an entry in the UOM table if not already there.
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @item_uom_desc = system_attr.attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_id = 404

			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc) BEGIN
			    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc) BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY
					EXEC sp_I_Uom @item_uom_desc, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_at OUTPUT, @item_uom OUTPUT
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					-- Probably a Race Condition causing Unique Key Constraint errors - detect and ignore
					IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627  and (XACT_STATE() = 1) BEGIN
						SELECT @item_uom = uom.uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc
					END ELSE IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627 BEGIN
						RAISERROR( 'This job failed to create.  Please re-submit.{6015}', 16, 1 )
						RETURN -1
					END ELSE BEGIN
						set @err = ERROR_MESSAGE() + ' ' + Cast(ERROR_NUMBER() as nvarchar(20))
						RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1)
					END
				END CATCH
                            END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @item_uom = uom.uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc
			END
		END
	END
	-- Handle cases where description is provided.
	ELSE BEGIN
		-- If item exists, then use the UOM from the item and provide a warning if it is different than the UOM provided as input.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK), uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id AND item.uom_id = uom.uom_id AND uom.description = @item_uom_desc) BEGIN
				SELECT @warning_messages = @warning_messages + ';Item UOM specified is different from the existing item UOM for this item - ignoring item UOM specified'
			END

			SELECT @item_uom = item.uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id
		END
		-- Otherwise, use the UOM provided as input and create an entry in the UOM table if one does not already exist.
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc) BEGIN
			    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc) BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY
					EXEC sp_I_Uom @item_uom_desc, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_at OUTPUT, @item_uom OUTPUT
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					-- Probably a Race Condition causing Unique Key Constraint errors - detect and ignore
					IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627  and (XACT_STATE() = 1) BEGIN
						SELECT @item_uom = uom.uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc
					END ELSE IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627 BEGIN
						RAISERROR( 'This job failed to create.  Please re-submit.{6015}', 16, 1 )
						RETURN -1
					END ELSE BEGIN
						set @err = ERROR_MESSAGE() + ' ' + Cast(ERROR_NUMBER() as nvarchar(20))
						RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1)
					END
				END CATCH
                            END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @item_uom = uom.uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom.description = @item_uom_desc
			END
		END
	END


	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_class WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_class.item_class_id = @item_class_id) BEGIN

		IF ( @item_class_id IS NULL OR @item_class_id = '' ) BEGIN
			SELECT @blank_item_class_passed = 1
			SELECT @item_class_id = system_attr.attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_id = 402
		END

		IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_class WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_class.item_class_id = @item_class_id ) BEGIN
		    IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_class WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE item_class.item_class_id = @item_class_id ) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Class 	@item_class_id, @item_class_id, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, null, null, null, null, -1, 0, '', '', '',
									'', '', @last_edit_at
                    END
		END

	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id AND item.item_class_id <> @item_class_id AND @blank_item_class_passed = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @warning_messages = @warning_messages + ';Item class specified is different from the existing item class for this item - ignoring item class specified'
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id) BEGIN

		IF ( @item_id IS NULL OR @item_id = '' ) BEGIN
			SELECT @item_id = system_attr.attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_id = 403

			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id AND item.item_class_id <> @item_class_id AND @blank_item_class_passed = 0) BEGIN
				SELECT @warning_messages = @warning_messages + ';Item class specified is different from the existing item class for the default item - ignoring item class specified'
			END
		END

		IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id ) BEGIN

			IF ( @item_uom IS NULL ) OR ( @item_uom < 0 ) BEGIN
				RAISERROR( 'A valid unit of measure is required to create this item.{5781}', 16, 1 )
				RETURN -1
			END

		        IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id ) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_I_Item 	@item_id, @item_id, @item_class_id, @item_uom, 0, null, null, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, null, null, null, null,
							0, null, null, null, null, null, -1, null, null, null, @inv_unique_by_job, '', '', '', '', '', '', @last_edit_at
                        END

		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @uom_id_temp = item.uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id

			IF ( @item_uom IS NULL ) OR ( @item_uom < 0 ) OR ( @uom_id_temp <> @item_uom ) BEGIN
				SELECT @item_uom = @uom_id_temp
				IF ( @blank_item_uom_passed = 0 ) BEGIN
					SELECT @warning_messages = @warning_messages + ';Item UOM specified is different from the existing item UOM for this item - ignoring item UOM specified'
				END
			END

		END

	END
	ELSE BEGIN

		SELECT @uom_id_temp = item.uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item.item_id = @item_id

		IF ( @item_uom IS NULL ) OR ( @item_uom < 0 ) OR ( @uom_id_temp <> @item_uom ) BEGIN
			SELECT @item_uom = @uom_id_temp
			IF ( @blank_item_uom_passed = 0 ) BEGIN
				SELECT @warning_messages = @warning_messages + ';Item UOM specified is different from the existing item UOM for this item - ignoring item UOM specified'
			END
		END

	END

	IF ( @wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '' ) BEGIN
		SELECT @wo_id = system_attr.attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_id = 400
	END

	IF ( @oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '' ) BEGIN
		SELECT @oper_id = system_attr.attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_id = 401
	END

	--Get the cur_wo_id and cur_oper_id for @ent_id for comparison to @wo_id and @oper_id
	SELECT 	@cur_wo_id = je.cur_wo_id,	@cur_oper_id = je.cur_oper_id, @cur_item_id = j.item_id
		,	@cur_prod_uom = j.prod_uom, @cur_prod_rate = j.est_prod_rate, @cur_start_quantity = j.qty_at_start
		,	@cur_batch_size = j.batch_size, @cur_reqd_quantity = j.qty_reqd
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND
			je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND
			je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
	WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id

	-- Provide warning if not using new values.
	--IF EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND job.oper_id = @oper_id ) BEGIN

	IF ( @wo_id <> isnull(@cur_wo_id, '') ) OR ( @oper_id <> isnull(@cur_oper_id, '') ) OR ( @item_id <> isnull(@cur_item_id,'' ) ) OR
	   ( @prod_uom <> isnull(@cur_prod_uom, '') ) OR ( @target_prod_rate <> isnull(@cur_prod_rate, '') ) OR
	   ( @start_quantity <> isnull(@cur_start_quantity, '') ) OR (@batch_size <> isnull(@cur_batch_size, '') ) OR
	   ( @reqd_quantity <> isnull(@cur_reqd_quantity,'') )
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id ) BEGIN
		    IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id ) BEGIN
			IF (@process_id IS NOT NULL AND @bom_ver_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SAVE TRANSACTION CWOFP
					BEGIN TRY
						EXEC sp_I_job_exec_CWOFP_stack @wo_id=@wo_id, @process_id=@process_id, @item_id=@item_id, @req_qty=@reqd_quantity,
							@user_id=@user_id, @start_qty=@start_quantity, @init_wo_state = 1, @wo_desc=@wo_id, @release_time=NULL, @release_time_tz = NULL,
							@req_finish_time=NULL, @req_finish_time_tz = NULL, @wo_priority=1, @cust_info=NULL, @mo_id=@mo_id, @production_schedule_id=@production_schedule_id,
							@notes=NULL, @bom_ver_id=@bom_ver_id, @for_first_op=0, @spec_ver_id=NULL, @may_override_route=0,
							@parent_wo_id=NULL, @parent_oper_id=NULL, @parent_seq_no=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL

							-- Trace - just using this as a short circuit for testing
							exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Ent_PrepProdAttributes_t', @src_key='CWOFP_stack'
							IF ( @dbg_resp = 1 ) RETURN

							SET @seq_no =0
							GOTO STARTJOB;
					END TRY
					BEGIN CATCH
						SET @error_msg_tmp = ERROR_MESSAGE();
						ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
						BEGIN TRANSACTION
						EXEC sp_U_Ent_PrepProdAttributes @session_id=@session_id, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @event_time_utc=@event_time_utc,
							@ent_id=@ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @item_class_id=@item_class_id,
							@item_uom_desc=@item_uom_desc, @wo_id=@wo_id, @mo_id=@mo_id, @production_schedule_id=@production_schedule_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
							@target_prod_rate=@target_prod_rate, @prod_uom=@prod_uom, @batch_size=@batch_size, @start_quantity=@start_quantity,
							@user_id=@user_id, @reqd_quantity=@reqd_quantity, @update_inventory=@update_inventory, @inv_unique_by_job=@inv_unique_by_job,
							@process_id=NULL, @bom_ver_id=NULL,
							@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @auto_start_job=@auto_start_job, @warning_messages=@warning_messages OUTPUT

						SET @warning_messages = @error_msg_tmp + COALESCE(@warning_messages, '');
						RETURN
					END CATCH
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
			        -- 07/17/2009 SLR Added null values for the input_wo_id, input_oper_id, and input_seq_no parameters
				EXEC sp_I_Wo  @wo_id, @wo_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, @item_id, 0, NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL, 1, NULL, NULL, @mo_id, @production_schedule_id, NULL,
							0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @mod_id OUTPUT
			END

/*			BEGIN TRY
					--IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_log WITH (ROWLOCK) WHERE log_id = (SELECT cur_log_id FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
						--SET @ret = 1

					-- 07/17/2009 RWB Added null values for the segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters
                    -- 08/20/2009 SLR Added null value for rework_process_id parameter and remove null values for the segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters
					EXEC sp_I_Job	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @oper_id, @item_id, 2, 1, NULL, @ent_id, @ent_id,
									@ent_id, @reqd_quantity, 0, 0, 0, 0, @start_quantity, @deviation_above, @deviation_below, @batch_size, 0, 0, 0, 0, --check_inv
									NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @target_prod_rate, @prod_uom, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, -- concurrent_link
									NULL, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @display_seq, NULL, 0, --rework
									NULL, NULL, '', '', '', '', NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, 1, @last_edit_at OUTPUT

				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					IF ( ERROR_MESSAGE() = '2627' OR ERROR_MESSAGE() = '3930') and (XACT_STATE() = 1) BEGIN
						SET @retry = @retry - 1
						WAITFOR DELAY '000:00:01'
						GOTO RETRY
					END ELSE IF ERROR_MESSAGE() = '547' or ERROR_MESSAGE() = '2627' BEGIN
						RAISERROR( 'This job failed to create.  Please re-submit.{6015}', 16, 1 )
						RETURN -1
					END ELSE BEGIN
						SET @err = ERROR_MESSAGE() + ' ' + cast(ERROR_NUMBER() as nvarchar(20))
						RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1 )
					END
				END CATCH*/

                    END
		END

		SELECT @retry = 3, @end = 0

		WHILE ( (@retry > 0) AND (@end = 0) ) BEGIN

			SELECT @seq_no = MAX(seq_no), @display_seq = MAX(display_seq) FROM job WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
			SELECT @seq_no = ISNULL(@seq_no, -1) + 1, @display_seq = ISNULL(@display_seq, -1) + 1, @last_edit_at = NULL

			SELECT @deviation_above = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 103
			SELECT @deviation_below = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 104

			IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND job.oper_id = @oper_id AND job.seq_no = @seq_no ) BEGIN

				BEGIN TRY
					--IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_log WITH (ROWLOCK) WHERE log_id = (SELECT cur_log_id FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
						--SET @ret = 1

					-- 07/17/2009 RWB Added null values for the segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters
                    -- 08/20/2009 SLR Added null value for rework_process_id parameter and remove null values for the segment_requirement_id and segment_response_id parameters
					EXEC sp_I_Job @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_desc=@oper_id, @item_id=@item_id, @state_cd=2, @job_priority=1, @req_finish_time_local=NULL, @req_finish_time_tz=NULL, @init_sched_ent_id=@ent_id, @target_sched_ent_id=@ent_id,
						@run_ent_id=@ent_id, @qty_reqd=@reqd_quantity, @qty_prod=0, @qty_prod_erp=0, @qty_rejected=0, @qty_rejected_erp=0, @qty_at_start=@start_quantity, @deviation_above=@deviation_above, @deviation_below=@deviation_below, @batch_size=@batch_size, @first_job=0, @final_job=0, @sched_pinned=0, @check_inv=0, --check_inv
						@est_fixed_lab=NULL, @est_lab_rate=NULL, @est_setup_time=NULL, @est_teardown_time=NULL, @est_prod_rate=@target_prod_rate, @prod_uom=@prod_uom, @est_transfer_time=NULL, @sched_start_time_local=NULL, @sched_start_time_tz=NULL, @latest_start_time_local=NULL, @latest_start_time_tz=NULL, @sched_finish_time_local=NULL,
						@sched_finish_time_tz=NULL, @act_start_time_local=NULL, @act_start_time_tz=NULL, @act_finish_time_local=NULL, @act_finish_time_tz=NULL, @concurrent_link=0, -- concurrent_link
						@job_cost=NULL, @parent_contingent_job=0, @child_contingent_job=0, @notes=NULL, @assoc_file=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @display_seq=@display_seq, @folder_ver_id=NULL, @rework=0, --rework
						@rework_cd=NULL, @rework_process_id=NULL, @spare1='', @spare2='', @spare3='', @spare4='', @last_edit_comment=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @create_job_bom=1, @edit_time=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

					-- Trace - just using this as a short circuit for testing
					exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Ent_PrepProdAttributes_t', @src_key='post_sp_i_job'
					IF ( @dbg_resp = 1 ) RETURN

					IF (COALESCE(@update_inventory, 0) = 1)
						UPDATE job_bom SET update_inv = 1
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
						  AND oper_id = @oper_id
						  AND seq_no = @seq_no
						  AND bom_pos = 0
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					IF ( ERROR_MESSAGE() = '2627' OR ERROR_MESSAGE() = '3930') and (XACT_STATE() = 1) BEGIN
						SET @retry = @retry - 1
						WAITFOR DELAY '000:00:01'
						GOTO RETRY
					END ELSE IF ERROR_MESSAGE() = '547' or ERROR_MESSAGE() = '2627' BEGIN
						RAISERROR( 'This job failed to create.  Please re-submit.{6015}', 16, 1 )
						RETURN -1
					END ELSE BEGIN
						SET @err = ERROR_MESSAGE() + ' ' + cast(ERROR_NUMBER() as nvarchar(20))
						RAISERROR( @err, 16, 1 )
					END
				END CATCH

				SET @end = 1

			END

			RETRY:

		END

		IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id AND job.oper_id = @oper_id AND job.seq_no = @seq_no ) BEGIN
			RAISERROR( 'This job failed to create.  Please re-submit.{6015}', 16, 1 )
			RETURN -1
		END

		STARTJOB:
		IF (@auto_start_job = 0) BEGIN
			RETURN -1;
		END

		IF EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
		)
		BEGIN
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE BEGIN

			SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
			FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = 0

			SET @ret = 0

			IF ((@cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL))  BEGIN

				SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @ent_id

				IF EXISTS (
					SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
					WHERE (s.client_type = 64 AND
							( (el.[user_id] <> @user_id AND el.ent_id = @ent_id) OR
							  (el.[user_id] = @user_id AND el.ent_id = @ent_id AND el.session_id <> @session_id) ) )
				) BEGIN

					DECLARE @t_ent_logon TABLE (
						id int identity,
						ent_id int,
						session_id int,
						client_type int,
						[user_id] nvarchar(40),
						log_off_ent bit
					)

					INSERT INTO @t_ent_logon ( ent_id, session_id, client_type, [user_id], log_off_ent )
					SELECT 	el.ent_id, el.session_id, s.client_type, el.[user_id], 0
					FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
					WHERE (s.client_type = 64 AND el.ent_id = @ent_id)

					UPDATE @t_ent_logon SET log_off_ent = 1
					WHERE [user_id] <> @user_id

					DECLARE @max_id AS INT, @count AS INT, @old_session_id AS INT, @old_user_id AS STRING40, @log_off_ent AS LOGICAL
					SELECT @max_id = MAX( id ), @count = MIN( id ) FROM @t_ent_logon

					WHILE ( @count <= @max_id ) BEGIN

						SELECT @old_session_id = session_id, @old_user_id = [user_id], @log_off_ent = log_off_ent
						FROM @t_ent_logon tel WHERE tel.id = @count

						IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN

							EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @job_pos=0, @status_notes=NULL, @user_id=@user_id
									, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @client_type=37, @no_propogation=0, @check_auto_job_start=1
									, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_end_utc=@event_time_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

							DELETE FROM ent_logon WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id
						END ELSE BEGIN

							EXEC sp_d_ent_logon_logoffjob 	@old_session_id,
															@old_user_id,
															@ent_id,
															0,
															4,
															NULL,
															@event_time_local ,
															1,
															@time_zone_bias_value,
															@err OUTPUT
						END

						SET @count = @count + 1
					END

				END ELSE BEGIN
					EXEC @ret = sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @job_pos=0, @status_notes=NULL, @user_id=@user_id
							, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @client_type=37, @no_propogation=0, @check_auto_job_start=1
							, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_end_utc=@event_time_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
				END
			END

			IF (@ret <> -1) BEGIN

				IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sessn.session_id = @session_id ) BEGIN
				    IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sessn WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE sessn.session_id = @session_id ) BEGIN

					IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE system_attr.attr_value = @user_id AND system_attr.attr_id = 199 ) BEGIN
						EXEC SP_I_SESSION @session_id OUTPUT, 53, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @junk1 OUTPUT, @junk2 OUTPUT, @junk3 OUTPUT
					END ELSE BEGIN
						EXEC SP_I_SESSION @session_id OUTPUT, 64, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @junk1 OUTPUT, @junk2 OUTPUT, @junk3 OUTPUT
					END

				    END
				END


				IF ( @user_id <> @default_user ) BEGIN

					IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [user_name].[user_id] = @user_id ) BEGIN

						EXEC sp_U_Session_SwitchUser 	@session_id = @session_id,
														@user_id = @user_id,
														@auth_done = 1,
														@log_in = 1,
														@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value

						SELECT 	@def_lab_cd = un.def_lab_cd
						   ,	@def_dept_id = un.def_dept_id
						FROM user_name un WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE un.[user_id] = @user_id

						--Verify whether this entity allows multiple users to login into this entity.
						SELECT 	@def_lab_cd = COALESCE(@def_lab_cd, le.def_lab_cd)
							, 	@def_dept_id = COALESCE(@def_dept_id, le.def_dept_id)
						FROM labor_exec le WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE le.ent_id = @ent_id

						IF (@def_lab_cd IS NULL) SELECT @def_lab_cd = MIN(lab_cd) FROM labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK)
						IF (@def_dept_id IS NULL) SELECT @def_dept_id = MIN(dept_id) FROM labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK)

						--The user isn't the Default User, so we're going to use job-based login....
						EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_LogonJob 	@session_id = @session_id,
														@user_id = @user_id,
														@ent_id = @ent_id,
														@wo_id = @wo_id,
														@oper_id = @oper_id,
														@seq_no = @seq_no,
														@status_notes = NULL,
														@cur_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd,
														@cur_lab_dept_id = @def_dept_id,
														@pct_lab_to_apply = NULL,
														@logon_time = @event_time_local,
														@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
					END ELSE BEGIN
						--The user isn't a valid Factelligence user, so we're just going to start the job....
						EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL
							, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_start_utc=@event_time_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
					END
				END ELSE BEGIN
					--The user is the Default User, so we're just going to start the job....
					EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL
						, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @event_time_local=NULL, @job_start_utc=@event_time_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

				END
			END
		END
	END
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_po_line_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[po_line]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_po_line_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on po_line table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--05/12/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE po_line SET po_line.quantity = ROUND(po_line.quantity, ISNULL(it.num_decimals, 7)),
		po_line.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, po_line.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE po_line.po_id = i.po_id AND po_line.po_line_no = i.po_line_no
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_lm_customer_info
-- Description:	Insert Update Cust information
--
-- Usage:	Insert Update Cust information
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-13			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-03-05          Added the rtf info
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_customer_info]  
	 @cust_name	NVARCHAR(100)
	,@cust_img_path nvarchar(max) = NULL
	,@cust_info nvarchar(max) = NULL
	,@cust_info_rtf NVARCHAR(max) = NULL
	,@is_active   bit = 1
	,@type_of_content INT = 2
	,@user   nvarchar (100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @cust_count INT=0
	,@is_deleted   bit = 0;
	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0
	,@updated_on_tz						INT32 = NULL
	,@tz_temp 							INT32
	,@updated_on						datetime = GETDATE()
	,@updated_on_utc					datetime = GETUTCDATE()
	,@current_time						datetime;

	
	declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_Customerinfo'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Printer'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@l INT =0
			,@smeRcdCnt INT=0
			,@new_cust_id  NVARCHAR(100)
			,@new_cust_path NVARCHAR(200)
			,@new_cust_info NVARCHAR(200)
			,@new_cust_info_rtf NVARCHAR(MAX) 
			,@new_is_active INT
			,@new_type_of_content INT
			,@new_row_id INT			 
			,@resultset INT=1
			,@resultcode NVARCHAR(200)

	
	declare @custInfo as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	cust_name nvarchar(100),
	cust_path nvarchar(1000),
	cust_info nvarchar(1000),
	cust_info_rtf nvarchar(1000),
	is_active NVARCHAR(50),
	type_of_content INT
	);

	declare @custInfo1 as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	cust_name nvarchar(100),
	cust_path nvarchar(1000),
	cust_info nvarchar(1000),
	cust_info_rtf nvarchar(1000),
	is_active NVARCHAR(50),
	type_of_content INT
	);

	insert into @custInfo (row_id,cust_name,cust_path,cust_info, cust_info_rtf, is_active,type_of_content)
	select ci.cust_row_id,ci.cust_name,ci.cust_img_path,ci.cust_info,ci.cust_info_rtf,ci.is_active,ci.type_of_content
	from ofi_lm_customer_info ci with(nolock)
	where cust_name=@cust_name


	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 );

	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )


	 
    SELECT @cust_count=COUNT(lci.cust_name)
	FROM ofi_lm_customer_info lci WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE lci.cust_name=@cust_name

	 
	IF(@cust_count > 0)
	BEGIN
	--SELECT 'iNSIDE UPDATE';
	UPDATE ofi_lm_customer_info
	SET cust_img_path=@cust_img_path
	   ,cust_info=@cust_info
	   ,cust_info_rtf =@cust_info_rtf
	   ,is_active=@is_active
	   ,is_deleted=@is_deleted
	   ,updated_by=@user
	   ,updated_on_utc=@updated_on_utc
	   --,updated_on=@updated_on
	   ,type_of_content=@type_of_content
	WHERE cust_name=@cust_name

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	--SELECT 'iNSIDE INSERT';
	select @user
	INSERT INTO ofi_lm_customer_info 
	 
	(cust_name,cust_img_path,cust_info,cust_info_rtf, is_active,is_deleted,created_by,created_on_utc,type_of_content)
	values
	 
	(@cust_name,@cust_img_path,@cust_info,@cust_info_rtf,@is_active,@is_deleted,@user,@updated_on_utc,@type_of_content)
	END

	insert into @custInfo1 (row_id,cust_name,cust_path,cust_info,cust_info_rtf,is_active,type_of_content)
	select ci.cust_row_id,ci.cust_name,ci.cust_img_path,ci.cust_info,ci.cust_info_rtf,ci.is_active,ci.type_of_content
	from ofi_lm_customer_info ci with(nolock)
	where cust_name=@cust_name

	BEGIN TRY
	
	-- edit existing record present 
	SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.row_id)
	from @custInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @custInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_name,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_name,'-') as nvarchar(max))) 
	OR (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_info,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info,'-') as nvarchar(max)))
	OR (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_info_rtf,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info_rtf,'-') as nvarchar(max))) 
	OR (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_path,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_path,'-') as nvarchar(max))) 
	OR (t1.is_active <> t2.is_active) OR (t1.type_of_content <> t2.type_of_content)
	while (@i < @modCnt)
	BEGIN
	SELECT  @new_row_id=t2.row_id,
			@new_cust_id=t2.cust_name,
			@new_cust_info=cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info,'-') as nvarchar(max)),
			@new_cust_path=cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_path,'-') as nvarchar(max)),
			@new_cust_info_rtf=cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info_rtf,'-') as nvarchar(max)),
			@new_is_active=cast(t2.is_active as nvarchar(50)),
			@new_type_of_content=t2.type_of_content
	from @custInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @custInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_name,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_name,'-') as nvarchar(max))) 
	OR (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_info,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info,'-') as nvarchar(max))) 
	OR (cast(ISNULL(t1.cust_path,'-') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_path,'-') as nvarchar(max)))
	OR (t1.is_active <> t2.is_active) OR (t1.type_of_content <> t2.type_of_content)
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @i ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'cust_row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_name',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_info',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_info)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_info_rtf',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_info_rtf)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_img_path',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_path)),
							(@new_row_id,'is_active',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_is_active)),
							(@new_row_id,'type_of_content',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_type_of_content))
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+@new_cust_id+'_'
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	set @i=@i+1;
	END

	-- insert new record 
	select @newCnt =count(t2.row_id)
	from @custInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @custInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @custInfo t2 )
	 while (@j < @newCnt)
	 BEGIN
	select  @new_row_id=t2.row_id,
			@new_cust_id=t2.cust_name,
			@new_cust_info=cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info,'-') as nvarchar(max)),
			@new_cust_info_rtf=cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_info_rtf,'-') as nvarchar(max)),
			@new_cust_path=cast(ISNULL(t2.cust_path,'-') as nvarchar(max)),
			@new_is_active=cast(t2.is_active as nvarchar(50)),
			@new_type_of_content=t2.type_of_content
	from @custInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @custInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @custInfo t2 )
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @j ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
	Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'cust_row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_name',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_info',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_info)),
							(@new_row_id,'cust_info_rtf',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_info_rtf)), 
							(@new_row_id,'cust_img_path',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_cust_path)),
							(@new_row_id,'is_active',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_is_active)),
							(@new_row_id,'type_of_content',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_type_of_content))
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+@new_cust_id+'_'
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @j = @j + 1;
	END
	set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='Success';
	select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
	select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_SIM_Roasting_GetNextJob]
-- Description: Returns the next job to be executed by the Roasting simulator
--
-- Usage: Called from the IDE object Roasting_BMO_AUT_SIM_Data (script scr_SimLoop).
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version		Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00		XPM    		2026-09-14   		Initial version.
-- 0.02.00		XPM    		2026-09-14   		ISNULL on all input parameters.
-- 0.03.00		XPM    		2026-09-14   		Returns production and consumption storage units used before for the same item.
-- 0.04.00		XPM    		2026-09-14   		Skips jobs with a minimum consumption in the BOM: they cannot be stopped without consumption.
-- 0.05.00		XPM    		2026-09-15   		Skips jobs with backflushed BOM lines without def_reas_cd.	
-- 0.06.00		XPM	    	2026-09-16   		Consumption storage unit only if it still has inventory.
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SIM_Roasting_GetNextJob]
	@ent_id INT,
	@job_pos INT = 0,
	@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = 'Roasting',
	@after_wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = '',
	@min_qty_reqd FLOAT = 1000,
	@max_qty_reqd FLOAT = 100000,
	@wo_id_output NVARCHAR(40) = '' OUTPUT,
	@seq_no_output INT = -1 OUTPUT,
	@qty_reqd_output INT = 0 OUTPUT,
	@prod_item_id_output NVARCHAR(40) = '' OUTPUT,
	@cons_item_id_output NVARCHAR(40) = '' OUTPUT,
	@cons_ratio_permil_output INT = 0 OUTPUT,
	@prod_storage_unit_output NVARCHAR(40) = '' OUTPUT,
	@cons_storage_unit_output NVARCHAR(40) = '' OUTPUT,
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@return_code INT = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @cfg_rc_found INT = 0
		,	@cfg_rc_not_found INT = 1
		,	@cfg_rc_entity_busy INT = 2

	DECLARE @cur_wo_id_local NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
		,	@cur_seq_no_local INT = NULL
		,	@wo_id_local NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
		,	@seq_no_local INT = NULL
		,	@qty_reqd_local FLOAT = NULL
		,	@prod_item_id_local NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
		,	@cons_item_id_local NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
		,	@cons_max_local FLOAT = NULL
		,	@cons_min_local FLOAT = NULL
		,	@cons_ratio_local FLOAT = 1
		,	@prod_storage_unit_local NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
		,	@cons_storage_unit_local NVARCHAR(40) = NULL

	DECLARE @prod_su_candidates TABLE (
		su_ent_id INT,
		storage_unit NVARCHAR(40)
	)

	DECLARE @cons_su_candidates TABLE (
		su_ent_id INT,
		storage_unit NVARCHAR(40)
	)

	-- Defaults again: parameters not supplied from the IDE arrive as NULL
	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, 0)
	SET @oper_id = ISNULL(@oper_id, 'Roasting')
	SET @after_wo_id = ISNULL(@after_wo_id, '')
	SET @min_qty_reqd = ISNULL(@min_qty_reqd, 1000)
	SET @max_qty_reqd = ISNULL(@max_qty_reqd, 100000)

	SET @wo_id_output = ''
	SET @seq_no_output = -1
	SET @qty_reqd_output = 0
	SET @prod_item_id_output = ''
	SET @cons_item_id_output = ''
	SET @cons_ratio_permil_output = 0
	SET @prod_storage_unit_output = ''
	SET @cons_storage_unit_output = ''
	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @return_code = @cfg_rc_not_found


	-- 1. Check that the execution position is free
	SELECT	 @cur_wo_id_local = je.cur_wo_id
			,@cur_seq_no_local = je.cur_seq_no
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND je.job_pos = @job_pos

	IF @cur_wo_id_local IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		-- Return the running job so the caller can decide whether to stop it
		SET @wo_id_output = @cur_wo_id_local
		SET @seq_no_output = ISNULL(@cur_seq_no_local, 0)
		SET @message_output = 'Execution position busy. ent_id: ' + CAST(@ent_id AS NVARCHAR(10))
							+ ', job_pos: ' + CAST(@job_pos AS NVARCHAR(10))
							+ ', running wo_id: ' + @cur_wo_id_local
		SET @return_code = @cfg_rc_entity_busy

		RETURN @return_code
	END


	-- 2. Next valid job
	SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id_local = j.wo_id
				,@seq_no_local = j.seq_no
				,@qty_reqd_local = j.qty_reqd
				,@prod_item_id_local = jb.item_id
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = j.wo_id
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id
											AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
											AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
											AND jb.bom_pos = 0
		LEFT JOIN job_bom jbm WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbm.wo_id = j.wo_id
											AND jbm.oper_id = j.oper_id
											AND jbm.seq_no = j.seq_no
											AND jbm.bom_pos > 0
											AND ISNULL(jbm.min_qty_per_parent_item, 0) > 0
		LEFT JOIN job_bom jbf WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbf.wo_id = j.wo_id
											AND jbf.oper_id = j.oper_id
											AND jbf.seq_no = j.seq_no
											AND jbf.bom_pos > 0
											AND jbf.backflush = 1
											AND jbf.def_reas_cd IS NULL
	WHERE j.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND j.state_cd IN (1, 2)
		AND j.act_start_time_utc IS NULL
		AND w.state_cd <> 3
		AND j.qty_reqd BETWEEN @min_qty_reqd AND @max_qty_reqd
		AND jb.def_reas_cd IS NOT NULL
		AND jb.def_lot_no IS NOT NULL
		AND jbm.wo_id IS NULL
		AND jbf.wo_id IS NULL
		AND j.wo_id > @after_wo_id
	ORDER BY j.wo_id ASC
			,j.seq_no ASC

	IF @wo_id_local IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @message_output = 'No valid job found. oper_id: ' + @oper_id
							+ ', after_wo_id: ' + @after_wo_id
		SET @return_code = @cfg_rc_not_found

		RETURN @return_code
	END


	-- 3. Main consumed material: the BOM line with the highest quantity per parent item
	SELECT TOP 1 @cons_item_id_local = jb.item_id
				,@cons_max_local = ISNULL(jb.max_qty_per_parent_item, 0)
				,@cons_min_local = ISNULL(jb.min_qty_per_parent_item, 0)
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id_local
		AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no_local
		AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	ORDER BY jb.qty_per_parent_item DESC
			,jb.bom_pos ASC

	-- Allowed consumption per unit produced (see sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed)
	IF @cons_max_local > 0
		SET @cons_ratio_local = @cons_max_local
	ELSE IF @cons_min_local > 0
		SET @cons_ratio_local = @cons_min_local
	ELSE
		SET @cons_ratio_local = 1


	-- 4. Storage units used before by Roasting for the same items (random among them)
	-- 4.1 Production: distinct candidates first, then only the ones with room for the whole job
	INSERT INTO @prod_su_candidates (su_ent_id, storage_unit)
	SELECT DISTINCT os.su_ent_id
				,ea.attr_value
	FROM ofi_su_selection os WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = os.su_ent_id
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
										AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
										AND a.attr_grp = 2
	WHERE os.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND os.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND os.dest_type = 2
		AND os.jb_item_id = @prod_item_id_local

	SELECT TOP 1 @prod_storage_unit_local = su.storage_unit
	FROM @prod_su_candidates su
		LEFT JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = su.su_ent_id
		LEFT JOIN item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = su.su_ent_id
	GROUP BY su.su_ent_id
			,su.storage_unit
			,se.max_capacity
	HAVING ISNULL(se.max_capacity, 0) = 0
		OR ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left), 0) + @qty_reqd_local <= se.max_capacity
	ORDER BY NEWID()

	-- 4.2 Consumption: only units that still have something inside, whatever the item
	-- (sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessConsData consumes what is in the unit, and an empty one
	-- returns "data type error. data_type: -2")
	INSERT INTO @cons_su_candidates (su_ent_id, storage_unit)
	SELECT DISTINCT os.su_ent_id
				,ea.attr_value
	FROM ofi_su_selection os WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = os.su_ent_id
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
										AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
										AND a.attr_grp = 2
	WHERE os.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND os.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND os.dest_type = 1
		AND os.jb_item_id = @cons_item_id_local

	SELECT TOP 1 @cons_storage_unit_local = su.storage_unit
	FROM @cons_su_candidates su
		INNER JOIN item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = su.su_ent_id
	GROUP BY su.su_ent_id
			,su.storage_unit
	HAVING SUM(ii.qty_left) > 0
	ORDER BY NEWID()


	-- 5. Outputs
	SET @wo_id_output = @wo_id_local
	SET @seq_no_output = @seq_no_local
	SET @qty_reqd_output = CAST(CEILING(@qty_reqd_local) AS INT)
	SET @prod_item_id_output = @prod_item_id_local
	SET @cons_item_id_output = ISNULL(@cons_item_id_local, '')
	SET @cons_ratio_permil_output = CAST(ROUND(@cons_ratio_local * 1000, 0) AS INT)
	SET @prod_storage_unit_output = ISNULL(@prod_storage_unit_local, '')
	SET @cons_storage_unit_output = ISNULL(@cons_storage_unit_local, '')
	SET @message_output = 'Job found. wo_id: ' + @wo_id_local
						+ ', seq_no: ' + CAST(@seq_no_local AS NVARCHAR(10))
						+ ', qty_reqd: ' + CAST(@qty_reqd_output AS NVARCHAR(20))
						+ ', prod_su: ' + @prod_storage_unit_output
						+ ', cons_su: ' + @cons_storage_unit_output
	SET @return_code = @cfg_rc_found

	RETURN @return_code
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Std_Oper_Attr]
  (@oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @attr_id int = NULL,
   @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
   )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_S_Std_Oper_Attr
-- Description      - Select a single existing row identified by the primary key
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 10/17/2005	      Raghu		    3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/19/2018	      Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	      Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 7

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT std_oper_attr.oper_id
       ,std_oper_attr.attr_id
       ,std_oper_attr.attr_value
       ,std_oper_attr.notes
       ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_comment
       ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_by
       ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_at
FROM std_oper_attr std_oper_attr
WHERE (std_oper_attr.oper_id = @oper_id AND
       std_oper_attr.attr_id = @attr_id)
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_I_EI_PRO_DEF_ATTR
-- Description:  Inserts the work order details
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-27         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  AP          2023-11-23         Added insert for wo attribute 'NewOrderCheck'
-- 0.01.02  LP          2024-05-15         Added insert for wo attribute 'AllowBinAssignment'
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE[dbo].[SP_I_EI_PRO_DEF_ATTR] (@module        NVARCHAR(40),
                                              @plant_code    NVARCHAR(40),
                                              @wo_id         NVARCHAR(40),
                                              @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
                                              @item_id       NVARCHAR(40),
                                              @spare1        NVARCHAR(200),
                                              @spare2        NVARCHAR(200),
                                              @spare3        NVARCHAR(200),
                                              @spare4        NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
      IF @erp_wo_status = 'ACTIVE'
         AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                        FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
                        WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id)
         AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                    FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
                    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                           AND ( status = 1
                                  OR status IS NULL ))
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @attr_id        INT=NULL,
					@attr_id_Auto_Release        INT=NULL,
                    @rc             INT,
                    @error_msg      NVARCHAR(500),
                    @error_severity INT,
                    @error_state    INT,
                    @mod_id         VARCHAR(30),
                    @wo_uom         NVARCHAR(40),
                    @item_uom       NVARCHAR(40),
					@oper_val    NVARCHAR(40),
					@orderType      NVARCHAR(40)


            SELECT @item_uom = u.description
            FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
                   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
                           ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
                              AND i.item_id = @item_id

            SELECT @wo_uom = uom_desc
            FROM   ofi_wo_ext  WITH (nolock)
                   

            BEGIN try
                BEGIN TRANSACTION

				     SELECT @attr_id_Auto_Release = attr_id
                      FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'NewOrderCheck'
                             AND a.attr_grp = 6

					  EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_wo_attr]
                        @wo_id = @wo_id,
                        @attr_id = @attr_id_Auto_Release,
                        @attr_value = 'True',
                        @notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
                        @last_edit_comment = NULL,
                        @mod_id = @mod_id output

						 SELECT @attr_id = attr_id
							 FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
							 WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'AllowBinConsumption'
                             AND a.attr_grp = 7
						select top 1 @oper_val=oa.attr_value from  wo w with (nolock) 
						inner join oper_attr oa with (nolock) 
						on w.process_id=oa.process_id 
						where oa.attr_id=@attr_id
						and w.wo_id=@wo_id

						 SELECT @attr_id = attr_id
							 FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
							 WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'AllowBinAssignment'
                             AND a.attr_grp = 6

						IF @oper_val is not null and @oper_val='1'
						BEGIN							

							  EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_wo_attr]
								@wo_id = @wo_id,
								@attr_id = @attr_id,
								@attr_value = '1',
								@notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
								@last_edit_comment = NULL,
								@mod_id = @mod_id output
						  END
						  ELSE
						  BEGIN
						  
							  EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_wo_attr]
								@wo_id = @wo_id,
								@attr_id = @attr_id,
								@attr_value = '0',
								@notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
								@last_edit_comment = NULL,
								@mod_id = @mod_id output
						  END

                     

                IF @item_id <> @wo_uom
                  BEGIN
                      SELECT @attr_id = attr_id
                      FROM   attr a WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'ProdReportUOM'
                             AND a.attr_grp = 6

                      IF @attr_id IS NOT NULL
                        BEGIN
                            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
                                           FROM   wo_attr WITH (nolock)
                                           WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                                                  AND attr_id = @attr_id)
                  BEGIN
                      EXEC @rc = [dbo].[Sp_i_wo_attr]
                        @wo_id = @wo_id,
                        @attr_id = @attr_id,
                        @attr_value = @wo_uom,
                        @notes = 'ADDED BY EI',
                        @last_edit_comment = NULL,
                        @mod_id = @mod_id output

                      IF ( @rc <> 0 )
                        BEGIN
                            SET @error_msg =N'Error while creating work order attribute (' + @item_id + ') in MES  - SP_I_EI_PRO_DEF_ATTR -  '  + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
                            THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
                        END
                  END
                            ELSE
                              BEGIN
                                  UPDATE wo_attr
                                  SET    attr_value = @wo_uom
                                  WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
                                         AND attr_id = @attr_id
                              END
                        END
                      ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            SET @error_msg =N'Work Order attribute not found (ProdReportUOM) in MES  - SP_I_EI_PRO_DEF_ATTR -  '+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(16), @rc);
							THROW 51009, @error_msg, 1
						END
END

    COMMIT TRANSACTION
END try

    BEGIN catch
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
          ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),
               @error_severity = Error_severity(),
               @error_state = Error_state();

        RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
    END catch
END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_GetNextVerNo]
(@next_ver_no		NVARCHAR(40) OUTPUT
,@ver_option		INT = 0 -- Default to wo_id
,@criteria		NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_GetNextVerNo
-- Description       - Get next version nos for a work order and a process
--			HD# 2492, 4840
--			0 - Auto Generate Work Orders, 1 - Auto generate Process version nos
--			2 - Auto generate Purchase Orders
--			@criteria - can be any valid criteria, currently used to filter process class
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 07/08/2004
-- Version		- 2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes/Comments
--07/12/2004	Raghu		2.1.0		 It is not that hard to increment the next work order nos, but it is more complicated when incrementing a next process version no.
--						eg. Ver %.%.#.% SERIES is more complicated to increment the no in # position.
--07/23/2004	Raghu		2.1.0		Changed temptable valu column datatype - from int to float
--08/09/2004	Raghu		2.1.0		(HD# 4885) Included code to return next po_id
--10/04/2004	Raghu		2.1.3		(HD# 2492) This sp is modified to find the the increment versions manually rather relying on built-in PATINDEX function
--						which does not handle many cases such as when '%' appears many times in a search format, etc..
--07/25/2005	Raghu		2.1.24		Some version nos are not generated properly. Errors out when version no exists as 1.5.15
--						and the process version format is '%.#'. The error was when trying to convert a varchar (float value) to an integer
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @tmp_data		TABLE(version_id NVARCHAR(80), value FLOAT, left_part NVARCHAR(40), right_part NVARCHAR(40))
DECLARE @tmp_ver		TABLE(version_id NVARCHAR(80), left_part_end_pos INT, right_part_start_pos INT)

DECLARE  @format		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@search_str		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@start_pos		INT
	,@end_pos		INT
	,@first_part		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@second_part		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@max_valu		INT
	,@left_part		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@right_part		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@ver_id		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@lp_end_pos		INT
	,@rp_start_pos		INT

	IF (@ver_option IS NULL) SET @ver_option = 0


	IF (@ver_option = 0) BEGIN	-- WO Version Format
		SELECT @format = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 241
		IF (@format IS NULL OR @format = '') BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Work order format is not defined in System Attribute table{2687}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (CHARINDEX('#', @format, 1) = 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Work order increment format is not defined in System Attribute table{2706}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@ver_option = 1) BEGIN		--Process Version Format
		SELECT @format = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 223
		IF (@format IS NULL OR @format = '') BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Process Version format is not defined in System Attribute table{2755}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (CHARINDEX('#', @format, 1) = 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Process Version increment format is not defined in System Attribute table{2873}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@ver_option = 2) BEGIN		--Po Id Version Format
		SELECT @format = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 300
		IF (@format IS NULL OR @format = '') BEGIN
			RAISERROR('PO format is not defined in System Attribute table{2755}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (CHARINDEX('#', @format, 1) = 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Process Version increment format is not defined in System Attribute table{2873}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@ver_option = 3) BEGIN
	    SELECT @format = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 332
		IF ( @format IS NULL OR @format = '' ) BEGIN
			RAISERROR( 'Lot no. format is not defined in System Attribute table{2755}', 16, 1 )
		END

		IF (CHARINDEX('#', @format, 1) = 0) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Lot no. increment format is not defined in System Attribute table{2873}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SET @start_pos = LEN(@format) - CHARINDEX('#', REVERSE(@format))
	SET @end_pos = @start_pos + 2
	SET @first_part = SUBSTRING(@format, 1, @start_pos) + '%'
	SET @second_part = '%' + RIGHT(@format, LEN(@format) - @end_pos + 1);
	SET @search_str = @first_part + '%' + @second_part

	IF (@ver_option = 0) DECLARE csr_version CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT attr_value FROM system_attr
                       WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 412
                      --SELECT wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id LIKE @search_str
	ELSE IF (@ver_option = 1) DECLARE csr_version CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT process_ver_id FROM process WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE process_class_id = @criteria AND process_ver_id LIKE @search_str
	ELSE IF (@ver_option = 2) DECLARE csr_version CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT po_id FROM po WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE po_id LIKE @search_str
	ELSE IF (@ver_option = 3) DECLARE csr_version CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT lot_no FROM lot WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE item_id = @criteria AND lot_no LIKE @search_str
	OPEN csr_version
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM csr_version INTO @ver_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		EXEC SP_PATINDEX @ver_id, @first_part, -1, 0, @lp_end_pos OUTPUT
		EXEC SP_PATINDEX @ver_id, @second_part, 0, -1, @rp_start_pos OUTPUT
		INSERT INTO @tmp_ver (version_id, left_part_end_pos, right_part_start_pos)
		VALUES( @ver_id, @lp_end_pos, @rp_start_pos)
	END
	CLOSE csr_version
	DEALLOCATE csr_version

	INSERT INTO @tmp_data (version_id, value, left_part, right_part)
	SELECT y.version_id, valu = CASE WHEN (ISNUMERIC(y.valu) = 1) THEN CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(FLOAT, y.valu)) ELSE 0 END, y.left_part, y.right_part
	FROM (
		SELECT x.version_id, valu = CASE WHEN (x.right_part_start_pos  - x.left_part_end_pos)-1 <= 0 THEN SUBSTRING(x.version_id, x.left_part_end_pos + 1, LEN(x.version_id) - x.left_part_end_pos + 1)
			   				 ELSE SUBSTRING(x.version_id, x.left_part_end_pos + 1, (x.right_part_start_pos - x.left_part_end_pos) -1) END
					,SUBSTRING(x.version_id, 1, x.left_part_end_pos) left_part
					,CASE WHEN (x.right_part_start_pos > 0) THEN SUBSTRING(x.version_id, x.right_part_start_pos, LEN(x.version_id)-x.right_part_start_pos + 1)
						  ELSE NULL END right_part
			FROM @tmp_ver x
	)y

	SELECT @max_valu = value, @left_part = left_part, @right_part = right_part
	FROM @tmp_data WHERE version_id + ' ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, value) =
	(SELECT MAX(version_id) + ' ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, MAX(value)) FROM @tmp_data
	WHERE value = (SELECT MAX(value) FROM @tmp_data))

	IF @max_valu IS NULL SET @max_valu = 1 ELSE SET @max_valu = @max_valu + 1
	IF (@left_part IS NULL OR @left_part = '')  AND (@right_part IS NULL OR @right_part = '')  BEGIN
		SET @left_part = REPLACE(REPLACE(@first_part, '_', ''), '%', '')
		SET @right_part = REPLACE(REPLACE(@second_part, '_', ''), '%', '')
	END

	SET @next_ver_no = ISNULL(@left_part, '') + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @max_valu) + ISNULL(@right_part, '')

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_Exec_SetPendingReas]
(@ent_id             INT32
,@final_reas_cd      INT32
,@log_id	INT
,@period_affected    INT32 = NULL
,@old_reas_cd        INT32 = NULL
,@comments           STRING2000_NULL = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.18
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2		Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 07/23/2003		KRF				1.6.15		Default @period_affected to 0 instead of 480, and make 0 mean
-- 												to update only the last non-final reason regardless of start_time (3424)
--08/05/2003		Raghu			1.6.17		(HD# 3467) Included updating of cur_log_id and cur_state_cd in util_exec
--08/22/2003		Raghu			1.2.0		(HD# 3510) To set the possible final reason for the old non-final reason.  Added log_id param, if log_id matches with the current util_exec log_id for the
--												current entity, then update util_exec else do not update util_exec. If log_id is passed in update only the row which is exactly passed in
--												Also updates util_exec ONLY if the current pending reason is the final pending reason; should match with log_id OR current reason start
--10/20/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Language string ID added.
--10/17/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 06/16/2006		SJ				3.1.0.18	Hold update lock when selecting UTIL_EXEC records
--01/30/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
-- 10/04/2011		Ashish			4.1.0		Modified for CR-L00116939 clone CR-L00112799 (HF 2502)to update categories
-- 12/21/2015		Tentu			5.2			Story 569840: To address CR L00139311 updated the @comments parameter type to STRING2000
-- 08/17/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 675688-As Lenka, I want the Raw Reason from UCO and New Reason from Operator to be logged
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@state_cd	INT32
	,@runtime	LOGICAL
	,@downtime	LOGICAL
	,@setuptime	LOGICAL
	,@teardowntime	LOGICAL
	,@fixedtime	LOGICAL
	,@failure	LOGICAL
	,@vartime	LOGICAL
	,@category1	STRING80
	,@category2	STRING80
	,@category3	STRING80
	,@category4	STRING80
	,@start_range	TDATETIME2
	,@end_range	TDATETIME2 = GETUTCDATE()
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'UtilExec.SetPendingReason'

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
	--Return error if the entity and the final_reas_cd are not specified
	IF ((@ent_id IS NULL) OR (@final_reas_cd IS NULL)) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The ent_id or the final_reas_cd cannot be null.{4734}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Set default values
	IF @comments IS NULL SET @comments = ''

	--Verify whether the supplied entity is capable of capturing utilization events
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('A row does not exist in util_exec for this entity{3243}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied reason exists in the database
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @final_reas_cd) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified final reason is not defined in the util_reas table{3246}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @runtime = runtime, @downtime = downtime
		, @setuptime = setuptime, @teardowntime = teardowntime, @fixedtime = fixedtime
		, @failure = failure, @vartime = vartime
		, @category1 = category1, @category2 = category2, @category3 = category3, @category4 = category4
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @final_reas_cd

	--Determine whether this is the final event
	IF (@log_id IS NULL AND @period_affected is NULL) BEGIN
		--A null log id indicates no single event is identified
		--Since the period_affected is NULL, the update corresponds to the final event in the database
		--Default to the last event for the entity
		SELECT @event_time_utc = MAX(event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Since a single event is modified, there is no need to look for a range of events
		SELECT @start_range = NULL, @end_range = @event_time_utc
	END

	--If a period is supplied, then use the supplied period to update the final reason
	IF (@period_affected IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @end_range = MAX(event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--A log_id is supplied, a range of time is specified, or both
		--Determine the starting time of the range
		SET @event_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@period_affected, @end_range)

		--Since a range of events are modified, set the starting and ending range
		SELECT @start_range = @event_time_utc
	END

	--If log_id is supplied restrict to a single event
	IF (@log_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.log_id = @log_id

		--Since a single event is modified, there is no need to look for a range of events
		SELECT @start_range = NULL, @end_range = @event_time_utc
	END

	--Update the utilization event(s)
	UPDATE util_history
	SET reas_pending = 0
	  ,reas_cd = @final_reas_cd
	  ,comments = @comments
	  ,state_cd = @state_cd
	  ,runtime = @runtime
	  ,downtime = @downtime
	  ,setuptime = @setuptime
	  ,teardowntime = @teardowntime
	  ,fixedtime = @fixedtime
	  ,vartime = @vartime
	  ,category1 = @category1
	  ,category2 = @category2
	  ,category3 = @category3
	  ,category4 = @category4
	  ,failure   = @failure
	  ,last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND (event_time_utc >= @event_time_utc OR @event_time_utc IS NULL)
	  --The current event must have a non-final reason to become final
	  AND reas_pending = 1
	  --Optionally restrict to the supplied log_id, if non-null is supplied
	  AND (log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL)
	  --Optionally restrict to the identified reason code
	  AND (reas_cd = @old_reas_cd OR @old_reas_cd IS NULL)

	--Determine whether any events to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc_start_range=@start_range, @event_time_utc_end_range=@end_range
		, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, @records_affected=NULL
END
