EventGlobId,
cast (EventId as nvarchar) as EventID,
cast (EventLinkId as nvarchar) as EventLinkID,
GenealogyId,
ProductionScheduleId
from vw_MaterialConsumedActual --item_prod ip inner join job_event je

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_WO_GetByFilter]
(
	@wo_id 						STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@item_id 					STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@target_sched_line_id       INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@wo_status_filter			NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@number_of_wos              INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@include_from_process	LOGICAL = 0,
	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0
/*
Example XML
<wo_status>
	<status code="1" />
	<status code="2" />
	<status code="3" />
	<status code="4" />
	<status code="5" />
	<status code="6" />
</wo_status>
*/
)

AS
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-	sp_SA_WO_GetByFilter
-- Description		-	Selects the rows from the work order table that match the supplied filters
--						The quantities for the work orders will be calculated in the following manner:
--						There are 4 cases:
--						1. A work order is being run on a line (where it is required that all needed conversions exist or an
--						   error is returned)
--						2. A work order is not being run on a line, there is a single first operation, and the needed
--						   conversions exist
--						3. A work order is not being run on a line, there is more than one first operation, and the needed
--						   conversions exist (this is the least likely case)
--						4. A work order is not being run on a line, and at least one needed conversion does not exist
--
--						Note that what conversions are "needed" may differ from value to value, so the same case may not
--						apply to all values (for example, when conversions for the UOMs of the items reported as good
--						production exist, but not for all rejects).  Also, a conversion is needed only for non-zero values.
--						There may be rejects but no good production, or vice versa.  The required quantity (qty_reqd) is
--						always the sum of the qty_reqd of the last jobs in the work order (those where final_job is true),
--						and the remaining required quantity (def_reqd_qty) is always the greater of 0 or the required
--						quantity (qty_reqd) minus the good production quantity (qty_prod), however they were calculated.
--						The rest can vary for each case:
--
--						Case 1 (A work order is being run on a line)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the first jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item
--						qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the jobs at the production position, converted to the UOM of the final item (the production position is the last position if no production entity is identified)
--						qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of the jobs at the production position and before, each converted to the UOM of the final item before summing
--						qty_remaining = the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - qty_rejected)
--
--						Case 2 (A work order is not being run on a line, there is a single first operation, and the needed conversions exist)
--						qty_at_start = same as Case 1
--						qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the last jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item
--						qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of each job, each converted to the UOM of the final item before summing
--						qty_remaining = same as Case 1
--
--						Case 3 (A work order is not being run on a line, there is more than one first operation, and the needed conversions exist)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the last jobs
--						qty_prod = same as Case 2
--						qty_rejected = same as Case 2
--						qty_remaining = the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - sum of the qty_rejected fields of the last jobs)
--
--						Case 4 (A work order is not being run on a line, and at least one needed conversions does not exist)
--						qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the last jobs
--						qty_prod = same as Case 2
--						qty_rejected = 0
--						qty_remaining = same as Case 3
--
--						Note that while in cases 1 and 2 that the qty_remaining is given as "same as Case 1", since it's
--						always equal to the greater of 0 or (qty_at_start - qty_prod - qty_rejected), nevertheless what 2 of
--						these 3 components are varies from case to case, so how the value of qty_remaining is derived may
--						not be the same if the "final" values for each aren't directly used.  This is also true of the
--						calculation of def_reqd_qty.

-- Author			-
-- Date Created		- 05/06/2014
-- Version			- 5.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--  08/22/2014		SLR			5.0		added input filter for target_sched_line_id, number_of_wos parameter to limit the
--										number of rows to be returned, and changed the order by to work order id.
--  09/05/2014		SLR			5.0		update select to retrieve work orders based on filters ordered by row_id desc to get
--										the most resently created work orders, then select and return the top N order by
--										the work order id
--  09/08/2014		JEO			5.0		update interpretation of the target_sched_line_id parameter value as the following:
--										>= 0 -- return work orders scheduled to a particular line
--										NULL -- return work orders that are not schedule to any line
--										-1   -- Return work orders without regard to a line
--  09/08/2014		RWB			5.0		For CR L00133799, removed the pre-calculation of the work order status.  Calculating
--										the status of every work slows down the SP when the number of work orders exceeds
--										the number of work orders requested.
--	02/05/2015		RWB			5.0.1	For story 439593, made changes to account for different items being produced at
--										different jobs in the work order.  This involves calculating all quantity information
--										to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
--	04/28/2016		Surya		5.0.3	For story 594231, made changes to improve the performance by removing the row number check,
--										and using TOP to retrieve top most work orders.
--	05/20/2016		RWB			5.0.3	For story 59231, added a temporary table to hold the work order ID and status of each
--										work order.  Also, changed the order of the inner select from row_id to row_id DESC.
-- 06/08/2016	Raghu G		5.3	UserStory: 594231 - As Bruce I want the WO collection page to load quicker so that it takes less time (CR L00135959)
--					Modified this stored procedure to improve the performance significantly.
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
-- 10/05/2017	RaghuG		6.0	UserStory: 921577 - As Bruce, I want to be able to use filters to get a list of work orders from the MES database, including work orders created from a process.
-- 11/29/2018	Srinivas	6.01	UserStory: 1031503 - Made changes to return the work orders created from process and assigned to line.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @num_decimals_good_pp	INT,
		@doc_handle				INT,
		@min_factor				INT,
		@wo_limit				INT,
		@no_conv_wo_id			NVARCHAR(40),
		@err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
DECLARE @wo_status_tbl			TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(40) primary key, status_cd INT, wo_uom_id INT, target_sched_line_id INT, num_op INT, row_id INT)
DECLARE @wo_qtys TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY
	, fj_qty_at_start FLOAT, fj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_at_start FLOAT, lj_qty_reqd FLOAT, lj_qty_prod FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)
DECLARE @line_prod_ent_qty TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, qty_prod FLOAT, qty_reqd FLOAT, qty_rejected FLOAT)

BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @wo_limit = COALESCE(@number_of_wos, 999999999)
	SET @include_from_process = COALESCE(@include_from_process, 0)

	SELECT @num_decimals_good_pp = CONVERT(INT, attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @wo_status_filter

	; WITH wo_statuses (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id) AS
		(SELECT wo.wo_id, dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(wo.wo_id), i.uom_id, wo.target_sched_line_id, first_job_counts.num_op, wo.row_id
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = i.item_id
		OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(oper_id)) num_op
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
			  AND j.first_job = 1) first_job_counts
		WHERE (wo.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			(wo.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			--When include from process is true, then the SP returns all work orders, whether they are related to process or not.
			((@include_from_process = 0 AND wo.process_id IS NULL) OR (@include_from_process = 1) OR (wo.process_id IS NOT NULL AND wo.target_sched_line_id is not null)) AND
			((wo.target_sched_line_id = @target_sched_line_id) OR (wo.target_sched_line_id IS NULL AND @target_sched_line_id IS NULL) OR (@target_sched_line_id = -1))
		)
		, wo_for_filter (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id) AS
		(
		SELECT TOP (@wo_limit) wst.wo_id, wst.status_cd, wst.wo_uom_id, wst.target_sched_line_id, wst.num_op, wst.row_id
		FROM wo_statuses wst
		-- Join with the supplied XML which contains the work order statuses that we are interested in
		JOIN OPENXML(@doc_handle, '/wo_status/status',2) WITH (code int '@code') on wst.status_cd = code
		ORDER BY wst.row_id DESC
		)
		INSERT INTO @wo_status_tbl (wo_id, status_cd, wo_uom_id, target_sched_line_id, num_op, row_id)
		SELECT wff.wo_id, wff.status_cd, wff.wo_uom_id, wff.target_sched_line_id, wff.num_op, wff.row_id
		FROM wo_for_filter wff

		EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle


	-- Check if there are any work orders matching the filter that are assigned to lines
	-- and do not have the necessary UOM conversions.
	; WITH
	-- Get the conversion factors for all jobs that produce an item that uses a different UOM than the item produced
	-- by the work order.  If there is no conversion factor between the UOM of the item produced by a job and the
	-- the UOM of the item produced by the work order, default to zero.  Since we are only looking for necessary
	-- conversions, we can ignore any job after the production entities, any jobs that have no reject quantity, or
	-- the jobs on the production entity if they have no production quantity.
	factors (wo_id, factor) AS (
		-- Get the conversions related to reject production items at or before the production position if defined
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
			WHERE lel.ent_id = COALESCE(l.prod_ent_id, (select MIN(COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)) last_ent_id
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.final_job = 1 AND j.wo_id = wo.wo_id))
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order >= prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_rejected <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions related to good production items at the production position if defined, or from the last jobs if not
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo1.target_sched_line_id = prod_ents.line_id
				AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
			SELECT DISTINCT l.line_id, lel.child_order
			FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND l.line_id = lel.line_id
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents_in_line.line_id = prod_ents.line_id
					AND prod_ents_in_line.child_order = prod_ents.child_order
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = wo1.target_sched_line_id
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.qty_prod <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions for the first operation to see if the start quantity can be converted to the
		-- work orders item.
		SELECT wo1.wo_id, factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo1 ON j.wo_id = wo1.wo_id
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo1.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE wo1.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		  AND j.first_job = 1 AND i.uom_id <> wo1.wo_uom_id -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
	)
	-- Get one of the work orders where there is no conversion
	SELECT TOP 1 @no_conv_wo_id = wo_id from factors
	WHERE factors.factor = 0
	IF @no_conv_wo_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		  SET @err_msg = 'There is a quantity of an item for a job of work order %1 having a unit of measure for which there is no conversion to that of the final item for the work order, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{3005},' + @no_conv_wo_id
		  RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		  RETURN
	END

	INSERT INTO @wo_qtys (wo_id, fj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_at_start, lj_qty_reqd, lj_qty_prod, qty_rejected)
	SELECT j.wo_id
	-- Get the starting quantity by summing up the starting quantities of all the first jobs.  The jobs starting
	-- quantity will be converted to the work order's UOM if possible.  If no conversion exists, starting quantity
	-- returned by this CTE will be null, so it will not be used.  This quantity will also not be used if the
	-- number of first operations in the work order is greater than one.
	, SUM(CASE WHEN j.first_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wo.wo_uom_id
		THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END)
	-- Get the starting quantity, quantity produced, and quantity rejected at the last operation in the work order
	-- by summing up those values at the jobs marked as the final job for the work order.  There is no need to
	-- convert the values to the UOM of the item produced by the work order as the last operation must make the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This starting quantity will be used if there are more than one first operation or
	-- if the UOM of the item produced by the first operation cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced by
	-- the work order.  This quantity produced will be used if the work order is not run on a line.  This quantity
	-- rejected will be used if any item rejected in a job running before the final jobs cannot be converted to the UOM
	-- of the item produced by the work order.
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_at_start ELSE 0 END) as qty_at_start
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_reqd ELSE 0 END) as qty_reqd
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) as qty_prod
	,SUM(CASE WHEN j.final_job = 1 THEN j.qty_rejected ELSE 0 END) as qty_rejected
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wo ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	WHERE j.first_job = 1 OR j.final_job = 1
	GROUP BY j.wo_id;

	-- Get the quantity produced on a line by adding up the quantity produced by jobs running at the production entity.
	-- The UOM of the item produced by the jobs running on the production entities is converted to the UOM of the item
	-- produced by the work order.  This quantity will be null if the work order is not run on a line.  Also get the sum
	-- of the required quantities of the jobs running on the production entities.  This quantity will be null if the work
	-- order is not run on a line.
	INSERT INTO @line_prod_ent_qty (wo_id, qty_prod, qty_reqd, qty_rejected)
		SELECT j.wo_id
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order = prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_prod * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order = prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_reqd * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prod_ents.child_order <= prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod THEN j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END),0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wfp ON wfp.wo_id = j.wo_id
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link prod_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_ents.line_id = wfp.target_sched_line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = prod_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN   (--Return the child order from a line to select all entities from the child order
				SELECT l.line_id, COALESCE(MAX(lel.child_order)
							, (SELECT MAX(lel_max.child_order) FROM line_ent_link lel_max WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel_max.line_id = l.line_id AND lel_max.line_is_child = 0)) child_order_prod
				 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id AND lel.ent_id = l.prod_ent_id
				GROUP BY l.line_id
			) prod_ents_in_line -- Limit the lines to selected child orders.
				ON prod_ents.line_id = prod_ents_in_line.line_id AND prod_ents.child_order <= prod_ents_in_line.child_order_prod
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		GROUP BY j.wo_id

	-- Get the rejected quantity of a work order that is not run on a line by adding up the total number of rejects
	-- in the work order.  The UOM of each rejected item is converted to the UOM of the item produced by the work order.
	-- This quantity will be null if the UOM of any rejected item cannot be converted to the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	;WITH nonline_total_rej_prod (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT x.wo_id, CASE WHEN (x.rejected = x.ignore_missed_conv) THEN x.rejected ELSE NULL END
		FROM
			(SELECT j.wo_id
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.factor ELSE 1 END) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, CASE WHEN i.uom_id <> wfp.wo_uom_id THEN uc_generic.offset ELSE 0 END)) AS rejected
				,SUM(j.qty_rejected * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)) AS ignore_missed_conv
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @wo_status_tbl wfp ON wfp.wo_id = j.wo_id
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wfp.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
			GROUP BY j.wo_id) x
	),
	-- Get the total good and rejected for a work order.  The total good will either come from the quantity produced at the
	-- production entities if the work order is run on a line, will come from the quantity produced at the final
	-- operation in the work order if the work order is not run on a line, or will be zero if the work order has no
	-- jobs.  The total rejected will come from the quantity rejected at or
	-- before the production entities if the work order is run on a line, the quantity rejected at or before the final
	-- jobs if the work order is not run on a line and the the UOM of the rejected items can be converted to the UOM of
	-- the item produced by the work order, or the quantity rejected at the final jobs if the work order is not run on
	-- a line and one of more the UOMs from the rejected quantity cannot be converted into the UOM of the item produced
	-- by the work order.
	total_prod (wo_id, qty_good, qty_rejected) AS
	(
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_prod, ljq.lj_qty_prod, 0), COALESCE(lpeq.qty_rejected, nltrp.qty, 0)
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wff.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod nltrp ON wff.wo_id = nltrp.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the start quantity for the work order.  The starting quantity will either be the sum of the start quantities
	-- from the first operation if there is only one first operation and the UOM of the item produced at the first
	-- operation can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order and the UOMs of all the rejects
	-- can be converted into the UOM of the item produced by the work order or it will be the sum of the starting
	-- quantity of the final operation in the work order.
	start_qty (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, CASE WHEN (wff.num_op = 1) THEN COALESCE(jq.fj_qty_at_start, jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) ELSE COALESCE(jq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) END
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys jq ON wff.wo_id = jq.wo_id
	),
	-- Get the qty_reqd for the work order.  This is either the sum of the required quantities of the jobs running at
	-- the production entities if the work order is run on a line or by the sum of the required quantities of the final
	-- jobs.
	qty_reqd (wo_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT wff.wo_id, COALESCE(lpeq.qty_reqd, ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0)
		FROM @wo_status_tbl wff
		LEFT JOIN @line_prod_ent_qty lpeq ON wff.wo_id = lpeq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON ljq.wo_id = wff.wo_id
	)
	 SELECT
	  wo.wo_id
		,	wo.wo_desc
		,	wo.process_id
		,	process.process_desc
		,	wo.bom_ver_id
		,	wo.spec_ver_id
		,	wo.item_id
		,	item.item_desc
		,	item.serial_no_lvl
		,   item.uom_id
		,	uom.description AS uom_desc
		,   item.num_decimals
		,	@num_decimals_good_pp num_decimals_good_pp
		,	wo.req_qty
		,	wo.release_time_utc
		,	wo.release_time_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, wo.release_time_utc) as release_time
		,	wo.req_finish_time_utc
		,	wo.req_finish_time_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, wo.req_finish_time_utc) as req_finish_time
		,	wo.state_cd
		,	wo.wo_priority
		,	wo.cust_info
		,	wo.mo_id
		,	wo.production_schedule_id
		,	wo.notes
		,	wo.not_deletable
		,	wo.disassembly
		,	wo.may_override_route
		,	wo.override_serialization
		,   wo.input_wo_id
		,   wo.input_oper_id
		,   wo.input_seq_no
		,	wo.target_sched_line_id
		,   line.line_name as target_sched_line_name
		,	wo.queue_seq_no
		,	wff.status_cd as wo_status
		,	js.state_desc AS wo_status_desc
		,	js.color
		,	qr.qty AS qty_reqd
		,	sq.qty AS qty_at_start
		,	tp.qty_good AS qty_prod
		,	tp.qty_rejected AS qty_rejected
		-- The quantity remaining is the start quantity - (good production + rejected production).
		,   CASE  -- Added "AND fo.num = 1" to the WHEN and THEN clauses so work orders with >1 1st operation use rejected quantities from last jobs only
			   WHEN (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN sq.qty ELSE ljq.lj_qty_at_start END)
					- (tp.qty_good + CASE WHEN tp.qty_rejected <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN tp.qty_rejected ELSE ljq.qty_rejected END) > 0
			   THEN (CASE WHEN ntrp.qty IS NOT NULL THEN sq.qty ELSE ljq.lj_qty_at_start END)
					- (tp.qty_good + CASE WHEN tp.qty_rejected <> 0 AND wff.num_op = 1 THEN tp.qty_rejected ELSE ljq.qty_rejected END)
			   ELSE 0
		   END AS qty_remaining
		-- The def_reqd_qty is the required quantity - good production
		,	CASE
				WHEN qr.qty - tp.qty_good > 0 THEN qr.qty - tp.qty_good
				ELSE 0
			END AS def_reqd_qty
		,	wo.spare1
		,	wo.spare2
		,	wo.spare3
		,	wo.spare4
		,	wo.last_edit_comment
		,	wo.last_edit_by
		,	wo.last_edit_at
		,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id))) mod_id
		,	COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_at_start, 0) as calc_start_qty
		,	COALESCE(ljq.lj_qty_reqd, 0) as calc_reqd_qty
		,	ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wo.row_id DESC) row_num
	    ,   wo.row_id
	   FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @wo_status_tbl wff ON wo.wo_id = wff.wo_id
		JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON wff.status_cd = js.state_cd
		LEFT JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.process_id = process.process_id
		JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = item.item_id
		JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON  item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		LEFT JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.target_sched_line_id = line.line_id
		JOIN start_qty sq ON wo.wo_id = sq.wo_id
		JOIN total_prod tp ON wo.wo_id = tp.wo_id
		JOIN qty_reqd qr ON wo.wo_id = qr.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN @wo_qtys ljq ON wo.wo_id = ljq.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN nonline_total_rej_prod ntrp ON wo.wo_id = ntrp.wo_id
		ORDER BY wo.wo_id
END

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:    [Sp_U_ofi_Inv_Unique_SU_Production]
-- Description: Updates Unique Silo based on Unique item and grade configuration and production.
--
-- Usage:  in Unique Item SU job add production for OM and OMAR Silo.  Calling from WF.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  CK      2023-12-04      Initial version. 
-- ===========================================================================================*/
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_U_ofi_Inv_Unique_SU_Production] @ent_name_su nvarchar(100) = NULL,
@item_id nvarchar(50) = NULL
AS
BEGIN     -- logic begin

  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @su_attr AS TABLE (
    attr_id int,
    attr_desc nvarchar(80),
    attr_value STRING1700_NULL
  )

  DECLARE @ent_id int
  DECLARE @siloType nvarchar(50) = NULL


  DECLARE @lock_for_input nvarchar(50) = 'false'
  DECLARE @blk_for_quality_id int = 0
  DECLARE @blk_for_quality nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @def_grd_code int = 0
  DECLARE @def_grd_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @unq_item_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @auto_reclass_attr_value nvarchar(50) = 'false'

  DECLARE @prod_grade nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @prod_qty float = 0
  DECLARE @is_silo_block nvarchar(50) = 'false'
  DECLARE @error_code nvarchar(max) = NULL

  DECLARE @return_value_reclass int = 0
  DECLARE @row_id int = 0,
          @reclass_qty float = 0,
          @transfer_qty_erp float = 0,
          @edit_at TDATETIME = GETDATE(),
          @return_value int
 Declare @edit_comment nvarchar(100)=NULL
  -- 2 IF start -logic of silo is presnt 
  IF (@ent_name_su IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN
    SELECT
      @ent_id = E.ent_id
    FROM ent E WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE E.ent_name = @ent_name_su


    --get silo type (source/destination)
    SELECT
      @siloType = LOWER(EISL.type)
    FROM ofi_ent_item_storage_link EISL WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE EISL.storage_ent_id = @ent_id

    -- 4 IF start- if silo is of type destination 
    IF (@siloType = 'destination')
    BEGIN
      -- 5 IF start-checking if Record is present in item prod for that silo(Production happened in that silo\ent or not)
      IF EXISTS (SELECT
          1
        FROM item_prod IP WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE IP.to_ent_id = @ent_id)
      BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @su_attr
          SELECT
            A.attr_id,
            A.attr_desc,
            EA.attr_value
          FROM ent_attr EA WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN attr A WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON A.attr_id = EA.attr_id
          WHERE EA.ent_id = @ent_id
          AND A.attr_desc IN ('LockForInput', 'BlockForQuality', 'default_grade', 'unique_item_id', 'auto_reclassify')

        -- get all attribute values into variables
        --check lock for input       
        SELECT
          @lock_for_input = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'LockForInput'


        -- get blockforQuality value        
        SELECT
          @blk_for_quality_id = SA.attr_id,
          @blk_for_quality = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'


        -- get default grade value         
        SELECT
          @def_grd_attr_value = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'default_grade'


        -- get unique item value         
        SELECT
          @unq_item_attr_value = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'unique_item_id'


        -- get auto_reclassify value         
        SELECT
          @auto_reclass_attr_value = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify'


        -- get data from item_prod 
        SELECT TOP 1
          @prod_grade = ISNULL(IP.grade_cd, 0),
          @prod_qty = ISNULL(IP.qty_prod, 0)
        FROM item_prod IP WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE IP.to_ent_id = @ent_id
        AND IP.item_id = @item_id
        ORDER BY IP.created_at_utc DESC

        SELECT
          @def_grd_code = IG.item_grade_cd
        FROM item_grade IG WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE IG.item_grade_desc = @def_grd_attr_value

        -- 6 IF Start- check type _OM
        IF (@def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @auto_reclass_attr_value = 'false')
        BEGIN
          -- 7 IF start
          IF ((@def_grd_code <> @prod_grade)
            OR (@unq_item_attr_value <> @item_id)
            OR @blk_for_quality = 1)
          BEGIN
            SET @is_silo_block = 'true'
          END

        END--6 IF end-  check type _OM

        -- 8 IF Start- check type _OMAR
        ELSE
        IF (@def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @auto_reclass_attr_value = 'true')
        BEGIN
          -- 9 IF start
          IF (((@def_grd_code <> @prod_grade)
            OR (@unq_item_attr_value <> @item_id))
            AND @blk_for_quality <> 1)
          BEGIN
            -- do reclassification 
            SELECT TOP 1
              @row_id = IV.row_id,
              @reclass_qty = IV.qty_left,
              @transfer_qty_erp = IV.qty_left_erp
            FROM item_inv IV WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE IV.item_id = @item_id
            AND IV.ent_id = @ent_id
            ORDER BY IV.date_in_utc DESC

            EXEC @return_value_reclass = [dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_item_inv_move] @from_row_id = @row_id,
                                                                        @from_last_edit_at = @edit_at,
                                                                        @from_ent_id = @ent_id,
                                                                        @transfer_qty = @reclass_qty,
                                                                        @in_to_ent_id = @ent_id,
                                                                        @in_to_item_id = @unq_item_attr_value,
                                                                        @in_to_grade_cd = @def_grd_code,
                                                                        @transfer_option = 2,
                                                                        @transfer_comments = 'RECLASS',
                                                                        @log_transfer = 1,
                                                                        @item_id = @unq_item_attr_value

          END

        END--8 IF end-  check type _OMAR

        --10 IF start
        IF (@is_silo_block = 'true')
        BEGIN
          SET @error_code = 'Error: '

          IF (@def_grd_attr_value IS NULL)
          BEGIN
            SET @error_code = @error_code
            + dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString('300001',NULL,10)
          END

          IF (@unq_item_attr_value IS NULL)
          BEGIN
            SET @error_code = @error_code + dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString('300002',NULL,10)
          END

          IF (@item_id != @unq_item_attr_value)
          BEGIN
            SET @error_code = @error_code
            + dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString('300003',NULL,10)
          END

          IF EXISTS (SELECT
              1
            FROM @su_attr SA
            WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
            AND SA.attr_value = 1)
          BEGIN
		  select @edit_comment= dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString('300004',NULL,10);
		 
		  select @edit_at=ea.last_edit_at from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
		  where ea.attr_id=@blk_for_quality_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id

		  EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_Attr] @ent_id,@blk_for_quality_id,1,@error_code,@edit_comment,@edit_at
          
          END
          ELSE
          BEGIN
            EXEC @return_value = [dbo].[Sp_i_ent_attr] @ent_id = @ent_id,
                                                       @attr_id = @blk_for_quality_id,
                                                       @attr_value = 1,
                                                       @notes = @error_code,
                                                       @last_edit_comment = @edit_comment,
                                                       @last_edit_at = @edit_at OUTPUT
          END

        END

      END-- 5 IF end
    END-- 4 IF end



    -- set code for reset storage exec value 
    IF ((@unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
      OR @def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL)
      AND @siloType = 'destination')
    BEGIN
      UPDATE storage_exec
      SET allow_multiple_items = ISNULL(spare_int3, 0),
          allow_multiple_lots = ISNULL(spare_int4, 0)
      WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
    END
  END	--2 IF end- silo present

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Oper]
(
	@process_id			NVARCHAR(40) ,
	@oper_id			NVARCHAR(40) ,
	@oper_desc			NVARCHAR(80) ,
	@def_reject_rate	FLOAT,
	@first_oper			BIT,
	@final_oper			BIT,
	@display_seq		INT,
	@check_inv			BIT,
	@sched_to_ent_id	INT,
	@oper_type			NVARCHAR(80) ,
	@oper_cost			FLOAT,
	@deviation_above	FLOAT,
	@deviation_below	FLOAT,
	@assoc_file			NVARCHAR(254) ,
	@rework_cd			NVARCHAR(40), -- Added 07/26/2007 AML
	@notes				NOTES,
	@spare1				NVARCHAR(80),
	@spare2				NVARCHAR(80),
	@spare3				NVARCHAR(80),
	@spare4				NVARCHAR(80),
	@last_edit_comment	nvarchar(254) ,
	@mod_id				VARCHAR(30) OUT
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - SP_I_OPER
-- Description	  - Insert into operation table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  - 04/26/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By		Ver.		Changes
-- 05/16/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.0.0.1		Check for record in bom item oper link for bom position 0 for each of the parent items
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu			1.5.0.0		Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 12/12/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.5.0.1		Avoiding BOM_POS = 0 duplicates
-- 05/15/2003	Sheetal Jain	1.6.0.0		(HD# 457) BOM item oper link default start pct set to the value in system attribute 203
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1.6.0.1		Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 09/28/2004	Raghu			2.1.1		HD# 4984, Inserting an Oper does not create bom_item_oper_link record due to parameter
--											mismatch while calling sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link also included SET NOCOUNT ON to raise
--											any errors during this transaction
-- 09/19/2005	Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 12/28/2005	Raghu			3.1.7		datatype of def_lot_no is changed from int to string
-- 01/15/2007	KRF				3.2.1		HD# 8314, part of DB changes - copy def_sublot_no
-- 01/18/2007	KRF				3.2.1		HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 02/08/2007	Raghu			3.2.0		HD# 8314, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/13/2007	Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/16/2007	Raghu           3.3.1		HD# 10048, Add rework_cd before notes.
-- 10/24/2007	AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		    6.1	        UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
-- 10/25/2018	RWB			    6.1         UserStory:1084807 - added a check for a null assoc_file and only added the file type to the file_type table if the assoc_file is not null
-- 02/04/2020   Jim O'Hearn     6.2.0       Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
	 @V_Item					STRING40
	,@V_Ver_Id					STRING40
	,@V_Qty_Per_Parent_Item 	TFLOAT
	,@V_Count               	INT32
	,@V_Status					CHAR(1)
	,@V_Reqd_Start_Pct			TFLOAT_NULL
	,@last_edit_by				STRING40
	,@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
	,@def_reas_cd				INT32
	,@def_storage_ent_id		INT32
	,@def_reject_ent_id			INT32
	,@update_inv				LOGICAL
	,@backflush					LOGICAL
	,@def_lot_no				STRING80
	,@def_sublot_no				STRING80 -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	,@must_consume_from_inv		LOGICAL
	,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc	LOGICAL
	,@may_create_new_lots		LOGICAL
	,@must_consume_from_wip		LOGICAL
	,@must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL
	,@constant_qty				LOGICAL
	,@ftle		DATETIME
	,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(254)

SET NOCOUNT ON

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

BEGIN
	IF @first_oper IS NULL  SET @first_oper = 0
	IF @final_oper IS NULL  SET @final_oper = 0
	IF @check_inv IS NULL  SET @check_inv = 0

	IF @deviation_above IS NULL SELECT @deviation_above = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 103
	IF @deviation_below IS NULL SELECT @deviation_below = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 104

	SET @first_oper = 1
	SET @final_oper = 1

	IF @assoc_file IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		SET @assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(@assoc_file)
		EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
			, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
			, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
	END

	INSERT INTO oper (process_id, oper_id, oper_desc, def_reject_rate, first_oper, final_oper, display_seq, check_inv,
		sched_to_ent_id, oper_type, oper_cost, deviation_above, deviation_below, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, rework_cd /* Added 07/27/2006 AML */,
		notes, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES (@process_id, @oper_id, @oper_desc, @def_reject_rate, @first_oper, @final_oper, @display_seq, @check_inv,
		@sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type, @oper_cost, @deviation_above, @deviation_below, @assoc_file, @assoc_file_type, @rework_cd /* Added 07/27/2006 AML */,
		@notes, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

  --Get all the items in bom position 0 using this process
  -- Added "b.def_sublot_no," to statement below 1/15/07 KRF
  DECLARE cur_item CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT i.item_id, b.ver_id, b.qty_per_parent_item, b.update_inv, b.backflush,
	b.def_reas_cd, b.def_lot_no, b.def_sublot_no, b.def_storage_ent_id, b.def_reject_ent_id, b.must_consume_from_inv,
	b.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, b.may_create_new_lots, b.must_consume_from_wip, b.must_consume_before_prod,
	b.constant_qty
    FROM item_process_link i WITH (NOLOCK), bom_item b WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE i.item_id = b.item_id AND i.process_id = @process_id AND b.bom_pos = 0
  OPEN cur_item
  -- Added "@def_sublot_no," to statement below 1/15/07 KRF
  FETCH cur_item INTO @V_Item, @V_Ver_Id, @V_Qty_Per_Parent_Item, @update_inv, @backflush, @def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no,
	@def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id, @must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
	@may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip, @must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty

  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --Check if record already exists, if so update else insert
    SELECT @V_Count=COUNT(*) FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item AND ver_id = @V_Ver_Id AND bom_pos = 0
      AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    SELECT @V_Reqd_Start_Pct = CAST(attr_value AS FLOAT)/100 FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 203  --Default percent to start<2173>
    IF @V_Count = 0
    BEGIN
      --Check for duplicate BOM_POS=0
      SET @V_Status = 'Y'
      EXEC sp_BOM_Item_Oper_Link_Chk @V_Item, @oper_id, @process_id, @V_Status = @V_Status OUTPUT
      IF @V_Status = 'Y'
        --Insert into bom item oper link
	-- Added "@def_sublot_no," to following statement
        EXEC sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link @V_Item, @V_Ver_Id, 0, @process_id, @oper_id, @V_Qty_Per_Parent_Item, @V_Reqd_Start_Pct,
			@def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id, @update_inv, @backflush,
			@must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc, @may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip,
			@must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty, NULL, @mod_id OUT
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      --Update the start percent to zero
      UPDATE bom_item_oper_link SET reqd_start_pct = @V_Reqd_Start_Pct WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item AND ver_id = @V_Ver_Id AND bom_pos = 0
        AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    END
    FETCH cur_item INTO @V_Item, @V_Ver_Id, @V_Qty_Per_Parent_Item, @update_inv, @backflush, @def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no,
	@def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id, @must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
	@may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip, @must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty
  END
  CLOSE cur_item
  DEALLOCATE cur_item

  -- Return timestamp
  --  SET @mod_id = (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) FROM oper
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
                   WHERE (process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id)
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp -
-- Description:	   To compare MES BOM with SAP
--
-- Usage:			
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			DS				2023-04-14						To compare MES BOM with SAP BOM at the time of set-recipe @ set UP UI

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	-- @json nvarchar(MAX)=null
		 @wo_id nvarchar(80)
		,@oper_id nvarchar(80)
		,@seq_no int
		,@ent_id int
		,@parent_item_id nvarchar(80)
		,@recipe_name nvarchar(80)
	 AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Counter INT, @iterate int=1
	declare @cte_temp table
	(
				item_id nvarchar(50)
	)

	declare @item_id nvarchar(50),
	@missingBOM nvarchar(100),
	@is_wip_oper nvarchar(50),
	@wip_item  nvarchar(50),
	@sap_target_item nvarchar(50),
	@wip_item_prefix nvarchar(40) = '',
	@wip_target_item nvarchar(40) = '',
	@target_ent_id int,
	--@recipe_name nvarchar(80),
	@bom_item_cnt nvarchar(50),
	@recipe_version int,
	@ritem_id nvarchar(40),
	@rname nvarchar(100),
	@rver nvarchar(40),
	@isRecipeNull int=0
	,@lastWo_id nvarchar(80)
	,@lastOper_id nvarchar(80)
	,@lastseqNo int

	

	declare @sap_bom table
	(   
		row_id int identity(1,1),
		item_id nvarchar(50)
	)
	declare @row_min int 
	declare @row_max int 
	declare @sap_bom_item nvarchar(40)

	declare @mes_bom table
	(
		item_id nvarchar(50)
	)
	declare @result_temp table
	(
		wo_id nvarchar(20),
		oper_id nvarchar(30),
		seq_no int,
		result_code int,
		failed_msg nvarchar(MAX),
		bom_item nvarchar(MAX)
	)
	
	set @isRecipeNull=0
	set @missingBOM = null
	delete @sap_bom
	delete @mes_bom
	--this if condition will work only for the process for the wo only where set recipe step is applicable


		BEGIN
						if ((select spare1 from wo with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id) is not null) -- checking for the SAP order
						BEGIN
								-- fetching the sap bom
												insert into @sap_bom
												select item_id from ofi_wo_item_ext with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos <>0

								
								-- fetching the MES bom 
										
										if(@recipe_name<>'Last used recipe')
											BEGIN
												
												if exists( select 1  from ofi_master_recipe omr with(nolock) where  recipe_name = @recipe_name)
												begin

													select  distinct @ritem_id=omr.item_id,@rname=recipe_name, @rver=version 
													from ofi_master_recipe omr with(nolock) 
													where  
													--omr.item_id = @parent_item_id and omr.ent_id = @ent_id
													 recipe_name = @recipe_name
																							
												-- Fetching the bom components from master recipe
													insert into @mes_bom 
													select bi.item_id from bom_item bi with(nolock)
													inner join item with(nolock) on item.item_id =bi.item_id
													inner join item_class ic  with(nolock) on item.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id 
													and ic.item_class_id not in ('INTERMEDIATE', 'WIP')
													where bi.bom_pos<>0 and bi.parent_item_id=@ritem_id and bi.ver_id=@rver
													and bi.spare2 = 'Active'
												end
												else
												begin
														set @isRecipeNull = 1
														insert into @result_temp
														values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,2,'@@RecipeDoesnotExists@@',@missingBOM)
												end

											END
											else -- in case of last used recipe
												BEGIN

													select top 1 @lastWo_id = wo_id,@lastOper_id = oper_id, @lastseqNo = seq_no from job with(nolock) where run_ent_id = @ent_id and item_id = @parent_item_id and state_cd = 4 order by act_finish_time_utc desc 
													insert into @mes_bom
													select item_id from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @lastWo_id and oper_id = @lastOper_id and seq_no =@lastseqNo and bom_pos<>0

												END 

											-- comparison starts
								if(@isRecipeNull=0)
								BEGIN
										
										;with cte as(
											select item_id from @mes_bom
											except
											select item_id from @sap_bom)
											
											insert into @cte_temp
											select item_id from cte		
											
											select @bom_item_cnt=count(1) from @cte_temp
						
					
								SELECT @missingBOM=STUFF((SELECT ', ' + i.item_desc +'('+o.item_id+')'
								  FROM @cte_temp o
								  inner join item i with(nolock) on i.item_id=o.item_id
								  FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 2, '') 
								  
								  delete @cte_temp

								 
								 -- ALLOWED TO SHOW ERROR AND NOT WARNING if the set recipe is applicaple and prefereed recipe is not found against the item and entity then the job should not get released //comment from AJAY	

										if (@bom_item_cnt>0 )
											BEGIN 
												insert into @result_temp
												--values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,2,'@@ExtraBOM@@',@missingBOM)
												values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,2,'ExtraBOM',@missingBOM)
											END
											else 
											BEGIN 
												insert into @result_temp
												--values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,1,'@@success@@',null)
												values(@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,1,'success',null)
											END
									END--@isRecipeNull=1
									
					
						END

	END

select * from @result_temp


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_RefreshShiftSched]
(@in_ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_start_time			TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_days_ahead			INT32 = 7
,@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
,@shift_sched_ent		INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
,@shift_start_time		TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
,@shift_end_time		TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_RefreshShiftSched
-- Description		- Refreshes the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 10/13/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	 @start_time		TDATETIME
	,@days_ahead		INT32
	,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32
	,@current_time		TDATETIME
	,@end_time		TDATETIME
	,@start_day		TDATETIME
	,@ent_id		INT32
	,@parent_ent_id		INT32
	,@can_sched_shifts	LOGICAL

BEGIN
	--Apply defaults first
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,@days_ahead = COALESCE(@in_days_ahead, 7)

	--Get the current time based on the bias value.
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

	--Adjust the days ahead. If the supplied days ahead is older than the current day, then default to the current day.
	--If the supplied days ahead is more than a year, then default to 365 days.
	IF (@days_ahead < 1) SET @days_ahead = 1
	ELSE IF (@days_ahead > 365) SET @days_ahead = 365

	--Adjust times based on the supplied bias value
	SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @in_start_time)

	--If the supplied time is NULL, then use the current time from the database.
	--Also, set the start time to the previous day, because the shifts may start from the previous day.
	SET @start_time = DATEADD(d, -1, COALESCE(@start_time, @current_time))

	--Adjust the end time accordingly.
	SET @end_time = DATEADD(dd, @days_ahead + 1, @start_time)

	--Verify whether the shift schedules has to be refreshed for the supplied entity.
	--If an entity is not supplied, then refresh the schedules for all the entity.
	IF (@in_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Assume the supplied entity can schedule shifts.
		SET @ent_id = @in_ent_id

		--Verify whether the supplied entity can schedule shifts.
		--If not, find the preferred ancestor entity for the suppplied entity that can schedule shifts.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_sched_shifts = 1) BEGIN
			--The supplied entity can schedule shifts.
			--Refresh the shifts for the supplied entity.
			EXEC sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftsToGo @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_start_date_time=@start_time, @in_end_date_time=@end_time
				, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--Default the can sched shifts to 0.
			SET @can_sched_shifts = 0

			--The supplied entity cannot schedule shifts.
			--Find the FIRST preferred ancestor entity that can schedule shifts.
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				--Find the immediate ancestor entity that can schedule a shift.
				SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id, @can_sched_shifts = can_sched_shifts FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE parent_ent_id = @ent_id

				--Exit if the ancestor entity can schedule a shift or there are no more ancestor entities
				IF (@can_sched_shifts = 1 OR @parent_ent_id IS NULL) BREAK

				--Set the parent entity as the current entity.
				SET @ent_id = @parent_ent_id
			END

			--Verify whether the entity (the entity that is found last) can schedule shifts
			--Refresh shifts for this entity
			IF (@can_sched_shifts = 1)
				EXEC sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftsToGo @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_start_date_time=@start_time, @in_end_date_time=@end_time
					, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Verify and refresh the shift schedules for all the entity that can schedule shifts.
		DECLARE shift_sched_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE can_sched_shifts = 1

		OPEN shift_sched_csr
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM shift_sched_csr INTO @ent_id

			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			EXEC sp_U_Ent_CreateShiftsToGo @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_start_date_time=@start_time, @in_end_date_time=@end_time
				, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
		CLOSE shift_sched_csr
		DEALLOCATE shift_sched_csr

		SET @ent_id = NULL
	END

	SELECT @shift_sched_ent = @ent_id, @shift_start_time = @start_time, @shift_end_time = @end_time
END

CREATE  Trigger [tg_process_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[process]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_process_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on process table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE process_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
			SELECT b.process_id
			FROM deleted b

		OPEN process_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM process_cursor INTO @process_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Cannot delete a process that is currently certified.{4739}', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		CLOSE process_cursor
		DEALLOCATE process_cursor
	END
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_lm_label
-- Description:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
--
-- Usage:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-07			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-02-20          Deleted the synonym logic.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label_old] 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
	,@ent_id INT=NULL
	,@fault_code INT=NULL
	,@lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)=NULL OUTPUT
	
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	-- declare temp table to get show kosher value 
	DECLARE @layoutTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,value NVARCHAR(50));
	DECLARE @paramTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,paramName NVARCHAR(255),paramValue nvarchar(255),tableName nvarchar(255) );
		-- declare variables used in MES mapping 
	DECLARE  @layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100)	=	NULL
			,@layout_name NVARCHAR(50)			=	NULL
			,@layout_id	NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@showkosher NVARCHAR(10) = 0
			,@hidekosher NVARCHAR(10) = 1
			,@splitCount INT = 0
			,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@maxRowCnt INT
			,@label_header NVARCHAR(200)
			,@print_qty INT
			,@process_attr NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@overlayDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL
			,@TypeOfLblContent INT=2
			,@swHasCustomerRichText INT=0
			,@jobGrpId INT=5 -- 5 job_attr group 
			,@hu NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
			,@swShowLB INT = 0
			,@itemUOM NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@swIsReject BIT=0
			,@swIsBigBag BIT=0
			,@expiry_date_null NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			
			,@expiry_date NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@expireItemId NVARCHAR(100)		=	NULL
			,@expireLot NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@trigger_type  NVARCHAR(100)='inline'
			,@trigger_from NVARCHAR(100)='dcs_trigger'
			,@bag_weight_qty FLOAT
			,@bigBagCount INT = 0
			,@item_id NVARCHAR(100);


		

		-- get expiry date
		select @expireLot=owe.lot_no
			 ,@expireItemId=owe.item_id
			 ,@item_id=owe.item_id
		from ofi_wo_ext owe with(nolock)
		where owe.wo_id=@wo_id

		--fetch default value from mapping for expiry , and if that is null set getdate

		select @expiry_date_null=default_value from ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping ollam
		where ollam.as_value = 'BestBeforeDateFormatted' and ollam.layout_name=@layout_name


		select @expiry_date = FORMAT(ISNULL(ii.expiry_date,ISNULL(@expiry_date_null,getdate())), 'dd-MM-yyyy')
		from item_inv ii with(nolock)
		where ii.lot_no = @expireLot and ii.item_id=@expireItemId and ii.wo_id=@wo_id and ii.oper_id=@oper_id and ii.seq_no=@seq_no

		select @bigBagCount=count(*) from item_attr ia with(nolock)
		where ia.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id
							FROM attr a with(nolock)
							where a.attr_desc = 'IsBigBag')
		AND ia.item_id=@item_id

		IF(@bigBagCount > 0)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swIsBigBag=1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swIsBigBag=0
		END


		-- get bag weigh
		if(@swIsBigBag = '0')
		BEGIN
		select @bag_weight_qty=ia.attr_value 
		from item_attr ia with(nolock)
		where ia.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
							 FROM attr a with(nolock)
							 where a.attr_desc like 'BagWeight')
		AND ia.item_id=@item_id
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		IF (@swIsReject = 0)
		BEGIN
		select @bag_weight_qty=j.qty_prod
		FROM job j with(nolock)
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id AND j.oper_id=@oper_id AND j.seq_no=@seq_no
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		select @bag_weight_qty=j.qty_rejected
		FROM job j with(nolock)
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id AND j.oper_id=@oper_id AND j.seq_no=@seq_no
		END
		END
		
		-- set kosher value
		IF(@showkosher = '1')
	BEGIN
		SET @hidekosher= '0'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @hidekosher= '1'
	END

		--get item UOM
		select @itemUOM=LOWER(u.description)
		from uom u with(nolock)
		inner join item i on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
		inner join ofi_wo_ext owe on owe.item_id=i.item_id and owe.wo_id=@wo_id

		if(@itemUOM = 'kg')
		begin
		select @swShowLB=0
		end
		else
		begin
			if(@itemUOM = 'lb')
			begin
			select @swShowLB=1
			end
			else
			begin
			select @swShowLB=0
			end			
		end
		--select @swShowLB as swShowLB


		SELECT @TypeOfLblContent= CAST(ja.attr_value AS INT )
		FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
							FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
							WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId)
		AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no

		-- using attr_id find values 
		SELECT @overlayDetails = ja.attr_value 
		FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
							FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
							WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId)
		AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no

			   		 		



		IF(@overlayDetails IS NOT NULL OR @overlayDetails !='')
		BEGIN
		
		IF(@TypeOfLblContent = 2)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 1;
		END
		ELSE IF(@TypeOfLblContent = 1)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 2;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 0;
		END
		
		END


	


	IF(@fault_code=0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='NORMAL_BAG';
	END 
	ELSE IF(@fault_code = -1)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='METAL';
	END
	ELSE IF(@fault_code = -2 )
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='METAL_TEST';
	END
	ELSE IF(@fault_code = -3)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='FLUSH';
	END
	ELSE IF(@fault_code = -4)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='WEIGHT_HIGH';
	END
	ELSE IF(@fault_code = -5)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='WEIGHT_LOW';
	END
	ELSE IF(@fault_code = -6)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @label_header='NO_DATA';
	END

	IF(@fault_code <> 0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @swIsReject=1

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	SELECT @swIsReject=0
	END
	
	



	SELECT @maxRowCnt=max(row_id) from item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK) where ip.wo_id =@wo_id and ip.oper_id=@oper_id and ip.seq_no=@seq_no;

	-- get @hu

--===========================================================================================
-- Name			:	sp_SA_ofi_Get_All_StorageInfo
-- Description	:   Returns product type, product grade, classification and sync status
--					for every storage unit with inventory, in a single set-based query
--					(no cursors, no calls to other SPs). No input parameters.
--					- Storage units = entities with the UpdateSUInfoToAUT attribute configured.
--					- Inventory is read directly from item_inv.
--					- Maximum 2 different items per storage unit (lowest item_id first).
--					- Filtering (sync_status, silos configured) is done in the Galaxy object.
--
-- Usage:  EXEC sp_SA_ofi_Get_All_StorageInfo
--
-- Output (one row per storage unit WITH inventory):
--	ent_name | ent_id | product_type | product_grade | classification | sync_status
--	- product_type   : descriptions of the (max 2) items, ';' separated, ordered by item_id.
--	- product_grade  : distinct grades of those items, ';' separated.
--	- classification : distinct Classification values of those items, ';' separated ('' if none).
--
-- *** IMPORTANT ***
--	Storage units WITHOUT inventory are NOT returned. The Galaxy object must clear the tags
--	of any configured silo that is not present in the result set.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change description
-- 0.01.00  AML, XPM		2026-09-23				Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Get_All_StorageInfo]
	@dummy INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	DECLARE @sync_attr_id  INT = (SELECT attr_id FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK)
								  WHERE attr_desc = 'UpdateSUInfoToAUT' AND attr_grp = 2);
	DECLARE @class_attr_id INT = (SELECT attr_id FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK)
								  WHERE attr_desc = 'Classification' AND attr_grp = 1);

	DECLARE @Silos TABLE (
		ent_id      INT PRIMARY KEY,
		ent_name    NVARCHAR(80),
		sync_status NVARCHAR(1700)
	);

	INSERT INTO @Silos (ent_id, ent_name, sync_status)
	SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name, ea.attr_value
	FROM dbo.ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN dbo.ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	WHERE ea.attr_id = @sync_attr_id;

	DECLARE @Inv TABLE (
		ent_id          INT,
		item_id         NVARCHAR(40),
		item_desc       NVARCHAR(100),
		item_grade_desc NVARCHAR(100)
	);

	INSERT INTO @Inv (ent_id, item_id, item_desc, item_grade_desc)
	SELECT r.ent_id, r.item_id, it.item_desc, g.item_grade_desc
	FROM (
		SELECT inv.ent_id, inv.item_id, inv.grade_cd,
			   DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.ent_id ORDER BY inv.item_id) AS item_rank
		FROM (
			SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id, ii.item_id, ii.grade_cd
			FROM dbo.item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN @Silos s ON s.ent_id = ii.ent_id
		) inv
	) r
	LEFT JOIN dbo.item       it WITH (NOLOCK) ON it.item_id      = r.item_id
	LEFT JOIN dbo.item_grade g  WITH (NOLOCK) ON g.item_grade_cd = r.grade_cd
	WHERE r.item_rank <= 2;


	SELECT ISNULL(s.ent_name, '') AS ent_name,
			s.ent_id,
			ISNULL(pt.product_type, '') AS product_type,
			ISNULL(pg.product_grade, '') AS product_grade,
			ISNULL(cl.classification, '') AS classification,
			ISNULL(TRY_CAST(s.sync_status AS INT), 0) AS sync_status
	FROM @Silos s
	JOIN (
		SELECT d.ent_id,
			   STRING_AGG(d.item_desc, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.item_id) AS product_type
		FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, item_id, item_desc FROM @Inv) d
		GROUP BY d.ent_id
	) pt ON pt.ent_id = s.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT d.ent_id,
			   STRING_AGG(d.item_grade_desc, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.item_grade_desc) AS product_grade
		FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, item_grade_desc FROM @Inv) d
		GROUP BY d.ent_id
	) pg ON pg.ent_id = s.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT d.ent_id,
			   STRING_AGG(d.attr_value, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.attr_value) AS classification
		FROM (
			SELECT DISTINCT inv.ent_id, ia.attr_value
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, item_id FROM @Inv) inv
			JOIN dbo.item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON ia.item_id = inv.item_id
			   AND ia.attr_id = @class_attr_id
			JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON i.item_id = ia.item_id
			   AND i.obsolete = 0          
			WHERE ISNULL(ia.attr_value, '') <> ''
		) d
		GROUP BY d.ent_id
	) cl ON cl.ent_id = s.ent_id
	ORDER BY s.ent_name;
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_I_EI_PRO_Validate_Data
-- Description: Inserts the validation status
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-12      Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_EI_PRO_Validate_Data] (@module     NVARCHAR(40),
                                                   @plant_code NVARCHAR(40),
                                                   @spare1     NVARCHAR(200),
                                                   @spare2     NVARCHAR(200),
                                                   @spare3     NVARCHAR(200),
                                                   @spare4     NVARCHAR(200),
                                                   @spare5     NVARCHAR(200),
                                                   @spare6     NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @validate_result     INT=1,
              @validation_comments NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,
              @process_id          NVARCHAR(40),
              @from_uom_id         INT,
              @to_uom_id           INT,
              @error_msg           NVARCHAR(500)

      IF @spare6 = 'ACTIVE'
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                      FROM   ofi_wo_ext WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  lot_no IS NULL
                             AND wo_id = @spare1)
              BEGIN
                  SET @validate_result=0
                  SET @validation_comments='Lot number missing'
              END

            IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                      FROM   ofi_wo_item_ext WITH (nolock)
                      WHERE  wo_id = @spare1
                             AND ( item_id IS NULL
                                    OR parent_item_id IS NULL
                                    OR qty IS NULL
                                    OR ( co_product = 1
                                         AND def_lot_no IS NULL ) ))
              BEGIN
                  SET @validate_result=0
                  SET @validation_comments='BOM Item data is not correct'
              END

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                          FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
                                 INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (nolock)
                                         ON ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id
                                            AND ic.produced = 1
                          WHERE  i.item_id = @spare5)
              BEGIN
                  SET @validate_result=0
                  SET @validation_comments='The end product does not exist in MES database or it does not belong to the produced item_class'
			END

			SELECT @process_id = dbo.Fn_s_ofi_processbyprodsupervisor(@spare4)

			IF @process_id IS NULL
			  BEGIN
				  SET @validate_result=0
				  SET @validation_comments= 'Process not found'
			  END

			SELECT @to_uom_id = u.uom_id
			FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
				   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
						   ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
							  AND i.item_id = @spare5

			SELECT @from_uom_id = u.uom_id
			FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock)
				   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
						   ON u.description = owe.uom_desc
							  AND owe.wo_id = @spare1

			IF (@from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
						  FROM   uom_conv WITH (nolock)
						  WHERE  from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
								 AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
								 AND item_id = @spare5)
			  BEGIN
				  SET @validate_result=0
				  SET @validation_comments='Item UOM and the PRO UOM are different and no UOM conversion exist in MES'
			END

			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
						  FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock)
								 INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
										 ON u.description = owe.uom_desc
											AND owe.wo_id = @spare1)
			  BEGIN
				  SET @validate_result=0
				  SET @validation_comments='UOM as part of PRO message does not exist in MES'
			  END

			UPDATE ofi_wo_ext
			SET    status = @validate_result,
				   comments = @validation_comments
			WHERE  wo_id = @spare1
END
END

BEGIN

	SET @SQL = ''
	SET @temp_SQL = ''
	SET @separator = '$$'

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'ICF:' AND CHARINDEX('ICF:', @temp_filter, 0) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('ICF:', @temp_filter, 0) <= 3 BEGIN

			ELSE

			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @ic_produced'
		END
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'CONSUMED=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') AND (UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''T CARE'  AND UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''''T CARE') BEGIN
			IF (UPPER(@value) = 'TRUE' OR @value = '1') SET @ic_consumed = 1 ELSE SET @ic_consumed = 0
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND ic.consumed'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'ic.consumed'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @ic_consumed'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'OBSOLETE=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') AND (UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''T CARE'  AND UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''''T CARE') BEGIN

			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @ic_obsolete'
		END
		IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ')'

	END

	--		START of extracting Item Filters and frame the query---------------------------------------------
	IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'IF:' AND CHARINDEX('IF:', @temp_filter, 0) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('IF:', @temp_filter, 0) <= 3 BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ''

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_ID=', @separator, @item_id OUTPUT
		IF (@item_id <> '') BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.item_id)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(i.item_id)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ITEM_DESC=', @separator, @item_desc OUTPUT
		IF (@item_desc <> '') BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.item_desc)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(i.item_desc)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @item_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @item_desc) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @item_desc'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @item_desc'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'UNITS=', @separator, @uom_desc OUTPUT
		IF (@uom_desc <> '')  BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(uom.description)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(uom.description)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @uom_desc) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @uom_desc) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @uom_desc'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @uom_desc'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'UOM_ID=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @uom_id = CAST(@value AS INT)
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND i.uom_id'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'i.uom_id'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @uom_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'TEMPLATE=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') AND (UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''T CARE'  AND UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''''T CARE') BEGIN
			IF (UPPER(@value) = 'TRUE' OR @value = '1')  SET @template = 1 ELSE SET @template = 0
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND i.template'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'i.template'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @template'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'LIFETIME=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN

			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND i.lifetime'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'i.lifetime'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @lifetime'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'UNIT_COST=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @unit_cost = CAST(@value AS FLOAT)
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND i.unit_cost'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'i.unit_cost'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @unit_cost'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'OBSOLETE=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') AND (UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''T CARE'  AND UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''''T CARE') BEGIN
			IF (UPPER(@value) = 'TRUE' OR @value = '1')  SET @i_obsolete = 1 ELSE SET @i_obsolete = 0
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND i.obsolete'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'i.obsolete'

		END
