		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @num_decimals = CAST(@value AS INT)
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND i.num_decimals'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'i.num_decimals'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @num_decimals'

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'SPARE1=', @separator, @spare1 OUTPUT

			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.spare1)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(i.spare1)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @spare1) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @spare1) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @spare1'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @spare1'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'SPARE2=', @separator, @spare2 OUTPUT
		IF (@spare2 <> '') BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.spare2)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(i.spare2)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @spare2) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @spare2) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @spare2'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @spare2'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'SPARE3=', @separator, @spare3 OUTPUT
		IF (@spare3 <> '') BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.spare3)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(i.spare3)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @spare3) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @spare3) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @spare3'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @spare3'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'SPARE4=', @separator, @spare4 OUTPUT
		IF (@spare4 <> '') BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(i.spare4)'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = ' AND (' + 'UPPER(i.spare4)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @spare4) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @spare4) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @spare4'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @spare4'
		END
		IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ')'	END
--		End of extracting Item Filters

	IF @filter_id = 'PF:' AND CHARINDEX('PF:', @temp_filter, 0) > 0  AND CHARINDEX('PF:', @temp_filter, 0) <= 3 BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ''
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'PROCESS_ID=', @separator, @process_id OUTPUT
		IF (@process_id <> '') BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(p.process_id)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @process_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @process_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @process_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @process_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'OPER_ID=', @separator, @oper_id OUTPUT
		IF (@oper_id <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(op.oper_id)'

				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @oper_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @oper_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'ENTITY=', @separator, @ent_id OUTPUT
		IF (@ent_id <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND oel.ent_id'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @ent_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @ent_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @ent_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @ent_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'PROCESS_LEVEL=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @process_level = CAST(@value AS INT)
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND p.process_level'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @process_level'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'PROCESS_STATUS=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @process_status = CAST(@value AS INT)
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND p.process_status'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @process_status'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'CREATOR=', @separator, @creator OUTPUT
		IF (@creator <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(p.creator)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @creator) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @creator) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @creator'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @creator'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'APPROVER=', @separator, @approver OUTPUT
		IF (@approver <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(p.approver)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @approver) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @approver) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @approver'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @approver'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'LASTEDITOR=', @separator, @last_editor OUTPUT
		IF (@last_editor <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(p.last_editor)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @last_editor) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @last_editor) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @last_editor'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @last_editor'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'CHECKEDOUTBY=', @separator, @check_out_by OUTPUT
		IF (@check_out_by <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(p.checked_out_by)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @check_out_by) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @check_out_by) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @check_out_by'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @check_out_by'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'REWORK=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') AND (UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''T CARE'  AND UPPER(@value) <> 'DON''''T CARE') BEGIN
			IF (UPPER(@value) = 'TRUE' OR @value = '1')  SET @rework = 1 ELSE SET @rework = 0
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND p.rework'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @rework'
		END

	END

	IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'WOF:' AND CHARINDEX('WOF:', @temp_filter, 0) > 0  AND CHARINDEX('WOF:', @temp_filter, 0) <= 3 BEGIN

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'WO_ID=', @separator, @wo_id OUTPUT
		IF (@wo_id <> '') BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = ' AND UPPER(wo.wo_id)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @wo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @wo_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @wo_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @wo_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'REQD_QTY=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @reqd_qty = CAST(@value AS FLOAT)
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND wo.REQ_QTY'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @reqd_qty'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'RELEASE_DATE_TIME=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') BEGIN
			SET @release_date_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CAST(@value AS DATETIME))
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL+ ' AND wo.release_time_utc'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '<= @release_date_utc'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'DUE_DATE_TIME=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') BEGIN
			SET @req_finish_time_utc  = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, CAST(@value AS DATETIME))
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL+ ' AND wo.req_finish_time_utc'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '<= @req_finish_time_utc'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'WO_PRIORITY=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @priority = CAST(@value AS INT)
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND wo.wo_priority'
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @priority'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'CUSTOMER=', @separator, @customer OUTPUT
		IF (@customer <> '') BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(wo.cust_info)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @customer) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @customer) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @customer'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @customer'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'MANF_ORDER=', @separator, @mo_id OUTPUT
		IF (@mo_id <> '') BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND UPPER(wo.mo_id)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @mo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @mo_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @mo_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @mo_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'WO_STATE=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '') BEGIN
			IF UPPER(@value) = 'CLOSED' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND j.state_cd NOT IN (1,2,3,5,6)'
			IF UPPER(@value) = 'OPEN' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND j.state_cd NOT IN (7,4)'
		END
	END

	IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'JF:' AND CHARINDEX('JF:', @temp_filter, 0) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('JF:', @temp_filter, 0) <= 3 BEGIN
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'WO_ID=', @separator, @job_wo_id OUTPUT
		IF (@job_wo_id <> '') BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = ' AND UPPER(j.wo_id)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @job_wo_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @job_wo_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @job_wo_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @job_wo_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'OPER_ID=', @separator, @job_oper_id OUTPUT

		IF (@value = '1')  BEGIN

		IF (@value = '1')  BEGIN

		IF (@value = '1')  BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL = '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd=6'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' OR j.state_cd=6'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @temp_filter, 'CANCELLED=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value = '1')  BEGIN
			IF @temp_SQL = '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND (j.state_cd=7'
			ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' OR j.state_cd=7'
		END
		IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ')'
	END

	IF (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'ICA:') OR (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'IA:') OR (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'PA:')
		OR (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'WA:') OR (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'JA:') OR (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'SOA:')
		OR (UPPER(@filter_id) = 'OA:') BEGIN

		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'ICA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN item_class_attr ica0 ON ica0.item_class_id=ic.item_class_id', @table_alias = 'ica'
		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'IA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN item_attr ia0 ON ia0.item_id=i.item_id', @table_alias = 'ia'
		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'PA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN process_attr pa0 ON pa0.process_id=p.process_id', @table_alias = 'pa'
		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'WA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN wo_attr wa0 ON wa0.wo_id=wo.wo_id', @table_alias = 'wa'
		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'JA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN job_attr ja0 ON ja0.wo_id=j.wo_id AND ja0.oper_id=j.oper_id AND ja0.seq_no=j.seq_no', @table_alias = 'ja'
		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'SOA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN std_oper_attr soa0 ON soa0.oper_id=sop.oper_id', @table_alias = 'soa'
		IF UPPER(@filter_id) = 'OA:' SELECT @table_clause = ' INNER JOIN oper_attr oa0 ON oa0.process_id=p.process_id AND oa0.oper_id=op.oper_id', @table_alias = 'oa'

		SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
		SET @counter = 1
		SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
		WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @table_alias_temp = @table_alias + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @counter)
			SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
			SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
			SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

			IF @value <> '' BEGIN
				SET @counter = @counter + 1
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + REPLACE(@table_clause, @table_alias + '0', @table_alias_temp)
				SET @table_alias_temp = @table_alias_temp + '.'
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND ' + @table_alias_temp + 'attr_id=' +  LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) + ' AND UPPER(' + @table_alias_temp + 'attr_value)'
				SET @value = UPPER(@value)
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @value) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @value) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE N''' + @value + ''''
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '=N''' + @value + ''''
			END
			SET @start = @end + 4
			SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
		END
--		IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ')'
/*
		SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
		SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
		WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
			SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
			SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
			SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')
			IF @value <> '' BEGIN
				IF @temp_SQL = '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND ('
				ELSE SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' OR '
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '(' + @attr_name + 'attr_id=' +  LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) + ' AND UPPER(' + @attr_name + 'attr_value)'
				SET @value = UPPER(@value)
				IF (CHARINDEX('%', @value) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @value) > 0)
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE ''' + @value + ''''
				ELSE
					SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '=''' + @value + ''''
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ')'
			END
			SET @start = @end + 4
			SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
		END
		IF @temp_SQL <> '' SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ')'*/
	END

	SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
	SET @SQL_OUT = @SQL

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_ent_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[ent]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name           - tg_ent_aft_del
-- Description           - Trigger on Ent table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted on this table
-- Author				 - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 04/18/2006
-- Version (last edit)   - 6.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 04/18/2006	Raghu		3.1.14		HD# ?, Verify OEE_EXEC.job_ent_id and .util_ent_id
-- 12/05/2018	Varun		6.1.0		US#1106919: Original delete trigger code restored
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE	@ent_name	STRING80,
		@msg		NVARCHAR(400)

BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM deleted WHERE can_run_jobs = 1 OR can_capture_util = 1) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM deleted d INNER JOIN oee_exec oe ON oe.job_ent_id = d.ent_id) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN deleted d WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.job_ent_id = d.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.ent_id = e.ent_id
			SET @msg = 'This entity cannot be deleted, since the %1 from this entity are currently reported to %2.{4951},performance and quality obtained,' + @ent_name
			RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM deleted d INNER JOIN oee_exec oe ON oe.util_ent_id = d.ent_id) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN deleted d WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.util_ent_id = d.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.ent_id = e.ent_id
			SET @msg = 'This entity cannot be deleted, since the %1 from this entity are currently reported to %2.{4951},utilization measured,' + @ent_name
			RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Bom_Item_Subst]
(
	@parent_item_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ver_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@bom_pos				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@alt_no					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@pref					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@subst_level			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@reqd_grade_cd			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@update_inv				LOGICAL = 0
,	@backflush				LOGICAL = 0
,	@def_reas_cd			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@def_lot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@def_sublot_no			STRING40_NULL = NULL

,	@def_reject_ent_id		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@spare1					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare2					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare3					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare4					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Bom_Item_Subst
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--07/29/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included parent_item_desc, and item_desc columns
--09/19/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--01/20/2006		Raghu			3.1.8	Included ent_name in the select clause
--01/25/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--07/02/2007		AML				3.2.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	bom_item_subst.parent_item_id
       ,	parent_item.item_desc as parent_item_desc
       ,	bom_item_subst.ver_id
       ,	bom_item_subst.bom_pos
       ,	bom_item_subst.alt_no
       ,	bom_item_subst.pref
       ,	bom_item_subst.subst_level
       ,	bom_item_subst.item_id
       ,	item.item_desc
       ,	bom_item_subst.reqd_grade_cd
       ,	bom_item_subst.instruction
       ,	bom_item_subst.qty_per_parent_item
       ,	bom_item_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item
       ,	bom_item_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item
       ,	bom_item_subst.update_inv
       ,	bom_item_subst.backflush
       ,	bom_item_subst.def_reas_cd
       ,	bom_item_subst.def_lot_no
       ,	bom_item_subst.def_sublot_no
       ,	bom_item_subst.def_storage_ent_id
	   ,	storage_ent.ent_name
       ,	bom_item_subst.def_reject_ent_id
       ,	bom_item_subst.scaling_factor
       ,	bom_item_subst.must_consume_from_inv
       ,	bom_item_subst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
       ,	bom_item_subst.may_create_new_lots
       ,	bom_item_subst.must_consume_from_wip
       ,	bom_item_subst.must_consume_before_prod
       ,	bom_item_subst.constant_qty
       ,	bom_item_subst.est_time
       ,	bom_item_subst.spare1
       ,	bom_item_subst.spare2
       ,	bom_item_subst.spare3
       ,	bom_item_subst.spare4
       ,	bom_item_subst.last_edit_comment
       ,	bom_item_subst.last_edit_by
       ,	bom_item_subst.last_edit_at
       ,	item.uom_id uom_id
       ,	item.num_decimals num_decimals
    FROM bom_item_subst bom_item_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item parent_item WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_item.item_id = bom_item_subst.parent_item_id
		INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = bom_item_subst.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent storage_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item_subst.def_storage_ent_id = storage_ent.ent_id
    WHERE (
			(bom_item_subst.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id OR @parent_item_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.alt_no = @alt_no OR @alt_no IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.pref = @pref OR @pref IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.subst_level = @subst_level OR @subst_level IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.update_inv = ABS(@update_inv) OR @update_inv IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.backflush = ABS(@backflush) OR @backflush IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.def_reas_cd = @def_reas_cd OR @def_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.def_lot_no = @def_lot_no OR @def_lot_no IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.def_sublot_no = @def_sublot_no OR @def_sublot_no IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.def_storage_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id OR @def_storage_ent_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.def_reject_ent_id = @def_reject_ent_id OR @def_reject_ent_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(bom_item_subst.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )

END

,@orig_seq_no           INT32_NULL = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_SA_WO_GetWoCreatedForRework
-- Description    - Returns all work orders created for rework from supplied wo
-- Author         - Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created   - 07/24/2009
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By        Version        Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT  ON

BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @sSQL NVARCHAR(MAX)
    --Select the wo records for work orders created for rework
 	SET @sSQL = 'SELECT w.wo_id, jb.oper_id first_oper_id, jb.job_desc, rw.rework_process_id, rw.orig_rework_cd, rw.orig_process_id, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'w.input_wo_id orig_wo_id, w.input_oper_id orig_oper_id, w.input_seq_no orig_seq_no, rw.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc, ir.reas_grp_id, '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'rw.item_id, w.last_edit_comment, w.last_edit_by, w.last_edit_at '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'FROM wo w WITH (NOLOCK) '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN job jb with (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = w.wo_id '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN job jb2 with (NOLOCK) ON jb2.wo_id = w.input_wo_id and jb2.oper_id = w.input_oper_id and jb2.seq_no = w.input_seq_no '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN rework_process_usage rw with (NOLOCK) ON rw.orig_rework_cd = jb2.rework_cd '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'INNER JOIN item_reas ir with (NOLOCK)ON ir.reas_cd = rw.reas_cd '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'WHERE w.input_wo_id IS NOT NULL '
    IF (@orig_wo_id IS NOT NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND w.input_wo_id = ' + '''' + @orig_wo_id + '''' + ' '
    IF (@orig_oper_id IS NOT NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND w.input_oper_id = ' + '''' + @orig_oper_id + '''' + ' '
    IF (@orig_seq_no IS NOT NULL) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND w.input_seq_no = ' + cast(@orig_seq_no as nvarchar(20)) + ' '
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND jb.first_job = 1';
    SET @sSQL = @sSQL + 'ORDER BY jb.display_seq'
    PRINT @sSQL

   EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL
END

--===========================================================================================
    -- Name:     sp_U_ofi_ItemGrade 
    -- Description: The stored procedure will handle item grade
    --  
    -- Usage:       handle item grade
    -- ===========================================================================================
    -- Version  Author          Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
    -- 0.01     SSB             2023-04-18          Initial version.
    -- 0.02     MP              2023-04-23          Updated grade_cd in req_track numer condition
    -- 0.03     DS              2023-06-19          setting up the reas_cd for by-co product butter for pressing. #22 BAT issue list
    -- 0.04     DS              2023-09-08          set the inv_update flag to 0 for loadout process
    -- 0.05     LP              2023-09-26          set the inv_update flag to 1 for Butter FDD process for WIP and consumable
    -- 0.06     MP              2023-10-06          set the def_grade_cd for consumable in Butter Loadout Process
    -- 0.07     SSB             2024-06-19          added logic for bin rework Liquour Butter Rework Goodgrade
    -- 0.08     AML, XPM         2026-01-16          Added call to sp_I_ofi_set_Job_spec for Packing process
    -- ===========================================================================================
    CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_ItemGrade] -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
    @wo_id nvarchar(40),
    @oper_id nvarchar(40),
    @seq_no int AS BEGIN -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
SET
    NOCOUNT ON;

-- Insert statements for procedure here
declare @recipe_name nvarchar(80),
@req_track_no nvarchar(40) = NULL --for checking grade from SAP
,
@target_sched_ent_id int,
@def_reas_desc_ent nvarchar(40),
@def_reas_cd_ent int,
@uom_desc nvarchar(20),
@reqd_grade_cd int,
@processType nvarchar(40) declare @attr_id int,
@it_grp nvarchar(80) declare @by_product_reas_cd int --/ Handling the grade in job bom table
BEGIN
SELECT
    @attr_id = attr_id
FROM
    attr WITH(nolock)
WHERE
    attr_desc = 'itemgroup'
SELECT
    @req_track_no = req_track_no,
    @it_grp = ia.attr_value
FROM
    ofi_wo_ext oe WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN item_attr ia ON ia.item_id = oe.item_id
    AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id -- req_track_no is  item grade
    IF(@req_track_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN -- @req_track_no has to configure as grade and reason description
    -- reas_grp_id - production reasons
SELECT
    @def_reas_cd_ent = reas_cd,
    @reqd_grade_cd = item_grade_cd
FROM
    item_reas WITH(nolock)
WHERE
    reas_grp_id = 0
    AND item_grade_cd = (
        SELECT
            item_grade_cd
        FROM
            item_grade
        WHERE
            item_grade_desc = @it_grp + ' - ' + @req_track_no
    )
    AND item_status_cd = (
        SELECT
            item_status_cd
        FROM
            item_state WITH(nolock)
        WHERE
            item_status_desc = 'UNRESTRICTED'
    )
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    def_reas_cd = @def_reas_cd_ent,
    reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos = 0
END
ELSE BEGIN
SELECT
    @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id
FROM
    job
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
SELECT
    @def_reas_desc_ent = attr_value
FROM
    ent_attr WITH(nolock)
WHERE
    ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id
    AND attr_id = (
        SELECT
            attr_id
        FROM
            attr WITH(nolock)
        WHERE
            attr_desc = 'def_reas_cd'
    ) print @def_reas_desc_ent
	IF(@def_reas_desc_ent IS NOT NULL) -- configured grade and reas_desc is same
    BEGIN
SELECT
    @def_reas_cd_ent = reas_cd,
    @reqd_grade_cd = item_grade_cd
FROM
    item_reas WITH(nolock)
WHERE
    reas_grp_id = 0
    AND reas_desc = @def_reas_desc_ent --and item_status_cd = (select item_status_cd from item_state with(nolock) where item_status_desc ='UNRESTRICTED' ) 
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd,
    def_reas_cd = @def_reas_cd_ent
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos = 0 --- for the packing process
SELECT
    top 1 @processType = pa.attr_value
FROM
    wo WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN PROCESS WITH(nolock) ON wo.process_id = PROCESS.process_id
    INNER JOIN process_attr pa WITH(nolock) ON pa.process_id = PROCESS.process_id
    INNER JOIN attr WITH(nolock) ON pa.attr_id = attr.attr_id
    AND attr_desc = 'ProcessType'
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id 
	
	IF (
        @processType IS NOT NULL
        AND @processType = 'Packing'
    ) BEGIN
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd --, def_reas_cd = @def_reas_cd_ent  
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos > 0
    AND backflush <> 1 

	EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_set_Job_spec] 
	@wo_id = @wo_id,
    @oper = @oper_id,
    @seq = @seq_no
END --0.07
IF (
    @processType IS NOT NULL
    AND @processType = 'Rework'
    AND @oper_id = 'LiquorButterRework'
) BEGIN print 4
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos > 0
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    reqd_grade_cd = NULL
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos = 0
END  
IF (
    @processType IS NOT NULL
    AND @processType = 'Loadout'
) BEGIN -- On the final operation of the loadout setting update_inv flag to 0  
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    update_inv = 0
FROM
    job_bom jb WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN job WITH(nolock) ON job.wo_id = jb.wo_id
    AND job.oper_id = jb.oper_id
    AND job.seq_no = jb.seq_no
WHERE
    job.wo_id = @wo_id
    AND job.final_job = 1
    AND jb.bom_pos = 0
END IF (
    @processType IS NOT NULL
    AND @processType = 'Butter Loadout'
) BEGIN -- On the final operation of the loadout setting update_inv flag to 0  
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    update_inv = 0
FROM
    job_bom jb WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN job WITH(nolock) ON job.wo_id = jb.wo_id
    AND job.oper_id = jb.oper_id
    AND job.seq_no = jb.seq_no
WHERE
    job.wo_id = @wo_id
    AND job.final_job = 1
    AND jb.bom_pos = 0
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos > 0
END IF (
    @processType IS NOT NULL
    AND @processType = 'Butter'
) BEGIN -- On the final operation of the loadout setting update_inv flag to 0  
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    update_inv = 1
FROM
    job_bom jb WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN job WITH(nolock) ON job.wo_id = jb.wo_id
    AND job.oper_id = jb.oper_id
    AND job.seq_no = jb.seq_no
WHERE
    job.wo_id = @wo_id --and job.final_job = 1
    --and jb.bom_pos=0
END
END
ELSE BEGIN
SELECT
    top 1 @processType = pa.attr_value
FROM
    wo WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN PROCESS WITH(nolock) ON wo.process_id = PROCESS.process_id
    INNER JOIN process_attr pa WITH(nolock) ON pa.process_id = PROCESS.process_id
    INNER JOIN attr WITH(nolock) ON pa.attr_id = attr.attr_id
    AND attr_desc = 'ProcessType'
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id IF (
        @processType IS NOT NULL
        AND @processType = 'Loadout'
    ) BEGIN -- On the final operation of the loadout setting update_inv flag to 0  
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    update_inv = 0
FROM
    job_bom jb WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN job WITH(nolock) ON job.wo_id = jb.wo_id
    AND job.oper_id = jb.oper_id
    AND job.seq_no = jb.seq_no
WHERE
    job.wo_id = @wo_id
    AND job.final_job = 1
    AND jb.bom_pos = 0
END IF (
    @processType IS NOT NULL
    AND @processType = 'Butter Loadout'
) BEGIN -- On the final operation of the loadout setting update_inv flag to 0  
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    update_inv = 0
FROM
    job_bom jb WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN job WITH(nolock) ON job.wo_id = jb.wo_id
    AND job.oper_id = jb.oper_id
    AND job.seq_no = jb.seq_no
WHERE
    job.wo_id = @wo_id
    AND job.final_job = 1
    AND jb.bom_pos = 0
UPDATE
    job_bom
SET
    reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
WHERE
    wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND seq_no = @seq_no
    AND bom_pos > 0
END IF (
    @processType IS NOT NULL
    AND @processType = 'Butter'

UPDATE

SET
    update_inv = 1
FROM
    job_bom jb WITH(nolock)
    INNER JOIN job WITH(nolock) ON job.wo_id = jb.wo_id
    AND job.oper_id = jb.oper_id
    AND job.seq_no = jb.seq_no

    job.wo_id = @wo_id --and job.final_job = 1
    --and jb.bom_pos=0

END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_MDM_SCHED_GET_JOB_RES_REQUIREMENT]
@scheduler_date datetime =NULL,
@res_grp_ids NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,
@res_ids NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,
@loc_ids NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,
@eq_grp_ids NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,
@callFrom NVARCHAR(40) = 'REPORT'
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- SP_SA_MDM_SCHED_JOB_RES_REQUIREMENT
-- Description					- Get all the resources required for the job
-- Author						- Sk
-- Date Created					- 2018-08-21
-- Version						- 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2015 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 22/08/2018        Sk				1.1		Added no lock,added filter w.r.t res_grp_id and added order by 
-- 24/08/2018		Chinmay			1.2		Returning start_time_utc and end time_utc and returning eni_id from se.job_sched_ent_id, returning res_grp_id from rg.res_grp_id
--											,Changed name field from resource_type to res_grp_desc,changed entity name from equipment to ent_name		
--											,column renamed  from ent_id to default_ent_id	,column renamed resource to res_desc		
--28/08/2018		 Sk				1.3		Added filter w.r.t res_id, location and equipment group					
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;




		;WITH cte AS
		(
		   SELECT SE.job_latest_start_time, SE.job_sched_entity_id, SE.job_sched_entity_name, e.description, SE.job_req_finished_time, SS.session_id,SS.scheduler_date, SE.item_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wo_id,oper_id,job_seq_no ORDER BY released_at DESC) AS rn
		   FROM [SDB].[dbo].scheduler_exec SE WITH (NOLOCK)
		   INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK)							ON	e.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
		   INNER JOIN [SDB].[dbo].scheduler_sessn SS WITH (NOLOCK)	ON SE.session_id = ss.session_id
		   WHERE is_released=1 and ss.scheduler_date = @scheduler_date
		)
		
SELECT 
	   l.loc_desc						as location
	  ,eqGrp.res_grp_desc				as eq_grp_desc
	   --se.wo_id,
	  ,se.job_sched_entity_id			as default_ent_id
	  ,se.job_sched_entity_name			as ent_name
	  ,se.description					as ent_desc
	  ,CASE WHEN mr.res_desc IS NULL THEN 'RTR' ELSE 'RR' END as req_type
	  ,rg.res_grp_id					as res_grp_id
	  ,rg.res_grp_desc					as res_grp_desc
	  ,mr.res_id						as res_id
	  ,mr.res_desc						as res_desc
	   --mvig.res_id,
	  ,mvrg_req.Qty							as qty
	  ,se.job_latest_start_time			as start_time	 
	  ,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, se.job_latest_start_time), se.job_latest_start_time),null) as start_time_utc
	  ,se.job_req_finished_time			as end_time
	  ,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, se.job_req_finished_time), se.job_req_finished_time),null) as end_time_utc
	  ,se.scheduler_date
	  ,se.session_id
INTO #data
FROM cte se

INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].res_grp_ent rge				WITH (NOLOCK) on	rge.ent_id		 =  se.job_sched_entity_id 
INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].res_Grp eqGrp				WITH (NOLOCK) on	eqGrp.res_grp_id =  rge.res_grp_id AND eqGrp.is_moveable = 0
INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].loc l						WITH (NOLOCK) on	l.loc_id		 =  eqGrp.loc_id
--INNER JOIN [SDB].[dbo].scheduler_sessn ss			WITH (NOLOCK) on	ss.session_id	 =	se.session_id
INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].item_grp_item i				WITH (NOLOCK) on	i.ItemId		 =	se.item_id
INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].item_grp ig					WITH (NOLOCK) on	ig.id			 =	i.ItemGrpId
INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].mov_res_item_grp mvrg_req	WITH (NOLOCK) on	mvrg_req.item_grp_id =	ig.id
INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].res_grp rg					WITH (NOLOCK) on	rg.res_grp_id	 =	mvrg_req.res_grp_id and rg.Is_Moveable = 1

LEFT  JOIN [SDB].[SCH].res mr						WITH (NOLOCK) on	mr.res_id		 =	mvrg_req.res_id


WHERE se.rn=1

and (@res_grp_ids IS NULL
OR rg.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value FROM   Fn_split(@res_grp_ids, ',')))

and (@res_ids IS NULL
OR mr.res_id IN (SELECT value FROM   Fn_split(@res_ids, ',')))

and (@loc_ids IS NULL
OR l.loc_id IN (SELECT value FROM   Fn_split(@loc_ids, ',')))

and (@eq_grp_ids IS NULL
OR eqGrp.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value FROM   Fn_split(@eq_grp_ids, ',')))

ORDER BY rg.res_grp_desc,mr.res_desc,se.job_latest_start_time


IF @callFrom = 'REPORT' 
BEGIN
	SELECT * FROM #data
	Order By res_grp_desc, res_desc, job_latest_start_time
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SELECT * FROM #data
	Order By default_ent_id, res_grp_desc 
END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_GetChartPoint]
(
      @char_id             INT32
   ,  @sample_id           INT32
   ,  @chart_type          INT32
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -  sp_SA_Sample_GetChartPoint
-- Description          -  Get the measurements for a single characteristic and sample.  Also gets the
--                   centerline, lower control limits, and the upper control limits for the point based on the
--                   chart type.  The center line, and control limit values come from either the qm_spec_char_link record
--                   with the qm_spec_id coming from the sample_char_link table or from the characteristic table.
-- Author          - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created          -    03/23/2011
-- Version          - 4.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

   SET NOCOUNT ON

   SELECT sample.sample_id,
      CASE @chart_type
         WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_xbar, characteristic.cl_xbar)
         WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_xbar, characteristic.cl_xbar)
         WHEN 5 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_ix, characteristic.cl_ix)
         WHEN 7 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_ma, characteristic.cl_ma)
         WHEN 8 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_ma, characteristic.cl_ma)
      END AS primary_cl,
      CASE @chart_type
         WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_xbar, characteristic.lcl_xbar)
         WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_xbar, characteristic.lcl_xbar)
         WHEN 5 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_ix, characteristic.lcl_ix)
         WHEN 7 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_ma, characteristic.lcl_ma)
         WHEN 8 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_ma, characteristic.lcl_ma)
      END AS primary_lcl,
      CASE @chart_type
         WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_xbar, characteristic.ucl_xbar)
         WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_xbar, characteristic.ucl_xbar)
         WHEN 5 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_ix, characteristic.ucl_ix)
         WHEN 7 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_ma, characteristic.ucl_ma)
         WHEN 8 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_ma, characteristic.ucl_ma)
      END AS primary_ucl,
      CASE @chart_type
         WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_range, characteristic.cl_range)
         WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_sigma, characteristic.cl_sigma)
         WHEN 5 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_imr, characteristic.cl_imr)
         WHEN 7 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_mr, characteristic.cl_mr)
         WHEN 8 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.cl_ms, characteristic.cl_ms)
      END AS secondary_cl,
      CASE @chart_type
         WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_range, characteristic.lcl_range)
         WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_sigma, characteristic.lcl_sigma)
         WHEN 5 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_imr, characteristic.lcl_imr)
         WHEN 7 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_mr, characteristic.lcl_mr)
         WHEN 8 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.lcl_ms, characteristic.lcl_ms)
      END AS secondary_lcl,
      CASE @chart_type
         WHEN 2 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_range, characteristic.ucl_range)
         WHEN 3 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_sigma, characteristic.ucl_sigma)
         WHEN 5 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_imr, characteristic.ucl_imr)
         WHEN 7 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_mr, characteristic.ucl_mr)
         WHEN 8 THEN COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.ucl_ms, characteristic.ucl_ms)
      END AS secondary_ucl,
      sample.requested_time_local,
      sample.requested_time_utc,
      sample.requested_time_utc AS requested_time,
      sample_char_link.note,
      result.value_no,
      result.result_value,
      sample_char_link.act_sample_size
   FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
   INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id = sample.sample_id
   INNER JOIN result WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = sample.sample_id
   INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = sample_char_link.char_id
   LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.char_id = characteristic.char_id AND qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = sample_char_link.qm_spec_id
   WHERE sample.sample_id = @sample_id AND sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND result.char_id = @char_id AND
      (sample.sample_status = 6 OR sample.sample_status = 7) AND
      sample_char_link.ignore_sample = 0 AND
      result.superseded = 0
   ORDER BY sample.requested_time_utc, sample.sample_id, result.value_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_ScheduleShifts]
(@in_ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_start_time			TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_days_ahead			INT32 = 7
,@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Ent_ScheduleShifts
-- Description		- Refreshes the shift schedules for the supplied entity.
--				Apparently, verifies and adjusts the shift for the supplied entity.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 08/23/2006
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	 @shift_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@shift_end_time	TDATETIME
	,@shift_sched_ent	INT32


BEGIN
	--Create a temporary table for template shifts; if a temporary table does not exist in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[#shift_to_go_template]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISUSERTABLE') = 1)
		CREATE TABLE #shift_to_go_template (ent_id INT, start_day INT, shift_id INT
						,start_date DATETIME, end_date DATETIME
						,break1_start DATETIME, break1_end DATETIME
						,break2_start DATETIME, break2_end DATETIME
						,break3_start DATETIME, break3_end DATETIME
						,row_id INT IDENTITY (1,1))

	--Call the refresh shift sched procedure to populate all template shifts for an entity.
	EXEC sp_U_Ent_RefreshShiftSched @in_ent_id = @in_ent_id, @in_start_time = @in_start_time
		, @in_days_ahead = @in_days_ahead, @in_time_zone_bias_value = 0
		, @shift_sched_ent = @shift_sched_ent OUTPUT, @shift_start_time = @shift_start_time OUTPUT
		, @shift_end_time = @shift_end_time OUTPUT

	--Delete the current shifts from the shift to go table;
	EXEC sp_D_Shift_To_Go_DelBetwDates @ent_id=@shift_sched_ent, @start_time=@shift_start_time, @start_time_tz=0
		,@end_time=@shift_end_time, @end_time_tz=0, @time_zone_bias_value=0

	--Insert tempalte shifts into shift_to_go table.
	INSERT INTO shift_to_go (ent_id, start_time, end_time, shift_id,
		break1_start, break1_end, break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end)
	SELECT ent_id, start_date, end_date, shift_id,
		break1_start, break1_end, break2_start, break2_end, break3_start, break3_end
	FROM #shift_to_go_template
	WHERE start_date >= @shift_start_time
	  AND end_date <= @shift_end_time
	ORDER BY ent_id, start_date, shift_id, end_date

	--Drop the temporary table as we don't need anymore.
	DROP TABLE #shift_to_go_template
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ScheduledJob]
(
@wo_id NVARCHAR(max),
@user_name NVARCHAR(50),
@scheduledate NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare  @sSQL NVARCHAR(max) 
	,@sessoId  NVARCHAR(10)
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select top 1 @sessoId = session_id from SDB..scheduler_sessn where cast(scheduler_date as Date) = cast(@scheduledate as Date) 
	order by session_id desc

	update SDB.[dbo].[scheduler_exec] set checkedout_by =  @user_name , is_checkedout = 1,session_id =  @sessoId 
	, sched_owner = @user_name  where wo_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@wo_id, ',')) and is_released = 0 and session_id is null

		SELECT se.[row_id],[mo_id],[wo_id],SE.[oper_id],[item_id],[item_desc],[wo_release_time],[wo_req_finish_time],[job_state],[wo_state],[job_latest_start_time],[job_req_finished_time] 
		,[wo_priority],[job_state],[job_sched_entity_id],[job_sched_entity_name],[job_priority],[job_seq_no],[req_qty],[job_sched_pinned],[is_checkedout] 
		,[checkedout_by],[is_validated],[is_downtime_exists],[validated_by],[validated_at],[is_released],[released_by],[released_at],[session_id], [res_grp_id] 
		,[sched_owner],[schedule_sequence],[error_code],[error_description], 
		ISNULL([process_id], 'Not Defined') as [process_id] , 
		ISNULL(EA.parent_ent_id, SE.job_sched_entity_id) parent_ent_id, 
		ISNULL(EA.jobposition, 0) as jobposition
		FROM SDB.[dbo].[scheduler_exec] se with (nolock)
		inner join SDB.[SCH].[res_grp_ent] rge with (nolock) on rge.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id 
		left join ( SELECT ea.ent_id, attr_value as jobposition, e.parent_ent_id  from ent_attr ea with (nolock) 
			inner join attr A with (nolock) on A.attr_id=ea.attr_id and attr_desc = 'JobPositions'
			inner join ent e with (nolock) on e.ent_id = ea.ent_id) EA on ea.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
		left join (Select process_id, oper_id, ent_id from (select RANK() OVER  (PARTITION BY ent_id ORDER BY process_id ASC) AS RankPI  ,process_id, oper_id, ent_id from oper_ent_link with (nolock) where process_id not like '%[_]%') A where RankPI = 1) ProcessID  on ProcessID.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
		where  req_qty <> 0 and is_released = 0 and (wo_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@wo_id, ',')) OR @wo_id is null) and cast(wo_release_time as Date) = cast(@scheduledate as Date) 
		order by ISNULL(EA.parent_ent_id, SE.job_sched_entity_id),ISNULL(EA.jobposition, 0), se.row_id 
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_process_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[process]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_process_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on process table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.6.0.19
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769)  Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--12/17/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2041)  Disallow Process Status change if the user making the change is not the same user who last edited
--12/17/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2022)  May only have one certified Process in a Process class. If yes, how to downgrade a certified process
--05/15/2003    Sheetal Jain    1.6.0.0 (HD# 546) Lower the item process link status level to process level when higher
--06/04/2003	Raghu		1.6.7	(HD# 3195). Appover of a process
--08/12/2003    Sheetal Jain    1.6.0.19 (HD# 546) Correction
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	HD# 5678, 6785 Part of DB Changes
--02/06/2013	Saiteja     4.6		Added changes for CR L00114821.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value			BIT
	,@process_status		INT
	,@user_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@last_editor			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_process_stat_change	BIT
	,@may_have_one_cert_proc	BIT
	,@process_class_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_downgrad_proc_level	INT
	,@last_changes_at		DATETIME
	,@prev_process_status		INT

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207
	SELECT @may_have_one_cert_proc = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 211
	SELECT @attr_process_stat_change = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 222
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	SET @last_changes_at = GETUTCDATE()
	SET @last_changes_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @last_changes_at )

	DECLARE process_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT b.process_id, b.process_status, b.last_editor, b.process_class_id
		FROM process a, inserted b WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
	OPEN process_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM process_cursor INTO @process_id, @process_status, @last_editor, @process_class_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				IF NOT UPDATE(PROCESS_STATUS) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Cannot delete or modify components of a certified process.{2179}.', 16, 1)
					BREAK
				END
			END
		END

		IF UPDATE(PROCESS_STATUS)  BEGIN
			SELECT @prev_process_status = process_status FROM DELETED WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status <> @prev_process_status)  BEGIN
				IF (@attr_process_stat_change = 1) AND (@last_editor IS NOT NULL) AND (@last_editor = @user_id) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Process approver and editor must be different users.{2981}', 16, 1)
					BREAK
				END

				IF (@may_have_one_cert_proc = 1)   BEGIN
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_class_id = @process_class_id
						    AND process_status = 3 AND process_id <> @process_id)  BEGIN
						SELECT @attr_downgrad_proc_level = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 212
						UPDATE process SET process_status = @attr_downgrad_proc_level, last_user_to_change_status = @user_id,
									approver = NULL, last_status_change_at = @last_changes_at
						WHERE process_class_id = @process_class_id AND process_status = 3 AND process_id <> @process_id
					END
				END
				IF (@process_status = 2 OR @process_status = 3)
					UPDATE process SET approver = @user_id, last_user_to_change_status = @user_id, last_status_change_at = @last_changes_at WHERE process_id = @process_id
				ELSE
					UPDATE process SET approver = NULL, last_user_to_change_status = @user_id, last_status_change_at = @last_changes_at WHERE process_id = @process_id

                              --Set the item process link status to the lowered process status
                              IF @process_status < @prev_process_status
                                UPDATE item_process_link SET status = @process_status WHERE status > @process_status AND process_id = @process_id

			END
		END
		IF (UPDATE(PROCESS_CLASS_ID) OR UPDATE(PROCESS_VER_ID) OR UPDATE(PROCESS_DESC) OR UPDATE(PROCESS_LEVEL)
			-- OR UPDATE(PARENT_PROCESS_ID)  removed since field removed in 3.1
			OR UPDATE(DISASSEMBLY) OR UPDATE(NOTES))  BEGIN
			IF NOT UPDATE(checked_out_by)
			UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id WHERE process_id = @process_id
		END
		IF NOT UPDATE(checked_out_by)
		UPDATE process SET last_edit_at = @last_changes_at WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE process_cursor
	DEALLOCATE process_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label_manual_history] 
	 @old_lbl_id NVARCHAR(100)
	 ,@print_name NVARCHAR(100)
	 ,@print_qty INT
	,@lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)=NULL OUTPUT
	
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE  @layout_name NVARCHAR(50)			=	NULL
			,@layout_id	NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@showkosher BIT = 0
			,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@wo_id NVARCHAR(50)			=	NULL
			,@hu NVARCHAR(50)			=	NULL
			,@lbl_cnt INT				= 0

	SELECT @printer_id=ISNULL(lpld.manual_value,ISNULL(lpld.actual_value,lpld.default_value)) 
	FROM ofi_lm_print_label_details lpld WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE lpld.as_value='printer_id' and lpld.label_id=@old_lbl_id

	SELECT @layout_name=ISNULL(lpld.manual_value,ISNULL(lpld.actual_value,lpld.default_value)) 
	FROM ofi_lm_print_label_details lpld WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE lpld.as_value='layout_name' and lpld.label_id=@old_lbl_id

	SELECT @wo_id = lplh.wo_id, @hu = lplh.hu
	FROM [dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_header] lplh WITH(NOLOCK)	
	WHERE lplh.label_id=@old_lbl_id 

	SELECT @layout_id = ln.layout_id 
	FROM [dbo].[ofi_lm_layout_name] ln WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ln.layout_name = @layout_name


	EXEC sp_I_ofi_lm_print_label_header
	@layout_id, @printer_id, @wo_id, @hu, @label_type ='manual', @label_name = @lbl_name OUTPUT

	INSERT INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details 
	(label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value
	,min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @lbl_name, lpld.record_title, ISNULL(lpld.manual_value,lpld.actual_value), lpld.default_value, lpld.as_value
	,lpld.min_length, lpld.max_length, lpld.pattern, lpld.editable, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE()
	FROM ofi_lm_print_label_details lpld WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE lpld.label_id=@old_lbl_id


	UPDATE [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] 
	SET actual_value = @lbl_name 
    WHERE label_id=@lbl_name and as_value='lbl_name' 
	 
	UPDATE [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details]
	SET  actual_value=@print_name
	WHERE as_value='printer_id' and label_id=@lbl_name

	-- UPDATE [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details]
	-- set  printer_id=@print_name
	-- where  label_id=@lbl_name
	 
	UPDATE [dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_header]
	SET printer_id=@print_name
	WHERE label_id=@lbl_name
	 
	SELECT @lbl_cnt = COUNT(1)
	FROM [dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE as_value='label_quantity'AND label_id=@lbl_name

	IF(@lbl_cnt > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details]
		SET actual_value=CAST(@print_qty as NVARCHAR(50))
		WHERE as_value='label_quantity'and label_id=@lbl_name
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
		INSERT INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details 
		(label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value
		,min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT @lbl_name, 'label_quantity', CAST(@print_qty as NVARCHAR(50)), '1', 'label_quantity'
		,1, 3, 'INT', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE()
	END

	SELECT @lbl_name AS lbl_name
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name      :  sp_SA_ofi_GetAllStorageInfo
-- Description  :   Returns product type, product grade, classification and sync-status
--          for EVERY silo that currently holds inventory - no silo list is passed
--          in; the object/binding script is responsible for looping its own array
--          of configured silos and matching each one against this result set by
--          ent_name. Internally, it still loops per silo and REUSES the existing
--          SPs instead of duplicating their logic:
--            - sp_SA_ofi_Get_StorageInfo  (current inventory)
--            - sp_S_Item                  (product description)
--            - sp_S_Item_Grade            (grade description)
--            - sp_SA_Item_Attr            (Classification attribute)
--            - sp_S_Ent_Attr              (UpdateSUInfoToAUT / sync flag)
--
-- Usage:    EXEC sp_SA_ofi_GetAllStorageInfo
--
-- *** IMPORTANT ***
--  A silo with NO current inventory will NOT appear in the result set.
--
-- Notes:
--  - Mixing behaviour preserved: up to 2 items/lots per silo, concatenated with ';', same
--    order as today (product_type, product_grade, classification all align by position).
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)    Change description
-- 0.01.00  AML, XPM    2026-09-23        Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetAllStorageInfo]
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @Result TABLE (
    ent_name        NVARCHAR(80),
    ent_id          INT,
    product_type    NVARCHAR(400),
    product_grade   NVARCHAR(400),
    classification  NVARCHAR(1700),
    sync_status     NVARCHAR(1700)
  );

  DECLARE @cur_ent_name NVARCHAR(80);

  DECLARE silo_cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
    SELECT DISTINCT e.ent_name
    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON e.ent_id = ii.ent_id;

  OPEN silo_cur;
  FETCH NEXT FROM silo_cur INTO @cur_ent_name;

  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 1: reuse sp_SA_ofi_Get_StorageInfo
    -- Retrieve the current inventory information for the silo.
    ------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @StorageInfo TABLE (
      item_id NVARCHAR(40),
      grade_cd INT,
      ent_id INT
    );

    INSERT INTO @StorageInfo (
      item_id,
      grade_cd,
      ent_id
    )
    EXEC dbo.sp_SA_ofi_Get_StorageInfo
      @ent_name = @cur_ent_name;

    DECLARE @ent_id INT =
      (SELECT TOP 1 ent_id FROM @StorageInfo);


    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 2: reuse sp_S_Ent_Attr for the sync flag
    ------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @EntAttr TABLE (
      ent_id            INT,
      attr_id           INT,
      attr_value        NVARCHAR(1700),
      notes             NVARCHAR(1700),
      last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(100),
      last_edit_by      NVARCHAR(40),
      last_edit_at      DATETIME
    );

    INSERT INTO @EntAttr
    EXEC dbo.sp_S_Ent_Attr
      @ent_name = @cur_ent_name,
      @attr_desc = 'UpdateSUInfoToAUT';

    DECLARE @sync_status NVARCHAR(1700) =
      (SELECT TOP 1 attr_value FROM @EntAttr);


    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 3: reuse sp_S_Item, sp_S_Item_Grade and sp_SA_Item_Attr
    -- for the descriptive information of the first two items.
    ------------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @types NVARCHAR(400) = NULL;
    DECLARE @grades NVARCHAR(400) = NULL;
    DECLARE @classes NVARCHAR(1700) = NULL;

    DECLARE @row_item_id NVARCHAR(40);
    DECLARE @row_grade_cd INT;

    DECLARE item_cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
      SELECT TOP 2
        item_id,
        grade_cd
      FROM @StorageInfo
      ORDER BY item_id;

    OPEN item_cur;
    FETCH NEXT FROM item_cur
      INTO @row_item_id, @row_grade_cd;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- sp_S_Item: retrieve product description
      ------------------------------------------------------------------

      DECLARE @Item TABLE (
        item_id NVARCHAR(40),
        item_desc NVARCHAR(100),
        item_class_id NVARCHAR(40),
        uom_id INT,
        template BIT,
        lifetime INT,
        unit_cost FLOAT,
        obsolete BIT,
        purchased BIT,
        sold BIT,
        num_decimals INT,
        must_complete_steps BIT,
        must_prod_reqd_qty BIT,
        min_grade INT,
        min_state INT,
        min_inv_level FLOAT,
        reorder_amt FLOAT,
        auto_reorder BIT,
        lot_no_format NVARCHAR(40),
        last_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
        max_lot_size FLOAT,
        sublot_no_format NVARCHAR(40),
        last_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40),
        serial_no_lvl INT,
        max_sublot_size FLOAT,
        max_order_size FLOAT,
        min_trace_inv FLOAT,
        inv_unique_by_job BIT,
        notes NVARCHAR(1700),
        spare1 NVARCHAR(100),
        spare2 NVARCHAR(100),
        spare3 NVARCHAR(100),
        spare4 NVARCHAR(100),
        last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(100),
        last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40),
        last_edit_at DATETIME
      );

      DELETE FROM @Item;

      INSERT INTO @Item
      EXEC dbo.sp_S_Item
        @item_id = @row_item_id;

      SET @types =
        ISNULL(@types + ';', '') +
        ISNULL(
          (SELECT TOP 1 item_desc FROM @Item),
          ''
        );


      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- sp_S_Item_Grade: retrieve product grade description
      ------------------------------------------------------------------

      DECLARE @Grade TABLE (
        item_grade_cd INT,
        item_grade_desc NVARCHAR(100),
        good_prod BIT,
        scrapped BIT,
        color NVARCHAR(40),
        pref INT,
        last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(100),
        last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40),
        last_edit_at DATETIME
      );

      DELETE FROM @Grade;

      INSERT INTO @Grade
      EXEC dbo.sp_S_Item_Grade
        @item_grade_cd = @row_grade_cd;

      SET @grades =
        ISNULL(@grades + ';', '') +
        ISNULL(
          (SELECT TOP 1 item_grade_desc FROM @Grade),
          ''
        );


      ------------------------------------------------------------------
      -- sp_SA_Item_Attr: retrieve Classification
      ------------------------------------------------------------------

      DECLARE @ItemAttr TABLE (
        item_id NVARCHAR(40),
        item_desc NVARCHAR(100),
        attr_id INT,
        attr_value NVARCHAR(1700),
        notes NVARCHAR(1700),
        attr_desc NVARCHAR(80),
        predefined BIT,
        data_type INT,
        entry_type INT,
        visible_in_queue BIT,
        visible_in_inv BIT,
        last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(100),
        last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40),
        last_edit_at DATETIME,
        mod_id VARCHAR(30)
      );

      DELETE FROM @ItemAttr;

      INSERT INTO @ItemAttr
      EXEC dbo.sp_SA_Item_Attr
        @item_id = @row_item_id,
        @attr_desc = 'Classification',
        @attr_value = NULL,
        @last_edit_by = NULL,
        @last_edit_at = NULL,
        @mod_id = NULL;

      SET @classes =
        ISNULL(@classes + ';', '') +
        ISNULL(
          (SELECT TOP 1 attr_value FROM @ItemAttr),
          ''
        );


      FETCH NEXT FROM item_cur
        INTO @row_item_id, @row_grade_cd;

    END

    CLOSE item_cur;
    DEALLOCATE item_cur;


    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 4: store the consolidated information for the silo
    ------------------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO @Result (
      ent_name,
      ent_id,
      product_type,
      product_grade,
      classification,
      sync_status
    )
    VALUES (
      @cur_ent_name,
      @ent_id,
      @types,
      @grades,
      @classes,
      @sync_status
    );


    FETCH NEXT FROM silo_cur
      INTO @cur_ent_name;

  END

  CLOSE silo_cur;
  DEALLOCATE silo_cur;


  ------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Return information for all silos with inventory
  ------------------------------------------------------------------

  SELECT *
  FROM @Result;

END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_S_GLL_LineAccByUser
-- Description	  -	Returns a data set contain the specified user's line access for each line defined in the
--					system.
-- Author		  -
-- Date Created	  -	05/22/2014
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By     Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
IF NOT @user_id IS NULL
BEGIN
	SELECT grp_line_link.line_id
		,line.line_name
		,(max(CAST(grp_line_link.accss AS Int))) access
	FROM grp_line_link grp_line_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.line_id = line.line_id

	ORDER BY line.line_name
