   @can_ship		LOGICAL,
   @can_receive		LOGICAL,
   @lab_cd		STRING40,
   @dept_id		STRING40,
   @identical_job_execs   INT,
   @job_pos_counter	INT

DECLARE
   @ent_desc		STRING80,
   @shift_id		INT32,
   @shift_desc		STRING80,
   @shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME,
   @shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME,
   @shift_end_time_utc	TDATETIME,
   @shift_end_time_local	TDATETIME,
   @wo_id		STRING40,
   @oper_id		STRING40,
   @seq_no		STRING40,
   @def_prod_reas_cd	NVARCHAR(10),
   @def_cons_reas_cd	INT,
   @msg			NVARCHAR(2000),
   @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),
   @last_edit_at	DATETIME,
   @job_ent_id		INT32,
   @util_ent_id		INT32,
   @parent_ent_id	INT32

DECLARE	@parent_level				INT32
	,	@old_shift_start_time_utc		TDATETIME
	,	@old_shift_start_time_local		TDATETIME
	,	@old_parent_ent_id			INT32
	,	@old_can_sched_shifts		INT32
	,	@site						INT32
	,	@cur_time_local				DATETIME

BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Raise an error if the identical jobs execs is greater than 1 and the entity belongs to a line.  Exclude the
	-- parent of the line from the check.
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = i.ent_id
		WHERE lel.line_is_child = 0 AND i.identical_job_execs > 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This entity belongs to a line so Identical Job Execs cannot be greater than 1.<7904>', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	--Open a cursor to fetch all the rows, one at a time
	DECLARE Ent_Exec_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
		SELECT b.ent_id, b.can_sched_jobs, b.can_run_jobs, b.can_capture_util, b.can_capture_labor,
			b.can_track_oee, b.can_store, b.can_do_dnc, b.can_log_data, b.can_ship, b.can_receive,
			b.can_sched_shifts, b.cur_shift_id, b.cur_shift_start_time_utc, b.cur_shift_start_time_local, b.description, b.identical_job_execs, b.parent_ent_id,
			d.cur_shift_start_time_utc AS old_shift_start_time_utc, d.cur_shift_start_time_local AS old_shift_start_time_local,
			d.parent_ent_id AS old_parent_ent_id, d.can_sched_shifts AS old_can_sched_shifts, b.site
		FROM ent a INNER JOIN inserted b ON a.ent_id = b.ent_id INNER JOIN deleted d ON a.ent_id = d.ent_id
	OPEN ENT_Exec_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM Ent_Exec_cursor INTO @ent_id, @can_sched_jobs, @can_run_jobs, @can_capture_util,
			@can_capture_labor, @can_track_oee, @can_store, @can_do_dnc, @can_log_data, @can_ship,
			@can_receive, @can_sched_shifts, @shift_id, @shift_start_time_utc, @shift_start_time_local, @ent_desc, @identical_job_execs, @parent_ent_id,
			@old_shift_start_time_utc, @old_shift_start_time_local, @old_parent_ent_id, @old_can_sched_shifts, @site
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF (@can_do_dnc = 1) BEGIN
			UPDATE ent SET can_do_dnc = 0 WHERE ent_ID = @ent_id
			SET @can_do_dnc = 0
		END

		IF (UPDATE(CAN_SCHED_JOBS))  BEGIN
			IF (@can_sched_jobs = 1)  BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_sched_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
					INSERT INTO job_sched_exec (ent_id, oper_type, queue_time, sort_order, filtr, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (@ent_id, NULL, NULL, '$$SortColumn=req_finish_time_utc$$$$SortType=ASC$$', '1,2,3,4,5,6;CANCELLED=0;COMPLETED=0', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WHERE (init_sched_ent_id = @ent_id OR target_sched_ent_id = @ent_id) AND (state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7)) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Some of the jobs for this entity are not completed or cancelled.  These must be deleted or moved to a different entity before this capability can be removed.{4221}', 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE EXEC sp_D_Job_Sched_Exec @ent_id
					--DELETE FROM job_sched_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
		IF (UPDATE(CAN_RUN_JOBS) OR UPDATE(IDENTICAL_JOB_EXECS)) BEGIN
			IF (@can_run_jobs = 1)  BEGIN
				SELECT @def_cons_reas_cd = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 215
				SELECT @def_prod_reas_cd = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 216
				IF ((@def_prod_reas_cd IS NULL)  OR (@def_prod_reas_cd = '')) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Default production reason code is not defined in system attributes.{4222}', 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				IF (ISNUMERIC(@def_prod_reas_cd) = 0) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Default production reason code should be numeric in system attributes.{4223}', 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				IF (@def_cons_reas_cd IS NULL) OR (@def_cons_reas_cd = '') SET @def_cons_reas_cd = NULL
				SELECT @job_pos_counter = max(job_pos) FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				IF @job_pos_counter IS NULL SET @job_pos_counter = -1
				IF (@identical_job_execs IS NULL OR @identical_job_execs = 0) SET @identical_job_execs = 1
				WHILE (@job_pos_counter < (@identical_job_execs -1)) BEGIN --No rows or less rows in job exec (with identical job execs)
					SET @job_pos_counter = @job_pos_counter + 1
					IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos_counter)
						IF EXISTS  (SELECT TOP 1 1  FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
							INSERT INTO job_exec (ent_id, job_pos, next_job_only, item_based_desc, job_end_confirm_msg, def_to_ent_id,
								def_reject_ent_id, def_from_ent_id, def_prod_reas_cd, def_cons_reas_cd, def_lot_no, autoload_job_specs,
								auto_seq_start_option, auto_job_start_option, auto_job_end_option, incl_class_reas, must_complete_steps,
								must_prod_reqd_qty, local_movable_cons_ent, local_movable_prod_ent, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
								last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
							SELECT @ent_id, @job_pos_counter, next_job_only, item_based_desc, job_end_confirm_msg, def_to_ent_id,
								def_reject_ent_id, def_from_ent_id, def_prod_reas_cd, def_cons_reas_cd, def_lot_no, autoload_job_specs,
								auto_seq_start_option, auto_job_start_option, auto_job_end_option, incl_class_reas, must_complete_steps,
								must_prod_reqd_qty, local_movable_cons_ent, local_movable_prod_ent, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
								last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
							FROM job_exec
							WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
							AND job_pos = (SELECT MIN(job_pos) FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
						ELSE
							INSERT INTO job_exec (ent_id, job_pos, next_job_only, item_based_desc, job_end_confirm_msg, def_to_ent_id, def_from_ent_id, def_prod_reas_cd,
									def_cons_reas_cd, def_lot_no, autoload_job_specs, auto_seq_start_option, auto_job_start_option, auto_job_end_option, incl_class_reas,
									cur_wo_id, cur_oper_id, cur_seq_no, cur_step_no, cur_step_start, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
							VALUES (@ent_id, @job_pos_counter, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, @def_prod_reas_cd, @def_cons_reas_cd, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
				END
				WHILE (@job_pos_counter > (@identical_job_execs -1)) BEGIN --More rows in job_exec table with multiple job_pos (UPDATEd identical_job_execs with less value)
					SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
					FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos_counter
					IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '') AND (@oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '') BEGIN
						DELETE FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos_counter
						SET @job_pos_counter = @job_pos_counter - 1
					END
					ELSE BEGIN
						--SET @msg = 'A job is running on this entity at job pos = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @job_pos_counter)
--						SET @msg = 'There is currently a job running on the specified entity at job pos# %1{3175},' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @job_pos_counter)
						SET @msg = 'You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}'
						RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
						BREAK
					END
				END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WHERE (run_ent_id = @ent_id) AND (state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7)) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Some of the jobs for this entity are not completed or cancelled.  These must be deleted or moved to a different entity before this capability can be removed.{4221}', 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oee_exec WHERE job_ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @ent_desc = e.ent_name FROM oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE oe.job_ent_id = @ent_id
					SET @msg = 'The %1 property for this entity cannot be turned off, since the %2 from this entity are currently reported to %3.{4948},can_run_jobs,performance and quality obtained,' + @ent_desc
					RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @ent_desc = l.line_name FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0
					SET @msg = 'This entity must be removed from the line: %1 first before turning off the can_run_jobs capability for the entity.{7858},' + @ent_desc
					RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE DELETE FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
		IF (UPDATE(CAN_CAPTURE_UTIL)) BEGIN
			IF (@can_capture_util = 1)  BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
					INSERT INTO util_exec (ent_id, cur_state_cd, cur_reas_cd, cur_reas_start_utc, cur_reas_start_local, cur_raw_reas_cd, reas_reqd, cur_log_id, target_util,
						current_util, jobstart_reas_cd, jobend_reas_cd, unkn_stop_reas_cd, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
						last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)

					VALUES (@ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oee_exec WHERE util_ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @ent_desc = e.ent_name FROM oee_exec oe WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON oe.ent_id = e.ent_id
					WHERE oe.util_ent_id = @ent_id
					SET @msg = 'The %1 property for this entity cannot be turned off, since the %2 from this entity are currently reported to %3.{4948},can_capture_utilization,utilization measured,' + @ent_desc
					RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @ent_desc = l.line_name FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0
					SET @msg = 'This entity must be removed from the line: %1 first before turning off the can_capture_util capability for the entity.{7859},' + @ent_desc
					RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE
					DELETE FROM util_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
		IF (UPDATE(CAN_CAPTURE_LABOR)) BEGIN
			IF (@can_capture_labor = 1)  BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
					SELECT @lab_cd = lab_cd FROM labor_cat
					SELECT @dept_id = dept_id FROM labor_dept
					INSERT INTO labor_exec (ent_id, def_lab_cd, def_dept_id, multiple_operators, cur_raw_reas_cd,
						spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (@ent_id, @lab_cd, @dept_id, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
				END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Some of the labor records for this entity are currently active. These must be made inactive before this capability can be removed.{4224}', 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE DELETE FROM labor_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
		IF (UPDATE(CAN_TRACK_OEE)) BEGIN
			IF (@can_track_oee = 1)  BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oee_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
					SELECT @job_ent_id = NULL, @util_ent_id = NULL
					EXEC sp_SA_Oee_Exec_VerifyOEEEnts @ent_id, @job_ent_id OUTPUT, @util_ent_id OUTPUT
					IF (@job_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
						RAISERROR('The can track OEE property for this entity cannot be turned on, since none of the entities are configured to %1.{4949},run jobs', 16, 1, @@error)
						BREAK
					END
					IF (@util_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
						RAISERROR('The can track OEE property for this entity cannot be turned on, since none of the entities are configured to %1.{4949},capture utilization', 16, 1, @@error)
						BREAK
					END
					INSERT INTO oee_exec (ent_id, job_ent_id, util_ent_id, target_perf, current_perf, target_qual, current_qual,
						def_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, std_item_id, target_oee, current_oee, basis, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (@ent_id, @job_ent_id, @util_ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						0, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
				END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @ent_desc = l.line_name FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0
					SET @msg = 'This entity must be removed from the line: %1 first before turning off the can_track_oee capability for the entity.{7860},' + @ent_desc
					RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				DELETE FROM oee_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
		IF (UPDATE(CAN_STORE)) BEGIN
			IF (@can_store = 1)  BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM storage_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
--					INSERT INTO storage_exec VALUES (@ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)
					INSERT INTO storage_exec (ent_id, type, status, max_capacity, auto_del_zero_inv, allow_neg_qty,
						scannable_id, allow_multiple_items, allow_multiple_lots, movable, storage_ent_id,
						allow_dirty_state, log_state_transitions,indistinguishable_lots, spare_int1, spare_int2, spare_int3, spare_int4,
						spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (@ent_id, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, 0, NULL, 1, 1, 0, NULL, 0, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('There is material stored at this entity.  All must be removed before this capability can be removed.{4225}', 16, 1, @@error)
					BREAK
				END
				ELSE
                                BEGIN
                                 --DELETE FROM storage_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
                                  EXEC sp_D_Storage_Exec @ent_id
                                END
			END
		END
		-- L00141330: Change parent entity not updating ent_link
        IF (COALESCE(@parent_ent_id, -1) <> COALESCE(@old_parent_ent_id, -1)) BEGIN
            -- Check to see if linkage already exists
			IF (@parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_ent_id = @parent_ent_id and child_ent_id = @ent_id))) BEGIN
                  EXEC sp_I_Ent_Link @parent_ent_id = @parent_ent_id, @child_ent_id = @ent_id, @last_edit_comment = NULL, @last_edit_at = NULL
            END
        END

		-- If the can_sched_shifts capability is turned off, check to make sure that there are no shift
		-- schedules set up for the entity
		IF (@can_sched_shifts <> @old_can_sched_shifts AND @can_sched_shifts = 0) BEGIN
			IF (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_sched WHERE ent_id= @ent_id)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_exc WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR('There is atleast one shift defined for this entity.  All must be deleted before this capability can be removed.{4226}', 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		IF (@can_sched_shifts = 0 AND COALESCE(@parent_ent_id, -1) <> COALESCE(@old_parent_ent_id, -1))
			EXEC sp_U_Ent_UpdCurrShiftSchedule @ent_id = @ent_id, @line_id = NULL, @create_shift_history = 1


		IF(UPDATE(cur_shift_start_time_utc) AND @shift_start_time_utc  IS NOT NULL AND(@old_shift_start_time_utc IS NULL OR @shift_start_time_utc <> @old_shift_start_time_utc)) BEGIN
				-- There is a possibility that the ent.shift_start_time_utc does not match with the shift_history.shift_start_time_utc.
				--Therefore, just close the current shift for this entity in the shift history table
				UPDATE shift_history SET shift_end_utc = DATEADD(ss,-1,@shift_start_time_utc)
							,shift_end_local = DATEADD(ss,-1,@shift_start_time_local)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND (shift_end_utc IS NULL OR shift_end_local IS NULL)

				IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_history sh WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id AND sh.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_time_utc )) BEGIN
					--Log this shift event in the shift history table.
					INSERT INTO shift_history (ent_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, shift_id)
					VALUES (@ent_id, @shift_start_time_utc, @shift_start_time_local, @shift_id)
				END
			END

/*		IF (UPDATE(CUR_SHIFT_ID)) OR (UPDATE(CUR_SHIFT_START_TIME_UTC))  BEGIN

			SELECT @shift_id = shift_id, @shift_desc = shift_desc
			FROM shift WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE shift_id = @shift_id

			UPDATE fc_namesp_tag SET last_value = @shift_id, new_value = 1
			FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
			  AND UPPER(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SHIFTID'
			  AND b.ent_id = @ent_id

			UPDATE fc_namesp_tag SET last_value = @shift_desc, new_value = 1
			FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
			  AND UPPER(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SHIFTDESC'
			  AND b.ent_id = @ent_id

			UPDATE fc_namesp_tag  SET last_value = @shift_start_time_utc, new_value = 1
			FROM fc_namesp_node b WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE fc_namesp_tag.node_id = b.node_id
			  AND UPPER(fc_namesp_tag.tag_desc) = 'SHIFTSTART'
			  AND b.ent_id = @ent_id*/

--			Get Old shift details, AND UPDATE the quantities in tpm_stat FOR the old values
/*			SELECT @old_shift_start_time = cur_shift_start_time  FROM deleted WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
			FROM job_exec  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

			--EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @old_shift_start_time
			Exec sp_U_TPM_Stat_NewEvent @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @old_shift_start_time

--			Call new shift AND create a new row in tpm_stat table
			EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_NewShift @ent_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_time*/

--			Exec sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewShift @ent_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_time
--			Exec sp_U_Util_Exec_NewShift @ent_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_time
--		END

/* RWB: This change was made for CR L00085757, but it is being rolled back until Sidus 3 Rewire.
		IF UPDATE(ent_name) OR UPDATE(description) OR UPDATE(parent_ent_id) OR UPDATE(site) OR UPDATE(hourly_cost) OR
		   UPDATE(can_sched_jobs) OR UPDATE(can_run_jobs) OR UPDATE(can_capture_util) OR UPDATE(can_capture_labor) OR
		   UPDATE(can_do_dnc) OR UPDATE(can_track_oee) OR UPDATE(can_sched_shifts) OR UPDATE(can_store) OR
		   UPDATE(can_log_data) OR UPDATE(can_ship) OR UPDATE(can_receive) OR UPDATE(can_copy_folders) OR
		   UPDATE(last_domain_change) OR UPDATE(tree_icon) OR UPDATE(flow_diag_img) OR UPDATE(identical_job_execs) OR
		   UPDATE(show_in_dsp_tree) OR UPDATE(spare1) OR UPDATE(spare2) OR UPDATE(spare3) OR UPDATE(spare4) BEGIN
*/
			UPDATE ent SET last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
/*
		END
*/
	END
	CLOSE Ent_Exec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE Ent_Exec_cursor
END

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Folder_Item_Oper_Ent_Link]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ent_id int ,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Bom_Ver]
(
	@parent_item_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ver_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ver_date				TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@ver_date_tz			INT32 = NULL
,	@ver_comments			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@preferred_ver			LOGICAL = 0
,	@disassembly			LOGICAL = 0
,	@start_eff				TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@start_eff_tz			INT32 = NULL
,	@end_eff				TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@end_eff_tz				INT32 = NULL
,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@mod_id					varchar(30)
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-	10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By     Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 09/19/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 07/02/2007		AML				3.2.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- 11/27/2009		Eswar			4.0		HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @v_ver_date TDATETIME,
			@v_start_eff TDATETIME,
			@v_end_eff TDATETIME,
			@dbg_resp INT32

    SET @ver_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@ver_date_tz)
    SET @start_eff_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_eff_tz)
    SET @end_eff_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_eff_tz)
    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Bom_Ver', @src_key='post_validate', @date_val1 = @ver_date, @numeric_val1 = @ver_date_tz,
					 @date_val2 = @start_eff, @numeric_val2 = @start_eff_tz,
					 @date_val3 = @end_eff, @numeric_val3 = @end_eff_tz

	IF ( @ver_date IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @v_ver_date = DATEADD( mi, -@ver_date_tz, @ver_date )
	END

	IF ( @start_eff IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @v_start_eff = DATEADD( mi, -@start_eff_tz, @start_eff )
	END

	IF ( @end_eff IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @v_end_eff = DATEADD( mi, -@end_eff_tz, @end_eff )
	END

	SELECT	bom_ver.parent_item_id
		,	bom_ver.ver_id
		,	bom_ver.ver_date
		,	bom_ver.ver_comments
		,	bom_ver.preferred_ver
		,	item.item_desc
		,	bom_ver.disassembly
		,	bom_ver.start_eff
		,	bom_ver.end_eff
		,	bom_ver.last_edit_comment
		,	bom_ver.last_edit_by
		,	bom_ver.last_edit_at
		,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, bom_ver.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK)ON bom_ver.parent_item_id = item.item_id
	WHERE (
			(bom_ver.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id OR @parent_item_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_ver.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
			(bom_ver.ver_date = @v_ver_date OR @v_ver_date IS NULL) AND
			(bom_ver.ver_comments = @ver_comments OR @ver_comments IS NULL) AND
			(bom_ver.preferred_ver = ABS(@preferred_ver) OR @preferred_ver IS NULL) AND
		    (bom_ver.disassembly = ABS(@disassembly) OR @disassembly IS NULL) AND
		    (bom_ver.start_eff = @v_start_eff OR @v_start_eff IS NULL) AND
		    (bom_ver.end_eff = @v_end_eff OR @v_end_eff IS NULL) AND
		    (bom_ver.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		    (bom_ver.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
			(CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, bom_ver.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
		  )
	ORDER BY bom_ver.ver_comments

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_Exec_SetReason]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@new_reas_cd		INT32
,@new_reas_start_local	TDATETIME2
,@reas_pending		LOGICAL
,@comments		STRING2000_NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/26/2002		Tony            1.5.0    	Use job_pos = 0 to get current wo running on an entity
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2		Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06-06-2003		Sheetal Jain    1600		Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 02/15/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 08/15/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--12/21/2015	    Tentu		    5.2	        Story 569840: To address CR L00139311 updated the @comments parameter type to STRING2000
-- 08/17/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 675688-As Lenka, I want the Raw Reason from UCO and New Reason from Operator to be logged
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @new_reas_start_utc TDATETIME2
	,@cur_reas_start_utc TDATETIME2
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'UtilExec.SetReason(new reason start local time)'

	--Verify whether the entity captures utilizaion
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The entity does not have its "can_capture_util" set to True{3248}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Return error if ent_id or new_reas_cd is not specified
	IF ((@ent_id Is NUll) Or (@new_reas_cd IS NULL)) BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('The ent_id and new_reas_cd have to be specified{3371}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END

	--Default the supplied values to null
	SELECT @reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, 0), @comments = COALESCE(@comments, '')

	--Verify whether the reason start time is supplied
	IF (@new_reas_start_local IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Get the UTC time from the supplied local time
		SET @new_reas_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @new_reas_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

		--Retrieve the current reason start
		SELECT @cur_reas_start_utc = cur_reas_start_utc FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--If the new_reas_start is specified it should be greater than cur_reas_start else default it to now
		IF (@new_reas_start_utc <= @cur_reas_start_utc) SET @new_reas_start_utc = GETUTCDATE()
	END

	--Create a new utilization event
	EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@new_reas_start_utc
		, @reas_cd=@new_reas_cd, @reas_pending=@reas_pending, @comments=@comments, @raw_reas_cd=NULL
		, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
		, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
		, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Wo_File]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @file_path  nvarchar(254)  ,
 @file_type  nvarchar(254)  ,
 @last_modified  datetime  ,
 @author  nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)   AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/11/2005		Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 12/22/2009		Kishore		4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @last_modified IS NOT NULL SET @last_modified = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @last_modified)

SELECT wo_file.wo_id
            ,wo_file.file_path
            ,wo_file.file_desc
            ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(wo_file.file_path) AS file_type
            ,wo_file.last_modified as last_modified
            ,wo_file.file_size
            ,wo_file.author
			,wo_file.spare1
            ,wo_file.spare2
            ,wo_file.spare3
            ,wo_file.spare4
            ,user_name.user_desc
            ,wo_file.last_edit_comment
            ,wo_file.last_edit_by
            ,wo_file.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo_file.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM wo_file wo_file WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name user_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo_file.author = user_name.user_id
WHERE ((wo_file.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (wo_file.file_path = @file_path OR @file_path IS NULL) AND
       (dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(wo_file.file_path) = @file_type OR @file_type IS NULL) AND
       (wo_file.last_modified >= @last_modified OR @last_modified IS NULL) AND
       (wo_file.author = @author OR @author IS NULL) AND
       (wo_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (wo_file.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY wo_file.file_desc

-- Description: This procedure reports liquor consumption
--
-- Version    Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)    Change description
-- 0.01.00    LK        2023-10-27          Initial Version
--===========================================================================================

CREATE  procedure [dbo].[sp_u_ofi_item_cons_remain_qty]
as begin

Declare @lot_no nvarchar(50), @sublot_no nvarchar(50),@ent_id integer ,@wo_id nvarchar(50),@qty_toreport float,@row_id integer ,@fg_lot_no nvarchar(50),@fg_sublot_no nvarchar(50)
,@qty_cons_tocheck float,@qty_cons_erp_tocheck float,@qty_cons float,@qty_cons_erp float,@spare1 nvarchar(10)
select top 1 @qty_cons=qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@spare1=spare1, @lot_no=lot_no,@sublot_no=sublot_no,@fg_lot_no=fg_lot_no,@fg_sublot_no=fg_sublot_no ,@ent_id=ent_id,@wo_id=wo_id,@row_id=row_id from item_cons with(nolock) where oper_id in ('ButterFiltering','LiqBlend') and qty_cons<>qty_cons_erp order by  created_at_local desc

	IF NOT EXISTS (select *from item_inv with(nolock) where lot_no=@fg_lot_no and sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no )
	BEGIN
	select @qty_toreport=qty_cons-qty_cons_erp, @row_id=row_id from item_cons with(nolock) where lot_no=@lot_no and sublot_no=@sublot_no and ent_id=@ent_id and row_id=@row_id
	select @qty_cons_tocheck=qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp_tocheck=qty_cons_erp from item_cons with(nolock) where lot_no=@fg_lot_no and sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no and oper_id in ('ButterLoadout','LiqLoad')
	if (@qty_cons_tocheck=@qty_cons_erp_tocheck )
	BEGIN
	if(@qty_cons >@qty_cons_erp and CAST(isnull(@spare1,0) as float)=0)
	update item_cons set spare1=CAST(isnull(spare1,0) as float) +@qty_toreport where row_id=@row_id
	END

	--select  @qty_toreport,@wo_id,@row_id
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_MDM_Sched_Get_Mov_Res_Def_Alloc]

	,@eq_grp_id				nvarchar(max) = null
		
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Select MREM.[res_grp_id]
		  ,mrg.[res_grp_desc]
		  ,MREM.[res_id]
		  ,R.[res_desc]		  
		  ,MREM.[default_ent_id]
		  ,e.[ent_name]
		  --,cast((concat(@date,' ',MREM.[starttime] )) as datetime) as starttime
		  --DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, start_time_utc), start_time_utc) as start_time_utc	
		  --,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, cast((concat(@date,' ',MREM.[starttime] )) as datetime) as starttime), cast((concat(@date,' ',MREM.[starttime] )) as datetime) as starttime) as start_time
		  ,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[starttime] )) as datetime)), cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[starttime] ))as datetime)) as starttime							
		  ,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[starttime] )) as datetime)), cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[starttime] ))as datetime)) , null) as start_time_utc

		  --,cast((CONCAT(@date,' ',MREM.[endtime]   )) as datetime) as endtime
		  ,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[endtime] )) as datetime)), cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[endtime] ))as datetime)) as endtime							
		  ,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[endtime] )) as datetime)), cast((concat(cast(@res_sched_date as date),' ',MREM.[endtime] ))as datetime)) , null) as end_time_utc

		  ,MREM.[row_id]

	INNER JOIN [MESDB_R].[dbo].ENT E			 WITH (NOLOCK)		ON	  MREM.default_ent_id	= E.ent_id	
	INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].res_grp_ent rge	 WITH (NOLOCK)		ON	  rge.ent_id = e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN [SDB].[SCH].res_grp	eq_grp	 WITH (NOLOCK)		ON    eq_grp.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id AND eq_grp.is_moveable = 0

	LEFT JOIN [SDB].[SCH].[RES] R			 WITH (NOLOCK)		ON    MREM.res_id			= R.res_id
	LEFT JOIN [SDB].[SCH].[res_grp] mrg		 WITH (NOLOCK)		ON	  MREM.res_grp_id		= mrg.res_grp_id AND mrg.is_moveable = 1
	
	WHERE		( @eq_grp_id IS NULL AND (eq_grp.loc_id IN (SELECT value FROM   Fn_split(@loc, ',')) or @loc is null))
		   AND	( eq_grp.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value FROM Fn_split(@eq_grp_id, ','))  or @eq_grp_id IS null)
		   AND	(@res_grp_id IS null OR mrg.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value FROM   Fn_split(@res_grp_id, ',')) )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtTypeByFilt]
(
		@char_id            	INT32
	,	@ent_id					INT32 = NULL
	,	@item					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_category_id		INT32 = NULL
	,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@process_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_response_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare1					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare2					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare3					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare4					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@start_time				DATETIME = NULL
	,	@start_time_tz			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@end_time				DATETIME = NULL
	,	@end_time_tz			INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -	sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtTypeByFilt
-- Description          -	Get the default_chart, cl_source, samples_for_cl, std_avg, std_deviation, chacteritic type,
--							normal sample size, number of defects per opportunity, and qm spec ID  for the specified
--							characteristic based on the supplied filter information.  The sample that matches the filter
--							information and has the most recent entry in the result table will be used to get the qm_spec_id
--							from the sample_char_link table.  The qm_spec_id is used to look up the qm_spec_char links and
--							all values that are not set to null will be returned from this table.  Any values that are null
--							in the qm_spec_char_link table will be gotten from the characteristic table.  If there is no
--							qm_spec_id in the sample_char_link table, all values will be returned from the characeristic table.
-- Author          - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created          -    03/11/2011
-- Version          - 4.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 05/22/2013		  Prashanth		   4.6	        Modified SP to return item, category, operation, speclimits, uom description and equipment field
-- 08/02/2013		  Arun			   4.6			Commented the sample_char_link.ignore_sample from the where clause
-- 08/12/2013		  Ibrahim		   4.6			Added characteristic.num_decimals to the select query.
-- 09/25/2013		  Srinivasa Rao	   4.6			Added qm_spec table to get qm_spec.num_pts_per_page using select query.
-- 06/16/2014		  Ibrahim	       5.0			Story#298880: CR# L00129318 Fix: Updated the join for qm_spec table from inner join to left outer join.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @start_time_utc		DATETIME,
			@end_time_utc		DATETIME,
			@temp_tz			int

	SET @start_time_tz	 = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
	SET @temp_tz = -@start_time_tz
	EXEC SP_S_GetUtcDate @start_time, @temp_tz, @start_time_utc OUTPUT
	SET @end_time_tz	 = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)
	SET @temp_tz = -@end_time_tz
	EXEC SP_S_GetUtcDate @end_time, @temp_tz, @end_time_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT COALESCE(x.default_chart, characteristic.default_chart) AS default_chart,
			COALESCE(x.cl_source, characteristic.cl_source) AS cl_source,
			COALESCE(x.samples_for_cl, characteristic.samples_for_cl) AS samples_for_cl,
			COALESCE(x.samples_before_cl, characteristic.samples_before_cl) as samples_before_cl,
			CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.std_avg_is_target, characteristic.std_avg_is_target) = 1
				 THEN x.target
				 ELSE COALESCE(x.std_avg, characteristic.std_avg)
			END AS std_avg,
			COALESCE(x.std_deviation, characteristic.std_deviation) AS std_deviation,
			characteristic.type,
			COALESCE(x.normal_sample_size, characteristic.normal_sample_size) as normal_sample_size,
			characteristic.num_defect_opp,
			characteristic.num_decimals,
			x.qm_spec_id,
			characteristic.mov_avg_span,
			x.item_id,
			x.item_desc,
			x.category_name,
			x.category_desc,
			x.oper_id,
			x.lsv,
			x.usv,
			x.created_by,
			x.ent_name,
			uom.description as uom_desc,
			x.equipment,
			qm_spec.num_pts_per_page
	FROM (SELECT TOP 1 sample_char_link.qm_spec_id, sample_char_link.char_id, qm_spec_char_link.default_chart, qm_spec_char_link.cl_source, qm_spec_char_link.samples_for_cl, qm_spec_char_link.samples_before_cl, qm_spec_char_link.std_avg, qm_spec_char_link.std_deviation, qm_spec_char_link.normal_sample_size, qm_spec_char_link.std_avg_is_target, qm_spec_char_link.target, sample.item_id, item.item_desc, item_category.category_name, item_category.category_desc, sample.oper_id, qm_spec_char_link.lsv, qm_spec_char_link.usv, COALESCE(entity_from_filter.ent_name, entity_from_sample.ent_name) as ent_name, result.created_by, sample_char_link.equipment
			FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample_char_link.sample_id = sample.sample_id
			INNER JOIN result WITH (NOLOCK) ON result.sample_id = sample.sample_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = sample_char_link.qm_spec_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = sample.item_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN category item_category WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_category.category_id = @item_category_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent entity_from_filter WITH (NOLOCK) ON entity_from_filter.ent_id = @ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent entity_from_sample WITH (NOLOCK) ON entity_from_sample.ent_id = sample.ent_id
			WHERE sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id AND result.char_id = @char_id AND
				(COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.minimum_sample_size, (select minimum_sample_size from characteristic where char_id = @char_id)) <= (SELECT act_sample_size FROM sample_char_link scl WHERE scl.sample_id = sample.sample_id AND scl.char_id = @char_id)) AND
				-- sample_char_link.ignore_sample = 0 AND
				result.superseded = 0 AND
				(sample.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.item_id = @item OR @item IS NULL) AND
				(sample.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_category_link WHERE category_id = @item_category_id) OR @item_category_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
				(sample.requested_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL) AND
				(sample.requested_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL)
			ORDER BY result.created_at_utc desc) x
	INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON characteristic.char_id = x.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec.qm_spec_id = x.qm_spec_id
	INNER JOIN uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON uom.uom_id = characteristic.uom_id
	WHERE x.char_id = @char_id
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        sp_S_ofi_CBamqp_Req_Res
-- Description: Fetch request paylod to send to window service and is_resp=1 fetch response to get service result/prediction
-- exec sp_S_ofi_CBamqp_Req_Res 'lgdoow5pup0kh9b_s4' 
-- Usage:       From which object this script is called.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author                  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)       Change description
-- 0.01.00      AKM                       2022-12-08            Initial version.
-- 0.02.00		JSC						2025-10-15				Cakeblender FATs
-- 0.02.01		JSC						2025-11-26				Added All allowed components with 0 % on the output of response
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_CBamqp_Req_Res] 
	@correlation_id nvarchar(max),
	@is_resp int=0
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	DECLARE @wo_id nvarchar(40)=null, 	
			@oper_id nvarchar(40)=null,	
			@seq_no INT=null,	
			@curr_correction_step INT=null

	DECLARE @corr_id nvarchar(40), 
			@is_manual int =0, 
			@is_req_toBeUpdated int =1

	DECLARE @temp table(id nvarchar(40), 
						val nvarchar(40),
						type int)
 

	INSERT INTO @temp
    SELECT * FROM OpenJson(@correlation_id);

	SELECT @corr_id = val 
	FROM @temp 
	WHERE id='corrId'
	
	SELECT @wo_id=val 
	FROM @temp 
	WHERE id='wo_id'
	
	SELECT @oper_id = val 
	FROM @temp 
	WHERE id='oper_id'
	
	SELECT @seq_no = val 
	FROM @temp
	WHERE id='seq_no'
	
	SELECT @curr_correction_step=val 
	FROM @temp 
	WHERE id='curr_step'

	IF(@corr_id like '%_m%')
	BEGIN
		SET @is_manual =1
	END
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	IF (@is_resp =0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @json_out NVARCHAR(4000)
		SELECT  @json_out='{'+ STUFF((
							 SELECT Distinct ','	
											+'"wo_id' + '":' + '"'+@wo_id  + '"'+','
											+'"oper_id' + '":' + '"'+@oper_id  + '"'+','
											+'"seq_no' + '":' +CONVERT (NVARCHAR,@seq_no)  +','
											+'"curr_step' + '":' + CONVERT (NVARCHAR, @curr_correction_step)  + ','
											+'"corrId' +'":' + '"'+@corr_id  + '"'												
								FOR XML PATH('')
							 ), 1, 1, '')+'}'


		SELECT CONCAT(LEFT(c.request,LEN(c.request)-1),',"Request":',@json_out,'}') as 'request' 
		FROM ofi_CBamqp_Resp c WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND Oper_id = @oper_id 
			AND seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND curr_correction_step = @curr_correction_step 
			AND isManual = @is_manual
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-- v0.02.01 Modified the response
		SELECT 	response = JSON_MODIFY(r.response, '$.SearchResult.ResultComponents', JSON_QUERY('[' + (
										SELECT STRING_AGG('"' + ac.ComponentId + ': ' + ISNULL(rc.Value, '0 %') + '"', ',')
										FROM (
											SELECT value AS ComponentId
											FROM OPENJSON(r.request, '$.RecipeData.AllowedComponents')
										) ac
										LEFT JOIN (
											SELECT 
												LEFT(value, CHARINDEX(':', value) - 1) AS ComponentId,
												LTRIM(SUBSTRING(value, CHARINDEX(':', value) + 1, LEN(value))) AS Value
											FROM OPENJSON(r.response, '$.SearchResult.ResultComponents')
										) rc ON ac.ComponentId = rc.ComponentId
									) + ']'))
				,sample_id = r.sample_id
		FROM ofi_CBamqp_Resp r WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND Oper_id = @oper_id 
			AND seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND curr_correction_step = @curr_correction_step 
			AND isManual = @is_manual
   END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Ent_Logon_LogOnJob]
(
		@session_id              INT32
	,	@user_id                 STRING80
	,	@ent_id                  INT32
	,	@wo_id                   STRING80
	,	@oper_id                 STRING80
	,	@seq_no                  INT32
	,	@status_notes            STRING80
	,	@cur_lab_cd              STRING80
	,	@cur_lab_dept_id         STRING80
	,	@pct_lab_to_apply        TFLOAT
	,	@logon_time              TDATETIME
	,	@time_zone_bias_value    INT32 = 0

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_ENT_LOGON_LOGONJOB
-- Description          - HD# 9288, Logon a user to a job.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 04/04/2007
-- Version				- 3.2.0.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 08/27/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
--01/11/2008		Raghu		3.4		73697; Starting a job using job based login fails.
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET XACT_ABORT ON
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @err_msg                		NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@row_count              		INT32
		,	@process_id             		STRING80
		,	@item_id                		STRING80
		,	@state_cd               		INT32
		,	@ent_name               		STRING80
		,	@user_desc              		STRING80
		,	@log_id                 		INT32
		,	@can_capture_labor      		LOGICAL
		,	@cur_shift_id           		INT32
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc   	TDATETIME
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_local   	TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_utc        		TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_local				TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp						INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SELECT	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
		,	@labor_start_local = COALESCE( @logon_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_utc OUTPUT

    --Verify whether the supplied session is value.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sessn  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @session_id) BEGIN
        --Raise an exception to the caller since the supplied session does not exist in the database.
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},session_id=' + STR(@session_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether a valid job is supplied to logon.
    IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @oper_id IS NULL OR @seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Raise an exception to the caller since the supplied job does not identify a valid job.
		SET @err_msg = 'The %1 must be supplied %2{4677},' + 'job details,to identify a valid job'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether the supplied job is a valid job
    SELECT @state_cd = state_cd
    FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
      AND oper_id = @oper_id
      AND seq_no = @seq_no

	IF (@state_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
        --Raise an exception to the caller since this job does not exist in the database.
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'wo_id=' + @wo_id + ' oper_id=' + @oper_id + ' seq_no=' + STR(@seq_no)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id) BEGIN
        --Raise an exception to the caller since this user does not exist in the database.
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},row identifying the supplied user:' + @user_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether the supplied entity is a valid entity.
    SELECT	@ent_name = ent_name
		,	@can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor
		,	@cur_shift_id = cur_shift_id
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
    FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	IF (@ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row identifying the entity:' + STR(@ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
    END

    --Get the process and item that is linked to this work order.
    SELECT @process_id = process_id, @item_id = item_id
    FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

    --Verify whether this user has a valid certification to logon to this job.
    EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_CertStartAllowed @user_id=@user_id, @process_id=@process_id,
        @oper_id=@oper_id, @step_no=NULL, @item_id=@item_id,
        @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

    --Log this user to this job.
	SET @pct_lab_to_apply = COALESCE(@pct_lab_to_apply, 1)

    --Start this job if the supplied job is NOT running.
    IF (@state_cd <> 3)
        --The supplied job is not running. Start all the job(s) if this job is linked to a batch.
        --Since there is NO link between ent_logon and job_exec first start the job which will start all the jobs
        --in a batch. Once the job is started then pull all the jobs that are started now (from the supplied job details)
        --and attach the user to this job by creating a new labor_usage records.
        	EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=@status_notes
			, @check_privs=1, @check_certs=1, @event_time_local=@logon_time, @job_start_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

    --Adjust the ent_logon time if it is supplied. or default the ent_logon time if not supplied.
	SET @logon_time = DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logon_time)
	IF (@logon_time IS NULL)
		IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0)
			SET @logon_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
		ELSE
			SET @logon_time = GETUTCDATE()

	IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @session_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id)
			INSERT INTO ent_logon (session_id, ent_id, user_id, start_time, cur_lab_cd, pct_lab_to_apply, cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_usage_log_id)
			VALUES (@session_id, @ent_id, @user_id, @logon_time, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE session_id = @session_id
		          AND ent_id = @ent_id
        	  AND user_id = @user_id) BEGIN

        --Verify whether this user has already logged on to this entity on this session.
        SELECT @cur_lab_cd = COALESCE(@cur_lab_cd, cur_lab_cd), @pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply
		,@cur_lab_dept_id = COALESCE(@cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_dept_id), @log_id = cur_lab_usage_log_id

        FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE session_id = @session_id
          AND ent_id = @ent_id
          AND user_id = @user_id

        IF (@pct_lab_to_apply = 0 AND @can_capture_labor = 1) BEGIN
            --Reset the labor precetage to 1 (was 0) and let the apply labor sp calculates the correct entity percentage.
			SET @pct_lab_to_apply = 1
            --The current labor percentage for this entity is 0 and the entity is collecting labor.
            --Probably, this user has logged into this entity using indirect labor.
            --Log this user into this job and start collecting labor as he is now logging into a job.
		    EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_ApplyLabor	@session_id, @ent_id, @user_id, @labor_start_local, 1, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 1,
											@time_zone_bias_value, @cur_lab_cd OUTPUT, @cur_lab_dept_id OUTPUT, @pct_lab_to_apply OUTPUT, @log_id OUTPUT
		END
        ELSE
            --Verify whether this user has already logged on to this job.
			--The supplied user has already logged on to this entity.
            --Verify whether this user has already logged on to this job.
			IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			    WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND
					  wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND
					  seq_no = @seq_no AND active = 1
			)
			BEGIN
				--Logon this user to the supplied job and adjust the percentage within this entity
				EXEC sp_I_Ent_Logon_AdjustJobPct	@user_id, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_lab_dept_id,
													@labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local,
													@cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @pct_lab_to_apply,
													@log_id OUTPUT
			END

        --Update ent logon with the MAX labor usage log id.
        UPDATE ent_logon
        SET pct_lab_to_apply = @pct_lab_to_apply,
            cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id

    END
	ELSE BEGIN
	        --This user has not logged on to this entity on this session.
        	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id) BEGIN
                --Verify whether this user has already logged into this entity on any other session (logged in by another job)
                SELECT TOP 1 @cur_lab_cd = COALESCE(@cur_lab_cd, cur_lab_cd), @pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply,
						@cur_lab_dept_id = COALESCE(@cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_dept_id), @log_id = cur_lab_usage_log_id
                FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id

                IF (@pct_lab_to_apply = 0 AND @can_capture_labor = 1) BEGIN
                    --Reset the labor precetage to 1 (was 0) and let the apply labor sp calculates the correct entity percentage.
                    SET @pct_lab_to_apply = 1
                    --The current labor percentage for this entity is 0 and the entity is collecting labor.
                    --Probably, this user has logged into this entity using indirect labor.
                    --Log this user into this job and start collecting labor as he is now logging into a job.
        		    EXEC sp_I_Ent_LogOn_ApplyLabor	@session_id, @ent_id, @user_id, @labor_start_local, 1, @wo_id,
													@oper_id, @seq_no, 1, @time_zone_bias_value, @cur_lab_cd OUTPUT,
													@cur_lab_dept_id OUTPUT, @pct_lab_to_apply OUTPUT, @log_id OUTPUT
				END
                ELSE
                    --Verify whether this user has already logged on to this job.
                    --The supplied user has already logged on to this entity.
                    --Verify whether this user has already logged on to this job.
					IF NOT EXISTS (
						SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
		                WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND
							  wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND
							  seq_no = @seq_no AND active = 1
					)
					BEGIN

                        --Logon this user to the supplied job and adjust the percentage within this entity
                        EXEC sp_I_Ent_LogOn_AdjustJobPct	@user_id, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_lab_dept_id,
															@labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local,
															@cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @pct_lab_to_apply,
															@log_id OUTPUT
					END

                --Update ent logon with the MAX labor usage log id.
                UPDATE ent_logon
                SET pct_lab_to_apply = @pct_lab_to_apply,
                    cur_lab_usage_log_id = @log_id
                WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = @user_id
			END
			ELSE
                    --This user has not logged on to this entity on any other session.
				EXEC sp_I_Ent_LogOn_ApplyLabor	@session_id, @ent_id, @user_id, @labor_start_local, 1, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 0,
												@time_zone_bias_value, @cur_lab_cd OUTPUT, @cur_lab_dept_id OUTPUT, @pct_lab_to_apply OUTPUT, @log_id OUTPUT

            --Adjust the ent_logon time if it is supplied. or default the ent_logon time if not supplied.
			IF (@logon_time IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @logon_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logon_time)
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0)
					SET @logon_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
				ELSE
					SET @logon_time = GETUTCDATE()
			END

            --Insert a new ent_logon record for the supplied user to the supplied entity and session.
        	INSERT INTO ent_logon (session_id, ent_id, user_id, start_time, cur_lab_cd, pct_lab_to_apply, cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_usage_log_id)
        	VALUES (@session_id, @ent_id, @user_id, @logon_time, @cur_lab_cd, @pct_lab_to_apply, @cur_lab_dept_id, @log_id)
    END

    --Delete all labor usage records that are inactive and has a duration of 0.
    IF EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 0 AND duration = 0 ) BEGIN
		DELETE FROM labor_usage
		WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 0 AND duration = 0
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_StartShift]
(
		@ent_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
    ,	@shift_end			    TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Ent_StartShift
-- Description				-
-- Author					-
-- Date Created				-
-- Version (last edit)		-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
