-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 10/01/2002		Raghu			1.4		sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewShift and sp_U_Util_Exec_NewShift is not being executed when shift changes.
--											Moved to ent_after update trigger.
-- 12/03/2002		Chandresh		1.5		if @shift_start was null, it was storing milli seconds which is not required.
--											Changed the format type from 113 to 114
-- 12/09/2002		Raghu			1.5.2	sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewShift and sp_U_Util_Exec_NewShift is not being executed when shift changes.
--											Moved back to this sp from ent_after update trigger.
-- 12/09/2002		Raghu			1.5.2	(HD# 1773) Apply shift start reason code and shift end reason code when NO job is running on
--											the entity (default job_pos to 0 for now)
-- 12/17/2002		Chandresh		1.5.3	Changed the format type from 114 to 20-ODBC cannonical (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss).
--											114 was not the correct format. Adam B. pointed out it was putting 1/1/1900 for any updates.
-- 12/20/2002		Raghu			1.5.2	(HD# 1773) Applying shift start or shift end reason code creates a new row when the same reason
--											is repeated.  Code Moved to sp_U_Util_Exec_NewShift.
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/20/2003		Raghu			1.5.5	(HD# 2208) No Shift being logged for Util & Labor. If a shift change occurs via Factelligence
--											Service, the parent ent id looks for all the child entitties to change the shift for those
--											entities when can_sched_shifts = 0.  Inserted a cursor to loop thru all the child entities to
--											call New Labor and New Shift to close the existing record and to open a new record.
-- 02/20/2004		Raghu			2.0.26	(HD# 3852) Do not raise err if shift_id > 5 as it there may be unlimited no of shifts
-- 09/13/2004		Raghu			2.0.40	HD# 4918, Update tpm_stat ONLY after all util_log updations are done
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 07/11/2006		Raghu			3.1.19	HD# 8434, Strip the milli-seconds by converting the datetime value to a character type and
--											then convert it back to a datetime datatype
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes
-- 05/21/2007		Raghu			3.2.13  Shift changes are not cascaded to the child entities.
-- 08/06/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 01/03/2008		AML				3.4.0	Changed @shift_start_local to @shift_start to conform with middleware.
-- 01/16/2008		Raghu			3.4		L00073919; Auto shift changes does not work.
-- 05/27/2008		AML				3.5.0	DB Changes: Added hour_start to calls to sp_U_TPM_Stat_NewShift.  Added another NULL argument
--											to calls to sp_u_TPM_Stat_RefreshCurrVals for hour_start.
--09/30/2008	Raghu 	    3.5	L00084287 Hotfix ID: SR 37110234 - Shifts won't change if a both default utilization reasons for shift start and shift end are enabled on an entity. (Hotfix 1107)
--11/18/2009	Eswar		4.0	HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
--01/17/2012    PradeepS    4.5 Update Ent Table with cur_shift_end_time_local and cur_shift_end_time_utc values
--02/14/2012	Raghu		Handle DST changes for shift end time
--02/14/2012	Raghu		4.5	Handle DST changes
--05/02/2012	Arun		4.0Sp2	Fix for CRL00116545
--08/02/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 216158 - As Bruce I want to define shifts for the lines.
--11/12/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 259170 - Update shift information for the entities when the entities are moved around or added to a line.
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
--09/27/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 675738 - As Lenka, I want the shift changes to be processed efficiently
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
-- 02/07/2018	Raghu		6.0	UserStory: 928814 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00146852 (HF CR L00146752:QM auto samples not being generated randomly.)
-- 10/29/2019   Srinivas    6.2 US#1227521,Merge-CR#L00155153 for HF-CR#L00153810(Changes done to fix the issue of incorrect timing values in shift_history table in case of daylight savings).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
	,	@prev_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@prev_shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	,	@can_capture_labor		LOGICAL
	,	@can_sched_shifts		LOGICAL
	,	@cur_shift_id			INT32
	,	@cur_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	,	@v_current_time_utc		TDATETIME
	,	@tree_level				INT32
	,	@tz_temp				INT32
	,	@queue_detail			NVARCHAR(4000)
    ,	@cur_UTC_time			TDATETIME -- Added for CR L00108351 - RWB 11/18/2010
	,	@shift_end_local		TDATETIME
	,   @shift_end_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@can_capture_qm_data	LOGICAL
    ,	@cur_shift_end_time_local   TDATETIME
	,   @cur_shift_end_time_utc		TDATETIME
	,   @shift_end_time_utc		TDATETIME
    ,   @current_local_time     TDATETIME  -- For Shift id = 0, Calculate local time and then compute end_time (start_time of next shift if shift_id = 0)
	,   @can_run_jobs			LOGICAL
	,   @can_log_data			LOGICAL
	, @can_capture_util		LOGICAL
	, @shift_start_reas_cd		INT32
	, @shift_end_reas_cd		INT32
	, @shift_reas_cd		INT32
	, @last_edit_comment		STRING254

DECLARE @shift_entities	TABLE (
	ent_id INT,
	parent_ent_id INT,
	tree_level INT,
	can_capture_labor BIT,
	can_capture_util BIT,
	can_sched_shifts BIT,
	can_capture_qm_data BIT,
	cur_shift_id INT,
	cur_shift_start_time_local DATETIME,
	cur_shift_start_time_utc DATETIME,
	line_id INT
)

BEGIN

	IF ( @time_zone_bias_value is NULL ) SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc(@ent_id, NULL) -- get entity local offset

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

    -- Calulate current_local_time based on time_zone_bias_value
    SET @current_local_time = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, GETUTCDATE())
    SET @current_local_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_local_time )

	SET @shift_start = ISNULL( @shift_start, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(@time_zone_bias_value) )
	SET @shift_start = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @shift_start )

	-- SET @shift_start = NULL
	-- EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start OUTPUT

	-- set @shift_start_utc = Null
	-- EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT, @shift_start, NULL


	--EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start, DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start))

    -- when the supplied shift_end is null, the stored procedure is to find the shift end time for the supplied entity
    -- and cascade that shift end time to all the child entities.
    IF (@shift_end IS NULL AND @shift_id <> 0 )
      SELECT @shift_end = end_time FROM SHIFT_TO_GO WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE (ent_id = @ent_id) AND (start_time <= @shift_start AND end_time >= @shift_start)

    --If shift_id is 0, then end_time will be the start_time of next shift
    ELSE IF(@shift_end IS NULL AND @shift_id = 0)
      SELECT @shift_end = MIN(start_time) FROM SHIFT_TO_GO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  start_time >= @current_local_time

    SET @shift_end_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_end, DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value, @shift_end))

	--Get the current time depending upon the system attribute.
	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @server_time=@v_current_time OUTPUT
	SET @v_current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	-- If shift start time NOT included set it to current time
	--EXEC sp_S_AdjustORDefaultDateForDB @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @server_time=@shift_start OUTPUT

	-- Return error if invalid shift_id
	IF (@shift_id < 0) BEGIN --OR (@shift_id > 5) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('New Shift ID must be between 0 and 5{3226}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Get the current shift details, so that we need to update the labor after the current shift changes are done.
	SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor, @can_log_data = can_log_data, @can_run_jobs = can_run_jobs, @can_capture_util = can_capture_util
		, @cur_shift_id=cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local, @cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
		,@can_capture_qm_data = can_capture_qm_data
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	--Derive the previous shift start time in terms of client time zone.
	SET @prev_shift_start_local = @cur_shift_start_local

	IF (@shift_start_utc <> @cur_shift_start_utc) BEGIN
		--Therefore, verify whether there are any dependant records for this entity to defer the shift change for this entity.
		--If not, inherit the shifts from the nearest ancestor immediately, if this entity cannot schedule shifts.
		IF (@can_capture_labor = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
		  OR (@can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_16 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
		  OR (@can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_48 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
		  OR (@can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
		  OR (@can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
			--This entity has at least one record exists for: labor or data log or production or consumption
			--Therefore, defer to update the shift schedule for the entity.
			RETURN
	END

	IF (@shift_start_utc < @cur_shift_start_utc)
		EXEC sp_U_Ent_UpdCurrShiftSchedule @ent_id = @ent_id

	IF (@cur_shift_id <> @shift_id OR @cur_shift_start_local <> @shift_start) BEGIN

		UPDATE ent
		SET	cur_shift_id = @shift_id,
			cur_shift_start_time_local = @shift_start,
			cur_shift_start_time_utc = @shift_start_utc,
			cur_shift_end_time_local = @shift_end,
            cur_shift_end_time_utc = @shift_end_time_utc
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Error updating current shift data in ent table{3227}', 16, 1)
			RETURN @@error
		END

	---Added for CRL00116545
        --Record the shift end details, so that the Factelligence Service can execute the shift-end export later.
            SET @queue_detail = '<request><ent_id>' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @ent_id ) + '</ent_id><parameters>'
            SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="ent_id" value="' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @ent_id ) + '"></parameter>'
            SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="shift_id" value="' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @shift_id ) + '"></parameter>'
            SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '</parameters></request>'

            --Insert the shift end details in the dx_queue table.
            INSERT INTO dx_queue (inserted_at, activity_type, details)
            VALUES ( @v_current_time_utc, 1, @queue_detail)

		IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 1)
			INSERT INTO qm_context (context_ent_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, is_job_running, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			VALUES (NULL, @ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, 2, 'admin', @shift_start_utc)

		IF (@can_capture_util = 1) BEGIN
			--This entity is capable of capturing utilization.
			--Determine whether there is any shift start/end reason code configured
			SELECT @shift_start_reas_cd = ue.shift_start_reas_cd, @shift_end_reas_cd = ue.shift_end_reas_cd
			FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ue.ent_id = @ent_id

			-- Default to no shift reason configured
			SELECT @shift_reas_cd = NULL, @last_edit_comment = NULL

			IF (@shift_id > 0 AND @shift_start_reas_cd IS NOT NULL)
				--A shift id greater than zero is a valid shift and a shift start reason code is configured
				SELECT @shift_reas_cd = @shift_start_reas_cd, @last_edit_comment = 'Ent.StartShift(shift start reason code)'

			IF (@shift_reas_cd IS NULL AND @shift_end_reas_cd IS NOT NULL)
				--There is no shift start reason code configured
				--A shift has ended and it has a shift end reason code configured
				SELECT @shift_reas_cd = @shift_end_reas_cd, @last_edit_comment = 'Ent.StartShift(shift end reason code)'

			IF (@shift_reas_cd IS NOT NULL) --There is a valid shift start/end reason code configured for the entity
				EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@shift_start_utc, @reas_cd=@shift_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0
					, @comments=NULL, @raw_reas_cd=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
					, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
					, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @update_if_exists=1
					, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=NULL
		END

	    --Create a new labor usage record for this entity.
	    EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewShift @ent_id, @shift_id, @shift_start, @time_zone_bias_value
 	-- Added for the CR L00116544 Clone (L00109354(HF# 2291))
        BEGIN TRY
            UPDATE labor_usage
            SET shift_id = @shift_id, shift_start_local = @shift_start
            WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
            AND labor_start_local >= @shift_start;
		END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH

        END CATCH

		END

	SET @tree_level = 1
	INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, tree_level, can_capture_labor, can_capture_util,
			 can_sched_shifts, can_capture_qm_data, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local)
	SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_capture_util,
			 e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE e.parent_ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND e.can_sched_shifts = 0

	SET @tree_level = 2

	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, tree_level, can_capture_labor, can_capture_util,
				 can_sched_shifts, can_capture_qm_data, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local)
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_capture_util,
				 e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.parent_ent_id IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @shift_entities WHERE tree_level = @tree_level -1)
		  AND e.can_sched_shifts = 0
		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
		SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
	END

	--If a line has an entity that is defined as a parent to that line, then shift schedules for that line are derived from that entity,
	--regardless of the shift schedules that are assigned to the preferred parent entity for an entity in a line.
	--Since the while..loop above would have constructed the direct descendants, the code should remove those direct decendants,
	--if those descendant entities are part of a line and that line has at least one entity defined as a parent to the line.
	DELETE se
	FROM
	@shift_entities se,
	(SELECT DISTINCT lel_child_ents.ent_id
	FROM line_ent_link lel_child_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN
		--Retreive all the lines that have entities that are defined as parents to lines
		(SELECT lel.line_id
		FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Limit to entities that are defined as parents to lines
		WHERE lel.line_is_child = 1
		) parent_ent_for_line ON lel_child_ents.line_id = parent_ent_for_line.line_id
	--Limit to entities that are descendant to lines
	WHERE lel_child_ents.line_is_child = 0
	) line_ents
	--Limit to all the descendant entities that are in a line AND that line has at least one entity marked as parent of a line.
	WHERE se.ent_id = line_ents.ent_id

	--Capture the entities that are immediate parents to the line.
	INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, tree_level, can_capture_labor, can_capture_util,
			 can_sched_shifts, can_capture_qm_data, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local, line_id)
	SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_capture_util,
			 e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, lel.line_id
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = lel.ent_id
	--Limit to the supplied entity.
	WHERE lel.ent_id = @ent_id
	--The supplied entity is parent to the line
	  AND lel.line_is_child = 1
	UNION
	SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_capture_util,
			 e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, lel.line_id
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = lel.ent_id
	--Limit to the entities that are parents to lines and either they have shift schedules or they inherit from their ancestors.
	INNER JOIN @shift_entities se ON lel.ent_id = se.ent_id
	--Limit to the entities that are immediate parentes to the line.
	WHERE lel.line_is_child = 1

	SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
	--Retrieve all entities that are descendants to the line.
	INSERT INTO @shift_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, tree_level, can_capture_labor, can_capture_util,
			can_sched_shifts, can_capture_qm_data, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_start_time_local, line_id)
	SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_capture_util,
			e.can_sched_shifts, e.can_capture_qm_data, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, lel.line_id
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = lel.ent_id
	--Limit to lines that are descendants of the entity hierarchy
	INNER JOIN @shift_entities se ON lel.line_id = se.line_id
	--Limit to entities that are child to a line.
	WHERE lel.line_is_child = 0
	--Only include entities that need shifts to be inherited from its parents.
	  AND e.can_sched_shifts = 0

	--If an entity is not the top-most entity, then that entity may appear as a descendant to another entity in the @shift_entities temporary table.
	--So, if an entity that is not the top-most entity and that entity is a parent of a line, then that entity information is added twice to the temporary table.
	--Remove the duplicate entities that do not have line_id.
	DELETE se
	FROM
	@shift_entities se,
		--Select the list of entities that has duplicate rows
		(SELECT ent_id
		 FROM @shift_entities parent_ents
		 GROUP BY ent_id
		 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
		) line_parents
	WHERE se.ent_id = line_parents.ent_id
	--Remove the entities whose line ID is null
	  AND se.line_id IS NULL

	--Loop through all the child entities; and change the shifts for all the childs.
	DECLARE csr_ent_shift_change CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT se.ent_id, se.can_capture_labor, se.can_capture_util, se.can_sched_shifts, se.can_capture_qm_data, e.can_capture_labor, e.can_log_data, e.can_run_jobs
	, se.cur_shift_id, se.cur_shift_start_time_local
	FROM @shift_entities se
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = se.ent_id
	WHERE se.ent_id <>  @ent_id

	OPEN csr_ent_shift_change
	WHILE (1 =1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM csr_ent_shift_change into @ent_id, @can_capture_labor, @can_capture_util,
			@can_sched_shifts, @can_capture_qm_data, @can_capture_labor, @can_log_data, @can_run_jobs,
			@cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_local
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Derive the previous shift start time for this entity in terms of client time zone.
--		SET @prev_shift_start_local = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @cur_shift_start_local)

		IF (@shift_start_utc <> @cur_shift_start_utc) BEGIN
			--Therefore, verify whether there are any dependant records for this entity to defer the shift change for this entity.
			--If not, inherit the shifts from the nearest ancestor immediately, if this entity cannot schedule shifts.
			IF (@can_capture_labor = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
			  OR (@can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_16 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
			  OR (@can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_48 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
			  OR (@can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
			  OR (@can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_start_utc > @shift_start_utc))
				--This entity has at least one record exists for: labor or data log or production or consumption
				--Therefore, defer to update the shift schedule for the entity.
				CONTINUE
		END

		IF (@cur_shift_id <> @shift_id OR @cur_shift_start_local <> @shift_start) BEGIN

			UPDATE ent
			SET	cur_shift_id = @shift_id,
				cur_shift_start_time_local = @shift_start,
				cur_shift_start_time_utc = @shift_start_utc,
                cur_shift_end_time_local = @shift_end,
                cur_shift_end_time_utc = @shift_end_time_utc
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Error updating current shift data in ent table{3227}', 16, 1)
				RETURN @@error
			END

			--Record the shift end details, so that the Factelligence Service can execute the shift-end export later.
            SET @queue_detail = '<request><ent_id>' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @ent_id ) + '</ent_id><parameters>'
            SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="ent_id" value="' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @ent_id ) + '"></parameter>'
            SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '<parameter name="shift_id" value="' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @shift_id ) + '"></parameter>'
            SET @queue_detail = @queue_detail + '</parameters></request>'

            --Insert the shift end details in the dx_queue table.
            INSERT INTO dx_queue (inserted_at, activity_type, details)
            VALUES ( @v_current_time_utc, 1, @queue_detail)

		IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 1)
			INSERT INTO qm_context (context_ent_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, is_job_running, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			VALUES (NULL, @ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, 2, 'admin', @shift_start_utc)

		IF (@can_capture_util = 1) BEGIN
			--Default the variables to null
			SELECT @shift_start_reas_cd = NULL, @shift_end_reas_cd = NULL, @shift_reas_cd = NULL

			--This entity is capable of capturing utilization.
			--Determine whether there is any shift start/end reason code configured
			SELECT @shift_start_reas_cd = ue.shift_start_reas_cd, @shift_end_reas_cd = ue.shift_end_reas_cd
			FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ue.ent_id = @ent_id

			-- Default to no shift reason configured
			SELECT @shift_reas_cd = NULL, @last_edit_comment = NULL

			IF (@shift_id > 0 AND @shift_start_reas_cd IS NOT NULL)
				--A shift id greater than zero is a valid shift and a shift start reason code is configured
				SELECT @shift_reas_cd = @shift_start_reas_cd, @last_edit_comment = 'Ent.StartShift(shift start reason code)'

			IF (@shift_reas_cd IS NULL AND @shift_end_reas_cd IS NOT NULL)
				--There is no shift start reason code configured
				--A shift has ended and it has a shift end reason code configured
				SELECT @shift_reas_cd = @shift_end_reas_cd, @last_edit_comment = 'Ent.StartShift(shift end reason code)'

			IF (@shift_reas_cd IS NOT NULL) --There is a valid shift start/end reason code configured for the entity
				EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@shift_start_utc, @reas_cd=@shift_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0
					, @comments=NULL, @raw_reas_cd=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
					, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
					, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @update_if_exists=1
					, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=NULL
		END

            -- Added for the CR L00116544 Clone (L00109354(HF# 2291))
			--Create a new labor usage record for this entity.
			EXEC sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewShift @ent_id, @shift_id, @shift_start, @time_zone_bias_value
              BEGIN TRY
            UPDATE labor_usage
            SET shift_id = @shift_id, shift_start_local = @shift_start
            WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
            AND labor_start_local >= @shift_start;
		    END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH

            END CATCH

		END
	END
	CLOSE csr_ent_shift_change
	DEALLOCATE csr_ent_shift_change

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_consumption_LiquorLoad
-- Description:  Returns the consumption for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  lp			2023-07-25		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  lp			2023-08-30		   Added extra condition for Liquor blend
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE               PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_consumption_LiquorLoad] as
begin
    Declare @row_id int, @ent_id int, @storage_locn VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON


	BEGIN TRY
	declare @itemgrp nvarchar(40), @nibslot nvarchar(40), @nibsSublot nvarchar(40), @nibsConsQty float, @nibsOrder nvarchar(40),@nibsTotalCons float

	SET @ent_id = -1


	--Ap: 22-Feb-2023 - added filter for pack class, also beans are excluded, it will be reported as part of nibs.
    SELECT TOP 1	@row_id = ic.row_id,
					@ent_id = ic.from_ent_id, 
					@itemgrp=ia.attr_value, 
					@nibslot=ic.lot_no, 
					@nibsSublot=ic.sublot_no, 
					@nibsTotalCons = qty_cons,
					@nibsConsQty=qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0),
					@nibsOrder = ic.wo_id
	  
	  FROM				item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	  INNER join		item i								on ic.item_id = i.item_id
	  INNER JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia with(nolock)			ON ia.item_id=i.item_id 															
															AND ( ic.oper_id like 'LiqLoad' ) -- 0.01.01
    -- LEFT JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia1 with(nolock)			ON ia1.item_id=i.item_id	-- (KN 21Jul23 - Get only items which don't have the attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set for them)
														--	AND ia1.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting')
	 LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK)
															ON ie.item_id = i.item_id 
															AND ie.wo_id = ic.wo_id	--(KN 28Jun23 - Added join condition to return rows based on work order)

		WHERE	qty_cons_erp < qty_cons 
				AND i.item_class_id <> UPPER('PACK')
				AND (
				(UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('WIP') OR (UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('INTERMEDIATE')) AND IA.attr_VALUE LIKE '%NIBS'  or IA.attr_VALUE LIKE '%liquor' )-- 0.01.01
				--or  (UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('WIP') AND UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('INTERMEDIATE'))
				)	---Pick WIP item only if it is NIBS
				AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1  AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
				
	 
		ORDER by ic.created_at_local asc




	
			BEGIN

					print 'nibs'

					IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#beansConsRows') IS NOT NULL
						BEGIN
						DROP TABLE #beansConsRows
						END

					----------------
					--AP: 23-FEB; BEANS Reporting on nibs consumption
					------------
					DECLARE  @NibsProdQty float,@NibsConsPercent float, @beansRowId int=-1, @beansQty float,@qty_cons_erp float,@beans_already_reported float
					

					--Step 1 - find out total nibs produced in the given sublot and how much percentage nibs are getting consumed
						select @NibsProdQty = sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),  @NibsConsPercent = case when round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod),3)>1 then 1 
						else round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),3) end
						from item_prod ip with(nolock)
						where ip.lot_no=@nibslot and ip.sublot_no=@nibsSublot


					--Step 2 Find out total beans consumed, and beans to be reported based on the consumed nibs percentage

					Declare @totalBeanCons float,@created_at_local datetime, @beansQtyToBeReported float, @beansDeclared float
					set @beansDeclared=0
					select @totalBeanCons= Sum(ic.qty_cons),@beans_already_reported=sum(qty_cons_erp) from item_cons ic with(nolock) -- (KN 21-Apr Finding Beans consumption from item_cons)
					where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot--and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp

					SET @beansQtyToBeReported = round(@totalBeanCons * @NibsConsPercent,3)

					--Step 3 - Get all the relevent consumption record in temp table 

					select qty_cons,qty_cons_erp,lot_no,sublot_no,row_id,  spare1,  spare3, created_at_local,fg_lot_no, fg_sublot_no
						into #beansConsRows
					from item_cons with(nolock)

				--	where  DATEDIFF(ss,@created_at_local,created_at_local)<=60
					where fg_lot_no=@nibslot and fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp and CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float)=0
					--select @beansQtyToBeReported, @totalBeanCons, @NibsConsPercent,  @NibsProdQty
					
					select * from #beansConsRows
					
					While @beansQtyToBeReported > @beansDeclared AND (@beansQtyToBeReported - @beansDeclared)>0.001
					begin 

						IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#tempBeansConsRows') IS NOT NULL
						BEGIN
						DROP TABLE #tempBeansConsRows
						END
						
												SET @beansRowId = -1;

							select top 1 @beansRowId=row_id,@beansQty = qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@created_at_local=created_at_local 
							from #beansConsRows ic with(nolock)
							where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot 
							and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp and CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)=0
							and isnull(spare3,'0') <>'-1'
							order by created_at_local asc
							
							--select @beansRowId

							Declare @spare1 float;
							
							select qty_cons,qty_cons_erp,lot_no,sublot_no,row_id,  spare1   into #tempBeansConsRows
							from #beansConsRows with(nolock)
							where  DATEDIFF(ss,@created_at_local,created_at_local)<=180
							and fg_lot_no=@nibslot and fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp and CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float)=0
							and isnull(spare3,'0') <>'-1'
							 select @spare1=CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float) from #tempBeansConsRows
							 
							 IF  @spare1<>0.0
							 BEGIN
							 select * from #tempBeansConsRows 
							 END

				
							declare @totalBeansForConsRows float, @totalSAPForConsRows float, @beanreportedper float

							select @totalBeansForConsRows =sum(qty_cons), @totalSAPForConsRows=sum(qty_cons_erp) from #tempBeansConsRows
					
							--Calculate ratio for beans
							Update #tempBeansConsRows set spare1 = case when (((@beansQtyToBeReported-@beansDeclared)/@totalBeansForConsRows)*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
																			then (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
																		else (((@beansQtyToBeReported-@beansDeclared)/@totalBeansForConsRows)*qty_cons) 
																		end
													--	, spare3='-1'
							--Total how much reported 
							declare @cycleSum float
							select @cycleSum = sum(CAST (isnull(spare1,'0') AS float)) from #tempBeansConsRows
							set @beansDeclared = @beansDeclared+@cycleSum

								update #beansConsRows
								set spare1 = s.spare1
								from #beansConsRows ic
								inner join #tempBeansConsRows s on
								ic.row_id = s.row_id
								SELECT * FROM #tempBeansConsRows
					end

				/**	update item_cons
					set spare1 = s.spare1
					from item_cons ic
					inner join #beansConsRows s on
					ic.row_id = s.row_id

					UPDATE ITEM_CONS SET qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @nibsConsQty WHERE row_id = @row_id*/
			END



	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes]
(@ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
,@start_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = NULL OUTPUT
,@end_time_utc			TDATETIME2 = NULL OUTPUT
,@prod_start_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes
-- Description	      -	The purpose of this stored procedure is to determine the start and end time based on the supplied time units, so that the logic is not sprinkled in multiple stored procedures
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	10/12/2016
-- Version	      - 5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 11/30/2017	Raghu G		6.0	UserStory-714529 - [Enhancement] As SE, I want to fix CR L00138956 so that OEE values are returned for short time periods without distinct production records
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE	@event_start_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME2 = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	,@event_end_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(4000)

	,@distinct_good_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@distinct_reject_prod	NVARCHAR(1)

BEGIN
	IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN -- Raise an error if the supplied entity is null
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},ENT_ID'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@filter_time_unit IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@filter_time_unit < 0 OR @filter_time_unit > 5) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_TIME_UNIT,0,5'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF (@filter_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},FILTER_START_TIME'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE IF (@filter_start_time < COALESCE(@filter_end_time, 0)) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = '%1 must be greater than %2.{2030},FILTER_END_TIME,FILTER_START_TIME'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	SELECT @filter_start_time = COALESCE(@filter_start_time, 1) -- Default the start time to current, if none is supplied
		, @filter_end_time = COALESCE(@filter_end_time, 0) -- Default the end time to current, if none is supplied

	--The end time is inclusive of the end time range.  For example, shift1: 6a-2p, shift2:2p-10p.
	--When the data for shift1 is requested, the end time includes 2p, so the duration can be calculated up to 2p.
	--For example, the duration from 1p to 2p will be 3600 only if 2p is included; otherwise the duration will be 3599.
	--It is up to the calling methods to whether or not to ignore events at 2p.
	IF (@filter_time_unit <> 1) BEGIN
		--Filter using timer periods, and NOT by using shift.

		;WITH current_local_times (curr_local_time, curr_local_time_start_day, curr_local_time_end_day) AS
		(
			SELECT dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @current_time_utc) AS curr_local_time
			, CAST(CAST(dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @current_time_utc) AS DATE) AS DATETIME) AS curr_local_time_start_day
			--Start from the current day, add 1 day (moves to next day), trim to the start of the day (next day), reduce 1 second to determine the end of the current day
			, DATEADD(DD, 1, CAST(CAST(dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @current_time_utc) AS DATE) AS DATETIME)) AS curr_local_time_end_day
		)
		SELECT @event_start_utc = CASE WHEN @filter_time_unit = 0 THEN -- Hour
			--Use UTC times to limit the data, since limiting the number of hours using local times may vary during DST change.
				COALESCE(DATEADD(hh, -@filter_start_time, @current_time_utc), @current_time_utc)
			WHEN @filter_time_unit = 2 THEN -- Day
				dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(DD, -@filter_start_time+1, clt.curr_local_time_start_day), @current_time_utc)
			WHEN @filter_time_unit = 3 THEN -- Week
				dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(WK, -@filter_start_time+1, DATEADD(DD, 1 - DATEPART(DW, clt.curr_local_time_start_day), clt.curr_local_time_start_day)), @current_time_utc)
			WHEN @filter_time_unit = 4 THEN -- Month
				dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(M, -@filter_start_time+1, DATEADD(M, DATEDIFF(M, 0, clt.curr_local_time), 0)), @current_time_utc)
			WHEN @filter_time_unit = 5 THEN -- Year
				dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(YY, -@filter_start_time+1, DATEADD(YY, DATEDIFF(YY, 0, clt.curr_local_time), 0)), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, clt.curr_local_time, @current_time_utc)
			END
			, @event_end_utc = CASE WHEN @filter_time_unit = 0 THEN -- Hour
				--Use UTC times to limit the data, since limiting the number of hours using local times may vary during DST change.
					DATEADD(hh, -@filter_end_time, @current_time_utc)
				WHEN @filter_time_unit = 2 THEN -- Day
					--Reduce the number of days from the current end of the day
					dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(DD, -@filter_end_time, clt.curr_local_time_end_day), @current_time_utc)
				WHEN @filter_time_unit = 3 THEN -- Week
					--Start from the current day, add 1 week (date moves to next week), reduce the days to the beginning of the week (date moves to the beginning of next week)
					--Reduce 1 second from the beginning of next week (date moves back to the end of current week)
					--Reduce the number of weeks from the end of current week
					dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(WK, -@filter_end_time, DATEADD(SS, -0, DATEADD(DD, -DATEPART(DW, clt.curr_local_time_start_day)+1, DATEADD(WK, 1, clt.curr_local_time_start_day)))), @current_time_utc)
				WHEN @filter_time_unit = 4 THEN -- Month
					dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(SS, -0, DATEADD(M, -@filter_end_time, DATEADD(M, 1, DATEADD(M, DATEDIFF(M, 0, clt.curr_local_time), 0)))), @current_time_utc)
				WHEN @filter_time_unit = 5 THEN -- Year
					dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, DATEADD(SS, -0, DATEADD(YY, -@filter_end_time, DATEADD(YY, 1, DATEADD(YY, DATEDIFF(YY, 0, clt.curr_local_time), 0)))), @current_time_utc)
				ELSE dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, clt.curr_local_time, @current_time_utc)
			END
		FROM current_local_times clt
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Find the range of shifts that needs to be used to report KPI type data.
		SELECT @event_start_utc = MAX(CASE WHEN shifts_with_id.rowiden = @filter_start_time-1 THEN shifts_with_id.shift_start_utc ELSE NULL END)
			,@event_end_utc = MAX(CASE WHEN rowiden = @filter_end_time-1 THEN shifts_with_id.shift_start_utc ELSE NULL END)
		FROM
			(SELECT sh.shift_start_utc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC)-1 AS rowiden
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			) AS shifts_with_id

		IF (@filter_end_time = 0) SET @event_end_utc = @current_time_utc
	END

	SELECT @start_time_utc = COALESCE(@event_start_utc, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120)), @end_time_utc = COALESCE(@event_end_utc, @current_time_utc)

	--Get the distinct good production flag
	SELECT @distinct_good_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 362

	--Get the distinct reject production flag
	SELECT @distinct_reject_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 309

	--The time filter is hour (i.e. filter time unit is 0)
	--If the distinct good production and distinct reject projection are not true, reset the starting time to the top of the hour
	--since the production quantities are rolled up to the top of the hour.
	IF @filter_time_unit = 0 AND NOT (@distinct_good_prod = '1' AND @distinct_reject_prod = '1')
		SET @prod_start_time_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @start_time_utc),0)

	--Default to the calculated start time if production start time cannot be identified from above
	SET @prod_start_time_utc = COALESCE(@prod_start_time_utc, @start_time_utc)
END

CREATE Trigger [tg_process_attr_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[process_attr]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_process_attr_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on Process_Attr  table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE process_attr_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM deleted b
	OPEN process_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM process_attr_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},process_attr', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE process_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE process_attr_cursor
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_lm_label_manual_job_produce
-- Description:	Insert Label from Layout from manual job produce
--
-- Usage:	Insert Label from Layout from manual job produce
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-11			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00	XPM, AML	2026-20-02			Deleted the synonym logic. 
-- 0.03.00	XPM, AML	2026-06-03			No longer used.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label_manual_job_produce] 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
	,@ip_row_id INT
	,@layout_name NVARCHAR(100)
	,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@print_qty INT = NULL
	,@lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)=NULL OUTPUT
	
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	-- declare temp table to get show kosher value 
	DECLARE @layoutTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,value NVARCHAR(50));
	DECLARE @paramTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,paramName NVARCHAR(255),paramValue nvarchar(255),tableName nvarchar(255) );
		-- declare variables used in MES mapping 
	DECLARE  @layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100)	=	NULL			
			,@layout_id	NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@showkosher BIT = 0
			,@hidekosher BIT = 1
			,@splitCount INT = 0			
			,@maxRowCnt INT
			,@overlayDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL
			,@TypeOfLblContent INT=2
			,@swHasCustomerRichText INT=0
			,@jobGrpId INT=5 -- 5 job_attr group
			,@swShowCustomerDetails INT
			,@hu NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@trigger_type  NVARCHAR(100)='manual'
			,@trigger_from NVARCHAR(100)='produce_trigger'
			,@item_grade_cd INT = NULL
			,@item_reas_cd INT = NULL
			,@item_grade_desc NVARCHAR(200)= NULL
			,@label_header NVARCHAR(200)= NULL
			,@swIsReject BIT=0
			,@swIsBigBag BIT=0
			,@raw_ent_id int
			,@actl_ent_id int
			,@raw_attr_value nvarchar(50)
			,@defaultShelfLife INT=0
			,@defShelfCnt INT=0
			,@HUGenrationTime Date 
			,@expiry_date_null NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@expiry_date_count INT=NULL
			,@expiry_date NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@expireItemId NVARCHAR(100)		=	NULL
			,@expireLot NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@bag_weight_qty FLOAT
			,@bigBagCount INT = 0
			,@bigBagAttrValue INT=0
			,@item_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@itemUOM NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@swShowLB INT = 0
			,@itemLifetime INT=0
			;
			--,@row_id INT;
			
			-- get @hu
		
		Select @item_grade_cd= ip.grade_cd
		,@item_reas_cd= ip.reas_cd
		,@hu= ip.spare2
		FROM item_prod ip with(nolock)
		WHERE row_id=@ip_row_id

		--select @hu
			-- using attr_id find values 
		SELECT @overlayDetails = ja.attr_value 
		FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
							FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
							WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId)
		AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no



		SELECT @TypeOfLblContent= CAST(ja.attr_value AS INT )
		FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
							FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
							WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId)
		AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no

			--based on values set flag
		
		
		IF(@overlayDetails IS NOT NULL OR @overlayDetails !='')
		BEGIN
		
		IF(@TypeOfLblContent = 2)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 1;
		END
		ELSE IF(@TypeOfLblContent = 1)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 2;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 0;
		END
		
		END
		

		-- get expiry date
		select @expireLot=owe.lot_no
			 ,@expireItemId=owe.item_id
			 ,@item_id=owe.item_id
		from ofi_wo_ext owe with(nolock)
		where owe.wo_id=@wo_id

		--fetch default value from mapping for expiry , and if that is null set getdate

		select @itemLifetime=i.lifetime
		FROM item i with(nolock)
		where i.item_id=@item_id

		select @expiry_date_null=default_value from ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping ollam with(nolock)
		where ollam.as_value = 'BestBeforeDateFormatted' and ollam.layout_name=@layout_name

		select  @expiry_date_count= count(ii.expiry_date )
		from item_inv ii with(nolock)
		where ii.lot_no = @expireLot and ii.item_id=@expireItemId and ii.wo_id=@wo_id and ii.oper_id=@oper_id and ii.seq_no=@seq_no

		if(@itemLifetime > 0)
		BEGIN
		select @HUGenrationTime= CAST(min(created_at_local)AS DATE) from item_prod ip
				where ip.spare2 = @hu

		IF(@HUGenrationTime is null OR  @HUGenrationTime='')
		BEGIN
		select @HUGenrationTime =getdate()
		END

			select  @expiry_date =FORMAT( DATEADD(DAY, @itemLifetime, @HUGenrationTime), 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
				SELECT @raw_ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
				FROM JOB j WITH(NOLOCK)
				where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no


				select @raw_attr_value=ea.attr_value
				from ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
				where ea.ent_id=@raw_ent_id and ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
												   from attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
												   where a.attr_desc like '%EntityType%')

				IF(@raw_attr_value ='Segment')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id
					FROM ent e with(nolock)
					where e.ent_id=@raw_ent_id
				END
				ELSE IF(@raw_attr_value ='Line')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id=@raw_ent_id
				END

				select @defShelfCnt= count(ea.attr_value)  
				from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
				where ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
									from attr a with(nolock)
									where a.attr_desc ='DefaultShelfLife')
				and ea.ent_id=@actl_ent_id

				if(@defShelfCnt > 0)
				BEGIN
					select @defaultShelfLife=ea.attr_value  
					from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
					where ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
										from attr a with(nolock)
										where a.attr_desc ='DefaultShelfLife')
					and ea.ent_id=@actl_ent_id

					select @HUGenrationTime= CAST(min(created_at_local)AS DATE) from item_prod ip
					where ip.spare2 = @hu

					
					if(@HUGenrationTime is null OR @HUGenrationTime='')
					BEGIN
					select @HUGenrationTime=getdate()
					END

					select  @expiry_date =FORMAT( dateADD(day,@defaultShelfLife,@HUGenrationTime), 'dd-MM-yyyy')
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
				select  @expiry_date =NULL;
				END

		END
		select @expiry_date

		

	SELECT @label_header = ig.item_grade_desc
	FROM item_grade ig WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ig.item_grade_cd=@item_grade_cd

	IF(@item_grade_cd = 2 OR @item_grade_cd = 0 )
	BEGIN
	SELECT @swIsReject=0
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	SELECT @swIsReject=1
	END


		select @bigBagCount=count(1) from item_attr ia with(nolock)
		where ia.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id
							FROM attr a with(nolock)
							where a.attr_desc = 'IsBigBag')
		AND ia.item_id=@item_id

		IF(@bigBagCount > 0)
	BEGIN
	select @bigBagAttrValue = ia.attr_value 
	from item_attr ia with(nolock)
	where ia.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id
						FROM attr a with(nolock)
						where a.attr_desc like 'IsBigBag')
	AND ia.item_id=@item_id
	END

	IF(@bigBagAttrValue = 1)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swIsBigBag=1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT @swIsBigBag=0
		END

	-- get bag weigh
		if(@swIsBigBag = '0')
		BEGIN		
		
			select @bag_weight_qty=ia.attr_value 
			from item_attr ia with(nolock)
			where ia.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
								 FROM attr a with(nolock)
								 where a.attr_desc like 'BagWeight')
			AND ia.item_id=@item_id
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN			
				IF (@swIsReject = 0)
				BEGIN				

				SELECT @hu=ip.spare2
				FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ip.wo_id=@wo_id AND ip.oper_id=@oper_id AND ip.seq_no=@seq_no AND ip.row_id=@ip_row_id
					
					select @bag_weight_qty = cast(sum(ip.qty_prod ) as FLOAT)
					from item_prod ip with(nolock)
					where ip.wo_id=@wo_id and ip.oper_id=@oper_id and ip.seq_no=@seq_no 
					and  ip.spare2 = @hu 
					and ip.good_prod = 1
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN	

				SELECT @hu=ip.spare2
				FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ip.wo_id=@wo_id AND ip.oper_id=@oper_id AND ip.seq_no=@seq_no AND ip.row_id=@ip_row_id
					
					select @bag_weight_qty = cast(sum(ip.qty_prod ) as FLOAT)
					from item_prod ip with(nolock)
					where ip.wo_id=@wo_id and ip.oper_id=@oper_id and ip.seq_no=@seq_no and  ip.spare2= @hu and ip.good_prod = 0

				END
		END
		select @bag_weight_qty as bag_w
			-- set kosher value
		IF(@showkosher = '1')
	BEGIN
		SET @hidekosher= '0'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @hidekosher= '1'
	END

	--get item UOM
		select @itemUOM=LOWER(u.description)
		from uom u with(nolock)
		inner join item i on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
		inner join ofi_wo_ext owe on owe.item_id=i.item_id and owe.wo_id=@wo_id

		if(@itemUOM = 'kg')
		begin
		select @swShowLB = 0
		end
		else
		begin
			if(@itemUOM = 'lb')
			begin
			select @swShowLB = 1
			end
			else
			begin
			select @swShowLB = 0
			end			
		end

	

	SELECT @maxRowCnt= @ip_row_id ;

	
	
	INSERT INTO @paramTable(paramName,paramValue,tableName)
	SELECT paramName, paramValue,'job' as tableName
	FROM ( SELECT CAST(wo_id as nvarchar(255)) as wo_id
				 ,CAST(oper_id as nvarchar(255)) as oper_id
				 ,CAST(seq_no as nvarchar(255)) as seq_no
				 ,CAST(job_desc as nvarchar(255)) as job_desc
				 ,CAST(item_id as nvarchar(255)) as item_id
				 ,CAST(state_cd as nvarchar(255)) as state_cd
				 ,CAST(job_priority as nvarchar(255)) as job_priority
				 ,CAST(req_finish_time_utc as nvarchar(255)) as req_finish_time_utc
				 ,CAST(req_finish_time_local as nvarchar(255)) as req_finish_time_local
				 ,CAST(init_sched_ent_id as nvarchar(255)) as init_sched_ent_id
				 ,CAST(target_sched_ent_id as nvarchar(255)) as target_sched_ent_id
				 ,CAST(run_ent_id as nvarchar(255)) as run_ent_id
				 ,CAST(qty_reqd as nvarchar(255)) as qty_reqd
				 ,CAST(qty_prod as nvarchar(255)) as qty_prod
				 ,CAST(qty_prod_erp as nvarchar(255)) as qty_prod_erp
				 ,CAST(qty_rejected as nvarchar(255)) as qty_rejected
				 ,CAST(qty_rejected_erp as nvarchar(255)) as qty_rejected_erp
				 ,CAST(qty_at_start as nvarchar(255)) as qty_at_start
				 ,CAST(deviation_above as nvarchar(255)) as deviation_above
				 ,CAST(deviation_below as nvarchar(255)) as deviation_below
				 ,CAST(batch_size as nvarchar(255)) as batch_size
				 ,CAST(uom_id as nvarchar(255)) as uom_id
				 ,CAST(first_job as nvarchar(255)) as first_job
				 ,CAST(final_job as nvarchar(255)) as final_job
				 ,CAST(sched_pinned as nvarchar(255)) as sched_pinned
				 ,CAST(check_inv as nvarchar(255)) as check_inv
				 ,CAST(est_fixed_lab as nvarchar(255)) as est_fixed_lab
				 ,CAST(est_lab_rate as nvarchar(255)) as est_lab_rate
				 ,CAST(est_setup_time as nvarchar(255)) as est_setup_time
				 ,CAST(est_teardown_time as nvarchar(255)) as est_teardown_time
				 ,CAST(est_prod_rate as nvarchar(255)) as est_prod_rate
				 ,CAST(prod_uom as nvarchar(255)) as prod_uom
				 ,CAST(est_transfer_time as nvarchar(255)) as est_transfer_time
				 ,CAST(sched_start_time_utc as nvarchar(255)) as sched_start_time_utc
				 ,CAST(sched_start_time_local as nvarchar(255)) as sched_start_time_local
				 ,CAST(latest_start_time_utc as nvarchar(255)) as latest_start_time_utc
				 ,CAST(latest_start_time_local as nvarchar(255)) as latest_start_time_local
				 ,CAST(sched_finish_time_utc as nvarchar(255)) as sched_finish_time_utc
				 ,CAST(sched_finish_time_local as nvarchar(255)) as sched_finish_time_local
				 ,CAST(act_start_time_utc as nvarchar(255)) as act_start_time_utc
				 ,CAST(act_start_time_local as nvarchar(255)) as act_start_time_local
				 ,CAST(act_finish_time_utc as nvarchar(255)) as act_finish_time_utc
				 ,CAST(act_finish_time_local as nvarchar(255)) as act_finish_time_local
				 ,CAST(concurrent_link as nvarchar(255)) as concurrent_link
				 ,CAST(job_cost as nvarchar(255)) as job_cost
				 ,CAST(parent_contingent_job as nvarchar(255)) as parent_contingent_job
				 ,CAST(child_contingent_job as nvarchar(255)) as child_contingent_job
				 ,CAST(notes as nvarchar(255)) as notes
				 ,CAST(assoc_file as nvarchar(255)) as assoc_file
				 ,CAST(assoc_file_type as nvarchar(255)) as assoc_file_type
				 ,CAST(status_notes as nvarchar(255)) as status_notes
				 ,CAST(display_seq as nvarchar(255)) as display_seq
				 ,CAST(folder_ver_id as nvarchar(255)) as folder_ver_id
				 ,CAST(rework as nvarchar(255)) as rework
				 ,CAST(rework_cd as nvarchar(255)) as rework_cd
				 ,CAST(rework_process_id as nvarchar(255)) as rework_process_id
				 ,CAST(spare1 as nvarchar(255)) as spare1
				 ,CAST(spare2 as nvarchar(255)) as spare2
				 ,CAST(spare3 as nvarchar(255)) as spare3
				 ,CAST(spare4 as nvarchar(255)) as spare4
				 ,CAST(last_edit_comment as nvarchar(255)) as last_edit_comment
				 ,CAST(edited_by as nvarchar(255)) as edited_by
				 ,CAST(edit_time as nvarchar(255)) as edit_time
				 ,CAST(row_id as nvarchar(255)) as row_id
	FROM job j with(nolock) WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id=@oper_id AND j.seq_no=@seq_no) a
	UNPIVOT(paramValue FOR paramName IN (wo_id
										,oper_id
										,seq_no
										,job_desc
										,item_id
										,state_cd
										,job_priority
										,req_finish_time_utc
										,req_finish_time_local
										,init_sched_ent_id
										,target_sched_ent_id
										,run_ent_id
										,qty_reqd
										,qty_prod
										,qty_prod_erp
										,qty_rejected
										,qty_rejected_erp

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Folder_Remove]
(@item_id	STRING40
,@oper_id	STRING40 = NULL
,@ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,@ver_id	STRING40 = NULL
,@oper_desc	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Folder_Remove
-- Description	      - HD# 8907,Removes a folder(s) depending upon the supplied parameters
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 10/05/2006
-- Version		- 3.1.2.23
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
DECLARE @disallow_delete	INT32
	,@preferred_ver		LOGICAL
	,@folder_count		INT32

	--Verify whether we are allowed to delete a folder.
	SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value
	FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 196

	IF (@disallow_delete = 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Deleting data from %1 is not allowed{3863},Folder', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the item_id and the oper_id is supplied; else all folders for this item will be deleted.
	IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--All the folders that are tied to an operation group (with/without a description) is being deleted,
		--or the folders that are tied to an entity being deleted,
		--or a specific version that is tied to a group is being deleted.

		--First, verify the level of folder that is being deleted.
		IF (@ver_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--This is the lowest level in a folder that is being deleted.

			--Verify whether this version of folder is a preferred version. If yes, then do no allow this folder to delete unless this is the only folder remains.
			SELECT TOP 1 @preferred_ver = preferred_ver
			FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id = @ver_id

			--Verify whether this folder is marked as a preferred version
			IF (@preferred_ver = 1) BEGIN
				--Since this folder is marked as a preferred version, then verify there are no other folder exist
				SELECT @folder_count = COUNT(*)
				FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE item_id = @item_id
				  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
				  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id

				--Verify whether any other folder exists (in this operation group); do not allow this folder to delete unless this is the only folder that exist.
				--disallow the deletion of a folder where preferred_ver is true unless there is no more than one other folder for the given item, operation, and entity
				IF (@folder_count > 1) BEGIN
					RAISERROR('Cannot delete a preferred version. Please select another version as preferred before deleting.{1868}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE IF (@folder_count = 0) BEGIN
					--There are no other folders in this operation group.
					--Verify whethere there are any folders in the other operation group, and a folder deletion should be allowed
					--only when there are no more than one folder in the other group as well.
					SET @folder_count = 0

					SELECT @folder_count = COUNT(*)
					FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE f.item_id = @item_id
					  AND (f.oper_id = @oper_id AND COALESCE(f.oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET'))
					  AND f.ent_id = @ent_id

					IF (@folder_count = 1)
						--Since there is only one folder exist in the other groups other than the selected folder, automatically set the other folder in the other group as the preferred version.
						UPDATE folder SET preferred_ver = 1
						WHERE item_id = @item_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
						  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id
					ELSE IF (@folder_count > 1) BEGIN
						--There are folders in the other operation group(s). Do not allow the folder to delete until a preferred version is set.
						RAISERROR('What you are trying to delete includes at least one preferred version of a folder for a given combination of operation and entity, and there is more than one other folder for this combination that is assigned a different operation description.,  Please set one of these folders for each such combination with a different operation description as the preferred version.{5073}', 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END
				END
				ELSE IF (@folder_count = 1)
					--Since there is only one folder exist other than the selected folder, automatically set the other folder as the preferred version.
					UPDATE folder SET preferred_ver = 1
					WHERE item_id = @item_id
					  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
					  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id
			END
		END	--A folder identified at a version level (ver_id) is being deleted.

		ELSE IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN -- A folder identified at an entity level is being deleted.
			--Verify whether any preferred version exist for this entity (from this operation group).
			SELECT TOP 1 @preferred_ver = preferred_ver
			FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND preferred_ver = 1

			--Verify whether there is any one folder that is marked as a preferred version (from this operation group).
			IF (@preferred_ver = 1) BEGIN
				--There is a folder marked as a preferred version in this operation group, then verify there are no other folders exist in the other operation group.
				--Verify whethere there are any folders in the other operation group, and a folder deletion should be allowed
				--only when there are no other folders in the other group as well.
				SET @folder_count = 0

				SELECT @folder_count = COUNT(*)
				FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE f.item_id = @item_id
				  AND (f.oper_id = @oper_id AND COALESCE(f.oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET'))
				  AND f.ent_id = @ent_id

				IF (@folder_count = 1)
					--Since there is only one folder exist in the other groups other than the selected folder, automatically set the other folder in the other group as the preferred version.
					UPDATE folder SET preferred_ver = 1
					WHERE item_id = @item_id
					  AND (oper_id = @oper_id AND COALESCE(oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET'))
					  AND ent_id = @ent_id
				ELSE IF (@folder_count > 1) BEGIN
					--There are folders in the other operation group(s). Do not allow the folder to delete until a preferred version is set.
--					SET @err_desc = 'Cannot delete a preferred version from this operation group, beacause there are folder(s) in the operation group:' + COALESCE(@grp_oper_desc, 'NO OPERATION DESCRIPTION') + ' for entity:' + @grp_ent_name + '. Please select another version from the other group as preferred before deleting this operation group.'
					RAISERROR('What you are trying to delete includes at least one preferred version of a folder for a given combination of operation and entity, and there is more than one other folder for this combination that is assigned a different operation description.,  Please set one of these folders for each such combination with a different operation description as the preferred version.{5073}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
			END
		END -- A folder identified at an entity level is being deleted.

		ELSE IF (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN -- A folder identified at an operation level is being deleted.
			--Now, allow to delete the operation group only if
			--i) None of the entities in this operation group should be marked as a preferred version, or
			--ii) If any of the folder is marked as a preferred version, then there should NOT BE any folders
			--in any other operation groups.

			--i) Verify whether any of the entities in the operation group is marked as a preferred version.
			SELECT TOP 1 @preferred_ver = preferred_ver
			FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND preferred_ver = 1

			IF (@preferred_ver = 1) BEGIN
				--Atleast one folder is marked as a preferred version
				--ii) Now verify whether there are any folder(s) in other operation groups for the entities in the deletion group.
				IF EXISTS (SELECT f.item_id, f.oper_id, f.ent_id
					FROM folder f WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id
							FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE item_id = @item_id
							  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
							  AND preferred_ver = 1) folder_delete_group
						ON f.ent_id = folder_delete_group.ent_id
					WHERE item_id = @item_id
					  AND (oper_id = @oper_id AND COALESCE(oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET'))
					GROUP BY f.item_id, f.oper_id, f.ent_id
					HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) BEGIN
					--There are folders in the other operation group(s). Do not allow the folder to delete until a preferred version is set.
					RAISERROR('What you are trying to delete includes at least one preferred version of a folder for a given combination of operation and entity, and there is more than one other folder for this combination that is assigned a different operation description.,  Please set one of these folders for each such combination with a different operation description as the preferred version.{5073}', 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				--Since there is only one folder exist in the other groups other than the selected folder, automatically set the other folder in the other group as the preferred version.
				UPDATE folder SET preferred_ver = 1
				FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id
						FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE item_id = @item_id
						  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
						  AND preferred_ver = 1) folder_delete_group
				WHERE folder.ent_id = folder_delete_group.ent_id AND folder.item_id = @item_id
				  AND (folder.oper_id = @oper_id AND COALESCE(folder.oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET') <> COALESCE(@oper_desc, '987654321CIMNET'))
			END
		END  -- A folder identified at an operation level is being deleted.
	END --Verify whether the item_id and the oper_id is supplied; else all folders for this item will be deleted.

	--DELETE the identified folder record.
	DELETE folder
	WHERE item_id = @item_id
	  AND ((oper_id = @oper_id AND (oper_desc = @oper_desc OR (oper_desc IS NULL AND @oper_desc IS NULL))) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ent_id = @ent_id  OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Bottleneck_History]
(@line_id INT32 = NULL
,@ent_id INT32 = NULL
,@start_time TDATETIME = NULL
,@start_time_utc TDATETIME = NULL
,@end_time TDATETIME = NULL
,@end_time_utc TDATETIME = NULL
,@last_edit_by STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@last_edit_at TDATETIME = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Bottleneck_History
-- Description	      - Return the requested bottleneck_history records.
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT  bottleneck_history.line_id
	,line.line_name
	,bottleneck_history.ent_id
	,ent.ent_name
	,bottleneck_history.start_time_utc
	,bottleneck_history.start_time_local
	,bottleneck_history.start_time_utc as start_time
	,bottleneck_history.end_time_utc
	,bottleneck_history.end_time_local
	,bottleneck_history.end_time_utc as end_time
	,bottleneck_history.est_prod_rate
	,bottleneck_history.last_edit_comment
	,bottleneck_history.last_edit_by
	,bottleneck_history.last_edit_at
	,bottleneck_history.row_id
FROM bottleneck_history WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN line WITH (NOLOCK) ON bottleneck_history.line_id = line.line_id
INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON bottleneck_history.ent_id = ent.ent_id
WHERE (bottleneck_history.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.start_time_utc >= @start_time_utc OR @start_time_utc IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.start_time_local >= @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.end_time_utc <= @end_time_utc OR @end_time_utc IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.end_time_local <= @end_time OR @end_time IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
  AND (bottleneck_history.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
ORDER BY line.line_name, ent.ent_name

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_History]
(@ent_id		INT32
,@event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
,@reas_cd		INT32 = NULL
,@reas_pending		LOGICAL = 0
,@comments 		nvarchar(2000) = NULL
,@raw_reas_cd 		nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@spare1		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare2		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare3		STRING80 = NULL
,@spare4		STRING80 = NULL
,@category1  		STRING80 = NULL
,@category2  		STRING80 = NULL
,@category3  		STRING80 = NULL
,@category4  		STRING80 = NULL
,@last_edit_comment 	nvarchar(254) = NULL
,@last_edit_at 		DATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
,@log_id 		int = NULL OUT
,@records_affected	INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Util_History
-- Description			-
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu			5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
-- 07/27/2017		Raghu			6.0		UserStory:716502 - As SE development, I want to address all the failures in the stateless API to make it compatible with the new schema
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @state_cd	INT32
	,@runtime	LOGICAL
	,@downtime	LOGICAL
	,@setuptime	LOGICAL
	,@teardowntime	LOGICAL
	,@fixedtime	LOGICAL
	,@failure	LOGICAL
	,@vartime	LOGICAL

	,@pre_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@next_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@range_end		TDATETIME2
	,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)

	--For backward compatibility, retrieve the primary key values using the log_id if primary key values are not supplied
	IF (@ent_id IS NULL OR @event_time_utc IS NULL)
		SELECT @ent_id = uh.ent_id, @event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.log_id = @log_id

	--Strip out the milliseconds
	SELECT @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@event_time_utc), @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@last_edit_at)
		--default to update, if no context is supplied
		, @last_edit_comment = COALESCE(@last_edit_comment, 'UtilHistory.Update')

	--Exit, if the event does not exist
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc = @event_time_utc)
	BEGIN
		--Determine whether the call is from the client to update a single record (not split/merge/combine).  If yes, and if the record is not found, then raise an error.
		--The last_edit_comment is not exposed to the client to send a value, therefore the comment should be defaulted to UtilHistory.Update
		--However, if the all is initiated from other contexts such as adjusting utilization events/splitting eventings, then there is no need for raising an error when the event is not found
		IF @last_edit_comment = 'UtilHistory.Update' BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied entity: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id) + ' and the event time (UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @event_time_utc, 120) + ' to modify an existing utilization event does not exist in the database.{8003},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @event_time_utc, 120)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--An event does not exist at the specified time, exit
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT	@state_cd = state_cd, @runtime = runtime, @downtime = downtime,
		@setuptime = setuptime, @teardowntime = teardowntime, @fixedtime = fixedtime,
		@failure = failure, @vartime = vartime
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd

	IF (@state_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677}, valid reason code, to update an utilization event.', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	UPDATE util_history
	SET state_cd = @state_cd
		, reas_cd = @reas_cd
		, reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, reas_pending)
		, runtime = @runtime
		, downtime = @downtime
		, setuptime = @setuptime
		, teardowntime = @teardowntime
		, fixedtime = @fixedtime
		, vartime = @vartime
		, failure = @failure
		, comments = @comments
		, raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd
		, spare1 = @spare1
		, spare2 = @spare2
		, spare3 = @spare3
		, spare4 = @spare4
		, category1 = @category1
		, category2 = @category2
		, category3 = @category3
		, category4 = @category4
		, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND event_time_utc = @event_time_utc
	  AND (last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)

	--Capture the record count
	SET @records_affected = COALESCE(@records_affected, 0) + @@ROWCOUNT

	--The events across shifts may need to be merged.
	SELECT @pre_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc < @event_time_utc

	--Retrieve the start time of the next event
	SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc > @event_time_utc

	--Default to the supplied event time utc, if there are no future events
	SET @range_end = COALESCE(@next_event_time_utc, @event_time_utc)

	--Determine whether any events to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id = @ent_id
		, @event_time_utc_start_range = @pre_event_time_utc, @event_time_utc_end_range = @range_end
		, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, @records_affected = @records_affected OUTPUT

END
