CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Oper_Clone]
(@existing_process_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@existing_oper_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@new_process_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@new_oper_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@new_oper_desc		NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@mod_id		NVARCHAR(30) = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_I_Oper_Clone
-- Description	      - Clone the current operation to a new operation.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 07/29/2005
-- Version	      - 2.1.25
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 08/19/2005	Raghu		2.1.26  Added error message to language table, so that it can be translatable.
-- 09/29/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 11/07/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Deviation above and deviation below values are interchanged while cloning an operation.
-- 02/22/2006	Raghu		3.1.10	HD# 7376, Included a dummy string while returning an error next to the {} statement.
-- 03/02/2006	Raghu		3.1.11	HD# 7317, Error while cloning an operation
-- 10/24/2006	KRF			3.1.25	HD Call 8953 - clone data_log_grp_oper_link records
-- 01/15/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 9222 & 9226, part of DB changes - copy reqd_rep_pct, handle renamed fields.  Also
--							5678	w.r.t. created_at
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 02/04/2008	AML			3.4.0	Updated procedure to clone oper_step_choice records.
-- 10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6     spc_char_oper_link are removed from the database
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

DECLARE  @old_process_id		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@old_oper_id		NVARCHAR(80)
--	,@oper_desc		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@def_reject_rate	FLOAT
	,@first_oper		BIT
	,@final_oper		BIT
	,@display_seq		INT
	,@check_inv		BIT
	,@sched_to_ent_id	INT
	,@oper_type		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@oper_cost		FLOAT
	,@assoc_file		NVARCHAR(254)
	,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(20)
	,@rework_cd			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@notes			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@data_log_grp_id	INT
	,@spare1		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@spare2		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@spare3		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@spare4		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@last_edit_comment	NVARCHAR(254)
	,@last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,@checked_out_by	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@err_str		NVARCHAR(160)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
	,@deviation_above	FLOAT
	,@deviation_below	FLOAT
	,@reqd_process_checkout	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@created_at		DATETIME
	,@use_gmt		INT32


	IF (@existing_process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1  Should not be Null{3329},Existing_Process_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@existing_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1  Should not be Null{3329},Existing_Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@new_process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1  Should not be Null{3329},New_Process_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@new_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1  Should not be Null{3329},New_Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},existing Process_Id and existing Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @new_process_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},new Process_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @new_process_id AND oper_id = @new_oper_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 already exist in the database.{4675},new Process_Id and new Oper_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Added following 4 lines 1/15/07 KRF
 	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_gmt OUTPUT
 	SET @use_gmt = ISNULL(@use_gmt, 0)
 	IF @use_gmt = 1 SET @created_at = @last_edit_at
 	ELSE SET @created_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	SELECT @process_status = process_status, @checked_out_by = checked_out_by FROM process WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @new_process_id

	SELECT @reqd_process_checkout = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 304

	IF (@reqd_process_checkout = '1') BEGIN
		IF (@checked_out_by IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_str = 'Process is not checked out by %1 user{3231},' + ISNULL(@last_edit_by, '')
			RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE IF (@checked_out_by IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (@checked_out_by <> @last_edit_by) BEGIN
				SET @err_str = 'Process is checked out by %1 user{3369},' + @checked_out_by
				RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Cannot delete or modify the components of a certified process{2179}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--@existing_process_id=process_id, @existing_oper_id=oper_id, @oper_desc=oper_desc, @notes=notes,
	SELECT @def_reject_rate=def_reject_rate, @first_oper=first_oper, @final_oper=final_oper, @display_seq=display_seq
		,@check_inv=check_inv ,@sched_to_ent_id=sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type=oper_type, @oper_cost=oper_cost
		,@deviation_above=deviation_above, @deviation_below=deviation_below
		,@assoc_file=assoc_file, @assoc_file_type=assoc_file_type, @rework_cd = rework_cd, @notes = notes
		,@spare1=spare1, @spare2=spare2, @spare3=spare3, @spare4=spare4, @last_edit_comment=last_edit_comment
	FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	SELECT @first_oper = 0, @final_oper = 0

	EXEC sp_I_Oper @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, @new_oper_desc, @def_reject_rate, @first_oper, @final_oper, @display_seq,
		@check_inv, @sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type, @oper_cost, @deviation_above, @deviation_below, @assoc_file,
		@rework_cd, @notes, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUTPUT

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
    SELECT DISTINCT  (select row_id from oper where process_id = @new_process_id and oper_id = @new_oper_id) as key_id, 4 as key_type
		,	des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period, des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at
		,	des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1, des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1
		,	des.number_spare2, des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN oper ON des.key_id = oper.row_id
	WHERE des.key_type = 4 and oper.process_id = @existing_process_id and oper.oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_attr (process_id, oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_attr
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_ent_link (process_id, oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time, init_prod_pct,
		parent_contingent_ent, child_contingent_ent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time, init_prod_pct,
		parent_contingent_ent, child_contingent_ent, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_ent_link
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_step_grp (process_id, oper_id, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc,
		step_grp_seq, repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_step_grp
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added "reqd_rep_pct," 2 places in following statement 1/15/07 KRF
	-- Re-Added control_type, high_limit, low_limit, and limit_warning.  Somehow they disappeared.
	INSERT INTO oper_step (process_id, oper_id, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time,
		complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name,
		data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3,
		spare4, spare5, spare6, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time,
		complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name,
		data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3,
		spare4, spare5, spare6, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_step
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	DECLARE @each_oper_step_des TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime,
			step_no int
		)

	DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
			@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
			@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40), @t_last_edit_at datetime, @t_step_no int, @i int, @max_i int

	DELETE FROM @each_oper_step_des

	INSERT INTO @each_oper_step_des
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
		step_no
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT des.key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
		des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
		des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
		des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at, os.step_no
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN oper_step os ON des.key_id = os.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 5 AND process_id = @existing_process_id and os.oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_oper_step_des

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @t_step_no = step_no FROM @each_oper_step_des WHERE id = @i

		SELECT @t_key_id = os.row_id
		FROM oper_step os
		WHERE os.oper_id = @new_oper_id AND os.step_no = @t_step_no

		SELECT	@t_key_type = 5, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
			,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
			,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
			,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
			,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
			,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
			,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		FROM @each_oper_step_des
		WHERE id = @i

		INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
		(
			key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
			last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
			number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
			@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
			@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
			@last_edit_by,  @last_edit_at
		)

		SET @i = (@i + 1)
	END

	INSERT INTO oper_step_choice ( process_id, oper_id, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	FROM oper_step_choice
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_step_file (process_id, oper_id, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_step_file
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_step_ent_exc (process_id, oper_id, step_no, ent_id, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, ent_id, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_step_ent_exc
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_spec_ver (process_id, oper_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_spec_ver
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_ent_spec (process_id, oper_id, step_no, ent_id, ver_id, spec_id, spec_value,
		assoc_file, assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, ent_id, ver_id, spec_id, spec_value, assoc_file,
		assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_ent_spec
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO res_oper_link (res_id, process_id, oper_id, qty_reqd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT res_id, @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, qty_reqd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM res_oper_link
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO cert_oper_link (cert_name, process_id, oper_id, cert_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, cert_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_oper_link
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	INSERT INTO cert_oper_step_link (cert_name, process_id, oper_id, step_no, cert_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, cert_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_oper_step_link
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added 10/24/2006 to clone data_log_grp_oper_link records per HD call 8953
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_oper_link (grp_id, process_id, oper_id, cert_name, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT grp_id, @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, cert_name, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_oper_link
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

	-- Added 02/05/2008 CR L00074730 to clone data_log_grp_oper_step_link records....
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_oper_step_link ( grp_id, process_id, oper_id, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT grp_id, @new_process_id, @new_oper_id, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_oper_step_link
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id AND oper_id = @existing_oper_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents]
(
		@log_id   				INT32 = NULL
	,	@user_id   				STRING40 = NULL
	,	@ent_id   				INT32 = NULL
	,	@event_time				TDATETIME = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					- 10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/23/2002		Sheetal Jain				Base version(Bulk labor deadlocks)
-- 10/17/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/08/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 07/31/2015		Neeraja	5.2		L00137568 (Merged from HF-L00137241) : labor_usage.duration was not getting calculated correctly. Assigned the value of @event_time
--												to @event_time_utc for the correct calculation of duration.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

                DECLARE @event_time_utc AS DATETIME
	IF @event_time IS NULL
		SET @event_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()
    ELSE
    	SET @event_time_utc =  DATEADD(minute, -@time_zone_bias_value, @event_time)


	--Set duration = DateDiff (labor_start, event_time), active = 0
	--log_id: Optional. Which row in labor_usage to be updated. Defaults to Null
	--(ALL active rows for log_id). When specified can only close off a single row)
	--user_id: Optional - Filter active rows for a specific user. Default to null (all users).
	--ent_id: Optional - Filter active rows for a specific ent. Default to null (all entities).
/*	update labor_usage
		SET duration = datediff(ss, labor_start, @event_time), active = 0
	WHERE active = 1
	  and (log_id = @log_id or @log_id IS NULL)
	  and (user_id = @user_id or @user_id IS NULL)
	  and (ent_id = @ent_id or @ent_id IS NULL)*/
	  IF @user_id IS NULL
	    UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
	      WHERE active = 1 AND (log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL) AND (user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL)
	        AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  ELSE  --Force the usage of cluster key - user_id
	    UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
	      WHERE active = 1 AND (log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL) AND user_id = @user_id AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_MDM_SCHED_GETSHIFTSCHEDULES]
(
		
	@start_time				TDATETIME
,	@end_time				TDATETIME


)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- 
-- Description					- 
--								  
-- Author						- AP
-- Date Created					- 
-- Version						- 
--
-- Copyright (c) 2015 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	
	Select * from (

	SELECT stg.ent_id
		,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, stg.start_time,null) As shift_start_utc
		,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, stg.end_time,null) As shift_end_utc
		,shift_id


	FROM shift_to_go stg WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e with(Nolock) ON e.ent_id = stg.ent_id AND can_sched_shifts = 1 AND stg.start_time >= e.cur_shift_start_time_local
	  AND (start_time >= @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL)
	  AND (end_time <= @end_time OR @end_time IS NULL)

	union all
	
	SELECT ent_id
		,shift_start_utc
		,shift_end_utc
		,shift_id
	

	FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE shift_end_utc is not null
		AND ent_id in (select ent_id from ent with(Nolock) where can_sched_shifts = 1)
	    AND (shift_start_local >= @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL)
	    AND (shift_end_local <= @end_time OR @end_time IS NULL)
		) as a

		Order by a.ent_id, a.shift_start_utc
		

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtDatNamFilt]
(
		@char_name            	STRING40
	,	@site_name				STRING80_NULL = NULL

	,	@item					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,   @item_category_name		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@process_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_response_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare1					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare2					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare3					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare4					STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@start_time				DATETIME = NULL
	,	@start_time_tz			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@end_time				DATETIME = NULL
	,	@end_time_tz			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@num_points				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@chart_type				INT32
	,	@last_created_at_utc	DATETIME = NULL
	,   @x_axis_label			INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -	sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtDatNamFilt
-- Description          -	Get the measurements for each sample that matches the filter and the characteristic.  Also gets the
--							centerline, lower control limits, and the upper control limits for each point based on the
--							chart type.  The center line, and control limit values come from either the qm_spec_char_link record
--							with the qm_spec_id coming from the sample_char_link table or from the characteristic table.
-- Author          - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created          -    03/23/2011
-- Version          - 4.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 12/02/2014		  Ibrahim			5.0		   Story#241203. Returns the x_axis label field value as part of the query
--                                                 based on the x-axis label input.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ent_id				INT32
	DECLARE @char_id			INT32
	DECLARE @item_category_id	INT32

	SELECT @char_id = (SELECT char_id FROM characteristic WHERE char_name = @char_name)

	SELECT @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

	if (@ent_name IS NOT NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL) SET @ent_id = -1

	if (@item_category_name IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @item_category_id = category_id FROM category WHERE category.category_name = @item_category_name
		SET @item_category_id = COALESCE(@item_category_id, -1)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @item_category_id = null
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtDataByFilt @char_id, @ent_id, @item, @item_category_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @process_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @start_time, @start_time_tz, @end_time, @end_time_tz, @num_points, @chart_type, @last_created_at_utc, @x_axis_label

END

-- Name:        sp_s_ofi_cb_calculation
-- Description: fetch BOM correction prediction
--
-- Usage:       From which object this script is called.

-- 0.01.00      Sudhakar                       2022-01-11            Initial version.

--exec [sp_s_ofi_cb_alternate_calculation] @l=10,@c=5,@h=12,@wl=2,@wc=6,@wh=9,@e_weight=4000,@ed_weight=5000,@m_moisture=4,@r_fat=5,@m_fat=6,@ph_spec=7,@m_ph=8,@n_11_original=10,@d_23_original=10,@b_11_original=80,@minimization=0,@n_11_alternate=15,@d_23_alternate=15,@b_11_alternate=70
CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_cb_calculation]
	(
		@l float,
		@c float,
		@h float,
		@wl float,
		@wc float,
		@wh float,
		@e_weight float,
		@ed_weight float,		
		@r_fat	int=0,
		@m_fat int=0,
		@ph_spec int=0,
		@m_ph int=0,
		@m_moisture int=0,
		@n_11_original int = 0,
		@d_11_original int=0,
		@s_11_original int=0,
		@x_11_original int=0,
		@b_11_original int=0,
		@n_23_original int=0,
		@d_23_original int=0,
		@s_23_original int=0,
		@x_23_original int=0,
		@b_23_original int=0,
		@n_11_alternate int = 0,
		@d_11_alternate int=0,
		@s_11_alternate int=0,
		@x_11_alternate int=0,
		@b_11_alternate int=0,
		@n_23_alternate int=0,
		@d_23_alternate int=0,
		@s_23_alternate int=0,
		@x_23_alternate int=0,
		@b_23_alternate int=0,
		@item_id nvarchar(40)
		)
		as
set nocount on
begin

DECLARE @MinL  FLOAT,
        @MaxL  FLOAT,
        @MinC  FLOAT,
        @MaxC  FLOAT,
        @MinH  FLOAT,
        @MaxH  FLOAT,
        @MinFAT  FLOAT,
        @MaxFAT  FLOAT,
		@MinPh  FLOAT,
        @MaxPh  FLOAT,
		@MinMoist  FLOAT,
        @MaxMoist  FLOAT
			

SELECT @MinL = ia1.attr_value,
@MaxL= ia2.attr_value,
@MinC= ia3.attr_value,
@MaxC= ia4.attr_value,
@MinH= ia5.attr_value,
@MaxH= ia6.attr_value,
@MinFAT= ia7.attr_value,
@MaxFAT= ia8.attr_value,
@MinMoist= ia9.attr_value,
@MaxMoist= ia10.attr_value,
@MinPh= ia11.attr_value,
@MaxPh= ia12.attr_value
from
   item i WITH (nolock)
       INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia1.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a1 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia1.attr_id = a1.attr_id and a1.attr_desc='MinL'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia2.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a2 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia2.attr_id = a2.attr_id and a2.attr_desc='MaxL'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia3 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia3.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a3 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia3.attr_id = a3.attr_id and a3.attr_desc='MinC'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia4 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia4.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a4 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia4.attr_id = a4.attr_id and a4.attr_desc='MaxC'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia5 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia5.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a5 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia5.attr_id = a5.attr_id and a5.attr_desc='MinH'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia6 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia6.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a6 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia6.attr_id = a6.attr_id and a6.attr_desc='MaxH'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia7 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia7.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a7 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia7.attr_id = a7.attr_id and a7.attr_desc='MinFAT'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia8 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia8.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a8 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia8.attr_id = a8.attr_id and a8.attr_desc='MaxFAT'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia9 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia9.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a9 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia9.attr_id = a9.attr_id and a9.attr_desc='MinMoist'

			          INNER JOIN item_attr ia10 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia10.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a10 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia10.attr_id = a10.attr_id and a10.attr_desc='MaxMoist'

			   INNER JOIN item_attr ia11 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia11.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a11 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia11.attr_id = a11.attr_id and a11.attr_desc='MinPh'

			   INNER JOIN item_attr ia12 WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = ia12.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a12 WITH (nolock)
               ON ia12.attr_id = a12.attr_id and a12.attr_desc='MaxPh'
where i.item_id=@item_id

	declare @delta_current_solution float=0
	declare @table_count int=1,@out_p1 float=0,@out_p2 float=0,@out_p3 float=0
	declare @xa_value float=0,@ya_value float=0,@za_value float=0,@xb_value float=0,@yb_value float=0,@zb_value float=0,@a float=0,@b float=0,@x_value float=0,@y_value float=0,@z_value float=0
	declare @c_n_11 int=0,@c_d_11 int=0,@c_s_11 int=0,@c_x_11 int=0,@c_b_11 int=0,@c_n_23 int=0,@c_d_23 int=0,@c_s_23 int=0,@c_x_23 int=0,@c_b_23 int=0
	--declare @n_11_perc int=0,@d_11_perc int=0,@s_11_perc int=0,@x_11_perc int=0,@b_11_perc int=0,@n_23_perc int=0,@d_23_perc int=0,@s_23_perc int=0,@x_23_perc int=0,@b_23_perc int=0
	declare @desired_moisture_perc float=0,@moisture_dose float=0,@moisture_correction float=0,@weight_after_correction float=0,@high_fat float=0,@low_fat float=0
	declare @desired_fat_perc_postdose float=0,@perc_lowfat_cake float=0,@density_base_dose float=0,@delta_best_solution float=0,@density_post_dose float=0
	declare @b_out_p1 float=0,@b_out_p2 float=0,@b_out_p3 float=0,@power_div float=1,@power_divd float=3
	declare @ph_basic float=0,@ph_deviation float=0,@ph_postdose float=0,@ph_end float=0,@b_zout float=0,@o_zout float=0

	set @desired_moisture_perc=0.044
	set @moisture_dose=(@ed_weight * (@desired_moisture_perc-@m_moisture)) / (1-@m_moisture)
	if @moisture_dose < 0 
	begin
		set @moisture_dose=0
		end
	else if (@moisture_correction > @ed_weight- @e_weight)
	begin
		set @moisture_dose = @ed_weight- @e_weight
	end
	--gewicht_nacorrectie_koek
	set @weight_after_correction=@ed_weight - @moisture_dose - @e_weight
	set @high_fat=0.235
	set @low_fat=0.102
	--gewenst_vet_percentage_nadosering
	set @desired_fat_perc_postdose= (@r_fat * @ed_weight / (@ed_weight - @e_weight - @moisture_dose) - @m_fat * (@e_weight /(@ed_weight - @e_weight - @moisture_dose)))
	--percentage_magere_koek
	set @perc_lowfat_cake = (@high_fat - @desired_fat_perc_postdose)/(@high_fat-@low_fat)
		if @perc_lowfat_cake < 0
		begin
			set @perc_lowfat_cake=0;
		end
		else if (@perc_lowfat_cake > 1)
		begin
			set @perc_lowfat_cake=100
		end
		else
		begin
			set @perc_lowfat_cake= round(100 * @perc_lowfat_cake,0)
		end	
		
	--pigment_dichtheid_basisdosering
	set @density_base_dose = @n_11_original * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'n') +
							 @d_11_original * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'd') +
							 @s_11_original * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 's') +
							 @x_11_original * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'x') +
							 @b_11_original * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'b') +
							 @n_23_original * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'n') +
							 @d_23_original * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'd') +
							 @s_23_original * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 's') +
							 @x_23_original * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'x') +
							 @b_23_original * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'b') 

	--pigment_dichtheid_nadosering
										
	set @density_post_dose = (@n_11_alternate * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'n') +
							@d_11_alternate * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'd') +
							@s_11_alternate * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 's') +
							@x_11_alternate * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'x') +
							@b_11_alternate * (select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'b') +
							@n_23_alternate * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'n') +
							@d_23_alternate * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'd') +
							@s_23_alternate * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 's') +
							@x_23_alternate * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'x') +
							@b_23_alternate * (select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'b') ) / 100
	
	create table #temp_solutions(solution_col1 float,solution_col2 float,solution_col3 float,solution_col4 float,solution_col5 float,solution_col6 float,solution_col7 float,solution_col8 float,solution_col9 float,solution_col10 float)
	insert into #temp_solutions values(0,0,0,@perc_lowfat_cake,0,0,0,0,(100-@perc_lowfat_cake),0)
	create table #calc_lch_value(lch_char char(10),lch_calc_value float,lch_value float)

	set @delta_best_solution=1000000
	delete from #calc_lch_value
	insert into #calc_lch_value 
	select component_char,ks_values_post_dose ,(ks_values_post_dose + 1) - sqrt((((ks_values_post_dose + 1) * (ks_values_post_dose + 1)) - 1)) from (
	select ((@e_weight / @ed_weight * @density_base_dose * ((1-measured_value) * (1-measured_value)) / (2* measured_value)) +
	(@weight_after_correction / @ed_weight * @density_post_dose * ks_values_postdose )) /
	((((@e_weight / @ed_weight) * @density_base_dose) + ((@weight_after_correction / @ed_weight) * @density_post_dose))) as ks_values_post_dose,component_char  from (
	select (((((1-n_value) * (1-n_value)) / (2 * n_value)) *((select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'n')) * @n_11_alternate) +
		((((1-d_value)*(1-d_value)) / (2 * d_value)) *((select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'd')) * @d_11_alternate) +
		((((1-s_value)*(1-s_value)) / (2 * s_value)) *((select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 's')) * @s_11_alternate) +
		((((1-x_value) * (1-x_value)) / (2 * x_value)) *((select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'x')) * @x_11_alternate) +
		((((1-b_value)*(1-b_value)) / (2 * b_value)) *((select isnull(low_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'b')) * @b_11_alternate) +
		((((1-n_value) * (1-n_value)) / (2 * n_value)) *((select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'n')) * @n_23_alternate) +
		((((1-d_value) * (1-d_value)) / (2 * d_value)) *((select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'd')) * @d_23_alternate) +
		((((1-s_value) * (1-s_value)) / (2 * s_value)) *((select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 's')) * @s_23_alternate) +
		((((1-x_value) * (1-x_value)) / (2 * x_value)) *((select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'x')) * @x_23_alternate) +
		((((1-b_value) * (1-b_value)) / (2 * b_value)) *((select isnull(high_fat,0) from ofi_cal_density_components(nolock) where components = 'b')) * @b_23_alternate)) / (@density_post_dose * 100) as ks_values_postdose ,row_id,component_char from dbo.ofi_cal_reflection_components(nolock)) as rc inner join [dbo].[ofi_cal_measured_reflection] as mr(nolock) on rc.row_id=mr.row_id and rc.component_char=mr.measured_char) as out_tab
	--x,y,z value calculation -----------------------------------------------------
									
	select @xa_value= sum(isnull((xc.x_values *cl.lch_value),0)) from ofi_x_calculation as xc(nolock) inner join #calc_lch_value as cl(nolock) on xc.x_char=cl.lch_char
	select @ya_value= sum(isnull((yc.y_values *cl.lch_value),0)) from ofi_y_calculation as yc(nolock) inner join #calc_lch_value as cl(nolock) on yc.y_char=cl.lch_char
	select @za_value= sum(isnull((zc.z_values *cl.lch_value),0)) from ofi_z_calculation as zc(nolock) inner join #calc_lch_value as cl(nolock) on zc.z_char=cl.lch_char
	--ks_waarden_basisdosering
	set @xb_value = @xa_value / 94.78247
	set @yb_value = @ya_value / 100
	set @zb_value = @za_value / 107.3613
									
	if @xb_value < 0.008856
	begin
		set @x_value = 7.787 * @xb_value + 0.138
	end
	else
	begin
		set @x_value  = power(@xb_value,@power_div/@power_divd)
		--set @x_value  = 0
	end
    
	if @yb_value < 0.008856
	begin
		set @y_value = 7.787 * @yb_value + 0.138
	end
	else
	begin
		--set @y_value = @yb_value ^ (1 / 3)
		set @y_value = power(@yb_value,@power_div/@power_divd)
	end
    
	if @zb_value < 0.008856
	begin
		set @z_value = 7.787 * @zb_value + 0.138
	end
	else
	begin
		--set @z_value = @zb_value ^ (1 / 3)
		set @z_value = power(@zb_value,@power_div/@power_divd)
	end

	set @a= 500 *(@x_value - @y_value);
	set @b = 200 * (@y_value - @z_value);

	set @out_p1= (116 * @y_value) - 16
	set @out_p2 = sqrt((@a * @a)+(@b *@b))
	set @out_p3 = atan(@b / @a) * 57.2957795130823

										-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	set @delta_current_solution= sqrt(((@wl * ((@out_p1 - @l) * (@out_p1 - @l))) + (@wc * ((@out_p2 - @c) * (@out_p2 - @c))) + (@wh * ((@out_p3 - @h) * (@out_p3 - @h)))))
	set @delta_best_solution = @delta_current_solution
	set @b_out_p1=@out_p1
	set @b_out_p2=@out_p2
	set @b_out_p3=@out_p3
	update #temp_solutions set solution_col1=@n_11_alternate,solution_col2=@d_11_alternate,solution_col3=@s_11_alternate,solution_col4=@x_11_alternate,solution_col5=@b_11_alternate,
												solution_col6=@n_23_alternate,solution_col7=@d_23_alternate,solution_col8=@s_23_alternate,solution_col9=@x_23_alternate,solution_col10=@b_23_alternate

			
		--ph value calculation ----------------------------------------------------------------
		set @ph_basic= @m_ph * @e_weight / (@e_weight + @weight_after_correction)
		set @ph_deviation=0.12
		set @ph_postdose=0;

		select @ph_postdose=(solution_col1/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='n') +
			   solution_col2/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='d') +
			   solution_col3/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='s') +
			   solution_col4/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='x') +
			   solution_col5/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='b') +
			   solution_col6/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='n') +
			   solution_col7/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='d') +
			   solution_col8/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='s') +
			   solution_col9/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='x') +
			   solution_col10/100 * (select  isnull(ph_value,0) from ofi_cal_ph_components(nolock) where components='b')) from #temp_solutions

		set @ph_postdose = @ph_postdose * @weight_after_correction / (@e_weight + @weight_after_correction)
		set @ph_end = @ph_basic + @ph_postdose
	
		if abs(@ph_end - @ph_spec) > @ph_deviation
		begin
			if @ph_end - @ph_spec < 0
			begin
				set @b_zout = abs(@ph_end - @ph_spec) * 0.014 * (@weight_after_correction + @e_weight)
				set @o_zout = 0
			end
			else
			begin
				set @o_zout = abs(@ph_end - @ph_spec) * 0.01 * (@weight_after_correction + @e_weight)
				set @b_zout = 0
			end
		end
		else
		begin
			set @b_zout = 0
			set @o_zout = 0
		end
		-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	drop table #calc_lch_value
	drop table #temp_solutions
	select 	round(@b_out_p1,2) as l_prediction,round(@b_out_p2,2) as c_prediction,round(@b_out_p3,2) as h_prediction,@r_fat as fat_prediction,4.4 as moisture_prediction,round(@ph_end,2) as ph_prediction,
		(case when round(@b_out_p1,2) between @MinL and @MaxL then '#000000' else '#FF0000' end) as l_color,
	   (case when round(@b_out_p2,2) between @MinC and @MaxC then '#000000' else '#FF0000' end) as c_color,
	   (case when round(@b_out_p3,2) between @MinH and @MaxH then '#000000' else '#FF0000' end) as h_color,
	   (case when @r_fat between @MinFAT and @MaxFAT then '#000000' else '#FF0000' end) as fat_color,
	   (case when 4.4 between @MinMoist and @MaxMoist then '#000000' else '#FF0000' end) as moist_color,
	   (case when round(@ph_end,2) between @MinPh and @MaxPh then '#000000' else '#FF0000' end) as ph_color
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].sp_U_Ent_UpdateSite
(@in_ent_id				INT32 = NULL
,@in_remove_site		INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -    SP_U_ENT_UPDATESITE
-- Description          -    Verifies the supplied site information
-- Author          - RAGHU
-- Date Created          -    01/07/2010
-- Version          - 4.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ent_id				INT32
		,@ent_name			NVARCHAR(160)
		,@site_name		NVARCHAR(160)
		,@new_ent_name		NVARCHAR(160)
		,@remove_site		INT32
		,@err_msg			NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@record_exists		INT32
BEGIN

	SET @remove_site = COALESCE(ABS(@in_remove_site), 0)

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'An entity with the supplied entity ID does not exist.{5775}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END;

	IF (@remove_site = 1) BEGIN
		--Just remove all the site references to this entity and all its decendants.
        WITH child_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
			(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.ent_name
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN child_ents ce ON ce.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			)
		UPDATE ent
		SET site = NULL
		FROM ent e
		INNER JOIN child_ents AS ce ON e.ent_id = ce.ent_id;
        RETURN;
    END;

	WITH site_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
		(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id
			UNION ALL
			SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			INNER JOIN site_ents se ON se.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
		)
		SELECT @record_exists = COUNT(*)
		FROM site_ents WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = site_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent ent_site WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_site.ent_id = e.site
		WHERE e.site IS NOT NULL
		  AND e.site <> @in_ent_id;

	IF (@record_exists > 0) BEGIN
		WITH site_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
			(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.ent_name
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN site_ents se ON se.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			)
			SELECT @ent_id = e.ent_id, @ent_name = e.ent_name, @site_name = ent_site.site_name
			FROM site_ents
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = site_ents.ent_id
			INNER JOIN site ent_site WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_site.ent_id = e.site
			WHERE e.site IS NOT NULL
			  AND e.site <> @in_ent_id

		--There is a child entity configured to a different site.
		--Get the supplied entity's name, now, this cannot be assigned to a site, because
		-- a child entity to this is configured to a different site, which needs to be corrected
		--before assigning all of the child entity to a site.
		SELECT @new_ent_name = e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id

		--Raise an error, as cannot assign the site to an entity.
		SET @err_msg = 'The site information cannot be attached to the entity: %1, because the child entity: %2 belongs to a different site: %3.{6304},'
			+ @new_ent_name + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + @site_name;
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END;

	--Verify if any of the ANCESTOR entity is assigned with a site name.
	SET @record_exists = 0;
	WITH site_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
		(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id
			UNION ALL
			SELECT el.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = e.ent_id
			INNER JOIN site_ents se ON se.ent_id = el.child_ent_id
		)
		SELECT @record_exists = COUNT(*)
		FROM site_ents
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = site_ents.ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent ent_site WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_site.ent_id = e.site
		WHERE e.site IS NOT NULL
		  AND e.site <> @in_ent_id;

	IF (@record_exists > 0) BEGIN
		WITH site_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
			(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id
				UNION ALL
				SELECT el.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.parent_ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN site_ents se ON se.ent_id = el.child_ent_id
			)
			SELECT @ent_id = e.ent_id, @ent_name = e.ent_name, @site_name = ent_site.site_name
			FROM site_ents
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = site_ents.ent_id
			INNER JOIN site ent_site WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_site.ent_id = e.site
			WHERE e.site IS NOT NULL
			  AND e.site <> @in_ent_id

		--There is an ancestor entity configured to a different site.
		--Get the supplied entity's name, now, this cannot be assigned to a site, because
		-- an ancestor entity to this is configured to a different site, which needs to be corrected
		--before assigning all of the child entity to a site.
		SELECT @new_ent_name = e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id

		--Raise an error, as cannot assign the site to an entity.
		SET @err_msg = 'The site information cannot be attached to the entity: %1, because the ancestor entity: %2 belongs to a different site: %3.{6305},'
			+ @new_ent_name + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + @site_name;
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN
	END;

	--Update all the decendants (including this entity) with the site information.
	WITH child_ents(ent_id, ent_name) AS
		(SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @in_ent_id
			UNION ALL
			SELECT el.child_ent_id, e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			INNER JOIN child_ents ce ON ce.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
		)
	UPDATE ent
	SET site = @in_ent_id
	FROM ent e
	INNER JOIN child_ents AS ce ON e.ent_id = ce.ent_id;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ScheduledJob_EntityList]
(
@res_grp_id NVARCHAR(max)
,@loc_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL
,@user_pref_id NVARCHAR(40)	= NULL
)
-- exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_GET_SCHEDULEDJOB_ENTITYLIST @res_grp_id=N'3001',@user_pref_id = 'W Line'
AS
BEGIN

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare @countEnt int

      IF Object_id('tempdb..#res_grp') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #res_grp

      -- Create temp table to res_grp_id for a give location id
      CREATE TABLE #res_grp
        (
           res_grp_id INT,
		   ent_id INT,
		   Seq_No INT,
		   grpOrder INT
        )
	
	--Get XML string from ui_config for the given pref_id

	--convert xmlstring into a temp table
	  --Get the preference and find the entity sequence
	  Declare @user_pref as nvarchar(max), @eqOrderXML as nvarchar(max), @charPos int
	  Declare @EqGrpOrder TABLE (EqGrpId int, seqNo int)
	  
	  

	  Select	@user_pref = valu
	  From		ui_config with(nolock)
	  Where		sectn = @user_pref_id and config_id='MDCC.Scheduler'

	  --select @user_pref
	  -- Change from eq grp to eq id for sequencing <EqIdSeq><EqSeq
	  IF @user_pref is not null
	  begin
		--SET @charPos = charindex('<EqIdSeq>', @user_pref)
		SET @charPos = charindex('"eqOrder":"', @user_pref)
		--If eqGrpOrder node exists then it can be translated to XML and temp table
		if(@charPos > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @eqOrderXML  = SUBSTRING(@user_pref, @charPos+11, (LEN(@user_pref)-@charPos - 2)) 
			set @eqOrderXML = substring(@eqOrderXML, 0, (len(@eqOrderXML) - 1))
			IF LEN(@eqOrderXML) > 0
			BEGIN
			insert into @EqGrpOrder(seqNo, EqGrpId)
				SELECT * FROM fn_Split(@eqOrderXML, ',')
			END
		END

	  end

	  

	  --select * from openxml(@docHandle, N'/EqIdSeq/EqSeq') with (EqGrp int '@id', SeqNo int '@seqNo');


	  INSERT INTO #res_grp
                        (res_grp_id, ent_id,seq_no, grpOrder)
            SELECT rg.res_grp_id, rge.ent_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rge.ent_id ORDER BY rg.res_grp_id asc), ego.seqNo
            FROM   sdb.[SCH].[res_grp] rg WITH(nolock)
			INNER JOIN sdb.sch.res_grp_ent rge WITH(NOLOCK) ON rg.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id
			LEFT JOIN @EqGrpOrder ego ON ego.EqGrpId = rge.ent_id
            WHERE  ( @res_grp_id IS NULL AND rg.loc_id IN (SELECT value
                                 FROM   Fn_split(@loc_id, ','))) or rg.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value
                                          FROM
                       Fn_split(@res_grp_id, ','))



SET @countEnt = (select count(distinct(ent_id)) from SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent RGE where res_grp_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@res_grp_id, ',')));

if @countEnt > 63 
begin

					SELECT '2mnyrows' AS job_sched_entity_id, 
       					   '2mnyrows' AS job_sched_entity_name, 
       					   '2mnyrows' AS entity_name, 
       					   '2mnyrows' AS process_id, 
       					   '2mnyrows' AS Scheduler_DisplayEnt,
						   '2mnyrows' AS SegmentType

end
else
begin
					;WITH CTE AS (
					SELECT DISTINCT( e.ent_id )                              AS job_sched_entity_id, 
               					   e.description                             AS 
               					   job_sched_entity_name, 
               					   e.ent_name                                AS entity_name, 
               					   Isnull(ProcessID.process_id, 'Undefined') AS process_id, 
               					   Isnull(ProcessID.process_id, '--') + ':' + e.[description] + ':' +  cast(e.ent_id as nvarchar)
														                     AS Scheduler_DisplayEnt,
								   IsNull(EA.attr_value, 'NOIDEA')			 AS SegmentType,
								   e.parent_ent_id							 AS ParentEntId
					FROM   sdb.sch.res_grp_ent RGE  WITH (nolock)
						   
       					   INNER JOIN ent E WITH (nolock) 
               					   ON E.ent_id = RGE.ent_id 
       					   LEFT JOIN ent_attr EA  WITH (nolock)
                 					 INNER JOIN attr A  WITH (nolock)
                         					 ON A.attr_id = EA.attr_id 
                            					AND A.attr_desc = 'SegmentType' 
              					  ON EA.ent_id = RGE.ent_id 
       					   LEFT JOIN (SELECT process_id, 
                         					 oper_id, 
                         					 ent_id 
                  					  FROM   (SELECT Rank() 
                                   					   OVER ( 
                                     					 partition BY ent_id 
                                     					 ORDER BY len(process_id) ASC,process_id ASC) AS RankPI, -- Added 24.01.2018 
                                 					 process_id, 
                                 					 oper_id, 
                                 					 ent_id 
                          					  FROM   oper_ent_link WITH(nolock) 
                          					  --WHERE  process_id NOT LIKE '%[_]%'
																	) A 
                  					  WHERE  rankpi = 1) ProcessID 
              					  ON ProcessID.ent_id = RGE.ent_id 
					WHERE  rge.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value 
                      					  FROM   Fn_split(@res_grp_id, ','))
																				  ),
			AllEnt as (
			select ea.attr_value JobPosition, ea.attr_desc JPDesc,eaM.attr_value EntManaged, eaM.attr_desc EntManagedDesc, e.ent_id,e.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description from ent e
			left join (select ea.attr_value, a.attr_desc, ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea 
			inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'JobPositions' ) ea on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
			left join (select ea.attr_value, a.attr_desc, ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea 
			inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id and a.attr_desc = 'MDM_Sched_EntManaged') eaM on eaM.ent_id = e.ent_id
			)
			, AllEntManagedParent as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntParent.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from AllEnt
			left join AllEnt AllEntParent on AllEnt.parent_ent_id = AllEntParent.ent_id)
			,AllEntManagedChildren as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntChild.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from AllEnt
			left join AllEnt AllEntChild on AllEntChild.parent_ent_id = AllEnt.ent_id)
			, AllEntManaged as (
			select case when AllEnt.EntManaged = 1 or AllEntParent.EntManaged = 1 then 1 else 0 end as EntManaged, AllEnt.ent_id, AllEnt.parent_ent_id from  AllEntManagedChildren AllEnt
			left join AllEntManagedParent AllEntParent on AllEnt.parent_ent_id = AllEntParent.ent_id)

					SELECT distinct IsNull(rg.grpOrder, 9999)  as seqNo,(A.job_sched_entity_id), 
       					   A.job_sched_entity_name, 
       					   A.entity_name, 
       					   A.process_id, 
       					   A.Scheduler_DisplayEnt,
						   
						   CASE WHEN A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' THEN IsNull(B.SegmentType, 'NOIDEA') ELSE A.SegmentType END as SegmentType
						   
						,A.ParentEntId
						,case when A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' then A.ParentEntId else A.job_sched_entity_id end ,case when A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' then 2 else 1 end, A.job_sched_entity_name
						FROM CTE A
						INNER JOIN #res_grp rg on rg.ent_id = A.job_sched_entity_id and rg.Seq_No = 1
						INNER JOIN AllEntManaged AE on AE.ent_id = A.job_sched_entity_id and AE.EntManaged = 1
						LEFT JOIN CTE B ON A.ParentEntId = B.job_sched_entity_id
						group by 
						IsNull(rg.grpOrder, 9999),
						(A.job_sched_entity_id), 
       					   A.job_sched_entity_name, 
       					   A.entity_name, 
       					   A.process_id, 
       					   A.Scheduler_DisplayEnt,
						   CASE WHEN A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' THEN IsNull(B.SegmentType, 'NOIDEA') ELSE A.SegmentType END 
						,A.ParentEntId
						, case when A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' then A.ParentEntId else A.job_sched_entity_id end ,case when A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' then 2 else 1 end, A.job_sched_entity_name
						order by IsNull(rg.grpOrder, 9999),case when A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' then A.ParentEntId else A.job_sched_entity_id end ,case when A.SegmentType = 'NOIDEA' then 2 else 1 end, A.job_sched_entity_name


end

--select e.ent_id as job_sched_entity_id, e.description as  job_sched_entity_name, e.ent_name as entity_name 
--from SDB.SCH.res_item RI
--INNER JOIN ENT E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.ent_id = RI.ent_id
--where ri.item_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@item_id, ',')) 


END

CREATE Trigger [tg_process_attr_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[process_attr]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_process_attr_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on Process_Attr  table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE()
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
DECLARE @user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207
	DECLARE process_attr_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT b.process_id
		FROM process_attr a, inserted b
		WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
		      AND a.attr_id = b.attr_id
	OPEN process_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM process_attr_cursor INTO @process_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@attr_value = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
			IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},process_attr', 16, 1)
				BREAK
			END
		END
		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL
		UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	CLOSE process_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE process_attr_cursor
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_lm_label_preview
-- Description:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
--
-- Usage:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-07			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-02-20          Deleted Synonym logic
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label_preview] 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
	,@ent_id INT=NULL
	,@fault_code INT=0
	,@lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)=NULL OUTPUT
	
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	-- declare temp table to get show kosher value 
	DECLARE @layoutTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,value NVARCHAR(50));
	
		-- declare variables used in MES mapping 
	DECLARE  @layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100)	=	NULL
			,@layout_name NVARCHAR(50)			=	NULL
			,@layout_id	NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@showkosher NVARCHAR(10) = 0
			,@hidekosher NVARCHAR(10) = 1
			,@splitCount INT = 0
			,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@maxRowCnt INT
			,@label_header NVARCHAR(200)
			,@print_qty INT
			,@process_attr NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@overlayDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL
			,@TypeOfLblContent INT=2
			,@swHasCustomerRichText INT=0
			,@jobGrpId INT=5 -- 5 job_attr group 
			,@hu NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
			,@swShowLB INT = 0
			,@itemUOM NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@swIsReject BIT=0
			,@swIsBigBag BIT=0
			,@raw_ent_id int
			,@actl_ent_id int
			,@raw_attr_value nvarchar(50)
			,@defaultShelfLife INT=0
			,@defShelfCnt INT=0
			,@HUGenrationTime Date 
			,@expiry_date_null NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@expiry_date_count INT=NULL
			,@expiry_date NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@expireItemId NVARCHAR(100)		=	NULL
			,@expireLot NVARCHAR(100)			=	NULL
			,@trigger_type  NVARCHAR(100)='preview'
			,@trigger_from NVARCHAR(100)='preview_trigger';

	-- declare variables for preview				
	DECLARE @item_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@item_desc NVARCHAR(500)
			,@batch_no NVARCHAR(100)
			,@batch_no_job_bom NVARCHAR(100)
			,@batch_no_local NVARCHAR(100)
			,@prod_desc1 NVARCHAR(500)
			,@prod_desc2 NVARCHAR(500)
			,@packing_print_line1 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line2 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line3 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line4 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line5 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line6 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line7 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line8 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line9 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line10 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line11 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line12 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@packing_print_line13 NVARCHAR(max)
			,@productCode1 NVARCHAR(500)
			,@productCode2 NVARCHAR(500)
			,@bag_weight_qty FLOAT=0
			,@bigBagCount INT = 0
			,@bigBagAttrValue INT=0
			,@expiryInFormat NVARCHAR(150)
			,@itemLifetime INT=0

			SELECT @maxRowCnt=max(row_id) from item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK) where ip.wo_id =@wo_id and ip.oper_id=@oper_id and ip.seq_no=@seq_no;

	-- get expiry date
		select @expireLot=owe.lot_no
			 ,@expireItemId=owe.item_id
			 ,@item_id=owe.item_id
		from ofi_wo_ext owe with(nolock)
		where owe.wo_id=@wo_id

		select top 1 @hu=ip.spare2
		from item_prod ip with(nolock)
		where ip.wo_id=@wo_id and ip.lot_no=@expireLot and ip.item_id=@item_id
		and ip.spare2 is not null and ip.good_prod=1

		--fetch default value from mapping for expiry , and if that is null set getdate

		select @itemLifetime=i.lifetime
		FROM item i with(nolock)
		where i.item_id=@item_id

		SELECT @layout_ofi_wo_ext=owe.layout_name	
		FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE owe.wo_id=@wo_id
		
		SELECT @splitCount=count(value) 
		FROM fn_Split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-');

		IF(@layout_ofi_wo_ext IS NOT NULL and @splitCount > 0)
		BEGIN	-- split count if starts

		INSERT INTO @layoutTable
		SELECT value FROM fn_Split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-')

		SELECT  @layout_name=value FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id=1
		SELECT  @showkosher=value FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id=2
		END
		select @expiry_date_null=default_value from ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping ollam WITH(NOLOCK)
		where ollam.as_value = 'BestBeforeDateFormatted' and ollam.layout_name=@layout_name

		select  @expiry_date_count= count(ii.expiry_date )
		from item_inv ii with(nolock)
		where ii.lot_no = @expireLot and ii.item_id=@expireItemId and ii.wo_id=@wo_id and ii.oper_id=@oper_id and ii.seq_no=@seq_no

		
		if(@itemLifetime > 0)
		BEGIN
		select @HUGenrationTime= CAST(min(created_at_local)AS DATE) from item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
				where ip.spare2 = @hu
			--select @HUGenrationTime	
			IF(@HUGenrationTime is null OR  @HUGenrationTime='')
		BEGIN
		select @HUGenrationTime =getdate()
		END

			select  @expiry_date =FORMAT( DATEADD(DAY, @itemLifetime, @HUGenrationTime), 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
				SELECT @raw_ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
				FROM JOB j WITH(NOLOCK)
				where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no


				select @raw_attr_value=ea.attr_value
				from ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
				where ea.ent_id=@raw_ent_id and ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
												   from attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
												   where a.attr_desc like '%EntityType%')

				IF(@raw_attr_value ='Segment')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id
					FROM ent e with(nolock)
					where e.ent_id=@raw_ent_id
				END
				ELSE IF(@raw_attr_value ='Line')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id=@raw_ent_id
				END

				select @defShelfCnt= count(ea.attr_value)  
				from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
				where ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
									from attr a with(nolock)
									where a.attr_desc ='DefaultShelfLife')
				and ea.ent_id=@actl_ent_id

				if(@defShelfCnt > 0)
				BEGIN
					select @defaultShelfLife=ea.attr_value  
					from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
					where ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
										from attr a with(nolock)
										where a.attr_desc ='DefaultShelfLife')
					and ea.ent_id=@actl_ent_id

					select @HUGenrationTime= CAST(min(created_at_local)AS DATE) from item_prod ip
					where ip.spare2 = @hu

					if(@HUGenrationTime is null OR @HUGenrationTime='')
					BEGIN
					select @HUGenrationTime=getdate()
					END

					select  @expiry_date =FORMAT( dateADD(day,@defaultShelfLife,@HUGenrationTime), 'dd-MM-yyyy')
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
