--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionToReport
-- Description:  Returns the bean consumption for SAP
--
-- Note : Only BEANs has been tested
--
-- Runs after: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
-- 0.01.00 	JSC         	2024-07-25    		Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC			2025-02-06			Removed the limitation for only BEANs and Added restriction on quantity to be reported
-- 0.01.02 	JSC			2025-05-19			Added limitation to only process those with spare1 > 0 even after the first select.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport] AS BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- Declare variables	
DECLARE @error_msg         NVARCHAR(MAX)
    ,@error_severity       INT
    ,@error_state          INT
DECLARE @row_id            INT = -1
    ,@ent_id               INT
    ,@item_grp             NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@item_id              NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cons_lot             NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cons_sublot          NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cons_wo_id           NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@wip_table_row_id     INT
    ,@wip_table_wo_id      NVARCHAR(40)
	,@wip_reported_created_at DATETIME
    ,@cur_cons_qty         FLOAT
    ,@cur_cons_qty_erp     FLOAT
    ,@cur_pending_cons_qty FLOAT
    ,@cons_spare1          FLOAT = 0
    ,@cons_created_at      DATETIME

    ,@storage_locn         NVARCHAR(100)
    ,@cons_fg_lot          NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@cons_fg_sublot       NVARCHAR(40)
    ,@reporting_precision  INT = 3
BEGIN TRY
    -- STEP 1: Get TOP 1 oldest WIP/INTERMEDIATE Consumption record with quantity left to be reported
    -- Verify current sublot number running on the WIP production line
    SELECT TOP 1 
		@row_id        			= ic.row_id
		,@ent_id               	= ic.from_ent_id
		,@item_grp             	= ia.attr_value
		,@item_id              	= ic.item_id
		,@cons_lot             	= ic.lot_no
		,@cons_sublot          	= ic.sublot_no
		,@cons_fg_lot          	= ic.fg_lot_no
		,@cons_fg_sublot       	= ic.fg_sublot_no
		,@cur_cons_qty         	= qty_cons
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty 	= (qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp, 0))
		,@cur_cons_qty_erp     	= qty_cons_erp
		,@cons_wo_id           	= ic.wo_id
		,@cons_spare1          	= ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,ic.spare1), 0) -- v1.02: MOD
		,@cons_created_at      	= ic.created_at_utc
    FROM
        item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
        -- LEFT JOIN ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported icr WITH (NOLOCK) ON icr.item_cons_row_id = ic.row_id
        -- AND icr.spare1 = ic.spare1
        INNER JOIN
            item i WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON
                ic.item_id = i.item_id
        INNER JOIN
            item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON
                ia.item_id     = i.item_id
                AND ia.attr_id =
                (
                    SELECT
                        attr_id
                    FROM
                        attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE
                        attr_desc    = 'ItemGroup'
                        AND attr_grp = 1
                )
                LEFT OUTER JOIN
                    item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON
                        ia2.item_id     = i.item_id
                        AND ia2.attr_id =
                        (
                            SELECT
                                attr_id
                            FROM
                                attr WITH (NOLOCK)
                            WHERE
                                attr_desc    = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
                                AND attr_grp = 1
                        )
                        LEFT JOIN
                            ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK)
                            ON
                                ie.item_id   = i.item_id
                                AND ie.wo_id = ic.wo_id
                    WHERE
						qty_cons > qty_cons_erp -- Added v1.01
                        AND ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,ic.spare1), 0) <> 0  -- v1.02: MOD
                        AND i.item_class_id NOT IN ( 'WIP' ,'INTERMEDIATE' )
                        -- AND ia.attr_value       IN ('Beans') -- Removed v1.01
                        -- Prevent items to be reported when SkipConsumptionReporting is set
                        AND
                        (
                            ISNULL(ia2.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%'
                        )
                    ORDER BY
                        ic.created_at_utc ASC
    -- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
    IF ( @row_id IS NULL
			OR @row_id = -1
			OR ROUND(@cons_spare1,@reporting_precision) = 0 ) -- v1.02: MOD
    BEGIN
        RETURN;
    END
    -- STEP 2: Get the extra information from the staging TABLE
    SELECT
        TOP 1 @wip_table_row_id = icr.row_id
      ,@wip_table_wo_id         = icr.sap_reported_wip_wo_id
	  ,@wip_reported_created_at = icr.sap_reported_created_at_utc
    FROM
        ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported icr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE
        icr.item_cons_row_id                    = @row_id
        AND icr.spare1                          = @cons_spare1
        AND icr.sap_reported_processed_id IS NULL
    ORDER BY
        icr.created_at_utc DESC
    -- STEP 3: Get Storage Location
    SET @storage_locn = NULL
    SELECT
        @storage_locn = attr_value
    FROM
        ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE
        ent_id      = @ent_id
        AND attr_id =
        (
            SELECT
                attr_id
            FROM
                attr WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE
                attr_desc    = 'SAPLocation'
                AND attr_grp = 2
        )
        IF @storage_locn IS NULL
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @storage_locn = ent_name
            FROM
                ent WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE
                ent_id = @ent_id
        END
        -- STEP 3.1: Start Transaction:
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        -- Declare Variables for this step
        DECLARE @processed_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID()
        -- STEP 4: Update staging table
        IF (@wip_table_row_id IS NOT NULL)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE
                [dbo].[ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported]
            SET [last_edit_comment]        = 'Data processed and sent to SAP'
              ,[last_edit_at]              = GETUTCDATE()
              ,[sap_reported_processed_id] = @processed_id
            WHERE
                [row_id] = @wip_table_row_id
        END
        -- Declare variables for the step
        DECLARE @qty_erp_total FLOAT         = 0.0
            ,@qty_reported     FLOAT         = 0.0
            ,@comment_reported NVARCHAR(400) = ''
            -- STEP 5: Update the item_cons TABLE: If we go above the item_cons, then set it to item_cons
        IF ((@cur_cons_qty_erp+@cons_spare1) <= @cur_cons_qty)
        BEGIN
            SET @qty_erp_total    = @cur_cons_qty_erp + @cons_spare1
            SET @qty_reported     = ROUND(@cons_spare1,@reporting_precision) -- v1.02 MOD.
            SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Last quantity reported to SAP: ' + CAST((@qty_reported) AS NVARCHAR(1000)) -- v1.02 MOD
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @qty_erp_total    = @cur_cons_qty
            SET @qty_reported     = ROUND(@cur_cons_qty - @cur_cons_qty_erp,@reporting_precision)
            SET @comment_reported = 'Update for WIP Report: Reported - Total consumption went above of qty_cons. Total extra was: ' + CAST((@cur_cons_qty_erp + @cons_spare1 - @cur_cons_qty) AS NVARCHAR(1000))
        END
        -- Run the update
        UPDATE
            [dbo].[item_cons]
        SET [qty_cons_erp]     = @qty_erp_total
          ,[spare1]            ='0'
          ,[last_edit_comment] = @comment_reported
        WHERE
            [row_id] = @row_id
        -- STEP 6: Give Output from SP
        -- OUTPUT FORMAT:
        -- Should be XML format for SAP:
        --
        -- [wo_id] Order_Number
        -- [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant
        -- [lot_no] Batch_Number
        -- [item_id] Material
        --  [spare1 or qty_cons] Quantity
        -- [uom].[description] UOM
        -- '261' or '262' Movement_Type
        --  format([item_cons].[created_at_local], 'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date
        -- format(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate
        -- format(GETDATE(), 'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime
        -- @storage_locn Storage_Location
        -- Document_Number
        -- Message
        -- Message
        SELECT
            ISNULL(@wip_table_wo_id,@cons_wo_id) Order_Number
          ,[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]()          Plant
          ,@cons_lot                             Batch_Number
          ,@item_id                              Material
          ,@qty_reported                         Quantity
          ,u.description                         UOM
          ,CASE
                WHEN @qty_reported < 0.0
                    THEN '262'
                    ELSE '261'
            END                                AS Movement_Type
          ,FORMAT(COALESCE(@wip_reported_created_at,@cons_created_at),'yyyyMMdd')    Posting_Date
          ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd')           File_GenerationDate
          ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')             File_GenerationTime
          ,@storage_locn                          Storage_Location
          ,''                                     Document_Number
          ,''                                     Message
          ,''                                     Message
        FROM
            item i WITH (NOLOCK)
            LEFT JOIN
                uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON
                    i.uom_id = u.uom_id
        WHERE
            i.item_id = @item_id
        -- STEP 6.1: Commit transaction.
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT
            @error_msg     = ERROR_MESSAGE()
          ,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
          ,@error_state    = ERROR_STATE()
        ;
        
        RAISERROR( @error_msg ,@error_severity ,@error_state )
    END CATCH
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_ent_file_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[ent_file]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_ent_file_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on ent_file table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 09/27/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/01/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the file_type matches the extension of the file_path
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Makes sure the file_type matches the extension of the file_path
	UPDATE ent_file SET file_type = x.extension
	FROM (SELECT ent_id, file_path, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(file_path) as extension, file_type FROM inserted) x
	WHERE ent_file.ent_id = x.ent_id AND ent_file.file_path = x.file_path AND x.extension <> x.file_type

	UPDATE ent_file SET ent_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, ent_file.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE ent_file.ent_id = i.ent_id AND ent_file.file_path = i.file_path
END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_History_AddEvent]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@new_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@event_time			TDATETIME2 = NULL --local time for backward compatibility; will be overridden if event_time_utc is supplied since UTC is more reliable
,@reas_cd			INT32
,@reas_pending			LOGICAL = 0
,@new_event_end_time_utc	TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@duration			INT32 = NULL  -- duration for backward compatibility; will be overridden if the new event_end_time_utc is supplied
,@comments			STRING2000_NULL = NULL
,@raw_reas_cd			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@spare1			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@spare2			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@spare3			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@spare4			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@category1			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@category2			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@category3			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@category4			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@records_affected		INT32_NULL = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Util_History_AddEvent
-- Description	      - UserStory: 675693 - Adds new utilization event and adjust all the events around this event accordingly
-- Author	      -    Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	08/15/2016
-- Version	      - 5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu			5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @pre_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@pre_event_end_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@ending_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@next_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2

  	,@state_cd			INT32
	,@runtime			LOGICAL
	,@downtime			LOGICAL
	,@setuptime			LOGICAL
	,@teardowntime			LOGICAL
	,@fixedtime			LOGICAL
	,@failure			LOGICAL
	,@vartime			LOGICAL

	,@last_edit_by			STRING40
	,@last_edit_at			TDATETIME

	,@range_start_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@range_end_utc			TDATETIME2
	,@error_msg			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@last_edit_comment 		STRING254 = 'UtilHistory.AddEvent'

BEGIN
	--Default the duration to 0
	SELECT @duration = COALESCE(@duration, 0), @reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, 0)

	--Error, if the supplied duration is less than zero.
	IF (@duration < 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Duration cannot be negative.{5984}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the reason code exist in the database
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified utilization reason does not exist.{7926}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- If the event time UTC is supplied, use that since UTC is more reliable
	IF (@new_event_time_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Since UTC time is not supplied; use the supplied local time to determine the UTC time
		--This case is for backward compatibility
		IF (@event_time IS NULL) BEGIN -- Verify whether a local time is supplied
			--The start time is not supplied.  Raise an error, exit
			SET @error_msg = 'The %1 should be a valid datetime. Please enter a valid date and time.{3347}, start time'
			RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Use the local time to determine the new start time
		SET @new_event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	--Strip out the milliseconds
	SET @new_event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@new_event_time_utc)

	--Verify that the event is not in the future
	IF (@new_event_time_utc > GETUTCDATE()) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This is a future event, and the duration and event_time does not fit in with the current date and time{4258}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Determine if the end event time of the new event utc is supplied
	IF (@new_event_end_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
		--The end time of the new event is supplied
		SET @duration = DATEDIFF(SS, @new_event_time_utc, @new_event_end_time_utc)
	ELSE
		--The new event end time utc is not supplied. For backward compatibility, use the duration, if supplied
		SET @new_event_end_time_utc = DATEADD(SS, @duration, @new_event_time_utc)

	--Error, if the supplied duration is less than zero.
	IF (@duration < 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Start datetime must be earlier than end datetime{3030}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the start time and end time of the preceding event from the new start time
	SELECT @pre_event_time_utc = vuh.event_time_utc, @pre_event_end_time_utc = vuh.event_end_time_utc
	FROM vw_util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE vuh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND vuh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc)
				    FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
				    WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
				      AND event_time_utc <= @new_event_time_utc)

	--If the duration is null or 0, then the inserted event will take the rest of the duration in the current event
	IF (@duration = 0) OR
		--Verify whether the starting time of the new event and the ending time of the new event exactly match.
		(@new_event_time_utc = @pre_event_time_utc AND @pre_event_end_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc) BEGIN
		--The supplied duration is zero.
		--Call to add an event, set the event_exists property to true, so if the event already exist, it will be updated with the new properties.
		EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@new_event_time_utc, @reas_cd=@reas_cd, @reas_pending=@reas_pending
			, @comments=@comments, @raw_reas_cd=@raw_reas_cd, @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4
			, @category1=@category1, @category2=@category2, @category3=@category3, @category4=@category4
			, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @update_if_exists=1
			, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=@records_affected OUTPUT

		--Since the new event did not affect any other events, call the standard SPs and exit.
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the start time of the next event
	SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND event_time_utc >= @new_event_end_time_utc

	--Get the last edit at time
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	--If there are no events in the future, then default the current date time as the next event.
	SET @next_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@next_event_time_utc, @last_edit_at)

	--Get the user who is running this transaction
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Verify whether the new event is entirely contained inside an existing event
	IF (@new_event_time_utc > @pre_event_time_utc AND @new_event_time_utc < @pre_event_end_time_utc
	   AND @new_event_end_time_utc > @pre_event_time_utc AND @new_event_end_time_utc < @pre_event_end_time_utc) BEGIN
	   	--The new event is contained entirely within an existing single event
			--Now insert the first chunk into the 3rd slot to cover the remaining time
			INSERT INTO util_history (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_time_local, state_cd, reas_cd, reas_pending
				, runtime, downtime, setuptime, teardowntime, fixedtime, vartime, failure, comments, raw_reas_cd
				, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, category1, category2, category3, category4
				, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			SELECT uh.ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc), uh.state_cd, uh.reas_cd, uh.reas_pending
				, uh.runtime, uh.downtime, uh.setuptime, uh.teardowntime, uh.fixedtime, uh.vartime, uh.failure, uh.comments, uh.raw_reas_cd
				, uh.spare1, uh.spare2, uh.spare3, uh.spare4, uh.category1, uh.category2, uh.category3, uh.category4
				, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
			FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND uh.event_time_utc = @pre_event_time_utc
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Move the subsequent event to start at the end of the supplied event, if the ending event is not the start of next event
		IF (@new_event_end_time_utc < @next_event_time_utc) BEGIN
			--Get the start time of the ending event
			SELECT @ending_event_time_utc = vuh.event_time_utc
			FROM util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE vuh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND vuh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc)
						    FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
						    WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
						      AND event_time_utc <= @new_event_end_time_utc)

			--The new event is not ending on top of the start of next event; therefore, update the event
			UPDATE util_history
			SET event_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc
			 , event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc)
			 , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND event_time_utc = @ending_event_time_utc
		END

		-- The new event is spanning at least one event
		-- Therefore, remove all the events in the middle
		DELETE util_history
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND event_time_utc > @new_event_time_utc
		  AND event_time_utc < @new_event_end_time_utc
	END

	-- The supplied new event is contained entirely within an another event
	-- Get the reason details for the new event
	SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @runtime = runtime, @downtime = downtime
		, @setuptime = setuptime, @teardowntime = teardowntime, @fixedtime = fixedtime
		, @failure = failure, @vartime = vartime
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd

	--Verify whether an event exist at this time
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc)

		--An event already exist. Therefore, update the existing event
		UPDATE util_history
		SET state_cd = @state_cd, reas_cd = @reas_cd, reas_pending = @reas_pending
			, runtime = @runtime, downtime = @downtime, setuptime = @setuptime, teardowntime = @teardowntime, fixedtime = @fixedtime
			, vartime = @vartime, failure = @failure, comments = COALESCE(@comments, comments)
			, raw_reas_cd = COALESCE(@raw_reas_cd, raw_reas_cd)
			, spare1 = COALESCE(@spare1, spare1), spare2 = COALESCE(@spare2, spare2), spare3 = COALESCE(@spare3, spare3), spare4 = COALESCE(@spare4, spare4)
			, category1 = COALESCE(@category1, category1), category2 = COALESCE(@category2, category2), category3 = COALESCE(@category3, category3), category4 = COALESCE(@category4, category4)
			, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc
	ELSE
		--Insert the new event
		INSERT INTO util_history (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_time_local, state_cd, reas_cd, reas_pending
			, runtime, downtime, setuptime, teardowntime, fixedtime, vartime, failure, comments, raw_reas_cd
			, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, category1, category2, category3, category4
			, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (@ent_id, @new_event_time_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_time_utc), @state_cd, @reas_cd, @reas_pending
			, @runtime, @downtime, @setuptime, @teardowntime, @fixedtime, @vartime, @failure, @comments, @raw_reas_cd
			, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @category1, @category2, @category3, @category4
			, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

	--Determine whether the first event in the event adjustment is the new event start time
	IF (@pre_event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc)
		--The new start time of the event is same as the start time of the preceding event.
		SELECT @pre_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc < @pre_event_time_utc

	--Determine the start and end rage of events
	SELECT @range_start_utc = MIN(v), @range_end_utc = MAX(v)
	FROM (VALUES (@new_event_time_utc), (@new_event_end_time_utc), (@pre_event_time_utc), (@pre_event_end_time_utc), (@ending_event_time_utc), (@next_event_time_utc)) AS value(v)

	--Merge events if they need to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id = @ent_id
		, @event_time_utc_start_range = @range_start_utc, @event_time_utc_end_range = @range_end_utc
		, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, @records_affected = @records_affected OUTPUT
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewJob]
(
		@ent_id					INT32
	,	@wo_id					STRING40
	,	@oper_id				STRING40
	,	@seq_no					INT32
	,	@item_id				STRING40
	,	@old_wo_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@old_oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@old_seq_no				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 12/03/2002		Raghu			1.5.0		(HD# 1300) Changed checking from Idle to Null
-- 01/22/2003		Raghu			1.5.5 		(HD# 1748) Donot carry Step_Nos and Lot_Nos to next jobs. Set Step_NO and Lot_No to NULL
-- 03/11/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		(HD# 1748) Default lot_no from job_bom.def_lot_no on job start
-- 04/01/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		To improve performance and to remove deadlock, the code which loops thru into the cursor is commented out.
--												Changed to direct select and direct update statement
-- 12/01/2003		Raghu			2.0.13		(HD# 3879) Handling steps with multiple job execs.
-- 02/10/2004		Raghu			2.0.25		(HD# 1717) Ignore default labor code if a job is started/stopped on multi job pos
-- 06/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Included NULL value for last_edit_comment field while calling sp_I_Labor_Usage.
-- 												Also added last_edit_by and last_edit_at in insert statements
-- 10/27/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/05/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	 	Part of DB Changes
-- 04/04/2007    	Raghu       	3.2.0.7 	HD# 9288, Logon a user to a job; Handle job_exec.run_without_operator case
-- 08/20/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 12/31/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF 1432 Bring Hotfix forward
-- 02/22/2010        SLR            4.0.0       Updating labor usage records to make inactive when starting or suspending batch jobs was jot working correctly
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@log_id					INT32
		,	@labor_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_local		TDATETIME
		,	@user_id				STRING40
		,	@step_no				INT32
		,	@lot_no					STRING40
		,	@sublot_no				STRING40
		,	@lab_cd					STRING40
		,	@dept_id				STRING40
		,	@shift_id				INT32
		,	@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_local		TDATETIME
		,	@pct_to_apply			TFLOAT
		,	@active					LOGICAL
		,	@duration				INT32
		,	@comments				STRING254
		,	@mod_id					STRING40
		,	@return					INT32
		,	@can_capture_labor		INT32
		,	@ent_pct_to_apply		TFLOAT
		,	@no_running_jobs		INT32
		,	@cur_job_pct_to_apply	TFLOAT
		,	@tot_pct_to_apply		TFLOAT
		,	@def_lab_cd				STRING40
		,	@state_cd				INT32
		,	@last_edit_by			STRING40
		,	@job_based_login		INT32
		,	@def_dept_id			STRING40
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SELECT	@can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor
		,	@shift_id = cur_shift_id
		,	@shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
		,	@shift_start_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	IF (COALESCE(@can_capture_labor, 0) = 0) RETURN 0

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Retrieve general default labor code and dept ID for this entity - added 6/29/07 KRF
    IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE labor_exec.ent_id = @ent_id ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'No labor_exec record found for the current entity.', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd, @def_dept_id = def_dept_id
        FROM labor_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	--If input params = "Idle" to indicate job has ended then set wo_id, oper_id, seq_no and item_id = null
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @oper_id IS NULL) OR (@wo_id = '' OR @oper_id = '') OR ((lower(@wo_id) = 'idle') and (lower(@oper_id) = 'idle')) BEGIN   --  and (@seq_no IS NULL)) BEGIN
		SELECT @wo_id = NULL, @oper_id = NULL, @seq_no = NULL, @item_id = NULL, @lot_no = NULL, @sublot_no = NULL, @step_no = NULL

		SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd
		FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE reas_cd = (SELECT jobend_reas_cd FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @lot_no = def_lot_no, @sublot_no = def_sublot_no
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0

		SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd
		FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE reas_cd = (SELECT jobstart_reas_cd FROM util_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
	END

	SET @labor_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	SET @labor_start_local= NULL
	SET @time_zone_bias_value=NULL
	EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @labor_start_utc,@labor_start_local OUTPUT,  @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT

  -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewJob', @src_key='GetDateInfo', @date_val1 = @labor_start_local,@date_val2 = @labor_start_utc

	DECLARE new_job_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	OPEN new_job_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM new_job_cursor INTO @user_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

        --Loop through each user to adjust labor percentage.
        --Verify whether this user is logged in using job based login.
        SELECT @job_based_login = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
        FROM grp_priv_link gpl WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
        WHERE gpl.priv_id = 92 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

		--Default the job_based_login privilege to 0; if not found.
		SELECT @job_based_login = COALESCE(@job_based_login, 0), @cur_job_pct_to_apply = 0,
			@ent_pct_to_apply = 0, @tot_pct_to_apply = 0

		--Verify whether a job is currently paused/ended or started.
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN --New Job is Started on this entity
			--A job is started on this entity.
			IF (@job_based_login = 0) BEGIN
				--Get a count of jobs that are running on this entity.
				SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*)
				FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND (cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)

				--Get the MAXimum percentage that was applied to this entity.
				SELECT @ent_pct_to_apply = MAX(pct_lab_to_apply)
				FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND user_id = @user_id

				IF (@no_running_jobs > 1) BEGIN --More than ONE job is running on this entity
					--There is ONLY one job that is running on this entity; probably this is the job that started on this entity.
					--Calculate the curret job percentage by dividing the no. of jobs that are running on this entity.
					SET @cur_job_pct_to_apply = @ent_pct_to_apply/(@no_running_jobs - 1)

					--Calculate the percentage that must be applied for this job.
					SET @tot_pct_to_apply = @ent_pct_to_apply + @cur_job_pct_to_apply

					--Create a new set of labor usage records.
					INSERT INTO labor_usage
					(
						labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no,
						lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply, active, duration, comments,
						last_edit_by, last_edit_at
					)
					SELECT	@labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, item_id, lot_no,
							sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
							CASE WHEN @tot_pct_to_apply = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (pct_to_apply/@tot_pct_to_apply)*@ent_pct_to_apply END,
							active, 0, comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_usage.active = 1
				END

--02/22/2010 SLR updating labor usage records was not working correctly for batched jobs because the labor_start_utc is the same
				--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
				UPDATE labor_usage
				SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @labor_start_utc), active = 0
                WHERE log_id in (SELECT MIN(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE active = 1
				  AND user_id = @user_id
				  AND ent_id = @ent_id
                  GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no)
				  --AND labor_start_utc <> @labor_start_utc
-- END CHANGE 2/22/2010 SLR

				--Calculate the percentage that must be applied for a job.
				SET @cur_job_pct_to_apply = @ent_pct_to_apply/@no_running_jobs

				--Retreive a default labor_cod and dept_id for this user and the entity.
				SELECT @lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd), @dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id)
				FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND user_id = @user_id
				  AND ent_logon.cur_lab_cd IS NOT NULL
				  AND ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id IS NOT NULL

				IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
                    -- See if the user has a default labor code
                    SELECT @lab_cd = def_lab_cd
					FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_name.[user_id] = @user_id

                    -- If still null use the default labor code from the entity
                    IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
                        SET @lab_cd = @def_lab_cd
                    END

                    IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
                    -- If still null look up lowest labor code for any active labor_usage record for this user and entity
                        SELECT @lab_cd = MIN(lab_cd)
						FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
                        WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
							  labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
							  labor_usage.active = 1
                    END
                END

                IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
                    -- See if the user has a default dept ID
                    SELECT @dept_id = def_dept_id
					FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE user_name.[user_id] = @user_id

                    -- If still null use the default dept ID from the entity
                    IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
                        SET @dept_id = @def_dept_id
                    END

                    IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
                    -- If still null look up lowest dept ID for any active labor_usage record for this user and entity
                        SELECT @dept_id = MIN(dept_id)
						FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
                        WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
							  labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
							  labor_usage.active = 1
                    END
                END

				--Create a new labor usage record for the new job.

				EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage  	@log_id, @labor_start_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @item_id,
										@lot_no, @sublot_no, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, 0, @cur_job_pct_to_apply,
										1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @mod_id

				--Update ent_logon with the current logid
				UPDATE ent_logon
				SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id)
				WHERE user_id = @user_id
					AND ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--A job is paused on this entity.
			--Verify whether this user is using a job based login.
			IF (@job_based_login = 1) BEGIN
				--This user is logged in using job based login.
				--Verify whether this user has logged on to this job.
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
								  AND wo_id = @old_wo_id AND oper_id = @old_oper_id AND seq_no = @old_seq_no
								  AND active = 1)
					CONTINUE
			END

			--Logout this user from the supplied job.
			SELECT @cur_job_pct_to_apply = SUM(lu.pct_to_apply)
			FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lu.user_id = @user_id
			  AND lu.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND lu.wo_id = @old_wo_id
			  AND lu.oper_id = @old_oper_id
			  AND lu.seq_no = @old_seq_no
			  AND lu.active = 1

			--Get the MAXimum percentage that was applied to this entity.
			SELECT @ent_pct_to_apply = MAX(pct_lab_to_apply)
			FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND user_id = @user_id

			--Calculate the percentage to apply from the total percentage applied for the entity.
			SET @tot_pct_to_apply = @ent_pct_to_apply - @cur_job_pct_to_apply

			SET @tot_pct_to_apply = COALESCE(@tot_pct_to_apply, 1)

			--create a new set of labor_usage records
			INSERT INTO labor_usage
			(
				labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
			    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
			    active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			SELECT @labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,
			    item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
			    CASE WHEN @tot_pct_to_apply = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (pct_to_apply/@tot_pct_to_apply)*@ent_pct_to_apply END,
			    1, 0, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment,
			    @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE user_id = @user_id
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND active = 1
			  AND (wo_id + ';' + oper_id + ';' + LTRIM(STR(seq_no))) NOT IN
				(SELECT @old_wo_id + ';' + @old_oper_id + ';' + LTRIM(STR(@old_seq_no)))
			  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL

--02/22/2010 SLR updating labor usage records was not working correctly for batched jobs because the labor_start_utc is the same
			--Close all the current active labor_usage records.
			UPDATE labor_usage
			SET duration = DATEDIFF(SS, labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @labor_start_utc), active = 0
            WHERE log_id in (SELECT MIN(log_id) FROM labor_usage
			WHERE active = 1
			  AND user_id = @user_id
			  AND ent_id = @ent_id
              GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no)
			  --AND labor_start_utc <> @labor_start_utc
 -- END CHANGE 2/22/2010 SLR

			IF (@job_based_login = 0)
				--Get a count of jobs that are running on this entity.
				SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*)
				FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND (cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL)
			ELSE
				--This user has logged in based on the job based login.
				--Verify whether this user has logged on to any other job on this entity.
				--Get a count of jobs that are running on this entity.
				SELECT @no_running_jobs = COUNT(*)
				FROM (
					SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
					FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND user_id = @user_id
					  AND wo_id IS NOT NULL AND oper_id IS NOT NULL AND seq_no IS NOT NULL
					  AND active = 1
					GROUP BY wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
				) AS lu

			IF (@no_running_jobs = 0) BEGIN
				--Do not duplicate the NULL job entry; if such an entry already exist in the labor_usage table.
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
								AND user_id = @user_id AND active = 1 AND wo_id IS NULL AND oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
					--Insert a labor usage record with NULL job details.
					--Retreive a default labor_cod and dept_id for this user and the entity.
					SELECT @lab_cd = MAX(cur_lab_cd), @dept_id = MAX(cur_lab_dept_id)
					FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
						AND user_id = @user_id
						AND ent_logon.cur_lab_cd IS NOT NULL
						AND ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id IS NOT NULL

					IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
						-- See if the user has a default labor code
						SELECT @lab_cd = def_lab_cd
						FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE user_name.[user_id] = @user_id

						-- If still null use the default labor code from the entity
						IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
							SET @lab_cd = @def_lab_cd
						END

						IF (@lab_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
						-- If still null look up lowest labor code for any active labor_usage record for this user and entity
							SELECT @lab_cd = MIN(lab_cd)
							FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
								labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
								labor_usage.active = 1
						END
					END

					IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
						-- See if the user has a default dept ID
						SELECT @dept_id = def_dept_id
						FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE user_name.[user_id] = @user_id

						-- If still null use the default dept ID from the entity
						IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
							SET @dept_id = @def_dept_id
						END

						IF (@dept_id IS NULL) BEGIN
						-- If still null look up lowest dept ID for any active labor_usage record for this user and entity
							SELECT @dept_id = MIN(dept_id)
							FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND
								labor_usage.ent_id = @ent_id AND
								labor_usage.active = 1
						END
					END

					--Create a new labor usage record for the new job.

					EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage 	@log_id, @labor_start_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @user_id, @ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL,
											NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @lab_cd, @dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_local, 0,
											@ent_pct_to_apply, 1, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @mod_id

				END

				--Update ent_logon with the current logid
				UPDATE ent_logon SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id)
				WHERE user_id = @user_id
				  AND ent_id = @ent_id
			END
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_GetControlRules]
(
		@qm_spec_id            	INT32
	,	@char_id				INT32
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -	sp_SA_Sample_GetControlRules
-- Description          -	Get the control rules that are assigned to the specificide qm_spec_id excluding an rule that is
--							excluded from the specified characteristic.  The rules are returned in priority order and include
--							the information for which chart the rules apply.
-- Author				- Rich Boyle
-- Date Created			- 04/09/2012
-- Version				- 4.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 02/21/2018			RWB				6.0			Story 977461 - added the test1 and test2 columns from the spc_rule table
--													as columns in the returned record set.
-- 01/31/2019         Srinivasa         6.3         US#1120686;Merge L00151783 (HF CR L00151604: Changes done in order to fix the issue (rows were not returned even if the severity was changed to Key via QM Spec linked characteristics level).
-- 	 	                                            Changed the WHERE clause to get severity_cd from qm_spec_char_link table instead of characteristics table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	SELECT qm_spec_rule_link.rule_id, spc_rule.priority, spc_rule.use_for_ix, spc_rule.use_for_xbar, spc_rule.use_for_sigma, spc_rule.use_for_ma, spc_rule.use_for_range, spc_rule.use_for_mr, spc_rule.use_for_attr, spc_rule.test1, spc_rule.test2
       FROM qm_spec_rule_link WITH (NOLOCK)
       INNER JOIN spc_rule WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_rule_link.rule_id = spc_rule.rule_id
       INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) ON qm_spec_rule_link.qm_spec_id = qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id AND @char_id = qm_spec_char_link.char_id
       INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON @char_id = characteristic.char_id
       WHERE qm_spec_rule_link.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND
             spc_rule.rule_id not in (SELECT rule_id FROM char_rule_exc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE char_id = @char_id) AND
              COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.severity_cd,characteristic.severity_cd)>1
       ORDER BY spc_rule.priority

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_get_all_segments_create_job]
	@ent_id INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @attr_id INT,
	@attr_value NVARCHAR(100),
	@area_ent INT

    SELECT @attr_id=A.attr_id
	FROM attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_desc like '%EntityType%'

	SELECT @attr_value=ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ea.attr_id=@attr_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id
	
	IF(@attr_value = 'Segment')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @area_ent=e.parent_ent_id
		FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id IN (SELECT e2.parent_ent_id
							FROM ent e2 WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE e2.ent_id=@ent_id)
	END
	ELSE IF(@attr_value = 'Line')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @area_ent=e.parent_ent_id
		FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id=@ent_id
	END
	ELSE IF(@attr_value = 'Area')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @area_ent=@ent_id;
	END

	SELECT e3.ent_id
			,e3.ent_name
			,e3.description
	FROM ent e3 with(nolock)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea on ea.ent_id =e3.ent_id and ea.attr_value='Segment' and e3.can_run_jobs=1
	WHERE e3.ent_id IN (select e4.ent_id
						from ent e4 with(nolock)
						where e4.parent_ent_id IN(select e5.ent_id
													from ent e5 with(nolock)
													where e5.parent_ent_id=@area_ent))

	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Error_Log]
  (@log_id int OUT,
   @logged_at datetime ,
   @severity int ,
   @instance_info nvarchar(254) ,
   @object_name nvarchar(80) ,
   @object_section nvarchar(254) ,
   @description nvarchar(1700) ,
   @system_msg NOTES ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	          -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	          - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group PLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 10/10/2005     Raghu        3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/08/2006     KRF          3.2.1    HD# 9213, part of DB changes - change type of @system_msg from nvarchar(254) to ntext
-- 09/21/2017	  Raghu		   6.0	    UserStory:909250 - As Terry, I want the migration of util tables to the new schema to not fail because of error messages in error_log table (CR L00146457)
-- 02/04/2020     Jim O'Hearn  6.2.0    Removed ntext in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF (@logged_at IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @logged_at = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @logged_at = GETUTCDATE()
ELSE SET @logged_at =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logged_at)
SET @logged_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @logged_at )

 IF @severity IS null SET @severity = 3
 INSERT INTO error_log
 (logged_at,
  severity,
  instance_info,
  object_name,
  object_section,
  description,
  system_msg)
VALUES
  (@logged_at,
   @severity,
   @instance_info,
   @object_name,
   @object_section,
   @description,
   @system_msg)
-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
SELECT @log_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_UpdCurrShiftSchedule]
(@ent_id				INT32 = NULL
,@line_id				INT32 = NULL
,@create_shift_history	BIT = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_U_Ent_UpdCurrShiftSchedule
-- Description       - UserStory: 259170 - Update shift information for the entities when the entities are moved around or added to a line.
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 11/04/2013
-- Version           - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
--
--This stored procedure works on two contexts: entity (if the @ent_id input parameter is not null) and line (if the @line_id input parameter is not null). One of these two parameters should be null and the other non-null
--
--Entity Context: When an entity is moved under different parent or the shift schedule for an entity is changed, this stored procedure
--                is called to fix the shift schedules for the supplied entity and to fix the schedules for all of its descendants.
--		  Entities affected: supplied entity
--				     direct descendants, if the descendant entity is not in a line
--				     direct descendants, if the descendant entity is in a line and the line's parent is a descendant of the supplied entity
--				     entities in a line, if the line's parent is a descendant of the supplied entity

--Line Context: When an entity is added/removed from a line or when a line's parent is added or removed from a line, this stored procedure
--		  is called to fix the shift schedules for all the entities in a line.
--		Entities affected: Entities that are members of a line.

--For example, the entity hierarchy is configured as below:
--A
--|-----B1
--|----------B2
--|---------------Grinder01
--|---------------Filler01
--|----------B21
--|---------------Grinder02
--|---------------Filler02
--|-----C1
--|----------C2
--|---------------Grinder03
--|---------------Filler03
--|-----D1
--|----------D2
--|---------------Grinder04
--|---------------Filler04
--|----------D21
--|---------------Grinder05
--|---------------Filler05


--Let's say there are four lines with the setup below:
--|-----B1
--|----------Line01
--|---------------Grinder01
--|---------------Filler01

--|-----B2
--|----------Line02
--|---------------Grinder03
--|---------------Filler03

--|-----C1
--|----------Line03
--|---------------Grinder02
--|---------------Filler02

--|-----D21
--|----------Line04
--|---------------Grinder04
--|---------------Filler05

--Operating on Entity context:
----------------------------
--When the shift schedule for B1 is modified, then the shift schedules for the following entities should be updated:B1,B2,B21,Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder03,Filler03,
--but NOT for Grinder02,Filler02 since these two entities are under Line03 which has a parent C2 and C2 is not a descendant of B1.
--Entities prefer to inherit their shift schedules from the line to which they belong rather than from their preferred parent entity

--The ent_descendants CTE builds all the entities that are direct descendants (B1,B2,B21,Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder02,Filler02) to the supplied entity B1.

--The line_descendants CTE builds all the entities in a line (Grinder01, Grinder03, Filler01, Filler03) that are directly/indirectly descendants to one of the entities.
--in the entity hierarchy (B1,B2,B21,Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder02,Filler02).

--The line_entities_to_exclude CTE builds all the entities in a line that have parents.  The resultset would have: Grinder01-5, Filler01-5.

--The line_entities CTE would not have any records in it, because the query limits the records by the supplied line ID and a line ID is not supplied in this context.

--The inner query in Step5 performs an operation on ent_descendants CTE to exclude all the entities in line_entities_to_exclude CTE.
--Therefore, (B1,B2,B21,Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder02,Filler02) - (Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder02,Filler02,Grinder03,Filler03,Grinder04,Filler04,Grinder05,Filler05) = B1,B2,B21

--The inner query on line_descendants in Step5 adds the entities back to the list.  Therefore (B1,B2,B21) + (Grinder01,Grinder03,Filler01,Filler03) = B1,B2,B21,Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder03,Filler03.

--The shift schedules for the following entities are updated when the shift schedule for B1 is modified: B1,B2,B21,Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder03,Filler03.


--Operating on Line context:
--------------------------
--When an entity is added to a line, or a line's parent is added/removed from a line, then the shift schdule(s) from the appropriate ancestor is updated to all the entities in a line.
--For example, when a parent entity B2 is added to the Line02, then the members in a line should inherit their shift schedules from B2.

--The ent_descendants CTE would not have any records, since this CTE works only when an entity ID is supplied.

--The line_descendants CTE would not have any records, since the source of entities are inherited from ent_descendants and that the ent_descendants is empty,
--therefore, this CTE would not have any records for this context.

--The line_entities_to_exclude CTE builds all the entities in a line that have parents.  The resultset would have: Grinder01-5, Filler01-5.

--The line_entities CTE would have the entities that are members for the supplied line.  For example, Grinder03, Filler03.


--The inner query in Step5 performs an operation on ent_descents CTE to exclude all the entities in line_entities_to_exclude CTE.
--Therefore, (empty list) - (Grinder01,Filler01,Grinder02,Filler02,Grinder03,Filler03,Grinder04,Filler04,Grinder05,Filler05) = empty list

--The inner query on line_descendants in Step5 adds the entities back to the list.  Therefore (empty list) + (empty list) = empty list.

--The inner query on line_entities in Step5 adds the entities back to the list.  Therefore (empty list) + (Grinder03,Filler03) = Grinder03,Filler03.

--The shift schedules for the following entities for Line02 are updated: Grinder03,Filler03.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	 Changes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @can_sched_shifts				BIT
		,@can_capture_labor				BIT
		,@can_log_data					BIT
		,@can_run_jobs					BIT

		,@shift_ent_for_line			INT
		,@cur_shift_id					INT
		,@cur_shift_start_time_local	DATETIME
		,@cur_shift_end_time_local		DATETIME
		,@cur_shift_start_time_utc		DATETIME
		,@cur_shift_end_time_utc		DATETIME

DECLARE @descendant_entities			TABLE (ent_id INT, cur_shift_id INT, cur_shift_start_time_local DATETIME, cur_shift_end_time_local DATETIME, cur_shift_start_time_utc DATETIME, cur_shift_end_time_utc DATETIME)

BEGIN

	SET @create_shift_history = COALESCE(@create_shift_history, 0)

	--Step1: Verify whether the entity ID is supplied
	IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @can_sched_shifts = e.can_sched_shifts, @can_capture_labor = e.can_capture_labor, @can_log_data = e.can_log_data
			, @can_run_jobs = e.can_run_jobs
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		--This entity may be moved under different parent.
		--Therefore, verify whether there are any dependant records for this entity to defer the shift change for this entity.
		--If not, inherit the shifts from the nearest ancestor immediately, if this entity cannot schedule shifts.
		IF (@can_capture_labor = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
		  OR (@can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_16 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
		  OR (@can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_48 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
		  OR (@can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
		  OR (@can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id))
			--This entity has at least one record exists for: labor or data log or production or consumption
			--Therefore, defer to update the shift schedule for the entity.
			RETURN
	END
	--The line ID is supplied.
	ELSE IF (@line_id IS NOT NULL)
		--Step2: Retrieve the entity that can drive the shift schedules for the line.
		SELECT TOP 1 @shift_ent_for_line = lel.ent_id
		FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
		  AND lel.line_is_child = 1

	--Step3: Determine the current shift schedule from the ancestor entity.
	;WITH ent_parents AS
	(SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, e.can_sched_shifts, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, e.cur_shift_end_time_local
			, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	 --Limit to the supplied entity, if supplied
	 --Limit to the line's parent, if the supplied entity is null.
	 WHERE e.ent_id = COALESCE(@ent_id, @shift_ent_for_line)
	 UNION ALL
	 SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, e.can_sched_shifts, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, e.cur_shift_end_time_local
			, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	 --Look up on the ancestor entities to find an entity that can schedule shifts
	 INNER JOIN ent_parents ep ON e.ent_id = ep.parent_ent_id
	 WHERE ep.can_sched_shifts = 0
	)
	--Retrieve the shift details from the identified ancestor entity.
	SELECT @cur_shift_id = parent_ent_shift.cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_local = parent_ent_shift.cur_shift_start_time_local, @cur_shift_end_time_local = parent_ent_shift.cur_shift_end_time_local
		, @cur_shift_start_time_utc = parent_ent_shift.cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_end_time_utc = parent_ent_shift.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	FROM ent_parents parent_ent_shift
	WHERE parent_ent_shift.can_sched_shifts = 1

	--Step4: Get all descendant entities that are applicable
	;WITH ent_descendants AS
	--The ent_descendants are the direct descendants of the supplied entity.
	(SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, e.can_sched_shifts
	 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	 --Limit to the supplied entity
	 WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
	 UNION ALL
	 SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, e.can_sched_shifts
	 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	 --Look for all the descendant entities till there are no other descendants or a descendant entity that can schedule shifts of its own.
	 INNER JOIN ent_descendants ed ON e.parent_ent_id = ed.ent_id
	 WHERE e.can_sched_shifts = 0
	)
	, line_descendants AS
	--The line_descendants contains entities (members) in a line whose parent (line's parent) is part of the entity descendants (ent_decendants) found above.
	--The descendants of a line are populated only when this stored procedure is called with entity context (i.e. entity ID is supplied).
	(SELECT lel.ent_id
	 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	 INNER JOIN (SELECT l.line_id
				 FROM line_ent_link l WITH (NOLOCK)
				 INNER JOIN ent_descendants ed ON l.ent_id = ed.ent_id
				 WHERE l.line_is_child = 1) lines ON lel.line_id = lines.line_id
	)
	, line_entities_to_exclude AS
	--The line_entities_to_exclude contains entities from lines that have parents.
	(SELECT lel.ent_id
	 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	 INNER JOIN (SELECT l.line_id
				 FROM line_ent_link l WITH (NOLOCK)
				 WHERE l.line_is_child = 1) lines ON lel.line_id = lines.line_id
	)
	, line_entities AS
	--List of entities from the supplied line
	(SELECT lel.ent_id
	 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	 INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = lel.ent_id
	 WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
	   AND e.can_sched_shifts = 0
	)
	INSERT INTO @descendant_entities (ent_id, cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_local, cur_shift_end_time_local, cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_end_time_utc)
	--Step5: Select the entities that do not have history records for shifts that are greater than the supplied shift start time UTC.
	SELECT DISTINCT descs.ent_id, @cur_shift_id, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @cur_shift_end_time_local, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_end_time_utc
	FROM
		(SELECT e.ent_id
			, CASE WHEN e.can_capture_labor = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = e.ent_id AND shift_start_utc >= @cur_shift_start_time_utc) THEN 1
				   WHEN e.can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_16 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = e.ent_id AND shift_start_utc >= @cur_shift_start_time_utc) THEN 1
				   WHEN e.can_log_data = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_48 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = e.ent_id AND shift_start_utc >= @cur_shift_start_time_utc) THEN 1
				   WHEN e.can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = e.ent_id AND shift_start_utc >= @cur_shift_start_time_utc) THEN 1
				   WHEN e.can_run_jobs = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = e.ent_id AND shift_start_utc >= @cur_shift_start_time_utc) THEN 1
				 ELSE 0
			END dependent_record_exist
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN (SELECT ent_id FROM
					(--The supplied entity and the list of all descendants from the supplied entity
					SELECT ent_id FROM ent_descendants
					EXCEPT
					--Exclude all entities in a line
					SELECT ent_id FROM line_entities_to_exclude
					) desc_list
					UNION
					--Only include entities that are direct descendants to a line, and the line's parent is part of the supplied entity descendants
					SELECT ent_id FROM line_descendants
					UNION
					--Include all the entities in a line
					SELECT ent_id FROM line_entities
					) descendants ON e.ent_id = descendants.ent_id
		) descs
	WHERE descs.dependent_record_exist = 0

	--Step6: The parent of a line drives the shift schedule for the members in a line.  So, when a parent entity is added or removed from a line,
	--do not handle that entity to modify the shift schedule.
	DELETE FROM @descendant_entities WHERE ent_id = @shift_ent_for_line

	--Step7: The line_id is supplied, but the supplied line does not have any parent.
	--Therefore, use the shift from the default ancestors for all the entities in a line
	IF (@line_id IS NOT NULL AND @shift_ent_for_line IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Using the example above (at the beginning of the SP), when the line's parent is removed, say D21 for Line04, then the entities: Grinder04 and Filler05
		--should fall back to the schedule from their default ancestors.
		--Grinder04 should get the shift schedule from D2
		--Filler05 should get the shift schedule from D21
		;WITH ent_parents AS
		(SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, e.ent_id ent_needs_shift, e.can_sched_shifts, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, e.cur_shift_end_time_local
				, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
		 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN @descendant_entities de ON e.ent_id = de.ent_id
		 UNION ALL
		 SELECT e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, ep.ent_needs_shift, e.can_sched_shifts, e.cur_shift_id, e.cur_shift_start_time_local, e.cur_shift_end_time_local
				, e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
		 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN ent_parents ep ON e.ent_id = ep.parent_ent_id
		 WHERE ep.can_sched_shifts = 0
		)
		UPDATE de
		SET cur_shift_id = ent_parents.cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_local = ent_parents.cur_shift_start_time_local, cur_shift_start_time_utc = ent_parents.cur_shift_start_time_utc
			, cur_shift_end_time_local = ent_parents.cur_shift_end_time_local, cur_shift_end_time_utc = ent_parents.cur_shift_end_time_utc
		FROM @descendant_entities de
		INNER JOIN ent_parents ON de.ent_id = ent_parents.ent_needs_shift
		WHERE ent_parents.can_sched_shifts = 1

	END

	--Step8: Fix the shift history.  Remove the shift history records, if there are records with start time UTC greater than the identified start time UTC.
	DELETE FROM sh
	FROM @descendant_entities de
	INNER JOIN shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) ON de.ent_id = sh.ent_id
	WHERE shift_start_utc >= de.cur_shift_start_time_utc
	   OR shift_end_utc IS NULL

	--Step9: Update the previous shift to end at the current shift start time utc
	UPDATE sh
	SET shift_end_utc = DATEADD(SS, -1, de.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
		,shift_end_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(de.ent_id, DATEADD(SS, -1, de.cur_shift_start_time_utc))
	FROM @descendant_entities de
	INNER JOIN shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) ON de.ent_id = sh.ent_id
	WHERE shift_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(shift_start_utc) FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = sh.ent_id)
	  AND shift_start_utc < de.cur_shift_start_time_utc

	--Step10: Make sure to get the shift schedule for the entities in the list, if none of the ancestors can schedule shifts
	UPDATE de
	--If there is no parent entity or none of the ancestors can schedule shift, use the shift details from the current entity
	SET cur_shift_id = e.cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_local = e.cur_shift_start_time_local
		, cur_shift_start_time_utc = e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, cur_shift_end_time_local = e.cur_shift_end_time_local
		, cur_shift_end_time_utc = e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	FROM @descendant_entities de
	INNER JOIN ent e ON de.ent_id = e.ent_id
	--Limit to the entities where a shift schedule cannot be found
	WHERE de.cur_shift_id IS NULL OR de.cur_shift_start_time_local IS NULL

	--Step11: Update the ent table and fix the shift history table.
	UPDATE e
	SET cur_shift_id = de.cur_shift_id, cur_shift_start_time_local = de.cur_shift_start_time_local, cur_shift_start_time_utc = de.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		, cur_shift_end_time_local = de.cur_shift_end_time_local, cur_shift_end_time_utc = de.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	FROM @descendant_entities de
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON de.ent_id = e.ent_id

	IF (@create_shift_history = 1)
		--Step12: Create shift history records if they do not exist for the descendants.
		INSERT INTO shift_history (ent_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local)
		SELECT de.ent_id, de.cur_shift_id, de.cur_shift_start_time_utc, de.cur_shift_start_time_local
		FROM @descendant_entities de
		INNER JOIN (SELECT dent.ent_id FROM @descendant_entities dent
					EXCEPT
					SELECT sh.ent_id FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN @descendant_entities ents_to_exclude ON sh.ent_id = ents_to_exclude.ent_id AND sh.shift_start_utc = ents_to_exclude.cur_shift_start_time_utc
					) ents_to_consider ON de.ent_id = ents_to_consider.ent_id
END
