CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Get_ScheduledJob_MergeView] 
				( @wo_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL,
				  @res_grp_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL,
				  @item_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL,
				  @user_name NVARCHAR(50),
				  @session_id INT,
				  @loc_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL --Example 2,3,4,
				  ,	@user_pref_id NVARCHAR(40)	= NULL
				  , @equipWithError bit = NULL -- (1 Error, 0 Normal)
				)
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @sSQL         NVARCHAR(max),
              @sessoId      NVARCHAR(10),
              @scheduledate NVARCHAR(50),
			  @isReleased   bit,
			  @status		int

      -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
      -- interfering with SELECT statements.
      SET nocount ON;

	  Select @status= sessn.status
	  from sdb..scheduler_sessn sessn
	  where sessn.session_id = @session_id

	  If (@status = 3)
	   BEGIN
	    SET @isReleased=1;
	   END
	  ELSE
	   BEGIN
		SET @isReleased=0;
	   END
	  


      IF Object_id('tempdb..#res_grp') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #res_grp

      -- Create temp table to res_grp_id for a give location id
      CREATE TABLE #res_grp
        (
           res_grp_id INT,
		   ent_id INT,
		   Seq_No INT,
		   grpOrder INT
        )
	
	--Get XML string from ui_config for the given pref_id

	--convert xmlstring into a temp table
	  --Get the preference and find the entity sequence
	  Declare @user_pref as nvarchar(max), @eqOrderXML as nvarchar(max), @charPos int
	  Declare @EqGrpOrder TABLE (EqGrpId int, seqNo int)
	  
	  DECLARE @docHandle int;  

	  Select	@user_pref = valu
	  From		ui_config with(nolock)
	  Where		sectn = @user_pref_id and config_id='MDCC.Scheduler'
	  -- Change from eq grp to eq id for sequencing <EqIdSeq><EqSeq
	  IF @user_pref is not null
	  BEGIN
		--SET @charPos = charindex('<EqIdSeq>', @user_pref)
		SET @charPos = charindex('"eqOrder":"', @user_pref)
		--If eqGrpOrder node exists then it can be translated to XML and temp table
		IF(@charPos > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @eqOrderXML  = SUBSTRING(@user_pref, @charPos+11, (LEN(@user_pref)-@charPos - 2)) 
			set @eqOrderXML = substring(@eqOrderXML, 0, (len(@eqOrderXML) - 1))
			IF LEN(@eqOrderXML) > 0
			BEGIN
			insert into @EqGrpOrder(seqNo, EqGrpId)
				SELECT * FROM fn_Split(@eqOrderXML, ',')
			END
		END

	  END
	  

	 
	 


      --select top 1 @sessoId = session_id from SDB..scheduler_sessn where cast(scheduler_date as Date) = cast(@scheduledate as Date) 
      SELECT TOP 1 @scheduledate = scheduler_date
      FROM   sdb..scheduler_sessn
      WHERE  session_id = @session_id
      ORDER  BY session_id DESC

	  
      --Get equipment (resource) groups from location id only if @res_grp_id is null or empty, disregard @loc_id if @res_grp_id is given
      --IF( ( @res_grp_id IS NULL
      --       OR @res_grp_id = '' )
      --    AND ( @loc_id IS NOT NULL
      --           OR @loc_id <> '' ) )
      --  BEGIN
      --      INSERT INTO #res_grp
      --                  (res_grp_id)
      --      SELECT res_grp_id
      --      FROM   sdb.[SCH].[res_grp] rg WITH(nolock)
      --      WHERE  rg.loc_id IN (SELECT value
      --                           FROM   Fn_split(@loc_id, ','))
      --  END

		  INSERT INTO #res_grp
                        (res_grp_id, ent_id,seq_no, grpOrder)
            SELECT rg.res_grp_id, rge.ent_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rge.ent_id ORDER BY rg.res_grp_id asc), ego.seqNo
            FROM   sdb.[SCH].[res_grp] rg WITH(nolock)
			INNER JOIN sdb.sch.res_grp_ent rge WITH(NOLOCK) ON rg.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id
			LEFT JOIN @EqGrpOrder ego ON ego.EqGrpId = rge.ent_id
            WHERE  ( @res_grp_id IS NULL AND rg.loc_id IN (SELECT value
                                 FROM   Fn_split(@loc_id, ','))) or rg.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value
                                          FROM
                       Fn_split(@res_grp_id, ','))

		
      UPDATE sdb.[dbo].[scheduler_exec]
      SET    checkedout_by = @user_name,
             is_checkedout = 1,
             session_id = @session_id,
             sched_owner = @user_name
      WHERE  session_id = @session_id
	  or 
	  (wo_id in (SELECT Value FROM fn_Split(@wo_id, ',')) and is_released = 0 and session_id is null)



	 -- Update scheduler exec for partial release
	  UPDATE sdb.[dbo].[scheduler_exec]
      SET    checkedout_by = @user_name,
             is_checkedout = null,
             session_id = @session_id,
             sched_owner = @user_name
	WHERE job_sched_entity_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id
                                      FROM #res_grp)
				AND session_id = @session_id

		;WITH segmentparent AS 
			( 
           			   SELECT     e.ent_id, 
                      			  p.ent_id      parent_ent_id, 
                      			  ea.attr_value segmenttype 
           			   FROM       ent e 
           			   INNER JOIN ent p 
           			   ON         e.parent_ent_id =p.ent_id 
           			   LEFT JOIN  ent_attr ea 
           			   INNER JOIN attr a 
           			   ON         a.attr_id = ea.attr_id 
           			   AND        a.attr_desc = 'SegmentType' 
           			   ON         ea.ent_id = e.ent_id) , segmentchild AS 
			( 
          			  SELECT    c.ent_id, 
                    			c.parent_ent_id, 
                    			c.segmenttype , 
                    			p.segmenttype AS pseg 
          			  FROM      segmentparent c 
          			  LEFT JOIN segmentparent p 
          			  ON        c.parent_ent_id = p.ent_id) , segmentall AS 
			( 
         			 SELECT   ent_id, 
                  			  parent_ent_id, 
                  			  Isnull(segmenttype,Isnull(pseg,'NOIDEA')) segmenttype 
         			 FROM     segmentchild 
         			) ,
						validationErrorList as (SELECT DISTINCT wo_id, 
																	oper_id, 
																	job_seq_no, 
																	Stuff((SELECT top 2 ',' + ssv.error_code + ':' 
																				  + ssv.error_description 
																		   FROM   sdb.sch.scheduler_session_validation ssv 
																		   WHERE  ssv.session_id = sv.session_id 
																				  AND ssv.wo_id = sv.wo_id 
																				  AND ssv.oper_id = sv.oper_id 
																				  AND ssv.job_seq_no = sv.job_seq_no 
																				  AND ssv.session_id = @session_id 
																				  AND sv.session_id = @session_id 
																		   FOR xml path ('')), 1, 1, '') AS errorlist 
													FROM   sdb.sch.scheduler_session_validation sv 
													WHERE  session_id = @session_id )
													, se as ( SELECT  *

																				FROM   sdb.[dbo].[scheduler_exec] se WITH(nolock) where se.session_id = @session_id) 
													, ValidationEntList as ( select distinct job_sched_entity_id errorEntId from se
																				inner join validationErrorList vel on vel.wo_id = se.wo_id and vel.oper_id = se.oper_id and vel.job_seq_no = se.job_seq_no)

      SELECT  se.row_id                                       AS row_id,
                      [mo_id],
                      se.[wo_id],
                      SE.[oper_id],
                      [item_id],
                      [item_desc],
					  [job_latest_start_time],
                      [job_req_finished_time],
					  DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, [job_latest_start_time_utc]), [job_latest_start_time_utc]) as [job_latest_start_time_utc],
                      DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, [job_req_finished_time_utc]), [job_req_finished_time_utc]) as [job_req_finished_time_utc],
                      [wo_release_time],
                      [wo_req_finish_time],
                      [job_state],
                      [wo_state],

                      [wo_priority],
                      [job_state],
					  JS.state_desc as JobStateDesc,
                      [job_sched_entity_id],
                      [job_sched_entity_name],
                      [job_priority],
                      se.[job_seq_no],
                      [req_qty],
                      [job_sched_pinned],
                      [is_checkedout],
                      [checkedout_by],
                      [is_validated],
                      [is_downtime_exists],
                      [validated_by],
                      [validated_at],
                      [is_released],
                      [released_by],
                      [released_at],
                      [session_id],
                      rg.res_grp_id,
                      [sched_owner],
                      [schedule_sequence],
                      [error_code],
                      vel.errorlist as  [error_description], -- changes made to take validation errors from table
                      [validation_match],
                      Isnull([process_id], 'Not Defined')             AS                      [process_id],
                      Isnull(e.parent_ent_id, SE.job_sched_entity_id)
                      parent_ent_id,
                      Isnull(ea.attr_value, 0)                        AS                      jobposition,
					  SA.segmenttype								  AS					  segmentType,
					   Isnull(ProcessID.process_id, '--') + ':' + e.[description] + ':' + cast(job_sched_entity_id as nvarchar)
											                     AS Scheduler_DisplayEnt
					  ,SE.setup_start_time
					  ,SE.setup_end_time
					  ,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, SE.setup_start_time_utc), SE.setup_start_time_utc) as setup_start_time_utc
					  ,DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, SE.setup_end_time_utc), SE.setup_end_time_utc) as setup_end_time_utc
					  ,case when isnull(at.attr_desc,'NA') = 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft'  then 2 
									when isnull(at.attr_desc,'NA') = 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr' then 1 else 0 end as cmbBfrAft -- 0 None 1 Before 2 After
					  ,isnull(woa.attr_value,null) as cmbBfrAftTime
					  ,isnull(el.errorEntId,'0') isError

      FROM   se WITH(nolock)
			 INNER JOIN ent e WITH(nolock)
                               ON e.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id 
			 INNER JOIN segmentall SA on SA.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
			 INNER JOIN job_state JS on JS.state_cd = SE.job_state
			 INNER JOIN #res_grp rg on rg.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id and rg.Seq_No = 1
			 LEFT JOIN validationErrorList VEL on VEL.wo_id = SE.wo_id and VEL.oper_id = SE.oper_id and VEL.job_seq_no = SE.job_seq_no

			 LEFT JOIN wo_attr woa  
						inner join attr at on at.attr_id = woa.attr_id and at.attr_desc in ('MDM_SCH_WO_cmpAft', 'MDM_SCH_WO_cmpBfr')
						on se.wo_id = woa.wo_id

             LEFT JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(nolock)
                       INNER JOIN attr A WITH(nolock)
                               ON A.attr_id = ea.attr_id
                                  AND attr_desc = 'JobPositions'
                       
                    ON ea.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
			 
			 LEFT JOIN ValidationEntList EL on EL.errorEntId = se.job_sched_entity_id
             LEFT JOIN (SELECT process_id,
                               oper_id,
                               ent_id
                        FROM   (SELECT Rank()
                                         OVER (
                                           partition BY ent_id
                                           ORDER BY len(process_id) ASC,process_id ASC) AS RankPI, -- Added 24.01.2018
                                       process_id,
                                       oper_id,
                                       ent_id
                                FROM   oper_ent_link WITH(nolock)
                                 -- WHERE  process_id NOT LIKE '%[_]%'
								) A
                        WHERE  rankpi = 1) ProcessID
                    ON ProcessID.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id
			
			

      WHERE  req_qty <> 0
             AND is_released = @isReleased
             AND se.session_id = @session_id 
			 AND se.job_sched_entity_id =  case isnull(@equipWithError,0) when 1 then EL.errorEntId else se.job_sched_entity_id end
      ORDER  BY IsNull(rg.grpOrder, 9999),
				Isnull(e.parent_ent_id, SE.job_sched_entity_id),
                Isnull(EA.attr_value, 0),[job_sched_entity_name],
                se.row_id
  END

-- Name:  [sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff]
-- Description: Used to insert the raw data into the buffer table
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert a new the record. Exec from parent SPs. Prevents duplicates
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC		2025-05-27			Added row_id as output
-- ===========================================================================================*/
-- Insert Procedure (uses try/catch instead of serializable)
CREATE      PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff]
    @Data NVARCHAR(4000),                   
    @object_name NVARCHAR(80),               
    @interface_type NVARCHAR(15),            
    @current_timestamp DATETIME,
    @Error INT OUTPUT
	,@id INT = -1 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @insertedID AS TABLE ( id INT)
    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT dbo.ofi_aut_interface_buffer 
            (Data, ObjectName, InterfaceType, CurrentTimestamp)
		OUTPUT INSERTED.Id
		INTO @insertedID
        VALUES
            (@Data, @object_name, @interface_type, @current_timestamp);
        
		SELECT @id = i.id
		FROM @insertedID i

        SET @Error = 0;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627  -- Duplicate key violation
            SET @Error = 50000;
        ELSE
            SET @Error = ERROR_NUMBER();
    END CATCH
END;

CREATE Trigger [tg_process_attr_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[process_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_process_attr_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on Process_Attr  table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)   	-- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@process_status	INT
DECLARE @user_id		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id 	FROM process_attr pa INNER JOIN inserted i ON pa.process_id = i.process_id AND pa.attr_id = i.attr_id)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},process_attr', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET process.last_editor = @user_id, process.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id 	FROM process_attr pa INNER JOIN inserted i ON pa.process_id = i.process_id AND pa.attr_id = i.attr_id) pattr
	WHERE process.process_id = pattr.process_id

	UPDATE process_attr SET process_attr.last_edit_by = @user_id, process_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE process_attr.process_id = i.process_id AND process_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_layout_header]

	,@printer_id nvarchar(100)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @ifexists int = 0
			,@layout_name nvarchar(100)=NULL

	SELECT @layout_name = ln.layout_name

	SELECT @ifexists = count(1)

	BEGIN

		VALUES (@layout_id, @printer_id,@layout_name,GETUTCDATE())

		SELECT @result='record_inserted';
	END

	SELECT @result;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_EI_PUO_Validate_Data] (@po_doc_no NVARCHAR(40),@material_no NVARCHAR(40),@plant_code NVARCHAR(40)) AS
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

      DECLARE @validate_result     INT=1,
              @validation_comments NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,
              @error_msg           NVARCHAR(500),
			  @wo_id				NVARCHAR(100),
			  @from_uom_id         INT,
              @to_uom_id           INT

			SET @wo_id = @po_doc_no

			IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
			BEGIN
                  SET @validate_result=0
                  SET @validation_comments='The work order already exists'				
			END			

			IF(dbo.fn_S_ofi_PlantCode()<>@plant_code)
			BEGIN
                  SET @validate_result=0
                  SET @validation_comments='The plant code is wrong'				
			END

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
                          FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
                                 INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (nolock)
                                         ON ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id
                                            AND ic.produced = 1
                          WHERE  i.item_id = @material_no)
            BEGIN
                  SET @validate_result=0
                  SET @validation_comments='The end product does not exist in MES database or it does not belong to the produced item_class'
			END


			SELECT @to_uom_id = u.uom_id FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
				   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
						   ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
							  AND i.item_id = @material_no

			SELECT @from_uom_id = u.uom_id
			FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock)
				   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
						   ON u.description = owe.uom_desc
							  AND owe.wo_id = @wo_id

			IF (@from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
						  FROM   uom_conv WITH (nolock)
						  WHERE  from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
								 AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
								 AND item_id = @material_no)
			  BEGIN
				  SET @validate_result=0
				  SET @validation_comments='Item UOM and the PRO UOM are different and no UOM conversion exist in MES'
			END


			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM   ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (nolock) INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock) ON u.description = owe.uom_desc AND owe.wo_id = @wo_id)
			  BEGIN
				  SET @validate_result=0
				  SET @validation_comments='UOM as part of PRO message does not exist in MES'
			  END

	
	UPDATE ofi_wo_ext SET status = @validate_result,comments = @validation_comments WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Grp_Line_Link]
(@grp_id		INT  ,
 @line_id		INT  ,
 @accss			BIT ,
 @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40) ,
 @last_edit_at	DATETIME)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-	sp_SA_Grp_Line_Link
-- Description		-	Returns the rows that match the supplied filter values from the grp_line_link table along
--						with the group description from the group_name table and the line name from the line table.
-- Author			-
-- Date Created		-	05/20/2014
-- Version			-	5.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/05/2014	Prashanth	US#389877: Returning groups based on MES authentication mode
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE	 @auth_method	INT

SET @auth_method = NULL
SELECT @auth_method = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 405

IF @auth_method = 2
	SELECT grp_line_link.grp_id
		,grp_line_link.line_id
		,grp_name.grp_desc
		,line.line_name
		,grp_line_link.accss 'access'
		,grp_line_link.last_edit_comment
		,grp_line_link.last_edit_by
		,grp_line_link.last_edit_at
	FROM grp_line_link grp_line_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.line_id = line.line_id
	INNER JOIN grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.grp_id = grp_name.grp_id
	WHERE ((grp_line_link.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_line_link.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_line_link.accss = @accss OR @accss IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_name.auth_method = @auth_method) AND
		   (grp_line_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_line_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY line.line_name,  grp_name.grp_desc
ELSE
	SELECT grp_line_link.grp_id
		,grp_line_link.line_id
		,grp_name.grp_desc
		,line.line_name
		,grp_line_link.accss 'access'
		,grp_line_link.last_edit_comment
		,grp_line_link.last_edit_by
		,grp_line_link.last_edit_at
	FROM grp_line_link grp_line_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.line_id = line.line_id
	INNER JOIN grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.grp_id = grp_name.grp_id
	WHERE ((grp_line_link.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_line_link.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_line_link.accss = @accss OR @accss IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_name.auth_method = 0 OR grp_name.auth_method = 1) AND
		   (grp_line_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		   (grp_line_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY line.line_name,  grp_name.grp_desc

-- 0.01.00  AML, XPM      2026-02-20          Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_lm_list_columns]
    @table_name NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
          c.name AS column_name
    FROM sys.columns c
    INNER JOIN sys.tables t ON c.object_id = t.object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
    WHERE t.name = @table_name
    ORDER BY c.column_id;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Job]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--09/15/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--09/06/2007	aml			3.3.0		db changes
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--12/13/2011    Ashish          4.2     For CR-L00110219
--03/22/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 157572, Return the target completion time, projected completion time, and standard rate completion time
--12/05/2014	Ravi		5.0.1	HF L00134438: Arithmetic overflow when calculation completion times with large WO quantities and limited production qtys
--08/07/2015	Varun M		5.2		CR L00137619 Merge changes (HF CR L00137205). Arithmetic overflow. Modifed the code to
--									return current time utc if the sum of the produced and rejected quantity is greater than
--									quantity required.
--03/30/2016	Surya		5.3		CR L00129677 While calculating the cur_rate_finish_time_utc and std_rate_finish_time_utc,
--									if qty_req is zero, subtract the total production from qty_at_start
--									else, subtract qty_prod from qty_reqd
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @current_datetime_utc	DATETIME

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
SET @current_datetime_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

SELECT job.wo_id
          ,job.oper_id
          ,job.seq_no
          ,job.job_desc
          --,job.segment_requirement_id -- Added 07/16/2009 RWB -- Removed 08/20/2009 SLR
          --,job.segment_response_id -- Added 07/16/2009 RWB -- Removed 08/20/2009 SLR
          ,job.item_id
          ,job.state_cd
          ,job.job_priority
          ,job.req_finish_time_utc
          ,job.req_finish_time_local
          ,job.init_sched_ent_id
          ,job.target_sched_ent_id
          ,job.run_ent_id
          ,job.qty_reqd
          ,job.qty_prod
          ,job.qty_prod_erp
          ,job.qty_rejected
          ,job.qty_rejected_erp
          ,job.qty_at_start
          ,job.deviation_above
          ,job.deviation_below
          ,job.batch_size
          ,job.first_job
          ,job.final_job
          ,job.sched_pinned
          ,job.check_inv
          ,job.est_fixed_lab
          ,job.est_lab_rate
          ,job.est_setup_time
          ,job.est_teardown_time
          ,job.est_prod_rate
	,job.prod_uom
          ,job.est_transfer_time
	      ,job.sched_start_time_utc
          ,job.sched_start_time_local
	      ,job.latest_start_time_utc
          ,job.latest_start_time_local
	      ,job.sched_finish_time_utc
          ,job.sched_finish_time_local
	      ,job.act_start_time_utc
          ,job.act_start_time_local
	      ,job.act_finish_time_utc
          ,job.act_finish_time_local
          ,completion_times.target_finish_time_utc
          --do the case checks for performance benefits
          ,CASE WHEN completion_times.target_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(job.run_ent_id, completion_times.target_finish_time_utc) END AS target_finish_local
          ,CASE WHEN completion_times.target_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value, completion_times.target_finish_time_utc) END AS target_finish_time
          ,completion_times.cur_rate_finish_time_utc
          ,CASE WHEN completion_times.cur_rate_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(job.run_ent_id, completion_times.cur_rate_finish_time_utc) END AS cur_rate_finish_time_local
          ,CASE WHEN completion_times.cur_rate_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value, completion_times.cur_rate_finish_time_utc) END AS cur_rate_finish_time
          ,completion_times.std_rate_finish_time_utc
          ,CASE WHEN completion_times.std_rate_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(job.run_ent_id, completion_times.std_rate_finish_time_utc) END AS std_rate_finish_time_local
          ,CASE WHEN completion_times.std_rate_finish_time_utc IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value, completion_times.std_rate_finish_time_utc) END AS std_rate_finish_time
          ,job.concurrent_link
          ,job.job_cost
          ,job.parent_contingent_job
          ,job.child_contingent_job
          ,job.notes
          ,job.assoc_file
          ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
          ,job.status_notes
          ,job.display_seq
          ,job.folder_ver_id
          ,job.rework
          ,job.rework_cd
          ,job.rework_process_id
          ,job.spare1
          ,job.spare2
          ,job.spare3
          ,job.spare4
          ,job.last_edit_comment
          ,job.edited_by
          ,job.edit_time
	  ,job.row_id
  FROM job job with (nolock)
  LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, j1.seq_no
  			, DATEADD(SS,
				-- Begin HF L00134348: Use max integer value if calculation exceeds it to determine the completion times
				--Since the partial batch takes as much time as to produce one full batch, CEIL the batch size to the next highest integer, if dividing the required qty by batch size results with partial batch size.
  			CASE WHEN CEILING(CASE WHEN j1.qty_reqd <= 0 THEN j1.qty_at_start ELSE j1.qty_reqd END / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END)
  			 -- Convert the production rate to hours/batch, and then convert the result into seconds.  For example, 0.5 hours is equavalent to 1800 seconds.
  				* ROUND(dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j1.est_prod_rate, j1.prod_uom), 2) * 3600 > 2147483647 THEN 2147483647 ELSE
  				CEILING(CASE WHEN j1.qty_reqd <= 0 THEN j1.qty_at_start ELSE j1.qty_reqd END / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END)
  			 -- Convert the production rate to hours/batch, and then convert the result into seconds.  For example, 0.5 hours is equavalent to 1800 seconds.
  				* ROUND(dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j1.est_prod_rate, j1.prod_uom), 2) * 3600 END
  			,  j1.act_start_time_utc) AS target_finish_time_utc,
CASE WHEN (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected = 0) THEN NULL
	 WHEN (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected > j1.qty_reqd) THEN dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()) -- L00137619 Change
			  ELSE DATEADD(SS,
			  	--Since the partial batch takes as much time as to produce one full batch, CEIL the batch size to the next highest integer, if dividing the required qty by batch size results with partial batch size.
			  	--Find the total quantity produced so far and convert the quantities into batches to determine how many batches produced so far, and calculate the remaining number of batches to be produced.
			  	CASE WHEN CEILING((CASE WHEN j1.qty_reqd <= 0 THEN j1.qty_at_start - (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected) ELSE j1.qty_reqd - j1.qty_prod END) / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END)
			  		--The time to produce one batch is the number of batches produced so far
					* DATEDIFF(SS, j1.act_start_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc) / CEILING((j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected) / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END) > 2147483647 THEN 2147483647 ELSE
					CEILING((CASE WHEN j1.qty_reqd <= 0 THEN j1.qty_at_start - (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected) ELSE j1.qty_reqd - j1.qty_prod END) / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END)
			  		--The time to produce one batch is the number of batches produced so far
					* DATEDIFF(SS, j1.act_start_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc) / CEILING((j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected) / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END) END
                            	, @current_datetime_utc)
			  END AS cur_rate_finish_time_utc,
CASE WHEN (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected > j1.qty_reqd) THEN dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())  -- L00137619 Change
	ELSE
		DATEADD(SS,
			-- Convert the production rate to hours/batch, and then convert the result into seconds.  For example, 0.5 hours is equavalent to 1800 seconds.
				CASE WHEN CEILING((CASE WHEN j1.qty_reqd <= 0 THEN j1.qty_at_start - (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected) ELSE j1.qty_reqd - j1.qty_prod END) / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END)
			-- Convert the production rate to hours/batch, and then convert the result into seconds.  For example, 0.5 hours is equavalent to 1800 seconds.
				* ROUND(dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j1.est_prod_rate, j1.prod_uom), 2) * 3600 >  2147483647 THEN 2147483647 ELSE
				CEILING((CASE WHEN j1.qty_reqd <= 0 THEN j1.qty_at_start - (j1.qty_prod + j1.qty_rejected) ELSE j1.qty_reqd - j1.qty_prod END) / CASE WHEN j1.batch_size <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE j1.batch_size END)
			-- Convert the production rate to hours/batch, and then convert the result into seconds.  For example, 0.5 hours is equavalent to 1800 seconds.
				* ROUND(dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j1.est_prod_rate, j1.prod_uom), 2) * 3600 END
				,  @current_datetime_utc)
	END AS std_rate_finish_time_utc
				-- End HF L00134348
  		FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
  		WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
  		  AND j1.oper_id = @oper_id
  		  AND j1.seq_no = @seq_no
  		  AND j1.state_cd = 3
  		) completion_times ON job.wo_id = completion_times.wo_id AND job.oper_id = completion_times.oper_id AND job.seq_no = completion_times.seq_no
WHERE (job.wo_id = @wo_id AND
       job.oper_id = @oper_id AND
       job.seq_no = @seq_no)

DECLARE @jobBomRow int32
DECLARE @item_id_a1 nvarchar(80)
DECLARE @qty_per_parent_item_a1 float
DECLARE @min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 float
DECLARE @max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 float
declare @grade_cd nvarchar(50)
-- TODO: Set parameter values here.
--assumption that bom pos -0  entry  will alsways be there--

SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

declare		  @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
             ,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_AssignRecipe'
             ,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
             ,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			 ,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			 ,@iRowId  int
			 ,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Set Recipe'
			 ,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL

		declare @cte table ( rowId int identity(1,1)
							,bom_pos  int
							,item_id   varchar(80)
							,reqd_grade_cd int
							,item_desc  varchar(120)
							,item_grade_desc   varchar(120)
							,qty_per_parent_item float
							,min_qty_per_parent_item float
							,max_qty_per_parent_item float
							,recipe_reqd_qty_per float
							,uom_description  varchar(40)
							,job_qty_reqd float
							,last_wo		varchar(80)
							,last_oper		varchar(80)
							,last_seq		varchar(80)
							,material_type		varchar(80)
							,is_cakeblender_running  int
							,qty_reqd  float
							);

		declare @result_temp table
						(
							wo_id nvarchar(20),
							oper_id nvarchar(30),
							seq_no int,
							result_code int,
							failed_msg nvarchar(MAX),
							bom_item nvarchar(MAX)
						)

INSERT INTO @cte(bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
				,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
				,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
				,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd) 
SELECT bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
				,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
				,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
				,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd  FROM  
 OPENJSON ( @grid )  
WITH (        
			 -- rowId  int '$.row_id',
			  bom_pos  int  '$.bom_pos' ,
              item_id   varchar(80) '$.item_id' ,  
              --item_desc  varchar(120) '$.item_desc', 
			  reqd_grade_cd   int  '$.reqd_grade_cd' ,
			  item_grade_desc   varchar(120) '$.item_grade_desc', 
			  qty_per_parent_item float  '$.qty_per_parent_item',
			  min_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.min_qty_per_parent_item',
			  max_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.max_qty_per_parent_item',
			  recipe_reqd_qty_per float  '$.recipe_reqd_qty_per',
			  uom_description  varchar(40)  '$.uom_description',
			  job_qty_reqd float  '$.job_qty_reqd',
			  last_wo		varchar(80) '$.last_wo' ,
			  last_oper		varchar(80) '$.last_oper' ,
			  last_seq		varchar(80) '$.last_seq' ,
			  material_type		varchar(80) '$.material_type' ,
			  is_cakeblender_running  int  '$.is_cakeblender_running' ,
			  qty_reqd  float  '$.qty_reqd'
	);

	 if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe')
	 begin
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LastjobBOMRecipe') Is Not Null BEGIN DROP TABLE #LastjobBOMRecipe; END
		 SELECT top 1 @lastWo_id = wo_id,@lastOper_id = oper_id, @lastseqNo = seq_no from job with(nolock) where run_ent_id = @ent_id and item_id = @parent_item_id and state_cd = 4 order by act_finish_time_utc desc 
		 SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #LastjobBOMRecipe FROM  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id=@lastWo_id and oper_id = @lastOper_id and seq_no = @lastseqNo and bom_pos<>0
	 end
	 else 
		 begin
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BOMRecipe') Is Not Null BEGIN DROP TABLE #BOMRecipe; END
			select @bomItem = item_id, @bomVersion = version from ofi_master_recipe with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name;
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #BOMRecipe FROM  bom_item with(nolock) where parent_item_id = @bomItem and ver_id = @bomVersion and bom_pos <>0

		 end

		 --select @bomItem ,@bomVersion
		 --select * from @cte
		 --select * from #BOMRecipe


	--	 validation 
		--begin
		--	select 0 as result, '@@CakeBlenderCompenentIsNotPresent@@' as resultCode;  
		--	--select 1 as result,'updated successfully ' as resultCode
		--	return;
		--end

		--BOM Compare
		-- same SP can't be used as we have to pass the selected parameter
		
		
		begin
				insert into @result_temp
							exec [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp] 
							   @wo_id
							  ,@oper_id
							  ,@seq_no
							  ,@ent_id
							  ,@parent_item_id
							  ,@recipe_name
			
			if ((select top 1 result_code from @result_temp)<>1)
			begin
				select @resultset = 0 ,@resultCode =  (select top 1  CONCAT(failed_msg,'- ',bom_item) from @result_temp); 
				return;
			end

		end 


	 
	 if(@saveRecords=1) 
	 begin

			-- populating the audit table
			 insert into @jobBomAudit select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0

			 --update job_bom set 
			 delete from job_bom where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos<>0 and item_id not in( select item_id from @cte)

			 update job_bom set qty_per_parent_item = case  when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			 ,min_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			 ,max_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			 ,qty_reqd = ct.qty_reqd
			 ,reqd_grade_cd =  isnull(ct.reqd_grade_cd,(select item_grade_cd from item_grade with(nolock) where item_grade_desc = ct.item_grade_desc))
			 ,bom_pos = ct.bom_pos
			 from job_bom jb with(nolock) inner join @cte ct on jb.item_id = ct.item_id
			 and jb.wo_id =  @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no

			 select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @cte
			--select * from @cte

		WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
					BEGIN


								
								BEGIN
										-- updating variables from @cte 
									select @bom_pos = bom_pos, @item_id = item_id
									,@qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
									,@max_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
									,@min_qty_per_parent_item =  case when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
									,@qty_reqd =qty_reqd from @cte as ct where rowId =@row_cnt 
			    
									if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe') -- updating values here
									begin
										select top 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
													,@reqd_start_val				= reqd_start_val           
													,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		= reqd_start_val_is_pct    
													,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
													,@backflush                  = backflush                
													,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
													--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
													--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
													,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
													,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
													,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
													,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
													,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
													,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
													,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
													,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
													,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
													,@est_time                   = est_time                 
													,@current_subst              = current_subst         from #LastjobBOMRecipe where item_id = @item_id    
									end
									else
										begin
											select top 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
													,@reqd_start_val				= 0           
													,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		=	0    
													,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
													,@backflush                  = backflush                
													,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
													--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
													--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
													,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
													,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
													,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
													,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
													,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
													,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
													,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
													,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
													,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
													,@est_time                   = est_time                 
													,@current_subst              = NULL         from #BOMRecipe where item_id = @item_id   

										end

										-- checking if it is existing in the job bom
								IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos <>0 and item_id = @item_id)
								begin
								 select @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
				
								-- inserting values in job bom
									exec 
										 [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Bom] @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@maxBomPos
										,@item_id
										,@reqd_grade_cd
										,@instruction
										,@qty_per_parent_item
										,@max_qty_per_parent_item
										,@min_qty_per_parent_item
										,@reqd_start_val
										,@reqd_start_val_is_pct
										,@update_inv
										,@backflush
										,@def_reas_cd
										,@def_lot_no
										,@def_sublot_no
										,@def_storage_ent_id
										,@def_reject_ent_id
										,@scaling_factor
										,@must_consume_from_inv
										,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc
										,@may_create_new_lots
										,@must_consume_from_wip
										,@must_consume_before_prod
										,@constant_qty
										,@est_time
										,@current_subst
										,@qty_reqd
										,@serial_no_source
										,@spare1
										,@spare2
										,@spare3
										,@spare4
										,@last_edit_comment
										,@mod_id OUTPUT

										SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
									end
								END
							set @row_cnt = @row_cnt+1
					END
				
				-- inserting the values for audit trail
				insert into @jobBomAudit1 select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] 
				 from job_bom with(nolock) 
				 where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0


				select @already_used = [already_used] from  [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name
				
				if(@recipe_name is not null and @already_used = 'N' and @recipe_name <>'Last used recipe')
				BEGIN
					-- updating ofi master 
					UPDATE [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] SET already_used = 'Y',last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(),last_edit_at_local = GETDATE(),last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
					where  recipe_name = @recipe_name
				END

				if(@recipe_name <> (select isnull(spare1,'') from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no))
				begin
					update job_bom set spare1 = @recipe_name where  wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no;
				end


				-- invalidating the applicable subsequent steps
				exec [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
				   @wo_id
				  ,@oper_id
				  ,@seq_no
				  ,@step_name
				  ,@step_data = @recipe_name

				EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_invalidate_steps]  @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@ent_id,@item_id,@step_name=NULL
				

			
			set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
			select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode

	end
	else
		begin
				
				set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@RecordsValidatedSuccessfully@@'
				select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
		end 

END TRY


BEGIN CATCH
			
			set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
			select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
END CATCH

BEGIN TRY
						  
						   

 SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.qty_per_parent_item)
 from @jobBomAudit t1
 FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
 where (t1.qty_per_parent_item <> t2.qty_per_parent_item) OR (t1.min_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.min_qty_per_parent_item) OR (t1.max_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.max_qty_per_parent_item)
  OR (t1.reqd_grade_cd <> t2.reqd_grade_cd)
 while (@i < @modCnt)
 BEGIN			   

 SELECT @jobBomRow=t2.row_id
		 ,@item_id_a1=t2.item_id
		 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.min_qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.max_qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@grade_cd= cast(t2.reqd_grade_cd as nvarchar(50))
 from @jobBomAudit t1
 FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
  where (t1.qty_per_parent_item <> t2.qty_per_parent_item) OR (t1.min_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.min_qty_per_parent_item) OR (t1.max_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.max_qty_per_parent_item)
  OR (t1.reqd_grade_cd <> t2.reqd_grade_cd)
 order by t2.row_id
 OFFSET @i ROWS   
 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

 select @grade_cd= ig.item_grade_desc
 from item_grade ig with(nolock)
 where ig.item_grade_cd=@grade_cd


  Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
  Select @strCommentMsg = 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';
 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)),
							(@jobBomRow,'spare1',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name))
							,(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1))
							,(@jobBomRow,'reqd_grade_cd',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@grade_cd))
							,(@jobBomRow,'qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
							,(@jobBomRow,'min_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
							,(@jobBomRow,'max_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))

EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = @wo_id
						,@keyField2 = @oper_id
						,@keyField3 = @seq_no
						,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @last_edit_by
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg

 SET @i = @i + 1;
 
 END
 
-- added new record
select @newCnt= count(t2.qty_per_parent_item)
from @jobBomAudit t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						  from @jobBomAudit t2 )
 while (@j < @newCnt)
 BEGIN
 SELECT @jobBomRow=t2.row_id
		 ,@item_id_a1=t2.item_id
		 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.min_qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.max_qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@grade_cd= cast(t2.reqd_grade_cd as nvarchar(50))
 from @jobBomAudit t1
 FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						  from @jobBomAudit t2 )
 order by t2.row_id
 OFFSET @j ROWS   
 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY


 Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
 Select @strCommentMsg ='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';;

 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)),
							--(@jobBomRow,'wo_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@wo_id))
							--,(@jobBomRow,'oper_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@oper_id))
							--,(@jobBomRow,'seq_no',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no)),
						--	(@jobBomRow,'recipe_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name)),
							(@jobBomRow,'spare1',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name)),							
							(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1))							
							,(@jobBomRow,'reqd_grade_cd',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@grade_cd))
							,(@jobBomRow,'qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
							,(@jobBomRow,'min_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
							,(@jobBomRow,'max_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))

EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = @wo_id
						,@keyField2 = @oper_id
						,@keyField3 = @seq_no
						,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @last_edit_by
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg

 SET @j = @j + 1;
 END

-- removed record
select @delCnt=count(t1.qty_per_parent_item) 
from @jobBomAudit t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						from @jobBomAudit1 t2 )
while (@k < @delCnt)
 BEGIN
  

 SELECT   @jobBomRow=t1.row_id,
		  @item_id_a1=t1.item_id
		 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.min_qty_per_parent_item
		 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.max_qty_per_parent_item
 from @jobBomAudit t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						from @jobBomAudit1 t2 )
 order by t1.row_id
 OFFSET @k ROWS   
 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

 Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
 Select @strCommentMsg =' Removed row_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)+' in '+@recipe_name+' for item: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1)+', '+' in wo: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@wo_id)+' in oper: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@oper_id)+' in seq: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no)+' _ '
 delete from @auditTrailParameters
 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow))
							,(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg ))
							
					   
										 
						   

EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						--,@xmlDeletedRow = @xmlDeletedRow
						,@keyField1 = @wo_id
						,@keyField2 = @oper_id
						,@keyField3 = @seq_no
						,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @last_edit_by
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg

	

 SET @k = @k + 1;
 END

 -- records where only recipe is changed , check for recipe change 
 select @old_recipe_name=jb.spare1
 from job_bom jb with(nolock)
 where jb.bom_pos=0 and jb.item_id=@item_id


END TRY 
BEGIN CATCH
set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_History_ChangeReasWhenElap]
(@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Util_History_ChangeReasWhenElap
-- Description                      - UserStory:222536, As Bruce, I want the MES Service to change the Utilization Reason for an Entity's Utilizatiom Log entry after the Maximum Duration is exceeded
-- Author                           - Raghu
-- Date Created                     - 09/20/2016
-- Version                          - 5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By       Ver         Changes
-- 09/20/2016	Raghu		5.3		UserStory: 201085 - Moved the code from sp_U_Util_Log_UpdAllDurations
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @ent_id		INT32
	,@new_reas_cd		INT32
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = 'MinutelyTask.ChangeReasWhenElap'

	DECLARE max_duration_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	--Retrieve the entity ID and the new reason code
	SELECT ue.ent_id, ur.new_reas_cd
	FROM util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ue.cur_reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
	--Limit to utilization reasons that have maximum duration and new reason code configured.
	WHERE ur.max_duration IS NOT NULL AND ur.new_reas_cd IS NOT NULL
	  --Verify that the current utilization reason is not the same as the new reason
	  AND ue.cur_reas_cd <> ur.new_reas_cd
	  --Verify that the start time of the current reason plus the maximum duration of the current reason exceeded the time limit.
	  AND DATEADD(SS, ur.max_duration, ue.cur_reas_start_utc) <= @current_time_utc

	OPEN max_duration_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM max_duration_cursor INTO @ent_id, @new_reas_cd
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Change the current reason for this entity.
		EXEC sp_I_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=NULL
			, @reas_cd=@new_reas_cd, @reas_pending=0, @comments=NULL, @raw_reas_cd=NULL
			, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
			, @category1=NULL, @category2=NULL, @category3=NULL, @category4=NULL
			, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @update_if_exists=1, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL
	END
	CLOSE max_duration_cursor
	DEALLOCATE max_duration_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_WO_GetTgtWoContnsserItms]
(
	@wo_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id       STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@mo_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL

)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_WO_GETTGTWOCONTNSSERITMS
-- Description          -  7.3.3.7  To Work Order
--                          If the dialog is opened in the context of a job,
--                          the work order of that job will be the only choice in this dropdown,
--                          and the dropdown will be disabled.  Other wise this dropdown will contain all
--                          work orders not completed or closed that produces a serialized item
--                          (on the assumption that serialized components will never go into a
--                          non-serialized final product).  If the manufacturing order is specified in the
--                          filter, the work orders listed will be limited to those that are part of that
--                          manufacturing order.  If the item is specified in the filter, the work orders
--                          listed will be limited to those having a job that consumes that item.
--                          This must include those that consume the item in position 0 of the job BOM,
--                          if that item is produced in a preceding job.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/06/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/06/2007		AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

    --Split the retrieval based on the item_id for better performance. This will reduce the join with the job_bom table.
    IF (@item_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT j.wo_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
        --Limit to the supplied work order id, if a work order id is supplied.
        WHERE (wo.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
        --Limit to the supplied mo_id, if a mo_id is supplied.
          AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
          --work orders not completed or closed
          AND wo.state_cd < 2
          --that produces a serialized item
          AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
        ORDER BY j.wo_id
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT j.wo_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
        INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
        --Limit to the supplied work order id, if a work order id is supplied.
        WHERE (wo.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
        --Limit to the supplied item_id, if an item_id is supplied.
        --and the operations listed will be limited to those having a job that consumes that item
          AND (jb.item_id = @item_id AND jb.bom_pos > 0)
          --Limit to the supplied mo_id, if a mo_id is supplied.
          AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
          --work orders not completed or closed
          AND wo.state_cd < 2
          --that produces a serialized item
          AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT j.wo_id
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
        --Limit to the supplied item_id, if an item_id is supplied.
        --and the operations listed will be limited to those having a job that consumes that item
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN job_route prev_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON prev_job.wo_id = j.wo_id AND prev_job.oper_id = j.oper_id AND prev_job.seq_no = j.seq_no
        LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom prev_jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON prev_jb.wo_id = prev_job.wo_id AND prev_jb.oper_id = prev_job.input_oper_id AND prev_jb.seq_no = prev_job.input_seq_no
        --Limit to the supplied work order id, if a work order id is supplied.
        WHERE (wo.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
          --Limit to the supplied item_id, if an item_id is supplied.
          --This must include those that consume the item in position 0 of the job BOM,
          --if that item is produced in a  preceding job.
          AND (jb.item_id = @item_id AND jb.bom_pos = 0)
          --Limit to the supplied mo_id, if a mo_id is supplied.
          AND (wo.mo_id = @mo_id OR @mo_id IS NULL)
          --work orders not completed or closed
          AND wo.state_cd < 2
          --that produces a serialized item
          AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
    END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor]
(
		@user_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@ent_id					INT32
	,	@step_no				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@lab_cd					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@dept_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@pct_to_apply			TFLOAT = NULL
	,	@comments				STRING254_NULL	= NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
	,	@wo_id 					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no 				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,   @raw_reas_cd 			STRING40_NULL = NULL
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor
-- Description				-
-- Author					-
-- Date Created				-
-- Version (last edit)		- 1.6.0.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 08-14-2002       Nagaraju 					added "SET NOCOUNT ON"
-- 10-23-2002       Sheetal Jain    1.3.0		Bulk labor deadlocks
-- 02/12/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		(HD# 2475). Included Updation of Labor FC Tags when Labor_Dept or Labor_Cat
--												is changed in an entity for the user
-- 03/07/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		(HD# 2632) Create a new labor record only if step_no or lot_no or lab_cd or
--												dept_id is changed or else donot create a new record.
-- 03/11/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		Update FC Tags ONLY when lab_cd OR dept_id is changed
-- 04/01/2003		Raghu			1.5.5		If user_id input param is not passed, force to use user_id. Get user_id from
--												ent_logon and join it in the where clause.
-- 04/21/2003		Raghu			1.6.0		Commented code calling SP_U_Labor_Exec_CloseLabEvents. As the labor rows will
--												be specific to steps and lots, make a seperate call to close the labor records
--												with user_id, ent_id and active (cluster keys) which improves performance.
-- 04/22/2003		Raghu			1.6.0		When steps are divided into multiple lots, pct also should be divided among
--												multiple lots for the steps. When pct is changed, adjust the percentage among
--												all the other steps
-- 06-06-2003		Sheetal Jain    1602		Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 12/05/2003		Raghu			2.0.0.13	(HD# 4156) Labor Resource Data - Handling with Multiple Job Execs
-- 12/15/2003		Raghu			2.0.0.16	(HD# 4281) Changing labor or depts does not change labor records
-- 01/27/2004		Raghu			2.0.0.23	FC Tags were not updating when labor category or labor departments are changed - Fixed
-- 02/11/2004		Raghu			2.0.0.25	def_lab_cd was ignored while updating lab_cd in ent_logon for all the user and
--												the cursor uses the last user_id - fixed
-- 06/17/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Included NULL value for last_edit_comment field while calling sp_I_Labor_Usage.
-- 10/11/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2007		Raghu			3.1.27		HD# 9351, Changed parameter name @pct_lab_to_apply to @pct_to_apply to work with .NET middleware
-- 03/20/2007		Raghu			3.2.4		HD# 9351, Changed parameter name @pct_lab_to_apply to @pct_to_apply to work with .NET middleware
-- 08/15/2007		AML			3.3.0		DB Changes
--01/11/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00073674, L00073864 ; Error while trying to set a new reason; Error while changing labor categories.
-- 02/22/2008		DianaI			3.4 L00074574, sp_U_Labor_Exec_SetRawReason needs to pass @raw_reas_cd to sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor
-- 01/07/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF 1432 Bring Hotfix forward
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@log_id					INT
		,	@labor_start_utc		DATETIME
		,	@labor_start_local		DATETIME
		,	@cur_user_id			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@item_id				NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_step_no			INT
		,	@cur_lot_no				NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_sublot_no			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_lab_cd				NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@cur_dept_id			NVARCHAR(40)
		,	@shift_id				INT
		,	@shift_start_utc		DATETIME
		,	@shift_start_local		DATETIME
		,	@pct_lab_to_apply 		FLOAT
		,	@cur_pct_to_apply 		FLOAT
		,	@active					BIT
		,	@duration				INT
		,	@cur_comments			NVARCHAR(254)
		,	@mod_id					NVARCHAR(30)
		,	@return					INT
		,	@ent_pct_to_apply		FLOAT
		,	@ent_old_pct_to_apply	FLOAT
		,	@desc					NVARCHAR(80)
		,	@cur_fc_user_node		INT
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32
		,	@tz_temp				INT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- CR L00108371
	SET @pct_lab_to_apply = @pct_to_apply

	DECLARE labor_usage_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
	SELECT  log_id, labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, lab_cd, dept_id
		, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply
		, CASE WHEN (@pct_lab_to_apply IS NULL) THEN labor_usage.pct_to_apply
			   WHEN (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) THEN @pct_lab_to_apply  -- Added this case as we want to use the passed in pct_to_apply for the specific labor_usage record, not the entity 6/29/07 KRF
			   ELSE (labor_usage.pct_to_apply/(SELECT DISTINCT pct_lab_to_apply FROM ent_logon WHERE ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id AND user_id = labor_usage.user_id)) * @pct_lab_to_apply
			   END cur_pct_to_apply
		, active, duration, comments
		,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM labor_usage
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
	  AND ((user_id = @user_id) OR (user_id  IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND @user_id IS NULL)))
	  AND (step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
	  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR @cur_sublot_no IS NULL) -- Added 6/27/07 KRF
      AND (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) -- Added 6/27/07 KRF
      AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) -- Added 6/27/07 KRF
      AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) -- Added 6/27/07 KRF
      ORDER BY user_id , ent_id

	OPEN labor_usage_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)	BEGIN
		--Read all fields for this row into local variables

		FETCH NEXT FROM labor_usage_cursor
		INTO @log_id, @labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local, @cur_user_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @cur_step_no,
			 @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @item_id, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local,
			 @pct_lab_to_apply, @cur_pct_to_apply, @active, @duration, @cur_comments, @mod_id

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		-- Added by Raghu on 03/07/2003.  Check Step_No or lot_no or lab_cd or dept_id is changed to create a new record, or else donot create a new record
		IF  (@lab_cd IS NOT NULL AND @lab_cd <> @cur_lab_cd) OR
			(@dept_id IS NOT NULL AND @dept_id <> @cur_dept_id) OR
			(@pct_lab_to_apply <> @cur_pct_to_apply) OR
			(@comments IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(@comments,' ') <> ISNULL(@cur_comments, ' '))
		BEGIN
			--Optional. Default to existing value. Only include if the labor_cd has changed
			IF @lab_cd IS NOT NULL SET @cur_lab_cd = @lab_cd

			--Optional. Default to existing value. Only include if the dept_id has changed
			IF @dept_id IS NOT NULL SET @cur_dept_id = @dept_id

			--Optional. Default to existing value. Only include if it has changed
			IF @step_no IS NOT NULL SET @cur_step_no = @step_no

			--Optional. Default to existing value. Only include if it has changed
			IF @lot_no IS NOT NULL SET @cur_lot_no = @lot_no

			--Optional. Default to existing value. Only include if it has changed
			IF @sublot_no IS NOT NULL SET @cur_sublot_no = @sublot_no

			--Optional. Default to existing value. Only include if it has changed
			IF @comments IS NOT NULL SET @cur_comments = @comments

			--Insert a new row in the labor_usage table and save the new log_id for it in a local
			--variable. Same values as existing row (except replace the optional new values for this event
			-- lab_cd and / or dept_id and / or pct_to_apply), duration = 0, active = 1
			--IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @labor_start = GETDATE() ELSE SET @labor_start = GETUTCDATE()

			--SET @labor_start_local = GETDATE()
			--EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_utc OUTPUT

			SET @labor_start_utc  = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			SET @labor_start_local= NULL
			SET @time_zone_bias_value=NULL
			EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @labor_start_utc,@labor_start_local OUTPUT,  @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT
			  -- TRACE
			EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor', @src_key='GetDateInfo', @date_val1 = @labor_start_local,@date_val2 = @labor_start_utc


			UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @labor_start_utc), active = 0
			WHERE log_id = @log_id AND user_id = @cur_user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1
				AND (step_no = @cur_step_no OR @cur_step_no IS NULL)
				AND (lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR @cur_lot_no IS NULL)
				AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR @cur_sublot_no IS NULL)

			--SET @labor_start = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @labor_start)

			EXEC sp_I_Labor_Usage @log_id OUTPUT, @labor_start_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @cur_user_id, @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id,
					@seq_no, @cur_step_no, @item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_lab_cd, @cur_dept_id, @shift_id,
					@shift_start_local, 0, @cur_pct_to_apply, 1, 0, @cur_comments, @raw_reas_cd, NULL,@time_zone_bias_value, @mod_id OUTPUT

		END	-- Step_No OR Lot_No OR lab_cd or dept_id IS Changed to create a new record
	END--end labor_usage_cursor

	CLOSE labor_usage_cursor
	DEALLOCATE labor_usage_cursor

--	BEGIN CR L00108371
	UPDATE ent_logon
	SET	cur_lab_cd = CASE WHEN (@lab_cd IS NULL) THEN ent_logon.cur_lab_cd ELSE
					 CASE WHEN (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND (select count(distinct lab_cd) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND active = 1 GROUP BY ent_id,user_id) > 1) THEN NULL
					 ELSE @lab_cd END
					 END,
		cur_lab_dept_id = CASE WHEN (@dept_id IS NULL) THEN ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id ELSE
						  CASE WHEN (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND (select count(distinct lab_cd) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND active = 1 GROUP BY ent_id,user_id) > 1) THEN NULL
						  ELSE @dept_id END
						  END,
		pct_lab_to_apply =  CASE WHEN (@pct_to_apply IS NULL) THEN ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply ELSE
							CASE WHEN (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) THEN (select sum(pct_to_apply) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND active = 1) ELSE @pct_to_apply END
							END,
		cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(log_id) FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND active = 1)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND ((user_id = @user_id AND @user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)  AND @user_id IS NULL))
--	END CR L00108371

RETURN 0
END
