/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_S_ofi_bcons_GetDumpingData]
-- Description: Retrieves dumping data for the line entity of the specified segment.
--
-- Usage: Invoked from Work Tasks (MES UI); JS functions in ofi.ProductionExecution 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 MH   	2025-10-16   		Initial version
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_bcons_GetDumpingData]
    @EntityName nvarchar(80)
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET XACT_ABORT ON

    BEGIN TRANSACTION

        -- Validate parameters
        IF @EntityName IS NULL
            THROW 50000, '@EntityName is NULL.', 0

        -- Find parent entity ID
        DECLARE @LineEntityId AS int

        SELECT @LineEntityId = [parent_ent_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_name] = @EntityName

        IF @LineEntityId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, '@EntityName does not exist in the database, or does not have a parent entity assigned.', 1

        -- Select attribute IDs based on their names
        DECLARE
            @CollectionStartTimeAttributeId int,
            @CollectionEndTimeAttributeId int,
            @CollectionAreaAttributeId int,
            @CollectionWeighingAttributeId int

        SELECT @CollectionStartTimeAttributeId = [attr_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [attr_desc] = 'ActiveBinCollectionStartTime'
          AND [attr_grp] = 2 -- Entity

        IF @CollectionStartTimeAttributeId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, 'Could not find ''ActiveBinCollectionStartTime'' MES entity attribute.', 2

        SELECT @CollectionEndTimeAttributeId = [attr_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [attr_desc] = 'ActiveBinCollectionEndTime'
          AND [attr_grp] = 2 -- Entity

        IF @CollectionEndTimeAttributeId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, 'Could not find ''ActiveBinCollectionEndTime'' MES entity attribute.', 3

        SELECT @CollectionAreaAttributeId = [attr_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [attr_desc] = 'ActiveBinCollectionArea'
          AND [attr_grp] = 2 -- Entity

        IF @CollectionAreaAttributeId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, 'Could not find ''ActiveBinCollectionArea'' MES entity attribute.', 4

        SELECT @CollectionWeighingAttributeId = [attr_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [attr_desc] = 'ActiveBinCollectionWeighing'
          AND [attr_grp] = 2 -- Entity

        IF @CollectionWeighingAttributeId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, 'Could not find ''ActiveBinCollectionWeighing'' MES entity attribute.', 5
        
        -- Select attribute values
        DECLARE
            @CollectionStartTime nvarchar(80),
            @CollectionEndTime nvarchar(80),
            @CollectionArea nvarchar(80),
            @CollectionWeighing nvarchar(80);

        SELECT @CollectionStartTime = [attr_value]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent_attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_id] = @LineEntityId
          AND [attr_id] = @CollectionStartTimeAttributeId

        SELECT @CollectionEndTime = [attr_value]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent_attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_id] = @LineEntityId
          AND [attr_id] = @CollectionEndTimeAttributeId

        SELECT @CollectionArea = [attr_value]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent_attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_id] = @LineEntityId
          AND [attr_id] = @CollectionAreaAttributeId

        SELECT @CollectionWeighing = [attr_value]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent_attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_id] = @LineEntityId
          AND [attr_id] = @CollectionWeighingAttributeId
        
        -- Get entity names
        DECLARE
            @LineEntityName nvarchar(80),
            @CollectionAreaEntityName nvarchar(80);

        SELECT @LineEntityName = [ent_name]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent]
        WHERE [ent_id] = @LineEntityId

        SELECT @CollectionAreaEntityName = [ent_name]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent]
        WHERE [ent_id] = @CollectionArea
        
        SET NOCOUNT OFF
        SELECT
            @LineEntityId AS parent_ent_id,
            @LineEntityName AS parent_ent_name,
            @CollectionStartTime AS collection_start_time,
            @CollectionEndTime AS collection_end_time,
            @CollectionArea AS collection_area_id,
            @CollectionAreaEntityName AS collection_area_name,
            @CollectionWeighing AS collection_weighing

    COMMIT TRANSACTION
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtTypNamFilt]
(
		@char_name            	STRING40
	,	@site_name				STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@ent_name				STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@item					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,   @item_category_name	    STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@process_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_response_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare1                 STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare2                 STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare3                 STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,   @spare4                 STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@start_time				DATETIME = NULL
	,	@start_time_tz			INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@end_time				DATETIME = NULL
	,	@end_time_tz			INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -	sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtTypNamFilt
-- Description          -	Get the default_chart, cl_source, samples_for_cl, std_mean, and std_deviation for the specified
--							characteristic based on the supplied filter information.  The sample that matches the filter
--							information and has the most recent entry in the result table will be used to get the qm_spec_id
--							from the sample_char_link table.  The qm_spec_id is used to look up the qm_spec_char links and
--							all values that are not set to null will be returned from this table.  Any values that are null
--							in the qm_spec_char_link table will be gotten from the characteristic table.  If there is no
--							qm_spec_id in the sample_char_link table, all values will be returned from the characeristic table.
-- Author          - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created          -    03/15/2011
-- Version          - 4.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ent_id			INT32
	DECLARE @char_id		INT32
	DECLARE @item_category_id	INT32

	SELECT @char_id = (SELECT char_id FROM characteristic WHERE char_name = @char_name)

	SELECT @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

	if (@item_category_name IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @item_category_id = category_id FROM category WHERE category.category_name = @item_category_name
		SET @item_category_id = COALESCE(@item_category_id, -1)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @item_category_id = null
	END

	if (@ent_name IS NOT NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL) SET @ent_id = -1

	EXEC sp_SA_Sample_GetChrtTypeByFilt @char_id, @ent_id, @item, @item_category_id, @wo_id,@oper_id, @process_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @start_time, @start_time_tz, @end_time, @end_time_tz

END

-- Version
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By      Changes

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_GetPrevLotSubLotJob_Bom] (
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no INT
	,@item_id NVARCHAR(40)
	,@bom_pos INT
	)
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 def_lot_no
		,def_sublot_no
		,wo_id
		,oper_id
		,seq_no
		,bom_pos
		,item_id
	FROM job_bom

		AND seq_no = @seq_no
		AND bom_pos = @bom_pos
		AND def_lot_no IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY row_id DESC
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Error_Log_Enh]
(@severity        INT,
 @instance_info   NVARCHAR(254),
 @object_name     NVARCHAR(80),
 @object_section  NVARCHAR(254),
 @description     NVARCHAR(1700),
 @system_msg      NOTES,
 @system_severity INT = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	SP_I_ERROR_LOG_ENH
-- Description	  -	Error logging
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	03/18/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 06/15/2004     Raghu        2.1.0    Changed GETDATE TO GETUTCDATE
-- 01/08/2006     KRF          3.2.1    HD# 9213, part of DB changes - change type of @system_msg from nvarchar(254) to ntext
-- 31/03/2016	  Ibrahim	   5.3.0    US#615685 Fix for the CRL00140583: Updated the SP to insert error log only if the given severity value
--												  is equal to or less than system severity level value.
--												  ( 0 - critical, 1 - serious, 2 - partial, 3 - trivial , 4 - events )
-- 09/21/2017	  Raghu		   6.0	    UserStory:909250 - As Terry, I want the migration of util tables to the new schema to not fail because of error messages in error_log table (CR L00146457)
-- 02/04/2020     Jim O'Hearn  6.2.0    Removed ntext in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @logged_at DATETIME
  -- If the system severity level setting was not included then retrieve it
  IF @system_severity IS NULL
  BEGIN
    EXEC sp_S_system_attr_GetSevLevel @system_severity OUTPUT
  END
  -- PRINT 'Severity = ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(20), @system_severity)
  -- Only insert error if given severity value is less than or equal to the system severity level setting
  IF @severity > @system_severity
    RETURN 0
  -- Only get here if we must log the error
  SET @logged_at = GETUTCDATE()
  INSERT INTO error_log(logged_at, severity, instance_info, object_name, object_section, description, system_msg)
    VALUES(@logged_at, @severity, @instance_info, @object_name, @object_section, @description, @system_msg)

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Error_Log]
  (@log_id int ,
   @logged_at datetime ,
   @severity int ,
   @instance_info nvarchar(254) ,
   @object_name nvarchar(80) ,
   @object_section nvarchar(254) ,
   @description nvarchar(1700) ,
   @system_msg NOTES ,
   @time_zone_bias_value int = 0)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver.      Changes
--10/10/2005	  Raghu		   3.1.0	 Part of DB Changes
-- 09/21/2017	  Raghu		   6.0	     UserStory:909250 - As Terry, I want the migration of util tables to the new schema to not fail because of error messages in error_log table (CR L00146457)
-- 02/05/2020     Jim O'Hearn  6.2.0     Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @logged_at IS NOT NULL SET @logged_at = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @logged_at)

UPDATE error_log
SET logged_at = @logged_at,
    severity = @severity,
    instance_info = @instance_info,
    object_name = @object_name,
    object_section = @object_section,
    description = @description,
    system_msg = @system_msg
WHERE 	(log_id = @log_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_MDM_Sched_addEntAttr] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ent_id int,
	@attr_desc varchar(50),
	@attr_value varchar(50),
	@lastEditComment varchar(50)=NULL,
	@attr_notes varchar(50)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare @attrGroup int
	Declare @mod_id int
	Set @attrGroup=2
	Declare @attr_id int
	if (@ent_id is not null and @attr_desc is not null and @attr_value is not null)
	BEGIN
		if exists(select * from attr with (nolock) where attr_grp=@attrGroup and attr_desc=@attr_desc)
			select @attr_id=attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_grp=@attrGroup and attr_desc=@attr_desc
		else
			exec sp_I_Attr  @attr_id=@attr_id OUT ,   @attr_desc=@attr_desc ,   @attr_grp=@attrGroup ,   @last_edit_comment=@lastEditComment,@predefined=NULL,@data_type=NULL,@filtr=NULL,@last_edit_at=NULL,@entry_type=2

		if exists(select * from ent_attr with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id and attr_id=@attr_id)
			update ent_attr set attr_value=@attr_value, notes=@attr_notes where ent_id=@ent_id and attr_id=@attr_id
		else
			exec sp_I_Ent_Attr  @ent_id=@ent_id ,   @attr_id=@attr_id ,   @attr_value= @attr_value ,   @notes=@attr_notes,   @last_edit_comment=@lastEditComment,@last_edit_at=NULL
	END
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Grp_Line_Link_GetAcc]
  (@user_id nvarchar(40),
  @line_id INT)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_S_Grp_Line_Link_GetAcc
-- Description	  -	Returns a data set with a single row containing the specified user's line access for the
--					specfied line.
-- Author		  -
-- Date Created	  -	05/22/2014
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By     Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
IF NOT @user_id IS NULL
BEGIN
	SELECT grp_line_link.line_id
		,line.line_name
		,(max(CAST(grp_line_link.accss AS Int))) access
	FROM grp_line_link grp_line_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON grp_line_link.line_id = line.line_id
	WHERE ((grp_line_link.line_id = @line_id) AND
	       (grp_line_link.grp_id in (SELECT grp_id FROM user_grp_link WHERE user_id = @user_id)))
	GROUP BY grp_line_link.line_id, line.line_name
	ORDER BY line.line_name
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_ent_logon_aft_del] ON [dbo].[ent_logon] AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	TG_ENT_LOGON_AFT_DEL
-- Description	      -	Code moved from AFTER INSERT trigger of ENT_LOGON table
-- Date Created	      -	10/18/2002
-- Version	      -       1.3.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/18/2002		Sheetal Jain				Base version
-- 11/14/2002		Sheetal Jain				Deleted trigger accessed through Temp table in the cursor
-- 01/21/2003		Raghu						FC Labor Tags Included
-- 03/27/2003		Raghu						Updating FC Tags moved to sp_ent_logon_aft_del stored procedure to improve performance
-- 12/07/2007		AML				3.4.2		Re-wrote trigger to call sp_D_Ent_LogOffEnts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@session_id				INT32
		,	@ent_id					INT32
		,	@user_id				STRING40_NULL
		,	@cur_lab_usage_log_id	INT32
		,	@pct_lab_to_apply		TFLOAT
		,	@i						INT32
		,	@max_i					INT32

	--Create table variable to hold deleted values
	DECLARE @tmp_ent_logon TABLE (
		id int identity,
		session_id int,
		user_id nvarchar(40),
		ent_id int,
		pct_lab_to_apply float,
		cur_lab_usage_log_id int
	)

	--Populate table variable with values from deleted
	INSERT INTO @tmp_ent_logon ( session_id, user_id, ent_id, pct_lab_to_apply, cur_lab_usage_log_id )
	SELECT session_id, user_id, ent_id, pct_lab_to_apply, cur_lab_usage_log_id
	FROM DELETED d

	SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @tmp_ent_logon

	--Loop through the data and pass each record to the stored proc
	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@session_id = session_id
			,	@user_id = user_id
			,	@ent_id = ent_id
			,	@pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply
			,	@cur_lab_usage_log_id = cur_lab_usage_log_id
		FROM @tmp_ent_logon
		WHERE id = @i

		EXEC sp_D_Ent_Logon_LogOffEnts @session_id, @user_id, NULL, @ent_id, @pct_lab_to_apply, @cur_lab_usage_log_id

		SET @i = ( @i + 1 )
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cause_Grp_Category_Link]
  (@category_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
   @cause_grp_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
   @last_edit_by STRING40_NULL = NULL,
   @last_edit_at TDATETIME_NULL = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	        - sp_SA_Cause_Grp_Category_Link
-- Description          - Retrieves the specified records from the cause_grp_category_link table
-- Author               - Arun
-- Date Created         - 02/21/2013
-- Version              - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SELECT cause_grp_category_link.category_id
    ,cause_grp_category_link.cause_grp_id
    ,cause_grp.cause_grp_desc
    ,cause_grp.display_seq
    ,cause_grp_category_link.last_edit_comment
    ,cause_grp_category_link.last_edit_by
    ,cause_grp_category_link.last_edit_at
FROM cause_grp_category_link WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN cause_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cause_grp_category_link.cause_grp_id = cause_grp.cause_grp_id
INNER JOIN category WITH(NOLOCK) ON category.category_id = cause_grp_category_link.category_id
WHERE ((cause_grp_category_link.category_id = @category_id OR @category_id IS NULL) AND
       (cause_grp_category_link.cause_grp_id = @cause_grp_id OR @cause_grp_id IS NULL) AND
       (cause_grp_category_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (cause_grp_category_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
      )
ORDER BY cause_grp_category_link.category_id, cause_grp.cause_grp_desc;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@event_time_utc_start_range	TDATETIME2
,@event_time_utc_end_range	TDATETIME2
,@last_edit_comment		STRING254 = NULL
,@records_affected		INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents
-- Description			- HD# 5083, Insert Past Raw Reason.  This sp is intended to used only VIA other sps
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 12/21/2004
-- Version				- 2.1.10
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 07/28/2016		Raghu			5.3		UserStory: 676234 - Rework on the stored procedure; Renamed from sp_U_Util_Log_MergeLogs
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu			5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
-- 06/29/2017		Raghu			6.1		UserStory: 787366 - [Enhancement] As Lenka, I want the UCO spare fields recorded in the util_exec table (CR L00120430)
-- 07/01/2020		Raghu			6.2		UserStory: 1265956-As Aveva, I want the util_shift_link table to be backfilled periodically, just the same way the job_hour_history table is filled in
-- 07/20/2020		Raghu			6.2		US-1339700: As Aveva, I want the issue in the upgrade script to be fixed when backfilling util_shift_link table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	 @old_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@old_state_cd			INT32
	,@old_reas_cd			INT32
	,@old_reas_pending		LOGICAL
	,@old_raw_reas_cd		STRING80
	,@old_comments			STRING2000

	,@new_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@new_state_cd			INT32
	,@new_reas_cd			INT32
	,@new_reas_pending		LOGICAL
	,@new_raw_reas_cd		STRING80
	,@new_comments			STRING2000
	,@new_spare1			STRING80
	,@new_spare2			STRING80
	,@new_spare3			STRING80
	,@new_spare4			STRING80

	,@counter			INT32
	,@cur_event_time_utc 		TDATETIME2
	,@raw_reas_merge_option		INT32
	,@comment_merge_option		INT32
	,@last_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@log_id			INT32
	,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

BEGIN
	--Verify whether the event modification is related to a single event.
	IF (@event_time_utc_start_range IS NULL AND @event_time_utc_end_range IS NOT NULL )
		--The event modification is related to a single event.
		--Get the preceding event
		SELECT @event_time_utc_start_range = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc < @event_time_utc_end_range

	--If the event start time is still null, default to the supplied end time range
	SET @event_time_utc_start_range = COALESCE(@event_time_utc_start_range, @event_time_utc_end_range)

	-- Get the merge options from the system_attr table
	-- attr_id = 440: "How to handle raw reason codes when merging utilzation events"
	SELECT @raw_reas_merge_option = CAST(attr_value AS INT)
	FROM system_attr WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 440

	-- Set the raw reas merge option to the default of don't merge if the attribute cannot be found
	SET @raw_reas_merge_option = COALESCE(@raw_reas_merge_option, 0)

	-- attr_id = 441: "How to handle comments when merging utilzation events"
	SELECT @comment_merge_option = CAST(attr_value AS INT)
	FROM system_attr WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 441

	-- Set the comment merge option to the default of don't merge if the attribute cannot be found
	SET @comment_merge_option = COALESCE(@comment_merge_option, 0)

	--Default the count to 0, if the count is null
	SET @records_affected = COALESCE(@records_affected, 0)

	--Verify whether a range of events are supplied to determine whether they have to be merged.
	IF (@event_time_utc_start_range IS NOT NULL AND @event_time_utc_end_range IS NOT NULL AND @event_time_utc_start_range <= @event_time_utc_end_range) BEGIN
		--A range of utilization events are supplied.
		SET @new_event_time_utc = @event_time_utc_start_range

		WHILE (1 = 1) BEGIN

			--Retrieve the starting event
			IF (@new_event_time_utc = @event_time_utc_start_range AND @old_event_time_utc IS NULL)
				SELECT @new_event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc, @new_state_cd = uh.state_cd, @new_reas_cd = uh.reas_cd
					, @new_reas_pending = uh.reas_pending
					, @new_comments = uh.comments, @new_raw_reas_cd = uh.raw_reas_cd
				FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
			 	  AND uh.event_time_utc = @event_time_utc_start_range
			ELSE BEGIN
				--Reset the variables to null
				SELECT @new_event_time_utc = NULL, @new_state_cd = NULL, @new_reas_cd = NULL, @new_reas_pending = NULL
					, @new_comments = NULL, @new_raw_reas_cd = NULL

				--If previous events are accessed, then retrieve the subsequent event to the current event
				SELECT @new_event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc, @new_state_cd = uh.state_cd, @new_reas_cd = uh.reas_cd
					, @new_reas_pending = uh.reas_pending
					, @new_comments = uh.comments, @new_raw_reas_cd = uh.raw_reas_cd
				FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND uh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MIN(uh1.event_time_utc)
							   FROM util_history uh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
							   WHERE uh1.ent_id = @ent_id
							     AND uh1.event_time_utc > @old_event_time_utc)
			END

			--Exit, if there are no more records
			IF (@new_event_time_utc IS NULL
			--Or, exit if the next event is greater than the applicable range
			OR @new_event_time_utc > @event_time_utc_end_range) BREAK

			--Verify whether this is the first event to compare.
			IF (@old_event_time_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				--This is not the first event to verify.
				--Verify whether this event is the same event as the previous event.
				IF (@old_state_cd = @new_state_cd AND @old_reas_cd = @new_reas_cd
				  AND @old_reas_pending = @new_reas_pending
				  AND (COALESCE(@old_comments, '') = COALESCE(@new_comments, '') OR @comment_merge_option <> 0)
			  	  AND (COALESCE(@old_raw_reas_cd, '') = COALESCE(@new_raw_reas_cd, '') OR @raw_reas_merge_option <> 0)) BEGIN

			  	  	--This event appears to be exactly same as the previous event.
			  	  	--Therefore, delete this event
					DELETE FROM util_history
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc

					--Capture the no. of records affected on this delete process.
					SET @records_affected = @records_affected + @@ROWCOUNT

					-- If we are using the new reason code when merging two events,
					-- then copy the new reason code into the old reason code
					IF @raw_reas_merge_option = 2 SET @old_raw_reas_cd = @new_raw_reas_cd

					-- If we are using the new comment when merging two events,
					-- then copy the new comment into the old comment
					IF @comment_merge_option = 2 SET @old_comments = @new_comments

					--Use the new comment to update the old event
					UPDATE util_history
					SET raw_reas_cd = @old_raw_reas_cd
					   , comments = @old_comments
					   , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND event_time_utc = @old_event_time_utc
					  --Make sure the values are different; otherwise, there is no point in updating the utilization row
					  AND (COALESCE(util_history.raw_reas_cd, '') <> COALESCE(@old_raw_reas_cd, '') OR COALESCE(util_history.comments, '') <> COALESCE(@old_comments, '') )

					--Capture the number of records affected during this operation
					SET @records_affected = @records_affected + @@ROWCOUNT

					--Move to the next record
					CONTINUE
				END
			END

			SELECT @old_event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc
				, @old_state_cd = @new_state_cd, @old_reas_cd = @new_reas_cd, @old_reas_pending = @new_reas_pending
				, @old_comments = @new_comments, @old_raw_reas_cd = @new_raw_reas_cd
		END

		--Determine the first and last events from the list of events
		SELECT @event_time_utc_start_range = MIN(v), @event_time_utc_end_range = MAX(v)
 		FROM (VALUES (@event_time_utc_start_range), (@old_event_time_utc), (@new_event_time_utc), (@event_time_utc_end_range)) AS value(v)
	END

	--Get the last event for the entity
	SELECT @last_event_time_utc = MAX(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id

	--Verify whether any one of the events is in the list is the last event
	IF (@last_event_time_utc BETWEEN @event_time_utc_start_range AND @event_time_utc_end_range) BEGIN
		--This is the latest and greatest event
		--Retrieve the details of the current event to compare with the previous events to determine whether or not to update the util_exec
		SELECT @new_event_time_utc = uhlast.event_time_utc, @new_state_cd = uhlast.state_cd, @new_reas_cd = uhlast.reas_cd
			, @new_raw_reas_cd = uhlast.raw_reas_cd, @new_reas_pending = uhlast.reas_pending
			, @new_spare1 = uhlast.spare1, @new_spare2 = uhlast.spare2, @new_spare3 = uhlast.spare3, @new_spare4 = uhlast.spare4
			, @log_id = uhlast.log_id
		FROM util_history uhlast WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uhlast.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND uhlast.event_time_utc = @last_event_time_utc

		--Default the new event as the current event
		SELECT @cur_event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc, @counter = 1

		--There shouldn't be no more than 100 events having the same reason code, but only differ by comments.
		WHILE (@counter < 100) BEGIN
			--Default the old event time to null
			SET @old_event_time_utc = NULL

			--Select the previous event to determine when this reason actually started
			SELECT @old_event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc, @old_reas_cd = uh.reas_cd, @old_raw_reas_cd = uh.raw_reas_cd
			FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
			AND uh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc)
						FROM util_history uh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
						  AND event_time_utc < @cur_event_time_utc)

			--If the previous reason is not the same as the current reason, then exit
			--The goal is to find when the reason actually started, so if the previous reason is different than the current one, quit
			IF (@new_reas_cd <> @old_reas_cd OR COALESCE(@new_raw_reas_cd, '') <> COALESCE(@old_raw_reas_cd, '')) OR @old_event_time_utc IS NULL BREAK
			SELECT @cur_event_time_utc = @old_event_time_utc, @counter = @counter + 1
		END

		--Update util_exec with the new event information
		UPDATE util_exec
		SET cur_state_cd = @new_state_cd
		  , cur_reas_cd = @new_reas_cd
		  , cur_reas_start_utc = @cur_event_time_utc
		  , cur_reas_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @cur_event_time_utc)
		  , cur_raw_reas_cd = @new_raw_reas_cd
		  , reas_reqd = @new_reas_pending
		  , cur_log_id = @log_id
		  , spare1 = @new_spare1
		  , spare2 = @new_spare2
		  , spare3 = @new_spare3
		  , spare4 = @new_spare4
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	--Update the utilization event times in the job_hour_history, if necessary
	EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshTimes @ent_id=@ent_id, @start_utc_range=@event_time_utc_start_range, @end_utc_range=@event_time_utc_end_range
		, @wo_id=NULL, @oper_id=NULL, @seq_no=NULL, @job_start_utc=NULL, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment

	-- If there are no future events beyond the end utc range, then default to current datetime so that the shift changes in-between the 2 subsequent events can be captured
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND event_time_utc > @event_time_utc_end_range)
		SET @event_time_utc_end_range = GETUTCDATE()

	--- Sync up the utilization events in the util_shift_link table after the utilization events are created/modified/deleted
	EXEC sp_U_Util_Shift_Link_MergeEvents @ent_id=@ent_id, @start_utc_range=@event_time_utc_start_range, @end_utc_range=@event_time_utc_end_range
		,@last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Item_Spec]
(@row_id int,
 @process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @step_no int,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @item_class_id nvarchar(40) ,
 @ver_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @spec_id  nvarchar(40) ,
 @grp_id nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By     Ver	    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 12/19/2017		Surya			6.0	    US:956690 As Peter I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT oper_item_spec.row_id
            ,oper_item_spec.process_id
            ,oper_item_spec.oper_id
            ,oper_item_spec.step_no
            ,oper_item_spec.item_id
            ,oper_item_spec.item_class_id
            ,oper_item_spec.ver_id
            ,oper_item_spec.spec_id
            ,oper_item_spec.spec_value
	        ,spec.grp_id
            ,oper_item_spec.assoc_file
            ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(oper_item_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
            ,oper_item_spec.comments
            ,oper_item_spec.min_value
            ,oper_item_spec.max_value
            ,oper_item_spec.access_level
            ,process.process_desc
            ,spec.spec_desc
	        ,spec.units
  	        ,spec.spare1
  	        ,spec.spare2
  	        ,spec.spare3
  	        ,spec.spare4
            ,oper_item_spec.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_item_spec.last_edit_by
            ,oper_item_spec.last_edit_at
            ,spec.data_type data_type
FROM oper_item_spec oper_item_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_item_spec.process_id = process.process_id
INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_item_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
WHERE ((oper_item_spec.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.item_class_id = @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
       (spec.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_item_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY oper_item_spec.spec_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Oper_Ent_Route]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ent_id int ,
   @input_oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @input_ent_id int ,
   @input_percent float ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.12
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0  Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1600   Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 01/18/2005     SJ            2112   HD#HD#1441 - Oper_ent_route and job_route Validation
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID changes..
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
 ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
BEGIN
  IF @oper_id = @input_oper_id AND @ent_id = @input_ent_id
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Source operation and the entity must be different than the destination operation and the entity.{4531}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  IF @input_percent IS null SET @input_percent = 1

  INSERT INTO oper_ent_route
 (process_id,
  oper_id,
  ent_id,
  input_oper_id,
  input_ent_id,
  input_percent,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
 VALUES
  (@process_id,
   @oper_id,
   @ent_id,
   @input_oper_id,
   @input_ent_id,
   @input_percent,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

  --* Return timestamp
  --SET @mod_id = (SELECT CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM oper_ent_route
    WHERE (process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
      AND input_oper_id = @input_oper_id AND input_ent_id = @input_ent_id)
END

    --Current shift is no shift
    IF(@shift_id = 0)
    Begin
        --take labor start for the previous shift from labor usage table
        BEGIN
            SELECT @labor_start_local =labor_start_local
            FROM (SELECT labor_start_local,shift_id,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY labor_start_local DESC) l_rank
            FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
            AND ent_id=@ent_id) lsl
            WHERE lsl.l_rank =1
             SET @labor_start_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value,  @labor_start_local)
        END
        -- get the previous shift start and end times from the shift to go table using previous shiftlabor start

        BEGIN
            SELECT @prev_shift_start=start_time,@prev_shift_end=end_time, @prev_shift_id = shift_id
            FROM shift_to_go WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE (ent_id =@ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
                AND (start_time <= @labor_start_local AND end_time >= @labor_start_local)
        SET @prev_shift_start_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value,  @prev_shift_start)
      SET @prev_shift_end_utc = DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value,  @prev_shift_end)

        END

        --Create new labor usage records.
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
            lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
            active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
            SELECT  @prev_shift_end_utc,@prev_shift_end, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
                lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, @shift_id, @prev_shift_end_utc, @prev_shift_end, pct_to_apply,
                active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
            FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
              AND ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_start_local <= @prev_shift_end
              AND active = 1 AND labor_start_local <>@v_current_time_local



        END
        -- close the new record created in this shift
        IF(@v_current_time_local != @prev_shift_end  )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE labor_usage
            SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss,labor_start_local, @v_current_time_local)
            ,active = 0
            WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
              AND ent_id = @ent_id
              AND active = 1 AND labor_start_local = @prev_shift_end
        END

        --Create new labor record to capture the labor usage now onwards
        IF (@v_current_time_local != @prev_shift_end)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
            lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
            active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
            SELECT @v_current_time_utc,@v_current_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
                lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, @shift_id,@shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
                active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
            FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
              AND ent_id = @ent_id
              AND active = 1
        END


        --Close the current labor records created in the previous shift.

        BEGIN
             UPDATE labor_usage
             SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss,labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @prev_shift_end_utc)
             ,active = 0
              --(TO_DATE(SP_U_LABOR_EXEC_NEWSHIFT.v_current_time)-TO_DATE(labor_start))*24*3600
             WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
             AND ent_id = @ent_id
             AND active = 1
             AND labor_start_local <> @v_current_time_local AND labor_start_local < @prev_shift_end
        END

      END
    ELSE
        --Current shift is a usual shift.
        --Create new labor usage records.
        BEGIN
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
            lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
            active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
            SELECT @shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
                lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, @shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
                active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
            FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
              AND ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_start_local < @shift_start_local
              AND active = 1
        END

        -- close the new record created in this shift
        IF(@v_current_time_local != @shift_start_local  )
        BEGIN
            UPDATE labor_usage
            SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss,labor_usage.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc)
            ,active = 0
            WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
             AND ent_id = @ent_id
             AND active = 1 AND labor_start_local = @shift_start_local
        END

        --Create new labor record to capture the labor usage now onwards

        IF(@v_current_time_local != @shift_start_local  )
        BEGIN

            INSERT INTO labor_usage (labor_start_utc, labor_start_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
            lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, shift_id, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
            active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
            SELECT @v_current_time_utc,@v_current_time_local, user_id, ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id,
                lot_no, sublot_no, lab_cd, dept_id, @shift_id, @shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local, pct_to_apply,
                active, duration, comments, raw_reas_cd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
            FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
              AND ent_id = @ent_id
              AND active = 1
        END

     --Added for the CR# L00116545.
     --Close the current labor records created in the previous shift.

        BEGIN
         UPDATE labor_usage
         SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss,labor_usage.labor_start_local, @shift_start_local)
         ,active = 0
          --(TO_DATE(SP_U_LABOR_EXEC_NEWSHIFT.v_current_time)-TO_DATE(labor_start))*24*3600
         WHERE user_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
         AND ent_id = @ent_id
         AND active = 1
         AND labor_start_local<> @v_current_time_local AND labor_start_local < @shift_start_local
      END

     END

     --Close the current labor records created in the previous shift.

    --Find the associated row in ent_logon and update its cur_lab_usage_log_id with the new
    --log_id. What if there are now > 1 row in labor_usage because of splits to multiple
    --steps / lots :1 Just take the 1st one :2
    UPDATE ent_logon
	SET cur_lab_usage_log_id = (SELECT MAX(lu.log_id) FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lu.ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id AND lu.user_id = ent_logon.user_id AND active = 1)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_MDM_SCHED_Shift_Exc]
(@start_time	DATETIME
,@end_time	DATETIME

) AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	[sp_SA_MDM_SCHED_Shift_Exc]
-- Description	      -	Returns a recordset of all shift exceptions in a given date range
-- Author			  - Ajay
-- Date Created	      -	2018/08/21
-- Version			  - 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2015 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 2018-09-03	  AP			1.0.1	Added last_edit_comment column in select
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT    ent_id
		, DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, shift_exc.start_time), shift_exc.start_time) as start_time
		, DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, shift_exc.end_time), shift_exc.end_time) as end_time
		, dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, shift_exc.start_time), shift_exc.start_time), null) as start_time_utc
		, dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, DATEADD(ms, -DATEPART(ms, shift_exc.end_time), shift_exc.end_time), null) as end_time_utc

		, CASE ISNULL(shift_id, 0)
			WHEN 0 THEN last_edit_comment
			ELSE CAST(shift_id AS NVARCHAR) + ' - ' + last_edit_comment
		  END as exception_desc
	,additive
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) mod_id
	, shift_id
	,last_edit_comment

FROM shift_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (start_time > @start_time AND start_time < @end_time)
   OR (end_time > @start_time  AND end_time < @end_time)
   OR (start_time < @start_time AND end_time > @end_time)
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        sp_s_ofi_cb_process_parameter
-- Description: SP to fetch process parameter details along with correction step
--
-- Usage:       From which object this script is called.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
-- 0.01.00      AKM         2023-03-30          Initial version.
-- 0.02.00		JSC			2025-10-21			Cakeblender FATS
-- 0.02.01		JSC			2025-11-11			Modified the way to get the cur_step number
-- 0.02.02		JSC			2026-01-25			Fixed the logic to create a new step only if sent to DCS
-- 0.02.03		JSC			2026-01-26			Fixed the initial logic + changed CB_Batch weight
-- 0.02.04		JSC			2026-02-02			Updated the way to calculate the cur_step as it didn't go up
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_cb_process_parameter]
        @wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT
AS
        BEGIN
                DECLARE @curr_correction_step INT = 0,
                        @base_dose_param      FLOAT,
                        @correction_step      INT
                --v2.02 moved here to get the current value
				SELECT  @curr_correction_step =  ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,js.act_spec_value),0)
				FROM    job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE
						js.wo_id       = @wo_id
						AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
						AND js.seq_no  = @seq_no
						AND js.spec_id = 'CB_Current correction step'
				
				-- v2.00 Added
                DECLARE @job_spare1 INT = 0
                SELECT  @job_spare1 = ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,j.spare1),0)
                FROM    job j WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE
                        j.wo_id       = @wo_id
                        AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
                        AND j.seq_no  = @seq_no

				-- Update only when it is not pending to be sent ( value 4 - SENT to DCS; Value 3 - waiting to be sent (or failed), value 2 - calculated; value 1 - AMQP calculating 
                IF ( @job_spare1 < 3  OR @curr_correction_step = 0 OR @curr_correction_step IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					SET  @curr_correction_step = ISNULL(@curr_correction_step,0)+1	 -- add one
				END
				

				-- Get the other values
                SELECT  @base_dose_param = act_spec_value
                FROM    job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE
                        wo_id           = @wo_id
                        AND oper_id     = @oper_id
                        AND seq_no      = @seq_no
                        AND spec_id     = 'CB_Dosing weight'
                SELECT  @correction_step = act_spec_value
                FROM    job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE
                        wo_id      = @wo_id
                        AND oper_id = @oper_id
                        AND seq_no  = @seq_no
                        AND spec_id = 'CB_Number of corrections'

                ---return---
                SELECT  @base_dose_param      AS base_dose_param,
                        @curr_correction_step AS curr_correction_step,
                        @correction_step      AS correction_step
        END

-- 10/25/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084807 - moved the check for a null extension to before the check if the file extension exists
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@error_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)

SELECT @edit_level = COALESCE(@edit_level, 1), @view_level = COALESCE(@view_level, 1), @print_level = COALESCE(@print_level, 1), @ignore_if_exists = COALESCE(@ignore_if_exists, 0)

IF (@file_ext IS NULL) BEGIN
	SET @error_msg = 'The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext'
	RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

IF (@ignore_if_exists = 1) BEGIN  -- Verfiy whether the file extension has to be determined for its existence
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE file_ext = @file_ext)
	--If the supplied file_ext is null (i.e. most likely the call is made from other stored procedures), then exit.  In this case, the assoc_file is null, i.e., there is no file associated to a job, operation, etc.
	--Therefore, there is no need to attempt to crate a new file type. Therefore, exit.
	--If the file extension already exist, then exit
	RETURN
END

IF (@edit_level < 1 OR @edit_level > 999) BEGIN
	SET @error_msg = 'The edit_level must be in the range 1-999.{3365},edit_level,1,999'
	RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

IF (@view_level < 1 OR @view_level > 999) BEGIN
	SET @error_msg = 'The view_level must be in the range 1-999.{3365},view_level,1,999'
	RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

IF (@print_level < 1 OR @print_level > 999) BEGIN
	SET @error_msg = 'The print_level must be in the range 1-999.{3365},print_level,1,999'
	RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_D_ofi_aut_int_buff_CleanupOldRecords]
-- Description: Cleanup old records from the table
--
-- Usage: For Maintenance: Delete old records (older than 1 month ?)
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC		2026-01-20			Update for maintenance
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_ofi_aut_int_buff_CleanupOldRecords]
      @RetentionMonths INT = 3
    , @BatchSize INT = 5000
    , @UntilEmpty INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @RowsDeleted INT;

    -- First batch (always executed at least once)
    DELETE TOP (@BatchSize)
    FROM dbo.ofi_aut_interface_buffer
    WHERE CurrentTimestamp < DATEADD(MONTH, -@RetentionMonths, GETUTCDATE());

    SET @RowsDeleted = @@ROWCOUNT;

    -- If we do NOT want to loop until empty, exit after one batch
    IF @UntilEmpty = 0
        RETURN @RowsDeleted;   -- optional: return number of rows deleted

    -- If @UntilEmpty = 1, continue looping until no rows left
    WHILE @RowsDeleted > 0
    BEGIN
        WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:05';   -- throttle between batches

        DELETE TOP (@BatchSize)
        FROM dbo.ofi_aut_interface_buffer
        WHERE CurrentTimestamp < DATEADD(MONTH, -@RetentionMonths, GETUTCDATE());

        SET @RowsDeleted = @@ROWCOUNT;
    END;

    RETURN;
END;

CREATE Trigger [dbo].[tg_qm_scl_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[qm_spec_char_link]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_qm_scl_aft_ins
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER inserting on qm_spec_char_link table to update
--			 lsl and usl columns
-- Author             - JA
-- Date Created         5/26/2011
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--	06/04/2012		Ahmed		4.5		Update the regen_samples flag of db_status table when new rows are inserted
--  07/12/2012    Pradeep S     4.5     Fix for CR 120710 - Take absolute value of target field while calculating lsl and usl vlaues
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @lsv FLOAT
	        ,@usv FLOAT
	        ,@lsv_is_offset BIT
	        ,@usv_is_offset BIT
	        ,@lsv_offset_is_pct BIT
			,@usv_offset_is_pct BIT
			,@target FLOAT
			,@qm_spec_id INT
			,@char_id int

	DECLARE sl_ins_cursor CURSOR
	FOR SELECT  lsv
		        ,usv
			    ,lsv_is_offset
				,usv_is_offset
				,lsv_offset_is_pct
				,usv_offset_is_pct
				,target
				,qm_spec_id
				,char_id
	FROM inserted;

	OPEN sl_ins_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT from sl_ins_cursor INTO @lsv,@usv,@lsv_is_offset,@usv_is_offset
				,@lsv_offset_is_pct,@usv_offset_is_pct,@target
				,@qm_spec_id ,@char_id ;

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--LSL calculation
		IF @lsv_is_offset=1
		 BEGIN
		   IF @lsv_offset_is_pct=0
			UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
			SET lsl=target-lsv
			WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id AND char_id=@char_id;
		   ELSE
			UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
			SET lsl=target-(ABS(target)*lsv/100) -- Fix for CR 120710 - Take absolute value of target field
			WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;
		 END
		ELSE
		   UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
		   SET lsl=lsv
		   WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;

		--USL calculation
		IF @usv_is_offset=1
		 BEGIN
		   IF @usv_offset_is_pct=0
			UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
			SET usl=target+usv
			WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id AND char_id=@char_id;
		   ELSE
			UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
			SET usl=target+(ABS(target)*usv/100) -- Fix for CR 120710 - Take absolute value of target field
			WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;
		 END
		ELSE
		   UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
		   SET usl=usv
		   WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;

	END -- END of WHILE (1-1)
	CLOSE sl_ins_cursor
	DEALLOCATE sl_ins_cursor

	IF EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0) AND
		EXISTS(SELECT top 1 qm_spec.qm_spec_id FROM qm_spec WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE qm_spec.start_eff_local<GETDATE() AND (qm_spec.end_eff_local>GETDATE() OR qm_spec.end_eff_local IS NULL) AND qm_spec_id IN (select INSERTED.qm_spec_id from INSERTED))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
			END
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_I_ofi_lm_printer_name]
-- Description: Insert into printer information
--
-- Usage:	Insert into printer information
-- select * from [ofi_lm_printer_information]
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-03			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-09-08			Audit trail added
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_lm_printer_name]  
	@printer_id NVARCHAR(500)
	,@printer_name NVARCHAR(500)=NULL
	,@inUse bit
	,@printer_type int
	,@user_id NVARCHAR(200)
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @isPresent INT=0;
	DECLARE @new_printer_desc NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@old_printer_id NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
			,@new_printer_inUse NVARCHAR(50)
			,@new_printer_type NVARCHAR(50)
			,@new_row_id INT
			,@resultset INT=1
			,@resultcode NVARCHAR(100)=NULL

declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_PrinterInfo'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Printer'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@l INT =0
			,@smeRcdCnt INT=0

	DECLARE @printerInfo as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	printer_id NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_desc NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_inUse INT,
	printer_type INT
	);

	DECLARE @printerInfo1 as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	printer_id NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_desc NVARCHAR(200),
	printer_inUse INT,
	printer_type INT
	);

	insert into @printerInfo (row_id,printer_id,printer_desc,printer_inUse,printer_type)
	select olpi.printer_row_id,olpi.printer_id,olpi.printer_desc,olpi.printer_inUse,olpi.printer_type
	from [ofi_lm_printer_information]  olpi WITH(NOLOCK)

	SELECT @isPresent=COUNT(printer_id)
	FROM [ofi_lm_printer_information] olpi WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE olpi.printer_id=@printer_id

	IF(@isPresent > 0)
	BEGIN
	UPDATE [ofi_lm_printer_information]
	SET printer_desc=@printer_name
		,printer_inUse=@inUse
		,printer_type=@printer_type
	WHERE printer_id=@printer_id
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	Insert Into [ofi_lm_printer_information] (printer_id,printer_desc,printer_inUse,printer_type)
	values(@printer_id,@printer_name,@inUse,@printer_type)
	END

	insert into @printerInfo1 (row_id,printer_id,printer_desc,printer_inUse,printer_type)
	select olpi.printer_row_id,olpi.printer_id,olpi.printer_desc,olpi.printer_inUse,olpi.printer_type
	from [ofi_lm_printer_information]  olpi WITH(NOLOCK)

	BEGIN TRY
	
	-- edit existing record present 
	SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.printer_desc)
	from @printerInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (t1.printer_desc <> t2.printer_desc) OR (t1.printer_inUse <> t2.printer_inUse) OR (t1.printer_type <> t2.printer_type)
	
	while (@i < @modCnt)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @new_printer_desc= t2.printer_desc 
		,@new_printer_inUse=case when t2.printer_inUse=1 then 'Inuse'
							else 'NotInUse'
							end
		,@new_printer_type= CASE when t2.printer_type= 0 then 'Manual'
							ELSE 'In-Line'
							end
		,@new_row_id=t2.row_id
	from @printerInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (t1.printer_desc <> t2.printer_desc) OR (t1.printer_inUse <> t2.printer_inUse) OR (t1.printer_type <> t2.printer_type)
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @i ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'printer_type',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_printer_type))
							,(@new_row_id,'printer_inUse',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_printer_inUse))
							,(@new_row_id,'printer_desc',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_printer_desc))
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+@printer_id+' _ ';
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg

	SET @i = @i + 1;
	
	END

	-- insert new record 
select @newCnt= count(t2.printer_desc)
from @printerInfo t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						  from @printerInfo t2 )
 while (@j < @newCnt)
 BEGIN
 SELECT @new_printer_desc= t2.printer_desc 
		,@new_printer_inUse=case when t2.printer_inUse=1 then 'Inuse'
							else 'NotInUse'
							end
		,@new_printer_type= CASE when t2.printer_type= 0 then 'Manual'
							ELSE 'In-Line'
							end
		,@new_row_id=t2.row_id
	from @printerInfo t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @printerInfo t2 )
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @j ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+@printer_id+' _ '
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'printer_type',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_printer_type))
							,(@new_row_id,'printer_inUse',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_printer_inUse))
							,(@new_row_id,'printer_desc',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_printer_desc))
	
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @j = @j + 1;

 END

 --delete record
 select @delCnt=count(t1.printer_desc) 
from @printerInfo t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						from @printerInfo1 t2 )
while (@k < @delCnt)
 BEGIN
 SELECT @new_printer_desc= t1.printer_desc 
		,@new_printer_inUse=case when t1.printer_inUse=1 then 'Inuse'
							else 'NotInUse'
							end
		,@new_printer_type= CASE when t1.printer_type= 0 then 'Manual'
							ELSE 'In-Line'
							end
		,@new_row_id=t1.row_id
		from @printerInfo t1
		FULL OUTER JOIN @printerInfo1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @printerInfo1 t2 )
 order by t1.row_id
 OFFSET @k ROWS   
 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

 Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
 set @strCommentMsg='For '+@printer_id+' _ '
 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id))							
							,(@new_row_id,'printer_desc',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg))
	
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @k = @k + 1;
 END




set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='Success';
select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_MDM_Sched_addItemAttr] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@item_id varchar(50),
	@attr_desc varchar(50),
	@attr_value varchar(50),
	@lastEditComment varchar(50)='',
	@attr_notes varchar(50)=''
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare @attrGroup int
	Declare @mod_id int
	Set @attrGroup=1
	Declare @attr_id int
	if (@item_id is not null and @attr_desc is not null and @attr_value is not null)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Job_Attr]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @attr_id int = NULL,
   @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
   )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 09/15/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2018     Surya         6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 5

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT job_attr.wo_id
          ,job_attr.oper_id
          ,job_attr.seq_no
          ,job_attr.attr_id
          ,job_attr.attr_value
          ,job_attr.notes
          ,job_attr.last_edit_comment
          ,job_attr.last_edit_by
          ,job_attr.last_edit_at
          ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM job_attr job_attr
WHERE (job_attr.wo_id = @wo_id AND
       job_attr.oper_id = @oper_id AND
       job_attr.seq_no = @seq_no AND
       job_attr.attr_id = @attr_id)
END

(@cause_id  int  ,
 @cause_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @cause_grp_id  int  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(80),
 @spare2  nvarchar(80),
 @spare3  nvarchar(80),
 @spare4  nvarchar(80),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       -
-- Description       -
-- Author         -
-- Date Created         -  6/28/2011
-- Version        -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT cause.cause_id
            ,cause.cause_desc
            ,cause.cause_grp_id
            ,cause_grp.cause_grp_desc
            ,cause.display_seq

            ,cause.spare2
            ,cause.spare3

       (cause.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
