CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_History_UpdateEvent]
(@ent_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@existing_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@log_id			INT32_NULL = NULL  -- for backward compatibility; will be overridden if exiting_event_time_utc is supplied since UTC is more reliable
,@new_event_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@event_time_local		TDATETIME2 = NULL  -- new local time for backward compatibility; will be overridden if event_time_utc is supplied since UTC is more reliable
,@new_event_end_time_utc	TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@duration			INT32 = NULL  -- duration for backward compatibility; will be overridden if the new event_end_time_utc is supplied
,@reas_cd			INT32
,@reas_pending			LOGICAL = NULL
,@comments			STRING2000_NULL = NULL
,@raw_reas_cd			STRING40 = NULL
,@spare1			STRING80 = NULL
,@spare2			STRING80 = NULL
,@spare3			STRING80 = NULL
,@spare4			STRING80 = NULL
,@category1			STRING80 = NULL
,@category2			STRING80 = NULL
,@category3			STRING80 = NULL
,@category4			STRING80 = NULL
,@records_affected		INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Util_History_UpdateEvent
-- Description                      - UserStory: 675693 -Update utilization events and adjust adjacent events
-- Author                           - Raghu
-- Date Created                     - 08/15/2016
-- Version                          - 5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By       Ver         Changes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu	5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
-- 08/04/2017	Raghu		6.0		UserStory:716502 - Stateless API issues for backward compatibility
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @pre_event_time_utc			TDATETIME2
	,@pre_event_end_time_utc		TDATETIME2
	,@ending_event_time_utc			TDATETIME2
	,@next_event_time_utc			TDATETIME2

	,@event_time_utc_update_start		TDATETIME2
	,@event_time_utc_update_end		TDATETIME2

  	,@existing_duration			INT32
  	,@existing_event_end_time_utc		TDATETIME2
  	,@state_cd				INT32
	,@runtime				LOGICAL
	,@downtime				LOGICAL
	,@setuptime				LOGICAL
	,@teardowntime				LOGICAL
	,@fixedtime				LOGICAL
	,@failure				LOGICAL
	,@vartime				LOGICAL

	,@last_edit_by				STRING40
	,@last_edit_at				TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	,@range_start_utc			TDATETIME2
	,@range_end_utc				TDATETIME2
	,@error_msg				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@last_edit_comment 			STRING254 = 'UtilHistory.UpdateEvent'
	,@existing_ent_id			INT32

BEGIN
	--Determine if the existing event time is supplied; if not use the log_id to determine the existing event_time
	IF (@existing_event_time_utc IS NULL)
		SELECT @existing_ent_id = uh.ent_id, @existing_event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.log_id = @log_id

	--Use the ent-id from the util_log record, if it is not supplied, for backward compatibility
	SET @ent_id = COALESCE(@ent_id, @existing_ent_id)

	--Get the duration of the existing event
	SELECT @existing_duration = vuh.duration, @existing_event_end_time_utc = vuh.event_end_time_utc
	FROM vw_util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE vuh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND vuh.event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc

	IF (@existing_duration IS NULL) BEGIN -- Verify whether a record exist
		--The start time is not supplied.  Raise an error, exit
		SET @error_msg = 'The %1 should be a valid datetime. Please enter a valid date and time.{3347}, existing event time'
		RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- If the event time UTC is supplied, use that since UTC is more reliable
	IF (@new_event_time_utc IS NULL)
		--Since UTC time is not supplied; use the supplied local time to determine the UTC time
		--This case is for backward compatibility
		IF (@event_time_local IS NOT NULL)
			SET @new_event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE())

	--default the new event time to be existing event time if not supplied
	SELECT @new_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@new_event_time_utc, @existing_event_time_utc)

	--Strip out the milliseconds
	SET @new_event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@new_event_time_utc)

	--Error, if the supplied duration is less than zero.
	IF (COALESCE(@duration, 0) < 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Duration cannot be negative.{5984}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify that the event is not in the future
	IF (@new_event_time_utc > GETUTCDATE()) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('This is a future event, and the duration and event_time does not fit in with the current date and time{4258}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the reason code exist in the database
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified utilization reason does not exist.{7926}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Determine if the end event time of the new event utc is supplied
	IF (@new_event_end_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
		--The end time of the new event is supplied
		SET @duration = DATEDIFF(SS, @new_event_time_utc, @new_event_end_time_utc)
	ELSE IF (@duration IS NOT NULL)
		--The new event end time utc is not supplied. For backward compatibility, use the duration, if supplied
		SET @new_event_end_time_utc = DATEADD(SS, @duration, @new_event_time_utc)
	ELSE -- Neither the new event end time utc is suppied nor the duration is supplied
		--Therefore, use the existing end time
		SELECT @new_event_end_time_utc = @existing_event_end_time_utc, @duration = DATEDIFF(SS, @new_event_time_utc, @existing_event_end_time_utc)

	--Error, if the supplied duration is less than zero.
	IF (@duration < 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Start datetime must be earlier than end datetime{3030}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--If the duration is null or 0, then the inserted event will take the rest of the duration in the current event
	IF (@duration = 0) BEGIN
		--The supplied duration is zero.
		--Remove the event and exit
		EXEC sp_D_Util_History @log_id=@log_id, @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@existing_event_time_utc, @records_affected=@records_affected OUTPUT

		--Since the new event did not affect any other events, call the standard SPs and exit.
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify that the event is not ending in the future
	IF (@new_event_end_time_utc > GETUTCDATE())
		--Default to the current date and time
		SET @new_event_end_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	--Get the start time and end time of the preceding event
	--This is the first event in the range where the events are modified
	SELECT @pre_event_time_utc = vuh.event_time_utc, @pre_event_end_time_utc = vuh.event_end_time_utc
	FROM vw_util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE vuh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND vuh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc)
				    FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
				    WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
				      AND event_time_utc <= @new_event_time_utc)

	--Verify whether the starting time of the new event and the ending time of the new event exactly match.
	IF (@pre_event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc AND @pre_event_end_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc
		--And the existing event is the same
		AND @new_event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc AND @new_event_end_time_utc = @existing_event_end_time_utc) BEGIN
		--An event exist at this time with the exact start time and end time, therefore, update the existing event
		EXEC sp_U_Util_History @ent_id=@ent_id, @event_time_utc=@new_event_time_utc, @reas_cd=@reas_cd, @reas_pending=@reas_pending
			, @comments=@comments, @raw_reas_cd=@raw_reas_cd, @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4
			, @category1=@category1, @category2=@category2, @category3=@category3, @category4=@category4
			, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment, @last_edit_at=NULL, @log_id=NULL, @records_affected=@records_affected OUTPUT

		--Exit, since the existing event is updated
		RETURN
	END

	--Determine the earlist start time where the records are affected
	IF (@existing_event_time_utc > @new_event_time_utc)
		--The star time of the event is moved backwards from the current starting time
		--Default to the new event time, if there are no preceding events
		SET @event_time_utc_update_start = COALESCE(@pre_event_time_utc, @new_event_time_utc)
	ELSE
		--The start time of the event is moved forward from the current starting time
		SET @event_time_utc_update_start = @existing_event_time_utc

	--Determine the latest end time among the event adjustments
	IF (@existing_event_end_time_utc < @new_event_end_time_utc)
		--Since the new event's end time is later, set the new event's end time as the start of the next event
		--The end time of the event is moved forward from the current end time
		SET @event_time_utc_update_end = @new_event_end_time_utc
	ELSE
		--The new event is ending earlier than the end time of the current event; therefore, set the end time of the current event
		--The end time of the event is moved backwards from the current end time
		SET @event_time_utc_update_end = @existing_event_end_time_utc

	--Get the actual start time of the next event starting at the end time of the new event
	SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND event_time_utc >= @event_time_utc_update_end

	-- Get the reason details for the new event
	SELECT @state_cd = state_cd, @runtime = runtime, @downtime = downtime
		, @setuptime = setuptime, @teardowntime = teardowntime, @fixedtime = fixedtime
		, @failure = failure, @vartime = vartime
	FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd

	--Get the user who is running this transaction
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Verify whether the duration of the current event is reduced
	IF (@new_event_time_utc BETWEEN @existing_event_time_utc AND @existing_event_end_time_utc
		AND @new_event_end_time_utc BETWEEN @existing_event_time_utc AND @existing_event_end_time_utc) BEGIN
		--The event adjustment is within an existing event.  Therefore, move the start time or the ending time inside the event
		--Verify whether the startime of the existing event is modified
		IF (@existing_event_time_utc < @new_event_time_utc)
			--The start time of the existing event is modified to more forward. Therefore, modify the start time of the existing event
			UPDATE util_history
			SET event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc
				, event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_time_utc)
				, state_cd = @state_cd, reas_cd = @reas_cd, reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, reas_pending)
				, runtime = @runtime, downtime = @downtime, setuptime = @setuptime, teardowntime = @teardowntime, fixedtime = @fixedtime
				, vartime = @vartime, failure = @failure, comments = COALESCE(@comments, comments)
				, raw_reas_cd = COALESCE(@raw_reas_cd, raw_reas_cd)
				, spare1 = COALESCE(@spare1, spare1), spare2 = COALESCE(@spare2, spare2), spare3 = COALESCE(@spare3, spare3), spare4 = COALESCE(@spare4, spare4)
				, category1 = COALESCE(@category1, category1), category2 = COALESCE(@category2, category2), category3 = COALESCE(@category3, category3), category4 = COALESCE(@category4, category4)
				, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  	  AND event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc
		ELSE
			--The start time of an existing event is not modified, but there may be other modifications to the existing event
			UPDATE util_history
			SET state_cd = @state_cd, reas_cd = @reas_cd, reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, reas_pending)
				, runtime = @runtime, downtime = @downtime, setuptime = @setuptime, teardowntime = @teardowntime, fixedtime = @fixedtime
				, vartime = @vartime, failure = @failure, comments = @comments
				, raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd
				, spare1 = COALESCE(@spare1, spare1), spare2 = COALESCE(@spare2, spare2), spare3 = COALESCE(@spare3, spare3), spare4 = COALESCE(@spare4, spare4)
				, category1 = COALESCE(@category1, category1), category2 = COALESCE(@category2, category2), category3 = COALESCE(@category3, category3), category4 = COALESCE(@category4, category4)
				, last_edit_comment =@last_edit_comment
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  	  AND event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc

		--Verify whether the end of time of existing event is modified
		IF (@new_event_end_time_utc < @existing_event_end_time_utc)
			--The duration of the existing event is reduced or the end time is moved backwards. Therefore, move the next event to start at the end of the existing event
			UPDATE util_history
			SET event_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc
			 , event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc)
			 , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND event_time_utc = @existing_event_end_time_utc
	END
	ELSE BEGIN --Event adjustments are not entirely within an existing event
		--Verify whether the new event is entirely contained inside an pre existing event
		IF (@new_event_time_utc > @pre_event_time_utc AND @new_event_time_utc < @pre_event_end_time_utc
		   AND @new_event_end_time_utc > @pre_event_time_utc AND @new_event_end_time_utc < @pre_event_end_time_utc)
			--The new event is contained entirely within an existing single event
			--Since the new event is not ending right on top of the next event
			--Now insert the first chunk into the 3rd slot to cover the remaining time
			INSERT INTO util_history (ent_id, event_time_utc, event_time_local, state_cd, reas_cd, reas_pending
				, runtime, downtime, setuptime, teardowntime, fixedtime, vartime, failure, comments, raw_reas_cd
				, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, category1, category2, category3, category4
				, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			SELECT uh.ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc), uh.state_cd, uh.reas_cd, uh.reas_pending
				, uh.runtime, uh.downtime, uh.setuptime, uh.teardowntime, uh.fixedtime, uh.vartime, uh.failure, uh.comments, uh.raw_reas_cd
				, uh.spare1, uh.spare2, uh.spare3, uh.spare4, uh.category1, uh.category2, uh.category3, uh.category4
				, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
			FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND uh.event_time_utc = @pre_event_time_utc
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The event adjusments spans outside the current event
			--Verify whether there are any events starting at the end of the new event.
			--If not, move the starttime of the ending event to start at the end of the new event.
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND uh.event_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc) BEGIN

				--Get the event that is in the middle of the new end time
				SELECT @ending_event_time_utc = vuh.event_time_utc
				FROM util_history vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE vuh.ent_id = @ent_id
				  AND vuh.event_time_utc = (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc)
							    FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
							    WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
							      AND event_time_utc >= @new_event_time_utc
							      AND event_time_utc <= @new_event_end_time_utc
							      AND event_time_utc <> @existing_event_time_utc)

				--The new event is not ending on top of the start of next event; therefore, update the following event to start at the new end time
				IF (@ending_event_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
					--Update the starting time of the preceding event if an event exist.
					UPDATE util_history
					SET event_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc
					 , event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc)
					 , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND event_time_utc = @ending_event_time_utc

				ELSE IF (@new_event_end_time_utc BETWEEN @existing_event_time_utc AND @existing_event_end_time_utc)
					--The start time of the existing event is moved into the previous event and the end event is reduced within the existing event
					--The duration of the existing event is reduced or the end time is moved backwards. Therefore, move the next event to start at the end of the existing event
					UPDATE util_history
					SET event_time_utc = @new_event_end_time_utc
					 , event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_end_time_utc)
					 , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
					WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND event_time_utc = @existing_event_end_time_utc
			END
		END

		--Delete any existing utilization event (except the current event) exist at start of the new event
		DELETE FROM util_history
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc
		  AND event_time_utc <> @existing_event_time_utc

		--Delete all the events that fall within the update range
		DELETE FROM util_history
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND event_time_utc > @new_event_time_utc
		  AND event_time_utc < @new_event_end_time_utc
		  AND event_time_utc <> @existing_event_time_utc

		--If the start time of the new event and the existing event are the same, then just update the existing event
		IF (@new_event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc)
			--This is the current event
			UPDATE util_history
			SET state_cd = @state_cd, reas_cd = @reas_cd, reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, reas_pending)
				, runtime = @runtime, downtime = @downtime, setuptime = @setuptime, teardowntime = @teardowntime, fixedtime = @fixedtime
				, vartime = @vartime, failure = @failure, comments = @comments
				, raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd
				, spare1 = COALESCE(@spare1, spare1), spare2 = COALESCE(@spare2, spare2), spare3 = COALESCE(@spare3, spare3), spare4 = COALESCE(@spare4, spare4)
				, category1 = COALESCE(@category1, category1), category2 = COALESCE(@category2, category2), category3 = COALESCE(@category3, category3), category4 = COALESCE(@category4, category4)
				, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc
		ELSE
			--Update the existing event to start at the new event
			UPDATE util_history
			SET event_time_utc = @new_event_time_utc
				, event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @new_event_time_utc)
				, state_cd = @state_cd, reas_cd = @reas_cd, reas_pending = COALESCE(@reas_pending, reas_pending)
				, runtime = @runtime, downtime = @downtime, setuptime = @setuptime, teardowntime = @teardowntime, fixedtime = @fixedtime
				, vartime = @vartime, failure = @failure, comments = @comments
				, raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd
				, spare1 = COALESCE(@spare1, spare1), spare2 = COALESCE(@spare2, spare2), spare3 = COALESCE(@spare3, spare3), spare4 = COALESCE(@spare4, spare4)
				, category1 = COALESCE(@category1, category1), category2 = COALESCE(@category2, category2), category3 = COALESCE(@category3, category3), category4 = COALESCE(@category4, category4)
				, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND event_time_utc = @existing_event_time_utc
	END

	--Always get the preceding event to determine the event adjustment because the current event may have a reason that can be merged with the preceding or next event.
	SELECT @event_time_utc_update_start = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc < @event_time_utc_update_start

	--Determine the start and end rage of events
	SELECT @range_start_utc = MIN(v), @range_end_utc = MAX(v)
	FROM (VALUES (@existing_event_time_utc), (@existing_event_end_time_utc), (@new_event_time_utc), (@new_event_end_time_utc)
		, (@pre_event_time_utc), (@pre_event_end_time_utc), (@ending_event_time_utc), (@next_event_time_utc)
		, (@event_time_utc_update_start)) AS value(v)

	--Merge events if they need to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id = @ent_id
		, @event_time_utc_start_range = @range_start_utc, @event_time_utc_end_range = @range_end_utc
		, @last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, @records_affected = @records_affected OUTPUT
END

-- Author						-

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	DISTINCT bom_item.item_id
		           , item.item_desc
		           , item.item_class_id
		           , item_class.item_class_desc
	FROM bom_item_oper_link bom_item_oper_link (NOLOCK)
        LEFT OUTER JOIN bom_item WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item.parent_item_id = bom_item_oper_link.parent_item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON bom_item.item_id = item.item_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN item_class WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id

	(

        (bom_item.bom_pos = bom_item_oper_link.bom_pos) AND
        (bom_item.ver_id = bom_item_oper_link.ver_id)
	)


END

 (process_id,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Labor_Exec_SetRawReason]
(@ent_id             INT32
,@raw_reas_cd        INT32
,@new_reas_start     TDATETIME
,@comments           STRING254
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_U_Labor_Exec_SetRawReason
-- Description           - Set the Raw Reason Code received from I/O
-- Date Created        - 09/12/2002
-- Version (last edit)  - 1.4
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Author	     - Raghu
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver    		Changes
--11/18/2002	Raghu		1.5.0		Set the Raw Reason Code in cur_raw_reason_cd field. As in 1.5.0 db, we got the new field cur_raw_reas_cd, so
--						we can set this field instead of setting in spare1 field
--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--01/30/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074574; Unable to set a raw reason code.
--02/22/2008	DianaI		3.4		L00074574, sp_U_Labor_Exec_SetRawReason needs to pass @raw_reas_cd to sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @def_lab_cd	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@current_time	TDATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()
	IF @new_reas_start IS NULL SET @new_reas_start = @current_time

	--Check if the row exists in labor_exec for this entity. If not, raise an error
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM labor_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('A row does not exist in %1 table for this entity.{4733},labor_exec', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
--	Modified by Raghu on 11/18/2002. Set the cur_raw_reas_cd in cur_raw_reas_cd (instead of setting in spare1)
	UPDATE labor_exec SET cur_raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	SELECT @def_lab_cd = def_lab_cd
	FROM labor_raw_reas
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd
	--Reason Code passed from I/O can be anything and may have an unknown reason code.
	--Since we got the new labor code for this raw reason (from IO), close all current labor and
	--create new labor records for ALL USERS
	IF @def_lab_cd IS NOT NULL
		Exec sp_U_Labor_Exec_NewLabor NULL, @ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, @def_lab_cd
			, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL, NULL, NULL,@raw_reas_cd
END

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-	fn_APR_GetKeyColumns
-- Description			-	Gets the primary key columns as a comma separated list
-- Author				-	Rich Boyle
--
-- Date Created			-	03/04/2016
-- Version				-	5.03
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_APR_GetKeyColumns]
(
@table_name as NVARCHAR(MAX)
) RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @column_list NVARCHAR(1000)

	-- select the list of primary key columns and remove the last comma and assign it to the
	-- @column_list variable
	SELECT @column_list = LEFT(Main.column_names, LEN(Main.column_names)-1)
	FROM
	(
		-- need one more level of select so that we can get the column list string
		SELECT
			(
				-- create a comma separated list of the primary keys sorted by the column name
				SELECT x.column_name + ',' AS [text()]
				FROM
					(
						-- Get the columns names and whether or not they are primary keys
						SELECT DISTINCT sys.columns.name AS column_name, (SELECT COUNT(column_name) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_NAME = sys.tables.name AND CONSTRAINT_NAME = (SELECT constraint_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = sys.tables.name AND constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND COLUMN_NAME = sys.columns.name)) AS IsPrimaryKey
						FROM sys.columns WITH (NOLOCK)
						JOIN sys.tables WITH (NOLOCK) ON sys.columns.object_id = sys.tables.object_id
						JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WITH (NOLOCK) ON sys.tables.name = INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS.TABLE_NAME
						WHERE sys.tables.object_id = OBJECT_ID(@table_name)
					) x
				WHERE x.isPrimaryKey = 1
				ORDER by x.column_name
				FOR XML PATH ('')
			) [column_names]
	) [Main]

	RETURN @column_list
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Folder]
  (@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ent_id int ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_desc nvarchar(80) ,
   @notes NOTES ,
   @udf1 nvarchar(40) ,
   @udf2 nvarchar(40) ,
   @preferred_ver bit ,
   @design_hold bit,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_I_Folder
-- Description          -
-- Author	            -
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  -  6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--10/07/2002	 Raghu		    1.4		If the current version is set to preferred_ver, then sets all the other (item_id, oper_id, ent_id) preferred versions to 0
--12/04/2002	 Raghu		    1.5.0		Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
--04/01/2003	 Raghu		    1.6.0		Included field 'design_hold'. Part of DB Changes V1.6.0
--06-06-2003	 Sheetal Jain   1.6.0.1 Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
--09/01/2006	 Raghu		    3.1.22	HD# 8682, Preferred version should be always set for the first folder;
--										and when there are no folders. Also, prevent folders being created from an obsolete item.
--										Default design_hold to 0 if NULL
--02/13/2007	 Raghu		    3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--10/24/2007	 AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--										dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--02/04/2020     Jim O'Hearn    6.2.0   Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	STRING40
	,@last_edit_at	TDATETIME

BEGIN
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	--Prevent folders created from an obsolete item.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WHERE item_id = @item_id AND obsolete = 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('A folder cannot be created from an obsolete item.{5045}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--default the preferred version to be 0; if not supplied or the preferred verison is supplied as null.
	SELECT @preferred_ver = COALESCE(@preferred_ver, 0), @design_hold = COALESCE(@design_hold, 0)

	--Verify whether any folder version already exist; if not default this folder as the preferred version.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM folder WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ent_id = @ent_id)
		SET @preferred_ver = 1

	INSERT INTO folder (item_id, oper_id, ent_id, ver_id, oper_desc, notes, udf1, udf2,
		preferred_ver, design_hold, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES (@item_id, @oper_id, @ent_id, @ver_id, @oper_desc, @notes, @udf1, @udf2,
		@preferred_ver, @design_hold, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

	--* Return timestamp
	--SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
	FROM folder
	WHERE (item_id = @item_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND ver_id = @ver_id)

	IF (@preferred_ver = 1)
		UPDATE folder
		SET preferred_ver = 0
		WHERE (item_id = @item_id)
		  AND (oper_id = @oper_id)
		  AND (ent_id = @ent_id)
		  AND (ver_id <> @ver_id)
END

--

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
--10/07/2002	  Raghu		    1.4		If the current version is set to preferred_ver, then sets all the other (item_id, oper_id, ent_id) preferred versions to 0
--04/01/2003	  Raghu		    1.6.0	Included field design_hold - Part of DB Changes V1.6.0

CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessProdData]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'PROD',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28));
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) = CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28)) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		IF @TranCounter = 0
            BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;


			 --- PASTE FROM HERE ---

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN
		
			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,
					@sublot_no INT,
					@qty FLOAT,
					@storage_unit NVARCHAR(40),
					@item_id NVARCHAR(80) ,
					@alibiNumber NVARCHAR(40) ,
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
					--@message_output NVARCHAR(4000),
					--@status_output INT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
					@debug INT = 0

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@sublot_no = sublot_no
					,@qty = qty
					,@storage_unit = storage_unit
					,@item_id = item_id
					,@alibiNumber = alibiNumber
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',
				sublot_no INT '$.sublot_no',
				qty FLOAT '$.qty',
				storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) '$.storage_unit',
				item_id NVARCHAR(80) '$.item_id',
				alibiNumber NVARCHAR(40) '$.alibiNumber',
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME	'$.recorded_timestamp'
			);

			
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
					,@mes_su_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- Get the MES item_id
			SELECT	@mes_item_id = i.item_id 
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(@item_id,2) ia 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.mes_item_id

			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid


			-- v1.03: BPROD

			DECLARE @hu_number INT
					,@goodprod_bag INT
					,@flush_bag INT
					,@metal_bag INT
					,@metaltest_bag INT
					,@no_of_bags INT
					--,@weighttoohigh_bag INT
					,@weighttoolow_bag INT
					--,@nodata_bag INT
					,@mes_reas_desc NVARCHAR(40)
					,@data_bag_spare2  NVARCHAR(80)--Bags Spare2
					,@data_hu_number  NVARCHAR(80)-- HU number
					,@pallet_completed INT = 0 -- Spare 4
					,@CBWoId NVARCHAR(40)
					,@CBSeqNo INT
					,@CBSublotNo INT
					,@PalletCounter NVARCHAR(40)
			
			
			IF @InterfaceType = 'BPROD'
			BEGIN
			
				-- Split the data field into local variables
				SELECT	 @hu_number = hu_number
						,@goodprod_bag = goodprod_bag
						,@flush_bag = flush_bag
						,@metal_bag = metal_bag
						,@metaltest_bag = metaltest_bag
						--,@weighttoohigh_bag = weighttoohigh_bag
						,@weighttoolow_bag = weighttoolow_bag 
						--,@nodata_bag = nodata_bag
						,@no_of_bags = no_of_bags
						--,@pallet_completed = pallet_completed
						,@CBSeqNo = CBSeqNo
						,@CBWoId = CBWoId
						,@CBSublotNo = CBSublotNo
						,@PalletCounter = PalletCounter
				FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
				WITH (
					hu_number INT '$.hu_number',
					goodprod_bag INT '$.goodprod_bag',
					flush_bag INT '$.flush_bag',
					metal_bag INT '$.metal_bag',
					metaltest_bag INT '$.metaltest_bag',
					--weighttoohigh_bag INT '$.weighttoohigh_bag',
					weighttoolow_bag  INT '$.weighttoolow_bag ',
					--nodata_bag INT	'$.nodata_bag'
					no_of_bags INT	'$.no_of_bags',
					--pallet_completed INT '$.pallet_completed',
					CBWoId NVARCHAR(40) '$.CBWoId',
					CBSeqNo INT '$.CBSeqNo',
					CBSublotNo INT '$.CBSublotNo',
					PalletCounter NVARCHAR(40) '$.PalletCounter'
				);

				-- Fix the empty storage_unit value that should be the PSA one 
				IF @storage_unit IS NULL
				BEGIN
					-- Get the MES DESTINATION storage unit ent_id
					SELECT TOP 1 @storage_unit = ea.attr_value
					FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN ent_attr ea with (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
						INNER JOIN  attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
					WHERE e.ent_name = 'PSA'  
						AND  a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
					ORDER BY ea.last_edit_at DESC
				END

				-- get the reas_desc based on which tag is 1				
				IF @goodprod_bag >= 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'GoodProduction';
				ELSE IF @flush_bag >= 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'FlushBag';
				ELSE IF @metal_bag >= 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'MetalBag';
				ELSE IF @metaltest_bag >= 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'MetalTestBag';
				ELSE IF @weighttoolow_bag >= 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'WeightTooLow'; -- Fixed JSC: 20260728
				ELSE SET @mes_reas_desc = 'NoData';
				--ELSE IF @weighttoohigh_bag = 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'WeightTooHighBag';
				--ELSE IF @nodata_bag = 1 SET @mes_reas_desc = 'NoDataBag';
				-- @SAPNumber as SAPHUNumber,@NHU as NestedHUNo
				-- get the @data_bag_spare2

			END



				-- Checks if the expected weight matches the reported weight
				DECLARE @spec_netto_weight FLOAT = NULL;
				DECLARE @expected_weight FLOAT = 0;

				SELECT @spec_netto_weight = TRY_CAST(spec_value AS FLOAT)
				FROM job_spec WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				  AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id
				  AND seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND spec_id = 'Netto weight per bag';

				IF @spec_netto_weight IS NOT NULL AND @spec_netto_weight > 0 AND @no_of_bags IS NOT NULL AND @qty IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @expected_weight = @no_of_bags * @spec_netto_weight;
					IF @qty <> @expected_weight
					BEGIN
						DECLARE @weight_warning NVARCHAR(300);
						
						SET @weight_warning = ' Warning: Qty Mismatch. Reported ' + CAST(@qty AS NVARCHAR(20)) + 
											  'does not match calculation: ' + CAST(@no_of_bags AS NVARCHAR(10)) + 
											  ' bags * ' + CAST(@spec_netto_weight AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '(Expected: ' + 
											  CAST(@expected_weight AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ').';
						
						SET @message_output = ISNULL(@message_output, '') + @weight_warning;
						
						SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed;

						IF @debug = 1 
						BEGIN
							SELECT @message_output as 'weight_consistency_warning', @status_output
						END
					END
				END

		
			-- Get the MES DESTINATION storage unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_su_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent_attr ea with (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN  attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
			WHERE ea.attr_value = @storage_unit
				AND  a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
			ORDER BY ea.last_edit_at DESC

			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type 
				,@ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'
				,@sublot_no as 'sublot_no'
				,@qty as 'qty'
				,@storage_unit as 'storage'
				,@mes_su_ent_id as 'storage_unit_ent_id'
				,@item_id as 'item_id'
				,@mes_item_id as 'mes_item_id'
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid item is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_item_id IS NULL AND @InterfaceType <> 'BPROD' 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','item_id: '+@item_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'item_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid destination storage unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_su_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','Storage Unit / SUNumberInAUT: '+@storage_unit)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'su_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Declare the outputs of the ofi_AddprodWF_data Stored Procedure plus a local variable table to pick it up
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				,@data_bom_pos	INT
				,@data_def_lot_no nvarchar(40)
				,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				,@data_factor	FLOAT
				,@data_thr_result	INT
				,@data_to_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				,@data_to_qty FLOAT
				,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				,@data_su_result INT
				,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME

			-- CANNOT DO NESTED INSERT INTO

---- LOGIC FROM ADD PROD WF DATA


			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT @data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
			FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd=state_cd
					,@data_edit_time=edit_time 
			FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND seq_no = @seq_no

			-- if JOB is COMPLETED/NEW or RELEASED, ERROR
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED -- 4 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500015,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END


				GOTO Exit_Tree;

			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd = 4
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500016,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos=job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			---- Calculate the recorded_timestamp for the specified job
			DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME 
			DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT 
			DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT 


			-- Get the valid timestamp in case the job is running or has ran:
			SELECT @record_min_Diff = record_min_Diff
					,@recorded_timestamp_case = recorded_timestamp_case
					,@record_selected = record_selected
			FROM [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] (
			   @mes_wo_id
			  ,@mes_oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@recorded_timestamp)

			-- SET the actual date : In case the job has never RAN; we use the provided timestamp and let MES deal with it.
			SET @data_created_at_utc = ISNULL(@record_selected,@recorded_timestamp)
			
			-- Set warning if the recorded timestamp falls outside the job run time
			IF @recorded_timestamp_case > 500
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(@recorded_timestamp_case,NULL,NULL)+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@data_created_at_utc,121) +'. original recorded_timestamp: '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@recorded_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timestamp_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

			DECLARE @update_inventory INT
			SELECT @update_inventory = update_inv
			FROM job_bom
			--Get Current Storage unit status V.0.02.00

			IF @update_inventory <> 0
			BEGIN
				SELECT @data_max_capacity = max_capacity
				FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

				IF (@data_max_capacity = 0)
					BEGIN
						SET @data_su_result=1
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @data_su_result=0
					END

			
				-- if SU is not complletely configure (Max Capacity is 0) warning and continue (if not other error is found.)
				IF @data_su_result IS NULL OR @data_su_result = 1 -- 1 = not configured
				BEGIN
					-- Set output message and RETURN
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(465,NULL,NULL)+' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15))
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'SU_conf_warning',@status_output
					END
				END

				--Check the SU have 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
				SELECT TOP 1 @data_su_status = attr_desc
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
					INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
				WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id 
					AND attr_desc IN ('BlockForQuality','LockForInput') 
					AND attr_value = '1'

				-- if SU is in any of the states 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
				IF @data_su_status IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					-- Set output message and RETURN
					SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300050,NULL,NULL)+ @data_su_status +' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15))
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'SU_status_warning',@status_output as 'status'
					END
				END
			END
			--Get Lot number and bom_pos for normal production and item_id for bag Prodution
			IF (@mes_item_id is null or @mes_item_id ='0')
			BEGIN
				SELECT	 @data_def_lot_no = def_lot_no
						,@data_bom_pos = bom_pos
						,@mes_item_id = item_id
						,@data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd 
				FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND bom_pos = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @data_def_lot_no = def_lot_no
							,@data_bom_pos = bom_pos
							,@data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd 
				FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND item_id = @mes_item_id

			END

			-- v1.03: Get reas_cd for the bag if BPROD
			IF @InterfaceType = 'BPROD'
			BEGIN
				SELECT @data_def_reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
				FROM item_reas ir
				WHERE ir.reas_desc = @mes_reas_desc
				ORDER BY ir.last_edit_at DESC
			END

			DECLARE @NonBOMItem INT = 0
			--FIx for empty def_lot_no for NON-bom PROD; and empty def_reas_cd
			IF @data_def_lot_no IS NULL OR @data_def_reas_cd IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SELECT	@NonBOMItem = CASE WHEN @data_def_lot_no IS NULL
												THEN 1
											ELSE 2
										END,
						@data_def_lot_no = ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no ,def_lot_no),
						@data_def_reas_cd = ISNULL(@data_def_reas_cd,def_reas_cd)
				FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND bom_pos = 0

				-- Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500018,NULL,NULL)+ CAST(ISNULL(@mes_item_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(35))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'item_not_in_bom',@status_output
				END
			END
			-- Declare the by-product bit
			DECLARE @mes_byproduct INT

			SET @mes_byproduct = CASE WHEN @data_bom_pos < 0
										THEN 1
									ELSE 0
									END

			--Declare table for UOM factor 
			DECLARE @UOM_factor TABLE (factor float)

			-- GET UOM FACTOR
			INSERT @UOM_factor
			EXECUTE sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT 
				 @item_id = @mes_item_id
				,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
				,@interface = 'PROD' 

			SELECT @data_factor = factor
			FROM @UOM_factor

			--Get item_inv for threshold
			DECLARE @item_inv_threshold TABLE (
												result INT,
												item_id NVARCHAR(30),
												to_item_id NVARCHAR(30),
												lot_no NVARCHAR(30),
												sublot_no NVARCHAR(30),
												to_qty FLOAT
												)
			INSERT @item_inv_threshold
			EXECUTE sp_S_ofi_iteminv_AUT 
				 @item_id = @mes_item_id
				,@ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			SELECT	 @data_thr_result = result
					,@mes_item_id = item_id
					,@data_to_item_id = to_item_id
					,@data_lot_no = lot_no
					,@data_sublot_no = sublot_no
					,@data_to_qty = to_qty 
			FROM @item_inv_threshold



---- END OF LOGIC FROM ADD PROD WF DATA

			-- VERIFY SU
			
			-- Get the grade for the prod REASON
			DECLARE @mes_item_grade_cd INT
					,@mes_item_status_cd INT

			IF @data_def_reas_cd IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN

				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_item_grade_cd = ir.item_grade_cd
							,@mes_item_status_cd = ir.item_status_cd
				FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ir.reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd				
			END


			-- v1.03 Prior making any changes in inventory, call the FlagSet SP			
			EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Storeage_Exec_FlagSet] 
						@ent_name_su = @storage_unit



			-- check if @data_thr_Result == 1; then we need to update the inventory and transfer it.
			IF @data_thr_result  = 1 AND @InterfaceType <> 'BPROD'
			BEGIN

				-- sp_u_ofi_item_inv_move getspec?

				-- from item to item id = mes_item_id
				-- to item_grade = mes_item_grade_cd 
				-- transfer option = 2
				-- status_cd = mes_item_status_cd
				--  COMMENts = 'RECLASS'
				-- BULK_MOVE_RECLASSIFY = 1
				-- from_ to ENT = mes_su_ent_it
				-- transfer_qty = data_to_qty
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Item_Inv_Move] 
							   @from_row_id = NULL
							--  ,@from_last_edit_at
							--  ,
							  ,@item_id = @mes_item_id
							  ,@lot_no = NULL
							  ,@sublot_no = NULL
							  ,@to_sublot_no = NULL
							  ,@to_lot_no = NULL
							  ,@to_status_cd = @mes_item_status_cd
							  --,@to_uom
							  --,@to_expiry_date
							  ,@to_grade_cd = @mes_item_grade_cd
							  --,@to_seq_no
							  ,@log_transfer = NULL
							  ,@transfer_option = 2
							  ,@transfer_comments = 'RECLASS'
							  --,@from_wo_id
							  ,@to_item_id = @mes_item_id
							  --,@to_wo_id
							  ,@from_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
							  ,@transfer_qty = @data_to_qty
							  --,@transfer_qty_erp
							  ,@in_to_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
							  ,@in_to_item_id = @mes_item_id
							  --,@in_to_lot_no
							  --,@in_to_sublot_no
							  --,@in_to_grade_cd
							  --,@to_expiry_date_utc
							  --,@to_oper_id
							  --,@from_oper_id
							  --,@from_seq_no
							  --,@in_to_status_cd
							  --,@in_to_uom_id
							  --,@in_to_expiry_date
							  --,@in_to_expiry_date_tz
							  --,@in_to_wo_id
							  --,@in_to_oper_id
							  --,@in_to_seq_no
							  ,@in_transfer_option = 2
							  --,@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job
							  ,@in_transfer_comments = 'RECLASS'
							  --,@in_log_transfer
							  ,@bulk_move_reclassify = 1
							  --,@time_zone_bias_value

			END

			---- v1.01.04
			---- check if @data_thr_Result == 2; outside the limits silo will end-up in block for quality
			IF @data_thr_result  = 2 AND @InterfaceType <> 'BPROD'
			BEGIN
				 --Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500028,NULL,NULL)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'Outside Limits',@status_output
				END
			END

------>>>   BPROD

			DECLARE @GeneratedSAPHU TABLE (hunumber VARCHAR(100),
							dcsnumber VARCHAR(100),
							rework_hunumber VARCHAR(100),
							flush_hunumber VARCHAR(100),
							RESULT INT)

			DECLARE		@hutype AS INT,
						@reject_hu_attr_id INT,
						@good_hu_attr_id INT,
						--@NHU nvarchar(20),
						@p_type INT
	
			SET @hutype = LEFT(@hu_number, 1) 

			
			IF @hutype = 1 
			BEGIN
				SET @data_hu_number = dbo.fn_s_ofi_dcsHU_to_SAPHU(@hu_number,
    																@mes_wo_id,
    																@mes_oper_id,
    																@seq_no);
				SET @data_bag_spare2 = @data_hu_number;
				SET @pallet_completed = 1;
			END
		
			ELSE IF @hutype = 2 
			BEGIN
				SET @p_type = 3
				IF @PalletCounter IS NOT NULL 
				BEGIN
					IF LEN(@PalletCounter) = 10 AND LEFT(@PalletCounter, 1) = '1'
					BEGIN
						SET @pallet_completed = 1
						SET @PalletCounter = RIGHT(@PalletCounter, 9)
					END
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						SET @pallet_completed = 0 
					END
				END
				SET @data_hu_number = dbo.fn_s_ofi_dcsHU_to_SAPHU(@hu_number,
    																@mes_wo_id,
    																@mes_oper_id,
    																@seq_no);
		
				INSERT INTO @GeneratedSAPHU
				EXEC [SP_S_ofi_GenerateHUNumber] 
						@HU_Type = @p_type,
						@hu_number = @hu_number,
						@wo_id = @wo_id ,
						@oper_id = @mes_oper_id,
						@seq_no = @seq_no,
						@PalletCounter = @PalletCounter
				SELECT  @data_bag_spare2 = flush_hunumber
				FROM @GeneratedSAPHU
			END

			
			IF @data_bag_spare2 IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @data_bag_spare2 = @data_hu_number; 
			END


			-- Prepare SUBLOT_NO to 5 zeros:
			DECLARE @mes_sublot_no NVARCHAR(25)

			-- Fix the missing sublot data with a 'T' for Traceability
			SET @mes_sublot_no = CASE WHEN @NonBOMItem = 1 
										THEN	ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no,@data_lot_no) + RIGHT('00000'+CAST(@sublot_no as VARCHAR(5)),5) + 'T'
									ELSE ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no,@data_lot_no) + RIGHT('00000'+CAST(@sublot_no as VARCHAR(5)),5)
								END

			-- Prepare the data for quantity
			DECLARE @mes_qty_prod FLOAT = 0.0
			SET @mes_qty_prod = ISNULL(@qty, 0) * ISNULL(@data_factor,1)

			-- Declare the outputs
			DECLARE @prod_row_id INT
					,@prod_info_sp NVARCHAR(4000)

			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)

			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()
			

			-- Skip production insert and reclass logic if a BPROD message arrives with 0 bags
			IF @InterfaceType <> 'BPROD' OR (@InterfaceType = 'BPROD' AND ISNULL(@no_of_bags, 0) > 0)
			BEGIN

				-- verify if job running or not
				IF @data_job_state_cd = 3 AND @data_job_pos > -1
				BEGIN	

					-- fields: created_at_utc; byproduct_bom_pos;ent_id;to_ent_id;item_id;job_pos;qty_prod;sublot_no.
					-- add prod to the current job
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Item_Prod_AddProd]
								@session_id = NULL
								--,@event_time_local
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
								,@qty_prod = @mes_qty_prod
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_def_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @mes_sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
								,@item_id = @mes_item_id
								,@byproduct_bom_pos = @data_bom_pos
								--,@ext_ref
								-- ,@apply_scaling_factor
								-- ,@genealogy_id
								-- ,@event_id
								--,@segment_requirement_id
								--,@segment_response_id
								-- ,@comments
								-- ,@spare1
								,@spare2 = @data_bag_spare2 --Nested HU
								,@spare3 = @data_hu_number  -- HU Number
								,@spare4 = @pallet_completed
							--  ,@spare4
								,@check_privs = NULL
								,@created_at_utc = @data_created_at_utc
							--  ,@time_zone_bias_value
								,@row_id = @prod_row_id OUTPUT
								,@prod_info = @prod_info_sp OUTPUT
					
				END

				ELSE 
				BEGIN

					-- add prod to other status job
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec]
								@session_id = NULL
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@qty_prod = @mes_qty_prod
								,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
								,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
								,@seq_no = @seq_no
								,@created_at_utc = @data_created_at_utc
							--  ,@shift_start_local
							--  ,@hour_start_local
							--  ,@shift_id
								,@item_id = @mes_item_id
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_def_lot_no
								--,@rm_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @mes_sublot_no
							--  ,@rm_sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
								-- ,@processed
								,@byproduct = @mes_byproduct
							--  ,@ext_ref
							-- ,@move_status
							-- ,@genealogy_id
							-- ,@event_id
							--,@segment_requirement_id
							--,@segment_response_id
							-- ,@comments
							--,@spare1
								,@spare2 = @data_bag_spare2 --Bags Spare2
								,@spare3 = @data_hu_number  -- HU number
								,@spare4 = @pallet_completed
							--  ,@time_zone_bias_value
								,@row_id = @prod_row_id OUTPUT
					
				END

				-- AFTER CREATING THE INVENTORY; CALL THE FIX TO RECLASS THE SILO
				DECLARE @result_reclass INT
				EXECUTE @result_reclass = [dbo].[Sp_U_ofi_Su_reset_reclass] 
							@ent_name_su = @storage_unit
							,@item_id = @item_id
							,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
							,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
							,@seq_no = @seq_no

				-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
				IF @status_output = 1 
				BEGIN
					-- SET OK
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500019,NULL,NULL)
				END
			END

			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN

				SELECT @prod_info_sp as prod_info
						,@prod_row_id  as prod_row_id
					
				SELECT *
				FROM item_prod i with (nolock)
				WHERE i.row_id = @prod_row_id

				SELECT *
				FROM item_inv i with (nolock)
				WHERE i.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

				SELECT
							@data_wo_state_cd AS wo_status
						,@data_job_state_cd	AS state_cd
						,@data_job_pos	AS job_pos 
						,@data_bom_pos	AS bom_pos
						,@data_def_lot_no AS def_lot_no
						,@data_def_reas_cd AS def_reas_cd
						,@data_factor	AS factor
						,@data_thr_result	AS thr_result
						,@mes_item_id AS mes_item_id
						,@data_to_item_id AS to_item_id
						,@data_lot_no AS lot_no
						,@data_sublot_no AS sublot_no
						,@data_to_qty AS to_qty
						,@data_edit_time AS edit_time
						,@data_max_capacity AS max_capacity 
						,@data_su_result AS su_result
						,@data_su_status AS su_status
						,@mes_su_ent_id AS su_ent_id
						,@mes_sublot_no AS mes_sublot_no
						,@data_created_at_utc as created_at_utc
						,@mes_qty_prod as mes_qty_prod
						,@mes_byproduct as mes_byproduct
						,@mes_user_id as mes_user_id

			END
-- Exit without prod
						--VERIFY if we are Producing BPROD or normal PROD or PPROD
			IF @InterfaceType = 'BPROD' AND ISNULL(@no_of_bags, 0) > 0
			BEGIN
				
				PRINT '@interfaceType = ' + @interfaceType

				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Batchmaker_number] 
						@CBWoId = @CBWoId,
						@oper_id  = 'CakeBlending',
						@CBSeqNo = @CBSeqNo,
						@CBSublotNo = @CBSublotNo,
						@row_id =  @prod_row_id

			END
			
			ELSE IF @InterfaceType = 'BPROD' AND ISNULL(@no_of_bags, 0) <= 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Message processed: 0 bags produced. Production and Batchmaker skipped.';
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed;
			END
			
			IF @InterfaceType = 'BPROD' AND @pallet_completed = 1 AND @data_bag_spare2 IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN

				SET @message_output = ISNULL(@message_output, '') + ' | Pallet closed flag executed for HU:' + @data_bag_spare2;
				IF @hutype = 2
				BEGIN
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_MarkNestedHU_Completed] 
						@nested_hu = @data_bag_spare2; 
				END 

			END

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT   @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @message_output = @message
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

        IF @xstate = -1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
	END CATCH
END;

CREATE Trigger [dbo].[tg_qm_scl_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[qm_spec_char_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_qm_scl_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on qm_spec_char_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Rich
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -  4.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5/26/2011		JA					 Added LSL and USL calculation
-- 05/04/2012		Ahmed		4.5		update the db_status table when char_name or severity_cd is updated
-- 07/06/2012		Ahmed		4.5		updated the db_status table as per CR120755
--  07/12/2012    Pradeep S     4.5     Fix for CR 120710 - Take absolute value of target field while calculating lsl and usl vlaues
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	        ,@lsv FLOAT
	        ,@usv FLOAT
	        ,@lsv_is_offset BIT
	        ,@usv_is_offset BIT
	        ,@lsv_offset_is_pct BIT
			,@usv_offset_is_pct BIT
			,@target FLOAT
			,@qm_spec_id INT
			,@char_id INT

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
	SET qm_spec_char_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
	  , qm_spec_char_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id = i.qm_spec_id AND qm_spec_char_link.char_id = i.char_id


	DECLARE sl_upd_cursor CURSOR
	  FOR SELECT
	      i.lsv, i.lsv_is_offset, i.lsv_offset_is_pct
	     ,i.usv, i.usv_is_offset, i.usv_offset_is_pct
	     ,i.target
	     ,qm_spec_id
	   	,char_id
	 FROM inserted i


	 OPEN sl_upd_cursor
	 WHILE (1=1)
	 BEGIN
	  FETCH NEXT FROM sl_upd_cursor INTO @lsv, @lsv_is_offset, @lsv_offset_is_pct
	     ,@usv, @usv_is_offset, @usv_offset_is_pct
	     ,@target,@qm_spec_id ,@char_id

	  IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

       --LSL calculation
	  IF ( UPDATE(lsv) OR UPDATE(lsv_is_offset) OR UPDATE(lsv_offset_is_pct) OR UPDATE(target))
	   BEGIN
			IF @lsv_is_offset=1
			 BEGIN
			   IF @lsv_offset_is_pct=0
				UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
				SET lsl=target-lsv
				WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id AND char_id=@char_id;
			   ELSE
				UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
				SET lsl=target-(lsv/100*ABS(@target)) --Fix for CR 120710 - Take absolute value of target field
				WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;
			 END
			ELSE
			   UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
			   SET lsl=lsv
			   WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;
		END

		--USL calculation
		IF ( UPDATE(usv) OR UPDATE(usv_is_offset) OR UPDATE(usv_offset_is_pct) OR UPDATE(target))
		BEGIN
			IF @usv_is_offset=1
			 BEGIN
			   IF @usv_offset_is_pct=0
				UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
				SET usl=@target+@usv
				WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id AND char_id=@char_id;
			   ELSE
				UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
				SET usl=@target+(@usv/100*ABS(@target)) --Fix for CR 120710 - Take absolute value of target field
				WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;
			 END
			ELSE
			   UPDATE qm_spec_char_link
			   SET usl=@usv
			   WHERE qm_spec_id=@qm_spec_id and char_id=@char_id;
		END

	 END -- END of WHILE (1-1)
 	CLOSE sl_upd_cursor
    DEALLOCATE sl_upd_cursor

     IF EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0)
		     AND
		EXISTS(SELECT top 1 qm_spec.qm_spec_id FROM qm_spec WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE qm_spec.start_eff_utc<GETUTCDATE() AND (qm_spec.end_eff_utc>GETUTCDATE() OR qm_spec.end_eff_utc IS NULL) AND qm_spec_id IN (select INSERTED.qm_spec_id from INSERTED))
		BEGIN
			IF (
					(
						UPDATE(plan_id)
							AND
						EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INSERTED INNER JOIN DELETED ON (INSERTED.qm_spec_id=DELETED.qm_spec_id) WHERE (INSERTED.plan_id<>DELETED.plan_id))
							AND
						EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON (sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = INSERTED.char_id AND sample_char_link_to_go.qm_spec_id = INSERTED.qm_spec_id))
					)
					OR
					(
						UPDATE(severity_cd)
							AND
						EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 from INSERTED inner join DELETED ON (inserted.char_id = deleted.char_id)
																WHERE (inserted.severity_cd > 0 AND inserted.severity_cd IS NOT NULL AND deleted.severity_cd = 0))
					)
					OR
					(
						UPDATE(severity_cd)
							AND
						EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 inserted.severity_cd,deleted.severity_cd from INSERTED inner join DELETED ON (inserted.char_id = deleted.char_id)
																WHERE
																	(
																		inserted.severity_cd <> 0 AND (deleted.severity_cd IS NULL OR deleted.severity_cd = -1)
																				AND
																		EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(characteristic.char_id = INSERTED.char_id) WHERE characteristic.severity_cd = 0)
																	)
																	OR
																	(
																		inserted.severity_cd = 0 AND (deleted.severity_cd <> 0 AND deleted.severity_cd IS NOT NULL AND deleted.severity_cd <> -1)
																			AND
																		EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = INSERTED.char_id and sample_char_link_to_go.qm_spec_id = INSERTED.qm_spec_id))
																	)
																	OR
																	(
																		inserted.severity_cd = 0 AND (deleted.severity_cd IS NULL OR deleted.severity_cd = -1)
																			AND
																	    EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(characteristic.char_id = INSERTED.char_id) WHERE characteristic.severity_cd <> 0)
																			AND
																		EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = INSERTED.char_id and sample_char_link_to_go.qm_spec_id = INSERTED.qm_spec_id))
																	)
																	OR
																	(
																		(inserted.severity_cd IS NULL OR inserted.severity_cd = -1) AND (deleted.severity_cd = 0)
																			AND
																	    EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(characteristic.char_id = INSERTED.char_id) WHERE characteristic.severity_cd <> 0)
																	)
																	OR
																	(
																		(inserted.severity_cd IS NULL OR inserted.severity_cd = -1) AND (deleted.severity_cd <> 0)
																				AND
																		EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(characteristic.char_id = INSERTED.char_id) WHERE characteristic.severity_cd = 0)
																			AND
																		EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_link_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) inner join INSERTED ON(sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = INSERTED.char_id and sample_char_link_to_go.qm_spec_id = INSERTED.qm_spec_id))
																	)
								)
					)

				)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
				END
		END
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_i_ofi_lm_print_details_manual]
-- Description: Update Manual field value
--
-- Usage:	Update Manual field value
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-10			Initial version. 
   0.01.01  CK			2023-03-09			Added updated column
   0.01.02  CK			2023-09-09			Added audit trail
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-04-01          Updated to use the new tables structure
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_print_details_manual]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@manual_value NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
	,@row_id INT
	,@user_id Nvarchar(100)
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_PrintHistory'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Printer'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@l INT =0
			,@smeRcdCnt INT=0
			,@new_manual NVARCHAR(100)
			,@new_label_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@new_rec_title NVARCHAR(100)
			,@resultset INT=1
			,@resultcode NVARCHAR(200)

	declare @printHistory as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	manual_value nvarchar(200),
	label_id nvarchar(200),
	record_title nvarchar(200)
	);

	declare @printHistory1 as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	manual_value nvarchar(200),
	label_id nvarchar(200),
	record_title nvarchar(200)
	);

	insert into @printHistory(row_id,manual_value)
	select row_id,manual_value
	from [dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] with(nolock)
	where row_id=@row_id

	UPDATE [dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details]
	SET manual_value=@manual_value
		,last_edit_at=GETUTCDATE()
	WHERE row_id=@row_id


	insert into @printHistory1(row_id,manual_value)
	select row_id,manual_value
	from [dbo].[ofi_lm_print_label_details] with(nolock)
	where row_id=@row_id

	BEGIN TRY
	-- edit existing record present 
	SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.row_id)
	from @printHistory t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @printHistory1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (CAST(ISNULL(t1.manual_value,'-') as nvarchar(100)) <> CAST(ISNULL(t2.manual_value,'-') as nvarchar(100)))

	while (@i < @modCnt)
	BEGIN
	SELECT  @new_manual=t2.manual_value
			,@new_label_id=t2.label_id
			,@new_rec_title=t2.record_title
	from @printHistory t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @printHistory1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (CAST(ISNULL(t1.manual_value,'-') as nvarchar(100)) <> CAST(ISNULL(t2.manual_value,'-') as nvarchar(100)))
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @i ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
	
	Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@row_id)),
							  (@row_id,'manual_value',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_manual))

	set @strCommentMsg='For '+@new_label_id+' _ '+@new_rec_title+' _ ';
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = NULL
						,@keyField2 = NULL
						,@keyField3 = NULL
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @i = @i + 1;
	
	END
	
	set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='Success';
	select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
	select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Std_Oper_Ent_Spec]
  (@oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @step_no int ,
   @ent_id int ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) )

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_D_Std_Oper_Ent_Spec
-- Description      - Delete an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
-- 11/08/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Maintain std_oper_ent_spec.ver_date automatically
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32

DELETE std_oper_ent_spec
WHERE (oper_id = @oper_id AND
       step_no = @step_no AND
       ent_id = @ent_id AND
       ver_id = @ver_id AND
       spec_id = @spec_id)

	SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )

	UPDATE std_oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @current_time
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id  AND ver_id = @ver_id
