						                    END
						FROM #SampleControlLimits s
						LEFT OUTER JOIN factor f
						     ON s.act_sample_size = f.sample_size
						WHERE char_id = @temp_char_id AND s.char_id = @temp_char_id
							AND indx = s.indx
					ELSE UPDATE @GroupedRawResults SET
						est_sigma = @est_std_dev
						,cp = cap_perf_stats.cp
						,cpk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl END
						       WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
						       WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
						       ELSE 0
							END
						,pp = cap_perf_stats.pp
						,ppk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl END
						       WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
							   WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
						       ELSE 0
							END
						FROM
							(SELECT CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @est_std_dev)
							             WHEN @est_std_dev <= 0 THEN 99999
							             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @est_std_dev) END AS cp
							      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_usl
							      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_lsl
							      , CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @population_sigma > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @population_sigma)
							             WHEN @population_sigma <= 0 THEN 99999
							             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @population_sigma) END AS pp
							      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_usl
							      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_lsl
						) cap_perf_stats
						WHERE ReportBasis = @curReportBasis AND Characteristic = (select char_name from characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) where char_id = @temp_char_Id)
						AND QMSpecName = (select qm_spec_name from qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) where qm_spec_id = @temp_qm_spec_id)
				END
				-- As above but for Xbar + S
				IF @temp_default_chart = 3 AND @temp_cl_source = 0
					AND @num_samp >= @temp_samples_before_cl
					AND (@samp_used > 0 OR @temp_sigma_est = 1) BEGIN
					IF @temp_sigma_est = 0 SET @est_std_dev = @est_std_dev_sum/@samp_used
					IF @QMReportType = 'SPC' UPDATE #SampleControlLimits
						SET Primary_target = @x_bar,
						    Primary_lcl = @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/
						                  SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
						    Primary_ucl = @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/
						                  SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
						    Secondary_target = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1
						                            THEN NULL
						                            ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4
						                       END,
						    Secondary_lcl = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1
						                         THEN NULL
						                         ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4*b3
						                    END,
						    Secondary_ucl=  CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1
						                         THEN NULL
						                         ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4*b4
						                    END
						FROM #SampleControlLimits s
						LEFT OUTER JOIN factor f
						     ON s.act_sample_size = f.sample_size
						WHERE char_id = @temp_char_id AND s.char_id = @temp_char_id
							AND indx = s.indx
					ELSE UPDATE @GroupedRawResults SET
						est_sigma = @est_std_dev
						,cp = cap_perf_stats.cp
						,cpk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl END
							  WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
							    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
							    ELSE 0
							END
						,pp = cap_perf_stats.pp
						,ppk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl END
							  WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
							   WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
								CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
							    ELSE 0
							END
						FROM
							(SELECT CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @est_std_dev)
							             WHEN @est_std_dev <= 0 THEN 99999
							             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @est_std_dev) END AS cp
							      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_usl
							      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_lsl
							      , CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @population_sigma > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @population_sigma)
							             WHEN @population_sigma <= 0 THEN 99999
							             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @population_sigma) END AS pp
							      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_usl
							      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_lsl
						) cap_perf_stats
						WHERE ReportBasis = @curReportBasis AND Characteristic = (select char_name from characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) where char_id = @temp_char_Id)
						AND QMSpecName = (select qm_spec_name from qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) where qm_spec_id = @temp_qm_spec_id)
				END
			END -- of "IF @temp_char_id <> -1" (If not the first time through)
			-- 2nd part of test in following line was "@SummaryData = 1" but that is true when generating characteristic detail table too
			IF @cl_source = 0  OR @QMReportType = 'summary' BEGIN -- Calculate if cl_source is data or for statistics
				SET @not_enough_samples = 0 -- Start by assuming there are enough
				                            -- samples to satisfy samples_before_cl
				SET @num_samp = 1 -- Only have to count samples when calculating
				                  -- limits from data
				SET @samp_used = 0
				SET @sum_x = 0
				SET @sum_x_squared = 0
				SET @x_bar = 0
				SET @est_std_dev = 0
				SET @est_std_dev_sum = 0
				-- @population_sigma needed to calculate Pp and Ppk
				-- not limited by samples_for_cl or samples_before_cl
				-- but must vary by qm_spec_id and ReportBasis as well as characteristic
				IF @QMReportType = 'summary' -- was IF @SummaryData = 1 but it needn't be calculated when @QMReportType = 'SPC'
					SELECT @population_sigma = STDEV(result_value)
						FROM #RawResults  WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE char_id = @char_id
						AND qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
						AND ReportBasis = @curReportBasis
				-- If xbar (and est_std_dev if variable) can be gotten right away
				-- for the new characteristic do it now
				IF @default_chart > 4 BEGIN -- each result is a sample, so we can
				                            -- count #RawResults records to know
				                            -- how many to include
					SELECT @num_samp = COUNT(*) FROM #RawResults  WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE char_id = @char_id
						AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
					IF @num_samp < @samples_before_cl SET @not_enough_samples = 1
					ELSE BEGIN -- There are enough samples
						-- Limit number of samples to samples_for_cl
						IF @num_samp > @samples_for_cl and @samples_for_cl > 0
							SET @num_samp = @samples_for_cl
						-- A variable using population S.D.
						IF @default_chart < 9 AND @sigma_est = 1
							SELECT @x_bar = AVG(result_value),
							       @est_std_dev = STDEV(result_value)
								FROM #RawResults  WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE char_id = @char_id
								AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
								AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
						-- IX + MR using sample S.D.
						IF @default_chart = 5 AND @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @x_bar = AVG(rr1.result_value),
							       @est_std_dev = CASE WHEN @num_samp = 1 THEN 0
									ELSE SUM(ABS(rr1.result_value -
							                      COALESCE(rr2.result_value,
							                               rr1.result_value)))/
							                      ((@num_samp - 1)* 1.128379168) END
								FROM #RawResults rr1 WITH (NOLOCK)
								LEFT OUTER JOIN #RawResults rr2 WITH (NOLOCK)
									ON rr1.char_id = rr2.char_id
									AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (rr1.qm_spec_id = rr2.qm_spec_id AND rr1.ReportBasis = rr2.ReportBasis))
									AND rr1.rnum = rr2.rnum + 1
								WHERE rr1.char_id = @char_id
									AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (rr1.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND rr1.ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
									AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
									     rr1.rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
						END
						-- MA + MR using sample S.D.
						IF @default_chart = 7 AND @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @x_bar = AVG(result_value)
								FROM #RawResults WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE char_id = @char_id
									AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
									AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
									     rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
							SELECT @d_2 = d_2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
							SELECT @est_std_dev = SUM(mr)/
							                      ((@num_samp-@mov_avg_span+1)*@d_2)
								FROM (
									SELECT MAX(rr2.result_value) -
								           MIN(rr2.result_value) AS mr
										FROM #RawResults rr1 WITH (NOLOCK)
										LEFT OUTER JOIN #RawResults rr2 WITH (NOLOCK)
											ON rr1.char_id = rr2.char_id
											AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (rr1.qm_spec_id = rr2.qm_spec_id AND rr1.ReportBasis = rr2.ReportBasis))
												AND rr2.rnum >= rr1.rnum
												AND rr2.rnum < rr1.rnum +
												    @mov_avg_span
									WHERE rr1.char_id = @char_Id
										AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (rr1.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND rr1.ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
										AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
										     rr1.rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
									GROUP BY rr1.rnum
									HAVING COUNT(rr2.rnum) = @mov_avg_span) ranges
 						END
 						-- MA + MS using sample S.D.
						IF @default_chart = 8 AND @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
							SELECT @x_bar = AVG(result_value)
								FROM #RawResults WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE char_id = @char_id
									AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
									AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
									     rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
							SELECT @c_4 = c_4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
							SELECT @est_std_dev = SUM(ms)/
							                      ((@num_samp-@mov_avg_span+1)*@c_4)
								FROM (
									SELECT STDEV(rr2.result_value) AS ms
										FROM #RawResults rr1 WITH (NOLOCK)
										LEFT OUTER JOIN #RawResults rr2 WITH (NOLOCK)
											ON rr1.char_id = rr2.char_id
												AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (rr1.qm_spec_id = rr2.qm_spec_id AND rr1.ReportBasis = rr2.ReportBasis))
												AND rr2.rnum >= rr1.rnum
												AND rr2.rnum < rr1.rnum +
												    @mov_avg_span
									WHERE rr1.char_id = @char_Id
										AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (rr1.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND rr1.ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
										AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR
											rr1.rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
									GROUP BY rr1.rnum
									HAVING COUNT(rr2.rnum) = @mov_avg_span) sigmas
 						END
						IF @default_chart >= 9 -- An attribute
							SELECT @x_bar = SUM(result_value)/SUM(act_sample_size)
								FROM #RawResults  WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE char_id = @char_id
									AND (@QMReportType = 'SPC' OR (qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND ReportBasis = @curReportBasis))
									AND (@samples_for_cl = 0
									     OR rnum <= @samples_for_cl)
						IF @QMReportType = 'summary' AND @default_chart < 9 -- 1st part of test was IF @SummaryData = 1 but @GroupedRawResults isn't returned when @QMReportType = 'SPC'
							UPDATE @GroupedRawResults SET
							est_sigma = @est_std_dev
							,cp = cap_perf_stats.cp
							,cpk = CASE WHEN (@lsl IS NOT NULL AND @usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
									CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl END
								    WHEN (@usl IS NOT NULL AND @lsl IS NULL) THEN
									CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
								    WHEN (@usl IS NULL AND @lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
									CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
								    ELSE 0
								END
							,pp = cap_perf_stats.pp
							,ppk = CASE WHEN (@lsl IS NOT NULL AND @usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
									CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl END
								    WHEN (@usl IS NOT NULL AND @lsl IS NULL) THEN
									CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
								    WHEN (@usl IS NULL AND @lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
									CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
								    ELSE 0
								END
							FROM
								(SELECT CASE WHEN (@lsl IS NULL OR @usl IS NULL) AND @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@usl, @target) - COALESCE(@lsl, @target))/(3 * @est_std_dev)
								             WHEN @est_std_dev <= 0 THEN 99999
								             ELSE (@usl - @lsl) / (6 * @est_std_dev) END AS cp
								      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_usl
								      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @lsl) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_lsl
								      , CASE WHEN (@lsl IS NULL OR @usl IS NULL) AND @population_sigma > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@usl, @target) - COALESCE(@lsl, @target))/(3 * @population_sigma  )
								             WHEN @population_sigma <= 0 THEN 99999
								             ELSE (@usl - @lsl) / (6 * @population_sigma) END AS pp
								      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_usl
								      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @lsl) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_lsl
						) cap_perf_stats
								WHERE ReportBasis = @curReportBasis
								AND Characteristic =
									(select char_name from characteristic
										WITH (NOLOCK) where char_id = @char_Id)
								AND QMSpecName =
									(select qm_spec_name from qm_spec
										WITH (NOLOCK) where qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id)

					END -- "Else" (there are enough samples)
				END -- of "@default_chart > 4"
			END -- of "IF @cl_source = 0 OR @QMReportType = 'summary'"
		END -- of "IF @char_Id <> @temp_char_id OR @qm_spec_id <> @temp_qm_spec_id OR @curReportBasis <> @tempReportBasis (if a new characteristic or QM spec or report basis)
		-- Calculate est_std_dev or population S.D. if calculating from data, and
		-- it's a variable, and each result is not its own sample, and either
		-- samples_for_cl is 0 or you have not yet reached samples_for_cl samples
		-- 2nd part of test in line below was @SummaryData = 1 but that's true when populating the characteristic detail table even when cl_source > 0
		IF ((@cl_source = 0 OR @QMReportType = 'summary') AND @default_chart <= 4
			AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR @num_samp <= @samples_for_cl)) BEGIN
			-- Also need to calculate x_bar because it too depends on the right set
			-- of samples
			SET @sum_x = @result_value + @sum_x
			SET @x_bar = @sum_x / @rnum -- Current best estimate for x_bar
--TEST
--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES (CAST(@count AS nvarchar(20)),CAST(@char_Id AS nvarchar)+'|'+CAST(@qm_spec_id AS nvarchar)+'|'+@curReportBasis,@sum_x,@rnum)
--SET @count+=1
			IF @sigma_est = 0 BEGIN
				-- Accumulate sample range or S. D. to enable calculation of
				-- est_std_dev one all applicable samples are read
				IF @default_chart = 2 AND @value_no = 1
					AND @act_sample_size > 1 BEGIN -- Xbar + R
					SELECT @d_2 = d_2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
					SET @samp_used = @samp_used + 1
					SET @est_std_dev_sum = @range/@d_2 + @est_std_dev_sum
				END
				IF @default_chart = 3 AND @value_no = 1
					AND @act_sample_size > 1 BEGIN -- Xbar + S
					SELECT @c_4 = c_4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
					SET @samp_used = @samp_used + 1
					SET @est_std_dev_sum = @standard_dev/@c_4 + @est_std_dev_sum
				END
				-- We have already gotten x_bar and est_std_dev for all other
				-- chart types so don't need cases for them here
			END -- of "IF @sigma_est = 0"
			-- Calculate est_std_dev from population S.D. using the right samples
			IF @sigma_est = 1 BEGIN
				SET @sum_x_squared = (@result_value*@result_value) + @sum_x_squared
				-- Calculate current best estimate for est_std_dev
				SET @x_square_diff = @sum_x_squared - (@sum_x * @sum_x / @rnum)
				IF @x_square_diff < 0 SET @x_square_diff = 0
				SET @est_std_dev = CASE @rnum
				                        WHEN 1 THEN 0 -- use 0 for 1st result in
				                                      -- case 1st sample has only
				                                      -- 1 result
				                        ELSE SQRT((1.0/(@rnum-1))* @x_square_diff)
				                        END
			END -- of "IF @sigma_est = 1"
			IF @sample_Id <> @temp_sample_id -- If a new sample
				SET @num_samp = @num_samp + 1
		END	-- of "IF ((@cl_source = 0 OR @QMReportType = 'summary') AND @default_chart <= 4
		    --     AND (@samples_for_cl = 0 OR @num_samp <= @samples_for_cl))"
		-- If you have not yet gotten beyond num_pts_per_page and it's the last
		-- result for this sample (per default_chart), calculate control limits
		-- for this sample and add it to #SampleControlLimits
		IF @indx <= @points_per_page BEGIN
			UPDATE #RawResults SET indx = @indx WHERE row_id = @rr_row_id
			IF ((@default_chart > 4 AND @default_chart < 9) OR @value_no = 1) BEGIN
				IF @cl_source = 0 BEGIN -- Calculate from data
				    IF @default_chart = 2 OR @default_chart = 3 -- Xbar + R or S
						-- No need to figure out targets or limits now, they will
						-- be set later once final values for x_bar and est_std_dev
						-- are known; for now just record act_sample_size
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							NULL, NULL,	NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 5 -- IX + MR
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3 ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3 ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*1.128379168 ELSE NULL END,
							NULL, -- No LCL for the MR part of an IX + MR chart
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*3.6858865724 ELSE NULL END,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 7 BEGIN -- MA + MR
						SELECT @d_2 = d_2, @d1 = d1, @d2 = d2 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@d_2 ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@d1 ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@d2 ELSE NULL END,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					END -- of "IF @default_chart = 7"
					IF @default_chart = 8 BEGIN -- MA + MS
						SELECT @c_4 = c_4, @b3 = b3, @b4 = b4 FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar-@est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar+@est_std_dev*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span)
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@c_4 ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@c_4*@b3 ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @est_std_dev*@c_4*@b4 ELSE NULL END,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					END -- of "IF @default_chart = 8"
					IF @default_chart = 16 -- p
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									-- Limit LCL to >= 0
									CASE WHEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/
								            @act_sample_size) > 0
										THEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/
								            @act_sample_size)
										ELSE 0
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									-- Limit UCL to <= 1
									CASE WHEN @x_bar+3*
											SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/@act_sample_size) >= 1
										THEN 1
										ELSE @x_bar+3*
											SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)/@act_sample_size)
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 17 -- np
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									-- Limit LCL to >= 0
									CASE WHEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(
								            @x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size) > 0
										THEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(
								            @x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size)
										ELSE 0
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									-- Limit UCL to <= act_sample_size
									CASE WHEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size+3*
								            SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size)
								             >= @act_sample_size
										THEN @act_sample_size
										ELSE @x_bar*@act_sample_size+3*
								            SQRT(@x_bar*(1-@x_bar)*@act_sample_size)
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 18 -- u
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									CASE WHEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
									          > 0
										THEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
										ELSE 0
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar+3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
								ELSE NULL END,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 19 -- c
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar*@act_sample_size ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									CASE WHEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)-(3*SQRT(
									          @x_bar*@act_sample_size)) > 0
										THEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)-(3*SQRT(
									         @x_bar*@act_sample_size))
										ELSE 0
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN (@x_bar*@act_sample_size)+
									(3*SQRT(@x_bar*@act_sample_size))
								ELSE NULL END,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 20 -- DPMO
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN @x_bar * 1000000/@num_defect_opp
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN
									CASE WHEN @x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size)
								            > 0
										THEN (@x_bar-3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size))
								            *1000000/@num_defect_opp
										ELSE 0
									END
								ELSE NULL END,
							CASE @not_enough_samples
								WHEN 0 THEN (@x_bar+3*SQRT(@x_bar/@act_sample_size))
								            *1000000/@num_defect_opp
								ELSE NULL END,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
				END -- of "IF @cl_source = 0"
				IF @cl_source = 1 BEGIN -- Compute from standard values
					IF @std_avg_is_target = 1 SET @std_avg = @target
				    IF @default_chart = 2 BEGIN-- Xbar + R
						IF @act_sample_size = 1
							INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								@std_avg - @est_std_dev*3,
								@std_avg + @est_std_dev*3,
								NULL,
								NULL,
								NULL,
								@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
						ELSE BEGIN
							SELECT @d_2 = d_2, @d1 = d1, @d2 = d2
								FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
							INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								@std_avg - @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
								@std_avg + @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
								@std_deviation*@d_2,
								@std_deviation*@d1,
								@std_deviation*@d2,
								@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
						END
					END
					IF @default_chart = 3 BEGIN-- Xbar + S
						IF @act_sample_size = 1
							INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								@std_avg - @std_deviation*3,
								@std_avg + @std_deviation*3,
								NULL,
								NULL,
								NULL,
								@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
						ELSE BEGIN
							SELECT @c_4 = c_4, @b1 = b1, @b2 = b2
								FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE sample_size = @act_sample_size
							INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
								@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
								@std_avg,
								@std_avg - @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
								@std_avg + @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@act_sample_size),
								@std_deviation*@c_4,
								@std_deviation*@b1*SQRT(@act_sample_size/
								                        (@act_sample_size-1.0)),
								@std_deviation*@b2*SQRT(@act_sample_size/
								                        (@act_sample_size-1.0)),
								@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
						END
					END
					IF @default_chart = 5 -- IX + MR
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							 @requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							 @std_avg,
							 @std_avg - @std_deviation*3,
							 @std_avg + @std_deviation*3,
							 @std_deviation*1.128379168,
							 NULL,
							 @std_deviation*3.6858865724,
							 @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 7 BEGIN -- MA + MR
						SELECT @d_2 = d_2, @d1 = d1, @d2 = d2
							FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg,
							@std_avg - @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
							@std_avg + @std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
							@std_deviation*@d_2,
							@std_deviation*@d1,
							@std_deviation*@d2,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					END
					IF @default_chart = 8 BEGIN -- MA + MS
						SELECT @c_4 = c_4, @b1 = b1, @b2 = b2
							FROM factor WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE sample_size = @mov_avg_span
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg,
							@std_avg-@std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
							@std_avg+@std_deviation*3/SQRT(@mov_avg_span),
							@std_deviation*@c_4,
							@std_deviation*@b1*SQRT(@mov_avg_span/(@mov_avg_span-1.0)),
							@std_deviation*@b2*SQRT(@mov_avg_span/(@mov_avg_span-1.0)),
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					END
					IF @default_chart = 16 -- p
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg,
							CASE WHEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)/
							          @act_sample_size) > 0
								THEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)/
								     @act_sample_size)
								ELSE 0
							END,
							@std_avg+3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)/@act_sample_size),
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 17 -- np
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg*@act_sample_size,
							CASE WHEN @std_avg*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)*
							          @act_sample_size) > 0
								THEN @std_avg*@act_sample_size-3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)*
								     @act_sample_size)
								ELSE 0
							END,
							@std_avg*@act_sample_size+3*SQRT(@std_avg*(1-@std_avg)*@act_sample_size),
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 18 -- u
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg,
							CASE WHEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size) > 0
								THEN @std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size)
								ELSE 0
							END,
							@std_avg+3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size),
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 19 -- c
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg*@act_sample_size,
							CASE WHEN (@std_avg*@act_sample_size)-3*SQRT(@std_avg*@act_sample_size) > 0
								THEN (@std_avg*@act_sample_size)-3*SQRT(@std_avg*@act_sample_size)
								ELSE 0
							END,
							(@std_avg*@act_sample_size)+3*SQRT(@std_avg*@act_sample_size),
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 20 -- DPMO
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id,
							@std_avg * 1000000/@num_defect_opp,
							CASE WHEN (@std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size))
								      *1000000/@num_defect_opp > 0
								THEN (@std_avg-3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size))
								     *1000000/@num_defect_opp
								ELSE 0
							END,
							(@std_avg+3*SQRT(@std_avg/@act_sample_size))
								*1000000/@num_defect_opp,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
				END -- of "IF @cl_source = 1"
				IF @cl_source = 2 BEGIN -- Use preset values
				    IF @default_chart = 2 -- Xbar + R
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_xbar, @lcl_xbar,
							@ucl_xbar, @cl_range, @lcl_range, @ucl_range,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 3 -- Xbar + S
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_xbar, @lcl_xbar,
							@ucl_xbar, @cl_sigma, @lcl_sigma, @ucl_sigma,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 5 -- IX + MR
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_ix, @lcl_ix,
							@ucl_ix, @cl_imr, @lcl_imr, @ucl_imr,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 7 -- MA + MR
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_ma, @lcl_ma,
							@ucl_ma, @cl_mr, @lcl_mr, @ucl_mr,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 8 -- MA + MS
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_ma, @lcl_ma,
							@ucl_ma, @cl_ms, @lcl_ms, @ucl_ms,
							@indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 16 -- p
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_p, @lcl_p, @ucl_p,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 17 -- np
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_np, @lcl_np, @ucl_np,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 18 -- u
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_u, @lcl_u, @ucl_u,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 19 -- c
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_c, @lcl_c, @ucl_c,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
					IF @default_chart = 20 -- DPMO
						INSERT INTO #SampleControlLimits VALUES (@sample_Id,
							@requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @cl_u*1000000/
							@num_defect_opp, @lcl_u*1000000/@num_defect_opp,
							@ucl_u*1000000/@num_defect_opp, NULL, NULL,
							NULL, @indx, @points_per_page, @act_sample_size)
				END -- of "IF @cl_source = 2"
				SELECT @indx = @indx + 1 -- Increment if new sample
			END -- of "IF (@default_chart > 4 AND @default_chart < 9) OR @value_no = 1"
		END -- of "IF @indx <= @points_per_page"
		-- Update info on last result, before next one fetched
		SELECT @temp_char_id = @char_Id
		SET @temp_sample_id = @sample_Id
		SET @temp_default_chart = @default_chart
		SET @temp_qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
		SET @tempReportBasis = @curReportBasis
		SET @temp_lsl = @lsl
		SET @temp_usl = @usl
		SET @temp_target = @target
		SET @temp_sigma_est = @sigma_est
		SET @temp_cl_source = @cl_source
		SET @temp_samples_before_cl = @samples_before_cl
		FETCH curRR INTO @sample_Id, @requested_time_utc, @char_Id, @qm_spec_id, @curReportBasis, @value_no,
			@result_value,
			@standard_dev, @mean, @range, @act_sample_size, @default_chart, @cl_source,
			@samples_for_cl, @samples_before_cl, @std_avg, @std_avg_is_target,
			@std_deviation, @target, @points_per_page, @lcl_xbar, @cl_xbar,
			@ucl_xbar, @lcl_range, @cl_range, @ucl_range, @lcl_sigma, @cl_sigma,
			@ucl_sigma, @lcl_ix, @cl_ix, @ucl_ix, @lcl_imr, @cl_imr, @ucl_imr,
			@lcl_ma, @cl_ma, @ucl_ma, @lcl_mr, @cl_mr, @ucl_mr, @lcl_ms, @cl_ms,
			@ucl_ms, @lcl_p, @cl_p, @ucl_p, @lcl_np, @cl_np, @ucl_np, @lcl_u,
			@cl_u, @ucl_u, @lcl_c, @cl_c, @ucl_c, @num_defect_opp, @mov_avg_span,
			@sigma_est, @rnum, @lsl, @usl, @rr_row_id
	END -- of "WHILE @@Fetch_Status = 0"
	CLOSE curRR
	DEALLOCATE curRR
		-- Adjust last characteristic's control limits if needed
		-- given final x_bar and est_std_dev if there were enough samples
	IF @temp_default_chart = 2 AND @temp_cl_source = 0 AND @num_samp >= @temp_samples_before_cl
		AND (@samp_used > 0 OR @temp_sigma_est = 1) BEGIN
		IF @temp_sigma_est = 0 SET @est_std_dev = @est_std_dev_sum/@samp_used
		IF @QMReportType = 'SPC' UPDATE #SampleControlLimits
			SET Primary_target = @x_bar,
			    Primary_lcl = @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
			    Primary_ucl = @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
			    Secondary_target = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
										ELSE @est_std_dev*d_2 END,
			    Secondary_lcl = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
			                         ELSE @est_std_dev*d1 END,
			    Secondary_ucl=  CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
			                         ELSE @est_std_dev*d2 END
			FROM #SampleControlLimits s  WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN factor f WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON s.act_sample_size = f.sample_size
			WHERE char_id = @temp_char_id AND s.char_id = char_id
		ELSE UPDATE @GroupedRawResults SET
			est_sigma = @est_std_dev
			,cp = cap_perf_stats.cp
			,cpk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
				    ELSE 0
				END
			,pp = cap_perf_stats.pp
			,ppk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
				    ELSE 0
				END
			FROM
			(SELECT CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @est_std_dev)
			             WHEN @est_std_dev <= 0 THEN 99999
			             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @est_std_dev) END AS cp
			      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_usl
			      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_lsl
			      , CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @population_sigma > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @population_sigma)
			             WHEN @population_sigma <= 0 THEN 99999
			             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @population_sigma) END AS pp
			      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_usl
			      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_lsl
			) cap_perf_stats
			WHERE ReportBasis = @curReportBasis AND Characteristic = (select char_name from characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) where char_id = @temp_char_Id)
			AND QMSpecName = (select qm_spec_name from qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) where qm_spec_id = @temp_qm_spec_id)

	END
	IF @temp_default_chart = 3 AND @temp_cl_source = 0 AND @num_samp >= @temp_samples_before_cl
		AND (@samp_used > 0 OR @temp_sigma_est = 1) BEGIN
		IF @temp_sigma_est = 0 SET @est_std_dev = @est_std_dev_sum/@samp_used
		IF @QMReportType = 'SPC' UPDATE #SampleControlLimits
			SET Primary_target = @x_bar,
			    Primary_lcl = @x_bar - @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
			    Primary_ucl = @x_bar + @est_std_dev*3/SQRT(s.act_sample_size),
			    Secondary_target = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
			                            ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4 END,
			    Secondary_lcl = CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
			                         ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4*b3 END,
			    Secondary_ucl=  CASE WHEN s.act_sample_size = 1 THEN NULL
			                         ELSE @est_std_dev*c_4*b4 END
			FROM #SampleControlLimits s WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN factor f WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON s.act_sample_size = f.sample_size
			WHERE char_id = @temp_char_id AND s.char_id = char_id
		ELSE UPDATE @GroupedRawResults SET
			est_sigma = @est_std_dev
			,cp = cap_perf_stats.cp
			,cpk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.cp THEN cap_perf_stats.cpk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.cp END
				    ELSE 0
				END
			,pp = cap_perf_stats.pp
			,ppk = CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_usl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NOT NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_usl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
				    WHEN (@temp_usl IS NULL AND @temp_lsl IS NOT NULL) THEN
					CASE WHEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl < cap_perf_stats.pp THEN cap_perf_stats.ppk_lsl ELSE cap_perf_stats.pp END
				    ELSE 0
				END
			FROM
			(SELECT CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @est_std_dev)
			             WHEN @est_std_dev <= 0 THEN 99999
			             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @est_std_dev) END AS cp
			      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_usl
			      , CASE WHEN @est_std_dev > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @est_std_dev) ELSE 99999 END AS cpk_lsl
			      , CASE WHEN (@temp_lsl IS NULL OR @temp_usl IS NULL) AND @population_sigma > 0 THEN (COALESCE(@temp_usl, @temp_target) - COALESCE(@temp_lsl, @temp_target))/(3 * @population_sigma)
			             WHEN @population_sigma <= 0 THEN 99999
			             ELSE (@temp_usl - @temp_lsl) / (6 * @population_sigma) END AS pp
			      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@temp_usl - @x_bar) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_usl
			      , CASE WHEN @population_sigma > 0 THEN (@x_bar - @temp_lsl) / (3 * @population_sigma) ELSE 99999 END AS ppk_lsl
			) cap_perf_stats
			WHERE ReportBasis = @curReportBasis AND Characteristic = (select char_name from characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) where char_id = @temp_char_Id)
			AND QMSpecName = (select qm_spec_name from qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) where qm_spec_id = @temp_qm_spec_id)
	END
--TEST
--SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM #SampleControlLimits
--INSERT INTO dbug VALUES ('Z','#SampleControlLimits count',NULL,@count)

	--TEST
	--select * from @MostRecentSamplePerChar order by char_id

	IF @QMReportType = 'SPC'
	BEGIN
		IF @SummaryData = 0
		-- return SPC chart data
		BEGIN
			--TEST
			--select * from #SampleControlLimits order by char_id, indx

			UPDATE @MostRecentSamplePerChar
					SET sample_interval = b.interval,
					max_sample_size = b.max_sample_size
			FROM
			@MostRecentSamplePerChar m INNER JOIN
			(SELECT char_id
			, CASE WHEN MAX(indx) > 1 THEN CONVERT(FLOAT, (DATEDIFF(SECOND, MIN(sample_time), MAX(sample_time)) + 60) / ((MAX(indx)-1) * 60) + 1)
				   WHEN MAX(indx) = 1 THEN 15
				END interval
			, MAX(act_sample_size) max_sample_size
			from #SampleControlLimits
			WHERE indx <= points_per_page
			GROUP BY char_id) b ON m.char_id = b.char_id

			SELECT a.sample_id,
				a.char_name,
				--a.char_id,
				--a.spec_name,
				--a.qm_spec_id AS spec_id,
				a.requested_time_local,
				CASE  WHEN a.act_sample_size = 0 AND (m.default_chart_id = 16 OR m.default_chart_id = 18 OR m.default_chart_id = 20) THEN 0
					  WHEN a.act_sample_size <> 0 AND (m.default_chart_id = 16 OR m.default_chart_id = 18 OR m.default_chart_id = 20) THEN CONVERT(FLOAT, a.result_value) / CONVERT(FLOAT, a.act_sample_size)
					 ELSE a.result_value
				END primary_chart_value,
				--s.primary_target As primary_target,
				CASE WHEN m.default_chart_id = 16 THEN s.primary_target * CONVERT(FLOAT, 100)

					 ELSE s.primary_target
				END primary_target,
				--s.primary_lcl AS primary_lcl,
				CASE WHEN m.default_chart_id = 16 THEN s.primary_lcl * CONVERT(FLOAT, 100)
					 ELSE s.primary_lcl
				END primary_lcl,
				--s.primary_ucl AS primary_ucl,
				CASE WHEN m.default_chart_id = 16 THEN s.primary_ucl * CONVERT(FLOAT, 100)
					 ELSE s.primary_ucl
				END primary_ucl,
				s.secondary_target As secondary_target,
				s.secondary_lcl AS secondary_lcl,
				s.secondary_ucl AS secondary_ucl,
				--a.ent_name,
				--a.sample_name,
				--a.item_id,
				--a.wo_id,
				--a.oper_id,
				--a.segment_requirement_id,
				--a.segment_response_id,
				--a.lot_no,
				--a.sublot_no,
				--a.sample_note,
				--a.cause_desc,
				a.act_sample_size AS sample_size,
				--sample_in_control = CASE WHEN EXISTS(select * from sample_char_rule_link WITH (NOLOCK) where sample_id = s.sample_id and char_id = s.char_id) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
				m.points_per_page,
				--m.default_chart_id,
				CASE m.default_chart_id WHEN 2 THEN '- XBar + Range'
										WHEN 3 THEN '- XBar + Sigma'
										WHEN 5 THEN '- IX + MR'
										WHEN 7 THEN '- MA + Range'
										WHEN 8 THEN '- MA + Sigma'
										WHEN 16 THEN '- p'
										WHEN 17 THEN '- np'
										WHEN 18 THEN '- u'
										WHEN 19 THEN '- c'
										WHEN 20 THEN '- DPMO'
										ELSE 'None'
				END default_chart_name,
				s.indx,
				m.sample_interval,
				CASE m.default_chart_id WHEN 2 THEN a.act_sample_size
										WHEN 3 THEN a.act_sample_size
										WHEN 7 THEN m.mov_avg_span
										WHEN 8 THEN m.mov_avg_span
										ELSE 1
				END chart_sample_size,
				m.max_sample_size
			FROM #RawResults a  WITH (NOLOCK)
			-- Need to join on indx because multiple plot points may have the same sample ID
			-- and thus there may be multiple #SampleControlLimits records per sample.
			-- Normally all will have the same targets and limits but in the case of grouped
			-- data plotted with a MA chart, the sample size of each won't be the same (at
			-- the beginning).  The LEFT OUTER JOIN between #RawResults and
			-- #SampleControlLimits is required because we want to show all qualifying
			-- results in the Characteristic Details Section even if there's more than can
			-- be plotted.
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #SampleControlLimits s  WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON a.indx = s.indx AND a.char_id = s.char_id
			INNER JOIN @MostRecentSamplePerChar m
				ON a.char_id = m.char_id
			WHERE s.indx IS NOT NULL
				  --AND s.primary_target IS NOT NULL
				  --AND s.primary_lcl IS NOT NULL
				  --AND s.primary_ucl IS NOT NULL

			ORDER BY a.char_id, a.requested_time_local, a.sample_id, a.value_no

		END -- of "IF @SummaryData = 0"

		IF @SummaryData = 1
		-- return SPC summary data
		BEGIN
			SELECT a.sample_id,
				a.char_name,
				a.char_id,
				a.spec_name,
				a.qm_spec_id AS spec_id,
				a.requested_time_local,
				a.result_value AS primary_chart_value,
				ROUND(s.primary_target, 10) As primary_target,
				ROUND(s.primary_lcl, 10) AS primary_lcl,
				ROUND(s.primary_ucl, 10) AS primary_ucl,
				ROUND(s.secondary_target, 10) As secondary_target,
				ROUND(s.secondary_lcl, 10) AS secondary_lcl,
				ROUND(s.secondary_ucl, 10) AS secondary_ucl,
				a.ent_name,
				a.sample_name,
				a.item_id,
				a.wo_id,
				a.oper_id,
				a.segment_requirement_id,
				a.segment_response_id,
				a.lot_no,
				a.sublot_no,
				SUBSTRING(ISNULL(a.sample_note, ''),1, 80) AS sample_note,
				a.cause_desc,
				a.act_sample_size AS sample_size,
				sample_in_control = CASE WHEN EXISTS(select * from sample_char_rule_link WITH (NOLOCK) where sample_id = s.sample_id and char_id = s.char_id) THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END,
				m.points_per_page,
				m.default_chart_id,
				CASE m.default_chart_id WHEN 2 THEN '- XBar + Range'
										WHEN 3 THEN '- XBar + Sigma'
										WHEN 5 THEN '- IX + MR'
										WHEN 7 THEN '- MA + Range'
										WHEN 8 THEN '- MA + Sigma'
										WHEN 16 THEN '- p'
										WHEN 17 THEN '- np'
										WHEN 18 THEN '- u'
										WHEN 19 THEN '- c'
										WHEN 20 THEN '- DPMO'
										ELSE 'None'
				END default_chart_name,
				s.indx,
				m.sample_interval,
				CASE m.default_chart_id WHEN 2 THEN a.act_sample_size
										WHEN 3 THEN a.act_sample_size
										WHEN 7 THEN m.mov_avg_span
										WHEN 8 THEN m.mov_avg_span
										ELSE 1
				END chart_sample_size,
				CASE WHEN s.indx IS NOT NULL THEN 1
					ELSE 0
				END IncludeInChart
			FROM #RawResults a  WITH (NOLOCK)
			-- Need to join on indx because multiple plot points may have the same sample ID
			-- and thus there may be multiple #SampleControlLimits records per sample.
			-- Normally all will have the same targets and limits but in the case of grouped
			-- data plotted with a MA chart, the sample size of each won't be the same (at
			-- the beginning).  The LEFT OUTER JOIN between #RawResults and
			-- #SampleControlLimits is required because we want to show all qualifying
			-- results in the Characteristic Details Section even if there's more than can
			-- be plotted.
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #SampleControlLimits s  WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON a.indx = s.indx AND a.char_id = s.char_id
			INNER JOIN @MostRecentSamplePerChar m
				ON a.char_id = m.char_id

			ORDER BY a.char_id, a.requested_time_local, a.sample_id, a.value_no
		END

		IF @SummaryData = 2
		-- retun character id/name that will be included in the set of charts
		BEGIN
			SELECT DISTINCT a.char_name,
				a.char_id
			FROM #RawResults a  WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #SampleControlLimits s  WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON a.indx = s.indx AND a.char_id = s.char_id
			INNER JOIN @MostRecentSamplePerChar m
				ON a.char_id = m.char_id
			WHERE s.indx IS NOT NULL

			ORDER BY a.char_id
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		select GRR.ReportBasis ,
		GRR.Characteristic ,
		GRR.QMSpecName ,
		GRR.SumOOS ,
		GRR.NumResults ,
		GRR.OutOfSpecPct ,
		GRR.OOCCount ,
		GRR.TotalSampleCount , GRR.OutOfControlPct ,
		GRR.mean_result_value ,
		GRR.min_result_value ,
		GRR.max_result_value ,
		GRR.std_dev ,
		GRR.est_sigma ,
		GRR.range ,
		CASE WHEN IsNULL(c.type,1) > 0 then NULL else grr.cp END as cp,
		CASE WHEN IsNULL(c.type,1) > 0 then NULL else grr.cpk END as cpk,
		CASE WHEN IsNULL(c.type,1) > 0 then NULL else grr.pp END as pp,
		CASE WHEN IsNULL(c.type,1) > 0 then NULL else GRR.ppk END as ppk,
		GRR.target ,
		GRR.lsl ,
		GRR.usl ,
		GRR.max_sample_time ,
		GRR.ver_id from @GroupedRawResults GRR
		LEFT join characteristic c on grr.Characteristic = c.char_name
		order by ReportBasis, characteristic, QMSpecName
	END
END -- of "IF @QMReportType = 'SPC' OR @SummaryData  = 1"

END

-- Name:  	sp_U_ofi_jobBo
-- Description: Update qty_reqd for splitted job_bom 
--
-- Usage:	Update qty_reqd for splitted job_bom

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB			2023-05-25			Initial version.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_jobBom]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(MAX),
	@oper_id nvarchar(MAX),
	@from_seq_no int,
	@to_seq_no int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
		declare @nw_qty_reqd nvarchar(50) 

	declare @temp1 table (qty float, seq_no int, bom_pos int)

	select @nw_qty_reqd=qty_reqd from job with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id  and seq_no=@to_seq_no
	   

	insert into @temp1
	select (@nw_qty_reqd*qty_per_parent_item)as qty,seq_no,bom_pos from job_bom with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id  and seq_no=@to_seq_no
	


	update jb 
	set jb.qty_reqd=(jb.qty_reqd-t1.qty)
	from job_bom  as jb with (nolock)
	inner join @temp1 t1 on jb.bom_pos=t1.bom_pos
	where jb.wo_id=@wo_id and jb.oper_id=@oper_id  and jb.seq_no=@from_seq_no

	UPDATE job_bom
SET qty_reqd = (
    SELECT (@nw_qty_reqd*qty_per_parent_item)as qty_req
    FROM job_bom AS t2 with (nolock)
    WHERE t2.seq_no = @from_seq_no
        AND t2.bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos
		and  wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id 
)
WHERE  wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id  and seq_no=@to_seq_no
END

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1600  Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = @last_edit_at
ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @ver_date)
SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @ver_date )

 IF @preferred_ver IS null SET @preferred_ver = 0

 INSERT INTO oper_spec_ver
 (process_id,
  oper_id,
  ver_id,
  ver_date,
  ver_comments,
  preferred_ver,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@process_id,
   @oper_id,
   @ver_id,
   @ver_date,
   @ver_comments,
   @preferred_ver,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Return timestamp
--SET @mod_id = (SELECT CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
FROM oper_spec_ver
WHERE (process_id = @process_id AND
oper_id = @oper_id AND
ver_id = @ver_id)
--Only one can be a preferred version
IF @preferred_ver = 1
BEGIN
	UPDATE oper_spec_ver
	SET preferred_ver = 0, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
             WHERE ver_id <> @ver_id AND 	process_id = @process_id AND  oper_id = @oper_id
END

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - fn_CheckDecimalLimit
-- Description          -  Checks the supplied decimals after the decimal point.
--	                 The function returns zero if supplied decimal lenght is less than precision scale else returns one.
--
-- Author               - Mohammed Asgar Ali
--
-- Date Created      - 06/11/2015
-- Version              - 5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 12/29/2014	Mohammed Asgar 4.5 P01	CR L00135116: Add function to check decimal limit.
-- 06/11/2015            	 Neeraja                 5.2              CR L00135851:Added function to check decimal limit.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_CheckDecimalLimit]
(
	@real_number DECIMAL(38, 10)
	,@precision_scale  INT32
) returns INT AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @fractionalPart NVARCHAR(100)
       , @strRealNumber NVARCHAR(100)
       , @index INT32
       , @length INT32

-- Extracts the decimal value after the decimal point and reverse the string
SET @strRealNumber = CAST(@real_number AS NVARCHAR(100))
SET @fractionalPart = SUBSTRING(@strRealNumber,CHARINDEX('.',@strRealNumber,1)+1,LEN(@strRealNumber))
SET @fractionalPart = REVERSE(@fractionalPart)

SET @index=1
SET @length=0

-- Finds the number of zeros in the reverse string
WHILE @index <=LEN(@fractionalPart)
BEGIN
      IF SUBSTRING(@fractionalPart,@index,1)!='0'
		BREAK
      IF SUBSTRING(@fractionalPart,@index,1)='0'
      BEGIN
		SET @length=@length+1
      END

	  SET @index=@index+1
END
-- Remove the zeros from the the string and finds the lenght of the decimal string.
SET @length = LEN(@fractionalPart)-@length
If @length = 0 OR @length > @precision_scale BEGIN
	RETURN  1
END
RETURN  0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_cb_process_parameter_bck20251023]
	@wo_id nvarchar(40),
	@oper_id nvarchar(40),
	@seq_no INT
AS
BEGIN
	declare @curr_correction_step int = 0, @base_dose_param float, @correction_step int

	if exists(select 1
			 from ofi_cb_approved_correction(nolock)
			 where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no)
	BEGIN
		
		set @curr_correction_step = (select max(correction_step) + 1
			 from ofi_cb_approved_correction(nolock)
			 where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		set @curr_correction_step =@curr_correction_step + 1
	
	END

	select	@base_dose_param = act_spec_value from job_spec(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and spec_id='CB_Batch weight'
	
	select @correction_step=act_spec_value from job_spec(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and spec_id='CB_Number of corrections'

	---return---
	select @base_dose_param as base_dose_param,
	@curr_correction_step as curr_correction_step,
	@correction_step as correction_step

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Sample_ReadRecentByName]
( @entity_name NVARCHAR(80)
 ,@site_name STRING80 = NULL
 ,@no_of_samples int = 20
 ,@ent_name_list	NVARCHAR(MAX)
 ,@time_zone_bias_value int =0
) AS
/*
Example XML for the ent_name list
<ent_names>
	<ent ent_name="Mixing" no_of_samples="40"/>
	<ent ent_name="Filler1" no_of_samples="20"  />
	<ent ent_name="Filler2" no_of_samples="30" />
	<ent ent_name="StorageEnt" no_of_samples="50" />
	<ent ent_name="Brewer" no_of_samples="60" />
</ent_names>
*/

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Sample_ReadRecentByName
-- Description       - ReadRecentSamples By Name Refer to section 4.2.4 of the SRO DFS.
--
-- Author            - Johnny Agsalog
-- Date Created      - 6/15/2011
-- Version           -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By Ver   Changes
-- 06/15/2012	  Ibrahim			Added columns qscl.lsl and qscl.usl to the select statement.
-- 08/10/2012	  RaghuG			L00121924: Performance Improvements
-- 31/12/2012	  Ibrahim			Added fields from the stats table to the select statement.
-- 04/18/2014	  Ibrahim	 5.0	UserStory: 195827 - As Joe, I want to be notified of Control Rule Violations through the SRO even when I enter results manually in the Sample Viewer
-- 08/15/2014	RaghuG		5.0	UserStory: 384708 - L00132703:  Performance issues observed with the SP SP_SA_SAMPLE_READRECENTBYNAME
-- 02/03/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 754651 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00143704 (HF CR L00143488: SR 19912585 An issue with the SRO object not connecting after a switchover of AOS.)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN
   SET NOCOUNT ON
   DECLARE @ent_id INT
	,@doc_handle  INT

DECLARE @samples	TABLE (sample_id INT PRIMARY KEY, ent_id INT)

   SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
   SET @no_of_samples = ISNULL( @no_of_samples, 20 )

   IF (@entity_name IS NOT NULL OR (@entity_name IS NULL AND @ent_name_list IS NULL)) BEGIN
	   -- Get the ent_id for the ent
	   SET @ent_id=dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@entity_name,@site_name);

	   EXEC sp_SA_Sample_ReadRecentSamples @ent_id,@no_of_samples, @time_zone_bias_value

	   RETURN
   END

   EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @ent_name_list

		DECLARE recent_samples_for_ent CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
		SELECT e.ent_id
		FROM  OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/ent_names/ent',2)
	         WITH  (ent_name nvarchar(80)   '@ent_name'
			) ent_list
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_name = ent_list.ent_name

	OPEN recent_samples_for_ent
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM recent_samples_for_ent INTO @ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @samples WHERE ent_id = @ent_id)
					CONTINUE

		INSERT INTO @samples (sample_id, ent_id)
		SELECT TOP 20 s.sample_id, ent_id
		FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE s.ent_id=@ent_id
		ORDER BY s.requested_time_utc DESC
	END
	CLOSE recent_samples_for_ent
	DEALLOCATE recent_samples_for_ent

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

   SELECT sample.ent_id
      ,e.ent_name
      ,sample.sample_id
      ,sample.sample_name
      ,dbo.fn_GetCharList(sample.sample_id) AS char_list
      ,sample.wo_id
      ,sample.oper_id
      ,sample.seq_no
      ,sample.item_id
      ,sample.requested_time_local
      ,sample.requested_time_utc
      ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value , sample.requested_time_utc) requested_time
      ,sample.expiry_time_local
      ,sample.expiry_time_utc
      ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, sample.expiry_time_utc) expiry_time
      ,warning_time_local
      ,warning_time_utc
      ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, sample.warning_time_utc) warning_time
      ,CASE sample_status
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Ready'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Ready Warning'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'Missed'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'In Progress'
           WHEN 5 THEN 'Late'
           WHEN 6 THEN 'Complete'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'Complete Late'
           WHEN 8 THEN 'Cancelled'
       END sample_status
      ,sample.sample_status sample_status_id
      ,CASE sample.sample_result
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Pending'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Good'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'OOC'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'OOS'
           WHEN 5 THEN 'OOC Key'
           WHEN 6 THEN 'OOS Key'
           WHEN 7 THEN 'OOC Critical'
           WHEN 8 THEN 'OOS Critical'
       END sample_result
      ,sample.sample_result sample_result_id
      ,sample.freq_id
      ,sample_freq.freq_name
      ,sample_freq.freq_type AS freq_type_id
      ,CASE sample_freq.freq_type
		WHEN 0 THEN 'Shift'
		WHEN 1 THEN 'Calendar Time'
		WHEN 2 THEN 'Run Time'
		WHEN 3 THEN 'Production'
		WHEN 4 THEN 'Main item produced changes (job_bom.current_subst for bom_pos = 0)'
		WHEN 5 THEN 'Item consumed at any BOM position changes'
		WHEN 6 THEN 'The lot number of the main item'
		WHEN 7 THEN 'The lot number of an item consumed at any BOM position changes'
		WHEN 8 THEN 'A job starts'
		WHEN 9 THEN 'Utilization changes from runtime to downtime'
		WHEN 10 THEN 'Utilization changes from runtime to idle time'
		WHEN 11 THEN 'Utilization changes from downtime to runtime'
		WHEN 12 THEN 'Utilization changes from downtime to idle time'
		WHEN 13 THEN 'Utilization changes from idle time to runtime'
		WHEN 14 THEN 'Utilization changes from idle time to downtime'
		WHEN 15 THEN 'Inventory is received'
      WHEN 16 THEN 'A new specification value is downloaded for the job running on a job position'
		WHEN 17 THEN 'A step with action type:6 starts'
		WHEN 18 THEN 'A step with action type:6 finishes'
		WHEN 19 THEN 'Manual'
		WHEN 20 THEN 'A job ends'
	END AS freq_type
	,sample.priority
      ,sample.verified_by
      ,sample.spare1
      ,sample.spare2
      ,sample.spare3
      ,sample.spare4
      ,charc.char_id
      ,charc.char_name
      ,qm_spec.qm_spec_name
      ,qm_spec.start_eff_local
      ,qm_spec.start_eff_utc
      ,DATEADD(mi,@time_zone_bias_value, qm_spec.start_eff_utc) start_eff_time
      ,uom.description  uom_desc
      ,COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, charc.minimum_sample_size)  minimum_sample_size
      ,COALESCE(qscl.normal_sample_size, charc.normal_sample_size ) normal_sample_size
      ,COALESCE(qscl.maximum_sample_size, charc.maximum_sample_size) maximum_sample_size
      ,CASE COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, charc.severity_cd)
           WHEN 0 THEN 'Unused'
           WHEN 1 THEN 'Not Monitored'
           WHEN 2 THEN 'Non-Key'
           WHEN 3 THEN 'Key'
           WHEN 4 THEN 'Critical'
          END Severity
      ,COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, charc.severity_cd) severity_cd
      ,CASE COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, charc.default_chart)
          WHEN 2 THEN 'Xbar + Range'
          WHEN 3 THEN 'Xbar + Sigma'
          WHEN 5 THEN 'IX + MR'
          WHEN 7 THEN 'MA + Range'
          WHEN 8 THEN 'MA + Sigma'
          WHEN 16 THEN 'p'
          WHEN 17 THEN 'np'
          WHEN 18 THEN 'u'
          WHEN 19 THEN 'c'
          WHEN 20 THEN 'DPMO'
         END  default_chart
        ,COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, charc.default_chart)                    default_chart_cd
   ,COALESCE(CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN NULL ELSE qscl.automated_coll END, CASE charc.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) automated_coll
   ,CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN charc.time_interval ELSE COALESCE(qscl.time_interval, charc.time_interval) END AS time_interval
   ,CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN charc.time_int_unit ELSE COALESCE(qscl.time_int_unit, charc.time_int_unit) END AS time_int_unit
	,scl.act_sample_size
        ,CASE
         WHEN qscl.lrv_is_mult=1 AND qscl.lsl IS NOT NULL
         THEN
             qscl.target -(qscl.target-qscl.lsl)*qscl.lrv
         ELSE
             qscl.lrv
         END LRL
      ,CASE
         WHEN qscl.urv_is_mult=1 AND qscl.usl IS NOT NULL
         THEN
             qscl.target +(qscl.usl-qscl.target)*qscl.urv
         ELSE
            qscl.urv
         END URL
	  ,qscl.lsl
	  ,qscl.usl
	  ,st.act_percent_out_of_sl
	  ,st.cp
	  ,st.cpk
	  ,st.mean_result_value
	  ,st.pp
	  ,st.ppk
	  ,st.range
	  ,st.rbar
	  ,st.num_results
	  ,st.std_dev
	  ,st.est_sigma
      ,st.total
	  ,st.min_result_value
	  ,st.max_result_value
	  ,dbo.FN_GETCONTROLRULEMSG(scl.sample_id, scl.char_id, scl.qm_spec_id) AS rule_violations
      FROM
        @samples recent_samples
       INNER JOIN sample WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.sample_id = recent_samples.sample_id
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.ent_id = e.ent_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN  sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.freq_id=sample_freq.freq_id
       INNER JOIN  sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK) ON sample.sample_id=scl.sample_id
       INNER JOIN characteristic charc WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id=charc.char_id
       INNER JOIN uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON charc.uom_id =uom.uom_id
       INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id=charc.char_id AND qscl.qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id
       INNER JOIN qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON  scl.qm_spec_id=qm_spec.qm_spec_id  AND qscl.qm_spec_id=qm_spec.qm_spec_id
	   LEFT OUTER JOIN stats st WITH (NOLOCK) ON st.char_id = qscl.char_id  AND st.ent_id = e.ent_id
      ORDER BY sample.ent_id
		 ,sample.requested_time_UTC DESC
         ,sample.sample_name ASC
         ,charc.char_name ASC

END

/*--===========================================================================================  
-- Name:  sp_S_ofi_checkReclassSu  
-- Description: SP checks if silo is in active state or not
--  
-- Usage:   In SU Overview screen 
-- ===========================================================================================  
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description  
-- 0.01.00 CK      2023-06-06			Initial version.  
-- =========================================================================================== */ 
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_checkReclassSu]( @ent_id INT	)   
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE	@countEnt INT =0
			,@result NVARCHAR(50)
			,@isPresent bit =0
			,@attr_id INT 
			,@attr_value NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
			,@isActiveSiloCnt INT=0	
			,@auto_reclassify_id INT = NULL
			,@is_auto_reclassify_val nvarchar(50)='false'

select @attr_id=a.attr_id 
	from attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_desc like 'AllowReclassify'

	select @attr_value=ea.attr_value
	from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
	where ea.attr_id=@attr_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id

	set @result= ISNULL(@attr_value,'true');

	select @auto_reclassify_id = a.attr_id
	from attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify'

	select  @is_auto_reclassify_val = ea.attr_value  from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
	where ea.attr_id=@auto_reclassify_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id	
	
	IF(@is_auto_reclassify_val ='true' )
	BEGIN
	set @result='false'
	END

		 
SELECT @countEnt  = count (1) from ofi_su_selection oss WITH(NOLOCK) where oss.active_su_ent_id=@ent_id
		  
IF (@countEnt>0 OR @result='false')

BEGIN
SET @isPresent=1;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
SET @isPresent=0;
END
SELECT @isPresent AS SUACTIVE
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_MarkTimeout]
-- Description: Used to insert PROD interface data into the buffer table
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE PROD object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01 JSC		2025-07-17			Update for JOB interface Mark also those unprocessed
-- 0.01.02	JSC		2025-08-13			Update to avoid timeouts on JOB interface
-- 0.01.03	JSC		2025-10-06			Update to prevent PAGE level locks on updates
-- 0.01.04	JSC		2026-07-02			Added recompile option
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_MarkTimeout]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'PROD',
	@NewStatus INT = 13, -- 13 means timeout error
	@rownumber_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- v1.01 ADDED
	DECLARE @MinStatus INT = 1
	DECLARE @MaxStatus INT = 1

	IF @InterfaceType = 'JOB_OUT'
	BEGIN
		SET @MinStatus = 0
	END

	DECLARE @CurDate DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
	DECLARE @MaxDate DATETIME = DATEADD(minute,-15,@CurDate)

	UPDATE oa WITH (ROWLOCK) -- MOD v1.03
    SET oa.[Comment] = 'Processing failed and timeout',
        oa.[Status] = @NewStatus,
        oa.[StatusTimestamp] = @CurDate
	FROM [dbo].[ofi_aut_interface_buffer] oa WITH (READPAST)
    WHERE oa.[ObjectName] = @ObjectName
			AND oa.[InterfaceType] = @InterfaceType
			AND oa.[Status] BETWEEN @MinStatus AND @MaxStatus  -- v1.01 MOD
			AND oa.[StatusTimestamp] < @MaxDate
			OPTION (RECOMPILE); -- MOD v1.04

	SET @rownumber_output = @@ROWCOUNT;
		
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_SA_Labor_Exec_GetAvLabCds]
(@ent_id       INT32
,@raw_reas_cd  STRING40)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	- sp_SA_Labor_Exec_GetAvailableLabCodes
-- Description       	- Get Available Labor Codes for the user from this entity
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Author 		- Raghu
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver    	Changes
--09/12/2002	Raghu		1.4	Use the current raw reas specified from I/O. If not get all Labor codes
--11/18/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Get the Raw reson code from cur_raw_reas_cd field (instead of getting from spare1)
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string id changes..
--04/10/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--07/16/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00080625: util/Util_Reas_Link.cls middleware code has several references to raw_reas_cd as an integer instead of string
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @can_capture_labor INT32
DECLARE @count     INT32

--Return error if the entity's can_store capability is not set
SELECT @can_capture_labor = can_capture_labor FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
IF (@can_capture_labor = 0) BEGIN
--   RAISERROR('This entity does not have the can_capture_labor capability set', 16, 1)
   RAISERROR('This entity does not have the %1 capability set.{4710},can_capture_labor', 16, 1)
   RETURN -1
END
--set default value
IF ((@raw_reas_cd IS NULL) OR (@raw_reas_cd = '') AND (@raw_reas_cd != 0)) SET @raw_reas_cd = -1
--IF @raw_reas_cd = -1 SELECT @raw_reas_cd = ISNULL(cur_raw_reas_cd,- 1) FROM util_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
--Modified by Raghu on 11/18/2002. Get the raw reason code from cur_raw_reas_cd field (instead of getting from spare1)
IF @raw_reas_cd = -1 SELECT @raw_reas_cd = ISNULL(cur_raw_reas_cd, -1) FROM labor_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
--Check if the entity exists otherwise return error
SELECT @count = count(*) FROM labor_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
IF @count = 0 BEGIN
   RAISERROR('Labor cannot be collected on this entity as it does not exist{3364}', 16, 1)
   RETURN -1
END
--The entity exists, hence get the available labcodes for the entity and reason code.
--Modified by Raghu. If labor_reasons are not defined for the entity, get all the labor reasons
/*IF EXISTS (
SELECT labor_cat.lab_cd
      ,labor_cat.lab_desc
      ,labor_cat.color
FROM  labor_reas_link labor_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
     ,labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE((labor_reas_link.lab_cd *= labor_cat.lab_cd) AND(labor_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id)
        AND(labor_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd))
)
SELECT DISTINCT labor_cat.lab_cd
      ,labor_cat.lab_desc
     ,labor_cat.color
FROM  labor_reas_link labor_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
     ,labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE((labor_reas_link.lab_cd *= labor_cat.lab_cd) AND(labor_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id)
        AND(labor_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd))*/
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_reas_link labor_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK) ON labor_cat.lab_cd = labor_reas_link.lab_cd
	WHERE labor_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd)
	SELECT DISTINCT labor_cat.lab_cd
		,labor_cat.lab_desc
		,labor_cat.color
	FROM labor_reas_link labor_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK) ON labor_cat.lab_cd = labor_reas_link.lab_cd
		WHERE labor_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id AND labor_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd
ELSE

	      ,labor_cat.lab_desc

	FROM  labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK)
