	 	@wo_id NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
   ,@oper_id NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
   ,@seq_no INT=0
AS
BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare	 @jobDetailsAttrId INT
			,@typeofContentId INT
			,@isOverlayDataPresnt INT=0
			,@isTypeOfContentPresent INT=0
			,@jobGrpId INT=5 -- 5 job_attr group 
			,@mod_id_jobDetails NVARCHAR(50)
			,@mod_id_contentType NVARCHAR(50)
			,@mod_id_jobDetails_cnt INT
			,@mod_id_contentType_cnt INT
			,@mod_id_out NVARCHAR(50)

    -- get job_label_details attr Id
	SELECT @jobDetailsAttrId=a.attr_id 
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId

	SELECT @typeofContentId=a.attr_id
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId
	    
	SELECT @jobDetailsAttrId as jobDetailsAttrId ,@typeofContentId as contentTypeAttrId

	SELECT @mod_id_jobDetails_cnt = COUNT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id))))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@jobDetailsAttrId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	IF(@mod_id_jobDetails_cnt > 0)

	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@jobDetailsAttrId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

							   ,@oper_id = @oper_id 
							   ,@seq_no = @seq_no
							   ,@attr_id = @jobDetailsAttrId
							   ,@attr_value = NULL
							   ,@notes = NULL
							   ,@last_edit_comment = NULL
							   ,@mod_id = @mod_id_jobDetails
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Attr]	@wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@seq_no=@seq_no,@attr_id=@jobDetailsAttrId,@attr_value=NULL,@notes=NULL,@last_edit_comment=NULL,@mod_id=@mod_id_jobDetails OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT @mod_id_contentType_cnt = COUNT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id))))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@typeofContentId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	IF(@mod_id_contentType_cnt > 0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @mod_id_contentType = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id)))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@typeofContentId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Attr]	@wo_id = @wo_id 
							   ,@oper_id = @oper_id 
							   ,@seq_no = @seq_no
							   ,@attr_id = @typeofContentId
							   ,@attr_value = 2
							   ,@notes = NULL
							   ,@last_edit_comment = NULL
							   ,@mod_id = @mod_id_contentType
	END
END

-- Description:	This SP is used to insert the resource group to entity mapping

 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_i_mdm_sched_addres_grp_ent] (@res_grp_desc NVARCHAR(50),
                                                @loc_desc     NVARCHAR(50),
                                                @ent_name     NVARCHAR(50),@res_grp_id  NVARCHAR(50) = null)
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @res_grp_id_new NVARCHAR(50)
      DECLARE @loc_id NVARCHAR(50)
      DECLARE @ent_id INT
      DECLARE @user_name NVARCHAR(50) = 'Autogen'
      DECLARE @row_id NVARCHAR(50) = 10010101
      DECLARE @deleteFlag BIT = 0

     

      SELECT @loc_id = loc_id
      FROM   sdb.sch.loc
      WHERE  loc_desc = @loc_desc

      IF ( @loc_id IS NULL )
        BEGIN
            EXECUTE [dbo].[Sp_s_mdm_sched_cud_loc]
              @loc_id = @loc_id,
              @loc_desc = @loc_desc,
              @user_name = @user_name,
              @row_id = @row_id,
              @deleteFlag = @deleteFlag

            SELECT @loc_id = loc_id
            FROM   sdb.sch.loc
            WHERE  loc_desc = @loc_desc
        END
	
      SELECT @res_grp_id_new = res_grp_id
      FROM   sdb.sch.res_grp
      WHERE  res_grp_desc = @res_grp_desc
	  
      IF( @res_grp_id_new IS NULL )
        BEGIN
			declare @isAvailable_res_grp_id nvarchar(50);
			select @isAvailable_res_grp_id = res_grp_id
			  FROM   sdb.sch.res_grp
			  WHERE  res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
			if @isAvailable_res_grp_id is not null
			begin
				SET @res_grp_id = null;
			end

            EXECUTE [dbo].[Sp_s_mdm_sched_cud_res_grp]
              @res_grp_id = @res_grp_id,
              @res_grp_desc = @res_grp_desc,
              @loc_id = @loc_id,
              @user_name = @user_name,
              @row_id = @row_id,
              @deleteFlag = @deleteFlag

            SELECT @res_grp_id = res_grp_id
            FROM   sdb.sch.res_grp
            WHERE  res_grp_desc = @res_grp_desc
        END
		else
		begin
			SET @res_grp_id = @res_grp_id_new;
		end


      SELECT @ent_id = ent_id
      FROM   ent
      WHERE  ent_name = @ent_name

	  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent WHERE res_grp_id = @res_grp_id and ent_id = @ent_id) 
      BEGIN

	  EXECUTE [dbo].[Sp_s_mdm_sched_cud_res_grp_ent]
        @res_grp_id = @res_grp_id,
        @ent_id = @ent_id,
        @user_name = @user_name,
        @row_id = @row_id,
        @deleteFlag = @deleteFlag

	  END

	  -- Also Insert the Child Entities for the parent segment
	  DECLARE @ChildEntities table (child_ent_id int, ent_id int)
	  insert into @ChildEntities 
	  select ent_id,parent_ent_id from ent where parent_ent_id = @ent_id
	  DECLARE @CntEnt int
	  select @CntEnt = count(ent_id) from @ChildEntities
	  declare @childEnt int

	  while( @CntEnt > 0)
	  BEGIN
		select  top 1 @childEnt = child_ent_id from @ChildEntities
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent WHERE res_grp_id = @res_grp_id and ent_id = @childEnt) 
				  BEGIN

				  EXECUTE [dbo].[Sp_s_mdm_sched_cud_res_grp_ent]
					@res_grp_id = @res_grp_id,
					@ent_id = @childEnt,
					@user_name = @user_name,
					@row_id = @row_id,
					@deleteFlag = @deleteFlag

				  END
		delete from @ChildEntities where child_ent_id = @childEnt;
		select @CntEnt = count(ent_id) from @ChildEntities	
	  END
	  
  END  

  
  /*
   SELECT ent_name,description,ent_id FROM ENT
   SELECT loc_desc,loc_id FROM SDB.SCH.loc
   SELECT res_grp_desc, res_grp_id, loc_desc,loc.loc_id  FROM SDB.SCH.res_grp rg
   INNER JOIN SDB.SCH.loc loc on loc.loc_id = rg.loc_id
   SELECT rg.res_grp_desc, rg.res_grp_id, e.ent_name, e.description,e.ent_id FROM SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent rge
   INNER JOIN ent e on e.ent_id = rge.ent_id
   INNER JOIN SDB.SCH.res_grp rg on rg.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id 
 */

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [vw_ofi_wip_composition]
-- Description: This is used to summarize the composition of the WIP production against 
--				its consumption for reporting (SnowFlake)
--
--
--
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC      2024-08-14   		Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_ofi_wip_composition] AS

SELECT DISTINCT
   iprod.row_id
  ,iprod.item_id
  ,i.item_desc
  ,ia.attr_value AS 'prod_item_group'
  ,iprod.lot_no
  ,iprod.sublot_no
  ,iprod.qty_prod
  ,iprod.qty_prod_erp
  ,i.uom_id
  ,u.abbreviation AS 'uom_abbreviation'
  ,u.description  AS 'uom_description'
  ,iprod.spare3
  ,CASE
        WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END 													AS 'is_wip'
  ,iprod.created_at_local
  ,iprod.wo_id
  ,iprod.oper_id
  ,iprod.seq_no
  ,ic_rm.row_id                                            	AS 'rm_row_id'
  ,ic_rm.item_id                                           	AS 'rm_item_id'
  ,ia2.attr_value                                          	AS 'rm_item_group'
  ,ic_rm.lot_no                                            	AS 'rm_lot_no'
  ,ic_rm.sublot_no                                         	AS 'rm_sublot_no'
  ,ic_rm.fg_lot_no                                         	AS 'rm_fg_lot_no'
  ,ic_rm.fg_sublot_no                                      	AS 'rm_fg_sublot_no'
  ,ic_rm.qty_cons                                          	AS 'rm_qty_cons'
  ,SUM(ic_rm.qty_cons) OVER(PARTITION BY iprod.row_id)     	AS 'rm_qty_cons_totals'
  ,ic_rm.qty_cons_erp                                     	AS 'rm_qty_cons_erp'
  ,SUM(ic_rm.qty_cons_erp) OVER(PARTITION BY iprod.row_id) 	AS 'rm_qty_cons_totals_erp'
  ,ic_rm.wo_id                                             	AS 'rm_wo_id'
  ,CASE
        WHEN i2.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END 													AS 'rm_is_wip'
FROM dbo.item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.item_id = i.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_cons ic_rm WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.lot_no = ic_rm.fg_lot_no
													AND iprod.sublot_no = ic_rm.fg_sublot_no
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item i2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic_rm.item_id = i2.item_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.uom AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_attr AS ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.item_id
													AND ia.attr_id = ( 	SELECT TOP 1 attr_id
																		FROM dbo.attr WITH (NOLOCK)
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
																			AND attr_grp = 1
																	)
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.item_attr AS ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i2.item_id = ia2.item_id 
													AND ia2.attr_id = ( SELECT TOP 1 attr_id
																		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
																		WHERE attr_desc    = 'ItemGroup'
																			AND attr_grp = 1
																	)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_IC_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@item_class_id		STRING80
,@user_id		STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_IC_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for this item_class_attributes.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/24/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.23
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--10/31/2005	Raghu		2.1.31/3.1.0	HD# 6624, Attributes are sorted by attr_desc.
--11/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Entry_type column is included.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp, attr.entry_type
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 4 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM item_class_attr WHERE item_class_id = @item_class_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 4 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM item_class_attr WHERE item_class_id = @item_class_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

--09/10/2002	Raghu		1.4	If disallow delete is set to true then set obsolete to True

--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language ID changes
--04/19/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 8051, Error deleting an Item

--04/07/2016	Malleswara Rao 5.03 User Story: 615398 -As Bruce, I want the MES database to have proper foreign keys so that I do not accidentally delete data - Part 2
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @disallow_item_delete	INT
	,@wo_id			STRING80
	,@oper_id		STRING80
	,@seq_no		INT32
	,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(2000)

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM  job WHERE item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('There is an existing work order for this item, so this item cannot be deleted.{4714}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @disallow_item_delete = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 192

	IF @disallow_item_delete = 1
		UPDATE item SET obsolete = 1 WHERE (item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
	ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE FROM job_bom_subst WHERE item_id = @item_id
		DELETE FROM bom_item_subst WHERE item_id = @item_id
		DELETE FROM item_subst WHERE item_id = @item_id
		DELETE item WHERE (item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
	END
END

-- Name:		fn_S_ofi_QM_getPreferredSamplePlan
-- Description: This function will select preferred sample plan for given item
-- Usage:		Sample creation
-- SELECT * FROM fn_S_ofi_QM_getPreferredSamplePlan ('500000041842',NULL,'1234',NULL,'')
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2024-03-12		Initial version.
--	0.01.01	Veervar Joshi		2024-04-15		Added datetime check for qm spec
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_QM_getPreferredSamplePlan] 
(	
    @item_id    NVARCHAR(80)
  , @frequency_id	INT=NULL
  , @customer_info  NVARCHAR(80)=null
  , @aut_deflevel  NVARCHAR(40)=null
  , @aut_defstage NVARCHAR(40)=null
  
  
)
RETURNS 
@Output TABLE
(
	item_id     NVARCHAR(40) 
  , pref_plan_id  INT
  , qm_spec_id	  INT
  , frequency_id INT
  , customer_info NVARCHAR(80) NULL
  , plevel      NVARCHAR(40) NULL
  , pstage      NVARCHAR(40) NULL

  
)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE		
		@pref_plan_id int,	
		@qm_spec_id int,
		@plevel NVARCHAR(40),
		@qmspec_id INT,
		@currentUTCDate DATETIME,
		@pstage NVARCHAR(40)		
		
		SET @currentUTCDate = GETUTCDATE();
	
	DECLARE @tblALLPlans AS TABLE (qm_spec_id INT, plan_id INT, frequency_id INT,plevel NVARCHAR(40), stage NVARCHAR(40),customer NVARCHAR(80))
	DECLARE @tblvalidPlans AS TABLE (qm_spec_id INT, plan_id INT,frequency_id INT, plevel NVARCHAR(40), stage NVARCHAR(40),customer NVARCHAR(80))
	
	--GET SAMPLE PLAN WITH MATCHING ITEM, LEVEL, STAGE
	;WITH cte_allPlans as (select qs.qm_spec_id, QS.plan_id,fcfreq.[1] AS customer,spf.freq_id, FLV.[1] as plevel,FLV.[2] as stage, qs.item_id from qm_spec  qs with (nolock) 
	INNER JOIN sample_plan sp with(nolock) on qs.plan_id=sp.plan_id
	INNER JOIN sample_plan_freq_link SPF with (nolock)  on spf.plan_id=qs.plan_id
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].[ufn_ofi_SplitStringAsTableColumns](ISNULL(sp.spare2,''),'|') FLV
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].[ufn_ofi_SplitStringAsTableColumns](ISNULL(sp.spare3,''),'|') as fcfreq
	where qs.item_id=@item_id 
	AND (@frequency_id IS NULL OR spf.freq_id=@frequency_id)
	AND (FLV.[1]=@aut_deflevel or @aut_deflevel is null OR @aut_deflevel ='') 
	AND (FLV.[2]=@aut_defstage OR @aut_defstage IS NULL OR @aut_defstage='') 
	AND (@currentUTCDate < qs.end_eff_utc OR qs.end_eff_utc IS NULL)  --	0.01.01
	
	)

	INSERT INTO @tblALLPlans SELECT qm_spec_id,plan_id,freq_id, plevel,stage,customer FROM cte_allPlans

	IF( @customer_info IS NOT NULL OR @customer_info <>'')-- IF CUSTOMER INFO PROVIDED
	BEGIN		
	
		INSERT INTO @tblvalidPlans
		SELECT qm_spec_id,plan_id,frequency_id, plevel,stage,customer FROM @tblALLPlans
		where customer=@customer_info	
	END 
	ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 qm_spec_id FROM @tblvalidPlans) AND ( @customer_info IS NOT NULL OR @customer_info <>'')-- IF NO CUSTOMER SPECIFIC PLAN FOUND
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO @tblvalidPlans
		SELECT qm_spec_id,plan_id,frequency_id, plevel,stage,customer FROM @tblALLPlans
		where customer IS NULL OR customer =''
			
	END 
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 qm_spec_id FROM @tblvalidPlans) -- SELECT ALL VALID PLANS
	BEGIN
	
		INSERT INTO @tblvalidPlans
		SELECT qm_spec_id,plan_id,frequency_id, plevel,stage,customer FROM @tblALLPlans
		where customer IS NULL OR customer =''
	END


	INSERT INTO @Output
	SELECT @item_id, plan_id,qm_spec_id,frequency_id,customer, plevel,stage FROM @tblvalidPlans
	RETURN 
END

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 02/14/2005		Raghu			2.1.13		HD# 5258, 5367 Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time
-- 09/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 02/01/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/02/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- 08/02/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 11/01/2007		AML				3.4.0		DB Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	/*
	DECLARE @v_sign_off TDATETIME, @v_time_zone_bias_value INT32_NULL

	SELECT 	@v_time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 ),
			@v_sign_off = DATEADD( mi, -@v_time_zone_bias_value, @sign_off )
	*/

	SELECT	cert_audit_log.wo_id
		,	cert_audit_log.oper_id
		,	cert_audit_log.seq_no
		,	cert_audit_log.step_no
		,	cert_audit_log.lot_no
		,	cert_audit_log.sublot_no
		,	cert_audit_log.prod_log_id
		,	cert_audit_log.cons_log_id
		,	cert_audit_log.grp_id

		,	cert_audit_log.process_status
		,	cert_audit_log.active
		,	cert_audit_log.cert_name
		,	cert_audit_log.user_id
		--,	DATEADD( mi, @v_time_zone_bias_value, cert_audit_log.sign_off ) AS sign_off
		,	cert_audit_log.sign_off_utc		-- Added 08/02/2007	AML
		,	cert_audit_log.sign_off_local	-- Added 08/02/2007	AML
		,	user_name.user_desc
		,	cert_audit_log.comments
		,	cert_audit_log.ref_row_id
		,	cert_audit_log.last_edit_comment
		,	cert_audit_log.last_edit_by
		,	cert_audit_log.last_edit_at
		,	cert_audit_log.row_id
	FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN user_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON cert_audit_log.user_id = user_name.user_id
	WHERE (
			(cert_audit_log.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND

			(cert_audit_log.prod_log_id = @prod_log_id OR @prod_log_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.cons_log_id = @cons_log_id OR @cons_log_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.process_id  = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.process_status  = @process_status OR @process_status IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.active = ABS(@active) OR @active IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL) AND
			--(cert_audit_log.sign_off = @v_sign_off OR @sign_off IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.sign_off_utc = @sign_off_utc OR @sign_off_utc IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.sign_off_local = @sign_off_local OR @sign_off_local IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.comments = @comments OR @comments IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.ref_row_id = @ref_row_id OR @ref_row_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_audit_log.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
		  )
	ORDER BY cert_audit_log.cert_name

END

--									   having Item's BOM configured must_consume_from_wip to true.
-- 05/24/2012	  Ravi Teja	   4.5    CR# L00120522(Clone of L00109966) - Modified the code to avoid conversion failure of item quantity
--									  while creating work order from process which uses multi level BOM item.
--10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6      spc_char_job is removed from the database
-- 04/04/2014   Srinivasa Tentu  5.0    L00130980 , Merging HF CR L00130409, Modified the condition to update correct item for job when non-preferred BOM version is selected.
-- 06/11/2015   Neeraja          5.2    CR L00135851 -An error occurs while updating the quantity of a work order. Modified the code to use Round function
-- 06/11/2015	Naren			5.0.1		-- Modified changes for the CR L00131526
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @V_Start_Qty           FLOAT,
  @V_Reqd_Qty            FLOAT,
  @V_Integer             INTEGER,   ---adding up fractions?
  @V_Integer1            INTEGER,   ---adding up fractions?
  @V_Oper_Id             STRING40,
  @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id   INT32,
  @V_Target_Sched_Ent_Id INT32,
  @V_Seq_No              INT32,
  @V_Count               TFLOAT,
  @V_Init_Prod_Perc      TFLOAT,
  @V_Input_Oper_Id       STRING40,
  @V_Input_Ent_Id        INT32,
  @V_Input_Perc          TFLOAT,
  @V_Input_Start_Qty     FLOAT,
  @V_Input_Reqd_Qty      FLOAT,
  @V_Input_Seq_No        INT32,
  @V_Out_Oper_Id         STRING40,
  @V_Out_Ent_Id          INT32,
  @V_Out_Seq_No          INT32,

  @V_Reqd_Remain         FLOAT,
  @V_Prev_Op             STRING40,

--  @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd       FLOAT,

  @V_Ver0                NVARCHAR(40),

  @V_Seq_Chk             CHAR(1),
  @V_Qty                 FLOAT,
  @V_Constant            BIT,
  @V_Constant_Qty        FLOAT,
  @V_Const_Qty           FLOAT,
  @dbg_resp				 INT32,

  @cast_qty				 DECIMAL(18,7),
  @sub_string_qty   	 VARCHAR(10)
BEGIN
  set @req_finish_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
  set @release_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
  set @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  --Check if it is a qty change execution
  IF @process_id IS NULL
  BEGIN
    SELECT @process_id=process_id, @req_finish_time=req_finish_time_local, @req_finish_time_tz=dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtcLocal(req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local) FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

	-- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_Alloc_Job_Qty', @src_key='post_wo_query', @date_val1 = @req_finish_time, @numeric_val1 = @req_finish_time_tz

    --sequence the operations and entities and store in add temporary table
    CREATE TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), ent_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER)
    SET @V_Seq = 0
    --Select all the operations and entities for the process and insert into temporary table
    DECLARE cur_ins_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT a.oper_id, a.seq_no FROM job a
      INNER JOIN ent b ON a.init_sched_ent_id = b.ent_id
        WHERE a.wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY a.oper_id, b.ent_name  -- Added a.oper_id to ORDER BY clause 1/24/03 SJ
    OPEN cur_ins_ops
    FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Seq = @V_Seq + 1
      INSERT INTO #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq(wo_id, oper_id, ent_id, seq_no) VALUES(@wo_id, @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq)
      FETCH cur_ins_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
    END
    CLOSE cur_ins_ops
    DEALLOCATE cur_ins_ops
    SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
    WHILE @V_Seq_Chk = 1
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Seq_Chk = 0
      DECLARE cur_seq_ops CURSOR DYNAMIC LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no DESC
      OPEN cur_seq_ops
      FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        --check if any of the feeding operations are ahead in the sequence
        DECLARE cur_feeding_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT input_oper_id, input_seq_no FROM job_route
          WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
        OPEN cur_feeding_ops
        FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          --get the feeding op's seq and compare
          SELECT @V_Feed_Seq = seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND ent_id = @V_Input_Ent_Id
          --if feeding op's seq lesser interchange the sequence nos
          IF @V_Feed_Seq > @V_Seq
          BEGIN
            UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @V_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND ent_id = @V_Input_Ent_Id
            UPDATE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq SET seq_no = @V_Feed_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
            SET @V_Seq = @V_Feed_Seq
            SET @V_Seq_Chk = 1
          END  --End of @V_Feed_Seq > @V_Seq
          FETCH cur_feeding_ops INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id
        END
        CLOSE cur_feeding_ops
        DEALLOCATE cur_feeding_ops
        FETCH cur_seq_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
      END
      CLOSE cur_seq_ops
      DEALLOCATE cur_seq_ops
    END  --End of @V_Seq_Chk = 1

    --Get the current start and required quantities
    SELECT @V_Input_Start_Qty = SUM(qty_at_start), @V_Input_Reqd_Qty = SUM(qty_reqd) FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1
    --If the old start qty is non zero
    IF @V_Input_Start_Qty > 0
    BEGIN
      --For every operation check if there are constant qty used for any of the items in their BOM
      DECLARE cur_oper_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq ORDER BY seq_no
      OPEN cur_oper_seq
      WHILE (1=1)
      BEGIN
        FETCH cur_oper_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
        IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
          BREAK
        SET @V_Constant_Qty = 0
        SET @V_Const_Qty = 0
        --Check if this item produced in this operation is a constant qty item in the subsequent operations
        DECLARE cur_const_bom CURSOR LOCAL FOR
          SELECT DISTINCT j1.item_id, jb.qty_per_parent_item FROM job j
            INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.item_id = jb.item_id
            INNER JOIN job j1 ON jb.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j1.seq_no
            INNER JOIN #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq tt ON jb.oper_id = tt.oper_id
              WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND jb.bom_pos > 0 AND jb.constant_qty = 1 AND tt.seq_no > @V_Seq
        OPEN cur_const_bom
        WHILE (1=1)
        BEGIN
          FETCH cur_const_bom INTO @V_Item0, @V_Const_Qty
          IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
            BREAK
          SET @V_Constant_Qty = @V_Constant_Qty + @V_Const_Qty
        END
        CLOSE cur_const_bom
        DEALLOCATE cur_const_bom

        --Update job quantities based on % increase or decrease
        UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = ((qty_at_start-@V_Constant_Qty)*@start_qty/@V_Input_Start_Qty)+@V_Constant_Qty
          WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Ent_Id
            AND EXISTS
              (SELECT 1 FROM job_bom jb WHERE jb.wo_id = job.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = job.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = job.seq_no
                 AND jb.bom_pos = 0 AND jb.constant_qty = 0)
      END
      CLOSE cur_oper_seq
      DEALLOCATE cur_oper_seq
    END
    ELSE IF @V_Input_Start_Qty = 0
    BEGIN
      --If the starting quantity has changed
      IF @V_Input_Start_Qty <> @start_qty
      BEGIN
        --make sure that you don't divide by zero
        SET @V_Input_Start_Qty = 1
        --Update job quantities based on job item per final item ratio
        UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = CASE WHEN qty_at_start=0 THEN 1 ELSE qty_at_start END *@start_qty/@V_Input_Start_Qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
          AND EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM job_bom jb WHERE jb.wo_id = job.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = job.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = job.seq_no
               AND jb.bom_pos = 0 AND jb.constant_qty = 0)
      END
    END
    --If the old start qty is non zero
    IF @V_Input_Reqd_Qty > 0
    BEGIN
      --For every operation check if there are constant qty used for any of the items in their BOM
      DECLARE cur_oper_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq ORDER BY seq_no
      OPEN cur_oper_seq
      WHILE (1=1)
      BEGIN
        FETCH cur_oper_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
        IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
          BREAK
        SET @V_Constant_Qty = 0
        SET @V_Const_Qty = 0
        --Check if this item produced in this operation is a constant qty item in the subsequent operations
        DECLARE cur_const_bom CURSOR LOCAL FOR
          SELECT DISTINCT j1.item_id, jb.qty_per_parent_item FROM job j
            INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.item_id = jb.item_id
            INNER JOIN job j1 ON jb.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j1.seq_no
            INNER JOIN #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq tt ON jb.oper_id = tt.oper_id
              WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND jb.bom_pos > 0 AND jb.constant_qty = 1 AND tt.seq_no > @V_Seq
        OPEN cur_const_bom
        WHILE (1=1)
        BEGIN
          FETCH cur_const_bom INTO @V_Item0, @V_Const_Qty
          IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
            BREAK
          SET @V_Constant_Qty = @V_Constant_Qty + @V_Const_Qty
        END
        CLOSE cur_const_bom
        DEALLOCATE cur_const_bom
        --Update job quantities based on % increase or decrease
        UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = ((qty_reqd-@V_Constant_Qty)*@req_qty/@V_Input_Reqd_Qty)+@V_Constant_Qty
          WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
            AND EXISTS
              (SELECT 1 FROM job_bom jb WHERE jb.wo_id = job.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = job.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = job.seq_no
                 AND jb.bom_pos = 0 AND jb.constant_qty = 0)
      END
      CLOSE cur_oper_seq
      DEALLOCATE cur_oper_seq
    END
    ELSE IF @V_Input_Reqd_Qty = 0
    BEGIN
      --If the new required qty has changed
      IF @V_Input_Reqd_Qty <> @req_qty
      BEGIN
        --make sure that you don't divide by zero
        SET @V_Input_Reqd_Qty = 1
        --Update job quantities based on % increase or decrease
        UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = CASE WHEN qty_reqd=0 THEN 1 ELSE qty_reqd END *@req_qty/@V_Input_Reqd_Qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
          AND EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM job_bom jb WHERE jb.wo_id = job.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = job.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = job.seq_no
               AND jb.bom_pos = 0 AND jb.constant_qty = 0)
      END
    END

    --Handle job quantity precisions
    DECLARE cur_job_qty CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id, i.num_decimals, j.qty_reqd, j.qty_at_start
      FROM job j INNER JOIN item i ON j.item_id = i.item_id
        WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND i.num_decimals > 0 AND ((FLOOR(j.qty_reqd) < j.qty_reqd) OR (FLOOR(j.qty_at_start) < j.qty_at_start))
    OPEN cur_job_qty
    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
      FETCH cur_job_qty INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Seq, @V_Parent_Item, @V_Integer1, @V_Reqd_Qty, @V_Start_Qty
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
        BREAK
      --Check if start or required qtys need to be rounded upto the next decimal digit
       IF dbo.fn_CheckDecimalLimit (@V_Start_Qty, @V_Integer1) > 0
        SET @V_Start_Qty = ROUND(@V_Start_Qty, @V_Integer1, 1)
      IF dbo.fn_CheckDecimalLimit (@V_Reqd_Qty, @V_Integer1) > 0
        SET @V_Reqd_Qty = ROUND(@V_Reqd_Qty, @V_Integer1, 1)

      --Update job with new qtys
      UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = @V_Start_Qty, qty_reqd = @V_Reqd_Qty
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq
    END
    CLOSE cur_job_qty
    DEALLOCATE cur_job_qty

    --Execute calculate times
    EXEC sp_Calculate_Times @wo_id, @process_id, @req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_tz
    RETURN
  END  --End of @process_id IS NULL

--SJ
  --Temporary table used to hold the entire BOM tree of the final item
  CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), parent_ver_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
  --Get the preferred version for the parent item
  SELECT @V_Pref_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
  INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, status) VALUES(@item_id, @V_Pref_Ver, @item_id, @V_Pref_Ver, 0)
  SET @V_Count = 0
  WHILE @V_Count = 0
  BEGIN
    --Handle infinite loops for items without BOM
    DECLARE cur_item0 CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, ver_id, item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0 AND ver_id IS NOT NULL
    OPEN cur_item0
    FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_PVer, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Count = 1
      UPDATE #tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item0 AND parent_ver_id = @V_PVer AND item_id = @V_Id0 AND ver_id = @V_Ver0
      --L00131526 Load the items based on item and operation link
       INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, status)
        SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.ver_id, a.item_id, b.ver_id, 0 FROM bom_item a
			INNER JOIN BOM_item_oper_link iter on iter.parent_item_id = a.item_id
			INNER JOIN bom_ver b ON a.item_id = b.parent_item_id
            WHERE a.parent_item_id = @V_Id0 AND a.ver_id = @V_Ver0 AND item_id <> @V_Id0
            and iter.bom_pos = 0 and iter.ver_id = b.ver_id and iter.process_id = @process_id
      FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_PVer, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
    END
    CLOSE cur_item0
    DEALLOCATE cur_item0
    IF @V_Count = 1
      SET @V_Count = 0
    ELSE
      SET @V_Count = 1
  END  --End of @V_Count = 0

  --Temporary table used to hold data of operations and items produced in them if different than the final item
  CREATE TABLE #tmp_oper_item(oper_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40))
  --update job with right quantities and item
  DECLARE cur_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id
  OPEN cur_ops
  FETCH cur_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --Reset the variables used
    SET @V_Reqd_Qty = 0
    SET @V_Count = 0
    SET @V_Input_Start_Qty = 0
    SET @V_Item = NULL
    --Get the preferred version for the parent item
    SELECT @V_Pref_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
    --Check if the item being produced in this op is the item being produced at the end
    SELECT TOP 1 @V_Item = parent_item_id FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
--
--SJ      AND (reqd_start_pct > 0 OR qty_per_parent_item > 0) AND parent_item_id <> @item_id AND bom_pos >= 0
--
      AND parent_item_id <> @item_id AND bom_pos = 0
      AND parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id and bom_pos = 0) --L00131526 Only items produced
    --Check if the item is in the tree
    SELECT @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND item_id = @V_Item
      AND item_ver_id IN (SELECT ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item ) AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND bom_pos >= 0  --L00131526 New column 'item_ver_id' has the appropriate version id
    --If not update job item id for this op
    IF @V_Item <> @item_id AND @V_Count > 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Count = 0
      --check in all the items being produced if this item is used and calculate the job quantity
     --L00131526 Get the items from list of items produced as populated in temp table and its version instead of preferred version
      DECLARE cur_item_parents CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.qty_per_parent_item FROM bom_item a join bom_ver b
        ON a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
        JOIN #tmp_bom_item0 t on t.item_id = a.parent_item_id and t.ver_id = a.ver_id
        WHERE a.item_id = @V_Item AND a.parent_item_id <> a.item_id
          AND a.parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id)
      OPEN cur_item_parents
      FETCH cur_item_parents INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Qty_Per_Parent
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        --Check if its a produced item in this process
--
--SJ        SELECT DISTINCT @V_Count = 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND (reqd_start_pct > 0 OR qty_per_parent_item > 0)
        SELECT DISTINCT @V_Count = 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id
--SJ          AND parent_item_id NOT IN (@item_id, @V_Item) AND parent_item_id = @V_Parent_Item AND bom_pos > 0
          AND parent_item_id NOT IN (@item_id, @V_Item) AND parent_item_id = @V_Parent_Item AND bom_pos = 0
--
          AND parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id)
        IF @V_Parent_Item = @item_id
          SET @V_Input_Start_Qty = @V_Qty_Per_Parent
        --if this is not the final item being produced
        IF @V_Parent_Item <> @item_id AND @V_Count = 1
        BEGIN
          SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Reqd_Qty + @V_Qty_Per_Parent
        END  --End of @V_Parent_Item <> @item_id AND @V_Count = 1
        FETCH cur_item_parents INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Qty_Per_Parent
      END
      CLOSE cur_item_parents
      DEALLOCATE cur_item_parents

      --update the item and the job quantities
      IF @V_Input_Start_Qty > 0
        SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Input_Start_Qty + @V_Reqd_Qty
      IF @V_Reqd_Qty > 0
        INSERT INTO #tmp_oper_item VALUES(@V_Oper_Id, @V_Item)
    END  --end of @V_Item <> @item_id

    FETCH cur_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id
  END
  CLOSE cur_ops
  DEALLOCATE cur_ops

  --Reset the variables used
  SET @V_Reqd_Qty = 0
  SET @V_Count = 0
  SET @V_Input_Start_Qty = 0
  SET @V_Item = NULL
------------------------------------------------------

  --Check if the required quantity is a whole number
  IF (SELECT num_decimals FROM item WHERE item_id = @item_id) > 0
    SET @V_Integer1 = 0
  ELSE
    SET @V_Integer1 = 1

  --Update the first and final operation quantities
  UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = @start_qty, qty_reqd = @req_qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND (first_job = 1 OR final_job = 1)

  --If more than one entity in first operations, use field oper_ent_link.init_prod_perc
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 1 GROUP BY wo_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
  BEGIN
    DECLARE cur_first_op_split CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, init_sched_ent_id, seq_no FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 1
    OPEN cur_first_op_split
    FETCH cur_first_op_split INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      --Get the percent for this entity
      SELECT @V_Init_Prod_Perc = ISNULL(init_prod_pct,0) FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
        AND ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id

      --Apply the percent to the quantities
      SET @V_Start_Qty = @start_qty * @V_Init_Prod_Perc
      SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @req_qty * @V_Init_Prod_Perc

      IF (SELECT i.num_decimals FROM #tmp_oper_item AS t INNER JOIN item AS i ON t.item_id = i.item_id WHERE t.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id) > 0
        SET @V_Integer = 0
      ELSE
        SET @V_Integer = @V_Integer1

      IF @V_Integer = 1
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Start_Qty = FLOOR(@V_Start_Qty)
        SET @V_Reqd_Qty = FLOOR(@V_Reqd_Qty)
      END

      UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = @V_Start_Qty, qty_reqd = @V_Reqd_Qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq
      FETCH cur_first_op_split INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
    END
    CLOSE cur_first_op_split
    DEALLOCATE cur_first_op_split
  END

  --Make sure that first operation has all the quantities
  IF @V_Integer = 1
  BEGIN
    DECLARE cur_first_op_all CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, @start_qty-SUM(ISNULL(qty_at_start, 0)), @req_qty-SUM(ISNULL(qty_reqd, 0)) FROM job
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 1 GROUP BY oper_id HAVING SUM(ISNULL(qty_at_start, 0))<@start_qty OR SUM(ISNULL(qty_reqd, 0))<@req_qty
    OPEN cur_first_op_all
    FETCH cur_first_op_all INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Start_Qty, @V_Reqd_Qty
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      DECLARE cur_first_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT seq_no FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id ORDER BY seq_no
      OPEN cur_first_ops
      FETCH cur_first_ops INTO @V_Seq_No
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        -- 99780 The following code does not take into account the possibility that init_prod_pct = 0
        -- 99780 It also assumes there is only one item that could have a remainder to be divided up among the first jobs that make it.
        IF @V_Start_Qty > 0 AND @V_Reqd_Qty > 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start+1, qty_reqd = qty_reqd+1
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
          SET @V_Start_Qty = @V_Start_Qty - 1
          SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Reqd_Qty - 1
        END
        ELSE IF @V_Start_Qty > 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start+1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
          SET @V_Start_Qty = @V_Start_Qty - 1
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
          UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = qty_reqd+1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
          SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Reqd_Qty - 1
        END

        --Exit if all the quantities are assigned
        IF @V_Start_Qty = 0 AND @V_Reqd_Qty = 0
          BREAK;
        FETCH cur_first_ops INTO @V_Seq_No
      END
      CLOSE cur_first_ops
      DEALLOCATE cur_first_ops

      FETCH cur_first_op_all INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Start_Qty, @V_Reqd_Qty
    END
    CLOSE cur_first_op_all
    DEALLOCATE cur_first_op_all
  END

  --Initialize quantities in the rest
  UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = 0, qty_reqd = 0 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 0

  --99780 Create temporary table to hold remainders by source job
  CREATE TABLE #tbl_Remainder (oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER, item_id NVARCHAR(40), start_remain FLOAT, reqd_remain FLOAT)

  DECLARE cur_temp_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no
  OPEN cur_temp_seq
  FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --Following section rewritten extensively for CR 99780
    --Select all the operations other than first that have material flowing into them (i.e. input_percent > 0)
    DECLARE cur_job_op CURSOR DYNAMIC LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_at_start
      FROM job j
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 0 AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND init_sched_ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
	  AND seq_no IN (SELECT seq_no FROM job_route where wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND input_percent > 0)
    OPEN cur_job_op
    FETCH cur_job_op INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Seq_No, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Target_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Reqd_Qty, @V_Start_Qty
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      --Get the input entity and the percent of input
      DECLARE cur_input_perc CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT input_oper_id, input_ent_id, input_percent FROM oper_ent_route
        WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
      OPEN cur_input_perc
      FETCH cur_input_perc INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id, @V_Input_Perc
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
		SET @V_Input_Seq_No = NULL
        SELECT @V_Input_Seq_No = seq_no FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND Init_Sched_Ent_Id = @V_Input_Ent_Id
		IF @V_Input_Seq_No IS NOT NULL  --this can be NULL due to Fix for CR L00099799/HF 1751
		BEGIN
			SELECT @V_Reqd_Qty = qty_reqd, @V_Start_Qty = qty_at_start FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id
			  AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No
			--Get the right quantities
			SET @V_Start_Qty = @V_Start_Qty * @V_Input_Perc
			SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Reqd_Qty * @V_Input_Perc

			IF (SELECT i.num_decimals FROM #tmp_oper_item AS t INNER JOIN item AS i ON t.item_id = i.item_id WHERE t.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id) > 0
			  SET @V_Integer = 0
			ELSE
			  SET @V_Integer = @V_Integer1

			--If the required quantity is a whole number, then apply the remainder logic
			IF @V_Integer = 1
			BEGIN
			  --Save remainder for the job from which it came
			  SET @V_Start_Remain = @V_Start_Qty - FLOOR(@V_Start_Qty)
			  SET @V_Reqd_Remain = @V_Reqd_Qty - FLOOR(@V_Reqd_Qty)
			  IF (@V_Start_Remain > 0 OR @V_Reqd_Remain > 0)
			  BEGIN
				--Get item made by feeding job
				SET @V_Item0 = NULL
				SELECT @V_Item = item_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No
				SELECT @V_Item0 = item_id FROM #tbl_Remainder WHERE oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No
				IF @V_Item0 IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
				  --Only save remainders that are for the same item as what's already there
				  IF(@V_Item = @V_Item0)
					UPDATE #tbl_Remainder SET start_remain = start_remain + @V_Start_Remain, reqd_remain = reqd_remain + @V_Reqd_Remain
					  WHERE oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No
				END
				ELSE
				  INSERT INTO #tbl_Remainder VALUES (@V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Seq_No, @V_Item, @V_Start_Remain, @V_Reqd_Remain)
			  END
			  SET @V_Start_Qty = FLOOR(@V_Start_Qty)
			  SET @V_Reqd_Qty = FLOOR(@V_Reqd_Qty)
			END  --End of @V_Integer = 1
			--Update job with these quantities, check if it has already reached quantities
			UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = qty_reqd+@V_Reqd_Qty, qty_at_start = qty_at_start+ISNULL(@V_Start_Qty, 0) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No AND qty_reqd+@V_Reqd_Qty <= @req_qty AND qty_at_start+ISNULL(@V_Start_Qty, 0) <= ISNULL(@start_qty, 0)
			-- 99780 If feeding job has remainders >= 1 move a unit to this job
			IF @V_Integer = 1
			BEGIN
			  SELECT @V_Start_Remain = start_remain, @V_Reqd_Remain = reqd_remain FROM #tbl_Remainder WHERE oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No

			  IF ISNULL(@V_Start_Remain, 0) >= 1
			  BEGIN
				UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start + 1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
				UPDATE #tbl_Remainder SET start_remain = start_remain - 1 WHERE oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No
			  END  --End of ISNULL(@V_Start_Remain, 0) >= 1

			  IF ISNULL(@V_Reqd_Remain, 0) >= 1
			  BEGIN
				UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = qty_reqd + 1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
				UPDATE #tbl_Remainder SET reqd_remain = reqd_remain - 1 WHERE oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Input_Seq_No
			  END  --End of ISNULL(@V_Reqd_Remain, 0) >= 1
			END  --End of @V_Integer = 1
		END
        FETCH cur_input_perc INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id, @V_Input_Perc
      END
      CLOSE cur_input_perc
      DEALLOCATE cur_input_perc
      FETCH cur_job_op INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Seq_No, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Target_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Reqd_Qty, @V_Start_Qty
    END
    CLOSE cur_job_op
    DEALLOCATE cur_job_op
    FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
  END
  CLOSE cur_temp_seq
  DEALLOCATE cur_temp_seq

  DROP TABLE #tbl_Remainder -- 99780

  --Make sure that there are no decimal digits
--  IF @V_Integer = 1
--  BEGIN
--    UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = FLOOR(qty_reqd), qty_at_start = FLOOR(qty_at_start) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
    UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = FLOOR(qty_reqd), qty_at_start = FLOOR(qty_at_start) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
      AND oper_id IN (SELECT t.oper_id FROM #tmp_oper_item AS t INNER JOIN item AS i ON t.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.num_decimals = 0)
    IF @V_Integer1 = 1
      UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = FLOOR(qty_reqd), qty_at_start = FLOOR(qty_at_start) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM #tmp_oper_item)
--  END

  --Now apply the reject rate starting from the last op and backwards
  DECLARE cur_temp_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, ent_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no DESC
  OPEN cur_temp_seq
  FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    SELECT @V_Rej_Rate = ISNULL(def_reject_rate, 0)/100 FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
    --Check if same operation exists above this level, if so skip
    SELECT @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no > @V_Seq
    --Get the reject qty to apply to the reqd qty based off the reject rate in the next operation
--    SELECT @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd = SUM(j.qty_reqd*ISNULL(o.def_reject_rate, 0)/100) FROM oper AS o
--      INNER JOIN oper_ent_route AS r ON o.process_id = r.process_id AND o.oper_id = r.oper_id
--      INNER JOIN job AS j ON r.oper_id = j.oper_id AND r.ent_id = j.init_sched_ent_id
--        WHERE o.process_id = @process_id AND r.input_oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND j.wo_id = @wo_id GROUP BY o.oper_id
--    SET @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd = ISNULL(@V_Rej_Rate_Reqd,0)

    --if reject rate present apply qty to all ops before this op
    IF @V_Count = 0 AND @V_Rej_Rate > 0
--    IF @V_Count = 0 AND (@V_Rej_Rate > 0 OR @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd > 0)
    BEGIN
      --Get the quantities for this op
      SELECT @V_Reqd_Qty = SUM(qty_reqd) FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
---      SELECT @V_Reqd_Qty = SUM(qty_reqd)+@V_Rej_Rate_Reqd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
      --Get the reject quantity
      SET @V_Rej_Rate = @V_Reqd_Qty * @V_Rej_Rate

      IF (SELECT i.num_decimals FROM #tmp_oper_item AS t INNER JOIN item AS i ON t.item_id = i.item_id WHERE t.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id) > 0
        SET @V_Integer = 0
      ELSE
        SET @V_Integer = @V_Integer1

      --If whole piece to be produced
      IF @V_Integer = 1
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Rej_Rate = CEILING(@V_Rej_Rate)
---        SET @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd = CEILING(@V_Rej_Rate_Reqd)
      END

      --Update quantities in this op
      UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start + @V_Rej_Rate, qty_reqd = qty_reqd + @V_Rej_Rate WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
--      UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start + @V_Rej_Rate, qty_reqd = qty_reqd + @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND init_sched_ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
      --Get all the unique operations and one entity in those operations lesser than the sequence
      DECLARE cur_upsream_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, MAX(ent_id) FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        AND seq_no < @V_Seq AND oper_id <> @V_Oper_Id GROUP BY oper_id
      OPEN cur_upsream_ops
      FETCH cur_upsream_ops INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
--        UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start + @V_Rej_Rate, qty_reqd = qty_reqd + @V_Rej_Rate_Reqd WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = qty_at_start + @V_Rej_Rate, qty_reqd = qty_reqd + @V_Rej_Rate WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
          AND oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND init_sched_ent_id = @V_Input_Ent_Id
        FETCH cur_upsream_ops INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Input_Ent_Id
      END
      CLOSE cur_upsream_ops
      DEALLOCATE cur_upsream_ops
    END  --End of @V_Count = 0 AND @V_Rej_Rate > 0
    FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Seq
  END
  CLOSE cur_temp_seq
  DEALLOCATE cur_temp_seq

  --Get the preferred version for the parent item
  SET @V_Pref_Ver = NULL
  SET @V_Start_Qty = 0
  SELECT @V_Pref_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
  --update job with right quantities and item
  --Check if the item being produced in this op is the item being produced at the end
  --Check if the item is in the tree
  DECLARE cur_ops CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT o.oper_id, t.item_id FROM oper o
    INNER JOIN #tmp_oper_item t ON o.oper_id = t.oper_id
      WHERE o.process_id = @process_id AND @V_Pref_Ver IS NOT NULL
  OPEN cur_ops
  FETCH cur_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Item
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --Reset the variables used
    SET @V_Start_Qty = 0
    SET @V_Reqd_Qty = 1
    SET @V_Count = 0
    SET @V_Input_Start_Qty = 0
    SET @V_Parent_Item = @V_Item

    --check in all the items being produced if this item is used and calculate the job quantity
    --L00131526 Get the items from list of items produced as populated in temp table and its version instead of preferred version
         DECLARE cur_item_parents CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.qty_per_parent_item,a.constant_qty FROM bom_item a join bom_ver b
        ON a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
        JOIN #tmp_bom_item0 t on t.item_id = a.parent_item_id and t.ver_id = a.ver_id
        WHERE a.item_id = @V_Item AND a.parent_item_id <> a.item_id
         AND a.parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id)
    OPEN cur_item_parents
    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
      FETCH cur_item_parents INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Count, @V_Constant
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
        BREAK

      SET @V_Reqd_Qty = 1
      IF @V_Constant = 1
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Parent_Item = @item_id
      END

      --work all the way upto the final item being produced and findout pieces required
      WHILE @V_Parent_Item <> @item_id
      BEGIN

        DECLARE cur_item_parent CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT b.parent_item_id, b.qty_per_parent_item, b.constant_qty FROM bom_item b
          INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM #tmp_bom_item0) t ON b.parent_item_id = t.parent_item_id AND b.ver_id = t.parent_ver_id AND b.item_id = t.item_id
          INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON v.parent_item_id = t.item_id AND v.ver_id = t.ver_id
          INNER JOIN bom_ver v1 ON v1.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND v1.ver_id = b.ver_id
            WHERE t.item_id = @V_Parent_Item AND b.bom_pos > 0 --L00131526 Temp table has the correct version, so need to take based on preferred version
        OPEN cur_item_parent
        SET @V_Parent_Item = NULL
        WHILE (1=1)
        BEGIN
          FETCH cur_item_parent INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Qty_Per_Parent, @V_Constant
          IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
            BREAK
          SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Reqd_Qty * @V_Qty_Per_Parent
          --If its constant qty
          IF @V_Constant = 1
          BEGIN
            --Get out of the loop
            SET @V_Parent_Item = @item_id
            BREAK
          END
        END
        CLOSE cur_item_parent
        DEALLOCATE cur_item_parent
      END  --End of @V_Parent_Item <> @item_id

      IF @V_Constant = 1
      BEGIN
        --Calculate in terms of final item
        SET @V_Start_Qty = @V_Start_Qty + @V_Reqd_Qty * @V_Count/@req_qty
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Start_Qty = @V_Start_Qty + @V_Reqd_Qty * @V_Count
      END
    END
    CLOSE cur_item_parents
    DEALLOCATE cur_item_parents
    SET @V_Reqd_Qty = @V_Start_Qty

    IF @V_Reqd_Qty > 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE job SET item_id = @V_Item, qty_at_start = qty_at_start * @V_Reqd_Qty, qty_reqd = qty_reqd * @V_Reqd_Qty
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
    END

    --Attach the folder to the job if found for process, item, operation and entity
    SET @V_Folder_Ver = NULL
    DECLARE cur_folder CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT a.ent_id, b.ver_id FROM oper_ent_link a, folder_item_oper_ent_link b
      WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.ent_id = b.ent_id AND a.process_id = @process_id
        AND a.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND b.item_id = ISNULL(@V_Item, @item_id)
    OPEN cur_folder
    FETCH cur_folder INTO @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Folder_Ver
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE job SET folder_ver_id = @V_Folder_Ver WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND init_sched_ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
      FETCH cur_folder INTO @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Folder_Ver
    END
    CLOSE cur_folder
    DEALLOCATE cur_folder
    --If folder not found in link table check folders for preferred version
    IF @V_Folder_Ver IS NULL
    BEGIN
      DECLARE cur_fold CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT b.ent_id, b.ver_id FROM job a, folder b WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id
        AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.init_sched_ent_id = b.ent_id AND a.wo_id = @wo_id AND a.oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
        AND a.item_id = ISNULL(@V_Item, @item_id) AND b.preferred_ver = 1
      OPEN cur_fold
      FETCH cur_fold INTO @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Folder_Ver
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        UPDATE job SET folder_ver_id = @V_Folder_Ver WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND init_sched_ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
        FETCH cur_fold INTO @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id, @V_Folder_Ver
      END
      CLOSE cur_fold
      DEALLOCATE cur_fold
    END  --End of @V_Folder_Ver IS NULL

    FETCH cur_ops INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Item
  END
  CLOSE cur_ops
  DEALLOCATE cur_ops

  --Only the final jobs to update inventory
/*  DECLARE cur_upd_inv CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT b.item_id, MAX(a.seq_no) FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq a, job b
    WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND b.wo_id = @wo_id GROUP BY b.item_id
  OPEN cur_upd_inv
  FETCH cur_upd_inv INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Seq
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --Get the update inventory flag
    SELECT @V_Integer=a.update_inv FROM bom_item a, bom_ver b WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id
      AND b.preferred_ver = 1 AND a.parent_item_id = @V_Parent_Item AND a.bom_pos = 0
    IF @V_Integer = 1
    BEGIN
      --Update the flag to true for final job producing this item
      UPDATE job_bom SET update_inv = @V_Integer WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        AND oper_id = (SELECT oper_id FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE seq_no = @V_Seq) AND bom_pos = 0 AND item_id = @V_Parent_Item
      --Update the flag to false for all jobs not producing this item
      UPDATE job_bom SET update_inv = 0 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
        AND oper_id <> (SELECT oper_id FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE seq_no = @V_Seq) AND bom_pos = 0 AND item_id = @V_Parent_Item
    END
    FETCH cur_upd_inv INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Seq
  END
  CLOSE cur_upd_inv
  DEALLOCATE cur_upd_inv*/

  --Execute calculate times
  EXEC sp_Calculate_Times @wo_id, @process_id, @req_finish_time, @req_finish_time_tz

  --Drop the temporary table
  DROP TABLE #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq

  --Check if current date is past release date
  IF dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) > ISNULL(@release_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1)
  BEGIN
    --Check system attribute 310 for the initial job status
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 2 FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 310 AND attr_value = '0')
      UPDATE job SET state_cd = 2 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 1 AND state_cd = 1
  END

  BEGIN

    --Delete the jobs having zero quantities if workorder start qty is > 0
    IF @start_qty > 0
    BEGIN
      --Make sure that jobs with zero quantities need to be deleted
      SELECT @V_Constant = @V_Constant FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 340 AND attr_value = '0'  --Include jobs with 0 quantity when creating work orders<4819>
      IF @@ROWCOUNT = 1
      BEGIN
        DELETE FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job
                        WHERE wo_id = job_route.wo_id AND qty_at_start = 0
                          AND ((job.oper_id = job_route.oper_id AND job.seq_no = job_route.seq_no)
                            OR (job.oper_id = job_route.input_oper_id AND job.seq_no = job_route.input_seq_no)))
        DELETE FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND qty_at_start = 0
      END  --End of @@ROWCOUNT = 1
    END  --End of @start_qty > 0
  END

  --Handle job quantity precisions
  DECLARE cur_job_qty CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.item_id, i.num_decimals, j.qty_reqd, j.qty_at_start
    FROM job j INNER JOIN item i ON j.item_id = i.item_id
      WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND i.num_decimals > 0 AND ((FLOOR(j.qty_reqd) < j.qty_reqd) OR (FLOOR(j.qty_at_start) < j.qty_at_start))
  OPEN cur_job_qty
  WHILE (1=1)
  BEGIN
    FETCH cur_job_qty INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Seq, @V_Parent_Item, @V_Integer1, @V_Reqd_Qty, @V_Start_Qty
    IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BREAK
    --Check if start or required qtys need to be rounded upto the next decimal digit
    	--Added code to avoid Conversion failures for for CR-L00116940 clone CR-L00109966(HF#2505)
	SET @cast_qty = CAST(@V_Start_Qty AS DECIMAL(18,7))
	IF LEN(SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR), CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),1)+1, @V_Integer1+1)) > @V_Integer1
	BEGIN
		SET @sub_string_qty = NULL
		SET @sub_string_qty = SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@cast_qty as VARCHAR),1)+@V_Integer1+1,7)
		IF CAST(@sub_string_qty AS INTEGER) > 0
			SET @V_Start_Qty = FLOOR(@cast_qty) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@cast_qty as VARCHAR),1)+1,@V_Integer1) AS INTEGER)+1)*1.0/POWER(10,@V_Integer1)
		ELSE
			SET @V_Start_Qty=  FLOOR(@cast_qty) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@cast_qty as VARCHAR),1)+1,@V_Integer1) AS INTEGER))*1.0/POWER(10,@V_Integer1)
	END
	--Added code to avoid Conversion failures for for CR-L00116940 clone CR-L00109966(HF#2505)
	SET @cast_qty = CAST(@V_Reqd_Qty AS DECIMAL(18,7))
	IF LEN(SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR), CHARINDEX('.',CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),1)+1, @V_Integer1+1)) > @V_Integer1
	BEGIN
		SET @sub_string_qty = NULL
		SET @sub_string_qty = SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@cast_qty as VARCHAR),1)+@V_Integer1+1,7)
		IF CAST(@sub_string_qty AS INTEGER) > 0
			SET @V_Reqd_Qty = FLOOR(@cast_qty) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@cast_qty as VARCHAR),1)+1,@V_Integer1) AS INTEGER)+1)*1.0/POWER(10,@V_Integer1)
		ELSE
			SET @V_Reqd_Qty=  FLOOR(@cast_qty) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(@cast_qty AS VARCHAR),CHARINDEX('.', CAST(@cast_qty as VARCHAR),1)+1,@V_Integer1) AS INTEGER))*1.0/POWER(10,@V_Integer1)
	END
    UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = @V_Start_Qty, qty_reqd = @V_Reqd_Qty
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq
  END
  CLOSE cur_job_qty
  DEALLOCATE cur_job_qty

  --Set the must consume from wip flag appropriately
  --if the previous operation produces this item or is a byproduct in the previous operation only then this operation can consume from wip
  /*UPDATE job_bom SET must_consume_from_wip = 1
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND bom_pos > 0 AND must_consume_from_wip = 0 AND EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM job_route jr
         INNER JOIN job j ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j.seq_no
           WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND jr.seq_no= job_bom.seq_no AND j.item_id = job_bom.item_id
       UNION
       SELECT 1 FROM job_route jr
         INNER JOIN job j ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j.seq_no
         INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
           WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.bom_pos < 0
             AND jr.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND jr.seq_no= job_bom.seq_no AND jb.item_id = job_bom.item_id) */
  --if the previous operation does not produce this item and is not a byproduct in the previous operation then this operation can not consume from wip
  --also at first operation can not consume from wip
  --Added condition for CR# L00118180
  UPDATE job_bom SET must_consume_from_wip = 0
    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND bom_pos >= 0 AND must_consume_from_wip = 1 AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM job_route jr
         INNER JOIN job j ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j.seq_no
           WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND jr.seq_no= job_bom.seq_no AND j.item_id = job_bom.item_id
       UNION
       SELECT 1 FROM job_route jr
         INNER JOIN job j ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j.seq_no
         INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
           WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.bom_pos < 0
                  AND jr.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND jr.seq_no= job_bom.seq_no AND jb.item_id = job_bom.item_id
	   UNION
       SELECT 1 FROM process p
		 INNER JOIN oper o ON p.process_id = o.process_id
		 INNER JOIN job j ON j.oper_id = o.oper_id
		 INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.wo_id=j.wo_id and jb.item_id = j.item_id
		 INNER JOIN bom_item bm ON bm.item_id = jb.item_id and bm.bom_pos = jb.bom_pos and bm.must_consume_from_wip = jb.must_consume_from_wip
		 WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id and p.rework =1 and jb.bom_pos =0 and bm.must_consume_from_wip =1)

  --Drop the table used to hold operation-item relation data
  DROP TABLE #tmp_oper_item
  --Drop the table used to hold the BOM tree of the final item
  DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Attr]
  (@attr_id int )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--09/15/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT attr.attr_id
          ,attr.predefined
          ,attr.data_type
          ,attr.attr_desc
          ,attr.attr_grp
          ,attr.filtr
	  ,attr.entry_type
	  ,attr.visible_in_queue

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Labor_Usage]
(
	@log_id int ,
	--@labor_start datetime ,
	@labor_start_local datetime, -- Added 08/01/2007 AML
	@labor_start_tz INT32 = NULL ,
	@user_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@ent_id int ,
	@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@seq_no int ,
	@step_no int ,
	@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@lab_cd nvarchar(40) ,
	@dept_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@shift_id int ,
	--@shift_start datetime ,
	@shift_start_local datetime, -- Added 08/01/2007 AML
	@shift_start_tz INT32 = NULL ,
	@pct_to_apply float ,
	@active bit ,
	@duration int ,
	@comments nvarchar(254) ,
	@raw_reas_cd nvarchar(80) ,
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
	@mod_id varchar(30) ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				-
-- Description				-
-- Author					-
-- Date Created				- 10/21/2002
-- Version					- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version     Changes
-- 10/11/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/01/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 05/07/2007		Raghu			3.2.11		HD# 9824, Updates needs a revamping
-- 08/01/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 11/12/2009       Eswar           4.0			HF1432 Datetime changes.
-- 01/05/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Bring HF Forward Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @labor_start_start	TDATETIME
	,	@labor_start_end	TDATETIME
	,	@labor_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@tz_temp			INT32
	,	@dbg_resp			INT32

SET @labor_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@labor_start_tz)
SET @labor_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@labor_start_local, @labor_start_tz)

SET @shift_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_tz)
SET @shift_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@shift_start_local, @shift_start_tz)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)


SELECT	@labor_start_start = DATEADD( mi, -@labor_start_tz, @labor_start_local )
	,	@labor_start_end = DATEADD( ss, @duration, @labor_start_start )

SET @tz_temp = -@labor_start_tz
EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_utc OUTPUT


SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_tz
EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT


SET @shift_start_tz = NULL
SET @shift_start_local = NULL
EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local OUTPUT, @shift_start_tz OUTPUT
EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Labor_Usage', @src_key='GETDATEINFO-SHIFTSTART', @date_val1 = @shift_start_local,@date_val2 = @shift_start_utc

SET @labor_start_tz = NULL
SET @labor_start_local = NULL
EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @labor_start_utc, @labor_start_local OUTPUT, @labor_start_tz OUTPUT
EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Labor_Usage', @src_key='GETDATEINFO-LABORSTART', @date_val1 = @labor_start_local,@date_val2 = @labor_start_utc

--Verify whether the supplied data exists for another labor event.
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE (labor_start_local BETWEEN @labor_start_start AND @labor_start_end
			  OR DATEADD(ss, duration, @labor_start_local) BETWEEN @labor_start_start AND @labor_start_end)
			  AND user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND (wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
			  AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
			  AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
			  AND (step_no = @step_no OR (step_no IS NULL AND @step_no IS NULL))
			  AND (item_id = @item_id OR (item_id IS NULL AND @item_id IS NULL))
			  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND log_id <> @log_id) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('A labor record identifying this job and user that ran on this entity already exist.', 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

UPDATE labor_usage
SET --labor_start = @labor_start_start,
	labor_start_local = @labor_start_local,
	labor_start_utc = @labor_start_utc,
    user_id = @user_id,
    ent_id = @ent_id,
    wo_id = @wo_id,
    oper_id = @oper_id,
    seq_no = @seq_no,
    step_no = @step_no,
    item_id = @item_id,
    lot_no = @lot_no,
	sublot_no = @sublot_no,
    lab_cd = @lab_cd,
    dept_id = @dept_id,
    shift_id = @shift_id,
    --shift_start = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start),
	shift_start_local = @shift_start_local,
	shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc,
    pct_to_apply = @pct_to_apply,
    active = @active,
    duration = @duration,
    comments = @comments,
	raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(log_id = @log_id AND
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id)

CREATE function [dbo].[fnDurationToHHMMSS](@duration integer)
    returns string80
begin
    declare @iHours as integer
    declare @iMinutes as integer
    declare @iSeconds as integer
    declare @fRemainder as integer
    declare @sMin as string80
    declare @sHour as string80
    declare @sSecond as string80

    set @iHours = ((@duration/60)/60);
    set @fRemainder = @duration - ((@iHours*60)*60);
    set @iMinutes = @fRemainder/60;
    set @iSeconds = @fRemainder%60;

    set @sHour = cast(@iHours as varchar(80));

    --make minutes look good
    if( @iMinutes = 0)
       begin
          set @sMin = '00';
       end
    else if(@iMinutes < 10)
       begin
           set @sMin = '0' + cast(@iMinutes as varchar(80));
       end
    else
       begin
           set @sMin = cast(@iMinutes as varchar(80));
       end

    --make seconds look good
    if( @iSeconds = 0)
       begin
          set @sSecond = '00';
       end
    else if(@iSeconds < 10)
       begin
           set @sSecond = '0' + cast(@iSeconds as varchar(80));
       end
    else
       begin
               set @sSecond = cast(@iSeconds as varchar(80));
       end

    return @sHour +':'+ @sMin + ':' + @sSecond;

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_CheckWoExistAutoIncrement]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @CurrentWO NVARCHAR(20),
			@NewWO BIGINT,
			@Checking BIT = 1,
			@Counter INT = 0

    /* Disabled because use other way
	SELECT @CurrentWO=attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'CurrentManualOrder' 
	AND grp_id = 200 -- General Group
	*/

	-- Get last order
	SELECT @CurrentWO = ISNULL(max(wo_id),'80000000') FROM WO WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE (wo_id NOT LIKE '%[^0-9.]%' AND (CAST(wo_id AS BIGINT) >= 80000000 AND CAST(wo_id AS BIGINT) <= 99999999) )

	-- Resetting into 80000000 if the current order is reach 99999999
	IF (@CurrentWO = '99999999')
	BEGIN
		SET @CurrentWO= '80000000'
	END

	-- Update Wo to the Next Order
	SET @NewWO = CAST(@CurrentWO AS  BIGINT)+1

	WHILE (@Checking = 1 AND @Counter<10) -- Maximum retries is 10 times
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id=@NewWO)
		BEGIN
			/* Disabled because use other way
		    -- Save to the new attribute 
			UPDATE system_attr 
			SET attr_value = CAST(@NewWO AS NVARCHAR(100))
			WHERE attr_desc = 'CurrentManualOrder' 
				AND grp_id = 200 -- General Group
			*/

			SET @Checking = 0
			SELECT @NewWO
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id=@NewWO)
		BEGIN
			SET @NewWO = @NewWO + 1
			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1 
		END

	END

	print @max


	set @max=MAX(CAST(@max AS  BIGINT))+1


	while @ia='TRUE'
	BEGIN	
		if not exists(select wo_id from wo where wo_id=@max and spare1='1')
			BEGIN
				SET @sqlText = N'SELECT ' + @max 
				Exec (@sqlText)
				set @ia='FALSE'
			END
		ELSE IF exists(select wo_id from wo where wo_id=@max and spare1='1')
			BEGIN
			print @max

       (labor_raw_reas.prompt = @prompt OR @prompt IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.def_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd OR @def_lab_cd IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, labor_raw_reas.raw_reas_cd
*/
SELECT labor_raw_reas.ent_id
            ,labor_raw_reas.raw_reas_cd
            ,labor_raw_reas.prompt
            ,labor_raw_reas.def_lab_cd
            ,labor_cat.lab_desc
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,labor_raw_reas.last_edit_comment
            ,labor_raw_reas.last_edit_by
            ,labor_raw_reas.last_edit_at
FROM labor_raw_reas labor_raw_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON labor_raw_reas.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK) ON labor_raw_reas.def_lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
WHERE ((labor_raw_reas.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.prompt = @prompt OR @prompt IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.def_lab_cd = @def_lab_cd OR @def_lab_cd IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (labor_raw_reas.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, labor_raw_reas.raw_reas_cd
