   0.01.01	CK			2023-09-11			Audit trail
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_saveOverlayData] 
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(100)=NULL
   ,@oper_id NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
   ,@seq_no INT=0
   ,@overlayData NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL
   ,@contentType INT=2
   ,@user_id NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare  @jobDetailsAttrId INT
			,@typeofContentId INT
			,@isOverlayDataPresnt INT=0
			,@isTypeOfContentPresent INT=0
			,@jobGrpId INT=5 -- 5 job_attr group 
			,@mod_id_jobDetails NVARCHAR(50)
			,@mod_id_contentType NVARCHAR(50)
			,@mod_id_jobDetails_cnt INT
			,@mod_id_contentType_cnt INT
			,@mod_id_out NVARCHAR(50)
			,@new_attr_desc  NVARCHAR(100)
			,@new_attr_id  NVARCHAR(100)
			,@new_row_id INT
			,@new_attr_value NVARCHAR(max)
			,@resultset INT=1
			,@resultcode NVARCHAR(200)

	
declare		 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'LM_Overlay'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Printer'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@i INT =0
			,@modCnt INT=0
			,@j INT =0
			,@newCnt INT=0
			,@k INT =0
			,@delCnt INT=0
			,@l INT =0
			,@smeRcdCnt INT=0

DECLARE @jobAttr as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	wo_id NVARCHAR(100),
	oper_id  NVARCHAR(100),
	seq_no INT,
	attr_id INT, 
	attr_value NVARCHAR(max)
);

DECLARE @jobAttr1 as table (
	rowSeq int identity(1,1),
	row_id INT,
	wo_id NVARCHAR(100),
	oper_id  NVARCHAR(100),
	seq_no INT,
	attr_id INT, 
	attr_value NVARCHAR(max)
);

insert into @jobAttr (row_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,attr_id,attr_value)
select ja.row_id,ja.wo_id,ja.oper_id,ja.seq_no,ja.attr_id,ja.attr_value
from job_attr ja with(nolock)
where ja.wo_id=@wo_id and ja.oper_id=@oper_id and ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	 -- get job_label_details attr Id
	SELECT @jobDetailsAttrId=a.attr_id 
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId

	 -- get job_label_details attr Id
	SELECT @typeofContentId=a.attr_id
	FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)	
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent' and a.attr_grp=@jobGrpId
	    
	SELECT @jobDetailsAttrId as jobDetailsAttrId ,@typeofContentId as contentTypeAttrId

	SELECT @mod_id_jobDetails_cnt = COUNT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id))))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@jobDetailsAttrId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	IF(@mod_id_jobDetails_cnt > 0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @mod_id_jobDetails = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id)))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@jobDetailsAttrId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no
		

	set @overlayData= cast(@overlayData as nvarchar(1000))
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Attr]	@wo_id = @wo_id 
							   ,@oper_id = @oper_id 
							   ,@seq_no = @seq_no
							   ,@attr_id = @jobDetailsAttrId
							   ,@attr_value = @overlayData
							   ,@notes = NULL
							   ,@last_edit_comment = NULL
							   ,@mod_id = @mod_id_jobDetails
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Attr]	@wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@seq_no=@seq_no,@attr_id=@jobDetailsAttrId,@attr_value=@overlayData,@notes=NULL,@last_edit_comment=NULL,@mod_id=@mod_id_jobDetails OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT @mod_id_contentType_cnt = COUNT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id))))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@typeofContentId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	IF(@mod_id_contentType_cnt > 0)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @mod_id_contentType = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ja.mod_id)))
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id =@typeofContentId	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	set @contentType= cast(@contentType as nvarchar(1000));

	EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Attr]	@wo_id = @wo_id 
							   ,@oper_id = @oper_id 
							   ,@seq_no = @seq_no
							   ,@attr_id = @typeofContentId
							   ,@attr_value = @contentType
							   ,@notes = NULL
							   ,@last_edit_comment = NULL
							   ,@mod_id = @mod_id_contentType
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Attr]	@wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@seq_no=@seq_no,@attr_id=@typeofContentId,@attr_value= @contentType  ,@notes=NULL,@last_edit_comment=NULL,@mod_id=@mod_id_contentType OUTPUT
	END
	--SELECT @mod_id_jobDetails,@mod_id_contentType

	--SELECT *
	--FROM job_attr ja
	--WHERE ja.attr_id IN (@jobDetailsAttrId,@typeofContentId)
	--AND ja.wo_id = @wo_id

	insert into @jobAttr1 (row_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,attr_id,attr_value)
	select ja.row_id,ja.wo_id,ja.oper_id,ja.seq_no,ja.attr_id,ja.attr_value
	from job_attr ja with(nolock)
	where ja.wo_id=@wo_id and ja.oper_id=@oper_id and ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	--select * from @jobAttr
	--select * from @jobAttr1
	BEGIN TRY
	
	-- edit existing record present 
	SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.attr_id)
	from @jobAttr t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @jobAttr1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (cast(ISNULL(t1.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max))) 
	
	while (@i < @modCnt)
	BEGIN
	 

	SELECT  @new_row_id=t2.row_id
			,@new_attr_id=t2.attr_id
			,@new_attr_value=cast(ISNULL(t2.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max))
	from @jobAttr t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @jobAttr1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where (cast(ISNULL(t1.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max)) <> cast(ISNULL(t2.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max))) 
	--where (t1.attr_value <> t2.attr_value) 
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @i ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	select @new_attr_desc=a.attr_desc
	from attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_id=@new_attr_id

	Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'attr_value',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(max),@new_attr_value))
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+cast(@new_attr_desc as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ '+cast(@wo_id as NVARCHAR(200)) +' _ '+cast(@oper_id as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ '+cast(@seq_no as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ ';

	set @seq_no=cast(@seq_no as NVARCHAR(200));

	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = @wo_id
						,@keyField2 = @oper_id
						,@keyField3 = @seq_no
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @i = @i + 1;
	END


	-- insert new record 
	select @newCnt =count(t2.attr_id)
	from @jobAttr t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @jobAttr1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @jobAttr t2 )
	 while (@j < @newCnt)
	 BEGIN
	 SELECT  @new_row_id=t2.row_id
			,@new_attr_id=t2.attr_id
			,@new_attr_value=cast(ISNULL(t2.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max))
	from @jobAttr t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @jobAttr1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @jobAttr t2 )
	order by t2.row_id
	OFFSET @j ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	select @new_attr_desc=a.attr_desc
	from attr a with(nolock)
	where a.attr_id=@new_attr_id

	Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'attr_value',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_attr_value))
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+cast(@new_attr_desc as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ '+cast(@wo_id as NVARCHAR(200)) +' _ '+cast(@oper_id as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ '+cast(@seq_no as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ ';
	set @seq_no=cast(@seq_no as NVARCHAR(200));
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = @wo_id
						,@keyField2 = @oper_id
						,@keyField3 = @seq_no
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @j = @j + 1;
	END

	 --delete record
	select @delCnt=count(t1.attr_id) 
	from @jobAttr t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @jobAttr1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							from @jobAttr1 t2 )
	while (@k < @delCnt)
	 BEGIN
	 SELECT  @new_row_id=t1.row_id
			,@new_attr_id=t1.attr_id
			,@new_attr_value=cast(ISNULL(t1.attr_value,'NULL') as nvarchar(max))
	from @jobAttr t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @jobAttr1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							from @jobAttr1 t2 )
	order by t1.row_id
	OFFSET @k ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY	
	Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@new_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_row_id)),
							(@new_row_id,'attr_value',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@new_attr_value))
	set @strCommentMsg='For '+cast(@new_attr_desc as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ '+cast(@wo_id as NVARCHAR(200)) +' _ '+cast(@oper_id as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ '+cast(@seq_no as NVARCHAR(200))+' _ ';
	set @seq_no=cast(@seq_no as NVARCHAR(200));
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
						,@function_id = @strFunctionName
						,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
						,@keyField1 = @wo_id
						,@keyField2 = @oper_id
						,@keyField3 = @seq_no
						,@keyField4 = NULL
						,@keyField5 = NULL
						,@user_id = @user_id
						,@activity = @strActivityMsg
						,@audit_category = 'Info'
						,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @k = @k + 1;
	 END
	set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='Success';
	select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
	select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_MDM_Sched_CUD_SDBItemAttr] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@item_id varchar(50),
	@attr_name varchar(50),
	@ItemGrpDesc varchar(50),
	@attr_value varchar(50)
	
AS
BEGIN
	
	Declare @isItemPresent int = 0,
	@attrId int = 0,
	@isItemAttrValueId int = 0,
	@ItemGroupId int = 0,
	@MaxId int = 0,
	@user_name varchar(10) = 'system'

	select @isItemPresent = count(0) from item where item_id = @item_id
	select @attrId = id from sdb.sch.attr where name = @attr_name
	select @ItemGroupId = id from sdb.sch.item_grp where [desc] = @ItemGrpDesc
	select @isItemAttrValueId = id from sdb.sch.item_grp_attr where attr_id = @attrId and item_grp_id = @ItemGroupId

	if  ( coalesce(@isItemPresent,0) > 0 ) --proceed when item is present
	begin
			 if coalesce(@attrId,0) = 0 -- inset attribute is not already exist
			 begin
											select @MaxId = ISNULL(max(id),0) + 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[attr]

											INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[attr]
													   ([id]
													   ,[name]
													   ,[desc]
													   ,[type]
													   ,[data_type]
													   ,[default_value]
													   ,[data]
													   ,[last_edit_date]
													   ,[last_edit_by])
												 VALUES
													   (@MaxId
													   ,@attr_name
													   ,@attr_name
													   ,'ATTR'
													   ,'Char'
													   ,@attr_value
													   ,@attr_value
													   ,getdate()
													   ,@user_name)

													   set @attrId = @MaxId
			 end

			 if coalesce(@ItemGroupId,0) = 0 -- inset itemgrp is not already exist
			 begin
				select @MaxId = ISNULL(max(id),0) + 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp]

									INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp]
											   ([id]
											   ,[desc]
											   ,[type]
											   ,[last_edit_date]
											   ,[last_edit_by]
											   											   )
										 VALUES
											   (@MaxId
											   ,@ItemGrpDesc
											   ,@ItemGrpDesc
											   ,getdate()
											   ,@user_name
											   )

											   SET @ItemGroupId = @MaxId
			 end

			 declare @isPresentItemGrpItem int = 0
			 select @isPresentItemGrpItem = count(0) from sdb.sch.item_grp_item where itemid = @item_id and ItemGrpId = @ItemGroupId
			 if coalesce(@isPresentItemGrpItem,0)= 0
			 begin

			 INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_item]
											   ([ItemGrpId]
											   ,[ItemId]
											   ,[order]
											   ,[last_edit_date]
											   ,[last_edit_by]
											   )
										 VALUES
											   (@ItemGroupId
											   ,@item_id
											   ,1
											   ,getdate()
											   ,@user_name)

			 end


			 if coalesce(@isItemAttrValueId,0) = 0
						BEGIN
						--code for insert
							select @MaxId = ISNULL(max(id),0) + 1 from [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_attr]
									INSERT INTO [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_attr]
											   ([item_grp_id]
											   ,[attr_id]
											   ,[attr_value]
											   ,[attr_characteristic]
											   ,[last_edit_date]
											   ,[last_edit_by]
											   )
										 VALUES
											   (@ItemGroupId
											   ,@attrId
											   ,@attr_value
											   ,@ItemGrpDesc
											   ,getdate()
											   ,@user_name)
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
								UPDATE [SDB].[SCH].[item_grp_attr]
								   SET [item_grp_id] = @ItemGroupId
									  ,[attr_id] = @attrId
									  ,[attr_value] = @attr_value
									  ,[attr_characteristic] = @ItemGrpDesc
									  ,[last_edit_date] = getdate()
									  ,[last_edit_by] = @user_name
								 WHERE id = @isItemAttrValueId
						END





	 end


	
	
	END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo]
-- Description: This function will get line info of provided segment/line
-- Usage:		Sample creation
-- SELECT * FROM [fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo] (205,0)
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2024-03-14		Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo] 
(	
    @ent_id    INT ,
	@type INT= 0--- 0= GET LINE INFO, 1 =GET SEGMENT INFO
)
RETURNS 
@Output TABLE
(
	line_id     INT
  , line_Name  NVARCHAR(40) 
  , line_desc	NVARCHAR(80) 
  
)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE		
		@ent_type NVARCHAR(40),	
		@parent_ent_id INT,
		@line_id int,
		@line_name NVARCHAR(40),		
		@line_desc NVARCHAR(80)
		
	
		SELECT  @ent_type=ea.attr_value, @parent_ent_id=ent.parent_ent_id FROM ent_attr ea with (nolock)
		INNER JOIN ent with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id		
		INNER JOIN attr with (nolock) ON ea.attr_id=attr.attr_id
		WHERE attr_desc='EntityType' AND ea.ent_id=@ent_id

		if (@type=0)--select line details
		BEGIN
			IF (@ent_type='Segment')
			BEGIN
				SELECT @line_id=ent_id, @line_name=ent_name, @line_desc=ISNULL(description,ent_name) FROM ent with (nolock) WHERE ent_id=@parent_ent_id
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @line_id=ent_id, @line_name=ent_name, @line_desc=ISNULL(description,ent_name) FROM ent with (nolock) WHERE ent_id=@ent_id
			END
		END
		ELSE--select segment details
		BEGIN
			IF (@ent_type='Segment')
			BEGIN
				SELECT @line_id=ent_id, @line_name=ent_name, @line_desc=ISNULL(description,ent_name) FROM ent with (nolock) WHERE ent_id=@ent_id
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @line_id=ent.ent_id, @line_name=ent_name, @line_desc=ISNULL(description,ent_name) FROM ent with (nolock)
				INNER JOIN ent_attr ea with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id		
				INNER JOIN attr with (nolock) ON ea.attr_id=attr.attr_id
				WHERE attr_desc='EntityType' and ea.attr_value='Segment'
				and parent_ent_id=@ent_id
				
			END
		END

		
	INSERT INTO @Output
	SELECT @line_id, @line_name,@line_desc
	RETURN 
END

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  	[Sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative]
-- Description: update job_bom from setup on base dosing while job run, and bom correction approve with cumulative qty
--
-- Usage:	update job_bom from setup on base dosing while job run, and bom correction approve with cumulative qty
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Ajeet			2023-05-22			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	JSC			2025-10-27			FAT Cakeblending - fixed JOB BOM mod
-- 0.02.01	JSC			2025-11-10			If Component not yet in BOM, then Insert on correction step
-- 0.02.02	JSC			2026-01-26			Changed CB_Batch weight
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative]
        @wo_id       NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id     NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no      INT,
        @recipeGrid  NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
        @reqd_qty    FLOAT        = NULL,
        @trigger_src NVARCHAR(50), --setup/cb
        @is_manual   INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
		-- v2.01 Updated for existing bom item or not
		--- declaration
        DECLARE @temp_recipe TABLE
                (
                        item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
                        item_desc           NVARCHAR(40),
                        qty_percent         FLOAT,
                        qty_reqd            FLOAT,
                        qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
                        man_qty_percent     FLOAT,
                        man_qty_reqd        FLOAT,
                        row_id              INT,
						mes_bom_pos			INT
                )
						
        DECLARE @Counter     INT,
        @iterate             INT=1,
        @item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
        @bom_pos             INT,
        @qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
        @qty_reqd_per_item   FLOAT,
        @curr_dosingStep     INT,
        @job_reqd_qty        FLOAT
				
        DECLARE @CTE TABLE
                (
                        id                  INT identity(1,1) NOT NULL,
                        item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
                        qty_reqd            FLOAT,
                        qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
                        bom_pos             INT
                )
						
        DECLARE @TEMP_CONS TABLE
                (
                        itemid  NVARCHAR(40),
                        qty_con FLOAT
                )
						
        SELECT  @job_reqd_qty = qty_reqd
        FROM    job (NOLOCK)
        WHERE
                wo_id       = @wo_id
                AND oper_id = @oper_id
                AND seq_no  = @seq_no
						
        IF (@trigger_src = 'setup')
        BEGIN
                IF (ISNULL(@reqd_qty,0) = 0)
                BEGIN
                        SELECT  @reqd_qty = CONVERT(FLOAT, act_spec_value)
                        FROM    job_spec (NOLOCK)
                        WHERE
                                wo_id      =@wo_id
                                AND oper_id=@oper_id
                                AND seq_no =@seq_no
                                AND spec_id='CB_Dosing weight'
                END
						
                UPDATE  job_bom
                SET
                        qty_reqd = CONVERT(FLOAT,ROUND(@reqd_qty*ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0),3))
                WHERE
                        wo_id       =@wo_id
                        AND oper_id =@oper_id
                        AND seq_no  = @seq_no
                        AND bom_pos > 0
								
                --- Insert base dosing recipe in job_bom_correction_details  table to read from automation for cakeblender.
                INSERT INTO @cte
                        (
                                item_id,
                                qty_reqd,
                                qty_per_parent_item,
                                bom_pos
                        )
								
                SELECT  item_id,
                        qty_reqd,
                        qty_per_parent_item,
                        bom_pos
                FROM    job_bom (NOLOCK) jb
                WHERE
                        jb.wo_id         =@wo_id
                        AND jb.oper_id   =@oper_id
                        AND jb.seq_no    =@seq_no
                        AND bom_pos      >0
                        
				SELECT  @curr_dosingStep =
                        (       SELECT  ISNULL(MAX(dosing_step),0)
                                FROM    job_bom_correction_details (NOLOCK) jb
                                WHERE
                                        jb.wo_id      =@wo_id
                                        AND jb.oper_id=@oper_id
                                        AND jb.seq_no =@seq_no)
                        
				SET @Counter=
                        (       SELECT  COUNT(1)
                                FROM    job_bom (NOLOCK) jb
                                WHERE
                                        jb.wo_id      =@wo_id
                                        AND jb.oper_id=@oper_id
                                        AND jb.seq_no =@seq_no
                                        AND bom_pos   >0)
                        WHILE ( @iterate              <= @Counter)
                        BEGIN
                                SELECT  @item_id            = item_id,
                                        @qty_per_parent_item= qty_per_parent_item ,
                                        @qty_reqd_per_item  = ct.qty_reqd,
                                        @bom_pos            = ct.bom_pos
                                FROM    @cte                  ct
                                WHERE
                                        ct.id = @iterate
												
                                EXEC sp_i_ofi_job_bom_correction_details @wo_id,
                                @oper_id,
                                @seq_no,
                                @item_id,
                                @bom_pos,
                                @qty_reqd_per_item,
                                @qty_per_parent_item,
                                @curr_dosingStep
										
                                SET @iterate = @iterate + 1
										
                        END
								
						-- v2.00 REMOVED!
						-- Only update the target Quantity, not the qty_per_parent_item this should be done by the screen.
                        -- UPDATE  Job_bom
                        -- SET
                                -- qty_per_parent_item = CONVERT(FLOAT, qty_reqd/@job_reqd_qty)
                        -- WHERE
                                -- wo_id       =@wo_id
                                -- AND oper_id =@oper_id
                                -- AND seq_no  = @seq_no
                                -- AND bom_pos > 0
										
        END
				
        IF (@trigger_src = 'correction_step')
        BEGIN
                INSERT INTO @temp_recipe
                        (
                                item_id,
                                item_desc,
                                qty_percent,
                                qty_reqd,
                                qty_per_parent_item,
                                man_qty_percent,
                                man_qty_reqd,
                                row_id,
								mes_bom_pos
                        )
                SELECT  item_id,
                        item_desc,
                        qty_percent,
                        qty_reqd,
                        qty_per_parent_item,
                        man_qty_percent,
                        man_qty_reqd,
                        row_id
						,-9
                FROM    OPENJSON ( @recipeGrid ) WITH ( item_id VARCHAR(200) '$.item_id' , item_desc VARCHAR(200) '$.item_desc', qty_percent FLOAT '$.qty_percent', qty_reqd FLOAT '$.qty_reqd' , qty_per_parent_item FLOAT '$.qty_per_parent_item', man_qty_percent FLOAT '$.man_qty_percent', man_qty_reqd FLOAT '$.man_qty_reqd' , row_id INT '$.row_id' )
                
				

				-- get the current MAX bom POS; and add 1 for the new
				DECLARE @MaxBOMPos INT		
				SELECT @MaxBOMPos = MAX(bom_pos)
				FROM job_bom jb WITH  (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND jb.oper_id =  @oper_id
					AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
					AND jb.bom_pos > 0

				-- get the current job_bom pos
				UPDATE tr
				SET mes_bom_pos = jb.bom_pos								
				FROM @temp_recipe tr
					INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = tr.item_id
				WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND jb.oper_id =  @oper_id
					AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
					AND jb.bom_pos > 0

                --Update Job bom based on actual qty selected by user while bom correction approval(cumulative)
                UPDATE  jb
                SET
					jb.qty_reqd =CASE
											WHEN    @is_manual = 0
											THEN    (ISNULL(jb.qty_reqd,0)+ISNULL(r.qty_reqd,0))
											WHEN    @is_manual = 1
											THEN    (ISNULL(jb.qty_reqd,0)+ISNULL(r.man_qty_reqd,0))
									END,
					jb.qty_per_parent_item = CASE
													WHEN @is_manual = 0
														THEN ISNULL(r.qty_percent,0)/100
													WHEN @is_manual = 1
														THEN ISNULL(r.man_qty_percent,0)/100
											END
                FROM    job_bom jb
                JOIN @temp_recipe r ON jb.item_id = r.item_id AND jb.bom_pos = r.mes_bom_pos
                WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
                        AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
                        AND jb.seq_no  = @seq_no
                        AND jb.bom_pos > 0

				-- Remove all updated rows
				DELETE 
				FROM @temp_recipe
				WHERE mes_bom_pos > 0 
				-- v2.01 -> To Delete the none-valid new positions (Review the Additives)
					OR (CASE
							WHEN @is_manual = 0 AND (ISNULL(qty_percent,0) > 0 OR ISNULL(qty_reqd,0) > 0)
								THEN 1
							WHEN @is_manual = 1 AND (ISNULL(man_qty_percent,0) > 0 OR ISNULL(man_qty_reqd,0) > 0)
								THEN 1
							ELSE 0
						END) = 0

				-- CHECK if there is any row remaining
				IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM @temp_recipe)
				BEGIN
								
					WITH NumberedRows AS (
						SELECT *,
							   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY row_id) AS rn
						FROM @temp_recipe
					)
					UPDATE tr
					SET mes_bom_pos = @MaxBOMPos + nr.rn
					FROM @temp_recipe tr
						JOIN NumberedRows nr ON tr.row_id = nr.row_id;


					-- v2.01 Pick default CONSUMPTION grade for the entity
					DECLARE @default_grade INT

					-- try job_exec 1st
					SELECT TOP 1 @default_grade = ir.item_grade_cd
					FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
						JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_cons_reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
						JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = @wo_id 
														AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
														AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
														AND j.run_ent_id = je.ent_id

					-- try ent_attr 2nd
					IF (@default_grade IS NULL or @default_grade < 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT TOP 1 @default_grade = ig.item_grade_cd
						FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
							JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_desc = 'default_grade' 
																AND ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
							JOIN item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ig.item_grade_desc = ea.attr_value
							JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = @wo_id 
															AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
															AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
															AND j.run_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		
					END	
		
					-- just in case... try standard 3rd
					SELECT TOP 1  @default_grade = ISNULL(@default_grade,ig.item_grade_cd)
					FROM item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) 			
					WHERE ig.item_grade_desc = 'STANDARD'

					-- Insert into job_bom now
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[job_bom]
									 (wo_id,
									  oper_id,
									  seq_no,
									  bom_pos,
									  item_id,
									  reqd_grade_cd,
									  instruction,
									  qty_per_parent_item,
									  max_qty_per_parent_item,
									  min_qty_per_parent_item,
									  reqd_start_val,
									  reqd_start_val_is_pct,
									  update_inv,
									  backflush,
									  def_reas_cd,
									  def_lot_no,
									  def_sublot_no, -- Added 1/12/07 KRF
									  def_storage_ent_id,
									  def_reject_ent_id,
									  scaling_factor,
									  must_consume_from_inv,
									  may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
									  may_create_new_lots,
									  must_consume_from_wip,
									  must_consume_before_prod,
									  constant_qty,
									  est_time,
									  current_subst,
									  qty_reqd,
									  serial_no_source, -- Added 1/12/07 KRF
									  spare1,
									  spare2,
									  spare3,
									  spare4,
									  last_edit_comment,
									  last_edit_by)
						SELECT DISTINCT	@wo_id,
										@oper_id,
										@seq_no,
										tr.mes_bom_pos,
										tr.item_id,
										@default_grade, --@reqd_grade_cd,
										NULL,--@instruction,
										CASE
											WHEN @is_manual = 0
												THEN ISNULL(tr.qty_percent,0)/100
											WHEN @is_manual = 1
												THEN ISNULL(tr.man_qty_percent,0)/100
										END, --@qty_per_parent_item
										1, --@max_qty_per_parent_item,
										0, --@min_qty_per_parent_item,
										0, --@reqd_start_val,
										0, --@reqd_start_val_is_pct,
										1, --@update_inv,
										0, --@backflush,
										NULL, --@def_reas_cd,
										NULL, --@def_lot_no,
										NULL, --@def_sublot_no, -- Added 1/12/07 KRF
										NULL, --@def_storage_ent_id,
										NULL, --@def_reject_ent_id,
										NULL, --@scaling_factor,
										0, --@must_consume_from_inv,
										0, --@may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
										1, --@may_create_new_lots,
										0, --@must_consume_from_wip,
										0, --@must_consume_before_prod,
										0, --@constant_qty,
										0, --@est_time,
										NULL, --@current_subst,
										CASE
											WHEN    @is_manual = 0
												THEN    (ISNULL(tr.qty_reqd,0))
											WHEN    @is_manual = 1
												THEN    (ISNULL(tr.man_qty_reqd,0))
										END,	-- @qty_reqd,
										0, --@serial_no_source, -- Added 1/12/07 KRF
										NULL, --@spare1,
										NULL, --@spare2,
										NULL, --@spare3,
										NULL, --@spare4,
										@trigger_src, --@last_edit_comment,
										CURRENT_USER --@last_edit_by
							FROM @temp_recipe tr
				END

        END
				
		-- v 2.00 -- ADDED
		IF (@trigger_src = 'job_complete')
        BEGIN
                -- Update Job Bom from item cons to have updated qty and qty per parent item before cumulative update
                -- jobbom update from item_cons
                INSERT INTO @temp_cons
                SELECT  ic.item_id,
                        SUM(qty_cons)
                FROM    item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE
                        ic.wo_id       = @wo_id
                        AND ic.oper_id = @oper_id
                        AND ic.seq_no  = @seq_no
                GROUP BY
                        ic.item_id								
								
                UPDATE  jb
                SET
                        jb.qty_reqd            = ISNULL(tc.qty_con,0),
                        jb.qty_per_parent_item = iSNULL(tc.qty_con,0)/ISNULL(@job_reqd_qty,1)
                FROM    job_bom jb
                JOIN
                        @temp_cons tc
                ON
                        jb.item_id = tc.itemid                        
                WHERE
                        jb.wo_id       = @wo_id
                        AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
                        AND jb.seq_no  = @seq_no
                        AND jb.bom_pos > 0
								
                       
        END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Session_TransfrUserSessn]
(@user_id		STRING40
,@new_session_id	INT32
,@existing_session_id	INT32 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Session_TransfrUserSessn
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Description	      -	HD# 6665, Transfers a user's ent_logon records to a new session
-- Date Created	      -	10/04/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.26
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By   	Ver		Changes
-- 05/11/2007		Raghu			3.2.12  Issue fixed to have a substituted dummy value when a null value is compared against an actual value.
-- 07/24/2007		Raghu			3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change shift_start with *_utc and *_local.
-- 09/04/2007		AML				3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
--12/22/2009		Kishore			4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE	@allow_inactive_logon		NVARCHAR(1)
--	,@current_time			TDATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	--Verify whether this instance of Factellligence db is allowed to transfer a user's session to a different session
	SELECT @allow_inactive_logon = attr_value
	FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 331

	--Default the system attribute value to 0 (not allowed); if the system attribute value is not found or null.
	SET @allow_inactive_logon = COALESCE(@allow_inactive_logon, '0')

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @new_session_id)
		--If a new session does not exist, then set the inactive logon parameter to 0;
		--thus returning an empty dataset to the caller.
		SET @allow_inactive_logon = '0'

	--Verify whether the system attribute allows the inactive user to be transferred to a different user session.
	IF (@allow_inactive_logon = '1') BEGIN

		--Verify whether the user has logged on to some entities in the target session.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id AND session_id = @new_session_id)
			--Update user's session to a new session id
			--and exclude entities to which the user has already logged on to a new session.
			UPDATE ent_logon SET session_id = @new_session_id
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT el.session_id session_id, el.ent_id, el.user_id, el.start_time
				--Pick distinct ent_logon records as user may have logged into the same entity on different sessions
				FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN
					--If the user has logged into the same entity on multiple sessions, then pick the earliest start time
					(SELECT el.ent_id, MIN(el.start_time) start_time
					FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
					WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND COALESCE(s.user_id, '987654321CIMNET') <> @user_id
					  AND (el.session_id = @existing_session_id OR @existing_session_id IS NULL)
					GROUP BY el.ent_id) el_distinct_ent ON el.ent_id = el_distinct_ent.ent_id AND el.start_time = el_distinct_ent.start_time
				INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
				WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND COALESCE(s.user_id, '987654321CIMNET') <> @user_id
				  AND (el.session_id = @existing_session_id OR @existing_session_id IS NULL)
				) el_sessions
			WHERE ent_logon.session_id = el_sessions.session_id
			  AND ent_logon.ent_id = el_sessions.ent_id
			  AND ent_logon.user_id = el_sessions.user_id
			  AND ent_logon.start_time = el_sessions.start_time
			--Do not logon this user to an entity to which the user has already logged on to a new session
			  AND ent_logon.ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @new_session_id AND user_id = @user_id)
		ELSE
			--Update user's session to a new session id.
			UPDATE ent_logon SET session_id = @new_session_id
			FROM (SELECT DISTINCT el.session_id, el.ent_id, el.user_id, el.start_time
				--Pick distinct ent_logon records as user may have logged into the same entity on different sessions
				FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN
					--If the user has logged into the same entity on multiple sessions, then pick the earliest start time
					(SELECT el.ent_id, MIN(el.start_time) start_time
					FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
					WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND COALESCE(s.user_id, '987654321CIMNET') <> @user_id
					  AND (el.session_id = @existing_session_id OR @existing_session_id IS NULL)
					GROUP BY el.ent_id) el_distinct_ent ON el.ent_id = el_distinct_ent.ent_id AND el.start_time = el_distinct_ent.start_time
				INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
				WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND COALESCE(s.user_id, '987654321CIMNET') <> @user_id
				  AND (el.session_id = @existing_session_id OR @existing_session_id IS NULL)
				) el_sessions
			WHERE ent_logon.session_id = el_sessions.session_id
			  AND ent_logon.ent_id = el_sessions.ent_id
			  AND ent_logon.user_id = el_sessions.user_id
			  AND ent_logon.start_time = el_sessions.start_time

/*		--Transfer the existing session records to a new session.
		INSERT INTO ent_logon (session_id, ent_id, user_id, start_time, cur_lab_cd, pct_lab_to_apply, cur_lab_dept_id, cur_lab_usage_log_id)
		SELECT @new_session_id, el.ent_id, @user_id, @current_time, el.cur_lab_cd, el.pct_lab_to_apply, el.cur_lab_dept_id, el.cur_lab_usage_log_id
		FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN sessn s WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.session_id = s.session_id
		--select all sessions where the current user is not the active user in the session table
		WHERE el.user_id = @user_id AND s.user_id <> @user_id
		  AND (el.session_id = @existing_session_id OR @existing_session_id IS NULL)
		--Do not logon this user to an entity to which the user has already logged on to a new session
		  AND ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @new_session_id AND user_id = @user_id)
*/
		--Delete all existing (or old) entities to which the user has logged into.
		DELETE ent_logon FROM sessn s
		WHERE ent_logon.session_id = s.session_id
		  AND ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND COALESCE(s.user_id, '987654321CIMNET') <> @user_id
		  AND ((ent_logon.session_id = @existing_session_id OR @existing_session_id IS NULL) AND ent_logon.session_id <> @new_session_id)

		--Return the new set of logged in entities to the caller.
		/*
		SELECT ent_logon.session_id, ent_logon.ent_id, ent_logon.user_id, DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ent_logon.start_time) start_time
			,ent.ent_name, ent_logon.cur_lab_cd, ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply, ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id
			,ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id, labor_cat.lab_desc cur_lab_desc, labor_cat.color
			,labor_dept.dept_desc cur_lab_dept_desc
		FROM ent_logon ent_logon WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent ent WITH(NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH(NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept WITH(NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
		WHERE session_id = @new_session_id AND user_id = @user_id
		ORDER BY ent.ent_name
		*/
		SELECT ent_logon.session_id, ent_logon.ent_id, ent_logon.user_id
            , ent_logon.start_time as start_time
			,ent.ent_name, ent_logon.cur_lab_cd, ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply, ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id
			,ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id, labor_cat.lab_desc cur_lab_desc, labor_cat.color
			,labor_dept.dept_desc cur_lab_dept_desc
            ,ent.site, site.site_name
            ,ent.can_sched_jobs, ent.can_run_jobs, ent.can_capture_util, ent.can_capture_labor
            ,ent.can_do_dnc, ent.can_track_oee, ent.can_sched_shifts, ent.can_store
            ,ent.can_log_data, ent.can_ship, ent.can_receive, ent.can_copy_folders
            ,ent.cur_shift_id
            ,ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc
            ,ent.cur_shift_start_time_local
            ,ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc AS cur_shift_start_time
            ,shift.shift_desc
            ,ent.last_domain_change AS last_domain_change
            ,ent.tree_icon,  ent.flow_diag_img,  ent.identical_job_execs, ent.show_in_dsp_tree
		FROM ent_logon ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
    	LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.cur_shift_id = shift.shift_id
    	LEFT OUTER JOIN site site WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.site = site.ent_id
		WHERE session_id = @new_session_id AND user_id = @user_id
		ORDER BY ent.ent_name
	END
	ELSE
		--Transferring a user's session to a different session is not allowed.
		--OR the new session itself does not exist. Return an empty recordset.
		/*
		SELECT ent_logon.session_id, ent_logon.ent_id, ent_logon.user_id, DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ent_logon.start_time) start_time
			,ent.ent_name, ent_logon.cur_lab_cd, ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply, ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id
			,ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id, labor_cat.lab_desc cur_lab_desc, labor_cat.color
			,labor_dept.dept_desc cur_lab_dept_desc
		FROM ent_logon ent_logon WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent ent WITH(NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH(NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept WITH(NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
		WHERE session_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL
		*/
		SELECT ent_logon.session_id, ent_logon.ent_id, ent_logon.user_id
			,ent_logon.start_time AS start_time
			,ent.ent_name, ent_logon.cur_lab_cd, ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply, ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id
			,ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id, labor_cat.lab_desc cur_lab_desc, labor_cat.color
			,labor_dept.dept_desc cur_lab_dept_desc
            ,ent.site, site.site_name
            ,ent.can_sched_jobs, ent.can_run_jobs, ent.can_capture_util, ent.can_capture_labor
            ,ent.can_do_dnc, ent.can_track_oee, ent.can_sched_shifts, ent.can_store
            ,ent.can_log_data, ent.can_ship, ent.can_receive, ent.can_copy_folders
            ,ent.cur_shift_id
            ,ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc, ent.cur_shift_start_time_local
            ,ent.cur_shift_start_time_utc AS cur_shift_start_time
            ,shift.shift_desc
            ,ent.last_domain_change AS last_domain_change
            ,ent.tree_icon,  ent.flow_diag_img,  ent.identical_job_execs, ent.show_in_dsp_tree
		FROM ent_logon ent_logon WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ent_logon.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_cat labor_cat WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_cd = labor_cat.lab_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN labor_dept labor_dept WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_logon.cur_lab_dept_id = labor_dept.dept_id
    	LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.cur_shift_id = shift.shift_id
    	LEFT OUTER JOIN site site WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.site = site.ent_id
		WHERE session_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL
END

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_Split](@text varchar(8000), @delimiter varchar(20) = ' ')
RETURNS @Strings TABLE
(   
  position int IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  value varchar(8000)  
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @index int
SET @index = -1

WHILE (LEN(@text) > 0)
  BEGIN 
    SET @index = CHARINDEX(@delimiter , @text) 
    IF (@index = 0) AND (LEN(@text) > 0) 
      BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @Strings VALUES (@text)
          BREAK 
      END 
    IF (@index > 1) 
      BEGIN  
        INSERT INTO @Strings VALUES (LEFT(@text, @index - 1))  
        SET @text = RIGHT(@text, (LEN(@text) - @index)) 
      END 
    ELSE
      SET @text = RIGHT(@text, (LEN(@text) - @index))
    END
  RETURN
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetPRODData]
-- Description: Used to insert PROD interface data into the buffer table
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE PROD object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessProdData_bck_05_22_2025]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'PROD',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28));
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) = CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28)) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		IF @TranCounter = 0
            BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;


			 --- PASTE FROM HERE ---

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN
			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,
					@sublot_no INT,
					@qty FLOAT,
					@storage_unit NVARCHAR(40),
					@item_id NVARCHAR(80) ,
					@alibiNumber NVARCHAR(40) ,
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
					--@message_output NVARCHAR(4000),
					--@status_output INT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
					@debug INT = 0

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@sublot_no = sublot_no
					,@qty = qty
					,@storage_unit = storage_unit
					,@item_id = item_id
					,@alibiNumber = alibiNumber
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',
				sublot_no INT '$.sublot_no',
				qty FLOAT '$.qty',
				storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) '$.storage_unit',
				item_id NVARCHAR(80) '$.item_id',
				alibiNumber NVARCHAR(40) '$.alibiNumber',
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME	'$.recorded_timestamp'
			);

			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
					,@mes_su_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- Get the MES item_id
			SELECT	@mes_item_id = i.item_id 
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(@item_id,2) ia 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.mes_item_id

			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid
		
			-- Get the MES DESTINATION storage unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_su_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent_attr ea with (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN  attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
			WHERE ea.attr_value = @storage_unit
				AND  a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
			ORDER BY ea.last_edit_at DESC

			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type, @ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'
				,@sublot_no as 'sublot_no'
				,@qty as 'qty'
				,@storage_unit as 'storage'
				,@mes_su_ent_id as 'storage_unit_ent_id'
				,@item_id as 'item_id'
				,@mes_item_id as 'mes_item_id'
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid item is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_item_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','item_id: '+@item_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'item_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid destination storage unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_su_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','Storage Unit / SUNumberInAUT: '+@storage_unit)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'su_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Declare the outputs of the ofi_AddprodWF_data Stored Procedure plus a local variable table to pick it up
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				,@data_bom_pos	INT
				,@data_def_lot_no nvarchar(40)
				,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				,@data_factor	FLOAT
				,@data_thr_result	INT
				,@data_to_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				,@data_to_qty FLOAT
				,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				,@data_su_result INT
				,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME

			-- CANNOT DO NESTED INSERT INTO

---- LOGIC FROM ADD PROD WF DATA


			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT @data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
			FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd=state_cd
					,@data_edit_time=edit_time 
			FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND seq_no = @seq_no

			-- if JOB is COMPLETED/NEW or RELEASED, ERROR
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED -- 4 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500015,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END


				GOTO Exit_Tree;

			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd = 4
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500016,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos=job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			---- Calculate the recorded_timestamp for the specified job
			DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME 
			DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT 
			DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT 


			-- Get the valid timestamp in case the job is running or has ran:
			SELECT @record_min_Diff = record_min_Diff
					,@recorded_timestamp_case = recorded_timestamp_case
					,@record_selected = record_selected
			FROM [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] (
			   @mes_wo_id
			  ,@mes_oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@recorded_timestamp)

			-- SET the actual date : In case the job has never RAN; we use the provided timestamp and let MES deal with it.
			SET @data_created_at_utc = ISNULL(@record_selected,@recorded_timestamp)
			
			-- Set warning if the recorded timestamp falls outside the job run time
			IF @recorded_timestamp_case > 500
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(@recorded_timestamp_case,NULL,NULL)+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@data_created_at_utc,121) +'. original recorded_timestamp: '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@recorded_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timestamp_warning',@status_output
				END
			END


			--Get Current Storage unit status V.0.02.00
			SELECT @data_max_capacity = max_capacity
			FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			IF (@data_max_capacity = 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @data_su_result=1
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @data_su_result=0
				END

			
			-- if SU is not complletely configure (Max Capacity is 0) warning and continue (if not other error is found.)
			IF @data_su_result IS NULL OR @data_su_result = 1 -- 1 = not configured
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(465,NULL,NULL)+' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'SU_conf_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

			--Check the SU have 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
			SELECT TOP 1 @data_su_status = attr_desc
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id 
				AND attr_desc IN ('LockForOutput','BlockForQuality','LockForInput') 
				AND attr_value = '1'

			--Get Lot number and bom_pos for normal production and item_id for bag Prodution
			IF (@mes_item_id is null or @mes_item_id ='0')
				BEGIN
					SELECT	 @data_def_lot_no = def_lot_no
							,@data_bom_pos = bom_pos
							,@mes_item_id = item_id
							,@data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd 
					FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
						AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
						AND seq_no = @seq_no 
						AND bom_pos = 0
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @data_def_lot_no = def_lot_no
								,@data_bom_pos = bom_pos
								,@data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd 
					FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
						AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
						AND seq_no = @seq_no 
						AND item_id = @mes_item_id

				END

			DECLARE @NonBOMItem INT = 0
			--FIx for empty def_lot_no for NON-bom PROD; and empty def_reas_cd
			IF @data_def_lot_no IS NULL OR @data_def_reas_cd IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SELECT	@NonBOMItem = CASE WHEN @data_def_lot_no IS NULL
												THEN 1
											ELSE 2
										END,
						@data_def_lot_no = ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no ,def_lot_no),
						@data_def_reas_cd = ISNULL(@data_def_reas_cd,def_reas_cd)
				FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND bom_pos = 0

				-- Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500018,NULL,NULL)+ CAST(ISNULL(@mes_item_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(35))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'item_not_in_bom',@status_output
				END
			END
			-- Declare the by-product bit
			DECLARE @mes_byproduct INT

			SET @mes_byproduct = CASE WHEN @data_bom_pos < 0
										THEN 1
									ELSE 0
									END

			--Declare table for UOM factor 
			DECLARE @UOM_factor TABLE (factor float)

			-- GET UOM FACTOR
			INSERT @UOM_factor
			EXECUTE sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT 
				 @item_id = @mes_item_id
				,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
				,@interface = 'PROD' 

			SELECT @data_factor = factor
			FROM @UOM_factor

			--Get item_inv for threshold
			DECLARE @item_inv_threshold TABLE (
												result INT,
												item_id NVARCHAR(30),
												to_item_id NVARCHAR(30),
												lot_no NVARCHAR(30),
												sublot_no NVARCHAR(30),
												to_qty FLOAT
												)
			INSERT @item_inv_threshold
			EXECUTE sp_S_ofi_iteminv_AUT 
				 @item_id = @mes_item_id
				,@ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			SELECT	 @data_thr_result = result
					,@mes_item_id = item_id
					,@data_to_item_id = to_item_id
					,@data_lot_no = lot_no
					,@data_sublot_no = sublot_no
					,@data_to_qty = to_qty 
			FROM @item_inv_threshold



---- END OF LOGIC FROM ADD PROD WF DATA

			-- VERIFY SU
			
			-- Get the grade for the prod REASON
			DECLARE @mes_item_grade_cd INT
					,@mes_item_status_cd INT
			IF @data_def_reas_cd IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN

				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_item_grade_cd = ir.item_grade_cd
							,@mes_item_status_cd = ir.item_status_cd
				FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ir.reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd				
			END

			-- check if @data_thr_Result == 1; then we need to update the inventory and transfer it.
			IF @data_thr_result  = 1
			BEGIN

				-- sp_u_ofi_item_inv_move getspec?

				-- from item to item id = mes_item_id
				-- to item_grade = mes_item_grade_cd 
				-- transfer option = 2
				-- status_cd = mes_item_status_cd
				--  COMMENts = 'RECLASS'
				-- BULK_MOVE_RECLASSIFY = 1
				-- from_ to ENT = mes_su_ent_it
				-- transfer_qty = data_to_qty
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Item_Inv_Move] 
							   @from_row_id = NULL
							--  ,@from_last_edit_at
							--  ,
							  ,@item_id = @mes_item_id
							  ,@lot_no = NULL
							  ,@sublot_no = NULL
							  ,@to_sublot_no = NULL
							  ,@to_lot_no = NULL
							  ,@to_status_cd = @mes_item_status_cd
							  --,@to_uom
							  --,@to_expiry_date
							  ,@to_grade_cd = @mes_item_grade_cd
							  --,@to_seq_no
							  ,@log_transfer = NULL
							  ,@transfer_option = 2
							  ,@transfer_comments = 'RECLASS'
							  --,@from_wo_id
							  ,@to_item_id = @mes_item_id
							  --,@to_wo_id
							  ,@from_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
							  ,@transfer_qty = @data_to_qty
							  --,@transfer_qty_erp
							  ,@in_to_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
							  ,@in_to_item_id = @mes_item_id
							  --,@in_to_lot_no
							  --,@in_to_sublot_no
							  --,@in_to_grade_cd
							  --,@to_expiry_date_utc
							  --,@to_oper_id
							  --,@from_oper_id
							  --,@from_seq_no
							  --,@in_to_status_cd
							  --,@in_to_uom_id
							  --,@in_to_expiry_date
							  --,@in_to_expiry_date_tz
							  --,@in_to_wo_id
							  --,@in_to_oper_id
							  --,@in_to_seq_no
							  ,@in_transfer_option = 2
							  --,@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job
							  ,@in_transfer_comments = 'RECLASS'
							  --,@in_log_transfer
							  ,@bulk_move_reclassify = 1
							  --,@time_zone_bias_value

			END




			-- Prepare SUBLOT_NO to 5 zeros:
			DECLARE @mes_sublot_no NVARCHAR(25)

			-- Fix the missing sublot data with a 'T' for Traceability
			SET @mes_sublot_no = CASE WHEN @NonBOMItem = 1 
										THEN	ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no,@data_lot_no) + RIGHT('00000'+CAST(@sublot_no as VARCHAR(5)),5) + 'T'
									ELSE ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no,@data_lot_no) + RIGHT('00000'+CAST(@sublot_no as VARCHAR(5)),5)
								END

			-- Prepare the data for quantity
			DECLARE @mes_qty_prod FLOAT = 0.0
			SET @mes_qty_prod = ISNULL(@qty, 0) * ISNULL(@data_factor,1)

			-- Declare the outputs
			DECLARE @output_row_id INT
					,@output_prod_info NVARCHAR(4000)

			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)

			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			--VERIFY if we are Producing BPROD or normal PROD or PPROD
			IF @InterfaceType = 'PROD'
			BEGIN

				-- verify if job running or not
				IF @data_job_state_cd = 3 AND @data_job_pos > -1
				BEGIN
					

					-- fields: created_at_utc; byproduct_bom_pos;ent_id;to_ent_id;item_id;job_pos;qty_prod;sublot_no.
					-- add prod to the current job
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Item_Prod_AddProd]
								@session_id = NULL
								--,@event_time_local
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
								,@qty_prod = @mes_qty_prod
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_def_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @mes_sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
								,@item_id = @mes_item_id
								,@byproduct_bom_pos = @data_bom_pos
								--,@ext_ref
								-- ,@apply_scaling_factor
								-- ,@genealogy_id
								-- ,@event_id
								--,@segment_requirement_id
								--,@segment_response_id
								-- ,@comments
								-- ,@spare1
							--  ,@spare2 = @data_bag_spare2 --Bags Spare2
							--  ,@spare3 = @data_hu_number  -- HU number
							--  ,@spare4
								,@check_privs = NULL
								,@created_at_utc = @data_created_at_utc
							--  ,@time_zone_bias_value
								,@row_id = @output_row_id OUTPUT
								,@prod_info = @output_prod_info OUTPUT
					
				END

				ELSE 
				BEGIN

					-- add prod to other status job
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec]
								@session_id = NULL
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@qty_prod = @mes_qty_prod
								,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
								,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
								,@seq_no = @seq_no
								,@created_at_utc = @data_created_at_utc
							--  ,@shift_start_local
							--  ,@hour_start_local
							--  ,@shift_id
								,@item_id = @mes_item_id
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_def_lot_no
								--,@rm_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @mes_sublot_no
							--  ,@rm_sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
								-- ,@processed
								,@byproduct = @mes_byproduct
							--  ,@ext_ref
							-- ,@move_status
							-- ,@genealogy_id
							-- ,@event_id
							--,@segment_requirement_id
							--,@segment_response_id
							-- ,@comments
							--,@spare1
							--  ,@spare2
							--  ,@spare3
							--  ,@spare4
							--  ,@time_zone_bias_value
								,@row_id = @output_row_id OUTPUT
					
				END

				-- AFTER CREATING THE INVENTORY; CALL THE FIX TO RECLASS THE SILO
				DECLARE @result_reclass INT
				EXECUTE @result_reclass = [dbo].[Sp_U_ofi_Su_reset_reclass] 
						   @ent_name_su = @storage_unit
						  ,@item_id = @item_id
						  ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no

				-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
				IF @status_output = 1 
				BEGIN
					-- SET OK
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500019,NULL,NULL)
				END


				IF @debug = 1
				BEGIN

					SELECT @output_prod_info as prod_info
							,@output_row_id  as row_id
					
					SELECT *
					FROM item_prod i with (nolock)
					WHERE i.row_id = @output_row_id

					SELECT *
					FROM item_inv i with (nolock)
					WHERE i.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

					SELECT
							 @data_wo_state_cd AS wo_status
							,@data_job_state_cd	AS state_cd
							,@data_job_pos	AS job_pos 
							,@data_bom_pos	AS bom_pos
							,@data_def_lot_no AS def_lot_no
							,@data_def_reas_cd AS def_reas_cd
							,@data_factor	AS factor
							,@data_thr_result	AS thr_result
							,@mes_item_id AS mes_item_id
							,@data_to_item_id AS to_item_id
							,@data_lot_no AS lot_no
							,@data_sublot_no AS sublot_no
							,@data_to_qty AS to_qty
							,@data_edit_time AS edit_time
							,@data_max_capacity AS max_capacity 
							,@data_su_result AS su_result
							,@data_su_status AS su_status
							,@mes_su_ent_id AS su_ent_id
							,@mes_sublot_no AS mes_sublot_no
							,@data_created_at_utc as created_at_utc
							,@mes_qty_prod as mes_qty_prod
							,@mes_byproduct as mes_byproduct
							,@mes_user_id as mes_user_id

				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--Call the other type of PRODs PPROD or BPROD
				-- EXEC [sp_I_Item_Prod_PPROD]
				-- EXEC [sp_I_Item_Prod_BPROD]
				-- spare2 and spare3 needs extra calculations HU and BAG numbers
				PRINT '@interfaceType = ' + @interfaceType
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		Exit_Tree:
		--- PASTE UNTIL HERE ---

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
        IF @xstate = -1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
	END CATCH
END;

 @raw_reas_cd  NVARCHAR(40)  ,
 @lab_cd  nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,

--

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--07/16/2008	Raghu		3.5	L00080625: util/Util_Reas_Link.cls middleware code has several references to raw_reas_cd as an integer instead of string
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
/*SELECT labor_reas_link.ent_id
            ,labor_reas_link.raw_reas_cd
            ,labor_reas_link.lab_cd
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,labor_cat.lab_desc
            ,labor_reas_link.last_edit_comment

  FROM labor_reas_link labor_reas_link WITH (NOLOCK)

WHERE ((labor_reas_link.lab_cd *= labor_cat.lab_cd)AND
       (labor_reas_link.ent_id *= ent.ent_id)AND
       (labor_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (labor_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL) AND
