CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Util_Shift_Link_MergeEvents]
(@ent_id		INT32 = NULL
,@start_utc_range	TDATETIME2
,@end_utc_range		TDATETIME2
,@last_edit_comment	STRING254 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Util_Shift_Link_MergeEvents
-- Description			- The purpose of this stored procedure is to break down the utilization events by shift,
--				- any add/delete to the existing utilization events be merged into this table along with the shift information.
--				- Additionally, link the job history information (if any).
-- Author			- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 04/20/20020
-- Version			- 6.2
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @util_shift_link_temp	TABLE (ent_id INT NOT NULL, act_event_time_utc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, event_time_utc DATETIME2 NOT NULL
					, event_time_local DATETIME2 NOT NULL, shift_start_utc DATETIME NULL)

DECLARE @util_shift_job	TABLE (ent_id INT NOT NULL, act_event_time_utc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, event_time_utc DATETIME2 NOT NULL
					, event_time_local DATETIME2 NOT NULL, shift_start_utc DATETIME NULL, job_hist_row_id INT
					PRIMARY KEY (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc))

DECLARE @util_job	TABLE (ent_id INT NOT NULL, act_event_time_utc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, event_time_utc DATETIME2 NOT NULL, job_hist_row_id INT
					PRIMARY KEY (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc))

DECLARE  @last_edit_at			TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	, @last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN
	--If the ending time is not supplied, exit
	IF (@start_utc_range IS NULL OR @end_utc_range IS NULL) RETURN

	--If the start range is within the time range when the events are modified most, then exit
	IF @start_utc_range >= DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @last_edit_at),0)) RETURN

	IF @last_edit_comment = 'MESService.UtilShiftLinkMergeEvents' SET @end_utc_range = DATEADD(HH, 1, @start_utc_range)

	--If the end time is within the last 2 hours bucket, then reset the endtime to be before the cut-off time period
	IF (@end_utc_range > DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @last_edit_at),0)))
		SET @end_utc_range = DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @last_edit_at),0))

	--If incorrect start time and end times are supplied; return
	IF @end_utc_range < @start_utc_range RETURN

	-- Remove the events that fall within the supplied range; so that they will get re-created with approrpriate dependant utilization and shift events
	DELETE FROM util_shift_link
	WHERE (ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND event_time_utc >= @start_utc_range
	  AND event_time_utc <= @end_utc_range

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Insert the utilization events from utilization history to contain shift information
	INSERT INTO @util_shift_link_temp (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, event_time_local, shift_start_utc)
	SELECT uh.ent_id, uh.event_time_utc, uh.event_time_utc, uh.event_time_local
		, (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc) FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sh.ent_id = uh.ent_id AND sh.shift_start_utc <= uh.event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (uh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND uh.event_time_utc >= @start_utc_range
	  AND uh.event_time_utc <= @end_utc_range

	--Insert utilization events that are on shift boundaries (shift start)
	INSERT INTO @util_shift_link_temp (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, event_time_local, shift_start_utc)
	SELECT sh.ent_id, util.event_time_utc, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local, sh.shift_start_utc
	FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) event_time_utc FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh.ent_id = sh.ent_id
			  AND uh.event_time_utc <= sh.shift_start_utc) util
	WHERE (sh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND sh.shift_start_utc >= @start_utc_range
	  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @end_utc_range
	  AND util.event_time_utc IS NOT NULL

	-- Remove the duplicates
	; WITH dups AS
	(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc ORDER BY usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc) AS rnk
	, usl.shift_start_utc, usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc, usl.event_time_local
	FROM @util_shift_link_temp usl
	)
	INSERT INTO @util_shift_job (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, event_time_local, shift_start_utc)
	SELECT ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, event_time_local, shift_start_utc
	FROM dups
	WHERE rnk = 1
	  AND shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL

	; WITH next_events AS
	(SELECT uh.ent_id, MIN(uh.event_time_utc) next_event_time_utc FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (uh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND uh.event_time_utc > @end_utc_range
		  GROUP BY uh.ent_id
	UNION
	SELECT sh.ent_id, MIN(sh.shift_start_utc) next_event_time_utc FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (sh.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND sh.shift_start_utc > @end_utc_range
		GROUP BY sh.ent_id
	)
	, next_event AS
	(SELECT ne.ent_id, MIN(ne.next_event_time_utc) next_event_time_utc FROM next_events ne GROUP BY ne.ent_id
	)
	, util_shift_times AS
	(SELECT uslt.ent_id, uslt.act_event_time_utc
	, uslt.event_time_utc
	, LEAD(uslt.event_time_utc, 1, COALESCE(ne.next_event_time_utc, (SELECT MIN(uh.event_time_utc) FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = uslt.ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc > uslt.event_time_utc), GETUTCDATE())
		) OVER (PARTITION BY uslt.ent_id ORDER BY uslt.event_time_utc) AS event_end_time_utc -- This is the time difference between the broken events by shift start time
	FROM @util_shift_job uslt
	LEFT OUTER JOIN next_event ne ON uslt.ent_id = ne.ent_id
	), job_links AS
	(SELECT usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc, MAX(jh.row_id) job_hist_row_id
	FROM util_shift_times usl WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON usl.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jh.job_start_utc < usl.event_end_time_utc AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > usl.event_time_utc
	GROUP BY usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc
	)
	INSERT INTO @util_job (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, job_hist_row_id)
	SELECT ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, job_hist_row_id
	FROM job_links jl

	-- Insert into util_shift_link table
	INSERT INTO util_shift_link (ent_id, act_event_time_utc, event_time_utc, event_time_local, shift_start_utc, job_hist_row_id, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT uslt.ent_id, uslt.act_event_time_utc, uslt.event_time_utc, uslt.event_time_local, uslt.shift_start_utc, uj.job_hist_row_id, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM @util_shift_job uslt
	LEFT OUTER JOIN @util_job uj ON uslt.ent_id = uj.ent_id AND uslt.act_event_time_utc = uj.act_event_time_utc AND uslt.event_time_utc = uj.event_time_utc
	LEFT OUTER JOIN util_shift_link usl WITH (NOLOCK) ON uslt.ent_id = usl.ent_id AND uslt.act_event_time_utc = usl.act_event_time_utc AND uslt.event_time_utc = usl.event_time_utc
	WHERE usl.ent_id IS NULL -- Limit to records that do not exist in the util_shift_link table
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_BG_Hourly_Tasks] ( @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0 ) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_BG_Hourly_Tasks
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 2.1.0.18
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 05/15/2003		Sheetal Jain  	1.6.0.0   	Ready first jobs if they are new and if the work order release date has passed (HD#832)
-- 02/05/2004		Sheetal Jain  	20024     	HD# 434 - Allow configuration of Archival Process execution time
-- 02/27/2004		Sheetal Jain  	20026     	Was always executing archive process by a day late.
-- 02/01/2005		SJ            	21012     	HD#4714 Make initial job's default state configurable
-- 04/18/2005		SJ            	21018     	HD#5558 - Archiving to be executed as a database job through Factelligence Service
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/31/2006		RG/TC			3.1.21		Always verify whether there is a custom procedure for hourly task execution;
--												perform the custom hourly task if any.
-- 08/27/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
--09/25/2008		Raghu 			3.5			L00082286, L00083732, L00084282, L00084592 ; UCO State Change and deadlock resolution
--07/17/2014		Srinivasa Tentu	5.0			User Story # 367575,CR L00132263:Merged the HF L00131969, Disable legacy archiving
-- 09/01/2016		Raghu		5.3		User Story: 679407 - As Lenka, I want the utilization events in the past (older than 2 hrs) should be updated in job_hour_history
-- 08/16/2017		RWB				6.0			User Story 898138: Removed the call to sp_U_Job_Hour_History_RefreshQtysAndTimes as this call
--												is now made by MES Service
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909264-As Lenka, I don't want to have primary key violations reporting production(CR L00146480)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @hour_start_utc			TDATETIME
	,@initial_job_status		INT
	,@ready_jobs_together		INT
	,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		, @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @current_time_utc),0)

	--NOTE: THE CUSTOM HOURLY TASK STORED PROCEDURE MUST ACCEPT EXACTLY THE SAME NO. OF PARAMETERS (INCLUDING THE PARAMETER NAME AND DATATYPE)
	--AS THIS STORED PROCEDURE.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM dbo.SYSOBJECTS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[sp_BG_Hourly_Tasks_Custom]') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(ID, N'ISPROCEDURE') = 1)
		EXEC sp_BG_Hourly_Tasks_Custom @time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value

	--Ready first jobs if the release date has already passed and if they are having new state(HD#832)
	--Check system attribute 310 for the initial job status
	SELECT @initial_job_status = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 310
	IF (@initial_job_status = 0) SET @initial_job_status = 2

	--Check system attribute 254 for if all jobs in the work order should be started together
	SELECT @ready_jobs_together = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 254

	IF @initial_job_status = 2 BEGIN
		UPDATE job SET state_cd = 2
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE job.wo_id = wo.wo_id AND
			  job.state_cd = 1 AND
			  (job.first_job = 1 OR @ready_jobs_together = 1)AND
			  wo.release_time_utc < @current_time_utc
	END

	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		EXECUTE sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 2, 'Stored Procedure', 'Hourly Tasks Stored Procedure - sp_BG_Hourly_Tasks'
				,'job', 'Error occurred when readying jobs', NULL
	END

	--Create new job_hour_history records for the jobs that are currently running
	INSERT INTO job_hour_history (ent_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_start_utc
		, hour_start_utc, hour_start_local
		, hour_end_utc, hour_end_local
		, item_id, std_prod_rate, batch_size
		, qty_good, qty_reject, runtime, downtime, idletime
		, last_edit_comment, last_edit_at)
	SELECT e.ent_id, je.cur_wo_id, je.cur_oper_id, je.cur_seq_no
		, jh.job_start_utc
		, @hour_start_utc, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(je.ent_id, @hour_start_utc)
		, DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc), dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(je.ent_id, DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc))
		, j.item_id, dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(j.est_prod_rate, j.prod_uom), j.batch_size
		, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		, 'HourlyTask(new buckets for running jobs)', @current_time_utc
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
	INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id = jh.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = jh.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = jh.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = jh.seq_no AND jhh.job_start_utc = jh.job_start_utc
		AND jhh.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc
	WHERE e.can_track_oee = 1
	  --Exclude jobs that are started in the current hour
	  AND DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, jh.job_start_utc),0) <> @hour_start_utc
	  AND (jh.job_end_utc IS NULL -- job is still running
	  	-- or, a job just ended right on top of the hour
	  	OR jh.job_end_utc = @hour_start_utc)
	  AND jhh.ent_id IS NULL -- exclude the jobs that are already added to tpm_stat
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_AuthenticateUserPriv]
(@session_id	int32,
@user_id 	nvarchar(80)
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/06/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1779) Client Types are changed to Cimlic Product Codes
-- 12/09/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	Messenger doesnot require any privileges, if client_type = 55, Bypass checking and authenticate to run the apps
-- 01/23/2003   Rich		1.5.5	Scheduler does not require any privileges as yet, if client_type = 57, Bypass checking and authenticate to run the apps
-- 03/14/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 1356)  Included error string into String Editor and had a reference to that error message
-- 03/20/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	Schedulers Priv Id is defined as 200 in Priv Table. Check for the user who has a valid priv to run Scheduler
-- 08/15/2003	Raghu		2.0.0	Included check for valid session before checking privileges
-- 09/11/2014	Jim		4.6.0	HF L00132295: Added NOLOCK hint to sessn query
-- 10/24/2014	Ashish		5.1.0	Megre CR-L00133676 cloned from HF L00132295: Added NOLOCK hint to sessn query
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @client_type	INT32,
	@local_priv_id	INT32,
	@priv_value	INT32

	SET @client_type = NULL
	SELECT @client_type = client_type FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @session_id

	IF @client_type IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The supplied Session ID is not valid{3448}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

--Old Name GetPrivByUser
	SELECT @client_type = client_type FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @session_id
	IF @client_type = 35 SET @local_priv_id = 1
	IF @client_type = 36 SET @local_priv_id = 20
	IF @client_type = 37 SET @local_priv_id = 60
	IF @client_type = 38 SET @local_priv_id = 100
	IF @client_type = 54 SET @local_priv_id = 120
	IF @client_type = 56 SET @local_priv_id = 111
	IF @client_type = 57 SET @local_priv_id = 200
	SELECT 	 @priv_value = MAX(priv_value)
	FROM 	grp_priv_link gpl, user_grp_link ugl, priv p
	WHERE 	ugl.user_id = @user_id AND
		gpl.priv_id = p.priv_id AND
		ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id and
		p.priv_id in (@local_priv_id)
	GROUP BY gpl.priv_id, p.priv_desc
	ORDER BY gpl.priv_id

	IF @priv_value is NULL SET @priv_value = 0
	IF @client_type = 55 SET @priv_value = 1
--	IF @client_type = 57 SET @priv_value = 1 --RWB Needs to be removed when Scheduler is licensed. Commented out by Raghu on 03/20/2003 as Scheduler got its priv id

	IF @priv_value <> 1 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('User does not have the required privilege to run this application{3575}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Oper_Step_CopyXML]
(@xml_source	NVARCHAR(4000)
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_OPER_STEP_COPY_XML
-- Description          - Copies each operation/step to a new process/operation/
-- Author              - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 10/01/2007
-- Version              - 3.3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver        Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT  ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @doc_handle		INT32
	,@target_process_id	NVARCHAR(160)
	,@target_oper_id	NVARCHAR(160)
	,@target_step_no	INT32
	,@process_id		NVARCHAR(160)
	,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(160)
	,@step_no		INT32

BEGIN
	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml, and read the target_process_id, target_oper_id and target_step_no
	SELECT @target_process_id = CASE WHEN target_process_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE target_process_id END
		,@target_oper_id = CASE WHEN target_oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE target_oper_id END
		,@target_step_no = CASE WHEN target_step_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE target_step_no END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (target_process_id  NVARCHAR(160),
		target_oper_id	NVARCHAR(160),
		target_step_no	NVARCHAR(160))

	--Loop through each source section and copy the step to a target process.
	DECLARE oper_step_copy_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT CASE WHEN process_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE process_id END AS process_id
		,CASE WHEN oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE oper_id END AS oper_id
		,CASE WHEN step_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE step_no END AS step_no
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/source', 2)
	WITH (process_id  NVARCHAR(160),
		oper_id	NVARCHAR(160),
		step_no	NVARCHAR(160))

	OPEN oper_step_copy_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_copy_cursor INTO @process_id, @oper_id, @step_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		EXEC sp_I_Oper_Step_Copy @in_process_id=@process_id, @in_oper_id=@oper_id
			,@in_step_no=@step_no, @in_target_process_id=@target_process_id
			,@in_target_oper_id=@target_oper_id, @in_target_step_no=@target_step_no
	END -- End of While (1=1)
	CLOSE oper_step_copy_cursor
	DEALLOCATE oper_step_copy_cursor

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

		@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SELECT @old_line_class = line_class FROM line WHERE line_id=@line_id

    UPDATE line SET
      line_name = @line_name,
      line_class = @line_class,
      origin_line_class_id = @origin_line_class_id,
      labor_load = @labor_load,
      max_wo = @max_wo,

	ELSE IF @old_line_class = 1 AND @line_class = 0 BEGIN

	END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[mdmGetInitialLineSpeed]
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	 @ent_id int,
	 @item_id varchar(50),
	 @wo_id varchar(50),
	 @oper_id varchar(50),
	 @seq_no int,
	 @req_qty float

)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @lSpeed float
	Set @lSpeed=-1.0
		
	--select @req_qty=req_qty, @wo_id=wo_id,@oper_id=oper_id,@seq_no=job_seq_no,@item_id=item_id,@ent_id=job_sched_entity_id from sdb..scheduler_exec where row_id=@row_id

	-- Declare the return variable here
	if exists(select * from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=@ent_id and item_id=@item_id)
		select @lSpeed=line_speed from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=@ent_id  and item_id=@item_id
	else
	--BEGIN
		if exists(select * from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=0 and item_id=@item_id)
			select @lSpeed=line_speed from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=0 and item_id=@item_id
		else
			BEGIN
				Declare @attr_id int
				select @attr_id=attr_id from attr where attr_desc='Operation_time' and attr_grp=5

				select @lSpeed = cast(@req_qty as float)  /(case when cast(attr_value as float) = 0.0 then 1 else cast(attr_value as float) end) from job_attr where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and attr_id=@attr_id

			END
	
	if(@lSpeed <0)
		select @lSpeed=@req_qty/2/60
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @lSpeed

END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetJobStateForTimestamp] 
--Create Date:        2025
--Author:             JSC
--Description:        To get a valid recorded timestamp for PROD or CONS so it will fall within a job run
--						The reason for this conversion is: 
--
/*

When a message is sent by automation it will be git the generated recorded time; it could be that in MES this timestamp a job was not running or has just finished.


*/

--Call by:            Initial idea was for PROD /CONS but not yet used.                 
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_GetJobStateForTimestamp] ('10000000','beanbulkintake',0,'2025-04-29 12:00:14.123',486)  -- EXAMPLES in create script
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2025-05-15          JSC					1.0					First version
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE     FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetJobStateForTimestamp] (
    @mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no INT,
    @recorded_timestamp DATETIME -- UTC
	,@mes_ent_id INT
)
RETURNS @Result TABLE (
	record_state_cd INT,
	record_is_initial INT,
    record_state_cd_timestamp DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN

	INSERT INTO @Result
    SELECT TOP 1
       CASE
            WHEN je.event_time_utc > @recorded_timestamp
                THEN 1
            ELSE je.value1
       END,
        CASE 
            WHEN je.event_time_utc > @recorded_timestamp
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END,
       CASE 
            WHEN je.event_time_utc > @recorded_timestamp
                THEN @recorded_timestamp
            ELSE je.event_time_utc
		END
    FROM job_event je WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE je.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
        AND je.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
        AND je.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND je.event_type = 'JobStateChanged'
		AND (je.ent_id = @mes_ent_id OR (je.ent_id IS NULL))
		AND je.event_time_utc <= @recorded_timestamp
    ORDER BY je.event_time_utc DESC;

    RETURN;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Labr_Exec_GetPrvShftStrt]
(@user_id		STRING40
,@ent_id		INT32
,@shift_start_time	TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
,@prev_shift_start_time	TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Labr_Exec_GetPrvShftStrt
-- Description	      -	Get the previous shift start time for an entity from the supplied shift start time.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	09/28/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @shift_start_time_utc AS DATETIME
	--Default the time_zone_bias_value parameter to 0; if not supplied.
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		, @shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_time)

	--Verify whether the supplied start time is not null
	--If a shift start time is supplied, then get the previous shift start time from the supplied shift start time.
	IF (@shift_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The supplied shift start time is NULL;
		--default to the current shift start as the start time from the supplied entity.
		SELECT @shift_start_time = cur_shift_start_time_local, @shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

		--Verify whether the current shift_start_time IS NOT NULL for the supplied entity.
		--If still NULL, then default to the current datetime.
		--If datetimes are not stored in GMT, then default the shift start time to current time
		SET @shift_start_time = COALESCE(@shift_start_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))
		--If datetimes are stored in GMT, then default the shift start time to GMT time
		SET @shift_start_time_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_time_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	--Get the previous shift start time
	SELECT TOP 1 @prev_shift_start_time = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, MAX(shift_start_utc))
	FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE user_id = @user_id
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND shift_start_utc < @shift_start_time_utc
	  AND shift_id > 0
END

-- Name:		sp_I_ofi_SetItemAttrs
-- Description:	The stored procedure will set item attr based on the configuration saved on
--				ofi_master_attr
--	
-- Usage:		sp_I_ofi_AddMaterialMaster
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-08-15			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_SetItemAttrs]
(@item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@template_name NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@comments NVARCHAR(80) = NULL)
AS
BEGIN	
	DECLARE @attr_id INT,
			@default_value NVARCHAR(80),
			@mod_id NVARCHAR(30)
	
	-- Cursor Started
	DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR 
	SELECT 
		attr_id,
		def_value
	FROM ofi_master_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_group = @template_name
		AND (process_id IS NULL AND oper_id IS NULL)

	OPEN db_cursor  
	FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @attr_id , @default_value 

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
	BEGIN 
		-- Add item attribute if not exist in the table
		IF NOT(EXISTS(SELECT 1 
					FROM item_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
					WHERE item_id = @item_id 
						AND attr_id = @attr_id))
		BEGIN
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Attr 
				@item_id = @item_id, 
				@attr_id = @attr_id, 
				@attr_value = @default_value, 
				@notes = NULL,
				@last_edit_comment = @comments,
				@mod_id = @mod_id OUT
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- Get Mod_ID
			SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
			FROM item_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id AND attr_id = @attr_id

			EXEC sp_U_Item_Attr 
				@item_id = @item_id, 
				@attr_id = @attr_id, 
				@attr_value = @default_value, 
				@notes = NULL,
				@last_edit_comment = @comments,
				@mod_id = @mod_id
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @attr_id, @default_value 
	END 

	CLOSE db_cursor  
	DEALLOCATE db_cursor 
	-- Cursor Ended
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24         Initial version.
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-02-09		   Refer to the comments in the SP on this date
-- 0.01.03  Lavkesh     2024-05-16		   For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- ===========================================================================================
 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg__BAK_240902] as
begin
 
 
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT
 
 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
 
 
    BEGIN TRY
 
  		BEGIN

			WITH ProduceToSAPOpers as(
				Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP') and attr_value <> 1
				union
				Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id <> (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP')
				union 
				Select oper_id from oper where oper_id not in (select oper_id from oper_attr)
			)
			
            Select  ip.spare2,ip.sublot_no,ip.wo_id,wo.bags_per_pallet,qty_prod,qty_prod_erp,u.description,ip.item_id,ip.created_at_local as last_edit_at,ip.lot_no,ip.row_id -- 0.01.03
			into #temp
            from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
            inner join ofi_wo_ext wo  with (nolock) on wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id and wo.module <> 'PO'
			inner join wo w on w.wo_id = wo.wo_id and w.state_cd < 3	--- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
            inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
            inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
			inner join job_bom jb on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
			inner join ProduceToSAPOpers oa on oa.oper_id = ip.oper_id  --(KN - 09/02/23 - Include only those operations where the NotConsumeToSAP has not been set)
            where qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod and i.item_class_id = 'SFG' and ip.sublot_no is not null
 			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL
			Begin

 			Declare @Mainhu varchar(100),@subLot varchar(100),@lot_no varchar(100),@wo_id varchar(100),@item_id varchar(100),@item_class varchar(100),@row_id INT
			Declare @sap_item_id varchar(100)

			Select top 1 @subLot = sublot_no,@lot_no = lot_no,@wo_id = wo_id,@item_id = item_id,@row_id = row_id from #temp

			PRINT @row_id

			Select @item_class = item_class_id from item where item_id = @item_id

				BEGIN
           			select '' Handling_Unit_Number,wo_id Order_Number,		---HU is empty for SFG
					sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number,'101' Movement_Type, bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
					sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp) Quantity, description Unit_of_Measure,
					IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,T.item_id,ia.attr_value) SAP_MaterialCode_Number,				--(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					Format(min(last_edit_at),'yyyyMMdd') Production_startdate,Format(min(last_edit_at),'hhmmss') Production_starttime,
					Format(max(last_edit_at),'yyyyMMdd') Production_enddate,Format(max(last_edit_at),'hhmmss') Production_endtime,
					lot_no SAP_Batch_Number,
					Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date,Format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_Generation_Time, 
					'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
					from 
					#temp T
					left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
						on T.item_id = ia.item_id --(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					where lot_no = @lot_no and isnull(sublot_no,'') = isnull(@subLot,'')
          		   group by wo_id,bags_per_pallet,description,T.item_id,sublot_no,lot_no,ia.attr_value

					BEGIN TRANSACTION 
 
           			Update ip set qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod from item_prod ip
					inner join (Select * from #temp where lot_no = @lot_no and sublot_no = @subLot) t on ip.row_id = t.row_id

					COMMIT TRANSACTION
				END
			End

        END
    END TRY
 
 
     BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
        RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
    END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item]
(
	@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@item_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@item_class_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@uom_id  int  ,
	@template  bit  ,
	@lifetime  int  ,
	@unit_cost  float  ,
	@obsolete bit,
	@purchased bit ,
	@sold bit ,
	@num_decimals int,
	@must_complete_steps bit ,
	@must_prod_reqd_qty bit ,
	@min_grade int ,
	@min_state int ,
	@min_inv_level float ,
	@auto_reorder bit ,
	@lot_no_format string80 ,
	@last_lot_no string80 ,
	@max_lot_size tfloat,
	@sublot_no_format string40,
	@last_sublot_no   string40,
	@serial_no_lvl    int32,
	@max_sublot_size  tfloat,
	@max_order_size tfloat,
	@min_trace_inv  tfloat,
	@inv_unique_by_job logical,
	@spare1  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@spare2  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@spare3  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@spare4  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@class_produced bit    ,
	@class_consumed bit ,
	@class_obsolete bit ,
	@order_by_ic_first bit ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Item
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 09/10/2002		Raghu			1.4			Add obsolete option. If obsolete is SET to true, then get all, ie obsolete
--												and non-obsolete items, if obsolete is set to false, then get only on-obsolete
--												items
-- 07/21/2003		Raghu			1.6.15		(HD# 2830) User sort should depend on system_attr = 210
-- 06/15/1004		Raghu			2.1.0		Changed IF conditions to CASE statements for sorting
-- 06/24/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Added uom_description in select clause - may be useful for client application
--												to display units
-- 03/22/2005		Raghu			2.1.17		HD# 5409, A new column named 'item_display' added to the resultset to return the
--												value based on the system attribute
-- 09/15/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 05/31/2007		KRF				3.2.1		Added class_obsolete and order_by_ic_first arguments, and class_obsolete and
--												item_class_display as returned fields, to facilitate creation of item class / item trees.
--												Commented out unused variables.
-- 07/11/2007		AML				3.2.1		Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
-- 11/27/2007		AML				3.4.0		Updated parameter list.
-- 09/25/2012		Ravi Teja		4.6			CR L00118103 - removed default filter on obsolete field.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @attr_value_class NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @class_sort NVARCHAR(10)

--IF @obsolete  IS NULL SET @obsolete = 0
IF @obsolete = 1 SET @obsolete = NULL

IF @class_obsolete IS NULL SET @class_obsolete = 0
IF @class_obsolete = 1 SET @class_obsolete = NULL

SET @order_by_ic_first = COALESCE( @order_by_ic_first, 0 )

SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

SELECT @attr_value_class = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 208
IF (@attr_value_class IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value_class) = 0) SET @attr_value_class = '0'

SET @class_sort = @attr_value_class

IF (@order_by_ic_first = 0) BEGIN
    SET @class_sort = '-1'; -- -1 indicates not to sort by item class at all
END


 SELECT item.item_id
	,	item.item_desc
	,	item.item_class_id
	,	item_class.item_class_desc
	,	item.uom_id
	,	uom.description uom_description
	,	item.template
	,	item.lifetime
	,	item.unit_cost
	,	item.obsolete
	,	item.purchased
	,	item.sold
	,	item.num_decimals
	,	item.must_complete_steps
	,	item.must_prod_reqd_qty
	,	item.min_grade
	,	item.min_state
	,	item.min_inv_level
	,	item.reorder_amt
	,	item.auto_reorder
	,	item.lot_no_format
	,	item.last_lot_no
	,	item.max_lot_size
	,	item.sublot_no_format
	,	item.last_sublot_no
	,	item.serial_no_lvl
	,	item.max_sublot_size
	,	item.max_order_size
	,	item.min_trace_inv
	,	item.inv_unique_by_job
	,	item.notes
	,	item.spare1
	,	item.spare2
	,	item.spare3
	,	item.spare4
	,	item_class.produced
	,	item_class.consumed
	,	item_class.obsolete class_obsolete
	,	item.last_edit_comment
	,	item.last_edit_by
	,	item.last_edit_at
	,	CASE
			WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
			WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
			WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
			WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
		END AS item_display
	,	CASE
			WHEN @attr_value_class = '0' THEN item_class.item_class_id
			WHEN @attr_value_class = '1' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
			WHEN @attr_value_class = '2' THEN item_class.item_class_id + '(' + item_class.item_class_desc + ')'
			WHEN @attr_value_class = '3' THEN item_class.item_class_desc + '(' + item_class.item_class_id + ')'
		END AS item_class_display
FROM item item WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item_class item_class WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
WHERE ((item.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (item.item_desc = @item_desc OR @item_desc IS NULL) AND
       (item.item_class_id = @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL) AND
       (item.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (item.template = ABS(@template) OR @template IS NULL) AND
       (item.lifetime = @lifetime OR @lifetime IS NULL) AND
       (item.unit_cost = @unit_cost OR @unit_cost IS NULL) AND
       (item.obsolete = @obsolete OR @obsolete IS NULL) AND
       (item.purchased = ABS(@purchased) OR @purchased IS NULL) AND
       (item.sold = ABS(@sold) OR @sold IS NULL) AND
       (item.num_decimals = @num_decimals OR @num_decimals IS NULL) AND
       (item.must_complete_steps = ABS(@must_complete_steps) OR @must_complete_steps IS NULL) AND
       (item.must_prod_reqd_qty = ABS(@must_prod_reqd_qty) OR @must_prod_reqd_qty IS NULL) AND
       (item.min_grade = @min_grade OR @min_grade IS NULL) AND
       (item.min_state = @min_state OR @min_state IS NULL) AND
       (item.min_inv_level = @min_inv_level OR @min_inv_level IS NULL) AND
       (item.auto_reorder = ABS(@auto_reorder) OR @auto_reorder IS NULL) AND
       (item_class.produced = ABS(@class_produced) OR @class_produced IS NULL) AND
       (item_class.consumed = ABS(@class_consumed) OR @class_consumed IS NULL) AND
       (item_class.obsolete = @class_obsolete OR @class_obsolete IS NULL) AND
       (item.serial_no_lvl = @serial_no_lvl OR @serial_no_lvl IS NULL) AND
       (item.inv_unique_by_job = ABS(@inv_unique_by_job) OR @inv_unique_by_job IS NULL) AND
       (item.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (item.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (item.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (item.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (item.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (item.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY
	CASE @class_sort
        WHEN '0' THEN item_class.item_class_id
        WHEN '1' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
        WHEN '2' THEN item_class.item_class_id
        WHEN '3' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
    END,
    CASE @attr_value_class
        WHEN '3' THEN item_class.item_class_id
    END,
    CASE @attr_value
        WHEN '0' THEN item.item_id
        WHEN '1' THEN item.item_desc
        WHEN '2' THEN item.item_id
        WHEN '3' THEN item.item_desc
        ELSE item.item_id
    END,
    CASE @attr_value
        WHEN '3' THEN item.item_id
    END

FROM job_exec job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (job_exec.ent_id = @ent_id AND
       job_exec.job_pos = @job_pos)

-- *******************************************************************************************************************************************************
-- Name				: sp_U_ofi_QM_Sample_GenerateASample
-- Description		: This SP will create sample in MES.  Extented the existing functionality of the standard SP: 'sp_U_Sample_GenerateASample'. 
-- Usage			: Manual Sample request UI
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour				Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change Description
-- 01.00			Veervar Joshi		2024-03-20				Initial draft
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *********************************************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_QM_Sample_GenerateASample] (
	@ent_name STRING80
	,@site_name STRING80
	,@qm_spec_name STRING80
	,@ver_id STRING40 = NULL
	,@sample_name STRING80 = NULL
	,@item_id STRING80 = NULL
	,@wo_id STRING80 = NULL
	,@oper_id STRING80 = NULL
	,@seq_no INT32 = NULL
	,@plan_name STRING80 = NULL
	,@requested_time_local TDATETIME = NULL
	,@requested_time_utc TDATETIME = NULL
	,@expiry_time INT32 = NULL
	,@warning_time INT32 = NULL
	,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
	,@sample_id INT32 = 0 OUTPUT
	)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @qm_ent_id INT32
		,@can_capture_qm_data LOGICAL
		,@can_capture_util LOGICAL
		,@qm_spec_id INT32
		,@current_datetime_utc TDATETIME
		,@warning_time_utc TDATETIME
		,@expiry_time_utc TDATETIME
		,@template_sample_name STRING80
		,@reset_option INT32
		,@freq_id INT32
		,@freq_name STRING80
		,@plan_id INT32
		,@char_name STRING80
		,@sample_status INT32
		,@err_msg NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@last_edit_by STRING80
		,@sample_name_instance STRING80
		,@current_sample_no INT32

	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,@current_datetime_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	--Get the entity ID using the supplied entity name and site name
	SET @qm_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

	--Verify whether the supplied entity exist in the MES database, if not raise an exception to the caller.
	IF (@qm_ent_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--SET @err_msg = 'The supplied entity: %1 does not exist in the database.{7557},' + COALESCE(@ent_name, '')
		SET @err_msg = 'Test mesageThe supplied entity: %1 does not exist in the database.{7557},' + COALESCE(@ent_name, '')+ @qm_spec_name
		RAISERROR (
				@err_msg
				,16
				,1
				)

		RETURN
	END

	--Retrieve the can_capture_* properties for utilization and qm_data
	SELECT @can_capture_util = e.can_capture_util
		,@can_capture_qm_data = e.can_capture_qm_data
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE e.ent_id = @qm_ent_id

	--Verify whether the supplied entity can capture QM data, if not raise an error to the caller.
	IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'This entity does not have the %1 capability flag set.{4710},can_capture_qm_data'

		RAISERROR (
				@err_msg
				,16
				,1
				)
	END

	IF (@requested_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @requested_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @requested_time_utc)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@requested_time_local IS NULL)
			SET @requested_time_utc = @current_datetime_utc
		ELSE
			--Get the requested time in UTC to verify whether the supplied requested time is in the future or not.
			SET @requested_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@qm_ent_id, @requested_time_local, DATEADD(MI, - @time_zone_bias_value, @requested_time_local))
	END

	--Get the requested time (in local) based on the requested time UTC.
	SET @requested_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @requested_time_utc)

	--Raise an error if the supplied requested time (in UTC) is greater than the current date and time (in UTC).
	IF (@requested_time_utc > @current_datetime_utc)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR (
				'The sample request time cannot be in the future.{7558}'
				,16
				,1
				)

		RETURN
	END

	--Reset the warning time and expiry time to NULL, if they have a value less than zero.
	IF (@warning_time < 0)
		SET @warning_time = NULL

	IF (@expiry_time < 0)
		SET @expiry_time = NULL

	--Determine the warning time and expiry time (relative to requested time UTC) using the supplied values
	SELECT @warning_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @warning_time, @requested_time_utc)
		,@expiry_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @expiry_time, @requested_time_utc)

	--Raise an error if the supplied warning time is greater than or equal to the expiry time
	IF (
			@warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL
			AND @expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL
			AND @warning_time_utc >= @expiry_time_utc
			)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR (
				'The warning time cannot be greater than or equal to the expiry time.{7559}'
				,16
				,1
				)

		RETURN
	END

	IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Raise an error if the supplied item contains a non-null value, but the item does not exist in the database.
		IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 1
				FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE item_id = @item_id
				)
		BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied item: %1 does not exist in the database.{7560},' + @item_id

			RAISERROR (
					@err_msg
					,16
					,1
					)

			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Verify whether this sample is generated for the job context.
	IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL)
		OR (
			@wo_id IS NOT NULL
			AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL
			AND @seq_no IS NULL
			)
	BEGIN
		IF (
				@wo_id IS NOT NULL
				AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL
				AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL
				)
		BEGIN
			--Raise an error if the supplied job contains a non-null value, but the job does not exist in the database.
			IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
						AND oper_id = @oper_id
						AND seq_no = @seq_no
					)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR (
						'The specified job does not exist in the database.{3176}'
						,16
						,1
						)

				RETURN
			END
		END

		IF (
				@item_id IS NOT NULL
				AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL
				AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL
				AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL
				)
		BEGIN
			--Raise an error if the supplied job does not produce the supplied item.
			IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
						AND oper_id = @oper_id
						AND seq_no = @seq_no
						AND item_id = @item_id
					)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR (
						'The supplied item does not match with the existing job item{3561}'
						,16
						,1
						)

				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	--Raise an error if the supplied QM spec does not exist in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
				AND (
					ver_id = @ver_id
					OR @ver_id IS NULL
					)
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The supplied QM spec: %1 does not exist in the database.{7561},' + COALESCE(@qm_spec_name, '')

		RAISERROR (
				@err_msg
				,16
				,1
				)

		RETURN
	END

	--Raise an error if the supplied QM spec was not active during the sample requested time.
	IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
				AND (
					ver_id = @ver_id
					OR @ver_id IS NULL
					)
				AND start_eff_utc <= @requested_time_utc
				AND (
					end_eff_utc > @requested_time_utc
					OR end_eff_utc IS NULL
					)
			)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR (
				'The supplied QM spec was not active during the requested time of a sample.{7562}'
				,16
				,1
				)

		RETURN
	END

	--Retrieve the QM spec id, that is the most recent spec relative to the requested time.
	SELECT @qm_spec_id = qs.qm_spec_id
	FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN (
		SELECT qsmax.qm_spec_name
			,MAX(qsmax.start_eff_utc) start_eff_utc_max
		FROM qm_spec qsmax WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE qsmax.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
			AND (
				qsmax.ver_id = @ver_id
				OR @ver_id IS NULL
				)
			AND start_eff_utc <= @requested_time_utc
			AND (
				end_eff_utc > @requested_time_utc
				OR end_eff_utc IS NULL
				)
		GROUP BY qsmax.qm_spec_name
		) max_qm_spec ON qs.qm_spec_name = max_qm_spec.qm_spec_name
		AND qs.start_eff_utc = max_qm_spec.start_eff_utc_max
	WHERE qs.qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name

	--Raise an error if there is not at least one characteristic that is not unused attached to the supplied QM spec.
	IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
			WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
				AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0
			)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR (
				'To generate a sample, there must be at least one characteristic that is not unused that is attached to the QM spec.{7563}'
				,16
				,1
				)

		RETURN
	END

	--If the supplied sample request time UTC is the same as the current time, then retrieve the jobs that are currently running on this entity
	IF (@requested_time_utc = @current_datetime_utc)
		--If an item id or the job information is supplied, then retrieve the job that is running at the least job position to fill the job details.
		SELECT @wo_id = j.wo_id
			,@oper_id = j.oper_id
			,@seq_no = j.seq_no
			,@item_id = j.item_id
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id
			AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id
			AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
		INNER JOIN (
			SELECT MIN(je.job_pos) job_pos
			FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id
				AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id
				AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
			WHERE je.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
				AND (
					j.wo_id = @wo_id
					OR @wo_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					j.oper_id = @oper_id
					OR @oper_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					j.seq_no = @seq_no
					OR @seq_no IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					j.item_id = @item_id
					OR @item_id IS NULL
					)
			) runon_job_min_job_pos ON je.job_pos = runon_job_min_job_pos.job_pos
		WHERE je.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--The supplied sample request time is in the PAST, therefore find the job that ran at this time on this entity.
		--If this entity is capable of capturing utilization data, then get the job information from the job_history table;
		--otherwise get the job information from the job_event table.
		IF (@can_capture_util = 1)
			SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = jull.wo_id
				,@oper_id = jull.oper_id
				,@seq_no = jull.seq_no
				,@item_id = jull.item_id
			FROM job_history jull WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jull.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
				AND jull.job_start_utc <= @requested_time_utc
				AND (
					jull.wo_id = @wo_id
					OR @wo_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					jull.oper_id = @oper_id
					OR @oper_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					jull.seq_no = @seq_no
					OR @seq_no IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					jull.item_id = @item_id
					OR @item_id IS NULL
					)
			ORDER BY jull.job_start_utc DESC
				,jull.job_pos ASC
		ELSE
			--Since this entity is not capable of capturing utilziation data, get the job information from the job_event table.
			SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = je.wo_id
				,@oper_id = je.oper_id
				,@seq_no = je.seq_no
				,@item_id = je.item_id
			FROM job_event je WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE je.event_time_utc <= @requested_time_utc
				AND je.ent_id = @qm_ent_id
				AND je.event_type = 'JobStateChanged'
				AND (
					je.wo_id = @wo_id
					OR @wo_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					je.oper_id = @oper_id
					OR @oper_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					je.seq_no = @seq_no
					OR @seq_no IS NULL
					)
				AND (
					je.item_id = @item_id
					OR @item_id IS NULL
					)
				AND (je.value1 = 3)
			ORDER BY je.event_time_utc DESC
	END

	-- Verify whether a plan name is supplied.
	IF (@plan_name IS NOT NULL)
		--The supplied plan name contains a non-null value, therefore, retrieve the plan_id from the supplied plan name.
		SELECT @plan_id = sp.plan_id
		FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sp.plan_name = @plan_name

	--Verify whether a valid plan ID is identified.
	IF (@plan_id IS NULL)
		--A valid plan_id could not be retrieved using the supplied plan name, therefore retrieve the plan_id using the QM spec determined.
		SELECT @plan_id = qs.plan_id
		FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE qs.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id

	--Get the freq ID (manual)
	SELECT @freq_id = MIN(sf.freq_id)
	FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN sample_plan_freq_link spfl WITH (NOLOCK) ON sf.freq_id = spfl.freq_id
	WHERE --sf.freq_type = 19
		--AND 
		spfl.plan_id = @plan_id

	--Get the frequency ID (manual) if none of the frequencies attached to the sample plan has a manual frequency.
	IF (@freq_id IS NULL)
		SELECT @freq_id = MIN(sf.freq_id)
		FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sf.freq_type = 19

	--Verify whether a sample name is supplied.
	--If a sample name is supplied, then set the plan_id as null, because we don't want to generate conflicting samples names for a plan id.
	IF (@sample_name IS NOT NULL)
		SET @plan_id = NULL
	ELSE
	BEGIN -- sample name is not supplied.
		--Get the frequency name using the frequency ID.
		IF (@freq_id IS NOT NULL)
			SELECT @freq_name = sf.freq_name
			FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sf.freq_id = @freq_id

		--Get the sample plan details
		SELECT @plan_name = sp.plan_name
			,@template_sample_name = sp.sample_name
			,@reset_option = sp.reset_option
		FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sp.plan_id = @plan_id

		--Get the first characteristic assigned for this QM spc.
		SELECT TOP 1 @char_name = c.char_name
		FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
		WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
			AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0

		-- Get the sample name for this requested time
		EXEC sp_SA_GetNextSampleName @plan_id = @plan_id
			,@plan_name = @plan_name
			,@temp_sample_name = @template_sample_name
			,@reset_option = @reset_option
			,@requested_time_local = @requested_time_local
			,@ent_name = @ent_name
			,@wo_id = @wo_id
			,@oper_id = @oper_id
			,@seq_no = @seq_no
			,@segment_requirement_id = NULL
			,@segment_response_id = NULL
			,@item_id = @item_id
			,@char_name = @char_name
			,@qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name
			,@freq_name = @freq_name
			,@prev_sample_name_instance = NULL
			,@next_sample_name = @sample_name OUTPUT
			,@sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance OUTPUT
			,@next_sample_id = @current_sample_no OUTPUT

		--If the sample instance name is empty, then there are no replaceable parameters except octothorpes, therefore replace the instance name with '-'
		IF (@sample_name_instance = '')
			AND (
				@current_sample_no IS NOT NULL
				AND @current_sample_no > 0
				)
			SET @sample_name_instance = '-'

		IF (
				@template_sample_name IS NOT NULL
				AND @sample_name_instance IS NOT NULL
				AND @current_sample_no IS NOT NULL
				)
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (
					SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM last_sample_no lsn WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE lsn.sample_name_template = @template_sample_name
						AND lsn.sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance
					)
				--Update the last_sample_no table with the current sample no from the sample_to_go table
				UPDATE last_sample_no
				SET current_sample_no = @current_sample_no
					,last_edit_at = @current_datetime_utc
				WHERE sample_name_template = @template_sample_name
					AND sample_name_instance = @sample_name_instance
					AND current_sample_no < @current_sample_no
			ELSE
				--Insert the ordinal numbers (if any) into last_sample_no table from the sample_to_go records if they were not already recorded.
				INSERT INTO last_sample_no (
					sample_name_template
					,sample_name_instance
					,current_sample_no
					,last_edit_at
					)
				VALUES (
					@template_sample_name
					,@sample_name_instance
					,@current_sample_no
					,@current_datetime_utc
					)
		END
	END -- sample name is not supplied.

	--Get the warning time and the expiry time from the frquency definition if any of these values are not supplied.
	IF (
			@warning_time IS NULL
			OR @expiry_time IS NULL
			)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @warning_time = COALESCE(@warning_time, CASE 
					WHEN sf.warning_unit = 1
						THEN sf.warning_time
					WHEN sf.warning_unit = 2
						THEN sf.warning_time * 60
					WHEN sf.warning_unit = 3
						THEN sf.warning_time * 1440
					ELSE NULL
					END)
			,@expiry_time = COALESCE(@expiry_time, CASE 
					WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 1
						THEN sf.expiry_time
					WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 2
						THEN sf.expiry_time * 60
					WHEN sf.expiry_unit = 3
						THEN sf.expiry_time * 1440
					ELSE NULL
					END)
		FROM sample_freq sf WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sf.freq_id = @freq_id

		--Determine the warning time and expiry time (relative to requested time UTC) using the supplied values
		SELECT @warning_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @warning_time, @requested_time_utc)
			,@expiry_time_utc = DATEADD(MI, @expiry_time, @requested_time_utc)

		--Raise an error if the supplied warning time is greater than or equal to the expiry time
		IF (
				@warning_time_utc IS NOT NULL
				AND @expiry_time_utc IS NOT NULL
				AND @warning_time_utc >= @expiry_time_utc
				)
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR (
					'The warning time cannot be greater than or equal to the expiry time.{7559}'
					,16
					,1
					)

			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT
		,NULL

	--Determine the sample status (relative the requested time and the current time UTC).
	SET @sample_status = CASE 
			WHEN @current_datetime_utc <= COALESCE(@expiry_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc + 1)
				AND @current_datetime_utc >= COALESCE(@warning_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc + 1)
				THEN 2
			WHEN @current_datetime_utc > COALESCE(@expiry_time_utc, @current_datetime_utc + 1)
				THEN 3
			ELSE 1
			END

	--Create an ad-hoc sample.
	INSERT INTO sample (
		ent_id
		,sample_name
		,item_id
		,wo_id
		,oper_id
		,seq_no
		,freq_id
		,plan_id
		,requested_time_utc
		,requested_time_local
		,expiry_time_utc
		,expiry_time_local
		,warning_time_utc
		,warning_time_local
		,final
		,sample_status
		,last_edit_by
		,last_edit_at
		)
	VALUES (
		@qm_ent_id
		,@sample_name
		,@item_id
		,@wo_id
		,@oper_id
		,@seq_no
		,@freq_id
		,@plan_id
		,@requested_time_utc
		,@requested_time_local
		,@expiry_time_utc
		,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @expiry_time_utc)
		,@warning_time_utc
		,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @warning_time_utc)
		,0
		,@sample_status
		,@last_edit_by
		,@current_datetime_utc
		)

	--Get the ID of the sample
	SET @sample_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	--Include all the sample characteristics that are NOT un-used for this sample for the supplied QM spec
	INSERT INTO sample_char_link (
		sample_id
		,char_id
		,qm_spec_id
		,control_move
		,ignore_sample
		,act_sample_size
		,last_edit_by
		,last_edit_at
		)
	SELECT @sample_id
		,qscl.char_id
		,@qm_spec_id
		,0
		,0
		,0
		,@last_edit_by
		,@current_datetime_utc
	FROM qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.char_id = c.char_id
	WHERE qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id
		AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) > 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cert_Job_Step_Link]
(
	@cert_name			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@cert_level			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_BG_Minutely_Tasks]
(@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author             -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.11
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 09/08/2004     Sheetal Jain  2040   Moved util log updates ahead of job updates.
-- 11/09/2004	Raghu		2.1.8	Changed GetDate() to GETUTCDATE()
-- 01/13/2005     SJ            2111   HD#5134 - Don't change scheduled finish time for a job unless specifically directed to
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--12/28/2006	Raghu		3.1.26	HD# 9229, Wait period before session cleanup
--01/24/2007    Raghu       3.4.1 L00074339;  Periodic data collection.
--02/12/2008	Raghu	3.4	L00074324; Stop a step when elapsed
-- 09/20/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 201085 - Changed the call from sp_U_Util_Log_UpdAllDurations to sp_U_Util_History_ChngEvntWhenReasElap
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @timenow datetime
 ,@current_time	TDATETIME
BEGIN
  -- NB SQL Server Agent Service MUST be running for this task to be triggered periodically
  -- This SP triggered by SQL Server Agent Service every minute (or background service)
  -- Tasks to be performed every minute are as follows:
  --	Update duration of current util events
  -- If hour is up trigger the hourly SP ?
--	Exec SP_U_Labor_Exec_UpdLabDuration
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

  IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()
  SET @timenow = DATEADD(MI, -10, @current_time)

--  EXEC sp_D_Session_KillStaleSessions @timenow
 -- HD# 9229, Call the below SP to verify whether the DB is down before deleting the stale sessions.
  EXEC sp_BG_MT_VerifySessionStatus @time_zone_bias_value

  EXEC sp_U_Util_History_ChangeReasWhenElap @time_zone_bias_value

  --Check if automatic update of scheduled finish time is allowed for running jobs
  IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 311 AND attr_value = '1' )
    EXEC sp_U_JobFinishTime @time_zone_bias_value
  -- Insert entry into error log for testing
  --	EXECUTE sp_I_Error_Log 1, @timenow, 1, 'Minutely Tasks', 'NA', 'NA', 'NA', ''

  --Collect data periodically if configured.
  EXEC sp_I_DL_CollectPeriodicData

  EXEC sp_U_Job_Step_StopStepWhenElap @time_zone_bias_value
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ConvertRate]
(
@rate as TFLOAT,
@from_uom as INT32,
@to_uom as INT32
) returns TFLOAT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - fn_ConvertRate
-- Description	      - Convert the rate from one unit to another unit.
-- Author		- JimO
--
-- Date Created      - 05/27/2013
-- Version			 - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
      DECLARE @result_rate TFLOAT
      DECLARE @factor TFLOAT

      IF @from_uom = @to_uom
      BEGIN
            SELECT @result_rate = @rate
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
            IF @from_uom = 0 -- convert hrs/batch to something else
                  SELECT @result_rate =
                        CASE @to_uom
                              WHEN 1 THEN @rate * 60 -- convert to min/batch
                              WHEN 2 THEN @rate * 3600 -- convert to seconds/batch
                              WHEN 3 THEN 1/@rate -- convert to batches/hr
                              WHEN 4 THEN (1/(@rate*60)) -- convert to batches/min
                              WHEN 5 THEN (1/(@rate*3600)) -- convert to batches/second
                        END
            IF @from_uom = 1 -- convert minutes/batch to something else
                  SELECT @result_rate =
                        CASE @to_uom
                              WHEN 0 THEN @rate/60 -- convert to hrs/batch
                              WHEN 2 THEN @rate*60 -- convert to seconds/batch
                              WHEN 3 THEN (1/(@rate/60)) -- convert to batches/hr
                              WHEN 4 THEN 1/@rate -- convert to batches/min
                              WHEN 5 THEN (1/(@rate*60)) -- convert to batches/second
                        END
            IF @from_uom = 2 -- convert seconds/batch to something else
                  SELECT @result_rate =
                        CASE @to_uom
                              WHEN 0 THEN @rate/3660 -- convert to hrs/batch
                              WHEN 1 THEN @rate/60 -- convert to min/batch
                              WHEN 3 THEN (1/(@rate/3600)) -- convert to batches/hr
                              WHEN 4 THEN (1/(@rate/60)) -- convert to batches/min
                              WHEN 5 THEN 1/@rate -- convert to batches/sec
                        END
            IF @from_uom = 3 -- convert batches/hr to something else
                  SELECT @result_rate =
                        CASE @to_uom
                              WHEN 0 THEN 1/@rate -- convert to hrs/batch
                              WHEN 1 THEN (1/(@rate/60)) -- convert to min/batch
                              WHEN 2 THEN (1/(@rate/3600)) -- convert to seconds/batch
                              WHEN 4 THEN @rate/60 -- convert to batches/min
                              WHEN 5 THEN @rate/3600 -- convert to batches/sec
                        END
            IF @from_uom = 4 -- convert batches/min to something else
                  SELECT @result_rate =
                        CASE @to_uom
                              WHEN 0 THEN (1/(@rate*60)) -- convert to hrs/batch
                              WHEN 1 THEN 1/@rate -- convert to min/batch
                              WHEN 2 THEN (1/(@rate/60)) -- convert to seconds/batch
                              WHEN 3 THEN @rate*60 -- convert to batches/hr
                              WHEN 5 THEN @rate/60 -- convert to batches/sec
                        END
            IF @from_uom = 5 -- convert batches/sec to something else
                  SELECT @result_rate =
                        CASE @to_uom
                              WHEN 0 THEN (1/(@rate*3600)) -- convert to hrs/batch
                              WHEN 1 THEN (1/(@rate*60)) -- convert to min/batch
                              WHEN 2 THEN 1/@rate -- convert to seconds/batch
                              WHEN 3 THEN @rate*3600 -- convert to batches/hr
                              WHEN 4 THEN @rate*60 -- convert to batches/min
                        END
      END

      return @result_rate

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
-- Description:This will be used to select the Sub Lot Number
-- Note : Add SublotCounter Attribute on Line Level in MES Client
-- Usage:	This will be used to select the Sub Lot Number
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	MP     	2022-07-28			Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	YG     	2022-07-28			Added separate sublot_counter and sublot_no
-- 0.03.00	MP     	2023-09-14			Added 5 digit sublot logic
-- 0.04.00	AKM		2024-02-01			coding best practice and dead code cleaning
-- 0.05.00	JSC		2025-10-22			Bring back this version on QA to use job bom/ added fail safe for not deflot found
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot_bck20251023]
        @wo_id   NVARCHAR(40),
        @oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
        @seq_no  INT
AS
BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT ON;
		DECLARE @def_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40),
				@parent_ent_id INT,
				@attr_id       INT,
				@sublot_no     NVARCHAR(40),
				@sublot_counter NVARCHAR(40)
				
		SELECT  @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
		FROM    job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
				wo_id       = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no  = @seq_no
				AND bom_pos = 0
				
		--v0.05 added
		IF 	(@def_lot_no IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT  @def_lot_no = w.lot_no
			FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE
					w.wo_id = @wo_id
					AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
		END
		
		SELECT  @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id
		FROM    ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
		WHERE 	wo_id  	= @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no 	= @seq_no
			
		SELECT  @attr_id = a.attr_id
		FROM    attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE a.attr_desc  = 'SublotCounter'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2

		-- 1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
		--v0.05 Added
		SELECT @sublot_counter = REPLACE (ea.attr_value,',','')
		FROM    ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	ea.attr_id	= @attr_id
			AND ea.ent_id 	= @parent_ent_id
		
		--v0.5 Mod
		SELECT  @sublot_no = CONCAT( @def_lot_no, (FORMAT(CAST(@sublot_counter AS INT),'00000','en-US')))
		
		-- RETURN select
		SELECT  @sublot_counter sublot_counter,
				@sublot_no      sublot_no
END

CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_DestinationInvSummary] @ent_id as int
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_DestinationInvSummary  -
-- Description:	    Get the summation of the destination inv summary
--
-- Usage:			InventorySummary (01.00.00) from used to display the destination destination details
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-24						Find the  destination information
-- 0.02.00			Devesh			2024-02-01						Updated inline comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
Declare @item_id varchar(150), @item_seg_type varchar(150), @process_ent_id varchar(150), @pent_id as int, @chil_ent_id as int,@line_ent_id as int,
@seg_ent_id as int, @ent_type as varchar(40), @area_ent_id as int
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dline_ent_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dline_ent_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dseg_ent_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dseg_ent_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dline_seg_ent_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dline_seg_ent_id
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ditem_id') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ditem_id
--select @pent_id=parent_ent_id from ent with(nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id

select @ent_type=attr_value from ent_Attr ea with(nolock)  where  ea.ent_id=@ent_id and ea.attr_value in ('Area','Line','Segment')


If @ent_type = 'Area'
begin

select e.ent_id into #dline_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Line'  and e.parent_ent_id in (@ent_id)
--select * from #line_ent_id
select e.ent_id into #dseg_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Segment'  and e.parent_ent_id in (select * from #dline_ent_id)
--select * from #seg_ent_id


set @area_ent_id =@ent_id 

end
if @ent_type = 'Line' 
begin
--print 'Line'

--fetching area level entity
	
	select @area_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Line'  and e.ent_id in (@ent_id)

--fetching segment level entities
select e.ent_id into #dline_seg_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Segment'  and e.parent_ent_id in (@ent_id)



set @line_ent_id =@ent_id 

end
else if @ent_type = 'Segment'
begin

select @line_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Segment'  and e.ent_id in (@ent_id)
select @area_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id from ent e with(nolock)
inner join ent_Attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
where ea.attr_value ='Line'  and e.ent_id in (@line_ent_id)
	set @seg_ent_id =@ent_id
	
end


select distinct iel.item_id,oe.process_id into #ditem_id from oper_ent_link oe with(nolock)
inner join item_process_link iel with(nolock) on iel.process_id = oe.process_id
inner join item_attr ia with(nolock) on ia.item_id = iel.item_id 
where oe.ent_id=@area_ent_id 

select @item_seg_type=(case when ia.attr_value='' then '' else ia.attr_value end) from item_attr ia with(nolock) 
where item_id in (select item_id from #ditem_id)  and attr_id in (select ar.attr_id from attr ar with(nolock) where ar.attr_desc='Classification')



if @ent_type = 'Segment'  -- if the entity type is segment
begin
	select sl.ent_id,sl.storage_ent_id as st_ent_id,sl.item_group as item_group, e.ent_name as storage_unit,i.item_desc as item,u.abbreviation as uom_desc, sum(iv.qty_left) as mes_qty
	,'' as dcs_qty,iis.item_status_desc as item_Status,iis.item_status_desc as mes_status,'' as dcs_status,@item_seg_type as segeration_type,ig.item_grade_desc as item_grade
	 --,--el.oper_id--,*
	 from ent e with(nolock)
	 inner join ofi_ent_item_storage_link sl with(nolock) on sl.storage_ent_id = e.ent_id
	 inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.ent_id = sl.storage_ent_id
	 inner join item i with(nolock) on i.item_id = iv.item_id
	 inner join item_state iis with(nolock) on iis.item_status_cd= iv.status_cd
	 inner join uom u with(nolock) on u.uom_id = iv.uom_id
	 inner join item_grade ig with(nolock) on ig.item_grade_cd = iv.grade_cd
	 
	 where sl.type='destination' and sl.ent_id=@seg_ent_id 
	 
	 group by sl.ent_id,sl.storage_ent_id,sl.item_group, e.ent_name,i.item_desc,iv.qty_left,iis.item_status_desc,u.abbreviation,ig.item_grade_desc

else if @ent_type = 'Line'   -- if the entity type is line

	 from ent e with(nolock)
