	 inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.ent_id = sl.storage_ent_id
	 inner join item i with(nolock) on i.item_id = iv.item_id
	 inner join item_state iis with(nolock) on iis.item_status_cd= iv.status_cd
	 inner join uom u with(nolock) on u.uom_id = iv.uom_id
	 inner join item_grade ig with(nolock) on ig.item_grade_cd = iv.grade_cd
	 where sl.type='destination' and sl.ent_id in (select * from #dline_seg_ent_id) and iv.item_id in (select item_id from #ditem_id) 
	 group by sl.ent_id,sl.storage_ent_id,sl.item_group, e.ent_name,i.item_desc,iv.qty_left,iis.item_status_desc,u.abbreviation,ig.item_grade_desc
end
else if @ent_type = 'Area'  -- if the entity type is area
begin
		select sl.ent_id,sl.storage_ent_id as st_ent_id,sl.item_group as item_group, e.ent_name as storage_unit,i.item_desc as item,u.abbreviation as uom_desc, sum(iv.qty_left) as mes_qty
	,'' as dcs_qty,iis.item_status_desc as item_Status,iis.item_status_desc as mes_status,'' as dcs_status,@item_seg_type as segeration_type,ig.item_grade_desc as item_grade
	 --,--el.oper_id--,*
	 from ent e with(nolock)
	 inner join ofi_ent_item_storage_link sl with(nolock) on sl.storage_ent_id = e.ent_id
	 inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.ent_id = sl.storage_ent_id
	 inner join item i with(nolock) on i.item_id = iv.item_id
	 inner join item_state iis with(nolock) on iis.item_status_cd= iv.status_cd
	 inner join uom u with(nolock) on u.uom_id = iv.uom_id
	 inner join item_grade ig with(nolock) on ig.item_grade_cd = iv.grade_cd
	 where sl.type='destination' and sl.ent_id in (select * from #dseg_ent_id) and iv.item_id in (select item_id from #ditem_id) 
	 group by sl.ent_id,sl.storage_ent_id,sl.item_group, e.ent_name,i.item_desc,iv.qty_left,iis.item_status_desc,u.abbreviation,ig.item_grade_desc
end

	@row_id int, @new_entId int = null
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @lSpeed float
	Set @lSpeed=-1.0
	Declare @ent_id int
	Declare @item_id varchar(50)
	Declare @wo_id varchar(50)
	Declare @oper_id varchar(50)
	Declare @seq_no int
	Declare @req_qty float
	Declare @attr_ent float

	select @req_qty=req_qty, @wo_id=wo_id,@oper_id=oper_id,@seq_no=job_seq_no,@item_id=item_id,@ent_id=job_sched_entity_id, @lSpeed = Item_Speed from sdb..scheduler_exec where row_id=@row_id
	
	if (@new_entId is not null and @new_entId <> @ent_id)
	begin
		
		-- Check whether the move is a parent child move
		-- if parent child do below steps
		if exists (select 1 from ent where (ent_id = @ent_id and parent_ent_id = @new_entId) or (ent_id = @new_entId and parent_ent_id = @ent_id))

		select top 1 @attr_ent_new = attr_value from ent_attr ea
		inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
		where attr_desc='EquipPerformance' and ent_id = @new_entId 

		select top 1 @attr_ent = attr_value from ent_attr ea
		inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
		where attr_desc='EquipPerformance' and ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @lSpeed = (ISNULL(@attr_ent_new,100)/ISNULL(@attr_ent,100)) * @lSpeed
		END
		ELSE
		-- if not parent child .. change linespeed to null and let it fetch the speed.
		SET @lSpeed = null
		
		/*
		if @lSpeed is null
		begin

					;with AllPositions as 
					(select e.ent_id, e.parent_ent_id, ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea WITH(nolock)
										   INNER JOIN ENT E on E.ent_id = ea.ent_id
										   INNER JOIN attr A WITH(nolock)
												   ON A.attr_id = ea.attr_id
													  AND attr_desc = 'JobPositions' --'JobPositions' -- 'EquipPerformance'
													  )
					, ParentCount as (select parent_ent_id, count(parent_ent_id) parentcount from AllPositions group by parent_ent_id)

					Insert into @JobPositionTable
					select ent_id, A.parent_ent_id, P.parentcount from AllPositions A
					inner join ParentCount P on A.parent_ent_id = p.parent_ent_id where ent_id in (@ent_id,@new_entId)
					or p.parent_ent_id in (@ent_id,@new_entId)
		end
		*/
	end


	
	if @lSpeed is null 
	begin
	-- Declare the return variable here
	if exists(select * from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=@ent_id and item_id=@item_id)
		select @lSpeed=line_speed from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=@ent_id  and item_id=@item_id
	else
	--BEGIN
		if exists(select * from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=0 and item_id=@item_id)
			select @lSpeed=line_speed from sdb.sch.item_ent_speed with (NOLOCK) where ent_id=0 and item_id=@item_id
		else
			BEGIN
				Declare @attr_id int
				select @attr_id=attr_id from attr where attr_desc='Operation_time' and attr_grp=5

				--select @lSpeed = cast(@req_qty as float)  /(case when cast(attr_value as float) = 0.0 then 1 else cast(attr_value as float) end) from job_attr where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=0 and attr_id=@attr_id
				select @lSpeed = cast(item_speed as float)  from sdb..scheduler_exec where row_id=@row_id
			END
	end


	if(@lSpeed <0)
		select @lSpeed=@req_qty/2/60
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @lSpeed

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Grp_Ent_Link]
  (@grp_id int ,
   @ent_id int ,
   @accss bit ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at DATETIME,
   @propagate_to_child_ents bit =1 )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Verison		Changes
-- 06/16/2016		Varun		 5.3		Merge CR L00141405 HF-L00141091 Changes: Introduced a logical parameter(@propagate_to_child_ents).
--											Based on the input of the parameter recursive call to the cursor will be made or not in
--                                          order to update last_edit_at for all the child entities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @child_ent int

-- First Update access for this ent_id
UPDATE grp_ent_link
SET accss = @accss
   , last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(grp_id = @grp_id AND
        ent_id = @ent_id AND
        last_edit_at = @last_edit_at)
-- Now recurse thru all this entity's children to repeat the update
-- NB Cursor must be LOCAL for recursion
-- CR L00141405 : recurse thru all this entity's children only when @propagate_to_child_ents is passed as true i.e. 1 from the caller.
IF @propagate_to_child_ents = 1
BEGIN
DECLARE get_child_entities CURSOR LOCAL FOR
SELECT child_ent_id FROM ent_link WHERE parent_ent_id = @ent_id
OPEN get_child_entities
	FETCH NEXT FROM get_child_entities INTO @child_ent
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		-- Call SP recursively to update access for all children
		EXEC sp_U_Grp_Ent_Link @grp_id, @child_ent, @accss, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_at, @propagate_to_child_ents
		-- Fetch next child entity for ent_id
		FETCH NEXT FROM get_child_entities INTO @child_ent
	END
CLOSE get_child_entities
DEALLOCATE get_child_entities
END

--/*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--Procedure:          [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] 
--Create Date:        2025
--Author:             JSC
--Description:        To get a valid recorded timestamp for PROD or CONS so it will fall within a job run
--						The reason for this conversion is: 
--
/*

When a message is sent by automation it will be git the generated recorded time; it could be that in MES this timestamp a job was not running or has just finished.


*/

--Call by:            Common function; getting called from multiple SPs.                     
--Affected table(s):  
--                   
--Used By:            Functional Area:  
--
--	SELECT * FROM [ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] ('10000000','beanbulkintake',0,'2025-04-29 12:00:14.123')
--**********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
--SUMMARY OF CHANGES
--Date(yyyy-mm-dd)    Author				Ver					Comments
------------------- ------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--2025-04-29          JSC					1.0					First version
--*********************************************************************************************************************************************************************/

CREATE   FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp_bck_23_05_2025] (
    @mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no INT,
    @recorded_timestamp DATETIME
)
RETURNS @Result TABLE (
	record_min_Diff INT,
	recorded_timestamp_case INT,
    record_selected DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME;
    DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT;
    DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT;

	INSERT INTO @Result
    SELECT TOP 1
       CASE
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN 0
            WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
                THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp))
            ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
        END,
        CASE 
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN 1
            ELSE 500017
        END,
       CASE 
            WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
                THEN @recorded_timestamp
            WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
                THEN DATEADD(MILLISECOND, 100, jh.job_start_utc)
            ELSE DATEADD(MILLISECOND, -100, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()))
        END
    
    FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE jh.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
        AND jh.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
        AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN jh.job_start_utc <= @recorded_timestamp AND @recorded_timestamp <= ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())
            THEN 0
        WHEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp)) <= ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
            THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, jh.job_start_utc, @recorded_timestamp))
        ELSE ABS(DATEDIFF(SECOND, @recorded_timestamp, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())))
    END ASC;

    RETURN;
END;

--===================================================================================================================
    -- Name:    sp_I_ofi_set_Job_spec
    -- Description:  The stored procedure to set the job specs
    --  
    -- Usage:     
    -- ==================================================================================================================
    -- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)   Change description
    -- 0.01.00  CK          2022-12-08          Initial version
    -- 0.01.01  AML, XPM    2026-01-13          Added logic for CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe attribute
	-- 0.01.02  AML, XPM    2026-01-15          Updated the ent_group variable so the function doesn't return null.
	-- 0.01.02  AML, XPM    2026-01-16			Updated the ent_group variable with parent line.
	-- ==================================================================================================================
    CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_set_Job_spec] -- Stored Procedure Parameters
    @wo_id nvarchar(40),
    @oper nvarchar(40),
    @seq INT,
    @user_id nvarchar(100) = 'User' AS 
	BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @item_id nvarchar(100),
			@ent_id int,
			@ent_group nvarchar(100), -- Variable for EntityGroup
			@CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe int = 0 -- New variable, default 0


	SELECT  @item_id = j.item_id,
			@ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id,
			@ent_group = ea.attr_value 
	FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_link ep WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = ep.child_ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) ON ep.parent_ent_id = ea.ent_id
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	AND a.attr_desc = 'EntityGroup'	
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
    AND j.oper_id = @oper
    AND j.seq_no = @seq

	SELECT  @item_id AS Item,
			@ent_id AS ent,
			 @ent_group AS [EntityGroup_Attr] 

	SELECT  @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = TRY_CAST(oa.attr_value AS INT)
	FROM oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper
    AND a.attr_desc = 'CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe' 


	IF @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe IS NULL
	SET @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = 0 -- Delete existing specs if exist 
	DELETE FROM job_spec
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
    AND oper_id = @oper
    AND seq_no = @seq
    AND step_no = -1 IF @CreateAUTParamsWithoutRecipe = 0 BEGIN -- Insert into job_spec

	INSERT INTO job_spec (
        wo_id,
        oper_id,
        seq_no,
        step_no,
        spec_id,
        spec_value,
        act_spec_value,
        min_value,
        max_value,
        comments,
        access_level,
        last_edit_by,
        last_edit_at)
	SELECT  @wo_id,
            @oper,
            @seq,
			-1,
			omrp.spec_id,
			omrp.spec_value,
			omrp.spec_value,
			omrp.min_value,
			omrp.max_value,
			omrp.comments,
			0,
            @user_id,
			GETDATE()
	FROM ofi_master_recipe omr WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ofi_master_recipe_parameter omrp WITH(NOLOCK) ON omrp.recipe_name = omr.recipe_name
	WHERE omr.item_id = @item_id
    AND omr.ent_id = @ent_id
    AND omr.preferred = 'Y'
    AND omr.is_active = 'Y' -- Output

	SELECT  @wo_id,
			@oper,
			@seq,
			-1,
			omrp.spec_id,
			omrp.spec_value,
			omrp.min_value,
			omrp.max_value,
			omrp.comments,
			0,
			@user_id,
			GETDATE()
	FROM  ofi_master_recipe omr WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ofi_master_recipe_parameter omrp WITH(NOLOCK) ON omrp.recipe_name = omr.recipe_name
	WHERE omr.item_id = @item_id
    AND omr.ent_id = @ent_id
    AND omr.preferred = 'Y'
    AND omr.is_active = 'Y'
	END

	ELSE BEGIN -- Insert using the function based on EntityGroup
		--IF @oper = 'CakePowderPacking' 
			--SET @ent_group = 'Packing'  -- Small verification so we don't do it so hardcoded

	INSERT INTO job_spec (
        wo_id,
        oper_id,
        seq_no,
        step_no,
        spec_id,
        spec_value,
        act_spec_value,
        min_value,
        max_value,
        comments,
        access_level,
        last_edit_by,
        last_edit_at)

	SELECT  @wo_id,
			@oper,
			@seq,
			-1,
			f.spec_id,
			f.spec_value,
			f.spec_value,
			f.min_value,
			f.max_value,
			f.comments,
			0,
			@user_id,
			GETDATE()
	FROM ufn_ofi_GetJobSpecByEntityGroup(@wo_id, @oper, @seq, @ent_group) f -- Output
		
END
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_fg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24           Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	Karthik		2023-05-01			Changed MainHU from Spare3 to Spare2 and SubHU from Spare2 to Spare3.
-- 0.02.01  Lavkesh     2024-05-16		   For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- ===========================================================================================
 
 
CREATE                PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_fg_BAK_240902] as
begin
 
 
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT
 
 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
 
 
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION 
 
  		BEGIN
			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #temp

            Select  ip.spare3,ip.sublot_no,ip.wo_id,wo.bags_per_pallet,qty_prod,qty_prod_erp, ---(KN 01May23 Changed from ip.spare2 to ip.spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
                    u.description,ip.item_id,ip.created_at_local as last_edit_at,ip.lot_no,ip.row_id, --changed ip.last_edit_at to ip.created_at_local  0.02.01
					ip.seq_no,ip.oper_id
			into #temp
            from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
            inner join ofi_wo_ext wo  with (nolock) on wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id and wo.module <> 'PO'
			inner join wo w on w.wo_id = wo.wo_id and w.state_cd < 3	--- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
            inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
            inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
			inner join job_bom jb on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 
			--and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
            where qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod and i.item_class_id = 'FG'
			and ip.spare4 = '1'	---(KN 01May23 Changed from ip.spare2 to ip.spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
			--and ip.spare4 = '0'  (KN 23-Apr-23 - Ignoring this condition as discussed with Siva)
			and ip.spare3 is not null
 			
			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 from #temp)
			BEGIN
				--Select * from #temp

 				Declare @Subhu varchar(100),@subLot varchar(100),
				@lot_no varchar(100),@wo_id varchar(100),@item_id varchar(100),@item_class varchar(100),@row_id INT
				Declare @seq_no int,@oper_id varchar(100),@fg_lot_no varchar(100),@fg_sub_lot_no varchar(100)

				Select top 1 @Subhu = spare3, @lot_no = lot_no,@wo_id = wo_id,@item_id = item_id,@row_id = row_id,	---@subLot = isnull(sublot_no,'') ,
				@seq_no = seq_no, @oper_id = oper_id
				from #temp

				Declare @row INT

				Set @subLot = null

				
				Select top 1 @fg_lot_no = ic.lot_no,@fg_sub_lot_no = ic.sublot_no,	--(KN 24May23 - Changed logic to pick lot_no and sub_lot of consumption)
				@row = ic.row_id from item_cons ic 
				inner join item i on ic.item_id = i.item_id
				where ic.wo_id = @wo_id and ic.oper_id = @oper_id and ic.seq_no = @seq_no and i.item_class_id = 'SFG'	--(KN 18May23 - Added logic to pick only SFG items from consumption)
				order by ic.created_at_local desc	--(KN 13Apr23 - Retrieving subLot from item_cons instead of item_prod based on Bug #796)

				Print @fg_lot_no + ' - ' + @fg_sub_lot_no

				Select top 1 @subLot =  iif(len(isnull(ic.sublot_no,''))>10,RIGHT(sublot_no,10),null)  --(KN 24May23 Pick only last 10 digits for Batchmaker number)
				from item_cons ic where --fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no and	--(KN 31May23 - Excluding fg_lot_no as fg_sub_lot_no will contain the fg_lot_no anyways, as advised by Ajay)
				fg_sublot_no = @fg_sub_lot_no --(KN 24May23 - Use fg_lot details to find consumption lot details)


				--Update item_prod set last_edit_comment = @subLot, last_edit_at = GETDATE()  where row_id = @row_id	--(KN 18May23 - Added logic to store the subLot into last_edit_comment)

				Select @item_class = item_class_id from item where item_id = @item_id
 			
					BEGIN
           				select spare3 Handling_Unit_Number,wo_id Order_Number,		---(KN 01May23 Changed from spare2 to spare3 (spare3 is SubHU))
						--sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number,	-- SAP will ignore it in SFG
						@subLot Batch_Maker_Number,
						'101' Movement_Type, bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
						sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp) Quantity, description Unit_of_Measure,
						IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,T.item_id,ia.attr_value) SAP_MaterialCode_Number,		--(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)			
						Format(min(last_edit_at),'yyyyMMdd') Production_startdate,Format(min(last_edit_at),'hhmmss') Production_starttime,
						Format(max(last_edit_at),'yyyyMMdd') Production_enddate,Format(max(last_edit_at),'hhmmss') Production_endtime,
						
						lot_no SAP_Batch_Number,
						Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date,Format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_Generation_Time, 
						'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
						from 
						#temp T
						left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
							on T.item_id = ia.item_id	--(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
						where lot_no = @lot_no 
						--and isnull(sublot_no,'') = isnull(@subLot,'') 
						and spare3 = @Subhu 
          			   group by wo_id,bags_per_pallet,description,T.item_id,sublot_no,lot_no,spare3,ia.attr_value
 
 
           				Update ip set ip.qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod,last_edit_comment = @subLot, last_edit_at = GETDATE() from item_prod ip	---(KN 9/Feb/23 - Removed ,ip.spare4 = 1)
						inner join (Select * from #temp where lot_no = @lot_no and spare3 = @Subhu) t on ip.row_id = t.row_id 
					END
				END

        END
 
 

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
 
 
     BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
        RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
    END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Attr]
(@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @attr_id  int  = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700)  ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @mod_id  varchar(30))
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Attr
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	    Changes
-- 09/10/2002	  Raghu		    1.4	    Select only non-obsolete attributes
-- 09/15/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006	  Raghu		    3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 01/18/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0     Updated last_edit_by and last_edit_at field comparison
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 1

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

  SELECT item_attr.item_id
            ,item.item_desc
            ,item_attr.attr_id
            ,item_attr.attr_value
            ,item_attr.notes
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,item_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,item_attr.last_edit_by
            ,item_attr.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM item_attr item_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_attr.item_id = item.item_id
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((item_attr.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (item.obsolete = 0) AND
       (item_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (item_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY attr.attr_desc, item.item_desc
END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_grp_ent_link_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[grp_ent_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_grp_ent_link_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on grp_ent_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
--
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 07/16/2004     Sheetal Jain  2038    HD#4654 - Removing access to entity doesn't remove from default or last saved list
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Ent  INT32,
  @V_Grp  INT32
BEGIN
  DECLARE cur_ent CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT i.ent_id, i.grp_id FROM inserted i
    INNER JOIN deleted g ON i.ent_id = g.ent_id AND i.grp_id = g.grp_id
      WHERE g.accss = 1 AND i.accss = 0
  OPEN cur_ent
  WHILE (1=1)
  BEGIN
    FETCH cur_ent INTO @V_Ent, @V_Grp
    IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BREAK
    EXEC sp_D_Ent_Access @V_Grp, NULL, @V_Ent
  END
  CLOSE cur_ent
  DEALLOCATE cur_ent

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

  UPDATE grp_ent_link SET grp_ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, grp_ent_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
    FROM inserted i WHERE grp_ent_link.grp_id = i.grp_id AND grp_ent_link.ent_id = i.ent_id

END

AS

--

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	cert_oper_link.cert_name
		,	cert_oper_link.process_id
		,	cert_oper_link.oper_id
		,	cert_oper_link.cert_level
		,	process.process_desc
		,	oper.oper_desc
		,	cert_type.max_level
		,	cert_type.cert_audit
        ,	cert_oper_link.last_edit_comment
        ,	cert_oper_link.last_edit_by
        ,	cert_oper_link.last_edit_at
	FROM cert_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN oper WITH (NOLOCK) ON cert_oper_link.process_id = oper.process_id AND cert_oper_link.oper_id = oper.oper_id

BEGIN
	--Default the bias value to 0; if supplied as NULL value.
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	--Get the current time based on the Factelligence Bias settings.
	SET @current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	--Set the cut off time to delete the staled sessions.
	SET @cutoff_time = DATEADD(mi, -10, @current_time)

	--Retrieve the last time the Factelligence Service has ran (Minutely Task) on this database.
	--Also, retrieve the wait time from the db_status table.
	SELECT @fact_service_last_ran = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( service_last_ran ), @wait_time = wait_time
	FROM db_status WITH (NOLOCK)

	--Verify whether the factelligence service has ran before the cut off time.
	IF (@fact_service_last_ran <= @cutoff_time) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the wait time is NULL; that is current session state is in the wait state.
		--If not, set the wait time to 10 minutes.
		IF (@wait_time IS NULL) SET @wait_time = 10
		--If the sessions are already in the wait state, then reduce the current counter by 1.
		ELSE SET @wait_time = @wait_time - 1

		--Verify whether the wait state has reached to 0
		IF COALESCE(@wait_time, 0) <= 0 BEGIN
			--Clear the wait state, set the current time
			--Kill the staled sessions from the db.
			UPDATE db_status SET wait_time = NULL, service_last_ran = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )
			EXEC sp_D_Session_KillStaleSessions @cutoff_time
		END
			--If the wait state has not reached to 0; then update the current wait state to DB.
		ELSE UPDATE db_status SET wait_time = @wait_time
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The Factelligence service has run recently
		--Update the current time to the db_status table.
		UPDATE db_status SET wait_time = NULL, service_last_ran = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )

		--Call the below sp to kill staled sessions on this DB.
		EXEC sp_D_Session_KillStaleSessions @cutoff_time
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Line_Ent_Link]

   @reorder logical = 0,

   @last_edit_at DATETIME)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - sp_U_Line_Ent_Link
-- Description	  - Updates a line_ent_link record.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  -	02/25/2013
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0

--

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--02/25/2013	RaghuG		4.6	Support for line management
--04/05/2013	RaghuG		4.6	UserStories: 165903, 165492 - Assign an entity in a line as a bottleneck, assign parallel entity segments to a single position in a line
--06/17/2013	RaghuG		4.6	UserStory: 196762 - I need existing functionality to be retrofitted to detect a disabled entity on a line.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @can_run_jobs  BIT

BEGIN
SELECT @reorder = COALESCE(@reorder, 0), @can_be_bottleneck = COALESCE(@can_be_bottleneck, 1)

IF (@reorder = 1)
	--Reorder all the remaining lines for this entity
	UPDATE line_ent_link SET child_order = child_order + 1 WHERE line_id = @line_id AND child_order >= @child_order

IF (@line_is_child = 1) SELECT @segment_no = NULL

SET child_order = @child_order
	, input_pct = @input_pct
	, line_is_child = @line_is_child
	, segment_no = @segment_no
	, can_be_bottleneck = @can_be_bottleneck
	, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE line_id = @line_id
  AND ent_id = @ent_id
  AND last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
END

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_DL_IsCertificationReqd]
(
	@grp_id         INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@max_value      INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id          STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id        STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no         INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no        INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no         STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no      STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@cert_name      STRING40_NULL = NULL

)  RETURNS INT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - FN_DL_ISCERTIFICATIONREQD
-- Description          - Returns an available set of data_log_groups for the given job/step.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    12/07/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @row_count	INT
		,	@i			INT
		,	@max_i		INT
		,	@row_id		INT

	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @oper_id IS NULL OR @cert_name IS NULL) BEGIN
        RETURN 0
    END

    IF (@max_value = 16) BEGIN

		DECLARE @each_data_log_n_16 TABLE (
			id int identity,
			row_id int
		)

		INSERT INTO @each_data_log_n_16 ( row_id )
		SELECT dl16.row_id
		FROM data_log_16 dl16
        WHERE dl16.grp_id = @grp_id
          AND dl16.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND dl16.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND dl16.seq_no = @seq_no
          AND (dl16.step_no = @step_no OR ((dl16.step_no IS NULL OR dl16.step_no = -1) AND @step_no IS NULL))
          AND (dl16.lot_no = @lot_no OR ((dl16.lot_no IS NULL or dl16.lot_no = '-') AND @lot_no IS NULL))
          AND (dl16.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR ((dl16.sublot_no IS NULL or dl16.sublot_no = '-') AND @sublot_no IS NULL))

		SELECT @i = MIN( id ), @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @each_data_log_n_16

		WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

			select @row_id = row_id from @each_data_log_n_16 where id = @i

			IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_audit_log cal
                WHERE cal.wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND cal.oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND cal.seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND (cal.step_no = @step_no OR ((cal.step_no IS NULL OR cal.step_no = -1) AND @step_no IS NULL))
                  AND (cal.lot_no = @lot_no OR ((cal.lot_no IS NULL or cal.lot_no = '-') AND @lot_no IS NULL))
                  AND (cal.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (cal.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
                  AND cal.grp_id = @grp_id
                  AND cal.cert_name = @cert_name
                  AND cal.ref_row_id = @row_id ) BEGIN

				RETURN 1
			END

			SET @i = (@i + 1)
		END
	END ELSE BEGIN

			DECLARE @each_data_log_n_48 TABLE (
				id int identity,
				row_id int
			)

			INSERT INTO @each_data_log_n_48 ( row_id )
			SELECT dl48.row_id FROM data_log_16 dl48
            WHERE dl48.grp_id = @grp_id
              AND dl48.wo_id = @wo_id
              AND dl48.oper_id = @oper_id
              AND dl48.seq_no = @seq_no
              AND (dl48.step_no = @step_no OR ((dl48.step_no IS NULL OR dl48.step_no = -1) AND @step_no IS NULL))
              AND (dl48.lot_no = @lot_no OR ((dl48.lot_no IS NULL or dl48.lot_no = '-') AND @lot_no IS NULL))
              AND (dl48.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR ((dl48.sublot_no IS NULL or dl48.sublot_no = '-') AND @sublot_no IS NULL))

			SELECT @i = MIN( id ), @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @each_data_log_n_48

			WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

				select @row_id = row_id from @each_data_log_n_48 where id = @i

				IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_audit_log cal
                            WHERE cal.wo_id = @wo_id
                              AND cal.oper_id = @oper_id
                              AND cal.seq_no = @seq_no
                              AND (cal.step_no = @step_no OR ((cal.step_no IS NULL OR cal.step_no = -1) AND @step_no IS NULL))
                              AND (cal.lot_no = @lot_no OR ((cal.lot_no IS NULL or cal.lot_no = '-') AND @lot_no IS NULL))
                              AND (cal.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (cal.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
                              AND cal.grp_id = @grp_id
                              AND cal.cert_name = @cert_name
                              AND cal.ref_row_id = @row_id ) BEGIN

					RETURN 1
				END

				SET @i = (@i + 1)
			END
		END

	--IF( @row_count > 0 ) RETURN 1

    RETURN 0
END

                                         ON j.wo_id = @wo_id

                           INNER JOIN item_attr ia  (nolock)

                                         ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
                                                AND a.attr_desc = 'Category'

                     INNER JOIN item_attr ia2  (nolock)

								  order by id asc

       END
       
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Grp_CloneGroup]
(
		@grp_id					INT32 OUT
	,	@session_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@description			STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@source_user_group_id	INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_I_Grp_CloneGroup
-- Description			- Creates a new user group based on the given user group.
-- Author				- Aaron Lightfoot
-- Date Created			- 08/01/2008
-- Version				- 3.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @source_user_group_id ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid user group ID must be provided.{5796}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @description IS NULL OR @description = '' ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A valid description for the new group must be provided.{5797}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	DECLARE @last_edit_by AS STRING40, @last_edit_at AS STRING40

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_desc = @description ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'A user group with this description already exists.{5801}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	DECLARE	 @auth_method	INT
	SET @auth_method = 0
	SELECT @auth_method = auth_method  FROM grp_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @source_user_group_id

	INSERT INTO grp_name ( grp_desc, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, auth_method,last_edit_at )
	VALUES ( @description, NULL, @last_edit_by,@auth_method, @last_edit_at )

	SELECT @grp_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	IF ( @grp_id IS NULL OR @grp_id < 0 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'Creation of new user group failed.{5798}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	BEGIN TRY
		INSERT INTO grp_ent_link ( grp_id, ent_id, accss, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
		SELECT  @grp_id AS grp_id, ent.ent_id AS ent_id, gel.accss AS accss,
				NULL AS last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by AS last_edit_by, @last_edit_at AS last_edit_at
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN grp_ent_link gel WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = gel.ent_id
		WHERE gel.grp_id = @source_user_group_id
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		RAISERROR( 'Insertion of user group entity links failed.{5802}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END CATCH

	BEGIN TRY
		INSERT INTO grp_priv_link (grp_id, priv_id, priv_value, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT	@grp_id AS grp_id, priv.priv_id AS priv_id, gpl.priv_value AS priv_value,
				NULL AS last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by AS last_edit_by, @last_edit_at AS last_edit_at
		FROM priv WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN grp_priv_link gpl WITH (NOLOCK) ON priv.priv_id = gpl.priv_id
		WHERE gpl.grp_id = @source_user_group_id
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		RAISERROR( 'Insertion of user group privilege links failed.{5803}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END CATCH

	BEGIN TRY
		INSERT INTO user_grp_link ( grp_id, user_id, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
		SELECT @grp_id AS grp_id, ugl.user_id, null, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ugl.grp_id = @source_user_group_id
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		RAISERROR( 'Insertion of user group links failed.{5804}', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END CATCH

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_st_audittrail
-- Description:	The stored procedure will add the audit trail for the stock transfer start/stop/qty changes 
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer Audit trail
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	LK/Veervar				2024-01-24  		Initial version.

-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_st_audittrail]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@src_su_ent_id INT
	,@dest_su_ent_id int
	,@lineid int
	,@status int
	,@transType int
	,@target_qty nvarchar(50)
	,@qty_transferred nvarchar(50)
	,@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--VARIABLE DECLARATION
	
	DECLARE @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'StockTransfer'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@strCommentMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@delete_detail NVARCHAR(50) = NULL	
		,@keyField1 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField2 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField3 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField4 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField5 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField6 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL	
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
		,@log_id INT
		,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
		,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
		,@change_type INT = 1
		,@table_name NVARCHAR(80) = '[ofi_st_trans_selection]'
		,@row_id INT
		,@audit_category NVARCHAR(80) = 'Info'
		,@linestatus NVARCHAR(20)
	   DECLARE @newval NVARCHAR(max)
	   ,@oldVal NVARCHAR(MAX)
	   ,@prevLineStatus NVARCHAR(100)
		,@newlineEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStoragesrcEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStoragedestEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@transfertype nvarchar(120)
		DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName

		IF @status=5
		bEGIN
		set @linestatus='IDLE'
		SET @prevLineStatus='RUNNING'
		END
		IF @status=3
		BEGIN
		set @linestatus='RUNNING'
		SET @prevLineStatus='IDLE'

		END
		--select *from ent
		SELECT @row_id = max(row_id) + 1
			FROM ofi_st_trans_selection
		select @newlineEntId=description from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@lineid
		select @newStoragesrcEntId=description from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@src_su_ent_id
		select @newStoragedestEntId=description from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@dest_su_ent_id
		set @column_name='[transfer_status_cd]'
		if(@transType=3)
		begin
		set @transfertype=' ,Transfer Type:Manual, '+'Target QTY:'+@target_qty+' QTY Transferred:'+ISNULL(@qty_transferred,0)
		end
		if(@transType=1)
		begin
		set @transfertype=' ,Transfer Type:Empty Source silo, '+'Target QTY:'+@target_qty+' QTY Transferred:'+ISNULL(@qty_transferred,0)
		end
		if(@transType=2)
		begin
		set @transfertype=' ,Transfer Type:continuous,  QTY Transferred:'+ISNULL(@qty_transferred,0)
		end

		SET @newval =  ' Status: ' + @linestatus
		SET @oldVal =  ' Status: ' + @prevLineStatus


		EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		,@change_type
		,@table_name
		,@row_id
		,@column_name
		,@oldVal
		,@newval
		,@audit_comments
		,@delete_detail;

	UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
	SET origin = @strFunctionName
	WHERE log_id = @log_id;
	SET @newval = 'Line: ' + @newlineEntId + ' Source Storage: ' + @newStoragesrcEntId + ' Destination Storage: ' + @newStoragedestEntId + ' Status: ' + @linestatus
	SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Updated Values: ' + @newval + ''+@transfertype

	SET @strActivityMsg = 'Updated'

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
		log_id
		,keyField1
		,keyField2
		,keyField3
		,keyField4
		,module_id
		,function_id
		,spare1
		,spare2
		,spare3
		,spare4
		,spare5
		,spare6
		,audit_category
		,activity
		,comments
		,created_at_utc
		,created_at_local
		,created_by
		)
	VALUES (
		@log_id
		,@newlineEntId
		,@newStoragesrcEntId
		,@newStoragedestEntId
		,@linestatus
		,@strModuleName
		,@strFunctionName
		,@keyField1
		,@keyField2
		,@keyField3
		,@keyField4
		,@keyField5
		,@keyField6
		,@audit_category
		,@strActivityMsg
		,@strCommentMsg
		,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		);

END

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.15
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver   Changes
-- 10/28/2004     SJ            2105  HD#4367 - Null out referenced fields when capability removed
-- 11/21/2005     KF            3103  Extend to new def_reject_ent_id fields and *_subst tables
-- 04/27/2006     SJ            31015 HD#6475 - database error when modifying an Entity
-- 12/29/2006     KRF           3.2.1 Do not delete item_transfer records just because source or destination can no longer store
--                                    Also add check that there are no movable storage entities located here
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	--Check if any material is stored at this location
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 '1' FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Materials are still stored at this inventory location.<4068>', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	-- Check if any movable storage entities located here
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 '1' FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE storage_ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('One or more movable storage entities are located in/at this entity.<5241>', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Update rows in nullable table fields that may reference this ent
	UPDATE job_exec SET def_to_ent_id = null WHERE def_to_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE job_exec SET def_from_ent_id = null WHERE def_from_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE job_exec SET def_reject_ent_id = null WHERE def_reject_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE bom_item SET def_storage_ent_id = null WHERE def_storage_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE bom_item SET def_reject_ent_id = null WHERE def_reject_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE job_bom SET def_storage_ent_id = null WHERE def_storage_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE job_bom SET def_reject_ent_id = null WHERE def_reject_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE item_subst SET def_storage_ent_id = null WHERE def_storage_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE item_subst SET def_reject_ent_id = null WHERE def_reject_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE bom_item_subst SET def_storage_ent_id = null WHERE def_storage_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE bom_item_subst SET def_reject_ent_id = null WHERE def_reject_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE job_bom_subst SET def_storage_ent_id = null WHERE def_storage_ent_id = @ent_id
	UPDATE job_bom_subst SET def_reject_ent_id = null WHERE def_reject_ent_id = @ent_id
	-- DELETE item_transfer WHERE from_ent_id = @ent_id OR to_ent_id = @ent_id  <- This is done in sp_D_Ent

	DELETE storage_exec WHERE (ent_id = @ent_id)
END

-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_conf
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-10-10		   Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_conf__BAK_240902] as
begin

DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION

		declare @main_hu varchar(100),@wo_id varchar(100),@prod_bags_per_pallet varchar(10),@uom varchar(40),@item_id varchar(100),@row_id int
		SET @main_hu = ''
		Select top 1 @row_id = row_id, @wo_id = wo_id,@main_hu = spare2,@item_id = item_id from item_prod with (nolock) where qty_prod_erp < qty_prod and spare2 is not null
		SET @prod_bags_per_pallet = 0
		Select @prod_bags_per_pallet = bags_per_pallet from ofi_wo_ext with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id

		IF @main_hu <> ''
		BEGIN
			Select @uom = u.description from item i with (nolock) inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id = u.uom_id where item_id = @item_id

			Select @main_hu Handling_Unit_Number,@wo_id Order_Number, '' Batch_Maker_Number, 
			@prod_bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet, sum(qty_prod) Quantity, @uom  Unit_Of_Measure,
			@item_id SAP_MaterialCode_Number, Format(min(created_at_local),'yyyyddMM') Production_startdate,
			Format(min(created_at_local),'hhmmss') Production_starttime,Format(max(created_at_local),'yyyyddMM') Production_enddate,
			Format(max(created_at_local),'hhmmss') Production_endtime,max(lot_no) SAP_Batch_Number,Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyddMM') File_Generation_Date,
			Format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_Generation_Time, '' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
			from item_prod with (nolock) where row_id = @row_id --wo_id = @wo_id and spare2 = @main_hu 
			group by wo_id,spare2

			Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = qty_prod where row_id = @row_id --wo_id = @wo_id and spare2 = @main_hu
		END
		ELSE
			PRINT 'Main HU missing - Row ' + cast(@row_id as varchar)

		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Attr_GetAttrs]
(@item_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description	      - Raghu
-- Author	      - Get all attributes that are associated to an item.
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/10/2002	Raghu		1.4	Select only non-obsolete attributes
--09/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  SELECT item_attr.item_id
            ,item_attr.attr_id
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,item.item_desc
            ,item_attr.attr_value
            ,item_attr.notes
            ,item_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,item_attr.last_edit_by
            ,item_attr.last_edit_at
	,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id) <=
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal
			INNER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cal.cert_name = cul.cert_name
			WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id AND cul.user_id = @user_id AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level)
		THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		editable
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM item item WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN item_attr item_attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = item_attr.item_id
  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id

ORDER BY attr.attr_desc, item.item_desc

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	cert_oper_step_link.cert_name
		,	cert_oper_step_link.process_id
		,	cert_oper_step_link.oper_id
		,	cert_oper_step_link.step_no

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Wo]
(
	@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@wo_desc nvarchar(80) ,
	@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@bom_ver_id NVARCHAR(80) ,
	@spec_ver_id NVARCHAR(80),
	@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@req_qty float ,
	--@release_time datetime , -- 07/25/2007 AML
	@release_time_local datetime,
	@release_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
	--@req_finish_time datetime , -- 07/25/2007 AML
	@req_finish_time_local datetime,
	@req_finish_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@state_cd int,
	@wo_priority int ,
	@cust_info nvarchar(80) ,
	@mo_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@production_schedule_id nvarchar(80),
	@notes NOTES ,
	@not_deletable bit,
	@disassembly bit,
	@may_override_route bit,
	@override_serialization bit,
        @input_wo_id nvarchar(40),
        @input_oper_id nvarchar(40),
        @input_seq_no int,
	@spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare2 nvarchar(80),
	@spare3 nvarchar(80),
	@spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
	@mod_id varchar(30) ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 04/01/2003		Raghu			1.6.0	Included state_cd field for updates - part of DB V1.6 changes
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/13/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 07/25/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes; Removed @release_time and @req_finish_time from parameters, replaced
--											with @release_time_local and @req_finish_time_local.  Added @release_time_local,
--											@release_time_utc, @req_finish_time_utc, and @req_finish_time_local to update.
-- 10/31/2007		AML				3.4.0	DB Changes
-- 07/17/2009       SLR             4.0.0   DB Changes
-- 08/21/2009       Raghu			4.0.0   DB Changes
-- 11/27/2009		Kishore			4.1		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
-- 02/05/2020       Jim O'Hearn     6.2.0   Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @release_time_utc DATETIME, @req_finish_time_utc DATETIME, @dbg_resp INT32

SELECT	@not_deletable = ISNULL( @not_deletable, 0 )
	,	@disassembly = ISNULL( @disassembly, 0 )
	,	@may_override_route = ISNULL( @may_override_route, 0 )
	,	@override_serialization = ISNULL( @override_serialization, 0 )

  SET @release_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
  SET @release_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@release_time_local, @release_time_tz)
  SET @req_finish_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
  SET @req_finish_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@req_finish_time_local, @req_finish_time_tz)

  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Wo', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @release_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @release_time_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val2 = @req_finish_time_tz

IF ( @release_time_local IS NOT NULL ) SET @release_time_utc = DATEADD( mi, -@release_time_tz, @release_time_local )
IF ( @req_finish_time_local IS NOT NULL ) SET @req_finish_time_utc = DATEADD( mi, -@req_finish_time_tz, @req_finish_time_local )

UPDATE wo
SET wo_desc = @wo_desc,
    process_id = @process_id,
    bom_ver_id = @bom_ver_id,
    spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id,
    item_id = @item_id,
    req_qty = @req_qty,
    --release_time = @release_time, -- 07/25/2007 AML
	release_time_utc = @release_time_utc,
	release_time_local = @release_time_local,
    --req_finish_time = @req_finish_time, -- 07/25/2007 AML
	req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc,
	req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local,
    state_cd = @state_cd,
    wo_priority = @wo_priority,
    cust_info = @cust_info,
    mo_id = @mo_id,
    production_schedule_id = @production_schedule_id,
    notes = @notes,
    not_deletable = @not_deletable,
    disassembly = @disassembly,
    may_override_route = @may_override_route,
	override_serialization = @override_serialization,
        input_wo_id = @input_wo_id,
        input_oper_id = @input_oper_id,
        input_seq_no = @input_seq_no,
	spare1 = @spare1,
	spare2 = @spare2,
	spare3 = @spare3,
	spare4 = @spare4,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(wo_id = @wo_id AND
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_BIOSL_to_Job_BOM_step]
@wo_id                NVARCHAR(40),
@J_seq_no             INT,
@BIOL_parent_item_id  NVARCHAR(40),
@BIOL_ver_id          NVARCHAR(40),
@BIOL_BOM_pos         INT,
@process_id           NVARCHAR(40),
@BIOL_oper_id         NVARCHAR(40)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	SP_BIOSL_TO_JOB_BOM_STEP
-- Description	      -
-- Author             -
-- Date Created	      -	03/18/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.8
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver   Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/22/2002     Sheetal Jain  -     Changes as per modified spec
-- 06/16/2004	  Raghu		2.1.0 Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 11/11/2004     SJ            2108  Primary key constraint violation error.
--08/01/2005	  Raghu		2.1.25 HD# 6051, Foreign Key error while creating work order from process
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
--10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
--fields from BOM_item_oper_step_link table
DECLARE
  @BIOSL_step_no INT32,
  @BIOSL_qty_per_parent_item TFLOAT,
  @last_edit_by	STRING40,
  @last_edit_at TDATETIME
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 '1' FROM job_bom_step WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id
                   AND seq_no = @J_seq_no AND bom_pos = @BIOL_BOM_pos)
  BEGIN
    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
    SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

    --14	Get steps (matching rows) from BOM_ITEM_OPER_STEP_LINK
    DECLARE BOM_item_oper_step_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT step_no, qty_per_parent_item FROM BOM_item_oper_step_link
      WHERE parent_item_id = @BIOL_parent_item_id AND ver_id = @BIOL_ver_id AND BOM_pos = @BIOL_BOM_pos AND process_id = @process_id
        AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id ORDER BY LTRIM(RTRIM(process_id)) DESC
    OPEN BOM_item_oper_step_link_cursor
    FETCH NEXT FROM BOM_item_oper_step_link_cursor INTO @BIOSL_step_no, @BIOSL_qty_per_parent_item
    --15	for each step from BOM_ITEM_OPER_STEP_LINK
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
	--CWOFP does not create rows for a job_step if a step is excluded for some entities (in oper_step_ent_exc).
	--In this case, the job_bom_step should not be created at all. Creating a job_bom_step record will raise
	--a foreign key violation as job_step record for this work order was not created at all.
      --16 INSERT a row into JOB_BOM_STEP table
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_step WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no
		AND step_no = @BIOSL_step_no)
	      INSERT INTO job_BOM_step(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, BOM_pos, step_no, qty_per_parent_item, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	        VALUES(@wo_id, @BIOL_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @BIOL_BOM_pos, @BIOSL_step_no, @BIOSL_qty_per_parent_item, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

      FETCH NEXT FROM BOM_item_oper_step_link_cursor INTO @BIOSL_step_no, @BIOSL_qty_per_parent_item
      --17			next step from BOM_ITEM_OPER_STEP_LINK
    END
    CLOSE BOM_item_oper_step_link_cursor
    DEALLOCATE BOM_item_oper_step_link_cursor
  END  --End of NOT EXISTS ...
END

  FROM bom_item_oper_spec bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ( bom_item_oper_spec.item_id = @item_id AND

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_DL_IsCertReqdForThisDlRow]
(
	@row_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@grp_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no         INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no         INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no          STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no       STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@cert_name       STRING40_NULL = NULL

) RETURNS INT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - FN_DL_ISCERTREQDFORHTISDLROW
-- Description          - Verifies whether the collected data are certified. Returns 0 if the collected data are ceritified
--                         (meaning no more certification required for this step data); otherwise return 1 indicating a
--                          a certification is necessary for this job step data record.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    12/07/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 02/13/2008		RWB			3.4.0	CR L00075045 (EXISTS => NOT EXISTS)
-- 02/20/2008		RWB			3.4.0	CR L00075173 (Added Begin/Ends to IF (COALES... statement and top 1 to selects
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	IF (@cert_name IS NULL)        RETURN 0

    IF (COALESCE(@step_no, -1) = -1)
    BEGIN
		IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_audit_log cal
                    WHERE cal.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND cal.oper_id = @oper_id
                      AND cal.seq_no = @seq_no
                      AND (cal.step_no IS NULL OR cal.step_no = -1)
                      AND cal.grp_id = @grp_id
                      AND cal.ref_row_id = @row_id
                      AND cal.cert_name = @cert_name ) RETURN 0
	END
    ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_audit_log cal
                    WHERE cal.wo_id = @wo_id
                      AND cal.oper_id = @oper_id
                      AND cal.seq_no = @seq_no
                      AND cal.step_no = @step_no
                      AND (cal.lot_no = @lot_no OR cal.lot_no = '-' OR (cal.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
                      AND (cal.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR cal.sublot_no = '-' OR (cal.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
                      AND cal.grp_id = @grp_id
                      AND cal.ref_row_id = @row_id
                      AND cal.cert_name = @cert_name ) RETURN 0
	END
	RETURN 1
END
