CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_correction_recipe_bck20251023]
        @wo_id     NVARCHAR ( 40 ),
        @oper_id   NVARCHAR ( 40 ),
        @seq_no    INT,
        @result    NVARCHAR ( MAX ),
        @is_manual INT= 0
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @CTE TABLE
            (
                    id                  INT identity(1,1) NOT NULL,
                    item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
                    item_desc           NVARCHAR(40),
                    qty_percent         FLOAT,
                    qty_reqd            FLOAT,
                    qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
                    man_qty_percent     FLOAT,
                    man_qty_reqd        FLOAT,
                    row_id              INT
            )
    DECLARE @curr_correction_step INT = 0,
    @is_success                   INT =0,
    @water                        FLOAT
    DECLARE @Counter              INT,
    @iterate                      INT=1,
    @item_id                      NVARCHAR(40),
    @bom_pos                      INT,
    @qty_per_parent_item          FLOAT
    DECLARE @Qty_reqd             FLOAT,
    @base_dose_param              FLOAT,
    @correction_step              FLOAT,
    @Qty_reqd_item                FLOAT
    DECLARE @corrType1            NVARCHAR(40),
    @corrVal1                     FLOAT,
    @corrType2                    NVARCHAR(40),
    @corrVal2                     FLOAT,
    @corrType3                    NVARCHAR(40),
    @corrVal3                     FLOAT,
    @corrType4                    NVARCHAR(40),
    @corrVal4                     FLOAT
    SELECT  @base_dose_param = act_spec_value
    FROM    job_spec WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE
            wo_id           =@wo_id
            AND oper_id     =@oper_id
            AND seq_no      =@seq_no
            AND spec_id     ='CB_Batch weight'
    SELECT  @correction_step= act_spec_value
    FROM    job_spec WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE
            wo_id      =@wo_id
            AND oper_id=@oper_id
            AND seq_no =@seq_no
            AND spec_id='CB_Number of corrections'
    IF EXISTS
    (       SELECT  1
            FROM    job_bom_correction_details WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE
                    wo_id      =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id=@oper_id
                    AND seq_no =@seq_no)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @curr_correction_step =
                (       SELECT  MAX(dosing_step)+1
                        FROM    job_bom_correction_details WITH(NOLOCK)
                        WHERE
                                wo_id      =@wo_id
                                AND oper_id=@oper_id
                                AND seq_no =@seq_no)
        -- SET @Qty_reqd =
                -- (       SELECT  (@base_dose_param + (@curr_correction_step *(qty_reqd - qty_prod)/@correction_step))
                        -- FROM    job WITH (NOLOCK)
                        -- WHERE
                                -- wo_id      =@wo_id
                                -- AND oper_id=@oper_id
                                -- AND seq_no =@seq_no)
    END
    -- ELSE
    -- BEGIN
            -- SELECT @Qty_reqd = @base_dose_param
    -- END
                
	INSERT INTO @cte
            (
                    item_id,
                    item_desc,
                    qty_percent,
                    qty_reqd,
                    qty_per_parent_item,
                    man_qty_percent,
                    man_qty_reqd,
                    row_id
            )
    SELECT  item_id,
            item_desc,
            qty_percent,
            qty_reqd,
            qty_per_parent_item,
            man_qty_percent,
            man_qty_reqd,
            row_id
    FROM    OPENJSON ( @result ) WITH ( item_id VARCHAR(200) '$.item_id', item_desc VARCHAR(200) '$.item_desc', qty_percent FLOAT '$.qty_percent', qty_reqd FLOAT '$.qty_reqd', qty_per_parent_item FLOAT '$.qty_per_parent_item', man_qty_percent FLOAT '$.man_qty_percent', man_qty_reqd FLOAT '$.man_qty_reqd', row_id INT '$.row_id' )
                
	UPDATE  ocr
    SET
            ocr.qty_per_parent_item = CASE
                                                WHEN    @is_manual =0
                                                THEN    cte.qty_percent/100
                                                WHEN    @is_manual =1
                                                THEN    cte.man_qty_percent/100
                                        END
    FROM    ofi_correction_recipe ocr WITH(NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN
            @cte cte
    ON
            ocr.row_id = cte.row_id
                
	SELECT  @Qty_reqd  = qty_reqd
    FROM    job WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE
            wo_id      =@wo_id
            AND oper_id=@oper_id
            AND seq_no =@seq_no
                
	EXEC Sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative @wo_id,
									@oper_id,
									@seq_no,
									@result,
									@Qty_reqd,
									'cb',
									@is_manual
                
	SET @Counter = ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @cte )

    WHILE ( @iterate <= @Counter)
    BEGIN
        SELECT  @item_id            =jb.item_id,
                @bom_pos            =jb.bom_pos,
                @qty_per_parent_item= ISNULL(
                        CASE
                                WHEN    @is_manual = 0
                                THEN    ct.qty_per_parent_item
                                WHEN    @is_manual = 1
                                THEN    ct.man_qty_percent/100
                        END,0),
                @Qty_reqd_item = ISNULL(
                        CASE
                                WHEN    @is_manual = 0
                                THEN    ct.qty_reqd
                                WHEN    @is_manual = 1
                                THEN    ct.man_qty_reqd
                        END,0)
        FROM    @cte ct
        JOIN
                job_bom jb
        ON
                jb.item_id = ct.item_id
        WHERE
                jb.wo_id      =@wo_id
                AND jb.oper_id=@oper_id
                AND jb.seq_no =@seq_no
                AND ct.id     = @iterate

        EXEC sp_i_ofi_job_bom_correction_details @wo_id,
												@oper_id,
												@seq_no,
												@item_id,
												@bom_pos,
												@Qty_reqd_item,
												@qty_per_parent_item,
												@curr_correction_step
                              
		SET @iterate = @iterate + 1
    END

    -- Updating the process parameter for the water, O-Salt, B-Salt Powder, B-Salt Liquid
    SELECT TOP 1 @water = moist_water,
            @corrType1  =phCorrectionType1,
            @corrVal1   =pHCorrectionValue1,
            @corrType2  =phCorrectionType2,
            @corrVal2   =pHCorrectionValue2,
            @corrType3  =phCorrectionType3,
            @corrVal3   =pHCorrectionValue3,
            @corrType4  =phCorrectionType4,
            @corrVal4   =pHCorrectionValue4
    FROM    ofi_cb_sample_results WITH(NOLOCK)
    WHERE
            wo_id         =@wo_id
            AND oper_id   =@oper_id
            AND seq_no    =@seq_no
            AND is_manual = @is_manual
    ORDER BY
            row_id DESC

    UPDATE  job_spec
    SET
            act_spec_value = @water
    WHERE
            wo_id       =@wo_id
            AND oper_id =@oper_id
            AND seq_no  =@seq_no
            AND spec_id = 'CB_Water'

    IF (@corrType1 ='CitricAcid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal1
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_O-Salt'
    END

    IF (@corrType2 ='CitricAcid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal2
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_O-Salt'
    END

    IF (@corrType3 ='CitricAcid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal3
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_O-Salt'
    END

    IF (@corrType4 ='CitricAcid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal4
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_O-Salt'
    END

    IF (@corrType1 = 'PotassiumCarbonate')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal1
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Powder'
    END

    IF (@corrType2 = 'PotassiumCarbonate')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal2
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Powder'
    END

    IF (@corrType3 = 'PotassiumCarbonate')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal3
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Powder'
    END

    IF (@corrType4 = 'PotassiumCarbonate')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal4
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Powder'
    END

    IF (@corrType1 = 'PotassiumLiquid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal1
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Liquid'
    END

    IF (@corrType2 = 'PotassiumLiquid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal2
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Liquid'
    END

    IF (@corrType3 = 'PotassiumLiquid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal3
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Liquid'
    END

    IF (@corrType4 = 'PotassiumLiquid')
    BEGIN
            UPDATE  job_spec
            SET
                    act_spec_value = @corrVal4
            WHERE
                    wo_id       =@wo_id
                    AND oper_id =@oper_id
                    AND seq_no  =@seq_no
                    AND spec_id = 'CB_B-Salt_Liquid'
    END

    -- v2.00 ADDED
    UPDATE  job_spec
    SET
            act_spec_value = @curr_correction_step
    WHERE
            wo_id       =@wo_id
            AND oper_id =@oper_id
            AND seq_no  =@seq_no
            AND spec_id = 'CB_Current correction step'
	-- OT temp Batch weight update
	UPDATE  job_spec
    SET
            act_spec_value =  (SELECT  (qty_reqd - qty_prod)
								FROM    job WITH (NOLOCK)
									WHERE
									wo_id      =@wo_id
									AND oper_id=@oper_id
									AND seq_no =@seq_no)
    WHERE
            wo_id       =@wo_id
            AND oper_id =@oper_id
            AND seq_no  =@seq_no
            AND spec_id = 'CB_Batch weight'

    INSERT INTO ofi_cb_approved_correction
            (
                    wo_id,
                    oper_id,
                    seq_no,
                    recipe_json,
                    is_manual,
                    correction_step
            )
    VALUES
            (
                    @wo_id,
                    @oper_id,
                    @seq_no,
                    @result,
                    @is_manual,
                    @curr_correction_step
            )

    UPDATE  Job
    SET
            spare1 =3
    WHERE
            wo_id      =@wo_id
            AND oper_id=@oper_id
            AND seq_no =@seq_no

    SELECT 1 AS row_id
 END

@item_id as varchar(100), @item_group as varchar(100), @item_status as varchar(100), @item_grade as varchar(100)

  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_DestinationInventory_sublotno  -
-- Description:	    Get the  destination silo details of sublot number
--
-- Usage:			InventorySummary (01.00.00) from used to display the destination silo information
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-10-06						Find the source destination sublot information
-- 0.02.00			DS				2024-02-01						Find the source destination sublot information
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON 
	
	Declare  @item_seg_type varchar(150), @process_name varchar(150)
	
	select sl.ent_id as process_ent_id,e.ent_id,e.ent_name, iv.lot_no as lot_no,iv.sublot_no as sublot_no, iv.qty_left as mes_qty  from ent e with(nolock)	 
	 inner join ent_attr ea with(nolock) on ea.ent_id=e.ent_id and ea.attr_value='StorageUnit'
	 inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id= ea.attr_id
	 inner join ofi_ent_item_storage_link sl with(nolock) on sl.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id and sl.type='destination'
	 inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.ent_id =sl.storage_ent_id 
	 inner join uom u with(nolock) on u.uom_id= iv.uom_id
	 inner join item_state iis with(nolock) on iis.item_status_cd= iv.status_cd
	 inner join item_grade ig with(nolock) on ig.item_grade_cd= iv.grade_cd
	 where  sl.ent_id=@process_ent_id and sl.storage_ent_id=@ent_id and iv.item_id=@item_id and iv.lot_no = @lot_no and sl.item_group=@item_group and iis.item_status_desc = @item_status

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff_InsertConsData]
-- Description: Used to insert Cons interface data into the buffer table
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE Cons object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01 JSC		2025-06-04			Adapted for BIN consumption BCONS
-- 0.01.02	JSC		2025-11-10			Added the Step Id (Named in JSON cons_reas_id)
-- ===========================================================================================*/
-- Updated Cons Data Proc with correct data types
CREATE        PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff_InsertConsData]
    @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @seq_no INT,
    @sublot_no INT = -1,
    @qty FLOAT,
    @storage_unit NVARCHAR(40),
    @item_id NVARCHAR(80) = '', 
	@cons_reas_id INT =  -1,
    @recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
	@current_timestamp DATETIME,
    @object_name NVARCHAR(80),              
    @interface_type NVARCHAR(15) = 'CONS',
	@return_code INT = 0 OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @object_name_local NVARCHAR(80)
		,   @interface_type_local NVARCHAR(15)
		,	@current_timestamp_local DATETIME

	SET @object_name_local = @object_name
	SET @interface_type_local = @interface_type
	SET @current_timestamp_local = @current_timestamp

	SET @sublot_no = CASE	WHEN @sublot_no = -1
								THEN NULL
							ELSE @sublot_no
					 END
	SET @cons_reas_id = CASE	WHEN @cons_reas_id = -1
									THEN NULL
								ELSE @cons_reas_id
						END

	SET @item_id = CASE	WHEN @item_id = ''
								THEN NULL
							ELSE @item_id
					 END

	-- v0.01.01 BCONS part
	DECLARE @bin_coll_starttime DATETIME
			,@bin_coll_endtime DATETIME
			,@bin_coll_area	INT
			,@bin_coll_weighing INT
			,@bin_coll_item NVARCHAR(80)
			,@mes_line_ent_id INT
			,@mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
			,@mes_line_name NVARCHAR(80)



	IF @interface_type = 'BCONS'
	BEGIN
			
		-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
		SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@object_name, CHARINDEX('_' + @interface_type, @object_name) - 1)

		-- Get the Line in te BCONS case
		SET @mes_line_name = LEFT(@mes_parent_name,LEN(@mes_parent_name)-1) + 'L'

		-- Get the Consumption unit ent_id
		SELECT TOP 1 @mes_line_ent_id = ent_id
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_line_name

		SELECT @bin_coll_area = CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT)
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
											AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- entity
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_line_ent_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'ActiveBinCollectionArea'

		SELECT @bin_coll_starttime = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
											AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- entity
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_line_ent_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'ActiveBinCollectionStartTime'

		SELECT @bin_coll_endtime = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
											AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- entity
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_line_ent_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'ActiveBinCollectionEndTime'

		SELECT @bin_coll_weighing = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
											AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- entity
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_line_ent_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'ActiveBinCollectionWeighing'

		SELECT @bin_coll_item = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
											AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- entity
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_line_ent_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'ReworkBinItem'

		SELECT @item_id = COALESCE(@item_id,@bin_coll_item)
	END


    DECLARE @Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = (
        SELECT
            @wo_id AS wo_id,
            @seq_no AS seq_no,
            @sublot_no AS sublot_no,
            @qty AS qty,
            @storage_unit AS storage_unit,
            @item_id AS item_id,
			@recorded_timestamp AS recorded_timestamp, -- v0.01.01 MOD
			@cons_reas_id AS cons_reas_id, -- v0.01.02 ADDED
			@bin_coll_area AS bin_coll_area,
			@bin_coll_starttime AS bin_coll_starttime,
			@bin_coll_endtime AS bin_coll_endtime,
			@bin_coll_weighing AS bin_coll_weighing
        FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER
    );
    
    EXEC dbo.sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff 
        @Data = @Data_local,
        @object_name = @object_name_local,
        @interface_type = @interface_type_local,
        @current_timestamp = @current_timestamp_local,
        @Error = @return_code OUTPUT;

    RETURN @return_code
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Language_GetStrings]
(@lang_id			INT32 = NULL
,@string_ids_xml	NVARCHAR(MAX)
) AS
/*
Notes: The line_id must be supplied to identify the line
Example XML
'<string_ids>
	<lang string_id="22" />
	<lang string_id="456" />
	<lang string_id="7285" />
</string_ids>'

*/
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_SA_Language_GetStrings
-- Description		- The purpose of this stored procedure is to return the language strings for the supplied string IDs that correspond to the supplied language ID.
--			  If a language ID is not identified (null), then the default language ID defined in the database is used.
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 09/19/2013
-- Version			- 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE	@doc_handle					INT32

BEGIN
	--Verify whether a language ID is identified
	IF (@lang_id IS NULL)
		--If the supplied language ID is null, default to the defined language ID in the database.
		SELECT @lang_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 344

	--If the language ID is still null, default to 1 (default from the installation).
	SET @lang_id = COALESCE(@lang_id, 1)

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @string_ids_xml

	SELECT  @lang_id lang_id, language_strings.string_id, l.grp_id, l.string, l.context, l.last_edit_comment, l.last_edit_by, l.last_edit_at
	FROM   OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/string_ids/lang',2)
	WITH  (string_id int   '@string_id'
	      ) language_strings
	--Restrict to the list of supplied language strings
	LEFT OUTER JOIN language l WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.lang_id = @lang_id AND l.string_id = language_strings.string_id
	--Limit to the supplied language OR the default language, if exists
	WHERE l.lang_id = @lang_id OR l.lang_id IS NULL

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_st_trans_mapping
-- Description:	The stored procedure will create new transfer mapping for passed silo and line
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer Configuration
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2023-12-04		Initial version.
-- 0.01.10	Veervar Joshi		2024-01-24		Localisation added.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_st_trans_mapping] @ent_id INT
	,@storage_ent_id INT
	,@type NVARCHAR(100)
	,@itemGroup NVARCHAR(100)
	,@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--VARIABLES DECLARATION
	DECLARE @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'StockTransferMapping'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@strCommentMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@delete_detail NVARCHAR(50) = NULL	
		,@keyField1 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField2 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField3 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField4 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField5 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField6 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL	
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
		,@log_id INT
		,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
		,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
		,@change_type INT = 1
		,@table_name NVARCHAR(80) = '[ofi_st_trans_mapping]'
		,@row_id INT
		,@audit_category NVARCHAR(80) = 'Info'
	DECLARE @newval NVARCHAR(max)
		,@newEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStorageEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
		DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName


	--VERIFY REQUIRED INPUT PARAMETERS ARE PASSED
	IF (@ent_id IS NULL OR @storage_ent_id IS NULL or @itemGroup IS NULL OR @type IS NULL	)
	BEGIN		
		SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400010,NULL,NULL)		
		RAISERROR ( @errorMessage,16,1 
				);
		RETURN - 1
	END


	--CHECK IF SELCTED MAPPING IS ALREADY EXIST OR NOT
	IF EXISTS (
			SELECT ent_id
			FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping stm
			WHERE 
				 (stm.storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id				
				AND stm.item_group = @itemGroup AND stm.type=@type 
				and stm.ent_id=@ent_id
				)
				or
				(stm.storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id				
				AND stm.item_group != @itemGroup )

			)
	BEGIN	
		SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400009,NULL,NULL)
		RAISERROR (	@errorMessage,16,1
				);
		RETURN -1
	END


	--INSERT NEW MAPPING RECORD 
	INSERT INTO [dbo].ofi_st_trans_mapping (
		ent_id
		,storage_ent_id
		,type
		,item_group
		,created_at_utc
		,created_at_local
		,created_by
		,last_edit_at_local
		,last_edit_at_utc
		,last_edit_by
		)
	VALUES (
		@ent_id
		,@storage_Ent_ID
		,@type
		,@itemGroup
		,GETUTCDATE()
		,GETDATE()
		,@user_name
		,GETDATE()
		,GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_name
		)



	----INSERT AUDIT TRAIL LOG FOR THIS TRANSACTION
	SELECT @newEntId = ent_name
	FROM ent
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	SELECT @newStorageEntId = ent_name
	FROM ent
	WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id

	SELECT @row_id = max(row_id) + 1
	FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping

	SET @newval = 'Equipment: ' + @newEntId + ' Storage Ent: ' + @newStorageEntId + ' Type: ' + @type + ' Item Group: ' + @itemGroup
	SET @column_name = NULL

	EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		,@change_type
		,@table_name
		,@row_id
		,@column_name
		,NULL
		,@newval
		,@audit_comments
		,@delete_detail;

	UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
	SET origin = @strFunctionName
	WHERE log_id = @log_id;

	SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Inserted into [dbo].[ofi_st_trans_mapping]  ,Values: ' + @newval + ''

	SET @strActivityMsg = 'INSERTED'

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
		log_id
		,keyField1
		,keyField2
		,keyField3
		,keyField4
		,module_id
		,function_id
		,spare1
		,spare2
		,spare3
		,spare4
		,spare5
		,spare6
		,audit_category
		,activity
		,comments
		,created_at_utc
		,created_at_local
		,created_by
		)
	VALUES (
		@log_id
		,@newEntId
		,@newStorageEntId
		,@type
		,@itemGroup
		,@strModuleName
		,@strFunctionName
		,@keyField1
		,@keyField2
		,@keyField3
		,@keyField4
		,@keyField5
		,@keyField6
		,@audit_category
		,@strActivityMsg
		,@strCommentMsg
		,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		);
END

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes						-
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--	Date_Modified		Modified_By     Version     Changes
--	04/27/2007			Raghu			3.2.0.10	Deleting a sublot should also cascade delete all of its children.
--												    Ref: Item_Lot_Editor.doc (Section: 1.4, Page:4)
--	06/21/2007			AML				3.2.16		HD#10102, Deleting a lot should also delete inventory where the quantity is 0.
--	09/10/2007			AML				3.3.0		Updating procedure to reflect changes to the Oracle version.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @tree_level		INT32
		,	@ent_name		STRING80
		,	@item_desc		STRING80

	DECLARE @child_sublots TABLE (
		item_id NVARCHAR(80),
		lot_no NVARCHAR(80),
		sublot_no NVARCHAR(80),
		tree_level INT
	)


	INSERT INTO @child_sublots ( item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, tree_level)
	VALUES ( @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, 1)

	SELECT @tree_level = 2

	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @child_sublots (item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, tree_level)
		SELECT item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, @tree_level
		FROM sublot WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id
		  AND lot_no = @lot_no
		  AND parent IN (SELECT sublot_no FROM @child_sublots WHERE tree_level = @tree_level - 1)

		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
		SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
	END

	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE	item_id = @item_id AND
					lot_no = @lot_no AND
					sublot_no IN ( SELECT sublot_no FROM @child_sublots ) AND
					qty_left > 0
	) BEGIN
		DECLARE @err_msg VARCHAR(254)
		SET @err_msg = 'This lot: %1, sublot: %2 cannot be deleted, because the inventory location: %3 for this sublot or one of its descendant has this item: %4.{5533}'
		RAISERROR( @err_msg, 16, 1 )
		RETURN
	END

	DELETE item_inv WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lot_no = @lot_no AND sublot_no IN ( SELECT sublot_no FROM @child_sublots )

	DELETE sublot WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lot_no = @lot_no AND sublot_no IN ( SELECT sublot_no FROM @child_sublots )
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24         Initial version.
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-02-09		   Refer to the comments in the SP on this date
-- 0.01.03  Lavkesh     2024-05-16		   For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- 0.01.04  Michal H    2024-09-02         Fix incorrect timestamp format - change the erroneous 12-hour format specifier ("hhmmss")
--                                         to the 24-hour format specifier ("HHmmss").
-- ===========================================================================================
 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg__BAK_240903] as
begin
 
 
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT
 
 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
 
 
    BEGIN TRY
 
  		BEGIN

			WITH ProduceToSAPOpers as(
				Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP') and attr_value <> 1
				union
				Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id <> (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP')
				union 
				Select oper_id from oper where oper_id not in (select oper_id from oper_attr)
			)
			
            Select  ip.spare2, ip.sublot_no, ip.wo_id, wo.bags_per_pallet, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, u.description, ip.item_id, ip.created_at_local as last_edit_at, ip.lot_no, ip.row_id -- 0.01.03
			into #temp
            from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
            inner join ofi_wo_ext wo  with (nolock) on wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id and wo.module <> 'PO'
			inner join wo w on w.wo_id = wo.wo_id and w.state_cd < 3	--- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
            inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
            inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
			inner join job_bom jb on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
			inner join ProduceToSAPOpers oa on oa.oper_id = ip.oper_id  --(KN - 09/02/23 - Include only those operations where the NotConsumeToSAP has not been set)
            where qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod and i.item_class_id = 'SFG' and ip.sublot_no is not null
 			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL
			Begin

 			Declare @Mainhu varchar(100), @subLot varchar(100), @lot_no varchar(100), @wo_id varchar(100), @item_id varchar(100), @item_class varchar(100), @row_id INT
			Declare @sap_item_id varchar(100)

			Select top 1 @subLot = sublot_no, @lot_no = lot_no, @wo_id = wo_id, @item_id = item_id, @row_id = row_id from #temp

			PRINT @row_id

			Select @item_class = item_class_id from item where item_id = @item_id

				BEGIN
           			select '' Handling_Unit_Number, wo_id Order_Number,  --HU is empty for SFG
					sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number, '101' Movement_Type, bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
					sum(qty_prod - qty_prod_erp) Quantity, description Unit_of_Measure,
					IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL, T.item_id, ia.attr_value) SAP_MaterialCode_Number,  --(KN  02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					Format(min(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') Production_startdate, Format(min(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') Production_starttime,
					Format(max(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') Production_enddate,   Format(max(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') Production_endtime,
					lot_no SAP_Batch_Number,
					Format(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date, Format(GETDATE(), 'HHmmss') File_Generation_Time, 
					'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
					from 
					#temp T
					left join (Select item_id, attr_value from item_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
						on T.item_id = ia.item_id  --(KN  02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					where lot_no = @lot_no and isnull(sublot_no, '') = isnull(@subLot, '')
          		    group by wo_id, bags_per_pallet, description, T.item_id, sublot_no, lot_no, ia.attr_value

					BEGIN TRANSACTION 
 
           			Update ip set qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod from item_prod ip
					inner join (Select * from #temp where lot_no = @lot_no and sublot_no = @subLot) t on ip.row_id = t.row_id

					COMMIT TRANSACTION
				END
			End

        END
    END TRY
 
 
     BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(), @error_severity = Error_severity(), @error_state = Error_state();
        RAISERROR(@error_msg, @error_severity, @error_state)
    END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@item_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for a Item (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific Item)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 12/15/2004
-- Version                  - 2.1.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--06/27/2005	Raghu		2.1.23	Added restriction to filter attributes that does not have valid certifications
--10/31/2005	Raghu		2.1.31/3.1.0	HD# 6624, Sort attributes by attr_desc.
--11/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Entry_type column is included.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
/*	SELECT   attr.attr_id
		,attr.predefined
		,attr.data_type
		,attr.attr_desc
		,attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr
		,attr.last_edit_comment
		,attr.last_edit_by
		,attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr
	WHERE attr_grp = 1 AND attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM item_attr WHERE item_id = @item_id)*/

	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 1 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM item_attr WHERE item_id = @item_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 1 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM item_attr WHERE item_id = @item_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
