CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ofi_Sample_GetChars]
(@sample_id  int
)
AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT x.* FROM (
	SELECT scl.sample_id
		  ,scl.char_id
		  ,c.char_name
          ,c.type as type_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) as severity_cd
          ,ISNULL(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) as minimum_sample_size_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.maximum_sample_size, c.maximum_sample_size) as maximum_sample_size_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.sample_size_source, c.sample_size_source) as sample_size_source_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.normal_sample_size, c.normal_sample_size) as normal_sample_size_h
          ,COALESCE(CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN NULL ELSE qscl.automated_coll END, CASE c.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as automated_coll_h
          ,scl.act_sample_size as act_sample_size_h
	  ,scl.qm_spec_id
	  ,qm_spec.qm_spec_name
	  ,qm_spec.display_seq as qm_display_seq
	  ,qm_spec.ver_id
	  ,qscl.display_seq as qscl_display_seq
          ,qscl.target
          ,qscl.lsl as lsv
--		  ,(SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id) as lsv
          ,qscl.usl as usv
--		  ,(SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id) as usv
	      ,(SELECT lrv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (lrv * ((SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id)
                    - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id) as lrv
	      ,(SELECT urv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (urv * ((SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id)
                  - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id) as urv
	  ,scl.equipment
	  ,scl.last_edit_comment
	  ,scl.last_edit_by
	  ,scl.last_edit_at
	  ,c.char_desc
	  ,c.num_decimals
	  ,c.uom_id
	  ,uom.description
	  ,c.spare1
	  ,c.spare2
	  ,c.spare3
	  ,c.spare4
	FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qm_spec.qm_spec_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id and qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
	UNION
	SELECT (scltg.sample_id * -1) as sample_id
	      ,scltg.char_id
	      ,c.char_name
          ,c.type as type_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) as severity_cd
          ,ISNULL(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) as minimum_sample_size_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.maximum_sample_size, c.maximum_sample_size) as maximum_sample_size_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.sample_size_source, c.sample_size_source) as sample_size_source_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.normal_sample_size, c.normal_sample_size) as normal_sample_size_h
          ,COALESCE(CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN NULL ELSE qscl.automated_coll END, CASE c.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as automated_coll_h
          ,0 as actual_sample_size_h
	  ,scltg.qm_spec_id
	  ,qm_spec.qm_spec_name
	  ,qm_spec.display_seq as qm_display_seq
	  ,qm_spec.ver_id
	  ,qscl.display_seq as qscl_display_seq
          ,qscl.target
          ,qscl.lsl as lsv
--		  ,(SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as lsv
          ,qscl.usl as usv
--		  ,(SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0  AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--           UNION
--            SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as usv
	      ,(SELECT lrv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (lrv * ((SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id)
                    - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as lrv
	      ,(SELECT urv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (urv * ((SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0  AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id)
                   - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as urv
	      ,NULL
	      ,scltg.last_edit_comment
	      ,scltg.last_edit_by
	      ,scltg.last_edit_at
		  ,c.char_desc
		  ,c.num_decimals
		  ,c.uom_id
		  ,uom.description
		  ,c.spare1
		  ,c.spare2
		  ,c.spare3
		  ,c.spare4
	FROM sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.char_id = c.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.qm_spec_id = qm_spec.qm_spec_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id and qscl.char_id = scltg.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	WHERE scltg.sample_id = @sample_id
    )x ORDER BY x.qm_display_seq, x.qscl_display_seq, x.char_name

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cert_State_Link]
(
	@cert_name				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@from_item_state_cd		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@to_item_state_cd		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@cert_level				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Cert_State_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 09/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/03/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT	cert_state_link.cert_name
		,	cert_state_link.from_item_state_cd
		,	cert_state_link.to_item_state_cd
		,	cert_state_link.cert_level
		,	cert_state_link.last_edit_comment
		,	cert_state_link.last_edit_by
		,	cert_state_link.last_edit_at
    FROM cert_state_link
    WHERE (
			(cert_state_link.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL) AND
			(cert_state_link.from_item_state_cd = @from_item_state_cd OR @from_item_state_cd IS NULL) AND
			(cert_state_link.to_item_state_cd = @to_item_state_cd OR @to_item_state_cd IS NULL) AND
			(cert_state_link.cert_level = @cert_level OR @cert_level IS NULL) AND
			(cert_state_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(cert_state_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Wo_AssgnOrUnassgnToALine]
(@wo_id				STRING80
,@assign			LOGICAL = 1
,@line_id			INT32 = NULL
,@queue_seq_no			INT32 = NULL
,@new_wo			LOGICAL = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- [sp_U_Wo_AssgnOrUnassgnToALine
-- Description		- The purpose of this stored procedure is to assign a work order to a line,
--					 or to un-assign a work order from a line.
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 05/02/2013
-- Version			- 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 06/02/2014	RaghuG		5.0	UserStory:341879 - NFS - DBfit failures - ORDER BY issue in SQL Server 2012
-- 11/27/2018	Raghu		6.1 US-1102377-As AVEVA, I want to refactor the CWOFP SPs to not recalculate the routings when associating to a line
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @line_job_route			TABLE(column_position INT, child_order INT, child_order_seq INT, segment_no INT, line_ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80), ancestor_ent_id INT, can_run_jobs BIT, input_percent FLOAT,
										wo_id NVARCHAR(80), oper_id NVARCHAR(80), seq_no INT, init_sched_ent_id INT, qty_reqd float, qty_at_start float, prev_column_position INT, input_oper_id NVARCHAR(80), input_seq_no INT)

DECLARE @line_ent_id					INT32
		,@ent_name						STRING80
		,@column_position				INT32
		,@line_name						STRING80
		,@ents_are_descendants			INT32
		,@ent_can_run_jobs				INT32
		,@err_msg						NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@last_edit_by					STRING80
		,@last_edit_at					TDATETIME
		,@ent_pos_mismatch				LOGICAL

BEGIN
	SET @new_wo = COALESCE(@new_wo, 0)
	IF (@new_wo = 1) SET @assign = 1

	SET @assign = COALESCE(@assign, 1)

	--Verify whether the supplied work order exist in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'WorkOrderID:' + @wo_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Retrieve the name of the line.
	SELECT @line_name = l.line_name FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE l.line_id = @line_id

	IF (@assign = 1) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the supplied line ID exist in the database.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'LineID:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @line_id)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether the work order was already assigned to a line.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND target_sched_line_id = @line_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'This work order: %1 was already assigned to the line: %2.{7639},' + @wo_id + ',' + @line_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify all the jobs in a work order is either new or ready or completed.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND NOT (j.state_cd = 1 OR j.state_cd = 2 OR j.state_cd = 4)) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'At least one of the job in the work order: %1 are not new or ready or completed.{7640},' + @wo_id
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Build the ancestor entities for all the entities in a line.
		;WITH line_ent_hierarchy (column_position, child_order, child_order_seq, segment_no, line_ent_id, ent_name, ancestor_ent_id, can_run_jobs, ent_hierarchy, input_percent) AS
			(SELECT TOP 1000 DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lel.child_order) AS column_position, lel.child_order
				  --The incremental row number for each distinct entity in a column position, row number starts from 1 for each column posiiton.
				, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lel.child_order ORDER BY lel.child_order, lel.segment_no), lel.segment_no, lel.ent_id
				, e.ent_name, lel.ent_id AS ancestor_ent_id, e.can_run_jobs, 1 AS ent_hierarchy, lel.input_pct
			FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			--Eliminate all entities in a line that do not have a child order.
			  AND lel.child_order IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY lel.child_order, lel.segment_no, e.ent_name
			UNION ALL
			SELECT leh.column_position, leh.child_order, leh.child_order_seq, leh.segment_no, leh.line_ent_id,  leh.ent_name
				, el.parent_ent_id, leh.can_run_jobs, leh.ent_hierarchy+1, leh.input_percent
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN line_ent_hierarchy leh ON el.child_ent_id = leh.ancestor_ent_id
			)
		--Loop through the job route created by CWOFP and assign the jobs to the corresponding column positions.
		, job_route_positions (column_position, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id) AS
			(SELECT 1 AS column_position, j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.init_sched_ent_id
			 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			 LEFT OUTER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jr.seq_no
			 WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				--Start with the first job
			   AND j.first_job = 1
			UNION ALL
			--For each column position, assign the job to the column position
			SELECT jrp_prev.column_position+1 AS column_position, jrp_prev.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, j.init_sched_ent_id
			FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN job_route_positions jrp_prev ON jr.wo_id = jrp_prev.wo_id
				AND jr.input_oper_id = jrp_prev.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = jrp_prev.seq_no
			)
		--Insert the consolidated list of line positions and jobs (combined) in the temporary table.
		INSERT INTO @line_job_route (column_position, child_order, child_order_seq, segment_no, line_ent_id, ent_name, ancestor_ent_id, can_run_jobs, input_percent,
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id)
		SELECT leh.column_position, leh.child_order, leh.child_order_seq, leh.segment_no, leh.line_ent_id, leh.ent_name, leh.ancestor_ent_id, leh.can_run_jobs, leh.input_percent,
			jre.wo_id, jre.oper_id, jre.seq_no, jre.init_sched_ent_id
		FROM line_ent_hierarchy leh
		--The init_sched_ent_id for a job in a column position may not be the ancestor entity for an entity in a line in the same column position
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT column_position, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id FROM job_route_positions) jre ON leh.column_position = jre.column_position AND leh.ancestor_ent_id = jre.init_sched_ent_id
		ORDER BY leh.column_position, leh.line_ent_id, leh.ent_hierarchy

		SELECT @column_position = ents_in_hierarchy.column_position
				, @line_ent_id = ents_in_hierarchy.line_ent_id
				, @ent_name = ents_in_hierarchy.ent_name
				, @ents_are_descendants = ents_in_hierarchy.no_of_ents_in_hierarchy
				, @ent_can_run_jobs = ents_in_hierarchy.can_run_jobs
		FROM
			(SELECT ljr.column_position, ljr.line_ent_id, ljr.ent_name
				--For each entity in a column position, verify whether the entity id in a line has a matching ancestor entity id
				, SUM(CASE WHEN ljr.init_sched_ent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) no_of_ents_in_hierarchy
				--For each entity in a column position, verify whether the entity is capable of running jobs
				, MIN(CASE WHEN ljr.can_run_jobs = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) can_run_jobs
			FROM @line_job_route ljr
			GROUP BY ljr.column_position, ljr.line_ent_id, ljr.ent_name
			) ents_in_hierarchy
		--Verify whether there is an entity in a line that is not the descendant of the target schedule entity for a job
		--Also, verify whether there is an entity in a line that cannot run jobs.
		WHERE ents_in_hierarchy.no_of_ents_in_hierarchy = 0 OR ents_in_hierarchy.can_run_jobs = 0

		--Remove all the temporary records whose wo_id or oper_id is null
		--The NULL columns (wo_id and oper_id) are populated when the entity in a line does not match with the ancestor entity.
		DELETE FROM @line_job_route
		WHERE wo_id IS NULL AND oper_id IS NULL

		IF (@ent_can_run_jobs = 0) BEGIN
			--Raise an error, if, at least one of the entity in a line is not capable of running jobs.
			SET @err_msg = 'The entity: %1 at column position: %2 of the %3 line is not capable of running jobs.{7641},' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @column_position) + ',' + @line_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (@ents_are_descendants = 0) BEGIN
			--Raise an error, if, at least one of the entity in a column position is not a descendant entity for a job that appear in the same column position.
			SET @err_msg = 'The entity: %1 at column position: %2 of the %3 line is not one of the descendants of the entity configured for the operation that is to be done at this position.{7642},' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @column_position) + ',' + @line_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @column_position = line_ents.column_position
		FROM
			(SELECT ljr.column_position
				 --Add 1, if the entity in a line match exactly to an entity to which the job is scheduled to.
				, SUM(CASE WHEN ljr.line_ent_id = ljr.init_sched_ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) line_ent_is_target_sched_ent
				--Add 1, if the entity in a line does not match exactly to an entity to which the job is scheduled to.
				, SUM(CASE WHEN ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) line_ent_is_desc_target_sched_ent
				--Count the number of entities in a line
				, COUNT(*) no_of_ents
			FROM @line_job_route ljr
			GROUP BY ljr.column_position
			HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
			) line_ents
		--Verify EITHER all the entities in a line match those of all the target schedule entities for the jobs in the column position
		--OR the entities in a line do not match those of all the target schedule entities (i.e. ancestor entities) for the jobs in the column posiiton
		WHERE NOT (line_ents.line_ent_is_target_sched_ent = line_ents.no_of_ents
		   OR line_ents.line_ent_is_desc_target_sched_ent = line_ents.no_of_ents)

		IF (@column_position IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Raise an error, if all the line entities in a column position are not directly linked to the entity that can run jobs or to an ancestor entity
			SET @err_msg = 'The entities at column position: %1 of the %2 line must either be descendant of the entities configured for the operations that are to be done at this position or they must be scheduled for the operations that are to be done at this position.{7643},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @column_position) + ',' + @line_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--At this point, the entities in a line are validated against the process model to ensure they match; if not, an exception would have raised above.
		--Verify whether the work order is created brand new and assigned to a line:
		IF (@new_wo = 1) BEGIN
			--(i) the number of line entities in a column position match the number of entities in a process model at the same operation.
			;WITH line_ent_hierarchy (column_position, child_order, child_order_seq, segment_no, line_ent_id) AS
			(SELECT TOP 1000 DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lel.child_order) AS column_position, lel.child_order
				  --The incremental row number for each distinct entity in a column position, row number starts from 1 for each column posiiton.
				, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lel.child_order ORDER BY lel.child_order, lel.segment_no), lel.segment_no, lel.ent_id
			FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			--Eliminate all entities in a line that do not have a child order.
			  AND lel.child_order IS NOT NULL
			ORDER BY lel.child_order, lel.segment_no, e.ent_name
			)
			--Loop through the job route created by CWOFP and assign the jobs to the corresponding column positions.
			, job_route_positions (column_position, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id) AS
			(SELECT 1 AS column_position, j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.init_sched_ent_id
			 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			 LEFT OUTER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jr.seq_no
			 WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				--Start with the first job
			   AND j.first_job = 1
			UNION ALL
			--For each column position, assign the job to the column position
			SELECT jrp_prev.column_position+1 AS column_position, jrp_prev.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, j.init_sched_ent_id
			FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN job_route_positions jrp_prev ON jr.wo_id = jrp_prev.wo_id
				AND jr.input_oper_id = jrp_prev.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = jrp_prev.seq_no
			)
			, job_routings (column_position, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id) AS
			(SELECT DISTINCT column_position, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id FROM job_route_positions)
			, wo_on_line AS
			(SELECT leh.column_position, COUNT(*) AS no_of_ents_col_pos_line
				, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_routings jrp WHERE jrp.column_position = leh.column_position) AS no_of_ents_col_pos_oper
			FROM line_ent_hierarchy leh
			GROUP BY leh.column_position
			)
			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_pos_mismatch =  1
			FROM wo_on_line WHERE no_of_ents_col_pos_line <> no_of_ents_col_pos_oper

			SET @ent_pos_mismatch = COALESCE(@ent_pos_mismatch, 0)

			IF (@ent_pos_mismatch = 0) BEGIN
				--Since the number of entities in a column position match with the number of entities in an operation,
				--assign the target schedule entity ids to line entities, and exit. Do not modify the job routes, percentages, quantities, etc.

				;WITH line_ent_hierarchy (column_position, child_order, child_order_seq, segment_no, line_ent_id, ent_hierarchy, ancestor_ent_id) AS
				(SELECT TOP 1000 DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lel.child_order) AS column_position, lel.child_order
					  --The incremental row number for each distinct entity in a column position, row number starts from 1 for each column posiiton.
					, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lel.child_order ORDER BY lel.child_order, lel.segment_no), lel.segment_no, lel.ent_id
					, 1 AS ent_hierarchy, lel.ent_id
				FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
				WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
				--Eliminate all entities in a line that do not have a child order.
				  AND lel.child_order IS NOT NULL
				ORDER BY lel.child_order, lel.segment_no, e.ent_name
				UNION ALL
				SELECT leh.column_position, leh.child_order, leh.child_order_seq, leh.segment_no, leh.line_ent_id
					, leh.ent_hierarchy+1, el.parent_ent_id
				FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN line_ent_hierarchy leh ON el.child_ent_id = leh.ancestor_ent_id
				)
				--Loop through the job route created by CWOFP and assign the jobs to the corresponding column positions.
				, job_route_positions (column_position, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, init_sched_ent_id) AS
				(SELECT 1 AS column_position, j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.init_sched_ent_id
				 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				 LEFT OUTER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jr.seq_no
				 WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
					--Start with the first job
				   AND j.first_job = 1
				UNION ALL
				--For each column position, assign the job to the column position
				SELECT jrp_prev.column_position+1 AS column_position, jrp_prev.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, j.init_sched_ent_id
				FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
				INNER JOIN job_route_positions jrp_prev ON jr.wo_id = jrp_prev.wo_id
					AND jr.input_oper_id = jrp_prev.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = jrp_prev.seq_no
				)
				UPDATE job SET job.target_sched_ent_id = line_wo_ent.line_ent_id
				FROM (SELECT DISTINCT jrp.wo_id, jrp.oper_id, jrp.seq_no, leh.line_ent_id
					FROM job_route_positions jrp
					INNER JOIN line_ent_hierarchy leh ON jrp.column_position = leh.column_position AND jrp.init_sched_ent_id = leh.ancestor_ent_id
					) line_wo_ent
				WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND job.wo_id = line_wo_ent.wo_id
				  AND job.oper_id = line_wo_ent.oper_id
				  AND job.seq_no = line_wo_ent.seq_no

				--Verify whether the queue sequence number is supplied
				IF (@queue_seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
					--Verify whether the supplied queue sequence number exist for a work order
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no)
						--Increasement the queue sequence number for all the work orders, whose queue sequence number is the supplied sequence number or higher.
						UPDATE wo SET queue_seq_no = queue_seq_no + 1 WHERE queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no
				END

				--Update the work order with the supplied line ID and queue sequence number
				UPDATE wo SET target_sched_line_id = @line_id, queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				RETURN
			END
		END

		--Update the temporary table to identify the previous column positon in a convenient way.
		UPDATE @line_job_route SET seq_no = child_order_seq - 1, prev_column_position = column_position - 1

		--Capture the total reqd quantity and qty_at_start in the temporary table, so that these quantities can be used to evenly split among other jobs in the same column posiiton.
		--This should also capture the quantities from the completed jobs.
		UPDATE line_job_route SET line_job_route.qty_reqd = existing_jobs.qty_reqd, line_job_route.qty_at_start = existing_jobs.qty_at_start
		FROM (SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, SUM(j.qty_reqd) qty_reqd, SUM(qty_at_start) qty_at_start
			  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			  WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			  --Exclude the completed jobs
			    AND j.state_cd <> 4
			  GROUP BY j.wo_id, j.oper_id) existing_jobs
		INNER JOIN @line_job_route line_job_route ON line_job_route.wo_id = existing_jobs.wo_id AND line_job_route.oper_id = existing_jobs.oper_id-- AND line_job_route.init_sched_ent_id = j.init_sched_ent_id
		WHERE line_job_route.wo_id = @wo_id

		UPDATE job SET target_sched_ent_id = ljr.line_ent_id
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		WHERE job.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND job.oper_id = ljr.oper_id
		  AND job.seq_no = 0
		  AND ljr.seq_no = 0

		INSERT INTO job	(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc, item_id, state_cd, job_priority, req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local,
			init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected,
			qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start, deviation_above, deviation_below, batch_size, first_job, final_job, sched_pinned,
			check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, est_transfer_time,
			sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local, latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local,
			sched_finish_time_utc, sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local, act_finish_time_utc,
			act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link, job_cost, notes, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes, edited_by,
			edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework, rework_cd, rework_process_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.job_desc, first_jobs.item_id, 1, first_jobs.job_priority, first_jobs.req_finish_time_utc, first_jobs.req_finish_time_local,
			first_jobs.init_sched_ent_id, ljr.line_ent_id, NULL, ljr.qty_reqd, 0, 0, 0,
			0, first_jobs.qty_at_start , first_jobs.deviation_above, first_jobs.deviation_below, first_jobs.batch_size, first_jobs.first_job, first_jobs.final_job, first_jobs.sched_pinned,
			first_jobs.check_inv, first_jobs.est_fixed_lab, first_jobs.est_lab_rate, first_jobs.est_setup_time, first_jobs.est_teardown_time, first_jobs.est_prod_rate, first_jobs.prod_uom, first_jobs.est_transfer_time,
			first_jobs.sched_start_time_utc, first_jobs.sched_start_time_local, first_jobs.latest_start_time_utc, first_jobs.latest_start_time_local,
			first_jobs.sched_finish_time_utc, first_jobs.sched_finish_time_local, first_jobs.act_start_time_utc, first_jobs.act_start_time_local, first_jobs.act_finish_time_utc,
			first_jobs.act_finish_time_local, first_jobs.concurrent_link, first_jobs.job_cost, first_jobs.notes, first_jobs.assoc_file, first_jobs.assoc_file_type, first_jobs.status_notes, first_jobs.edited_by,
			first_jobs.edit_time, first_jobs.display_seq, first_jobs.folder_ver_id, first_jobs.rework, first_jobs.rework_cd, first_jobs.rework_process_id, first_jobs.spare1, first_jobs.spare2, first_jobs.spare3, first_jobs.spare4
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first jobs to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, first_job.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Update the quantities for the first job, if the job was not completed.
		UPDATE job
		--Calculate the integer quantity and the remainder quantity, and finally add the remaining quantities to the first job
		--For example, a required quantity of 103 / 4 jobs will be split as below:
		--The first job receives 28 (25 + 3) quantities, and the remaining 3 jobs will receive 25 quantities each
		--Allocate these quantities to the first job in a column position that is not completed.
		--Using the example above, FLOOR(qty_reqd / first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs) should return 25 quantities => 103/4 = 25 (int),
		--CAST(qty_reqd AS DECIMAL(20,10))% first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs should return 3 quantities => 103%4 = 3 (int remainder)
		SET qty_reqd = FLOOR(list_of_jobs.qty_reqd / first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs) + (CAST(list_of_jobs.qty_reqd AS DECIMAL(20,10)) % first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs)
			, qty_at_start = FLOOR(list_of_jobs.qty_at_start / first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs) + (CAST(list_of_jobs.qty_at_start AS DECIMAL(20,10)) % first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs)
		FROM @line_job_route list_of_jobs
			--Determine the first job to allocate the excess (remainder) quantities
			INNER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, MIN(seq_no) seq_no, COUNT(*) AS no_of_uncompleted_jobs
						FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
						  AND j.state_cd <> 4
						GROUP BY j.wo_id, j.oper_id
						) first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys ON list_of_jobs.wo_id = first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.wo_id AND list_of_jobs.oper_id = first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.oper_id
		WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND job.wo_id = list_of_jobs.wo_id
		  AND job.oper_id = list_of_jobs.oper_id
		  AND job.target_sched_ent_id = list_of_jobs.line_ent_id
		  --Allocate the excess quantities to the first uncompleted job in this column position
		  AND job.seq_no = first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.seq_no
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND job.state_cd <> 4

		--Update the quantities for the remaining jobs that were not completed.
		--Using the example above, the remaining jobs will have 25 quantities each.
		--I.e. 103 / 4 => 25 each
		UPDATE job
		SET qty_reqd = FLOOR(list_of_jobs.qty_reqd / first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs)
			, qty_at_start = FLOOR(list_of_jobs.qty_at_start / first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.no_of_uncompleted_jobs)
		FROM @line_job_route list_of_jobs
			--Determine the first job to allocate the excess (remainder) quantities
			INNER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, MIN(seq_no) seq_no, COUNT(*) AS no_of_uncompleted_jobs
						FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
						  AND j.state_cd <> 4
						GROUP BY j.wo_id, j.oper_id
						) first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys ON list_of_jobs.wo_id = first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.wo_id AND list_of_jobs.oper_id = first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.oper_id
		WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND job.wo_id = list_of_jobs.wo_id
		  AND job.oper_id = list_of_jobs.oper_id
		  AND job.target_sched_ent_id = list_of_jobs.line_ent_id
		  AND job.seq_no <> first_job_to_alloc_max_qtys.seq_no
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND job.state_cd <> 4

		--Copy Job BOM records
		INSERT INTO job_bom (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val,
			reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv,
			may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, current_subst, qty_reqd, serial_no_source,
			spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.bom_pos, first_jobs.item_id, first_jobs.reqd_grade_cd, first_jobs.instruction, first_jobs.qty_per_parent_item, first_jobs.max_qty_per_parent_item, first_jobs.min_qty_per_parent_item, first_jobs.reqd_start_val,
			first_jobs.reqd_start_val_is_pct, first_jobs.update_inv, first_jobs.backflush, first_jobs.def_reas_cd, first_jobs.def_lot_no, first_jobs.def_sublot_no, first_jobs.def_storage_ent_id, first_jobs.def_reject_ent_id, first_jobs.scaling_factor, first_jobs.must_consume_from_inv,
			first_jobs.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, first_jobs.may_create_new_lots, first_jobs.must_consume_from_wip, first_jobs.must_consume_before_prod, first_jobs.constant_qty, first_jobs.est_time, first_jobs.current_subst, first_jobs.qty_reqd, first_jobs.serial_no_source,
			first_jobs.spare1, first_jobs.spare2, first_jobs.spare3, first_jobs.spare4, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first jobs to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, jb.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = jb.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Copy Job BOM substitution records
		INSERT INTO job_bom_subst (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, alt_no, pref, subst_level, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction,
			qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val,
			reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv,
			may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time,
			spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.bom_pos, first_jobs.alt_no, first_jobs.pref, first_jobs.subst_level, first_jobs.item_id, first_jobs.reqd_grade_cd, first_jobs.instruction,
			first_jobs.qty_per_parent_item, first_jobs.max_qty_per_parent_item, first_jobs.min_qty_per_parent_item, first_jobs.reqd_start_val,
			first_jobs.reqd_start_val_is_pct, first_jobs.update_inv, first_jobs.backflush, first_jobs.def_reas_cd, first_jobs.def_lot_no, first_jobs.def_sublot_no, first_jobs.def_storage_ent_id, first_jobs.def_reject_ent_id, first_jobs.scaling_factor, first_jobs.must_consume_from_inv,
			first_jobs.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, first_jobs.may_create_new_lots, first_jobs.must_consume_from_wip, first_jobs.must_consume_before_prod, first_jobs.constant_qty, first_jobs.est_time,
			first_jobs.spare1, first_jobs.spare2, first_jobs.spare3, first_jobs.spare4, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job BOMs for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first jobs to copy the data for other job BOMs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, jbst.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = jbst.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Remove all the job routes for this work order.
		DELETE FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
		SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

		--Job Route
		;WITH job_route_from_line (column_position, line_ent_id, segment_no, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent) AS
			(SELECT ljr.column_position, j.target_sched_ent_id, ljr.segment_no, j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, ljr.input_percent
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @line_job_route ljr ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.target_sched_ent_id = ljr.line_ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = jr.seq_no
			--Retrieve the jobs from the first column position
			WHERE ljr.column_position = 1
			UNION ALL
			--Job route for the line entities that are NOT configured as segments
			SELECT current_position.column_position, j.target_sched_ent_id, current_position.segment_no,
				j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, prev_position.oper_id, prev_position.seq_no, current_position.input_percent
			FROM @line_job_route current_position
			INNER JOIN job_route_from_line prev_position ON prev_position.column_position = current_position.prev_column_position
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON current_position.wo_id = j.wo_id AND current_position.oper_id = j.oper_id AND current_position.line_ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			WHERE current_position.segment_no IS NULL
			UNION ALL
			--Job route for the line entities that are configured as segments
			SELECT current_position.column_position, j.target_sched_ent_id, current_position.segment_no,
				j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, prev_position.oper_id, prev_position.seq_no, current_position.input_percent
			FROM @line_job_route current_position
			INNER JOIN job_route_from_line prev_position ON prev_position.column_position = current_position.prev_column_position
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON current_position.wo_id = j.wo_id AND current_position.oper_id = j.oper_id AND current_position.line_ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			WHERE ((prev_position.segment_no IS NULL AND current_position.segment_no IS NOT NULL)
			   OR (prev_position.segment_no IS NOT NULL AND current_position.segment_no IS NOT NULL AND prev_position.segment_no = current_position.segment_no))
			)
		INSERT INTO job_route (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT line_route_to_job_route.wo_id, line_route_to_job_route.oper_id, line_route_to_job_route.seq_no
			, line_route_to_job_route.input_oper_id, line_route_to_job_route.input_seq_no, COALESCE(line_route_to_job_route.input_percent, 1)
			, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM
			(SELECT DISTINCT column_position, line_ent_id, segment_no, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent
			FROM job_route_from_line jrfl
			--Eliminate the first job from the list, since there no preceding operations
			WHERE jrfl.input_oper_id IS NOT NULL
		) line_route_to_job_route

		--Update the input percentages
		UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = job_route.input_percent / job_route_pct.no_of_records
		FROM
			(SELECT jr.wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, SUM(input_percent) total_input_percent, COUNT(*) no_of_records
			FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
			GROUP BY jr.wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no) job_route_pct
		WHERE job_route.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND job_route.wo_id = job_route_pct.wo_id AND job_route.input_oper_id = job_route_pct.input_oper_id
		  AND job_route.input_seq_no = job_route_pct.input_seq_no
		  --update the input percentages only for the jobs that do not have input percetages.
		  -- For the jobs that do not have input percentages, this stored procedure assigs 1 (100%)
		  AND job_route_pct.total_input_percent / job_route_pct.no_of_records = 1

		--Copy job specs
		INSERT INTO job_spec (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, spec_id, spec_value, act_spec_value, assoc_file,
			assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.step_no, first_jobs.spec_id, first_jobs.spec_value, first_jobs.act_spec_value, first_jobs.assoc_file,
			first_jobs.assoc_file_type, first_jobs.comments, first_jobs.min_value, first_jobs.max_value, first_jobs.access_level, first_jobs.last_edit_comment, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job specs for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first set of job steps to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, js.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = js.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = js.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = js.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Copy job attributes
		INSERT INTO job_attr (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.attr_id, first_jobs.attr_value, first_jobs.notes, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job attributes for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first set of job attributes to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, ja.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_attr ja WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = ja.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = ja.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = ja.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Copy Job Step Groups
		INSERT INTO job_step_grp (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.step_grp_id, first_jobs.step_grp_desc, first_jobs.step_grp_seq, first_jobs.repeatability, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job step groups for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first set of job step gropus to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, jsg.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_step_grp jsg WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = jsg.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = jsg.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = jsg.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Copy Job Steps
		INSERT INTO job_step (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, step_seq, step_name, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id,
			spc_char, form_name, data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning,
			spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.step_no, first_jobs.step_seq, first_jobs.step_name, first_jobs.step_desc, first_jobs.action_type, first_jobs.std_time, first_jobs.complete_cond, first_jobs.allow_bypass, first_jobs.enter_data, first_jobs.step_grp_id,
			first_jobs.spc_char, first_jobs.form_name, first_jobs.data_log_grp_id, first_jobs.reqd_rep, first_jobs.control_type, first_jobs.high_limit, first_jobs.low_limit, first_jobs.limit_warning,
			first_jobs.spare1, first_jobs.spare2, first_jobs.spare3, first_jobs.spare4, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job steps for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first set of job steps to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, js.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = js.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = js.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = js.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Copy Job Step Choices
		INSERT INTO job_step_choice (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.step_no, first_jobs.choice_no, first_jobs.choice_label, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job step choices for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first set of job step choices to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, jsc.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_step_choice jsc WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = jsc.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = jsc.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = jsc.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Copy Job Step Files
		INSERT INTO job_step_file (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT ljr.wo_id, ljr.oper_id, ljr.child_order_seq -1, first_jobs.step_no, first_jobs.assoc_file, first_jobs.assoc_file_type, first_jobs.last_edit_by, first_jobs.last_edit_at
		FROM @line_job_route ljr
		INNER JOIN
			--Retrieve the job step files for the first jobs from all the column positions and use the information from the first set of job step files to copy the data for other jobs in the same column position
			(SELECT first_job_in_col_pos.column_position, jsf.*
			 FROM @line_job_route first_job_in_col_pos
			 INNER JOIN job first_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job_in_col_pos.wo_id = first_job.wo_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.oper_id = first_job.oper_id AND first_job_in_col_pos.line_ent_id = first_job.target_sched_ent_id
			 INNER JOIN job_step_file jsf WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.wo_id = jsf.wo_id AND first_job.oper_id = jsf.oper_id AND first_job.seq_no = jsf.seq_no
			 WHERE first_job.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND first_job_in_col_pos.child_order_seq = 1
			) first_jobs ON ljr.column_position = first_jobs.column_position
		--Exclude completed jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = ljr.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ljr.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ljr.child_order_seq -1 AND j.state_cd = 4
		WHERE --Create new jobs only for the column positions that have more than one entity.
		  ljr.child_order_seq >= 2
		  --Eliminate the case when the line entity is scheduled as the job's target schedule entity
		  AND ljr.line_ent_id <> ljr.init_sched_ent_id
		  AND j.wo_id IS NULL

		--Verify whether the queue sequence number is supplied
		IF (@queue_seq_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Verify whether the supplied queue sequence number exist for a work order
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no)
				--Increasement the queue sequence number for all the work orders, whose queue sequence number is the supplied sequence number or higher.
				UPDATE wo SET queue_seq_no = queue_seq_no + 1 WHERE queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no
		END

		--Update the work order with the supplied line ID and queue sequence number
		UPDATE wo SET target_sched_line_id = @line_id, queue_seq_no = @queue_seq_no WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	END
	ELSE BEGIN --The supplied work order is un-assigned from a line.

		--If the supplied line does not exist in the database, return
		IF (@line_name IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'LineID:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @line_id)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether the supplied work order is assigned to a line
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND target_sched_line_id IS NULL)
			--Since this work order is not assigned to any line, return
			RETURN

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND target_sched_line_id <> @line_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The supplied work order: %1 is not assigned to the line: %2.{7644},' + @wo_id + ',' + COALESCE(@line_name, '')
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify none of jobs in the supplied work order is currently running.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.state_cd = 3) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'There is at least one job in this work order: %1 that is currently running.{7645},' + @wo_id
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Remove the job step file records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_step_file
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_step_file.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_step_file.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_step_file.seq_no = j.seq_no
		  AND job_step_file.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND job_step_file.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Remove the job step choice records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_step_choice
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_step_choice.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_step_choice.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_step_choice.seq_no = j.seq_no
		  AND j.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND j.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Remove the job step records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_step
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_step.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_step.seq_no = j.seq_no
		  AND j.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND j.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Remove the job step group records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_step_grp
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_step_grp.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_step_grp.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_step_grp.seq_no = j.seq_no
		  AND j.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND j.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Remove the job attr records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_attr
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_attr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_attr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_attr.seq_no = j.seq_no
		  AND j.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND j.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Remove the job spec records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_spec
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_spec.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_spec.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_spec.seq_no = j.seq_no
		  AND j.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND j.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Remove the job route records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job_route
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		,(SELECT j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id, MIN(j1.seq_no) seq_no
		  FROM job j1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j1.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND j1.state_cd <> 4
		  GROUP BY j1.wo_id, j1.oper_id) uncompl_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job_route.wo_id = j.wo_id
		  AND ((job_route.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_route.seq_no = j.seq_no)
			OR (job_route.input_oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_route.input_seq_no = j.seq_no))
		  AND j.wo_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.wo_id AND j.oper_id = uncompl_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND j.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND j.seq_no > uncompl_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND j.state_cd <> 4

		--Fix job routes percentages
		UPDATE job_route SET input_percent = 1/input_jobs.no_of_jobs
		FROM (SELECT jr.wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, COUNT(*) no_of_jobs
				FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
				GROUP BY jr.wo_id, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no) input_jobs
		WHERE job_route.wo_id = input_jobs.wo_id
		  AND job_route.input_oper_id = input_jobs.input_oper_id AND job_route.input_seq_no = input_jobs.input_seq_no

		--Fix job quantities
		;WITH alloc_qtys_to_fir_uncompl_job (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no) AS
		(SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, MIN(j.seq_no) seq_no
		 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			 WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
			   AND j.state_cd <> 4
			GROUP BY j.wo_id, j.oper_id
		)
		UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = job.qty_at_start + COALESCE(remaining_qtys.qty_at_start, 0), qty_reqd = job.qty_reqd + COALESCE(remaining_qtys.qty_reqd, 0)
			, qty_prod = job.qty_prod + COALESCE(remaining_qtys.qty_prod, 0), qty_prod_erp = job.qty_prod_erp + COALESCE(remaining_qtys.qty_prod_erp, 0)
			, qty_rejected = job.qty_rejected + COALESCE(remaining_qtys.qty_rejected, 0), qty_rejected_erp = job.qty_rejected_erp + COALESCE(remaining_qtys.qty_rejected_erp, 0)
		FROM alloc_qtys_to_fir_uncompl_job first_uncompl_jobs
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, SUM(j.qty_at_start) qty_at_start, SUM(j.qty_reqd) qty_reqd
				, SUM(j.qty_prod) qty_prod, SUM(j.qty_prod_erp) qty_prod_erp
				, SUM(j.qty_rejected) qty_rejected, SUM(j.qty_rejected_erp) qty_rejected_erp
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN alloc_qtys_to_fir_uncompl_job first_uncompl_jobs2 ON j.wo_id = first_uncompl_jobs2.wo_id AND j.oper_id = first_uncompl_jobs2.oper_id
				WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				  --Retrieve the remaining uncompleted jobs whose sequence number is greater than the sequence number of the first uncompleted job in this column position.
				  AND j.seq_no > first_uncompl_jobs2.seq_no
				  AND j.init_sched_ent_id <> j.target_sched_ent_id
				  --Exclude the completed jobs
				  AND j.state_cd <> 4
				GROUP BY j.wo_id, j.oper_id
			) remaining_qtys ON remaining_qtys.wo_id = first_uncompl_jobs.wo_id AND remaining_qtys.oper_id = first_uncompl_jobs.oper_id
		WHERE job.wo_id = first_uncompl_jobs.wo_id
		  AND job.oper_id = first_uncompl_jobs.oper_id
		  AND job.seq_no = first_uncompl_jobs.seq_no

		--Remove the job records for the supplied work order whose initial schedule entity is not the target schedule entity and there are more than one jobs in a column position.
		DELETE job
		FROM (SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, MIN(j.seq_no) seq_no
			 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			 WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			   AND j.state_cd <> 4
			 GROUP BY j.wo_id, j.oper_id) first_uncompleted_job_in_col_pos
		WHERE job.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND job.wo_id = first_uncompleted_job_in_col_pos.wo_id
		  AND job.oper_id = first_uncompleted_job_in_col_pos.oper_id
		  AND job.seq_no > first_uncompleted_job_in_col_pos.seq_no
		  AND job.init_sched_ent_id <> job.target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND job.state_cd <> 4

		--The update statement above would not catch the jobs that do not have sequence numbers greater than 0 after the job split.
		--Therefore, update all the jobs in this work order to reset the target schedule entity to initial schedule entity, if they're not equal
		UPDATE  job
		SET target_sched_ent_id = init_sched_ent_id
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND init_sched_ent_id <> target_sched_ent_id
		  --Exclude the completed jobs
		  AND job.state_cd <> 4

		--Un-assign the work order from a line.
		UPDATE wo SET target_sched_line_id = NULL, queue_seq_no = NULL WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	END
END

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_BIOS_to_Job_spec]
  @wo_id           NVARCHAR(40),
  @J_seq_no        INT,
  @process_id      STRING40,
  @BI_item_id      STRING40,
  @BIOL_ver_id     STRING40,
  @BIOL_bom_pos    INT,
  @BIOL_process_id STRING40,
  @BIOL_oper_id    STRING40,
  @spec_ver_id	   STRING40 = NULL
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_BIOS_TO_JOB_SPEC
-- Description	      - Builds job specifications based on the specifications used for all the items in this
--                      process for this particular operation based on the preferred specification version.
-- Author             -
-- Date Created	      - 03/18/2002
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.13
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver   Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/22/2002     Sheetal Jain  1001  Changes as per modified spec
-- 05/22/2002     Sheetal Jain  1002  Item spec inserted only if its not already present(primary key) in the job
-- 05/30/2002     Vijay Raj     1002  When inserting value into job_spec, step no defaults to -1(part of Primary Key now)
-- 05/13/2002     Sheetal Jain  1003  All the item specifications are transferred to job for the operation
-- 08/09/2002     Sheetal Jain  1004  Step_No picked from Oper_Ent_Spec
-- 10/22/2002     KRF           1004  Write step_no read from BOM_Item_Oper_Spec to Job_Spec, instead of always writing -1
-- 12/24/2002     Sheetal Jain  1500  Step_No not always negative
-- 12/03/2003     Sheetal Jain  2013  HD# 4133 Support new spec fields
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 10/19/2004     SJ            2042  HD#5076 CWFP -- PK violation in job_spec
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
--10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/24/2009	  SLR           4.0.0 Added code to retrieve specs from the new oper_item_spec table
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @last_edit_by	STRING40,
  @last_edit_at	DATETIME
BEGIN
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  --18	Read Preferred Spec ver_id from OPER_SPEC_VER table for this Oper
  --19	Get all specs (matching rows) from BOM_ITEM_OPER_SPEC table using ver_id from OPER_SPEC_VER table
  INSERT INTO job_spec(wo_id, oper_id, step_no, seq_no, spec_id, spec_value, act_spec_value, assoc_file,
                       assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    (

    SELECT @wo_id, bios.oper_id, bios.step_no, @J_seq_no, bios.spec_id, bios.spec_value, NULL, bios.assoc_file,
           bios.assoc_file_type, bios.comments, bios.min_value, bios.max_value, bios.access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM BOM_item_oper_spec bios
      INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON bios.process_id = osv.process_id AND bios.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND bios.spec_ver_id = osv.ver_id
        WHERE bios.process_id = @BIOL_process_id AND bios.oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND bios.item_id = @BI_item_id AND bios.ver_id = @BIOL_ver_id
          AND (bios.spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1))
          AND bios.spec_id NOT IN (SELECT spec_id FROM job_spec WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no)

    UNION

    -- retrieve all of the specs assigned to an item from oper_item_spec table
    SELECT @wo_id, ois.oper_id, ois.step_no, @J_seq_no, ois.spec_id, ois.spec_value, NULL, ois.assoc_file,
           ois.assoc_file_type, ois.comments, ois.min_value, ois.max_value, ois.access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM oper_item_spec ois
      INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON ois.process_id = osv.process_id AND ois.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND ois.ver_id = osv.ver_id
        WHERE ois.process_id = @BIOL_process_id AND ois.oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND ois.item_id = @BI_item_id
          AND (ois.ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1))
          AND ois.spec_id NOT IN (SELECT spec_id FROM job_spec WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no
                                  UNION
                                  SELECT bios.spec_id FROM BOM_ITEM_oper_spec bios
                                  INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON bios.process_id = osv.process_id AND bios.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND bios.spec_ver_id = osv.ver_id
                                  WHERE bios.process_id = @BIOL_process_id AND bios.oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND
                                  bios.item_id = @BI_item_id AND bios.ver_id = @BIOL_ver_id and (bios.spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1)))

    UNION

    -- retrieve all of the specs assigned to an item_class from new oper_item_spec table
    SELECT @wo_id, ois.oper_id, ois.step_no, @J_seq_no, ois.spec_id, ois.spec_value, NULL, ois.assoc_file,
           ois.assoc_file_type, ois.comments, ois.min_value, ois.max_value, ois.access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM oper_item_spec ois
      INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON ois.process_id = osv.process_id AND ois.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND ois.ver_id = osv.ver_id
        WHERE ois.process_id = @BIOL_process_id AND ois.oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id
          AND (ois.ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1))
          AND ois.item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM item where item_id = @BI_item_id)
          AND ois.item_id IS NULL
          AND ois.spec_id NOT IN (SELECT spec_id FROM job_spec WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no
                                  UNION
                                  SELECT bios.spec_id FROM BOM_ITEM_oper_spec bios
                                  INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON bios.process_id = osv.process_id AND bios.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND bios.spec_ver_id = osv.ver_id
                                  WHERE bios.process_id = @BIOL_process_id AND bios.oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND
                                  bios.item_id = @BI_item_id AND bios.ver_id = @BIOL_ver_id and (bios.spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1))
                                  UNION
                                  SELECT tmp.spec_id FROM oper_item_spec tmp
                                  INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON tmp.process_id = osv.process_id AND tmp.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND tmp.ver_id = osv.ver_id
                                  WHERE tmp.process_id = ois.process_id AND tmp.oper_id = ois.oper_id AND tmp.item_id = @BI_item_id
                                  AND (tmp.ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1)))
    )
END

-- Name:  	[sp_U_ofi_MergeJobJoin]
-- Description: Update qty_reqd for splitted job_bom
-- Usage:	Update qty_reqd for splitted job_bom

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB			2023-06-10			Initial version. 

-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_MergeJobJoin]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(MAX),
	@oper_id nvarchar(MAX),
	@present_seq_no int,
	@merge_to_seq_no int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here



	declare @temp1 table (qty float, seq_no int, bom_pos int)


	
	declare @to_merge_seq_no float

	insert into @temp1
	select qty_reqd,seq_no, bom_pos from job_bom with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id  and seq_no=@present_seq_no --and bom_pos=0
	


	update jb
	set jb.qty_reqd=CAST((jb.qty_reqd+t1.qty)as float)
	from job_bom as jb with (nolock)
	inner join @temp1 as t1 on jb.bom_pos=t1.bom_pos 
	where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id  and jb.seq_no=@merge_to_seq_no
	


END
