				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid item is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_item_id IS NULL AND @ItemIdFromAUT = 1
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','item_id: '+@item_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'item_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid SOURCE storage unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_su_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','Storage Unit / SUNumberInAUT: '+@storage_unit)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'su_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Check if source is part of the selected ones
			DECLARE @mes_source_su_active INT = 0
			SELECT @mes_source_su_active = count (os.wo_id)
			FROM ofi_su_selection os WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE os.dest_type = 1 -- source
				AND os.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				AND os.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
				AND os.seq_no = @seq_no
				AND (os.su_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id OR os.secondary_silo_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id)

			-- if an invalid SOURCE storage unit is suplied; as it is not active for the selected job
			IF (@mes_source_su_active IS NULL OR @mes_source_su_active = 0)
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500026,NULL,NULL),'%1','Storage Unit / SUNumberInAUT: '+@storage_unit)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'su_not_Active_warning',@status_output
				END				
			END

			-- Declare the outputs of the SP_S_ofi_Get_Cons_Qty_Value Stored Procedure plus a local variable table to pick it up
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				,@data_bom_pos	INT
				,@data_def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				,@data_factor	FLOAT
				,@data_thr_result	INT
				,@data_from_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				,@data_qty_cons FLOAT
				,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				,@data_su_result INT
				,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME
				,@data_type INT = -1

			-- IMPORTANT::: CANNOT DO NESTED INSERT INTO




			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT @data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
			FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd=state_cd
					,@data_edit_time=edit_time 
			FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND seq_no = @seq_no

			-- if JOB is COMPLETED/NEW or RELEASED, ERROR -- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED -- 4 COMPLETED == WARNING --- 6 to 10 Other invalid job states (not allowed in AddCons)
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10) 
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500024,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
								
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				-- exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;

			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd = 4
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500016,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
										
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			---- Calculate the recorded_timestamp for the specified job
			DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME 
			DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT 
			DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT 


			-- Get the valid timestamp in case the job is running or has ran:
			SELECT @record_min_Diff = record_min_Diff
					,@recorded_timestamp_case = recorded_timestamp_case
					,@record_selected = record_selected
			FROM [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] (
			   @mes_wo_id
			  ,@mes_oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@recorded_timestamp)

			-- SET the actual date : In case the job has never RAN; we use the provided timestamp and let MES deal with it.
			SET @data_created_at_utc = ISNULL(@record_selected,@recorded_timestamp)
			
			-- Set warning if the recorded timestamp falls outside the job run time
			IF @recorded_timestamp_case > 500
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(@recorded_timestamp_case,NULL,NULL)+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@data_created_at_utc,121) +'. original recorded_timestamp: '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@recorded_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timestamp_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

		
			-- MAIN Logic taken from SP_S_ofi_GET_CONS_Qty_value
			
			-- 1. ++ Retrieve Item from Inventory from Location Provided
			DECLARE @ItemTable TABLE(
				item_id nvarchar(40)
			)

			INSERT INTO @ItemTable
			EXEC SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption @mes_wo_id,@mes_oper_id,@seq_no,@storage_unit, NULL

			-- Gets one item from the inventory according to the sp GetItemForConsumption
			SELECT @data_from_item_id = item_id 
			FROM @ItemTable

			SET @mes_item_id = @data_from_item_id

			-- if no storage is found: 
			IF (@data_from_item_id IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				--SELECT -2 type, 'No item is not available in the storage, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
				--SELECT -2 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('No item is not available in the storage, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
				SELECT 	@data_type = -2, 
						@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300046,NULL,10) + ISNULL(@storage_unit,'')

				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END


			DECLARE @UOM_factor TABLE (factor float)

			-- GET UOM FACTOR
			INSERT @UOM_factor
			EXECUTE sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT 
				 @item_id = @data_from_item_id
				,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
				,@interface = 'CONS' 

			SELECT @data_factor = factor
			FROM @UOM_factor

			IF (@data_factor is NULL OR @data_factor = 0)
			BEGIN
				--SELECT -3 type, 'Factor is not defined, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
				--SELECT -3 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Factor is not defined, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
				SELECT 	@data_type = -3, 
						@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300047,NULL,10) + ISNULL(@data_from_item_id,'')
				
				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END
			-- 2. -- end

			
			-- 3. ++ Get Real Qty To Be Consume after Convertion
			DECLARE @ConsQtyTable TABLE(
				[type] INT,
				[qty_to_consume] FLOAT NULL DEFAULT 0.00
			)

			INSERT @ConsQtyTable
			EXEC SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty @data_from_item_id,  @storage_unit, @qty, @data_factor

			SELECT 	 @data_type = [type]
					,@data_qty_cons = ISNULL([qty_to_consume] ,0) -- MOd v1.03
			FROM @ConsQtyTable
			
			-- if SU does not have enough inventory then show Inventory warning == 9
			IF @data_type IS NULL OR @data_type = 1 -- 1 = qty_left < qty to consume
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500023,NULL,NULL)+' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15)) + '. qty_left: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@data_qty_cons/@data_factor,0) AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_inventory

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'SU_qty_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

			PRINT '@data_qty_cons: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@data_qty_cons)
			PRINT '@data_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@data_type)

			-- v2.00 = Give warninig message when qty_left is zero on inventory
			-- Fix for zero quantity
			IF @data_type = -1
			BEGIN
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_inventory
				SET @message_output = 'No inventory quantity on  ' + ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') + ' - found item: ' + ISNULL(@data_from_item_id,' Not item found either')

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_error',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
				-- Done here; exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- 3. -----
			-- 4. ++ Check Grade Code
			DECLARE @mes_item_grade_cd INT,
					@mes_item_status_cd INT,
					@minID INT,
					@req_grade_cd INT,
					@typeOfCons NVARCHAR(20) = 'FIFO', 
					@storage_item_id NVARCHAR(40)

			SELECT @typeOfCons = attr_value
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
												AND a.attr_desc = 'typeOfCons'
												AND a.attr_grp = 2
			WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			SELECT TOP 1 @storage_item_id = item_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			SET @typeOfCons = ISNULL(@typeOfCons,'FIFO')

			SELECT @req_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
			FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id  = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND item_id = @storage_item_id
			
			
				--Check the SU have 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
			SELECT TOP 1 @data_su_status = attr_desc
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id 
				AND attr_desc IN ('LockForOutput','BlockForQuality') 
				AND attr_value = '1'
			
			-- if SU is in any of the states 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
			IF @data_su_status IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300050,NULL,NULL)+ @data_su_status +' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'SU_status_warning',@status_output as 'status'
				END
			END
			
			DECLARE @invlist1 TABLE (   id INT  PRIMARY KEY, 
								lot NVARCHAR(40) ,
								sublot NVARCHAR(40), 
								qty FLOAT, 
								cons_qty FLOAT,  
								consume_full BIT ,
								grade_cd INT, 
								status_cd INT, 
								row_id int)

			INSERT INTO @invlist1
			EXEC SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons @mes_su_ent_id, @data_from_item_id, @data_qty_cons, @typeOfCons  -- changed FIFO to @typeOfCons

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @invlist1 WHERE cons_qty >0

			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL )
			BEGIN
				SELECT @mes_item_grade_cd = grade_cd, @mes_item_status_cd = status_cd FROM @invlist1 WHERE id = @minID

				IF(@req_grade_cd <> @mes_item_grade_cd)
				BEGIN
					--SELECT -4 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, 'Grade is not match with The BOM, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
					--SELECT -4 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Grade is not match with The BOM, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
					SELECT @data_type = -4 
						   ,@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300048,NULL,10) + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_item_grade_cd,'') as VARCHAR(32)) + ' vs ' + CAST(ISNULL(@req_grade_cd,'') as VARCHAR(32))
					BREAK;
				END

				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @invlist1 WHERE id > @minID AND cons_qty >0
			END
			
			IF @data_type = -4
			BEGIN
				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END;
			-- 4. --
			
			-- 5. --			
			IF EXISTS(	SELECT iv.row_id 
						FROM item_inv iv
						LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
																	and jb.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
																	and jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
																	and jb.item_id = iv.item_id
						WHERE 
							iv.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
								AND jb.item_id IS NULL )
			BEGIN
				--SELECT -5 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, 'Material is not available in the BoM, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
				--SELECT -5 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Material is not available in the BoM, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
				SELECT   @data_type = -5 
						,@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300049,NULL,10) + ' AUT_SU: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') AS VARCHAR(32))
				
				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END
			
			
			--- FINAL OUTPUT OF THE SP: 
			---	SELECT 	ISNULL(@data_type,-1) type
			--		   	, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id
			--			, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons
			--			, '' message_info
			--			, @data_su_status su_status
			--			, @su_aut_name su_aut_name
			
			
			-- evaluation - Check data type value and continue!
		EvaluateType:

		
			PRINT '@data_qty_cons: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@data_qty_cons)
			PRINT '@data_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@data_type)


			IF @data_type IN (-5, -4)
			BEGIN
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
				
				-- Warning, continue with CONS
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_warning',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
			END
			ELSE IF @data_type = 1
			BEGIN

				-- Warning, continue with CONS
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_warning',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
			END
			ELSE IF @data_type = 0
			BEGIN
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_ok',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
			END
			ELSE IF @data_type = -1 -- silo have data item_inv but qty_left = 0 so; send error anyway
			BEGIN
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @message_output = 'No inventory quantity on ' + ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') + ' but item is found: ' + ISNULL(@data_from_item_id,' Not found')

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_error',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
				-- Done here; exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @message_output = 'data type error. data_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20),ISNULL(@data_type,-100))
				
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_error',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
				-- Done here; exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
	
			-- v2.00 -- Added support to get the sublot from AUT if not found, use the current one as before.
			-- Prepare SUBLOT_NO to 5 zeros:
			DECLARE @mes_fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(25)
				

			-- Check if the fg_sublot_no is provided: 
			IF @sublot_no IS NULL OR @sublot_no < 0 
			BEGIN
				
				-- v2.00 use the new function [ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot]
				-- Get SUBLOT_NO
				DECLARE @sublotTable TABLE (
												sublot_counter INT,
												sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
											)

				INSERT @sublotTable
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
											@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
											,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
											,@seq_no = @seq_no
						
				-- v2.01
				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_fg_Sublot_no = sublot_no 
							,@sublot_no = sublot_counter
				FROM @sublotTable

				-- SET THE MESSAGE HERE
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(500045,NULL,1) + ' Sublot: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@sublot_no,'') AS NVARCHAR(45))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'not_valid_Sublot_provided',@status_output
				END
			END

			-- SELECT with NEw funct WIHT OUTPUT:  out_sublot_no 	NVARCHAR(40) ,out_lot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
			SELECT	@mes_fg_Sublot_no = out_sublot_no
					,@data_def_lot_no = out_lot_no
			FROM [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot] (@mes_wo_id,@mes_oper_id,@seq_no,@sublot_no)

			-- v2.00 Review if we receive a def_reas_id and get its value from the function with the custom logic.
			IF (@cons_reas_id IS NOT NULL AND @cons_reas_id > -1)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
				FROM [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_GetDefReasCdFromId] (@mes_wo_id,@mes_oper_id,@seq_no,@cons_reas_id)
			END

		-- Fly by to calculate the quantity
		Virtual_Silo_CONS: 
			-- Prepare the data for quantity
			DECLARE @mes_qty_Cons FLOAT = 0.0
			SET @mes_qty_Cons = ISNULL(@qty, 0) * ISNULL(@data_factor,1)

			-- Declare the outputs
			DECLARE @cons_row_id INT
					,@cons_info NVARCHAR(4000)


			-- DEFINE OUTPUTS
			DECLARE @return_bit INT
			
			IF @IsVirtualSilo = 1 
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @AddConsAdditivesTable AS TABLE (
															row_id INT
															,error_desc NVARCHAR(80)
														)
							
				INSERT INTO @AddConsAdditivesTable
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Additive_AddCons] 
						   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  ,@qty = @mes_qty_Cons   --> actual quantity to report
						  ,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id  --> Line source of the consumption message ent_id required
						  ,@aut_storage_id = @storage_unit --> shall be the storage unit value from the AUT interface 
						  ,@item_id = NULL  --> not used within the SP


				-- Set the output row IF
				SELECT TOP 1 @cons_row_id = row_id
							,@message_output = error_desc
				FROM @AddConsAdditivesTable

				IF @cons_row_id < 0
				BEGIN
					-- Set output message in case of error
					SET @message_output = 'Virtual silo fail with message: '+ @message_output + '. AND Storage_unit: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') AS NVARCHAR(35)) -- to review: Virtual Silo cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				END
				ELSE IF @cons_row_id > 0 AND @message_output <> '' AND @message_output IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @message_output = 'Virtual silo WARNING message: '+ @message_output + '. AND Storage_unit: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') AS NVARCHAR(35)) -- to review: Virtual Silo cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
				END

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'virtual_silo_output',@status_output
				END

				-- Done here; exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- Verify the Dosing STEP when doing the consumption in MES
				-- Execute normal procedure from OFI --->
				EXECUTE @return_bit = [dbo].[SP_I_ofi_Item_Cons_AddCons] 
										@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
										,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
										,@seq_no = @seq_no
										,@qty = @data_qty_cons ---> calculated on SP
										,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
										,@aut_storage_id = @storage_unit
										,@item_id = @data_from_item_id  ---> Calculated on SP
										,@actual_cons_time = @data_created_at_utc
										,@target_fg_lot_no = @data_def_lot_no --v1.03.00 Added
										,@target_fg_sublot_no = @mes_fg_Sublot_no --v1.03.00 Added
										,@target_cons_reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd --v1.03.00 Added -- review type

			
				IF @return_bit > 0
				BEGIN
					-- SET Error in Add Cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500021,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@return_bit,555) AS VARCHAR(32))
					
					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END;
			END



			-- Check Add prod from CONS attribute
			DECLARE @mes_dec_prod_from_cons NVARCHAR(3000)
					,@mes_def_destination_su NVARCHAR(40)
					,@mes_def_destination_su_ent_id INT
					,@mes_prod_item_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@prod_row_id INT = -1
					,@prod_info NVARCHAR(4000)
			
			SELECT @mes_dec_prod_from_cons = oa.attr_value
			FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
			WHERE a.attr_desc = 'declare_prod_with_cons'
				AND a.attr_grp = 7
				AND oa.oper_id = @mes_oper_id

			IF @mes_dec_prod_from_cons = 'YES'
			BEGIN
				-- Produce agains the consumption:
				-- find the default destination if configured: if not use the consuming SEGMENT
				--- LOGIC TAKEN FROM sp_SA_ofi_Oper_Attr

				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id = active_su_ent_id 
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND dest_type = 2 
				
				SELECT @mes_def_destination_su = ent_name  
				FROM ent WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE ent_id = @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id
			

				IF(@mes_def_destination_su IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @mes_def_destination_su = oper_attr.attr_value 
					FROM oper_attr oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
					WHERE 	oper_attr.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
							AND attr.attr_desc = 'def_destination_su'
					
				END
				
				-- PICK either current value or new value based on it being NULL or NOT
				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id = COALESCE(@mes_def_destination_su_ent_id,e.ent_id)
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_def_destination_su

				-- If no destination found; Raise inventory error
				IF @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id IS NULL
				BEGIN
					-- SET Error in Add Cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_inventory
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500025,NULL,NULL) + @mes_oper_id;
					
					RAISERROR(@message_output,16,1);	
					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END

				-- Get DEF lot, reas, material for BOM_POS = 0 for the selected job
				SELECT	 @data_def_lot_no = COALESCE(@data_def_lot_no,def_lot_no)
						,@data_bom_pos = bom_pos
						,@mes_prod_item_id = item_id
						,@data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
				FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND bom_pos = 0
				

				--v2.00 added
				IF 	(@data_def_lot_no IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					SELECT  @data_def_lot_no = w.lot_no
					FROM    ofi_wo_ext w WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE
							w.wo_id = @wo_id
							AND w.lot_no IS NOT NULL
						
				END

				SELECT @data_def_reas_cd = ISNULL(@data_def_reas_cd, ir.reas_cd)
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				INNER JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.reas_desc = ea.attr_value
				WHERE a.attr_desc like 'def_reas_cd'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND ea.ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
						
				
				
				-- DO PRODUCTION AFTER CONS
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd] 
								 @session_id = NULL
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@qty_prod = @data_qty_cons
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_def_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @mes_fg_Sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id
								,@item_id = @mes_prod_item_id
								,@check_privs  = NULL
								,@created_at_utc = @data_created_at_utc
								,@row_id = @prod_row_id OUTPUT
								,@prod_info = @prod_info OUTPUT		  
			END

			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN

				SELECT @cons_info as Cons_info
						,@cons_row_id  as cons_row_id
						,@prod_info as prod_info
						,@prod_row_id as prod_row_id
				
				SELECT *
				FROM item_Cons i WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.row_id = @cons_row_id

				SELECT *
				FROM item_inv i WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
				
				SELECT *
				FROM item_prod i WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.row_id = @prod_row_id

				SELECT
						 @data_wo_state_cd AS wo_status
						,@data_job_state_cd	AS state_cd
						,@data_job_pos	AS job_pos 
						,@data_bom_pos	AS bom_pos
						,@data_def_lot_no AS def_lot_no
						,@data_def_reas_cd AS def_reas_cd
						,@data_factor	AS factor
						,@data_thr_result	AS thr_result
						,@mes_item_id AS mes_item_id
						,@data_from_item_id AS from_item_id
						,@data_lot_no AS lot_no
						,@data_sublot_no AS sublot_no
						,@data_qty_cons AS qty_cons
						,@data_edit_time AS edit_time
						,@data_max_capacity AS max_capacity 
						,@data_su_result AS su_result
						,@data_su_status AS su_status
						,@mes_su_ent_id AS su_ent_id
						--,@mes_fg_sublot_no AS mes_sublot_no
						,@data_created_at_utc as created_at_utc
						,@mes_qty_Cons as mes_qty_Cons
						--,@mes_byproduct as mes_byproduct
						,@mes_user_id as mes_user_id

			END			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END


		-- Exit area
		Exit_Tree:
		--- PASTE UNTIL HERE ---
		
		-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
		IF @status_output = 1 
		BEGIN
			-- SET OK
			SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
			SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500022,NULL,NULL)
		END

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @message_output = @message_output + ' - ErrorMessagE: ' + @message
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

        BEGIN TRY
			---- ADDed extras v1.03  ==> if state is -1 then we just need to rollback all
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			-- Find the last opening brace
			DECLARE @start INT = LEN(@message_output) - CHARINDEX('{', REVERSE(@message_output)) + 1;

			-- Find the corresponding closing brace
			DECLARE @end INT = CHARINDEX('}', @message_output, @start);

			-- Remove the substring if both braces are found
			IF @start > 0 AND @end > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = STUFF(@message_output, @start, @end - @start + 1, '');
			END

			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@status_output)+';message_output:'+@message_output
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
					,@status_output as status_output
					,@message_output as message_output
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

-- Description:	The stored procedure will insert the attributes if not created by mes client
--
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JN				2022-09-22			Initial version.
-- 0.01.10	YG				2024-01-30			Added the comment on the body script and formating 
-- ===========================================================================================*******************************************************************************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_su_attr]
(@ent_id INT,
@last_edit_at DATETIME OUTPUT )
 
AS
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),
		@attr_desc NVARCHAR(80),
		@count int

-- Get User Id
EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL;

-- Set Initial Value
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() );
SET @count=0 ;
SET @attr_desc = 'LockForInput';
BEGIN
	-- Insert attribute (lockforinput and lockforoutput) on the ent attribute if not available
	while  (@count<4)
	Begin
		If NOT exists (select ent_attr.ent_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						inner join ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) on attr.attr_id=ent_attr.attr_id 
						where attr_desc = @attr_desc and ent_id = @ent_id)
			INSERT INTO ent_attr 
				(ent_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes,last_edit_comment,last_edit_by,last_edit_at) 
			VALUES
				(@ent_id,(select attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = @attr_desc),0,NULL,NULL,@last_edit_by,@last_edit_at);

		-- Set Attribute into 'LockForQuality' if Counter value is 1
		If (@count=1) 
		Begin
			SET @attr_desc = 'LockForQuality';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'LockForOutput' if Counter value is 2
		Else if(@count=2)
		Begin
			SET @attr_desc = 'LockForOutput';
		End
	
		SET @count=@count+1;
	End
End

	END

	-- Data Validation received from 'Consumption' interface
	IF @interface = 'CONS'
	BEGIN

		-- Get Silo Properties 'LockForOutput'
		SELECT @lockforoutput = ea.attr_value

		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'LockForOutput'

		WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id

		-- Get Silo Properties 'BlockForQuality'

		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
		IF (left(@aut_storage_id,1)=9)
		 BEGIN
		 SET @storage_ent_id=@aut_storage_id
		 END

		IF EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 1
				FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
					AND oper_id = @oper_id
					AND seq_no = @seq_no
				)
			AND (@storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL)
			
			--AND (@qty < 0.00) -- Check if qty is less than 0
			--AND (
			--	(
			--		SELECT Sum(qty_left)
			--		FROM item_inv
			--		WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id
			--		AND status_cd = (SELECT item_status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')   --0.02.00 Added
			--		) >= @qty
			--	)
			-- Disabled on version 0.05.00
			--AND (
			--	(@lockforoutput IS NULL OR @lockforoutput != '1')
			--	AND 
			--	(@lockforquality IS NULL OR @lockforquality != '1')
			--	)
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 1
		END
	END

	--Merging DSU and SSU logic as one validation in RSU
	--IF @interface = 'SSU'
	--BEGIN
	--	DECLARE @secondary_S_silo_ent_id INT

	--	SELECT @secondary_S_silo_ent_id = secondary_silo_ent_id
	--	FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
	--	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	--		AND oper_id = @oper_id
	--		AND seq_no = @seq_no
	--		AND storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id

	--	IF EXISTS (
	--			SELECT TOP 1 1
	--			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	--			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	--				AND oper_id = @oper_id
	--				AND seq_no = @seq_no
	--			)
	--		AND (@storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL)
	--		AND (@secondary_S_silo_ent_id IS NOT NULL or @secondary_S_silo_ent_id <>0)
	--	BEGIN
	--		SET @result = 1
	--	END
	--END

	-- Data Validation received from 'New Silo Request' interface
	IF @interface = 'RSU'
	BEGIN
		-- TBC as this validation will not work for the destination request
		--DECLARE @secondary_silo_ent_id INT

		--SELECT @secondary_silo_ent_id = secondary_silo_ent_id
		--FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
		--WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		--	AND oper_id = @oper_id
		--	AND seq_no = @seq_no
		--	AND storage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id
			
		--IF EXISTS (
		--		SELECT TOP 1 1
		--		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		--		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		--			AND oper_id = @oper_id
		--			AND seq_no = @seq_no
		--		)
		--	AND (@storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL)
		--	AND (@secondary_silo_ent_id IS NOT NULL or @secondary_silo_ent_id <>0)
		--BEGIN
		--	SET @result = 1
		--END

		SET @result = 1
	END

	-- Data Validation received from 'Bag Production' interface
	IF @interface = 'BPROD'
		AND EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1
	END

	-- Data Validation received from 'Pallet Production' interface
	IF @interface = 'Pallet'
		AND EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1
	END

	-- Data Validation received from 'HU Request' interface
	IF @interface = 'HU'
	AND EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
			--AND state_cd = 3
		)
	BEGIN
		SET @result = 1
	END

	-- Data Validation received from 'Press Calculation' interface
	IF @interface = 'PRESS'
		AND EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no
			)
	BEGIN
		Declare @process_id nvarchar(40), @attr_id int,@attr_value nvarchar(20)
		select @attr_id=attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='CalculateButter'
		select @process_id=process_id from wo with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id
		SELECT @attr_value=attr_value FROM process_attr with (nolock) WHERE process_attr.process_id = @process_id and attr_id=@attr_id
		IF @attr_value = '0'
		BEGIN
		 SET @result = 1
		END
		--SET @result = 1
	END

	IF @interface = 'SUBLOT'
	BEGIN
		IF (
				SELECT count(ea.attr_value)
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'InterfaceWithAUT'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND ea.ent_id = (
						SELECT run_ent_id
						FROM job
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
						)
				) = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (
				SELECT ea.attr_value
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'InterfaceWithAUT'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND e.ent_id = (
						SELECT run_ent_id
						FROM job
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
						)
				) > 0
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (
				SELECT ea.attr_value
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				WHERE a.attr_desc = 'InterfaceWithAUT'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND e.ent_id = (
						SELECT run_ent_id
						FROM job
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND oper_id = @oper_id
						)
				) = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @result = 0
		END
	END

	SELECT @result AS result
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Category_Link]
  (@category_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
   @item_id nvarchar(40) = NULL,
   @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) = NULL,
   @last_edit_at datetime = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Category_Link
-- Description          - Retrieves the specified records from the Item_Category_Link table
-- Author               - Pradeep Shenoy
-- Date Created         - 04/20/2012
-- Version              - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 04/20/2012     Pradeep S        Retrieves the specified records from the Item_Category_Link table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  DECLARE
@disp_order       NVARCHAR(10)
BEGIN
SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
IF (@disp_order IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@disp_order) = 0) SET @disp_order = '0'

SELECT category.category_name
      ,item_category_link.category_id
      ,CASE
             WHEN @disp_order = '0' THEN item.item_id
             WHEN @disp_order = '1' THEN item.item_desc
             WHEN @disp_order = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
             WHEN @disp_order = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
            END AS item_display
      , item_category_link.item_id
      ,item_category_link.last_edit_comment
      ,item_category_link.last_edit_by
      ,item_category_link.last_edit_at
      ,item_category_link.row_id
FROM item_category_link WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN category WITH(NOLOCK) ON category.category_id = item_category_link.category_id
INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = item_category_link.item_id

WHERE (
        (item_category_link.category_id = @category_id OR @category_id IS NULL) AND
        (item_category_link.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
        (item_category_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
        (item_category_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
    ORDER BY item_category_link.category_id;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_job_exec_VerifyProcess]
@process_id      STRING40,
@parent_item_id  NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@wo_id           STRING40 = NULL
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_S_JOB_EXEC_VERIFYPROCESS
-- Description	      - This module verifies that the process is legitimate
-- Author	      - Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created	      - 03/18/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.21
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver		Changes
-- 03/16/2002     Sheetal Jain  1001	Verification process from the modified spec
-- 05/14/2002     Sheetal Jain  1002	Input percent changes (adds upto 1 now)
-- 05/22/2002     Sheetal Jain  1003	Validation added for checking duplicate specs(item and ent) in and operation
-- 06/12/2002     Sheetal Jain  1004	Item status should be Approved/Certified only
-- 08/21/2002     Sheetal Jain  1300	Routes checked for every entity(
-- 08/29/2002     Sheetal Jain  1302	Item process link verification for particular item only(#487)
-- 09/09/2002     Sheetal Jain  1303	Check bom items and their item classes for obsolete
-- 09/23/2002     Sheetal Jain  1400	BOM tree check for items attached to same process(#1505, #991)
-- 12/12/2002     Sheetal Jain  1500	First operation entities - init_prod_pct
-- 12/16/2002     KRF	        1500	Verify that operations being fed from more than one other operation have links to all the
--										same downstream entities and that the total input_percents to each downstream entity from
--										a given operation is either 0 for each upsteam operation or nonzero for each upstream operation.
--										Also corrected check that init_prod_pct sums to 1 and not 100 (#2036)
-- 12/31/2002     Sheetal Jain  1501	First and Final Oper flags not updated for a Certified process
-- 01/09/2003	  Rohit			1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 10/03/2003     Sheetal Jain  1626	Attribute 201 changed from value+1 to value (#3757)
-- 07/15/2004     Sheetal Jain  2038	Add BOM quantity allocation check to VerifyProcess (#4729)
-- 03/24/2005     SJ            2117	Exit condition for #tmp_bom_item0 changed
-- 04/25/2005     SJ            2120	HD#5424 - SCC Work Order (With Proccess)
-- 05/18/2005     SJ            2121	HD#5556 - CWOFP - no BOM defined
--10/20/2005	Raghu			3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 01/28/2008   LoriN			4.0.0	CR 75324 - Verify Process successfull even when initial prod pct nOt 100%
--09/21/2011	Praveen P		4.0.SP1 CRL00115839 and CRL00115914
--01/21/2013	Saiteja.K		4.6     Added Changes for CR L00114821.
-- 02/11/2013	Ravi Teja		4.6		CR L00124788 - Type casted the float values to decimal values to avoid rounding error while
--										calculating sum of input_percent values
-- 02/09/2015   Varun			5.2		CR L00137959 Merge changes (HF CR #L00137705) :: Merged fix for HF CR 119111 and
--										added bom_ver to the where clause for finding obsolete item and item classes
-- 10/28/2015   Tentu			5.2		CR L00139311 to merge HF CR L00138787 - The verify process take long time. Optimized the code which verifies all specifications associated with an operation
-- 08/18/2017	Varun			6.0		CR L00146060 Merge changes (HF CR #L00145747) : Introduced the CAST (to Decimal) in couple of WHERE clauses to address the issues of the
--										operations having more BOM being consumed at the operation than available in the BOM.
-- 10/10/2018	Raghu			6.1	UserStory: 1090763- MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00150360 (HF CR L00149390: SR 48912162: Verify process fails due to a defect in SP "SP_S_JOB_EXEC_VERIFYPROCESS".)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @count		INT32,
  @first_oper_id	NVARCHAR(40),
  @final_oper_id	NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Check		INTEGER,
  @V_Bom_Ver	        STRING40,
  @V_Item_Id		NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Item_Class_Id		NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Error		VARCHAR(2000),
  @V_Count		INT,
  @V_Sub_Item	        NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Sub_Ver		STRING40,
  @V_Sub_Bom_Pos	INT,
  @V_Sub_Oper	        STRING40,
  @V_Item0		NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Id0		NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Ver0		NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Oper_Id		NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Input_Oper_Id	NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Ent_Id		INT32,
  @V_Spec_Id    NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_last_ent_id	INT32,
  @V_Input_Percent	FLOAT,
  @alternative		BIT,
  @opercount		INT32,
  @V_Certified          CHAR(1),
  @verID           NVARCHAR(40),
  @dbg_resp			INT32,
  @isReworkProcess integer
BEGIN
  --First check the number of Operations for the given process

  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_S_job_exec_VerifyProcess', @src_key='on_entry'
	IF(@dbg_resp = 1)
	RETURN

  SET @count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id)
  IF @count = 0
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Process is not defined{3353}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    --Check if every operation has an entity defined for it
    SET @V_Check = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id NOT IN
                      (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id))
    IF @V_Check > 0
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('Not all operations have entities defined{3354}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END
  END

 --Check if the process has the specified item attached (only for CWFP)
  select @isReworkProcess = rework from process where process_id = @process_id;
  IF ((@isReworkProcess = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_process_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id = @parent_item_id)) OR (@isReworkProcess = 0))
  BEGIN
        IF (@parent_item_id IS NOT NULL AND @parent_item_id <> '')  -- ORIGNAL IF CONDITION
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_process_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id = @parent_item_id)
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Specified item is not attached to this process.{4631}', 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
        END
  END


  --Check if the process is a certified process
  SET @V_Certified = 'N'
  SELECT @V_Certified = 'Y' FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id AND process_status = 3

  IF @count = 1  --since there is only one operation defined for the given process, so oper_ent_route table will not have any corresponding rows
  BEGIN
    --set both the flags(first_oper,final_oper) if its not a certified process
    IF @V_Certified <> 'Y' and @first_oper_id = NULL and  @final_oper_id =NULL
      UPDATE oper SET first_oper = 1, final_oper = 1 WHERE process_id = @process_id
  END
  ELSE
  --@count > 1
  BEGIN
    --Determine the final operation
    SET @V_Check = 0
    DECLARE cur_last_op CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT DISTINCT oper_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id
      AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT input_oper_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id)
    OPEN cur_last_op
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_last_op INTO @final_oper_id
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Check = @V_Check + 1
      FETCH NEXT FROM cur_last_op INTO @final_oper_id
    END
    CLOSE cur_last_op
    DEALLOCATE cur_last_op
    --Check for looping and for more than one final operations
    IF @V_Check > 1
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('There are more than one last operation{3355}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END
    ELSE IF @V_Check = 0
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('There is no last operation, process has an idefinite loop{3356}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      --Update the final op flag and reset for other ops if its not a certified process
      IF @V_Certified <> 'Y' and @first_oper_id = NULL and  @final_oper_id =NULL
      BEGIN
        UPDATE oper SET final_oper = 1 WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @final_oper_id
        UPDATE oper SET final_oper = 0 WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id <> @final_oper_id
      END
    END
    --Determine the first operation, reset the first op flags first if its not a certified process
    IF @V_Certified <> 'Y' and @first_oper_id = NULL and  @final_oper_id =NULL
      UPDATE oper SET first_oper = 0 WHERE process_id = @process_id
    SET @V_Check = 0
    DECLARE cur_first_op CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT DISTINCT input_oper_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id
      AND input_oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id)
    OPEN cur_first_op
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_first_op INTO @first_oper_id
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Check = @V_Check + 1
      IF @V_Certified <> 'Y' and @first_oper_id = NULL and  @final_oper_id =NULL
        UPDATE oper SET first_oper = 1 WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @first_oper_id
      FETCH NEXT FROM cur_first_op INTO @first_oper_id
    END
    CLOSE cur_first_op
    DEALLOCATE cur_first_op
    IF @V_Check = 0
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('There is no first operation, process has an idefinite loop{3357}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END

    --Check if routes are defined for the process
    --Check the non-first and non-last operations first for routes
    SELECT @V_Check = COUNT(*) FROM oper a, oper_ent_link b WHERE a.process_id = @process_id
      AND first_oper = 0 AND final_oper = 0 AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
      AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) NOT IN
        (SELECT oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) IN
             (SELECT oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id)
           AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) IN
             (SELECT input_oper_id+' '+CAST(input_ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id))
    --Check the first operation for routes
    SELECT @V_Check = @V_Check + COUNT(*) FROM oper a, oper_ent_link b WHERE a.process_id = @process_id
      AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.first_oper=1 AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) NOT IN
        (SELECT oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id
           AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) NOT IN
             (SELECT oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id)
           AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) IN
             (SELECT input_oper_id+' '+CAST(input_ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id))
    --Check the last operation for routes
    SELECT @V_Check = @V_Check + COUNT(*) FROM oper a, oper_ent_link b WHERE a.process_id = @process_id
      AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.final_oper=1 AND b.oper_id+' '+CAST(b.ent_id AS CHAR) NOT IN
        (SELECT oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) IN
             (SELECT oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id)
           AND oper_id+' '+CAST(ent_id AS CHAR) NOT IN
             (SELECT input_oper_id+' '+CAST(input_ent_id AS CHAR) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id))
    IF @V_Check > 0
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('Not all routes exist for the process{3358}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END

  END  --  End of @count > 1
  --Column to be added to OPER_ENT_LINK - INIT_PROD_PCT (Values sum to 1)
  --Check if init_prod_pct in first ops having more than one entities output 100%
  SET @first_oper_id = NULL
  SELECT TOP 1 @first_oper_id=a.oper_id FROM oper_ent_link a, oper b WHERE a.process_id = b.process_id
    AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.process_id = @process_id AND b.first_oper = 1
      GROUP BY a.process_id, a.oper_id HAVING (COUNT(*) > 1 AND SUM(CAST(ISNULL(init_prod_pct, 0) as numeric(8,7))) <> 1.00)  -- 1 was 100 KRF 12/16/02
                   OR ((COUNT(*) = 1) AND (SUM(ISNULL(init_prod_pct,1.00)) <> 1.00))
  IF @first_oper_id IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
--    SET @V_Error = 'The first operation#' + @first_oper_id + ' has more/less than 100 percent of the workorder quantity defined in its entities.'
--    SET @V_Error = N'The initial production percentage for all entities in the first operation# ' + @first_oper_id + N' must add up to 100 percent.'	--VRB 12/31/2002
    SET @V_Error = N'The initial production percentage for all entities in the first operation# %1 must add up to 100 percent.{4724},' + @first_oper_id	--VRB 12/31/2002
    RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  --Check if for all the input ops the input percent sums upto 1
  DECLARE cur_input_perc CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT input_oper_id, input_ent_id, SUM(input_percent) FROM oper_ent_route
    WHERE process_id = @process_id GROUP BY input_oper_id, input_ent_id HAVING CAST(SUM(input_percent) AS DECIMAL(10,7)) < 1
  OPEN cur_input_perc
  FETCH NEXT FROM cur_input_perc INTO @first_oper_id, @final_oper_id, @V_Check
  IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Some of the entities in the process do not output 100 percent{3359}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END
  CLOSE cur_input_perc
  DEALLOCATE cur_input_perc
  --	Find ver_id from BOM_VER table using parent_item_id and perfered_ver = 1
  IF @parent_item_id IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
    SELECT @V_Bom_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
    --bom oper link should be present as bom version exists
    IF @V_Bom_Ver IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
/*      --Check if bom oper link has been populated for all operations
      DECLARE cur_bom_link CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id NOT IN
        (SELECT oper_id FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver)
      OPEN cur_bom_link
      FETCH cur_bom_link INTO @first_oper_id
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Some of the operations in the process do not have BOM details defined{3360}', 16, 1)
        RETURN -1
      END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS
      CLOSE cur_bom_link
      DEALLOCATE cur_bom_link
*/
      --Check if the BOM qty consumed at the operation is available in the BOM
      IF EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link biol
        INNER JOIN bom_item bi ON biol.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND biol.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
          WHERE biol.process_id = @process_id AND biol.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver AND biol.bom_pos <> 0
          GROUP BY biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id, biol.bom_pos
            HAVING CAST(MAX(bi.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)) < CAST(SUM(biol.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)))
      BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Some of the operations have more BOM being consumed at the operation than available in the BOM.{4373}', 16, 1)
        RETURN -1
      END

      --Check if the BOM consumed in steps is more than consumed at the operation for this process and for this item
      IF EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link biol
        INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_step_link biosl ON biol.parent_item_id = biosl.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = biosl.ver_id
          AND biol.bom_pos = biosl.bom_pos AND biol.process_id = biosl.process_id AND biol.oper_id = biosl.oper_id
        WHERE biol.process_id = @process_id AND biol.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver
          GROUP BY biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id, biol.process_id, biol.bom_pos, biol.oper_id
            HAVING CAST(SUM(biol.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)) < CAST(SUM(biosl.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)))
      BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Some of the operations have more BOM being consumed at the steps than available at the operation.{4374}', 16, 1)
        RETURN -1
      END

      --Check if for every operation for every parent_item_id there is Bom_Pos=0
      DECLARE cur_bom_link_pos CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id
        AND parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT oper_id FROM bom_item_oper_link
          WHERE process_id = @process_id AND parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver AND bom_pos = 0)
      OPEN cur_bom_link_pos
      FETCH cur_bom_link_pos INTO @first_oper_id
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Some of the operations do not produce any items (BOM position zero missing){3361}', 16, 1)
        RETURN -1
      END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS
      CLOSE cur_bom_link_pos
      DEALLOCATE cur_bom_link_pos
      --Check if one operation produces the item
--      SELECT @V_Check = COUNT(*) FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
--        AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver AND bom_pos = 0
--      IF @V_Check > 1
--      BEGIN
--        RAISERROR('More than one operation produces the parent item', 16, 1)
--        RETURN -1
--      END  --End of @V_Check > 1
    END  --End of @V_Bom_Ver IS NOT NULL
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
      --Check if the BOM qty consumed at the operation is available in the BOM
      IF EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link biol
        INNER JOIN bom_item bi ON biol.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND biol.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
          WHERE biol.process_id = @process_id AND biol.bom_pos <> 0
          GROUP BY biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id, biol.bom_pos
            HAVING CAST(MAX(bi.qty_per_parent_item)AS DECIMAL(30,7)) < CAST(SUM(biol.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)))
      BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Some of the operations have more BOM being consumed at the operation than available in the BOM.{4373}', 16, 1)
        RETURN -1
      END

      --Check if the BOM consumed in steps is more than consumed at the operation for this process and for this item
      IF EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM bom_item_oper_link biol
        INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_step_link biosl ON biol.parent_item_id = biosl.parent_item_id AND biol.ver_id = biosl.ver_id
          AND biol.bom_pos = biosl.bom_pos AND biol.process_id = biosl.process_id AND biol.oper_id = biosl.oper_id
        WHERE biol.process_id = @process_id
          GROUP BY biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id, biol.process_id, biol.bom_pos, biol.oper_id
            HAVING CAST(SUM(biol.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)) < CAST(SUM(biosl.qty_per_parent_item) AS DECIMAL(30,7)))
      BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Some of the operations have more BOM being consumed at the steps than available at the operation.{4374}', 16, 1)
        RETURN -1
      END
  END  --End of @parent_item_id IS NOT NULL
  --Check if each and every item in the process has a preferred bom version
  DECLARE cur_all_items CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT DISTINCT parent_item_id FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE process_id = @process_id
  OPEN cur_all_items
  FETCH cur_all_items INTO @V_Item_Id
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    SELECT @V_Bom_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item_Id AND preferred_ver = 1
    --bom oper link should be present as bom version exists
    IF @V_Bom_Ver IS NULL
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR('Not all parent items have preferred BOM versions{3362}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END  --End of @V_Bom_Ver IS NULL
    --Check if there are duplicate specification (item spec, entity spec)
    DECLARE cur_item_ent_spec CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT a.oper_id, a.ver_id, a.spec_id FROM oper_ent_spec a, bom_item_oper_spec b
      WHERE a.process_id = @process_id AND b.process_id = @process_id AND b.ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
        AND a.ver_id = b.spec_ver_id AND a.spec_id = b.spec_id UNION SELECT a.oper_id, a.ver_id, a.spec_id FROM oper_ent_spec a,
        oper_item_spec c WHERE a.process_id = @process_id AND c.process_id = @process_id AND a.oper_id = c.oper_id AND
        a.ver_id = c.ver_id AND a.spec_id = c.spec_id ORDER BY oper_id
    OPEN cur_item_ent_spec
    FETCH cur_item_ent_spec INTO @first_oper_id, @V_Bom_Ver, @V_Item_Id
    IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
--      SET @V_Error = N'Operation#' + @first_oper_id + N' Specification Version#' + @V_Bom_Ver + N' Specification ID#' + @V_Item_Id +
--                     N' is existing in both operation entity specification and item specification.'
      SET @V_Error = N'Operation# %1, Specification Version# %2,  Specification ID# %3 is existing in the both operation entity specification and item specification.{4725},' + @first_oper_id + ',' + @V_Bom_Ver + ',' + @V_Item_Id
      RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS
    CLOSE cur_item_ent_spec
    DEALLOCATE cur_item_ent_spec
    FETCH cur_all_items INTO @V_Item_Id
  END
  CLOSE cur_all_items
  DEALLOCATE cur_all_items
  --Check if there are multiple operation entity specifications
  -- CR L00138787  modification
  DECLARE cur_ent_spec CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT DISTINCT oper_id, ent_id, ver_id from oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE process_id = @process_id ORDER BY oper_id
  OPEN cur_ent_spec
  FETCH cur_ent_spec INTO @first_oper_id, @V_Ent_Id, @verID
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    EXEC @V_Spec_Id = fn_s_oper_ent_spec_verifyspecs @first_oper_id, @V_Ent_Id, @verID, @process_id
 	IF @V_Spec_Id IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Error = N'Operation# %1, Specification Version# %2,  Specification ID# %3 is existing in multiple operation entity specifications.{6265},' + @first_oper_id + ',' + @verID + ',' + @V_Spec_Id
      RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
    END  --End VerifySpecs
    FETCH cur_ent_spec INTO @first_oper_id, @V_Ent_Id, @verID
  END
  --Check if the work order to be created already exists
  SELECT @V_Bom_Ver = wo_id FROM wo WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Work Order already exists{3363}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END --End of @@ROWCOUNT = 0
  --Check if each of the items being produced have a status of approved/certified
  DECLARE cur_item_status CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT item_id FROM item_process_link WHERE process_id = @process_id
    AND item_id = @parent_item_id AND status < (SELECT attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 201)
  OPEN cur_item_status
  FETCH cur_item_status INTO @V_Item_Id
  IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
--    SET @V_Error = N'The status of this process is lower for Item#' + @V_Item_Id + N' than that required to create a work order from it.'
    SET @V_Error = N'The status of this process is lower for Item# %1 than that required to create a work order from it.{4726},' + @V_Item_Id
    RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END
  CLOSE cur_item_status
  DEALLOCATE cur_item_status

  --Check if the item and BOM have no obsolete items or item classes
  --Create temporary table to hold bom item data for comparison
  CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), bom_pos INT, oper_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
  CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
  SELECT @V_Bom_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
  INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, status) VALUES(@parent_item_id, @parent_item_id, @V_Bom_Ver, 0)
  DECLARE cur_item0 CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id, item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0
  OPEN cur_item0
  FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    UPDATE #tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item0 AND item_id = @V_Id0
    INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, status)
      SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.item_id, b.ver_id, 0 FROM bom_item a, bom_ver b WHERE a.item_id = b.parent_item_id
        AND a.parent_item_id = @V_Id0 AND b.preferred_ver = 1 AND item_id <> @V_Id0
    FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
  END
  CLOSE cur_item0
  DEALLOCATE cur_item0
  DECLARE cur_oper CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id
  OPEN cur_oper
  FETCH cur_oper INTO @first_oper_id
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    SET @V_Count = 0
    INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
      VALUES(@parent_item_id, @parent_item_id, @V_Bom_Ver, 0, @first_oper_id, 0)
    WHILE @V_Count = 0
    BEGIN
      --Recursively get into item-subitems
      --Handle items without BOM
      DECLARE cur_sub_item CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id FROM #tmp_bom_item
        WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND status = 0 AND ver_id IS NOT NULL
      OPEN cur_sub_item
      FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        UPDATE #tmp_bom_item SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND ver_id = @V_Sub_Ver
          AND bom_pos = @V_Sub_Bom_Pos AND oper_id = @V_Sub_Oper
        SET @V_Count = 1
        IF @V_Sub_Item = @parent_item_id
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
            SELECT @parent_item_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @first_oper_id, 0 FROM bom_item a, bom_item_oper_link b
              WHERE a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos AND b.oper_id = @first_oper_id
                AND b.process_id = @process_id AND a.parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0) AND a.item_id <> @parent_item_id
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
            SELECT @parent_item_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @first_oper_id, 0 FROM bom_item a, bom_item_oper_link b
              WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
                AND b.oper_id = @first_oper_id AND a.parent_item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND a.item_id <> @V_Sub_Item
        END
        FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
      END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS
      CLOSE cur_sub_item
      DEALLOCATE cur_sub_item
      IF @V_Count = 1
        SET @V_Count = 0
      ELSE
        SET @V_Count = 1
    END  --End of @v_Count = 0
    FETCH cur_oper INTO @first_oper_id
  END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  CLOSE cur_oper
  DEALLOCATE cur_oper
  SET @V_Item_Id = NULL
  --Check each of the items and their item classes to verify that they are not "obsolete"
  SELECT TOP 1 @V_Item_Id=a.parent_item_id, @V_Sub_Item=a.item_id, @V_Sub_Ver=a.ver_id, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos=a.bom_pos, @V_Sub_Oper=a.oper_id, @V_Item_Class_Id = c.item_class_id
    FROM #tmp_bom_item a, item b, item_class c WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND b.item_class_id = c.item_class_id
      AND (b.obsolete = 1 OR c.obsolete = 1)
      AND (a.ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver) -- Added for CR L00137959 Merge changes (HF CR #L00137705)
  IF @V_Item_Id IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
--    SET @V_Error = N'In operation#' + @V_Sub_Oper + N' the parent item#' + @V_Item_Id + N' with the BOM revision#' + @V_Sub_Ver +
--                   N' has the item#' + @V_Sub_Item + N' belonging to item class#' + @final_oper_id +
--                   N' at the BOM position#' + CAST(@V_Sub_Bom_Pos AS NVARCHAR)+ N' which is an obsolete item or belongs to an obsolete item class.'
    SET @V_Error = N'In operation# %1 the parent item# %2 with the BOM revision# %3 has the item# %4 belonging to item class# %5 at the BOM position# %6 which is an obsolete item or belongs to an obsolete item class.{4727},' + @V_Sub_Oper + ',' + @V_Item_Id + ',' + @V_Sub_Ver + ',' + @V_Sub_Item + ',' + @V_Item_Class_Id + ',' +  CAST(@V_Sub_Bom_Pos AS NVARCHAR)
    RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  --Check if parent and item are both attached to the same process
  SET @V_Item_Id = NULL
  SELECT TOP 1 @V_Item_Id = item_id FROM item_process_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id IN
    (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE bom_pos = 0 AND item_id <> @parent_item_id)
  IF @V_Item_Id IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
--    SET @V_Error = N'Item#' + @V_Item_Id + N' in the BOM tree is also attached to the same process. Attaching items to the same process '+
--                   N' in the BOM tree of the final item being produced is not allowed.'
    SET @V_Error = N'Item# %1 in the BOM tree is also attached to the same process. Attaching items to the same process in the BOM tree of the final item being produced is not allowed.{4728},' + @V_Item_Id
    RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END   --End of @V_Count > 1
  --drop the temporary tables
  DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item
  DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0
  -- For operations being fed from more than one other operation ...
  DECLARE opercur CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id
  OPEN opercur
  FETCH opercur INTO @V_Oper_Id
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN  -- fetching (downstream) operations
    SET @count = (SELECT count (DISTINCT input_oper_id) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND process_id = @process_id)
    IF @count>1  -- If more than one input operation
    BEGIN
      -- Verify that each upstream operation has links to same downstream entities
      -- Find the operation that links to the most downstream entities (all should have the same # of links anyway)
      DECLARE entcur CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT TOP 1 input_oper_id, count(ent_id) as num FROM oper_ent_route
        WHERE oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND process_id = @process_id
        GROUP BY input_oper_id ORDER BY num desc
      OPEN entcur
      FETCH entcur INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @opercount
      CLOSE entcur
      DEALLOCATE entcur
      -- Use that operation's list to check every other operation
      DECLARE entcur CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT DISTINCT ent_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE input_oper_id = @V_Input_Oper_Id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND process_id = @process_id
      OPEN entcur
      FETCH entcur INTO @V_Ent_Id
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        -- Find the number of upstream operations linking to that entity
        SET @opercount = (SELECT count (DISTINCT input_oper_id) FROM oper_ent_route WHERE ent_id = @V_Ent_Id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND process_id = @process_id)
        IF @opercount < @count  -- If not all linked to it, that's wrong
        BEGIN
--          SET @V_Error = N'Entity ' + CAST(@V_Ent_Id AS NVARCHAR) + N' in operation ' + @V_Oper_Id + N' is not linked to all input operations.'
          SET @V_Error = N'Entity %1 in operation is not linked to all input operations.{4729},' + CAST(@V_Ent_Id AS NVARCHAR) + ',' + @V_Oper_Id
          RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
          RETURN -1
        END
        FETCH entcur INTO @V_Ent_Id
      END
      CLOSE entcur
      DEALLOCATE entcur
      -- Also verify that the total input_percents to each downstream entity from a given operation is either 0 for each upsteam operation
      -- or nonzero for each upstream operation.
      -- Get the total input_percent from each upstream operation to each downstream entity, ordered by entity.
      -- Order of operations doesn't matter since all must be the same.
      DECLARE routecur CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT input_oper_id, ent_id, SUM(input_percent) FROM oper_ent_route
        WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id GROUP BY ent_id, input_oper_id ORDER BY ent_id
      OPEN routecur
      FETCH routecur INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Ent_Id, @V_Input_Percent
      SET @V_last_ent_id = -1
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        IF @V_Ent_Id = @V_last_ent_id -- If still on the same entity as before, this is a new operation feeding it
        BEGIN
          IF (@alternative = 1 AND @V_Input_Percent > 0) OR (@alternative = 0 AND @V_Input_Percent = 0)  -- If both operations not 0, or both not nonzero
          BEGIN
--            SET @V_Error = N'Entity ' + CAST(@V_Ent_Id AS NVARCHAR) + N' in operation ' + @V_Oper_Id + N' is viewed as an alternative to one input operation and not another.'
            SET @V_Error = N'Entity %1 in operation %2 is viewed as an alternative to one input operation and not another.{4730},' + CAST(@V_Ent_Id AS NVARCHAR) + ',' + @V_Oper_Id
            RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
            RETURN -1
          END
        END
        ELSE -- Encountered a new entity, so reset @alternative flag
        BEGIN
          SET @V_last_ent_id = @V_Ent_Id
          IF @V_Input_Percent = 0 SET @alternative = 1
          ELSE SET @alternative = 0
        END
        FETCH routecur INTO @V_Input_Oper_Id, @V_Ent_Id, @V_Input_Percent
      END
      CLOSE routecur
      DEALLOCATE routecur
    END  -- of "If more than one input operation"
    FETCH opercur INTO @V_Oper_Id
  END  -- of fetching (downstream) operations
  CLOSE opercur
  DEALLOCATE opercur
SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cert_Std_Oper_Link]
(
	@cert_name			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@cert_level			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Cert_Std_Oper_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 11/07/2005		Raghu			3.1.1		Included oper_desc, max_level, cert_audit column in the resultset.
-- 07/03/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	cert_std_oper_link.cert_name
		,	cert_std_oper_link.oper_id
		,	cert_std_oper_link.cert_level
		,	cert_std_oper_link.last_edit_comment
		,	cert_std_oper_link.last_edit_by
		,	cert_std_oper_link.last_edit_at
		,	cert_type.max_level
		,	cert_type.cert_audit
		,	std_oper.oper_desc
    FROM cert_std_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN cert_type WITH (NOLOCK) ON cert_type.cert_name = cert_std_oper_link.cert_name
		INNER JOIN std_oper WITH (NOLOCK) ON std_oper.oper_id = cert_std_oper_link.oper_id
    WHERE (
			(cert_std_oper_link.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL) AND
			(cert_std_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			(cert_std_oper_link.cert_level = @cert_level OR @cert_level IS NULL) AND
			(cert_std_oper_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(cert_std_oper_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
END
