@process_id              NVARCHAR(40),
@wo_id                   NVARCHAR(40),
@parent_item_id          STRING40,
@BV_ver_id               STRING40,
@BOM_pos                 INT,
@BIOL_oper_id            STRING40,
@J_seq_no                INT,
@BIOL_BOM_pos            INT,
@float_start_val         FLOAT,
@float_start_Val_is_pct  LOGICAL,
@BI_item_id              STRING40 OUTPUT,
@BI_qty_per_parent_item  FLOAT OUTPUT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	SP_BI_TO_JOB_BOM
-- Description	      -	Used to create a job BOM record with bom_pos = 0
-- Author             -
-- Date Created	      -	03/18/2002
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 04/19/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.0.0.1	Changes as per modified spec
-- 06/12/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.0.0.2	New bom flags brought over to job, reqd_start_pct, must_consume_from_inv,
--					may_choose_alt_inv_loc and may_create_new_lots
-- 06/21/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.0.0.3	Job_bom default storage fields from the job_exec defaults if not defined in the Bom_item.
-- 09/04/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.4.0.0	Def_Cont_Id removed (Ref#886)
-- 09/30/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.4.0.1	New fields - max and min qty_per_parent_item, must_consume - wip, before_prod
-- 11/19/2002	TC		1.5.0.0	When reading default values from job_exec use job_pos = 0 as job_pos is now part of PK
-- 12/18/2002	Sheetal Jain	1.5.0.1	New field "constant_qty" added
-- 01/27/2003	Vijay Raj	1.5.0.2	Changed 'na' to '-'
-- 05/15/2003	Sheetal Jain	1.6.0.0	Max and Min qty of job bom is proportional to Max and Min qty of bom item
-- 06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 12/16/2004	Sheetal Jain	2.1.0.9	HD#5193 CWOFP enters a ''-'' if the bom_item def_lot_no is NULL
-- 04/18/2005	SJ		2.1.0.18	HD#5560 - Default job_exec lot number and CWOFP
--					HD#5565 - Create Work Order from Process Default Storage Location
-- 09/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 12/14/2005	SJ		3.1.0.5	HD#6981 - Problm with CWFP
-- 12/29/2006	KRF		3.2.1	Include est_time, def_sublot_no (HD #8314) and serial_no_source (HD #9232)
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
--10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 12/11/2007	AML		3.4.2		Added @BI_def_sublot_no to BOM_item_cursor fetch.
-- 04/11/2016   Surya           3.5     Updated the logic to check job_exec records for the particular target_sched_ent_id
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- fields from BOM_item
DECLARE
  @BI_parent_item_id     STRING40,
  @BI_ver_id             STRING40,
  @BI_BOM_pos            INT,
--DECLARE @BI_item_id STRING40,
  @BI_reqd_grade_cd      INT,
  @BI_instruction        VARCHAR(2000),
--  @BI_qty_per_parent_item float,
  @BI_update_inv         LOGICAL,
  @BI_backflush          LOGICAL,
  @BI_def_reas_cd        INT,
  @BI_def_lot_no         STRING40,
  @BI_def_storage_ent_id INT,
  @BI_def_reject_ent_id  INT,
  @BI_scaling_factor     FLOAT,
  @BI_spare1             STRING80,
  @BI_spare2             STRING80,
  @BI_spare3             STRING80,
  @BI_spare4             STRING80,
  @BI_mod_id             TIMESTAMP,
  @J_target_sched_ent_id INT,
  @JE_def_to_ent_id      INT,
  @JE_def_prod_reas_cd   INT,
  @JE_def_lot_no         STRING40,
  @update_inv            LOGICAL,
  @JB_row_count          INT,
  @DEBUG_STR             NVARCHAR(2000),
  @V_float_start_val     FLOAT,
  @V_From_Inv            LOGICAL,
  @V_Alt_Inv_Loc         LOGICAL,
  @V_New_Lots            LOGICAL,
  @V_Min_Qty             FLOAT,
  @V_Max_Qty             FLOAT,
  @V_Consume_WIP         LOGICAL,
  @V_Consume_Prod        LOGICAL,
  @V_Constant_Qty        LOGICAL,
  @JE_def_sublot_no      STRING40, -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
  @BI_est_time           TFLOAT,   -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
  @BI_def_sublot_no      STRING40, -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
  @BI_serial_no_source   LOGICAL   -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	STRING40
	    ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
BEGIN
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  SELECT @JB_row_count = COUNT(*) FROM job_bom WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id
    AND seq_no = @J_seq_no AND BOM_pos = @BIOL_BOM_pos
  IF @JB_row_count = 0 -- If the row we're about to create doesn't already exist
  BEGIN
    IF @BV_ver_id IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      -- read values from BOM_ITEM table
      DECLARE BOM_item_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT i.parent_item_id, i.ver_id, i.BOM_pos, i.item_id, i.reqd_grade_cd, i.instruction,
          l.qty_per_parent_item, i.update_inv, i.backflush, i.def_reas_cd, i.def_lot_no, i.def_sublot_no, i.def_storage_ent_id, i.def_reject_ent_id,
          i.scaling_factor, i.spare1, i.spare2, i.spare3, i.spare4, i.mod_id, l.reqd_start_pct, i.must_consume_from_inv,
          i.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, i.may_create_new_lots,
          i.max_qty_per_Parent_item/i.qty_per_parent_item*l.qty_per_parent_item, i.min_qty_per_parent_item/i.qty_per_parent_item*l.qty_per_parent_item,
          i.must_consume_from_wip, i.must_consume_before_prod, i.constant_qty, i.est_time, i.serial_no_source
        FROM BOM_item AS i
          INNER JOIN BOM_item_oper_link AS l ON i.parent_item_id = l.parent_item_id AND i.ver_id = l.ver_id AND i.bom_pos = l.bom_pos
            WHERE i.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND i.ver_id = @BV_ver_id AND i.BOM_pos = @BOM_pos
              AND l.process_id = @process_id AND l.oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id
      OPEN BOM_item_cursor
      FETCH NEXT FROM BOM_item_cursor INTO @BI_parent_item_id, @BI_ver_id, @BI_BOM_pos, @BI_item_id, @BI_reqd_grade_cd, @BI_instruction,
        @BI_qty_per_parent_item, @BI_update_inv, @BI_backflush, @BI_def_reas_cd, @BI_def_lot_no, @BI_def_sublot_no, @BI_def_storage_ent_id, @BI_def_reject_ent_id,
        @BI_scaling_factor, @BI_spare1, @BI_spare2, @BI_spare3, @BI_spare4, @BI_mod_id, @V_float_start_val, @V_From_Inv,
        @V_Alt_Inv_Loc, @V_New_Lots, @V_Max_Qty, @V_Min_Qty, @V_Consume_WIP, @V_Consume_Prod, @V_Constant_Qty, @BI_est_time, @BI_serial_no_source
      IF @BI_parent_item_id IS NOT NULL
      BEGIN
        -- Ensure def_lot_no is not null in job_bom for BOM pos 0
        IF @BI_def_lot_no IS NULL AND @BI_BOM_pos = 0
        BEGIN
          SELECT @BI_def_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = (SELECT init_sched_ent_id FROM job
              WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no)
        END
        --For produced items use job_exec.def_to_ent_id and for consumed items use job_exec.def_from_ent_id
        IF @BI_def_storage_ent_id IS NULL
        BEGIN
          -- For produced items use job_exec.def_to_ent_id
          IF @BI_BOM_pos <= 0
          BEGIN
            SELECT @BI_def_storage_ent_id = def_to_ent_id FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = (SELECT init_sched_ent_id FROM job
              WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no)
          END
          ELSE  -- for consumed items use job_exec.def_from_ent_id
          BEGIN
            SELECT @BI_def_storage_ent_id = def_from_ent_id FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = (SELECT init_sched_ent_id FROM job
              WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no)
          END
        END

        INSERT INTO job_BOM(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, BOM_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val,
                            reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
		  	     scaling_factor, est_time, serial_no_source, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots,
                            max_qty_per_Parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
          VALUES(@wo_id, @BIOL_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @BIOL_BOM_pos, @BI_item_id, @BI_reqd_grade_cd, @BI_instruction, @BI_qty_per_parent_item, @V_float_start_val,
	         @float_start_Val_is_pct, @BI_update_inv, @BI_backflush, @BI_def_reas_cd, @BI_def_lot_no, @BI_def_sublot_no, @BI_def_storage_ent_id, @BI_def_reject_ent_id,
                 @BI_scaling_factor, @BI_est_time, @BI_serial_no_source, @BI_spare1, @BI_spare2, @BI_spare3, @BI_spare4, @V_From_Inv, @V_Alt_Inv_Loc, @V_New_Lots,
                 @V_Max_Qty, @V_Min_Qty, @V_Consume_WIP, @V_Consume_Prod, @V_Constant_Qty, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
      END
      CLOSE BOM_item_cursor
      DEALLOCATE BOM_item_cursor
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN	--when @BV_ver_id is NULL
      --10 Create a JOB_BOM record with bom_pos = 0
      --Get the target sched entity identity
      SELECT @J_target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no
      --decide update_inv value
      SET @update_inv = 1
      --Assign the values when no preferred bom version exists
      IF @BIOL_BOM_pos = 0
      BEGIN
        SET @float_start_Val_is_pct = 1
        SET @float_start_val = 1
        SET @update_inv = 0
        SET @BI_backflush = 0
        IF @J_target_sched_ent_id IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          --Check if record exists in job exec for target sched ent id
        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @J_target_sched_ent_id)
          BEGIN
            SELECT @JE_def_prod_reas_cd = def_prod_reas_cd, @JE_def_lot_no = def_lot_no, @JE_def_sublot_no = def_sublot_no, @BI_def_storage_ent_id = def_to_ent_id
              FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @J_target_sched_ent_id and job_pos = 0
-- 11/19/2002     TC	1.5.0    When reading default values from job_exec use job_pos = 0 as job_pos is now part of PK
          END
          ELSE
          BEGIN
            ----Select item reason good for production?
	    SELECT @JE_def_prod_reas_cd = IR.reas_cd FROM item_grade IG, item_reas IR WHERE IG.good_prod = 1 AND IR.item_grade_cd = IG.item_grade_cd
            SET @JE_def_lot_no = NULL
            SET @BI_def_storage_ent_id = NULL
            SET @BI_scaling_factor = NULL
          END  --End of @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        END  --End of @V_Target_Ent_Id IS NOT NULL
      END
      INSERT INTO job_BOM(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, BOM_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_val,
                          reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush,	def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id,
			   scaling_factor, serial_no_source, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots,
                          max_qty_per_Parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES(@wo_id, @BIOL_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @BIOL_BOM_pos,	@parent_item_id, NULL, NULL, 1, @float_start_val,
               @float_start_Val_is_pct, @update_inv, 0,	@JE_def_prod_reas_cd, @JE_def_lot_no, @JE_def_sublot_no, @JE_def_to_ent_id,
	       NULL, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
    END  --End of @BV_ver_id IS NOT NULL
  END  --End of @JB_row_count = 0
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_U_ofi_merge_adj_events]
-- Description:To merge the Adjcent events incase both have same reas_cd

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-08-14		Intial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_merge_adj_events] 
@ent_id as int


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

Declare 
@result as int=0,
@curr_log_id as int,
@log_id as int,
@curr_reas_cd as int,
@last_reas_cd as int,
@speedloss_handling_type as nvarchar(40),
@curr_comment as nvarchar(40),
@last_comment as nvarchar(40),
@id_min as int,
@id_max as int,
@curr_datetime_utc as datetime,
@last_datetime_utc as datetime,
@job_act_start_time_utc as datetime,
@wo_id as nvarchar(40),
@oper_id as nvarchar(40),
@seq_no as int




SELECT TOP 1 @job_act_start_time_utc=act_start_time_utc,@oper_id=oper_id 
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE run_ent_id=@ent_id 
		AND state_cd=3 --For running order


	--Get the current date_time_utc which is latest cycle event time after the job start or latest job suspend/complete finish time 
	IF (@job_act_start_time_utc IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN

		SELECT TOP 1 @curr_datetime_utc=event_time_utc
				FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
					AND raw_reas_cd='Batch_Cycle_Start' 
					AND event_time_utc >= @job_act_start_time_utc 
					ORDER BY log_id DESC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @job_act_start_time_utc=act_start_time_utc,@curr_datetime_utc=act_finish_time_utc,@oper_id=oper_id
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) 
					WHERE run_ent_id=@ent_id 
					AND state_cd in (4,5) 
					ORDER BY act_finish_time_utc DESC  
	
		END
--Validation for batch process
SELECT @speedloss_handling_type=oa.attr_value
	FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'SpeedHandlingType'
			AND a.attr_grp = 7
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
--Get the Last date_time_utc which is latest merged event end time after the job start or job start_utc
IF (@speedloss_handling_type ='Batch')
 BEGIN

SELECT TOP 1 @last_datetime_utc=event_time_utc
		FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
			AND last_edit_comment='Auto Merged' 
			AND event_time_utc >= @job_act_start_time_utc 
			ORDER BY log_id DESC

			IF (@last_datetime_utc IS NULL)
			BEGIN
			SET @last_datetime_utc = @job_act_start_time_utc
			END


print '@last_datetime_utc ->' + cast(@last_datetime_utc AS NVARCHAR(100))	
--SELECT TOP 1 @curr_log_id=log_id from util_history WITH (NOLOCK) where ent_id=@ent_id ORDER BY log_id DESC


 DECLARE
  @temp TABLE 
  (
   id int IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
   log_id int,
   reas_cd int,
   comments nvarchar(40)
  )


  INSERT @temp
    SELECT log_id,reas_cd,comments
    FROM util_history  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
		AND event_time_utc < @curr_datetime_utc
		AND event_time_utc >=@last_datetime_utc
		--AND (event_time_utc between @last_datetime_utc and @curr_datetime_utc ) 
		--AND log_id < @curr_log_id
		ORDER by log_id desc

 -- select *from @temp
SELECT @id_min = MIN(id),@id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp 

print '@id_min ->' + cast(@id_min AS NVARCHAR(100))
print '@id_max ->' + cast(@id_max AS NVARCHAR(100))

WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
  BEGIN

	SELECT @curr_reas_cd=reas_cd,@curr_comment=comments FROM @temp WHERE id = @id_min
	SELECT @last_reas_cd=reas_cd,@last_comment=comments FROM @temp  WHERE id =(@id_min +1)


			--print @curr_reas_cd
			--print @last_reas_cd
			print '@id_min ->' + cast(@id_min AS NVARCHAR(100))
		IF (@curr_comment IS NULL AND @last_comment IS NULL )
		BEGIN
			IF (@curr_reas_cd = @last_reas_cd AND @curr_reas_cd IS NOT NULL AND @last_reas_cd IS NOT NULL )
			BEGIN
				SELECT @log_id=log_id FROM @temp WHERE id=@id_min
				EXEC sp_D_Util_History @log_id,@ent_id,null,null
				--upadte last_comment_edit as Auto_merged 
				UPDATE util_history SET last_edit_comment='Auto Merged' where log_id=(SELECT log_id FROM @temp WHERE id=@id_min+1)
				print 'Log id ->' + cast(@log_id AS NVARCHAR(100))
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF (@curr_reas_cd = @last_reas_cd AND @curr_comment=@last_comment AND @curr_reas_cd IS NOT NULL AND @last_reas_cd IS NOT NULL )
			BEGIN
				SELECT @log_id=log_id FROM @temp WHERE id=@id_min
				EXEC sp_D_Util_History @log_id,@ent_id,null,null
				--upadte last_comment_edit as Auto_merged 
				UPDATE util_history SET last_edit_comment='Auto Merged' where log_id=(SELECT log_id FROM @temp WHERE id=@id_min+1)
				print 'Log id ->' + cast(@log_id AS NVARCHAR(100))
			END
		END
		SET @curr_reas_cd=NULL
		SET @last_reas_cd=NULL
		SET @log_id=NULL


    SET @id_min = @id_min + 1
  END

	SELECT @result AS result
 END
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_DL_IsDataCollectionReqd]
(@grp_id		INT32_NULL = NULL
,@max_value		INT32_NULL = NULL
,@wo_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@seq_no		INT32_NULL = NULL
,@step_no		INT32_NULL = NULL
,@lot_no		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@sublot_no		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@data_collect_reqd	LOGICAL
) RETURNS INT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_DLG_COLLECTDATA
-- Description          - Returns an available set of data_log_groups for the given job/step.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    12/07/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--02/04/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074426; L00074427; L00074701; L00074692; Collect data is not returning whether a data_log_n group requires a data collection or not.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

DECLARE  @row_count	INT
	,@i		INT
	,@max_i		INT
	,@row_id	INT

	IF (COALESCE(@data_collect_reqd, 0) = 0) RETURN 0

	IF (@max_value = 16) BEGIN
		DECLARE @each_data_log_16 TABLE (id int identity, row_id int)

		INSERT INTO @each_data_log_16 (row_id)
		SELECT dl16.row_id FROM data_log_16 dl16
		WHERE dl16.grp_id = @grp_id
		  AND dl16.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND dl16.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND dl16.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND (dl16.step_no = @step_no OR ((dl16.step_no = -1 OR dl16.step_no IS NULL) AND @step_no IS NULL))
		  AND (dl16.lot_no = @lot_no OR (dl16.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no IS NULL AND dl16.lot_no = '-'))
		  AND (dl16.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (dl16.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@sublot_no IS NULL AND dl16.sublot_no = '-'))

		SELECT @i = MIN(id), @max_i = MAX(id) FROM @each_data_log_16

		WHILE (@i <= @max_i) BEGIN
			SELECT @row_id = row_id FROM @each_data_log_16 WHERE id = @i
			SET @row_count = dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisRow(@row_id, @grp_id, 16, 1)
			IF (@row_count = 1) RETURN 1
			SET @i = (@i + 1)
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		DECLARE @each_data_log_48 TABLE (id int identity, row_id int)

		INSERT INTO @each_data_log_48 (row_id)
		SELECT dl48.row_id FROM data_log_48 dl48
		WHERE dl48.grp_id = @grp_id
		  AND dl48.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND dl48.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND dl48.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND (dl48.step_no = @step_no OR ((dl48.step_no = -1 OR dl48.step_no IS NULL) AND @step_no IS NULL))
		  AND (dl48.lot_no = @lot_no OR (dl48.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no IS NULL AND dl48.lot_no = '-'))
		  AND (dl48.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (dl48.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@sublot_no IS NULL AND dl48.sublot_no = '-'))

		SELECT @i = MIN(id), @max_i = MAX(id) FROM @each_data_log_48

		WHILE (@i <= @max_i) BEGIN
			SELECT @row_id = row_id FROM @each_data_log_48 WHERE id = @i
			SET @row_count = dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisRow(@row_id, @grp_id, 48, 1)
			IF (@row_count = 1) RETURN 1
			SET @i = (@i + 1)
		END
	END
	RETURN 0
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Insert_Location]
(
@location_name nvarchar(50),
@user_name nvarchar(50),
@loc_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.loc where loc_id = @loc_id
		if @rowCount = 0 
		begin
			insert into SDB.SCH.loc ([loc_id],[loc_desc],[last_edit_by]) VALUES (@loc_id,@location_name,@user_name)
			set @message = CONCAT('Successfully added location : ' , @location_name)
		end
		else
		begin
			set @message = CONCAT('location already present in table with location ID: ' , @loc_id)
		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to add location: ' , @location_name)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
	

	select @location_name
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    Fn_s_ofi_get_processByCriteria
-- Description:  Returns the process order type
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  KN          2023-03-13         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  LP          2023-09-13         Added condition for butter loadout process
-- 0.01.02   LP          2023-12-06         Updated the liquor process with breaking and winowing process, commented previous code
-- 0.01.03	VJ			2024-04-29			Added statement for Bean Rework-1 process
-- 0.01.04	VJ			2024-05-27			Updated statement for LiquorButterRework-1 process

CREATE                             function [dbo].[Fn_s_ofi_get_processByCriteria_backup_29_05_2025] (
		@wo_id			NVARCHAR(200),
		@product_group	NVARCHAR(200),
		@prodn_method	NVARCHAR(200),
		@material_state	NVARCHAR(200),
		@order_type		NVARCHAR(200)) returns NVARCHAR(100)
AS
Begin
      DECLARE @process_id NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,@comments NVARCHAR(40) = NULL

	  SELECT @process_id = 
		CASE

			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-BLOCKED' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Butter Packing-1'	-- Tested. Works
			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Butter LoadOut-1'	-- Will take time. SAP working on it
			
			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'LiquorBlendAndLoadOut-1'	-- Will take time. SAP working on it, commented by LP
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Butter LoadOut-1'	-- Added by LP
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Liquor Melt-1'	-- Will take time. SAP working on it


			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Powder Packing-1'		-- Duplicate for FG-CAKE
			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-LIQUOR-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'LiquorBlendAndLoadOut-1'		-- Liquor Loadout No such process defined
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-POWDER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Powder Packing-1'		-- Duplicate for FG-CAKE
			
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-BUTTER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Butter Melt-1'			-- Tested. Works
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Liquor Melt-1'			


			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Pressing-1'					-- Tested. Works
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'STERILIZING' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Wet Rework-1'			-- Tested. Error while creating BOM
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Dry Rework-1'				-- SAP looking into creating this order in their system

			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Liquor Process'			-- Liquor Process No such process defined
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'BreakingWinRoasting-1'	--BreakandWin Process

			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'DEODORIZED' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Petzomat'				-- Petzomat No such process defined
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Liquor Melt-1'			-- Tested. Works
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'STERILIZING' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'LiquorButterRework-1' -- LiquorButterRework (BINs Consumption)

			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-POWDER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Powder Packing-1'		-- Duplicate for FG-CAKE
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-POWDER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Blending-1'

			--ADDED FOR BLUE BINS REWORK ORDERS FOR BEANR REWORK
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-BEAN BLEND' AND (UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' or @prodn_method is null) AND (UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' OR @material_state IS NULL) AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Bean Rework-1'		-- Bean rework Process for Blue Bins


			ELSE NULL
		END
		

	  return @process_id
End

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_I_ofi_su_mes_states_mapping]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will insert the attributes if not created by mes client
--
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JN				2022-09-23			Initial version.
-- 0.01.10	YG				2024-01-30			Added the comment on the body script and formating 
-- ===========================================================================================*******************************************************************************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_su_mes_states_mapping]
(@ent_id INT,
@last_edit_at DATETIME OUTPUT )
 
AS
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),
	@su_status_desc NVARCHAR(80),
	@count int

-- Get User Id
EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL;

-- Set Initial Value
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() );
SET @count=0 ;
SET @su_status_desc = 'Idle';

Begin
	while  (@count<10)
	Begin
		If NOT exists (select j.su_ent_id from ofi_su_states i WITH (NOLOCK) 
						inner join ofi_su_mes_states_mapping j WITH (NOLOCK) on i.su_status_cd=j.su_status_cd 
						where i.su_status_desc =@su_status_desc and j.su_ent_id = @ent_id)
			INSERT INTO ofi_su_mes_states_mapping (su_ent_id, su_status_cd,last_edit_comment,last_edit_by,last_edit_at_local,su_status_value) 
			VALUES(@ent_id,(select su_status_cd from ofi_su_states WITH (NOLOCK) where su_status_desc = @su_status_desc),NULL,@last_edit_by,@last_edit_at,0)
		
		-- Set Attribute into 'Filling' if Counter value is 1
		If (@count=1) 
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Filling';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'Filled' if Counter value is 2
		Else if(@count=2)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Filled';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'Cleaning' if Counter value is 3
		Else if(@count=3)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Cleaning';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'Filling_Emptying' if Counter value is 4
		Else if(@count=4)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Filling_Emptying';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'Released' if Counter value is 5
		Else if(@count=5)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Released';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'Cleaned' if Counter value is 6
		Else if(@count=6)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Cleaned';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'In_Quarantine' if Counter value is 7 
		Else if(@count=7)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'In_Quarantine';
		End
		-- Set Attribute into 'Emptying' if Counter value is 8
		Else if(@count=8)
		Begin
			SET @su_status_desc = 'Emptying';
		End

		SET @count=@count+1;
	End
End

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [vw_ofi_su_details]
-- Description: This is used to get all configured Storage Units for later reports
--
--
--
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC      2024-09-25   		Initial Version
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE     VIEW [dbo].[vw_ofi_su_details] AS



	SELECT DISTINCT
			 ent_id
		   , ent_name
		   , description
		   , item_group
	FROM
			 (
					-- Storage configuration by user interface
					SELECT DISTINCT 
						   isl.storage_ent_id AS ent_id
						 , e.ent_name
						 , e.description
						 , isl.item_GROUP AS item_GROUP
					FROM
						   ofi_ent_item_storage_link isl WITH(NOLOCK)
						   JOIN
								  ent e with (nolock)
								  ON
										 e.ent_id = isl.storage_ent_id
					UNION ALL
					-- Storage with inventory
					SELECT DISTINCT
							   ii.ent_id
							 , e.ent_name
							 , e.description
							 , ia1.attr_value AS item_GROUP
					FROM
							   item_inv ii WITH(NOLOCK)
							   INNER JOIN
										  item_attr ia1 WITH(NOLOCK)
										  ON
													 ia1.item_id     = ii.item_id
													 AND ia1.attr_id = (SELECT TOP 1 
																						a.attr_id
																					FROM
																						   attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
																					WHERE
																						   attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
							   JOIN
										  ent e with (nolock)
										  ON
													 e.ent_id = ii.ent_id
			 )
			 AS all_SUs
	GROUP BY
			 ent_id
		   , ent_name
		   , description
		   , item_GROUP

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Class]
(@item_class_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @item_class_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @produced  bit  ,
 @consumed  bit,
 @obsolete bit,
 @purchased bit,
 @sold bit,
 @lot_no_format string40,
 @last_lot_no string40,
 @sublot_no_format string40,
 @last_sublot_no string40,
 @serial_no_lvl int32,
 @inv_unique_by_job bit,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Class
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/09/2002	Raghu		1.4	Added obsolete condition for items
--11/13/2003	Raghu		2.0.0.9	(HD# 1650) Item_class display is ordered based on the value is set in the system_attr table
--03/22/2005	Raghu		2.1.17	HD# 5409, A new column named 'item_display' added to the resultset to return the value based on
--					the system attribute
--09/15/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--07/11/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--10/11/2007	AML			3.3.3	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @disp_order NVARCHAR(1)

IF @obsolete  IS NULL SET @obsolete = 0
IF @obsolete = 1 SET @obsolete = NULL

SELECT @disp_order = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 208
IF (@disp_order IS NULL) OR ISNUMERIC(@disp_order) = 0 SET @disp_order = 0

SELECT item_class.item_class_id
            ,item_class.item_class_desc
            ,item_class.produced
            ,item_class.consumed
            ,item_class.obsolete
            ,item_class.purchased
            ,item_class.sold
	        ,item_class.lot_no_format
            ,item_class.last_lot_no
            ,item_class.sublot_no_format
            ,item_class.last_sublot_no
            ,item_class.serial_no_lvl
            ,item_class.inv_unique_by_job
            ,item_class.spare1
            ,item_class.spare2
            ,item_class.spare3
            ,item_class.spare4
            ,item_class.last_edit_comment
            ,item_class.last_edit_by
            ,item_class.last_edit_at
	,	CASE
			WHEN @disp_order = '0' THEN item_class.item_class_id
			WHEN @disp_order = '1' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
			WHEN @disp_order = '2' THEN item_class.item_class_id + '(' + item_class.item_class_desc + ')'
			WHEN @disp_order = '3' THEN item_class.item_class_desc + '(' + item_class.item_class_id + ')'
		END item_class_display
FROM item_class item_class WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (	(item_class.item_class_id = @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.item_class_desc = @item_class_desc OR @item_class_desc IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.produced = @produced OR @produced IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.consumed = @consumed OR @consumed IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.obsolete = @obsolete OR  @obsolete IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.purchased = @purchased OR @purchased IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.sold = @sold OR @sold IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.lot_no_format = @lot_no_format OR @lot_no_format IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.sublot_no_format = @sublot_no_format OR @sublot_no_format IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.last_sublot_no = @last_sublot_no OR @last_sublot_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.serial_no_lvl = @serial_no_lvl OR @serial_no_lvl IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.inv_unique_by_job = ABS(@inv_unique_by_job) OR @inv_unique_by_job IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.last_lot_no = @last_lot_no OR @last_lot_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(item_class.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY 	CASE @disp_order
			WHEN '0' THEN item_class.item_class_id
			WHEN '1' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
			WHEN '2' THEN item_class.item_class_id
			WHEN '3' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
			ELSE item_class.item_class_id
		 END,
		 CASE @disp_order
			WHEN '2' THEN item_class.item_class_desc
            			WHEN '3' THEN item_class.item_class_id
		 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Job_Path]
(@wo_id		nvarchar(40),
 @sort_order	bit = 1
) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
Begin
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_S_JOB_Path
-- Description	      - To get a list of jobs for a work order in the order the jobs should be run based on the
--			sort order specified.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 08/19/2002
-- Version	      - 1.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
--09/10/2002	  Raghu		1.4	Modified code to get the job path from job_route
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
Declare	@oper_id	nvarchar(40),
	@seq_no		int,
	@max_path_len	int,
	@row_count	int
	IF @wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 Should not be Null{3339},Wo_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SET @max_path_len = 0
	IF @sort_order IS NULL SET @sort_order = 1
	SET @row_count = 1
	CREATE TABLE #tbl_job_path (wo_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INTEGER, max_path_len int)
	INSERT INTO #tbl_job_path (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no , max_path_len)
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, @max_path_len FROM JOB
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and final_job = 1
	WHILE (@row_count > 0) BEGIN
		DECLARE cur_job CURSOR STATIC FOR
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM #tbl_job_path
			WHERE max_path_len = @max_path_len
		OPEN cur_job
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur_job into @oper_id, @seq_no
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			INSERT INTO #tbl_job_path (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, max_path_len)
			SELECT @wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, @max_path_len + 1 FROM job_route
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
--			SELECT @input_oper_id = input_oper_id, @input_seq_no = input_seq_no, @row_id = row_id FROM job_route
--			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
--			INSERT INTO #tbl_job_path (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, max_path_len)
--				VALUES (@wo_id, @input_oper_id, @input_seq_no, @max_path_len + 1)
--			PRINT 'W ID = ' + @wo_id + ', oper_id = ' + @input_oper_id + ', seq_no = ' + str(@input_seq_no) + ', Row Id = ' + str(@row_id)
		END
		CLOSE cur_job
		DEALLOCATE cur_job
		SET @max_path_len = @max_path_len + 1
		SELECT @row_count = count(*) FROM job_route
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROM #tbl_job_path WHERE max_path_len = @max_path_len)
		IF @row_count = 0 BREAK
	END
	IF @sort_order = 1 SELECT * FROM #tbl_job_path
	ELSE SELECT * FROM #tbl_job_path ORDER BY max_path_len DESC, seq_no DESC
	DROP TABLE #tbl_job_path
End

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Cert_Std_Oper_Step_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes

-- 07/03/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000.

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	WHERE (
			(cert_std_oper_step_link.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL) AND
			(cert_std_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND

		  )

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_BI_to_Job_BOM_Subst]
  @wo_id            NVARCHAR(40),
  @process_id       NVARCHAR(40),
  @parent_item_id   NVARCHAR(40),
  @ver_id           NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
  @oper_id          NVARCHAR(40),
  @seq_no           INT,
  @bom_pos          INT,
  @start_val        FLOAT,
  @start_Val_is_pct LOGICAL
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_BI_TO_JOB_BOM_SUBST
-- Description	      -
-- Author             - Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created	      - 08/05/2004
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver       Changes
-- 10/01/2004     SJ           2.1.0.3 - HD#5012 Item substitution corrected.
-- 09/30/2005     Raghu	       3.1.0     Part of DB Changes
-- 12/29/2006     KRF          3.2.1     Added def_sublot_no
-- 10/24/2007	  AML		   3.3.4	 HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									     dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE
  @V_AltNo         INT32,
  @V_Last_Edit_At  TDATETIME,
  @V_Last_Edit_By  STRING40,
--
  @V_Pref          INT32,
  @V_Subst_Level   INT32,
  @V_Item_Id       STRING40,
  @V_Reqd_Grade_Cd INT32_NULL,
  @V_Instruction   STRING1700_NULL,
  @V_Qty_Per_Parent_Item TFLOAT,
  @V_Max_Qty_Per_Parent_Item TFLOAT,
  @V_Min_Qty_Per_Parent_Item TFLOAT,
  @V_Update_Inv    LOGICAL,
  @V_Backflush     LOGICAL,
  @V_Def_Reas_Cd   INT32_NULL,
  @V_Def_Lot_No    STRING40_NULL,
  @V_def_sublot_no STRING40_NULL, -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
  @V_Def_Storage_Ent_Id INT32_NULL,
  @V_Def_Reject_Ent_Id INT32,
  @V_Scaling_Factor TFLOAT_NULL,
  @V_Must_Consume_From_Inv LOGICAL,
  @V_May_Choose_Alt_Inv_Loc LOGICAL,
  @V_May_Create_New_Lots LOGICAL,
  @V_Must_Consume_From_Wip LOGICAL,
  @V_Must_Consume_Before_Prod LOGICAL,
  @V_Constant_Qty LOGICAL,
  @V_Est_Time TFLOAT_NULL,
  @V_Spare1   STRING1000_NULL,
  @V_Spare2   STRING1000_NULL,
  @V_Spare3   STRING1000_NULL,
  @V_Spare4   STRING1000_NULL,
  @J_target_sched_ent_id INT32
BEGIN
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @V_Last_Edit_By OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @V_Last_Edit_At = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  --Check if this BOM position has already been processed
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND BOM_pos = @BOM_pos)
  BEGIN
    --Check if this item has a BOM
    IF @ver_id IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      --Find BOM substitutes for this item and add it to job BOM substitutes
      INSERT INTO job_bom_subst(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, alt_no, pref, subst_level, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item,
                            max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item,
                            reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
                            scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
                            must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
        SELECT @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @bom_pos, i.alt_no, i.pref, i.subst_level, i.item_id, i.reqd_grade_cd, i.instruction, i.qty_per_parent_item,
            i.max_qty_per_Parent_item/i.qty_per_parent_item*l.qty_per_parent_item, i.min_qty_per_parent_item/i.qty_per_parent_item*l.qty_per_parent_item,
            @start_val, @start_val_is_pct, i.update_inv, i.backflush, i.def_reas_cd, i.def_lot_no, i.def_sublot_no, i.def_storage_ent_id, i.def_reject_ent_id,
            i.scaling_factor, i.must_consume_from_inv, i.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, i.may_create_new_lots, i.must_consume_from_wip,
            i.must_consume_before_prod, i.constant_qty, i.est_time, i.spare1, i.spare2, i.spare3, i.spare4, @V_Last_Edit_By, @V_Last_Edit_At
          FROM BOM_item_subst AS i
            INNER JOIN BOM_item_oper_link AS l ON i.parent_item_id = l.parent_item_id AND i.ver_id = l.ver_id AND i.bom_pos = l.bom_pos
              WHERE i.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND i.ver_id = @ver_id AND i.BOM_pos = @BOM_pos
                AND l.process_id = @process_id AND l.oper_id = @oper_id

      --Find item substitutes for items for which no BOM substitutes exist and add them as job BOM substitutes
      DECLARE cur_item_subst CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT i.pref, i.subst_level, i.item_id, i.reqd_grade_cd, i.instruction, i.qty_per_parent_item,
               i.max_qty_per_parent_item/i.qty_per_parent_item*l.qty_per_parent_item, i.min_qty_per_parent_item/i.qty_per_parent_item*l.qty_per_parent_item,
               i.update_inv, i.backflush, i.def_reas_cd, i.def_lot_no, i.def_sublot_no, i.def_storage_ent_id, i.def_reject_ent_id,
               i.scaling_factor, i.must_consume_from_inv, i.may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  i.may_create_new_lots, i.must_consume_from_wip,
               i.must_consume_before_prod, i.constant_qty, i.est_time, i.spare1, i.spare2, i.spare3, i.spare4
          FROM bom_item_oper_link AS l
            INNER JOIN bom_item AS b ON l.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND l.ver_id = b.ver_id AND l.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
            INNER JOIN item_subst AS i ON i.orig_item_id = b.item_id
              WHERE l.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND l.ver_id = @ver_id AND l.bom_pos = @bom_pos
                AND l.process_id = @process_id AND l.oper_id = @oper_id AND i.item_id NOT IN
                (SELECT item_id FROM job_bom_subst WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no)
      OPEN cur_item_subst
      SELECT @V_AltNo = ISNULL(MAX(alt_no), 0)+1 FROM job_bom_subst WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
      WHILE (1=1)
      BEGIN
        FETCH cur_item_subst INTO @V_pref, @V_subst_level, @V_item_id, @V_reqd_grade_cd, @V_instruction, @V_qty_per_parent_item,
                            @V_max_qty_per_parent_item, @V_min_qty_per_parent_item,
                            @V_update_inv, @V_backflush, @V_def_reas_cd, @V_def_lot_no, @V_def_sublot_no, @V_def_storage_ent_id, @V_def_reject_ent_id,
                            @V_scaling_factor, @V_must_consume_from_inv, @V_may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  @V_may_create_new_lots, @V_must_consume_from_wip,
                            @V_must_consume_before_prod, @V_constant_qty, @V_est_time, @V_spare1, @V_spare2, @V_spare3, @V_spare4
        IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
          BREAK

        INSERT INTO job_bom_subst(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, alt_no, pref, subst_level, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item,
                            max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item,
                            reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
                            scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
                            must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
          VALUES(@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @bom_pos, @V_AltNo, @V_pref, @V_subst_level, @V_item_id, @V_reqd_grade_cd, @V_instruction, @V_qty_per_parent_item,
                 @V_max_qty_per_parent_item, @V_min_qty_per_parent_item,
                 @start_val, @start_val_is_pct, @V_update_inv, @V_backflush, @V_def_reas_cd, @V_def_lot_no, @V_def_sublot_no, @V_def_storage_ent_id, @V_def_reject_ent_id,
                 @V_scaling_factor, @V_must_consume_from_inv, @V_may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  @V_may_create_new_lots, @V_must_consume_from_wip,
                 @V_must_consume_before_prod, @V_constant_qty, @V_est_time, @V_spare1, @V_spare2, @V_spare3, @V_spare4, @V_Last_Edit_By, @V_Last_Edit_At)
        SET @V_AltNo = @V_AltNo + 1  --Just a place holder in job BOM
      END
      CLOSE cur_item_subst
      DEALLOCATE cur_item_subst
    END  --End of @ver_id IS NOT NULL
    ELSE
    BEGIN  --FOR BOM 0 check if any substitutes exist
      --Find item substitutes for BOM 0 item
      DECLARE cur_item_subst CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT i.pref, i.subst_level, i.item_id, i.reqd_grade_cd, i.instruction, i.qty_per_parent_item,
               i.max_qty_per_parent_item, i.min_qty_per_parent_item,
               i.update_inv, i.backflush, i.def_reas_cd, i.def_lot_no, i.def_sublot_no, i.def_storage_ent_id, i.def_reject_ent_id,
               i.scaling_factor, i.must_consume_from_inv, i.may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  i.may_create_new_lots, i.must_consume_from_wip,
               i.must_consume_before_prod, i.constant_qty, i.est_time, i.spare1, i.spare2, i.spare3, i.spare4
          FROM item_subst AS i WHERE orig_item_id = @parent_item_id
      OPEN cur_item_subst
      SET @V_AltNo = 1  --Just a place holder in job BOM
      WHILE (1=1)
      BEGIN
        FETCH cur_item_subst INTO @V_pref, @V_subst_level, @V_item_id, @V_reqd_grade_cd, @V_instruction, @V_qty_per_parent_item,
                            @V_max_qty_per_parent_item, @V_min_qty_per_parent_item,
                            @V_update_inv, @V_backflush, @V_def_reas_cd, @V_def_lot_no, @V_def_sublot_no, @V_def_storage_ent_id, @V_def_reject_ent_id,
                            @V_scaling_factor, @V_must_consume_from_inv, @V_may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  @V_may_create_new_lots, @V_must_consume_from_wip,
                            @V_must_consume_before_prod, @V_constant_qty, @V_est_time, @V_spare1, @V_spare2, @V_spare3, @V_spare4
        IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
          BREAK

        --Assign the values when no preferred bom version exists
        IF @BOM_pos = 0
        BEGIN
          --Get the target sched entity identity
          SELECT @J_target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

          SET @start_Val_is_pct = 1
          SET @start_val = 1
          SET @V_update_inv = 0
          SET @V_backflush = 0
          IF @J_target_sched_ent_id IS NOT NULL
          BEGIN
            --Check if record exists in job exec for target sched ent id
            IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @J_target_sched_ent_id)
            BEGIN
              SELECT @V_def_reas_cd = def_prod_reas_cd, @V_def_lot_no = def_lot_no, @V_def_storage_ent_id = def_to_ent_id
                FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @J_target_sched_ent_id and job_pos = 0
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
              ----Select item reason good for production?
	      SELECT @V_def_reas_cd = IR.reas_cd FROM item_grade IG, item_reas IR WHERE IG.good_prod = 1 AND IR.item_grade_cd = IG.item_grade_cd
              SET @V_def_lot_no = NULL
              SET @V_def_storage_ent_id = NULL
              SET @V_scaling_factor = NULL
            END  --End of @@ROWCOUNT > 0
          END  --End of @V_Target_Ent_Id IS NOT NULL
        END

        INSERT INTO job_bom_subst(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, alt_no, pref, subst_level, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item,
                            max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item,
                            reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
                            scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
                            must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
          VALUES(@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @bom_pos, @V_AltNo, @V_pref, @V_subst_level, @V_item_id, @V_reqd_grade_cd, @V_instruction, @V_qty_per_parent_item,
                 @V_max_qty_per_parent_item, @V_min_qty_per_parent_item,
                 @start_val, @start_val_is_pct, @V_update_inv, @V_backflush, @V_def_reas_cd, @V_def_lot_no, @V_def_sublot_no, @V_def_storage_ent_id, @V_def_reject_ent_id,
                 @V_scaling_factor, @V_must_consume_from_inv, @V_may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  @V_may_create_new_lots, @V_must_consume_from_wip,
                 @V_must_consume_before_prod, @V_constant_qty, @V_est_time, @V_spare1, @V_spare2, @V_spare3, @V_spare4, @V_Last_Edit_By, @V_Last_Edit_At)
        SET @V_AltNo = @V_AltNo + 1  --Just a place holder in job BOM
      END
      CLOSE cur_item_subst
      DEALLOCATE cur_item_subst
    END
  END  -- IF NOT EXISTS ...
END

/*
=============================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_NextSUInQueue
-- Description:	

-- Usage:		NewStorageUnitRequest WF
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2023-02-19			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2023-05-23			Disable checking on the old silo
==============================================================================================
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_NextSUInQueue]
		@wo_id nvarchar(100) = NULL,
		@oper_id nvarchar(100) =NULL,
		@seq_no int = NULL,
		@message_type int = NULL,
		@Old_SU nvarchar(40) = NULL,
		@New_SU nvarchar(40) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	Declare @Result_Desc Nvarchar(100),
			@New_Mes_Ent_Id INT,
			@Old_Mes_Ent_Id INT

	if (@New_SU is null OR @New_SU = 0)
	begin
		set @Result_Desc = 'Error: New storage unit is not getting the value';

		select 0 as result, @Result_Desc as result_desc
		return
	end
	else 
	begin
		SELECT @New_Mes_Ent_Id = e.ent_id FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
							AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr where attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT')
							AND ea.attr_value = @New_SU
	end

	/* Disabled on v0.02
	if (@Old_SU is null OR @Old_SU = 0)
	begin
		set @Result_Desc = 'Error: Old storage unit is not getting the value';

		select 0 as result, @Result_Desc as result_desc
		return
	end
	else
	begin
		SELECT @Old_Mes_Ent_Id = e.ent_id FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
							AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr where attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT')
							AND ea.attr_value = @Old_SU
	end
	*/

	-- Added on v0.02
	SELECT @Old_Mes_Ent_Id = e.ent_id FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
						AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr where attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT')
						AND (ea.attr_value = @Old_SU)

	-- Used for debugger
	Print @New_Mes_Ent_Id 
	Print @Old_Mes_Ent_Id
	--return

	/*
	select * from ofi_su_selection with (nolock)
	where wo_id = @wo_id 
		and oper_id = @oper_id
		and seq_no = @seq_no
		and dest_type = @dest_type
	*/

	if (@message_type = 2)
	Begin
		-- Clear the item
		Update ofi_su_selection 
		set latest_aut_silo = 1
		where wo_id = @wo_id 
			and oper_id = @oper_id
			and seq_no = @seq_no
			and dest_type = @message_type

		-- Update the current 
		Update ofi_su_selection 
		set latest_aut_silo = 0
		where wo_id = @wo_id 
			and oper_id = @oper_id
			and seq_no = @seq_no
			and dest_type = @message_type
			--and storage_ent_id = @New_Mes_Ent_Id
			and su_ent_id = @New_Mes_Ent_Id
	End
	if(@message_type = 1)
	BEGIN
		-- Update the current 
		Update ofi_su_selection 
		set latest_aut_silo = 0
		where wo_id = @wo_id 
			and oper_id = @oper_id
			and seq_no = @seq_no
			and dest_type = @message_type
			--and storage_ent_id = @Old_Mes_Ent_Id
			and su_ent_id = @Old_Mes_Ent_Id
			and secondary_silo_ent_id = @New_Mes_Ent_Id
	END

End

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Lot_Rename]
(@in_item_id			STRING80
,@in_old_lot_no			STRING80
,@in_new_lot_no			STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -    SP_U_LOT_RENAME
-- Description          -    Rename this lot to a new lot name
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -  04/30/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.10
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes

--10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6      spc_sample is removed from the database
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @err_str		NVARCHAR(4000)

BEGIN
	--Verify whether the existing lot exist in the database.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM lot WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
					  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'lot_no:' + @in_old_lot_no
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the new lot already exist in the database.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM lot WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
					  AND lot_no = @in_new_lot_no) BEGIN
		--The new lot_no already exist in the database. raise an error to the caller.
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'lot_no:' + @in_new_lot_no
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

    --Start renaming all the old_lot_no to a new lot_no.
    --Rename old_lot_no to a new lot_no in lot table.
	UPDATE lot
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot_no to a new lot_no in the sublot table.
	UPDATE sublot
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the lot_attr table.
	UPDATE lot_attr
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the assigned_lot table.
	UPDATE assigned_lot
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the item_inv table.
	UPDATE item_inv
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the inv_lot_attr table.
	UPDATE inv_lot_attr
	SET inv_lot_lot_no_h = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE inv_lot_item_id_h = @in_item_id
	  AND inv_lot_lot_no_h = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the item_prod table.
	UPDATE item_prod
	SET lot_no = CASE WHEN lot_no = @in_old_lot_no THEN @in_new_lot_no ELSE lot_no END,
		rm_lot_no = CASE WHEN rm_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no THEN @in_new_lot_no ELSE rm_lot_no END
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND (lot_no = @in_old_lot_no OR rm_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no)

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the job_event table.
	UPDATE job_event
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the item_cons table.
	UPDATE item_cons
	SET lot_no = CASE WHEN lot_no = @in_old_lot_no THEN @in_new_lot_no ELSE lot_no END,
		fg_lot_no = CASE WHEN fg_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no THEN @in_new_lot_no ELSE fg_lot_no END
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND (lot_no = @in_old_lot_no OR fg_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no)

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the job_step_data table.
	UPDATE job_step_data
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_step_data.wo_id = j.wo_id AND job_step_data.oper_id = j.oper_id AND job_step_data.seq_no = j.seq_no
	  AND j.item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the item_transfer table.
	UPDATE item_transfer
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the item_transfer table.
	UPDATE item_transfer
	SET from_lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE from_item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND from_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the transfer_list table.
	UPDATE transfer_list
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the transfer_list table.
	UPDATE transfer_list
	SET from_lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE from_item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND from_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the labor_usage table.
	UPDATE labor_usage
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the cert_audit_log table.
	UPDATE cert_audit_log
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE cert_audit_log.wo_id = j.wo_id AND cert_audit_log.oper_id = j.oper_id AND cert_audit_log.seq_no = j.seq_no
	  AND j.item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the data_log_16 table.
	UPDATE data_log_16
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the data_log_48 table.
	UPDATE data_log_48
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the shipment_lot table.
	UPDATE shipment_lot
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	FROM
	(SELECT s.cust_id, s.po_id, s.so_line_no, s.ship_date_utc
	 FROM shipment s WITH (NOLOCK)
	 INNER JOIN so_line sl WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.cust_id = sl.cust_id AND s.po_id = sl.po_id AND s.so_line_no = sl.so_line_no
	  WHERE sl.item_id = @in_item_id) cust_shipment
	WHERE cust_shipment.cust_id = shipment_lot.cust_id AND cust_shipment.po_id = shipment_lot.po_id
	  AND cust_shipment.so_line_no = shipment_lot.so_line_no AND cust_shipment.ship_date_utc = shipment_lot.ship_date_utc
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the receipt_lot table.
	UPDATE receipt_lot
	SET lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	  AND lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	/*    --Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the job_exec table.
	UPDATE job_exec
	SET sublot_no = @in_new_sublot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND lot_no = @in_lot_no
	AND sublot_no = @in_old_sublot_no */

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the bom_item table.
	UPDATE bom_item
	SET def_lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE parent_item_id = @in_item_id
	AND def_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the bom_item_subst table.
	UPDATE bom_item_subst
	SET def_lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE parent_item_id = @in_item_id
	AND def_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the job_bom table.
	UPDATE job_bom
	SET def_lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND def_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

	--Rename old lot no to a new lot no in the job_bom_subst table.
	UPDATE job_bom_subst
	SET def_lot_no = @in_new_lot_no
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	AND def_lot_no = @in_old_lot_no

END

		,@wo_id                   NVARCHAR(160)
