		,@batch_size              FLOAT
		,@start_qty               FLOAT
		,@reqd_qty                FLOAT
		,@target_prod_rate        FLOAT
		,@target_prod_rate_uom    INT
		,@update_inventory        LOGICAL
		,@inv_unique_by_job       LOGICAL
		,@run_ent_name            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@run_ent_site_name       NVARCHAR(160)
		,@reas_desc               NVARCHAR(160)
		,@reas_grp_desc           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@from_ent_name           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@from_ent_site_name      NVARCHAR(160)
		,@from_lot_no             NVARCHAR(160)
		,@fg_lot_no				  NVARCHAR(160)
		,@from_sublot_no          NVARCHAR(160)
		,@fg_sublot_no			  NVARCHAR(160)
		,@genealogy_id            NVARCHAR(508)
		,@upstream_event_id       NVARCHAR(160)
		,@segment_requirement_id  NVARCHAR(160)
		,@segment_response_id     NVARCHAR(160)
		,@subsegment_id           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@qty_cons                FLOAT
		,@cons_qty_uom            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@user_id                 NVARCHAR(160)
		,@comments                NVARCHAR(508)
		,@time_zone_bias_value    INT
		,@dummy                   INT
		,@dummy2                  INT
		,@last_edit_at            TDATETIME
		,@item_uom_id             INT
		,@item_uom_desc           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@reported_uom_id         INT
		,@factor                  FLOAT
		,@offset                  FLOAT
		,@reas_cd                 INT

		,@cur_seq_no              INT
		,@cur_state_cd            INT
		,@cur_item_id             NVARCHAR(160)
		,@display_seq             INT
		,@run_ent_id              INT
		,@deviation_above         FLOAT
		,@deviation_below         FLOAT
		,@cur_run_ent_id          INT
		,@cur_job_pos             INT

		,@temp_wo_id              NVARCHAR(160)
		,@temp_oper_id            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@temp_seq_no             INT
		,@current_subst           INT
		,@alt_no                  INT
		,@warning_message         NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@error_message			  NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@prod_item				  NVARCHAR(160)
		,@bom_pos				  INT
		,@extended_cons_attrs     NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@event_name            NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@personnel_list        NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@serial_no_list        NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@grp_desc              NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@event_time_utc		DATETIME
		,@event_time_local		DATETIME
		,@tz_temp				INT32


SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
    SELECT @item_class_id = @in_item_class_id
		,@item_id = @in_item_id
		,@production_schedule_id = @in_production_schedule_id
		,@wo_id = @in_wo_id
	    ,@oper_id = @in_oper_id
        ,@batch_size = COALESCE(@in_batch_size, 1)
	    ,@start_qty = COALESCE(@in_start_qty, 0)
	    ,@reqd_qty = COALESCE(@in_reqd_qty, 0)
        ,@target_prod_rate = COALESCE(@in_target_prod_rate, 1)
	    ,@target_prod_rate_uom = COALESCE(@in_target_prod_rate_uom, 0)
	    ,@update_inventory = COALESCE(@in_update_inventory, 0)
	    ,@inv_unique_by_job = COALESCE(@in_inv_unique_by_job, 0)
	    ,@run_ent_name = @in_run_ent_name
	    ,@run_ent_site_name = @in_run_ent_site_name
	    ,@reas_desc = @in_reas_desc
	    ,@reas_grp_desc = @in_reas_grp_desc
	    ,@from_ent_name = @in_from_ent_name
	    ,@from_ent_site_name = @in_from_ent_site_name
	    ,@from_lot_no = @in_from_lot_no
		,@fg_lot_no = @in_fg_lot_no
	    ,@from_sublot_no = @in_from_sublot_no
		,@fg_sublot_no = @in_fg_sublot_no
	    ,@genealogy_id = @in_genealogy_id
	    ,@upstream_event_id = @in_upstream_event_id
	    ,@segment_requirement_id = @in_segment_requirement_id
	    ,@segment_response_id = @in_segment_response_id
	    ,@subsegment_id = @in_subsegment_id
	    ,@qty_cons = COALESCE(@in_qty_cons, 0)
	    ,@cons_qty_uom = @in_cons_qty_uom
	    ,@user_id = @in_user_id
	    ,@comments = @in_comments
		,@extended_cons_attrs = @in_extended_cons_attrs
		,@event_time_local = @in_event_time_local
		,@event_name  =  @in_event_name
		,@personnel_list  =  @in_personnel_list
		,@serial_no_list  =	 @in_serial_no_list
		,@grp_desc		=    @in_grp_desc
	    ,@time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value


		-- Get local utc time
		EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @event_time_utc OUTPUT, @event_time_local OUTPUT, @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT

		SELECT	@event_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @event_time_local )
			,	@event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @event_time_utc )


    --Veify whether the supplied run on entity exist in the database.
	SELECT @run_ent_id = dbo.FN_GETENTITYID(@run_ent_name, @run_ent_site_name)

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('An entity with the supplied entity ID does not exist.{5775}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	IF (@in_batch_size IS NULL AND @in_target_prod_rate IS NULL AND @in_target_prod_rate_uom IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE
			je.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
			je.job_pos = 0 AND
			je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND
			je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL AND
			je.cur_seq_no IS NOT NULL
			)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				@batch_size = jb.batch_size,
				@target_prod_rate = jb.est_prod_rate,
				@target_prod_rate_uom = jb.prod_uom,
				@item_id = COALESCE(@item_id,jb.item_id)
			FROM
				job jb WITH (NOLOCK) inner join  job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) on
				jb.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id
				AND jb.oper_id =  je.cur_oper_id
                AND jb.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
			WHERE
				je.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
				je.job_pos = 0
		END
    END

    IF (@item_id IS NULL)
		--Default the item_id from system _attribute
		SELECT @item_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 403

    IF (@item_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the item does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},item_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether we have a valid work order ID
    IF (@wo_id IS NULL)
        --Default the wo_id from system _attribute
        SELECT @wo_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 400

    IF (@wo_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the item does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},wo_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether we have a valid operation id
    IF (@oper_id IS NULL)
        --Default the oper_id from system _attribute
        SELECT @oper_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 401

    IF (@oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the item does not exist in the database.
        RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},oper_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    IF (@user_id IS NOT NULL)
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
		SET @user_id = NULL

    --Verify whether we have a valid user ID
    IF (@user_id IS NULL)
        --Default the user_id from system _attribute
        SELECT @user_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199

    IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the user does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},user_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	SELECT @dummy = COUNT(*)
    FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
    WHERE ir.reas_desc = @reas_desc
      AND (irg.reas_grp_desc = @reas_grp_desc OR @reas_grp_desc IS NULL)

	IF (@dummy > 1) BEGIN
        RAISERROR ('The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},reason group,to identify the production reason', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
    FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
    WHERE ir.reas_desc = @reas_desc
      AND (irg.reas_grp_desc = @reas_grp_desc OR @reas_grp_desc IS NULL)

	IF (COALESCE(@reas_cd, -1) = -1)
		--Default the reas_desc from system _attribute
		SELECT @reas_cd = CAST(sa.attr_value AS INT) FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sa.attr_id = 215

	--Verify whether the supplied item_id exist in the databae.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id)
        --The supplied item exist in the database.
		SELECT @item_uom_id = i.uom_id FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id
	ELSE BEGIN
         --The supplied item_id does not exist in the database.
	    IF (@item_class_id IS NULL)
		    --Default the item_class_id from the system_attr table.
		    SELECT @item_class_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 402

	    --Raise an error if item_class_id cannot be found.
	    IF (@item_class_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		    RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},item_class_id', 16, 1)
		    RETURN
	    END

		--Verify whether this item_class already exist or not.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_class ic WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE ic.item_class_id = @item_class_id)
			--Item class does not exist, crate a new item_class.
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Class @item_class_id=@item_class_id, @item_class_desc=@item_class_id,
				@produced=1, @consumed=1, @obsolete=0, @purchased=0, @sold=0, @lot_no_format=NULL,
				@last_lot_no=NULL, @sublot_no_format=NULL, @last_sublot_no=NULL, @serial_no_lvl=-1,
				@inv_unique_by_job=0, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL,
				@last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

		IF (@cons_qty_uom IS NULL)
            --Default the item_class_id from the system_attr table.
			SELECT @cons_qty_uom = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 404

        --Raise an error if the UOM id is not found.
        IF (@cons_qty_uom IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},prod_qty_uom', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether this item_class already exist or not.
		SELECT @item_uom_id = um.uom_id FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE um.description = @cons_qty_uom

		IF (@item_uom_id IS NULL)
			--UOM does not exist, create a new UOM.
			EXEC sp_I_Uom @description=@cons_qty_uom, @abbreviation=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
                    @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at, @uom_id=@item_uom_id OUTPUT

        --Create a new item.
		EXEC sp_I_Item @item_id=@item_id, @item_desc=@item_id,
            @item_class_id=@item_class_id, @uom_id=@item_uom_id,
            @template=0, @lifetime=NULL, @unit_cost=NULL, @obsolete=0, @purchased=0, @sold=0, @num_decimals=2,
            @must_complete_steps=0, @must_prod_reqd_qty=0, @min_grade=NULL, @min_state=NULL, @min_inv_level=NULL,
            @reorder_amt=NULL, @auto_reorder=0, @lot_no_format=NULL, @last_lot_no=NULL, @max_lot_size=NULL,
            @sublot_no_format=NULL, @last_sublot_no=NULL, @serial_no_lvl=-1, @max_sublot_size=NULL,
            @max_order_size=NULL, @min_trace_inv=NULL, @inv_unique_by_job=@inv_unique_by_job,
            @notes=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
            @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT
    END

    --Verify whether the supplied quantities are reported in the native UOM,
    --if not verify whether we have a conversion factor availble to convert the quantities reported from the current units to native units.
    IF (@cons_qty_uom IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE um.description = @cons_qty_uom) BEGIN
			SET @error_message = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},prod_qty_uom:' + @cons_qty_uom
			RAISERROR (@error_message, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

        --A uom is reported for production
		SELECT @reported_uom_id = um.uom_id
		FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE um.description = @cons_qty_uom

		--Verify whether the supplied uom and the item's uom are the same.
		IF (@item_uom_id <> @reported_uom_id) BEGIN
			--They're different.  Verify whether we have a conversion factor to convert them into native units.
            SELECT TOP 1 @factor = uc.factor, @offset = uc.offset
            FROM uom_conv uc WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE uc.from_uom_id = @reported_uom_id
              AND uc.to_uom_id = @item_uom_id
              AND (uc.item_id = @item_id OR uc.item_id IS NULL)
            ORDER BY item_id DESC

			IF (@factor IS NULL OR @offset IS NULL) BEGIN
				SELECT @item_uom_desc = um.description FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE um.uom_id = @item_uom_id

				SET @error_message = 'A conversion factor does not exist in the database to convert from %1 to %2{9999},' + @cons_qty_uom + ',' + @item_uom_desc
				RAISERROR (@error_message, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			--Convert the quantities to native units of this item.
			SET @qty_cons = (@qty_cons * @factor) + @offset
		END
    END

    --Verify whether a job exists.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	         WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND (j.batch_size = @batch_size OR @batch_size IS NULL)
			  AND (j.est_prod_rate = @target_prod_rate OR @target_prod_rate IS NULL)
			  AND (j.prod_uom = @target_prod_rate_uom OR @target_prod_rate_uom IS NULL))

			--Get the job that has the same work order, operation, batch size, production rate and production uom.
			--If any of this differs, then a new job ought to be created.
			SELECT TOP 1 @cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND (j.batch_size = @batch_size OR @batch_size IS NULL)
			  AND (j.est_prod_rate = @target_prod_rate OR @target_prod_rate IS NULL)
			  AND (j.prod_uom = @target_prod_rate_uom OR @target_prod_rate_uom IS NULL)
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @prod_item = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 403

        IF (@item_class_id IS NOT NULL)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_class WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE item_class_id = @item_class_id)
            SET @item_class_id = NULL

         --The supplied item_id does not exist in the database.
	    IF (@item_class_id IS NULL)
		    --Default the item_class_id from the system_attr table.
		    SELECT @item_class_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 402

	    --Raise an error if item_class_id cannot be found.
	    IF (@item_class_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		    RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},item_class_id', 16, 1)
		    RETURN
	    END

        --Verify whether this item_class already exist or not.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_class ic WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE ic.item_class_id = @item_class_id)
			--Item class does not exist, crate a new item_class.
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Class @item_class_id=@item_class_id, @item_class_desc=@item_class_id,
				@produced=1, @consumed=1, @obsolete=0, @purchased=0, @sold=0, @lot_no_format=NULL,
				@last_lot_no=NULL, @sublot_no_format=NULL, @last_sublot_no=NULL, @serial_no_lvl=-1,
				@inv_unique_by_job=0, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL,
				@last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item i WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @prod_item)
			--Create a new item.
			EXEC sp_I_Item @item_id=@prod_item, @item_desc=@prod_item,
				@item_class_id=@item_class_id, @uom_id=@item_uom_id,
				@template=0, @lifetime=NULL, @unit_cost=NULL, @obsolete=0, @purchased=0, @sold=0, @num_decimals=2,
				@must_complete_steps=0, @must_prod_reqd_qty=0, @min_grade=NULL, @min_state=NULL, @min_inv_level=NULL,
				@reorder_amt=NULL, @auto_reorder=0, @lot_no_format=NULL, @last_lot_no=NULL, @max_lot_size=NULL,
				@sublot_no_format=NULL, @last_sublot_no=NULL, @serial_no_lvl=-1, @max_sublot_size=NULL,
				@max_order_size=NULL, @min_trace_inv=NULL, @inv_unique_by_job=@inv_unique_by_job,
				@notes=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
				@last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

		--There is no such job exist with this configuration. Create new job.
		--Verify whether we have a work order.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
            --The work order does not exist, create a new work order.
			EXEC sp_I_Wo @wo_id=@wo_id, @wo_desc=@wo_id,
                    @process_id=NULL, @bom_ver_id=NULL, @spec_ver_id=NULL, @item_id=@item_id,
                    @req_qty=0, @release_time_local=NULL,@release_time_tz=NULL, @req_finish_time_local=NULL,@req_finish_time_tz=NULL, @state_cd=1, @wo_priority=NULL,
                    @cust_info=NULL, @mo_id=NULL, @production_schedule_id=@in_production_schedule_id,
                    @notes=NULL, @not_deletable=0, @disassembly=0, @may_override_route=0, @override_serialization=0,
                    @input_wo_id=NULL, @input_oper_id=NULL, @input_seq_no=NULL,
                    @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
                    @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value,
                    @mod_id=@error_message OUTPUT

		SELECT @deviation_above = CAST(sa.attr_value AS FLOAT) FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 103

		SELECT @deviation_below = CAST(sa.attr_value AS FLOAT) FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 104

		SELECT @deviation_above = COALESCE(@deviation_above, 0), @deviation_below = COALESCE(@deviation_below, 0)

		--Get the next highest sequence number
        SELECT @cur_seq_no = MAX(j.seq_no), @display_seq = MAX(j.display_seq)
        FROM job j WITH (UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK)
        WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND j.oper_id = @oper_id

		SELECT @cur_seq_no = COALESCE(@cur_seq_no, -1) + 1, @display_seq = COALESCE(@display_seq, -1) + 1

		--Create a new job.
        EXEC sp_I_Job  @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
              @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @job_desc=@oper_id,
              @item_id=@prod_item, @state_cd=2, @job_priority=1, @req_finish_time_local=NULL,
              @req_finish_time_tz = NULL,@init_sched_ent_id=@run_ent_id, @target_sched_ent_id=@run_ent_id,
              @run_ent_id=NULL, @qty_reqd=@reqd_qty, @qty_prod=0, @qty_prod_erp=0, @qty_rejected=0, @qty_rejected_erp=0,
              @qty_at_start=@start_qty, @deviation_above=@deviation_above,
              @deviation_below=@deviation_below, @batch_size=@batch_size,
              @first_job=0, @final_job=0, @sched_pinned=0, @check_inv=0, @est_fixed_lab=NULL, @est_lab_rate=NULL,
              @est_setup_time=NULL, @est_teardown_time=NULL, @est_prod_rate=@target_prod_rate,
              @prod_uom=@target_prod_rate_uom, @est_transfer_time=NULL, @sched_start_time_local=NULL, @sched_start_time_tz=NULL,
              @latest_start_time_local=NULL, @latest_start_time_tz=NULL, @sched_finish_time_local=NULL, @sched_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @act_start_time_local=NULL, @act_start_time_tz=NULL, @act_finish_time_local=NULL, @act_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @concurrent_link=0, @job_cost=NULL, @parent_contingent_job=NULL, @child_contingent_job=NULL, @notes=NULL,
              @assoc_file=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @display_seq=@display_seq,
              @folder_ver_id=NULL, @rework=0, @rework_cd=NULL, @rework_process_id=NULL,
              @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
              @time_zone_bias_value=NULL,
              @create_job_bom=1, @edit_time=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

		--Update the BOM flags.
        IF (@update_inventory = 1)
            UPDATE job_bom SET update_inv = 1
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
              AND oper_id = @oper_id
              AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
              AND bom_pos = 0
	END

    --Verify whether the current item is the job BOM 0 item, If this is not the job BOM 0 item, create this as a substitute item, and set the current production as the substitute item.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND jb.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
          AND jb.bom_pos > 0
          AND jb.item_id = @item_id)

        SELECT @bom_pos = jb.bom_pos
        FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND jb.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
          AND jb.bom_pos > 0
          AND jb.item_id = @item_id
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Get the next available highest BOM position
		SELECT @bom_pos = MAX(jb.bom_pos)
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK)
        WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND jb.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
          AND jb.bom_pos > 0

		SET @bom_pos = COALESCE(@bom_pos, 0) + 1;

		--Create a new BOM item
        EXEC sp_I_Job_Bom @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
            @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @item_id=@item_id, @reqd_grade_cd=NULL,
            @instruction=NULL, @qty_per_parent_item=1, @max_qty_per_parent_item=NULL, @min_qty_per_parent_item=NULL,
            @reqd_start_val=0, @reqd_start_val_is_pct=0, @update_inv=@update_inventory,
            @backflush=0, @def_reas_cd=NULL, @def_lot_no=NULL, @def_sublot_no=NULL, @def_storage_ent_id=NULL, @def_reject_ent_id=NULL,
            @scaling_factor=NULL, @must_consume_from_inv=0, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc=1, @may_create_new_lots=1,
            @must_consume_from_wip=0, @must_consume_before_prod=0, @constant_qty=0, @est_time=NULL,
			@current_subst=NULL, @qty_reqd=NULL, @serial_no_source=NULL,
            @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @mod_id=@error_message OUTPUT
	END


    --Verify whether this job is running on any entity.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND je.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no)

        SELECT @cur_run_ent_id = je.ent_id, @cur_job_pos = je.job_pos
        FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
          AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
          AND je.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	ELSE BEGIN
		--This job is NOT currently running on any entity.
		--Verify whether we have enough job positions to start this job.
		SELECT @cur_job_pos = MIN(je.job_pos)
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id
		  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NULL

		SET @cur_job_pos = COALESCE(@cur_job_pos, -1)

		IF (@cur_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
			--We don't have enough job positions on this entity.
			--Stop the oldest running job on this entity.
            SELECT @temp_wo_id = j.wo_id, @temp_oper_id = j.oper_id, @temp_seq_no = j.seq_no,
					@cur_job_pos = je.job_pos
            FROM
                (SELECT MIN(j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time_utc
                FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
                WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id) min_job
            INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.act_start_time_utc = min_job.act_start_time_utc
            INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
            WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id

            --Pause the identified job.
			EXEC SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ENDBATCHJOBS @ent_id=@run_ent_id,
                        @wo_id=@temp_wo_id, @oper_id=@temp_oper_id,
                        @seq_no=@temp_seq_no, @job_pos=@cur_job_pos,
                        @status_notes=NULL, @user_id=NULL,
                        @check_privs=0, @check_certs=NULL, @client_type=NULL, @no_propogation=NULL,
                        @check_auto_job_start=0, @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
                        @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
	END

	IF (@cur_run_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @cur_job_pos = NULL
		--Get the available job position.
		SELECT @cur_job_pos = MIN(je.job_pos)
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id
		  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NULL

		SET @cur_job_pos = COALESCE(@cur_job_pos, -1)

		--This job is not currently running.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id,
            @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id,
            @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
            @job_pos=@cur_job_pos, @status_notes=NULL,
            @check_privs=0, @check_certs=0, @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
            @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @run_ent_id = @cur_run_ent_id

        --Get the entity_name
		SELECT @run_ent_name = e.ent_name, @run_ent_site_name = ste.site_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        --ID of ancestor entity that defines site of this entity if = ent_id, this entity is a site.
        --Null for entities above sites, or for single-site systems
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.site = site_ent.ent_id
        --Name of this site
		LEFT OUTER JOIN site ste WITH (NOLOCK) ON ste.ent_id = site_ent.ent_id
		WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id
    END

	--Verify whether the request is to start a subsegment or to add a production.
    IF (@qty_cons <> 0) BEGIN
		--Delegate to add prod to add production
		EXEC sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsByName @session_id=@in_session_id,
			@event_time_local=@event_time_local,
            @user_id=@user_id, @ent_name=@run_ent_name,
            @site_name=@run_ent_site_name, @job_pos=@cur_job_pos,
            @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @qty_cons=@qty_cons, @reas_cd=@reas_cd,
            @lot_no=@from_lot_no, @fg_lot_no=@fg_lot_no,
			@sublot_no=@from_sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no,
            @from_ent_name=@from_ent_name, @from_site_name=@from_ent_site_name,
            @item_id=@item_id,
            @ext_ref=NULL, @apply_scaling_factor=0, @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id,
            @upstream_event_id=@upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id=@segment_requirement_id,
            @segment_response_id=@segment_response_id, @comments=@comments,
            @spare1=@in_spare1, @spare2=@in_spare2,
            @spare3=@in_spare3, @spare4=@in_spare4,
            @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT
	END

	--Log Job Event and EPA data.
    EXEC SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ADDPEMDATA @event_type='Material Consumed Actual', @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
        @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
        @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@from_lot_no, @sublot_no=@from_sublot_no,
        @ent_name=@run_ent_name, @site_name=@run_ent_site_name,
        @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id, @segment_requirement_id=@segment_requirement_id,
        @segment_response_id=@segment_response_id, @subsegment_id=@subsegment_id,
        @quantity=@in_qty_cons, @item_uom=@in_cons_qty_uom, @comments=@comments,
        @production_schedule_id=@production_schedule_id, @location_name=@from_ent_name,
        @location_site_name=@from_ent_site_name, @personnel_list=@personnel_list,
        @serial_no_list=@serial_no_list, @event_name=@event_name,
        @equipment_id=NULL, @grp_desc= @grp_desc, @extended_attrs=@extended_cons_attrs,
        @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @ref_row_id=@row_id,@material_type=NULL,
		@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Insert_Resource_Group]
(
@user_name nvarchar(50),
@res_grp_id int,
@res_grp_desc nvarchar(50),
@loc_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.res_grp with (nolock) where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
		if @rowCount = 0 
		begin
			insert into SDB.SCH.res_grp (res_grp_id,res_grp_desc,loc_id,last_edit_by) VALUES (@res_grp_id,@res_grp_desc,@loc_id,@user_name)

		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to add Reason Group: ' , @res_grp_desc)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_I_ofi_SU_Silo_Attribute
-- Description:  Update Silo Attribute For inpout Output and quality
--
-- Usage:  
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  DS           2022-08-17    Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_SU_Silo_Attribute] (
	@ent_id INT = NULL
	,@lockForInput FLOAT = NULL
	,@lockForOutput FLOAT = NULL
	,@lockForQuality FLOAT = NULL
	,@last_comment NVARCHAR(MAX)
	
	
	)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Get the storage unit status of selected storage unit   
	DECLARE @inputattr_val INT
		,@outputattr_val INT
		,@qualityattr_val INT
		,@lckinupt FLOAT
		,@lckoutput FLOAT
		,@lckquality FLOAT
		
		



	IF (
			@lockForInput IS NULL
			OR @lockForInput = ''
			)
		SET @lckinupt = 0

	IF (
			@lockForOutput IS NULL
			OR @lockForOutput = ''
			)
		SET @lckoutput = 0

	IF (
			@lockForQuality IS NULL
			OR @lockForQuality = ''
			)
		SET @lckquality = 0
	SET @inputattr_val = (
			SELECT j.attr_id
			FROM attr i WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_attr j WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.attr_id = j.attr_id
			WHERE i.attr_desc = 'LockForInput'
				AND ent_id = @ent_id
			)
	SET @outputattr_val = (
			SELECT j.attr_id
			FROM attr i WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_attr j WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.attr_id = j.attr_id
			WHERE i.attr_desc = 'LockForOutput'
				AND ent_id = @ent_id
			)
	SET @qualityattr_val = (
			SELECT j.attr_id
			FROM attr i WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_attr j WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.attr_id = j.attr_id
			WHERE i.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
				AND ent_id = @ent_id
			)

	BEGIN
		UPDATE ent_attr
		SET attr_value = @lockForInput
			,last_edit_comment = @last_comment
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			AND attr_id = @inputattr_val

		UPDATE ent_attr
		SET attr_value = @lockForOutput
			,last_edit_comment = @last_comment
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			AND attr_id = @outputattr_val

		UPDATE ent_attr
		SET attr_value = @lockForQuality
			,last_edit_comment = @last_comment
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			AND attr_id = @qualityattr_val

			 -------------Audit Trail------------------
	  BEGIN TRY
	  BEGIN
	   --Print 'Lavkesh'
		 DECLARE @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
		  ,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'INV_SUSTATE'
             ,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
             ,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'EDIT'
			 ,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = 'Storage Unit State change'
			 ,@iRowId  int
			 ,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Storage Unit State'
			 ,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			 ,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			-- select @from_row_id as lkDate
			
			declare @rowid int,@last_edit_by nvarchar(50),@ent_desc nvarchar(50);
			select @rowid=row_id,@last_edit_by=last_edit_by from ent_attr with(nolock) where attr_id=@inputattr_val and ent_id= @ent_id
			select @ent_desc=description from ent with(nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id

		 DELETE from @auditTrailParameters
		 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters(row_id, field_name, field_value)values(@rowid,'@ent_id',@ent_desc)
		 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters(row_id, field_name, field_value)values(@rowid,'@LockForInput',@lockForInput)
		 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters(row_id, field_name, field_value)values(@rowid,'@LockForOutput',@lockForOutput)
		 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters(row_id, field_name, field_value)values(@rowid,'@BlockForQuality',@lockForQuality)
		 
		-- select @strFunctionName as fun,@strModuleName as module,@strActivityMsg as cmt

		-- select *from @auditTrailParameters
		 EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
											,@function_id = @strFunctionName
											,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
											,@keyField1 = NULL
											,@keyField2 = NULL
											,@keyField3 = NULL
											,@keyField4 = NULL
											,@keyField5 = NULL
											,@user_id = @last_edit_by
											,@activity = @strActivityMsg
											,@audit_category = 'Info'
											,@comments = @strCommentMsg

		END
	  END TRY
	  BEGIN CATCH
		--print 'Error on audit'
		--set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
		--select @resultcode
	  END CATCH;

			
			
			
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Class_Attr]
(@item_class_id  nvarchar(40),
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Class_Attr
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	    Changes
-- 09/10/2002	  Raghu		    1.4	    Get only non-obsolete items
-- 09/15/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006	  Raghu		    3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 01/18/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 4

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

  SELECT item_class_attr.item_class_id
            ,item_class_attr.attr_id
            ,item_class.item_class_desc
            ,item_class_attr.attr_value
            ,item_class_attr.notes
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,item_class_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,item_class_attr.last_edit_by
            ,item_class_attr.last_edit_at
  FROM item_class_attr item_class_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN item_class item_class WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_class_attr.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id
  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_class_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((item_class_attr.item_class_id = @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_class_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_class_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (item_class.obsolete = 0) AND
       (item_class_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (item_class_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY item_class.item_class_desc, attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_irgel_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[item_reas_grp_ent_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_irgel_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_reas_grp_ent_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cert_Type]
(
	@cert_name				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@max_level				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@duration				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@audit					LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_oper			LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_oper_step		LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_prod_item		LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_cons_item		LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_attr			LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_grade_chg		LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_state_chg		LOGICAL = 0
,	@avail_to_log_data		LOGICAL = 0
,	@up_to_experimental		LOGICAL = 0
,	@up_to_approved			LOGICAL = 0
,	@up_to_certified		LOGICAL = 0
,	@down_to_disabled		LOGICAL = 0
,	@down_to_experimental	LOGICAL = 0
,	@down_to_approved		LOGICAL = 0
,	@spare1					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare2					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare3					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare4					STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-	10/21/2002
-- Version						- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 07/03/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000.
-- 11/01/2007		AML				3.4.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT	cert_type.cert_name
		,	cert_type.max_level
		,	cert_type.duration
		,	cert_type.cert_audit
		,	cert_type.signoff_notes
		,	cert_type.num_signoffs_reqd
		,	cert_type.reqd_exp_to_renew
		,	cert_type.comments_reqd
		,	cert_type.avail_to_oper
		,	cert_type.avail_to_oper_step
		,	cert_type.avail_to_prod_item
		,	cert_type.avail_to_cons_item
		,	cert_type.avail_to_attr
		,	cert_type.avail_to_grade_chg
		,	cert_type.avail_to_state_chg
		,	cert_type.avail_to_log_data
		,	cert_type.up_to_experimental
		,	cert_type.up_to_approved
		,	cert_type.up_to_certified
		,	cert_type.down_to_disabled
		,	cert_type.down_to_experimental
		,	cert_type.down_to_approved
		,	cert_type.spare1
		,	cert_type.spare2
		,	cert_type.spare3
		,	cert_type.spare4
		,	cert_type.last_edit_comment
		,	cert_type.last_edit_by
		,	cert_type.last_edit_at
	FROM cert_type WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (
			(cert_type.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.max_level = @max_level OR @max_level IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.duration = @duration OR @duration IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.cert_audit = ABS(@audit) OR @audit IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_oper = ABS(@avail_to_oper) OR @avail_to_oper IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_oper_step = ABS(@avail_to_oper_step) OR @avail_to_oper_step IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_prod_item = ABS(@avail_to_prod_item) OR @avail_to_prod_item IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_cons_item = ABS(@avail_to_cons_item) OR @avail_to_cons_item IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_attr = ABS(@avail_to_attr) OR @avail_to_attr IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_grade_chg = ABS(@avail_to_grade_chg) OR @avail_to_grade_chg IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_state_chg = ABS(@avail_to_state_chg) OR @avail_to_state_chg IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.avail_to_log_data = ABS(@avail_to_log_data) OR @avail_to_log_data IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.up_to_experimental = ABS(@up_to_experimental) OR @up_to_experimental IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.up_to_approved = ABS(@up_to_approved) OR @up_to_approved IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.up_to_certified = ABS(@up_to_certified) OR @up_to_certified IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.down_to_disabled = @down_to_disabled OR @down_to_disabled IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.down_to_experimental = @down_to_experimental OR @down_to_experimental IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.down_to_approved = @down_to_approved OR @down_to_approved IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(cert_type.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
	ORDER BY cert_type.cert_name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_BOM_Item_Oper_Link_Chk]
(
	@V_Item NVARCHAR(40),
	@first_oper_id NVARCHAR(40),
	@process_id STRING40,
	@V_Status CHAR(1) OUTPUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK_CHK
-- Description	      - This procedure is used to check if already any item uptree/downtree of the current item's BOM is
--                    - existing for this process for this operation to make sure that only one BOM_POS = 0 record exists
-- Author	      - Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created	      - 12/12/2002
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver    Changes
-- 02/24/2005     SJ            2115   Changes made to always return a non-null @V_Status value
-- 03/24/2005     SJ            2117 - Exit condition for #tmp_bom_item0 changed
-- 02/06/2006     SJ            3109 - If item does not have preferred BOM exit unconditionally
-- 04/16/2014	  Abhay Pandey	4.5	 - Changed all the cursor types from LOCAL to FAST_FORWARD, Added WITH(NOLOCK) with
--									   SELECT statements & Introduced indices on temporary tables(in order to improve perf)
--07/11/2014	Mohammed Asgar	4.6	 - Merge CR L00131387 for the HF CR 130954. Changed all the cursor types from LOCAL to FAST_FORWARD,
--									   Added WITH(NOLOCK) with SELECT statements & introduced indices on temporary tables(in order to improve perf)
-- 03/17/2016	Abhay Pandey	5.03	US #608705 : Merge L00140435 (HF CR L00140150: After upgrade: Creating a BOM on a item that has already have BOM fails. Cursor already exists):
--										Changed the scope of the cursor 'cur_item_process' and others to LOCAL in order to fix the issue(cursor already exists) for the DB having settings as Default Cursor = GLOBAL.
-- 06/05/2017   Srinivasa Tentu 6.0     HF Merge L00145121 (HF CR L00144751) Closed and deallocated the cursor before return.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @V_Bom_Ver                 STRING40,
  @V_Count                   INT,
  @V_Sub_Item                NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Sub_Ver                 STRING40,
  @V_Sub_Bom_Pos             INT,
  @V_Sub_Oper                STRING40,
  @V_Item0                   NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Id0                     NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Ver0                    NVARCHAR(40),
  @parent_item_id            NVARCHAR(40),
  @V_Item_Id                 NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
  SET @V_Count = 0
  SET @parent_item_id = @V_Item

  CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), bom_pos INT, oper_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
  CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IDX_C_tmp_bom_item_parent_item_id ON #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id)
  CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
  CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IDX_C_tmp_bom_item0_parent_item_id ON #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id)
  --If more than one items are present in the process
  DECLARE cur_item_process CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT item_id  FROM item_process_link a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id
  OPEN cur_item_process
  FETCH cur_item_process INTO @parent_item_id
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    SELECT @V_Bom_Ver = ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND preferred_ver = 1
    --Exit unconditionally if preferred BOM not found
    IF @V_Bom_Ver IS NULL
	BEGIN

	 -- Close and deallocate the cursor before return
	  CLOSE cur_item_process
	  DEALLOCATE cur_item_process

	  --Drop the temporary tables used
      DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item
      DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0

      RETURN
	END

    INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, status) VALUES(@parent_item_id, @parent_item_id, @V_Bom_Ver, 0)
    DECLARE cur_item0 CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id, item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0
    OPEN cur_item0
    FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE #tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item0 AND item_id = @V_Id0
      INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, status)
        SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.item_id, b.ver_id, 0 FROM bom_item a WITH(NOLOCK), bom_ver b WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.item_id = b.parent_item_id
          AND a.parent_item_id = @V_Id0 AND b.preferred_ver = 1 AND item_id <> @V_Id0
      FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
    END
    CLOSE cur_item0
    DEALLOCATE cur_item0

    INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
      VALUES(@parent_item_id, @parent_item_id, @V_Bom_Ver, 0, @first_oper_id, 0)
    WHILE @V_Count = 0
    BEGIN
      --Recursively get into item-subitems
      DECLARE cur_sub_item CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id FROM #tmp_bom_item
        WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND status = 0
      OPEN cur_sub_item
      FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      BEGIN
        UPDATE #tmp_bom_item SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND ver_id = @V_Sub_Ver
          AND bom_pos = @V_Sub_Bom_Pos AND oper_id = @V_Sub_Oper
        SET @V_Count = 1
        IF @V_Sub_Item = @parent_item_id
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
            SELECT @parent_item_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @first_oper_id, 0 FROM bom_item a WITH(NOLOCK), bom_item_oper_link b WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos AND b.oper_id = @first_oper_id
                AND b.process_id = @process_id AND a.parent_item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0) AND a.item_id <> @parent_item_id
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item(parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status)
            SELECT @parent_item_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @first_oper_id, 0 FROM bom_item a WITH(NOLOCK), bom_item_oper_link b WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
                AND b.oper_id = @first_oper_id AND a.parent_item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND a.item_id <> @V_Sub_Item
        END
        FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
      END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS
      CLOSE cur_sub_item
      DEALLOCATE cur_sub_item
      IF @V_Count = 1
        SET @V_Count = 0
      ELSE
        SET @V_Count = 1
    END  --End of @v_Count = 0
    --Checking upstream in the process
    SET @V_Item_Id = NULL
    SELECT TOP 1 @V_Item_Id = item_id FROM item_process_link WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id IN
      (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE bom_pos = 0 AND item_id <> @V_Item)
      AND item_id IN (SELECT parent_item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE item_id = @V_Item)
    IF @V_Item_Id = @parent_item_id
    BEGIN
      IF @V_Item_Id IS NOT NULL OR (@V_Item_Id IS NULL AND 1=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_process_link WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id))
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Status = 'Y'       --        'up tree item already present, delete
        DELETE FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @V_Bom_Ver
          AND bom_pos = 0 AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @first_oper_id
      END
    END
--    print @parent_item_id +' '+@V_Item+' '+ISNULL(@V_Item_Id, 0)
    IF @V_Item_Id IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_process_link WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id)>1
    BEGIN
      --Check downstream in the process
      SELECT TOP 1 @V_Item_Id = item_id FROM item_process_link a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id
        AND item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 b WHERE a.item_id = b.item_id AND parent_item_id <> item_id AND item_id <> @V_Item)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE item_id = @V_Item)
      IF @V_Item_Id IS NOT NULL
        SET @V_Status = 'N'
      ELSE  -- SJ 02/25/2005
        SET @V_Status = 'Y'  -- SJ 02/25/2005
    END
    --Drop the temporary tables used
    DELETE #tmp_bom_item
    DELETE #tmp_bom_item0

    FETCH cur_item_process INTO @parent_item_id
  END
  CLOSE cur_item_process
  DEALLOCATE cur_item_process

  --Drop the temporary tables used
  DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item
  DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0
END  --End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Bottleneck_History]
  (@line_id int32,
   @ent_id int32,
   @start_time_utc tdatetime)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_S_Bottleneck_History
-- Description	      - Gets the specified bottleneck_history record based on the supplied row_id
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [Sp_u_ofi_Pack_Additives]
-- Description: update lot details in set up UI
--
-- Defined step: "Set Lot"
-- Usage: 	
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		Ajeet	2022-12-07			Initial version.
-- 0.02		DS		2023-05-24			Changes done for Audit trail
-- 0.03		Ajeet	2023-07-10			Added condition to avoid job step insert for cake blend
-- 0.04		CK		2023-08-09			Commented 0.02 changed and implemented new Audit trail code 
-- 0.05		DS		2023-08-09			Added header and inline comments 
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_Pack_Additives] 
 @wo_id [dbo].[STRING40]
,@oper_id [dbo].[STRING40]
,@seq_no [dbo].[INT32]
,@lot_grid nvarchar(max) --@result
,@last_edit_by [dbo].[STRING40]
,@saveRecords int
,@resultset int output
,@resultcode nvarchar(250) output

AS
BEGIN

declare @step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Set Lot'


declare
			 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_SetLot'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'ADD'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@iRowId  int
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@i						INT						   =0
			,@modCnt				INT						   =0
			,@j						INT						   =0
			,@newCnt				INT						   =0
			,@k						INT						   =0
			,@delCnt				INT						   =0

DECLARE @row_cnt_au int
DECLARE @max_row_cnt_au int

DECLARE @job_bom_audit as table 
		   ([rowSeq] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			[item_id]			[dbo].[STRING80]  NULL,
			[def_lot_no]		[dbo].[STRING80]  NULL,
			[row_id]			[int],
			[last_edit_by]		[dbo].[STRING40_NULL] NULL
			)

DECLARE @job_bom_audit1 as table 
		   ([rowSeq] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			[item_id]			[dbo].[STRING80]  NULL,
			[def_lot_no]		[dbo].[STRING80]  NULL,
			[row_id]			[int],
			[last_edit_by]		[dbo].[STRING40_NULL] NULL
			)

declare  @a1_item_id		[dbo].[STRING80]
		,@a1_def_lot_no		[dbo].[STRING80]
		,@a1_last_edit_by	[dbo].[STRING40_NULL]
		,@a1_row_id			int 

declare @cte table (item_id nvarchar(40), item_desc nvarchar(40), def_lot_no nvarchar(40), last_used_lot nvarchar(40))

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

BEGIN TRY

	if(@saveRecords=1)
	BEGIN
			-- fetching the data for audit trail
			
			insert into @cte(item_id,item_desc,def_lot_no,last_used_lot)  
			SELECT item_id,item_desc,def_lot_no,last_used_lot FROM  
			 OPENJSON ( @lot_grid )  
			WITH (   
						  item_id   varchar(200) '$.item_id' ,  
						  item_desc  varchar(200)     '$.item_desc',  
						  def_lot_no varchar(200) '$.def_lot_no',  
						  last_used_lot varchar(200)          '$.last_used_lot'  
			 );

			 --select * from @cte
			 -- fetching the data for audit trail
			 insert into @job_bom_audit 
			 select item_id,def_lot_no,row_id,last_edit_by
			 from job_bom with(nolock) 
			 where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no
												and item_id in(select item_id from @cte )


			-- updating the job bom with lot number
			Update jb
				 set jb.def_lot_no = cte.def_lot_no
			FROM 
				 job_bom jb 
				 INNER JOIN @cte cte 
				 ON jb.item_id = cte.item_id and jb.wo_id=@wo_id and seq_no=@seq_no and oper_id=@oper_id
	

   
			if(@oper_id <> 'cakeblending') -- for cake blender calling the below SP
			BEGIN
				exec [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
											   @wo_id
											  ,@oper_id
											  ,@seq_no
											  ,@step_name
											  ,@step_data = 'Completed'
			END
			insert into @job_bom_audit1 
		select item_id,def_lot_no,row_id,last_edit_by
		from job_bom with(nolock) 
		where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no
										and item_id in(select item_id from @cte )

	END
		

		set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
		select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode

END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
			--	select 0 as result,ERROR_MESSAGE() as resultCode
			set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
			select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
				  
END CATCH


	--audit trail section
	
if(@saveRecords=1) -- records will be saved only when @saveRecords=1
BEGIN
BEGIN TRY
	SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.item_id)
	 
	 from @job_bom_audit t1
	 FULL OUTER JOIN @job_bom_audit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	 where (t1.item_id <> t2.item_id) OR (isnull(t1.def_lot_no,'-') <> isnull(t2.def_lot_no,'-')) OR (t1.last_edit_by <> t2.last_edit_by) 

	 while (@i < @modCnt)
	BEGIN 
	SELECT  @a1_item_id=t2.item_id
		   ,@a1_def_lot_no=t2.def_lot_no
		   ,@a1_last_edit_by=t2.last_edit_by
		   ,@a1_row_id=t2.row_id
	 from @job_bom_audit t1
	 FULL OUTER JOIN @job_bom_audit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	 where (t1.item_id <> t2.item_id) OR (isnull(t1.def_lot_no,'-') <> isnull(t2.def_lot_no,'-')) OR (t1.last_edit_by <> t2.last_edit_by)
	 order by t2.row_id
	 OFFSET @i ROWS   
	 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	 Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
	 Select @strCommentMsg ='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';
	 INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
	 (@a1_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_row_id))
	,(@a1_row_id,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_item_id))
	,(@a1_row_id,'def_lot_no',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_def_lot_no))
		  
		
		

	 EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
							,@function_id = @strFunctionName
	
							,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
							,@keyField1 = @wo_id
							,@keyField2 = @oper_id
							,@keyField3 = @seq_no
							,@keyField4 = @a1_item_id
							,@keyField5 = NULL
							,@user_id = @last_edit_by
							,@activity = @strActivityMsg
							,@audit_category = 'Info'
							,@comments = @strCommentMsg

	 SET @i = @i + 1;
	END

	-- added new record
	select @newCnt= count(t2.item_id)
	from @job_bom_audit t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @job_bom_audit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @job_bom_audit t2 )

	while (@j < @newCnt)
	 BEGIN
				 

	 SELECT @a1_item_id=t2.item_id
		   ,@a1_def_lot_no=t2.def_lot_no
		   ,@a1_last_edit_by=t2.last_edit_by
		   ,@a1_row_id=t2.row_id
	from @job_bom_audit t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @job_bom_audit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							  from @job_bom_audit t2 )
				   
				  
					   
	Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
	Select @strCommentMsg = 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
	 (@a1_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_row_id))
	,(@a1_row_id,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_item_id))
	,(@a1_row_id,'def_lot_no',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_def_lot_no))
	

		   
		   -- calling common audit trail SP
	 EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
							,@function_id = @strFunctionName
							,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
							,@keyField1 = @wo_id
							,@keyField2 = @oper_id
							,@keyField3 = @seq_no
							,@keyField4 = @a1_item_id
							,@keyField5 = NULL
							,@user_id = @last_edit_by
							,@activity = @strActivityMsg
							,@audit_category = 'Info'
							,@comments = @strCommentMsg
	SET @j = @j + 1;
	END


	 -- removed record
select @delCnt=count(t1.item_id) 
from @job_bom_audit t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @job_bom_audit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
						from @job_bom_audit1 t2 )
while (@k < @delCnt)
 BEGIN

	SELECT  @a1_item_id=t1.item_id
		   ,@a1_def_lot_no=isnull(t1.def_lot_no,'-')
		   ,@a1_last_edit_by=t1.last_edit_by
		   ,@a1_row_id=t1.row_id
	from @job_bom_audit t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @job_bom_audit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
	where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
							from @job_bom_audit1 t2 )
	order by t1.row_id
	OFFSET @k ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
	Select @strActivityMsg ='Delete'
	delete @auditTrailParameters
	Select @strCommentMsg ='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_'+' Record removed for row_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),@a1_row_id)+' By: '+@last_edit_by
	INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
							 (@a1_row_id,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),@a1_row_id))
							,(@a1_row_id,'wo_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),@wo_id))
							,(@a1_row_id,'oper_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),@oper_id))
							,(@a1_row_id,'seq_no',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no))
							,(@a1_row_id,'created_by',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg))
	
	-- calling common audit trail SP
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail 
	 @module_id = @strModuleName
	,@function_id = @strFunctionName
	,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
	,@keyField1 = @wo_id
	,@keyField2 = @oper_id
	,@keyField3 = @seq_no
	,@keyField4 = NULL
	,@keyField5 = NULL
	,@user_id = @last_edit_by
	,@activity = @strActivityMsg
	,@audit_category = 'Info'
	,@comments = @strCommentMsg

	SET @k = @k + 1;
	END
   

END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
END CATCH

END		   
	 
		 


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Lot_VerifyLotSubLotFormat]
(@in_item_id		STRING80
,@in_lot_no			STRING80
,@in_sublot_no		STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_U_LOT_VERIFYLOTSUBLOTFORMAT
-- Description          - HD# 9732, Verifies the lot_no, and sublot_no formats.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 04/23/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes
--04/30/2007        Raghu       3.2.10    HD# 9777 Do not raise an error if the lot_no format does not conform the exisiting format.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @err_str				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@item_id				STRING80
		,@item_class_id			STRING80
		,@lot_no_format			STRING80
		,@sublot_no_format		STRING80
		,@serial_no_lvl			INT32
		,@start_pos				INT32
		,@end_pos				INT32
		,@lot_no_format_temp	STRING80

BEGIN

	--Verify whether the supplied item is a valid item.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WHERE item_id = @in_item_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},item_id=' + @in_item_id
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Additionally, retrieve the lot_no_format and sublot_no_format as well.
	SELECT @item_id = item_id, @item_class_id = item_class_id, @lot_no_format = lot_no_format
		,@sublot_no_format = sublot_no_format, @serial_no_lvl = serial_no_lvl
	FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_id = @in_item_id

	--Verify the *_no_format only for the serialized items (FOR NOW).
	IF (@serial_no_lvl = -1)
		--This is not a serialized item just return.
		RETURN

	--Only verify the lot_no formats for now.
	IF (@in_sublot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		--If sublot_no is null meaning the insert is made on the lot table.
		--Verify the lot_no_format ONLY if we can successfully retrieve a format.
		IF (@lot_no_format IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--We have a lo_no format for this item. Verify whether the new lot conforms the specified format.
			--Default the temporary lot_no to the value that is supplied in.
			SET @lot_no_format_temp = @lot_no_format

			--Find whether we can successfully identify an angle bracket representing the datetime format.
			SET @start_pos = CHARINDEX('<', @lot_no_format_temp, 1)

			WHILE (@start_pos > 0) BEGIN
				--Find the ending position which represents the datetime format.
				SET @end_pos = CHARINDEX('>', @lot_no_format_temp, @start_pos)

				--Verify whether we can successfully find an ending angle bracket '>'.
				IF (@end_pos > 0) BEGIN
					--A successful starting and ending angle brackets has been found.
					--If an equivalent value from the format is not found then replace the format itself.
					IF (SUBSTRING(@in_lot_no, @start_pos, @end_pos - 1-@start_pos) IS NULL)
						--An equivalent value for a format is not found replace the format string itself.
						SET @lot_no_format_temp = SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, 1, @start_pos -1)
							+ SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, @start_pos+1, @end_pos - 1-@start_pos)
							+ SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, @end_pos + 1, LEN(@lot_no_format_temp))
					ELSE
						--Replace the datetime string with the current value from the lot_no
						SET @lot_no_format_temp = SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, 1, @start_pos -1)
							+ SUBSTRING(@in_lot_no, @start_pos, @end_pos - 1-@start_pos)
							+ SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, @end_pos + 1, LEN(@lot_no_format_temp))

					--Set the next starting position as this end position.
					SET @start_pos = @end_pos
				END
				ELSE
					--Set the starting position to look for the next angle bracket eg. <<
					SET @start_pos = @start_pos + 1

				--Find whether we can successfully identify an angle bracket representing the datetime format.
				SET @start_pos = CHARINDEX('<', @lot_no_format_temp, @start_pos)
			END

			--Find whether we can successfully identify a # representing the no.
			SET @start_pos = CHARINDEX('#', @lot_no_format_temp, 1)

			WHILE (@start_pos > 0) BEGIN
				--A successful # is found from the format.
				--Verify whether we can find an equivalent digit from the supplied lot_no
				IF (SUBSTRING(@in_lot_no, @start_pos, 1) IS NULL)
					--An equivalent digit from the lot_no is not found replace the template string as is.
					SET @lot_no_format_temp = SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, 1, @start_pos -1)
						+ '#'
						+ SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, @start_pos + 1, LEN(@lot_no_format_temp))
				ELSE
					--Replace the # with an equivalent digit from the lot_no
					SET @lot_no_format_temp = SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, 1, @start_pos -1)
						+ SUBSTRING(@in_lot_no, @start_pos, 1)
						+ SUBSTRING(@lot_no_format_temp, @start_pos + 1, LEN(@lot_no_format_temp))

				--Move on to the next #
				SET @start_pos = @start_pos + 1

				--Find whether we can successfully identify a hash
				SET @start_pos = CHARINDEX('#', @lot_no_format_temp, @start_pos)
			END

			--Since we identified a format for this lot_no verify whether the lot_no conforms the format.
			IF (@lot_no_format_temp = @in_lot_no)
				--Always update the last_lot_no that was created for this item since this conforms this format.
				UPDATE item SET last_lot_no = @in_lot_no
				WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
		END
		ELSE
			--Just update the last lot_no always when NO lot_no formats were defined.
			UPDATE item SET last_lot_no = @in_lot_no
			WHERE item_id = @in_item_id
	END
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisStep]
(
	@job_step_row_id         	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@job_step_data_row_id		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@state_cd                	INT32_NULL = NULL
)
RETURNS INT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - FN_DL_ISDATACOLLREQDFORTHSSTEP
-- Description          - Verifies whether a data is collected for a given job step_data record. Returns 0 if no more data
--                      data has to be collected; otherwise return 1, if data needs to be collected.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    12/07/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	IF (COALESCE(@state_cd, -1) <> 3) BEGIN
        RETURN 0
    END

	DECLARE @row_count	INT32
		,	@i			INT32
		,	@max_i		INT32
		,	@wo_id		STRING40
		,	@oper_id	STRING40
		,	@seq_no		INT32
		,	@step_no	INT32
		,	@lot_no		STRING40
		,	@sublot_no	STRING40
		,	@grp_id		INT32
		,	@max_value	INT32

	DECLARE @each_job_step_to_collect_data TABLE (
		id int identity,
		wo_id nvarchar(40),
		oper_id nvarchar(40),
		seq_no int,
		step_no int,
		lot_no nvarchar(40),
		sublot_no nvarchar(40),
		grp_id int,
		max_value int
	)

	INSERT INTO @each_job_step_to_collect_data ( wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, lot_no, sublot_no, grp_id, max_value )
	SELECT js.wo_id, js.oper_id, js.seq_no, js.step_no, jsd.lot_no, jsd.sublot_no, dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value
	FROM data_entry_sched des
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON
			des.value_name = dlg.grp_desc
		INNER JOIN job_step js ON
			des.key_id = js.row_id
		INNER JOIN job_step_data jsd ON
			js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id AND
			js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id AND
			js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no AND
			js.step_no = jsd.step_no
	WHERE des.key_type = 7 -- job_step
		AND des.category = 'Datalog Group'
		AND js.row_id = @job_step_row_id
		AND jsd.row_id = @job_step_data_row_id
		AND jsd.state_cd = 3

	SELECT @i = MIN( id ), @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @each_job_step_to_collect_data

	--Get a list of jobs that are running (state_cd =3), and data_entry_sched.key_type = 7 (we are collecting data for jobs_steps),
    --and the category is data log group and it is either collected by minute or hour.
	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@wo_id = wo_id
			,	@oper_id = oper_id
			,	@seq_no = seq_no
			,	@step_no = step_no
			,	@lot_no = lot_no
			,	@sublot_no = sublot_no
			,	@grp_id = grp_id
			,	@max_value = max_value
		FROM @each_job_step_to_collect_data
		WHERE id = @i

		SET @row_count = dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollectionReqd( @grp_id, @max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @lot_no, @sublot_no, 1 )

		IF (@row_count = 1) BEGIN
            RETURN 1
        END

		SET @i = ( @i + 1 )

	END

    RETURN 0

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetNonMovableEntsTree] AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETNONMOVABLEENTSTREE
-- Description          -  Returns a list of non-movable entities
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/13/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/04/2007		AML		3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
-- 02/05/2016           SLR        5.2.0 Added columns without t_ in hearder to end of return dataset to remove unhandled
--                                       exception being thrown Transer Serial Numbers Filter dialog.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@tree_level			INT32
		,	@root_ent_id		INT32
		,	@current_ent_id		INT32
		,	@i					INT32
		,	@max_i				INT32

	DECLARE @temp_ent_id TABLE ( id int identity, t_entity_id int )

	INSERT INTO @temp_ent_id
		SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	SELECT @i = 1, @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @temp_ent_id

	DECLARE @temp_sched_entities TABLE (
		t_root_ent_id int,
		t_ent_id int,
		t_ent_name nvarchar(40),
		t_parent_ent_id nvarchar(40),
		t_child_level int,
		t_ent_tree nvarchar(4000)
	)

    SET @tree_level = 0

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@root_ent_id = te.t_entity_id
			,	@tree_level = 1
			,	@current_ent_id = te.t_entity_id
		FROM @temp_ent_id te WHERE te.id = @i

		INSERT INTO @temp_sched_entities ( t_root_ent_id, t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_parent_ent_id, t_child_level )
        SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, NULL, @tree_level
        FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE e.ent_id = @current_ent_id

        SET @tree_level = 2

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_sched_entities ( t_root_ent_id, t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_parent_ent_id, t_child_level, t_ent_tree )
            SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, x.t_ent_tree
            FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					SELECT	t_ent_id,
							CASE
								WHEN t_ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT( VARCHAR, t_ent_id )
                                ELSE t_ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, t_ent_id )
                            END t_ent_tree
                    FROM @temp_sched_entities
                    WHERE t_child_level = @tree_level - 1 AND t_root_ent_id = @root_ent_id
                ) x ON x.t_ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
            WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN (
				SELECT t_ent_id FROM @temp_sched_entities
                WHERE t_child_level = @tree_level -1 AND t_root_ent_id = @root_ent_id
			)

            IF  (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BEGIN
                BREAK
            END

			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1

		END

		SET @i = ( @i + 1 )

	END

    SELECT	tse.t_root_ent_id, tse.t_ent_id, tse.t_ent_name, tse.t_parent_ent_id, e.ent_name parent_ent_name
		,	tse.t_child_level, tse.t_ent_tree, COALESCE(selectable_entities.selectable, 0) AS selectable
    		,   tse.t_root_ent_id AS root_ent_id, tse.t_ent_id AS ent_id, tse.t_ent_name AS ent_name
		,   tse.t_parent_ent_id AS parent_ent_id, tse.t_child_level AS child_level
		,   tse.t_ent_tree AS ent_tree
FROM @temp_sched_entities tse
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = tse.t_parent_ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			SELECT ent_id, 1 AS selectable
			FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE movable = 0
		) selectable_entities ON selectable_entities.ent_id = tse.t_ent_id
    ORDER BY tse.t_child_level, e.ent_name, tse.t_ent_name

END
