CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr]
(
	@item_id			STRING80 = NULL
,	@attr_id			INT32	= NULL
,	@remove_attr_col	LOGICAL = 0
,	@remove_item		LOGICAL = 0

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr
-- Description	      -	HD# 6192, Update Inventory Item Attribute table automatically based on the item or item_attribute changes.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	11/17/2005
-- Version	      - 3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (C) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
--11/22/2005	Raghu		3.1.3	Modifications related to handle quotes on item_id or attribute description.
--02/06/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	HD# 9207, Part of DB Changes
--01/06/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073212, L00073016: Exclude column names that starts with the table name
--08/07/2012	Arun		4.5	Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
--06/03/2015        Srinivas    6.2          CR L00136163.attr# column type changed to store 1700 characters for attribute value.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
--WARNING: Caller should call this procedure ONLY AFTER finishing all his/her transactions.
--Any exception/error raised from the caller procedure must be rolled back there itself and the call should not
--enter here. Since DDL operations are involved here such as adding additional columns OR dropping columns, all
--the transactions for this session are commited automatically; and any errors from the calling procedures may
--NOT get rolled back.
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @col_name		STRING80
	,	@col_id			INT32
	,	@desc_col_names	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@desc_vals		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@SQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@attr_id_col	STRING80
	,	@attr_desc		STRING80
	,	@attr_value		STRING1700
	,	@attr_id_temp	INT32
	,	@dummy_val		NVARCHAR(1)

	-- do nothing if nothing is supplied. Proceed ONLY if item_id OR attr_id or both are supplied.
	IF (@item_id IS NULL AND @attr_id IS NULL)  RETURN

	SELECT @remove_attr_col = ISNULL(@remove_attr_col, 0), @remove_item = ISNULL(@remove_item, 0)

	--Check if the call is to remove an attribute column.
	IF (@remove_attr_col = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@attr_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
				  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN
				--Since the supplied attribute column exists, remove this attribute column
				--from the inv_item_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_item_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

				--Also, remove the attr_id_d_h column from the inv_item_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_item_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
			END

			--Check if any attributes are made visible in the inv. If none of the attributes are made
			--visible for the inv, then remove all the items from the inv_item_attr table.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
				  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0)
				--DELETE items from the inv_item_attr table where item equals:
				--i) There are no attributes exist for this item
				--ii) or there are no attributes for this item that can be made visible in the inv.
				DELETE FROM inv_item_attr
				FROM
					(
						SELECT qia.inv_item_item_id_h
						FROM item_attr ia
							INNER JOIN (
								SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
								FROM syscolumns
								WHERE id = (
									SELECT id FROM sysobjects
									WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U'
									) AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
									AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0
								) AS attr ON ia.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
							RIGHT OUTER JOIN inv_item_attr qia ON qia.inv_item_item_id_h = ia.item_id
						WHERE ia.item_id IS NULL) AS inv_attr
				WHERE inv_item_attr.inv_item_item_id_h = inv_attr.inv_item_item_id_h
			ELSE
				--Delete all the rows from the inv_item_attr table.
				--i) either there are no attributes assigned for any item
				--ii)or there no attributes that are made visible in the inv for any items.
				DELETE FROM inv_item_attr
		END
		RETURN
	END

	--Check whether the supplied attribute can be included in the inv.
	SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr
	WHERE attr_id = @attr_id AND visible_in_inv = 1

	--Do nothing if the current attribute cannot be included for the inv.
	IF (@attr_desc IS NULL) RETURN

	--Generate a list of all attribute description columns.
	SET @desc_col_names = ''

	--Handle the item_id first to insert a new row in the inv_item_attr table for items
	--do this ONLY if the supplied item_id is not null AND we are inserting or updating an item
	IF (@remove_item = 0) AND (@item_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inv_item_attr WHERE inv_item_item_id_h = @item_id) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inv_item_attr) BEGIN
			DECLARE inv_item_attr_col_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT name, colid
			FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
			ORDER BY colid

			OPEN inv_item_attr_col_csr
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM inv_item_attr_col_csr INTO @col_name, @col_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Generate a list of all attribute description columns; since this is a non-null column in the database.
				IF UPPER(@col_name) <> 'ITEM_ID' AND CHARINDEX('d_h', @col_name) > 0
					SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @col_name + ','
			END
			CLOSE inv_item_attr_col_csr
			DEALLOCATE inv_item_attr_col_csr

			--Atleast if any 1 row exists for the inv_item_attr, then duplicate that row for the new item
			--SELECT * FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = ',' + LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') BEGIN
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO inv_item_attr (inv_item_item_id_h' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT TOP 1 @item_id' + @desc_col_names + ' FROM inv_item_attr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40', @item_id
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--INSERT INTO inv_item_attr (item_id) VALUES (@item_id)
			--There are no rows in the inv_item_attr table.
			--Create this item and automatically fill the attribute values in the appropriate attribute columns.
			SET @desc_vals = ''
			DECLARE inv_item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
			FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
			  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

			OPEN inv_item_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM inv_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
				SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
			END
			CLOSE inv_item_attr_cursor
--			DEALLOCATE inv_item_attr_cursor

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
				IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
				IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO inv_item_attr (inv_item_item_id_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' VALUES (@item_id,' + @desc_vals + ')'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40', @item_id
			END
			ELSE INSERT INTO inv_item_attr (inv_item_item_id_h) VALUES (@item_id)

			SET @desc_vals = ''
			OPEN inv_item_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM inv_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_item_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '=atr.attr_desc FROM '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT a.attr_id, a.attr_desc, ia.item_id, ia.attr_value '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM attr a '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia ON ia.attr_id = a.attr_id AND ia.item_id = @item_id '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE a.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40, @attr_id_temp INT32', @item_id, @attr_id_temp
			END
			CLOSE inv_item_attr_cursor
			DEALLOCATE inv_item_attr_cursor
		END
	END

	SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)

	--Check whether a column for this attribute name exists.
	IF(@remove_item = 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
		  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN

		--If not, create a column name for this attribute.
		--Explicitly made the column nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_item_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + ' STRING1700_NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--If not, create the attribute description column as NULL now, since row may already exists
		--in this table. After updating the attribute description column, this column can be
		--changed to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_item_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--Update the attribute description column.
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_item_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h = @attr_desc'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc

		--Change the attribute description column to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_item_attr ALTER COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NOT NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
	END

	IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Retrieve the item attribute value for this column.
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM item_attr
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND attr_id = @attr_id

		IF (@remove_item = 1)
			DELETE FROM inv_item_attr
			FROM
				(SELECT qia.inv_item_item_id_h
				FROM item_attr ia
				INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
						FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
						AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
				  		AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON ia.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
				RIGHT OUTER JOIN inv_item_attr qia ON qia.inv_item_item_id_h = ia.item_id
				WHERE qia.inv_item_item_id_h = @item_id AND ia.item_id IS NULL) inv_attr
			WHERE inv_item_attr.inv_item_item_id_h = @item_id AND inv_item_attr.inv_item_item_id_h = inv_attr.inv_item_item_id_h

		--Update the attribute value for this item
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_item_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + ' = @attr_value WHERE inv_item_item_id_h = @item_id'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_value STRING1700, @item_id STRING40', @attr_value, @item_id
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The visible_in_inv property for this attribute is set to true.
		--Create all items that have this attribute and this item is not added to the inv_item_attr table.
		SET @desc_vals = ''
		DECLARE inv_item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
		FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_ITEM%'
		  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

		OPEN inv_item_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM inv_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
			SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
		END
		CLOSE inv_item_attr_cursor

		IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
			IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
			SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO inv_item_attr (inv_item_item_id_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT ia.item_id, ' + @desc_vals + ' FROM item_attr ia'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_item_attr qia ON qia.inv_item_item_id_h = ia.item_id'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' WHERE ia.attr_id = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), @attr_id) + ' AND qia.inv_item_item_id_h IS NULL'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL


			--If there are >= 1 row(s) inserted into the queue_item_attr table,
			--then update all the attribute values and descriptions for the new rows.
			--If no rows were inserted into the queue_item_attr table, then we don't need to loop thru all the
			--rows to update the attribute values and description.
			IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 BEGIN
				SET @dummy_val = '0'
				OPEN inv_item_attr_cursor
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM inv_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
					IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_temp
					SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_item_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
					SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '=@attr_desc FROM '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT i.item_id, ia.attr_value '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM item i '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE inv_item_attr.inv_item_item_id_h=atr.item_id AND inv_item_attr.' + @attr_id_col + '=@dummy_val'
					EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id_temp INT32, @attr_desc STRING80, @dummy_val NVARCHAR(1)', @attr_id_temp, @attr_desc, @dummy_val
				END
				CLOSE inv_item_attr_cursor
			END
		END
		DEALLOCATE inv_item_attr_cursor

		--The above update will update ONLY the new rows if inserted.
		--Rows may already exist in this inv_item_attr table for many items. If an attribute property is changed to make visible in the grid,
		--then the below update statement should update all the existing rows
		--SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr WHERE attr_id = @attr_id
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_item_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value FROM '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT i.item_id, ia.attr_value '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM item i '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id) atr '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE inv_item_attr.inv_item_item_id_h=atr.item_id '
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id INT32', @attr_id
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Insert_Resource_Group_Ent]
(
@user_name nvarchar(50),
@res_grp_id int,
@ent_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.res_grp_ent with (nolock) where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id and ent_id =  @ent_id
		if @rowCount = 0 
		begin
			insert into SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent (res_grp_id,ent_id,last_edit_by) VALUES (@res_grp_id,@ent_id,@user_name)
			set @message = CONCAT('Successfully added Reason Group :' , @res_grp_id)
		end
		else
		begin
			set @message = CONCAT('Reason Group already present :' , @res_grp_id)
		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to add Reason Group :' , @res_grp_id)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Class_Attr_GetAttrs]
(@item_class_id		STRING80
,@user_id		STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Class_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description	      - Get all attributes that are assigned to the item class.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.23
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/15/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

--	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp
	SELECT ica.item_class_id
            ,ica.attr_id
            ,a.attr_desc
	    ,a.predefined
            ,a.data_type
            ,a.entry_type
            ,a.visible_in_queue
            ,a.visible_in_inv
            ,ic.item_class_desc
            ,ica.attr_value
            ,ica.notes
            ,ica.last_edit_comment
            ,ica.last_edit_by
            ,ica.last_edit_at
	,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WHERE cal.attr_id = a.attr_id) <=
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal
			INNER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cal.cert_name = cul.cert_name
			WHERE cal.attr_id = a.attr_id AND cul.user_id = @user_id AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level)
		THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		editable
	FROM item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item_class_attr ica WITH (NOLOCK) ON ica.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ica.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE ica.item_class_id = @item_class_id AND a.attr_grp = 4 AND ic.obsolete = 0
--	  AND (ica.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	ORDER BY a.attr_desc
END

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes

--04/06/2016	Malleswara Rao  5.03  User Story: 615398 -As Bruce, I want the MES database to have proper foreign keys so that I do not accidentally delete data - Part 2
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @ent_id			INT32
	,@ent_name		STRING80
	,@parent_item_id	STRING80
	,@ver_id		STRING80
	,@bom_pos		INT32
	,@err_str		STRING1700
	,@alt_no		INT32
	,@process_id		STRING80
	,@oper_id		STRING80
	,@wo_id			STRING80
	,@seq_no		INT32

-- Update rows in nullable table fields that may reference this ent
--UPDATE job_exec SET def_prod_reas_cd = NULL
--WHERE def_prod_reas_cd = @reas_cd
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec WHERE def_prod_reas_cd = @reas_cd) BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @ent_id = ent_id FROM job_exec WHERE def_prod_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	SELECT @ent_name = ent_name FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	SET @err_str = 'This reason code cannot be deleted, because this reason code is currently used as the %1 by the entity %2.{4764},default production reason code,' + @ent_name
	RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

--UPDATE job_exec SET def_cons_reas_cd = NULL

--UPDATE bom_item SET def_reas_cd = NULL

	SELECT TOP 1 @parent_item_id = parent_item_id, @ver_id = ver_id, @bom_pos = bom_pos
	FROM bom_item

	SELECT TOP 1 @parent_item_id = parent_item_id, @ver_id = ver_id, @bom_pos = bom_pos,
		@process_id = process_id, @oper_id = oper_id
	FROM bom_item_oper_link
	WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	SET @err_str = 'This reason code cannot be deleted, because this reason code is currently used as the default reason code by the %1.{4770},bom_item_oper_link table where Parent_Item_Id=' + @parent_item_id + ' AND Ver_Id =' + @ver_id + ' AND Bom_Pos=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @bom_pos) + ' AND Process_Id=' + @process_id + ' AND Oper_Id=' + @oper_id
	RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

--UPDATE job_bom SET def_reas_cd = NULL
--WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd) BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = wo_id, @oper_id = oper_id, @seq_no = seq_no, @bom_pos = @bom_pos
	FROM job_bom
	WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	SET @err_str = 'This reason code cannot be deleted, because this reason code is currently used as the default reason code by the %1.{4770},job_bom table where Wo_Id=' + @wo_id + ' AND Oper_Id=' + @oper_id + ' AND Seq_No=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @seq_no) + ' AND Bom_Pos=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @bom_pos)
	RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

--UPDATE job_bom_subst SET def_reas_cd = NULL
--WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd) BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = wo_id, @oper_id = oper_id, @seq_no = seq_no, @bom_pos = @bom_pos, @alt_no = alt_no
	FROM job_bom_subst
	WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	SET @err_str = 'This reason code cannot be deleted, because this reason code is currently used as the default reason code by the %1.{4770},job_bom_subst table where Wo_Id=' + @wo_id + ' AND Oper_Id=' + @oper_id + ' AND Seq_No=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @seq_no) + ' AND Bom_Pos=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @bom_pos) + ' AND Alt_No=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @alt_no)
	RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

--UPDATE item_subst SET def_reas_cd = NULL
--WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_subst WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd) BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @parent_item_id = orig_item_id, @alt_no = alt_no
	FROM item_subst
	WHERE def_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	SET @err_str = 'This reason code cannot be deleted, because this reason code is currently used as the defaul reason code by the %1.{4770},item_subst table where Orig_Item_Id=' + @parent_item_id + ' AND Alt_No=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @alt_no)
	RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

update job_exec set def_cons_reas_cd=null where def_cons_reas_cd=@reas_cd
update job_exec set def_prod_reas_cd=null where def_prod_reas_cd=@reas_cd

--Other table rows will be deleted by the DBMS cascade delete
--SET NOCOUNT OFF
DELETE item_reas
WHERE (reas_cd = @reas_cd)

-- Name:		sp_sa_ofi_qm_workorder
-- Description: This SP will fetch Lines where Sample Plan is configured. It will fetch all WO from selected line or segement where job is running 
-- Usage:		Manual Sample request UI
--EXEC [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_workorder] 270
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2024-02-19		Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_workorder] @line_id INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;;

	WITH cte
	AS (
		SELECT ent.ent_id			
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ea.ent_id
		INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
		WHERE attr_desc = 'EntityType'
			AND ea.attr_value ='Segment'
				AND ENT.parent_ent_id= @line_id
		)
	SELECT DISTINCT wo.wo_id
		,wo_desc
	FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = job.wo_id
	INNER JOIN cte ON CTE.ent_id=JOB.run_ent_id
	INNER JOIN qm_spec QS WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.item_id=job.item_id 
	WHERE wo.state_cd IN (1,2) -- state code 3 means Closed	
		--AND job.state_cd = 3 -- where job is running- 
	ORDER BY wo_id;
END

		,	user_name.user_desc
		,	cert_user_link.last_edit_comment

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Build_Alt_Job]
@session_ID	INT32,
@wo_id		STRING40,
@process_id      STRING40,
@item_id	STRING40,
@req_finish_time DATETIME = NULL,
@release_time DATETIME = NULL,
@wo_priority	INT = 1
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	 - sp_Build_Alt_Job
-- Description		- Similar to sp_Build_Job_nonalphabetical but uses Temp_Alt_*# tables, doesn't
--			  deal with specs or steps or attributes, and the WO record already exists
-- Author		- KRF
-- Date Created		- 01/03/2003
-- Version		- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE

@SQLString VARCHAR(2000),
@seq_no                INT,
-- Variable declarations for OPER table
@O_oper_id             STRING40,
@O_first_oper          LOGICAL,
@O_final_oper          LOGICAL,
@O_sched_to_ent_id     INT32,
-- Variable declarations for OPER_ENT_LINK table
@OEL_ent_id            INT32,
@OEL_est_setup_time    TFLOAT,
@OEL_est_teardown_time TFLOAT,
@OEL_est_prod_rate     TFLOAT,
@OEL_batch_size        TFLOAT,
@OEL_est_transfer_time TFLOAT,
@DEBUG_STR             NVARCHAR(2000),
@system_severity       INT,
@V_Error               VARCHAR(2000),
@V_Row_Count           INT,
@V_Deletable           LOGICAL
EXECUTE sp_S_system_attr_GetSevLevel @system_severity
-- item_id inserted in the Temp_Alt_Job# table will be the final item only.
-- later in the sp_Build_BOM, will take care of updating Job table for correct Item_ID
-- Read data for all operations for this process_id from oper table
DECLARE oper_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT oper_id, first_oper, final_oper, sched_to_ent_id  FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id
OPEN oper_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM oper_cursor INTO @O_oper_id, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper, @O_sched_to_ent_id
-- for each oper in process
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN  --OPER_CURSOR
  IF @O_sched_to_ent_id IS NULL
  BEGIN
    -- read all rows from OPER_ENT_LINK table for this oper
    DECLARE oper_ent_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT ent_id, est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, batch_size, est_transfer_time
      FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id order by ent_id
    OPEN oper_ent_link_cursor
    FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_link_cursor INTO @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate,
      @OEL_batch_size, @OEL_est_transfer_time
    SET @seq_no = -1
    -- for each ent_id that performs this operation (OPER_ENT_LINK_cursor)
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      --Get the next sequence no
      SET @seq_no = @seq_no + 1
      SET @SQLString = N'INSERT INTO temp_alt_job' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@session_id) + N' VALUES(@process_id, 0, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no,
@req_finish_time, wo_priority,  @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate, @release_time, 0, 0,
@OEL_est_transfer_time, 1, @OEL_batch_size, @item_id, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper)'
      EXEC sp_executesql @SQLString
      -- read all routes to this oper and ent from the OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
      EXECUTE sp_OER_to_Alt_Job_Route @session_id, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @process_id, @seq_no

      FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_link_cursor INTO @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate,
        @OEL_batch_size, @OEL_est_transfer_time
    END  -- OPER_ENT_LINK_cursor    CLOSE oper_ent_link_cursor
    DEALLOCATE oper_ent_link_cursor
  END
  ELSE -- @O_sched_to_ent_id is not NULL; currently this can't happen
  BEGIN
    -- Initialize SEQ_NO
    SET @seq_no = 0
    -- if the select statement bellow fails, all the @OEL_* variables will be NULL
    SELECT @OEL_ent_id = ent_id, @OEL_est_setup_time = est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time = est_teardown_time,
      @OEL_est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate, @OEL_batch_size = batch_size, @OEL_est_transfer_time = est_transfer_time
      FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 -- no row was found in OPER_ENT_LINK table
    BEGIN
      SET @OEL_est_setup_time = NULL
      SET @OEL_est_teardown_time = NULL
      SET @OEL_est_prod_rate = 1
      SET @OEL_batch_size = 1
      SET @OEL_est_transfer_time = NULL
      SET @OEL_ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id
    END
    SET @SQLString = N'INSERT INTO temp_alt_job' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@session_id) + N' VALUES(@process_id, 0, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no,
@req_finish_time, wo_priority,  @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate, @release_time, 0, 0,
@OEL_est_transfer_time, 1, @OEL_batch_size, @item_id, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper)'
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQLString
    -- read all routes to this oper and ent from the OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
    EXECUTE sp_OER_to_Alt_Job_Route @session_id, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @process_id, @seq_no
  END -- else @O_sched_to_ent_id is NOT NULL
  -- copy secondary resource requirements
  EXECUTE sp_Res_Oper_to_Alt_Res_Job @session_id, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @process_id
  FETCH NEXT FROM oper_cursor INTO @O_oper_id, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper, @O_sched_to_ent_id
  END  -- OPER_CURSOR
CLOSE oper_cursor
DEALLOCATE oper_cursor

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete
-- Description:	Update maxqty parameter into null before end job and set back again after job complete
-- 
-- Usage:		EndJobWorkflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2023-04-24			Initial version
--===========================================================================================*/

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_PresetDataBeforeComplete]   
		@wo_id NVARCHAR(100) ,
		@seq_no int ,
		@oper_id NVARCHAR(100) ,
		@operation NVARCHAR(100) = 'BACKUP'
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @list_bom TABLE (
		id int IDENTITY(1,1),
		item_id nvarchar(100),
		bom_pos int,
		min_qty FLOAT NULL,
		max_qty FLOAT NULL,
		spare3 NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
		spare4 NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
		row_id INT
	)

	Declare @TempData TABLE (
		Id INT ,
		value NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	DECLARE @counter INT = 1,
		@len INT = 0

	INSERT @list_bom 
	SELECT 
		jb.item_id,
		bom_pos,
		min_qty_per_parent_item, 
		max_qty_per_parent_item, 
		spare3,
		spare4,
		row_id
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos > 0

	SELECT @len = count(*) FROM @list_bom

	DECLARE @MinQty FLOAT,
		@MaxQty FLOAT,
		@TempValue NVARCHAR(100),
		@RowId INT

	IF @operation = 'BACKUP' 
	BEGIN
	WHILE (@len >= @counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @MaxQty= max_qty, @MinQty = min_qty, @RowId = row_id FROM @list_bom 
			WHERE id = @counter

			UPDATE job_bom SET Spare3 = CONCAT(@MinQty, ';', @MaxQty) , min_qty_per_parent_item = NULL , max_qty_per_parent_item = NULL WHERE row_id = @RowId

			PRINT Concat(@MinQty, ';', @MaxQty)
			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1;
		END

	END

	IF @operation = 'RESTORE' 
	BEGIN
		WHILE (@len >= @counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @TempValue= Spare3, @RowId = row_id FROM @list_bom 
			WHERE id = @counter

			INSERT @TempData
			SELECT [key]+1,[value] FROM OPENJSON(CONCAT('["', REPLACE(@TempValue, ';', '","'), '"]')) ORDER BY CONVERT(int, [key])
			--SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY value),value FROM STRING_SPLIT(@TempValue, ';');

			SELECT @MinQty = case 
								when (value <> '') then cast(cast(value as nvarchar(50)) as float) 
								else NULL 
							 end 
			FROM @TempData WHERE id =1

			SELECT @MaxQty = case 
								when (value <> '') then cast(cast(value as nvarchar(50)) as float) 
								else NULL 
							 end 
			FROM @TempData WHERE id =2

			UPDATE job_bom SET max_qty_per_parent_item = @MaxQty, min_qty_per_parent_item = @MinQty--, Spare3 = NULL 
			WHERE row_id = @RowId

			DELETE FROM @TempData
			PRINT @MinQty
			PRINT @MaxQty

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1;
		END
	END
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt]
(@in_prod_rate				FLOAT
,@in_prod_uom				INTEGER
,@in_batch_size				FLOAT
,@in_prod_count_interval	INTEGER
) RETURNS FLOAT AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_FreqProdCntIntToTimeInt
-- Description       - Uses the production rate of the running job to convert the production count interval to a seconds-based
--						time interval.
-- Author         - Rich Boyle
-- Date Created      - 1/10/2013
-- Version        - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	-- Since production rate is expressed in terms of batches and the production count is
	-- expressed in terms of units, we need to divide the production count by the batch size
	-- to get the number of batches we will produce between samples.
	-- We need to convert the production rate into seconds per batch and multiply this number
	-- by the number of batches between samples.
	DECLARE @batches_per_sample as real
			,@seconds_per_batch as real

	SET @batches_per_sample = @in_prod_count_interval / @in_batch_size

	--SET @seconds_per_batch = [dbo].fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(@in_prod_rate, @in_prod_uom) * 3600.0
	SET @seconds_per_batch =
		CASE WHEN @in_prod_uom = 0 THEN @in_prod_rate * 3600
			WHEN @in_prod_uom = 1 THEN  @in_prod_rate * 60
		    WHEN @in_prod_uom = 2 THEN @in_prod_rate
		    WHEN @in_prod_uom = 3 THEN (3600.0/@in_prod_rate)
		    WHEN @in_prod_uom = 4 THEN (60.0/@in_prod_rate)
		    WHEN @in_prod_uom = 5 THEN (1.0/@in_prod_rate)
		    ELSE 1
		    END

	RETURN @batches_per_sample * @seconds_per_batch
End

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_chkStorageValidity]
(@ent_id INT
,@silo_type STRING80 -- Source or Destination
,@item_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
,@wo_id  nvarchar(40) 
,@oper_id nvarchar(80) 
,@seq_no	int
) 

--RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable

RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  isNotValidEnt int
		  ,notValidDescDetails NVARCHAR(600)
		)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_chkSiloValidity
-- Description       - Returns the silo validity based on different parameters
-- Author			 - DS
-- Date Created      - 14/09/2022
-- Version			 - 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 14/09/2022     DS 			 1.0		Initial version
-- 23/01/2024     DS 			 2.0		Changes related to db localization
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	 @su_status_cd			INT32
		 ,@isNotValidEnt int = 0
		 ,@notValidDescDetails nvarchar(300) = ''
		 ,@item_state_cd int
		
		if(@silo_type='source')
			BEGIN
				if((select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id where attr_desc='LockForOutput' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1)
					BEGIN
						set @isNotValidEnt=1
						set @notValidDescDetails =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300037,NULL,NULL)  --'Storage unit is locked for output.'
					END
				if((select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a  with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id where attr_desc='BlockForQuality' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1)
					BEGIN
						set @isNotValidEnt=1
						set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
					END
			END

		if(@silo_type='destination')
			BEGIN
				if((select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock)  on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id where attr_desc='LockForInput' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1)
						BEGIN
							set @isNotValidEnt=1
							set @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300024,NULL,NULL) --'Storage unit is locked for input.'
						END
				if((select ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id where attr_desc='BlockForQuality' and ea.ent_id=@ent_id)=1)	
						BEGIN
							set @isNotValidEnt=1
							set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)
						END
			END
		

		
			if exists (select * from ofi_su_mes_states_mapping with(nolock) where su_ent_id = @ent_id and interlock_type = @silo_type)
				begin 
					set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
					set @notValidDescDetails =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300050,NULL,NULL) -- ' Storage unit is in '
					
					select @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + su_status_desc + ', ' from 
					ofi_su_mes_states_mapping osm with(nolock) inner join ofi_su_states oss with(nolock) on osm.su_status_cd = oss.su_status_cd
					where osm.su_ent_id = @ent_id and interlock_type = @silo_type ;

					set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300051,NULL,NULL) --' State '
				end
			

			IF(@item_id IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN 
				 
				select @item_state_cd = item_status_cd from item_state with(nolock) where item_status_desc = 'UNRESTRICTED'

					if exists (select 1 from  item_inv with(nolock) where ent_id =@ent_id and item_id = @item_id and status_cd <>@item_state_cd)
					begin 
						set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
						set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300036,NULL,NULL) -- ' Item state is not in Unrestricted'
					end
				END

		insert into @Output
		select @isNotValidEnt,@notValidDescDetails

	RETURN ;
END

-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_GenerateSAPHUNO] 
	@HUNumber  INT = NULL,
	@wo_id VARCHAR(100),
	@oper_id VARCHAR(100),
	@seq_no INT
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @SAPNumber nvarchar(20),
			@year VARCHAR(10),
			@month VARCHAR(10),
			@day VARCHAR(10),
			@plant_code AS INT,
			@line_no VARCHAR(10),
			@serial_no VARCHAR(10),
			@hutype AS INT,
			@line_ent nvarchar(10),
			@trim_hunumber nvarchar(20),
			@reject_hu_attr_id INT,
			@good_hu_attr_id INT,
			@NHU nvarchar(20),
			@p_type INT,
			@update_inv AS INT 
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpHUnum') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpHUnum --Drop the table in case it exists
	
	CREATE TABLE #tmpHUnum (hunumber VARCHAR(100),
							dcsnumber VARCHAR(100),
							rework_hunumber VARCHAR(100),
							flush_hunumber VARCHAR(100),
							RESULT INT)

	SELECT DISTINCT @line_ent = e.parent_ent_id
	FROM item_prod ip WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN ent e WITH(nolock) ON e.ent_id = ip.ent_id
								INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(nolock) ON ea.ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
								INNER JOIN ent ee WITH(nolock) ON ee.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	WHERE ea.attr_value = 'Line'AND ip.wo_id = @wo_id
								AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id
								AND seq_no = @seq_no

	SELECT @line_no = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH(nolock) INNER JOIN attr A WITH(nolock) ON A.attr_id = ea.attr_id
	WHERE A.attr_desc = 'LineCode' AND ea.ent_id = @line_ent

	SET @line_no = CAST(right(@line_no, 1) AS VARCHAR(10)) 
	PRINT @line_no

	SELECT @plant_code = attr_value
	FROM system_attr WITH(nolocK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'HUPlantCode'

	SET @year = CAST(right(YEAR(getDate()), 1) AS VARCHAR(10))
	SET @month = CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(2), cast(getdate() AS datetime), 101) AS VARCHAR(10)) 
	--SET @month=CAST(month(getDate()) as varchar(10))
	--SET @day=CAST(DAY(getDate()) as varchar(10))
	SET @day = CAST(FORMAT(getdate(), 'dd') AS VARCHAR(2)) 
	--SET @HUNumber='230410001'



	SET @serial_no = right(@HUNumber, 3)
	SET @hutype = LEFT(@HUNumber, 1) 

	PRINT @hutype

	SELECT @update_inv = update_inv
	FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
						AND seq_no = @seq_no
						AND bom_pos = 0 

	IF @update_inv = 1 
	BEGIN
		UPDATE job_bom
		SET update_inv = 0
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
							AND seq_no = @seq_no
							AND bom_pos = 0
	END 

	--SET @trim_hunumber= RIGHT(@HUNumber, LEN(@HUNumber) - 2)
		
	IF @hutype = 1 
	BEGIN
		SELECT @good_hu_attr_id = attr_id
		FROM attr A WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE A .attr_desc = 'GoodHU'
		
		SELECT @SAPNumber = attr_value
		FROM job_attr WITH(nolock)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND attr_id = @good_hu_attr_id
			
		SELECT @NHU = attr_value
		FROM job_attr WITH(nolock)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND attr_id = @good_hu_attr_id
	END
		
	ELSE IF @hutype = 2 
	BEGIN
		SET @p_type = 3

		SELECT @reject_hu_attr_id = attr_id
		FROM attr A WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE A .attr_desc = 'RejectHU'
			
		SELECT @SAPNumber = attr_value
		FROM job_attr WITH(nolock)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND attr_id = @reject_hu_attr_id
		
		INSERT INTO #tmpHUnum Exec [ SP_S_ofi_GenerateHUNumber ] 
				@p_type,
				@wo_id,
				@oper_id,
				@seq_no
			
		SELECT @NHU = flush_hunumber
		FROM #tmpHUnum 
		
		--SELECT @NHU=attr_value FROM wo_attr with(nolock) WHERE wo_id=@wo_id AND attr_id=@good_hu_attr_id
		--SET @SAPNumber = CONCAT(2,@year,@month,@day,@serial_no,0)
	END

	--SELECT @attr_id=attr_id FROM wo_attr WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id=@wo_id AND attr_value=@serial_no
	--SELECT @seq_no AS seqno
	--SET @SAPNumber = CONCAT(12,8,@hutype,@year,@month,@day,@serial_no,0)
	--SET @SAPNumber = CONCAT(@plant_code,@line_no,@hutype,@year,@month,@day,@serial_no,0)
	--SET @SAPNumber = CONCAT(@plant_code,@line_no,@hutype,@year,@trim_hunumber,0)
	--SET @SAPNumber = CONCAT(@plant_code,@line_no,@hutype,@year,@month,@day,@serial_no,0

	SELECT @SAPNumber AS SAPHUNumber,
		   @NHU AS NestedHUNo
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_IP_AddProdViaDataEntryJob]
( @in_session_id              INT32 = NULL
,@in_event_time_local        datetime = NULL
,@in_item_class_id           NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_item_id                 NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_production_schedule_id  NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_wo_id                   NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_oper_id                 NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_batch_size              TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_start_qty               TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_reqd_qty                TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_target_prod_rate        TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_target_prod_rate_uom    INT32 = NULL
,@in_update_inventory        LOGICAL = 0
,@in_inv_unique_by_job       LOGICAL = 0
,@in_run_ent_name            NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_run_ent_site_name       NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_reas_desc               NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_reas_grp_desc           NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
