,@in_to_ent_site_name        NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_to_lot_no               NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_to_sublot_no            NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_genealogy_id            NVARCHAR(508) = NULL
,@in_event_id                NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_segment_requirement_id  NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_segment_response_id     NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_subsegment_id           NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_qty_prod                TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_prod_qty_uom            NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_user_id                 NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_comments                NVARCHAR(508) = NULL
,@in_spare1                  NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_spare2                  NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_spare3                  NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_spare4                  NVARCHAR(160) = NULL
,@in_event_name              NVARCHAR(1000)= NULL
,@in_personnel_list          NVARCHAR(1000)= NULL
,@in_serial_no_list          NVARCHAR(1000)= NULL
,@in_grp_desc                NVARCHAR(1000)= NULL
,@in_extended_prod_attrs     NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,@in_time_zone_bias_value    INT32 = NULL
,@row_id					 INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - SP_I_IP_ADDPRODVIADATAENTRYJOB
-- Description      - Create a new data entry job on the fly if not exist, and add a production to the data entry job
-- Author    - Raghu
--                    Sidus 3 Phoenix Iteration4 Internal Genealogy Implementation
-- Date Created      - 08/27/2009
-- Version             - 4.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 12/12/2009		AJAY		4.0.0		H1423 FIX/Changes
-- 01/12/2010		Vinit		4.1.0       HF1432 changes.
-- 02/06/2017       Surya       5.3         UserStory: 691067 - MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00130975 (HF CR L00130028: Triggering an OCO PEM Production Event without a default prod rate end a job and a new job to incorrectly created and started with an incremented seq no.)
-- 10/02/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE  @item_class_id           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@item_id                 NVARCHAR(160)
		,@production_schedule_id  NVARCHAR(160)
		,@wo_id                   NVARCHAR(160)
		,@oper_id                 NVARCHAR(160)
		,@batch_size              FLOAT
		,@start_qty               FLOAT
		,@reqd_qty                FLOAT
		,@target_prod_rate        FLOAT
		,@target_prod_rate_uom    INT
		,@update_inventory        LOGICAL
		,@inv_unique_by_job       LOGICAL
		,@run_ent_name            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@run_ent_site_name       NVARCHAR(160)
		,@reas_desc               NVARCHAR(160)
		,@reas_grp_desc           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@to_ent_name             NVARCHAR(160)
		,@to_ent_site_name        NVARCHAR(160)
		,@to_lot_no               NVARCHAR(160)
		,@to_sublot_no            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@genealogy_id            NVARCHAR(508)
		,@event_id                NVARCHAR(160)
		,@segment_requirement_id  NVARCHAR(160)
		,@segment_response_id     NVARCHAR(160)
		,@subsegment_id           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@qty_prod                FLOAT
		,@prod_qty_uom            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@user_id                 NVARCHAR(160)
		,@comments                NVARCHAR(508)
		,@extended_prod_attrs     NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@time_zone_bias_value    INT
		,@dummy                   INT
		,@dummy2                  INT
		,@last_edit_at            TDATETIME
		,@item_uom_id             INT
		,@item_uom_desc           NVARCHAR(160)
		,@reported_uom_id         INT
		,@factor                  FLOAT
		,@offset                  FLOAT
		,@reas_cd                 INT

		,@cur_seq_no              INT
		,@cur_state_cd            INT
		,@cur_item_id             NVARCHAR(160)
		,@display_seq             INT
		,@run_ent_id              INT
		,@deviation_above         FLOAT
		,@deviation_below         FLOAT
		,@cur_run_ent_id          INT
		,@cur_job_pos             INT

		,@temp_wo_id              NVARCHAR(160)
		,@temp_oper_id            NVARCHAR(160)
		,@temp_seq_no             INT
		,@current_subst           INT
		,@alt_no                  INT
		,@warning_message         NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@error_message			  NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@event_name              NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@personnel_list          NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@serial_no_list          NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@grp_desc                NVARCHAR(1000)
		,@event_time_utc		DATETIME
		,@event_time_local		DATETIME
		,@tz_temp				INT32


SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
    SELECT @item_class_id = @in_item_class_id
		,@item_id = @in_item_id
		,@production_schedule_id = @in_production_schedule_id
		,@wo_id = @in_wo_id
	    ,@oper_id = @in_oper_id
		,@batch_size = COALESCE(@in_batch_size, 1)
	    ,@start_qty = COALESCE(@in_start_qty, 0)
	    ,@reqd_qty = COALESCE(@in_reqd_qty, 0)
	    ,@target_prod_rate = COALESCE(@in_target_prod_rate, 1)
	    ,@target_prod_rate_uom = COALESCE(@in_target_prod_rate_uom, 0)
	    ,@update_inventory = COALESCE(@in_update_inventory, 0)
	    ,@inv_unique_by_job = COALESCE(@in_inv_unique_by_job, 0)
	    ,@run_ent_name = @in_run_ent_name
	    ,@run_ent_site_name = @in_run_ent_site_name
	    ,@reas_desc = @in_reas_desc
	    ,@reas_grp_desc = @in_reas_grp_desc
	    ,@to_ent_name = @in_to_ent_name
	    ,@to_ent_site_name = @in_to_ent_site_name
	    ,@to_lot_no = @in_to_lot_no
	    ,@to_sublot_no = @in_to_sublot_no
	    ,@genealogy_id = @in_genealogy_id
	    ,@event_id = @in_event_id
	    ,@segment_requirement_id = @in_segment_requirement_id
	    ,@segment_response_id = @in_segment_response_id
	    ,@subsegment_id = @in_subsegment_id
	    ,@qty_prod = COALESCE(@in_qty_prod, 0)
	    ,@prod_qty_uom = @in_prod_qty_uom
	    ,@user_id = @in_user_id
	    ,@comments = @in_comments
		,@event_time_local=@in_event_time_local
		,@event_name =  @in_event_name
		,@personnel_list =  @in_personnel_list
		,@serial_no_list  = @in_serial_no_list
		,@grp_desc   = @in_grp_desc
	    ,@extended_prod_attrs = @in_extended_prod_attrs
	    ,@time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	-- Get local utc time
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @event_time_utc OUTPUT, @event_time_local OUTPUT, @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT

	SELECT	@event_time_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @event_time_local )
		,	@event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @event_time_utc )


    --Veify whether the supplied run on entity exist in the database.
	SELECT @run_ent_id = dbo.FN_GETENTITYID(@run_ent_name, @run_ent_site_name)

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @run_ent_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('An entity with the supplied entity ID does not exist.{5775}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    IF (@in_batch_size IS NULL AND @in_target_prod_rate IS NULL AND @in_target_prod_rate_uom IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE
			je.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
			je.job_pos = 0 AND
			je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND
			je.cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL AND
			je.cur_seq_no IS NOT NULL
			)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				@batch_size = jb.batch_size,
				@target_prod_rate = jb.est_prod_rate,
				@target_prod_rate_uom = jb.prod_uom,
				@item_id = COALESCE(@item_id,jb.item_id)
			FROM
				job jb WITH (NOLOCK) inner join  job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) on
				jb.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id
				AND jb.oper_id =  je.cur_oper_id
                AND jb.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
			WHERE
				je.ent_id = @run_ent_id AND
				je.job_pos = 0
		END
    END

    IF (@item_id IS NULL)
		--Default the item_id from system _attribute
		SELECT @item_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 403

    IF (@item_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the item does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},item_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether we have a valid work order ID
    IF (@wo_id IS NULL)
        --Default the wo_id from system _attribute
        SELECT @wo_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 400

    IF (@wo_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the item does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},wo_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    --Verify whether we have a valid operation id
    IF (@oper_id IS NULL)
        --Default the oper_id from system _attribute
        SELECT @oper_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 401

    IF (@oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the item does not exist in the database.
        RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},oper_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

    IF (@user_id IS NOT NULL)
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
		SET @user_id = NULL

    --Verify whether we have a valid user ID
    IF (@user_id IS NULL)
        --Default the user_id from system _attribute
        SELECT @user_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199

    IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the user does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},user_id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	SELECT @dummy = COUNT(*)
    FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
    WHERE ir.reas_desc = @reas_desc
      AND (irg.reas_grp_desc = @reas_grp_desc OR @reas_grp_desc IS NULL)

	IF (@dummy > 1) BEGIN
        RAISERROR ('The %1 must be supplied %2.{4677},reason group,to identify the production reason', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
    FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id
    WHERE ir.reas_desc = @reas_desc
      AND (irg.reas_grp_desc = @reas_grp_desc OR @reas_grp_desc IS NULL)

	IF (COALESCE(@reas_cd, -1) = -1)
		--Default the reas_desc from system _attribute
		SELECT @reas_cd = CAST(sa.attr_value AS INT) FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sa.attr_id = 216

	--Verify whether the supplied item_id exist in the databae.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id)
        --The supplied item exist in the database.
		SELECT @item_uom_id = i.uom_id FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The supplied item_id does not exist in the database.
		IF (@item_class_id IS NULL)
			--Default the item_class_id from the system_attr table.
			SELECT @item_class_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 402

		--Raise an error if item_class_id cannot be found.
		IF (@item_class_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},item_class_id', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether this item_class already exist or not.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item_class ic WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE ic.item_class_id = @item_class_id)
			--Item class does not exist, crate a new item_class.
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Class @item_class_id=@item_class_id, @item_class_desc=@item_class_id,
				@produced=1, @consumed=1, @obsolete=0, @purchased=0, @sold=0, @lot_no_format=NULL,
				@last_lot_no=NULL, @sublot_no_format=NULL, @last_sublot_no=NULL, @serial_no_lvl=-1,
				@inv_unique_by_job=0, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL,
				@last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

		IF (@prod_qty_uom IS NULL)
            --Default the item_class_id from the system_attr table.
			SELECT @prod_qty_uom = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 404

        --Raise an error if the UOM id is not found.
        IF (@prod_qty_uom IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},prod_qty_uom', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether this item_class already exist or not.
		SELECT @item_uom_id = um.uom_id FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE um.description = @prod_qty_uom

		IF (@item_uom_id IS NULL)
			--UOM does not exist, create a new UOM.
			EXEC sp_I_Uom @description=@prod_qty_uom, @abbreviation=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
                    @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at, @uom_id=@item_uom_id OUTPUT

        --Create a new item.
		EXEC sp_I_Item @item_id=@item_id, @item_desc=@item_id,
            @item_class_id=@item_class_id, @uom_id=@item_uom_id,
            @template=0, @lifetime=NULL, @unit_cost=NULL, @obsolete=0, @purchased=0, @sold=0, @num_decimals=2,
            @must_complete_steps=0, @must_prod_reqd_qty=0, @min_grade=NULL, @min_state=NULL, @min_inv_level=NULL,
            @reorder_amt=NULL, @auto_reorder=0, @lot_no_format=NULL, @last_lot_no=NULL, @max_lot_size=NULL,
            @sublot_no_format=NULL, @last_sublot_no=NULL, @serial_no_lvl=-1, @max_sublot_size=NULL,
            @max_order_size=NULL, @min_trace_inv=NULL, @inv_unique_by_job=@inv_unique_by_job,
            @notes=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
            @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT
    END

    --Verify whether the supplied quantities are reported in the native UOM,
    --if not verify whether we have a conversion factor availble to convert the quantities reported from the current units to native units.
    IF (@prod_qty_uom IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE um.description = @prod_qty_uom) BEGIN
			SET @error_message = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},prod_qty_uom:' + @prod_qty_uom
			RAISERROR (@error_message, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

        --A uom is reported for production
		SELECT @reported_uom_id = um.uom_id
		FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE um.description = @prod_qty_uom

		--Verify whether the supplied uom and the item's uom are the same.
		IF (@item_uom_id <> @reported_uom_id) BEGIN
			--They're different.  Verify whether we have a conversion factor to convert them into native units.
            SELECT TOP 1 @factor = uc.factor, @offset = uc.offset
            FROM uom_conv uc WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE uc.from_uom_id = @reported_uom_id
              AND uc.to_uom_id = @item_uom_id
              AND (uc.item_id = @item_id OR uc.item_id IS NULL)
            ORDER BY item_id DESC

			IF (@factor IS NULL OR @offset IS NULL) BEGIN
				SELECT @item_uom_desc = um.description FROM uom um WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE um.uom_id = @item_uom_id

				SET @error_message = 'A conversion factor does not exist in the database to convert from %1 to %2{9999},' + @prod_qty_uom + ',' + @item_uom_desc
				RAISERROR (@error_message, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			--Convert the quantities to native units of this item.
			SET @qty_prod = (@qty_prod * @factor) + @offset
		END
    END

    --Verify whether a job exists.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	         WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND (j.batch_size = @batch_size OR @batch_size IS NULL)
			  AND (j.est_prod_rate = @target_prod_rate OR @target_prod_rate IS NULL)
			  AND (j.prod_uom = @target_prod_rate_uom OR @target_prod_rate_uom IS NULL))

			--Get the job that has the same work order, operation, batch size, production rate and production uom.
			--If any of this differs, then a new job ought to be created.
			SELECT TOP 1 @cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
              AND (j.batch_size = @batch_size OR @batch_size IS NULL)
			  AND (j.est_prod_rate = @target_prod_rate OR @target_prod_rate IS NULL)
			  AND (j.prod_uom = @target_prod_rate_uom OR @target_prod_rate_uom IS NULL)
	ELSE BEGIN
		--There is no such job exist with this configuration. Create new job.
		--Verify whether we have a work order.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
            --The work order does not exist, create a new work order.
			EXEC sp_I_Wo  @wo_id=@wo_id, @wo_desc=@wo_id,
                    @process_id=NULL, @bom_ver_id=NULL, @spec_ver_id=NULL, @item_id=@item_id,
                    @req_qty=0, @release_time_local=NULL,@release_time_tz=NULL, @req_finish_time_local=NULL,@req_finish_time_tz=NULL, @state_cd=1, @wo_priority=NULL,
                    @cust_info=NULL, @mo_id=NULL, @production_schedule_id=@in_production_schedule_id,
                    @notes=NULL, @not_deletable=0, @disassembly=0, @may_override_route=0, @override_serialization=0,
                    @input_wo_id=NULL, @input_oper_id=NULL, @input_seq_no=NULL,
                    @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
                    @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value,
                    @mod_id=@error_message OUTPUT

		SELECT @deviation_above = CAST(sa.attr_value AS FLOAT) FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 103

		SELECT @deviation_below = CAST(sa.attr_value AS FLOAT) FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 104

		SELECT @deviation_above = COALESCE(@deviation_above, 0), @deviation_below = COALESCE(@deviation_below, 0)

		--Get the next highest sequence number
        SELECT @cur_seq_no = MAX(j.seq_no), @display_seq = MAX(j.display_seq)
        FROM job j WITH (UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK)
        WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND j.oper_id = @oper_id

		SELECT @cur_seq_no = COALESCE(@cur_seq_no, -1) + 1, @display_seq = COALESCE(@display_seq, -1) + 1

		--Create a new job.
        EXEC sp_I_Job @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
              @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @job_desc=@oper_id,
              @item_id=@item_id, @state_cd=2, @job_priority=1, @req_finish_time_local=NULL, @req_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @init_sched_ent_id=@run_ent_id, @target_sched_ent_id=@run_ent_id, @run_ent_id=NULL,
              @qty_reqd=@reqd_qty, @qty_prod=0, @qty_prod_erp=0, @qty_rejected=0, @qty_rejected_erp=0,
              @qty_at_start=@start_qty, @deviation_above=@deviation_above,
              @deviation_below=@deviation_below, @batch_size=@batch_size,
              @first_job=0, @final_job=0, @sched_pinned=0, @check_inv=0, @est_fixed_lab=NULL, @est_lab_rate=NULL,
              @est_setup_time=NULL, @est_teardown_time=NULL, @est_prod_rate=@target_prod_rate,
              @prod_uom=@target_prod_rate_uom, @est_transfer_time=NULL, @sched_start_time_local=NULL, @sched_start_time_tz=NULL,
              @latest_start_time_local=NULL, @latest_start_time_tz=NULL, @sched_finish_time_local=NULL, @sched_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @act_start_time_local=NULL, @act_start_time_tz=NULL,  @act_finish_time_local=NULL,  @act_finish_time_tz=NULL,
              @concurrent_link=0, @job_cost=NULL, @parent_contingent_job=NULL, @child_contingent_job=NULL, @notes=NULL,
              @assoc_file=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @display_seq=@display_seq,
              @folder_ver_id=NULL, @rework=0, @rework_cd=NULL, @rework_process_id=NULL,
              @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL,
              @time_zone_bias_value=NULL,
              @create_job_bom=1, @edit_time=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

		--Update the BOM flags.
        IF (@update_inventory = 1)
            UPDATE job_bom SET update_inv = 1
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
              AND oper_id = @oper_id
              AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
              AND bom_pos = 0
	END

    --Verify whether the current item is the job BOM 0 item, If this is not the job BOM 0 item, create this as a substitute item, and set the current production as the substitute item.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND jb.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
          AND jb.bom_pos = 0
          AND jb.item_id = @item_id)

        SELECT @cur_item_id = jb.item_id, @current_subst = jb.current_subst
        FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND jb.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
          AND jb.bom_pos = 0
          AND jb.item_id = @item_id
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Verify whether we have this substitute item.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE jbst.wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND jbst.oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND jbst.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
                  AND jbst.bom_pos = 0
                  AND jbst.item_id = @item_id) BEGIN

			SELECT @cur_item_id = jbst.item_id, @alt_no = jbst.alt_no
			FROM job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE jbst.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND jbst.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND jbst.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND jbst.bom_pos = 0
			  AND jbst.item_id = @item_id

			IF (COALESCE(@current_subst, -1) <> @alt_no)
                --Update the current BOM 0 item to use this substitute.
                UPDATE job_bom
                SET current_subst = @current_subst
                WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
                  AND bom_pos = 0
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
            --Get the next available substitute number.
            SELECT @current_subst = MAX(jbst.alt_no)
            FROM job_bom_subst jbst WITH (UPDLOCK ROWLOCK)
            WHERE jbst.wo_id = @wo_id
              AND jbst.oper_id = @oper_id
              AND jbst.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
              AND jbst.bom_pos = 0

            --Get the next available current substitute number.
            SET @current_subst = COALESCE(@current_subst, -1) + 1

            --Create this item as a substitute item.
            EXEC sp_I_Job_Bom_Subst @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id,
                @seq_no=@cur_seq_no, @bom_pos=0, @alt_no=@current_subst,
                @pref=1, @subst_level=0, @item_id=@item_id, @reqd_grade_cd=NULL,
                @instruction=NULL, @qty_per_parent_item=1, @max_qty_per_parent_item=NULL, @min_qty_per_parent_item=NULL,
                @reqd_start_val=0, @reqd_start_val_is_pct=0, @update_inv=@update_inventory,
                @backflush=0, @def_reas_cd=NULL, @def_lot_no=NULL, @def_storage_ent_id=NULL, @def_reject_ent_id=NULL,
                @scaling_factor=NULL, @must_consume_from_inv=0, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc=1, @may_create_new_lots=1,
                @must_consume_from_wip=0, @must_consume_before_prod=0, @constant_qty=0, @est_time=NULL,
                @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

            --Update the current BOM 0 item to use this substitute.
            UPDATE job_bom
            SET current_subst = @current_subst
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
              AND oper_id = @oper_id
              AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
			  AND bom_pos = 0
		END
	END

    --Verify whether this job is running on any entity.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
				  AND je.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no)

        SELECT @cur_run_ent_id = je.ent_id, @cur_job_pos = je.job_pos
        FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
          AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
          AND je.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	ELSE BEGIN
		--This job is NOT currently running on any entity.
		--Verify whether we have enough job positions to start this job.
		SET @cur_job_pos = NULL
		--Get the available job position.
		SELECT @cur_job_pos = MIN(je.job_pos)
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id
		  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NULL

		SET @cur_job_pos = COALESCE(@cur_job_pos, -1)

		IF (@cur_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
			--We don't have enough job positions on this entity.
			--Stop the oldest running job on this entity.
            SELECT @temp_wo_id = j.wo_id, @temp_oper_id = j.oper_id, @temp_seq_no = j.seq_no,
					@cur_job_pos = je.job_pos
            FROM
                (SELECT MIN(j.act_start_time_utc) act_start_time_utc
                FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
                INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
                WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id) min_job
            INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.act_start_time_utc = min_job.act_start_time_utc
            INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.cur_wo_id = j.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = j.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = j.seq_no
            WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id

			--End the identified job.
            EXEC SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ENDBATCHJOBS @ent_id=@run_ent_id,
                    @wo_id=@temp_wo_id, @oper_id=@temp_oper_id,
                    @seq_no=@temp_seq_no, @job_pos=@cur_job_pos,
                    @status_notes= NULL, @user_id= NULL,
                    @check_privs= 0, @check_certs= NULL, @client_type= NULL, @no_propogation= NULL,
                    @check_auto_job_start= 0, @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
                    @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value

		END
	END

	IF (@cur_run_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Get the available job position.
		SET @cur_job_pos = NULL
		--Get the available job position.
		SELECT @cur_job_pos = MIN(je.job_pos)
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @run_ent_id
		  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NULL AND je.cur_oper_id IS NULL

		SET @cur_job_pos = COALESCE(@cur_job_pos, -1)

		--This job is not currently running.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id,
            @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id,
            @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
            @job_pos=@cur_job_pos, @status_notes=NULL,
            @check_privs=0, @check_certs=0,
            @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
            @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @run_ent_id = @cur_run_ent_id

        --Get the entity_name
		SELECT @run_ent_name = e.ent_name, @run_ent_site_name = ste.site_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
        --ID of ancestor entity that defines site of this entity if = ent_id, this entity is a site.
        --Null for entities above sites, or for single-site systems
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.site = site_ent.ent_id
        --Name of this site
		LEFT OUTER JOIN site ste WITH (NOLOCK) ON ste.ent_id = site_ent.ent_id
		WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id
    END

	--Verify whether the request is to start a subsegment or to add a production.
    IF (@qty_prod <> 0) BEGIN
		--Delegate to add prod to add production
		EXEC sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdByName @session_id=@in_session_id,
			@event_time_local=@event_time_local,
            @user_id=@user_id, @ent_name=@run_ent_name,
            @site_name=@run_ent_site_name, @job_pos=@cur_job_pos,
            @qty_prod=@qty_prod, @reas_cd=@reas_cd,
            @lot_no=@to_lot_no, @sublot_no=@to_sublot_no,
            @to_ent_name=@to_ent_name, @to_site_name=@to_ent_site_name,
            @item_id=@item_id, @byproduct_bom_pos=0,
            @ext_ref=NULL, @apply_scaling_factor=0, @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id,
            @event_id=@event_id, @segment_requirement_id=@segment_requirement_id,
            @segment_response_id=@segment_response_id, @comments=@comments,
            @spare1=@in_spare1, @spare2=@in_spare2,
            @spare3=@in_spare3, @spare4=@in_spare4,
            @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT,
            @prod_info=@warning_message OUTPUT
	END
	--Log Job Event and EPA data.
    Exec SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ADDPEMDATA @event_type='Material Produced Actual', @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
        @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no,
        @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@to_lot_no, @sublot_no=@to_sublot_no,
        @ent_name=@run_ent_name, @site_name=@run_ent_site_name,
        @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id, @segment_requirement_id=@segment_requirement_id,
        @segment_response_id=@segment_response_id, @subsegment_id=@subsegment_id,
        @quantity=@in_qty_prod, @item_uom=@in_prod_qty_uom, @comments=@comments,
        @production_schedule_id=@production_schedule_id, @location_name=@to_ent_name,
        @location_site_name=@to_ent_site_name, @personnel_list=@personnel_list,
        @serial_no_list=@serial_no_list, @event_name=@event_name,
        @equipment_id=NULL, @grp_desc=@grp_desc, @extended_attrs=@extended_prod_attrs,
        @bom_pos=0, @ref_row_id=@row_id, @material_type=@in_reas_desc,
        @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr]
(
	@item_id			STRING80 = NULL
,	@lot_no				STRING80 = NULL
,	@attr_id			INT32 = NULL
,	@remove_attr_col	LOGICAL = 0
,	@remove_inv_lot		LOGICAL = 0

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr
-- Description				- HD# 6192, Update Inventory lot attribute table automatically based on the attribute or lot attribute changes.
-- Author					- Raghu
-- Date Created				- 11/17/2005
-- Version					- 3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (C) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 02/16/2006		Raghu			3.1.10	HD# 7489, attribute values are not updated properly in the inv_lot_attr_table
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	HD# 9207, Part of DB Changes
--01/06/2008		Raghu		    3.4	    L00073212, L00073016: Exclude column names that starts with the table name
--08/07/2012		Arun		    4.5	    Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
--11/17/2015		Varun		    5.2     CR L00139147 Merge changes (HF CR #L00139028): The following changes are done to optimize the stored procedure.
--											1. Modified the ALTER TABLE statement to add 'attr<att_id>d_h' column with not null and attribute description as
--												default value instead of adding the column with null value and making it not null later.
--											2. Removed the cursor which is looping through each attribute column of the inv_lot_attr.
--											   Modified the update statement to update only the columns related to newly added attribute in the table.
--06/03/2015        Srinivas        6.2     CR L00136163.attr# column type changed to store 1700 characters for attribute value.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
--WARNING: Caller should call this procedure ONLY AFTER finishing all his/her transactions.
--Any exception/error raised from the caller procedure must be rolled back there itself and the call should not
--enter here. Since DDL operations are involved here such as adding additional columns OR dropping columns, all
--the transactions for this session are commited automatically; and any errors from the calling procedures may
--NOT get rolled back.
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @col_name		STRING80
	,	@col_id			INT32
	,	@desc_col_names	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@desc_vals		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@SQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@attr_id_col	STRING80
	,	@attr_desc		STRING80
	,	@attr_value		STRING1700
	,	@attr_id_temp	INT32
	,   @DefaultConstraintName NVARCHAR(200)

	-- do nothing if nothing is supplied. Proceed ONLY if a job OR attr_id or both are supplied.
	IF (@item_id IS NULL AND @attr_id IS NULL)  RETURN

	SELECT @remove_attr_col = ISNULL(@remove_attr_col, 0), @remove_inv_lot = ISNULL(@remove_inv_lot, 0)

	--Check if the call is to remove an attribute column.
	IF (@remove_attr_col = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@attr_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
				  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN
				--Since the supplied attribute column exists, remove this attribute column
				--from the inv_lot_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_lot_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

				--Also, remove the attr_id_d_h column and its default constraint from the inv_lot_attr table.
				SELECT @DefaultConstraintName = Name
				FROM SYS.DEFAULT_CONSTRAINTS WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE PARENT_OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID(N'inv_lot_attr')
				AND PARENT_COLUMN_ID = (SELECT column_id FROM sys.columns WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE NAME = @attr_id_col + N'd_h'
				AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'inv_lot_attr'))

				IF @DefaultConstraintName IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					EXEC('ALTER TABLE inv_lot_attr DROP CONSTRAINT ' + @DefaultConstraintName)
				END

				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_lot_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
			END

			--Check if any attributes are made visible in the inventory. If none of the attributes are made
			--visible for the inventory, then remove all the lot attributes from the inv_lot_attr table.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
				  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0)
				--DELETE lots from the inv_lot_attr table where lot equals:
				--i) There are no lot attributes exist for this item
				--ii) or there are no lot attributes that can be made visible in the inventory.
				DELETE FROM inv_lot_attr
				FROM
					(SELECT ila.inv_lot_item_id_h, ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h
					FROM lot_attr la
					INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
							FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
							AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
					  		AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON la.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
					RIGHT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila ON ila.inv_lot_item_id_h = la.item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h = la.lot_no
					WHERE la.item_id IS NULL) lot_attr_temp
				WHERE inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_item_id_h = lot_attr_temp.inv_lot_item_id_h AND inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_lot_no_h = lot_attr_temp.inv_lot_lot_no_h
			ELSE
				--Delete all the rows from the inv_lot_attr table.
				--i) either there are no attributes assigned for any lots
				--ii)or there no lot attributes that are made visible for the inventory.
				DELETE FROM inv_lot_attr
		END
		RETURN
	END

	--Check whether the supplied lot attribute can be included in the inventory.
	SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr
	WHERE attr_id = @attr_id AND visible_in_inv = 1

	--Do nothing if the current attribute cannot be included in the inventory.
	IF (@attr_desc IS NULL) RETURN

	--Generate a list of all attribute description columns.
	SET @desc_col_names = ''

	--Handle the inventory lot first to insert a new row in the inv_lot_attr table.
	--do this ONLY if the inventory lot is not null AND we are inserting OR updating a lot attribute.
	IF (@remove_inv_lot = 0) AND (@item_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inv_lot_attr WHERE inv_lot_item_id_h = @item_id AND inv_lot_lot_no_h = @lot_no) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inv_lot_attr) BEGIN
			DECLARE inv_lot_attr_col_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT name, colid
			FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
			ORDER BY colid

			OPEN inv_lot_attr_col_csr
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM inv_lot_attr_col_csr INTO @col_name, @col_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Generate a list of all attribute description columns; since this is a non-null column in the database.
				IF CHARINDEX('d_h', @col_name) > 0
					SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @col_name + ','
			END
			CLOSE inv_lot_attr_col_csr
			DEALLOCATE inv_lot_attr_col_csr

			--Atleast if any 1 row exists for the inv_lot_attr, then duplicate that row for the new lot attribute
			--SELECT * FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = ',' + LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') BEGIN
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO inv_lot_attr (inv_lot_item_id_h,inv_lot_lot_no_h' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT TOP 1 @item_id, @lot_no' + @desc_col_names + ' FROM inv_lot_attr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40, @lot_no STRING40', @item_id, @lot_no
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--There are no rows in the inv_lot_attr table.
			--Create this lot attribute and automatically fill the attribute values in the appropriate attribute columns.
			SELECT @desc_col_names = '', @desc_vals = ''
			DECLARE inv_lot_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
			FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
			  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

			OPEN inv_lot_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM inv_lot_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Since the attribute description column does not allow NULLs,
				--just update now with a dummy value. Since there are no rows, and since we're
				--creating the first row (ONLY for this row), peformance MAY NOT be a problem.
				SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
				SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
			END
			CLOSE inv_lot_attr_cursor

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
				IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
				IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO inv_lot_attr (inv_lot_item_id_h,inv_lot_lot_no_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' VALUES (@item_id,@lot_no,' + @desc_vals + ')'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40, @lot_no STRING40', @item_id, @lot_no
			END
			ELSE INSERT INTO inv_lot_attr (inv_lot_item_id_h,inv_lot_lot_no_h) VALUES (@item_id,@lot_no)

			OPEN inv_lot_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM inv_lot_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_lot_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '=atr.attr_desc FROM '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT a.attr_id, a.attr_desc, la.item_id, la.lot_no, la.attr_value '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM attr a '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN lot_attr la ON la.attr_id = a.attr_id AND la.item_id = @item_id AND la.lot_no = @lot_no '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE a.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40, @lot_no STRING40, @attr_id_temp INT32', @item_id, @lot_no, @attr_id_temp
			END
			CLOSE inv_lot_attr_cursor
			DEALLOCATE inv_lot_attr_cursor
		END
	END

	SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)

	--Check whether a column for this attribute name exists.
	IF(@remove_inv_lot = 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
		  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN

		--If not, create a column name for this attribute.
		--Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_lot_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + ' STRING1700_NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--If not, create the attribute description column as NULL now, since row may already exists
		--in this table. After updating the attribute description column, this column can be
		--changed to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE inv_lot_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NOT NULL DEFAULT ''' + @attr_desc + ''' WITH VALUES'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL -- CR L00139147 Changes
	END

	IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Retrieve the lot attribute value for this column.
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM lot_attr
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lot_no = @lot_no AND attr_id = @attr_id

		IF (@remove_inv_lot = 1)
			DELETE FROM inv_lot_attr
			FROM
				(SELECT ila.inv_lot_item_id_h, ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h
				FROM lot_attr la
				INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
						FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
						AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
				  		AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON la.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
				RIGHT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila ON ila.inv_lot_item_id_h = la.item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h = la.lot_no
				WHERE ila.inv_lot_item_id_h = @item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h = @lot_no AND la.item_id IS NULL) lot_attr
			WHERE inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_item_id_h = @item_id AND inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_lot_no_h = @lot_no
			  AND inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_item_id_h = lot_attr.inv_lot_item_id_h AND inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_lot_no_h = lot_attr.inv_lot_lot_no_h

		--Update the attribute value for this lot attr
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_lot_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + ' = @attr_value WHERE inv_lot_item_id_h = @item_id AND inv_lot_lot_no_h = @lot_no'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_value STRING1700, @item_id STRING40, @lot_no STRING40', @attr_value, @item_id, @lot_no
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Create a lot row if lot_attr row DOES NOT exist
		SET @desc_vals = ''
		DECLARE inv_lot_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
		FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'INV_LOT%'
		  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

		OPEN inv_lot_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM inv_lot_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
			SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
		END
		CLOSE inv_lot_attr_cursor
		DEALLOCATE inv_lot_attr_cursor -- CR L00139147 Changes

		IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
			IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
			SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO inv_lot_attr (inv_lot_item_id_h, inv_lot_lot_no_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT la.item_id,la.lot_no,' + @desc_vals + ' FROM lot_attr la WITH (NOLOCK) ' -- CR L00139147 Changes
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila ON ila.inv_lot_item_id_h = la.item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h = la.lot_no'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' WHERE la.attr_id = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), @attr_id) + ' AND ila.inv_lot_item_id_h IS NULL'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
		END
			-- CR L00139147 Changes
			SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + 'd_h'
			SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_lot_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '=atr.attr_value,'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '=@attr_desc FROM '
			SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT ila.inv_lot_item_id_h, ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h, la.attr_value '
			SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM inv_lot_attr ila WITH (NOLOCK) '
			SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN lot_attr la ON la.item_id = ila.inv_lot_item_id_h AND la.lot_no = ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h AND la.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr '
			SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_item_id_h=atr.inv_lot_item_id_h AND inv_lot_attr.inv_lot_lot_no_h=atr.inv_lot_lot_no_h' -- AND inv_lot_attr.' + @attr_id_col + '=@dummy_val'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id_temp INT32, @attr_desc STRING80', @attr_id, @attr_desc
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_LE_GetLabrStrtForAShift]
(@in_user_id			STRING40
,@in_ent_id			INT32
,@in_shift_start_time		TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_use_previous_shift		INT32 = 0
,@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
,@labor_start_time		TDATETIME = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_LE_GetLaborStartTime
-- Description	      -	Gets the first labor start time for an entity optionally filtered by the supplied shift start time.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	09/28/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @shift_start_time	TDATETIME
	, @shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32
	,@prev_shift_start_time	TDATETIME
	,@prev_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
BEGIN
	--Default the time_zone_bias_value parameter to 0; if not supplied.
	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@in_time_zone_bias_value, 0)
		,@shift_start_time = @in_shift_start_time
		,@in_use_previous_shift = COALESCE(@in_use_previous_shift, 0)

	SET @shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_time )

	--Verify whether the supplied start time is not null
	--If a shift start time is supplied, then get the previous shift start time from the supplied shift start time.
	IF (@in_shift_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The supplied shift start time is NULL;
		--default to the current shift start as the start time from the supplied entity.
		SELECT @shift_start_time = cur_shift_start_time_local, @shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @in_ent_id

		--Verify whether the current shift_start_time IS NOT NULL for the supplied entity.
		--If still NULL, then default to the current datetime.
		--If datetimes are not stored in GMT, then default the shift start time to current time
		SET @shift_start_time = COALESCE(@shift_start_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))
		--If datetimes are stored in GMT, then default the shift start time to GMT time
		SET @shift_start_time_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_time_utc, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	IF (@in_shift_start_time IS NULL) AND (@in_use_previous_shift = 1)  BEGIN
		EXEC sp_SA_Labr_Exec_GetPrvShftStrt @user_id=@in_user_id, @ent_id=@in_ent_id, @shift_start_time=NULL
			,@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @prev_shift_start_time=@prev_shift_start_time OUTPUT

		SET @prev_shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @prev_shift_start_time)
	END
	ELSE
		--The supplied shift start time paramter does not contain a null value; and the caller is not looking for a previous shift
		--Adjust the shift start time using the time zone bias value.
		IF (@in_shift_start_time IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @prev_shift_start_time_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_time)
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @prev_shift_start_time = @shift_start_time
		end

	--Get the previous shift start time
	SELECT TOP 1 @labor_start_time = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, MIN(labor_start_utc))
	FROM labor_usage WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE user_id = @in_user_id
	  AND ent_id = @in_ent_id
	  AND shift_start_utc >= @prev_shift_start_time_utc
	  AND shift_id > 0
END

-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on res_std_oper_link table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu

-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

/*
--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_ofi_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData]
--  
-- Description - Returns all job_bom records with the filters supplied in.
--			Also, if a substitution is set to a job_bom record, then it returns the substitute record
--			for the specific bom_pos	
--			This sp is derived from STD store sprocedure - sp_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData, only handled the decimal values upto 4 places
-- Usage - 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		Shuvam\Lavkesh	2024-01-30			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
*/


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ofi_SA_Job_Bom_GetJobBomData]
(
 @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@seq_no	INT
,@bom_pos	INT		= NULL) AS
--set @wo_id=50673204
--set @seq_no=0
--set @bom_pos= NULL
--set @oper_id='CakeBlending'

DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(10)

SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT  jb.wo_id, jb.oper_id, jb.seq_no, jb.bom_pos,
	'job_bom_subst_exist' = CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = jb.wo_id AND oper_id = jb.oper_id AND seq_no = jb.seq_no AND bom_pos = jb.bom_pos) = 1 THEN 1
				ELSE 0 END,
	jb.current_subst, jbst.pref, jbst.subst_level,
	'item_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END,
	'item_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END,
		CASE
			WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END
			WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END
			WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END + '(' + CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END + ')'
			WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_desc ELSE jbst.item_desc END + '(' + CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_id ELSE jbst.item_id END + ')'
		END AS item_display,
	'uom_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.uom_id ELSE jbst.uom_id END,
	'description' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.description ELSE jbst.description END,
	'abbreviation' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.abbreviation ELSE jbst.abbreviation END,
	'lifetime' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.lifetime ELSE jbst.lifetime END,
	'reqd_grade_cd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_grade_cd ELSE jbst.reqd_grade_cd END,
	'item_grade_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_grade_desc ELSE jbst.item_grade_desc END,
	'color' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.color ELSE jbst.color END,
	'instruction' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.instruction ELSE jbst.instruction END,
	'qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN Round(jb.qty_per_parent_item,4) ELSE Round(jbst.qty_per_parent_item,4) END,
	'max_qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN Round(jb.max_qty_per_parent_item,4) ELSE Round(jbst.max_qty_per_parent_item,4) END,
	'min_qty_per_parent_item' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN Round(jb.min_qty_per_parent_item,4) ELSE Round(jbst.min_qty_per_parent_item,4) END,
	'reqd_start_val' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_start_val ELSE jbst.reqd_start_val END,
	'reqd_start_val_is_pct' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reqd_start_val_is_pct ELSE jbst.reqd_start_val_is_pct END,
	'qty_prod' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_prod ELSE jbst.qty_prod END,
	'qty_rejected' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_rejected ELSE jbst.qty_rejected END,
	'update_inv' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.update_inv ELSE jbst.update_inv END,
	'backflush' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.backflush ELSE jbst.backflush END,
	'def_reas_cd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_reas_cd ELSE jbst.def_reas_cd END,
	'reas_desc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.reas_desc ELSE jbst.reas_desc END,
	'def_lot_no' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_lot_no ELSE jbst.def_lot_no END,
	'def_sublot_no' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_sublot_no ELSE jbst.def_sublot_no END,
	'def_storage_ent_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.def_storage_ent_id ELSE jbst.def_storage_ent_id END,
	'ent_name' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.ent_name ELSE jbst.ent_name END,
	'scaling_factor' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.scaling_factor ELSE jbst.scaling_factor END,
	'must_consume_from_inv' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_from_inv ELSE jbst.must_consume_from_inv END,
	'may_choose_alt_inv_loc' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.may_choose_alt_inv_loc ELSE jbst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc END,
	'may_create_new_lots' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.may_create_new_lots ELSE jbst.may_create_new_lots END,
	'must_consume_from_wip' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_from_wip ELSE jbst.must_consume_from_wip END,
	'must_consume_before_prod' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.must_consume_before_prod ELSE jbst.must_consume_before_prod END,
	'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.consumed_so_far ELSE jbst.consumed_so_far END,
	'constant_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.constant_qty ELSE jbst.constant_qty END,
	'est_time' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.est_time ELSE jbst.est_time END,
	'spare1' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare1 ELSE jbst.spare1 END,
	'spare2' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare2 ELSE jbst.spare2 END,
	'spare3' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare3 ELSE jbst.spare3 END,
	'spare4' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.spare4 ELSE jbst.spare4 END,
	'qty_reqd' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_reqd ELSE jbst.qty_reqd END,
	'qty_at_start' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_at_start ELSE jbst.qty_at_start END,
	'num_decimals' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.num_decimals ELSE jbst.num_decimals END,
	'item_spare1' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare1 ELSE jbst.item_spare1 END,
	'item_spare2' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare2 ELSE jbst.item_spare2 END,
	'item_spare3' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare3 ELSE jbst.item_spare3 END,
	'item_spare4' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.item_spare4 ELSE jbst.item_spare4 END,
	'last_edit_comment' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_comment ELSE jbst.last_edit_comment END,
	'last_edit_by' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_by ELSE jbst.last_edit_by END,
	'last_edit_at' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.last_edit_at ELSE jbst.last_edit_at END,
	'qty_used_in_steps' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.qty_used_in_steps ELSE jbst.qty_used_in_steps END,
	'mod_id' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.mod_id ELSE NULL END,
	'actual_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_qty ELSE jbst.actual_qty END,
	'actual_min_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_min_qty ELSE jbst.actual_min_qty END,
	'actual_max_qty' = CASE WHEN jb.current_subst IS NULL THEN jb.actual_max_qty ELSE jbst.actual_max_qty END,
	'qty_good_at_bom_pos' = COALESCE(jb.qty_good_at_bom_pos, 0),
	'qty_rejected_at_bom_pos' = COALESCE(jb.qty_rejected_at_bom_pos, 0)
FROM (SELECT job_bom.wo_id, job_bom.oper_id, job_bom.seq_no, job_bom.bom_pos, job_bom.current_subst, job_bom.item_id, item.item_desc,
		item.uom_id, uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,
		job_bom.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom.instruction, job_bom.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom.reqd_start_val, job_bom.reqd_start_val_is_pct,
		job_bom.update_inv, job_bom.backflush, job_bom.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, job_bom.def_lot_no, job_bom.def_sublot_no,
		job_bom.def_storage_ent_id, ent.ent_name, job_bom.scaling_factor, job_bom.must_consume_from_inv,
		job_bom.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, job_bom.may_create_new_lots, job_bom.must_consume_from_wip,
		job_bom.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom.constant_qty, job_bom.est_time,
		job_bom.spare1, job_bom.spare2, job_bom.spare3, job_bom.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom.last_edit_comment, job_bom.last_edit_by, job_bom.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_bom.mod_id))) mod_id,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.qty_per_parent_item
		 ELSE CASE WHEN (job.qty_at_start IS NULL) THEN job_bom.qty_reqd
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
          END
		 END AS actual_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_min_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_max_qty
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN job_bom.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_good_at_bom_pos
		, ROUND(CASE WHEN job_bom.bom_pos < 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 1
			)
			WHEN job_bom.bom_pos = 0 THEN
			(SELECT SUM(ip.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = job_bom.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = job_bom.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = job_bom.seq_no AND ip.item_id = job_bom.item_id
			  AND ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 0
			)
		ELSE 0
		END, item.num_decimals) AS qty_rejected_at_bom_pos
	FROM job_bom job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.seq_no = @seq_no or @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
--	  AND (job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
--	  AND (job_bom.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	) jb LEFT OUTER JOIN
	(SELECT job_bom_subst.wo_id, job_bom_subst.oper_id, job_bom_subst.seq_no, job_bom_subst.bom_pos, job_bom_subst.alt_no,
		job_bom_subst.pref, job_bom_subst.subst_level, job_bom_subst.item_id, item.item_desc, item.uom_id,
		uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime,
		job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc, item_grade.color, job_bom_subst.instruction, job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item,
		job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item, job_bom_subst.reqd_start_val, job_bom_subst.reqd_start_val_is_pct,
		job_bom_subst.update_inv, job_bom_subst.backflush, job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd, item_reas.reas_desc, job_bom_subst.def_lot_no, job_bom_subst.def_sublot_no,
		job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id, ent.ent_name, job_bom_subst.scaling_factor, job_bom_subst.must_consume_from_inv,
		job_bom_subst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, job_bom_subst.may_create_new_lots, job_bom_subst.must_consume_from_wip,
		job_bom_subst.must_consume_before_prod,
	        'consumed_so_far' = CASE WHEN job_bom_subst.bom_pos >= 0 THEN
					ISNULL((SELECT SUM(qty_cons) FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
						  AND item_id = job_bom_subst.item_id AND item_cons.item_scrapped =0 AND transaction_type = 0), 0)
		 		      ELSE 0
		END,
		job_bom_subst.constant_qty, job_bom_subst.est_time,
		job_bom_subst.spare1, job_bom_subst.spare2, job_bom_subst.spare3, job_bom_subst.spare4, job.qty_reqd, job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals,
		item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4,
		job_bom_subst.last_edit_comment, job_bom_subst.last_edit_by, job_bom_subst.last_edit_at,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item,0)), 0) FROM job_bom_step WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE wo_id = job_bom_subst.wo_id AND oper_id = job_bom_subst.oper_id AND seq_no = job_bom_subst.seq_no
		    AND bom_pos = job_bom_subst.bom_pos AND bom_pos <> 0) qty_used_in_steps,
		job.qty_prod, job.qty_rejected,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item
		 ELSE CASE WHEN (job.qty_at_start IS NULL) THEN job.qty_reqd
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
          END
		 END AS actual_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_min_qty,
    	CASE WHEN (job_bom_subst.constant_qty <> 0) THEN job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item
		  ELSE CASE WHEN job.qty_at_start > (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected) THEN
		    Round(job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item * job.qty_at_start, item.num_decimals)
		    ELSE Round(job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item * (job.qty_prod + job.qty_rejected), item.num_decimals)
			END
		 END AS actual_max_qty
	FROM job_bom_subst job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	INNER JOIN job job WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.wo_id = job.wo_id AND job_bom_subst.oper_id = job.oper_id AND job_bom_subst.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.reqd_grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_bom_subst.def_storage_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (job_bom_subst.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (job_bom_subst.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (job_bom_subst.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL))
--	  AND (job_bom_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
--	  AND (job_bom_subst.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	) jbst
ON jb.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbst.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbst.bom_pos
AND jb.current_subst = jbst.alt_no
END

	,	item_cons.segment_response_id
	,	item_cons.comments
	,	item_cons.spare1
	,	item_cons.spare2
	,	item_cons.spare3
	,	item_cons.spare4
	,	item_cons.last_edit_comment
	,	item_cons.last_edit_by
	,	item_cons.last_edit_at
FROM item_cons item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.from_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.shift_id = shift.shift_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state item_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_cons.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
WHERE ((item_cons.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
	   (item_cons.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.shift_start_local = @shift_start_local OR @shift_start_local IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR @fg_lot_no IS NULL) AND
	   (item_cons.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR @fg_sublot_no IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.item_scrapped = @item_scrapped OR @item_scrapped IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.ext_ref = @ext_ref OR @ext_ref IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.transaction_type = @transaction_type OR @transaction_type IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR @upstream_event_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.comments = @comments OR @comments IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (item_cons.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY item.item_desc

BEGIN

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_sa_ofi_qm_sublot
-- Description: This SP will fetch sublots for selected Work order
-- Usage:		Manual Sample request UI
--EXEC [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_sublot] '8105038459'
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
--  0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2024-02-19		Initial version.
--	0.01.01 Veervar Joshi		2024-04-16		Updates for batch maker number selection
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_sublot] @wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
	,@line_id INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @attr_id INT
		,@pline_id INT
	DECLARE @attrLottypedesc NVARCHAR(80) = 'LotTypeForSample' --- BatchMaker or Sublot
	DECLARE @attr_value NVARCHAR(80)
	DECLARE @tblSublot AS TABLE (sublot_no NVARCHAR(80))
	DECLARE @runent_id INT
	DECLARE @oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

	SELECT @runent_id=ent.ent_id			
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ea.ent_id
		INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
		WHERE attr_desc = 'EntityType'
			AND ea.attr_value =	'Segment'
			AND ENT.parent_ent_id=@line_id	
			
		
	--GET OPER ID
	SELECT @oper_id=oper_id FROM job WHERE wo_id=@wo_id and run_ent_id=@runent_id
		

	SELECT @pline_id = line_id
	FROM [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo](@line_id, 0)

	--GET @LotTypeForSample VALUE FOR LINE ID
	SELECT @attr_value = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE ea.ent_id = @pline_id
		AND a.attr_desc = @attrLottypedesc

	IF (@attr_value = 'BatchMaker') 
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @tblSublot
		SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(last_edit_comment) AS sublot_no -- Batch Maker number for Cake Packing
		FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id
	END
	ELSE -- GET ALL SUBLOT NO. FOR WO
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @tblSublot
		SELECT DISTINCT sublot_no
		FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM @tblSublot
			) -- IF THERE IS NO RECORD IN ITEM_PROD IN BOTH CASE THEN SELECT DEF_LOT_NO
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @tblSublot
		SELECT DISTINCT def_lot_no AS sublot_no
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND def_lot_no IS NOT NULL
	END

	SELECT DISTINCT sublot_no
	FROM @tblSublot
	WHERE sublot_no IS NOT NULL
		OR sublot_no <> ''
END
