CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Build_BOM_stack]
(
		@wo_id           		STRING40
	,	@process_id      		STRING40
	,	@parent_item_id  		STRING40
	,	@req_qty         		TFLOAT
	,	@char_start_qty  		STRING20
	,	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME
	,	@oper_id         		STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no          		INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@spec_ver_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      	- SP_BUILD_BOM_STACK
-- Description	      	- same as sp_BUILD_BOM except instead of recursively calling itself it pushes the parameters
--                    	  for that call onto BUILD_BOM_STACK
-- Author             	- KRF
-- Date Created	      	- 03/18/2002
-- Version	      		- 3.1.0.13
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By   	Ver     	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/19/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1001 		-  Changes as per modified spec
-- 05/03/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1002 		-  Parent item being passed for bom stack
-- 05/14/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1003 		-  Null values handled
-- 05/17/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1004 		-  Job BOM generated for sub item boms as well
-- 05/22/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1005 		-  Sub items also passed when creating job specifications
-- 06/17/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1006 		-  Bom zero was not getting created in bom item oper link after database upgrade
-- 07/02/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1007 		-  Above change was reverted
-- 08/23/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1300 		-  Performance bottleneck due to bom_item_oper_link loop avoided
-- 08/27/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1303 		-  BOM correction for process attached to multiple items(#1244)
-- 09/16/2002     	Sheetal Jain  	1400 		-  1244, 1438, 1456
-- 12/12/2003     	Sheetal Jain  	1637 		-  Added column parent_ver_id to temporary table #tmp_bom_item0
-- 08/06/2004     	Sheetal Jain  	2100 		-  HD#4881 - CreateWorkOrderFromProcess should create job_BOM_subst records
-- 03/24/2005     	SJ            	2117 		-  Exit condition for #tmp_bom_item0 changed
-- 04/18/2005     	SJ            	2118 		-  HD#5549 - Bom Pos 0 consumption for a step is not being created when CWOFP is ran
-- 04/10/2006     	SJ            	3114 		-  HD#7782 - Error in Supervisor's Create Work Order from Process
-- 08/27/2007		AML				3.3.0		-  DB Changes
-- 11/26/2009	  AJAY			    4.0		H1423 FIX
-- 06/08/2012      Saiteja          4.5       -- Modified changes for the CR120891(Clone for CRL00120705).
-- 17/10/2012      praveenkumar     4.5       -- Modified changes for the CRL00123288
-- 25/10/2012      praveenkumar     4.6       -- Modified changes for the L00123448(Clone for the CRL00123288)
-- 06/11/2012      praveenkumar     4.6       --Added a insert statement inorder to insert values in job_spec table[Modified changes for the L00119488]
-- 07/08/2013      Ashish		    4.6		  -- Modified for CR-L00127106 cloned from CR-L00126797
-- 01/20/2015	   Naren R      	5.0.1	  -- Modified changes for the CR L00136188. This is derived from HF done under CR L00135077
-- 06/11/2015		Naren			5.0.1		-- Modified changes for the CR L00131526
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	--MISC VARIABLES
	DECLARE @COMPONENTS_FOUND						BIT
		,	@standard_time_to_do_this_job			FLOAT
		,	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc		DATETIME
		,	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local	DATETIME
		,	@float_start_qty						FLOAT
		,	@CharFormOfFloat_start_qty				FLOAT
		,	@start_qty_is_int              			BIT
		,	@para_start_qty							NVARCHAR(20) --this will store the calculated start_qty which is to be passed for recursion
		,	@para_req_qty							NVARCHAR(20)

		-- FIELDS FROM BOM_VER table
  		,	@BV_ver_id						STRING40

		-- fields from JOB table
  		,	@J_oper_id						STRING40
  		,	@J_seq_no						INT
  		,	@J_final_job					LOGICAL
  		,	@J_item_id						STRING40
  		,	@J_est_setup_time				FLOAT
  		,	@J_est_teardown_time			FLOAT
  		,	@J_est_transfer_time			FLOAT
  		,	@J_est_prod_rate				FLOAT

		-- fields for BOM_item_oper_link table
  		,	@BIOL_parent_item_id			STRING40
  		,	@BIOL_ver_id					STRING40
  		,	@BIOL_BOM_pos					INT
  		,	@BIOL_process_id				STRING40
  		,	@BIOL_oper_id					STRING40
  		,	@BIOL_qty_per_parent_item		FLOAT
  		,	@BIOL_reqd_start_pct			FLOAT
  		,	@BIOL_mod_id					TIMESTAMP

		-- fields for BOM_item table
  		,	@BI_item_id                     STRING40
  		,	@BI_qty_per_parent_item         FLOAT

		--fields from JOB_ROUTE and JOB table
  		,	@JR_seq_no                      NVARCHAR(40)
  		,	@JR_input_seq_no                INT32
  		,	@JR_input_oper_id               STRING40
  		,	@DEBUG_STR                      NVARCHAR(2000)
  		,	@system_severity                INT
  		,	@OSV_pref_spec_ver_id           STRING40
  		,	@V_Bom_Pos_Found                LOGICAL
  		,	@V_Count                        INT
  		,	@V_Loop_Chk                     INT
  		,	@V_Sub_Item                     NVARCHAR(40)
  		,	@V_Sub_Ver                      STRING40
  		,	@V_Sub_Bom_Pos                  INT
  		,	@V_Sub_Oper                     STRING40
		,	@req_finish_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@dbg_resp						INT32

		  --Declared the parameter for the CRL00119488
		 , @last_edit_by	                   STRING40
          ,@last_edit_at	                    DATETIME

    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
    SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, NULL, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_Build_BOM_stack', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @req_finish_time_local
	IF(@dbg_resp = 1)
	RETURN

	IF @char_start_qty IS NULL BEGIN
		SET @float_start_qty = @req_qty
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @float_start_qty = CONVERT(FLOAT, @char_start_qty)
	END

	--decide if the start_qty is integer or float (default is float)
	SET @start_qty_is_int = 0	--false

	IF @char_start_qty IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF CHARINDEX('.', @char_start_qty) = 0 --could not find a dot
			SET @start_qty_is_int = 1
	END

	--1	Find ver_id from BOM_VER table using parent_item_id and perfered_ver = 1
	SELECT @BV_ver_id = ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND preferred_ver = 1

	IF @oper_id IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL BEGIN
		--3	Find matching row(s) for given wo_id from JOB table where final_job = true
		DECLARE job_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT	oper_id, seq_no, final_job, item_id, ISNULL(est_setup_time, 0), ISNULL(est_teardown_time, 0),
					ISNULL(est_transfer_time, 0), ISNULL(est_prod_rate, 0)
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--5	Find matching row for given wo_id, oper_id, seq_no from JOB table
		DECLARE job_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT	oper_id, seq_no, final_job, item_id, ISNULL(est_setup_time, 0), ISNULL(est_teardown_time, 0),
					ISNULL(est_transfer_time, 0), ISNULL(est_prod_rate, 0)
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	END

	OPEN job_cursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM job_cursor
	INTO @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @J_final_job, @J_item_id, @J_est_setup_time, @J_est_teardown_time, @J_est_transfer_time, @J_est_prod_rate

	--7	For each row in JOB table (may be multiple final jobs)
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN	--FETCH NEXT FROM job_cursor
		--Get Preferred Spec version for this operation
		SELECT @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id = ver_id
		FROM oper_spec_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @J_oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

		SET @standard_time_to_do_this_job = ISNULL(@J_est_setup_time,0) + ISNULL(@J_est_teardown_time,0) + ISNULL(@J_est_transfer_time,0) + (@J_est_prod_rate * @float_start_qty)

		--Prevent arithmetic overflow due to datatype INT(times adjusted in Sp_Calculate_Times)
		SET @standard_time_to_do_this_job = 1

		SET	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local = DATEADD(HOUR, -ROUND(CONVERT(FLOAT, @standard_time_to_do_this_job), 0), @req_finish_time_local)
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, NULL, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc OUTPUT

		--LATER WE HAVE TO CONSIDER SHIFT SCHEDULE FOR THIS
		IF @BV_ver_id IS NULL BEGIN
			EXECUTE sp_BI_to_Job_BOM 	@process_id, @wo_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, 0, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, 0, 1, 1,
										@BI_item_id = @BI_item_id OUTPUT, @BI_qty_per_parent_item = @BI_qty_per_parent_item OUTPUT

			-- Look in the JOB_ROUTE table and find the JOB(s) feeding this, recursively call sp_BUILD_BOM again
			SET @CharFormOfFloat_start_qty = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @float_start_qty)

			-- Call below changed from sp_LOOK_job_route_table so it ends up calling sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY_stack
			-- which will not call sp_BUILD_BOM but just push the parameters to it in the BUILD_BOM_STACK
			EXECUTE sp_LOOK_job_route_table_stack   @wo_id, @process_id, @parent_item_id, @req_qty, @CharFormOfFloat_start_qty,
													@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no
			--Insert values into job_spec table[Added code for the CRL00119488]
	   INSERT INTO job_spec(wo_id, oper_id, step_no, seq_no, spec_id, spec_value, act_spec_value, assoc_file,
                       assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
                       ( -- retrieve all of the specs assigned to an item from oper_item_spec table
         SELECT @wo_id, ois.oper_id, ois.step_no, @J_seq_no, ois.spec_id, ois.spec_value, NULL, ois.assoc_file,
           ois.assoc_file_type, ois.comments, ois.min_value, ois.max_value, ois.access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM oper_item_spec ois
      INNER JOIN oper_spec_ver osv ON ois.process_id = osv.process_id AND ois.oper_id = osv.oper_id AND ois.ver_id = osv.ver_id
        WHERE ois.process_id = @process_id AND ois.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND ois.item_id = @J_item_id
         AND (ois.ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR ((@spec_ver_id IS NULL) AND osv.preferred_ver = 1))	)
		END  --of -if @BV_ver_id IS NULL
		ELSE BEGIN -- there is a preferred BOM version
			--8 Find bom_pos (matching rows) from BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK for parent_item_id, BOM_VER.ver_id, process_id, JOB.oper_id
			-- CR L00136188 Modify @V_Count logic to find out if is it multi level BOM in the same hierarchy as @parent_item_id
			-- Use CTE (Common Table Iteration) to find the entire item child list under @parent_item_id hierarchy
			WITH ItemHierarchyCTE
			 AS (
			 SELECT item_id
			 FROM bom_item b3
			 WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id and ver_id = @BV_ver_id
			 UNION ALL
			 SELECT b3.item_id
			 FROM bom_item b3
			 INNER JOIN ItemHierarchyCTE ON b3.parent_item_id = ItemHierarchyCTE.item_id
			 WHERE b3.parent_item_id <> @parent_item_id and b3.bom_pos <> 0
			 )
			SELECT @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM BOM_item_oper_link b1 WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE b1.process_id = @process_id AND b1.parent_item_id <> @parent_item_id AND b1.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND
							  b1.parent_item_id NOT IN(
								SELECT i1.item_id FROM item_process_link i1 WITH (NOLOCK)
								WHERE i1.process_id = @process_id AND i1.item_id <> @parent_item_id
							  ) and  b1.parent_item_id IN (select ItemHierarchyCTE.item_id from ItemHierarchyCTE)

			IF @V_Count = 0 BEGIN -- not a multi-level BOM
				DECLARE BOM_item_oper_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
					SELECT	parent_item_id, ver_id, BOM_pos, process_id, oper_id,
							qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, mod_id
					FROM BOM_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE process_id = @process_id AND
						  parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND
						  ver_id = @BV_ver_id AND
						  oper_id = @J_oper_id AND
						  parent_item_id IN (
							SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND oper_id = @J_oper_id
						  )
					ORDER BY bom_pos
			END
			ELSE BEGIN -- @V_Count > 0, i.e is a multi-level BOM
				DECLARE BOM_item_oper_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
					SELECT	parent_item_id, ver_id, BOM_pos, process_id, oper_id,
							qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, mod_id
					FROM BOM_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE process_id = @process_id AND
						  parent_item_id <> @parent_item_id AND
						  oper_id = @J_oper_id AND
						  parent_item_id NOT IN (
							SELECT item_id FROM item_process_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id <> @parent_item_id
						  ) AND
						    parent_item_id IN (
						           SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND oper_id = @J_oper_id
						    )
					ORDER BY bom_pos
			END -- End of "else @V_Count > 0"

			--Check if the item belongs to the parent item's tree
			SELECT @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM #tmp_bom_item WHERE oper_id = @J_oper_id

			--Make sure that the temporary table and the data get formed only once
			IF @V_Count = 0 BEGIN
				SET @V_Count = 0
				DECLARE @V_Item0 NVARCHAR(40), @V_Id0 NVARCHAR(40), @V_Ver0 NVARCHAR(40), @V_PVer NVARCHAR(40)

				CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item0(
					parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), parent_ver_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT
				)

				INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0 ( parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, status )
				VALUES ( @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, 0 )

				WHILE @V_Count = 0 BEGIN
					DECLARE cur_item0 CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, ver_id, item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0

					OPEN cur_item0
					FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_PVer, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
						SET @V_Count = 1
						UPDATE #tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1
						WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Item0 AND parent_ver_id = @V_PVer AND item_id = @V_Id0 AND ver_id = @V_Ver0

						--L00131526 Load only the items which are produced in the operations for the given process
						INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0( parent_item_id, parent_ver_id, item_id, ver_id, status )
						SELECT a.parent_item_id, a.ver_id, a.item_id, b.ver_id, 0
						FROM bom_item a WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN BOM_item_oper_link iter on iter.parent_item_id = a.item_id
							INNER JOIN bom_ver b WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.item_id = b.parent_item_id
						WHERE a.parent_item_id = @V_Id0 AND a.ver_id = @V_Ver0 AND item_id <> @V_Id0
						and iter.bom_pos = 0 and iter.ver_id = b.ver_id and iter.process_id = @process_id

						FETCH cur_item0 INTO @V_Item0, @V_PVer, @V_Ver0, @V_Id0
					END

					CLOSE cur_item0
					DEALLOCATE cur_item0

					IF @V_Count = 1
						SET @V_Count = 0
					ELSE
						SET @V_Count = 1
					END

					--L00131526 Insert into new columns as well
					INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item ( parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status, item_ver_id, actual_parent_item_id )
					VALUES ( @parent_item_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, 0, @J_oper_id, 0, @BV_ver_id, @parent_item_id )

					SET @V_Count = 0

					WHILE @V_Count = 0 BEGIN
						--Recursively get into item-subitems
						DECLARE cur_sub_item CURSOR LOCAL FOR
							SELECT item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id FROM #tmp_bom_item
							WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND status = 0

						OPEN cur_sub_item
						FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper

						WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
							UPDATE #tmp_bom_item SET status = 1
							WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND
								  item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND
								  ver_id = @V_Sub_Ver AND
								  bom_pos = @V_Sub_Bom_Pos AND
								  oper_id = @V_Sub_Oper

							SET @V_Count = 1

							IF @V_Sub_Item = @parent_item_id BEGIN
								--L00131526 Insert into new columns as well
								INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item ( parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status, item_ver_id, actual_parent_item_id )
								SELECT @parent_item_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @J_oper_id, 0, a.ver_id, a.parent_item_id
								FROM bom_item a WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link b WITH (NOLOCK) ON
										a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND
										a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND
										a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
								WHERE b.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND
									  b.process_id = @process_id AND
									  a.parent_item_id IN ( SELECT item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 ) AND
									  a.item_id <> @parent_item_id
							END
							ELSE BEGIN
								--L00131526 Insert into new columns as well
								INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item ( parent_item_id, item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, oper_id, status, item_ver_id, actual_parent_item_id )
								SELECT @parent_item_id, a.item_id, a.ver_id, a.bom_pos, @J_oper_id, 0, a.ver_id, a.parent_item_id
								FROM bom_item a WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN bom_item_oper_link b WITH (NOLOCK) ON
										a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND
										a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND
										a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
								WHERE b.process_id = @process_id AND
									  b.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND
									  a.parent_item_id = @V_Sub_Item AND
									  a.item_id <> @V_Sub_Item
							END

							FETCH cur_sub_item INTO @V_Sub_Item, @V_Sub_Ver, @V_Sub_Bom_Pos, @V_Sub_Oper
						END  --End of @@FETCH_STATUS

						CLOSE cur_sub_item
						DEALLOCATE cur_sub_item

						IF @V_Count = 1
							SET @V_Count = 0
						ELSE
							SET @V_Count = 1

					END  --End of @v_Count = 0

					----L00131526 Update the version of the item.
					--This only update version of the items produced from the operations
					--For remaining items it is their parent item version, same as 'ver_id' column
					update t1 set t1.item_ver_id  = t2.ver_id from #tmp_bom_item t1 join #tmp_bom_item0 t2 on
					t1.item_id = t2.item_id and t1.actual_parent_item_id = t2.parent_item_id and t1.ver_id = t2.parent_ver_id

					DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0

				END  --End of @v_Count = 0

			OPEN BOM_item_oper_link_cursor
			FETCH NEXT FROM BOM_item_oper_link_cursor
			INTO @BIOL_parent_item_id, @BIOL_ver_id, @BIOL_BOM_pos, @BIOL_process_id, @BIOL_oper_id,
			     @BIOL_qty_per_parent_item, @BIOL_reqd_start_pct, @BIOL_mod_id

			--Set Loop check
			SET @V_Loop_Chk = 0

			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BEGIN
				--9  If no bom_pos (records) found then Create a JOB_BOM record with bom_pos = 0 reading data
				--   from BOM_ITEM table (case where no bom_items consumed on this job and item in = item out)
				EXECUTE sp_BI_to_Job_BOM    @process_id, @wo_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, 0, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, 0, 0, 0,	--@J_seq_no, 0, @float_start_qty, 0,
											@BI_item_id OUTPUT, @BI_qty_per_parent_item OUTPUT

				--job BOM substitutions
				EXEC sp_BI_to_Job_BOM_Subst @wo_id, @process_id, @parent_item_id, @BV_ver_id, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, 0, 0, 0

				-- Look in the JOB_ROUTE table and find the JOB(s) feeding this, recursively call sp_BUILD_BOM again
				SET @CharFormOfFloat_start_qty = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @float_start_qty)

				-- Call below changed from sp_LOOK_job_route_table so it ends up calling sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY_stack
				-- which will not call sp_BUILD_BOM but just push the parameters to it in the BUILD_BOM_STACK
				EXECUTE sp_LOOK_job_route_table_stack	@wo_id, @process_id, @parent_item_id, @req_qty, @CharFormOfFloat_start_qty,
														@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no
			END
			ELSE BEGIN --If @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				--11  Else BOM_Item_Oper_Link records found, so BOM items may be consumed in this operation
				--12 For each bom_pos in BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK table
				SELECT @COMPONENTS_FOUND = 0	--SET @COMPONENTS_FOUND TO FALSE

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
					--Check if the item is in the tree
					SELECT @V_Count = COUNT(*) FROM #tmp_bom_item
					WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @BIOL_ver_id AND bom_pos = @BIOL_BOM_pos AND oper_id = @J_oper_id
					--AND item_id = @BIOL_parent_item_id

					--Execute only if record found
					IF @V_Count > 0 BEGIN
						--Check if bom_pos zero found for the operation for the parent item
						IF @BIOL_BOM_pos = 0 SET @V_Bom_Pos_Found = 1 --13 INSERT a row into JOB_BOM table.

						EXECUTE sp_BI_to_Job_BOM	@process_id, @wo_id, @BIOL_parent_item_id, @BIOL_ver_id, @BIOL_BOM_pos, @BIOL_oper_id,
		   											@J_seq_no, @BIOL_BOM_pos, @BIOL_reqd_start_pct, 1,	--this 1 will indicate requ_start_val is pct
													@BI_item_id = @BI_item_id OUTPUT, @BI_qty_per_parent_item = @BI_qty_per_parent_item OUTPUT

						--job BOM substitutions
						EXEC sp_BI_to_Job_BOM_Subst	@wo_id, @process_id, @BIOL_parent_item_id, @BIOL_ver_id, @BIOL_oper_id, @J_seq_no,
													@BIOL_BOM_pos, @BIOL_reqd_start_pct, 1

					--If bom_pos <> 0 then for each step
					--HD#5549
					--	    IF @BIOL_bom_pos != 0

						EXECUTE sp_BIOSL_to_Job_BOM_step	@wo_id, @J_seq_no, @BIOL_parent_item_id, @BIOL_ver_id, @BIOL_BOM_pos,
															@process_id, @BIOL_oper_id

						EXECUTE sp_BIOS_to_Job_spec		@wo_id, @J_seq_no, @process_id, @BIOL_parent_item_id, @BIOL_ver_id, @BIOL_bom_pos,
														@BIOL_process_id, @BIOL_oper_id, @spec_ver_id

						--23	if bom_pos > 0 (components found) then
						IF @BIOL_bom_pos > 0 BEGIN --this one is a component
							--24 Call sp_BUILD_BOM (recursion)
							SELECT @COMPONENTS_FOUND = 1	--SET @COMPONENTS_FOUND TO TRUE

							--decide the start qty for the previous oper
							SET @para_start_qty = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @float_start_qty * @BI_qty_per_parent_item)
							SET @para_req_qty = @req_qty * @BI_qty_per_parent_item

							IF @start_qty_is_int = 1
								SET @para_start_qty = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), ROUND(CONVERT(FLOAT, @para_start_qty), 0))

							--set to the parent item
							SET @BI_item_id = @parent_item_id

							--find out seq_no from the job_route table
							DECLARE Job_Route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
								SELECT JR.input_oper_id, JR.input_seq_no
								FROM Job_Route JR WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN Job J WITH (NOLOCK) ON
										JR.wo_id = J.wo_id AND
										JR.oper_id = J.oper_id AND
										JR.seq_no = J.seq_no
								WHERE JR.wo_id = @wo_id AND
									  JR.oper_id = @J_oper_id AND
									  JR.seq_no = @J_seq_no AND --CHD 2/14 and JR.input_oper_id = @BIOL_oper_id
									  J.item_id = @BI_item_id -- Added this line KRF 3/20/02

							OPEN Job_Route_cursor
							FETCH NEXT FROM Job_Route_cursor INTO @JR_input_oper_id, @JR_input_seq_no

							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
								IF @V_Loop_Chk = 0 BEGIN
									-- Call below changed from  sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY so it
									-- will not call sp_BUILD_BOM but just push the parameters to it in the BUILD_BOM_STACK
									EXECUTE sp_build_BOM_w_pr_ST_QTY_stack	@wo_id,	@process_id, @BI_item_id, @para_req_qty, @para_start_qty,
																			@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, @JR_input_oper_id, @JR_input_seq_no
								END

								FETCH NEXT FROM Job_Route_cursor INTO @JR_input_oper_id, @JR_input_seq_no	--CHD 2/14 @JR_seq_no
							END

							CLOSE job_Route_cursor
							DEALLOCATE job_Route_cursor

							SET @V_Loop_Chk = 1
						END  --End of @BIOL_bom_pos > 0
					END --End of @V_Count > 0

					--26	Next bom_pos in BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK table
					FETCH NEXT FROM BOM_item_oper_link_cursor
					INTO @BIOL_parent_item_id, @BIOL_ver_id, @BIOL_BOM_pos, @BIOL_process_id, @BIOL_oper_id,
						 @BIOL_qty_per_parent_item,	@BIOL_reqd_start_pct, @BIOL_mod_id

				END	--For each bom_pos in BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK table

				--27 If none of the rows found in BOM_ITEM_OPER_LINK were components (no components found) then
				IF @COMPONENTS_FOUND = 0 BEGIN
					SET @CharFormOfFloat_start_qty = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @float_start_qty)

					-- Call below changed from sp_LOOK_job_route_table so it ends up calling sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY_stack
					-- which will not call sp_BUILD_BOM but just push the parameters to it in the BUILD_BOM_STACK
					EXECUTE sp_LOOK_job_route_table_stack	@wo_id, @process_id, @parent_item_id, @req_qty,	@CharFormOfFloat_start_qty,
															@req_finish_time_local, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no
				END
			END	--If @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0, ELSE PART

			-- Update BOM dependent data in JOB table
			IF @BIOL_bom_pos = 0 OR @V_Bom_Pos_Found = 1 BEGIN --update BOM dependent data in job
				IF @req_qty IS NULL SET @req_qty = 100	--TESTING

				UPDATE job
				SET	item_id = @parent_item_id, qty_reqd = @req_qty,
					qty_at_start = COALESCE(CONVERT(FLOAT, @char_start_qty), 0),
					latest_start_time_utc = @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc,
					latest_start_time_local = @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local,
					req_finish_time_utc = @req_finish_time_utc,
					req_finish_time_local = @req_finish_time_local
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @J_oper_id AND seq_no = @J_seq_no
			END

			CLOSE BOM_item_oper_link_cursor
			DEALLOCATE BOM_item_oper_link_cursor

			FETCH NEXT FROM job_cursor
			INTO @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @J_final_job, @J_item_id, @J_est_setup_time, @J_est_teardown_time,
				 @J_est_transfer_time, @J_est_prod_rate

		END	--ELSE if @BV_ver_id IS NULL then
	END	--FETCH NEXT FROM job_cursor

	CLOSE job_cursor
	DEALLOCATE job_cursor

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Process]
(
	@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@process_class_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@process_ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@process_desc nvarchar(80) ,
	@process_level int ,
	@process_status int ,
	@last_instantiated datetime ,
	@last_instantiated_tz INT32 = NULL ,
	@disassembly bit,
	--   @creator nvarchar(40) ,
	--   @approver nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_user_to_change_status nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_status_change_at datetime ,
	@last_status_change_at_tz INT32 = NULL ,
	@checked_out_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@may_override_route bit , -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@rework bit, -- Added 07/26/2007 AML
	@notes NOTES ,
	@spare1 nvarchar(80) ,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@spare2 nvarchar(80) ,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@spare3 nvarchar(80) ,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@spare4 nvarchar(80) ,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL ,
	@mod_id varchar(30) OUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - sp_I_Process
-- Description        - Insert a row into the table
-- Author	          -
-- Date Created       - 10/17/2002
-- Version            - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06/04/2003	Raghu		1.6.7	(HD# 3195). Appover of a process
-- 06/06/2003	SJ			1.6.8	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ..., TOP 1 ...)
-- 09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 11/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.3	HD# 6881, Automatically check-In the process if the process is created via a background user.
-- 04/06/2006	Rich		3.1.14	HD#7373 and 7379, Set checked_out_by to null if check in/check out is not being used.
-- 01/15/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 9224 & 9248, part of DB changes - added @may_override_route and @spare1-4 arguments
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 07/26/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/11/2009   Eswar       4.0		HF 1432 - datetime changes.
-- 02/04/2020   Jim O'Hearn 6.2.0   Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @attr_process_stat_change	NVARCHAR(2)
	   ,@may_have_one_cert_proc	NVARCHAR(2)
	   ,@attr_downgrad_proc_level	INT
	   ,@user_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	   ,@created_at			TDATETIME
	   ,@last_edit_at		TDATETIME
	   ,@last_editor		STRING80
	   ,@creator			STRING80
	   ,@approver			STRING80
	   ,@client_type		STRING40
	   ,@background_user_id		STRING40
	   ,@current_time		TDATETIME
                ,@useCheckInOut		NVARCHAR(2)

SET @last_instantiated_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_instantiated_tz)
SET @last_instantiated = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@last_instantiated, @last_instantiated_tz)

SET @last_status_change_at_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@last_status_change_at_tz)
SET @last_status_change_at = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@last_status_change_at, @last_status_change_at_tz)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

 IF @process_level IS NULL SET @process_level = 3
 IF @process_status IS NULL SET @process_status = 1
 IF @may_override_route IS NULL SET @may_override_route = 0

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, @client_type OUTPUT
SELECT  @creator = @user_id, @last_editor = @user_id
IF (@checked_out_by IS NULL) SET @checked_out_by = @creator

-- Determine if we are using check in/out
SELECT @useCheckInOut = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 304
if (@useCheckInOut = '0') SET @checked_out_by = null

--Check if the current process is imported via a background user
IF (@client_type = 53) BEGIN
	--If the process is imported via a background user, and if the current user_id matches the background user id,
	--then set the checked_out_by value to NULL. This automatically inserts the process in the checked_in state.
	SELECT @background_user_id = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 199
	IF UPPER(@background_user_id) = UPPER(@user_id) SET @checked_out_by = NULL
END

SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @created_at = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @created_at = @last_edit_at
SET @created_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @created_at )
SELECT @last_instantiated = DATEADD(mi, -@last_instantiated_tz, @last_instantiated), @last_status_change_at = DATEADD(mi, -@last_status_change_at_tz, @last_status_change_at)

SELECT @attr_process_stat_change = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 222
IF (@attr_process_stat_change = '1'  AND (@process_status = 2 OR @process_status = 3))  BEGIN
	IF (@last_editor IS NOT NULL) AND (@last_editor = @user_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Process approver and editor must be different users{2981}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

IF (@process_class_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process_class WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_class_id = @process_class_id)
	INSERT INTO process_class (process_class_id, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES (@process_class_id, @last_edit_comment, @last_editor, @last_edit_at)

SELECT @may_have_one_cert_proc = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 211
IF (@may_have_one_cert_proc = '1') BEGIN
	IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_class_id = @process_class_id
			    AND process_status = 3 AND process_id <> @process_id)  BEGIN
			SELECT @attr_downgrad_proc_level = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 212
			UPDATE process SET process_status = @attr_downgrad_proc_level, last_user_to_change_status = @user_id,
						approver = NULL, last_status_change_at = @last_edit_at
			WHERE process_class_id = @process_class_id AND process_status = 3 AND process_id <> @process_id
		END
	END
END

INSERT INTO process
(
	process_id,
	process_class_id,
	process_ver_id,
	process_desc,
	process_level,
	process_status,
	last_instantiated,
	disassembly,
	creator,
	approver,
	created_at,
	last_user_to_change_status,
	last_status_change_at,
	checked_out_by,
	may_override_route, -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	rework, -- Added 07/26/2007 AML
	notes,
	spare1,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	spare2,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	spare3,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	spare4,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	last_edit_comment,
	last_editor,
	last_edit_at
)
VALUES
(
	@process_id,
	@process_class_id,
	@process_ver_id,
	@process_desc,
	@process_level,
	@process_status,
	@last_instantiated,
	@disassembly,
	@creator,
	@approver,
	@created_at,
	@last_user_to_change_status,
	@last_status_change_at,
	@checked_out_by,
	@may_override_route, -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@rework, -- Added 07/26/2007 AML
	@notes,
	@spare1,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@spare2,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@spare3,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@spare4,  -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	@last_edit_comment,
	@last_editor,
	@last_edit_at
)

-- Return timestamp
--SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
from process
WHERE (process_id = @process_id)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetHourStart] (@Utc LOGICAL)
RETURNS TDATETIME AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetHourStart
-- Description       - Strips off all the time parts except the hour from the current DATETIME.
-- Author			 - Aaron
-- Date Created      - 05/19/2008
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	DECLARE @return AS TDATETIME

	IF ( @Utc = 1 )
		SET @return = CONVERT( DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(13), getutcdate(), 120) + ':00:00.000', 120 )
	ELSE
		SET @return = CONVERT( DATETIME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(13), dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL), 120) + ':00:00.000', 120 )

	RETURN @return
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetSrcInvLocsTree]
(
		@ent_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@job_pos         INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@from_ent_id     INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@serial_no       STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@grade_cd        INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL

) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETSRCINVLOCSTREE
-- Description          - Returns a list of available storage location (source location)
--                          7.3.3.6    From Location Dropdown or Tree button
--                          This dropdown will contain all entities, moveable and not, that contain inventory
--                          of serialized parts.  If there is a non-blank selection in the "From Work Order"
--                          dropdown, the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing
--                          inventory made by a job with that work order.  Otherwise, if the dialog is
--                          opened in the context of a hard-pegged job and the user does not have the
--                          privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow (so that the empty "
--                          From Work Order" was forced by the choice of the item),
--                          the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory
--                          that was not made by any work order.  If there is also a non-blank selection in the
--                          "From Operation" dropdown, the entities listed will be limited to those
--                          directly containing inventory made by a job with that operation.
--                          Otherwise, if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order
--                          requiring linear flow and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged
--                          and linear flow (so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the
--                          item), the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory
--                          that was not made by any operation.  If the item is specified in the filter,
--                          the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing that item.
--                          If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
--                          to those directly containing an item of that grade.  If the "From Entity" filter
--                          selection is set, then the entities listed will be limited to moveable storage entities
--                          ultimately located at that (non-movable) entity.  If the "Serial Number" filter is
--                          not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing
--                          inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.  In each case,
--                          if movable storage entities are included in the list, so are the non-movable
--                          storage entities at which they are ultimately located.  When the dialog is
--                          opened in the context of a job, the selection should default to the first
--                          non-movable entity in the list.  This or a movable storage entity located at
--                          it will contain inventory of the part that job produces because of the initial value
--                          of the item filter in this case.
-- Author          -       Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/06/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/07/2007		AML			3.3.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
--01/24/2008	Raghu	3.4		L00074359; Unhandled exception occurred when clicki...
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @hard_pegged				LOGICAL
		,	@cur_wo_id                  STRING80
		,	@cur_oper_id                STRING80
		,	@cur_seq_no                 INT32
		,	@may_override_route         LOGICAL
		,	@user_id                    STRING80
		,	@client_info                STRING80
		,	@user_has_priv_to_override  LOGICAL
		,	@tree_level                 INT32
		,	@root_ent_id                INT32
		,	@current_ent_id             INT32
		,	@i							INT32
		,	@max_i						INT32

	SET @hard_pegged = 0

	DECLARE @temp_ent_id TABLE ( id int identity, t_entity_id int )

	INSERT INTO @temp_ent_id
		SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	SELECT @i = 1, @max_i = MAX( id ) FROM @temp_ent_id

	DECLARE @temp_sched_entities TABLE (
		t_root_ent_id int,
		t_ent_id int,
		t_ent_name nvarchar(40),
		t_parent_ent_id nvarchar(40),
		t_child_level int,
		t_ent_tree nvarchar(4000)
	)

    SET @tree_level = 0

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN
		SELECT	@root_ent_id = te.t_entity_id
			,	@tree_level = 1
			,	@current_ent_id = te.t_entity_id
		FROM @temp_ent_id te WHERE te.id = @i

		INSERT INTO @temp_sched_entities ( t_root_ent_id, t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_parent_ent_id, t_child_level )
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, NULL, @tree_level
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_id = @current_ent_id

		SET @tree_level = 2

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @temp_sched_entities ( t_root_ent_id, t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_parent_ent_id, t_child_level, t_ent_tree )
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, x.t_ent_tree
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN (
					SELECT t_ent_id,
							CASE WHEN t_ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT( VARCHAR, t_ent_id )
					             ELSE t_ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, t_ent_id)
                            END t_ent_tree
				    FROM @temp_sched_entities
					WHERE t_child_level = @tree_level -1 AND t_root_ent_id = @root_ent_id
				) x ON x.t_ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN (
				SELECT t_ent_id FROM @temp_sched_entities
                WHERE t_child_level = @tree_level -1 AND t_root_ent_id = @root_ent_id
			)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BEGIN
				BREAK
			END

			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
		END

		SET @i = ( @i + 1 )
	END

    --Verify whether a valid job can be identified
    IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @job_pos IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        --Retrieve the current job that is running on an entity.
        SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
        FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

        --Verify whether the linear flow is enabled on this work order.
        SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
        FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id

        IF (@may_override_route = 0) BEGIN
            --Get the user id who is accessing the database.
			EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, @client_info OUTPUT

			--Verify whether this user has a privilege to override the route.
            SELECT @user_has_priv_to_override = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
            FROM grp_priv_link gpl WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
            WHERE gpl.priv_id = 261 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

			IF ( @user_has_priv_to_override IS NULL ) BEGIN
				SET @user_has_priv_to_override = 0
            END

            IF (@user_has_priv_to_override = 0) BEGIN
                --This user does not have a privilege to override the route.
                --Verify whether a valid job can be identified
                --Verify whether this job is hard pegged.

                SELECT @hard_pegged = must_consume_from_wip
                FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND
					  oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND
					  seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND
					  bom_pos = 0

                IF (@hard_pegged = 1) BEGIN
					--Since the job is hard pegged, make sure  none of the operations or work order has produced this item.
                    IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
                        --Set the hard_pegged flag back to 0, to enable the supplied wo_id and oper_id to get filtered.
                        SET @hard_pegged = 0
                    END
                END
            END
        END
    END

	DECLARE @temp_ent_ids TABLE ( t_ent_id int,	t_child_level int )
	DECLARE @temp_storage_ent_ids TABLE ( t_ent_id int, t_child_level int )
	DECLARE @level AS INT

    --The recordset will contain all entities, moveable and not, that contain inventory of serialized parts.
    --Split the data retrieval based on the fron_ent_id for optimal performance
    IF (@from_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_ent_ids
		SELECT se.ent_id, @level
		FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE se.ent_id = @from_ent_id AND se.movable = 1

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_ent_ids
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1
			FROM @temp_ent_ids t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1

			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1

		END

		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ent_ids
		SELECT se.storage_ent_id AS t_ent_id, @level AS t_child_level
		FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE se.ent_id = @from_ent_id AND se.movable = 1

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ent_ids
			SELECT se.storage_ent_id, @level + 1
			FROM @temp_storage_ent_ids t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1

			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1

		END


        SELECT el.t_root_ent_id AS root_ent_id, el.t_ent_id AS ent_id, el.t_ent_name AS ent_name, el.t_parent_ent_id AS parent_ent_id,
            e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.t_child_level AS child_level, el.t_ent_tree AS ent_tree, COALESCE(selectable_entities.selectable, 0) AS selectable
        FROM @temp_sched_entities el
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.t_parent_ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
				SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id, 1 AS selectable
				FROM (
					SELECT DISTINCT t_ent_id AS ent_id FROM @temp_ent_ids
					UNION
					SELECT DISTINCT t_ent_id AS ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ent_ids
                ) se
            LEFT OUTER JOIN
                (
                    SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id
                    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
                    INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
                    WHERE (ii.item_id = @item_id OR ii.item_id IS NULL)
                      AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR
                            ii.lot_no IN (
								SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON
										ii.item_id = i.item_id AND
										i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND
										ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no
							 )
							)
                      --If the "Serial Number" filter is not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those
                      --directly containing inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.
                      AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR ii.sublot_no IN (
							SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
								INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON
									ii.item_id = i.item_id AND
									i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND
									ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no
						  )
						)
                      AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR ii.lot_no IN (
						SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON
								ii.item_id = i.item_id AND
								i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND
								ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no
							) OR
                            ii.sublot_no IN (
								SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON
										ii.item_id = i.item_id AND
										i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND
										ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no
							)
                           )
                      --If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
                      --to those directly containing an item of that grade.
                      AND (@grade_cd IS NULL OR ii.grade_cd IS NULL OR ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd)
                    --if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order requiring linear flow
                    --and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow
                    --(so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the item),
                    --the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory that was not made by any operation.
                      AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (@wo_id IS NULL OR ii.wo_id IS NULL OR ii.wo_id = @wo_id))
                           OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.wo_id IS NULL)) )
                      AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (@oper_id IS NULL OR ii.oper_id IS NULL OR ii.oper_id = @oper_id))
                           OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.oper_id IS NULL)) )
                ) inv_filters ON inv_filters.ent_id = se.ent_id
            ) selectable_entities ON el.t_ent_id = selectable_entities.ent_id
        ORDER BY el.t_child_level, e.ent_name, el.t_ent_name
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
		DELETE FROM @temp_ent_ids
		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_ent_ids
		SELECT se.ent_id, @level FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE se.ent_id IN (
			SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
			--If the "Serial Number" filter is not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those
			--directly containing inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.
			WHERE	(ii.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
					(@serial_no IS NULL OR ii.lot_no IN (
						SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no
					) OR
					ii.sublot_no IN (
						SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no
						)
					) AND
					--If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
					--to those directly containing an item of that grade.
					(ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL) AND
					--if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order requiring linear flow
					--and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow
					--(so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the item),
					--the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory that was not made by any operation.
					( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (ii.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)) OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.wo_id IS NULL)) ) AND
					( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (ii.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)) OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.oper_id IS NULL)) )
		)

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_ent_ids
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1
			FROM @temp_ent_ids t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1

			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1

		END


		DELETE FROM @temp_storage_ent_ids
		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_ent_ids
		SELECT se.ent_id, @level FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE se.ent_id IN (
			SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id
				FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
				WHERE (ii.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
				--If the "Serial Number" filter is not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those
				--directly containing inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.
				  AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR ii.lot_no IN (
						SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no
					  ) OR
					ii.sublot_no IN (
						SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no
					  )
				  )
				  --If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
				  --to those directly containing an item of that grade.
				  AND (ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
				--if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order requiring linear flow
				--and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow
				--(so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the item),
				--the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory that was not made by any operation.
				  AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (ii.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL))
					   OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.wo_id IS NULL)) )
				  AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (ii.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL))
					   OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.oper_id IS NULL)) )
		)

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ent_ids
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1
			FROM @temp_storage_ent_ids t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1

			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1

		END

        --Since there is no filter for entity, return all entities.
        SELECT el.t_root_ent_id AS root_ent_id, el.t_ent_id AS ent_id, el.t_ent_name AS ent_name, el.t_parent_ent_id AS parent_ent_id,
            e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.t_child_level AS child_level, el.t_ent_tree AS ent_tree, COALESCE(selectable_entities.selectable, 0) AS selectable
        FROM @temp_sched_entities el
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = el.t_parent_ent_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT se.t_ent_id, 1 AS selectable
			FROM (

				SELECT DISTINCT t.t_ent_id FROM @temp_ent_ids t
				UNION
				SELECT DISTINCT t.t_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ent_ids t
			) se
        INNER JOIN ent e ON se.t_ent_id = e.ent_id
        ) selectable_entities ON el.t_ent_id = selectable_entities.t_ent_id
        ORDER BY el.t_child_level, e.ent_name, el.t_ent_name
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_getActiveDestStorage] 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
	
AS
--select @wo_id=N'1003372203',@oper_id=N'BreakingWinnowing',@seq_no=0

BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE  @active_ent INT
			,@active_ent_name NVARCHAR(400)
			,@active_sc_ent INT
			,@active_sc_ent_name NVARCHAR(500)
			,@run_ent_id INT
			,@state_desc NVARCHAR(50)
			,@state_cd int
			,@run_ent_name NVARCHAR(100)
			,@color NVARCHAR(100)
			
	-- Get Entity ID Status and The Status Properties
	SELECT @run_ent_id=ISNULL(j.run_ent_id,ISNULL(j.target_sched_ent_id,j.init_sched_ent_id))
		  ,@state_desc=js.state_desc
		  ,@state_cd = js.state_cd
		  ,@color = js.color
	FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN job_state js WITH(NOLOCK) ON js.state_cd=j.state_cd
	WHERE j.wo_id=@wo_id AND j.oper_id=@oper_id AND j.seq_no=@seq_no

	--SELECT @run_ent_id as run_ent

	-- Get Entity Name 
	SELECT @run_ent_name= ISNULL(e.description,e.ent_name)
	FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE e.ent_id=@run_ent_id
	
	-- Show the lowest sequence destination silo when latest_aut_silo==null
	SELECT  @active_ent_name= STRING_AGG( isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name),',')	--Added isnull condition to take ent description instead of ent name
	FROM ofi_su_selection oss WITH(NOLOCK)	
	inner join ent with (nolock) on oss.active_su_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE oss.wo_id=@wo_id 
		and oss.oper_id=@oper_id 
		and oss.seq_no=@seq_no 
		and oss.dest_type=2 
		--order by oss.silo_seq asc
	
	-- If the destination silo from ofi_su_selection is not available
	if(@active_ent_name IS NULL)
	begin
		if (
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no 
				AND state_cd = 3) -- running
			AND 
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
								WHERE attr_desc = 'def_destination_su' AND attr_grp = 7)
					  AND oper_id = @oper_id))
		begin
			-- Get the default destination silo from operation attribute
			SELECT @active_ent_name=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
							WHERE attr_desc = 'def_destination_su' AND attr_grp = 7)
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		end
		else
		begin
			-- SELECT @active_ent_name='No Active Destination Storage' v 1.05 Replaced for localization
			-- SELECT @active_ent_name= dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('No Active Destination Storage',  10)
			SELECT @active_ent_name= dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300043,NULL,  10)
		end
	end
	--else
	--begin
	--	select @active_ent_name =   substring(rtrim(@active_ent_name),-1,len(@active_ent_name)+1)
	--end 
	
	-- Get the source silo 
	SELECT  @active_sc_ent_name= STRING_AGG( isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name),',')	--Added isnull condition to take ent description instead of ent name
	FROM ofi_su_selection oss WITH(NOLOCK)	
	inner join ent with (nolock) on oss.active_su_ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE oss.wo_id=@wo_id 
		and oss.oper_id=@oper_id 
		and oss.seq_no=@seq_no 
		and oss.dest_type=1
		--order by oss.silo_seq asc
		
	-- If the source silo from ofi_su_selection is not available
	if(@active_sc_ent_name IS NULL)
	begin
		if (
			EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND state_cd = 3) -- running
		AND 
			EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
							WHERE attr_desc = 'def_source_su' AND attr_grp = 7)
					AND oper_id = @oper_id))
		begin
			-- Get the default source silo from operation attribute
			SELECT @active_sc_ent_name=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
							WHERE attr_desc = 'def_source_su' AND attr_grp = 7)
					AND oper_id = @oper_id
		end
		else
		begin
			-- SELECT @active_sc_ent_name='No Active Source Storage' v 1.05 Replaced for localization
			-- SELECT @active_sc_ent_name= dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('No Active Source Storage',  10)
			SELECT @active_sc_ent_name= dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300044, NULL,  10)
		end
	end
	--else
	--begin
	--	select @active_sc_ent_name =   substring(rtrim(@active_sc_ent_name),-1,len(@active_sc_ent_name)+1)
	--end 
	   
	--SELECT @active_ent_name as active_ent_name
	SELECT   ISNULL(@wo_id,'No WO') as wo_id
			,ISNULL(@oper_id,'No Oper') as oper_id
			,ISNULL(@seq_no,0) as seq_no
			,@active_ent_name as active_storage
			,@active_sc_ent_name as active_sc_ent_name
			,ISNULL(@run_ent_name,1) as run_ent_name
			,ISNULL(@state_desc,'NEW') as state_desc
			,CASE WHEN UPPER(@state_cd) =1  THEN '#00A5B5'
				  WHEN UPPER(@state_cd) =2 THEN '#7373C0' 
				  WHEN UPPER(@state_cd) =3 THEN '#6EBB00' 
				  WHEN UPPER(@state_cd) =4 THEN '#870064'
				  WHEN UPPER(@state_cd) =5 THEN '#F88D2A'			----#177
				  WHEN UPPER(@state_cd) =7 THEN '#D53547' 
				  ELSE '#EDEDED'
				  END
			as color_h	
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_bcons_StopBinConsumption]
-- Description: Used to reset the bin consumption weighing MES attribute for a given process
--
-- Usage: Invoked from Work Tasks (MES UI); StopBinsCons workflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 MH   	2025-06-05   		Initial version
-- 0.02.00 MH   	2025-06-10   		Move process parameters to entity parameters
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_bcons_StopBinConsumption]
    @EntityName nvarchar(80)
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET XACT_ABORT ON

    BEGIN TRANSACTION

        -- Validate parameters
        IF @EntityName IS NULL
            THROW 50000, '@EntityName is NULL.', 0

        -- Find parent entity ID
        DECLARE @LineEntityId AS int

        SELECT @LineEntityId = [parent_ent_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_name] = @EntityName

        IF @LineEntityId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, '@EntityName does not exist in the database, or does not have a parent entity assigned.', 4

        -- Select attribute ID based on its name
        DECLARE @CollectionWeighingAttributeId int
        
        SELECT @CollectionWeighingAttributeId = [attr_id]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [attr_desc] = 'ActiveBinCollectionWeighing'
          AND [attr_grp] = 2 -- Entity

        IF @CollectionWeighingAttributeId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, 'Could not find ''ActiveBinCollectionWeighing'' MES entity attribute.', 8

        -- Insert or update attribute
        DECLARE @EditComment AS nvarchar(128) = 'StopBinsCons Workflow - Stop Bin Consumption';

        -- MH: For some reason the entity update procedures require the last edited timestamp?
        DECLARE @EditTimestamp AS datetime

        SELECT @EditTimestamp = [last_edit_at]
        FROM [MESDB].[dbo].[ent_attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [ent_id] = @LineEntityId
          AND [attr_id] = @CollectionWeighingAttributeId

        IF @EditTimestamp IS NOT NULL
            EXEC [MESDB].[dbo].[sp_U_Ent_Attr]
                 @ent_id = @LineEntityId,
                 @attr_id = @CollectionWeighingAttributeId,
                 @attr_value = 1,
                 @notes = NULL,
                 @last_edit_comment = @EditComment,
                 @last_edit_at = @EditTimestamp
        ELSE
            EXEC [MESDB].[dbo].[sp_U_Ent_Attr]
                 @ent_id = @LineEntityId,
                 @attr_id = @CollectionWeighingAttributeId,
                 @attr_value = 1,
                 @notes = NULL,
                 @last_edit_comment = @EditComment,
                 @last_edit_at = NULL
    COMMIT TRANSACTION
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Cons_GetConsByFiltr]
(@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@shift_id		INT32
,@shift_start_start	TDATETIME
,@shift_start_start_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@shift_start_end	TDATETIME
,@shift_start_end_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@item_id		STRING40
,@item_desc		STRING80
,@lot_no		STRING80
,@fg_lot_no		STRING80
,@sublot_no		STRING80
,@fg_sublot_no	STRING80
,@reas_cd		INT32
,@grade_cd		INT32
,@status_cd		INT32
,@run_ent_id		INT32
,@storage_ent_id	INT32
,@qty_min		TFLOAT
,@qty_max		TFLOAT
,@user_id		STRING40
,@user_desc		STRING80
,@ext_ref		STRING40
,@item_scrapped		LOGICAL
,@transaction_type	INT32
,@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
,@segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@comments 		STRING254 = null -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB
,@spare1		STRING80
,@spare2		STRING80
,@spare3		STRING80
,@spare4		STRING80
,@created_at_start	TDATETIME
,@created_at_start_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@created_at_end	TDATETIME
,@created_at_end_tz	INT32 =NULL
,@row_id			INT32
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Item_Cons_GetConsByFiltr
-- Description	      -	Retrieve consumption records based on the supplied filters.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	01/16/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.27
--
-- Copyright (C) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu			4.0		DB Changes
-- 11/26/2009		Kishore			4.1		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
-- 07/11/2018		Surya			6.0		US#1047941 - As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00149494 (HF CR L00148797: SR 48912088: Item_prod and Item_cons queries validate the "user_id" parameter passed and will not return all requested rows)
-- 01/24/2019		Raghu			6.1		UserStory: 1074968-As Bruce, I want to fix CRs L00149579 and L00149589 so that I can distinguish between the two different entity names being returned
-- 06/06/2019       Srinivasa       6.2     US#1180039, Merge CR#L00153745 to merge the changes done for HFCR#153358, Added fix as part of hotfix CR#L00153358,Replaced the local time columns with UTC columns in where clause.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	DECLARE @shift_start_start_utc DATETIME,
			@shift_start_end_utc DATETIME,
			@created_at_start_utc DATETIME,
			@created_at_end_utc DATETIME,
			@dbg_resp INT32

	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Item_Cons_GetConsByFiltr', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @shift_start_start, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_start_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @shift_start_end, @numeric_val2 = @shift_start_end_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @created_at_start, @numeric_val3 = @created_at_start_tz
					 , @date_val4 = @created_at_end, @numeric_val4 = @created_at_end_tz

	IF @shift_start_start IS NOT NULL SET @shift_start_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@run_ent_id, @shift_start_start, GETUTCDATE())
	IF @shift_start_end IS NOT NULL	SET @shift_start_end_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@run_ent_id, @shift_start_end, GETUTCDATE())
	IF @created_at_start IS NOT NULL SET @created_at_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@run_ent_id, @created_at_start, GETUTCDATE())
	IF @created_at_end IS NOT NULL	SET @created_at_end_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@run_ent_id, @created_at_end, GETUTCDATE())

	SELECT	ic.row_id, ic.wo_id, ic.oper_id, ic.seq_no
		,	ic.shift_start_utc, ic.shift_start_local
		--ToDo (Need to chaange �@time_zone_bias_value�)
		,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ic.shift_start_utc ) as shift_start
		,	ic.item_id, i.item_desc, i.serial_no_lvl, ic.lot_no, ic.fg_lot_no, ic.sublot_no, ic.fg_sublot_no
        ,	ic.reas_cd, ir.reas_desc, ic.user_id, un.user_desc
        ,	ic.item_scrapped, ic.ent_id, run_ent.ent_name, ic.shift_id, s.shift_desc, ic.grade_cd, ig.item_grade_desc,ig.color item_grade_color
        ,	ic.status_cd, ist.item_status_desc, ist.color item_state_color, ic.from_ent_id, storage_ent.ent_name AS from_ent_name
        ,	ic.qty_cons, ic.qty_cons_erp, ic.ext_ref, ic.transaction_type
	,	ic.genealogy_id, ic.upstream_event_id, ic.segment_requirement_id, ic.segment_response_id, ic.comments -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB
        ,	ic.spare1, ic.spare2, ic.spare3, ic.spare4, ic.last_edit_comment, ic.last_edit_by, ic.last_edit_at
        ,	ic.created_at_utc
        ,	ic.created_at_local
		,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ic.created_at_utc ) as created_at
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent run_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.ent_id = run_ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent storage_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.from_ent_id = storage_ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN shift s WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.shift_id = s.shift_id
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
		INNER JOIN item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
		INNER JOIN item_state ist WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.status_cd = ist.item_status_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name un WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.user_id = un.user_id
	WHERE (ic.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
	  AND (i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc OR @item_desc IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.fg_lot_no LIKE @fg_lot_no OR @fg_lot_no IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.ent_id = @run_ent_id OR @run_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.from_ent_id = @storage_ent_id OR @storage_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.qty_cons >= @qty_min OR @qty_min IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.qty_cons <= @qty_max OR @qty_max IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.user_id LIKE @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL)
	  AND (un.user_desc LIKE @user_desc OR @user_desc IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.ext_ref LIKE @ext_ref OR @ext_ref IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.item_scrapped = @item_scrapped OR @item_scrapped IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.transaction_type = @transaction_type OR @transaction_type IS NULL)
       	  AND (ic.genealogy_id LIKE @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL)
       	  AND (ic.upstream_event_id LIKE @upstream_event_id OR @upstream_event_id IS NULL)
          AND (ic.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL)
          AND (ic.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL) -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB
	  AND (ic.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL)
	  AND (ic.created_at_utc >= @created_at_start_utc OR @created_at_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.created_at_utc <= @created_at_end_utc OR @created_at_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)

END

--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @item_id		STRING80
		,@attr_id		INT32
		,@visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@visible_in_inv		LOGICAL

	DECLARE item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT i.item_id, i.attr_id, a.visible_in_queue, a.visible_in_inv FROM  inserted i
	INNER JOIN attr a ON i.attr_id = a.attr_id AND (a.visible_in_queue = 1 OR a.visible_in_inv = 1)

	OPEN item_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM item_attr_cursor INTO @item_id, @attr_id, @visible_in_queue, @visible_in_inv
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@visible_in_queue = 1) EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr @item_id, @attr_id
		IF (@visible_in_inv = 1) EXEC sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr @item_id, @attr_id
	END
	CLOSE item_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE item_attr_cursor


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_sampleplanByWo] (
@wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
@line_id INT)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @runent_id INT
	DECLARE @item_id NVARCHAR(80)

	SELECT @runent_id=ent.ent_id			
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ea.ent_id
		INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
		WHERE attr_desc = 'EntityType'
			AND ea.attr_value =	'Segment'
			AND ENT.parent_ent_id=@line_id	

	--GET ITEM ID
	SELECT @item_id=item_id FROM job WHERE wo_id=@wo_id and run_ent_id=@runent_id


	;WITH cte_plan
	AS (
		SELECT DISTINCT vp.pref_plan_id
		FROM qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.plan_id = sp.plan_id		
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) on jb.item_id=qs.item_id AND JB.bom_pos=0
		INNER JOIN ofi_wo_ext wxt WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = wxt.wo_id
		CROSS APPLY DBO.fn_S_ofi_QM_getPreferredSamplePlan (@item_id,NULL,wxt.ship_to_customer,NULL,'') vp
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.item_id=@item_id
		)
	SELECT cp.pref_plan_id as plan_id
		,ISNULL(sp.plan_desc, SP.plan_name) AS plan_name
	FROM cte_plan cp
	INNER JOIN sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.pref_plan_id = sp.plan_id
END
