CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_build_BOM_w_pr_ST_QTY_stack]
@wo_id           STRING40,
@process_id      STRING40,
@parent_item_id  STRING40,
@req_qty         TFLOAT,
@char_start_qty  STRING20,
@req_finish_time TDATETIME,
@oper_id         STRING40 = NULL,
@seq_no          INT32 = NULL
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_CALL_BUILD_BOM_WITH_PROPER_START_QTY_STACK
-- Description	      - Same as sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY except it doesn't call sp_BUILD_BOM directly
--                      to avoid recursion, but just pushes the call parameters onto BUILD_BOM_STACK for later
--                      execution by an external iterator
-- Date Created	      - 03/18/2002
-- Author             - KRF
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/19/2002     Sheetal Jain  -  Changes as per modified spec
-- 01/30/2003     Sheetal Jain  -  Removed all references to debug strings
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @temp_table_name        NVARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @consuming_oper_id      STRING40
DECLARE @consuming_seq_no       INT32
DECLARE @matching_oper_cnt      INT
DECLARE @total_qty              FLOAT
DECLARE @qty_used_so_far        FLOAT
DECLARE @processed_oper_count   INT
DECLARE @start_qty_is_int       BIT
DECLARE @start_qty_for_this_job NVARCHAR(20)
DECLARE @DEBUG_STR              NVARCHAR(2000)
DECLARE @system_severity        INT
DECLARE @stack_index            INT -- Added to implement pushing onto the stack
SET NOCOUNT ON
  EXEC sp_S_system_attr_GetSevLevel @system_severity
  --decide if the start_qty is integer or float (default is float)
  SET @start_qty_is_int = 0	--false
  IF @char_start_qty IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
    IF CHARINDEX('.', @char_start_qty) = 0 --could not find a dot
      SET @start_qty_is_int = 1
  END
  SET @temp_table_name = '#tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty' --ltrim(rtrim(@wo_id)) + '_' + ltrim(rtrim(@process_id))
  --find oper_id of the job which is being fed by this job
  SELECT @consuming_oper_id = oper_id, @consuming_seq_no = seq_no FROM job_route JR
    WHERE JR.wo_id = @wo_id AND JR.input_oper_id = @oper_id	AND JR.input_seq_no = @seq_no
  --find all jobs which are feeding JOB = @consuming_oper_id and are producing item = @parent_item_id
  SELECT @matching_oper_cnt = COUNT(*) FROM job_route JR , job J WHERE JR.wo_id = J.wo_id AND JR.input_oper_id = J.oper_id
    AND JR.input_seq_no = J.seq_no AND JR.wo_id = @wo_id AND JR.oper_id = @consuming_oper_id --and J.item_id = @parent_item_id
  IF @matching_oper_cnt = 1
  BEGIN	--there is one operation producing the item, no need to split the start_qty -------RECURSION
    SET @start_qty_for_this_job = @char_start_qty
    SELECT @stack_index = COUNT(*) FROM #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK
    INSERT INTO #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK
      VALUES(@wo_id, @process_id, @parent_item_id, @req_qty, @start_qty_for_this_job, @req_finish_time, @oper_id, @seq_no, @stack_index+1)
    -- End of code differentiating sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY_stack from sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    IF @matching_oper_cnt > 1 --there are multiple operations producing same item
    BEGIN
      --check in the temp table for the given wo_id and item_id
      SELECT @qty_used_so_far = qty_used_so_far, @total_qty = total_qty, @processed_oper_count = processed_oper_count
	FROM #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND item_id = @parent_item_id AND consuming_oper_id = @consuming_oper_id

      IF @@rowcount = 0	--row NOT found in the temp table
      BEGIN
	-- insert row in the temp table
	INSERT INTO #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty
	  VALUES (@wo_id, @parent_item_id, @consuming_oper_id, @matching_oper_cnt, 0, 0, CONVERT(FLOAT, @char_start_qty) )
	SET @qty_used_so_far = 0
	SET @total_qty = CONVERT(FLOAT, @char_start_qty)
	SET @processed_oper_count = 0
      END
      --split the start qty between those operations
      IF (@matching_oper_cnt - 1) = @processed_oper_count -- this is the last operations among the matching operations
      BEGIN
	SET @start_qty_for_this_job = @total_qty - @qty_used_so_far
	--Fix for CR L00105473/HF2036 ported to CR L00108359
	--If @start_qty_is_int value is 1, then rounding off the @start_qty_for_this_job and assigning that to @qty_used_so_far in each
	--iteration is causing "@start_qty_for_this_job" to become negative sometimes.
	--"@start_qty_for_this_job" value is used to update 'qty_at_start' column value in "Job" table(@start_qty_for_this_job)
	--If '@start_qty_for_this_job' value is negative, then constraint �CHK_job_qty_at_start� on job table(qty_at_start>=0) is conflicted.
	--To avoid this "@qty_used_so_far" is assigned with @start_qty_for_this_job value before rounding off.
	--'qty_at_start' column values are updated agian in 'sp_Alloc_Job_Qty' while creating a workorder
    	SET @qty_used_so_far = @qty_used_so_far + CONVERT(FLOAT, @start_qty_for_this_job)

      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
	SET @start_qty_for_this_job = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @total_qty / @matching_oper_cnt)
	--Fix for CR L00105473/HF2036 ported to CR L00108359
	SET @qty_used_so_far = @qty_used_so_far + CONVERT(FLOAT, @start_qty_for_this_job)
	IF @start_qty_is_int = 1
	BEGIN
	  SET @start_qty_for_this_job = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), ROUND(CONVERT(FLOAT, @start_qty_for_this_job), 0))
	END
      END
      --Fix for CR L00105473/HF2036 ported to CR L00108359
      --SET @qty_used_so_far = @qty_used_so_far + CONVERT(FLOAT, @start_qty_for_this_job)
      SET @processed_oper_count = @processed_oper_count + 1
      --update the temp table
      UPDATE #tbl_Temp_Table_For_Start_Qty SET qty_used_so_far = @qty_used_so_far, processed_oper_count = @processed_oper_count
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND item_id = @parent_item_id AND consuming_oper_id = @consuming_oper_id
      SELECT @stack_index = COUNT(*) FROM #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK
      INSERT INTO #tbl_BUILD_BOM_STACK
        VALUES (@wo_id, @process_id, @parent_item_id, @req_qty,	@start_qty_for_this_job, @req_finish_time, @oper_id, @seq_no, @stack_index+1)
-- End of code differentiating sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY_stack from sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY
    END	--if @matching_oper_cnt > 1 --there are multiple operations producing same item
  END	--ELSE OF if @matching_oper_cnt = 1
SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Message]
  (@sender nvarchar(80) ,
   @subject nvarchar(80) ,
   @sent datetime ,
   @sent_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @recipient nvarchar(40) ,
   @rcvd datetime ,
   @rcvd_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @message NOTES ,
   @ver_recpt bit ,
   @cc bit ,
   @category int ,
   @priority int,
   @save_till datetime,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at DATETIME ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver.     Changes
-- 10/06/2005	  Raghu		   2.1.30	Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.
-- 02/13/2007	  Raghu		   3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 11/12/2009     Eswar        4.0		HF1432 Datetime changes.
-- 02/05/2020     Jim O'Hearn  6.2.0    Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE		@dbg_resp				 INT32

SET @sent_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@sent_tz)
SET @sent = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@sent, @sent_tz)

SET @rcvd_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@rcvd_tz)
SET @rcvd = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@rcvd, @rcvd_tz)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

-- TRACE
EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Message', @src_key='post_validate', @date_val1 = @sent, @numeric_val1 = @sent_tz,
				 @date_val2 = @rcvd, @numeric_val2 = @rcvd_tz

SET @sent = DATEADD(mi, -@sent_tz, @sent)

UPDATE message
SET subject = @subject,
    rcvd = DATEADD(mi, -@rcvd_tz, @rcvd),
    message = @message,
    ver_recpt = @ver_recpt,
    cc = @cc,
    category = @category,
    priority = @priority,
    save_till = @save_till,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(sender = @sender AND
        sent = @sent AND
        recipient = @recipient AND
        last_edit_at = @last_edit_at)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetUOMId]
(@uom_desc as STRING80) returns int32
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @uom_id INT32

	SELECT top 1 @uom_id = uom_id from uom WITH (NOLOCK) where description = @uom_desc

	return @uom_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetSrcInvLocTreByName]
(@ent_name		STRING80
,@site_name		STRING80
,@job_pos         INT32_NULL = NULL
,@from_ent_name		STRING80
,@from_site_name	STRING80
,@item_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@serial_no       STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@grade_desc        STRING80 = NULL
,@wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_SA_SE_GetSrcInvLocTreByName
-- Description          - Returns a list of available storage location (source location)
--                          7.3.3.6    From Location Dropdown or Tree button
--                          This dropdown will contain all entities, moveable and not, that contain inventory
--                          of serialized parts.  If there is a non-blank selection in the "From Work Order"
--                          dropdown, the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing
--                          inventory made by a job with that work order.  Otherwise, if the dialog is
--                          opened in the context of a hard-pegged job and the user does not have the
--                          privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow (so that the empty "
--                          From Work Order" was forced by the choice of the item),
--                          the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory
--                          that was not made by any work order.  If there is also a non-blank selection in the
--                          "From Operation" dropdown, the entities listed will be limited to those
--                          directly containing inventory made by a job with that operation.
--                          Otherwise, if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order
--                          requiring linear flow and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged
--                          and linear flow (so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the
--                          item), the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory
--                          that was not made by any operation.  If the item is specified in the filter,
--                          the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing that item.
--                          If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
--                          to those directly containing an item of that grade.  If the "From Entity" filter
--                          selection is set, then the entities listed will be limited to moveable storage entities
--                          ultimately located at that (non-movable) entity.  If the "Serial Number" filter is
--                          not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing
--                          inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.  In each case,
--                          if movable storage entities are included in the list, so are the non-movable
--                          storage entities at which they are ultimately located.  When the dialog is
--                          opened in the context of a job, the selection should default to the first
--                          non-movable entity in the list.  This or a movable storage entity located at
--                          it will contain inventory of the part that job produces because of the initial value
--                          of the item filter in this case.
-- Author				- Raghu
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ent_id			INT32
			,@from_ent_id	INT32
			,@grade_cd	INT32

	SELECT @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)
		,@from_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@from_ent_name, @from_site_name)
		,@grade_cd = dbo.fn_GetItemGradeCode(@grade_desc)

	EXEC sp_SA_SE_GetSrcInvLocsTree @ent_id, @job_pos, @from_ent_id, @item_id, @serial_no, @grade_cd, @wo_id, @oper_id
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid -
-- Description:	   	To get the assign HU grid for the selected wo
--
-- Usage:			
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			SSB				2022-07-26						Initial version
-- 0.01.01			MC				2025-07-08						Reorganisation of the search for pallet storage location
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- exec sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid '2000087601', null, 'grid', '', '', null
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid]
	@wo_id nvarchar(30),
	@assign_status nvarchar(10)=null,
	@type nvarchar(20),
	@batch_no nvarchar(20),
	@item_id nvarchar(50),
	@spare1 nvarchar(50)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	--using assigntype since sometimes when the HUAssignGrid is null and item_inv has pallets no is set when it is null or else yes is set as default
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @assigntype nvarchar(30)='yes'
	declare @temp table
(
    tot_rows int,
    wo_id nvarchar(50),
    row_id int,
    ent_id int,
    sublot_no nvarchar(50),
	lot_no nvarchar(50),
    item_id nvarchar(50),
    item_desc nvarchar(50),
    itConcat nvarchar(MAX),
    qty_left float,
    uom_id int,
    abbreviation nvarchar(50),
    assign_status int,
    last_edit_at nvarchar(50),
    last_edit_by nvarchar(MAX)
)
declare @ent_id int

if @type='grid'
BEGIN
	if @assign_status is null or @assign_status=0
	BEGIN
		if not exists(select * from ofi_AssignHuWoId where assign_status=0 or assign_status=1)
		BEGIN
					set @assign_status=null
					set @assigntype='no'
		END
	END

	-- 0.01.01
	/*declare @ent_id int
	SELECT @ent_id=e3.ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
	inner join ent (nolock) e1 on e1.ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e2 on e2.ent_id=e1.parent_ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e3 on e3.ent_id=e2.parent_ent_id
	WHERE  final_job=1
	AND    wo_id=@wo_id*/

	declare @ent_id_segment int
	SELECT @ent_id_segment= target_sched_ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
	where j.wo_id = @wo_id

	declare @areas_names nvarchar(max)
	SELECT @areas_names = ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with (nolock)
	left join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
	where a.attr_desc = 'PalletConsumptionAreas' and ea.ent_id = @ent_id_segment

	declare @ent_table table (ent_name nvarchar(20), ent_id int);
	insert into @ent_table (ent_name, ent_id) 
	(SELECT e.ent_name, e.ent_id from ent e where e.ent_name in (SELECT items FROM fn_ofi_Split (@areas_names, ',')))
	

		print @assigntype
		--print @ent_id
	if (@assign_status=1 or @assign_status is null) 
	BEGIN
			if @assigntype='no'
			BEGIN
				print 'no'
				

insert into @temp
select  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Order by iv.row_id)as tot_rows,
				STRING_AGG(ai.wo_id,' , ')as wo_id,
				   iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2 as sublot_no,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc,
				   ( '('+i.item_desc+')'+' '+iv.item_id) as itConcat,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,
				  -- ai.wo_id,
				    CONVERT(varchar,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(null,iv.last_edit_at),22) as last_edit_at,
				   iv.last_edit_by
				  -- iv.row_id as inv_row_id
				 -- ai.row_id
				FROM       item_inv iv with (nolock)
				INNER JOIN uom (nolock) u
				ON         u.uom_id=iv.uom_id
				INNER JOIN item (nolock)i on i.item_id=iv.item_id
				LEFT JOIN  ofi_assignhuwoid ai
				ON         iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id where iv.spare2 is not null
				--and iv.ent_id=@ent_id and -- 0.01.01
				and iv.ent_id in (SELECT ent_id from @ent_table) and -- 0.01.01
				(ai.assign_status is NULL  )   
				and (iv.lot_no like '%' + @batch_no + '%' or @batch_no is null or @batch_no='')
				and (iv.item_id=@item_id or @item_id is null or @item_id='')
			--	and (iv.spare1=@spare1 or @spare1 is null or @spare1='')
				group by  iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,           
				   iv.last_edit_at,
				    iv.last_edit_by,
				   ai.row_id,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc



select max(tot_rows) as tot_rows ,
       max(wo_id) as wo_id,
       max(row_id) as row_id,
       Max(ent_id) as ent_id,
       sublot_no,
	      STUFF((
    SELECT ', ' + lot_no
    FROM item_inv (nolock) AS ii
    WHERE  ii.spare2 = t2.sublot_no
	GROUP BY ii.lot_no
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
  ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '')as lot_no,
	  -- Max(lot_no) as lot_no,
       Max(item_id) as item_id,
       max(item_desc) as item_desc,
       max(itConcat) as itConcat,
       sum(qty_left) as qty_left,
       max(uom_id) as uom_id ,
       max(abbreviation) as abbreviation,
       max(assign_status) as assign_status,
       max(last_edit_at)as last_edit_at,
       max(last_edit_by)as last_edit_by
from @temp t2
group by sublot_no

				END

			if @assigntype='yes'
			BEGIN
			print 'yes'
				
insert into @temp
select  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Order by iv.row_id)as tot_rows,
				STRING_AGG(ai.wo_id,',')as wo_id,
				   iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2 as sublot_no,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc,
				 ( '('+i.item_desc+')'+' '+iv.item_id) as itConcat,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,
				  -- ai.wo_id,
				     CONVERT(varchar,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(null,iv.last_edit_at),22) as last_edit_at,
				   iv.last_edit_by
				FROM       item_inv iv with (nolock)
				INNER JOIN uom (nolock) u
				ON         u.uom_id=iv.uom_id
				INNER JOIN item (nolock) i on i.item_id=iv.item_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN  ofi_assignhuwoid ai

				ON         iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id where iv.spare2 is not null
				--and iv.ent_id=@ent_id and  (ai.assign_status=@assign_status or @assign_status is NULL )  -- 0.01.01
				and iv.ent_id in (SELECT ent_id from @ent_table) and  (ai.assign_status=@assign_status or @assign_status is NULL )  -- 0.01.01
				and (iv.lot_no like '%' + @batch_no + '%'  or @batch_no is null or @batch_no='')
				and (iv.item_id=@item_id or @item_id is null or @item_id='')
			--	and (iv.spare1=@spare1 or @spare1 is null or @spare1='')
				group by  
				   iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,           
				   iv.last_edit_at,
				    iv.last_edit_by,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc



select max(tot_rows) as tot_rows ,
       max(wo_id) as wo_id,
       max(row_id) as row_id,
       Max(ent_id) as ent_id,
       sublot_no,
	 STUFF((
    SELECT ', ' + lot_no
    FROM item_inv (nolock) AS ii
    WHERE  ii.spare2 = t2.sublot_no
	GROUP BY ii.lot_no
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
  ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '')as lot_no,
	  -- Max(lot_no) as lot_no,
       Max(item_id) as item_id,
       max(item_desc) as item_desc,
       max(itConcat) as itConcat,
       sum(qty_left) as qty_left,
       max(uom_id) as uom_id ,
       max(abbreviation) as abbreviation,
       max(assign_status) as assign_status,
       max(last_edit_at)as last_edit_at,
       max(last_edit_by)as last_edit_by
from @temp t2
group by sublot_no
			END
		END
	
if @assign_status=0
	BEGIN
		
insert into @temp
select  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Order by iv.row_id)as tot_rows,
		STRING_AGG(ai.wo_id,',')as wo_id,
           iv.row_id,
           iv.ent_id,
           iv.spare2 as sublot_no,
           iv.lot_no,
		   iv.item_id,
		   i.item_desc,
		   ( '('+i.item_desc+')'+' '+iv.item_id) as itConcat,
           iv.qty_left,
           iv.uom_id,
           u.abbreviation,
           ai.assign_status,
          -- ai.wo_id,
             CONVERT(varchar,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(null,iv.last_edit_at),22) as last_edit_at,
          iv.last_edit_by
		FROM       item_inv iv with (nolock)
		INNER JOIN uom (nolock) u
		ON         u.uom_id=iv.uom_id
		INNER JOIN item  (nolock) i on i.item_id=iv.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN  ofi_assignhuwoid ai

		ON         iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id where iv.spare2 is not null
		--and iv.ent_id=@ent_id -- 0.01.01
		and iv.ent_id in (SELECT ent_id FROM @ent_table) -- 0.01.01
		and ai.wo_id is null  
		and (iv.lot_no like '%' + @batch_no + '%'  or @batch_no is null or @batch_no='')
		and (iv.item_id=@item_id or @item_id is null or @item_id='')
		--and (iv.spare1=@spare1 or @spare1 is null or @spare1='')
		group by  
		   iv.row_id,
           iv.ent_id,
           iv.spare2,
           iv.lot_no,
           iv.qty_left,
           iv.uom_id,
           u.abbreviation,
           ai.assign_status,           
           iv.last_edit_at,
            iv.last_edit_by,
		   iv.item_id,
		   i.item_desc



select max(tot_rows) as tot_rows ,
       max(wo_id) as wo_id,
       max(row_id) as row_id,
       Max(ent_id) as ent_id,
       sublot_no,
	    STUFF((
    SELECT ', ' + lot_no
    FROM item_inv (nolock) AS ii
    WHERE  ii.spare2 = t2.sublot_no
	GROUP BY ii.lot_no
    FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
  ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, '')as lot_no,
	  -- Max(lot_no) as lot_no,
       Max(item_id) as item_id,
       max(item_desc) as item_desc,
       max(itConcat) as itConcat,
       sum(qty_left) as qty_left,
       max(uom_id) as uom_id ,
       max(abbreviation) as abbreviation,
       max(assign_status) as assign_status,
       max(last_edit_at)as last_edit_at,
       max(last_edit_by)as last_edit_by
from @temp t2
group by sublot_no

	END
END

if @type='lookup'
BEGIN
	select @ent_id=e3.ent_id  from job j with (nolock)
	inner join ent (nolock) e1 on e1.ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e2 on e1.parent_ent_id=e2.ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e3 on e2.parent_ent_id=e3.ent_id
	 where final_job=1 and wo_id=@wo_id	
	
 
	select  distinct lot_no from item_inv iv with (nolock) 
	left join ofi_AssignHuWoId ai on iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id 	 
	where iv.ent_id=@ent_id and lot_no is not null
	order by lot_no asc
END


if @type='itemL'
BEGIN
		select @ent_id=e3.ent_id  from job j with (nolock)
	inner join ent (nolock) e1 on e1.ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e2 on e1.parent_ent_id=e2.ent_id
	inner join ent (nolock) e3 on e2.parent_ent_id=e3.ent_id
	 where final_job=1 and wo_id=@wo_id	
	
 
	select  distinct ( '('+i.item_desc+')'+' '+iv.item_id) as itConcat,iv.item_id from item_inv iv with (nolock) 
	inner join item (nolock) i on i.item_id=iv.item_id
	left join ofi_AssignHuWoId ai on iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id 	 
	where iv.ent_id=@ent_id and iv.item_id is not null
END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Session](
@scheduledate NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
declare @row_count int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select @row_count = count(*) from SDB..[scheduler_sessn] where  cast(scheduler_date as Date) = cast(@scheduledate as Date) and [status] IN (1,2)
	if (@row_count = 0)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO SDB.[dbo].[scheduler_sessn]
				   ([scheduler_date]
				   ,[status]
				   ,[last_edit_date]
				   ,created_date)
			 VALUES
				   (@scheduledate
				   ,1
				   ,Getdate()

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line]
(@line_id int32,
 @line_name nvarchar(80),
 @line_class bit,
 @origin_line_class_id int32,
 @labor_load  int32,
 @max_wo int32,
 @prod_ent_id int32,
 @bottleneck_ent_id int32,
 @spare1 nvarchar(2000),
 @spare2 nvarchar(2000),
 @spare3 nvarchar(2000),
 @spare4 nvarchar(2000),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime
 )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_SA_Line
-- Description	      - returns all of the line records that fit the filter criteria specified
-- Author	          - Sara Reynolds
-- Date Created	      -	02/25/2013
-- Version	          - 4.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 03/18/2013     SLR              Added prod_ent_id field to table
-- 05/17/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory:178630 - configure normalized production rates
-- 08/14/2014	Raghu		4.6	UserStory: 226242 - As Bruce, I want to indicate that a specific line position "IS" the bottleneck.
-- 12/04/2014   SLR         5.1 UserStory: 419435 - Added target_oee, target_perf, target_qual, target_util to return dataset
-- 10/12/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory: 1084767 - Added item_display and uom_description to the returned dataset
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(10)

SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

SELECT line.line_id
            ,line.line_name
            ,line.line_class
            ,line.origin_line_class_id
            ,line.labor_load
            ,line.max_wo
            ,line.prod_ent_id
            ,line.prod_uom
            ,line.batch_size
            ,line.std_item_id
            ,CASE
                WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
                WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
                WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
                WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
             END AS item_display
			,uom.description as uom_description
            ,line.bottleneck_ent_id
            ,line.target_util
            ,line.target_qual
            ,line.target_perf
            ,line.target_oee
	    ,line.spare1
	    ,line.spare2
	    ,line.spare3
            ,line.spare4
            ,line.last_edit_comment
            ,line.last_edit_by
            ,line.last_edit_at
FROM line line WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON line.std_item_id = item.item_id
LEFT JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
WHERE ((line.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL) AND
       (line.line_name = @line_name OR @line_name IS NULL) AND
       (line.line_class = @line_class OR @line_class IS NULL) AND
       (line.origin_line_class_id = @origin_line_class_id OR @origin_line_class_id IS NULL) AND
       (line.labor_load = @labor_load OR @labor_load IS NULL) AND
       (line.max_wo = @max_wo OR @max_wo IS NULL) AND
       (line.prod_ent_id = @prod_ent_id OR @prod_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (line.bottleneck_ent_id = @bottleneck_ent_id OR @bottleneck_ent_id IS NULL) AND
	(line.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
	(line.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
	(line.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
	(line.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (line.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (line.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY line_name

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

		--	SELECT item_desc ,lot_no ,sublot_no, ent_id, silo_ent_id,qty_cons,

			  , @sfg_ent_id= ent_id

			  , @sfg_fg_sublot_no = fg_sublot_no
			  , @sfg_qty = qty_cons
			  , @source = source

			  , @sfg_wo = wo_id
			  , @sfg_oper_id = oper_id
			  , @sfg_seq_no = seq_no
			FROM #sfg_wo
			WHERE processed = 0
			--ORDER BY
			--	ID
			ORDER BY
				id ASC
				--seq_no ASC
				--
			--select @prod_row_id--AAA
			UPDATE #sfg_wo
			SET
				processed = 1
			WHERE
				ID = @prod_row_id

				
			DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
			FOR
			SELECT
					ip.item_id
				  , ip.lot_no				 
				  ,	ip.sublot_no
				  ,	ip.ent_id
				  , ip.to_ent_id as silo_ent_id
				  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ip.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod' --SUM(ip.qty_prod)
				  , ip.oper_id
				  , @sfg_fg_lot_no fg_lot_no				 
				  ,	@sfg_fg_sublot_no as fg_sublot_no
				FROM @tempItemProd ip 
				INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
				
				
				WHERE
					
					ip.lot_no=@sfg_fg_lot_no
					AND ip.sublot_no = @sfg_fg_sublot_no
				GROUP BY
					ip.lot_no
				  , ip.item_id
				  , ip.oper_id
				  , i.uom_id
				  ,	ip.sublot_no
				  ,	ip.ent_id
				  , ip.to_ent_id

			SELECT

					  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](cons.item_id, SUM(cons.qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons' --SUM(cons.qty_cons)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Item_Cons_GetConsCount
-- Description			- Retrieve a count of consumption records based on the supplied filter.

BEGIN

	DECLARE @shift_start_start_utc	DATETIME

		,	@created_at_end_utc		DATETIME

	SET @shift_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
    SET @created_at_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_start_tz)
	SET @created_at_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_end_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32
  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Item_Cons_GetConsCount', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @shift_start_start, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_start_tz

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@created_at_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_start, @tz_temp, @created_at_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@created_at_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_end, @tz_temp, @created_at_end_utc OUTPUT

	--IF @shift_start_start IS NOT NULL SET @shift_start_start = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_start)
	--IF @shift_start_end IS NOT NULL SET @shift_start_end = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_end)

	SELECT @no_of_cons_records = COUNT(*)
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name un WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.user_id = un.user_id
	WHERE (ic.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (ic.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (ic.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
      AND (ic.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
      AND (ic.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc OR @item_desc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ic.fg_lot_no LIKE @fg_lot_no OR @fg_lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ic.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ic.fg_sublot_no LIKE @fg_sublot_no OR @fg_sublot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ic.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ic.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ic.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ic.ent_id = @run_ent_id OR @run_ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ic.from_ent_id = @storage_ent_id OR @storage_ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ic.qty_cons >= @qty_min OR @qty_min IS NULL)
      AND (ic.qty_cons <= @qty_max OR @qty_max IS NULL)
      AND (ic.user_id LIKE @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL)
      AND (un.user_desc LIKE @user_desc OR @user_desc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.ext_ref LIKE @ext_ref OR @ext_ref IS NULL)
      AND (ic.item_scrapped = @item_scrapped OR @item_scrapped IS NULL)
      AND (ic.transaction_type = @transaction_type OR @transaction_type IS NULL)
	AND (ic.genealogy_id LIKE @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL)
       	  AND (ic.upstream_event_id LIKE @upstream_event_id OR @upstream_event_id IS NULL)
          AND (ic.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL)
          AND (ic.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL)
      AND (ic.comments = @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
      AND (ic.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL)
      AND (ic.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL)
      AND (ic.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL)
      AND (ic.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL)
      AND (ic.created_at_utc >= @created_at_start_utc OR @created_at_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.created_at_utc <= @created_at_end_utc OR @created_at_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ic.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL);

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_attr_aft_del] ON [dbo].[item_attr]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_attr_aft_del
-- Description        -  Update queue_item_attr table automatically if the attribute is visible in queue.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 11/11/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7931, Updated item_attr  value not updated in FC
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @item_id		STRING80
		,@attr_id		INT32
		,@visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@visible_in_inv		LOGICAL

	DECLARE item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT d.item_id, d.attr_id, a.visible_in_queue, a.visible_in_inv FROM deleted d
	INNER JOIN attr a ON d.attr_id = a.attr_id AND (a.visible_in_queue = 1 OR a.visible_in_inv = 1)

	OPEN item_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM item_attr_cursor INTO @item_id, @attr_id, @visible_in_queue, @visible_in_inv
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@visible_in_queue = 1)  EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr @item_id, @attr_id, 0, 1
		IF (@visible_in_inv = 1) EXEC sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr @item_id, @attr_id, 0, 1
	END
	CLOSE item_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE item_attr_cursor


END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_lm_label
-- Description:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
-- Usage:		Generates Label Details dynamically using info_MES_Mapping
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AML, XPM	2026-02-26			Initial version (based on sp_i_ofi_lm_label) 
-- 0.01.01  AML, XPM    2026-02-26          Added the ent_id as a variable instead of a parameter. 
-- 0.01.02  AML, XPM    2026-02-27			Added some parameters to add the manual trigger to the logic
-- 0.01.03  AML, XPM    2026-03-16			Changed columns in layout details and layout header
-- 0.01.04  AML, XPM    2026-04-01          Updated how we get the subot for CR593
-- 0.01.05  AML, XPM    2026-04-09			Added date format yyyy-MM-dd and dd-MM-yyyy
-- 0.01.06  AML, XPM    2026-05-05			Added support to calculate new BBD
-- 0.01.07	AML, XPM    2026-05-11          Updated logic to obtain Netto weight per bag using UOM conversion
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM 	2026-05-28          Updated the label header in the manual trigger and fixed reject logic.
-- 0.02.01  AML, XPM 	2026-05-29          Update weights insert logic
-- 0.03.00  AML, XPM	2026-06-10			Added the inline qty as a parameter
-- 0.04.00	AML, XPM	2026-06-29			Updated the item_prod filter when getting the qty in manual case
-- 0.05.00	AML, XPM	2026-07-02			Updated to match the new hu_number format (formatted in LPR for inline printing)
-- 0.05.01  AML, XPM    2026-07-27			Added new bag type 4 for low weight
-- 0.05.02	AML, XPM	2026-07-28			Set a translation for the reject/good production
-- 0.05.03  AML, XPM	2026-07-31			Set swHasCustomerRichText to -1 for rejects
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label] 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
	,@trigger_type NVARCHAR(100)		
	,@trigger_from NVARCHAR(100)
	,@ip_row_id INT = NULL
	,@layout_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
	,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
	,@hu_number NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
	,@print_qty INT = NULL
	,@bag_type INT=NULL
	,@sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@recorded_timestamp DATETIME = NULL
	,@lpr_qty FLOAT = NULL
	,@lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)=NULL OUTPUT


	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	DECLARE @layoutTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,value NVARCHAR(50));

	DECLARE	 @layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100)	= NULL
			 --,@layout_name NVARCHAR(50)			= NULL
			,@layout_id	NVARCHAR(100)			= NULL
			,@showkosher NVARCHAR(10)			= '0'
			,@hidekosher NVARCHAR(10)			= '1'
			,@splitCount INT					= 0
			 --,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@maxRowCnt INT
			,@label_header NVARCHAR(200)
			 --,@print_qty INT
			,@process_attr NVARCHAR(200)		= NULL
			,@overlayDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)		= NULL
			,@TypeOfLblContent INT				= 2
			,@swHasCustomerRichText INT			= 0
			,@jobGrpId INT						= 5 ---1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9=Sublots, 10=Samples, 11=Results, 12=Lines, 13=Shifts
			,@hu NVARCHAR(50)					= NULL
			,@swShowLB INT						= 0
			,@itemUOM NVARCHAR(100)				= NULL
			,@swIsReject BIT					= 0
			,@swIsBigBag BIT					= 0
			,@expiry_date NVARCHAR(200)			= NULL
			,@bag_weight_qty FLOAT
			,@bigBagCount INT					= 0
			,@ent_id INT
			,@item_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@raw_ent_id int
			,@actl_ent_id int
			,@raw_attr_value nvarchar(50)
			,@defaultShelfLife INT = -1
			,@HUGenrationTime Date
			,@itemLifetime INT=0
			,@expiry_date_count INT=NULL; 


	-- Update
	SELECT @ent_id = j.run_ent_id, @item_id = j.item_id 
	FROM job j
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

	
	SELECT @layout_ofi_wo_ext = owe.layout_name	
	FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE owe.wo_id = @wo_id;

	SELECT @splitCount = count(value) 
	FROM fn_Split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-');

	IF(@layout_ofi_wo_ext IS NOT NULL and @splitCount > 0)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @layoutTable
		SELECT value FROM fn_Split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-');

		IF @trigger_type = 'inline'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @layout_name = value FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id=1;
		END

		SELECT @showkosher = value FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id=2;
		
		-- Update
		SET @showkosher = COALESCE(@showkosher,'0')
		IF(@showkosher = '1') 
		BEGIN 
			SET @hidekosher = '0' 
		END 
		ELSE 
		BEGIN 
			SET @hidekosher = '1' 
		END

		----SELECT @bigBagCount = COUNT(*) 
		----FROM item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK)
		----WHERE ia.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = 'IsBigBag') 
		----AND ia.item_id=@item_id;

		----IF(@bigBagCount > 0) 
		----BEGIN 
		----	SELECT @swIsBigBag = 1 
		----END 
		----ELSE 
		----BEGIN 
		----	SELECT @swIsBigBag = 0 
		----END

		-- JSC: Aligned the values to the reas_desc
		IF(@bag_type = 0 OR @bag_type IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT @label_header='GoodProduction' END 
		ELSE IF(@bag_type = 1) BEGIN SELECT @label_header='MetalBag' END
		ELSE IF(@bag_type = 2 ) BEGIN SELECT @label_header='MetalTestBag' END
		ELSE IF(@bag_type = 3) BEGIN SELECT @label_header='FlushBag' END
		ELSE IF(@bag_type = 4) BEGIN SELECT @label_header='WeightTooLow' END

		IF(@bag_type <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @swIsReject=1 
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @swIsReject=0 
		END

		SELECT @itemUOM = u.description 
		FROM uom u WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
		INNER JOIN ofi_wo_ext owe ON owe.item_id = i.item_id 
			AND owe.wo_id = @wo_id;

		IF(@itemUOM = 'kg') 
		BEGIN 
			SELECT @swShowLB = 0 
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF(@itemUOM = 'lb') 
			BEGIN 
				SELECT @swShowLB = 1 
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @swShowLB=0
			END			
		END

		
		DECLARE @bag_weight_qty_attr FLOAT = 0, @sum_qty_good FLOAT = 0, @sum_qty_reject FLOAT = 0;

		SELECT @swIsBigBag = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(ia.attr_value AS INT)), 0)
		FROM item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE ia.item_id = @item_id AND a.attr_desc = 'IsBigBag';

		SELECT @bag_weight_qty_attr = factor 
		FROM uom_conv uc WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN uom fr WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.from_uom_id = fr.uom_id
		JOIN uom t WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.to_uom_id = t.uom_id
		WHERE item_id = @item_id 
		AND fr.description = 'BAG'
		AND t.description = @itemUOM


		SELECT @TypeOfLblContent= CAST(ja.attr_value AS INT ) 
		FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK) 
							 WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent' and a.attr_grp = @jobGrpId )
		AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no;

		SELECT @overlayDetails = ja.attr_value 
		FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK) 
							 WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details' and a.attr_grp = @jobGrpId )
		AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no;

		IF(@overlayDetails IS NOT NULL OR @overlayDetails !='')
		BEGIN
			IF(@TypeOfLblContent = 2) 
			BEGIN 
				SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 1; 
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF(@TypeOfLblContent = 1) 
				BEGIN 
					SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 2; 
				END
				ELSE 
				BEGIN 
					SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 0; 
				END
			END
		END 
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @swHasCustomerRichText = 0;
		END


			----SET @hu = @hu_number;
			
			--   EXEC [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_dcsHU_to_SAPHU] 
			--	@HUNumber = @hu_number,
			--	@wo_id = @wo_id,
			--	@oper_id = @oper_id,
			--	@seq_no = @seq_no,
			--	@SAPNumber = @hu OUTPUT;
			
		
		IF (@trigger_type = 'manual' AND @hu_number IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @reas_cd INT;
			SELECT @hu = ip.spare2,
        	@sublot_no = ip.last_edit_comment,
        	@bag_type = CASE 
                        	WHEN ip.good_prod = 1 THEN 0
                        	WHEN ip.good_prod = 0 THEN 1
                        ELSE 1
                    END,
			@reas_cd = ip.reas_cd
			FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id 
			AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND ip.row_id = @ip_row_id;

			IF @bag_type <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @swIsReject = 1;

				SELECT @label_header = r.reas_desc
				FROM item_reas r WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE r.reas_cd = @reas_cd;
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN 
				SET @swIsReject = 0;
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @hu = @hu_number
		END

		-- JSC: Manually set a translation for the reject/good production to be displayed on label:
		DECLARE @lang_header NVARCHAR(100)
		SELECT TOP 1 @lang_header = l.string
		FROM [dbo].[language] l WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE l.context = CONCAT('label_', @label_header)
			AND l.lang_id = 1
			AND l.grp_id = 10

		SET @label_header = COALESCE(@lang_header, @label_header)


		IF (@swIsBigBag = 0)
			SET @bag_weight_qty = @bag_weight_qty_attr;
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @lpr_qty IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SELECT 
				@sum_qty_good = SUM(CASE WHEN good_prod = 1 THEN qty_prod ELSE 0 END),
				@sum_qty_reject = SUM(CASE WHEN good_prod = 0 THEN qty_prod ELSE 0 END)
				FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND row_id = @ip_row_id--AND ip.spare2 = @hu;
				IF (@swIsReject = 0)
					SET @bag_weight_qty = ISNULL(@sum_qty_good,0);
				ELSE	
					SET @bag_weight_qty = ISNULL(@sum_qty_reject,0);
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN 
				SET @bag_weight_qty = @lpr_qty
			END
		END

		-- v5.03
		IF (@swIsReject = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @swHasCustomerRichText = -1;
		END

		SELECT @itemLifetime = i.lifetime
		FROM item i WITH(NOLOCK)
		where i.item_id=@item_id

		SELECT @HUGenrationTime= CAST(min(created_at_local) AS DATE) 
		FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ip.spare2 = @hu

		IF(@HUGenrationTime IS NULL OR  @HUGenrationTime='')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HUGenrationTime = GETDATE()
		END

		-- GEt expiry date
		IF(@itemLifetime > 0)
		BEGIN
			
			SELECT @expiry_date = FORMAT([dbo].[fn_lm_getDatePartFromLifetime](@HUGenrationTime, @itemLifetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy')			

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
				SELECT @raw_ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
				FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE j.wo_id=@wo_id 
					and j.oper_id=@oper_id 
					and j.seq_no=@seq_no


				SELECT @raw_attr_value=ea.attr_value
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ea.ent_id=@raw_ent_id 
					AND ea.attr_id IN (	SELECT a.attr_id
										FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
										WHERE a.attr_desc = 'EntityType')

				IF(@raw_attr_value ='Segment')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
					FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE e.ent_id=@raw_ent_id
				END
				ELSE IF(@raw_attr_value ='Line')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id = @raw_ent_id
				END

				SELECT @defaultShelfLife = CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT)
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
					JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
				WHERE a.attr_desc ='DefaultShelfLife'
					AND ea.ent_id = @actl_ent_id

				IF(@defaultShelfLife IS NOT NULL OR @defaultShelfLife > -1)
				BEGIN			

					SELECT @expiry_date = FORMAT([dbo].[fn_lm_getDatePartFromLifetime](@HUGenrationTime, CAST(@defaultShelfLife AS INT)), 'dd-MM-yyyy')

				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT  @expiry_date = NULL;
				END

		END

		-- Get layout id
		SELECT @layout_id = ln.layout_id
		FROM ofi_lm_layout_name ln WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ln.layout_name = @layout_name;

		-- Get printer_id and printer_qty in the inline case
		IF (@trigger_type = 'inline')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @printer_id=dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterName (@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no);
			IF (@print_qty IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @print_qty=dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterPrintQty (@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no);
			END

			--IF(@printer_id IS NULL) 
			--BEGIN
			--	----SELECT @printer_id=ollah.printer_id 
			--	----FROM ofi_lm_layout_header ollah WITH(NOLOCK)	
			--	----WHERE ollah.layout_id=@layout_id AND ollah.layout_name=@layout_name;
			--END
		END

		EXEC sp_I_ofi_lm_print_label_header
			@layout_id = @layout_id,
			@printer_id = @printer_id,
			@wo_id = @wo_id,
			@hu = @hu,
			@label_type = @trigger_type,
			@label_name = @lbl_name OUTPUT;

		DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';
		SELECT @Query = @Query + 
			N'INSERT INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at) ' +
			N'SELECT TOP 1 @p_lbl_name, ''' + attr.record_title + ''', CAST(' + QUOTENAME(map.column_name) + N' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''' + ISNULL(attr.default_value,'') + ''', ''' + attr.as_value + ''', ' + CAST(ISNULL(attr.min_length,0) AS NVARCHAR) + ', ' + CAST(ISNULL(attr.max_length,100) AS NVARCHAR) + ', ''' + ISNULL(attr.pattern,'STRING') + ''', ' + CAST(ISNULL(attr.editable,0) AS NVARCHAR) + ', NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE() ' +
			N'FROM ' + QUOTENAME(map.table_name) + N' WITH(NOLOCK) ' +
			N'WHERE ' + 
			CASE map.filter_id 
				WHEN 'wo' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id'
				WHEN 'job_item' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND oper_id = @p_oper_id AND seq_no = @p_seq_no AND item_id = @p_item_id'
				WHEN 'item' THEN N'item_id = @p_item_id '
				WHEN 'job' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND oper_id = @p_oper_id AND seq_no = @p_seq_no'
				WHEN 'wo_item' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND item_id = @p_item_id'
				WHEN 'ent' THEN N'ent_id = @p_ent_id'
				WHEN 'job_run_ent' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND oper_id = @p_oper_id AND seq_no = @p_seq_no AND run_ent_id = @p_ent_id'
		    END + N'; ' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)
		FROM ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping attr WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ofi_lm_mes_info_mapping map WITH(NOLOCK) ON attr.record_title = map.title
		WHERE attr.layout_id = @layout_id;

		IF LEN(@Query) > 0
		BEGIN
			
			EXEC sp_executesql 
				@stmt = @Query, 
				@params = N'@p_wo_id NVARCHAR(100), @p_oper_id NVARCHAR(100), @p_seq_no INT, @p_item_id NVARCHAR(100), @p_ent_id INT, @p_lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)', 
				@p_wo_id = @wo_id, 
				@p_oper_id = @oper_id,
				@p_seq_no = @seq_no,
				@p_item_id = @item_id,
				@p_ent_id = @ent_id,
				@p_lbl_name = @lbl_name;
				
		END

		MERGE INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details AS tgt
		USING (
			VALUES
			 (@lbl_name, 'label name', @lbl_name, @lbl_name, 'lbl_name', 0, 100, 'STRING', 0, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'layout name', @layout_name, @layout_name, 'layout_name', 0, 100, 'STRING', 0, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'printer_id', @printer_id, @printer_id, 'printer_id', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())    
			,(@lbl_name, 'lbl_heading', @label_header, @label_header, 'lbl_heading', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'label_quantity', CAST(@print_qty as NVARCHAR(20)), '1', 'label_quantity', 0, 100, 'INT', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'DayOfWeek_Date', CAST(FORMAT(GETUTCDATE(), 'dddd dd-MM-yyyy', 'en-US') AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(FORMAT(GETUTCDATE(), 'dddd dd-MM-yyyy', 'en-US') AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'DayOfWeek_Date', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'BestBeforeDate_DMY', CAST(@expiry_date AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(@expiry_date AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'BestBeforeDate_DMY', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'BestBeforeDateFormatted', CAST(RIGHT(@expiry_date, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(@expiry_date, 4, 2) + '-' + LEFT(@expiry_date, 2) AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(RIGHT(@expiry_date, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(@expiry_date, 4, 2) + '-' + LEFT(@expiry_date, 2) AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'BestBeforeDateFormatted', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'ProductionDate_DMY', CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime, 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime, 'dd-MM-yyyy') AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'ProductionDateFormatted', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swHideKosherLogo', CAST(@hidekosher AS NVARCHAR(50)), '1', 'swHideKosherLogo', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swShowKosherLogo', CAST(@showkosher AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swShowKosherLogo', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swIsReject', CAST(@swIsReject AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swIsReject', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swShowLB', CAST(@swShowLB AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swShowLB', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swIsBigBag', CAST(@swIsBigBag AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swIsBigBag', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swHasCustomerRichText', CAST(@swHasCustomerRichText AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swHasCustomerRichText', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'WeightInKG', CASE WHEN  @swShowLB = 0 THEN CAST(@bag_weight_qty AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, NULL, 'WeightInKG', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'WeightInLB', CASE WHEN  @swShowLB = 1 THEN CAST(@bag_weight_qty AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, NULL, 'WeightInLB', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'CustomerRichText', CASE WHEN @overlayDetails IS NOT NULL AND @overlayDetails != '' THEN CAST(@overlayDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, NULL, 'CustomerRichText', 0, 5500, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'swTypeOfLblContent', CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@TypeOfLblContent AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE '0' END, CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@TypeOfLblContent AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE '0' END, 'swTypeOfLblContent', 0, 5, 'int', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'imagePath', CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@overlayDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@overlayDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, 'imagePath', 0, 255, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			,(@lbl_name, 'ProductionCode', ISNULL(CAST(@hu AS NVARCHAR(150)),'XXXXXXXXXX'), ISNULL(CAST(@hu AS NVARCHAR(150)),'XXXXXXXXXX'), 'ProductionCode', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		) AS src (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		ON tgt.label_id = src.label_id AND tgt.as_value = src.as_value
		WHEN MATCHED THEN
			UPDATE SET 
				actual_value = ISNULL(src.actual_value, tgt.actual_value),
				last_edit_by = src.last_edit_by,
				last_edit_at = src.last_edit_at
		WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
			INSERT (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			VALUES (src.label_id, src.record_title, src.actual_value, src.default_value, src.as_value, src.min_length, src.max_length, src.pattern, src.editable, src.manual_value, src.created_at, src.last_edit_by, src.last_edit_at);


		IF (@trigger_type = 'inline')
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @date_inline NVARCHAR(50) = CAST(FORMAT(ISNULL(@recorded_timestamp, GETDATE()), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50));

			MERGE INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details AS tgt
			USING (
				VALUES (@lbl_name, 'ProductionDateFormatted', @date_inline, @date_inline, 'ProductionDateFormatted', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			) AS src (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			ON tgt.label_id = src.label_id AND tgt.as_value = src.as_value
			WHEN MATCHED THEN
				UPDATE SET 
					actual_value = ISNULL(src.actual_value, tgt.actual_value),
					last_edit_by = src.last_edit_by,
					last_edit_at = src.last_edit_at
			WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				INSERT (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
				VALUES (src.label_id, src.record_title, src.actual_value, src.default_value, src.as_value, src.min_length, src.max_length, src.pattern, src.editable, src.manual_value, src.created_at, src.last_edit_by, src.last_edit_at);
		END

		IF (@trigger_type = 'manual')
		BEGIN
			MERGE INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details AS tgt
			USING (
				VALUES (@lbl_name, 'ProductionDateFormatted', CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'ProductionDateFormatted', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
			) AS src (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			ON tgt.label_id = src.label_id AND tgt.as_value = src.as_value
			WHEN MATCHED THEN
				UPDATE SET 
					actual_value = ISNULL(src.actual_value, tgt.actual_value),
					last_edit_by = src.last_edit_by,
					last_edit_at = src.last_edit_at
			WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
				INSERT (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
				VALUES (src.label_id, src.record_title, src.actual_value, src.default_value, src.as_value, src.min_length, src.max_length, src.pattern, src.editable, src.manual_value, src.created_at, src.last_edit_by, src.last_edit_at);
		END


		IF (@sublot_no IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				MERGE INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details AS tgt
				USING (
					VALUES (@lbl_name, 'BatchNumber', CAST(@sublot_no AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(@sublot_no AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'BatchNumber', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
				) AS src (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
				ON tgt.label_id = src.label_id AND tgt.as_value = src.as_value
				WHEN MATCHED THEN
					UPDATE SET 
						actual_value = ISNULL(src.actual_value, tgt.actual_value),
						last_edit_by = src.last_edit_by,
						last_edit_at = src.last_edit_at
				WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
					INSERT (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (src.label_id, src.record_title, src.actual_value, src.default_value, src.as_value, src.min_length, src.max_length, src.pattern, src.editable, src.manual_value, src.created_at, src.last_edit_by, src.last_edit_at);
		END
		DECLARE @usesublotforexport INT, 
					@process_id NVARCHAR(40);
			
		SELECT @process_id = process_id 
		FROM wo  WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

		SELECT @usesublotforexport = attr_value 
		FROM process_attr pa WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON pa.attr_id = a.attr_id 
		WHERE pa.process_id = @process_id AND a.attr_desc = 'UseSublotForExport'

		IF @usesublotforexport = '1'
		BEGIN
			UPDATE oi
			SET actual_value = [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_Sublot_For_Export](actual_value)
				,default_value = [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_Sublot_For_Export](default_value)
			FROM ofi_lm_print_label_details oi
			WHERE label_id = @lbl_name AND as_value = 'BatchNumber'			
		END

	END 

	SELECT @lbl_name AS lbl_name;
END

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 11/03/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:933266 - As Bruce I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT job_spec.wo_id
          ,job_spec.oper_id
          ,job_spec.seq_no
          ,job_spec.step_no
          ,job_spec.spec_id
          ,job_spec.spec_value
          ,job_spec.act_spec_value
          ,job_spec.assoc_file
          ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(job_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
          ,job_spec.comments
          ,job_spec.min_value
          ,job_spec.max_value
          ,job_spec.access_level
          ,spec.spec_desc
          ,job_spec.last_edit_comment
          ,job_spec.last_edit_by
          ,job_spec.last_edit_at
          ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, job_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM job_spec job_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON job_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
WHERE (job_spec.wo_id = @wo_id AND
       job_spec.oper_id = @oper_id AND
       job_spec.seq_no = @seq_no AND
       job_spec.step_no = @step_no AND
       job_spec.spec_id = @spec_id)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Ofi_QM_Sample_GetChars]
(@sample_id  int
)
AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT x.* FROM (
	SELECT scl.sample_id
		  ,scl.char_id
		  ,c.char_name
          ,c.type as type_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) as severity_cd

          ,ISNULL(qscl.maximum_sample_size, c.maximum_sample_size) as maximum_sample_size_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.sample_size_source, c.sample_size_source) as sample_size_source_h
          ,ISNULL(qscl.normal_sample_size, c.normal_sample_size) as normal_sample_size_h
          ,COALESCE(CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN NULL ELSE qscl.automated_coll END, CASE c.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as automated_coll_h
          ,scl.act_sample_size as act_sample_size_h
	  ,scl.qm_spec_id
	  ,qm_spec.qm_spec_name
	  ,qm_spec.display_seq as qm_display_seq
	  ,qm_spec.ver_id
	  ,qscl.display_seq as qscl_display_seq
          ,qscl.target
          ,qscl.lsl as lsv
--		  ,(SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id) as lsv
          ,qscl.usl as usv
--		  ,(SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id

	      ,(SELECT lrv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (lrv * ((SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id

                    - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id) as lrv
	      ,(SELECT urv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (urv * ((SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id
                            UNION
                            SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scl.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scl.char_id)

	  ,scl.equipment

	  ,scl.last_edit_at
	  --,c.char_desc
	  ,CONCAT_WS(' | ', 
              c.spare1, 
              NULLIF(c.spare3, ''), 
              NULLIF(c.spare2, '')
             ) as char_desc
	  ,c.num_decimals
	  ,c.uom_id
	  ,uom.description
	  ,c.spare1 as parameter -- LIMS info
	  ,c.spare2 as test_method -- LIMS info
	  ,c.spare3 as variant -- LIMS info
	  ,c.spare4

	LEFT OUTER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id

	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id

	SELECT (scltg.sample_id * -1) as sample_id

          ,COALESCE(CASE WHEN qscl.automated_coll = 2 THEN NULL ELSE qscl.automated_coll END, CASE c.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as automated_coll_h
          ,0 as actual_sample_size_h
	  ,scltg.qm_spec_id
	  ,qm_spec.qm_spec_name
	  ,qm_spec.display_seq as qm_display_seq
	  ,qm_spec.ver_id
	  ,qscl.display_seq as qscl_display_seq
          ,qscl.target
          ,qscl.lsl as lsv
--		  ,(SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as lsv
          ,qscl.usl as usv
--		  ,(SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--            UNION
--            SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0  AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
--           UNION
--            SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as usv
	      ,(SELECT lrv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (lrv * ((SELECT lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT target - lsv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT  target * (1 - (lsv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lsv_is_offset = 1 AND lsv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id)
                    - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE lrv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as lrv
	      ,(SELECT urv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
            UNION
            SELECT (urv * ((SELECT usv FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 0 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT usv + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 0  AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id
                           UNION
                           SELECT target * (1 + (usv/100)) FROM qm_spec_char_link where usv_is_offset = 1 AND usv_offset_is_pct = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id)
                   - target)) + target FROM qm_spec_char_link WHERE urv_is_mult = 1 AND qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id AND char_id = scltg.char_id) as urv
	      ,NULL
	      ,scltg.last_edit_comment
	      ,scltg.last_edit_by
	      ,scltg.last_edit_at
		   --,c.char_desc
		  , CONCAT(c.spare1, ' | ', c.spare3, ' | ',c.spare2) as char_desc
		  ,c.num_decimals
		  ,c.uom_id
		  ,uom.description
		  ,c.spare1 as parameter -- LIMS info
		  ,c.spare2 as test_method-- LIMS info
		  ,c.spare3 as variant-- LIMS info
		  ,c.spare4
	FROM sample_char_link_to_go scltg WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.char_id = c.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON scltg.qm_spec_id = qm_spec.qm_spec_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON qscl.qm_spec_id = scltg.qm_spec_id and qscl.char_id = scltg.char_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	WHERE scltg.sample_id = @sample_id
    )x ORDER BY x.qm_display_seq, x.qscl_display_seq, x.char_name

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Char_Category_Link]
  (@category_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
   @char_id INT32_NULL = NULL,
   @last_edit_by STRING40_NULL = NULL,
   @last_edit_at TDATETIME_NULL = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_SA_Char_Category_Link
-- Description          - Retrieves the specified records from the char_category_link table
-- Author               - Arun
-- Date Created         - 02/26/2013
-- Version              - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SELECT char_category_link.category_id
    ,char_category_link.char_id
    ,characteristic.char_name
    ,char_category_link .last_edit_comment
    ,char_category_link .last_edit_by
    ,char_category_link .last_edit_at
FROM char_category_link WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN characteristic WITH (NOLOCK) ON char_category_link.char_id = characteristic.char_id
INNER JOIN category WITH(NOLOCK) ON category.category_id = char_category_link.category_id
WHERE ((char_category_link.category_id = @category_id OR @category_id IS NULL) AND
       (char_category_link.char_id = @char_id OR @char_id IS NULL) AND
       (char_category_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (char_category_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
      )
ORDER BY char_category_link.category_id, characteristic.char_name;
END
