CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Build_Job_Nonalphabetical]
(
	@wo_id					STRING40,
	@process_id				STRING40,
	@item_id				STRING40,
	@req_qty				TFLOAT,
	@user_id				STRING40,
	@start_qty				TFLOAT = NULL,
	@init_wo_state			INT32 = 1,
	@wo_desc				STRING80 = @wo_id,
	@release_time_local		TDATETIME = NULL,
	@release_time_tz		INT32 = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_tz		INT32 = NULL,
	@wo_priority			INT32 = 1,
	@cust_info				STRING80 = '',
	@mo_id					STRING40 = '',
	@production_schedule_id STRING80_NULL = '',
	@notes					NOTES = '',
	@spec_ver_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@may_override_route		LOGICAL = 0,
    @parent_wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL,
    @parent_oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL,
    @parent_seq_no          INT32_NULL = NULL,
    @check_privs 		    INT32 = 1,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_BUILD_JOB_NONALPHABETICAL
-- Description			- Same as sp_Build_Job but does not assume flow between operations always happens in alphabetical order
--						  of operation ID. Start and reqd quantities written here are 0; they'll be changed later by sp_Build_BOM
-- Author				- KRF
-- Date Created			- 03/18/2002
-- Version				- 3.1.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/17/2002		Sheetal Jain	1001 -  Changes as per modified spec
-- 05/03/2002		Sheetal Jain	1002 -  Check for preferred spec version only if it exists
-- 05/14/2002		Sheetal Jain	1003 -  Preferred spec check changes
-- 05/22/2002		Sheetal Jain	1004 -  Process Id passed to SP_OES_TO_JOB_SPEC_VERSION
-- 06/05/2002		Sheetal Jain	1005 -  Steps entered for each of the entities in an operation
-- 06/12/2002		Sheetal Jain	1006 -  WO.NOT_DELETABLE = TRUE if process is certified
-- 08/08/2002		Sheetal Jain	1007 -  Job attributes created for each entity - 1013
-- 08/29/2002		Sheetal Jain	1301 -  Operations processed based on route
-- 09/13/2002		Sheetal Jain	1302 -  Process diagram = Job diagram (#1360)
-- 12/12/2002		KRF             1303 -  Added call to new sp_Res_Oper_to_Res_Job to instantiate resource requirements
-- 01/02/2003		KRF				1303 -  Changed default due date to 24 hours after release date, not 24 hours from now
--                                          Fetch feeding entity/operations in entity ID order
-- 01/03/2003		Sheetal Jain	1500 -  Creation of #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq moved to sp_I_job_exec_CreateWOFromProcess_stack
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2 - Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/10/2003		KRF				1.5.2 - Added call to sp_Res_Oper_to_Res_Job near end of " IF @O_sched_to_ent_id IS NULL"
--											block so job resource requirements are created regardless of value in oper.sched_to_ent_id
--											Also added statement to create job_attr records when oper.sched_to_ent_id is NOT null
-- 01/24/2003		Sheetal Jain	1504  - System attribute 200 checked for WO not deletable
-- 06/16/2004		Raghu			2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 09/28/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 11/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.1	HD# 6729, Error while creating a work order from process. If deviation_* is null in oper, then
-- 											deviation above and deviation below values must be derrived from the system attribute table.
-- 01/17/2006		SJ				3107 -  HD#7208 - Set release time to GMT when null
-- 02/22/2006		SJ				3110 -  HD#6519 - CWOFP - Copy operation attributes to job atrributes
-- 02/28/2006		SJ				3110 -  HD#6894 - CWFP to allow spec_ver as an optional parameter
-- 03/04/2006		SJ				3113 -  HD#4604 - CreateWorkOrderFromProcess must copy oper spares to job (V. 2.1)
-- 10/25/2006		SJ				3124 -  HD#9037 - CWOFP - WO State Code for Instantiation
-- 01/18/2007		KRF				3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 03/20/2007		HK/KRF			3.1.27	HD #9554 - Changed to default release time (and thus required finish time) according to system attribute 323.
-- 08/14/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/29/2007		Sanjay					Changed process to insert job_state into Job table. Added code to verify it from system_attr and oper table.
-- 01/17/2008		Raghu			3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu			4.0		Added production_schedule_id
-- 11/22/2009		AJAY			4.0		H1423 FIX
-- 04/08/2014    Srinivasa Tentu   5.0.0   UserStory:374735, Added @check_privs optional input parameter to check privileges conditionally.
-- 04/09/2015           ARUN  	   		5.0.1   	Fix for the CR#L00130426, setting release time to the current time if no release time is specified
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @P_priv_id				INT,
			@priv_status			INT,
			@OSV_pref_spec_ver_id	NVARCHAR(40),
			@seq_no					INT,
			-- Variable declarations for OPER table
			@O_process_id			STRING40,
			@O_oper_id				STRING40,
			@O_oper_desc			STRING80,
			@O_def_reject_rate		TFLOAT,
			@O_first_oper			LOGICAL,
			@O_final_oper			LOGICAL,
			@O_display_seq			INT32,
			@O_check_inv			LOGICAL,
			@O_sched_to_ent_id		INT32,
			@O_oper_type			STRING80,
			@O_oper_cost			TFLOAT,
			@O_assoc_file			STRING254,
			@O_assoc_file_type		STRING20,
			@O_notes				NVARCHAR(4000),
			@O_data_log_grp_id		INT,
			@O_mod_id				TIMESTAMP,
			@O_rework_cd			STRING40,
			-- Variable declarations for OPER_ENT_LINK table
			@OEL_process_id			STRING40,
			@OEL_oper_id			STRING40,
			@OEL_ent_id				INT32,
			@OEL_est_fixed_lab		TFLOAT,
			@OEL_est_lab_rate		TFLOAT,
			@OEL_est_setup_time		TFLOAT,
			@OEL_est_teardown_time	TFLOAT,
			@OEL_est_prod_rate		TFLOAT,
			@OEL_batch_size			TFLOAT,
			@OEL_est_transfer_time		TFLOAT,
			@OEL_prod_uom		INT32,
			@FIOEL_ver_id			STRING40,
			@DEBUG_STR				NVARCHAR(2000),
			@system_severity		INT,
			@V_Error				VARCHAR(2000),
			@V_Row_Count			INT,
			@V_Deletable			LOGICAL,
			@V_Feed_Seq				INTEGER,
			@O_sched_to_ent_id1		INT32,
			@V_Seq_Chk				CHAR(1),
			@O_deviation_above 		TFLOAT,
			@O_deviation_below 		TFLOAT,
			@last_edit_by			STRING40,
			@last_edit_at			DATETIME,
			@V_Spare1				STRING80_NULL,
			@V_Spare2				STRING80_NULL,
			@V_Spare3				STRING80_NULL,
			@V_Spare4				STRING80_NULL,
			@datetimes_are_local	STRING80, -- Added 3/20/07 HK/KRF
			@release_time_utc		TDATETIME,
			@req_finish_time_utc	TDATETIME,
			@tz_temp				INT,
			@dbg_resp				INT,
			@init_job_state			INT,
			@ready_all_new_jobs	    int,
			@init_status_first_job  int,
			@current_time_utc		TDATETIME,
            @rework_flag            LOGICAL,
            @rework_process_id      STRING40



	SET @release_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@release_time_tz)
	SET @release_time_local		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@release_time_local, @release_time_tz)
	SET @req_finish_time_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@req_finish_time_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SET @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 1)

      -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_Build_Job_Nonalphabetical_t', @src_key='sp_Build_Job_Nonalphabetical_t', @date_val1 = @release_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @release_time_tz, @date_val2 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val2 = @req_finish_time_tz
    if ( @dbg_resp = 1 )
		RETURN


	SET @may_override_route = isnull( @may_override_route, 0 )

	SET @tz_temp = - @release_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @release_time_local, @tz_temp, @release_time_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = - @req_finish_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	EXECUTE sp_S_system_attr_GetSevLevel @system_severity
	--item_id inserted in the Job table will be the final item only.
	--later in the sp_Build_BOM, will take care of updating Job table for correct Item_ID

	IF  (@release_time_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
    	SET @release_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
    	SET @release_time_local = DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value ,@release_time_utc)
	END

	IF ( @req_finish_time_local IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SELECT	@req_finish_time_local = DATEADD(HOUR, 24, @release_time_local)
			,	@req_finish_time_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, 24, @release_time_utc)
	END

    -- if this is a work order for rework or adding jobs for rework, the rework flag should be true for all jobs being added
    IF ( @parent_wo_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
        SET @rework_flag = 1
        SET @rework_process_id = @process_id
   END
    ELSE BEGIN
        SET @rework_flag = 0
    END

    IF @check_privs = 1
    BEGIN
		-- Call the stored procedure to check the user's privilege to create WO
		EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_UserHasPriv @user_id, @V_Priv_Status = @priv_status OUTPUT  -- gets called in verify process
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			SET @priv_status =1
	END

	IF (@priv_Status <> 1) BEGIN
		RETURN -1
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--2 Insert row into WO table
		--based on process status determine if the job is deletable
		SET @V_Deletable = 0

		SELECT @V_Deletable = 1
		FROM process WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	process_id = @process_id AND
				process_status = 3 AND
				EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 200 AND attr_value = 1)

		INSERT INTO wo
		(
			wo_id, wo_desc, process_id, item_id, req_qty, release_time_utc, release_time_local, req_finish_time_utc,
			req_finish_time_local, state_cd, wo_priority, cust_info, mo_id, production_schedule_id, notes, not_deletable, spec_ver_id, may_override_route,
			input_wo_id, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@wo_id, @wo_desc, @process_id, @item_id, @req_qty, @release_time_utc, @release_time_local, @req_finish_time_utc,
			@req_finish_time_local, 0, @wo_priority, @cust_info, @mo_id, @production_schedule_id, @notes, @V_Deletable, @spec_ver_id, @may_override_route,
			@parent_wo_id, @parent_oper_id, @parent_seq_no, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		)

	-- Get the Current UTC time
		Set @current_time_utc = getutcdate()

    -- Set status for the work order, if its new, 2 else should be checked with operation data
        SELECT @init_status_first_job = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 310

		If @release_time_utc > @current_time_utc BEGIN
			SET @init_status_first_job = 1
		END

		IF (@init_status_first_job) = 0 SET @init_status_first_job = 2

		SELECT @ready_all_new_jobs = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 254

		--Use data in process_attr table to populate wo_attr table for attributes having same desc and data_type
		INSERT INTO wo_attr ( wo_id, attr_id, attr_value, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
			SELECT @wo_id, wa.attr_id, p.attr_value, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
			FROM process_attr p WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					a.attr_id = p.attr_id
				INNER JOIN attr wa WITH (NOLOCK) ON
					a.attr_desc = wa.attr_desc AND
					a.data_type = wa.data_type AND
					a.entry_type = wa.entry_type AND
					a.predefined = wa.predefined
			WHERE p.process_id = @process_id AND wa.attr_grp = 6

		DECLARE cur_temp_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT oper_id, ent_id FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no ASC


		DECLARE @each_des_oper_to_job TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime
		)

		DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
				@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
				@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
				@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
				@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40),  @t_last_edit_at datetime, @i int, @max_i int


		OPEN cur_temp_seq
		FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id1
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
			--3 Read data for all operators for this process_id from oper table
			DECLARE oper_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
				SELECT	process_id, oper_id, oper_desc, def_reject_rate, first_oper, final_oper, display_seq,
						check_inv, sched_to_ent_id, oper_type, oper_cost, deviation_above, deviation_below,
						assoc_file, assoc_file_type, notes, rework_cd, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
				FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id

			OPEN oper_cursor
			FETCH NEXT FROM oper_cursor INTO @O_process_id, @O_oper_id, @O_oper_desc, @O_def_reject_rate, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper, @O_display_seq,
			@O_check_inv, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @O_oper_type, @O_oper_cost, @O_deviation_above, @O_deviation_below,
			@O_assoc_file, @O_assoc_file_type, @O_notes, @O_rework_cd, @V_Spare1, @V_Spare2, @V_Spare3, @V_Spare4
			--4 for each oper in process
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN  --OPER_CURSOR

              -- Set value for the status field of job
               IF @O_first_oper = 1 BEGIN
                  SET @init_job_state = @init_status_first_job
               END
               ELSE if @ready_all_new_jobs = 1 and @init_status_first_job = 2
			   BEGIN
				   SET @init_job_state = 2
			   END
			   ELSE
			   BEGIN
				   SET @init_job_state = 1
			   END

				IF @O_sched_to_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
				--6 Get Preferred Spec version for this operation
					IF @spec_ver_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
						SET @V_Row_Count = 1
						SET @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id
					END
					ELSE BEGIN
						SELECT @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id = ver_id
						FROM oper_spec_ver
						WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

						SET @V_Row_Count = @@ROWCOUNT
					END

					IF @V_Row_Count > 1 BEGIN
						SET @V_Error = 'More than one preferred specification version specified for operation#{3344}' +  @O_oper_id
						RAISERROR (@V_Error, 16, 1)
						RETURN -1
					END
					ELSE IF @V_Row_Count = 0 BEGIN
						SELECT @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND preferred_ver = 0
						IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 BEGIN
							SET @V_Error = 'Preferred specification version not specified for operation#{3345}' +  @O_oper_id
							RAISERROR (@V_Error, 16, 1)
							RETURN -1
						END
					END
					--5 read all rows from OPER_ENT_LINK table for this oper
					-- Fix for CR L00099799/HF 1751
					-- Use original query if SysAttr id 340 is "Yes"(default)(Include jobs with 0 quantity when creating work orders)
					IF 1 = (SELECT CONVERT(INT,attr_value) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 340)
						DECLARE oper_ent_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
						SELECT	process_id, oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
								est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time
						FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id1
					ELSE
					-- Use query below if SysAttr id 340 is "No"(Include jobs with 0 quantity when creating work orders)
					-- Instead of creating all jobs then deleting some it is more scalable and performant to not create them in the first place
						DECLARE oper_ent_link_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
						SELECT oel.process_id, oel.oper_id, oel.ent_id, oel.est_fixed_lab, oel.est_lab_rate, oel.est_setup_time,
								oel.est_teardown_time, oel.est_prod_rate, oel.prod_uom, oel.batch_size, oel.est_transfer_time
						FROM oper_ent_link oel WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN oper WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper.process_id = oel.process_id AND oper.oper_id = oel.oper_id
						WHERE oel.process_id = @process_id AND oel.oper_id = @O_oper_id AND oel.ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id1
							 AND ((oper.first_oper = 1 AND oel.init_prod_pct IS NOT NULL AND oel.init_prod_pct > 0)
								OR (EXISTS(SELECT process_id
											FROM oper_ent_route WITH (NOLOCK)
											WHERE process_id = @process_id
												AND oper_id = @O_oper_id
												AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id1
												AND input_percent > 0)
									)
								)
					-- End
					OPEN oper_ent_link_cursor
					FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_link_cursor INTO @OEL_process_id, @OEL_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_est_fixed_lab,
						@OEL_est_lab_rate, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate, @OEL_prod_uom, @OEL_batch_size,
						@OEL_est_transfer_time
					--8 for each ent_id that performs this operation (OPER_ENT_LINK_cursor)
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
						--Get the right sequenec no
						SELECT @seq_no = MAX(seq_no)+1 FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id
						IF @seq_no IS NULL
						  SET @seq_no = 0
						--folder_oper_item_ent_link - new table - provides default job.folder_ver_id when creating WO from process
						SELECT @FIOEL_ver_id = ver_id FROM folder_item_oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id
						  AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id

						IF @O_deviation_above IS NULL SELECT @O_deviation_above = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 103
						IF @O_deviation_below IS NULL SELECT @O_deviation_below = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 104

						-- In below insert of job, the colum state_cd value has been changed from @init_wo_state to @init_job_state
						INSERT INTO job
						(
							wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc, item_id, state_cd, job_priority, req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local,
							init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected,
							qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start, deviation_above, deviation_below, batch_size, first_job, final_job, sched_pinned,
							check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, est_transfer_time,
							sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local, latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local,
							sched_finish_time_utc, sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local, act_finish_time_utc,
							act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link, job_cost, notes, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes, edited_by,
							edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework, rework_cd, rework_process_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
						)
						VALUES
						(
							@wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, @O_oper_desc, @item_id, @init_job_state, @wo_priority, @req_finish_time_utc,
							@req_finish_time_local, @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_ent_id, NULL, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, @O_deviation_above,
							@O_deviation_below, @OEL_batch_size, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper, 0, @O_check_inv, @OEL_est_fixed_lab,
							@OEL_est_lab_rate, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate, @OEL_prod_uom, @OEL_est_transfer_time,
							NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @O_oper_cost, @O_notes, @O_assoc_file,
							@O_assoc_file_type, NULL, @user_id, @last_edit_at, @O_display_seq, @FIOEL_ver_id, @rework_flag, @O_rework_cd, @rework_process_id, @V_Spare1, @V_Spare2,
							@V_SPare3, @V_Spare4
						)


						-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
						DELETE FROM @each_des_oper_to_job

						INSERT INTO @each_des_oper_to_job
						(
							key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
							last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
							number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
						)
						SELECT ( select row_id from job where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @O_oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no ) as row_id,
							6 as key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
							des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
							des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
							des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at
						FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN oper op ON des.key_id = op.row_id
						WHERE des.key_type = 4 AND op.process_id = @process_id AND op.oper_id = @O_oper_id

						SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_des_oper_to_job

						WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

							SELECT	@t_key_id = key_id, @t_key_type = key_type, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
								,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
								,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
								,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
								,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
								,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
								,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
							FROM @each_des_oper_to_job
							WHERE id = @i

							INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
							(
								key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
								last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
								number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
							)
							VALUES
							(
								@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
								@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
								@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
								@t_last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at
							)

							SET @i = (@i + 1)
						END
						--14 read all routes to this oper and ent from the OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
						EXECUTE sp_OER_to_Job_Route_bidir @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @process_id, @seq_no

						--18 Read all specs for this Oper and Ent from the OPER_ENT_SPEC table
						EXECUTE sp_OES_to_Job_SPEC_Version @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @seq_no, @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id, @process_id

						--18 Read all steps for this Oper and Ent from the OPER_STEP table
						EXECUTE sp_OS_to_JOB_STEP @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @process_id, @seq_no

						--Use data in oper_attr table to populate job_attr table for each job
						INSERT INTO job_attr(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, attr_id, attr_value, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
						SELECT @wo_id, oa.oper_id, @seq_no, ja.attr_id, oa.attr_value, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
						FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN attr a ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
							INNER JOIN attr ja ON a.attr_desc = ja.attr_desc AND a.data_type = ja.data_type AND a.entry_type = ja.entry_type AND a.predefined = ja.predefined
						WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ja.attr_grp = 5

						--Copy data log groups
						INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_link(grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, cert_name, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
						SELECT grp_id, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, cert_name, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at FROM data_log_grp_oper_link
						WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id

						-- Added 12/12/02 to copy secondary resource requirements - KRF
						EXECUTE sp_Res_Oper_to_Res_Job @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @process_id, @seq_no

    				FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_link_cursor
					INTO	@OEL_process_id, @OEL_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_est_fixed_lab,
							@OEL_est_lab_rate, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time,
							@OEL_est_prod_rate, @OEL_prod_uom, @OEL_batch_size, @OEL_est_transfer_time

				END  --OPER_ENT_LINK_cursor

				CLOSE oper_ent_link_cursor
				DEALLOCATE oper_ent_link_cursor

			END
			ELSE BEGIN -- @O_sched_to_ent_id is not NULL; currently this can't happen
				-- Cursor Declaration/manipulation for SELECT from OPER_ENT_LINK table
				--6 Get Preferred Spec version for this operation
				IF @spec_ver_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
					SET @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id = ver_id
					FROM oper_spec_ver
					WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1
				END

				IF @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id IS NULL BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Preferred version for the operation is not specified{3334}', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END

				--7 Initialize SEQ_NO
				SET @seq_no = 0

				-- if the select statement bellow fails, all the @OEL_* variables will be NULL
				SELECT	@OEL_process_id = process_id, @OEL_oper_id = oper_id, @OEL_ent_id = ent_id, @OEL_est_fixed_lab = est_fixed_lab,
						@OEL_est_lab_rate = est_lab_rate, @OEL_est_setup_time = est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time = est_teardown_time,
						@OEL_est_prod_rate = est_prod_rate, @OEL_prod_uom = prod_uom,
						@OEL_batch_size = batch_size, @OEL_est_transfer_time = est_transfer_time
				FROM oper_ent_link
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id

				IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BEGIN -- no row was found in OPER_ENT_LINK table
					SELECT	@OEL_est_fixed_lab = NULL
						,	@OEL_est_lab_rate = NULL
						,	@OEL_est_setup_time = NULL
						,	@OEL_est_teardown_time = NULL
						,	@OEL_est_prod_rate = 1
						,	@OEL_prod_uom = 0
						,	@OEL_batch_size = 1
						,	@OEL_est_transfer_time = NULL
						,	@OEL_ent_id = @O_sched_to_ent_id
				END

				--folder_oper_item_ent_link - new table - provides default job.folder_ver_id when creating WO from process
				SELECT @FIOEL_ver_id = ver_id
				FROM folder_item_oper_ent_link
				WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id

				IF @O_deviation_above IS NULL SELECT @O_deviation_above = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 103
				IF @O_deviation_below IS NULL SELECT @O_deviation_below = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 104

				INSERT INTO job
				(
					wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc, item_id, state_cd, job_priority, req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local,
					init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected,
					qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start, deviation_above, deviation_below, batch_size, first_job, final_job, sched_pinned,
					check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, est_transfer_time,
					sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local, latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local, sched_finish_time_utc,
					sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local, act_finish_time_utc, act_finish_time_local,
					concurrent_link, job_cost, notes, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes, edited_by, edit_time, display_seq,
					folder_ver_id, rework, rework_cd, rework_process_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
				)
				VALUES
				(
					@wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, @O_oper_desc, @item_id, @init_job_state, @wo_priority, @req_finish_time_utc,
					@req_finish_time_local, @OEL_ent_id, @OEL_ent_id, NULL, @req_qty, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, @O_deviation_above,
					@O_deviation_below, @OEL_batch_size, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper, 0, @O_check_inv, @OEL_est_fixed_lab,
					@OEL_est_lab_rate, @OEL_est_setup_time, @OEL_est_teardown_time, @OEL_est_prod_rate, @OEL_prod_uom, @OEL_est_transfer_time,
					NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @O_oper_cost, @O_notes, @O_assoc_file,
					@O_assoc_file_type, NULL, @user_id, @last_edit_at, @O_display_seq, @FIOEL_ver_id, @rework_flag, @O_rework_cd, @rework_process_id, @V_Spare1, @V_Spare2,
					@V_SPare3, @V_Spare4
				)

				--14 read all routes to this oper and ent from the OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
				EXECUTE sp_OER_to_Job_Route_bidir @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @process_id, @seq_no

				--18 Read all specs for this Oper and Ent from the OPER_ENT_SPEC table EXECUTE sp_OES_to_Job_SPEC_Version @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @seq_no, @OSV_pref_spec_ver_id, @process_id
				--23 Declare cursor for OPER_STEP table
				EXECUTE sp_OS_to_JOB_STEP @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @OEL_ent_id, @process_id, @seq_no

				--Use data in oper_attr table to populate job_attr table for each job
				INSERT INTO job_attr(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, attr_id, attr_value, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					SELECT @wo_id, oa.oper_id, @seq_no, ja.attr_id, oa.attr_value, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
					FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON
							oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
						INNER JOIN attr ja WITH (NOLOCK) ON
							a.attr_desc = ja.attr_desc AND
							a.data_type = ja.data_type AND
							a.entry_type = ja.entry_type AND
							a.predefined = ja.predefined
					WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ja.attr_grp = 5

				-- Added 12/12/02 to copy secondary resource requirements - KRF
				EXECUTE sp_Res_Oper_to_Res_Job @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @process_id, @seq_no

				--Copy data log groups
				INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_link(grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, cert_name, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					SELECT grp_id, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, cert_name, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at FROM data_log_grp_oper_link
					WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id

			END --if @O_sched_to_ent_id is NULL, else part


			FETCH NEXT FROM oper_cursor
			INTO	@O_process_id, @O_oper_id, @O_oper_desc, @O_def_reject_rate, @O_first_oper, @O_final_oper,
					@O_display_seq, @O_check_inv, @O_sched_to_ent_id, @O_oper_type, @O_oper_cost, @O_deviation_above,
					@O_deviation_below, @O_assoc_file, @O_assoc_file_type, @O_notes, @O_rework_cd, @V_Spare1, @V_Spare2, @V_Spare3, @V_Spare4

		END  --OPER_CURSOR

		CLOSE oper_cursor
		DEALLOCATE oper_cursor

		FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @O_oper_id, @O_sched_to_ent_id1
    END

    CLOSE cur_temp_seq
    DEALLOCATE cur_temp_seq

  END	--IF (@priv_status =1)
END

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_recipe_bom]
                 (
                                  @wo_id [dbo].[STRING40]

                 AS BEGIN

				 
--DECLARE @RC                       int

DECLARE @def_reject_ent_id        int = NULL
DECLARE @scaling_factor           float =NULL

DECLARE @may_create_new_lots      bit = NULL
DECLARE @must_consume_from_wip    bit = 0

DECLARE @mod_id                   varchar(30)
DECLARE @last_edit_at			  datetime = GETDATE()

DECLARE @recipe_name			  nvarchar(80)
DECLARE	@already_used			  nvarchar(2)
DECLARE @row_id					  int
DECLARE @type nvarchar(50) = 'Recipe'
DECLARE @step_data STRING254_NULL
DECLARE @step_no int

-- TODO: Set parameter values here.
--assumption that bom pos -0  entry  will alsways be there--

   SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare		  @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
             ,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_AssignRecipe'
             ,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
             ,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			 ,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			 ,@iRowId  int

			


SELECT  @qty_per_parent_itemv1 = TRY_CAST(@qty_per_parent_item AS DECIMAL(10, 5))
SELECT  @max_qty_per_parent_itemv1 = TRY_CAST(@max_qty_per_parent_item AS DECIMAL(10, 5))
set @qty_reqd = @max_qty_per_parent_itemv1;

	BEGIN TRY


		select @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))),@iRowId = row_id  from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = @bom_pos and seq_no  = @seq_no and item_id =@item_id 

		select @recipe_name = [recipe_name], @already_used = [already_used] from  [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] with(nolock) where [item_id] = @parent_item_id and [ent_id] = @ent_id and [version] = @ver_id

		--setting the spare1 column as recipe_name


		set @spare1 = @recipe_name

			if(@recipe_name <> (select isnull(spare1,'') from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no))
			begin
			 update job_bom set spare1 = @recipe_name where  wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no;
			end
			set @spare1 = NULL

			

		IF (@mod_id IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				-- update records here
				

				set  @strActivityMsg	= 'update'
				set  @strCommentMsg		= 'Updated into [dbo].[Job_Bom]'
	
			select	@reqd_start_val = reqd_start_val,
			@reqd_start_val_is_pct = reqd_start_val_is_pct,

			@may_create_new_lots  =may_create_new_lots,     
			@must_consume_from_wip    =must_consume_from_wip,
			@must_consume_before_prod =  must_consume_before_prod, 
			@constant_qty    =constant_qty ,         
			@est_time       = est_time,           
			@current_subst   = current_subst,          
			--@qty_reqd    =qty_reqd, 
			--@qty_reqd = @qty_reqd,
			@serial_no_source = serial_no_source,
			@row_id = row_id
			from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = @bom_pos and seq_no  = @seq_no and item_id =@item_id 
	  
		
		  
			   exec
					 [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Bom] @wo_id
					,@oper_id
					,@seq_no
					,@bom_pos
					,@item_id
					,@reqd_grade_cd
					,@instruction
					,@qty_per_parent_itemv1
					,@max_qty_per_parent_item
					,@min_qty_per_parent_item
					,@reqd_start_val
					,@reqd_start_val_is_pct
					,@update_inv
					,@backflush
					,@def_reas_cd
					,@def_lot_no
					,@def_sublot_no
					,@def_storage_ent_id
					,@def_reject_ent_id
					,@scaling_factor
					,@must_consume_from_inv
					,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc
					,@may_create_new_lots
					,@must_consume_from_wip
					,@must_consume_before_prod
					,@constant_qty
					,@est_time
					,@current_subst
					,@qty_reqd
					,@serial_no_source
					,@spare1
					,@spare2
					,@spare3
					,@spare4
					,@last_edit_comment
					,@mod_id
					
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- insert record here
					set  @strActivityMsg	= 'add'
					set  @strCommentMsg		= 'Inserted into [dbo].[Job_Bom]'

				exec 
					 [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Bom] @wo_id
					,@oper_id
					,@seq_no
					,@bom_pos
					,@item_id
					,@reqd_grade_cd
					,@instruction
					,@qty_per_parent_itemv1
					,@max_qty_per_parent_item
					,@min_qty_per_parent_item

					,@reqd_start_val_is_pct

					,@def_reject_ent_id
					,@scaling_factor

					,@spare3
					,@spare4
					,@last_edit_comment
					,@mod_id OUTPUT

				SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
			END

			--SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY

				where [item_id] = @parent_item_id and [ent_id] = @ent_id and [version] = @ver_id
			END

				(row_id, field_name, field_value)		
				values

				 ( @iRowId, '@wo_id',CAST(@wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40)) )
				,( @iRowId, '@oper_id', CAST(@oper_id AS NVARCHAR(40)))
				,( @iRowId, '@seq_no', CAST(@seq_no AS NVARCHAR(40)))
				,( @iRowId, '@recipe_id', CAST(@recipe_name AS NVARCHAR(40)))

				EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName,
                        @function_id = @strFunctionName,
                        @auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters,
                        @user_id = @last_edit_by,
                        @activity = @strActivityMsg,
                        @audit_category = 'Info',
                        @comments = @strCommentMsg

			SET @step_data =  @recipe_name
			select @step_no = step_no from job_step with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
		if not exists(select 1 from job_step_data with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no)
			begin
				EXEC  [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
					   @wo_id
					  ,@oper_id
					  ,@seq_no
					  ,@type
					  ,@step_data

			end
				


				select 1 as result,'updated successfully ' as resultCode

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
				select 0 as result,ERROR_MESSAGE() as resultCode
	END CATCH

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_PadNumber]
(     @n              INT32  -- the number to be padded
     ,@length         INT32  -- length of the string
     ,@char            CHAR(1) -- character to pad, example '0'
)  RETURNS VARCHAR(32)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - fn_PadNumber
-- Description          - Returns a padded string based.
--                        Example usage: sp_SA_GetNextSampleName to pad leading zeroes in sample names
-- Author               - Johnny Agsalog
-- Date Created         - 12/19/2011
-- Version              -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

    RETURN (REPLICATE(@char,@length - LEN(CONVERT(VARCHAR(32),@n)))    -- padded characters
            + CONVERT(VARCHAR(32),@n)                                  -- original number
           )

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetSrcWoFromSERItems]
(
		@item_id	STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@mo_id      STRING40_NULL = NULL
)

AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETSRCWOFROMSERITEMS
-- Description          - Returns a list of work orders that have jobs that produce a serialied item that is still in the inventory.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/06/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 09/05/2007		AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server from Oracle.
--01/24/2008	Raghu	3.4		L00074359; Unhandled exception occurred when clicki...
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

    --Returns a list of work orders that have jobs
    SELECT DISTINCT ii.wo_id
    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.wo_id = wo.wo_id
    WHERE (ii.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND (wo.mo_id = mo_id OR mo_id IS NULL)
      --Returns a list of work orders that have jobs that produce a serialied item
      AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
      --that is still in the inventory.
      AND ii.qty_left > 0
    ORDER BY ii.wo_id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_Attr]
(
 @line_id  int = NULL,
 @line_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime
  )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -  sp_SA_Line_Attr
-- Description	      -  Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Author	          -  Srinivasa Tentu
-- Date Created	      -	10/07/2013
-- Version			  - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 03/09/2018	  Srinivasa     6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 03/23/2018	  Surya			6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 12

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

  IF (@line_id IS NULL AND @line_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @line_id = line.line_id FROM line line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line.line_name= @line_name

	IF (@line_id IS NULL)
		SET @line_id = -1
  END

SELECT
line_attr.line_id
,line.line_name
,line_attr.attr_id
,line_attr.attr_value
,line_attr.notes
,attr.attr_desc
,attr.predefined
,attr.data_type
,attr.entry_type
,line_attr.last_edit_comment
,line_attr.last_edit_by
,line_attr.last_edit_at
FROM line_attr line_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN line line WITH (NOLOCK) ON line_attr.line_id = line.line_id
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON line_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((line_attr.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL) AND
       (line_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (line_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (line_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (line_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
        ORDER BY line_attr.line_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_File]
(
	@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@file_path  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@file_desc  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@file_type  nvarchar(254)  ,
	@last_modified  datetime  ,
	@file_size  int  ,
	@author  nvarchar(80),
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime ,
	@mod_id  varchar(30) ,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/11/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 03/27/2006		Raghu			3.1.12		Added URL column to the select clause
-- 04/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.14		HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 07/31/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 12/24/2007		AML				3.4.0		Updated parameter list to match Oracle version
-- 02/04/2008		Raghu			3.4			L00074768; FolderBuilder window - cannot delete a file associated to an item/operation/entity
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
-- 11.02.12018		RWB				6.1			User Story 1084807 - replaced the join to the doc_type table with a join to the file_type table.
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF @last_modified IS NOT NULL SET @last_modified = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @last_modified)

SELECT	item_file.item_id
	,	item_file.file_path
	,	item.item_desc
	,	item_file.file_desc
	,	dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(item_file.file_path) AS file_type
	,	item_file.last_modified
	,	item_file.file_size
	,	item_file.author
	,	user_name.user_desc
	,	item_file.spare1
	,	item_file.spare2
	,	item_file.spare3
	,	item_file.spare4
	,	file_type.edit_level edit_level_h
	,	file_type.view_level view_level_h
	,	file_type.print_level print_level_h
	,	item_file.last_edit_comment
	,	item_file.last_edit_by
	,	item_file.last_edit_at
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_file.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM item_file WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_file.author = user_name.user_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_file.item_id = item.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN file_type WITH (NOLOCK) ON file_type.file_ext = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(item_file.file_path)
WHERE (
	(item_file.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
	(item_file.file_path = @file_path OR @file_path IS NULL) AND
	(item_file.file_desc = @file_desc OR @file_desc IS NULL) AND
	(dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(item_file.file_path) = @file_type OR @file_type IS NULL) AND
	(item_file.last_modified = @last_modified OR @last_modified IS NULL) AND
	(item_file.file_size = @file_size OR @file_size IS NULL) AND
	(item_file.author = @author OR @author IS NULL)  AND
	(item_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	(item_file.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
	(CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_file.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY item_file.file_desc

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_attr_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[item_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_attr_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_attr table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Update queue_item_attr table automatically
-- 04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7931, Updated wo_attr value not updated in FC
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@item_id	STRING80
		,@attr_id	INT32
		,@visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@visible_in_inv		LOGICAL

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE item_attr SET item_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE item_attr.item_id = i.item_id AND item_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id

	IF UPDATE(attr_value) BEGIN

		DECLARE item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT i.item_id, i.attr_id, a.visible_in_queue, a.visible_in_inv FROM item_attr ia
		INNER JOIN inserted i ON ia.item_id = i.item_id AND ia.attr_id = i.attr_id
		INNER JOIN attr a ON i.attr_id = a.attr_id AND (a.visible_in_queue = 1 OR a.visible_in_inv = 1)

		OPEN item_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM item_attr_cursor INTO @item_id, @attr_id, @visible_in_queue, @visible_in_inv
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			IF (@visible_in_queue = 1) EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr @item_id, @attr_id
			IF (@visible_in_inv = 1) EXEC sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr @item_id, @attr_id
		END
		CLOSE item_attr_cursor
		DEALLOCATE item_attr_cursor
	END
END

-- Description: This SP will fetch Lines where Sample Plan is configured.
-- Usage:		Manual Sample request UI
--EXEC  [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_Line]
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2024-02-19		Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_qm_Line] @grpname NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
		--GET LINE ATTRIBUTE ENTITIES
		;

	WITH cte_lineattr
	AS (
		SELECT ent.ent_id
			,ent.ent_name
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ea.ent_id
		INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
		WHERE attr_desc = 'EntityType'
			AND ea.attr_value IN (
				'Line'
				,'Segment'
				)
		)
		--GET LINES WHERE QM SPEC HAVE ITEM ID ASSIGNMENT 
		,cte_jobent
	AS (
		SELECT DISTINCT job.run_ent_id
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN qm_spec qs WITH (NOLOCK) ON qs.item_id = job.item_id
		INNER JOIN ENT WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = job.run_ent_id
		INNER JOIN cte_lineattr cl ON cl.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		WHERE ent.can_capture_qm_data = 1
		)
	--GET FINAL DATASET
	SELECT gl.line_id AS line_id
		,ISNULL(gl.line_desc, gl.line_Name) AS line_name
	FROM cte_jobent cf
	INNER JOIN ENT WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = cf.run_ent_id
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo](ent.ent_id, 0) gl
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Calculate_Times]
(
	@wo_id					STRING40,
	@process_id				STRING40,
	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- SP_CALCULATE_TIMES
-- Description			- Update work order start and finish dates
-- Author				- Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created			- 04/26/2002
-- Version				- 3.1.0.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver  Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 05/14/2002     Sheetal Jain        Null values handled
-- 08/07/2002     Sheetal Jain        Procedure gets called up from SP_ALLOCATE_QTY now
-- 03/13/2003     Sheetal Jain        HD#2460 Changes made to batch size and reqd start val calculation
-- 02/16/2006     SJ            3114  HD#7501 - sp_Calculate_Times is figuring production time wrong
-- 08/09/2007	  AML			3.3.0 DB Changes
--01/17/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 10/19/2011	  Saiteja		    3.5	 CR116941( L00113493)modified for CR116941(cloneCR113493).
-- 08/15/2012     JimE		4.5	Fix for CR L00122055
-- 02/01/2016	Raghu		5.2	CR L00139826 - Error when creating work order from process with quantity: 2000000
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
	@V_Std_Time_Prod			TFLOAT,
	@V_Std_Time_Min_Qty			TFLOAT,
	@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc	TDATETIME,
	@V_Latest_Start_Time_Local	TDATETIME,
	@V_Latest_Start_Time1_Utc	TDATETIME,
	@V_Latest_Start_Time1_Local	TDATETIME,
	@V_Est_Setup_Time			TFLOAT,
	@V_Est_Transfer_Time		TFLOAT,
	@V_Est_Prod_Rate			TFLOAT,
	@V_prod_uom			INT32,
	@V_Qty_At_Start				TFLOAT,
	@V_Batch_Size				TFLOAT,
	@V_Min_Start_Qty			TFLOAT,
	@V_Def_Rej_Rate				TFLOAT,
	@V_Oper_Id					STRING40,
	@V_Seq_No					INT32,
	@V_Reqd_Start_Val			TFLOAT,
	@V_Reqd_Start_Val_Pct		LOGICAL,
	@V_Final_Job				LOGICAL,
	@V_Item_Id					STRING40,
	@V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id		INT32,
	@V_Min_Feed_Qty				TFLOAT_NULL,
	@V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc		TDATETIME,
	@tz_temp					INT32,
	@dbg_resp					INT32
BEGIN
	-- ON_ENTRY trace
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_Calculate_Times', @src_key='on_entry', @str_val1 = @wo_id, @str_val2 = @process_id, @date_val1 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @time_zone_bias_value
	if ( @dbg_resp = 1 )
		RETURN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

  EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc OUTPUT

  DECLARE cur_temp_seq CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT oper_id, ent_id FROM #tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq
      WHERE wo_id = @wo_id ORDER BY seq_no DESC
  OPEN cur_temp_seq
  WHILE (3 = 3)
  BEGIN
    FETCH cur_temp_seq INTO @V_Oper_Id, @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
    IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BREAK

    --Select the final jobs first and work backwards
    DECLARE cur_final_jobs CURSOR DYNAMIC LOCAL FOR
      SELECT est_setup_time, est_transfer_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, qty_at_start, latest_start_time_utc, batch_size, oper_id, seq_no, final_job FROM job
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND init_sched_ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id
          ORDER BY oper_id, seq_no
    OPEN cur_final_jobs

    WHILE (2 = 2)
    BEGIN
      FETCH cur_final_jobs INTO @V_Est_Setup_Time, @V_Est_Transfer_Time, @V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom,  @V_Qty_At_Start, @V_Latest_Start_Time1_Utc,
                                @V_Batch_Size, @V_Oper_Id, @V_Seq_No, @V_Final_Job
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
        BREAK

      SELECT @V_Est_Setup_Time=ISNULL(est_setup_time, 0), @V_Est_Transfer_Time=ISNULL(est_transfer_time, 0), @V_Est_Prod_Rate=ISNULL(est_prod_rate, 0)
	,@V_Prod_Uom = ISNULL(prod_uom, 0)
        FROM oper_ent_link WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND ent_id = @V_Init_Sched_Ent_Id

      --If final job
      IF @V_Final_Job = 1
      BEGIN
        SET @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc = @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc
        SET @V_Std_Time_Min_Qty = 0
      END

      DECLARE cur_job_bom CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT item_id, reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct FROM job_bom
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No AND bom_pos = 0
      OPEN cur_job_bom
      --Initialize min_start_qty???
      SET @V_Min_Start_Qty = 0
      WHILE (1 = 1)
      BEGIN
        FETCH cur_job_bom INTO @V_Item_Id, @V_Reqd_Start_Val, @V_Reqd_Start_Val_Pct
        IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
          BREAK

        IF @V_Reqd_Start_Val_Pct = 1
          SET @V_Min_Start_Qty = @V_Min_Start_Qty + @V_Qty_At_Start * @V_Reqd_Start_Val
        ELSE
          SET @V_Min_Start_Qty = @V_Min_Start_Qty + @V_Qty_At_Start
      END
      CLOSE cur_job_bom
      DEALLOCATE cur_job_bom

      --If not final job set min start qty
      IF @V_Final_Job = 0
      BEGIN
        --job route input percent
        SELECT @V_Min_Start_Qty = @V_Min_Start_Qty*SUM(input_percent) FROM job_route
          WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
            AND input_oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND item_id = @V_Item_Id)
        --If first operation
        IF @V_Min_Start_Qty IS NULL
        BEGIN
          SELECT @V_Min_Start_Qty = qty_at_start FROM job
            WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
        END
      END
      --Check the start qty percent of the jobs this job is feeding into
      SET @V_Min_Feed_Qty = NULL
      SELECT @V_Min_Feed_Qty = MIN(j.input_percent*k.reqd_start_val)*@V_Min_Start_Qty FROM job_route AS j
        INNER JOIN job_bom AS k ON j.wo_id = k.wo_id AND j.oper_id = k.oper_id AND j.seq_no = k.seq_no
          WHERE k.bom_pos = 0 AND k.reqd_start_val_is_pct = 1 AND j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.input_oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
            AND j.input_seq_no = @V_Seq_No AND j.input_percent*k.reqd_start_val <> 1
      IF @V_Min_Feed_Qty IS NULL
        SELECT @V_Min_Feed_Qty = MIN(k.reqd_start_val) FROM job_route AS j
          INNER JOIN job_bom AS k ON j.wo_id = k.wo_id AND j.oper_id = k.oper_id AND j.seq_no = k.seq_no
            WHERE k.bom_pos = 0 AND k.reqd_start_val_is_pct = 0 AND j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.input_oper_id = @V_Oper_Id
              AND j.input_seq_no = @V_Seq_No AND k.reqd_start_val > 0

      --Determine standard time to complete production
      SET @V_Std_Time_Prod = ISNULL(@V_Est_Setup_Time, 0) + ISNULL(@V_Est_Transfer_Time, 0)
				+ ISNULL(dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom), 0) * CEILING(@V_Qty_At_Start/@V_Batch_Size)
      --Determine standard time to produce minimum start qty
      SET @V_Std_Time_Min_Qty = ISNULL(@V_Est_Setup_Time, 0) + ISNULL(@V_Est_Transfer_Time, 0)
				+ ISNULL(dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom), 0) * CEILING(@V_Min_Start_Qty * 1/@V_Batch_Size)
      --Determine latest start time for this job

	  ---Added for CR116941(CRL00113493)----
	  IF (@V_Std_Time_Min_Qty/24 > DATEDIFF(dd, '1-1-1753 12:00AM',@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc))
		SET  @V_Std_Time_Min_Qty = 	DATEDIFF(dd, '1-1-1753 12:00AM',@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc) * 24

	  IF (@V_Std_Time_Prod/24 > DATEDIFF(dd, '1-1-1753 12:00AM',@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc))
		SET  @V_Std_Time_Prod = DATEDIFF(dd, '1-1-1753 12:00AM',@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc) * 24
	  ---END BLOCK---

      IF (@V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc - @V_Std_Time_Prod/24) < (@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc - ISNULL(@V_Std_Time_Min_Qty, 0)/24)
        SET @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc = @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc - @V_Std_Time_Prod/24.0
      ELSE
        SET @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc = @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc - @V_Std_Time_Min_Qty/24.0

      --Add min feed qty time to latest start and required finish times
      SET @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc = @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc + dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom)*ISNULL(@V_Min_Feed_Qty,0)/@V_Batch_Size/24.0
      SET @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc = @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc + dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom)*ISNULL(@V_Min_Feed_Qty,0)/@V_Batch_Size/24.0
      --Update job dates
      UPDATE job
	  SET req_finish_time_utc = @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc,
		  req_finish_time_local = DATEADD( mi, DATEDIFF( mi, GETUTCDATE(), dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ) , @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc ),
		  			--Determine if the latest start time is 1753
		  latest_start_time_utc = CASE WHEN CAST(@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc AS DATE) <= CONVERT(DATETIME, '1753-01-01', 120)  THEN
		  					-- The start time is 1753
		  					-- Determine if the bias value is < 0 (Americas), if yes, assume the local time as 1753-01-01 12a.  Therefore, add the bias value to the local time to determine UTC
		  					CASE WHEN  @time_zone_bias_value < 0 THEN DATEADD(MI, -@time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1753-01-01', 120))
		  					-- If the bias value is > 0 (+GMT), therefore, default the UTC time as 1751-01-01 12a.
		  					ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, '1753-01-01', 120)
		  					END
		  			ELSE -- If the date is not 1753-01-01, default the calculation as it was done before
		  				@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc
		  			END,
		  				--Determine if the latest start time is 1753
		  latest_start_time_local = CASE WHEN CAST(@V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc AS DATE) <= CONVERT(DATETIME, '1753-01-01', 120) THEN
		  					-- The start time is 1753
		  					-- Determine if the bias value is <= 0 (Americas +GMT), therefore, default the local time as 1753-01-01 12a.
		  					CASE WHEN  @time_zone_bias_value <= 0 THEN '1753-01-01'
		  					-- Add the bias value to the UTC time to determine the local time
		  					ELSE DATEADD(MI, @time_zone_bias_value, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1753-01-01', 120))
		  					END
		  			ELSE -- If the date is not 1753-01-01, default the calculation as it was done before
		  				DATEADD( mi, DATEDIFF( mi, GETUTCDATE(), dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ), @V_Latest_Start_Time_Utc )
					END
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No
      --finish date
      SELECT @V_Min_Start_Qty = qty_reqd FROM job
        WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @V_Oper_Id AND seq_no = @V_Seq_No

      ---Added for CR116941(CRL00113493)----
	  IF dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom)*@V_Min_Start_Qty/@V_Batch_Size/24.0 - ISNULL(@V_Est_Setup_Time, 0)/24 - ISNULL(@V_Est_Transfer_Time, 0)/24
			< DATEDIFF(dd, '1-1-1753 12:00AM',@V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc)
      SET @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc = @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc - dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(@V_Est_Prod_Rate, @V_Prod_Uom)*@V_Min_Start_Qty/@V_Batch_Size/24.0 - ISNULL(@V_Est_Setup_Time, 0)/24 - ISNULL(@V_Est_Transfer_Time, 0)/24
	  ELSE
	    SET @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc = @V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc - DATEDIFF(dd, '1-1-1753 12:00AM',@V_Req_Finish_Time_Utc)
	  ---END BLOCK---

    END
    CLOSE cur_final_jobs
    DEALLOCATE cur_final_jobs
  END
  CLOSE cur_temp_seq
  DEALLOCATE cur_temp_seq
END

-- Description: this SP inserts/updates the records into Job_Spec table , if not exists inserts into Job_Spec
--
-- Usage:

-- 0.01.00		DS			2022-08-07				 Initial version.[Default step no will be -1 if spec is not being saved against step no]
-- 0.01.01		Veervar		2024-02-09				Cleanup.

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_recipe_parameter]
								 (
                                  @wo_id [dbo].[STRING40]
                                , @parent_item_id [dbo].[STRING40]
                                , @oper_id [dbo].[STRING40]
                                , @seq_no [dbo].[INT32]
                                , @ent_id [dbo].[INT32]
                                , @ver_id [dbo].[STRING40]
								, @spec_id nvarchar(40)
								, @spec_value nvarchar(1700)=NULL		-- planned spec value
								, @act_spec_value nvarchar(1700)  --actual spec value
								, @min_value nvarchar(80)
								, @max_value nvarchar(80)								
                                , @last_edit_by [dbo].[STRING40]
                                
								)
                 AS 
BEGIN

						 
DECLARE @step_no int = -1
DECLARE @assoc_file nvarchar(254) = NULL
DECLARE @comments nvarchar(2000) = NULL
DECLARE @assoc_file_type nvarchar(254) = NULL
DECLARE @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) = NULL
DECLARE @mod_id varchar(30)
DECLARE @access_level int = 0
		

	BEGIN TRY
			if exists(select 1 from dbo.job_spec where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no and step_no = -1 and spec_id = @spec_id )  -- default step no = -1
				begin

					select @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) from dbo.job_spec where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no and step_no = -1 and spec_id = @spec_id

					exec [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Spec] 
							   @wo_id
							  ,@oper_id
							  ,@seq_no
							  ,@step_no
							  ,@spec_id
							  ,@spec_value
							  ,@act_spec_value
							  ,@assoc_file
							  ,@assoc_file_type
							  ,@comments
							  ,@min_value
							  ,@max_value
							  ,@access_level
							  ,@last_edit_comment
							  ,@mod_id

					end
				else
					begin

					exec		[dbo].[sp_I_Job_Spec] 
								   @wo_id
								  ,@oper_id
								  ,@seq_no
								  ,@step_no
								  ,@spec_id
								  ,@spec_value
								  ,@act_spec_value
								  ,@assoc_file
								  ,@comments
								  ,@min_value
								  ,@max_value
								  ,@access_level
								  ,@last_edit_comment
								  ,@mod_id OUTPUT

					end

				select 1 as result,'updated successfully' as resultCode

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
				select 0 as result,ERROR_MESSAGE() as resultCode
	END CATCH

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Process_Clone]
(@user_id		NVARCHAR(40),
 @existing_process_id	NVARCHAR(40),
 @new_process_id	NVARCHAR(40),
 @new_process_desc	NVARCHAR(80),
 @new_process_ver_id	NVARCHAR(80),
 @disassociate_items	BIT = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name     - sp_I_Process_Clone
-- Description     	   - (HD# 1143) To clone an existing Process in the database supplying a new Process ID.
--		     All data in the Process, Process_Attr, Oper, Oper_Attr, Oper_Step_Grp, Oper_Step, Oper_Ent_Link,
--		     Oper_Ent_Route, Oper_Step_Ent_Exc, Oper_Spec_Ver, Oper_Ent_Spec,  Oper_Step_Ent_Exc and
--		     Oper_Step_File, Cert_Oper_Link and Cert_Oper_Step_Link for the exising_process_id are cloned
--		     to the new_process_id.  If disassociate_items is false, all data in the Item_Process_Link,
--		     BOM_Item_Oper_Link BOM_Item_Oper_Step_Link and BOM_Item_Oper_Spec are cloned to the new_process_id.
-- Date Created    - 11/15/2002
-- Author	   - Raghu
-- Version         - 3.1.0.7
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 12/18/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2014). Automatically generate Version Numbers for a cloned process
-- 06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 10/13/2004	Raghu		2.1.3	(HD# 5060), Included spc_char_oper_link records during process clone
-- 12/10/2004	Raghu		2.1.9	HD# 5180, Included min_value, max_value and access_level while cloning a process
-- 08/19/2005	Raghu		2.1.26  Added error message to language table, so that it can be translatable.
-- 09/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/17/2006	SJ              3107	HD#6726 - Error while cloning a process. Violation of UNIQUE KEY constraint 'IX_item_process_link'
-- 10/24/2006	KRF		3.1.25	HD Call 8953 - clone data_log_grp_oper_link records
-- 11/09/2006	Raghu		3.1.25	HD# 9083, Cloning a process does not clone oper.spare* fields.
-- 01/15/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD #8314, 9222, 9224, 9226, & 9248, part of DB changes - copy bom_item_oper_link.def_sublot_no,
--					oper_step.reqd_rep_pct, process.spare1-4, & process.may_override_route, and handle renamed
--					spc_char_oper_link fields.  Also HD# 5678 w.r.t. created_at.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--02/12/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074939; Error when cloning a process
--02/23/2011	Ibrahim     4.0 L00110618/HF2373; The process_status of a cloned process is set based on the general parameter
--												  settings defined for the cloned process in a process class.
--06/15/2012   Praveen      4.5 L00119566 Added a rework_cd parameter to the insert statement of oper table.
--10/08/2012	  Arun          4.6         spc_char_oper_link is removed from the database
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @process_ver_id		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@process_class_id	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@last_edit_by		STRING40
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,@created_at		DATETIME -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	,@use_gmt		INT32 -- Added 1/15/07 KRF
	,@process_status INT32 -- ADDED FOR CR L00110618/HF2373
	,@certproc_per_procclass INT -- ADDED FOR CR L00110618/HF2373

	IF (@existing_process_id IS NULL OR @new_process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 Should not be Null{3339},Existing Process Id and New Process Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id) BEGIN
--		RAISERROR('Source Process ID does not exist. Can not Clone', 16, 1)
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},Source Process Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_id = @new_process_id) BEGIN
--		RAISERROR('A Process ID with the name already exists. Can not Clone', 16, 1)
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 already exist in the database.{4675},New Process Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Added following 4 lines 1/15/07 KRF
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_gmt OUTPUT
	SET @use_gmt = ISNULL(@use_gmt, 0)
	IF @use_gmt = 1 SET @created_at = @last_edit_at
	ELSE SET @created_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	SELECT @process_class_id = process_class_id FROM process
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id
	IF @new_process_ver_id IS NULL EXEC sp_SA_Process_GetNextVerId @process_class_id, @process_ver_id OUTPUT
	ELSE SET @process_ver_id = @new_process_ver_id
	IF @new_process_desc IS NULL SET @new_process_desc = @new_process_id

	--BEGIN Fix for CR L00110618/HF2373
	--If the Existing Process is a Certified Process then validate the status of the cloned process.
	SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM process WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id
	IF @process_status = 3 -- existing process is a certified process
	BEGIN
		SELECT @certproc_per_procclass = CAST(attr_value as INT) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_id = 211 --May only have one certified process in a process class.
		IF @certproc_per_procclass = 1 -- only one certified process per process class.
		BEGIN
			SELECT @process_status = CAST(attr_value AS INT) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE attr_id = 213 --Cloned certified process status if only one certified process is allowed.
		END
	END
	-- Added "may_override_route," and ", spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4" 2 places each in statement below 1/15/07 KRF
	INSERT INTO process (process_id, process_class_id, process_ver_id, process_desc, process_level,
		process_status, creator, approver, created_at, last_editor, last_edit_at,
		last_instantiated, disassembly, may_override_route, notes, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4)
	SELECT @new_process_id, process_class_id
		,'process_ver_id'  = CASE WHEN (@process_ver_id IS NOT NULL) THEN @process_ver_id ELSE process_ver_id END
		, @new_process_desc, process_level,
		@process_status, @user_id, NULL, @last_edit_at , @user_id, @last_edit_at,
		last_instantiated, disassembly, may_override_route, notes, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
	FROM process
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id
	--END Fix for CR L00110618/HF2373
	INSERT INTO process_attr (process_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at FROM process_attr
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id

--Modified for the CRL00119566
	INSERT INTO oper (process_id, oper_id, oper_desc, def_reject_rate, first_oper, final_oper, display_seq,
		check_inv, sched_to_ent_id, oper_type, oper_cost, deviation_above, deviation_below, assoc_file,
		assoc_file_type,rework_cd, notes, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, oper_id, oper_desc, def_reject_rate, first_oper, final_oper, display_seq,
		check_inv, sched_to_ent_id, oper_type, oper_cost, deviation_above, deviation_below, assoc_file,
		assoc_file_type, rework_cd,notes, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id

	INSERT INTO oper_attr (process_id, oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_process_id, oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM oper_attr
	WHERE process_id = @existing_process_id

	-- Added 10/24/2006 to clone data_log_grp_oper_link records per HD call 8953

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN

    	SET @string =  ''''''
	END ELSE BEGIN
    	SET @string =  '''' + REPLACE(@string, '''', '''''') + ''''

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetStorLocFiltrByName]
(@ent_name		STRING80
,@site_name		STRING80
,@current_inventory		INT32_NULL = 0
,@filtr					STRING4000_NULL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETSTORLOCTNSBYFILTER
-- Description          -    Returns inventory.  If the flag is set, then the inventory is returned for just the specified entity,
--                      and is restricted by the filter shown below.  If the flag is not set, then the inventory is returned
--                      for the specified entities and all the entities located at that entity.
--                      The stored procedure will have to descend the storage_exec?s storage_ent_id field to get the entities
--                      to include in the record set.
--                      Filter Example: $$item_id=$$$$lot_no=$$$$item_grade_cd=$$$$item_status_cd=$$
--                      1) When opened in the context of a job and is hard pegged, the work order and to
--                          operation are disabled and the ITEM filter is set to BOM 0.
--                      2) The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in
--                          BOM 0 item and its substitutes, and all job bom component serial numbers
--                          located at the selected location that are flagged for inheritance at the selected operation.
--                      3) When hard pegged, the selected Work order will filter the list of BOM 0 item serial numbers
--                          listed in the current inventory grid but not when soft pegged.
-- Author				- Raghu
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @ent_id			INT32

	SELECT @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

	EXEC sp_SA_SE_GetStorLoctnsByFilter @ent_id, @current_inventory, @filtr, @time_zone_bias_value
END
