BEGIN
	
	Declare @ent_name varchar(100)
	print @ent_id
	if @ent_id = -1 and @entity_type = 'Area'
	begin
	print '1'
	select distinct e.ent_name,e.ent_id from attr a with(nolock)
	inner join ent_attr ea with(nolock) on ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	inner join ent e with(nolock) on e.ent_id = ea.ent_id

	end

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job
-- Description:  Splits the Jobs for the given order
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-01-29			Initial version.
-- 0.01.02  MC			2025-04-25			adding condition to add job bom pos 0 to ext table only if all jobs are in new state
-- ===========================================================================================
-- exec SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job 1001268411
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job_backup020725] @wo_id VARCHAR(100) AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @attr_id INT,@process_id VARCHAR(100),@oper_id VARCHAR(100),@qty_reqd FLOAT,@seq_no INT,
@error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@material_grp VARCHAR(100)

BEGIN TRY

	DECLARE @event_time_utc DATETIME,@event_time_local DATETIME,@created_by NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @event_time_utc = dbo.Fn_stripmillisecsfromdatetime(Getutcdate())
	SET @event_time_local =dbo.Fn_tz_getlocaldatefromutc(NULL, @event_time_utc)

	SELECT @created_by = attr_value FROM   system_attr sa WITH (nolock) WHERE  sa.attr_id = 199

	IF (SELECT COUNT(row_id) FROM job with (nolock) WHERE wo_id=@wo_id and state_cd>1)=0 --0.01.02 - verification if all jobs are in new state
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_wo_item_ext](					-- (KN 18/02/23 - Added logic to copy the bom_pos 0 item from job_bom to ofi_wo_item_ext as requested by AVEVA)
		[wo_id],[parent_item_id],[bom_pos],[item_id],[qty],[qty_per_parent_item],[backflush],[def_lot_no],
		[item_number],[item_desc],[uom_desc],[by_product],[co_product],[spare6],[created_at_utc],[created_at_local],
		[last_edit_at_utc],[last_edit_at_local],[created_by],[last_edit_by])
		SELECT 
		wo_id,NULL,bom_pos,item_id,qty_reqd,qty_per_parent_item,backflush,def_lot_no,
		NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,
		@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,@created_by,@created_by
		FROM job_bom with(nolock) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos = 0
	END

	DECLARE oper_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR Select oper_id, qty_reqd, seq_no from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id and seq_no = 0	--Get all jobs with operations and qty_reqd  for the work order

	Open oper_cur

	Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0								-- For each of that job (operation)
    BEGIN

		DECLARE @batch_size varchar(10),@new_seq_no int,@target_ent_id int,@split_cnt float
		SET @attr_id = -1
		select @attr_id =  attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'BatchSize'

		Select @material_grp = product_group from ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id
		Select @process_id = process_id from process_attr with (nolock) where attr_value = @material_grp

		IF EXISTS(select 1 from oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id)
		BEGIN

			Select @batch_size = attr_value from oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id			-- Get the batch size
			Select @target_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id from job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = 0 and oper_id = @oper_id

			SET @split_cnt = (@qty_reqd / convert(float, @batch_size))-1

				WHILE @split_cnt > 0
				BEGIN
					BEGIN TRANSACTION

					SELECT @new_seq_no = max(seq_no) from JOB WITH (NOLOCK) where oper_id = @oper_id and wo_id = @wo_id

					SET @new_seq_no = @new_seq_no + 1

					exec SP_I_JOB_EXEC_SPLITJOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@orig_seq_no=0,@user_id=NULL,@split_qty=@batch_size,
					@new_seq_no=@new_seq_no output,@split_start_qty=NULL,@new_state_cd=1,@req_finish_time=NULL,@req_finish_time_utc=NULL,@target_ent_id=@target_ent_id,
					@status_notes=NULL,@ignore_zero_start_qty_check=NULL,@time_zone_bias_value=60

					Update job set last_edit_comment = 'EI SPLIT JOB' WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no

					COMMIT TRANSACTION

					SET @split_cnt = @split_cnt - 1;
				END

		END

		Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no
	END

Close oper_cur
Deallocate oper_cur

END try

BEGIN catch
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();

    RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END catch


END

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Line_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description	      - Get all attributes that are associated to a Line.
-- Author	      - Arun.
-- Date Created	      - 10/22/2013
-- Version            - 4.6.0.0

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY

  SELECT line_attr.line_id

            ,line_attr.last_edit_by
            ,line_attr.last_edit_at

  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON line_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id

CREATE   Trigger [tg_item_class_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[item_class]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_class_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_class table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @item_class_id	NVARCHAR(40)
	   ,@obsolete	BIT
	,@last_edit_by 	STRING40

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--Open a cursor to fetch all the rows, one at a time
	DECLARE item_class_cursor CURSOR STATIC FOR
		select b.item_class_id, b.obsolete
		FROM item_class a, inserted b
		WHERE a.item_class_id = b.item_class_id
	OPEN item_class_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM item_class_cursor INTO @item_class_id, @obsolete
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (UPDATE(obsolete))  BEGIN
			IF (@obsolete = 1) UPDATE item SET obsolete = 1 WHERE item_class_id = @item_class_id
		END
		UPDATE item_class SET last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		WHERE item_class_id = @item_class_id
	END
	CLOSE item_class_cursor
	DEALLOCATE item_class_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessLPRData]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'LPR',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT, -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
	@label_id NVARCHAR(15) = '' OUTPUT -- V2.01 Added label_id to the output
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5,
			@cfg_feedback_timeout INT = 30;

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(50)),23)+ FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmssfff');
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(@TranName,29) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1
	SET @label_id = '' -- V2.01

	BEGIN TRY
		
		-- moved here
		IF @TranCounter = 0
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
		ELSE
			SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN
		------@wo_id AS wo_id,
  ------          @seq_no AS seq_no,
  ------          @hu_number AS hu_number,
  ------          @recorded_timestamp AS recorded_timestamp,
  ------          @qty AS qty,
  ------          @no_of_prints AS no_of_prints,
  ------          @bag_type AS bag_type,
		------	@CBWoId AS CBWoId,
		------	@CBSeqNo AS CBSeqNo,
		------	@CBSublotNo AS CBSublotNo
			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,	
					@hu_number NVARCHAR(40) = NULL, 
					@qty FLOAT, 	
					@no_of_prints INT,
					@bag_type INT,
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
					@CBWoId INT,
					@CBSeqNo INT,
					@CBSublotNo INT,
					@debug INT = 0,
					@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@hu_number = hu_number
					,@qty = qty
					,@no_of_prints = no_of_prints
					,@bag_type = bag_type
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
					,@CBWoId = CBWoId
					,@CBSeqNo = CBSeqNo
					,@CBSublotNo = CBSublotNo
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',
				hu_number NVARCHAR(40) '$.hu_number', 
				qty FLOAT '$.qty',  
				no_of_prints INT '$.no_of_prints',
				bag_type INT '$.bag_type',
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME '$.recorded_timestamp' ,
				CBWoId INT '$.CBWoId',
				CBSeqNo INT '$.CBSeqNo',
				CBSublotNo INT '$.CBSublotNo'
			);
	
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based) SEGMENT NAME_INTERFACETYPE_EXTRAINFO
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = wa.output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			
			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type, @ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'				
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- Declare the outputs 
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT	@data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state, qty prod and qty req
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if JOB is new or ready ERROR; Else is not RUNNING (3) (nor new nor Ready) then WARNING  -- ,7,8,9
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED, 7, 8, 9 -- Avoid errors -- 4,5 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500030,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500031,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			IF @data_job_pos = -1
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(5438,NULL,NULL)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_pos_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- GET USER ID
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			-- Verify that we are not in TIMEOUT:
			
			-- Verify if we are OK within timeout margin of processing the message
			DECLARE @timeout_timestamp DATETIME
					,@curTime DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			SET @recorded_timestamp = COALESCE(@recorded_timestamp,@current_timestamp) 
			SET @timeout_timestamp = DATEADD(SECOND, @cfg_feedback_timeout, @recorded_timestamp)
			
			
			IF @curTime > @timeout_timestamp
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500040,NULL,NULL)+' @recorded_timestamp: '+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@recorded_timestamp,121) + '; @timeout_timestamp: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@timeout_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timeout_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			DECLARE @lbl_name_generated NVARCHAR(100) = NULL;
			DECLARE @sublot NVARCHAR(40),
					@lot_no NVARCHAR(40);

			SELECT @sublot = out_sublot_no,
				   @lot_no = out_lot_no
			FROM [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_GenerateSublot](@CBWoId, 'CakeBlending', @CBSeqNo, @CBSublotNo);

			DECLARE @usesublotforexport INT, 
					@process_id NVARCHAR(40);
			
			SELECT @process_id = process_id 
			FROM wo 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id

			SELECT @usesublotforexport = attr_value 
			FROM process_attr pa 
				JOIN attr a ON pa.attr_id = a.attr_id 
			WHERE pa.process_id = @process_id AND a.attr_desc = 'UseSublotForExport'

			IF @usesublotforexport = '1'
			BEGIN
				SET @sublot = [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_Sublot_For_Export](@sublot);
			END

			DECLARE @hu_number_sap NVARCHAR(40)
			SET @hu_number_sap = dbo.fn_s_ofi_dcsHU_to_SAPHU(@hu_number,
    																	@mes_wo_id,
    																	@mes_oper_id,
    																	@seq_no);
			IF @bag_type <> 0 
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @nested_hu NVARCHAR(40);
				
				SELECT @nested_hu = ip.spare2  --V4.00
				FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ip.spare3 = @hu_number_sap 
					AND ip.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND ip.seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND ip.oper_id = @mes_oper_id

				SET @hu_number_sap = @nested_hu
			END

			EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label] 
				@wo_id = @mes_wo_id,
				@oper_id = @mes_oper_id,
				@seq_no = @seq_no,
				@trigger_type = 'inline',       
				@trigger_from = 'DCS_Trigger',
				@hu_number = @hu_number_sap,
				@print_qty = @no_of_prints,
				@bag_type = @bag_type,
				@sublot_no = @sublot,
				@recorded_timestamp = @recorded_timestamp,
				@lpr_qty = @qty,
				@lbl_name = @lbl_name_generated OUTPUT;

			-- Generated label validation V2.02
			IF @lbl_name_generated IS NULL OR @lbl_name_generated = ''
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Error: sp_i_ofi_lm_label failed to generate a valid label for wo_id: ' + ISNULL(@wo_id, 'NULL')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'Generate label error', @status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Do the final part prior to exiting the process
			Finishing_OK:

			PRINT 'Finishing OK'

			-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
			IF @status_output = 1 
			BEGIN
				-- SET OK
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
				-- Add the generated label ID to the success message for tracing
				SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500039,NULL,NULL) + ' | Generated Label: ' + ISNULL(@lbl_name_generated, 'N/A')
				-- V2.01 Added label ID
				SET @label_id = ISNULL(@lbl_name_generated, '')
			END

			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		-- Exit place
		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output
				,@label_id as [label_id] -- V2.01

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

		SET @message_output = @message_output + @message


		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output
				,@label_id as [label_id]

		BEGIN TRY
			---- ADDed extras v1.03  ==> if state is -1 then we just need to rollback all
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			-- Find the last opening brace
			DECLARE @start INT = LEN(@message_output) - CHARINDEX('{', REVERSE(@message_output)) + 1;

			-- Find the corresponding closing brace
			DECLARE @end INT = CHARINDEX('}', @message_output, @start);

			-- Remove the substring if both braces are found
			IF @start > 0 AND @end > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = STUFF(@message_output, @start, @end - @start + 1, '');
			END

			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@status_output)+';message_output:'+@message_output
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
					,@status_output as status_output
					,@message_output as message_output
					,@label_id as [label_id] -- V2.01
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_EI_validSampleCreationRequests]
-- Description: This SP will cancel samples created in MES if not trigerred by preferred sample plan
-- Usage:		EI - Create sample request
-- EXEC [sp_SA_ofi_EI_validSampleCreationRequests]
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi	2024-03-12		Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Veervar Joshi	2024-04-30		Updated for SampleMode check for triggered samples and cancel sample
-- 0.01.02 JSC				2025-06-24			Update LIMS to get default batch or sublot when sending sample request (if prod is empty)
-- ===========================================================================================-
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_EI_validSampleCreationRequests]

AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @sampleSourceUI NVARCHAR(40)= 'UI' -- Sample Created in MES BY QM trigger
	DECLARE @sampleSourceAUT NVARCHAR(40)= 'AUT' -- Sample Created in MES BY QM trigger
	DECLARE @sampleSourceLIMS NVARCHAR(40)= 'LIMS' -- Sample Created in MES BY QM trigger
	DECLARE @smpCount INT=0	
	DECLARE @attr_value NVARCHAR(80)
	DECLARE @lastcomment NVARCHAR(80)= 'Invalid Plan' 
	DECLARE @cancelledSample_Status int =8

	DECLARE @tblallSmples AS TABLE (
	row_num INT,
	ent_id INT, 
	lineName NVARCHAR(40),
	line_id INT, 
	limsPlanId NVARCHAR(40),
	limsFreq NVARCHAR(40), 
	sample_id INT,
	sent_to_lims INT,
	plevel NVARCHAR(40),
	stage NVARCHAR(40),
	wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
	wo_cust NVARCHAR(80), 
	item_id NVARCHAR(40),
	sample_status INT, 
	freq_id INT, 
	plan_id INT,
	stimestamp DATETIME,
	is_valid INT,
	lot_no NVARCHAR(80), 
	sublot NVARCHAR(80), 
	lims_sublotno NVARCHAR(80),
	sampleSource NVARCHAR(40)
	)

	--0.01.01
	--CANCEL MES SCHEDULER TRIGGERRED SAMPLE IF LINE IS CONFIGURED FOR AUTOSAMPLER MODE
	DECLARE @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80)= 'SampleRequestMode'
	DECLARE @attr_val NVARCHAR(80)= 'Automation'
	SET @lastcomment='Invalid Trigger'
	;WITH cte_autEnt as( 
	select DISTINCT ent.ent_id from ent
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id 
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	where a.attr_desc=@attr_desc and ea.attr_value=@attr_val)
	,
	cte_allSample as (select sample_id, GL.line_id, smp.ent_id,smp.spare4,sample_status from sample smp WITH (NOLOCK)	
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo](smp.ent_id,0) GL
	WHERE smp.sample_status <> 8 -- Cancelled Status
	AND (smp.spare4 <> @sampleSourceLIMS OR smp.spare4 IS NULL)
	AND (smp.spare4 <> @sampleSourceAUT OR smp.spare4 IS NULL)
	AND (smp.spare4 <> @sampleSourceUI OR smp.spare4 IS NULL)
	AND SMP.sample_status IN (1,2,3,5) ---READY/WARNING/MISSED/LATE
	)
	, cte_ivSamples as (select sample_id, spare4, sample_status, cte_allSample.ent_id from cte_allSample
	inner join cte_autEnt on cte_allSample.line_id=cte_autEnt.ent_id)	
	
	UPDATE SAMPLE SET sample_status=@cancelledSample_Status,
	last_edit_comment=@lastcomment,
	last_edit_at= getdate() WHERE sample_id IN (SELECT sample_id FROM cte_ivSamples)


	--INSERT SAMPLES INTO TEMP TABLE
	INSERT INTO @tblallSmples
   SELECT 
	   ROW_NUMBER() over(order by sample_id) AS row_id,
	   smp.ent_id,
	   GL.line_name, 
	   GL.line_id,
	   FSP.[1],
	   FRQ.[2], 
	   sample_id,
	   smp.spare3,
	   FLV.[1],
	   FLV.[2],
	   smp.wo_id,
	   wxt.ship_to_customer,
	   smp.item_id,
	   sample_status,
	   spf.freq_id,
	   smp.plan_id,
	   smp.requested_time_local,
	   0,
	   smp.lot_no,
	   smp.sublot_no,
	   NULL	   ,
	   smp.spare4
   FROM sample smp WITH (NOLOCK)
   INNER JOIN wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON smp.wo_id=wo.wo_id
   LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_ext wxt WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = wxt.wo_id
   INNER JOIN sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK) on sp.plan_id=smp.plan_id   
   INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) on ent.ent_id= smp.ent_id
   INNER JOIN [sample_plan_freq_link] spf WITH (NOLOCK) ON spf.plan_id=smp.plan_id
   CROSS APPLY [dbo].[ufn_ofi_SplitStringAsTableColumns](ISNULL(sp.spare2,''),'|') FLV
   CROSS APPLY [dbo].[ufn_ofi_SplitStringAsTableColumns](ISNULL(sp.spare3,''),'|') FRQ
   CROSS APPLY [dbo].[ufn_ofi_SplitStringAsTableColumns](ISNULL(sp.spare1,''),'|') FSP
   CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_QM_getLineInfo](smp.ent_id,0) GL
   
   WHERE
   (smp.spare3 = 0 or smp.spare3 IS NULL) --Unprocessed Samples  
   AND smp.sample_status <> 8 -- sample status not equal to cancelled
   AND smp.wo_id IS NOT NULL
   AND (SMP.spare4 <> @sampleSourceLIMS OR SMP.spare4 IS NULL)
   AND smp.final=0
   AND SMP.item_id IS NOT NULL AND smp.item_id <> ''

 
   SELECT @smpCount= COUNT(1) from @tblallSmples

   DECLARE 
   @ent_id INT,
   @line_id INT,
   @sample_id INT,
   @sent_to_lims INT,
   @plevel NVARCHAR(40),
   @stage NVARCHAR(40), 
   @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
   @wo_cust NVARCHAR(80),
   @item_id NVARCHAR(40),
   @sample_status INT, 
   @freq_id INT,
   @plan_id INT,
   @sublot_no NVARCHAR(80),
   @is_valid INT,
   @lot_no NVARCHAR(80),
   @lims_sublotno NVARCHAR(80),
   @sampleSource NVARCHAR(80)
  	SET @lastcomment='Invalid Plan'

 DECLARE @loopcnt INT =1
 
   IF (@smpCount > 0 )
   BEGIN
   WHILE (@loopcnt <= @smpCount) --LOOP THROUGH EACH UN-PROCESSED SAMPLE 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@line_id=line_id,
			@sample_id=sample_id ,
		   @sent_to_lims=sent_to_lims ,
		   @plevel=plevel ,
		   @stage =stage, 
		   @wo_id =wo_id,
		   @wo_cust=wo_cust ,
		   @item_id =item_id,
		   @sample_status=sample_status , 
		   @freq_id=freq_id ,
		   @plan_id =plan_id,
		   @is_valid=is_valid,
		   @sublot_no=sublot,
		   @lot_no=lot_no,
		   @sampleSource= sampleSource
		   
		   FROM @tblallSmples where row_num=@loopcnt


		   IF (EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM fn_S_ofi_QM_getPreferredSamplePlan(@item_id,@freq_id,@wo_cust,@plevel,@stage) psmp WHERE psmp.pref_plan_id = @plan_id))
		   OR (@sampleSource = @sampleSourceUI or @sampleSource=@sampleSourceAUT)
		   BEGIN		 
		   
				SET @lims_sublotno =  [dbo].[ufn_S_ofi_QM_getLotnoforSampleRequest](@ent_id,@line_id,@wo_id,@sample_id)
			
				SELECT @lims_sublotno = COALESCE(@lims_sublotno,ow.def_lot_no)
				FROM ofi_wo_item_ext ow WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ow.wo_id = @wo_id 
					AND ow.item_id = @item_id
					AND ow.bom_pos = 0

				UPDATE @tblallSmples SET is_valid=1, lims_sublotno=@lims_sublotno  WHERE sample_id= @sample_id
			
		   END
		   ELSE
		   BEGIN
		    
			UPDATE @tblallSmples SET is_valid=0 WHERE sample_id= @sample_id
			--SET SAMPLE STATUS AS CANCEL CODE GOES HERE
			UPDATE sample set sample_status=@cancelledSample_Status, last_edit_comment=@lastcomment,
			last_edit_at= getdate()
			WHERE sample_id=@sample_id
					   			 

		   END
		   	
			SET @loopcnt= @loopcnt+1
		
   END
END


	 SELECT 
		sample_id AS samplerequestid,
		limsPlanId AS sampleplanid,
		item_id AS materialid,
		stimestamp AS timestamp,
		lims_sublotno AS sublotnumber,
		lineName AS linename,
		plevel AS level,
		stage AS stage,
		limsFreq AS frequency  FROM @tblallSmples where is_valid=1


END

-- 11/25/2002		Raghu			1.5			(HD# 1899). 8) If lot_no is NULL, use job_exec.def_lot_no. If still NUL, use
--												lot_no = '-'
-- 12/06/2002		Raghu			1.5.2		(HD# ??) FROM Interface Change.doc. Added optional sign_off parameter to get
--												the sign off date. If sign_off is null, default to current date
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2		Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 04/25/2003		Raghu			1.6.0		(HD# 2713). If wo_id, or oper_id is blank, raise the err bak to the user, which
--												should not allow the user to insert a record in cert_audit_log
-- 05/13/2003		Raghu			1.6.7		()HD# 2498). Auto Populating of Job Event table.
-- 06-06-2003		Sheetal Jain    1608  		Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 06/15/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement
-- 02/09/2005		Raghu			2.1.13		HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 04/25/2005		Raghu			2.1.20		An exception is thrown if the user has already signed off this certification
-- 08/19/2005		Raghu			2.1.26		Added error message to language table, so that it can be translatable.
-- 09/28/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2007		KRF				3.2.1		HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 08/15/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	DECLARE @return 		INT32
		,	@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@ent_id			INT32
		,	@job_pos		INT32
		,	@last_edit_at	TDATETIME
		,	@last_edit_by	STRING40
		,	@err_msg		STRING254
		,	@in_signoff		TDATETIME
		,	@sign_off_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp		TDATETIME

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	IF (@process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	END

	SELECT @in_signoff = @sign_off_local, @active = ISNULL(@active, 1)

	IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @wo_id = '' ) OR (@oper_id IS NULL OR @oper_id = '') BEGIN
		RAISERROR('WO_Id or Oper_Id cannot be null or blank{3862}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXECUTE @return = sp_Cert_SignOff_Allowed @user_id, @process_id, @oper_id, @step_no, @cert_name, @time_zone_bias_value
	IF @return <> 0 BEGIN
		--RAISERROR(' Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level or Certificate has expired.: %d', 16, 1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Assuming CertName is a required parameter.
	-- Value for StepNo parameter is passed, if not default step_no to 0
	IF (@step_no is null or @step_no = '') SET @step_no = -1

	--Added by Raghu. If lot_no is NULL, use job_exec.def_lot_no or '-'
	IF @lot_no IS NULL BEGIN

		SELECT @lot_no = def_lot_no
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id
			AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
			AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

		IF (@lot_no IS NULL) SET @lot_no = ''

	END

	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			AND (step_no = @step_no OR (step_no IS NULL AND @step_no IS NULL)) AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			AND (prod_log_id = @prod_log_id OR (prod_log_id IS NULL AND @prod_log_id IS NULL))
			AND (cons_log_id = @cons_log_id OR (cons_log_id IS NULL AND @cons_log_id IS NULL))
			AND cert_name = @cert_name
			AND cert_audit_log.user_id = @user_id
	)
	BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 has already signed this certification. Please try another user.{4673},' + @user_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	/*
	-- IF @sign_off IS NULL SET @sign_off = @last_edit_at
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF (@sign_off IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @sign_off = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @sign_off = @last_edit_at
	ELSE SET @sign_off =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sign_off)
	SET @sign_off = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @sign_off, 120)
	*/

	IF ( @sign_off_local IS NULL ) SET @sign_off_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @sign_off_local, @tz_temp, @sign_off_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT	@sign_off_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sign_off_utc )
		,	@sign_off_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @sign_off_local )

	INSERT INTO cert_audit_log
	(
		wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, lot_no, prod_log_id, cons_log_id,
		process_id, process_status, active, cert_name, user_id, sign_off_utc,
		sign_off_local, comments, ref_row_id, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	VALUES
	(
		@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, @lot_no, @prod_log_id, @cons_log_id,
		@process_id, @process_status, @active, @cert_name, @user_id, @sign_off_utc,
		@sign_off_local, @comments, @ref_row_id, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	)

	IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('SQL ERROR, inserting into cert_audit_log{3333}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 231

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id, @job_pos = job_pos
		FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

		IF EXISTS (
			SELECT TOP 1 'X'
			FROM job_event WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no
				AND step_no = @step_no
				AND lot_no = @lot_no
				AND cert_name = @cert_name
				AND UPPER(event_type) = 'CERTSIGNOFF'
				AND ent_id = @ent_id
		)
		BEGIN

			UPDATE job_event SET checked_by_user_id = @user_id
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no
				AND step_no = @step_no
				AND lot_no = @lot_no
				AND cert_name = @cert_name
				AND UPPER(event_type) = 'CERTSIGNOFF'
				AND ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @ent_id, @in_signoff, @job_pos, @step_no, 'CertSignOff', NULL, @lot_no, NULL, @cert_name, @user_id,
			NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Cert_Grade_Link]
  (@cert_name nvarchar(40) ,
   @from_item_grade_cd int ,
   @to_item_grade_cd int )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_S_Cert_Grade_Link
-- Description      - Select a single existing row identified by the primary key
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--09/22/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT cert_grade_link.cert_name
       ,cert_grade_link.from_item_grade_cd
       ,cert_grade_link.to_item_grade_cd
       ,cert_grade_link.cert_level
       ,cert_grade_link.last_edit_comment
       ,cert_grade_link.last_edit_by
       ,cert_grade_link.last_edit_at
       ,cert_grade_link.row_id
FROM cert_grade_link cert_grade_link
WHERE (cert_grade_link.cert_name = @cert_name AND
       cert_grade_link.from_item_grade_cd = @from_item_grade_cd AND
       cert_grade_link.to_item_grade_cd = @to_item_grade_cd)

	DECLARE @jobBomRow int32

		declare @result_temp table
