							wo_id nvarchar(20),
							oper_id nvarchar(30),
							seq_no int,
							result_code int,
							failed_msg nvarchar(MAX),
							bom_item nvarchar(MAX)
						)

		INSERT INTO @cte(bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
					,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
					,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
					,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd) 
		SELECT bom_pos ,item_id ,reqd_grade_cd 
					,item_grade_desc ,qty_per_parent_item ,min_qty_per_parent_item 
					,max_qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_reqd_qty_per ,uom_description  ,job_qty_reqd ,last_wo		
					,last_oper,last_seq,material_type,is_cakeblender_running ,qty_reqd  FROM  
		OPENJSON ( @grid )  
		WITH (        
				 -- rowId  int '$.row_id',
				  bom_pos  int  '$.bom_pos' ,
				  item_id   varchar(80) '$.item_id' ,  
				  --item_desc  varchar(120) '$.item_desc', 
				  reqd_grade_cd   int  '$.reqd_grade_cd' ,
				  item_grade_desc   varchar(120) '$.item_grade_desc', 
				  qty_per_parent_item float  '$.qty_per_parent_item',
				  min_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.min_qty_per_parent_item',
				  max_qty_per_parent_item float  '$.max_qty_per_parent_item',
				  recipe_reqd_qty_per float  '$.recipe_reqd_qty_per',
				  uom_description  varchar(40)  '$.uom_description',
				  job_qty_reqd float  '$.job_qty_reqd',
				  last_wo		varchar(80) '$.last_wo' ,
				  last_oper		varchar(80) '$.last_oper' ,
				  last_seq		varchar(80) '$.last_seq' ,
				  material_type		varchar(80) '$.material_type' ,
				  is_cakeblender_running  int  '$.is_cakeblender_running' ,
				  qty_reqd  float  '$.qty_reqd'
		);

		update @cte set reqd_grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
		from item_grade ig inner join @cte c1 on ig.item_grade_desc = c1.item_grade_desc and ig.good_prod =1


		if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe')
		begin
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LastjobBOMRecipe') Is Not Null 
			BEGIN 
				DROP TABLE #LastjobBOMRecipe; 
			END
			SELECT top 1 @lastWo_id = wo_id,@lastOper_id = oper_id, @lastseqNo = seq_no from job with(nolock) where run_ent_id = @ent_id and item_id = @parent_item_id and state_cd = 4 order by act_finish_time_utc desc 
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #LastjobBOMRecipe FROM  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id=@lastWo_id and oper_id = @lastOper_id and seq_no = @lastseqNo and bom_pos<>0
		end
		else 
		begin
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BOMRecipe') Is Not Null 
			BEGIN 
				DROP TABLE #BOMRecipe; 
			END
			select @bomItem = item_id, @bomVersion = version from ofi_master_recipe with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name;
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by row_id)as rows,* INTO #BOMRecipe FROM  bom_item with(nolock) where parent_item_id = @bomItem and ver_id = @bomVersion and bom_pos <>0
		end

			 --select @bomItem ,@bomVersion
			 --select * from @cte
			 --select * from #BOMRecipe


		--	 validation 
			--begin
			--	select 0 as result, '@@CakeBlenderCompenentIsNotPresent@@' as resultCode;  
			--	--select 1 as result,'updated successfully ' as resultCode
			--	return;
			--end

			--BOM Compare
			-- same SP can't be used as we have to pass the selected parameter
			

		insert into @result_temp
			exec [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompareSetUp] 
			   @wo_id
			  ,@oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@ent_id
			  ,@parent_item_id
			  ,@recipe_name

		if ((select top 1 result_code from @result_temp)<>1)
		begin
			select @resultset = 0 
			,@resultCode =  (select top 1  CONCAT(failed_msg,'- ',bom_item) from @result_temp); 
			return;
		end




		IF(@saveRecords=1) 
		BEGIN

			-- populating the audit table
			INSERT INTO @jobBomAudit select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0

			--update job_bom set 
			delete from jb
			from job_bom jb --inner join @cte  c1 on jb.item_id = c1.item_id and jb.reqd_grade_cd =c1.reqd_grade_cd
			where jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and jb.bom_pos<>0 --and jb.item_id not in( select item_id from @cte)

			update job_bom set qty_per_parent_item = case  when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0 when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			,min_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			,max_qty_per_parent_item = case when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 then  0  when ct.uom_description = 'MT' then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 end 
			,qty_reqd = ct.qty_reqd
			,reqd_grade_cd =  isnull(ct.reqd_grade_cd,(select item_grade_cd from item_grade with(nolock) where item_grade_desc = ct.item_grade_desc))
			,bom_pos = ct.bom_pos
			from job_bom jb with(nolock) inner join @cte ct on jb.item_id = ct.item_id
			and jb.wo_id =  @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no

			select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @cte
			--select * from @cte

			WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
			BEGIN
			--BEGIN -- v0.07 DELETED
				-- updating variables from @cte 
				SELECT @bom_pos = bom_pos, @item_id = item_id
				,@qty_per_parent_item = case 	when ct.qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 
													then  0 
												when ct.uom_description = 'MT' 
													then ((ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 
												else (ct.qty_per_parent_item)/100 
										end 
				,@max_qty_per_parent_item = case 	when ct.max_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 
														then  0 
													when ct.uom_description = 'MT' 
														then ((ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 
													else (ct.max_qty_per_parent_item)/100 
											end 
				,@min_qty_per_parent_item = case 	when ct.min_qty_per_parent_item  <=  0.00001 
														then  0 
													when ct.uom_description = 'MT' 
														then ((ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100)/1000 
													else (ct.min_qty_per_parent_item)/100 
											end 
				,@qty_reqd =qty_reqd 
				,@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
				from @cte as ct 
				where rowId =@row_cnt 

				-- Update the remaining values based on last recipe or new one
				if(@recipe_name='Last used recipe') -- updating values here
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
								,@reqd_start_val				= reqd_start_val           
								,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		= reqd_start_val_is_pct    
								,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
								,@backflush                  = backflush                
								,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
								--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
								--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
								,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
								,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
								,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
								,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
								,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
								,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
								,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
								,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
								,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
								,@est_time                   = est_time                 
								,@current_subst              = current_subst         
					from #LastjobBOMRecipe 
					where item_id = @item_id   
						and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd  
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
							,@reqd_start_val				= 0           
							,@reqd_start_val_is_pct		=	0    
							,@update_inv				    = update_inv               
							,@backflush                  = backflush                
							,@def_reas_cd                = def_reas_cd              
							--,@def_lot_no                 = def_lot_no               
							--,@def_sublot_no              = def_sublot_no            
							,@def_storage_ent_id         = def_storage_ent_id       
							,@def_reject_ent_id          = def_reject_ent_id        
							,@scaling_factor             = scaling_factor           
							,@must_consume_from_inv      = must_consume_from_inv    
							,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc     = may_choose_alt_inv_loc   
							,@may_create_new_lots        = may_create_new_lots      
							,@must_consume_from_wip      = must_consume_from_wip    
							,@must_consume_before_prod   = must_consume_before_prod 
							,@constant_qty               = constant_qty             
							,@est_time                   = est_time                 
							,@current_subst              = NULL         
					from #BOMRecipe 
					where item_id = @item_id   
						and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd 
				END

				-- v0.07 CRXXX fix for by-prods
				SELECT TOP 1 @def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd              
					,@def_lot_no = def_lot_no
				FROM @jobBomAudit jb
				JOIN @cte ct ON ct.item_id = jb.item_id 
				WHERE ct.rowId = @row_cnt 

				-- 0.08
				-- Check def_lot_no in job_bom table for bom_pos<0
				IF (@def_lot_no is null and @bom_pos < 0) --NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_bom with(NOLOCK) WHERE def_lot_no IS NULL and wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos<0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @def_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM ofi_wo_item_ext with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos < 0
					IF @def_lot_no is null
					BEGIN
						SELECT @def_lot_no = lot_no FROM ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id
					END
				END

				-- 0.08
				-- Check def_reas_cd in job_bom table for bom_pos<0
				IF (@bom_pos < 0) --NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_bom with(NOLOCK) WHERE def_reas_cd IS NULL and wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos<0)
				BEGIN
					IF @def_reas_cd is null
						SELECT @def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd FROM job_bom with(nolock) where bom_pos=0
					else
						SELECT @def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd FROM #BOMRecipe where parent_item_id = @bomItem and ver_id = @bomVersion and bom_pos = @bom_pos
				END

				-- checking if it is existing in the job bom
				IF NOT EXISTS	(	SELECT 1 
									from job_bom with(nolock) 
									where wo_id = @wo_id 
										and oper_id = @oper_id 
										and seq_no = @seq_no 
										and bom_pos <>0 
										and item_id = @item_id 
										and reqd_grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
								)
				BEGIN
					--select @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					--0.06 
					IF(@bom_pos<0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT @maxBomPos =  min(bom_pos)-1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					END 
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @maxBomPos =  max(bom_pos)+1 from  job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					END
					
					-- inserting values in job bom
					EXEC 
						 [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Bom] @wo_id
						,@oper_id
						,@seq_no
						,@maxBomPos
						,@item_id
						,@reqd_grade_cd
						,@instruction
						,@qty_per_parent_item
						,@max_qty_per_parent_item
						,@min_qty_per_parent_item
						,@reqd_start_val
						,@reqd_start_val_is_pct
						,@update_inv
						,@backflush
						,@def_reas_cd
						,@def_lot_no
						,@def_sublot_no
						,@def_storage_ent_id
						,@def_reject_ent_id
						,@scaling_factor
						,@must_consume_from_inv
						,@may_choose_alt_inv_loc
						,@may_create_new_lots
						,@must_consume_from_wip
						,@must_consume_before_prod
						,@constant_qty
						,@est_time
						,@current_subst
						,@qty_reqd
						,@serial_no_source
						,@spare1
						,@spare2
						,@spare3
						,@spare4
						,@last_edit_comment
						,@mod_id OUTPUT

					SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
				END
			-- END -- v0.07 DELETED
				SET @row_cnt = @row_cnt+1
			END
		
			-- inserting the values for audit trail
			insert into @jobBomAudit1 select [wo_id],[oper_id],[seq_no],[bom_pos],[item_id],[reqd_grade_cd],[instruction],[qty_per_parent_item],[max_qty_per_parent_item],[min_qty_per_parent_item],[reqd_start_val],[reqd_start_val_is_pct],[update_inv],[backflush],[def_reas_cd],[def_lot_no],[def_sublot_no],[def_storage_ent_id],[def_reject_ent_id],[scaling_factor],[must_consume_from_inv],[may_choose_alt_inv_loc],[may_create_new_lots],[must_consume_from_wip],[must_consume_before_prod],[constant_qty],[est_time],[current_subst],[qty_reqd],[serial_no_source],[spare1],[spare2],[spare3],[spare4],[last_edit_comment],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id] 
			from job_bom with(nolock) 
			where wo_id =  @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and  bom_pos<>0


			select @already_used = [already_used] from  [MESDB].[dbo].[ofi_master_recipe] with(nolock) where recipe_name = @recipe_name
			
			if(@recipe_name is not null and @already_used = 'N' and @recipe_name <>'Last used recipe')
			BEGIN
				-- updating ofi master 
				UPDATE [ofi_master_recipe] 
				SET already_used = 'Y'
					,last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE()
					,last_edit_at_local = GETDATE()
					,last_edit_by = @last_edit_by
				where  recipe_name = @recipe_name
			END

			if(@recipe_name <> (select isnull(spare1,'') from job_bom with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id =@oper_id and bom_pos = 0 and seq_no  = @seq_no))
			BEGIN
				update job_bom 
				set spare1 = @recipe_name 
				where  wo_id =@wo_id 
					and oper_id =@oper_id 
					and bom_pos = 0 
					and seq_no  = @seq_no;
			END


			-- invalidating the applicable subsequent steps
			EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
			   @wo_id
			  ,@oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@step_name
			  ,@step_data = @recipe_name

			  
			IF(@invalidateSteps=1)
			BEGIN
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_invalidate_steps]  @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@ent_id,@item_id,@step_name=NULL
			END

			-- SET THE OUTPUT of this SP here 
			set @resultset =1; 
			set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
			select 	@resultset as resultset
					,@resultcode as resultcode

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN			
			-- SET THE OUTPUT of this SP here 
			SET @resultset =1; 
			set @resultcode='@@RecordsValidatedSuccessfully@@'
			select 	@resultset as result
					,@resultcode as resultcode
		END
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		
		-- SET THE OUTPUT of this SP here 	 (On error only)
		set @resultset =0; 
		set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
		select 	@resultset as result
				,@resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH

	BEGIN TRY				   

		SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.qty_per_parent_item)
		FROM @jobBomAudit t1
			FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		WHERE 	(t1.qty_per_parent_item <> t2.qty_per_parent_item) 
			OR (t1.min_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.min_qty_per_parent_item) 
			OR (t1.max_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.max_qty_per_parent_item)
			OR (t1.reqd_grade_cd <> t2.reqd_grade_cd)
			
		WHILE (@i < @modCnt)
		BEGIN			   

			SELECT @jobBomRow=t2.row_id
			 ,@item_id_a1=t2.item_id
			 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.qty_per_parent_item
			 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.min_qty_per_parent_item
			 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.max_qty_per_parent_item
			 ,@grade_cd= cast(t2.reqd_grade_cd as nvarchar(50))
			from @jobBomAudit t1
			FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
			where (t1.qty_per_parent_item <> t2.qty_per_parent_item) 
				OR (t1.min_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.min_qty_per_parent_item) 
				OR (t1.max_qty_per_parent_item <> t2.max_qty_per_parent_item)
				OR (t1.reqd_grade_cd <> t2.reqd_grade_cd)
			ORDER BY t2.row_id
			OFFSET @i ROWS   
			FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

			select @grade_cd= ig.item_grade_desc
			from item_grade ig with(nolock)
			where ig.item_grade_cd=@grade_cd

			Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
			Select @strCommentMsg = 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';
			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
									 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)),
									(@jobBomRow,'spare1',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name))
									,(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1))
									,(@jobBomRow,'reqd_grade_cd',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@grade_cd))
									,(@jobBomRow,'qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
									,(@jobBomRow,'min_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
									,(@jobBomRow,'max_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
									,@function_id = @strFunctionName
									,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
									,@keyField1 = @wo_id
									,@keyField2 = @oper_id
									,@keyField3 = @seq_no
									,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
									,@keyField5 = NULL
									,@user_id = @last_edit_by
									,@activity = @strActivityMsg
									,@audit_category = 'Info'
									,@comments = @strCommentMsg

			 SET @i = @i + 1;
		 
		END  -- for WHILE (@i < @modCnt)
		 
		-- added new record
		select @newCnt= count(t2.qty_per_parent_item)
		from @jobBomAudit t1
			FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @jobBomAudit t2 )
								
		WHILE (@j < @newCnt)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @jobBomRow=t2.row_id
				 ,@item_id_a1=t2.item_id
				 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.min_qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t2.max_qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@grade_cd= cast(t2.reqd_grade_cd as nvarchar(50))
			from @jobBomAudit t1
				FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
			where t2.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
									from @jobBomAudit t2 )
			order by t2.row_id
			OFFSET @j ROWS   
			FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY


			Select @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'
			Select @strCommentMsg ='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';;

			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	
			VALUES 
				(@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)),
				--(@jobBomRow,'wo_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@wo_id))
				--,(@jobBomRow,'oper_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@oper_id))
				--,(@jobBomRow,'seq_no',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no)),
				--	(@jobBomRow,'recipe_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name)),
				(@jobBomRow,'spare1',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@recipe_name)),							
				(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1))							
				,(@jobBomRow,'reqd_grade_cd',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@grade_cd))
				,(@jobBomRow,'qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
				,(@jobBomRow,'min_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))
				,(@jobBomRow,'max_qty_per_parent_item',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),cast(@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1 as decimal(10,4))))

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
									,@function_id = @strFunctionName
									,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
									,@keyField1 = @wo_id
									,@keyField2 = @oper_id
									,@keyField3 = @seq_no
									,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
									,@keyField5 = NULL
									,@user_id = @last_edit_by
									,@activity = @strActivityMsg
									,@audit_category = 'Info'
									,@comments = @strCommentMsg

			SET @j = @j + 1;
		END -- FOR: WHILE (@j < @newCnt)

		-- removed record
		select @delCnt=count(t1.qty_per_parent_item) 
		from @jobBomAudit t1
		FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
		where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
								from @jobBomAudit1 t2 )
								
		WHILE (@k < @delCnt)
		BEGIN
		  

			SELECT   @jobBomRow=t1.row_id,
				  @item_id_a1=t1.item_id
				 ,@qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@min_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.min_qty_per_parent_item
				 ,@max_qty_per_parent_item_a1=t1.max_qty_per_parent_item
			from @jobBomAudit t1
				FULL OUTER JOIN @jobBomAudit1 t2 on t1.row_id=t2.row_id
			where t1.row_id not in (select t2.row_id
									from @jobBomAudit1 t2 )
			order by t1.row_id
			OFFSET @k ROWS   
			FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

			Select @strActivityMsg = 'Delete'
			Select @strCommentMsg =' Removed row_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow)+' in '+@recipe_name+' for item: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@item_id_a1)+', '+' in wo: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@wo_id)+' in oper: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@oper_id)+' in seq: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@seq_no)+' _ '
			delete from @auditTrailParameters
			
			INSERT INTO @auditTrailParameters (row_id, field_name, field_value)	values 
									 (@jobBomRow,'row_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@jobBomRow))
									,(@jobBomRow,'item_id',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@strActivityMsg ))
									
							   
												 
								   

			EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
									,@function_id = @strFunctionName
									,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
									--,@xmlDeletedRow = @xmlDeletedRow
									,@keyField1 = @wo_id
									,@keyField2 = @oper_id
									,@keyField3 = @seq_no
									,@keyField4 = @item_id_a1
									,@keyField5 = NULL
									,@user_id = @last_edit_by
									,@activity = @strActivityMsg
									,@audit_category = 'Info'
									,@comments = @strCommentMsg

			

			SET @k = @k + 1;
		END -- FOR: WHILE (@k < @delCnt)

		-- records where only recipe is changed , check for recipe change 
		select @old_recipe_name=jb.spare1
		from job_bom jb with(nolock)
		where jb.bom_pos=0 and jb.item_id=@item_id


	END TRY 
	BEGIN CATCH
		set @resultset =0; 
		set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
		select	 @resultset as result
				,@resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Process_CreateOpFromStdOp]
(@process_id		STRING80
,@oper_id		STRING80
,@oper_desc		STRING80
,@display_seq		INT32
,@std_oper_id		STRING80
,@skip_process_checkout_check LOGICAL = 0
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_I_Process_CreateOpFromStdOp
-- Description	      - Create operations from standard operations
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 11/09/2005
-- Version	      - 3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 03/30/2006	Raghu		3.1.13	HD# 7849, Inserting a std. operation should consider system attribute 304.
-- 07/05/2006	Raghu		3.1.18	HD# 8208,  Inserting Standard operation for a process
-- 10/24/2006	KRF			3.1.24	HD Call 8953 Data_Log_Grp_Std_Oper_Link records should be
--									used to create Data_Log_Grp_Oper_Link records
-- 01/15/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD # 9222 & 9226, part of DB changes - copy oper_step.reqd_rep_pct and handle renamed
--									spc_char_oper_link fields.
-- 01/18/2007	KRF			3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/06/2008	Raghu		3.4.0	L00073442 ; Error trying to add Std. Operations to an Operation
-- 01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4.0	L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 02/05/2008	AML			3.4.0	L00074725; Added insert statement to copy std_oper_step_choice records to oper_step_choice.
-- 02/05/2008	AML			3.4.0	L00074806; Create data_log_grp_oper_step_link records from data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk records
--10/08/2012	Arun          4.6      spc_char_oper_link is removed from the database
--03/26/2018	Srinivasa   6.0      US#839922, @err_str size increased to store complete error message when maximum allowed length
--                                     of operation and process id's passed
-- 05/08/2018	RWB			6.0		US 1024364 - added a flag to allow the process checkout check to be skipped.  The flag defaults to
--									false, so that the check will happen if it is not supplied.
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE	 @last_edit_by		STRING80
	,@last_edit_at		TDATETIME
	,@checked_out_by	STRING80
	,@err_str		STRING254
	,@process_status	INT32
	,@attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@def_reject_rate	FLOAT
	,@first_oper		BIT
	,@final_oper		BIT
	,@check_inv		BIT
	,@sched_to_ent_id	INT
	,@oper_type		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@oper_cost		FLOAT
	,@assoc_file		NVARCHAR(254)
	,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(20)
	,@notes			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@data_log_grp_id	INT
	,@spare1		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@spare2		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@spare3		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@spare4		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@last_edit_comment	NVARCHAR(254)
	,@deviation_above	TFLOAT
	,@deviation_below	TFLOAT
	,@created_at		TDATETIME
	,@mod_id		STRING80
	,@reqd_process_checkout	NVARCHAR(1)


	IF (@process_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The %1 Should not be Null{3339},Process Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},Process Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@skip_process_checkout_check IS NULL) SET @skip_process_checkout_check = 0

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @created_at = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @created_at = @last_edit_at
	SET @created_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @created_at )

	SELECT @process_status = process_status, @checked_out_by = checked_out_by FROM process WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @process_id

	-- If the skip process checkout parameter is set, then we will not require the process to be checked out; otherwise we
	-- check the system parameter to decide if we should require process checkout.
	SELECT @reqd_process_checkout = CASE WHEN @skip_process_checkout_check = 1 THEN '0' ELSE attr_value END FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 304

	IF (@reqd_process_checkout = '1') BEGIN
		IF (@checked_out_by IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_str = 'Process is not checked out by %1 user{3231},' + ISNULL(@last_edit_by, '')
			RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE IF (@checked_out_by IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF (@checked_out_by <> @last_edit_by) BEGIN
				SET @err_str = 'Process is checked out by %1 user{3369},' + @checked_out_by
				RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
				RETURN

			END
		END
	END

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Cannot delete or modify the components of a certified process{2179}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SELECT @first_oper = 0, @final_oper = 0

	SELECT @def_reject_rate=def_reject_rate, @check_inv=check_inv ,@sched_to_ent_id=sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type=oper_type
		,@oper_cost=oper_cost, @deviation_above=deviation_above, @deviation_below=deviation_below
		,@assoc_file=assoc_file, @assoc_file_type=assoc_file_type, @notes = notes
		,@spare1=spare1, @spare2=spare2, @spare3=spare3, @spare4=spare4, @last_edit_comment=last_edit_comment
	FROM std_oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 already exist in the database.{4675},' + 'OperId=' + @oper_id + ' for the process:' + @process_id
		RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_I_Oper @process_id, @oper_id, @oper_desc, @def_reject_rate, NULL, NULL, @display_seq,
		@check_inv, @sched_to_ent_id, @oper_type, @oper_cost, @deviation_above, @deviation_below, @assoc_file,
		NULL, @notes, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUTPUT

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
   	SELECT	(select row_id from oper where oper_id = @oper_id) as key_id, 4 as key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type,
			des.trigger_period, des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
			des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2, des.number_spare3,
			des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
    FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN std_oper so ON des.key_id = so.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 2 AND so.oper_id = @std_oper_id


	INSERT INTO oper_attr (process_id, oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, attr_id, attr_value, notes, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_attr
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_ent_link (process_id, oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time, init_prod_pct,
		parent_contingent_ent, child_contingent_ent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, ent_id, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate, est_setup_time,
		est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, est_transfer_time, init_prod_pct,
		0, 0, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_ent_link
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_step_grp (process_id, oper_id, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc,
		step_grp_seq, repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq, repeatability, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_grp
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Added "reqd_rep_pct" 2 places below 1/15/07 KRF
    -- Added "step_name"
	INSERT INTO oper_step (process_id, oper_id, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time,
		complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name,
		data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, step_name, step_seq, step_desc, action_type, std_time,
		complete_cond, allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name,
		data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit, low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
	DECLARE @each_std_oper_step_des TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime,
			step_no int
		)

	DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
			@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
			@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40),  @t_last_edit_at datetime, @t_step_no int, @i int, @max_i int

	DELETE FROM @each_std_oper_step_des

	INSERT INTO @each_std_oper_step_des
	(
		key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
		last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
		number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
		step_no
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT des. key_id, des.key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
		des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
		des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
		des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at, sos.step_no
	FROM data_entry_sched des INNER JOIN std_oper_step sos ON des.key_id = sos.row_id
    WHERE des.key_type = 3 AND sos.oper_id = @std_oper_id

	SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_std_oper_step_des

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @t_step_no = step_no FROM @each_std_oper_step_des WHERE id = @i

		SELECT @t_key_id = os.row_id
		FROM oper_step os
		WHERE os.process_id = @process_id AND os.oper_id = @oper_id AND os.step_no = @t_step_no

		SELECT	@t_key_type = 5, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
			,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
			,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
			,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
			,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
			,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
			,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		FROM @each_std_oper_step_des
		WHERE id = @i

		INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
		(
			key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
			last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
			number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
			@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
			@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
			@last_edit_by,  @last_edit_at
		)

		SET @i = (@i + 1)
	END

	INSERT INTO oper_step_choice ( process_id, oper_id, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_choice
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_step_file (process_id, oper_id, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_file
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_step_ent_exc (process_id, oper_id, step_no, ent_id, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, ent_id, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_step_ent_exc
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_spec_ver (process_id, oper_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_spec_ver
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO oper_ent_spec (process_id, oper_id, step_no, ent_id, ver_id, spec_id, spec_value,
		assoc_file, assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, ent_id, ver_id, spec_id, spec_value, assoc_file,
		assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM std_oper_ent_spec
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO res_oper_link (res_id, process_id, oper_id, qty_reqd, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT res_id, @process_id, @oper_id, qty_reqd, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM res_std_oper_link
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO cert_oper_link (cert_name, process_id, oper_id, cert_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @process_id, @oper_id, cert_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_std_oper_link
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	INSERT INTO cert_oper_step_link (cert_name, process_id, oper_id, step_no, cert_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT cert_name, @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, cert_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM cert_std_oper_step_link
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Added 10/24/2006 for HD call 8953 - Create data_log_grp_oper_link records from data_log_grp_std_oper_link records
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_oper_link (grp_id, process_id, oper_id, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT grp_id, @process_id, @oper_id, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_link
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id

	-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create data_log_grp_oper_step_link records from data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk records
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_oper_step_link ( grp_id, process_id, oper_id, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT grp_id, @process_id, @oper_id, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_step_lnk
	WHERE oper_id = @std_oper_id


END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ReplaceQuotes] ( @string NVARCHAR(4000) )
RETURNS NVARCHAR(4000)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - REPLACEQUOTES
-- Description       - Replaces a single quote with 2 single quotes.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created         -  03/23/2007
-- Version        - 3.2.0.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @temp	NVARCHAR(4000)

	--Replace a single quote with 2 single quotes to prevent dynamic SQL being crashing.
	IF @string IS NULL RETURN NULL

	SET @temp = @string

	RETURN REPLACE(@temp, '''', '''''')
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetStorLoctnsByFilter]
(
		@ent_id					INT32_NULL = 0
	,	@current_inventory		INT32_NULL = 0
	,	@filtr					STRING4000_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0

)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETSTORLOCTNSBYFILTER
-- Description          -    Returns inventory.  If the flag is set, then the inventory is returned for just the specified entity,
--                      and is restricted by the filter shown below.  If the flag is not set, then the inventory is returned
--                      for the specified entities and all the entities located at that entity.
--                      The stored procedure will have to descend the storage_exec?s storage_ent_id field to get the entities
--                      to include in the record set.
--                      Filter Example: $$item_id=$$$$lot_no=$$$$item_grade_cd=$$$$item_status_cd=$$
--                      1) When opened in the context of a job and is hard pegged, the work order and to
--                          operation are disabled and the ITEM filter is set to BOM 0.
--                      2) The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in
--                          BOM 0 item and its substitutes, and all job bom component serial numbers
--                          located at the selected location that are flagged for inheritance at the selected operation.
--                      3) When hard pegged, the selected Work order will filter the list of BOM 0 item serial numbers
--                          listed in the current inventory grid but not when soft pegged.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created      -    03/14/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 09/07/2007		AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
--02/14/2008 Raghu   3.4  L00074457  Cannot transfer serial numbers
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @item_id                 	STRING80_NULL
		,	@item_desc               	STRING254_NULL
		,	@item_class_id           	STRING80_NULL
		,	@item_class_desc         	STRING254_NULL
		,	@lot_no                  	STRING80_NULL
		,	@grade_cd                	INT32_NULL
		,	@status_cd               	INT32_NULL
		,	@expiry_date             	TDATETIME_NULL
		,	@wo_id                   	STRING80_NULL
		,	@oper_id                 	STRING80_NULL
		,	@seq_no                  	INT32_NULL
		,	@serial_no               	STRING80_NULL
		,	@serialized_items        	NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@may_override_route      	LOGICAL
		,	@hard_pegged             	LOGICAL
		,	@filter_wo_id            	STRING80_NULL
		,	@filter_oper_id          	STRING80_NULL
		,	@valu_                   	NVARCHAR(508)
		,	@user_id                 	STRING80_NULL
		,	@client_info             	STRING80_NULL
		,	@user_has_priv_to_override  LOGICAL

    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_ID=', '$$', @item_id OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_DESC=', '$$', @item_desc OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_CLASS_ID=', '$$', @item_class_id OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_CLASS_DESC=', '$$', @item_class_desc OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'LOT_NO=', '$$', @lot_no OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'GRADE_CD=', '$$', @grade_cd OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'STATUS_CD=', '$$', @status_cd OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'EXPIRY_DATE=', '$$', @valu_ OUTPUT

    IF (@expiry_date IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        SET @expiry_date = CONVERT( VARCHAR, @valu_, 101 )
    END

    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'WO_ID=', '$$', @wo_id OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'OPER_ID=', '$$', @oper_id OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SEQ_NO=', '$$', @seq_no OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SERIAL_NO=', '$$', @serial_no OUTPUT
    EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SERIALIZED_ITEMS=', '$$', @serialized_items OUTPUT

	IF @item_id = '' SET @item_id = NULL
	IF @item_desc = '' SET @item_desc = NULL
	IF @item_class_id = '' SET @item_class_id = NULL
	IF @item_class_desc = '' SET @item_class_desc = NULL
	IF @lot_no = '' set @lot_no = NULL
	IF @grade_cd = '' SET @grade_cd = NULL
	IF @status_cd = '' SET @status_cd = NULL
	IF @wo_id = '' SET @wo_id = NULL
	IF @oper_id = '' SET @oper_id = null
	IF @seq_no = '' SET @seq_no = null
	IF @serial_no = '' SET @serial_no = null
	if @serialized_items = '' SET @serialized_items = null

	DECLARE @temp_storage_ents TABLE (
		t_ent_id		int,
		t_ent_name		nvarchar(80),
		t_movable		bit,
		t_stor_ent_id	int,
		t_stor_ent_name nvarchar(80),
		t_child_level	int
	)

	DECLARE @level AS INT
	SET @level = 1

	INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
	SELECT se.ent_id, e.ent_name, se.movable, se.storage_ent_id AS located_at_ent_id, sent.ent_name AS located_at_ent_name, @level
	FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent sent WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = sent.ent_id
	WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id

	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

            INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
            SELECT se.ent_id, e.ent_name, se.movable, se.storage_ent_id as located_ent_id, sent.ent_name as located_at_ent_name, @level + 1
            FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
            INNER JOIN @temp_storage_ents t ON se.storage_ent_id = t.t_ent_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ent sent WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.storage_ent_id = sent.ent_id
            WHERE t.t_child_level = @level

		IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

		SET @level = @level + 1

	END

    --Verify whether we are dealing with current inventory (used by the WIP process; or we are dealing with a general inventory)
    IF (@current_inventory = 1 AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

        --Verify whether the linear flow is enabled on this work order.
        SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
        FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE UPPER(wo_id) = @wo_id

        --Verify whether a valid seq_no is supplied.
        IF (@seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
            --The seq_no is not supplied; retrieve a valid MIN(seq_no) from the current job.
            SELECT @seq_no = MIN(seq_no)
            FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE UPPER(wo_id) = @wo_id AND UPPER(oper_id) = @oper_id
        END

        IF (@may_override_route = 0) BEGIN
            --Get the user id who is accessing the database.
			EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, @client_info OUTPUT

            --Verify whether this user has a privilege to override the route.
            SELECT @user_has_priv_to_override = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
            FROM grp_priv_link gpl WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
            WHERE gpl.priv_id = 261 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

			IF ( @user_has_priv_to_override IS NULL ) BEGIN
				SET @user_has_priv_to_override = 0
			END

            IF (@user_has_priv_to_override = 0) BEGIN
                --This user does not have a privilege to override the route.
                --Verify whether a valid job can be identified
                --Verify whether this job is hard pegged.
                SELECT @hard_pegged = must_consume_from_wip
                FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE UPPER(wo_id) = @wo_id
                  AND UPPER(oper_id) = @oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND bom_pos = 0

                IF (@hard_pegged = 1) BEGIN
                    SET @filter_wo_id = @wo_id

                    SELECT TOP 1 @filter_oper_id = jr.input_oper_id
                    FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE UPPER(jr.wo_id) = @wo_id
                      AND UPPER(jr.oper_id) = @oper_id
                      AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no
                END
            END
            ELSE BEGIN
                --This user has a privilege to override the route;
                --meaning this user can see the inventory produced by any work order.
                SELECT @filter_wo_id = NULL, @filter_oper_id = NULL
            END
        END

        --The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers
        SELECT DISTINCT storage_ents.t_ent_id AS ent_id, storage_ents.t_ent_name AS ent_name, storage_ents.t_movable AS movable,
						storage_ents.t_stor_ent_id AS storage_ent_id, storage_ents.t_stor_ent_name AS storage_ent_name
        FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_movable, t_stor_ent_id, t_stor_ent_name, t_child_level FROM @temp_storage_ents
			) storage_ents ON ii.ent_id = storage_ents.t_ent_id
			INNER JOIN
            --The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in BOM 0 item
            (SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no
            FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = ii.item_id
            WHERE UPPER(jb.wo_id) = @wo_id
              AND UPPER(jb.oper_id) = @oper_id
              AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
              AND jb.bom_pos = 0
              AND (UPPER(ii.wo_id) = @filter_wo_id OR @filter_wo_id IS NULL)
              AND (UPPER(ii.oper_id) = @filter_oper_id OR @filter_oper_id IS NULL)
            UNION
            --The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in BOM 0 item
            --AND ITS SUBSTITUTES
            SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no
            FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.item_id = ii.item_id
            INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND jbst.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND jbst.seq_no = jb.seq_no
                AND jbst.bom_pos = jb.bom_pos AND jbst.alt_no = jb.current_subst
            WHERE UPPER(jbst.wo_id) = @wo_id
              AND UPPER(jbst.oper_id) = @oper_id
              AND jbst.seq_no = @seq_no
              AND jb.bom_pos = 0
              AND (UPPER(ii.wo_id) = @filter_wo_id OR @filter_wo_id IS NULL)
              AND (UPPER(ii.oper_id) = @filter_oper_id OR @filter_oper_id IS NULL)
            UNION
            --and all job bom component serial numbers located at the selected location that
            --are flagged for inheritance at the selected operation.
            SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no
            FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
            INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = ii.item_id
            WHERE UPPER(jb.wo_id) = @wo_id
              AND UPPER(jb.oper_id) = @oper_id
              AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
              AND jb.bom_pos > 0
              AND jb.serial_no_source = 1
              AND (UPPER(ii.wo_id) = @filter_wo_id OR @filter_wo_id IS NULL)
              AND (UPPER(ii.oper_id) = @filter_oper_id OR @filter_oper_id IS NULL)
          ) uncompleted_snos ON uncompleted_snos.lot_no = ii.lot_no
        WHERE i.serial_no_lvl > -1
          AND (UPPER(ii.item_id) LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
          AND (ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
          AND ((@serial_no IS NOT NULL AND (ii.lot_no IN (SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no))
                    OR (ii.sublot_no IN (SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no)))
                    OR @serial_no IS NULL
              )
          AND ((@serialized_items IS NOT NULL
                AND ((@serialized_items = '1' AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1)
                    OR (@serialized_items = '0' AND i.serial_no_lvl = -1))
              ) OR @serialized_items IS NULL)

        RETURN
    END

    --We are dealing with all items that are located at the supplied inventory.
    SELECT DISTINCT storage_ents.t_ent_id AS ent_id, storage_ents.t_ent_name AS ent_name, storage_ents.t_movable AS movable, storage_ents.t_stor_ent_id AS storage_ent_id
        ,storage_ents.t_stor_ent_name AS storage_ent_name
    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN (
		SELECT t_ent_id, t_ent_name, t_movable, t_stor_ent_id, t_stor_ent_name, t_child_level FROM @temp_storage_ents
	) storage_ents ON ii.ent_id = storage_ents.t_ent_id
    INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
    INNER JOIN item_class ic ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
    WHERE (UPPER(ii.item_id) LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (UPPER(i.item_desc) LIKE @item_desc OR @item_desc IS NULL)
      AND (UPPER(ic.item_class_id) LIKE @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL)
      AND (UPPER(ic.item_class_desc) LIKE @item_class_desc OR @item_class_desc IS NULL)
      AND (UPPER(ii.lot_no) LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ii.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ii.expiry_date = @expiry_date OR @expiry_date IS NULL)
      AND (UPPER(ii.wo_id) LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (UPPER(ii.oper_id) LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND ((@serial_no IS NOT NULL AND (ii.lot_no IN (SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no))
                OR (ii.sublot_no IN (SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no)))
                OR @serial_no IS NULL
          )
      AND ((@serialized_items IS NOT NULL
            AND ((@serialized_items = '1' AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1)
                OR (@serialized_items = '0' AND i.serial_no_lvl = -1))
          ) OR @serialized_items IS NULL)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_getEntityAccessforuser]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@user_id nvarchar(50),
	@ent_id int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @domain NVARCHAR(100)
	SELECT @domain = DEFAULT_DOMAIN()
	set @user_id=@domain+'\'+@user_id

	--select @user_id as userid
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi_temp') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi_temp
		CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi_temp (
	
		ent_id	INT,
		ent_name nvarchar(50),
		can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
		can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
		can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
		can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
		can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
		can_stre nvarchar(5),
		can_log_data nvarchar(5),
		parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
		access int
		);
		INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi_temp
		exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user_id
		select access from #ent_access_ofi_temp where ent_id=@ent_id
END
