CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Cons]
(
	@row_id int,
	@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@seq_no int ,
	--@shift_start datetime ,
	@shift_start_local datetime, --Added 07/30/2007 AML
	@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@fg_lot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
	@reas_cd int ,
	@user_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@item_scrapped bit ,
	@ent_id int ,
	@shift_id int ,
	@grade_cd int ,
	@status_cd int ,
	@from_ent_id int = NULL ,
	@qty_cons float ,
	@qty_cons_erp float ,
	@ext_ref nvarchar(40),
	@transaction_type int ,
	@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL,
	@upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL,
	@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL,
	@segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL,
	@comments nvarchar(254) = null, -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB
	@spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
	@spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
	@last_edit_at datetime  = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				-
-- Description				-
-- Author					-
-- Date Created				- 10/21/2002
-- Version					- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver.	Changes
-- 08/08/2002		Nagaraju  				made it identical to sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons
-- 08-14-2002       Nagaraju		-		made the selection of  status and grade outside update/insert
-- 08-23-2002		Rohit			-		Added @grade_cd, @status_cd parametrs in SP_U_Item_Inv_Reduce call.
-- 08-28-2002		Rohit			-		Added logic to determine the consumption is virtual or normal.This flag is passed in sp SP_U_Item_Inv_Reduce.
-- 08/29/2002		Raghu			1.4		Remove Cont_id; Get Row_Id from the join and use the row_id in where clause for add/update/delete
-- 09-06-2002		Rohit			-		Added logic to insert item_inv status_cd for normal cons and inv_update =1.
-- 12/09/2002		Rohit			1.5.0	If must_consume_from_wip is set to true, fail the transaction if work order from consumption does not matches with inventory.
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/28/2003		Chandresh		1.5.	THIS SP WAS COPIED FROM sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec. CHECK #1560, 2337, 2338.
--											This procedure will be used by DataEditor for Update and Delete in Item_cons table.
--											This procedure will be simillar to sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec except that it will NOT use
--											defaults as used in sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec.
--											Added @qty_cons > 0 condition while checking @must_consume_from_wip
-- 05/15/2003		Raghu			1.6.7	(HD# 2498). Auto Populating of Job Event table when Consumption is reported and sys attr is set to true
-- 07/07/2003		Raghu			1.7.0	(HD# 3365) Removed log_trans param from inventory procedures; as it is not used anyway.
--											Value is fetched from system_attr = 198 to log the transfers or not
-- 02/09/2005		Raghu			2.1.13	HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 07/19/2005		Raghu			2.1.24	HD# 5938, Some of the fields in item_cons are not updated. Also modified the sp
--											to handle qty changes.
-- 10/12/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/25/2006		Raghu			3.1.8	HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
-- 02/20/2007		Raghu			3.1.27	Per BradJ's email, do not update qty_cons_erp field, adjust shift_start accordingly
-- 01/25/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 02/20/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Per BradJ's email, do not update qty_cons_erp field, adjust shift_start accordingly
-- 04/04/2007		Raghu			3.2.6   HD# 9287, Linear Flow of non-serialized parts
-- 07/30/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu			4.0		DB Changes
-- 01/07/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HF 1432 Bring Hotfix forward
-- 11/17/2016       Varun           5.03    CR#L00143396 Merge Changes(HF CR#L00143099): Allow update to consumed substitute item
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@cur_qty_cons 				TFLOAT
	,	@bom_pos 					INT32
	,	@scrapped					INT32
	,	@expiry_date				TDATETIME
	,	@update_inv					INT32
	,	@def_storage_ent_id			INT32
	,	@return						INT32
	-- Added by Rohit
	,	@must_consume_from_inv		LOGICAL
	,	@bgood_prod					LOGICAL
	,	@must_consume_from_wip		LOGICAL
	,	@inv_wo_id					STRING40
	,	@inv_status_cd				INT32
	,	@qty_difference				TFLOAT
	,	@attr_value					NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@cur_wo_id					STRING40
	,	@cur_oper_id				STRING40
	,	@cur_seq_no					INT32
	,	@cur_item_id				STRING40
	--,@cur_qty_cons				TFLOAT
	,	@cur_run_ent_id				INT32
	,	@cur_lot_no					STRING40
	,	@cur_sublot_no				STRING40
	,	@cur_from_ent_id			INT32
	,	@cur_grade_cd				INT32
	,	@cur_status_cd				INT32
	,	@cur_reas_cd				INT32
	,	@cur_user_id				STRING40
	,	@cur_bom_pos                INT32
	,	@cur_reqd_grade_cd          INT32
	,	@cur_update_inv				LOGICAL
	,	@cur_def_storage_ent_id		INT32
	,	@cur_must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@cur_must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL
	,	@cur_inv_oper_id            STRING80
	,	@cur_inv_seq_no             INT32
	,	@last_edit_by				STRING40
	,	@item_inv_row_id			INT32
	,	@new_bom_pos				INT32
	,	@new_reqd_grade_cd			INT32
	,	@new_update_inv				INT32
	,	@new_def_storage_ent_id		INT32
	,	@new_must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@new_must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL
	,	@new_item_scrapped			INT32
	,	@new_inv_oper_id			STRING80
	,	@new_inv_seq_no				INT32
	,	@err_str					NVARCHAR(4000)
	,	@log_job_event				NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@shift_start_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@dbg_resp					INT32

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	-- Init the values
	SET @scrapped = NULL
	IF @last_edit_at IS NULL SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)



	DECLARE @tz_temp AS INT
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @shift_start_local= NULL
	SET @time_zone_bias_value=NULL
	EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @shift_start_utc,@shift_start_local OUTPUT,  @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT

     -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Cons_t', @src_key='GetDateInfo', @date_val1 = @shift_start_local,@date_val2 = @shift_start_utc

	if (@dbg_resp=1)
	return 1;



	-- Read default values from job_bom table to apply if not included ( include update_inv flag )
	-- for the supplied item
	-- CR L00143396: Allow update of consumed substitute item
 	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id)
 	BEGIN
		SELECT	@bom_pos = bom_pos, @new_reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd, @new_update_inv = update_inv
			,	@new_def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id, @new_must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
			,	@new_must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id
	END
 	ELSE
 	BEGIN
 		SELECT	@bom_pos = bom_pos, @new_reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd, @new_update_inv = update_inv
 	        ,   @new_def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id, @new_must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
 	        ,   @new_must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
 	    FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
 	    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id
 	END

	IF @bom_pos IS NULL BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'component:' + @item_id + ' for a job wo_id=' + @wo_id + '; oper_id=' + @oper_id + '; seq_no=' + STR(@seq_no)
		RAISERROR (@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error
	SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @status_cd = item_status_cd
	FROM	item_reas
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd
	IF @grade_cd IS  NULL  BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied (new) job should update inventory.
	IF @new_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
		--The new job should update inventory.
		--Default the from_ent_id to the job_bom.default storage entity id if the supplied from entity id is null.
		SET @from_ent_id = COALESCE(@from_ent_id, @new_def_storage_ent_id)

		--Verify whether the new job must consume from the WIP inventory.
		IF @new_must_consume_from_wip = 1 and @qty_cons > 0 BEGIN
			--Verify whether we have sufficient quantities to consume from the inventory.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND first_job !=1) BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @new_inv_oper_id=ii.oper_id, @new_inv_seq_no=ii.seq_no
				FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
				WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
				AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id
				AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no
				AND ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
				AND ii.item_id = @item_id
				AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
				AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
				AND (ii.grade_cd = @new_reqd_grade_cd OR @new_reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
				AND (ii.qty_left >= @qty_cons)

				IF @new_inv_oper_id IS NULL OR @new_inv_seq_no IS NULL BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job.{4674}', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
		END --The must_consume_from wip flag for the new job is set to true.
	END --The update inventory flag for the new job is set to true.

	--Default the current consumed quantity from the existing row as NULL.
	SET @cur_qty_cons = NULL
	SELECT	@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no, @cur_item_id = item_id
		,	@cur_qty_cons = qty_cons, @cur_run_ent_id = ent_id, @cur_lot_no = lot_no, @cur_sublot_no = sublot_no
		,	@cur_from_ent_id = from_ent_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd
		,	@cur_reas_cd = reas_cd, @cur_user_id = user_id
	FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @row_id

	IF (@cur_qty_cons IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row identifying a consumption record:' + STR(@row_id)
		RAISERROR (@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Read the job bom properties from the identified job (ie. from the existing consumption record)
	SELECT	@cur_bom_pos = bom_pos, @cur_reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd, @cur_update_inv = update_inv
		,	@cur_def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id, @cur_must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
		,	@cur_must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
	FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND item_id = @cur_item_id

	--Get the item scrapped flag from the supplied grade code.
	SELECT @item_scrapped = scrapped FROM item_grade WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd

	IF (@item_scrapped IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Raise an exception to the caller if such a grade does not exist in the database.
		SET @err_str = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'item grade:' + STR(@grade_cd)
		RAISERROR (@err_str, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Calculate the quantity difference.
	SET @qty_difference = @qty_cons - @cur_qty_cons

	IF @cur_qty_cons IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	        --Verify whether the a quantity of 0 is supplied for the existing row;
	        --meaning we need to delete the item consumption record.
		IF @qty_cons = 0 BEGIN
			--A quantity of 0 is supplied; delete the item consumption row and the job event related to this row.
			DELETE item_cons WHERE row_id = @row_id

			--Delete the job event row that is tied to this consumption record.
			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Cons%'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--A quantity other than 0 is supplied. Update the existing item consumption record.
			UPDATE item_cons
			SET wo_id = @wo_id,
				oper_id = @oper_id,
				seq_no = @seq_no,
				--shift_start = @shift_start,
				shift_start_local = @shift_start_local,
				shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc,
				item_id = @item_id,
				lot_no = @lot_no,
				fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no,
				sublot_no = @sublot_no,
				fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no,
				reas_cd = @reas_cd,
				user_id = @user_id,
				item_scrapped = @item_scrapped,
				ent_id = @ent_id,
				shift_id = @shift_id,
				grade_cd = @grade_cd,
				status_cd = @status_cd,
				from_ent_id = @from_ent_id,
				qty_cons = @qty_cons,
				--qty_cons_erp = @qty_cons_erp,
				ext_ref = @ext_ref,
				--last_edit_at = @last_edit_at,
				genealogy_id = @genealogy_id,
				upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id,
				segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id,
				segment_response_id = @segment_response_id,
				comments= @comments,  -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB
				spare1 = @spare1,
				spare2 = @spare2,
				spare3 = @spare3,
				spare4 = @spare4
			WHERE row_id = @row_id;

			-- Return error if this was not successful
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('SQL Error updating item_cons table{3301}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			SELECT @log_job_event = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 232

			--Default log job event to false; if such an attribute is not found in the database,
			SET @log_job_event = COALESCE(@log_job_event, '0')

			IF (@log_job_event = '1') BEGIN
					EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

					INSERT INTO job_event
					(
						event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos,
						lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
					)
					VALUES
					(
						@last_edit_at, DATEADD( mi, dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc(@ent_id, @last_edit_at), @last_edit_at ), @wo_id, @oper_id,
						@seq_no, 'EditCons', @ent_id, @bom_pos, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id,
						@segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_cons, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
					)
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Item consumption record not found in the database{3298}',16,1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--Check if there any storage location changes or job change during this update
	IF (@from_ent_id = @cur_from_ent_id OR (@from_ent_id IS NULL AND @cur_from_ent_id IS NULL))
		AND (@item_id = @cur_item_id)
		AND (@lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (@lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
		AND (@sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (@sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
		AND (@wo_id = @cur_wo_id OR (@wo_id IS NULL AND @cur_wo_id IS NULL))
		AND (@oper_id = @cur_oper_id OR (@oper_id IS NULL AND @cur_oper_id IS NULL))
		AND (@seq_no = @cur_seq_no OR (@seq_no IS NULL AND @cur_seq_no IS NULL)) BEGIN

		--Storage locations appears to be same.
		--Update the inventory with the current quantity.
		IF (@new_update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Requires entity to be specified in order to update inventory.{3505}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
			--Do not call inventory if qty_difference is zero. May be the qtys are not updated now.
			--Reduce inventory only if there are any difference in qtys.
			IF (@qty_difference <> 0) BEGIN
				--Default the oper_id and seq_no from the WIP oper_id and seq_no; if this quantity from this job
				--has to be consumed from WIP.
				SELECT @cur_oper_id = COALESCE(@new_inv_oper_id, @cur_oper_id)
					, @cur_seq_no = COALESCE(@new_inv_seq_no, @cur_seq_no)
				EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_difference, @reduce_qty_erp=0
						, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
						, @must_consume_from_inv=@must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no
						, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL

				IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Storage entity or item or lot selected is now different than the currently consumed item.
		--Check if there any changes in the item. If so, extract the inventory flags and defaults for the old item.
--		IF (@item_id = @cur_item_id)
--			SELECT @cur_update_inv = @update_inv, @cur_must_consume_from_inv = @must_consume_from_inv
--			,@cur_must_consume_from_wip = @must_consume_from_wip, @cur_def_storage_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id

		--If the original consumption record is recorded in the inventory, then put back all the quantities that
		--are consumed from the original location.
		IF (@cur_update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			--If the previous consumption record does not have a storage location,
			--then ignore reducing the qtys from the old location.
			IF (@cur_from_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				--Verify whether the current consumption is done from WIP.
				IF (@cur_must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
						  AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND first_job != 1) BEGIN
						SELECT TOP 1 @cur_inv_oper_id=ii.oper_id, @cur_inv_seq_no=ii.seq_no
						FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
						WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
						AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
						AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
						AND ii.ent_id = @cur_from_ent_id
						AND ii.item_id = @cur_item_id
						AND (ii.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
						AND (ii.sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
						AND (ii.grade_cd = @cur_reqd_grade_cd OR @cur_reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
					END
				END
				--Default the current oper_id, and seq_no to a job (only if this is WIP inventory)
				--that is immediately upstream to this.
				SELECT @cur_oper_id = COALESCE(@cur_inv_oper_id, @cur_oper_id)
					,@cur_seq_no = COALESCE(@cur_inv_seq_no, @cur_seq_no)

				SET @cur_qty_cons = -@cur_qty_cons
				EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@cur_from_ent_id, @item_id=@cur_item_id, @lot_no=@cur_lot_no, @sublot_no=@cur_sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@cur_qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=0
						, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@cur_grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@cur_status_cd, @item_reas_cd=cur_reas_cd
						, @must_consume_from_inv=@cur_must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no
						, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
				IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			END
		END

		--Check if the current update can store items in the inventory. If yes, reduce the qtys from the inventory.
		IF (@new_update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			SET @from_ent_id = COALESCE(@from_ent_id, @new_def_storage_ent_id)
			IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Requires entity to be specified in order to update inventory.{3505}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
			--Default the current oper_id, and seq_no to a job (only if this is WIP inventory)
			--that is immediately upstream to this.
			SELECT @oper_id = COALESCE(@new_inv_oper_id, @oper_id)
				,@seq_no = COALESCE(@new_inv_seq_no, @seq_no)
			EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=0
					, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=reas_cd
					, @must_consume_from_inv=@cur_must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
					, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END
END

-- ==========================================================================================
-- Author:		Wilwin Lewis
-- Create date: 01-09-2017
-- Description:	The SP created a session in scheduler exec for the actual Schedule and returns the session.
-- ==========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Show_Actual_Schedule]
(
@scheduledDay nvarchar(50)
,@user_name nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @release_sessionid int,
@sessionid int,
@sessionstate int

select top 1 @release_sessionid =  (session_id), @sessionstate = [status] from sdb..scheduler_sessn with (nolock) where status in (3,4) and 
scheduler_date = @scheduledDay order by status desc, last_edit_date desc
-- Created a new session based on data for @session_id
IF(@sessionstate = 3) 
	BEGIN
		insert into SDB.dbo.scheduler_sessn
								([scheduler_date]
								,[created_date]
								,[last_edit_date]
								,[last_user]
								,[status])
							VALUES
								(@scheduledDay
								,getdate()
								,getdate()
								,@user_name
								,4)

			SELECT @sessionid = max(s.session_id) FROM SDB.dbo.scheduler_sessn s with (nolock) WHERE s.scheduler_date = @scheduledDay
		-- Pass new session to the SP

		INSERT INTO [SDB].[dbo].[scheduler_exec]
				   ([mo_id]
				   ,[wo_id]
				   ,[oper_id]
				   ,[item_id]
				   ,[item_desc]
				   ,[wo_release_time]
				   ,[wo_req_finish_time]
				   ,[job_latest_start_time]
				   ,[job_req_finished_time]
				   ,[wo_priority]
				   ,[job_state]
				   ,[wo_state]
				   ,[job_sched_entity_id]
				   ,[job_sched_entity_name]
				   ,[job_priority]
				   ,[job_seq_no]
				   ,[is_downtime_exists]
				   ,[req_qty]
				   ,[parent_req_qty]
				   ,[is_split_job]
				   ,[parent_job_seq_no]
				   ,[job_sched_pinned]
				   ,[is_checkedout]
				   ,[checkedout_by]
				   ,[is_validated]
				   ,[validated_by]
				   ,[validated_at]
				   ,[is_released]
				   ,[released_by]
				   ,[released_at]
				   ,[schedule_sequence]
				   ,[session_id]
				   ,[sched_owner]
				   ,[Error_Code]
				   ,[Error_Description]
				   ,[Validation_Match]
				   ,[Validation_Time]
				   ,[Item_Speed]
				   ,[last_edit_at])

		SELECT [mo_id]
			  ,[wo_id]
			  ,[oper_id]
			  ,[item_id]
			  ,[item_desc]
			  ,[wo_release_time]
			  ,[wo_req_finish_time]
			  ,[job_latest_start_time]
			  ,[job_req_finished_time]
			  ,[wo_priority]
			  ,[job_state]
			  ,[wo_state]
			  ,[job_sched_entity_id]
			  ,[job_sched_entity_name]
			  ,[job_priority]
			  ,[job_seq_no]
			  ,[is_downtime_exists]
			  ,[req_qty]
			  ,[parent_req_qty]
			  ,[is_split_job]
			  ,[parent_job_seq_no]
			  ,[job_sched_pinned]
			  ,[is_checkedout]
			  ,[checkedout_by]
			  ,[is_validated]
			  ,[validated_by]
			  ,[validated_at]
			  ,[is_released]
			  ,[released_by]
			  ,[released_at]
			  ,[schedule_sequence]
			  ,@sessionid
			  ,[sched_owner]
			  ,[Error_Code]
			  ,[Error_Description]
			  ,[Validation_Match]
			  ,[Validation_Time]
			  ,[Item_Speed]
			  ,[last_edit_at] 
     
		  FROM [SDB].[dbo].[scheduler_exec] with (nolock) where session_id = @release_sessionid

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @sessionid = @release_sessionid
	END





EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ScheduleJobDistribution_SetUpTime_Generic_WithActual] 
   @sessionid
  ,@user_name
 


 SELECT @sessionid as sessionid

 
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg_backup02_07_25] as
begin
 
 
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT
 
 
    SET NOCOUNT ON
 
 
    BEGIN TRY
 
  		BEGIN

			WITH ProduceToSAPOpers as(
				Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP') and attr_value <> 1
				union
				Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id <> (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotProduceToSAP')
				union 
				Select oper_id from oper where oper_id not in (select oper_id from oper_attr)
			)
			
            Select  ip.spare2, ip.sublot_no, ip.wo_id, wo.bags_per_pallet, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, u.description, ip.item_id, ip.created_at_local as last_edit_at, ip.lot_no, ip.row_id -- 0.01.03
			into #temp
            from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
            inner join ofi_wo_ext wo  with (nolock) on wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id and wo.module <> 'PO'
			inner join wo w on w.wo_id = wo.wo_id and w.state_cd < 3	--- Only for work orders which aren't closed yet.
            inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id=i.item_id
            inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
			inner join job_bom jb on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
			inner join ProduceToSAPOpers oa on oa.oper_id = ip.oper_id  --(KN - 09/02/23 - Include only those operations where the NotConsumeToSAP has not been set)
            where qty_prod_erp <> qty_prod and i.item_class_id = 'SFG' and ip.sublot_no is not null
 			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#temp') IS NOT NULL
			Begin

 			Declare @Mainhu varchar(100), @subLot varchar(100), @lot_no varchar(100), @wo_id varchar(100), @item_id varchar(100), @item_class varchar(100), @row_id INT
			Declare @sap_item_id varchar(100)

			Select top 1 @subLot = sublot_no, @lot_no = lot_no, @wo_id = wo_id, @item_id = item_id, @row_id = row_id from #temp

			PRINT @row_id

			Select @item_class = item_class_id from item where item_id = @item_id

				BEGIN
           			select '' Handling_Unit_Number, wo_id Order_Number,  --HU is empty for SFG
					sublot_no Batch_Maker_Number, '101' Movement_Type, bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
					sum(qty_prod - qty_prod_erp) Quantity, description Unit_of_Measure,
					IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL, T.item_id, ia.attr_value) SAP_MaterialCode_Number,  --(KN  02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					Format(min(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') Production_startdate, Format(min(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') Production_starttime,
					Format(max(last_edit_at), 'yyyyMMdd') Production_enddate,   Format(max(last_edit_at), 'HHmmss') Production_endtime,
					lot_no SAP_Batch_Number,
					Format(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date, Format(GETDATE(), 'HHmmss') File_Generation_Time, 
					'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
					from 
					#temp T
					left join (Select item_id, attr_value from item_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
						on T.item_id = ia.item_id  --(KN  02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
					where lot_no = @lot_no and isnull(sublot_no, '') = isnull(@subLot, '')
          		    group by wo_id, bags_per_pallet, description, T.item_id, sublot_no, lot_no, ia.attr_value

					BEGIN TRANSACTION 
 
           			Update ip set qty_prod_erp = ip.qty_prod from item_prod ip
					inner join (Select * from #temp where lot_no = @lot_no and sublot_no = @subLot) t on ip.row_id = t.row_id

					COMMIT TRANSACTION
				END
			End

        END
    END TRY
 
 
     BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(), @error_severity = Error_severity(), @error_state = Error_state();
        RAISERROR(@error_msg, @error_severity, @error_state)
    END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@line_id	INT32
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Line_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for a Line (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific Line)
-- Author	          - Arun
-- Date Created	      - 10/22/2013
-- Version            - 4.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

 SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id
                ,attr.attr_desc
                ,attr.attr_grp
                ,attr.predefined
                ,attr.data_type
                ,attr.entry_type
                ,attr.filtr
                ,attr.last_edit_comment
                ,attr.last_edit_by
                ,attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 12 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM line_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 12 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM line_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_Characteristic_GetBySpec]
(@qm_spec_id_list       VARCHAR(2000) -- Comma separated list of qm_spec ids
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - SP_SA_Characteristic_GetBySpec
-- Description      - The purpose of this method is to get the characteristics based on the list of qm_spec ids.
-- Date Created     - 05/06/2011
-- Version          - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
-- 11/23/2011		  Ibrahim		   Modified the script to return characteristic auto collection details if qm_spec_char_link
--									   is set to 'Use Characteristic setting'
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

   DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(4000)
   SET @SQL = N'
    SELECT DISTINCT
       chr.char_id
      ,chr.char_name
      ,chr.char_desc
      ,chr.type
      ,CASE chr.type
        WHEN 0 THEN ''Variable''
        WHEN 1 THEN ''Binary Attribute''
        WHEN 2 THEN ''Counted Attribute''
       END type_desc
      ,chr.uom_id
      ,uom.description  uom_desc
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.default_chart,chr.default_chart) default_chart
      ,CASE COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.default_chart,chr.default_chart)
        WHEN 2 THEN ''Xbar + Range''
        WHEN 3 THEN ''Xbar + Sigma''
        WHEN 5 THEN ''IX + MR''
        WHEN 7 THEN ''MA + Range''
        WHEN 8 THEN ''MA + Sigma''
        WHEN 16 THEN ''p''
        WHEN 17 THEN ''np''
        WHEN 18 THEN ''u''
        WHEN 19 THEN ''c''
        WHEN 20 THEN ''DPMO''
       END default_chart_desc
      ,COALESCE( CASE WHEN qm_spec_char_link.automated_coll = 2 THEN NULL ELSE qm_spec_char_link.automated_coll END, CASE chr.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) automated_coll
      ,CASE COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.automated_coll,chr.automated_coll)
        WHEN 1 Then ''Yes''
        WHEN 0 Then ''No''
		WHEN 2 Then CASE chr.automated_coll WHEN 1 THEN ''Yes'' ELSE ''No'' END
       END automated_coll_desc
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.time_interval,chr.time_interval) time_interval
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.time_int_unit,chr.time_int_unit) time_int_unit
      ,CASE COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.time_int_unit,chr.time_int_unit)
        WHEN 0 THEN ''Seconds''
        WHEN 1 THEN ''Minutes''
        WHEN 2 THEN ''Hours''
       END time_int_unit_desc
      ,chr.num_decimals
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.sample_size_source, chr.sample_size_source) sample_size_source
      ,CASE COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.sample_size_source, chr.sample_size_source)
	WHEN 0 THEN ''Fixed''
	WHEN 1 THEN ''Entered''
	WHEN 2 THEN ''Copied from the previous value''
	WHEN 3 THEN ''Obtained from a sample size characteristic''
       END sample_size_source_desc
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.normal_sample_size, chr.normal_sample_size) normal_sample_size
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.minimum_sample_size, chr.minimum_sample_size) minimum_sample_size
      ,COALESCE(qm_spec_char_link.maximum_sample_size, chr.maximum_sample_size) maximum_sample_size
    FROM characteristic chr
    INNER JOIN uom on uom.uom_id = chr.uom_id
    INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link on chr.char_id = qm_spec_char_link.char_id
    '
   IF @qm_spec_id_list IS NOT NULL or len(ltrim(@qm_spec_id_list)) > 0
      SET @SQL = @SQL + N' WHERE qm_spec_char_link.qm_spec_id in (' + @qm_spec_id_list + N')'

   EXECUTE (@SQL)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Cert_SignOff_Allowed]

,@oper_id 	STRING40
,@step_no 	INT32 = NULL
,@cert_name 		STRING40 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--02/07/2006	Raghu		3.1.9	HD# 6871, Added certification name to error message.
--09/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.23	HD# 6871, Added certification name to the first error string.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @reqd_level 		INT32,
	@duration 		INT32,
	@audit			LOGICAL,
	@user_cert_level	INT32,
	@expiry			TDATETIME,
	@cert_checked		LOGICAL,
	@current_time		TDATETIME,
	@err_desc		NVARCHAR(4000),
	@user_cert_name		STRING80

BEGIN
  SET @cert_checked = 0

--iF process_id and oper_id is passed with step_no, then get all certificates with the arguments passed,
-- else get all the certificates with the user_id passed.
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

   IF ((@process_id IS NOT NULL AND @process_id <> '') AND (@oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id <> '')) BEGIN
	IF (@step_no IS NULL OR @step_no = '')  BEGIN
		--Get all the certificates based on process_id and oper_id
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
			FROM cert_oper_link cert_oper_link, cert_type cert_type
			WHERE cert_oper_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			AND cert_oper_link.process_id = @process_id AND cert_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND  (cert_oper_link.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
   	END
   	ELSE IF (@step_no IS NOT NULL AND @step_no <> '') BEGIN
--Get all the certificates based on process_id, oper_id and step_no
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_step_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
			FROM cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type
			WHERE cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id AND cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no  AND (cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
/*			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_step_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.audit
			from cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type, cert_oper_link cert_oper_link
			where cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.cert_name   = cert_oper_link.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id  = cert_oper_link.process_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id     = cert_oper_link.oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no*/
	END
/*   ELSE  BEGIN
--Get all the certificates based on user_id
   	DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		select cert_type.cert_name, cert_type.max_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.audit
		from cert_user_link cert_user_link, cert_type cert_type
		where cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		and cert_user_link.user_id = @user_id
   END
*/
   OPEN cert_cursor
   WHILE (1=1)
   BEGIN
   FETCH NEXT FROM cert_cursor INTO @cert_name, @reqd_level, @duration, @audit
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
	SET @cert_checked = 1
	IF (@audit = 1) BEGIN
	 	SELECT @user_cert_level = cert_user_link.cert_level, @expiry = cert_user_link.expiry
		,@user_cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		FROM cert_user_link cert_user_link
		INNER JOIN cert_type cert_type ON cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		WHERE cert_user_link.cert_name = @cert_name AND user_id = @user_id

		IF (@user_cert_level IS NULL) BEGIN
--        			RAISERROR('User does not have a valid certification.{3327}', 16, 1, @@ERROR)
--				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a valid certification.{3327},' + @user_id
				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
        			RETURN -1
		END
		IF @user_cert_level < @reqd_level BEGIN
--        			RAISERROR('Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level.{3328}', 16, 1, @@ERROR)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
        			RETURN -1
		END
		IF @expiry < @current_time BEGIN
--        		RAISERROR('Users Certificate has expired.{3329}', 16, 1, @@ERROR)
			SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
			RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
               		RETURN -1
		END
	END
   END
   CLOSE cert_cursor
   DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
   END
/*   if (@cert_checked = 0) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Certificate Not found', 16, 1, @@error)
             	RETURN -1
   END
*/
RETURN 0
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_SaveAssignRecipeParam]
-- Description: this SP inserts/updates the recipe param
--
-- Defined step: "Set Parameter"
-- Usage: 	
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author   Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		DS		2022-08-07			Initial version.[Default step no will be -1 if spec is not being saved against step no]
-- 0.02		Chitta	2023-04-26			when SaveRecords=0 then validation message needs to show
-- 0.03		DS		2023-05-24			Changes done for Audit trail
-- 0.04		DS		2023-07-15			if parameters are first tab then save the details in job_bom
-- 0.05		CK		2023-08-03			Removed Audit trail changes from 0.03 and added new code for audit trail
-- 0.04		DS		2024-02-08			updated header & inline comments 
-- 1.00		JSC		2026-01-26			XChanged CB_Batch weight
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_SaveAssignRecipeParam]
								 (
									  @wo_id [dbo].[STRING40]
									, @parent_item_id [dbo].[STRING40]
									, @oper_id [dbo].[STRING40]
									, @seq_no [dbo].[INT32]
									, @ent_id [dbo].[INT32]
									, @ver_id [dbo].[STRING40]
									, @saveRecords  [dbo].[INT32] = NULL		-- if this parameter is 1 then records wll be saved in to db otherwise only validation will be done.// to handle the running condition
									, @last_edit_by [dbo].[STRING40]
									, @load_equip_params int =  NULL
									, @ddParam [dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
									, @grid nvarchar(max)
									, @resultset int output
									, @resultcode nvarchar(250) output
								)
                 AS 
BEGIN

						 
DECLARE @step_no int = -1
DECLARE @assoc_file nvarchar(254) = NULL
DECLARE @comments nvarchar(2000) = NULL
DECLARE @assoc_file_type nvarchar(254) = NULL
DECLARE @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) = NULL
DECLARE @mod_id varchar(30)
DECLARE @access_level int = 0

DECLARE @row_cnt int
DECLARE @max_row_cnt int
,@i INT =0
,@modCnt INT=0
,@j INT =0
,@newCnt INT=0
,@k INT =0
,@delCnt INT=0

declare  @spec_id nvarchar(40)
		, @spec_value nvarchar(1700)
		, @act_spec_value nvarchar(1700) 
		, @min_value nvarchar(80)
		, @max_value nvarchar(80)
		--, @step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Set Parameter'
		, @step_data STRING254_NULL

declare
			 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_SetParameter'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'ADD'
			,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			,@iRowId  int
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Set Parameter'
			,@keyField1             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField2             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@keyField6             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@old_value1	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@new_value1	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@old_value2	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@new_value2	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@old_value3	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@new_value3	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@column_name NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
			,@log_id INT
			,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
			,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			,@user_id	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@user_name	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@change_type INT = 2
			,@table_name NVARCHAR(80)              = 'job_spec'
			,@row_id INT
			,@audit_category        NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			declare @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName;
			DECLARE @delete_detail NVARCHAR(MAX);
	
	if @audit_category is null set @audit_category = 'Info' ;

DECLARE @row_cnt_au int
DECLARE @max_row_cnt_au int

DECLARE @job_spec_audit as table 
		   ([rowSeq] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			[spec_id]			[dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
			[spec_value]		[dbo].[STRING1700] NOT NULL,
			[act_spec_value]	[dbo].[STRING1700_NULL] NULL,
			[last_edit_by]		[dbo].[STRING40_NULL] NULL,
			[last_edit_at]		[dbo].[TDATETIME] NOT NULL,
			[row_id]			[int]
			)

DECLARE @job_spec_audit1 as table 
		   ([rowSeq] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
			[spec_id]			[dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
			[spec_value]		[dbo].[STRING1700] NOT NULL,
			[act_spec_value]	[dbo].[STRING1700_NULL] NULL,
			[last_edit_by]		[dbo].[STRING40_NULL] NULL,
			[last_edit_at]		[dbo].[TDATETIME] NOT NULL,
			[row_id]			[int]
			)

declare  @a1_spec_id		[dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
		,@a1_spec_id_new	[dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
		,@a1_spec_value		[dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
		,@a1_act_spec_value [dbo].[STRING1700] = NULL
		,@a1_spec_value_old	[dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
		,@a1_spec_value_new	[dbo].[STRING40] = NULL
		,@a1_act_spec_value_old [dbo].[STRING1700] = NULL		
		,@a1_last_edit_by	[dbo].[STRING40_NULL] = NULL 
		,@a1_row_id			int = 0

declare @CB_Batch_weight float 
declare @CB_Number_corrections int
declare @jobReqQty float

declare @cte table (rowId int identity(1,1), spec_id nvarchar(40), spec_desc nvarchar(80), min_value float,recipe_value float,max_value float, target_value float, Unit nvarchar(40), row_id int)

BEGIN TRY

			select @jobReqQty = qty_reqd  from job with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no 
					-- begin
					---- print 1
					--	select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = 'test issue- no save validation'
					--		return ;
					--  end

			insert into @job_spec_audit select [spec_id],[spec_value],[act_spec_value],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id]
												from job_spec with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no and step_no = -1;

						
						insert into @cte(spec_id,spec_desc,min_value,recipe_value,max_value,target_value,Unit,row_id )  
						SELECT spec_id,spec_desc,min_value,recipe_value,max_value,target_value,Unit,row_id  FROM  
						 OPENJSON ( @grid )  
						WITH (        
									 -- rowId  int '$.row_id',
									  spec_id  nvarchar(40)  '$.spec_id' ,
									  spec_desc   nvarchar(80) '$.spec_desc' ,  
									  min_value  float '$.min_value',
									  recipe_value float  '$.recipe_value',
									  max_value float  '$.max_value',
									  target_value float  '$.target_value', -- target value is set value in UI
									  Unit  varchar(40)  '$.Unit',
									  row_id int  '$.row_id'
							);

							--Additional check for cake blender
					if exists( select 1 from @cte where spec_id = 'CB_Number of corrections')
					begin
						select @CB_Number_corrections = target_value from @cte where  spec_id = 'CB_Number of corrections';
						select @CB_Batch_weight = target_value from @cte where  spec_id = 'CB_Dosing weight';
					
						if( @CB_Batch_weight<> @jobReqQty and @CB_Number_corrections =0)
						begin
							select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = '@@NoOfCorrectionStepto0@@'
							return ;
						end 
						if( @CB_Batch_weight= @jobReqQty and @CB_Number_corrections > 0)
                        begin
                                select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = '@@BatchWeightError@@'
                                return ;
                        end



					end 

			 if(@saveRecords=1) 
			 begin
					
					if(@load_equip_params =1) -- if set parameters are first tab then save the recipe details
					begin
						update job_bom set spare1 = @ddParam where  wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no and bom_pos = 0
					end
					
					

					select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @cte

					--DELETING all the job spec against that order
					DELETE FROM  dbo.job_spec where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no and step_no = -1;


					WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
					BEGIN
	
						 select @spec_id = spec_id, @min_value = min_value, @spec_value = ISNULL(recipe_value,0),  @act_spec_value = ISNULL(target_value,0), @max_value = max_value
									 from @cte where rowId =@row_cnt 

						
										BEGIN
										-- inserting into job spec table
											exec	[dbo].[sp_I_Job_Spec] 
														   @wo_id
														  ,@oper_id
														  ,@seq_no
														  ,@step_no
														  ,@spec_id
														  ,@spec_value
														  ,@act_spec_value
														  ,@assoc_file
														  ,@comments
														  ,@min_value
														  ,@max_value
														  ,@access_level
														  ,@last_edit_comment
														  ,@mod_id OUTPUT

										END

						set @row_cnt = @row_cnt+1
					END


					insert into @job_spec_audit1 
					select [spec_id],[spec_value],[act_spec_value],[last_edit_by],[last_edit_at],[row_id]
					from job_spec with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no= @seq_no and step_no = -1;

					-- Completing the steps
									exec [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_InsertJobStepDataForRecipe] 
									   @wo_id
									  ,@oper_id
									  ,@seq_no
									  ,@step_name
									  ,@step_data = @ver_id


				set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@updatedSuccessfully@@'
				select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode

			end
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				set @resultset =1; set @resultcode='@@RecordsValidatedSuccessfully@@'
				select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
			END
	END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
			--	select 0 as result,ERROR_MESSAGE() as resultCode
			set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
			select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
				  
END CATCH
if(@saveRecords=1) 
BEGIN
BEGIN TRY

-- audit trail section

	SELECT  @modCnt=count(t2.spec_id)
	 from @job_spec_audit t1
	 FULL OUTER JOIN @job_spec_audit1 t2 on t1.spec_id=t2.spec_id
	 where (t1.act_spec_value <> t2.act_spec_value) OR (t1.act_spec_value <> t2.spec_value) --OR (t1.last_edit_at <> t2.last_edit_at)

 while (@i < @modCnt)
	BEGIN 
	  

	 select  @a1_row_id			= t2.row_id
			,@a1_spec_id		= t2.spec_id
			,@a1_spec_value		= t2.spec_value
			,@a1_act_spec_value	= t2.act_spec_value
			,@a1_spec_value_old		= t1.spec_value
			,@a1_act_spec_value_old	= t1.act_spec_value
			,@a1_last_edit_by	= t2.last_edit_by
			 
	 from @job_spec_audit t1
	 FULL OUTER JOIN @job_spec_audit1 t2 on t1.spec_id=t2.spec_id
	 where (t1.act_spec_value <> t2.act_spec_value) OR (t1.act_spec_value <> t2.spec_value) --OR (t1.last_edit_at <> t2.last_edit_at)
	 order by t2.spec_id
	 OFFSET @i ROWS   
	 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	 Select @strActivityMsg = 'EDIT'
	
	IF(@a1_spec_value <> @a1_spec_value_old)
			BEGIN
			SET @column_name  = 'spec_value'
			set @change_type  = 2
			set @old_value1=@a1_spec_value_old
			set @new_value1=@a1_spec_value 
						   
						   
			set @user_name=@a1_last_edit_by
			set @row_id=@a1_row_id
								  
									

			EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @user_name, @change_type, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, @old_value1, @new_value1, @audit_comments, @delete_detail;

				UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
				SET
					 origin = @strFunctionName			
				WHERE
					log_id = @log_id;
	
			select @strCommentMsg='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_'+ @column_name +' is changed from : '+ cast(@old_value1 as nvarchar(50)) +' to: '+ cast(@new_value1 as nvarchar(50));
			set @keyField1=@wo_id
			set @keyField2=@oper_id
			set @keyField3=@seq_no
			set @keyField4=@spec_id
			

			INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
				(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
				VALUES
				(
					   @log_id, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @strModuleName, @strFunctionName, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @keyField5, @keyField6, @audit_category, @strActivityMsg, @strCommentMsg
					 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE()), @logged_at, @user_name
				);
			END
	IF(@a1_act_spec_value <> @a1_act_spec_value_old)
			BEGIN
			SET @column_name  = 'act_spec_value'
			set @change_type  = 2
			set @old_value1=@a1_act_spec_value_old
			set @new_value1=@a1_act_spec_value 
			set @user_name=@a1_last_edit_by
			set @row_id=@a1_row_id

			EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @user_name, @change_type, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, @old_value1, @new_value1, @audit_comments, @delete_detail;
						 
				UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
				SET
					 origin = @strFunctionName			
				WHERE
					log_id = @log_id;
	
			select @strCommentMsg= 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_' +@column_name +' is changed from : '+ cast(@old_value1 as nvarchar(50)) +' to: '+ cast(@new_value1 as nvarchar(50));
			set @keyField1=@wo_id
			set @keyField2=@oper_id
			set @keyField3=@seq_no
			set @keyField4=@spec_id
							

			INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
				(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
				VALUES
													 
				(
					   @log_id, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @strModuleName, @strFunctionName, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @keyField5, @keyField6, @audit_category, @strActivityMsg, @strCommentMsg
					 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE()), @logged_at, @user_name
				);
			END
			 
	SET @i = @i + 1;
	 	END

select @newCnt= count(t2.spec_id)
from @job_spec_audit t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @job_spec_audit1 t2 on t1.spec_id=t2.spec_id
where t2.spec_id not in (select t2.spec_id
						  from @job_spec_audit t2 )

while (@j < @newCnt)
BEGIN


	select  @a1_row_id			= t2.row_id
			,@a1_spec_id		= t2.spec_id
			,@a1_spec_value		= t2.spec_value
			,@a1_last_edit_by	= t2.last_edit_by
	from @job_spec_audit t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @job_spec_audit1 t2 on t1.spec_id=t2.spec_id
	where t2.spec_id not in (select t2.spec_id
							  from @job_spec_audit t2 )
	order by t2.spec_id
	 OFFSET @j ROWS   
	 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

	Select @strActivityMsg ='ADD'
	select @strCommentMsg= 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_';

	,(@a1_row_id,'act_spec_value',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_act_spec_value))
	
	
	EXEC sp_I_ofi_AuditTrail @module_id = @strModuleName
							,@function_id = @strFunctionName
							,@auditTrailParameters = @auditTrailParameters
							,@keyField1 = @wo_id
							,@keyField2 = @oper_id
							,@keyField3 = @seq_no
							,@keyField4 = NULL
							,@keyField5 = NULL
							,@user_id = @last_edit_by
							,@activity = @strActivityMsg
							,@audit_category = 'Info'
							,@comments = @strCommentMsg
SET @j = @j + 1;
END

-- removed record
select @delCnt=count(t1.act_spec_value) 
from @job_spec_audit t1
FULL OUTER JOIN @job_spec_audit1 t2 on t1.spec_id=t2.spec_id
where t1.spec_id not in (select t2.spec_id
						from @job_spec_audit1 t2 )
while (@k < @delCnt)
 BEGIN
		 

	select  @a1_row_id			= t1.row_id
			,@a1_spec_id		= t1.spec_id
			,@a1_spec_id_new	= 'Delete'
			--,@a1_spec_value			= t1.spec_value
			--,@a1_spec_value_new		= 'Delete'

			,@user_name	= @last_edit_by
	from @job_spec_audit t1
	FULL OUTER JOIN @job_spec_audit1 t2 on t1.spec_id=t2.spec_id
	where t1.spec_id not in (select t2.spec_id
							from @job_spec_audit1 t2 )
	 order by t1.spec_id
	 OFFSET @k ROWS   
	 FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
	 Select @strActivityMsg ='Delete'
	 Select @strCommentMsg = 'WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_'+'Removed row_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_row_id)+' Spec_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80),@a1_spec_id);
	 
	 SET @column_name  = 'spec_id'
			set @old_value1=@a1_spec_id;
			set @new_value1='Delete'

	EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @user_name, @change_type, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, @old_value1, @new_value1, @audit_comments, @delete_detail;
																
																	
																		
	
		UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
		SET
			 origin = @strFunctionName
		WHERE
			log_id = @log_id;
	
	
	set @keyField1=@wo_id;
	set @keyField2=@oper_id;
	set @keyField3=@seq_no;
	set @keyField4=@spec_id

	INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
		(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
		VALUES
		(
			   @log_id, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @strModuleName, @strFunctionName, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @keyField5, @keyField6, @audit_category, @strActivityMsg, @strCommentMsg
			 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE()), @logged_at, @user_name
		);

									

	
	SET @k = @k + 1;
 END


END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
select @resultset as result, @resultcode as resultcode
END CATCH
END

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_SA_SE_GetMovableEnts] (@ent_id	INT32)
RETURNS @movable_storage_ents TABLE (ent_id INT, storage_ent_id INT, tree_level INT) AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name			- fn_SA_SE_GetMovableEnts
-- Description			- Used to build a tree of entities that are movable from the supplied entity.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 06/20/2007
-- Version				- 3.2.16
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
DECLARE	@tree_level 	INT32

	SET @tree_level = 1

	INSERT INTO @movable_storage_ents (ent_id, storage_ent_id, tree_level)
	SELECT @ent_id, storage_ent_id, @tree_level
	FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1

		INSERT INTO @movable_storage_ents (ent_id, storage_ent_id, tree_level)
		SELECT ent_id, storage_ent_id, @tree_level
		FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id IN (SELECT storage_ent_id FROM @movable_storage_ents WHERE tree_level = @tree_level -1)

		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	END
	RETURN
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetTargetStorLocatns]
(
		@wo_id        STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id      STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@ent_id       INT32_NULL = NULL
)

AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETTARGETSTORLOCATNS
-- Description          -  7.3.3.9  To Location Drop down
--                          To location will contain all storage entities, moveable and not.
--                          If there are selections in the To Work Order or To Operation drop downs,
--                          this list will be limited to the set of entities to which any job conforming
--                          to these selections is scheduled or run, their immediate children,
--                          or any moveable storage entities located at any of these entities.
--                          If the ?From Entity? filter selection is set, then the list will be limited
--                          to only that entity and the moveable storage entities located at it.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/13/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
--05/11/2007    Raghu           3.2.12  HD# 9841, The tree was not returning the correct entities.
--05/29/2007    Raghu           3.2.14  The target entities does not have to have a serialied item in the inventory.
--05/31/2007    Raghu           3.2.15  HD# 9844, Transfer WIP inventory-Entities not displayed in alphabetical order
--09/05/2007	AML				3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
--01/24/2008	Raghu	3.4		L00074359; Unhandled exception occurred when clicki...
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

    --Split the recordset retrieval based on the supplied filters - for better performance by avoiding join with multiple tables.
    IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL OR @oper_id IS NOT NULL OR @ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		DECLARE @temp_storage_ents TABLE ( t_ent_id INT, t_child_level INT )
		DECLARE @level AS INT

		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level
			FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id AND se.movable = 1

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
				SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1
				FROM @temp_storage_ents t
					INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
				WHERE t.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1

			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1
		END


		DECLARE @temp_storage_ents2 TABLE ( t_ent_id int, t_child_level int )
		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents2
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE se.ent_id IN (
				--If there are selections in the To Work Order or To Operation drop downs,
				--this list will be limited to the set of entities to which any job conforming
				--to these selections is scheduled or run, their immediate children,
				SELECT COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) AS ent_id
				FROM job j
				WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
				UNION
				SELECT el.child_ent_id AS ent_id
				FROM ent_link el
				INNER JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) AS ent_id
						FROM job j
						WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
						  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id) parent_ents ON parent_ents.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
				UNION
				--If the From Entity filter selection is set, then the list will be limited
				--to only that entity and the moveable storage entities located at it.
				SELECT t.t_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ents t
			 )

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents2
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1 FROM @temp_storage_ents2 t2
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t2.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t2.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1


			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1
		END

        SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id, e.ent_name
        FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e  WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
			INNER JOIN ( SELECT t_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ents2 ) AS filtered_ents ON filtered_ents.t_ent_id = se.ent_id
        ORDER BY e.ent_name

	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        --Since there are no filters supplied, just return all the entities
        --To location will contain all storage entities, moveable and not.
        SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id, e.ent_name
        FROM item_inv ii
			INNER JOIN ent e ON ii.ent_id = e.ent_id
        --INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
        --WHERE i.serial_no_lvl > -1;
        ORDER BY e.ent_name
    END

END

-- Name:		[sp_s_ofi_getfatcheckforrecipe]
-- Description:	Check one-one fat and non-fat is present for recipe 
--
-- Usage:	 It is being used in the steup UI	
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		CK				2023-01-05			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_getfatcheckforrecipe]
	
	@recipe_name nvarchar(100)
		
AS
BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @wo_id nvarchar(50)
		,@oper_id nvarchar(50)
		,@seq_no int
		,@fatcount int
		,@nonfatcount int
SELECT @wo_id = jb2.wo_id
	  ,@oper_id = jb2.oper_id
	  ,@seq_no = jb2.seq_no
FROM job_bom jb2 WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE jb2.spare1=@recipe_name

-- checking the attribute on item level
SELECT @fatcount=count(*)
FROM item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE ia.attr_value ='FAT' 
AND ia.item_id IN (SELECT jb.item_id 
				   FROM job_bom jb WITH(NOLOCK)
				   WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
				   AND jb.oper_id=@oper_id 
				   AND jb.seq_no=@seq_no)

-- checking the attribute on item level

SELECT @nonfatcount=count(*)
FROM item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK)
WHERE ia.attr_value ='NON FAT' 
AND ia.item_id IN (SELECT jb.item_id 
				   FROM job_bom jb WITH(NOLOCK)
				   WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id
				   AND jb.oper_id=@oper_id 
				   AND jb.seq_no=@seq_no)

--SELECT @fatcount as fatcount, @nonfatcount as nonfatcount
if(@fatcount >0 AND @nonfatcount >0)
BEGIN
select 'true' as fatTest
END
ELSE
BEGIN
select 'false' as fatTest
END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Cons_AddGeneology]
(
		@wo_id					STRING80
	,	@oper_id				STRING80
	,	@seq_no					INT32
	,	@shift_start_local		TDATETIME
	,	@shift_start_tz			INT32 = NULL
	,	@item_id				STRING80
	,	@lot_no					STRING80
	,	@sublot_no				STRING80
	,	@fg_lot_no				STRING80
	,	@fg_sublot_no			STRING80
	,	@reas_cd				INT32
	,	@user_id				STRING80
	,	@item_scrapped			LOGICAL
	,	@ent_id					INT32
	,	@shift_id				INT32
	,	@grade_cd				INT32
	,	@status_cd				INT32
	,	@from_ent_id			INT32
	,	@qty_cons				TFLOAT
	,	@qty_cons_erp			TFLOAT
	,	@ext_ref				STRING40
	,	@transaction_type		INT32
	,	@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
	,	@segment_response_id	STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@comments				STRING254 = null  -- Added 07/22/2009 RWB
	,	@spare1					STRING80
	,	@spare2					STRING80
	,	@spare3					STRING80
	,	@spare4					STRING80
	,	@last_edit_by			STRING40
	,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME
	,	@must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL
	,	@must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@checkgrade				LOGICAL
	,	@inv_oper_id			STRING80
	,	@inv_seq_no				INT32
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 =NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Item_Cons_AddGeneology
-- Description				- HD# 3654, Apply Indistinguishable lots
-- Author					- Raghu
-- Date Created				- 05/12/2006
-- Version					- 3.1.16.SQL
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 01/23/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 08/08/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 03/04/2008		AML				3.4.0	L00075593: Defaulted last_edit_at to getutcdate().  Added created_at_local and
--											created_at_utc, defaulted to current datetime.
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu			4.0		DB Changes
--11/26/2009		AJAY			4.0		H1423 FIX
--01/27/2012        Saiteja         4.0 sp2 L00118740: Added code to validate the system attribute
--											'maintain distinct consumption records' and insert distinct records in the
--											Item_cons table. Modified the update statement to update the exact record
--											using row_id if multiple records present.
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @tz_temp			INT
		,	@shift_start_utc	DATETIME
		,	@created_at_local	DATETIME
		,	@created_at_utc		DATETIME
		,	@dbg_resp			INT
		,   @maintain_dist_cons_records	BIT -- Added for CR L00118740


	SET @shift_start_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)


	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @last_edit_at = ISNULL( @last_edit_at, GETUTCDATE() )

	SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(@time_zone_bias_value)
	--time_zone_bias_value should be client local
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_local, @tz_temp, @created_at_utc OUTPUT

	-- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Cons_AddGeneology_t', @src_key='sp_U_Item_Cons_AddGeneology',
		@date_val1 = @shift_start_utc, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_tz, @date_val2 = @created_at_utc, @numeric_val2 = @time_zone_bias_value
	if ( @dbg_resp = 1 ) RETURN

	--Begin Changes for CR L00118740.
	--Get the value of system attribute  'maintain distinct consumption records'
	SELECT @maintain_dist_cons_records = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 325
	SET @maintain_dist_cons_records = ISNULL(@maintain_dist_cons_records, 0)
	--End Changes for CR L00118740.

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( shift_start_local ) = @shift_start_local
			  AND item_id = @item_id
			  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
			  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
			  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id is null))
			  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			  AND @maintain_dist_cons_records <> 1)--Added for CR L00118740

		--Since this is the item that is being consumed, just add the prorated quantity
		--directly to the consumption record.
		--Modified the update statement to update the exact record using row_id if multiple records are present CR L00118740.
		UPDATE item_cons SET qty_cons = qty_cons + @qty_cons
				,qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @qty_cons_erp
		WHERE  row_id = (SELECT MAX(row_id) from item_cons where wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( shift_start_local ) = @shift_start_local
		  AND item_id = @item_id
		  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
		  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id is null))
		  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
		  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
		  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL)))
	ELSE
		--Since the consumed item is not the same item that is in the inventory,
		--Add a new consumption record for this new lot.
		--Added the subsegent_id and comments columns
		INSERT INTO item_cons (
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no,
			fg_sublot_no, reas_cd, user_id, item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id,
			qty_cons, qty_cons_erp,  ext_ref, transaction_type, genealogy_id, upstream_event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
			comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by,
			last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local
		)
		VALUES (
			@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local, @item_id, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no,
			@sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no, @reas_cd, @user_id, @item_scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd,
			@status_cd, @from_ent_id, @qty_cons, @qty_cons_erp, @ext_ref, 0, @genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
			@comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
			@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc, @created_at_local
		)

	--Call the standard inventory method to reduce the inventory.
	EXEC  sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=@qty_cons_erp
			, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
			, @must_consume_from_inv=@must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=@must_consume_from_wip, @checkgrade=@checkGrade, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@inv_oper_id, @seq_no=@inv_seq_no
			, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @row_id=NULL

END
