CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Cert_SignOff_Done](
@wo_id		STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@seq_no		INT32,
@step_no	INT32 = NULL,
@cert_name	STRING40 = NULL,
@lot_no		STRING40 = NULL,
@prod_log_id	INT = NULL,
@cons_log_id	INT = NULL,
@process_id	STRING40 = NULL,
@process_status	INT32 = NULL,
@active		LOGICAL,
@success	INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 11/20/2002	Rohit		   	Added logic to identify Oper or Step level certification
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/06/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	changed logic to hANDle '' lot no for non repeatable steps
-- 06/15/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included prod_log_id AND cons_log_id to find the no of certification sign offs.
--10/03/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @TotalCertificates	INT32
	,@NumberOfSignOff	INT32
	,@bStep			LOGICAL

-- Assuming cert_name is a required parameter.
-- Find the no. of entries in cert_audit_log based on the parameters passed.
-- If records exist, then the Cert_name is already signed off.
-- If records doesnot exist, then itz not yet signed off.
BEGIN
	--If step level make sure both step/lot is supplied
	IF (@step_no IS NOT NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Lot No cannot be null{3331}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id
		     AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
		    AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
		IF (@lot_no IS NULL OR @lot_no = '') SET @lot_no = '-'
	END

	--Check if oper/step level
	IF (@step_no is NOT NULL AND @lot_no is NOT NULL) SET @bStep = 1
	ELSE SET @bStep = 0

-- Get the number of SignOff required for the Certification
	SELECT @NumberOfSignOff = num_signoffs_reqd
	FROM cert_type WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE cert_name = @cert_name

	IF (@NumberOfSignOff IS NULL or @NumberOfSignOff = 0)  SET @NumberOfSignOff = 1

--   IF (@wo_id is NOT NULL AND @wo_id <> '') AND (@oper_id is NOT NULL AND @oper_id <> '')
--	AND (@seq_no is NOT NULL AND @seq_no <> '')  BEGIN
	--Add step/lot_no parameter only if it's step level certification
	IF @bStep = 1 BEGIN
		SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*)
		FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		    AND (cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
		    AND (step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
		    AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR lot_no IS NULL)
		    AND (prod_log_id = @prod_log_id OR @prod_log_id IS NULL)
		    AND (cons_log_id = @cons_log_id OR @cons_log_id IS NULL)
		    AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL)
		    AND (process_status = @process_status OR @process_status IS NULL)
		    AND (active = @active OR @active IS NULL)
		END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*)
		FROM cert_audit_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		    AND (cert_name = @cert_name or @cert_name IS NULL)
	END

--print @TotalCertificates
--print @NumberOfSignOff
   IF (@TotalCertificates >= @NumberOfSignOff) SET @Success = 0
   ELSE SET @Success = -1
END

-- 0.03.05		JSC				2026-01-26				Changed parameter CB_Batch weight

-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_getInputForCBMsg]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = null,
	@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = null,
	@seq_no INT = null,
	@item_id	NVARCHAR(40) = null,
	@manual_components NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
	@use_qty_spec INT = 0

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @is_manual INT = 0-- Default is System Prediction
	-- v03.04 Added; Give default values as they may not be send or be null by caller
	IF @manual_components <> '' AND @manual_components IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @is_manual = 1
	END
	
	SET @use_qty_spec = COALESCE(@use_qty_spec,0) -- Default is update qty for dosing.


    -- Insert statements for procedure here

					DECLARE @temp_payload TABLE (
					  Ref400 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref410 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref420 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref430 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref440 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref450 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref460 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref470 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref480 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref490 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref500 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref510 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref520 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref530 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref540 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref550 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref560 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref570 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref580 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref590 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref600 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref610 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref620 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref630 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref640 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref650 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref660 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref670 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref680 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref690 NVARCHAR(50),
					  Ref700 NVARCHAR(50),
					  fat NVARCHAR(50),
					  ph NVARCHAR(50),
					  moist NVARCHAR(50),
					  allowed_comp NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  base_dose NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  job_id NVARCHAR(50),
					  item_id NVARCHAR(50),
					  sample_id NVARCHAR(50),
					  min_dosing_qty_kg NVARCHAR(50),
					  additives NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  rcpLCH NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  rcp_moist NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcp_fat NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcp_fat_min NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcp_fat_max NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcp_ph NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcp_minimize_x NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcp_ph_deviation NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcpWLCH NVARCHAR(50),
					  rcpXLCH NVARCHAR(50),
					  cakeComponents NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  x_tristimulus NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  y_tristimulus NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  z_tristimulus NVARCHAR(MAX),
					  x_normalize NVARCHAR(50),
					  y_normalize NVARCHAR(50),
					  z_normalize NVARCHAR(50),
					  sat_thresold NVARCHAR(50)
					)

					DECLARE @temp_param TABLE (
					  base_dose_param FLOAT, -- MOD v0.3.06
					  curr_correction_step NVARCHAR(50),
					  correction_step NVARCHAR(50)
					  )


					  -- MOD set qty to floats
					  -- MOD set qtys to DECIMAL(18,4)
					DECLARE @qtyActual DECIMAL(18,3),--FLOAT,--NVARCHAR(50),
							@qtyTarget DECIMAL(18,3),--FLOAT,--NVARCHAR(50),
							@currQtyTarget  DECIMAL(18,3),--FLOAT,--NVARCHAR(50),
							@randomString NVARCHAR(10),
							@random_no NVARCHAR(20),
						    @curr_correction_step int,
							@sample_id NVARCHAR(50)

					INSERT INTO @temp_payload
					EXEC sp_S_OFI_CB_Prep_MQTT_Msg_Payload
							@wo_id ,
							@oper_id ,
							@seq_no,
							@item_id 
					
					select @sample_id = sample_id from @temp_payload

					INSERT INTO @temp_param
					EXEC sp_s_ofi_cb_process_parameter
							@wo_id ,
							@oper_id ,
							@seq_no


					SELECT	@qtyActual = ROUND(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,6), qty_prod), 4), 
							@qtyTarget = ROUND(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,6), qty_reqd), 4) 
					FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) 
					WHERE 	wo_id = @wo_id and
							oper_id = @oper_id and
							seq_no = @seq_no

					-- v0.3 ADDED
					DECLARE @conf_corr_step INT
							,@base_dose_param DECIMAL(18,3) -- MOD
							-- v0.3.1 ADDED
							,@min_dosing FLOAT
							
							
					SELECT TOP 1 @conf_corr_step = ISNULL(correction_step,0)
								,@curr_correction_step = ISNULL(curr_correction_step,1)
								,@base_dose_param = ROUND(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,6), base_dose_param),0.0),4) -- MOD from float to DECIMAL(18,6)
					FROM @temp_param

					-- if not min is found just use 100 for the system prediction
					SELECT @min_dosing = ISNULL(js.min_value,100)
					FROM job_spec js WITH (NOLOCK) 
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						and oper_id = @oper_id 
						and seq_no = @seq_no 
						and spec_id = 'CB_Dosing weight'
						
					SELECT @min_dosing = COALESCE(@min_dosing,100)

					-- IF We are running an extra correction, then pick value of min dosing quantity
					IF @conf_corr_step < @curr_correction_step
					BEGIN
						
						SET @currQtyTarget = @min_dosing					
					END
					ELSE IF @conf_corr_step >= @curr_correction_step
					BEGIN

						SET @currQtyTarget = ROUND(((@qtyTarget - ISNULL(@qtyActual,0)) *  @curr_correction_step  ) / @conf_corr_step,4) -- MOD rounded					
					END

					-- FIX in case over dosed on previous steps
					IF @currQtyTarget < @min_dosing
					BEGIN
						SET @currQtyTarget = @min_dosing 	
					END

					-- v03.03 Added
					IF @use_qty_spec = 1
					BEGIN
						SET @currQtyTarget = @base_dose_param
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN

						-- v03.03 Update the dosing qty (batch weight)
						EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Job_Spec] 
									   @wo_id = @wo_id
									  ,@oper_id = @oper_id
									  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
									  ,@step_no = -1
									  ,@spec_id = 'CB_Dosing weight'
									  ,@act_spec_value = @currQtyTarget
					END
					-- Finally add the qty actual for the calculation to work
					SET @currQtyTarget = @currQtyTarget + ISNULL(@qtyActual,0)

					-- Added 
					SELECT @randomString = LEFT(oc.correlation_id,LEN(oc.correlation_id)-3)
					FROM ofi_CBamqp_Resp oc WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE oc.wo_id = @wo_id
						AND oc.oper_id = @oper_id
						AND oc.seq_no = @seq_no
						AND oc.curr_correction_step = @curr_correction_step
						AND oc.isManual = 0

					IF @randomString IS NULL OR @is_manual = 0 OR @is_manual IS NULL
					BEGIN
						SET @randomString = CONCAT(NEWID(), CHECKSUM(NEWID()));
					END

					SET @random_no=@randomString + CASE WHEN @is_manual = 1
															THEN '_m'
														ELSE '_s' 
													END									
										+ CAST(FLOOR(RAND() * 10) AS NVARCHAR(1));

					declare @json_in nvarchar(max)
					declare @json_out nvarchar(max)
					

					SELECT  @json_in='{'+ STUFF((
							 SELECT Distinct ','	
													+'"ReplyQueue' + '":' + '"'+'CakeBlenderReply' + '"'+','
													+'"CorrelationId' +'":' + '"'+@random_no + + '"'+','
													+'"JobData' + '":' +'{'

																			-- Added New v03.03

-- Description:	Function that go thru orders in a session and based on the prod cunsome relation

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_SimpleJobDist_SequencePriority]
(
@I_SessionId int,
@I_User_Name nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	

--	Update SDB..Scheduler_Custom_Functions set lastexecutedon = getdate() where functionName = 'Test Function 01'

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--Declare @I_SessionId int set @I_SessionId = 78
	Declare @Jobs  table(mo_id varchar(50),ent_id int,wo_id varchar(50),oper_id varchar(50),seq_no varchar(50),duration int,qty float,sched_seq int, wo_priority int)
--Create table #tracking(wo_id varchar(50),item_id varchar(50),track_id varchar(50))

--Declare @Items as table (item_id varchar(50),isCons bit,isProd bit)

insert into @Jobs
select mo_id,job_sched_entity_id,wo_id,oper_id,job_seq_no, DateDiff(MI,job_latest_start_time,job_req_finished_time),req_qty,isnull(schedule_sequence,100), isnull(wo_priority,100) from SDB..scheduler_exec where session_id=@I_SessionId

select * from @Jobs

 
 
 Declare @ent_id varchar(50)
 --Declare @level int
 Declare @wo_id varchar(50)
 Declare @oper_id varchar(50)
 Declare @seq_no varchar(50)
 Declare @duration int
 Declare @lastEndTime datetime
 Declare @newEndTime datetime
  

	DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR  
	select distinct job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec where session_id=@I_SessionId 

	OPEN db_cursor   
	FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor into @ent_id

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
	BEGIN   
		Select @lastEndTime=min(wo_release_time) from SDB..scheduler_exec where session_id=@I_SessionId 
		DECLARE db_cursor2 CURSOR FOR   
		select wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,duration from @Jobs where ent_id=@ent_id order by sched_seq,wo_priority, qty desc

		OPEN db_cursor2   
		FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor2 into @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@duration

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
		BEGIN
			select @newEndTime=DATEADD(MI,@duration,@lastEndTime)
			update sdb..scheduler_exec set job_latest_start_time=@lastEndTime,job_req_finished_time=@newEndTime 
			,checkedout_by =   @I_User_Name  , is_checkedout = 1
			where session_id=@I_SessionId and wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and job_seq_no=@seq_no
				
			select @lastEndTime=@newEndTime

		FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor2 into  @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@duration
		END   

		CLOSE db_cursor2   
		DEALLOCATE db_cursor2 
				
       FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor into @ent_id
	END   

	CLOSE db_cursor   
	DEALLOCATE db_cursor 

--select * from #tracking order by wo_id
--drop table #WOS
--drop table #tracking

select * from SDB..scheduler_sessn where session_id=@I_SessionId

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_S_prodn_co_by_product
-- Description:  Returns the production for co / by product
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-30         Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  Lavkesh     2023-06-22         added extra condition bom_pos<0
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE             procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ei_prodn_co_by_product] as
begin
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN try
		Declare @wo_id varchar(40),@row_id int,@lot_no varchar(40),@qty_prod float
		Declare @ent_id int,@ent_name varchar(100),@co_product bit
		Declare @error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT

		SET @wo_id = NULL

		Select top 1 @wo_id = ip.wo_id,@row_id = ip.row_id,@lot_no = lot_no,@qty_prod = qty_prod-qty_prod_erp,
		@ent_id = ent_id,
		@co_product = case when jb.spare4 = '1' or jb.bom_pos<0 then 1 else 0 end 
		from item_prod ip  with(nolock)
		inner join job_bom jb with(nolock) on ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id and ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no and jb.bom_pos < 0 and ip.item_id = jb.item_id
		inner join (Select wo_id from wo  with(nolock) where state_cd <3) wo on ip.wo_id = wo.wo_id -- (KN 02-01-23 - To prevent clashing with close pro / close puo)
		where  qty_prod <> qty_prod_erp
		--Print @wo_id
		
		if @wo_id is not null
		Begin
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
			Select @ent_name = ent_name from ent where ent_id = @ent_id

			set @ent_name = 'SF01';	--(KN 18May21 - SAP confirmed this will be SF01 for both co-product & by-product at all times)

			Select  wo_id Order_Number,[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,@lot_no Batch_Number, 
			item_id Material,@qty_prod Quantity,

			Case when
			@co_product = 1 then '101' else '531' end
			Movement_Type,
		
			format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date, --format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd')
			format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,'000000' File_GenerationTime, --format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')
			@ent_name Storage_Location,iif(@co_product =1,'X','') CoProduct_Indicator, '' Document_Number,'' Message, '' Message
			from item_prod where row_id = @row_id


			Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = @qty_prod where row_id = @row_id
		Commit Transaction
		end
	End Try

	BEGIN catch
     IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

     SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
     RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
   END catch

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_GetCountsAndDuraton]
(@in_line_id				INT32 = NULL
,@in_type					INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_state_cd				int32 = null
,@in_reas_grp_cd			INT32 = NULL
,@runtime					LOGICAL
,@downtime					LOGICAL
,@setuptime					LOGICAL
,@teardowntime				LOGICAL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -    sp_SA_Line_GetCountsAndDuraton
-- Description          -    Get Utilization counts and duration for a line.  Also can return the set of entities that
--							 were the bottleneck entities for a given period.
--			UserStory:406417 - [Stored Proc] As Michelle I want to know the Counts and Durations for a Line so I can monitor performance of the entire Line
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    10/31/2014
-- Version          - 5.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 Aveva Group, plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
--	12/17/2014		RWB				5.1		Story 408832 - added a new type (3) for returning the set of entities that
--											were the bottleneck entites during the specified time period.
--  12/18/2014      KRF             5.1    Return the line name instead of its ID if there are no entities in it
--  10/11/2016	    Raghu		    5.3	   UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
--  07/31/2019      Jim O'          6.2    Merging changes by Ashish for v5.3 hotfix CR L00150964/merge CR L00151774:
--                                         this change selects util_ent_id from oee_exec when evaluating the bottleneck
--                                         entity regarding an OEE util data configuration involving another entity
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @err_msg				NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@line_id				INT32
		,@ent_id				INT32
		,@type					INT32
		,@filter_time_unit		INT32
		,@filter_start_time		INT32
		,@filter_end_time		INT32
		,@event_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,@event_end_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,@ret			INT32
		,@util_start_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
		,@shift_id				INT32
		--,@shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
		--,@shift_end_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,@start					TDATETIME
		,@end					TDATETIME
		,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,@max_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
   	    ,@max_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	    ,@min_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	    ,@min_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	    ,@cur_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	    ,@cur_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	    ,@line_name           NVARCHAR(80)

BEGIN

	SELECT @line_id = @in_line_id, @filter_time_unit = @in_filter_time_unit
		, @filter_start_time = @in_filter_start_time, @filter_end_time = @in_filter_end_time
		, @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	IF (@in_line_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 may not be empty{5413},LINE_ID'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The specified line does not exist{7929}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_name = line_name FROM line WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
		SET @err_msg =  N'There are no entities in the supplied line: %1.{7890},' + @line_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@in_type IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 may not be empty{5413},TYPE'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
    ELSE IF (@in_type < 0 OR @in_type > 3) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The %1 must be in the range %2-%3{3356},TYPE,0,2'
        RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	--Get the entity (any one) from the line.
	SELECT TOP 1 @ent_id = lel.ent_id FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id

	EXEC @ret = sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes @ent_id=@ent_id, @filter_time_unit=@filter_time_unit
		, @filter_start_time=@filter_start_time, @filter_end_time=@filter_end_time
		, @start_time_utc=@start OUTPUT, @end_time_utc=@end OUTPUT

	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 1) BEGIN
		-- Filter Time Unit = 1 (Shift)
		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 1
		IF @ent_id IS NOT NULL
			SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
			       @cur_shift_end_utc = cur_shift_end_time_utc FROM ent WITH (nOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		-- If current shift ended before now, parent entity used to have a shift schedule but doesn't anymore
		IF @cur_shift_start_utc IS NULL OR @cur_shift_end_utc <= GETUTCDATE() BEGIN
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1 -- Current shift
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
					, @min_shift_start_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
					, @max_shift_end_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
					, @min_shift_end_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
				WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
				  AND lel.line_is_child = 0
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_start_utc)
						, @min_shift_start_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_start_utc)
						, @max_shift_end_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
						, @min_shift_end_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN shift_history sh_prev WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = sh_prev.ent_id AND DATEADD(SS,-1,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc) = sh_prev.shift_end_utc
				WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
				  AND lel.line_is_child = 0

			IF (@max_shift_start_utc<>@min_shift_start_utc OR @max_shift_end_utc<>@min_shift_end_utc) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Entities in line have differing shift schedules - querying by shift is not possible.{2031}'
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN -- There is a parent entity for the line with a legitimate shift schedule
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = @cur_shift_start_utc,	@max_shift_end_utc = @cur_shift_end_utc
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @max_shift_end_utc = shift_end_utc
				FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND DATEADD(SS,-1,@cur_shift_start_utc) = shift_end_utc
		END

		SELECT @start = @max_shift_start_utc, @end = @max_shift_end_utc
	END -- End Filter Time Unit = 1 (Shift)

	IF (@in_type = 0) BEGIN
		--Utilization States

		SELECT bottleneck_util.state_cd, bottleneck_util.state_desc, bottleneck_util.color
			, SUM(DATEDIFF(SS, bottleneck_util.event_start_utc, bottleneck_util.event_end_utc)) AS duration
			, MAX(bottleneck_util.util_count) AS util_count
			, MAX(CASE WHEN bottleneck_util.state_cd = bottleneck_util.cur_state_cd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
		FROM
			(SELECT us.state_cd, us.state_desc, us.color
				, CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < bottleneck.start_time_utc THEN bottleneck.start_time_utc ELSE ul.event_time_utc END AS event_start_utc
				, CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > bottleneck.end_time_utc THEN bottleneck.end_time_utc ELSE ul.event_end_time_utc END AS event_end_utc
				, ue.cur_state_cd
				--Count the number of distinct util log events for each state code
				, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ul.state_cd ORDER BY ul.log_id) util_count
			FROM (SELECT bh.ent_id, CASE WHEN bh.start_time_utc < @start THEN @start ELSE bh.start_time_utc END AS start_time_utc
						, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) > @end THEN @end ELSE COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) END AS end_time_utc
					FROM bottleneck_history bh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE bh.line_id = @line_id
					  AND bh.start_time_utc < @end
					  AND COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) >= @start) bottleneck
			INNER JOIN vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id =
			  (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottleneck.ent_id)
			  AND ul.event_time_utc < bottleneck.end_time_utc
			  AND ul.event_end_time_utc > bottleneck.start_time_utc
			INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.state_cd = us.state_cd
			INNER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = ue.ent_id
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc
					FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE uh.ent_id = (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottleneck.ent_id)
					  AND uh.event_time_utc <= bottleneck.start_time_utc) util
			WHERE ul.event_time_utc >= COALESCE(util.start_event_time_utc, @start)
			  AND (ul.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL)
			) bottleneck_util
		GROUP BY bottleneck_util.state_cd, bottleneck_util.state_desc, bottleneck_util.color

	END
	ELSE IF (@in_type = 1) BEGIN
		--Utilization Reason Groups

		SELECT bottleneck_util.reas_grp_id, (SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc FROM util_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = bottleneck_util.reas_grp_id) as reas_grp_desc
			, SUM(DATEDIFF(SS, bottleneck_util.event_start_utc, bottleneck_util.event_end_utc)) AS duration
			, MAX(bottleneck_util.util_count) AS util_count
			, MAX(CASE WHEN bottleneck_util.reas_grp_id = bottleneck_util.curr_reas_grp_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
		FROM
			(SELECT ur.reas_grp_id
				, CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < bottleneck.start_time_utc THEN bottleneck.start_time_utc ELSE ul.event_time_utc END AS event_start_utc
				, CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > bottleneck.end_time_utc THEN bottleneck.end_time_utc ELSE ul.event_end_time_utc END AS event_end_utc
				, curr_reas_grp.reas_grp_id curr_reas_grp_id
				--Count the number of distinct util log events for each reason group code
				, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ur.reas_grp_id ORDER BY ul.log_id) util_count
			FROM (SELECT bh.ent_id, CASE WHEN bh.start_time_utc < @start THEN @start ELSE bh.start_time_utc END AS start_time_utc
						, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) > @end THEN @end ELSE COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) END AS end_time_utc
					FROM bottleneck_history bh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE bh.line_id = @line_id
					  AND bh.start_time_utc < @end
					  AND COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) >= @start) bottleneck
			INNER JOIN vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id =
			  (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottleneck.ent_id)
			  AND ul.event_time_utc < bottleneck.end_time_utc
			  AND ul.event_end_time_utc > bottleneck.start_time_utc
			INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
			INNER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = ue.ent_id
			INNER JOIN util_reas curr_reas_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON ue.cur_reas_cd = curr_reas_grp.reas_cd
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc
					FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE uh.ent_id = (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottleneck.ent_id) AND uh.event_time_utc <= bottleneck.start_time_utc) util
			WHERE ul.event_time_utc >= COALESCE(util.start_event_time_utc, @start)
			  AND (ul.state_cd = @in_state_cd OR @in_state_cd IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL)
			) bottleneck_util
		GROUP BY bottleneck_util.reas_grp_id
	END
	ELSE IF (@in_type = 2) BEGIN
        --Utilization Reasons
		SELECT bottleneck_util.reas_cd, bottleneck_util.reas_desc, bottleneck_util.state_cd, bottleneck_util.state_desc, bottleneck_util.color
			, SUM(DATEDIFF(SS, bottleneck_util.event_start_utc, bottleneck_util.event_end_utc)) AS duration
			, MAX(bottleneck_util.util_count) AS util_count
			, MAX(CASE WHEN bottleneck_util.reas_cd = bottleneck_util.cur_reas_cd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active
		FROM
			(SELECT ur.reas_cd, ur.reas_desc, ur.state_cd, us.state_desc, us.color
				, CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < bottleneck.start_time_utc THEN bottleneck.start_time_utc ELSE ul.event_time_utc END AS event_start_utc
				, CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > bottleneck.end_time_utc THEN bottleneck.end_time_utc ELSE ul.event_end_time_utc END AS event_end_utc
				, ue.cur_reas_cd
				--Count the number of distinct util log events for each reason code
				, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ur.reas_cd ORDER BY ul.log_id) util_count
			FROM (SELECT bh.ent_id, CASE WHEN bh.start_time_utc < @start THEN @start ELSE bh.start_time_utc END AS start_time_utc
						, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) > @end THEN @end ELSE COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) END AS end_time_utc
					FROM bottleneck_history bh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE bh.line_id = @line_id
					  AND bh.start_time_utc < @end
					  AND COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) >= @start) bottleneck
			INNER JOIN vw_util_history ul WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id =
				(SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottleneck.ent_id)
				AND ul.event_time_utc < bottleneck.end_time_utc
				AND ul.event_end_time_utc > bottleneck.start_time_utc
			INNER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
			INNER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id = ue.ent_id
			INNER JOIN util_state us WITH (NOLOCK) ON ur.state_cd = us.state_cd
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc
					FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE uh.ent_id = (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottleneck.ent_id)
					  AND uh.event_time_utc <= bottleneck.start_time_utc) util
			WHERE ul.event_time_utc >= COALESCE(util.start_event_time_utc, @start)
			  AND (ur.reas_grp_id = @in_reas_grp_cd OR @in_reas_grp_cd IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.state_cd = @in_state_cd OR @in_state_cd IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.runtime = @runtime OR @runtime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.downtime = @downtime OR @downtime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.setuptime = @setuptime OR @setuptime IS NULL)
			  AND (ul.teardowntime = @teardowntime OR @teardowntime IS NULL)
			) bottleneck_util
		GROUP BY bottleneck_util.reas_cd, bottleneck_util.reas_desc, bottleneck_util.state_cd, bottleneck_util.state_desc, bottleneck_util.color
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		-- Bottleneck entities
		SELECT DISTINCT bh.ent_id, e.ent_name
			--, CASE WHEN bh.start_time_utc < @start THEN @start ELSE bh.start_time_utc END AS start_time_utc
			--, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) > @end THEN @end ELSE COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) END AS end_time_utc
		FROM bottleneck_history bh WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON bh.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE bh.line_id = @line_id
		  AND bh.start_time_utc < @end
		  AND COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) >= @start
		ORDER BY e.ent_name
	END
END

-- Name:  	[sp_SA_ofi_AssignJob]
-- Description: Get all Lines and Entity on click of Assign Button
--
-- Usage:	Get Lines or Entities for the Lines selected
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB			2022-06-06			Initial version. 
-- 0.01.01  MA			2024-02-01			Changes to fetch ent desc instead of ent name.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_AssignJob]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50),
	@seq_no int,
	@oper_id nvarchar(50),
	@ent_id nvarchar(50)=NULL
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

	declare @init_ent nvarchar(50)
	declare @attr_val nvarchar(100)

	if(@ent_id is null)
	BEGIN
		select @init_ent=init_sched_ent_id from job with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and seq_no=@seq_no and oper_id=@oper_id
		print @init_ent
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		set @init_ent=@ent_id
	END

	select @attr_val=a.attr_value from ent_attr  a  with (nolock)
	inner join ent e  with (nolock) on e.ent_id=a.ent_id
	inner join attr atr  with (nolock) on a.attr_id=atr.attr_id
	where e.ent_id=@init_ent and atr.attr_desc='EntityType'

	print @attr_val
	if(@ent_id is null and @attr_val='Line')
	BEGIN
	print 'Line'
	select ent_id,isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name) as ent_name from  ent  with (nolock) where  ent_id=(select parent_ent_id from ent where ent_id=@init_ent)
		
		
	END

	if @attr_val='Area'
	BEGIN
	print 'Area'
		select  distinct e.ent_id,isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_name from ent e with (nolock) 
		inner join ent_attr ea with (nolock) on ea.ent_id=e.ent_id
		inner join attr atr with (nolock) on ea.attr_id=atr.attr_id
		where parent_ent_id=@init_ent and ea.attr_value<>'StorageUnit'  and atr.attr_desc='EntityType'
	END
	if (@attr_val='Line' and @ent_id is not null)
	BEGIN
		select ent_id,isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name) as ent_name from ent with (nolock) where parent_ent_id=@init_ent-- or ent_id=@init_ent
	END

	if @attr_val='Segment'
	BEGIN
	print 'Segment'
	select distinct ent.ent_id,isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name) as ent_name from ent with (nolock)
	inner join job j with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
	where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no
	END
END

) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--02/13/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--07/17/2007  Raghu           3.3.1   HD# 10081, Replace cur_reas_start with *_utc and *_local.
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
--06/07/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserStory: 816528 - As Lenka, I want statistics to be optionally calculated and defaulted to TRUE when sp_SA_Oee_Exec, sp_S_Oee_Exec, sp_SA_Util_Exec, and sp_S_Util_Exec is called
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @current_util		FLOAT = NULL

	--Default to 1, current utilization will be calculated by default.
	SET @get_current_util = COALESCE(@get_current_util, 1)

	IF (@get_current_util = 1) --If the request is to return the KPI values, call the SP to return the KPI values
		EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetValue @in_session_id=-1, @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_kpi_type=2
			, @in_filter_time_unit=1, @in_filter_start_time=1, @in_filter_end_time=0
			, @availability=@current_util OUTPUT

	SELECT util_exec.ent_id
		  ,util_exec.cur_state_cd
		  ,util_exec.cur_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.cur_reas_start_utc
		  ,util_exec.cur_reas_start_local
		  ,util_exec.cur_raw_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.reas_reqd
		  ,util_exec.cur_log_id
		  ,util_exec.target_util
		  ,@current_util AS current_util
		  ,util_exec.jobstart_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.jobend_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.shift_start_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.shift_end_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.unkn_stop_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.break_start_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.break_end_reas_cd
		  ,util_exec.inherit_from_parent
		  ,util_exec.spare1
		  ,util_exec.spare2
		  ,util_exec.spare3
		  ,util_exec.spare4
		  ,util_exec.last_edit_comment
		  ,util_exec.last_edit_by
		  ,util_exec.last_edit_at
	  FROM util_exec util_exec with (nolock)
	WHERE (util_exec.ent_id = @ent_id)
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_S_OFI_GetBinReworkABA
-- Description:	to get the attr_value whether checked or not checked for ABA--ofi.ProductionExecution.js 
-- 
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB				2024-03-27			Initial version
-- 1.00.00	JSC				2024-10-02			Fixed version for handheld from sp_S_OFI_GetBinReworkMaster
-- 1.00.01	JSC				2024-10-02			Added extra BinDump type for checking the value agains WO
--===========================================================================================*/
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_OFI_ValidateForBinRework]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@type nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare1 nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare2 nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare3 nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare4 nvarchar(50)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Added v1.0.1
	if @type='BinDump'
	BEGIN
		select top 1 ja.attr_value as isDumping from job_attr ja (NOLOCK)
		inner join attr a (NOLOCK) on ja.attr_id=a.attr_id
		where a.attr_desc='isDumping' and wo_id=@wo_id
		order by ja.last_edit_at desc

		RETURN;
	END
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	if @type='BinReworkABA'
	BEGIN
		select ISNULL(wa.attr_value,0) as chkABA from wo_attr wa (nolock)
		inner join wo w (nolock) on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
		where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=@wo_id
		
		RETURN;
	END
	
	if @type='GetBinConsMode'
	BEGIN
			select ea.attr_value as BinConsumptionMode from job  j (nolock)
		inner join ent e1 (nolock) on e1.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent e2  (nolock) on e2.ent_id=e1.parent_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr ea (nolock) on ea.ent_id=e2.ent_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.state_cd=3 and a.attr_desc='BinConsumptionMode'
		
		RETURN;
	END

	if @type='AllowPalletConsumption'
	BEGIN
		declare @oper_id nvarchar(max),
		@seq_no int,
		@attr_id int
		select @oper_id=oper_id, @seq_no=seq_no from job (NOLOCK) where state_cd=3 and wo_id=@wo_id
		select @attr_id= ja.attr_id from job_attr ja (NOLOCK)
		inner join attr a (NOLOCK) on ja.attr_id=a.attr_id
		where a.attr_desc='AllowPalletConsumption'

		select pa.attr_value from process_attr pa inner join attr a on a.attr_id=pa.attr_id 
			inner join oper o on o.process_id=pa.process_id
			inner join job j on j.oper_id=o.oper_id
		where a.attr_desc='AllowPalletConsumption' and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no

		RETURN;

	END
	
	if @type='validDumpingOnScan'
	BEGIN
		SELECT ISNULL((select attr_value from job j (nolock)
		inner join job_attr ja (nolock) on ja.wo_id=j.wo_id and ja.oper_id=j.oper_id and ja.seq_no=j.seq_no
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ja.attr_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='isDumping' and j.state_cd=3),0) as isDumping
	
		RETURN;
	END

	if @type='chkDumping'
	BEGIN
		if exists(select 1  from job j (nolock)
		inner join job_attr ja (nolock) on ja.wo_id=j.wo_id and ja.oper_id=j.oper_id and ja.seq_no=j.seq_no
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ja.attr_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='isDumping')
		BEGIN
				select top 1 isNULL(attr_value,1) as isDumping  from job j (nolock)
				inner join job_attr ja (nolock) on ja.wo_id=j.wo_id and ja.oper_id=j.oper_id and ja.seq_no=j.seq_no
				inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ja.attr_id
				where j.wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='isDumping' order by ja.last_edit_at desc
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			
			DECLARE	
			@mod_id varchar(30)
			select @spare1=oper_id, @spare2=seq_no from job (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and state_cd=3
			select @spare3=attr_id from attr (nolock) where attr_desc='isDumping'

			EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Attr]
			@wo_id =@wo_id,
			@oper_id =@spare1,
			@seq_no = @spare2,
			@attr_id = @spare3,
			@attr_value = '1',
			@notes = NULL,
			@last_edit_comment = NULL,
			@mod_id = @mod_id OUTPUT

			SELECT	@mod_id as N'@mod_id'
		END

		RETURN;
	END

	if @type='ReworkBinItem'
	BEGIN
		select ea.attr_value as ReworkBinItem,i.item_desc,u.description,i.num_decimals from job j (nolock)
		inner join ent e (nolock) on e.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent e1 (nolock) on e1.ent_id=e.parent_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr ea (nolock) on ea.ent_id=e1.ent_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
		inner join item i (nolock) on i.item_id=ea.attr_value
		inner join uom u (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.state_cd=3 and a.attr_desc='ReworkBinItem'
	
		RETURN;
	END

	if @type='AllowReworkD'
	BEGIN
		
	

		exec SP_SA_OFI_BinAreaLine @wo_id=@wo_id ,@reworkItem=@spare1
		
		
		RETURN;
	END
	if @type='GetCurAllowBinAssign'
	BEGIN
		select wa.attr_value as chckCurABA from wo_attr wa  (nolock)
			inner join wo w (nolock) on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
			inner join attr a  (nolock) on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=@wo_id

		RETURN;
	END

	if @type='ValidateWOExistConsumption'
	BEGIN
				--test variables that will be using spare fields
				--declare @originArea INT =293,
				--@collectionstarttime nvarchar(50)='06/10/2024 22:00:00',
				--@collectionendtime nvarchar(50)='06/12/2024 22:00:00',
				--@item_id nvarchar (20)='100000095378'

				declare @originArea INT =CONVERT(INT,@spare1),
				@collectionstarttime nvarchar(50)=@spare2,
				@collectionendtime nvarchar(50)=@spare3,
				@item_id nvarchar (20)=@spare4


				DECLARE @OriginEntities as table (ent_id INT)

				declare
				  @date_from datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @collectionStartTime),
				  @date_to datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @collectionEndTime)

				INSERT INTO @OriginEntities select ent.ent_id
						FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ea.ent_id
						INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
						WHERE attr_desc = 'EntityType'
						AND ea.attr_value IN ('Segment')
						AND (ent.parent_ent_id=@originArea or ent.parent_ent_id in (select ent_id from ent where parent_ent_id=@originArea))


				;with cte_wo as (select wxt.wo_id from ofi_wo_item_ext wxt
				Inner join wo WITH (NOLOCK) on wxt.wo_id=wo.wo_id
				where 
				wxt.bom_pos < 0 
				AND wxt.item_id=@item_id
				and wo.state_cd IN (1, 2) -- (Started/Completed)
				),
				CTE_prod as (SELECT
					top 1 ip.ent_id,
							ip.wo_id,
						   ip.oper_id,
						   ip.seq_no,
						   j.state_cd,          
						   j.item_id,             
						   SUM(ip.qty_prod) qty_prod,
						   NULL as split_qty,
						   MAX(ip.lot_no) as lot_no,
						   MAX(IP.sublot_no) as sublot_no,
						   MAX(ip.shift_start_local) shift_start_local,
						   MAX(ip.hour_start_local) hour_start_local,
						   MAX(ip.created_at_utc) created_at_utc
					FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
					INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id  AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id   AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no
					INNER JOIN job_bom JB WITH(NOLOCK) on jb.wo_id=ip.wo_id and ip.oper_id=jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no=jb.seq_no and ip.item_id=jb.item_id 
					INNER JOIN @OriginEntities oe on ip.ent_id=oe.ent_id 
					Inner join cte_wo on ip.wo_id=cte_wo.wo_id
					WHERE	
					 jb.bom_pos=0
					AND w.state_cd IN (1, 2) -- (Started/Completed)    
				   AND j.state_cd IN (3, 4, 5)-- (RUNNING/COMPLETED/STOPPED)
					AND ip.created_at_utc BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to --date from and date to logic not yet added due to testing
					GROUP BY ip.wo_id,
							 ip.oper_id,
							 ip.seq_no,
							 j.item_id,           
							 j.state_cd,
							 ip.ent_id
							 )
			 
				SELECT ISNULL((select 1  from CTE_prod), 0) woExist
				
			
		RETURN;
	END
	
	SELECT TOP 0
	'' AS chkABA
	,'' AS BinConsumptionMode
	,'' AS attr_value
	,'' AS isDumping
	,'' AS '@mod_id'
	,'' AS ReworkBinItem
	,'' AS item_desc
	,'' AS description
	,'' AS num_decimals
	,'' AS ent_id
	,'' AS ent_name
	,'' AS chckCurABA
	,'' AS woExist
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_GetSerializedItems]
(
	@wo_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- SP_SA_ITEM_GETSERIALIZEDITEMS
-- Description					- Returns a list of serialized items that are produced or consumed by some job
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 03/06/2007
-- Version						- 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 07/11/2007		AML				3.2.1		Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@item_class_display	NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@item_display		NVARCHAR(1)

	--Retrieve the item class display order from the system_attribute table.
	SELECT @item_class_display = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 208

	IF ( @item_class_display IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @item_class_display = '0'
	END

	--Retrieve the item display order from the system_attribute table.
	SELECT @item_display = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 210

	IF ( @item_display IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @item_display = '0'
	END

	SELECT DISTINCT	ic.item_class_id
		,	ic.item_class_desc
	    ,	CASE @item_class_display
				WHEN '0' THEN ic.item_class_id
				WHEN '1' THEN ic.item_class_desc
				WHEN '2' THEN ic.item_class_id + '(' + ic.item_class_desc + ')'
				WHEN '3' THEN ic.item_class_desc + '(' + ic.item_class_id + ')'
			END AS item_class_display
        ,	i.item_id
		,	i.item_desc
	    ,	CASE @item_display
				WHEN '0' THEN i.item_id
				WHEN '1' THEN i.item_desc
				WHEN '2' THEN i.item_id + '(' + i.item_desc + ')'
				WHEN '3' THEN i.item_desc + '(' + i.item_id + ')'
			END AS item_display
    FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = jb.item_id
    WHERE (jb.wo_id =  @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (jb.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (i.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND i.serial_no_lvl > -1
    ORDER BY
		CASE @item_class_display
			WHEN '0' THEN ic.item_class_id
    		WHEN '1' THEN ic.item_class_desc
    		WHEN '2' THEN ic.item_class_id + '(' + ic.item_class_desc + ')'
    		WHEN '3' THEN ic.item_class_desc + '(' + ic.item_class_id + ')'
    	END,
		CASE @item_display
			WHEN '0' THEN i.item_id
    		WHEN '1' THEN i.item_desc
    		WHEN '2' THEN i.item_id + '(' + i.item_desc + ')'
    		WHEN '3' THEN i.item_desc + '(' + i.item_id + ')'
		END
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_cons_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[item_cons]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_cons_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_cons table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- 12/26/2016	Anwar		5.03		CR L00143393,HF L00142751: Only delete item cons and item prod records when both qty and qty erp are 0.
-- 03/28/2017	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:787207, As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00144715: so that a user can reduce consumption with the Genealogy .Net Control even when a different user
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	-- CR L00143393: Delete item cons and item prod records when both qty and qty erp are 0.
	IF EXISTS(select i.row_id from inserted i where i.qty_cons =0 AND i.qty_cons_erp = 0)
	BEGIN
		DELETE ic FROM item_cons ic
			INNER JOIN inserted i ON ic.row_id = i.row_id
			WHERE i.qty_cons =0 AND i.qty_cons_erp = 0
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE item_cons SET qty_cons = ROUND(i.qty_cons, it.num_decimals), qty_cons_erp = ROUND(i.qty_cons_erp, it.num_decimals),
		item_cons.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_cons.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE item_cons.row_id = i.row_id
	IF(@@ROWCOUNT < 1) BEGIN
		RETURN
	END
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Job_Step_Data_StepsCompl]
(@wo_id		STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@seq_no		INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.8
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 01/09/2003	  Rohit		1.5.2  Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 05/15/2003	  Raghu		1.6.7  (HD# 2421) 2)  Do Not allow the job to be completed if the production repeated for every lot has
--				       all its repeatable steps completely finished and none bypassed.
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1608   Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @step_no	  INT,
  @repeatability  INT,
  @step_desc  NVARCHAR(1700),
  @lot_no	  NVARCHAR(40),
  @err_str    NVARCHAR(1700)
BEGIN
  DECLARE Job_Step_Cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT job_step.step_no, job_step_grp.repeatability, job_step.step_desc
      FROM job_step job_step WITH (NOLOCK), job_step_grp job_step_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_step.wo_id = job_step_grp.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = job_step_grp.oper_id
	  AND job_step.seq_no = job_step_grp.seq_no AND job_step.step_grp_id = job_step_grp.step_grp_id
	  AND job_step.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = @oper_id AND job_step.seq_no = @seq_no
  OPEN Job_Step_Cursor
  WHILE (1=1)
  BEGIN
    FETCH NEXT FROM Job_Step_Cursor INTO @step_no, @repeatability, @step_desc
    IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)
      BREAK

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
		     WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_no = @step_no)
    BEGIN
            SET @err_str = 'The job (wo_id: %1, oper_id: %2, seq_no: %3) has a step: %4 (%5), which is not started yet.{3352},' + @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + STR(@seq_no) + ',' + STR(@step_no) + ',' + @step_desc
			RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN -1
    END

    IF (@repeatability = 0)
    BEGIN
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
		   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_no = @step_no
		     AND NOT state_cd IN (4, 8, 9))
      BEGIN
			SET @err_str = 'The job (wo_id: %1, oper_id: %2, seq_no: %3) has a step: %4 (%5), which is not started yet.{3352},' + @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + STR(@seq_no) + ',' + STR(@step_no) + ',' + @step_desc
			RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
	RETURN -1
      END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
		   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_no = @step_no
		     AND NOT state_cd IN (4, 8, 9))
      BEGIN
    SET @err_str = 'The job (wo_id: %1, oper_id: %2, seq_no: %3) has a step: %4 (%5), which is not started yet.{3352},' + @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + STR(@seq_no) + ',' + STR(@step_no) + ',' + @step_desc
	RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
	RETURN -1
      END

      DECLARE job_step_data_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT lot_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
	  WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND step_no = @step_no AND state_cd = 4
      OPEN job_step_data_cursor
      WHILE (1= 1)
      BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM job_step_data_cursor INTO @lot_no
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)
          BREAK
	IF @lot_no = ''
          SET @lot_no = NULL
	IF @lot_no IS NULL
        BEGIN
	  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND lot_no IS NULL)
          BEGIN
	    RAISERROR('Production should be reported for all the lots in the repeatable step{3861}', 16, 1, @@error)
	    RETURN -1
	  END
	END
	ELSE
        BEGIN
	  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND lot_no = @lot_no)
          BEGIN
	    RAISERROR('Production should be reported for all the lots in the repeatable step{3861}', 16, 1, @@error)
	    RETURN -1
	  END
	END  --End of @lot_no IS NULL
      END  --End of job_step_data_cursor
      CLOSE job_step_data_cursor
      DEALLOCATE job_step_data_cursor
    END  --End of @repeatability = 0
  END
  CLOSE job_step_cursor
  DEALLOCATE job_step_cursor
  RETURN 0
END

-- ***************************************************************************************************************************************************
-- Name				: sp_S_ofi_ei_mesmaterial  -
-- Description		: Get the MES only material from item master which is not yet send to LIMS system (where spare1 field is NULL)
--
-- Author			: Unnikrishnan Nair P G (GDC)
-- Creation date	: 2024-02-12
--
-- Usage			: Using IN LIMS interface EI location MES_LIMS_Material_IN
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour				Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change Description
-- 00.01			PG					2024-02-12				Initial draft
-- 00.02			JSC					2025-06-24				Updated to have row_id as input for selection and FIX DLL-MIDDLEWARE issues
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *****************************************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_ei_mesmaterial]	
	@row_id int = -1
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @cur_sys_local_time datetime = GETDATE() ;
	
	SET @row_id = COALESCE(@row_id,-1)

	IF @row_id > 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			item_id AS materialid,
			item_desc AS materialdesc,
			@cur_sys_local_time AS timestamp,
			row_id
		FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_class_id = 'INTERMEDIATE' 
			AND (row_id = @row_id)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			item_id AS materialid,
			item_desc AS materialdesc,
			@cur_sys_local_time AS timestamp,
			row_id
		FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_class_id = 'INTERMEDIATE' 
			AND (spare1 IS NULL or spare1 ='0')
		ORDER BY row_id 
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_JE_PauseBatchJobsByName]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Cert_SignOff_Reqd](
@process_id 	STRING40,
@oper_id 	STRING40,
@step_no 	INT32 = Null,
@Success	INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @TotalCertificates	INT32
BEGIN

   IF ((@process_id IS NOT NULL and @process_id <> '') AND (@oper_id IS NOT NULL and @oper_id <> '')) BEGIN
	--Frame the query depending on the Step_No
	IF  (@step_no IS NULL OR @step_no = '')  BEGIN
		SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*)
			FROM cert_oper_link cert_oper_link, cert_type cert_type
			WHERE cert_oper_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			  AND cert_oper_link.process_id = @process_id AND cert_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
/*		select @TotalCertificates = count(*)
			from cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type, cert_oper_link
			where cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_oper_link.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = cert_oper_link.process_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = cert_oper_link.oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no*/
		SELECT @TotalCertificates = COUNT(*)
			FROM cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type
			WHERE cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			AND cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id AND cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no
	END
   END
--TotalCertificates holds the total no of certificates to be signed off. If any certification exist, then exit
-- and return True else return False.

   if (@TotalCertificates > 0) SET @Success = 0
   ELSE SET @Success = -1
END

DECLARE @su_details_audit as table

		DECLARE @su_details_audit1 as table

		[row_id] [int] ,

		[abs_selected_qty] [dbo].[TFLOAT] NULL

declare  @a1_jb_item_id nvarchar(80)
		,@a1_jb_grade_cd int 
		,@a1_is_chk bit
		,@a1_su_ent_id int 
		,@a1_su_ent_name Nvarchar(80)
		,@a1_active_su_ent_name Nvarchar(80)
		,@a1_secondary_silo nvarchar(80)

		,@a1_created_by  nvarchar(80)
		,@a1_active_su_ent_id int

		,@a1_is_active int
		,@a1_row_id int 
		,@a1_row_id_old int =NULL
		,@a1_jb_item_id_old nvarchar(80)

		,@a1_state_desc nvarchar(50)
		,@i INT =0
		,@modCnt INT=0
		,@j INT =0
		,@newCnt INT=0
		,@k INT =0
		,@delCnt INT=0


SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY
			declare
			 @auditTrailParameters ofi_audittrailparameters
			,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_SetDestination'
			,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
			,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = 'ADD'

			--,@saveFlag int=1			-- it will pass from UI
			,@isValidFlag int = 1
			,@job_state_cd int
			,@step_name nvarchar(40) = 'Set Destination'
			,@step_data nvarchar(max)

			,@keyField3             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField4             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField5             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@keyField6             NVARCHAR(200)              = NULL
			,@old_value1	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@new_value1	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@old_value2	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@new_value2	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@old_value3	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@new_value3	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL

			declare @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName
			,@column_name NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
			,@log_id INT
			,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
			,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			,@user_id	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@user_name	NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
			,@change_type INT = 2
			,@table_name NVARCHAR(80)              = 'ofi_su_selection'
			,@row_id INT
			,@audit_category        NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
	
	if @audit_category is null set @audit_category = 'Info' ;

			DECLARE @delete_detail NVARCHAR(MAX);
			declare @row_cnt int
			declare @max_row_cnt int

			declare  @p_created_at_utc			[DATETIME]
					,@p_created_at_local		[DATETIME]
					,@p_last_edit_at_utc		[DATETIME]	
					,@p_last_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]

			set @p_created_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(); set  @p_last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE();
			set @p_created_at_local = GETDATE(); set @p_last_edit_at_local = GETDATE();

				declare	 @p_jb_item_id					varchar(80)	
						,@p_jb_grade_cd					int			
						,@p_jb_item_group				varchar(40)	
						,@p_ent_id						int			
						,@p_ent_name					varchar(40)	
						,@p_grade						varchar(40)	
						,@p_inv_grade_cd				varchar(40)	
						,@p_item_desc					varchar(80)	
						,@p_item_group					varchar(40)	
						,@p_item_id						varchar(80)	
						,@p_oper_id						varchar(80)	
						,@p_seq_no						int			
						,@p_storage_ent_id				int			
						,@p_wo_id						varchar(40)
						,@p_silo_seq_no					int

			declare @sourceSiloDetails table 
					(
					  ent_name   nvarchar(40)
					 ,jb_item_id nvarchar(80)
					 ,jb_grade_cd int
					 ,su_ent_id int
					)
			declare @sourceSiloCount int
			declare @destiSiloCount int
			declare @IsOnlyAllowedSingleDestination int
			declare @destSiloCount int
		
			declare @destinationgrid table ( 
					 rowId						int identity(1,1)
					,jb_item_id					varchar(80)		-- BOM ITEM ID
					,jb_grade_cd				int			-- BOM GRADE CODE
					,jb_item_group				varchar(40)	-- BOM ITEM GROUP
					,ent_id						int								
					,ent_name					varchar(40)						
					,grade						varchar(40)		NULL
					,inv_grade_cd				varchar(40)		NULL	-- INVENTORY GRADE CODE							
					,item_desc					varchar(80)		NULL							
					,item_group					varchar(40)		NULL 				
					,item_id					varchar(80)		NULL					
					,oper_id					varchar(80)														
					,seq_no						int							
					,storage_ent_id				int							
					,wo_id						varchar(40)
					,silo_seq_no				int
					);	
						
			
							
				insert into  @destinationgrid (
							   jb_item_id		
							  ,jb_grade_cd	
							  ,jb_item_group	
							  ,ent_id					
							  ,ent_name				
							  ,grade					
							  ,inv_grade_cd			
							  ,item_desc				
							  ,item_group				
							  ,item_id				
							  ,oper_id				
							  ,seq_no					
							  ,storage_ent_id			
							  ,wo_id					
							  ,silo_seq_no			
							 )
							select  
								 jb_item_id		
								,jb_grade_cd	
								,jb_item_group	
								,ent_id					
								,ent_name				
								,grade					
								,inv_grade_cd			
								,item_desc				
								,item_group				
								,item_id				
								,oper_id				
								,seq_no					
								,storage_ent_id			
								,wo_id					
								,silo_seq_no
									 FROM  
							 OPENJSON ( @dest_grid )  
								WITH  ( 	
										 jb_item_id  varchar(80)			'$.jb_item_id'
										,jb_grade_cd	int					'$.jb_grade_cd'
										,jb_item_group	varchar(40)			'$.jb_item_group'
										,ent_id  int						'$.ent_id'						
										,ent_name   varchar(40)				'$.ent_name'		
										,grade  varchar(40)					'$.grade'	
										,inv_grade_cd int					'$.inv_grade_cd'	
										,item_desc varchar(80)				'$.item_desc'				
										,item_group  varchar(40)			'$.item_group'		
										,item_id varchar(80)				'$.item_id'				
										,oper_id	varchar(80)				'$.oper_id'								
										,seq_no		int						'$.seq_no'	
										,storage_ent_id	int					'$.storage_ent_id'		
										,wo_id  varchar(40)					'$.wo_id'
										,silo_seq_no int					'$.silo_seq_no'
										);	
			
			----------------------------------------------
			--- saving into db
			
			--#279 validation the data for Bidirectional silos
			--fetching the details of source silo

			select @job_state_cd = state_cd from job with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no



				insert into @sourceSiloDetails
				select ent.ent_name,oss.jb_item_id,oss.jb_grade_cd,oss.su_ent_id from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock)
				inner join ent with(nolock) on oss.su_ent_id = ent.ent_id
				where oss.wo_id = @wo_id and oss.oper_id = @oper_id and oss.seq_no = @seq_no and oss.dest_type = 1  -- fetch the silo details in source selection

				--select @sourceSiloCount =count(*) from @destinationgrid where ent_name in(select ent_name from @sourceSiloDetails)
				--select @destiSiloCount = count(*) from @destinationgrid

				--	if (@sourceSiloCount>1)
				--	 begin
				--			select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = 'Only one silo can be selected as the destination if that silo has been chosen as one of the source silos.'
				--			--select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode
				--			return ;
				--	 end
				--	 else if(@sourceSiloCount=1 and @destiSiloCount>1 )
				--	  begin
				--			select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = 'Only one silo can be selected as the destination if that silo has been chosen as one of the source silos.'
				--			--select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode
				--			return ;
				--	 end

			select @IsOnlyAllowedSingleDestination  = attr_value from oper_attr oa with(nolock) inner join attr with(nolock) on oa.attr_id = attr.attr_id 
			and attr_desc = 'AllowedOnlySingleDestination' and oper_id = @oper_id
			set @IsOnlyAllowedSingleDestination = isnull(@IsOnlyAllowedSingleDestination,0);

			if(@IsOnlyAllowedSingleDestination=1)
				begin
					select @destSiloCount = count(*) from @destinationgrid
						if(@destSiloCount>1)
						begin
							set @isValidFlag=0;
							--set @ratioShortfall =  round(((@totalRequiredQtyforItem-@totalQtyForSelectedSilo)/@totalRequiredQtyforItem)*100,2)
							
							--set @resultcode = 'Only one silo can be selected for this process.'
							select @resultcode =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300011, NULL,NULL);

							select  top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = @resultcode
							return ;
						end
				end


					 if(@job_state_cd=3) -- check the running state and restrict user to modify the destination selection if user has already selected one of source as destination
					 begin
						if exists(select 1 from ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) where oss.wo_id = @wo_id and oss.oper_id = @oper_id and oss.seq_no = @seq_no and oss.dest_type = 2 
									and oss.su_ent_id in(select su_ent_id from @sourceSiloDetails))
						begin
							
							--set @resultcode = 'Modifying the destination is not feasible because one of the source silos has been chosen as the destination silo.'
							select @resultcode =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300012, NULL,NULL);
							
							select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = @resultcode
							--select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode
							return ;
						end

					 end 


			if(@saveRecords=1)

			BEGIN
				
			-- fetching the data for audit trail
			  insert into @su_details_audit select * from ofi_su_selection with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2
				
			-- check if the order is running
				 
				
				--if(@job_state_cd<>3) -- when the order is not running, need to check if the order is runnning 
				begin
					delete from ofi_su_selection where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type=2
				end

			
				 select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @destinationgrid
				 --select @max_row_cnt,@row_cnt 

					WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
						BEGIN

					

					select 	
						 @p_jb_item_id				=		jb_item_id		
						,@p_jb_grade_cd				=		jb_grade_cd	
						,@p_jb_item_group			=		jb_item_group	
						,@p_ent_id					=		ent_id					
						,@p_ent_name				=		ent_name				
						,@p_grade					=		grade					
						--,@p_inv_grade_cd			=		,inv_grade_cd			
						,@p_item_desc				=		item_desc				
						,@p_item_group				=		item_group				
						,@p_item_id					=		item_id				
						,@p_oper_id					=		oper_id				
						,@p_seq_no					=		seq_no					
						,@p_storage_ent_id			=		storage_ent_id			
						,@p_wo_id					=		wo_id					
						,@p_silo_seq_no				=		silo_seq_no

				,@a1_jb_item_id				= t1.jb_item_id
				,@a1_jb_grade_cd  			= t1.jb_grade_cd
				,@a1_is_chk 				= t1.is_chk
				,@a1_su_ent_id  			= t1.su_ent_id
				,@new_value3  				= t2.su_ent_id
				,@a1_secondary_silo 		= t1.secondary_silo
				,@a1_ratio 					= t1.ratio
				,@a1_created_by  			= t1.created_by
				--,@a1_active_su_ent_id 		= t1.active_su_ent_id
				--,@a1_silo_seq 				= t1.silo_seq
	from @su_details_audit t1
		FULL OUTER JOIN @su_details_audit1 t2 on t1.wo_id=t2.wo_id and t1.oper_id=t2.oper_id and t1.seq_no=t2.seq_no and t1.jb_item_id=t2.jb_item_id and t1.ent_id=t2.ent_id 
		where t1.wo_id not in (select t2.wo_id
								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )
		and t1.oper_id not in (select t2.oper_id
								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )
		and t1.seq_no not in (select t2.seq_no
								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )
		and t1.jb_item_id not in (select t2.jb_item_id
								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )
		and t1.su_ent_id not in (select t2.su_ent_id
						from @su_details_audit1 t2)
	order by t1.su_ent_id
	OFFSET @k ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY



	Select @strActivityMsg ='Deleted'
	
	set @row_id = @a1_row_id
	set @new_value1= 'Deleted'

	delete @auditTrailParameters
	Select @strCommentMsg ='WO: '+cast(@wo_id as nvarchar(100))+' Oper_id _'+ cast(@oper_id as nvarchar(100))+' seq_no_'+ cast(@seq_no as nvarchar(100))+'_'+' Record removed for row_id: '+CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),ISNULL(@a1_row_id,'-'))+' By: '+@last_edit_by
	set @user_name = @a1_created_by;
	SET @column_name  = 'su_ent_id'
			select @old_value1 = e.ent_name
			from ent e with(nolock)
			where e.ent_id =@a1_su_ent_id
																	

	EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @user_name, @change_type, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, @old_value1, @new_value1, @audit_comments, @delete_detail;
	
		UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
		SET
			 origin = @strFunctionName
		WHERE
			log_id = @log_id;
	
	
	set @keyField1=@wo_id;
	set @keyField2=@oper_id;
	set @keyField3=@seq_no;
	set @keyField4=@a1_jb_item_id

	INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
		(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
		VALUES
		(
			   @log_id, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @strModuleName, @strFunctionName, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @keyField5, @keyField6, @audit_category, @strActivityMsg, @strCommentMsg
			 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE()), @logged_at, @user_name
		);
		 									 
	 SET @k = @k + 1;

 END

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	set @resultset =0; set @resultcode=ERROR_MESSAGE();
	select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode
	END CATCH

END
