CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SE_GetTgtStorLocatnsTree]
(@wo_id        STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id      STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@ent_id       INT32_NULL = NULL
)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_SE_GETTGTSTORLOCATNSTREE
-- Description          -  7.3.3.9  To Location Drop down
--                          To location will contain all storage entities, moveable and not.
--                          If there are selections in the To Work Order or To Operation drop downs,
--                          this list will be limited to the set of entities to which any job conforming
--                          to these selections is scheduled or run, their immediate children,
--                          or any moveable storage entities located at any of these entities.
--                          If the ?From Entity? filter selection is set, then the list will be limited
--                          to only that entity and the moveable storage entities located at it.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/13/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
--05/11/2007    Raghu           3.2.12  HD# 9841, The tree was not returning the correct entities.
--05/29/2007    Raghu           3.2.14  The target entities does not have to have a serialied item in the inventory.
--09/07/2007	AML				3.3.0	Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
--01/24/2008	Raghu	3.4		L00074359; Unhandled exception occurred when clicki...
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN

	DECLARE @tree_level		INT32_NULL
		,	@root_ent_id	INT32_NULL
		,	@current_ent_id INT32_NULL
		,	@i				INT32_NULL
		,	@max_i			INT32_NULL

    DECLARE @tmp_tbl_schedentities TABLE (
		root_ent_id INT,
		ent_id INT,
		ent_name nvarchar(80),
		parent_ent_id INT,
		child_level INT,
		ent_tree varchar(4000)
	)

	DECLARE @tmp_ent_ids TABLE ( t_id int identity, t_ent_id int )

	INSERT INTO @tmp_ent_ids
	SELECT ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	SELECT  @tree_level = 1
		,	@i = 1
		,	@max_i = MAX( t_id )
	FROM @tmp_ent_ids

	WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

		SELECT @root_ent_id = i.t_ent_id, @current_ent_id = i.t_ent_id FROM @tmp_ent_ids i WHERE i.t_id = @i

		INSERT INTO @tmp_tbl_schedentities ( root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level )
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, NULL, @tree_level
		FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @current_ent_id

		SET @tree_level = 2

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @tmp_tbl_schedentities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id, @tree_level, x.ent_tree
			FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT( VARCHAR, ent_id )
					                        ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, ent_id )
                                            END ent_tree
				             FROM @tmp_tbl_schedentities
				             WHERE child_level = @tree_level -1
                               AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id
                            ) x ON x.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  el.parent_ent_id IN (
				SELECT ent_id FROM @tmp_tbl_schedentities WHERE child_level = @tree_level - 1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id
			)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK

			SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1

		END

		SET @i = @i + 1

	END

	DECLARE @temp_storage_ents TABLE ( t_ent_id INT, t_child_level INT )
	DECLARE @level AS INT

	SET @level = 1

	INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
		SELECT se.ent_id, @level
		FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id AND se.movable = 1

	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1
			FROM @temp_storage_ents t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1

		IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

		SET @level = @level + 1
	END

    --Split the recordset retrieval based on the supplied filters - for better performance by avoiding join with multiple tables.
    IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL OR @oper_id IS NOT NULL OR @ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		DECLARE @temp_storage_ents2 TABLE ( t_ent_id int, t_child_level int )
		SET @level = 1

		INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents2
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE se.ent_id IN (
				--If there are selections in the To Work Order or To Operation drop downs,
				--this list will be limited to the set of entities to which any job conforming
				--to these selections is scheduled or run, their immediate children,
				SELECT COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) AS ent_id
				FROM job j
				WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
				UNION
				SELECT el.child_ent_id AS ent_id
				FROM ent_link el
				INNER JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) AS ent_id
						FROM job j
						WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
						  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id) parent_ents ON parent_ents.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
				UNION
				--If the From Entity filter selection is set, then the list will be limited
				--to only that entity and the moveable storage entities located at it.
				SELECT t.t_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ents t
			 )

		WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

			INSERT INTO @temp_storage_ents2
			SELECT se.ent_id, @level + 1 FROM @temp_storage_ents2 t2
				INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON t2.t_ent_id = se.storage_ent_id
			WHERE t2.t_child_level = @level AND se.movable = 1


			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT <= 0 ) BREAK

			SET @level = @level + 1
		END


        SELECT el.root_ent_id, el.ent_id, el.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id,
            e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.child_level, el.ent_tree, COALESCE(selectable_entities.selectable, 0) AS selectable
        FROM @tmp_tbl_schedentities el
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id, 1 AS selectable
            FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
			--or any moveable storage entities located at any of these entities.
				INNER JOIN ( SELECT t_ent_id FROM @temp_storage_ents2 ) filtered_ents ON filtered_ents.t_ent_id = se.ent_id
        ) selectable_entities ON selectable_entities.ent_id = el.ent_id
        ORDER BY el.child_level, e.ent_name, el.ent_name
	END
    ELSE BEGIN
        --Since there are no filters supplied, just return all the entities
        --To location will contain all storage entities, moveable and not.
        SELECT el.root_ent_id, el.ent_id, el.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id,
            e.ent_name parent_ent_name, el.child_level, el.ent_tree, COALESCE(selectable_entities.selectable, 0) AS selectable
        FROM @tmp_tbl_schedentities el
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = el.parent_ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, 1 AS selectable FROM storage_exec) selectable_entities ON selectable_entities.ent_id = el.ent_id
        ORDER BY el.child_level, e.ent_name, el.ent_name;
    END
END

-- Description:	Function that go thru orders in a session and based on the prod cunsome relation

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_SplitAndMoveJob]
(
@I_SessionId int,
@I_User_Name nvarchar(50),
@I_SelEvent nvarchar(50) ,
@I_EQLoaded nvarchar(MAX)=NULL,
@I_CommandParam nvarchar(MAX) = NULL,
@commandreply nvarchar(max) = 'success' output
)
AS
BEGIN

Declare @ent_id int
Declare @attr_id int
Declare @maxBatchSize float
Declare @minBatchSize float
Declare @OrigJobQty float
Declare @jobQty float
Declare @tStr varchar(100)
Declare @wo_id STRING40
Declare @user_name STRING40
Declare @operId STRING40
Declare @priority INT32
Declare @starttime NVARCHAR(50)
Declare @endtime NVARCHAR(50)
Declare @jobSeqNo int
Declare @entId int
Declare @reqQty int--decimal(10,2)
Declare @splitQty INT32
Declare @isSplit int
Declare @isMerge int
Declare @mergeJobSeq int
Declare @QtyRemaining float
Declare @i int
Declare @cSeq_no int
Declare @cQty float
Declare @seqNo int
Declare @cEntID int
Declare @tEntID int
Declare @row_id int
Declare @HaveChilds int=0
Declare @ChildCount int=0
Declare @ChildNum int=0
Declare @lastJobEndTime datetime
Declare @jobs table(seq_no int, qty float,ent_id int)
Declare @jobState int
Declare @resequenceEnts nvarchar(max)
	--commented 03.01.2018
	--select @ent_id=job_sched_entity_id,@OrigJobQty=req_qty from SDB..scheduler_exec where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
	--added 03.01.2018
	select @ent_id=job_sched_entity_id,@OrigJobQty=req_qty, @wo_id=wo_id,@operid=oper_id,@priority=job_priority,@starttime=job_latest_start_time,@endtime=job_req_finished_time,@jobseqno=job_seq_no,@reqqty=req_qty, @entid=job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
	select @jobState = state_cd from job where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @operId and seq_no = @jobSeqNo
	
	if (@jobState in (1,2,5) or @jobstate is null)
	begin
					select @ent_id=IsNULL(@ent_id,-1)
	
					select @tStr=cast(@ent_id as varchar(50))  + ':' + cast(@OrigJobQty as varchar(50))
	
	
	
					select @attr_id=attr_id from attr  with (nolock) where attr_grp=2 and attr_desc='MinBatchSize'
					select @attr_id=IsNULL(@attr_id,-1)
					select @minBatchSize=attr_value from ent_attr  with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id and attr_id=@attr_id
					select @minBatchSize=isnull(@minBatchSize,-1)
					select @tStr=@tStr + ':'+ cast(@minBatchSize as varchar(50))

					select @attr_id=attr_id from attr  with (nolock) where attr_grp=2 and attr_desc='MaxBatchSize'
					select @attr_id=IsNULL(@attr_id,-1)
					select @maxBatchSize=attr_value from ent_attr  with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id and attr_id=@attr_id
					select @maxBatchSize=isnull(@maxBatchSize,-1)
					select @tStr=@tStr + ':'+ cast(@maxBatchSize as varchar(50))
	
					--exec SP_I_MDM_Sched_addLog	@type='Ititial data' ,@sp_name='SP_S_MDM_Sched_SplitJob',	@SessionId=@I_SessionId ,	@text1 =@I_SelEvent,	@text2 = @I_EQLoaded,@text3=@tStr

					Set @i=1
					Set @QtyRemaining=@OrigJobQty

					-- Check whether the Split By Number value is passed in the command param
					IF ISNUMERIC(@I_CommandParam) = 1 
					BEGIN
					SET @maxBatchSize = cast(CEILING(cast(@OrigJobQty as float)/cast(@I_CommandParam as int)) as int)
					END
					Declare @Childs table (ent_id int, num int IDENTITY(1,1))
					-- Find if the entity hav childs
					if exists(select * from ent where parent_ent_id=@ent_id)
					BEGIN
					set @HaveChilds=1
					insert into @Childs
					select ent_id from ent  with (nolock) where parent_ent_id=@ent_id order by description

					select @ChildCount=count(ent_id) from ent  with (nolock) where parent_ent_id=@ent_id
					END




					if( @maxBatchSize > 0)
					BEGIN
						WHILE @QtyRemaining > @maxBatchSize
						BEGIN
							if(@HaveChilds=1)
							BEGIN
				
								select @ChildNum=CASE WHEN @i%@ChildCount=0 THEN  @ChildCount ELSE @i%@ChildCount END 
								select @cEntID=ent_id from @Childs where num=@ChildNum
								insert into @jobs values(@i,@maxBatchSize,@cEntID)
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								insert into @jobs values(@i,@maxBatchSize,@ent_id)
							END
							Set @i=@i+1
							Set @QtyRemaining=@QtyRemaining-@maxBatchSize
						END;
						if(@HaveChilds=1)
						BEGIN
							select @ChildNum=CASE WHEN @i%@ChildCount=0 THEN  @ChildCount ELSE @i%@ChildCount END 
							select @cEntID=ent_id from @Childs where num=@ChildNum
							insert into @jobs values(@i,@QtyRemaining,@cEntID)
							select @cEntID=ent_id from @jobs where seq_no=1
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							insert into @jobs values(@i,@QtyRemaining,@ent_id)
						END
						delete @jobs where seq_no=1
		
		
	
						DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR  
							SELECT  seq_no,qty,ent_id
								FROM @jobs
									order by seq_no desc
						select @tStr=''--cast(@ent_id as varchar(50))  + ':' +
						OPEN db_cursor   
						FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @cSeq_no,@cQty,@tEntID

						WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
						BEGIN   
							select @tStr=@tStr+' '+cast(@cSeq_no as varchar(50))  + ':' +cast(@cQty as varchar(50))
							select @wo_id=wo_id,@operid=oper_id,@priority=job_priority,@starttime=job_latest_start_time,@endtime=job_req_finished_time,@jobseqno=job_seq_no,@reqqty=req_qty, @entid=job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec with (nolock)  where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
							Set @reqqty=@reqqty-@cQty
							--23-Feb Commented @seqno, its no longer output param in update sp - ajay
							
							print concat('split..',CONVERT(varchar, getdate(), 121))
							
							exec @seqNo = SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=@operid,@priority=@priority,@starttime=@starttime,@endtime=@endtime,@jobseqno=@jobseqno,@entid=@entid,@reqqty=@reqqty ,@splitqty=@cQty,@issplit=1,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0,@sessionid=@I_SessionId,@returnData = 0 --, @seqNo = @seqNo output
							
							
							

							if(@HaveChilds=1)
							BEGIN
							-- find last job finished time on target eq and use that to calc start time of moved job
							select @lastJobEndTime= max(job_req_finished_time) from sdb..scheduler_exec with (nolock)  where job_sched_entity_id=@tEntID and session_id=@I_SessionId

							-- update sched job with new target ent and new start time
							select @row_id=row_id,@wo_id=wo_id,@operid=oper_id,@priority=job_priority,@starttime=job_latest_start_time,@endtime=job_req_finished_time,@jobseqno=job_seq_no,@reqqty=req_qty, @entid=job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec with (nolock)  where session_id=@I_SessionId and  wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@operid and job_seq_no=@seqNo
							set @lastJobEndTime=isnull(@lastJobEndTime,@starttime)
							--23-Feb Commented @seqno, its no longer output param in update sp - ajay
							print concat('move..',CONVERT(varchar, getdate(), 121))
							SET @resequenceEnts = concat(@resequenceEnts, ',', @tEntID)
							exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=@operid,@priority=@priority,@starttime=@lastJobEndTime,@endtime=@endtime,@jobseqno=@jobseqno,@entid=@tEntID,@reqqty=@reqqty ,@splitqty=0,@issplit=0,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0,@rowid=@row_id, @sessionid=@I_SessionId,@returnData = 0 --, @seqNo = @seqNo output
							
							END
					   FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @cSeq_no,@cQty,@tEntID  
					END   
					if(@HaveChilds=1)
							BEGIN
							-- find last job finished time on target eq and use that to calc start time of moved job
							select @lastJobEndTime= max(job_req_finished_time) from sdb..scheduler_exec  with (nolock) where job_sched_entity_id=@cEntID and session_id=@I_SessionId
			
							-- update sched job with new target ent and new start time
							select @wo_id=wo_id,@operid=oper_id,@priority=job_priority,@starttime=job_latest_start_time,@endtime=job_req_finished_time,@jobseqno=job_seq_no,@reqqty=req_qty, @entid=job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec  with (nolock) where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
							set @lastJobEndTime=isnull(@lastJobEndTime,@starttime)
							set @row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
							--23-Feb Commented @seqno, its no longer output param in update sp - ajay
							print concat('last..',CONVERT(varchar, getdate(), 121))
							exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=@operid,@priority=@priority,@starttime=@lastJobEndTime,@endtime=@endtime,@jobseqno=@jobseqno,@entid=@cEntID,@reqqty=@reqqty ,@splitqty=0,@issplit=0,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0,@rowid=@row_id, @sessionid=@I_SessionId,@returnData = 1, @resequenceEnts = @resequenceEnts --, @seqNo = @seqNo output
							END
					CLOSE db_cursor   
					DEALLOCATE db_cursor 
		

					--exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=N'30000065',@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=N'Cooking',@priority=50,@starttime=N'2017-03-15 12:57:00',@endtime=N'2017-03-15 17:00:00',@jobseqno=0,@entid=50,@reqqty=4667,@splitqty=1333,@issplit=1,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0
	
					END

					--exec SP_I_MDM_Sched_addLog	@type='split list' ,@sp_name='SP_S_MDM_Sched_SplitJob',	@SessionId=@I_SessionId ,	@text1 =@I_SelEvent,	@text2 = @tStr,@text3=''


				-- select * from SDB..scheduler_sessn where session_id=@I_SessionId

				SET @commandreply = 'success'
			END
			ELSE
			SET @commandreply = 'jobstateerror'
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
-- Description: This is used to prepare the RM/SFG/FG materials report based on WIP consumptions
-- Note : Only NIBs has been tested
--			Liquor Loadout testing now
--
-- Runs before: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsToReport; 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC            	2024-07-25			Initial Version
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2025-02-06			Removed the filter for the ONLY NIBS
-- 0.01.02	JSC				2025-02-10			Fixed wrong link for INTERMEDIATE wip reports
-- 0.01.03	JSC				2025-02-10			Added the STRING_AGG function to avoid duplicates in ofi table
-- 0.01.04	JSC				2025-02-12			Added fix to prevent miss reporting WIP composition if another is still pending
-- 0.01.05	JSC				2025-02-13			Added fix to allow reblend in reblended liquors
-- 0.01.06  JSC				2025-06-30			Added fix to STRING_AGG to limit it to max size of column in target 80 chars
-- 0.01.07	JSC				2025-07-02			Added default output when info is empty
-- 0.01.08	JSC				2025-07-02			Added check for SkipConsumptionReporting in TO BE reported RM or SFG
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- SP NAME: sp_S_ofi_EI_GetWIPsConsumptionsPrepwork
	-- Declare general variables 
	DECLARE     
		 @internal_precision  	INT   = 7     -- Used for rounding of values to use in internal calculations
		,@reporting_precision 	INT   = 3     -- Used for rounding of values to use in reporting output
		,@to_report_perc      	FLOAT = 1  	-- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_cons	  	FLOAT = 1   -- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_cons_erp  	FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
		,@to_reduce_total_cons	FLOAT = 1	-- Used for internal test
		,@error_msg           	NVARCHAR(MAX) -- Error handling
		,@error_severity      	INT           -- Error handling
		,@error_state         	INT           -- Error handling
		,@debug            		BIT   = 0 -- Used for internal DEBUG -- SET to zero before deployment
		,@pending_cons  		FLOAT = 0 -- UPDATED to FLOAT
	
	
	-- Declare variables for STEP 1
	DECLARE @row_id				INT = -1
		,@ent_id				INT
		,@item_grp				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cons_lot				NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cons_sublot			NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty	FLOAT
		,@cur_wo_id          	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_cons_qty 			FLOAT
		,@parent_ent_id			INT
		,@sublotcounter_attr_id INT
		,@cur_ent_sublot_no 	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@cur_created_at		DATETIME

		
	-- STEP 1: Get TOP 1 oldest WIP/INTERMEDIATE Consumption record with quantity left to be reported
	-- Verify current sublot number running on the WIP production line
	SELECT TOP 1 
		 @row_id        		= ic.row_id
		,@ent_id            	= ic.from_ent_id
		,@item_grp          	= ia.attr_value
		,@cons_lot          	= ic.lot_no
		,@cons_sublot       	= ic.sublot_no
		,@cur_cons_qty 			= qty_cons
		,@cur_pending_cons_qty 		= qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0)
		,@cur_wo_id 			= ic.wo_id
		,@cur_created_at		= ic.created_at_utc
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
											AND ia.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = ic.wo_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.process_id = w.process_id 
												AND oa.oper_id = ic.oper_id
												AND oa.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'NotConsumeToSAP'
																	AND attr_grp = 7
															)																
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ie.item_id
												AND ic.wo_id = ie.wo_id
	CROSS APPLY
		[dbo].[fn_S_ofi_ValidateWIPReportSublot] (ic.lot_no, ic.sublot_no) AS vs 
	WHERE qty_cons_erp < qty_cons
		-- Retreive only consumption records older than 20 minutes
		AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,COALESCE(ic.last_edit_at,ic.created_at_utc),GETUTCDATE())>=20  
		-- INTERMEDIATE material class consumptions
		AND i.item_class_id IN ('WIP','INTERMEDIATE')
		-- Get only NIBs -- or Liquor (TO BE CHECKED)
		--AND ( ia.attr_value LIKE '%NIBS')   -- v1.01 REMOVED!
			 --OR ia.attr_VALUE  LIKE '%liquor')
		-- Prevent items to be reported when SkipConsumptionReporting is set
		AND ( ISNULL(ia2.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
		-- Prevent BACKFLUSH to be reported to SAP
		AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1
		-- Only consumptions with source entity are allowed
		AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
		-- Prevent reporting from Operations configured with NotConsumeToSAP
		AND ( ISNULL(oa.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
		-- Validate that sublot_no is not the current sublot being produced and if it was, wait at least 20 minutes
		AND ( 
				( 
					vs.prod_sublot_no <> ic.sublot_no 				 
					OR
					( vs.prod_sublot_no = ic.sublot_no
						AND vs.prod_job_state_cd <> 3  -- 3 means RUNNING
					)
				)
				AND vs.cons_sublot = ic.sublot_no
				AND vs.cons_lot = ic.lot_no
				AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE,COALESCE(vs.prod_last_edit_at,GETUTCDATE()-100),GETUTCDATE())>=20  
			)
		-- Prevent 'non-traceable' consumptions to lock the reporting
		AND ic.wo_id IS NOT NULL 
	ORDER BY ic.last_edit_at ASC

	-- STEP 1.1: Exit if we haven't found any value in the initial query
	IF (@row_id IS NULL OR @row_id = -1)
	BEGIN		
		-- v0.01.07
		SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no

		RETURN;
	END
	
	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 @row_id AS 'row_id'
				,@ent_id AS '@ent_id'
				,@item_grp AS '@item_grp'
				,@cons_lot AS '@cons_lot'
				,@cons_sublot AS '@cons_sublot'
				,@cur_cons_qty AS '@cur_cons_qty'
				,@cur_pending_cons_qty AS '@cur_pending_cons_qty'
				,@cur_wo_id AS '@cur_wo_id'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Declare variables for STEP 2
	DECLARE @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
		
	-- Declare variables for STEP 3
	DECLARE  @total_wip_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT

	-- Declare variables for STEP 4
	DECLARE @final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	-- Declare variables for STEP 5
	DECLARE  @cur_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			
	-- STEPs 2 - 5: Added into a Function:
	SELECT   @total_wip_sublot_cons_qty = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
			,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
			,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp
			,@wip_cons_qty_ratio = wip_cons_qty_ratio
			,@final_cons_declaration = final_cons_declaration
			,@cur_rm_cons_to_report = cur_rm_cons_to_report
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty
			,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
	FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (@cons_lot,@cons_sublot,@cur_pending_cons_qty)


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 2'
				,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty AS '@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty'
				,@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp AS '@total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp'

	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 3'
				,@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty AS '@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty'
				,@wip_cons_qty_ratio AS '@wip_cons_qty_ratio'

	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --


	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 4'
				,@final_cons_declaration AS '@final_cons_declaration'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 5'
				,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty AS '@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty'
				,@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp AS '@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp'
				,@cur_rm_cons_to_report AS '@cur_rm_cons_to_report'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --


	-- Declare variables for STEP 6
	DECLARE @cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio FLOAT

	-- STEP 6: Calculate the ratio of RM/SFG/FG to be reported on current row versus the total consumed for the sublot
	SET @cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio = @cur_rm_cons_to_report/@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT	 'STEP 6'
				,@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio AS '@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio'
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Declare variables for STEP 7
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows AS TABLE ( 	 qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 
										,spare3 NVARCHAR(80) 
										,intermediate INT
										,intermediate_processed INT
										,created_at_local DATETIME 
										,fg_lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,intermediate_row_id INT
										,SkipConsumptionReporting INT
									--	,PRIMARY KEY (row_id)
									)



	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows

	-- STEP 7: Get all rows from RM/SFG/FG related to the cur sublot to be reported on
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows
	SELECT 	ic.qty_cons
			,ic.qty_cons_erp
			,ic.lot_no
			,ic.sublot_no
			,ic.row_id
			,ic.spare1
			,ic.spare3
			,CASE 
				WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
					THEN 1
				ELSE 0
				END 
			,0
			,ic.created_at_local
			,ic.fg_lot_no
			,ic.fg_sublot_no
			,0
			,ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,ia2.attr_value),0) -- ADDED: v1.08
	FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id   --- ADDED: v1.08
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
	WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cons_lot 
		AND ic.fg_sublot_no=@cons_sublot
		AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
	--	AND CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)=0  --  v1.04: Removed so we can findout if something is pending

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 'STEP 7',*,qty_cons_erp/qty_cons as 'ratio' FROM @rm_cons_rows ORDER BY row_id asc
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END  --

	-- Added v1.04: Verify if there is any pending consumption to be reported and abort this one.
	-- Calculate the amount of pending consumption quantity
	SELECT @pending_cons = ISNULL(SUM(CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)),0.0)
	FROM @rm_cons_rows ic
	WHERE ic.SkipConsumptionReporting = 0
		AND ic.[intermediate] = 0

	-- STEP 7.1: Verify if we have any pending consumptions quantity the expected materials, and skip this round if so.
	-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
	IF (@debug = 0 AND @pending_cons > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
		SET [last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work: SKIP (Consumptions PENDING)'
		,[last_edit_at]=DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, [last_edit_at])
		WHERE [row_id] = @row_id
		
		-- exit SP
		RETURN;
	END

	-- STEP 8: Calculate for each consumption row of RM/SFG/FG that belongs to the sublot the spare1 (qty to report)
	UPDATE @rm_cons_rows 
	SET spare1 = CASE 
					WHEN (@final_cons_declaration = 1)
						THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
					WHEN (@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
					ELSE ROUND(((@cur_rm_cons_to_report_ratio)*qty_cons),@reporting_precision,2)
				 END
				 

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 'STEP 8',*,spare1/qty_cons as 'ratio',(spare1+qty_cons_erp)/qty_cons as 'ratio' FROM @rm_cons_rows ORDER BY row_id asc
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END--

	-- Declare variables for STEP 9
	DECLARE  @total_processed_intermediate INT = 0
			,@total_intermediate INT = 0

	DECLARE @cur_wip_row_id      		INT
			,@cur_wip_cons_lot_no       NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_fg_lot_no 	    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_fg_sublot_no	    NVARCHAR(40)
			,@cur_wip_cons_spare1		NVARCHAR(80)
			,@total_step_cons_qty		FLOAT
			,@total_step_cons_qty_erp 	FLOAT
			,@intermediate_row_id 		INT -- v1.05: Added to follow up sources
			
	-- Declare variables for STEP 9.4
	DECLARE  @total_step_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@total_step_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			
	DECLARE  @total_step_sublot_prod_qty FLOAT
			,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty_erp FLOAT
			,@step_cons_qty_ratio FLOAT
			
	DECLARE  @step_final_cons_declaration BIT = 0

	DECLARE  @step_rm_cons_to_report FLOAT = 0.0
			,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty FLOAT
			,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp FLOAT
			



	-- STEP 9: While WIPs are found in the table from [6] and not rechecked completely; we should search upstream for RM/SFG/FG,
	--	    add any found consumptions in the table variable and mark the WIP as 'processed'.

	-- STEP 9.1:  Get the total intermedia WIP to be checked (WIP consumed to produce WIP)
	SELECT 	 @total_processed_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate_processed,0))									
			,@total_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate,0))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 1

	-- 9.1.1 prepare verification of pending reports
	SET @pending_cons = 0

	-- STEP 9.2: Start the WHILE loop 
	WHILE @total_intermediate > @total_processed_intermediate
	BEGIN
		
		-- STEP 9.3:  Get one WIP consumption from those to be reported and go upstream
		SELECT TOP 1
			 @cur_wip_row_id      		= rc.row_id
			,@cur_wip_cons_lot_no       = rc.lot_no
			,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no    = rc.sublot_no
			,@cur_wip_fg_lot_no 	    = rc.fg_lot_no
			,@cur_wip_fg_sublot_no	    = rc.fg_sublot_no
			,@cur_wip_cons_spare1		= rc.spare1
			,@intermediate_row_id		= rc.intermediate_row_id  -- v1.05: Added
		FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
		WHERE rc.intermediate = 1 and rc.intermediate_processed = 0
		
		-- STEP 9.4: Calculate ratio of reporting WIP consumption of the step
		SELECT   @total_step_sublot_cons_qty = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty 
				,@total_step_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_cons_qty_erp
				,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty
				,@total_step_sublot_prod_qty_erp = total_wip_sublot_prod_qty_erp
				,@step_cons_qty_ratio = wip_cons_qty_ratio
				,@step_final_cons_declaration = final_cons_declaration
				,@step_rm_cons_to_report = cur_rm_cons_to_report
				,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty
				,@step_total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp = total_rm_sublot_cons_qty_erp  
		FROM [fn_S_ofi_GetConsumptionRatios] (@cur_wip_cons_lot_no,@cur_wip_cons_sublot_no,@cur_wip_cons_spare1)
			

		-- STEP 9.5: Insert the new consumptions from WIP
		INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows
		SELECT 	ic.qty_cons
				,ic.qty_cons_erp
				,ic.lot_no
				,ic.sublot_no
				,ic.row_id
				,CASE 
						WHEN (@step_final_cons_declaration = 1)
							THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						WHEN (@step_cons_qty_ratio*qty_cons) > (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
							THEN (qty_cons-qty_cons_erp) 
						ELSE ROUND(((@step_cons_qty_ratio)*qty_cons),@reporting_precision,2)
					 END
				,ic.spare3
				,CASE 
					WHEN i.item_class_id IN ('INTERMEDIATE','WIP')
						THEN 1
					ELSE 0
					END 
				,0
				,ic.created_at_local
				,ic.fg_lot_no
				,ic.fg_sublot_no
				,CASE											-- v1.05: Modified to include parent
						WHEN (@intermediate_row_id = 0)
							THEN @cur_wip_row_id         --from WIP
						ELSE
							@intermediate_row_id		-- from PARENT WIP
					END
				,ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT,ia2.attr_value),0) -- ADDED: v1.08
		FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = ic.item_id   --- ADDED: v1.08
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no 
			AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
			AND CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)=0 
		
		-- STEP 9.6: Verify that we don't have any pending consumptions for this set:
		-- Calculate the amount of pending consumption quantity
		SELECT @pending_cons = @pending_cons + ISNULL(SUM(CAST (ISNULL(ic.spare1,'0') AS float)),0.0)
		FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = ic.item_id   --- ADDED: v1.08
											AND ia2.attr_id = ( 	SELECT attr_id 
																FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																WHERE attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting'
																	AND attr_grp = 1
															)
		WHERE ic.fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no 
			AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp 
			-- Prevent items to be reported when SkipConsumptionReporting is set   -- ADDED v1.08
			AND ( ISNULL(ia2.attr_value,'0') LIKE '%0%')
	
		
		-- STEP 9.7:  Update the current row as processed
		UPDATE @rm_cons_rows
		SET intermediate_processed = 1
		WHERE intermediate = 1
			AND lot_no = @cur_wip_cons_lot_no
			AND sublot_no = @cur_wip_cons_sublot_no
			AND fg_lot_no = @cur_wip_fg_lot_no
			AND fg_sublot_no = @cur_wip_fg_sublot_no -- v.1.02 FIXED was pointing to cons sublot
			AND row_id = @cur_wip_row_id
			AND spare1 = @cur_wip_cons_spare1 -- v1.05 Added to prevent marking duplicates as processed

		-- STEP 9.8: Set the current values for this loop
		SELECT   @total_processed_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate_processed,0))									
				,@total_intermediate = SUM(ISNULL(rc.intermediate,0))
		FROM @rm_cons_rows rc 
		WHERE rc.intermediate = 1
	END

	-- Added v1.04: Verify if there is any pending consumption to be reported and abort this one.
	-- STEP 9.8: Verify if we have any pending consumptions quantity the expected materials, and skip this round if so.
	-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
	IF (@debug = 0 AND @pending_cons > 0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
		SET [last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work: SKIP (WIP Consumptions PENDING)'
		,[last_edit_at]=DATEADD(MINUTE, 2, [last_edit_at])
		WHERE [row_id] = @row_id
		
		-- exit SP
		RETURN;
	END


	-- Declare variables for STEP 10
	DECLARE  @rm_total_spare1 FLOAT
			,@wip_total_reported_ratio FLOAT
			,@wip_total_reported FLOAT

	-- STEP 10: Calculate actuals to be reported from spare1 in table variable
	SELECT @rm_total_spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) 
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0

	SET @wip_total_reported_ratio = @rm_total_spare1/@total_rm_sublot_cons_qty

	SET @wip_total_reported = @wip_total_reported_ratio*@total_wip_sublot_prod_qty

	-- Aggregate any repeating row_ids
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows_to_report AS TABLE (								
										qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 								
									)

	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report

	
	-- Insert aggregated
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows_to_report
	SELECT   rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
			,spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0
		AND rc.SkipConsumptionReporting = 0 -- ADDED: v0.01.08
	GROUP BY  rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
	HAVING SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) <> 0.000

	-- ADDED v1.08
	
	-- Aggregate any repeating row_ids
	DECLARE @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report AS TABLE (								
										qty_cons FLOAT 
										,qty_cons_erp FLOAT 
										,lot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) 
										,row_id INT 
										,spare1 NVARCHAR(80) 								
									)

	--Clear the variable in case of multiple batches ran parallel 
	DELETE FROM @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report

	-- Insert aggregated
	INSERT INTO @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report
	SELECT   rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
			,spare1 = SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT))
	FROM @rm_cons_rows rc
	WHERE rc.intermediate = 0
		AND rc.SkipConsumptionReporting = 1 
	GROUP BY  rc.qty_cons
			,rc.qty_cons_erp
			,rc.lot_no
			,rc.sublot_no
			,rc.row_id
	HAVING SUM(CAST (ISNULL(rc.spare1,'0') AS FLOAT)) <> 0.000

	---- DEBUG -- START--
	IF (@debug = 1) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 	 @rm_total_spare1 AS '@rm_total_spare1'
				,@wip_total_reported_ratio AS '@wip_total_reported_ratio'
				,@wip_total_reported as '@wip_total_reported'
				
		SELECT * FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report

		SELECT * FROM @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report
	END
	---- DEBUG -- END--
		
	BEGIN TRY
	
		-- STEP 10.1: Start Transaction:
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;


		-- STEP 11: Add values to staging table, including the wo_id variable
		INSERT INTO ofi_ei_item_cons_wip_reported
		SELECT 	 rcr1.row_id
				,rcr1.lot_no
				,rc.fg_lot_no
				,rcr1.sublot_no
				,rc.fg_sublot_no
				,rcr1.qty_cons
				,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
				,rcr1.spare1
				,rc.spare3
				,'INSERTED for EI Report of WIPs'						
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,GETUTCDATE()
				,RIGHT(STRING_AGG(rc.intermediate_row_id,','),80)
				,@row_id
				,@cur_wo_id
				,@cur_created_at
				,NULL
		FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report rcr1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @rm_cons_rows rc ON rcr1.row_id = rc.row_id
		GROUP BY  	 rcr1.row_id
					,rcr1.lot_no
					,rc.fg_lot_no
					,rcr1.sublot_no
					,rc.fg_sublot_no
					,rcr1.qty_cons
					,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
					,rcr1.spare1
					,rc.spare3
		
		-- v 0.01.07 Get default output if no row is found:
		DECLARE @output_rows INT


		-- STEP 11.1: Select as OUTPUT
		SELECT DISTINCT	 rcr1.qty_cons
				,rcr1.qty_cons_erp
				,rcr1.lot_no
				,rcr1.sublot_no
				,rcr1.row_id
				,rcr1.spare1
				,rc.spare3
				,rc.created_at_local
				,rc.fg_lot_no
				,rc.fg_sublot_no
		FROM @rm_cons_rows_to_report rcr1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @rm_cons_rows rc ON rcr1.row_id = rc.row_id

		SET @output_rows = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF @output_rows <= 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 0 NULL as qty_cons_rm
				,NULL as qty_cons_erp
				,NULL as lot_no
				,NULL as sublot_no
				,NULL as row_id
				,NULL as spare1
				,NULL as spare3
				,NULL as created_at_local
				,NULL as fg_lot_no
				,NULL as fg_sublot_no
		END

		-- STEP 12: Update the item_cons table spare1 based on the values from [11] table variable
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ic
			SET ic.spare1 = rc.spare1
				,ic.last_edit_comment = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work'
			FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @rm_cons_rows_to_report rc ON ic.row_id = rc.row_id			
		END

		-- ADDED v1.08
		-- STEP 12.1 Update item_cons for those 'skipconsumptionreport' rows
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ic
			SET  ic.[qty_cons_erp] = ic.[qty_cons_erp] + rc.spare1
				,ic.spare1 = NULL
				,ic.last_edit_comment = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work + Skipped by attribute'
			FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN @rm_cons_rows_SKIP_report rc ON ic.row_id = rc.row_id			
		END

		-- STEP 13: Update the item_cons table on WIPs reported erp column value with the 'theoretical' value
		-- Verify we are not in DEBUG MODE
		IF (@debug = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[item_cons]
			SET [qty_cons_erp] = [qty_cons_erp] + @cur_pending_cons_qty 
				,[last_edit_comment] = 'Update for WIP Report: Prep Work'
			WHERE [row_id] = @row_id

		END
	
		-- STEP 13.1: Commit transaction.
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		
	END TRY
	
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		
		SELECT 	 @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE()
				,@error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
				,@error_state = ERROR_STATE();
				
		RAISERROR(   @error_msg
					,@error_severity
					,@error_state
				)
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_GetItemRunOnLine]
(@in_line_id				INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Line_GetItemRunOnLine
-- Description      - Get the items that were produced on a line during a period of time
-- Author           - KRF
-- Date Created     - 10/27/2014
-- Version          - 5.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 11/24/2014       Raghu          5.1    Excluded by products from the top level CTE and round the quantities to the number of decimals configured for items
-- 12/18/2014       KRF            5.1    Return the line name instead of its ID if there are no entities in it
--  1/08/2015       KRF            5.1    Remove rounding (User story 424210 Task 434435)
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
-- 11/30/2017	Raghu G		6.0	UserStory-714529 - [Enhancement] As SE, I want to fix CR L00138956 so that OEE values are returned for short time periods without distinct production records
-- 10/26/2018	Varun		6.0	UserStory: 1022902 - As Joe, I want the Entity Monitor and Line Monitor pages in the
--													 Web Portal (2014 R3) to include a reporting period for current week and
--													 last week so that I can see more data
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err_msg             NVARCHAR(4000)
	   ,@event_start_time    TDATETIME  -- UTC time
	   ,@event_end_time	     TDATETIME
	   ,@attr_value			 STRING80
	   ,@line_parent_ent_id  INT
	   ,@prod_pos            INT
	   ,@max_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
   	   ,@max_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@min_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	   ,@min_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@cur_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	   ,@cur_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@num_recs            INT
	   ,@root_ent_id         INT
	   ,@site_ent_id         INT
	   ,@current_time_utc    TDATETIME
	   ,@line_name           NVARCHAR(80)

	   ,@distinct_good_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	   ,@distinct_reject_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	   ,@prod_start_time_utc	TDATETIME2

--DECLARE @ent_shift			TABLE (ent_id INT, shift_start_utc DATETIME, shift_end_utc DATETIME)
DECLARE @ents_in_line        TABLE (ent_id INT)
DECLARE @prod_ents           TABLE (ent_id INT)
DECLARE @reject_ents         TABLE (ent_id INT)

BEGIN
	-- Check for bad input arguments
	IF (@in_line_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},LINE_ID'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	-- Last N hours is limited to no more than 168
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 0 AND @in_filter_end_time = 0 AND (@in_filter_start_time > 168 OR @in_filter_start_time < 1)) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_START_TIME,1,168'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@in_filter_time_unit < 0 OR @in_filter_time_unit > 5) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = N'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_TIME_UNIT,0,5'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
    IF (@in_filter_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 may not be empty{5413},FILTER_START_TIME'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
    ELSE IF (@in_filter_start_time < COALESCE(@in_filter_end_time, 0)) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 must be greater than %2.{2030},FILTER_START_TIME,FILTER_END_TIME'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END
	SELECT @num_recs = COUNT(*) FROM line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
	IF (@num_recs = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The specified line does not exist{7929}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END
	INSERT INTO @ents_in_line SELECT ent_id from line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 0
	SELECT @num_recs = COUNT(*) FROM @ents_in_line
	IF (@num_recs = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_name = line_name FROM line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
		SET @err_msg = N'There are no entities in the supplied line: %1.{7890},' + @line_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	-- Check that if querying about a shift and the line has no parent entity with a shift schedule that all the line's members have the same
	-- shift schedule, for either the current shift or the previous shift, whichever is being queried for
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_parent_ent_id = ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 1
		IF @line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
			       @cur_shift_end_utc = cur_shift_end_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id
		-- If current shift ended before now, parent entity used to have a shift schedule but doesn't anymore
		IF @cur_shift_start_utc IS NULL OR @cur_shift_end_utc <= GETUTCDATE() BEGIN
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1 -- Current shift
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc),
				@min_shift_start_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc),
				@max_shift_end_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc),
				@min_shift_end_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
				FROM @ents_in_line eil
				JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON eil.ent_id = e.ent_id
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_start_utc),
				@min_shift_start_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_start_utc),
				@max_shift_end_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_end_utc),
				@min_shift_end_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
				FROM @ents_in_line eil
				JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON eil.ent_id = e.ent_id
				JOIN shift_history sh_prev WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = sh_prev.ent_id AND dateadd(ss,-1,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc) = sh_prev.shift_end_utc
			IF (@max_shift_start_utc<>@min_shift_start_utc OR @max_shift_end_utc<>@min_shift_end_utc) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Entities in line have differing shift schedules - querying by shift is not possible.{2031}'
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN -- There is a parent entity for the line with a legitimate shift schedule
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = @cur_shift_start_utc,	@max_shift_end_utc = @cur_shift_end_utc
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @max_shift_end_utc = shift_end_utc
				FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id AND dateadd(ss,-1,@cur_shift_start_utc) = shift_end_utc
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Filter using time periods, and NOT by using shift.
		SELECT @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 0) -- Hour
			SELECT @event_start_time = DATEADD(hh, -@in_filter_start_time, @current_time_utc)
				,@event_end_time = DATEADD(hh, -@in_filter_end_time, @current_time_utc)
		ELSE BEGIN
			-- Boundaries will be determined starting with local times, so we must get the site entity if one exists
			IF (@line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT @root_ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id
			ELSE SELECT @root_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
			SELECT @site_ent_id = site FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @root_ent_id
			IF @site_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
				;WITH ParentEnts(parent_id, child_id) AS
				(
					SELECT parent_ent_id, child_ent_id
					FROM ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE child_ent_id = @root_ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT el.parent_ent_id, el.child_ent_id
					FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
					JOIN ParentEnts pe
					ON el.child_ent_id = pe.parent_id
				)
				select @site_ent_id = MAX(parent_id) FROM  ParentEnts pe JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON pe.parent_id = e.ent_id WHERE e.site = e.ent_id
			END
			IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 2) -- Day
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(dd, -@in_filter_start_time+1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(dd, -@in_filter_end_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 3) -- Week
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(wk, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1-DATEPART(dw, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(D, 6, DATEADD(wk, -@in_filter_end_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1-DATEPART(dw, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)))), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 4) -- Month
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(7), DATEADD(mm, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(d, -1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(7), DATEADD(mm, -@in_filter_end_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01 00:00:00', 120)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 5) -- Year
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEADD(yy, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01-01 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(d, -1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEADD(yy, -@in_filter_end_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01-01 00:00:00', 120)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
		END
		--IF (@event_end_time > @current_time_utc) SET @event_end_time = @current_time_utc
	END

	--Get the distinct good production flag
	SELECT @distinct_good_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 362

	--Get the distinct reject production flag
	SELECT @distinct_reject_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 309

	--The time filter is hour (i.e. filter time unit is 0)
	--If the distinct good production and distinct reject projection are not true, reset the starting time to the top of the hour
	--since the production quantities are rolled up to the top of the hour.
	IF @in_filter_time_unit = 0 AND NOT (@distinct_good_prod = '1' AND @distinct_reject_prod = '1')
		SET @prod_start_time_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_start_time),0)

	--Default to the calculated start time if production start time cannot be identified from above
	SET @event_start_time = COALESCE(@prod_start_time_utc, @event_start_time)

	-- Figure out how to display items
    SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 210
	IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

	-- Return work order ID, the item ID, this item's description, the item display per system attribute 210,
	-- the name of the "native" UOM of this item, the abbreviation of the "native" UOM of this item ,
	-- the number of decimal places for the item, the starting quantity, the required quantity,
	-- the remaining quantity (which is the difference between the starting quantity and the total production, good and rejected),
	-- the good quantity produced during the selected period, the total good quantity produced for this work order,
	-- the rejected quantity produced during the selected period, the total rejected quantity produced for this work order,
	-- the work order's current status code, the work order's current status code name,  and the work order's current status color.

	-- Get production entities for the sake of returning production numbers
	-- Get production entities and those upstream from them for the sake of returning reject numbers

	SELECT DISTINCT @prod_pos = lel.child_order
    FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
	AND ((l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id) OR
	    (l.prod_ent_id IS NULL AND lel.ent_id = (SELECT MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND
	    child_order = (SELECT MAX(child_order) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND line_is_child = 0))))
	WHERE l.line_id = @in_line_id

	INSERT INTO @prod_ents SELECT ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND child_order = @prod_pos

	INSERT INTO @reject_ents SELECT ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND child_order <= @prod_pos

	;WITH items_for_line_and_period (item_id) AS (
		SELECT DISTINCT item_id
		FROM  @reject_ents re
		LEFT JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.ent_id = re.ent_id
		WHERE ip.byproduct = 0
		  AND (created_at_utc < @event_end_time OR (@event_end_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc < @max_shift_end_utc))
	    AND (created_at_utc >= @event_start_time OR (@event_start_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc >= @max_shift_start_utc))
    ),
	period_good_prod (item_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT iflap.item_id, SUM(ip.qty_prod)
		FROM items_for_line_and_period iflap
		LEFT JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = iflap.item_id
		JOIN @prod_ents pe ON pe.ent_id = ip.ent_id
		WHERE ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 0
		AND (created_at_utc < @event_end_time OR (@event_end_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc < @max_shift_end_utc))
	    AND (created_at_utc >= @event_start_time OR (@event_start_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc >= @max_shift_start_utc))
		GROUP BY iflap.item_id
	),
	period_rej_prod (item_id, qty) AS (
		SELECT iflap.item_id, SUM(ip.qty_prod)
		FROM items_for_line_and_period iflap
		LEFT JOIN item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = iflap.item_id
		JOIN @reject_ents pe ON pe.ent_id = ip.ent_id
		WHERE ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 0
		AND (created_at_utc < @event_end_time OR (@event_end_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc < @max_shift_end_utc))
	    AND (created_at_utc >= @event_start_time OR (@event_start_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc >= @max_shift_start_utc))
		GROUP BY iflap.item_id
	)
	SELECT item.item_id AS item_id,
	       item.item_desc AS item_desc,
	       CASE
	           WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
	           WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
	           WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
	           WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
	       END AS item_display,
	       uom.description AS uom_description,
	       uom.abbreviation AS uom_abbreviation,
	       item.num_decimals as num_decimals,
		   -- ROUND(COALESCE(pgp.qty, 0), item.num_decimals) AS period_produced,
	       -- ROUND(COALESCE(prp.qty, 0), item.num_decimals) AS period_rejected
		   -- 2 lines below were 2 lines above 1/8/15 KRF
		   COALESCE(pgp.qty, 0) AS period_produced,
		   COALESCE(prp.qty, 0) AS period_rejected
	FROM items_for_line_and_period ilp
	JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = ilp.item_id
	JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON uom.uom_id = item.uom_id
	LEFT JOIN period_good_prod pgp ON pgp.item_id = ilp.item_id
	LEFT JOIN period_rej_prod prp ON prp.item_id = ilp.item_id
	ORDER BY item.item_id
END

-- Description:	The stored procedure will retrieve attr list
-- Usage:		AddMaterialTemplate
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-08-16			Initial version.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Attr_Set]
(@attr_desc  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @possible_value  nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @row_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @attr_id INT
	
	SELECT @attr_id = attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = @attr_desc

	SELECT attr_set.attr_id
			,attr_set.possible_value
			,attr.attr_desc
			,attr_set.display_seq
			,attr_set.last_edit_comment
			,attr_set.last_edit_by
			,attr_set.last_edit_at
			,attr_set.row_id
	FROM attr_set attr_set WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON attr.attr_id = attr_set.attr_id
	WHERE ((attr_set.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
		(attr_set.possible_value = @possible_value OR @possible_value IS NULL) AND
		(attr_set.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(attr_set.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
		(attr_set.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL))
	ORDER BY attr_set.display_seq

END

AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_file_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_file table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/01/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the file_type matches the extension of the file_path
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Makes sure the file_type matches the extension of the file_path
	UPDATE item_file SET file_type = x.extension
	FROM (SELECT item_id, file_path, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(file_path) as extension, file_type FROM inserted) x
	WHERE item_file.item_id = x.item_id AND item_file.file_path = x.file_path AND x.extension <> x.file_type

	UPDATE item_file SET item_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_file.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE item_file.item_id = i.item_id AND item_file.file_path = i.file_path
END

	EXEC [sp_I_ofi_qm_samplecreationrequest] ;

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_qm_samplecreationrequest] (
	@ent_id INT
	,@sampleplan_id INT
	,@wo_id STRING80 = NULL
	,@sublot_no STRING80 = NULL
	,@username STRING80 = NULL
	,@sample_id INT32 = 0 OUTPUT
	)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @return_value INT;
	DECLARE @def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @item_id NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @qmspec_name NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @ent_name NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @plan_name NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @attr_id INT;
	DECLARE @attrLottypedesc NVARCHAR(80) = 'LotTypeForSample';--- BatchMaker or Sublot
	DECLARE @attr_value NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @tblSublot AS TABLE (sublot_no NVARCHAR(80));
	DECLARE @lotno NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @IsBatchmaker BIT =0
	DECLARE @seg_id int =0;
	DECLARE @oper_id NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @seq INT
	DECLARE @sampleSource NVARCHAR(40) ='UI'

	--GET QM SPEC NAME
	SELECT TOP 1 @qmspec_name = qm_spec_name
	FROM qm_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE plan_id = @sampleplan_id;

	--GET ENTITY NAME	
		SELECT @ent_name=ent.ent_name, @seg_id=ent.ent_id FROM ent_attr ea with (nolock)
		INNER JOIN ent with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id		
		INNER JOIN attr with (nolock) ON ea.attr_id=attr.attr_id
		WHERE attr_desc='EntityType' AND ent.parent_ent_id=@ent_id and ea.attr_value='Segment'


	--GET SAMPLE PLAN FOR RECEIVED FREQUENCY TYPE
	SELECT @plan_name = plan_name
	FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE plan_id = @sampleplan_id;

	--GET @LotTypeForSample VALUE FOR LINE ID
	SELECT @attr_value = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE ea.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND a.attr_desc = @attrLottypedesc

	--REQUEST FROM LIMS FOR LOCATION BASED
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL )
	BEGIN	
		--select running wo_id from entity
		SELECT top 1 @wo_id=wo_id, @oper_id=oper_id, @seq=seq_no, @item_id=item_id FROM job WHERE state_cd=3 and run_ent_id=@seg_id
		ORDER BY edit_time DESC		

		SET @sampleSource='LIMS'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--GET ITEM ID 	
		--data available @wo_id, @ent_id, @sublot_no		
		SELECT top 1 @wo_id=wo_id, @oper_id=oper_id, @item_id=item_id
		FROM job WHERE 
		wo_id=@wo_id
		AND run_ent_id=@seg_id
		ORDER BY edit_time DESC	


	END 

	-- 00.03 added seq_no selection
	SELECT @seq = seq_no
	From item_prod where
	wo_id = @wo_id and item_id = @item_id and sublot_no = @sublot_no
	
	
	EXEC @return_value = [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_QM_Sample_GenerateASample] @ent_name = @ent_name
		,@site_name = NULL
		,@qm_spec_name = @qmspec_name
		,@ver_id = NULL
		,@sample_name = NULL
		,@item_id = @item_id
		,@wo_id = @wo_id
		,@oper_id = @oper_id
		,@seq_no = @seq -- 00.03 added seq_no to SP execution for manual sample creation
		,@plan_name = @plan_name
		,@requested_time_local = NULL
		,@requested_time_utc = NULL
		,@expiry_time = NULL
		,@warning_time = NULL
		,@time_zone_bias_value = NULL
		,@sample_id = @sample_id OUTPUT;

	
	--SUBLOT_NO,matchmaker, def_lot_no
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT top 1 1 FROM item_prod WHERE wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND item_id=@item_id) -- 
	BEGIN -- WHEN DEF_LOT_NO is sent from UI
		UPDATE sample
		SET lot_no = @sublot_no
			,spare4 = @sampleSource
			,spare3 = 0
		WHERE sample_id = @sample_id;
	END
	ELSE --when sublot_no sent from UI
	BEGIN
		IF (@attr_value = 'BatchMaker')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @lotno = lot_no
			FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sublot_no LIKE '%'+ @sublot_no +'%'
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @lotno = lot_no
			FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sublot_no = @sublot_no and ent_id=@seg_id

		END
		

		UPDATE sample
		SET sublot_no = @sublot_no
			,lot_no = @lotno
			,spare4 = @sampleSource
			,spare3 = 0
		WHERE sample_id = @sample_id;
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Cert_Start_Allowed](
@user_id 	STRING40,
@process_id 	STRING40 = Null,
@oper_id 	STRING40 = Null,
@step_no 	INT32 = Null,
@item_id 	STRING40 = Null,
@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--02/07/2006	Raghu		3.1.9	HD# 6871, Added certification name to error message.
--09/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.23	HD# 6871, Added certification name to the first error string.
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @cert_name 		STRING40,
	@reqd_level 		INT32,
	@duration 		INT32,
	@audit			LOGICAL,
	@user_cert_level	INT32,
	@expiry			TDATETIME,
	@cert_checked		LOGICAL,
	@current_time		TDATETIME,
	@err_desc		NVARCHAR(4000),
	@user_cert_name		STRING80

BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

   SET @cert_checked = 0
   IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

   IF (@process_id is NOT NULL and @process_id <> '') AND (@oper_id is NOT NULL and @oper_id <> '') BEGIN
-- iF process_id and oper_id is not null, then check for step_no, depending on the values passed, frame a cursor
	IF (@step_no is NULL or @step_no = '')  BEGIN
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
			from cert_oper_link cert_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK) , cert_type cert_type WITH (NOLOCK)
			where cert_oper_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_link.oper_id = @oper_id
   	END
   	ELSE IF (@step_no is NOT NULL and @step_no <> '')  BEGIN
		DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_step_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
			from cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link WITH (NOLOCK) , cert_type cert_type WITH (NOLOCK)
			where cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no
/*			select cert_type.cert_name, cert_oper_step_link.cert_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.audit
			from cert_oper_step_link cert_oper_step_link, cert_type cert_type, cert_oper_link cert_oper_link
			where cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.cert_name = cert_oper_link.cert_name
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = cert_oper_link.process_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = cert_oper_link.oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.process_id = @process_id and cert_oper_step_link.oper_id = @oper_id
			and cert_oper_step_link.step_no = @step_no*/
	END
	OPEN cert_cursor
   	WHILE (1=1)
   	BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT from cert_cursor into @cert_name, @reqd_level, @duration, @audit
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @cert_checked = 1
		if (@audit = 0) BEGIN
		 	SELECT @user_cert_level = cert_user_link.cert_level, @expiry =  cert_user_link.expiry
				,@user_cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			FROM cert_user_link cert_user_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type cert_type  WITH (NOLOCK) ON cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			WHERE cert_user_link.cert_name = @cert_name and user_id = @user_id
			IF (@user_cert_level is null) BEGIN
--				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a valid certification.{3327},' + @user_id
--				RAISERROR('User does not have a valid certification.{3327}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF @user_cert_level < @reqd_level BEGIN
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
--				RAISERROR('Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level.{3328}', 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF @expiry < @current_time BEGIN
--				RAISERROR('Users Certificate has expired.{3329}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE cert_cursor
	DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
   END
/*   ELSE  BEGIN
-- process_id, and oper_id is null, so frame a cursor based on user_id
   	DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		select cert_type.cert_name, cert_type.max_level, cert_type.duration, cert_type.audit
		from cert_user_link cert_user_link, cert_type cert_type
		where cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		and cert_user_link.user_id = @user_id
   END
*/
   IF (@item_id is NOT NULL and @item_id <> '') BEGIN
	DECLARE cert_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL FOR
		select cert_type.cert_name, cert_type.max_level,
		cert_type.duration, cert_type.cert_audit
		from cert_item_link cert_item_link WITH (NOLOCK) , cert_type cert_type WITH (NOLOCK)
		where cert_item_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
		and cert_item_link.item_id = @item_id
	OPEN cert_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
   		FETCH NEXT from cert_cursor into @cert_name, @reqd_level, @duration, @audit
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @cert_checked = 1
		if (@audit = 0) BEGIN
	 		select @user_cert_level = cert_user_link.cert_level, @expiry = cert_user_link.expiry
				,@user_cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			from cert_user_link cert_user_link WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type cert_type WITH (NOLOCK)  ON cert_user_link.cert_name = cert_type.cert_name
			where cert_user_link.cert_name = @cert_name and user_id = @user_id
			if (@user_cert_level is null) BEGIN
--        				RAISERROR('User does not have a valid certification{3327}', 16, 1, @@error)
--					SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a valid certification.{3327},' + @user_id
				SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
        				RETURN -1
			END
			if @user_cert_level < @reqd_level BEGIN
--        				RAISERROR('Users Certificate Level is lesser than the required Certificate Level{3328}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
       				RETURN -1
			END
			if @expiry < @current_time BEGIN
--    				RAISERROR('Users Certificate has expired{3329}', 16, 1, @@error)
				SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
               			RETURN -1
			END
		END
   	END
   	CLOSE cert_cursor
   	DEALLOCATE cert_cursor
   END
/*   if (@cert_checked = 0) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Certificate Not found', 16, 1, @@error)
             	RETURN -1
   END
*/
RETURN 0
END

	BEGIN TRY

			 @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS

			,@audit_category        NVARCHAR(80)              = NULL
	
	if @audit_category is null set @audit_category = 'Info' ;

			DECLARE @delete_detail NVARCHAR(MAX);
			declare @row_cnt int
			declare @max_row_cnt int

			declare @bg_max_row_cnt int

			declare  @p_created_at_utc			[DATETIME]

			declare	 @p_ent_id  int

			declare @MaxSiloPerBOMItem  int  -- @source level

			declare @silo_details_maxBlend nvarchar(200)
			declare @jobrequiredQty float
			declare @totalSelectQtyforItem float
			declare @totalRequiredQtyforItem float
			declare @totalQtyForSelectedSilo float
			declare @ratioShortfall float
			declare @IsRequiredQtyMandatory int
			declare @IsOnlyAllowedSingleSiloSelection int
			declare @qty_prod float			  

			declare @entered_ratio float
			declare @silo_mes_qty float
			declare @srciSiloCount int

			declare  @bg_bom_pos int
					,@bg_grade_code int		
					,@bg_grade_desc [dbo].[STRING40]	
					,@bg_item_desc [dbo].[STRING80]	
					,@bg_item_group [dbo].[STRING80]	
					,@bg_item_id [dbo].[STRING80]	
					,@bg_qty_per_parent_item float

					,@bg_uom_description nvarchar(20)		 
			
			declare @validationTab as table (err_flag int,
										silo_name [dbo].[STRING80],
										maxBR_allowed float)
			declare @validlotTab as table (	 err_flag int
											,lot_no [dbo].[STRING80]
											,item_id [dbo].[STRING80]
