											,maxblend_ratio float
											)

			declare @lotinfo as table (storage_ent_id int,item_id STRING80,lotNo STRING40,max_blend_r float, total_lot_ratio float )
			--storage_ent_id,lot_no,ratio max_blend_r)
			declare @sumlotratio as table (storage_ent_id int, lot_no STRING40,ratio float, max_blend_r float)
			--declare @ratio float
			--declare @maxblendr float

			declare @BOMGrid as table (
					 rowId int identity(1,1)
					,bom_pos int
					,grade_code int		NULL
					,grade_desc [dbo].[STRING40]	
					,item_desc [dbo].[STRING80]	
					,item_group [dbo].[STRING80]	
					,item_id [dbo].[STRING80]	
					,qty_per_parent_item float	NULL
					,recipe_id [dbo].[STRING80]	 NULL
					,uom_description nvarchar(20)	NULL	 
					);

					
			declare @sourcegrid table ( 
					 rowId	int identity(1,1)
					,jb_item_id  varchar(80)		 -- selected item id
					,jb_grade_cd	int				 -- selected grade_cd	
					,jb_item_group	varchar(40)		 --	selected item group		
					,ent_id  int								
					,ent_name   varchar(40)						
					,grade  varchar(40)		 NULL
					,inv_grade_cd  varchar(40)		 NULL	
					,isChk int			NULL					
					,is_chk int				NULL				
					,is_disabled int		NULL					
					,item_desc varchar(80)	NULL							
					,item_group  varchar(40)	 				
					,item_id varchar(80)								
					,maxBlendRatio		float	 NULL		
					,mes_qty		float		NULL		
					,min_dosing_qty_kg		float	 NULL	
					,oper_id	varchar(80)						
					,entered_ratio  float				NULL					
					,secondary_silo  varchar(80)	NULL
					,secondary_silo_ent_id	int		NULL						
					,seq_no		int							
					,storage_ent_id	int							
					,wo_id  varchar(40)
					,abs_selected_qty float
					);	
						
			insert into @BOMGrid(
					 bom_pos ,grade_code ,grade_desc 
					,item_desc ,item_group 	,item_id 
					,qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_id ,uom_description 
					)
			select  bom_pos ,grade_code ,grade_desc 
							,item_desc ,item_group 	,item_id 
							,qty_per_parent_item ,recipe_id ,uom_description 
							 FROM  
							 OPENJSON ( @bom_grid )  
								WITH  ( 
										 bom_pos int					'$.bom_pos'
										,grade_code int					'$.grade_code'
										,grade_desc [dbo].[STRING40]	'$.grade_desc'
										,item_desc [dbo].[STRING80]		'$.item_desc'
										,item_group [dbo].[STRING80]	'$.item_group'
										,item_id [dbo].[STRING80]		'$.item_id'
										,qty_per_parent_item float		'$.qty_per_parent_item'
										,recipe_id [dbo].[STRING80]		'$.recipe_id'
										,uom_description nvarchar(20)	'$.uom_description'		
									  );
							
				insert into  @sourcegrid ( jb_item_id,jb_grade_cd,jb_item_group,
							  ent_id  ,ent_name  ,grade,inv_grade_cd  			
							 ,isChk ,is_chk ,is_disabled 					
							 ,item_desc ,item_group  		
							 ,item_id ,maxBlendRatio,mes_qty						
							 ,min_dosing_qty_kg	,oper_id,entered_ratio  
							 ,secondary_silo  ,secondary_silo_ent_id				
							 ,seq_no ,storage_ent_id ,wo_id,abs_selected_qty 
							 )
			    select jb_item_id,jb_grade_cd,jb_item_group, ent_id ,ent_name   ,grade,inv_grade_cd					
						,isChk ,is_chk  ,is_disabled						
						,item_desc 	,item_group 	
						,item_id ,maxBlendRatio ,mes_qty				
						,min_dosing_qty_kg,oper_id ,ratio					
						,secondary_silo  ,secondary_silo_ent_id		
						,seq_no	,storage_ent_id	,wo_id ,abs_selected_qty
									 FROM  
							 OPENJSON ( @source_grid )  
								WITH  ( 		
										 jb_item_id  varchar(80)			'$.jb_item_id'				 -- selected item id
										,jb_grade_cd	int					'$.jb_grade_cd'				 -- selected grade_cd	
										,jb_item_group	varchar(40)			'$.jb_item_group'			 --	selected item group	
										,ent_id  int						'$.ent_id'						
										,ent_name   varchar(40)				'$.ent_name'		
										,grade  varchar(40)					'$.grade'				
										,inv_grade_cd  varchar(40)			'$.inv_grade_cd'	
										,isChk bit							'$.isChk'	
										,is_chk bit							'$.is_chk'	
										,is_disabled int					'$.is_disabled'		
										,item_desc varchar(80)				'$.item_desc'				
										,item_group  varchar(40)			'$.item_group'		
										,item_id varchar(80)				'$.item_id'				
										,maxBlendRatio		float			'$.maxBlendRatio'
										,mes_qty		float				'$.mes_qty'
										,min_dosing_qty_kg		float		'$.min_dosing_qty_kg'
										,oper_id	varchar(80)				'$.oper_id'		
										,ratio  float						'$.ratio'			
										,secondary_silo  varchar(80)		'$.secondary_silo'
										,secondary_silo_ent_id	int			'$.secondary_silo_ent_id'					
										,seq_no		int						'$.seq_no'	
										,storage_ent_id	int					'$.storage_ent_id'		
										,wo_id  varchar(40)					'$.wo_id'
										,abs_selected_qty float				'$.abs_selected_qty'
										);

			--select * from @BOMGrid
			--select * from @sourcegrid
			-----------------------------------------
			-- MaxSiloPerBOMItem  validation
			select @job_state_cd = state_cd,@jobrequiredQty = qty_reqd ,@qty_prod = qty_prod 
			from job with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
			set @jobrequiredQty = case when (@jobrequiredQty-@qty_prod)>0 then (@jobrequiredQty-@qty_prod) else 0 end

			select @IsRequiredQtyMandatory  = attr_value from oper_attr oa with(nolock) inner join attr with(nolock) on oa.attr_id = attr.attr_id 
			and attr_desc = 'IsRequiredQtyMandatory' and oper_id = @oper_id
			
			select @IsOnlyAllowedSingleSiloSelection  = attr_value from oper_attr oa with(nolock) inner join attr with(nolock) on oa.attr_id = attr.attr_id 
			and attr_desc = 'AllowedOnlySingleSource' and oper_id = @oper_id
			set @IsOnlyAllowedSingleSiloSelection = isnull(@IsOnlyAllowedSingleSiloSelection,0);


			delete from @BOMGrid where qty_per_parent_item<=0

			set @resultset =1

			--#0.10 
			--- CanAllowedSingleSiloSelection
			if(@IsOnlyAllowedSingleSiloSelection=1)
				begin
					select @srciSiloCount = count(*) from @sourcegrid
						if(@srciSiloCount>1)
						begin
							set @isValidFlag=0;
							--set @ratioShortfall =  round(((@totalRequiredQtyforItem-@totalQtyForSelectedSilo)/@totalRequiredQtyforItem)*100,2)
							
							--set @resultcode = 'Only one silo can be selected for this process.'
							select @resultcode =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300011, NULL,NULL);

							select  top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = @resultcode
							return ;
						end
				end


			
			begin

						select @MaxSiloPerBOMItem = attr_value 
						from ent_attr ea with(nolock) 
						inner join attr with(nolock) on ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id and attr.attr_desc = 'MaxSiloPerBOMItem'
						where ea.ent_id = @ent_id

					--select * from @sourcegrid
					--set @MaxSiloPerBOMItem = ISNULL(@MaxSiloPerBOMItem,0) -- if null considered as 1 
					
					if exists(select count(1) from @sourcegrid group by jb_item_id having count(1)> @MaxSiloPerBOMItem and @MaxSiloPerBOMItem is not null) -- #0.08
					 begin
					-- print 1
						select top 1 @validateItem = jb_item_id from @sourcegrid group by jb_item_id having count(1) > @MaxSiloPerBOMItem
						select @validateItemDesc = item_desc from item with(nolock) where item_id = @validateItem

						--set @dblocalMsg1 = 'Max sources per item is configured to '
						select @dblocalMsg1 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300013, NULL,NULL);
						--set @dblocalMsg2 = ' has more than allowed source silo selected.'
						select @dblocalMsg2 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300014, NULL,NULL);


						select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = concat(@dblocalMsg1,@MaxSiloPerBOMItem,', ',@validateItemDesc,@dblocalMsg2) 
							--select @resultset as resultset, @resultcode as resultcode
							return ;
					 end
					
			end
			


			----------------------------------------------
			--Max blend ratio validation->
			--if exists (select 1 from lot_attr la with(nolock) inner join lot with(nolock) on la.item_id = lot.item_id and la.lot_no = lot.lot_no
			--			inner join attr with(nolock) on la.attr_id = attr.attr_id and attr.attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio'
			--			inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.lot_no = la.lot_no and iv.ent_id in(select storage_ent_id from @sourcegrid))
			begin
				-- if max blend ratio exists in the 
				-- print 2

				select @bg_max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@bg_row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @BOMGrid
				WHILE ((@bg_row_cnt<=@bg_max_row_cnt) and @bg_row_cnt<>0)
				BEGIN
				
					select @bg_bom_pos=bom_pos,@bg_grade_code = grade_code,@bg_item_id = item_id,@bg_qty_per_parent_item = qty_per_parent_item,@bg_uom_description = uom_description,@bg_item_desc = item_desc from @BOMGrid where rowId = @bg_row_cnt
				 --print @bg_row_cnt

				 -- max blend ratio condition starts
							if exists(select la.*,iv.qty_left,iv.ent_id from lot_attr la with(nolock) inner join lot with(nolock) on la.item_id = lot.item_id and la.lot_no = lot.lot_no
							inner join attr with(nolock) on la.attr_id = attr.attr_id and attr.attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio'
							inner join item_inv iv with(nolock) on iv.lot_no = la.lot_no and iv.ent_id in(select storage_ent_id from @sourcegrid)
							where iv.item_id = @bg_item_id and iv.grade_cd = @bg_grade_code ) -- again we are check the consition 
							begin
						
									select @minMaxBlendRatio = (min(maxBlendRatio)/@bg_qty_per_parent_item)*100,@sum_entered_ratio = sum(entered_ratio),
									@silo_details_maxBlend = STRING_AGG(ent_name, ',')  from  @sourcegrid sg where sg.jb_item_id = @bg_item_id and maxBlendRatio>0

								--select @minMaxBlendRatio  , @sum_entered_ratio 
								if(@sum_entered_ratio>@minMaxBlendRatio)
								begin
								--select 1
									set @isValidFlag=0;
									
									--set @dblocalMsg1 = 'For item-'
									select @dblocalMsg1 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300015, NULL, NULL);
									--set @dblocalMsg2 = ' max blend ratio is '
									select @dblocalMsg2 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300016, NULL, NULL);
									--set @dblocalMsg3 = '%, however currently total '
									select @dblocalMsg3 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300017, NULL, NULL);
									--set @dblocalMsg4 = '% is being used in silo '
									select @dblocalMsg4 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300018, NULL, NULL);
									
									select top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = concat(@dblocalMsg1, @bg_item_desc, @dblocalMsg2, @minMaxBlendRatio, @dblocalMsg3, @sum_entered_ratio, @dblocalMsg4, @silo_details_maxBlend)
										
										break;
								end
							end
					-- max blend ratio condition ends
					
					
					-- job required qty must be selected in silo validation
						if(@IsRequiredQtyMandatory=1)
						begin
							--print '@IsRequiredQtyMandatory'
								set @totalRequiredQtyforItem = (@jobrequiredQty*@bg_qty_per_parent_item)/100

								select  @totalQtyForSelectedSilo = SUM(mes_qty)        --@totalSelectQtyforItem = (@jobrequiredQty/ sum(entered_ratio))*100 , 
										,@silo_details_maxBlend = STRING_AGG(ent_name, ',')  from  @sourcegrid sg where sg.jb_item_id = @bg_item_id 

								if(@totalQtyForSelectedSilo< @totalRequiredQtyforItem)
								begin
										set @isValidFlag=0;
										set @ratioShortfall =  round(((@totalRequiredQtyforItem-@totalQtyForSelectedSilo)/@totalRequiredQtyforItem)*100,2)
										
										--set @dblocalMsg1 = '[Batch Process] For item-'
										select @dblocalMsg1 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300019, NULL, NULL);
										--set @dblocalMsg2 = '% of the required quantity still needs to be selected, as silo '
										select @dblocalMsg2 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300020, NULL, NULL);
										--set @dblocalMsg3 = ' has lower quantity.'
										select @dblocalMsg3 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300021, NULL, NULL);
																				
										
										select  top 1 @resultset=0, @resultcode = concat(@dblocalMsg1, @bg_item_desc, ' ',@ratioShortfall, @dblocalMsg2, @silo_details_maxBlend, @dblocalMsg3)
									
										break;
								end
						end


					set @bg_row_cnt = @bg_row_cnt+1
				END

				
			end


			----------------------------------------------
			--- saving into db
			

			if(@saveRecords=1 and @isValidFlag=1)
			BEGIN
			-- print 3
				-- fetching the data for audit trail
			   insert into @su_details_audit select * from ofi_su_selection with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1
			-- check if the order is running
				--select @job_state_cd = state_cd from job with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
				
				--if(@job_state_cd<>3) -- when the order is not running, need to check if the order is runnning 
				begin
					delete from ofi_su_selection where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type =1 -- only source soilos to be deleted
				end

				
		
			
				 select @max_row_cnt=max(rowId),@row_cnt = min(rowId) from  @sourcegrid
				 --select @max_row_cnt,@row_cnt 

					WHILE ((@row_cnt<=@max_row_cnt) and @row_cnt<>0)
						BEGIN

					--'$.jb_item_id'
					--'$.jb_grade_cd'
					--'$.jb_item_group'

					--,@jb_item_id	varchar(80)		
					--,@jb_grade_cd	int			
					--,@jb_item_group	varchar(40)	

					select 
						 @jb_item_id				= case when oper_id ='BeanBulkIntake' then @parent_item_id else  jb_item_id	end					-- selected item id
						,@jb_grade_cd				= jb_grade_cd						-- selected grade_cd	
						,@jb_item_group				= jb_item_group						--	selected item group	
						,@p_ent_id					= ent_id			
						,@p_ent_name				= ent_name		
						,@p_grade					= grade			
						,@p_isChk					= isChk			
						,@p_is_chk					= is_chk			
						,@p_is_disabled				= is_disabled		
						,@p_item_desc				= item_desc		
						,@p_item_group				= item_group		
						,@p_item_id					= item_id			
						,@p_maxBlendRatio			= maxBlendRatio	
						,@p_mes_qty					= mes_qty			
						,@p_min_dosing_qty_kg		= min_dosing_qty_kg	
						,@p_oper_id					= oper_id			
						,@p_ratio					= entered_ratio			
						,@p_secondary_silo  		= secondary_silo  
						,@p_secondary_silo_ent_id	= secondary_silo_ent_id	
						,@p_seq_no					= seq_no							
						,@p_storage_ent_id			= storage_ent_id				
						,@p_wo_id					= wo_id
						,@p_abs_selected_qty		= abs_selected_qty   from @sourcegrid where rowId = @row_cnt
						
						
						
						--print @p_ent_name
						set @step_data = isnull(@step_data,'') + @p_ent_name + ',' ;

						INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
								(	 
								 [wo_id]				
								,[oper_id]				
								,[seq_no]				
								,[parent_item_id]		
								,[ent_id]				
								,[jb_item_id] 			
								,[jb_item_group] 		
								,[jb_grade_cd] 			
								,[dest_type]			
								,[is_chk]

				--,@a1_silo_seq 				= t1.silo_seq

								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )

								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )
		and  t1.wo_id not in (select t2.wo_id
								from @su_details_audit1 t2 )
	order by t1.su_ent_id
	OFFSET @k ROWS   
	FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY



	Select @strActivityMsg ='Deleted'
	
	set @row_id = @a1_row_id
	set @new_value3= 'Deleted'

	set @user_name = @a1_created_by;
	SET @column_name  = 'su_ent_id'
			select @old_value1 = e.ent_name
			from ent e with(nolock)								  
			where e.ent_id =@a1_su_ent_id
																	

	EXEC  [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail]	@log_id OUTPUT , @logged_at, @user_name, @change_type, @table_name, @row_id, @column_name, @old_value1, @new_value3, @audit_comments, @delete_detail;
	
		UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
		SET
			 origin = @strFunctionName
		WHERE
			log_id = @log_id;
	--select @strCommentMsg= @column_name+' deleted: '+ cast(ISNULL(@old_value1,'-') as nvarchar(50));
	
	set @keyField1=@wo_id;
	set @keyField2=@oper_id;
	set @keyField3=@seq_no;
	set @keyField4=@a1_jb_item_id

	INSERT INTO  [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext]
		(log_id, keyField1, keyField2, keyField3, keyField4, module_id, function_id, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, audit_category, activity, comments, created_at_utc, created_at_local, created_by)
		VALUES
		(
			   @log_id, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @strModuleName, @strFunctionName, @keyField1, @keyField2, @keyField3, @keyField4, @keyField5, @keyField6, @audit_category, @strActivityMsg, @strCommentMsg
			 , ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE()), @logged_at, @user_name
		);

												 
	 SET @k = @k + 1;

 END

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH

END

CREATE FUNCTION FN_GETCONTROLRULEMSG
(@sample_id INT
 ,@char_id INT
 ,@qm_spec_id INT
) RETURNS NVARCHAR(2000)
AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - FN_GETCONTROLRULEMSG
-- Description       - Returns the rules violated message having chart and rules violated for the sample.
-- Author          -   Raghu G and Ibrahim.
-- Date Created      - 4/14/2014
-- Version         -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 04/17/2014	  Ibrahim		 5.0	UserStory: 195827 - As Joe, I want to be notified of Control Rule Violations through the SRO even when I enter results manually in the Sample Viewer
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
	DECLARE @controlrule_msg NVARCHAR(2000)
    SELECT @controlrule_msg = CASE WHEN rule_violations.primary_chart_rules IS NOT NULL THEN '[' + rule_violations.primary_chart_name + ']: ' + rule_violations.primary_chart_rules  ELSE '' END
                           + CASE  WHEN rule_violations.sec_chart_rules IS NOT NULL THEN '  [' + rule_violations.sec_chart_name + ']: ' + rule_violations.sec_chart_rules
                          ELSE '' END
                  FROM
                  (SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) IN (2, 3) THEN 'XBar Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 5 THEN 'Individual X (IX) Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) IN (7, 8) THEN 'Moving Average (MA) Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 16 THEN 'p Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 17 THEN 'np Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 18 THEN 'u Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 19 THEN 'c Chart'
                           WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 20 THEN 'DPMO Chart'
                           ELSE '' END primary_chart_name
                          , rules_violated_for_char.primary_chart_rules
                          , CASE WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 2 THEN 'Range Chart'
                                          WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 3 THEN 'Sigma Chart'
                                          WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) IN (5, 7) THEN 'Moving Range Chart'
                                          WHEN COALESCE(qscl.default_chart, c.default_chart) = 8 THEN 'Moving Sigma Chart'
                                          ELSE '' END sec_chart_name
                         ,rules_violated_for_char.sec_chart_rules
                  FROM
                    (SELECT distinct scrl2.sample_id,STUFF((Select CASE WHEN scrl1.chart_pos IN (1,3) THEN ' ID(' + cast(sr.rule_id as varchar(10)) + '): ' +
						sr.rule_desc + ';' ELSE NULL END FROM sample_char_rule_link scrl1 WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON scrl1.rule_id = sr.rule_id
						where scrl1.sample_id = scrl2.sample_id AND scrl1.char_id = @char_id
						ORDER BY scrl1.rule_id
						For XML PATH ('')),1,1,'') as primary_chart_rules
                    , STUFF((Select CASE WHEN scrl3.chart_pos IN (2,3) THEN ' ID(' + cast(sr.rule_id as varchar(10)) + '): ' +
						sr.rule_desc + ';' ELSE NULL END FROM sample_char_rule_link scrl3 WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN spc_rule sr WITH (NOLOCK) ON scrl3.rule_id = sr.rule_id
						where scrl3.sample_id = scrl2.sample_id AND scrl3.char_id = @char_id
						ORDER BY scrl3.rule_id
						For XML PATH ('')),1,1,'') as sec_chart_rules
                    FROM sample_char_rule_link scrl2 WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE scrl2.sample_id = @sample_id AND scrl2.char_id = @char_id
                    ) rules_violated_for_char
                  , characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK)
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.char_id = qscl.char_id
                  WHERE c.char_id = @char_id and (qscl.qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id OR @qm_spec_id IS NULL)
                  ) rule_violations
     RETURN @controlrule_msg
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    [SP_S_ofi_GetItemForCons]
-- Description:  Used to get item id if AUT doesnt provide Item_id
--
-- Usage:  MDMAddConsumptionJobWorkflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  YG            2022-08-30      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  YG			  2023-04-28	  Get Item Id even it is not same with the BoM
-- 0.02.10	YG			  2024-02-06	  Update the script body comment
--
-- EXEC [SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption] '1000671266','LiquidLoadout',0,524004,'100000055863'
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption] (
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(40) 
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) 
	,@seq_no INT 
	,@aut_storage_id INT 
	,@item_id  NVARCHAR(40) = NULL 
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @storage_ent_id INT

	--GETS Required Data
	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@aut_storage_id AS NVARCHAR)

	-- v0.03.00 ++ Added checking if item_id is NULL and get item_id from item_inv table with respecting to the job_bom
	IF (@item_id is NULL OR @item_id = '0')
	BEGIN
		-- Check if job required item is available on the storage silo
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON iv.item_id = jb.item_id
					WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id and jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no )
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @item_id = jb.item_id FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON iv.item_id = jb.item_id
			WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id and jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM item_inv iv
					  LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = @wo_id 
																and jb.oper_id = @oper_id 
																and jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
																and jb.item_id = iv.item_id
						WHERE 
							iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
							AND jb.item_id IS NULL)
		BEGIN 
			SELECT TOP 1 @item_id = iv.item_id FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
		END
	END

	SELECT @item_id item_id
	-- v0.03.00 --
END

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE	@cur_qty_cons 			TFLOAT
	,	@cur_wo_id 				STRING40
	,	@cur_oper_id 			STRING40
	,	@cur_seq_no 			INT32
	,	@cur_shift_id 			INT32
	,	@cur_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	,	@cur_item_id 			STRING40
	,	@cur_lot_no 			STRING40
	,	@cur_sublot_no 			STRING40
	,	@cur_cont_id 			STRING40
	,	@cur_fg_lot_no 			STRING40
	,	@cur_fg_sublot_no		STRING40
	,	@cur_reas_cd 			INT32
	,	@cur_storage_ent_id 	INT32
	,	@grade_cd 				INT32
	,	@status_cd 				INT32
	,	@scrapped 				INT32
	,	@cur_update_inv 		INT32
	,	@cur_backflush 			INT32
	,	@cur_spare1 			STRING40
	,	@cur_spare2 			STRING40
	,	@cur_spare3 			STRING40
	,	@cur_spare4 			STRING40
	,	@LotChanged 			INT32
	,	@reas_desc 				STRING40
	,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME
	,	@expiry_date			TDATETIME
	-- 10/26/2002	TC	1.5.0	Include row_id as an output parameter to return the ID of the row updated or inserted
	--,  @row_id		INT32
	,	@return           		INT32
	,	@must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@bgood_prod				LOGICAL
	,	@inv_status_cd			INT32
	--Added by Raghu on 12/03/2002.
	,	@scaling_factor			TFLOAT
	-- Added by Rohit
	,	@must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL
	,	@inv_wo_id 				STRING40
	,	@attr_value				NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@prev_inv_ent_id		INT32
	,	@prev_inv_lot_no		STRING40
	,	@prev_oper_id			STRING40
	,	@cur_qty_left			TFLOAT
	,	@reqd_grade_cd			INT32
	,	@checkGrade				LOGICAL
	,	@last_edit_by			STRING40
	,	@current_subst			INT32
	,	@def_lot_no				STRING40
	,	@def_sublot_no			STRING40
	,	@distinct_cons			NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@inv_row_id				INT32
	,	@current_time			TDATETIME
	--,	@use_gmt				INT32
	,	@tz_temp				INT32
	,	@tempvar4				INT32
	,	@stoo_selcnt			INT32
	,	@inv_oper_id			STRING40
	,	@inv_seq_no				INT32
--RaghuK CR L00088636 Start
	,	@temp_flag				LOGICAL
	,	@temp_inv_oper_id		STRING40
	,	@temp_inv_seq_no		INT32
	,	@temp_inv_qty_left		TFLOAT
	,	@temp_qty_cons			TFLOAT
	,	@qty_to_be_consumed		TFLOAT
	,	@required_qty_consumed	LOGICAL
--RaghuK CR L00088636 End
	,	@cur_subsegment_id		STRING80 -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
	,	@cur_comments			STRING254 -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
	,	@event_time_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@cur_shift_start_local_tz		INT32
	,	@inv_unique_by_job		INT -- Added 05/20/2015 - CR:L00136813

	SET @tempvar4 = 0
    SET @temp_flag = 0		--RaghuK CR L00088636

SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

-- Init the values
SELECT	@LotChanged = 0
	,	@cur_wo_id = NULL
	,	@cur_oper_id = NULL
	,	@cur_seq_no = 0
	,	@grade_cd = NULL
	,	@status_cd = NULL
	,	@scrapped = NULL
	,	@cur_shift_id = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	, 	@event_time_utc = @created_at_utc

	--Verify whether an event time is supplied
	IF (@event_time_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) BEGIN
			--Event time is not supplied, therefore, default to the current utc time
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
			--Determine the local time using the utc time
			SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
		END
		ELSE --an event time is supplied
			--Determine the utc time from the supplied local time
			SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE())
	END

-- Read current job data from the job_exec table
SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

-- 10/26/2002	TC		1.5.0		Include job_pos in WHERE clause
-- If NO job is running return an error
IF (@cur_wo_id IS NULL) OR (@cur_wo_id = 'Idle') OR (@cur_wo_id = '') BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('The job is not currently running on the specified entity.{3189}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END


SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @cur_shift_id=sh.shift_id
FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
AND shift_start_utc =
(SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
	FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
	--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
	AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @event_time_utc)

SET @cur_shift_id = COALESCE(@cur_shift_id, 0)
SET @cur_shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@cur_shift_start_utc, @event_time_utc)
SET @cur_shift_start_local = COALESCE(@cur_shift_start_local, @event_time_local)

-- If values where not returned default them to Null shift and Now

SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

--Read current item_id and lot details from the job_bom table for the given job and bom_pos
SELECT	@cur_item_id = item_id
	,	@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
	,	@cur_lot_no = def_lot_no
	,	@cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no
	--      ,@cur_cont_id = cur_cont_id
	,	@cur_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
	,	@cur_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
	,	@cur_update_inv = update_inv
	,	@cur_backflush = backflush
	,	@scaling_factor = scaling_factor
	,	@must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
	,	@must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
	,	@current_subst = current_subst
	,	@cur_spare1 = spare1
	,	@cur_spare2 = spare2
	,	@cur_spare3 = spare3
	,	@cur_spare4 = spare4
FROM  job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos

IF (@current_subst IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst) BEGIN
		SELECT	@cur_item_id = item_id
			,	@reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
			,	@cur_lot_no = def_lot_no
			,	@cur_sublot_no = def_sublot_no
			,	@cur_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
			,	@cur_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			,	@cur_update_inv = update_inv
			,	@cur_backflush = backflush
			,	@scaling_factor = scaling_factor
			,	@must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
			,	@must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
			,	@cur_spare1 = spare1
			,	@cur_spare2 = spare2
			,	@cur_spare3 = spare3
			,	@cur_spare4 = spare4
		FROM  job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst
	END
END

--Added by Raghu on 12/03/2002.  Apply Scaling Factor
IF (@apply_scaling_factor  = 1) BEGIN
	IF (@scaling_factor IS NULL OR @scaling_factor = 0) SET @scaling_factor = 1
	SET @qty_cons = @qty_cons * @scaling_factor
END

--Read the FG lot_no from job_bom where bom_pos = 0
--SELECT @cur_fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_bom WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
IF (@fg_lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
	IF (@fg_lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @def_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
		SET @fg_lot_no = @def_lot_no
	END
END
SET @cur_fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no

--Pick the fg_lot_no from job_exec if null SJ 1/30/03
--IF @cur_fg_lot_no IS NULL  SELECT @cur_fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

IF (@fg_sublot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @fg_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
	IF (@fg_sublot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @def_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos
		SET @fg_sublot_no = @def_sublot_no
	END
END
SET @cur_fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no

-- If any parameter lot values are NOT null, and are different to the current values, then update the current values
IF NOT ((@item_id IS NULL) OR (@item_id = '')) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_item_id IS NULL SET @cur_item_id = @item_id
	IF (@cur_item_id <> @item_id) BEGIN
		SET @cur_item_id = @item_id
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END

--Added by Raghu on 07/01/2003. Check for bom_pos = 0. If it is..then get the previous inventory location and lot_no
-- Undone the above change HD# 3303, Replaced by 5097

IF NOT ((@lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no = '')) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_lot_no IS NULL SET @cur_lot_no = @lot_no
	IF (@cur_lot_no <> @lot_no) BEGIN
		SET @cur_lot_no = @lot_no
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END

-- Added 1/9/07 KRF
IF NOT ((@sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@sublot_no = '')) BEGIN
	IF @cur_sublot_no IS NULL SET @cur_sublot_no = @sublot_no
	IF (@cur_sublot_no <> @sublot_no) SET @cur_sublot_no = @sublot_no
END

IF NOT (@reas_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
	IF (@cur_reas_cd <> @reas_cd) BEGIN
		SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END
IF NOT (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
	--below one condition(one line of code) is added by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
	IF @cur_storage_ent_id IS NULL SET @cur_storage_ent_id = @from_ent_id
	IF (@cur_storage_ent_id <> @from_ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @cur_storage_ent_id = @from_ent_id
		--below  line is commented  by Nagaraju on 01-14-03
		--SET @LotChanged = 1
	END
END

--Added by Raghu on 11/23/2004 for HD# 5161
IF @spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' '  SET @cur_spare1 = @spare1
IF @spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' '  SET @cur_spare2 = @spare2
IF @spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' '  SET @cur_spare3 = @spare3
IF @spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' '  SET @cur_spare4 = @spare4

 -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
IF @comments != ' ' BEGIN
	SET @cur_comments = @comments
END
ELSE BEGIN
	SET @cur_comments = NULL
END

-- If any of the parameter values have changed then do NOT update the current lot data in the job_bom table..
--Added by Raghu on 07/31/2002. HD #933. Check the Expiry date of the item in inventory before consuming it.
--Modified by Raghu on 10/03/2002. The below check is moved down. As it raises the error for manual consumption
IF @cur_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
	SELECT @expiry_date = expiry_date FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id AND item_id = @cur_item_id AND (lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
	AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Clasue added 1/9/07 KRF
	IF @expiry_date IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @expiry_date < @current_time BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Item is expired and cannot be consumed{3303}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
END
--below line is added by Nagaraju on 01/02/03 for  HD #2051
--IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL AND NOT @reas_cd IS NULL SET @cur_reas_cd = @reas_cd
--below 2 conditions are added by Nagaraju on 12/10/02
IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL SELECT @cur_reas_cd = def_cons_reas_cd FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)  Where ent_id = @ent_id
IF @cur_reas_cd IS NULL
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Default Consumption Code is not defined{3304}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get good_prod flag
SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd,@status_cd = item_status_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd
IF @grade_cd IS NOT NULL BEGIN
	-- reas_cd is defined, grade and status loaded - now get good_prod flag
	SELECT @scrapped = scrapped	FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
	-- Return error if this was not successful
	IF @scrapped IS NULL BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid scrapped flag{3299}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END
ELSE BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
	--Retrieve the user_id from the session table with the supplied session_id
	-- Get user id from sessn when @session_id is between -1 to -9 (reserved for custom implementations) or positive number
		IF(@session_id >= -9) BEGIN
			SELECT @user_id = s.user_id
			FROM sessn s WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE s.session_id = @session_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
		    SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
		END
	--This will not help the UCO, however, since setting the operator production attribute does not set a current user
	--for the session.  It does however log that user in to the labor_usage table, and log any other user out.
	--So the next choice would be the first current  user found in the labor_usage table for the job
	--if there is one.  The �current user found in the labor_usage table� would be the one where duration was 0,
	--as terminating a labor_usage record sets the duration.
	IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @user_id = MAX(lu.user_id) FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE lu.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND lu.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND lu.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND lu.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND lu.duration = 0
		  AND lu.active = 1
	END
    -- If there is no current user for the job either, use the background user (identified by system attribute 199).
    IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        SELECT @user_id = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199
    END
    --Raise a custom error, otherwise the database is going to throw a system generated error complaining about the user_id cannot be null.
    IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        RAISERROR('%1 may not be empty{5413},user_id',16,1);
    END
END


-- If FG lot_no changed DON't write it back ?
-- @cur_fg_lot_no
-- Added by Rohit to check for work order if must_consume_from_wip is set to true
-- CHD added the '@qty_cons > 0' check, KRF's recomendation (because if you're putting back, needn't match)
/*IF @cur_update_inv = 1 and @must_consume_from_wip = 1 and @qty_cons > 0 BEGIN
	SELECT @inv_wo_id = wo_id FROM item_inv	WHERE ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id AND item_id = @cur_item_id AND lot_no = @cur_lot_no
	IF @cur_wo_id <> @inv_wo_id BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Work Order for consumptiom does not match with inventory{3300}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END*/

--Added by Raghu on 08/06/2003. Required grade_cd does not match with inventory; if update_inv flag is turned on
--Checks if update_inventory flag is set to true, and reqd_grade code is not null. If true, then checks the current reason which falls under waste category,
--If the current reason is waste reason, proceed as it is, if it is not a waste reason, then the grade code in inventory should match. So, set the grade_cd to reqd_grade_cd
IF (@cur_update_inv = 1) AND (@reqd_grade_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK), item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id AND irg.reas_grp_type = 3 	AND ir.reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd)  BEGIN
		SET @checkGrade = 1
		SET @grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
	END
END

SELECT @inv_unique_by_job = inv_unique_by_job from item WITH(NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id

--If must_consume_from_wip is true; verify whether the current item has sufficient quantities in the inventory.
IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN

    SELECT @stoo_selcnt = 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		AND first_job != 1

	IF ( @stoo_selcnt <> 1 ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1 )
	END
	--RaghuK L00088636 Start
	ELSE IF (@bom_pos = 0 AND @cur_backflush = 1 ) BEGIN
		SET @temp_flag = 1
		DECLARE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor1 CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT ii.oper_id, ii.seq_no, ii.qty_left
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)  ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
		WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND ii.ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id
		  AND ii.item_id = @cur_item_id
		  AND (ii.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
	END
	--RaghuK L00088636 End

    ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @inv_oper_id = ii.oper_id, @inv_seq_no = ii.seq_no
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)  ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
		WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		  AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		  AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		  AND ii.ent_id = @cur_storage_ent_id
		  AND ii.item_id = @cur_item_id
		  AND (ii.lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (ii.grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
		  AND (ii.qty_left >= @qty_cons)
	END
END
ELSE IF @inv_unique_by_job = 1
BEGIN
	SELECT @inv_oper_id = @cur_oper_id, @inv_seq_no = @cur_seq_no

END

--HD# 5474, Raghu - Maintain distinct consumption records
SELECT @cur_qty_cons = NULL, @distinct_cons = '0'
SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')
IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
	SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_qty_cons = qty_cons FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
	  AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( shift_start_utc ) = @cur_shift_start_utc
	  AND item_id = @cur_item_id
	  AND (lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (fg_lot_no = @cur_fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_fg_lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (fg_sublot_no = @cur_fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
	  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
	  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
	  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))

	-- 10/26/2002	TC	1.5.0	Set row_id = ID of inserted row
	select @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots	@row_id, @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_local,@cur_shift_start_local_tz, @cur_item_id,

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_SplitJob]
(
@I_SessionId int,
@I_User_Name nvarchar(50),
@I_SelEvent nvarchar(50) ,
@I_EQLoaded nvarchar(MAX),
@I_CommandParam nvarchar(MAX) = NULL,
@commandreply nvarchar(max) = 'success' output
)
AS
BEGIN

Declare @ent_id int
Declare @attr_id int
Declare @maxBatchSize float
Declare @minBatchSize float
Declare @OrigJobQty float
Declare @jobQty float
Declare @tStr varchar(100)
Declare @wo_id STRING40
Declare @user_name STRING40
Declare @operId STRING40
Declare @priority INT32
Declare @starttime NVARCHAR(50)
Declare @endtime NVARCHAR(50)
Declare @jobSeqNo int
Declare @entId int
Declare @reqQty int--decimal(10,2)
Declare @splitQty INT32
Declare @isSplit int
Declare @isMerge int
Declare @mergeJobSeq int
Declare @QtyRemaining float
Declare @i int
Declare @cSeq_no int
Declare @cQty float
Declare @jobs table(seq_no int, qty float)
Declare @jobState int

	--commented 03.01.2018
	--select @ent_id=job_sched_entity_id,@OrigJobQty=req_qty from SDB..scheduler_exec where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
	--added 03.01.2018
	select @ent_id=job_sched_entity_id,@OrigJobQty=req_qty, @wo_id=wo_id,@operid=oper_id,@priority=job_priority,@starttime=job_latest_start_time,@endtime=job_req_finished_time,@jobseqno=job_seq_no,@reqqty=req_qty, @entid=job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)
	select @jobState = state_cd from job where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @operId and seq_no = @jobSeqNo
	
	if (@jobState in (1,2,5) or @jobstate is null)
	begin


					select @ent_id=IsNULL(@ent_id,-1)
	
					select @tStr=cast(@ent_id as varchar(50))  + ':' + cast(@OrigJobQty as varchar(50))
	
	
	
					select @attr_id=attr_id from attr  with (nolock) where attr_grp=2 and attr_desc='MinBatchSize'
					select @attr_id=IsNULL(@attr_id,-1)
					select @minBatchSize=attr_value from ent_attr  with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id and attr_id=@attr_id
					select @minBatchSize=isnull(@minBatchSize,-1)
					select @tStr=@tStr + ':'+ cast(@minBatchSize as varchar(50))

					select @attr_id=attr_id from attr  with (nolock) where attr_grp=2 and attr_desc='MaxBatchSize'
					select @attr_id=IsNULL(@attr_id,-1)
					select @maxBatchSize=attr_value from ent_attr  with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id and attr_id=@attr_id
					select @maxBatchSize=isnull(@maxBatchSize,-1)
					select @tStr=@tStr + ':'+ cast(@maxBatchSize as varchar(50))
	
					--exec SP_I_MDM_Sched_addLog	@type='Ititial data' ,@sp_name='SP_S_MDM_Sched_SplitJob',	@SessionId=@I_SessionId ,	@text1 =@I_SelEvent,	@text2 = @I_EQLoaded,@text3=@tStr

					Set @i=1
					Set @QtyRemaining=@OrigJobQty

					-- Check whether the Split By Number value is passed in the command param
					IF ISNUMERIC(@I_CommandParam) = 1 
					BEGIN
					SET @maxBatchSize = cast(CEILING(cast(@OrigJobQty as float)/cast(@I_CommandParam as int)) as int)
					END



					if( @maxBatchSize > 0)
					BEGIN
						WHILE @QtyRemaining > @maxBatchSize
						BEGIN
							insert into @jobs values(@i,@maxBatchSize)
							Set @i=@i+1
							Set @QtyRemaining=@QtyRemaining-@maxBatchSize
						END;
						insert into @jobs values(@i,@QtyRemaining)
						delete @jobs where seq_no=1
		
						declare @j int = @i
		
						DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR  
							SELECT  seq_no,qty
								FROM @jobs
									order by seq_no desc
						select @tStr=''--cast(@ent_id as varchar(50))  + ':' +
						OPEN db_cursor   
						FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @cSeq_no,@cQty

						WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
						BEGIN   
							select @tStr=@tStr+' '+cast(@cSeq_no as varchar(50))  + ':' +cast(@cQty as varchar(50))
							--commented 03.01.2018
							--select @wo_id=wo_id,@operid=oper_id,@priority=job_priority,@starttime=job_latest_start_time,@endtime=job_req_finished_time,@jobseqno=job_seq_no,@reqqty=req_qty, @entid=job_sched_entity_id from SDB..scheduler_exec where row_id=cast(@I_SelEvent as int)


							Set @reqqty=@reqqty-@cQty


							if @j=2
							exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=@operid,@priority=@priority,@starttime=@starttime,@endtime=@endtime,@jobseqno=@jobseqno,@entid=@entid,@reqqty=@reqqty ,@splitqty=@cQty,@issplit=1,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0,@sessionid=@I_SessionId, @returndata = 1
							else
							exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=@operid,@priority=@priority,@starttime=@starttime,@endtime=@endtime,@jobseqno=@jobseqno,@entid=@entid,@reqqty=@reqqty ,@splitqty=@cQty,@issplit=1,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0,@sessionid=@I_SessionId, @returndata = 0

							SET @j = @j - 1 

					   FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @cSeq_no,@cQty  
					END   
	
					CLOSE db_cursor   
					DEALLOCATE db_cursor 
		

					--exec SP_S_MDM_SCHED_UPDATE_SCHEDULED_JOB @wo_id=N'30000065',@user_name=@I_User_Name,@operid=N'Cooking',@priority=50,@starttime=N'2017-03-15 12:57:00',@endtime=N'2017-03-15 17:00:00',@jobseqno=0,@entid=50,@reqqty=4667,@splitqty=1333,@issplit=1,@ismerge=0,@mergejobseq=0
	
					END

					--exec SP_I_MDM_Sched_addLog	@type='split list' ,@sp_name='SP_S_MDM_Sched_SplitJob',	@SessionId=@I_SessionId ,	@text1 =@I_SelEvent,	@text2 = @tStr,@text3=''


				-- select * from SDB..scheduler_sessn where session_id=@I_SessionId

				SET @commandreply = 'success'
			END
			ELSE
			SET @commandreply = 'jobstateerror'

END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid -
-- Description:	   	To get the assign HU grid for the selected wo
--
-- Usage:			
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			SSB				2022-07-26						Initial version

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid_backup08_07_25]
	@wo_id nvarchar(30),
	@assign_status nvarchar(10)=null,
	@type nvarchar(20),
	@batch_no nvarchar(20),
	@item_id nvarchar(50),
	@spare1 nvarchar(50)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	--using assigntype since sometimes when the HUAssignGrid is null and item_inv has pallets no is set when it is null or else yes is set as default
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @assigntype nvarchar(30)='yes'
	declare @temp table
(
    tot_rows int,
    wo_id nvarchar(50),
    row_id int,
    ent_id int,
    sublot_no nvarchar(50),
	lot_no nvarchar(50),
    item_id nvarchar(50),
    item_desc nvarchar(50),
    itConcat nvarchar(MAX),
    qty_left float,
    uom_id int,
    abbreviation nvarchar(50),
    assign_status int,
    last_edit_at nvarchar(50),
    last_edit_by nvarchar(MAX)
)

if @type='grid'
BEGIN
	if @assign_status is null or @assign_status=0
	BEGIN
		if not exists(select * from ofi_AssignHuWoId where assign_status=0 or assign_status=1)
		BEGIN
					set @assign_status=null
					set @assigntype='no'
		END
	END

	declare @ent_id int
	SELECT @ent_id=e3.ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
inner join ent (nolock) e1 on e1.ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
inner join ent (nolock) e2 on e2.ent_id=e1.parent_ent_id
inner join ent (nolock) e3 on e3.ent_id=e2.parent_ent_id
	WHERE  final_job=1
	AND    wo_id=@wo_id

		print @assigntype
		print @ent_id
	if (@assign_status=1 or @assign_status is null) 
	BEGIN
			if @assigntype='no'
			BEGIN
				print 'no'
				

insert into @temp
select  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (Order by iv.row_id)as tot_rows,
				STRING_AGG(ai.wo_id,' , ')as wo_id,
				   iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2 as sublot_no,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.item_id,
				   i.item_desc,
				   ( '('+i.item_desc+')'+' '+iv.item_id) as itConcat,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,
				  -- ai.wo_id,
				    CONVERT(varchar,dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(null,iv.last_edit_at),22) as last_edit_at,
				   iv.last_edit_by
				  -- iv.row_id as inv_row_id
				 -- ai.row_id
				FROM       item_inv iv with (nolock)
				INNER JOIN uom (nolock) u
				ON         u.uom_id=iv.uom_id
				INNER JOIN item (nolock)i on i.item_id=iv.item_id
				LEFT JOIN  ofi_assignhuwoid ai
				ON         iv.spare2=ai.pallet_id where iv.spare2 is not null
				and iv.ent_id=@ent_id and
				(ai.assign_status is NULL  )   
				and (iv.lot_no like '%' + @batch_no + '%' or @batch_no is null or @batch_no='')
				and (iv.item_id=@item_id or @item_id is null or @item_id='')
			--	and (iv.spare1=@spare1 or @spare1 is null or @spare1='')
				group by  iv.row_id,
				   iv.ent_id,
				   iv.spare2,
				   iv.lot_no,
				   iv.qty_left,
				   iv.uom_id,
				   u.abbreviation,
				   ai.assign_status,           
				   iv.last_edit_at,
				    iv.last_edit_by,
