-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_GetKPI]
(@in_line_id                  INT32 = NULL
,@in_kpi_type                INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_time_unit        INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_start_time       INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_end_time         INT32 = NULL
) AS
BEGIN
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -    sp_SA_Line_GetKPI
-- Description          -    Get KPI for a line
--				UserStory: 406416 - As Michelle, I want to know the KPIs for a line so I can monitor performance of the entire line
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    11/19/2014
-- Version          - 5.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 Aveva Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
-- 09/13/2017	Raghu		6.0	US:909265-As Lenka, I don't want to have check constraint violations when starting / stopping jobs (CR L00146479)
--					Performance Improvements
-- 11/30/2017	Raghu G		6.0	UserStory-714529 - [Enhancement] As SE, I want to fix CR L00138956 so that OEE values are returned for short time periods without distinct production records
-- 04/06/2018	Raghu G		6.0	US-804232-As Bruce, I want to fix CR L00145026 so that I get a message back if TransferandUpdateInv does not have entities - failing db fit tests
-- 07/31/2019   Jim O'      6.2 Merging changes by Ashish from v5.3 hotfix CR L00150964/merge CR L00151774:  this change
--                              selects the util_ent_id from oee_exec when evaluating the bottleneck entity regarding an
--                              OEE util data configuration involving another entity
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
-- 07/15/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1339726-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00153667 so that the MES Web Portal Line Monitor page performs well with many items, inventory records, and storage entities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@line_id		INT32
	,@ent_id		INT32
	,@line_parent_ent_id	INT32
	,@type			INT32
	,@shift_id		INT32
	,@start			TDATETIME
	,@end			TDATETIME
	,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME
	,@max_shift_start_utc   TDATETIME
	,@max_shift_end_utc     TDATETIME
	,@min_shift_start_utc   TDATETIME
	,@min_shift_end_utc     TDATETIME
	,@cur_shift_start_utc   TDATETIME
	,@cur_shift_end_utc     TDATETIME
	,@std_item_id		STRING40_NULL
	,@item_desc		STRING80
	,@uom_description	STRING40
	,@ret			INT32

	,@prod_uom		INT32
	,@batch_size		TFLOAT
	,@to_uom_id		INT32
	,@total_runtime		TFLOAT
	,@total_downtime	TFLOAT
	,@total_good		TFLOAT
	,@total_rejected	TFLOAT
	,@prod_ent_child_pos	INT32
	,@availability		TFLOAT
	,@quality		TFLOAT
	,@performance		TFLOAT
	,@actual_performance	TFLOAT
	,@efficiency		TFLOAT
	,@target_util		TFLOAT
	,@target_qual		TFLOAT
	,@target_perf		TFLOAT
	,@target_oee		TFLOAT
	,@no_conv_fact_uom	INT32
	,@expected_perf_at_bott	TFLOAT
	,@prod_start_time_utc		TDATETIME2

DECLARE @production_data TABLE(item_id NVARCHAR(80), uom_id INT, qty_prod FLOAT, good_prod INT, child_order INT)
DECLARE @factors_for_items TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(80), factor FLOAT, offset FLOAT)
DECLARE @factors_generic TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(80), factor FLOAT, offset FLOAT)
DECLARE @bottleneck TABLE (ent_id INT, event_start_utc DATETIME2, event_end_utc DATETIME2, est_prod_rate FLOAT, runtime FLOAT, downtime FLOAT PRIMARY KEY (ent_id, event_start_utc, event_end_utc))
DECLARE @ents TABLE (ent_id INT NOT NULL, child_order INT PRIMARY KEY (ent_id))

	SELECT @line_id = @in_line_id, @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	IF (@in_line_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 may not be empty{5413},LINE_ID'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The specified line does not exist{7929}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg =  N'There are no entities in the supplied line:%1.{7890},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @in_line_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@in_kpi_type IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},KPI_TYPE'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	ELSE IF (@in_kpi_type < 0 OR @in_kpi_type > 3) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},KPI_TYPE,0,3'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the entity (any one) from the line.
	--The assumption is that all entities must have the same shift schedule and they all must be in the same time zone. If not, the SP will raise an error.
	SELECT TOP 1 @ent_id = lel.ent_id FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id

	EXEC @ret = sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes @ent_id=@ent_id, @filter_time_unit=@in_filter_time_unit
			, @filter_start_time=@in_filter_start_time, @filter_end_time=@in_filter_end_time
			, @start_time_utc=@start OUTPUT, @end_time_utc=@end OUTPUT
			, @prod_start_time_utc=@prod_start_time_utc OUTPUT

	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 1) BEGIN -- Filter Time Unit = 1 (Shift)
		SELECT @line_parent_ent_id = ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 1
		IF @line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
				   @cur_shift_end_utc = cur_shift_end_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id

		-- If current shift ended before now, parent entity used to have a shift schedule but doesn't anymore
		IF @cur_shift_start_utc IS NULL OR @cur_shift_end_utc <= GETUTCDATE() BEGIN
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1 -- Current shift
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
					, @min_shift_start_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)
					, @max_shift_end_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
					, @min_shift_end_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
				WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
				  AND lel.line_is_child = 0
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_start_utc)
						, @min_shift_start_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_start_utc)
						, @max_shift_end_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
						, @min_shift_end_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN shift_history sh_prev WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = sh_prev.ent_id AND DATEADD(SS,-1,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc) = sh_prev.shift_end_utc
				WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
				  AND lel.line_is_child = 0

			IF (@max_shift_start_utc<>@min_shift_start_utc OR @max_shift_end_utc<>@min_shift_end_utc) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Entities in line have differing shift schedules - querying by shift is not possible.{2031}'
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN -- There is a parent entity for the line with a legitimate shift schedule
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = @cur_shift_start_utc, @max_shift_end_utc = @cur_shift_end_utc
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @max_shift_end_utc = shift_end_utc
				FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND DATEADD(SS,-1,@cur_shift_start_utc) = shift_end_utc
		END

		SELECT @start = @max_shift_start_utc, @end = @max_shift_end_utc
	END -- End Filter Time Unit = 1 (Shift)

	--Default production start time to start, if null.
	SET @prod_start_time_utc = COALESCE(@max_shift_start_utc, @prod_start_time_utc, @start)

	--Retrieve the properties of the line
	SELECT @prod_uom = l.prod_uom, @batch_size = l.batch_size, @to_uom_id = i.uom_id
		, @target_util = l.target_util, @target_qual = l.target_qual, @target_perf = l.target_perf, @target_oee = l.target_oee
		, @std_item_id = l.std_item_id, @item_desc = i.item_desc,  @uom_description = uom.description
	FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.std_item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	WHERE l.line_id = @line_id

	INSERT INTO @bottleneck (ent_id, event_start_utc, event_end_utc, est_prod_rate, runtime, downtime)
	SELECT ul.ent_id
		--If the utilization start time is before the bottleneck start time, then limit to the bottleneck start time; otherwise use the utilization start time
		 ,CASE WHEN ul.event_time_utc < bottlenecks.start_time_utc THEN bottlenecks.start_time_utc ELSE ul.event_time_utc END AS event_start_utc
		--If the duration of the utilization event spans beyond the bottleneck end time for an entity, then limit to the bottleneck end time; otherwise, use the utilization end time
		, CASE WHEN ul.event_end_time_utc > bottlenecks.end_time_utc THEN bottlenecks.end_time_utc ELSE ul.event_end_time_utc END AS event_end_utc
		, bottlenecks.est_prod_rate
		--Determine whether the utilization is runtime or downtime
		, ul.runtime, ul.downtime
	FROM (SELECT bh.ent_id, CASE WHEN bh.start_time_utc < @start THEN @start ELSE bh.start_time_utc END AS start_time_utc
		, CASE WHEN COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) > @end THEN @end ELSE COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) END AS end_time_utc
		, est_prod_rate
		FROM bottleneck_history bh WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Limit to the supplied line
		WHERE bh.line_id = @line_id
		  AND bh.start_time_utc < @end
		  AND COALESCE(bh.end_time_utc, @end, @current_time_utc) >= @start) bottlenecks
	INNER JOIN vw_util_history_times ul WITH (NOLOCK) ON ul.ent_id =
	  (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottlenecks.ent_id)
	  AND ul.event_time_utc < bottlenecks.end_time_utc
	  AND ul.event_end_time_utc > bottlenecks.start_time_utc -- JO
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc
			FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh.ent_id = (SELECT util_ent_id FROM oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = bottlenecks.ent_id)
			  AND uh.event_time_utc <= bottlenecks.start_time_utc) util
	--Additionally, limit utilization start times that are before the filter end time
	WHERE ul.event_time_utc >= COALESCE(util.start_event_time_utc, @start)
	  AND ul.event_time_utc < @end
	  --Limit to the utilization events that are either runtime or downtime
	  AND (ul.runtime = 1 OR ul.downtime = 1)

	IF (@in_kpi_type IN (0,2,3)) BEGIN --0:Availability, 2:Performance, 3:OEE
		--Get Machine Availability
		SELECT --Determine the runtime and downtime durations
			@total_runtime = SUM(CASE WHEN util.runtime = 1 THEN DATEDIFF(SS, util.event_start_utc, util.event_end_utc) ELSE 0 END)
			, @total_downtime = SUM(CASE WHEN util.downtime = 1 THEN DATEDIFF(SS, util.event_start_utc, util.event_end_utc) ELSE 0 END)
		FROM @bottleneck util

		--Default the runtime and downtime duration to 0, if they are null
		SELECT @total_runtime = COALESCE(@total_runtime, 0), @total_downtime = COALESCE(@total_downtime, 0)

		--If the sum of total runtime and total downtime is zero, set the availability to 1 to avoid divide by zero error
		IF (@total_runtime + @total_downtime) = 0 SET @availability = 1

		--Calculate the line availability
		ELSE SET @availability = @total_runtime / (@total_runtime + @total_downtime)

	END

	IF (@in_kpi_type IN (1, 2, 3)) BEGIN --1:Quality, 2:Performance, 3:OEE
		--Determine the position of the production entity in the line
		SELECT @prod_ent_child_pos = lel.child_order
		FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Link to the production entity configured for this line
		INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id AND l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id
		--Limit to the supplied line
		WHERE l.line_id = @line_id

		--Verify whether a production entity is configured for this line
		IF (@prod_ent_child_pos IS NULL)
			--There is no production entity configured for this line.
			--Default to the entities in the last column position in this line.
			SELECT @prod_ent_child_pos = MAX(lel.child_order) FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0

		--Determine the expected production counts that falls in the given time period
		SELECT @expected_perf_at_bott = SUM(b.est_prod_rate * DATEDIFF(SS, b.event_start_utc, b.event_end_utc))
		FROM @bottleneck b
		WHERE b.runtime = 1 --Limit to the utilization events that are only runtime

		--Default the expected production counts to 1 to avoid divide-by-zero error
		IF COALESCE(@expected_perf_at_bott, 0) = 0
			SET @expected_perf_at_bott = 1

		INSERT INTO @ents (ent_id, child_order)
		SELECT le.ent_id, le.child_order FROM line_ent_link le WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Limit to the supplied line
		WHERE le.line_id = @line_id
		--Include all entities that appear before this child position (inclusive)
		AND le.child_order <= @prod_ent_child_pos

		INSERT INTO @production_data (item_id, uom_id, qty_prod, good_prod, child_order)
		SELECT iprod.item_id, i.uom_id, iprod.qty_prod, iprod.good_prod, lel.child_order
		 FROM item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.item_id = i.item_id
		 --Retrieve the measurement units
		 INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		 --Limit the production entities with the entities in the identified line
		 INNER JOIN @ents lel ON iprod.ent_id = lel.ent_id
		 WHERE iprod.created_at_utc >= @prod_start_time_utc AND iprod.created_at_utc < @end
		   --Exclude byproducts
		   AND iprod.byproduct = 0

		-- Determine the conversion factors that are specific to the items
		INSERT INTO @factors_for_items
		SELECT DISTINCT pd.item_id, uc.factor, uc.offset
		  FROM uom_conv uc WITH (NOLOCK)
		  --Limit to factors that convert from the production item's UOM to the line's UOM.
		  INNER JOIN @production_data pd ON uc.from_uom_id = pd.uom_id AND uc.to_uom_id = @to_uom_id AND uc.item_id = pd.item_id
		  --Limit to factors that are different than the line's UOM
		  WHERE pd.uom_id <> @to_uom_id

		--Determine the conversion factors that are generic (not specific to items)
		INSERT INTO @factors_generic
		SELECT DISTINCT pd.item_id, uc.factor, uc.offset
		  FROM uom_conv uc WITH (NOLOCK)
		  --Limit to factors that convert from the production item's UOM to the line's UOM.
		  INNER JOIN @production_data pd ON uc.from_uom_id = pd.uom_id AND uc.to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
		  LEFT OUTER JOIN @factors_for_items fi ON pd.item_id = fi.item_id
		  WHERE --Limit to factors that are different than the line's UOM
		    pd.uom_id <> @to_uom_id
		    --Exclude conversion factors that are specific to items
			AND uc.item_id IS NULL AND fi.item_id IS NULL

		  SELECT @total_good = SUM(line_prod.total_good) -- Sum up the good quantities
			--Sum up the reject quantities
			, @total_rejected = SUM(line_prod.total_rejected)
			--Calculate performance
			, @performance = SUM(line_prod.total_good + line_prod.total_rejected)
			--Determine whether there are any production records that do not have conversion factors
			, @no_conv_fact_uom = MIN(line_prod.no_conv_fact_uom)
		  FROM
			  (SELECT --Limit to  entities in the child order position where the good production is accounted
				--Limit to good quantities
				--The quantities do not need to be converted to line's UOM if the UOM of the production item is same as the UOM of the line's item.
				CASE WHEN pd.child_order = @prod_ent_child_pos AND pd.good_prod = 1 THEN
					CASE WHEN pd.uom_id = @to_uom_id THEN pd.qty_prod
					--Convert the production quantities into line's UOM.
					ELSE (pd.qty_prod * COALESCE(fi.factor, fg.factor, -9999999999)) + COALESCE(fi.offset, fg.offset, 0)
					END
				ELSE 0 END AS total_good
				--Limit to all entities in a line prior to the production entities (inclusive)
				--Limit to reject quantities
				--The quantities do not need to be converted to line's UOM if the UOM of the production item is same as the UOM of the line's item.
				, CASE WHEN pd.good_prod = 0 THEN
					CASE WHEN pd.uom_id = @to_uom_id THEN pd.qty_prod
					--Convert the rejected quantities into line's UOM.
					ELSE (pd.qty_prod * COALESCE(fi.factor, fg.factor, -9999999999)) + COALESCE(fi.offset, fg.offset, 0)
					END
				ELSE 0 END AS total_rejected
				--, pd.est_prod_rate, pd.prod_uom, pd.batch_size
				--, pd.uom_id
				--Determine whether there are any conversion factors missing
				, CASE WHEN pd.uom_id <> @to_uom_id AND COALESCE(fi.factor, fg.factor, -9999999999) <= -9999999999 THEN pd.uom_id ELSE NULL END AS no_conv_fact_uom
			  FROM @production_data pd
			  --Use item specific conversion factors, if available
			  LEFT OUTER JOIN @factors_for_items fi ON pd.item_id = fi.item_id
			  --Use generic conversion factors, if item specific factors are not available
			  LEFT OUTER JOIN @factors_generic fg ON pd.item_id = fg.item_id
			  ) line_prod

		IF @no_conv_fact_uom IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'There is production during this period using a UOM for which there is no conversion to that of the standard item for the line, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{2135}'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Default the total good quantities, total reject quantities, and the performance to 0, if they are null.
		SELECT @total_good = COALESCE(@total_good, 0), @total_rejected = COALESCE(@total_rejected, 0), @performance = COALESCE(@performance, 0)

		--If the sum of total good and total rejected is zero, set the quality to 1 to avoid divide by zero error.
		IF (@total_good + @total_rejected = 0) SET @quality = 1
		--Calculate the quality of the line
		ELSE SET @quality = @total_good / (@total_good + @total_rejected)

	END

	IF (@in_kpi_type IN (2, 3)) BEGIN --2:Performance, 3:OEE
		--If the total duration of runtime is zero, set the performance to 1 to avoid divide by zero error
		IF (@total_runtime = 0) SET @actual_performance = 1
		ELSE  --Calculate the performance
			SET @actual_performance = @performance / @expected_perf_at_bott
	END

	IF (@in_kpi_type = 3) -- OEE
		--Calculate the line efficiency
		SET @efficiency = @availability * @quality * @actual_performance

    	--Return all the KPI metrics
	SELECT @target_util AS target_util, @availability AS actual_util, @target_qual AS target_qual, @quality AS actual_qual
		, @target_perf AS target_perf, @actual_performance AS actual_perf, @target_oee AS target_oee, @efficiency AS actual_oee
		, @total_runtime AS total_runtime, @total_downtime AS total_downtime, @total_good AS total_good, @total_rejected AS total_rejects
		, @std_item_id AS std_item_id, @item_desc AS item_desc, @to_uom_id AS to_uom_id, @uom_description AS to_uom_description
END

CREATE Trigger [dbo].[tg_sample_freq_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[sample_freq]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_sample_freq_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on sample_freq table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Rich
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -  4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--  02-Feb-2012		Ahmed		4.5		update the db_status table when any of the following columns are updated
--										freq_name,freq_type,interval,interval_unit,offset_start,offset_start_unitoffset_end,offset_end_unit
--										samples_per_shift,enabled,expiry_time,expiry_unit,warning_time,warning_unit
--	12-Jul-2012		Ahmed		4.5		Modified to fix the CR 120951
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE sample_freq SET sample_freq.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, sample_freq.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE sample_freq.freq_id = i.freq_id

	IF EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0)
	BEGIN

		IF UPDATE(enabled) AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 INSERTED.freq_id,DELETED.freq_id FROM INSERTED INNER JOIN DELETED ON (INSERTED.freq_id=DELETED.freq_id) where(INSERTED.enabled=1 AND DELETED.enabled=0))
			BEGIN
				UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
			END
		ELSE IF( UPDATE(freq_name) OR UPDATE(freq_type) OR UPDATE(interval) OR UPDATE(interval_unit)
			OR UPDATE(offset_start) OR UPDATE(offset_start_unit) OR UPDATE(offset_end) OR UPDATE(offset_end_unit)
			OR UPDATE(samples_per_shift) OR (UPDATE(enabled) AND EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 INSERTED.freq_id,DELETED.freq_id FROM INSERTED INNER JOIN DELETED ON (INSERTED.freq_id=DELETED.freq_id) where(INSERTED.enabled=0 AND DELETED.enabled=1))) OR UPDATE(expiry_time) OR UPDATE(expiry_unit)
			OR UPDATE(warning_time)OR UPDATE(warning_unit))
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 sample_to_go.freq_id FROM sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_to_go.freq_id IN (SELECT INSERTED.freq_id FROM INSERTED))
					BEGIN
						UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
					END
			END
	END

END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_auto_release_check]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch the information for release
--
-- Usage:
--EXEC [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_auto_release_check]
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author						Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AP				2023-11-14			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	LK				2024-03-28			Extracting only those wo who are in new state
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_auto_release_check]
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @ent_id INT;
	DECLARE @ent_name NVARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @oper_id NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @seq_no INT
	DECLARE @Json NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @enableLablePreview INT
	DECLARE @wodetailsTable TABLE
	(
		wo_id              NVARCHAR(40)
	  , oper_id            NVARCHAR(100)
	  , seq_no             INT
	  , enableLablePreview INT
	)

	DECLARE @BomCompareTable TABLE
	(
		wo_id       NVARCHAR(40)
	  , oper_id     NVARCHAR(100)
	  , seq_no      INT
	  , result_code INT
	  , faild_msg   NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , bom_item    NVARCHAR(MAX)
	)

	DECLARE @entCompareTableTemp TABLE
	(
		attr_value              NVARCHAR(100)
	  , targer_sched_ent_id     INT
	  , state_desc              NVARCHAR(40)
	  , state_cd                INT
	  , oper_id                 NVARCHAR(100)
	  , wo_id                   NVARCHAR(40)
	  , seq_no                  INT
	  , splitvischeck           INT
	  , release_ent_type        NVARCHAR(100)
	  , allow_multipul_releases INT
	  , ID                      INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
	)

	DECLARE @entCompareTable TABLE
	(
		attr_value              NVARCHAR(100)
	  , targer_sched_ent_id     INT
	  , state_desc              NVARCHAR(40)
	  , state_cd                INT
	  , oper_id                 NVARCHAR(100)
	  , wo_id                   NVARCHAR(40)
	  , seq_no                  INT
	  , splitvischeck           INT
	  , release_ent_type        NVARCHAR(100)
	  , allow_multipul_releases INT
	  , enableLablePreview      INT
	  , ID                      INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
	)

	SELECT
		@ent_id = ea.ent_id
	  , @ent_name = e.ent_name
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ATTR a WITH(NOLOCK) ON
		a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
		AND attr_desc = 'EntityType'
		AND attr_grp = 2
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	WHERE attr_value = 'Site'
	-- Get the auto relese enebaled WO and job details 
	INSERT INTO @wodetailsTable
	(
		wo_id
	  , oper_id
	  , seq_no
	  , enableLablePreview
	)
	SELECT
		j.wo_id
	  , j.oper_id
	  , j.seq_no
	  , ISNULL(op1.attr_value, 0)
	FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN oper o WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.oper_id = o.oper_id
		 INNER JOIN oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK) ON
		 	o.oper_id = oa.oper_id
		 	AND oa.attr_value = 'True'
		 INNER JOIN attr ap WITH(NOLOCK) ON
		 	ap.attr_id = oa.attr_id
		 	AND ap.attr_desc = 'CanAutoRelease'
	LEFT JOIN oper_attr op1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON --get the details for label printing 
		j.oper_id = op1.oper_id
		AND op1.attr_value = '1'
		AND op1.attr_id = (SELECT
							   attr_id
						   FROM attr
						   WHERE
							   attr_grp = '7'
							   AND attr_desc = 'enableLablePreview')
	--WHERE wo_id = '1001111952'
	WHERE wo_id IN (SELECT
						  w.wo_id
					  FROM wo w WITH(NOLOCK)
					  INNER JOIN wo_attr wa WITH(NOLOCK) ON
						  w.wo_id = wa.wo_id
						  AND wa.attr_value = 'True'
					  INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON
						  a.attr_id = wa.attr_id
						  AND a.attr_desc = 'NewOrderCheck'
						  where w.state_cd=0  -- 0.01.01
						  )

	DECLARE wodetailscursor CURSOR
	FOR SELECT DISTINCT
			wo_id
		FROM @wodetailsTable

	OPEN wodetailscursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM wodetailscursor INTO @wo_id

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @entCompareTableTemp
		(
			attr_value
		  , targer_sched_ent_id
		  , state_desc
		  , state_cd
		  , oper_id
		  , wo_id
		  , seq_no
		  , splitvischeck
		  , release_ent_type
		  , allow_multipul_releases
		)
		EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_MasterJobDetails]
			 @wo_id
		   , NULL
		   , NULL
		   , 'getjob'

		FETCH NEXT FROM wodetailscursor INTO @wo_id
	END

	CLOSE wodetailscursor
	DEALLOCATE wodetailscursor

	---To filter the  for oper_id  where the attribute value is set true 
	DECLARE wodetailscursor CURSOR
	FOR SELECT DISTINCT
			wo_id
		  , oper_id
		  , seq_no
		  , enableLablePreview
		FROM @wodetailsTable

	OPEN wodetailscursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM wodetailscursor INTO @wo_id
									   , @oper_id
									   , @seq_no
									   , @enableLablePreview

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @entCompareTable
		(
			attr_value
		  , targer_sched_ent_id
		  , state_desc
		  , state_cd
		  , oper_id
		  , wo_id
		  , seq_no
		  , splitvischeck
		  , release_ent_type
		  , allow_multipul_releases
		  , enableLablePreview
		)
		SELECT
			attr_value
		  , targer_sched_ent_id
		  , state_desc
		  , state_cd
		  , oper_id
		  , wo_id
		  , seq_no
		  , splitvischeck
		  , release_ent_type
		  , allow_multipul_releases
		  , @enableLablePreview
		FROM @entCompareTableTemp
		WHERE
			wo_id = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no

		FETCH NEXT FROM wodetailscursor INTO @wo_id
										   , @oper_id
										   , @seq_no
										   , @enableLablePreview
	END

	CLOSE wodetailscursor
	DEALLOCATE wodetailscursor

	--To get the BOM details for the valid WO 
	SET @Json = (SELECT
					 wo_id
				   , oper_id
				   , seq_no
				 FROM @entCompareTable
				 WHERE release_ent_type LIKE('%' + attr_value + '%') FOR JSON AUTO)
	
	--select @Json
	INSERT INTO @BomCompareTable
	EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_BOMCompares]
		 @Json

	--SELECT		*	FROM @entCompareTableTemp
	--SELECT	*	FROM @entCompareTable
	--;WITH CTE AS (
	SELECT -- *,
		CASE
			WHEN a.release_ent_type LIKE('%' + a.attr_value + '%')
			THEN 'True'
			ELSE 'False'
		END                  release_ent_check
	  , ISNULL(CASE
				   WHEN a.release_ent_type LIKE('%' + a.attr_value + '%')
				   THEN CASE
							WHEN
		b.result_code = 1
		OR a.release_ent_type <> 'Segment'
							THEN 'True'
							ELSE CASE
									 WHEN b.result_code = 5
									 THEN 'True'--True
									 ELSE 'False'
								 END
						END
			   END, 'False')  AS auto_release_chck
	  , CASE
			WHEN a.enableLablePreview = 1
			THEN 'True'
			ELSE 'False'
		END AS               enableLablePreview
	  , a.wo_id
	  , a.oper_id
	  , a.seq_no
	  , b.result_code
	  , CASE
			WHEN a.release_ent_type LIKE('%' + a.attr_value + '%')
			THEN b.faild_msg
			ELSE [dbo].[fn_s_ofi_getLangString]  (300053,null,10)--Error code
		END                  faild_msg
	  , b.bom_item
	  , a.release_ent_type
	  , a.attr_value
	  , a.targer_sched_ent_id
	  , a.state_cd
	  , a.splitvischeck
	  , a.allow_multipul_releases
	  , a.ID
	  , j.item_id
	  , @ent_id AS           site_id
	  , @ent_name AS         site_name
	FROM @entCompareTable a
	LEFT JOIN @BomCompareTable b ON
		a.wo_id = b.wo_id
		AND a.seq_no = b.seq_no
		AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
	INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON
		a.wo_id = j.wo_id
		AND a.seq_no = j.seq_no
		AND a.oper_id = j.oper_id
	ORDER BY
		a.id

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Inv]
(
	@row_id int,
	@ent_id  int  ,
	@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@sublot_no	nvarchar(40) ,
	@grade_cd  int  ,
	@status_cd  int  ,
	@uom_id int ,
	@date_in_utc datetime,
	@date_in_local datetime,
	@date_in_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@date_out_utc datetime,
	@date_out_local datetime,
	@date_out_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@expiry_date  datetime  ,
	@expiry_date_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@seq_no  int ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime ,
	@time_zone_bias_value int = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.10
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 01/05/2005		SJ				21010		HD#5267 - Include relevant uom.description in result set
-- 02/09/2005		Raghu			2.1.13		HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 06/03/2005		Raghu			2.1.22		Included columns 'shippable_grade' and 'shippable_state' which returns 1 or 0
-- 09/21/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/25/2006		Raghu			3.1.20		HD# 8489, Lot Number Dropdown list in Shipment Lot Grid -- Customers Window
-- 01/26/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes; Added item.inv_unique_by_job column to the select clause.
-- 07/12/2007		AML				3.2.1		Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
-- 07/30/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 12/24/2007		AML				3.4.0		Added @sublot_no
-- 01/07/2010		Kishore			4.0			HF1432
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN




-- Added 07/30/2007 AML
DECLARE @tz_temp		INT,
		@dbg_resp		INT32
--	,	@date_in_utc	DATETIME
--	,	@date_out_utc	DATETIME

	SET @date_in_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_in_tz)
	SET @date_out_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_out_tz)
  	SET @expiry_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@expiry_date_tz)

  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)


  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Item_Inv', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @date_in_local, @numeric_val1 = @date_in_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @date_out_local, @numeric_val2 = @date_out_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @expiry_date, @numeric_val3 = @expiry_date_tz


--Fix for CR L00092686, both local and UTC times are passed in and should be used as is
--SET @tz_temp = -@date_in_tz
--EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @date_in_local, @tz_temp, @date_in_utc OUTPUT
--SET @tz_temp = -@date_out_tz
--EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @date_out_local, @tz_temp, @date_out_utc OUTPUT

IF @expiry_date IS NOT NULL SET @expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@expiry_date_tz, @expiry_date)

SELECT	item_inv.row_id
	,	item_inv.ent_id
	,	item_inv.item_id
	,	item_inv.lot_no
	,	item_inv.sublot_no
	,	item_inv.grade_cd
	,	item_inv.status_cd
	,	ent.ent_name
	,	item.item_desc
	,	item.uom_id item_uom_id
	,	item.inv_unique_by_job
	,	item_grade.item_grade_desc
	,	item_grade.color grade_color
	,	item_state.item_status_desc
	,	item_state.color state_color
	,	item_inv.qty_left
	,	item_inv.qty_left_erp
	,	item_inv.uom_id
	,	item_inv.date_in_utc
	,	item_inv.date_in_local
	,	DATEADD(mi, @date_in_tz, item_inv.date_in_utc) AS date_in
	,	item_inv.date_out_utc
	,	item_inv.date_out_local
	,	DATEADD(mi, @date_out_tz, item_inv.date_out_utc) AS date_out
	,	item_inv.expiry_date
	,	item_inv.wo_id
	,	item_inv.oper_id
	,	item_inv.seq_no
	,	item_inv.spare1
	,	item_inv.spare2
	,	item_inv.spare3
	,	item_inv.spare4
	,	item_inv.spare5
	,	item_inv.spare6
	,	item.num_decimals
	,	item_inv.last_edit_comment
	,	item_inv.last_edit_by
	,	item_inv.last_edit_at
	,	CASE
			WHEN item_inv.uom_id IS NULL THEN (SELECT description from uom where uom_id = item.uom_id)
			ELSE (SELECT description from uom where uom_id = item_inv.uom_id)
		END uom_desc
	,	ISNULL(
			(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade i_grade ON ISNULL(item.min_grade, -1) = i_grade.item_grade_cd
				WHERE ii.item_id = item_inv.item_id AND (ii.lot_no = item_inv.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND item_inv.lot_no IS NULL))
					/*AND ii.grade_cd >= ISNULL(item.min_grade, -1)*/
					AND item_grade.pref <= ISNULL(i_grade.pref, item_grade.pref)), 0) AS shippable_grade_h
	,	ISNULL(
			(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state i_state ON ISNULL(item.min_state, -1) = i_state.item_status_cd
				WHERE ii.item_id = item_inv.item_id AND (ii.lot_no = item_inv.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND item_inv.lot_no IS NULL))
				/*AND ii.status_cd >= ISNULL(item.min_state, -1)*/
				AND item_state.pref <= ISNULL(i_state.pref, item_state.pref)), 0) AS shippable_state_h
FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	INNER JOIN item_state item_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
WHERE ((item_inv.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
	   (item_inv.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.date_in_local >= @date_in_local OR @date_in_local IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.date_out_local >= @date_out_local OR @date_out_local IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.expiry_date >= @expiry_date OR @expiry_date IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (item_inv.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, item.item_desc, item_grade.item_grade_desc
END

AFTER UPDATE
AS

-- Module Name        - tg_item_grade_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_grade table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Job]
(@wo_id nvarchar(40)
,@oper_id nvarchar(40)
,@seq_no int
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version        - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
-- 01/15/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8314, part of DB changes - delete related assigned_lot records with job
--04/26/2007    Raghu      3.2.10   HD# 8314, Cascade delete assigned_lots associated related to this job
--07/10/2014	Raghu		5.0	Userstory: 348566 - As Jack, I want to prohibit MES client from making changes to work orders assigned to lines that would make them incompatible with the line to which they were assigned so that I do not create a problem for the Web client (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- First delete all rows in job_route as cascade delete cannot be defined for this job as an input route as well as an
-- output route
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @upstream_ent_name	NVARCHAR(80)
	 ,@downstream_ent_name	NVARCHAR(80)
	 ,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@line_name		NVARCHAR(80)

-- Delete related assigned_lot records 1/15/07 KRF
DELETE assigned_lot
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	AND  (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	AND  (seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)

-- Other table rows will be deleted by the DBMS cascade delete
-- Ensure that @numrows affected is set correctly
--SET NOCOUNT OFF
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM assigned_lot WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
			  AND seq_no IS NOT NULL)
	DELETE FROM assigned_lot
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)

DELETE job_route
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	AND (((oper_id = @oper_id  OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)) OR
	 ((input_oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND (input_seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)))

-- Finally delete the row in the ent table
DELETE job
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	AND  (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	AND  (seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)


EXEC sp_U_Wo_ValJobRteWithLineRte @wo_id = @wo_id, @upstream_ent_name = @upstream_ent_name OUTPUT, @downstream_ent_name	= @downstream_ent_name OUTPUT

IF (@upstream_ent_name IS NOT NULL OR @downstream_ent_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @line_name = l.line_name
	FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
	WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

	SET @err_msg = 'The work order: %1 is currently assigned to line: %2. The job cannot be deleted, because the sequence of entities (upstream entity: %3, downstream entity: %4) in the job route do not match with the sequence of entities in the line route.{7920},' + @wo_id + ',' + @line_name + ',' + COALESCE(@upstream_ent_name, '') + ',' + COALESCE(@downstream_ent_name, '')
	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_lm_label_preview
-- Description:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
--
-- Usage:	Gets triggered from Automation when DCS sends print command
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-07			Initial version. 
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM    2026-02-20          Deleted Synonym logic
-- 0.02.01  AML, XPM    2026-03-03			Optimization of the updates
-- 0.02.02  AML, XPM    2026-03-04          Updated how we get the HUNo and insert data using mapping
-- 0.02.03  AML, XPM    2026-03-09          Updated the label_heading and label_quantity so they fit the NiceLabel Names.
-- 0.03.00  AML, XPM    2026-03-16          Adapted to new  Header/Details tables structure & SYSTEM_USER
-- 0.03.01	AML, XPM    2026-05-11          Updated logic to obtain Netto weight per bag using UOM conversion
-- 0.03.02  AML, XPM    2026-05-18			Added date format yyyy-MM-dd and dd-MM-yyyy
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_lm_label_preview] 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
	,@ent_id INT=NULL
	,@fault_code INT=0
	,@lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)=NULL OUTPUT
	
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @layoutTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1), value NVARCHAR(50));
	
	DECLARE  @layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@layout_name NVARCHAR(50) = 'DEFAULT'
			,@layout_id	NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@showkosher NVARCHAR(10) = '0'
			,@hidekosher NVARCHAR(10) = '1'
			,@splitCount INT = 0
			,@printer_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@label_header NVARCHAR(200)
			,@print_qty INT
			,@overlayDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
			,@TypeOfLblContent INT = 2
			,@swHasCustomerRichText INT = 0
			,@jobGrpId INT = 5 
			,@hu NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
			,@swShowLB INT = 0
			,@itemUOM NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
			,@swIsReject BIT = 0
			,@swIsBigBag BIT = 0
			,@raw_ent_id INT
			,@actl_ent_id INT
			,@raw_attr_value NVARCHAR(50)
			,@defaultShelfLife INT = 0
			,@HUGenrationTime DATE 
			,@expiry_date NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
			,@trigger_type  NVARCHAR(100) = 'preview';

	DECLARE @plant_code AS INT,
			@line_no VARCHAR(10),
			@year VARCHAR(2),
			@month VARCHAR(2),
			@day VARCHAR(2),
			@parent_ent_id INT;

	DECLARE  @item_id NVARCHAR(100)
			,@bag_weight_qty FLOAT = 0
			,@itemLifetime INT = 0;


	SELECT @ent_id = j.run_ent_id, @item_id = j.item_id 
	FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no;

	--  Get Layout 
	SELECT @layout_ofi_wo_ext = owe.layout_name	
	FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE owe.wo_id = @wo_id;

	IF (@layout_ofi_wo_ext IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN	
		INSERT INTO @layoutTable SELECT value FROM fn_Split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-');
		SELECT @layout_name = ISNULL(value, 'DEFAULT') FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id = 1;
		SELECT @showkosher = ISNULL(value, '0') FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id = 2;
	END

	SET @showkosher = COALESCE(@showkosher,'0');
	SET @hidekosher = CASE WHEN @showkosher = '1' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END;

	-- 3. Calculate HU exactly as in HU Request
	SELECT @plant_code = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'HUPlantCode';
	SET @year = CAST(right(year(getDate()), 2) AS VARCHAR(2));
	SET @day = CAST(FORMAT(getdate(), 'dd') AS VARCHAR(2));
	SET @month = CAST(FORMAT(getdate(), 'MM') AS VARCHAR(2));

	SELECT @parent_ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
	FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = e.ent_id
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no;

	SELECT @line_no = ea.attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
	WHERE a.attr_desc = 'LineCode' AND ent_id = @parent_ent_id;
	
	SET @hu = CONCAT(@plant_code, @line_no,0, @year, @month, @day,000,0);
	

	-- 4. Get item Lifetime & UOM
	SELECT @itemLifetime = ISNULL(i.lifetime, 0), @itemUOM = LOWER(u.description)
	FROM item i WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	WHERE i.item_id = @item_id;

	SET @swShowLB = CASE WHEN @itemUOM = 'lb' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

	-- 5. Expiry Date Logic
	IF (@itemLifetime > 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HUGenrationTime = ISNULL(CAST(MIN(created_at_local) AS DATE), GETDATE()) 
			FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ip.spare2 = @hu;
			SET @expiry_date = FORMAT([dbo].[fn_lm_getDatePartFromLifetime](@HUGenrationTime, @itemLifetime), 'dd-MM-yyyy');	
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @raw_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no;

			SELECT @raw_attr_value = ea.attr_value FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			WHERE ea.ent_id = @raw_ent_id AND a.attr_desc LIKE '%EntityType%';

			SET @actl_ent_id = @raw_ent_id;
			IF (@raw_attr_value = 'Segment')
				BEGIN
					SELECT @actl_ent_id = e.parent_ent_id FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @raw_ent_id;
				END

			SELECT @defaultShelfLife = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(ea.attr_value AS INT)), 0)
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			WHERE ea.ent_id = @actl_ent_id AND a.attr_desc = 'DefaultShelfLife';

			IF (@defaultShelfLife > 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @HUGenrationTime = ISNULL(CAST(MIN(created_at_local) AS DATE), GETDATE()) 
				FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ip.spare2 = @hu;
				SET @expiry_date = FORMAT([dbo].[fn_lm_getDatePartFromLifetime](@HUGenrationTime, @defaultShelfLife), 'dd-MM-yyyy');			
			END
		END

	-- 6. Header and Fault Code
	SET @label_header = CASE 
		WHEN ISNULL(@fault_code, 0) = 0 THEN 'NORMAL_BAG'
		WHEN @fault_code = -1 THEN 'METAL'
		WHEN @fault_code = -2 THEN 'METAL_TEST'
		WHEN @fault_code = -3 THEN 'FLUSH'
		WHEN @fault_code = -4 THEN 'WEIGHT_HIGH'
		WHEN @fault_code = -5 THEN 'WEIGHT_LOW'
		WHEN @fault_code = -6 THEN 'NO_DATA'
	END;
	
	SET @swIsReject = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@fault_code, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

	-- 7. Bag Weight & Big Bag Logic
	DECLARE @bag_weight_qty_attr FLOAT = 0, @sum_qty_good FLOAT = 0, @sum_qty_reject FLOAT = 0;

	SELECT @swIsBigBag = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(ia.attr_value AS INT)), 0)
	FROM item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE ia.item_id = @item_id AND a.attr_desc = 'IsBigBag';

	


	IF (@swIsBigBag = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @bag_weight_qty_attr = factor 
		FROM uom_conv uc WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN uom fr WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.from_uom_id = fr.uom_id
		JOIN uom t WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.to_uom_id = t.uom_id
		WHERE item_id = @item_id 
		AND fr.description = 'BAG'
		AND t.description = @itemUOM
		SET @bag_weight_qty = @bag_weight_qty_attr;
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @bag_weight_qty_attr = factor 
		FROM uom_conv uc WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN uom fr WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.from_uom_id = fr.uom_id
		JOIN uom t WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.to_uom_id = t.uom_id
		WHERE item_id = @item_id 
		AND fr.description = 'BBG'
		AND t.description = @itemUOM
		SET @bag_weight_qty = @bag_weight_qty_attr;
		--SELECT 
		--@sum_qty_good = SUM(CASE WHEN good_prod = 1 THEN qty_prod ELSE 0 END),
		--@sum_qty_reject = SUM(CASE WHEN good_prod = 0 THEN qty_prod ELSE 0 END)
		--FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
		--WHERE ip.wo_id = @wo_id AND ip.oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND ip.spare2 = @hu;
		--IF (@swIsReject = 0)
		--	SET @bag_weight_qty = COALESCE(NULLIF(@sum_qty_good, 0), @bag_weight_qty_attr);
		--ELSE	
		--	SET @bag_weight_qty = @sum_qty_reject;
	END

	-- 8. Job Attributes (Overlay & Content)
	SELECT 
		 @overlayDetails = MAX(CASE WHEN a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details' THEN ja.attr_value END)
		,@TypeOfLblContent = ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent' THEN CAST(ja.attr_value AS INT) END), 2)
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ja.attr_id = a.attr_id
	WHERE ja.wo_id = @wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no AND a.attr_grp = @jobGrpId;

	IF (ISNULL(@overlayDetails, '') <> '')
		SET @swHasCustomerRichText = CASE WHEN @TypeOfLblContent = 2 THEN 1 WHEN @TypeOfLblContent = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END;

	-- 9. Get Layout ID and Printers
	SELECT @layout_id = ln.layout_id FROM ofi_lm_layout_name ln WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ln.layout_name = @layout_name;

	SELECT @printer_id = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterName(@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no);
	SELECT @print_qty = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterPrintQty(@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no); 


	EXEC sp_I_ofi_lm_print_label_header 
			@layout_id = @layout_id, 
			@printer_id = @printer_id, 
			@wo_id = @wo_id, 
			@hu = @hu, 
			@label_type = @trigger_type, 
			@label_name = @lbl_name OUTPUT;


	DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';
	SELECT @Query = @Query + 
		N'INSERT INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at) ' +
		N'SELECT TOP 1 @p_lbl_name, ''' + attr.record_title + ''', CAST(' + QUOTENAME(map.column_name) + N' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''' + ISNULL(attr.default_value,'') + ''', ''' + attr.as_value + ''', ' + CAST(ISNULL(attr.min_length,0) AS NVARCHAR) + ', ' + CAST(ISNULL(attr.max_length,100) AS NVARCHAR) + ', ''' + ISNULL(attr.pattern,'STRING') + ''', ' + CAST(ISNULL(attr.editable,0) AS NVARCHAR) + ', NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE() ' +
		N'FROM ' + QUOTENAME(map.table_name) + N' WITH(NOLOCK) ' +
		N'WHERE ' + 
		CASE map.filter_id 
			WHEN 'wo' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id'
			WHEN 'job_item' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND oper_id = @p_oper_id AND seq_no = @p_seq_no AND item_id = @p_item_id'
			WHEN 'item' THEN N'item_id = @p_item_id '
			WHEN 'job' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND oper_id = @p_oper_id AND seq_no = @p_seq_no'
			WHEN 'wo_item' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND item_id = @p_item_id'
			WHEN 'ent' THEN N'ent_id = @p_ent_id'
			WHEN 'job_run_ent' THEN N'wo_id = @p_wo_id AND oper_id = @p_oper_id AND seq_no = @p_seq_no AND run_ent_id = @p_ent_id'
	    END + N'; ' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)
	FROM ofi_lm_layout_attr_mapping attr WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ofi_lm_mes_info_mapping map WITH(NOLOCK) ON attr.record_title = map.title
	WHERE attr.layout_id = @layout_id;

	IF LEN(@Query) > 0
	BEGIN
		EXEC sp_executesql 
			@stmt = @Query, 
			@params = N'@p_wo_id NVARCHAR(100), @p_oper_id NVARCHAR(100), @p_seq_no INT, @p_item_id NVARCHAR(100), @p_ent_id INT, @p_lbl_name NVARCHAR(100)', 
			@p_wo_id = @wo_id, 
			@p_oper_id = @oper_id,
			@p_seq_no = @seq_no,
			@p_item_id = @item_id,
			@p_ent_id = @ent_id,
			@p_lbl_name = @lbl_name;
	END

	MERGE INTO ofi_lm_print_label_details AS tgt
	USING (
		VALUES
		 (@lbl_name, 'label name', @lbl_name, @lbl_name, 'lbl_name', 0, 100, 'STRING', 0, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'layout name', @layout_name, @layout_name, 'layout_name', 0, 100, 'STRING', 0, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'printer_id', @printer_id, @printer_id, 'printer_id', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())    
		,(@lbl_name, 'lbl_heading', @label_header, @label_header, 'lbl_heading', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'label_quantity', CAST(@print_qty as NVARCHAR(20)), '1', 'label_quantity', 0, 100, 'INT', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'BestBeforeDateFormatted', CAST(RIGHT(@expiry_date, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(@expiry_date, 4, 2) + '-' + LEFT(@expiry_date, 2) AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(RIGHT(@expiry_date, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(@expiry_date, 4, 2) + '-' + LEFT(@expiry_date, 2) AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'BestBeforeDateFormatted', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'BestBeforeDate_DMY', CAST(@expiry_date AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(@expiry_date AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'BestBeforeDate_DMY', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'DayOfWeek_Date', CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'DayOfWeek_Date', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'ProductionDateFormatted', CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'yyyy-MM-dd') AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'ProductionDateFormatted', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'ProductionDate_DMY', CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'dd-MM-yyyy') AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(FORMAT(@HUGenrationTime ,'dd-MM-yyyy') AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'ProductionDate_DMY', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swHideKosherLogo', CAST(@hidekosher AS NVARCHAR(50)), '1', 'swHideKosherLogo', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swShowKosherLogo', CAST(@showkosher AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swShowKosherLogo', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swIsReject', CAST(@swIsReject AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swIsReject', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swShowLB', CAST(@swShowLB AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swShowLB', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swIsBigBag', CAST(@swIsBigBag AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swIsBigBag', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swHasCustomerRichText', CAST(@swHasCustomerRichText AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0', 'swHasCustomerRichText', 0, 50, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'WeightInKG', CASE WHEN @swIsBigBag = 0 AND @swShowLB = 0 THEN CAST(@bag_weight_qty AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, NULL, 'WeightInKG', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'WeightInLB', CASE WHEN @swIsBigBag = 0 AND @swShowLB = 1 THEN CAST(@bag_weight_qty AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, NULL, 'WeightInLB', 0, 100, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'CustomerRichText', CASE WHEN @overlayDetails IS NOT NULL AND @overlayDetails != '' THEN CAST(@overlayDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, NULL, 'CustomerRichText', 0, 5500, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'swTypeOfLblContent', CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@TypeOfLblContent AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE '0' END, CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@TypeOfLblContent AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE '0' END, 'swTypeOfLblContent', 0, 5, 'int', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'imagePath', CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@overlayDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN @swHasCustomerRichText = 2 THEN CAST(@overlayDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) ELSE NULL END, 'imagePath', 0, 255, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
		,(@lbl_name, 'ProductionCode', CAST(@hu AS NVARCHAR(150)), CAST(@hu AS NVARCHAR(150)), 'ProductionCode', 0, 150, 'STRING', 1, NULL, GETUTCDATE(), SYSTEM_USER, GETUTCDATE())
	) AS src (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	ON tgt.label_id = src.label_id AND tgt.as_value = src.as_value
	WHEN MATCHED THEN
		UPDATE SET 
			actual_value = ISNULL(src.actual_value, tgt.actual_value), 
			last_edit_at = src.last_edit_at, 
			last_edit_by = src.last_edit_by
	WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
		INSERT (label_id, record_title, actual_value, default_value, as_value, min_length, max_length, pattern, editable, manual_value, created_at, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES (src.label_id, src.record_title, src.actual_value, src.default_value, src.as_value, src.min_length, src.max_length, src.pattern, src.editable, src.manual_value, src.created_at, src.last_edit_by, src.last_edit_at);

	SELECT @lbl_name AS lbl_name;

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_chKDestinationValidity]
(@storage_ent_id INT
--,@silo_type STRING80 -- Source or Destination
,@inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- inventory item 
,@inv_grade_cd int		-- inv grade cd
,@jb_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- job bom item id
,@jb_grade_cd int			-- jb grade cd
,@wo_id  nvarchar(40) 
,@oper_id nvarchar(80) 
,@seq_no	int
,@job_ent_id int
) 

--RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable

RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  isNotValidEnt int
		  ,notValidDescDetails nvarchar(max)
		  ,storage_ent_id int
		  ,item_attr_id NVARCHAR(100) NULL
		  ,item_attr_value NVARCHAR(100) NULL
		  ,grade_cd INT NULL
		  ,grade_desc nvarchar(50) NULL
		)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_chkSiloValidity
-- Description       - Returns the silo validity based on dIFferent parameters
-- Author			 - DS
-- Date Created      - 14/09/2022
-- Version			 - 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_ModIFied  ModIFied_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 14/09/2022     DS 			 1.0		Initial version
-- 23/05/2023	  YG			 2.0		Add checking : silo is fully empty
-- 23/08/2023     DS			 3.0		#279 making changes to enable silos for source as destination for liquer blending 
-- 05/09/2023     DS			 4.0		#279 If the selected source silo has more than the quantity required as per BOM/recipe, 
--											 then it will be disabled for destination selection. Only when the tank has the 
--											 Quantity = BOM Quantity +/- Silo threshold, then it will be enabled for destination selection.
--											 Proposal is to use the same silo threshold that is being used in consumption mode 
--											 setup( to consume all if below this threshold). 
--											
-- 05/10/2023     DS			 5.0		#279 If a user selects a destination silo that has also been chosen as one of the source silos,
--											the system will restrict from saving of the destination silo if the user has not allocated the 
--											entire quantity of that silo for consumption in source selection
-- 19/12/2023	  CK			 6.0		Adding code for Unique Item SU	
-- 14/01/2024     DS			 7.0		Changed for DB localization
-- 23/01/2024     DS			 8.0		Changed for DB localization
-- 14/03/2024	  YG			 9.0		Changed how to get value from db because of issue when getting value thousands. it is having comma
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
BEGIN
declare	  @su_status_cd	   INT32
			,@isNotValidEnt int = 0
			,@notValidDescDetails nvarchar(max) = ''
			,@item_state_cd int
			,@cfg_act_line_cnt int -- configured active line count in the silo attribute
			,@act_line_count int  --silo which is used in the other lines at present
			,@act_line_count_press int
			,@allow_same_po_flag int
			,@active_lines_as_dest int
			,@active_lines_as_dest_flag int=0
			,@AllowOnlyEmptySilo int = 0
			,@EnableDestOnSrcSelection int

			--#0.4
			declare @nos_src_selected int
			declare @total_mes_qty float
			declare @final_item_qty_reqd float
			declare @final_item_min_qty_reqd float
			declare @final_item_max_qty_reqd float
			declare @mes_qty float
			declare @absolute_qty float

			declare	  @su_attr as table(attr_desc nvarchar(80),attr_value STRING1700_NULL)

			insert into @su_attr
							select a.attr_desc, ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id 
							where ea.ent_id=@storage_ent_id
							and a.attr_desc  in ('LockForInput', 'BlockForQuality','active_lines_as_dest','allow_destination_for_same_po','BiDirectionalSilo')
			--#6.0
			declare @unq_item_su_msg nvarchar(max)
			declare @unq_item_su_active INT = 1

			declare @auto_reclass_attr_id INT = NULL
			declare @auto_reclass_attr_value NVARCHAR(50)='false'
			
			declare @bfq_id INT
            declare @bfq_desc NVARCHAR(10)='false'
			
			declare @def_grd_attr_id INT
			declare @def_grd_attr_value NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
			declare @def_grd_code INT =0

			declare @unq_item_attr_id INT
			declare @unq_item_attr_value NVARCHAR(50)= NULL
			
			declare @check_inv NVARCHAR(50)='false'
			declare @item_description nvarchar(100)=NULL
				
			declare @item_attr_id NVARCHAR(100)
			declare @item_attr_value NVARCHAR(100) =NULL
			declare @grade_cd INT=0
			declare @grade_desc nvarchar(50)
			declare @reqd_grade_cd INT = -1
			declare @reqd_item_id nvarchar(100)
			declare @sutype NVARCHAR(100)= 'NotBlocked'

			declare  @dblocalMsg1 nvarchar(80)
					,@dblocalMsg2 nvarchar(80)
					,@dblocalMsg3 nvarchar(80)
					,@dblocalMsg4 nvarchar(80)

			-- get ID for all attributes 
	SELECT @auto_reclass_attr_id = a.attr_id	FROM   attr a WITH(nolock)	WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify' AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- ent attr
			-- fetch id
	SELECT @bfq_id = attr_id FROM   attr a WITH(nolock)	WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'	AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- ent attr
	SELECT @def_grd_attr_id = attr_id FROM   attr a WITH(nolock) WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'default_grade' AND a.attr_grp = 2-- ent attr
	SELECT @unq_item_attr_id = attr_id FROM   attr a WITH(nolock) WHERE  a.attr_desc = 'unique_item_id'	AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- ent attr
	-- fetch values

	-- get  @auto_reclass_attr_value value 	 
            SELECT @auto_reclass_attr_value = ea.attr_value
            FROM   ent_attr ea WITH(nolock)
            WHERE  ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
                   AND ea.attr_id = @auto_reclass_attr_id
        

	-- get bfq block for quality 
	 -- check block for quality      
            SELECT @bfq_desc = ea.attr_value
            FROM   ent_attr ea WITH(nolock)
            WHERE  ea.attr_id = @bfq_id
                   AND ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
        

	-- get grade code 
	--fetch configured default grade desc from entity	 
      SELECT @def_grd_attr_value = ea.attr_value
      FROM   ent_attr ea WITH(nolock)
      WHERE  ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
             AND ea.attr_id = @def_grd_attr_id

	--fetch configured default grade ID from entity 
      SELECT @def_grd_code = ig.item_grade_cd
      FROM   item_grade ig WITH(nolock)
      WHERE  ig.item_grade_desc = @def_grd_attr_value and @def_grd_attr_value is not null
	  

	  -- get unique item value 
	  SELECT @unq_item_attr_value = ea.attr_value
      FROM   ent_attr ea WITH(nolock)
      WHERE  ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
             AND ea.attr_id = @unq_item_attr_id

	-- if @unq_item_attr_value and @def_grd_attr_value is not null then its unique Item SU
	-- for unique Item SU only check if SU holds any inventory then it goes into else part but if its empty them its SU will return as active and with info as 

	IF EXISTS(select 1 from item_inv ii with(nolock) where ii.ent_id=@storage_ent_id)
	BEGIN
	set @check_inv='true'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	set @check_inv='false'
	END

	-- check if silo is blocked 
      IF (  ( (SELECT attr_value
                  FROM   @su_attr
                  WHERE  attr_desc = 'LockForInput') = 1 )
           OR ( (SELECT attr_value
                  FROM   @su_attr
                  WHERE  attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality') = 1 ) )
        BEGIN
            SET @sutype = 'blocked'
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
			SET @sutype = 'NotBlocked'
		END

		--check if item inv is having value for that silo
	IF (@unq_item_attr_value is not null and @def_grd_attr_value is not null and @check_inv='false'  )
	BEGIN

	-- get item grade from job bom for item configured
		select @reqd_grade_cd= reqd_grade_cd from job_bom jb with(nolock)
		where jb.wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and item_id=@unq_item_attr_value 

		
			-- set values for unique if item and grade matches else set as inactive
			if ( @unq_item_attr_value is not null and @reqd_grade_cd = @def_grd_code and @sutype = 'NotBlocked')
			BEGIN
			-- set values are same, SU active   and set SU is configured for item and grade in msg
			select @item_description=i.item_desc from item i with(nolock) where i.item_id=@unq_item_attr_value

			--set @dblocalMsg1 = ' Target material is: '
			select @dblocalMsg1 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300022, NULL, NULL);
			--set @dblocalMsg2 = ' and grade: '
			select @dblocalMsg2 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300023, NULL, NULL);

			select @isNotValidEnt=0
				  ,@notValidDescDetails= concat(@dblocalMsg1,@item_description,@dblocalMsg2,@def_grd_attr_value)
				  ,@storage_ent_id=@storage_ent_id
				  ,@item_attr_id= @unq_item_attr_value
				  ,@item_attr_value=@item_description
				  ,@grade_cd=@def_grd_code
				  ,@grade_desc=@def_grd_attr_value
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
			-- set values are different, SU inactive and set SU is configured for item and grade in msg
			select @item_description=i.item_desc from item i with(nolock) where i.item_id=@unq_item_attr_value
			
			--set @dblocalMsg1 = ' Target material is: '
			select @dblocalMsg1 =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300022, NULL, NULL);
			--set @dblocalMsg2 = ' and grade: '
			select @dblocalMsg2 = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300023, NULL, NULL);
			
			
			select @isNotValidEnt=1
				   ,@notValidDescDetails= concat(@dblocalMsg1,@item_description,@dblocalMsg2,@def_grd_attr_value)
				  ,@storage_ent_id=@storage_ent_id
				  ,@item_attr_id= @unq_item_attr_value
				  ,@item_attr_value=@item_description
				  ,@grade_cd=@def_grd_code
				  ,@grade_desc=@def_grd_attr_value

			END
						
			IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='LockForInput')=1)
			BEGIN
				set @isNotValidEnt=1
				set @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300024,NULL,NULL)
			END
			IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='BlockForQuality')=1)
			BEGIN
				set @isNotValidEnt=1
				set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)
			END

			
		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			--declare @bidirectioanlSiloList as 
			--table (jb_item_id nvarchar(80),jb_qty_reqd float,jb_qty_prod float, silo_id int,mes_qty float,qty_per float, threshold_val float
			--,final_qty_reqd float
			--,final_item_qty_reqd float
			--,final_item_min_qty_reqd float
			--,final_item_max_qty_reqd float
			--);

			declare @bidirectSiloList1 as 
			table (jb_item_id nvarchar(80),jb_qty_reqd float,jb_qty_prod float, silo_id int,mes_qty float,absolute_qty float,qty_per float, threshold_val float
			,final_qty_reqd float
			,final_item_qty_reqd float
			,final_item_min_qty_reqd float
			,final_item_max_qty_reqd float
			);



			BEGIN

						

							 --Changes related to #3.0
							select @EnableDestOnSrcSelection = oa.attr_value  from oper_attr oa with(nolock) join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=oa.attr_id
								where oa.oper_id = @oper_id and a.attr_desc = 'EnableDestOnSrcSelection'
							
							IF (@jb_item_id IS NULL and @inv_item_id is not null)
							BEGIN
									BEGIN 
										set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300026,NULL,NULL) 
									END
							END
							ELSE
								BEGIN 
									--checking grade
								IF(@inv_item_id is not null) AND (@jb_grade_cd IS NOT NULL)

									IF (@inv_grade_cd <> isnull(@jb_grade_cd,-1)) 
									BEGIN 
										set @isNotValidEnt = 1 
										set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300027,NULL,NULL)
									END
					

								END

							IF (@EnableDestOnSrcSelection=1)
							BEGIN
								if  exists(select 1 from  job_bom jb1 with(nolock) 
											inner join item_inv iv1 with(nolock) on  jb1.item_id = iv1.item_id and jb1.reqd_grade_cd = iv1.grade_cd and iv1.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
											inner join ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) on oss.su_ent_id = iv1.ent_id and oss.wo_id = @wo_id and oss.oper_id = @oper_id and oss.seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type=1
											where jb1.wo_id = @wo_id and jb1.oper_id = @oper_id and jb1.seq_no = @seq_no)
								begin
									;with cte1 as (

											select jb1.item_id,max(job.qty_reqd) qty_reqd, max(job.qty_prod) qty_prod, oss.su_ent_id as silo_id, sum(iv1.qty_left) qty_left
											,max(abs_selected_qty) abs_selected_qty
											,max(jb1.qty_per_parent_item) qty_per
											--,max(jb1.min_qty_per_parent_item) min_qty_per
											--,max(jb1.max_qty_per_parent_item) max_qty_per
											,max(REPLACE(ea.attr_value,',','')) threshold_val -- v9.0 update how to take value from db
											from  job_bom jb1 with(nolock) 
											inner join job with(nolock) on job.wo_id = jb1.wo_id and job.oper_id = jb1.oper_id and job.seq_no = jb1.seq_no
											inner join item_inv iv1 with(nolock) on  jb1.item_id = iv1.item_id and jb1.reqd_grade_cd = iv1.grade_cd	and jb1.item_id = @inv_item_id			--and iv1.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
											inner join ofi_su_selection oss with(nolock) on oss.su_ent_id = iv1.ent_id and oss.wo_id = @wo_id and oss.oper_id = @oper_id and oss.seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type=1
											left join ent_attr ea with(nolock) on oss.su_ent_id = ea.ent_id and ea.attr_id = (select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'StorageUnitThreshold')
											where jb1.wo_id = @wo_id and jb1.oper_id = @oper_id and jb1.seq_no = @seq_no
											group by jb1.item_id,oss.su_ent_id
											)
											, cte2 as (
											select *, case when (qty_reqd-qty_prod)>0 then (qty_reqd-qty_prod) else 0 end as final_qty_reqd
											from cte1 )
											insert into @bidirectSiloList1
											select *, 
											(qty_per*final_qty_reqd) as final_item_qty_reqd
											,(qty_per*final_qty_reqd)-threshold_val as final_item_min_qty_reqd
											,(qty_per*final_qty_reqd)+threshold_val as final_item_max_qty_reqd
											from cte2
											select  @mes_qty = mes_qty 
													,@absolute_qty = absolute_qty
													from @bidirectSiloList1 where silo_id = @storage_ent_id
												IF((select attr_value from @su_attr where attr_desc='BiDirectionalSilo')<>1)
												begin
													set @isNotValidEnt=1
													set @notValidDescDetails =   dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300028,NULL,NULL)
												end
												else
												begin
													--if( @mes_qty = @absolute_qty)
													if( abs(@mes_qty - @absolute_qty)<0.0001)
													begin
														set @isNotValidEnt=0
														set @notValidDescDetails = ' '
													end
													else 
													begin
														set @isNotValidEnt=1
														set @notValidDescDetails = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300029,NULL,NULL) 
													end
												end

								end
								-- checking whether silo is not empty and not has been chosen in the soruce then disable
								else if (@jb_item_id is not null and @inv_item_id is not null)
								 and not exists(select 1 from  job_bom jb1 with(nolock)

	SET NOCOUNT ON

		,	cust.address1

		,	cust.zip

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:    [sp_U_ofi_Storeage_Exec_FlagReset]
-- Description: set storage exec of SU _om or _omar
--
-- Usage: in Unique Item SU job add production for OM and OMAR Silo.  Calling from MDMAddjobProduction WF.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  CK       	2024-01-11       Initial version. 
-- ===========================================================================================*/
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Storeage_Exec_FlagReset] @ent_name_su nvarchar(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @ent_id int
  DECLARE @siloType nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @su_attr AS TABLE (
    attr_id int,
    attr_desc nvarchar(80),
    attr_value STRING1700_NULL
  )

  DECLARE @unq_item_attr_id int = 0
  DECLARE @unq_item_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @def_grd_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @def_grd_attr_id int = 0
  DECLARE @def_grd_code int = 0

  -- 2 IF start -logic continue of silo is presnt 
  IF (@ent_name_su IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN
    SELECT
      @ent_id = e.ent_id
    FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE e.ent_name = @ent_name_su

      INSERT INTO @su_attr
        SELECT
          a.attr_id,
          a.attr_desc,
          ea.attr_value
        FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
          ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
        WHERE ea.ent_id = @ent_id
        AND a.attr_desc IN ('default_grade', 'unique_item_id')

      -- take value of unique item
      SELECT
        @unq_item_attr_id = sa.attr_id,
        @unq_item_attr_value = sa.attr_value
      FROM @su_attr sa
      WHERE sa.attr_desc = 'unique_item_id'

      -- take value of default grade
      SELECT
        @def_grd_attr_id = sa.attr_id,
        @def_grd_attr_value = sa.attr_value
      FROM @su_attr sa
      WHERE sa.attr_desc = 'default_grade'

      --7 IF start
      IF ((@unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
        OR @def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL))
       
      BEGIN
        UPDATE storage_exec
        SET 
            allow_multiple_items = 0,
            allow_multiple_lots = 0
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
      END--7 IF end


  END-- 2 IF end


END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetEntityID]
(@ent_name STRING80
,@site_name STRING80 = NULL
) RETURNS INT32 AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetEntityID
-- Description       - Returns the Ent_Id for a given ent_name and site.
-- Author			 - Aaron
-- Date Created      - 07/08/2008
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 05/07/2009	Raghu			3.x			Code Restructured; Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- 07/09/2019   Srinivasa       6.2         US#1191718(Merge L00154067 (HF CR L00153711 for HF-L00153711: Add @ent_name to WHERE clause when ent is assigned to as site.)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	 @ent_id			INT32
		,@no_of_entities	INT32

	IF (@ent_name IS NULL) RETURN NULL

	--Verify this entity does not exist in another site.
	SELECT @no_of_entities = COUNT(*) FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_name = @ent_name

	--Verify whether a valid entity name is identified.
	IF (@no_of_entities < 1)
		--Return null if there are no entity's with this name.
		RETURN NULL

	ELSE IF (@no_of_entities = 1)
		--If there is one single entity with this name, return that entity name regardless of what site it belongs to.
		SELECT @ent_id = e.ent_id FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE e.ent_name = @ent_name

	ELSE BEGIN
		--If the supplied site_name is null, then verify if the supplied entity (name) is not linked to any site
		--and this is the only entity (name) that is not linked to any site
		--otherwise, it would become ambiguous to identify the entity.
		--Return null to caller if no such entity is found; and the let the caller handle what is supposed to be done when site is null.
		IF (@site_name IS NULL)
			SELECT @ent_id = e.ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @ent_name AND e.site IS NULL

		ELSE
			SELECT @ent_id = e.ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			--ID of ancestor entity that defines site of this entity; if = ent_id, this entity is a site.
			--Null for entities above sites, or for single-site systems
			INNER JOIN ent site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.site = site_ent.ent_id
			--Name of this site
			INNER JOIN site ste WITH (NOLOCK) ON ste.ent_id = site_ent.ent_id
			WHERE ste.site_name = @site_name
			AND e.ent_name = @ent_name
	END

	--Return the entity ID to the caller.
	RETURN @ent_id
END

--

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
