-- Name:    [SP_S_ofi_GetItemForCons]
-- Description:  Used to get item id if AUT doesnt provide Item_id
--
-- Usage:  MDMAddConsumptionJobWorkflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  YG            2022-08-30      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG			  2023-04-07	  Added to get item for non BoM

-- EXEC [SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption] '1000671266','LiquidLoadout',0,524004,'100000055863'
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption_TBD] (
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(40) 
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) 
	,@seq_no INT 
	,@aut_storage_id INT 
	,@item_id  NVARCHAR(40) = NULL 
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--Used for debugger
	--SELECT @wo_id ='1001016290', @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no=0, @aut_storage_id='540010', @item_id='0'
	
	DECLARE @storage_ent_id INT,
			@is_bom_item INT = 1

	--GETS Required Data
	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@aut_storage_id AS NVARCHAR)

	-- v0.03.00 ++ Added checking if item_id is NULL and get item_id from item_inv table with respecting to the job_bom
	IF (@item_id is NULL OR @item_id = '0')
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON iv.item_id = jb.item_id
					WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id and jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no )
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @item_id = jb.item_id FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON iv.item_id = jb.item_id
			WHERE iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id and jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
		
		END
		ELSE -- if Material Available in the Silo is Non Bom
		BEGIN
			SELECT top 1 @item_id = iv.item_id
			FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id
			GROUP by item_id

			SET @is_bom_item = 0;
		END
	END

	SELECT @is_bom_item is_bom_item , @item_id item_id
	-- v0.03.00 --
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsByJob]
(@session_id              INT32
,@event_time_local        TDATETIME = NULL
,@user_id                 nvarchar(40)
,@ent_name                STRING80
,@site_name               STRING80
,@wo_id                   nvarchar(40)
,@oper_id                 nvarchar(40)
,@seq_no                  nvarchar(40)
,@bom_pos                 INT32
,@qty_cons                float
,@reas_cd                 INT32 = NULL
,@lot_no                  nvarchar(40)
,@fg_lot_no               nvarchar(40)
,@sublot_no               nvarchar(40)
,@fg_sublot_no            nvarchar(40)
,@from_ent_name           STRING80
,@from_site_name          STRING80
,@item_id                 STRING40
,@ext_ref                 STRING40
,@apply_scaling_factor    INT32 = 0
,@genealogy_id            STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@upstream_event_id       STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_requirement_id  STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_response_id     STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@comments                STRING254_NULL = NULL -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
,@spare1                  nvarchar(80)
,@spare2                  nvarchar(80)
,@spare3                  nvarchar(80)
,@spare4                  nvarchar(80)
,@created_at_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value    INT32 = NULL
,@row_id		INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                - sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons
-- Description                - Used to create a consumption records when the job is  running
-- Author                    - Raghu
--                        Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version             - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
--08/25/2009    Raghu        4.0.0    DB Changes
--04/30/2020	Raghu			6.2	US-1191957-As Bruce, I want a Consumption Post web API so I can record consumption after the job is completed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @job_pos        INT32
	,@ent_id        INT32
	,@from_ent_id   INT32
	,@err_msg	NVARCHAR(MAX)

BEGIN

    --Get the running entity
    SET @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

    IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
    	SET @err_msg = 'The specified entity:' + COALESCE(@ent_name, 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},entity:' + COALESCE(@ent_name, 'NULL')
    	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
    	RETURN
    END

    --Get the storage entity
    SET @from_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@from_ent_name, @from_site_name)

    --Retrieve the job position where this job is currently running.
    SELECT @job_pos = je.job_pos FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
      AND je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
      AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
      AND je.cur_seq_no = @seq_no

	IF (@job_pos IS NULL) BEGIN
        --If a valid job cannot be identified, raise an exception to the caller.
        RAISERROR ('The supplied job is not the job that is currently running on this entity.{5139}',16,1)
        RETURN
    END

    --Call to add consumption using the retrieved job position.
    EXEC SP_I_ITEM_CONS_ADDCONS @session_id = @session_id, @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
        @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id,
        @job_pos=@job_pos, @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @qty_cons=@qty_cons,
        @reas_cd=@reas_cd, @lot_no=@lot_no, @fg_lot_no=@fg_lot_no,
        @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id,
        @item_id=@item_id, @ext_ref=@ext_ref, @apply_scaling_factor=@apply_scaling_factor,
        @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id=@upstream_event_id,
        @segment_requirement_id=@segment_requirement_id,
        @segment_response_id=@segment_response_id,
        @comments=@comments,
        @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2,
        @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4, @created_at_utc=@created_at_utc,
        @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value,
        @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT

END

		inner join ent e with (nolock)on e.ent_id=ea.ent_id
		where a.attr_desc='ScannableId' and attr_value=@equip

	END
    
	if @type='GetEquip'
	BEGIN
	--	--select * from job where wo_id='1000'
	--	select @ent_id=ent_id from ent_attr ea  with (nolock)
	--	inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
	--	where a.attr_desc='ScannableId' and attr_value=@equip

	--	set @user='Aveva\'+@user
	--	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi') IS NOT NULL
	--	DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi
	--	CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi (
	
	--	ent_id	INT,
	--	ent_name nvarchar(50),
	--	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
	--	can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
	--	can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
	--	can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
	--	can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
	--	can_stre nvarchar(5),
	--	can_log_data nvarchar(5),
	--	parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
	--	access int
	--	);
	--	INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi
	--	exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user
	----	select *from #ent_access_ofi where ent_id=492
	--	IF @ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	--	BEGIN
	--		select w.wo_id,j.run_ent_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,i.item_desc from wo  w with (nolock)
	--		inner join job j with (nolock) on j.wo_id=w.wo_id 
	--		inner join item i with (nolock) on i.item_id=j.item_id
	--		where j.run_ent_id=@ent_id and j.state_cd=3
	--	END

	--commented 
	SELECT @ent_id=ent_id FROM ent_attr ea  WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
		WHERE a.attr_desc='ScannableId' AND attr_value=@equip

		SELECT w.wo_id,j.run_ent_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,i.item_desc FROM wo  w WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=w.wo_id 
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=j.item_id
		WHERE j.run_ent_id=@ent_id AND j.state_cd=3

	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Exists INT = 0
				,@SkipPalletAssignmentCheck NVARCHAR(80) = 0
				,@EntId INT = -1

		IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @pallet_id IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS Exits
			RETURN;
		END
		
		-- CR486: Added the logic here to avoid checking for Pallet assignment if Attribute is set
		SELECT TOP 1 @SkipPalletAssignmentCheck = ISNULL(ea.attr_value,0)
					,@EntId = ISNULL(ea.ent_id,-1)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		WHERE j.state_cd=3 
			AND j.wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND ea.attr_id = (	SELECT TOP 1 attr_id

			END

			SELECT @process_attr_id = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'Disable_UD'

			INSERT INTO @temp (process_id, disable_ud)
			SELECT process_id, attr_value FROM process_attr WHERE attr_id = @process_attr_id

			SELECT ISNULL(mrt.disable_ud, '0') AS disable_ud
			FROM job j
			INNER JOIN oper o ON o.oper_id = j.oper_id
			INNER JOIN process p ON p.process_id = o.process_id
			LEFT JOIN @temp mrt ON p.process_id = mrt.process_id
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id


	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].sp_SA_Line_GetProdForPeriod

) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Line_GetProdForPeriod
-- Description      - Get the total good and reject production, normalized to the line's standard item's UOM, on a line during a period of time
-- Author           - KRF
-- Date Created     - 11/20/2014
-- Version          - 5.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 12/18/2014     KRF              5.1    Return the line name instead of its ID if there are no entities in it
-- 03/20/2017	Raghu		5.3	UserStory: 781958 - As a SE developer, I want to investigate and correct a performance issue with sp_SA_Line_GetProdForPeriod to ensure good web portal performance
-- 11/30/2017	Raghu G		6.0	UserStory-714529 - [Enhancement] As SE, I want to fix CR L00138956 so that OEE values are returned for short time periods without distinct production records
-- 10/26/2018	Varun		6.0	UserStory: 1022902 - As Joe, I want the Entity Monitor and Line Monitor pages in the
--													 Web Portal (2014 R3) to include a reporting period for current week and
--													 last week so that I can see more data
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err_msg             NVARCHAR(4000)
	   ,@event_start_time    TDATETIME  -- UTC time
	   ,@event_end_time	     TDATETIME
	   ,@attr_value			 STRING80
	   ,@line_parent_ent_id  INT
	   ,@prod_pos            INT
	   ,@max_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
   	   ,@max_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@min_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	   ,@min_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@cur_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	   ,@cur_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@num_recs            INT
	   ,@root_ent_id         INT
	   ,@site_ent_id         INT
	   ,@current_time_utc    TDATETIME
	   ,@standard_uom        INT
	   ,@standard_item_id	 STRING40
	   ,@standard_item_desc	 STRING80
	   ,@max_uom_id          INT
	   ,@min_uom_id          INT
	   ,@min_factor          TFLOAT
	   ,@max_num_decimals    INT
	   ,@line_name           NVARCHAR(80)

	   ,@distinct_good_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	   ,@distinct_reject_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	   ,@prod_start_time_utc	TDATETIME2

DECLARE @ents_in_line        TABLE (ent_id INT)
DECLARE @prod_ents           TABLE (ent_id INT)
DECLARE @reject_ents         TABLE (ent_id INT)

DECLARE @prod	TABLE(item_id NVARCHAR(80), good_prod INT, qty FLOAT)


BEGIN
	-- Check for bad input arguments
	IF (@in_line_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},LINE_ID'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	-- Last N hours is limited to no more than 168
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 0 AND @in_filter_end_time = 0 AND (@in_filter_start_time > 168 OR @in_filter_start_time < 1)) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_START_TIME,1,168'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@in_filter_time_unit < 0 OR @in_filter_time_unit > 5) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = N'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_TIME_UNIT,0,5'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
    IF (@in_filter_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 may not be empty{5413},FILTER_START_TIME'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
    ELSE IF (@in_filter_start_time < COALESCE(@in_filter_end_time, 0)) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 must be greater than %2.{2030},FILTER_START_TIME,FILTER_END_TIME'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END
	SELECT @num_recs = COUNT(*) FROM line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
	IF (@num_recs = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The specified line does not exist{7929}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END
	INSERT INTO @ents_in_line SELECT ent_id from line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 0
	SELECT @num_recs = COUNT(*) FROM @ents_in_line
	IF (@num_recs = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_name = line_name FROM line WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
		SET @err_msg = N'There are no entities in the supplied line: %1.{7890},' + @line_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	-- Check that if querying about a shift and the line has no parent entity with a shift schedule that all the line's members have the same
	-- shift schedule, for either the current shift or the previous shift, whichever is being queried for
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_parent_ent_id = ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 1
		IF @line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
			       @cur_shift_end_utc = cur_shift_end_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id
		-- If current shift ended before now, parent entity used to have a shift schedule but doesn't anymore
		IF @cur_shift_start_utc IS NULL OR @cur_shift_end_utc <= GETUTCDATE() BEGIN
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1 -- Current shift
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc),
				@min_shift_start_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc),
				@max_shift_end_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc),
				@min_shift_end_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
				FROM @ents_in_line eil
				JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK)  ON eil.ent_id = e.ent_id
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_start_utc),
				@min_shift_start_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_start_utc),
				@max_shift_end_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_end_utc),
				@min_shift_end_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
				FROM @ents_in_line eil
				JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK)  ON eil.ent_id = e.ent_id
				JOIN shift_history sh_prev WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = sh_prev.ent_id AND dateadd(ss,-1,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc) = sh_prev.shift_end_utc
			IF (@max_shift_start_utc<>@min_shift_start_utc OR @max_shift_end_utc<>@min_shift_end_utc) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Entities in line have differing shift schedules - querying by shift is not possible.{2031}'
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN -- There is a parent entity for the line with a legitimate shift schedule
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = @cur_shift_start_utc,	@max_shift_end_utc = @cur_shift_end_utc
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @max_shift_end_utc = shift_end_utc
				FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id AND dateadd(ss,-1,@cur_shift_start_utc) = shift_end_utc
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Filter using time periods, and NOT by using shift.
		SELECT @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 0) -- Hour
			SELECT @event_start_time = DATEADD(hh, -@in_filter_start_time, @current_time_utc)
				,@event_end_time = DATEADD(hh, -@in_filter_end_time, @current_time_utc)
		ELSE BEGIN
			-- Boundaries will be determined starting with local times, so we must get the site entity if one exists
			IF (@line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT @root_ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id
			ELSE SELECT @root_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
			SELECT @site_ent_id = site FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent.ent_id = @root_ent_id
			IF @site_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
				;WITH ParentEnts(parent_id, child_id) AS
				(
					SELECT parent_ent_id, child_ent_id
					FROM ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE child_ent_id = @root_ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT el.parent_ent_id, el.child_ent_id
					FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
					JOIN ParentEnts pe
					ON el.child_ent_id = pe.parent_id
				)
				select @site_ent_id = MAX(parent_id) FROM  ParentEnts pe JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON pe.parent_id = e.ent_id WHERE e.site = e.ent_id
			END
			IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 2) -- Day
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(dd, -@in_filter_start_time+1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(dd, -@in_filter_end_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 3) -- Week
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(wk, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1-DATEPART(dw, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(D, 6, DATEADD(wk, -@in_filter_end_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1-DATEPART(dw, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)))), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 4) -- Month
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(7), DATEADD(mm, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(d, -1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(7), DATEADD(mm, -@in_filter_end_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01 00:00:00', 120)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 5) -- Year
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEADD(yy, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01-01 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(d, -1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEADD(yy, -@in_filter_end_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01-01 00:00:00', 120)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
		END
		--IF (@event_end_time > @current_time_utc) SET @event_end_time = @current_time_utc
	END

	--Get the distinct good production flag
	SELECT @distinct_good_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 362

	--Get the distinct reject production flag
	SELECT @distinct_reject_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 309

	--The time filter is hour (i.e. filter time unit is 0)
	--If the distinct good production and distinct reject projection are not true, reset the starting time to the top of the hour
	--since the production quantities are rolled up to the top of the hour.
	IF @in_filter_time_unit = 0 AND NOT (@distinct_good_prod = '1' AND @distinct_reject_prod = '1')
		SET @prod_start_time_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_start_time),0)

	--Default to the calculated start time if production start time cannot be identified from above
	SET @event_start_time = COALESCE(@prod_start_time_utc, @event_start_time)

	-- Figure out how to display items
    SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 210
	IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

	-- Return work order ID, the item ID, this item's description, the item display per system attribute 210,
	-- the name of the "native" UOM of this item, the abbreviation of the "native" UOM of this item ,
	-- the number of decimal places for the item, the starting quantity, the required quantity,
	-- the remaining quantity (which is the difference between the starting quantity and the total production, good and rejected),
	-- the good quantity produced during the selected period, the total good quantity produced for this work order,
	-- the rejected quantity produced during the selected period, the total rejected quantity produced for this work order,
	-- the work order's current status code, the work order's current status code name,  and the work order's current status color.

	-- Get production entities for the sake of returning production numbers
	-- Get production entities and those upstream from them for the sake of returning reject numbers

	SELECT DISTINCT @prod_pos = lel.child_order
    FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
	AND ((l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id) OR
	    (l.prod_ent_id IS NULL AND lel.ent_id = (SELECT MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND
	    child_order = (SELECT MAX(child_order) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND line_is_child = 0))))
	WHERE l.line_id = @in_line_id

	INSERT INTO @prod_ents SELECT ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND child_order = @prod_pos

	INSERT INTO @reject_ents SELECT ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND child_order <= @prod_pos

	SELECT @standard_uom = uom_id, @standard_item_id = l.std_item_id, @standard_item_desc = i.item_desc
	FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN line l WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = l.std_item_id
	WHERE line_id = @in_line_id

	INSERT INTO @prod (item_id, good_prod, qty)
	SELECT ip.item_id, ip.good_prod, ip.qty_prod
	FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN @prod_ents pe ON pe.ent_id = ip.ent_id
	WHERE ip.good_prod = 1 AND ip.byproduct = 0
	AND (created_at_utc < @event_end_time OR (@event_end_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc < @max_shift_end_utc))
	AND (created_at_utc >= @event_start_time OR (@event_start_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc >= @max_shift_start_utc))

	INSERT INTO @prod (item_id, good_prod, qty)
	SELECT ip.item_id, ip.good_prod, ip.qty_prod
	FROM  item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN @reject_ents pe ON pe.ent_id = ip.ent_id
	WHERE ip.good_prod = 0 AND ip.byproduct = 0
	AND (created_at_utc < @event_end_time OR (@event_end_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc < @max_shift_end_utc))
	AND (created_at_utc >= @event_start_time OR (@event_start_time IS NULL AND created_at_utc >= @max_shift_start_utc))


	IF @standard_uom IS NULL BEGIN -- If there's no standard item and thus UOM, all relevant production must use the same UOM so it can be directly added
		;WITH uoms AS (
			SELECT i.uom_id
			FROM @prod ip
			JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
			)
		SELECT @max_uom_id = MAX(uom_id), @min_uom_id = MIN(uom_id) FROM uoms
		IF @max_uom_id IS NOT NULL AND @min_uom_id <> @max_uom_id BEGIN -- Note that if @max_uom_id is not null then so is @min_uom_id
			SET @err_msg = 'There is no standard item for the line and differing units of measure are used for production during this period, so it cannot be totaled.{2032}'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @out_period_good_prod = SUM(p.qty)
		FROM @prod p
		WHERE p.good_prod = 1

		SELECT @out_period_rej_prod = SUM(p.qty)
		FROM @prod p
		WHERE p.good_prod = 0

		SELECT @max_num_decimals = COALESCE(MAX(num_decimals), 0)
		FROM @prod p
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = p.item_id

		SELECT NULL AS item_id,
		       NULL AS item_desc,
		       NULL AS item_display,
	           uom.description AS uom_description,
	           uom.abbreviation AS uom_abbreviation,
	           @max_num_decimals as num_decimals,
		       @out_period_good_prod AS period_produced,
	           @out_period_rej_prod AS period_rejected
		FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @max_uom_id

	END
	ELSE BEGIN -- If there is a standard UOM, all production UOMs must have a conversion factor to it

		WITH factors AS (
			SELECT factor = COALESCE(uc1.factor, uc2.factor, 0)
			FROM @prod ip
			JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i .item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc1.from_uom_id AND uc1.to_uom_id = @standard_uom AND uc1.item_id = ip.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc2.from_uom_id AND uc2.to_uom_id = @standard_uom AND uc2.item_id IS NULL
			WHERE i.uom_id <> @standard_uom -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the standard UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		)
		SELECT @min_factor = MIN(factor) from factors  WITH (NOLOCK)

		IF @min_factor = 0 BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'There is production during this period using a UOM for which there is no conversion to that of the standard item for the line, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{2135}'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @out_period_good_prod = COALESCE(SUM(ip.qty * COALESCE(uc1.factor, uc2.factor, 1) + CASE WHEN uc1.factor IS NULL THEN COALESCE(uc2.offset, 0) ELSE uc1.offset END),0)
		FROM @prod ip
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc1.from_uom_id AND uc1.to_uom_id = @standard_uom AND uc1.item_id = ip.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc2.from_uom_id AND uc2.to_uom_id = @standard_uom AND uc2.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE ip.good_prod = 1

		SELECT @out_period_rej_prod = COALESCE(SUM(ip.qty * COALESCE(uc1.factor, uc2.factor, 1) + CASE WHEN uc1.factor IS NULL THEN COALESCE(uc2.offset, 0) ELSE uc1.offset END),0)
		FROM  @prod ip
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc1.from_uom_id AND uc1.to_uom_id = @standard_uom AND uc1.item_id = ip.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc2.from_uom_id AND uc2.to_uom_id = @standard_uom AND uc2.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE ip.good_prod = 0

		SELECT item.item_id AS item_id,
	           item.item_desc AS item_desc,
	           CASE
	               WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
	               WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
	               WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
	               WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
	           END AS item_display,
	           uom.description AS uom_description,
	           uom.abbreviation AS uom_abbreviation,
	           item.num_decimals as num_decimals,
		       @out_period_good_prod AS period_produced,
	           @out_period_rej_prod AS period_rejected
		FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = l.std_item_id
		JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON uom.uom_id = item.uom_id
		WHERE line_id = @in_line_id

	END

END

CREATE Trigger [dbo].[tg_sample_plan_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[sample_plan]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_sample_plan_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on sample_plan table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Rich
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -  4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--  02-Feb-2012		Ahmed		4.5		update the db_status table when Plan_Name,Sample_Name or Reset_Option of Sample_Plan table changes
--  07-Aug-2012		Ibrahim		4.5		added code to update last_edit_by and last_edit_at columns on updation of the sample plan.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE sample_plan SET sample_plan.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, sample_plan.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE sample_plan.plan_id = i.plan_id


	IF(UPDATE(Plan_Name) OR UPDATE(Sample_Name) OR UPDATE(Reset_Option)) AND (EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0))
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 sample_to_go.plan_id FROM sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_to_go.plan_id IN (SELECT INSERTED.plan_id FROM INSERTED))
				BEGIN
					UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
				END
		END

END

   0.02.00	CK				2022-11-11			Added Layout and Printer information

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_AUT_Details] 
		@wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@seq_no INT = NULL,
		@ent_id INT = NULL
 
AS
BEGIN
 
	-- TBU Updated
	-- 0.09.00 Disabled
	--if (len(@wo_id) = 9 )
	--BEGIN
	--	SET @wo_id =CONCAT('8',@wo_id);
	--END
 
	-- 0.09.00 Added
	-- 0.10.00 Disabled
	--DECLARE @truncated_mesorder NVARCHAR(40),
	--		@prefix_id INT
 
	--SELECT @wo_id= mesorder,@truncated_mesorder=truncated_mesorder,@prefix_id=prefix_id FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid] (@wo_id,@oper_id)

	-- 0.10.00 Added
	DECLARE @output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		@output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		@output_operid NVARCHAR(100),
		@output_seqno INT,
		@result INT
 
	SELECT @output_woid=output_woid,@output_truncated_woid=output_truncated_woid,@output_operid=output_operid,@output_seqno=output_seqno FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid](@wo_id,@seq_no,@ent_id)

	SET @wo_id = @output_woid
 
	-- Get the latest sublot no for selected order
	DECLARE @sublot_counter INT
		   ,@layout_name NVARCHAR(50)=NULL
		   ,@printer_id NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
		   ,@layout_ofi_wo_ext NVARCHAR(100)	=	NULL
		   ,@splitCount INT = 0
		   ,@defaultUoMDesc NVARCHAR(20) = 'KG'
		   ,@defaultUoMId INT 
	SELECT @defaultUoMId = uom_id FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description = @defaultUoMDesc
 
	DECLARE @layoutTable TABLE ( row_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) ,value NVARCHAR(50));
 
	SELECT @printer_id=[dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterName] (@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no);
	--GET LAYOUT INFO
	SELECT @layout_ofi_wo_ext=owe.layout_name	
	FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE owe.wo_id=@wo_id
 
	SELECT @splitCount=count(value) 
	FROM string_split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-');
 
	IF(@layout_ofi_wo_ext IS NOT NULL and @splitCount > 0)
	BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @layoutTable
	SELECT value FROM string_split(@layout_ofi_wo_ext, '-')
 
	SELECT  @layout_name=value FROM @layoutTable WHERE row_id=1
	END
 
	DECLARE @sublotTable TABLE (
	    sublot_counter INT,
		sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
	)
	--INSERT SUBLOT DETAILS IN TEMP TABLE
	INSERT @sublotTable
	EXEC sp_S_ofi_Sublot @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
 
	SELECT TOP 1 @sublot_counter = sublot_counter FROM @sublotTable
 
	--SELECT FINAL DATA SET
	SELECT 
		  --case when left(j.wo_id,1) ='8' then  RIGHT(j.wo_id,9) else j.wo_id end wo_id,																				-- 0.09.00 Disabled
		   --CASE WHEN @prefix_id > 2 THEN @truncated_mesorder ELSE @wo_id END wo_id,																						-- 0.09.00 Added -- 0.10.00 Disabled
		   @output_truncated_woid wo_id,-- 0.10.00 Added
		   j.oper_id,
		   j.seq_no,
		   i.item_desc,
		   dbo.fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom(i.item_id,j.qty_reqd,i.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) qty_reqd,
		   GETUTCDATE() current_times,
		   @sublot_counter sublot_no, 
		   ISNULL(ia.attr_value,'') segregation_type,
		   @layout_name layout_name,
		   @printer_id printer_id,
		   ig.item_grade_desc item_grade,																																-- v0.08.00 Added	
		  dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](j.item_id,(j.qty_reqd-j.qty_prod),i.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) remaining_qty
	FROM [dbo].job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN [dbo].item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN [dbo].job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no AND jb.item_id = j.item_id and jb.bom_pos = 0	-- v0.08.00 Added
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ig.item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd																			-- v0.08.00 Added -- 0.09.00 Update from INNER JOIN into LEFT OUTER JOIN
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = j.item_id 
													AND ia.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																	  FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																	  WHERE attr_desc = 'Classification' AND attr_grp = 1) -- Add attribute group =1 (item)
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id 
		AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Util_History]
(@log_id		INT32 = NULL
,@ent_id		INT32 = NULL
,@event_time_utc 	TDATETIME2 = NULL
,@records_affected	INT = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_D_Util_History
-- Description			- Deletes an utilization event. The previous event is stretched till the end time of the current event.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 07/26/2016
-- Version				- 5.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/22/2016		Raghu			5.3		UserStory: 702950 - As Lenka, I want to split/merge utilization events across shifts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @next_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
	,@range_start		TDATETIME2
	,@range_end		TDATETIME2

	--For backward compatibility, retrieve the primary key values using the log_id if primary key values are not supplied
	IF (@ent_id IS NULL OR @event_time_utc IS NULL)
		SELECT @ent_id = uh.ent_id, @event_time_utc = uh.event_time_utc
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.log_id = @log_id

	--Strip out the milliseconds
	SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@event_time_utc)

	--Exit, if the event does not exist
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id AND uh.event_time_utc = @event_time_utc)
		--An event does not exist at the specified time, exit
		RETURN

	--Delete the util_history record based on its primary key values
	DELETE FROM util_history
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND event_time_utc = @event_time_utc

	--Capture the record count
	SET @records_affected = COALESCE(@records_affected, 0) + @@ROWCOUNT

	--Retrieve the start time of the next event
	SELECT @next_event_time_utc = MIN(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND uh.event_time_utc > @event_time_utc

	--Default to the supplied event time utc, if there are no future events
	SET @range_end = COALESCE(@next_event_time_utc, @event_time_utc)

	--Determine the starting range
	SELECT @range_start = MAX(event_time_utc)
	FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND event_time_utc <= @event_time_utc

	--Determine whether any events to be merged
	EXEC sp_U_Util_History_MergeEvents @ent_id = @ent_id
		, @event_time_utc_start_range = @range_start, @event_time_utc_end_range = @range_end
		, @last_edit_comment='UtilHistory.Delete', @records_affected = @records_affected OUTPUT
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Inv_Filtr]
(
	@ent_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@restrict_to_ent		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@current_inventory		LOGICAL = 0
,	@filtr					STRING1700_NULL = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					- Returns inventory.  If the flag is set, then the inventory is returned for just the specified entity,
--								  and is restricted by the filter shown below.  If the flag is not set, then the inventory is returned
--								  for the specified entities and all the entities located at that entity.
--								  The stored procedure will have to descend the storage_exec?s storage_ent_id field to get the entities
--								  to include in the record set.
--								  Filter Example: $$item_id=$$$$lot_no=$$$$item_grade_cd=$$$$item_status_cd=$$
-- Author						- Sheetal Jain
-- Date Created					- 01/31/2005
-- Version						- 2.1.0.15
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 02/09/2005		Raghu			2.1.13		HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 03/11/2005		SJ				21015		Sort order of items based on system attribute 210
-- 05/20/2005		Raghu			2.1.21		Re-written this sp such that the filters works with LIKE filters (%, _, etc..)
--												Added item_desc, item_class_id, and item_class_desc filters
-- 11/17/2005		Raghu			3.1.1		HD# 6192, Include inv_item_attr, inv_lot_attr columns in the recordset.
-- 04/13/2006		Raghu			3.1.14		HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities; Prepend 'N' before concatenating each string.
-- 10/10/2006		Raghu			3.1.23		HD# ?, in_flg parameter is changed to in_restrict_to_ent to support .NET middleware.
-- 12/20/2006		Raghu			3.1.26		HD# ?, Adjust expiry_date with GMT datetime along with other datetime columns in
--												the select clause.
-- 03/09/2007		Raghu			3.2.1		Added few more filters "wo_id, oper_id, serial_no, serialized_items flag" to filter the dataset.
-- 03/13/2007		Raghu			3.2.1		Fill the appropriate parent_ent_id while creating the storage entity structure.
-- 04/09/2007		Raghu			3.2.1		Add more restriction when the filter is applied in context of a job.
--													1) When opened in the context of a job and is hard pegged, the work order and to
--													   operation are disabled and the ITEM filter is set to BOM 0.
--													2) The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in
--													   BOM 0 item and its substitutes, and all job bom component serial numbers
--													   located at the selected location that are flagged for inheritance at the selected
--													   operation.
--													3) When hard pegged, the selected Work order will filter the list of BOM 0 item serial
--													   numbers listed in the current inventory grid but not when soft pegged.
-- 04/20/2007		Raghu			3.2.1		HD#  9741, Not handling Apostropes in Item _id
-- 05/29/2007		Raghu			3.2.1		HD# 9971, Serial numbers getting reverted in Select and Tranfers dialog
-- 07/12/2007		AML				3.2.1		Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
-- 01/14/2008		Raghu			3.4.0		L00073821; Error while clicking on inventory tab.
-- 01/25/2008		Raghu			3.4.0		L00074381; Inventory control for Operator - filter ...
-- 02/04/2008		AML				3.4.0		L00074523; Replaced all instances of @seq_no in the dynamic sql with Convert(nvarchar, @seq_no).
-- 12/23/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HF1432 Part of DateTime changes/fix
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@level						INT32_NULL
		,	@sql						NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@tempSql					NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@value						STRING2000_NULL
		,	@wo_id						STRING40_NULL
		,	@oper_id					STRING40_NULL
		,	@seq_no						INT32_NULL

		,	@serial_no					STRING40_NULL
		,	@serialized_items			NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@may_override_route			LOGICAL
		,	@hard_pegged				LOGICAL
		,	@filter_wo_id				STRING40_NULL
		,	@filter_oper_id				STRING40_NULL
		,	@user_id					STRING40_NULL
		,	@client_info				STRING40_NULL
		,	@user_has_priv_to_override	LOGICAL

	SELECT @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
		,@current_inventory = ISNULL(@current_inventory, 0)

	CREATE TABLE #tmp_tbl_schedentities( parent_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, child_level INT )

	SET @level = 1

	INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_schedentities( parent_ent_id, ent_id, child_level )
		SELECT se.storage_ent_id, se.ent_id, @level
		FROM storage_exec se
		WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id

	--If the flag is set, then the inventory is returned for just the specified entity
	IF (@restrict_to_ent = 0) BEGIN
		--Populate the temp table by descending down Storage_Exec.Storage_Ent_Id
		WHILE (1=1)	BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #tmp_tbl_schedentities( parent_ent_id, ent_id, child_level )
				SELECT t.ent_id, s.ent_id, @level + 1
				FROM #tmp_tbl_schedentities t WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN storage_exec s ON t.ent_id = s.storage_ent_id
				WHERE t.child_level = @level AND s.storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK
			SET @level = @level + 1
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SERIALIZED_ITEMS=', '$$', @serialized_items OUTPUT

	--Return the result set based on values present in temp table
	SET @sql = 'SELECT ii.row_id,ii.ent_id,ii.item_id,ii.lot_no,ii.sublot_no'

	IF ( @serialized_items = '1' ) BEGIN
		SET @sql = @sql +
				',CASE
							WHEN item.serial_no_lvl = -1 THEN NULL
							WHEN item.serial_no_lvl = 0 THEN ii.lot_no
							WHEN item.serial_no_lvl > 0 THEN ii.sublot_no
						END AS SERIAL_NO '
	END

	SET @sql =
		@sql + '	,ii.grade_cd
					,ii.status_cd
					,ent.ent_name
					,t.parent_ent_id AS located_at_ent_id
					,located_at.ent_name AS located_at_ent_name
					,item.item_desc
					,item.uom_id item_uom_id
					,item.inv_unique_by_job as inv_unique_by_job_h
					,item_grade.item_grade_desc
					,item_grade.color grade_color
					,item_state.item_status_desc
					,item_state.color state_color
					,ii.qty_left
					,ii.qty_left_erp
					,ii.uom_id
					,ii.date_in_utc AS date_in, ii.date_in_local, ii.date_in_utc
					,ii.date_out_utc AS date_out
					,ii.expiry_date  AS expiry_date
					,ii.wo_id
					,ii.oper_id
					,ii.seq_no
					,item.num_decimals
					,ii.last_edit_comment
					,ii.last_edit_by
					,ii.last_edit_at
					,CASE
							WHEN ii.uom_id IS NULL THEN (SELECT description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = item.uom_id)
							ELSE (SELECT description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = ii.uom_id)
						END uom_desc
					,item_class.item_class_id
					,item_class.item_class_desc
					,iia.*
					,ila.*
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			  INNER JOIN #tmp_tbl_schedentities t WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = t.ent_id
			  INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = ent.ent_id
			  INNER JOIN storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = se.ent_id
			  LEFT OUTER JOIN ent located_at WITH (NOLOCK) ON t.parent_ent_id = located_at.ent_id
			  INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = item.item_id
			  INNER JOIN item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
			  INNER JOIN item_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
			  INNER JOIN item_class WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_class.item_class_id = item.item_class_id
			  LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_item_attr iia WITH (NOLOCK) ON iia.inv_item_item_id_h=ii.item_id
			  LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila WITH (NOLOCK) ON ila.inv_lot_item_id_h=ii.item_id AND ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h=ii.lot_no '

	SET @tempSql = ''
	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_ID=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = 'WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END

		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(ii.item_id) '
--		IF ( CHARINDEX( @value, '%' ) > 0 ) OR ( CHARINDEX( @value, '_' ) > 0) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE(@value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
--		END
--		ELSE BEGIN
--			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + '=''' + REPLACE(@value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
--		END
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_DESC=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '' ) BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL ) OR ( @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(item.item_desc) '
--		IF ( CHARINDEX( @value, '%' ) > 0 ) OR ( CHARINDEX( @value, '_' ) > 0 ) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
/*		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + '=''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END*/
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_CLASS_ID=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(item_class.item_class_id)'
--		IF ( CHARINDEX( @value, '%' ) > 0 ) OR ( CHARINDEX( @value, '_' ) > 0 ) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
/*		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + '=''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END*/
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'ITEM_CLASS_DESC=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(item_class.item_class_desc)'
--		IF ( CHARINDEX( @value, '%' ) > 0 ) OR ( CHARINDEX( @value, '_' ) > 0 ) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
/*		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + '=''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END*/
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'LOT_NO=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(ii.lot_no)'
--		IF ( CHARINDEX( @value, '%' ) > 0 ) OR ( CHARINDEX( @value, '_' ) > 0 ) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
/*		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + '=''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END*/
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'GRADE_CD=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'ii.grade_cd IN ' + @value
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'STATUS_CD=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'ii.status_cd IN ' + @value
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'EXPIRY_DATE=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'ii.expiry_date=' + 'CONVERT( DATETIME, ''' + @value + ''')'
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'WO_ID=', '$$', @wo_id OUTPUT
	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'OPER_ID=', '$$', @oper_id OUTPUT
	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SEQ_NO=', '$$', @seq_no OUTPUT

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SERIAL_NO=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + '(ii.lot_no IN (SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''')'
	        SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' OR ii.sublot_no IN (SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @value, '''', '''''' ) + ''')'
	        SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ')'
	END

	EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filtr, 'SERIALIZED_ITEMS=', '$$', @value OUTPUT
	IF ( @value IS NOT NULL AND @value <> '') BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '' ) BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		        IF ( @value  = '1' ) BEGIN
			    SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' item.serial_no_lvl > -1 '
			END
	        ELSE IF ( @value  = '0' ) BEGIN
	            SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' item.serial_no_lvl = -1 '
	        END
	END

  	--Determine the sort order for items
	SET @value = null

	SELECT @value =
		CASE attr_value
		   WHEN '4' THEN ',item.item_desc, item.item_id'
		   WHEN '3' THEN ',item.item_id, item.item_desc'
		   WHEN '2' THEN ',item.item_desc'
		   ELSE ',item.item_id'
		END
	FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 210

	SET @value = ISNULL( @value, ',item.item_id' )

	--Verify whether the user is looking on current inventory.
	IF ( @current_inventory = 1 AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN

		SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
		FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE UPPER(wo_id) = @wo_id

		--Verify whether a valid seq_no is supplied.
		IF ( @seq_no IS NULL ) BEGIN
			--The seq_no is not supplied; retrieve a valid MIN(seq_no) from the current job.
			SELECT @seq_no = MIN(seq_no)
			FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE UPPER(wo_id) = @wo_id AND UPPER(oper_id) = @oper_id
		END

		IF ( @may_override_route = 0) BEGIN
			--Get the user id who is accessing the database.
			EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id output, @client_info output

			--Verify whether this user has a privilege to override the route.
			SELECT @user_has_priv_to_override = max(gpl.priv_value)
			FROM grp_priv_link gpl WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl WITH (NOLOCK) ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
			WHERE gpl.priv_id = 261 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id

			IF ( @user_has_priv_to_override IS NULL ) SET @user_has_priv_to_override = 0

			IF ( @user_has_priv_to_override = 0 ) BEGIN
				--This user does not have a privilege to override the route.
				--Verify whether a valid job can be identified

				--Verify whether this job is hard pegged.
				SELECT @hard_pegged = must_consume_from_wip
				FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE	UPPER(wo_id) = @wo_id
				  AND	UPPER(oper_id) = @oper_id
				  AND	seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND	bom_pos = 0

				IF ( @hard_pegged = 1 ) BEGIN
					SET @filter_wo_id = @wo_id
					--SET @filter_oper_id = @oper_id
					SELECT TOP 1 @filter_oper_id = jr.input_oper_id
					FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE	UPPER(jr.wo_id) = @wo_id
						AND	UPPER(jr.oper_id) = @oper_id
						AND	jr.seq_no = @seq_no
				END


			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--This user has a privilege to override the route;
			--meaning this user can see the inventory produced by any work order.
			SELECT @filter_wo_id = NULL, @filter_oper_id = NULL
		END

		--The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in BOM 0 item
		SET @sql = @sql + ' INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id=ii.item_id WHERE UPPER(jb.wo_id) = '''
		SET @sql = @sql + REPLACE( @wo_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND UPPER(jb.oper_id) = ''' + REPLACE( @oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND jb.seq_no = ' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @seq_no )
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND jb.bom_pos = 0 '
		IF ( @filter_wo_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			SET @sql = @sql + ' AND ii.wo_id=''' + REPLACE( @filter_wo_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END
		IF ( @filter_oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @sql = @sql + ' AND ii.oper_id=''' + REPLACE( @filter_oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END

		SET @sql = @sql + ' UNION '
		--The current inventory grid will list all uncompleted serial numbers for the passed in BOM 0 item
		--AND ITS SUBSTITUTES
		SET @sql = @sql + 'SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.item_id=ii.item_id INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.wo_id=jb.wo_id AND jbst.oper_id=jb.oper_id AND jbst.seq_no=jb.seq_no AND jbst.bom_pos=jb.bom_pos AND jbst.alt_no=jb.current_subst WHERE UPPER(jbst.wo_id) = '''
		SET @sql = @sql + REPLACE( @wo_id, '''', '''''') + ''''
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND UPPER(jbst.oper_id) = ''' + REPLACE( @oper_id, '''', '''''' )  + ''''
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND jbst.seq_no=' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @seq_no )
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND jb.bom_pos = 0'
		IF (@filter_wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @sql = @sql + ' AND ii.wo_id = ''' + REPLACE( @filter_wo_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END
		IF ( @filter_oper_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			SET @sql = @sql + ' AND ii.oper_id=''' + REPLACE( @filter_oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END

		SET @sql = @sql + ' UNION '
		--and all job bom component serial numbers located at the selected location that
		--are flagged for inheritance at the selected operation.
		SET @sql = @sql + 'SELECT DISTINCT ii.lot_no AS lot_no FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id=ii.item_id WHERE UPPER(jb.wo_id) = '''
		SET @sql = @sql + REPLACE( @wo_id, '''', '''''') + ''''
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND UPPER(jb.oper_id)=''' + REPLACE( @oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND jb.seq_no = ' + CONVERT( NVARCHAR, @seq_no )
		SET @sql = @sql + ' AND jb.bom_pos > 0 AND jb.serial_no_source = 1 '
		IF ( @filter_wo_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			SET @sql = @sql + ' AND ii.wo_id = ''' + REPLACE( @filter_wo_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END
		IF ( @filter_oper_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			SET @sql = @sql + ' AND ii.oper_id = ''' + REPLACE( @filter_oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END

		SET @sql = @sql + ') uncompleted_snos ON uncompleted_snos.lot_no = ii.lot_no '
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @filter_wo_id = @wo_id
		SET @filter_oper_id = @oper_id
	END

	SET @filter_wo_id = ISNULL( @filter_wo_id, @wo_id )
	IF ( @filter_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @filter_wo_id <> '' ) BEGIN
		IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '') BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(ii.wo_id)'
--		IF ( CHARINDEX( @filter_wo_id, '%' ) > 0 ) OR ( CHARINDEX( @filter_wo_id, '_' ) > 0 ) BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @filter_wo_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
/*		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' = ''' + REPLACE( @filter_wo_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
		END*/
	END

	SET @filter_oper_id = ISNULL( @filter_oper_id, @oper_id )
    IF ( @filter_oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @filter_oper_id <> '') BEGIN
    	IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '') BEGIN
		    SET @tempSql = ' WHERE '
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
		END
		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + 'UPPER(ii.oper_id)'
--    	IF ( CHARINDEX( @filter_oper_id,'%') > 0) OR  ( CHARINDEX( @filter_oper_id, '_' ) > 0 ) BEGIN
    		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' LIKE ''' + REPLACE( @filter_oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
/*		END
    	ELSE BEGIN
    		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' = ''' + REPLACE( @filter_oper_id, '''', '''''' ) + ''''
    	END*/
    END

	IF ( @serialized_items = '1' ) BEGIN
    	IF ( @tempSql IS NULL OR @tempSql = '') BEGIN
    	    SET @tempSql = 'WHERE '
		END
    	ELSE BEGIN
    		SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' AND '
    	END
    	SET @tempSql = @tempSql + ' ii.qty_left > 0 '
	END

	SET @sql = @sql + @tempSql + ' ORDER BY ent.ent_name' + @value + ',item_grade.item_grade_desc'

	EXEC( @sql )

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_inv_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[item_inv]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_inv_aft_ins
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any insert is made on item_inv table
--			HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 05/12/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.21
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	UPDATE item_inv SET qty_left = ROUND(i.qty_left, it.num_decimals), qty_left_erp =  ROUND(i.qty_left_erp, it.num_decimals)
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE item_inv.row_id = i.row_id
END

CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_Job_Step_TotalPrevSteps]
(@wo_id		STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@seq_no		INT32,
@step_seq	INT32,
@step_grp_id	INT32,
@step_count	INT32 OUTPUT,
@lot_no	STRING40 =null --rohit
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
/* Have preceding steps within this group been Completed: Check that all steps
with lower seq_no in same step_grp_id as this one have a row in job_step_data
with state_cd = COMPLETE or BYPASSED.*/
select @step_count = count(*)
	from job_step job_step LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step_data job_step_data
	ON job_step.wo_id = job_step_data.wo_id
		and job_step.oper_id = job_step_data.oper_id
		and job_step.seq_no = job_step_data.seq_no
		and job_step.step_no = job_step_data.step_no
	WHERE 	job_step.wo_id = @wo_id
		and job_step.oper_id = @oper_id
		and job_step.seq_no = @seq_no
		and job_step_data.lot_no = @lot_no --rohit
		and job_step.step_grp_id = @step_grp_id
		and job_step.step_seq < @step_seq
		and ((job_step_data.state_cd IS NULL) or (job_step_data.state_cd <> 4 and job_step_data.state_cd <> 8))
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_EI_sampleresults] 
(

)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- SET XACT_ABORT ON will cause the transaction to be uncommittable  
	-- when the constraint violation occurs.   
	SET XACT_ABORT ON;

	-- xml sample as shown below
	/*
	<?xml version="1.0"?>

		<testcompleted>2023-08-19T21:58:24</testcompleted>

	</LIMSResults>
	<LIMSResults>
		<limssampleid>S-230818-00221</limssampleid>
		<remarks>Damaged bag does not affect results</remarks>
		<disclaimer>The sample bag was damaged</disclaimer>
		<testmethod>Color Tests</testmethod>
		<testcompleted>2023-08-19T20:58:24</testcompleted>
		<datasetName>Color</datasetName>
		<datasetinstance>1</datasetinstance>
		<variant>Lovibond</variant>
		<datasetcompleted>2023-08-19T21:58:24</datasetcompleted>
		<parameter>Red value</parameter>
		<condition>Pass</condition>
		<displayValue>201</displayValue>
		<displayUnits/>
		<limitType>InSpec</limitType>
		<modDate>2023-08-19T19:58:23</modDate>
	</LIMSResults>
	<LIMSResults>
		<limssampleid>S-230818-00221</limssampleid>
		<remarks>Damaged bag does not affect results</remarks>
		<disclaimer>The sample bag was damaged</disclaimer>
		<testmethod>Color Tests</testmethod>
		<testcompleted>2023-08-19T20:58:24</testcompleted>
		<datasetName>Color</datasetName>
		<datasetinstance>1</datasetinstance>
		<variant>Lovibond</variant>
		<datasetcompleted>2023-08-19T21:58:24</datasetcompleted>
		<parameter>Blue value</parameter>
		<condition>Pass</condition>
		<displayValue>250</displayValue>
		<displayUnits/>
		<limitType>InSpec</limitType>
		<modDate>2023-08-19T19:58:23</modDate>
	</LIMSResults>
	<LIMSResults>
		<limssampleid>S-230818-00221</limssampleid>
		<remarks>Damaged bag does not affect results</remarks>
		<disclaimer>The sample bag was damaged</disclaimer>
		<testmethod>Color Tests</testmethod>
		<testcompleted>2023-08-19T20:58:24</testcompleted>
		<datasetName>Color</datasetName>
		<datasetinstance>1</datasetinstance>
		<variant>Lovibond</variant>
		<datasetcompleted>2023-08-19T21:58:24</datasetcompleted>
		<parameter>Yellow value</parameter>
		<condition>Pass</condition>
		<displayValue>310</displayValue>
		<displayUnits/>
		<limitType>InSpec</limitType>
		<modDate>2023-08-19T19:58:23</modDate>
	</LIMSResults>
	</ArrayOfLIMSResults>
	*/
	-- ' (apostrophe or single quote) REPLACE WITH ' 
	SET @xml_data_in = REPLACE(@xml_data_in, '''', ''');

	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(254) = '';
	DECLARE @msg_output NVARCHAR(500) = '';
	DECLARE @cur_sys_local_time DATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @converted_data_xml XML = CONVERT(XML, @xml_data_in);
	DECLARE @i_min INT;
	DECLARE @i_max INT;
	DECLARE @char_id INT32 = NULL;-- default value
	DECLARE @sample_id INT32 = NULL;-- default value
	DECLARE @value_no INT32_NULL = NULL;
	DECLARE @result_value TFLOAT;
	DECLARE @act_sample_size INT32_NULL = NULL;
	DECLARE @created_by STRING80_NULL = 'MES-LIMS interface';
	DECLARE @created_at_utc TDATETIME = NULL;
	DECLARE @created_at_local TDATETIME;
	DECLARE @created_at_tz INT32 = NULL;
	DECLARE @superseded INT32_NULL = NULL;
	DECLARE @last_edit_comment NOTES_NULL = 'inserted through MES-LIMS interface';
	DECLARE @validate_control_rules LOGICAL = 1;
	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL;
	DECLARE @last_edit_at DATETIME = NULL;
	DECLARE @row_id INT = NULL;
	DECLARE @control_rule_violations NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL;
	DECLARE @attr_id_lims_value INT;
	DECLARE @result_value_for_non_numeric_type FLOAT = - 999999;	-- default value in case if the result value is not numeric. 
	DECLARE @limssampleid NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @remarks NVARCHAR(254);
	DECLARE @disclaimer NVARCHAR(254);
	DECLARE @testmethod NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @testcompleted DATETIME;
	DECLARE @datasetName NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @datasetinstance INT;
	DECLARE @variant NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @datasetcompleted DATETIME;
	DECLARE @parameter NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @condition NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @displayValue NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @displayUnits NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @limitType NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @modDate DATETIME;
	DECLARE @tbl_ResultData TABLE (
		row_id INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
		,limssampleid NVARCHAR(40)
		,remarks NVARCHAR(254)
		,disclaimer NVARCHAR(254)
		,testmethod NVARCHAR(40)
		,testcompleted DATETIME
		,datasetName NVARCHAR(80)
		,datasetinstance INT
		,variant NVARCHAR(40)
		,datasetcompleted DATETIME
		,parameter NVARCHAR(40)
		,condition NVARCHAR(20)
		,displayValue NVARCHAR(40)
		,displayUnits NVARCHAR(40)
		,limitType NVARCHAR(40)
		,modDate DATETIME
		);

	INSERT INTO @tbl_ResultData (
		limssampleid
		,remarks
		,disclaimer
		,testmethod
		,testcompleted
		,datasetName
		,datasetinstance
		,variant
		,datasetcompleted
		,parameter
		,condition
		,displayValue
		,displayUnits
		,limitType
		,modDate
		)
	SELECT C.value('limssampleid[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS limssampleid
		,C.value('remarks[1]', 'nvarchar(254)') AS remarks
		,C.value('disclaimer[1]', 'nvarchar(254)') AS disclaimer
		,C.value('testmethod[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS testmethod
		,C.value('testcompleted[1]', 'datetime') AS testcompleted
		,C.value('datasetName[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS datasetName
		,C.value('datasetinstance[1]', 'int') AS datasetinstance
		,C.value('variant[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS variant
		,C.value('datasetcompleted[1]', 'datetime') AS datasetcompleted
		,C.value('parameter[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS parameter
		,C.value('condition[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS condition
		,C.value('displayValue[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS displayValue
		,C.value('displayUnits[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS displayUnits
		,C.value('limitType[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS limitType
		,C.value('modDate[1]', 'datetime') AS modDate
	FROM @converted_data_xml.nodes('/ArrayOfLIMSResults/LIMSResults') AS T(C);

	SELECT @i_min = MIN(row_id)
		,@i_max = MAX(row_id)
	FROM @tbl_ResultData;

	SELECT @attr_id_lims_value = attr_id
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = 'lims_value'
		AND attr_grp = 11;-- attr_grp = 11 means result_attr

	SELECT @limssampleid = limssampleid
	FROM @tbl_ResultData
	WHERE row_id = @i_min;

	SELECT @sample_id = sample_id
	FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE spare1 = @limssampleid;-- sample.spare1 field stores lims sample id

	-- check the sample exist in mes or not; if not throw an error
	IF (@sample_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- string_id 500006 = 'The given LIMS sample not exist in MES DB.  LIMS Sample id: '
		SELECT  @msg = CONCAT (dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500006, NULL, NULL), @limssampleid) ;
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';

		RAISERROR (
				@msg_output
				,16
				,1
				);

		Return -1 ;
	END;

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;

		WHILE (@i_min <= @i_max)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @limssampleid = limssampleid
				,@remarks = remarks
				,@disclaimer = disclaimer
				,@testmethod = testmethod
				,@testcompleted = testcompleted
				,@datasetName = datasetName
				,@datasetinstance = datasetinstance
				,@variant = variant
				,@datasetcompleted = datasetcompleted
				,@parameter = parameter
				,@condition = condition
				,@displayValue = displayValue
				,@displayUnits = displayUnits
				,@limitType = limitType
				,@modDate = modDate
			FROM @tbl_ResultData
			WHERE row_id = @i_min;

			-- get the characterstic(parameter) id from MES characterstic table.  spare1 = parameter name, spare2 = test method and spare3 = variant in characterstic table.
			SELECT @char_id = char_id
			FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE spare1 = @parameter
				AND spare2 = @testmethod
				AND spare3 = @variant;

			-- if the given characterstic exist in MESDB, set its value against the given sample id
			IF (@char_id IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				-- use the std. SP sp_I_result to create results
				-- if numeric result, add directly in result table using std SP with actual value; otherwise set result attr with non-numeric value what we have.
				-- for non-numeric type result, first create a record in result table with value as -999999, and then set the actual value in result_attr table.  
				-- the value -999999 indicates its actual value present in result_attr table.
				SET @result_value = @result_value_for_non_numeric_type;-- default initialization 

				IF (ISNUMERIC(@displayValue) = 1)
				BEGIN
					SET @result_value = CONVERT(FLOAT, @displayValue);
				END;

				EXEC sp_I_Result 
					@sample_id = @sample_id
					,@char_id = @char_id
					,@value_no = @value_no OUTPUT
					,@result_value = @result_value
					,@act_sample_size = @act_sample_size
					,@created_by = @created_by
					,@created_at_utc = @created_at_utc
					,@created_at_local = @cur_sys_local_time
					,@created_at_tz = @created_at_tz
					,@superseded = @superseded
					,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
					,@validate_control_rules = @validate_control_rules
					,@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
					,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT
					,@row_id = @row_id OUTPUT
					,@control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations OUTPUT;

				IF (ISNUMERIC(@displayValue) = 0)
				BEGIN
					EXEC sp_I_Result_Attr 
						@sample_id = @sample_id
						,@char_id = @char_id
						,@value_no = @value_no
						,@attr_id = @attr_id_lims_value
						,@attr_value = @displayValue
						,@notes = NULL
						,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
						,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT;
				END;
			END;

			--ELSE BEGIN
			--	-- check need to insert characteristic or not.  at moment not inserting the missing characteristic in mes table.
			--END ;	
			
			-- reset @char_id
			SELECT @char_id = NULL;

			-- increment the row id
			SET @i_min = @i_min + 1;
		END;

		-- v1.00
		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_EI_result_arrived]
			@sample_id = @sample_id

		-- If the SPs execution  succeeds, commit the transaction.  
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'LIMS Sample Id: ' + @limssampleid + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';

		SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @msg = ERROR_MESSAGE();
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';

		-- XACT_STATE:  
		-- If 1, the transaction is committable.  
		-- If -1, the transaction is uncommittable and should be rolled back.  
		-- XACT_STATE = 0 means that there is no transaction and  
		--     a commit or rollback operation would generate an error.  
		-- Test whether the transaction is uncommittable.  
		IF (XACT_STATE()) = - 1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

			RAISERROR (
					@msg_output
					,16
					,1
					);

			Return -1 ;
		END;

		-- Test whether the transaction is committable.
		-- You may want to commit a transaction in a catch block if you want to commit changes to statements that ran prior to the error.
		--IF (XACT_STATE()) = 1
		--BEGIN
		--	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

		--	SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'LIMS Sample Id: ' + @limssampleid + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';			
		--END;

		SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cust_Contact]

,	@spare4				STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					-
-- Description					-

--

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version			Changes
-- 07/05/2007		AML			3.2.0			Ported to Sql Server 2000
--10/13/2011            Praveen P               4.0 SP2                 CR #L00116943  Clone CR-L00116640
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT	cust_contact.cust_id
		,	cust_contact.contact_id
		,	cust_contact.contact_name
		,	cust_contact.dept
		,	cust_contact.phone
		,	cust_contact.fax
		,	cust_contact.email
		,	cust_contact.spare1
		,	cust_contact.spare2
		,	cust_contact.spare3
		,	cust_contact.spare4
		,	cust.cust_name
		,	cust_contact.last_edit_comment
		,	cust_contact.last_edit_by
		,	cust_contact.last_edit_at
		,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, cust_contact.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM cust_contact WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cust WITH (NOLOCK) ON cust_contact.cust_id = cust.cust_id
	WHERE (
			(cust_contact.cust_id = @cust_id OR @cust_id IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.contact_id = @contact_id OR @contact_id IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.contact_name = @contact_name OR @contact_name IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.dept = @dept OR @dept IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(cust_contact.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
	ORDER BY cust_contact.contact_name

END
