CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Clone_Job]
(
	@wo_id					STRING40,
	@oper_id				STRING40,
	@seq_no					INT32,
	@user_id				STRING40,
	@new_wo_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@new_oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL,
	@new_seq_no				INT32_NULL = NULL,
	@req_qty				TFLOAT_NULL  = NULL,
	@start_qty				TFLOAT_NULL  = NULL,
	@req_finish_time_local	TDATETIME = NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author               -
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/03/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes - I don't think this procedure is used.
-- 08/17/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @row_count INT32
		,	@standard_time_to_do_this_job TFLOAT
		,	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc TDATETIME
		,	@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_wo_id STRING40
		,	@J_oper_id STRING40
		,	@J_seq_no INT32
		,	@J_job_desc string80
		,	@J_item_id STRING40
		,	@J_state_cd INT32
		,	@J_job_priority INT32
		,	@J_req_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_req_finish_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_init_sched_ent_id INT32
		,	@J_target_sched_ent_id INT32
		,	@J_run_ent_id INT32
		,	@J_qty_reqd TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_prod TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_prod_erp TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_rejected TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_rejected_erp TFLOAT
		,	@J_qty_at_start TFLOAT
		,	@J_batch_size TFLOAT
		,	@J_first_job logical
		,	@J_final_job logical
		,	@J_sched_pinned logical
		,	@J_check_inv logical
		,	@J_est_fixed_lab TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_lab_rate TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_setup_time TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_teardown_time TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_prod_rate TFLOAT
		,	@J_est_transfer_time TFLOAT
		,	@J_sched_start_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_sched_start_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_latest_start_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_latest_start_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_sched_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_sched_finish_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_start_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_start_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@J_act_finish_time_local TDATETIME
		,	@J_concurrent_link INT32
		,	@J_job_cost TFLOAT
		,	@J_notes nvarchar(4000)
		,	@J_assoc_file string254
		,	@J_assoc_file_type string20
		,	@J_status_notes varchar(2000)
		,	@J_edited_by STRING40
		,	@J_edit_time TDATETIME
		,	@J_display_seq INT32
		,	@J_data_log_grp_id INT32
		,	@J_folder_ver_id STRING40
		,	@J_rework logical
		-- variables for JOB_ROUTE table fields
		,	@JR_wo_id STRING40
		,	@JR_oper_id STRING40
		,	@JR_seq_no INT32
		,	@JR_input_oper_id STRING40
		,	@JR_input_seq_no INT32
		,	@JR_input_percent TFLOAT
		,	@JR_mod_id timestamp
		,	@req_finish_time_utc TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp INT

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @req_finish_time_local, @tz_temp, @req_finish_time_utc OUTPUT

--1.	Check if the new wo_id/oper_id/seq_no exist raise an error, exit proc.  If none of new.. specified, crate new_seq_no
	--check if the row exists in the JOB table
	DECLARE JOB_cursor CURSOR LOCAL
	FOR SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc,
			item_id, state_cd, job_priority, req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local,
			init_sched_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd,
			qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp,
			qty_at_start, batch_size, first_job, final_job,
			sched_pinned, check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate,
			est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, est_transfer_time,
			sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local, latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local,
			sched_finish_time_utc, sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local,
			act_finish_time_utc, act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link, job_cost, notes,
			assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes, edited_by,
			edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework
	FROM JOB
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no

	OPEN JOB_cursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM JOB_cursor
	INTO	@J_wo_id, @J_oper_id, @J_seq_no, @J_job_desc,
			@J_item_id, @J_state_cd, @J_job_priority, @J_req_finish_time_utc, @J_req_finish_time_local,
			@J_init_sched_ent_id, @J_target_sched_ent_id, @J_run_ent_id, @J_qty_reqd,
			@J_qty_prod, @J_qty_prod_erp, @J_qty_rejected, @J_qty_rejected_erp,
			@J_qty_at_start, @J_batch_size, @J_first_job, @J_final_job,
			@J_sched_pinned, @J_check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate,
			@J_est_setup_time, @J_est_teardown_time, @J_est_prod_rate, @J_est_transfer_time,
			@J_sched_start_time_utc, @J_sched_start_time_local, @J_latest_start_time_utc, @J_latest_start_time_local,
			@J_sched_finish_time_utc, @J_sched_finish_time_local, @J_act_start_time_utc, @J_act_start_time_local,
			@J_act_finish_time_utc, @J_act_finish_time_local, @J_concurrent_link, @J_job_cost, @J_notes,
			@J_assoc_file, @J_assoc_file_type, @J_status_notes, @J_edited_by,
			@J_edit_time, @J_display_seq, @J_folder_ver_id, @J_rework
	IF @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
--2.	Check if user has permission to clone, if not,  raise an error, exit proc.
--3.	if new_wo_id is specified oper_id, seq_no will remain same for the new record being created
			--ELSE(for new_wo_id = NULL) look in the job table for wo_id and oper_id
			--and calculate next seq_no (ie. new_seq_no)
		if @new_wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @new_wo_id = @wo_id
		END
		if @new_oper_id IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @new_oper_id = @oper_id
		END
		if @new_seq_no IS NULL BEGIN
			if (@new_wo_id = @wo_id) AND (@new_oper_id = @oper_id) BEGIN
				SELECT @new_seq_no = max(seq_no) + 1
				FROM JOB WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @new_seq_no = @seq_no
			END
		END
		--set the variables before inserting in JOB table
		if @req_qty IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @req_qty = @J_qty_reqd
		END
		if @start_qty IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @start_qty = @J_qty_at_start
		END
		if @req_finish_time_utc IS NULL BEGIN
			SELECT	@req_finish_time_utc = @J_req_finish_time_utc
				,	@req_finish_time_local = @J_req_finish_time_local
		END
		SET @J_edit_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
--5.		calculate latest start time (JOB table) by using req_qty and req_finish_time
		SET @standard_time_to_do_this_job = @J_est_setup_time + @J_est_teardown_time + @J_est_transfer_time
			+ (@J_est_prod_rate * @start_qty)

		SET @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local =
			DATEADD(Hour, -ROUND(CONVERT(float, @standard_time_to_do_this_job), 0), @req_finish_time_local)

		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, @tz_temp, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc OUTPUT

		EXEC sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 1, 'sp_Clone_Job', 'sp_Clone_Job', 'Before inserting into JOB', 'INSERT INTO JOB', ''
--4.		Clone JOB table row (everything but wo_id, seq_no, state_cd,  req_finish_time, run_ent_id,
			--qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start,
			--sched_pinned, sched_start_time, sched_finish_time, act_start_time,
			--act_finish_time, concurrent_link, status_notes, edited_by, edit_time
		INSERT INTO JOB
		(
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, job_desc, item_id, state_cd, job_priority,
			req_finish_time_utc, req_finish_time_local, init_sched_ent_id,
			target_sched_ent_id, run_ent_id, qty_reqd, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp,
			qty_rejected, qty_rejected_erp, qty_at_start, batch_size, first_job,
			final_job, sched_pinned, check_inv, est_fixed_lab, est_lab_rate,
			est_setup_time, est_teardown_time, est_prod_rate, est_transfer_time,
			sched_start_time_utc, sched_start_time_local,
			latest_start_time_utc, latest_start_time_local, sched_finish_time_utc,
			sched_finish_time_local, act_start_time_utc, act_start_time_local,
			act_finish_time_utc, act_finish_time_local, concurrent_link, job_cost,
			notes, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, status_notes,
			edited_by, edit_time, display_seq, folder_ver_id, rework
		)
		VALUES	--state_cd=1-NEW,
		(
			@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @J_job_desc,
			@J_item_id, 1, @J_job_priority, @req_finish_time_utc, @req_finish_time_local,
			@J_init_sched_ent_id, @J_target_sched_ent_id, NULL, @req_qty,
			0, NULL, 0, NULL, @start_qty, @J_batch_size, @J_first_job, @J_final_job,
			0, @J_check_inv, @J_est_fixed_lab, @J_est_lab_rate, @J_est_setup_time,
			@J_est_teardown_time, @J_est_prod_rate, @J_est_transfer_time,
			NULL, NULL, @latest_start_time_for_this_job_utc,
			@latest_start_time_for_this_job_local, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, @J_job_cost,
			@J_notes, @J_assoc_file, @J_assoc_file_type, NULL, @user_id,
			@J_edit_time, @J_display_seq, @J_folder_ver_id, @J_rework
		)
--6.	Clone JOB_BOM table row(s)* and then Clone JOB_BOM_STEP table row(s)*.
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_BOM @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
--7.	Clone*** JOB_SPEC table row(s)*.
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_spec @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
--8.	Clone*** JOB_STEP table row(s)*.
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_step @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
--9.	Clone JOB_ROUTE row.  Here if the new_wo_id is same as wo_id (just clone a job)
			--then insert new record with new seq_no, everything else remains same.
			--If new_wo_id is different then wo_id (clone to a new work order),
			--we have to clone the input JOB row before we can clone a row in the job_route.
		if @new_wo_id = @wo_id BEGIN
			EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_route @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no
		END
		CLOSE JOB_cursor
		DEALLOCATE JOB_cursor
	END
END

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description

-- Description	      - Extracts the file extension from the given file name
-- Author		- Raghu

-- Version			 - 6.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
-- 10/25/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084807 - Modified so that null is returned if there is no file extension
-- 11/27/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084813 - Modified to strip off
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetFileExtn]
(@file_name AS STRING254
) RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @tmp_file_name NVARCHAR(MAX)

	SET @tmp_file_name = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('.', @file_name) > 0 THEN N'.' + RIGHT( @file_name, CHARINDEX(N'.', REVERSE( @file_name ) + N'.' ) - 1 ) ELSE null END

	IF CHARINDEX(':', @tmp_file_name) > 0 BEGIN
		SET @tmp_file_name = SUBSTRING(@tmp_file_name, 1, CHARINDEX(':', @tmp_file_name)-1)
	END

	IF CHARINDEX('?', @tmp_file_name) > 0 BEGIN
		SET @tmp_file_name = SUBSTRING(@tmp_file_name, 1, CHARINDEX('?', @tmp_file_name)-1)
	END

	IF CHARINDEX('/', @tmp_file_name) > 0 BEGIN
		SET @tmp_file_name = SUBSTRING(@tmp_file_name, 1, CHARINDEX('/', @tmp_file_name)-1)
	END

	RETURN @tmp_file_name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_Attr]
(@shift_id  int = NULL,
 @shift_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime
 )
  AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Shift_Attr
-- Description			- Get all shift attributes
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	    Changes
-- 01/22/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 03/09/2018	  Srinivasa     6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 03/23/2018	  Surya			6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

  BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 13

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

   IF (@shift_id IS NULL AND @shift_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @shift_id = shift.shift_id FROM shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE shift.shift_desc= @shift_desc

	IF (@shift_id IS NULL)
		SET @shift_id = -1
  END

  SELECT shift_attr.shift_id
            ,shift.shift_desc
            ,shift_attr.attr_id
            ,shift_attr.attr_value
            ,shift_attr.notes
            ,attr.attr_desc
	        ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,shift_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,shift_attr.last_edit_by
            ,shift_attr.last_edit_at
FROM shift_attr shift_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_attr.shift_id = shift.shift_id
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((shift_attr.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
       (shift_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (shift_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (shift_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (shift_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY attr.attr_desc, shift.shift_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots]
(@row_id					INT32
,@wo_id						STRING80
,@oper_id					STRING80
,@seq_no					INT32
,@shift_start				TDATETIME
,@shift_start_tz			INT32= NULL
,@item_id					STRING80
,@lot_no					STRING80
,@sublot_no					STRING80
,@fg_lot_no					STRING80
,@fg_sublot_no				STRING80
,@reas_cd					INT32
,@user_id					STRING80
,@item_scrapped				LOGICAL
,@ent_id					INT32
,@shift_id					INT32
,@grade_cd					INT32
,@status_cd					INT32
,@from_ent_id				INT32
,@qty_cons					TFLOAT
,@qty_cons_erp				TFLOAT
,@ext_ref					STRING40
,@transaction_type			INT32
,@spare1					STRING80
,@spare2					STRING80
,@spare3					STRING80
,@spare4					STRING80
,@last_edit_by				STRING40
,@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
,@must_consume_from_wip		LOGICAL
,@must_consume_from_inv		LOGICAL
,@checkgrade				LOGICAL
,@inv_oper_id				STRING80
,@inv_seq_no				INT32
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 =NULL
,@apply_indistlots_option	INT32 = 0
,@in_to_uom_id				STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date			TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date_tz		INT32 = NULL
,@transfer_option			INT32 = 0
,@transfer_comments			STRING254 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndist_Lots
-- Description	      -	HD# 3654, Apply Indistinguishable lots
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	05/12/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.16.SQL
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Parameters		- apply_indistlots_option-0: Defaults to consumption transaction
--			  apply_inditlots_option-1: Identifies this is an inventory transfer.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver	Changes
-- 05/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.17	HD# 3654; This procedure was originally written to cater consumption transactions;
--					but this is enhanced now to support inventory transfers as well, because the inventory
--					transfers as well follow the same logic. So, the consumption or inventory transactions
--					are handled depending upon the apply_indistlots option in the storage_exec.
--06/22/2006	Raghu		3.1.18	HD# 3654, Use item's native UOM ID when backflush is set to true (automatic consumption)
--					Also, ignore rows that has 0 quantities.
--01/23/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--06/15/2007    Raghu       3.2.16  Move inventory to downstream job ONLY if it is instructed to do so.
--03/04/2007	AML			3.4.0	L00075593: Added missing arguments to calls so sp_U_Item_Cons_AddGeneology.
-- 08/22/2009	Raghu		4.0		DB Changes
--11/26/2009	AJAY		4.0.0	H1423 FIX
--02/08/2010	Ajay		4.0.0	Added FIX for CR 90935
--04/30/2012    siddu       4.0 Sp2 Added Fix For CR119216
--06/05/2012		Saiteja		4.2		Added Changes for the Merge of CR120590
--07/27/2012        Ashish      4.5     Reverting back the code changes as the HF CR120590 rejected.
--10/22/2012	Saiteja		4.6   Added Changes for Merge CR L00123384 cloned for L00123132.
--06/02/2014	Raghu		5.0   MOL: Merge L00124379 (HF CR L00124019) not taking into account the storage location can have negative inventory
--					Refactored the code.
-- 07/01/2015    Neeraja    5.2	 CR L00137223  : (HF-L00136863)Changes done in order to address one error while consuming the quantity and stopping a record with null value for lot is to be inserted in item_cons table.
--08/25/2016    Malleswara  5.03  US#661954 Merge changes Merge CR#L00141647 changes : Minimum traceable Inventory amount' is not applied for indistinguishable lots in storage entity.
-- 29/03/2019   Srinivasa    6.1   CR#L00152259 to  Merge HF CR L00151788: MES does not main distinct consumption records.
-- 04/11/2019   Srinivasa   6.2     US#1180034;Merge CR#L00153744 for HF L00153281: Added row_id parameter to sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce call
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE @indistinguishable_lots	LOGICAL
	,@item_uom_id			INT32
	,@inv_row_id			INT32
	,@inv_item_id			STRING80
	,@inv_lot_no			STRING80
	,@inv_sublot_no			STRING80
	,@total_qty_left_in_inv		TFLOAT
	,@qty_left_in_inv		TFLOAT
	,@qty_to_reduce			TFLOAT
	,@qty_to_consume		TFLOAT
	,@qty_cons_in_inv_units		TFLOAT
	,@ent_name			STRING80
	,@to_ent_name			STRING80
	,@qty_limit			TFLOAT
	,@uom_count			INT32
	,@inv_uom_id			INT32
	,@min_inv_qty			TFLOAT
	,@factor			TFLOAT
	,@offset			TFLOAT
	,@from_uom_desc			STRING40
	,@to_uom_desc			STRING40
	,@maintain_dist_cons_records	INT32
	,@item_num_decimals		INT32
	,@err_msg			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@log_inv_transfers		INT32
	,@dbg_resp			INT32
	,@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
	,@curr_local_time		TDATETIME
	,@curr_utc_time			TDATETIME
	,@indistinguishable_lots_to_ent	LOGICAL
	,@distinct_cons NVARCHAR(1) = '0'

BEGIN
--@apply_indistlots_option = 0: represents adding consumption and reducing inventory
--@apply_indistlots_option = 1: represents transferring inventory from one location to another location

      -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots_t', @src_key='sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots_t', @date_val1 = @shift_start, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_tz, @date_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz
    if ( @dbg_resp = 1 )
		RETURN

	--If the option is not specified, then default to consumption transaction.
	SET @apply_indistlots_option = ISNULL(@apply_indistlots_option, 0)
	SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start, DATEADD(MI, -@shift_start_tz, @shift_start))
	SET @curr_utc_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
	SET @curr_local_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @curr_utc_time)

	--Log inventory transfers only if the transaction is a pure inventory transaction;
	--On all other cases, default the inventory transfers to false.
	IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 0) SELECT @transfer_option = 2, @log_inv_transfers = 0
	ELSE IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 1) SET @log_inv_transfers = 1

	--Verify whether the inventory location is defined as indistinguishable lots
	IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 0) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the inventory location is defined as indistinguishable lots
		SELECT @indistinguishable_lots = indistinguishable_lots
		FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

		--Check if the indistinguishable lots for the entity is true or not.
		IF (@indistinguishable_lots = 0) BEGIN
			--Reduce the inventory ONLY if the request is to consume quantities.
			--The indistinguishable lots for the consuming entity is false, so proceed further as part of the normal inventory consumption.
            		--RaghuK CR L00088636 Pass the @inv_oper_id, @inv_seq_no instead of @oper_id, @seq_no
			EXEC  sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=@qty_cons_erp
					, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
					, @must_consume_from_inv=@must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=@must_consume_from_wip, @checkgrade=@checkGrade, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@inv_oper_id, @seq_no=@inv_seq_no
					, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @item_uom_id = i.uom_id
		FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE i.item_id = @item_id
	END
	--If the current option is to transfer inventory, then identify the source row using the supplied row_id
	ELSE IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @from_ent_id = ii.ent_id, @item_id = ii.item_id, @lot_no = ii.lot_no, @sublot_no = ii.sublot_no, @item_uom_id = COALESCE(@in_to_uom_id, i.uom_id)
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE ii.row_id = @row_id

		IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'source inventory row:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @row_id)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether the inventory location is defined as indistinguishable lots
		SELECT @indistinguishable_lots = indistinguishable_lots
		FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
	END

	SELECT @ent_name = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
	IF (@ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied item and lot exists in the inventory.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
			  AND ii.item_id = @item_id
			  AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))) BEGIN
		IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 0) AND (@lot_no IS NULL) BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg ='The item: %1 you are trying to consume from the inventory location: %2, lot: %3 does not exist.{4987},' + @item_id + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@lot_no, 'NULL');
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @err_msg ='The item: %1 you are trying to consume from the inventory location: %2, lot: %3 does not exist.{4987},' + @item_id + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@lot_no, 'NULL');
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SELECT @uom_count = COUNT(DISTINCT uom_id)
	FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
	GROUP BY ii.uom_id

	IF (@uom_count > 1) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg ='The items or lots in the inventory location: %1 do not have a common unit.{7891},' + @ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 @inv_uom_id = ii.uom_id
	FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id

	IF (@inv_uom_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg ='The items or lots in the inventory location: %1 do not have a common unit.{7891},' + @ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Reset the factor and offset values to null.
	SELECT @factor = NULL, @offset = NULL

	--Convert the quantity in inventory into native units of the item before logging the consumption record.
	IF (@item_uom_id <> @inv_uom_id) BEGIN
		--Get the conversion factor for the source uom_id and destination uom_id
		--Check if any conversion factor exist for this item; if exist get that conversion factor
		--else get a generic conversion factor
		SELECT TOP 1 @factor = factor, @offset = offset FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE from_uom_id = @item_uom_id AND to_uom_id = @inv_uom_id
		  AND (item_id = @item_id OR item_id IS NULL)
		ORDER BY item_id DESC

		--If there is no conversion factor defined between the item in the inventory and native units of the item, throw an error.
		IF (@factor IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @from_uom_desc = NULL, @to_uom_desc = NULL

			SELECT @from_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @item_uom_id
			IF (@from_uom_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified from uom ID: %1 used by the source inventory item does not exist in the database.{7900},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @item_uom_id)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT @to_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @inv_uom_id
			IF (@to_uom_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified uom ID: %1 for the destination inventory item does not exist in the database.{7901},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @inv_uom_id)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SET @err_msg = 'A conversion factor does not exist for the item: %1 to convert the quantities from uom: %2 to the uom: %3 used in the inventory location: %4.{7892},' + @item_id + ',' + @from_uom_desc + ','  + @to_uom_desc + ',' + @ent_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		SET @qty_cons_in_inv_units = (@qty_cons * COALESCE(@factor, 1)) + COALESCE(@offset, 0)
	END
	ELSE SET @qty_cons_in_inv_units = @qty_cons

	--Get the indistinguishable lots property from the destination entity
	SELECT @indistinguishable_lots_to_ent = indistinguishable_lots
	FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

	--Get the minimum traceable inventory quantity from the system attribute table
	SELECT @min_inv_qty = CONVERT(FLOAT, attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 343
	SET @min_inv_qty = COALESCE(@min_inv_qty, 0)

	SELECT @maintain_dist_cons_records = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
	SET @maintain_dist_cons_records = COALESCE(@maintain_dist_cons_records, 0)

	--Default the total qty and total_qty_erp to 0.
	SELECT @total_qty_left_in_inv = 0, @qty_to_consume = 0

	--Check if there are >0 quantities; if we don't find any quantities that are greater than 0,
	--then default to any quantities. If then entity does not allow negative quantities, then the
	--reduceInv method will automatically catch the exception.
	SET @qty_limit = 0
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND qty_left > 0)
		SET @qty_limit = NULL

	SELECT @total_qty_left_in_inv = SUM(ii.qty_left)
	FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
	  AND (ii.qty_left > @qty_limit OR @qty_limit IS NULL)

	-- Begin HF L00136863 (CR L00137223 )
	IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 0)
	BEGIN
		-- Since apply indist lots is true, reduce the item_cons record with current consumption to allow the consumed quantity to
		-- be correctly prorated across all lots in inventory
		UPDATE item_cons SET qty_cons = qty_cons - @qty_cons WHERE row_id = @row_id
		-- Verify whether current cons qty is 0 and if so delete this row
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = @row_id and qty_cons = 0)
			DELETE FROM item_cons WHERE row_id = @row_id
	END
	-- End HF L00136863 (CR L00137223 )

	--Now, we have the total quantities in the destination unit of measurement.
	--Loop through each item in the inventory; consume the item from the inventory and add it to the
	--consumption record.
	DECLARE item_inv_indist CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT ii.item_id, ii.lot_no, ii.sublot_no, ii.qty_left, ii.uom_id item_inv_uom_id,
		 i.uom_id, i.num_decimals, ii.row_id FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
	  AND (ii.qty_left > @qty_limit OR @qty_limit IS NULL)

	OPEN item_inv_indist
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM item_inv_indist INTO @inv_item_id, @inv_lot_no, @inv_sublot_no, @qty_left_in_inv
			, @inv_uom_id, @item_uom_id, @item_num_decimals, @inv_row_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--If the option is to transfer inventory, convert the quantities into destination units, if supplied.
		--Since this SP does not know the storage properties for the destination location (e.g., indistinguishable or not, has UOM or not, etc.), simply convert the quantities into destination units
		--and let the Inventory Transfer SP handle the units appropriately.
		IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 1)
			SET @item_uom_id = COALESCE(@in_to_uom_id, @inv_uom_id)

		--Reset the factor and offset values to null.
		SELECT @factor = NULL, @offset = NULL

		--Convert the quantity in inventory into native units of the item before logging the consumption record.
		IF (@inv_uom_id <> @item_uom_id) BEGIN
			--Get the conversion factor for the source uom_id and destination uom_id
			--Check if any conversion factor exist for this item; if exist get that conversion factor
			--else get a generic conversion factor
			SELECT TOP 1 @factor = factor, @offset = offset FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE from_uom_id = @inv_uom_id AND to_uom_id = @item_uom_id
			  AND (item_id = @inv_item_id OR item_id IS NULL)
			ORDER BY item_id DESC

			--If there is no conversion factor defined between the item in the inventory and native units of the item, throw an error.
			IF (@factor IS NULL) BEGIN
				SELECT @from_uom_desc = NULL, @to_uom_desc = NULL

				SELECT @from_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @inv_uom_id
				IF (@from_uom_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = 'The specified from uom ID: %1 used by the source inventory item does not exist in the database.{7900},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @inv_uom_id)
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				SELECT @to_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @item_uom_id
				IF (@to_uom_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = 'The specified uom ID: %1 for the destination inventory item does not exist in the database.{7901},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @item_uom_id)
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				SET @err_msg = 'A conversion factor between %1 and %2 is required to convert this item into destination units, because the item: %3 stored in the inventory location: %4, lot: %5 uses a different unit of measurement than the item: %6 stored in the inventory location: %7, lot: %8. Pl add a conversion factor between two units.{4990},'
						+ ISNULL(@from_uom_desc, 'NULL') + ',' + ISNULL(@to_uom_desc, 'NULL')  + ',' + @inv_item_id + ',' + ISNULL(@inv_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + @item_id + ','  + ISNULL(@lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		--Calculate the prorated quantity that needs to be reduced from the current inventory location
		SELECT @qty_to_reduce = (@qty_left_in_inv / @total_qty_left_in_inv) * @qty_cons_in_inv_units

		--If we have a conversion factor between two different measurements, then use the conversion factor
		--to get quantity on th destination measurement.
		SELECT @qty_to_consume = (@qty_to_reduce * COALESCE(@factor, 1)) + COALESCE(@offset, 0)

		--If the option is to consume quantities, then reduce the consumption with the supplied quantities.
		IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 0) BEGIN

		   SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
 	 	   SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')
 	 	   IF (@distinct_cons = '0' AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND shift_start_local = @shift_start
			  AND item_id = @inv_item_id
			  AND (lot_no = @inv_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @inv_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @inv_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @inv_sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
			  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
			  AND genealogy_id IS NULL  AND upstream_event_id IS NULL AND segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND segment_response_id IS NULL))

				--Since this is the item that is being consumed, just add the prorated quantity
				--directly to the consumption record.
				--Modified the update statement to update the exact record using row_id if multiple records are present CR L00118740.
				UPDATE item_cons SET qty_cons = qty_cons + @qty_to_consume
				WHERE  row_id = (SELECT MAX(row_id) from item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND shift_start_local = @shift_start
				  AND item_id = @inv_item_id
				  AND (lot_no = @inv_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @inv_lot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (sublot_no = @inv_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @inv_sublot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
				  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
				  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
				  AND genealogy_id IS NULL  AND upstream_event_id IS NULL AND segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND segment_response_id IS NULL)
			ELSE
				--Since the consumed item is not the same item that is in the inventory,
				--Add a new consumption record for this new lot.
				--Added the subsegent_id and comments columns
				INSERT INTO item_cons (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no,
					fg_sublot_no, reas_cd, user_id, item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id,
					qty_cons, qty_cons_erp,  ext_ref, transaction_type, genealogy_id, upstream_event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
					comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by,
					last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local)
				VALUES (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start, @inv_item_id, @inv_lot_no, @fg_lot_no,
					@inv_sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no, @reas_cd, @user_id, @item_scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd,
					@status_cd, @from_ent_id, @qty_to_consume, @qty_cons_erp, @ext_ref, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
					NULL, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
					@last_edit_by, @curr_utc_time, @curr_utc_time, @curr_local_time)

			--Reduce the inventory
			EXEC  sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@inv_item_id, @lot_no=@inv_lot_no, @sublot_no=@inv_sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_to_reduce, @reduce_qty_erp=@qty_cons_erp
					, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
					, @must_consume_from_inv=@must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=@must_consume_from_wip, @checkgrade=@checkGrade, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@inv_oper_id, @seq_no=@inv_seq_no
					, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id
		END
		ELSE IF (@apply_indistlots_option = 1) BEGIN
			--The option is to transfer quantities from one location to another location.
			--If the target unit of measurement is not explicitly specified, then default to the unit of measurement from the source inventory row.
			IF (@indistinguishable_lots_to_ent = 0) BEGIN
				--Do not allow the inventory transfer if the source entity has more than one item in it and the destination entity can distinguish different items.
				IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id) > 1) BEGIN
					SELECT @to_ent_name = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
					SET @err_msg = 'An item cannot be transferred from an entity: %1 where the items are indistinguishable to another entity: %2 where the items are distinguishable.{7893},' + @ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END
			END
			SET @inv_uom_id = COALESCE(@in_to_uom_id, @inv_uom_id)
			--Transfer the quantity from one inventory location to another location.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty  @in_from_row_id=@inv_row_id, @in_from_last_edit_at=NULL, @in_transfer_qty=@qty_to_consume, @in_transfer_qty_erp=NULL
				, @in_to_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@inv_item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@inv_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@sublot_no
				, @in_to_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd=@status_cd, @in_to_uom_id=@inv_uom_id, @in_to_expiry_date=@in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=@in_to_expiry_date_tz, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=NULL
				, @in_to_wo_id=@wo_id, @in_to_oper_id=@oper_id, @in_to_seq_no=@seq_no
				, @in_transfer_option=@transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=0, @in_transfer_comments=@transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer=@log_inv_transfers, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END
	END
	CLOSE item_inv_indist
	DEALLOCATE item_inv_indist

	--Find the inventory row that has the highest quantity in absolute terms
	SELECT TOP 1 @inv_row_id = ii.row_id
	FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
	  AND ABS(ii.qty_left) = (SELECT MAX(ABS(iiv.qty_left)) FROM item_inv iiv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE iiv.ent_id = @from_ent_id)

	--Update the inventory location with quantities from the other items that are lower than the minimum traceable inventory.
	--RG: Handle min_inv_qty can be null or zero
	;WITH remaining_quantities (qty_left) AS
	(SELECT SUM(ii.qty_left) FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
			  AND ii.qty_left < @min_inv_qty
			  AND ii.row_id <> @inv_row_id
	)
	UPDATE item_inv
	SET qty_left = item_inv.qty_left + rq.qty_left
	FROM remaining_quantities rq
	WHERE row_id = @inv_row_id
	 AND rq.qty_left IS NOT NULL

	--Delete inventory rows whose quantities are lower than the minimum inventory
	DELETE from item_inv
		WHERE item_inv.ent_id = @from_ent_id
			AND item_inv.qty_left < @min_inv_qty
END

@endtime NVARCHAR(50),

)

DECLARE @RowAvailable int

select @RowAvailable = row_id from SDB.SCH.res_planned_availability where row_id = @row_id

if @deleteFlag = 0
BEGIN 
						if @RowAvailable is null

								 WHERE row_id = @row_id

	select top 1 ent_id from ent
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			 sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid -
-- Description:	   	To get the assign HU grid for the selected wo
--
-- Usage:			
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			SSB				2022-07-26						Initial version
-- 0.01.01			MC				2025-07-08						Reorganisation of the search for pallet storage location
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- exec sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid '2000087601', null, 'grid', '', '', null
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetAssignHUGrid]
	@wo_id nvarchar(30),
	@assign_status nvarchar(10)=null,
	@type nvarchar(20),
	@batch_no nvarchar(20),
	@item_id nvarchar(50),
	@spare1 nvarchar(50)
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	--using assigntype since sometimes when the HUAssignGrid is null and item_inv has pallets no is set when it is null or else yes is set as default
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @assigntype nvarchar(30)='yes'
	declare @temp table
(
    tot_rows int,
    wo_id nvarchar(50),
    row_id int,
    ent_id int,
    sublot_no nvarchar(50),
	lot_no nvarchar(50),
    item_id nvarchar(50),
    item_desc nvarchar(50),
    itConcat nvarchar(MAX),
    qty_left float,
    uom_id int,
    abbreviation nvarchar(50),
    assign_status int,
    last_edit_at nvarchar(50),
    last_edit_by nvarchar(MAX)
)
declare @ent_id int

if @type='grid'
BEGIN
	if @assign_status is null or @assign_status=0
	BEGIN
		if not exists(select * from ofi_AssignHuWoId where assign_status=0 or assign_status=1)
		BEGIN
					set @assign_status=null
					set @assigntype='no'
		END
	END

	-- 0.01.01
	declare @ent_id_segment int
	SELECT @ent_id_segment= target_sched_ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
	where j.wo_id = @wo_id

	declare @areas_names nvarchar(max)
	SELECT @areas_names = ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with (nolock)
	left join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_GetProductionEnts]
(@line_id                            INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_SA_Line_GetProductionEnts
-- Description		- Returns a list of entities that contribute to production
--                    Userstory: 154856: 1. Get the entities that are contributing to production
--                    (in) Select a line (by ent_id) that is producing
--                    (out/return) list of ent_id (s) that provide production amounts for the line
--                    How do you we determine the return entities:
--                    a) If we have a parallel set, get all ent_id(s) that provide production
--                       (i.e. all that are in the same parallel set as the identified production source entity)
--                    b)      If non parallel, get the individual ent id

-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 03/18/2013
-- Version			- 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By       Ver.    Changes
-- 2014/12/02	KRF             5.1     Return the entity/entities at the last line position if no production entity is identified for the line
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE @prod_ent_id	INT32

    --Retrieve the entity that contributes to the production line
	SELECT @prod_ent_id = l.prod_ent_id
	FROM line l WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE l.line_id = @line_id

	IF @prod_ent_id IS NOT NULL
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
		--For a given line, retrieve all the entities (parallel, if the production entity is configured in parallel with other entities; otherwise, the production entity)
		  AND lel.child_order = (SELECT lelc.child_order
					FROM line_ent_link lelc WITH (NOLOCK)
					--Limit the entities in a line with the production entity ID.
					WHERE lelc.line_id = @line_id AND lelc.ent_id = @prod_ent_id)
	--order the entities by entity name
	ORDER BY e.ent_name
	ELSE
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
		--For a given line, retrieve all the final entities
		  AND lel.child_order = (SELECT MAX(lelc.child_order)
					FROM line_ent_link lelc WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE lelc.line_id = @line_id)
		--order the entities by entity name
		ORDER BY e.ent_name
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_Aut_SourceDest_Details
-- Description:	This sp used to validate the auto selection of source and destination during milling operation based on the attribute value

-- Usage:		Job Management-Milling-Archestra script
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)			Change description
-- 0.01.00	SM				2022-05-22					Initial version.

-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Aut_SourceDest_Details] 
		@wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
		@seq_no AS INT = NULL,
		@ent_id as INT =NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically AS NVARCHAR(40), @IsdestSiloSelectedAutomatically AS NVARCHAR(40),@st_ent_id as int,@lot_no as nvarchar(100),
	@item_group as nvarchar(100),@item_id as nvarchar(100),@cons_item_id as nvarchar(100),@Cons_item_group as nvarchar(100),@def_lot_no  as nvarchar(100)

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	
	-- To get the source silo auto enabled or not using the below attribute 
	SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

		-- To get the destiatnion silo auto enabled or not using the below attribute 
		SELECT @IsdestSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

		-- To get the production and consumtion id  to verify the batch number 
		select @item_id=item_id from job where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no
		select @cons_item_id=item_id from job_bom where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no =@seq_no and bom_pos=1

		print @item_id
		print @cons_item_id
		print @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		 
		if @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1										--To check the source silo is enabled or not
		begin
		print 'source enter'
		if exists(select * from ofi_ent_item_storage_link WITH (NOLOCK)  where ent_id=@ent_id and type='source') 
		begin
		--print 'working'
			select @st_ent_id=storage_ent_id from ofi_ent_item_storage_link WITH (NOLOCK)  where ent_id=@ent_id and type='source'
			if ((select top 1 qty_left from item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) where  ent_id=@st_ent_id)> 0)    --To check the source silo quantity is > 0
			begin
			print 'working'
			--print qty_left
			-- To get the itemgroup of milling operation 
				select @item_group=ia.attr_value from item_attr ia with(nolock)
				inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
				where  ia.item_id=@item_id and a.attr_desc='ItemGroup'
				print @item_group
				-- To get the itemgroup of consumption operation 
				select @Cons_item_group=ia.attr_value from item_attr ia with(nolock)
				inner join attr a on a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
				where  ia.item_id=@cons_item_id and a.attr_desc='ItemGroup'
				print @Cons_item_group
				if (@item_group = @Cons_item_group)
				begin
				--To check the lot no of produced and consumed item
					select @def_lot_no=def_lot_no from job_bom with(nolock) where bom_pos=1 and wo_id=@wo_id  and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
					select @lot_no=lot_no from item_inv with(nolock) where lot_no =@lot_no and ent_id=@st_ent_id
					if (@def_lot_no <> @lot_no)
					begin
						set @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
					end
				end
				else 
				begin
					set @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
				end
			end
			else 
			begin
				set @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
			end
		end
		else if not exists(select * from ofi_ent_item_storage_link WITH (NOLOCK)  where ent_id=@ent_id and type='source') --not exists in storage unit
		 begin
		  set @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
		 end
		end

		print @IsdestSiloSelectedAutomatically
		if @IsdestSiloSelectedAutomatically <> 1
		begin
		 set @IsdestSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
		end

		select @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically as 'Source',@IsdestSiloSelectedAutomatically as 'Dest'

		
END

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_inv_aft_upd_del]
ON [dbo].[item_inv]
AFTER UPDATE, DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_inv_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_inv table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 10/01/2004      KRF               2.01.0001 Added code for automatic ordering (Kanban); name was tg_item_inv_aft_upd
--                                                                 because it used to fire only after updates
-- 05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- 05/25/2005      KRF              2.01.0022 HD #5693 @reqd_ratio was being incorrectly calculated as js.new_reqd/js.orig_start
-- 05/16/2006	KRF,Raghu		3.1.16	HD# 8169, A warning message was generated while rejecting a production
--01/17/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00073985; Inventory Window-Error receiving Items with lots.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

DECLARE @kanban_desc STRING80_NULL,
        @user_id STRING40,
        @item_id STRING40,
        @last_item_id STRING40_NULL,
        @min_inv_level TFLOAT,
        @min_reorder_amount TFLOAT,
        @qty_in_inv TFLOAT,
        @purchased LOGICAL,
        @amt_on_order TFLOAT,
        @total_local_shortages TFLOAT,
        @act_reorder_amt TFLOAT,
        @overall_amt_in_inv TFLOAT,
        @reorder_amt TFLOAT,
        @vendor_id STRING40,
        @po_id STRING40,
        @wo_id STRING40,
        @total_qty_at_start TFLOAT,
        @total_qty_reqd TFLOAT,
        @input_oper_id STRING40,
        @input_seq_no INT32,
        @ops_away_from_final INT32,
        @oper_id STRING40,
        @seq_no INT32,
        @start_ratio TFLOAT,
        @reqd_ratio TFLOAT,
        @qty_at_start TFLOAT,
        @qty_reqd TFLOAT,
        @min_process_status INT32,
        @process_id STRING40,
        @vend_id STRING40_NULL,
        @num_decimals INT32,
        @thetime datetime,
        @uom_id INT32,
        @unit_cost TFLOAT_NULL,
        @line_price TFLOAT_NULL,
        @price TFLOAT_NULL,
        @lead_time INT32_NULL,
        @reqd_by TDATETIME_NULL,
		@lasteditat_out TDATETIME_NULL

-- Beginning of original code of tg_item_inv_aft_upd
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

SET NOCOUNT ON
EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

UPDATE item_inv SET qty_left = ROUND(i.qty_left, it.num_decimals), qty_left_erp =  ROUND(i.qty_left_erp, it.num_decimals),
	item_inv.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_inv.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
FROM inserted i
INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
WHERE item_inv.row_id = i.row_id
-- End of original code of tg_item_inv_aft_upd

CREATE TABLE #items_to_check (item_id nvarchar(40) NOT NULL,
                              uom_id int NOT NULL,
                              purchased bit NOT NULL,
                              overall_min_inv_level float NULL,
                              overall_reorder_amt float NULL,
                              unit_cost float NULL,
                              amt_on_order float NOT NULL,
                              total_local_shortages float NOT NULL,
                              overall_amt_in_inv float NOT NULL,
                              act_reorder_amt float NOT NULL)

-- If item is to be auto-reordered, and inventory has decreased,
-- check for shortage.  Use of LEFT OUTER JOIN on inserted table
-- allows same code to be used for AFTER DELETE & AFTER UPDATE triggers.
/*INSERT INTO #items_to_check
	SELECT it.item_id, it.uom_id, it.purchased, it.min_inv_level,
	       it.reorder_amt, it.unit_cost, 0, 0, 0, 0
		FROM deleted d
		LEFT OUTER JOIN inserted i ON i.row_id = d.row_id
		INNER JOIN item it ON d.item_id = it.item_id
		WHERE it.auto_reorder = 1 AND
		      (ISNULL(i.qty_left,0) - d.qty_left) < 0
		GROUP BY it.item_id, it.uom_id, it.purchased, it.min_inv_level,
		         it.reorder_amt, it.unit_cost*/
INSERT INTO #items_to_check
SELECT it.item_id, it.uom_id, it.purchased, it.min_inv_level, it.reorder_amt, it.unit_cost, 0, 0, 0, 0
FROM item it WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN (SELECT it.item_id FROM deleted d
                        LEFT OUTER JOIN inserted i ON i.row_id = d.row_id
                        INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK)  ON d.item_id = it.item_id
                        WHERE it.auto_reorder = 1 AND (ISNULL(i.qty_left,0) - d.qty_left) < 0
                        GROUP BY it.item_id) ii ON ii.item_id = it.item_id

-- If there are no auto-reordered items whose inventory has decreased,
-- there will be no new Kanban orders, so return
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	BEGIN
	DROP TABLE #items_to_check
	RETURN
	END

-- Otherwise there are items to check so there may be orders generated,
-- so fetch order description, minimum instantiable process status,
-- background user ID, and current local time
SET @kanban_desc = (SELECT attr_value FROM system_attr  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 301)
SET @min_process_status = (CAST((SELECT attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = 201) AS int))
SELECT @user_id = mw_db_user FROM db_status WITH (NOLOCK)
SET @thetime = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

-- If item is purchased, see how much yet to receive on outstanding
-- (state_cd = 0 or 1) orders.  Note that may need to convert units-of-
-- measure both for order and receipts so far.  polc = po_line (UOM)
-- conversion and rlc = receipt_lot (UOM) conversion.
UPDATE #items_to_check SET amt_on_order = (
	SELECT ISNULL(SUM((pol.quantity * ISNULL(polc.factor, 1)) +
	       ISNULL(polc.offset, 0) -
	       ISNULL(receipts_on_outstanding_orders.qty_rcvd_so_far, 0)), 0)
		FROM po_line pol WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN po po WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON pol.po_id = po.po_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			SELECT r.po_id,
			       r.po_line_no,
			       ISNULL(SUM((rl.quantity * ISNULL(rlc.factor, 1)) +
			       ISNULL(rlc.offset, 0)), 0) qty_rcvd_so_far
				FROM receipt r WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN receipt_lot rl WITH (NOLOCK)
					ON r.po_id = rl.po_id AND
					   r.date_rcvd_utc = rl.date_rcvd_utc AND
					   r.item_id = rl.item_id
				INNER JOIN po po WITH (NOLOCK)
					ON po.po_id = r.po_id
				LEFT OUTER JOIN uom_conv rlc WITH (NOLOCK)
					ON rl.uom_id = rlc.from_uom_id AND
					               #items_to_check.uom_id = rlc.to_uom_id
				WHERE po.state_cd < 2 AND
				      rl.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id AND
					  #items_to_check.purchased = 1
				GROUP BY r.po_id, r.po_line_no
			) receipts_on_outstanding_orders
			ON pol.po_id = receipts_on_outstanding_orders.po_id AND
			   pol.po_line_no = receipts_on_outstanding_orders.po_line_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN uom_conv polc WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON pol.uom_id = polc.from_uom_id AND
			   #items_to_check.uom_id = polc.to_uom_id
		WHERE pol.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id AND
		      po.state_cd < 2)
	WHERE purchased = 1

-- If item is built, see how much yet to produce on WOs where this is final
-- product
UPDATE #items_to_check SET amt_on_order = (
	SELECT ISNULL(SUM(j.qty_at_start - (j.qty_prod + j.qty_rejected)),0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON j.wo_id = w.wo_id
		WHERE w.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id AND
		      w.state_cd < 2 AND
		      j.final_job = 1)
	WHERE purchased = 0

-- Calculate total local shortages
/*UPDATE #items_to_check SET total_local_shortages = (
	SELECT ISNULL(SUM(isel.min_inv_level - inv_by_ent.qty_in_inv),0)
		FROM item_storage_exec_link isel
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			SELECT ent_id,
			       ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left),0) qty_in_inv
				FROM item_inv ii
				WHERE ii.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id
				GROUP BY ii.ent_id
			) inv_by_ent
			ON isel.ent_id = inv_by_ent.ent_id
		WHERE isel.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id)*/
UPDATE #items_to_check SET total_local_shortages = (
	SELECT ISNULL(SUM(isel.min_inv_level - ISNULL(inv_by_ent.qty_in_inv, 0)),0)
		FROM item_storage_exec_link isel WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			SELECT ent_id,
			       ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left),0) qty_in_inv
				FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ii.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id
				GROUP BY ii.ent_id
			) inv_by_ent
			ON isel.ent_id = inv_by_ent.ent_id
		WHERE isel.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id)

-- An order must be placed if there is a local shortage for the inventory
-- location just updated and there's not enough on order to cover all
-- local shortages.  The reorder amount is the larger of the reorder
-- amount of the inventory location that was just updated, or the
-- difference between the amount on order and the sum of all location-
-- specific shortages.  Note that while there may not exist an
-- item_storage_exec_link record for the item and entity whose inventory
-- was just decreased, we still do an inner join on it, because without
-- such a record, there can be no local shortage.  Similarly, by doing an
-- inner join on #items_to_check, we get rid of records that don't matter.
SET @act_reorder_amt = 0
DECLARE deleted_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT d.item_id, min_inv_level, min_reorder_amt,
           qty_in_inv, amt_on_order, total_local_shortages
		FROM deleted d
		INNER JOIN item_storage_exec_link isel WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON d.ent_id = isel.ent_id AND
			   d.item_id = isel.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			SELECT ent_id, item_id, ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left),0) qty_in_inv
				FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				GROUP BY ii.ent_id, item_id) inv_by_ent_item
			ON d.ent_id = inv_by_ent_item.ent_id AND
			   d.item_id = inv_by_ent_item.item_id
		INNER JOIN #items_to_check itc
			ON d.item_id = itc.item_id
		WHERE min_inv_level > 0
		ORDER BY d.item_id
OPEN deleted_cursor
SET @act_reorder_amt = 0
FETCH NEXT FROM deleted_cursor
	INTO @item_id, @min_inv_level, @min_reorder_amount, @qty_in_inv,
	     @amt_on_order, @total_local_shortages
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
	IF @last_item_id <> @item_id AND
	   @last_item_id IS NOT NULL AND
	   @act_reorder_amt <> 0
		BEGIN
		UPDATE #items_to_check SET act_reorder_amt = @act_reorder_amt
			WHERE item_id = @last_item_id
		SET @act_reorder_amt = 0
		END
	IF @qty_in_inv < @min_inv_level AND
	   @amt_on_order + @act_reorder_amt < @total_local_shortages
		BEGIN
		IF @total_local_shortages - (@amt_on_order + @act_reorder_amt) >
		   @min_reorder_amount
			SET @act_reorder_amt = @total_local_shortages - @amt_on_order
		ELSE SET @act_reorder_amt = @act_reorder_amt + @min_reorder_amount
		END
	SET @last_item_id = @item_id
	FETCH NEXT FROM deleted_cursor
		INTO @item_id, @min_inv_level, @min_reorder_amount, @qty_in_inv,
		     @amt_on_order, @total_local_shortages
	END
CLOSE deleted_cursor
DEALLOCATE deleted_cursor
IF @act_reorder_amt <> 0
	BEGIN
	UPDATE #items_to_check SET act_reorder_amt = @act_reorder_amt
		WHERE item_id = @last_item_id
	END

-- See how much is in inventory overall
UPDATE #items_to_check SET overall_amt_in_inv = (
	SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ii.qty_left), 0) FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ii.item_id = #items_to_check.item_id)

CREATE TABLE #jobs (oper_id nvarchar(40) NOT NULL,
                    seq_no int NOT NULL,
                    def_reject_rate float NULL,
                    num_decimals int NOT NULL,
                    ops_away_from_final int NOT NULL,
                    orig_start float NOT NULL,
                    orig_reqd float NOT NULL,
                    new_start float NOT NULL,
                    new_reqd float NOT NULL)

-- If there's an still an overall shortage after allowing for reorder
-- amount generated from local shortages, even more must be ordered.
-- The total amount being ordered will be the larger of what's already
-- being ordered plus the remaining shortage or the minumum
-- reorder amount for this item
DECLARE itc_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT item_id, uom_id, purchased, overall_min_inv_level,
	       overall_reorder_amt, unit_cost, amt_on_order,
	       overall_amt_in_inv, act_reorder_amt
		FROM #items_to_check
OPEN itc_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM itc_cursor
	INTO @item_id, @uom_id, @purchased, @min_inv_level, @reorder_amt,
	     @unit_cost, @amt_on_order, @overall_amt_in_inv, @act_reorder_amt
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
	-- If there's still a remaining shortage
	IF @min_inv_level -
	   (@overall_amt_in_inv + @amt_on_order + @act_reorder_amt) > 0
		BEGIN
		IF @min_inv_level - (@overall_amt_in_inv + @amt_on_order) >
		   @reorder_amt
			SET @act_reorder_amt = @min_inv_level -
				(@overall_amt_in_inv + @amt_on_order)
		ELSE
			SET @act_reorder_amt = @reorder_amt
		END

	-- Now actually place order, now that final amounts are known,
	-- if there's something to be ordered
	IF @act_reorder_amt > 0
		BEGIN
		-- If purchased, issue new PO
		IF @purchased = 1
			BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @vend_id = vend_id,
			             @price = price,
			             @lead_time = lead_time
				FROM vendor_item_link WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE item_id = @item_id ORDER BY pref
			EXEC sp_SA_Po_GetNextPoId @po_id OUTPUT
			EXEC sp_I_Po @po_id, @vend_id, NULL, NULL,
			             @thetime, 0, NULL,
			             NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
						 @lasteditat_out OUTPUT
			IF @lead_time = NULL SET @reqd_by = NULL
			ELSE SET @reqd_by = DATEADD(day, @lead_time, @thetime)
			IF @price IS NULL
				BEGIN
				IF @unit_cost IS NULL SET @line_price = NULL
				ELSE SET @line_price = @unit_cost * @act_reorder_amt
				END
			ELSE SET @line_price = @price * @act_reorder_amt
 			EXEC sp_I_Po_Line @po_id, 1, @item_id, NULL, @act_reorder_amt,
			                  @uom_id, @act_reorder_amt, @act_reorder_amt,
			                  @line_price, @reqd_by, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			                  NULL, NULL, NULL,
							 @lasteditat_out OUTPUT
			END
		-- If manufactured, see if there's an unstarted Kanban order that
		-- could be increased
		ELSE -- Manufactured
			BEGIN
			IF @kanban_desc IS NULL
				SET @wo_id = (
					SELECT TOP 1 wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE state_cd = 0 AND wo_desc IS NULL AND item_id = @item_id)
			ELSE
				SET @wo_id = (
					SELECT TOP 1 wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE state_cd = 0 AND wo_desc = @kanban_desc AND item_id = @item_id)
			IF @wo_id IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
				-- Update wo.req_qty
				UPDATE wo SET req_qty = req_qty + @act_reorder_amt
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				-- Work backwards from last job(s) in case rounding up has
				-- to occur when num_decimals = 0
				DELETE FROM #jobs
				INSERT INTO #jobs
					SELECT j.oper_id, j.seq_no, def_reject_rate,
					       num_decimals, 0, j.qty_at_start, j.qty_reqd,
					       0, 0
						FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN item i  WITH (NOLOCK) on j.item_id = i.item_id
						INNER JOIN wo w  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = w.wo_id
						LEFT OUTER JOIN oper o WITH (NOLOCK)
							ON w.process_id = o.process_id AND
						    j.oper_id = o.oper_id
						WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 1
				-- Following is OK because only final jobs there now
				SELECT @total_qty_at_start = SUM(orig_start),
				       @total_qty_reqd = SUM(orig_reqd) from #jobs
				UPDATE #jobs SET new_start = orig_start +
					(@act_reorder_amt * (1+ISNULL(def_reject_rate,0)) *
					orig_start/@total_qty_at_start),
					new_reqd = orig_reqd + (@act_reorder_amt *
					orig_reqd/@total_qty_reqd)
				UPDATE #jobs SET new_start = CEILING(new_start),
				                 new_reqd = CEILING(new_reqd)
					WHERE num_decimals = 0
				DECLARE jobs_cursor CURSOR LOCAL DYNAMIC FOR
					SELECT input_oper_id, input_seq_no,
					       ops_away_from_final, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no,
					       js.new_start/js.orig_start,
					       js.new_reqd/js.orig_reqd, j.qty_at_start,
					       j.qty_reqd, i.num_decimals
						FROM #jobs js
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
							ON js.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND
							   js.seq_no = jr.seq_no
						INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK)
							ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND
							   jr.input_oper_id = j.oper_id AND
							   jr.input_seq_no = j.seq_no
						INNER JOIN item i  WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
						WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
				OPEN jobs_cursor
				FETCH NEXT FROM jobs_cursor INTO @input_oper_id,
					@input_seq_no, @ops_away_from_final, @oper_id, @seq_no,
					@start_ratio, @reqd_ratio, @qty_at_start, @qty_reqd,
					@num_decimals
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #jobs (oper_id,
					                   seq_no,
					                   num_decimals,
					                   ops_away_from_final,
					                   orig_start,
					                   orig_reqd,
					                   new_start,
					                   new_reqd) VALUES (
					                   @input_oper_id,
					                   @input_seq_no,
					                   @num_decimals,
					                   @ops_away_from_final + 1,
 					                   @qty_at_start,
					                   @qty_reqd,
					                   @qty_at_start * @start_ratio,
					                   @qty_reqd * @reqd_ratio)
					UPDATE #jobs SET new_start = CEILING(new_start),
					                 new_reqd = CEILING(new_reqd)
						WHERE num_decimals = 0 AND
						      oper_id = @input_oper_id AND
						      seq_no = @input_seq_no
					FETCH NEXT FROM jobs_cursor INTO @input_oper_id,
						@input_seq_no, @ops_away_from_final, @oper_id, @seq_no,
						@start_ratio, @reqd_ratio, @qty_at_start, @qty_reqd,
						@num_decimals
					END
				CLOSE jobs_cursor
				DEALLOCATE jobs_cursor
				-- Now update job quantities from #jobs
				UPDATE job SET qty_at_start = (
					SELECT MAX(new_start) FROM #jobs js
						WHERE js.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
						      js.seq_no = job.seq_no
						GROUP BY js.oper_id, js.seq_no),
				               qty_reqd = (
					SELECT MAX(new_reqd) FROM #jobs js
						WHERE js.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
						      js.seq_no = job.seq_no
						GROUP BY js.oper_id, js.seq_no)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				END -- of "If there's a work order to update"
			-- If not, start a new one
			ELSE
				BEGIN
				EXEC sp_SA_Wo_GetNextWoId @wo_id OUTPUT
				SET @process_id = (
					SELECT TOP 1 p.process_id
						FROM process p WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK)
							ON p.process_id = ipl.process_id
						WHERE ipl.item_id = @item_id AND
						      process_status >= @min_process_status AND
						      status >= @min_process_status
						ORDER BY item_pref)

				EXEC sp_I_job_exec_CWOFP_stack @wo_id,
				                               @process_id,
				                               @item_id,
				                               @act_reorder_amt,
				                               @user_id,
				                               @act_reorder_amt,
				                               1,
				                               @kanban_desc,
				                               @thetime,
				                               NULL,
				                               @thetime,
				                               NULL,
				                               50,
				                               NULL,
				                               NULL,
				                               NULL,
				                               NULL,
				                               0, --(Added from HF-1432-Branch)
											   NULL,
											   0,
											   NULL --CR L00092686	(End of change)


				END
			END -- of "else manufactured"
		END -- of "If there's something to order"
	FETCH NEXT FROM itc_cursor
		INTO @item_id, @uom_id, @purchased, @min_inv_level, @reorder_amt,
		     @unit_cost, @amt_on_order, @overall_amt_in_inv,
		     @act_reorder_amt
	END	-- of loop retrieving item_to_check records
CLOSE itc_cursor
DEALLOCATE itc_cursor
DROP TABLE #jobs
DROP TABLE #items_to_check
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Job_Attr]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @attr_id int ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version        - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_System_Attr]
(@attr_id  int  = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(80) = NULL  ,
 @grp_id  int = NULL ,
 @edit_type  int = NULL,
 @reqd_lic NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) = NULL,
 @last_edit_at datetime = NULL)
  AS


SELECT system_attr.attr_id
            ,system_attr.attr_desc
            ,system_attr.attr_value
            ,system_attr.grp_id
            ,system_attr.attr_seq
            ,system_attr.edit_type
            ,system_attr.attr_constraints
            ,system_attr.reqd_lic
            ,system_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,system_attr.last_edit_by
            ,system_attr.last_edit_at
  FROM system_attr system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)

       (system_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
