       (system_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY system_attr.attr_seq

CREATE  Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_Job_Step_TotlPrevStepGrps]
(@wo_id		STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@seq_no		INT32,
@step_grp_id	INT32,
@step_count	INT32 OUTPUT,
@lot_no		STRING40 =null --rohit
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @step_grp_seq	INT32
/*Have preceding steps within ALL preceding groups been Completed:
Check that ALL steps in ALL step_grp_id's with lower step_grp_seq than this group have a row in job_step_data
with state_cd = COMPLETE or BYPASSED. */
--Get the current Step_grp_seq for the step_grp based on the parameters passed
select @step_grp_seq = job_step_grp.step_grp_seq
	from job_step_grp job_step_grp
	where job_step_grp.wo_id = @wo_id
	  and job_step_grp.oper_id = @oper_id
	  and job_step_grp.seq_no = @seq_no
	  and job_step_grp.step_grp_id = @step_grp_id
--Get all the step_grp_ids which is less than the above @step_grp_seq.
--Then get the count for all the steps in these groups which are <> completed and bypassed
select @step_count = count(*)
	from job_step job_step LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step_data job_step_data
	ON job_step.wo_id = job_step_data.wo_id
		and job_step.oper_id = job_step_data.oper_id
		and job_step.seq_no = job_step_data.seq_no
		and job_step.step_no = job_step_data.step_no
	WHERE 	job_step.wo_id = @wo_id
		and job_step.oper_id = @oper_id
		and job_step.seq_no = @seq_no
		and job_step_data.lot_no = @lot_no --rohit
		and ((job_step_data.state_cd IS NULL) or (job_step_data.state_cd <> 4 and job_step_data.state_cd <> 8))
		and (job_step.step_grp_id in
			(select job_step_grp.step_grp_id from job_step_grp job_step_grp
				where job_step_grp.wo_id = @wo_id
				  and job_step_grp.oper_id = @oper_id
				  and job_step_grp.seq_no = @seq_no
				  and job_step_grp.step_grp_seq < @step_grp_seq))
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_maxBlendRatio]
(@storage_ent_id INT
,@silo_type STRING80 -- Source or Destination
,@inv_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- inventory item id
--,@inv_grade_cd int		-- inv grade cd
--,@jb_item_id NVARCHAR(80) -- job bom item id
--,@jb_grade_cd int			-- jb grade cd
,@wo_id  nvarchar(40) 
,@oper_id nvarchar(80) 
,@seq_no	int
) 

--RETURNS INT32 AS   --return 1 and 0 as validity, 1-is valid for enable and 0 for disable

RETURNS @Output TABLE (
		  maxBlendRatio float
		  ,blendRatio_info NVARCHAR(MAX)
		)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - [fn_maxBlendRatio]
-- Description       - Returns the silo's belnd ratio
-- Author			 - DS
-- Date Created      - 09/04/2023
-- Version			 - 1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_ModIFied  ModIFied_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 09/04/2023     DS 			 1.0		Initial version
-- 09/07/2023     DS 			 2.0		Modified for fixing the decimal point, #307

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN		 
				declare		 @min_maxBlendRatio float
							,@blendRatio_info nvarchar(MAX) = ''
				declare		 @su_maxBlend as table( row_id int identity(1,1), item_id STRING40,lot_no STRING40, max_blend_ratio  STRING1700_NULL)

			insert into @su_maxBlend
			select la.item_id,la.lot_no,la.attr_value from [dbo].[item_inv] itv with(nolock) inner join lot with(nolock) on itv.item_id = lot.item_id and itv.lot_no = lot.lot_no
			inner join [dbo].[lot_attr] la with(nolock) on itv.item_id = la.item_id and itv.lot_no = la.lot_no 
			inner join dbo.attr with(nolock)  on la.attr_id = la.attr_id
			where itv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
			and attr.attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio';

			select @min_maxBlendRatio = min(cast(replace(max_blend_ratio, ',', '') as decimal(18,3))) from @su_maxBlend
			
			--select @min_maxBlendRatio = min(replace(max_blend_ratio, ',', '')) from @su_maxBlend

			if(@min_maxBlendRatio is not null)
			begin
				--set @blendRatio_info = LTRIM(STR(@min_maxBlendRatio, 25, 1)) +' Max blend ratio'
				set @blendRatio_info = CONCAT(@min_maxBlendRatio, '% - Max blend ratio')
			end



		insert into @Output
		select @min_maxBlendRatio,@blendRatio_info

	RETURN ;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Cust_GetAllByFilter]
(
	@user_id	STRING40_NULL = NULL
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Cust_GetAllByFilter
-- Description					- Returns a recordset of customers and sales orders filtered by the user's
--								  current filter settings.
--								  New BR reqd doc (Customer Window Business Rules.doc) from Rich B
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					-	08/20/2003
-- Version						- 2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/27/2003		Raghu			2.0.0.6		Defaulted filter values to 0; (if not found from ui_config)
--				  			   					Also, modified to execute with partial filter options, eg., Open, Complete
-- 06/23/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Changed po_line to so_line; also the joins are corrected
-- 01/10/2005		Raghu			2.1.2		HD# 5283, Customer window does not show up
-- 07/05/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@config_value		STRING2000_NULL
		,	@open_filter		STRING20_NULL
		,	@partial_filter		STRING20_NULL
		,	@complete_filter 	STRING20_NULL
		,	@start				INT32_NULL
		,	@end				INT32_NULL
		,	@sSQL 				STRING2000_NULL
		,	@temp_sSQL 			STRING2000_NULL



	SELECT @config_value = valu
	FROM ui_config WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE	UPPER(config_id) = UPPER(@user_id) AND
			UPPER(screen) = 'CUSTOMER' AND
			UPPER(sectn) = 'CUSTOMERTREEVIEW' AND
			UPPER(parameter) = 'FILTERS'


	SELECT @open_filter = '0', @partial_filter = '0', @complete_filter = '0'

	IF ( @config_value IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Open=', ':', @open_filter OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Partial=', ':', @partial_filter OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Complete=', ':', @complete_filter OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT	@sSQL = 'SELECT c.cust_id, c.cust_name, so.po_id FROM cust c WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					'LEFT OUTER JOIN so so WITH (NOLOCK) ON c.cust_id = so.cust_id ' +
					'WHERE c.customer = 1 '
--			@temp_sSQL = ''

	IF ( ( @open_filter = '1' ) OR ( @partial_filter = '1' ) OR ( @complete_filter = '1' ) ) BEGIN
		SELECT @sSQL = @sSQL + 'AND ( '

		IF ( @open_filter = '1' ) BEGIN
			SELECT @temp_sSQL = ' so.po_id IN (SELECT po_id FROM so_line sl WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					' WHERE sl.cust_id = c.cust_id AND sl.po_id = so.po_id AND ' +
					' NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_lot slot WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					' WHERE slot.cust_id = sl.cust_id and slot.po_id = sl.po_id and slot.so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)) '
		END

		IF ( @partial_filter = '1' ) BEGIN
			IF ( @temp_sSQL IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
				SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' OR '
			END
			ELSE SELECT @temp_sSQL = ''
			SELECT @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' so.po_id in (SELECT po_id FROM so_line sl WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					' WHERE sl.cust_id = c.cust_id AND sl.po_id = so.po_id AND quantity > ' +
					' (SELECT SUM(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot slot WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					' WHERE slot.cust_id = sl.cust_id and slot.po_id = sl.po_id and slot.so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)) '
		END

		IF ( @complete_filter = '1' ) BEGIN
			IF ( @temp_sSQL IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
				SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' OR '
			END
			ELSE SELECT @temp_sSQL = ''
			SELECT @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' so.po_id in (SELECT po_id FROM so_line sl WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					' WHERE sl.cust_id = c.cust_id AND sl.po_id = so.po_id AND quantity <= ' +
					' (SELECT SUM(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot slot WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
					' WHERE slot.cust_id = sl.cust_id and slot.po_id = sl.po_id and slot.so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)) '
		END

		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_sSQL + ') '
	END

	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY c.cust_name, so.so_id'

	EXEC( @sSQL )
	--SELECT @sSQL

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueuByName]
(@wo_id						STRING40
,@oper_id					STRING40
,@seq_no					INT32
,@state_cd					INT32 = NULL
,@job_priority				INT32 = NULL
,@req_finish_time_local		TDATETIME = NULL
,@target_sched_ent_name		STRING80 = NULL
,@target_sched_site_name	STRING80 = NULL
,@concurrent_link			INT32 = NULL
,@status_notes				STRING1700 = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = NULL
,@run_ent_name				STRING80 OUTPUT
,@run_ent_site_name			STRING80 OUTPUT
,@edit_time					TDATETIME OUTPUT
,@refresh_all				INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueuByName
-- Description			- HD# 5932, Batch Processing
-- Author					- Raghu
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 11/12/2009	  Ajay			4.0.0		HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @target_sched_ent_id	INT32
			,@run_ent_id			INT32
			,@dbg_resp				INT


	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueuByName', @src_key='sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueuByName',
					@date_val1 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val1 = @time_zone_bias_value,
					@date_val2 = @req_finish_time_local, @numeric_val2 = @time_zone_bias_value

	SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@target_sched_ent_name, @target_sched_site_name)

	EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_SetJobQueue @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @state_cd, @job_priority, @req_finish_time_local,
				@target_sched_ent_id,  @concurrent_link, @status_notes, @time_zone_bias_value,
				@run_ent_id OUTPUT, @edit_time OUTPUT, @refresh_all OUTPUT

	SELECT @run_ent_name = e.ent_name, @run_ent_site_name = ste.site_name
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	--ID of ancestor entity that defines site of this entity; if = ent_id, this entity is a site.
	--Null for entities above sites, or for single-site systems
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent site_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.site = site_ent.ent_id
	--Name of this site
	LEFT OUTER JOIN site ste WITH (NOLOCK) ON ste.ent_id = site_ent.ent_id
	WHERE e.ent_id = @run_ent_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CLONE_job_BOM]
	@wo_id string40,
	@oper_id string40,
	@seq_no int,
	@new_wo_id string40,
	@new_oper_id string40,
	@new_seq_no int
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_CLONE_job_BOM
-- Author	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 09/09/2002     Raghu		1.4     Removed Cont_id
-- 12/29/2006     KRF           3.2.1   Added def_sublot_no, def_reject_ent_id, must_consume_from_inv,
--                                      may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
--                                      must_consume_before_prod, est_time, serial_no_source
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @JB_wo_id STRING40
DECLARE @JB_oper_id STRING40
DECLARE @JB_seq_no int
DECLARE @JB_BOM_pos int
DECLARE @JB_item_id STRING40
DECLARE @JB_reqd_grade_cd int
DECLARE @JB_instruction VARCHAR(2000)
DECLARE @JB_qty_per_parent_item float
DECLARE @JB_reqd_start_val float
DECLARE @JB_reqd_start_val_is_pct logical
DECLARE @JB_update_inv logical
DECLARE @JB_backflush logical
DECLARE @JB_def_reas_cd int
DECLARE @JB_def_lot_no STRING40
DECLARE @JB_def_sublot_no STRING40  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_def_storage_ent_id int
DECLARE @JB_def_reject_ent_id int  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_scaling_factor float
DECLARE @JB_must_consume_from_inv logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_may_choose_alt_inv_loc logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_may_create_new_lots logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_must_consume_from_wip logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_must_consume_before_prod logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_constant_qty logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_est_time tfloat  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_serial_no_source logical  -- Added 12/29/06 KRF
DECLARE @JB_spare1 STRING80
DECLARE @JB_spare2 STRING80
DECLARE @JB_spare3 STRING80
DECLARE @JB_spare4 STRING80
DECLARE @JB_mod_id timestamp
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 1, 'sp_CLONE_job_BOM', 'sp_CLONE_job_BOM',
		'Before opening Job_bom_cursor', 'DECLARE Job_bom_cursor CURSOR LOCAL', ''
--6.	Clone JOB_BOM table row(s)* and then Clone JOB_BOM_STEP table row(s)*.
	DECLARE Job_bom_cursor CURSOR LOCAL
	FOR SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, BOM_pos,
		item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item,
		reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush,
		def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
		scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
		may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod,
		constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4 FROM Job_BOM
	    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
	OPEN  Job_bom_cursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM Job_bom_cursor
	INTO @JB_wo_id, @JB_oper_id, @JB_seq_no, @JB_BOM_pos,
		@JB_item_id, @JB_reqd_grade_cd, @JB_instruction, @JB_qty_per_parent_item,
		@JB_reqd_start_val, @JB_reqd_start_val_is_pct, @JB_update_inv, @JB_backflush,
		@JB_def_reas_cd, @JB_def_lot_no, @JB_def_sublot_no, @JB_def_storage_ent_id,
		@JB_def_reject_ent_id, @JB_scaling_factor, @JB_must_consume_from_inv,
		@JB_may_choose_alt_inv_loc, @JB_may_create_new_lots, @JB_must_consume_from_wip,
		@JB_must_consume_before_prod, @JB_constant_qty, @JB_est_time,
		@JB_serial_no_source, @JB_spare1, @JB_spare2, @JB_spare3, @JB_spare4
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
		INSERT INTO job_BOM
			(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, BOM_pos,
			item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item,
			reqd_start_val, reqd_start_val_is_pct, update_inv, backflush,
			def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
			scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
			may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod,
			constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4)
		VALUES
			(@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @JB_BOM_pos,
			@JB_item_id, @JB_reqd_grade_cd, @JB_instruction, @JB_qty_per_parent_item,
			@JB_reqd_start_val, @JB_reqd_start_val_is_pct, @JB_update_inv, @JB_backflush,
			@JB_def_reas_cd, @JB_def_lot_no, @JB_def_sublot_no, @JB_def_storage_ent_id,
			@JB_def_reject_ent_id, @JB_scaling_factor, @JB_must_consume_from_inv,
			@JB_may_choose_alt_inv_loc, @JB_may_create_new_lots, @JB_must_consume_from_wip,
			@JB_must_consume_before_prod, @JB_constant_qty, @JB_est_time,
			@JB_serial_no_source, @JB_spare1, @JB_spare2, @JB_spare3, @JB_spare4)
-- 		CLONE JOB_BOM_STEP ROWS
		EXECUTE sp_CLONE_job_BOM_step @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @JB_BOM_pos, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @JB_BOM_pos
		FETCH NEXT FROM Job_bom_cursor
			INTO @JB_wo_id, @JB_oper_id, @JB_seq_no, @JB_BOM_pos,
			@JB_item_id, @JB_reqd_grade_cd, @JB_instruction, @JB_qty_per_parent_item,
			@JB_reqd_start_val, @JB_reqd_start_val_is_pct, @JB_update_inv, @JB_backflush,
			@JB_def_reas_cd, @JB_def_lot_no, @JB_def_sublot_no, @JB_def_storage_ent_id,
			@JB_def_reject_ent_id, @JB_scaling_factor, @JB_must_consume_from_inv,
			@JB_may_choose_alt_inv_loc, @JB_may_create_new_lots, @JB_must_consume_from_wip,
			@JB_must_consume_before_prod, @JB_constant_qty, @JB_est_time,
			@JB_serial_no_source, @JB_spare1, @JB_spare2, @JB_spare3, @JB_spare4

	END
	CLOSE Job_bom_cursor
	DEALLOCATE Job_bom_cursor
END

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Description      - Select a single existing row identified by the primary key
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT cert_std_oper_link.cert_name

-- Name:		sp_i_ofi_st_audittrail
-- Description:	The stored procedure will add the audit trail for the stock transfer start/stop/qty changes 
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer Audit trail
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	LK				2024-01-24  		Initial version.

-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ofi_st_audittrail]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@src_su_ent_id INT
	,@dest_su_ent_id int
	,@lineid int
	,@status int
	,@qty_target float
	,@qty_transfered float
	,@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--VARIABLE DECLARATION
	
	DECLARE @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'StockTransfer'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@strCommentMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@delete_detail NVARCHAR(50) = NULL	
		,@keyField1 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField2 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField3 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField4 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField5 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField6 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL	
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
		,@log_id INT
		,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
		,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
		,@change_type INT = 1
		,@table_name NVARCHAR(80) = '[ofi_st_trans_selection]'
		,@row_id INT
		,@audit_category NVARCHAR(80) = 'Info'
		,@linestatus NVARCHAR(20)
	   DECLARE @newval NVARCHAR(max)
		,@newlineEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStoragesrcEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStoragedestEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
		DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName

		
		
		--select *from ent
		SELECT @row_id = max(row_id) + 1
			FROM ofi_st_trans_selection
		select @newlineEntId=description from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@lineid
		select @newStoragesrcEntId=description from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@src_su_ent_id
		select @newStoragedestEntId=description from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@dest_su_ent_id
		set @column_name='[qty_transferred]'

		
		if @status=3
			Begin
			set @linestatus='RUNNING'
			SET @newval = 'Line: ' + @newlineEntId + ' Source Storage: ' + @newStoragesrcEntId + ' Destination Storage: ' + @newStoragedestEntId + ' Status: ' + @linestatus
			+' Target Qty: '+@qty_target+' Transfer Qty: '+@qty_transfered
			end
		else
			begin
			set @linestatus='IDLE'
			SET @newval = 'Line: ' + @newlineEntId + ' Source Storage: ' + @newStoragesrcEntId + ' Destination Storage: ' + @newStoragedestEntId + ' Status: ' + @linestatus
			
			end

		
		EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		,@change_type
		,@table_name
		,@row_id
		,@column_name
		,NULL
		,@newval
		,@audit_comments
		,@delete_detail;

	UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
	SET origin = @strFunctionName
	WHERE log_id = @log_id;

	SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Updated into [dbo].[ofi_st_trans_selection]  ,Values: ' + @newval + ''

	SET @strActivityMsg = 'Updated'

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
		log_id
		,keyField1
		,keyField2
		,keyField3
		,keyField4
		,module_id
		,function_id
		,spare1
		,spare2
		,spare3
		,spare4
		,spare5
		,spare6
		,audit_category
		,activity
		,comments
		,created_at_utc
		,created_at_local
		,created_by
		)
	VALUES (
		@log_id
		,@newlineEntId
		,@newStoragesrcEntId
		,@newStoragedestEntId
		,@linestatus
		,@strModuleName
		,@strFunctionName
		,@keyField1
		,@keyField2
		,@keyField3
		,@keyField4
		,@keyField5
		,@keyField6
		,@audit_category
		,@strActivityMsg
		,@strCommentMsg
		,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		);

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags]
(@process_id	NVARCHAR(40)
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Oper_SetOperFlags
-- Description	      - (HD #2034) Sets the First Oper and Final Oper in Oper table
--			Base code copied from sp_S_Job_Exec_VerifyProcess
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 12/20/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1600    Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 04/03/2007     SJ            31027   Performance improvements
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
@count			INT,
@first_oper_id		NVARCHAR(40),
@final_oper_id		NVARCHAR(40),
@V_Check		INT
BEGIN
  UPDATE oper SET final_oper = 0, first_oper = 0
    WHERE process_id = @process_id AND (first_oper = 1 OR final_oper = 1)
  --First check the number of Operations for the given process
  SELECT @count = COUNT(*) FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id
  IF @count = 1
  --since there is only one operation defined for the given process, so oper_ent_route table will not have any corresponding rows
  BEGIN
    --set the both flags(first_oper,final_oper)
    UPDATE oper SET first_oper = 1, final_oper = 1 WHERE process_id = @process_id
  END
  ELSE IF @count > 1
  BEGIN
    --Determine the final operation
    SET @V_Check = 0
    DECLARE cur_last_op CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT oper_id FROM oper_ent_route oer
        WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oer1.input_oper_id FROM oper_ent_route oer1 WHERE oer1.process_id = oer.process_id)
    OPEN cur_last_op
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_last_op INTO @final_oper_id
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Check = @V_Check + 1
      --Update the final op flag and reset for other ops
      UPDATE oper SET final_oper = 1 WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @final_oper_id
      FETCH NEXT FROM cur_last_op INTO @final_oper_id
    END
    CLOSE cur_last_op
    DEALLOCATE cur_last_op

    --Determine the first operation, reset the first op flags first
    SET @V_Check = 0
    DECLARE cur_first_op CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT DISTINCT input_oper_id FROM oper_ent_route oer
        WHERE process_id = @process_id AND input_oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oer1.oper_id FROM oper_ent_route oer1 WHERE oer1.process_id = oer.process_id)
    OPEN cur_first_op
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_first_op INTO @first_oper_id
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @V_Check = @V_Check + 1
      UPDATE oper SET first_oper = 1 WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @first_oper_id
      FETCH NEXT FROM cur_first_op INTO @first_oper_id
    END
    CLOSE cur_first_op
    DEALLOCATE cur_first_op

    --Set the flags to default if routes do not exist for any operation
    UPDATE oper SET first_oper = 1, final_oper = 1
      WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id NOT IN
        (SELECT oer1.input_oper_id FROM oper_ent_route oer1 WHERE oer1.process_id = oper.process_id
         UNION SELECT oer2.oper_id FROM oper_ent_route oer2 WHERE oer2.process_id = oper.process_id)
  END  --  End of @count > 1
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetItemGradeCode]
(@item_grade_desc	STRING80
) RETURNS INT32 AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetItemGradeCode
-- Description       - Returns the ID of the item grade code for the supplied item grade description
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Author			 - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	@item_grade_cd INT32

	--Return NULL if the supplied item grade description is null.
	IF (@item_grade_desc IS NULL) RETURN NULL

	--Query the item grade code for the supplied item grade description
	SELECT @item_grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd

	--Return the ID of the supplied item grade.
	RETURN @item_grade_cd
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_Attr_GetAttrs]
(@shift_id	int
,@user_id	STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Shift_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description			- Get all attributes that are associated to a shift
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT shift_attr.shift_id
    ,shift_attr.attr_id
    ,attr.attr_desc
	,attr.predefined
    ,attr.data_type
    ,attr.entry_type
    ,attr.visible_in_queue
    ,attr.visible_in_inv
    ,shift.shift_desc
    ,shift_attr.attr_value
    ,shift_attr.notes
	,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id) <=
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.cert_name = cul.cert_name
			WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id AND cul.user_id = @user_id AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level)
		THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		editable
            ,shift_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,shift_attr.last_edit_by
            ,shift_attr.last_edit_at
  FROM shift shift WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN shift_attr shift_attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift.shift_id = shift_attr.shift_id
  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE shift.shift_id = @shift_id AND attr.attr_grp = 13
ORDER BY attr.attr_desc, shift.shift_desc

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:     	sp_S_ofi_GetLatestJobMessageLog
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch Latest Job transaction information from Message Log Table 
--	
-- Usage:		MDMJobManagement 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 YG				2023-01-05			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	 YG				2024-01-18			Updated for localization
-- 0.02.01	 YG				2024-01-22			Updated for localization
-- 0.03.00	JSC				2025-11-18			Fixed for wrong order
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetLatestJobMessageLog] 
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@seq_no INT = NULL
	,@type NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
	,@startingDateMessage NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
					FROM ofi_Job_Message_log WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
						AND oper_id = @oper_id
						AND seq_no = @seq_no
						AND type=@type
						AND logged_at > @startingDateMessage)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 
			type
			,description
			,ISNULL(status,0) status
		FROM ofi_Job_Message_log WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
			AND type=@type
			AND logged_at > @startingDateMessage
		ORDER BY
			CASE WHEN ISNULL(status, 0) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,  -- prioritize rows with status > 0
			logged_at DESC;  -- then sort by logged_at descending
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@type,
			-- 'Initializing' description, -- v0.02 Replaces for localization
			-- dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Initializing',  10) description,
			dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300045,NULL, 10) description,
			0 status
	END


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsDirect]
(@from_ent_id			INT32
,@item_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@lot_no			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@sublot_no			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@qty_cons			TFLOAT_NULL = 0
,@reas_cd			INT32
,@grade_cd			INT32 = 0
,@status_cd			INT32 = 0
,@user_id			STRING40
,@wo_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@seq_no			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@shift_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@fg_lot_no			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@fg_sublot_no			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@item_scrapped			INT32 = 0
,@ent_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@shift_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@qty_cons_erp			TFLOAT_NULL= 0
,@ext_ref			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@transaction_type		INT32 = 0
,@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
,@segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@comments			STRING254 = ' ' -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
,@spare1			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare2			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare3			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare4			STRING40 = ' '
,@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value  	INT32 = NULL
,@row_id			INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      	- sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsDirect
-- Description	      	- HD# 3690. This method is used to add a direct consumption record and reduce the qty from inventory
-- Author	      		- Raghu
-- Date Created	      	- 08/20/2004
-- Version	      		- 2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 01/11/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.11  HD# 5285, Handle storage_exec properties while handling inventory
-- 02/09/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.13  HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 03/15/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.16  HD# 5474, Maintain distinct consumption records
-- 09/06/2005      	Raghu         	2.1.28  HD# ?, Return row_id for the currently added row
-- 10/13/2005      	Raghu         	3.1.0   HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/25/2006      	Raghu         	3.1.8   HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
-- 03/09/2006      	Raghu         	3.1.11  HD# 7650, Allow updates to item_prod and item_cons spares
-- 01/09/2007     	KRF           	3.2.1   HD# 8314, part of DB changes - added @sublot_no and @fg_sublot_no arguments
-- 08/27/2007		AML		3.3.0	DB Changes
--01/24/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00074045; Do not add a waste consumption to inventory if the update_inventory is unchecked for a BOM consumption.
--01/25/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00074045; Verify update_inv flag only if it is related to a job
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu		4.0		DB Changes
-- 01/07/2009		Ajay			4.0.0	HF 1432 Bring Hotfix forward
--06/05/2012		Saiteja		4.2		Added Changes for the Merge of CR120590
--07/27/2012        Ashish      4.5     Reverting back the code changes as the HF CR120590 rejected.
--11/28/2016        Mallesh     5.03    US#734692:Merge L00143083(HF CR L00142363-sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce: incorrectly logs consumptions into item_transfer table).
--11/06/2018        SLR         6.1     US#1103745:Update to handle scrap for an entire location indicated when item_id and lot information are null
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @last_edit_at	datetime
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @item_cons_row_id 	INT32
		,@distinct_cons		    NVARCHAR(1)
		,@item_inv_row_id	    INT32
		,@tz_temp		        INT32
		,@update_inv		    INT32
		,@ent_tz_bias_value     INT32
		,@shift_start_tz	    INT32
		,@dbg_resp			    INT32
		,@log_transfer		    INT32 = 0	-- L00143083
		,@cur_auto_del_zero_inv LOGICAL
		,@date_out_utc		TDATETIME
		,@date_out_local	TDATETIME
		,@shift_start_utc_act	TDATETIME

	-- Verify whether a shift start UTC time is supplied
	IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- shift start time UTC is not supplied
		IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL) SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())
	END

	-- Default the shift times to null
	SELECT @shift_start_local = NULL, @shift_id = NULL

	-- Verify the shift actually exist
	SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_start_utc_act = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_id = sh.shift_id
        FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
        AND shift_start_utc <= COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, GETUTCDATE()) -- Default to the current date time, if no shift start utc/local is supplied to identify the current shift
	ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC

	-- Default the shift times to 1900 when a reliable shift cannot be found in the database
	IF (@shift_start_utc_act IS NULL) SET @shift_start_tz = 0
	SELECT @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc_act, '1900-01-01'), @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, '1900-01-01'), @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

	IF (@item_scrapped IS NULL) SET @item_scrapped = 0
	IF (@qty_cons IS NULL) SET @qty_cons = 0
	IF (@qty_cons_erp IS NULL) SET @qty_cons_erp = 0
	IF (@transaction_type IS NULL) SET @transaction_type = 0
	SET @update_inv = 1

	IF (@item_id IS NULL) BEGIN -- removing inventory for entire location
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id) BEGIN
		-- there is at least one item inventory at this location
			SELECT @item_cons_row_id = -1, @distinct_cons = '0'
			SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
			SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')

 			--loop through all item inventory records and update the item_cons
			DECLARE scrap_inv_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd, qty_left
			FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

			OPEN scrap_inv_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM scrap_inv_cursor INTO @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @grade_cd, @status_cd,	@qty_cons
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @item_cons_row_id = -1

				IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @item_cons_row_id = row_id FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
						AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
						AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
			            AND (shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR (shift_start_utc IS NULL AND @shift_start_utc IS NULL))
						AND (item_id = @item_id)
						AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			            AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
						AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		                AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
        				AND (reas_cd = @reas_cd) AND (user_id = @user_id) AND (item_scrapped = @item_scrapped)
			            AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR (ent_id IS NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL))
			            AND (shift_id = @shift_id OR (shift_id IS NULL AND @shift_id IS NULL))
						AND (grade_cd = @grade_cd) AND (status_cd = @status_cd) AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id)
						AND (transaction_type = @transaction_type)
         			    AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (@genealogy_id IS NULL AND genealogy_id IS NULL))
			            AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
			            AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			            AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			            AND (spare1 = @spare1 OR (spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))
			            AND (spare2 = @spare2 OR (spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))
			            AND (spare3 = @spare3 OR (spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))
			            AND (spare4 = @spare4 OR (spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL))
				END

				IF (@item_cons_row_id = -1) BEGIN
						-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/20/2009 RWB
					EXEC sp_I_Item_Cons	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_local , @item_id, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no, @sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no,
										@reas_cd, @user_id, @item_scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id,
										@qty_cons, @qty_cons_erp, @ext_ref, @transaction_type,
										@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
										@comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
										NULL, @shift_start_tz , @last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id OUTPUT
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					UPDATE item_cons
					SET qty_cons = qty_cons + @qty_cons,
						qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @qty_cons_erp,
						comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END, -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
						spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END,
						spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END,
						spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END,
						spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
					WHERE row_id = @item_cons_row_id
				END

	        END -- End of While (1=1)
	        CLOSE scrap_inv_cursor
	        DEALLOCATE scrap_inv_cursor
		    -- remove all inventory for specified location
	        SELECT @cur_auto_del_zero_inv = auto_del_zero_inv FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
		    IF (@cur_auto_del_zero_inv = 1) BEGIN
		         DELETE FROM item_inv where ent_id = @from_ent_id
		         IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		              RAISERROR('SQL Error deleting zero quantity from item_inv table: %d{3223}', 16, 1, @@error)
			          RETURN
		         END
		    END
		    ELSE BEGIN
		    	SET @date_out_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		    	SET @date_out_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @date_out_utc)
		         UPDATE item_inv SET qty_left = 0, date_out_utc = @date_out_utc, date_out_local = @date_out_local
                 WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
			     IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			          RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating item_inv table: %d{3224}', 16, 1, @@error)
				      RETURN
			     END
		    END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN	-- removing inventory for single item
		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL AND @item_id IS NOT NULL)
			SELECT @update_inv = update_inv
			FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND item_id = @item_id


		IF (@update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id AND
					  ((lot_no = @lot_no) OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL)) AND
					  ((sublot_no = @sublot_no) OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},inventory row', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		SELECT @item_cons_row_id = -1, @distinct_cons = '0'
		SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
		SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')

		IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @item_cons_row_id = row_id FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
			  AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
			  AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
			  AND (shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR (shift_start_utc IS NULL AND @shift_start_utc IS NULL))
			  AND (item_id = @item_id)
			  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (reas_cd = @reas_cd) AND (user_id = @user_id) AND (item_scrapped = @item_scrapped)
			  AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR (ent_id IS NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL))
			  AND (shift_id = @shift_id OR (shift_id IS NULL AND @shift_id IS NULL))
			  AND (grade_cd = @grade_cd) AND (status_cd = @status_cd) AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id)
			  AND (transaction_type = @transaction_type)
			  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (@genealogy_id IS NULL AND genealogy_id IS NULL))
			  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			  AND (spare1 = @spare1 OR (spare1 IS NULL AND @spare1 IS NULL))
			  AND (spare2 = @spare2 OR (spare2 IS NULL AND @spare2 IS NULL))
			  AND (spare3 = @spare3 OR (spare3 IS NULL AND @spare3 IS NULL))
			  AND (spare4 = @spare4 OR (spare4 IS NULL AND @spare4 IS NULL))
        END


		IF (@item_cons_row_id = -1) BEGIN
			 -- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/20/2009 RWB
			EXEC sp_I_Item_Cons	@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_local , @item_id, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no, @sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no,
								@reas_cd, @user_id, @item_scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id,
								@qty_cons, @qty_cons_erp, @ext_ref, @transaction_type,
								@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
								@comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
								NULL, @shift_start_tz , @last_edit_at OUTPUT, @row_id OUTPUT
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE item_cons
			SET qty_cons = qty_cons + @qty_cons,
				qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @qty_cons_erp,
				comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END, -- Added 07/20/2009 RWB
				spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END,
				spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END,
				spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END,
				spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
			WHERE row_id = @item_cons_row_id

			SET @row_id = @item_cons_row_id
		END

	--	Shouldn't the following update should use sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce ? May be in the future ??
	/*	UPDATE item_inv SET qty_left = qty_left - @qty_cons, qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp - @qty_cons_erp
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id
		  AND ((lot_no = @lot_no) OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))*/

		IF (@update_inv = 1)
		BEGIN
			-- L00143083: Pass @log_transfer which defaults to false
			IF (@item_scrapped = 1) SET @log_transfer = 1
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=@qty_cons_erp
				, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
				, @must_consume_from_inv=1, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=1, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
				, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=@log_transfer, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@ent_tz_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Inv_Move]
(@from_row_id			INT32
,@from_last_edit_at		TDATETIME = NULL
,@from_ent_id           INT32 = NULL
,@transfer_qty   		TFLOAT = NULL
,@transfer_qty_erp		TFLOAT = NULL
,@in_to_ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_item_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_lot_no			STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_sublot_no		STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_grade_cd		INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_status_cd		INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_uom_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date		TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date_tz	INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@in_to_wo_id			STRING80 = NULL
,@in_to_oper_id			STRING80 = NULL
,@in_to_seq_no			INT32 = NULL
,@in_transfer_option	INT32 = NULL
,@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job	INT32 = NULL
,@in_transfer_comments	STRING254 = NULL
,@in_log_transfer	INT32 = 1
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Item_Inv_Move
-- Description	      - HD# 3596, Allows multiple lots for an item to be combined into a new lot or added to an existing lot
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 02/23/2005
-- Version	      - 2.1.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--10/03/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--01/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.8	HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
--05/17/2006	Raghu		3.1.16	Handle UOM_ID conversions in terms of destination measurements
--05/24/2006	Raghu		3.1.17	HD# 3654, Handle Indistinguishable lots and delegate this call to sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty
--01/23/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--03/30/2007    Raghu       3.2.5   HD# 9287, Inventory Unique By Job
                                    --If the item is hard pegged, and a user has the privilege to override this,
                                    --the fields in the inventory table identifying which job produced this serial number will be updated
                                    --to match those of any job immediately preceeding the first job identified by the work order
                                    --and operation on the ?To? side of the transfer screen, that produces the item being transferred.
                                    --If there is no such ?upstream? job, these fields are left unchanged.
--06/15/2007    Raghu       3.2.16  Move inventory to downstream job ONLY if it is instructed to do so.
--11/26/2009	AJAY		4.0.0	H1423 FIX
-- 03/19/2018   Srinivasa   6.0     US#804232(Handled null value for @from_row_id).
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
	 @from_ent_name			STRING80
	,@to_ent_id				INT32
	,@to_ent_name			STRING80
	,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@can_store				INT32
	,@from_ent_indistinct	INT32
	,@to_ent_indistinct		INT32
	,@dbg_resp				INT32



	SET @in_to_expiry_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_to_expiry_date_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

      -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Inv_Move_t', @src_key='sp_U_Item_Inv_Move_t',
									 @date_val1 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val1 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz,
									 @date_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz

    if ( @dbg_resp = 1 )
		RETURN


SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	--Retrieve the source inventory row.
	SELECT @from_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @from_row_id
	  AND (last_edit_at = @from_last_edit_at OR @from_last_edit_at IS NULL)

	--Check whether we found a source inventory row.
	IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Check whether the inventory row exist, but the qty is modified by the time this call is initiated.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WHERE row_id = @from_row_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified row was not found in the database, or it has been modified by someone else since you retrieved it for the row_id = %%1 {3441},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_row_id, -1))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The supplied inventory source row does not exist in the database.
			SET @err_msg = 'The source row does not exist for row_id = %%1 {3203},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_row_id, -1))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Get the source entity name for the source inventory location.
	--Also, check if the source entity has the can_store capability set to true.
	SELECT @from_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

	IF (@from_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @from_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SET @to_ent_id = ISNULL(@in_to_ent_id, @from_ent_id)

	--Check whether the can store capability for the destination entity is turned on;
	--otherwise raise an error.
	SELECT @to_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id
	IF (@to_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @to_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify if the source entity and the target entity are same.
	IF (@from_ent_id <> @to_ent_id) BEGIN
		--The source entity and the target entity are different. Verify whether the source entity and the destination entity are configured as indistinguishable lots.
		SELECT @from_ent_indistinct = 0, @to_ent_indistinct = 0

		--Get the indistinguishable_lots capability for the source entity.
		SELECT @from_ent_indistinct = indistinguishable_lots FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

		--Get the indistinguishable_lots capability for the destination entity.
		SELECT @to_ent_indistinct = indistinguishable_lots FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id

		--Verify if both the source and the destination entities are configured as indishtinguishable lots
		--If yes, then prorate the quantity in the source inventory location
		--and transfer the prorated quantity to the destination location.
		IF (@from_ent_indistinct = 1 AND @to_ent_indistinct = 1) BEGIN
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_ApplyIndistLots  @from_row_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
												NULL, @to_ent_id, NULL, @in_to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd, @from_ent_id, @transfer_qty,
												@transfer_qty_erp, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
												@in_to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no, @time_zone_bias_value, 1, @in_to_uom_id, @in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz,
												@in_transfer_option, @in_transfer_comments
		END
		-- Fix for CR L00096446/HF-1602
		-- ELSE IF (@from_ent_indistinct <> @to_ent_indistinct) BEGIN
		ELSE IF (@from_ent_indistinct = 1 AND @to_ent_indistinct = 0) BEGIN
			--One of the entity here is configured as  indistinguishable lots and the other is not configured as indistinguishable lots.
			--Do not allow inventory transfers if both does not have the same configuration, throw an error.
			--SET @err_msg = 'The item(s) cannot be transferred to the destination entity, because the source entitity''s:%1 setup for indistinguishable lots is different than the destination entity''s:%2 setup.{5009},' + @from_ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
			SET @err_msg = 'The item(s) cannot be transferred to the destination entity, because lots or items stored in/on the source entity (%1) are indistinguishable whereas lots/items stored in/on the destination entity (%2) are distinguishable.{5009},' + @from_ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE
			--The source and the destination entities are not configured as indistinguishable lots,
			--delegate to this 'sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty' stored procedure which does the inventory transfer.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty	@in_from_row_id=@from_row_id, @in_from_last_edit_at=@from_last_edit_at, @in_transfer_qty=@transfer_qty, @in_transfer_qty_erp=@transfer_qty_erp
				, @in_to_ent_id=@in_to_ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@in_to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@in_to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@in_to_sublot_no
				, @in_to_grade_cd=@in_to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd=@in_to_status_cd, @in_to_uom_id=@in_to_uom_id
				, @in_to_expiry_date=@in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=@in_to_expiry_date_tz, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=@in_to_expiry_date_utc
				, @in_to_wo_id=@in_to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id=@in_to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no=@in_to_seq_no
				, @in_transfer_option=@in_transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job
				, @in_transfer_comments=@in_transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer=@in_log_transfer, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
	END
	ELSE	-- The source and the destination entity are same.
		--just delegate to this 'sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty' stored procedure which does the inventory transfer.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty @in_from_row_id=@from_row_id, @in_from_last_edit_at=@from_last_edit_at, @in_transfer_qty=@transfer_qty, @in_transfer_qty_erp=@transfer_qty_erp
				, @in_to_ent_id=@in_to_ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@in_to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@in_to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@in_to_sublot_no
				, @in_to_grade_cd=@in_to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd=@in_to_status_cd, @in_to_uom_id=@in_to_uom_id
				, @in_to_expiry_date=@in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=@in_to_expiry_date_tz, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=@in_to_expiry_date_utc
				, @in_to_wo_id=@in_to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id=@in_to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no=@in_to_seq_no
				, @in_transfer_option=@in_transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job
				, @in_transfer_comments=@in_transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer=@in_log_transfer, @in_time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
END
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_JobDistribution_Actual] AS

-- ===================================================================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_SA_ofi_GetPalletConsScan]
-- Author:		Shuvam SB
-- Create date: 10/08/2022

-- Description:Handheld Pallet Consumption- scan equipment
-- ===================================================================================================================================
-- Version	Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change Description
-- 0.0.2	LK		2023-07-18			Added extra parameter in SP @user to get the entity access
-- 0.0.3	JSC		2025-03-10			CR486: Allow to skip pallet assignment check on a specific line running the provided job
-- 0.0.4	JSC		2025-03-18			CR486: Add inventory location check in case we skip assigment CHECK
-- 0.0.5	MC		2025-07-08			Reorganisation of the search for pallet storage location
-- ===================================================================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetPalletConsScan]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@equip nvarchar(10),
	@type nvarchar(20),
	@wo_id nvarchar(30)=null,
	@pallet_id nvarchar(1000)=null,
	@user nvarchar(50)=null

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @ent_id int

	if @type='ValEnt'	
	BEGIN
		--select * from job where wo_id='1000'
		select ea.ent_id, e.ent_name,e.description from ent_attr ea  with (nolock)
		inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
		inner join ent e with (nolock)on e.ent_id=ea.ent_id
		where a.attr_desc='ScannableId' and attr_value=@equip

	END
    
	if @type='GetEquip'
	BEGIN
	--	--select * from job where wo_id='1000'
	--	select @ent_id=ent_id from ent_attr ea  with (nolock)
	--	inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
	--	where a.attr_desc='ScannableId' and attr_value=@equip

	--	set @user='Aveva\'+@user
	--	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi') IS NOT NULL
	--	DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi
	--	CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi (
	
	--	ent_id	INT,
	--	ent_name nvarchar(50),
	--	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
	--	can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
	--	can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
	--	can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
	--	can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
	--	can_stre nvarchar(5),
	--	can_log_data nvarchar(5),
	--	parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
	--	access int
	--	);
	--	INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi
	--	exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user
	----	select *from #ent_access_ofi where ent_id=492
	--	IF @ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	--	BEGIN
	--		select w.wo_id,j.run_ent_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,i.item_desc from wo  w with (nolock)
	--		inner join job j with (nolock) on j.wo_id=w.wo_id 
	--		inner join item i with (nolock) on i.item_id=j.item_id
	--		where j.run_ent_id=@ent_id and j.state_cd=3
	--	END

	--commented 
	SELECT @ent_id=ent_id FROM ent_attr ea  WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
		WHERE a.attr_desc='ScannableId' AND attr_value=@equip

		SELECT w.wo_id,j.run_ent_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,i.item_desc FROM wo  w WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=w.wo_id 
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=j.item_id
		WHERE j.run_ent_id=@ent_id AND j.state_cd=3
	END
	IF @type='CheckPalletAssign'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Exists INT = 0
				,@SkipPalletAssignmentCheck NVARCHAR(80) = 0
				,@EntId INT = -1
		
		-- CR486: Improvement: Check if input values are different than NULL
		IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @pallet_id IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS Exits
			RETURN;
		END
		
		-- CR486: Added the logic here to avoid checking for Pallet assignment if Attribute is set
		SELECT TOP 1 @SkipPalletAssignmentCheck = ISNULL(ea.attr_value,0)
					,@EntId = ISNULL(ea.ent_id,-1)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		WHERE j.state_cd=3 
			AND j.wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND ea.attr_id = (	SELECT TOP 1 attr_id 
								FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) 
								WHERE a.attr_desc = 'SkipPalletAssignmentCheck'
							 )
		
		--	CR486: Check for value and give back result if OK.
		IF (@SkipPalletAssignmentCheck = 1) 
		BEGIN
			--	CR486: v0.0.4 Added: Check the pallet location versus the running line parent
			DECLARE @Parent_ent_id INT =-1
			DECLARE @Pallet_ent_id INT =-1
			--SELECT @Parent_ent_id = [dbo].fn_S_ofi_GetParentWithAttrValue(@EntId,'AREA')

			-- 0.0.5 selecting parnt ent_id based on PalletConsumptionAreas declared in segment
			declare @ent_id_segment int
			SELECT @ent_id_segment= target_sched_ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
			where j.wo_id = @wo_id

			declare @areas_names nvarchar(max)
			SELECT @areas_names = ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with (nolock)
			left join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc = 'PalletConsumptionAreas' and ea.ent_id = @ent_id_segment

			declare @ent_table table (ent_id int);
			IF @areas_names IS NULL --if there is no data for new attribute use old way to take area
				insert into @ent_table (ent_id) -- table with parent ent_id
				SELECT [dbo].fn_S_ofi_GetParentWithAttrValue(@EntId,'AREA')
			ELSE
				insert into @ent_table (ent_id) -- table with parent ent_id 
				(SELECT e.ent_id from ent e where e.ent_name in (SELECT items FROM fn_ofi_Split (@areas_names, ',')))

			SELECT TOP 1 @Pallet_ent_id = ii.ent_id
			FROM item_inv ii with (nolock)
			WHERE ii.spare2 = @pallet_id

			-- if pallet location is not the running entity's parent then exit as not valid
			--IF (@Pallet_ent_id <> @Parent_ent_id)
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @ent_table WHERE ent_id = @Pallet_ent_id)
			BEGIN 
				SELECT -1 AS exist
				RETURN;
			END
			-- CR486: v0.0.4 Added (end)
			
			
			SELECT 1 AS exist
			RETURN;
		END
		
		-- Standard check for pallet assigment
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ofi_AssignHuWoId WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id=@wo_id AND pallet_id=@pallet_id)
		BEGIN
			SET @Exists=1
		END

		SELECT @Exists AS exist
	END
	if @type='validateUD'
	BEGIN
			DECLARE @process_attr_id INT

			DECLARE @temp TABLE (
				process_id NVARCHAR(40),
				disable_ud  NVARCHAR(40)
			)

			SELECT @process_attr_id = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'Disable_UD'

			INSERT INTO @temp (process_id, disable_ud)
			SELECT process_id, attr_value FROM process_attr WHERE attr_id = @process_attr_id

			SELECT ISNULL(mrt.disable_ud, '0') AS disable_ud
			FROM job j
			INNER JOIN oper o ON o.oper_id = j.oper_id
			INNER JOIN process p ON p.process_id = o.process_id
			LEFT JOIN @temp mrt ON p.process_id = mrt.process_id
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id


	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_GetShiftSchedEnts]
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_SA_Line_GetShiftSchedEnts
-- Description		- UserStory: 229362 - Returns a list of ancestor entities from which the shift schedules can be inherited for the entities in a line.
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 08/22/2013
-- Version			- 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	--Get the list of entities in a line, and generate a list of descendant entities from the list of entities in a line.
	;WITH desc_ents_to_be_excluded (ent_id, ent_name)
	AS
	(
		--Get the list of entities in a line.
		SELECT lel.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Join with the entity table to retrieve the entity name
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		--Limit to the entities that are in a line
		WHERE lel.line_is_child = 0
		UNION ALL
		--Get the list of immediate descendant entities (recursive) from the list of entities
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Get the descendant entities
		INNER JOIN desc_ents_to_be_excluded de ON e.parent_ent_id = de.ent_id
	),
	--Start from the entities that can schedule shifts, and then retrieve a list of descendant entities from these entities
	desc_ents_shift_sched (ent_id, ent_name)
	AS
	(
		--Get a list of entities that can schedule shifts
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Limit to the entities that can schedule shifts
		WHERE e.can_sched_shifts = 1
		UNION ALL
		--Get the list of immediate descendant entities (recursive) from the list of entities
		SELECT e.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		--Get the descendant entities
		INNER JOIN desc_ents_shift_sched dess ON e.parent_ent_id = dess.ent_id
	)
	--Returns a list of entities that can schedule shifts and their descendants
	SELECT DISTINCT ss.ent_id, ss.ent_name
	FROM desc_ents_shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
	--Exclude the entities that are in a line and descendant entities.
	EXCEPT
	--Get a list of entities in a line and their descendants
	SELECT dents.ent_id, dents.ent_name
	FROM desc_ents_to_be_excluded dents WITH (NOLOCK)
	ORDER BY ss.ent_name
END
