--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        [sp_sa_ofi_cb_correction_recipe]
-- Description: Get the predicted recipe for current batch correction
-- Usage:       From which object this script is called.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00      AKM		2023-08-01			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00		JSC		2025-10-20			Cakeblending FAT: added comp_item_id for silo selection
-- 0.02.01		JSC		2025-11-03			Cakeblending FAT: If correction found then use SAP BOM (not MES)
-- 0.02.02		JSC		2025-11-11			Allow Only additives with predicted values
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_cb_correction_recipe]
	@wo_id     NVARCHAR(40),
	@oper_id   NVARCHAR(40),
	@seq_no    INT,
	@spare1    NVARCHAR(40),
	@is_man    INT,
	@corr_step INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @job_qty_reqd FLOAT
	
	DECLARE @RESULT TABLE
		(
			id                  INT PRIMARY KEY identity(1,1),
			item_id             NVARCHAR(40),
			item_desc           NVARCHAR(40),
			qty_percent         FLOAT,
			qty_reqd            FLOAT,
			category            NVARCHAR(40),
			material_type       NVARCHAR(40),
			qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
			row_id              INT,
			job_qty_reqd        FLOAT,
			man_qty_percent     FLOAT,
			man_qty_reqd        FLOAT ,
			comp_item_id        NVARCHAR(50)
		)--added v2.00
	DECLARE @PHCORRECTIONT TABLE
		(
			item_desc		NVARCHAR(80),
			item_id			NVARCHAR(40),
			correctionVal	FLOAT
		)
	SELECT @job_qty_reqd = reqd_qty
	FROM ofi_cb_sample_results (NOLOCK)
	WHERE spare1           = @spare1
		AND is_manual      = @is_man
		AND correction_step= @corr_step
	
	INSERT INTO @PHCORRECTIONT
	SELECT   i.item_desc
			,i.item_id
		   ,CASE 
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType1 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue1
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType2 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue2
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType3 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue3
				WHEN cb.phCorrectionType4 = a.Component
					THEN cb.phCorrectionValue4
			END
	FROM cakeblend.Additives a WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ofi_cb_sample_results cb WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.Component IN (cb.phCorrectionType1, cb.phCorrectionType2, cb.phCorrectionType3, cb.phCorrectionType4)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = a.item_id 
	WHERE cb.spare1           = @spare1
		AND cb.is_manual      = @is_man
		AND cb.correction_step= @corr_step


	IF EXISTS
	(   SELECT 1
		FROM ofi_correction_recipe ocr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ocr.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND ocr.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND ocr.seq_no = @seq_no
			AND ocr.spare1 = @spare1
			AND ocr.corr_counter = @corr_step )
	BEGIN

		-- v2.01 Pick default grade for the entity
		DECLARE @default_grade INT

		-- try job_exec 1st
		SELECT TOP 1 @default_grade = ir.item_grade_cd
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_cons_reas_cd = ir.reas_cd
			JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = @wo_id 
											AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
											AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
											AND j.run_ent_id = je.ent_id

		-- try ent_attr 2nd
		IF (@default_grade IS NULL or @default_grade < 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @default_grade = ig.item_grade_cd
			FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
				JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_desc = 'default_grade' 
													AND ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
				JOIN item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ig.item_grade_desc = ea.attr_value
				JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = @wo_id 
												AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
												AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
												AND j.run_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		END
		
		
		-- just in case... to review.
		SELECT TOP 1  @default_grade = ISNULL(@default_grade,ig.item_grade_cd)
		FROM item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) 			
		WHERE ig.item_grade_desc = 'STANDARD'

		INSERT INTO @result
			(   item_id,
				item_desc,
				qty_percent ,
				qty_reqd ,
				category ,
				material_type,
				qty_per_parent_item ,
				row_id ,
				job_qty_reqd ,
				man_qty_percent ,
				man_qty_reqd ,
				comp_item_id
			)
		SELECT i.item_id, -- v2.01 changed
			i.item_desc,
			ROUND(( ocr.qty_per_parent_item * 100 ),2)                         AS qty_percent,
			ROUND(( ocr.qty_per_parent_item * ( j.qty_reqd - j.qty_prod ) ),2) AS qty_reqd,
			ia.attr_value                                                      AS category,
			ia2.attr_value                                                     AS material_type,
			ocr.qty_per_parent_item                                            AS qty_per_parent_item,
			ocr.row_id,
			@job_qty_reqd                                                      AS job_qty_reqd,
			NULL                                                               AS man_qty_percent,
			NULL                                                               AS man_qty_reqd ,
			CONCAT(ocr.item_id,@default_grade)                                 AS comp_item_id -- added v2.00 -- v2.01 changed
		FROM ofi_correction_recipe ocr WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id                      = ocr.item_id
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id                        = ocr.wo_id
				AND j.oper_id                                                = ocr.oper_id
				AND j.seq_no                                                 = ocr.seq_no
			INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id              = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)       ON a.attr_id               = ia.attr_id
				AND a.attr_desc                                              = 'Category'
				AND a.attr_grp                                               = 1
			INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id            = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a2 WITH (NOLOCK)       ON a2.attr_id             = ia2.attr_id
				AND a2.attr_desc                                             = 'MaterialType'
				AND a2.attr_grp                                              = 1
		WHERE ocr.wo_id = @wo_id
			AND ocr.oper_id = @oper_id
			AND ocr.seq_no = @seq_no
			AND ocr.spare1 = @spare1
			AND ocr.corr_counter = @corr_step
		UNION
		-- Insert statements for procedure here
		SELECT jb.item_id,
			i.item_desc,
			0                                   AS qty_percent ,
			ph.correctionVal                    AS qty_reqd,
			ia.attr_value                       AS category,
			'Additives'                         AS material_type,
			0                                   AS qty_per_parent_item,
			jb.row_id,							-- never used for ADDITIVEs 
			0                                   AS job_qty_reqd,
			NULL                                AS man_qty_percent,
			CASE
				WHEN @is_man=1
					THEN ph.correctionVal
				WHEN @is_man=0
					THEN NULL
			END                                 AS man_qty_reqd ,
			CONCAT(jb.item_id,@default_grade) AS comp_item_id -- added v2.00 --v2.01 MOD
		FROM ofi_wo_item_ext jb WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item (NOLOCK) i       ON i.item_id  =jb.item_id
			INNER JOIN item_attr (NOLOCK) ia ON jb.item_id = ia.item_id
				AND ia.attr_value                         = 'additives'
			LEFT JOIN @pHcorrectionT ph ON ph.item_id   = jb.item_id -- v2.091 MOD
		WHERE jb.wo_id                                    = @wo_id
			--AND jb.oper_id                                = @oper_id --v2.01 MOD
			--AND jb.seq_no                                 = @seq_no  --v2.01 MOD
			AND jb.bom_pos                                > 0
			AND ph.correctionVal > 0 -- v2.02 MOD

		-- output
		SELECT r.item_id,
			r.item_desc,
			qty_percent,
			qty_reqd,
			category,
			material_type,
			qty_per_parent_item,
			r.row_id,
			job_qty_reqd,
			man_qty_percent,
			man_qty_reqd ,
			item.num_decimals ,
			comp_item_id -- added v2.00
		FROM @result r
			INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON item.item_id=r.item_id
		ORDER BY id ASC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--select top 1 @job_qty_reqd = qty_reqd - qty_prod from job with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and  oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
		INSERT INTO @result
			(   item_id,
				item_desc,
				qty_percent ,
				qty_reqd ,
				category ,
				material_type,
				qty_per_parent_item ,
				row_id ,
				job_qty_reqd ,
				man_qty_percent ,
				man_qty_reqd ,
				comp_item_id
			)--added v2.00
		SELECT jb.item_id,
			i.item_desc,
			0                                          AS qty_percent,
			0                                          AS qty_reqd,
			ia.attr_value                              AS category,
			ia2.attr_value                             AS material_type,
			0                                          AS qty_per_parent_item,
			row_number() OVER (   ORDER BY jb.item_id) AS row_id,
			@job_qty_reqd                              AS job_qty_reqd,
			NULL                                       AS man_qty_percent,
			NULL                                       AS man_qty_reqd ,
			CONCAT(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd)        AS comp_item_id -- added v2.00
		FROM job_bom (NOLOCK)                           jb
			--left join ofi_correction_recipe ocr WITH (nolock)
			--on ocr.item_id = jb.item_id and ocr.spare1=@spare1
			LEFT JOIN item i (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id           = jb.item_id
				AND jb.wo_id                                 =@wo_id
			INNER JOIN job j (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id             = @wo_id
				AND j.oper_id                                = @oper_id
				AND j.seq_no                                 = @seq_no
			INNER JOIN item_attr ia (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id   = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a (NOLOCK)       ON a.attr_id    = ia.attr_id
				AND a.attr_desc                              = 'Category'
				AND a.attr_grp                               = 1
			INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 (NOLOCK) ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a2 (NOLOCK)       ON a2.attr_id  = ia2.attr_id
				AND a2.attr_desc                             = 'MaterialType'
				AND a2.attr_grp                              = 1
		WHERE jb.wo_id                                       =@wo_id
			AND jb.oper_id                                   =@oper_id
			AND jb.seq_no                                    =@seq_no
			AND jb.bom_pos                                   >0
		-- output
		SELECT	r.item_id,
				r.item_desc,
				qty_percent,
				qty_reqd,
				category,
				material_type,
				qty_per_parent_item,
				r.row_id,
				job_qty_reqd,
				man_qty_percent,
				man_qty_reqd ,
				item.num_decimals ,
				comp_item_id -- added v2.00
		FROM @result r
			INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK) ON item.item_id=r.item_id
		ORDER BY id ASC
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SA_ITEM_INV_GETBYFILTER]
(@ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,@item_id	STRING80 = NULL
,@lot_no	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	SP_SA_ITEM_INV_GETBYFILTER
-- Description	      -	Returns inventory records optionally filtered by ent_id, item_id and lot_no paramters.
--			Along with the inventory columns, this method also returns the ent_name, entity description,
--			attribute id, attribute description, attribute value and attribute notes for
--			item attributes and lot attributes.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	02/09/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.10
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 12/29/2006     KRF          3.2.1    Return sublot_no from item_inv (but no sublot_attr)
-- 08/03/2007	  AML		   3.3.0    DB Changes
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

	SELECT ii.ent_id, e.ent_name, e.description, ii.item_id, i.item_desc, ii.lot_no, ii.sublot_no, ii.grade_cd, ii.status_cd, ii.qty_left, ii.qty_left_erp, ii.uom_id,
	ii.date_in_utc, ii.date_in_local, ii.date_out_utc, ii.date_out_local, ii.expiry_date, ii.wo_id, ii.oper_id, ii.seq_no, ii.spare1, ii.spare2, ii.spare3,
	ii.spare4, ii.spare5, ii.spare6, ii.last_edit_by, ii.last_edit_at, ii.row_id,
	ia.attr_id AS item_attr_id, iad.attr_desc AS item_attr_desc, ia.attr_value AS item_attr_value, ia.notes AS item_attr_notes,
	la.attr_id AS lot_attr_id, lad.attr_desc AS lot_attr_desc, la.attr_value AS lot_attr_value, ia.notes AS lot_attr_notes
	FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = e.ent_id
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN attr iad WITH (NOLOCK) ON iad.attr_id = ia.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN lot_attr la WITH (NOLOCK) ON la.item_id = ii.item_id AND la.lot_no = ii.lot_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN attr lad WITH (NOLOCK) ON lad.attr_id = la.attr_id
	WHERE (ii.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	AND (ii.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
	AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_process_link_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[item_process_link]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    	-- tg_item_process_link_aft_del
-- Description     	-- Delete bom_item_oper_link records as and when item_process_link records are deleted
--			   for the matching item_id and process_id
-- Date Created    	-- 11/18/2002
-- Author	   	-- Raghu
-- Version         	-- 2.1.0.21
--
-- Copyright 2019 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 12/10/2002	  Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- 08/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0   (HD#3145) Delete all associated bom_item_oper_link data for the item
-- 05/18/2005     SJ            21021   HD#5610 Clone Process - BOM_ITEM_OPER_SPEC Data
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 03/02/2018   Varun       6.0		Merge CR L00148197(HF L00147796)- Added check condition for checking the uniqueness on
--                                  the column before inserting the records into #tmp_bom_itm and validating before inserting
--                                  new record. There are three location found where the insertion to temporary table.
-- 05/24/2019		Raghu		6.2 US-1165981-MOL: As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00153267 (HF CR L00152505: It takes a very long time (more than 5 minutes) to add a bom version.)
-- 07/25/2019		RWB			6.2.0	Story 1165973 - Added code to make sure that all items are removed from the
--										BOM_Item_Oper_Link and BOM_Item_Oper_Spec tables for the processes being unlinked
--										if the items are in the BOM of an item being unlinked from a process and no other items
--										linked to the process have the item in their BOMs.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @attr_value	BIT,
  @V_Item	STRING40,
  @V_Ver	STRING40,
  @V_Process_id STRING40,
  @child_level  INT32
BEGIN
  SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 207
  IF (@attr_value = 1)
  BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process p INNER JOIN deleted d ON p.process_id = d.process_id WHERE p.process_status = 3)
--      RAISERROR ('Cannot delete the item_process_link of a certified process', 16, 1)
      RAISERROR ('Can not delete the %1 record that is attached to a certified process.{4737},item_process_link', 16, 1)
  END

  DECLARE @tmp_bom_item TABLE(process_id NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, item_id NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)
  ;WITH bom_data
  AS
  (
    SELECT d.process_id, d.item_id
    FROM deleted d
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bom_data.process_id, bom_item.item_id
    FROM bom_item (NOLOCK)
    JOIN bom_data ON bom_item.parent_item_id = bom_data.item_id
    WHERE bom_pos <> 0
  )
  INSERT INTO @tmp_bom_item
  SELECT process_id, item_id
  FROM bom_data

  ;WITH bom_data_to_keep
  AS
  (
    SELECT ipl.process_id, ipl.item_id AS item_id
    FROM item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN deleted d ON ipl.process_id = d.process_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bdtk.process_id, bom_item.item_id
    FROM bom_item (NOLOCK)
    JOIN bom_data_to_keep bdtk ON bom_item.parent_item_id = bdtk.item_id
    WHERE bom_pos <> 0
  )
  DELETE @tmp_bom_item
  FROM @tmp_bom_item tbi
  JOIN bom_data_to_keep bdtk ON tbi.process_id = bdtk.process_id AND tbi.item_id = bdtk.item_id

  DELETE bom_item_oper_link
  FROM bom_item_oper_link biol
  JOIN @tmp_bom_item tbi ON biol.process_id = tbi.process_id AND biol.parent_item_id = tbi.item_id

  DELETE bom_item_oper_spec
  FROM bom_item_oper_spec bios
  JOIN @tmp_bom_item tbi ON bios.process_id = tbi.process_id AND bios.item_id = tbi.item_id

END

-- Description:	Gets triggered from Nice Label
-- Usage:		updates label status
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AML, XPM	2026-03-05			Initial version
-- 0.01.01  AML, XPM    2026-03-20          Updated to match the new tables structure
-- 0.02.00  AML, XPM	2026-06-08			Managed the error coming from NL so we have some feedback
-- 0.02.01  AML, XPM    2026-06-12          Handled empty strings in @error_message.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ofi_lm_label_processed] 
	 @label_id NVARCHAR(100),
	 @label_type NVARCHAR(100),
	 @error_message NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @processed INT = 1,
			@active INT = 1;

	IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@error_message, ''))) <> ''
	BEGIN
		SET @processed = -1
		SET @active = 0
	END

	IF @label_type IN ('preview', 'manual')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ofi_lm_print_label_header
		SET  is_label_processed = @processed
		,is_active = 0
		WHERE [label_id] = @label_id 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN		
		UPDATE ofi_lm_print_label_header
		SET  is_label_processed = @processed
		,is_active = @active
		WHERE [label_id] = @label_id 
	END
	
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_EI_sampleplan_timeAndlocation] (
	@xml_data_in NVARCHAR(max)
	,@samplePlanType INT = 1 -- 0. LabVantage Product Variant (material and process based sample plan) --1. LabVantage Sample Point Schedule Plans (time and location based sample plan)
	)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	-- SET XACT_ABORT ON will cause the transaction to be uncommittable  
	-- when the constraint violation occurs.   
	SET XACT_ABORT ON;
	-- xml sample as shown below
	/*
<ArrayOfMESInternalSamplePlan02Data
	xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
	xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
 
 
	<MESInternalSamplePlan02Data>
<SamplePointID>SP-000161</SamplePointID>
<LocationLabel>Line 3</LocationLabel>
<LocationPath>/Koog/Plant1/Line 3</LocationPath>
<SchedulePlan>Weekdays for Line 3</SchedulePlan>
<Recurrence>TIME_8_W(MTWTF--)</Recurrence>
<TestMethod>Color Tests</TestMethod>
<ParameterListID>Color</ParameterListID>
<Variant>Lovibond</Variant>
<Parameter>Red value</Parameter>
<DataType>Numeric</DataType>
<LowerLimit>206</LowerLimit>
<UpperLimit>222</UpperLimit>
<TargetValue>214</TargetValue>
<Units />
<MESWait>1</MESWait>
</MESInternalSamplePlan02Data>
 
	<MESInternalSamplePlan02Data>
<SamplePointID>SP-000161</SamplePointID>
<LocationLabel>Line 3</LocationLabel>
<LocationPath>/Koog/Plant1/Line 3</LocationPath>
<SchedulePlan>Weekdays for Line 3</SchedulePlan>
<Recurrence>TIME_8_W(MTWTF--)</Recurrence>
<TestMethod>Color Tests</TestMethod>
<ParameterListID>Color</ParameterListID>
<Variant>Lovibond</Variant>
<Parameter>Yellow value</Parameter>
<DataType>Numeric</DataType>
<LowerLimit>26</LowerLimit>
<UpperLimit>22</UpperLimit>
<TargetValue>24</TargetValue>
<Units />
<MESWait>0</MESWait>
</MESInternalSamplePlan02Data>
 
	<MESInternalSamplePlan02Data>
<SamplePointID>SP-000161</SamplePointID>
<LocationLabel>Line 3</LocationLabel>
<LocationPath>/Koog/Plant1/Line 3</LocationPath>
<SchedulePlan>Weekdays for Line 3</SchedulePlan>
<Recurrence>TIME_8_W(MTWTF--)</Recurrence>
<TestMethod>Color Tests</TestMethod>
<ParameterListID>Color</ParameterListID>
<Variant>Lovibond</Variant>
<Parameter>Blue value</Parameter>
<DataType>Numeric</DataType>
<LowerLimit>326</LowerLimit>
<UpperLimit>322</UpperLimit>
<TargetValue>324</TargetValue>
<Units />
<MESWait>0</MESWait>
</MESInternalSamplePlan02Data>
	*/
	-- ' (apostrophe or single quote) REPLACE WITH ' 
	SET @xml_data_in = REPLACE(@xml_data_in, '''', ''');
 
	DECLARE @new_recurrence nvarchar(20) ;
	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(254) = '';
	DECLARE @msg_output NVARCHAR(500) = '';
	DECLARE @enabled_freq LOGICAL = 0;-- frequency will be disabled in these sample plans. (To avoid schedule triggers.  This trigger actually happens from LIMS system, so no need to trigger in MES side.)
	DECLARE @ent_id INT;
	DECLARE @mes_plan_id INT;
	DECLARE @freq_id INT32;
	DECLARE @char_id INT32;
	DECLARE @cur_sys_local_time DATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @converted_data_xml XML = CONVERT(XML, @xml_data_in);
	DECLARE @i_min INT;
	DECLARE @i_max INT;
	DECLARE @i_first_row INT;	-- v00.02
	DECLARE @SamplePointID NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @LocationLabel NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @LocationPath NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @SchedulePlan NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @Recurrence NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @TestMethod NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @ParameterListID NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Variant NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Parameter NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @DataType NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @LowerLimit NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @UpperLimit NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @TargetValue NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @Units NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @MESWait NVARCHAR(1);
	DECLARE @tbl_SamplePlanData TABLE (
		row_id INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
		,SamplePointID NVARCHAR(40)
		,LocationLabel NVARCHAR(40)
		,LocationPath NVARCHAR(40)
		,SchedulePlan NVARCHAR(80)
		,Recurrence NVARCHAR(20)
		,TestMethod NVARCHAR(40)
		,ParameterListID NVARCHAR(40)
		,Variant NVARCHAR(40)
		,Parameter NVARCHAR(40)
		,DataType NVARCHAR(20)
		,LowerLimit NVARCHAR(80)
		,UpperLimit NVARCHAR(80)
		,TargetValue NVARCHAR(80)
		,Units NVARCHAR(40)
		,MESWait NVARCHAR(1)
		,FirstRowSamplePlan INT -- ADDED v1.00						
		);
 
	INSERT INTO @tbl_SamplePlanData (
		SamplePointID
		,LocationLabel
		,LocationPath
		,SchedulePlan
		,Recurrence
		,TestMethod
		,ParameterListID
		,Variant
		,Parameter
		,DataType
		,LowerLimit
		,UpperLimit
		,TargetValue
		,Units
		,MESWait
		,FirstRowSamplePlan -- ADDED v1.00						
		)
	SELECT C.value('SamplePointID[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS SamplePointID
		,C.value('LocationLabel[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS LocationLabel
		,C.value('LocationPath[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS LocationPath
		,C.value('SchedulePlan[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS SchedulePlan
		,C.value('Recurrence[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS Recurrence
		,C.value('TestMethod[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS TestMethod
		,C.value('ParameterListID[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS ParameterListID
		,C.value('Variant[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Variant
		,C.value('Parameter[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Parameter
		,C.value('DataType[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS DataType
		,C.value('LowerLimit[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS LowerLimit
		,C.value('UpperLimit[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS UpperLimit
		,C.value('TargetValue[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS TargetValue
		,C.value('Units[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Units
		,C.value('MESWait[1]', 'nvarchar(1)') AS MESWait
		,0 AS FirstRowSamplePlan -- ADDED v1.00								 
	FROM @converted_data_xml.nodes('/ArrayOfMESInternalSamplePlan02Data/MESInternalSamplePlan02Data') AS T(C);
	
	-- v1.00 Added
	-- Step 1: Use a CTE to calculate row numbers
	WITH RankedRows AS (
		SELECT *,
			   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.SamplePointID,sp.LocationLabel,sp.Recurrence ORDER BY sp.SamplePointID,sp.LocationLabel,sp.Recurrence) AS RowNum
		FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData sp
	)
	-- Step 2: Update the original table variable
	UPDATE t
	SET t.FirstRowSamplePlan = 1
	FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData t
		INNER JOIN RankedRows r ON
			t.row_id = r.row_id
	WHERE r.RowNum = 1;		
	

	SELECT @i_min = MIN(row_id)
		,@i_max = MAX(row_id)
		--,@i_first_row = MIN(row_id) -- v1.00 MOD	-- v00.02
	FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData;
 
	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;
 
		WHILE (@i_min <= @i_max)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SamplePointID = SamplePointID
				,@LocationLabel = LocationLabel
				,@LocationPath = LocationPath
				,@SchedulePlan = SchedulePlan
				,@Recurrence = UPPER(Recurrence)
				,@TestMethod = TestMethod
				,@ParameterListID = ParameterListID
				,@Variant = Variant
				,@Parameter = Parameter
				,@DataType = DataType
				,@LowerLimit = LowerLimit
				,@UpperLimit = UpperLimit
				,@TargetValue = TargetValue
				,@Units = Units
				,@MESWait = MESWait
				,@i_first_row = FirstRowSamplePlan -- v1.00 ADDED							 
			FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData
			WHERE row_id = @i_min;
 
			SET @DataType = ISNULL(@DataType, 'Numeric');-- default data type in case if not provided.
 
			IF (@DataType = '')
				SET @DataType = 'Numeric';
 
			-- if the given product not exist in MESDB, throw an error
			IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE ent_name = @LocationLabel
					)
			BEGIN;
				-- string_id 500002 = 'The given location not exist in MES DB.  Location id: '
				SELECT  @msg = CONCAT (dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500002, NULL, NULL), @LocationLabel) ;
				SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';
 
				RAISERROR (
						@msg
						,16
						,1
						);
 
				Return -1 ;
			END;
 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_name = @LocationLabel;
 
			-- v1.00 MOD
			-- for sample plan, it has to be linked with frequency
			SET @new_recurrence = 'L_' + @Recurrence ;
			
			-- v1.00 MOD
			IF (@i_first_row = 1) BEGIN
					-- v1.00 MOD 
				-- check whether the given sample plan is already exist or not; if yes, just disable its qm ti avoid further trigger
				EXEC sp_U_ofi_EI_disablesampleplan 
						@SamplePlanID = @SamplePointID
						,@ProductID = NULL	-- SET To NULL as it is not part of this set
						,@Level = NULL		-- SET To NULL as it is not part of this set
						,@Stage = NULL		-- SET To NULL as it is not part of this set
						,@Customer = NULL	-- SET To NULL as it is not part of this set
						,@SourceLabel = @new_recurrence -- same as for SAMPLE PLAN CREATION
						,@LocationLabel = @LocationLabel 
						,@Count = NULL		-- SET To NULL as it is not part of this set
						,@samplePlanType = @samplePlanType;
			END ;
			-- -- v00.02 BE
 
			-- 01. create characteristic
			-- 02. create sample frequency
			-- 03. create sample plan
			-- 04. create qm-spec
			-- 01. create characteristic
			EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_samplechar @Parameter
				,@TestMethod
				,@Variant
				,@DataType
				,@Units
				,@LowerLimit
				,@UpperLimit
				,@TargetValue
				,@char_id OUTPUT;
 
			-- 02. create sample frequency
			-- check the sample frequency exist or not; if not exist create it
			IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE freq_name = 'L_' + @Recurrence
					)
			BEGIN
				EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_samplefreq @Recurrence
					,'' --ProductID
					,'' --Customer
					,'' --Level
					,'' --Stage
					,@TestMethod
					,@ParameterListID
					,@Variant
					,@enabled_freq
					,@samplePlanType
					,@freq_id OUTPUT;
			END;
 
			-- 03. create sample plan
			
			EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_generatesampleplan @SamplePointID --'@SamplePlanID '
				,@samplePlanType
				,'' --ProductID
				,'' --Customer
				,'' --Level
				,'' --Stage
				,@new_recurrence --SourceLabel
				,@TestMethod
				,@ParameterListID
				,@Variant
				,@LocationLabel
				,@LocationPath
				,@mes_plan_id OUTPUT;
 
			-- 04. create qm-spec
			-- for qm-spec, it has to be linked with characteristic, and sample plan name.  so first sample plan has to be created
			EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_qmspec @SamplePointID --'@SamplePlanID '
				,NULL --'@ProductID 
				,@ent_id
				,'' --Customer
				,'' --Level
				,'' --Stage
				,@Recurrence --SourceLabel
				,@TestMethod
				,@ParameterListID
				,@Variant
				,@Parameter
				,@DataType
				,@Units
				,@LowerLimit
				,@UpperLimit
				,@TargetValue
				,@MESWait
				,@mes_plan_id
				,@char_id;
 
			-- increment the row id
			SET @i_min = @i_min + 1;
		END;
 
		-- If the SPs execution succeeds, commit the transaction.  
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
 
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'Sample point ' + @SamplePointID + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';
 
		SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
	END TRY
 
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @msg = ERROR_MESSAGE();
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';
 
		-- XACT_STATE:  
		-- If 1, the transaction is committable.  
		-- If -1, the transaction is uncommittable and should be rolled back.  
		-- XACT_STATE = 0 means that there is no transaction and  
		--     a commit or rollback operation would generate an error.  
		-- Test whether the transaction is uncommittable.  
		IF (XACT_STATE()) = - 1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
 
			RAISERROR (
					@msg_output
					,16
					,1
					);
 
			Return -1 ;
		END;
 
		-- Test whether the transaction is committable.
		-- You may want to commit a transaction in a catch block if you want to commit changes to statements that ran prior to the error.
		IF (XACT_STATE()) = 1
		BEGIN
			COMMIT TRANSACTION;
 
			SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'Sample point ' + @SamplePointID + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';
 
			SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
		END;
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CLONE_job_BOM_step]
	@wo_id string40,
	@oper_id string40,
	@seq_no int,
	@BOM_pos int,
	@new_wo_id string40,
	@new_oper_id string40,
	@new_seq_no int,

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @JBS_wo_id STRING40
DECLARE @JBS_oper_id STRING40
DECLARE @JBS_seq_no int
DECLARE @JBS_BOM_pos int
DECLARE @JBS_step_no STRING40
DECLARE @JBS_qty_per_parent_item int
DECLARE @JBS_mod_id timestamp
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	EXEC sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 1, 'sp_CLONE_job_BOM_step', 'sp_CLONE_job_BOM_step',
		'Before opening Job_bom_step_cursor', 'DECLARE Job_bom_step_cursor CURSOR LOCAL', ''
--6.	Clone JOB_BOM table row(s)* and then Clone JOB_BOM_STEP table row(s)*.
	DECLARE Job_bom_step_cursor CURSOR LOCAL
	--FOR SELECT * FROM Job_BOM_step
	FOR SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, step_no, qty_per_parent_item, mod_id FROM Job_BOM_step
	    WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and bom_pos = @BOM_pos
	OPEN  Job_bom_step_cursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM Job_bom_step_cursor
	INTO @JBS_wo_id, @JBS_oper_id, @JBS_seq_no, @JBS_BOM_pos,
		@JBS_step_no, @JBS_qty_per_parent_item, @JBS_mod_id
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO job_BOM_step
			(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, BOM_pos,
			step_no, qty_per_parent_item)
		VALUES
			(@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @new_BOM_pos,

		FETCH NEXT FROM Job_bom_step_cursor

			@JBS_step_no, @JBS_qty_per_parent_item, @JBS_mod_id
	END
	CLOSE Job_bom_step_cursor
	DEALLOCATE Job_bom_step_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Oper_Spec_Ver]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_date datetime ,
   @ver_comments nvarchar(80) ,
   @preferred_ver bit ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
   @mod_id varchar(30) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  20024  HD# 4414 Maintain oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = @last_edit_at
ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @ver_date)
SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @ver_date )

  UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @ver_date, ver_comments = @ver_comments, preferred_ver = @preferred_ver, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
    WHERE (process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id)
  --Only one can be a preferred version
  IF @preferred_ver = 1
  BEGIN
    UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET preferred_ver = 0, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
      WHERE ver_id <> @ver_id AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
  END
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetItemStatusCode]
(@item_status_desc	STRING80
) RETURNS INT32 AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetItemStatusCode
-- Description       - Returns the ID of the item status code for the supplied item status description
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Author			 - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	@item_status_cd INT32

	--Return NULL if the supplied item status description is null.
	IF (@item_status_desc IS NULL) RETURN NULL

	--Query the item status code for the supplied item status description
	SELECT @item_status_cd = ist.item_status_cd

	WHERE ist.item_status_desc = @item_status_desc

	--Return the ID of the supplied item status.
	RETURN @item_status_cd
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@shift_id	int
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_SA_Shift_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description			- Get Available attributes for a shift
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 13 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM shift_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE shift_id = @shift_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal WITH (NOLOCK) ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 13 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM shift_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE shift_id = @shift_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

,@upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
,@segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@comments			NVARCHAR(254) = ' ' -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB
,@spare1			NVARCHAR(40) = ' '
,@spare2			NVARCHAR(40) = ' '
,@spare3			NVARCHAR(40) = ' '
,@spare4			NVARCHAR(40) = ' '
,@created_at_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@row_id			INT = NULL OUTPUT
,@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = NULL
) AS

DECLARE @cur_qty_cons 			FLOAT
	,	@grade_cd 				INT
	,	@status_cd 				INT
	,	@scrapped 				INT
	,	@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,	@expiry_date			DATETIME
	,	@update_inv				INT
	,	@def_item_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@def_reas_cd			INT
	,	@def_lot_no				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@def_fg_lot_no			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@def_sublot_no			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@def_fg_sublot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@def_storage_ent_id		INT
	-- This is now passed in,	@row_id 				INT
	,	@return					INT
	-- Added by Rohit
	,	@virtual_inv			BIT
	,	@bgood_prod          	BIT
	,	@must_consume_from_wip	BIT
	,	@inv_wo_id 				NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@inv_status_cd			INT
	,	@attr_value				NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@job_pos				INT
	,	@V_Qty_Inv_Cons			FLOAT
	,	@V_Count				FLOAT
	,	@prev_oper_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@cur_qty_left			FLOAT
	,	@last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@current_subst			INT
	,	@distinct_cons			NVARCHAR(1)
	,	@inv_row_id				INT
	,	@created_at_local		DATETIME
	--,	@use_gmt				INT
	,	@inv_oper_id            STRING80
	,	@inv_seq_no             INT32
	,	@shift_start_utc		DATETIME
	,	@tz_temp				INT
	,	@serial_no_lvl          INT
	,	@override_serialization  BIT
	,	@reqd_grade_cd			INT32
	,	@ent_tz_bias_value		INT32
	,	@dbg_resp				INT32
	,	@input_wo_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@input_oper_id			NVARCHAR(40)
	,	@input_seq_no			INT
	,	@cur_uom_id      		INT32
	,	@inv_unique_by_job		INT -- Added 05/20/2015 - CR:L00136813
	,	@log_transfer		INT32 = 0	-- L00143083
	,   @check_grade            LOGICAL -- CR L00143394
	,	@cur_qty_cons_erp			TFLOAT -- CR L00143393


SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- Init the values
	SELECT	@grade_cd = NULL, @status_cd = NULL, @scrapped = NULL, @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value, @last_edit_at =  dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())

	-- Determine whether a row identifying the consumption record is supplied
	IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the supplied row exist
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = @row_id) BEGIN
			-- A row identifying a consumption record is supplied.
			-- Read the shift start time, created at utc, etc. from the supplied row_id, and default to the values in the row if not supplied
			SELECT @wo_id = COALESCE(@wo_id, ic.wo_id), @oper_id = COALESCE(@oper_id, ic.oper_id), @seq_no = COALESCE(@seq_no, ic.seq_no)
				, @shift_start_utc = ic.shift_start_utc, @item_id = COALESCE(@item_id, ic.item_id)
				, @reas_cd = COALESCE(@reas_cd, ic.reas_cd)
				, @user_id = COALESCE(@user_id, ic.user_id)
				, @created_at_utc = ic.created_at_utc, @created_at_local = ic.created_at_local
			FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ic.row_id = @row_id

			-- Remove milli-seconds, if any
			SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@created_at_utc)
		END -- Since the row does not exist, default to the current time
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()), @shift_start_local = NULL, @shift_id = NULl
			SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		-- Row ID is not supplied to identify a unique consumption row
		-- Therefore, use the created_at_utc if supplied
		IF (@created_at_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			-- Created at UTC is supplied, strip the milli-seconds if any.
			SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@created_at_utc)
			SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL) BEGIN -- Shift start local is supplied
				-- Strip the milli-seconds if any.
				SET @shift_start_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@shift_start_local)

				-- Using the supplied shift start local, retrieve the UTC times
				SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

				-- Default the created times to be null
				SELECT @created_at_utc = NULL, @created_at_local = null
			END
			ELSE BEGIN -- Shift start local is not supplied either; therefore, default to the current date time and shift
				SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
				SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)
			END

		END
	END

	-- Get the shift information using the supplied shift time
	SELECT TOP 1 @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id = sh.shift_id
	FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id AND sh.shift_start_utc <= COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, @created_at_utc)
	ORDER BY sh.shift_start_utc DESC

	-- If a valid shift information cannot be obtained, defaulted to 1900 shift
	IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL) SELECT @shift_start_local = NULL, @shift_id = NULL
	SELECT @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, '1900-01-01'), @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, '1900-01-01'), @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

	-- Remove any milli-seconds in the shift
	SELECT @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@shift_start_utc), @shift_start_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@shift_start_local)

	SELECT @override_serialization = wo.override_serialization
	FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

	IF (@bom_pos IS NULL)
		--CHD : this check is required because when calling from DataEditor there will not be any BOM_POS
		-- Read default values from job_bom table to apply if not included ( include update_inv flag )
		SELECT @def_item_id = jb.item_id, @reqd_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd, @def_reas_cd = jb.def_reas_cd
			, @def_lot_no = jb.def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no = jb.def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id = jb.def_storage_ent_id
			, @update_inv = jb.update_inv, @bom_pos = jb.bom_pos, @virtual_inv = jb.must_consume_from_inv
			, @must_consume_from_wip = jb.must_consume_from_wip, @current_subst = jb.current_subst
			, @serial_no_lvl = i.serial_no_lvl
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no AND jb.item_id = @item_id
	ELSE
		-- Read default values from job_bom table to apply if not included ( include update_inv flag )
		SELECT @def_item_id = jb.item_id, @reqd_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd, @def_reas_cd = jb.def_reas_cd
			, @def_lot_no = jb.def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no = jb.def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id = jb.def_storage_ent_id
			, @update_inv = jb.update_inv, @virtual_inv = jb.must_consume_from_inv,	@must_consume_from_wip = jb.must_consume_from_wip
			, @current_subst = jb.current_subst, @serial_no_lvl = i.serial_no_lvl
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = @bom_pos

	IF (@current_subst IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst) BEGIN
			SELECT @def_item_id = jbs.item_id, @reqd_grade_cd = jbs.reqd_grade_cd, @def_reas_cd = jbs.def_reas_cd
				, @def_lot_no = jbs.def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no = jbs.def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id = jbs.def_storage_ent_id
				, @update_inv = jbs.update_inv,	@virtual_inv = jbs.must_consume_from_inv, @must_consume_from_wip = jbs.must_consume_from_wip
				, @serial_no_lvl = i.serial_no_lvl
			FROM job_bom_subst jbs WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbs.item_id = i.item_id
			WHERE jbs.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbs.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbs.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbs.bom_pos = @bom_pos AND jbs.alt_no = @current_subst
		END
	END

	IF ((@item_id IS NULL) OR (@item_id = '')) SET @item_id = @def_item_id
	IF (@reas_cd IS NULL) SET @reas_cd = @def_reas_cd
	IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) SET @from_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id
	IF (@lot_no IS NULL) SET @lot_no = @def_lot_no
	IF (@sublot_no IS NULL) SET @sublot_no = @def_sublot_no

	IF (@override_serialization = 1) SET @serial_no_lvl = -1

	IF ((@fg_lot_no IS NULL) OR (@fg_lot_no = '')) BEGIN
		--Read the FG lot_no from job_bom where bom_pos = 0
		SET @current_subst = NULL
		SELECT @def_fg_lot_no = def_lot_no, @current_subst = current_subst FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
		IF @current_subst IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0 AND alt_no = @current_subst) BEGIN
				SELECT @def_fg_lot_no = def_lot_no FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0 AND alt_no = @current_subst
			END
		END
		SET @fg_lot_no = @def_fg_lot_no
	END

	IF ((@fg_sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@fg_sublot_no = '')) BEGIN
		--Read the FG lot_no from job_bom where bom_pos = 0
		SET @current_subst = NULL
		SELECT @def_fg_sublot_no = def_sublot_no, @current_subst = current_subst FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
		IF @current_subst IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0 AND alt_no = @current_subst) BEGIN
				SELECT @def_fg_sublot_no = def_sublot_no FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0 AND alt_no = @current_subst
			END
		END
		SET @fg_sublot_no = @def_fg_sublot_no
	END

	IF @reas_cd IS NULL SELECT TOP 1 @reas_cd = def_cons_reas_cd FROM job_exec Where ent_id = @ent_id AND def_cons_reas_cd IS NOT NULL
	-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get scrapped flag
	SELECT 	@grade_cd = item_grade_cd,@status_cd = item_status_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd
	IF @grade_cd IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- reas_cd is defined, grade and status loaded - now get good_prod flag
		SELECT @scrapped = scrapped	FROM item_grade	WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @scrapped IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid scrapped flag{3299}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	--BEGIN CR L00143394
 	--Added by Raghu on 08/06/2003. Required grade_cd does not match with inventory; if update_inv flag is turned on
 	--Checks if update_inventory flag is set to true, and reqd_grade code is not null. If true, then checks the current reason which falls under waste category,
 	--If the current reason is waste reason, proceed as it is, if it is not a waste reason, then the grade code in inventory should match. So, set the grade_cd to reqd_grade_cd
 	IF (@update_inv = 1) AND (@reqd_grade_cd IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
 		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK), item_reas_grp irg WITH (NOLOCK)
 			WHERE ir.reas_grp_id = irg.reas_grp_id AND irg.reas_grp_type = 3 AND ir.reas_cd = @def_reas_cd) BEGIN
 				SET @check_grade = 1
 				SET @grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd
 		END
 	END
 	--END CR L00143394

	--If must_consume_from_wip is true; verify whether the current item has sufficient quantities in the inventory.
	--If qty consumption is greater than 0, then the quantity is being consumed; otherwise the intention is to put back the consumed quantity.
	IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND first_job != 1) BEGIN
			  	--Verify whether we can find sufficient quantities from the immediate upstream job that produced this item.
				SELECT @inv_oper_id = ii.oper_id, @inv_seq_no = ii.seq_no
				FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ii.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND ii.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
				WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
				  AND ii.item_id = @item_id
				  AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (ii.grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL)
				  AND (ii.qty_left >= @qty_cons)

				IF (@inv_oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
		END
        ELSE BEGIN
			--The intention is to put back the quantity.
			--Find the right consumption record that has sufficient quantities where it has consumed from.
			IF (@serial_no_lvl > -1)
					SELECT @from_ent_id = from_ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no
					FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
					  AND seq_no = @seq_no AND shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
					  AND item_id = @item_id AND reas_cd = @reas_cd
					  AND user_id = @user_id
					  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR @fg_lot_no IS NULL)
					  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR @fg_sublot_no IS NULL)
					  AND qty_cons >= ABS(@qty_cons)
        END
    END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--HD# 5474, Raghu - Maintain distinct consumption records
	SELECT @cur_qty_cons = NULL, @distinct_cons = '0'

	SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
	SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')

	IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_qty_cons = qty_cons, @cur_qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( shift_start_utc ) = @shift_start_utc
		  AND item_id = @item_id
		  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (fg_sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
		  AND (from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL)
		  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
		  AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
		  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
		  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
		  AND (row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
	END

	--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 233

	IF @cur_qty_cons IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Row DOES already exist
		IF (@cur_qty_cons + @qty_cons = 0 AND @cur_qty_cons_erp = 0) BEGIN
		-- DELETE THE ROW
			DELETE item_cons WHERE row_id = @row_id
			--Since we got the row_id, delete the record based on the row_id. Even if the select returns multiple records in that combination, it always updates/deletes only one row which is = row_id
			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Cons%'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			-- Row does exist - add the qty_consumed and update it
			-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/21/2009 RWB
			-- CR L00141920: Use correct variables for the comments and spare1 fields.
			UPDATE	item_cons SET qty_cons = @cur_qty_cons + @qty_cons
				,	comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END
				,	spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END
				,	spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END
				,	spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END
				,	spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
				,	last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			-- Return error if this was not successful
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('SQL Error updating item_cons table{3301}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
				SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@created_at_utc, GETUTCDATE()))
				SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)

				INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos
					, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id
					, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
				VALUES (@created_at_utc, @created_at_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'EditCons', @ent_id, @bom_pos
					, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id
					, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_cons, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		-- Row does NOT exist - insert a new one
--		IF ((@lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no = '')) SET @lot_no = @def_lot_no --ONLY FOR INSERT

		SELECT @bgood_prod = g.good_prod FROM item_reas r WITH (NOLOCK),item_grade g WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE r.item_grade_cd = g.item_grade_cd AND r.reas_cd = @reas_cd
		IF @update_inv = 1 AND @bgood_prod = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @inv_status_cd = status_cd FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND item_id = @item_id AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			SET @status_cd = ISNULL(@inv_status_cd,@status_cd)
		END

		SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@created_at_utc, GETUTCDATE()))
		SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)

		-- Now insert the new row
		-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/21/2009 RWB
		INSERT INTO item_cons (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no
			, reas_cd, user_id, item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, ext_ref
			, transaction_type, genealogy_id, upstream_event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id
			, comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local)
		VALUES (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local, @item_id, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no, @sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no
			, @reas_cd, @user_id, @scrapped, @ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @from_ent_id, @qty_cons, 0, @ext_ref
			, 0, @genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id
			, @comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc, @created_at_local)

	 	-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('SQL Error inserting into item_cons table{3302}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
		SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos
				, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity
				, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
			VALUES (@created_at_utc, @created_at_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'AddCons', @ent_id, @bom_pos
				, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_cons
				, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
		END
	END

	-- Update inventory consumed for this BOM item if the flag is true
	IF @update_inv = 1 BEGIN

	SELECT @inv_unique_by_job = inv_unique_by_job FROM item WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id

	-- HF1479 - If must consume from WIP and current quantity is negative, then retrieve
		-- the previous job key to update the inventory for that specific job record.
	SELECT @input_wo_id = NULL,  @input_oper_id = NULL, @input_seq_no = NULL

		if ((@must_consume_from_wip = 1) and (@qty_cons < 0))
			EXECUTE sp_S_Job_Route_PrevOper @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @input_wo_id OUTPUT, @input_oper_id OUTPUT, @input_seq_no OUTPUT
		else if (@inv_unique_by_job = 1)
			SELECT @input_wo_id = @wo_id, @input_oper_id = @oper_id, @input_seq_no = @seq_no

		--above line is commented by Nagaraju on 05-09-02 and below  lines added
--		IF @from_ent_id IS NULL SET @from_ent_id=@def_storage_ent_id
		IF NOT @from_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
			--When deviation is allowed above start qty check if the feeding job's produced qty is not lesser than produced here
			IF  @bom_pos = 0 BEGIN
				SET @V_Qty_Inv_Cons = @qty_cons
				SET @V_Count = NULL
				EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=0
					, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
					, @must_consume_from_inv=@virtual_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=@must_consume_from_wip, @checkgrade=@check_grade, @wo_id=@input_wo_id, @oper_id=@input_oper_id, @seq_no=@input_seq_no
					, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=NULL, @date_out_utc=@created_at_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@ent_tz_bias_value, @row_id=NULL

				IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			END
			ELSE BEGIN --bom_pos <> 0
				--SELECT @virtual_inv = must_consume_from_inv FROM job_bom WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and bom_pos = @bom_pos
				--print 'for item inv reduce the ent id =' + convert(varchar,@from_ent_id)
				--(HD# 2983) Added by Raghu on 04/24/2003. If qty_cons is reached to 0, then add to inventory 'sp_I_Item_Inv_Add'
				IF (@cur_qty_cons + @qty_cons <= 0)  BEGIN
					SET @qty_cons = ABS(@qty_cons)

					SELECT @cur_uom_id = uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id

					EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @grade_cd=@grade_cd, @status_cd=@status_cd, @add_qty=@qty_cons
						, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=@ent_tz_bias_value, @expiry_date=NULL, @wo_id=@input_wo_id, @oper_id=@input_oper_id, @seq_no=@input_seq_no
						, @from_ent_id=NULL, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL
						, @goods_received=NULL, @checkgradestatus=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @date_in_utc=@created_at_utc, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=NULL

				END
				ELSE BEGIN
				-- L00143083: Pass @log_transfer which defaults to false
				IF (@scrapped = 1) SET @log_transfer = 1
					EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=0
						, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@reas_cd
						, @must_consume_from_inv=@virtual_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=@check_grade, @wo_id=@input_wo_id, @oper_id=@input_oper_id, @seq_no=@input_seq_no
						, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=@log_transfer, @date_out_utc=@created_at_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@ent_tz_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
				END
				IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			END --bom_pos <> 0
		END	-- from_ent_id IS NOT NULL - Storage Location Exists
	END	-- update_inventory is True (=1)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Inv_MoveXML]
(@xml_source		NVARCHAR(MAX)
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_U_ITEM_INV_MOVEXML
-- Description          - Moves item(s) in a batch from one location to another location.
-- Author              - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 10/01/2007
-- Version              - 3.3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver        Changes
--12/12/2009		Ajay		  4.0.0		HF1423 change/Fix
--14/12/2011   praveen kumar p    4.0 sp2   Modified datatype of the variable move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job(CRL00115798)
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT  ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @doc_handle				INT32
	,@transfer_option			INT32
	,@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job	bit  --L00115798
	,@to_ent_id					INT32
	,@to_item_id				NVARCHAR(160)
	,@to_lot_no					NVARCHAR(160)
	,@to_sublot_no				NVARCHAR(160)
	,@to_grade_cd				INT32
	,@to_status_cd				INT32
	,@to_expiry_date			TDATETIME
	,@to_expiry_date_utc			TDATETIME
	,@to_uom_id					INT32
	,@to_wo_id					NVARCHAR(160)
	,@to_oper_id				NVARCHAR(160)
	,@to_seq_no					INT32
	,@from_row_id				INT32
	,@from_storage_ent_id		INT32
	,@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
	,@transfer_qty				TFLOAT
	,@transfer_qty_erp			TFLOAT
	,@transfer_comments			NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@to_expiry_date_tz			INT32

BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml, and read the target_process_id, target_oper_id and target_step_no
	SELECT @to_ent_id = CASE WHEN to_ent_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_ent_id END
		,@to_item_id = CASE WHEN to_item_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_item_id END
		,@to_lot_no = CASE WHEN to_lot_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_lot_no END
		,@to_sublot_no = CASE WHEN to_sublot_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_sublot_no END
		,@to_grade_cd = CASE WHEN to_grade_cd = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_grade_cd END
		,@to_status_cd = CASE WHEN to_status_cd = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_status_cd END
		,@to_uom_id = CASE WHEN to_uom_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_uom_id END
		,@to_expiry_date = CASE WHEN to_expiry_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, to_expiry_date, 120) END
		,@to_expiry_date_utc = CASE WHEN to_expiry_date_utc = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, to_expiry_date_utc, 120) END
		,@to_wo_id = CASE WHEN to_wo_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_wo_id END
		,@to_oper_id = CASE WHEN to_oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_oper_id END
		,@to_seq_no = CASE WHEN to_seq_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_seq_no END
		,@transfer_option = CASE WHEN transfer_option = '' THEN NULL ELSE transfer_option END
		,@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job = CASE WHEN move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job = '' THEN NULL ELSE move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (to_ent_id  NVARCHAR(160),
		to_item_id NVARCHAR(160),
		to_lot_no NVARCHAR(160),
		to_sublot_no NVARCHAR(160),
		to_grade_cd NVARCHAR(160),
		to_status_cd NVARCHAR(160),
		to_uom_id NVARCHAR(160),
		to_expiry_date NVARCHAR(160),
		to_expiry_date_utc NVARCHAR(160),
		to_wo_id NVARCHAR(160),
		to_oper_id NVARCHAR(160),
		to_seq_no NVARCHAR(160),
		transfer_option NVARCHAR(160),
		move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job NVARCHAR(160))

	--Loop through each source section and copy the step to a target process.
	DECLARE move_inv_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT CASE WHEN from_row_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE from_row_id END AS from_row_id
		,CASE WHEN storage_ent_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE storage_ent_id END AS storage_ent_id
		,CASE WHEN last_edit_at = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONVERT(DATETIME, last_edit_at, 120) END AS last_edit_at
		,CASE WHEN transfer_qty = '' THEN NULL ELSE transfer_qty END AS transfer_qty
		,CASE WHEN transfer_qty_erp = '' THEN NULL ELSE transfer_qty_erp END AS transfer_qty_erp
		,CASE WHEN transfer_comments = '' THEN NULL ELSE transfer_comments END AS transfer_comments
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/source', 2)
	WITH (from_row_id  NVARCHAR(160),
		storage_ent_id	NVARCHAR(160),
		last_edit_at	NVARCHAR(160),
		transfer_qty	NVARCHAR(160),
		transfer_qty_erp	NVARCHAR(160),
		transfer_comments	NVARCHAR(4000))

	OPEN move_inv_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM move_inv_cursor INTO @from_row_id, @from_storage_ent_id, @last_edit_at
			,@transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp, @transfer_comments
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF (@from_storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE storage_exec SET storage_ent_id = @to_ent_id
			WHERE ent_id = @from_storage_ent_id
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--EXEC sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset NULL, @to_expiry_date, @to_expiry_date_tz OUTPUT
			SET @to_expiry_date_tz = 0 --Added for CR L00118073 Pass a time zone offset of 0 thus not modifying the expiry date.  MES does not take into consideration the time portion of the expiry date.
			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Move @from_row_id=@from_row_id, @from_last_edit_at=@last_edit_at, @from_ent_id=@from_storage_ent_id, @transfer_qty=@transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp=@transfer_qty_erp
				, @in_to_ent_id=@to_ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@to_sublot_no, @in_to_grade_cd=@to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd=@to_status_cd
				, @in_to_uom_id=@to_uom_id, @in_to_expiry_date=@to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=@to_expiry_date_tz, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=@to_expiry_date_utc
				, @in_to_wo_id=@to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id=@to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no=@to_seq_no, @in_transfer_option=@transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job
				, @in_transfer_comments=@transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer=1, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
		END

	END -- End of While (1=1)
	CLOSE move_inv_cursor
	DEALLOCATE move_inv_cursor

	EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_Line_Speed]
(
@item_id nvarchar(50),
@ent_id int,
@line_Speed int,
@row_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.item_ent_speed where row_id = @row_id
		if @rowCount > 0 
		begin
			update sdb.SCH.item_ent_speed set item_id = @item_id , ent_id =  @ent_id , line_speed = @line_Speed where row_id = @row_id
			set @message = CONCAT('Successfully updated Line Speed with ID: ' , @item_id)
		end
		else
		begin
			set @message = CONCAT('Invalid or missing Line Speed ID: ' , @item_id)
		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to update Line Speed: ' , @item_id)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
END
