		@wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
		@seq_no AS INT = NULL,
		@ent_id AS INT = NULL
 
AS
BEGIN
	-- Only for Debugging
	-- SELECT @wo_id = '80000005' ,@oper_id = 'Milling', @seq_no = 0
 
	-- TBU Updated
	-- 0.09.00 Disabled
	--if (len(@wo_id) = 9 )
	--BEGIN
	--	SET @wo_id =CONCAT('8',@wo_id);
	--END
 
	-- 0.09.00 Added 0.10.00 Disabled
	--DECLARE @truncated_mesorder NVARCHAR(40),
	--		@prefix_id INT
 
	--SELECT @wo_id= mesorder,@truncated_mesorder=truncated_mesorder,@prefix_id=prefix_id FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid] (@wo_id,@oper_id)
	-- 0.10.00 Added
	DECLARE @output_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		@output_truncated_woid NVARCHAR(40),
		@output_operid NVARCHAR(100),
		@output_seqno INT,
		@result INT
 
	SELECT @output_woid=output_woid, @output_truncated_woid=output_truncated_woid,@output_operid=output_operid,@output_seqno=output_seqno FROM [ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid](@wo_id,@seq_no,@ent_id)

	SET @wo_id = ISNULL(@output_woid,@wo_id)

	DECLARE @defaultUoMDesc NVARCHAR(20) = 'KG'
			,@defaultUoMId INT
			,@IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0
			,@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0
			,@UserId NVARCHAR(100)
 
 
	DECLARE @id INT,
			@dest_type int,
			@storage_ent_id int,
			@ratio FLOAT,
			@silo_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
			@parent_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
			@jb_grade_cd INT,
			@silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100),
			@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT INT = 0 --v 0.06.00 added
 
	DECLARE @target_sched_ent_id INT,
					@minID INT =1
 
	SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job 
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
 
	-- BS v 0.06.00 added
	SELECT @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = attr_value FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'ShareCoProdSiloToAUT' and attr_grp=2) and ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id
 
	SET @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT  = ISNULL(@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT,0);
	-- BE v 0.06.00 added
	SET @UserId = SUSER_NAME();
 
	DECLARE @DestSilos TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
		dest_type int,
		storage_ent_id int,
		mes_ent_id int,
		parent_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		silo_item_id int,
		mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		ratio float,
		silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL, 
		bom_pos INT NULL
	)
 
	INSERT @DestSilos
	SELECT 
		dest_type,
		ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
		osu.su_ent_id as storage_ent_id, -- v0.11 Updated as CASE was not needed
		j.item_id,
		aut_item_id,
		case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,
		0.00 ratio,
		null,
		jb.bom_pos
	FROM 
	ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id and osu.oper_id = j.oper_id and osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
	INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.item_id = jb_item_id -- v 0.06.00 added
												AND jb.bom_pos IN (SELECT CASE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT WHEN 1 THEN bom_pos WHEN 0 THEN 0 END FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = j.wo_id AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND seq_no = j.seq_no AND item_id = jb_item_id AND bom_pos <= 0 ) -- v 0.06.00 added
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.su_ent_id = ea.ent_id -- v0.11 Updated as CASE was not needed
													   AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		 FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id IS NOT NULL then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
	WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id 
		AND osu.oper_id = @oper_id 
		AND osu.seq_no = @seq_no 
		AND osu.dest_type = 2 
		AND is_chk = 1
		AND (osu.latest_aut_silo = 0 OR osu.latest_aut_silo IS NULL)-- v0.11 UPDATED for dest_type = 2	AFTER RSU this will be valid
	ORDER by Jb.bom_pos DESC, silo_seq -- v0.06.00 Added

	SELECT @defaultUoMId = uom_id FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description = @defaultUoMDesc
 
	DECLARE @SourceSilos TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
		dest_type int,
		storage_ent_id int,
		mes_silo_id NVARCHAR(50),
		parent_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
		silo_item_id int,
		mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		ratio float,
		silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
		bom_pos INT  NULL
	)
 
	-- v.0.05.00 Begin 
	DECLARE @Jb_Corr_Details TABLE (
		[wo_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[oper_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[seq_no] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
		[bom_pos] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
		[item_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT] NOT NULL,
		[qty_reqd] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL] NULL,
		[reqd_grade_cd] [dbo].[INT32] NULL
	)
 
	-- Job Bom Correction Detail table will have data on job_start or bom_correction step
	IF (@oper_id = 'CakeBlending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no ))
	BEGIN
		declare @CurrentDosingStep INT = (SELECT MAX(dosing_step) FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK) 
										WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no )
 
		INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
		SELECT jbc.wo_id, jbc.oper_id, jbc.seq_no, jbc.bom_pos, jbc.item_id, jbc.qty_per_parent_item,jbc.qty_reqd,jb.reqd_grade_cd from job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id = jbc.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbc.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbc.seq_no AND jb.item_id = jbc.item_id
		WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbc.dosing_step =  @CurrentDosingStep
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item,qty_reqd,reqd_grade_cd from job_bom with (nolock)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no 
	END
 
	-- v.0.05.00 End
		--SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		--INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
		--								AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		--WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

	--	if @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
	--if not exists(select * from ofi_su_selection where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and dest_type=1 and su_ent_id=@st_ent_id)
		--begin
	INSERT @SourceSilos
	SELECT 
		dest_type,
		ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
		case 
			when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
			else osu.su_ent_id 
		end,
		j.item_id,
		aut_item_id,
		case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,
		--jb.qty_per_parent_item*(osu.ratio/100.0) ratio,
		CASE dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) 
			WHEN 1000.00 THEN 1 
			ELSE ISNULL(dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) ,1)
		END  ratio,
		NULL,
		NULL
	FROM 
	ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id and osu.oper_id = j.oper_id and osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
														AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
														AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
														AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id AND jb.reqd_grade_cd = jb_grade_cd
														AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	--LEFT OUTER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
	--													AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
	--													AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
	--													AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id
	--													AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item jbi WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = jbi.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON case 
															when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
															when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
															else osu.su_ent_id 
													   end = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2) -- Add attribute group =2 (entity)
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
	WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id and osu.oper_id = @oper_id and osu.seq_no = @seq_no and osu.dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1
	ORDER by created_at_utc
	--end
	print @oper_id
	-- Auto insert source silo
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @SourceSilos))
	BEGIN
		-- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
 
		
		print @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET	@minID = 1
 
			SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
 
			INSERT @SourceSilos
			SELECT TOP 1 1 dest_type,
					ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
					oea.storage_ent_id,
					j.item_id,
					aut_item_id,
					jb.item_id,
					1.0 ratio,
					oea.item_group,
					jb.bom_pos
			FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Source' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			--LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = iv.ent_id -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 --and jb.reqd_grade_cd=iv.grade_cd -- Get only for the consumable material
			--INNER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 -- Get only for the consumable material
			--OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			--INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no AND cj.state_cd = 4 -- only take inventory who job completed
			INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no  -- only take inventory who job completed
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																			FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																			WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(jb.item_id,1)
			--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Source', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oea.storage_ent_id,'source',iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id,null)
			WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND isNotValidEnt=0   
			--AND (iv.ent_id IS NOT NULL OR iv.qty_left > 0.00) -- Get only for filled silo => Disabled because handled by silo validity
			order by cj.act_finish_time_local,iv.date_in_local ASC
			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos
 
			DECLARE @Len INT 
			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceSilos
 
			UPDATE @SourceSilos SET ratio = ratio/@Len -- Update ratio
 
			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @id=ID,@dest_type=dest_type,@storage_ent_id=mes_silo_id,@parent_item_id=parent_item_id,@ratio=ratio,@silo_item_group =silo_item_group,
				@silo_item_id = mes_item_id
				FROM @SourceSilos WHERE ID = @minID
				print '@storage_ent_id'
				print @storage_ent_id
				SELECT @jb_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd from job_bom WITH (nolock)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and item_id = @silo_item_id
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
										(
										 [wo_id]									
										,[oper_id]							
										,[seq_no]					
										,[parent_item_id]
										,[ent_id]
										,[jb_item_id] 	
										,[jb_item_group] 
										,[jb_grade_cd] 								
										,[dest_type]							
										,[is_chk]
										,[su_ent_id]
										,[is_active]
										,[ratio]
										,[created_at_utc]
										,[created_at_local]
										,[created_by]
										,[last_edit_at_utc]
										,[last_edit_at_local]
										,[last_edit_by]
										,[active_su_ent_id]
										,[silo_seq]
										)
								VALUES
										(
										 @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@parent_item_id
										,@target_sched_ent_id
										,@silo_item_id
										,@silo_item_group
										,@jb_grade_cd
										,1
										,1
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										,@ratio*100.00
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										)
				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos WHERE id > @minID
			END
		END
	END
	--if @oper_id like '%Rework%'
	if exists (select 1 from oper_attr with(nolock) where oper_id=@oper_id and attr_id in(select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='def_source_su'))
	BEGIN
		declare @mes_ent_id int
		select @storage_ent_id= ea.attr_value,@mes_ent_id=ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea 
		inner join attr a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		inner join ent e on e.ent_id=ea.ent_id
		where e.ent_name in (select attr_value from oper_attr oa
		inner join attr a  on a.attr_id=oa.attr_id where
		attr_desc='def_source_su'
		and oper_id=@oper_id) and attr_desc='SUNumberInAUT'
		insert into @SourceSilos(dest_type,storage_ent_id,mes_silo_id,ratio)
		values(1,@storage_ent_id,@mes_ent_id,1)

	END
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos = 0
	UNION
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos < 0
	UNION 
	SELECT * FROM @SourceSilos where ratio > 0

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_GetWoRunOnLine]
(@in_line_id				INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Line_GetWoRunOnLine
-- Description      - Get the work orders that were run on a line during a period of time
-- Author           - KRF
-- Date Created     - 10/27/2014
-- Version          - 5.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 11/24/2014     Raghu            5.1    Removed the time zone parameter
-- 12/18/2014     KRF              5.1    Return the line name instead of its ID if there are no entities in it
--  1/08/2015     KRF              5.1    Allow for different items in a WO, converting quantities to the equivalents
--                                        for the item for the work order - task 434427 , user story 424210
-- 02/20/2015	  Raghu		   5.1	  UserStory: 448011 - [I-CR 135544]  Performance issue with Line Monitoring page
-- 01/19/2017	RaghuG		5.3	UserStory: 695693 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00142115: Significant performance issues have been observed when running PSR tests
-- 11/30/2017	Raghu G		6.0	UserStory-714529 - [Enhancement] As SE, I want to fix CR L00138956 so that OEE values are returned for short time periods without distinct production records
-- 10/26/2018	Varun		6.0	UserStory: 1022902 - As Joe, I want the Entity Monitor and Line Monitor pages in the
--					 Web Portal (2014 R3) to include a reporting period for current week and
--					 last week so that I can see more data
-- 07/15/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1339726-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00153667 so that the MES Web Portal Line Monitor page performs well with many items, inventory records, and storage entities
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @err_msg             NVARCHAR(4000)
	   ,@event_start_time    TDATETIME -- UTC time
	   ,@event_end_time	     TDATETIME -- UTC time
	   ,@attr_value			 STRING80
	   ,@line_parent_ent_id  INT
	   ,@prod_pos            INT
	   ,@max_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
   	   ,@max_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@min_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	   ,@min_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@cur_shift_start_utc TDATETIME
	   ,@cur_shift_end_utc   TDATETIME
	   ,@num_recs            INT
	   ,@root_ent_id         INT
	   ,@site_ent_id         INT
	   ,@current_time_utc    TDATETIME
	   ,@line_name           NVARCHAR(80)
	   ,@min_factor          TFLOAT

	   ,@distinct_good_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	   ,@distinct_reject_prod	NVARCHAR(1)
	   ,@prod_start_time_utc	TDATETIME2

DECLARE @ents_in_line        TABLE (ent_id INT NOT NULL, child_order INT PRIMARY KEY (ent_id))
DECLARE @wo_list TABLE (wo_id NVARCHAR(80) PRIMARY KEY, wo_status_cd INT, wo_uom_id INT)

BEGIN
	-- Check for bad input arguments
	IF (@in_line_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},LINE_ID'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	-- Last N hours is limited to no more than 168
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 0 AND @in_filter_end_time = 0 AND (@in_filter_start_time > 168 OR @in_filter_start_time < 1)) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_START_TIME,1,168'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@in_filter_time_unit < 0 OR @in_filter_time_unit > 5) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = N'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},FILTER_TIME_UNIT,0,5'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
    IF (@in_filter_start_time IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 may not be empty{5413},FILTER_START_TIME'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
    ELSE IF (@in_filter_start_time < COALESCE(@in_filter_end_time, 0)) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'%1 must be greater than %2.{2030},FILTER_START_TIME,FILTER_END_TIME'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    END

	SELECT @num_recs = COUNT(*) FROM line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
	IF (@num_recs = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The specified line does not exist{7929}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    	END

	INSERT INTO @ents_in_line (ent_id, child_order)
	SELECT ent_id, child_order
	from line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 0

	SELECT @num_recs = COUNT(*) FROM @ents_in_line
	IF (@num_recs = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_name = line_name FROM line WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
		SET @err_msg = N'There are no entities in the supplied line: %1.{7890},' + @line_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
    	END

	-- Check that if querying about a shift and the line has no parent entity with a shift schedule that all the line's members have the same
	-- shift schedule, for either the current shift or the previous shift, whichever is being queried for
	IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @line_parent_ent_id = ent_id FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id AND line_is_child = 1
		IF @line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL
			SELECT @cur_shift_start_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc,
			       @cur_shift_end_utc = cur_shift_end_time_utc FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id
		-- If current shift ended before now, parent entity used to have a shift schedule but doesn't anymore
		IF @cur_shift_start_utc IS NULL OR @cur_shift_end_utc <= GETUTCDATE() BEGIN
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1 -- Current shift
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc),
				@min_shift_start_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_start_time_utc),
				@max_shift_end_utc = MAX(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc),
				@min_shift_end_utc = MIN(e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
				FROM @ents_in_line eil
				JOIN ent e  WITH (NOLOCK) ON eil.ent_id = e.ent_id
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_start_utc),
				@min_shift_start_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_start_utc),
				@max_shift_end_utc = MAX(sh_prev.shift_end_utc),
				@min_shift_end_utc = MIN(sh_prev.shift_end_utc)
				FROM @ents_in_line eil
				JOIN ent e  WITH (NOLOCK) ON eil.ent_id = e.ent_id
				JOIN shift_history sh_prev WITH (NOLOCK)  ON e.ent_id = sh_prev.ent_id AND dateadd(ss,-1,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc) = sh_prev.shift_end_utc
			IF (@max_shift_start_utc<>@min_shift_start_utc OR @max_shift_end_utc<>@min_shift_end_utc) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Entities in line have differing shift schedules - querying by shift is not possible.{2031}'
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN -- There is a parent entity for the line with a legitimate shift schedule
			IF @in_filter_start_time = 1
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = @cur_shift_start_utc,	@max_shift_end_utc = @cur_shift_end_utc
			ELSE
				SELECT @max_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @max_shift_end_utc = shift_end_utc
				FROM shift_history  WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id AND dateadd(ss,-1,@cur_shift_start_utc) = shift_end_utc
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Filter using time periods, and NOT by using shift.
		SELECT @current_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 0) -- Hour
			SELECT @event_start_time = DATEADD(hh, -@in_filter_start_time, @current_time_utc)
				,@event_end_time = DATEADD(hh, -@in_filter_end_time, @current_time_utc)
		ELSE BEGIN
			-- Boundaries will be determined starting with local times, so we must get the site entity if one exists
			IF (@line_parent_ent_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT @root_ent_id = @line_parent_ent_id
			ELSE SELECT @root_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE line_id = @in_line_id
			SELECT @site_ent_id = site FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent.ent_id = @root_ent_id
			IF @site_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
				;WITH ParentEnts(parent_id, child_id) AS
				(
					SELECT parent_ent_id, child_ent_id
					FROM ent_link  WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE child_ent_id = @root_ent_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT el.parent_ent_id, el.child_ent_id
					FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
					JOIN ParentEnts pe
					ON el.child_ent_id = pe.parent_id
				)
				select @site_ent_id = MAX(parent_id) FROM  ParentEnts pe JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK)  ON pe.parent_id = e.ent_id WHERE e.site = e.ent_id
			END
			IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 2) -- Day
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(dd, -@in_filter_start_time+1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(dd, -@in_filter_end_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 3) -- Week
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(wk, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1-DATEPART(dw, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))), 120) + ' 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(D, 6, DATEADD(wk, -@in_filter_end_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)+1-DATEPART(dw, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)))), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 4) -- Month
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(7), DATEADD(mm, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(d, -1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(7), DATEADD(mm, -@in_filter_end_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01 00:00:00', 120)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
			ELSE IF (@in_filter_time_unit = 5) -- Year
				SELECT @event_start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEADD(yy, -@in_filter_start_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01-01 00:00:00', 120), @current_time_utc)
					,@event_end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@site_ent_id, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(d, -1, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), DATEADD(yy, -@in_filter_end_time + 1, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)), 120) + '-01-01 00:00:00', 120)), 120) + ' 23:59:59', 120), @current_time_utc)
		END
		--IF (@event_end_time > @current_time_utc) SET @event_end_time = @current_time_utc
	END

	-- Figure out how to display items
    SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 210
	IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '0'

	--Get the distinct good production flag
	SELECT @distinct_good_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 362

	--Get the distinct reject production flag
	SELECT @distinct_reject_prod = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 309

	--The time filter is hour (i.e. filter time unit is 0)
	--If the distinct good production and distinct reject projection are not true, reset the starting time to the top of the hour
	--since the production quantities are rolled up to the top of the hour.
	IF @in_filter_time_unit = 0 AND NOT (@distinct_good_prod = '1' AND @distinct_reject_prod = '1')
		SET @prod_start_time_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_start_time),0)

	--Default to the calculated start time if production start time cannot be identified from above
	SET @event_start_time = COALESCE(@prod_start_time_utc, @event_start_time)

	-- Return work order ID, the item ID, this item's description, the item display per system attribute 210,
	-- the name of the "native" UOM of this item, the abbreviation of the "native" UOM of this item ,
	-- the number of decimal places for the item, the starting quantity, the required quantity,
	-- the remaining quantity (which is the difference between the starting quantity and the total production, good and rejected),
	-- the good quantity produced during the selected period, the total good quantity produced for this work order,
	-- the rejected quantity produced during the selected period, the total rejected quantity produced for this work order,
	-- the work order's current status code, the work order's current status code name,  and the work order's current status color.

	-- Get production entities for the sake of returning production numbers
	-- Get production entities and those upstream from them for the sake of returning reject numbers
	SELECT @prod_pos = lel.child_order
	FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line l WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.line_id = l.line_id AND lel.ent_id = l.prod_ent_id
	WHERE l.line_id = @in_line_id
	  AND lel.line_is_child = 0

	IF (@prod_pos IS NULL)
		SELECT @prod_pos = MAX(lel.child_order) FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @in_line_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0

	-- Following added 1/8/15 to make sure there are no production records using an item that can't be converted to the corresponding WO item

	SELECT @min_factor = MIN(COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0))
	FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.item_id = i.item_id
	INNER JOIN item wu WITH (NOLOCK)  ON wu.item_id = wo.item_id
	INNER JOIN @ents_in_line lel ON iprod.ent_id = lel.ent_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wu.uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = iprod.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wu.uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	WHERE i.uom_id <> wu.uom_id -- To cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
	  --AND ip.created_at_utc < COALESCE(@event_end_time, @max_shift_end_utc)
	  --AND ip.created_at_utc >= COALESCE(@event_start_time, @max_shift_start_utc)
	  AND iprod.byproduct = 0
	  AND wo.target_sched_line_id = @in_line_id

	IF @min_factor = 0  BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'There is production using a UOM for which there is no conversion to that of the item for the corresponding work order, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{2145}'
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	-- End 1/8/15 addition

	INSERT INTO @wo_list (wo_id, wo_status_cd, wo_uom_id)
	SELECT wo.wo_id, dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(wo.wo_id) AS status_cd, i.uom_id
	FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT iprod.wo_id
		 FROM item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK)
		 INNER JOIN @ents_in_line lel  ON iprod.ent_id = lel.ent_id
		 WHERE iprod.created_at_utc < COALESCE(@event_end_time, @max_shift_end_utc)
		  AND iprod.created_at_utc >= COALESCE(@event_start_time, @max_shift_start_utc)
		  AND iprod.byproduct = 0
		  AND lel.child_order <= @prod_pos) prod_wo
	  INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON prod_wo.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	  INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = i.item_id
	  WHERE wo.target_sched_line_id = @in_line_id

	;WITH prod (wo_id, period_qty_prod_good, period_qty_prod_rejected, total_qty_prod_good, total_qty_prod_rejected) AS
	(
		SELECT wo.wo_id
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN iprod.good_prod = 1 AND lel.child_order = @prod_pos
								AND iprod.created_at_utc < COALESCE(@event_end_time, @max_shift_end_utc) AND iprod.created_at_utc >= COALESCE(@event_start_time, @max_shift_start_utc)
				THEN iprod.qty_prod
					* COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0)
					AS period_qty_prod_good
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN iprod.good_prod = 0 AND lel.child_order <= @prod_pos
								AND iprod.created_at_utc < COALESCE(@event_end_time, @max_shift_end_utc) AND iprod.created_at_utc >= COALESCE(@event_start_time, @max_shift_start_utc)
				THEN iprod.qty_prod
					* COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0)
					AS period_qty_prod_rejected
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN iprod.good_prod = 1 AND lel.child_order = @prod_pos THEN iprod.qty_prod
					* COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0)
					AS total_qty_prod_good
			, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN iprod.good_prod = 0 AND lel.child_order <= @prod_pos THEN iprod.qty_prod
					* COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1) + COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0)
					AS total_qty_prod_rejected
		FROM @wo_list wo
		INNER JOIN item_prod iprod WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.wo_id = wo.wo_id
		INNER JOIN @ents_in_line lel ON iprod.ent_id = lel.ent_id
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON iprod.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_specific.item_id = iprod.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE lel.child_order <= @prod_pos
		  AND iprod.byproduct = 0
		GROUP BY wo.wo_id
	)
	, first_jobs_qty  AS (
		SELECT first_job.wo_id, SUM(first_job.qty_at_start * COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1)
				+ COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)) AS qty_at_start
		FROM job first_job WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON first_job.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN @wo_list wo ON wo.wo_id = first_job.wo_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id  AND uc_specific.item_id = first_job.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = wo.wo_uom_id AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE first_job.first_job = 1
		GROUP BY first_job.wo_id
	)
	SELECT wo.wo_id AS wo_id,
           wo.item_id AS item_id,
	       item.item_desc AS item_desc,
	       CASE
	           WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
	           WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
	           WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
	           WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
	       END AS item_display,
	       uom.description AS uom_description,
	       uom.abbreviation AS uom_abbreviation,
	       item.num_decimals as num_decimals,
	       fjq.qty_at_start AS starting_quantity,
	       wo.req_qty AS required_quantity,
		CASE
	           WHEN fjq.qty_at_start - (COALESCE(p.total_qty_prod_good, 0) + COALESCE(p.total_qty_prod_rejected, 0)) > 0 THEN fjq.qty_at_start - (COALESCE(p.total_qty_prod_good, 0) + COALESCE(p.total_qty_prod_rejected, 0))
			   ELSE 0
           END AS remaining_quantity,
		   COALESCE(p.period_qty_prod_good, 0) AS period_produced,
	       COALESCE(p.total_qty_prod_good, 0) AS total_produced,
	       COALESCE(p.period_qty_prod_rejected, 0) AS period_rejected,
	       COALESCE(p.total_qty_prod_rejected, 0) AS total_rejected,
	       ws.wo_status_cd as wo_status,
	       js.state_desc AS wo_status_desc,
	       js.color AS wo_status_color
	FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN @wo_list ws ON wo.wo_id = ws.wo_id
	JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.item_id = wo.item_id
	JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON uom.uom_id = item.uom_id
	INNER JOIN first_jobs_qty fjq ON fjq.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	INNER JOIN prod p ON p.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	JOIN job_state js WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.state_cd = ws.wo_status_cd
	ORDER BY wo.wo_id

END

CREATE Trigger [dbo].[tg_sample_char_link_to_go_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[sample_char_link_to_go]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_sample_char_link_to_go_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on sample table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -  4.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE sample_char_link_to_go SET sample_char_link_to_go.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, sample_char_link_to_go.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE sample_char_link_to_go.sample_id = i.sample_id AND sample_char_link_to_go.char_id = i.char_id
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        sp_sa_ofi_cb_item_cons
-- Description:	fetch the all cunsmption fo specific WO, Oper and Seq
-- exec sp_sa_ofi_cb_item_cons '1001019194','cakeblending',5
-- Usage:       to show all the consumption in BOM Consume tab
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author                  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)       Change description
-- 0.01.00      AKM							2024-01-31              Initial version.
-- 0.02.00		BI						2025-10-17				Check if correction step is equal to 0
-- 0.02.01		JSC						2026-01-26				Changed the CB_Batch weight
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_cb_item_cons] 
@wo_id nvarchar(40),
@oper_id nvarchar(40),
@seq_no INT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @Qty_reqd float, @curr_correction_step float, @base_dose_param float, @correction_step float

select @base_dose_param = act_spec_value from job_spec(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and spec_id='CB_Dosing weight'
select @correction_step= act_spec_value from job_spec(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and spec_id='CB_Number of corrections'


if exists(select 1
			 from ofi_cb_approved_correction(nolock)
			 where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no)
	BEGIN

		select @curr_correction_step = max(correction_step) 
			 from ofi_cb_approved_correction(nolock)
			 where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no
					
			-- V 0.02.00 		
			 IF @correction_step = 0 
					set @correction_step = 1

			 set @Qty_reqd =(select  (@base_dose_param + (@curr_correction_step *(qty_reqd - qty_prod)/@correction_step)) from job(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		select	@Qty_reqd = @base_dose_param
	END


;with CTE AS(

SELECT jb.item_id                                                     AS item_id,
       i.item_desc                                                    AS item_desc,
       Isnull(ic.qty_cons, 0)                                         AS qty_cons,
       --Cast(Round(( jb.qty_per_parent_item * @Qty_reqd ), 0) AS INT)  AS qty_reqd,
	   Max(ISNULL(jb.qty_reqd,0)) AS qty_reqd,
       u.abbreviation                                                 AS uom,
       e.ent_name                                                     AS storage_location,
       case when ISNULL(@curr_correction_step,0) = 0 then 'Base' 
	   when ISNULL(@curr_correction_step,0) = 1 then '1' 
	   when ISNULL(@curr_correction_step,0) = 2 then '2' end		  AS dosing_stage,
	   ia.attr_value												  AS material_type,
	    ROUND(( jb.qty_per_parent_item * 100 ),2)                     AS qty_percent
FROM   job_bom jb WITH (nolock)
       INNER JOIN job j WITH (nolock)
               ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id
                  AND j.oper_id = jb.oper_id
                  AND j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
                  AND jb.wo_id = @wo_id
                  AND jb.oper_id = @oper_id
                  AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
                  AND jb.bom_pos > 0
       INNER JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
               ON i.item_id = jb.item_id
       INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
               ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
	   INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (nolock)
               ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
       INNER JOIN attr a with (nolock)
               ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
                  AND a.attr_desc = 'MaterialType'
                  AND a.attr_grp = 1 
       LEFT JOIN item_cons ic WITH (nolock)
              ON ic.wo_id = jb.wo_id
                 AND ic.oper_id = jb.oper_id
                 AND ic.seq_no = jb.seq_no
                 AND ic.item_id = jb.item_id
       INNER JOIN ent e WITH (nolock)
               ON e.ent_id = ic.from_ent_id
GROUP  BY jb.item_id,
          i.item_desc,
          u.abbreviation,
          jb.qty_per_parent_item,
          j.qty_reqd,
          ic.qty_cons,
          e.ent_name,
		  ia.attr_value
	)

	 select cte.item_id,
		  cte.item_desc,
		  sum(qty_cons) as qty_cons,
		  qty_reqd,
		  uom,
		  storage_location,

		  material_type,
		  qty_percent,
		  i.num_decimals
		  
		  from CTE
		  inner join item(nolock) i on i.item_id=cte.item_id
		  group by cte.item_id,cte.item_desc,qty_reqd,uom,storage_location,dosing_stage,material_type,qty_percent,i.num_decimals
		  


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_item_inv_getdestinvlocs]
(
	@ent_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id           STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL

)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_ITEM_INV_GETSRCINVLOCS
-- Description          - Returns a list of available storage location (source location)
-- Author          -       Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/06/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @tree_level			INT32
		,	@se_parent_ent_id	INT32
		,	@se_ent_id			INT32
		,	@se_child_level		INT32

	SET @tree_level = 0

	DECLARE @sched_entities TABLE (
		id int identity,
		parent_ent_id int,
		ent_id int,
		child_level int
	)

    --Verify if any entity is supplied to restrict upto a certain storage location.
    IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

        --Insert the supplied entity to the temp table.
        INSERT INTO @sched_entities( parent_ent_id, ent_id, child_level )
        VALUES( @ent_id, @ent_id, @tree_level)

        --Loop through all the storage exec entities that are located at this location.
        WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @sched_entities ( parent_ent_id, ent_id, child_level )
            SELECT t.ent_id, s.ent_id, @tree_level + 1
            FROM @sched_entities t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec s ON t.ent_id = s.storage_ent_id
            WHERE ( t.child_level = @tree_level ) AND ( s.storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL )

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BEGIN
                BREAK
    	    END

            SET @tree_level = ( @tree_level + 1 )
        END

    END

    IF ( (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@oper_id IS NOT NULL) ) BEGIN

        INSERT INTO @sched_entities ( parent_ent_id, ent_id, child_level )
        SELECT COALESCE( j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id ), COALESCE( j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id ), @tree_level
        FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id

        --Loop through all the storage exec entities that are located at this location.
        WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @sched_entities (parent_ent_id, ent_id, child_level)
            SELECT t.ent_id, s.ent_id, @tree_level + 1
            FROM @sched_entities t
				INNER JOIN storage_exec s ON t.ent_id = s.storage_ent_id
            WHERE t.child_level = @tree_level AND s.storage_ent_id IS NOT NULL

            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BEGIN
                BREAK
    	    END

            SET @tree_level = @tree_level + 1
        END

    END

    --Since there is no filter for entity, return all entities.
    SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id, e.ent_name
    FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.ent_id = e.ent_id
		INNER JOIN @sched_entities storage_ents ON ii.ent_id = storage_ents.ent_id
    ORDER BY e.ent_name

END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_process_link_aft_ins] ON [dbo].[item_process_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_item_process_link_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- (HD# 4973). Do not allow item_process_link.status to exceed that of the process
-- Author	 	-- SJ
-- Date Created      	-- 10/29/2004
-- Version (last edit)  -- 2.1.0.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 10/29/2004     SJ            2106    HD#4973 Do not allow item_process_link.status to exceed that of the process
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
  --Check if the new status is greater than the allowed process status
  IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM inserted ipl INNER JOIN process p ON ipl.process_id = p.process_id
               WHERE ipl.status > p.process_status)
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Status of the item attached to a process cannot be greater than the process status.{4249}', 16, 1)
    RETURN
  END
END

CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_EI_sampleplan] (
	@samplePlanType INT -- 0. LabVantage Product Variant (material and process based sample plan) --1. LabVantage Sample Point Schedule Plans (time and location based sample plan)
	,@xml_data_in NVARCHAR(max)
	)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	-- SET XACT_ABORT ON will cause the transaction to be uncommittable  
	-- when the constraint violation occurs.   
	SET XACT_ABORT ON;
 
	--// The parameter @samplePlanTypeLocationId can be either: "LIMS_MES_Sample_Plan_materialAndprocess_IN" or "LIMS_MES_Sample_Plan_timeAndlocation_IN".
	--// This parameter value differentiate whether the Sample Plan is:-
	--0. LabVantage Product Variant (material and process based sample plan) or 
	--1. LabVantage Sample Point Schedule Plans (time and location based sample plan)
	IF (@samplePlanType = 1)
	BEGIN --	time and location based sample plan
		EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_sampleplan_timeAndlocation @xml_data_in;
 
		RETURN;
	END;
 
	-- xml sample as shown below
	/*
<ArrayOfMESInternalSamplePlanData
	xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
	xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
 
 
	<MESInternalSamplePlan01Data>
<SamplePlanID>GNLNL0043</SamplePlanID>
<ProductID>10022554</ProductID>
<Customer>1011325</Customer>
<Level>Full</Level>
<Stage>PhysChem</Stage>
<Count>1</Count>
<SourceLabel>TIME_8_H</SourceLabel>
<TestMethod>Color Tests</TestMethod>
<ParameterListID>Color</ParameterListID>
<Variant>Lovibond</Variant>
<Parameter>Red value</Parameter>
<DataType>Numeric</DataType>
<LowerLimit>206</LowerLimit>
<UpperLimit>222</UpperLimit>
<TargetValue>214</TargetValue>
<Units/>
<MESWait>1</MESWait>
</MESInternalSamplePlan01Data>
 
	<MESInternalSamplePlan01Data>
<SamplePlanID>GNLNL0043</SamplePlanID>
<ProductID>10022554</ProductID>
<Customer>1011325</Customer>
<Level>Full</Level>
<Stage>PhysChem</Stage>
<Count>1</Count>
<SourceLabel>TIME_8_H</SourceLabel>
<TestMethod>Color Tests</TestMethod>
<ParameterListID>Color</ParameterListID>
<Variant>Lovibond</Variant>
<Parameter>Yellow value</Parameter>
<DataType>Numeric</DataType>
<LowerLimit>26</LowerLimit>
<UpperLimit>22</UpperLimit>
<TargetValue>24</TargetValue>
<Units/>
<MESWait>0</MESWait>
</MESInternalSamplePlan01Data>
 
	<MESInternalSamplePlan01Data>
<SamplePlanID>GNLNL0043</SamplePlanID>
<ProductID>10022554</ProductID>
<Customer>1011325</Customer>
<Level>Full</Level>
<Stage>PhysChem</Stage>
<Count>1</Count>
<SourceLabel>TIME_8_H</SourceLabel>
<TestMethod>Color Tests</TestMethod>
<ParameterListID>Color</ParameterListID>
<Variant>Lovibond</Variant>
<Parameter>Blue value</Parameter>
<DataType>Numeric</DataType>
<LowerLimit>326</LowerLimit>
<UpperLimit>322</UpperLimit>
<TargetValue>324</TargetValue>
<Units/>
<MESWait>0</MESWait>
</MESInternalSamplePlan01Data>
	*/
	-- ' (apostrophe or single quote) REPLACE WITH ' 
	SET @xml_data_in = REPLACE(@xml_data_in, '''', ''');
 
	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(254) = '';
	DECLARE @msg_output NVARCHAR(500) = '';
	DECLARE @enabled_freq LOGICAL = 1;
	DECLARE @ent_id INT = NULL;
	DECLARE @mes_plan_id INT;
	DECLARE @freq_id INT32;
	DECLARE @char_id INT32;
	DECLARE @cur_sys_local_time DATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @converted_data_xml XML = CONVERT(XML, @xml_data_in);
	DECLARE @i_min INT;
	DECLARE @i_max INT;
	DECLARE @i_first_row INT;	-- v00.02
	DECLARE @SamplePlanID NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @ProductID NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Customer NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Level NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @Stage NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @Count int;
	DECLARE @counter int = 1 ;
	DECLARE @SourceLabel NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @TestMethod NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @ParameterListID NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Variant NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Parameter NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @DataType NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @LowerLimit NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @UpperLimit NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @TargetValue NVARCHAR(80);
	DECLARE @Units NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @MESWait NVARCHAR(1);
	DECLARE @tbl_SamplePlanData TABLE (
		row_id INT IDENTITY(1, 1)
		,SamplePlanID NVARCHAR(40)
		,ProductID NVARCHAR(40)
		,Customer NVARCHAR(40)
		,LEVEL NVARCHAR(20)
		,Stage NVARCHAR(20)
		,SampleCount nvarchar(2)
		,SourceLabel NVARCHAR(80)
		,TestMethod NVARCHAR(40)
		,ParameterListID NVARCHAR(40)
		,Variant NVARCHAR(40)
		,Parameter NVARCHAR(40)
		,DataType NVARCHAR(20)
		,LowerLimit NVARCHAR(80)
		,UpperLimit NVARCHAR(80)
		,TargetValue NVARCHAR(80)
		,Units NVARCHAR(40)
		,MESWait NVARCHAR(1)
		,FirstRowSamplePlan INT -- ADDED v1.00
		);
 
	INSERT INTO @tbl_SamplePlanData (
		SamplePlanID
		,ProductID
		,Customer
		,LEVEL
		,Stage
		,SampleCount
		,SourceLabel
		,TestMethod
		,ParameterListID
		,Variant
		,Parameter
		,DataType
		,LowerLimit
		,UpperLimit
		,TargetValue
		,Units
		,MESWait
		,FirstRowSamplePlan -- ADDED v1.00
		)
	SELECT C.value('SamplePlanID[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS SamplePlanID
		,C.value('ProductID[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS ProductID
		,C.value('Customer[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Customer
		,C.value('Level[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS LEVEL
		,C.value('Stage[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS Stage
		,C.value('Count[1]', 'nvarchar(2)') AS SampleCount
		,C.value('SourceLabel[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS SourceLabel
		,C.value('TestMethod[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS TestMethod
		,C.value('ParameterListID[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS ParameterListID
		,C.value('Variant[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Variant
		,C.value('Parameter[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Parameter
		,C.value('DataType[1]', 'nvarchar(20)') AS DataType
		,C.value('LowerLimit[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS LowerLimit
		,C.value('UpperLimit[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS UpperLimit
		,C.value('TargetValue[1]', 'nvarchar(80)') AS TargetValue
		,C.value('Units[1]', 'nvarchar(40)') AS Units
		,C.value('MESWait[1]', 'nvarchar(1)') AS MESWait
		,0 AS FirstRowSamplePlan -- ADDED v1.00
	FROM @converted_data_xml.nodes('/ArrayOfMESInternalSamplePlan01Data/MESInternalSamplePlan01Data') AS T(C);
 
	-- v1.00 Added
	-- Step 1: Use a CTE to calculate row numbers
	WITH RankedRows AS (
		SELECT *,
			   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.SamplePlanID,sp.ProductID,sp.Customer,sp.LEVEL,sp.Stage,sp.SourceLabel,sp.SampleCount ORDER BY sp.SamplePlanID,sp.ProductID,sp.Customer,sp.LEVEL,sp.Stage,sp.SourceLabel,sp.SampleCount) AS RowNum
		FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData sp
	)
	-- Step 2: Update the original table variable
	UPDATE t
	SET t.FirstRowSamplePlan = 1
	FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData t
		INNER JOIN RankedRows r ON
			t.row_id = r.row_id
	WHERE r.RowNum = 1;


	SELECT @i_min = MIN(row_id)
		,@i_max = MAX(row_id)
		--,@i_first_row = MIN(row_id) -- v1.00 REMOVED	-- v00.02
	FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData;
 
	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION;
 
		WHILE (@i_min <= @i_max)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SamplePlanID = SamplePlanID
				,@ProductID = ProductID
				,@Customer = Customer
				,@Level = LEVEL
				,@Stage = Stage
				,@Count = Convert(int, SampleCount)
				,@SourceLabel = UPPER(SourceLabel)
				,@TestMethod = TestMethod
				,@ParameterListID = ParameterListID
				,@Variant = Variant
				,@Parameter = Parameter
				,@DataType = DataType
				,@LowerLimit = LowerLimit
				,@UpperLimit = UpperLimit
				,@TargetValue = TargetValue
				,@Units = Units
				,@MESWait = MESWait
				,@i_first_row = FirstRowSamplePlan -- v1.00 ADDED
			FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData
			WHERE row_id = @i_min;
 
			SET @DataType = ISNULL(@DataType, 'Numeric');-- default data type in case if not provided.
 
			IF (@DataType = '')
				SET @DataType = 'Numeric';
 
			-- if the given product not exist in MESDB, throw an error
			IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE item_id = @ProductID
					)
			BEGIN				
				-- string_id 500001 = 'The given item not exist in MES DB.  Item id: '
				SELECT  @msg = CONCAT (dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500001, NULL, NULL), @ProductID) ;
 
				SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';
 
				RAISERROR (
						@msg
						,16
						,1
						);
 
				Return -1 ;
			END;
 
			-- v1.00 MOD
			IF (@i_first_row = 1) BEGIN
				-- v1.00 MOD 
				-- check whether the given sample plan is already exist or not; if yes, just disable its qm ti avoid further trigger
				EXEC sp_U_ofi_EI_disablesampleplan 
						@SamplePlanID = @SamplePlanID
						,@ProductID = @ProductID
						,@Level = @Level
						,@Stage = @Stage
						,@Customer = @Customer
						,@SourceLabel = @SourceLabel
						,@LocationLabel = NULL -- SET To NULL as it is not part of this set
						,@Count = @Count
						,@samplePlanType = @samplePlanType;
						
			END ;
			
 
			-- 01. create characteristic
			-- 02. create sample frequency
			-- 03. create sample plan
			-- 04. create qm-spec
			-- 01. create characteristic
			EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_samplechar @Parameter
				,@TestMethod
				,@Variant
				,@DataType
				,@Units
				,@LowerLimit
				,@UpperLimit
				,@TargetValue
				,@char_id OUTPUT;
 
			-- 02. create sample frequency
			-- check the sample frequency exist or not; if not exist create it
			IF NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT 1
					FROM sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE freq_name = @SourceLabel
					)
			BEGIN
				EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_samplefreq @SourceLabel
					,@ProductID
					,@Customer
					,@Level
					,@Stage
					,@TestMethod
					,@ParameterListID
					,@Variant
					,@enabled_freq
					,@samplePlanType
					,@freq_id OUTPUT;
			END;
 
			-- 03. create sample plan
			-- for sample plan, it has to be linked with frequency
			-- In case if samplecount is more than 1, it should create multiple samples to handle.  There is no out of box functionality at moment.
			--
			-- initialize the counter
			SET @counter = 1 ;
 
			WHILE (@counter <= @Count) BEGIN
				EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_generatesampleplan @SamplePlanID
					,@samplePlanType
					,@ProductID
					,@Customer
					,@Level
					,@Stage
					,@SourceLabel
					,@TestMethod
					,@ParameterListID
					,@Variant
					,NULL	-- location label
					,NULL	-- location path
					,@mes_plan_id OUTPUT
					,@counter ;
 
				-- 04. create qm-spec
				-- for qm-spec, it has to be linked with characteristic, and sample plan name.  so first sample plan has to be created
				EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_qmspec @SamplePlanID
					,@ProductID
					,@ent_id
					,@Customer
					,@Level
					,@Stage
					,@SourceLabel
					,@TestMethod
					,@ParameterListID
					,@Variant
					,@Parameter
					,@DataType
					,@Units
					,@LowerLimit
					,@UpperLimit
					,@TargetValue
					,@MESWait
					,@mes_plan_id
					,@char_id;
				-- increment the counter by 1
				SET @counter = @counter + 1 ;
			END ;
 
			-- increment the row id
			SET @i_min = @i_min + 1;
		END;

		-- If the SPs execution  succeeds, commit the transaction.  
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        
        -- fater the commit send this to update the master data for limits
		DECLARE postcommit_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT SamplePlanID, ProductID, LEVEL, Stage, SourceLabel, SampleCount, Customer
			FROM @tbl_SamplePlanData
			WHERE FirstRowSamplePlan = 1
				AND ProductID IS NOT NULL;

		DECLARE @pc_SamplePlanID NVARCHAR(40);
		DECLARE @pc_ProductID NVARCHAR(40);
		DECLARE @pc_Level NVARCHAR(20);
		DECLARE @pc_Stage NVARCHAR(20);
		DECLARE @pc_SourceLabel NVARCHAR(80);
        DECLARE @pc_Customer NVARCHAR(40);
        DECLARE @pc_SamplePlanType INT = @samplePlanType;
        DECLARE @pc_count nvarchar(2);
        DECLARE @c_count INT;

		OPEN postcommit_cursor;
		FETCH NEXT FROM postcommit_cursor INTO @pc_SamplePlanID, @pc_ProductID, @pc_Level, @pc_Stage, @pc_SourceLabel, @pc_count, @pc_Customer;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			BEGIN TRY

                SET @c_count = Convert(int, @pc_count);
				-- Replace with your SP and parameters
				 -- call sp_U_ofi_LIMS_Limits_MasterData 
                EXEC dbo.sp_U_ofi_LIMS_Limits_MasterData
                    @sample_plan_id = @pc_SamplePlanID,
                    @product_id = @pc_ProductID,
                    @level = @pc_Level,
                    @stage = @pc_Stage,
                    @source_label = @pc_SourceLabel,
                    @customer = @pc_Customer,
                    @Count = @c_count,
                    @location_label = NULL,
                    @samplePlanType = @pc_SamplePlanType;                   
				

			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				-- Log or handle the per-row failure; do NOT rely on cursor auto-cleanup
				DECLARE @err NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
				-- continue to next row
			END CATCH

			FETCH NEXT FROM postcommit_cursor INTO @pc_SamplePlanID, @pc_ProductID, @pc_Level, @pc_Stage, @pc_SourceLabel, @pc_count, @pc_Customer;
		END

		CLOSE postcommit_cursor;
		DEALLOCATE postcommit_cursor;

        -- Update the output message
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'Sample plan ' + @SamplePlanID + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';

		SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;

	END TRY
 
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @msg = ERROR_MESSAGE();
		SET @msg_output = '{"code": 500,"status": "Error","error": "Error","message": "' + @msg + '"}';
 
		-- XACT_STATE:  
		-- If 1, the transaction is committable.  
		-- If -1, the transaction is uncommittable and should be rolled back.  
		-- XACT_STATE = 0 means that there is no transaction and  
		--     a commit or rollback operation would generate an error.  
		-- Test whether the transaction is uncommittable.  
		IF (XACT_STATE()) = - 1
		BEGIN
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
 
			RAISERROR (
					@msg_output
					,16
					,1
					);
 
			Return -1 ;
		END;
 
		-- Test whether the transaction is committable.
		-- You may want to commit a transaction in a catch block if you want to commit changes to statements that ran prior to the error.
		IF (XACT_STATE()) = 1
		BEGIN
			COMMIT TRANSACTION;
 
			SET @msg_output = '{"code": 200,"status": "OK","message": "' + 'Sample plan ' + @SamplePlanID + ' creation executed successfully.' + '"}';
 
			SELECT @msg_output AS execution_message;
		END;
	END CATCH
END

--========================================================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_u_ofi_st_trans_mapping]
-- Description:	The stored procedure used to update transfer mapping exisitng record by rowid	

-- Usage:		Stock Transfer Configuration
-- =====================================================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	Veervar Joshi		2023-12-20					Initial version.
-- =====================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_st_trans_mapping] @Equipment_ID INT
	,@EquipName NVARCHAR(100)
	,@StorageEntID INT
	,@StorageEquipName NVARCHAR(100)
	,@type NVARCHAR(50)
	,@item_group NVARCHAR(50)
	,@RowID INT
	,@user_name NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--VARIABLE DECLARATION
	DECLARE @currentEntID NVARCHAR(50)
		,@currentStoEntID NVARCHAR(50)
		,@currentType NVARCHAR(50)
		,@currentItemGrp NVARCHAR(50)
		,@oldval NVARCHAR(max)
		,@newval NVARCHAR(max)
		,@newEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStorageEntId NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'StockTransferMapping'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@strCommentMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@delete_detail NVARCHAR(50) = NULL		
		,@keyField1 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField2 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField3 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField4 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField5 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField6 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
	DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
		,@log_id INT
		,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
		,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
		,@change_type INT = 2
		,@table_name NVARCHAR(80) = '[ofi_st_trans_mapping]'
		,@audit_category NVARCHAR(80) = 'Info'
		,@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)

	DECLARE @TransferRunning varchar(80)='RUNNING'
	DECLARE @transferStatusCdRunning INT=0
	--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE
	SELECT @transferStatusCdRunning=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@TransferRunning

	--VERIFY REQUIRED PARAMETERS ARE PASSED
	IF (@Equipment_ID IS NULL OR @StorageEntID IS NULL	)
	BEGIN
		-- Set Error Message 'Parameters is not completed'
			SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400010,NULL,NULL)	
		RAISERROR (	
				@errorMessage,16,1
				);

		RETURN - 1
	END
	


	--CHECK IF SELCTED TRANSFER LINE STATUS IS RUNNING OR NOT
	IF EXISTS (
			SELECT ent_id FROM ofi_st_trans_selection st
			WHERE st.ent_id = @Equipment_ID
				AND (ST.src_su_ent_id=@StorageEntID OR st.dest_su_ent_id= @StorageEntID)				   
				AND st.transfer_status_cd = @transferStatusCdRunning
			)
	BEGIN
		SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400008,NULL,NULL)	
		RAISERROR (
				@errorMessage,16,1
				);
			RETURN -1
	END
	
	--CHECK IS THIS MAPPING RECORD ALREADY EXISTS
	IF EXISTS (SELECT ent_id		
				FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping stm	
				WHERE 
				(stm.storage_ent_id = @StorageEntID				
				AND stm.item_group = @item_group AND stm.type=@type and stm.ent_id=@Equipment_ID and row_id <> @RowID)
				or
				(stm.storage_ent_id = @StorageEntID				
				AND stm.item_group != @item_group and row_id <> @RowID) 
	)
			
	BEGIN
	SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400009,NULL,NULL)
		RAISERROR (
				@errorMessage,16,1
				);
			RETURN -1
	END


	

	--SELECT EXISTING MAPPING RECORD TO UPDATE
	SELECT @currentEntID = e.ent_name
		,@currentStoEntID = e2.ent_name
		,@currentType = type
		,@currentItemGrp = item_group
	FROM ofi_st_trans_mapping el WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = el.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent e2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON e2.ent_id = storage_ent_id
	WHERE row_id = @RowID

	SET @oldval = 'Equipment: ' + @currentEntID + ' Storage Ent: ' + @currentStoEntID + ' Type: ' + @currentType + ' Item Group: ' + @currentItemGrp

	--UPDATE RECORD
	UPDATE ofi_st_trans_mapping
	SET ent_id = @Equipment_ID
		,storage_ent_id = @StorageEntID
		,type = @type
		,item_group = @item_group
		,last_edit_by = @user_name
		,last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE()
		,last_edit_at_local = GETDATE()
	WHERE row_id = @RowID



	--INSERT AUDIT TRAIL LOG FOR THIS TRANSACTION
	SELECT @newEntId = ent_name
	FROM ent
	WHERE ent_id = @Equipment_ID

	SELECT @newStorageEntId = ent_name
	FROM ent
	WHERE ent_id = @StorageEntID

	SET @newval = 'Equipment: ' + @newEntId + ' Storage Ent: ' + @newStorageEntId + ' Type: ' + @type + ' Item Group: ' + @item_group

	IF @newEntId <> @currentEntID
	BEGIN
		SET @column_name = '[ent_id]'

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
			,@logged_at
			,@user_name
			,@change_type
			,@table_name
			,@RowID
			,@column_name
			,@currentEntID
			,@newEntId
			,@audit_comments
			,@delete_detail;

		UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
		SET origin = @strFunctionName
		WHERE log_id = @log_id;

		SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Updated From [dbo].[ofi_st_trans_mapping] [ent_id] field change.  Old value: ' + @currentEntID + ' -> New value: ' + @newEntId + ''

		SET @strActivityMsg = 'UPDATED'

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
			log_id
			,keyField1
			,keyField2
			,keyField3
			,keyField4
			,module_id
			,function_id
			,spare1
			,spare2
			,spare3
			,spare4
			,spare5
			,spare6
			,audit_category
			,activity
			,comments
			,created_at_utc
			,created_at_local
			,created_by
			)
		VALUES (
			@log_id
			,@newEntId
			,@newStorageEntId
			,@type
			,@item_group
			,@strModuleName
			,@strFunctionName
			,@keyField1
			,@keyField2
			,@keyField3
			,@keyField4
			,@keyField5
			,@keyField6
			,@audit_category
			,@strActivityMsg
			,@strCommentMsg
			,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
			,@logged_at
			,@user_name
			);
	END

	IF @newStorageEntId <> @currentStoEntID
	BEGIN
		SET @column_name = '[storage_ent_id]'

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
			,@logged_at
			,@user_name
			,@change_type
			,@table_name
			,@RowID
			,@column_name
			,@currentStoEntID
			,@newStorageEntId
			,@audit_comments
			,@delete_detail;

		UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
		SET origin = @strFunctionName
		WHERE log_id = @log_id;

		SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Updated From [dbo].[ofi_st_trans_mapping] [storage_ent_id] field change.  Old value: ' + @currentStoEntID + ' -> New value: ' + @newStorageEntId + ''

		SET @strActivityMsg = 'UPDATED'

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
			log_id
			,keyField1
			,keyField2
			,keyField3
			,keyField4
			,module_id
			,function_id
			,spare1
			,spare2
			,spare3
			,spare4
			,spare5
			,spare6
			,audit_category
			,activity
			,comments
			,created_at_utc
			,created_at_local
			,created_by
			)
		VALUES (
			@log_id
			,@newEntId
			,@newStorageEntId
			,@type
			,@item_group
			,@strModuleName
			,@strFunctionName

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Rejected_Message]
(@rejected_message_local	TDATETIME
,@xml_message			nvarchar(2000)
,@xml_error_message		nvarchar(2000)
,@message_status		INT32
,@object_name			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@object_section		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@message_region		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@message_locale		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@message_version		INT32 = NULL
,@last_edit_comment		STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
,@last_edit_at			TDATETIME OUTPUT
,@row_id				INT32 OUTPUT
) AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_I_REJECTED_MESSAGE
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 06/24/2016	  Raghu G	5.3	US 135517, As Bruce, I want to establish a Rejected Messages Subscription specific to an Entity/TimePeriod/OCOAsyncMessages, so that I can be notified when there are new rejected messages matching my filter
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @v_Client_Info	STRING40
	,@rejected_message_utc	TDATETIME
	,@last_edit_by nvarchar(40)
	,@tz_temp	INT32
	,@xml_message_source NVARCHAR(MAX)

BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	EXEC dbo.sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT , @v_Client_Info OUTPUT

--	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @rejected_message_local OUTPUT, @time_zone_bias_value, @rejected_message_utc OUTPUT
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @rejected_message_utc OUTPUT, @rejected_message_local OUTPUT, @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT

	SET @xml_message_source = UPPER(@xml_message)

	-- Presently, the rejected messages are logged only when the commands initiated from an 'object' fails.
	-- Therefore, determine the object that initiated the command, since the commands are unique among the objects.
	-- Set the object section to the corresponding object, so that the data read can just filter the messages recorded for 'OCO'
	IF @xml_message_source LIKE '%STARTJOBBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%PAUSEJOBBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%ENDJOBBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%STARTNEXTJOBVIAFCBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%PREPAREPRODUCTIONATTRIBUTESBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%CREATEWOFROMPROCESS%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%ADDPRODBYJOB%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%SETCURLOTDATABYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%ADDCONSBYJOB%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%ADDINVBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%TRANSFERINVENTORYBYNAME%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%ADDPEM%'
		 OR @xml_message_source LIKE '%JOB_SPEC%UPDATESPECIFIC%'
	 SET @object_section = 'OCO'

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	INSERT INTO rejected_message (rejected_message_utc, rejected_message_local, xml_message, xml_error_message,
		message_status, object_name, object_section, message_region, message_locale, message_version,
		last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES (@rejected_message_utc, @rejected_message_local,
		@xml_message, @xml_error_message, COALESCE(@message_status, 0),
		@object_name, @object_section, @message_region,
		@message_locale, @message_version,
		@last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

	SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetDataLogGroupID]
(@grp_desc	STRING80
) RETURNS INT32 AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetDataLogGroupID
-- Description       - Returns the ID of the data log group for the supplied data log group description
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Author			 - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	@grp_id	INT32

	--Return NULL if the supplied data log group description is NULL
	IF (@grp_desc IS NULL) RETURN NULL

	--Query the data log group for the supplied data log group description
	SELECT @grp_id = dl.grp_id
	FROM data_log_grp dl WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE dl.grp_desc = @grp_desc

	--Return the ID of the supplied data log group.
	RETURN @grp_id
END

(@ent_id  int  ,

 @end_time  datetime  ,

 @additive  bit  ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -

--

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time)
--IF @end_time IS NOT NULL SET @end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @end_time)

SELECT shift_exc.ent_id
            --,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_exc.start_time) start_time
			,shift_exc.start_time
            ,ent.ent_name
            --,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_exc.end_time) end_time
			,shift_exc.end_time
            ,shift_exc.shift_id
            ,shift.shift_desc
            ,shift_exc.additive
            ,shift_exc.last_edit_comment
            ,shift_exc.last_edit_by
            ,shift_exc.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, shift_exc.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM shift_exc shift_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_exc.shift_id = shift.shift_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_exc.ent_id = ent.ent_id

       (shift_exc.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (shift_exc.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, shift_exc.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name
