CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlshPstExec]
( @session_id		INT32
, @user_id		STRING40
, @ent_id		INT32
, @qty_prod		TFLOAT
, @wo_id		STRING40
, @oper_id		STRING40
, @seq_no		INT32
, @shift_start		TDATETIME
, @hour_start     TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
, @shift_id		INT32
, @fg_lot_no		STRING40
, @fg_sublot_no		STRING40
, @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlshPstExec
-- Description            - for a given job this procedure checks for the backfulsh for all the bom positions and
--                                calls the relevant procedures to report the consumption and to report the byproducts
--                                production
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 08/08/2002     Nagaraju  		-  made it identical to sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlush
-- 08/12/2002	Raghu			- fg_lot_no is passed to sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec procedure
-- 08/30/2002	Raghu		1.4	-- Parameter Cont_id is removed which was passed to AddProdPostExec and AddConsPostExec
-- 06/24/2003	Raghu/Sheetal	1.6.11	(HD# 3304) Allow backflushing BOM_pos = 0 item
-- 11/05/2004	Raghu		2.1.8	HD# 3306, 3307, 3308. Redefine Must Consume from WIP, Backflush consumption from correct inventory record if only one
--02/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
--04/15/2005	Raghu		2.1.19	HD# 5563, Cannot report production - joining to a job table is commented out as it is not required.
--07/26/2005	Raghu		2.1.25	HD# 5749, Second part of the problem related to Backflushing.
-- 08/19/2005	Raghu		2.1.26  Added error message to language table, so that it can be translatable.
-- 09/29/2006	Raghu		3.1.22	HD# 8434, Truncate milli-seconds using correct datetime style to work with all regional settings.
-- 01/09/2007     KRF           3.2.1   HD# 8314, part of DB changes - added @fg_sublot_no argument
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/25/2008	DRT			3.4.0	CR L00074415 - Added null row_id argument when calling sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec (2 spots)
-- 03/23/2011   Pradeep		4.5	CR L00110335/HF 2356 replaced oper_id with input_oper_id in the where condition
--13/3/2012          siddu       4.0Sp2  OEE Changes are included from 3.5patch2
-- 10/25/2017		RaghuG	6.0	UserStory: 928152 - MOL: Part-2: As Schneider Electric, I want to record the production (L00146335 , HF CR L00146064: Hotfix L00127801) in the correct hour bucket
-- 09/27/2019	Raghu		6.2	UserStory: 1120685 - MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00151782 - Backflushing for substitutes does not work correctly
-- 03/13/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1143092-As AVEVA, I want a the AddConsPostExec SP to use the same mechanism as the AddProdPostExec to identify the shift information
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @item_id 		STRING40
, @bom_pos 		INT32
, @qty_per_parent	TFLOAT
, @qty_cons		TFLOAT
,@cur_backflush         	bit
,@return               	 INT32
, @item_id_same	INT
, @reqd_grade_cd	INT
, @must_consume_from_wip LOGICAL
, @from_ent_id		INT
, @lot_no		STRING40
, @row_count		INT
, @sublot_no		STRING40  -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
, @current_subst	INT32

SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

--Added by Raghu. Truncate the milliseconds for shift_start
SET @shift_start = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @shift_start )
-- Read item, qty_per_parent, default reas_cd, lot_no, cont_id, storage_ent from job_bom
DECLARE Job_Bom_Cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
SELECT bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, qty_per_parent_item, backflush, must_consume_from_wip, current_subst
FROM Job_Bom WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
--and BOM_pos > 0
OPEN  Job_Bom_Cursor
WHILE 1=1 BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM Job_Bom_Cursor
	INTO @bom_pos, @item_id, @reqd_grade_cd, @qty_per_parent,@cur_backflush, @must_consume_from_wip, @current_subst
	IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 BREAK

	IF (@current_subst IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst)
		SELECT @item_id = item_id, @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd, @qty_per_parent = qty_per_parent_item, @cur_backflush = backflush, @must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip
		FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst
	END

	IF @cur_backflush = 1 BEGIN
		IF @qty_per_parent > 0 	BEGIN
			-- Calculate the qty consumed of this item based on the qty_produced in this transaction
			SET @qty_cons = @qty_per_parent * @qty_prod
			-- Now call the normal SP to Add consumption for this row
			-- Pass nulls for all values that this SP reads from job_bom anyway, pass FG lot_no in case it was specified
			--Modified by Raghu on 08/22/2002. Instead of passing NULL for @fg_lot_no, @fg_lot_no is passed
			--Modified by Raghu on 08/30/2002. cont_id is removed which was passed to AddConsPostExec and AddProdPostExec
			SELECT @from_ent_id = NULL, @lot_no = NULL, @sublot_no = NULL
			IF (@bom_pos = 0) BEGIN
				SET @item_id_same = 0
				--EXEC @item_id_same = sp_SA_Item_Prod_IsSameProduced @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id
				--Check for the qts ONLY if wip is true, otherwise ignore checking for quantities.
				IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND first_job != 1) BEGIN
						SET @item_id_same = 1
						SELECT @row_count = COUNT(*) FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
	--								INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
	--								INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
	--								      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
						WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no -- CR L00110335/HF 2356 replaced oper_id with input_oper_id in the where condition
						  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_prod
						  AND (lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (item_inv.lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
						  AND (sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (item_inv.sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
						IF (@row_count = 1)
							SELECT @from_ent_id = ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
	--									INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
	--									INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
	--									      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
							WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no -- CR L00110335/HF 2356 replaced oper_id with input_oper_id in the where condition
							  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_prod
							  AND (lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (item_inv.lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
							  AND (sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (item_inv.sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
						ELSE IF (@row_count = 0) BEGIN
							RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
							RETURN -1
						END
					END
				END
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
					SELECT @row_count = COUNT(*) FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
--								INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
--								INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
--								      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
					WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no -- CR L00110335/HF 2356 replaced oper_id with input_oper_id in the where condition
					  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons
					IF (@row_count = 1) BEGIN
						SELECT  @from_ent_id = ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
--									INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
--									INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
--									      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
						WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @seq_no -- CR L00110335/HF 2356 replaced oper_id with input_oper_id in the where condition
						  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons
					END
					ELSE IF (@row_count = 0) BEGIN
						RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
						RETURN -1
					END
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF 1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons) BEGIN
						SELECT  @from_ent_id = ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons
					END
				END
			END

			-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/21/2009 RWB
            ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			IF @bom_pos > 0 EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec @session_id=@session_id, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id, @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @qty_cons=@qty_cons
				, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @shift_start_local=@shift_start, @shift_id=@shift_id, @item_id=@item_id, @reas_cd=NULL
				, @lot_no=@lot_no, @fg_lot_no=@fg_lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no
				, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @ext_ref=NULL, @genealogy_id=NULL, @upstream_event_id=NULL, @segment_requirement_id=NULL, @segment_response_id=NULL
				, @comments=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @created_at_utc=NULL, @row_id=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			IF @bom_pos < 0 EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec @session_id=@session_id, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id, @qty_prod=@qty_cons
								, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @created_at_utc=NULL, @shift_start_local=@shift_start
								, @hour_start_local=@hour_start, @shift_id=@shift_id, @item_id=@item_id, @reas_cd=NULL, @lot_no=NULL
								, @sublot_no=NULL, @to_ent_id=NULL, @processed=1, @byproduct=1, @ext_ref=NULL, @move_status=NULL
								, @genealogy_id=NULL, @event_id=NULL, @segment_requirement_id=NULL, @segment_response_id=NULL
								, @comments=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1

			--Added by Raghu for  (HD# 3304). Allow Backflush bom_pos = 0
			IF (@bom_pos = 0 AND @item_id_same = 1)
				-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/21/2009 RWB
				EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddConsPostExec @session_id=@session_id, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id, @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @qty_cons=@qty_cons
					, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @shift_start_local=@shift_start, @shift_id=@shift_id, @item_id=@item_id, @reas_cd=NULL
					, @lot_no=@lot_no, @fg_lot_no=@fg_lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no
					, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @ext_ref=NULL, @genealogy_id=NULL, @upstream_event_id=NULL, @segment_requirement_id=NULL, @segment_response_id=NULL
					, @comments=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @created_at_utc=NULL, @row_id=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END
END
-- Close and deallocate the cursor
CLOSE Job_Bom_Cursor
DEALLOCATE Job_Bom_Cursor
SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@item_id			STRING40
,@lot_no			STRING40

DECLARE @can_store		  LOGICAL
DECLARE @status               	  STRING80
DECLARE @cur_qty_left             TFLOAT
DECLARE @qty_left                 TFLOAT
DECLARE @qty_left_erp             TFLOAT
DECLARE @cur_max_capacity         TFLOAT
--JK replace cur_max_capacity with the new field of storage_exec table??
DECLARE @cur_auto_del_zero_inv    LOGICAL
DECLARE @cur_allow_neg_qty        LOGICAL
DECLARE @grade_cd                 INT32
DECLARE @status_cd                INT32
DECLARE @cur_type                 STRING80
DECLARE @cur_status               STRING80
DECLARE @cur_spare1               STRING80
DECLARE @cur_spare2               STRING80
DECLARE @cur_spare3               STRING80
DECLARE @cur_grade_cd             INT32
DECLARE @cur_status_cd            INT32
DECLARE @cur_qty_left_erp         TFLOAT
DECLARE @cur_date_in_utc          TDATETIME
DECLARE @cur_date_in_local          TDATETIME
DECLARE @cur_date_out_utc             TDATETIME
DECLARE @cur_date_out_local             TDATETIME
DECLARE @cur_last_edit_at         TDATETIME
DECLARE @cur_expiry_date          TDATETIME
DECLARE @cur_wo_id                STRING40
DECLARE @cur_oper_id              STRING40
DECLARE @cur_seq_no               INT32
DECLARE @totqty		TFLOAT
DECLARE @return		INT32
DECLARE @bgood_prod        LOGICAL
DECLARE @log_trans		LOGICAL
--DECLARE @last_edit_at		DATETIME
DECLARE @transfer_time_local	TDATETIME
DECLARE @transfer_time_utc	TDATETIME
DECLARE @last_edit_by		STRING80
DECLARE @date_out_local		TDATETIME

DECLARE @pref_cd		INT32
DECLARE @inv_pref_cd	INT32

--CR L00098047
DECLARE @num_decimals		INT32
-- HF CR 118671
DECLARE @from_spare1	nvarchar(80)
DECLARE @from_spare2	nvarchar(80)
DECLARE @from_spare3	nvarchar(80)
DECLARE @from_spare4	nvarchar(80)
DECLARE @from_spare5	nvarchar(80)
DECLARE @from_spare6	nvarchar(80)

-- CR L00089753
DECLARE @inv_unique_by_job INT32

--CR 118945
DECLARE	@from_uom_id	INT32

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	--Init the values
	SELECT @grade_cd = @item_grade_cd, @status_cd = @item_status_cd, @num_decimals = 0

	-- Set defaults if not defined
	SELECT @reduce_qty_erp = COALESCE(@reduce_qty_erp, 0), @goods_shipped = COALESCE(@goods_shipped, 0), @must_cons_from_wip = COALESCE(@must_cons_from_wip, 0)
		, @checkgrade = COALESCE(@checkgrade, 0), @log_trans = COALESCE(@log_trans, 1)

	----return error if the reduction qty is not specified
	IF (@reduce_qty IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Quantity to be reduced must be specified{3220}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- If the ent_id does not have the can_store capability return error
	SELECT @can_store = can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The entity does not have the can_store capability{3221}', 16, 1)

	EXECUTE sp_S_Storage_exec_GetDepData @ent_id, @cur_type OUTPUT, @cur_status OUTPUT, @cur_max_capacity OUTPUT,
		@cur_auto_del_zero_inv OUTPUT, @cur_allow_neg_qty OUTPUT, @cur_spare1 OUTPUT, @cur_spare2 OUTPUT, @cur_spare3 OUTPUT

	--RaghuK CR L00088636 Get the inv_unique_by_job for this item
	SELECT @inv_unique_by_job = inv_unique_by_job FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id

	--RaghuK CR L00088636 If @inv_unique_by_job is True then include the job details in the WHERE clause to find the inventory rows specific to this job

						(oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL)) AND

				,@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no,@from_spare1 = spare1, @from_spare2 = spare2, @from_spare3 = spare3, @from_spare4 = spare4
				,   @from_spare5 = spare5, @from_spare6 = spare6
				FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE	ent_id = @ent_id AND
						item_id = @item_id AND
						(lot_no IS NULL)
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			IF (@inv_unique_by_job = 1)
				-- CR L00108362 - Updated to allow for null job information
				SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd, @cur_qty_left = qty_left, @cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
				,@cur_date_in_utc = date_in_utc, @cur_date_in_local = date_in_local, @cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @cur_date_out_local = date_out_local, @cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at, @cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
				,@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no,@from_spare1 = spare1, @from_spare2 = spare2, @from_spare3 = spare3, @from_spare4 = spare4
				,   @from_spare5 = spare5, @from_spare6 = spare6
				FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE  ent_id = @ent_id AND
					   item_id = @item_id AND
						(wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL)) AND
						(oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL)) AND
						(seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL)) AND
					   (lot_no = @lot_no) AND
					   (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			ELSE
				SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd, @cur_qty_left = qty_left, @cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
				,@cur_date_in_utc = date_in_utc, @cur_date_in_local = date_in_local, @cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @cur_date_out_local = date_out_local, @cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at, @cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
				,@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no,@from_spare1 = spare1, @from_spare2 = spare2, @from_spare3 = spare3, @from_spare4 = spare4
				,   @from_spare5 = spare5, @from_spare6 = spare6
				FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE  ent_id = @ent_id AND
					   item_id = @item_id AND
						(lot_no = @lot_no)AND
						 (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd, @cur_qty_left = qty_left, @cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
			, @cur_date_in_utc = date_in_utc, @cur_date_in_local = date_in_local, @cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @cur_date_out_local = date_out_local, @cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at, @cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
			, @cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no
			, @from_spare1 = spare1, @from_spare2 = spare2, @from_spare3 = spare3, @from_spare4 = spare4, @from_spare5 = spare5, @from_spare6 = spare6
		FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE row_id = @row_id
	END

	IF (@from_uom_id IS NULL) SELECT @from_uom_id = uom_id from item  WITH (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--(HD# 3307) -Added by Raghu on 06/30/2003. Always set Current Allow Neg Qtys to False for @must_cons_from_wip = 1
	IF (@must_cons_from_wip = 1) SET @cur_allow_neg_qty = 0

	SELECT @bgood_prod = g.good_prod
	FROM item_reas r WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item_grade g WITH (NOLOCK) ON r.item_grade_cd = g.item_grade_cd
	WHERE r.reas_cd = @item_reas_cd

	IF @bgood_prod = 1 AND  @must_consume_from_inv = 1 BEGIN
		--check for the grade
		IF  (NOT @grade_cd IS NULL) AND (NOT @cur_grade_cd  IS NULL)  AND  ( @cur_grade_cd  <>0)   BEGIN
			-- see if we use preference or the actual grade code itself
			SELECT @use_pref = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 411
			IF @use_pref = 1 BEGIN
				SELECT @inv_pref_cd = pref FROM Item_grade  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd
				SELECT @pref_cd = pref FROM Item_grade WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
				IF (NOT (@inv_pref_cd <= @pref_cd)) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = N'The supplied item %%1 does not match with the %%2 in the inventory.{3222},grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@grade_cd)) + ' pref: '+ ltrim(str(@pref_cd)) + ',grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@cur_grade_cd)) + ' pref: '+ ltrim(str(@inv_pref_cd ))
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END
			ELSE IF @grade_cd <> @cur_grade_cd  BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = N'The supplied item %%1 does not match with the %%2 in the inventory.{3222},grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@grade_cd)) + ',grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@cur_grade_cd))
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END

	--Added by Raghu on 08/06/2003,  If CheckGrade parameter is true, then source grade and inventory grade should match
	IF @checkGrade = 1 BEGIN
		-- see if we use preference or the actual grade code itself
		SELECT @use_pref = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 411
		IF @use_pref = 1 BEGIN
			SELECT @inv_pref_cd = pref FROM Item_grade  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd
			SELECT @pref_cd = pref FROM Item_grade  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
			IF (NOT (@inv_pref_cd <= @pref_cd)) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = N'The supplied item %%1 does not match with the %%2 in the inventory.{3222},grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@grade_cd)) + ' pref: '+ ltrim(str(@pref_cd)) + ',grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@cur_grade_cd)) + ' pref: '+ ltrim(str(@inv_pref_cd ))
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
		ELSE IF @grade_cd <> @cur_grade_cd  BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = N'The supplied item %%1 does not match with the %%2 in the inventory.{3222},grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@grade_cd)) + ',grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@cur_grade_cd))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
	EXEC dbo.sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @cur_date_in_utc OUTPUT, @cur_date_in_local OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @cur_date_in_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @cur_date_in_utc )
	SET @cur_date_in_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @cur_date_in_local )

	IF (@date_out_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @date_out = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @date_out_utc) -- Get the local date from utc
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@date_out IS NOT NULL) SET @date_out_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @date_out, GETUTCDATE())
		ELSE SELECT @date_out_utc = @cur_date_in_utc, @date_out_local = @cur_date_in_local
	END

	--If the row already exists, then update the quantity of item and other fields of that row
	IF NOT  @cur_qty_left IS NULL BEGIN    -- row DOES exist
		--  if the current qty_left_erp is Null, replace it with default value 0
		SET @cur_qty_left_erp = COALESCE(@cur_qty_left_erp, 0)

		SET  @qty_left = @cur_qty_left - @reduce_qty
		SET  @qty_left_erp = @cur_qty_left_erp - @reduce_qty_erp

		SELECT @num_decimals = num_decimals FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE item_id = @item_id

		IF (ROUND(@qty_left, @num_decimals) = 0) BEGIN
			-- if auto_del_zero_inv flag is TRUE then delete the row
			IF (@cur_auto_del_zero_inv = 1) BEGIN
				DELETE item_inv WHERE row_id = @row_id
				IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
					RAISERROR('SQL Error deleting zero quantity from item_inv table: %d{3223}', 16, 1, @@error)
					RETURN -1
				END

			       EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @qty_left, 1
	        	END
		        ELSE BEGIN
				-- If qty reduced to 0 and auto_del_zero_inv flag is FALSE then leave the row
				--Modified by Raghu on 08/30/2002. Since we got the row_id, use row_id in the where clause which identifies the unique row.
				UPDATE item_inv
				SET qty_left = @qty_left
				  ,qty_left_erp = @qty_left_erp
				  ,date_in_utc = @cur_date_in_utc
				  ,date_in_local = @cur_date_in_local
				  ,date_out_utc = @date_out_utc
				  ,date_out_local = @date_out_local
				  ,last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
				WHERE row_id = @row_id

				IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
					RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating item_inv table: %d{3224}', 16, 1, @@ERROR)
					RETURN -1
				END

				SET @totqty = @qty_left
				EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @qty_left, 1
				IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			END
		END

		IF (ROUND(@qty_left, @num_decimals) < 0) BEGIN
			-- Check for allowing neg qty's before updating - use max_capacity flag for now
			IF (@cur_allow_neg_qty != 0) BEGIN
				--Modified by Raghu on 08/30/2002. Since we got the row_id, use row_id in the where clause which identifies the unique row.
				UPDATE item_inv
				SET qty_left = @qty_left
				  ,qty_left_erp = @qty_left_erp
				  ,date_in_utc = @cur_date_in_utc
				  ,date_in_local = @cur_date_in_local
				  ,date_out_utc = @date_out_utc
				  ,date_out_local = @date_out_local
				  ,last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
				WHERE row_id = @row_id

				IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
					RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating negative qty into item_inv table: %d', 16, 1, @@error)
					RETURN -1
				END

				SET @totqty = @qty_left
				EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @qty_left, 1
				IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1

			END
			ELSE BEGIN
			   RAISERROR('qty_left cannot be negative{3225}', 16, 1)
			   RETURN -1
			END
		END

		IF @qty_left > 0 BEGIN
			-- qty reduced but still > 0
			--Modified by Raghu on 08/30/2002. Since we got the row_id, use row_id in the where clause which identifies the unique row.
			UPDATE item_inv
			SET qty_left = @qty_left
			  , qty_left_erp = @qty_left_erp
			  , last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating the item_inv table: %d{3209}', 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN -1
			END

			SET @totqty = @qty_left
			EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @qty_left, 1
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN --Row does not exist, insert a new one if negative quantities are allowed

		SELECT @qty_left = -@reduce_qty, @qty_left_erp = -@reduce_qty_erp

		--Modified by Raghu on 04/24/2003. If all items are consumed from inventory and no rows exist, and if a consumption is reduced, then it should add to the inventory.
		IF (@cur_allow_neg_qty != 0) OR (@qty_left > 0) BEGIN
			EXEC SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADDLOTSUBLOT @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no,@grade_cd,@status_cd

			INSERT INTO ITEM_INV (ent_id, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd, qty_left, qty_left_erp, date_in_utc, date_in_local
				, date_out_utc, date_out_local, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, expiry_date, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no)
			VALUES (@ent_id, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @qty_left, @qty_left_erp, @cur_date_in_utc, @cur_date_in_local
				, @date_out_utc, @date_out_local, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, null, null, null, null)

			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR('SQL ERROR inserting into item_inv table: %d{3209}', 16, 1, @@ERROR)
				RETURN -1
			END

			SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			SET @totqty = @qty_left
			EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @qty_left, 1
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			RAISERROR('There in not enough inventory in this storage location to keep the balance from becoming negative, which is not allowed.{4701}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	--Do not log transfers if this transaction is a production transaction or consumption transaction
	--US#734692:Merge L00143083(HF CR L00142363-sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce: incorrectly logs consumptions into item_transfer table).
	IF (@log_transfer = 0) RETURN

	--Get Log_Inventory Transfers system_attr
	SELECT @log_trans = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 198
	--If update or insert was successful and the log_trans is true then insert a new row in item_transfer table
	IF @log_trans = 1 BEGIN
		--Added for CR-L00117843 cloned from CRL00117663
		SELECT @transfer_time_utc = @date_out_utc, @transfer_time_local = @date_out
		IF (@transfer_time_utc IS NULL) SET @transfer_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		SET @transfer_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @transfer_time_utc)

		/* CR 118945: Added expiry date and uom_id to columns inserted into item_transfer */
		INSERT INTO item_transfer (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, expiry_date, from_ent_id, to_ent_id
			, qty_txd, qty_txd_erp,uom_id, goods_received, goods_shipped, grade_cd, status_cd, comments
			, transfer_by, transfer_time_utc, transfer_time_local, from_spare1, from_spare2, from_spare3, from_spare4, from_spare5, from_spare6)
		VALUES (@cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @cur_expiry_date, @ent_id, NULL
			, -@reduce_qty, -@reduce_qty_erp,@from_uom_id, 0, @goods_shipped, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @transfer_comments
			, @last_edit_by, @transfer_time_utc, @transfer_time_local, @from_spare1, @from_spare2, @from_spare3, @from_spare4, @from_spare5, @from_spare6)

		IF @@error<> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('SQL ERROR inserting into item_transfer table{3210}', 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
END

-- 0.01.00  CK      2023-12-04      Initial version.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_set_storeage_exec] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @ent_id_aut nvarchar(50) --=524003
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @SUNumberInAUT_id nvarchar(50)
	,@SUNumberInAUT_val nvarchar(50)
	,@ent_id INT
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	select @SUNumberInAUT_id=a.attr_id from attr a with(nolock) where a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
	select @ent_id=ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea with(nolock) where ea.attr_id=@SUNumberInAUT_id and ea.attr_value=@ent_id_aut
	 
		update storage_exec  
		set spare_int3 = allow_multiple_items
			,spare_int4 = allow_multiple_lots
			,allow_multiple_items=1
			,allow_multiple_lots=1
			where ent_id=@ent_id
END

-- Create date: 10 April 2017
-- Description:	This SP is used to update Location - Now obsolete
-- =======================================================================================================================================
-- Change Date		Change By		Version			Changes
-- =======================================================================================================================================
-- Change Date		Change By		Version			Changes
-- 10/4/2017		WLe				1.0				original version

-- =======================================================================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_Location]
(
@loc_id int,
@loc_name nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.loc where loc_id = @loc_id
		if @rowCount > 0 
		begin
			update sdb.SCH.loc set loc_desc = @loc_name where loc_id = @loc_id
			set @message = CONCAT('Successfully updated location with ID: ' , @loc_id)
		end
		else
		begin
			set @message = CONCAT('Invalid or missing location ID: ' , @loc_id)
		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to update location: ' , @loc_name)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    Fn_s_ofi_get_processByCriteria
-- Description:  Returns the process order type
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  KN          2023-03-13         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  LP          2023-09-13         Added condition for butter loadout process
-- 0.01.02   LP          2023-12-06         Updated the liquor process with breaking and winowing process, commented previous code
-- 0.01.03	VJ			2024-04-29			Added statement for Bean Rework-1 process
-- 0.01.04	VJ			2024-05-27			Updated statement for LiquorButterRework-1 process

Create                             function [dbo].[Fn_s_ofi_get_processByCriteria_backup_01_08_25] (
		@wo_id			NVARCHAR(200),
		@product_group	NVARCHAR(200),
		@prodn_method	NVARCHAR(200),
		@material_state	NVARCHAR(200),
		@order_type		NVARCHAR(200)) returns NVARCHAR(100)
AS
Begin
      DECLARE @process_id NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,@comments NVARCHAR(40) = NULL

	  SELECT @process_id = 
		CASE

			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-BLOCKED' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Butter Packing-1'	-- Tested. Works
			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Butter LoadOut-1'	-- Will take time. SAP working on it
			
			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'LiquorBlendAndLoadOut-1'	-- Will take time. SAP working on it, commented by LP
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Butter LoadOut-1'	-- Added by LP
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-BUTTER-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Liquor Melt-1'	-- Will take time. SAP working on it


			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Powder Packing-1'		-- Duplicate for FG-CAKE
			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-LIQUOR-LIQUID' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'LiquorBlendAndLoadOut-1'		-- Liquor Loadout No such process defined
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'FG-POWDER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Powder Packing-1'		-- Duplicate for FG-CAKE
			
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-BUTTER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Butter Melt-1'			-- Tested. Works
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Liquor Melt-1'			


			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Pressing-1'					-- Tested. Works
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'STERILIZING' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Wet Rework-1'			-- Tested. Error while creating BOM
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-CAKE' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Dry Rework-1'				-- SAP looking into creating this order in their system

			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Liquor Process'			-- Liquor Process No such process defined
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'BreakingWinRoasting-1'	--BreakandWin Process

			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'DEODORIZED' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Petzomat'				-- Petzomat No such process defined
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Liquor Melt-1'			-- Tested. Works
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-LIQUOR' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'STERILIZING' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'LIQUID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'LiquorButterRework-1' -- LiquorButterRework (BINs Consumption)

			--WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-POWDER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Powder Packing-1'		-- Duplicate for FG-CAKE
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-POWDER' AND UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' AND UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI01' THEN 'Cake Blending-1'

			--ADDED FOR BLUE BINS REWORK ORDERS FOR BEANR REWORK
			WHEN UPPER(@product_group) = 'SFG-BEAN BLEND' AND (UPPER(@prodn_method) = 'NORMAL' or @prodn_method is null) AND (UPPER(@material_state) = 'SOLID' OR @material_state IS NULL) AND UPPER(@order_type) = 'ZI02' THEN 'Bean Rework-1'		-- Bean rework Process for Blue Bins


			ELSE NULL
		END
		

	  return @process_id
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Line_Ent_Link]
(
	@line_id  int = null,
	@ent_id  int = null,
	@line_is_child logical = null,
	@segment_no int = null,
	@can_be_bottleneck logical = null,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40)  = null,
	@last_edit_at datetime = null
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Line_Ent_Link
-- Description	      - Select a line_ent_link record.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	02/25/2013
-- Version	      - 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--02/25/2013	RaghuG		4.6	Support for line management
--04/05/2013	RaghuG		4.6	UserStories: 165903, 165492 - Assign an entity in a line as a bottleneck, assign parallel entity segments to a single position in a line
--06/17/2013	RaghuG		4.6	UserStory: 196762 - I need existing functionality to be retrofitted to detect a disabled entity on a line.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT  line_ent_link.line_id
	,line_ent_link.ent_id
	,line_ent_link.child_order
	,line_ent_link.input_pct
	,line_ent_link.line_is_child
	,line_ent_link.segment_no
	,line_ent_link.can_be_bottleneck
	,	COALESCE(ur.ent_enabled, CAST(1 AS BIT)) AS ent_enabled
	,	line_ent_link.last_edit_comment
	,	line_ent_link.last_edit_by
	,	line_ent_link.last_edit_at
FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON line_ent_link.ent_id = ue.ent_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ue.cur_reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
WHERE (
		(line_ent_link.line_id = @line_id OR @line_id IS NULL) AND
		(line_ent_link.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(line_ent_link.line_is_child = @line_is_child OR @line_is_child IS NULL) AND
		(line_ent_link.segment_no = @segment_no OR @segment_no IS NULL) AND
		(line_ent_link.can_be_bottleneck = @can_be_bottleneck OR @can_be_bottleneck IS NULL) AND
		(line_ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(line_ent_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	  )
ORDER BY line_ent_link.child_order

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

-- Description          - Returns a list of available storage location (source location)
--                          7.3.3.6	From Location Dropdown or Tree button
--                          This dropdown will contain all entities, moveable and not, that contain inventory
--                          of serialized parts.  If there is a non-blank selection in the "From Work Order"
--                          dropdown, the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing
--                          inventory made by a job with that work order.  Otherwise, if the dialog is
--                          opened in the context of a hard-pegged job and the user does not have the
--                          privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow (so that the empty "
--                          From Work Order" was forced by the choice of the item),
--                          the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory
--                          that was not made by any work order.  If there is also a non-blank selection in the
--                          "From Operation" dropdown, the entities listed will be limited to those
--                          directly containing inventory made by a job with that operation.
--                          Otherwise, if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order
--                          requiring linear flow and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged
--                          and linear flow (so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the
--                          item), the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory
--                          that was not made by any operation.  If the item is specified in the filter,
--                          the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing that item.
--                          If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
--                          to those directly containing an item of that grade.  If the "From Entity" filter
--                          selection is set, BEGIN the entities listed will be limited to moveable storage entities
--                          ultimately located at that (non-movable) entity.  If the "Serial Number" filter is
--                          not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing
--                          inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.  In each case,
--                          if movable storage entities are included in the list, so are the non-movable
--                          storage entities at which they are ultimately located.  When the dialog is
--                          opened in the context of a job, the selection should default to the first
--                          non-movable entity in the list.  This or a movable storage entity located at
--                          it will contain inventory of the part that job produces because of the initial value
--                          of the item filter in this case.
-- Author          -       Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/06/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Changes
--
-- 2/25/2008		DonT			Gave @hard_pegged a default value and fixed an issue with the recursive routines
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @hard_pegged				LOGICAL
		,	@cur_wo_id					STRING40
		,	@cur_oper_id				STRING40
		,	@cur_seq_no					INT32
		,	@may_override_route			LOGICAL
		,	@user_id					STRING40
		,	@client_info				STRING80
		,	@user_has_priv_to_override  LOGICAL

    set @hard_pegged = 0

    --Verify whether a valid job can be identified
    IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @job_pos IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

        --Retrieve the current job that is running on an entity.
        SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no
        FROM job_exec
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = @job_pos

        --Verify whether the linear flow is enabled on this work order.
        SELECT @may_override_route = may_override_route
        FROM wo
        WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id

        IF (@may_override_route = 0) BEGIN
            --Get the user id who is accessing the database.
            EXEC sp_s_db_status_getaudtrailusr	@user_id OUTPUT, @client_info OUTPUT

            --Verify whether this user has a privilege to override the route.
            SELECT @user_has_priv_to_override = MAX(gpl.priv_value)
            FROM grp_priv_link gpl
				INNER JOIN user_grp_link ugl ON ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id
            WHERE gpl.priv_id = 261 AND ugl.user_id = @user_id;

			IF ( @user_has_priv_to_override IS NULL ) BEGIN
				SET @user_has_priv_to_override = 0
			END

            IF (@user_has_priv_to_override = 0) BEGIN
                --This user does not have a privilege to override the route.
                --Verify whether a valid job can be identified
                --Verify whether this job is hard pegged.
                SELECT @hard_pegged = must_consume_from_wip
                FROM job_bom
                WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id
                  AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id
                  AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
                  AND bom_pos = 0

                IF (@hard_pegged = 1) BEGIN
                    IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
                        --Since the job is hard pegged, make sure  none of the operations or work order has produced this item.
						--Set the hard_pegged flag back to 0, to enable the supplied wo_id and oper_id to get filtered.
                        SET @hard_pegged = 0
                    END
                END
            END
        END

    END

    --The recordset will contain all entities, moveable and not, that contain inventory of serialized parts.
    --Split the data retrieval based on the fron_ent_id for optimal performance
    IF (@from_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN

		WITH StorageEntities ( ent_id ) AS
		(
			--If the "From Entity" filter selection is set, BEGIN the entities listed will be limited
			--to moveable storage entities ultimately located at that (non-movable) entity.
			--[DonT 2/2008]Got rid of code forcing from_entity to be moveable. We'll return it and it's child 'movable' locations
			SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id AS ent_id
			FROM storage_exec se
			WHERE se.ent_id = @from_ent_id

			UNION ALL

			SELECT se.ent_id AS ent_id
			FROM storage_exec se
				INNER JOIN StorageEntities ON se.storage_ent_id = StorageEntities.ent_id
			WHERE se.movable = 1
		)

		SELECT se.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM StorageEntities se
			INNER JOIN ent e ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id
                FROM item_inv ii
					INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
                WHERE i.serial_no_lvl > -1
					AND (ii.item_id =  @item_id OR ii.item_id IS NULL)
					AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR
						ii.lot_no IN (SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no))
					--If the "Serial Number" filter is not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those
					--directly containing inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.
					AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR
						ii.sublot_no IN (SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no))
					AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR
						ii.lot_no IN (SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no) OR
						ii.sublot_no IN (SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no)
						)
					--If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
					--to those directly containing an item of that grade.
					AND (@grade_cd IS NULL OR ii.grade_cd IS NULL OR ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd)
					--if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order requiring linear flow
					--and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow
					--(so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the item),
					--the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory that was not made by any operation.
					AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (@wo_id IS NULL OR ii.wo_id IS NULL OR ii.wo_id = @wo_id))
					   OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.wo_id IS NULL)) )
					AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (@oper_id IS NULL OR ii.oper_id IS NULL OR ii.oper_id = @oper_id))
					   OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.oper_id IS NULL)) )
			) inv_filters ON inv_filters.ent_id = se.ent_id
        ORDER BY e.ent_name

    END ELSE BEGIN
        --Since there is no filter for entity, return all entities.
		--[DonT 2/2008]Got rid of code forcing all init entities to be moveable. We'll return all possible locations and then fetch parents of moveable ones
		WITH StorageEntities ( ent_id ) AS
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id
            FROM storage_exec se
			WHERE se.ent_id IN (
					SELECT DISTINCT ii.ent_id
                    FROM item_inv ii
						INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
						--If the "Serial Number" filter is not empty, the entities listed will be limited to those
						--directly containing inventory with serial numbers matching the specified filter.
                    WHERE i.serial_no_lvl > -1
						AND (ii.item_id =  @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
						AND (@serial_no IS NULL OR
							ii.lot_no IN (SELECT ii.lot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl = 0 AND ii.lot_no LIKE @serial_no) OR
							ii.sublot_no IN (SELECT ii.sublot_no FROM item_inv ii INNER JOIN item i ON ii.item_id = i.item_id AND i.serial_no_lvl > 0 AND ii.sublot_no LIKE @serial_no)
							)
						--If the item grade is specified in the filter, the entities listed will be limited
						--to those directly containing an item of that grade.
						AND (ii.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
						--if the dialog is opened in the context of a job for a work order requiring linear flow
						--and the user does not have the privilege to override hard pegged and linear flow
						--(so that the empty "From Operation" was forced by the choice of the item),
						--the entities listed will be limited to those directly containing inventory that was not made by any operation.
						AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (ii.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL))
						   OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.wo_id IS NULL)) )
						AND ( (@hard_pegged = 0 AND (ii.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL))
						   OR (@hard_pegged = 1 AND (ii.oper_id IS NULL)) )
				  )

			UNION ALL

			SELECT se.storage_ent_id AS ent_id
            FROM storage_exec se
            --if movable storage entities are included in the list, so are the non-movable storage entities
            --at which they are ultimately located.
				INNER JOIN StorageEntities ON se.ent_id = StorageEntities.ent_id
			WHERE se.movable = 1 and se.storage_ent_id is not null
		)

		SELECT DISTINCT se.ent_id, e.ent_name
		FROM StorageEntities se
			INNER JOIN ent e ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
        ORDER BY e.ent_name

    END

END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_item_process_link_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[item_process_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_item_process_link_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on item_process_link table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 2.1.0.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 06/07/2004	  Raghu		2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 10/29/2004     SJ            2106    HD#4973 Don't allow item_process_link.status to exceed that of the process
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @last_edit_by  NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
  IF '1' = (SELECT attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 207)
  BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
		(SELECT DISTINCT i.process_id FROM item_process_link ipl, inserted i
		   WHERE ipl.item_id = i.item_id AND ipl.process_id = i.process_id))
    BEGIN
      RAISERROR ('Certified processes cannot be modified.{4242}', 16, 1)
      RETURN
    END
  END
  --Check if the new status is greater than the allowed process status
  IF EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM inserted ipl INNER JOIN process p ON ipl.process_id = p.process_id
               WHERE ipl.status > p.process_status)
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Status of the item attached to a process cannot be greater than the process status.{4249}', 16, 1)
    RETURN
  END

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  UPDATE item_process_link SET item_process_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_process_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
    FROM inserted i WHERE item_process_link.item_id = i.item_id AND item_process_link.process_id = i.process_id
END

	INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) ON data_log.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON data_log.wo_id = wo.wo_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON data_log.wo_id = job.wo_id AND data_log.oper_id = job.oper_id AND data_log.seq_no = job.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step WITH (NOLOCK) ON data_log.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND data_log.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND data_log.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND data_log.step_no = job_step.step_no

	WHERE ((data_log.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.sample_time_utc = @sample_time_utc OR @sample_time_utc IS NULL)

	   AND (data_log.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.shift_start_local = @shift_start_local OR @shift_start_local IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.created_at_utc = @created_at_utc OR @created_at_utc IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.created_at_local = @created_at_local OR @created_at_local IS NULL)
	   AND (data_log.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
	   AND dlg.obsolete = 0
	)
	ORDER BY data_log.sample_time_utc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CLONE_job_spec]
	@wo_id string40,
	@oper_id string40,
	@seq_no int,
	@new_wo_id string40,
	@new_oper_id string40,
	@new_seq_no int

			@JS_assoc_file_type, @JS_comments, @JS_mod_id

/*

-- Name:		[Sp_u_ofi_st_trans_selection]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will update/insert silo details for
--              source/destination for stock Trasfer--
-- Usage:		Stock Transfer
--EXEC [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_st_trans_source] 1,541,'Beans'
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.01 	AP				2023-12-22			Initial version.
-- 0.01.02	Veervar			2024-01-30			Logic comments added.
-- 0.01.03	VJ				2024-03-04			Changes for saving selection locally. 6 new Parameters added.
-- 0.01.04	VJ				2024-03-20			Interlock added for concurrent requests with 60 sec wait time
-- 0.01.05	VJ				2024-03-22			removed update statement,Create new record for each call 
-- 0.01.06	MH				2025-10-24			Skip validating destination item if source item has the AllowReclassInTransfer attribute set 
-- ===========================================================================================
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_U_ofi_st_trans_selection](
    -- declare
    @ent_id INT,
    @src_su_ent_id INT,
    @src_item_id NVARCHAR(40),
    @dest_su_ent_id INT,
    @dest_item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
    @st_transfer_type INT,
    @target_qty FLOAT,
    @src_item_group NVARCHAR(40),
    @src_grade_cd INT,
    @last_edit_by NVARCHAR(100),
    @row_id INT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @TransferIdle VARCHAR(80) = 'STOPPED'
    DECLARE @transferStatusCdIdle INT
    DECLARE @errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @watiTimesec INT = 60000
    -- minimum time required between two start requests for same line


    --GET STATUS CODE FOR IDLE/STOPPED
    SELECT @transferStatusCdIdle = state_cd
    FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE state_desc = @TransferIdle


    -- Check if Line is already initiated by another user
    -- 0.01.04
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT TOP 1 1
        FROM Ofi_st_trans_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
            AND is_active = 1
            AND DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, last_edit_at_local, GETDATE()) < @watiTimesec
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @errorMessage = '@@STInProcessError@@'
        RAISERROR ( @errorMessage,16,1 );
        RETURN -1
    END


    -- Check if Line is already started by another user
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT TOP 1 1
        FROM Ofi_st_trans_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
            AND is_active = 1
            AND transfer_status_cd = 3
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @errorMessage = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400022, NULL, NULL)
        RAISERROR ( @errorMessage,16,1 );
        RETURN -1
    END

    -- [0.01.06 - CR 00203562]
    -- Set the destination item to the source item if the source item
    -- has the AllowReclassInTransfer attribute set
    DECLARE @AllowReclassInTransferAttrId AS int;
    SELECT @AllowReclassInTransferAttrId = [attr_id]
    FROM [attr] WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE [attr_desc] = 'AllowReclassInTransfer'
        AND [attr_grp] = 1 -- Item
        
    DECLARE @AllowReclassInTransferAttrValue AS bit;
    SELECT @AllowReclassInTransferAttrValue = IIF(attr_value = '1', 1, 0)
    FROM item_attr
    WHERE item_id = @src_item_id
      AND attr_id = @AllowReclassInTransferAttrId
    -- [/0.01.06 - CR 00203562]

    --RESET PREVIOUS RECORDS FOR THIS LINE
    UPDATE Ofi_st_trans_selection SET is_active=0 WHERE ent_id = @ent_id


    INSERT INTO Ofi_st_trans_selection (
        ent_id,
        src_su_ent_id,
        src_item_id,
        src_item_group,
        src_grade_cd,
        dest_su_ent_id,
        dest_item_id,
        dest_grade_cd,
        is_active,
        st_transfer_type,
        transfer_status_cd,
        target_qty,
        last_edit_by,
        last_edit_at_local,
        last_edit_at_utc,
        created_by,
        created_at_local,
        created_at_utc
    ) VALUES (
        @ent_id,
        @src_su_ent_id,
        @src_item_id,
        @src_item_group,
        @src_grade_cd,
        @dest_su_ent_id,
        IIF(
            @AllowReclassInTransferAttrValue = 1,
            @src_item_id,
            ISNULL(@dest_item_id, @src_item_id)),
        @src_grade_cd,
        1,
        @st_transfer_type,
        @transferStatusCdIdle,
        @target_qty,
        @last_edit_by,
        GETDATE(),
        GETUTCDATE(),
        @last_edit_by,
        GETDATE(),
        GETUTCDATE()
    )


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Res]
  (@res_id int OUT,
   @res_desc nvarchar(80) ,
   @res_class nvarchar(80) ,
   @qty_avail float ,
   @allow_neg_bal bit ,
   @num_decimals int ,
   @spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
   @spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_I_Res
-- Description    - Insert a row into the table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created   - 10/17/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1600  Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

 INSERT INTO res
 (res_desc,
  res_class,
  qty_avail,
  allow_neg_bal,
  num_decimals,
  spare1,
  spare2,
  spare3,
  spare4,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@res_desc,
   @res_class,
   @qty_avail,
   @allow_neg_bal,
   @num_decimals,
   @spare1,
   @spare2,
   @spare3,
   @spare4,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
SELECT @res_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

-- Return timestamp
--SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
FROM res
WHERE (res_id = @res_id)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GBFAppendToWhereClause]
(
	@WhereClause	NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@FilterName		NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@ParameterName	NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@FilterValue	NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name		- fn_GetByFilterAppendStringToWhereClause
-- Description		- Appends a string filter value to the supplied where clause using either a like or equals statement.
-- Author			- Rich Boyle
-- Date Created		- 06/25/2009
-- Version			- 4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 5/25/2017		RWB			6.0.0		For story 782078, added a parameter name parameter which is used to create a parameterized
--											SQL snippet
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
DECLARE  @TempWhereClause NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@CharIndex Int

		IF @WhereClause is null BEGIN
			SET @TempWhereClause = ''
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @TempWhereClause = @WhereClause
		END
		IF @TempWhereClause <> '' BEGIN
			SET @TempWhereClause = @TempWhereClause + ' AND '
		END
		SET @CharIndex = CHARINDEX('%', @FilterValue, 1)
		IF @CharIndex = 0 BEGIN
			SET @TempWhereClause = @TempWhereClause + @FilterName + ' = ' + @ParameterName
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @TempWhereClause = @TempWhereClause + @FilterName + ' LIKE ' + @ParameterName
		END
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @TempWhereClause

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_Exc_GetExceptions]
(@start_time	DATETIME
,@end_time	DATETIME
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Shift_Exc_GetExceptions
-- Description	      -	Returns a recordset of all shift exceptions in a given date range
--			New BR reqd doc (New Supervisor Business Rules.doc) from Rich B
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	06/30/2003
-- Version	      - 1.7.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

--IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time)
--IF @end_time IS NOT NULL SET @end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @end_time)

SELECT   ent_id
	--,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_exc.start_time) start_time
	--,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_exc.end_time) end_time
	,shift_exc.start_time
	,shift_exc.end_time
	,CASE shift_id   -- Null value should pass to UI, if it is null then it will mark it as holiday
	WHEN 0 THEN null
	ELSE shift_id
	END shift_id
	,additive
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) mod_id
FROM shift_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (start_time > @start_time AND start_time < @end_time)
   OR (end_time > @start_time  AND end_time < @end_time)
   OR (start_time < @start_time AND end_time > @end_time)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlush]

, @event_time_local TDATETIME = NULL
, @user_id		STRING40

, @job_pos		INT32 = 0
, @qty_prod		TFLOAT
, @from_ent_id		INT32=NULL
