--,@cont_id	             STRING40=NULL
, @genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
, @check_privs 		INT32 = 1
, @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlush
-- Description            -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 08/30/2002	Raghu		1.4		Removed Cont_id as a input parameter
-- 10/22/2002	TC		1.5.0		Read current lot data from job_bom not job_bom_exec
-- 10/26/2002	TC		1.5.0		Include job_pos as parameter and use where relevant
-- 11/20/2002	Rohit		1.5.0		Added logic the handle constant_qty flag of job_bom.
-- 12/03/2002	Raghu		1.5.0		Defaulted apply_scaling_factor to 0 for AddProd and AddCons
-- 12/18/2002	Rohit		1.5.0		Altered logic for constant_qty, to call item_cons insert only if qty_cons is less then @qty_per_parent if flag is set to true.
-- 05/01/2003	Raghu		1.6.3		Changed NULL (for fg_lot_no) to @lot_no param which is passed from Production to call Item_cons_AddCons
-- 06/23/2003	Raghu/Sheetal	1.6.11		(HD# 3304) Backflushing Consumption for bom_pos = 0
-- 11/05/2004	Raghu		2.1.8		HD# 3306, 3307, 3308, Redefine Must Consume from WIP, Backflush consumption from correct inventory record if only one
--02/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.13		HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
--04/15/2005	Raghu		2.1.19		HD# 5563, Cannot report production - joining to a job table is commented out as it is not required.
--07/26/2005	Raghu		2.1.25		HD# 5749, Second part of the problem related to Backflushing.
-- 08/19/2005	Raghu		2.1.26 		Added error message to language table, so that it can be translatable.
-- 01/09/2007     KRF           3.2.1           HD# 8314, part of DB changes - added @fg_sublot_no argument
-- 01/14/2008	AML			3.4.0		Updated argument list for call to [sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd].
-- 08/22/2012	Ravi Teja	 4.5		CR L00121836(Clone of L00121631) - Enforce backflush consumption from the default storage location even though only one
--                                      inventory location is present for that item.
-- 10/26/2012   Saiteja      4.6        Changed the string_id for error message More than one storage location available for backflush consumption for CR L00113727.
--07/31/2014    Srinivasa Tentu   5.0.0   UserStory:374735, Added @check_privs optional input parameter to check privileges conditionally.
-- 08/02/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:716502 - Renamed the cursor name
-- 09/27/2019	Raghu		6.2	UserStory: 1120685 - MOL: As Aveva, I want to merge L00151782 - Backflushing for substitutes does not work correctly
-- 04/27/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1302809-As Bruce, I want the Production Endpoint to better showcase the various Add prod methods (Part 2)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE
  @item_id 		STRING40
, @bom_pos 		INT32
, @qty_per_parent	TFLOAT
, @qty_cons		TFLOAT
, @cur_backflush        bit
, @return               INT32
, @cur_wo_id 		STRING40
, @cur_oper_id 		STRING40
, @cur_seq_no 		INT32
, @row_id		INT32
, @bConstant_Qty	LOGICAL
, @item_qty_cons	TFLOAT
, @contant_qty_cons	TFLOAT
, @item_id_same	INT
, @reqd_grade_cd	INT
, @must_consume_from_wip LOGICAL
, @lot_no		STRING40
, @sublot_no		STRING40 -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
, @row_count		INT
, @prod_info		NVARCHAR(4000)
--RaghuK 2/18/09 CR L00088636 Start
, @temp_ent_id		INT32
, @temp_count INT
, @first_ent_id INT32
, @item_inv_qty_left TFLOAT
, @sum_of_qty_left TFLOAT
, @def_from_ent_id INT32
, @first_job	LOGICAL
--RaghuK 2/18/09 CR L00088636 End
, @def_storage_ent_id INT32 -- Added for CR L00121836
, @current_subst	INT32

SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

-- TC 10/22/2002 First read current job data - needed to loop thru correct job_bom rows
-- Read current job data from the job_exec table
--RaghuK CR L00088636 Get the def_from_ent_id also from job_exec table
SET @def_from_ent_id = NULL
SELECT @cur_wo_id = cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id = cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no = cur_seq_no, @def_from_ent_id = def_from_ent_id
FROM  job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

-- 10/26/2002	TC	Include job_pos in WHERE clause
-- Read all rows from job_bom_exec for component and byproduct items (bom_pos <> 0)
DECLARE Job_Bom_Cursor_backflush CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
SELECT jb.bom_pos, jb.item_id, jb.reqd_grade_cd, jb.qty_per_parent_item, jb.backflush, jb.constant_qty, jb.must_consume_from_wip, j.first_job, jb.def_storage_ent_id, jb.current_subst
FROM Job_Bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
WHERE  jb.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jb.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jb.seq_no = @cur_seq_no

--Modified by Raghu on 06/19/2003. Eliminated bom_pos <> 0  to backflush bom_pos = 0
--WHERE  wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos <> 0
-- KRF 7/25/02 Eliminated "AND bom_pos > 0"  from above statement so backflushed byproducts are produced
-- TC 10/22/2002 Changed SQL to read from job_bom table instead
OPEN  Job_Bom_Cursor_backflush
WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM Job_Bom_Cursor_backflush INTO @bom_pos, @item_id, @reqd_grade_cd, @qty_per_parent
		, @cur_backflush, @bConstant_Qty, @must_consume_from_wip, @first_job, @def_storage_ent_id, @current_subst
	IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 BREAK

		IF (@current_subst IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst)
			SELECT @item_id = item_id, @reqd_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd, @qty_per_parent = qty_per_parent_item, @cur_backflush = backflush, @bConstant_Qty = constant_qty
				, @must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip, @def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			FROM job_bom_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND alt_no = @current_subst
		END

	IF (@cur_backflush = 1) BEGIN
		IF @qty_per_parent > 0 BEGIN
			-- Calculate the qty consumed of this item based on the qty_produced in this transaction
			IF @bConstant_Qty = 0 BEGIN
				SET @qty_cons = @qty_per_parent * @qty_prod
				SET @contant_qty_cons = 1
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @qty_cons = @qty_per_parent
				-- Added by Rohit 12/18/02
				SELECT @item_qty_cons = qty_cons FROM item_cons  WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no
				  AND item_id = @item_id
				IF @item_qty_cons IS NULL SET @item_qty_cons = 0
				IF @item_qty_cons < @qty_cons BEGIN
					IF @item_qty_cons > 0 SET @qty_cons = @qty_cons - @item_qty_cons
					SET @contant_qty_cons = @qty_cons - @item_qty_cons
				END
				ELSE SET @contant_qty_cons = -1
			END

			SELECT @row_count = 0, @item_id_same = 0
--			IF (@bom_pos = 0) EXEC @item_id_same = sp_SA_Item_Prod_IsSameProduced @cur_wo_id, @cur_oper_id, @cur_seq_no, @item_id
			-- Now call the normal SP to Add consumption for this row
			-- Pass nulls for all values that this SP reads from job_bom anyway
			--EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @bom_pos, @qty_cons, @reas_cd, @lot_no, @cont_id, NULL,
				--@from_ent_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
			-- IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			-- EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @bom_pos, @qty_cons, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
			-- KRF 7/25/02 3 lines below were 2 lines above - changed so backflushed byproducts are produced
			--Modified by Raghu on 08/30/2002 . Removed cont_id parameter, which was passed to AddCons, AddProd procedures
			-- 10/26/2002	TC   Include job_pos as parameter and use where relevant
			--Raghu 12/03/2002. Defaulted apply_scaling_factor to 0 for AddProd and AddCons
			IF @contant_qty_cons > 0 BEGIN
				SELECT @from_ent_id = NULL, @lot_no = NULL, @sublot_no = NULL

				IF (@bom_pos = 0) BEGIN
					--Check for the qts ONLY if wip is true, otherwise ignore checking for quantities.
					IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
						IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND first_job != 1) BEGIN
							SET @item_id_same = 1
--							SELECT @row_count = COUNT(*) FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
--							INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
--							INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
--							INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
--							      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
--							WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
--							  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_prod
--							  AND (lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (item_inv.lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
--							  AND (sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (item_inv.sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
--							IF (@row_count = 1)
--								SELECT @from_ent_id = ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
--								INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
--								INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
--								INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
--								      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
--								WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
--								  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_prod
--								  AND (lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (item_inv.lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
--								  AND (sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (item_inv.sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
--							ELSE IF (@row_count = 0) BEGIN
--								RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
--								RETURN -1
--							END
							SELECT @from_ent_id = NULL
							IF NOT @def_from_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
								-- Rich Boyle 11/12/2010 CR L00108366 (rolled in from HF 1482) Include lot_no, sublot_no in the SELECT clause so that the inventory is updated correctly for serialized parts.
								SELECT @from_ent_id = item_inv.ent_id, @lot_no = item_inv.lot_no, @sublot_no = item_inv.sublot_no FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
								WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
									  --HF1479
									  --AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND ((grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND (grade_cd NOT IN (SELECT item_grade_cd FROM item_grade WHERE scrapped = 1))) AND qty_left >= @qty_prod
									  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND ((grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd) OR (@reqd_grade_cd IS NULL AND (grade_cd IN (SELECT item_grade_cd FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE good_prod = 1)))) AND qty_left >= @qty_prod
									  AND (lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (item_inv.lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
									  AND (sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (item_inv.sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
									  AND item_inv.ent_id = @def_from_ent_id
							END
							IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
								--If there is no def_from_ent_id specified for this job, then find all the storage locations that
								--have the good inventory that is produced by the upstream job or jobs
								DECLARE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
								-- Rich Boyle 11/12/2010 CR L00108366 (rolled in from HF 1482) Include lot_no, sublot_no in the SELECT clause so that the inventory is updated correctly for serialized parts.
								SELECT item_inv.ent_id, item_inv.qty_left, item_inv.lot_no, item_inv.sublot_no FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
									INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
								WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
									  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND ((grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND (grade_cd IN (SELECT item_grade_cd FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE good_prod = 1)))
									  AND (lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (item_inv.lot_no IS NULL AND @fg_lot_no IS NULL))
									  AND (sublot_no = @fg_sublot_no OR (item_inv.sublot_no IS NULL AND @fg_sublot_no IS NULL))

								SELECT @temp_count = 0
								SELECT @sum_of_qty_left = 0
								OPEN Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor
								WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
									-- Rich Boyle 11/12/2010 CR L00108366 (rolled in from HF 1482) fetch the lot_no and sublot_no so that the inventory is updated correctly for serialized parts.
									FETCH NEXT FROM Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor INTO @temp_ent_id, @item_inv_qty_left, @lot_no, @sublot_no  --RaghuK 7/2/2009 CR L00093710 (HF 1482)

									IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 BREAK
									SET @temp_count = @temp_count + 1
									IF( @temp_count = 1) BEGIN
										SELECT @first_ent_id = @temp_ent_id
									END
									--If the upstream job(s) produced to more than one storage location raise an error
									IF (@first_ent_id <> @temp_ent_id) BEGIN
										RAISERROR ('More than one storage location available for backflush consumption{7593}', 16, 1)
										RETURN -1
									END
									SET @sum_of_qty_left = @sum_of_qty_left + @item_inv_qty_left
								END
								--If there is no storage location available raise an error
								IF (@temp_count = 0) BEGIN
									RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
									RETURN -1
								END
								--The upstream job(s) have produced the inventory to only one storage location, so choose that storage location as one
								--from which to consume the inventory
								IF (@sum_of_qty_left >= @qty_prod) BEGIN
									SELECT @from_ent_id = @first_ent_id
								END
								ELSE BEGIN
									RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
									RETURN -1
								END
								CLOSE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor
								DEALLOCATE Item_Inv_Job_Route_Cursor
							END
						END
						--RaghuK 2/18/09 CR L00088636  End
					END
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					IF (@must_consume_from_wip = 1) BEGIN
						SELECT @row_count = COUNT(*) FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
--						INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
--						INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
--						      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
						WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
						  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons
						IF (@row_count = 1) BEGIN
							SELECT  @from_ent_id = ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = item_inv.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = item_inv.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = item_inv.seq_no
--							INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
--							INNER JOIN job j1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = j1.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = j1.seq_no
--							      AND j.wo_id = j1.wo_id AND j.item_id = j1.item_id
							WHERE jr.wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND jr.oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND jr.seq_no = @cur_seq_no
							  AND item_inv.item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons
						END
						ELSE IF (@row_count = 0) BEGIN
							RAISERROR ('Inventory does not have sufficient quantities to consume from the previous job{4674}', 16, 1)
							RETURN -1
						END
					END
					ELSE BEGIN
						-- CR L00121836 - Enforce the backflush consumption from the default storage location even when we have
						-- single lot present in the inventory for that item unless we have no default location.
						IF (@def_storage_ent_id IS NULL) AND 1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons) BEGIN
							SELECT  @from_ent_id = ent_id, @lot_no = lot_no, @sublot_no = sublot_no FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE item_id = @item_id AND (grade_cd = @reqd_grade_cd OR @reqd_grade_cd IS NULL) AND qty_left >= @qty_cons
						END
					END
				END

				-- Added NULL values for the subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/20/2009 RWB
				IF @bom_pos > 0 EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons @session_id=@session_id, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id
							, @job_pos=@job_pos, @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @qty_cons=@qty_cons, @reas_cd=NULL, @lot_no=@lot_no, @fg_lot_no=@fg_lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no
							, @fg_sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=NULL, @ext_ref=NULL, @apply_scaling_factor=0
							, @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id=NULL, @segment_requirement_id=NULL, @segment_response_id=NULL
							, @comments=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @created_at_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT
				IF @bom_pos < 0 BEGIN
					EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd @session_id=@session_id, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id
								, @job_pos=@job_pos, @qty_prod=@qty_cons, @reas_cd=NULL, @lot_no=NULL, @sublot_no=NULL, @to_ent_id=@ent_id
								, @item_id=@item_id, @byproduct_bom_pos=@bom_pos, @ext_ref=NULL, @apply_scaling_factor=0, @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id
								, @event_id=NULL, @segment_requirement_id=NULL, @segment_response_id=NULL, @comments=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL
								, @check_privs=@check_privs, @created_at_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT, @prod_info=@prod_info OUTPUT
				END
				-- Added NULL values for the subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/20/2009 RWB
				--IF (@bom_pos = 0 AND @item_id_same = 1)  EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons @session_id,@event_time_local, @user_id, @ent_id, @job_pos, @bom_pos, @qty_cons, NULL, @lot_no, @fg_lot_no, @sublot_no, @fg_sublot_no, @from_ent_id, NULL, NULL, 0,@genealogy_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, @row_id OUTPUT
				IF (@bom_pos = 0 AND @first_job <> 1)  EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons @session_id=@session_id, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @user_id=@user_id, @ent_id=@ent_id
										, @job_pos=@job_pos, @bom_pos=@bom_pos, @qty_cons=@qty_cons, @reas_cd=NULL, @lot_no=@lot_no, @fg_lot_no=@fg_lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no
										, @fg_sublot_no=@fg_sublot_no, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @item_id=NULL, @ext_ref=NULL, @apply_scaling_factor=0
										, @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id, @upstream_event_id=NULL, @segment_requirement_id=NULL, @segment_response_id=NULL
										, @comments=NULL, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @created_at_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT
			END
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END
END
--below block is commented by Nagaraju on 05-21-02.
--now all the rows will be read from job_bom where bom_pos <>0
-- Calculate the qty consumed of this item based on the qty_produced in this transaction
--IF @qty_per_parent >= 0 BEGIN
--	SET @qty_cons = @qty_per_parent * @qty_prod
	-- Now call the normal SP to Add consumption for this row
	-- Pass nulls for all values that this SP reads from job_bom anyway
--	EXECUTE sp_I_Item_Cons_AddCons @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @bom_pos, @qty_cons, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,

CLOSE Job_Bom_Cursor_backflush
DEALLOCATE Job_Bom_Cursor_backflush
SET NOCOUNT OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Inv_Split]
(
		@old_row_id				INT32
	,	@old_last_edit_at		TDATETIME
	,	@split_qty				TFLOAT
	,	@new_ent_id				INT32
	,	@new_item_id			STRING40

	,	@new_sublot_no			STRING40
	,	@new_grade_cd			INT32

	,	@split_qty_erp			TFLOAT
	,	@new_uom_id				INT32
	,	@new_expiry_date		INT32
	,	@transfer_comments		STRING254
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- Description			-

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 08/30/2002		Raghu			1.4		Removed Cont_id
-- 09/09/2002		Raghu			1.4		Get Log_Trans option value from system_attribute =198 and log inventory transfers if this attribute is set to 1
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit			1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/17/2003		Raghu			1.5.5	(HD# 2273) Lot_No changed to allow NULL values

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@old_ent_id				INT32
		,	@old_item_id			STRING40

		,	@can_store				LOGICAL
		,	@status					STRING80
		,	@cur_qty_left			TFLOAT
		,	@ent_id					INT32
		,	@item_id				STRING40
		,	@lot_no					STRING40
		,	@sublot_no				STRING40
		,	@cur_grade_cd			INT32
		,	@cur_status_cd			INT32
		,	@cur_expiry_date		TDATETIME

		,	@cur_date_out_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@cur_date_out_local		TDATETIME
		,	@cur_seq_no				INT32
		,	@cur_qty_left_erp		TFLOAT
		,	@cur_date_in_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@cur_date_in_local		TDATETIME
		,	@cur_last_edit_at		TDATETIME
		,	@grade_cd				INT32
		,	@status_cd				INT32
		,	@expiry_date			TDATETIME
		,	@wo_id					STRING40
		,	@oper_id				STRING40
		,	@seq_no					INT32
		,	@qty_left				TFLOAT
		,	@qty_left_erp			TFLOAT
		,	@new_row_id				INT32
		,	@cur_total_qtys			TFLOAT
		,	@max_capacity			TFLOAT
		,	@log_trans				LOGICAL
		,	@cur_shift_id			INT32

		,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME

		,	@cur_reas_cd			INT32
		,	@scrapped				LOGICAL
		,	@user_id				STRING80
		,	@last_edit_at_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@last_edit_at_local		TDATETIME
		,	@transaction_type		INT32
		,	@tz_temp				INT32

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	--Set default values
	IF ((@split_qty_erp IS NULL) OR (@split_qty_erp = '')) SET @split_qty_erp = 0
	IF @log_trans IS NULL SET @log_trans = 1
	--Default transaction_type as combine lot
	SET @transaction_type = 2

	--If the new_ent_id does not have the can_store capability return error
	SELECT @can_store = can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  ent_id = @new_ent_id
	IF (@can_store=0) BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('The destination entity does not have the can_store capability{3213}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT	@old_ent_id = ent_id
		,	@old_item_id = item_id
		,	@old_lot_no = lot_no
		,	@old_sublot_no = sublot_no
		,	@cur_grade_cd = grade_cd
		,	@cur_status_cd = status_cd
		,	@cur_qty_left = qty_left
		,	@cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
		,	@cur_date_in_utc = date_in_utc
		,	@cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc
		,	@cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		,	@cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
		,	@cur_wo_id = wo_id
		,	@cur_oper_id = oper_id
		,	@cur_seq_no = seq_no
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @old_row_id

	SELECT	@ent_id = @old_ent_id
		,	@item_id = @old_item_id
		,	@lot_no = @old_lot_no
		,	@sublot_no = @old_sublot_no

	--check if the source row exists
	IF @cur_qty_left IS NULL BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('The source does not exist{3203}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END
	--There is no quantity left in the source row so cannot be split
	IF @cur_qty_left = 0 BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('The current quantity of item in the source is zero hence it cannot be split{3214}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT	@grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd
		,	@grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd
		,	@status_cd = @cur_status_cd
		,	@expiry_date = @cur_expiry_date
		,	@wo_id = @cur_wo_id
		,	@oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		,	@seq_no = @cur_seq_no
		,	@qty_left = @cur_qty_left
		,	@qty_left_erp = @cur_qty_left_erp

	EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL,@last_edit_at_utc OUTPUT, @last_edit_at_local OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @last_edit_at_utc )

	--return error if the split quantity is greater than the qty in the source row
	IF NOT ((@split_qty <= @qty_left)) BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('The quantity of item to be split should be less than or equal to the source quantity{3215}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END
	--If none of the destination fields are mentioned return error
	IF(((@new_ent_id IS NULL) OR (@new_ent_id = '')) AND ((@new_item_id IS NULL)OR(@new_item_id = ''))AND
	   ((@new_lot_no IS NULL)OR(@new_lot_no = ''))) BEGIN
	   RAISERROR('Atleast one field in the destination location should be specified{3216}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END
	---If any of the destination fields are not mentioned then they will get the source row value
	IF (@new_ent_id IS NULL) OR (@new_ent_id = '') SET @new_ent_id = @old_ent_id
	IF (@new_item_id IS NULL) OR (@new_item_id = '') SET @new_item_id = @old_item_id
	IF (@new_lot_no IS NULL) OR (@new_lot_no = '') SET @new_lot_no = @old_lot_no
	IF (@new_sublot_no IS NULL) OR (@new_sublot_no = '') SET @new_sublot_no = @old_sublot_no
	--IF (@new_cont_id IS NULL) OR (@new_cont_id = '') SET @new_cont_id = @old_cont_id
	IF (@new_grade_cd IS NULL) OR (@new_grade_cd = '') SET @new_grade_cd =@grade_cd
	IF (@new_status_cd IS NULL) OR (@new_status_cd = '') SET @new_status_cd = @status_cd
	IF ((@new_ent_id = @old_ent_id) AND (@new_item_id = @old_item_id) AND (@new_lot_no =@old_lot_no)) BEGIN
	--   AND(@new_cont_id = @old_cont_id)) BEGIN
	   RAISERROR(' rows cannot be the same{3217}', 16, 1)
	   RETURN -1
	END

	--Added by Raghu on 07/03/2003. (HD# 3362) Max capacity in a storage location will go only on per entity basis in item_inv; not on lot or items
	SELECT @max_capacity = ISNULL(max_capacity, 0) FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @new_ent_id
	SELECT @cur_total_qtys = ISNULL(SUM(qty_left), 0) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @new_ent_id
	IF (@max_capacity <> 0) AND ((@cur_total_qtys + @split_qty) > @max_capacity) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Total Quantity cannot exceed the max capacity{3205}', 16, 1, @@error)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @cur_qty_left = NULL
	SET @cur_qty_left_erp = NULL

	--check if the destination row exists
	SET @ent_id = @new_ent_id
	SET @item_id = @new_item_id
	SET @lot_no = @new_lot_no
	SET @sublot_no = @new_sublot_no
	--SET @cont_id = @new_cont_id
	--Modifed by Raghu on 08/30/2002.  Use Select query with row_id to get the dependant data
	/*EXECUTE sp_S_item_inv_GetDepData @ent_id, @item_id, @lot_no, @cont_id, @cur_grade_cd OUTPUT,
	@cur_status_cd OUTPUT, @cur_qty_left OUTPUT, @cur_qty_left_erp OUTPUT, @cur_date_in OUTPUT, @cur_date_out OUTPUT,
	@cur_last_edit_at OUTPUT, @cur_expiry_date OUTPUT, @cur_wo_id OUTPUT, @cur_oper_id OUTPUT, @cur_seq_no OUTPUT*/
	--Get the New Row Id for the new_ent_id, new_item_id, new_lot_no, new_cont_id
	SELECT	@new_row_id = row_id
		,	@cur_qty_left = qty_left
		,	@cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
		,	@cur_date_in_utc = date_in_utc
		,	@cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc
		,	@cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
		,	@cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
		,	@cur_wo_id = wo_id
		,	@cur_oper_id = oper_id
		,	@cur_seq_no = seq_no
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND
		  item_id = @item_id AND
		 (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL)) AND
		 (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))

	SET @cur_date_in_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @cur_date_in_utc )
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	----If any of the parameter values are NULL,replace with default values
	IF @cur_qty_left IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		IF @cur_qty_left_erp IS NULL SET @cur_qty_left_erp = 0

		--check if the dependent fields of the source and the destination fields match
		IF ((@grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd) AND (@status_cd = @cur_status_cd) AND (@expiry_date = @cur_expiry_date)) BEGIN
		--The dependent fields match, hence update the destination and the source rows
			UPDATE item_inv
			SET	qty_left = @cur_qty_left + @split_qty,
				qty_left_erp = @cur_qty_left_erp + @split_qty_erp,
				date_in_utc = @cur_date_in_utc,
				date_in_local = DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @cur_date_in_utc ),
				date_out_utc = NULL,
				date_out_local = NULL,
				last_edit_at = @last_edit_at_utc
			WHERE row_id = @new_row_id

			--If error in updating the destination row, return error
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			   RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating the destination row{3206}', 16, 1, @@error)
			   RETURN -1
			END

			--Update the source row
			UPDATE item_inv
			SET qty_left = @qty_left - @split_qty,
				qty_left_erp = @qty_left_erp - @split_qty_erp,
				date_out_utc = NULL,
				date_out_local = NULL,
				last_edit_at = @last_edit_at_utc
			WHERE row_id = @old_row_id

			--If error in updating the source row, return error
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			   RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating item_inv table{3209}', 16, 1, @@error)
			   RETURN -1
			END
		 END
		 ELSE BEGIN
			--return error if the source and destination dependent fields do not match
			RAISERROR('The dependent fields do not match hence,cannot update the source and destination rows{3218}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		 END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		EXEC SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADDLOTSUBLOT @new_item_id, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no,@new_grade_cd,@new_status_cd
		--Insert a new row
		INSERT INTO item_inv
		(
			ent_id, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd, qty_left, qty_left_erp,
			date_in_utc, date_in_local, date_out_utc, date_out_local, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
			expiry_date, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@new_ent_id, @new_item_id, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_grade_cd, @new_status_cd,
			@split_qty, @split_qty_erp, @cur_date_in_utc, DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @cur_date_in_utc ), NULL, NULL, @user_id,
			@last_edit_at_utc, @expiry_date, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
		)

		--Return error if insertion fails
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('SQL ERROR inserting into item_inv table: %d{3209}', 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN -1
		END

		SET @transaction_type = 1

		--Update the source row
		UPDATE item_inv
		SET qty_left = @qty_left - @split_qty,
			qty_left_erp = @qty_left_erp - @split_qty_erp,
			date_out_utc = NULL,
			date_out_local = NULL,
			last_edit_at = @last_edit_at_utc
		WHERE row_id = @old_row_id

		--If error in updating the source row, return error
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating item_inv table after insertion of the destination row{3219}', 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN -1
		END

	END

	--if update or insert was successful then, check if the log_trans is 'true'
	--if true then insert a new row in item_transfer table
	--Get Log_Inventory Transfers system_attr
	SELECT @log_trans = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 198
	IF (@log_trans = 1) BEGIN
		--return error if insertion fails
		INSERT INTO item_transfer
		(
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, to_ent_id, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd,
			qty_txd, uom_id, expiry_date, to_spare1, to_spare2, to_spare3, to_spare4, to_spare5, to_spare6,
			from_ent_id, from_item_id, from_lot_no, from_sublot_no, from_grade_cd, from_status_cd,
			from_qty_txd, from_uom_id, from_expiry_date, from_spare1, from_spare2, from_spare3, from_spare4,
			from_spare5, from_spare6, qty_txd_erp, goods_received, goods_shipped, transfer_list_row_id,
			comments, transfer_by, transfer_time_utc, transfer_time_local
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, NULL, @new_ent_id, @new_item_id, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_grade_cd,
			@new_status_cd, @split_qty, @new_uom_id, @new_expiry_date, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
			@old_ent_id, @old_item_id, @old_lot_no, @old_sublot_no, @cur_grade_cd, @cur_status_cd,
			@split_qty, NULL, @cur_expiry_date, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @split_qty_erp, 0, 0,
			NULL, @transfer_comments, @user_id, @last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_at_local
		)

	   IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
		  RAISERROR('SQL Error inserting into item_transfer table: %d{3210}', 16, 1, @@error)
		  RETURN -1
	   END
	END

	-- Create an item_cons record
	SELECT	@cur_shift_id = cur_shift_id
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_local = @cur_shift_start_time_local
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @old_ent_id

	SELECT @cur_reas_cd = MIN(reas_cd) FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd AND item_status_cd = @cur_status_cd

	IF (@cur_reas_cd IS NULL) SELECT @cur_reas_cd = MIN(reas_cd) FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @cur_grade_cd
	IF (@cur_reas_cd IS NULL) SELECT @cur_reas_cd = MIN(reas_cd) FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK)

	SELECT @scrapped = scrapped FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = (SELECT item_grade_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd)

	INSERT INTO item_cons
	(
		wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, reas_cd, user_id,
		item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, ext_ref,
		transaction_type, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local
	)
	VALUES
	(
		@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @new_item_id, @old_lot_no,
		@new_lot_no, @old_sublot_no, @sublot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id, @scrapped, NULL, @cur_shift_id, @cur_grade_cd, @cur_status_cd,
		@old_ent_id, @split_qty, 0, NULL, @transaction_type, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @user_id, @last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_at_local
	)

END

-- =======================================================================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_Onload_AutoRun]
(
@I_SessionId int
,@I_User_Name nvarchar(50)
--@scheduleDay datetime = '2017-02-15',

)
AS
BEGIN
declare  @ent_name NVARCHAR(50)
DECLARE @SQLString nvarchar(500);  
DECLARE @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500); 
DECLARE @rowid int
Declare @I_SPNAME NVARCHAR(500)
Declare @FunctionToExecute Table( rowid int, spname nvarchar(500))

Insert into @FunctionToExecute (rowid,spname)
select RunAtLoadOrder, StoredProcedure from [SDB].[dbo].[Scheduler_Custom_Functions] with (nolock)  where RunAtLoadOrder > 0 order by RunAtLoadOrder

SET @rowid = (select top 1 (rowid) from @FunctionToExecute) 

while  @rowid is not null
BEGIN

	select @I_SPNAME = spname from @FunctionToExecute where rowid = @rowid

SET @SQLString = N'exec ' + @I_SPNAME + ' @SessionId, @user_name'		
	SET @ParmDefinition = N'@SessionId int, @user_name  nvarchar(50)';
--print cast(cast(getdate() as datetime2(3)) as varchar(100)) + '   start autorun ' + @SQLString;
EXECUTE sp_executesql @SQLString, @ParmDefinition,  
                     @SessionId = @I_SessionId, @user_name = @I_User_Name;

						delete from @FunctionToExecute where rowid = @rowid
						SET @rowid = (select top 1(rowid) from @FunctionToExecute) 
--print cast(cast(getdate() as datetime2(3)) as varchar(100)) + '   end autorun ' + @SQLString;
END
	

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2023-01-24         Initial version.
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-02-09		   Refer to the comments in the SP on this date
-- 0.01.03  Lavkesh     2024-05-16		   For posting date changed last_edit_at field to created_at_local
-- 0.01.04  Michal H    2024-09-02         Fix incorrect timestamp format - change the erroneous 12-hour format specifier ("hhmmss")
--                                         to the 24-hour format specifier ("HHmmss").
-- 0.01.05	OT			2025-07-02			Adjustment for RM production in PRO - related to problem with production reporting to SAP on Bean Rework
-- 0.02.00	MC			2025-08-01			Rebuild selecting data to be reported - agregation by lot number - rebuild whole SP
-- 0.02.10	MC			2025-09-11			Add minimum frequency for reporting data
-- 0.02.11	MC			2025-10-28			Additional safeguard to not report prod for MES wo
-- ===========================================================================================
-- exec sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg_new
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_confirm_sfg]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Error handling variables
    DECLARE @error_msg NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @error_severity INT,
            @error_state INT;

    -- Parameters and working variables
    DECLARE @delay_hours INT = 0; -- report data older than @delay_hours
	DECLARE @cutoff_date DATETIME; -- time threshold for data selection
	-- 0.02.10 new attributes
	DECLARE @frequency_hours INT = 1;	--  report data every X hours for each batch
	DECLARE @interface NVARCHAR(40) = 'PROD_CONF_DETAILS' --ei interface name
	DECLARE @row_id int --ofi_ei_interface_last_execution table row id

    DECLARE @lot_no VARCHAR(100),
            @wo_id VARCHAR(100),
            @item_id VARCHAR(100)

    -- Temporary table to store production data
    DECLARE @productionSFG TABLE (
        wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
        item_id NVARCHAR(40),
		sap_item_id NVARCHAR(40),
        lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
        qty_prod DECIMAL(18,3),
        qty_prod_erp DECIMAL(18,3),
        unit NVARCHAR(40),
        bags_per_pallet NVARCHAR(40),
        created_at_local DATETIME,
        row_id INT
    );

    BEGIN TRY
        -- Calculate cutoff time
        SET @cutoff_date = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, -@delay_hours, GETUTCDATE())), 0);

        -- Load production data into temporary table	
		INSERT INTO @productionSFG
        SELECT
            ip.wo_id,
            ip.item_id,
            sap.attr_value AS sap_item_id,
            ip.lot_no,
            ip.qty_prod,
            ip.qty_prod_erp,
            u.description AS unit,
            wo.bags_per_pallet,
            ip.created_at_local,
            ip.row_id
        FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN ofi_wo_ext wo WITH(NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND wo.module <> 'PO'
        INNER JOIN wo w ON w.wo_id = wo.wo_id AND w.state_cd < 3
        INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
        INNER JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
        INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON ip.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jb.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = 0 AND ip.item_id = jb.item_id
        LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT oa.oper_id, oa.attr_value
		FROM oper_attr oa
		JOIN attr a ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
		WHERE a.attr_desc = 'NotProduceToSAP'
		) oa_filtered ON oa_filtered.oper_id = ip.oper_id
		LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT ia.item_id, ia.attr_value
			FROM item_attr ia
			JOIN attr a ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
			WHERE a.attr_desc = 'sap_item_id'
		) sap ON sap.item_id = ip.item_id
		LEFT JOIN ofi_ei_interface_last_execution ile ON ile.wo_id=ip.wo_id AND ile.lot_no=ip.lot_no AND ile.item_id=ip.item_id AND ile.interface=@interface -- -- 0.02.10 join with execution history table
        WHERE CAST(qty_prod_erp AS DECIMAL(18,3)) <> CAST(qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,3))
          AND i.item_class_id IN ('SFG', 'RM')
          AND ip.lot_no IS NOT NULL
          AND ip.created_at_utc < @cutoff_date
          AND (oa_filtered.attr_value IS NULL OR oa_filtered.attr_value <> '1') -- exclude operations with NotProduceToSAP = 1
		  AND (ile.last_sent_at IS NULL OR ile.last_sent_at < DATEADD(hour,-@frequency_hours,GETDATE())) -- -- 0.02.10 exclude batches sent in the last time window
		  AND ISNULL(w.spare1,'0')='1' -- 0.02.11

		-- If there is data to report
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @productionSFG)
        BEGIN
            -- Select the oldest production group to report
            SELECT TOP 1
                @wo_id = wo_id,
                @lot_no = lot_no,
                @item_id = item_id
            FROM @productionSFG
            ORDER BY created_at_local;
			
			-- Generate report
			SELECT
				'' AS Handling_Unit_Number,
				wo_id AS Order_Number,
				'101' AS Movement_Type,
				bags_per_pallet AS Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet,
				SUM(qty_prod - qty_prod_erp) AS Quantity,
				unit AS Unit_of_Measure,
				COALESCE(t.sap_item_id,t.item_id) AS SAP_MaterialCode_Number,
				FORMAT(MIN(created_at_local), 'yyyyMMdd') AS Production_startdate,
				FORMAT(MIN(created_at_local), 'HHmmss') AS Production_starttime,
				FORMAT(MAX(created_at_local), 'yyyyMMdd') AS Production_enddate,
				FORMAT(MAX(created_at_local), 'HHmmss') AS Production_endtime,
				lot_no AS SAP_Batch_Number,
				FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMdd') AS File_Generation_Date,
				FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmss') AS File_Generation_Time,
				'' AS Document_Number,
				'' AS Message,
				'' AS Message
			FROM @productionSFG t
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND lot_no = @lot_no AND t.item_id = @item_id
			GROUP BY t.wo_id, t.lot_no, t.item_id, t.sap_item_id, t.bags_per_pallet, unit;

			-- Update ERP quantities
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
				UPDATE ip
				SET ip.qty_prod_erp = t.qty_prod
				FROM item_prod ip
				INNER JOIN (
					SELECT row_id, qty_prod
					FROM @productionSFG
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND lot_no = @lot_no AND item_id = @item_id
				) t ON ip.row_id = t.row_id;
				
				-- 0.02.10 update history execution table
				SELECT @row_id=id from ofi_ei_interface_last_execution WHERE interface = @interface AND wo_id=@wo_id AND lot_no=@lot_no AND item_id=@item_id

				IF @row_id IS NOT NULL --if already exist update timestamp
					UPDATE dbo.ofi_ei_interface_last_execution
					SET last_sent_at = GETDATE()
					WHERE id = @row_id;
				ELSE -- else create new record
					INSERT INTO ofi_ei_interface_last_execution (wo_id, lot_no, item_id, interface, last_sent_at)
					VALUES (@wo_id, @lot_no, @item_id, @interface, GETDATE())


            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        END
    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @error_severity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @error_state = ERROR_STATE();

        RAISERROR(@error_msg, @error_severity, @error_state);
    END CATCH
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:        sp_sa_ofi_correction_recipe
-- Description:	Get the cake blender recipe based on manual and system prodiction

-- Usage:       BOM correction recipe grid data
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author                  Date (yyyy-MM-dd)       Change description
-- 0.01.00      AKM							2023-08-09            Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_ofi_correction_recipe]
@wo_id nvarchar(40),
@oper_id nvarchar(40),
@seq_no INT,
@spare1 nvarchar(40),
@is_man int
AS
BEGIN
		SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @job_qty_reqd int 

	declare @corrType nvarchar(40), @corrVal float
	select @corrType=phCorrectionType1, @corrVal =pHCorrectionValue1 from ofi_cb_sample_results(nolock) where spare1=@spare1 and is_manual=@is_man
	if(@corrType in ('O-salt','55022 CITRIC ACID'))
	set @corrType='55022 CITRIC ACID'
	if(@corrType in ('B-salt','55065 POTASSIUM CARBONATE POWD'))
	set @corrType='55065 POTASSIUM CARBONATE POWD'

	declare @pHcorrectionT table(item_desc nvarchar(40), correctionVal float)
	insert into @pHcorrectionT(item_desc, correctionVal)
	values(@corrType,@corrVal)

	if exists(select 1 from ofi_correction_recipe(nolock) where spare1=@spare1)
	BEGIN
			--select top 1 @job_qty_reqd = qty_reqd from job with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and  oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no  
			select top 1 @job_qty_reqd = qty_reqd - qty_prod from job with(nolock) where wo_id =@wo_id and  oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no  
			-- Insert statements for procedure here
			SELECT jb.item_id,
				i.item_desc,
				ROUND(( ocr.qty_per_parent_item * 100 ),2) AS qty_percent,
				ROUND(( ocr.qty_per_parent_item * ( j.qty_reqd - j.qty_prod ) ),2) AS qty_reqd,
				ia.attr_value AS category,
				ia2.attr_value AS material_type,
				ocr.qty_per_parent_item as qty_per_parent_item,
				ocr.row_id,
				@job_qty_reqd as job_qty_reqd,
				null as man_qty_percent,
				null as man_qty_reqd
			FROM   job_bom(nolock) jb
			left join ofi_correction_recipe ocr WITH (nolock)
			on ocr.item_id = jb.item_id and ocr.spare1=@spare1
				left JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
						ON i.item_id = jb.item_id and jb.wo_id=@wo_id
				INNER JOIN job j WITH (nolock)
						ON j.wo_id = @wo_id
							AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
							AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
				INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (nolock)
						ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
				INNER JOIN attr a with (nolock)
						ON a.attr_id = ia.attr_id
							AND a.attr_desc = 'Category'
							AND a.attr_grp = 1 
			INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (nolock)
						ON ia2.item_id = i.item_id
				INNER JOIN attr a2 with (nolock)
						ON a2.attr_id = ia2.attr_id
							AND a2.attr_desc = 'MaterialType'
							AND a2.attr_grp = 1 
							where
							jb.wo_id=@wo_id and  jb.oper_id=@oper_id and jb.seq_no=@seq_no and jb.bom_pos>0

		UNION
			  -- Insert statements for procedure here
			SELECT jb.item_id,
			   i.item_desc,
			   0   AS qty_percent ,
			  ph.correctionVal AS  qty_reqd,
			   ia.attr_value AS category,
			   'Additives' AS material_type,
			  0 as qty_per_parent_item,
			   jb.row_id,
			   0 as job_qty_reqd,
			   null as man_qty_percent,
				null as man_qty_reqd
			  from job_bom jb 
			  inner join item(nolock) i on i.item_id=jb.item_id
				   inner join item_attr(nolock) ia on jb.item_id = ia.item_id and ia.attr_value ='additives'
				   left join @pHcorrectionT ph on ph.item_desc = i.item_desc
				   where jb.wo_id=@wo_id and  jb.oper_id=@oper_id and jb.seq_no=@seq_no and jb.bom_pos>0
	END
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_item_inv_verfyinvpropxml]
(
	@xml_source					NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32_NULL = 0
,	@properties_are_identical	INT32  OUTPUT
,	@properties_differ_info		NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT

)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_SA_ITEM_INV_VERFYINVPROPXML
-- Description	      - HD# 3654, Verifies inventory properties such as grade_cd, status_cd and expiry date.
--			This method will verify whether the grade, status and expiry date of an item in the source inventory location
--			has the same grade, status and expiry date of an item in the destination inventory location.
--			Returns 1 (true) if the inventory properties are identical; else 0 (false).
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 05/26/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.17
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
-- 11/14/2006    Raghu        3.1.25    Noticed by Keith; email dated:11/09/2006; The indistinguishable_lots property is checked
--                                    for both the source and destination inventory location; irrespective of whether the destination
--                                    inventory location exist or not.
--02/19/2007    Raghu        3.2.0    Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @to_ent_id              INT32
		,	@to_item_id             STRING80
		,	@to_lot_no              STRING80
		,	@to_sublot_no           STRING80
		,	@to_grade_cd            INT32
		,	@to_status_cd           INT32
		,	@to_expiry_date         TDATETIME
		,	@from_row_id            INT32
		,	@doc_handle				INT32


    SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

    --Convert the input xml to XML Type.
    EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml, and read the target_process_id, target_oper_id and target_step_no
	SELECT	@to_ent_id = CASE WHEN to_ent_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_ent_id END
		,	@to_item_id = CASE WHEN to_item_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_item_id END
		,	@to_lot_no = CASE WHEN to_lot_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_lot_no END
		,	@to_sublot_no = CASE WHEN to_sublot_no = '' THEN 0 ELSE to_sublot_no END
		,	@to_grade_cd = CASE WHEN to_grade_cd = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_grade_cd END
		,	@to_status_cd = CASE WHEN to_status_cd = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_status_cd END
		,	@to_expiry_date = CASE WHEN to_expiry_date = '' THEN NULL ELSE to_expiry_date END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (	to_ent_id NVARCHAR(160),
			to_item_id NVARCHAR(160),
			to_lot_no NVARCHAR(160),
			to_sublot_no NVARCHAR(160),
			to_grade_cd NVARCHAR(160),
			to_status_cd NVARCHAR(160),
			to_expiry_date NVARCHAR(160)	)


	--Get a list of nodes that contains the 'source' element.
	DECLARE source_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN from_row_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE from_row_id END AS from_row_id
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/source', 2)
	WITH (from_row_id NVARCHAR(160))

	--Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
    OPEN source_cursor
	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN

		FETCH NEXT FROM source_cursor INTO @from_row_id

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		EXEC sp_sa_item_inv_verifyinvprops	@from_row_id, @to_ent_id, @to_item_id, @to_lot_no, @to_sublot_no, @to_grade_cd, @to_status_cd,
											@to_expiry_date, @time_zone_bias_value, @properties_are_identical OUTPUT, @properties_differ_info OUTPUT

        IF (COALESCE(@properties_are_identical, 0) = 0) BEGIN
            BREAK
        END
	END

    CLOSE source_cursor
	DEALLOCATE source_cursor

    --Destroy the instance.
    EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

END

,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
--,	@shift_start			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_start_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@genealogy_id	nvarchar(254) = NULL
,	@segment_requirement_id nvarchar(254) = NULL
,	@segment_response_id nvarchar(254) = NULL
,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@row_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- SP_SA_DATA_LOG_16
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 09/10/2002		Raghu			1.4			Get data log 16 values only from non-obsolete data_log group
-- 09/23/2002		Raghu			1.4			Truncated the Milli-Seconds value for sample_time field (as Operator couldnot able to delete the record)
--												Pl let me or Nagaraju know before modifying the sample time field (changing the miili-seconds)
-- 10/30/2002		Sheetal Jain    1.5			Include NOLOCK hint in the query
-- 6/13/2003		Chandresh		1.6			Included row_id in the select statement
-- 03/05/2004		Raghu			2.0.0.27	Removed sample_time conversion and returned the sample_time as is.
-- 02/14/2005		Raghu			2.1.13		HD# 5258, 5367 Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time
-- 05/24/2005		Raghu			2.1.22		HD# 5713, Returns sample_time in datetime format; instead of string format.
-- 09/21/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5713, Sample_time column is returned as datetime and not as a string.
-- 10/12/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/01/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/05/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000.
-- 08/02/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 11/09/2012		Ashish			4.6			Modified for CR-L00123625 cloned from HF CR-L00123573
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	/* 08/02/2007 AML
	IF ( @sample_time IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @sample_time = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sample_time )
	END

	IF ( @shift_start IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @shift_start = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start )
	END
	*/

	SELECT	data_log_16.grp_id
		,	data_log_grp.grp_desc
		,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, data_log_16.sample_time_utc ) AS sample_time
		,	data_log_16.sample_time_utc		-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_16.sample_time_local	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_16.wo_id
		,	wo.wo_desc
		,	data_log_16.oper_id
		,	data_log_16.seq_no
		,	job.job_desc
		,	data_log_16.step_no
		,	job_step.step_desc
		,	data_log_16.item_id
		,	item.item_desc
		,	data_log_16.lot_no
		,	data_log_16.sublot_no
		,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, data_log_16.shift_start_utc ) AS shift_start
		,	data_log_16.shift_start_utc		-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_16.shift_start_local	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_16.shift_id
		,	shift.shift_desc
		,	data_log_16.ent_id
		,	data_log_16.genealogy_id
		,	data_log_16.segment_requirement_id
		,	data_log_16.segment_response_id
		,	data_log_16.value1
		,	data_log_16.value2
		,	data_log_16.value3
		,	data_log_16.value4
		,	data_log_16.value5
		,	data_log_16.value6
		,	data_log_16.value7
		,	data_log_16.value8
		,	data_log_16.value9
		,	data_log_16.value10
		,	data_log_16.value11
		,	data_log_16.value12
		,	data_log_16.value13
		,	data_log_16.value14
		,	data_log_16.value15
		,	data_log_16.value16
		,	data_log_16.last_edit_comment
		,	data_log_16.last_edit_by
		,	data_log_16.last_edit_at
		,	data_log_16.row_id
	FROM data_log_16 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_16.grp_id = data_log_grp.grp_id
		INNER JOIN shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_16.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_16.wo_id = wo.wo_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_16.wo_id = job.wo_id AND
			data_log_16.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
			data_log_16.seq_no = job.seq_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_16.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
			data_log_16.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND
			data_log_16.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
			data_log_16.step_no = job_step.step_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_16.item_id = item.item_id
	WHERE (
			(data_log_16.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
			--(data_log_16.sample_time = @sample_time OR @sample_time IS NULL) AND
			-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
			(data_log_16.sample_time_utc = @sample_time_utc OR @sample_time_utc IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.sample_time_local = @sample_time_local OR @sample_time_local IS NULL) AND
			--
			(data_log_16.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
			--(data_log_16.shift_start = @shift_start OR @shift_start IS NULL) AND
			-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
			(data_log_16.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.shift_start_local = @shift_start_local OR @shift_start_local IS NULL) AND
			--
			(data_log_16.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_16.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.obsolete = 0)
		  )
	ORDER BY data_log_grp.grp_desc

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_st_trans_status] @lineid INT,
@rowid INT = NULL,
@status VARCHAR(80),
@srcSU INT=NULL,
@destSU INT=NULL,
@itemId INT=NULL
,@user_name NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @transferStatus VARCHAR(80) = UPPER(@status)
	DECLARE @transferStatusStopDesc VARCHAR(80)='STOPPED'
	DECLARE @transferStatusCd INT=0
	DECLARE @attr_id_SUNumberInAUT INT
	DECLARE @vSrcSU NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE @lineName NVARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @vDestSU NVARCHAR(40)
	declare @p_created_at_local datetime, @p_last_edit_at_local datetime,@p_created_at_utc datetime, @p_last_edit_at_utc datetime
	DECLARE @strItemid NVARCHAR(80),@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX);
	declare @transType int
	declare @target_qty nvarchar(50)
	declare @qty_transferred nvarchar(50)

	--VERIFY REQUIRED INPUT PARAMETERS ARE PASSED
	IF (@lineid IS NULL OR @status IS NULL or @rowid is null )
	BEGIN
		SET @errorMessage=dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(400010,NULL,NULL)		
		RAISERROR (@errorMessage,16,1 
				);
		RETURN - 1
	END

	--GET ATTR_ID FOR SUNumberInAUT
	SELECT @attr_id_SUNumberInAUT=attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2

	--GET LINE NAME
	SELECT @lineName=ent_name FROM ent where ent_id=@lineid
	
	--USE 'STOPPED' STATUS FOR IDLE STATUS OF TRANSFER LINE
	IF (@transferStatus='IDLE')
	BEGIN
		SET @transferStatus=@transferStatusStopDesc
	END 
	
	set @p_created_at_local = GETDATE(); set @p_last_edit_at_local = GETDATE();
	set @p_created_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(); set  @p_last_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE();


	IF (ISNULL(@rowid,0)=0)
		BEGIN
			--GET SOURCE SILO MES ID
			SELECT @vSrcSU=ent.ent_id FROM ent ent
			INNER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id 													  
																AND ea.attr_id = @attr_id_SUNumberInAUT
																AND ea.attr_value=CAST(@srcSU AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			--GET DESTINATION SILO MES ID
			SELECT @vDestSU=ent.ent_id FROM ent ent
			INNER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id 													  
																AND ea.attr_id = @attr_id_SUNumberInAUT
																AND ea.attr_value=CAST(@destSU AS NVARCHAR(MAX))
			--GET MES ITEM ID	
			SELECT @strItemid=autitem.mes_item_id from ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(CAST(@itemId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),2) autitem

			--get roid
			SELECT @rowid=row_id FROM ofi_st_trans_selection with(nolock) WHERE src_su_ent_id=@vSrcSU and dest_su_ent_id=@vDestSU and ent_id=@lineid
			and is_Active=1
		END 
	ELSE 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @vSrcSU=ent_id FROM ent where ent_id=(select src_su_ent_id from ofi_st_trans_selection with(nolock) where row_id=@rowid )
			SELECT @vDestSU=ent_id FROM ent where ent_id=(select dest_su_ent_id from ofi_st_trans_selection with(nolock) where row_id=@rowid )

		END

	IF (ISNULL(@rowid,0)=0)

			--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE

			if(@transferStatusCd=3)
			begin
			--UPDATE TRANSFER LINE STATUS
			UPDATE ofi_st_trans_selection
			SET transfer_status_cd=@transferStatusCd, is_active=1, created_by=@user_name 
			WHERE ent_id=@lineid AND row_id=@rowid
			end
			else
			begin
			--UPDATE TRANSFER LINE STATUS
			UPDATE ofi_st_trans_selection
			SET transfer_status_cd=@transferStatusCd, is_active=0
			WHERE ent_id=@lineid AND row_id=@rowid
			end

			   		 
			--UPDATE AUDIT TRAIL
			exec sp_i_ofi_st_audittrail @vSrcSU,@vDestSU,@lineid,@transferStatusCd,@transType,@target_qty,@qty_transferred,@user_name

		END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		--GET TRANSFER STATUS CODE
		SELECT @transferStatusCd=state_cd FROM job_state WHERE state_desc=@transferStatus

		--GET MES ITEM ID	
		SELECT @strItemid=autitem.mes_item_id from ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(CAST(@itemId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),2) autitem
		
		if(@transferStatusCd=3)
			begin
			--UPDATE TRANSFER LINE STATUS
			UPDATE ofi_st_trans_selection
			SET transfer_status_cd=@transferStatusCd, is_active=1, created_by=@user_name 
			WHERE ent_id=@lineid AND row_id=@rowid
			end
		 else
			begin
			--UPDATE TRANSFER LINE STATUS
			UPDATE ofi_st_trans_selection
			SET transfer_status_cd=@transferStatusCd, is_active=0
			WHERE ent_id=@lineid AND row_id=@rowid
			end

		--UPDATE AUDIT TRAIL
			exec sp_i_ofi_st_audittrail @vSrcSU,@vDestSU,@lineid,@transferStatusCd,@transType,@target_qty,@qty_transferred,@user_name

	END

	--UPDATE SILO SELECTION TABLE FOR SOURCE 
		DECLARE @suactiveId INT =NULL
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [ofi_su_selection] WITH (NOLOCK) 
					where wo_id=@rowid and [ent_id]=@lineid

										--,[active_su_ent_id]
										)

			--SET active_su_end_id to NULL IF LINE SET TO IDLE

				begin

				end
			ELSE 
				BEGIN

				END
			UPDATE [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
				SET 
					[active_su_ent_id]=@suactiveId
					,[last_edit_at_utc]=@p_last_edit_at_utc
					,[last_edit_at_local]=@p_last_edit_at_local

				begin

				end

				END
			UPDATE [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
			SET

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Res_Exc]
  (@res_id int ,
   @start_time datetime ,
   @start_time_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @end_time datetime ,
   @end_time_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @qty_unavail float ,
   @comments nvarchar(2000) ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_I_Res_Exc
-- Description      - Insert a row into the table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain	1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/11/2009   Eswar       4.0     HF 1432 - datetime changes.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
		 ,@dbg_resp		INT32

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

SET @start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
SET @start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@start_time, @start_time_tz)

SET @end_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)
SET @end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@end_time, @end_time_tz)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

-- TRACE
EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='SP_I_RES_EXC', @src_key='post_validate', @date_val1 = @start_time, @numeric_val1 = @start_time_tz,
				@date_val2 = @end_time, @numeric_val2 = @end_time_tz

IF (@start_time IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @start_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @start_time = @last_edit_at
ELSE SET @start_time =  DATEADD(mi, -@start_time_tz, @start_time)
SET @start_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @start_time )

IF (@end_time IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @end_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @end_time = @last_edit_at
ELSE SET @end_time =  DATEADD(mi, -@end_time_tz, @end_time)
SET @end_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @end_time )

 INSERT INTO res_exc
 (res_id,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  qty_unavail,
  comments,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@res_id,
   @start_time,
   @end_time,
   @qty_unavail,
   @comments,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Return timestamp
--SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
from res_exc
WHERE (res_id = @res_id AND
start_time = @start_time)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_Sched]
(@ent_id  int  ,
 @start_day  int  ,
 @shift_id  int  ,
 @start_time  datetime  ,
 @end_time  datetime  ,
 @break1_start  datetime  ,
 @break1_end  datetime  ,
 @break2_start  datetime  ,
 @break2_end  datetime  ,
 @break3_start  datetime  ,
 @break3_end  datetime ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0)   AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
/*SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time)
SET @end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @end_time)
SET @break1_start = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @break1_start)
SET @break1_end = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @break1_end)
SET @break2_start = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @break2_start)
SET @break2_end = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @break2_end)
SET @break3_start = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @break3_start)
SET @break3_end = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @break3_end)
*/
SELECT shift_sched.ent_id
            ,shift_sched.start_day
            ,shift_sched.shift_id
            --,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.start_time) start_time
			,shift_sched.start_time
            ,shift.shift_desc
            ,ent.ent_name
/*            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.end_time) end_time
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.break1_start) break1_start
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.break1_end) break1_end
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.break2_start) break2_start
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.break2_end) break2_end
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.break3_start) break3_start
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shift_sched.break3_end) break3_end*/
			,shift_sched.end_time, shift_sched.break1_start, shift_sched.break1_end
			,shift_sched.break2_start, shift_sched.break2_end, shift_sched.break3_start, shift_sched.break3_end
            ,shift_sched.last_edit_comment
            ,shift_sched.last_edit_by
            ,shift_sched.last_edit_at
  FROM shift_sched shift_sched WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_sched.shift_id = shift.shift_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON shift_sched.ent_id = ent.ent_id
WHERE ((shift_sched.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.start_day = @start_day OR @start_day IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.start_time = @start_time OR @start_time IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.end_time = @end_time OR @end_time IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.break1_start = @break1_start OR @break1_start IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.break1_end = @break1_end OR @break1_end IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.break2_start = @break2_start OR @break2_start IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.break2_end = @break2_end OR @break2_end IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.break3_start = @break3_start OR @break3_start IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.break3_end = @break3_end OR @break3_end IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (shift_sched.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, shift_sched.start_day, shift_sched.start_time
