CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GETOEE] @ent_id as int

  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_GETOEE  -
-- Description:	    Get the OEE and TEEP percentage
--
-- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-01						Find the OEE & TEEP percentage
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilQual') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmputilQual
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilPerf') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmputilPerf
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilAvail') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmputilAvail

Create table #tmputilQual(util_max int,avil_data int,qual_data int,qual_loss int,exp_prod int, act_prod int,good int, bad int)
Insert into #tmputilQual Exec [sp_S_ofi_GETQualityLoss] @ent_id
--Select * from #tmputilQual

Create table #tmputilPerf(util_max int,util_data int, avil_data int,perf_data int,perf_loss int)
Insert into #tmputilPerf Exec [sp_S_ofi_GETPerformanceLoss] @ent_id
--Select * from #tmputilPerf

Create table #tmputilAvail(util_max int,util_data int, util_percent int,util_loss int,avil_data int,avil_loss int, avil_per int)
Insert into #tmputilAvail Exec [sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss] @ent_id
--Select * from #tmputilAvail
Declare @util_percent as int,@perf_percent as int,@qual_percent as int, @avil_data as int, @perf_data as int, @perf_loss as int,
		@qual_data as int, @qual_loss as int, @avil_percent as int,@oee_percent as INT, @teep_percent as INT, @expected_prod as int,
		@actual_prod as int, @good_prod as int, @bad_prod as int
select @avil_data=avil_data,@perf_data=perf_data from #tmputilPerf
select @util_percent=util_percent, @avil_percent=avil_per from #tmputilAvail
Select @qual_data=qual_data,@expected_prod=exp_prod,@actual_prod=act_prod,@good_prod=good,@bad_prod=bad from #tmputilQual
if @avil_data >= @perf_data
begin
set @perf_percent =  CAST((@perf_data/@avil_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
set @perf_loss = 100 - @perf_percent
end
if @perf_data >= @qual_data
begin
set @qual_percent = CAST((@qual_data/@perf_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
set @qual_loss = 100 - @qual_percent
end
print @qual_percent
print @qual_loss 
set @oee_percent=CAST((@util_percent*@perf_percent*@qual_percent)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
print 'oee percent'
set @oee_percent= LEFT(@oee_percent, 2)
set @teep_percent = @oee_percent * @util_percent
print @oee_percent
set @teep_percent= LEFT(@teep_percent, 2)
print @teep_percent

select  @util_percent as util_percent,  @avil_percent as avil_percent, @perf_percent as perf_percent
		, @qual_percent as qual_percent, @expected_prod as exp_prod, @actual_prod as act_prod,
		@good_prod as good, (case when @bad_prod > 0 then @bad_prod else 0 end) as bad, @oee_percent as oee, @teep_percent as teep

drop table #tmputilQual
drop table #tmputilPerf
drop table #tmputilAvail

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Cons_Split]
(
	  	@session_id				INT32
	, 	@old_row_id				INT32
	, 	@split_qty_cons       	TFLOAT
	, 	@new_wo_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_oper_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_seq_no				INT32_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_shift_start_local	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_item_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_lot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_fg_lot_no        	STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_sublot_no			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_fg_sublot_no     	STRING40_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_reas_cd			INT32_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_user_id			STRING40_NULL
	, 	@new_ent_id				INT32_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_shift_id        	INT32_NULL = NULL
	, 	@new_from_ent_id      	INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@new_genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@new_upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@new_segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
	,	@new_segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
	, 	@split_qty_cons_erp		TFLOAT_NULL = NULL
	, 	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	, 	@time_zone_bias_value 	INT32 = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        	- sp_I_Item_Cons_Split
-- Description          -
-- Author	      		-
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.		Changes
-- 08/29/2002	Raghu		1.4			Remove Cont_id.  Get Row_Id from the join and use only Row_id for add/update/delete in where clause
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2		Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 02/04/2003	Nagaraju	1.5.2		Re-written the stored procedure as it was not doing what intended to be.
-- 05/14/2003	Raghu		1.6.7		(HD# 2498). Auto Populating of Job Event table when Consumption is reported and sys attr is set to true
-- 07/07/2003	Raghu		1.7.0		(HD# 3365) Removed log_trans param from inventory procedures; as it is not used anyway.
--										Value is fetched from system_attr = 198 to log the transfers or not
-- 06/15/2004	Raghu		2.1.0		Included NULL parameter in the last position while calling sp_I_Job_Event
-- 02/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.13		HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 03/15/2005	Raghu		2.1.16		HD# 5474, Maintain distinct consumption records
-- 09/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 01/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.8		HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
-- 09/29/2006	Raghu		3.1.22		HD# 8434, Truncate milli-seconds using correct datetime style to work with all regional settings.
-- 01/09/2007	KRF			3.2.1		HD# 8314 & 8876, part of DB changes - added @new_sublot_no and @new_fg_sublot_no arguments,
--										and initialize created_at
-- 08/20/2007	AML			3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--										dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 01/12/2010	Vinit		4.0.0       HF1432 changes.
--10/29/2012    Praveen     4.6    Passed null value for the stored procedure SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADD(for the CR122433)
-- 25/06/2013    Srinu      4.6    Passed uom_id value for the stored procedure SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADD(for the CR127047)
-- 02/17/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187825-As Bruce, I want a Web API to process ItemInv records so I can interact with inventory
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @cur_qty_cons			TFLOAT
		, 	@new_qty_cons			TFLOAT
		, 	@cur_wo_id				STRING40
		, 	@cur_reas_desc			STRING80
		, 	@cur_shift_id			INT32
		, 	@cur_item_id			STRING40
		, 	@cur_from_ent_id		INT32
		, 	@cur_ent_id				INT32
		, 	@cur_uom_id				INT32
		, 	@cur_qty_cons_erp		TFLOAT
		, 	@cur_item_scrapped		LOGICAL
		, 	@cur_grade_cd			INT32
		, 	@new_grade_cd			INT32
		, 	@cur_status_cd			INT32
		, 	@new_status_cd			INT32
		, 	@old_wo_id				STRING40
		, 	@old_oper_id			STRING40
		, 	@old_seq_no				INT32
		, 	@old_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@old_shift_start_local	TDATETIME
		, 	@old_item_id			STRING40
		, 	@old_lot_no				STRING40
		, 	@old_fg_lot_no      	STRING40
		, 	@old_sublot_no			STRING40 -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
		, 	@old_fg_sublot_no   	STRING40 -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
		, 	@old_reas_cd			INT32
		, 	@old_user_id			STRING40
		, 	@new_row_id				INT32
		--	, @last_edit_at			datetime
		, 	@cur_update_inv 		INT32
		, 	@check_inv_update   	LOGICAL
		, 	@inv_row_id				INT32
		, 	@return					INT32
		, 	@virtual_inv			LOGICAL
		, 	@row_found				INT32
		, 	@attr_value				NVARCHAR(1)
		, 	@job_pos				INT32
		, 	@bom_pos				INT32
		, 	@last_edit_by			STRING40
		, 	@distinct_cons			NVARCHAR(1)
		, 	@created_at_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@created_at_local		TDATETIME
		,	@new_shift_start_utc	TDATETIME
		--, 	@use_gmt				INT32
		,	@tz_temp				INT32
		,@cur_genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL
		,@cur_upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL
		,@cur_segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL
		,@cur_segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL
		,@old_genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL
		,@old_upstream_event_id		STRING80_NULL
		,@old_segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL
		,@old_segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL

		,	@comments				VARCHAR(254) -- Added 07/21/2009 RWB

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @new_shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @new_shift_start_utc OUTPUT


	--main logic for sp
	-- Update existing row by reducing qty_cons(if the qty is equal delete the row)
	-- Get the PK values for new row
	-- If new row exists add qty_cons to existing item_cons record, else insert new row with split qty_cons
	--
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	--read the the  record with old @old_row_id. if row is not existed raise the error.
	-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/21/2009 RWB
	SELECT	@old_wo_id = wo_id, @old_oper_id = oper_id,  @old_seq_no = seq_no, @old_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc,
			@old_shift_start_local = shift_start_local, @old_item_id = item_id, @old_lot_no = lot_no, @old_fg_lot_no = fg_lot_no,
			@old_sublot_no = sublot_no, @old_fg_sublot_no = fg_sublot_no, @old_reas_cd = reas_cd, @old_user_id = user_id,
			@cur_qty_cons = qty_cons, @cur_ent_id = ent_id, @cur_from_ent_id = from_ent_id, @cur_qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp,
			@cur_item_scrapped = item_scrapped, @cur_shift_id = shift_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd,	@cur_status_cd = status_cd,
			@old_genealogy_id = genealogy_id, @old_upstream_event_id = upstream_event_id,
			@old_segment_requirement_id = segment_requirement_id, @old_segment_response_id = segment_response_id,  @comments = comments
	FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @old_row_id

	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 BEGIN
		IF @cur_qty_cons = @split_qty_cons BEGIN
			--the quantity is equal, so delete the old row
			DELETE FROM item_cons WHERE row_id = @old_row_id
			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @old_row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Cons%'
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--the quantity is not equal, so update the old row
			UPDATE item_cons SET qty_cons = qty_cons - @split_qty_cons
				WHERE row_id = @old_row_id
		END

		--insert the row with the new values
		--before insert, check whether the row is existed with the new (primary key) values
		--if row is not existed, insert the row else update
		--check atleast one of the new_*** should have the value
		IF  (@new_wo_id IS NULL) AND (@new_oper_id IS NULL) AND (@new_seq_no IS NULL) AND
			(@new_shift_start_utc IS NULL) AND (@new_item_id IS NULL) AND
			(@new_lot_no IS NULL) AND
			(@new_fg_lot_no IS NULL) AND (@new_reas_cd IS NULL)AND
			(@new_sublot_no IS NULL) AND (@new_fg_sublot_no IS NULL) -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('split item consumption failed, at least one new value is required.{3276}',16,1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF @new_wo_id IS NULL SET @new_wo_id = @old_wo_id
		IF @new_oper_id IS NULL SET @new_oper_id = @old_oper_id
		IF @new_seq_no IS NULL SET @new_seq_no = @old_seq_no

		IF @new_shift_start_utc IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @new_shift_start_local = @old_shift_start_utc
			EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @new_shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @new_shift_start_utc OUTPUT
		END

		IF @new_item_id IS NULL SET @new_item_id = @old_item_id
		IF @new_reas_cd IS NULL SET @new_reas_cd = @old_reas_cd
		IF @new_user_id IS NULL SET @new_user_id = @old_user_id
		SELECT @new_genealogy_id = COALESCE(@new_genealogy_id, @old_genealogy_id), @new_upstream_event_id = COALESCE(@new_upstream_event_id, @old_upstream_event_id)
			, @new_segment_requirement_id = COALESCE(@new_segment_requirement_id, @old_segment_requirement_id), @new_segment_response_id = COALESCE(@new_segment_response_id, @old_segment_response_id)

		SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

		EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

		SELECT	@new_shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@new_shift_start_utc)
			,	@new_shift_start_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@new_shift_start_local)

		SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_local, @tz_temp, @created_at_utc OUTPUT
		SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @created_at_utc )

		--HD# 5474, Raghu - Maintain distinct consumption records
		SELECT @new_qty_cons = NULL, @distinct_cons = '0'
		SELECT @distinct_cons = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 325
		SET @distinct_cons = ISNULL(@distinct_cons, '0')
		IF NOT (@distinct_cons = '1' AND @split_qty_cons > 0) BEGIN
			SELECT @new_row_id = row_id, @new_qty_cons = qty_cons FROM item_cons
			WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id AND oper_id = @new_oper_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no
			  AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( shift_start_utc ) = @new_shift_start_utc
			  AND item_id = @new_item_id
			  AND (lot_no = @new_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @new_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (fg_lot_no = @new_fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @new_fg_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @new_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @new_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
			  AND (fg_sublot_no = @new_fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @new_fg_sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/9/07 KRF
			  AND reas_cd = @new_reas_cd AND user_id = @new_user_id
			  AND (from_ent_id = @new_from_ent_id OR @new_from_ent_id IS NULL)
			  AND (genealogy_id = @new_genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @new_genealogy_id IS NULL))
			  AND (upstream_event_id = @new_upstream_event_id OR (upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @new_upstream_event_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_requirement_id = @new_segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @new_segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_response_id = @new_segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @new_segment_response_id IS NULL));

		END

		IF  @new_qty_cons IS NOT NULL BEGIN
			IF @new_ent_id IS NULL SET @new_ent_id = @cur_ent_id

			--means row is existed, so update the row
			UPDATE item_cons
			SET qty_cons = @split_qty_cons + qty_cons
				,last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
			Where row_id = @new_row_id

			--check for the result
			IF NOT @@ROWCOUNT > 0
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('split item consumption failed{3295}',16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--row is not existed with the new values, so insert the row
			--check job does exists or not
			SET @cur_wo_id = NULL
			SELECT @cur_wo_id = wo_id FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id AND oper_id = @new_oper_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no

			IF @cur_wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
				RAISERROR('split item consumption failed, job does not exist.{3296}',16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END
			--if the new_item_id is specified then it must exist otherwise return the error
			IF @new_item_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
				SET @cur_item_id = NULL
				SELECT @cur_item_id = item_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @new_item_id
				IF @cur_item_id IS NULL BEGIN
					RAISERROR('split item consumption failed, Item not found.{3297}',16,1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END

			-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get good_prod flag
			EXECUTE sp_S_item_reas_OP @new_reas_cd, @cur_reas_desc OUTPUT, @new_grade_cd OUTPUT, @new_status_cd OUTPUT

			IF @new_grade_cd IS NULL BEGIN
				-- Return error - reas_cd NOT defined in DB
				RAISERROR('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}',16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				--find out whether it's a scrapped  item grade or not
				SET @cur_item_scrapped = NULL
				SELECT @cur_item_scrapped = scrapped FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @new_grade_cd
				-- Return error if this was not successful
				IF @cur_item_scrapped IS NULL BEGIN
					RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid scrapped flag{3299}', 16, 1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			END


			IF @new_ent_id IS NULL SET @new_ent_id = @cur_ent_id
			IF @new_from_ent_id IS NULL SET @new_from_ent_id = @cur_from_ent_id
			IF @split_qty_cons_erp IS NULL SET @split_qty_cons_erp = @cur_qty_cons_erp
			IF @new_shift_id IS NULL SET @new_shift_id = @cur_shift_id
			-- Now insert the new row
			-- Added subsegment_id and comments parameters 07/21/2009 RWB
			INSERT INTO item_cons
			(
				-- Added "sublot_no, fg_sublot_no," 1/9/07 KRF
				-- Added ", created_at" 1/9/07 KRF
				wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no,
				fg_sublot_no, reas_cd, user_id, item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id,
				qty_cons,qty_cons_erp, transaction_type, genealogy_id, upstream_event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
				comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local
			)
			VALUES
			(
				-- Added "@new_sublot_no, @new_fg_sublot_no," 1/9/07 KRF
				-- Added ", @created_at" 1/9/07 KRF
				@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @new_shift_start_utc, @new_shift_start_local, @new_item_id,
				@new_lot_no, @new_fg_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_fg_sublot_no, @new_reas_cd, @new_user_id, @cur_item_scrapped,
				@new_ent_id, @new_shift_id, @new_grade_cd, @new_status_cd, @new_from_ent_id, @split_qty_cons, @split_qty_cons_erp,
				0, @new_genealogy_id, @new_upstream_event_id, @new_segment_requirement_id, @new_segment_response_id,
				@comments, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc, @created_at_local
			)

			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR( 'split item consumption failed{3295}', 16, 1 )
				RETURN -1
			END

			SET @new_row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		END

		--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 233
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @job_pos = job_pos
			FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @new_ent_id AND cur_wo_id = @new_wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @new_oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @new_seq_no

			SELECT @bom_pos = bom_pos FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id AND oper_id = @new_oper_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no AND item_id = @new_item_id

			-- Added "@new_sublot_no," 1/9/07 KRF
	  		EXEC sp_I_Job_Event	@new_ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, NULL, 'ReclassifyCons', @bom_pos, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no,
								@new_item_id, NULL, @new_user_id,  NULL, @new_row_id, NULL, @new_genealogy_id, @new_segment_requirement_id, @new_segment_response_id, NULL,
								NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END

		-- Insert new row or update old row is successful.  Now find out whether inventory updates to be done. This is required if lot number or from entity id is changed
		IF @old_lot_no <> @new_lot_no SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF (@old_lot_no IS NULL)  AND NOT (@new_lot_no IS NULL) SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF NOT(@old_lot_no IS NULL) AND  (@new_lot_no IS NULL) SET @check_inv_update =1
		-- Added following 3 lines 1/9/07 KRF
		IF @old_sublot_no <> @new_sublot_no SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF (@old_sublot_no IS NULL)  AND NOT (@new_sublot_no IS NULL) SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF NOT(@old_sublot_no IS NULL) AND  (@new_sublot_no IS NULL) SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF @cur_from_ent_id <> @new_from_ent_id  SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF NOT(@cur_from_ent_id IS NULL) AND (@new_from_ent_id IS NULL) SET @check_inv_update =1
		IF (@cur_from_ent_id IS NULL) AND NOT (@new_from_ent_id IS NULL) SET @check_inv_update =1

		IF @check_inv_update = 1 BEGIN
			--read the update inventory flag from job table for the old job
			SELECT @cur_update_inv = update_inv
			FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @old_wo_id
				AND oper_id = @old_oper_id
				AND seq_no = @old_seq_no
				AND item_id = @old_item_id

	        SET @cur_uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WHERE item_id = @old_item_id)

			IF @cur_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
				IF NOT @cur_from_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
					-- Added "@old_sublot_no," 1/9/07 KRF
					EXECUTE @return = SP_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@cur_from_ent_id, @item_id=@old_item_id, @lot_no=@old_lot_no, @sublot_no=@old_sublot_no
						, @grade_cd=@cur_grade_cd, @status_cd=@cur_status_cd, @add_qty=@split_qty_cons, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=NULL, @expiry_date=NULL
						, @wo_id=@old_wo_id, @oper_id=@old_oper_id, @seq_no=@old_seq_no, @from_ent_id=NULL, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id
						, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL, @goods_received=0, @checkgradestatus=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL
						, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @date_in_utc=NULL, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id OUTPUT
					IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
				END
			END

			SET @cur_update_inv = NULL

			--read the update inventory flag from job table for the new job
			SELECT	@cur_update_inv = update_inv,
					@virtual_inv = must_consume_from_inv
			FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @new_wo_id
				AND oper_id = @new_oper_id
				AND seq_no = @new_seq_no
				AND item_id = @new_item_id

			IF @cur_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
				IF NOT @new_from_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
					-- Added "@new_sublot_no," 1/9/07 KRF
					EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@new_from_ent_id, @item_id=@new_item_id, @lot_no=@new_lot_no, @sublot_no=@new_sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@split_qty_cons, @reduce_qty_erp=0
						, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@new_grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@new_status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@new_reas_cd
						, @must_consume_from_inv=@virtual_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=NULL, @oper_id=NULL, @seq_no=NULL
						, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
					IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
				END
			END

		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Item consumption record not found in the database{3298}',16,1)
		RETURN -1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Inv_TransAndUpdInv]
(@from_ent_id		INT32
,@to_ent_id			INT32
,@item_id			STRING40

,@lot_no			STRING40
,@to_lot_no			STRING40

,@to_sublot_no		STRING40
,@from_grade_cd		INT32
,@to_grade_cd		INT32
,@from_status_cd	INT32
,@to_status_cd		INT32
,@transfer_qty		TFLOAT
,@transfer_qty_erp  TFLOAT
,@transfer_option   INT32
,@transfer_comments STRING254
,@log_transfer		INT32
,@from_wo_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@from_oper_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@from_seq_no		INT32_NULL = NULL
,@to_wo_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@to_oper_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@to_seq_no			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@to_expiry_date	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@to_expiry_date_utc	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@to_uom			INT32_NULL = NULL
,@bulk_move_reclassify	LOGICAL = 0
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32_NULL = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferAndUpdateInv
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--08/21/2002	Raghu			Ignore checking for max_capacity for max_capacity = 0. If max_capacity = 0, then NO Limit
--08/30/2002	Raghu		1.4	Included Parameter From_Grade_Cd, From_Status_Cd, To_Grade_Cd and To_Status_Cd
--08/06/2002	Raghu		1.4	Joining with status_cd and grade_cd is removed.  As in 1.4 database, ent_id, item_id and lot_no are always unique
--09/09/2002	Raghu		1.4	Get Log_Trans option value from system_attribute =198 and log inventory transfers if this attribute is set to 1
--09/19/2002	Raghu		1.4	If allow neg qtys for an entity are set in storage_exec, then allow the entity can hold negative qtys
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5	Renamed sp_U_Item_Inv_Transfer1 to sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferAndUpdateInv
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/17/2003	Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 2273). Lot_No allowed to change NULL Values
-- 01/31/2003	Rohit		1.5.5	Changed the logic to hangle storage exec status
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     	1600  	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
--07/03/2003	Raghu		1.6.13	(HD# 3362) Max capacity in a storage location will go only on per entity basis; not on lot or items
-- 07/07/2003	Raghu		1.7.0	(HD# 3365) Removed log_trans param; as it is not used anyway. Value is fetched from system_attr = 198 to log the transfers or not
-- 12/11/2003	KRF			(HD#4254) Do not default expiry dates to now if they are null; null is OK, meaning no expiration
--02/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
--02/28/2005	Raghu		2.1.15		HD# 5430, Included user_id in the item_trasfer insert statements to know who the user is changing the inventory.
--03/23/2005	Raghu		2.1.17	HD# 5430, Track Inventory Users, Delegate this call to Move
--01/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.8	HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
--01/23/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--12/12/2009	Ajay		4.0.0	HF1432 Changes/fix
--12/12/2012	Saiteja		4.6.0   CR 118000-Replaced @cur_wo_id,@cur_oper_id,@cur_seq_no with @to_wo_id,@to_oper_id,@to_seq_no to populate the values when transferring in inventory when destination values are required.
--02/20/2019	Raghu		6.1.0	UserStory-1145991, As Karen, I want to move/reclassify inventory one or more inventory rows in a single transaction
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
SET @bulk_move_reclassify = COALESCE(@bulk_move_reclassify, 0)

DECLARE @row_id INT
		,@inv_unique_by_job LOGICAL
		,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(2000)
		,@cur_grade_cd	INT32
		,@cur_status_cd	INT32
		,@cur_qty_left	TFLOAT
		,@cur_qty_left_erp	TFLOAT
		,@cur_date_in	TDATETIME
		,@cur_date_out	TDATETIME
		,@cur_last_edit_at TDATETIME
		,@cur_expiry_dat	TDATETIME
		,@cur_wo_id			STRING40
		,@cur_seq_no		INT32
		,@cur_oper_id		STRING40

	IF (@bulk_move_reclassify = 1) BEGIN

		IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The %1 should not be null{3339},from entity ID'
			RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
			RETURN
		END

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'entity ID :' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @from_ent_id)
			RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
			RETURN
		END

		DECLARE item_inv_loc CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT ii.row_id, ii.qty_left, ii.qty_left_erp
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
		  AND (ii.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) -- Restrict to the item, if supplied
		  AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) -- Restrict to the lot, if supplied
		  AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) -- Restrict to the sublot, if supplied
		OPEN item_inv_loc
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM item_inv_loc INTO @row_id, @transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Move @from_row_id=@row_id, @from_last_edit_at=NULL, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @transfer_qty=@transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp=@transfer_qty_erp
				, @in_to_ent_id=@to_ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@to_sublot_no
				, @in_to_grade_cd=@to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd=@to_status_cd, @in_to_uom_id=@to_uom, @in_to_expiry_date=@to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=0
				, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=@to_expiry_date_utc
				, @in_to_wo_id=@to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id=@to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no=@to_seq_no, @in_transfer_option=@transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=NULL
				, @in_transfer_comments=@transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer=@log_transfer, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL
		END
		CLOSE item_inv_loc
		DEALLOCATE item_inv_loc
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT @inv_unique_by_job = inv_unique_by_job FROM item  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id

		IF (@inv_unique_by_job = 0) BEGIN
			--This item in the inventory is NOT captured per job basis.
			SELECT @row_id = ii.row_id
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
			 AND ii.item_id = @item_id
			 AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			 AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			IF (@@ROWCOUNT > 1) BEGIN
				--A unique row identifying a storage location cannot be found. Raise an exception in this case.
				SET @err_msg = 'There are too many storage locations identifying the supplied entity: %1, item: %2, lot: %3 and sublot: %4. Pl fix the inventory to uniquely identify a storage location.{5408},' + @from_ent_id + ',' + @item_id + ',' + COALESCE(@lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + COALESCE(@sublot_no, 'NULL')
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @row_id = ii.row_id
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
		 AND ii.item_id = @item_id
		 AND (ii.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
		 AND (ii.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (ii.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		 AND (ii.wo_id = @from_wo_id OR (ii.wo_id IS NULL AND @from_wo_id IS NULL))
		 AND (ii.oper_id = @from_oper_id OR (ii.oper_id IS NULL AND @from_oper_id IS NULL))
		 AND (ii.seq_no = @from_seq_no OR (ii.seq_no IS NULL AND @from_seq_no IS NULL))
			IF (@@ROWCOUNT > 1) BEGIN
				--A unique row identifying a storage location cannot be found. Raise an exception in this case.
				SET @err_msg = 'There are too many storage locations identifying the supplied entity: %1, item: %2, lot: %3 and sublot: %4, wo_id: %5, oper_id: %6 and seq_no: %7.
							Pl fix the inventory to uniquely identify a storage location.{5410},'
						 + @from_ent_id + ',' + @item_id + ',' + COALESCE(@lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + COALESCE(@sublot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @from_wo_id + ',' + @from_oper_id + ',' + @from_seq_no
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			END
		END

		IF (@to_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND RIGHT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @to_expiry_date, 120), 8) = '00:00:00')
		-- If the expiry date (in local) does not contain a time component, then the expiry date is set to midnight of that day, no time zone adjustments are done
			SET @time_zone_bias_value = 0

		EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_Move @from_row_id=@row_id, @from_last_edit_at=NULL, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @transfer_qty=@transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp=@transfer_qty_erp
			, @in_to_ent_id=@to_ent_id, @in_to_item_id=@to_item_id, @in_to_lot_no=@to_lot_no, @in_to_sublot_no=@to_sublot_no
			, @in_to_grade_cd=@to_grade_cd, @in_to_status_cd=@to_status_cd, @in_to_uom_id=@to_uom, @in_to_expiry_date=@to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz=@time_zone_bias_value
			, @in_to_expiry_date_utc=@to_expiry_date_utc
			, @in_to_wo_id=@to_wo_id, @in_to_oper_id=@to_oper_id, @in_to_seq_no=@to_seq_no, @in_transfer_option=@transfer_option, @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job=NULL
			, @in_transfer_comments=@transfer_comments, @in_log_transfer=@log_transfer, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_Planed_Downtime]
(
@loc_id NVARCHAR(50),
@res_grp_id NVARCHAR(50),
@ent_id NVARCHAR(50),
@reas_cd NVARCHAR(50),
@starttime NVARCHAR(50),
@endtime NVARCHAR(50),
@row_id NVARCHAR(50),
@sessionid int = null, --24may made sessionid nullable
@callJobDistribution bit = 1 --24may parameter is to execute jobdistribution
)
AS
BEGIN
declare  @ent_name NVARCHAR(50)
		,@loc_desc NVARCHAR(50)
		,@res_grp_desc NVARCHAR(50)
		,@Reas_desc NVARCHAR(50)
		,@row_count int
		,@start_time_O datetime 
        ,@end_time_O datetime
		,@ent_id_O NVARCHAR(50)
		,@wo_id STRING40,@jobSeqNo int
		,@operId STRING40
		, @jobstarttime datetime
		, @jobendtime datetime
		, @user_name nvarchar(50) = 'System'
		
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	DECLARE @JobstoUpdate TABLE (
									StartTime datetime,
									EndTime datetime,
									WoId nvarchar(40),
									Operid nvarchar(40),
									JobSeqNo int,
									NewStartTime datetime,
									NewEndTime datetime )

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--check if there exists a downtime with the same details
	select top 1 @row_count = row_id,@ent_id_O = [ent_id], @start_time_O = [start_time]
           ,@end_time_O = [end_time] from SDB.SCH.ent_planned_downtime with (nolock)
	where row_id = @row_id or

	(ent_id = @ent_id and
	start_time = @starttime and 
	end_time = @endtime)

	select @ent_name = description from ent where ent_id = @ent_id
			select @res_grp_id = res_grp_id from SDB.SCH.res_grp_ent with (nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id
			select @res_grp_desc = res_grp_desc from SDB.SCH.res_grp with (nolock) where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
			select @loc_id = loc_id from SDB.SCH.res_grp with (nolock) where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
			select @loc_desc = loc_desc from SDB.SCH.loc with (nolock) where loc_id = @loc_id
			select @Reas_desc = reas_desc from util_reas with (nolock) where reas_cd = @reas_cd

	if @row_count is null
		begin
			
			INSERT INTO SDB.[SCH].[ent_planned_downtime]
           ([loc_id]
           ,[loc_desc]
           ,[res_grp_id]
           ,[res_grp_desc]
           ,[ent_id]
           ,[ent_name]
           ,[start_time]
           ,[end_time]
		   ,[start_time_utc]
           ,[end_time_utc]
           ,[reas_cd]
           ,[reas_desc])
     VALUES
           (@loc_id
           ,@loc_desc
           ,@res_grp_id
           ,@res_grp_desc
           ,@ent_id
           ,@ent_name
           ,@starttime
           ,@endtime
		   ,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, @starttime, null)
           ,dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, @endtime, null)
           ,@reas_cd
           ,@Reas_desc)

 
		end
	else
		begin
		
		UPDATE sdb.[SCH].[ent_planned_downtime] 
		SET    [loc_id] = @loc_id , 
			   [loc_desc] = @loc_desc , 
			   [res_grp_id] = @res_grp_id , 
			   [res_grp_desc] = @res_grp_desc , 
			   [ent_id] = @ent_id , 
			   [ent_name] = @ent_name , 
			   [start_time] = @starttime , 
			   [end_time] = @endtime , 
			   [start_time_utc] = dbo.fn_tz_getutcdatefromlocal(NULL, @starttime, NULL) , 
			   [end_time_utc] = dbo.fn_tz_getutcdatefromlocal(NULL,@endtime,NULL) , 
			   [reas_cd] = @reas_cd , 
			   [reas_desc] = @Reas_desc 
		WHERE  row_id = @row_id


			--UPDATE SDB.[SCH].[ent_planned_downtime]
			--   SET 
			--	  [start_time] = @starttime
			--	  ,[end_time] = @endtime
			--	  ,[reas_cd] = @reas_cd
			--	  ,[reas_desc] = @Reas_desc
			--	  ,[start_time_utc] = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, @starttime, null)
			--	  ,[end_time_utc] = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(null, @endtime, null)
			-- WHERE row_id =  @row_id		
		end

	
	 
	if @callJobDistribution is null or @callJobDistribution = 1 
	begin
		 --this sp's should not get fired when we are calling it from planDowntime 
		EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ScheduleJobDistribution_SetUpTime_ALL_RuleTypes_Integrated_Generic]    @sessionid   ,@user_name , @ent_id
		EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ScheduleJobDistribution_Validate_LeadTime]    @sessionid  ,@user_name
	end
	select top 1 ent_id from ent
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Lot_Attr]
(@item_id  nvarchar(40),
 @lot_no  nvarchar(40),
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @mod_id  varchar(30)
 )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 09/22/2005	Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006	Raghu		    3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 09/21/2015	Varun		    5.2		CR L00138283 Merge changes (HF CR #L00138056) :: Unable to delete an attribute
--									    with attr_id > 999
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  Declare @sql nvarchar(max)

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 3

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

	Set @SQL =
	'
	SELECT lot_attr.item_id
				,lot_attr.lot_no
				,lot_attr.attr_id
				,attr.attr_desc
			,attr.predefined
				,attr.data_type
				,attr.entry_type
				,attr.visible_in_queue
				,attr.visible_in_inv
				,item.item_desc
				,lot_attr.attr_value
				,lot_attr.notes
				,lot_attr.last_edit_comment
				,lot_attr.last_edit_by
				,lot_attr.last_edit_at
				,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, lot_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM lot_attr lot_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON lot_attr.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON lot_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
	WHERE 1= 1
	'

	If @item_id is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + ' AND lot_attr.item_id = @item_id '

	If @lot_no is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + ' AND lot_attr.lot_no = @lot_no '

	If @attr_id is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + ' AND lot_attr.attr_id = cast(@attr_id as nvarchar(10)) ' -- CR L00138283

	If @attr_value is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + ' AND lot_attr.attr_value =  @attr_value '

	If @last_edit_by is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + ' AND lot_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by '

	If @last_edit_at is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + ' AND lot_attr.last_edit_at = convert(nvarchar(50),@last_edit_at,109) '

	If @mod_id is not null
		Set @SQL = @SQL + 'AND CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, lot_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id '

	Set @SQL = @SQL + '
	ORDER BY item.item_desc,  lot_attr.lot_no, attr.attr_desc'

	exec sp_executesql @SQL, N'@item_id NVARCHAR(40), @lot_no NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id INT, @attr_value NVARCHAR(1700),
		@last_edit_by NVARCHAR(40), @last_edit_at DATETIME, @mod_id NVARCHAR(30)',
		@item_id = @item_id, @lot_no = @lot_no, @attr_id = @attr_id, @attr_value = @attr_value,
		@last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at = @last_edit_at, @mod_id = @mod_id
END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 05/24/2019	  Varun 		6.2		US#1170538 - CR L00144600 & L00121581, shift scheduled to any entity should not be deleted.
--										And deleted shift records should be deleted from shift_sched and shift_to_go tables.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	-- Check if the shift_desc to be updated to null has been schedule to any entity in shift_sched table
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inserted ins JOIN shift_sched ss ON ss.shift_id = ins.shift_id WHERE ins.shift_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The selected shift cannot be deleted because it is scheduled on an entity. Make sure that the shift is not in any active schedules before trying to delete it.{8014}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE shift SET shift.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, shift.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE shift.shift_id = i.shift_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Dashboard_Ent]

	@user_id  NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
  , @grp_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
  , @ent_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL

  -- select @user_id=N'AVEVAQA\deveshkumar.s',@grp_name=N'MES_Administrators',@ent_name=N''

AS
BEGIN

declare @entityAcc as table (ent_id int)

----- Fix for first time user login to MES system 0.05.00
--EXECUTE AS LOGIN = 'AVEVAQA\MesControlSvcAccount'
exec [dbo].[sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry] @user_id


	DECLARE @grp_name_dmn NVARCHAR(80) --temporarly added MP
	SELECT
		@grp_name_dmn = grp_desc
	FROM grp_name
	--WHERE grp_desc LIKE '%' + @grp_name + '%'
	where grp_id in(select grp_id from user_grp_link ugl with(nolock) where user_id = @user_id )
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	 insert into @entityAcc
			select distinct gel.ent_id from  
			grp_ent_link gel WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN grp_name gn WITH(NOLOCK) ON gn.grp_id = gel.grp_id
			inner join ent e1 with(nolock) on gel.ent_id =e1.ent_id and e1.can_run_jobs = 1
			where 
			(					
			gn.grp_desc in(
				SELECT
					 grp_desc
				FROM grp_name with(nolock)
				where grp_id in(select grp_id from user_grp_link ugl with(nolock) where user_id = @user_id ))
					)				 
			AND gel.accss = 1

	IF
		(
			@ent_name IS NULL
			OR @ent_name = ''
		)
	BEGIN

		SELECT
			@ent_name = ent_name
		FROM ent
		WHERE ent_id = (SELECT
							ent_id
						FROM site)
	END
		
		;
	WITH ent_hierarchy
		 AS (SELECT
				 ent_id
			   , ent_name
			   , 0 AS hierarchy_level
			 FROM ent
			 WHERE(ent_name = @ent_name)
			 UNION ALL
			 SELECT
				 e.ent_id
			   , e.ent_name
			   , hierarchy_level + 1
			 FROM ent e
				, ent_hierarchy ch
			 WHERE e.parent_ent_id = ch.ent_id)
		 SELECT
			 *
		 INTO
			 #ent_hirarch123
		 FROM ent_hierarchy;

	--GET ACESSIBLE ENTITIES WITH RUNNING JOB DETAILS INTO CTE 
	WITH temp_cte
		 AS (SELECT
				 e.ent_name AS     ent_name
			   , e.description AS  ent_desc
			   , js.state_desc AS  job_state_desc
			   , j.wo_id AS        wo_id
			   , j.qty_reqd AS     qty_reqd
			   , j.qty_prod AS     qty_prod
			   , u.abbreviation AS uom_abbr
			   , i.item_id AS      item_id
			   , i.item_desc AS    item_desc
			   , js.color AS       color
			   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.description
				 ORDER BY
				 (CASE j.state_cd
					  WHEN 3
					  THEN 0
					  WHEN 2
					  THEN 1
					  WHEN 5
					  THEN 2
				  END)
			   , j.row_id ASC)     row_num
			 FROM ent e WITH(NOLOCK)
			 INNER JOIN #ent_hirarch123 eh ON e.ent_id = eh.ent_id	
			 inner join @entityAcc ea on ea.ent_id = e.ent_id
			 --INNER JOIN grp_ent_link gel WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = gel.ent_id
			 --INNER JOIN grp_name gn WITH(NOLOCK) ON gn.grp_id = gel.grp_id			
			 LEFT JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON
				 (
					 (
						 j.run_ent_id IS NULL
						 AND j.target_sched_ent_id = e.ent_id
					 )
					 OR
				 (
					 j.run_ent_id IS NOT NULL
					 AND j.run_ent_id = e.ent_id
				 )
				 )
				 AND j.state_cd IN(2, 3, 5)
				 AND j.state_cd IN(2, 3, 5)
			 LEFT JOIN job_state js WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.state_cd = js.state_cd
			 LEFT JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = j.item_id
			 LEFT JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
			 --WHERE			 
				-- (					
				--	-- gn.grp_desc = @grp_name_dmn
				--	gn.grp_desc in(
				--		SELECT
				--			 grp_desc
				--		FROM grp_name with(nolock)
				--		where grp_id in(select grp_id from user_grp_link ugl with(nolock) where user_id = @user_id ))

				-- )				 
				-- AND gel.accss = 1
				 AND e.can_run_jobs = 1)

		--SELECT FINAL DATASET FOR DASHBOARD FROM CTE
		 SELECT
			 r1.ent_desc AS       header_value_left
		   , r1.job_state_desc AS header_value_right
		   , r1.ent_name AS       ent_name
		   , CASE
				 WHEN
			 r1.job_state_desc = 'RUNNING'
			 AND r2.job_state_desc = 'RUNNING'
				 THEN CONCAT('Running Jobs:', ' ', 2)
				 WHEN
			 r1.job_state_desc = 'RUNNING'
			 AND
			 (
				 r2.job_state_desc <> 'RUNNING'
				 OR r2.job_state_desc IS NULL
			 )
				 THEN CONCAT('Running Jobs:', ' ', 1)
				 WHEN
			 r1.job_state_desc <> 'RUNNING'
			 AND r2.job_state_desc = 'RUNNING'
				 THEN CONCAT('Running Jobs:', ' ', 1)
				 ELSE 'Running Jobs: 0'
			 END AS               value1
		   , CASE
				 WHEN r1.wo_id IS NOT NULL
				 THEN Concat(r1.wo_id, ' - ', format(r1.qty_prod,N'#.#####'), '/', format(r1.qty_reqd,N'#.#####'), ' ', r1.uom_abbr)
				 ELSE '-'
			 END AS               value2
		   , CASE
				 WHEN r1.item_id IS NOT NULL
				 THEN Concat(r1.item_id, ' - ', r1.item_desc)
				 ELSE '-'
			 END AS               value2_label
		   , CASE
				 WHEN r2.wo_id IS NOT NULL
				 THEN Concat(r2.wo_id, ' - ', format(r2.qty_prod,N'#.#####'), '/', format(r2.qty_reqd,N'#.#####'), ' ', r2.uom_abbr)
				 ELSE '-'
			 END AS               value3
		   , CASE
				 WHEN r2.item_id IS NOT NULL
				 THEN Concat(r2.item_id, ' - ', r2.item_desc)
				 ELSE '-'
			 END AS               value3_label
		   , '' AS                value4
		   , '' AS                value4_label
		   , '' AS                value5
		   , '' AS                value5_label
		   , CASE
				 WHEN r1.job_state_desc IS NULL
				   -- THEN '#FFAEBC'
				 THEN '#EDEDED'
				 ELSE '#' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), CAST(ABS(r1.color) AS VARBINARY(1)) + CAST(ABS(r1.color / 256) AS VARBINARY(1)) + CAST(ABS(r1.color / 256 / 256) AS VARBINARY(1)), 2)
			 END AS               color
		   , 'JOB' AS             action_button1_label
		   , 'INVENTORY' AS       action_button2_label
		   , '' AS                action_button3_label
		 FROM temp_cte r1
		 LEFT JOIN temp_cte r2 ON
			 r1.ent_desc = r2.ent_desc
			 AND r2.row_num = 2
		 WHERE r1.row_num = 1
		 ORDER BY--0.02.00
			 r1.job_state_desc DESC
		   , r1.row_num
		   , r1.ent_desc


	IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#ent_hirarch123') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #ent_hirarch123
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Inv_VerifyInvProps]
(@from_row_id		INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_ent_id		INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_item_id		STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_lot_no		STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_sublot_no	STRING40 = NULL
,@in_to_grade_cd	INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_status_cd	INT32 = NULL
,@in_to_expiry_date	TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
,@inv_properties_are_identical	INT32 OUTPUT
,@inv_properties_differ_info	NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Inv_VerifyInvProps
-- Description	      - HD# 3654, Verifies inventory properties such as grade_cd, status_cd and expiry date.
--			This method will verify whether the grade, status and expiry date of an item in the source inventory location
--			has the same grade, status and expiry date of an item in the destination inventory location.
--			Returns 1 (true) if the inventory properties are identical; else 0 (false).
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 05/26/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.17
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 11/14/2006	Raghu		3.1.25	Noticed by Keith; email dated:11/09/2006; The indistinguishable_lots property is checked
--					for both the source and destination inventory location; irrespective of whether the destination
--					inventory location exist or not.
-- 12/24/2007		AML			3.4.0	Added @sublot_no
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE	 @from_ent_id		INT32
	,@from_ent_name		STRING80
	,@from_item_id		STRING80
	,@from_lot_no		STRING80
	,@from_sublot_no	STRING80
	,@from_grade_cd		INT32
	,@from_status_cd	INT32
	,@from_expiry_date	TDATETIME
	,@from_grade_desc	STRING80
	,@from_status_desc	STRING80
	,@from_ent_indistinct	INT32
	,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@can_store		INT32
	,@to_ent_id		INT32
	,@to_ent_name		STRING80
	,@to_item_id		STRING80
	,@to_lot_no		STRING80
	,@to_sublot_no	STRING80
	,@to_grade_cd		INT32
	,@to_status_cd		INT32
	,@to_expiry_date	TDATETIME
	,@to_grade_desc		STRING80
	,@to_status_desc	STRING80
	,@to_ent_indistinct	INT32
	,@to_row_id		INT32
	,@qty_limit		TFLOAT

	--Default the identical flag to true, indicating that the grade, status and expiry date has a match with the destination row.
	--This flag is turned false when a match between source inventory row and destination inventory row is not found.
	--Also, default the @inv_properties_differ_info to a null value.
	SELECT @inv_properties_are_identical = 1, @inv_properties_differ_info = NULL

	--Check whether the from_row_id is supplied, meaning the user is trying to verify the the properties between source inventory row and destination inventory row.
	--If the from row id is null, then the user is trying to verify the existing destination row with the supplied properties.
	IF (@from_row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The from_row_id is not supplied. Verify atleast the user has supplied the destination inventory row.
		IF (@in_to_ent_id IS NULL OR @in_to_item_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The user must supply the source inventory row or atleast should identify the destination inventory location.{5018}'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		--Retrieve the row_id from the destination inventory location.
		SELECT @from_row_id = row_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @in_to_ent_id AND item_id = @in_to_item_id
		  AND (lot_no = @in_to_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @in_to_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (sublot_no = @in_to_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @in_to_sublot_no IS NULL))

		--If row_id is not found, then probably the user is trying to create a new row.
		IF (@from_row_id IS NULL) RETURN
	END

	--Retrieve the source inventory row.
	SELECT @from_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @from_row_id

	--Check whether we found a source inventory row.
	IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The supplied inventory source row does not exist in the database.
		SET @err_msg = 'The source row does not exist for row_id = %1 {3203},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_row_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the source entity name for the source inventory location.
	--Also, check if the source entity has the can_store capability set to true.
	SELECT @from_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

	IF (@from_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @from_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SET @to_ent_id = ISNULL(@in_to_ent_id, @from_ent_id)

	--Check whether the can store capability for the destination entity is turned on;
	--otherwise raise an error.
	SELECT @to_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id

	IF (@to_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @to_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Adjust expiry date and other defaults
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	SET @in_to_expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @in_to_expiry_date)

	--Retrieve the source inventory row.
	SELECT @from_ent_id = ent_id, @from_item_id = item_id, @from_lot_no = lot_no, @from_sublot_no = sublot_no, @from_grade_cd = grade_cd
		,@from_status_cd = status_cd, @from_expiry_date = expiry_date
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @from_row_id

	--Check if the supplied destination inventory location (ent_id, item_id and lot_no) is null,
	--If yes, then default to source inventory location.
	SELECT @to_item_id = ISNULL(@in_to_item_id, @from_item_id), @to_lot_no = ISNULL(@in_to_lot_no, @from_lot_no)

	--Retrieve the destination inventory row.
	SELECT TOP 1 @to_row_id=row_id, @to_grade_cd=grade_cd, @to_status_cd=status_cd
		,@to_expiry_date=expiry_date
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE  ent_id = @to_ent_id
	  AND item_id = @to_item_id
	  AND (lot_no = @to_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @to_lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (sublot_no = @in_to_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @in_to_sublot_no IS NULL))

	--If to_row_id is not found, probably the request is to create a new inventory row.
	IF (@to_row_id IS NULL)
		SELECT @to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @from_grade_cd)
			,@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @from_status_cd)
			,@to_expiry_date = ISNULL(@in_to_expiry_date, @from_expiry_date)

	--Default the source entity and the destination entity are not configured as indistinguishable lots.
	SELECT @from_ent_indistinct = 0, @to_ent_indistinct = 0

	--Get the indistinguishable_lots capability for the source entity.
	SELECT @from_ent_indistinct = indistinguishable_lots FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

	--Verify if the source entity and the target entity are same.
	IF (@from_ent_id <> @to_ent_id)
		--The source entity and the target entity are different. Verify whether the source entity and the destination entity are configured as indistinguishable lots.
		--Get the indistinguishable_lots capability for the destination entity.
		SELECT @to_ent_indistinct = indistinguishable_lots FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id
	ELSE SET @to_ent_indistinct = @from_ent_indistinct

	--Verify if both the source and the destination entities are configured as indishtinguishable lots
	--If yes, then verify the source has the same grade, status and expiry date as destination
	IF (@from_ent_id <> @to_ent_id) AND (@from_ent_indistinct = 1 AND @to_ent_indistinct = 1) BEGIN
		--Check if there are >0 quantities; if we don't find any quantities that are greater than 0,
		--then default to any quantities. If then entity does not allow negative quantities, then the
		--reduceInv method will automatically catch the exception.
		SET @qty_limit = 0
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id AND qty_left > 0)
			SET @qty_limit = NULL

		--The source and the destination entities are configured as indishtinguishable lots
		--Verify every item in this lot has a same grade, status and expiry date as the target entity.
		DECLARE item_inv_indist CURSOR LOCAL  FOR
		SELECT ii.item_id, ii.lot_no, ii.sublot_no, ii.grade_cd, ii.status_cd, ii.expiry_date
		FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id AND (ii.qty_left > @qty_limit OR @qty_limit IS NULL)

		OPEN item_inv_indist
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM item_inv_indist INTO @from_item_id, @from_lot_no, @from_sublot_no, @from_grade_cd,
				@from_status_cd, @from_expiry_date
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			--Verify whether the destination inventory row exist for this item and lot.
			--If a destination inventory does not exist, then probably a new inventory row will be created, so do not bother to verify the grade, status or expiry date.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id AND item_id = @from_item_id
				  AND (lot_no = @from_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @from_lot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (sublot_no = @from_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @from_sublot_no IS NULL))) BEGIN

				--The destination row exist, then retrieve the destination inventory row to check for grade, status and expiry date.
				SELECT @to_item_id = item_id, @to_lot_no = lot_no, @to_sublot_no = sublot_no, @to_grade_cd = grade_cd,
					@to_status_cd = status_cd, @to_expiry_date = expiry_date
				FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id AND item_id = @from_item_id
				  AND (lot_no = @from_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @from_lot_no IS NULL))
				  AND (sublot_no = @from_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @from_sublot_no IS NULL))


				--If the supplied grade_cd, status or expiry date is null (or not supplied), then default the grade, status and expiry date to the existing row
				--We have to account the supplied grade, status and expiry date as this is the one which is going to end up in the destination inventory row.
				SELECT @to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd), @to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd)
					,@to_expiry_date = ISNULL(@in_to_expiry_date, @to_expiry_date)

				IF (@from_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd) AND (@from_status_cd = @to_status_cd)
					AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @from_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120)) OR (@from_expiry_date IS NULL AND @to_expiry_date IS NULL))
					AND (@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd))
					AND (@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd))
					AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ISNULL(@in_to_expiry_date, @to_expiry_date), 120)) OR (@to_expiry_date IS NULL AND @in_to_expiry_date IS NULL))
					--If we get here, there is a match in inventory properties between source inventory and destination inventory row.
					--Just verify the next row.
					--PRINT 'DO NOTHING'
					DECLARE @x as bit
				ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @from_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @from_grade_cd
					IF (@from_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_grade_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @from_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @from_status_cd
					IF (@from_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_status_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @to_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd
					IF (@to_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_grade_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @to_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @to_status_cd
					IF (@to_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_status_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					--The grade, status or expiry date in the destination inventory row does not match with the source inventory row.
					SET @inv_properties_are_identical = 0
					SET @inv_properties_differ_info = 'The item: %1 in the source inventory location: %2, lot: %3 has a grade: %4, status: %5 and expiry date: %6 is different than the item: %7 stored in the destination inventory location: %8, lot: %9 which has grade: %10, status: %11 and expiry date: %12 in it.{5010},'
								+ @from_item_id + ',' + @from_ent_name + ',' +  ISNULL(@from_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + ISNULL(@from_sublot_no, 'NULL' ) + ',' + @from_grade_desc + ',' + @from_status_desc + ',' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @from_expiry_date, 120), 'NULL') + ',' + @to_item_id + ',' + @to_ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@to_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @to_grade_desc + ',' + @to_status_desc + ',' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120), 'NULL')
					RETURN
				END
			END
		END
		CLOSE item_inv_indist
		DEALLOCATE item_inv_indist
	END -- The source and the destination entity is configured as indishtinguishable lots, the entities as well are not same.
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The source and the destination entities are NOT same and they are NOT configured as indistinguishable lots as well OR the source and the destination entities are same and they are configured as indistinguishable lots.
		-- Fix for CR L00096446/HF-1602
		-- IF (@from_ent_indistinct <> @to_ent_indistinct) BEGIN
		IF (@from_ent_indistinct = 1 AND @to_ent_indistinct = 0) BEGIN
			--One of the entity here is configured as  indistinguishable lots and the other is not configured as indistinguishable lots.
			--Do not allow inventory transfers if both does not have the same configuration, throw an error.
			--SET @err_msg = 'The item(s) cannot be transferred to the destination entity, because the source entitity''s:%1 setup for indistinguishable lots is different than the destination entity''s:%2 setup.{5009},' + @from_ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
			SET @err_msg = 'The item(s) cannot be transferred to the destination entity, because lots or items stored in/on the source entity (%1) are indistinguishable whereas lots/items stored in/on the destination entity (%2) are distinguishable.{5009},' + @from_ent_name + ',' + @to_ent_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--The source and the destination entities are not configured as indistinguishable lots.
		--Verify if both the source and the destination entities are configured as indishtinguishable lots
		--Check whether the source inventory row differs from the destination inventory row.
		--If both are same, then probably the request is to change the grade, status or expiry_date.
		--The inventory transfer option is required only if the destination row's grade, status, or expiry date differs
		--from the source inventory row.
		IF (@to_row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--If the supplied grade_cd, status or expiry date is null (or not supplied), then default the grade, status and expiry date to the existing row
			--We have to account the supplied grade, status and expiry date as this is the one which is going to end up in the destination inventory row.
			SELECT @to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd), @to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd)
				,@to_expiry_date = ISNULL(@in_to_expiry_date, @to_expiry_date)

			IF (@from_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd) AND (@from_status_cd = @to_status_cd)
				AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @from_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120)) OR (@from_expiry_date IS NULL AND @to_expiry_date IS NULL))
				AND (@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd))
				AND (@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd))
				AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ISNULL(@in_to_expiry_date, @to_expiry_date), 120)) OR (@to_expiry_date IS NULL AND @in_to_expiry_date IS NULL))
				--If we get here, there is a match in inventory properties between source inventory and destination inventory row.
				RETURN
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @from_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @from_grade_cd
				IF (@from_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_grade_cd)
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				SELECT @from_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @from_status_cd
				IF (@from_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_status_cd)
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				SELECT @to_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd
				IF (@to_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_grade_cd)
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				SELECT @to_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @to_status_cd
				IF (@to_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
					SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_status_cd)
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
					RETURN
				END

				--The grade, status or expiry date in the destination inventory row does not match with the source inventory row.
				SET @inv_properties_are_identical = 0
				SET @inv_properties_differ_info = 'The item: %1 in the source inventory location: %2, lot: %3 has a grade: %4, status: %5 and expiry date: %6 is different than the item: %7 stored in the destination inventory location: %8, lot: %9 which has grade: %10, status: %11 and expiry date: %12 in it.{5010},'
							+ @from_item_id + ',' + @from_ent_name + ',' +  ISNULL(@from_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + ISNULL(@from_sublot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @from_grade_desc + ',' + @from_status_desc + ',' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @from_expiry_date, 120), 'NULL') + ',' + @to_item_id + ',' + @to_ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@to_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @to_grade_desc + ',' + @to_status_desc + ',' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120), 'NULL')
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END --The source and the destination entities are NOT same and they are NOT configured as indistinguishable lots as well OR the source and the destination entities are same and they are configured as indistinguishable lots.
END

CREATE   Trigger [tg_item_prod_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[item_prod]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
as
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - Trigger on item_prod table. Executes after any updation made on this table
-- Description       - Whenever a production is reported (added production or qtys rejected on item prod will
--			update data into tpm_stat
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 09/26/2002
-- Version
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver			Changes
-- 12/26/2016	Anwar			5.03		CR L00143393,HF L00142751: Only delete item cons and item prod records when both qty and qty erp are 0.
-- 03/28/2017	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:787207, As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00144715: so that a user can reduce consumption with the Genealogy .Net Control even when a different user
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	-- CR L00143393: Delete item cons and item prod records when both qty and qty erp are 0.
	IF EXISTS(select i.row_id from inserted i where i.qty_prod =0 AND i.qty_prod_erp = 0)
	BEGIN
		DELETE ip FROM item_prod ip
			INNER JOIN inserted i ON ip.row_id = i.row_id
			WHERE i.qty_prod =0 AND i.qty_prod_erp = 0
		RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE item_prod SET item_prod.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_prod.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE item_prod.row_id = i.row_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_48]
(
		@grp_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
	--,	@sample_time			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@sample_time_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML

	,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no					STRING40_NULL = NULL

	--,	@shift_start			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML

	,	@genealogy_id	STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_requirement_id STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@segment_response_id STRING80_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by			STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at			TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@row_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- SP_SA_DATA_LOG_48
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 09/10/2002		Raghu			1.4			Get data log 48 values only from a non-obsolete data log group
-- 06/12/2003		Raghu			1.6.10		Truncate milli-seconds for sample time
-- 6/13/2003		Chandresh		1.6			Included row_id in the select statement
-- 03/05/2004		Raghu			2.0.0.27	Removed sample_time conversion and returned the sample_time as is.
-- 02/14/2005		Raghu			2.1.13		HD# 5258, 5367 Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time
-- 05/24/2005		Raghu			2.1.22		HD# 5713, Returns sample_time in datetime format; instead of string format.
-- 09/21/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5713, Sample_time column is returned as datetime and not as a string.
-- 10/12/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 02/01/2007		Raghu			3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/05/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000.
-- 08/02/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	/* 08/02/2007 AML
    IF ( @sample_time IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @sample_time = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sample_time )
	END

	IF ( @shift_start IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @shift_start = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start )
	END
	*/



	SELECT	data_log_48.grp_id
		,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, data_log_48.sample_time_utc ) AS sample_time
		,	data_log_48.sample_time_utc		-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_48.sample_time_local	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_48.wo_id
		,	wo.wo_desc
		,	data_log_48.oper_id
		,	data_log_48.seq_no
		,	job.job_desc
		,	data_log_48.step_no
		,	job_step.step_desc
		,	data_log_48.item_id
		,	item.item_desc
		,	data_log_48.lot_no
		,	data_log_48.sublot_no
		,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, data_log_48.shift_start_utc ) AS shift_start
		,	data_log_48.shift_start_utc		-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_48.shift_start_local	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
		,	data_log_48.shift_id
		,	data_log_48.ent_id
		,	data_log_48.genealogy_id
        ,	data_log_48.segment_requirement_id
        ,	data_log_48.segment_response_id
		,	data_log_48.value1
		,	data_log_48.value2
		,	data_log_48.value3
		,	data_log_48.value4
		,	data_log_48.value5
		,	data_log_48.value6
		,	data_log_48.value7
		,	data_log_48.value8
		,	data_log_48.value9
		,	data_log_48.value10
		,	data_log_48.value11
		,	data_log_48.value12
		,	data_log_48.value13
		,	data_log_48.value14
		,	data_log_48.value15
		,	data_log_48.value16
		,	data_log_48.value17
		,	data_log_48.value18
		,	data_log_48.value19
		,	data_log_48.value20
		,	data_log_48.value21
		,	data_log_48.value22
		,	data_log_48.value23
		,	data_log_48.value24
		,	data_log_48.value25
		,	data_log_48.value26
		,	data_log_48.value27
		,	data_log_48.value28
		,	data_log_48.value29
		,	data_log_48.value30
		,	data_log_48.value31
		,	data_log_48.value32
		,	data_log_48.value33
		,	data_log_48.value34
		,	data_log_48.value35
		,	data_log_48.value36
		,	data_log_48.value37
		,	data_log_48.value38
		,	data_log_48.value39
		,	data_log_48.value40
		,	data_log_48.value41
		,	data_log_48.value42
		,	data_log_48.value43
		,	data_log_48.value44
		,	data_log_48.value45
		,	data_log_48.value46
		,	data_log_48.value47
		,	data_log_48.value48
		,	data_log_48.last_edit_comment
		,	data_log_48.last_edit_by
		,	data_log_48.last_edit_at
		,	data_log_48.row_id
	FROM data_log_48 WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_48.wo_id = wo.wo_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_48.wo_id  = job.wo_id AND
			data_log_48.oper_id = job.oper_id AND
			data_log_48.seq_no = job.seq_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_48.wo_id = job_step.wo_id AND
			data_log_48.oper_id = job_step.oper_id AND
			data_log_48.seq_no = job_step.seq_no AND
			data_log_48.step_no = job_step.step_no
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			data_log_48.item_id = item.item_id
	WHERE (
			(data_log_48.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
			--(data_log_48.sample_time = @sample_time OR @sample_time IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.sample_time_utc = @sample_time_utc OR @sample_time_utc IS NULL) AND -- Added 08/02/2007 AML
			(data_log_48.sample_time_local = @sample_time_local OR @sample_time_local IS NULL) AND -- Added 08/02/2007 AML

			(data_log_48.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND

			(data_log_48.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND

			(data_log_48.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL) AND -- Added 08/02/2007 AML
			(data_log_48.shift_start_local = @shift_start_local OR @shift_start_local IS NULL) AND -- Added 08/02/2007 AML
			(data_log_48.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_48.grp_id IN (SELECT grp_id FROM data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE obsolete = 0 ))
		  )
	ORDER BY data_log_48.sample_time_utc

END
