CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Sublot_Attr] 

@wo_id as nvarchar(40),
@oper_id as nvarchar(40),
@seq_no as int,
@ent_id as int,
@eventName as nvarchar(20)


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

Declare 
@parent_ent_id as int,
@area_ent_id as int,
@line_ent_id as int,
@jb_state_cd as int,
@attr_id as int,
@area_attr_id as int,
@is_req_area_level as nvarchar(100),
@sublot_no as nvarchar(100),
@sublot_attr_value as nvarchar(100),
@good_hu_attr_id as int,
@MaxSublotCounter_str as nvarchar(40),
@MaxSublotCounter as int,
@counter_value as int


SELECT @area_ent_id=parent_ent_id 
	FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id=( SELECT parent_ent_id FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) INNER join job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_id=target_sched_ent_id WHERE  ( wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND seq_no=@seq_no ))
SELECT @line_ent_id= parent_ent_id 
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) 
	INNER join job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent_id=target_sched_ent_id 
		WHERE  ent_id=@ent_id OR ( wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND seq_no=@seq_no )
										
SELECT @area_attr_id= attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	 WHERE attr_desc='isRequiredAreaSublotforMultiLine'
SELECT @attr_id=attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	 WHERE attr_desc='SublotCounter'
--V0.08.00
SELECT @MaxSublotCounter_str=ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'MaxSublotCounter'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @area_ent_id

SELECT @MaxSublotCounter = CAST((SELECT REPLACE(@MaxSublotCounter_str,',','')) AS INT)

IF(@MaxSublotCounter IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	SET @MaxSublotCounter=999
	END
--V0.08.00 END

SELECT @jb_state_cd=state_cd 
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) 
	 WHERE ( wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND seq_no=@seq_no )

SELECT @is_req_area_level=attr_value
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE attr_id=@area_attr_id AND ent_id=@area_ent_id 
SELECT @sublot_attr_value=attr_value 
	FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
	 WHERE attr_id=@attr_id AND ent_id=@area_ent_id 



Declare
@NewSublotStartJob as int,
@NewSublotEditRecipe as int,
@NewSublotOnSUChange as int,
@NewSublotOnShiftChange as int,
@NewSublotOnDayChange as int,
@NewSublotOnSURecipeChange as int, -- v0.04.00
@NewSublotOnlyFirstTimeStartJob as int, -- v0.05.00
@NewSublotOnHUChange as int, -- v0.06.00
@NewSublotOnFrequency as int -- v0.08.00

--If Area level counter is available need to update the value inside the Lines indipendently
IF (@is_req_area_level='1' AND @sublot_attr_value is not null	)
	BEGIN 
	--print 'START'
	--print @area_ent_id
	--print @sublot_attr_value

	SET @parent_ent_id=@area_ent_id
	SELECT @counter_value =CAST((SELECT REPLACE((select attr_value FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id=@attr_id AND ent_id=@parent_ent_id),',','')) AS INT)

	SELECT @NewSublotStartJob=ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'NewSublotStartJob'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id

	SELECT @NewSublotOnlyFirstTimeStartJob=ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'NewSublotOnlyFirstTimeStartJob'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id

	SELECT @NewSublotEditRecipe=ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'NewSublotEditRecipe'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id

	SELECT @NewSublotOnSUChange=ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'NewSublotOnSUChange'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @line_ent_id

	SELECT @NewSublotOnShiftChange=ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)

			AND a.attr_desc = 'NewSublotOnShiftChange'

	SELECT @NewSublotOnDayChange=ea.attr_value

			AND a.attr_desc = 'NewSublotOnDayChange'

	SELECT @NewSublotOnFrequency=ea.attr_value

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GETPerformanceLoss]
	@ent_id AS INT
AS
	-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
	-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_GETPerformanceLoss  -
	-- Description:	    Get the performance percentage
	--
	-- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
	-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-01						Find the performance percentage
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @day AS                 INT
		  , @wdays AS               NVARCHAR(20)
		  , @shift_day AS           INT
		  , @shift_id AS            INT
		  , @shift_start_time AS    DATETIME
		  , @shift_end_time AS      DATETIME
		  , @diff_shift_mins AS     INT
		  , @utlization AS          INT
		  , @utlization_loss AS     INT
		  , @util_mins AS           DECIMAL
		  , @avil_runtime AS        INTEGER
		  , @avil_downtime AS       INTEGER
		  , @avil_percent AS        INTEGER
		  , @parent_ent_id AS       INTEGER
		  , @expected_prod AS       DECIMAL
		  , @actual_prod AS         DECIMAL
		  , @performance_percent AS DECIMAL
		  , @speed AS               INTEGER
		  , @perm_loss AS           INT

	--get the running day of the week from the above
	SET @wdays = Datename(weekday, GETDATE())

	IF @wdays = 'Monday'
	BEGIN
		SET @day = 0
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @wdays = 'Tuesday'
		BEGIN
			SET @day = 1
		END
			ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @wdays = 'Wednesday'
			BEGIN
				SET @day = 2
			END
				ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @wdays = 'Thursday'
				BEGIN
					SET @day = 3
				END
					ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @wdays = 'Friday'
					BEGIN
						SET @day = 4
					END
						ELSE
					BEGIN
						IF @wdays = 'Saturday'
						BEGIN
							SET @day = 5
						END
							ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF @wdays = 'Sunday'
							BEGIN
								SET @day = 6
							END
						END
					END
				END
			END
		END
	END

	-- Get the Current shift_id from the below query
	SELECT
		@shift_id = shift_id
	  , @parent_ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
	FROM shift_history sh WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = sh.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	WHERE
		sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL
		AND e.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND attr_value = 'Segment'

	--Fetch the shift start and end date time with below query
	SELECT TOP 1
		@shift_start_time = shift_start_utc
	  , @shift_end_time = shift_end_utc
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL
		--AND shift_end_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC

	-- Calculate the timing difference between the start and end time
	SET @diff_shift_mins = DATEDIFF(minute, @shift_start_time, GETUTCDATE())
	PRINT '@diff_shift_mins' + CAST(@diff_shift_mins AS VARCHAR)
	PRINT '@shift_start_time' + CAST(@shift_start_time AS VARCHAR)
	--Get the current run shift_start time and shift_end time from the shift_history table
	SELECT TOP 1
		@shift_start_time = shift_start_utc
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		ent_id = @ent_id --WHERE  ent_id = @parent_ent_id
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC

	--using the below query to find the running shift end time
	SET @shift_end_time = DATEADD(minute, @diff_shift_mins, @shift_start_time)

	--using the below view to find the total utilization time in mins
	SELECT
		@util_mins = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= @shift_end_time
	SET @util_mins = ISNULL(@util_mins, 0)
	--check the utilization mins and it's less than total mins duration then set default value
	IF @util_mins > @diff_shift_mins
	BEGIN
		SET @utlization = 100
		SET @utlization_loss = 0
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @util_mins < @diff_shift_mins
		BEGIN
			SET @utlization = CAST((@util_mins / @diff_shift_mins) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
			SET @utlization_loss = 100 - @utlization
		END
	END

	DECLARE @duration_down    FLOAT
		  , @duration_running FLOAT
	EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
		 @ent_id = @ent_id
	   , @runtime = 0
	   , @wocheck = 1
	   , @durationSecout = @duration_down OUT
	EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
		 @ent_id = @ent_id
	   , @runtime = 1
	   , @wocheck = 1
	   , @durationSecout = @duration_running OUT
	DECLARE @availPer FLOAT
		  , @utilPer  FLOAT

	DECLARE @totaltime FLOAT
	SET @totaltime = @duration_down + @duration_running

	IF @totaltime > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @availPer = (((@totaltime - @duration_down) / @totaltime)) * 100
		SET @util_mins = (@totaltime - @duration_down) / 60
	END
	--below query used to find the avilable runtime and downtime from the total utilization time
	SELECT
		@avil_runtime = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc <= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		-- AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETUTCDATE(), 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= GETUTCDATE()
		AND runtime = 1
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
	SET @avil_runtime = ISNULL(@util_mins, 0)
	PRINT '@avil_runtime' + CAST(@avil_runtime AS VARCHAR)

	SELECT
		@avil_downtime = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= @shift_end_time
		AND runtime = 0
	SET @avil_percent = 0
	IF @util_mins > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @avil_percent = CAST((@avil_runtime / @util_mins) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
	END


	--Get the actual production, job capactity per hour from current running shift
	;WITH CTE as (
	SELECT
		[dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ip.item_id, SUM(ip.qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'
	FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN job j ON j.wo_id = ip.wo_id and j.oper_id=ip.oper_id and j.seq_no=ip.seq_no
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		AND j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
		GROUP BY ip.item_id, i.uom_id
		)Select @actual_prod=SUM(qty_prod) from CTE;

	DECLARE @totalactualprod FLOAT
	SET @totalactualprod = @diff_shift_mins * @speed
	PRINT '@totalactualprod' + CAST(@totalactualprod AS VARCHAR)
	PRINT 'actual_prod' + CAST(@actual_prod AS VARCHAR)

	----Get from the ofi_Table below capcity
	
	

	;WITH CTE as (
	select 
		SUM(CASE WHEN job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,jh.job_start_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE()))
		ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE())) 
		END *(os.nameplate_speed /3600)) as exp_qty
		,SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,j.sched_start_time_utc,sched_finish_time_utc) IS NULL
		THEN 0
		ELSE 
		CASE WHEN job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,jh.job_start_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE()))
		ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE())) 
		END
		*j.qty_reqd/DATEDIFF(SECOND,j.sched_start_time_utc,sched_finish_time_utc)
		END)	as planned_qty		
		from ent e  WITH(NOLOCK)
		left join job_history jh WITH(NOLOCK) on e.ent_id=jh.ent_id and (jh.job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc or jh.job_end_utc is null or jh.job_end_utc between e.cur_shift_start_time_utc and e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
		INNER join job j WITH(NOLOCK) on j.wo_id=jh.wo_id and j.oper_id=jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		LEFT JOIN ofi_nameplate_speed os  WITH(NOLOCK) on j.run_ent_id=os.ent_id and os.item_id=j.item_id
		
		WHERE	
		 j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
		GROUP by j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.item_id
		)
				SELECT @expected_prod=SUM (exp_qty) from cte

		
		
	PRINT @avil_runtime
	PRINT 'Speed' + CAST(@speed AS VARCHAR)
	PRINT 'Exp Prod' + CAST(@expected_prod AS VARCHAR)
	--calculate performance percentage and it's losses 
	SET @performance_percent = CAST((@actual_prod / @expected_prod) * 100 AS--@expected_prod
	DECIMAL(18, 2))
	PRINT '@performance_percent' + CAST(@performance_percent AS VARCHAR)
	--set  @performance_percent =  (82 / 116 ) * 100
	SET @perm_loss = @avil_runtime - @performance_percent

	IF @performance_percent >= 100
	BEGIN
		SET @performance_percent = 100
		SET @perm_loss = 0
	END
	
	SELECT
		ISNULL(@diff_shift_mins, 0) AS     util_max
	  , ISNULL(@util_mins, 0) AS           util_data
	  , ISNULL(@avil_runtime, 0) AS        avil_data
	  , ISNULL(@performance_percent, 0) AS perf_data
	  , ISNULL(@perm_loss, 0) AS           perf_loss
END

,@in_transfer_comments		STRING254 = NULL
,@in_log_transfer			INT32 = 1
,@in_time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty
-- Description			- HD# 3596, Allows multiple lots for an item to be combined into a new lot or added to an existing lot
--						  Transfer Option 1: Source row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry date must match with the
--							destination row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry date. If not an error is returned.
--						  Transfer Option 2: Even if source row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry Date do not match a possible
--							destination row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry Date,
--							the original destination row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry Date will be retained
--							and the source row?s quantity will be added to it.
--							One exception to this is, if the to_grade_cd, to_status_cd, or to_expiry_date is supplied
--							then use that for the destination inventory; else retain whatever is in the destination inventory.
--						  Transfer Option 3: Even if source row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry Date do not match a possible
--							destination row?s Grade Code, Status Code and Expiry Date, the source row?s Grade Code, Status Code
--							and Expiry Date will overwrite the existing values in the destination row
--							and the source row?s quantity will be added to it.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 05/23/2006
-- Version				- 3.1.17
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

--Description of changes carried over from sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferAndUpdateInv and sp_U_Item_Inv_Move
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 08/21/2002		Raghu					Ignore checking for max_capacity for max_capacity = 0. If max_capacity = 0, then NO Limit
-- 08/30/2002		Raghu		1.4			Included Parameter From_Grade_Cd, From_Status_Cd, To_Grade_Cd and To_Status_Cd
-- 08/06/2002		Raghu		1.4			Joining with status_cd and grade_cd is removed.  As in 1.4 database, ent_id, item_id and lot_no are always unique
-- 09/09/2002		Raghu		1.4			Get Log_Trans option value from system_attribute =198 and log inventory transfers if this attribute is set to 1
-- 09/19/2002		Raghu		1.4			If allow neg qtys for an entity are set in storage_exec, then allow the entity can hold negative qtys
-- 12/04/2002		Raghu		1.5			Renamed sp_U_Item_Inv_Transfer1 to sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferAndUpdateInv
-- 01/09/2003		Rohit		1.5.2		Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/17/2003		Raghu		1.5.5		(HD# 2273). Lot_No allowed to change NULL Values
-- 01/31/2003		Rohit		1.5.5		Changed the logic to hangle storage exec status
-- 06-06-2003		SJ     		1.6.0  		Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 07/03/2003		Raghu		1.6.13		(HD# 3362) Max capacity in a storage location will go only on per entity basis; not on lot or items
-- 07/07/2003		Raghu		1.7.0		(HD# 3365) Removed log_trans param; as it is not used anyway. Value is fetched from system_attr = 198 to log the transfers or not
-- 12/11/2003		KRF						(HD#4254) Do not default expiry dates to now if they are null; null is OK, meaning no expiration
-- 02/09/2005		Raghu		2.1.13		HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
-- 02/28/2005		Raghu		2.1.15		HD# 5430, Included user_id in the item_trasfer insert statements to know who the user is changing the inventory.
-- 03/23/2005		Raghu		2.1.17		HD# 5430, Track Inventory Users, Delegate this call to Move
-- 01/25/2006		Raghu		3.1.8		HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
-- 10/03/2005		Raghu		3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 01/25/2006		Raghu		3.1.8		HD# 6829, log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transfer.
-- 05/17/2006		Raghu		3.1.17		HD# 3654; Handle UOM_ID conversions in terms of destination measurements; Apply Indistinguishable lots
-- 01/23/2007		Raghu		3.2.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 03/05/2007		Raghu       3.2.2		HD# 9497, Inventory window/ splitting and combining lots
-- 03/30/2007		Raghu       3.2.5		HD# 9287, Inventory Unique By Job
--											If the item is hard pegged, and a user has the privilege to override this,
--											the fields in the inventory table identifying which job produced this serial number will be updated
--											to match those of any job immediately preceeding the first job identified by the work order
--											and operation on the ?To? side of the transfer screen, that produces the item being transferred.
--											If there is no such ?upstream? job, these fields are left unchanged.
-- 04/17/2007		Raghu		3.2.8		HD# 9712, Locate inventory using the job information only if it is supplied.
-- 05/01/2007		Raghu		3.2.10		HD# 9788, Transferring a lot/serial number sets wo_id and op_id to null
-- 05/17/2007		Raghu		3.2.12		HD# 9893, Do not raise an exception when inv_unique_by_job is set to true; and a valid wo_id, oper_id, seq_no is not found in the db
-- 05/30/2007		Raghu		3.2.14		HD# 10000, Expiration date is being set incorrectly
-- 06/08/2007		Raghu		3.2.16		HD# 9893, Default wo_id, oper_id and seq_no from source row when inventory is reclassified.
-- 06/15/2007		Raghu		3.2.16		Move inventory to downstream job ONLY if it is instructed to do so.
-- 08/17/2007		AML			3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML			3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--08/24/2008		Raghu       3.5.		L00075704; GE - Job Based Serialization - provide the ability to turn off item serialization at the work order level. Hotfix Request ID 887
-- 11/22/2009		AJAY			4.0		H1423 FIX
-- 12/16/2011		Rupak		4.2			CR107451
--01/27/2012     praveen kumar  4.0 sp2     Modified for CRL00118671,Spare fields are used they do not get carried over if the Item is transferred or shipped in the new record in the database
--10/03/2012		Saiteja		4.6		Added changes for CR L00122604
--05/22/2013		Ashish		4.6			Modified for backlog CR-L00123841
--01/27/2014		Roma		4.6			Merged CR-L00129489 to the Aries branch
--06/02/2014	Raghu		5.0   MOL: Merge L00124379 (HF CR L00124019) not taking into account the storage location can have negative inventory
-- 03/19/2018   Srinivasa   6.0     US#804232(Handled null value for @from_ent_id and @from_row_id).
-- 06/09/2019	Varun		6.2		US#1170529: CR L00150831- Added COALESCE to avoid blank/null value in @count_of_distinct_uoms
--02/28/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187829-As Bruce, I want an ItemInventory Put web API so I can transfer inventory

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@to_item_desc				STRING80
		,	@to_serial_no_lvl			INT32
		,	@to_inv_unique_by_job		INT32
		,	@from_ent_id				INT32
		,	@from_item_id				STRING40
		,	@from_item_desc				STRING80
		,	@from_serial_no_lvl			INT32
		,	@from_inv_unique_by_job 	INT32
		,	@from_lot_no				STRING40
		,	@from_sublot_no				STRING40
		,	@from_grade_cd				INT32
		,	@from_status_cd				INT32
		,	@from_qty_left				TFLOAT
		,	@from_qty_left_erp			TFLOAT
		,	@from_uom_id				INT32
		,	@from_date_in_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@from_date_in_local			TDATETIME
		,	@from_date_out_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@from_date_out_local		TDATETIME
		,	@from_expiry_date			TDATETIME
		,	@from_wo_id					STRING40
		,	@from_oper_id				STRING40
		,	@from_seq_no				INT32
		,	@from_ent_name				STRING80
		,	@from_inv_uom_id			INT32
	    ,	@from_spare1				nvarchar(80)
		,	@from_spare2				nvarchar(80)
		,	@from_spare3				nvarchar(80)
		,	@from_spare4				nvarchar(80)
		,	@from_spare5				nvarchar(80)
		,	@from_spare6				nvarchar(80)
		,	@to_row_id					INT32
		,	@to_qty_left				TFLOAT
		,	@to_qty_left_erp			TFLOAT
		,	@to_date_in_utc				TDATETIME
		,	@to_date_in_local			TDATETIME
		,	@to_date_out_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@to_date_out_local			TDATETIME
		,	@to_ent_name				STRING80
		,	@to_inv_uom_id				INT32
		,	@err_msg					NVARCHAR(2000)
		,	@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,	@transfer_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@transfer_time_local		TDATETIME
		,	@transaction_type			INT32
		,	@can_store					INT32
		,	@reduce_qty					TFLOAT
		,	@reduce_qty_erp				TFLOAT
		,	@factor_source				TFLOAT
		,	@offset_source				TFLOAT
		,	@factor_dest				TFLOAT
		,	@offset_dest				TFLOAT
		,	@from_uom_desc				STRING40
		,	@to_uom_desc				STRING40
		,	@max_capacity				TFLOAT
		,	@cur_total_qty				TFLOAT
		,	@auto_del_zero_inv			INT32
		,	@allow_neg_qty				INT32
		,	@log_trans					LOGICAL
		,	@user_id					STRING40
		,	@cur_shift_id				INT32
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@cur_shift_start_time_local	TDATETIME
		,	@cur_reas_cd				INT32
		,	@scrapped					LOGICAL
		,	@from_grade_desc			STRING80
		,	@from_status_desc			STRING80
		,	@to_grade_desc				STRING80
		,	@to_status_desc				STRING80
		,	@in_to_expiry_date_			TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp					INT32
		,	@from_row_id				INT32
		,	@from_last_edit_at			TDATETIME
		,	@transfer_qty   			TFLOAT
		,	@transfer_qty_erp			TFLOAT
		,	@to_ent_id					INT32
		,	@to_item_id					STRING40
		,	@to_lot_no					STRING40
		,	@to_sublot_no				STRING40
		,	@to_grade_cd				INT32
		,	@to_status_cd				INT32
		,	@to_uom_id					STRING40
		,	@to_expiry_date				TDATETIME
		,	@to_wo_id					STRING80
		,	@to_oper_id					STRING80
		,	@to_seq_no					INT32
		,	@transfer_option			INT32
		,	@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job	INT32
		,	@transfer_comments			STRING254
		,	@log_transfer				INT32
		,	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32
		,	@override_serialization		BIT
		,	@dbg_resp					INT
		,	@temp_in_to_expiry_date		INT
-- CR L00098047
		,	@num_decimals				INT32
		,	@indistinguishable_lots_from_ent LOGICAL
		,	@indistinguishable_lots_to_ent	LOGICAL
		,	@count_of_distinct_uoms		INT32


	SET @in_to_expiry_date_tz		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@in_to_expiry_date_tz)
	SET @in_to_expiry_date			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value		= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

      -- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty_temp', @src_key='sp_U_Item_Inv_TransferQty_temp',
									 @date_val1 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val1 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz ,
									 @date_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date, @numeric_val2 = @in_to_expiry_date_tz
	if (@dbg_resp=1)
		return


	SELECT	@from_row_id = @in_from_row_id
		,	@from_last_edit_at = @in_from_last_edit_at
		,	@transfer_qty = @in_transfer_qty
		,	@transfer_qty_erp = @in_transfer_qty_erp
		,	@to_ent_id = @in_to_ent_id
		,	@to_item_id = @in_to_item_id
		,	@to_lot_no = @in_to_lot_no
		,	@to_sublot_no = @in_to_sublot_no
		,	@to_grade_cd = @in_to_grade_cd
		,	@to_status_cd = @in_to_status_cd
		,	@to_uom_id = @in_to_uom_id
		,	@to_expiry_date = @in_to_expiry_date
		,	@to_wo_id = @in_to_wo_id
		,	@to_oper_id = @in_to_oper_id
		,	@to_seq_no = @in_to_seq_no
		,	@transfer_option = @in_transfer_option
		,	@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job = ISNULL( @in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job, 0 )
		,	@transfer_comments = @in_transfer_comments
		,	@log_transfer = @in_log_transfer
		,	@time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @in_time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
		,	@in_to_expiry_date_ = @in_to_expiry_date
-- CR L00098047
		,	@num_decimals = 0

	SET		@temp_in_to_expiry_date = -@in_to_expiry_date_tz

	SET @in_to_expiry_date_ = dateadd( mi, @temp_in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date_ )

	--Default transfer_qty_erp to 0, always default last_edit_at value to GMT Date and Time
	SELECT	@last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	SET @transfer_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @transfer_time_local = @transfer_time_utc
	ELSE SET @transfer_time_local = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, @transfer_time_utc)


	--Default transaction_type to combine lots, and default log_transfer to 1 (assuming this is a pure inventory transfer)
	SELECT	@from_last_edit_at = @last_edit_at, @in_to_expiry_date = @to_expiry_date
		,	@transfer_option = COALESCE(@transfer_option, 1), @log_transfer = COALESCE(@log_transfer, 1)
		,	@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job = COALESCE(@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job, 0)

	SELECT @in_to_expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, @temp_in_to_expiry_date, @in_to_expiry_date), @transaction_type = 2

	--Retrieve the source inventory row.
	SELECT	@from_ent_id = ent_id, @from_item_id = item_id, @from_lot_no = lot_no
		,	@from_sublot_no = sublot_no, @from_grade_cd = grade_cd, @from_status_cd = status_cd
		,	@from_qty_left = qty_left, @from_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp, @from_uom_id = uom_id
		,	@from_date_in_utc = date_in_utc, @from_date_in_local = date_in_local
		,	@from_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @from_date_out_local = date_out_local
		,	@from_expiry_date = expiry_date, @from_wo_id = wo_id, @from_oper_id = oper_id, @from_seq_no = seq_no
		,   @from_spare1 = spare1, @from_spare2 = spare2, @from_spare3 = spare3, @from_spare4 = spare4
		,   @from_spare5 = spare5, @from_spare6 = spare6

	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @from_row_id
	  --AND (last_edit_at = @from_last_edit_at OR @from_last_edit_at IS NULL)

-- CR L00098047
	IF (@from_item_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT @num_decimals = num_decimals FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @from_item_id

	--Check whether we found a source inventory row.
	IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Check whether the inventory row exist, but the qty is modified by the time this call is initiated.
		IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = @from_row_id ) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified row was not found in the database, or it has been modified by someone else since you retrieved it for the row_id = %1 {3441},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_row_id, -1))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The supplied inventory source row does not exist in the database.
			SET @err_msg = 'The source row does not exist for row_id = %1 {3203},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_row_id, -1))
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Get the source entity name for the source inventory location.
	--Also, check if the source entity has the can_store capability set to true.
	SELECT @from_ent_name = ent_name, @can_store = can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

	IF (@from_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, COALESCE(@from_ent_id, -1))
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @from_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the UOM and the item properties from the source item.
	SELECT	@from_item_desc = item_desc
		,	@from_inv_uom_id = uom_id
		,	@from_serial_no_lvl = serial_no_lvl
		,	@from_inv_unique_by_job = inv_unique_by_job
	FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_id = @from_item_id

	IF (@from_item_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for item_id:' + @from_item_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the unit of measurement from the source inventory row (item), if the source inventory row does not have a unit of measurement
	IF (@from_uom_id IS NOT NULL)
		SET @from_inv_uom_id = @from_uom_id

	--Check if the destination inventory location (ent_id, item_id and lot_no) is null,
	--If yes, then default to source inventory location. In this case, probably there may be only
	--qty changes or grade changes, etc..
	IF (@in_to_ent_id IS NULL AND @in_to_item_id IS NULL AND @in_to_lot_no IS NULL AND @in_to_sublot_no IS NULL)
		SELECT	@to_ent_id = @from_ent_id,
				@to_item_id = @from_item_id,
				@to_lot_no = @from_lot_no,
				@to_sublot_no = @from_sublot_no,
				@to_wo_id = COALESCE(@in_to_wo_id, @from_wo_id),
				@to_oper_id = COALESCE(@in_to_oper_id, @from_oper_id),
				@to_seq_no = COALESCE(@in_to_seq_no, @from_seq_no)
	ELSE
    IF (@in_to_ent_id IS Not NULL AND @in_to_item_id IS NULL AND @in_to_lot_no IS NULL AND @in_to_sublot_no IS NULL)
            SELECT      @to_ent_id = ISNULL(@in_to_ent_id, @from_ent_id),
                        @to_item_id = ISNULL(@in_to_item_id, @from_item_id),
                        @to_lot_no = ISNULL(@in_to_lot_no, @from_lot_no),
                        @to_sublot_no = ISNULL(@in_to_sublot_no, @from_sublot_no),
                        @to_wo_id = COALESCE(@in_to_wo_id, @from_wo_id),
                        @to_oper_id = COALESCE(@in_to_oper_id, @from_oper_id),
                        @to_seq_no = COALESCE(@in_to_seq_no, @from_seq_no)

  else
		SELECT	@to_ent_id = ISNULL(@in_to_ent_id, @from_ent_id),
				@to_item_id = ISNULL(@in_to_item_id, @from_item_id),
				@to_lot_no = ISNULL(@in_to_lot_no, @from_lot_no),
				--@to_sublot_no = ISNULL(@in_to_sublot_no, @from_sublot_no),
				@to_sublot_no = @in_to_sublot_no, ---changes done for CR107451
				@to_wo_id = COALESCE(@in_to_wo_id, @from_wo_id),
				@to_oper_id = COALESCE(@in_to_oper_id, @from_oper_id),
				@to_seq_no = COALESCE(@in_to_seq_no, @from_seq_no)

	--Check whether the can store capability for the destination entity is turned on;
	--otherwise raise an error.
	SELECT @to_ent_name=ent_name, @can_store=can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id
	IF (@to_ent_name IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for ent_id=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_ent_id)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF (@can_store = 0) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'You cannot add/transfer any item(s) to this inventory location, because this entity: %1 is not capable of storing items. Please change the entity''s setup to allow items to be stored in this entity.{5008},' + @to_ent_name
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Verify whether the supplied TO item is a valid item.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @to_item_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'item:' + @to_item_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	--Get the item properties from the target item.
	SELECT @to_item_desc=item_desc, @to_serial_no_lvl=serial_no_lvl,
		@to_inv_unique_by_job=inv_unique_by_job
	FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE item_id = @to_item_id

	--Verify whether the supplied item is a serialized item; OR the inventory is unique by job.
	IF (@to_inv_unique_by_job = 1 OR @to_serial_no_lvl >= 0) BEGIN
		--The supplied item is a serialized item. OR the item is identified to have a unique location per job.
		IF (@to_wo_id IS NULL OR @to_oper_id IS NULL OR @to_seq_no IS NULL) BEGIN
			IF (@to_inv_unique_by_job = 1)
				--PRINT 'DO NOTHING'
				declare @x as bit
			ELSE
				--A valid job identifying this serialized part is not supplied. Hence raise an exception to the caller.
				--SP_U_ITEM_INV_TRANSFERQTY.err_msg :=  'The supplied item:%1 is a serialized item; hence a valid details identifying a job must be supplied.{5411},' || SP_U_ITEM_INV_TRANSFERQTY.to_item_desc;
				--raise_application_error(-20999, SP_U_ITEM_INV_TRANSFERQTY.err_msg);
				--A job may not be running to identify this serialized part. Do not check the inventory with a work order, etc..
				--Just reset this serial_no_lvl flag as a non-serialized part.
				SET @to_serial_no_lvl = -1
		END
	END

	--Verify whether the target item is a serialized item.
	IF (@move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job = 1 AND @to_serial_no_lvl >= 0) BEGIN
		--The target item is a serialized item.
		SELECT @override_serialization = wo.override_serialization
		FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo.wo_id = @to_wo_id

		IF (@override_serialization = 1) SET @to_serial_no_lvl = -1

		IF (@to_serial_no_lvl >= 0) BEGIN
			--If the item is hard pegged, and a user has the privilege to override this,
			--the fields in the inventory table identifying which job produced this serial number will be updated
			--to match those of any job immediately preceeding the first job identified by the work order
			--and operation on the ?To? side of the transfer screen, that produces the item being transferred.
			--If there is no such ?upstream? job, these fields are left unchanged.
			--First, find whether any job immediately preceeding this job produces this item as a substitute item
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
					INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
					INNER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbst.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbst.bom_pos AND jb.current_subst = jbst.alt_no
					WHERE j.wo_id = @to_wo_id
					  AND j.oper_id = @to_oper_id
					  AND j.seq_no = @to_seq_no
					  AND jb.bom_pos = 0
					  AND jb.item_id = @to_item_id)

				SELECT TOP 1 @to_oper_id = jr.input_oper_id, @to_seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
				INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
				INNER JOIN job_bom_subst jbst WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jbst.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbst.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbst.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = jbst.bom_pos AND jb.current_subst = jbst.alt_no
				WHERE j.wo_id = @to_wo_id
				  AND j.oper_id = @to_oper_id
				  AND j.seq_no = @to_seq_no
				  AND jb.bom_pos = 0
				  AND jb.item_id = @to_item_id
			ELSE
				--This item is NOT produced as a substitute from this job that immediately preceeding this job.
				--Verify whether we can retrieve a job immediately preceeding this job that produces this item.
				SELECT TOP 1 @to_oper_id = jr.input_oper_id, @to_seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
				INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
				WHERE j.wo_id = @to_wo_id
				  AND j.oper_id = @to_oper_id
				  AND j.seq_no = @to_seq_no
				  AND jb.bom_pos = 0
				  AND jb.item_id = @to_item_id
		END
	END

	--Default the destination row_id as null.
	SET @to_row_id = NULL

	--Identify a unique inventory row depending upon how the item is configured.
	IF (@to_inv_unique_by_job = 0)
		--This item is not configured to store inventory for each job.
		--Retrieve the destination inventory row.
		SELECT TOP 1 @to_row_id = row_id, @to_grade_cd = grade_cd, @to_status_cd = status_cd, @to_qty_left = qty_left,
			@to_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp, @to_uom_id = uom_id, @to_date_in_utc = date_in_utc, @to_date_in_local = date_in_local,
			@to_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @to_date_out_local = date_out_local, @to_expiry_date = expiry_date,
			@to_wo_id = COALESCE(@to_wo_id, wo_id), @to_oper_id = COALESCE(@to_oper_id, oper_id), @to_seq_no = COALESCE(@to_seq_no, seq_no)
		FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE  ent_id = @to_ent_id
		  AND item_id = @to_item_id
		  AND (lot_no = @to_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @to_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (sublot_no = @to_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @to_sublot_no IS NULL))
	ELSE
		--This item is configured to store item for each job.
		--Retrieve the destination inventory row.
		SELECT TOP 1 @to_row_id = row_id, @to_grade_cd = grade_cd, @to_status_cd = status_cd, @to_qty_left = qty_left,
			@to_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp, @to_uom_id = uom_id, @to_date_in_utc = date_in_utc, @to_date_in_local = date_in_local,
			@to_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @to_date_out_local = date_out_local, @to_expiry_date = expiry_date,
			@to_wo_id = COALESCE(@to_wo_id, wo_id), @to_oper_id = COALESCE(@to_oper_id, oper_id), @to_seq_no = COALESCE(@to_seq_no, seq_no)
		FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE  ent_id = @to_ent_id
		  AND item_id = @to_item_id
		  AND (lot_no = @to_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @to_lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (sublot_no = @to_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @to_sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (wo_id = @to_wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @to_wo_id IS NULL))
		  AND (oper_id = @to_oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @to_oper_id IS NULL))
		  AND (seq_no = @to_seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @to_seq_no IS NULL))

	--Check if the destination row exist
	--If the destination row exist, then the unit of measurement has to be used in terms of destination row,
	--and ignore the incoming to_uom_id value
	--If transfer_qty IS NULL, then probably the request is to change the grade or status of an inventory row.
	IF (@transfer_qty IS NULL) BEGIN
		IF (@to_row_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			--The requested destination inventory row does not exist. We cannot create a new inventory row because the quantities are not supplied.
			SET @err_msg = 'The requested destination inventory location: %1 for item: %2 and lot: %3 does not exist, a valid quantity must be supplied to create a new inventory location with the supplied quantities.{5011},' + @to_ent_name + ',' + @to_item_id + ',' + ISNULL(@to_lot_no, 'NULL')
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
		ELSE
			--probably the request is only to change the grade or status or expiry_date of a destination inventory row.
			SELECT	@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd)
				,	@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd)
				,	@to_expiry_date = COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_, @to_expiry_date)
	END	--transfer quantity is null
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Get the reduce quantity
		SELECT	@reduce_qty = @transfer_qty, @reduce_qty_erp = ISNULL(@transfer_qty_erp, 0)
			,	@transfer_qty_erp = ISNULL(@transfer_qty_erp, 0)

		SELECT @indistinguishable_lots_from_ent = indistinguishable_lots
		FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

		IF (@indistinguishable_lots_from_ent = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @count_of_distinct_uoms = COUNT(DISTINCT uom_id)
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id
			GROUP BY ii.uom_id

			IF (@count_of_distinct_uoms > 1) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg ='The items or lots in the inventory location: %1 do not have a common unit.{7891},' + @from_ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT TOP 1 @from_inv_uom_id = ii.uom_id
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @from_ent_id

			IF (@from_inv_uom_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg ='The items or lots in the inventory location: %1 do not have a common unit.{7891},' + @from_ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		--Get the indistinguishable lots property from the destination entity
		SELECT @indistinguishable_lots_to_ent = indistinguishable_lots
		FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id

		IF (@indistinguishable_lots_to_ent = 1) BEGIN
			SELECT @count_of_distinct_uoms = COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uom_id)
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @to_ent_id
			GROUP BY ii.uom_id), 0)

			IF (@count_of_distinct_uoms > 1) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg ='The items or lots in the inventory location: %1 do not have a common unit.{7891},' + @to_ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT TOP 1 @to_inv_uom_id = ii.uom_id
			FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ii.ent_id = @to_ent_id

			IF (@to_inv_uom_id IS NULL AND @count_of_distinct_uoms = 1) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg ='The items or lots in the inventory location: %1 do not have a common unit.{7891},' + @to_ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END

		--If the quantity is supplied with a specific unit (to_uom_id), then the supplied quantities must be converted from the supplied unit to the destination units in the inventory.
		--For example, Qty: 10, in_to_uom_id: Gallons
		--If the source inventory location is in litres and the destination inventory is in ounces, then the supplied quantity must be reduced in litres (conversion from gallons to litres) in the source inventory,
		--and added in ounces (conversion from gallons to ounces) in the destination inventory.
		--Verify whether the quantity is identified in certain units

		--The quantity is supplied in certain units.  Determine the source UOM
		SET @from_inv_uom_id = COALESCE(@from_inv_uom_id, @from_uom_id)

		IF (@in_to_uom_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Convert the supplied quantity from the supplied UOM to the UOM stored in the inventory.
			IF (@in_to_uom_id <> @from_inv_uom_id)
				EXEC dbo.sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams @factor_source output, @offset_source output, @in_to_uom_id, @from_inv_uom_id, @from_item_id

			--Determine the destination UOM
			--The quantities in the inventory must be represented in the following order of sequence:
			--(1) if there is an existing unit of measurement for the entity, then use that UOM (to_inv_uom_id), (2)if there is an existing unit of measurement for an inventory row, then use that,
			--(3) use the supplied unit of measurement
			SET @to_inv_uom_id = COALESCE(@to_inv_uom_id, @to_uom_id, @in_to_uom_id)

			--Convert the supplied quantity from the identified UOM to the destination units
			IF (@in_to_uom_id <> @to_inv_uom_id)
				EXEC dbo.sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams @factor_dest output, @offset_dest output, @in_to_uom_id, @to_inv_uom_id, @to_item_id

		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--The quantities are not supplied in specific units.  Therefore, determine the destination units.
			SELECT @to_inv_uom_id = COALESCE(@to_inv_uom_id, @to_uom_id)

			IF (@to_inv_uom_id IS NULL)
				SELECT @to_inv_uom_id = uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @to_item_id

			IF (@from_inv_uom_id <> @to_inv_uom_id)
				EXEC dbo.sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams @factor_dest output, @offset_dest output, @from_inv_uom_id, @to_inv_uom_id, @to_item_id
		END

		--Convert the quantity from the identified units to the source units to reduce inventory
		IF (@factor_source IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @reduce_qty = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@reduce_qty, COALESCE(@factor_source, 1), COALESCE(@offset_source, 0))
			SET @reduce_qty_erp = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@reduce_qty_erp, COALESCE(@factor_source, 1), COALESCE(@offset_source, 0))
		END

		--Calculate the quantities in terms of destination unit of measure.
		IF (@factor_dest IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @transfer_qty = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@transfer_qty, COALESCE(@factor_dest, 1), COALESCE(@offset_dest, 0))
			SET @transfer_qty_erp = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@transfer_qty_erp, COALESCE(@factor_dest, 1), COALESCE(@offset_dest, 0))
		END

/*		--check that the source uom is the same as the uom of the transfer quantity
		IF (@in_to_uom_id <> @from_inv_uom_id OR @from_inv_uom_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			--Adjust the @reduce_qty if the @in_to_uom_id <> @from_inv_uom_id
			--Adjust the requce quantity to the from_inv_uom_id units
			exec dbo.sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams @factor output, @offset output, @in_to_uom_id, @from_inv_uom_id, @from_item_id

			SET @reduce_qty = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@reduce_qty, @factor, @offset)
			SET @reduce_qty_erp = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@reduce_qty_erp, @factor, @offset)
		END

		IF (@to_uom_id IS NOT NULL)  SET @to_inv_uom_id = @to_uom_id
			--The request does not contain any unit of measurement specifying the destination unit of measurement.
			--Default to item's unit of measurement, incase if we need to convert the source qty into destination units.
		ELSE SELECT @to_inv_uom_id = uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @to_item_id

		--Check the unit of measurements that are same for the source inventory row (item) and destination item
		IF (@from_inv_uom_id <> @to_inv_uom_id OR @from_inv_uom_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			exec dbo.sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams @factor output, @offset output, @in_to_uom_id, @to_inv_uom_id, @to_item_id

			--Calculate the quantities in terms of destination unit of measure.
			SET @transfer_qty = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@transfer_qty, @factor, @offset)
			SET @transfer_qty_erp = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@transfer_qty_erp, @factor, @offset)
		END*/

		--Verify the maximum capacity of the destination entity. Get the total no. of qtys the destination qty can store.
		SELECT @max_capacity = ISNULL(max_capacity, 0) FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id

		--Calculate the current total quantity that is stored in this inventory location
		SELECT @cur_total_qty = ISNULL(SUM(qty_left), 0) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @to_ent_id

		--If the requested transfer qty + the existing qtys exceeds the maximum capacity for an entity, then throw an error.
		IF (@max_capacity <> 0) AND ((@cur_total_qty + @transfer_qty) > @max_capacity) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The requested quantities for this item: %1 cannot be transferred to the destination inventory location: %2, lot: %3 and sublot: %4, because transferring this quantity to a destination location will exceed the maximum storage capacity for that entity.{3205},' + @to_item_id + ',' + @to_ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@to_lot_no, 'NULL')+ ',' + ISNULL(@to_sublot_no, 'NULL')
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END

		--Get the auto_del_zero_inv property and allow_negative qty property for the source entity.
		--If the quantity in the source entity falls below zero, then automatically delete the inventory row for the source entity.
		SELECT @auto_del_zero_inv = auto_del_zero_inv, @allow_neg_qty = allow_neg_qty FROM storage_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id
		IF (@allow_neg_qty = 0) BEGIN
-- CR L00098047
			-- IF (@reduce_qty > @from_qty_left) BEGIN
			IF (ROUND(@reduce_qty, @num_decimals) > @from_qty_left) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The requested quantities for the item: %1, from the inventory location: %2, lot: %3, sublot: %4 cannot be transferred, because this entity does not allow transferring quantities more than what is available in the current inventory location. If you want to allow quantities to be transferred irrespective of what is available in this location, then pl change the entity''s setup to allow negative quantities.{3204},' + @from_item_id + ',' + @from_ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@from_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + ISNULL(@from_sublot_no, 'NULL')
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END -- transfer quantity is not null

	--Check if the destination row exists
	--If yes, then add the quantities to destination row and subtract the quantities from source row.
	IF (@to_row_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--The destination inventory row exist.
		--Verify whether the source inventory row and destination row are same, if yes, then it could probably be
		--the request to change the grade, status or expiry date.
		IF (@from_row_id = @to_row_id) BEGIN
			--The request is to change the grade, status or expiry_date.
			--Use the supplied grade_cd, status_cd and expiry_date, else default to whatever exists in the destination inventory row.
			SELECT	@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd)
				,	@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd)
				,	@to_expiry_date = COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_, @to_expiry_date)

			SELECT @to_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd
			IF (@to_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_grade_cd)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT @to_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @to_status_cd
			IF (@to_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_status_cd)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			UPDATE item_inv
			SET grade_cd = @to_grade_cd,
				status_cd = @to_status_cd,
				expiry_date = @to_expiry_date,
				wo_id = @to_wo_id,
				oper_id = @to_oper_id,
				seq_no = @to_seq_no,
				last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
			WHERE row_id = @to_row_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN--The source inventory row and destination inventory row are different.
			--The source inventory row and destination inventory row are different.
			--Check whether this request is to transfer quantities. If not, throw an error
			IF (@transfer_qty IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'A quantity to transfer must be supplied, because the source inventory location: %1 for this item%2, lot: %3, sublot: %4 is different than the destination location: %5, item: %6, lot: %7 and sublot: %8 in the inventory.{5012},'
					+ @from_ent_name + ',' + @from_item_id + ',' + ISNULL(@from_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + ISNULL(@from_sublot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @to_ent_name + ',' + @to_item_id + ',' + ISNULL(@to_lot_no, 'NULL')+ ',' + ISNULL(@to_sublot_no, 'NULL')
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			--Added by RG per Rich (via ERB ?) on 06/06/2006, If the reclassified or supplied grade, status, expiry date matches the destination row,
			--do not raise any exception; instead just retain the destination row and move the quantities
			IF (@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, -1)) AND (@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, -1))
			AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)-15000), 120)) OR (@to_expiry_date IS NULL AND COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_) IS NULL))
				SET @transfer_option = 2

			--Verify whether the grade, status and expiry date are same between source inventory row and destination inventory row.
			--If yes, change only the quantities
			IF (@from_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd) AND (@from_status_cd = @to_status_cd)
				AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @from_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120)) OR (@from_expiry_date IS NULL AND @to_expiry_date IS NULL))
				AND (@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd))
				AND (@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd))
				AND ((CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_, @to_expiry_date), 120)) OR (@to_expiry_date IS NULL AND COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_) IS NULL)) BEGIN

				--The grade, status and expiry dates are same between source inventory row and destination inventory row.
				--update the quantities
				--Add the quantities to the destination inventory row.
				UPDATE item_inv
				SET qty_left = qty_left + @transfer_qty,
					qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp + @transfer_qty_erp,
					date_in_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
					date_in_local = @transfer_time_local,
					wo_id = @to_wo_id,
					oper_id = @to_oper_id,
					seq_no = @to_seq_no,
					last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
				WHERE row_id = @to_row_id

				--Calculate the total quantity left in the destination row
				SET @cur_total_qty = @to_qty_left + @transfer_qty
				--Update the storage exec status for the destination entity.
				EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @to_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 1

				--Reduce the quantities from the source inventory row.
				UPDATE item_inv
				SET qty_left = qty_left - @reduce_qty,
					qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp - @reduce_qty_erp,
					date_out_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
					date_out_local = @transfer_time_local,
					last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
				WHERE row_id = @from_row_id

				--Calculate the total quantity left in the source row, ie., after reducing the current quantity
				SET @cur_total_qty = @from_qty_left - @reduce_qty
				--Update the storage exec status for the source entity.
				EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @from_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 0

				--If the source entity is configured to delete the inventory row as soon as it becomes zero,
				--then automatically delete the inventory row if the quantity reaches zero.
-- CR L00098047
				-- IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND ((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty) = 0)
				IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND (ROUND((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty), @num_decimals) = 0)
					EXEC sp_D_Item_Inv @from_row_id

			END	--There is a match on grade, status, expiry_date between source and destination inventory rows.
			ELSE BEGIN
				--Even if the request is only for quantity changes, check whether there is a request for grade, status or expiry date changes
				--If yes, then use the supplied grade_cd, status_cd and expiry_date, else default to whatever exists in the destination inventory row.

				--There is NO match on grade, status, expiry_date between source and destination inventory rows.
				IF (@transfer_option = 2) BEGIN
					SELECT	@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd)
						,	@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @to_status_cd)
						,	@to_expiry_date = COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_, @to_expiry_date)

					SELECT @to_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd
					IF (@to_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_grade_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @to_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @to_status_cd
					IF (@to_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_status_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					UPDATE item_inv
					SET qty_left = qty_left + @transfer_qty,
						qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp + @transfer_qty_erp,
						grade_cd = @to_grade_cd,
						status_cd = @to_status_cd,
						expiry_date = @to_expiry_date,
						date_in_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
						date_in_local = @transfer_time_local,
						wo_id = @to_wo_id,
						oper_id = @to_oper_id,
						seq_no = @to_seq_no,
						last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
					WHERE row_id = @to_row_id

					--Calculate the total quantity left in the destination row
					SET @cur_total_qty = @to_qty_left + @transfer_qty
					--Update the storage exec status for the destination entity.
					EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @to_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 1

					--Reduce the quantities from the source inventory row.
					UPDATE item_inv
					SET qty_left = qty_left - @reduce_qty,
						qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp - @reduce_qty_erp,
						date_out_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
						date_out_local = @transfer_time_local,
						last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
					WHERE row_id = @from_row_id

					--Calculate the total quantity left in the source row, ie., after reducing the current quantity
					SET @cur_total_qty = @from_qty_left - @reduce_qty
					--Update the storage exec status for the source entity.
					EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @from_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 0

					--If the source entity is configured to delete the inventory row as soon as it becomes zero,
					--then automatically delete the inventory row if the quantity reaches zero.
-- CR L00098047
					-- IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND ((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty) = 0)
					IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND (ROUND((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty), @num_decimals) = 0)
						EXEC sp_D_Item_Inv @from_row_id

				END -- Transfer option = 2
				ELSE IF (@transfer_option = 3) BEGIN
					--The grade, status and expiry dates does NOT match between source inventory row and destination inventory row.
					--Add the quantities to the destination inventory row,
					--and update the grade, status and expiry date from the source inventory row.
					UPDATE item_inv
					SET qty_left = qty_left + @transfer_qty,
						qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp + @transfer_qty_erp,
						grade_cd = @from_grade_cd,
						status_cd = @from_status_cd,
						expiry_date = @from_expiry_date,
						date_in_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
						date_in_local = @transfer_time_local,
						wo_id = @to_wo_id,
						oper_id = @to_oper_id,
						seq_no = @to_seq_no,
						last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
					WHERE row_id = @to_row_id

					--Calculate the total quantity left in the destination row
					SET @cur_total_qty = @to_qty_left + @transfer_qty
					--Update the storage exec status for the destination entity.
					EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @to_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 1

					--Reduce the quantities from the source inventory row.
					UPDATE item_inv
					SET qty_left = qty_left - @reduce_qty,
						qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp - @reduce_qty_erp,
						date_out_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
						date_out_local = @transfer_time_local,
						last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
					WHERE row_id = @from_row_id

					--Calculate the total quantity left in the source row, ie., after reducing the current quantity
					SET @cur_total_qty = @from_qty_left - @reduce_qty
					--Update the storage exec status for the source entity.
					EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @from_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 0

					--If the source entity is configured to delete the inventory row as soon as it becomes zero,
					--then automatically delete the inventory row if the quantity reaches zero.
-- CR L00098047
					-- IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND ((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty) = 0)
					IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND (ROUND((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty), @num_decimals) = 0)
						EXEC sp_D_Item_Inv @from_row_id

				END	--Transfer option = 3
				ELSE BEGIN	--Invalid transfer option
--					RAISERROR('Invalid Transfer Option{3208}', 16, 1, @@error)
					SELECT @from_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @from_grade_cd
					IF (@from_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_grade_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @from_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @from_status_cd
					IF (@from_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_status_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @to_grade_desc = item_grade_desc FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd
					IF (@to_grade_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for grade_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_grade_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SELECT @to_status_desc = item_status_desc FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @to_status_cd
					IF (@to_status_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
						SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'row for status_cd=' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_status_cd)
						RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END

					SET @err_msg = 'You must specify whether you want to retain the grade, status and expiry date in the destination or you want to infer the grade, status and expiry date from the source inventory location, because the item: %1 in the destination inventory location: %2, lot: %3, sublot: %4 has a grade: %5, status: %6 and expiry date: %7 is different than the item: %8 stored in the source inventory location: %9, lot: %10, sublot: %11 which has grade: %12, status: %13 and expiry date: %14 in it.{3208},'
						+ @to_item_id + ',' + @to_ent_name + ',' +  ISNULL(@to_lot_no, 'NULL') +  ISNULL(@to_sublot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @to_grade_desc + ',' + @to_status_desc + ',' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @to_expiry_date, 120), 'NULL')
						+ ',' + @from_item_id + ',' + @from_ent_name + ',' + ISNULL(@from_lot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + ISNULL(@from_sublot_no, 'NULL') + ',' + @from_grade_desc + ',' + @from_status_desc + ',' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @from_expiry_date, 120), 'NULL')
					RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1, @@error)
					RETURN
				END

			END --There is NO match on grade, status, expiry_date between source and destination inventory rows.
		END --The source inventory row and destination inventory row are different.
	END --The destination inventory row exist.
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The destination inventory row DOES NOT exist.
		--If the grade, status and expiry date is not supplied, default these to the source row's grade, status and expiry date
		SELECT	@to_grade_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_grade_cd, @from_grade_cd)
			,	@to_status_cd = ISNULL(@in_to_status_cd, @from_status_cd)
			,	@to_expiry_date = COALESCE(@in_to_expiry_date_utc, @in_to_expiry_date_, @from_expiry_date)
			,	@to_wo_id = COALESCE(@to_wo_id, @from_wo_id)
			,	@to_oper_id = COALESCE(@to_oper_id, @from_oper_id)
			,	@to_seq_no = COALESCE(@to_seq_no, @from_seq_no)

		-- Find grade and status codes from inventory if the input values are NULL.
		EXEC sp_S_Item_Inv_GetGradeAndStatus @to_item_id, @to_lot_no, @to_sublot_no, @to_grade_cd OUTPUT, @to_status_cd OUTPUT

		--Verify whether the supplied grade_cd is a valid grade_cd to prevent foreign key violation.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @to_grade_cd) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'item grade:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_grade_cd)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether the supplied status_cd is a valid status_cd to prevent foreign key violation.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_cd = @to_status_cd) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'item state:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_status_cd)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether the supplied uom_id is a valid uom_id to prevent foreign key violation.
		IF (@to_uom_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @to_uom_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'uom:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @to_uom_id)
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Verify whether this lot and sublot exist; if not create a new lot or sublot.
		EXEC sp_I_Item_Inv_AddLotSubLot @item_id=@to_item_id,
			@lot_no=@to_lot_no, @sublot_no=@to_sublot_no, @grade_cd=@to_grade_cd, @status_cd=@to_status_cd

		--Add a new inventory row.
		--Unless otherwise the to_uom_id is explicitly specified, OR
		--if the unit of measurement is used in the source inventory row, do not write  into item_inv table.
       /* CR 118945: Insert @to_inv_uom_id into the item_inv table for uom_id */

		INSERT INTO item_inv
		(
			ent_id, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd, qty_left, qty_left_erp,
			uom_id, date_in_utc, date_in_local, date_out_utc, date_out_local, expiry_date,
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no,spare1,spare2,spare3,spare4,spare5,spare6, last_edit_at,last_edit_comment
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@to_ent_id, @to_item_id, @to_lot_no, @to_sublot_no, @to_grade_cd, @to_status_cd, @transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp,
			@to_inv_uom_id, @transfer_time_utc, @transfer_time_local, NULL, NULL, @to_expiry_date, @to_wo_id, @to_oper_id, @to_seq_no,
			@from_spare1, @from_spare2, @from_spare3, @from_spare4,@from_spare5, @from_spare6,@last_edit_at,@transfer_comments
        )



		--Get the destination's row_id
		SET @to_row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		--Calculate the total quantity left in the destination row
		SET @cur_total_qty = @transfer_qty
		--Update the storage exec status for the destination entity.
		EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @to_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 1

		--Reduce the quantities from the source inventory row.
		UPDATE item_inv
		SET qty_left = qty_left - @reduce_qty,
			qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp - @reduce_qty_erp,
			date_out_utc = @transfer_time_utc,
			date_out_local = @transfer_time_local,
			last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
		WHERE row_id = @from_row_id

		--Calculate the total quantity left in the source row, ie., after reducing the current quantity
		SET @cur_total_qty = @from_qty_left - @reduce_qty
		--Update the storage exec status for the source entity.
		EXEC sp_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @from_ent_id, @cur_total_qty, 0

		--If the source entity is configured to delete the inventory row as soon as it becomes zero,
		--then automatically delete the inventory row if the quantity reaches zero.
-- CR L00098047
		-- IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND ((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty) = 0)
		IF (@auto_del_zero_inv = 1) AND (ROUND((@from_qty_left - @reduce_qty), @num_decimals) = 0)
			EXEC sp_D_Item_Inv @from_row_id

		--If this is a new lot, then set the transaction type to split_lot else set the transaction_type to combine lot
		IF (1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lot_no = @to_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @to_lot_no IS NULL)))
			SET @transaction_type = 1
		ELSE SET @transaction_type = 2

	END  --The destination inventory row DOES NOT exist.

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	--log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transaction. Do not log inventory transfers if this is from production or consumption.
	IF (@log_transfer = 1) BEGIN
		--Get Log_Inventory Transfers system_attr
		SELECT @log_trans = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 198
		--if update or insert was successful then, check if the log_trans is 'true', if yes then insert a new row in item_transfer table
		IF (@log_trans = 1) AND (@transfer_qty IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			INSERT INTO item_transfer
			(
				wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, to_ent_id, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd,
				qty_txd, uom_id, expiry_date, to_spare1, to_spare2, to_spare3, to_spare4, to_spare5, to_spare6,
				from_wo_id, from_oper_id, from_seq_no, from_ent_id, from_item_id, from_lot_no, from_sublot_no, from_grade_cd,
				from_status_cd, from_qty_txd, from_uom_id, from_expiry_date, from_spare1, from_spare2, from_spare3, from_spare4,
				from_spare5, from_spare6, qty_txd_erp, goods_received, goods_shipped, transfer_list_row_id,
				comments, transfer_by, transfer_time_utc, transfer_time_local
			)
			VALUES
			(
				@from_wo_id, @from_oper_id, @from_seq_no, NULL, @to_ent_id, @to_item_id, @to_lot_no, @to_sublot_no,
				@to_grade_cd, @to_status_cd, @transfer_qty, @to_inv_uom_id, @to_expiry_date, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
				@from_wo_id, @from_oper_id, @from_seq_no, @from_ent_id, @from_item_id, @from_lot_no, @from_sublot_no, @from_grade_cd,
				@from_status_cd, @reduce_qty, @from_inv_uom_id, @from_expiry_date,@from_spare1, @from_spare2, @from_spare3, @from_spare4,
				@from_spare5, @from_spare6, @transfer_qty_erp, 0, 0, NULL, @transfer_comments, @user_id, @transfer_time_utc, @transfer_time_local
			)
			--return error if insertion fails
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR('SQL Error inserting into item_transfer table: %d{3210}', 16, 1, @@error)
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END

	-- Create an item_cons record
	IF (@from_lot_no IS NULL AND @to_lot_no IS NULL) OR (@from_lot_no = @to_lot_no) BEGIN
		--IF from_lot_no and to_lot_no are same, then there are no changes in the lot_no -- do nothing
		--else if from_lot_no = to_lot_no, then both lots are same -- do nothing
		--PRINT 'DO NOT WRITE TO ITEM_CONS'
		declare @y as bit
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT	@cur_shift_id = cur_shift_id
			,	@cur_shift_start_time_utc = cur_shift_start_time_utc
			,	@cur_shift_start_time_local = cur_shift_start_time_local
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id = @from_ent_id

		SELECT @cur_reas_cd = MIN(reas_cd) FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @from_grade_cd AND item_status_cd = @from_status_cd

		IF (@cur_reas_cd IS NULL) SELECT @cur_reas_cd = MIN(reas_cd) FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @from_grade_cd
		IF (@cur_reas_cd IS NULL) SELECT @cur_reas_cd = MIN(reas_cd) FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK)

		SELECT @scrapped = scrapped FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = (SELECT item_grade_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd)
		--SELECT @cur_grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = item_status_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @cur_reas_cd

		INSERT INTO item_cons
		(
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_lot_no, reas_cd, user_id,
			item_scrapped, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp,  ext_ref, transaction_type,
			spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@from_wo_id, @from_oper_id, @from_seq_no, @cur_shift_start_time_utc, @cur_shift_start_time_local, @to_item_id,
			@from_lot_no, @from_sublot_no, @to_lot_no, @cur_reas_cd, @user_id, @scrapped, NULL, @cur_shift_id, @from_grade_cd,
			@from_status_cd, @from_ent_id, @reduce_qty, 0, NULL, @transaction_type, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @user_id, @last_edit_at,
			dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(@last_edit_at), dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL))
		)

		--return error if insertion fails
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR('SQL Error inserting into item_transfer table: %d{3210}', 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_Resource_Group]
(
@res_grp_id int,
@res_grp_desc nvarchar(50),
@loc_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.res_grp where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
		if @rowCount > 0 
		begin
			update sdb.SCH.res_grp set res_grp_desc = @res_grp_desc ,loc_id = @loc_id where res_grp_id = @res_grp_id
			set @message = CONCAT('Successfully updated Resource Group with ID: ' , @res_grp_id)
		end
		else
		begin
			set @message = CONCAT('Invalid or missing Resource Group ID: ' , @res_grp_id)
		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to update Resource Group: ' , @res_grp_desc)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
END

-- =============================================
-- Name:    [SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty] 
-- Description:  Determine the type of consumption qty based on the actual qty and requested qty
--
-- Usage:  MDMAddConsumptionWF
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  YG            2023-01-24      Initial version.
-- 0.01.10  YG            2024-02-07      Add script body comment update header 
-- =============================================
-- EXEC [SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty] '100000041475', 500004, 50000, 0.001
-- =============================================
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty_backup_04_08_25] 
		@item_id nvarchar(40),
		@to_ent_id int,
		@qty_cons float,
		@conv_factor float
AS
BEGIN
	-- Init
	DECLARE @qty_left FLOAT,
			@qty_to_consume FLOAT,
			@storage_ent_id int

	-- Get the entity id from the automation silo id
	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@to_ent_id AS NVARCHAR)

	-- Get the qty left from the silo inventory
	SELECT @qty_left = ISNULL(SUM(qty_left),0.00) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id 
		AND item_id = @item_id
		AND status_cd = (SELECT item_status_cd FROM item_state WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted')

	-- Convert the qty into destination uom
	SET @qty_to_consume = ROUND(@qty_cons * @conv_factor,4)
	PRINT @qty_to_consume
	PRINT @qty_left

	-- Defining type of consumption
	IF (@qty_left < @qty_to_consume AND @qty_left > 0.00)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 1 Type,@qty_left qty_to_consume; -- Consumption with qty which currently available in the inventory
	END
	ELSE IF (@qty_left >= @qty_to_consume)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0 Type,@qty_to_consume qty_to_consume;  -- Consumption with requested qty
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT -1 Type -- No inventory in the silo
	END

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Lot_Attr_Default]
(@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @seq_no  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @attr_id  int  ,

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_Ent_byJobState]
-- Description:	Get all the jobs which can have job state 3,4,& 5 and based on Entity
--
-- Usage:	This will be used in the Waste Management
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2022-07-19		Intial Version
-- 0.02.00	 MP				  2023-02-14        Changed date time filter and added qty_reqd>0 and j.qty_prod>0
-- 0.02.01	Veervar			  2024-01-31		Logic comments added.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Ent_byJobState] 

@ent_id as int,
@qty	as int,
@date_in as datetime


AS
BEGIN
declare 

@date_conv as datetime,
@total as int

SELECT @date_conv= DATEADD(day, 1, @date_in)
SET NOCOUNT ON;

--GET JOB TOTAL QTY REQUIRED FOR ENTITY WHERE JOB STATE IN (3,4,5)
select 
  @total = sum(qty_reqd) 
from job j WITH (nolock) 
  inner join wo w WITH (nolock) on j.wo_id = w.wo_id 
where 
  j.state_cd in (3, 4, 5) 
  and j.run_ent_id = @ent_id 
  and w.state_cd in (1, 2) 
  and j.act_start_time_local between @date_in and @date_conv
  and j.qty_reqd>0
  and j.qty_prod>0

--SELECT FINAL DATASET WITH LOT AND WO DETAILS
select 
j.wo_id,
j.item_id,
j.state_cd,
j.oper_id, 
j.seq_no,
j.qty_reqd,
j.run_ent_id,
(select top 1 lot_no from item_prod WITH (nolock) where wo_id=j.wo_id order by row_id desc ) as def_lot_no,
(select top 1 shift_start_local from item_prod WITH (nolock) where wo_id=j.wo_id order by row_id desc ) as shift_start_local,
(select top 1 hour_start_local from item_prod WITH (nolock) where wo_id=j.wo_id order by row_id desc ) as hour_start_local,
(select top 1 created_at_utc from item_prod WITH (nolock) where wo_id=j.wo_id order by row_id desc ) as created_at_utc,
Round ((j.qty_reqd*@qty)/@total,0) as Split_qty
from job j WITH (nolock)
			inner join wo w WITH (nolock) on j.wo_id = w.wo_id 
			where j.state_cd in (3,4,5) 
				and j.run_ent_id = @ent_id 
				and w.state_cd in (1,2) 
				and j.act_start_time_local between @date_in and @date_conv
				and j.qty_reqd>0
				and j.qty_prod>0

END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	--Verify whether any utilization reason has a reference to this utilization state; If any, raise an exception to the caller.
