CREATE  Trigger [tg_item_reas_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[item_reas]
AFTER DELETE
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_item_reas_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on item_reas table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 2104). Update System_Attribute for the Default Production Reason to NULL OR "" string
--			   if the same item_reas is deleted from item_reas table
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/30/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @reas_cd		INT
	,@attr_value		INT
BEGIN
	DECLARE item_reas_cursor CURSOR STATIC for
		SELECT reas_cd FROM deleted
	OPEN item_reas_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM item_reas_cursor INTO @reas_cd
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 215
		IF (@attr_value = @reas_cd)  UPDATE system_attr SET attr_value = '' WHERE attr_id = 215
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 216
		IF (@attr_value = @reas_cd)  UPDATE system_attr SET attr_value = '' WHERE attr_id = 216
	END
	CLOSE item_reas_cursor
	DEALLOCATE item_reas_cursor
END

-- *******************************************************************************************************************************************************************
-- Name				: sp_I_ofi_EI_generatesampleplan
-- Description		: To create sample plan, and link with sample frequency.
--
-- Author			: Unnikrishnan Nair P G (GDC)
-- Creation date	: 2024-02-12
--
-- Usage			: Using IN LIMS interface EI location MES_LIMS_SamplePlan_IN
--	EXEC sp_I_ofi_EI_generatesampleplan 'GNLNL0043',  '10022554', '1011325', 'Full', 'PhysChem', 'TIME_12_H', 'Color Test', 'Color', 'Lovibond' ; 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour				Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change Description
-- 00.01			PG					2024-02-12				Initial draft
-- 00.02			PG					2024-04-12				Added logic to check whether the same plan is exist or not.  if yes, disable and create as new. 
-- 00.03			PG					2024-04-15				The disable sample plan logic should be called from the main SP sp_I_ofi_EI_sampleplan & sp_I_ofi_EI_sampleplan_timeAndlocation
-- 00.04			AML, XPM			2026-06-25				Fixed plan limit (4 digits), auto-reset (9999) 
-- 00.05			AML, XPM			2026-06-30				Avoid overflow and reuse empty slots
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *******************************************************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_EI_generatesampleplan] (
	@SamplePlanID NVARCHAR(100) -- V00.04
	,@samplePlanType INT -- 0. LabVantage Product Variant (material and process based sample plan) --1. LabVantage Sample Point Schedule Plans (time and location based sample plan)
	,@ProductID NVARCHAR(40)
	,@Customer NVARCHAR(40)
	,@Level NVARCHAR(20)
	,@Stage NVARCHAR(20)
	,@SourceLabel NVARCHAR(80)
	,@TestMethod NVARCHAR(40)
	,@ParameterListID NVARCHAR(40)
	,@Variant NVARCHAR(40)
	,@LocationLabel NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@LocationPath NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@mes_plan_id INT OUTPUT
	,@Count INT = 1
	)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
	DECLARE @freq_id INT = NULL;
	DECLARE @time_zone_bias_value INT = NULL;
	DECLARE @plan_id INT = NULL;
	DECLARE @plan_name NVARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @plan_desc NVARCHAR(80) = @SamplePlanID + '|' + @Level + '|' + @Stage + '|' + @SourceLabel + '|' + ISNULL(@Customer, '');
	DECLARE @category_id INT;
	DECLARE @verified_write BIT = 0;
	DECLARE @sample_name NVARCHAR(254) = '[SamplePlanName][YYYY][MM][DD][####]';
	DECLARE @reset_option int32 = 1;	--Numbering reset option in MES Client.  value 0: = never; 1 = change in local date
	DECLARE @spare1 STRING80_NULL = @SamplePlanID;
	DECLARE @spare2 STRING80_NULL = @Level + '|' + @Stage;-- combination of level and stage
	--DECLARE @spare3 STRING80_NULL = ISNULL(@Customer, '') + '|' + @SourceLabel;-- combination of customer and frequency
	DECLARE @spare3 STRING80_NULL = ISNULL(@Customer, '') + '|' + @SourceLabel + '|' + ISNULL(@ProductID, '') ;-- combination of customer, frequency and product
	DECLARE @spare4 STRING80_NULL = @ProductID + '|' + ISNULL(@Customer, '') + '|' + @Variant + '|' + @TestMethod + '|' + @ParameterListID;-- combination of product id, customer, variant, test method and parameterlistid
	DECLARE @last_edit_comment STRING254_NULL = 'inserted through script';
	DECLARE @last_edit_at TDATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @next_seq_no INT = 0;
	DECLARE @new_plan_name NVARCHAR(40) = @SamplePlanID;
	DECLARE @productId_from_spare4 nvarchar(40) = '';
	DECLARE @counter INT = 0; -- V00.05
 
 
	---- check whether the given sample plan is already exist or not; if yes, just disable its qm ti avoid further trigger
	--EXEC sp_U_ofi_EI_disablesampleplan @SamplePlanID = @SamplePlanID ;		-- v00.02	-- commented in v00.03
 
	SET @SamplePlanID = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SamplePlanID));
	SET @SourceLabel = LTRIM(RTRIM(@SourceLabel));
 
	-- check how many records are there for the given sample plan id, if exist create plan name as given name + next available sequence number.  Ex: GNLNL0043_01
	SELECT @next_seq_no = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(RTRIM(plan_name), 4) AS INT)), 0)
	FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE spare1 = @SamplePlanID AND RIGHT(RTRIM(plan_name), 4) NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'; -- V00.05
 
	SET @next_seq_no = @next_seq_no + 1;

	-- V00.04
	IF @next_seq_no > 9999
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'WARNING: The limit of 9999 for ' + @SamplePlanID + ' has been reached. Free slots will be searched.';
		SET @next_seq_no = 1;
	END

	SET @new_plan_name = LEFT(@SamplePlanID, 35) + '_' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, dbo.fn_PadNumber(@next_seq_no, 4, '0')); -- V00.04

	-- V00.05
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE plan_name = @new_plan_name)
	BEGIN
		SET @next_seq_no = @next_seq_no + 1;
		IF @next_seq_no > 9999 
		BEGIN
			SET @next_seq_no = 1;
		END
		SET @new_plan_name = LEFT(@SamplePlanID, 35) + '_' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, dbo.fn_PadNumber(@next_seq_no, 4, '0'));
		SET @counter = @counter + 1;
		IF @counter > 10000
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('ERROR: Max limit of 9999 plans reached for this SamplePlanID.', 16, 1);
			RETURN;
		END
	END

 
	-- 01. create sample plan using the std SP: sp_I_Sample_Plan
	-- 02. link sample plan and frequency using the std SP: sp_I_Sample_Plan_Freq_Link
	-- 
	-- For each unique combination of LIMS Sample Plan Id, Level, Stage, Customer and frequency distinct sample plan will be created in MES. Ex: GNLNL0044|Full|PhysicalChemistry|TIME_8_H|1011325
	-- Source Label field from LIMS sample plan will define frequency for MES sample plan.
	-- check whether sample plan exist for the combination of LIMS Sample Plan Id, Level, Stage, frequency and Customer
	-- if sample type is location and time based, check whether the same plan exist or not
	IF (@samplePlanType = 0)
	BEGIN
		--SELECT @productId_from_spare4 = [1] FROM ufn_ofi_SplitStringAsTableColumns((SELECT TOP 1 spare4 FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spare1 = @SamplePlanID AND spare2 = @spare2 AND  spare3 = @spare3), '|') ;		
		SET @spare2 = @spare2 + '|' + CONVERT(nvarchar, @Count) ;
 
		IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN qm_spec q WITH (NOLOCK) ON sp.plan_id = q.plan_id	-- v00.03
				WHERE sp.spare1 = @SamplePlanID
					AND sp.spare2 = @spare2
					AND sp.spare3 = @spare3	
					AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL	-- v00.03				
				)
		BEGIN
			-- create sample plan using the std SP: sp_I_Sample_Plan
			EXEC sp_I_Sample_Plan @plan_id = @plan_id OUTPUT
				,@plan_name = @new_plan_name
				,@plan_desc = @plan_desc
				,@category_id = NULL
				,@verified_write = @verified_write
				,@sample_name = @sample_name
				,@reset_option = @reset_option
				,@spare1 = @spare1
				,@spare2 = @spare2
				,@spare3 = @spare3
				,@spare4 = @spare4
				,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
				,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT;

			SET @mes_plan_id = @plan_id;-- v00.03 
		END;
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @mes_plan_id = sp.plan_id
			FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec q WITH (NOLOCK) ON sp.plan_id = q.plan_id	-- v00.03
			WHERE sp.spare1 = @SamplePlanID
				AND sp.spare2 = @spare2
				AND sp.spare3 = @spare3	
				AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL ; 
		END ;
		-- v00.03 BE

	END;
	ELSE
	BEGIN --	@samplePlanType = 1
		SET @plan_desc = @SamplePlanID + CASE WHEN @LocationLabel IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '|' + @LocationLabel END ;
		SELECT @spare3 = ISNULL(@Customer, '') + '|' + @SourceLabel + '|' + ISNULL(@LocationLabel, '')  
 
		IF NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN qm_spec q WITH (NOLOCK) ON sp.plan_id = q.plan_id	-- v00.03
				--WHERE plan_name = @SamplePlanID
				WHERE sp.spare1 = @SamplePlanID
					AND sp.spare3 = @spare3
					AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL	-- v00.03
				)
		BEGIN
			-- create sample plan using the std SP: sp_I_Sample_Plan
			EXEC sp_I_Sample_Plan @plan_id = @plan_id OUTPUT
				,@plan_name = @new_plan_name	--@SamplePlanID
				,@plan_desc = @plan_desc
				,@category_id = NULL
				,@verified_write = @verified_write
				,@sample_name = @sample_name
				,@reset_option = @reset_option
				,@spare1 = @spare1
				,@spare2 = @spare2
				,@spare3 = @spare3
				,@spare4 = @spare4
				,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
				,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT;

			SET @mes_plan_id = @plan_id;-- v00.03 
		END;
		-- v00.03 BS
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @mes_plan_id = sp.plan_id
			FROM sample_plan sp WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec q WITH (NOLOCK) ON sp.plan_id = q.plan_id
			WHERE sp.spare1 = @SamplePlanID
				AND sp.spare3 = @spare3
				AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL
			-- v00.03 BE
		END

	END;
 
	--SET @mes_plan_id = @plan_id;
 
	-- link sample plan and frequency using the std SP: sp_I_Sample_Plan_Freq_Link
	SELECT @freq_id = freq_id
	FROM sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE freq_name = @SourceLabel;
 
	IF (
			@freq_id IS NOT NULL
			AND @plan_id IS NOT NULL
			AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM sample_plan_freq_link WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE plan_id = @plan_id
					AND freq_id = @freq_id
				)
			)
	BEGIN
		EXEC sp_I_Sample_Plan_Freq_Link @plan_id = @plan_id
			,@freq_id = @freq_id
			,@last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
			,@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value
			,@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OUTPUT;
	END;
 
	IF (@samplePlanType = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @mes_plan_id = plan_id
		FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE spare1 = @SamplePlanID
			AND spare2 = @spare2
			AND spare3 = @spare3;
	END;
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @mes_plan_id = plan_id
		FROM sample_plan WITH (NOLOCK)
		--WHERE plan_name = @SamplePlanID;
		WHERE spare1 = @SamplePlanID
			AND spare3 = @spare3 ;
	END;
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc]
(
	@site_ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,	@in_utc	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)  RETURNS INT32
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc
-- Description          - Returns an offset based on the passed UTC (or current UTC if NULL). The offset can be Entity Local
--                        if a site ent_id is supplied. Else it will be Client Local
-- Author               - DonT
-- Date Created         - 1/22/2010
-- Version              - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @region_id nvarchar(80)
	DECLARE @current_utc datetime
	DECLARE	@context_info int32
	DECLARE @tz_offset INT32

	SET @current_utc = @in_utc
	IF ( @current_utc IS NULL )
		SET @current_utc = GetUtcDate()

	IF ( @site_ent_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		select @region_id = s.region_id from ent WITH (NOLOCK)
				left outer join site s WITH (NOLOCK) on s.ent_id = ent.site
				where ent.ent_id = @site_ent_id
	END

	-- If we still need region_id, get it from sessn table
	IF ( @region_id IS NULL ) BEGIN
		-- Get session_id from connection context
		SELECT @context_info = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spid =  @@spid
		--Retrieve the current region from the session context.
		SELECT @region_id = region_id FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @context_info
	END

	-- use current UTC to lookup our offset
	select @tz_offset = max(offset) from tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
		where (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id is NULL AND default_region = 1))
		AND (start_utc <= @current_utc AND end_utc >= @current_utc)

	-- in case we are unable to get client local offset - goto server as last resort
	IF (@tz_offset IS NULL) BEGIN
        RETURN dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromServer()
    END

    RETURN @tz_offset
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_History_GetByRange]
(@ent_id  int  ,
 @start_range_local  datetime  ,
 @shift_range_tz	INT32 = NULL,
 @end_range_local  datetime,
 @end_range_tz  INT32 = null
)   AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_ShiftHistory_GetByRange
-- Description	      - This procedure gets the shifts that fall between the specified dates.
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	7/22/2011
-- Version	      - 4.0.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
--  03/04/2020    Srinivas       6.2     US#1285054(Fixed unambiguous stored procedure code in where clause)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE @start_range_utc	DATETIME
	,	@end_range_utc	DATETIME
	,	@tz_temp		INT

SET @tz_temp = -@shift_range_tz
EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @start_range_local, @tz_temp, @start_range_utc OUTPUT

SET @tz_temp = -@end_range_tz
EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @end_range_local, @tz_temp, @end_range_utc OUTPUT

SELECT	 shift_history.ent_id
		,ent_name
		,shift_id
		,shift_start_local
		,shift_start_utc
		,shift_end_local
		,shift_end_utc
    FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = shift_history.ent_id
    WHERE ((shift_history.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		  ((shift_start_utc >= @start_range_utc AND shift_start_utc < @end_range_utc) OR
		   (shift_end_utc > @start_range_utc AND shift_end_utc <= @end_range_utc) OR
		   (shift_start_utc < @start_range_utc AND (shift_end_utc >= @end_range_utc OR shift_end_utc IS NULL))))
  ORDER BY shift_history.ent_id, shift_history.shift_start_local

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GETQualityLoss]
	@ent_id AS INT
AS
/*-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_GETQualityLoss
-- Description:	    Get the Quality percentage
--
-- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-01						Find the Quality percentage
-- 0.01.01			DS				2024-02-09						Updated header comments & nolock
   0.01.02			CK				2024-03-21						Handled utilization =0
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************/
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @day AS                 INT
		  , @wdays AS               NVARCHAR(20)
		  , @shift_day AS           INT
		  , @shift_id AS            INT
		  , @shift_start_time AS    DATETIME
		  , @shift_end_time AS      DATETIME
		  , @diff_shift_mins AS     INT
		  , @utlization AS          INT
		  , @utlization_loss AS     INT
		  , @util_mins AS           DECIMAL
		  , @avil_runtime AS        INTEGER
		  , @avil_downtime AS       INTEGER
		  , @avil_percent AS        INTEGER
		  , @parent_ent_id AS       INTEGER
		  , @expected_prod AS       DECIMAL
		  , @actual_prod AS         DECIMAL
		  , @performance_percent AS INTEGER
		  , @capacity AS            INTEGER
		  , @perm_loss AS           INT
		  , @good_prod AS           FLOAT
		  , @total_prod  AS           FLOAT
		  , @bad_prod AS            FLOAT
		  , @qul_percent AS         INT
		  , @qul_loss AS            DECIMAL
		  , @qual_ldata AS          INT
		  , @planned_prod AS       DECIMAL
		  , @defaultUOM AS		 NVARCHAR(20)

		  

		   select @defaultUOM = attr_value from ent_attr ea with(nolock) 
		  inner join attr with(nolock) on attr.attr_id =  ea.attr_id and ea.ent_id = @ent_id
		  and attr.attr_desc = 'PRODUOM'

		  IF @defaultUOM IS NULL 
		  BEGIN
			SELECT  @defaultUOM=description from uom where   abbreviation ='KG'
		  END

	--get the running day of the week from the above
	SET @wdays = Datename(weekday, GETDATE())

	IF @wdays = 'Monday'
	BEGIN
		SET @day = 0
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @wdays = 'Tuesday'
		BEGIN
			SET @day = 1
		END
			ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @wdays = 'Wednesday'
			BEGIN
				SET @day = 2
			END
				ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @wdays = 'Thursday'
				BEGIN
					SET @day = 3
				END
					ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @wdays = 'Friday'
					BEGIN
						SET @day = 4
					END
						ELSE
					BEGIN
						IF @wdays = 'Saturday'
						BEGIN
							SET @day = 5
						END
							ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF @wdays = 'Sunday'
							BEGIN
								SET @day = 6
							END
						END
					END
				END
			END
		END
	END

	-- Get the Current shift_id from the below query
	--select @shift_id=shift_id from shift_history with (nolock) where shift_end_utc is null and ent_id = 
	SELECT
		@shift_id = shift_id
	  , @parent_ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
	FROM shift_history sh WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = sh.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	WHERE
		sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL
		AND e.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND attr_value = 'Segment'

	-- Get the last run shift_start time and shift_end time from the shift_history table
	SELECT TOP 1
		@shift_start_time = shift_start_utc
	  , @shift_end_time = shift_end_utc
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL
		--AND shift_end_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC

	-- Calculate the timing difference between the start and end time
	--SET @diff_shift_mins = DATEDIFF(minute, @shift_start_time, GETUTCDATE())
	SELECT TOP 1
	 @diff_shift_mins=DATEDIFF(minute, shift_start_utc,shift_end_utc)
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_end_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC
	--using the below query to find the running shift end time
	SET @shift_end_time = DATEADD(minute, @diff_shift_mins, @shift_start_time)

	DECLARE @duration_down    FLOAT
		  , @duration_running FLOAT
	EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
		 @ent_id = @ent_id
	   , @runtime = 0
	   , @wocheck = 1
	   , @durationSecout = @duration_down OUT
	EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
		 @ent_id = @ent_id
	   , @runtime = 1
	   , @wocheck = 1
	   , @durationSecout = @duration_running OUT
	DECLARE @availPer FLOAT
		  , @utilPer  FLOAT

	DECLARE @totaltime FLOAT
	SET @totaltime = @duration_down + @duration_running

	IF @totaltime > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @availPer = (((@totaltime - @duration_down) / @totaltime)) * 100
		SET @util_mins = (@totaltime - @duration_down) / 60
	END

	IF @util_mins > @diff_shift_mins
	BEGIN
		SET @utlization = 100
		SET @utlization_loss = 0
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @util_mins < @diff_shift_mins
		BEGIN
			SET @utlization = CAST((@util_mins / @diff_shift_mins) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
			SET @utlization_loss = 100 - @utlization
		END
	END

	--below query used to find the avilable runtime and downtime from the total utilization time
	SELECT
		@avil_runtime = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= @shift_end_time
		AND runtime = 1

	SELECT
		@avil_downtime = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= @shift_end_time
		AND runtime = 0

	if(@util_mins =0)
		BEGIN
		SET @avil_percent =0;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SET @avil_percent = CAST((@avil_runtime / @util_mins) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
		END


	SELECT
		@actual_prod = SUM(ip.qty_prod)
	  , @capacity = j.batch_size
	FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j ON j.wo_id = ip.wo_id
				  AND ip.oper_id=j.oper_id
	                AND j.seq_no=ip.seq_no
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		AND j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
	GROUP BY
		j.batch_size

	--Get from the ofi_Table below capcity
	--SELECT
	--	@capacity = nameplate_speed
	--FROM ofi_nameplate_speed WITH(NOLOCK)
	--WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	----SET @capacity = 33
	SET @avil_runtime = @util_mins;
	--SET @expected_prod = @avil_runtime * @capacity
	WITH CTE as (
	select 
		SUM(CASE WHEN job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,jh.job_start_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE()))
		ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE())) 
		END *(os.nameplate_speed /3600)) as exp_qty
		,SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,j.sched_start_time_utc,sched_finish_time_utc) IS NULL
		THEN 0
		ELSE 
		CASE WHEN job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,jh.job_start_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE()))
		ELSE DATEDIFF(SECOND,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, ISNULL(jh.job_end_utc,GETUTCDATE())) 
		END
		*j.qty_reqd/DATEDIFF(SECOND,j.sched_start_time_utc,sched_finish_time_utc)
		END)	as planned_qty		
		from ent e  WITH(NOLOCK)
		left join job_history jh WITH(NOLOCK) on e.ent_id=jh.ent_id and (jh.job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc or jh.job_end_utc is null or jh.job_end_utc between e.cur_shift_start_time_utc and e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
		INNER join job j WITH(NOLOCK) on j.wo_id=jh.wo_id and j.oper_id=jh.oper_id and j.seq_no=jh.seq_no
		LEFT JOIN ofi_nameplate_speed os  WITH(NOLOCK) on j.run_ent_id=os.ent_id and os.item_id=j.item_id
		
		WHERE	
		 j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
		GROUP by j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,j.item_id
		)
				SELECT @expected_prod=SUM (exp_qty),@planned_prod=SUM (planned_qty) from cte


	PRINT '@@actual_prod' + CAST(@actual_prod AS VARCHAR)
	PRINT '@capacity'
	PRINT '@expected_prod' + CAST(@expected_prod AS VARCHAR)
	--calculate performance percentage and it's losses 
	SET @performance_percent = CAST((@actual_prod / @expected_prod) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
	SET @perm_loss = @avil_runtime - @performance_percent

	IF @performance_percent >= 100
	BEGIN
		SET @performance_percent = @avil_runtime
		SET @perm_loss = 0
	END

	--Get the good production and bad production and display in the quality bar
	;WITH CTE as (
	SELECT
		[dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ip.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'
	FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE
		good_prod = 1
		AND shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		GROUP BY ip.item_id, i.uom_id
		)Select @good_prod=SUM(qty_prod) from CTE;

		
	WITH CTE as (
	SELECT
		[dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ip.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'
	FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
	WHERE
		good_prod = 0
		AND shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		GROUP BY ip.item_id, i.uom_id
		)Select @bad_prod=SUM(qty_prod) from CTE;

	PRINT '@good_prod' + CAST(@good_prod AS VARCHAR)
	PRINT '@bad_prod' + CAST(@bad_prod AS VARCHAR)

	IF @actual_prod >= @expected_prod
	BEGIN
		SET @qul_loss = 100--@avil_runtime
	END
		ELSE --IF @actual_prod > @good_prod
	BEGIN
		--SET @qul_percent=Cast(( @good_prod / @actual_prod ) * 100 AS
		-- DECIMAL(18, 2))
		PRINT 'else'
		SET @total_prod =(ISNULL(@good_prod,0) + (ISNULL(@bad_prod,0)))
		IF @total_prod=0
		BEGIN
		SET @total_prod=1
		END
		--declare @qualLossCalc float
		--set @qualLossCalc = (@bad_prod)/( @good_prod + @bad_prod)--(@bad_prod/(@good_prod + @bad_prod)* 100)
		--print '@qualLossCalc' + cast (@qualLossCalc as varchar)
		SET @qul_loss =(100 - ( ((ISNULL(@bad_prod,0)) / (ISNULL(@total_prod,0))) * 100 ))--@performance_percent - ( @good_prod / @actual_prod )
		PRINT '@qul_loss' + CAST(@qul_loss AS VARCHAR)
	END

	SET @qual_ldata = @good_prod
	SET @qul_loss = ISNULL(@qul_loss, 0)


	SELECT
		ISNULL(@diff_shift_mins, 0) AS util_max
	  , ISNULL(@avil_runtime, 0) AS    avil_data
	  , ISNULL(@qul_loss, 0) AS        qual_loss
	  , ISNULL(@qual_ldata, 0) AS      qual_data
		--( @performance_percent - @qul_loss ) AS qual_loss,
	  , ISNULL(@expected_prod, 0) AS   exp_prod
	  , ISNULL(@actual_prod, 0) AS     act_prod
	  , ISNULL(@good_prod, 0) AS       good	 
	  , (CASE
			 WHEN @bad_prod > 0
			 THEN @bad_prod
			 ELSE 0
		 END) AS                       bad
		  ,ISNULL(@planned_prod, 0)  as planned_prod
		  ,@defaultUOM as UOM
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_Resource_Group_Ent]
(
@res_grp_id int,
@ent_id int,
@row_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @message nvarchar(max),
	@rowCount int
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	begin try
		select @rowCount = count(*) from  sdb.SCH.res_grp_ent where row_id = @row_id
		if @rowCount > 0 
		begin
			update sdb.SCH.res_grp_ent set res_grp_id = @res_grp_id, ent_id= @ent_id where row_id = @row_id
			set @message = CONCAT('Successfully updated Resource Group with ID: ' , @res_grp_id)
		end
		else
		begin
			set @message = CONCAT('Invalid or missing Resource Group ID: ' , @res_grp_id)
		end
	end try
	begin catch
		set @message = CONCAT('unable to update Resource Group: ' , @res_grp_id)
	end catch
	select @message as 'message'
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetConsData]
-- Description: Used to insert Cons interface data into the buffer table
--
--  Old STEPS:
--		FROM QA:
		0.01 Find BCONs type
		0.02 Items got from buffer table
		0.03 Check if BIN itemgroup
		0.04 Insert cons or exit
--		1- Get the Event date by: SP_S_OFI_GETEVENTDATE
		2- Verify WO state: sp_s_wo
		3- Get the job state: 3, 4 or 5 are ‘OK’
		4- Virtual Silo check: AUT_Silo Number: 900000 to 999999
		4.1- Virtual Silo: sp_I_ofi_additive_addCons
		5- Get the max qty to be consumed:  sp_s_ofi_get_cons_qty_value and checks ‘type’
		5.1 – Values: -5, -4, 1, 0; Add Cons  (Continues at #6)
		5.2 – Values: -1, -2: Not consumption made
		6- Add cons procedure: sp_i_ofi_item_cons_addCons
		7 – Check Oper Attribute: ‘declare_prod_with_cons’
		7.1: if yes: Get Default Destination ‘def_destination_su’
		7.2 – Get def_des_su_ent_id: sp_sa_ent_GetEntityId
		7.3 – Get Item, def_lot and def_reas_cd: sp_s_job_bom
		7.4 – Get current valid sublot for production: sp_s_ofi_sublot
		7.5 – Do production: sp_i_item_prod_addprod
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE Cons object 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC		2025-06-04			Update for BINS CONS
-- 0.01.02	JSC		2025-06-30			Updated error message of the BINs item 
-- ===========================================================================================*/
create             PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessConsData_backup_04_08_25]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'CONS',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning), 13 timeout
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28));
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) = CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(28)) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		IF @TranCounter = 0
            BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
        ELSE
            SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;


			 --- PASTE FROM HERE ---

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN
			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,
					@sublot_no INT,
					@qty FLOAT,
					@storage_unit NVARCHAR(40),
					@item_id NVARCHAR(80) ,
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,
					@debug INT = 0

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@sublot_no = sublot_no
					,@qty = qty
					,@storage_unit = storage_unit
					,@item_id = item_id
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',
				sublot_no INT '$.sublot_no',
				qty FLOAT '$.qty',
				storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) '$.storage_unit',
				item_id NVARCHAR(80) '$.item_id',
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME	'$.recorded_timestamp'
			);


			-- v0.01.01
			DECLARE @bin_coll_starttime DATETIME
					,@bin_coll_endtime DATETIME
					,@bin_coll_area INT
					,@bin_coll_weighing NVARCHAR(80)
				
			

			-- 
			IF @InterfaceType = 'BCONS'
			BEGIN
				SELECT	 @bin_coll_starttime = bin_coll_starttime 
						,@bin_coll_endtime = bin_coll_endtime
						,@bin_coll_area = bin_coll_area
						,@bin_coll_weighing = bin_coll_weighing
				FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
				WITH (
					bin_coll_starttime  DATETIME '$.bin_coll_starttime ',
					bin_coll_endtime DATETIME '$.bin_coll_endtime',
					bin_coll_area INT '$.bin_coll_area',
					bin_coll_weighing NVARCHAR(80) '$.bin_coll_weighing'
				);

		
				-- LOGIC TAKENfrom the ofi_checkBinConsItemValidate script as WF from QA
				-- @item_id is already Bin item_iod as taken from the ent_attr
				-- check if item is BIN item
				
				DECLARE @validBinItem INT

				SELECT @validBinItem = 1
				FROM item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE ia.item_id = @item_id
					AND ia.attr_value IN ('Red Bins','White Bins','Blue Bins')
				
				IF @validBinItem IS NULL OR @validBinItem <> 1
				BEGIN
					-- Raise error value and exit:
					-- SET Error in Add Cons
					-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
					SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500029,NULL,NULL),'%1',ISNULL(@item_id,'empty value'))
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

					IF @debug = 1 
					BEGIN
						SELECT @message_output as 'item_error',@status_output
					END	

					GOTO exit_tree;
				END
			

			END

			-- GET MES USER
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)

			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
					,@mes_su_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the Consumption unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- Verify if we get the item_id from AUT
			DECLARE @ItemIdFromAUT INT = 0 -- Use a boolean 0 = no, 1 = yes.
			IF @item_id IS NOT NULL AND @item_id <> ''
			BEGIN
				-- Get the MES item_id
				SELECT	@mes_item_id = i.item_id 
				FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(@item_id,2) ia 
					LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.mes_item_id
				
				SET @ItemIdFromAUT = 1 -- Got value from AUT
			END
			
			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid
		
			-- check if virtual or real silo:
			DECLARE @IsVirtualSilo INT = 0
			-- @storage_unit between 900000 and 999999 is considered virtual silo
			IF @storage_unit BETWEEN 900000 AND 999999
				BEGIN
					SET @IsVirtualSilo = 1
					GOTO Virtual_Silo_CONS;
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					-- Get the MES SOURCE storage unit ent_id
					SELECT TOP 1 @mes_su_ent_id = ent_id
					FROM ent_attr ea with (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN  attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
					WHERE ea.attr_value = @storage_unit
						AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
						AND a.attr_grp = 2 -- ent attr group
					ORDER BY ea.last_edit_at DESC
				END

			-- check again do the cons and leave the script
			IF @InterfaceType = 'BCONS'
			BEGIN

				DECLARE @RC int
				-- TODO: Set parameter values here.

				EXECUTE @RC = [dbo].[SP_I_OFI_BinProdCons] 
				   @ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
				  ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				  ,@collectionStartTime = @bin_coll_starttime
				  ,@collectionEndTime = @bin_coll_endtime
				  ,@item = @item_id
				  ,@originArea = @bin_coll_area
				  ,@qty = @qty
				  ,@USERNAME = @mes_user_id

				IF @RC > 0
				BEGIN
					-- SET Error in Add Cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500021,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@RC,0) AS VARCHAR(32))					
				
				END;

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'binPRodError',@status_output
				END	

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END


			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type, @ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'
				,@sublot_no as 'sublot_no'
				,@qty as 'qty'
				,@storage_unit as 'storage'
				,@mes_su_ent_id as 'storage_unit_ent_id'
				,@item_id as 'item_id'
				,@mes_item_id as 'mes_item_id'
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid item is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_item_id IS NULL AND @ItemIdFromAUT = 1
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','item_id: '+@item_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'item_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- if an invalid SOURCE storage unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_su_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','Storage Unit / SUNumberInAUT: '+@storage_unit)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'su_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- Check if source is part of the selected ones
			DECLARE @mes_source_su_active INT = 0
			SELECT @mes_source_su_active = count (os.wo_id)
			FROM ofi_su_selection os WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE os.dest_type = 1 -- source
				AND os.wo_id = @mes_wo_id
				AND os.oper_id = @mes_oper_id
				AND os.seq_no = @seq_no
				AND (os.su_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id OR os.secondary_silo_ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id)

			-- if an invalid SOURCE storage unit is suplied; as it is not active for the selected job
			IF (@mes_source_su_active IS NULL OR @mes_source_su_active = 0)
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500026,NULL,NULL),'%1','Storage Unit / SUNumberInAUT: '+@storage_unit)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'su_not_Active_warning',@status_output
				END				
			END

			-- Declare the outputs of the SP_S_ofi_Get_Cons_Qty_Value Stored Procedure plus a local variable table to pick it up
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				,@data_bom_pos	INT
				,@data_def_lot_no nvarchar(40)
				,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				,@data_factor	FLOAT
				,@data_thr_result	INT
				,@data_from_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				,@data_qty_cons FLOAT
				,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				,@data_su_result INT
				,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME
				,@data_type INT = -1

			-- IMPORTANT::: CANNOT DO NESTED INSERT INTO




			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT @data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
			FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd=state_cd
					,@data_edit_time=edit_time 
			FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND seq_no = @seq_no

			-- if JOB is COMPLETED/NEW or RELEASED, ERROR -- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED -- 4 COMPLETED == WARNING --- 6 to 10 Other invalid job states (not allowed in AddCons)
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10) 
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500024,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
								
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				-- exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;

			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd = 4
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500016,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
										
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			---- Calculate the recorded_timestamp for the specified job
			DECLARE @record_selected DATETIME 
			DECLARE @record_min_Diff INT 
			DECLARE @recorded_timestamp_case INT 


			-- Get the valid timestamp in case the job is running or has ran:
			SELECT @record_min_Diff = record_min_Diff
					,@recorded_timestamp_case = recorded_timestamp_case
					,@record_selected = record_selected
			FROM [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetRecordedTimestamp] (
			   @mes_wo_id
			  ,@mes_oper_id
			  ,@seq_no
			  ,@recorded_timestamp)

			-- SET the actual date : In case the job has never RAN; we use the provided timestamp and let MES deal with it.
			SET @data_created_at_utc = ISNULL(@record_selected,@recorded_timestamp)
			
			-- Set warning if the recorded timestamp falls outside the job run time
			IF @recorded_timestamp_case > 500
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message 
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(@recorded_timestamp_case,NULL,NULL)+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@data_created_at_utc,121) +'. original recorded_timestamp: '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(35),@recorded_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timestamp_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

		
			-- MAIN Logic taken from SP_S_ofi_GET_CONS_Qty_value
			
			-- 1. ++ Retrieve Item from Inventory from Location Provided
			DECLARE @ItemTable TABLE(
				item_id nvarchar(40)
			)

			INSERT INTO @ItemTable
			EXEC SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption @mes_wo_id,@mes_oper_id,@seq_no,@storage_unit, NULL

			-- Gets one item from the inventory according to the sp GetItemForConsumption
			SELECT @data_from_item_id = item_id 
			FROM @ItemTable

			SET @mes_item_id = @data_from_item_id

			-- if no storage is found: 
			IF (@data_from_item_id IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				--SELECT -2 type, 'No item is not available in the storage, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
				--SELECT -2 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('No item is not available in the storage, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
				SELECT 	@data_type = -2, 
						@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300046,NULL,10) + ISNULL(@storage_unit,'')

				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END


			DECLARE @UOM_factor TABLE (factor float)

			-- GET UOM FACTOR
			INSERT @UOM_factor
			EXECUTE sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT 
				 @item_id = @data_from_item_id
				,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
				,@interface = 'CONS' 

			SELECT @data_factor = factor
			FROM @UOM_factor

			IF (@data_factor is NULL OR @data_factor = 0)
			BEGIN
				--SELECT -3 type, 'Factor is not defined, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
				--SELECT -3 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Factor is not defined, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
				SELECT 	@data_type = -3, 
						@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300047,NULL,10) + ISNULL(@data_from_item_id,'')
				
				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END
			-- 2. -- end

			
			-- 3. ++ Get Real Qty To Be Consume after Convertion
			DECLARE @ConsQtyTable TABLE(
				[type] INT,
				[qty_to_consume] FLOAT DEFAULT 0.00
			)

			INSERT @ConsQtyTable
			EXEC SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty @data_from_item_id,  @storage_unit, @qty, @data_factor

			SELECT 	 @data_type = [type]
					,@data_qty_cons = [qty_to_consume] 
			FROM @ConsQtyTable
			
			-- if SU does not have enough inventory then show Inventory warning == 9
			IF @data_type IS NULL OR @data_type = 1 -- 1 = qty_left < qty to consume
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500023,NULL,NULL)+' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15)) + '. qty_left: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@data_qty_cons/@data_factor,0) AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_inventory

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'SU_qty_warning',@status_output
				END
			END

			-- 3. -----
			-- 4. ++ Check Grade Code
			DECLARE @mes_item_grade_cd INT,
					@mes_item_status_cd INT,
					@minID INT,
					@req_grade_cd INT,
					@typeOfCons NVARCHAR(20) = 'FIFO', 
					@storage_item_id NVARCHAR(40)

			SELECT @typeOfCons = attr_value
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
												AND a.attr_desc = 'typeOfCons'
												AND a.attr_grp = 2
			WHERE ea.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			SELECT TOP 1 @storage_item_id = item_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id

			SET @typeOfCons = ISNULL(@typeOfCons,'FIFO')

			SELECT @req_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
			FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id  = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND item_id = @storage_item_id
			
			
				--Check the SU have 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
			SELECT TOP 1 @data_su_status = attr_desc
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id 
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id 
				AND attr_desc IN ('LockForOutput','BlockForQuality') 
				AND attr_value = '1'
			
			-- if SU is in any of the states 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' 
			IF @data_su_status IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300050,NULL,NULL)+ @data_su_status +' su_ent_id: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_su_ent_id,'') AS NVARCHAR(15))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'SU_status_warning',@status_output as 'status'
				END
			END
			
			DECLARE @invlist1 TABLE (   id INT  PRIMARY KEY, 
								lot NVARCHAR(40) ,
								sublot NVARCHAR(40), 
								qty FLOAT, 
								cons_qty FLOAT,  
								consume_full BIT ,
								grade_cd INT, 
								status_cd INT, 
								row_id int)

			INSERT INTO @invlist1
			EXEC SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons @mes_su_ent_id, @data_from_item_id, @data_qty_cons, 'FIFO'

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @invlist1 WHERE cons_qty >0

			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL )
			BEGIN
				SELECT @mes_item_grade_cd = grade_cd, @mes_item_status_cd = status_cd FROM @invlist1 WHERE id = @minID

				IF(@req_grade_cd <> @mes_item_grade_cd)
				BEGIN
					--SELECT -4 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, 'Grade is not match with The BOM, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
					--SELECT -4 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Grade is not match with The BOM, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
					SELECT @data_type = -4 
						   ,@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300048,NULL,10) + CAST(ISNULL(@mes_item_grade_cd,'') as VARCHAR(32)) + ' vs ' + CAST(ISNULL(@req_grade_cd,'') as VARCHAR(32))
					BREAK;
				END

				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @invlist1 WHERE id > @minID AND cons_qty >0
			END
			
			IF @data_type = -4
			BEGIN
				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END;
			-- 4. --
			
			-- 5. --			
			IF EXISTS(	SELECT iv.row_id 
						FROM item_inv iv
						LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
																	and jb.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
																	and jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
																	and jb.item_id = iv.item_id
						WHERE 
							iv.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
								AND jb.item_id IS NULL )
			BEGIN
				--SELECT -5 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, 'Material is not available in the BoM, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
				--SELECT -5 type, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Material is not available in the BoM, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
				SELECT   @data_type = -5 
						,@message_output = dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300049,NULL,10) + ' AUT_SU: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') AS VARCHAR(32))
				
				-- GOTO evaluation
				GOTO EvaluateType;
			END
			
			
			--- FINAL OUTPUT OF THE SP: 
			---	SELECT 	ISNULL(@data_type,-1) type
			--		   	, @data_from_item_id data_from_item_id
			--			, ISNULL(@data_qty_cons,0.00) data_qty_cons
			--			, '' message_info
			--			, @data_su_status su_status
			--			, @su_aut_name su_aut_name
			
			
			-- evaluation - Check data type value and continue!
		EvaluateType:
			IF @data_type IN (-5, -4)
			BEGIN
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
				
				-- Warning, continue with CONS
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_warning',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
			END
			ELSE IF @data_type = 1
			BEGIN

				-- Warning, continue with CONS
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_warning',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
			END
			ELSE IF @data_type = 0
			BEGIN
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_ok',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				
				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'data_type_error',@status_output, @data_type as 'data_type'
				END
				-- Done here; exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
	
			---- VERIFY IF NEEDED (for future Update to use sublot_no provided by DCS)

			-- Check if the fg_sublot_no is provided: 
			-- CANNOT USE the provided fg_Sublot_no as it is being calculated down the 'consumption' script.
	
			-- Prepare SUBLOT_NO to 5 zeros:
			-- DECLARE @mes_sublot_no NVARCHAR(25)

			-- -- Fix the missing sublot data with a 'T' for Traceability
			-- SET @mes_sublot_no = CASE WHEN @NonBOMItem = 1 
										-- THEN	ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no,@data_lot_no) + RIGHT('00000'+CAST(@sublot_no as VARCHAR(5)),5) + 'T'
									-- ELSE ISNULL(@data_def_lot_no,@data_lot_no) + RIGHT('00000'+CAST(@sublot_no as VARCHAR(5)),5)
								-- END

			--- VERIFY IF NEEDED ENDS

			-- Fly by to calculate the quantity
			Virtual_Silo_CONS: 
			-- Prepare the data for quantity
			DECLARE @mes_qty_Cons FLOAT = 0.0
			SET @mes_qty_Cons = ISNULL(@qty, 0) * ISNULL(@data_factor,1)

			-- Declare the outputs
			DECLARE @cons_row_id INT
					,@cons_info NVARCHAR(4000)


			-- DEFINE OUTPUTS
			DECLARE @return_bit INT
			
			IF @IsVirtualSilo = 1 
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @AddConsAdditivesTable AS TABLE (
															row_id INT
															,error_desc NVARCHAR(80)
														)
							
				INSERT INTO @AddConsAdditivesTable
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_Additive_AddCons] 
						   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  ,@qty = @mes_qty_Cons   --> actual quantity to report
						  ,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id  --> Line source of the consumption message ent_id required
						  ,@aut_storage_id = @storage_unit --> shall be the storage unit value from the AUT interface 
						  ,@item_id = NULL  --> not used within the SP


				-- Set the output row IF
				SELECT TOP 1 @cons_row_id = row_id
							,@message_output = error_desc
				FROM @AddConsAdditivesTable

				IF @cons_row_id < 0
				BEGIN
					-- Set output message in case of error
					SET @message_output = 'Virtual silo fail with message: '+ @message_output + '. AND Storage_unit: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') AS NVARCHAR(35)) -- to review: Virtual Silo cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				END
				ELSE IF @cons_row_id > 0 AND @message_output <> '' AND @message_output IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @message_output = 'Virtual silo WARNING message: '+ @message_output + '. AND Storage_unit: ' + CAST(ISNULL(@storage_unit,'') AS NVARCHAR(35)) -- to review: Virtual Silo cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_processed
				END

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'virtual_silo_output',@status_output
				END

				-- Done here; exit
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				-- Execute normal procedure from OFI --->
				EXECUTE @return_bit = [dbo].[SP_I_ofi_Item_Cons_AddCons] 
						   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
						  ,@qty = @data_qty_cons ---> calculated on SP
						  ,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
						  ,@aut_storage_id = @storage_unit
						  ,@item_id = @data_from_item_id  ---> Calculated on SP
						  ,@actual_cons_time = @data_created_at_utc
						  
			
				IF @return_bit > 0
				BEGIN
					-- SET Error in Add Cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500021,NULL,NULL) + CAST(@return_bit AS VARCHAR(32))
					
					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END;
			END



			-- Check Add prod from CONS attribute
			DECLARE @mes_dec_prod_from_cons NVARCHAR(3000)
					,@mes_def_destination_su NVARCHAR(40)
					,@mes_def_destination_su_ent_id INT
					,@mes_prod_item_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@prod_row_id INT = -1
					,@prod_info NVARCHAR(4000)
			
			SELECT @mes_dec_prod_from_cons = oa.attr_value
			FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id
			WHERE a.attr_desc = 'declare_prod_with_cons'
				AND a.attr_grp = 7
				AND oa.oper_id = @mes_oper_id

			IF @mes_dec_prod_from_cons = 'YES'
			BEGIN
				-- Produce agains the consumption:
				-- find the default destination if configured: if not use the consuming SEGMENT
				--- LOGIC TAKEN FROM sp_SA_ofi_Oper_Attr

				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id = active_su_ent_id 
				FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND dest_type = 2 
				
				SELECT @mes_def_destination_su = ent_name  
				FROM ent WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE ent_id = @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id
			

				IF(@mes_def_destination_su IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 @mes_def_destination_su = oper_attr.attr_value 
					FROM oper_attr oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
					WHERE 	oper_attr.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
							AND attr.attr_desc = 'def_destination_su'
					
				END
				
				-- PICK either current value or new value based on it being NULL or NOT
				SELECT TOP 1 @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id = COALESCE(@mes_def_destination_su_ent_id,e.ent_id)
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_def_destination_su

				-- If no destination found; Raise inventory error
				IF @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id IS NULL
				BEGIN
					-- SET Error in Add Cons
					SET @status_output = @cfg_status_warning_inventory
					SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500025,NULL,NULL) + @mes_oper_id;
					
					RAISERROR(@message_output,16,1);	
					GOTO Exit_Tree;
				END

				-- Get DEF lot, reas, material for BOM_POS = 0 for the selected job
				SELECT	 @data_def_lot_no = def_lot_no
						,@data_bom_pos = bom_pos
						,@mes_prod_item_id = item_id
						,@data_def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
				FROM job_bom WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
					AND oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
					AND seq_no = @seq_no 
					AND bom_pos = 0
				
				SELECT @data_def_reas_cd = ISNULL(@data_def_reas_cd, ir.reas_cd)
				FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
				INNER JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.reas_desc = ea.attr_value
				WHERE a.attr_desc like 'def_reas_cd'
					AND a.attr_grp = 2
					AND ea.ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
						
				-- Get SUBLOT_NO
				DECLARE @sublotTable TABLE (
												sublot_counter INT,
												sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
											)

				INSERT @sublotTable
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Sublot]
						 @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						,@seq_no = @seq_no
						
				DECLARE @fg_Sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				SELECT TOP 1 @fg_Sublot_no = sublot_no 
				FROM @sublotTable
				
				-- DO PRODUCTION AFTER CONS
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd] 
								 @session_id = NULL
								,@user_id = @mes_user_id
								,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
								,@qty_prod = @data_qty_cons
								,@reas_cd = @data_def_reas_cd
								,@lot_no = @data_def_lot_no
								,@sublot_no = @fg_Sublot_no
								,@to_ent_id = @mes_def_destination_su_ent_id
								,@item_id = @mes_prod_item_id
								,@check_privs  = NULL
								,@created_at_utc = @data_created_at_utc
								,@row_id = @prod_row_id OUTPUT
								,@prod_info = @prod_info OUTPUT		  
			END

			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN

				SELECT @cons_info as Cons_info
						,@cons_row_id  as cons_row_id
						,@prod_info as prod_info
						,@prod_row_id as prod_row_id
				
				SELECT *
				FROM item_Cons i WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.row_id = @cons_row_id

				SELECT *
				FROM item_inv i WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.ent_id = @mes_su_ent_id
				
				SELECT *
				FROM item_prod i WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.row_id = @prod_row_id

				SELECT
						 @data_wo_state_cd AS wo_status
						,@data_job_state_cd	AS state_cd
						,@data_job_pos	AS job_pos 
						,@data_bom_pos	AS bom_pos
						,@data_def_lot_no AS def_lot_no
						,@data_def_reas_cd AS def_reas_cd
						,@data_factor	AS factor
						,@data_thr_result	AS thr_result
						,@mes_item_id AS mes_item_id
						,@data_from_item_id AS from_item_id
						,@data_lot_no AS lot_no
						,@data_sublot_no AS sublot_no
						,@data_qty_cons AS qty_cons
						,@data_edit_time AS edit_time
						,@data_max_capacity AS max_capacity 
						,@data_su_result AS su_result
						,@data_su_status AS su_status
						,@mes_su_ent_id AS su_ent_id
						--,@mes_sublot_no AS mes_sublot_no
						,@data_created_at_utc as created_at_utc
						,@mes_qty_Cons as mes_qty_Cons
						--,@mes_byproduct as mes_byproduct
						,@mes_user_id as mes_user_id

			END			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END


		-- Exit area
		Exit_Tree:
		--- PASTE UNTIL HERE ---
		
		-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
		IF @status_output = 1 
		BEGIN
			-- SET OK
			SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
			SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500022,NULL,NULL)
		END

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @message_output = @message
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

        IF @xstate = -1
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName
        IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
	END CATCH
END;

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_shift_sched_aft_del] ON [dbo].[shift_sched]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_shift_sched_aft_del
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on shift_sched table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--03/05/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00075055; On change of shift got "No Shift" despit...
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
			,@ent_id		INT32
			,@start_day		INT32
			,@shift_id		INT32
			,@start_time	DATETIME
			,@end_time		DATETIME
			,@days_ahead	INT32
			,@v_current_time	DATETIME
			--,@use_gmt		INT32

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--EXEC SP_SA_SYSTEM_ATTR_USEGMT @use_gmt=@use_gmt

	SET @v_current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	DECLARE shift_sched_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT d.ent_id, d.start_day, d.shift_id, d.start_time, d.end_time
	FROM deleted d

	OPEN shift_sched_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_sched_cursor into @ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id, @start_time, @end_time
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @start_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @v_current_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @start_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		SET @end_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @v_current_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		SET @days_ahead = DATEDIFF(D, @start_time, @end_time)
		SELECT @start_time = @start_time -1, @days_ahead = @days_ahead + 4

		--Call the refresh shift sched procedure to populate all template shifts for an entity.
		EXEC SP_U_ENT_SCHEDULESHIFTS @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_start_time=@start_time
			, @in_days_ahead=@days_ahead, @in_time_zone_bias_value=0
	END
	CLOSE shift_sched_cursor
	DEALLOCATE shift_sched_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Process_Link]
(@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @item_pref  int  ,
 @status int,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @mod_id  varchar(30) )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 6/13/03           Rich Boyle         Append process.process_status and process.process_level columns to
--                                                   recordset that is returned.
--03/03/2005	Raghu		2.1.15	HD# 5439, Sort items based on system_attribute parameter
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)

SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 210
IF (@attr_value IS NULL) OR (ISNUMERIC(@attr_value) = 0) SET @attr_value = '1'

SELECT item_process_link.item_id
           ,item_process_link.process_id
           ,item_process_link.item_pref
           ,item_process_link.status
           ,item.item_desc
	       ,CASE
			WHEN @attr_value = '0' THEN item.item_id
			WHEN @attr_value = '1' THEN item.item_desc
			WHEN @attr_value = '2' THEN item.item_id + '(' + item.item_desc + ')'
			WHEN @attr_value = '3' THEN item.item_desc + '(' + item.item_id + ')'
		    END AS item_display
 	       ,item.num_decimals
	       ,item.uom_id
	       ,uom.description uom_description
           ,process.process_desc
           ,process.process_status
           ,process.process_level
           ,item_class.item_class_id
           ,item_class.item_class_desc
           ,item_process_link.last_edit_comment
           ,item_process_link.last_edit_by
           ,item_process_link.last_edit_at
           ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_process_link.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM item_process_link item_process_link WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,item item WITH (NOLOCK)
 	    INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
       ,process process WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,item_class item_class WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((item_process_link.process_id = process.process_id)AND
       (item_process_link.item_id = item.item_id)AND
       (item.item_class_id = item_class.item_class_id) AND
       (item_process_link.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_process_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_process_link.item_pref = @item_pref OR @item_pref IS NULL) AND
       (item_process_link.status = @status OR @status IS NULL) AND
       (item_process_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (item_process_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_process_link.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY CASE  WHEN (@attr_value = '0') THEN item.item_id
		WHEN (@attr_value = '1') THEN item.item_desc
		WHEN (@attr_value = '2') THEN item.item_id
		WHEN (@attr_value = '3') THEN item.item_desc
		ELSE item.item_desc
	END, process.process_desc
--ORDER BY item.item_desc, process.process_desc

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp]
(
	@grp_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@grp_desc		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@max_value		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@trigger_type	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@obsolete		LOGICAL = 0
,	@spare1			STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare2			STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare3			STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@spare4			STRING1000_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/10/2002		Raghu			1.4		if obsolete is set to true, then get all, obsolete and non-obsolete
--											if obsolete is set to false, then get only non-obsolete data log groups
-- 09/26/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 07/05/2007		AML				3.2.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000.
--01/17/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00073591;Not deleting data log groups correctly
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @obsolete = ABS( @obsolete )

	IF  @obsolete IS NULL BEGIN
		SET @obsolete = 0
	END
	IF  @obsolete = 1 BEGIN
		SET @obsolete = NULL
	END

    SELECT	data_log_grp.grp_id
		,	data_log_grp.grp_desc
		,	data_log_grp.max_value
		,	data_log_grp.trigger_type
		,	data_log_grp.trigger_detail
		,	data_log_grp.obsolete
		,	data_log_grp.spare1
		,	data_log_grp.spare2
		,	data_log_grp.spare3
		,	data_log_grp.spare4
		,	data_log_grp.last_edit_comment
		,	data_log_grp.last_edit_by
		,	data_log_grp.last_edit_at
          ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, data_log_grp.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (
			(data_log_grp.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.grp_desc = @grp_desc OR @grp_desc IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.max_value = @max_value OR @max_value IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.trigger_type = @trigger_type OR @trigger_type IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.obsolete = @obsolete OR @obsolete IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
	ORDER BY data_log_grp.grp_desc
END
