CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ent_logon_aft_del]
@ent_id			INT32,
@user_id		STRING40_NULL,
@cur_lab_usage_log_id	INT32,
@event_time		TDATETIME,
@log_id			INT32
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	SP_ENT_LOGON_AFT_DEL
-- Description	      -	Code moved from AFTER INSERT trigger of ENT_LOGON table
-- Date Created	      -	10/18/2002
-- Version	      -       1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      	Changes
-- 10/18/2002     Sheetal Jain     		Base version
-- 10/23/2002     Sheetal Jain     		Added user_id in the WHERE clause of last UPDATE ent_logon(Bulk Labor Deadlocks)
-- 03/27/2003	Raghu			Updating FC Tags code moved from ent logon after delete trigger to improve performance
-- 03/28/2003	Raghu			Update FC Tags ONLY when parent FC node exists
-- 04/17/2003	Raghu			Donot fetch pct_to_apply from labor_usage as labor_usage.pct_to_apply might have split with multiple logged in steps and lots
--					Update labor usage directly instead of calling labor_exec close lab events which has join like ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL
--					creates performance issue.
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1600  	Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
--09/04/2003	Raghu		2.0	Included 'AND UPPER(b.node_desc) LIKE 'USER%'' While fetching user_id FROM user_id tag to avoid multiple user_id which might
--					have exposed via labor tags and Prod Screen tags
--11/13/2003	Raghu		2.0.9	While deleting labor_usage where duration < 2 secs, included labor_start to check for last 2 minutes - as all the labor transactions
--					will be finished in a minute or two - For performance improvement
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement
--06/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.23	HD# 5762, Fixed a bug to close all labor records that are not licensed for an entity and are collected for steps.
--07/11/2005	Raghu		2.1.24	HD# 5762, Cannot insert NULL exception is raised. @event_time should be defaulted to GetDate() in
--					the case where labor is not licensed and step is licensed.
--07/12/2006	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--12/07/2007	AML			3.4.0	DB Changes
--03/05/2008	AML			3.4.0	Added dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDatetime( GETUTCDATE() ) to last_edit_at in inserts.
--09/20/2017	Raghu		6.0	UseStory: 909252 - As Terry, I want the migration of util tables to the new schema to not fail on Invalid objects - 'fc_namesp_node' (CR L00146484)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE	@total_pct_lab_to_apply		TFLOAT,
		@LT_cenpercent				LOGICAL,
		@MT_cenpercent 				LOGICAL,
		@node_id					INT32,
		@last_edit_by				STRING40,
		@last_edit_at				TDATETIME,
		@use_gmt					INT32,
		@event_time_utc				TDATETIME,
		@tz_temp					INT32

BEGIN
	--SET log_id = null and event_time = null
	SET @log_id = NULL
	SET @event_time  = NULL
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

  --Check 'Allow user to account for less than 100% of his time<1108>'
  SELECT @LT_cenpercent = ISNULL(attr_value,0) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 188
  --Check 'Allow user to account for more than 100% of his time<1109>'
  SELECT @MT_cenpercent = ISNULL(attr_value,0) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 189
--  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ent_logon WHERE ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = @ent_id)


	SET @event_time = ISNULL( @event_time, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @event_time, @tz_temp, @event_time_utc OUTPUT


  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ent_logon WHERE ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = @ent_id)
     AND @cur_lab_usage_log_id IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN

	 UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(SS, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
	      WHERE user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1

    SELECT @total_pct_lab_to_apply = SUM(a.total_pct_lab_to_apply) FROM
      (SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ISNULL(pct_lab_to_apply,0) total_pct_lab_to_apply FROM ent_logon WHERE user_id = @user_id) a
    IF @total_pct_lab_to_apply IS NULL
      SET @total_pct_lab_to_apply = 1
    IF (@LT_cenpercent = 0)
    BEGIN
      IF (@total_pct_lab_to_apply) >= 1 AND (@MT_cenpercent = 1)
      BEGIN
		--print 'do nothing'
		declare @x as bit
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
--					Exec sp_I_Labor_Usage_Account @user_id
        --Create a new set of labor records for ths user.
	INSERT INTO labor_usage(labor_start_utc, labor_start_local,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
					dept_id, shift_id,shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,pct_to_apply,active,duration,comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	  SELECT @event_time_utc, @event_time,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
		 dept_id, shift_id,shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
		--pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply,
		CASE WHEN (@total_pct_lab_to_apply = 0)  THEN 0 ELSE pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply END,
		active,0,comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDatetime( GETUTCDATE() )
	    FROM labor_usage WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

	UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
	  WHERE active = 1 AND (user_id = @user_id AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc)

--	UPDATE labor_usage SET pct_to_apply = pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply
--	  WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

	UPDATE ent_logon SET ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id = labor_usage.log_id,
		ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply
--ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply = labor_usage.pct_to_apply
	  FROM labor_usage WHERE ent_logon.user_id = labor_usage.user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id
            AND labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

      END  --End of (@total_pct_lab_to_apply) >= 1 AND (@MT_cenpercent = 1)
    END  --End of (@LT_cenpercent = 0)
    ELSE
    BEGIN --Allow User to account for less than 100%
      IF @MT_cenpercent = 0
      BEGIN
	IF (@total_pct_lab_to_apply) > 1
        BEGIN
          --						Exec sp_I_Labor_Usage_Account @user_id
	  INSERT INTO labor_usage(labor_start_utc, labor_start_local,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
					  dept_id, shift_id,shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,pct_to_apply,active,duration,comments, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	    SELECT @event_time_utc, @event_time,user_id,ent_id,wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,step_no,item_id,lot_no,lab_cd,
		   dept_id, shift_id,shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
		 CASE WHEN (@total_pct_lab_to_apply = 0)  THEN 0 ELSE pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply END,
		active,0,comments, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDatetime( GETUTCDATE() )
	      FROM labor_usage WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

	  UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
	    WHERE active = 1 AND (user_id = @user_id AND labor_start_utc <> @event_time_utc)

--	  UPDATE labor_usage SET pct_to_apply = pct_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply
--	    WHERE labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

	  UPDATE ent_logon SET ent_logon.cur_lab_usage_log_id = labor_usage.log_id,
		ent_logon.pct_lab_to_apply = pct_lab_to_apply/@total_pct_lab_to_apply
--pct_lab_to_apply = labor_usage.pct_to_apply
	    FROM labor_usage WHERE ent_logon.user_id = labor_usage.user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = labor_usage.ent_id
              AND labor_usage.user_id = @user_id AND labor_usage.active = 1

	END  --End of (@total_pct_lab_to_apply) > 1
      END  --End of @MT_cenpercent = 0
    END  -- End of ELSE
  END  --End of NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM ent_logon WHERE ent_logon.user_id = @user_id AND ent_logon.ent_id = @ent_id) ....
  ELSE BEGIN
	IF (@cur_lab_usage_log_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		UPDATE labor_usage SET duration = DATEDIFF(ss, labor_start_utc, @event_time_utc), active = 0
	    WHERE (user_id = @user_id AND ent_id = @ent_id AND active = 1)
	END
  END
  --Modified by Raghu on 08/13/2002. The below delete statement is moved into Cursor loop which always will have user_id value
  DELETE FROM labor_usage WHERE user_id = @user_id AND active = 0 AND duration < 2 AND labor_start_utc >= DATEADD(mi, -2, @event_time_utc)
--	select log_id, labor_start, user_id, ent_id, pct_to_apply, active, duration FROM LABOR_USAGE WHERE user_id = '111' and active = 0 and duration < 1
--	Code moved from ent logon after delete trigger to improve performance
--	User may be logged in to multiple sessions on the same entity, check any session exist. If exist donot update fc tags, and if doesnot exists then update fc tags.

END

CREATE               PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Check_Item_FinalJob] (
  @wo_id		STRING40
, @oper_id		STRING40
, @seq_no		INT32 = NULL
, @item_id		STRING40 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_S_Check_Item_FinalJob
-- Description    -	returns 1 if it's the last job for that item, else 0
-- Author	      - Rohit Pandya
-- Date Created   - 01/20/03
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE
   @next_item_id		STRING40
,  @next_oper_id		STRING40
,  @next_seq_no		INT32
	Declare NextJobs_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD LOCAL for
	Select oper_id, seq_no
		from job_route WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		   and  input_oper_id = @oper_id
		   and input_seq_no = @seq_no
	OPEN NextJobs_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		Fetch NEXT from NextJobs_cursor into @next_oper_id, @next_seq_no
		--print 'Prev Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_seq_no)
		if (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		--print 'Check Prev Oper = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_oper_id) + 'Seq No = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_seq_no)
		Select @next_item_id = item_id from job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		   and oper_id = @next_oper_id
		   and seq_no = @next_seq_no
		--print ' @next_item_id = ' + convert(nvarchar,@next_item_id) + '@item_id = ' + convert(nvarchar,@item_id) + 'status = '
		--Update only if the item produced are same
		IF @next_item_id = @item_id  BEGIN
			CLOSE NextJobs_cursor
			DEALLOCATE NextJobs_cursor
			RETURN 0
		END
	END
	CLOSE NextJobs_cursor
	DEALLOCATE NextJobs_cursor
return 1
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_U_ofi_su_cons_mode_by_state]
-- Description:To update the SU Consumption mode based on state

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-11-19		Intial Version
-- 0.01.01	 YG				  2024-02-09		Update Script Body Comment and Missing No Lock

--Check the stateCode and desc 
--0 = Idle,
--1 = "Empty_Dirty";
--2 = "Cleaning";
--3 = "Empty_Clean";
--4 = "Filling";
--5  = "Filled";
--6  = "Quarantaine";
--7  = "Released";
--8  = "FillingEmptying";
--9  = "Emptying";
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_cons_mode_by_state] 
@ent_name as nvarchar(40),
@state_cd as int


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

Declare 
@result as int=0,
@ent_id as int,
@cons_attr_id as int,
@enable_silo_mode_basedon_state as nvarchar(40)
--@user_id as nvarchar(40)='AVEVA\MesControlSvcAccount'

--Get the ent id
SELECT @ent_id=ent_id 
FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)  
where ent_name=@ent_name

--Get the Attribute value of SU
SELECT @enable_silo_mode_basedon_state=ea.attr_value
FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'EnableSiloModeBasedonState'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @ent_id

--Get the type of cons Attribute id
SELECT @cons_attr_id=ea.attr_id
FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfCons'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @ent_id

--Get the value of Enable Silo Mode Based on State Attribute value
IF (@enable_silo_mode_basedon_state ='YES') 
	BEGIN
	IF (@state_cd=8)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ent_attr
		SET	attr_value = 'FIFO'
			--notes='SU consumption mode was changed by DCS because the SU state has changed.',
			--last_edit_by=@user_id
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND
			  attr_id = @cons_attr_id 
		SET @result=@state_cd
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE ent_attr
		SET	attr_value = 'Mixed'
			--notes='SU consumption mode was changed by DCS because the SU state has changed.',
			--last_edit_by=@user_id
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND
			  attr_id = @cons_attr_id 
		SET @result=@state_cd
	END

END
Select @result as result

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_osc_addorupdatechoicesxml]
(
	@xml_source              NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value    INT32_NULL = NULL

)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_U_OSC_AddChoicesXML
-- Description          - Add or Update choices
-- Author              - Raghu
-- Date Created          - 12/01/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver        Changes
--01/11/2008	Raghu		3.4	73760; AddOrUpdateChoices does not work.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
--
--doc                         DBMS_XMLDOM.DOMDocument;
--ndoc                        DBMS_XMLDOM.DOMNode;
--docelem                     DBMS_XMLDOM.DOMElement;
--node                        DBMS_XMLDOM.DOMNode;
--childnode                   DBMS_XMLDOM.DOMNode;
--nodelist                    DBMS_XMLDOM.DOMNodelist;
--node_value                  VARCHAR2(4000);

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @doc_handle		INT32
		,	@process_id		STRING40
		,	@oper_id        STRING40
		,	@step_no		INT32
		,	@choice_no      INT32
		,	@choice_label   STRING40
		,	@row_count      INT32
		,	@last_edit_at   TDATETIME
		,	@row_id         INT32
		,	@delete_all     LOGICAL

    --Convert the input xml to XML Type.
    EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @xml_source

	--Open the xml, and read the target_process_id, target_oper_id and target_step_no
	SELECT	@process_id = CASE WHEN process_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE process_id END
		,	@oper_id = CASE WHEN oper_id = '' THEN NULL ELSE oper_id END
		,	@step_no = CASE WHEN step_no = '' THEN 0 ELSE step_no END
		,	@delete_all = CASE WHEN delete_all = '' THEN NULL ELSE delete_all END
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request', 2)
	WITH (	process_id  NVARCHAR(160),
			oper_id NVARCHAR(160),
			step_no NVARCHAR(160),
			delete_all NVARCHAR(160)	)

    IF (@delete_all = 1)
        DELETE FROM oper_step_choice
        WHERE process_id = @process_id
          AND oper_id = @oper_id
          AND step_no = @step_no

	--Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
	DECLARE choice_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT	CASE WHEN choice_no = '' THEN NULL ELSE choice_no END AS choice_no
		,	CASE WHEN choice_label = '' THEN NULL ELSE choice_label END AS choice_label
	FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/request/choice', 2)
	WITH (choice_no  NVARCHAR(160), choice_label NVARCHAR(160))

	--Loop through each source node to create a step copy.
	OPEN choice_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM choice_cursor INTO @choice_no, @choice_label

		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper_step_choice WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE process_id = @process_id
				  AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND step_no = @step_no
				AND choice_no = @choice_no) BEGIN
		        IF (@choice_label IS NULL)
		            DELETE FROM oper_step_choice
		            WHERE process_id = @process_id
		              AND oper_id = @oper_id

	 END

    EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shift_History_GetCurPrev]
(@ent_id	INT32 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Shift_History_GetCurPrev
-- Description	      - Returns the current shift and the previous non-zero shift for an entity
-- Author	      -	Raghu G
-- Date Created	      - 07/29/2013
-- Version			- 4.6
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
		SELECT sh.ent_id, e.ent_name, sh.shift_id, s.shift_desc, sh.shift_start_utc
			, sh.shift_start_local, sh.shift_start_utc AS shift_start
			, sh.shift_end_utc, sh.shift_end_local, sh.shift_end_utc AS shift_end
		FROM
			(--Select the non-zero shift that preceedes the current shift
			SELECT ps.ent_id, MAX(ps.shift_start_utc) shift_start_utc
			FROM shift_history ps WITH (NOLOCK)
			--Filter the list by the entity ID, if supplied.
			WHERE (ps.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
				--Eliminate shift 0's (no shift) from the list.
			   AND ps.shift_id <> 0
			   --Limit to the last non-zero shift
			   AND ps.shift_end_utc IS NOT NULL
			GROUP BY ps.ent_id
			UNION ALL
			--Select the current shift for all the entities
			SELECT cs.ent_id, cs.shift_start_utc
			FROM shift_history cs WITH (NOLOCK)
			--Filter the list by the entity ID, if supplied.
			WHERE (cs.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
				--Limit to the most recent shift
			  AND cs.shift_end_utc IS NULL
			) curr_and_prev
		--Join with the shift history table to retrieve other information
		INNER JOIN shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) ON sh.ent_id = curr_and_prev.ent_id AND sh.shift_start_utc = curr_and_prev.shift_start_utc
		--Retrieve entity name
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON sh.ent_id = e.ent_id
		--Retrieve shift description
		LEFT OUTER JOIN shift s WITH (NOLOCK) ON sh.shift_id = s.shift_id
		--Order by the list of entities and their shift start utc
		ORDER BY e.ent_name, sh.shift_start_utc
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_S_ofi_GetTtlBoMQty
-- Description:	The stored procedure will get total qty of BoM configured 
--
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-08-19			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  YG				2023-01-25			Added conversion UoM
-- 0.03.00  YG				2024-01-18			Added Nolock
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetTtlBoMQty] 
		@parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@version NVARCHAR(10) = NULL,
		@material_type NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@total_bom_qty FLOAT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @iItemGroupAttrId INT,
			@strItemGroupAttrDesc NVARCHAR(40) = 'MaterialType',
			@strDefaultUoM NVARCHAR(40) = 'KG'

	-- Get Attribute Id
	SELECT @iItemGroupAttrId = attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = @strItemGroupAttrDesc
		AND attr_grp = 1 -- Item attribute group is 1

	/*
	SELECT @total_bom_qty = SUM(qty_per_parent_item)*100 
	FROM bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.item_id = ia.item_id 
											AND ia.attr_id = @iItemGroupAttrId
	WHERE bi.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id 
		AND bi.ver_id = @version
		AND (bi.spare1 is NULL OR bi.spare1 <> 'InActive')
		AND bi.bom_pos > 0
		AND ia.attr_value = @material_type
	*/
	SELECT
          @total_bom_qty = ROUND(SUM(dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](bi.item_id,qty_per_parent_item,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,u.description,@strDefaultUoM)), 5) *100
     FROM bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK)
	 INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
	 INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id 
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.item_id = ia.item_id and attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = @strItemGroupAttrDesc
																													AND attr_grp = 1 )
     WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
		 AND attr_value = @material_type
		 AND ver_id = @version
		 AND bom_pos > 0
		 AND (bi.spare2 = 'Active'
		 OR bi.spare2 IS NULL)

	SELECT @total_bom_qty total_bom_qty 
END

	,	@max_qty_per_parent_item	TFLOAT

	,	@def_storage_ent_id			INT32
	,	@cur_ent_id	INT32
	,	@cur_to_ent_id				INT32
	,	@cur_lot_no					STRING40
	,	@cur_sublot_no				STRING40
	,	@cur_item_id				STRING40
	,	@cur_update_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@cur_must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL
	,	@cur_must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL

	,	@cur_status_cd				INT32

	,	@old_cur_int_qty			TFLOAT

	,	@shift_start_temp			TDATETIME
	,	@def_reject_ent_id			INT32
	,	@curr_qty_temp				TFLOAT
	,	@shift_start_utc			TDATETIME

	,	@cur_created_at_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@created_at_local			TDATETIME
	,	@cur_segment_requirement_id		STRING80
	,	@cur_segment_response_id		STRING80
	,	@dbg_resp					INT32
	,	@shift_start_tz				INT32
	,	@production_time_utc			TDATETIME
	,	@job_start_utc				TDATETIME
	,@tmp_shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
	,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(MAX)
     ,  @hour_start_utc             TDATETIME ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
     , @last_edit_comment2		STRING254 = 'ItemProd.Update'
     , @ent_name					NVARCHAR(80)

BEGIN
	--Verify whether the supplied parameters are legitimate
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified entity ID:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id), 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},entity ID:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id), 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- Init the values
	IF @last_edit_at IS NULL SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	--Get the created at UTC from the curent row
	SELECT @cur_created_at_utc = ip.created_at_utc
	FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ip.row_id = @row_id

	--Determine whether all time fields are supplied with null values
	IF (@created_at_utc IS NULL AND @shift_start_local IS NULL AND @hour_start_local IS NULL)
		--None of the time fields are supplied, default from the existing record
		SET @created_at_utc = @cur_created_at_utc

	--Determine whether created_at_utc is supplied.
	IF (@created_at_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		-- Since created_at_utc time is supplied, determine the hour start and the shift start from the production time.
		SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
		FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND shift_start_utc =
		     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  --shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
			  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @created_at_utc)

		--Raise an error, if a valid shift is not found
		IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
			--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

		--Determine the hour start bucket
		SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @created_at_utc), 0)

		--Determine the local times
		SELECT @hour_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_start_utc)
			, @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)
			, @production_time_utc = @created_at_utc
	   END
	   ELSE BEGIN --@created_at_utc is not supplied
		--Do this for backward compatibility

		--Strip out the minutes and seconds
		SET @hour_start_local = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @hour_start_local), 0)

		IF (@hour_start_local IS NOT NULL AND @shift_start_local IS NOT NULL)  BEGIN-- Determine whether the shift start and the hour start is supplied

			--Determine the shift start and hour start UTC times
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())
				, @hour_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @hour_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

			SET @tmp_shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
			SET @shift_start_utc = NULL

			--Verify whether this is a valid shift start
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND shift_start_utc =
			     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
				FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
				--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
				  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @tmp_shift_start_utc)

			--Raise an error, if a valid shift is not found
			IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
				--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
				--RAISERROR('A valid shift information cannot be determined using the supplied shift start time.{138}',16,1)
				SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

			/*--Determine whether the hour_start is later than the shift start time
			IF (@hour_start_local < DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @shift_start_local), 0)) BEGIN
				--The production hour must be within the shift.
				SET @err_msg = 'The supplied hour start time (local):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_local, 120) + ' cannnot be earlier than the shift start time (local):' +  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_local, 120) + '.{137},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_local, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_local, 120)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg,16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			--Determine whether the hour start is within the shift boundary
			IF @shift_start_utc <> CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120)
			  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND sh.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
					  AND @hour_start_utc >= DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, sh.shift_start_utc), 0)
					  AND (@hour_start_utc < sh.shift_end_utc OR sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL)) BEGIN
				--The production hour must be within the shift.
				SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
				SET @err_msg = 'The supplied hour start time (utc):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_utc, 120) + ' is not within the shift boundary for the shift start time (utc):' +  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_utc, 120) + ' for the entity:' + @ent_name + '.{139},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_utc, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_utc, 120) + ',' + @ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg,16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END*/

			--Default the created_at_utc to the hour start
			SELECT @production_time_utc = @hour_start_utc
		END

		--Shift start is supplied, but there is no hour start
		ELSE IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL AND @hour_start_local IS NULL) BEGIN

			SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

			--Verify whether this is a valid shift start
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND shift_start_utc =
			     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
				FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
				--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
				  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_utc)

			IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
				--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
				SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

			--Determine the hour start bucket
			SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @shift_start_utc), 0)

			--Determine the local times
			SET @hour_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_start_utc)

			--Default the created_at_utc to the shift start
			SET @production_time_utc = @shift_start_utc

		END

		--Shift start is not supplied, but the hour start is supplied
		ELSE IF (@shift_start_local IS NULL AND @hour_start_local IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			--Determine the hour start UTC time
			SET @hour_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @hour_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

			--Determine the shift that started before the hour start
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND shift_start_utc =
			     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
				FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
				--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
				  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @hour_start_utc)

			IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
				--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
				SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

			--Determine the hour start bucket
			SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @hour_start_utc), 0)

			--Default the created_at_utc to the shift start
			SET @production_time_utc = @hour_start_utc
		END

		--Determine whether the existing created at utc fall under the same hour; if yes, default to the existing created at utc
		IF DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @cur_created_at_utc), 0) = @hour_start_utc
			SELECT @production_time_utc = @cur_created_at_utc
				, @created_at_utc = @cur_created_at_utc

		--Determine whether this job was started in this hour.
		--If yes, default the created at time to the job start time
		SELECT @job_start_utc = MAX(jh.job_start_utc)
		FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jh.job_start_utc >= @hour_start_utc
		  AND jh.job_start_utc < DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc)

		--If job start time is not null, then the job started in this hour
		IF (@job_start_utc IS NOT NULL)
			--Default the production time and the created at time to be the job start time
			SELECT @production_time_utc = @job_start_utc
				, @created_at_utc = @job_start_utc
	   END

	--Reset the job_start_utc
	SET @job_start_utc = NULL

	--The production time (created at) is not supplied, but the code defaulted to the hour start/shift start which ever is later.
	--Verify whether this job ran during this hour; if not raise an error
	--If the job was started in this hour, use the last job start to record the production
	SELECT @job_start_utc = MAX(jh.job_start_utc)
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND @production_time_utc BETWEEN jh.job_start_utc AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())

	IF (@job_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The production time is NOT within the duration of the job (start and end).
		SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
		SET @err_msg = 'The supplied job (wo_id:' + @wo_id + ', oper_id:' + @oper_id + ', seq_no:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) + ') was not running on the entity:' + @ent_name + ' during the specified production time (in UTC):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @production_time_utc, 120) + '.{140},' + @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @production_time_utc, 120)
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	--The production time is within the duration of the job runtime.

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, @client_type OUTPUT

	-- adjust this to be entity_local for passing to child SP's
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc(@ent_id,NULL)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Item_Prod', @src_key='GetDateInfo', @date_val1 = @shift_start_local,@date_val2 = @shift_start_utc
	if (@dbg_resp=1) return 1;

	SET @byproduct = COALESCE(@byproduct, 0)

	--below condition is added by Nagaraju on 08-12-2002
	--if item id is null the assumption is bom pos 0 item
	IF @item_id IS NULL SET @byproduct =0

	-- Read default values from job_bom table to apply if not included ( include update_inv and backflush flags )
	IF @byproduct = 0
		SELECT	@cur_bom_pos = bom_pos, @update_inv = update_inv, @backflush = backflush
			,	@max_qty_per_parent_item = max_qty_per_parent_item, @min_qty_per_parent_item = min_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty = constant_qty
			,	@def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
		FROM  job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
	ELSE
		SELECT	@cur_bom_pos = bom_pos, @update_inv = update_inv, @backflush = backflush
			,	@max_qty_per_parent_item = max_qty_per_parent_item, @min_qty_per_parent_item = min_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty = constant_qty
			,	@def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
		FROM  job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id

	-- read current qty_prod value for it
	SET @cur_qty_prod = NULL

	SELECT	@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no, @cur_qty_prod = qty_prod
		,	@cur_shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @cur_shift_start_local = shift_start_local
		,	@cur_ent_id = ent_id, @cur_item_id = item_id, @cur_lot_no = lot_no, @cur_sublot_no = sublot_no
		,	@cur_to_ent_id = to_ent_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd, @cur_reas_cd = reas_cd
		,	@cur_user_id = user_id, @cur_segment_requirement_id = segment_requirement_id, @cur_segment_response_id = segment_response_id
		,	@cur_created_at_utc = created_at_utc
	FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE row_id = @row_id

	SET @created_at_utc = COALESCE(@created_at_utc, @production_time_utc, @hour_start_utc)
	SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)

	--Get all the flags for the current existing produced item
	SELECT  @cur_update_inv = update_inv, @cur_must_consume_from_inv = must_consume_from_inv
		,	@cur_must_consume_from_wip = must_consume_from_wip, @cur_def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
	FROM  job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @cur_wo_id AND oper_id = @cur_oper_id AND seq_no = @cur_seq_no AND item_id = @cur_item_id

	SET @qty_difference = @qty_prod - @cur_qty_prod

	-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get good_prod flag
	SELECT 	@grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @status_cd = item_status_cd
	FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd

	IF @grade_cd IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- reas_cd is defined, grade and status loaded - now get good_prod flag
		SELECT @good_prod = good_prod
		FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @good_prod IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid good_prod flag{3283}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified reason code:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @reas_cd), 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},reason code:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @reas_cd), 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified item ID:' + COALESCE(@item_id, 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},item ID:' + COALESCE(@item_id, 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	-- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
	IF @must_consume_before_prod = 1  BEGIN
		EXECUTE @return = sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no,  @item_id, @qty_difference
		IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--If update_inventory flag is set to true, and if the supplied to_ent_id IS NULL, then default from 'job_bom'
		--If job_bom.default storage ent_id is null, then get the storage entity from job_exec for the running entity.
		IF (@update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			SET @to_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id
			IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) SELECT TOP 1 @to_ent_id = def_to_ent_id FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND def_to_ent_id IS NOT NULL
		END
	END

	IF (@cur_to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--If update_inventory flag is set to true, and if the current to_ent_id IS NULL, then default from 'job_bom'
		--If job_bom.default storage ent_id is null, then get the storage entity from job_exec for the running entity.
		IF (@cur_update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			SET @cur_to_ent_id = @cur_def_storage_ent_id
			IF (@cur_to_ent_id IS NULL) SELECT TOP 1 @cur_to_ent_id = def_to_ent_id FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @cur_ent_id AND def_to_ent_id IS NOT NULL
		END
	END

	--Verify whether we can identify a valid storage entity
	IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The storage entity is not identified here.
		--Verify whether we can default the storage entity from job_exec.
		IF (@good_prod = 1)
			--Since this is a good production; retrieve the default storage entity that is configured for the good production.
			SELECT TOP 1 @to_ent_id = def_to_ent_id FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		ELSE
			--Since this is a reject; retrieve the default storage entity that is configured for the rejects.
			SELECT TOP 1 @def_reject_ent_id = def_reject_ent_id FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @to_ent_id
		,@qty_difference OUTPUT, @cur_int_qty OUTPUT, @good_prod_num_decimals OUTPUT

	SELECT @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0), @cur_int_qty = ISNULL(@cur_int_qty, 0)

	IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty = 0) BEGIN
		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty != 0) SET @curr_qty = @cur_int_qty
		ELSE SET @curr_qty = @qty_difference

		--call the backflush sp
		IF @byproduct = 0
		BEGIN
			EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @ent_id, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local,  @shift_start_tz OUTPUT
			EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlshPstExec NULL, @user_id, @ent_id, @curr_qty, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
						,@shift_start_local,@hour_start_local,@shift_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @shift_start_tz
			--print 'the return value =' + convert(varchar,@return)
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END

	--Added by Raghu. Truncate the milliseconds for Shift_Start (@shift_start param)
	IF @cur_qty_prod IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		-- Row DOES already exist
		IF @qty_prod = 0 BEGIN
			-- DELETE THE ROW
			DELETE item_prod
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			--Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
			EXEC sp_U_Assigned_Lot_UpdateStatus @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no,
					@wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @total_qty_prod=0

			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Prod%'
		END

		ELSE BEGIN
			-- UPDATE THE ROW
			UPDATE item_prod
			SET shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc,
				shift_start_local = @shift_start_local, -- Added 07/26/2007 AML
                hour_start_utc  = @hour_start_utc,
                hour_start_local = @hour_start_local,
			    item_id = @item_id,
			    lot_no = @lot_no,
				rm_lot_no = @rm_lot_no,
				sublot_no = @sublot_no,
				rm_sublot_no = @rm_sublot_no,
			    reas_cd = @reas_cd,
			    user_id = @user_id,
			    --ent_id = @ent_id,
			    shift_id = @shift_id,
			    grade_cd = @grade_cd,
			    status_cd = @status_cd,
			    to_ent_id = @to_ent_id,
			    good_prod = @good_prod,
			    qty_prod = @qty_prod,
			    qty_prod_erp = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(@client_type, 0) = 54) THEN qty_prod_erp ELSE COALESCE(@qty_prod_erp,qty_prod_erp) END,
			    processed_flag = @processed_flag,
			    byproduct = @byproduct,
			    ext_ref = @ext_ref,
--			    last_edit_at = @last_edit_at,
			    move_status = @move_status,
			    genealogy_id = @genealogy_id,
			    event_id = @event_id,
			    segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id,
			    segment_response_id = @segment_response_id,
			    comments = @comments, -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
			    spare1 = @spare1,
			    spare2 = @spare2,
			    spare3 = @spare3,
			    spare4 = @spare4,
			    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment,
				created_at_utc = @created_at_utc,
				created_at_local = @created_at_local
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			-- Return error if this was not successful
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('SQL Error updating item_prod table{3284}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			IF (@byproduct = 0) BEGIN
				EXECUTE sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no

				-- Update the job_hour_history if needed
				EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @event_time_utc=@cur_created_at_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment2

				--Determine whether the hour bucket for the existing row and the modified row are the same.
				--If the hour buckets are different, then a quantity may be reduced from a different hour and added to another hour.
				--Therefore, the quantities may need to be addressed twice to update different hour buckets.
				IF DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @cur_created_at_utc), 0) <> DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @created_at_utc), 0)
					EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @event_time_utc=@created_at_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment2
			END

			--Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
			EXEC sp_U_Assigned_Lot_UpdateStatus @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @wo_id=@wo_id,
				@oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @total_qty_prod=@qty_prod

			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 232
			IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
				-- Added for CR L00108351 - RWB 11/18/2010
				--Log job_event ONLY if there are any changes in the item_cons record
				IF  NOT ((@cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND @cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @wo_id IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND @cur_oper_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_seq_no = @seq_no AND @cur_seq_no IS NOT NULL AND @seq_no IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_ent_id = @ent_id AND @cur_ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @ent_id IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_ent_id IS NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_lot_no = @lot_no AND @cur_lot_no IS NOT NULL AND @lot_no IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_sublot_no = @lot_no AND @cur_sublot_no IS NOT NULL AND @sublot_no IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_item_id = @item_id AND @cur_item_id IS NOT NULL AND @item_id IS NOT NULL OR (@cur_item_id IS NULL AND @item_id IS NULL))
					AND (@cur_user_id = @user_id)) BEGIN
				-- End Addition for CR L00108351 - RWB 11/18/2010
					INSERT INTO job_event
					(
						event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id,
						done_by_user_id, source_row_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
					)
					VALUES
					(
						@last_edit_at, DATEADD( mi, dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc(@ent_id, @last_edit_at), @last_edit_at ), @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'EditProd',
						@ent_id, @cur_bom_pos, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_prod, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
					)
				-- Added for CR L00108351 - RWB 11/18/2010
				END
				-- End Addtion for CR L00108351 - RWB 11/18/2010
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified item_prod row_id:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @row_id), 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},item_prod row_id:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @row_id), 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SET @cur_uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @cur_item_id)

	--Check if there any storage location changes during this update
	IF (@to_ent_id = @cur_to_ent_id OR (@to_ent_id IS NULL AND @cur_to_ent_id IS NULL))
		AND (@item_id = @cur_item_id)
		AND (@lot_no = @cur_lot_no OR (@lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_lot_no IS NULL))
		AND (@sublot_no = @cur_sublot_no OR (@sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_sublot_no IS NULL))
		AND (@wo_id = @cur_wo_id OR (@wo_id IS NULL AND @cur_wo_id IS NULL))
		AND (@oper_id = @cur_oper_id OR (@oper_id IS NULL AND @cur_oper_id IS NULL))
		AND (@seq_no = @cur_seq_no OR (@seq_no IS NULL AND @cur_seq_no IS NULL)) BEGIN

		--Storage locations appears to be same. Update inventory only if the bom item flag is set to true.
		IF (@update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Requires entity to be specified in order to update inventory.{3505}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty = 0) BEGIN
				IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty != 0) SET @curr_qty = @cur_int_qty
				ELSE SET @curr_qty = @qty_difference

				IF @curr_qty <> 0  BEGIN
					SET @expiry_date = Null

					IF @curr_qty > 0 SELECT @temp_wo_id = @wo_id, @temp_oper_id = @oper_id, @temp_seq_no = @seq_no
					ELSE SELECT @temp_wo_id = NULL, @temp_oper_id = NULL, @temp_seq_no = NULL

					IF @curr_qty > 0
						EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @grade_cd=@grade_cd
							, @status_cd=@status_cd, @add_qty=@curr_qty, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=NULL, @expiry_date=@expiry_date
							, @wo_id=@temp_wo_id, @oper_id=@temp_oper_id, @seq_no=@temp_seq_no, @from_ent_id=NULL, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id
							, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL
							, @goods_received=0, @checkgradestatus=0, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
							, @date_in_utc=NULL, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id OUTPUT
					ELSE BEGIN
						SET @curr_qty_temp = @curr_qty * -1
						EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@curr_qty_temp, @reduce_qty_erp=0
								, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@cur_grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@cur_status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@cur_reas_cd
								, @must_consume_from_inv=@cur_must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no
								, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
					END
					IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
				END
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--Storage entity or item or lot selected is now different than the currently consumed item.
		--If the original production is recorded in the inventory, then put back all the quantities that
		--are produced to the original location.
		IF (@cur_update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			--If the previous production record does not have a storage location,
			--then Ignore reducing the qtys from the old location.
			IF (@cur_to_ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
				SET @old_qty_difference = @cur_qty_prod
				EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis @cur_item_id, @cur_lot_no, @cur_sublot_no, @cur_to_ent_id
					,@old_qty_difference OUTPUT, @old_cur_int_qty OUTPUT, @old_good_prod_num_decimals OUTPUT

				SELECT @old_good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@old_good_prod_num_decimals, 0), @old_cur_int_qty = ISNULL(@old_cur_int_qty, 0)

				IF NOT (@old_good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @old_cur_int_qty = 0) BEGIN
					IF (@old_good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @old_cur_int_qty != 0) SET @curr_qty = @old_cur_int_qty
					ELSE SET @curr_qty = @old_qty_difference
					EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@cur_to_ent_id, @item_id=@cur_item_id, @lot_no=@cur_lot_no, @sublot_no=@cur_sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@curr_qty, @reduce_qty_erp=0
							, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@cur_grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@cur_status_cd, @item_reas_cd=@cur_reas_cd
							, @must_consume_from_inv=@cur_must_consume_from_inv, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=@cur_wo_id, @oper_id=@cur_oper_id, @seq_no=@cur_seq_no
							, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
					IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1

				END
			END
		END

		--Check if the current update can store items in the inventory. If yes, reduce the qtys from the inventory.
		IF (@update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Requires entity to be specified in order to update inventory.{3505}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @to_ent_id
				,@qty_prod OUTPUT, @cur_int_qty OUTPUT, @good_prod_num_decimals OUTPUT

			SELECT @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0), @cur_int_qty = ISNULL(@cur_int_qty, 0)

			IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty = 0) BEGIN
				IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty != 0) SET @curr_qty = @cur_int_qty
				ELSE SET @curr_qty = @qty_prod

				IF @curr_qty <> 0  BEGIN
					SET @expiry_date = Null

					IF @curr_qty > 0 SELECT @temp_wo_id = @wo_id, @temp_oper_id = @oper_id, @temp_seq_no = @seq_no
					ELSE SELECT @temp_wo_id = NULL, @temp_oper_id = NULL, @temp_seq_no = NULL

					EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no
						, @grade_cd=@grade_cd, @status_cd=@status_cd, @add_qty=@curr_qty, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=NULL
						, @expiry_date=@expiry_date, @wo_id=@temp_wo_id, @oper_id=@temp_oper_id, @seq_no=@temp_seq_no, @from_ent_id=NULL
						, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL
						, @goods_received=0, @checkgradestatus=0, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
						, @date_in_utc=NULL, @expiry_date=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id OUTPUT
					IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
				END
			END
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ResourceOverlap]
(
@scheduleday datetime
)
AS
BEGIN




update SDB.SCH.res_planned_availability set comment = null
 where cast(start_time as date) = @scheduleday  
 OR cast(end_time as date) = @scheduleday
 

 
;with RR_Overlap as (
SELECT DISTINCT Table1.res_id res_id, Table1.ent_id ent_id, table1.row_id updateRowId , table2.row_id concatRowId 
FROM SDB.SCH.res_planned_availability table1, SDB.SCH.res_planned_availability table2 
WHERE table2.start_time < table1.end_time 
AND table2.end_time > table1.start_time 
AND table1.res_id = table2.res_id and table1.row_id <> table2.row_id
AND (cast(table1.start_time as date) = @scheduleday OR cast(table1.end_time as date) = @scheduleday)
AND (cast(table2.start_time as date) = @scheduleday OR cast(table2.end_time as date) = @scheduleday)
)

UPDATE RPA
SET RPA.COMMENT = 'Overlap'
FROM
SDB.SCH.res_planned_availability RPA
INNER JOIN RR_Overlap RR ON RPA.row_id = RR.updateRowId




END

AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_shift_sched_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on shift_sched table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--03/05/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00075055; On change of shift got "No Shift" despit...
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
			,@ent_id		INT32
			,@start_day		INT32
			,@shift_id		INT32
			,@start_time	DATETIME
			,@end_time		DATETIME
			,@days_ahead	INT32
			,@v_current_time	DATETIME
			--,@use_gmt		INT32

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--EXEC SP_SA_SYSTEM_ATTR_USEGMT @use_gmt=@use_gmt

	SET @v_current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	DECLARE shift_sched_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT i.ent_id, i.start_day, i.shift_id, i.start_time, i.end_time
	FROM inserted i

	OPEN shift_sched_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_sched_cursor into @ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id, @start_time, @end_time
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SET @start_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @v_current_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @start_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		SET @end_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @v_current_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
		SET @days_ahead = DATEDIFF(D, @start_time, @end_time)
		SELECT @start_time = @start_time -1, @days_ahead = @days_ahead + 4
		--Call the refresh shift sched procedure to populate all template shifts for an entity.
		EXEC SP_U_ENT_SCHEDULESHIFTS @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_start_time=@start_time
			, @in_days_ahead=@days_ahead, @in_time_zone_bias_value=0
	END
	CLOSE shift_sched_cursor
	DEALLOCATE shift_sched_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Wo]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Wo
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version                  -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver	Changes
-- 09/20/2002	Raghu		1.4	Disallow deletes for a certified process
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleteAll for SCC
-- 10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 01/15/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8314, part of DB changes - delete related assigned_lot records with wo
--04/26/2007    Raghu      3.2.10   HD# 8314, Cascade delete assigned_lots associated to this WO
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @JobState char
DECLARE @Deletable bit
DECLARE @disallow_deletes	int
DECLARE @process_id		nvarchar(40)
DECLARE  @process_status	int
-- First delete all relevant rows in job table as cascade delete cannot be defined to do this
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

/*SELECT @JobState = state_cd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and state_cd = 3
IF @JobState = 3
BEGIN
  RAISERROR ('The work order cannot be deleted because a job associated with this work order is running.', 16, 1)
  RETURN -1
END
*/
IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND state_cd = 3) BEGIN
	RAISERROR ('This work order cannot be deleted because a job associated to this work order is currently running.{4716}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
END

SELECT @disallow_deletes = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 200
IF @disallow_deletes = 1 BEGIN
	IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @process_id = process_id FROM WO WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		SELECT @process_status = process_status FROM PROCESS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id
		IF (@process_status = 3) BEGIN
			UPDATE wo SET not_deletable = 1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE wo SET not_deletable = 1 WHERE process_id IN (SELECT process_id FROM process WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_status = 3)
	END
END

-- Delete assigned_lot records - added 1/15/07 KRF
DELETE assigned_lot
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
     AND (wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE not_deletable = 0))

-- Call Delete Job SP as it also has cascade deletes to perform
-- First delete job_routes as job delete cannot cascade delete to all affected job_routes
DELETE job_route
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
     AND (wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE not_deletable = 0))

DELETE job  WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
     AND (wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE not_deletable = 0))
-- Other table rows will be deleted by the DBMS cascade delete
-- Ensure that @numrows affected is set correctly
--SET NOCOUNT OFF

-- Finally delete the row in the wo table
DELETE wo
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
AND  (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
AND (wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE not_deletable = 0))

-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Item_Prod
-- Description	      - Retrieve production records based on the supplied filters
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 10/30/2002		Sheetal Jain 	1.3.0	Include NOLOCK hint in the query
-- 10/21/2004		Raghu			2.1.5	HD# 4979, Included uom, lifetime fields in the Select clause
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 12/01/2005		Raghu			3.1.4	Shift Start column should return as shift_start
-- 01/23/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 03/07/2007		Raghu			3.2.3   Added item.serial_no_lvl as serial_no_lvl_h to the return recordset.
-- 07/24/2007		Raghu			3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change shift_start with *_utc and *_local.
-- 09/11/2007		AML				3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu			4.0		DB Changes
-- 11/28/2009		Kishore			4.1		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
-- 13/3/2012		siddu			4.0Sp2  OEE Changes are included from 3.5patch2
-- 19/4/2013		Tentu			5.3		US#594199, Changed the select query to dynamic query to imporove the performance.
-- 03/02/2017		Raghu			5.3		US# 775480 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00144330: [L10N][DE] There is an Error dialog when enter Production tab in Operator
-- 07/11/2018		Surya			6.0		US#1047941 - As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00149494 (HF CR L00148797: SR 48912088: Item_prod and Item_cons queries validate the "user_id" parameter passed and will not return all requested rows)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @created_at_utc		DATETIME
		,	@shift_start_utc	DATETIME
		,	@tz_temp			INT
		,   @dbg_resp			INT32
		,   @hour_start_utc     DATETIME ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
  		,	@sSQL					NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,	@whereClause			NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,	@ParmDefinition			NVARCHAR(MAX)


	SET @shift_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_tz)
	SET @hour_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@hour_start_tz)
	SET @created_at_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_tz)

    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Item_Prod', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @shift_start_local, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @created_at_local, @numeric_val2 = @created_at_tz


	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_tz

	IF @shift_start_local IS NOT NULL BEGIN
		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT
	END

	SET @tz_temp = -@created_at_tz
	 EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_local, @tz_temp, @created_at_utc OUTPUT
    SET @tz_temp = -@hour_start_tz
    EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @hour_start_local, @tz_temp, @hour_start_utc OUTPUT---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )

	SET @sSQL = 'SELECT	item_prod.row_id, item_prod.wo_id, item_prod.oper_id, item_prod.seq_no
        ,	item_prod.shift_start_utc, item_prod.shift_start_local
        ,	DATEADD(mi, ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), @shift_start_tz) + ', item_prod.shift_start_utc) AS shift_start
        ,   item_prod.hour_start_utc, item_prod.hour_start_local
        ,   DATEADD(mi, ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), @hour_start_tz) + ', item_prod.hour_start_utc) AS hour_start
        ,	item_prod.item_id, item_prod.lot_no, item_prod.rm_lot_no, item_prod.sublot_no, item_prod.rm_sublot_no, item_prod.reas_cd, item_prod.user_id
		,   user_name.user_desc, item.item_desc, item.uom_id, item.serial_no_lvl AS serial_no_lvl_h
		,   uom.description, uom.abbreviation, item.lifetime, item_reas.reas_desc, item_prod.ent_id
		,   ent.ent_name, item_prod.shift_id, shift.shift_desc, item_prod.grade_cd, item_grade.item_grade_desc
		,   item_grade.color item_grade_color, item_prod.status_cd, item_state.item_status_desc, item_state.color item_state_color, item_prod.to_ent_id
		,	ent1.ent_name as to_ent_name, item_prod.good_prod, item_prod.qty_prod, item_prod.qty_prod_erp, item_prod.processed_flag, item_prod.byproduct
        ,   item_prod.ext_ref, item_prod.move_status, item_prod.genealogy_id, item_prod.event_id, item_prod.segment_requirement_id, item_prod.segment_response_id
        ,   item_prod.comments
		,   item_prod.spare1, item_prod.spare2, item_prod.spare3, item_prod.spare4, item.spare1 item_spare1, item.spare2 item_spare2, item.spare3 item_spare3, item.spare4 item_spare4
		,   item_prod.last_edit_comment, item_prod.last_edit_by, item_prod.last_edit_at, item_prod.created_at_utc, item_prod.created_at_local
		,	DATEADD(mi, ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), @created_at_tz) + ', item_prod.created_at_utc) AS created_at
		FROM item_prod item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.ent_id = ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent ent1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.to_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
		INNER JOIN shift shift WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.shift_id = shift.shift_id
		INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.item_id = item.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_reas item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.reas_cd = item_reas.reas_cd
		INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
		INNER JOIN item_state item_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name user_name WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_prod.user_id = user_name.user_id
		INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		WHERE 1 = 1 '

	  SET @whereClause = ''

      IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.row_id = @row_id'
      IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.wo_id = @wo_id'
      IF (@oper_id IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.oper_id = @oper_id'
      IF (@seq_no IS NOT NULL) 			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.seq_no =  @seq_no'
      IF (@shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc'
      IF (@hour_start_utc IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc'
      IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.item_id = @item_id'
      IF (@lot_no IS NOT NULL)    	    SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.lot_no = @lot_no'
      IF (@rm_lot_no IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.rm_lot_no = @rm_lot_no'
      IF (@sublot_no IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.sublot_no = @sublot_no'
      IF (@rm_sublot_no IS NOT NULL)    SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.rm_sublot_no = @rm_sublot_no'
      IF (@reas_cd IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.reas_cd = @reas_cd'
      IF (@user_id IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.user_id = @user_id'
      IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.ent_id = @ent_id'
      IF (@shift_id IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.shift_id = @shift_id'
      IF (@grade_cd IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.grade_cd = @grade_cd'
      IF (@status_cd IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.status_cd = @status_cd'
      IF (@to_ent_id IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.to_ent_id = @to_ent_id'
      IF (@good_prod IS NOT NULL)		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.good_prod = @good_prod'
      IF (@processed_flag IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.processed_flag=@processed_flag'
      IF (@byproduct IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.byproduct = @byproduct'
      IF (@ext_ref IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.ext_ref = @ext_ref'
      IF (@move_status IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.move_status=@move_status'
      IF (@genealogy_id IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.genealogy_id = @genealogy_id'
      IF (@event_id IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.event_id = @event_id'
      IF (@segment_requirement_id IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id'
      IF (@segment_response_id IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id'
      IF (@comments IS NOT NULL) 		SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.comments = @comments'
      IF (@spare1 IS NOT NULL) 			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.spare1 = @spare1'
      IF (@spare2 IS NOT NULL)			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.spare2 = @spare2'
      IF (@spare3 IS NOT NULL) 			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.spare3 = @spare3'
      IF (@spare4 IS NOT NULL) 			SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.spare4 = @spare4'
      IF (@last_edit_by IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by'
	  IF (@last_edit_at IS NOT NULL) 	SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.last_edit_at>=@last_edit_at'
      IF (@created_at_utc IS NOT NULL)  SET @whereClause = @whereClause + ' AND item_prod.created_at_utc>=@created_at_utc'

	  SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @whereClause + ' ORDER BY item.item_desc'

	 SET @ParmDefinition = '@row_id INT32,	@wo_id 	STRING40, @oper_id STRING40, @seq_no INT32, @shift_start_utc DATETIME, @hour_start_utc DATETIME'
	 SET @ParmDefinition = @ParmDefinition + ', @item_id STRING80, @lot_no STRING80, @rm_lot_no STRING80, @sublot_no STRING80, @rm_sublot_no  STRING80'
	 SET @ParmDefinition = @ParmDefinition + ', @reas_cd INT32, @user_id STRING40, @ent_id INT32, @shift_id INT32, @grade_cd INT32, @status_cd INT32, @to_ent_id INT32'
	 SET @ParmDefinition = @ParmDefinition + ', @good_prod LOGICAL, @processed_flag LOGICAL, @byproduct LOGICAL, @ext_ref STRING40, @move_status  INT32, @genealogy_id STRING254'
	 SET @ParmDefinition = @ParmDefinition + ', @event_id STRING80, @segment_requirement_id	STRING80, @segment_response_id	STRING80, @comments	STRING254, @spare1 STRING80'
	 SET @ParmDefinition = @ParmDefinition + ', @spare2 STRING80, @spare3 STRING80, @spare4 STRING80, @last_edit_by  STRING40, @last_edit_at  TDATETIME, @created_at_utc DATETIME'

	 EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL,@ParmDefinition,
	 @row_id = @row_id,	@wo_id 	= @wo_id, @oper_id = @oper_id, @seq_no = @seq_no, @shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc, @hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc
	 , @item_id = @item_id, @lot_no = @lot_no, @rm_lot_no = @rm_lot_no, @sublot_no = @sublot_no, @rm_sublot_no  =@rm_sublot_no
	 , @reas_cd = @reas_cd, @user_id = @user_id, @ent_id = @ent_id, @shift_id = @shift_id, @grade_cd = @grade_cd, @status_cd = @status_cd, @to_ent_id = @to_ent_id
	 , @good_prod = @good_prod, @processed_flag = @processed_flag, @byproduct = @byproduct, @ext_ref = @ext_ref, @move_status  = @move_status, @genealogy_id = @genealogy_id
	 , @event_id = @event_id, @segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id = @segment_response_id, @comments	= @comments, @spare1 = @spare1
	 , @spare2 = @spare2, @spare3 = @spare3, @spare4 = @spare4, @last_edit_by  = @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at  = @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc = @created_at_utc
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_reas_grp_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[item_reas_grp]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_reas_grp_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_reas_grp table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE item_reas_grp SET item_reas_grp.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_reas_grp.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE item_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = i.reas_grp_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Ent_Link]
(
	@grp_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Ent_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version			Changes
-- 09/26/2005		Raghu			3.1.0			Part of DB Changes
-- 07/05/2007		AML				3.2.0			Ported to Sql Server 2000
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    SELECT	data_log_grp_ent_link.grp_id
		,	data_log_grp.grp_desc
		,	data_log_grp_ent_link.ent_id
		,	ent.ent_name
		,	data_log_grp.max_value
		,	data_log_grp_ent_link.last_edit_comment
		,	data_log_grp_ent_link.last_edit_by
		,	data_log_grp_ent_link.last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON data_log_grp_ent_link.grp_id = data_log_grp.grp_id
		INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON data_log_grp_ent_link.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	WHERE (
			(data_log_grp_ent_link.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp_ent_link.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp_ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(data_log_grp_ent_link.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
		  )
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name
END
