CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStartQtyOfItemInWO]
(@in_wo_id			STRING80
,@in_item_id		STRING80
,@in_oper_id		STRING80 = NULL
,@start_qty			INT32 OUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - sp_getStartQtyOfItemInWO
-- Description          - Get start quantity from a work order.
-- Author                   - Kishore
-- Date Created          -
-- Version          - 3.2.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver   Changes
--04/17/2007    Raghu           3.2.8   Hard coded values are removed.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @final_item_id		STRING80
		,@final_item_qty	TFLOAT
		,@l_wo_id			STRING80
		,@l_item_id			STRING80
		,@l_oper_id			STRING80
		,@totalQty			TFLOAT

		,@currOperId		STRING80
		,@currItemId		STRING80
		,@parentItemId		STRING80
		,@currQty			TFLOAT
		,@runningQty		TFLOAT
		,@qtyAtStart		TFLOAT
		,@parentQtyAtStart	TFLOAT

BEGIN
	SELECT @l_wo_id = @in_wo_id, @l_item_id = @in_item_id, @l_oper_id = @in_oper_id

	-- Get Final Item ID
	--select item_id into final_item_id from wo where wo_id = 'test1'; -- change here later
	SELECT @final_item_id = item_id
	FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @l_wo_id -- change here later

	-- Get Final Item Quantity
	SELECT @final_item_qty = SUM(qty_at_start)
	FROM job jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jb.item_id = @final_item_id
	  AND jb.wo_id = @l_wo_id
	  AND jb.final_job =1

	IF (@in_item_id = @final_item_id) BEGIN
		SET @start_qty = @final_item_qty
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@l_oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		-- get Qty per Parent Item
		SELECT @qtyatstart = SUM(jb.qty_per_parent_item)
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @l_wo_id
		  AND jb.bom_pos > 0
		  AND jb.item_id = @l_item_id
		  AND jb.oper_id = @l_oper_id

		 -- get Parent Item
		SELECT TOP 1 @parentitemid = item_id
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @l_wo_id
		  AND bom_pos = 0
		  AND oper_id = @l_oper_id

		-- Get qt_at_start for parent Items in the WO/oper
		SELECT @parentqtyatstart = SUM(qty_at_start)
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @l_wo_id
		  AND oper_id = @l_oper_id
		  AND item_id = @parentItemId

		-- multiply parentQty with qty_per_parent
		SET @start_qty = @parentQtyAtStart * @qtyAtStart

	END

	SET @totalQty = 0

	DECLARE cur_job_bom CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT jb.oper_id, SUM(qty_per_parent_item) AS start_qty
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @l_wo_id
	  AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	  AND jb.item_id =  @l_item_id
	GROUP BY jb.oper_id

	-- Open CURSOR
	OPEN cur_job_bom
	--Fetch from CURSOR
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur_job_bom INTO @currOperId, @qtyAtStart
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		-- We are looping thru every distinct operation where the item is a Component in the Bom

		-- get Parent ITEMID
		SELECT DISTINCT @parentItemId = item_id
		FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jb.wo_id = @l_wo_id AND jb.bom_pos = 0
		  AND jb.oper_id = @currOperId

		-- qty_per_parent item is available in qtyAtStart
		-- DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Parent Item is : ' || currItemId);
		-- get Parent Qty in the WO
		SELECT parentQtyAtStart = SUM(qty_at_start)
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @l_wo_id AND item_id = @parentItemId

		-- DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Parent Qty is : ' || parentQtyAtStart);
		SET @runningQty = @parentQtyAtStart * @qtyAtStart
		--DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Curr runningQty is : ' || runningQty);
		SET @totalQty = @totalQty + @runningQty

	END
	CLOSE cur_job_bom
	DEALLOCATE cur_job_bom

	SET @start_qty = @totalQty
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed] (
  @wo_id		STRING40
, @oper_id		STRING40
, @seq_no		INT32 = NULL
--, @lot_no		STRING40 = NULL
, @item_id		STRING40 = NULL
, @cur_qty_prod		TFLOAT
, @bStopJob		LOGICAL = 0  -- flag use to identify the sp is called from stop job or not.
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed
-- Description    -	Check Max/Min Qty while Production
-- Author	      - Rohit Pandya
-- Date Created   - 12/20/02
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/20/2002	Rohit		1.5.2	min/max qty is checked based on item cons qty.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/30/2003    Sheetal Jain  	1.5.3 	Item consumption checked against min qty
-- 04/28/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Changed Where clause while summing up @pre_qty_prod. changed lot_no = @lot_no to (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
--					Lot No may be passed as NULL and if lot_no is NULL and include the check with @lot_no IS NULL to give correct @pre_qty_prod
--04/30/2003	Raghu		1.6.0	Error Message Text changed. 3269 to 3771
--05/05/2003	Raghu		1.6.4	Removed Lot_No as Total Consumption should be check for the job, not for the individual lot
--05/07/2003	Raghu		1.6.4	Ignored qty_rejected in summing up with total production in job table
--07/30/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	(HD# 1001) Handle substitute items while checking consumption quantities
--09/17/2007	Raghu		3.1.30	Deadlock Resolution for AARP. Added NoLock hint where possible.
--01/09/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073468; L00073706; Error while adding a production.
--01/05/2012	SaiTeja		4.2 CR118420
--03/13/2012	SaiTeja		4.2 CR119540 :Added Round function for @total_item_cons_qty inorder to complete the job with out any error.
-- 11/16/2016		Raghu		5.3		UserStory: 678824 - Changed LOCAL to FAST_FORWARD cursor
-- 08/02/2017	Raghu		6.0	UserStory:716502 - Renamed the cursor name
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

DECLARE  @qty_per_parent_item		TFLOAT
	,@max_qty_for_item		TFLOAT
	,@min_qty_for_item		TFLOAT
	,@cur_wo_id			STRING40
	,@cur_oper_id			STRING40
	,@job_qty_start			TFLOAT
	,@fg_lot_no			STRING40
	,@total_item_cons_qty		TFLOAT
	,@bom_item_id			STRING40
	,@must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL
	,@pre_qty_prod			TFLOAT
	,@constant_qty			LOGICAL
	,@bom_pos			INT
	,@num_decimals    INT  -- Fix for L00117931

-- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
IF @bStopJob = 0
	--  SELECT @pre_qty_prod = isnull(sum(isnull(qty_prod,0)),0) FROM item_prod
	 SELECT @pre_qty_prod = SUM(ISNULL(qty_prod, 0)) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		AND  item_id = @item_id AND good_prod = 1 --AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
ELSE
  	SELECT @pre_qty_prod = ISNULL(qty_prod,0) FROM job  WITH (NOLOCK) --+ ISNULL(qty_rejected,0) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

IF @pre_qty_prod IS NULL SET @pre_qty_prod = 0
IF @cur_qty_prod IS NULL SET @cur_qty_prod = 0

IF @bStopJob = 0
	DECLARE job_bom_cursor_check_min_max CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT bom_pos, ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item, 0), ISNULL(max_qty_per_parent_item,0) , ISNULL(min_qty_per_parent_item,0) , item_id, constant_qty
		FROM job_bom  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos > 0 AND must_consume_before_prod = 1
ELSE
	DECLARE job_bom_cursor_check_min_max CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT bom_pos, ISNULL(qty_per_parent_item, 0), ISNULL(max_qty_per_parent_item,0) , ISNULL(min_qty_per_parent_item,0) , item_id, constant_qty
		FROM job_bom  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos > 0

OPEN job_bom_cursor_check_min_max
WHILE (1=1)
BEGIN
	FETCH NEXT FROM job_bom_cursor_check_min_max INTO @bom_pos, @qty_per_parent_item, @max_qty_for_item, @min_qty_for_item,
					@bom_item_id, @constant_qty
	IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
	SET @total_item_cons_qty = 0
	--Get the total qty consumed from item_cons for the given item
/*	IF @constant_qty = 0 AND @bStopJob = 0
		IF @lot_no IS NULL
			SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(isnull(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @bom_item_id  AND item_scrapped = 0 --AND fg_lot_no IS NULL
		ELSE
			SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id
				AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @bom_item_id AND item_scrapped = 0 -- AND fg_lot_no = @lot_no
	ELSE
		SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
				AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @bom_item_id AND item_scrapped = 0
*/
	SET @total_item_cons_qty = 0

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom_subst  WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos) BEGIN

		SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = ISNULL(SUM(qc.qty_cons), 0) FROM (
			SELECT SUM(ic.qty_cons) / (AVG(jbst.qty_per_parent_item)/@qty_per_parent_item) qty_cons
			FROM job_bom_subst jbst  WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item_cons ic  WITH (NOLOCK) ON jbst.wo_id = ic.wo_id AND jbst.oper_id = ic.oper_id
			  AND jbst.seq_no = ic.seq_no AND jbst.item_id = ic.item_id
			WHERE jbst.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbst.oper_id= @oper_id AND jbst.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbst.bom_pos = @bom_pos
			  AND ic.item_scrapped = 0 GROUP BY jbst.item_id) qc
	END

	SELECT @total_item_cons_qty = @total_item_cons_qty + ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(qty_cons,0)),0) FROM item_cons  WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND item_id = @bom_item_id AND item_scrapped = 0

	IF @bStopJob = 0 BEGIN
		IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND ISNULL(@total_item_cons_qty,0) < @min_qty_for_item  BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Finished goods Lot No does not match with Production Lot OR Total consumed quantity is less than the minimum consumption quantity{3771}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE
			IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND (@total_item_cons_qty IS NULL OR @total_item_cons_qty =0)  BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Finished good Lot no does not match with Production Lot or No Consumption Entered{3269}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
		END
	END

	--print '@total_item_cons_qty = ' + convert(nvarchar,@total_item_cons_qty) +  'Current @pre_qty_prod = ' + convert(nvarchar,@pre_qty_prod) + 'max_qty_for_item = ' + convert(nvarchar,@max_qty_for_item)	+ + 'min_qty_for_item = ' + convert(nvarchar,@min_qty_for_item)
	--Added Round function for @total_item_cons_qty inorder to complete the job with out any error :Fix for CR119540.
	IF @constant_qty = 0  BEGIN
			SELECT @num_decimals = num_decimals FROM item  WITH (NOLOCK) where item_id = @bom_item_id -- Fix for L00117931, round the calculations below to the number of decimals places for item being consumed
	       IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF NOT (Round((( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @min_qty_for_item),@num_decimals) <= Round(@total_item_cons_qty,@num_decimals) AND  Round((( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @max_qty_for_item),@num_decimals) >= Round(@total_item_cons_qty,@num_decimals)) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			 END
		END
		ELSE IF @min_qty_for_item = 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF NOT Round((( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @max_qty_for_item),@num_decimals) >= Round(@total_item_cons_qty,@num_decimals) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			 END
		END
		ELSE IF @max_qty_for_item = 0 AND @min_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF NOT Round((( @cur_qty_prod + @pre_qty_prod) * @min_qty_for_item),@num_decimals) <= Round(@total_item_cons_qty,@num_decimals) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
		 	END
		END
	END	--constant qty = 0
	ELSE BEGIN	-- constaint qty = 1
		IF @min_qty_for_item <> 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			 IF  NOT (@min_qty_for_item <= @total_item_cons_qty AND   @max_qty_for_item >= @total_item_cons_qty) BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
		ELSE IF @min_qty_for_item = 0 AND @max_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			IF NOT  @max_qty_for_item >= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
		 	END
		END
		ELSE IF @max_qty_for_item = 0 AND @min_qty_for_item <> 0 BEGIN
			IF NOT  @min_qty_for_item <= @total_item_cons_qty BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('Qty consumed should be between max/min qty allowed{3270}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			  END
		END
	END -- constant qty = 1

END	-- End of BOM Item Cursor
CLOSE job_bom_cursor_check_min_max
DEALLOCATE job_bom_cursor_check_min_max
RETURN 0
END

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:    [Sp_U_ofi_Inv_Unique_SU_Production]
-- Description: Updates Unique Silo based on Unique item and grade configuration and production.
--
-- Usage:  in Unique Item SU job add production for OM and OMAR Silo.  Calling from WF.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  CK      2023-12-04      Initial version. 
-- 0.01.01  YG      2024-06-05      Add checking on the @auto_reclass_attr_value before blocking the quality
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_U_ofi_Su_reset_reclass] @ent_name_su nvarchar(100) = NULL,
@item_id nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@wo_id  nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@oper_id  nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@seq_no INT =NULL
AS
BEGIN     -- logic begin

  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @su_attr AS TABLE (
    attr_id int,
    attr_desc nvarchar(80),
    attr_value STRING1700_NULL
  )

  DECLARE @ent_id int
  DECLARE @siloType nvarchar(50) = NULL
  Declare @mes_item_id nvarchar(40) = NULL 

  DECLARE @lock_for_input nvarchar(50) = 'false'
  DECLARE @blk_for_quality_id int = 0
  DECLARE @blk_for_quality nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @def_grd_code int = 0
  DECLARE @def_grd_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @unq_item_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @auto_reclass_attr_value nvarchar(50) = 'false'

  DECLARE @prod_grade nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @prod_qty float = 0
  DECLARE @is_silo_block nvarchar(50) = 'false'
  DECLARE @error_code nvarchar(max) = NULL

  DECLARE @return_value_reclass int = 0
  DECLARE @row_id int = 0,
          @reclass_qty float = 0,
          @transfer_qty_erp float = 0,
          @edit_at TDATETIME = GETDATE(),
          @return_value int
 Declare @edit_comment nvarchar(100)=NULL
 Declare @su_aut_attr_id INT=0
  -- 2 IF start -logic of silo is presnt 
  IF (@ent_name_su IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN
  select @mes_item_id=mes_item_id from [dbo].[ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid] (@item_id,2);
	
	select @su_aut_attr_id=a.attr_id from attr a
	where a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'

	select @ent_id=ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea
	where ea.attr_id=@su_aut_attr_id and ea.attr_value=@ent_name_su

    
      -- 5 IF start-checking if Record is present in item prod for that silo(Production happened in that silo\ent or not)
      IF EXISTS (SELECT
          1
        FROM item_prod IP WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE IP.to_ent_id = @ent_id
		and ip.wo_id=@wo_id and ip.oper_id=@oper_id and ip.seq_no=@seq_no)
      BEGIN
        INSERT INTO @su_attr
          SELECT
            A.attr_id,
            A.attr_desc,
            EA.attr_value
          FROM ent_attr EA WITH (NOLOCK)
          INNER JOIN attr A WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON A.attr_id = EA.attr_id
          WHERE EA.ent_id = @ent_id
          AND A.attr_desc IN ('LockForInput', 'BlockForQuality', 'default_grade', 'unique_item_id', 'auto_reclassify')

        -- get all attribute values into variables
        --check lock for input       
        SELECT
          @lock_for_input = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'LockForInput'


        -- get blockforQuality value        
        SELECT
          @blk_for_quality_id = SA.attr_id,
          @blk_for_quality = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'


        -- get default grade value         
        SELECT
          @def_grd_attr_value = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'default_grade'


        -- get unique item value         
        SELECT
          @unq_item_attr_value = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'unique_item_id'


        -- get auto_reclassify value         
        SELECT
          @auto_reclass_attr_value = SA.attr_value
        FROM @su_attr SA
        WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify'


        -- get data from item_prod 
        SELECT TOP 1
          @prod_grade = ISNULL(IP.grade_cd, 0),
          @prod_qty = ISNULL(IP.qty_prod, 0)
        FROM item_prod IP WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE IP.to_ent_id = @ent_id
        AND IP.item_id = @mes_item_id
		and ip.wo_id=@wo_id and ip.oper_id=@oper_id and ip.seq_no=@seq_no
        ORDER BY IP.created_at_utc DESC

        SELECT
          @def_grd_code = IG.item_grade_cd
        FROM item_grade IG WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE IG.item_grade_desc = @def_grd_attr_value

        -- 6 IF Start- check type _OM
        IF (@def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @auto_reclass_attr_value = 'false')
        BEGIN
          -- 7 IF start
          IF ((@def_grd_code <> @prod_grade)
            OR (@unq_item_attr_value <> @mes_item_id)
            OR @blk_for_quality = 1)
          BEGIN
            SET @is_silo_block = 'true'
          END

        END--6 IF end-  check type _OM

        -- 8 IF Start- check type _OMAR
        ELSE
        IF (@def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
          AND @auto_reclass_attr_value = 'true')
        BEGIN
          -- 9 IF start
          IF (((@def_grd_code <> @prod_grade)
            OR (@unq_item_attr_value <> @mes_item_id)))
            --AND @blk_for_quality <> 1)
          BEGIN
            -- do reclassification 
            SELECT TOP 1
              @row_id = IV.row_id,
              @reclass_qty = IV.qty_left,
              @transfer_qty_erp = IV.qty_left_erp
            FROM item_inv IV WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE IV.item_id = @mes_item_id
            AND IV.ent_id = @ent_id
            ORDER BY IV.date_in_utc DESC

            EXEC @return_value_reclass = [dbo].[Sp_u_ofi_item_inv_move] @from_row_id = @row_id,
                                                                        @from_last_edit_at = @edit_at,
                                                                        @from_ent_id = @ent_id,
                                                                        @transfer_qty = @reclass_qty,
                                                                        @in_to_ent_id = @ent_id,
                                                                        @in_to_item_id = @unq_item_attr_value,
                                                                        @in_to_grade_cd = @def_grd_code,
                                                                        @transfer_option = 2,
                                                                        @transfer_comments = 'RECLASS',
                                                                        @log_transfer = 1,
                                                                        @item_id = @unq_item_attr_value,
																		@lot_no=NULL,
																		@sublot_no=NULL,
																		@to_sublot_no=NULL,
																		@to_lot_no=NULL,
																		@bulk_move_reclassify=1,
																		@to_grade_cd=@def_grd_code,
																		@to_item_id=@unq_item_attr_value



          END

        END--8 IF end-  check type _OMAR

        --10 IF start
        IF (@is_silo_block = 'true' and @auto_reclass_attr_value = 'true') -- v00.01.01 Add checking for @auto_reclass_attr_value should be true
        BEGIN
          SET @error_code = 'Error: '

          IF (@def_grd_attr_value IS NULL)
          BEGIN
            SET @error_code = @error_code
            + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300001,NULL,NULL)
          END

          IF (@unq_item_attr_value IS NULL)
          BEGIN
            SET @error_code = @error_code + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300002,NULL,NULL)
          END

          IF (@mes_item_id <> @unq_item_attr_value)
          BEGIN
            SET @error_code = @error_code
            + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300003,NULL,NULL)
          END

          IF EXISTS (SELECT
              1
            FROM @su_attr SA
            WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
            )
          BEGIN
		  select @edit_comment= dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300004,NULL,NULL);
		 
		  select @edit_at=ea.last_edit_at from ent_attr ea with(nolock)
		  where ea.attr_id=@blk_for_quality_id and ea.ent_id=@ent_id

		  EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_Ent_Attr] @ent_id,@blk_for_quality_id,1,@error_code,@edit_comment,@edit_at
          
          END
          ELSE
          BEGIN
            EXEC @return_value = [dbo].[Sp_i_ent_attr] @ent_id = @ent_id,
                                                       @attr_id = @blk_for_quality_id,
                                                       @attr_value = 1,
                                                       @notes = @error_code,
                                                       @last_edit_comment = @edit_comment,
                                                       @last_edit_at = @edit_at OUTPUT
          END

        END

      END-- 5 IF end
    

    -- set code for reset storage exec value 
    IF ((@unq_item_attr_value IS NOT NULL
      OR @def_grd_attr_value IS NOT NULL))   
    BEGIN
      UPDATE storage_exec
      SET allow_multiple_items = ISNULL(spare_int3, 0),
          allow_multiple_lots = ISNULL(spare_int4, 0)
      WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
    END
  END	--2 IF end- silo present

END

-- Procedure definition
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Result]
  (@sample_id INT32,
   @char_id INT32,
   @value_no INT32_NULL OUTPUT,
   @result_value TFLOAT ,
   @act_sample_size INT32_NULL,
   @created_by STRING80_NULL,
   @created_at_utc TDATETIME = NULL,
   @created_at_local TDATETIME,
   @created_at_tz INT32 = NULL,
   @superseded INT32_NULL,
   @last_edit_comment STRING254_NULL,
   @validate_control_rules LOGICAL = 1,
   @time_zone_bias_value   INT32 = NULL,
   @last_edit_at datetime = NULL OUT,
   @row_id INT = NULL OUTPUT,
   @control_rule_violations NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL OUTPUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - SP_I_ResultEXCEPTION
-- Description       - insert a result record

-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date Change By   Ver.  Changes
-- 09/18/2011  Raghu             Enforce sample size source for the attribute type characteristics
-- 10/26/2011  Johnny            Added calculation of std. dev, mean. range, and act_sample_size to the sample_char_link table.
-- 11/11/2011  Johnny            Added checks for maximum sample size
-- 07/25/2012  Raghu             Determine sample result
-- 07/10/2017  Srinivas    6.0   US#830369--CR#L00145808 to merge HF CR#L00145564 : Added fix for HF-L00145564, added condition for "not monitored" characteristic to update the sample result
-- 11/15/2017  Anwar			 US#928812--CR#L00146851: Convert LSL, USL and sample result to decimal in sample result calculation
-- 11/07/2019  RWB         6.2   US#1184121: Added an optional ceated_at_utc so that the time can be specified as UTC
-- 06/18/2020	Raghu	6.2	US:1330922 - As Lenka, I want to analyze and address performance issues with QM web API methods
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

   SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40)
	,@tz_temp 			INT32
	,@err_msg			NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@str_results			NVARCHAR(200)
	,@type				INT32
	,@maximum_sample_size		INT32
	,@char_normal_sample_size	INT32
	,@char_maximum_sample_size	INT32
	,@char_sample_size_source	INT32
	,@spec_normal_sample_size	INT32
	,@spec_maximum_sample_size	INT32
	,@spec_sample_size_source	INT32
	,@sample_size_source		INT32
	,@num_results			INT32
	,@sample_result			INT32
	,@qm_ent_id			INT32
	,@add_result			LOGICAL = 1

	SELECT @qm_ent_id = s.ent_id FROM sample s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE s.sample_id = @sample_id

   -- Raise an error if sample_id is invalid
   IF @qm_ent_id IS NULL  BEGIN
      SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'Sample ID:' + STR(@sample_id)
      RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
      RETURN
   END

   IF EXISTS (
        SELECT TOP 1 1
        FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sample_id = @sample_id AND (sample_status = 3 OR final = 1)
     )
       BEGIN
          RAISERROR('Cannot edit a sample that has a status of MISSED or is Final.{7229}', 16, 1)
          RETURN -1
       END

   --Retrieve the characteristic type, normal sample size, maximum sample size  and sample size source
   SELECT @type = c.type
         ,@char_normal_sample_size = c.normal_sample_size
         ,@char_maximum_sample_size=c.maximum_sample_size
         ,@char_sample_size_source = c.sample_size_source
   FROM characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK)
   WHERE c.char_id = @char_id

   --Raise an error if the supplied characteristic does not exist in the database.
   IF (@type IS NULL) BEGIN
      SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'Characteristic ID:' + STR(@char_id)
      RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
      RETURN
   END

   --Raise an error if the supplied result value is not a legitimate value.
   IF (@type = 1 OR @type = 2) AND (COALESCE(@result_value, -1) < 0) BEGIN
      SET @err_msg = 'The %1 must be %2 or %3{3412},' + 'supplied result value:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@result_value))) + ',greater than' + ',equal to 0.'
      RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
      RETURN
   END

   IF (@type = 1 OR @type = 2)  BEGIN
      --The value number is always 1 for the attribute type characteristics.
      SET @value_no = 1

      --Retrieve the normal sample size and sample size source linked to the qm spec.
      SELECT @spec_normal_sample_size = qscl.normal_sample_size, @spec_sample_size_source = qscl.sample_size_source
      FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
      WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id AND scl.char_id = @char_id

      --Default the sample size source to characteristic, if the qm spec contains a null value
      SET @sample_size_source = COALESCE(@spec_sample_size_source, COALESCE(@char_sample_size_source, 0))

      IF (@sample_size_source = 0) -- Fixed
         --Default the actual sample size to the qm spec, if not null; otherwise, default to normal sample size configured for a characteristic
         SET @act_sample_size = COALESCE(@spec_normal_sample_size, @char_normal_sample_size)

      --Default to -1 to raise an error, if the supplied sample size is null
      SET @act_sample_size = COALESCE(@act_sample_size, -1)

      IF (@act_sample_size <= 0) BEGIN
         SET @err_msg = 'The %1 must be %2 or %3{3412},' + 'supplied actual sample size:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@act_sample_size))) + ',greater than' + ',equal to 1.'
         RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
         RETURN
      END

      --If the sample size is not legitimate, raise an error
      IF (@type = 1 AND @result_value > @act_sample_size) BEGIN
         SET @err_msg = 'The %1 must be %2 or %3{3412},' + 'supplied result value:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@result_value))) + ',less than' + ',equal to the actual sample size:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(@act_sample_size))) + '.'
         RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
         RETURN
      END

    END

   ELSE BEGIN   -- Variable Type Characteristic
          --Maximum Sample Size from the sample_char_link table
         SELECT @spec_maximum_sample_size = qscl.maximum_sample_size
	 FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
         LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
         WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
           AND scl.char_id = @char_id

         -- Determine the maximum sample size from the sample_char_link or the characteristic
         SET @maximum_sample_size = COALESCE(@spec_maximum_sample_size, @char_maximum_sample_size)

	SELECT @num_results = COUNT(*) FROM result WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id = @sample_id AND char_id = @char_id AND superseded = 0;

         -- If the value number is not supplied, default it to the next value number.
         IF (@value_no IS NULL)
               SELECT @value_no = COALESCE(MAX(resl.value_no), 0) + 1 FROM result resl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE resl.sample_id = @sample_id AND resl.char_id = @char_id

         -- Ignore the result if the number of results exceed the If the number of results exceeds the maximum sample size
         IF  (@maximum_sample_size  IS NOT NULL )
            AND ((@num_results = @maximum_sample_size
                   -- not superseded
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result WITH (NOLOCK)
                                   WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
                                   AND char_id = @char_id
                                   AND value_no = @value_no
                                  )
                  )
                  OR @num_results > @maximum_sample_size
                  OR @maximum_sample_size <= 0
                )
           BEGIN
              SET @add_result = 0
           END
     END

	IF (@add_result = 1) BEGIN
	    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	    SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

		IF @created_at_utc IS NULL AND @created_at_local IS NOT NULL
			SET @created_at_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@qm_ent_id, @created_at_local, @last_edit_at)
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @created_at_UTC IS NULL SET @created_at_utc = @last_edit_at
			SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@qm_ent_id, @created_at_utc)
		END

	    IF @superseded IS NULL SET @superseded = 0

	    -- If the result exist, supersede the record
	    IF (@superseded = 0)
		    UPDATE result
		    SET superseded = 1
		    WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
		       AND char_id = @char_id
		       AND value_no = @value_no
		       AND superseded=0;

	    INSERT INTO result
	       (sample_id,
		char_id,
		value_no,
		result_value,
		created_by,
		created_at_utc,
		created_at_local,
		superseded,
		last_edit_comment,
		last_edit_by,
		last_edit_at)
	    VALUES
		(@sample_id,
		 @char_id,
		 @value_no,
		 @result_value,
		 @created_by,
		 @created_at_utc,
		 @created_at_local,
		 @superseded,
		 @last_edit_comment,
		 @last_edit_by,
		 @last_edit_at)

	   SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	END

    SELECT @validate_control_rules = COALESCE(@validate_control_rules, 1)

    IF (@validate_control_rules = 0) RETURN

   -- Update Sample Char Link statistics based on the type of characteristic
   -- variable-type characteristic
   IF (@type = 0)
     BEGIN
      UPDATE sample_char_link
      SET
           sample_char_link.standard_dev = sample_stats.standard_dev
         , sample_char_link.mean = sample_stats.mean
         , sample_char_link.range = sample_stats.range
         , sample_char_link.act_sample_size = sample_stats.no_of_results
      FROM
         ( SELECT STDEV(r.result_value) as standard_dev
          , AVG(r.result_value) as mean
          , MAX(r.result_value) - MIN(r.result_value) as range
          , COUNT(r.result_value) as no_of_results
           FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
           WHERE
                 r.sample_id = @sample_id
             AND r.char_id = @char_id
             AND r.superseded = 0
          ) sample_stats
      WHERE sample_char_link.sample_id = @sample_id
        AND sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id

     END
   ELSE
    --Binary attribute (type=1)
    --Counted attribute (type=2)
     BEGIN
      UPDATE sample_char_link
        SET
           sample_char_link.standard_dev = null
         , sample_char_link.mean = @result_value
         , sample_char_link.range = null
         , sample_char_link.act_sample_size = @act_sample_size
      WHERE sample_char_link.sample_id = @sample_id
        AND sample_char_link.char_id = @char_id

      --Binary and Counted Type Characteristics do no have control rule violations
      SET @control_rule_violations=NULL

     END
      -- Determine Control Rule Violations
        EXECUTE sp_U_SCL_CalcStatsAndVerifyCRs
             @sample_id=@sample_id
            ,@char_id=@char_id
            ,@operator=@created_by
            ,@control_rule_violations=@control_rule_violations OUTPUT

	--Determine the sample result status

	--2= GOOD: all variables and attributes were within normal ranges
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
        FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
        INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN result r WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = r.sample_id AND scl.char_id = r.char_id
        WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
          --minimum number of results were collected for all the characteristics in this sample
          AND (COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size
          --all variables and attributes were within normal ranges
          OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample_char_rule_link scrl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE scrl.sample_id = @sample_id)
          OR (r.value_no IS NOT NULL AND r.superseded = 0 AND ((CAST(r.result_value  AS DECIMAL(20,7)) < CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.lsl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.lsl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.lsl IS NOT NULL)
                        OR (CAST(r.result_value AS DECIMAL(20,7)) > CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.usl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.usl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.usl IS NOT NULL)
                        ) )
          --accommodate when there are no results entered for this characteritisc
          OR r.value_no IS NULL )
          )
        SET @sample_result = 2

	--Determine the sample result state ONLY if the sample result is NOT good.
	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN

		--8 = OOS CRITICAL: at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of critical was out of spec
		--(even if there are still some results pending)
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			INNER JOIN result r WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = r.sample_id AND scl.char_id = r.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
			  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 4
			--at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of critical was out of spec
			  AND (r.superseded = 0 AND ((CAST(r.result_value  AS DECIMAL(20,7)) < CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.lsl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.lsl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.lsl IS NOT NULL)
                            OR (CAST(r.result_value AS DECIMAL(20,7)) > CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.usl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.usl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.usl IS NOT NULL)
                            ) )
              )
			SET @sample_result = 8
	END

	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN
		--7 = OOC CRITICAL: at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of critical was out of SPC control
		--and no critical variables or attributes were out of spec (even if there are still some results pending)
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			--at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of critical was out of SPC control
			INNER JOIN sample_char_rule_link scrl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = scrl.sample_id AND scl.char_id = scrl.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
			  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 4
			--NO CRITICAL VARIABLES OR ATTRIBUTES WERE OUT OF SPEC
			--Note: There wouldn't be any variables or attributes out-of-spec at this point,
			--because if there were then the sample result status would have been 8 at this point.
			  )
			SET @sample_result = 7
	END

	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN
		--6 = OOS KEY: at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of key was out of spec
		-- and no critical variables or attributes were out of spec or out of control (even if there are still some results pending)
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			INNER JOIN result r WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = r.sample_id AND scl.char_id = r.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
			  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 3
			--NO CRITICAL VARIABLES OR ATTRIBUTES WERE OUT OF CONTROL
			--NO CRITICAL VARIABLES OR ATTRIBUTES WERE OUT OF SPEC
			--Note: There wouldn't be any variables or attributes of severity code CRITICAL would be out of control or out of spec at this point,
			--because, if there were then the sample result would have been 8 or 7 at this point.
			--at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of key was out of spec
			  AND (r.superseded = 0 AND ((CAST(r.result_value  AS DECIMAL(20,7)) < CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.lsl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.lsl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.lsl IS NOT NULL)
                            OR (CAST(r.result_value AS DECIMAL(20,7)) > CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.usl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.usl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.usl IS NOT NULL)
                            ) )
              )
			SET @sample_result = 6
	END

	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN
		--5 = OOC KEY: at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of key was out of SPC control and no critical or key variables
		--or attributes were out of spec and no critical variables or attributes were out of control(even if there are still some results pending)
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			--at least one variable or attribute with a severity setting of key was out of SPC control
			INNER JOIN sample_char_rule_link scrl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = scrl.sample_id AND scl.char_id = scrl.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
			  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 3
			--NO CRITICAL VARIABLES OR ATTRIBUTES WERE OUT OF CONTROL
			--Note: There wouldn't be any variables or attributes of severity code CRITICAL would be out of control at this point,
			--because, if there were then the sample result would have been 7 at this point.
			--NO CRITICAL OR KEY VARIABLES OR ATTRIBUTES WERE OUT OF SPEC
			--Note: There wouldn't be any variables or attributes of severity code CRITICAL or KEY would be out of spec at this point,
			--because, if there were then the sample result would have been 8 or 6 at this point.
			  )
			SET @sample_result = 5
	END

	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN
		--4 = OOS: at least one variable or attribute was out of spec (even if there are still some results pending).
		--For variable characteristics, this is for individuals
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			INNER JOIN result r WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = r.sample_id AND scl.char_id = r.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
              AND ( COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 2 OR COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 1 )
			--at least one variable or attribute was out of spec
			  AND (r.superseded = 0 AND ((CAST(r.result_value  AS DECIMAL(20,7)) < CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.lsl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.lsl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.lsl IS NOT NULL)
                            OR (CAST(r.result_value AS DECIMAL(20,7)) > CASE WHEN c.type = 0 THEN CAST(qscl.usl AS DECIMAL(20,7)) ELSE CAST((qscl.usl * scl.act_sample_size) AS DECIMAL(20,7)) END AND qscl.usl IS NOT NULL)
                            ) )
              )
			SET @sample_result = 4
	END

	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN
		--3 = OOC: at least one variable or attribute was out of SPC control and no variables or attributes were out of spec
		--(even if there are still some results pending).
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			--at least one variable or attribute was out of SPC control
			INNER JOIN sample_char_rule_link scrl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = scrl.sample_id AND scl.char_id = scrl.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
			  AND COALESCE(qscl.severity_cd, c.severity_cd) = 2
			--AND NO VARIABLES OR ATTRIBUTES WERE OUT OF SPEC
			--Note: There wouldn't be any variables or attributes of severity code NON-KEY would be out of spec at this point,
			--because, if there were then the sample result would have been 4 at this point.
			  )
			SET @sample_result = 3

	END

	IF (@sample_result IS NULL) BEGIN
		--1 = PENDING: some variables and attributes are waiting to be collected and all that have been collected are within normal ranges
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND qscl.char_id = scl.char_id
			INNER JOIN characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.char_id = c.char_id
			--There is at least one result
			LEFT OUTER JOIN result r WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.sample_id = r.sample_id AND scl.char_id = r.char_id
			WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
			--some variables and attributes are waiting to be collected
			  AND (COALESCE(qscl.minimum_sample_size, c.minimum_sample_size) > scl.act_sample_size OR r.result_value IS NULL)
			  --ALL THAT HAVE BEEN COLLECTED ARE WITHIN NORMAL RANGES
			--Note: There wouldn't be any variables or attributes that would be out of spec or out of control at this point,
			--because, if there were then the sample result would have been 8 or 7 or 6 or 5 or 4 or 3 at this point.
			--there is at least one result for this sample
			AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id)
			  )
			SET @sample_result = 1
	END

	--Update the status of the sample
	EXEC sp_U_Sample_UpdateStatus @sample_id=@sample_id, @sample_un_pulled=0, @sample_result=@sample_result, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Po]
(
	@po_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@vend_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@seller_id int ,
	@ship_to int ,
	--@date_issued datetime ,
	@date_issued_local datetime, -- Added 08/02/2007 AML
	@state_cd int ,
	@notes NOTES ,
	@spare1 nvarchar(1000) ,
	@spare2 nvarchar(1000) ,
	@spare3 nvarchar(1000) ,
	@spare4 nvarchar(1000) ,
	@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
	@last_edit_at DATETIME,
	@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_U_Po
-- Description      - Update an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 6.2.0
-- Notes            - SP requires that all table fields be included
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By		Version     Changes
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/02/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
-- 02/05/2020       Jim O'Hearn     6.2.0       Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
DECLARE @date_issued_utc	DATETIME
	,	@tz_temp			INT

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @date_issued_local, @tz_temp, @date_issued_utc OUTPUT
--

UPDATE po
SET vend_id = @vend_id,
    seller_id = @seller_id,
    ship_to = @ship_to,
    --date_issued = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @date_issued),

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal]
(@site_ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,@in_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,@in_utc		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
)  RETURNS DATETIME
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal
-- Description          - Returns a generated local date calculated from the passed bias or from the Client Local regions bias
-- Author               - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 01/12/2012
-- Version              - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @region_id			NVARCHAR(80)
			,@current_local		TDATETIME
			,@context_info		int32
			,@tz_offset			INT32
			,@count				INT32
			,@start_time_diff	TDATETIME
			,@end_time_diff		TDATETIME
			,@time_diff			INT32

	SET @current_local = @in_local
	IF ( @current_local IS NULL )
		SET @current_local = GETDATE()

	IF ( @site_ent_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		select @region_id = s.region_id from ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		left outer join site s WITH (NOLOCK) on s.ent_id = ent.site
		where ent.ent_id = @site_ent_id
	END

	-- If we still need region_id, get it from sessn table
	IF ( @region_id IS NULL ) BEGIN
		-- Get session_id from connection context
		SELECT @context_info = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spid =  @@spid
		--Retrieve the current region from the session context.
		SELECT @region_id = region_id FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @context_info
	END

	-- use the supplied local time to retrieve the offset
	SELECT @tz_offset =  MAX(offset), @count = COUNT(*)
	FROM tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id IS NULL AND default_region = 1))
	  AND (start_local <= @in_local AND end_local >= @in_local)

	IF (@tz_offset IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The offset is null for the supplied time.  I.e. the time is requested when the clock moved forward by one hour.
		--For example, when the clock moves from 2012-03-11 02:00:00 to 2012-03-11 03:00:00, there is no time between them.
		--Therefore, when the local time requested is between 02:00:00 and 03:00:00, find the next start local time
		--that is greater than the supplied local time, that offset is applied to obtain the UTC.
		--I.e. the UTC time always moves forward, and the local time is just a representation of a time in local.

		--The end_time_diff variable below contains 2012-03-11 03:00:00
		SELECT @end_time_diff = start_local, @tz_offset = offset
		FROM tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id IS NULL AND default_region = 1))
		  AND start_local = (SELECT MIN(start_local) FROM tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
							 WHERE (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id IS NULL AND default_region = 1))
							   AND start_local > @in_local)

		--The start_time_diff variable contains 2012-03-11 02:00:00
		SELECT @start_time_diff = DATEADD(SS, 1, end_local)
		FROM tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id IS NULL AND default_region = 1))
		  AND end_local = (SELECT MAX(end_local) FROM tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
							 WHERE (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id IS NULL AND default_region = 1))
							   AND start_local < @in_local)

		--Calculate the difference time in seconds.
		SET @time_diff = DATEDIFF(SS, @start_time_diff, @end_time_diff)

		--Add the difference time to the supplied local time, which is the actual time in local.
		--For example, there is no 2012-03-11 02:30:00, infact it is 2012-03-11 03:30:00
		SET @in_local = DATEADD(SS, @time_diff, @in_local)
	END

	ELSE IF (@count > 1)
		--The clock moved backwards, therefore for the supplied local time has two offsets.
		--So, use the supplied UTC time to determine the offset value.
		--For example, when the clock moves from 2012-11-04 01:59:59 (EDT offset: -240) to 2012-11-04 01:00:00 (EST offset: -300),
		--there are two offset values, -240 and -300.
		--Therefore, if the supplied UTC time is on or before 2012-11-04 01:59:59, then this SP returns the offset as -240
		--but, if the supplied UTC time is after 2012-11-04 01:59:59, then this SP returns the offset as -300
		SELECT @tz_offset = MAX(offset) FROM tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id IS NULL AND default_region = 1))
		  AND (start_local <= @in_local or end_local >= @in_local )
		  AND (start_utc <= @in_utc AND end_utc >= @in_utc)

	-- in case we are unable to get client local offset - goto server as last resort
	IF (@tz_offset IS NULL)
        SET @tz_offset = dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromServer()

	--Return the UTC time using the offset and local time.
	RETURN DATEADD(MI, -@tz_offset, COALESCE(@in_local, @current_local))
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shipment]
(@cust_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @po_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @so_line_no  int  ,
 @ship_date_utc  datetime  ,
 @ship_date_local  datetime  ,
 @ship_via  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @ship_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @ship_from  int ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By 	Ver	 Changes
-- 08/06/2003     Rich Boyle        	 Added a total_to_ship column which is selected from the quantity field in the po_line_no table.
-- 08/06/2003     Rich Boyle        	 Added a total_qty_shipped column which is a sum of all the qty_shipped in the Shipment_lot for the shipment.
--08/07/2003	  Raghu		1.6.18	 Added po_line.item_id, item.item_desc, item.num_decimals column
--08/11/2003	  Raghu		1.6.19	 Changed "@shipment_date >= " to "@shipment_date = "
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--03/30/2006	  Raghu	  3.1.13		 HD# 7801, Ship_date should not check for >= ship_dates as this is part of the primary key.
--07/12/2006	Raghu	3.1.19		HD# 8460, Include shipment entity name in the return recordset.
--09/05/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT shipment.cust_id
            ,shipment.po_id
            ,shipment.so_line_no
			,shipment.ship_date_utc
            ,shipment.ship_date_local
            ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shipment.ship_date_utc) ship_date
            ,shipment.ship_via
            ,shipment.ship_by
            ,shipment.ship_from
			,shipment_ent.ent_name ship_from_ent_name
            ,shipment.spare1
            ,shipment.spare2
            ,shipment.spare3
            ,shipment.spare4
            ,cust.cust_name
            ,so_line.item_id
            ,item.item_desc
            ,item.num_decimals
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, shipment.mod_id))) mod_id
            ,(select isnull(quantity, 0) from so_line so_line WITH (NOLOCK) where so_line.cust_id = shipment.cust_id and so_line.po_id = shipment.po_id and so_line.so_line_no = shipment.so_line_no) total_to_ship
            ,(select isnull(sum(qty_shipped), 0) from shipment_lot shipment_lot WITH (NOLOCK) where shipment_lot.cust_id = shipment.cust_id and shipment_lot.po_id = shipment.po_id and shipment_lot.so_line_no = shipment.so_line_no) total_qty_shipped
            ,shipment.last_edit_comment
            ,shipment.last_edit_by
            ,shipment.last_edit_at
  FROM shipment shipment WITH (NOLOCK)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN cust cust WITH (NOLOCK) ON shipment.cust_id = cust.cust_id
       INNER JOIN so_line so_line WITH (NOLOCK) ON shipment.cust_id = so_line.cust_id AND shipment.po_id = so_line.po_id AND shipment.so_line_no = so_line.so_line_no
       INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON so_line.item_id = item.item_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ent shipment_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON shipment.ship_from = shipment_ent.ent_id
WHERE ((shipment.cust_id = @cust_id OR @cust_id IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.po_id = @po_id OR @po_id IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.so_line_no = @so_line_no OR @so_line_no IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.ship_date_utc = @ship_date_utc OR @ship_date_utc IS NULL) AND
	   (shipment.ship_date_local = @ship_date_local OR @ship_date_local IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.ship_via = @ship_via OR @ship_via IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.ship_by = @ship_by OR @ship_by IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.ship_from = @ship_from OR @ship_from IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (shipment.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY cust.cust_name, shipment.po_id, shipment.so_line_no

			INSERT INTO @tempItemProd--get records form MESDB and Archive DB
			(

				wo_id
			  , oper_id
			  , seq_no
			  , item_id
			  , lot_no
			  , sublot_no
				--, fg_lot_no    
				-- , fg_sub_lot_no
			  , CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,3), qty_prod) as qty_prod
			FROM  [ARCHIVEDB].[OFI_MESDB_Archive].[dbo].item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
			
		

	IF(@type = 'downstream') --RAW->SFG->FG

		--	DECLARE @sfg_source INT
		SET @sfg_source = 1
		SET @destination = @sfg_source + 1

		SET @id = 1

		--RETRIEVE THE FINISH FINISHED-GOOD WORK ORDER
		SELECT
			wo_id
		  , seq_no
		  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ic.item_id, SUM(qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons'--
		  , OPER_ID
		  , lot_no
		--  , row_id
		  , ic.item_id

		  , 0 AS                                                                  'processed'
		INTO

		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id

		  , seq_no
		  , OPER_ID
		  , ic.ITEM_ID
		  , item_desc
		  , i.uom_id
		ORDER BY
			id-- desc
	
		DECLARE @prod_row_id INT
		SELECT TOP 1
			@material = item_Desc
		  , @sfg_qty = qty_cons
		  , @source = source
		  , @destination = destination
		  , @prod_row_id = id
		  , @fg_wo = wo_id
		  , @fg_oper_id = oper_id
		  , @sfg_seq_no = seq_no
		FROM #sfg_wo
		WHERE processed = 0
		ORDER BY
			ID
		INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
		(
			material
		  , qty
		  , id
		  , source
		  , destination
		)
		VALUES
		(
			   @material
			 , @sfg_qty

		BEGIN
			--	declare @prod_row_id int
			SELECT TOP 1
				@material = item_Desc
			  , @sfg_qty = qty_cons
			  , @source = source
			  , @prod_row_id = id
			  , @sfg_wo = wo_id
			  , @sfg_oper_id = oper_id
			  , @sfg_seq_no = seq_no
			FROM #sfg_wo
			WHERE processed = 0
			ORDER BY
				ID

			--select @prod_row_id--AAA
			UPDATE #sfg_wo
			SET
				processed = 1
			WHERE
				ID = @prod_row_id

			DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
			FOR SELECT
					ip.item_id
				  , ip.lot_no
				  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ip.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod' --SUM(ip.qty_prod)
				  , oper_id
				FROM @tempItemProd ip
				INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
				WHERE
					ip.wo_id = @sfg_wo
					AND ip.seq_no = @sfg_seq_no
					AND ip.oper_id = @sfg_oper_id
				GROUP BY
					ip.lot_no
				  , ip.item_id
				  , ip.oper_id
				  , i.uom_id

			OPEN sfg_item

			FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
										, @sfg_lot_no
										, @sfg_qty
										, @sfg_oper_id

			WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
			BEGIN

				SET @sfg_source = @prod_row_id
				SET @id = @destination

				SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
									  item_desc
								  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
								  WHERE item_id = @sfg_item_id)

				SET @material = @item_desc + '_' + ISNULL(@sfg_lot_no, 0)
				--select TOP 1 @id=id+1 from @childTableInvValidation ORDER BY id DESC
				INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
				(
					material
				  , qty
				  , id
				  , source
				  , destination
				)
				VALUES
				(
					   @material
					 , @sfg_qty
					 , @id
					 , @sfg_source
					 , @destination
				)

				-- RETRIEVE THE SFG PRODUCED WORK ORDER BASED ON THE SFG ITEM
				DECLARE @maxid INT
				SELECT
					@maxid = MAX(id)
				FROM #sfg_wo
				INSERT INTO #sfg_wo
				SELECT
					wo_id
				  , seq_no
				  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ic.item_id, SUM(qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons'--SUM(qty_cons) as 'qty_cons'
				  , OPER_ID
				  , lot_no
				--  , row_id
				  , ic.item_id
				  , i.item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(ic.lot_no, 0) AS                         item_desc
				  , @sfg_source --source
				  , @sfg_source-- @destination
				  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
					ORDER BY
					(SELECT
						 NULL) ) + @maxid --NEXT VALUE FOR id_seq)--@id -- id
				  , 0 AS                                                                  'processed'
				FROM @tempItemCons ic 
				INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
				WHERE
					ic.item_id = @sfg_item_id
					AND ic.lot_no = @sfg_lot_no

				--AND jb.aaObsolete=0
				GROUP BY
					ic.wo_id
				  , ic.seq_no
				  , ic.lot_no
				  , ic.oper_id
				  , ic.item_id
				  , item_Desc
				  , i.uom_id
				--  SELECT * FROM #sfg_wo
				SET @destination = @destination + 1 --NEXT VALUE FOR id_seq
				FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
											, @sfg_lot_no
											, @sfg_qty
											, @sfg_oper_id
	END --end while cursor
			CLOSE sfg_item
			DEALLOCATE sfg_item

	END -- end while #sfg_wo
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@type = 'upstream') --FG->SFG->RAW 
		BEGIN

			SELECT
				@produce = produced
			  , @consume = consumed
			FROM item_class
			WHERE item_class_id = @item_class

			DECLARE @fg_seq_no INT
			DECLARE @fg_qty FLOAT
			DECLARE @fg_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_seq_no INT
			DECLARE @cons_qty FLOAT
			DECLARE @cons_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_wo_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @fg_source INT

			SET @source = 1
			SET @destination = @source + 1
			SET @fg_source = @source
			SET @id = 1

			SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
								  item_desc
							  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
							  WHERE item_id = @item_id)

			SET @material = @item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(@lot_no, 0);

			--RETRIEVE THE FINISH FINISHED-GOOD WORK ORDER
			SELECT
				wo_id
			  , seq_no
			  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](p.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'--SUM(qty_prod)
			  , OPER_ID
			  , lot_no
			--  , row_id
			  , p.item_id
			  , i.item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(p.lot_no, 0) AS                         item_desc
			  , @source AS                                                           source
			  , @destination AS                                                      destination
			  , @id AS                                                               id
			  , 0 AS                                                                 'processed'
			INTO
				#fg_wo
			FROM @tempItemProd p 
			INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.item_id = i.item_id
			WHERE
				p.item_id = @item_id
				AND lot_no = @lot_no
				AND
				(
					@WO_ID IS NULL
					OR wo_id = @wo_id
				)
			GROUP BY
				wo_id
			  , lot_no
			  , seq_no
			  , OPER_ID
			  , p.ITEM_ID
			  , item_desc
			  , item_desc
			  , i.uom_id
			ORDER BY
				id-- desc
		--select  *from #fg_wo
			-- Select Count(*) From #fg_wo Where Processed = 0--AAA
			--set @prod_row_id int
			SELECT TOP 1
				@material = item_Desc
			  , @fg_qty = qty_prod
			  , @source = source
			  , @destination = destination
			  , @prod_row_id = id
			  , @fg_wo = wo_id
			  , @fg_oper_id = oper_id
			  , @fg_seq_no = seq_no
			FROM #fg_wo
			WHERE processed = 0
			--order by ID 
			ORDER BY
				seq_no ASC
			INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
			(
				material
			  , qty
			  , id
			  , source
			  , destination
			)
			VALUES
			(
				   @material
				 , @fg_qty
				 , @prod_row_id
				 , @source
				 , @destination
			)
			--select * from #fg_wo	
			WHILE (SELECT
					   COUNT(*)
				   FROM #fg_wo
				   WHERE Processed = 0) > 0
			BEGIN
				--select  top 1 * from #fg_wo order by seq_no asc
				--	declare @prod_row_id int
				SELECT TOP 1
					@material = item_Desc
				  , @fg_qty = qty_prod
				  , @source = source
				  , @prod_row_id = id
				  , @fg_wo = wo_id
				  , @fg_oper_id = oper_id
				  , @fg_seq_no = seq_no
				FROM #fg_wo
				WHERE processed = 0
				--order by ID 
				ORDER BY
					seq_no ASC

				--select @prod_row_id--AAA
				UPDATE #fg_wo
				SET
					processed = 1
				WHERE
					ID = @prod_row_id

				--select @fg_seq_no as seqno
				DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
				FOR SELECT
						cons.item_id
					  , cons.lot_no
					  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](cons.item_id, SUM(cons.qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons' --SUM(cons.qty_cons)
					  , oper_id
					FROM @tempItemCons cons 
					INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON cons.item_id = i.item_id
					WHERE
						cons.wo_id = @fg_wo
						AND cons.seq_no = @fg_seq_no
						AND cons.oper_id = @fg_oper_id
					GROUP BY
						cons.lot_no
					  , cons.item_id
					  , cons.oper_id
					  , i.uom_id

				OPEN sfg_item

				FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
											, @sfg_lot_no
											, @sfg_qty
											, @sfg_oper_id

				WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
				BEGIN
					--select @sfg_item_id, @sfg_lot_no--AAA
					SET @sfg_source = @prod_row_id
					SET @id = @destination

					SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
										  item_desc
									  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
									  WHERE item_id = @sfg_item_id)

					SET @material = @item_desc + '_' + ISNULL(@sfg_lot_no, 0)
					--select TOP 1 @id=id+1 from @childTableInvValidation ORDER BY id DESC
					INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
					(
						material
					  , qty
					  , id
					  , source
					  , destination
					)
					VALUES
					(
						   @material
						 , @sfg_qty
						 , @id
						 , @sfg_source
						 , @destination
					)

					--SET @sfg_source = @destination
					--SELECT @sfg_item_id
					-- RETRIEVE THE SFG PRODUCED WORK ORDER BASED ON THE SFG ITEM
					INSERT INTO #fg_wo
					SELECT
						wo_id
					  , seq_no
					  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](prod.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'--SUM(qty_prod)
					  , OPER_ID
					  , lot_no
					--  , row_id
					  , prod.item_id
					  , i.item_desc + ' _ ' + ISNULL(prod.lot_no, 0) AS                         item_desc
					  , @sfg_source --source
					  , @destination
					  , @id -- id
					  , 0 AS                                                                    'processed'
					FROM @tempItemProd prod 
					INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON prod.item_id = i.item_id
					WHERE
						prod.item_id = @sfg_item_id
						AND prod.lot_no = @sfg_lot_no

					--AND jb.aaObsolete=0
					GROUP BY
						prod.wo_id
					  , prod.seq_no
					  , prod.lot_no
					  , prod.oper_id
					  , prod.item_id
					  , item_Desc
					  , i.uom_id
					SET @destination = @destination + 1
					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
												, @sfg_lot_no
												, @sfg_qty
												, @sfg_oper_id
		END --end while cursor
				CLOSE sfg_item
				DEALLOCATE sfg_item

				--select *from #fg_wo
		END -- end while #fg_wo
		END -- end else FG
	END

/*SELECT DISTINCT
				ISNULL(id,1) as id 
			  , material AS       name
			  , ISNULL(qty, 10) AS value
			  , source
			  , destination AS    target
			FROM @childTableInvValidation
			WHERE material IS NOT NULL*/

	DECLARE @temp_id INT

	SELECT TOP 1
		@temp_id = id
	FROM @childTableInvValidation
	WHERE material IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY
		id

	--SELECT @temp_id
	IF
		(@temp_id IS NOT NULL
		)
	BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			id AS          id
		  , material AS    name
		  , qty AS         value
		  , source
		  , destination AS target
		FROM @childTableInvValidation
		WHERE material IS NOT NULL
	END

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Inv_Add]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@item_id			STRING40
,@lot_no			STRING40
,@sublot_no          		STRING40
,@grade_cd			INT32
,@status_cd			INT32
,@add_qty			TFLOAT
,@add_qty_erp			TFLOAT
,@date_in_local			TDATETIME
,@date_in_tz			INT32 = NULL
,@expiry_date			TDATETIME
,@wo_id				STRING40
,@oper_id			STRING40
,@seq_no			INT32
,@from_ent_id			INT32
,@uom_id             		INT32
,@spare1			STRING80
,@spare2			STRING80
,@spare3			STRING80
,@spare4			STRING80
,@spare5			STRING80
,@spare6			STRING80
,@goods_received		LOGICAL
,@checkGradeStatus		LOGICAL = NULL
,@transfer_comments		STRING254 = NULL
,@log_transfer			INT32 = 1
,@time_zone_bias_value 		INT32 = NULL
,@date_in_utc			TDATETIME = NULL
,@expiry_date_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@row_id			INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************

-- 03/09/2006	Raghu		3.1.11	HD# 7650, Allow updates to item_prod and item_cons spares;  removed (@add_qty = '')  check as this does not allow 0 qtys
-- 01/09/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8314, part of DB changes - added @sublot_no argument
