-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
--01/17/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00073985; Inventory Window-Error receiving Items with lots.
-- 02/08/2008	DONT	3.4.0	CR 74506 - fixed inv grade error message
-- 11/10/2009   Eswar   4.0		HF 1432 - datetime changes.
-- 02/03/2010   Vinit   4.1		Code merged for CR 88928, from the file containing the changes done by Raghu for CR 88640.CR 88928 is clone of CR 88640.
-- 09/20/2012   Praveen          4.5        Passed the parameters  uom_id,last_edit_comment while inserting values in item_inv table for the CRL00122433.
--10/03/2012		Saiteja		4.6		Added changes for CR L00122604
-- 10/03/2012		Srinu		4.6		Added changes for CR L00127047
--06/02/2014	Raghu		5.0   MOL: Merge L00124379 (HF CR L00124019) not taking into account the storage location can have negative inventory
-- 08/26/2015	Surya			5.2	CR L00137944 - Merge HF CR L00137394 (Addressed the subquery exception.)
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
-- 02/12/2019   Srinivasa   6.2    US#1240919(As Aveva, I want to merge L00155616 (HF CR L00155424: sp_I_Item_Inv_Add wont log uom_id to item_transfer))
-- 02/17/2020	Raghu		6.2	   UserStory:1187825-As Bruce, I want a Web API to process ItemInv records so I can interact with inventory
-- 09/06/2020	Srinivasa	6.2	   UserStory:1322695-Fixed the issue like after setting "Inventory unique by job" to true and then when adding inventory for this item
--                                                   using sp_I_Item_Inv_Add and passing NULL for wo, oper, and seq_no, new item_inv entries are made on each call.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	@cur_qty_left    		TFLOAT,
		@cur_qty_left_erp		TFLOAT,
		@cur_date_in    		TDATETIME,
		@cur_date_out_local		TDATETIME,
		@cur_date_out_utc		TDATETIME,
		@cur_grade_cd    		INT32 ,
		@cur_status_cd   		INT32,
		@cur_expiry_date 		TDATETIME,
		@cur_last_edit_at 		TDATETIME,
		@cur_wo_id       		STRING40,
		@cur_oper_id     		STRING40,
		@cur_seq_no      		INT32,
		@date_out        		TDATETIME,
		@last_edit_at    		TDATETIME,
		@can_store       		LOGICAL,
		@status          		STRING40,
		@transfer_time   		TDATETIME,
		@to_ent_id       		INT32,
		@goods_shipped   		LOGICAL,
		@cur_type               STRING80,
		@cur_storage_status     STRING80,
		@cur_max_capacity       TFLOAT,
		@cur_auto_del_zero_inv  LOGICAL,
		@cur_allow_neg_qty      LOGICAL,
		@cur_spare1             STRING80,
		@cur_spare2             STRING80,
		@cur_spare3             STRING80,
		@cur_spare4             STRING80, -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
		@totqty					TFLOAT,
		@overall_qty			TFLOAT,
		@log_trans				LOGICAL,
		@last_edit_by			STRING40,
		@tz_temp				INT,
		@return 				INT32,
		@transfer_time_utc		TDATETIME,
		@err_msg				STRING254,
		@dbg_resp				INT32,
		@inv_unique_by_job		INT32,
		@factor                 TFLOAT,
		@cur_uom_id				INT32,
		@indistinguishable_lots	LOGICAL,
		@from_uom_id		INT32,
		@offset			TFLOAT,
		@from_uom_desc		STRING80,
		@to_uom_desc		STRING80,
		@ent_name		STRING80

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

  --return error if the qty to be added is not specified
  If (@add_qty IS NULL) BEGIN
    RAISERROR('The quantity of the item to be added should be specified{3290}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END
  --return error if a valid storage location is not supplied
    If (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
      RAISERROR('You must specify a valid storage location in order to add items to the inventory{5483}', 16, 1)
      RETURN -1
  END
  -- If the ent_id does not have the can_store capability return error
  SELECT @can_store = ( SELECT can_store FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  ent_id = @ent_id )
  IF (@can_store != 1) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('This entity does not have the can_store capability set{3221}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
  END

    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
    SET @expiry_date = COALESCE(@expiry_date_utc, @expiry_date)

	IF (@date_in_utc IS NOT NULL) SET @date_in_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @date_in_utc) -- Get the local date from utc
	ELSE BEGIN
	    	SET @date_in_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_in_tz)
		SET @tz_temp = -@date_in_tz
		SET @date_in_local = ISNULL( @date_in_local, dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

		EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @date_in_local, @tz_temp, @date_in_utc OUTPUT
	END

	--Init the Values and Set defaults if not defined
	SELECT @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()), @date_out= NULL, @add_qty_erp = COALESCE(@add_qty_erp, 0)
		, @log_trans = COALESCE(@log_trans, 0), @from_ent_id = NULL, @goods_received = COALESCE(@goods_received, 0)
		, @checkGradeStatus = COALESCE(@checkGradeStatus, 1), @log_transfer = COALESCE(@log_transfer, 1)

  SET @date_in_local = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @date_in_local )
  SET @date_in_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @date_in_utc )
  SET @transfer_time = @date_in_local
  SET @transfer_time_utc = @date_in_utc

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

  --Find out if the row exists..if so read cur_qty_left and other dependent data for it.
--EXECUTE sp_S_item_inv_GetDepData @ent_id, @item_id, @lot_no, @cont_id, @cur_grade_cd OUTPUT, @cur_status_cd OUTPUT,
--	@cur_qty_left OUTPUT, @cur_qty_left_erp OUTPUT, @cur_date_in OUTPUT, @cur_date_out OUTPUT,
--	@cur_last_edit_at OUTPUT, @cur_expiry_date OUTPUT, @cur_wo_id OUTPUT, @cur_oper_id OUTPUT, @cur_seq_no OUTPUT
--Select the dependent records along with grade cd and status cd in where clause.
  SELECT @inv_unique_by_job = i.inv_unique_by_job
	FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE i.item_id = @item_id

  IF (@inv_unique_by_job = 1)
    SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd, @cur_qty_left = qty_left, @cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
	,@cur_date_in = date_in_local, @cur_date_out_local = date_out_local, @cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at, @cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
	,@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no, @cur_uom_id = uom_id
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE  ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND item_id = @item_id
	  AND (uom_id = @uom_id OR (uom_id IS NULL AND @uom_id IS NULL) OR uom_id IN (SELECT to_uom_id FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE from_uom_id = @uom_id AND ( item_id = @item_id  OR item_id IS NULL))) -- CR L00137394 Fix
	  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (wo_id = @wo_id OR (wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
      AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR (oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
      AND (seq_no = @seq_no OR (seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
  ELSE
    SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_grade_cd = grade_cd, @cur_status_cd = status_cd, @cur_qty_left = qty_left, @cur_qty_left_erp = qty_left_erp
	,@cur_date_in = date_in_local, @cur_date_out_local = date_out_local, @cur_date_out_utc = date_out_utc, @cur_last_edit_at = last_edit_at, @cur_expiry_date = expiry_date
	,@cur_wo_id = wo_id, @cur_oper_id = oper_id, @cur_seq_no = seq_no, @cur_uom_id = uom_id
	FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE  ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND item_id = @item_id
	  AND (uom_id = @uom_id OR (uom_id IS NULL AND @uom_id IS NULL) OR uom_id IN (SELECT to_uom_id FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE from_uom_id = @uom_id AND ( item_id = @item_id  OR item_id IS NULL))) -- CR L00137394 Fix
	  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
	  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))

  --check below is added by chandresh ref HD #955
  IF @checkGradeStatus = 1
  BEGIN
    --below 2 conditions are added by Nagaraju on 05-22-02.
    --check for the grade
    IF  (NOT @grade_cd IS NULL) AND (NOT @cur_grade_cd  IS NULL)
    BEGIN
      IF @grade_cd <> @cur_grade_cd
      BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = N'The supplied item %%1 does not match with the %%2 in the inventory.{3222},grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@grade_cd)) + ',grade code: ' + ltrim(str(@cur_grade_cd))
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
      END
    END

    --check for the status
    IF NOT @status_cd IS NULL  AND (NOT @cur_status_cd  IS NULL)
    BEGIN
      IF @status_cd <> @cur_status_cd
      BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Item status does not match with the Source{3291}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
      END
    END
  END
  --below check is added by Nagaraju on 05-22-02.
  --check for the storage_exec.max_capacity
  EXECUTE sp_S_Storage_exec_GetDepData @ent_id, @cur_type OUTPUT, @cur_storage_status OUTPUT, @cur_max_capacity OUTPUT,
            @cur_auto_del_zero_inv OUTPUT, @cur_allow_neg_qty OUTPUT, @cur_spare1 OUTPUT, @cur_spare2 OUTPUT, @cur_spare3 OUTPUT--,
            --@cur_spare4 OUTPUT -- Added 1/10/07 KRF

  --Verify whether the items stored in the inventory are indistinguishable
  SELECT @indistinguishable_lots = se.indistinguishable_lots, @ent_name = e.ent_name
  FROM storage_exec se WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON se.ent_id = e.ent_id
  WHERE se.ent_id = @ent_id

  --If the items stored in the inventory are indistinguishable, then represent all items in a common unit.
  IF (@indistinguishable_lots = 1) BEGIN
  	--The items stored in this inventory location are indistinguishable
  	--Verify whether there are any items stored in this storage location
  	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
  		--There are items stored in this storage location
  		--Set the supplied unit as the source unit of measurement
  		SET @from_uom_id = @uom_id

		--Retrieve the uom ID for the supplied item in native units, if the source unit is not identified
		IF (@from_uom_id IS NULL)
			SELECT @from_uom_id = i.uom_id FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id

  		--Since there are items stored in the inventory, retrieve the uom ID from the inventory to represent the item in destination units
  		SELECT TOP 1 @uom_id = ii.uom_id FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ii.ent_id = @ent_id
	END
  	ELSE BEGIN
  		--There are no items stored in this storage location
  		--If the UOM ID is not supplied, default to the native units of the item
  		IF (@uom_id IS NULL)
			--There are no items in this storage location
			--Default to the native units of the item
			SELECT @uom_id = i.uom_id FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id

		--Set the source and destination units are the same, since there are no items in the inventory
		SET @from_uom_id = @uom_id
	END

	--Verify whether the UOM ID of the supplied item is same as the UOM IDs in the inventory for this storage location
	IF (@from_uom_id <> @uom_id) BEGIN
		--The quantity supplied is in native units of the item, but the items in the inventory are stored in different units.
		--Therefore, convert the supplied quantity to the units in the inventory.
		--Get the conversion factor for the source uom_id and destination uom_id
		--Check if any conversion factor exist for this item; if exist get that conversion factor
		--else get a generic conversion factor
		SELECT TOP 1 @factor = factor, @offset = offset
		FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE from_uom_id = @from_uom_id AND to_uom_id = @uom_id
		  AND (item_id = @item_id OR item_id IS NULL)
		ORDER BY item_id DESC

		--If there is no conversion factor defined between the item in the inventory and native units of the item, throw an error.
		IF (@factor IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @from_uom_desc = NULL, @to_uom_desc = NULL

			SELECT @from_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @from_uom_id
			IF (@from_uom_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified from uom ID: %1 used by the source inventory item does not exist in the database.{7900},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @from_uom_id)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT @to_uom_desc = description FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uom_id = @uom_id
			IF (@to_uom_desc IS NULL) BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'The specified uom ID: %1 for the destination inventory item does not exist in the database.{7901},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @uom_id)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END

			SET @err_msg = 'A conversion factor does not exist for the item: %1 to convert the quantities from uom: %2 to the uom: %3 used in the inventory location: %4.{7892},' + @item_id + ',' + @from_uom_desc + ','  + @to_uom_desc + ',' + @ent_name
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		--Convert the supplied quantity into the units stored in the storage location
		SET @add_qty = (@add_qty * COALESCE(@factor, 1)) + COALESCE(@offset, 0)
	END

  END
  ELSE BEGIN
	SELECT @factor = factor, @offset = offset FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE from_uom_id = @uom_id AND to_uom_id = @cur_uom_id
	IF( @factor IS NOT NULL)
	SET @add_qty = (@add_qty * COALESCE(@factor, 1)) + COALESCE(@offset, 0)
  END

--if the storage_exec.max_capacity is null, means no limit
  --Modified by Raghu on 07/03/2003. If max_capacity IS NULL or max_capacity = 0, then it is UnLimited. If max_capacity is null then convert to 0
  SET @cur_max_capacity = ISNULL(@cur_max_capacity, 0)
  IF @cur_max_capacity <> 0
  BEGIN
    --Added line below 7/3/03 KRF
    SELECT @overall_qty = SUM(qty_left) FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  ent_id = @ent_id
    --Can't use the quantity of just this row to calculate what's stored there; @overall_qty below was @cur_qty_left; changed 7/3/03 KRF
    IF ISNULL(@add_qty,0) + ISNULL(@overall_qty,0) > @cur_max_capacity
    BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Quantity  exceeds the maximum capacity of the entity{3292}', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
    END
  END

  IF (@cur_allow_neg_qty = 0) BEGIN
	IF (ISNULL(@cur_qty_left, 0) + (@add_qty)) < 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR('qty_left cannot be negative{3225}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
  END

  --if the record already exists, then update the quantity of item and all the dependent fields
  IF @cur_qty_left IS NOT NULL BEGIN
     --If any of the parameter values are NULL, then replace with existing values
     SELECT @grade_cd = COALESCE(@grade_cd, @cur_grade_cd), @status_cd = COALESCE(@status_cd, @cur_grade_cd)
     	, @cur_qty_left_erp = COALESCE(@cur_qty_left_erp, 0), @expiry_date = COALESCE(@expiry_date, @cur_expiry_date), @seq_no = COALESCE(@seq_no, @cur_seq_no)

     IF (@wo_id IS NULL) OR (@wo_id = '') SET @wo_id = @cur_wo_id
     IF (@oper_id IS NULL) OR (@oper_id = '') SET @oper_id = @cur_oper_id

     SET @totqty = @cur_qty_left + @add_qty

     -- if adding negative amount such that resulting qty will be 0 and auto_del_zero_inv flag is TRUE then delete the row
     IF (@totqty = 0 AND @cur_auto_del_zero_inv = 1) BEGIN
       DELETE item_inv WHERE row_id = @row_id
       IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
         RAISERROR('SQL Error deleting zero quantity from item_inv table: %d{3223}', 16, 1, @@error)
         RETURN -1
       END
     END
     ELSE
     BEGIN
       --SJ 11/04/04 HD#4749 - Use the lower of the current and the expriy date passed in
       IF @cur_expiry_date < @expiry_date
	    SET @expiry_date = @cur_expiry_date

       UPDATE item_inv
       SET  grade_cd = @grade_cd
        ,status_cd = @status_cd
        ,qty_left = @totqty
        ,qty_left_erp = @cur_qty_left_erp + @add_qty_erp
        ,date_in_local = @date_in_local
		,date_in_utc = @date_in_utc
        ,date_out_local = @cur_date_out_local
		,date_out_utc = @cur_date_out_utc
        ,last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
        ,expiry_date = @expiry_date
        ,wo_id = @wo_id
        ,oper_id = @oper_id
        ,seq_no = @seq_no
		,last_edit_comment = @transfer_comments
       WHERE  row_id = @row_id
       IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
         RAISERROR('SQL Error updating item_inv table: %d{3293}', 16, 1, @@error)
         RETURN -1
       END
    END
    EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @totqty, 1
    IF @return <> 0 BEGIN
      RETURN -1
    END
  END
  ELSE BEGIN
	EXEC SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADDLOTSUBLOT @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @grade_cd,@status_cd

    -- Find grade and status codes from inventory if the input values are NULL.
	EXEC sp_S_Item_Inv_GetGradeAndStatus @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @grade_cd OUTPUT, @status_cd OUTPUT

    --Row does not exist, insert a new one
    -- Added "sublot_no," and "@sublot_no," to following statement 1/9/07 KRF
    INSERT INTO item_inv (ent_id, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, grade_cd, status_cd, qty_left, qty_left_erp,uom_id,
	date_in_local, date_in_utc, date_out_local, date_out_utc, expiry_date, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
	spare5, spare6,last_edit_by, last_edit_at,last_edit_comment)
      VALUES (@ent_id, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @add_qty, @add_qty_erp,@uom_id,
        @date_in_local, @date_in_utc, NULL, NULL, @expiry_date, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4,
	@spare5, @spare6, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at,@transfer_comments)

    --Return error if insertion fails
    IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
      RAISERROR('SQL Error inserting into item_inv table: %d{3209}', 16, 1, @@error)
      RETURN -1
    END
    -- 10/26/2002    TC	1.5.0	Include row_id as an output parameter to return the ID of the row updated or inserted
    select @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    SET @totqty =  @add_qty
    EXEC @return =  SP_U_Storage_Exec_UpdateStatus @ent_id, @totqty, 1
    IF @return <> 0 BEGIN
       RETURN -1
    END
  END

  -- log inventory transfers only if this is a pure inventory transaction. ie, do not log inventory transfers
 -- if the inventory adjustment is from production or consumption.
  IF (@log_transfer = 0) RETURN
  --Get Log_Inventory Transfers system_attr
  SELECT @log_trans = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 198
  --if update or insert was successful then, check if the log_trans is 'true', if yes then insert a new row in item_transfer table
  IF (@log_trans = 1) BEGIN
	-- Added "sublot_no," and "@sublot_no," to following statement 1/9/07 KRF
	-- Added expiry date, from_spare1, from_spare2, from_spare3, from_spare4, from_spare5, from_spare6 for CR L00121141(Merge CRL00121833)
	INSERT INTO item_transfer (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, from_ent_id, to_ent_id,
            qty_txd, uom_id, qty_txd_erp, goods_received,
            goods_shipped, grade_cd, status_cd, comments, transfer_by, transfer_time_utc, transfer_time_local,
            expiry_date, from_spare1, from_spare2, from_spare3, from_spare4, from_spare5, from_spare6)
      VALUES (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @from_ent_id, @ent_id,
            @add_qty, @uom_id, @add_qty_erp, @goods_received,
            0, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @transfer_comments, @last_edit_by, @transfer_time_utc, @transfer_time,
            @expiry_date, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @spare5, @spare6)

    --return error if insertion fails
    IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
      RAISERROR('Inventory insert successful but SQL Error inserting into item_transfer table: %d{3294}', 16, 1, @@error)
      RETURN -1
    END
  END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis]
(@item_id			STRING80
,@to_lot_no			STRING80
,@to_sublot_no		STRING80
,@to_ent_id			INT32
,@qty_prod			TFLOAT	OUTPUT
,@int_qty_prod			TFLOAT	OUTPUT
,@good_prod_num_decimals	INT32	OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis
-- Description		- Used to round the qtys to a number of decimals specified for an item. If item.num_decimals = 0,
--			  then the system parameter is checked whether the current item supports fractional pieces.
-- Author		- Raghu
-- Date Created		- 05/09/2005
-- Version (last edit)	-  2.1.0.21
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Ver    		Changes
--09/15/2006	Raghu		3.1.2.22		If the no. of decimals for an item is > 0, then return the item decimals as is and the qty produced as is..
--01/24/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE	 @item_num_decimals		INT32
	,@tot_qty_prod			TFLOAT

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	SELECT @qty_prod = @qty_prod, @int_qty_prod = 0, @good_prod_num_decimals = 0

	--Check if the supplied item can have decimal values.
	SELECT @item_num_decimals = num_decimals FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id

	IF (@item_num_decimals = 0) BEGIN
		--Check the system attribute to determine whether this item can produce fractional pieces.
		SELECT @good_prod_num_decimals = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(attr_value) = 1 THEN CONVERT(INT, attr_value)
						ELSE 0 END
		FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 326

		SET @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0)

		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0) BEGIN
			--Round the current production qty to a number of decimals allowed.
			SET @qty_prod = ROUND(@qty_prod, @good_prod_num_decimals)

			--Do we need to check for to_ent_id as well along with the lot_no for an item ?
			--If no, and if we are concerned only about the LOT !, then for eg., a first 0.7 piece is produced at Entity 1211, LOT A
			--and a second piece of 0.5 is produced at Entity: 5843, LOT A
			--Now, which inventory entity receives the 1 whole unit of production (Entity 1211 or 5843 ?)
			--Check this with Keith.
		  	SELECT @tot_qty_prod = SUM(qty_prod)
			FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND (lot_no = @to_lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @to_lot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (sublot_no = @to_sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @to_sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_id IS NULL))

			SET @tot_qty_prod = ISNULL(@tot_qty_prod, 0)
			SET @int_qty_prod = CONVERT(INT, @tot_qty_prod)
			SET @int_qty_prod = CONVERT(INT, (@tot_qty_prod + @qty_prod)) - @int_qty_prod
		END
		ELSE --System attribute (=326) determines fraction of piece parts are not allowed. Round to item.num_decimals
			SET @qty_prod  = ROUND(@qty_prod, @item_num_decimals)
	END -- Round to item.num_decimals
	ELSE  SELECT @qty_prod  = ROUND(@qty_prod, @item_num_decimals)
		,@int_qty_prod = ROUND(@qty_prod, @item_num_decimals)
		,@good_prod_num_decimals = @item_num_decimals
END

create FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetHexaColorCode]
(@color	int
) RETURNS NVARCHAR(40) AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - [fn_GetHexaColorCode]
-- Description       - Return the color code in hexa value by passing the int color code
-- Author			 - Adnan
-- Date Created      - 1/02/2024
-- Version			 - 1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

DECLARE	@color_code nvarchar(40)

	--Return NULL if the supplied item grade description is null.
	IF (@color IS NULL) RETURN NULL

	--Query the item grade code for the supplied item grade description
SELECT @color_code =
			'#'        + CONVERT(varchar(6),
            CAST(ABS(@color) as varbinary(1))
            + CAST(ABS(@color/256) as varbinary(1))
            + CAST(ABS(@color/256/256) as varbinary(1))
        , 2)

	--Return the ID of the supplied item grade.
	RETURN @color_code
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Lot_GetAvailSNos]
(
		@item_id         STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@serial_no       STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_LOT_GETAVAILSNOS
-- Description          - Case: 7.1.5 - Get a list of available serial nos that are not assigned to any work order.
-- Author          -       Raghu
-- Date Created          -    03/08/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.0.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change inv_lot_attr_item_id to inv_lot_attr_item_id_h.
--09/04/2007	AML			3.3.0	Ported to Sql Server from Oracle.
--01/17/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00073518; Serial numbers are not showing in the ..
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

    SELECT DISTINCT l.item_id, i.item_desc, l.lot_no, l.spare1, l.spare2, l.spare3, l.spare4, L.row_id, ila.*
    FROM lot l WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			l.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN inv_lot_attr ila WITH (NOLOCK) ON
			ila.inv_lot_item_id_h = l.item_id AND
			ila.inv_lot_lot_no_h = l.lot_no
    WHERE (l.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
     AND (l.lot_no LIKE @serial_no OR @serial_no IS NULL)
     AND l.is_serial_no = 1
     AND (l.item_id + ' - ' + l.lot_no)
        --Exclude serial nos that are already assigned to a work order.
        NOT IN (SELECT al.item_id + ' - ' + al.lot_no FROM assigned_lot al WITH (NOLOCK)
                WHERE (al.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
                 AND (al.lot_no LIKE @serial_no OR @serial_no IS NULL))

/*
     --AND (l.item_id, l.lot_no)
	 --Exclude serial nos that are already assigned to a work order.
	 AND l.item_id IN (SELECT al.item_id FROM assigned_lot al WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (al.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND (al.lot_no LIKE @serial_no OR @serial_no IS NULL))
	 AND l.lot_no IN (SELECT al.lot_no FROM assigned_lot al WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (al.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND (al.lot_no LIKE @serial_no OR @serial_no IS NULL))
*/
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_shift_sched_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[shift_sched]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_shift_sched_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on shift_sched table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--03/05/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00075055; On change of shift got "No Shift" despit...
--06/24/2008    Raghu       3.5     CR# 75765, Sidus 2 Broadway Task ID: (3130,3131,3133) Change shifts to use local time instead of GMT.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
			,@ent_id		INT32
			,@start_day		INT32
			,@shift_id		INT32
			,@start_time	DATETIME
			,@end_time		DATETIME
			,@days_ahead	INT32
			,@v_current_time	DATETIME
			--,@use_gmt		INT32

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	--EXEC SP_SA_SYSTEM_ATTR_USEGMT @use_gmt=@use_gmt

	SET @v_current_time = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )

	DECLARE shift_sched_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ss.ent_id, ss.start_day, ss.shift_id, ss.start_time, ss.end_time
	FROM shift_sched ss WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN inserted i ON ss.ent_id = i.ent_id AND ss.start_day = i.start_day AND ss.shift_id = i.shift_id

	OPEN shift_sched_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM shift_sched_cursor into @ent_id, @start_day, @shift_id, @start_time, @end_time
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF UPDATE(START_TIME) OR UPDATE(END_TIME) OR UPDATE(BREAK1_START) OR UPDATE(BREAK1_END)
			OR UPDATE(BREAK2_START) OR UPDATE(BREAK2_END) OR UPDATE(BREAK3_START) OR UPDATE(BREAK3_END) BEGIN

			SET @start_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @v_current_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @start_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
			SET @end_time = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(11), @v_current_time, 120) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @end_time, 120), 12, 9), 120)
			SET @days_ahead = DATEDIFF(D, @start_time, @end_time)
			SELECT @start_time = @start_time -1, @days_ahead = @days_ahead + 4

			--Call the refresh shift sched procedure to populate all template shifts for an entity.
			EXEC SP_U_ENT_SCHEDULESHIFTS @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_start_time=@start_time
				, @in_days_ahead=@days_ahead, @in_time_zone_bias_value=0
		END

		UPDATE shift_sched SET shift_sched.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, shift_sched.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		WHERE shift_sched.ent_id = @ent_id AND shift_sched.start_day = @start_day AND shift_sched.shift_id = @shift_id
	END
	CLOSE shift_sched_cursor
	DEALLOCATE shift_sched_cursor
END

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Author:		Sivakumar SB
-- Create date: 06/06/2022
-- Description:	Get Segement Entity for the process
-- Eg. : exec sp_SA_ofi_GetAreaEntity @Seg=N'Segment'
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	AP				2022-12-23			Updated order by 
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetAreaEntity]
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Seg NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @t TABLE
	(
		ent_id            INT
	  , ent_name          NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , attr_id           INT
	  , attr_value        NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , notes             NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , attr_desc         NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , predefined        INT
	  , data_type         INT
	  , entry_type        INT
	  , visible_in_queue  INT
	  , visible_in_inv    INT
	  , last_edit_comment NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , last_edit_by      NVARCHAR(MAX)
	  , last_edit_at      DATETIME
	);
	INSERT INTO @t
	EXEC sp_SA_Ent_Attr
		 @ent_id = NULL
	   , @ent_name = NULL
	   , @site_name = NULL
	   , @attr_id = NULL
	   , @attr_desc = NULL
	   , @attr_value = @Seg
	   , @last_edit_by = NULL
	   , @last_edit_at = NULL

	SELECT DISTINCT
		e.ent_id
	  , e.description as 'ent_name'
	FROM @t t 
	inner join ent e WITH (NOLOCK) on e.ent_id= t.ent_id AND can_track_oee=1
	ORDER BY
		ent_name
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Wo]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
  @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver   Changes
-- 04/01/2003     Raghu        1.6.0 Included 'state_cd' field in Select clause - part of DB changes (V1.6)
-- 10/14/2005     Raghu        3.1.0 HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/23/2007     Raghu        3.2.0 Part of DB Changes
-- 07/16/2007     Raghu        3.3.1 HD# 10081, Replace release_time, req_finish_time with *_utc, *_local.
-- 10/31/2007     AML          3.4.0 DB Changes
-- 01/04/2007     Raghu              L00073441, L00073464 - Mod_Id was not converted properly.
-- 07/17/2009     SLR          4.0.0 DB Changes
-- 08/22/2009     Raghu        4.0.0 DB Changes
-- 05/03/2013     Raghu        4.6   UserStory: 158300 - Return the new target_sched_line_id and queue_seq_no columns from the wo table.
-- 05/31/2013     Raghu        4.6   UserStory: 179529 - Return the production counts for the line, if the work order is assigned to a line.
-- 02/26/2014     SLR          5.0   Add num_decimals and num_decimal_good_pp to the return dataset
-- 04/25/2014     Raghu        5.0   UserStory: 320537 - As Bruce, I want to get the line name for the line assigned to a particular WO to facilitate management of WO.
-- 01/27/2015     KRF          5.1   User story 439593 - If 1 first op., get starting quantity from 1st jobs, convert to last item's quantities if needed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

DECLARE @line_id          INT32 -- The line (if any) to which the work order is scheduled
	   ,@num_first_ops    INT32 -- The number of first operations in the work order
	   ,@prod_pos         INT32 -- The production position in the line (if any); null if @line_id is null
	   ,@wo_uom           INT32 -- The UOM ID of the item that is the work order's final product
	   ,@min_factor       TFLOAT -- The minimum conversion factor
	   ,@num_non_final    INT32 -- The number of jobs where final_job = 0
	   ,@err_msg          NVARCHAR(4000)

SELECT @num_first_ops = 1 -- Assume for now work order is scheduled to a line
-- Get the number of non-final jobs - if 0 then the absence of a non_final_qtys.qty_rejected value does not signal a missing conversion and it should be treated as 0
SELECT @num_non_final = COUNT(*) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND final_job = 0

SELECT @line_id = target_sched_line_id FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
IF @line_id IS NOT NULL
	SELECT DISTINCT @prod_pos = lel.child_order
    FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = lel.line_id
	AND ((l.prod_ent_id = lel.ent_id) OR
	    (l.prod_ent_id IS NULL AND lel.ent_id = (SELECT MIN(ent_id) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND
	    child_order = (SELECT MAX(child_order) FROM line_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = lel.line_id AND line_is_child = 0))))
	WHERE l.line_id = @line_id
ELSE
	SELECT @num_first_ops = COUNT(DISTINCT oper_id) FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND first_job = 1

SELECT @wo_uom = uom_id from item i WITH (NOLOCK) join wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = w.item_id where w.wo_id = @wo_id

-- If wo assigned to a line and there are missing conversions return an error
IF @line_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN
-- If work order is assigned to a line and there are missing conversions for rejects or good production or for the first position (for starting quantity), return an error
	;WITH factors AS (
		-- Get the conversions related to reject production items at or before the production position if defined
		SELECT factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = @line_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.qty_rejected <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> @wo_uom -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		AND lel.child_order <= @prod_pos
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions related to good production items at the production position if defined
		SELECT factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = @line_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.qty_prod <> 0 AND i.uom_id <> @wo_uom -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		AND lel.child_order = @prod_pos
		UNION
		-- Get the conversions related to starting quantity
		SELECT factor = COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 0)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
		LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND i.uom_id <> @wo_uom -- Last condition is to cover the case where something using the work order item's UOM is produced, for which there will be no conversion
		AND j.first_job = 1
	)
	SELECT @min_factor = MIN(factor) from factors WITH (NOLOCK)
	IF @min_factor = 0 BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'There is a quantity of an item for a job of work order %1 having a unit of measure for which there is no conversion to that of the final item for the work order, so it cannot be normalized and totaled.{3005},'+@wo_id
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
END

-- conv contains the conversion factors from any item to the work order's final item; missing = 1 if these are 1 and 0 because there's a difference in the UOM but no conversion exists
; WITH conv AS (
	-- Get conversion factors for the items of any jobs at the production position where there is good production, and at reject positions where there is reject production, and at the first postion if there's only one first operation
	SELECT j.item_id, MAX(COALESCE(uc_specific.factor, uc_generic.factor, 1)) AS factor, MAX(COALESCE(uc_specific.offset, uc_generic.offset, 0)) AS offset, MAX(CASE WHEN uc_specific.factor IS NULL AND uc_generic.factor IS NULL AND i.uom_id <> @wo_uom THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_specific WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_specific.from_uom_id AND uc_specific.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_specific.item_id = j.item_id
	LEFT JOIN uom_conv uc_generic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uc_generic.from_uom_id AND uc_generic.to_uom_id = @wo_uom AND uc_generic.item_id IS NULL
	LEFT JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, target_sched_ent_id) = lel.ent_id AND lel.line_id = @line_id
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
	AND ( -- Conversion for good production
	        (j.qty_prod <> 0 AND ((@prod_pos IS NULL AND j.final_job = 1) OR (@prod_pos IS NOT NULL AND lel.child_order = @prod_pos)))
		OR -- Conversions for reject production
		    (j.qty_rejected <> 0 AND (@prod_pos IS NULL OR (@prod_pos IS NOT NULL AND lel.child_order <= @prod_pos)))
		OR -- Conversions for starting quantities
		    (@num_first_ops = 1 AND j.first_job = 1)
		)
	GROUP BY j.item_id
)
SELECT wo.wo_id
      ,wo.wo_desc
      ,wo.process_id
      ,wo.bom_ver_id
      ,wo.spec_ver_id
      ,wo.item_id
      ,wo_item.item_desc
      ,wo_item.uom_id
      ,uom.description AS uom_desc
      ,wo_item.num_decimals
      ,(Select CONVERT(INT,attr_value) from system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_id = 326) as num_decimals_good_pp
      ,wo.req_qty
      ,wo.release_time_utc
      ,wo.release_time_local
      ,wo.req_finish_time_utc
      ,wo.req_finish_time_local
      ,wo.state_cd
      ,wo.wo_priority
      ,wo.cust_info
      ,wo.mo_id
      ,wo.production_schedule_id
      ,wo.notes
      ,wo.not_deletable
      ,wo.disassembly
      ,wo.may_override_route
      ,wo.override_serialization
      ,wo.input_wo_id
      ,wo.input_oper_id
      ,wo.input_seq_no
      ,wo.target_sched_line_id
      ,l.line_name AS target_sched_line_name
      ,wo.queue_seq_no
      ,dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(wo.wo_id) as wo_status
      --Regardless of whether a work order is assigned to a line or not, the required quantity comes from the last job(s) in the work order.
      , COALESCE(final_qtys.qty_reqd, 0) AS qty_reqd
      -- qty_at_start = sum of the qty_at_start fields of the first jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item if necessary,
      -- when there's only one first operation and, if the UOMs of the first and final jobs differ, the conversion exists.
      -- Otherwise first_qtys.qty_at_start will be null and it's the sum of the qty_at_start fields of the final jobs.
      , COALESCE(first_qtys.qty_at_start, final_qtys.qty_at_start, 0) AS qty_at_start
      -- qty_prod = sum of the qty_prod fields of the jobs at the production position, converted to the UOM of the final item if necessary,
      -- when the work order is being run on a line (for which the conversion has been verified to exist).
      -- Otherwise prod_qtys.qty_prod will be null and it's the sum of the qty_prod fields of the last jobs (which need no conversion).
      , COALESCE(prod_qtys.qty_prod, final_qtys.qty_prod, 0) AS qty_prod
      -- qty_rejected = sum of the qty_rejected fields of the jobs at or before the production position, converted to the UOM of the final item if necessary,
      -- when the work order is being run on a line (in which case the existence of the convesion is already verified)
      -- otherwise it's the sum of the qty_rejected fields of all jobs, converted to the UOM of the final item if necessary and the conversions exist.
      -- If any conversion doesn't exist return 0.  Note that if there are no non-final jobs this is just the rejected quantity at the final jobs.
      , COALESCE(rej_qtys.qty_rejected, (CASE WHEN @num_non_final = 0 THEN 0 ELSE non_final_qtys.qty_rejected END + final_qtys.qty_rejected), 0) AS qty_rejected -- This depends on the addition of a null and a non-null being null
      -- Unless there is a missing conversion for a work order not being run on a line, or there's more than one first operation, the remaining quantity is
      -- the greater of 0 or the difference between the qty_at_start and the sum of the qty_prod and qty_rejected), as calculated above except qty_rejected can't have defaulted to 0
      -- If there is a missing conversion or more than one first operation, it is the greater of 0 or the difference between the qty_at_start
      -- (which is the sum of the final jobs' starting quantities) and the sum of qty_prod (also from the final jobs) and the total reject production
      -- of the final jobs.
      , CASE WHEN @num_first_ops = 1 AND first_qtys.missing = 0 AND ((@line_id IS NOT NULL) OR (@line_id IS NULL AND non_final_qtys.missing = 0))
             THEN (CASE WHEN (first_qtys.qty_at_start - (COALESCE(prod_qtys.qty_prod, final_qtys.qty_prod) + COALESCE(rej_qtys.qty_rejected, (non_final_qtys.qty_rejected + final_qtys.qty_rejected)))) > 0
                        THEN (first_qtys.qty_at_start - (COALESCE(prod_qtys.qty_prod, final_qtys.qty_prod) + COALESCE(rej_qtys.qty_rejected, (non_final_qtys.qty_rejected + final_qtys.qty_rejected))))
                        ELSE 0
                   END)
			 ELSE (CASE WHEN (final_qtys.qty_at_start - (final_qtys.qty_prod + final_qtys.qty_rejected)) > 0
                        THEN (final_qtys.qty_at_start - (final_qtys.qty_prod + final_qtys.qty_rejected))
                        ELSE 0
                   END)
        END AS qty_remaining
      -- the remaining required quantity (def_reqd_qty) is always the greater of 0 or the required quantity (qty_reqd) minus the good production quantity (qty_prod), however the latter was calculated
      , CASE WHEN (final_qtys.qty_reqd - COALESCE(prod_qtys.qty_prod, final_qtys.qty_prod)) > 0
             THEN (final_qtys.qty_reqd - COALESCE(prod_qtys.qty_prod, final_qtys.qty_prod))
             ELSE 0
        END AS def_reqd_qty
      ,wo.spare1
      ,wo.spare2
      ,wo.spare3
      ,wo.spare4
      ,wo.last_edit_comment
      ,wo.last_edit_by
      ,wo.last_edit_at
      ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, wo.mod_id))) mod_id
	FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item wo_item WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.item_id = wo_item.item_id
	INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON  wo_item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN line l WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo.target_sched_line_id = l.line_id
	-- Get the required, start, good, and reject production at the last entites
	-- Note these never have to be converted to the UOM of the final item because the last jobs make the final item
	-- Use LEFT OUTER join in case work order has no jobs at all
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, SUM(j.qty_reqd) AS qty_reqd, SUM(j.qty_at_start) AS qty_at_start, SUM(j.qty_prod) AS qty_prod
				       , SUM(j.qty_rejected) AS qty_rejected
		  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		  WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.final_job = 1
		  GROUP BY j.wo_id
		) final_qtys ON wo.wo_id = final_qtys.wo_id
	-- Get the starting quantities of the first jobs if there's only one first op and it can be converted to the final item's UOM
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, CASE WHEN MAX(conv.missing) = 0 AND @num_first_ops = 1 THEN SUM(j.qty_at_start * conv.factor + conv.offset) ELSE NULL END AS qty_at_start, MAX(conv.missing) AS missing
		  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		  INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	      LEFT OUTER JOIN conv conv ON j.item_id = conv.item_id
		  WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.first_job = 1
		  GROUP BY j.wo_id
		) first_qtys ON wo.wo_id = first_qtys.wo_id
	-- Get the reject quantities from all jobs that are not last
	-- Use LEFT OUTER join in case work order has no jobs at all (but this also picks up the case of one-operation work orders, where none are non-final)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, CASE WHEN MAX(conv.missing) = 0 THEN SUM(j.qty_rejected * conv.factor + conv.offset) ELSE NULL END AS qty_rejected, MAX(conv.missing) AS missing
		  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		  INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
	      LEFT OUTER JOIN conv conv ON j.item_id = conv.item_id
		  WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.final_job = 0
		  GROUP BY j.wo_id
		) non_final_qtys ON wo.wo_id = non_final_qtys.wo_id
	-- Get the good production at the production entities, converting to the final item's UOM
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, SUM(j.qty_prod * conv.factor + conv.offset) AS qty_prod
		  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		  INNER JOIN wo wo2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo2.wo_id
	      INNER JOIN conv conv ON j.item_id = conv.item_id
		  --Limit to the lines (line_id's) that have work orders assigned to them, and the entities in the line on which the jobs ran.
		  --This join should return the list of lines and the corresponding entities identified as the source of production.
		  --If a job hasn't started on the entity (or entities identified as the source of production, then use target_sched_ent_id to determine the entities linked to a line to determine the quantities.
		  INNER JOIN line_ent_link job_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo2.target_sched_line_id = job_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = job_ents.ent_id
		  WHERE wo2.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL AND wo2.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_ents.child_order = @prod_pos
		  GROUP BY j.wo_id
		  --Limit the work orders to the set of work orders returned by the main query
		) prod_qtys ON wo.wo_id = prod_qtys.wo_id
	-- Get the reject production from all jobs running on the production entities
	-- and all jobs running on any entity upstream from the production entities.
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT j.wo_id, SUM(j.qty_rejected * conv.factor + conv.offset) AS qty_rejected
		  FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		  INNER JOIN wo wo2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = wo2.wo_id
	      INNER JOIN conv conv ON j.item_id = conv.item_id
		  --Limit the lines (line_id's) that have work orders assigned to them, and the entities in the line on which the jobs ran.
		  --This join should return the list of lines and the corresponding entities identified as the source of production or entities
		  --prior to the production entity in the line.
		  --If a job hasn't started on the entity (or entities identified as the source of production, then use target_sched_ent_id to determine the entities linked to a line to determine the quantities.
		  INNER JOIN line_ent_link job_ents WITH (NOLOCK) ON wo2.target_sched_line_id = job_ents.line_id AND COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id) = job_ents.ent_id
		  WHERE wo2.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL AND wo2.wo_id = @wo_id AND job_ents.child_order <= @prod_pos
		  GROUP BY j.wo_id
		  --Limit the work orders to the set of work orders returned by the main query
		) rej_qtys ON wo.wo_id = rej_qtys.wo_id
WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_sa_item_prod_getprodbyfiltr]
(
	@wo_id                   STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no                  INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_id                INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_start_start       TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_start_end         TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@shift_start_utc_start	 TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,       @shift_start_utc_end	 TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,   @hour_start_start        TDATETIME_NULL = NULL---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
,   @hour_start_end          TDATETIME_NULL = NULL---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
,	@item_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@item_desc               STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no                  STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@rm_lot_no               STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no               STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@rm_sublot_no            STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@reas_cd                 INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@grade_cd                INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@status_cd               INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@run_ent_id              INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@storage_ent_id          INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@qty_min                 INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@qty_max                 INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@user_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@user_desc               STRING80_NULL = NULL
,	@ext_ref                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@good_prod               INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@processed_flag          INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@byproduct               LOGICAL = 0
,	@move_status             INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Job_Route]
  (@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @seq_no int ,
   @input_oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @input_seq_no int ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version        - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
--03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
--07/02/2014	Raghu		5.0	Userstory: 325629 - As Jack, I want to prohibit MES client from making changes to work orders assigned to lines that would make them incompatible with the line to which they were assigned so that I do not create a problem for the Web client (Part 1)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @upstream_ent_name	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@downstream_ent_name	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@line_name		NVARCHAR(80)
BEGIN

DELETE job_route
WHERE (wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
	AND  (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
	AND  (seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
	AND  (input_oper_id = @input_oper_id OR @input_oper_id IS NULL)
	AND  (input_seq_no = @input_seq_no OR @input_seq_no IS NULL)
	AND  (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4),CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
--       CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id)

EXEC sp_U_Wo_ValJobRteWithLineRte @wo_id = @wo_id, @upstream_ent_name = @upstream_ent_name OUTPUT, @downstream_ent_name	= @downstream_ent_name OUTPUT

IF (@upstream_ent_name IS NOT NULL OR @downstream_ent_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @line_name = l.line_name
	FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
	WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

	SET @err_msg = 'The work order: %1 is currently assigned to line: %2. The job route cannot be removed, because the sequence of entities (upstream entity: %3, downstream entity: %4) in the job route do not match with the sequence of entities in the line route.{7915},' + @wo_id + ',' + @line_name + ',' + @upstream_ent_name + ',' + @downstream_ent_name
	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
	RETURN
END
END

	,	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_GetByFilter
-- Description					- Returns all data_log_16 and data_log_48 records optionally filtered by the supplied parameters
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 07/19/2005
-- Version (last edit)			- 2.1.24

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 09/28/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 07/05/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- 11/27/2009		Eswar			4.0			HF1432 - Part of Date/Time changes.
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @tz_temp				INT
		,	@sample_time_start_utc	DATETIME
		,	@sample_time_end_utc	DATETIME
		,	@shift_start_utc		DATETIME
		,	@shift_end_utc			DATETIME
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32

    SET @sample_time_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@sample_time_start_tz)
    SET @sample_time_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@sample_time_end_tz)
    SET @shift_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_tz)
    SET @shift_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_end_tz)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_GetByFilter', @src_key='post_validate', @date_val1 = @sample_time_start_local, @numeric_val1 = @sample_time_start_tz,
					 @date_val2 = @sample_time_end_local, @numeric_val2 = @sample_time_end_tz,
					 @date_val3 = @shift_start_local, @numeric_val3 = @shift_start_tz,
					 @date_val4 = @shift_end_local, @numeric_val4 = @shift_end_tz

    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	/*
	IF ( @sample_time_start IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @sample_time_start = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sample_time_start )
	END

	IF ( @sample_time_end IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @sample_time_end = DATEADD( mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sample_time_end )
	END
	*/

	SET @tz_temp = -@sample_time_start_tz
	IF (@sample_time_start_local IS NOT NULL) EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @sample_time_start_local, @tz_temp, @sample_time_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@sample_time_end_tz
	IF (@sample_time_end_local IS NOT NULL) EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @sample_time_end_local, @tz_temp, @sample_time_end_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_tz
	IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL) EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_utc OUTPUT
	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_end_tz
	IF (@shift_end_local IS NOT NULL) EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_end_local, @tz_temp, @shift_end_utc OUTPUT

	SELECT	dl16.grp_id, dl16.sample_time_utc, dl16.sample_time_local
		,	dl16.wo_id, dl16.oper_id, dl16.seq_no, dl16.step_no, dl16.item_id, dl16.lot_no
		,	dl16.shift_start_utc, dl16.shift_start_local, dl16.shift_id, dl16.ent_id
		, 	dl16.genealogy_id, dl16.segment_requirement_id, dl16.segment_response_id, value1, value2, value3, value4
		,	value5, value6, value7, value8, value9, value10, value11, value12, value13, value14
		,	value15, value16, null AS value17, null AS value18, null AS value19, null AS value20
		,	null AS value21, null AS value22, null AS value23, null AS value24, null AS value25
		,	null AS value26, null AS value27, null AS value28, null AS value29, null AS value30
		,	null AS value31, null AS value32, null AS value33, null AS value34, null AS value35
		,	null AS value36, null AS value37, null AS value38, null AS value39, null AS value40
		,	null AS value41, null AS value42, null AS value43, null AS value44, null AS value45
		,	null AS value46, null AS value47, null AS value48, i.item_desc, dlg.grp_desc, e.ent_name
		,	dl16.last_edit_at, dl16.row_id, 'data_log_16' AS table_name
	FROM data_log_16 dl16 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) ON dl16.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN data_log_grp_ent_link dlgel WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgel.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON dl16.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON dl16.wo_id = wo.wo_id AND wo.state_cd <> 3
	WHERE	(dl16.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.sample_time_utc >= @sample_time_start_utc OR @sample_time_start_utc IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.sample_time_utc <= @sample_time_end_utc OR @sample_time_end_utc IS NULL)
		AND (UPPER(dl16.wo_id) LIKE UPPER(@wo_id) OR @wo_id IS NULL)
		AND (UPPER(dl16.oper_id) LIKE UPPER(@oper_id) OR @oper_id IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
		AND (UPPER(dl16.item_id) LIKE UPPER(@item_id) OR @item_id IS NULL)
		AND (UPPER(dl16.lot_no) LIKE UPPER(@lot_no) OR @lot_no IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL)
		AND (dl16.shift_start_utc <= @shift_end_utc OR @shift_end_utc IS NULL)

	UNION

	SELECT	dl48.grp_id, dl48.sample_time_utc, dl48.sample_time_local, dl48.wo_id, dl48.oper_id, dl48.seq_no
		,	dl48.step_no, dl48.item_id, dl48.lot_no, dl48.shift_start_utc, dl48.shift_start_local
		,	dl48.shift_id, dl48.ent_id, dl48.genealogy_id, dl48.segment_requirement_id, dl48.segment_response_id
		, 	value1 , value2 , value3 , value4 , value5 , value6 , value7 , value8
		,	value9, value10, value11, value12, value13, value14, value15, value16, value17, value18, value19
		,	value20, value21, value22, value23, value24, value25, value26, value27, value28, value29, value30
		,	value31, value32, value33, value34, value35, value36, value37, value38, value39, value40, value41
		,	value42, value43, value44, value45, value46, value47, value48, i.item_desc, dlg.grp_desc, e.ent_name
		,	dl48.last_edit_at, dl48.row_id, 'data_log_48' AS table_name
	FROM data_log_48 dl48 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) ON dl48.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN data_log_grp_ent_link dlgel WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgel.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgel.ent_id = e.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON dl48.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN wo wo WITH (NOLOCK) ON dl48.wo_id = wo.wo_id AND wo.state_cd <> 3
	WHERE	(dl48.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL)
		AND (dl48.sample_time_utc >= @sample_time_start_utc OR @sample_time_start_utc IS NULL)
		AND (dl48.sample_time_utc <= @sample_time_end_utc OR @sample_time_end_utc IS NULL)

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_Job_Step_TotalPrevStepGrps]
(@step_grp_id	INT32,
@step_count	INT32 OUTPUT
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
select @step_count = count(*)
	from job_step job_step LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step_data job_step_data
	ON job_step.wo_id = job_step_data.wo_id
		and job_step.oper_id = job_step_data.oper_id
		and job_step.seq_no = job_step_data.seq_no
		and job_step.step_no = job_step_data.step_no
	WHERE 	job_step.step_grp_id < @step_grp_id
		and ((job_step_data.state_cd IS NULL) or (job_step_data.state_cd <> 4 and job_step_data.state_cd <> 8))
END

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_selection]
(
	
	@pwo_id	                    [dbo].[STRING40]  = NULL  ,					
	@poper_id					[dbo].[STRING40]=	  NULL,
	@pseq_no					[dbo].[INT32]	=	 NULL,
	@pitem_id					[dbo].[STRING40]	=  NULL,
	@pent_id					[dbo].[INT32]		= NULL,
	@precipe_id					[dbo].[STRING40]=	 NULL,
	@pversion_id				[dbo].[INT32]		= NULL,
	@pdest_type					[NVARCHAR]	(40)	=  NULL,	
	@pis_chk					[bit]	= NULL,	
	@pstorage_ent_id			[dbo].[INT32]	= NULL,
	@psilo_item_id				[dbo].[STRING40]	= NULL,
	@psilo_grade_cd				[dbo].[INT32]	= NULL, -- Newly Added
	@psilo_item_group			[dbo].[STRING40]	= NULL, -- Newly Added
	@pdsc_qty					[dbo].[TFLOAT]=	 NULL,
	@pmes_qty					[dbo].[TFLOAT]	= NULL,
	--@pstatus					[dbo].[INT32]	 NULL,
	@psecondary_silo			[dbo].[STRING40]	= NULL,
	@psecondary_silo_ent_id		[dbo].[STRING40]=	 NULL,
	@pratio						[dbo].[TFLOAT]	= NULL,
	@pis_disabled				[int]	= NULL,	
	@psilo_automation_status	[int]	= NULL,	
	@psilo_seq                  [int]	= NULL,	
	--@pspare1					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
	--@pspare2					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
	--@pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
	--@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
	@pcreated_by				[NVARCHAR]	(40)=  NULL,	
	--@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
	--@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
	@plast_edit_by				[NVARCHAR]	(40) =NULL
) 

AS
BEGIN

declare @pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME],	
		@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME],
		@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME],	
		@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME],
		
			  @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
             ,@strModuleName nvarchar(80) = 'JOM_SiloSelection'
             ,@strFunctionName nvarchar(80) = 'UI'
             ,@strActivityMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			 ,@strCommentMsg nvarchar(200) = ''
			 ,@iRowId  int,
			 @silo_item_id varchar(40)
            


set @pcreated_at_utc = GETUTCDATE(); set  @plast_edit_at_utc = GETUTCDATE();
set @pcreated_at_local = GETDATE(); set @plast_edit_at_local = GETDATE();
--select @silo_item_id = item_id from item where  item_desc =@psilo_item_id  --- Get the Silo item id
IF(@psecondary_silo IS NULL ) SET @psecondary_silo = '';

	---- 0.01.02 Start
		-- If destination type is 2 (destination storage unit)
		if(TRIM(@pdest_type) = '2')
		BEGIN
			DECLARE 
				@MaxDestAllAttrID INT,
				@MaxAllowedEntity INT = 99999,
				@ConfiguredEntity INT,
				@ExistingStorgeUnit bit;

		
			if exists (select wo_id from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] with (nolock) where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id )
				set @ExistingStorgeUnit = 1;
			else
				set @ExistingStorgeUnit = 0;

			--Skip the maximum allowed storage unit check if modifying an existing  storage unit
			if(@ExistingStorgeUnit = 0)
			BEGIN

				select @MaxDestAllAttrID = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaxDestinationSUAllowed' and attr_grp = 8

				select @MaxAllowedEntity = pa.attr_value 
				from process_attr pa with (nolock) 
				INNER JOIN wo with (nolock) on pa.process_id = wo.process_id
				WHERE
					wo.wo_id = @pwo_id
					and pa.attr_id = @MaxDestAllAttrID

				select @ConfiguredEntity = count(*) 
				from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] with (nolock)
				where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id <> @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id ;

				if(@ConfiguredEntity >= @MaxAllowedEntity)
				begin
					select 0 as result, '@@MoreThanMaxAllowedDest@@' as resultCode;  -- 'Maximum ' + CAST(@MaxAllowedEntity as nvarchar) + ' destination storage units allowed'  as resultCode;
					return;
				end
			END

			----Don't allow the modification if job state is running
			--  ##0.01.04  DS 
			--IF eXISTS(select wo_id from job with (nolock) where wo_id = @pwo_id and oper_id = @poper_id and seq_no = @pseq_no AND state_cd = 3)
			--BEGIN
			--	select 0 as result, '@@JobRunningError@@' as resultCode;  -- 'Destination storage is not allowing for a running work order'  as resultCode;
			--	return;
			--END
		END
	---- 0.01.02 END


	BEGIN TRY

	--IF( @pwo_id IS NOT NULL OR @poper_id IS NOT  NULL )

	---Remove this receipt ID because it is coming Null  - Praveen
    --if exists (select * from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and storage_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id )
				if exists (select * from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id )
				BEGIN

				set  @strActivityMsg	= 'update'
				set  @strCommentMsg		= 'Updated into [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]'
				---Remove this receipt ID because it is coming Null  - Praveen
				--select @iRowId = row_id from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and storage_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id
				select @iRowId = row_id from [dbo].[ofi_su_selection] where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id
				UPDATE [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
				SET 
				 [is_chk]					= @pis_chk
				,[secondary_silo]			= @psecondary_silo
				,[secondary_silo_ent_id]	= @psecondary_silo_ent_id
				,[ratio]					= @pratio
				,[last_edit_at_utc]			= @plast_edit_at_utc
				,[last_edit_at_local]		= @plast_edit_at_local
				,[last_edit_by]				= @plast_edit_by
				,[active_su_ent_id]			=@pstorage_ent_id
				,[silo_seq]	        		=@psilo_seq

				---Remove this receipt ID because it is coming Null  - Praveen
				--where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and storage_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id and recipe_id =@precipe_id
				where wo_id =@pwo_id  and oper_id= @poper_id and seq_no =@pseq_no and su_ent_id = @pstorage_ent_id 
				--SET @iRowId = @@IDENTITY
				END
		else if(@pis_chk =1)
				BEGIN

					set  @strActivityMsg	= 'add'
					set  @strCommentMsg		= 'Inserted into [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]'

					INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
					   ([wo_id]
					   ,[oper_id]
					   ,[seq_no]
					   ,[parent_item_id]
					   ,[jb_item_id]
					   ,[jb_grade_cd]
					   ,[jb_item_group]
					   ,[ent_id]
					   ,[recipe_id]
					   ,[version_id]
					   ,[dest_type]
					   ,[is_chk]
					   ,[su_ent_id]
					   --,[status]
					   ,[is_active]
					   ,[secondary_silo]
					   ,[secondary_silo_ent_id]
