CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Result_AddXML] (
@sample_id     INT32,
@char_id     INT32,
@operator      nvarchar(40)=null,
@created_at_utc DATETIME = NULL,
@results        nvarchar(MAX),
@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0,
@control_rule_violations NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
/*
Notes: The value_order must always be supplied to this stored procedure.
If there is no value_no, do not include the value_no in the XML.

Example XML
'<results>
	<result value_order = "1" result_value="4.032">
		<result_attr attr_desc="Thickness1" value="1.032" notes="my notes1" />
		<result_attr attr_desc="Color1" value="blue" notes="my notes2" />
	</result>
	<result value_order = "2" result_value="4.032" act_sample_size="1">
		<result_attr attr_desc="Thickness2" value="1.032" notes="my notes1" />
		<result_attr attr_desc="Color2" value="blue" notes="my notes2" />
	</result>
	<result value_order = "3" value_no="2" result_value="4.032">
		<result_attr attr_desc="Thickness3" value="1.032" notes="my notes1" />
		<result_attr attr_desc="Color3" value="blue" notes="my notes2" />
	</result>
</results>'

If there are no result attributes then an empty result_attr node must be supplied.  I.e. <result_attr />
For Example
'<results>
	<result value_order = "1" result_value="4.032" act_sample_size="2">
		<result_attr />
	</result>
</results>'

*/

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                    - SP_U_Result_AddXML
-- Description                    - Inserts Results and Result_Attrs from xml
-- Author                         - JA
-- Date Created                   - 6/24/2011
-- Version (last edit)            -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By        Ver			Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 01/10//2012      Johnny							User Story 46705 changes
-- 03/16/2012		Ibrahim							Fix for the CR L00119390
-- 14/06/2012		Ahmed							Modified as per changes in sp_U_Result_Attr
-- 11/07/2019		RWB					6.2.0		Story 1184121 - Added a created_at_utc tag in the XML so that the created at
--													time for each result can be specified
-- 06/18/2020	Raghu	6.2	US:1330922 - As Lenka, I want to analyze and address performance issues with QM web API methods
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
   @value_no int,
   @cur_value_order int,
   @result_value float,
   @attr_id int,
   @attr_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @notes nvarchar(max) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime,
   @doc_handle  int,
   @records_count INT32,
   @counter INT32,
   @validate_control_rules LOGICAL,
   @value_order INT32,
   @cur_value_no   INT32,
   @act_sample_size INT32,
   @char_type       INT32,
   @maximum_sample_size INT32,
   @char_maximum_sample_size INT32,
   @spec_maximum_sample_size  INT32,
   @num_results   INT32,
   @max_value_order  INT32,
   @is_superseded   smallint

BEGIN
   DECLARE @created_by  nvarchar(80)

   SET @created_at_utc = COALESCE(@created_at_utc, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ) )
   SET @validate_control_rules = 0
   SET @cur_value_order=-1;

   SELECT @char_type = c.type
          ,@char_maximum_sample_size=c.maximum_sample_size
   FROM characteristic c WITH (NOLOCK)
   WHERE c.char_id = @char_id;

   IF @char_type =0 -- Variable
    BEGIN
      SELECT @spec_maximum_sample_size = qscl.maximum_sample_size
      FROM sample_char_link scl WITH (NOLOCK)
         LEFT OUTER JOIN qm_spec_char_link qscl WITH (NOLOCK) ON scl.qm_spec_id = qscl.qm_spec_id AND scl.char_id = qscl.char_id
      WHERE scl.sample_id = @sample_id
           AND scl.char_id = @char_id;

        SET @maximum_sample_size = COALESCE(@spec_maximum_sample_size, @char_maximum_sample_size);
    END

   IF @operator is not null
     SET @created_by=@operator
   ELSE
     EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @created_by OUTPUT, NULL

   --Do not validate control rules for each result that is inserted into the database.  Do the validation at the end of the last record.
   SET @counter = 0
   -- The value order where inserting results/result attributes will stop
   SET @max_value_order=NULL

   EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @results


	SELECT @records_count = COUNT(*)
	 FROM   OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/results/result',1)
         WITH  (value_order int
              ) r

   DECLARE result_cursor CURSOR READ_ONLY FAST_FORWARD FOR
      SELECT  value_order, value_no, result_value, act_sample_size, attr.attr_id, attr_value, notes
      FROM   OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/results/result/result_attr',2)
         WITH  (value_order int   '../@value_order',
		          value_no  int             '../@value_no',
                result_value float        '../@result_value',
                act_sample_size int        '../@act_sample_size',
                attr_desc  varchar(400)   '@attr_desc',
                attr_value nvarchar(1700) '@value',
                notes     nvarchar(max)   '@notes'
              ) r
      LEFT OUTER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON r.attr_desc=attr.attr_desc AND attr.attr_grp=11
      ORDER BY r.value_order

   OPEN result_cursor
   WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
      FETCH NEXT FROM result_cursor INTO @value_order, @value_no, @result_value, @act_sample_size, @attr_id,@attr_value,@notes
      IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 OR @value_order>@max_value_order ) BREAK

      IF @value_order <> @cur_value_order BEGIN
	      SELECT @counter = @counter + 1, @cur_value_order = @value_order, @cur_value_no = @value_no


         SET @is_superseded=0
         IF   EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result WITH (NOLOCK)
                   WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
                   AND char_id = @char_id
                    AND value_no = @value_no
                  )
            SET @is_superseded=1

         IF  @char_type=0 AND @is_superseded=0   --Variable Type Characteristic
          BEGIN
             SELECT @num_results = COUNT(*)
             FROM result r WITH (NOLOCK)
             WHERE r.sample_id = @sample_id
                AND r.char_id = @char_id
                AND r.superseded = 0;

             -- Do not do anything if maximum is reached at the first record
             IF @counter=1 AND @num_results=@maximum_sample_size BREAK;

             -- Validate controls if maximum sample size is about to be reached
             IF  @num_results = @maximum_sample_size-1
                BEGIN
                  SET @validate_control_rules = 1
                  SET @max_value_order=@cur_value_order -- set the current value order as the last to be processed; see BREAK.
               END
          END

         --If this is the last record being inserted into the database from the XML, set the validate_control_rules_flag to true to validate the control rules.
         IF (@counter = @records_count) SET @validate_control_rules = 1

   	   EXECUTE sp_I_Result @sample_id = @sample_id, @char_id = @char_id, @value_no = @cur_value_no OUTPUT, @result_value = @result_value,
	  	    	@act_sample_size = @act_sample_size, @created_by = @created_by, @created_at_utc = @created_at_utc, @created_at_local = NULL, @created_at_tz = null,
		   	@superseded = null, @last_edit_comment = null, @validate_control_rules = @validate_control_rules,
		   	@time_zone_bias_value = @time_zone_bias_value, @last_edit_at = NULL,
		   	@row_id = NULL, @control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations OUTPUT
       END

   	 IF (@attr_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
      		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM result_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id=@sample_id AND char_id=@char_id and value_no=@cur_value_no and attr_id=@attr_id)
         		EXECUTE sp_U_result_attr @sample_id=@sample_id, @char_id=@char_id, @value_no=@cur_value_no, @attr_id=@attr_id, @attr_value=@attr_value, @notes=@notes, @last_edit_comment=null,@last_edit_at=null
            ELSE
         		EXECUTE sp_I_result_attr @sample_id=@sample_id, @char_id=@char_id, @value_no=@cur_value_no, @attr_id=@attr_id, @attr_value=@attr_value, @notes=@notes, @last_edit_comment=null, @last_edit_at=@last_edit_at OUTPUT

     END
   END
   CLOSE result_cursor
   DEALLOCATE result_cursor
   EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Po_Line]
(
	@po_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@po_line_no int ,
	@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
	@vendor_item_id nvarchar(40) ,

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_U_Po_Line
-- Description      - Update an existing row in the table
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            - SP requires that all table fields be included
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/10/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/02/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE @reqd_by_utc	DATETIME
	,	@tz_temp		INT

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

UPDATE po_line

	reqd_by_local = @reqd_by_local,	-- Added 08/02/2007 AML
    spare1 = @spare1,
    spare2 = @spare2,
    spare3 = @spare3,
    spare4 = @spare4,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE 	(po_id = @po_id AND
        po_line_no = @po_line_no AND
        last_edit_at = @last_edit_at)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_SA_HierarchicalReasons]
(

,	@in_raw_reas_cd 	STRING40_NULL = NULL
)
RETURNS
@outputReasons	TABLE(reas_grp_id int, reas_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, reas_cd int, reas_desc varchar(80)
						, p0_grp_id int, p0_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p1_grp_id int, p1_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p2_grp_id int, p2_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p3_grp_id int, p3_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p4_grp_id int, p4_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p5_grp_id int, p5_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p6_grp_id int, p6_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p7_grp_id int, p7_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p8_grp_id int, p8_grp_desc varchar(80)
						, p9_grp_id int, p9_grp_desc varchar(80),
						level_num int null)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - fn_SA_HierarchicalReasons
-- Description       -
-- Author            -
-- Date Created      -
-- Version           - 3.4
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @ent_id				INT32
		,	@raw_reas_cd 		STRING40
		,	@can_capture_util 	LOGICAL
		,	@StoO_selcnt		INT32


	SET @ent_id = @in_ent_id
	SET @raw_reas_cd = @in_raw_reas_cd

	IF @raw_reas_cd IS NULL BEGIN
		SELECT @raw_reas_cd = cur_raw_reas_cd
		FROM util_exec
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	IF ( @raw_reas_cd IS NULL ) BEGIN
	--Modified by Raghu on 08/14/2002. Order By clause modified. Changed to display_seq, description
		SET @raw_reas_cd = -1
	END


	SELECT @StoO_selcnt = 1
	FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link, util_reas util_reas,
		 util_reas_grp util_reas_grp
	WHERE (util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd) AND
		  (util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id) AND
		  ( ( (util_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id) AND (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd)))

	IF ( @StoO_selcnt <> 1 ) BEGIN
		SET @StoO_selcnt = 0
	END

DECLARE @reasons	TABLE(reas_grp_id int, reas_grp_desc varchar(80), reas_grp_display_seq int
						, reas_cd int, reas_desc varchar(80), reas_display_seq int
						, p1_grp_id int, p1_grp_desc varchar(80), p1_grp_disp_seq int
						, p2_grp_id int, p2_grp_desc varchar(80), p2_grp_disp_seq int
						, p3_grp_id int, p3_grp_desc varchar(80), p3_grp_disp_seq int
						, p4_grp_id int, p4_grp_desc varchar(80), p4_grp_disp_seq int
						, p5_grp_id int, p5_grp_desc varchar(80), p5_grp_disp_seq int
						, p6_grp_id int, p6_grp_desc varchar(80), p6_grp_disp_seq int
						, p7_grp_id int, p7_grp_desc varchar(80), p7_grp_disp_seq int
						, p8_grp_id int, p8_grp_desc varchar(80), p8_grp_disp_seq int
						, p9_grp_id int, p9_grp_desc varchar(80), p9_grp_disp_seq int)
	IF @StoO_selcnt <> 0 BEGIN

		insert into @reasons
		(reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc, reas_grp_display_seq
		, reas_cd, reas_desc, reas_display_seq
		, p1_grp_id, p1_grp_desc, p1_grp_disp_seq
		, p2_grp_id, p2_grp_desc, p2_grp_disp_seq
		, p3_grp_id, p3_grp_desc, p3_grp_disp_seq
		, p4_grp_id, p4_grp_desc, p4_grp_disp_seq
		, p5_grp_id, p5_grp_desc, p5_grp_disp_seq
		, p6_grp_id, p6_grp_desc, p6_grp_disp_seq
		, p7_grp_id, p7_grp_desc, p7_grp_disp_seq
		, p8_grp_id, p8_grp_desc, p8_grp_disp_seq
		, p9_grp_id, p9_grp_desc, p9_grp_disp_seq)
		SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
			,  util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
			,  util_reas_grp.display_seq
			,  util_reas.reas_cd
			,  util_reas.reas_desc
			,  util_reas.display_seq
			,  parent_urg1.reas_grp_id as p1_grp_id, parent_urg1.reas_grp_desc as p1_grp_desc, parent_urg1.display_seq as p1_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg2.reas_grp_id as p2_grp_id, parent_urg2.reas_grp_desc as p2_grp_desc, parent_urg2.display_seq as p2_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg3.reas_grp_id as p3_grp_id, parent_urg3.reas_grp_desc as p3_grp_desc, parent_urg3.display_seq as p3_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg4.reas_grp_id as p4_grp_id, parent_urg4.reas_grp_desc as p4_grp_desc, parent_urg4.display_seq as p4_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg5.reas_grp_id as p5_grp_id, parent_urg5.reas_grp_desc as p5_grp_desc, parent_urg5.display_seq as p5_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg6.reas_grp_id as p6_grp_id, parent_urg6.reas_grp_desc as p6_grp_desc, parent_urg6.display_seq as p6_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg7.reas_grp_id as p7_grp_id, parent_urg7.reas_grp_desc as p7_grp_desc, parent_urg7.display_seq as p7_grp_disp_seq
			,  parent_urg8.reas_grp_id as p8_grp_id, parent_urg8.reas_grp_desc as p8_grp_desc, parent_urg8.display_seq as p8_grp_disp_seq

		FROM util_reas_link util_reas_link
			INNER JOIN util_reas util_reas ON util_reas_link.reas_cd = util_reas.reas_cd
			INNER JOIN util_reas_grp util_reas_grp ON util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id = util_reas.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON util_reas_grp.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg1.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg1.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg2.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg3 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg2.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg3.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg4 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg3.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg4.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg5 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg4.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg5.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg6 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg5.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg6.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg7 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg6.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg7.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg8 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg7.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg8.reas_grp_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas_grp parent_urg9 WITH (NOLOCK) ON parent_urg8.parent_reas_grp_id = parent_urg9.reas_grp_id
		WHERE (((util_reas_link.ent_id = @ent_id) AND (util_reas_link.raw_reas_cd = @raw_reas_cd)))

	END ELSE BEGIN

		insert into @reasons
		(reas_grp_id, reas_grp_desc, reas_grp_display_seq
		, reas_cd, reas_desc, reas_display_seq
		, p1_grp_id, p1_grp_desc, p1_grp_disp_seq
		, p2_grp_id, p2_grp_desc, p2_grp_disp_seq
		, p3_grp_id, p3_grp_desc, p3_grp_disp_seq
		, p4_grp_id, p4_grp_desc, p4_grp_disp_seq
		, p5_grp_id, p5_grp_desc, p5_grp_disp_seq
		, p6_grp_id, p6_grp_desc, p6_grp_disp_seq
		, p7_grp_id, p7_grp_desc, p7_grp_disp_seq
		, p8_grp_id, p8_grp_desc, p8_grp_disp_seq
		, p9_grp_id, p9_grp_desc, p9_grp_disp_seq)
		SELECT util_reas_grp.reas_grp_id
			,  util_reas_grp.reas_grp_desc
			,  util_reas_grp.display_seq
			,  util_reas.reas_cd

--09/05/2007	AML			3.3.0		DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT	shipment_lot.cust_id
	,	shipment_lot.po_id
	,	shipment_lot.so_line_no
	,	shipment_lot.ship_date_utc
	,	shipment_lot.ship_date_local
	,	DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, shipment_lot.ship_date_utc ) AS ship_date
	,	shipment_lot.lot_no
	,	shipment_lot.sublot_no
	,	shipment_lot.qty_shipped
	,	shipment_lot.uom_id
	,	uom.description
	,	shipment_lot.trans_id
	,	cust.cust_name
	,	shipment_lot.last_edit_comment
	,	shipment_lot.last_edit_by
	,	shipment_lot.last_edit_at
	,	shipment_lot.mod_id
	,	shipment_lot.row_id
FROM shipment_lot WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cust cust WITH (NOLOCK) ON shipment_lot.cust_id = cust.cust_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON shipment_lot.uom_id = uom.uom_id
WHERE (
	(shipment_lot.cust_id = @cust_id OR @cust_id IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.po_id = @po_id OR @po_id IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.so_line_no = @so_line_no OR @so_line_no IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.ship_date_utc = @ship_date_utc OR @ship_date_utc IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.ship_date_local = @ship_date_local OR @ship_date_local IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.trans_id = @trans_id OR @trans_id IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
	(shipment_lot.row_id >= @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY cust.cust_name , shipment_lot.po_id , shipment_lot.so_line_no

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetUtilLoss]
	 @ent_id AS INT
	,@UtilPer float OUTPUT 
	,@util_down INT OUTPUT 
	,@util_running INT OUTPUT 

AS
	-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
	-- Name:			sp_S_ofi_GETUtilLoss  -
	-- Description:	    Get the Utlization data percentage
	--
	-- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
	--eg. EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_GetUtilLoss] 319
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
	-- 0.01.00			Anup			2023-01-20						Find the performance percentage
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Counter datetime ,@counter1 datetime ,@total_time_count float,@unutilized_time_count float 

SELECT @Counter=cur_shift_start_time_utc from ent WITH (NOLOCK) where   ent_id=@ent_id
set @counter1=getUTCdate()
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpUtilSeconds') IS NOT NULL
       BEGIN
              DROP TABLE #tmpUtilSeconds
       END
 CREATE TABLE #tmpUtilSeconds
       (
              fromSec  datetime
         , toSec datetime, ent_id int)

WHILE ( @Counter <= @counter1)
BEGIN
    Insert into #tmpUtilSeconds
	 select @counter,DATEADD(SECOND,1, @Counter ), @ent_id
    SET @Counter  =DATEADD(SECOND,1, @Counter )
END


--Get the totalk time in sec
SELECT @total_time_count=CAST(COUNT(fromSec) AS DECIMAL(12,2))  from #tmpUtilSeconds

-- Get the unutilized  time for the shift .
select @unutilized_time_count=CAST(COUNT(ts.fromSec) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) 
from ent e WITH (NOLOCK)  join #tmpUtilSeconds ts on e.ent_id = ts.ent_id and e.ent_id=@ent_id and not exists (select 1 from job_history jh with(nolock) where jh.ent_id=e.ent_id 
																		and ((jh.job_start_utc>=e.cur_shift_start_time_utc 
																			or jh.job_end_utc is null 
																			or jh.job_end_utc between e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
																									and e.cur_shift_end_time_utc)
																		and ts.fromSec   between jh.job_start_utc and isnull(jh.job_end_utc,@counter1)
																		)) 
																		and (
																		 not exists (select 1 from job j with(nolock) where j.target_sched_ent_id = e.ent_id
																		and ts.fromSec  between j.sched_start_time_utc and ISNULL(j.sched_finish_time_utc,@counter1)
																		and j.sched_start_time_utc>e.cur_shift_start_time_utc)) 

drop table #tmpUtilSeconds;

SET @UtilPer =CAST( (@total_time_count-@unutilized_time_count)/@total_time_count AS DECIMAL(12,2)) 
SET @util_running=@total_time_count-@unutilized_time_count
SET @util_down=@unutilized_time_count
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Inv_AddByName]
(@ent_name		STRING80
,@site_name		STRING80
,@item_id			STRING40
,@lot_no				STRING40
,@sublot_no          STRING40
,@grade_desc	STRING80
,@status_desc	STRING80
,@add_qty			TFLOAT
,@add_qty_erp		TFLOAT
,@add_qty_uom_desc	STRING80
,@date_in_local		TDATETIME
,@date_in_tz		INT32 = NULL
,@expiry_date		TDATETIME
,@wo_id				STRING40
,@oper_id			STRING40
,@seq_no				INT32
,@from_ent_name		STRING80
,@from_site_name	STRING80
,@spare1				STRING80
,@spare2				STRING80
,@spare3				STRING80
,@spare4				STRING80
,@spare5				STRING80
,@spare6				STRING80
,@goods_received		LOGICAL
,@checkGradeStatus	LOGICAL = NULL
,@transfer_comments	STRING254 = NULL
,@log_transfer		INT32 = 1
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL
,@row_id		INT32 OUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - sp_I_Item_Inv_Add
-- Description            -
-- Author				- Raghu
--						Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version			 - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 11/11/2009	  Eswar			4.0			HF 1432 - datetime changes.
-- 05/03/2010	  Nicky			4.0			Unit of measure conversions
--10/29/2012    Praveen         4.6    Passed null value for the stored procedure SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADD(for the CR122433)
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
-- 02/17/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1187825-As Bruce, I want a Web API to process ItemInv records so I can interact with inventory
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

   SET @date_in_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_in_tz)
	SET @date_in_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@date_in_local, @date_in_tz)

    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	DECLARE @ent_id			INT32
		,@from_ent_id		INT32
		,@grade_cd		INT32
		,@status_cd		INT32
		,@dbg_resp		INT32
		,@qty_uom_id	INT32
		,@dest_uom_id	INT32
		,@factor			TFLOAT
		,@offset			TFLOAT
		,@err_msg		NVARCHAR(2000)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Item_Inv_AddByName', @src_key='on_entry', @date_val1 = @date_in_local, @numeric_val1 = @date_in_tz

	SELECT @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)
		,@from_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@from_ent_name, @from_site_name)
		,@grade_cd = dbo.fn_GetItemGradeCode(@grade_desc)
		,@status_cd = dbo.fn_GetItemStatusCode(@status_desc)
		,@qty_uom_id = dbo.fn_GetUOMId(@add_qty_uom_desc)

	if(@grade_cd IS NULL AND @grade_desc IS NOT NULL AND @grade_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'grade:' + @grade_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@status_cd IS NULL AND @status_desc IS NOT NULL AND @status_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'status:' + @status_cd
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@qty_uom_id IS NULL AND @add_qty_uom_desc IS NOT NULL AND @add_qty_uom_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'uom description:' + @add_qty_uom_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	--Convert the quantity to the correct unit
	--Get the uom of the destination entity
	select @dest_uom_id = item_inv.uom_id
		from item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
		where item_inv.item_id = @item_id and item_inv.ent_id = @ent_id and item_inv.lot_no = @lot_no

	if(@dest_uom_id is null)
	begin
	--there was none specified at the destination entity get the uom id from the default item uom
	select @dest_uom_id = item.uom_id
		from item WITH (NOLOCK)
		where item.item_id = @item_id
	end

	--Convert the quantities to the correct value based on the source and destination UOM's
	exec dbo.sp_S_II_GetUOMConvParams @factor output, @offset output, @qty_uom_id, @dest_uom_id, @item_id
	set @add_qty = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@add_qty, @factor, @offset)
	--set @add_qty_erp = dbo.fn_ConvertQty(@add_qty_erp, @factor, @offset)

	EXEC sp_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @grade_cd=@grade_cd, @status_cd=@status_cd, @add_qty=@add_qty, @add_qty_erp=@add_qty_erp
			, @date_in_local=@date_in_local, @date_in_tz=@date_in_tz, @expiry_date=@expiry_date, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @uom_id=@qty_uom_id
			, @spare1=@spare1, @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4, @spare5=@spare5, @spare6=@spare6, @goods_received=@goods_received, @checkgradestatus=@checkgradestatus
			, @transfer_comments=@transfer_comments, @log_transfer=@log_transfer, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @date_in_utc=NULL, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ScheduleJobDistribution_SetUpTime_LeadTime]
(
@sessionid int
,@user_name nvarchar(50)
--@scheduleDay datetime = '2017-02-15',

)
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE
  @starttime datetime
, @endtime datetime
, @UpdEndTime datetime
, @MaxSeq int
, @MaxJob int
, @scheduleDay datetime
, @ent_id NVARCHAR(50) = 116
 
--select * from SDB.[SCH].[ent_planned_downtime] where cast(start_time as date) = cast(@starttime as date)
select top 1 @scheduleDay = cast(wo_release_time as Date) from sdb..scheduler_exec where session_id = @sessionid


DECLARE @JobstoUpdate TABLE ( 
									Seq int,
									StartTime datetime,
									EndTime datetime,
									Qty float,
									WoId nvarchar(40),
									MoId nvarchar(40),
									Schedule_Sequence int,
									ItemId int,
									Operid nvarchar(40),
									JobSeqNo int,
									ent_id int,
									NewStartTime datetime,
									NewEndTime datetime,
									LineSpeed float,
									Duration float )

DECLARE @Downtime TABLE (			Seq int,
									StartTime datetime,
									EndTime datetime,
									ent_id int )

DECLARE @SetUpTime Table(			cost decimal,
									SetUpTime decimal,
									ItemId int,
									NxtItemId int)
-- select * from sdb.SCH.item_ent_speed
insert into @JobstoUpdate (Seq,StartTime, EndTime,Qty, WoId,MoId,Schedule_Sequence,ItemId,Operid,JobSeqNo,ent_id,NewStartTime,NewEndTime,LineSpeed,duration)
	select  
	row# 
	,		job_latest_start_time
	,		job_req_finished_time 
	,		req_qty 
	,		wo_id
	,		mo_id
	,		schedule_sequence
	,		item_id     
	,		oper_id   
	,		job_seq_no
	,		job_sched_entity_id
--	,		case when row# = 1 then job_latest_start_time else null end --dummy
--	,		case when row# = 1 then DATEADD(minute,duration,job_latest_start_time) else null end --dummy
	,		case when row# = 1 then CONVERT(datetime, wo_release_time) else null end --dummy
	,		case when row# = 1 then DATEADD(minute,duration,CONVERT(datetime, wo_release_time)) else null end --dummy
	,		line_speed
	,		duration FROM (
	select  
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SE.job_sched_entity_id ORDER BY ISNULL(AR.spNum1,100) ASC, ISNULL(AR.spNum2,100) ASC, SE.job_latest_start_time ASC) as row# 
	,		SE.job_latest_start_time
	,		SE.job_req_finished_time
	,		SE.req_qty  
	,		SE.wo_id
	,		SE.mo_id
	,		SE.schedule_sequence  
	,		SE.item_id   
	,		SE.oper_id   
	,		SE.job_seq_no
	,		SE.job_sched_entity_id
	,		SE.wo_release_time
	,		LSPD.line_speed
	,		(SE.req_qty/ISNULL(LSPD.line_speed,1)) Duration, AR.spNum1 as [Priority]
	from SDB..scheduler_exec SE
	left join sdb.SCH.item_ent_speed LSPD ON LSPD.item_id = SE.item_id AND LSPD.ent_id = SE.job_sched_entity_id
	left join SDB.[SCH].item_grp_item  IGI ON SE.item_id = IGI.itemid
	left join SDB.[SCH].[Item_Grp_Attr] IGA ON  IGA.item_grp_id = IGI.ItemGrpId  
	left join SDB.[SCH].[Attr] A ON  A.id = IGA.[attr_id] 
	left join SDB.[SCH].[attr_rules] AR ON A.Type = AR.spTxt1Src and AR.sptxt1 = IGA.[attr_value] and AR.[Type] = 'Job Seq'
	where --SE.job_sched_entity_id = @ent_id and 
	--CONVERT(date, SE.job_latest_start_time) = CONVERT(date, @scheduleDay)  --and job_seq_no = 31
	session_id = @sessionid
	and job_latest_start_time is not null and SE.req_qty > 0 and LSPD.line_speed is not null) JobT 


--get the lst of workorder items from the complete list
;with item_list as ( Select Distinct(itemid) as itemid from @JobstoUpdate)
, item_grp_item_list as ( select igi.* from SDB.SCH.item_grp_item igi inner join item_list il on il.itemid = igi.itemid)

		Insert into @SetUpTime(Cost, SetUpTime, ItemId, NxtItemId)
		select AR.spNum1 as cost, AR.spNum2 as setuptime, IGI.ItemID, IGINxt.ItemId NxtItem from SDB.[SCH].[attr_rules] AR
		INNER JOIN SDB.[SCH].[Item_Grp_Attr] IGA ON  AR.sptxt1 = IGA.[attr_value]
		INNER JOIN SDB.[SCH].[Attr] A ON  A.id = IGA.[attr_id] and A.Type = AR.spTxt1Src
		INNER JOIN SDB.SCH.item_grp  IG ON IGA.item_grp_id = IG.id
		INNER JOIN SDB.[SCH].[Item_Grp_Attr] IGANxt ON  AR.sptxt2 = IGANxt.[attr_value]
		INNER JOIN SDB.[SCH].[Attr] ANxt ON  ANxt.id = IGANxt.[attr_id] and ANxt.Type = AR.spTxt2Src  
		INNER JOIN SDB.SCH.item_grp  IGNxt ON IGANxt.item_grp_id = IGNxt.id
		INNER JOIN item_grp_item_list  IGI ON IG.id = IGI.itemgrpid
		INNER JOIN item_grp_item_list  IGINxt ON IGNxt.id = IGINxt.itemgrpid
		where AR.[type] = 'SetUpTime'


insert into @Downtime(Seq,StartTime, EndTime, ent_id)
			select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY start_time ASC) as row# ,start_time, end_time, ent_id from SDB.[SCH].[ent_planned_downtime] where CONVERT(date, start_time) = CONVERT(date, @scheduleDay) 
			--and ent_id = @ent_id


select @MaxSeq = ISNULL(max(seq),0) from @Downtime
select @MaxJob = ISNULL(max(seq),0) from @JobstoUpdate


DECLARE @incDT int = 1, @incJob int = 1

WHILE (@incJob <= @MaxJob)
BEGIN

		WHILE (@incDT <= @MaxSeq)

		BEGIN
			--select 'A',* from @JobstoUpdate
			/*	
				SELECT @starttime = StartTime, @endtime = EndTime from @Downtime where seq = @incDT
				Update @JobstoUpdate
					SET		NewStartTime = Case When @starttime > NewStartTime and @endtime < NewEndTime then NewStartTime
												When @starttime < NewStartTime and @endtime < NewEndTime and @endtime > NewStartTime then @endtime
												When @starttime > NewStartTime and @starttime < NewEndTime and @endtime > NewEndTime then NewStartTime
												When @starttime < NewStartTime and @endtime > NewEndTime then @endtime
												else  NewStartTime end
							,NewEndTime = Case When @starttime > NewStartTime and @endtime < NewEndTime then DATEADD (ss, (DATEDIFF(ss,@starttime,@endtime)), NewEndTime)
												When @starttime < NewStartTime and @endtime < NewEndTime and @endtime > NewStartTime then DATEADD (ss, (DATEDIFF(ss,NewStartTime,@endtime)), NewEndTime)
												When @starttime > NewStartTime and @starttime < NewEndTime and @endtime > EndTime then DATEADD (ss, (DATEDIFF(ss,@starttime,NewEndTime)), @endtime)
												When @starttime < NewStartTime and @endtime > NewEndTime then DATEADD (ss, (DATEDIFF(ss,NewStartTime,NewEndTime)), @endtime)
												else  NewEndTime end 
							
							WHERE seq = @incJob

			*/


					Update @JobstoUpdate
					SET		NewStartTime = Case When DT.starttime > JU.NewStartTime and DT.endtime < JU.NewEndTime then JU.NewStartTime
												When DT.starttime <= JU.NewStartTime and DT.endtime < JU.NewEndTime and DT.endtime > JU.NewStartTime then DT.endtime
												When DT.starttime > JU.NewStartTime and DT.starttime < JU.NewEndTime and DT.endtime > JU.NewEndTime then JU.NewStartTime
												When DT.starttime <= JU.NewStartTime and DT.endtime >= JU.NewEndTime then DT.endtime
												else  NewStartTime end
							,NewEndTime = Case When DT.starttime > JU.NewStartTime and DT.endtime < JU.NewEndTime then DATEADD (MINUTE, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,DT.starttime,DT.endtime)), JU.NewEndTime)
												When DT.starttime <= JU.NewStartTime and DT.endtime < JU.NewEndTime and DT.endtime > JU.NewStartTime then DATEADD (MINUTE, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,JU.NewStartTime,DT.endtime)), JU.NewEndTime)
												When DT.starttime > JU.NewStartTime and DT.starttime < JU.NewEndTime and DT.endtime > JU.NewEndTime then DATEADD (MINUTE, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,DT.starttime,JU.NewEndTime)), DT.endtime)
												When DT.starttime <= JU.NewStartTime and DT.endtime >= JU.NewEndTime then DATEADD (MINUTE, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE,JU.NewStartTime,JU.NewEndTime)), DT.endtime)
												else  NewEndTime end 
												
												FROM @JobstoUpdate JU
												LEFT JOIN @Downtime DT ON JU.ent_id = DT.ent_id AND DT.Seq = @incDT
							
							WHERE JU.seq = @incJob

				SET @incDT = @incDT + 1
			--select 'B',* from @JobstoUpdate	
		 END

		 
		 --Select TOP 1 @UpdEndTime = NewEndTime from @JobstoUpdate where seq = @incJob
		 
		 Update JUNxt SET JUNxt.NewStartTime = DATEADD(MINUTE,ISNULL(SUT.SetUpTime,0),ISNULL(JU.NewEndTime, JU.EndTime))
		 , JUNxt.NewEndTime = DATEADD(MINUTE,JUNxt.Duration + ISNULL(SUT.SetUpTime,0),ISNULL(JU.NewEndTime, JU.EndTime))
		 
		 FROM @JobstoUpdate JUNxt  
		 INNER JOIN @JobstoUpdate JU ON JU.ent_id = JUNxt.ent_id AND JU.Seq + 1 = JUNxt.Seq
		 LEFT JOIN @SetUpTime SUT ON JU.ItemId = SUT.ItemId and JUNxt.ItemId = SUT.NxtItemId
		 WHERE  JU.seq = @incJob


		 select 'A',JU.*, SUT.*  
		 FROM @JobstoUpdate JUNxt

-- Name:    sp_s_ei_inv_reclass
-- Description:  Returns inventory reclassified for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-08			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Karthik		2022-09-13			Added logic to obtain data from item_transfer
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-05-05			Changed from and to entity location to 
-- 0.01.03	Karthik		2023-06-27			Grouped qty from multiple entries by lot and report. Refer comments below for this date
-- 0.01.04	Lavkesh		2024-02-21			Added condition to take only item having from_lot_no not null and from item id not equals to to item id
-- 0.01.05	Lavkesh		2024-04-14  		Added condition to take only SAP related item,used variable to check the condition
-- 0.01.05	Lavkesh		2024-04-24  		Added condition to take only SAP related item,used column to check the condition
-- 0.01.06	MC			2025-08-08			Added condition to take only PuO with delivery
-- 0.01.07	MC			2025-10-28			Report reclassification only for SAP wo
-- 0.01.08	MC			2025-12-03			Verification if there is enough production reported to SAP
-- 0.01.09	MC			2026-02-20			Fixed issue with reported qty verification
-- 0.01.10  AML, XPM    2026-06-29			Filter out 'T' traceability sublots
-- ===========================================================================================

-- exec [dbo].[sp_s_ei_inv_reclass_new]
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_inv_reclass] as
begin

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @trans_id int, @plant_code varchar(40), @qty_to_report DECIMAL(18,3)

--(KN 27Jun23) Added below variables
Declare @frm_lot varchar(100), @to_lot varchar(100), @frm_item varchar(100), @to_item varchar(100)

DECLARE @rc INT, @error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@frm_loc varchar(40),@to_loc varchar(40),@frm_ent int,@to_ent int

-- 0.01.07
DECLARE @sap_wo NVARCHAR(10)

BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
	BEGIN

	Set @plant_code = dbo.fn_S_ofi_PlantCode()
	SET @trans_id = NULL
	SET @frm_lot = NULL
	SET @to_lot = NULL
	--Select top 1 @trans_id = trans_id from item_transfer where ISNULL(qty_txd_erp,0) < ISNULL(qty_txd,0) and UPPER(to_spare1) like '%RECLASS%'
	
	--(KN 27Jun23) Assign values for from and to lots and items
	--0.01.09 - rebuilded query for reported qty verification (take reported quantity for original item_id)
	;WITH first_from AS (
    SELECT
        it1.from_lot_no,
        it1.from_item_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY it1.from_lot_no
            ORDER BY it1.trans_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.item_transfer it1 WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE it1.from_lot_no IS NOT NULL
	AND UPPER(it1.comments) LIKE '%RECLASS%'
	AND it1.from_item_id <> it1.item_id
	)
	SELECT TOP(1)
		 @frm_ent = it.from_ent_id,
		@to_ent = it.to_ent_id,
		@frm_lot = it.from_lot_no,
		@to_lot  = it.lot_no,
		@frm_item = it.from_item_id,
		@to_item = it.item_id,
		@sap_wo = w.spare1, -- 0.01.07
		@qty_to_report = SUM(it.qty_txd - it.qty_txd_erp)
	FROM dbo.item_transfer it WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT JOIN dbo.ofi_wo_ext owe WITH (NOLOCK) -- 0.01.06
		ON owe.lot_no = it.lot_no
	   AND owe.wo_id  = it.wo_id
	LEFT JOIN dbo.wo w WITH (NOLOCK) -- 0.01.07
		ON w.wo_id = it.wo_id
	-- adding oryginal item_id to check reported production
	LEFT JOIN first_from ff
		ON ff.from_lot_no = it.from_lot_no
	   AND ff.rn = 1
	-- calculating production sum (from_lot_no, first from_item_id)
	OUTER APPLY (
		SELECT 
			SUM(p.qty_prod_erp) AS sum_qty_prod_erp,
			MAX(p.last_edit_at) AS last_edit_at
		FROM dbo.item_prod p WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE p.lot_no = it.from_lot_no
		  AND p.item_id = ff.from_item_id
		  AND p.good_prod=1
	) prod
	WHERE 
		ISNULL(it.qty_txd_erp, 0) < ISNULL(it.qty_txd, 0)
		AND prod.last_edit_at < DATEADD(minute, -2, GETUTCDATE()) --0.01.08 wait 2min after last modification for selected group
		AND UPPER(it.comments) LIKE '%RECLASS%'
		AND it.from_lot_no IS NOT NULL -- 0.01.04
		AND it.from_item_id <> it.item_id
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM dbo.item i WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE i.item_id = it.from_item_id
			  AND i.item_desc LIKE '%WIP%'
			  AND i.item_class_id = 'INTERMEDIATE'
		) -- 0.01.05
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM dbo.item i2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE i2.item_id = it.item_id
			  AND i2.item_desc LIKE '%WIP%'
			  AND i2.item_class_id = 'INTERMEDIATE'
		)
		AND ( -- 0.01.06
			owe.module IS NULL
			OR owe.module <> 'PO'
			OR (owe.module = 'PO' AND owe.Delivery IS NOT NULL)
		)
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(it.from_sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- 0.01.10
		AND RIGHT(ISNULL(it.sublot_no, ''), 1) <> 'T' -- 0.01.10
		--AND ISNULL(it.from_sublot_no, '') NOT LIKE '%T' -- 0.01.10
		--AND ISNULL(it.sublot_no, '') NOT LIKE '%T' -- 0.01.10
	GROUP BY 
		it.from_ent_id, it.to_ent_id, it.from_lot_no, it.lot_no,
		it.from_item_id, it.item_id, w.spare1, 
		prod.sum_qty_prod_erp, ff.from_item_id
	--HAVING 
	--	SUM(it.qty_txd - it.qty_txd_erp) <= prod.sum_qty_prod_erp
	ORDER BY MAX(it.transfer_time_local) ASC


	--Select @frm_loc = attr_value from system_attr where attr_desc= 'InvFromStorageLocation'
	--Select @to_loc = attr_value from system_attr where attr_desc= 'InvToStorageLocation'

	Select @frm_loc = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock)  where ent_id = @frm_ent and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc like 'SAPLocation')
	Select @to_loc = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock)  where ent_id = @to_ent and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock)  where attr_desc like 'SAPLocation')


	/*(KN 27Jun23) Added new Logic. Grouping by lot_no (sublot_no is ignored). It is presumed that item reclassified from a 'from_lot_no' will always go to the same 'lot_no'
	
	--(KN 27Jun23) Removed the old Logic below
	
	IF @trans_id IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		Select @plant_code From_Plant_Code, @plant_code To_Plant_Code,
		@frm_loc From_Storage_location,@to_loc To_Storage_location,	from_item_id From_Material_Code,
		item_id To_Material_Code, (qty_txd - qty_txd_erp) Qty_reclassified, u.description Unitofmeasure, '309' Movement_type,
		format(transfer_time_utc,'yyyyMMdd') Reclassification_Date, 
		'000000' Reclassification_time, --format(transfer_time_utc,'hhmmss')
		from_lot_no From_SAPBatch_number,lot_no To_SAPBatch_number,
		--'' Filegeneration_date, --format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd')
		'' Filegeneration_time,	--format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')
		'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
		from item_transfer it with (nolock)
		inner join uom u with (nolock) on it.uom_id = u.uom_id
		where trans_id = @trans_id

		Update item_transfer set qty_txd_erp = qty_txd where trans_id = @trans_id
	END
	*/

	IF @frm_lot IS NOT NULL 
	BEGIN
	print 'inside if'
		-- 0.01.07 verification if it is SAP wo
		IF ISNULL(@sap_wo,'0')='1'
		BEGIN
			Select
			@plant_code From_Plant_Code,
			@plant_code To_Plant_Code,
			@frm_loc From_Storage_location,
			@to_loc To_Storage_location,
			from_item_id From_Material_Code,
			item_id To_Material_Code,
			@qty_to_report Qty_reclassified,
			u.description Unitofmeasure,
			'309' Movement_type,
			format(max(transfer_time_utc),'yyyyMMdd') Reclassification_Date, 
			'000000' Reclassification_time,
			from_lot_no From_SAPBatch_number,
			lot_no To_SAPBatch_number,
			'' Filegeneration_time,
			'' Document_Number,
			'' Message,
			'' Message
			from item_transfer it with (nolock)
			inner join uom u with (nolock) on it.uom_id = u.uom_id
			where from_lot_no = @frm_lot and lot_no= @to_lot and from_item_id = @frm_item and item_id = @to_item		---(KN 27Jun23 Same from_lot_no and lot_no combination can be used to reclassify different items)
			AND from_ent_id = @frm_ent AND to_ent_id = @to_ent	--0.01.08 bugfix - to be able aggregate qty there is need to consider all conditions used before
			and qty_txd_erp < qty_txd and UPPER(comments) like '%RECLASS%'
			group by from_item_id,item_id,u.description,from_lot_no,lot_no

			Update item_transfer
			set qty_txd_erp = qty_txd, transfer_time_local=GETDATE(), transfer_time_utc=GETUTCDATE()
			where from_lot_no = @frm_lot and lot_no= @to_lot and from_item_id = @frm_item and item_id = @to_item and qty_txd_erp < qty_txd and UPPER(comments) like '%RECLASS%'
			AND from_ent_id = @frm_ent AND to_ent_id = @to_ent --0.01.08 like above
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- 0.01.07
			Update item_transfer
			set qty_txd_erp = qty_txd, comments = comments + ' - skip report for MES wo', transfer_time_local=GETDATE(), transfer_time_utc=GETUTCDATE()
			where from_lot_no = @frm_lot and lot_no= @to_lot and from_item_id = @frm_item and item_id = @to_item and qty_txd_erp < qty_txd and UPPER(comments) like '%RECLASS%'
			AND from_ent_id = @frm_ent AND to_ent_id = @to_ent --0.01.08 like above
		END
		
	END

	Commit

	END
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
    RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END CATCH

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Lot_GetLotSublotByFiltr]
(
		@item_class_id          STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id                STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no_filter       STRING4000_NULL = NULL

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    -  SP_SA_LOT_GETLOTSUBLOTBYFILTR
-- Description    -  Returna a list of lots, sublots based on the supplied filter.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   -  03/15/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver   Changes
--04/27/2007    Raghu           3.2.10  Modified to have dynamic filter created by the client; and use the supplied filter
--                                      to filter out lots and sublots.
--05/10/2007    Raghu           3.2.12  Eliminate obsolete items from the return list.
--09/07/2007	AML				3.3.0	Ported from Oracle to Sql Server 2000.
--06/19/2020	Surya			6.2.0	Make sure sublot number filter works for single value filter
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
        SELECT DISTINCT l.item_id, l.lot_no, l.grade_cd, l.status_cd, l.expiry_date, l.is_serial_no,
            sl.sublot_no, sl.parent, sl.lvl,
            i.item_desc, ic.item_class_id, ic.item_class_desc
        FROM lot l WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.item_id = i.item_id
        INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN sublot sl WITH (NOLOCK) ON sl.item_id = l.item_id AND sl.lot_no = l.lot_no
        WHERE (ic.item_class_id = @item_class_id OR @item_class_id IS NULL)
          AND (i.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
          AND (l.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
          AND i.obsolete = 0
          AND (sl.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no_filter OR @sublot_no_filter IS NULL)
        ORDER BY ic.item_class_desc, i.item_desc, l.lot_no, sl.lvl, sl.sublot_no;

END

       wo_attr.attr_id = @attr_id)
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Item_Prod_GetProdCount
-- Description	      -	Retrieve a count of production records based on the supplied filter.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	01/16/2006
-- Version	      - 3.1.2.27
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 08/30/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
-- 12/24/2007		AML			3.4.0	DB Changes
-- 02/06/2008		DRT			3.4.0	Fixed created_at arguments to match Oracle
-- 08/22/2009		Raghu		4.0		DB Changes
-- 11/28/2009		Kishore		4.1		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
-- 13/3/2012		siddu       4.0Sp2  OEE Changes are included from 3.5patch2
-- 07/11/2018		Surya		6.0		US#1047941 - As Schneider Electric, I want to merge L00149494 (HF CR L00148797: SR 48912088: Item_prod and Item_cons queries validate the "user_id" parameter passed and will not return all requested rows)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
	--SET @time_zone_bias_value = COALESCE(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
	--IF @shift_start_start IS NOT NULL SET @shift_start_start = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_start)
	--IF @shift_start_end IS NOT NULL SET @shift_start_end = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @shift_start_end)

	DECLARE @tz_temp				INT32
		,	@shift_start_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_end_utc	TDATETIME
        ,   @hour_start_start_utc   TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
        ,   @hour_start_end_utc     TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
		,	@created_at_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@created_at_end_utc		TDATETIME

	SET @shift_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
    SET @hour_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@hour_start_start_tz)
	SET @hour_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@hour_start_end_tz)
   	SET @created_at_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_start_tz)
	SET @created_at_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@created_at_end_tz)
    SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

  DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32
  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Item_Prod_GetProdCount', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @shift_start_start, @numeric_val1 = @shift_start_start_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @shift_start_end, @numeric_val2 = @shift_start_end_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @created_at_start, @numeric_val3 = @created_at_start_tz
					 , @date_val4 = @created_at_end, @numeric_val4 = @created_at_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start, @tz_temp, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@created_at_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_start, @tz_temp, @created_at_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@created_at_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @created_at_end, @tz_temp, @created_at_end_utc OUTPUT

     SET @tz_temp = -@hour_start_start_tz
     EXEC sp_s_getutcdate @hour_start_start, @tz_temp, @hour_start_start_utc OUTPUT---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )

	 SET @tz_temp = -@hour_start_end_tz
     EXEC sp_s_getutcdate @hour_start_end, @tz_temp, @hour_start_end_utc OUTPUT---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )


	SELECT @no_of_prod_records = COUNT(*)
    FROM item_prod ip
		INNER JOIN ent run_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.ent_id = run_ent.ent_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN ent storage_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.to_ent_id = storage_ent.ent_id
		INNER JOIN shift s WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.shift_id = s.shift_id
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN user_name un WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.user_id = un.user_id
    WHERE (ip.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
      AND (ip.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ip.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
	  AND (ip.hour_start_utc >= @hour_start_start_utc OR @hour_start_start_utc IS NULL)---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
      AND (ip.hour_start_utc <= @hour_start_end_utc OR @hour_start_end_utc IS NULL)---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
      AND (ip.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (i.item_desc LIKE @item_desc OR @item_desc IS NULL)
      AND (ip.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ip.rm_lot_no LIKE @rm_lot_no OR @rm_lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ip.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ip.rm_sublot_no LIKE @rm_sublot_no OR @rm_sublot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ip.reas_cd = @reas_cd OR @reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ip.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ip.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL)
      AND (ip.ent_id = @run_ent_id OR @run_ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.to_ent_id = @storage_ent_id OR @storage_ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.qty_prod >= @qty_min OR @qty_min IS NULL)
      AND (ip.qty_prod <= @qty_max OR @qty_max IS NULL)
      AND (ip.user_id LIKE @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL)
      AND (un.user_desc LIKE @user_desc OR @user_desc IS NULL)
      AND (ip.ext_ref LIKE @ext_ref OR @ext_ref IS NULL)
      AND (ip.good_prod = @good_prod OR @good_prod IS NULL)
      AND (ip.processed_flag = @processed_flag OR @processed_flag IS NULL)
      AND (ip.byproduct = @byproduct OR @byproduct IS NULL)
      AND (ip.move_status = @move_status OR @move_status IS NULL)
      AND (ip.genealogy_id LIKE @genealogy_id OR @genealogy_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.event_id LIKE @event_id OR @event_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.segment_requirement_id LIKE @segment_requirement_id OR @segment_requirement_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.segment_response_id LIKE @segment_response_id OR @segment_response_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.comments = @comments or @comments is NULL) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
      AND (ip.spare1 LIKE @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL)
      AND (ip.spare2 LIKE @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL)
      AND (ip.spare3 LIKE @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL)
      AND (ip.spare4 LIKE @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL)
      AND (ip.created_at_utc >= @created_at_start_utc OR @created_at_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ip.created_at_utc <= @created_at_end_utc OR @created_at_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (ip.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_GetEntGrps]
(
	@ent_id	INT32_NULL = NULL
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_GetEntGroups
-- Description					- Walk up thru the Entity Tree and get all data log groups for the entity
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 02/06/2003
-- Version						- 1.5.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version			Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 10/03/2005		Raghu			3.1.0			Part of DB Changes
-- 07/09/2007		AML				3.2.0			Ported to Sql Server 2000
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @cur_ent_id INT
		,	@parent_ent_id INT
		,	@selCount INT

    DECLARE @tblEnt TABLE (
		ent_id INT
	)

	INSERT INTO @tblEnt ( ent_id ) VALUES (	@ent_id )

	SET @cur_ent_id = @ent_id

	WHILE ( 1 = 1 ) BEGIN
		SELECT @parent_ent_id = parent_ent_id FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @cur_ent_id

		IF ( @parent_ent_id IS NULL ) BEGIN
			BREAK
		END

		INSERT INTO @tblEnt ( ent_id ) VALUES ( @parent_ent_id )

		SET @cur_ent_id = @parent_ent_id
	END

	IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM data_log_grp_ent_link a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN @tblEnt b ON a.ent_id = b.ent_id ) BEGIN
		SET @selCount = 1
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @selCount = 0
	END

	IF ( @selCount > 0 ) BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT dlg.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc
		FROM data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN data_log_grp_ent_link dlgel WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlg.grp_id = dlgel.grp_id
			INNER JOIN @tblEnt e ON e.ent_id = dlgel.ent_id
	    ORDER BY dlg.grp_desc
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT grp_id, grp_desc
		FROM data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
		ORDER BY grp_desc
	END
END

BEGIN

	from job_step job_step LEFT OUTER JOIN job_step_data job_step_data

		and job_step.step_no = job_step_data.step_no

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
  IF (@inventory_licensed = 1) BEGIN
	SELECT ship.lot_no,
		ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_grade inv_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.grade_cd = inv_grade.item_grade_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade i_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.min_grade = i_grade.item_grade_cd
		WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id AND (ii.lot_no = ship.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND ship.lot_no IS NULL))
			  /*AND ii.grade_cd >= ISNULL(i.min_grade, -1)*/  AND inv_grade.pref <= ISNULL(i_grade.pref, inv_grade.pref)), 0) shippable_grade
		,ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_state inv_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.status_cd = inv_state.item_status_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state i_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.min_state = i_state.item_status_cd
		WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id AND (ii.lot_no = ship.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND ship.lot_no IS NULL))
		 /* AND ii.status_cd >= ISNULL(i.min_state, -1)*/ AND inv_state.pref <= ISNULL(i_state.pref, inv_state.pref)), 0) shippable_state
	FROM
	(SELECT DISTINCT(lot_no) lot_no FROM item_inv
	WHERE item_id = @item_id AND qty_left > 0
	  AND (NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT wo_id FROM so_wo_link  WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id AND so_line_no = @so_line_no)
	  OR lot_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT(lot_no) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id AND wo_id IN
			(SELECT wo_id FROM so_wo_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id
				AND so_line_no = @so_line_no)))
	) ship
  END
  ELSE BEGIN
	SELECT ship.lot_no,
		ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_grade inv_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.grade_cd = inv_grade.item_grade_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade i_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.min_grade = i_grade.item_grade_cd
		WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id AND (ii.lot_no = ship.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND ship.lot_no IS NULL))
			  /*AND ii.grade_cd >= ISNULL(i.min_grade, -1)*/ AND inv_grade.pref <= ISNULL(i_grade.pref, inv_grade.pref)), 0) shippable_grade
		,ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.item_id = i.item_id
		INNER JOIN item_state inv_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON ii.status_cd = inv_state.item_status_cd
		LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state i_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.min_state = i_state.item_status_cd
		WHERE ii.item_id = @item_id AND (ii.lot_no = ship.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND ship.lot_no IS NULL))
		  /*AND ii.status_cd >= ISNULL(i.min_state, -1)*/ AND inv_state.pref <= ISNULL(i_state.pref, inv_state.pref)), 0) shippable_state
	FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT(lot_no) FROM item_prod ip  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND wo_id IN
		  (SELECT wo_id FROM so_wo_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id AND so_line_no = @so_line_no)
		  AND (SELECT SUM(ip2.qty_prod) FROM item_prod ip2 WITH (NOLOCK), job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ip2.item_id = ip.item_id
			AND ip2.wo_id  = ip.wo_id AND ip2.wo_id = j.wo_id AND ip2.oper_id = j.oper_id
			AND ip2.seq_no = j.seq_no AND j.final_job = 1) >
				(SELECT SUM(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK), so_line sol WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE sl.lot_no = ip.lot_no AND sol.item_id = ip.item_id
					  AND sol.po_id = sl.po_id AND sol.so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)
		) ship
  END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Inv_AddLotSublot]
(
@item_id	STRING40,
@lot_no		STRING40,
@sublot_no	STRING40,
@grade_cd   INT,
@status_cd  INT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -  SP_I_ITEM_INV_ADDLOTSUBLOT
-- Description          -  Create a new lot or sublot for this item if a lot or sublot does not exist for this item.
-- Author               - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 03/01/2007
-- Version              - 3.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 05/17/2007	  AML		3.4	Converted to Sql Server from Oracle.
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4	74144; Error when adding production to an item that has 'update inventory' checked.
--10/03/2012		Saiteja		4.6		Added changes for CR L00122604
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @last_edit_at AS DATETIME

	IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE item_id = @item_id ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'The specified item does not exist in the database.{3566}, item_id = %s', 16, 1, @item_id )
	END

	IF (@lot_no IS NULL) RETURN

	IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM lot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id and lot_no = @lot_no ) BEGIN
		SET @last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
		EXEC sp_I_Lot @item_id, @lot_no, @grade_cd, @status_cd, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, @last_edit_at
	END

	IF (@sublot_no IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sublot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id and lot_no = @lot_no and sublot_no = @sublot_no ) BEGIN
			SET @last_edit_at = GETUTCDATE()
			EXEC sp_I_Sublot @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @lot_no, 1, @grade_cd, @status_cd, null, 0, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, @last_edit_at OUT, NULL
		END
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss]    Script Date: 25-10-2022 22:46:45 ******/

-- Procedure definition
-- exec [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss] 327
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss]
	@ent_id AS INT
AS
	-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	-- Name:			sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss  -
	-- Description:	    Get All the utilization and avilability percentage
	--
	-- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
	-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-01						Find the utilization and avilablity percentage
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @day AS              INT
		  , @wdays AS            NVARCHAR(20)
		  , @shift_day AS        INT
		  , @shift_id AS         INT
		  , @shift_start_time AS DATETIME
		  , @shift_end_time AS   DATETIME
		  , @diff_shift_mins AS  INT
		  , @utlization AS       FLOAT
		  , @utlization_loss AS  FLOAT
		  , @util_mins AS        FLOAT
		  , @avil_runtime AS     INTEGER
		  , @avil_downtime AS    INTEGER
		  , @avil_percent AS     FLOAT
		  , @parent_ent_id AS    INTEGER

	--get the running day of the week from the above
	SET @wdays = Datename(weekday, GETDATE())

	IF @wdays = 'Monday'
	BEGIN
		SET @day = 0
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @wdays = 'Tuesday'
		BEGIN
			SET @day = 1
		END
			ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @wdays = 'Wednesday'
			BEGIN
				SET @day = 2
			END
				ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @wdays = 'Thursday'
				BEGIN
					SET @day = 3
				END
					ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @wdays = 'Friday'
					BEGIN
						SET @day = 4
					END
						ELSE
					BEGIN
						IF @wdays = 'Saturday'
						BEGIN
							SET @day = 5
						END
							ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF @wdays = 'Sunday'
							BEGIN
								SET @day = 6
							END
						END
					END
				END
			END
		END
	END

	-- Get the Current shift_id from the below query
	
	SELECT
		@shift_id = shift_id
	  , @parent_ent_id = e.parent_ent_id
	FROM shift_history sh WITH(NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK) ON ea.ent_id = sh.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id
	WHERE
		sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL
		AND e.ent_id = @ent_id
		--AND attr_value = 'Equipment'
		AND attr_value = 'Segment'

	PRINT @shift_id
	PRINT @parent_ent_id


	SELECT TOP 1
		@shift_start_time = shift_start_utc
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL
		--AND shift_end_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC

	PRINT @shift_start_time
	PRINT @shift_end_time

	-- Calculate the timing difference between the start and end time
	-- SET @diff_shift_mins = Datediff(minute, @shift_start_time, @shift_end_time)--LP Commented
	--LP: using current UTC time to get the time difference
	--SET @diff_shift_mins = DATEDIFF(minute, @shift_start_time, GETUTCDATE())
	SELECT TOP 1
	 @diff_shift_mins=DATEDIFF(minute, shift_start_utc,shift_end_utc)
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_end_utc IS NOT NULL
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
		AND ent_id = @ent_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC
	--Get the current run shift_start time and shift_end time from the shift_history table
	SELECT TOP 1
		@shift_start_time = shift_start_utc
	FROM shift_history WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		ent_id = @ent_id 
		AND shift_id = @shift_id
	ORDER BY
		row_id DESC

	--using the below query to find the running shift end time	 
	SET @shift_end_time = DATEADD(minute, @diff_shift_mins, @shift_start_time)

	

	DECLARE @duration_down    FLOAT
		  , @duration_running FLOAT
	EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
		 @ent_id = @ent_id
	   , @runtime = 0
	   , @wocheck = 1
	   , @durationSecout = @duration_down OUT
	EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
		 @ent_id = @ent_id
	   , @runtime = 1
	   , @wocheck = 1
	   , @durationSecout = @duration_running OUT

	DECLARE @availPer FLOAT
		  , @utilPer  FLOAT
	
	DECLARE @totaltime FLOAT
	SET @totaltime = @duration_down + @duration_running
	
	IF @totaltime > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @availPer = (((@totaltime - @duration_down) / @totaltime)) * 100
		SET @util_mins = (@totaltime - @duration_down) / 60
		
		SET @availPer = ROUND(@availPer, 2)
		
		SET @util_mins = ROUND(@util_mins, 1)

		DECLARE @util_down    FLOAT
			  , @util_running FLOAT
		EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
			 @ent_id = @ent_id
		   , @runtime = 0
		   , @durationSecout = @util_down OUT
		EXEC sp_SA_OFI_UL_GetUtilByTimePeriod
			 @ent_id = @ent_id
		   , @runtime = 1
		   , @durationSecout = @util_running OUT

		   
	
		--SET @utilPer = (((@totaltime - @util_down) / @totaltime)) * 100
		EXEC sp_S_ofi_GetUtilLoss
			 @ent_id = @ent_id		  
		   , @UtilPer = @utilPer OUT
		   ,@util_down= @util_down OUT
		   ,@util_running= @util_running OUT
		   SET @totaltime = @util_down + @util_running




		SET @utilPer = ROUND(@utilPer, 2)
	END

	IF @util_mins > @diff_shift_mins
	BEGIN
		SET @utlization = 100
		SET @utlization_loss = 0
	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF @util_mins < @diff_shift_mins
		BEGIN
			SET @utlization = @utilPer *100
			SET @utlization_loss = @totaltime - @util_down
			
		END
	END

	--below query used to find the avilable runtime and downtime from the total utilization time
	SELECT
		@avil_runtime = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= @shift_end_time
		AND runtime = 1

	SELECT
		@avil_downtime = (SUM(duration) / 60)
	FROM util_log WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE
		shift_start_utc >= CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_start_time, 25)
		AND shift_start_utc < CONVERT(VARCHAR, @shift_end_time, 25)
		AND event_end_time_utc <= @shift_end_time
		AND runtime = 0

	SET @avil_percent = @availPer
	SET @avil_downtime = 100 - @avil_percent
	SET @avil_runtime = @util_mins
	
	SELECT
		ISNULL(@diff_shift_mins, 0) AS  util_max
	  , ISNULL(@util_mins, 0) AS        util_data
	  , ISNULL(@utlization, 0) AS       util_percent
	  , ISNULL(@utlization_loss, 0) AS  util_loss
	  , ISNULL(@avil_runtime, 0) AS     avil_data
	  , ISNULL(@avil_downtime, 0) AS    avil_loss
	  , ISNULL(@avil_percent, 0) AS     avil_per
	  , ISNULL(@shift_start_time, 0) AS shift_start
	  , ISNULL(@shift_end_time, 0) AS   shift_end
	  , @duration_running as avil_Run_time,@duration_down as avil_Down_time,@util_running as util_run_time,@util_down as util_down_time
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Prod_GetProdQtys]
(
	 @ent_id INT32_NULL = NULL
	,@shift_start_utc TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,@wo_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,@oper_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,@seq_no INT32_NULL = NULL
	,@user_id STRING40_NULL = NULL
)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_SA_ITEM_PROD_GETPRODQTYS
-- Description	      - Retrieves the sum of good and reject quantities from item_prod table based on the input filters.
-- Author			  -
-- Date Created	      -	06/18/2014
-- Version	          -	5.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN good_prod = 1 THEN qty_prod ELSE 0 END) as good_qty
      ,SUM(CASE WHEN good_prod = 1 THEN 0 ELSE qty_prod END) as reject_qty
FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ( ( item_prod.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL ) AND
		( item_prod.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc OR @shift_start_utc IS NULL ) AND
		( item_prod.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL ) AND
		( item_prod.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL ) AND
		( item_prod.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL ) AND
		( item_prod.user_id = @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL )
      )

-- ***************************************************************************************************************************************************
-- Name				: sp_U_ofi_EI_result_arrived
-- Description		: To update job.spare1 = '1' if all the results for the key characteristics are received from LIMS system.
--
-- Author			: Unnikrishnan Nair P G (GDC)
-- Creation date	: 2024-04-01
--
-- Usage			: Using IN LIMS interface EI location MES_LIMS_SampleResult_IN
--		EXEC sp_U_ofi_EI_result_arrived 26740
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour				Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change Description
-- 00.01			PG					2024-04-01				Initial draft
-- 01.00			BI					2025-10-13				severity code changed to 2 instead of 3
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *****************************************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_EI_result_arrived] 
(
	@sample_id INT 
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
	DECLARE @qm_spec_id int ;
	DECLARE @char_waiting_for_result int = 0 ;
	DECLARE @severity_code_key_char int = 2 ; -- v01.00
	DECLARE @wo_id nvarchar(40) ;
	DECLARE @oper_id nvarchar(80) ;
	DECLARE @seq_no int ;
 
	SELECT 
		@wo_id = wo_id,
		@oper_id = oper_id,
		@seq_no = seq_no
	FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE sample_id = @sample_id ;
 
	SELECT @qm_spec_id = qm_spec_id FROM sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
 
	SELECT 
		@char_waiting_for_result = COUNT(char_id) 
	FROM qm_spec_char_link WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id 
		AND severity_cd = @severity_code_key_char 
		AND char_id NOT IN (
							SELECT char_id 
							FROM result WITH (NOLOCK) 
							WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
							) ;
 
	-- if all the key characteristics received result, set job.spare1 = '1'
	IF (@char_waiting_for_result = 0) 
	BEGIN
		UPDATE job
		SET spare1 = '1'
		WHERE 
		wo_id = @wo_id AND
		oper_id = @oper_id AND
		seq_no = @seq_no ;
	END ;
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Language_Clone]
   (@new_lang_id int ,
   @cloned_lang_id int,
   @new_lang_desc varchar(40))
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1600		Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 10/24/2007	  AML			   3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @rows_existing integer
	,@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
BEGIN
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  -- Check that @cloned_lang_id has rows
  SELECT @rows_existing = count(string_id) FROM language WHERE lang_id = @cloned_lang_id
  IF @rows_existing = 0 BEGIN
  --	SET @error = "Cloned Language ID has no strings defined"
	RETURN -101
  END
  -- Check that @new_lang_id is NOT already used
  SELECT @rows_existing = count(string_id) FROM language WHERE lang_id = @new_lang_id
  IF @rows_existing > 0 BEGIN
--	SELECT 'Result' = "New Language ID is already in use"
	RETURN -102
  END
  INSERT INTO language (lang_id, string_id, grp_id, string, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    SELECT @new_lang_id, string_id, grp_id, string , @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at FROM language
      WHERE lang_id = @cloned_lang_id
  -- Now set new language as value for string = 1
  UPDATE language SET string = @new_lang_desc
    WHERE lang_id = @new_lang_id AND string_id = 1
END
