--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_I_EI_PRO_Split_Jobs
-- Description:  Splits the Jobs for the given order
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  KN		    2023-01-29			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	KN			2023-02-23			Added a logic to copy job_bom's bom_pos 0th item to ofi_wo_item_ext
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_EI_PRO_Split_Job] @wo_id VARCHAR(100) AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @attr_id INT,@process_id VARCHAR(100),@oper_id VARCHAR(100),@qty_reqd FLOAT,@seq_no INT,
@error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@material_grp VARCHAR(100)

BEGIN TRY

	BEGIN TRANSACTION

	DECLARE @event_time_utc DATETIME,@event_time_local DATETIME,@created_by NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @event_time_utc = dbo.Fn_stripmillisecsfromdatetime(Getutcdate())
	SET @event_time_local =dbo.Fn_tz_getlocaldatefromutc(NULL, @event_time_utc)

	SELECT @created_by = attr_value FROM   system_attr sa WITH (nolock) WHERE  sa.attr_id = 199

	
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_wo_item_ext](					-- (KN 18/02/23 - Added logic to copy the bom_pos 0 item from job_bom to ofi_wo_item_ext as requested by AVEVA)
	[wo_id],[parent_item_id],[bom_pos],[item_id],[qty],[qty_per_parent_item],[backflush],[def_lot_no],
	[item_number],[item_desc],[uom_desc],[by_product],[co_product],[spare6],[created_at_utc],[created_at_local],
	[last_edit_at_utc],[last_edit_at_local],[created_by],[last_edit_by])
	SELECT 
	wo_id,NULL,bom_pos,item_id,qty_reqd,qty_per_parent_item,backflush,def_lot_no,
	NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,
	@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,@created_by,@created_by
	FROM job_bom with(nolock) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos = 0
	

	DECLARE oper_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR Select oper_id, qty_reqd, seq_no from job where wo_id = @wo_id and seq_no = 0	--Get all jobs with operations and qty_reqd  for the work order

	Open oper_cur

	Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0								-- For each of that job (operation)
    BEGIN

		DECLARE @batch_size varchar(10),@new_seq_no int,@target_ent_id int,@split_cnt float
		SET @attr_id = -1
		select @attr_id =  attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'BatchSize'

		Select @material_grp = product_group from ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id
		Select @process_id = process_id from process_attr with (nolock) where attr_value = @material_grp
		 
		IF EXISTS(select 1 from oper_attr with(nolock) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id)
		BEGIN

			Select @batch_size = attr_value from oper_attr where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id			-- Get the batch size
			Select @target_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id from job with(nolock) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = 0 and oper_id = @oper_id

			SET @split_cnt = (@qty_reqd / @batch_size)-1

				WHILE @split_cnt > 0
				BEGIN
					BEGIN TRANSACTION

					SELECT @new_seq_no = max(seq_no) from JOB with(nolock) where oper_id = @oper_id and wo_id = @wo_id

					SET @new_seq_no = @new_seq_no + 1

					exec SP_I_JOB_EXEC_SPLITJOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@orig_seq_no=0,@user_id=NULL,@split_qty=@batch_size,
					@new_seq_no=@new_seq_no output,@split_start_qty=NULL,@new_state_cd=1,@req_finish_time=NULL,@req_finish_time_utc=NULL,@target_ent_id=@target_ent_id,
					@status_notes=NULL,@ignore_zero_start_qty_check=NULL,@time_zone_bias_value=60

					Update job set last_edit_comment = 'EI SPLIT JOB' WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no

					COMMIT TRANSACTION

					SET @split_cnt = @split_cnt - 1;
				END

		END

		Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no
	END

	Close oper_cur
	Deallocate oper_cur
	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION
END try

BEGIN catch
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();

    RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END catch


END

-- Author               - DonT

-- Version              - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @region_id nvarchar(80)
	DECLARE @current_utc datetime
	DECLARE	@context_info int32

	SET @current_utc = GetUtcDate()

	IF (@tz_offset IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- Get session_id from connection context
		SELECT @context_info = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spid =  @@spid
		--Retrieve the current region from the session context.
		SELECT @region_id = region_id FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @context_info

		-- use current UTC to lookup our offset
		select @tz_offset = max(offset) from tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
			where (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id is NULL AND default_region = 1))
			AND (start_utc <= @current_utc AND end_utc >= @current_utc)
    END

	-- in case we are unable to get client local offset - goto server as last resort
	IF (@tz_offset IS NULL) BEGIN
        RETURN dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromServer()
    END

    RETURN @tz_offset
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Shipment_Lot_GetMaxToShp]
(@item_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@cust_id 		NVARCHAR(40)
,@po_id			NVARCHAR(40)
,@so_line_no		INT
,@ship_date DATETIME
,@lot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
,@sublot_no		NVARCHAR(40)
,@inventory_licensed	INT
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT = 0
,@max_to_ship		FLOAT OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_SA_Shipment_Lot_GetMaxToShp
-- Description	  -	Returns the maximum amount or number of the item that can be shipped for a sales order line
--			        New BR reqd doc (Customer Window Business Rules.doc) FROM Rich B
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  -	08/20/2003
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- 09/05/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

  DECLARE @ship_date_utc DATETIME,
		  @tz_temp		 INT

  SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
  SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
  EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @ship_date, @tz_temp, @ship_date_utc OUTPUT

  IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM so_wo_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id AND so_line_no = @so_line_no) BEGIN
	IF (@lot_no <> '')
		SELECT @max_to_ship = ((x.a - y.b) + z.c)  FROM
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ip.qty_prod), 0) a FROM
		so_wo_link swl1 WITH (NOLOCK), item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK), job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE swl1.cust_id = @cust_id AND swl1.po_id = @po_id AND swl1.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND
		ip.wo_id = swl1.wo_id AND ip.item_id = @item_id AND ip.lot_no = @lot_no AND j.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND
		j.oper_id = ip.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ip.seq_no AND j.final_job = 1) x,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) b FROM so_wo_link swl1 WITH (NOLOCK), so_wo_link swl2 WITH (NOLOCK), shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
		swl1.cust_id = @cust_id AND swl1.po_id = @po_id AND swl1.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND swl2.wo_id = swl1.wo_id AND
		sl.cust_id = swl2.cust_id AND sl.po_id = swl2.po_id AND sl.so_line_no = swl2.so_line_no AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) y,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) c FROM shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sl.cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id =  @po_id AND
		sl.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc = @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) z
	ELSE
		SELECT @max_to_ship = (x.a - y.b) + z.c FROM
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ip.qty_prod), 0) a FROM so_wo_link swl1 WITH (NOLOCK), item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK), job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE swl1.cust_id = @cust_id AND swl1.po_id = @po_id AND swl1.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND
		ip.wo_id = swl1.wo_id AND ip.item_id = @item_id AND ip.lot_no is null AND j.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND
		j.oper_id = ip.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ip.seq_no AND j.final_job = 1) x,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) b FROM so_wo_link swl1 WITH (NOLOCK), so_wo_link swl2 WITH (NOLOCK), shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
		swl1.cust_id = @cust_id AND swl1.po_id = @po_id AND swl1.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND swl2.wo_id = swl1.wo_id AND
		sl.cust_id = swl2.cust_id AND sl.po_id = swl2.po_id AND sl.so_line_no = swl2.so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc <> @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) y,
		(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) c FROM shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sl.cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id AND
		sl.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc = @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) z
  END
  ELSE BEGIN
	IF (@inventory_licensed = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@lot_no <> '')
			SELECT @max_to_ship = (x.a - y.b) + z.c  FROM
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(qty_left), 0) a FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lot_no = @lot_no) x,
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) b FROM so_wo_link swl1 WITH (NOLOCK), so_wo_link swl2 WITH (NOLOCK), shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
			swl1.cust_id = @cust_id AND swl1.po_id = @po_id AND swl1.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND swl2.wo_id = swl1.wo_id AND
			sl.cust_id = swl2.cust_id AND sl.po_id = swl2.po_id AND sl.so_line_no = swl2.so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc <> @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) y,
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) c FROM shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sl.cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id AND
			sl.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc = @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) z
		ELSE
			SELECT @max_to_ship = (x.a - y.b) + z.c FROM
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(qty_left), 0) a FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lot_no is null) x,
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) b FROM so_wo_link swl1 WITH (NOLOCK), so_wo_link swl2 WITH (NOLOCK), shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
			swl1.cust_id = @cust_id AND swl1.po_id = @po_id AND swl1.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND swl2.wo_id = swl1.wo_id AND
			sl.cust_id = swl2.cust_id AND sl.po_id = swl2.po_id AND sl.so_line_no = swl2.so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc <> @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) y,
			(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(sl.qty_shipped), 0) c FROM shipment_lot sl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sl.cust_id = @cust_id AND po_id = @po_id AND
			sl.so_line_no = @so_line_no AND sl.ship_date_utc = @ship_date_utc AND sl.lot_no = @lot_no) z
	END
	ELSE SET @max_to_ship = -1
  END
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Item_Process_Link]
(@item_id    NVARCHAR(40),
@process_id NVARCHAR(40),
@item_pref  INT,
@status     INT,
@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
@mod_id     VARCHAR(30) OUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_I_ITEM_PROCESS_LINK
-- Description	      - Insert into bom item table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 04/26/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.36
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Version		Changes
-- 05/16/2002     Sheetal Jain  1001		Check for record in bom item oper link for bom position 0 for each of the parent items
-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu         1500		Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 12/12/2002     Sheetal Jain  1501		Avoiding BOM_POS = 0 duplicates
-- 05/15/2003     Sheetal Jain  1600		Item process link status defualted to process status (HD#545)
-- 05/15/2003     Sheetal Jain  1600		(HD# 457) BOM item oper link default start pct set to the value in system attribute 203
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1601		Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 11/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  16033		(HD# 3908) Always by default consume new bom items in the first operation
-- 12/09/2003     Sheetal Jain  16036		(HD# 4206) Auto BOM item allocation should only be for a process with one op
-- 06/15/2004     Raghu         2.1.0		Included def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_storage_ent_id in the insert statement to carry
--											the value from bom_item table
-- 09/28/2005     Raghu         3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 12/22/2005     Raghu         3.1.6		HD# 7021, variable def_lot_no is changed from integer to string; ought to be string
-- 01/10/2007     KRF           3.2.1		HD# 8314, part of DB changes - handle copying def_sublot_no from bom_item to
--											bom_item_oper_link
-- 01/18/2007		KRF			3.2.1		HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007		AML			3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--											dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 07/21/2015		RWB			5.0.2		Story 316411, added code to check if the item being linked to the process is an ancestor
--											or descendent in the BOM of any item already linked to the process.
-- 08/15/2019		RWB			6.2.0		Story 1216335: Made a modification to add the item being linked to the process to
--											the BOM_Item_Oper_Link table only for operations where a component of the item is
--											not already being produced by the operation.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @V_Ver_Id			STRING40,
  @V_Oper			STRING40,
  @V_Qty_Per_Parent_Item	TFLOAT,
  @V_Count			INT,
  @V_Status			CHAR(1),
  @V_Reqd_Start_Pct		TFLOAT_NULL,
  @V_StepNo			INT32,
  @last_edit_by			NVARCHAR(40),
  @last_edit_at			DATETIME,
  @def_reas_cd			INT32,
  @def_storage_ent_id		INT32,
  @def_reject_ent_id		INT32,
  @update_inv			LOGICAL,
  @backflush			LOGICAL,
  @def_lot_no			STRING80,
  @def_sublot_no		STRING80, -- added 1/10/07 KRF
  @must_consume_from_inv	LOGICAL,
  @may_choose_alt_inv_loc	LOGICAL,
  @may_create_new_lots		LOGICAL,
  @must_consume_from_wip	LOGICAL,
  @must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL,
  @constant_qty			LOGICAL,
  @has_anc_or_desc			LOGICAL,
  @error_msg				NVARCHAR(500)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

BEGIN

  -- Check to see if the item belongs to any BOMs where the ancestor or descendants of the item are being made by the
  -- process.  If there are any, raise an error.
	;
	WITH
	bom_ancestor AS (
		SELECT parent_item_id FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id AND bom_pos <> 0

		UNION ALL

		SELECT bi.parent_item_id FROM bom_item bi WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN bom_ancestor ba ON bi.item_id = ba.parent_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0
	),

	bom_descendant AS (
		SELECT item_id FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND bom_pos <> 0

		UNION ALL

		SELECT bi.item_id FROM bom_item bi WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN bom_descendant bd ON bi.parent_item_id = bd.item_id AND bi.bom_pos <> 0
	)

	SELECT TOP 1 @has_anc_or_desc = 1
	FROM item_process_link ipl WITH(NOLOCK)
	LEFT JOIN bom_ancestor ba ON ipl.item_id = ba.parent_item_id
	LEFT JOIN bom_descendant bd ON bd.item_id = ipl.item_id
	WHERE ipl.process_id = @process_id AND (ba.parent_item_id IS NOT NULL OR bd.item_id IS NOT NULL)

	IF @has_anc_or_desc = 1 BEGIN
		SET @error_msg = 'The item (%1) cannot be made by the process (%2) as the item belongs to at least one BOM where an ancestor or descendant of the item is being made by the process.<7988>,' + @item_id + ',' + @process_id
		RAISERROR(@error_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END



  IF @item_pref IS NULL OR @item_pref = 0
    SET @item_pref = 1

--  IF @status is NULL
--    SET @status = 2
  --Get the status from the process
  SELECT @status = process_status FROM process WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id

  INSERT INTO item_process_link (item_id, process_id, item_pref,status, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES(@item_id, @process_id, @item_pref,@status, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

	SELECT @V_Oper = oper_id FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND final_oper = 1
	IF @V_Oper IS NOT NULL
		EXEC sp_U_BOM_Item_Oper_Link_ChPrIt @process_id=@process_id, @oper_id=@V_Oper, @old_item_id=null, @old_ver_id=null, @new_item_id=@item_id, @new_ver_id=null

  -- Return timestamp
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM item_process_link
                   WHERE (item_id = @item_id AND process_id = @process_id)
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff]
-- Description: Used to insert the raw data into the buffer table
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert a new the record. Exec from parent SPs. Prevents duplicates
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version Author  	Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00 JSC   	2025-04-15   		CR512: Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC		2025-05-27			Added row_id as output
-- ===========================================================================================*/
-- Insert Procedure (uses try/catch instead of serializable)
create      PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff_bck21_8_25]
    @Data NVARCHAR(4000),                   
    @object_name NVARCHAR(80),               
    @interface_type NVARCHAR(15),            
    @current_timestamp DATETIME,
    @Error INT OUTPUT
	,@id INT = -1 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @insertedID AS TABLE ( id INT)
    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT dbo.ofi_aut_interface_buffer 
            (Data, ObjectName, InterfaceType, CurrentTimestamp)
		OUTPUT INSERTED.Id
		INTO @insertedID
        VALUES
            (@Data, @object_name, @interface_type, @current_timestamp);
        
		SELECT @id = i.id
		FROM @insertedID i

        SET @Error = 0;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 2627  -- Duplicate key violation
            SET @Error = 50000;
        ELSE
            SET @Error = ERROR_NUMBER();
    END CATCH
END;

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_LU_GETLABORBYFILTER
-- Description    - HD# 9721, Retrieves labor_usage records based on the supplied filters
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 04/16/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
--05/22/2007    Raghu               3.2.13  Added user_desc in the select clause.
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change shift_start with *_utc and *_local.
--09/04/2007	AML			3.3.0	DB Changes
--01/29/2008	Raghu	3.4 	L00074369; Incorrect data is being displayed after percentage min/max is applied.
--01/29/2008	Raghu	3.4	L00074450; An error occurs in the Labor_Usage.Updat...
-- 11/30/2009  Kishore   4.1   HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

	DECLARE @shift_start_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_start_utc  TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@v_current_time_utc     TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT32
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32


	SET @labor_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@labor_start_start_tz)
	SET @labor_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@labor_start_end_tz)
	SET @shift_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)


	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_LU_GetLaborByFilter', @src_key='on_entry',
		@date_val1 = @labor_start_start_local, @numeric_val1 = @labor_start_start_tz
      , @date_val2 = @labor_start_end_local, @numeric_val2 = @labor_start_end_tz
      , @date_val3 = @shift_start_start_local, @numeric_val3 = @shift_start_start_tz
      , @date_val4 = @shift_start_end_local, @numeric_val4 = @shift_start_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@labor_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_start_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@labor_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_end_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @v_current_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()

    SELECT lu.labor_start_utc, lu.labor_start_local
        ,DATEADD( mi, @labor_start_start_tz, lu.labor_start_utc ) AS labor_start
        ,lu.user_id, un.user_desc, lu.ent_id, e.ent_name, lu.wo_id, lu.oper_id, lu.seq_no, lu.step_no, lu.item_id
        ,i.item_desc, lu.lot_no, lu.sublot_no, lu.lab_cd, lc.lab_desc, lc.color, lu.dept_id, ld.dept_desc
        ,lu.shift_id, s.shift_desc
        ,lu.shift_start_utc, lu.shift_start_local
        ,DATEADD( mi, @shift_start_start_tz, lu.shift_start_utc ) AS shift_start
        ,ROUND(lu.pct_to_apply, 7) AS pct_to_apply
        ,lu.active, lu.duration
    	,'duration_in_time' = CASE WHEN lu.active = 1 THEN
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ((DATEDIFF(SS, lu.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc))/3600)) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ((DATEDIFF(SS, lu.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc))%3600)/60) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ((DATEDIFF(SS, lu.labor_start_utc, @v_current_time_utc))%3600)%60)
			  ELSE
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (lu.duration/3600)) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (lu.duration%3600)/60) + ':' +
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), (lu.duration%3600)%60)
			  END
        ,lu.comments, lu.raw_reas_cd, lu.last_edit_comment, lu.last_edit_by, lu.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, lu.mod_id))) mod_id_h
	,lu.log_id
    FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.ent_id = e.ent_id
    INNER JOIN labor_cat lc WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.lab_cd = lc.lab_cd
    INNER JOIN labor_dept ld WITH (NOLOCK) ON ld.dept_id = lu.dept_id
    INNER JOIN shift s WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.shift_id = s.shift_id
    INNER JOIN user_name un WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.user_id = un.user_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE (lu.labor_start_utc >= @labor_start_start_utc OR @labor_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.labor_start_utc <= @labor_start_end_utc OR @labor_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.user_id LIKE @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.lab_cd LIKE @lab_cd OR @lab_cd IS NULL)
      AND (lu.dept_id LIKE @dept_id OR @dept_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.pct_to_apply >= @pct_to_apply_min OR @pct_to_apply_min IS NULL)
      AND (lu.pct_to_apply <= @pct_to_apply_max OR @pct_to_apply_max IS NULL)
      AND (lu.active = @active OR @active IS NULL)
      AND (lu.duration >= @duration_min OR @duration_min IS NULL)
      AND (lu.duration <= @duration_max OR @duration_max IS NULL)
      AND (lu.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
      AND (lu.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (lu.last_edit_by LIKE @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
      AND (lu.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
      AND (lu.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Delete_All]
  (@table_name NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@where_xml NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      -	sp_Delete_All
-- Description      -	Delete rows from the specified table based on the information supplied in the XML.  The XML has the
--						following format:
--						<where_clauses>
--							<clause name="col1" value="val1"/>
--							<clause name="col2" value="val2"/>
--							...
--							<clause name="coln" value="valn"/>
--						<where_clauses>
-- Author			-	Rich Boyle
-- Date Created	    -	09/20/2017
-- Version			-	6.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
	DECLARE @sSQL NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@where_clause NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@where_clauses XML
		,@where_clause_used BIT
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(100)
		,@column_type NVARCHAR(100)
		,@column_value NVARCHAR(100)
		,@column_count INT
		,@err_msg NVARCHAR(1000)

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(@table_name) AND type in (N'U')) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The table is not an MES table{136}', 16, 1)
		RETURN - 1
	END

	SELECT @where_clauses = @where_xml, @sSQL = 'DELETE FROM ' + @table_name, @where_clause = ' WHERE', @where_clause_used = 0, @column_count = 0

	IF (@where_xml IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		CREATE TABLE #where_value (column_count INT, value NVARCHAR(100))
		DECLARE where_cursor  CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT  x.v.value('@name[1]', 'VARCHAR(100)') AS dimtype ,
				x.v.value('@value[1]', 'VARCHAR(100)') AS dimvalue
			FROM @where_clauses.nodes('/where_clauses/clause') x(v)
		OPEN where_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM where_cursor INTO @column_name, @column_value
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @column_type = NULL
			SELECT @column_type = LOWER(DATA_TYPE) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = @table_name AND COLUMN_NAME = @column_name
			IF @column_type IS NULL BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Column %1 not found.{6235},' + @column_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				CLOSE where_cursor
				DEALLOCATE where_cursor
				DROP TABLE #where_value
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF (@where_clause_used = 1)
				SET @where_clause = @where_clause + ' AND'
			IF (@column_value <> '') BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #where_value VALUES(@column_count, @column_value)
				IF @column_type = 'datetime'
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT CONVERT(datetime, value, 120) FROM #where_value WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE IF @column_type = 'datetime2'
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT CONVERT(datetime2, value, 120) FROM #where_value WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE if @column_type = 'timestamp'
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ' + @column_name + '))) = ' + '(SELECT value FROM #where_value WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT value FROM #where_value WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' IS NULL'
			END
			SELECT @where_clause_used = 1, @column_count = @column_count + 1
		END
		CLOSE where_cursor
		DEALLOCATE where_cursor
	END

	IF (@where_clause_used = 1) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @where_clause

	--PRINT @sSQL
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL
	IF (@where_clause_used = 1)
		DROP TABLE #where_value
END

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @SQL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @column_list AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @table_count AS INT

	SELECT @table_count = COUNT(*)  FROM sys.objects WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(@table_name) AND type in (N'U')

	IF (@table_count = 1)
	BEGIN

	END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_item_subst_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[item_subst]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_item_subst_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on item_subst table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--08/04/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Disallow update if the substitute item is the same item as the original item
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	IF UPDATE(item_id) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.orig_item_id = i.item_id) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The substitute item cannot be the same as the original item{2922}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE item_subst SET item_subst.qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,item_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.max_qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,item_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.min_qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,item_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, item_subst.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE item_subst.orig_item_id = i.orig_item_id AND item_subst.alt_no = i.alt_no
END

	-- TBU Updated

	DECLARE @defaultUoMDesc NVARCHAR(20) = 'KG'
			,@defaultUoMId INT
			,@IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0
			,@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0
			,@UserId NVARCHAR(100) 


	DECLARE @id INT,
			@dest_type int,
			@storage_ent_id int,
			@ratio FLOAT,
			@silo_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
			@parent_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
			@jb_grade_cd INT,
			@silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100),
			@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT INT = 0 --v 0.06.00 added

	DECLARE @target_sched_ent_id INT,
					@minID INT =1

	SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job 
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no 

	-- BS v 0.06.00 added
	SELECT @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT = attr_value FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'ShareCoProdSiloToAUT' and attr_grp=2) and ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id

	SET @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT  = ISNULL(@ShareCoProdSiloToAUT,0);
	-- BE v 0.06.00 added
	SET @UserId = SUSER_NAME();

	DECLARE @DestSilos TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
		dest_type int,
		storage_ent_id int,
		mes_ent_id int,
		parent_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		silo_item_id int,
		mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		ratio float,
		silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL, 
		bom_pos INT NULL
	)

	INSERT @DestSilos
	SELECT 
		dest_type,
		ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
		case 
			when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
			else osu.su_ent_id 
		end as storage_ent_id,
		j.item_id,
		aut_item_id,
		case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,
		0.00 ratio,
		null,
		jb.bom_pos
	FROM 
	ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id and osu.oper_id = j.oper_id and osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
	--INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.item_id = jb_item_id and jb.bom_pos = 0 -- v 0.06.00 Disabled
	INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.item_id = jb_item_id -- v 0.06.00 added
												AND jb.bom_pos IN (SELECT CASE @ShareCoProdSiloToAUT WHEN 1 THEN bom_pos WHEN 0 THEN 0 END FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = j.wo_id AND oper_id = j.oper_id AND seq_no = j.seq_no AND item_id = jb_item_id AND bom_pos <= 0 ) -- v 0.06.00 added
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON case 
															when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
															when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
															else osu.su_ent_id 
													   end = ea.ent_id 
													   AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		 FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
	WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id and osu.oper_id = @oper_id and osu.seq_no = @seq_no and osu.dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
	--ORDER BY latest_aut_silo, silo_seq ASC -- v0.06.00 disabled
	ORDER by Jb.bom_pos DESC, silo_seq -- v0.06.00 Added
	
	
	/* Disabled on v0.04.00
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @DestSilos))
	BEGIN
		-- Get Attribute IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically
		SELECT @IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

		IF (@IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
		BEGIN

				   ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,

			FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Destination' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 -- Get only for the end product
			--LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = iv.ent_id -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) where oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
													   AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		 FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(jb.item_id,1)
			--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Destination', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			CROSS APPLY dbo.fn_chKDestinationValidity(oea.storage_ent_id,iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id)  -- v0.03.00 Added
			WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no AND isNotValidEnt=0 --AND (iv.ent_id IS NULL OR iv.qty_left = 0.00)

			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @DestSilos
			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @result Table (iStatus int, sStatusDescription NVARCHAR(100))
				SELECT @id=ID,@dest_type=dest_type,@storage_ent_id=mes_ent_id,@parent_item_id=parent_item_id,@ratio=ratio,@silo_item_group =silo_item_group,
					@silo_item_id =mes_item_id 
				FROM @DestSilos WHERE ID = @minID
				
				SELECT @jb_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd from job_bom WITH (nolock)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and item_id = @silo_item_id

				/*
				INSERT @result
				EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_selection]
					@pwo_id = @wo_id,					
					@poper_id =	@oper_id,
					@pseq_no = @seq_no,
					@pitem_id	=  @silo_item_id,
					@pent_id = @target_sched_ent_id,
					@precipe_id =	 NULL,
					@pversion_id = NULL,
					@pdest_type = 2,	--Destination
					@pis_chk = 1,	
					@pstorage_ent_id = @storage_ent_id,
					@psilo_item_id= NULL,
					@pdsc_qty=	 NULL,
					@pmes_qty = NULL,
					--@pstatus					[dbo].[INT32]	 NULL,
					@psecondary_silo= NULL,
					@psecondary_silo_ent_id	= NULL,
					@pratio	= @ratio,
					@pis_disabled= 0,	
					@psilo_automation_status= NULL,	
					@psilo_seq= @id,	
					--@pspare1					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
					--@pspare2					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
					--@pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
					--@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
					@pcreated_by= @UserId,	
					--@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
					--@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
					@plast_edit_by =NULL
				*/

				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
										(
										 [wo_id]									
										,[oper_id]							
										,[seq_no]					
										,[parent_item_id]
										,[ent_id]
										,[jb_item_id] 	
										,[jb_item_group] 
										,[jb_grade_cd] 								
										,[dest_type]							
										,[is_chk]
										,[su_ent_id]
										,[is_active]
										,[created_at_utc]
										,[created_at_local]
										,[created_by]
										,[last_edit_at_utc]
										,[last_edit_at_local]
										,[last_edit_by]
										,[silo_seq] 
										,[ratio]
										)
								VALUES
										(
										 @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@parent_item_id
										,@target_sched_ent_id
										,@silo_item_id
										,@silo_item_group
										,@jb_grade_cd
										,2
										,1
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,@minID
										,null
										)
				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @DestSilos WHERE id > @minID
			END
		END
	END
	*/
	SELECT @defaultUoMId = uom_id FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description = @defaultUoMDesc

	DECLARE @SourceSilos TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
		dest_type int,
		storage_ent_id int,
		mes_silo_id NVARCHAR(50),
		parent_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
		silo_item_id int,
		mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		ratio float,
		silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
		bom_pos INT  NULL
	)

	-- v.0.05.00 Begin 
	DECLARE @Jb_Corr_Details TABLE (
		[wo_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[oper_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[seq_no] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
		[bom_pos] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
		[item_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT] NOT NULL,
		[qty_reqd] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL] NULL,
		[reqd_grade_cd] [dbo].[INT32] NULL
	)

	-- Job Bom Correction Detail table will have data on job_start or bom_correction step
	IF (@oper_id = 'CakeBlending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no ))
	BEGIN
		declare @CurrentDosingStep INT = (SELECT MAX(dosing_step) FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK) 
										WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no )

		INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
		SELECT jbc.wo_id, jbc.oper_id, jbc.seq_no, jbc.bom_pos, jbc.item_id, jbc.qty_per_parent_item,jbc.qty_reqd,jb.reqd_grade_cd from job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id = jbc.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbc.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbc.seq_no AND jb.item_id = jbc.item_id
		WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbc.dosing_step =  @CurrentDosingStep
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item,qty_reqd,reqd_grade_cd from job_bom with (nolock)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no 
	END

	-- v.0.05.00 End
		--SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		--INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
		--								AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		--WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
		
		
		
	--	if @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
	--if not exists(select * from ofi_su_selection where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and dest_type=1 and su_ent_id=@st_ent_id)
		--begin
	INSERT @SourceSilos
	SELECT 
		dest_type,
		ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
		case 
			when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
			else osu.su_ent_id 
		end,
		j.item_id,
		aut_item_id,
		case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,
		--jb.qty_per_parent_item*(osu.ratio/100.0) ratio,
		CASE dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) 
			WHEN 1000.00 THEN 1 
			ELSE ISNULL(dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) ,1)
		END  ratio,
		NULL,
		NULL
	FROM 
	ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id and osu.oper_id = j.oper_id and osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
														AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
														AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
														AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id
														AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item jbi WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = jbi.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON case 
															when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
															when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
															else osu.su_ent_id 
													   end = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2) -- Add attribute group =2 (entity)
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
	WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id and osu.oper_id = @oper_id and osu.seq_no = @seq_no and osu.dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1
	ORDER by created_at_utc
	--end
	print @oper_id
	-- Auto insert source silo
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @SourceSilos))
	BEGIN
		-- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

		
		print @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET	@minID = 1

			SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no 

			INSERT @SourceSilos
			SELECT TOP 1 1 dest_type,
					ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
					oea.storage_ent_id,
					j.item_id,
					aut_item_id,
					jb.item_id,
					1.0 ratio,
					oea.item_group,
					jb.bom_pos
			FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Source' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			--LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = iv.ent_id -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			INNER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 -- Get only for the consumable material
			--OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			--INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no AND cj.state_cd = 4 -- only take inventory who job completed
			INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no  -- only take inventory who job completed
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																			FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																			WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(jb.item_id,1)
			--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Source', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oea.storage_ent_id,'source',iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id,null)
			WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND isNotValidEnt=0   
			--AND (iv.ent_id IS NOT NULL OR iv.qty_left > 0.00) -- Get only for filled silo => Disabled because handled by silo validity
			order by cj.act_finish_time_local,iv.date_in_local ASC
			
			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos

			DECLARE @Len INT 
			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceSilos 

			UPDATE @SourceSilos SET ratio = ratio/@Len -- Update ratio

			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @id=ID,@dest_type=dest_type,@storage_ent_id=mes_silo_id,@parent_item_id=parent_item_id,@ratio=ratio,@silo_item_group =silo_item_group,
				@silo_item_id = mes_item_id
				FROM @SourceSilos WHERE ID = @minID
				print '@storage_ent_id'
				print @storage_ent_id
				
				SELECT @jb_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd from job_bom WITH (nolock)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and item_id = @silo_item_id
				
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
										(
										 [wo_id]									
										,[oper_id]							
										,[seq_no]					
										,[parent_item_id]
										,[ent_id]
										,[jb_item_id] 	
										,[jb_item_group] 
										,[jb_grade_cd] 								
										,[dest_type]							
										,[is_chk]
										,[su_ent_id]
										,[is_active]
										,[ratio]
										,[created_at_utc]
										,[created_at_local]
										,[created_by]
										,[last_edit_at_utc]
										,[last_edit_at_local]
										,[last_edit_by]
										,[active_su_ent_id]
										,[silo_seq]
										)
								VALUES
										(
										 @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@parent_item_id
										,@target_sched_ent_id
										,@silo_item_id
										,@silo_item_group
										,@jb_grade_cd
										,1
										,1
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										,@ratio*100.00
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										)
				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos WHERE id > @minID
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos = 0
	UNION
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos < 0
	UNION 
	SELECT * FROM @SourceSilos where ratio > 0

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_IsValExists]
(
	@grp_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@value_index	INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@value_exists	INT32_NULL = NULL OUT
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_IsValExists
-- Description					- For a given data_log_grp and a value column, this method checks whether any data log value exists
--								  for this group and returns 1 (true) if exists, otherwise 0 (false)
-- Author						- Raghu
-- Date Created					- 08/23/2004
-- Version						- 2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 07/09/2007		AML				3.2.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE	@max_value		INT32_NULL,
			@table_name		STRING40_NULL,
			@col_name		STRING40_NULL,
			@sql			STRING2000_NULL,
			@val_exists		INT32_NULL,
			@ParmDefinition	STRING40_NULL -- Added for CR L00105881


	SELECT @max_value = max_value FROM data_log_grp WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @grp_id

	IF ( @max_value IS NULL ) BEGIN
		RAISERROR( 'No data found.', 16, 1 )
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF ( @max_value = 16 ) BEGIN
		SET @table_name = 'data_log_16'
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @table_name = 'data_log_48'
	END

	IF ( @max_value = 16 ) BEGIN
		IF NOT ( @value_index >= 1 AND @value_index <= 16 ) BEGIN
			RAISERROR( 'The value index must be in the range 1-16.{5589}', 16, 1 )
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE IF ( @max_value = 48 ) BEGIN
		IF NOT ( @value_index >= 1 AND @value_index <=48 ) BEGIN
			RAISERROR( 'The value index must be in the range 1-48.{5590}', 16, 1 )
			RETURN -1
		END
	END

	SET @col_name = 'VALUE' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @value_index )

	-- CR L00105881 - Changed the commented code to the code following comments to address the fact that the procedure always returned 0
--	SET @sql = 'SELECT ISNULL( SUM( x.val ), 0 ) FROM ' +
--			   '(SELECT 1 AS val FROM ' + @table_name +
--			   ' WHERE grp_id = ' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @grp_id ) + ' AND ' + @col_name + ' IS NOT NULL) x'
--
--	EXECUTE sp_executesql @value_exists = @sql
	SET @sql = 'SELECT @val_e = ISNULL( SUM( x.val ), 0 ) FROM ' +
			   '(SELECT 1 AS val FROM ' + @table_name +
			   ' WHERE grp_id = ' + CONVERT( VARCHAR, @grp_id ) + ' AND ' + @col_name + ' IS NOT NULL) x'
	SET @ParmDefinition = N'@val_e int OUTPUT';

	EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql, @ParmDefinition, @val_e = @value_exists OUTPUT
	-- End changes for CR L00105881

	IF ( @value_exists IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @value_exists = 0
	END
END

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - SP_LOOK_JOB_ROUTE_TABLE_STACK
-- Description	  - same as sp_LOOK_job_route_table except it calls sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY_stack
--                  instead to avoid recursion
-- Author	      - KRF
-- Date Created	  - 03/18/2002

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
--fields from JOB_ROUTE and JOB table
DECLARE @JR_input_oper_id STRING40
DECLARE @JR_input_seq_no  INT32
DECLARE @J_item_id    STRING40
-- DECLARE @DEBUG_STR    NVARCHAR(2000)
DECLARE @system_severity  INT

BEGIN
  --28	Find input_oper_id (matching row) from JOB_ROUTE table for wo_id, JOB.oper_id, JOB.seq_no
  DECLARE Job_Route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT JR.input_oper_id, JR.input_seq_no, J.item_id

  BEGIN
    EXEC sp_I_Error_Log_Enh 1, 'sp_LOOK_job_route_table', 'sp_LOOK_job_route_table',
           'Before calling sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY', 'CALLING sp_CALL_build_BOM_with_proper_START_QTY', '', @system_severity

  DEALLOCATE Job_Route_cursor

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Result_RecordResultData] (

@operator      STRING40_NULL,
@created_at_utc	DATETIME = NULL,
@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0,
@control_rule_violations NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                    - sp_I_Result_RecordResultData
-- Description                    - Implements Section 4.3.2 of the SRO DFS.
-- Author                         - JA
-- Date Created                   - 6/24/2011
-- Version (last edit)            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By        Ver            Changes
-- 04/11/2012		MS				  				Fix for the CR L00119541
-- 11.08/2019		RWB					6.2			US#1184121: Added created_at_utc as a parameter so the time of the results can be specified
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
   @char_id int,
   @char_type int,
   @created_by  nvarchar(80),
   @row_id INT32,
   @err_msg STRING80

BEGIN
    -- Raise an error if sample_id is invalid
   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id = @sample_id)
     BEGIN
       SET @err_msg = '%1 sample does not exist<7543>,'  + STR(@sample_id)
       RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
       RETURN
   END

   SELECT @char_id=char_id,@char_type=type
   FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK)
   WHERE char_name=@char_name;

   IF @char_id IS NULL BEGIN
      SET @err_msg = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + @char_name
      RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
      RETURN
   END

   IF @operator IS NOT NULL
       SET @created_by=@operator
   ELSE
      EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @created_by OUTPUT, NULL

   EXECUTE sp_I_Result_AddXML @sample_id = @sample_id, @char_id = @char_id, @operator = @operator, @created_at_utc = @created_at_utc, @results = @resultsxml, @control_rule_violations = @control_rule_violations OUTPUT
 END

-- =============================================
-- Name:    [SP_S_ofi_Get_Cons_Qty_Value] 
-- Description:  Get qty consumption used for minimizing multiple xml command in the consumption wf
--
-- Usage:  MDMAddConsumptionWF
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00	 YG          2023-03-10			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	 MP          2023-05-02			To get the SU Name & status
-- 0.03.00	 YG			 2023-06-03			Set silo name in to the output
-- 0.04.00	 YG			 2024-01-17			Set error message using localization
-- 0.04.01   YG			 2024-01-22			Localization Updated
-- 0.05.00   YG			 2024-02-27			Add checking on the item
-- ===========================================================================================
-- exec SP_S_ofi_Get_Cons_Qty_Value '1001019120','Roasting',0,515002,'800',319
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_Get_Cons_Qty_Value] 
	@wo_id nvarchar(40),
	@oper_id nvarchar(100),
	@seq_no int,
	@aut_storage_id int,
	@qty_cons FLOAT,
	@ent_id int
AS
BEGIN
	--Used for debugging
	--select @wo_id = '1000675206',@oper_id = 'Roasting', @seq_no = 0, @aut_storage_id = 515003, @ent_id = 319, @qty_cons = 500
	--select  @wo_id=N'1000006004',@oper_id=N'BreakingWinnowing',@seq_no=0,@aut_storage_id=500001,@qty_cons=100000,@ent_id=208

	DECLARE @mes_item_id NVARCHAR(40),
			@factor FLOAT,
			@SP_Name NVARCHAR(100)= '[SP_S_ofi_Get_Cons_Qty_Value]',
			@type INT,
			@qty_to_consume FLOAT,
			@su_status nvarchar(40),
			@storage_ent_id INT,
			@su_aut_name nvarchar(40)

	-- 1. ++ Retrieve Item from Inventory from Location Provided
	DECLARE @ItemTable TABLE(
		item_id nvarchar(40)
	)

	INSERT INTO @ItemTable
	EXEC SP_S_ofi_GetItemForConsumption @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@aut_storage_id, NULL

	SELECT @mes_item_id = item_id FROM @ItemTable

	SELECT @storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
		AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
		AND a.attr_grp = 2
		AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@aut_storage_id AS NVARCHAR)

	--Get the Storage unit Automation name V.0.02.00
	SELECT @su_aut_name=ent_name 
			FROM ent  WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE ent_id=@storage_ent_id 

	IF (@mes_item_id is NULL)
	BEGIN
		--SELECT -2 type, 'No item is not available in the storage, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
		--SELECT -2 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('No item is not available in the storage, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
		SELECT -2 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300046,NULL,10),@SP_Name) message_info
		, @su_aut_name su_aut_name --v0.03.00 Added
		RETURN 
	END
	-- 1. --

	-- 2. ++ Retrieve Factor 
	DECLARE @FactorTable TABLE(
		factor float
	)

	INSERT @FactorTable
	EXEC sp_S_ofi_uomconv_AUT @mes_item_id,@ent_id,'CONS'

	SELECT @factor = factor FROM @FactorTable

	IF (@factor is NULL)
	BEGIN
		--SELECT -3 type, 'Factor is not defined, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
		--SELECT -3 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Factor is not defined, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
		SELECT -3 type, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300047,NULL,10),@SP_Name) message_info
		RETURN 
	END
	-- 2. --

	-- 3. ++ Get Real Qty To Be Consume after Convertion
	DECLARE @ConsQtyTable TABLE(
		type INT,
		qty_to_consume FLOAT DEFAULT 0.00
	)

	INSERT @ConsQtyTable
	EXEC SP_S_ofi_AUT_Get_Cons_Qty @mes_item_id,  @aut_storage_id, @qty_cons, @factor

	SELECT @type = type, @qty_to_consume = qty_to_consume FROM @ConsQtyTable
	-- 3. --

	-- 4. ++ Check Grade Code
	DECLARE @grade_cd INT,
		@status_cd INT,
		@minID INT,
		@req_grade_cd INT,
		@typeOfCons NVARCHAR(20) = 'FIFO', 
		@storage_item_id NVARCHAR(40)

	SELECT @typeOfCons = attr_value
	FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
									AND a.attr_desc = 'typeOfCons'
									AND a.attr_grp = 2
	WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_ent_id

	SELECT TOP 1 @storage_item_id = item_id FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE ent_id = @storage_ent_id

	SET @typeOfCons = ISNULL(@typeOfCons,'FIFO')

	SELECT @req_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd
	FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id  = @wo_id and
		  oper_id = @oper_id and
		  seq_no = @seq_no and 
		  item_id = @storage_item_id

----Check the SU have 'LockForOutput'/'BlockForQuality'/'LockForInput' V.0.02.00
SELECT TOP 1 @su_status=attr_desc 
			FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) 
			inner join attr a WITH (NOLOCK) 
			ON ea.attr_id=a.attr_id 
			WHERE ent_id=@storage_ent_id 
			AND attr_desc in ('LockForOutput','BlockForQuality','LockForInput') 
			AND attr_value='1'

	DECLARE @invlist1 TABLE (id INT  PRIMARY KEY, 
							lot NVARCHAR(40) ,
							sublot NVARCHAR(40), 
							qty FLOAT, 
							cons_qty FLOAT,  
							consume_full BIT ,
							grade_cd INT, 
							status_cd INT, 
							row_id int)

	INSERT INTO @invlist1
	EXEC SP_SA_ofi_item_inv_typeOfCons @storage_ent_id, @mes_item_id, @qty_to_consume, 'FIFO'

	SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @invlist1 WHERE cons_qty >0

	WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL )
	BEGIN
		SELECT @grade_cd = grade_cd, @status_cd = status_cd FROM @invlist1 WHERE id = @minID

		IF(@req_grade_cd <> @grade_cd)
		BEGIN
			--SELECT -4 type, @mes_item_id mes_item_id, ISNULL(@qty_to_consume,0.00) qty_to_consume, 'Grade is not match with The BOM, '+ @SP_Name message_info -- v0.04.00 replaced the script
			--SELECT -4 type, @mes_item_id mes_item_id, ISNULL(@qty_to_consume,0.00) qty_to_consume, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg('Grade is not match with The BOM, ',  10),@SP_Name) message_info
			SELECT -4 type, @mes_item_id mes_item_id, ISNULL(@qty_to_consume,0.00) qty_to_consume, CONCAT(dbo.fn_ofi_lm_getLangString(300048,NULL,10),@SP_Name) message_info
			, @su_aut_name su_aut_name --v0.03.00 Added
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @invlist1 WHERE id > @minID AND cons_qty >0
	END
	-- 4. --

	IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM item_inv iv
			  LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id = @wo_id 
														and jb.oper_id = @oper_id 
														and jb.seq_no = @seq_no 
														and jb.item_id = iv.item_id
				WHERE 
					iv.ent_id = @storage_ent_id
					AND jb.item_id IS NULL)
	BEGIN

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Validate_Scheduled_Job]
(
@user_name NVARCHAR(50)
, @sessionId int = null
, @wo_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL
, @res_grp_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL
, @loc_id NVARCHAR(max) = NULL --Example 2,3,4,
, @functionType NVARCHAR(max) = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	

      -- Create temp table to res_grp_id for a give location id
      declare @res_grp as TABLE 
        (
           res_grp_id INT,
		   ent_id INT,
		   Seq_No INT,
		   grpOrder INT
        )

	  INSERT INTO @res_grp
                        (res_grp_id, ent_id,seq_no)
            SELECT rg.res_grp_id, rge.ent_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rge.ent_id ORDER BY rg.res_grp_id asc)
            FROM   sdb.[SCH].[res_grp] rg WITH(nolock)
			INNER JOIN sdb.sch.res_grp_ent rge WITH(NOLOCK) ON rg.res_grp_id = rge.res_grp_id
			
            WHERE  ( @res_grp_id IS NULL AND rg.loc_id IN (SELECT value
                                 FROM   Fn_split(@loc_id, ','))) or rg.res_grp_id IN (SELECT value
                                          FROM
                       Fn_split(@res_grp_id, ','))

	if @functionType is null 
	begin
		set @functionType = 'SessionValidation'
	end


	EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_ExecExtendFunc] @SessionId = @sessionId  ,@User_Name = @user_name  ,@functionType = @functionType,  @runatloadorder = null
	
	--EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_MDM_Sched_Update_ScheduleJobDistribution_Validate_Session]    @sessionId  ,@user_name

	update SDB..scheduler_exec set is_validated = 1, validated_by = @user_name, validated_at = GETDATE() , job_sched_pinned = 1
			where 
			--is_checkedout = 1 and  checkedout_by  = @user_name  --and cast(last_edit_at as Date) = cast(GETDATE() as Date)
			--and 
			session_id = isnull(@sessionId,session_id)

if @res_grp_id is not null
begin
SELECT SSV.[wo_id] as [work order]
      ,SSV.[oper_id]  as [operation]
      ,SSV.[job_seq_no]  as [job sequence]
      ,SSV.[session_id] as [session id] 
      ,SSV.[Error_Code] as [error code]
      ,SSV.[Error_Description] as [error description]
      ,SSV.[Validation_Match] as [validation]
      ,SSV.[Validation_Time] as [Validation time]
      --,SSV.[v_wo_id]
      --,SSV.[v_oper_id]
      --,SSV.[v_job_seq_no]
      --,SSV.[last_edit_at]
      ,SSV.[row_id]
  FROM [SDB].[SCH].[scheduler_session_validation] SSV with (nolock)
  inner join [SDB].[DBO].[scheduler_exec] SE with (nolock) ON SSV.session_id = se.session_id and SE.wo_id = SSV.wo_id and se.oper_id = ssv.oper_id and se.job_seq_no = ssv.job_seq_no and SE.is_checkedout = 1
  INNER JOIN @res_grp rg on rg.ent_id = se.job_sched_entity_id and rg.Seq_No = 1

  where SSV.session_id = @sessionId  
end
else
begin
SELECT SSV.[wo_id] as [work order]
      ,SSV.[oper_id]  as [operation]
      ,SSV.[job_seq_no]  as [job sequence]
      ,SSV.[session_id] as [session id] 
      ,SSV.[Error_Code] as [error code]
      ,SSV.[Error_Description] as [error description]
      ,SSV.[Validation_Match] as [validation]
      ,SSV.[Validation_Time] as [Validation time]
      --,SSV.[v_wo_id]
      --,SSV.[v_oper_id]
      --,SSV.[v_job_seq_no]
      --,SSV.[last_edit_at]
      ,SSV.[row_id]
  FROM [SDB].[SCH].[scheduler_session_validation] SSV with (nolock)
  inner join [SDB].[DBO].[scheduler_exec] SE with (nolock) ON SSV.session_id = se.session_id and SE.wo_id = SSV.wo_id and se.oper_id = ssv.oper_id and se.job_seq_no = ssv.job_seq_no and SE.is_checkedout = 1
  

  where SSV.session_id = @sessionId and se.is_checkedout = 1
end


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_LU_GetLaborCount]
(
		@labor_start_start_local TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@labor_start_start_tz	 INT32 = NULL
	,	@labor_start_end_local   TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@labor_start_end_tz		 INT32 = NULL
	,	@user_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@ent_id                  INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@wo_id                   STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no                  INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@step_no                 INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no                  STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no               STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@lab_cd                  STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@dept_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_id                INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_start_local TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_start_tz	 INT32 = NULL
	,	@shift_start_end_local   TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@shift_start_end_tz		 INT32 = NULL
	,	@pct_to_apply_min        INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@pct_to_apply_max        INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@active                  LOGICAL
	,	@duration_min            INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@duration_max            INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@comments                STRING254_NULL = NULL
	,	@raw_reas_cd             STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_by            STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@last_edit_at            TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
	,	@log_id                  INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value    INT32 = NULL
	,	@no_of_labor_records	 INT32 Output

)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    - SP_SA_LU_GETLABORCOUNT
-- Description    - HD# 9721, Retrieves labor_usage records based on the supplied filters
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 04/16/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
--07/24/2007    Raghu       3.3.1   HD# 10081, Change shift_start with *_utc and *_local.
--01/20/2008	DonT		3.4.0	CR L00073982 - made @no_of_labor_records argument an Output parameter
-- 11/30/2009  Kishore   4.1   HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN

	DECLARE @shift_start_start_utc	TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_start_utc  TDATETIME
		,	@labor_start_end_utc    TDATETIME
		,	@v_current_time_utc     TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp				INT32
		,	@dbg_resp				INT32

	SET @labor_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@labor_start_start_tz)
	SET @labor_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@labor_start_end_tz)
	SET @shift_start_start_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_start_tz)
	SET @shift_start_end_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@shift_start_end_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

   EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_LU_GetLaborCount', @src_key='on_entry',
		@date_val1 = @labor_start_start_local, @numeric_val1 = @labor_start_start_tz
      , @date_val2 = @labor_start_end_local, @numeric_val2 = @labor_start_end_tz
      , @date_val3 = @shift_start_start_local, @numeric_val3 = @shift_start_start_tz
      , @date_val4 = @shift_start_end_local, @numeric_val4 = @shift_start_end_tz

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_start_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@shift_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @shift_start_end_local, @tz_temp, @shift_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@labor_start_start_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_start_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_start_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@labor_start_end_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @labor_start_end_local, @tz_temp, @labor_start_end_utc OUTPUT

	SET @v_current_time_utc = GETUTCDATE()

    SELECT @no_of_labor_records = COUNT(*)
    FROM labor_usage lu WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.ent_id = e.ent_id
    INNER JOIN labor_cat lc WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.lab_cd = lc.lab_cd
    INNER JOIN labor_dept ld WITH (NOLOCK) ON ld.dept_id = lu.dept_id
    INNER JOIN shift s WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.shift_id = s.shift_id
    INNER JOIN user_name un WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.user_id = un.user_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON lu.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE (lu.labor_start_utc >= @labor_start_start_utc OR @labor_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.labor_start_utc <= @labor_start_end_utc OR @labor_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.user_id LIKE @user_id OR @user_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.wo_id LIKE @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.oper_id LIKE @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.item_id LIKE @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.lot_no LIKE @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.sublot_no LIKE @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
      AND (lu.lab_cd LIKE @lab_cd OR @lab_cd IS NULL)
      AND (lu.dept_id LIKE @dept_id OR @dept_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.shift_id = @shift_id OR @shift_id IS NULL)
      AND (lu.shift_start_utc >= @shift_start_start_utc OR @shift_start_start_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_end_utc OR @shift_start_end_utc IS NULL)
      AND (lu.pct_to_apply >= @pct_to_apply_min OR @pct_to_apply_min IS NULL)
      AND (lu.pct_to_apply <= @pct_to_apply_max OR @pct_to_apply_max IS NULL)
      AND (lu.active = @active OR @active IS NULL)
      AND (lu.duration >= @duration_min OR @duration_min IS NULL)
      AND (lu.duration <= @duration_max OR @duration_max IS NULL)
      AND (lu.comments LIKE @comments OR @comments IS NULL)
      AND (lu.raw_reas_cd LIKE @raw_reas_cd OR @raw_reas_cd IS NULL)
      AND (lu.last_edit_by LIKE @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL)
      AND (lu.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
      AND (lu.log_id = @log_id OR @log_id IS NULL)

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_GetEntities
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch all the equipments with some filters
--
-- Usage:		CloneMasterRecipe, AddMasterRecipe, EditMasterRecipe 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-07-15			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  YG				2023-01-26			Added 2nd Parent Ent Id 
-- 0.03.00	SM				2023-08-04			Added on v0.4 to inculde the ent description if description is empty then ent name is displayed
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE    Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetEntities]
(@recipe_name	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
@entity_type	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
@type			INT = NULL -- 1 = Get equipments have capability can_run_jobs and entitytype = @entity_type  (used for AddMasterRecipe Form)
						   -- 2 = All filters available in type 1 and same parent id (used for CloneMasterRecipe Form)
) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @iParentEntId INT,
			@iParentEntId2 INT,
			@iEntityTypeAttrId INT,
			@strEntityTypeAttrDesc NVARCHAR(40) = 'EntityType'

	-- Retrieve entity type attr id
	SELECT @iEntityTypeAttrId = attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE attr_desc = @strEntityTypeAttrDesc AND attr_grp = 2

	-- Retrieve equipment id and desc
	IF (@type = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			e.ent_id, 
			e.ent_name
			--isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_name    --V0.03.00 Update ent description and it its' empty  ent name is displayed. old code --e.ent_name
		FROM 
			ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN 
			ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
										AND ea.attr_id = @iEntityTypeAttrId
		WHERE 
			can_run_jobs = 1 
			AND ea.attr_value = @entity_type
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		-- Retrieve parent ent 
		SELECT @iParentEntId = parent_ent_id 
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id  =	(SELECT ent_id 
						FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name)

		SELECT @iParentEntId2 = parent_ent_id 
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id  =	@iParentEntId

		SELECT 
			e.ent_id, 
			e.ent_name
			--isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_name    --V0.03.00 Update ent description and it its' empty  ent name is displayed. old code --e.ent_name 
		FROM 
			ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN 
			ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id 
											AND ea.attr_id = @iEntityTypeAttrId
		WHERE 
			ea.attr_value = @entity_type
			AND parent_ent_id IN (select ent_id from ent where parent_ent_id = @iParentEntId2)
			AND can_run_jobs = 1
	END
END
