CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetEntitiesForJob]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50),
	@seq_no int,
	@oper_id nvarchar(50)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

	declare @init_ent nvarchar(50)
	declare @attr_val nvarchar(100)

	select @init_ent=init_sched_ent_id from job with (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and seq_no=@seq_no and oper_id=@oper_id

	select @attr_val=a.attr_value from ent_attr a with (nolock)
	inner join ent e with (nolock) on e.ent_id=a.ent_id 
	inner join attr atr with (nolock) on a.attr_id=atr.attr_id
	where e.ent_id=@init_ent and atr.attr_desc='EntityType'

	if @attr_val='Area'
	BEGIN
	select distinct ent.ent_id,isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name) as ent_name from ent with (nolock)
		inner join ent_attr ea with (nolock) on ea.ent_id=ent.ent_id
		inner join attr atr with (nolock) on ea.attr_id=atr.attr_id
	inner join job j with (nolock) on ent.parent_ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
	where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no and j.oper_id=@oper_id and ea.attr_value<>'StorageUnit' and atr.attr_desc='EntityType'
	END

	if @attr_val='Segment'
	BEGIN
	if exists(
					select ent.ent_id,isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name) as ent_name from ent with (nolock) 
					inner join job j with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
	
					where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.seq_no=0
					group by
					ent.ent_id,
					ent.ent_name,
					ent.description
					having COUNT(*)>1)
					BEGIN
							select distinct ent.ent_id,isnull(ent.description,ent.ent_name) as ent_name from ent  with (nolock)
					inner join job j with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
					where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no
					END
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							select distinct e.ent_id,isnull(e.description,e.ent_name) as ent_name from ent with (nolock)
							inner join ent e with (nolock) on e.ent_id=ent.parent_ent_id
					inner join job j with (nolock) on ent.ent_id=j.init_sched_ent_id
					where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no
					END
	END
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

--

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

 IF @predefined IS null SET @predefined = 0
 IF @data_type IS null SET @data_type = 0
 IF @entry_type IS NULL SET @entry_type = 0
 IF @visible_in_queue IS NULL SET @visible_in_queue = 0
 IF @visible_in_inv IS NULL SET @visible_in_inv = 0

 INSERT INTO attr
 (predefined,
  data_type,
  attr_desc,
  attr_grp,
  filtr,
  entry_type,
  visible_in_queue,
  visible_in_inv,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
VALUES
  (@predefined,
   @data_type,
   @attr_desc,
   @attr_grp,
   @filtr,
   @entry_type,
   @visible_in_queue,
   @visible_in_inv,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
SELECT @attr_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_APR_DropTable]
  (@table_name NVARCHAR(30))
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_SankeyChartDetails_Export_test]
	@wo_id      NVARCHAR(40)   = NULL
  , @item_class NVARCHAR(20)   = NULL
  , @item_id    NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL
  , @lot_no     NVARCHAR(30)   = NULL
  , @type       NVARCHAR(15)   = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#fg_wo') IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #fg_wo
	END

	DECLARE @childTableInvValidation TABLE
	(
		material     NVARCHAR(400)
	  , lot_no       NVARCHAR(40)
	  , sublot_no    NVARCHAR(40)
	  , ent_id       INT
	  , silo_ent_id  INT
	  , qty          INT
	  , id           INT
	  , source       INT
	  , destination  INT
	  , fg_lot_no    NVARCHAR(40) NULL
	  , fg_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40) NULL
	)

	DECLARE @material    NVARCHAR(400)
		  , @qty         INT
		  , @oper_id     NVARCHAR(80)
		  , @seq_no      INT
		  , @source      INT
		  , @destination INT
		  , @Mtrl_info   NVARCHAR(80)
		  , @dest        INT
		  , @cur_Source  INT
		  , @querytext   NVARCHAR(100)
		  , @OutputFile  NVARCHAR(100)
		  , @cmd         VARCHAR(255)
		  , @produce     INT
		  , @consume     INT

	DECLARE @fg_item             NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @id                  INT
		  , @fg_wo               NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @fg_lot_no           NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_lot              NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_qty              FLOAT
		  , @sscc                NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @pallet_id           NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @pallet_qty          FLOAT
		  , @pallet_item_id      NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @pallet_lot_no       NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_wo              NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_seq_no          INT
		  , @sfg_qty             FLOAT
		  , @sfg_item_id         NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_lot_no          NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_sublot_no       NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_fg_lot_no       NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_fg_sublot_no    NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_ent_id          INT
		  , @sfg_silo_ent_id     INT
		  , @rm_source           INT
		  , @sfg_source          INT
		  , @rm_item             NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_item_id          NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_lot_no           NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @item_desc           NVARCHAR(100)
		  , @rm_wo               NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_seq_no           INT
		  , @rm_wo_qty           FLOAT
		  , @rm_cons_item_id     NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_cons_qty         FLOAT
		  , @rm_cons_lot_no      NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @item_class_id       NVARCHAR(10)
		  , @rm_cons_int_wo      NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_cons_int_seq_no  INT
		  , @rm_cons_raw_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_cons_raw_lot_no  NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @rm_cons_raw_qty     FLOAT
		  , @rm_cons_int_qty     FLOAT
		  , @APOPER_ID           NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @APRMOPER_ID         NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @sfg_oper_id         NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @fg_oper_id          NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @pallet_oper_id      NVARCHAR(40)
		  , @sfg_lot             NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @sfg_sub_lot         NVARCHAR(30)
		  , @max_id              INT
		  , @item_desc_input     VARCHAR(1000);

	SET @item_desc_input = @item_id

	SET @item_id = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@item_id, 0, CHARINDEX(' | ', @item_id))))
	SET @item_desc_input = TRIM(REPLACE(@item_desc_input, @item_id + ' | ', ''))

	IF(@type = 'downstream') --RAW->SFG->FG
	BEGIN

		--	DECLARE @sfg_source INT
		SET @sfg_source = 1
		SET @destination = @sfg_source + 1
		SET @sfg_source = @source
		SET @id = 1

		--RETRIEVE THE FINISH FINISHED-GOOD WORK ORDER
		SELECT
			wo_id
		  , seq_no
		  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ic.item_id, SUM(qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons'--
		  , OPER_ID
		  , lot_no
		  , sublot_no
		  , fg_lot_no
		  , fg_sublot_no
		  , ent_id
		  , from_ent_id AS                                                        silo_ent_id
		--  , row_id
		  , ic.item_id
		  , i.item_desc AS                                                        item_desc--+ ' _ ' + ISNULL(ic.lot_no, 0)
		  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
		ORDER BY
			sublot_no) AS                                                         id
		  , 0 AS                                                                  'source'--- 1 + row_number() over (ORDER BY sublot_no)
		  , 0 AS                                                                  'destination'
		  , 0 AS                                                                  'processed'
		INTO
			#sfg_wo
		FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE
			ic.item_id = @item_id
			AND lot_no = @lot_no
			AND
			(
				@wo_id IS NULL
				OR wo_id = @wo_id
			)
		GROUP BY
			wo_id
		  , lot_no
		  , seq_no
		  , OPER_ID
		  , ic.ITEM_ID
		  , item_desc
		  , i.uom_id
		  , sublot_no
		  , ent_id
		  , from_ent_id
		  , fg_lot_no
		  , fg_sublot_no
		ORDER BY
			id-- desc
		--SELECT
		--	*
		--FROM #sfg_wo
		DECLARE @prod_row_id INT
		--INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
		--	(
		--		material
		--	  , lot_no
		--	  , sublot_no
		--	  , ent_id
		--	  , silo_ent_id
		--	  , qty
		--	  , id
		--	  , source
		--	  , destination
		--	  ,  fg_lot_no 
		--	  , fg_sublot_no 
		--	)
		--	SELECT item_desc ,lot_no ,sublot_no, ent_id, silo_ent_id,qty_cons,
		--	 row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sublot_no) AS id,
		--	source  as 'source',
		--	row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sublot_no)  as 'destination' 
		--	,fg_lot_no
		--	,fg_sublot_no
		--	FROM #sfg_wo 
		--	ORDER BY sublot_no
		WHILE (SELECT
				   COUNT(*)
			   FROM #sfg_wo
			   WHERE Processed = 0) > 0
		BEGIN

			--	declare @prod_row_id int
			SELECT TOP 1
				@material = item_Desc
			  , @sfg_lot = lot_no
			  , @sfg_ent_id = ent_id
			  , @sfg_silo_ent_id = silo_ent_id
			  , @sfg_sub_lot = sublot_no
			  , @sfg_fg_lot_no = fg_lot_no
			  , @sfg_fg_sublot_no = fg_sublot_no
			  , @sfg_qty = qty_cons
			  , @source = source
			  , @prod_row_id = id
			  , @sfg_wo = wo_id
			  , @sfg_oper_id = oper_id
			  , @sfg_seq_no = seq_no
			FROM #sfg_wo
			WHERE processed = 0
			--ORDER BY
			--	ID
			ORDER BY
				id ASC
			--seq_no ASC
			--
			--select @prod_row_id--AAA
			UPDATE #sfg_wo
			SET
				processed = 1
			WHERE
				ID = @prod_row_id

			DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
			FOR SELECT
					ip.item_id
				  , ip.lot_no
				  , ip.sublot_no
				  , ip.ent_id
				  , ip.to_ent_id AS                                                       silo_ent_id
				  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ip.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod' --SUM(ip.qty_prod)
				  , ip.oper_id
				  , @sfg_fg_lot_no                                                        fg_lot_no
				  , @sfg_fg_sublot_no AS                                                  fg_sublot_no
				FROM item_prod ip WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ip.item_id = i.item_id
				--INNER Join item_cons ic  on ip.sublot_no = ic.fg_sublot_no
				WHERE
					ip.lot_no = @sfg_fg_lot_no
					AND ip.sublot_no = @sfg_fg_sublot_no
				GROUP BY
					ip.lot_no
				  , ip.item_id
				  , ip.oper_id
				  , i.uom_id
				  , ip.sublot_no
				  , ip.ent_id
				  , ip.to_ent_id
			--  ,ic.fg_lot_no
			-- , ic.fg_sublot_no
			OPEN sfg_item

			FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
										, @sfg_lot_no
										, @sfg_sublot_no
										, @sfg_ent_id
										, @sfg_silo_ent_id
										, @sfg_qty
										, @sfg_oper_id
										, @sfg_fg_lot_no
										, @sfg_fg_sublot_no

			WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
			BEGIN

				SET @sfg_source = @prod_row_id
				IF EXISTS (SELECT
							   1
						   FROM item_prod WITH(NOLOCK)
						   WHERE sublot_no = @sfg_fg_sublot_no)
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1
						@sfg_source = ID
					FROM @childTableInvValidation
					WHERE id > (SELECT
									MAX(source)
								FROM @childTableInvValidation)
							   ORDER BY
								   ID
				END
					ELSE
				BEGIN

					SET @sfg_source = 999
				END

				--SET @id = @destination
				--select @prod_row_id
				SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
									  item_desc
								  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
								  WHERE item_id = @sfg_item_id)

				SET @material = @item_desc --+ '_' + ISNULL(@sfg_lot_no, 0)
				--select TOP 1 @id=id+1 from @childTableInvValidation ORDER BY id DESC
				SELECT
					@max_id = MAX(id)
				FROM @childTableInvValidation
				SET @id = @max_id + 1

				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT
								   row_id
							   FROM item_cons
							   WHERE sublot_no = @sfg_sublot_no)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
					(
						material
					  , lot_no
					  , sublot_no
					  , ent_id
					  , silo_ent_id
					  , qty
					  , id
					  , source
					  , destination
					  , fg_lot_no
					  , fg_sublot_no
					)
					VALUES
					(
						   @material
						 , @sfg_lot_no
						 , @sfg_sublot_no
						 , @sfg_ent_id
						 , @sfg_silo_ent_id
						 , @sfg_qty
						 , @id
						 , 55
						 , @destination
						 , @sfg_fg_lot_no
						 , @sfg_fg_sublot_no
					)
				END
				--SELECT *,'Here' from @childTableInvValidation
				--IF((SELECT count(id) from @childTableInvValidation where id=@id) >1)
				--	BEGIN				
				--	UPDATE x
				--	SET x.id = x.new_id
				--	FROM (
				--	      SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER()over (order by (select NULL)) AS new_id
				--	      FROM @childTableInvValidation WHERE id=@id
				--	      ) x
				--	END
				-- RETRIEVE THE SFG PRODUCED WORK ORDER BASED ON THE SFG ITEM
				SELECT
					@max_id = MAX(id)
				FROM #sfg_wo
				SET @id = @max_id + 1
				
				INSERT INTO #sfg_wo
				SELECT
					wo_id
				  , seq_no
				  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](ic.item_id, SUM(qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons'--SUM(qty_cons) as 'qty_cons'
				  , OPER_ID
				  , lot_no
				  , sublot_no
				  , fg_lot_no
				  , fg_sublot_no
				  , ent_id
				  , from_ent_id AS                                                        silo_ent_id
				--  , row_id
				  , ic.item_id
				  , i.item_desc AS                                                        item_desc--+ ' _ ' + ISNULL(ic.lot_no, 0)
				  , @id AS                                                                id
				  , @source AS                                                            'source'
				  , 0 AS                                                                  'destination'
				  , 0 AS                                                                  'processed'
				FROM item_cons ic WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON ic.item_id = i.item_id
				WHERE
					ic.item_id = @sfg_item_id
					AND ic.lot_no = @sfg_lot_no
					AND ic.sublot_no = @sfg_sublot_no
				--AND jb.aaObsolete=0
				GROUP BY
					ic.wo_id
				  , ic.seq_no
				  , ic.lot_no
				  , ic.oper_id
				  , ic.item_id
				  , item_Desc
				  , i.uom_id
				  , sublot_no
				  , ent_id
				  , from_ent_id
				  , fg_lot_no
				  , fg_sublot_no

				SET @destination = @destination + 1 --NEXT VALUE FOR id_seq
				IF( (SELECT
						 COUNT(id)
					 FROM #sfg_wo
					 WHERE id = @id) > 1)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE x
					SET
						x.id = x.new_id
					FROM (SELECT
							  id
							, @id - 1 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
							  ORDER BY
							  (SELECT
								   NULL) ) AS new_id
						  FROM #sfg_wo
						  WHERE id = @id) x
				END

				FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
											, @sfg_lot_no
											, @sfg_sublot_no
											, @sfg_ent_id
											, @sfg_silo_ent_id
											, @sfg_qty
											, @sfg_oper_id
											, @sfg_fg_lot_no
											, @sfg_fg_sublot_no
	END --end while cursor
			CLOSE sfg_item
			DEALLOCATE sfg_item

	END -- end while #sfg_wo
		DECLARE sfg_add CURSOR
		FOR SELECT
				c.id
			  , c.lot_no
			  , c.sublot_no
			  , c.ent_id
			  , c.silo_ent_id
			  , c.qty
			  , c.material
			FROM @childTableInvValidation c
		OPEN sfg_add

		FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_add INTO @id
								   , @sfg_lot_no
								   , @sfg_sublot_no
								   , @sfg_ent_id
								   , @sfg_silo_ent_id
								   , @sfg_qty
								   , @material

		WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
		BEGIN

			SELECT
				@id = MAX(id) + 1
			FROM #sfg_wo

			IF EXISTS (SELECT
						   1
					   FROM #sfg_wo
					   WHERE fg_sublot_no = @sfg_sublot_no)
			BEGIN
				SELECT
					@source = id
				FROM #sfg_wo
				WHERE fg_sublot_no = @sfg_sublot_no
			END

			INSERT INTO #sfg_wo
			(
				wo_id
			  , seq_no
			  , qty_cons
			  , OPER_ID
			  , lot_no
			  , sublot_no
			  , fg_lot_no
			  , fg_sublot_no
			  , ent_id
			  , silo_ent_id
			  , ic.item_id
			  , item_desc
			  , id
			  , source
			  , destination
			  , processed
			)
			VALUES
			(
				   0
				 , 0
				 , @sfg_qty
				 , ''
				 , @sfg_lot_no
				 , @sfg_sublot_no
				 , ''
				 , ''
				 , @sfg_ent_id
				 , @sfg_silo_ent_id
				 , ''
				 , @material
				 , @id
				 , @source
				 , 0
				 , 0
			)

			FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_add INTO @id
									   , @sfg_lot_no
									   , @sfg_sublot_no
									   , @sfg_ent_id
									   , @sfg_silo_ent_id
									   , @sfg_qty
									   , @material
	END --end while cursor
		CLOSE sfg_add
		DEALLOCATE sfg_add

		--select * FROM #sfg_wo
		--SELECT * from @childTableInvValidation
		DELETE FROM @childTableInvValidation

		INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
		(
			material
		  , lot_no
		  , sublot_no
		  , ent_id
		  , silo_ent_id
		  , qty
		  , id
		  , source
		  , destination
		  , fg_lot_no
		  , fg_sublot_no
		)
		SELECT
			item_desc
		  , lot_no
		  , sublot_no
		  , ent_id
		  , silo_ent_id
		  , qty_cons
		  , id
		  , source
		  , destination
		  , fg_lot_no
		  , fg_sublot_no
		FROM #sfg_wo
		ORDER BY
			ID

	END
		ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@type = 'upstream') --FG->SFG->RAW 
		BEGIN

			SELECT
				@produce = produced
			  , @consume = consumed
			FROM item_class
			WHERE item_class_id = @item_class

			DECLARE @fg_seq_no INT
			DECLARE @fg_qty FLOAT
			DECLARE @fg_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @fg_lot NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @fg_sub_lot NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @fg_ent_id INT
			DECLARE @fg_silo_ent_id INT
			DECLARE @cons_seq_no INT
			DECLARE @cons_qty FLOAT
			DECLARE @cons_item_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_lot_no NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @cons_wo_id NVARCHAR(30)
			DECLARE @fg_source INT

			SET @source = 1
			SET @destination = @source + 1
			SET @fg_source = @source
			SET @id = 1

			SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
								  item_desc
							  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
							  WHERE item_id = @item_id)

			SET @material = @item_desc --+ ' _ ' + ISNULL(@lot_no, 0);
			--RETRIEVE THE FINISH FINISHED-GOOD WORK ORDER
			SELECT
				wo_id
			  , seq_no
			  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](p.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'--SUM(qty_prod)
			  , OPER_ID
			  , lot_no
			  , sublot_no
			  , ent_id
			  , to_ent_id AS                                                         silo_ent_id
			--  , row_id
			  , p.item_id
			  , i.item_desc                                                          item_desc-- + ' _ ' + ISNULL(p.lot_no, 0) AS  
			  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
			ORDER BY
				sublot_no) AS                                                        id
			  , 0 AS                                                                 'source'--- 1 + row_number() over (ORDER BY sublot_no)
			  , @destination - 1 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
				ORDER BY
				sublot_no) AS                                                        'destination'
			  , 0 AS                                                                 'processed'
			INTO
				#fg_wo
			FROM item_prod p WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON p.item_id = i.item_id
			WHERE
				p.item_id = @item_id
				AND lot_no = @lot_no
				AND
				(
					@WO_ID IS NULL
					OR wo_id = @wo_id
				)
			GROUP BY
				wo_id
			  , lot_no
			  , seq_no
			  , OPER_ID
			  , p.ITEM_ID
			  , item_desc
			  , item_desc
			  , i.uom_id
			  , sublot_no
			  , ent_id
			  , to_ent_id
			ORDER BY
				id
			INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
			(
				material
			  , lot_no
			  , sublot_no
			  , ent_id
			  , silo_ent_id
			  , qty
			  , id
			  , source
			  , destination
			)
			SELECT
				item_desc
			  , lot_no
			  , sublot_no
			  , ent_id
			  , silo_ent_id
			  , qty_prod
			  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
				ORDER BY
				sublot_no) AS id
			  , source AS     'source'
			  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
				ORDER BY
				sublot_no) AS 'destination'
			FROM #fg_wo
			ORDER BY
				sublot_no

			WHILE (SELECT
					   COUNT(*)
				   FROM #fg_wo
				   WHERE Processed = 0) > 0
			BEGIN

				SELECT TOP 1
					@material = item_Desc
				  , @fg_lot = lot_no
				  , @fg_ent_id = ent_id
				  , @fg_silo_ent_id = silo_ent_id
				  , @fg_sub_lot = sublot_no
				  , @fg_qty = qty_prod
				  , @source = source
				  , @prod_row_id = id
				  , @fg_wo = wo_id
				  , @fg_oper_id = oper_id
				  , @fg_seq_no = seq_no
				  , @destination = destination
				FROM #fg_wo
				WHERE processed = 0
				--order by ID 
				ORDER BY
					seq_no ASC

				--select @prod_row_id--AAA
				UPDATE #fg_wo
				SET
					processed = 1
				WHERE
					ID = @prod_row_id

				DECLARE sfg_item CURSOR
				FOR SELECT
						cons.item_id
					  , cons.lot_no
					  , cons.sublot_no
					  , cons.ent_id
					  , cons.from_ent_id AS                                                          silo_ent_id
					  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](cons.item_id, SUM(cons.qty_cons), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_cons' --SUM(cons.qty_cons)
					  , oper_id
					  , fg_lot_no
					  , fg_sublot_no
					FROM item_cons cons WITH(NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON cons.item_id = i.item_id
					WHERE
						cons.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot
						AND cons.fg_sublot_no = @fg_sub_lot
					GROUP BY
						cons.lot_no
					  , cons.sublot_no
					  , cons.ent_id
					  , cons.item_id
					  , cons.oper_id
					  , i.uom_id
					  , cons.from_ent_id
					  , fg_lot_no
					  , fg_sublot_no

				OPEN sfg_item

				FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
											, @sfg_lot_no
											, @sfg_sublot_no
											, @sfg_ent_id
											, @sfg_silo_ent_id
											, @sfg_qty
											, @sfg_oper_id
											, @sfg_fg_lot_no
											, @sfg_fg_sublot_no

				WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
				BEGIN

					SELECT
						@max_id = MAX(id)
					FROM #fg_wo
					SET @sfg_source = @prod_row_id
					SET @id = @max_id + 1

					SET @item_desc = (SELECT DISTINCT
										  item_desc
									  FROM item WITH(NOLOCK)
									  WHERE item_id = @sfg_item_id)

					SET @material = @item_desc-- + '_' + ISNULL(@sfg_lot_no, 0)
					INSERT INTO @childTableInvValidation
					(
						material
					  , lot_no
					  , sublot_no
					  , ent_id
					  , silo_ent_id
					  , qty
					  , id
					  , source
					  , destination
					)
					VALUES
					(
						   @material
						 , @sfg_lot_no
						 , @sfg_sublot_no
						 , @sfg_ent_id
						 , @sfg_silo_ent_id
						 , @sfg_qty
						 , @id
						 , @sfg_source
						 , @destination
					)

					INSERT INTO #fg_wo
					SELECT
						wo_id
					  , seq_no
					  , [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg](prod.item_id, SUM(qty_prod), i.uom_id) AS 'qty_prod'--SUM(qty_prod)
					  , OPER_ID
					  , lot_no
					  , sublot_no
					  , ent_id
					  , to_ent_id AS                                                            sfg_silo_ent_id
					  , prod.item_id
					  , i.item_desc AS                                                          item_desc--+ ' _ ' + ISNULL(prod.lot_no, 0)
					  , @id AS                                                                  id
					  , 0 AS                                                                    'source'
					  , 0 AS                                                                    'destination'
					  , 0 AS                                                                    'processed'
					FROM item_prod prod WITH(NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON prod.item_id = i.item_id
					WHERE
						prod.item_id = @sfg_item_id
						AND prod.lot_no = @sfg_lot_no
						AND prod.sublot_no = @sfg_sublot_no
					GROUP BY
						prod.wo_id
					  , prod.seq_no
					  , prod.lot_no
					  , prod.oper_id
					  , prod.item_id
					  , item_Desc
					  , i.uom_id
					  , sublot_no
					  , ent_id
					  , to_ent_id

					SET @destination = @destination + 1

					--
					FETCH NEXT FROM sfg_item INTO @sfg_item_id
												, @sfg_lot_no
												, @sfg_sublot_no
												, @sfg_ent_id
												, @sfg_silo_ent_id
												, @sfg_qty
												, @sfg_oper_id
												, @sfg_fg_lot_no
												, @sfg_fg_sublot_no
		END --end while cursor
				CLOSE sfg_item
				DEALLOCATE sfg_item

				--select *from #fg_wo
		END -- end while #fg_wo
		END -- end else FG
	END

	DECLARE @temp_id INT

	SELECT TOP 1
		@temp_id = id
	FROM @childTableInvValidation
	WHERE material IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY
		id

	--SELECT @temp_id
	IF
		(@temp_id IS NOT NULL
		)
	BEGIN

		SELECT DISTINCT
			id AS                                         id
		  , material AS                                   name
		  , CAST(lot_no AS VARCHAR(40)) AS                lot_no
		  , CAST(ISNULL(sublot_no, '') AS VARCHAR(40)) AS sublot_no
		  , e.ent_name
		  , e1.ent_name AS                                silo_name
		  , qty AS                                        value
		  , source
		  , destination AS                                target
		  , CASE
				WHEN EXISTS (SELECT
								 source
							 FROM @childTableInvValidation b
							 WHERE b.source = a.destination)
				THEN source + 1
				ELSE source
			END AS                                        OrderBy
		FROM @childTableInvValidation a
		INNER JOIN ent e WITH(NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = a.ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent e1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON e1.ent_id = a.silo_ent_id
		WHERE material IS NOT NULL

	END

		--SELECT DISTINCT
		--		1 AS          id
		--	  , 1 AS    name
		--	  , 'asd1' as lot_no
		--	  , 'asd1' as sublot_no
		--	  , 1 as ent_name
		--    , 1 as silo_name
		--	  , 1 AS         value
		--	  , 1 as source
		--	  , 1 AS target
		--	  ,1 as OrderBy
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_close_proc_order
-- Description:  Returns closed process order
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-19		   Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_close_proc_order] as
Begin
SET NOCOUNT ON



	BEGIN TRY

	DECLARE @attr_id INT,@wo_id VARCHAR(40),@wo_state VARCHAR(40),@mod_id VARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @prod_msgs int,@cons_msgs int,@start_time DATETIME,@end_time DATETIME
	Declare  @error_msg NVARCHAR(500), @error_severity INT,@error_state INT;

	BEGIN Transaction;

	Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'WO_state'

	Set @wo_id = NULL

	Select top 1 @wo_id = wo.wo_id from wo with(nolock) --- CLOSED in wo table but not sent to SAP
	inner join (select wo_id from ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where module = 'PRO') wo_ext on wo.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id
	where wo.state_cd >= 3 
	and not exists (Select attr_value from wo_attr wa with(nolock) where wa.wo_id = wo.wo_id and wa.attr_id = @attr_id) --- Using Not exists to take advantage of Left anti-semi join operator (Faster than joins)


	IF @wo_id IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		Select @prod_msgs = Count(*) from item_prod ip with(nolock) where ip.wo_id = @wo_id and qty_prod = qty_prod_erp --Production msgs sent to ERP for the wo_id
		Select @cons_msgs = Count(*) from item_cons ic with(nolock) where ic.wo_id = @wo_id and qty_cons = qty_cons_erp --Consumption msgs sent to ERP for the wo_id
	
		Select @start_time = Min(act_start_time_local),@end_time = Max(act_finish_time_local) from job with(nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id

		PRINT @wo_id

		Select @wo_id Order_Number,'TECO' Status, @prod_msgs NumberofProdMessages,@cons_msgs NumberofConsMessages,
		DATEDIFF(hh,@start_time,@end_time) Running_Hour, Format(@end_time,'yyyyMMdd') Closing_Date,Format(@end_time,'hhmmss') Closing_Time,
		Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,Format(@end_time,'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime, '' Document_Number, '' Message

		Exec dbo.sp_I_Wo_Attr @wo_id,@attr_id,'CLOSED','','CLOSED BY EI',@mod_id OUT --Add wo_attr to indicate the wo is closed and sent to SAP (Stops being picked up in the future by the same SP)
	END

	Commit Transaction

	End TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH

End

		,last_edit_comment = 'Updated from Excel Upload'
		  ,last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
		WHERE

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Job_Stp_Lnk]
(
	@grp_id			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no			INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@cert_name		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_by	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_at	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL

)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Job_Stp_Lnk
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 11/02/2007
-- Version          - 3.4.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version			Changes
-- 01/10/2008		AML				3.4.0			Updated select to include some missing fields.
-- 01/18/2008	Raghu		3.4.0		L00074039; Linking a data log group oper step to a data entry schedule does not work.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

SELECT dlgjsl.grp_id
        ,dlg.grp_desc
       ,dlgjsl.wo_id
       ,dlgjsl.oper_id
       ,dlgjsl.seq_no
       ,dlgjsl.step_no
       ,dlgjsl.cert_name
       ,des.key_id
       ,des.key_type
       ,des.category
       ,des.trigger_type
       ,des.trigger_period
       ,des.entries_reqd
       ,des.display_seq
       ,des.string_spare1
       ,des.string_spare2
       ,des.string_spare3
       ,des.string_spare4
       ,des.number_spare1
       ,des.number_spare2
       ,des.number_spare3
       ,des.number_spare4
       ,dlgjsl.last_edit_comment
       ,dlgjsl.last_edit_by
       ,dlgjsl.last_edit_at
       ,des.last_edit_at AS data_entry_sched_last_edit_at
       ,dlgjsl.row_id
    FROM data_log_grp_job_step_link dlgjsl WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgjsl.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
    INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgjsl.wo_id = js.wo_id AND dlgjsl.oper_id = js.oper_id AND dlgjsl.seq_no = js.seq_no AND dlgjsl.step_no = js.step_no
    LEFT OUTER JOIN data_entry_sched des WITH (NOLOCK) ON des.key_id = js.row_id AND des.key_type = 7 AND des.category = 'Datalog Group' AND des.value_name = dlg.grp_desc
    WHERE  (
       (dlgjsl.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
       (dlgjsl.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_OER_to_Job_Route_bidir]
@wo_id      STRING40,
@O_oper_id  STRING40,
@OEL_ent_id INT32,
@process_id STRING40,
@seq_no     INT32
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - SP_OER_TO_JOB_ROUTE_BIDIRECTIONAL
-- Description	  - Process Job routes both to and from
-- Author	      - KRF
-- Date Created	  - 03/18/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/17/2002     Sheetal Jain  -  		Changes as per modified spec
-- 08/23/2002     Sheetal Jain  -  		Modified the fetch statement in job_route_cursor
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
  @prev_job_input_seq_no     INT32_NULL,
  @next_job_seq_no           INT32_NULL,
  @system_severity           INT,
-- Variable declarations for OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
  @OER_process_id            STRING40,
  @OER_oper_id               STRING40,
  @OER_ent_id                INT32,
  @OER_input_oper_id         STRING40,
  @OER_input_ent_id          INT32,
  @OER_input_percent         TFLOAT,
  @OER_mod_id                TIMESTAMP,
  @prev_oper_sched_to_ent_id INT32,
  @next_oper_sched_to_ent_id INT32,
  @last_edit_by	STRING40,
  @last_edit_at		DATETIME,
  @Incl_Job_with_zero_qty INT32

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
  SET  @Incl_Job_with_zero_qty = (SELECT CONVERT(INT,attr_value) FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 340)

  -- Create routes TO the selected job
  --14 read all routes to this oper and ent from the OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
  -- Fix for CR L00099799/HF 1751
  IF @Incl_Job_with_zero_qty = 1
	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT process_id, oper_id, ent_id, input_oper_id, input_ent_id, input_percent, mod_id
	 FROM oper_ent_route WHERE oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id and process_id = @process_id
  ELSE
  --To avoid foreign key conflict for "FK_job_route_job_input" that are introduced with HF 1738/CR L00099652 changes to SP "sp_Build_Job_Nonalphabetical"
	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT process_id, oper_id, ent_id, input_oper_id, input_ent_id, input_percent, mod_id
	 FROM oper_ent_route WHERE oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id and process_id = @process_id
	  					  AND input_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id AND input_percent  = 0)

  OPEN oper_ent_route_cursor
  FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor	INTO @OER_process_id, @OER_oper_id, @OER_ent_id,
    @OER_input_oper_id, @OER_input_ent_id, @OER_input_percent, @OER_mod_id
  --15 for each route
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --16 insert row into JOB_ROUTE table
    -- If the previous operation has a non-null sched_to_ent_id, get its seq_no if you can (maybe job for it not yet created though)
    SELECT @prev_oper_sched_to_ent_id = sched_to_ent_id FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id and oper_id = @OER_input_oper_id
    IF @prev_oper_sched_to_ent_id IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SELECT @prev_job_input_seq_no = seq_no FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @OER_input_oper_id
        AND init_sched_ent_id = @OER_input_ent_id
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      SELECT @prev_job_input_seq_no = seq_no FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @OER_input_oper_id
        AND init_sched_ent_id = @prev_oper_sched_to_ent_id
    END
    -- If there is a job for the previous operation
    IF @prev_job_input_seq_no IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      DECLARE job_route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL	FOR SELECT CAST('0' AS INT)  FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id
        AND seq_no = @seq_no AND input_oper_id = @OER_input_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @prev_job_input_seq_no
      -- Before inserting, check to see that the record you're about to create don't already exists (having perhaps been created by the job feeding this one)
      OPEN job_route_cursor
      FETCH NEXT FROM job_route_cursor INTO @system_severity
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BEGIN -- Only insert record if it doesn't already exist
	INSERT INTO job_route(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	  VALUES(@wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, @OER_input_oper_id, @PREV_JOB_INPUT_SEQ_NO, @OER_input_percent, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
      END
      CLOSE job_route_cursor
      DEALLOCATE job_route_cursor
    END

    FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor INTO @OER_process_id, @OER_oper_id, @OER_ent_id, @OER_input_oper_id,
		    @OER_input_ent_id, @OER_input_percent, @OER_mod_id
    --17
  END
  CLOSE oper_ent_route_cursor
  DEALLOCATE oper_ent_route_cursor
  -- Now do it all again, but this time try to create routes FROM the selected job
  --14(2) read all routes from this oper and ent from the OPER_ENT_ROUTE table
  -- Fix for CR L00099799/HF 1751
  IF @Incl_Job_with_zero_qty = 1
	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT process_id, oper_id, ent_id, input_oper_id, input_ent_id, input_percent, mod_id
	 FROM oper_ent_route WHERE input_oper_id = @O_oper_id AND input_ent_id = @OEL_ent_id and process_id = @process_id
  ELSE
  --To avoid foreign key conflict for "FK_job_route_job_input" that are introduced with HF 1738/CR L00099652 changes to SP "sp_Build_Job_Nonalphabetical"
	DECLARE oper_ent_route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT process_id, oper_id, ent_id, input_oper_id, input_ent_id, input_percent, mod_id
	 FROM oper_ent_route WHERE input_oper_id = @O_oper_id AND input_ent_id = @OEL_ent_id and process_id = @process_id
	 					  AND input_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM oper_ent_route WHERE process_id = @process_id AND input_percent  = 0)

  OPEN oper_ent_route_cursor
  FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor	INTO @OER_process_id, @OER_oper_id, @OER_ent_id, @OER_input_oper_id,
		@OER_input_ent_id, @OER_input_percent, @OER_mod_id
  --15(2) for each route
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --16(2) insert row into JOB_ROUTE table
    -- If the next operation has a non-null sched_to_ent_id, get its seq_no if you can (maybe job for it not yet created though)
    SELECT @next_oper_sched_to_ent_id = sched_to_ent_id FROM oper WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @OER_input_oper_id
    IF @next_oper_sched_to_ent_id IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SELECT @next_job_seq_no = seq_no FROM job	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OER_oper_id AND init_sched_ent_id = @OER_ent_id
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      SELECT @next_job_seq_no = seq_no FROM job	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OER_oper_id
        AND init_sched_ent_id = @next_oper_sched_to_ent_id
    END

    -- If there is a job for the next operation
    IF @next_job_seq_no IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      DECLARE job_route_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT CAST('0' AS INT)  FROM job_route WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @OER_oper_id
        AND seq_no = @next_job_seq_no AND input_oper_id = @O_oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no
      -- Before inserting, check to see that the record you're about to create doen't already exists (having perhaps been created by the job feeding this one)
      OPEN job_route_cursor
      FETCH NEXT FROM job_route_cursor INTO @system_severity
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
      BEGIN -- Only insert record if it doesn't already exist
	INSERT INTO job_route(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, input_percent, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	  VALUES(@wo_id, @OER_oper_id, @next_job_seq_no, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, @OER_input_percent, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
      END
      CLOSE job_route_cursor
      DEALLOCATE job_route_cursor
    END
    FETCH NEXT FROM oper_ent_route_cursor INTO @OER_process_id, @OER_oper_id, @OER_ent_id, @OER_input_oper_id,
			@OER_input_ent_id, @OER_input_percent, @OER_mod_id
    --17(2)
  END
  CLOSE oper_ent_route_cursor
  DEALLOCATE oper_ent_route_cursor
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_U_ofi_Util_Batch_SpeedLoss]
-- Description:To update the Speedloss for Batch process

-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-07-27		Intial Version
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Util_Batch_SpeedLoss] 
@ent_id as int,
@wo_id as nvarchar(40),
@oper_id as nvarchar(40),
@seq_no as int




AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

Declare 
@result as int,
@item_id as nvarchar(40),
@nameplate_speed as float,
@threshold_speed as float,
@job_act_start_time_utc as datetime,
@last_cycle_start_time_utc as datetime,
@current_cycle_start_time_utc as datetime,
@curr_prod_qty as float,
@last_prod_qty as float,
@prod_qty as float,
@prod_diff_qty as nvarchar(40),
@act_duration as int,
@theor_duration_low_level as int,
@theor_duration_high_level as int,
@cycle_start_reas_cd as int,
@running_reas_cd as int,
@fast_running_reas_cd as int,
@fast_running_state_cd as int,
@slow_running_reas_cd as int,
@slow_running_state_cd as int,
@speedloss_handling_type as nvarchar(40),
@row_count as int,
@spare1 as nvarchar(40),
@log_id as int,
@jb_log_id as int


SELECT @item_id= item_id
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id=@wo_id 
		AND oper_id=@oper_id 
		AND seq_no=@seq_no 
		AND bom_pos=0

SELECT @nameplate_speed=nameplate_speed,
	   @threshold_speed=threshold_speed
		FROM ofi_nameplate_speed WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id=@ent_id and item_id=@item_id

SELECT @running_reas_cd=reas_cd 
	   FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) 
	   WHERE reas_desc = 'Running'

SELECT @fast_running_reas_cd=reas_cd, @fast_running_state_cd=state_cd
	   FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) 
	   WHERE reas_desc = 'Fast Running'

SELECT @slow_running_reas_cd=reas_cd, @slow_running_state_cd=state_cd
	   FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) 
	   WHERE reas_desc = 'Slow Running'

SELECT @cycle_start_reas_cd=reas_cd 
	  FROM util_reas WITH (NOLOCK) 
	  WHERE reas_desc = 'Cycle Start'

SELECT @job_act_start_time_utc= act_start_time_utc 
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id=@wo_id 
		AND oper_id=@oper_id 
		AND seq_no=@seq_no 

SELECT TOP 1 @current_cycle_start_time_utc=event_time_utc 
		FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
			AND raw_reas_cd='Batch_Cycle_Start' 
			AND event_time_utc >= @job_act_start_time_utc 
			ORDER BY log_id DESC


SELECT @speedloss_handling_type=oa.attr_value
	FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON oa.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'SpeedHandlingType'
			AND a.attr_grp = 7
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
	 										
SELECT @row_count= count(log_id) 
						FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
							AND raw_reas_cd='Batch_Cycle_Start'  
							AND event_time_utc >= @job_act_start_time_utc

--If Speed Loss handling type is 'Batch' then update the logic
IF (@speedloss_handling_type ='Batch')-- AND @row_count > 0)
	BEGIN

	  IF (@row_count >=2)
		BEGIN
		SELECT @last_cycle_start_time_utc= event_time_utc
					FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log_id DESC) AS RowNum
					FROM util_history WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
							AND raw_reas_cd='Batch_Cycle_Start'  
							AND event_time_utc >= @job_act_start_time_utc
							) AS sub
						WHERE RowNum = 2;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		SELECT @last_cycle_start_time_utc=@job_act_start_time_utc
		END

		--print @last_cycle_start_time_utc
		--print @current_cycle_start_time_utc
-- Get the Produced Qty
	SELECT @curr_prod_qty= SUM(qty_prod)
		FROM item_prod  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND seq_no = @seq_no


	SELECT TOP 1 @jb_log_id= log_id
		FROM job_util_log_link WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no  
		order by row_id

	SELECT TOP 1 @spare1= spare1
		FROM util_history
		 where  log_id >= @jb_log_id
		 AND spare1 IS NOT NULL
		 ORDER BY log_id DESC


	SELECT TOP 2 @last_prod_qty=value FROM STRING_SPLIT(@spare1, ',') 
	IF (@last_prod_qty IS NULL OR @last_prod_qty = ' ' )
	BEGIN
	SET @last_prod_qty = 0
	END

	SELECT @prod_qty =(@curr_prod_qty - @last_prod_qty)
	IF (@prod_qty < 0)
	  BEGIN
	  SET @prod_qty=@curr_prod_qty
	  END

	SELECT @prod_diff_qty = CONCAT(@prod_qty,',',@curr_prod_qty)

	SELECT TOP 1  @log_id= log_id
		FROM util_history  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ent_id=@ent_id
		AND raw_reas_cd='Batch_Cycle_Start' 
		  ORDER BY log_id DESC

	UPDATE util_history SET spare1=@prod_diff_qty 
		WHERE ent_id=@ent_id
		  AND log_id=@log_id
		  

-- Calculate the Actual duration time
	SELECT @act_duration= SUM(duration)
		FROM util_log  WITH (NOLOCK)
		 WHERE ent_id=@ent_id
		  AND reas_cd=@running_reas_cd
		  AND event_time_utc < @current_cycle_start_time_utc
		  AND event_time_utc >=@last_cycle_start_time_utc

-- Calculate the Theoritical duration time
	SELECT @theor_duration_low_level = ((@prod_qty/(@nameplate_speed + @threshold_speed))*60*60)
	SELECT @theor_duration_high_level = ((@prod_qty/(@nameplate_speed - @threshold_speed))*60*60)


-- Compare the speed loss and update the util_history table
	IF (@act_duration > @theor_duration_high_level)
		BEGIN
		UPDATE util_history 
		SET reas_cd=@slow_running_reas_cd ,
			state_cd=@slow_running_state_cd
			WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
			AND reas_cd=@running_reas_cd
			--AND (event_time_utc BETWEEN @last_cycle_start_time_utc AND @current_cycle_start_time_utc )
			AND event_time_utc < @current_cycle_start_time_utc
			AND event_time_utc >=@last_cycle_start_time_utc

		PRINT 'SLOW RUNNING'
		END

		ELSE IF (@act_duration < @theor_duration_low_level)
		BEGIN
		UPDATE util_history 
		SET reas_cd=@fast_running_reas_cd ,
			state_cd=@fast_running_state_cd
			WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 
			AND reas_cd=@running_reas_cd
			--AND (event_time_utc BETWEEN @last_cycle_start_time_utc AND @current_cycle_start_time_utc )
			AND event_time_utc < @current_cycle_start_time_utc
			AND event_time_utc >=@last_cycle_start_time_utc

		PRINT 'FAST RUNNING'
		END
	
	--print '@running_reas_cd ->' + cast(@running_reas_cd AS NVARCHAR(100))
	--print '@last_prod_qty ->' + cast(@last_prod_qty AS NVARCHAR(100))	
	--print '@prod_qty ->' + cast(@prod_qty AS NVARCHAR(100))	
	--print '@prod_diff_qty ->' + cast(@prod_diff_qty AS NVARCHAR(100))	
	--print '@act_duration ->' + cast(@act_duration AS NVARCHAR(100))
	--print '@last_cycle_start_time_utc ->' + cast(@last_cycle_start_time_utc AS NVARCHAR(100))
	--print '@current_cycle_start_time_utc ->' + cast(@current_cycle_start_time_utc AS NVARCHAR(100))
	--print '@theor_duration_low_level ->' + cast(@theor_duration_low_level AS NVARCHAR(100))
	--print '@theor_duration_high_level ->' + cast(@theor_duration_high_level AS NVARCHAR(100))

	SET @result=1	
	END
	 
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
	SET @result=0
		
	END

	SELECT @result AS result
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Rework_Process_Usage]
(
	@reas_cd				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@orig_rework_cd			STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@orig_process_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@rework_process_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@max_times_rework		INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@reentry_rework_cd		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@last_edit_comment		STRING40_NULL = NULL

,	@row_id					INT32 OUTPUT

)
AS
-- Procedure definition
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_I_REWORK_PROCESS_USAGE
-- Description          - Adds a new row to this table.
-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    07/25/2007
-- Version          - 3.3.0.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE @last_edit_by    STRING40
		,	@V_Client_Info   STRING40

    SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )


    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr	@last_edit_by OUTPUT, @V_Client_Info OUTPUT

    INSERT INTO rework_process_usage

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Process_CheckIn]
(@user_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@process_id	NVARCHAR(40)
,@notes		NOTES
,@mod_id	NVARCHAR(30) = NULL  OUTPUT
) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - sp_U_Process_CheckIn
-- Description	  - (HD 2019) Versioning of Processes
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  - 12/17/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
-- 01/09/2003	  Vijay		    1.5.3   If process is checked out, the name of user is returned
-- 01/09/2003	  Rohit		    1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0   Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 08/11/2005	  Raghu		    2.1.26	HD# 5964, Added notes parameter. Checking In a process observes system parameter 327.
-- 08/22/2005	  Raghu		    2.1.27	Added language string to the error message.
-- 05/04/2006	  Raghu		    3.1.15	HD# 8086, Process window/process notes
-- 02/13/2007	  Raghu		    3.2.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 02/05/2020     Jim O'Hearn   6.2.0   Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @priv_value	INT
	,@check_out	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@V_Error	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value	NVARCHAR(1)

	IF (@process_id IS NULL OR @user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Process_Id or User_Id cannot be NULL{3230}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},Process_Id', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SELECT @check_out = checked_out_by FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
	IF (@check_out IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Process is not checked out{3231}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	IF (@check_out <> @user_id) BEGIN
		SET @V_Error = 'Process is checked out by{3369} ' + @check_out
		RAISERROR(@V_Error , 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 327

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF @notes IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The %1 must be supplied %2{4677},Notes,to check in the process' , 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		UPDATE process SET checked_out_by = NULL, notes = @notes WHERE process_id = @process_id
	END
	ELSE  UPDATE process SET checked_out_by = NULL WHERE process_id = @process_id

		SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process.mod_id)))  FROM process
		WHERE process_id = @process_id
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetWarningMessage]
(@context	INT
,@line_id 	INT
,@child_order	INT
,@ent_id	INT
,@perf_rate	FLOAT
,@wo_id		NVARCHAR(80)
,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(80)
,@seq_no	INT
) RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetWarningMessage
-- Description       - Returns a warning message about why the bottleneck rate cannot be calculated.
-- Author          - RaghuG
-- Date Created      - 09/03/2014
-- Version         -  5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
-- 09/08/2014	Raghu		5.0	UserStory: 390858: As Michelle, I want to know the reason why the bottleneck rate cannot be accurately calculated to determine the status of a line.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Context 1: Refers to missing line configuration
--Context 2: Refers to missing configuration for the entity/job configuration, such no conversion factors between two different UOMs, no default std_item_id for the entity, etc.
--Context 3: Refers to misconfiguration - can_be_bottleneck is set to false, but the entity is identified as bottleneck, the current utilization reason for an entity disables the entity, etc.
--Context 4: Bottleneck entity and rate are identified, but a line status cannot be determined due to the fact that there is no current utilization reason for the bottleneck entity.

BEGIN
DECLARE @line_name		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@reas_desc		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@ent_name		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@to_item_id		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@to_uom_id		INT
	,@to_uom_desc		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@from_item_id		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@from_uom_id		INT
	,@from_uom_desc		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@def_prod_rate 	FLOAT


	--Retrieve the line configuration
	SELECT @line_name = l.line_name, @to_item_id = l.std_item_id, @to_uom_id = i.uom_id, @to_uom_desc = uom.description
	FROM line l WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = l.std_item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
	WHERE l.line_id = @line_id

	IF (@context <= 2) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the line has entities.
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id AND lel.line_is_child = 0)
			RETURN 'The line: %1 does not have entities.{7956},' + @line_name

		--Verify whether the line has a standard item ID configured.
		IF (@to_item_id IS NULL)
			RETURN 'The line: %1 does not have a standard item configured.{7948},' + @line_name

		IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL AND @oper_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_name = COALESCE(run_ent.ent_name, target_sched_ent.ent_name)
				, @from_item_id = j.item_id
				, @from_uom_id = i.uom_id
				, @from_uom_desc = uom.description
			FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.item_id = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
			INNER JOIN ent target_sched_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent run_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = run_ent.ent_id
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			IF (@from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id)
				RETURN 'The unit of measurement: %1 for the item: %2 used by the job (Work Order: %3, Operation: %4, Sequence: %5) running/scheduled for the entity: %6 is different than the unit of measurement: %7 for standard item: %8 assigned to the line: %9, and there is no conversion factor defined to convert between the two units.  A conversion factor must be defined to convert the units from: %10 to %11.{7952},'
					+ @from_uom_desc + ',' + @from_item_id + ',' + @wo_id + ',' + @oper_id + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + @to_uom_desc + ',' + @to_item_id + ',' + @line_name + ',' + @from_uom_desc + ',' + @to_uom_desc
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name, @def_prod_rate = oee.def_prod_rate, @from_item_id = oee.std_item_id, @from_uom_id = i.uom_id, @from_uom_desc = uom.description
			FROM oee_exec oee WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON oee.ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON oee.std_item_id = i.item_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = uom.uom_id
			WHERE oee.ent_id = @ent_id

			IF (@def_prod_rate IS NULL)
				RETURN 'A default production rate for the entity: %1 in this line: %2 must be configured.{7953},' + @ent_name + ',' + @line_name

			IF (@from_item_id IS NULL)
				RETURN 'A default item for the entity: %1 in this line: %2 must be configured.{7954},'  + @ent_name + ',' + @line_name

			IF (@from_uom_id <> @to_uom_id)
				RETURN 'The unit of measurement: %1 for the default item: %2 for the entity: %3 is different than the unit of measurement: %4 for item: %5 assigned to the line: %6, and there is no conversion factor defined to convert between the two units.  A conversion factor must be defined to convert the units from: %7 to %8.{7955},'
					+ @from_uom_desc + ',' + @from_item_id + ',' + @ent_name + ',' + @to_uom_desc + ',' + @to_item_id + ',' + @line_name + ',' + @from_uom_desc + ',' + @to_uom_desc
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@context = 3) BEGIN
		--Verify whether all the entities in this child order can be bottleneck
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			  AND lel.child_order = @child_order
			  AND lel.can_be_bottleneck = 0) BEGIN

			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name = e.ent_name
			FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			  AND lel.child_order = @child_order
			  AND lel.can_be_bottleneck = 0

			RETURN 'The entity: %1 in the line: %2 is identified as the bottleneck or part of the bottleneck, but this entity is configured not to be part of the bottleneck. The can_be_bottleneck property for this entity must be set to true to return the performance rate.{7957},' + @ent_name + ',' + @line_name

		END

		--Verify whether the current utilization reason for the entity in the child order is enabled.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = ue.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ue.cur_reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			  AND lel.child_order = @child_order
			  AND COALESCE(ur.ent_enabled, 1) = 0) BEGIN

			SELECT TOP 1 @ent_name = e.ent_name, @reas_desc = ur.reas_desc
			FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_exec ue WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = ue.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN util_reas ur WITH (NOLOCK) ON ue.cur_reas_cd = ur.reas_cd
			WHERE lel.line_id = @line_id
			  AND lel.child_order = @child_order
			  AND COALESCE(ur.ent_enabled, 1) = 0

			RETURN 'The current utilization reason: %1 for the bottleneck entity: %2 disables the entity.{7949},' + @reas_desc + ',' + @ent_name
		END

		--Verify whether any of the entities have the current utilization reason enabled.
		IF (@child_order IS NULL AND @ent_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL)
			RETURN 'All entities in the line: %1 are disabled because of the current utilization reason.{7950},' + @line_name
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--If the rate for an entity can be calculated, but there is no utilization reason to indicate the status of the line, then return that information
		IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL AND @perf_rate IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

			RETURN 'The bottleneck entity: %1 does not have a utilization reason to indicate the status of the line: %2.{7951},' + @ent_name + ',' + @line_name
		END
	END


	RETURN ''
END

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_SA_Site_GetTzId
(@ent_id	INT32 = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                - sp_SA_Site_GetTzId
-- Description                - Returns the time zone ID associated to the entity.  If none were linked to the entity, then it defaults to the middleware's time zone
-- Author                    - Raghu
-- Date Created      - 05/08/2020
-- Version             - 6.2
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @region_id	STRING80
	, @context_info INT32
BEGIN
	-- Determine whether the entity is linked to a site
	IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @region_id = s.region_id
		FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN site s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.ent_id = e.site
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
	END

	-- If the entity is not linked to a site, determine whether the region information can be extracted from the sessn table
	IF (@region_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- Get session_id from connection context
		SELECT @context_info = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spid =  @@spid

		--Retrieve the current region from the session context.
		SELECT @region_id = region_id FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @context_info
	END

	-- If the time zone ID cannot be determined, default to the time zone where the middleware has started.
	IF (@region_id IS NULL) SELECT TOP 1 @region_id = tzo.region_id FROM tz_offset tzo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE tzo.default_region = 1

	SELECT @region_id tz_id
END

,@site_name			STRING80
,@wo_id				nvarchar(40)

,@seq_no			INT32
,@qty_prod			TFLOAT
,@reas_cd			INT32 = NULL
,@lot_no			STRING40 = NULL
,@sublot_no			STRING40 = NULL
,@to_ent_name			STRING80 = NULL
,@to_site_name			STRING80 = NULL
,@item_id			STRING40 = NULL
,@byproduct_bom_pos		INT32 = NULL
,@ext_ref			STRING40 = NULL
,@apply_scaling_factor		BIT = 0
,@genealogy_id			STRING254_NULL = NULL
,@event_id			STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@segment_requirement_id	STRING80_NULL =  NULL
,@segment_response_id		STRING80_NULL = NULL
,@comments			STRING254 = ' ' -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
,@spare1			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare2			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare3			STRING40 = ' '
,@spare4			STRING40 = ' '
,@created_at_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value 		INT32 = 0
,@row_id			INT32 OUT
,@prod_info			NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name           - sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProd
-- Description          - Used to create a production records when the job is  running
-- Author                    - Raghu
--                        Sidus 3 Phoenix; Iteration2; Name in place of IDs.
-- Date Created      - 05/07/2009
-- Version             - 3.5.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver        Changes/Comments
--08/25/2009    Raghu        4.0.0    DB Changes
-- 04/27/2020	Raghu		6.2	UserStory:1302809-As Bruce, I want the Production Endpoint to better showcase the various Add prod methods (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @job_pos	INT32
	, @ent_id	INT32
	, @to_ent_id	INT32
	, @ret 		INT32
	, @err_msg	NVARCHAR(MAX)

BEGIN

    --Get the running entity
    SET @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@ent_name, @site_name)

    IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
    	SET @err_msg = 'The specified entity:' + COALESCE(@ent_name, 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},entity:' + COALESCE(@ent_name, 'NULL')
    	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
    	RETURN
    END

    --Get the storage entity
    SET @to_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@to_ent_name,@to_site_name)

    --Retrieve the job position where this job is currently running.
    SELECT @job_pos = je.job_pos
    FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
      AND je.cur_wo_id = @wo_id
      AND je.cur_oper_id = @oper_id
      AND je.cur_seq_no = @seq_no
	IF (@job_pos IS NULL) BEGIN
	 --If a valid job cannot be identified, raise an exception to the caller.
		 RAISERROR ('The supplied job is not the job that is currently running on this entity.{5139}',16,1)
         RETURN
	END

    --Call to add production using the retrieved job position.
    EXEC SP_I_ITEM_PROD_ADDPROD @session_id=@session_id,
        @event_time_local=@event_time_local,
        @user_id=@user_id,
        @ent_id=@ent_id,
        @job_pos=@job_pos, @qty_prod=@qty_prod,
        @reas_cd=@reas_cd,
        @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no,
        @to_ent_id=@to_ent_id,
        @item_id=@item_id, @byproduct_bom_pos=@byproduct_bom_pos,
        @ext_ref=@ext_ref, @apply_scaling_factor=@apply_scaling_factor,
        @genealogy_id=@genealogy_id, @event_id=@event_id,
        @segment_requirement_id=@segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id=@segment_response_id,
        @comments=@comments, @spare1=@spare1,
        @spare2=@spare2, @spare3=@spare3, @spare4=@spare4, @created_at_utc=@created_at_utc,
        @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value,
        @row_id=@row_id OUTPUT , @prod_info=@prod_info OUTPUT

END

 @address  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @ext_mail  bit  ,

 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @mod_id  varchar(30) )
  AS

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
/*SELECT mail_grp_member.id
            ,mail_grp_member.address
            ,mail_grp.name
            ,mail_grp_member.ext_mail
            ,mail_grp_member.last_edit_comment
            ,mail_grp_member.last_edit_by

            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mail_grp_member.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM mail_grp_member mail_grp_member WITH (NOLOCK)
      ,mail_grp mail_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((mail_grp_member.id *= mail_grp.id)AND
       (mail_grp_member.id = @id OR @id IS NULL) AND
       (mail_grp_member.address = @address OR @address IS NULL) AND
       (mail_grp_member.ext_mail = @ext_mail OR @ext_mail IS NULL) AND
       (mail_grp_member.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (mail_grp_member.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mail_grp_member.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY mail_grp.name, mail_grp_member.address
*/
SELECT mail_grp_member.id
            ,mail_grp_member.address
            ,mail_grp.name
            ,mail_grp_member.ext_mail
            ,mail_grp_member.last_edit_comment
            ,mail_grp_member.last_edit_by

INNER JOIN mail_grp mail_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON mail_grp_member.id = mail_grp.id

AFTER UPDATE
AS

-- Module Name        - tg_so_line_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on so_line table to update

-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_APR_GetTransferKeys]
(
	@table_name NVARCHAR(30),
	@filter_column NVARCHAR(30),
	@window_start DATETIME,
	@window_end DATETIME,
	@filter_clause NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-	sp_U_APR_GetTransferKeys
-- Description			-	This module will copy the primary keys for records that fall within the specified window and
--							match the filter clause (if supplied) from the specified table to the temporary APR table for
--							the specified table.  The temporary archive table must be set first by calling sp_U_APR_CreateTable.
-- Author				-	Rich Boyle
-- Date Created			-	03/04/2016
-- Version				-	5.03
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	DECLARE @SQL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @column_list AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @column_count AS INT
	DECLARE @identity_count AS INT

	-- Validate if the supplied filter_column is a real column in the specified table
	SELECT @column_count = COUNT(*)
	FROM sys.columns WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN sys.tables WITH (NOLOCK) ON sys.columns.object_id = sys.tables.object_id
	WHERE sys.columns.name = @filter_column AND sys.tables.object_id = OBJECT_ID(@table_name)

	IF (@column_count = 1)
	BEGIN
		-- Get the key columns from the specified table to use as selectors as we only want to copy the key
		-- values across to the tempory table
		SET @column_list = dbo.fn_APR_GetKeyColumns(@table_name)
		-- Determine if the temporary table has an identity column
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT @ic = COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TABLE_NAME = ''' + @table_name + '_tmp_prg'' AND COLUMNPROPERTY(object_id(''' + @table_name + '_tmp_prg''), COLUMN_NAME, ''IsIdentity'') = 1'
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql, N'@ic INT OUTPUT', @ic = @identity_count OUTPUT

		-- Because we are creating the temporary table from we will need to turn on identity insert if the table has an identity column
		IF (@identity_count = 1) SET @SQL = 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @table_name + '_tmp_prg ON;'
		ELSE SET @SQL = ''

		-- Create a statement to populate the temporary archive table with rows from the specified table
		-- that fall within the range and match the filter clause if supplied
		SET @SQL = @SQL
			+ ' INSERT INTO ' + @table_name + '_tmp_prg'
			+ ' (' + @column_list + ')'
			+ ' SELECT ' + @column_list
			+ ' FROM ' + @table_name + ' t1 WITH (NOLOCK)'

		IF @window_end IS NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' WHERE t1.' + @filter_column + ' = @ws'
		ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + ' WHERE t1.' + @filter_column + ' >= @ws AND t1.' + @filter_column + ' <= @we'
		IF @filter_clause IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' AND ' + @filter_clause
		SET @SQL = @SQL + ';'

		-- If we have turned on indentity insert, then turn it off
		IF (@identity_count = 1) SET @SQL = @SQL + 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @table_name + '_tmp_prg ON;'

		EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql, N'@ws DATETIME, @we DATETIME', @ws = @window_start, @we = @window_end
	END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_close_purch_order
-- Description:  Returns closed purchase order
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-15		   Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_close_purch_order] as
begin

	--WO State 0 = Released, 1 = Started, 2 = Completed, 3 = Closed
	Declare @wo_id varchar(40),@pend_trans_cnt int,@gr_msgs_cnt int,@attr_id int;
	Declare  @error_msg NVARCHAR(500), @error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@mod_id VARCHAR(30)

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN Transaction;

	SET @wo_id = NULL;
	Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'ReportedToSAP';

	With WO_Prodn_Cnt as(
		Select ip.wo_id,sum(qty_prod) qty_prod, sum(qty_prod_erp) qty_prod_erp from item_prod ip with(nolock)
			inner join (select wo_id from ofi_wo_ext with (nolock) where module = 'PO') wo_ext on ip.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id --and isnull(ip.spare4,'0') = '0'
		 group by ip.wo_id
	)
	Select top 1 @wo_id = w.wo_id from wo w with (nolock)
	inner join WO_Prodn_Cnt wc with (nolock) on w.wo_id = wc.wo_id
	where wc.qty_prod_erp < wc.qty_prod and w.state_cd >= 3
	and not exists (Select attr_value from wo_attr wa with(nolock) where wa.wo_id = wc.wo_id and wa.attr_id = @attr_id)	-- Pick only those orders where the WO_State attribute doesn't exist													

	if @wo_id is not null
	begin
	Select @pend_trans_cnt = count(*) from item_prod with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and qty_prod > qty_prod_erp
	Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'GR_Against_OBD_Messages_Count'
	Select @gr_msgs_cnt = attr_value from wo_attr with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attr_id


	Select wo_id PurchaseOrder_Doc_Number, item_id ItemNumberofPurchase_Document,
	'CLOSE' Status,isNull(@pend_trans_cnt,0) + isnull(@gr_msgs_cnt,0) Number_of_GRMessages, FORMAT(cast(last_edit_at as date),'yyyyMMdd') Closing_Date,
	FORMAT(cast(last_edit_at as datetime),'hhmmss') Closing_Time,FORMAT(cast(GETDATE() as date),'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date,
	FORMAT(cast(GETDATE() as datetime),'hhmmss') File_Generation_Time,'' Document,'' Message, '' Message
	from wo with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id

	Exec dbo.sp_I_Wo_Attr @wo_id,@attr_id,'1','','CLOSED BY EI',@mod_id OUT --Add wo_attr to indicate the wo is closed and sent to SAP (Stops being picked up in the future by the same SP)
	--Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = qty_prod,spare4= '1' where wo_id = @wo_id ---TBC with Sudhakar	
	end


	Commit Transaction

	End TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end
