CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_OES_to_JOB_SPEC_Version]
  @wo_id         STRING40,
  @O_oper_id     STRING40,
  @OEL_ent_id    INT32,
  @seq_no        INT32,
  @Version_Id    STRING40,
  @V_Process     STRING40
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	SP_OES_TO_JOB_SPEC_VERSION
-- Description	  -	Same
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	04/17/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver  Changes
-- 05/22/2002     Sheetal Jain  1001 Process should be passed to the procedure as a variable
-- 05/30/2002     Vijay Raj     1001 When inserting record into job_spec, step_no defaults to -1
-- 08/09/2002     Sheetal Jain  1002 Step_No picked from Oper_Ent_Spec
-- 12/03/2003     Sheetal Jain  2013 HD# 4133 Support new spec fields
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	STRING40
	    ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
DECLARE  @temp_entities TABLE (ent_id INT, parent_ent_id INT, dist_from_child INT)
DECLARE  @dist_from_child			INT32

BEGIN

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	SET @dist_from_child = 0
	-- First get the entities that are assigned to the operation and put them into the temp table
	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, dist_from_child)
	SELECT child_ent_id, parent_ent_id, @dist_from_child FROM ent_link
	WHERE child_ent_id = @OEL_ent_id
	-- Loop through all the entities in the temporary table looking for parent entities that are not listed as
	-- child entities in the temporary table but are listed as child entities in the ent_link table.
	-- Do this until no more entities are found.
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		SET @dist_from_child = @dist_from_child + 1
		INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, dist_from_child)
		SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, el.parent_ent_id, @dist_from_child FROM @temp_entities te
		INNER JOIN ent_link el on el.child_ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
		WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)

		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	END
	-- Add in the root entities
	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, dist_from_child)
	SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, null, @dist_from_child FROM @temp_entities te
	WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)
	-- Always make sure the operation entity is in the table, even if it has no parents.
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @temp_entities WHERE ent_id = @OEL_ent_id)) BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, parent_ent_id, dist_from_child)
			VALUES (@OEL_ent_id, NULL, 0)
	END

	-- Open a cursor that will read the each spec ID for each step
	DECLARE @spec_id STRING40
	DECLARE @step_no as INT32
	DECLARE spec_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT distinct spec_id, step_no FROM oper_ent_spec WHERE process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ver_id = @Version_Id AND ent_id in (select ent_id from @temp_entities)
	OPEN spec_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM spec_cursor INTO @spec_id, @step_no
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		INSERT INTO job_spec(wo_id, oper_id, step_no,seq_no, spec_id, spec_value, act_spec_value, assoc_file,
						   assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT @wo_id, oes.oper_id, oes.step_no, @seq_no, oes.spec_id, oes.spec_value, NULL, oes.assoc_file,
			   oes.assoc_file_type, oes.comments, oes.min_value, oes.max_value, oes.access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		  FROM oper_ent_spec oes
		  INNER JOIN @temp_entities te ON oes.ent_id = te.ent_id
			WHERE process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ver_id = @Version_Id AND spec_id = @spec_id AND step_no = @step_no AND
				te.dist_from_child = (SELECT MIN(dist_from_child) FROM @temp_entities
										WHERE ent_id in (SELECT ent_id FROM oper_ent_spec
															WHERE process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ver_id = @Version_Id	AND
																spec_id = @spec_id AND step_no = @step_no))
		END
	CLOSE spec_cursor
	DEALLOCATE spec_cursor

	--18 Read all specs for this Oper and Ent from the OPER_ENT_SPEC table
	--19 for each spec_id (OPER_ENT_SPEC_cursor)
	--20 insert row into JOB_SPEC table
--	INSERT INTO job_spec(wo_id, oper_id, step_no,seq_no, spec_id, spec_value, act_spec_value, assoc_file,
--					   assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
--	SELECT @wo_id, oper_id, step_no, @seq_no, spec_id, spec_value, NULL, assoc_file,
--		   assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
--	  FROM oper_ent_spec
--		WHERE process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id AND ver_id = @Version_Id

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Process_CheckOut]
(@user_id	NVARCHAR(40),
 @process_id	NVARCHAR(40),
 @mod_id	NVARCHAR(30) = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_Process_CheckOut
-- Description	      - (HD 2019) Versioning of Processes
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 12/17/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver     Changes
-- 01/09/2003	 Vijay		1.5.3   If process is checked out, then the user name is returned
-- 01/09/2003	 Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/27/2003	 Vijay		1.5.4   All the error messages are predefined, so no arguments can be passed. So
--				          if process is checked out, the username is not displayed now
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @priv_value	INT
	,@check_out	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@V_Error	NVARCHAR(40)

	IF (@process_id IS NULL OR @user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Process_Id or User_Id cannot be NULL{3230}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SELECT @priv_value = MAX(priv_value)
	FROM 	grp_priv_link gpl, user_grp_link ugl, priv p
	WHERE 	ugl.user_id = @user_id AND
		gpl.priv_id = p.priv_id AND
		ugl.grp_id = gpl.grp_id and
		p.priv_id = 23
	GROUP BY gpl.priv_id, p.priv_desc
	IF (@priv_value IS NULL) SET @priv_value = 0
	IF (@priv_value <> 1) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('User does not have the required privilege to edit the process.{3233}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	SELECT @check_out = checked_out_by FROM process WHERE process_id = @process_id
	IF (@check_out IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @V_Error = 'Process is already checked out{3232}'
		RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	UPDATE process SET checked_out_by = @user_id WHERE process_id = @process_id
	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, process.mod_id)))  FROM process
	WHERE process_id = @process_id
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetWOStatus]
(@wo_id	STRING80
) RETURNS INT32 AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - fn_GetWOStatus
-- Description       - Returns the status of the supplied work order.
--                     WO Statuses:
--							1 = New
--							2 = Ready
--							3 = In Progress
--							4 = Complete
--							5 = Suspended
--							6 = On Hold
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver    Changes
-- 06/08/2016	Raghu G		5.3	UserStory: 594231 - As Bruce I want the WO collection page to load quicker so that it takes less time (CR L00135959)
--					Rewrote this function to optimize the performance and to fix the statuses returning from the function.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN

DECLARE	 @wo_status		INT32
        ,@new_count		INT32
        ,@ready_count		INT32
        ,@running_count		INT32
        ,@suspended_count	INT32
        ,@onhold_count		INT32

	-- If no other status applies, the status of the work order will be new
	SET @wo_status = 1

	--Return Completed if the supplied work order is NULL
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL)
		RETURN @wo_status

	SELECT @new_count = [1], @ready_count = [2], @running_count = [3], @suspended_count = [5], @onhold_count = [6]
	FROM
	(SELECT state_cd FROM job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id) AS source_table
	PIVOT
	(
	    COUNT(state_cd)
		FOR state_cd IN ([1], [2], [3], [5], [6])
	) AS PivotTable

	IF (@running_count > 0) BEGIN
		-- If there is at least one job in work order is running, then the status of the work order is running
		SET @wo_status = 3
		RETURN @wo_status
	END

	IF (@new_count = 0 AND @ready_count = 0 AND @suspended_count = 0 AND @onhold_count = 0) BEGIN
		--There are no jobs with the following states: New (1), Ready (2), Suspended (5), and On-hold (6)
		--Since there was no job running either, the remaining jobs would have been either cancelled or completed.
		--Therefore, return the status of Completed (4).
		SET @wo_status = 4
		RETURN @wo_status
	END

	IF (@onhold_count > 0) BEGIN
		--There is at least one onhold job and no running jobs, so the work order is onhold.
		SET @wo_status = 6
		RETURN @wo_status
	END

	IF (@suspended_count > 0) BEGIN
		--There is at least one suspended job and no running or onhold jobs so the work order is suspended
		SET @wo_status = 5
		RETURN @wo_status
	END

	IF (@ready_count > 0) BEGIN
		--There is at least one ready job and no running, onhold, or suspended jobs, so the work order is ready.
		SET @wo_status = 2
		RETURN @wo_status
	END

	--There is at least one new job and no running, onhold, suspeneded, or ready jobs, so the work order is new.
	SET @wo_status = 1

	RETURN @wo_status
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_UserHasPriv_bck21_8_25] (@V_User_Id STRING40, @V_Priv_Status INTEGER OUTPUT) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_S_GRP_PRIV_LINK_USER_HAS_PRIV
-- Description	      - Verify if the user has "WO Create" privilege
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 04/17/2002
-- Version	      - 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By     Changes
-- 09/28/2003     KRF             Always allow mw_db_user to create WO as this will be the user assigned to WO created for automatic replenishment
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--10/17/2024	MC					Added with (nolock) for db_status select to improve performance
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  DECLARE @mw_db_user STRING40	-- Added 9/28/04 KRF

  -- Check if User has privileges to create a work order
  SELECT DISTINCT @V_Priv_Status = g.priv_value FROM grp_priv_link g, user_grp_link u WHERE g.grp_id = u.grp_id AND u.user_id = @V_User_Id
    AND g.priv_id = (SELECT priv_id FROM PRIV WHERE priv_id =26) AND g.priv_value = 1
--Commented by Vijay
--    AND g.priv_id = (SELECT priv_id FROM PRIV WHERE priv_desc = 'May Create Jobs') AND g.priv_value = 1)
--    AND g.priv_id = (SELECT priv_id FROM PRIV WHERE priv_desc = 'WO Create'))

  IF @V_Priv_Status IS NULL
    SET @V_Priv_Status = 0

  SELECT @mw_db_user = mw_db_user FROM db_status with (nolock) -- Added 9/28/04 KRF --Modified 10/17/2024
  IF @V_User_Id = @mw_db_user SET @V_Priv_Status = 1 -- Added 9/28/04 KRF

  -- execute sp_chk_user_priv @user_id, @P_priv_id, @ret_status = @priv_status OUTPUT
  IF (@V_Priv_Status <> 1 OR @@ERROR <> 0)
  BEGIN
--    RAISERROR ('User is not allowed to create WO', 16, 1)
    RAISERROR ('This user does not have the privilege to create a work order.', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Message]
(@sender  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @subject  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @sent  datetime  ,
 @sent_tz  INT32 = NULL  ,
 @recipient  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @rcvd  datetime  ,
 @rcvd_tz  INT32 = NULL  ,
 @ver_recpt  bit  ,
 @cc  bit  ,
 @category  int  ,
 @priority  int,
 @save_till datetime ,
 @save_till_tz INT32 = NULL,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime ,
 @time_zone_bias_value int = NULL
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/23/2003	Raghu		2.0.20	 read_at field is added to the SELECT list
-- 07/02/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed GetDate() to GMT Date and Time
-- 10/06/2005	Raghu		2.1.30	Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/26/2009	Kishore		4.0		HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
--12/22/2009	Kishore		4.1		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  SET @sent_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@sent_tz)
  SET @rcvd_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@rcvd_tz)
  SET @save_till_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@save_till_tz)


  SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
  DECLARE @dbg_resp INT32
  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Message', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @sent, @numeric_val1 = @sent_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @rcvd, @numeric_val2 = @rcvd_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @save_till, @numeric_val3 = @save_till_tz

IF @sent IS NOT NULL SET @sent = DATEADD(mi, -@sent_tz, @sent)
IF @rcvd IS NOT NULL SET @rcvd = DATEADD(mi, -@rcvd_tz, @rcvd)
IF @save_till IS NOT NULL SET @save_till = DATEADD(mi, -@save_till_tz, @rcvd)

SELECT message.sender
            ,message.subject
			, message.sent as sent
            ,message.recipient
			,message.rcvd as rcvd
            ,message.message
            ,message.ver_recpt
            ,message.cc
            ,message.category
            ,message.priority
            ,message.save_till as save_till
            ,message.read_at as read_at
            ,CASE WHEN (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) THEN dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
		ELSE dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, GETUTCDATE()) ) END NOW
	    ,CONVERT(INT, CASE WHEN (@rcvd IS NOT NULL AND @rcvd <= message.rcvd) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) new_mail
            ,message.last_edit_comment
            ,message.last_edit_by
            ,message.last_edit_at
  FROM message message WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((message.sender = @sender OR @sender IS NULL) AND
       (message.subject = @subject OR @subject IS NULL) AND
       (message.sent >= @sent OR @sent IS NULL) AND
       (message.recipient = @recipient OR @recipient IS NULL) AND
       (message.rcvd >= @rcvd OR @rcvd IS NULL) AND
       (message.ver_recpt = @ver_recpt OR @ver_recpt IS NULL) AND
       (message.cc = @cc OR @cc IS NULL) AND
       (message.category = @category OR @category IS NULL) AND
       (message.priority = @priority OR @priority IS NULL) AND
       (message.save_till = @save_till OR @save_till IS NULL) AND
       (message.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (message.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY message.ver_recpt, message.sent

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_APR_PurgeDependentData]
(
	@main_table_name NVARCHAR(30),
	@dependent_table_name NVARCHAR(30)
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-	sp_U_APR_PurgeDependentData
-- Description			-	This method purges the data in the supplied dependent table based on the rows that have been copied
--							to a temporary archive table from the supplied main table.  The archive table must be set up using
--							sp_U_APR_CreateTable and the data is copied to the temporary archive table using sp_U_APR_GetTransferKeys.
-- Author				-	Rich Boyle
--
-- Date Created			-	03/04/2016
-- Version				-	5.03
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @SQL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @where_clause AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @table_count AS INT

	-- Validate that the supplied main table name is a real table in the MES table space
	SELECT @table_count = COUNT(*)  FROM sys.objects WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(@main_table_name) AND type in (N'U')

	IF (@table_count = 1)
	BEGIN
		-- Validate that the supplied dependent table name is a real table in the MES table space
		SELECT @table_count = COUNT(*)  FROM sys.objects WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(@dependent_table_name) AND type in (N'U')

		IF (@table_count = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET @where_clause = dbo.fn_APR_GetPurgeDependentWhereClause(@main_table_name, 't2', @dependent_table_name)
			SET @SQL = 'DELETE FROM ' + @dependent_table_name + ' WHERE EXISTS ('
				+ 'SELECT 1 FROM ' + @main_table_name + '_tmp_prg t2 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ' + @where_clause + ')'
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql
		END
	END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_job_aft_ins] ON [dbo].[job]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_wo_aft_ins
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any insert is made on wo table
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 05/18/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0.13
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- 03/30/2006     SJ          31013 HD#7782 - ERROR IN SUPERVISOR'S CREATE WORK ORDER FROM PROCESS
-- 01/27/2015   JimO		5.0 SP1	Story 437474 -- Do not round qty_reqd or qty_at_start for jobs bound to a work order
--													created from a line due to improper handling of parallel entities
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
  --Make sure that for CWOFP rounding does not happen
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq') IS NULL
  BEGIN
	UPDATE job SET job.qty_reqd = ROUND(i.qty_reqd, it.num_decimals), job.qty_at_start = ROUND(i.qty_at_start, it.num_decimals)
	  FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	  WHERE job.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job.seq_no = i.seq_no
			AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo w WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.wo_id = w.wo_id AND w.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL)
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
	UPDATE job SET job.qty_reqd = ROUND(i.qty_reqd, it.num_decimals), job.qty_at_start = ROUND(i.qty_at_start, it.num_decimals)
	  FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	  WHERE job.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job.seq_no = i.seq_no
			AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #tbl_temp_for_op_seq t WHERE t.wo_id = i.wo_id)
			AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM wo w WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.wo_id = w.wo_id AND w.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL)
  END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Lavkesh
-- Create date: 08-04-2024
-- Description:	Execute from Archestra to get MES inventory of an Entity
-- Version		Date			Name	Remarks
-- 0.1			08-04-2024		LP		Initial Draft
-- 0.2			13-04-2024		YG		Update the query and always send into KG
-- EXEC [sp_s_ofi_GetInv] '500BN008', 'MT'
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_GetInv]
	@ent_name nvarchar(100),
	@DCS_UoM nvarchar(100)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- v0.2 Disabled
	--select sum(qty_left) as qty from item_inv iv with (nolock)
	--inner join ent e with(nolock) on iv.ent_id=e.ent_id
	--inner join item i with (nolock) on iv.item_id = i.item_id
	--where e.ent_name=@ent_name

	-- v0.2 Added
	Declare @qty float,
			@factor float,
			@defaultstorageuom nvarchar(100);

	-- v0.2 Added to get the default uom
	SELECT @defaultstorageuom = ISNULL(attr_value,'KG') FROM ent_attr WITH (nolock) 
	where ent_id = (select top 1 ent_id from ent WITH (nolock) where parent_ent_id is NULL)
	and attr_id = (select top 1 attr_id from attr WITH (nolock) where attr_desc = 'DefaultStorageUOM' and attr_grp=2) -- ent_attr group

	-- v0.2 Added
	SELECT @qty = Sum([dbo].[Fn_ofi_convertqtybyitemidanduom]
       (iv.item_id, iv.qty_left, NULL, NULL, u.description, @defaultstorageuom, NULL, NULL)) -- Always Set to KG
	FROM   item_inv iv WITH (nolock)
		   INNER JOIN ent e WITH(nolock)
				   ON iv.ent_id = e.ent_id
		   INNER JOIN item i WITH (nolock)
				   ON iv.item_id = i.item_id
		   INNER JOIN uom u WITH (nolock)
				   ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	WHERE  e.ent_name = @ent_name 

	-- v0.2  Added to get the conv factor
	SELECT TOP 1 @factor = factor FROM uom_conv  WITH (NOLOCK)
	where from_uom_id = (SELECT TOP 1 uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE abbreviation = @DCS_UoM) and
	to_uom_id = (SELECT TOP 1 uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE abbreviation = @defaultstorageuom)

	SELECT ISNULL(@qty,0.0) as qty, ISNULL(@factor,1.0) as factor 
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Opr_Stp_Lnk]
(
	@grp_id  int  ,
	@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@step_no int ,
	@cert_name nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@last_edit_at  datetime
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Opr_Stp_Lnk
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 11/02/2007
-- Version          - 3.4.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 01/11/08         KRF             3.4.0       Added joins and data from data_log_grp, oper_step os,
--                                              and data_entry_sched so it's the same as Oracle
-- 01/18/2008	Raghu		3.4.0		L00074039; Linking a data log group oper step to a data entry schedule does not work.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  SELECT dlgosl.grp_id
       ,dlg.grp_desc
       ,dlgosl.process_id
       ,dlgosl.oper_id
       ,dlgosl.step_no
       ,dlgosl.cert_name
       ,des.key_id
       ,des.key_type
       ,des.category
       ,des.trigger_type
       ,des.trigger_period
       ,des.entries_reqd
       ,des.display_seq
       ,des.string_spare1
       ,des.string_spare2
       ,des.string_spare3
       ,des.string_spare4
       ,des.number_spare1
       ,des.number_spare2
       ,des.number_spare3
       ,des.number_spare4
       ,dlgosl.last_edit_comment
       ,dlgosl.last_edit_by
       ,dlgosl.last_edit_at
       ,des.last_edit_at AS data_entry_sched_last_edit_at
       ,dlgosl.row_id
    FROM data_log_grp_oper_step_link dlgosl
    INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dlgosl.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
    INNER JOIN oper_step os ON dlgosl.process_id = os.process_id AND dlgosl.oper_id = os.oper_id AND dlgosl.step_no = os.step_no
    LEFT OUTER JOIN data_entry_sched des ON des.key_id = os.row_id AND des.key_type = 5 AND des.category = 'Datalog Group' AND des.value_name = dlg.grp_desc
WHERE (
		(dlgosl.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
		(dlgosl.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
		(dlgosl.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND

			,@from_status_cd	INT32
			,@to_status_cd		INT32

	SELECT @from_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@from_ent_name, @from_site_name)
		,@to_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@to_ent_name, @to_site_name)

		,@to_grade_cd = dbo.fn_GetItemGradeCode(@to_grade_desc)

		,@to_status_cd = dbo.fn_GetItemStatusCode(@to_status_desc)
		,@qty_uom_id = dbo.fn_GetUOMId(@transfer_uom_desc)

	if(@from_ent_id IS NULL)
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'entity:' + COALESCE(@from_ent_name,'')
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_name IS NOT NULL AND @to_ent_name <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'entity:' + COALESCE(@to_ent_name,'')
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@from_grade_cd IS NULL AND @from_grade_desc IS NOT NULL AND @from_grade_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'grade:' + @from_grade_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@to_grade_cd IS NULL AND @to_grade_desc IS NOT NULL AND @to_grade_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'grade:' + @to_grade_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@from_status_cd IS NULL AND @from_status_desc IS NOT NULL AND @from_status_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'status:' + @from_status_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@to_status_cd IS NULL AND @to_status_desc IS NOT NULL AND @to_status_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'status:' + @to_status_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	if(@qty_uom_id IS NULL AND @transfer_uom_desc IS NOT NULL AND @transfer_uom_desc <> '')
	begin
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified %%1 does not exist in the database.{3566},' + 'UOM Description:' + @transfer_uom_desc
		RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16,1)
		return -1
	end

	EXEC sp_U_Item_Inv_TransAndUpdInv @from_ent_id=@from_ent_id, @to_ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @to_item_id=@to_item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @to_lot_no=@to_lot_no,
			@sublot_no=@sublot_no, @to_sublot_no=@to_sublot_no, @from_grade_cd=@from_grade_cd, @to_grade_cd=@to_grade_cd, @from_status_cd=@from_status_cd, @to_status_cd=@to_status_cd,
			@transfer_qty=@transfer_qty, @transfer_qty_erp=@transfer_qty_erp, @transfer_option=@transfer_option, @transfer_comments=@transfer_comments, @log_transfer=@log_transfer,
			@from_wo_id=@from_wo_id, @from_oper_id=@from_oper_id, @from_seq_no=@from_seq_no, @to_wo_id=@to_wo_id, @to_oper_id=@to_oper_id, @to_seq_no=@to_seq_no, @to_expiry_date=@to_expiry_date,
			@to_uom=@qty_uom_id, @bulk_move_reclassify=0, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_OS_to_JOB_STEP]
@wo_id           STRING40,
@O_oper_id       STRING40,
@OEL_ent_id      INT32,
@process_id      STRING40,
@seq_no         INT32
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	SP_OS_TO_JOB_STEP
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	03/18/2002
-- Version	      -       1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 04/18/2002     Sheetal Jain  -  Changes as per modified spec
-- 07/12/2002     Sheetal Jain  -  New fields added to step table
-- 10/15/2002     Sheetal Jain  -  Repeatability field in step group
-- 07/23/2003     Sheetal Jain  -  HD#3283 Step Desc field width
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
--09/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 1/20/2008	DonT		3.4.0	CR L00073863 - Added step_name when copying from oper_step to job_step
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
-- Variable declarations for OPER_STEP table
DECLARE
  @OS_process_id         STRING40,
  @OS_oper_id            STRING40,
  @OS_step_no            INT32,
  @OS_step_seq           INT32,
  @OS_step_name          STRING40,
  @OS_step_desc          STRING2000_NULL,
  @OS_action_type        INT32,
  @OS_std_time           TFLOAT,
  @OS_complete_cond      INT32,
  @OS_allow_bypass       LOGICAL,
  @OS_enter_data         LOGICAL,
  @OS_step_grp_id        INT32,
  @OS_spc_char           STRING40,
  @OS_form_name          STRING254,
  @OS_script_id			 INT32,
  @OS_data_log_grp_id	 INT32,
  @OS_reqd_rep_pct		 TFLOAT,
  @OS_control_type		 INT32,
  @OS_high_limit		 TFLOAT,
  @OS_low_limit			 TFLOAT,
  @OS_limit_warning		 LOGICAL,
  @OS_spare1             STRING80,
  @OS_spare2             STRING80,
  @OS_spare3             STRING80,
  @OS_spare4             STRING80,
  @OS_spare5             STRING80,
  @OS_spare6             STRING80,
  @OS_mod_id             TIMESTAMP,
  @last_edit_by	         STRING40,
  @last_edit_at		 DATETIME,
  @OS_choice_no			 INT32,
  @OS_choice_label		 STRING40,
  @OS_last_edit_comment  STRING254,
  @row_id                INT32
BEGIN
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )


	DECLARE @each_des_oper_step_to_job_step TABLE (
			id int identity,
			key_id int,
			key_type int,
			category nvarchar(40),
			value_name nvarchar(40),
			trigger_type int,
			trigger_period int,
			entries_reqd int,
			display_seq int,
			last_trigger_at datetime,
			last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40),
			string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare2 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare3 nvarchar(40),
			string_spare4 nvarchar(40),
			number_spare1 float,
			number_spare2 float,
			number_spare3 float,
			number_spare4 float,
			last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
			last_edit_at datetime
		)

	DECLARE @t_key_id int, @t_key_type int, @t_category nvarchar(40), @t_value_name nvarchar(40), @t_trigger_type int, @t_trigger_period int,
			@t_entries_reqd int, @t_display_seq int, @t_last_trigger_at datetime, @t_last_trigger_desc nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare1 nvarchar(40),
			@t_string_spare2 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare3 nvarchar(40), @t_string_spare4 nvarchar(40), @t_number_spare1 float,
			@t_number_spare2 float, @t_number_spare3 float, @t_number_spare4 float, @t_last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
			@t_last_edit_by nvarchar(40),  @t_last_edit_at datetime, @i int, @max_i int

  -- TC Copy all job_step_grp's
  INSERT INTO job_step_grp(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq,repeatability, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    SELECT @wo_id, oper_id, @seq_no, step_grp_id, step_grp_desc, step_grp_seq,repeatability, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at FROM oper_step_grp
      WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id
	--	AND step_grp_id = @OS_step_grp_id
  --23 Declare cursor for OPER_STEP table
  --23,25,29 will be EXECUTEuted by the call bellow
  DECLARE oper_step_cursor CURSOR LOCAL	FOR SELECT process_id, oper_id, step_no, step_seq, step_name, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond,
      allow_bypass, enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep_pct, control_type, high_limit, low_limit,
	  limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, mod_id
    FROM oper_step WHERE oper_id = @O_oper_id AND process_id = @process_id ORDER BY step_no
  OPEN oper_step_cursor
  FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_cursor INTO @OS_process_id, @OS_oper_id, @OS_step_no, @OS_step_seq, @OS_step_name, @OS_step_desc, @OS_action_type, @OS_std_time,
    @OS_complete_cond, @OS_allow_bypass, @OS_enter_data, @OS_step_grp_id, @OS_spc_char, @OS_form_name, @OS_data_log_grp_id,
	@OS_reqd_rep_pct, @OS_control_type, @OS_high_limit, @OS_low_limit, @OS_limit_warning, @OS_spare1, @OS_spare2, @OS_spare3,
    @OS_spare4, @OS_spare5, @OS_spare6, @OS_mod_id
  --25 for each step in this operation (OPER_STEP_cursor)
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    --29 insert row into JOB_STEP table
--    SELECT 'X' FROM oper_step_ent_exc WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND step_no = @OS_step_no AND ent_id = @OEL_ent_id
    --if the step is excluded the query above will set the @@rowcount to 1
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 --THIS STEP IS NOT EXCLUDED
    BEGIN
		INSERT INTO job_step(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no,	step_seq, step_name, step_desc, action_type, std_time, complete_cond, allow_bypass,
				enter_data, step_grp_id, spc_char, form_name, data_log_grp_id, reqd_rep, control_type, high_limit,
				low_limit, limit_warning, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, spare5, spare6, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		VALUES(	@wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, @OS_step_no, @OS_step_seq, @OS_step_name, @OS_step_desc, @OS_action_type, @OS_std_time, @OS_complete_cond,
			@OS_allow_bypass, @OS_enter_data, @OS_step_grp_id, @OS_spc_char, @OS_form_name, @OS_data_log_grp_id, @OS_reqd_rep_pct,
			@OS_control_type, @OS_high_limit, @OS_low_limit, @OS_limit_warning, @OS_spare1, @OS_spare2, @OS_spare3, @OS_spare4, @OS_spare5,
			@OS_spare6, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

		-- Added 02/05/2008 for CR L00074806 - Create new data_entry_sched records for the operation and its steps...
		DELETE FROM @each_des_oper_step_to_job_step

		INSERT INTO @each_des_oper_step_to_job_step
		(
			key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
			last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
			number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
		)
		SELECT	( select row_id from job_step where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @O_oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @OS_step_no ) as row_id,
				7 as key_type, des.category, des.value_name, des.trigger_type, des.trigger_period,
				des.entries_reqd, des.display_seq, des.last_trigger_at, des.last_trigger_desc, des.string_spare1,
				des.string_spare2, des.string_spare3, des.string_spare4, des.number_spare1, des.number_spare2,
				des.number_spare3, des.number_spare4, des.last_edit_comment, des.last_edit_by, des.last_edit_at
		FROM data_entry_sched des
			INNER JOIN oper_step os ON des.key_id = os.row_id
		WHERE des.key_type = 5 AND os.process_id = @process_id AND os.oper_id = @O_oper_id and os.step_no = @OS_step_no


		SELECT @i = min( id ), @max_i = max( id ) FROM @each_des_oper_step_to_job_step

		WHILE ( @i <= @max_i ) BEGIN

			SELECT	@t_key_id = key_id, @t_key_type = key_type, @t_category = category, @t_value_name = value_name
				,	@t_trigger_type = trigger_type, @t_trigger_period = trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd = entries_reqd
				,	@t_display_seq = display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at = last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc = last_trigger_desc
				,	@t_string_spare1 = string_spare1, @t_string_spare2 = string_spare2, @t_string_spare3 = string_spare3
				,	@t_string_spare4 = string_spare4, @t_number_spare1 = number_spare1, @t_number_spare2 = number_spare2
				,	@t_number_spare3 = number_spare3, @t_number_spare4 = number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment = last_edit_comment
				,	@t_last_edit_by = last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at = last_edit_at
			FROM @each_des_oper_step_to_job_step
			WHERE id = @i

			INSERT INTO data_entry_sched
			(
				key_id, key_type, category, value_name, trigger_type, trigger_period, entries_reqd, display_seq,
				last_trigger_at, last_trigger_desc, string_spare1, string_spare2, string_spare3, string_spare4,
				number_spare1, number_spare2, number_spare3, number_spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			VALUES
			(
				@t_key_id, @t_key_type, @t_category, @t_value_name, @t_trigger_type, @t_trigger_period, @t_entries_reqd,
				@t_display_seq, @t_last_trigger_at, @t_last_trigger_desc, @t_string_spare1, @t_string_spare2, @t_string_spare3,
				@t_string_spare4, @t_number_spare1, @t_number_spare2, @t_number_spare3, @t_number_spare4, @t_last_edit_comment,
				@t_last_edit_by,  @t_last_edit_at
			)

			SET @i = (@i + 1)
		END



		INSERT INTO job_step_file(wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT @wo_id, oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at  FROM oper_step_file
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id AND step_no = @OS_step_no


 	  --  Copy operation step choices to job step choices table.
 	  DECLARE oper_step_choice_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT choice_no, choice_label, last_edit_comment
 	  FROM oper_step_choice WHERE oper_id = @O_oper_id AND process_id = @process_id AND step_no = @OS_step_no ORDER BY step_no
 	  OPEN oper_step_choice_cursor
 	  FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_choice_cursor INTO @OS_choice_no, @OS_choice_label, @OS_last_edit_comment
 	  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
 	  BEGIN
 			EXEC sp_I_Job_Step_Choice @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, @OS_step_no, @OS_choice_no, @OS_choice_label, @OS_last_edit_comment, @last_edit_at, @row_id
        	FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_choice_cursor INTO @OS_choice_no, @OS_choice_label, @OS_last_edit_comment
 	  END --oper_step_choice_cursor
      CLOSE oper_step_choice_cursor
      DEALLOCATE oper_step_choice_cursor
    END  --End of @@ROWCOUNT = 0

    FETCH NEXT FROM oper_step_cursor INTO @OS_process_id, @OS_oper_id, @OS_step_no, @OS_step_seq, @OS_step_name, @OS_step_desc, @OS_action_type, @OS_std_time,
	@OS_complete_cond, @OS_allow_bypass, @OS_enter_data, @OS_step_grp_id, @OS_spc_char, @OS_form_name, @OS_data_log_grp_id,
	@OS_reqd_rep_pct, @OS_control_type, @OS_high_limit, @OS_low_limit, @OS_limit_warning, @OS_spare1, @OS_spare2, @OS_spare3,
	@OS_spare4, @OS_spare5, @OS_spare6, @OS_mod_id
  END	--OPER_STEP_cursor
  CLOSE oper_step_cursor
  DEALLOCATE oper_step_cursor


	--Copy data_log_grp_job_step_link records
	INSERT INTO data_log_grp_job_step_link
	( grp_id, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at )
	SELECT grp_id, @wo_id, @O_oper_id, @seq_no, step_no, cert_name, last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM data_log_grp_oper_step_link
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @O_oper_id

END

@last_edit_at TDATETIME
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_U_Qm_Spec
-- Description       - Updates a row of the table qm_spec
-- Author
-- Date Created         -  10/4/2010
-- Version            - 4.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 07/28/2011     Johnny               Added num_pts_per_page column
-- 04/13/2020     SARA          6.2    Added display_seq column
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

SET @start_eff_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_eff_tz)
SET @start_eff_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@start_eff_local, @start_eff_tz)

SET @end_eff_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_eff_tz)
SET @end_eff_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@end_eff_local, @end_eff_tz)

	IF @edit_level IS NULL SET @edit_level = 1
  	IF @start_eff_local IS NULL SET @start_eff_local= dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(CONVERT( DATETIME,  GETDATE() ))
	IF @category_id IS NULL SET @category_id = 0
	IF @display_seq IS NULL SET @display_seq = 1

UPDATE qm_spec
SET
   qm_spec_name = @qm_spec_name,
   qm_spec_desc = @qm_spec_desc,
   edit_level = @edit_level,
   ver_id  = @ver_id,
    start_eff_utc = DATEADD( mi, - @start_eff_tz, @start_eff_local ),
   start_eff_local = @start_eff_local,
   end_eff_utc = DATEADD( mi, - @end_eff_tz, @end_eff_local ),
   end_eff_local = @end_eff_local,
   ent_id = @ent_id,

   last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
Where
   qm_spec_id = @qm_spec_id AND
   (last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_util_history_times]
AS
WITH util_hist AS
(SELECT uh.ent_id, uh.event_time_utc
	, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(uh_next.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh_next WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh_next.ent_id = uh.ent_id AND uh_next.event_time_utc > uh.event_time_utc)
		--It appears that Microsoft SQL Server retrieves the GETUTCDATE() at the beginning of the view execution and uses that time in subsequent calculations.
		--So, if the view executes for more than a second, and if any new events are added during the time of execution, the duration will result negative.
		--To avoid this situation, if the GETUTCDATE() is earlier than the event_time_utc, then default to event_time_utc.
		--This problem is only related to the current event (i.e. there are no future events from the last event) and the view takes few seconds to execute and there are > 4 or 5m records in the database
		, CASE WHEN GETUTCDATE() < uh.event_time_utc THEN uh.event_time_utc ELSE GETUTCDATE() END) AS event_end_time_utc
FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
)
SELECT hist.ent_id, hist.event_time_utc, hist.runtime, hist.downtime
		, DATEDIFF(SS, hist.event_time_utc, uhdur.event_end_time_utc) AS duration, uhdur.event_end_time_utc
FROM util_history hist WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN util_hist uhdur WITH (NOLOCK) ON hist.ent_id = uhdur.ent_id AND hist.event_time_utc = uhdur.event_time_utc

(@cust_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @po_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @so_line_no  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @customer_item_id nvarchar(40) ,

 @spare1  nvarchar(80)  ,

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************

--

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 08/07/2003	  Raghu		         Included item.num_decimals in the resultset
-- 08/26/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.22 (HD#3431) NOLOCK hints included
-- 02/03/2004      KRF		2.1.0    Changed name because table name changed. so_line* was po_line*  Added min_qty, max_qty.
-- 11/15/2004     KRF                    Added uom.description to returned recordset
--10/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--IF @reqd_by IS NOT NULL SET @reqd_by = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @reqd_by)

SELECT so_line.cust_id
            ,so_line.po_id
            ,so_line.so_line_no
            ,so_line.item_id
            ,so_line.customer_item_id
            ,item.item_desc
            ,item.num_decimals
            ,so_line.quantity
            ,so_line.uom_id
            ,uom.description
            ,so_line.min_qty
            ,so_line.max_qty
            ,so_line.line_price
            ,so_line.reqd_by_utc
            ,so_line.reqd_by_local
            ,so_line.spare1
            ,so_line.spare2
            ,so_line.spare3
            ,so_line.spare4
            ,cust.cust_name
            ,so_line.last_edit_comment
            ,so_line.last_edit_by
            ,so_line.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, so_line.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM so_line so_line with (nolock)
       LEFT OUTER JOIN cust cust with (nolock) ON so_line.cust_id = cust.cust_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN item item with (nolock) ON so_line.item_id = item.item_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN uom uom with (nolock) ON so_line.uom_id = uom.uom_id
    WHERE ((so_line.cust_id = @cust_id OR @cust_id IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.po_id = @po_id OR @po_id IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.so_line_no = @so_line_no OR @so_line_no IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.customer_item_id = @customer_item_id OR @customer_item_id IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.reqd_by_utc >= @reqd_by_utc OR @reqd_by_utc IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.reqd_by_local >= @reqd_by_local OR @reqd_by_local IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (so_line.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
    ORDER BY cust.cust_name ,  so_line.po_id, so_line.so_line_no

--									API (JobExec.AddProdPostExec) allows the two values (rm_lot_no and rm_sublot_no) to be supplied to it but the related procedure 'sp_I_Item_Prod_AddProdPostExec' does not. Introduced these two values to be allowed.
