-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @cur_qty_prod 				TFLOAT
		,	@grade_cd 					INT32
		,	@status_cd 					INT32
		,	@good_prod 					INT32
		,	@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,	@expiry_date				TDATETIME
		--	Define default values available from job_bom table
		,	@update_inv					INT32
		,	@backflush					INT32
		,	@def_item_id				STRING40
		,	@def_reas_cd				INT32
		,	@def_lot_no					STRING40
		,	@def_sublot_no				STRING40
		--,  @def_cont_id				STRING40
		,	@def_storage_ent_id			INT32
		,	@cur_uom_id					INT32
		,	@return						INT32
		-- 10/26/2002	TC		1.5.0	Call to SP_I_Item_Inv_Add now returns its row_id so add it as a parameter
		,	@inv_row_id					INT32
		-- Added by Rohit
		,	@max_qty_per_parent_item	TFLOAT
		,	@min_qty_per_parent_item    TFLOAT
		,	@must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL
		,	@constant_qty				LOGICAL
		,	@total_item_cons_qty		TFLOAT
		,	@attr_value					NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@job_pos					INT32
		,	@bom_pos					INT32
		,	@last_edit_by				STRING40-- Init the values
		,	@distinct_reject_prod		NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@good_prod_num_decimals		INT32
		,	@item_num_decimals			INT32
		,	@cur_int_qty_prod			TFLOAT
		,	@created_at_local			TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_utc			TDATETIME
        ,   @hour_start_utc             TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
		--,	@use_gmt					INT32 -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
		,	@tz_temp					INT32
		,	@distinct_good_prod			NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@cur_material_type			NVARCHAR(80) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_subsegment_id			NVARCHAR(80) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_comments				NVARCHAR(254) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
	    ,   @state_cd					INT32
		,   @is_job_running				INT32
		,   @zeroQuantity 				BIT  --CR L00127800
		,	@cur_qty_prod_erp			TFLOAT -- CR L00143393
		,   @last_edit_comment				STRING254 = 'JobExec.AddProdPostExec'
		,   @cur_created_at_utc				TDATETIME = NULL
		, @job_start_utc				TDATETIME
		, @production_time_utc				TDATETIME
		, @tmp_shift_start_utc				TDATETIME
		, @err_msg					NVARCHAR(MAX)
		, @ent_name					NVARCHAR(80)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SELECT	@grade_cd = NULL
		,	@status_cd = NULL
		,	@good_prod = NULL
		,	@last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		,	@tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	--Verify whether the supplied parameters are legitimate
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified entity ID:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id), 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},entity ID:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id), 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	   --Determine whether created_at_utc is supplied.
	   IF (@created_at_utc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		-- Since created_at_utc time is supplied, determine the hour start and the shift start from the production time.
		SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
		FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND shift_start_utc =
		     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  --shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
			  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @created_at_utc)

		--Raise an error, if a valid shift is not found
		IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
			--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

		--Determine the hour start bucket
		SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @created_at_utc), 0)

		--Determine the local times
		SELECT @hour_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_start_utc)
			, @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)
			, @production_time_utc = @created_at_utc
	   END
	   ELSE BEGIN --@created_at_utc is not supplied
		--Do this for backward compatibility

		--Strip out the minutes and seconds
		--SET @hour_start_local = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @hour_start_local), 0)

		--Determine whether a hour start (local) is supplied.  Hour start is supplied, but there is no shift start
		IF (@shift_start_local IS NULL) BEGIN
			--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
			RAISERROR('The shift start time must be supplied.{138}',16,1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		ELSE IF (@hour_start_local IS NOT NULL AND @shift_start_local IS NOT NULL)  BEGIN-- Determine whether the shift start and the hour start is supplied

			--Determine the shift start and hour start UTC times
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())
				, @hour_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @hour_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

			SET @tmp_shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
			SET @shift_start_utc = NULL

			--Verify whether this is a valid shift start
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND shift_start_utc =
			     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
				FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
				--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
				  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @tmp_shift_start_utc)

			--Raise an error, if a valid shift is not found
			IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
				--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
				--RAISERROR('A valid shift information cannot be determined using the supplied shift start time.{138}',16,1)
				SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

			/*--Determine whether the hour_start is later than the shift start time
			IF (@hour_start_local < DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @shift_start_local), 0)) BEGIN
				--The production hour must be within the shift.
				SET @err_msg = 'The supplied hour start time (local):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_local, 120) + ' cannnot be earlier than the shift start time (local):' +  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_local, 120) + '.{137},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_local, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_local, 120)
				RAISERROR(@err_msg,16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			--Determine whether the hour start is within the shift boundary
			IF @shift_start_utc <> CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120)
			  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND sh.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
					  AND @hour_start_utc >= DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, sh.shift_start_utc), 0)
					  AND (@hour_start_utc < sh.shift_end_utc OR sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL)) BEGIN
				--The production hour must be within the shift.
				SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
				SET @err_msg = 'The supplied hour start time (utc):' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_utc, 120) + ' is not within the shift boundary for the shift start time (utc):' +  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_utc, 120) + ' for the entity:' + @ent_name + '.{139},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @hour_start_utc, 120) + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @shift_start_utc, 120) + ',' + @ent_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg,16,1)
				RETURN -1
			END*/

			--Default the created_at_utc to the hour start
			SELECT @production_time_utc = @hour_start_utc
		END

		--Shift start is supplied, but there is no hour start
		ELSE IF (@shift_start_local IS NOT NULL AND @hour_start_local IS NULL) BEGIN

			SET @shift_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @shift_start_local, GETUTCDATE())

			--Verify whether this is a valid shift start
			SELECT @shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = sh.shift_start_local, @shift_id=sh.shift_id
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
			  AND shift_start_utc =
			     (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
				FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
				--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
				  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @shift_start_utc)

			IF (@shift_start_utc IS NULL)
				--The production hour must be within the shift and there is no shift start time
				SELECT @shift_start_utc = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_start_local = CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120), @shift_id = 0

			--Determine the hour start bucket
			SET @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @shift_start_utc), 0)

			--Determine the local times
			SET @hour_start_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @hour_start_utc)

			--Default the created_at_utc to the shift start
			SET @production_time_utc = @shift_start_utc

		END

		--Determine whether this job was started in this hour.
		--If yes, default the created at time to the job start time
		SELECT @job_start_utc = MAX(jh.job_start_utc)
		FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
		  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
		  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
		  AND jh.job_start_utc >= @hour_start_utc
		  AND jh.job_start_utc < DATEADD(HH, 1, @hour_start_utc)

		--If job start time is not null, then the job started in this hour
		IF (@job_start_utc IS NOT NULL)
			--Default the production time and the created at time to be the job start time
			SELECT @production_time_utc = @job_start_utc
				, @created_at_utc = @job_start_utc
	   END

	--Reset the job_start_utc
	SELECT @job_start_utc = NULL
		, @hour_start_local = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @hour_start_local), 0), @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @hour_start_utc), 0)

	--The production time (created at) is not supplied, but the code defaulted to the hour start/shift start which ever is later.
	--Verify whether this job ran during this hour; if not raise an error
	--If the job was started in this hour, use the last job start to record the production
	SELECT @job_start_utc = MAX(jh.job_start_utc)
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND jh.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND jh.seq_no = @seq_no
	  AND @production_time_utc BETWEEN jh.job_start_utc AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())

	IF (@job_start_utc IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The production time is NOT within the duration of the job (start and end).
		SELECT @ent_name = e.ent_name FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id
		SET @err_msg = 'The supplied job (wo_id:' + COALESCE(@wo_id, '') + ', oper_id:' + COALESCE(@oper_id, '') + ', seq_no:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(@seq_no, 0)) + ') was not running on the entity:' + COALESCE(@ent_name, '') + ' during the specified production time (in UTC):' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @production_time_utc, 120), '') + '.{140},' + COALESCE(@wo_id, '') + ',' + COALESCE(@oper_id,'') + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(@seq_no,0)) + ',' + COALESCE(@ent_name, '')+ ',' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), @production_time_utc, 120), '')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	--The production time is within the duration of the job runtime.

	--below condition is added by Nagaraju on 08-12-2002
	--if item id is null the assumption is bom pos 0 item
	IF @item_id IS NULL SET @byproduct =0

	-- Read default values from job_bom table to apply if not included ( include update_inv and backflush flags )
	--below condition is added by Nagaraju on 08-12-2002
	IF (@byproduct IS NULL) OR @byproduct=0 BEGIN
		SELECT	@bom_pos = bom_pos
			,	@def_item_id = item_id
			,	@def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
			,	@def_lot_no = def_lot_no
			,	@def_sublot_no = def_sublot_no -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
			,	@def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			,	@update_inv = update_inv
			,	@backflush = backflush
			,	@max_qty_per_parent_item = max_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@min_qty_per_parent_item = min_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod
			,	@constant_qty = constant_qty
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SELECT	@bom_pos = bom_pos
			,	@def_item_id = item_id
			,	@def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
			,	@def_lot_no = def_lot_no
			,	@def_sublot_no = def_sublot_no -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
			,	@def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			,	@update_inv = update_inv
			,	@backflush = backflush
			,	@max_qty_per_parent_item = max_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@min_qty_per_parent_item = min_qty_per_parent_item
			,	@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod
			,	@constant_qty = constant_qty
		FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND item_id = @item_id
	END

	-- Check which optional values are specified and apply defaults where appropriate
	IF ((@item_id IS NULL) OR (@item_id = '')) BEGIN
		SET @item_id = @def_item_id
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.item_id = @item_id) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified item ID:' + COALESCE(@item_id, 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},item ID:' + COALESCE(@item_id, 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@reas_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @reas_cd = @def_reas_cd
	END

	IF ((@lot_no IS NULL) OR (@lot_no = '')) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 'X' FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE	wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and
					dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(shift_start_utc) = @shift_start_utc and item_id = @item_id and
					(lot_no IS NULL OR lot_no = '') and reas_cd = @reas_cd and user_id = @user_id and
					(to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR @to_ent_id IS NULL)
		)
		BEGIN
			SET @lot_no = @def_lot_no
		END
	END

	IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 'X' FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE	wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and
					dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(shift_start_utc) = @shift_start_utc and
					item_id = @item_id and (lot_no = @lot_no OR lot_no IS NULL OR lot_no = '') and
					reas_cd = @reas_cd and user_id = @user_id and to_ent_id IS NULL
		)
		BEGIN
			SET @to_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id
		END
	END

	IF @byproduct IS NULL SET @byproduct =0

	-- Check the max/min item_cons.cons_qty -- Rohit
	IF @must_consume_before_prod = 1  BEGIN
		EXECUTE @return = sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, /*@lot_no,*/ @item_id, @qty_prod -- Commented out @lot_no 1/10/07 KRF
		IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
	END

	-- Is the passed reas_cd defined in the database ? If not return error, else get good_prod flag
	SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @status_cd = item_status_cd FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd

	IF ( @grade_cd IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
		-- reas_cd is defined, grade and status loaded - now get good_prod flag
		SELECT @good_prod = good_prod	FROM item_grade	WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd
		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @good_prod IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Reason Code results in invalid good_prod flag{3283}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The specified reason code:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @reas_cd), 'NULL') + ' does not exist in the database.{3566},reason code:' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @reas_cd), 'NULL')
		RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- Find out if row exists for this PK - if so read current qty_prod value for it
	SELECT  @distinct_reject_prod = '0', @cur_qty_prod = NULL, @item_num_decimals = 0, @good_prod_num_decimals = 0
	SELECT	@distinct_reject_prod = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 309
	SELECT @distinct_good_prod = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 362

	--check if any fractional pieces of production is allowed.
	EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis	@item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @to_ent_id, -- Added "@sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
										@qty_prod OUTPUT, @cur_int_qty_prod OUTPUT,
										@good_prod_num_decimals OUTPUT

	SELECT @item_num_decimals = ISNULL(@item_num_decimals, 0), @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0)

	IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod = 0) BEGIN
		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod != 0) SET @cur_qty_prod = @cur_int_qty_prod
		ELSE SET @cur_qty_prod = @qty_prod

		IF @byproduct = 0  BEGIN
			-- Added "@sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
            ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlshPstExec @session_id, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_qty_prod, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no,
							@shift_start_local,@hour_start_local,@shift_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @time_zone_bias_value

			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Find out if row exists for this PK - if so read current qty_prod value for it
	SET  @cur_qty_prod = NULL
	--  When negative production is passed in:
	--  1) check if enough to reduce, if not raise error
	--  2) if enough, start with oldest and reduce entire record continuing until meet qty
	IF (@qty_prod < 0) BEGIN
	 	SELECT @cur_qty_prod = SUM(qty_prod)
	 	FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
	 	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and
	 	        dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(shift_start_utc) = @shift_start_utc and hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc  and item_id = @item_id and
	 	        (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL)) and
	 	        (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL)) and -- Added this clause 1/10/07 KRF
	 	        reas_cd = @reas_cd and user_id = @user_id AND (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_id IS NULL))
	 	        AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
	 	        AND (event_id = @event_id OR (event_id IS NULL AND @event_id IS NULL))
	 	        AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
	 	        AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
	 	        AND qty_prod > 0
	 	IF (@cur_qty_prod IS NULL OR ABS(@qty_prod) > @cur_qty_prod)
	 	BEGIN
	 	    SET @err_msg = 'The amount:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(ABS(@qty_prod), 0)) + ' by which you are trying to reduce item production for Work Order = ' + COALESCE(@wo_id,'') + ', Operation ID = ' + COALESCE(@oper_id, '') + ', and Sequence No = ' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no), '') + ' is greater than the actual amount of production:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(@cur_qty_prod, 0)) + '.{8039},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(ABS(@qty_prod), 0)) + ',' + COALESCE(@wo_id,'') + ',' + COALESCE(@oper_id,'') + ',' + COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no), '') + ',' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), COALESCE(@cur_qty_prod, 0))
			RAISERROR (@err_msg, 16, 1)
	 	    RETURN -1
	 	END

		;WITH cteItemProdRows
		AS
		(SELECT row_id, qty_prod, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at_utc, row_id) row_num, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at_utc, row_id))-1 row_num_parent
		FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
		    AND dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(shift_start_utc) = @shift_start_utc and hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc  and item_id = @item_id
		    AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
		    AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))  -- Added this clause 1/10/07 KRF
		    AND reas_cd = @reas_cd and user_id = @user_id AND (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_id IS NULL))
		    AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
		    AND (event_id = @event_id OR (event_id IS NULL AND @event_id IS NULL))
		    AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
		    AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
		    AND qty_prod > 0
		)
		, QtyToReduce AS
		(SELECT ipr.row_id, ipr.row_num, ipr.row_num_parent
			, ipr.qty_prod
			, CASE WHEN ipr.qty_prod < ABS(@qty_prod) THEN ipr.qty_prod
					ELSE ABS(@qty_prod)
					END AS item_prod_qty_reduced
			, CAST(CAST(ipr.qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7)) - CAST(CASE WHEN ipr.qty_prod < ABS(@qty_prod) THEN ipr.qty_prod ELSE ABS(@qty_prod) END AS DECIMAL(18,7)) AS FLOAT) item_prod_qty_remaining
			, ABS(@qty_prod) - CASE WHEN ipr.qty_prod < ABS(@qty_prod) THEN ipr.qty_prod ELSE ABS(@qty_prod) END remaining_qty_to_be_reduced
		FROM cteItemProdRows ipr
		WHERE row_num = 1
		UNION ALL
		SELECT ipr.row_id, ipr.row_num, ipr.row_num_parent
			, ipr.qty_prod
			, CASE WHEN ipr.qty_prod < ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced) THEN ipr.qty_prod
					ELSE ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced)
					END AS item_prod_qty_reduced
			, CAST(CAST(ipr.qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7)) - CAST(CASE WHEN ipr.qty_prod < ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced) THEN ipr.qty_prod ELSE ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced) END AS DECIMAL(18,7)) AS FLOAT)  item_prod_qty_remaining
			, ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced) - CASE WHEN ipr.qty_prod < ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced) THEN ipr.qty_prod ELSE ABS(qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced) END remaining_qty_to_be_reduced
		FROM QtyToReduce qtr
		INNER JOIN cteItemProdRows ipr ON qtr.row_num = ipr.row_num_parent
		WHERE qtr.remaining_qty_to_be_reduced > 0
		)
		UPDATE item_prod
		SET item_prod.qty_prod = reduce_prod.item_prod_qty_remaining
		FROM QtyToReduce reduce_prod
		WHERE item_prod.row_id = reduce_prod.row_id;

	END
     ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
	ELSE  IF NOT (@distinct_reject_prod = '1' AND @good_prod = 0 AND @qty_prod > 0)
		AND NOT (@distinct_good_prod = '1' AND @good_prod = 1 AND @qty_prod > 0) BEGIN

		SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_qty_prod = qty_prod, @cur_created_at_utc = created_at_utc
		FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and
			  dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(shift_start_utc) = @shift_start_utc and hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc  and item_id = @item_id and
			  (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL)) and
			  (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL)) and -- Added this clause 1/10/07 KRF
			  reas_cd = @reas_cd and user_id = @user_id AND (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_id IS NULL))
			  AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
			  AND (event_id = @event_id OR (event_id IS NULL AND @event_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			  AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			  --and (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR @to_ent_id IS NULL)
	END

	--Set the created at time
	SET @created_at_utc = COALESCE(@cur_created_at_utc, @created_at_utc, @hour_start_utc)
	SET @created_at_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUTC(@ent_id, @created_at_utc)

	-- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
	IF (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ')
	BEGIN
		SET @cur_comments = @comments
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @cur_comments = NULL
	END
	SET @zeroQuantity  = 0  -- CR L00127800
	IF (@cur_qty_prod IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		-- Row DOES already exist
		IF (@cur_qty_prod + @qty_prod = 0 AND @cur_qty_prod_erp = 0) BEGIN
			SET @zeroQuantity = 1 -- CR L00127800
			-- DELETE THE ROW
			DELETE item_prod WHERE row_id = @row_id
			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Prod%'

            --Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
            EXEC sp_u_assigned_lot_updatestatus @item_id = @item_id,
                @lot_no = @lot_no, @sublot_no = @sublot_no,
                @wo_id = @wo_id, @oper_id = @oper_id,
                @seq_no = @seq_no,
                @total_qty_prod = 0
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			-- UPDATE THE ROW
			-- Added suport for the new material_type, subsegment_id, and comments columns
			UPDATE 	item_prod
			SET ent_id = @ent_id, shift_id = @shift_id, to_ent_id = @to_ent_id,
				qty_prod = CAST((CAST(@cur_qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7))+ CAST(@qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7))) AS FLOAT), byproduct = @byproduct,
				comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END,
				spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END,
				spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END,
				spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END,
				spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
			WHERE row_id = @row_id

			-- Return error if this was not successful
			IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
				RAISERROR ('SQL Error updating item_prod table{3284}', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			IF (@byproduct = 0) BEGIN
				EXECUTE sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no

				-- Update the job_hour_history if needed
				IF (@zeroQuantity <> 1) EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @event_time_utc=@created_at_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment
			END

            --Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
			DECLARE @qty_temp FLOAT;
			SET @qty_temp = @cur_qty_prod + @qty_prod

            EXEC sp_U_assigned_lot_updatestatus @item_id = @item_id,
                @lot_no = @lot_no, @sublot_no = @sublot_no,
                @wo_id = @wo_id, @oper_id = @oper_id,
                @seq_no = @seq_no,
                @total_qty_prod = @qty_temp


			--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
			SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_id = 232

			IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
				-- Added "sublot_no," and "@sublot_no" in statement below 1/10/07 KRF
				INSERT INTO job_event
				(
					event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos,
					lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
				)
				VALUES
				(
					@created_at_utc, @created_at_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'EditProd', @ent_id,
					@bom_pos, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_prod, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
				)
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		-- Row does NOT exist - insert a new one
		-- Assign other defaults if not included
		IF @processed IS NULL SET @processed = 0
		IF @byproduct IS NULL SET @byproduct = 0
		IF @move_status IS NULL SET @move_status = 0

		-- Now insert the new row
		-- Added suport for the new material_type, subsegment_id, and comments columns
		INSERT INTO item_prod
		(
			-- Added "sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			-- Added ", created_at" 1/10/07 KRF
			---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,hour_start_utc,hour_start_local,item_id, lot_no, rm_lot_no, sublot_no,rm_sublot_no, reas_cd, user_id,
			ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, to_ent_id, good_prod, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, processed_flag,
			byproduct, ext_ref, move_status, genealogy_id, event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
			comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc,
			created_at_local
		)
		VALUES
		(
			-- Added "@sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			-- Added ", @created_at" 1/10/07 KRF\
			---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local,@hour_start_utc,@hour_start_local, @item_id, @lot_no, @rm_lot_no, @sublot_no,@rm_sublot_no, @reas_cd, @user_id,
			@ent_id, @shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @to_ent_id, @good_prod, @qty_prod, 0, @processed, @byproduct, @ext_ref,
			@move_status, @genealogy_id, @event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
			@cur_comments, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc, @created_at_local
		)

		-- Return error if this was not successful
		IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('SQL Error inserting into item_prod table{3285}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		IF (@byproduct = 0) BEGIN
			EXECUTE sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no

			-- Update the job_hour_history if needed
			IF (@zeroQuantity <> 1) EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @event_time_utc=@created_at_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment
		END

        --Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
        EXEC sp_U_assigned_lot_updatestatus @item_id = @item_id,
            @lot_no = @lot_no, @sublot_no = @sublot_no,
            @wo_id = @wo_id, @oper_id = @oper_id,
            @seq_no = @seq_no,
            @total_qty_prod = @qty_prod

		--Added by Raghu. Auto Populate job_event
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 232
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			-- Added "sublot_no," and "@sublot_no" in statement below 1/10/07 KRF
			INSERT INTO job_event
			(
				event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos, lot_no,
				sublot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, quantity, last_edit_by, last_edit_at
			)
			VALUES
			(
				@created_at_utc, @created_at_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'AddProd', @ent_id, @bom_pos,
				@lot_no, @sublot_no, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @qty_prod, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
			)
		END
	END

	-- Call SP to update Job table with total good and reject prod qty's from item_prod

	IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod = 0) BEGIN
		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod != 0) SET @cur_qty_prod = @cur_int_qty_prod
		ELSE SET @cur_qty_prod = @qty_prod

		--Also update the TPM_Stat table with summarized data for this ent, job and shift
		--Calling this sp "sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys" is commented out. As we use a seperate trigger to update the quantities in TPM_Stat table. Below line is commented out by Raghu
		--EXECUTE sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start
		--Check whether we should update inventory with this production quantity
		IF (@update_inv = 1) BEGIN
			--IF NOT @to_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
			--11/03/04 SJ Lifetime from item used
			SET @expiry_date = NULL
			SELECT @expiry_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) + lifetime FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id AND lifetime > 0

			SET @cur_uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id)
			-- 10/26/2002 TC 1.5.0	Call to SP_I_Item_Inv_Add now returns its row_id so add it as a parameter
			-- Added "@sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			EXECUTE @return = SP_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @grade_cd=@grade_cd, @status_cd=@status_cd
				, @add_qty=@cur_qty_prod, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=@time_zone_bias_value, @expiry_date=@expiry_date, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no
				, @from_ent_id=NULL, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL
				, @goods_received=0, @checkgradestatus=0, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @date_in_utc=@created_at_utc, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id OUTPUT
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
		END
	END

	-- Determine if the supplied job is currently running
	SELECT @state_cd=state_cd from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id=@wo_id AND oper_id=@oper_id AND seq_no=@seq_no

	if @state_cd = 3
		SET @is_job_running = 1
	else
		SET @is_job_running = 0

	-- If the job is running and we are not producing a byproduct, generate samples
	-- for the 'record production' event type
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_capture_qm_data = 1) AND @is_job_running = 1 AND @byproduct = 0) BEGIN
		SELECT @job_pos = job_pos FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
--declare @errmsg varchar(1000)
--set @errmsg = 'Job Pos = ' + convert(varchar(20), coalesce(@job_pos, -1))
--raiserror(@errmsg, 16, 1)
		EXECUTE sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id, @last_edit_at, 3, 0, 0, @time_zone_bias_value, @job_pos
	END
END

/**********************************************************************************
Stored Procedure:		SP_S_MDRT_Config_GetAddedAttributes
Author:					Priyanka Randive
Created:				12/28/2017

Description:			To get MES Attributes which are assigned to MES aspects like entities, items,lots
Called by:				Skelta Form - Attribute Configuration screen

Revision		Date			Who				    What
========		====			===				    ====
0.1				12/28/2017		PR					First version

**********************************************************************************/
--==================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDRT_Config_GetAddedAttributes]
  (@attr_grp int )
AS

begin

select attr_desc,a.attr_grp,ag.attr_grp_name
,data_type
,case data_type
when 0 then 'Text'
when 1 then 'Drop down'
when 2 then 'Integer'
when 3 then 'Currency'
when 4 then 'Color'
when 5 then 'Date time'
when 6 then 'Floating point number'
when 7 then 'Percent'
when 8 then 'Checkbox'
when 9 then 'Non editable'
when 10 then 'Time of Day'
when 11 then 'Item reason'
when 12 then 'Long Text'
end as data_type_desc
,entry_type
,case entry_type
when 0 then 'Value only'
when 1 then 'Notes only'
when 2 then 'Value and Notes'
end as entry_type_desc
,visible_in_inv
,case visible_in_inv
when 0 then 'False'
when 1 then 'True'
end as visible_in_inv_desc
,visible_in_queue
,case visible_in_queue
when 0 then 'False'
when 1 then 'True'
end as visible_in_queue_desc
,attr_id 
from attr a with (NOLOCK) 
Left join vw_MDRT_Config_AttributeGrps ag  with (NOLOCK)  on ag.attr_grp = a.attr_grp where a.attr_grp = @attr_grp order by last_edit_at desc

  select 'result'




  end

 @job_ent_id  int  = NULL,
 @util_ent_id  int = NULL,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) = NULL ,
 @last_edit_at datetime = NULL,
 @get_current_oee LOGICAL = 1)
  AS

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 05/17/2013	Raghu		4.6	UserStory:178630 - configure normalized production rates
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
--05/16/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserStory: 676788 - As Lenka, I want statistics to be optionally calculated when sp_SA_Oee_Exec, sp_S_Oee_Exec, sp_SA_Util_Exec, and sp_S_Util_Exec is called
--06/07/2017	Raghu		6.1	UserStory: 816528 - As Lenka, I want statistics to be optionally calculated and defaulted to TRUE when sp_SA_Oee_Exec, sp_S_Oee_Exec, sp_SA_Util_Exec, and sp_S_Util_Exec is called
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @current_oees	TABLE(ent_id INT PRIMARY KEY, current_util FLOAT, current_qual FLOAT, current_perf FLOAT, current_oee FLOAT)

DECLARE @oee_ent_id	INT32
	,@tjob_ent_id	INT32
	,@tutil_ent_id	INT32
	,@basis		INT32
	,@current_perf	TFLOAT = NULL
	,@current_qual	TFLOAT = NULL
	,@current_oee	TFLOAT = NULL
	,@current_util	TFLOAT = NULL

	--Default to 1, oee will be calculated by default.
	SET @get_current_oee = COALESCE(@get_current_oee, 1)

	IF (@get_current_oee = 1) BEGIN
		DECLARE oee_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
    		SELECT oee_exec.ent_id, oee_exec.job_ent_id, oee_exec.util_ent_id, oee_exec.basis
    		FROM oee_exec oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
    		WHERE ((oee_exec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		       (oee_exec.job_ent_id = @job_ent_id OR @job_ent_id IS NULL) AND
		       (oee_exec.util_ent_id = @util_ent_id OR @util_ent_id IS NULL) AND
		       (oee_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
			(oee_exec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

		OPEN oee_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM oee_cursor INTO @oee_ent_id, @tjob_ent_id, @tutil_ent_id, @basis
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

			--Default the KPIs to null
			SELECT @current_util=NULL, @current_qual=NULL, @current_perf=NULL, @current_oee = NULL

			-- Call the SP to return the KPI values
			EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetCurrentKPIs @ent_id=@oee_ent_id, @job_ent_id=@tjob_ent_id, @util_ent_id=@tutil_ent_id, @basis=@basis
				, @availability=@current_util OUTPUT, @quality=@current_qual OUTPUT, @performance=@current_perf OUTPUT, @oee=@current_oee OUTPUT

			--Insert the record into the temporary table
			INSERT INTO @current_oees (ent_id, current_util, current_qual, current_perf, current_oee) VALUES (@oee_ent_id, @current_util, @current_qual, @current_perf, @current_oee)
		END
		CLOSE oee_cursor
		DEALLOCATE oee_cursor
	END

	SELECT oee_exec.ent_id
		    ,ent.ent_name
		    ,oee_exec.job_ent_id
		    ,ent1.ent_name as job_ent_name
		    ,oee_exec.util_ent_id
		    ,ent2.ent_name as util_ent_name
		    ,oee_exec.target_perf
		    ,curr_oee.current_perf
		    ,oee_exec.target_qual
		    ,curr_oee.current_qual
		    ,oee_exec.def_prod_rate
		,oee_exec.prod_uom
		    ,oee_exec.batch_size
		    ,oee_exec.std_item_id
		    ,oee_exec.target_oee
		    ,curr_oee.current_oee
		    ,oee_exec.basis
		    ,oee_exec.last_edit_comment
		    ,oee_exec.last_edit_by
		    ,oee_exec.last_edit_at
		    ,curr_oee.current_util
	FROM oee_exec oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON oee_exec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent ent1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON oee_exec.job_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent ent2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON oee_exec.util_ent_id = ent2.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN @current_oees curr_oee ON oee_exec.ent_id = curr_oee.ent_id
	WHERE ((oee_exec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
	       (oee_exec.job_ent_id = @job_ent_id OR @job_ent_id IS NULL) AND
	       (oee_exec.util_ent_id = @util_ent_id OR @util_ent_id IS NULL) AND
	       (oee_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
	       (oee_exec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
	ORDER BY ent.ent_name
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_SA_ofi_GetItems]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch all items with some filters
--
-- Usage:		CloneMasterRecipe, AddMasterRecipe, EditMasterRecipe
-- =====================================================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-07-15			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2022-09-27			Create new category to get the target material based on the entity
-- 0.03.00	AP				2022-12-07			condition added so that Obsolete Material should not come in
--												recipe BOM				
-- 0.04.00	SN				2022-12-14			Devops issue 298 - Issue with the duplicate component in the recipe
-- 0.05.00	SN				2023-02-17			Added @ent_id=null condition to show all the items in the dropdown incase no Equipment is selected			
-- =====================================================================================================================

CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetItems]
(@recipe_name	NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
@produced INT = NULL,
@consumed INT = NULL,
@type INT = NULL,
@ent_id INT = NULL,
@item_id nvarchar(40) = NULL,
@ver_id INT = NULL
) AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
		@iItemGroupAttrId INT,
		@strItemGroupAttrDesc NVARCHAR(80) = 'ItemGroup',
		@strItemGroupAttrValue NVARCHAR(80)
	DECLARE 
		@iDestMaterialsAttrId INT,
		@strDestMaterialsAttrDesc NVARCHAR(80) = 'DestMaterials',
		@strDestMaterialsAttrValue NVARCHAR(100) 
	DECLARE @item_class_ids TABLE(
		item_class_id NVARCHAR(40),
		item_class_desc NVARCHAR(80)
	)

	-- Retrive attr id of 'ItemGroup' desc
	SELECT 
		@iItemGroupAttrId = attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE 
		attr_desc = @strItemGroupAttrDesc
		AND attr_grp = 1 -- item attribute group

	-- Retrieve attribute id for attribute name 'DestMaterials'
	SELECT 
		@iDestMaterialsAttrId = attr_id 
	FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE 
		attr_desc = @strDestMaterialsAttrDesc
		AND attr_grp = 2 -- entity attribute group
	
	INSERT @item_class_ids
	SELECT item_class_id, item_class_desc 
	FROM item_class WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE (produced = @produced) OR (consumed = @consumed)
	
	-- Get the items
	IF (@type = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			item_id,
			item_desc
		FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM @item_class_ids)		
		AND obsolete=0 --  0.03.00
		--0.04.00 - added the below condition to remove the items that are already added 
		AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id 
							FROM bom_item with (nolock) 
							where parent_item_id = @item_id
							AND ver_id = @ver_id 
							AND (spare2 is NULL OR spare2 <> 'InActive')
							AND (bom_pos > 0 OR bom_pos < 0))
		ORDER by item_desc ASC
	END
	ELSE IF (@type = 2)
	BEGIN
		-- Retrive attr value with attr desc defined on @strItemGroupAttrDesc  
		SELECT 
			@strItemGroupAttrValue = attr_value
		FROM item_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE 
			attr_id = @iItemGroupAttrId
			AND item_id = (SELECT item_id 
						FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE recipe_name = @recipe_name)

		SELECT 
			i.item_id,
			i.item_desc
		FROM item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = i.item_id
		WHERE 
			attr_value = @strItemGroupAttrValue
			AND attr_id = @iItemGroupAttrId
			AND item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM @item_class_ids)
		ORDER by i.item_desc ASC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
-- Retrieve attr value with attr desc defined on @strDestMaterialsAttrDesc
--Added @ent_id=null condition to show all the items in the dropdown incase no Equipment is selected --0.05.00 
IF (@ent_id IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			@strDestMaterialsAttrValue = attr_value
		FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE 
			attr_id = @iDestMaterialsAttrId
			AND ent_id = @ent_id

		SELECT 
			i.item_id,
			i.item_desc
		FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.item_id 
										AND ia.attr_id = @iItemGroupAttrId
		WHERE 
			--(item_id IN (SELECT value FROM [dbo].fn_Split(@strDestMaterialsAttrValue,',')) OR @strDestMaterialsAttrValue IS NULL)
			(ia.attr_value IN (SELECT value FROM [dbo].fn_Split(@strDestMaterialsAttrValue,',')) OR @strDestMaterialsAttrValue IS NULL)
			AND i.item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM @item_class_ids)
		ORDER by i.item_desc ASC
	END

	ELSE 
		BEGIN
		SELECT 
			i.item_id,
			i.item_desc
		FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.item_id 
										AND ia.attr_id = @iItemGroupAttrId
		WHERE 
			--(item_id IN (SELECT value FROM [dbo].fn_Split(@strDestMaterialsAttrValue,',')) OR @strDestMaterialsAttrValue IS NULL)
			(ia.attr_value IN (SELECT value FROM [dbo].fn_Split(@strDestMaterialsAttrValue,',')) OR @strDestMaterialsAttrValue IS NULL)
			AND i.item_class_id IN (SELECT item_class_id FROM @item_class_ids)
		ORDER by i.item_desc ASC
		END

END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Bom_Item]
(@parent_item_id         NVARCHAR(40),
@ver_id                 NVARCHAR(40),
@bom_pos                INT,
@item_id                NVARCHAR(40),
@reqd_grade_cd          INT,
@instruction            NVARCHAR(2000),
@qty_per_parent_item    FLOAT,
@max_qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
@min_qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
@update_inv             BIT,
@backflush              BIT,
@def_reas_cd            INT,
@def_lot_no             NVARCHAR(40),
@def_sublot_no          NVARCHAR(40),
@def_storage_ent_id     INT,
@def_reject_ent_id	INT,
@scaling_factor         FLOAT,
@must_consume_from_inv  LOGICAL,
@may_choose_alt_inv_loc LOGICAL,
@may_create_new_lots    LOGICAL,
@must_consume_from_wip  BIT,
@must_consume_before_prod BIT,
@constant_qty           LOGICAL,
@est_time	        FLOAT,
@serial_no_source       LOGICAL,
@spare1                 NVARCHAR(1000),
@spare2                 NVARCHAR(1000),
@spare3                 NVARCHAR(1000),
@spare4                 NVARCHAR(1000),
@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254),
@mod_id                 VARCHAR(30) OUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	     - SP_I_BOM_ITEM
-- Description	     - Insert into bom item table
-- Author	     -
-- Date Created	     - 04/26/2002
-- Version	     - 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver	  Changes
-- 05/16/2002     Sheetal Jain  1.0.0.1  Check for record in bom item oper link for bom position 0 for each of the parent items
-- 09/04/2002     Sheetal Jain  1.4.0.0  Def_Cont_Id removed (Ref#886)
-- 09/11/2002	  Raghu	                 Added parameter fields max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod
--					 Also included max/min parent item_item, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod into insert statement
-- 10/18/2002	  Tony	        1.5.0.0  Include constant_qty field
-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0.0  Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 12/12/2002     Sheetal Jain  1.5.0.1  Avoiding BOM_POS = 0 duplicates
-- 01/14/2003	  Raghu	        1.5.0.5	 (HD# 2242) Donot default min_qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item to 0. Defaulting is commented out.
-- 05/15/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.0  (HD# 457) BOM item oper link default start pct set to the value in system attribute 203
-- 11/07/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.31 (HD# 784) Preventing infinite loops in bom item tree
-- 11/12/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.0.32 Fixed bom version creation issue due to the above fix
-- 11/19/2003	  Raghu		2.0.0.11 (HD# 4112) Added SET NOCOUNT ON
-- 11/25/2003     Sheetal Jain  2.0.0.12 (HD# 3908) Always by default consume new bom items in the first operation
-- 12/09/2003     Sheetal Jain  2.0.0.15 (HD# 4206) Auto BOM item allocation should only be for a process with one op
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  2.0.0.24 (HD# 4395) Maintain BOM_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
-- 07/07/2004     Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_eidt_at and last_edit_by in the insert statement- Also def_reas_cd, def_lot_no and def_storage_ent_id are forwarded
--					to bom_item_oper_link table
-- 10/01/2004     Raghu		2.1.3	Changed bom_ver.ver_date to be updated with GMT Date (instead of local date)
-- 08/08/2005     Raghu		2.1.25	HD# 6083, Bom_Ver.Ver_Date should be a local date and not a GMT date.
-- 09/19/2005     Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 10/20/2005     Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
-- 10/17/2005     Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/04/2007     KRF           3.2.1   HD# 8314, 9232 - Added @def_sublot_no, @serial_no_source arguments
-- 01/18/2007     KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE
  @V_Process            STRING40,
  @V_Oper       	STRING40,
  @V_Count      	INT,
  @V_Status     	CHAR(1),
  @V_Reqd_Start_Pct     TFLOAT_NULL,
  @V_Item               STRING40,
  @V_Parent_Item        STRING40,
  @V_Found              INTEGER,
  @V_Error              VARCHAR(255),
  @V_StepNo             INTEGER,
  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),
  @last_edit_at	DATETIME,
	@current_time	TDATETIME,
	@use_GMT	INT32
BEGIN
  IF @update_inv IS NULL  SET @update_inv = 0
  IF @backflush IS NULL  SET @backflush = 0
  IF @must_consume_from_inv IS NULL  SET @must_consume_from_inv = 0
  IF @may_choose_alt_inv_loc IS  NULL  SET @may_choose_alt_inv_loc = 1
  IF @may_create_new_lots IS NULL SET @may_create_new_lots = 1
--Modified by Raghu on 01/14/2002.  Donot default min_qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item to 0. Defaulting is commented out.
--  IF @max_qty_per_parent_item IS NULL SET @max_qty_per_parent_item = 0
--  IF @min_qty_per_parent_item IS NULL SET @min_qty_per_parent_item = 0
  IF @constant_qty IS  NULL  SET @constant_qty = 0
  IF @serial_no_source IS NULL SET @serial_no_source = 0

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  --Look downtree of the component being added
  IF @bom_pos <> 0
  BEGIN
    SET @V_Parent_Item = NULL
    SET @V_Item = @item_id
    CREATE TABLE #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40), item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), status INT)
    INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id,  status)
      SELECT b.parent_item_id, b.item_id, 0 FROM bom_item b INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON b.item_id = v.parent_item_id
        WHERE b.parent_item_id = @V_Item
    --Loop through the BOM tree and list all items with BOM
    DECLARE cur_item CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT parent_item_id, item_id FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE status = 0
    OPEN cur_item
    FETCH cur_item INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Item
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE #tmp_bom_item0 SET status = 1 WHERE parent_item_id = @V_Parent_Item AND item_id = @V_Item
      INSERT INTO #tmp_bom_item0(parent_item_id, item_id, status)
        SELECT b.parent_item_id, b.item_id, 0 FROM bom_item b INNER JOIN bom_ver v ON b.item_id = v.parent_item_id
          WHERE b.parent_item_id = @V_Item AND b.bom_pos <> 0
      FETCH cur_item INTO @V_Parent_Item, @V_Item
    END
    CLOSE cur_item
    DEALLOCATE cur_item
    --Check if the parent item to which this component is being added exists in the bom tree of the component
    SET @V_Found = 0
    SELECT DISTINCT @V_Found = 1 FROM #tmp_bom_item0 WHERE item_id = @parent_item_id
    IF @V_Found = 1
    BEGIN
--      SET @V_Error = N'Looping is not allowed. Parent item#' + @parent_item_id + N' is present in the BOM tree of the component#' + @item_id
      SET @V_Error = N'Looping is not allowed. Parent item# %1 is present in the BOM tree of the component# %2{4717},' + @parent_item_id + ',' + @item_id
      RAISERROR(@V_Error, 16,1)
      RETURN -1
    END
    DROP TABLE #tmp_bom_item0
  END  --End of @bom_pos <> 0

  INSERT INTO bom_item(parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item,
                       min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id,
                       scaling_factor, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip,
                       must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment,
                       last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    VALUES(@parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @item_id, @reqd_grade_cd, @instruction, @qty_per_parent_item, @max_qty_per_parent_item,
           @min_qty_per_parent_item, @update_inv, @backflush, @def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id,
           @scaling_factor, @must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc,  @may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip,
           @must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty, @est_time, @serial_no_source, @spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment,
           @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)
  --Get all the processes using this item
  IF @bom_pos = 0
  BEGIN
    DECLARE cur_process CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT o.process_id, o.oper_id FROM item_process_link i, oper o
      WHERE i.process_id = o.process_id AND i.item_id = @parent_item_id
    OPEN cur_process
    FETCH cur_process INTO @V_Process, @V_Oper

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      --Check if record already exists, if so update else insert
      SELECT @V_Count=COUNT(*) FROM bom_item_oper_link WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND bom_pos = 0
        AND process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @V_Oper
      SELECT @V_Reqd_Start_Pct = CAST(attr_value AS FLOAT)/100 FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 203  --Default percent to start<2173>
      IF @V_Count = 0
      BEGIN
        --Check for duplicate BOM_POS=0
        SET @V_Status = 'Y'
        EXEC sp_BOM_Item_Oper_Link_Chk @parent_item_id, @V_Oper, @V_Process, @V_Status = @V_Status OUTPUT
        IF @V_Status = 'Y'
          --Insert into bom item oper link
 --         EXEC sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @V_Process, @V_Oper, @qty_per_parent_item, @V_Reqd_Start_Pct,
--		@def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUT
		EXEC sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @V_Process, @V_Oper, @qty_per_parent_item, @V_Reqd_Start_Pct,
			@def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id, @update_inv, @backflush,
			@must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc, @may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip,
			@must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUT
      END
      ELSE
      BEGIN
        --Update the start percent to zero
        UPDATE bom_item_oper_link SET reqd_start_pct = @V_Reqd_Start_Pct WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND bom_pos = 0
          AND process_id = @V_Process AND oper_id = @V_Oper
      END
      FETCH cur_process INTO @V_Process, @V_Oper
    END
    CLOSE cur_process
    DEALLOCATE cur_process
  END  --End of @bom_pos = 0

  --for the new component add consumption/production to the first operation in each of the processes
  IF @bom_pos <> 0
  BEGIN
    SELECT @V_Reqd_Start_Pct = CAST(attr_value AS FLOAT)/100 FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 203  --Default percent to start<2173>
    DECLARE cur_process CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT b.process_id, b.oper_id FROM bom_item_oper_link b
      INNER JOIN oper p ON p.process_id = b.process_id AND p.oper_id = b.oper_id
        WHERE b.parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND b.ver_id = @ver_id AND b.bom_pos = 0 AND p.first_oper = 1
          AND 1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oper a WHERE a.process_id = p.process_id)
    OPEN cur_process
    WHILE (1=1)
    BEGIN
      FETCH cur_process INTO @V_Process, @V_Oper
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS <> 0
        BREAK
      --Check if parent_item is being produced at this operation in this process
      BEGIN
        --Insert into bom item oper link
--        EXEC sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @V_Process, @V_Oper, @qty_per_parent_item, @V_Reqd_Start_Pct,
--		@def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUT
		EXEC sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Link @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @V_Process, @V_Oper, @qty_per_parent_item, @V_Reqd_Start_Pct,
			@def_reas_cd, @def_lot_no, @def_sublot_no, @def_storage_ent_id, @def_reject_ent_id, @update_inv, @backflush,
			@must_consume_from_inv, @may_choose_alt_inv_loc, @may_create_new_lots, @must_consume_from_wip,
			@must_consume_before_prod, @constant_qty, @last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUT
        SET @V_StepNo = NULL
        --Select the first repeatable consumable step
        IF @bom_pos > 0
        BEGIN
          SELECT TOP 1 @V_StepNo = s.step_no FROM oper_step s
            INNER JOIN oper_step_grp g ON s.process_id = g.process_id AND s.oper_id = g.oper_id AND s.step_grp_id = g.step_grp_id
              WHERE s.process_id = @V_Process AND s.oper_id = @V_Oper AND s.action_type = 3 AND g.repeatability = 1
              ORDER BY s.step_seq
        END  --End of @bom_pos > 0
        --Select the last repeatable produceable step
        IF @bom_pos < 0
        BEGIN
          SELECT TOP 1 @V_StepNo = s.step_no FROM oper_step s
            INNER JOIN oper_step_grp g ON s.process_id = g.process_id AND s.oper_id = g.oper_id AND s.step_grp_id = g.step_grp_id
              WHERE s.process_id = @V_Process AND s.oper_id = @V_Oper AND s.action_type = 2 AND g.repeatability = 1
              ORDER BY s.step_seq DESC
        END
        --Create bom item oper step link records for consumable items
        IF @V_StepNo IS NOT NULL
          EXEC sp_I_Bom_Item_Oper_Step_Link @parent_item_id, @ver_id, @bom_pos, @V_Process, @V_Oper, @V_StepNo, @qty_per_parent_item,
			@last_edit_comment, @mod_id OUT
      END  --End  of EXISTS ...
    END  --End of (1=1)
    CLOSE cur_process
    DEALLOCATE cur_process
  END  --End of @bom_pos <> 0

  --Maintain bom version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)
  UPDATE bom_ver SET ver_date = @current_time  WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id

  -- Return timestamp
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM bom_item
    WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_APR_PurgeMainData]
(
	@main_table_name NVARCHAR(30)
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-	sp_U_APR_PurgeMainData
-- Description			-	This method purges the data in the supplied main table based on the rows that have been copied
--							to a temporary archive table from the main table.  The archive table must be set up using
--							sp_U_APR_CreateTable and the data is copied to the temporary archive table using sp_U_APR_GetTransferKeys.
-- Author				-	Rich Boyle
--
-- Date Created			-	03/04/2016
-- Version				-	6.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 08/23/2017     Srinivasa,tentu  US#790886, Added condition to allow user to puge only inactive records from labor_usage table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @SQL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @where_clause AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @table_count AS INT

	-- Validate that the supplied main table name is a real table in the MES table space
	SELECT @table_count = COUNT(*)  FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(@main_table_name) AND type in (N'U')

	IF (@table_count = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @where_clause = dbo.fn_APR_GetPurgeDependentWhereClause(@main_table_name, 't2', @main_table_name)
		SET @SQL = 'DELETE FROM ' + @main_table_name + ' WHERE EXISTS ('
			+ 'SELECT 1 FROM ' + @main_table_name + '_tmp_prg t2 WHERE ' + @where_clause + ')'

			IF UPPER(@main_table_name) = N'LABOR_USAGE'
			   SET @SQL =  @SQL + ' AND labor_usage.active = 0 '
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @sql
	END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_consumption
-- Description:  Returns the consumption for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-02		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Karthik     2022-09-05		   Added additional fields in the select
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-02-09		   Refer to the comments in the SP on this date	
-- 0.01.03	AP			2023-02-23		   Added logic for sending beans consumption when nibs is consumed
-- 0.01.04	Karthik		2023-06-28		   Added wo_id to the join condition to ofi_wo_item_ext. Refer notes below of the date
-- 0.01.05	Karthik		2023-07-03		   Updated condition to include Intermediate class id with NIBS. Modified join condition of ofi_wo_item_ext to left join
-- 0.01.06	LP  		2023-07-03		   Updated condition to check spare1 value for nibs consumption  and changed on update command to update spare1 value
-- 0.01.07	Karthik		2023-07-21		   Updated condition to ignore reporting items with attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set
-- 0.01.08	LP  		2023-07-24		   Updated condition to send consumption except Beans/nibs consumption, we created separate sp for bean/nibs consumption 
-- 0.01.09	Karthik		2023-08-11		   Updated the logics, to pick processes without NotConsumeToSAP attribute and avoid reporting lot_no in case of ShellBurning
-- 0.01.10	LP  		2023-08-30		   Updated the logics, added extra condition to handle the Liqor Blending in first select statement
-- 0.01.11	Veervar		2024-06-04			Updated for to check if production reporting pending for rework Bin item 
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE                   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_consumption] as
begin
    Declare @row_id int, @ent_id int, @storage_locn VARCHAR(100), @item_id nvarchar(40),
	@binItemattr_desc VARCHAR(100)= 'ReworkBinItem'
	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON


	BEGIN TRY
	declare @itemgrp nvarchar(40), @nibslot nvarchar(40), @nibsSublot nvarchar(40), @nibsConsQty float, @nibsOrder nvarchar(40),@nibsTotalCons float

	SET @ent_id = -1


	--Ap: 22-Feb-2023 - added filter for pack class, also beans are excluded, it will be reported as part of nibs.
    SELECT TOP 1	@row_id = ic.row_id,
					@ent_id = ic.from_ent_id, 
					@itemgrp=ia.attr_value, 
					@nibslot=ic.lot_no, 
					@nibsSublot=ic.sublot_no, 
					@nibsTotalCons = qty_cons,
					@nibsConsQty=qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0),
					@nibsOrder = ic.wo_id,
					@item_id=ic.item_id
					
	  
	  FROM				item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	  INNER join		item i								on ic.item_id = i.item_id
	  INNER JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia with(nolock)			ON ia.item_id=i.item_id 
															AND ia.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
															AND ia.attr_value not like '%BEANS'
															AND ic.oper_id not like '%blend'--0.01.10
	  LEFT JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia1 with(nolock)			ON ia1.item_id=i.item_id	-- (KN 21Jul23 - Get only items which don't have the attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set for them)
															AND ia1.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting')
	 LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK)
															ON ie.item_id = i.item_id 
															AND ie.wo_id = ic.wo_id	--(KN 28Jun23 - Added join condition to return rows based on work order)

		WHERE	qty_cons_erp < qty_cons 
				AND i.item_class_id <> UPPER('PACK')
				AND (
			--	(UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('WIP') OR (UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('INTERMEDIATE')) AND IA.attr_VALUE LIKE '%NIBS' )
			--	or  
				(UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('WIP') AND UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('INTERMEDIATE'))
				)	---Pick WIP item only if it is NIBS
				AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1  AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
				
				AND (ia1.attr_value IS NULL OR (ia1.attr_value IS NOT NULL AND ia1.attr_value <> 1))	-- (KN 21Jul23 - Get only items which don't have the attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set for them)
	 
		ORDER by ic.created_at_local asc


	--0.01.11 - block start
	--verify if current item is rework bin item and all production reported for this lot	
	--IF EXISTS(select distinct ea.attr_value
	--from ent_attr ea
	--INNER JOIN ENT ON ent.ent_id=ea.ent_id
	--INNER JOIN attr a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
	--where a.attr_desc=@binItemattr_desc and @item_id in (ea.attr_value))
	--	BEGIN
	--		IF EXISTS (SELECT top 1 row_id FROM item_prod where item_id=@item_id and qty_prod_erp < qty_prod and lot_no=@nibslot)
	--			BEGIN
	--				select 1 --SKIP CONSUMPTION MESSAGE FOR BIN ITEM IF PRODUCTION REPORTING IS PENDING FOR SAME LOT
	--			END
	--	END
	--0.01.11 - Block end


	 if @ent_id <> -1 and @ent_id is not NULL
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = NULL
			SELECT @storage_locn = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation')
			IF @storage_locn is NULL
				SELECT @storage_locn = ent_name from ent with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id
		
			BEGIN TRANSACTION;

			--(KN - 19-Feb-23 - Pick all operations for which NotCosumeToSAP has not been set)
			print @row_id
			print @storage_locn
			IF @itemgrp<>'NIBS'
			BEGIN

					print 'not nibs';


					with ConsToSAPOpers as(			-- (KN 11Aug23 - Updated logic to select processes which doesn't have NotConsumeToSAP set)
	Select oper_id from oper with(nolock) where oper_id not in(
			Select oper_id from oper_attr with(nolock) where attr_id  = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='NotConsumeToSAP') and cast(attr_value as varchar) = '1'
	)
)

					Select wo_id Order_Number,
						   [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,
						   iif(ic.oper_id <> 'ShellBurning',lot_no,null) Batch_Number,	-- (KN 11Aug23 - Exclude lot no for ShellBurning)
						   IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,ic.item_id,ia.attr_value) Material, --(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
						   qty_cons-ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0) Quantity,
						   u.description UOM,
						   '261' Movement_Type,
						   format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
				format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime,
						   @storage_locn Storage_Location,--e.ent_name Storage_Location,
						   '' Document_Number,
						   '' Message,
						   '' Message
					  from item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
					 inner join item i WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.item_id = i.item_id
					inner join item_class icl on i.item_class_id = icl.item_class_id	--(KN - 09/02/23 - Exclude items with Intermediate class id)
					inner join ConsToSAPOpers cs on cs.oper_id = ic.oper_id --(KN - 09/02/23 - Include only those operations where the NotConsumeToSAP has not been set)
					   --and i.spare1 is null --(KN - 05/09/22) Don't report SFG Material available only in MES
					left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
										on i.item_id = ia.item_id	--(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists. If there are diff type of butter exists, only SAP butter will be reported to SAP)
					  left join uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
						on i.uom_id   = u.uom_id
					  left join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
						on e.ent_id   = ic.ent_id
					 where ic.row_id = @row_id and UPPER(icl.item_class_desc) <> UPPER('Intermediate') --(KN - 09/02/23 - Exclude items with Intermediate class id)
	

						Update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id = @row_id
	
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

					print 'nibs'

					----------------
					--AP: 23-FEB; BEANS Reporting on nibs consumption
					------------
					DECLARE  @NibsProdQty float,@NibsConsPercent float, @beansRowId int=-1, @beansQty float,@qty_cons_erp float,@qty_cons float
					
					SET @beansRowId = -1;
					--select @nibsConsQty=qty_cons-qty_cons_erp from item_cons where row_id=@row_id
					Declare @totalBeanCons float

					select @totalBeanCons= Sum(ic.qty_cons) from item_cons ic with(nolock) -- (KN 21-Apr Finding Beans consumption from item_cons)
					where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot--and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp

					select top 1 @beansRowId=row_id,@beansQty = qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@qty_cons=qty_cons from item_cons ic with(nolock) -- (KN 21-Apr Finding Beans consumption from item_cons)
					where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp
					--and CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS float) < CAST(@nibsTotalCons as float)  -- @nibsTotalCons 	
					and CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS float) < CAST(@totalBeanCons as float)  -- @totalBeanCons 	
					order by created_at_local asc

					PRINT 'BEANS - ' +  CAST(isnull(@beansRowId,-1) as varchar)  + ' - ' + CAST(isnull(@beansQty,0) as varchar) +'-'+CAST(@nibsConsQty as varchar)

					IF @beansRowId<>-1
					BEGIN
						PRINT 'BEANS FOUND FOR  NIBS'

						
						declare @spare1 float

						select @NibsProdQty = sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),  @NibsConsPercent = case when round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),3)>1 then 1 
						else round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),3) end
						from item_prod ip with(nolock)
						where ip.lot_no=@nibslot and ip.sublot_no=@nibsSublot


						declare @beansQtyToBeReported float

						set @spare1= round(@totalBeanCons * @NibsConsPercent,3)
						SET @beansQtyToBeReported = round(@totalBeanCons * @NibsConsPercent,3)
						IF (@beansQty - @qty_cons_erp)<@spare1
						BEGIN
						 SET @beansQtyToBeReported=@beansQty-@qty_cons_erp
						END
						/*ELSE
						BEGIN
						SET @beansQtyToBeReported=@beansQty
						END*/

				
						print '@NibsConsPercent:'+CAST(@NibsConsPercent as varchar)
						Select top 1 @nibsOrder Order_Number,
						   [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,
						   lot_no Batch_Number,
						   IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,ic.item_id,ia.attr_value) Material, 
						   @beansQtyToBeReported Quantity,
						   --qty_cons *  @NibsConsPercent Quantity,
						   u.description UOM,
						   '261' Movement_Type,
						   format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
							format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime,
						   @storage_locn Storage_Location,
						   '' Document_Number,
						   '' Message,
						   '' Message
					  from item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
						inner join item i WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.item_id = i.item_id and ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot
										
					  	left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
							on i.item_id = ia.item_id	
						left join uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
							on i.uom_id   = u.uom_id
						left join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
							on e.ent_id   = ic.ent_id

						where ic.row_id = @beansRowId 

						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp+ @beansQtyToBeReported,spare1=(@spare1-@beansQtyToBeReported) where row_id=@beansRowId

						SET @spare1=@spare1-@beansQtyToBeReported
						---update roasting consumption@beansQty
						declare @nibsPercReported float,@nibsReported float

						--select @qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@qty_cons=qty_cons from item_cons where row_id=@row_id
						SET @nibsPercReported=ROUND(@beansQtyToBeReported/@totalBeanCons,3)
						SET @nibsReported=@nibsPercReported*@nibsConsQty

						IF @spare1<@beansQtyToBeReported
						BEGIN
						print '@beansQty*1000:'+CAST(@beansQty*1000 as varchar)+' @qty_cons_erp:'+CAST(@qty_cons_erp as varchar)+' @qty_cons:'+CAST(@qty_cons as varchar)
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp+@nibsReported where row_id=@row_id						
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id=@row_id
						END
					
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						-- If there are no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty
						--Update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id = @row_id
						PRINT 'no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty'
					END
						--end of beans cons reporting
	
			END


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	End

	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end
