--01/07/2010	Kishore		4.0	HF1432
-- 01/27/2015   JimO		5.0 SP1	Story 437474 -- Do not round qty_reqd or qty_at_start for jobs bound to a work order
--													created from a line due to improper handling of parallel entities
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
--10/10/2018	Raghu		6.1	User Story:1087138 - As an Aveva developer, , I want to analyze the cause of missing production data  on Line Production report
--10/23/2018	RWB		6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
--11/25/2019    Srinivasa   6.2   US#1240916(MOL Merge: job_event table is missing item_id for job state changes other than Running.)
-- 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889-As AVEVA, I want to fix CR L00151312 so that the Line KPI calculations use the job's prod rate and not the entity default rate (Part 2)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @ent_id   		INT
	,@wo_id   		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@oper_id  		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@seq_no   		INT
	,@qty_prod  		FLOAT
	,@qty_rejected  	FLOAT
	,@state_cd  		INT
	,@item_id  		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@folder_ver_id  	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@old_item_id  		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@old_folder_ver_id 	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@run_ent_id		INT
 	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@wo_state_cd		INT
	,@last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@log_job_state_chng	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@last_edit_at_utc	DATETIME
	,@last_edit_at_local	DATETIME
	,@row_id		INT
	,@qty_reqd		FLOAT
	,@qty_at_start		FLOAT
	,@num_decimals		INT
	,@ent_tz_bias_value	INT
	,@temp_ent_id       	INT32
	,@job_pos				INT32
	,@can_capture_qm_data	LOGICAL
	,@line_id				INT32

SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @user_id = @last_edit_by
	SET @last_edit_at_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Make sure the assoc_file_type is set to the extension for the assoc_file
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.wo_id = d.wo_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.seq_no = d.seq_no
		WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) BEGIN

		IF Exists(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM inserted i
			WHERE i.assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		UPDATE job SET assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(x.assoc_file)
		FROM (SELECT i.assoc_file, i.wo_id, i.oper_id, i.seq_no
				FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.wo_id = d.wo_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.seq_no = d.seq_no
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE job.wo_id = x.wo_id AND job.oper_id = x.oper_id AND job.seq_no = x.seq_no

		INSERT INTO file_type
		(file_ext, edit_level, view_level, print_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT x.file_ext, 1, 1, 1, @user_id, @last_edit_at_utc
		FROM (SELECT dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) as file_ext
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.wo_id = d.wo_id AND i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.seq_no = d.seq_no
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE x.file_ext IS NOT NULL AND x.file_ext NOT IN (SELECT file_ext FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK))
	END

	-- Check to see if the est_prod_rate, prod_uom, batch_size, or item_id have changed on a job
	-- that is queued to or running on an entity that is part of a line or if the job has been
	-- started, paused, or ended.  If so, the SP to populate the prod_rate_history and
	-- bottleneck_history table will need to be called.  In the case of an item change, the SP
	--will only need to be called if the uom_id for the old and new item are different.


	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.row_id = d.row_id
	INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = COALESCE(i.run_ent_id, i.target_sched_ent_id)
	INNER JOIN item it1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it1.item_id
	INNER JOIN item it2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.item_id = it2.item_id
	INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.wo_id = w.wo_id AND w.target_sched_line_id = lel.line_id
	WHERE (i.est_prod_rate <> d.est_prod_rate OR i.prod_uom <> d.prod_uom OR
		  i.batch_size <> d.batch_size OR it1.uom_id <> it2.uom_id)
	 AND COALESCE(i.last_edit_comment, '') NOT LIKE '%JobStartPauseEndAction'
	 AND w.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		DECLARE prod_rate_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT DISTINCT w.target_sched_line_id FROM inserted i
			INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.row_id = d.row_id
			INNER JOIN line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK) ON lel.ent_id = COALESCE(i.run_ent_id, i.target_sched_ent_id)
			INNER JOIN item it1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it1.item_id
			INNER JOIN item it2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.item_id = it2.item_id
			INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.wo_id = w.wo_id AND w.target_sched_line_id = lel.line_id
			WHERE (i.est_prod_rate <> d.est_prod_rate OR i.prod_uom <> d.prod_uom OR
				  i.batch_size <> d.batch_size OR it1.uom_id <> it2.uom_id)
			 AND COALESCE(i.last_edit_comment, '') NOT LIKE '%JobStartPauseEndAction'
		 	 AND w.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL
		OPEN prod_rate_job_cursor
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM prod_rate_job_cursor INTO @line_id

			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			EXEC sp_SA_Line_GetBottleneckEnts @line_id = @line_id, @log_prod_rates = 1, @start_time_utc = @last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_comment = 'Job.Update'
		END
		CLOSE prod_rate_job_cursor
		DEALLOCATE prod_rate_job_cursor
	END

	SELECT @log_job_state_chng = attr_value FROM system_attr  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 308

	 DECLARE job_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	  SELECT b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.qty_prod, b.qty_rejected, b.state_cd, b.qty_reqd, b.qty_at_start,
		b.item_id, b.run_ent_id, b.folder_ver_id, b.row_id, i.num_decimals
	  FROM job a WITH (NOLOCK)
	  INNER JOIN inserted b ON a.wo_id = b.wo_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.seq_no = b.seq_no
	  INNER JOIN item i  WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = b.item_id

	 OPEN job_cursor
	 WHILE (1=1) BEGIN

		  FETCH NEXT FROM job_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @qty_prod, @qty_rejected,
		     @state_cd, @qty_reqd, @qty_at_start, @item_id, @run_ent_id, @folder_ver_id, @row_id, @num_decimals
		  IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		  SELECT @qty_reqd = ROUND(@qty_reqd, @num_decimals), @qty_at_start = ROUND(@qty_at_start, @num_decimals)
		  IF UPDATE(QTY_AT_START) OR UPDATE(QTY_REQD) OR UPDATE(QTY_PROD)  OR  UPDATE(QTY_REJECTED) BEGIN
			   SELECT @ent_id = ent_id, @job_pos = job_pos FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			   WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id
			     AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id
			     AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

		IF UPDATE(QTY_AT_START)
			BEGIN
				-- Call sample generation if the job is running and the entity can capture QM data
				IF (@state_cd = 3)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @can_capture_qm_data = can_capture_qm_data FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id

					IF (@can_capture_qm_data = 1)
					BEGIN
						EXECUTE Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @temp_ent_id, @last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_at_local OUTPUT,  @ent_tz_bias_value OUTPUT
						EXECUTE sp_U_Sample_GenerateSamples @ent_id, NULL, 102, 0, 0, @ent_tz_bias_value, @job_pos
					END
				END
			END

		END

		  --(HD# 3565) Sets the state_cd in WO table
		  IF UPDATE(STATE_CD) BEGIN
			IF (@state_cd = 2) BEGIN
				--11/04/2003---Raghu--(HD# 3805) Auto Start Next Job as soon as the job is ready and in the top of the queue
				EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartNextJob @user_id, @run_ent_id, 0, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			END

			IF ((@state_cd = 4) OR (@state_cd = 7)) BEGIN
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
			      		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND (state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7))
				UPDATE wo SET state_cd = 2 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			END
			ELSE IF (@state_cd = 1 OR @state_cd = 2 OR @state_cd = 6) BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X'  FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id  AND ((state_cd <> 1 AND state_cd <> 2 AND state_cd <> 6 AND state_cd <> 7)
							OR (qty_prod <> 0 OR qty_rejected <> 0)))
					SET @wo_state_cd = 1
				ELSE SET @wo_state_cd = 0
				UPDATE wo SET state_cd = @wo_state_cd  WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			END

			--Fetch this from System_Attr later
			IF (@state_cd <> 3 AND  @state_cd <> 4) BEGIN
				IF (@log_job_state_chng = '1') BEGIN
					SELECT @temp_ent_id = COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id)
					FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.oper_id = @oper_id AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

					EXEC Sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @temp_ent_id, @last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_at_local OUTPUT,  @ent_tz_bias_value OUTPUT

					INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos, lot_no, item_id, done_by_user_id, source_row_id, value1, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
					VALUES (@last_edit_at_utc, @last_edit_at_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'JobStateChanged', @run_ent_id, NULL, NULL, @item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @state_cd, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at_utc)
				END
			END
		  END

 		 --09/08/2003 - Raghu - (HD# 2913) If a job is running, then disallowed changes to item_id and folder_ver_id
		  IF (@state_cd = 3) BEGIN
			   SELECT @old_item_id = item_id, @old_folder_ver_id = folder_ver_id FROM DELETED WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			   IF (@item_id <> @old_item_id) OR --(@old_folder_ver_id IS NOT NULL AND @old_folder_ver_id <> @folder_ver_id) BEGIN
					NOT (((@old_folder_ver_id IS NOT NULL AND @folder_ver_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@old_folder_ver_id = @folder_ver_id)) OR (@old_folder_ver_id IS NULL AND @folder_ver_id IS NULL)) BEGIN
				    RAISERROR('Cannot change item or folder for a running job{3989}', 16, 1)
				    BREAK
			   END
		  END

           --Make sure that for CWOFP and work orders created from a line that rounding does not happen
           IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq') IS NULL BEGIN
           	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 from wo w WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE w.wo_id = @wo_id AND w.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL)
           		UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = ROUND(qty_reqd, @num_decimals), qty_at_start = ROUND(qty_at_start, @num_decimals)
			   ,edited_by = @last_edit_by, edit_time = @last_edit_at_utc, last_edit_comment = CASE WHEN REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		ELSE
			UPDATE job SET edited_by = @last_edit_by, edit_time = @last_edit_at_utc, last_edit_comment = CASE WHEN REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
           END
           ELSE BEGIN
           	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 from wo w WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE w.wo_id = @wo_id AND w.target_sched_line_id IS NOT NULL)
			UPDATE job SET qty_reqd = ROUND(qty_reqd, @num_decimals), qty_at_start = ROUND(qty_at_start, @num_decimals)
			   ,edited_by = @last_edit_by, edit_time = @last_edit_at_utc, last_edit_comment = CASE WHEN REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tbl_temp_for_op_seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
		ELSE
			UPDATE job SET edited_by = @last_edit_by, edit_time = @last_edit_at_utc, last_edit_comment = CASE WHEN REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') = '' THEN NULL ELSE REPLACE(last_edit_comment, 'JobStartPauseEndAction', '') END
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
	                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tbl_temp_for_op_seq WHERE wo_id = @wo_id)
           END

           --Check if the item has changed, if so change item in bom_pos 0 in job_bom
		IF UPDATE(ITEM_ID) BEGIN
			SELECT @old_item_id = item_id FROM deleted WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			IF @old_item_id <> @item_id BEGIN
				UPDATE job_bom SET item_id = @item_id
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
				  AND bom_pos = 0 AND item_id = @old_item_id
			END
		END  --End of UPDATE(ITEM_ID)

	 END -- End of While (1=1)
	 CLOSE job_cursor
	 DEALLOCATE job_cursor
END

		  ,line.spare4

          ,line.last_edit_by

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Std_OperLnk]
(
	@grp_id  int  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@cert_name nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@last_edit_at  datetime
)

AS

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Data_Log_Grp_Std_Oper_Link
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 11/07/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Included grp_desc column in the resultset.
-- 10/31/2007		AML				3.4.0		DB Changes
-- 01/18/2008	Raghu		3.4.0		L00074039; Linking a data log group oper step to a data entry schedule does not work.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  SELECT dlgsol.grp_id
       ,dlg.grp_desc
       ,dlgsol.oper_id
       ,dlgsol.cert_name
       ,des.key_id
       ,des.key_type
       ,des.category
       ,des.trigger_type
       ,des.trigger_period
       ,des.entries_reqd
       ,des.display_seq
       ,des.string_spare1
       ,des.string_spare2
       ,des.string_spare3
       ,des.string_spare4
       ,des.number_spare1
       ,des.number_spare2
       ,des.number_spare3
       ,des.number_spare4
       ,dlgsol.last_edit_comment
       ,dlgsol.last_edit_by
       ,dlgsol.last_edit_at
       ,des.last_edit_at AS data_entry_sched_last_edit_at
    FROM data_log_grp_std_oper_link dlgsol
    INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dlg.grp_id = dlgsol.grp_id
    INNER JOIN std_oper so ON dlgsol.oper_id = so.oper_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN data_entry_sched des ON des.key_id = so.row_id AND des.key_type = 2 AND des.category = 'Datalog Group' AND des.value_name = dlg.grp_desc
WHERE (
		(dlgsol.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
		(dlgsol.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(dlgsol.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL) AND
		(dlgsol.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(dlgsol.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)
	  )
ORDER BY dlg.grp_desc

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_PATINDEX]
(@string_expr		NVARCHAR(80)
,@search_string		NVARCHAR(80)
,@search_type		INT = 0
,@search_style		INT = 0
,@string_position	INT = 0 OUTPUT
) AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name       - FN_PATINDEX
-- Description    - Used for pattern searching alias LIKE search. eg.,'%AB_D%', '__EBC%D_QS%EB'
--                  Used for incrementing work orders, process version nos: HD# 2492, 4840
--                     string_expr: Any valid string expression. eg., 'ABCDEFGABCDEFABCDEF'
--                     search_string: This function recognizes only % and _ search patterns.
--                                    e.g., %ABC%, ___DEF%, %ABC_E%__EF%, __AB_D%
--                     search_type: 0 - (>0) indicates to find the first matching position from the search string (Default)
--                                  -1 - (<0) Returns the ending position of the first occurrence in a specified expression
--                                            i.e., indicates to find the last matching position before %
--                                            from the search string. eg., SP_PATINDEX('BBCDADA', '%B%A%', -1) = 5
--                                            which is the final matching position of the search string (from left).
--                     search_style: 0 indicates to find the search in order the search string is passed (Default)
--                                   -1 - (<0) indicates to search the string from the reverse order OR
--                                             indicates to find the last matching search string from the string expression
--                                             e.g.,if string_expr is SP_PATINDEX('ABCCD', '%C%', 0, -1), then the result is 4
--                                             The first matching position of the search string from the right side is returned
--                     Changed as per Oracle
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 07/21/2004
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
DECLARE	 @last_search_char_is_pct	INT
	,@temp_search_pos		INT
	,@temp_search_string		NVARCHAR(80)

	IF ISNULL(@search_type, 0) < 0 SET @search_type = -1
	ELSE SET  @search_type = 0

	IF ISNULL(@search_style, 0) < 0 SET @search_style = -1
	ELSE SET @search_style = 0

	IF (@search_style = -1) SELECT @string_expr = REVERSE(@string_expr), @search_string = REVERSE(@search_string)

	SET @string_position = 0

	EXEC SP_PATINDEX_SEARCH @string_expr, @search_string, NULL, NULL,
			@last_search_char_is_pct OUTPUT, @temp_search_pos OUTPUT,
			@temp_search_string OUTPUT, @string_position OUTPUT

	IF (@string_position > 0 AND @last_search_char_is_pct = 0) BEGIN
		IF SUBSTRING(@string_expr, 1, (LEN(@string_expr)-ISNULL(LEN(@temp_search_string), 0))+ 1) <> @temp_search_string BEGIN
			SET @string_position = 0
		END
	END

	IF (@string_position > 0) BEGIN
		IF (@search_type = -1 AND @search_style = 0) BEGIN
			IF @temp_search_pos < @string_position BEGIN
				SET @temp_search_pos = @string_position
			END
	        	SET @string_position = @temp_search_pos + ISNULL(LEN(@temp_search_string), 0) - 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@search_type = 0 AND @search_style = -1) BEGIN
			IF @temp_search_pos < @string_position BEGIN
				SET @temp_search_pos = @string_position
			END
			SET @temp_search_pos = @temp_search_pos + ISNULL(LEN(@temp_search_string), 0) - 1
--			SET @string_position = (LEN(@string_expr) - ISNULL(LEN(SUBSTRING(@string_expr, 1, (@temp_search_pos * -1))), 0)) + 1
			SET @string_position = (LEN(@string_expr) - ISNULL(LEN(RIGHT(@string_expr, @temp_search_pos)), 0)) + 1
		END
		ELSE IF  (@search_type = -1 AND @search_style = -1) BEGIN
			SET @string_position = LEN(@string_expr) - @string_position + 1
		END
	END

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job
-- Description:  Splits the Jobs for the given order
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-01-29			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_EI_PRO_Split_Job] @wo_id VARCHAR(100) AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @attr_id INT,@process_id VARCHAR(100),@oper_id VARCHAR(100),@qty_reqd FLOAT,@seq_no INT,
@error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@material_grp VARCHAR(100)

BEGIN TRY

	DECLARE @event_time_utc DATETIME,@event_time_local DATETIME,@created_by NVARCHAR(40)

	SET @event_time_utc = dbo.Fn_stripmillisecsfromdatetime(Getutcdate())
	SET @event_time_local =dbo.Fn_tz_getlocaldatefromutc(NULL, @event_time_utc)

	SELECT @created_by = attr_value FROM   system_attr sa WITH (nolock) WHERE  sa.attr_id = 199

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_wo_item_ext](					-- (KN 18/02/23 - Added logic to copy the bom_pos 0 item from job_bom to ofi_wo_item_ext as requested by AVEVA)
	[wo_id],[parent_item_id],[bom_pos],[item_id],[qty],[qty_per_parent_item],[backflush],[def_lot_no],
	[item_number],[item_desc],[uom_desc],[by_product],[co_product],[spare6],[created_at_utc],[created_at_local],
	[last_edit_at_utc],[last_edit_at_local],[created_by],[last_edit_by])
	SELECT 
	wo_id,NULL,bom_pos,item_id,qty_reqd,qty_per_parent_item,backflush,def_lot_no,
	NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,
	@event_time_utc,@event_time_local,@created_by,@created_by
	FROM job_bom with(nolock) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and bom_pos = 0

	DECLARE oper_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR Select oper_id, qty_reqd, seq_no from job WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id and seq_no = 0	--Get all jobs with operations and qty_reqd  for the work order

	Open oper_cur

	Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0								-- For each of that job (operation)
    BEGIN

		DECLARE @batch_size varchar(10),@new_seq_no int,@target_ent_id int,@split_cnt float
		SET @attr_id = -1
		select @attr_id =  attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'BatchSize'

		Select @material_grp = product_group from ofi_wo_ext WITH (NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id
		Select @process_id = process_id from process_attr with (nolock) where attr_value = @material_grp
		 
		IF EXISTS(select 1 from oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id)
		BEGIN

			Select @batch_size = attr_value from oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and attr_id = @attr_id			-- Get the batch size
			Select @target_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id from job WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = 0 and oper_id = @oper_id

			SET @split_cnt = (@qty_reqd / @batch_size)-1

				WHILE @split_cnt > 0
				BEGIN
					BEGIN TRANSACTION

					SELECT @new_seq_no = max(seq_no) from JOB WITH (NOLOCK) where oper_id = @oper_id and wo_id = @wo_id

					SET @new_seq_no = @new_seq_no + 1

					exec SP_I_JOB_EXEC_SPLITJOB @wo_id=@wo_id,@oper_id=@oper_id,@orig_seq_no=0,@user_id=NULL,@split_qty=@batch_size,
					@new_seq_no=@new_seq_no output,@split_start_qty=NULL,@new_state_cd=1,@req_finish_time=NULL,@req_finish_time_utc=NULL,@target_ent_id=@target_ent_id,
					@status_notes=NULL,@ignore_zero_start_qty_check=NULL,@time_zone_bias_value=60

					Update job set last_edit_comment = 'EI SPLIT JOB' WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND seq_no = @new_seq_no

					COMMIT TRANSACTION

					SET @split_cnt = @split_cnt - 1;
				END

		END

		Fetch next from oper_cur into @oper_id,@qty_reqd,@seq_no
	END

Close oper_cur
Deallocate oper_cur

END try

BEGIN catch
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();

    RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END catch


END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[job_util_log_link]
AS
SELECT ulog.log_id
	, jh.job_pos, jh.wo_id, jh.oper_id, jh.seq_no, jh.item_id, jh.job_start_utc, jh.job_start_local
	--Default the job_end_utc to the current date and time, if null, for duration calculation
	, DATEDIFF(SS, jh.job_start_utc, COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE())) AS duration
	, jh.job_start_utc AS job_start, jh.job_end_utc AS job_end
	, jh.spare1, jh.spare2, jh.spare3, jh.spare4
	, jh.last_edit_comment, jh.last_edit_by, jh.last_edit_at
	, jh.row_id, jh.ent_id, jh.job_end_utc, jh.job_end_local
FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
--Unlike the old job_util_log_link that is created for each utilization event, the job_history record could potentially span multiple util_history records.
--To avoid retrieving multiple redundant util history log_ids (since there is no relation between job_history and util_history), but to provide backward compatibility with the previous version,
--the first utilization event from the start of job will be returned as log_id.
OUTER APPLY (SELECT uh.log_id
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = jh.ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc =
		  (SELECT MAX(event_time_utc)
		   FROM util_history uh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		   WHERE uh1.ent_id = jh.ent_id
		     AND uh1.event_time_utc <= jh.job_start_utc)) ulog

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_So_Line_GetAllByFilter]
(@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@cust_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@po_id			NVARCHAR(40)
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_So_Line_GetAllByFilter
-- Description	      -	Returns a recordset of line items filtered by the users current filter settings
--			New BR reqd doc (Customer Window Business Rules.doc) from Rich B
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	08/20/2003
-- Version	      - 2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Version  Changes
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  	Version  Changes
--10/27/2003	  Raghu		2.0.0.6	Defaulted filter values to 0; (if not found from ui_config). Also, modified to execute with partial filter options, eg., Open, Complete
-- 2/03/2004      KRF		2.1.0	Changed po_line* to so_line*
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities; Prepend 'N' before concatenating each string.
-- 07/19/2017	RWB			Story 811323 - Parameterized the SQL call to prevent SQL injection
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE  @config_value	NVARCHAR(80)
	,@open_filter		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@partial_filter		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@complete_filter	NVARCHAR(1)
	,@start			INT
	,@end			INT
	,@sSQL		NVARCHAR(2000)
	,@temp_sSQL		NVARCHAR(2000)

	SELECT @config_value = valu FROM ui_config  WITH (NOLOCK)
	  WHERE UPPER(config_id) = UPPER(@user_id) AND UPPER(screen) = 'CUSTOMER'
	    AND UPPER(sectn) = 'CUSTOMERTREEVIEW' AND UPPER(parameter) = 'FILTERS'

	SET @open_filter = 0
	SET @partial_filter = 0
	SET @complete_filter = 0

	IF (@config_value IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
/*		SET @start = CHARINDEX('=', @config_value, 1)
		IF @start > 0 BEGIN
			SET @end = CHARINDEX(':', @config_value, @start + 1)
			SET @open_filter = SUBSTRING(@config_value, @start + 1, @end - 1)
			SET @start = @end + 1
		END
		SET @start = CHARINDEX('=', @config_value, @start)
		IF @start > 0 BEGIN
			SET @end = CHARINDEX(':', @config_value, @start)
			SET @partial_filter = SUBSTRING(@config_value, @start + 1, @end - 1)
			SET @start = @end + 1
		END
		SET @start = CHARINDEX('=', @config_value, @start)
		IF @start > 0 BEGIN
			SET @end = CHARINDEX(':', @config_value, @start)
			SET @complete_filter = SUBSTRING(@config_value, @start + 1, @end - 1)
			SET @start = @end + 1
		END*/
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Open=', ':', @open_filter OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Partial=', ':', @partial_filter OUTPUT
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @config_value, 'Complete=', ':', @complete_filter OUTPUT
	END

	SET @sSQL = 'SELECT sl.so_line_no, sl.item_id, i.item_desc FROM so_line sl, item i'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' WHERE sl.cust_id = @cust_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND sl.po_id = @po_id'
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND sl.item_id = i.item_id'

	SET @temp_sSQL = ''
	IF ((@open_filter = 1) OR (@partial_filter = 1) OR (@complete_filter = 1)) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' AND ('
		IF (@open_filter = 1) BEGIN
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM shipment_lot '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' WHERE cust_id = @cust_id and po_id = @po_id'
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' and so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)'
		END
		IF (@partial_filter = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@temp_sSQL <> '') SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' OR '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' quantity > (SELECT sum(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' WHERE cust_id = @cust_id and po_id =  @po_id'
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' and so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)'
		END
		IF (@complete_filter = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@temp_sSQL <> '') SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' OR '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' quantity <= (SELECT sum(qty_shipped) FROM shipment_lot '
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' WHERE cust_id = @cust_id and po_id = @po_id'
			SET @temp_sSQL = @temp_sSQL + ' and so_line_no = sl.so_line_no)'
		END
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @temp_sSQL + ') '
	END
	SET @sSQL = @sSQL + ' ORDER BY sl.so_line_no'
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL, N'@cust_id NVARCHAR(40), @po_id NVARCHAR(40)', @cust_id, @po_id
END

 SELECT sm.su_ent_id

		,	@def_sublot_no				STRING40 -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
		,	@def_reas_cd				INT32
		,	@def_storage_ent_id			INT32
		,	@def_scaling_factor			TFLOAT
		,	@attr_value					NVARCHAR(1)
		,	@last_edit_by				STRING40
		,	@last_edit_at				TDATETIME
		,	@shift_id					INT32
		,	@shift_start_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@shift_start_local			TDATETIME
        ,   @hour_start_utc             TDATETIME---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
        ,   @hour_start_local           TDATETIME ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
		,	@grade_cd					INT32
		,	@status_cd					INT32
		,	@good_prod					LOGICAL
		,	@util_event_time_utc		TDATETIME
		,	@util_event_time_local		TDATETIME
		,	@row_id						INT32
		,	@backflush					LOGICAL
		,	@update_inv					LOGICAL
		,	@must_consume_before_prod	LOGICAL
		,	@return						INT32
		,	@expiry_date				TDATETIME
		,	@cur_qty_prod				TFLOAT
		,	@cur_int_qty_prod			TFLOAT
		,	@good_prod_num_decimals		INT32
		,	@cur_uom_id         		INT32
		,	@current_time_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@current_time_local			TDATETIME
		,	@created_at_utc				TDATETIME
		,	@created_at_local			TDATETIME
		--,	@use_gmt					INT32 -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
		,	@total_qty_prod				TFLOAT	--Added 05/17/2007
		,	@event_time_utc				TDATETIME
		,	@tz_temp					INT32
		,	@cur_material_type			NVARCHAR(80) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_subsegment_id			NVARCHAR(80) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_comments				NVARCHAR(254) -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		,	@cur_created_at_utc			TDATETIME
		,	@job_start_utc				TDATETIME
		,       @last_edit_comment			STRING254 = 'JobExec.InsertPastProduction'

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value IS NOT NULL) SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value

	--Verify whether an event time is supplied
	IF (@event_time_local IS NULL) BEGIN
		--Event time is not supplied, therefore, default to the current utc time
		SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		--Determine the local time using the utc time
		SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
	END
	ELSE --an event time is supplied
		--Determine the utc time from the supplied local time
		SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE())

	--Determine whether the supplied event time is greater than the current time
	IF (@event_time_utc > GETUTCDATE()) BEGIN
		--Default to the current datetime
		SET @event_time_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		--Determine the local time using the utc time
		SET @event_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDateFromUtc(@ent_id, @event_time_utc)
	END

	SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id = wo_id, @oper_id = oper_id, @seq_no = seq_no
	FROM job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jh.ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND jh.job_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(job_start_utc) FROM job_history jh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE jh1.ent_id = @ent_id
					  AND jh1.job_start_utc <= @event_time_utc)
	  AND (jh.job_end_utc IS NULL OR jh.job_end_utc >= @event_time_utc)
	 ORDER BY jh.job_pos

	IF (@wo_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('There was no job running at this time{4260}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	SELECT @shift_start_utc = shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local = shift_start_local, @shift_id = shift_id
	FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND shift_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(shift_start_utc)
	  			FROM shift_history WITH (NOLOCK)
	  			WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
	  			  AND shift_start_utc <= @event_time_utc)

	SELECT	@bom_pos = bom_pos, @def_item_id = item_id, @def_lot_no = def_lot_no,
			@def_lot_no = def_lot_no, @def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd, -- Added "@def_lot_no = def_lot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			@def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id, @update_inv = update_inv, @backflush = backflush,
			@must_consume_before_prod = must_consume_before_prod, @def_scaling_factor = scaling_factor
	FROM job_bom WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0

	IF (@reas_cd IS NULL) SET @reas_cd = @def_reas_cd
	IF (@lot_no IS NULL) SET @lot_no = @def_lot_no
	IF (@sublot_no IS NULL) SET @sublot_no = @def_sublot_no -- Added 1/10/2007 KRF
	IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) SET @to_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id
	IF (@item_id IS NULL) SET @item_id = @def_item_id
	IF (@processed IS NULL) SET @processed = 0
	IF (@byproduct IS NULL) SET @byproduct = 0
	IF (@move_status IS NULL) SET @move_status = 0
	IF (@scaling_factor IS NULL) SET @scaling_factor = 0
	IF (@scaling_factor  = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@def_scaling_factor IS NULL OR @def_scaling_factor = 0) SET @def_scaling_factor = 1
		SET @qty_prod = @qty_prod * @def_scaling_factor
	END

	IF @must_consume_before_prod = 1  BEGIN
		EXECUTE @return = sp_S_Check_Max_Min_Qty_Allowed @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, /*@lot_no,*/ @item_id, @qty_prod -- Commented out @lot_no 1/10/07 KRF
		IF @return <> 0 RETURN
	END

	IF @reas_cd IS NULL SELECT @reas_cd = def_prod_reas_cd FROM job_exec WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = 0
	IF (@reas_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Default Production Code is not defined{3288}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd, @status_cd = item_status_cd
	FROM item_reas WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd
	IF (@grade_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('Reason Code is not defined in the database{3278}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	SELECT @good_prod = good_prod FROM item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_grade_cd = @grade_cd

	--Added 05/17/2007 AML
	--Verify whether we can identify a valid storage entity
	IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The storage entity is not identified here.
		--Verify whether we can default the storage entity from job_exec.
		IF (@good_prod = 1) BEGIN
			--Since this is a good production; retrieve the default storage entity that is configured for the good production.
			SELECT DISTINCT @to_ent_id = ISNULL( to_ent_id, 0 ) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--Since this is a reject; retrieve the default storage entity that is configured for the rejects.
			SELECT DISTINCT @to_ent_id = ISNULL( def_reject_ent_id, 0 ) FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
		END
	END
	--END AML

	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 309

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	SELECT @hour_start_local = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_time_local),0)
		, @hour_start_utc = DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, @event_time_utc),0)

	SELECT @created_at_local = @event_time_local, @created_at_utc = @event_time_utc

	-- Added "@sublot_no" 1/10/07 KRF
	EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis	@item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @to_ent_id, @qty_prod OUTPUT,
										@cur_int_qty_prod OUTPUT, @good_prod_num_decimals OUTPUT

	SELECT @cur_int_qty_prod = ISNULL(@cur_int_qty_prod, 0), @good_prod_num_decimals = ISNULL(@good_prod_num_decimals, 0)

	SET @row_id = NULL

	IF EXISTS (
		SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
			AND hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc
			AND item_id = @item_id
			AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
			AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
			AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
			AND (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_id IS NULL))
			AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
			AND (event_id = @event_id OR (event_id IS NULL AND @event_id IS NULL))
			AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
			AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
			AND (NOT (@attr_value = '1' AND @good_prod = 0 AND @qty_prod > 0))
	)
	BEGIN

		SELECT @row_id = row_id, @cur_qty_prod = qty_prod FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
		  AND hour_start_utc = @hour_start_utc
		  AND item_id = @item_id
		  AND (lot_no = @lot_no OR (lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
		  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL)) -- Added 1/10/07 KRF
		  AND reas_cd = @reas_cd AND user_id = @user_id
		  AND (to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR (to_ent_id IS NULL AND @to_ent_id IS NULL))
		AND (genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
		AND (event_id = @event_id OR (event_id IS NULL AND @event_id IS NULL))
		AND (segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
		AND (segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL))
	END

	-- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
		IF (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ')
	BEGIN
		SET @cur_comments = @comments
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @cur_comments = NULL
	END

	IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL)  BEGIN
		UPDATE item_prod
			SET qty_prod = qty_prod + @qty_prod
			,comments = CASE WHEN (@comments IS NULL OR @comments != ' ') THEN @comments ELSE comments END
			,spare1 = CASE WHEN (@spare1 IS NULL OR @spare1 != ' ') THEN @spare1 ELSE spare1 END
			,spare2 = CASE WHEN (@spare2 IS NULL OR @spare2 != ' ') THEN @spare2 ELSE spare2 END
			,spare3 = CASE WHEN (@spare3 IS NULL OR @spare3 != ' ') THEN @spare3 ELSE spare3 END
			,spare4 = CASE WHEN (@spare4 IS NULL OR @spare4 != ' ') THEN @spare4 ELSE spare4 END
		WHERE row_id = @row_id

		--Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
		SELECT @total_qty_prod = (@cur_qty_prod + @qty_prod)

/*		IF (@cur_qty_prod + @qty_prod = 0) BEGIN
			DELETE FROM item_prod WHERE row_id = @row_id
			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Prod%'
		END*/
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		INSERT INTO item_prod
		(
			-- Added "sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,hour_start_utc,hour_start_local, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, reas_cd, user_id,
			ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd, status_cd, to_ent_id, good_prod, qty_prod, qty_prod_erp, processed_flag,
			byproduct, ext_ref, move_status, genealogy_id, event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
			comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc,
			created_at_local
		)
		VALUES
		(
			-- Added "@sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local,@hour_start_utc,@hour_start_local, @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @reas_cd, @user_id, @ent_id,
			@shift_id, @grade_cd, @status_cd, @to_ent_id, @good_prod, @qty_prod, 0, @processed, @byproduct, @ext_ref, @move_status,
			@genealogy_id, @event_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @cur_comments,
			@spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc, @created_at_local
		)
		SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		--Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
		SELECT @total_qty_prod = @qty_prod
	END

	IF @byproduct = 0 EXECUTE sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
	SET @cur_created_at_utc = COALESCE(@cur_created_at_utc, @created_at_utc)
	EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @event_time_utc=@created_at_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment

	EXEC sp_U_Assigned_Lot_UpdateStatus @item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @total_qty_prod

	-- Added "sublot_no," and "@sublot_no," in statement below 1/10/07 KRF
	INSERT INTO job_event
	(
		event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, event_type, ent_id, bom_pos, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id,
		done_by_user_id, source_row_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id, value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6, value7, value8, value9, value10,
		last_edit_by, last_edit_at
	)
	VALUES
	(
		@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, 'AddProd', @ent_id, @bom_pos, @lot_no, @sublot_no,
		@item_id, @user_id, @row_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @value1, @value2, @value3, @value4, @value5, @value6, @value7, @value8, @value9, @value10,
		@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	)

	IF NOT (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod = 0) BEGIN
		IF (@good_prod_num_decimals > 0 AND @cur_int_qty_prod != 0) SET @cur_qty_prod = @cur_int_qty_prod
		ELSE SET @cur_qty_prod = @qty_prod

		IF @update_inv = 1 BEGIN
--			IF NOT @to_ent_id IS NULL BEGIN
			SET @expiry_date = Null

			SET @cur_uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item WHERE item_id = @item_id)

			--Supply NULL for date_in, let Inventory Add method determines the date_in time depending on the time_bias
			EXECUTE @return = SP_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@to_ent_id, @item_id=@item_id, @lot_no=@lot_no, @sublot_no=@sublot_no, @grade_cd=@grade_cd
				, @status_cd=@status_cd, @add_qty=@cur_qty_prod, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=NULL, @expiry_date=@expiry_date
				, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @from_ent_id=NULL, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id
				, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL
				, @goods_received=0, @checkgradestatus=0, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
				, @date_in_utc=NULL, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=NULL
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN
--			END
		END
        ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
		IF @byproduct = 0 BEGIN
			EXECUTE @return = sp_I_Item_Cons_BackFlshPstExec	NULL, @user_id, @ent_id, @cur_qty_prod, @wo_id,
																@oper_id, @seq_no, @shift_start_local,@hour_start_local,@shift_id,
																@lot_no, @sublot_no, @time_zone_bias_value -- Added "@sublot_no," 1/10/07 KRF
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN
		END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_JE_CertSignOffAllowed]
(@wo_id		STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@seq_no	INT32
,@step_no	INT32
,@grp_id	INT32
,@process_id 	STRING40
,@cert_name 	STRING40 = NULL
,@user_id	STRING40
,@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author                   -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--10/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--02/07/2006	Raghu		3.1.9	HD# 6871, Added certification name to error message.
--09/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.23	HD# 6871, Added certification name to the first error string.
--01/24/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	Part of DB Changes; renamed from sp_CertSignOffAllowed
--04/20/2007    Raghu       	3.2.9   HD# 9622, 9640, 9741, Handle single quotes.
--01/25/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074265; Error trying to Authorize a certification
--02/13/2008	RWB			3.4		CR L00075045 removed setting @cert_name to null and changed check to @reqd_cert_name instead of @cert_name
--05/07/2014	Ibrahim		5.0		User Story# 316395: As Invensys, I want to merge L00130974 (HF CR L00129625 certs and standard operations).
--12/07/2017	Varun		6.0		Merge CR L00147330 (HF L00146188): Reverted HF L00129625 merge and added unions to cert_job_link and cert_job_step_link.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
DECLARE  @user_cert_level	INT32
	,@user_cert_name	STRING80
	,@user_cert_expiry	TDATETIME
	,@err_desc		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@currenttime		TDATETIME
	,@reqd_cert_name	STRING80
	,@reqd_cert_level	INT32
	,@reqd_cert_duration	INT32
	,@cert_audit		INT32

	--Verify whether the supplied certificate is a valid certificate.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM cert_type WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE cert_name = @cert_name) BEGIN
		--The supplied certificate does not exists in the database. raise an exception.
		SET @err_desc = 'The supplied %1 does not exist.{4261},' + 'certificate:' + dbo.fn_REPLACEQUOTES(@cert_name)
		RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
        	RETURN
	END

	--Determine whether this sign off is for a job, job_step or for a data_log_n record.
	IF (@process_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL AND @grp_id IS NULL) RETURN

	SET @currenttime = DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, GETUTCDATE())

	--Verify whether the certification sign off is for a job, job_step or for a data_log_n record.
	IF (@grp_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		--The sign off is for a job or for a job step.
		IF (@process_id IS NULL OR @oper_id IS NULL) RETURN

		IF (@step_no IS NULL) BEGIN
			--The sign off is for a job
			DECLARE job_certification_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT ct.cert_name, col.cert_level AS reqd_cert_level,  ct.cert_audit
			FROM cert_oper_link col WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON col.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			WHERE col.process_id = @process_id
			  AND col.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND (col.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
			UNION
			SELECT ct.cert_name, cjl.cert_level AS reqd_cert_level,  ct.cert_audit
			FROM cert_job_link cjl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cjl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			WHERE cjl.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND cjl.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND (cjl.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)

			OPEN job_certification_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM job_certification_cursor INTO @cert_name, @reqd_cert_level, @cert_audit
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				IF (@cert_audit = 1) BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
						FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK)
			                        INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			                        WHERE cul.cert_name = @cert_name
			                          AND user_id = @user_id) BEGIN
						SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				        	RETURN
					END

					SELECT @user_cert_level = cul.cert_level, @user_cert_expiry = cul.expiry, @user_cert_name = ct.cert_name
					FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = ct.cert_name
					WHERE cul.cert_name = @cert_name
					  AND user_id = @user_id

					IF (@user_cert_level < @reqd_cert_level) BEGIN
						SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				        	RETURN
					END

					IF (@user_cert_expiry < @currenttime) BEGIN
						SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				        	RETURN
					END
				END
			END
			CLOSE job_certification_cursor
			DEALLOCATE job_certification_cursor
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			DECLARE job_step_certification_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT ct.cert_name, cosl.cert_level AS reqd_cert_level,  ct.cert_audit
			FROM cert_oper_step_link cosl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cosl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			WHERE cosl.process_id = @process_id
			  AND cosl.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND cosl.step_no = @step_no
			  AND (cosl.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
			UNION
			SELECT ct.cert_name, cjsl.cert_level AS reqd_cert_level,  ct.cert_audit
			FROM cert_job_step_link cjsl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cjsl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			WHERE cjsl.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND cjsl.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND cjsl.step_no = @step_no
			  AND (cjsl.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)

			OPEN job_step_certification_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM job_step_certification_cursor INTO @cert_name, @reqd_cert_level, @cert_audit
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

				IF (@cert_audit = 1) BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
						FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK)
			                        INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			                        WHERE cul.cert_name = @cert_name
			                          AND user_id = @user_id) BEGIN
						SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' + @user_id + ',' + @cert_name
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				        	RETURN
					END

					SELECT @user_cert_level = cul.cert_level, @user_cert_expiry = cul.expiry, @user_cert_name = ct.cert_name
					FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = ct.cert_name
					WHERE cul.cert_name = @cert_name
					  AND user_id = @user_id

					IF (@user_cert_level < @reqd_cert_level) BEGIN
						SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				        	RETURN
					END

					IF (@user_cert_expiry < @currenttime) BEGIN
						SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate (%2) has expired.{3329},' +  @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
				        	RETURN
					END
				END
			END
			CLOSE job_step_certification_cursor
			DEALLOCATE job_step_certification_cursor
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The sign off is for a data_log_n record.
		IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @oper_id IS NULL OR @seq_no IS NULL) RETURN
		-- SET @cert_name = NULL

		IF (COALESCE(@step_no, -1) = -1)
			SELECT @reqd_cert_name = ct.cert_name, @reqd_cert_level =  /*dlgjl.cert_level*/ -1 ,
				@cert_audit = ct.cert_audit
			FROM data_log_grp_job_link dlgjl WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON dlgjl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
			WHERE dlgjl.grp_id = @grp_id
			  AND dlgjl.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND dlgjl.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND dlgjl.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND (dlgjl.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)
		ELSE
			SELECT @reqd_cert_name = ct.cert_name, @reqd_cert_level = /*dlgjl.cert_level*/ -1,
				@cert_audit = ct.cert_audit
			FROM data_log_grp_job_step_link dlgjsl WITH (NOLOCK)

			WHERE dlgjsl.grp_id = @grp_id
			  AND dlgjsl.wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND dlgjsl.oper_id = @oper_id
			  AND dlgjsl.seq_no = @seq_no
			  AND dlgjsl.step_no = @step_no
			  AND (dlgjsl.cert_name = @cert_name OR @cert_name IS NULL)

		IF (@reqd_cert_name IS NULL) BEGIN
			IF (COALESCE(@step_no, -1) = -1)
				SET @err_desc = 'The supplied data log grp for a job does not have the supplied certificate attached to it.{5727}'
			ELSE
				SET @err_desc = 'The supplied data log grp for a job step does not have the supplied certificate attached to it.{5728}'

			RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END

		IF (@cert_audit = 0) RETURN

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
				FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = ct.cert_name
				WHERE cul.cert_name = @reqd_cert_name
				AND user_id = @user_id) BEGIN
			SET @err_desc = '%1 does not have a %2 certificate.{3327},' +  @user_id + ',' + @reqd_cert_name
			RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @user_cert_level = cul.cert_level, @user_cert_expiry = cul.expiry, @user_cert_name = ct.cert_name
		FROM cert_user_link cul WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN cert_type ct WITH (NOLOCK) ON cul.cert_name = ct.cert_name
		WHERE cul.cert_name = @reqd_cert_name

		IF (@user_cert_level < @reqd_cert_level) BEGIN
			SET @err_desc = '%1 certificate level (%2) is lesser than the required Certificate Level (%3).{3328},' + @user_id + ',' + @user_cert_name + ',' + @cert_name
			RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1, @@error)
	        	RETURN
		END

		IF (@user_cert_expiry < @currenttime) BEGIN

		END
	END

/*

-- Name:     	sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_GetValidJobPos
-- Description:	The stored procedure finds the current or an empty job position based on input
--	
-- Usage:		StartJob_ofi / UpdateJob_ofi WFs
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC				2025-08-15			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	JSC				2025-09-17			Changed sorting so to get the smallest first
-- 0.01.02	JSC				2025-09-24			Updated the logic that could fail in specific cases
-- 0.01.04	JSC				2025-09-25			fixed
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *******************************************************************************************

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_GetValidJobPos]
(@ent_id	INT
,@cur_wo_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@cur_oper_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
,@cur_seq_no INT = 0
,@job_pos	INT OUTPUT
) AS

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

	
	SELECT TOP 1 @job_pos = je.job_pos
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
		AND  je.cur_wo_id = @cur_wo_id 
		AND je.cur_oper_id = @cur_oper_id
		AND je.cur_seq_no = @cur_seq_no 
	ORDER BY je.job_pos asc

	IF @job_pos IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @job_pos = je.job_pos
		FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id
			AND  je.cur_wo_id  IS NULL 
			AND je.cur_oper_id IS NULL
		ORDER BY je.job_pos asc
	END

	SET @job_pos = ISNULL(@job_pos, -1);

	SELECT @job_pos job_pos
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetCurrentKPIs]
(@ent_id			INT32
,@job_ent_id			INT32
,@util_ent_id			INT32
,@basis				INT32
,@availability			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@quality			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@performance			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@oee				TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetCurrentKPIs
-- Description       - Calculates the KPI for the current shift/job based on the basis.
--			UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
-- Author           - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 10/20/2016
-- Version (last edit)   -  5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @qty_good	TFLOAT
	,@qty_reject	TFLOAT
	,@perf_by_rate	TFLOAT
	,@runtime	TFLOAT
	,@total_qtys	TFLOAT

BEGIN

	IF (@basis = 0) -- Calculate OEE by shift
		EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetValue @in_session_id=-1, @in_ent_id=@ent_id, @in_kpi_type=0
			, @in_filter_time_unit=1, @in_filter_start_time=1, @in_filter_end_time=0
			, @kpi_value=@oee OUTPUT, @availability=@availability OUTPUT, @quality=@quality OUTPUT, @performance=@performance OUTPUT

	ELSE BEGIN -- Calculate OEE by job
		--Determine the total production good, rejects and the performance by rate
		SELECT @qty_good = SUM(ts.qty_good), @qty_reject = SUM(ts.qty_reject)
		, @perf_by_rate = SUM(CASE WHEN ts.batch_size = 0 THEN 0
					ELSE CEILING((ts.qty_good + ts.qty_reject)/ ts.batch_size) * ts.std_prod_rate
					END)
		, @runtime = SUM(ts.runtime/3600.00)
		FROM tpm_stat ts WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON ts.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND ts.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND ts.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND ts.seq_no = jh.seq_no AND ts.job_start_utc = jh.job_start_utc
		INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND je.cur_wo_id = jh.wo_id AND je.cur_oper_id = jh.oper_id AND je.cur_seq_no = jh.seq_no
		WHERE ts.ent_id = @job_ent_id
		  AND jh.job_end_utc IS NULL -- Only include the running jobs on the entity

		--Determine the total good and reject quantities
		SET  @total_qtys = @qty_good + @qty_reject

		--Calculate the quality
		IF @total_qtys = 0 SET @quality = 1 --Avoid divide by zero error if the sum of good + reject is 0.
		ELSE SET @quality = @qty_good / @total_qtys

		--Calculate the performance
		IF @runtime = 0 SET @performance = 1
		ELSE SET @performance = @perf_by_rate / @runtime

		--Determine the current utilization for the utilization entity
		EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetValue @in_session_id=-1, @in_ent_id=@util_ent_id, @in_kpi_type=2
			, @in_filter_time_unit=1, @in_filter_start_time=1, @in_filter_end_time=0
			, @availability=@availability OUTPUT

		SET @oee = @availability * @quality * @performance
	END
END

--- ***************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_spec_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on spec table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/08/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--

--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 01/24/2012     Rupak		4.2     Modified for CR111351
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------
--- ***************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40),
			 @msg NVARCHAR(200),
			 @old_type INT32,
			 @new_type INT32,
			 @specid NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	SELECT @old_type = d.data_type FROM deleted d INNER JOIN spec s ON s.spec_id = d.spec_id
	SELECT @new_type = i.data_type FROM inserted i INNER JOIN spec s ON s.spec_id = i.spec_id
	SELECT @specid = i.spec_id FROM inserted i

	IF((@new_type = 1) AND (@old_type <> @new_type))
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
			(SELECT ISNUMERIC(spec_value) x FROM oper_ent_spec ops INNER join inserted i ON i.spec_id = ops.spec_id
					UNION ALL SELECT ISNUMERIC(spec_value) x FROM bom_item_oper_spec bios INNER JOIN inserted i ON i.spec_id = bios.spec_id
					UNION ALL SELECT ISNUMERIC(spec_value) x FROM job_spec js INNER JOIN inserted i ON i.spec_id = js.spec_id) Y WHERE x = 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @msg = 'Spec {1461}' + @specid + ' value that cannot be converted from a string to a float.{7486}'
					RAISERROR (@msg, 16, 1, @specid)
				END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
					UPDATE spec SET spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, spec.last_edit_at =
						dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
					FROM inserted i
					WHERE spec.spec_id = i.spec_id
			END
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE spec SET spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, spec.last_edit_at =
				dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
			FROM inserted i

		(

		 @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@oper_id	NVARCHAR(40)

--SELECT @wo_id=N'1444413333',@oper_id=N'BreakingWinnowing',@seq_no=1,@bom_pos=NULL

BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

declare  @jobBom  as  table (
wo_id				[dbo].[STRING40]	NOT	NULL,
oper_id				[dbo].[STRING40]	NOT	NULL,
seq_no				[dbo].[INT32]	NOT	NULL,
bom_pos				[dbo].[INT32]	NOT	NULL,
job_bom_subst_exist		[dbo].[INT32]	NULL,
current_subst		[dbo].[INT32_NULL]	NULL,	
pref				[dbo].[INT32]  NULL,		
subst_level			[dbo].[INT32]  NULL,
item_id				[dbo].[STRING40]	NOT	NULL,
item_desc			[dbo].[STRING80]	NOT	NULL,
item_display		[dbo].[STRING1700_NULL]	NULL,		
uom_id				[dbo].[INT32]	NOT	NULL,
description			[dbo].[STRING40]	NULL,	
abbreviation		[dbo].[STRING40]	NULL,		
lifetime			[dbo].[INT32_NULL]	NULL,	
reqd_grade_cd		[dbo].[INT32_NULL]	NULL,	
item_grade_desc		[dbo].[STRING80]	NULL,
color				[dbo].[INT32_NULL]	NULL,	
instruction			[dbo].[STRING1700_NULL]	NULL,	
qty_per_parent_item	[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,
max_qty_per_parent_item	[dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]	NULL,	
min_qty_per_parent_item	[dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]	NULL,	
reqd_start_val		[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,
reqd_start_val_is_pct	[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
qty_prod			[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
qty_rejected		[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
update_inv			[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
backflush			[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
def_reas_cd			[dbo].[INT32_NULL]	NULL,	
reas_desc			[dbo].[STRING80]	NULL,
def_lot_no			[dbo].[STRING40_NULL]	NULL,	
def_sublot_no		[dbo].[STRING40_NULL]	NULL,	
def_storage_ent_id	[dbo].[INT32_NULL]	NULL,	
ent_name			[dbo].[STRING80]	NULL,	
scaling_factor		[dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]	NULL,	
must_consume_from_inv	[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
may_choose_alt_inv_loc	[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
may_create_new_lots		[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
must_consume_from_wip	[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
must_consume_before_prod	[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
consumed_so_far			[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
constant_qty		[dbo].[LOGICAL]		NULL,
est_time			[dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]	NULL,	
spare1				[dbo].[STRING1000_NULL]	NULL,	
spare2				[dbo].[STRING1000_NULL]	NULL,	
spare3				[dbo].[STRING1000_NULL]	NULL,	
spare4				[dbo].[STRING1000_NULL]	NULL,	
qty_reqd			[dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL]	NULL,	
qty_at_start		[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,			
num_decimals		[dbo].[INT32]		NULL,
item_spare1			[dbo].[STRING80_NULL]	NULL,	
item_spare2			[dbo].[STRING80_NULL]	NULL,	
item_spare3			[dbo].[STRING80_NULL]	NULL,	
item_spare4			[dbo].[STRING80_NULL]	NULL,	
last_edit_comment	[dbo].[STRING254_NULL]	NULL,	
last_edit_by		[dbo].[STRING40_NULL]	NULL,	
last_edit_at		[dbo].[TDATETIME]		NULL,
qty_used_in_steps	[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,		
mod_id				[dbo].[STRING1000_NULL]	NULL,
actual_qty			[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
actual_min_qty		[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
actual_max_qty		[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
qty_good_at_bom_pos	[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL,	
qty_rejected_at_bom_pos		[dbo].[TFLOAT]		NULL
)

 insert into @jobBom
   exec SP_SA_JOB_BOM_GETJOBBOMDATA @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,@bom_pos=NULL

  -- select * from @jobBom

   insert into @jobBom
   select 
		
			max(ic.wo_id) as wo_id,
			max(ic.oper_id) as oper_id,
			max(ic.seq_no) as seq_no,
			--ROW_NUMBER() over (row_id)  as bom_pos,
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ic.item_id DESC)+100 AS bom_pos, 
			0 as job_bom_subst_exist,
			NULL as current_subst,
			NULL as pref,
			NULL as subst_level,
			ic.item_id as item_id,
			max(item.item_desc) as item_desc,
			--NULL as item_display,
			max(concat(ic.item_id,'(',item.item_desc,')')) as item_display,
			max(item.uom_id) as uom_id,
			max(uom.description) as description,
			max(uom.abbreviation) as abbreviation,
			max(item.lifetime) as lifetime,
			max(ic.grade_cd) as reqd_grade_cd,
			max(ig.item_grade_desc) as item_grade_desc,
			max(ig.color) as color,
			NULL as instruction,
			0 as qty_per_parent_item,
			0 as max_qty_per_parent_item,
			0 as min_qty_per_parent_item,
			0 as reqd_start_val,
			0 as reqd_start_val_is_pct,
			max(job.qty_prod) as qty_prod,
			max(job.qty_rejected) as qty_rejected,
			NULL as update_inv,
			NULL as backflush,
			NULL as def_reas_cd,
			NULL as reas_desc,
			NULL as def_lot_no,
			NULL as def_sublot_no,
			NULL as def_storage_ent_id,
			NULL as ent_name,
			NULL as scaling_factor,
			NULL as must_consume_from_inv,
			NULL as may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
			NULL as may_create_new_lots,
			NULL as must_consume_from_wip,
			NULL as must_consume_before_prod,
			sum(ic.qty_cons) as consumed_so_far,
			NULL as constant_qty,
			NULL as est_time,
			NULL as spare1,
			NULL as spare2,
			NULL as spare3,
			NULL as spare4,
			max(job.qty_reqd) as qty_reqd,
			NULL as qty_at_start,
			max(item.num_decimals) as num_decimals,
			max(item.spare1) as item_spare1,
			max(item.spare2) as item_spare2,
			max(item.spare3) as item_spare3,
			max(item.spare4) as item_spare4,
			NULL as last_edit_comment,
			max(ic.last_edit_by) as last_edit_by,
			max(ic.last_edit_at) as last_edit_at,
			NULL as qty_used_in_steps,
			NULL as mod_id,
			--sum(ic.qty_cons) as actual_qty,
			NULL as actual_qty,
			NULL as actual_min_qty,
			NULL as actual_max_qty,
			NULL as qty_good_at_bom_pos,
			NULL as qty_rejected_at_bom_pos

		from item_cons ic with(nolock) inner join item on ic.item_id = item.item_id 
		inner join job on job.wo_id = ic.wo_id and ic.oper_id = job.oper_id and ic.seq_no = job.seq_no
		inner join uom on item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		inner join item_grade ig on ig.item_grade_cd = ic.grade_cd
		inner join ent on ent.ent_id = ic.ent_id
		where ic.wo_id = @wo_id and ic.oper_id = @oper_id and ic.seq_no = @seq_no
		and not exists (select 1 from job_bom jb with(nolock) where jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and jb.item_id=ic.item_id and bom_pos>0  )
		group by ic.item_id 


		select jb.*,uom.abbreviation job_qty_uom from @jobBom jb
		inner join job  with(nolock) on jb.wo_id = job.wo_id and jb.oper_id = job.oper_id and jb.seq_no = job.seq_no
		left join item with(nolock) on job.item_id = item.item_id 
		left join uom with(nolock) on item.uom_id = uom.uom_id
		where bom_pos>0

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_nested_hu
-- Description:  Returns all nested HUs for the given main HU
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-10-07		   Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	KN			2023-05-01			Changed MainHU from Spare3 to Spare2 and SubHU from Spare2 to Spare3.
-- 0.03.00	AML, XPM	2026-06-16			Updated to check spare2<>spare3
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE   PROCEDURE[dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_nested_hu] as
begin
Declare @main_pallet varchar(100),@plant varchar(40),@NestedHU varchar(40)
Declare @pallet_table table(main_pallet varchar(1000),sub_pallet varchar(1000))
DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT
DECLARE @cols AS NVARCHAR(MAX),@colHeads as varchar(MAX),@query  AS NVARCHAR(MAX)

SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN TRY

SET @main_pallet = NULL

--Spare2 is MainHU, Spare3 is Sub HU / Nested HU and Spare4 is flag

Select top 1 @main_pallet = ip.spare2 from item_prod ip 
where ip.spare4 = '1' and ip.good_prod <> 1
and not exists (Select 1 from item_prod ip2 where ip2.spare2 = @main_pallet and ip2.qty_prod <> ip2.qty_prod_erp)	
and ip.spare2 <> ip.spare3
order by ip.last_edit_at desc

IF EXISTS (Select 1 from item_prod where spare2 = @main_pallet and qty_prod <> qty_prod_erp)
	SET @main_pallet = NULL

IF Len(isnull(@main_pallet,'')) > 2
Begin
Select @plant = [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode_2]()

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS [#tmp] 
	


Create table #tmp(main_pallet varchar(1000),sub_pallet varchar(1000))
insert  INTO #tmp  Select spare2,spare3 from item_prod with(nolock) where spare2 = @main_pallet

IF exists (SELECT * from #tmp)
BEGIN

BEGIN TRANSACTION

select @cols = STUFF((SELECT ',' + QUOTENAME(sub_pallet) 
                    from #tmp
                    group by sub_pallet
                    order by sub_pallet
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
            ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') 
        ,1,1,'')

select @colHeads = REPLACE(@cols,']','] HU')

set @query = N'SELECT ''' + @main_pallet + '''  HandlingUnitNumber,' + @plant + ' Plant, '''' Document_Number,'''' Message,'''' Message,' 
			+ @colHeads + N'  from 
             (
                select sub_pallet as HU
                from #tmp
            ) x
            pivot 
            (
                max(HU)
                for HU in (' + @cols + N')
            ) p'
print @query
exec sp_executesql @query;

Update item_prod set spare4 = '2', comments = Null --spare4 = '1' --(KN 11Apr23 Changed update condition to spare4=2 based on discussion with with Ajay and Siva)
where spare2 = @main_pallet  and spare4 = '1' and qty_prod = qty_prod_erp -- and spare3 is not null 
COMMIT TRANSACTION
END


End
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END CATCH
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Line_Attr]
  (@line_id int = NULL,
   @line_name NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
   @attr_id int = NULL,
   @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
   )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_S_Line_Attr
-- Description	      - Select a single existing row identified by the primary key.
-- Author	          - Srinivasa Tentu
-- Date Created	      -	10/07/2013
-- Version	          - 4.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 01/18/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 03/09/2018	  Srinivasa     6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 03/23/2018	  Surya			6.0     US#987370 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on line and shift name instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value. (API changes).
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 12

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

   IF (@line_id IS NULL AND @line_name IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @line_id = line.line_id FROM line line WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE line.line_name= @line_name

	IF (@line_id IS NULL)
		SET @line_id = -1
  END

SELECT     line_attr.line_id
          ,line_attr.attr_id
          ,line_attr.attr_value
          ,line_attr.notes
          ,line_attr.last_edit_comment
          ,line_attr.last_edit_by
          ,line_attr.last_edit_at
  FROM line_attr line_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (line_attr.line_id = @line_id AND
       line_attr.attr_id = @attr_id)
END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour				Date (yyyy-MM-dd)		Change Description
-- 00.01			PG					2024-04-12				Initial draft
-- 01.00			JSC					2025-09-29				Cakeblender fix added capability to filter also on frequency and item
