CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_EI_disablesampleplan] (
	@SamplePlanID NVARCHAR(40)
	,@ProductID NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@Level NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
	,@Stage NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
	,@Customer NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@SourceLabel NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
	,@LocationLabel NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
	,@Count INT = 1
	,@samplePlanType INT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
	DECLARE @cur_date DATETIME = GETDATE();
	DECLARE @cur_date_utc DATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE());
 
	DECLARE @spare1 STRING80_NULL = @SamplePlanID;
	DECLARE @spare2 STRING80_NULL = @Level + '|' + @Stage;-- combination of level and stage
	DECLARE @spare3 STRING80_NULL = ISNULL(@Customer, '') + '|' + @SourceLabel + '|' + ISNULL(@ProductID, '') ;-- combination of customer, frequency and product
	--v01.00 added
	IF (@samplePlanType = 0)
	BEGIN
		
		SET @spare2 = @spare2 + '|' + CONVERT(nvarchar, @Count) ;

		UPDATE q
		SET q.end_eff_local = @cur_date,
			q.end_eff_utc = @cur_date_utc
		FROM qm_spec q
		INNER JOIN sample_plan p ON q.plan_id = p.plan_id
		WHERE p.plan_name LIKE @SamplePlanID + '%'
			AND p.spare1 = @SamplePlanID
			AND p.spare2 = @spare2
			AND p.spare3 = @spare3	
			AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL;
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT @spare3 = ISNULL(@Customer, '') + '|' + @SourceLabel + '|' + ISNULL(@LocationLabel, '')

		UPDATE q
		SET q.end_eff_local = @cur_date,
			q.end_eff_utc = @cur_date_utc
		FROM qm_spec q
		INNER JOIN sample_plan p ON q.plan_id = p.plan_id
		WHERE p.spare1 = @SamplePlanID
			AND p.spare3 = @spare3	
			AND q.end_eff_local IS NULL;
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Data_Log_Value]
(
	@grp_id  int  ,
	@value_index  int  ,
	@value_name  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@value_type  int  ,
	@editable  bit  ,
	@cur_value  nvarchar(80)  ,
	@spec_id nvarchar(40),
	@meaning int,
	@meaning_to_value_index int,
	@spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
	@spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
	@spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
	@spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime ,
	@mod_id  varchar(30)
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name					- sp_SA_Data_Log_Value
-- Description					-
-- Author						-
-- Date Created					-
-- Version						-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 09/10/2002		Raghu			1.4		Get data log values only from a non-obsolete data log group
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT	data_log_value.grp_id
	,	data_log_value.value_index
	,	data_log_value.value_name
	,	data_log_value.value_type
	,	data_log_value.editable
	,	data_log_value.cur_value
	,	data_log_value.spec_id
	,	data_log_value.meaning
	,	data_log_value.meaning_to_value_index
	,	data_log_value.spare1
	,	data_log_value.spare2
	,	data_log_value.spare3
	,	data_log_value.spare4
	,	data_log_value.last_edit_comment
	,	data_log_value.last_edit_by
	,	data_log_value.last_edit_at
	,	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, data_log_value.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM data_log_value data_log_value WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE (
		(data_log_value.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.value_index = @value_index OR @value_index IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.value_name = @value_name OR @value_name IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.value_type = @value_type OR @value_type IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.editable = @editable OR @editable IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.cur_value = @cur_value OR @cur_value IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.meaning = @meaning OR @meaning IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.meaning_to_value_index = @meaning_to_value_index OR @meaning_to_value_index IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
		(CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, data_log_value.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL) AND
		(data_log_value.grp_id IN (SELECT grp_id FROM data_log_grp WHERE obsolete = 0))
	  )
ORDER BY data_log_value.value_name

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_PATINDEX_SEARCH]
(@string_expr			NVARCHAR(80)
,@search_string			NVARCHAR(80)
,@string_expr_pos		INT
,@first_search_char_is_pct	INT
,@last_search_char_is_pct	INT OUTPUT
,@temp_search_pos		INT OUTPUT
,@temp_search_string		NVARCHAR(80) OUTPUT
,@temp_val			INT OUTPUT
) AS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Module Name    - SP_PATINDEX_SEARCH
-- Description    - Used for pattern searching alias LIKE search. eg.,'%AB_D%', '__EBC%D_QS%EB'
--                  Used for incrementing work orders, process version nos: HD# 2492, 4840
--                  Note: This function should NOT be called directly rather should be called via SP_PATINDEX
--                  Changed as per Oracle
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created   - 07/21/2004
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes/Comments
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @search_string_pos	INT
	,@search_string_char	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@string_position	INT
	,@temp_pos		INT
	,@temp_char		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@pre_wild_char		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@first_char_pos_found	INT
	,@pre_wild_char_count	INT
	,@temp_pct		INT
	,@tmp_val1		NVARCHAR(80)
	,@tmp_val2		INT

	SET @temp_search_string = ''
	SET @search_string_pos = 1
	SET @string_position = 0
	SET @temp_pos = 0
	SET @temp_char = ''
	SET @pre_wild_char = NULL
	SET @first_char_pos_found = 0
	SET @pre_wild_char_count = 0

	IF (@first_search_char_is_pct IS NULL) SET @first_search_char_is_pct = 0
	IF (@last_search_char_is_pct IS NULL) SET @last_search_char_is_pct = 0
	IF (@temp_search_pos IS NULL OR @temp_search_pos = 0) SET @temp_search_pos = 1
	IF (@string_expr_pos IS NULL OR @string_expr_pos = 0) SET @string_expr_pos = 1

	WHILE (@search_string_pos <= LEN(@search_string)) BEGIN
		SET @search_string_char = SUBSTRING(@search_string, @search_string_pos, 1)
		SET @last_search_char_is_pct = 0
		IF (@search_string_char = '%') BEGIN
			SET @pre_wild_char = '%'
			SET @pre_wild_char_count = 0
			SET @first_search_char_is_pct = 1
			SET @last_search_char_is_pct = 1
		END
		ELSE IF (@search_string_char = '_') BEGIN
			IF (@pre_wild_char = '%') BEGIN
				SET @pre_wild_char_count = @pre_wild_char_count + 1
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF (@string_expr_pos <= LEN(@string_expr)) BEGIN
					SET @temp_char = SUBSTRING(@string_expr, @string_expr_pos, 1)
					SET @temp_search_string = @temp_search_string + @temp_char
				END
				SET @pre_wild_char = '_'
				SET @string_expr_pos = @string_expr_pos + 1
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN -- CHARACTER is other than '%' or _
			IF (@pre_wild_char = '%') BEGIN
				IF (@temp_search_string IS NOT NULL AND @temp_search_string <> '') BEGIN
					SET @temp_search_pos = @temp_search_pos + LEN(@temp_search_string)
					SET @first_char_pos_found = 1
				END
				SET @temp_search_string = ''
			END
			IF (@pre_wild_char IS NULL OR @pre_wild_char = '%') BEGIN --pre wild char is null or '%'
				SET @temp_pos = CHARINDEX(@temp_search_string + @search_string_char, @string_expr, @temp_search_pos)
				IF (@temp_pos > 0) BEGIN
					SET @temp_search_string = @temp_search_string + @search_string_char
					SET @string_expr_pos = @temp_pos + LEN(@temp_search_string)
					IF (@first_char_pos_found = 0) BEGIN
						IF (@first_search_char_is_pct = 0 AND SUBSTRING(@string_expr, @temp_search_pos, LEN(@temp_search_string)) <> @temp_search_string) BEGIN
							SET @string_position = 0
							RETURN @string_position
						END
						SET @string_position = @temp_pos - @pre_wild_char_count
					END
					IF (@pre_wild_char = '%') BEGIN
						IF ((@temp_search_pos + @pre_wild_char_count) > @temp_pos) BEGIN
							SET @string_position = 0
							RETURN @string_position
						END
						SET @temp_search_pos = @temp_pos
					END
					SET @pre_wild_char = NULL
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					SET @string_position = 0
					RETURN @string_position
				END
			END --pre wild char is null or '%'
			ELSE BEGIN --pre wild char is NOT null AND NOT '%'
			  	IF (@string_expr_pos <= LEN(@string_expr)) BEGIN
					SET @temp_search_string = @temp_search_string + @search_string_char
					SET @temp_pos = CHARINDEX(@temp_search_string, @string_expr,  @temp_search_pos)
			        	IF (@first_search_char_is_pct = 0 AND SUBSTRING(@string_expr, @temp_search_pos, LEN(@temp_search_string)) <> ISNULL(@temp_search_string, -9999)) BEGIN
						SET @string_position = 0
						RETURN @string_position
					END
					IF (@temp_pos > 0) BEGIN
						IF (@first_char_pos_found = 0) BEGIN
							SET @string_position = @temp_pos - @pre_wild_char_count
						END
						SET @string_expr_pos = @temp_pos + LEN(@temp_search_string)
					END
					ELSE BEGIN
						IF (@temp_search_pos < @string_position) BEGIN
							SET @temp_search_pos = @string_position
						END
						SET @temp_search_pos = @temp_search_pos + 1
						SET @tmp_val1 = SUBSTRING(@search_string, @search_string_pos + 1 - LEN(@temp_search_string), LEN(@temp_search_string))
						EXEC SP_PATINDEX_SEARCH @string_expr, @tmp_val1,
								@string_expr_pos, @first_search_char_is_pct, @temp_pct OUTPUT,
								@temp_search_pos OUTPUT, @temp_search_string OUTPUT, @temp_val OUTPUT
						SET @temp_search_pos = @temp_val
						IF (@temp_search_pos = 0) BEGIN
							SET @string_position = 0
							RETURN @string_position
						END
						IF (@first_char_pos_found = 0) BEGIN
							SET @string_position = @temp_search_pos - @pre_wild_char_count
						END
						SET @string_expr_pos = @temp_search_pos + LEN(@temp_search_string)
					END
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					SET @string_position = 0
					RETURN @string_position
				END
			END --pre wild char is NOT null AND NOT '%'
		END -- CHARACTER is other than '%' or _
		SET @search_string_pos = @search_string_pos + 1
	END -- End for loop
	SET @temp_val = @string_position
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_JRHU_PostProcessing]
-- Description: Used to process the Job Request HU
--
--  JOB RHU - AUT to MES
--
--	STEPS:
--	1 - Get current Job information: job oper_id, job_pos
--  2 - Calculate Entity Name
--  3 - Insert record on JOB_OUT interface

--	FINISHED...


--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE JRHU object  towards the JOB_OUT one
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version		Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 		Change description
-- 0.01.00		XPM, AML   	2026-01-12   			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01		JSC			2026-04-14				Added support for pallet type 3 as well
-- 0.02.00		XPM, AML	2026-06-29				Updated to give the job pos as an output.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE             PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_JRHU_PostProcessing]
	@object_name NVARCHAR(60),
	@interface_type NVARCHAR(15) = 'JRHU',
	@ID INT = 0,
	@job_pos_output INT = -1 OUTPUT,
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@ID_JRHU_local INT = @ID,
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0--,
			--@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			--@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			--@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			--@cfg_status_OK INT = 5,
			--@cfg_job_state_pause INT = 5,
			--@cfg_job_state_complete INT = 4,
			--@cfg_feedback_timeout INT = 30,
			--@cfg_float_tolerance FLOAT = 0.00001;

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(50)),23)+ FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmssfff');
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(@TranName,29) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	--PRINT TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@TranCounter) + ' <= Tran Counter Value at the beginning'

	-- Declare MES outputs (To handle post action errors)
	DECLARE @data_job_exec_result_code INT

	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		
		-- moved here
		IF @TranCounter = 0
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
		ELSE
			SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetByID]
			@ObjectName = @object_name,
			@InterfaceType = @interface_type,
			@ID = @ID_JRHU_local,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @Error_local = 0
		BEGIN

			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,													
					@last_hu_number NVARCHAR(40) = NULL, 
					@pallet_type INT, 	
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,	
					@debug INT = 0,
					@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@last_hu_number = last_hu_number
					,@pallet_type = pallet_type
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',	
				last_hu_number NVARCHAR(40) '$.last_hu_number', 
				pallet_type INT '$.pallet_type', 	
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME '$.recorded_timestamp' 
			);
	
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@object_name, CHARINDEX('_' + @interface_type, @object_name) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT: sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT
			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = wa.output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			
			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @interface_type as interface_type, @object_name as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'				
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- Declare the outputs 
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT	@data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
					--,@data_process_id = process_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state, qty prod and qty req
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
					--,@data_job_qty_prod = j.qty_prod
					--,@data_job_qty_reqd = j.qty_reqd
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if JOB is new or ready ERROR; Else is not RUNNING (3) (nor new nor Ready) then WARNING  -- ,7,8,9
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED, 7, 8, 9 -- Avoid errors -- 4,5 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
			BEGIN
								
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)
			SET @job_pos_output = @data_job_pos 
			IF @data_job_pos = -1
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- GET USER ID
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			
			IF @pallet_type NOT IN (1, 2, 3) --1 Good, 2 Rejected, -- 3 Both
			BEGIN
				

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			DECLARE @job_command_local INT = 4 -- In this case, if pallet_type is correct, job command is 4 for all cases no if needed

			--IF @pallet_type IN (1,2)
			--BEGIN
				--SET @job_command_local = 4
			--END

			-- Do the final part prior to exiting the process
			Finishing_OK:

			PRINT 'Finishing OK'
			
			DECLARE @Cur_time DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
					,@RC INT

			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff_InsertJobOutData] 
			   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
			  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
			  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
			  ,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
			  ,@job_command = @job_command_local
			  ,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
			  ,@recorded_timestamp = @Cur_time
			  ,@current_timestamp = @Cur_time
			  ,@object_name = @mes_parent_name
			  ,@interface_type = 'JOB_OUT'
			  ,@return_code = @RC OUTPUT
			  ,@row_id_output =  @ID_local OUTPUT
						
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		-- Exit place
		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output, @job_pos_output as job_pos_ouput

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
	

		SET @TranCounter = @@TRANCOUNT

	

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output, @job_pos_output as job_pos_ouput
				

		BEGIN TRY
			---- ADDed extras v1.03  ==> if state is -1 then we just need to rollback all
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH
		
			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),7)+';message_output:'
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output, @job_pos_output as job_pos_ouput
				
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr]
(
		@item_id			STRING80 = NULL
	,	@attr_id			INT32 = NULL
	,	@remove_attr_col	LOGICAL = 0
	,	@remove_item		LOGICAL = 0
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr
-- Description			- HD# 6192, Update Queue Item Attribute table automatically based on the item or item_attribute changes.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 11/10/2005
-- Version				- 3.1.2
--
-- Copyright (C) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 11/22/2005		Raghu			3.1.3	Modifications related to handle quotes on item_id or attribute description.
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu			3.2.0	HD# 9207, Part of DB Changes
-- 07/26/2007		AML				3.3.0	DB Changes; Added _h to all occurrences of queue_item_attr.queue_item_item_id.
--01/06/2008		Raghu			3.4	    L00073212, L00073016: Exclude column names that starts with the table name
--08/07/2012		Arun			4.5	    Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
--06/03/2015        Srinivas        6.2     CR L00136163.attr# column type changed to store 1700 characters for attribute value.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
--WARNING: Caller should call this procedure ONLY AFTER finishing all his/her transactions.
--Any exception/error raised from the caller procedure must be rolled back there itself and the call should not
--enter here. Since DDL operations are involved here such as adding additional columns OR dropping columns, all
--the transactions for this session are commited automatically; and any errors from the calling procedures may
--NOT get rolled back.
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @col_name		STRING80
		,	@col_id			INT32
		,	@desc_col_names	NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@desc_vals		NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@SQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@attr_id_col	STRING80
		,	@attr_desc		STRING80
		,	@attr_value		STRING1700
		,	@attr_id_temp	INT32
		,	@dummy_val		NVARCHAR(1)

	-- do nothing if nothing is supplied. Proceed ONLY if item_id OR attr_id or both are supplied.
	IF (@item_id IS NULL AND @attr_id IS NULL)  RETURN

	SELECT @remove_attr_col = ISNULL(@remove_attr_col, 0), @remove_item = ISNULL(@remove_item, 0)

	--Check if the call is to remove an attribute column.
	IF (@remove_attr_col = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@attr_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%'
				  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN
				--Since the supplied attribute column exists, remove this attribute column
				--from the queue_item_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_item_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

				--Also, remove the attr_id_d_h column from the queue_item_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_item_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
			END

			--Check if any attributes are made visible in the queue. If none of the attributes are made
			--visible for the queue, then remove all the items from the queue_item_attr table.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%' AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0)
				--DELETE items from the queue_item_attr table where item equals:
				--i) There are no attributes exist for this item
				--ii) or there are no attributes for this item that can be made visible in the queue.
				DELETE FROM queue_item_attr
				FROM
					(SELECT qia.queue_item_item_id_h
					FROM item_attr ia
					INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
							FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
					  		AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%' AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON ia.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
					RIGHT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h = ia.item_id
					WHERE ia.item_id IS NULL) queue_attr
				WHERE queue_item_attr.queue_item_item_id_h = queue_attr.queue_item_item_id_h
			ELSE
				--Delete all the rows from the queue_item_attr table.
				--i) either there are no attributes assigned for any item
				--ii)or there no attributes that are made visible in the queue for any items.
				DELETE FROM queue_item_attr
		END
		RETURN
	END

	--Check whether the supplied attribute can be included in the queue.
	SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr
	WHERE attr_id = @attr_id AND visible_in_queue = 1

	--Do nothing if the current attribute cannot be included for the queue.
	IF (@attr_desc IS NULL) RETURN

	--Generate a list of all attribute description columns.
	SET @desc_col_names = ''

	--Handle the item_id first to insert a new row in the queue_item_attr table for items
	--do this ONLY if the supplied item_id is not null AND we are inserting or updating an item
	IF (@remove_item = 0) AND (@item_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM queue_item_attr WHERE queue_item_item_id_h = @item_id) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM queue_item_attr) BEGIN
			DECLARE queue_item_attr_col_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT name, colid
			FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%'
			ORDER BY colid

			OPEN queue_item_attr_col_csr
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM queue_item_attr_col_csr INTO @col_name, @col_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Generate a list of all attribute description columns; since this is a non-null column in the database.
				IF UPPER(@col_name) <> 'ITEM_ID' AND CHARINDEX('d_h', @col_name) > 0
					SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @col_name + ','
			END
			CLOSE queue_item_attr_col_csr
			DEALLOCATE queue_item_attr_col_csr

			--Atleast if any 1 row exists for the queue_item_attr, then duplicate that row for the new item
			--SELECT * FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = ',' + LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') BEGIN
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO queue_item_attr (queue_item_item_id_h' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT TOP 1 @item_id' + @desc_col_names + ' FROM queue_item_attr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40', @item_id
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--INSERT INTO queue_item_attr (item_id) VALUES (@item_id)
			--There are no rows in the queue_item_attr table.
			--Create this item and automatically fill the attribute values in the appropriate attribute columns.
			SET @desc_vals = ''
			DECLARE queue_item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
			FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%'
			  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

			OPEN queue_item_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM queue_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
				--Use a dummy value for the description columns, since this column does not allow nulls.
				SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
			END
			CLOSE queue_item_attr_cursor
--			DEALLOCATE queue_item_attr_cursor

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
				IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
				IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO queue_item_attr (queue_item_item_id_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' VALUES (@item_id,' + @desc_vals + ')'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40', @item_id
			END
			ELSE INSERT INTO queue_item_attr (queue_item_item_id_h) VALUES (@item_id)

			--Loop through all the attribute columns for this item and fill the appropriate item_attribute value
			--and attribute descriptions.
			SET @desc_vals = ''
			OPEN queue_item_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM queue_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_item_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '=atr.attr_desc FROM '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT a.attr_id, a.attr_desc, ia.item_id, ia.attr_value '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM attr a '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia ON ia.attr_id = a.attr_id AND ia.item_id = @item_id '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE a.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@item_id STRING40, @attr_id_temp INT32', @item_id, @attr_id_temp
			END
			CLOSE queue_item_attr_cursor
			DEALLOCATE queue_item_attr_cursor
		END
	END

	SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)

	--Check whether a column for this attribute name exists.
	IF(@remove_item = 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%'
		  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN

		--If not, create a column name for this attribute.
		--Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_item_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + ' STRING1700_NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--If not, create the attribute description column as NULL now, since row may already exists
		--in this table. After updating the attribute description column, this column can be
		--changed to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_item_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--Update the attribute description column.
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_item_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h = @attr_desc'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc

		--Change the attribute description column to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_item_attr ALTER COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NOT NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
	END

	IF (@item_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Retrieve the item attribute value for this column.
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM item_attr
		WHERE item_id = @item_id AND attr_id = @attr_id

		IF (@remove_item = 1)
			--If the item attribute is removed or the item itself is deleted, then delete this item.
			DELETE FROM queue_item_attr
			FROM
				(SELECT qia.queue_item_item_id_h
				FROM item_attr ia
				INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
						FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  		AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%' AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON ia.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
				RIGHT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h = ia.item_id
				WHERE qia.queue_item_item_id_h = @item_id AND ia.item_id IS NULL) queue_attr
			WHERE queue_item_attr.queue_item_item_id_h = @item_id AND queue_item_attr.queue_item_item_id_h = queue_attr.queue_item_item_id_h

		--Update the attribute value for this item
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_item_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + ' = @attr_value WHERE queue_item_item_id_h = @item_id'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_value STRING1700, @item_id STRING40', @attr_value, @item_id
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The visible_in_queue property for this attribute is set to true.
		--Create all items that have this attribute and this item is not added to the queue_item_attr table.
		SET @desc_vals = ''
		DECLARE queue_item_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
		FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_ITEM%'
		  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

		OPEN queue_item_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM queue_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
			SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
		END
		CLOSE queue_item_attr_cursor
--		DEALLOCATE queue_item_attr_cursor

		IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
			IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
			SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO queue_item_attr (queue_item_item_id_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT ia.item_id, ' + @desc_vals + ' FROM item_attr ia'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_item_attr qia ON qia.queue_item_item_id_h = ia.item_id'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' WHERE ia.attr_id = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), @attr_id) + ' AND qia.queue_item_item_id_h IS NULL'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

			--If there are >= 1 row(s) inserted into the queue_item_attr table,
			--then update all the attribute values and descriptions for the new rows.
			--If no rows were inserted into the queue_item_attr table, then we don't need to loop thru all the
			--rows to update the attribute values and description.
			IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 BEGIN
				SET @dummy_val = '0'
				OPEN queue_item_attr_cursor
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM queue_item_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
					IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_temp
					SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_item_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
					SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '= @attr_desc FROM '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT i.item_id, ia.attr_value '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM item i '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE queue_item_attr.queue_item_item_id_h=atr.item_id AND queue_item_attr.' + @attr_id_col + '=@dummy_val'
					EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id_temp INT32, @attr_desc STRING80, @dummy_val NVARCHAR(1)', @attr_id_temp, @attr_desc, @dummy_val
				END
				CLOSE queue_item_attr_cursor
			END
		END
		DEALLOCATE queue_item_attr_cursor

		--The above update will update ONLY the new rows if inserted.
		--Rows may already exist in this queue_item_attr table for many items. If an attribute property is changed to make visible in the grid,
		--then the below update statement should update all the existing rows
		--SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr WHERE attr_id = @attr_id
--		SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + 'd_h'
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_item_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '=atr.attr_value FROM '
--		SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '= @attr_desc FROM '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT i.item_id, ia.attr_value '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM item i '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id) atr '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE queue_item_attr.queue_item_item_id_h=atr.item_id'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id INT32', @attr_id

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[tpm_stat]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- tpm_stat
-- Description			- Returns the job_hour_history (tpm_stat) directly from the job_hour_history table for the time period up to 3 hours in the past from the top of the current hour
--				Returns the calculated times and quantities for the time period greater than 3 hours from the top of the current hour
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 08/01/2016
-- Version				- 5.3
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WITH boundaries AS
(SELECT jhh.ent_id, jhh.wo_id, jhh.oper_id, jhh.seq_no, jhh.job_start_utc, jhh.hour_start_utc
	, CASE WHEN jhh.job_start_utc < jhh.hour_start_utc THEN jhh.hour_start_utc ELSE jhh.job_start_utc END boundary_start_utc
	, CASE WHEN COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > jhh.hour_end_utc THEN jhh.hour_end_utc ELSE COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) END boundary_end_utc
	, jhh.hour_end_utc
	, (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc) FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
		  AND sh.shift_start_utc <= CASE WHEN jhh.hour_start_utc >= jhh.job_start_utc THEN jhh.hour_start_utc ELSE jhh.job_start_utc END) shift_start_utc
FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = jh.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = jh.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = jh.seq_no AND jhh.job_start_utc = jh.job_start_utc
)
SELECT jhh.ent_id, jhh.wo_id, jhh.oper_id, jhh.seq_no, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local
	, jhh.hour_start_utc, jhh.hour_start_local, sh.shift_id
	, jhh.item_id, jhh.qty_good, jhh.qty_reject, jhh.std_prod_rate
	, jhh.runtime, jhh.downtime, jhh.idletime, jhh.batch_size, jhh.last_edit_at
	, jhh.hour_end_utc, jhh.hour_end_local, jhh.job_start_utc, jhh.last_edit_comment
FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN boundaries b WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = b.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = b.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = b.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = b.seq_no
	AND jhh.job_start_utc = b.job_start_utc AND jhh.hour_start_utc = b.hour_start_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) ON b.ent_id = sh.ent_id AND b.shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc
WHERE jhh.hour_start_utc < DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, GETUTCDATE()),0))
UNION ALL
SELECT jhh.ent_id, jhh.wo_id, jhh.oper_id, jhh.seq_no, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local
	, jhh.hour_start_utc, jhh.hour_start_local, sh.shift_id
	, jhh.item_id
	, COALESCE(qtys.qty_prod, 0) AS qty_prod
	, COALESCE(qtys.qty_reject, 0) AS qty_reject
	, jhh.std_prod_rate
	, COALESCE(run.duration, 0) - CASE WHEN run.start_event_time_utc < b.boundary_start_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, run.start_event_time_utc, b.boundary_start_utc) ELSE 0 END
				- CASE WHEN run.last_event_end_time > b.boundary_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, b.boundary_end_utc, run.last_event_end_time) ELSE 0 END
			AS runtime
	, COALESCE(down.duration, 0) - CASE WHEN down.start_event_time_utc < b.boundary_start_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, down.start_event_time_utc, b.boundary_start_utc) ELSE 0 END
				- CASE WHEN down.last_event_end_time > b.boundary_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, b.boundary_end_utc, down.last_event_end_time) ELSE 0 END
			AS downtime
	, COALESCE(idle.duration, 0) - CASE WHEN idle.start_event_time_utc < b.boundary_start_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, idle.start_event_time_utc, b.boundary_start_utc) ELSE 0 END
				- CASE WHEN idle.last_event_end_time > b.boundary_end_utc THEN DATEDIFF(SS, b.boundary_end_utc, idle.last_event_end_time) ELSE 0 END
			AS idletime
	, jhh.batch_size, jhh.last_edit_at
	, jhh.hour_end_utc, jhh.hour_end_local, jhh.job_start_utc, jhh.last_edit_comment
FROM job_hour_history jhh WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN boundaries b WITH (NOLOCK) ON jhh.ent_id = b.ent_id AND jhh.wo_id = b.wo_id AND jhh.oper_id = b.oper_id AND jhh.seq_no = b.seq_no
	AND jhh.job_start_utc = b.job_start_utc AND jhh.hour_start_utc = b.hour_start_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) ON b.ent_id = sh.ent_id AND b.shift_start_utc = sh.shift_start_utc
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(vuh.duration) duration, MIN(vuh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc, MAX(vuh.event_end_time_utc) last_event_end_time
		   FROM vw_util_history_times vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
		   WHERE vuh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
			 AND vuh.event_time_utc >= (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
							FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE uh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
							  AND uh.event_time_utc <= b.boundary_start_utc)
			 AND vuh.event_time_utc < b.boundary_end_utc
			 AND vuh.runtime = 1
			) run
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(vuh.duration) duration, MIN(vuh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc, MAX(vuh.event_end_time_utc) last_event_end_time
		   FROM vw_util_history_times vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
		   WHERE vuh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
			 AND vuh.event_time_utc >= (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
							FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE uh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
							  AND uh.event_time_utc <= b.boundary_start_utc)
			 AND vuh.event_time_utc < b.boundary_end_utc
			 AND vuh.downtime = 1
			) down
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(vuh.duration) duration, MIN(vuh.event_time_utc) start_event_time_utc, MAX(vuh.event_end_time_utc) last_event_end_time
		   FROM vw_util_history_times vuh WITH (NOLOCK)
		   WHERE vuh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
			 AND vuh.event_time_utc >= (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
							FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE uh.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
							  AND uh.event_time_utc <= b.boundary_start_utc)
			 AND vuh.event_time_utc < b.boundary_end_utc
			 AND vuh.runtime = 0 AND vuh.downtime = 0
			) idle
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 1 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) AS qty_prod
		, SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 0 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END) AS qty_reject
		FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ip.ent_id = jhh.ent_id
		  AND ip.wo_id = jhh.wo_id
		  AND ip.oper_id = jhh.oper_id
		  AND ip.seq_no = jhh.seq_no
		  AND ip.byproduct = 0
		  AND ip.created_at_utc >= b.boundary_start_utc
		  --Must have <= AND < hour_end_utc since there are two cases to handle
		  --(i) A production accounted precisely at the end time of the job must be accounted.
		  --For example, if there is a production at 7:30:30 and the end time of the job is 7:30:30, then that production must be included
		  --(ii) However, if the production is at 8:00:00 and the end time of the job is 8:00:00, then the production must be included for this hour (excluding the production from the previoius hour)
		  --The created_at_utc <= boundar_end_utc includes all the production including the end time of the job, but the created_at_utc < hour_end_utc determines which hour the production should be included.
		  AND ip.created_at_utc <= b.boundary_end_utc AND ip.created_at_utc < b.hour_end_utc
		) qtys
WHERE jhh.hour_start_utc >= DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, GETUTCDATE()),0))

-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_invalidate_steps]
-- Description:	this SP to invalidate the next applicable subsequent steps on the change of the recipe 
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	DS				2023-04-07			this SP to invalidate the next applicable subsequent steps on the change of the recipe

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_invalidate_steps]
(
--declare 
  @wo_id		NVARCHAR(40)
 ,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
 ,@seq_no		INT
 ,@ent_id		INT --= NULL  
 ,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40) --= '100001234'
 ,@step_name	NVARCHAR(40) = NULL

) 
AS

--select  @wo_id=N'1001016150',@oper_id=N'BreakingWinnowing',@seq_no=0,@ent_id=208,@item_id=N'500000041590'

BEGIN

DECLARE @stepDetails as table (row_id int identity(1,1),step_name nvarchar(40),state_cd int,step_no int, step_seq int, step_name_localized nvarchar(40))
DECLARE @row_min int
DECLARE @row_max int
DECLARE @step_details varchar(40)
DECLARE @step_no varchar(40)

-- fetching the step details
	insert into @stepDetails
	select distinct js.step_name,isnull(jsd.state_cd,0) state_cd ,js.step_no, js.spare1 as step_seq,js.spare2 as step_name_localized
	from job_step js  with(nolock)
	left join job_step_data jsd with(nolock) on js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id 
	and js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id and js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no and js.step_no = jsd.step_no
	where js.wo_id = @wo_id and js.oper_id = @oper_id and JS.seq_no = @seq_no
	order by js.step_no asc

	--select * from @stepDetails order by step_seq

		 select @row_min=min(row_id),@row_max = max(row_id) from  @stepDetails where state_cd=4
			--select * from @cte

			--executing the loop and updating the steps data
		WHILE ((@row_min <= @row_max))
		BEGIN
			 select @step_details = step_name_localized,@step_no = step_no  from  @stepDetails where row_id = @row_min;
				
				-- checking the applicale steps and updating respectivly
				if(@step_details = '@@setParameter@@')
				begin
					
					delete from job_step_data where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;
					update job_step set complete_cond = 3 where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;

					
				end
				if(@step_details = '@@SetSource@@')
				begin
					
					delete from job_step_data where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;
					update job_step set complete_cond = 3 where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;

					delete from ofi_su_selection where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type=1

				end 
				if(@step_details = '@@SetDestination@@')
				begin
					

					delete from job_step_data where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;
					update job_step set complete_cond = 3 where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;

					delete from ofi_su_selection where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type=2
				end 
				if(@step_details = '@@SetLot@@')
				begin
					

					delete from job_step_data where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;
					update job_step set complete_cond = 3 where wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and step_no = @step_no;
					
					-- since the table is job bom only -- no action needed.

				end 

				set @row_min = @row_min+1
		END

END

		IF @cur_qty_prod = @split_qty_prod BEGIN

			DELETE item_prod

			-- Note: Delete trigger will update tpm_stat

			DELETE FROM job_event WHERE source_row_id = @old_row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Prod%'

		ELSE BEGIN

			UPDATE item_prod SET qty_prod = CAST((CAST(qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7)) - CAST(@split_qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7))) AS FLOAT) WHERE row_id = @old_row_id

			-- Call SP to update Job table with total good and reject prod qty's from item_prod
			--if it is by product do not update the job qtys
			IF @cur_item_id = @old_item_id EXECUTE sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @old_wo_id, @old_oper_id, @old_seq_no

			--Update tpm_stat

			--Added 05/17/2007 AML. Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
			SELECT @total_qty_prod = (@cur_qty_prod - @split_qty_prod)
			EXEC sp_U_Assigned_Lot_UpdateStatus @old_item_id, @old_lot_no, @old_sublot_no, @old_wo_id, @old_oper_id, @old_seq_no, @total_qty_prod
		END

		SELECT @reduce_inv_qty = @split_qty_prod, @reduce_inv_int_qty = 0, @reduce_good_prod_num_deci = 0
		EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis @old_item_id, @old_lot_no, @old_sublot_no, @old_to_ent_id -- Added "@old_sublot_no," 1/11/07 KRF
				,@reduce_inv_qty OUTPUT, @reduce_inv_int_qty OUTPUT, @reduce_good_prod_num_deci OUTPUT
		SELECT @reduce_inv_int_qty = ISNULL(@reduce_inv_int_qty, 0), @reduce_good_prod_num_deci = ISNULL(@reduce_good_prod_num_deci, 0)

		--insert the row with the new values

		--check atleast one of the new_*** should have the value
        ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
		IF (@new_wo_id IS NULL) AND (@new_oper_id IS NULL) AND (@new_seq_no IS NULL) AND (@new_shift_start_local IS NULL) AND (@new_hour_start_local IS NULL) AND
		(@new_item_id IS NULL) AND (@new_lot_no IS NULL) AND (@new_sublot_no IS NULL) AND (@new_reas_cd IS NULL) -- Added "(@new_sublot_no IS NULL) AND" 1/11/07 KRF

		IF @new_wo_id IS NULL SET @new_wo_id = @old_wo_id

         ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )

		SELECT  @row_id = NULL, @distinct_reject_prod = '0'

		SELECT @distinct_good_prod = attr_value FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 362

		IF NOT (@distinct_reject_prod = '1' AND @cur_good_prod = 0 AND @split_qty_prod > 0)

			SELECT	@row_id = row_id

		EXEC sp_U_Item_Prod_RoundToNumDecis @new_item_id, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_to_ent_id -- Added "@new_sublot_no," 1/11/07 KRF

			IF @split_byproduct_flag IS NULL SET @split_byproduct_flag = @cur_byproduct

			SET	qty_prod = CAST((CAST(@split_qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7)) + CAST(@cur_qty_prod AS DECIMAL(18,7))) AS FLOAT),

			IF @split_processed_flag IS NULL SET @split_processed_flag = @cur_processed_flag
			IF @split_byproduct_flag IS NULL SET @split_byproduct_flag = @cur_byproduct
			IF @new_shift_id IS NULL SET @new_shift_id = @cur_shift_id

			-- Now insert the new row
            ---Added 13/3/2012 sid(OEE Changes from 3.5patch2 )
			INSERT INTO item_prod
			(
				wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,hour_start_utc, hour_start_local,item_id,
				lot_no, rm_lot_no, sublot_no, rm_sublot_no,  -- Added "sublot_no, rm_sublot_no," 1/11/07 KRF
				reas_cd, user_id, ent_id, shift_id, grade_cd,

				last_edit_by, last_edit_at, created_at_utc, created_at_local -- Added ", created_at" 1/11/07 KRF

			VALUES
			(
				@new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @new_shift_start_utc, @new_shift_start_local, @new_hour_start_utc, @new_hour_start_local, @new_item_id,
				@new_lot_no, @new_rm_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_rm_sublot_no, -- Added "@new_sublot_no, @new_rm_sublot_no," 1/11/07 KRF
				@new_reas_cd, @new_user_id, @new_ent_id, @new_shift_id, @cur_grade_cd,
				@cur_status_cd, @new_to_ent_id, @cur_good_prod, @split_qty_prod,
				@split_qty_prod_erp, @split_processed_flag, @split_byproduct_flag, 0,
				@new_genealogy_id, @new_event_id, @new_segment_requirement_id, @new_segment_response_id, @cur_comments, -- Added 07/29/2009 RWB
				@last_edit_by, @last_edit_at, @created_at_utc, @created_at_local -- Added ", @created_at" 1/11/07 KRF
			)

			IF @@error <> 0
				BEGIN
					RAISERROR('split production failed{3279}',16,1)
					RETURN -1
				END
			SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			--Update tpm_stat
			EXEC sp_U_TPM_Stat_RefreshQtys @ent_id=@new_ent_id, @wo_id=@new_wo_id, @oper_id=@new_oper_id, @seq_no=@new_seq_no, @event_time_utc=@created_at_utc, @last_edit_comment=@last_edit_comment

			--Added 05/17/2007 AML. Update this lot status in the assigned_lot table.
			EXEC sp_U_Assigned_Lot_UpdateStatus @new_item_id, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @split_qty_prod
		END

		-- Fix for the CR L00137842. Refresh Job and TPM_Stat table on insert and update of item_prod table.
		EXEC sp_U_Job_RefreshQtys @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no

		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 232
		IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
			SELECT @job_pos = job_pos FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @new_ent_id AND cur_wo_id = @new_wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @new_oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @new_seq_no

			IF (1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_event  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE source_row_id = @old_row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Prod%'))
				SELECT TOP 1 @value1 = value1, @value2 = value2, @value3 = value3, @value4 = value4, @value5 = value5
						,	@value6 = value6, @value7 = value7, @value8 = value8, @value9 = value9, @value10 = value10
				FROM job_event WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE source_row_id = @old_row_id AND event_type LIKE '%Prod%' --AND event_time = @source_row_last_edit_at
			ELSE
				SELECT	@value1 = NULL, @value2 = NULL, @value3 = NULL, @value4 = NULL, @value5 = NULL
					,	@value6 = NULL, @value7 = NULL, @value8 = NULL, @value9 = NULL, @value10 = NULL

	  		EXEC sp_I_Job_Event @new_ent_id, NULL, @job_pos, NULL, 'ReclassifyProd', @bom_pos, @new_lot_no, @new_sublot_no, @new_item_id, -- Added "@new_sublot_no," 1/11/07 KRF
				NULL, @new_user_id, NULL, @row_id, NULL, @new_genealogy_id,@new_segment_requirement_id, @new_segment_response_id, NULL, NULL, NULL,@value1, @value2, @value3, @value4, @value5, @value6, @value7, @value8, @value9,
				@value10, NULL, @time_zone_bias_value, NULL
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Item Prod record not found in the database{3282}',16,1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	-- Check whether we should update inventory with this production quantity
	IF @cur_update_inv = 1 BEGIN
			--reduce the qty with the old values

		IF NOT (@reduce_good_prod_num_deci > 0 AND @reduce_inv_int_qty = 0) BEGIN
			IF (@reduce_good_prod_num_deci > 0 AND @reduce_inv_int_qty != 0) SET @reduce_inv_qty = @reduce_inv_int_qty
			ELSE SET @reduce_inv_qty = @split_qty_prod

			-- Modified by Raghu on 08/30/2002.  Added @cur_grade_cd and @cur_status_cd as the last parameter as ReduceInv requires grade and status to find the unique row.
			--Supply NULL for date_out, let Inventory Reduce method determines the date_in time depending on the time_bias
			EXEC @return = sp_U_Item_Inv_Reduce @ent_id=@old_to_ent_id, @item_id=@old_item_id, @lot_no=@old_lot_no, @sublot_no=@old_sublot_no, @reduce_qty=@reduce_inv_qty, @reduce_qty_erp=0
						, @date_out=NULL, @goods_shipped=0, @item_grade_cd=@old_grade_cd, @item_status_cd=@old_status_cd, @item_reas_cd=NULL
						, @must_consume_from_inv=0, @must_cons_from_wip=0, @checkgrade=NULL, @wo_id=NULL, @oper_id=NULL, @seq_no=NULL
						, @last_edit_at=NULL, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @date_out_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @row_id=NULL
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1
			--add the qty with the new values

			EXECUTE SP_U_Job_Exec_UnreadyDstrmJobs @old_wo_id, @old_oper_id, @old_seq_no, @old_item_id
		END

		IF NOT (@add_good_prod_num_deci > 0 AND @add_inv_int_qty = 0) BEGIN
			IF (@add_good_prod_num_deci > 0 AND @add_inv_int_qty != 0) SET @add_inv_qty = @add_inv_int_qty
			ELSE SET @add_inv_qty = @split_qty_prod

			SET @cur_uom_id = (SELECT uom_id FROM item  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @new_item_id)

            --SLR 4/13/2012
            --SET @expiry_date = Null --Commented for  CR-L00117351
			--Supply NULL for date_in, let Inventory Add method determines the date_in time depending on the time_bias
			EXECUTE @return = SP_I_Item_Inv_Add @ent_id=@new_to_ent_id, @item_id=@new_item_id, @lot_no=@new_lot_no, @sublot_no=@new_sublot_no
				, @grade_cd=@cur_grade_cd, @status_cd=@cur_status_cd, @add_qty=@add_inv_qty
				, @add_qty_erp=0, @date_in_local=NULL, @date_in_tz=NULL, @expiry_date=@expiry_date, @wo_id=@new_wo_id, @oper_id=@new_oper_id, @seq_no=@new_seq_no
				, @from_ent_id=@cur_storage_ent_id, @uom_id=@cur_uom_id, @spare1=NULL, @spare2=NULL, @spare3=NULL, @spare4=NULL, @spare5=NULL, @spare6=NULL
				, @goods_received=0, @checkgradestatus=1, @transfer_comments=NULL, @log_transfer=0, @time_zone_bias_value=NULL, @date_in_utc=NULL, @expiry_date_utc=NULL, @row_id=@inv_row_id OUTPUT
			IF @return <> 0 RETURN -1

			EXECUTE SP_U_Job_Exec_ReadyDstrmJobs @new_wo_id, @new_oper_id, @new_seq_no, @last_edit_by, -1, 0
		END
	END
	--EXECUTE SP_U_Job_Exec_UnreadyDstrmJobs @old_wo_id, @old_oper_id, @old_seq_no, @old_item_id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_JE_VerifyStepsAreCompletd]
(@in_wo_id		STRING80
,@in_oper_id	STRING80
,@in_seq_no		INT32
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          -
-- Description          -
-- Author          -
-- Date Created          - 10/21/2002
-- Version          - 2.0.0.33
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
-- 01/09/2003    Rohit        1.5.2    Added string Id reference to err messages.
--05/15/2003    Raghu        1.6.7    (HD# 2421) 2)  Do Not allow the job to be completed if the production repeated for every lot has
--                    all its repeatable steps completely finished and none bypassed.
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain     1608  Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 04/30/2004      Sheetal Jain    2033    Double the character variable lengths to support multibyte character
--02/07/2007	Raghu		3.2.0	HD# 9154, Part of DB Changes; renamed from sp_S_Job_Step_Data_StepsCompl
--04/24/2007    Raghu       3.2.9   HD# 9234, Implement Step predefined execution and notification enhancements; Restructured the sp.
--05/02/2007    Raghu       3.2.10  HD# 9812, There was a comma missing after the language string id. ie., '{5459}' ought to be '{5459},'.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @step_no				INT32
		,@step_desc				STRING80
		,@reqd_rep				INT32
		,@repeatability			INT32
		,@verify_steps_compl	LOGICAL
		,@err_str				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@row_count				INT32
		,@lot_no				STRING80

BEGIN
	--Loop through each step (from job_step template) and verify whether the steps are completed.
	DECLARE job_step_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT job_step.step_no, job_step.step_desc, job_step.reqd_rep, job_step_grp.repeatability
	FROM job_step job_step WITH (NOLOCK), job_step_grp job_step_grp WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE job_step.wo_id = job_step_grp.wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = job_step_grp.oper_id
	  AND job_step.seq_no = job_step_grp.seq_no AND job_step.step_grp_id = job_step_grp.step_grp_id
	  AND job_step.wo_id = @in_wo_id AND job_step.oper_id = @in_oper_id AND job_step.seq_no = @in_seq_no

	OPEN job_step_csr
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM job_step_csr INTO @step_no, @step_desc, @reqd_rep, @repeatability
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

		--Default that we need to verify whether this step has been completed.
		SET @verify_steps_compl = 1

		--First, verify whether this step is started for this job
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
			 WHERE wo_id = @in_wo_id AND oper_id = @in_oper_id AND seq_no = @in_seq_no AND step_no = @step_no) BEGIN
			SET @err_str = 'The job (wo_id: %1, oper_id: %2, seq_no: %3) has a step: %4 (%5), which is not started yet.{3352},' + @in_wo_id + ',' + @in_oper_id + ',' + STR(@in_seq_no) + ',' + STR(@step_no) + ',' + @step_desc
			RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF (@repeatability = 1) BEGIN
			--Verify whether the reqd_rep is set to a number.
			IF (@reqd_rep > 0) BEGIN
				--Verify whether any production quantities are reported on the lots
				--As long as the production is reported for the no. of required lots
				--configured in the job_step.reqd_rep; then it is fine
				SELECT @row_count = COUNT(DISTINCT ip.lot_no)
				FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_step_data jsd ON jsd.wo_id = ip.wo_id AND jsd.oper_id = ip.oper_id AND jsd.seq_no = ip.seq_no
				WHERE ip.wo_id = @in_wo_id
				  AND ip.oper_id = @in_oper_id
				  AND ip.seq_no = @in_seq_no
				  AND (ip.lot_no = jsd.lot_no OR (ip.lot_no IS NULL AND jsd.lot_no IS NULL))
				  AND jsd.step_no = @step_no
				  AND jsd.state_cd = 4

				IF (@row_count >= @reqd_rep)
					--There are as many lots that are completed (job_step.reqd_rep) has quantities reported for production.
					--Since this step has already got as many lots as production records; we do not need to verify further.
					--Move to next step.
					SET @verify_steps_compl = 0
			END

			IF (@verify_steps_compl = 1) BEGIN
				--Verify whether the current step is a repeatable step.
				--Verify whether this step is completed for this job.
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
							WHERE wo_id = @in_wo_id AND oper_id = @in_oper_id AND seq_no = @in_seq_no
							  AND step_no = @step_no
							  AND NOT state_cd IN (4, 8, 9)) BEGIN
					SET @err_str = 'The job (wo_id: %1, oper_id: %2, seq_no: %3) has a step: %4 (%5), which is not completed.{5459},' + @in_wo_id + ',' + @in_oper_id + ',' + STR(@in_seq_no) + ',' + STR(@step_no) + ',' + @step_desc
					RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
					RETURN -1
				END

				IF (@repeatability = 1) BEGIN
					--This is a repeatable step. Now, verify whether a production has reported for each lot on this step.
					DECLARE job_step_data_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
					SELECT lot_no FROM job_step_data WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE wo_id = @in_wo_id
					AND oper_id = @in_oper_id
					AND seq_no = @in_seq_no
					AND step_no = @step_no
					AND state_cd = 4

					OPEN job_step_csr
					WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
						FETCH NEXT FROM job_step_data_csr INTO @lot_no
						IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
						IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
										WHERE ip.wo_id = @in_wo_id
										  AND ip.oper_id = @in_oper_id
										  AND ip.seq_no = @in_seq_no
										  AND (ip.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ip.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))) BEGIN
							SET @err_str = 'The step%1 (%2) on this job (wo_id: %3, oper_id: %4, seq_no: %5) is configured as repeatable steps, and a production is not reported for this lot: %6. A production must be reported for all the lots in the repeatable step.{3861},' + STR(@step_no) + ',' + @step_desc + ',' + @in_wo_id + ',' + @in_oper_id + ',' + STR(@in_seq_no) + ',' + COALESCE(@lot_no, 'NULL')
							RAISERROR(@err_str, 16, 1, @@error)
							RETURN -1
						END
					END
					CLOSE job_step_data_csr
					DEALLOCATE job_step_data_csr
				END
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE job_step_csr
	DEALLOCATE job_step_csr
END

-- Module Name	      - sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_ValidateStart
-- Description	      - Validate on MES configuration Level the Start of a Job
/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_ValidateStart]
-- Description: Used on JOB AUT interface to validate the job will start in MES after AUT comm
--
-- Based on logic from:
--	sp_U_Job_Exec_StartJob version: 05/21/2020	Raghu G		6.2	US-1312889
--  sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJob version: 02/12/2020	Srinivas	    6.2	        US:1194084
--
--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to validate the job can be started after communication with AUT
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author  Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 	Change description
-- 0.01.00	JSC   	2025-06-16   		CR512: Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_Job_Exec_ValidateStart] (
 @ent_id		INT32
,@user_id 		STRING40
,@wo_id			STRING40
,@oper_id		STRING40
,@seq_no		INT32
,@job_pos		INT32 = 0
,@check_privs		INT32 = NULL
,@check_certs		INT32 = NULL
,@event_time_local  	TDATETIME = NULL
,@job_start_utc		TDATETIME = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = NULL
,@validation_message NVARCHAR(2000) = NULL OUTPUT
,@validation_status INT = -1 OUTPUT
) AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @cur_state_cd 		INT32
		,@process_id 		STRING40
		,@wo_item_id		STRING40
		,@job_item_id		STRING40
		,@certs_ok 		INT32
		,@runjobs_priv 		INT32
		,@runjobs_priv_id	INT32
		,@newjob_priv_id	INT32
		,@uncompletejob_priv_id	INT32
		,@session_id            INT32
		,@current_time_utc	TDATETIME = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE())
		,@err_str    NVARCHAR(400)
		,@Concurrent_Link		INT32
		,@available_job_pos		INT32

	-- Set it to error, and only fix if otherwise
	SET @validation_status = -1

	--Apply all defaults. Default the bias value if not supplied.
	IF (@job_start_utc IS NULL AND @event_time_local IS NOT NULL)
		--Use the job_start_utc if supplied (override the event_time_local time)
		SET @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@ent_id, @event_time_local, @current_time_utc)

	--Default the job start utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
	SET @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_start_utc, @current_time_utc))

	--Verify whether the job start time is greater than the current utc time
	IF (@job_start_utc > @current_time_utc)
		--If it is, default to the current utc time
		SET @job_start_utc = @current_time_utc

    IF NOT EXISTS (select * from ent (NOLOCK) where ent_id= @ent_id)
    BEGIN
	 SET @err_str = 'The supplied entity:' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id) + ' does not exist in the database.{7557},' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ent_id)
     SET @validation_message = @err_str
     RETURN
    END

	--Retrieve the status of the current job, and concurrent link no.  to identify whether the current job is linked to a batch or not.
	--Verify whether the current job to start is linked to a batch.
	SELECT @concurrent_link = concurrent_link
	FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

	if(@concurrent_link is null)
	BEGIN
	  SET @err_str = 'The specified job does not exist in the database.(wo-id'+COALESCE(@wo_id,'')+';oper_id='+COALESCE(@oper_id,'')+';seq_no='+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) +'){3176},(wo_id='+ COALESCE(@wo_id,'') + ';oper_id=' + COALESCE(@oper_id,'') + ';seq_no='+ CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @seq_no) +')'
	  SET @validation_message = @err_str
	  RETURN
	END

	IF (@concurrent_link = 0) BEGIN
		SET @available_job_pos = @job_pos

		IF (@available_job_pos IS NULL) BEGIN
			--If the supplied job pos is null, then determine the available job position to start this job.
			EXEC sp_SA_Job_Exec_GetAvailJobPos @ent_id, @available_job_pos OUTPUT

			--If job positions are NOT available, then raise an error.
			IF (@available_job_pos = -1) BEGIN
				SET @validation_message ='You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}'
				RETURN
			END
		END
			
	
		-- Default any null input params
		SELECT @check_certs = COALESCE(@check_certs, 0), @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 0)
		--Default the job start utc time to the current time if not supplied.  Trim down the milli seconds
			, @job_start_utc = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(COALESCE(@job_start_utc, @current_time_utc))

		--Verify whether the job start time is greater than the current utc time
		IF (@job_start_utc > @current_time_utc)
			--If it is, default to the current utc time
			SET @job_start_utc = @current_time_utc

		--Modified by Raghu on 08/28/2003. (HD# 3575). Disallow starting of any work order's job if the work order state is closed.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 3) BEGIN
			SET @validation_message ='Cannot start the job from the closed work order{4109}'
			RETURN
		END

		IF(@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			-- Get the sessionId from the sysprocesses table
			SELECT @session_id  = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WHERE spid =  @@spid
			--Retrieve the current user from the session context.
			-- Get user id from sessn when @session_id is between -1 to -9 (reserved for custom implementations) or positive number
				IF(@session_id >= -9) BEGIN
					SELECT @user_id = s.user_id
					FROM sessn s WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE s.session_id = @session_id
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT @user_id = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@session_id)-10
				END

			--This will not help the UCO, however, since setting the operator production attribute does not set a current user
			--for the session.  It does however log that user in to the labor_usage table, and log any other user out.
			--So the next choice would be the first current  user found in the labor_usage table for the job
			--if there is one.  The �current user found in the labor_usage table� would be the one where duration was 0,
			--as terminating a labor_usage record sets the duration.
			IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				SELECT @user_id  = MAX(el.user_id)
				FROM ent_logon el WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE el.session_id = @session_id
				  AND el.ent_id = @ent_id
			END
			-- If there is no current user for the job either, use the background user (identified by system attribute 199).
			IF (@user_id IS NULL) BEGIN
				SELECT @user_id  = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 199
			END
		END

		-- If the check_privs flag is set check that this user may start a job
		IF (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
			-- Get this user's Priv to Run Jobs here
			SET @runjobs_priv_id = 62
			EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @runjobs_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
			IF @runjobs_priv = 0 BEGIN
				SET @validation_message ='This user does not have the privilege to Run Jobs{3174}'
				RETURN
			END
		END

		-- Check that a job is NOT already running on the entity
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE je.ent_id = @ent_id AND je.job_pos = @job_pos
				  AND je.cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @validation_message ='You are trying to run more jobs on this entity than it allows to be run simultaneously.  You need to either stop one or more jobs if any are currently running, or start a job that does not have as many other jobs linked to it, or change the entity''s setup to allow more jobs to be run at the same time.{3175}'
			RETURN
		END

		SELECT @cur_state_cd = NULL, @job_item_id = NULL
		SELECT @cur_state_cd = state_cd, @job_item_id = item_id
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
		IF (@cur_state_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
			SET @validation_message ='The specified job does not exist in the database{3176}'
			RETURN
		END

		-- Get the process_id and item_id values from the WO table if certification checks are required
		IF @check_certs = 1 BEGIN
			SET @certs_ok = 1
			SELECT @process_id = process_id, @wo_item_id = item_id FROM wo  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			-- Now call SP to check if this user is certified to start this job (oper and item checks only)
			-- Need to get back @certs_ok here
			EXECUTE @certs_ok = sp_Cert_Start_Allowed @user_id, @process_id, @oper_id, NULL, @wo_item_id, @time_zone_bias_value

			-- Check result - passed as output parameter ?
			IF @certs_ok <> 0 BEGIN
				SET @validation_message ='This user is not certified to run this job'
				RETURN
			END
		END

		-- Check that the job's state makes it startable
		IF @cur_state_cd = 4
		BEGIN
		  IF @check_privs = 1
		  BEGIN
			SET @uncompletejob_priv_id = 41
			EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @uncompletejob_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
			IF (@runjobs_priv = 0) BEGIN
			  SET @validation_message ='This user does not have the privilege to Uncomplete a job{3177}'
			  RETURN
			END
		  END  --End of @check_privs = 1
		END  --End of @cur_state_cd = 4
		ELSE IF @cur_state_cd = 6
		BEGIN
		  IF @check_privs = 1  --on-hold job
		  BEGIN  -- check for on-hold job privs 01/30/03 - SJ
			SET @uncompletejob_priv_id = 180  -- May Change Hold Status<1861>
			EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @uncompletejob_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
			IF (@runjobs_priv = 0) BEGIN
			  SET @validation_message ='This user does not have the privilege to start a job that is on hold{3525}'
			  RETURN
			END  END  --End of @check_privs = 1
		END  --  End of @cur_state_cd = 6
		ELSE IF @cur_state_cd NOT IN (1,2,5)
		BEGIN
		  SET @validation_message ='The specified job must be NEW or READY or SUSPENDED for it to be started{3178}'
		  RETURN
		END

		--Below line is modified by Raghu on 12/23/2002. @cur_state_cd <> 1 is changed to @cur_state_cd = 1. The below check needs to be done only for the NEW job
		-- If the job's state is NEW and the check_privs flag is set check that this user may start a NEW job
		IF (@cur_state_cd = 1) AND (@check_privs = 1) BEGIN
			-- Check this user's Priv to start a NEW job here
			SET @newjob_priv_id = 64
			EXECUTE sp_S_Grp_Priv_Link_GetPriv @user_id, @newjob_priv_id, @runjobs_priv OUTPUT
			IF @runjobs_priv = 0 BEGIN
				SET @validation_message ='This user does not have the privilege to start a NEW job{3179}'
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END
	PRINT 'ALL OK'
	SET @validation_message ='Validation OK'
	SET @validation_status = 5
RETURN
END
