CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetValue]
(@in_session_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_ent_id			INT32 = NULL
,@in_kpi_type			INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_time_unit		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_start_time		INT32 = NULL
,@in_filter_end_time		INT32 = NULL
,@kpi_value			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@availability			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@quality			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@performance			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@total_runtime			TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@total_downtime		TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@total_qty_good		TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
,@total_qty_rejected		TFLOAT = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - SP_SA_OEE_EXEC_GETVALUE
-- Description       - Used to measure KPI type.
-- Author           - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/19/2008
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.5
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Group Plc. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver    Changes
--	10/09/2008		Raghu			3.4	L00085379; Filter start and end times for OEE_Exec.GetValue and Util_Log.GetCountsAndDuration need special interpretation when time unit is other than hours.
--  01/18/2012    Ashish            4.0 SP1 Modified HF CR 118175
--  11/21/2012    Ashish           4.6 Modified for backlog CR-L00123059 ,For line level OEE, the production and utilization entities could be different than the line entity itself
--10/11/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
-- 11/30/2017	Raghu G		6.0	UserStory-714529 - [Enhancement] As SE, I want to fix CR L00138956 so that OEE values are returned for short time periods without distinct production records
-- 06/24/2020   Srinivasa   6.2 US#1331560 I want to merge L00158763 (HF CR L00157586 : Removed byproducts from calculations)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE  @err_msg				NVARCHAR(4000)
		,@start				TDATETIME2
		,@end				TDATETIME2
		,@util_ent_id			INT32
		,@job_ent_id			INT32
		,@current_time_utc		TDATETIME2 = GETUTCDATE()
		,@util_start_event_time_utc	TDATETIME2
		,@ret				INT32

		,@total_qtys			TFLOAT
		,@total_times			TFLOAT
		,@performance_by_prod_rate	TFLOAT

		,@prod_start_time_utc		TDATETIME2

BEGIN
	IF (@in_ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},ENT_ID';
        	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@in_kpi_type IS NULL) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = '%1 may not be empty{5413},KPI_TYPE'
        	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END
	ELSE IF (@in_kpi_type < 0 OR @in_kpi_type > 3) BEGIN
		SET @err_msg = 'The ''%1'' must be in the range %2-%3{3356},KPI_TYPE,0,3'
        	RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	EXEC @ret = sp_SA_KPI_GetStartEndTimes @ent_id=@in_ent_id, @filter_time_unit=@in_filter_time_unit
		, @filter_start_time=@in_filter_start_time, @filter_end_time=@in_filter_end_time
		, @start_time_utc=@start OUTPUT, @end_time_utc=@end OUTPUT
		, @prod_start_time_utc=@prod_start_time_utc OUTPUT

	IF (@ret = -1) RETURN

	SELECT @util_ent_id = oee.util_ent_id, @job_ent_id = oee.job_ent_id
	FROM oee_exec oee WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oee.ent_id = @in_ent_id

	IF (@in_kpi_type IN (0,2,3)) BEGIN --2:Availability, 3:Performance, 0:OEE

		--Get the starting event from the start time
		SELECT @util_start_event_time_utc = MAX(uh.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh.ent_id = @util_ent_id
		  AND uh.event_time_utc <= @start

		SET @util_start_event_time_utc = COALESCE(@util_start_event_time_utc, @start)

		--Get machine availability using time filters.
		SELECT @total_runtime = SUM(CASE WHEN vuht.runtime = 1 THEN vuht.duration - CASE WHEN vuht.event_time_utc < @start THEN DATEDIFF(SS, vuht.event_time_utc, @start) ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN vuht.event_end_time_utc > @end THEN DATEDIFF(SS, @end, vuht.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END)
			,@total_downtime = SUM(CASE WHEN vuht.downtime = 1 THEN vuht.duration - CASE WHEN vuht.event_time_utc < @start THEN DATEDIFF(SS, vuht.event_time_utc, @start) ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN vuht.event_end_time_utc > @end THEN DATEDIFF(SS, @end, vuht.event_end_time_utc) ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END)
		FROM vw_util_history_times vuht WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE vuht.ent_id = @util_ent_id
		  AND vuht.event_time_utc >= @util_start_event_time_utc
		  AND vuht.event_time_utc < @end
		  AND (vuht.runtime = 1 OR vuht.downtime = 1)

		--Default the runtime and downtime duration to 0, if they are null
		SELECT @total_runtime = COALESCE(@total_runtime, 0), @total_downtime = COALESCE(@total_downtime, 0)

		--If the sum of total runtime and total downtime is zero, set the availability to 1 to avoid divide by zero error
		SET @total_times = @total_runtime + @total_downtime

		IF (@total_times) = 0 SET @availability = 1

		--Calculate the machine availability
		ELSE SET @availability = @total_runtime / @total_times

		IF (@in_kpi_type = 2) BEGIN --  ONLY report Machine Availability.
			SET @kpi_value = @availability
			RETURN
		END
	END

	IF (@in_kpi_type = 1) BEGIN -- ONLY report quality
		SELECT @total_qty_good = SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 1 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END)
			, @total_qty_rejected = SUM(CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 0 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END)
		FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ip.ent_id = @job_ent_id AND ip.byproduct = 0
		  AND ip.created_at_utc >= @prod_start_time_utc
		  --The production must be accounted less than end time.
		  --For example, let's say the end time is 10:00a. In the calculation, the production counts must be before 10a, since the 10a production will be included in the next time range.
		  AND ip.created_at_utc < @end

		SELECT @total_qty_good = COALESCE(@total_qty_good, 0), @total_qty_rejected = COALESCE(@total_qty_rejected, 0)

        	SET @total_qtys = @total_qty_good + @total_qty_rejected

		IF (@total_qtys = 0)
			SET @quality = 1 -- Changed for HF CR 118175
		ELSE
			SET @quality = @total_qty_good / @total_qtys

		SET @kpi_value = @quality

		RETURN
	END

	--3:Performance, 0:OEE
	SELECT @total_qty_good = SUM(prod.qty_good), @total_qty_rejected = SUM(prod.qty_reject)
		,@performance_by_prod_rate = SUM(CASE WHEN prod.batch_size = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CEILING((prod.qty_good + prod.qty_reject)/ prod.batch_size) * dbo.fn_ConvertProdRateToHrsPerBatch(prod.est_prod_rate, prod.prod_uom) END)
	FROM
		(SELECT ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no, j.batch_size, COALESCE(j.est_prod_rate, 1) AS est_prod_rate
			, COALESCE(j.prod_uom, 1) AS prod_uom
			,CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 1 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END AS qty_good
			,CASE WHEN ip.good_prod = 0 THEN ip.qty_prod ELSE 0 END AS qty_reject
		FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no
		WHERE ip.ent_id = @job_ent_id AND ip.byproduct = 0
		  AND ip.created_at_utc >= @prod_start_time_utc
		  --The production must be accounted less than end time.
		  --For example, let's say the end time is 10:00a. In the calculation, the production counts must be before 10a, since the 10a production will be included in the next time range.
		  AND ip.created_at_utc < @end
		) prod

		--If the total duration of runtime is zero, set the performance to 1 to avoid divide by zero error
		IF (@total_runtime = 0) SET @performance = 1
		ELSE  --Calculate the performance
			SET @performance = @performance_by_prod_rate /  (@total_runtime / 3600.0)

	IF (@in_kpi_type = 3) BEGIN -- Report PERFORMANCE
		SET @kpi_value = @performance
		RETURN
	END

	-- Report OEE
	SELECT @total_qty_good = COALESCE(@total_qty_good, 0)
		,@total_qty_rejected = COALESCE(@total_qty_rejected, 0)

	SET @total_qtys = @total_qty_good + @total_qty_rejected

	IF (@total_qtys = 0) SET @quality = 1 -- Changed for HF CR 118175
	ELSE SET @quality = @total_qty_good / @total_qtys

	SET @kpi_value = @performance * @availability * @quality
END

-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch recipe version number filter by item_id and ent_id

-- Usage:		AddMasterRecipe
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-08-19			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetListRecipeVersion]
(@item_id		NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@ent_id			INT = NULL
) AS
BEGIN

	-- Get list recipe version number for ent_id and item id
	SELECT 
		version
	FROM ofi_master_recipe WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE 
		(item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
		AND (ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
	GROUP BY version
	ORDER BY version ASC

END

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_I_BOM_ITEM_OPER_SPEC

-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0  Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1600   Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  20024  HD# 4414 Maintain oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT

-- 10/01/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1084805 - As Terry, I want the upgrade to modify the document / file stored procedures so that my existing configuration is still valid (Part 1)
-- 10/25/2018	RWB			6.1 UserStory:1084807 - added a check for a null assoc_file and only added the file type to the file_type table if the assoc_file is not null
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
	    ,@data_type		INT
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32

	,@assoc_file_type	NVARCHAR(254)

SELECT @data_type = data_type FROM spec WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spec_id = @spec_id

IF (@data_type = 1) BEGIN
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@spec_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},spec_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@min_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},min_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN

	IF ISNUMERIC(ISNULL(@max_value, -1)) = 0 BEGIN
		RAISERROR ('The %1 Should be Numeric{3341},max_value', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
END

IF (@assoc_file IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SET @assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(@assoc_file)
	EXEC sp_I_File_Type @file_ext=@assoc_file_type, @file_desc=NULL, @edit_level=NULL, @view_level=NULL, @print_level=NULL
		, @edit_args=NULL, @view_args=NULL, @print_args=NULL, @ignore_if_exists=1
		, @last_edit_comment=NULL, @last_edit_at=@ftle OUTPUT
END

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

BEGIN
  INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_spec (item_id,
  ver_id,
  bom_pos,
  process_id,
  oper_id,
  step_no,
  spec_ver_id,
  spec_id,
  spec_value,
  assoc_file,
  assoc_file_type,
  comments,
  min_value,
  max_value,
  access_level,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,
  last_edit_at)
  VALUES
  (@item_id,
   @ver_id,
   @bom_pos,
   @process_id,
   @oper_id,
   @step_no,
   @spec_ver_id,
   @spec_id,
   @spec_value,
   @assoc_file,
   @assoc_file_type,
   @comments,
   @min_value,
   @max_value,
   @access_level,
   @last_edit_comment,
   @last_edit_by,
   @last_edit_at)

  --update spec version date automatically
	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

  UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @current_time, last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment, last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
  WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    AND ver_id = @spec_ver_id

  -- Return timestamp
  --SET @mod_id = (select CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE (item_id = @item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND bom_pos = @bom_pos AND process_id = @process_id
      AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no AND spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id AND spec_id = @spec_id)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Assigned_Lot_UpdateStatus]
(@item_id         STRING40
,@lot_no          STRING40
,@sublot_no       STRING40
,@wo_id           STRING40
,@oper_id         STRING40
,@seq_no          INT32
,@total_qty_prod  TFLOAT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        -  SP_U_ASSIGNED_LOT_UPDATESTATUS
-- Description        -  HD# 9727, Updates the status on to the assigned_lot table.
-- Author          -  Raghu
-- Date Created          -   04/18/2007
-- Version          - 3.2.9
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
--01/24/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00074319; Error in the Update method of the Item_Prod.Update
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE  @final_job       INT32
	,@row_count       INT32
	,@status          INT32
BEGIN
	SET @final_job = 0

	--Verify whether the supplied job is a final job.
	SELECT @final_job = j.final_job
	FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

	--Update the status for the work order level lots.
	IF (@final_job = 0 OR @total_qty_prod < 1) BEGIN
		--Verify whether the quantity is equal to 0 (ie., the quantity is reduced or rolled back)
		IF (@total_qty_prod <= 0)
			--This is not a final job; or the quantity produced in the final job is 0
			--then set the state of the assigned lot belongs to this work order to 0 (in process)
			UPDATE assigned_lot
			SET status = 0  --unstarted.
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND lot_no = @lot_no
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND oper_id IS NULL
		ELSE
			--This is not a final job; or the quantity produced in the final job is less than 1.
			--then set the state of the assigned lot belongs to this work order to 1 (in process)
			UPDATE assigned_lot
			SET status = 1
			WHERE item_id = @item_id
			  AND lot_no = @lot_no
			  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
			  AND wo_id = @wo_id
			  AND oper_id IS NULL
	END
	ELSE
		--This is the final job; and the total quantity produced on this lot is equal to 1.
		--Set the state of the assigned lot belongs to the work order level to 2 (Done).
		UPDATE assigned_lot
		SET status = 2
		WHERE item_id = @item_id
		  AND lot_no = @lot_no
		  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND oper_id IS NULL

	--Determine the status to update (no matter whether it is for an individual job or for the work order).
	IF (@total_qty_prod <= 0)
		--The total quantity produced is less than 0; Set the status to unstarted.
		SET @status = 0 -- unstarted
	ELSE IF (@total_qty_prod > 0 AND @total_qty_prod < 1)
		--The total quantity produced is less than 1; set the status of the lot as in_process
		SET @status = 1 -- in_process
	ELSE
		--The total quantity produced is equal to 1; set the status of the lot as done; as we are done with this lot.
		SET @status = 2 -- done

	--Update the assigned lot status to an individual job.
        --First, try to find the supplied job assinged to the assigned lot table and update
	UPDATE assigned_lot
	SET status = @status
	WHERE item_id = @item_id
	  AND lot_no = @lot_no
	  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no = @seq_no

	--If we have more than 1 operations; then we get an error
	--If there exists an assigned lot record for this work order and the same oper_id,
	--its status is set to 1 if the total production is less than 1, or 2 if the total production equals 1.
	--If there is more than one record with the same wo_id and oper_id as the current job,
	--the one with the seq_no matching that of the current job is the one updated.
	UPDATE assigned_lot
	SET status = @status
	WHERE item_id = @item_id
	  AND lot_no = @lot_no
	  AND (sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
	  AND wo_id = @wo_id
	  AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND seq_no IS NULL
END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_production_conf
-- Description:  Returns the production confirmation for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-10-10		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Michal H    2024-09-02         Fix incorrect timestamp format - change the erroneous 12-hour format specifier ("hhmmss")
--                                         to the 24-hour format specifier ("HHmmss").
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_production_conf] as
begin

DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION

		declare @main_hu varchar(100),@wo_id varchar(100),@prod_bags_per_pallet varchar(10),@uom varchar(40),@item_id varchar(100),@row_id int
		SET @main_hu = ''
		Select top 1 @row_id = row_id, @wo_id = wo_id,@main_hu = spare2,@item_id = item_id from item_prod with (nolock) where qty_prod_erp < qty_prod and spare2 is not null
		SET @prod_bags_per_pallet = 0
		Select @prod_bags_per_pallet = bags_per_pallet from ofi_wo_ext with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id

		IF @main_hu <> ''
		BEGIN
			Select @uom = u.description from item i with (nolock) inner join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id = u.uom_id where item_id = @item_id

			Select @main_hu Handling_Unit_Number,@wo_id Order_Number, '' Batch_Maker_Number, 
			@prod_bags_per_pallet Produced_Numberofbagsonpallet, sum(qty_prod) Quantity, @uom  Unit_Of_Measure,
			@item_id SAP_MaterialCode_Number, Format(min(created_at_local),'yyyyddMM') Production_startdate,
			Format(min(created_at_local),'HHmmss') Production_starttime,Format(max(created_at_local),'yyyyddMM') Production_enddate,
			Format(max(created_at_local),'HHmmss') Production_endtime,max(lot_no) SAP_Batch_Number,Format(GETDATE(),'yyyyddMM') File_Generation_Date,
			Format(GETDATE(),'HHmmss') File_Generation_Time, '' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
			from item_prod with (nolock) where row_id = @row_id --wo_id = @wo_id and spare2 = @main_hu 
			group by wo_id,spare2

			Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = qty_prod where row_id = @row_id --wo_id = @wo_id and spare2 = @main_hu
		END
		ELSE
			PRINT 'Main HU missing - Row ' + cast(@row_id as varchar)

		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_S_OFI_GetBinReworkABA
-- Description:	to get the attr_value whether checked or not checked for ABA
-- 
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB				2024-03-27			Initial version
--===========================================================================================*/
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_OFI_GetBinReworkMaster]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@type nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare1 nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare2 nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare3 nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@spare4 nvarchar(50)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	if @type='BinReworkABA'
	BEGIN
		select ISNULL(wa.attr_value,0)as chkABA from wo_attr wa (nolock)
		inner join wo w (nolock) on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
		where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=@wo_id
	END
	
	if @type='GetBinConsMode'
	BEGIN
			select ea.attr_value as BinConsumptionMode from job  j (nolock)
		inner join ent e1 (nolock) on e1.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent e2  (nolock) on e2.ent_id=e1.parent_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr ea (nolock) on ea.ent_id=e2.ent_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.state_cd=3 and a.attr_desc='BinConsumptionMode'
	END

	if @type='AllowPalletConsumption'
	BEGIN
			declare @oper_id nvarchar(max),
			@seq_no int,
			@attr_id int
			select @oper_id=oper_id, @seq_no=seq_no from job (NOLOCK) where state_cd=3 and wo_id=@wo_id
			select @attr_id= ja.attr_id from job_attr ja (NOLOCK)
			inner join attr a (NOLOCK) on ja.attr_id=a.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc='AllowPalletConsumption'

			select pa.attr_value from process_attr pa inner join attr a on a.attr_id=pa.attr_id 
				inner join oper o on o.process_id=pa.process_id
				inner join job j on j.oper_id=o.oper_id
			where a.attr_desc='AllowPalletConsumption' and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no


	END
	if @type='validDumpingOnScan'
	BEGIN
		SELECT ISNULL((select attr_value from job j (nolock)
		inner join job_attr ja (nolock) on ja.wo_id=j.wo_id and ja.oper_id=j.oper_id and ja.seq_no=j.seq_no
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ja.attr_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='isDumping' and j.state_cd=3),0) as isDumping
	END

	if @type='chkDumping'
	BEGIN
		if exists(select 1  from job j (nolock)
		inner join job_attr ja (nolock) on ja.wo_id=j.wo_id and ja.oper_id=j.oper_id and ja.seq_no=j.seq_no
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ja.attr_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='isDumping')
		BEGIN
				select top 1 isNULL(attr_value,1) as isDumping  from job j (nolock)
				inner join job_attr ja (nolock) on ja.wo_id=j.wo_id and ja.oper_id=j.oper_id and ja.seq_no=j.seq_no
				inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ja.attr_id
				where j.wo_id=@wo_id and a.attr_desc='isDumping' order by ja.last_edit_at desc
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			
			DECLARE	
			@mod_id varchar(30)
			select @spare1=oper_id, @spare2=seq_no from job (nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id and state_cd=3
			select @spare3=attr_id from attr (nolock) where attr_desc='isDumping'

			EXEC [dbo].[sp_I_Job_Attr]
			@wo_id =@wo_id,
			@oper_id =@spare1,
			@seq_no = @spare2,
			@attr_id = @spare3,
			@attr_value = '1',
			@notes = NULL,
			@last_edit_comment = NULL,
			@mod_id = @mod_id OUTPUT

			SELECT	@mod_id as N'@mod_id'
		END

	END

	if @type='ReworkBinItem'
	BEGIN
		select ea.attr_value as ReworkBinItem,i.item_desc,u.description,i.num_decimals from job j (nolock)
		inner join ent e (nolock) on e.ent_id=j.target_sched_ent_id
		inner join ent e1 (nolock) on e1.ent_id=e.parent_ent_id
		inner join ent_attr ea (nolock) on ea.ent_id=e1.ent_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
		inner join item i (nolock) on i.item_id=ea.attr_value
		inner join uom u (nolock) on i.uom_id=u.uom_id
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.state_cd=3 and a.attr_desc='ReworkBinItem'
	END

	if @type='AllowReworkD'
	BEGIN
		
	

		exec SP_SA_OFI_BinAreaLine @wo_id=@wo_id ,@reworkItem=@spare1
	END
	if @type='GetCurAllowBinAssign'
	BEGIN
		select wa.attr_value as chckCurABA from wo_attr wa  (nolock)
			inner join wo w (nolock) on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
			inner join attr a  (nolock) on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=@wo_id

	END

	if @type='ValidateWOExistConsumption'
	BEGIN
				--test variables that will be using spare fields
				--declare @originArea INT =293,
				--@collectionstarttime nvarchar(50)='06/10/2024 22:00:00',
				--@collectionendtime nvarchar(50)='06/12/2024 22:00:00',
				--@item_id nvarchar (20)='100000095378'

				declare @originArea INT =CONVERT(INT,@spare1),
				@collectionstarttime nvarchar(50)=@spare2,
				@collectionendtime nvarchar(50)=@spare3,
				@item_id nvarchar (20)=@spare4


				DECLARE @OriginEntities as table (ent_id INT)

				declare
				  @date_from datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @collectionStartTime),
				  @date_to datetime = CONVERT(datetime, @collectionEndTime)

				INSERT INTO @OriginEntities select ent.ent_id
						FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON ent.ent_id = ea.ent_id
						INNER JOIN attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = attr.attr_id
						WHERE attr_desc = 'EntityType'
						AND ea.attr_value IN ('Segment')
						AND (ent.parent_ent_id=@originArea or ent.parent_ent_id in (select ent_id from ent where parent_ent_id=@originArea))


				;with cte_wo as (select wxt.wo_id from ofi_wo_item_ext wxt
				Inner join wo WITH (NOLOCK) on wxt.wo_id=wo.wo_id
				where 
				wxt.bom_pos < 0 
				AND wxt.item_id=@item_id
				and wo.state_cd IN (1, 2) -- (Started/Completed)
				),
				CTE_prod as (SELECT
					top 1 ip.ent_id,
							ip.wo_id,
						   ip.oper_id,
						   ip.seq_no,
						   j.state_cd,          
						   j.item_id,             
						   SUM(ip.qty_prod) qty_prod,
						   NULL as split_qty,
						   MAX(ip.lot_no) as lot_no,
						   MAX(IP.sublot_no) as sublot_no,
						   MAX(ip.shift_start_local) shift_start_local,
						   MAX(ip.hour_start_local) hour_start_local,
						   MAX(ip.created_at_utc) created_at_utc
					FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
					INNER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK)ON ip.wo_id = w.wo_id
					INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = j.wo_id  AND ip.oper_id = j.oper_id   AND ip.seq_no = j.seq_no
					INNER JOIN job_bom JB WITH(NOLOCK) on jb.wo_id=ip.wo_id and ip.oper_id=jb.oper_id and ip.seq_no=jb.seq_no and ip.item_id=jb.item_id 
					INNER JOIN @OriginEntities oe on ip.ent_id=oe.ent_id 
					Inner join cte_wo on ip.wo_id=cte_wo.wo_id
					WHERE	
					 jb.bom_pos=0
					AND w.state_cd IN (1, 2) -- (Started/Completed)    
				   AND j.state_cd IN (3, 4, 5)-- (RUNNING/COMPLETED/STOPPED)
					AND ip.created_at_utc BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to --date from and date to logic not yet added due to testing
					GROUP BY ip.wo_id,
							 ip.oper_id,
							 ip.seq_no,
							 j.item_id,           
							 j.state_cd,
							 ip.ent_id
							 )
			 
				SELECT ISNULL((select 1  from CTE_prod), 0) woExist
	END
END

/*
-- ==============================================================================================================
-- Name:  [sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJRHUData]
-- Description: Used to process the Job New HU request: RHU
--
--  JOB  New HU Request: RHU - AUT to MES
--
--	STEPS:
--	1 - Get current Job Pos from JOb_EXEC: SP_SA_JOB_EXEC_GETCURRJOBPOS
--  2 - Check pallet type; if NOT IN 1, 2 - Exit

--	FINISHED...


--
-- Usage: For AUT interface to insert the values from IDE JRSU object 
-- ================================================================================================================
-- Version		Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd) 		Change description
-- 0.01.00		XPM, AML   	2026-01-09   			 Initial version.
-- 0.01.01      XPM, AML    2026-01-12               Fixed the Generate HU no output and added specs to job_spec 
-- ================================================================================================================*/
CREATE             PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_ProcessJRHUData]
	@ObjectName NVARCHAR(60),
	@InterfaceType NVARCHAR(15) = 'JRHU',
	@message_output NVARCHAR(4000) = '' OUTPUT,
	@status_output INT = 1 OUTPUT, -- 5 ALL OK, 7 ERROR, 9 Warning-Inventory not created, 11 Warning (Processed but with warning),
	@row_id_output INT = -1 OUTPUT -- row ID -1 means not to be marked
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT OFF;

	DECLARE @ID_local INT = -1, 
			@Data_local NVARCHAR(4000) = '',
			@Error_local INT = 0,
			@cfg_status_error INT = 7,
			@cfg_status_warning_inventory INT = 9, --inventory
			@cfg_status_warning_processed INT = 11, -- but processed
			@cfg_status_OK INT = 5,
			@cfg_feedback_timeout INT = 30;

	DECLARE @TranCounter INT = @@TRANCOUNT;
	DECLARE @TranName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(CAST(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS NVARCHAR(50)),23)+ FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'HHmmssfff');
    DECLARE @SavePointName NVARCHAR(32) =  RIGHT(@TranName,29) + N'_' + CAST(@@NESTLEVEL AS NVARCHAR(3));

	SET @message_output = ''
	SET @status_output = 1
	SET @row_id_output = -1

	BEGIN TRY
		
		PRINT '@TranCounter: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@TranCounter)

		-- moved here
		IF @TranCounter = 0
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
		ELSE
			SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetNextRow]
			@ObjectName = @ObjectName,
			@InterfaceType = @InterfaceType,
			@ID = @ID_local OUTPUT,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @ID_local > 0
		BEGIN

			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@seq_no INT,													
					@last_hu_number NVARCHAR(40) = NULL, 
					@pallet_type INT, 	
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,	
					@debug INT = 1,
					@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@last_hu_number = last_hu_number
					,@pallet_type = pallet_type
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',	
				last_hu_number NVARCHAR(40) '$.last_hu_number', 
				pallet_type INT '$.pallet_type', 	
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME '$.recorded_timestamp' 
			);
	
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based) SEGMENT NAME_INTERFACETYPE_EXTRAINFO
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@ObjectName, CHARINDEX('_' + @InterfaceType, @ObjectName) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','entity name: '+@mes_parent_name)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'ent_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT: sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT
			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = wa.output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','wo_id: '+@wo_id)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				-- Message for erros; EXAMPLE USAGE
				-- set @notValidDescDetails = @notValidDescDetails + dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(300025,NULL,NULL)  --' Storage unit is locked for quality.'
				-- 3566	1	The specified %1 does not exist in the database.
				SET @message_output = REPLACE(dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3566,NULL,NULL),'%1','job')
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error 

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'oper_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			
			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @InterfaceType as interface_type, @ObjectName as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'				
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- Declare the outputs 
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				--,@data_job_qty_prod FLOAT
				--,@data_job_qty_reqd FLOAT
				--,@data_process_id nvarchar(40)
				--,@data_def_reas_cd INT
				--,@data_bom_pos	INT								
				--,@data_factor	FLOAT
				--,@data_thr_result	INT
				--,@data_to_item_id NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_lot_no NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_sublot_no NVARCHAR(40)	
				--,@data_to_qty FLOAT
				--,@data_edit_time DATETIME
				--,@data_max_capacity FLOAT
				--,@data_su_result INT
				--,@data_su_status NVARCHAR(40)
				--,@data_created_at_utc DATETIME

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT	@data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
					--,@data_process_id = process_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(3560,NULL,NULL)+'. wo_id: '+@wo_id
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'wo_error',@status_output
				END
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state, qty prod and qty req
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
					--,@data_job_qty_prod = j.qty_prod
					--,@data_job_qty_reqd = j.qty_reqd
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if JOB is new or ready ERROR; Else is not RUNNING (3) (nor new nor Ready) then WARNING  -- ,7,8,9
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED, 7, 8, 9 -- Avoid errors -- 4,5 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				-- Set output message and RETURN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500030,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
			BEGIN
				-- set output message WARNING
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500031,NULL,NULL)+' wo_id: '+@wo_id+' oper_id: '+@mes_oper_id+' and seq_no: '+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(3),ISNULL(@seq_no,0)) + '; state_cd: '+CAST(@data_job_state_cd as VARCHAR(1))				
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error										

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_error',@status_output
				END
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			IF @data_job_pos = -1
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(5438,NULL,NULL)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'job_pos_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- GET USER ID
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			-- Verify that we are not in TIMEOUT:
			
			-- Verify if we are OK within timeout margin of processing the message
			DECLARE @timeout_timestamp DATETIME
					,@curTime DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
			SET @recorded_timestamp = COALESCE(@recorded_timestamp,@current_timestamp) -- MOD: v1.03 swap places
			SET @timeout_timestamp = DATEADD(SECOND, @cfg_feedback_timeout, @recorded_timestamp)
			
			
			IF @curTime > @timeout_timestamp
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500040,NULL,NULL)+' @recorded_timestamp: '+ TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@recorded_timestamp,121) + '; @timeout_timestamp: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@timeout_timestamp,121)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'timeout_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			IF @pallet_type NOT IN (1, 2) --1 or 2 are good and rejected HU 
			BEGIN
				
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500043,NULL,NULL)+ '; @pallet_type: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1100),@pallet_type)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'bad_Status_error',@status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END


			DECLARE @GeneratedHUNumber TABLE (
                hunumber NVARCHAR(50),       
                dcs_number NVARCHAR(50),     
                rework_hunumber NVARCHAR(50),
                flush_hunumber NVARCHAR(50), 
                result INT                   
            );

            
            DECLARE @res_hunumber NVARCHAR(50),
                    @res_result INT,
					@res_dcs_number INT;

           PRINT 'Prior GeneratedHUnumber'

            INSERT INTO @GeneratedHUNumber
            EXECUTE [dbo].[SP_S_ofi_GenerateHUNumber] 
                        @HU_Type = @pallet_type
                       ,@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
                       ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
                       ,@seq_no = @seq_no;


			SELECT TOP 1 
                   @res_hunumber = hunumber,
                   @res_result = result,
				   @res_dcs_number = TRY_CONVERT(INT,dcs_number)
            FROM @GeneratedHUNumber;

            -- Check if there are any errors
            IF @res_result = -1 OR @res_hunumber IS NULL
			BEGIN
			    -- 100010 is the error code for no HU
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(100010,NULL,NULL) + ' HU Gen Error. Result: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @res_result)
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

				IF @debug = 1 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @message_output as 'hu_gen_error', @status_output
				END

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END	 



			DECLARE @spec_id_local NVARCHAR(40);

			IF @pallet_type = 1
			BEGIN
				SET @spec_id_local = 'GoodHU' 

				--if validation is OK we now can create a new Sublot				
				EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Sublot_Attr] 
						@wo_id = @mes_wo_id
						,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
						,@seq_no = @seq_no
						,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
						,@eventName = 'GOODHU'
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @spec_id_local = 'RejectedHU'
			END

			--DECLARE @rc INT;

			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_Job_Spec] -- No output expected
					@wo_id = @mes_wo_id ,
  					@oper_id = @mes_oper_id ,
 					@seq_no = @seq_no ,
  					@step_no = -1,
   					@spec_id = @spec_id_local ,
   					@act_spec_value = @res_dcs_number


			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN 
				PRINT '@mes_wo_id: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@mes_wo_id)
				PRINT '@mes_oper_id: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@mes_oper_id)
				PRINT '@seq_no: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@seq_no)
				PRINT '@spec_id: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@spec_id_local)
				PRINT '@act_spec_value: ' + TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40),@res_dcs_number)
			END

				

			--UPDATE job_spec
			--SET act_spec_value = @res_dcs_number
			--	,spec_value  = @res_dcs_number
			--WHERE 	(wo_id = @mes_wo_id AND
			--		oper_id = @mes_oper_id AND
			--		seq_no = @seq_no AND
			--		step_no = -1 AND
			--		spec_id = @spec_id_local )

		
			-- Do the final part prior to exiting the process
			Finishing_OK:

			PRINT 'Finishing OK'

			-- Mark OK as output if nothing failed
			IF @status_output = 1 
			BEGIN
				-- SET OK
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_OK
				SET @message_output =  dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500039,NULL,NULL)
			END

			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = dbo.fn_s_ofi_getLangString(500020,NULL,NULL) + CAST(ISNULL(@Error_local,'3000') AS VARCHAR(32))
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = 'Nothing found'	
				SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		-- Exit place
		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
		SET @status_output = @cfg_status_error

		SET @message_output = @message_output + @message


		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				,@status_output as status_output
				,@message_output as message_output

		BEGIN TRY
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			-- Find the last opening brace
			DECLARE @start INT = LEN(@message_output) - CHARINDEX('{', REVERSE(@message_output)) + 1;

			-- Find the corresponding closing brace
			DECLARE @end INT = CHARINDEX('}', @message_output, @start);

			-- Remove the substring if both braces are found
			IF @start > 0 AND @end > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @message_output = STUFF(@message_output, @start, @end - @start + 1, '');
			END

			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@status_output)+';message_output:'+@message_output
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
					,@status_output as status_output
					,@message_output as message_output
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

-- Procedure definition

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr]
(
		@wo_id				STRING80 = NULL
	,	@oper_id			STRING80 = NULL
	,	@seq_no				INT32 = NULL
	,	@attr_id			INT32	= NULL
	,	@remove_attr_col	LOGICAL = 0
	,	@remove_job			LOGICAL = 0

)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name				- sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr
-- Description				- HD# 6192, Update Queue Job Attribute table automatically based on the attribute or job_attribute changes.
-- Author					- Raghu
-- Date Created				- 11/14/2005
-- Version					- 3.1.2
--
-- Copyright (C) 2019 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver		Changes
-- 11/22/2005		Raghu		3.1.3	Modifications related to handle quotes on item_id or attribute description.
-- 02/06/2007		Raghu		3.2.0	HD# 9207, Part of DB Changes
-- 07/26/2007		AML			3.3.0	DB Changes; added _h to all occurrences of queue_job_attr.queue_job_wo_id,
--										queue_job_attr.queue_job_oper_id, and queue_job_attr.queue_job_seq_no.
--01/06/2008		Raghu		3.4	L00073212, L00073016: Exclude column names that starts with the table name
--08/07/2012		Arun		4.5	Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
--06/03/2015        Srinivas    6.2 CR L00136163.attr# column type changed to store 1700 characters for attribute value.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
--WARNING: Caller should call this procedure ONLY AFTER finishing all his/her transactions.
--Any exception/error raised from the caller procedure must be rolled back there itself and the call should not
--enter here. Since DDL operations are involved here such as adding additional columns OR dropping columns, all
--the transactions for this session are commited automatically; and any errors from the calling procedures may
--NOT get rolled back.
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE	@col_name		STRING80
		,	@col_id			INT32
		,	@desc_col_names	NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@desc_vals		NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@SQL			NVARCHAR(4000)
		,	@attr_id_col	STRING80
		,	@attr_desc		STRING80
		,	@attr_value		STRING1700
		,	@attr_id_temp	INT32
		,	@dummy_val		NVARCHAR(1)

	-- do nothing if nothing is supplied. Proceed ONLY if a job OR attr_id or both are supplied.
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL AND @attr_id IS NULL)  RETURN

	SELECT @remove_attr_col = ISNULL(@remove_attr_col, 0), @remove_job = ISNULL(@remove_job, 0)

	--Check if the call is to remove an attribute column.
	IF (@remove_attr_col = 1) BEGIN
		IF (@attr_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
			SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
				  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN
				--Since the supplied attribute column exists, remove this attribute column
				--from the queue_job_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_job_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

				--Also, remove the attr_id_d_h column from the queue_job_attr table.
				SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_job_attr DROP COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
			END

			--Check if any attributes are made visible in the queue. If none of the attributes are made
			--visible for the queue, then remove all the job attributes from the queue_job_attr table.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
				WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
				  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
				  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0)
				--DELETE jobs from the queue_job_attr table where job equals:
				--i) There are no attributes exist for this job
				--ii) or there are no attributes for this job that can be made visible in the queue.
				DELETE FROM queue_job_attr
				FROM
					(SELECT qja.queue_job_wo_id_h, qja.queue_job_oper_id_h, qja.queue_job_seq_no_h
					FROM job_attr ja
					INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
							FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
							AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
					  		AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON ja.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
					RIGHT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h = ja.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h = ja.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h = ja.seq_no
					WHERE ja.wo_id IS NULL) queue_attr
				WHERE queue_job_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h = queue_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h = queue_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h
				  AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h = queue_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h
			ELSE
				--Delete all the rows from the queue_job_attr table.
				--i) either there are no attributes assigned for any job
				--ii)or there no attributes that are made visible in the queue for any jobs.
				DELETE FROM queue_job_attr
		END
		RETURN
	END

	--Check whether the supplied attribute can be included in the queue.
	SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr
	WHERE attr_id = @attr_id AND visible_in_queue = 1

	--Do nothing if the current attribute cannot be included for the queue.
	IF (@attr_desc IS NULL) RETURN

	--Generate a list of all attribute description columns.
	SET @desc_col_names = ''

	--Handle the job first to insert a new row in the queue_job_attr table for jobs.
	--do this ONLY if the supplied job is not null AND we are inserting or updating a job attribute
	IF (@remove_job = 0) AND (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM queue_job_attr WHERE queue_job_wo_id_h = @wo_id AND queue_job_oper_id_h = @oper_id AND queue_job_seq_no_h = @seq_no) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM queue_job_attr) BEGIN
			DECLARE queue_job_attr_col_csr CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT name, colid
			FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
			ORDER BY colid

			OPEN queue_job_attr_col_csr
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM queue_job_attr_col_csr INTO @col_name, @col_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				--Generate a list of all attribute description columns; since this is a non-null column in the database.
				IF CHARINDEX('d_h', @col_name) > 0
					SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @col_name + ','
			END
			CLOSE queue_job_attr_col_csr
			DEALLOCATE queue_job_attr_col_csr

			--Atleast if any 1 row exists for the queue_job_attr, then duplicate that row for the new job
			--SELECT * FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = ',' + LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') BEGIN
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO queue_job_attr (queue_job_wo_id_h,queue_job_oper_id_h,queue_job_seq_no_h' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT TOP 1 @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no' + @desc_col_names + ' FROM queue_job_attr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@wo_id STRING40, @oper_id STRING40, @seq_no INT32', @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			END
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			--There are no rows in the queue_job_attr table.
			--Create this job and automatically fill the attribute values in the appropriate attribute columns.
			SET @desc_vals = ''
			DECLARE queue_job_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
			SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
			FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
			  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

			OPEN queue_job_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM queue_job_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
				--Use a dummy value for the description columns, since this column does not allow nulls.
				SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
			END
			CLOSE queue_job_attr_cursor
--			DEALLOCATE queue_job_attr_cursor

			IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
				IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
				IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
				SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO queue_job_attr (queue_job_wo_id_h,queue_job_oper_id_h,queue_job_seq_no_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + ' VALUES (@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,' + @desc_vals + ')'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@wo_id STRING40, @oper_id STRING40, @seq_no INT32', @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
			END
			ELSE INSERT INTO queue_job_attr (queue_job_wo_id_h, queue_job_oper_id_h, queue_job_seq_no_h) VALUES (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no)

			--Loop through all the attribute columns for this job and fill the appropriate job_attribute value
			--and attribute descriptions.
			SET @desc_vals = ''
			OPEN queue_job_attr_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM queue_job_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_job_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
				SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '=atr.attr_desc FROM '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT a.attr_id, a.attr_desc, ja.wo_id, ja.oper_id, ja.seq_no, ja.attr_value '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM attr a '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN job_attr ja ON ja.attr_id = a.attr_id AND ja.wo_id = @wo_id AND ja.oper_id = @oper_id AND ja.seq_no = @seq_no '
				SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE a.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr'
				EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@wo_id STRING40, @oper_id STRING40, @seq_no INT32, @attr_id_temp INT32', @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @attr_id_temp
			END
			CLOSE queue_job_attr_cursor
			DEALLOCATE queue_job_attr_cursor
		END
	END

	SET @attr_id_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id)

	--Check whether a column for this attribute name exists.
	IF(@remove_job = 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
		  AND name = @attr_id_col) BEGIN

		--If not, create a column name for this attribute.
		--Explicitly made the column @attr_id_col nullable to make it compatible with SQL Server 2012
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_job_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + ' STRING1700_NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--If not, create the attribute description column as NULL now, since row may already exists
		--in this table. After updating the attribute description column, this column can be
		--changed to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_job_attr ADD ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--Update the attribute description column.
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_job_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h = @attr_desc'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc

		--Change the attribute description column to non-nullable.
		SET @SQL = 'ALTER TABLE queue_job_attr ALTER COLUMN ' + @attr_id_col + 'd_h STRING80 NOT NULL'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL
	END

	IF (@wo_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		--Retrieve the job attribute value for this column.
		SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM job_attr
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND attr_id = @attr_id

		IF (@remove_job = 1)
			DELETE FROM queue_job_attr
			FROM
				(SELECT qja.queue_job_wo_id_h, qja.queue_job_oper_id_h, qja.queue_job_seq_no_h
				FROM job_attr ja
				INNER JOIN (SELECT CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id_used
						FROM syscolumns WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
						AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
				  		AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0) attr ON ja.attr_id = attr.attr_id_used
				RIGHT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h = ja.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h = ja.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h = ja.seq_no
				WHERE qja.queue_job_wo_id_h = @wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h = @oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h = @seq_no AND ja.wo_id IS NULL) queue_attr
			WHERE queue_job_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h = @wo_id AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h = @oper_id AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h = @seq_no
			  AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h = queue_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h = queue_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h
			  AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h = queue_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h

		--Update the attribute value for this job
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_job_attr SET ' + @attr_id_col + ' = @attr_value WHERE queue_job_wo_id_h = @wo_id AND queue_job_oper_id_h = @oper_id AND queue_job_seq_no_h = @seq_no'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_value STRING1700, @wo_id STRING40, @oper_id STRING40, @seq_no INT32', @attr_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The visible_in_queue property for this attribute is set to true.
		--Create all jobs that have this attribute and this job is not added to the queue_job_attr table.
		SET @desc_vals = ''
		DECLARE queue_job_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT  name, CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(REPLACE(name, 'attr', ''), 'd_h', '')) attr_id
		FROM syscolumns
		WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
		  AND UPPER(name) NOT LIKE 'QUEUE_JOB%'
		  AND CHARINDEX('d_h', name) > 0

		OPEN queue_job_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM queue_job_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @desc_col_names = @desc_col_names + @attr_id_col + ','
			SET @desc_vals = @desc_vals + '''0'','
		END
		CLOSE queue_job_attr_cursor
		--DEALLOCATE queue_job_attr_cursor

		IF (@desc_col_names <> '') AND (@desc_vals <> '') BEGIN
			IF RIGHT(@desc_col_names, 1) = ',' SET @desc_col_names = LEFT(@desc_col_names, LEN(@desc_col_names) - 1)
			IF RIGHT(@desc_vals, 1) = ',' SET @desc_vals = LEFT(@desc_vals, LEN(@desc_vals) - 1)
			SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO queue_job_attr (queue_job_wo_id_h, queue_job_oper_id_h,queue_job_seq_no_h,' + @desc_col_names + ')'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' SELECT ja.wo_id,ja.oper_id,ja.seq_no,' + @desc_vals + ' FROM job_attr ja'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN queue_job_attr qja ON qja.queue_job_wo_id_h = ja.wo_id AND qja.queue_job_oper_id_h = ja.oper_id AND qja.queue_job_seq_no_h = ja.seq_no'
			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' WHERE ja.attr_id = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), @attr_id) + ' AND qja.queue_job_wo_id_h IS NULL'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

			--If there are >= 1 row(s) inserted into the queue_job_attr table,
			--then update all the attribute values and descriptions for the new rows.
			--If no rows were inserted into the queue_job_attr table, then we don't need to loop thru all the
			--rows to update the attribute values and description.
			IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 BEGIN
				SET @dummy_val = '0'
				OPEN queue_job_attr_cursor
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM queue_job_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id_col, @attr_id_temp
					IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					SELECT @attr_desc = attr_desc FROM attr WHERE attr_id = @attr_id_temp
					SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_job_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id_temp) + '=atr.attr_value,'
					SET @SQL = @SQL + @attr_id_col + '= @attr_desc FROM '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, ja.attr_value '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM job j '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN job_attr ja ON j.wo_id = ja.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ja.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ja.seq_no AND ja.attr_id = @attr_id_temp) atr '
					SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE queue_job_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h=atr.wo_id AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h = atr.oper_id AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h = atr.seq_no AND queue_job_attr.' + @attr_id_col + '=@dummy_val'
					EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id_temp INT32, @attr_desc STRING80, @dummy_val NVARCHAR(1)', @attr_id_temp, @attr_desc, @dummy_val
				END
				CLOSE queue_job_attr_cursor
			END
		END
		DEALLOCATE queue_job_attr_cursor

		--The above update will update ONLY the new inserted rows.
		--Rows may already exist in this queue_job_attr table for many items. If an attribute property is changed to make visible in the grid,
		--then the below update statement should update all the existing rows
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_job_attr SET attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '=atr.attr_value FROM '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + '(SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, ja.attr_value '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM job j '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN job_attr ja ON j.wo_id = ja.wo_id AND j.oper_id = ja.oper_id AND j.seq_no = ja.seq_no AND ja.attr_id = @attr_id) atr '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'WHERE queue_job_attr.queue_job_wo_id_h=atr.wo_id AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_oper_id_h = atr.oper_id AND queue_job_attr.queue_job_seq_no_h = atr.seq_no'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_id INT32', @attr_id
	END
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[util_log]
AS
WITH util_hist AS
	(SELECT uh.ent_id, uh.event_time_utc
	, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(uh_next.event_time_utc)
			FROM util_history uh_next WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh_next.ent_id = uh.ent_id AND uh_next.event_time_utc > uh.event_time_utc)
		--It appears that Microsoft SQL Server retrieves the GETUTCDATE() at the beginning of the view execution and uses that time in subsequent calculations.
		--So, if the view executes for more than a second, and if any new events are added during the time of execution, the duration will result negative.
		--To avoid this situation, if the GETUTCDATE() is earlier than the event_time_utc, then default to event_time_utc.
		--This problem is only related to the current event (i.e. there are no future events from the last event) and the view takes few seconds to execute and there are > 4 or 5m records in the database
		, CASE WHEN GETUTCDATE() < uh.event_time_utc THEN uh.event_time_utc ELSE GETUTCDATE() END) AS event_end_time_utc
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	)
	SELECT hist.ent_id, hist.event_time_utc, hist.event_time_local
		, DATEDIFF(SS, uhdur.event_time_utc, uhdur.event_end_time_utc) AS duration, uhdur.event_end_time_utc
		, hist.event_time_utc AS event_time, uhdur.event_end_time_utc AS event_end_time
		, COALESCE(shiftinfo.shift_id, 0) AS shift_id, COALESCE(shiftinfo.shift_start_utc, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120)) AS shift_start_utc
		, COALESCE(shiftinfo.shift_start_local, CONVERT(DATETIME, '1900-01-01', 120)) AS shift_start_local
		, hist.state_cd, hist.reas_cd, hist.reas_pending
		, hist.runtime, hist.downtime, hist.setuptime
		, hist.teardowntime, hist.fixedtime, hist.vartime, hist.failure
		, hist.comments, hist.raw_reas_cd, hist.spare1, hist.spare2, hist.spare3, hist.spare4
		, hist.category1, hist.category2, hist.category3, hist.category4
		, hist.last_edit_comment, hist.last_edit_by, hist.last_edit_at, hist.log_id
	FROM util_history hist WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN util_hist uhdur WITH (NOLOCK) ON hist.ent_id = uhdur.ent_id AND hist.event_time_utc = uhdur.event_time_utc
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT sh.shift_id, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local
			 FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
			 WHERE sh.ent_id = hist.ent_id
			   AND sh.shift_start_utc = (SELECT MAX(sh1.shift_start_utc)
							 FROM shift_history sh1 WITH (NOLOCK)
							 WHERE sh1.ent_id = hist.ent_id
							   AND sh1.shift_start_utc <= hist.event_time_utc)) shiftinfo

Stored Procedure:		sp_S_MDRT_Config_GetDesc
Author:					priyanka randive
Created:				07/5/2016

Description:			gets description of MES aspect like entity,item,wo 
Called by:				Skelta Forms for displaying list of description to whom attribute is getting attached from MES configuration screen
						1=Items, 2=Entities, 3=Lots, 4=Item Classes, 5=Jobs, 6=WO, 7=Operations, 8=Processes, 9 = Sublot, 10=(QM) Samples, 11=(QM) Results
						 

Revision		Date			Who				    What
========		====			===				    ====
0.1				10/31/2017		PRa					First version
0.2				11/16/2017		PRa					Second version

**********************************************************************************/
--==================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_MDRT_Config_GetDesc]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here

	@attr_grp int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
		
if @attr_grp = 1 Select item_id as id,concat(item_id,'-',item_desc)as description from item with(nolock) 
else if @attr_grp = 2 Select ent_id  as id,description as description, ent_name as entity_name from ent with(nolock) 

else if @attr_grp = 3 select l.item_id as id, concat(lot_no,'-',i.item_desc) as description,lot_no ,i.item_desc
from lot l with(nolock) inner join item i on i.item_id=l.item_id 

else if @attr_grp = 4 select item_class_id as id,item_class_desc as description from item_class with(nolock) 
--else if @attr_grp = 5 select lot_no as id,lot_no as description from lot --job
else if @attr_grp = 5
select j.item_id as id, concat(wo_id,'-',oper_id,'-',seq_no) as description,j.wo_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no	from job j with(nolock)
else if @attr_grp = 6 select wo_id as id,wo_id as description from wo with(nolock) 
else if @attr_grp = 7 select oper_id as id,concat(oper_id,'-',process_id) as description,oper_id as oper_id,process_id  from oper
else if @attr_grp = 8 select process_id as id,process_desc as description from process with(nolock) 
else if @attr_grp = 9 select l.item_id as id, concat(lot_no,'-',sublot_no,'-',i.item_desc) as description,lot_no ,sublot_no,i.item_desc
from sublot l with(nolock) inner join item i on i.item_id=l.item_id  

END

-- Name:    sp_S_ofi_NextSUInQueue
-- Description:  Return the next available storage unit (applies for source and destination storage unit) in queue
--
-- Usage:  From Automation to MES 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk            2023-01-12      Initial version.
-- 0.02.00  MP            2023-02-10      Adding New Silo request logic (@type = 1-Source,2-Destination,3-DestinationFlushTail,4-DestinationFlushHead)
-- 0.03.00	YG			  2023-02-18	  Update major on silo item_id 
-- 0.04.00  YG			  2023-03-15      Update for Milling Destination Bug #177
-- 0.05.00  YG			  2023-04-26	  Update to get destination based on filter item 
-- 0.06.00  YG			  2023-05-22	  Refine : Update to get destination based on filter item 
-- 0.07.00  MP			  2023-06-09	  Added interlock for silo status (Lock for input,Lock for output and Block for quality)
-- 0.08.00  YG			  2023-06-12	  Update prev silo destination is_chk, active_su_ent_id, silo_seq

-- 0.11.00  YG			  2024-01-17	  Set ratio into null and give pratio into null since it is not needed for destination
-- 0.12.00  DS			  2024-02-02	  destination silo selection based on ent_name sequence
-- ===========================================================================================
-- exec sp_S_ofi_NextSUInQueue 1, '1001476306', 'Milling', 0, 469, 0
create     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_NextSUInQueue_bck21_8_25] (   @type      INT,
													   @wo_id          NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,
													   @oper_id        NVARCHAR(40)=NULL,
													   @seq_no         INT=NULL,
													   @ent_id         INT=NULL,
													   @aut_storage_id INT=NULL     )
AS
BEGIN
      SET nocount ON;

	  IF (LEN(@wo_id) = 9)
	  BEGIN
		SET @wo_id = '8'+@wo_id;
	  END

	  DECLARE @result Table (iStatus int, sStatusDescription NVARCHAR(100))

      DECLARE @last_storage_ent_id INT,
			  @storage_unit_ent_id INT,
			  @storage_unit_aut_id INT=0,
			  @storage_unit_ent_name NVARCHAR(40),
			  @storage_unit_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
			  @storage_unit_item_group NVARCHAR(40),
			  @storage_unit_grade_cd INT,
			  @parent_item_id NVARCHAR(40),
			  @silo_status int=0, -- if @silo_status=0 then no lock/block
			  @IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0,
			  @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically INT = 0,
			  @target_sched_ent_id INT,
			  @UserId NVARCHAR(40),
			  @attr_id_itemgroup int,
			  @attr_id_sunumberinaut int ;
			  
	  
	  SET @UserId = SUSER_NAME();

	  SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
	  WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no

	  --To get the ent_id for the Last Storage Unit 
      SELECT @last_storage_ent_id = ent_id
      FROM   ent_attr ea WITH (nolock)
	  INNER JOIN attr a WITH (nolock)
				ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
				AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
				AND a.attr_grp = 2
				AND ea.attr_value = Cast(@aut_storage_id AS NVARCHAR)

	-- get attribute id
	SELECT @attr_id_sunumberinaut = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2 ;
	SELECT @attr_id_itemgroup = attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' AND attr_grp = 1;

	--To get the secondary SU name 
	IF @type=1
	BEGIN 
		SELECT @storage_unit_ent_name = secondary_silo, -- Change to ent_id 
				@storage_unit_item_id = jb_item_id
		FROM   ofi_su_selection WITH (nolock)
		WHERE  wo_id=@wo_id 
				AND oper_id=@oper_id 
				AND seq_no=@seq_no 
				--AND silo_item_id=@item_id
				AND dest_type=@type
				AND su_ent_id = @last_storage_ent_id
				AND is_chk=1

		IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			-- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
			SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
											AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
											AND a.attr_grp = 7
			WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

			IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
			BEGIN
						
				SELECT top 1
						@storage_unit_ent_name = e.ent_name,
						@storage_unit_ent_id = e.ent_id,
						@storage_unit_item_id = jb.item_id,
						@storage_unit_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd,
						@storage_unit_item_group = ia.attr_value,
						@parent_item_id = j.item_id
				FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Source' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
				INNER JOIN ent E WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = e.ent_id
				INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 
				OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv 
				INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = jb.item_id 
																		AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id_itemgroup
				INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no  
				CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oea.storage_ent_id,'source',iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id,NULL)
				WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no 
				--AND isNotValidEnt=0   
				order by cj.act_finish_time_local,iv.date_in_local ASC
				print 'Source silo selected ' + @storage_unit_ent_name
				-- If record founded 
				IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'RECORD FOUNDED'

					UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
					SET is_chk = 0, active_su_ent_id = NULL, silo_seq = NULL 
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1

					INSERT @result
					EXEC [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_su_selection]
						@pwo_id = @wo_id,					
						@poper_id =	@oper_id,
						@pseq_no = @seq_no,
						@pitem_id = @parent_item_id,
						@pent_id = @target_sched_ent_id,
						@precipe_id =	 NULL,
						@pversion_id = NULL,
						@pdest_type = 1,	--Source
						@pis_chk = 1,	
						@pstorage_ent_id = @storage_unit_ent_id,
						@psilo_grade_cd = @storage_unit_grade_cd, 
						@psilo_item_id= @storage_unit_item_id, 
						@psilo_item_group = @storage_unit_item_group, 
						@pdsc_qty=	 NULL,
						@pmes_qty = NULL,
						--@pstatus					[dbo].[INT32]	 NULL,
						@psecondary_silo= NULL,
						@psecondary_silo_ent_id	= NULL,
						@pratio	= 100,
						@pis_disabled= 0,	
						@psilo_automation_status= NULL,	
						@psilo_seq= 1,	
						--@pspare1					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
						--@pspare2					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
						--@pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
						--@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
						@pcreated_by= @UserId,	
						--@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
						--@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
						@plast_edit_by =NULL
				END
						
			END
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @storage_unit_ent_name = E.ent_name,
					@storage_unit_item_id = jb_item_id
		FROM   ofi_su_selection OSU WITH (nolock) 
		JOIN ENT E WITH (nolock) ON OSU.su_ent_id=E.ent_ID 
		WHERE  wo_id=@wo_id 
				AND oper_id=@oper_id 
				AND seq_no=@seq_no 
				AND jb_item_id = (SELECT jb_item_id  
								FROM   ofi_su_selection WITH (nolock)
								WHERE	wo_id=@wo_id 
										AND oper_id=@oper_id 
										AND seq_no=@seq_no 
										AND dest_type=@type 
										AND su_ENT_ID = @last_storage_ent_id)
				AND dest_type=@type
				AND silo_SEQ > (SELECT silo_SEQ  
								FROM   ofi_su_selection WITH (nolock)
								WHERE	wo_id=@wo_id 
										AND oper_id=@oper_id 
										AND seq_no=@seq_no 
										--AND item_id=@item_id
										AND dest_type=@type 
										AND su_ENT_ID = @last_storage_ent_id)
				AND is_chk=1
		ORDER by OSU.silo_seq

		IF (@storage_unit_ent_name IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			-- Get Attribute IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically
			SELECT @IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
											AND a.attr_desc = 'IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically'
											AND a.attr_grp = 7
			WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

			IF (@IsDestSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE 
						@currentID INT = 0,
						@NextID INT
				--DECLARE @result Table (iStatus int, sStatusDescription NVARCHAR(100))

				SELECT	TOP 1 
						@storage_unit_ent_name = e.ent_name,
						@storage_unit_ent_id = e.ent_id,
						@storage_unit_item_id = jb.item_id,
						@storage_unit_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd,
						@storage_unit_item_group = ia.attr_value,
						@parent_item_id = j.item_id
				FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Destination' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id 
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (nolock) ON oea.storage_ent_id=e.ent_ID
				INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos = 0 -- v0.06.00 Added => Get only for the end product
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv ivc WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ivc.ent_id --Disabled on v 0.06.00 -- Enabled on v 0.10.00
				OUTER APPLY (SELECT item_id,grade_cd,ent_id,SUM(qty_left) qty_left FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) where oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd GROUP by item_id,grade_cd,ent_id) iv -- v0.06.00 Added
				INNER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id = jb.item_id 
														AND ia.attr_id = @attr_id_itemgroup
				LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
															AND ea.attr_id = @attr_id_sunumberinaut
				--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Destination', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) --Disabled on v0.06.00 
				CROSS APPLY dbo.fn_chKDestinationValidity(oea.storage_ent_id,ivc.item_id,ivc.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id)  -- v0.06.00 Added
				WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no 
				AND (e.ent_id <> @last_storage_ent_id or @last_storage_ent_id is null ) -- Added on v 0.10.00
				AND isNotValidEnt=0 
				--AND (oea.storage_ent_id <> @last_storage_ent_id OR @last_storage_ent_id is NULL) -- v0.06.00 Added checking if automation not giving any old silo 
				--AND (iv.ent_id IS NULL OR iv.qty_left = 0.00) --Disabled on v0.06.00 because handled by silo function validity
				--ORDER by oea.created_at_utc ASC
				ORDER by e.ent_name ASC

				PRINT @storage_unit_ent_name

				SELECT @currentID = silo_SEQ  
				FROM   ofi_su_selection WITH (nolock)
				WHERE	wo_id=@wo_id 
						AND oper_id=@oper_id 
						AND seq_no=@seq_no 
						--AND item_id=@item_id
						AND dest_type=@type 
						AND su_ent_id = @last_storage_ent_id

				SET @NextID = @currentID+1;

				-- If record founded

						@pwo_id = @wo_id,
