						@pdsc_qty=	 NULL,
						@pmes_qty = NULL,
						--@pstatus					[dbo].[INT32]	 NULL,
						@psecondary_silo= NULL,
						@psecondary_silo_ent_id	= NULL,
						@pratio	= NULL, -- v 0.11 make it NULL 
						@pis_disabled= 0,	
						@psilo_automation_status= NULL,	
						@psilo_seq= @NextID,	
						--@pspare1					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
						--@pspare2					[NVARCHAR]	(80) NULL,	
						--@pcreated_at_utc			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
						--@pcreated_at_local			[DATETIME]	  NULL,	
						@pcreated_by= @UserId,	
						--@plast_edit_at_utc			[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
						--@plast_edit_at_local		[DATETIME]	 NULL,	
						@plast_edit_by =NULL

						
				END
			END
		END
	END
--To get the secondary SU ent_id 
--print @storage_unit_ent_name
			Select @storage_unit_ent_id=ent_id from ent where ent_name=@storage_unit_ent_name 
			Select @storage_unit_item_id=aut_item_id from ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(@storage_unit_item_id,1);

--To Check the Silo status
		DECLARE @lockforoutput NVARCHAR(20)
			,@blockforquality NVARCHAR(20)
			,@lockforinput NVARCHAR(20)

		SELECT @lockforinput = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'Lockforinput'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_unit_ent_id

		SELECT @lockforoutput = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'LockForOutput'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_unit_ent_id

		SELECT @blockforquality = ea.attr_value
		FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			AND a.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality'
			AND a.attr_grp = 2
		WHERE ea.ent_id = @storage_unit_ent_id

		IF (@lockforinput ='1' and @type=2)
			BEGIN
			SET @silo_status=1 --Will not allow to select the new Destination
			END
		IF (@lockforoutput ='1' and @type=1)
			BEGIN
			SET @silo_status=2 --Will not allow to select the new Source
			END
		IF (@blockforquality ='1')-- and (@type=1 or @type=2))
			BEGIN
			SET @silo_status=3 --Will not allow to select the new Source or Destination
			END


--To get the secondary SU Aut_id 
		IF (@silo_status =0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @storage_unit_aut_id = attr_value
			FROM   ent_attr ea WITH (nolock)
             INNER JOIN attr a WITH (nolock)
                     ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
                        AND a.attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT'
                        AND a.attr_grp = 2
                        AND ea.ent_id = @storage_unit_ent_id
		END

	  IF @storage_unit_ent_id IS NULL SET @storage_unit_ent_id=0

	  SELECT @last_storage_ent_id As Last_Storage_Ent_Id, @storage_unit_ent_id AS Storage_Unit_Ent_Id, @storage_unit_aut_id AS Storage_Unit_Aut_Id, @silo_status AS Silo_Status, @storage_unit_item_id as Storage_Unit_Item_Id
  END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetOEEPercentage]
       @ent_id AS INT
AS
       -- *************************************************************************************************************************
       -- Name:                 [sp_SA_ofi_GetOEEPercentage]  -
       -- Description:        Get All the utilization and avilability percentage
       --
       -- Usage:                OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       -- Version               Authour                    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)                        Change Description
       -- 0.01.00               Siva                 2022-08-01                                      Find the OEE percentage
       ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       -- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
       SET NOCOUNT ON
       IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilQual') IS NOT NULL
       BEGIN
              DROP TABLE #tmputilQual
       END
       IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilPerf') IS NOT NULL
       BEGIN
              DROP TABLE #tmputilPerf
       END
       IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilAvail') IS NOT NULL
       BEGIN
              DROP TABLE #tmputilAvail
       END
       CREATE TABLE #tmputilQual
       (
              util_max  INT
         , avil_data INT
         , qual_loss INT
         , qual_data INT
         , exp_prod  INT
         , act_prod  INT
         , good      INT
         , bad       INT
		 , planned_prod       INT
		 , UOM       NVARCHAR(20)
       )
       INSERT INTO #tmputilQual
       EXEC [sp_S_ofi_GETQualityLoss]
              @ent_id      --Select * from #tmputilQual
       CREATE TABLE #tmputilPerf
       (
              util_max  INT
         , util_data INT
         , avil_data INT
         , perf_data INT
         , perf_loss INT
       )
       INSERT INTO #tmputilPerf
       EXEC [sp_S_ofi_GETPerformanceLoss]
              @ent_id            --Select * from #tmputilPerf
       CREATE TABLE #tmputilAvail
       (
              util_max     INT
         , util_data    FLOAT
         , util_percent DECIMAL
         , util_loss    FLOAT
         , avil_data    FLOAT
         , avil_loss    FLOAT
         , avil_per     FLOAT
         , shift_start  DATETIME
         , shift_end    DATETIME
		 , avil_Run_time INT,avil_Down_time INT,util_run_time INT,util_down_time INT--Chnage 19 Jan 2023
       )
       INSERT INTO #tmputilAvail
       EXEC [sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss]
              @ent_id                    --Select * from #tmputilAvail
       DECLARE @util_percent AS    FLOAT
                , @perf_percent AS    FLOAT
                , @qual_percent AS    INT
                , @avil_data AS       INT
                , @perf_data AS       DECIMAL
                , @perf_loss AS       INT
                , @qual_data AS       INT
                , @qual_loss AS       FLOAT
                , @avil_percent AS    FLOAT
                , @oee_percent AS     FLOAT
                , @teep_percent AS    FLOAT
                , @expected_prod AS   INT
                , @actual_prod AS     INT
                , @good_prod AS       INT
                , @bad_prod AS        INT
                , @wo_id AS           NVARCHAR(100)
                , @item_id AS         NVARCHAR(100)
                , @shift_start AS     DATETIME
                , @shift_end AS       DATETIME
                , @ent_name AS        NVARCHAR(50)
                , @diff_shift_mins AS INT
                , @act_start_date AS  DATETIME
                , @act_end_date AS    DATETIME
                , @uom AS             NVARCHAR(20)
				, @planned_qty AS           DECIMAL
				, @avil_Run_time AS INT,@avil_Down_time AS INT,@util_running AS INT,@util_down AS INT
       SELECT
              @avil_data = avil_data
         , @perf_data = perf_data
       FROM #tmputilPerf
	   
       SELECT
              @util_percent = util_percent
         , @avil_percent = convert( numeric(10,2),ISNULL (avil_per, 0))
         , @shift_start = shift_start
         , @shift_end = shift_end
		 , @avil_Run_time=avil_Run_time ,@avil_Down_time=avil_Down_time,@util_running =util_run_time ,@util_down =util_down_time
       FROM #tmputilAvail

       SELECT
           @qual_percent = qual_loss
         , @expected_prod = exp_prod
         , @actual_prod = act_prod
         , @good_prod = good
         , @bad_prod = bad
       FROM #tmputilQual

       SET @perf_percent = @perf_data
       PRINT '@qual_percentMainSP' + CAST(@qual_percent AS VARCHAR)
       IF @avil_data >= @perf_data
       BEGIN
              PRINT '@perf_data@avil_data'
              PRINT @perf_data
              PRINT @avil_data
              --set @perf_percent = 70 
              -- set @perf_percent = CAST((@perf_data / @avil_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) 
              --select @perf_percent=perf_data from #tmputilPerf
              --set @perf_percent = CAST((@perf_data ) as  DECIMAL(18, 2)) 
              --set @perf_percent = @perf_data--CAST((@perf_data / @avil_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) 
              PRINT 'Main SP Perf Per:' + CAST(@perf_percent AS VARCHAR)
              PRINT 'main qualpercent:' + CAST(@qual_percent AS VARCHAR)
              SET @perf_loss = 100 - @perf_percent
       END
       PRINT 'qual_data'
       PRINT @perf_data
       PRINT @qual_data

/*if @perf_data >= @qual_data 
                  begin
               set
                  @qual_percent = @qual_data--CAST((@qual_data * 100/ @perf_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) 
                             print 'qual_ percent'+cast(@qual_data as varchar)
                             print @qual_percent
                             if @qual_percent > 100
                             set @qual_percent= 100
               set
                  @qual_loss = 100 - @qual_percent 
                  end*/

       --set @qual_percent= @qual_data
       PRINT @qual_percent
       PRINT @qual_loss
       SET
       @oee_percent = CAST(((@avil_percent/100.00)*(@perf_percent/100.00)*(@qual_percent/100.00))* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
       --@oee_percent = ((@avil_percent + @perf_percent + @qual_percent) / 3);

	  --SET  @oee_percent = (@avil_Run_time/(@avil_Run_time+@avil_Down_time))
			--				*(@actual_prod/@expected_prod)
			--				*(@good_prod/(@bad_prod+@good_prod))
       PRINT 'oee percent' + CAST(@oee_percent AS VARCHAR)

       /* set     @oee_percent = LEFT(@oee_percent, 2) */

       SET @teep_percent =  ((@oee_percent/100.00) * (@util_percent/100.00))*100 --(@oee_percent + @util_percent) / 2
       PRINT @oee_percent
       -- set  @teep_percent = LEFT(@teep_percent, 2) print @teep_percent 
       --set @ent_id=138
       --select @wo_id=j.wo_id,@item_id=(i.item_id+'-'+i.item_desc) from job j with(nolock)
       --inner join item i with(nolock) on i.item_id= j.item_id
       --where  j.run_ent_id=@ent_id and j.state_cd=3
       SELECT TOP 1
              @wo_id = j.wo_id
         , @item_id = (i.item_id + '-' + i.item_desc)
         , @act_start_date = jh.job_start_local
         , @act_end_date = jh.job_end_local
         , @uom = u.abbreviation		
       FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
       INNER JOIN job_history jh WITH(NOLOCK) ON jh.wo_id = j.wo_id
       INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = j.item_id
       INNER JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id = i.uom_id
       WHERE
              j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
              AND j.state_cd = 3
		ORDER BY jh.job_start_utc desc 

       SELECT
              @ent_name = ent_name
       FROM ent WITH(NOLOCK)
       WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
       --select top 1 @shift_start=shift_start_local,@shift_end=shift_end_local from shift_history with(nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id order by row_id desc
       PRINT 'qulpercent'
       PRINT @qual_percent
       PRINT @diff_shift_mins

	    SELECT @actual_prod =qty_reqd from wo w 
			  INNER JOIN   job j WITH(NOLOCK) on j.wo_id= w.wo_id
			   WHERE
              j.run_ent_id = @ent_id
              AND j.state_cd = 3
       --using the below query to find the running shift end time
       --SET @shift_end =Dateadd(minute, @diff_shift_mins, @shift_start)
       SELECT
              convert(numeric(10,2),ISNULL (@util_percent, 0)) AS               util_percent
         , convert(numeric(10,2),ISNULL(@avil_percent, 0)) AS               avil_percent
              --'70' as perf_percent,
         , convert(numeric(10,2),ISNULL(@perf_percent, 0)) AS               perf_percent
              --'82' as qual_percent, 
         , convert(numeric(10,2),ISNULL(@qual_percent, 0)) AS               qual_percent
		  , ISNULL(@avil_Run_time , 0) AS              avil_Run_time
		   , ISNULL(@avil_Down_time, 0) AS              avil_Down_time
		    , ISNULL(@util_running, 0) AS              util_run_time
			 , ISNULL(@util_down, 0) AS              util_down_time
         , ISNULL(@expected_prod, 0) AS              exp_prod
         , ISNULL(@bad_prod+@good_prod, 0) AS        act_prod--ISNULL(@actual_prod, 0) AS                act_prod
         , @good_prod AS                             good
         , (CASE
                     WHEN @bad_prod > 0
                     THEN @bad_prod
                     ELSE 0
              END) AS                                  bad
              --'50' as oee, 
         , ISNULL(@oee_percent, 0) AS                oee
              -- '21' as teep, 
         , ISNULL(@teep_percent, 0) AS               teep
         , @wo_id AS                                 wo_id
         , @item_id AS                               item_id
         , CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(MI, DATEDIFF(MI, GETUTCDATE(), GETDATE()),@shift_start ) , 120) AS    shift_start
         , CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(MI, DATEDIFF(MI, GETUTCDATE(), GETDATE()),@shift_end ) , 120) AS      shift_end
         , @ent_name AS                              ent_name
         , CONVERT(VARCHAR, @act_start_date, 120) AS act_start_date
         , CONVERT(VARCHAR, @act_end_date, 120) AS   act_end_date
         , @uom AS                                   uom
       --select * from #tmputilAvail
       --SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 120)
       DROP TABLE #tmputilQual
       DROP TABLE #tmputilPerf
       DROP TABLE #tmputilAvail

END

-- Name:    sp_s_ei_gr_against_obd
-- Description:  Returns GR against OBD for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-06			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Karthik     2022-09-07			Updated the logic to pull data from item_prod
-- 0.01.02  Karthik     2022-09-08			Updated the logic for Delivery completed indicator
-- 0.01.02  Karthik     2022-09-16			Updated the logic to send only for materials of type "Raw materials" and introduced gr_count to track the gr_against_obd_messages
-- 0.01.03  Lavkesh     2024-02-16			Restricted to send GR untill delivery no not avilable in MES ,changed as requested by Koog
-- 0.01.04  Lavkesh     2024-02-18			Added logic to handle transit gain
-- 0.01.04  Lavkesh     2024-03-25			Swap the field File_Generation_Date and posting date as requested by SAP

-- 0.01.06  Lavkesh     2024-06-10			Blocking for intake order
-- 0.01.07	MC			2025-08-29			Prevent to loose qty between selecting result for SAP and updating the prod table
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE         PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_gr_against_obd] as
begin

	Declare @row_id int,@wo_id varchar(100),@state_cd int,@qty_prod float,@qty_prod_erp float,@gr_count int,@ent_id int,@to_ent_id int, @good_prod BIT
	Declare  @error_msg NVARCHAR(500), @error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@attr_id INT,@mod_id varchar(30),@storage_locn VARCHAR(100)
	Declare @plant_code varchar(100),@reas_cd INT,@mov_type varchar(10)
	Declare @gragainstobd nvarchar(5),@delivery nvarchar(20),@process_id nvarchar(100),@reportProd nvarchar(50)
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN Transaction

		--[WO state] 0 = Released, 1 = Started, 2 = Completed, 3 = Closed

		SET @row_id = -1;
		SET @ent_id = -1;
		SET @plant_code = ''

		Select top 1 @row_id = ip.row_id, @wo_id = ip.wo_id,@ent_id = ip.ent_id,@to_ent_id = ip.to_ent_id, @reas_cd = ip.reas_cd,@process_id=w.process_id,
		@good_prod = ip.good_prod from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
		inner join ofi_wo_ext wo_ext with (nolock) on ip.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id and wo_ext.module = 'PO'
		inner join wo w with (nolock) on w.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id
		--inner join ofi_wo_ext owe with(nolock) on owe.wo_id=w.wo_id -- 0.01.03
		where ip.qty_prod > ip.qty_prod_erp  --and owe.delivery is not null -- 0.01.03
		-- 0.01.06
		if EXISTS (select process_attr.attr_value from wo with(nolock) inner join process_attr with(nolock) on wo.process_id=process_attr.process_id
				where wo.wo_id=@wo_id and process_attr.attr_id=(select attr_id from attr with(nolock)where attr_desc='ReportProductionToSAP'))
					begin
					select @reportProd=process_attr.attr_value from wo with(nolock) inner join process_attr with(nolock) on wo.process_id=process_attr.process_id
					where wo.wo_id=@wo_id and process_attr.attr_id=(select attr_id from attr with(nolock)where attr_desc='ReportProductionToSAP')
					IF(@reportProd='No')
					BEGIN
					    update item_prod set qty_prod_erp=qty_prod where row_id=@row_id
						SET @row_id = -1;
						SET @ent_id=-1;
						END
					end
		-- 0.01.03 
		if EXISTS (select process_attr.attr_value from wo with(nolock) inner join process_attr with(nolock) on wo.process_id=process_attr.process_id
				where wo.wo_id=@wo_id and process_attr.attr_id=(select attr_id from attr with(nolock)where attr_desc='GRAgainstOBD'))
				begin				
					select @gragainstobd= process_attr.attr_value from wo with(nolock) inner join process_attr with(nolock) on wo.process_id=process_attr.process_id				
					where wo.wo_id=@wo_id and process_attr.attr_id=(select attr_id from attr with(nolock)where attr_desc='GRAgainstOBD')

					--fetching next record where obd exist.
					Select top 1 @row_id = ip.row_id, @wo_id = ip.wo_id,@ent_id = ip.ent_id,@to_ent_id = ip.to_ent_id, @reas_cd = ip.reas_cd,@process_id=w.process_id,
					@good_prod = ip.good_prod from item_prod ip with (nolock) 
					inner join ofi_wo_ext wo_ext with (nolock) on ip.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id and wo_ext.module = 'PO'
					inner join wo w with (nolock) on w.wo_id = wo_ext.wo_id
					inner join ofi_wo_ext owe with(nolock) on owe.wo_id=w.wo_id -- 0.01.03
					where ip.qty_prod > ip.qty_prod_erp  and owe.delivery is not null and w.process_id=@process_id-- 0.01.03

					select @delivery=delivery from ofi_wo_ext with(nolock) where wo_id=@wo_id
					if (@gragainstobd='1' and @delivery is null)
					begin
						SET @row_id = -1;
					end
					
				 end	
					

		if @ent_id <> -1 and @ent_id is not NULL
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = NULL
			SELECT @storage_locn = attr_value from ent_attr with (nolock) where ent_id = @to_ent_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation')
			IF @storage_locn is NULL
				SELECT @storage_locn = ent_name from ent with (nolock) where ent_id = CASE WHEN @good_prod = 0 THEN @to_ent_id ELSE @ent_id END

			SET @mov_type = '101'
		End

		SELECT @plant_code = attr_value from system_attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
		
		if @reas_cd = (Select top 1 reas_cd from item_reas with (nolock) where reas_desc = 'Transit Loss')
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = 'TL01'
			SET @mov_type = 'Z03' ---(KN - 20Feb23 - SAP confirmed that the movement type for Transit Loss is z03)
		End

		if @reas_cd = (Select top 1 reas_cd from item_reas with (nolock) where reas_desc = 'Transit Gain') --0.01.04
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = 'TL01'
			SET @mov_type = '701' ---(LK - 18Feb24 - SAP confirmed that the movement type for Transit Gain is 701)
		End
		
		IF @row_id <> -1 and @row_id is not nULL
		Begin
			Select @state_cd = state_cd from wo with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id
			Select @qty_prod = sum(qty_prod), @qty_prod_erp = sum(qty_prod_erp) from item_prod with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and row_id <> @row_id group by wo_id
			Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'GR_Against_OBD_Messages_Count'

			--0.01.07 Select qty values to variables to lock the value for update the table
			SELECT @qty_prod=qty_prod, @qty_prod_erp=qty_prod_erp FROM item_prod WHERE row_id=@row_id

			Select Format((GETDATE()),'yyyyMMdd') File_Generation_Date, Format(ip.created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
			'000000' File_Generation_Time, --Format((ip.last_edit_at),'hhmmss')
			ip.wo_id Document_Number,'' Message,ip.item_id Material_Number,
			--wo_ext.delivery_item Delivery_Item,
			RIGHT(wo_ext.delivery_item,len(wo_ext.delivery_item)-2) Delivery_Item, --KN 15/02/23 Updated to send only last 4 digits of delivery item as requested by SAP team + confirmed by AVEVA
			wo_ext.delivery Delivery_Number,
			--iif(@qty_prod = @qty_prod_erp and @state_cd >= 2,0,@qty_prod - @qty_prod_erp) Delivery_Quantity, --If Completed then send 0, else send the quantity produced
			--qty_prod Delivery_Quantity,-- (KN 20-Feb-23 - Since the above condn is not handling waste reporting)
			ROUND((@qty_prod - @qty_prod_erp),3) Delivery_Quantity, -- (KN 12-Apr-23 - Modified to report only the diff. Decision based on testing with Yoga/Mahesh)
			u.description BaseUnit_of_Measure,wo_ext.lot_no Batch_Number, ip.wo_id DocumentNumber_of_TheReferenceDocument,
			wo_ext.item_no_puo_doc ItemNumber_of_TheReferenceItem,
			@plant_code Plant,@storage_locn Storage_Location, @mov_type Movement_Type,
			'B' Movement_Indicator, -- KN 03/01/23 Changed from L to B as requested by SAP team -- KN 15/02/23 Changed from B to L, again L to B as requested by SAP team									
			iif(@storage_locn = 'TL01','C','') DeliveryCompleted_Indicator
			from item_Prod  ip with (nolock)
			inner join item i with (nolock) on ip.item_id = i.item_id
			inner join item_class ic with (nolock) on ic.item_class_id = i.item_class_id
			left join uom u with (nolock) on i.uom_id = u.uom_id
			left join ofi_wo_ext wo_ext with (nolock) on wo_ext.wo_id = ip.wo_id
			where ip.row_id = @row_id and ic.item_class_desc = 'Raw Materials' --Send only raw materials as this interface is sent for Liquid liquor intake, Liquid butter intake and Additive intake

			--Now increase the GR_Against_OBD_Messages_Count attribute value

			If not exists(SELECT wo_id FROM wo_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND attr_id = @attr_id)
				Exec sp_I_Wo_Attr @wo_id,@attr_id,1,'','',@mod_id OUT
			else
				begin
					Select @gr_count = attr_value,@mod_id = mod_id from wo_attr with (nolock) where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attr_id
					Set @gr_count = @gr_count + 1

					update wo_attr set attr_value = @gr_count where wo_id = @wo_id and attr_id = @attr_id

					--Exec sp_U_Wo_Attr @wo_id,@attr_id,@gr_count,'','',@mod_id
				end
			--0.01.07 use variable @qty_prod instead of qty_prod (table value)
			Update item_prod set qty_prod_erp = @qty_prod where row_id = @row_id
		End

		Commit Transaction

	End TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH

end

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_attr_aft_del] ON [dbo].[job_attr]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_attr_aft_del
-- Description        -  Update queue_job_attr table automatically if the attribute is visible in queue.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 11/15/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7931, Updated job_attribute FC tags to null whenever a job attribute is removed.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @wo_id			STRING80
		,@oper_id		STRING80
		,@seq_no		INT32
		,@attr_id		INT32

	DECLARE job_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT d.wo_id, d.oper_id, d.seq_no, d.attr_id FROM deleted d
	INNER JOIN attr a ON d.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.visible_in_queue = 1

	OPEN job_attr_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM job_attr_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @attr_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		EXEC sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @attr_id, 0, 1
	END
	CLOSE job_attr_cursor
	DEALLOCATE job_attr_cursor

END

  (@db_maint_job_id nvarchar(40)

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

          ,db_maint_history.description
          ,db_maint_history.actiontype
          ,db_maint_history.event_type_details
          ,db_maint_history.date_range_type
          ,db_maint_history.start_date_local
          ,db_maint_history.start_date_utc
          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, db_maint_history.start_date_utc) start_date

          ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, db_maint_history.end_date_utc) end_date

    (db_maint_history.data_set_path = @data_set_path  OR @data_set_path IS NULL) AND
    (db_maint_history.conflict_option = @conflict_option  OR @conflict_option IS NULL) AND
    (db_maint_history.completion_date_local = @completion_date_local  OR @completion_date_local IS NULL) AND

    (db_maint_history.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at  OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Res_Oper_to_Res_Job]
@wo_id		STRING40,
@oper_id	STRING40,
@process_id      STRING40,
@seq_no	INT32
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -  sp_Res_Oper_to_Res_Job
-- Description	      - Copies res_oper_link records to res_job_link when instantiating a job
-- Author                   - KRF
-- Date Created	      - 12/12/2002
-- Version	      - 1.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--06/16/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement.
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE
  @res_id 	INT32
 ,@qty_reqd 	TFLOAT
 ,@last_edit_by	STRING40
 ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  DECLARE RES_OPER_LINK_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT res_id, qty_reqd FROM RES_OPER_LINK
      WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
  OPEN RES_OPER_LINK_cursor
  FETCH NEXT FROM RES_OPER_LINK_cursor INTO @res_id, @qty_reqd
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_util_history]
AS
WITH util_hist AS
	(SELECT uh.ent_id, uh.event_time_utc
	, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(uh_next.event_time_utc)
		FROM util_history uh_next WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE uh_next.ent_id = uh.ent_id AND uh_next.event_time_utc > uh.event_time_utc)
		--It appears that Microsoft SQL Server retrieves the GETUTCDATE() at the beginning of the view execution and uses that time in subsequent calculations.
		--So, if the view executes for more than a second, and if any new events are added during the time of execution, the duration will result negative.
		--To avoid this situation, if the GETUTCDATE() is earlier than the event_time_utc, then default to event_time_utc.
		--This problem is only related to the current event (i.e. there are no future events from the last event) and the view takes few seconds to execute and there are > 4 or 5m records in the database
		, CASE WHEN GETUTCDATE() < uh.event_time_utc THEN uh.event_time_utc ELSE GETUTCDATE() END) AS event_end_time_utc
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	)
	SELECT hist.ent_id, hist.event_time_utc, hist.event_time_local
		, DATEDIFF(SS, uhdur.event_time_utc, uhdur.event_end_time_utc) AS duration, uhdur.event_end_time_utc
		, hist.state_cd, hist.reas_cd, hist.reas_pending
		, hist.runtime, hist.downtime, hist.setuptime
		, hist.teardowntime, hist.fixedtime, hist.vartime, hist.failure
		, hist.comments, hist.raw_reas_cd, hist.spare1, hist.spare2, hist.spare3, hist.spare4
		, hist.category1, hist.category2, hist.category3, hist.category4
		, hist.last_edit_comment, hist.last_edit_by, hist.last_edit_at, hist.log_id
	FROM util_history hist WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN util_hist uhdur WITH (NOLOCK) ON hist.ent_id = uhdur.ent_id AND hist.event_time_utc = uhdur.event_time_utc

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:  	[sp_S_ofi_iteminv_AUT]
-- Description:This will be used in Add production workflow during trigger form DCS


-- Usage:	This will be used in MDMAddProductionJobWorkflow for the below conditions
-- 1. If already minor inventory ( inventory below the minimum threshold level of the storage unit ) is there of different material, reclassify to the same material (Changing to new Item ID)	 
-- 2. If already inventory ( inventory above the minimum threshold level of the storage unit ) is there of different material, record the production but mark the storage unit to  Blocked Output. Log the information and notify the user.
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2022-12-01		Intial Version
-- 0.01.01	 MP			      2023-03-10		UOM Convertion added
-- 0.01.02	 CK				  2023-01-05		OMAR Entity handling, block for quality
-- 0.01.03	 YG				  2024-02-07		Add missing nolock, and do script body comment
-- 0.01.04   YG				  2024-03-07		Changed how to get value from db because of issue when getting value thousands. it is having comma
-- 0.01.05   YG				  2024-06-03		Add validation before calling the reclassification function and update the threshold attribute from StorageUnitThreshold into ReclassificationThreshold
-- ===========================================================================================*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_iteminv_AUT] @item_id AS nvarchar(40),
@ent_id AS int

AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE @to_item_id nvarchar(40),
          @qty_left float,
          @su_level_threshold float,
          @plant_level_threshold float,
          @final_threshold float,
          @lot_no nvarchar(40),
          @sublot_no nvarchar(40),
          @to_qty float,
          @result AS int,
          @factor AS float

  -- 0.01.02	 CK
  DECLARE @siloType nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @blk_for_quality nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @auto_reclass_attr_value nvarchar(50) = 'false'
  DECLARE @def_grd_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @unq_item_attr_value nvarchar(50) = NULL
  DECLARE @su_attr AS TABLE (
    attr_id int,
    attr_desc nvarchar(80),
    attr_value STRING1700_NULL
  )

  --Get the item Id from Item_Inv table
  SELECT TOP 1
    @to_item_id = item_id
  FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id 
  AND item_id <> @item_id -- v00.01.05 Added
  ORDER BY row_id DESC

  SET @to_item_id = ISNULL(@to_item_id,@item_id) -- v00.01.05 Added
  
  --Get item detail information from Item_Inv table
  SELECT
    @lot_no = lot_no,
    @sublot_no = sublot_no,
    @to_qty = qty_left
  FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
  AND item_id = @to_item_id

  SELECT
    @qty_left = qty_left
  FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
  AND item_id = @to_item_id

  -- v:0.01.01 Get the UOM CONVERTION Factor
  DECLARE @to_uom_id int,
          @from_uom_id int,
          @default_uom AS nvarchar(40) = 'KG'

  SET @from_uom_id = ISNULL(@from_uom_id, (SELECT
    uom_id
  FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE abbreviation = @default_uom)
  )

  SELECT
    @to_uom_id = uom_id
  FROM item WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE item_id = @item_id

  -- check availability of convertion factor 
  IF EXISTS (SELECT
      item_id
    FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE item_id = @item_id
    AND from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
    AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id)
  BEGIN
    SET @factor = (SELECT
      factor
    FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
    AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id
    AND item_id = @item_id)
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    SET @factor = (SELECT TOP 1
      factor
    FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE from_uom_id = @from_uom_id
    AND to_uom_id = @to_uom_id)
  END

  --Get the threshlod values from SU and plant
  SELECT
    @su_level_threshold = REPLACE(ea.attr_value, ',','') * @factor --v 0.01.04 Updated
  FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
  JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
  WHERE ea.ent_id = @ent_id
  AND a.attr_desc = 'ReclassificationThreshold'

  SELECT
    @plant_level_threshold = REPLACE(ea.attr_value, ',','') * @factor --v 0.01.04 Updated
  FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
  JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
  WHERE ea.ent_id = (SELECT TOP 1
    ent_id 
  FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL
  ORDER BY row_id)
  AND a.attr_desc = 'ReclassificationThreshold'

  -- If the Silo level threshold is missing then take the plant level threshold
  IF (@su_level_threshold = 0)
    OR (@su_level_threshold IS NULL)
  BEGIN
    SET @final_threshold = @plant_level_threshold
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    SET @final_threshold = @su_level_threshold
  END

  -- 0.01.02	 CK
  --do not block for quality  if the silo is set for auto_reclassify='true'
  
    INSERT INTO @su_attr
      SELECT
        A.attr_id,
        A.attr_desc,
        EA.attr_value
      FROM ent_attr EA WITH (NOLOCK)
      INNER JOIN attr A WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON A.attr_id = EA.attr_id
      WHERE EA.ent_id = @ent_id
      AND A.attr_desc IN ('auto_reclassify','unique_item_id') -- Added unique_item_id

    -- get auto_reclassify value         
    SELECT
      @auto_reclass_attr_value = SA.attr_value
    FROM @su_attr SA
    WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'auto_reclassify'
  
  -- Check if destination item same with current item
  IF (@item_id <> @to_item_id)
    AND (@to_item_id IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN
    PRINT @qty_left
    PRINT @final_threshold
    IF (@qty_left < @final_threshold)

    BEGIN
	  SELECT
      @unq_item_attr_value = SA.attr_value
	  FROM @su_attr SA
	  WHERE SA.attr_desc = 'unique_item_id'
	  
	  IF (@auto_reclass_attr_value = 'true' and (@unq_item_attr_value is not null or @unq_item_attr_value <> '')) 
	  BEGIN
		  --Dont Call the web API in the work flow SP_U_ITEM_INV_TRANSANDUPDINV to update with new Item
		  SET @result = 0 -- Inventory below the minimum threshold level of the storage unit bot no need to reclassify the left item
	  END
	  ELSE
	  BEGIN
		 --Call the web API in the work flow SP_U_ITEM_INV_TRANSANDUPDINV to update with new Item
		  SET @result = 1 -- Inventory below the minimum threshold level of the storage unit
	  END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      --Lock for Output
	   -- 0.01.02	 CK
  --do not block for quality  if the silo is set for auto_reclassify='true'
      IF (@auto_reclass_attr_value = 'false')
      BEGIN
        UPDATE ent_attr
        SET attr_value = 1
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
        AND attr_id = (SELECT
          ea.attr_id
        FROM ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK)
        JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
          ON ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
        WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
        AND a.attr_desc = 'BlockForQuality')
      END

      SET @result = 2 -- Inventory above the maximum threshold level of the storage unit
    END

  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    SET @result = 0 -- Automation Item id and Storage unit Item id are same
  END

  SELECT
    @result AS result,
    @item_id AS item_id,
    @to_item_id AS to_item_id,
    @lot_no AS lot_no,
    @sublot_no AS sublot_no,
    @to_qty AS to_qty

END

(
	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_U_JobFinishTime
-- Description			- Update estimate of finish time
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version				- 2.0.0.40
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 10/8/2002		Keith Frantz	-			Added ceiling since partial batches take as long as complete ones.
-- 10/8/2002		Keith Frantz	-			Added ceiling since partial batches take as long as complete ones.
-- 10/14/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 08/14/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	DECLARE	@current_time_utc			TDATETIME

	SET @current_time_utc = getUtcDate()

	-- do UTC time first
	UPDATE job
	SET sched_finish_time_utc = DATEADD(hh, (ROUND(CASE WHEN batch_size <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE CEILING((qty_reqd - qty_prod) / batch_size) END * ISNULL(dbo.fn_CONVERTPRODRATETOHRSPERBATCH(est_prod_rate, prod_uom),0), 0)+ ISNULL(est_teardown_time,0)), @current_time_utc)
	WHERE state_cd = 3

	-- next, update local based off of UTC's new value. It should be entity Local
	UPDATE job
	SET sched_finish_time_local = DATEADD(mi, dbo.fn_TZ_GetOffsetFromUtc(job.run_ent_id,job.sched_finish_time_utc),job.sched_finish_time_utc)
	WHERE state_cd = 3

END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_S_ofi_ValidateOnJobComplete
-- Description:	Validation before completing the job
--				1. Previous job are completely completed
--				2. Previous Intra Material completely consumed
--				3. Production Target should less than or equal with Actual Prod
-- Usage:		JobManagement
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01 	YG				2023-03-16			Initial version.
-- 0.02 	YG				2023-04-28			Add Checking for the consumption, it should whithin the range
-- 0.03     YG				2023-05-10			Reupdate the consumption checking
-- 0.04     DS				2023-06-26			#31[BAT List] Before completing the last job (Milling\Roasting job):
												1.	There shouldn’t be any RUNNING or SUSPENDED job exists in the cake blender\BW for a given WO.
													If that exists, then MES will not allow to complete that job (last job).
												2.	If there is any NEW & RELEASED job exists in the cake blender\BW,
													then MES will CANCEL those job automatically.
												3.	If there is any other Milling\Roasting job for same WO exists (in case of split of Milling\Roasting job)
													in NEW, RELEASED, RUNNING and SUSPEND state then the MES will allow that job to be completed.
													AND if not exists then MES will do the validation as mentioned in the point number 1 & 2.
	0.05     DS				2023-08-01			#177 change suspended to stopped
	0.06	 AKM			2024-02-02			coding best practice and dead code cleaning

--===========================================================================================*/

create Procedure [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_ValidateOnJobComplete_bck21_8_25]  
		@wo_id NVARCHAR(40)
		,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
		,@seq_no INT

AS
BEGIN


	--Declarations
	DECLARE @process_id NVARCHAR(100),
			@CheckPreviousJobState INT = 0,
			@CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed INT = 0,
			@oper_seq INT,
			@previous_operation NVARCHAR(100),
			@prev_prod_item_group NVARCHAR(40),
			@Released INT,
			@Running INT,
			@Suspended INT,
			@Canceled INT,
			@Completed INT,
			@def_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
			@CheckTargetVsActualProd INT = 0,
			@IsValidSplitJobExists INT = 0

	--Check the operation attribute
	SELECT @CheckPreviousJobState=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
		AND attr_id = ( SELECT attr_id
						FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckPreviousJobState' 
							AND attr_grp = 7) --7 = Operation Group 

	SELECT @CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
		AND attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
						FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed' 
							AND attr_grp = 7) --7 = Operation Group

	SELECT @CheckTargetVsActualProd=attr_value FROM oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
		AND attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
						FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						WHERE attr_desc = 'CheckTargetVsActualProd' 
							AND attr_grp = 7) --7 = Operation Group

	--Get the process id from current operation
	SELECT @process_id = process_id, 
		@oper_seq = display_seq 
	FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id

	--Based on process id getting the previous operation by utilizing display sequence column 
	SELECT TOP 1 @previous_operation = oper_id 
	FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @process_id 
		AND display_seq < @oper_seq
		AND oper_id <> @oper_id
	ORDER by display_seq DESC

	--Check consumed qty based on the job_bom
	DECLARE @len int,
		@counter int = 1,
		@consumed_qty DECIMAL(16,7) = 0.00

	DECLARE @list_bom TABLE (
		id int IDENTITY(1,1),
		item_id nvarchar(100),
		min_qty decimal(16, 7),
		qty decimal(16, 7),
		max_qty decimal(16, 7),
		target_uom_cd INT -- Added 0.03.00
	)

	INSERT @list_bom 
	SELECT 
		jb.item_id,
		
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](jb.item_id,jb.min_qty_per_parent_item,i.uom_id,it.uom_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*j.qty_reqd, -- Added 0.03.00
		
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](jb.item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,i.uom_id,it.uom_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*j.qty_reqd, -- Added 0.03.00
		
		dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](jb.item_id,jb.max_qty_per_parent_item,i.uom_id,it.uom_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*j.qty_reqd, -- Added 0.03.00
		
		it.uom_id
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = jb.wo_id and j.oper_id = jb.oper_id and j.seq_no = jb.seq_no
	INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = jb.item_id 
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON it.item_id = j.item_id -- Added 0.03.00
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id and jb.oper_id = @oper_id and jb.seq_no = @seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0

	SELECT @len = count(*) FROM @list_bom 
	
	WHILE (@len >= @counter)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @item_id nvarchar(100),
				@min_qty decimal(16, 7),
				@qty decimal(16, 7),
				@max_qty decimal(16, 7),
				@target_uom_id INT -- Added 0.03.00

		SELECT @item_id = item_id 
				, @min_qty = min_qty
				, @max_qty = max_qty
				, @qty = qty
				, @target_uom_id = target_uom_cd -- Added 0.03.00
		FROM @list_bom 
		WHERE id = @counter
		
		SELECT @consumed_qty = sum(dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](ic.item_id,ic.qty_cons,i.uom_id,@target_uom_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)) FROM item_cons(nolock) ic -- Added 0.03.00
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ic.item_id																								-- Added 0.03.00
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and ic.item_id = @item_id																-- Added 0.03.00

		IF (@min_qty <> 0 AND @max_qty <> 0)
		BEGIN
			PRINT @consumed_qty
			PRINT @min_qty
			PRINT @max_qty
			IF NOT(@consumed_qty >= @min_qty AND @consumed_qty <= @max_qty)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 4 Result, CONCAT([dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getLangString](200004,NULL, 10),@item_id) Descriptions
				RETURN
			END
		END

		set @counter = @counter + 1;
	END
	
	--Get State For Some State Cd
	SELECT @Released = state_cd 
	FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE state_cd = 2

	SELECT @Running = state_cd 
	FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE state_cd = 3

	SELECT @Suspended = state_cd 
	FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE state_cd = 5

	SELECT @Canceled = state_cd 
	FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE state_cd = 7

	SELECT @Completed = state_cd 
	FROM job_state WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE state_cd = 4


	--Commented by DS for cancel release scenario
	SELECT @def_lot_no = jb.def_lot_no
	FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE jb.wo_id = @wo_id 
		AND jb.oper_id = @previous_operation 
		AND jb.seq_no = @seq_no
		AND jb.bom_pos = 0

	

			if exists(  SELECT 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN  job_state js with(nolock) on job.state_cd = js.state_cd and js.state_cd in (1,2,3,5)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						AND seq_no<>@seq_no  -- Should not be same seq number
						AND oper_id = @oper_id ) AND (@CheckPreviousJobState = 1)
			begin
				set @IsValidSplitJobExists = 1;
			end

			IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id 
						AND oper_id = @previous_operation 
						--AND seq_no = @seq_no -- Disabled because check entire sequence
						AND state_cd IN (@Running,@Suspended))
						--AND state_cd  IN (@Completed,@Canceled))
				)
			AND  (@CheckPreviousJobState = 1)
			AND  (@IsValidSplitJobExists = 0) -- means this is the last job
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 Result, [dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getLangString](200001,NULL, 10) Descriptions
				RETURN
			END






	IF (@CheckWIPPrevOperConsumed =1)  AND  (@IsValidSplitJobExists = 0) --means this is the last job
		
		AND
		(
		EXISTS( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE iv.wo_id = @wo_id 
					AND iv.oper_id = @previous_operation 
					AND iv.qty_left > 0
					AND iv.lot_no = @def_lot_no)
		)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 2 Result, [dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getLangString](200002,NULL, 10) Descriptions
		RETURN
	END

	IF (
		@CheckTargetVsActualProd =1
		)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ProdReqd FLOAT,
				@GoodProd FLOAT

		SELECT	@ProdReqd = qty_reqd ,
				@GoodProd = qty_prod
		FROM job WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			AND oper_id = @oper_id
			AND seq_no = @seq_no
		
		IF(
			@ProdReqd > @GoodProd
		)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 3 Result, [dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getLangString](200003,NULL, 10) Descriptions
			RETURN
		END
	END

	SELECT 0 Result, '@@Success@@' Descriptions

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oee_Exec_VerifyOEEEnts]
(@oee_ent_id	INT32
,@job_ent_id	INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
,@util_ent_id	INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - sp_SA_Oee_Exec_VerifyOEEEnts
-- Description        - Get
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 04/18/2006
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.14
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
--Remarks		- Verify_Options: 0 - (Both) Verifies job_ent_id and util_ent_id
--					  1 - job_ent_id: Only verifies the job_ent_id
--					  2 - util_ent_id: Only verfies the util_ent_id
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE	@child_level	INT
DECLARE	@oee_ents	TABLE (ent_id INT, child_level INT, can_run_jobs BIT, can_capture_util BIT)

BEGIN
	--Check whether the oee_exec entity is capable of running jobs.
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @oee_ent_id AND can_run_jobs = 1)
		--If yes, then default the oee_exec entity itself as the target entity.
		SET @job_ent_id = @oee_ent_id
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The supplied oee_exec entity is not capable of running jobs.
		SELECT @job_ent_id = NULL, @child_level = 0

		--Find the first descendant entity that can run jobs.
		--If such an entity is found, then default that entity as the runnable entity for this oee_exec entity.
		INSERT INTO @oee_ents (ent_id, child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util)
		SELECT ent_id, @child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util
		FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @oee_ent_id

		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
			INSERT INTO @oee_ents (ent_id, child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util)
			SELECT ent_id, @child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON  el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
			WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @oee_ents WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
		END

		--Find the first descendant entity that can run jobs.
		SELECT @job_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM @oee_ents
		WHERE child_level = (SELECT MIN(child_level) FROM @oee_ents WHERE can_run_jobs = 1)
		  AND can_run_jobs = 1

		--If the descendant entities cannot run jobs, then default to any one entity that can run jobs.
		IF @job_ent_id IS NULL
			SELECT @job_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM ent WHERE can_run_jobs = 1
	END

	--Check whether the oee_exec entity is capable of capturing utilization
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent WHERE ent_id = @oee_ent_id AND can_capture_util = 1)
		--If yes, then default the oee_exec entity itself as the target entity.
		SET @util_ent_id = @oee_ent_id
	ELSE BEGIN
		--The supplied oee_exec entity is not capable of capturing utilization.
		SET @util_ent_id = NULL

		--Check whether the descendant entity tree has already generated, if yes, then do not re-generate again
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @oee_ents) BEGIN
			SET @child_level = 0

			INSERT INTO @oee_ents (ent_id, child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util)
			SELECT ent_id, @child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util
			FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @oee_ent_id

			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
				INSERT INTO @oee_ents (ent_id, child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util)
				SELECT ent_id, @child_level, can_run_jobs, can_capture_util
				FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK) ON  el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN
					(SELECT ent_id FROM @oee_ents WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
				IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			END
		END

		--Find the first descendant entity that can capture utilization
		SELECT @util_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM @oee_ents
		WHERE child_level = (SELECT MIN(child_level) FROM @oee_ents WHERE can_capture_util = 1)
		  AND can_capture_util = 1

		--If the descendant entities cannot capture utilization, then default to any one entity that can capture utilization.
		IF @util_ent_id IS NULL
			SELECT @util_ent_id = MIN(ent_id) FROM ent WHERE can_capture_util = 1
	END
END

	BEGIN

	--	inner join attr a with (nolock) on a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
	--	where a.attr_desc='ScannableId' and attr_value=@equip

	--	set @user='Aveva\'+@user
	--	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ent_access_ofi') IS NOT NULL
	--	DROP TABLE #ent_access_ofi
	--	CREATE TABLE #ent_access_ofi (
	
	--	ent_id	INT,
	--	ent_name nvarchar(50),
	--	can_sched_jobs nvarchar(5),
	--	can_run_jobs nvarchar(5),
	--	can_capture_util nvarchar(5),
	--	can_capture_labor nvarchar(5),
	--	can_do_dnc nvarchar(5),
	--	can_stre nvarchar(5),
	--	can_log_data nvarchar(5),
	--	parent_ent_id nvarchar(5),
	--	access int
	--	);
	--	INSERT INTO #ent_access_ofi
	--	exec sp_S_Grp_Ent_Link_EntAccByUser @user_id= @user
	----	select *from #ent_access_ofi where ent_id=492
	--	IF @ent_id in (select ent_id from #ent_access_ofi where access=1)
	--	BEGIN
	--		select w.wo_id,j.run_ent_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,i.item_desc from wo  w with (nolock)
	--		inner join job j with (nolock) on j.wo_id=w.wo_id 
	--		inner join item i with (nolock) on i.item_id=j.item_id
	--		where j.run_ent_id=@ent_id and j.state_cd=3
	--	END

	--commented 
	SELECT @ent_id=ent_id FROM ent_attr ea  WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id=ea.attr_id
		WHERE a.attr_desc='ScannableId' AND attr_value=@equip

		SELECT w.wo_id,j.run_ent_id,j.oper_id,j.seq_no,i.item_desc FROM wo  w WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id=w.wo_id 
		INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id=j.item_id
		WHERE j.run_ent_id=@ent_id AND j.state_cd=3
	END
	IF @type='CheckPalletAssign'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Exists INT = 0
				,@SkipPalletAssignmentCheck NVARCHAR(80) = 0
				,@EntId INT = -1
		
		-- CR486: Improvement: Check if input values are different than NULL
		IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @pallet_id IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0 AS Exits
			RETURN;
		END
		
		-- CR486: Added the logic here to avoid checking for Pallet assignment if Attribute is set
		SELECT TOP 1 @SkipPalletAssignmentCheck = ISNULL(ea.attr_value,0)
					,@EntId = ISNULL(ea.ent_id,-1)
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.run_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		WHERE j.state_cd=3 
			AND j.wo_id = @wo_id 
			AND ea.attr_id = (	SELECT TOP 1 attr_id 
								FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) 
								WHERE a.attr_desc = 'SkipPalletAssignmentCheck'
							 )
		
		--	CR486: Check for value and give back result if OK.
		IF (@SkipPalletAssignmentCheck = 1) 
		BEGIN
			--	CR486: v0.0.4 Added: Check the pallet location versus the running line parent

			DECLARE @Pallet_ent_id INT =-1
			--SELECT @Parent_ent_id = [dbo].fn_S_ofi_GetParentWithAttrValue(@EntId,'AREA')

			declare @ent_id_segment int
			SELECT @ent_id_segment= target_sched_ent_id FROM  job j with (nolock)
			where j.wo_id = @wo_id

			declare @areas_names nvarchar(max)
			SELECT @areas_names = ea.attr_value from ent_attr ea with (nolock)
			left join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id = ea.attr_id
			where a.attr_desc = 'PalletConsumptionAreas' and ea.ent_id = @ent_id_segment

			declare @ent_table table (ent_name nvarchar(20), ent_id int);
			insert into @ent_table (ent_name, ent_id) -- table with parent ent_id 
			(SELECT e.ent_name, e.ent_id from ent e where e.ent_name in (SELECT items FROM fn_ofi_Split (@areas_names, ',')))

			SELECT TOP 1 @Pallet_ent_id = ii.ent_id
			FROM item_inv ii with (nolock)
			WHERE ii.spare2 = @pallet_id

			-- if pallet location is not the running entity's parent then exit as not valid
			--IF (@Pallet_ent_id <> @Parent_ent_id)
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @ent_table WHERE ent_id = @Pallet_ent_id)
			BEGIN 
				SELECT -1 AS exist
				RETURN;
			END
			-- CR486: v0.0.4 Added (end)
			
			
			SELECT 1 AS exist
			RETURN;
		END
		
		-- Standard check for pallet assigment
		IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ofi_AssignHuWoId WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE wo_id=@wo_id AND pallet_id=@pallet_id)
		BEGIN
			SET @Exists=1
		END

		SELECT @Exists AS exist
	END
	if @type='validateUD'
	BEGIN
			DECLARE @process_attr_id INT

			DECLARE @temp TABLE (
				process_id NVARCHAR(40),
				disable_ud  NVARCHAR(40)
			)

			SELECT @process_attr_id = attr_id FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'Disable_UD'

			INSERT INTO @temp (process_id, disable_ud)
			SELECT process_id, attr_value FROM process_attr WHERE attr_id = @process_attr_id

			SELECT ISNULL(mrt.disable_ud, '0') AS disable_ud
			FROM job j
			INNER JOIN oper o ON o.oper_id = j.oper_id
			INNER JOIN process p ON p.process_id = o.process_id
			LEFT JOIN @temp mrt ON p.process_id = mrt.process_id
			WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id


	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Attr_Set]

-- Author          - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    07/13/2007
-- Version          - 3.3.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  	Modified_By	Version		Changes

-- 07/13/2007  		Raghu           3.3.1   	HD# 9608, Change primary key from attr_id + possible_value to row_id.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Subst]
(@orig_item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @alt_no  int  ,
 @pref  int  ,
 @subst_level  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @reqd_grade_cd  int  ,
 @update_inv  bit  ,
 @backflush  bit  ,
 @def_reas_cd  int  ,
 @def_lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @def_sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
 @def_storage_ent_id  int  ,
 @def_reject_ent_id int,
 @spare1  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(1000)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Item_Subst
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By  Ver    	Changes
--07/29/2004	Raghu		2..1.1	Included item_desc for substitute item
--01/20/2006	Rathu		3.1.8	Included ent_name in the select clause
--01/25/2006	Raghu		3.1.8	Included 'def_reject_ent_id' in the select clause. Also included def_reject_ent_id in the parameter list.
--12/27/2007	AML			3.4.0	Included def_sublot_no in select clause and parameter list.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT item_subst.orig_item_id
       ,item_subst.alt_no
       ,item_subst.pref
       ,item_subst.subst_level
       ,item_subst.item_id
       ,item.item_desc
       ,item_subst.reqd_grade_cd
       ,item_subst.instruction
       ,item_subst.qty_per_parent_item
       ,item_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item
       ,item_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item
       ,item_subst.update_inv
       ,item_subst.backflush
       ,item_subst.def_reas_cd
       ,item_subst.def_lot_no
       ,item_subst.def_sublot_no
       ,item_subst.def_storage_ent_id
	   ,storage_ent.ent_name ent_name
       ,item_subst.def_reject_ent_id
       ,item_subst.scaling_factor
       ,item_subst.must_consume_from_inv
       ,item_subst.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
       ,item_subst.may_create_new_lots
       ,item_subst.must_consume_from_wip
       ,item_subst.must_consume_before_prod
       ,item_subst.constant_qty
       ,item_subst.est_time
       ,item_subst.spare1
       ,item_subst.spare2
       ,item_subst.spare3
       ,item_subst.spare4
       ,item_subst.last_edit_comment
       ,item_subst.last_edit_by
       ,item_subst.last_edit_at
       ,item_subst.row_id
       ,item.uom_id uom_id
       ,item.num_decimals num_decimals
  FROM item_subst WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_subst.item_id = item.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent storage_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_subst.def_storage_ent_id = storage_ent.ent_id
  WHERE ((item_subst.orig_item_id = @orig_item_id OR @orig_item_id IS NULL) AND
       (item_subst.alt_no = @alt_no OR @alt_no IS NULL) AND

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_attr_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[job_attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_attr_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on job_attr table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         -
-- Version (last edit)   -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, looping thru cursor is removed
--11/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Update queue_job_attr table automatically
-- 04/04/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7931, Updated job_attr value to FC tags whenever a job attribute is updated.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
/*DECLARE @ent_id		INT32,
	@wo_id		STRING40,
	@oper_id	STRING40,
	@seq_no		INT32,
	@attr_id	INT32,
	@attr_value	STRING80*/
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
		,@wo_id		STRING80
		,@oper_id	STRING80
		,@seq_no	INT32
		,@attr_id	INT32

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE job_attr SET job_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_attr.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE job_attr.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_attr.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_attr.seq_no = i.seq_no AND job_attr.attr_id = i.attr_id

	IF UPDATE(attr_value) BEGIN
		DECLARE job_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT i.wo_id, i.oper_id, i.seq_no, i.attr_id FROM inserted i
		INNER JOIN attr a ON i.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.visible_in_queue = 1

		OPEN job_attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM job_attr_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @attr_id
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			EXEC sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @attr_id
		END
		CLOSE job_attr_cursor
		DEALLOCATE job_attr_cursor
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE sp_S_Item_Inv_GetGradeAndStatus
(

		@item_id			STRING40
	,	@lot_no				STRING40
	,	@sublot_no          STRING40
	,	@grade_cd			INT32 OUT
	,	@status_cd			INT32 OUT
)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_S_Item_Inv_GetGradeAndStatus
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			-
-- Version				-
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By    Ver  Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN
	--  Handle grade code look-up.
	IF (@grade_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- First try the sublot table.
		SELECT @grade_cd = sublot.grade_cd FROM sublot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
			(sublot.item_id = @item_id) and
			(sublot.lot_no = @lot_no) and
			(sublot.sublot_no = @sublot_no);

		-- Next try the lot table.
		IF (@grade_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @grade_cd = lot.grade_cd FROM lot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
				(lot.item_id = @item_id) and
				(lot.lot_no = @lot_no);
			END

		-- If none found then raise an exception.
		IF (@grade_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Invalid or null grade.', 16, 1)
			return
			END
	END

	--  Handle status code look-up.
	IF (@status_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
		-- First try the sublot table.
		SELECT @status_cd = sublot.status_cd FROM sublot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
			(sublot.item_id = @item_id) and
			(sublot.lot_no = @lot_no) and
			(sublot.sublot_no = @sublot_no);

		-- Next try the lot table.
		IF (@status_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
			SELECT @status_cd = lot.status_cd FROM lot WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE
				(lot.item_id = @item_id) and
				(lot.lot_no = @lot_no);
			END

		-- If none found then raise an exception.
		IF (@status_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Invalid or null status.', 16, 1)
			return
			END
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Sample_Char_Link_RecData] (
@sample_id     int,
@char_name     nvarchar(40),
@note          nvarchar(max) = null,
@cause_grp_desc  nvarchar(80) = null,
@cause_desc      nvarchar(80) = null,
@control_move   bit =0,
@ignore_sample  bit =0,
@equipment      nvarchar(80) = null,
@operator       nvarchar(40) = null,
@created_at_utc DATETIME = NULL,
@resultsxml    nvarchar(MAX) =null,
@time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL,
@control_rule_violations NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                    - sp_I_Sample_Char_Link_RecData
-- Description                    - Record Sample Characteristic Data Command. Implements Section 4.3.1 of the SRO DFS.
-- Author                         - JA
-- Date Created                   - 6/27/2011
-- Version (last edit)            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By        Ver            Changes
-- 03/16/2012		Ibrahim							 Fix for the CR L00119389
-- 04/06/2012		MS								 Fix CR L00119541
-- 03/13/2013		Ibrahim							 Added validation for Cause.
-- 03/18/2013		Ibrahim							 Added cancel state validation for Sample.
-- 11/08/2019		RWB					6.2			US#1184121: Added created_at_utc as a parameter so that the time of the results can be specified.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
   @char_id int,
   @cause_id  int,
   @sample_status int,
   @err_msg STRING80
BEGIN
   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sample_id = @sample_id)
     BEGIN
       SET @err_msg = '%1 sample does not exist<7543>,' + STR(@sample_id)
       RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
       RETURN
   END

   SELECT @sample_status = sample_status
   FROM sample WITH (NOLOCK)
   WHERE sample_id=@sample_id

   IF @sample_status = 8 -- Cancel State
   BEGIN
       SET @err_msg = '%1 sample is in cancel state.<7625>,' + STR(@sample_id)
	   RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
	   RETURN
   END

   SELECT @char_id=char_id
   FROM characteristic WITH (NOLOCK)
   WHERE char_name=@char_name;

   IF @char_id is not null
    BEGIN
      IF ( @cause_grp_desc is not null AND @cause_desc is null ) OR
	     ( @cause_grp_desc is null AND @cause_desc is  not null )
	   BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = 'Specify values for both the cause group and cause or for neither.<7622>'
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
	   END
	  IF ( @cause_grp_desc is not null AND @cause_desc is not null )
	   BEGIN
		  SELECT @cause_id=cause_id
		  FROM cause WITH (NOLOCK)
		  INNER JOIN cause_grp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cause.cause_grp_id=cause_grp.cause_grp_id
		  WHERE cause_desc=@cause_desc
		   AND cause_grp_desc=@cause_grp_desc
		  IF @cause_id is null
		  BEGIN
			SET @err_msg = '%1 cause does not exist.<7623>,' + @cause_desc
			RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
			RETURN
		  END
	   END
      IF EXISTS (
        SELECT TOP 1 1
        FROM sample_char_link WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE sample_id = @sample_id
        AND  char_id =@char_id
        )
        BEGIN
			-- Fix for the CR L00119389
			UPDATE sample_char_link
			SET note = @note,
				cause_id = @cause_id,
				control_move = @control_move,
				ignore_sample = @ignore_sample,
				equipment = @equipment
			WHERE (sample_id = @sample_id)
				AND (char_id = @char_id)
        END

     ELSE
       BEGIN
           EXECUTE sp_I_Sample_Char_Link @sample_id,@char_id,null,@note,@cause_id,@control_move,@ignore_sample,@equipment,null,null
       END


    IF @resultsxml IS NOT NULL
	     EXECUTE sp_I_Result_RecordResultData @sample_id=@sample_id, @char_name=@char_name, @resultsxml=@resultsxml, @operator=@operator, @created_at_utc=@created_at_utc,
		@time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value, @control_rule_violations=@control_rule_violations OUTPUT

   END
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_util_shift_link]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- vw_util_shift_link
-- Description			- Returns utilization events broken down by shifts optionally including the job row IDs
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 06/11/2020
-- Version				- 6.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WITH shift_links AS
(SELECT uh.ent_id, uh.event_time_utc AS act_event_time_utc, uh.event_time_utc, uh.event_time_local
		, (SELECT MAX(sh.shift_start_utc)
		FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE sh.ent_id = uh.ent_id AND sh.shift_start_utc <= uh.event_time_utc) AS shift_start_utc
	FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE uh.event_time_utc > DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, GETUTCDATE()),0))
UNION  --- Do not use union all, which may include duplicates when there is an utilization event on the shift start time
SELECT sh.ent_id, util.event_time_utc, sh.shift_start_utc, sh.shift_start_local, sh.shift_start_utc
	FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK)
	OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(uh.event_time_utc) event_time_utc FROM util_history uh WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE uh.ent_id = sh.ent_id
			  AND uh.event_time_utc <= sh.shift_start_utc) util
	WHERE sh.shift_start_utc > DATEADD(HH, -2, DATEADD(HOUR, DATEDIFF(HOUR, 0, GETUTCDATE()),0))
	  AND util.event_time_utc IS NOT NULL
), event_durations AS
(SELECT uslt.ent_id, uslt.act_event_time_utc
	, uslt.event_time_utc
	, uslt.event_time_local
	, uslt.shift_start_utc
	, LEAD(uslt.event_time_utc, 1, GETUTCDATE()) OVER (PARTITION BY uslt.ent_id ORDER BY uslt.event_time_utc) AS event_end_time_utc -- This is the time difference between the broken events by shift start time
FROM shift_links uslt
), job_links AS
(SELECT usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc, usl.event_time_local, usl.shift_start_utc, MAX(jh.row_id) job_hist_row_id
FROM event_durations usl WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT OUTER JOIN job_history jh WITH (NOLOCK) ON usl.ent_id = jh.ent_id AND jh.job_start_utc < usl.event_end_time_utc AND COALESCE(jh.job_end_utc, GETUTCDATE()) > usl.event_time_utc
GROUP BY usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc, usl.event_time_local, usl.shift_start_utc
) , util_shift AS
(SELECT usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc, usl.event_time_utc, usl.event_time_local, usl.shift_start_utc, usl.job_hist_row_id
FROM util_shift_link usl WITH (NOLOCK)
UNION
SELECT jl.ent_id, jl.act_event_time_utc, jl.event_time_utc, jl.event_time_local, jl.shift_start_utc, jl.job_hist_row_id
FROM job_links jl
)
SELECT usl.ent_id, usl.act_event_time_utc
, usl.event_time_utc
, LEAD(usl.event_time_utc, 1, GETUTCDATE()) OVER (PARTITION BY usl.ent_id ORDER BY usl.event_time_utc) AS event_end_time_utc -- This is the time difference between the broken events by shift start time
, usl.event_time_local
, usl.shift_start_utc
, usl.job_hist_row_id
FROM util_shift usl;

SELECT spec.spec_id

           ,spec.spare1

ORDER BY display_seq
