		CASE dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) 
			WHEN 1000.00 THEN 1 
			ELSE ISNULL(dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) ,1)
		END  ratio,
		NULL,
		NULL
	FROM 
	ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id and osu.oper_id = j.oper_id and osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
														AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
														AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
														AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id AND jb.reqd_grade_cd = jb_grade_cd
														AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	--LEFT OUTER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
	--													AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
	--													AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
	--													AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id
	--													AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item jbi WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = jbi.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON case 
															when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
															when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
															else osu.su_ent_id 
													   end = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2) -- Add attribute group =2 (entity)
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
	WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id and osu.oper_id = @oper_id and osu.seq_no = @seq_no and osu.dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1
	ORDER by created_at_utc
	--end
	print @oper_id
	-- Auto insert source silo
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @SourceSilos))
	BEGIN
		-- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
 
		
		print @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET	@minID = 1
 
			SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
 
			INSERT @SourceSilos
			SELECT TOP 1 1 dest_type,
					ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
					oea.storage_ent_id,
					j.item_id,
					aut_item_id,
					jb.item_id,
					1.0 ratio,
					oea.item_group,
					jb.bom_pos
			FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Source' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			--LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = iv.ent_id -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 --and jb.reqd_grade_cd=iv.grade_cd -- Get only for the consumable material
			--INNER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 -- Get only for the consumable material
			--OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			--INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no AND cj.state_cd = 4 -- only take inventory who job completed
			INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no  -- only take inventory who job completed
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																			FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																			WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(jb.item_id,1)
			--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Source', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oea.storage_ent_id,'source',iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id,null)
			WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND isNotValidEnt=0   
			--AND (iv.ent_id IS NOT NULL OR iv.qty_left > 0.00) -- Get only for filled silo => Disabled because handled by silo validity
			order by cj.act_finish_time_local,iv.date_in_local ASC
			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos
 
			DECLARE @Len INT 
			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceSilos
 
			UPDATE @SourceSilos SET ratio = ratio/@Len -- Update ratio
 
			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @id=ID,@dest_type=dest_type,@storage_ent_id=mes_silo_id,@parent_item_id=parent_item_id,@ratio=ratio,@silo_item_group =silo_item_group,
				@silo_item_id = mes_item_id
				FROM @SourceSilos WHERE ID = @minID
				print '@storage_ent_id'
				print @storage_ent_id
				SELECT @jb_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd from job_bom WITH (nolock)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and item_id = @silo_item_id
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
										(
										 [wo_id]									
										,[oper_id]							
										,[seq_no]					
										,[parent_item_id]
										,[ent_id]
										,[jb_item_id] 	
										,[jb_item_group] 
										,[jb_grade_cd] 								
										,[dest_type]							
										,[is_chk]
										,[su_ent_id]
										,[is_active]
										,[ratio]
										,[created_at_utc]
										,[created_at_local]
										,[created_by]
										,[last_edit_at_utc]
										,[last_edit_at_local]
										,[last_edit_by]
										,[active_su_ent_id]
										,[silo_seq]
										)
								VALUES
										(
										 @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@parent_item_id
										,@target_sched_ent_id
										,@silo_item_id
										,@silo_item_group
										,@jb_grade_cd
										,1
										,1
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										,@ratio*100.00
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										)
				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos WHERE id > @minID
			END
		END
	END
	--if @oper_id like '%Rework%'
	if exists (select 1 from oper_attr with(nolock) where oper_id=@oper_id and attr_id in(select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='def_source_su'))
	BEGIN
		declare @mes_ent_id int	
		select @storage_ent_id=ea.attr_value, @mes_ent_id=ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea
		inner join attr a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		inner join ent e on e.ent_id=ea.ent_id
		where e.ent_name in (select attr_value from oper_attr oa
		inner join attr a  on a.attr_id=oa.attr_id where
		attr_desc='def_source_su'
		and oper_id=@oper_id) and attr_desc='SUNumberInAUT'

		insert into @SourceSilos(dest_type,storage_ent_id,mes_silo_id,ratio)
		values(1,@storage_ent_id,@mes_ent_id,1)

	END
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos = 0
	UNION
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos < 0
	UNION 
	SELECT * FROM @SourceSilos where ratio > 0

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_OEL_Can_Log_Data]
(@process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@step_no		INT
,@can_log_data		INT 		OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -	sp_SA_OEL_Can_Log_Data
-- Description	  -	Given a process_id, oper_id and step_no, to find the entity (or its decendants) can log data
--			        where the entity is not excluded from the step
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	  -	01/12/2004
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @ent_id		INT
	,@child_level	INT
	,@row_count	INT
DECLARE @ent_descents	TABLE (ent_id INT, child_level INT, parent_ent_id INT, can_log_data INT)

SET @can_log_data = 0

	DECLARE oel_data_log CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id

	OPEN oel_data_log
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM oel_data_log INTO @ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM oper_step_ent_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no AND ent_id = @ent_id) BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND can_log_data = 1) BEGIN
				SET @can_log_data = 1
				RETURN
			END
			SET @child_level = 0
			DELETE FROM @ent_descents
			INSERT INTO @ent_descents
			SELECT ent_id, @child_level, parent_ent_id, 0 FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
				INSERT INTO @ent_descents
				SELECT el.child_ent_id, @child_level, el.parent_ent_id, e.can_log_data FROM ent_link el WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON el.child_ent_id = e.ent_id
				WHERE el.parent_ent_id IN
					(SELECT ent_id FROM @ent_descents WHERE child_level = @child_level -1)
					AND el.child_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM oper_step_ent_exc WITH (NOLOCK)
					WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND step_no = @step_no)
				SET @row_count = @@rowcount
				IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM @ent_descents WHERE child_level = @child_level AND can_log_data = 1) BEGIN
					SET @can_log_data = 1
					RETURN
				END
				IF (@row_count <= 0) BREAK
			END
		END
	END
	CLOSE oel_data_log
	DEALLOCATE oel_data_log
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_std_oper_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[std_oper]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_std_oper_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on std_oper table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 09/27/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--10/25/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
	,@assoc_file_type STRING20
	,@assoc_file STRING254

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Make sure the assoc_file_type is set to the extension for the assoc_file
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.oper_id = d.oper_id
		WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) BEGIN

		IF Exists(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM inserted i
			WHERE i.assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		UPDATE std_oper SET assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(x.assoc_file)
		FROM (SELECT i.assoc_file, i.oper_id
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.oper_id = d.oper_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE std_oper.oper_id = x.oper_id

		INSERT INTO file_type
		(file_ext, edit_level, view_level, print_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT x.file_ext, 1, 1, 1, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM (SELECT dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) as file_ext
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.oper_id = d.oper_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE x.file_ext IS NOT NULL AND x.file_ext NOT IN (SELECT file_ext FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK))
	END

	UPDATE std_oper SET std_oper.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, std_oper.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE std_oper.oper_id = i.oper_id
END

--===========================================================================================  
-- Name:  sp_SA_ofi_GetStorageUnitData  
-- Description: The stored procedure will fetch all the Storage Unit Data 
--  
-- Usage : Inventory Management
-- ===========================================================================================  
-- Version Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description  
-- 0.01.00 Harpreet    2022-07-15      Initial version.  
-- 0.02.00 Toshali     2022-11-18      Added  description in place of ent_name
-- 0.02.01	Veervar	  2024-01-31		Fetch entity name if description is null
-- ===========================================================================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetStorageUnitData] @attr_id INT
	,@attr_value NVARCHAR(100)
	,@canStore INT
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT e.ent_id
		,ISNULL(e.description,e.ent_Name) as description
	FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id = ea.ent_id	
	WHERE ea.attr_value = @attr_value
		AND can_store = @canStore
		order by e.description
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Bom_Ver]
  (@parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_date datetime ,
   @ver_date_tz INT32 =NULL ,
   @ver_comments nvarchar(80) ,
   @preferred_ver bit ,
   @disassembly bit,
   @start_eff datetime ,
   @start_eff_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @end_eff datetime ,
   @end_eff_tz INT32=NULL ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.6.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 12/04/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 06-06-2003	Sheetal Jain    1600	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
-- 07/07/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed getdate to gmt date and time
-- 08/08/2005	Raghu		2.1.25	HD# 6083, Bom_Ver.Ver_Date should be a local date and not a GMT date.
-- 10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 09/01/2006	Raghu		3.1.22	HD# 8682, Preferred version should be always set for the first bom version
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
-- 11/22/2009	Aay			4.0.0	HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	     ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
	     ,@dbg_resp INT


	SET @ver_date_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@ver_date_tz)
	SET @ver_date				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@ver_date, @ver_date_tz)
	SET @start_eff_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_eff_tz)
	SET @start_eff				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@start_eff, @start_eff_tz)
	SET @end_eff_tz				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_eff_tz)
	SET @end_eff				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@end_eff, @end_eff_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	   -- TRACE
   exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_I_Bom_Ver', @src_key='sp_I_Bom_Ver',
					@date_val1 = @ver_date, @numeric_val1 = @ver_date_tz,
					@date_val2 = @start_eff, @numeric_val2 = @start_eff_tz,
					@date_val3 = @end_eff, @numeric_val3 = @end_eff_tz

--	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = GETUTCDATE()
	ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, - @ver_date_tz, @ver_date)

	SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @ver_date )
	SET @start_eff =  DATEADD(mi, - @start_eff_tz, @start_eff)
	SET @end_eff =  DATEADD(mi, - @end_eff_tz, @end_eff)

	--default the preferred version to be 0; if not supplied or the preferred verison is supplied as null.
	SET @preferred_ver = COALESCE(@preferred_ver, 0)
	SET @disassembly = COALESCE(@disassembly, 0)

	--Verify whether any other bom version already exist; if not default this bom version as the preferred version.
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM bom_ver  WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id <> @ver_id)
		SET @preferred_ver = 1

	INSERT INTO bom_ver (parent_item_id, ver_id,  ver_date,  ver_comments,  preferred_ver, disassembly, start_eff,  end_eff,  last_edit_comment,  last_edit_by,  last_edit_at)
	VALUES (@parent_item_id,  @ver_id,  @ver_date,  @ver_comments,  @preferred_ver, @disassembly, @start_eff,  @end_eff,  @last_edit_comment,  @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

	-- Return timestamp
	--SET @mod_id = (SELECT CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13)
	SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id)))
	FROM bom_ver
	WHERE (parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
	  AND  ver_id = @ver_id)

	--Unset the preferrred versions for other versions under this parent item
	-- if this version set as the preferred version.
	IF @preferred_ver = 1
		UPDATE bom_ver
		SET preferred_ver = 0
		WHERE parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
		  AND ver_id <> @ver_id
END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON

BEGIN
DECLARE	@attr_desc_col	STRING80
	,@SQL		STRING254

	SET @attr_desc_col = 'attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), @attr_id) + 'd_h'
	SELECT @queue_item_attr = ISNULL(@queue_item_attr, 0), @queue_job_attr = ISNULL(@queue_job_attr, 0)
		,@inv_item_attr = ISNULL(@inv_item_attr, 0), @inv_lot_attr = ISNULL(@inv_lot_attr, 0)

	--Update queue_item_attr.*d_h column ONLY if this attribute is visible in queue.
	IF (@queue_item_attr = 1) BEGIN
		--Check if the *d_h column exist in the queue_item_attr table.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND name = @attr_desc_col) BEGIN
			SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_item_attr SET ' + @attr_desc_col + '=@attr_desc'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc
		END
	END

	--Update queue_job_attr.*d_h column ONLY if this attribute is visible in queue.
	IF (@queue_job_attr = 1) BEGIN
		--Check if the *d_h column exist in the queue_job_attr table.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'QUEUE_JOB_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND name = @attr_desc_col) BEGIN
			SET @SQL = 'UPDATE queue_job_attr SET ' + @attr_desc_col + '=@attr_desc'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc
		END
	END

	--Update inv_item_attr.*d_h column ONLY if this attribute is visible in the inventory.
	IF (@inv_item_attr = 1) BEGIN
		--Check if the *d_h column exist in the inv_item_attr table.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_ITEM_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND name = @attr_desc_col) BEGIN
			SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_item_attr SET ' + @attr_desc_col + '=@attr_desc'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc
		END
	END

	--Update inv_lot_attr.*d_h column ONLY if this attribute is visible in the inventory.
	IF (@inv_lot_attr = 1) BEGIN
		--Check if the *d_h column exist in the inv_lot_attr table.
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM syscolumns
			WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE UPPER(name) = 'INV_LOT_ATTR' AND xtype = 'U')
			  AND name = @attr_desc_col) BEGIN
			SET @SQL = 'UPDATE inv_lot_attr SET ' + @attr_desc_col + '=@attr_desc'
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@attr_desc STRING80', @attr_desc
		END
	END
END

CREATE  TRIGGER [tg_job_bom_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[job_bom]
AFTER INSERT
as
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - tg_job_bom_aft_ins
-- Description	      - Updates FC Tags after any insert is made on this table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 01/22/2003
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.13
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 05/10/2005		Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- 03/30/2006		SJ          31013 HD#7782 - ERROR IN SUPERVISOR'S CREATE WORK ORDER FROM PROCESS
-- 09/22/2008		AML			L00082756 - Replace cursor with a table variable and added (rowlock) to update statements
--								to prevent deadlocks.
-- 09/26/2012		Ravi Teja	4.6	  CR L00122689 - (Merge of CR L00122266) Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item of job_bom table.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN

	DECLARE @wo_id				NVARCHAR(80),
			@oper_id			NVARCHAR(80),
			@seq_no				INT,
			@ent_id				INT32,
			@bom_pos			INT32,
			@def_lot_no			STRING40,
			@def_storage_ent_id	INT32,
			@from_ent_id		INT32,
			@to_ent_id			INT32,
			@def_reas_cd		INT32,
			@prod_cd			INT32,
			@cons_cd			INT32

	DECLARE @t_job_bom TABLE (
		id int identity,
		wo_id nvarchar(40),
		oper_id nvarchar(40),
		seq_no int,
		bom_pos int,
		def_lot_no nvarchar(40),
		def_storage_ent_id int,
		def_reas_cd int
	)

	INSERT INTO @t_job_bom ( wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, def_lot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reas_cd )
	SELECT b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.bom_pos, b.def_lot_no, b.def_storage_ent_id, b.def_reas_cd
	FROM job_bom a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN inserted b ON
		a.wo_id = b.wo_id AND
		a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND
		a.seq_no = b.seq_no AND
		a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
	ORDER BY a.wo_id, a.oper_id, a.seq_no, a.bom_pos

	DECLARE @max_id AS INT, @count AS INT
	SELECT @max_id = MAX( id ), @count = MIN( id ) FROM @t_job_bom

	WHILE ( @count <= @max_id ) BEGIN

		SELECT	@wo_id = wo_id, @oper_id = oper_id, @seq_no = seq_no
			,	@bom_pos = bom_pos, @def_lot_no = def_lot_no
			,	@def_storage_ent_id = def_storage_ent_id
			,	@def_reas_cd = def_reas_cd
		FROM @t_job_bom
		WHERE id = @count

		IF ( UPDATE(def_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(def_lot_no) OR UPDATE(def_storage_ent_id) ) BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id
			FROM job_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

			IF ( @bom_pos <= 0 ) BEGIN
				SELECT @to_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id, @prod_cd = @def_reas_cd
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT @from_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id, @cons_cd = @def_reas_cd
			END

			SELECT	@def_lot_no = ISNULL( @def_lot_no, '' )
				,	@to_ent_id = ISNULL( @to_ent_id, 0 )
				,	@prod_cd = ISNULL( @prod_cd, 0 )
				,	@from_ent_id = ISNULL( @from_ent_id, 0 )
				,	@cons_Cd = ISNULL( @cons_cd, 0 )

		END

		SET @count = @count + 1
	END

	--Make sure that for CWOFP rounding does not happen
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq') IS NULL BEGIN
		UPDATE job_bom WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET job_bom.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item,
			job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item = i.max_qty_per_parent_item,
			job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item = i.min_qty_per_parent_item
		FROM inserted i INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
		WHERE job_bom.wo_id = i.wo_id AND
			  job_bom.oper_id = i.oper_id AND
			  job_bom.seq_no = i.seq_no AND
			  job_bom.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	END ELSE BEGIN
		UPDATE job_bom WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET job_bom.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item,
			job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item = i.max_qty_per_parent_item,
			job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item = i.min_qty_per_parent_item
		FROM inserted i INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
		WHERE job_bom.wo_id = i.wo_id AND
			  job_bom.oper_id = i.oper_id AND
			  job_bom.seq_no = i.seq_no AND
			  job_bom.bom_pos = i.bom_pos AND
			  NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #tbl_temp_for_op_seq t WHERE t.wo_id = i.wo_id)
	END
END

/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[SP_I_OFI_WO_ALLOWBINS]
-- Description:	Update or Insert Allow Bins Consumption value
-- 
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	SSB				2024-03-27			Initial version

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_I_OFI_WO_ALLOWBINS] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@wo_id nvarchar (50),
	@chkABA int,
	@user_name NVARCHAR(80)=NULL

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	
	declare @attr_id nvarchar(50) 
	DECLARE  
		@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
		,@userName NVARCHAR(80)
		,@change_type INT = 1
		,@table_name NVARCHAR(40)='[wo_attr]'
		,@row_id INT
		,@log_id INT
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(40)='[attr_value]'
		,@oldVal NVARCHAR(40)
		,@newval NVARCHAR(40)		
		,@delete_detail NVARCHAR(100)
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'ReworkBinConsumption'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@audit_category NVARCHAR(80) = 'Info'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@strCommentMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''		
		,@keyField1 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField2 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField3 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField4 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField5 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField6 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL		
		,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL;
		DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName


	select @attr_id=attr_id from attr (nolock) where attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment'

		if exists (select 1 from wo_attr  wa (nolock)
		inner join wo w (nolock) on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
		where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=@wo_id)
		BEGIN
			select @oldVal=attr_value , @row_id=wa.row_id from wo_attr  wa (nolock)
		inner join wo w (nolock) on w.wo_id=wa.wo_id
		inner join attr a (nolock) on a.attr_id=wa.attr_id
		where a.attr_desc='AllowBinAssignment' and w.wo_id=@wo_id

		
			EXEC [sp_U_ofi_Wo_Attr]
				@wo_id = @wo_id,
				@attr_id = @attr_id,
				@attr_value = @chkABA
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
				DECLARE	
				@mod_id varchar(30)

				EXEC [sp_I_Wo_Attr]
				@wo_id = @wo_id,
				@attr_id = @attr_id,
				@attr_value = @chkABA,
				@notes = NULL,
				@last_edit_comment = NULL,
				@mod_id = @mod_id OUTPUT

				SELECT	@mod_id as N'@mod_id'
				--SET @row_id=@mod_id
				select @row_id=max(row_id)+1 from wo_attr
				SET @oldVal=0
		END

	SET @newval=@chkABA


	--insert audit trail if attribute value is changed
	IF @oldVal <> @chkABA
	BEGIN

	EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		,@change_type
		,@table_name
		,@row_id
		,@column_name
		,@oldVal
		,@newval
		,@audit_comments
		,@delete_detail;

	UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
	SET origin = @strFunctionName
	WHERE log_id = @log_id;
	SET @strActivityMsg = 'Updated'

	SET @strCommentMsg = 'WO: ' + @wo_id + ' AllowBinAssignment attribute value updated.' 
	

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
		log_id
		,keyField1
		,keyField2
		,keyField3
		,keyField4
		,module_id
		,function_id
		,spare1
		,spare2
		,spare3
		,spare4
		,spare5
		,spare6
		,audit_category
		,activity
		,comments
		,created_at_utc
		,created_at_local
		,created_by
		)
	VALUES (
		@log_id
		,@wo_id
		,NULL
		,NULL
		,NULL
		,@strModuleName
		,@strFunctionName
		,@keyField1
		,@keyField2
		,@keyField3
		,@keyField4
		,@keyField5
		,@keyField6
		,@audit_category
		,@strActivityMsg
		,@strCommentMsg
		,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
		,@logged_at
		,@user_name
		);
	END
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_WO_SetStatus]
       (@wo_id		    STRING40
,	@req_status_cd	INT32
,	@user_id		STRING40 = NULL
,	@event_time_local DATETIME = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0
,	@check_privs 		INT32 = 1
,   @new_status_cd  INT32 OUTPUT)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_U_WO_SetStatus
-- Description	      - Updates a work order's jobs based on the current status of the work order and the new requested
--                      status for the work order.
--
--                      WO Statuses:
--							1 = New
--							2 = Ready
--							3 = In Progress
--							4 = Complete
--							5 = Suspended
--							6 = On Hold
--							7 = Cancelled (valid as a requested status only; a work order cannot be in this state)
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver		Changes
-- 03/11/2014		Rich		5.0.0	For story 299348, fixed the code that sets the work order status to Complete by having it pass the actual job_pos if the job is running or 0 if the job is not running as the job_pos parameter to sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs.
-- 05/16/2014		RaghuG		5.0.0	UserStory:333123, As Michelle, I want to see an intelligible error when trying to complete a work order having more than one job not meeting the required quantity so that I can more quickly fix the problem
-- 07/31/2014       Srinivasa Tentu   5.0.0   UserStory:345196, Added @check_privs optional input parameter to check privileges conditionally.
-- 09/12/2016	Raghu		5.3	UserStory:675639-As Lenka, I want new utilization events to be generated based on the job start/end reason codes
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

    DECLARE @RouteGraph   TABLE(oper_id NVARCHAR(40), seq_no INT, input_oper_id NVARCHAR(40), input_seq_no INT, state_cd INT)

	DECLARE @wo_status		INT32;
	DECLARE @oper_id		VARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @seq_no			INT32;
	DECLARE @state_cd_count	INT32;
	DECLARE @ready_all_new_jobs	INT32;
	DECLARE @line_id		INT32;
	DECLARE @max_wo			INT32;
	DECLARE @wo_count		INT32;
	DECLARE @run_wo_id		VARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @ent_id			INT32;
	DECLARE @target_sched_ent_id INT32;
	DECLARE @run_ent_id		INT32;
	DECLARE @run_oper_id	VARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @run_seq_no		INT32;
	DECLARE @run_job_pos	INT32;
	DECLARE @suspended		INT32;
	DECLARE @state_cd		INT32;
	DECLARE @qty_prod		FLOAT;
	DECLARE @qty_rejected	FLOAT;
	DECLARE @JobsWithNoProd		INT32;
	DECLARE @jobs_with_prod	INT32;
	DECLARE @error_msg		NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @severity		INT32;
	DECLARE @job_end_utc		TDATETIME;

 	SET @suspended = 5
	SET @wo_status = dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(@wo_id)

	SET @check_privs = COALESCE(@check_privs, 1)

	-- Raise an error if an unsupported status change is attempted
	IF (@wo_status = 4 AND @req_status_cd = 5)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unsupported work order status change:  Completed to Suspended<7650>', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@wo_status = 4 AND @req_status_cd = 6)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Unsupported work order status change:  Completed to On Hold<7651>', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@wo_status = 4 and (@req_status_cd = 2 OR @req_status_cd = 3))
	BEGIN
		SELECT @JobsWithNoProd = COUNT(*) FROM JOB
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND (qty_prod + qty_rejected) = 0

		IF (@JobsWithNoProd = 0)
		BEGIN
			IF (@req_status_cd = 2)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('The work order status cannot be changed from Completed to Ready when all jobs have production reported<7652>', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END

			IF (@req_status_cd = 3)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('The work order status cannot be changed from Completed to Running when all jobs have production reported<7653>', 16, 1)
				RETURN -1
			END
		END
	END

	IF (@event_time_local IS NULL)
		EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, NULL, @event_time_local OUTPUT, NULL

	-- When the requested status for the work order is New(1),
	-- set the state of all jobs in the work order to New, provided
	-- that all jobs for the work order have 0 for qty_prod and qty_rejected.
	IF (@req_status_cd = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @jobs_with_prod = COUNT(*)
		FROM job
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND (qty_prod + qty_rejected) <> 0

		IF @jobs_with_prod <> 0
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The status of the work order cannot be changed to New unless the produced and rejected quantities for all jobs are zero.{7647}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		DECLARE wo_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT oper_id, seq_no, run_ent_id, state_cd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd <> 1
		OPEN wo_job_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM wo_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @run_ent_id, @state_cd
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			IF @state_cd = 3
			BEGIN
				EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=1
					, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE job SET state_cd = 1 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
			END
		END
		CLOSE wo_job_cursor
		DEALLOCATE wo_job_cursor
	END

	-- If the work order's status is any state other than Ready, and the requested status is Running,
	-- set the work order to Ready.  Then, later in this proc, it will be changed from
	-- Ready to Running
	IF (@wo_status <> 2 AND @req_status_cd = 3)
	BEGIN
		EXEC sp_U_WO_SetStatus @wo_id, 2, @user_id, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @check_privs, @new_status_cd OUTPUT

		-- In some cases, a second call to set the status of the work order to ready will be needed
		-- (e.g. if the original routing was Suspended -> On Hold -> Ready)
		IF (@new_status_cd <> 2)
			EXEC sp_U_WO_SetStatus @wo_id, 2, @user_id, @event_time_local, @time_zone_bias_value, @check_privs, @new_status_cd OUTPUT

		-- If the work order still does not have a status of Ready, then something has gone wrong
		IF (@new_status_cd <> 2)
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('A failure setting the status of the Work Order to Running has occurred.{7649}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		SET @wo_status = 2
	END

	-- When the current status of the Work Order is Running(3), and the requested status is Ready(2),
	-- set the state of all running jobs to Ready.
	IF (@req_status_cd = 2 AND @wo_status = 3)
	BEGIN
       DECLARE wo_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
       SELECT oper_id, seq_no, run_ent_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 3
       OPEN wo_job_cursor
       WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
           FETCH NEXT FROM wo_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @run_ent_id
           IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
           EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=2
		, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
       END
       CLOSE wo_job_cursor
       DEALLOCATE wo_job_cursor
	END

	-- When the current status of the Work Order is On Hold (6), and the requested status is Ready (2)
	-- set the state of all On Hold jobs to Ready.
	ELSE IF (@req_status_cd = 2 AND @wo_status = 6)
    BEGIN
		UPDATE job SET state_cd = 2 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 6
    END

    -- When current status of the Work Order is Complete (4) and the requested status is Ready (2)
    -- set the state of all Cancelled (7) jobs and all Completed (4) jobs that have no production
    -- recorded for them to Ready (2).
    ELSE IF (@req_status_cd = 2 AND @wo_status = 4)
    BEGIN
		UPDATE job SET state_cd = 2
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			AND (state_cd = 7
			OR (state_cd = 4 AND qty_prod = 0 AND qty_rejected = 0))
    END

	-- When the requested status for the work order is Suspended(5),
	-- set the state of all jobs in the work order to Suspended, except
	-- for jobs with a state of Complete(4) or Cancelled(7).
	ELSE IF (@req_status_cd = 5)
	BEGIN
       DECLARE wo_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
       SELECT oper_id, seq_no, run_ent_id, state_cd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7
       OPEN wo_job_cursor
       WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
           FETCH NEXT FROM wo_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @run_ent_id, @state_cd
           IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
           IF @state_cd = 3
           BEGIN
           	EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=5
			, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
           END
           ELSE
           BEGIN
               UPDATE job SET state_cd = 5 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
           END
       END
       CLOSE wo_job_cursor
       DEALLOCATE wo_job_cursor
	END

	-- When the requested status for the work order is OnHold(6),
	-- set the state of all jobs in the work order to On Hold, except
	-- for jobs with a state of Complete(4) or Cancelled(7).
	ELSE IF (@req_status_cd = 6)
	BEGIN
       DECLARE wo_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
       SELECT oper_id, seq_no, run_ent_id, state_cd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7 AND state_cd <> 6
       OPEN wo_job_cursor
       WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
           FETCH NEXT FROM wo_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @run_ent_id, @state_cd
           IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
           IF @state_cd = 3
           BEGIN
           	EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=6
			, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
           END
           ELSE
           BEGIN
               UPDATE job SET state_cd = 6 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
           END
       END
       CLOSE wo_job_cursor
       DEALLOCATE wo_job_cursor
	END

    -- If the new status is Ready (2)  and work order status is New (1) or Suspended (5) or the new
    -- status is Running (3) and the work order status is Ready (2), we may need to build a route
    -- graph.  We need to build a route graph if we are readying the WO but not all the jobs in the WO
    -- or if we are running the job but the line can run more that one WO.
    ELSE IF ((@req_status_cd = 2 AND (@wo_status = 1 OR @wo_status = 5)) OR (@req_status_cd = 3 AND @wo_status = 2))
    BEGIN
		IF (@req_status_cd = 2)
		BEGIN
			-- Read the 'Ready all new jobs of a work order together' system attribute
			SELECT @ready_all_new_jobs = CONVERT(INT,attr_value) FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 254;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- Get the line the work order is scheduled to run on
			SELECT @line_id = target_sched_line_id FROM WO WITH(NOLOCK) where wo_id = @wo_id
			IF (@line_id IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('Work order is not scheduled to a line<7868>', 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
			-- Get the maximum number of work orders that can run on the line
			SELECT @max_wo = max_wo FROM line WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE line_id = @line_id
		END
		IF ((@req_status_cd = 2 AND @ready_all_new_jobs = 0) OR (@req_status_cd = 3 AND @max_wo > 1))
		BEGIN
			-- Recurse backwards through the job route from each terminal node (final job)
			WITH tree
			AS
			(
				SELECT jr.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, j.state_cd
				FROM job_route jr WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job j ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
				WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
					  AND j.final_job = 1

				UNION ALL

				SELECT jr.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, jr.input_oper_id, jr.input_seq_no, j.state_cd
				FROM job_route jr WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job j ON jr.wo_id = j.wo_id AND jr.oper_id = j.oper_id AND jr.seq_no = j.seq_no
				JOIN tree ON tree.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND tree.input_oper_id = jr.oper_id AND tree.input_seq_no = jr.seq_no
			)

			INSERT INTO @RouteGraph (oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, state_cd)
				SELECT oper_id, seq_no, input_oper_id, input_seq_no, state_cd from tree

				UNION

				-- The starting nodes in the route graph are not included in the job route,
				-- so these must be added separately.
				SELECT oper_id, seq_no, null, null, state_cd
				FROM job
				WHERE first_job = 1 AND wo_id = @wo_id
		END

		IF (@req_status_cd = 2)
		BEGIN
			IF (@ready_all_new_jobs = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- Set the state of all jobs that are not Complete(4) or Cancelled(7) to Ready(2)
				UPDATE job
					SET state_cd = 2
					FROM job
					WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

				-- Set the state of all jobs that are not Complete(4) or Cancelled(7), and that are not preceded by a job with a state
				-- other than Complete or Cancelled, to Ready(2).


				-- Process jobs which have a state of New(1) or Suspended(5)
				DECLARE route_tree_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
				SELECT oper_id, seq_no FROM @RouteGraph WHERE (state_cd = 1 OR state_cd = 5)
				OPEN route_tree_cursor
				WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
					  FETCH NEXT FROM route_tree_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no
					  IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK;

					-- Recurse backwards through the job route, starting with each selected job
					WITH route_tree
					AS
					(
					SELECT rt.oper_id, rt.seq_no, rt.input_oper_id, rt.input_seq_no, rt.state_cd
					FROM @RouteGraph rt
					WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
						  AND seq_no = @seq_no

					UNION ALL

					SELECT rt.oper_id, rt.seq_no, rt.input_oper_id, rt.input_seq_no, rt.state_cd
					FROM @RouteGraph rt
					JOIN route_tree ON route_tree.input_oper_id = rt.oper_id AND route_tree.input_seq_no = rt.seq_no
					)

					-- Find all jobs in the subtree consisting of the job route, backwards, from the selected job
					-- which have a state of Complete(4) or Cancelled(7)
					SELECT @state_cd_count = COUNT(*)
					FROM route_tree
					WHERE state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7 AND oper_id <> @oper_id OR seq_no <> @seq_no

					-- If no jobs with a state other than Complete or Cancelled were found in the subtree,
					-- set the state of the selected (i.e. via the cursor) job to Ready(2)
					IF (@state_cd_count = 0) UPDATE job SET state_cd = 2 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no

				END
				CLOSE route_tree_cursor
				DEALLOCATE route_tree_cursor
			END
		END

		IF (@req_status_cd = 3)
		BEGIN
			-- Check to see how many work orders are currently running on the line
			SELECT @wo_count = count(*)
			FROM
				(SELECT DISTINCT(wo.wo_id)
				 FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
				 INNER JOIN job WITH(NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = job.wo_id
				 WHERE wo.target_sched_line_id = @line_id AND job.state_cd = 3) X

			-- Suspend all work orders on the line if starting another work order on the line
			-- would exceed the maximum number of work orders that can run on the line
			IF (@wo_count >= @max_wo)
			BEGIN
				-- Suspend all jobs for any work orders currently running on entities in the line
				-- by calling sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob for each running job that is part of a work order scheduled to
				-- the line
				DECLARE suspend_wo_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
				SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, j.run_ent_id, je.job_pos
				FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON wo.wo_id = j.wo_id
				INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND j.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND j.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
				WHERE wo.target_sched_line_id = @line_id AND j.state_cd = 3
				OPEN suspend_wo_cursor
				WHILE (1=1)
				BEGIN
					FETCH NEXT FROM suspend_wo_cursor INTO @run_wo_id, @run_oper_id, @run_seq_no, @run_ent_id, @run_job_pos
					IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
					EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@run_wo_id, @oper_id=@run_oper_id, @seq_no=@run_seq_no, @paused_job_state=@suspended
						, @job_pos=@run_job_pos, @status_notes=@user_id, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
				END
				CLOSE suspend_wo_cursor
				DEALLOCATE suspend_wo_cursor
			END

			-- Loop through all ready jobs in the work order being started and start the jobs by
			-- calling sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs
			DECLARE wo_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT oper_id, seq_no, target_sched_ent_id FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd = 2
			OPEN wo_job_cursor
			WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
				FETCH NEXT FROM wo_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @target_sched_ent_id
				IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
				-- If the line can run multiple lines, then we only want to start the ready job(s) closest
				-- the first operation
				IF (@max_wo > 1)
				BEGIN
					-- Recurse backwards through the job route, starting with each selected job
					WITH route_tree
					AS
					(
						SELECT rt.oper_id, rt.seq_no, rt.input_oper_id, rt.input_seq_no, rt.state_cd
						FROM @RouteGraph rt
						WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
							  AND seq_no = @seq_no

						UNION ALL

						SELECT rt.oper_id, rt.seq_no, rt.input_oper_id, rt.input_seq_no, rt.state_cd
						FROM @RouteGraph rt
						JOIN route_tree ON route_tree.input_oper_id = rt.oper_id AND route_tree.input_seq_no = rt.seq_no
					)

					-- Find all jobs in the subtree consisting of the job route, backwards, from the selected job
					-- which have a state of Complete(4) or Cancelled(7)
					SELECT @state_cd_count = COUNT(*)
					FROM route_tree
					WHERE state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7 AND oper_id <> @oper_id OR seq_no <> @seq_no
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @state_cd_count = 0
				END
				-- if the state_cd_count is zero, we can start this job
				IF (@state_cd_count = 0)
				BEGIN
					-- Check if the entity is already at its limit of jobs it can run.  If so, end all the jobs
					-- currently running before starting this work orders job.
					IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM JOB_EXEC WITH(NOLOCK)	WHERE ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id AND cur_wo_id IS NOT NULL)
					BEGIN
						DECLARE suspend_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
						SELECT cur_wo_id, cur_oper_id, cur_seq_no, ent_id, job_pos
						FROM job_exec						WHERE ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id
						OPEN suspend_job_cursor
						WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
							FETCH NEXT FROM suspend_job_cursor INTO @run_wo_id, @run_oper_id, @run_seq_no, @run_ent_id, @run_job_pos
							IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
							IF (@event_time_local IS NOT NULL) SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@run_ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE()) ELSE SET @job_end_utc = NULL
							EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@run_wo_id, @oper_id=@run_oper_id, @seq_no=@run_seq_no, @paused_job_state=@suspended, @job_pos=@run_job_pos
								, @status_notes=@user_id, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
						END
						CLOSE suspend_job_cursor
						DEALLOCATE suspend_job_cursor
					END
					-- Check to see if there are any jobs scheduled to this line that are running on the entity.
					-- If so, pause them.
declare @temp_state_cd int
					IF (@max_wo > 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @run_wo_id = null
						SELECT @run_wo_id = j.wo_id, @run_oper_id = j.oper_id, @run_seq_no = j.seq_no, @run_job_pos = je.job_pos, @temp_state_cd = j.state_cd
						FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
						INNER JOIN job_exec je WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND j.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND j.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
						WHERE state_cd = 3
							AND je.ent_id = @target_sched_ent_id
							AND j.wo_id IN (SELECT wo_id FROM wo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE target_sched_line_id = @line_id)

						IF (@run_wo_id IS NOT NULL)
						BEGIN
							IF (@event_time_local IS NOT NULL) SET @job_end_utc = dbo.fn_TZ_GetUtcDateFromLocal(@run_ent_id, @event_time_local, GETUTCDATE()) ELSE SET @job_end_utc = NULL
							EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseJob @ent_id=@target_sched_ent_id, @wo_id=@run_wo_id, @oper_id=@run_oper_id, @seq_no=@run_seq_no, @paused_job_state=@suspended, @job_pos=@run_job_pos
								, @status_notes=@user_id, @job_end_utc=@job_end_utc, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
						END
					END
					EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_StartBatchJobs @ent_id=@target_sched_ent_id, @user_id=@user_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL
						, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=1, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_start_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
				END
			END
			CLOSE wo_job_cursor
			DEALLOCATE wo_job_cursor
		END
    END

	ELSE IF (@req_status_cd = 4)
	BEGIN
		-- Complete all of the work order's jobs except for those which have a status of Cancelled(7)
		-- by calling sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs
		DECLARE complete_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT j.oper_id, j.seq_no, COALESCE(j.run_ent_id, j.target_sched_ent_id), COALESCE(je.job_pos, 0) AS job_pos
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = je.cur_wo_id AND j.oper_id = je.cur_oper_id AND j.seq_no = je.cur_seq_no
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd <> 7 AND state_cd <> 4
		ORDER BY j.display_seq, j.seq_no
		OPEN complete_job_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM complete_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @target_sched_ent_id, @run_job_pos
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			-- There is a possiblitity that we only want to end all the jobs in a batch if the job in the
			-- work order being ended is currently running.  If the job is not running, we may want to
			-- leave other jobs in the batch alone.
			BEGIN TRY
                EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_EndBatchJobs @ent_id=@target_sched_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @job_pos=@run_job_pos, @status_notes=NULL, @user_id=@user_id
			, @check_privs=@check_privs, @check_certs=NULL, @client_type=NULL, @no_propogation=NULL, @check_auto_job_start=NULL
			, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                	SELECT @error_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @severity = ERROR_SEVERITY()
                	RAISERROR(@error_msg, @severity, 1)
                	RETURN
                END CATCH
		END
		CLOSE complete_job_cursor
		DEALLOCATE complete_job_cursor
	END

	-- When the requested status for the work order is Cancelled(7),
	-- set the state of all jobs in the work order to Cancelled, except
	-- for jobs with a state of Complete(4).
	ELSE IF (@req_status_cd = 7)
	BEGIN
       DECLARE wo_job_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
       SELECT oper_id, seq_no, run_ent_id, state_cd FROM job WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND state_cd <> 4 AND state_cd <> 7
       OPEN wo_job_cursor
       WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
           FETCH NEXT FROM wo_job_cursor INTO @oper_id, @seq_no, @run_ent_id, @state_cd
           IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
           IF @state_cd = 3
           BEGIN
           	EXEC sp_U_Job_Exec_PauseBatchJobs @ent_id=@run_ent_id, @wo_id=@wo_id, @oper_id=@oper_id, @seq_no=@seq_no, @paused_job_state=5
					, @job_pos=NULL, @status_notes=NULL, @event_time_local=@event_time_local, @job_end_utc=NULL, @time_zone_bias_value=@time_zone_bias_value
                END
           UPDATE job SET state_cd = 7 WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
       END
       CLOSE wo_job_cursor
       DEALLOCATE wo_job_cursor
	END

   SET @new_status_cd = dbo.fn_GetWOStatus(@wo_id)
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_TZ_GetDateInfo]
(
	@site_ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,	@inout_utc	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL OUTPUT
,	@inout_local	TDATETIME_NULL = NULL OUTPUT
,	@inout_tz_bias	INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      Universal routine that will fill in any NULL Input/Output params.
--					  If a value is passed for site_ent_id, it will override any inout_tz_bias passed.
--                    Pass a site_ent_id if you want to work with an Entity Local offset.
--                    Pass NULL for site_ent_id and inout_tz_bias to work with a Client Local offset.
-- Author             -
-- Date Created	      -	12/16/2009
-- Version		      - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--02/01/2017		Raghu			5.3	UserStory:745714 - As Schneider Electric, I want to fix CR L00143354 so that the MES Web portal screens do not have timeouts/deadlocks
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @region_id nvarchar(80)
	DECLARE @current_utc datetime
	DECLARE @row_count int
	DECLARE	@context_info int32

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @current_utc = GetUtcDate()

	-- get a valid offset based on Entities Site or Client region
	IF ( @site_ent_id IS NOT NULL OR @inout_tz_bias IS NULL ) BEGIN

		-- Need to get region_id - try using the entity site first
		IF ( @site_ent_id IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			select @region_id = s.region_id from ent WITH (NOLOCK)
				left outer join site s WITH (NOLOCK) on s.ent_id = ent.site
				where ent.ent_id = @site_ent_id
		END
		--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 1', @str_val1=@region_id

		-- If we still need region_id, get it from sessn table
		IF ( @region_id IS NULL ) BEGIN
			-- Get session_id from connection context
			SELECT @context_info = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE spid =  @@spid
			--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='log session_id', @numeric_val1=@context_info
			--Retrieve the current region from the session context.
			SELECT @region_id = region_id FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @context_info
		END
		--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 2', @str_val1=@region_id

		-- if no time passed in, we have to generate one based on UTC
		if ( @inout_utc IS NULL AND @inout_local IS NULL )
			SET @inout_utc = @current_utc

		-- if we have UTC time, use it to lookup our offset
		IF ( @inout_utc IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			select @inout_tz_bias = max(offset) from tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
			where (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id is NULL AND default_region = 1))
				AND (start_utc <= @inout_utc AND end_utc >= @inout_utc)

			-- since we're basing off UTC and bias, clear out any local value passed in - it will be filled in later
			SET @inout_local = NULL
			--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 3', @str_val1=@region_id, @numeric_val1=@inout_tz_bias
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			-- use passed local to get offset
			select @inout_tz_bias = max(offset), @row_count = count(offset) from tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
			where (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id is NULL AND default_region = 1))
				AND (start_local <= @inout_local AND end_local >= @inout_local)

			-- One hour a year we can get multiple rows. During this time, we use our current offset nased off UTC
			IF ( @row_count > 1 ) BEGIN
				select @inout_tz_bias = max(offset) from tz_offset WITH (NOLOCK)
				where (region_id = @region_id OR (@region_id is NULL AND default_region = 1))
					AND (start_utc <= @current_utc AND end_utc >= @current_utc)
			END
			--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 4', @str_val1=@region_id, @numeric_val1=@inout_tz_bias
		END
	END

	-- Incase we couldn't find any info above, make sure we have some bias
	IF ( @inout_tz_bias IS NULL ) BEGIN
		IF ( @inout_utc IS NOT NULL AND @inout_local IS NOT NULL ) BEGIN
			SET @inout_tz_bias = DATEDIFF(mi, @inout_utc, @inout_local)
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @inout_tz_bias = DATEDIFF(mi, GetUtcDate(), GetDate())
		END
		--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 5', @str_val1=@region_id, @numeric_val1=@inout_tz_bias
	END

	-- Get UTC - Bias should exist at this point
	IF ( @inout_utc IS NULL ) BEGIN
		IF ( @inout_local IS NULL ) BEGIN
			SET @inout_utc = GetUtcDate()
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			SET @inout_utc = DATEADD(mi, -@inout_tz_bias, @inout_local)
		END
	END
	--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 6', @str_val1=@region_id, @numeric_val1=@inout_tz_bias, @date_val1=@inout_utc

	-- Get LOCAL - Bias and Utc should exist at this point
	IF ( @inout_local IS NULL ) BEGIN
		SET @inout_local = DATEADD(mi, @inout_tz_bias, @inout_utc)
	END
	--EXEC sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_TZ_GetDateInfo', @src_key='spot 7', @str_val1=@region_id, @numeric_val1=@inout_tz_bias, @date_val1=@inout_local
END

-- Name:		[ufn_ofi_GetJobSpecByEntityGroup]
-- Description: This function will get specs info for provided EntityGroup.
--              Updated to include Packing Logic (specs)
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version      Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00     XPM, AML            2026-01-13       Initial version.
-- 0.01.01     XPM, AML            2026-01-15       Fixed some data type issues.
-- 0.01.02     XPM, AML            2026-01-15       Added Specs logic
-- 0.02.00     XPM, AML            2026-04-21       Added DisableMetalDetector Spec
-- 0.02.01     XPM, AML            2026-05-11		Updated logic to obtain Netto weight per bag using UOM conversion
-- 0.02.02     XPM, AML            2026-05-13       Fixed duplicate wo
-- 0.02.03     XPM, AML            2026-05-14       Fixed duplicate specs by replacing the single insert with default insert and separate updates.
-- 0.02.04     XPM, AML            2026-05-15       Updated Bags per pallet logic
-- 0.02.05     XPM, AML            2026-05-19       Added Bag Type Spec
-- 0.02.06      XPM, AML			2026-05-20		 Bags per pallet calculated via UOM conversion and added NumberOfLayers mapped from ext.bags_per_pallet
-- 0.02.07		JSC					2026-05-21		Used the @factor_KG_BA for the netto weight of the bag
-- 0.02.08		JSC					2026-06-25		Used the EntityGroup as filter instead of operation.
-- 0.02.09		MC					2026-08-05		Change source of UoM for DCS param from wo_ext to item MM
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE       FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_ofi_GetJobSpecByEntityGroup]
	(   @wo_id       NVARCHAR(40),
		@oper_id     NVARCHAR(40),
		@seq_no      INT,
		@EntityGroup NVARCHAR(40) )
RETURNS @Output TABLE
	(
		spec_id     NVARCHAR(40),
		spec_value  NVARCHAR(1000),
		min_value   NVARCHAR(1000),
		max_value   NVARCHAR(1000),
		comments    NVARCHAR(254),
		oper_id     NVARCHAR(40),
		EntityGroup NVARCHAR(40)
	)
AS
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @Output
	SELECT s.spec_id,
		s.spare3,
		s.spare1, -- min_value
		s.spare2, -- max_value
		s.last_edit_comment,
		@oper_id,
		@EntityGroup
	FROM spec s WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE s.grp_id = @EntityGroup
	ORDER BY s.display_seq ASC
	
	-- MOD 
	IF @EntityGroup = 'PowderPacking'
	--IF @oper_id = 'CakePowderPacking'
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @factor_KG_Pallet  FLOAT;
		DECLARE @factor_KG_Bag     FLOAT;
		DECLARE @factor_Bag_Pallet INT;
		SELECT @factor_KG_Pallet = uc.factor
		FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK)      ON i.item_id  = j.item_id
			INNER JOIN uom_conv uc WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.item_id = i.item_id
				AND uc.to_uom_id                              = i.uom_id
			INNER JOIN uom fr WITH(NOLOCK) ON fr.uom_id       = uc.from_uom_id
				AND fr.description                            = 'PAL'
		WHERE j.wo_id                                         = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id                                     = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no                                      = @seq_no;
		
		SELECT @factor_KG_Bag = uc.factor
		FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK)      ON i.item_id  = j.item_id
			INNER JOIN uom_conv uc WITH(NOLOCK) ON uc.item_id = i.item_id
				AND uc.to_uom_id                              = i.uom_id
			INNER JOIN uom fr WITH(NOLOCK) ON fr.uom_id       = uc.from_uom_id
				AND fr.description                            = 'BAG'
		WHERE j.wo_id                                         = @wo_id
			AND j.oper_id                                     = @oper_id
			AND j.seq_no                                      = @seq_no;
		
		IF (@factor_KG_Pallet IS NOT  NULL
			AND @factor_KG_Bag IS NOT NULL
			AND @factor_KG_Bag <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @factor_Bag_Pallet = CAST((@factor_KG_Pallet / @factor_KG_Bag) AS INT);
		END
		-- --
		UPDATE o
		SET
			o.spec_value = '0'
		FROM @Output o
		WHERE o.spec_id IN ( 'Good-HU',
							 'Reject-HU' );
		
		UPDATE o
		SET
			o.spec_value = CASE
							   -- PP03: Bags per pallet
							   WHEN o.spec_id = 'Bags per pallet'
								   THEN COALESCE(@factor_Bag_Pallet, CASE
																		 -- Big bags
																		 WHEN PATINDEX('%F[0-9][0-9][0-9]%', i.item_desc) > 0
																			 THEN '1'
																				 -- Small bags
																		 WHEN i.item_desc                       LIKE '%BAGS%'
																			 AND CHARINDEX('BAGS', i.item_desc) > 1
																			 THEN RIGHT(RTRIM(LEFT(i.item_desc, CHARINDEX('BAGS', i.item_desc) - 1)), CHARINDEX(' ', REVERSE(RTRIM(LEFT(i.item_desc, CHARINDEX('BAGS', i.item_desc) - 1))) + ' ') - 1)
																		 ELSE
																			 NULL
																	 END , o.spec_value)
									   -- PP06: Fat percentage
							   WHEN o.spec_id                                     = 'Fat percentage'
								   AND PATINDEX('%[A-Z][0-9][0-9]%', i.item_desc) > 0
								   THEN SUBSTRING(i.item_desc, PATINDEX('%[A-Z][0-9][0-9]%', i.item_desc) + 1, 2)
									   -- PP07: Yoke Height
							   WHEN o.spec_id                                      = 'Yokeheight'
								   AND PATINDEX('%F[0-9][0-9][0-9]%', i.item_desc) > 0
								   THEN SUBSTRING(i.item_desc, PATINDEX('%F[0-9][0-9][0-9]%', i.item_desc) + 1, 3)
									   -- Disable metal detector
							   WHEN o.spec_id = 'DisableMetalDetector'
								   THEN CASE
											WHEN i.item_desc LIKE '%KOEK%'
												THEN '1'
											ELSE
												'0'
										END
							   ELSE
								   o.spec_value
						   END
		FROM @Output o
			LEFT JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id            = @wo_id
				AND j.oper_id                                  = @oper_id
				AND j.seq_no                                   = @seq_no
			LEFT JOIN item i WITH(NOLOCK)         ON i.item_id = j.item_id
			LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_ext ext WITH(NOLOCK) ON ext.wo_id = @wo_id
		WHERE o.spec_id IN ('Bags per pallet',
							'Fat percentage',
							'Yokeheight',
							'DisableMetalDetector');
		
		DECLARE @IsBigBag INT;
		SELECT @IsBigBag = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(ia.attr_value AS INT)), 0)
		FROM item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN job j WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id  = j.item_id
				AND j.wo_id                        = @wo_id
				AND j.oper_id                      = @oper_id
				AND j.seq_no                       = @seq_no
			JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.attr_id = a.attr_id
		WHERE a.attr_desc                          = 'IsBigBag'
		UPDATE @Output
		SET
			spec_value = spec_value + ISNULL(@IsBigBag,0)
		WHERE spec_id  = 'Bag Type'
		/*
		IMPORTANT:
		The "Number of layers" specification is intentionally populated from
		ofi_wo_ext.bags_per_pallet.
		This is not because bags_per_pallet is the correct business meaning for this spec.
		It is because the SAP interface / ofi_wo_ext mapping is currently configured in a
		misleading way and the value required by MES for "Number of layers" is being received
		in the bags_per_pallet column.
		Bags per pallet itself must NOT use ext.bags_per_pallet anymore. Bags per pallet is
		calculated from UOM conversion using:
		factor_Bag_Pallet = factor_KG_Pallet / factor_KG_Bag
		*/
		UPDATE o
		SET o.spec_value = COALESCE(ext.bags_per_pallet,o.spec_value)
		FROM @Output o
			LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_ext ext WITH(NOLOCK) ON ext.wo_id = @wo_id
		WHERE o.spec_id = 'Number of layers';
		
		UPDATE o
		SET
			o.spec_value = CASE
							   -- PP02: Units type bag
							   WHEN o.spec_id = 'Units type bag'
								   THEN CASE
											WHEN u.description LIKE '%KG%' -- 0.02.09 change from ext.uom_id
												THEN '1'
											WHEN u.description LIKE '%LB%' -- 0.02.09 change from ext.uom_id
												THEN '2'
											ELSE
												o.spec_value
										END
										-- PP05: Pallet type
							   WHEN o.spec_id = 'Pallet type'
								   THEN CASE
											WHEN ext.type_of_pallet LIKE '%EUR%'
												THEN '1'
											WHEN ext.type_of_pallet LIKE '%USA%'
												THEN '2'
											ELSE
												o.spec_value
										END
							   ELSE
								   o.spec_value
						   END
		FROM @Output o
			LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_ext ext WITH(NOLOCK) ON ext.wo_id = @wo_id
			-- 0.02.09 --connect the MM uom data
			LEFT JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ext.item_id
			LEFT JOIN uom u WITH(NOLOCK) ON u.uom_id=i.uom_id
		WHERE o.spec_id IN ('Units type bag',
							'Pallet type');
		
		UPDATE @Output
		SET spec_value = COALESCE(@factor_KG_Bag,spec_value)
		WHERE spec_id  = 'Netto weight per bag';
	
	END
	RETURN;
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Data_Log_Grp_Job_Stp_Lnk]

CREATE TRIGGER [tgeb_spfl_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[sample_plan_freq_link]
AFTER DELETE
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	insert db_deleted_log select 'sample_plan_freq_link' as 'table_name', '<delete><plan_id>' + COALESCE(cast(plan_id as nvarchar(850)),'') + '</plan_id><freq_id>' + COALESCE(cast(freq_id as nvarchar(850)),'') + '</freq_id></delete>' as 'key_xml', GetUtcDate() as 'deleted_time' from deleted

	IF(EXISTS(SELECT top 1 db_status.regen_samples FROM db_status WHERE db_status.regen_samples=0))
		BEGIN
			IF (EXISTS(SELECT top 1 DELETED.plan_id,DELETED.freq_id FROM DELETED INNER JOIN sample_freq WITH (NOLOCK) ON DELETED.freq_id=sample_freq.freq_id
								 INNER JOIN sample_to_go WITH (NOLOCK) ON (DELETED.plan_id=sample_to_go.plan_id AND DELETED.freq_id=sample_to_go.freq_id)
								 WHERE sample_freq.enabled=1))
				BEGIN
					UPDATE db_status SET db_status.regen_samples = 1
				END
		END

END

-- ================================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom
-- Description:	Returns the converted quantity of a material based on the source and destination 
--              unit of measures.
-- ================================================================================================
-- Version		By		Date			Change Description
-- 1.0			CC		2018-05-09		Initial release
-- ================================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] 
(
	@item_id       nvarchar(40)
,	@qty           float
,	@from_uom_id   int          = NULL
,	@to_uom_id     int          = NULL
,	@from_uom_desc nvarchar(40) = NULL
,	@to_uom_desc   nvarchar(40) = NULL
,	@from_uom_abbr nvarchar(20) = NULL
,	@to_uom_abbr   nvarchar(20) = NULL
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @qty_conv float
	
	-- If necessary, retrieve the identifier of the source unit of measure (either from its abbreviation/description or from the material).
	IF @from_uom_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		IF @from_uom_desc IS NULL AND @from_uom_abbr IS NULL
			SELECT @from_uom_id = uom_id FROM item WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE item_id = @item_id
		ELSE
			SELECT @from_uom_id = uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE abbreviation = @from_uom_abbr OR description = @from_uom_desc
		
		IF @from_uom_id IS NULL
			RETURN NULL
	END

	-- If necessary, retrieve the identifier of the destination unit of measure (from its abbreviation/description).
	IF @to_uom_id IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @to_uom_id = uom_id FROM uom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE abbreviation = @to_uom_abbr OR description = @to_uom_desc

		IF @to_uom_id IS NULL
			RETURN NULL
	END

	-- Return the converted quantity (the table function also handles the scenario where source and destination unit of measures are the same).
	SELECT @qty_conv = qty_conv FROM [fn_S_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUomId](@item_id, @qty, @from_uom_id, @to_uom_id)
	RETURN @qty_conv --ISNULL(@qty_conv, @qty)

END

UPDATE res

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_util_log_by_shift]
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- util_log_by_shift
-- Description			- Returns utilization events broken down by shifts
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created			- 06/11/2020
-- Version				- 6.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT hist.ent_id
	, hist.event_time_utc AS act_event_time_utc
	, hist.event_time_local AS act_event_time_local
	, hist.event_time_utc AS act_event_time
	, hist.duration AS act_duration
	, hist.event_end_time_utc AS act_event_end_time_utc
	, vusl.event_time_utc
	, vusl.event_time_local
	, vusl.event_time_utc AS event_time
	, DATEDIFF(SS, vusl.event_time_utc, vusl.event_end_time_utc) AS duration
	, vusl.event_end_time_utc
	, shiftinfo.shift_start_utc
	, shiftinfo.shift_start_local
	, shiftinfo.shift_id
	, hist.state_cd, hist.reas_cd, hist.reas_pending
	, hist.runtime, hist.downtime, hist.setuptime
	, hist.teardowntime, hist.fixedtime, hist.vartime, hist.failure
	, hist.comments, hist.raw_reas_cd, hist.spare1, hist.spare2, hist.spare3, hist.spare4
	, hist.category1, hist.category2, hist.category3, hist.category4
	, hist.last_edit_comment, hist.last_edit_by, hist.last_edit_at, hist.log_id
FROM vw_util_history hist WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN vw_util_shift_link vusl WITH (NOLOCK) ON hist.ent_id = vusl.ent_id AND hist.event_time_utc = vusl.act_event_time_utc
LEFT OUTER JOIN shift_history shiftinfo WITH (NOLOCK) ON vusl.ent_id = shiftinfo.ent_id AND vusl.shift_start_utc = shiftinfo.shift_start_utc

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_stats]
(
     @char_id                    INT32 = NULL,
     @ent_id                     INT32 = NULL,
     @filter_ent_id              INT32_NULL = NULL,
     @item_id                    STRING40_NULL = NULL,
     @item_category_id           INT32_NULL = NULL,
     @wo_id                      STRING40_NULL = NULL,
     @oper_id                    STRING40_NULL = NULL,
     @process_id                 STRING40_NULL = NULL,
     @segment_requirement_id     STRING80_NULL = NULL,
     @segment_response_id        STRING80_NULL = NULL,
     @spare1                     STRING80_NULL = NULL,
     @spare2                     STRING80_NULL = NULL,
