CREATE      PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_System_Attr_GetActiveMQTTBrokerIp]
(@ActiveMQTTBrokerIp NVARCHAR(80) OUTPUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  - JOB START / UPDATE / OUT for Interfaces
-- Description	  -  USED in WF OFI_StartJob
-- Author	      - JSC
-- Date Created	  -	16-jul-2025
-- Version	      - 1.0.0
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
-- 16-jul-2025     JSC			1.0.0	 Initial version
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT  @ActiveMQTTBrokerIp =	CASE 
									WHEN a.attr_value = id_primary.attr_value 
										THEN ip_primary.attr_value
									WHEN a.attr_value = id_backup.attr_value 
										THEN ip_backup.attr_value
									ELSE ip_primary.attr_value -- give primary as default
								END
FROM system_attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT JOIN system_attr ip_primary WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip_primary.attr_desc = 'MQTTBrokerIpPrimary' AND ip_primary.grp_id = a.grp_id
	LEFT JOIN system_attr ip_backup WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip_backup.attr_desc = 'MQTTBrokerIpBackup' AND ip_backup.grp_id = a.grp_id
	LEFT JOIN system_attr id_primary WITH (NOLOCK) ON id_primary.attr_desc = 'MQTTBrokerIdPrimary' AND id_primary.grp_id = a.grp_id
	LEFT JOIN system_attr id_backup WITH (NOLOCK) ON id_backup.attr_desc = 'MQTTBrokerIdBackup' AND id_backup.grp_id = a.grp_id
WHERE a.attr_desc = 'MQTTBrokerId';

CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_OES_GetEntities]
(	@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Oper_Ent_Spec_GetEntities
-- Description	      - This method returns all the entities that are assigned to the specified operation in the specified
--						process and all the ancestors of those entities.
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	11/16/2009
-- Version	      - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE  @temp_entities TABLE (ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		parent_ent_id INT)

	-- First get the entities that are assigned to the operation and put them into the temp table
	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id)
	SELECT oel.ent_id, e.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id FROM oper_ent_link oel
	INNER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = oel.ent_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_link el ON el.child_ent_id = oel.ent_id
	WHERE oel.process_id = @process_id AND oel.oper_id = @oper_id

	-- Loop through all the entities in the temporary table looking for parent entities that are not listed as
	-- child entities in the temporary table but are listed as child entities in the ent_link table.
	-- Do this until no more entities are found.
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id)
		SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name, el.parent_ent_id FROM @temp_entities te
		INNER JOIN ent e on e.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
		INNER JOIN ent_link el on el.child_ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
		WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)

		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	END
	-- Add in the root entities
	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id)
	SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name, null FROM @temp_entities te
	INNER JOIN ent e on e.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
	WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)

	-- Return the entities
	SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ent_name FROM @temp_entities ORDER BY ent_name

	-- The code below is required for returning the recordset optimized for tree building, but we are not doing that now
/*	-- Now create a second temporary table that will use the first temporary table to create the data optimized for tree building
	DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))
	DECLARE  @child_level			INT32
		,@ent_id			INT32
		,@root_ent_id  			INT32

	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, NULL, @child_level FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @child_level = 2
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, te.parent_ent_id, @child_level
				,x.ent_tree
			FROM @temp_entities te
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON te.ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  te.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END
	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

	SELECT te.root_ent_id, te.ent_id, te.ent_name, te.parent_ent_id,
		e.ent_name as parent_ent_name, te.child_level, te.ent_tree
	FROM @entities te
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
	ORDER BY te.child_level, e.ent_name, te.ent_name
*/
END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Name:			sp_SA_ofi_GETTop5Downtime -
-- Description:	    Get the OEE and TEEP percentage
--
-- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
-- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-01						Find the OEE & TEEP percentage
--0.01.01			Veervar			2024-01-31						Logic comments added
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

-- Procedure definition
CREATE          PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GETTop5Downtime] @ent_id as int

  AS
BEGIN


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilQual') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmputilQual
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilPerf') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmputilPerf
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmputilAvail') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmputilAvail

--INSERT QUALITY LOSS DATA INTO TEMP TABLE
Create table #tmputilQual(util_max int,avil_data int,qual_data int,qual_loss int,exp_prod int, act_prod int,good int, bad int)
Insert into #tmputilQual Exec [sp_S_ofi_GETQualityLoss] @ent_id

--INSERT PERFORMANCE LOSS DATA INTO TEMP TABLE
Create table #tmputilPerf(util_max int,util_data int, avil_data int,perf_data int,perf_loss int)
Insert into #tmputilPerf Exec [sp_S_ofi_GETPerformanceLoss] @ent_id

--INSERT AVAILABILITY LOSS DATA INTO TEMP TABLE
Create table #tmputilAvail(util_max int, util_data int, util_percent DECIMAL, util_loss int, avil_data int, avil_loss int, avil_per int,shift_start datetime, shift_end datetime)
Insert into #tmputilAvail Exec [sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss] @ent_id

Declare @util_percent as int,@perf_percent as int,@qual_percent as int, @avil_data as int, @perf_data as int, @perf_loss as int,
		@qual_data as int, @qual_loss as int, @avil_percent as int,@oee_percent as INT, @teep_percent as INT, @expected_prod as int,
		@actual_prod as int, @good_prod as int, @bad_prod as int
select @avil_data=avil_data,@perf_data=perf_data from #tmputilPerf
select @util_percent=util_percent, @avil_percent=avil_per from #tmputilAvail
Select @qual_data=qual_data,@expected_prod=exp_prod,@actual_prod=act_prod,@good_prod=good,@bad_prod=bad from #tmputilQual
if @avil_data >= @perf_data
	begin
	set @perf_percent =  CAST((@perf_data/@avil_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
	set @perf_loss = 100 - @perf_percent
	end
if @perf_data >= @qual_data
	begin
	set @qual_percent = CAST((@qual_data/@perf_data)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
	set @qual_loss = 100 - @qual_percent
end

--OEE CALCULATION
set @oee_percent=CAST((@util_percent*@perf_percent*@qual_percent)* 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
set @oee_percent= LEFT(@oee_percent, 2)
set @teep_percent = @oee_percent * @util_percent
set @teep_percent= LEFT(@teep_percent, 2)

--SELECT FINAL DATASET
select  @util_percent as util_percent,  @avil_percent as avil_percent, @perf_percent as perf_percent
		, @qual_percent as qual_percent, @expected_prod as exp_prod, @actual_prod as act_prod,
		@good_prod as good, (case when @bad_prod > 0 then @bad_prod else 0 end) as bad, @oee_percent as oee, @teep_percent as teep

drop table #tmputilQual
drop table #tmputilPerf
drop table #tmputilAvail

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Bom_Ver_Clone]
  (@existing_parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @existing_ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @new_parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @new_ver_id nvarchar(40),
   @new_ver_comments NVARCHAR(80),
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_I_Bom_Ver_Clone
-- Description	      - To clone an existing BOM version in the database supplying a new Item ID and/or a new BOM version ID.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 08/09/2002
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.20
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
-- 09/12/2002	  Raghu		1.4	Included to insert the cloned items into Bom_Item
-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0	Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 01/03/2003	  Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2017) Included BOM_Item_Oper_Link, BOM_Item_Oper_Spec and BOM_Item_Oper_Step_Link for import clonings
-- 01/07/2003	  Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2192) Cloning BOMs should update date with current dates
-- 01/08/2003	  Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2181) Cloning BOM should update ver comments with 'clone of ver comments'
-- 01/09/2003	  Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 01/20/2003	  Vijay		1.5.6	(HD# 2279) After Cloning BOM Ver, if there is no preferred version, it should be marked as preferred
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain    1600  	Oracle migration changes - (TOP 1 ...)
-- 10/02/2003	  Raghu		1.6.26	(HD# 3773, 3739) Added a check while cloning BOM 0 for record exist; if exist, then update else insert
-- 10/20/2003	  Raghu		2.0.6	(HD# 3888) If BOM_VER. comments IS NULL, store it as null, do not default data to comments field
-- 06/15/2004	  Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement
-- 03/03/2005     SJ            2115    HD#5394 - Cloning a BOM writes records to the  bom_item_oper_link table
-- 04/29/2005     SJ            2120    HD#5596 - Clone BOM to different item
-- 08/08/2005	Raghu		2.1.25	HD# 6083, Bom_Ver.Ver_Date should be a local date and not a GMT date.
-- 10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
-- 01/04/2007     KRF           3.2.1   HD# 8314, 9232 - Include def_sublot_no and serial_no_source when cloning BOM_Item records,
--                                      and def_sublot_no when cloning BOM_Item_Oper_Link records
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @preferred_count 	INTEGER
  ,@process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@qty_per_parent_item	FLOAT
  ,@reqd_start_pct	FLOAT
  ,@last_edit_by	STRING40
  ,@last_edit_at	DATETIME
  ,@ver_date		DATETIME

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

BEGIN

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM bom_ver
		   WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id AND ver_id = @existing_ver_id)
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Cant Clone. Source BOM_VER not found{3324}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  IF EXISTS (SELECT 'X'  FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id AND ver_id = @new_ver_id)
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Cant Clone. Target BOM_VER exists{3325}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

  IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = GETUTCDATE()
  ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @ver_date)
  SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @ver_date )

  INSERT INTO bom_ver (parent_item_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, disassembly, start_eff, end_eff, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
  SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, @ver_date, @new_ver_comments, 0, disassembly, start_eff, end_eff, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM bom_ver
	WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id
  IF @@error <> 0
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating the row in Bom_Ver table{3323}', 16, 1, @@error)
    RETURN -1
  END

  --VRB
  --If there are no preferred versions after moving this version to a new item, then mark the version as preferred
  SELECT @preferred_count = COUNT(*) FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and preferred_ver=1
  IF @preferred_count=0
  BEGIN
    UPDATE bom_ver set preferred_ver = 1 where parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id
  END

  -- Return timestamp
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM bom_ver
    WHERE (parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id AND ver_id = @new_ver_id)

  IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id and bom_pos = 0)
  BEGIN
    UPDATE bom_item SET item_id = bi.item_id, reqd_grade_cd = bi.reqd_grade_cd, instruction = bi.instruction
			, qty_per_parent_item = bi.qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item = bi.max_qty_per_parent_item
			, min_qty_per_parent_item = bi.min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv =  bi.update_inv
			, backflush = bi.backflush, def_reas_cd = bi.def_reas_cd, def_lot_no = bi.def_lot_no, def_sublot_no = bi.def_sublot_no
			, def_storage_ent_id = bi.def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id = bi.def_reject_ent_id
			, scaling_factor = bi.scaling_factor
			, must_consume_from_inv = bi.must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc = bi.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
			, may_create_new_lots = bi.may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip = bi.must_consume_from_wip
			, must_consume_before_prod =  bi.must_consume_before_prod, serial_no_source = bi.serial_no_source
			, spare1 = bi.spare1, spare2 = bi.spare2, spare3 = bi.spare3, spare4 = bi.spare4
	FROM (SELECT @new_parent_item_id 'parent_item_id', @new_ver_id 'ver_id', bom_pos
			, @new_parent_item_id 'item_id', reqd_grade_cd, instruction
			, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
			, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
			, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
			, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, serial_no_source
			, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
		FROM bom_item
		  WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id and bom_pos = 0) bi
	  WHERE bom_item.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND bom_item.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND bom_item.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO bom_item (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
		, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
		, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
		, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
		, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
		, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, @new_parent_item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
		, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
		, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
		, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
		, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
		, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM bom_item
	    WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id and bom_pos = 0
  END

  INSERT INTO bom_item (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
	, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
	, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
	, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
	, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
	, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
	, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
	, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
	, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
	, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
	, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM bom_item
	WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id and bom_pos <> 0

  DECLARE biol_clone_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0
	AND process_id IN (SELECT process_id FROM item_process_link WHERE item_id = @new_parent_item_id)
  OPEN biol_clone_cursor
  WHILE (1 = 1)
  BEGIN
    FETCH NEXT FROM biol_clone_cursor INTO @process_id, @oper_id, @qty_per_parent_item, @reqd_start_pct
    IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)
      BREAK

    IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0
		AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id)
    BEGIN
      UPDATE bom_item_oper_link SET qty_per_parent_item = @qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct = @reqd_start_pct
	WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0
	  AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
	INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_link
	 (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no,
          def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, update_inv, backflush, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
	  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_comment,
	  last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no,
	   def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, update_inv, backflush, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
	  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_comment,
	  @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM bom_item_oper_link
	    WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id AND bom_pos = 0 AND oper_id = @oper_id
	      AND process_id = @process_id
    END
  END
  CLOSE biol_clone_cursor
  DEALLOCATE biol_clone_cursor

  --Insert components and byproducts to the new version only if items are same
  IF @new_parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id
  BEGIN
	INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_link
	 (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no,
	   def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, update_inv, backflush, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
	  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_comment,
	  last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no,
	   def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, update_inv, backflush, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc,
	  may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_comment,
	  @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM bom_item_oper_link
	  WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id AND bom_pos <> 0

    INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_step_link (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, step_no, qty_per_parent_item, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
      SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, step_no, qty_per_parent_item, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
        FROM bom_item_oper_step_link
	  WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id
    -- Fixed the CR L00094705
	INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_spec (item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, step_no, spec_ver_id
	,spec_id, spec_value, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, step_no, spec_ver_id
	,spec_id, spec_value, assoc_file, assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM bom_item_oper_spec
	WHERE item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id
  END
END

-- Name:    sp_s_ei_inv_reclass
-- Description:  Returns inventory reclassified for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-08			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Karthik		2022-09-13			Added logic to obtain data from item_transfer
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-05-05			Changed from and to entity location to 
-- 0.01.03	Karthik		2023-06-27			Grouped qty from multiple entries by lot and report. Refer comments below for this date
-- 0.01.04	Lavkesh		2024-02-21			Added condition to take only item having from_lot_no not null and from item id not equals to to item id
-- 0.01.05	Lavkesh		2024-04-14  		Added condition to take only SAP related item,used variable to check the condition
-- 0.01.05	Lavkesh		2024-04-24  		Added condition to take only SAP related item,used column to check the condition
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_inv_reclass] as
begin

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @trans_id int, @plant_code varchar(40),@frm_ent_id int, @to_ent_id int, @qty_txd float

--(KN 27Jun23) Added below variables
Declare @frm_lot varchar(100), @to_lot varchar(100), @frm_item varchar(100), @to_item varchar(100)

DECLARE @rc INT, @error_msg NVARCHAR(500),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT,@frm_loc varchar(40),@to_loc varchar(40),@frm_ent int,@to_ent int

BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION
	BEGIN

	Set @plant_code = dbo.fn_S_ofi_PlantCode()
	SET @trans_id = NULL
	SET @frm_lot = NULL
	SET @to_lot = NULL
	--Select top 1 @trans_id = trans_id from item_transfer where ISNULL(qty_txd_erp,0) < ISNULL(qty_txd,0) and UPPER(to_spare1) like '%RECLASS%'
	
	--(KN 27Jun23) Assign values for from and to lots and items
	
	Select top 1 @trans_id = trans_id,@frm_ent = from_ent_id,@to_ent = to_ent_id, @frm_lot = from_lot_no, @to_lot  = lot_no,
	@frm_item = from_item_id,@to_item = item_id
	from item_transfer with(nolock)   where ISNULL(qty_txd_erp,0) < ISNULL(qty_txd,0) and UPPER(comments) like '%RECLASS%' and from_lot_no is not null ---- 0.01.04
	and from_item_id<>item_id
	and from_item_id not in(select item_id from item with(nolock) where item_id=from_item_id and item_desc like '%WIP%' and item_class_id='INTERMEDIATE'  ) -- 0.01.05	
	and item_id not in(select item_id from item with(nolock) where item_id=item_id and item_desc like '%WIP%' and item_class_id='INTERMEDIATE' )-- 0.01.05	

	--Select @frm_loc = attr_value from system_attr where attr_desc= 'InvFromStorageLocation'
	--Select @to_loc = attr_value from system_attr where attr_desc= 'InvToStorageLocation'

	Select @frm_loc = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock)  where ent_id = @frm_ent and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc like 'SAPLocation')
	Select @to_loc = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock)  where ent_id = @to_ent and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock)  where attr_desc like 'SAPLocation')


	/*(KN 27Jun23) Added new Logic. Grouping by lot_no (sublot_no is ignored). It is presumed that item reclassified from a 'from_lot_no' will always go to the same 'lot_no'
	
	--(KN 27Jun23) Removed the old Logic below
	
	IF @trans_id IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		Select @plant_code From_Plant_Code, @plant_code To_Plant_Code,
		@frm_loc From_Storage_location,@to_loc To_Storage_location,	from_item_id From_Material_Code,
		item_id To_Material_Code, (qty_txd - qty_txd_erp) Qty_reclassified, u.description Unitofmeasure, '309' Movement_type,
		format(transfer_time_utc,'yyyyMMdd') Reclassification_Date, 
		'000000' Reclassification_time, --format(transfer_time_utc,'hhmmss')
		from_lot_no From_SAPBatch_number,lot_no To_SAPBatch_number,
		--'' Filegeneration_date, --format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd')
		'' Filegeneration_time,	--format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss')
		'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
		from item_transfer it with (nolock)
		inner join uom u with (nolock) on it.uom_id = u.uom_id
		where trans_id = @trans_id

		Update item_transfer set qty_txd_erp = qty_txd where trans_id = @trans_id
	END
	*/

	IF @frm_lot IS NOT NULL 
	BEGIN
		Select @plant_code From_Plant_Code, @plant_code To_Plant_Code,
		@frm_loc From_Storage_location,@to_loc To_Storage_location,	from_item_id From_Material_Code,
		item_id To_Material_Code, sum(qty_txd - qty_txd_erp) Qty_reclassified, u.description Unitofmeasure, '309' Movement_type,
		format(max(transfer_time_utc),'yyyyMMdd') Reclassification_Date, 
		'000000' Reclassification_time, from_lot_no From_SAPBatch_number,lot_no To_SAPBatch_number,
		'' Filegeneration_time,'' Document_Number, '' Message, '' Message
		from item_transfer it with (nolock)
		inner join uom u with (nolock) on it.uom_id = u.uom_id
		where from_lot_no = @frm_lot and lot_no= @to_lot and from_item_id = @frm_item and item_id = @to_item		---(KN 27Jun23 Same from_lot_no and lot_no combination can be used to reclassify different items)
		and qty_txd_erp < qty_txd and UPPER(comments) like '%RECLASS%'
		group by from_item_id,item_id,u.description,from_lot_no,lot_no

		Update item_transfer set qty_txd_erp = qty_txd where from_lot_no = @frm_lot and lot_no= @to_lot and from_item_id = @frm_item and item_id = @to_item 
		and qty_txd_erp < qty_txd and UPPER(comments) like '%RECLASS%'
	END

	Commit

	END
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
    RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
END CATCH

end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Item_Transfer]
(@wo_id nvarchar(40) ,
 @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
 @seq_no int ,
 @bom_pos int ,
 @to_ent_id  int  ,
 @item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @sublot_no nvarchar(40) ,
 @grade_cd int ,
 @status_cd int ,
 @expiry_date datetime ,
 @from_wo_id nvarchar(40),
 @from_oper_id nvarchar(40),
 @from_seq_no int,
 @from_ent_id  int  ,
 @from_item_id NVARCHAR(40),
 @from_lot_no NVARCHAR(40),
 @from_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
 @from_grade_cd int ,
 @from_status_cd int ,
 @from_expiry_date datetime ,
 @goods_received  bit  ,
 @goods_shipped  bit ,
 @transfer_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @transfer_time_utc datetime,
 @transfer_time_local  datetime  ,
 @trans_id  int ,
 @time_zone_bias_value int = 0
)  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 12/09/2002	Raghu		1.5.0	from_lot_no (int type), from_item_id (int type) are changed to NVARCHAR(40) as lot_no and item_id contains characters
--02/09/2005	Raghu		2.1.13	HD# 5258, Added new parameter for the time_zone bias value. Defaults to local time zone
--09/21/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--12/24/2007	AML			3.4.0	Updated parameter list and select statement to match oracle version.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
--SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
--SET @transfer_time = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @transfer_time)


SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

--SET @expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @expiry_date)
--SET @from_expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @from_expiry_date)

SELECT item_transfer.wo_id ,
	item_transfer.oper_id,
	item_transfer.seq_no ,
	item_transfer.bom_pos ,
	item_transfer.to_ent_id ,
	to_ent.ent_name AS to_ent_name,
	item_transfer.item_id  ,
	item.item_desc,
	item_transfer.lot_no ,
    item_transfer.sublot_no,
	item_transfer.grade_cd ,
	item_transfer.status_cd ,
	item_transfer.qty_txd  ,
	item_transfer.uom_id ,
	item_transfer.expiry_date ,
	item_transfer.to_spare1 ,
	item_transfer.to_spare2 ,
	item_transfer.to_spare3 ,
	item_transfer.to_spare4 ,
	item_transfer.to_spare5 ,
	item_transfer.to_spare6 ,
    item_transfer.from_wo_id ,
    item_transfer.from_oper_id ,
    item_transfer.from_seq_no ,
	item_transfer.from_ent_id ,
	from_ent.ent_name AS from_ent_name,
	item_transfer.from_item_id ,
	from_item.item_desc AS from_item_desc ,
	item_transfer.from_lot_no ,
    item_transfer.from_sublot_no,
	item_transfer.from_grade_cd ,
	item_transfer.from_status_cd ,
	item_transfer.from_qty_txd ,
	item_transfer.from_uom_id ,
	item_transfer.from_expiry_date ,
	item_transfer.from_spare1 ,
	item_transfer.from_spare2 ,
	item_transfer.from_spare3 ,
	item_transfer.from_spare4 ,
	item_transfer.from_spare5 ,
	item_transfer.from_spare6 ,
	item_transfer.qty_txd_erp ,
	item_transfer.goods_received ,
	item_transfer.goods_shipped ,
	item_transfer.transfer_list_row_id  ,
	item_transfer.comments ,
	item_transfer.transfer_by ,
    item_transfer.transfer_time_utc,
    item_transfer.transfer_time_local,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, item_transfer.mod_id))) mod_id,
	item_transfer.trans_id
FROM item_transfer item_transfer WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_transfer.item_id = item.item_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN item from_item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_transfer.from_item_id = from_item.item_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ent from_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_transfer.from_ent_id = from_ent.ent_id
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ent to_ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_transfer.to_ent_id = to_ent.ent_id
WHERE (
		(item_transfer.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.to_ent_id = @to_ent_id OR @to_ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
        (item_transfer.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.expiry_date = @expiry_date OR @expiry_date IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_wo_id = @from_wo_id OR @from_wo_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_oper_id = @from_oper_id OR @from_oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_seq_no = @from_seq_no OR @from_seq_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR @from_ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_item_id = @from_item_id OR @from_item_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_lot_no = @from_lot_no OR @from_lot_no IS NULL) AND
        (item_transfer.from_sublot_no = @from_sublot_no OR @from_sublot_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_grade_cd = @from_grade_cd OR @from_grade_cd IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_status_cd = @from_status_cd OR @from_status_cd IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.from_expiry_date = @from_expiry_date OR @from_expiry_date IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.goods_received = ABS(@goods_received) OR @goods_received IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.goods_shipped = ABS(@goods_shipped) OR @goods_shipped IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.trans_id = @trans_id OR @trans_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.transfer_by = @transfer_by OR @transfer_by IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.transfer_time_utc >= @transfer_time_utc OR @transfer_time_utc IS NULL) AND
        (item_transfer.transfer_time_local >= @transfer_time_local OR @transfer_time_local IS NULL) AND
		(item_transfer.trans_id = @trans_id OR @trans_id IS NULL))
	ORDER BY item_transfer.transfer_time_utc, item_transfer.transfer_time_local

CREATE  Trigger [tg_job_bom_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[job_bom]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - tg_job_bom_aft_upd
-- Description	      - Updates FC Tags after any updates is made on this table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      - 01/22/2003
-- Version	      - 3.1.0.13
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 11/10/2003     Sheetal Jain  1.6.32  (HD# 2038) Job and Job Bom - item_id validation
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
-- 03/30/2006     SJ          31013 HD#7782 - ERROR IN SUPERVISOR'S CREATE WORK ORDER FROM PROCESS
-- 09/26/2012	 Ravi Teja	   4.6	  CR L00122689 - (Merge of CR L00122266) Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item of job_bom table.
--04/29/2016	Malleswara Rao 	5.03	US#604490-As the SE Product Owner, I want to remove Factory Connector tables, so that I can remove support for Factory Connector.
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
	@wo_id			NVARCHAR(80),
	@oper_id		NVARCHAR(80),
	@seq_no			INT,
	@ent_id			INT32,
	@bom_pos		INT32,
	@def_lot_no		STRING40,
	@def_storage_ent_id	INT32,
	@from_ent_id		INT32,
	@to_ent_id		INT32,
	@def_reas_cd		INT32,
	@prod_cd		INT32,
	@cons_cd		INT32,
        @OItem_Id               STRING40,
        @NItem_Id               STRING40,
	  @last_edit_by	STRING40

SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	--Open a cursor to fetch all the rows, one at a time
	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	Declare job_bom_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		select b.wo_id, b.oper_id, b.seq_no, b.bom_pos, b.def_lot_no, b.def_storage_ent_id,
			b.def_reas_cd, b.item_id
		FROM job_bom a WITH (NOLOCK), inserted b
		WHERE a.wo_id = b.wo_id
		  AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id
		  AND a.seq_no = b.seq_no
		  AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
	OPEN job_bom_cursor
	WHILE (1=1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM job_bom_cursor INTO @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @bom_pos, @def_lot_no,
			@def_storage_ent_id, @def_reas_cd, @NItem_Id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (UPDATE(def_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(def_lot_no) OR UPDATE(def_storage_ent_id)) BEGIN
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id FROM job_exec  WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE cur_wo_id = @wo_id AND cur_oper_id = @oper_id AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no

			if @bom_pos <= 0 BEGIN
				SET @to_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id
				SET @prod_cd = @def_reas_cd
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @from_ent_id = @def_storage_ent_id
				SET @cons_cd = @def_reas_cd
			END
			IF (@def_lot_no IS NULL) SET @def_lot_no = ''
			IF (@to_ent_id IS NULL) SET @to_ent_id = 0
			IF (@prod_cd IS NULL) SET @prod_cd = 0
			IF (@from_ent_id IS NULL) SET @from_ent_id = 0
			IF (@cons_cd IS NULL) SET @cons_cd = 0

		END

                --Check if the bom_pos 0 item has changed
                IF UPDATE(item_id) AND @bom_pos = 0
                BEGIN
                  SELECT @OItem_Id = item_id FROM deleted
                    WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = 0
                  IF @OItem_Id <> @NItem_Id
                  BEGIN
                    UPDATE job SET item_id = @NItem_Id WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no
                      AND item_id = @OItem_Id
                  END
                END  --End of UPDATE(item_id) AND @bom_pos = 0

	END
	CLOSE job_bom_cursor
	DEALLOCATE job_bom_cursor

  --Make sure that for CWOFP rounding does not happen
  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl_Temp_For_Op_Seq') IS NULL
  BEGIN
    UPDATE job_bom SET job_bom.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item = i.max_qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item = i.min_qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_bom.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
      FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	  WHERE job_bom.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = i.seq_no AND job_bom.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    UPDATE job_bom SET job_bom.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.max_qty_per_parent_item = i.max_qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.min_qty_per_parent_item = i.min_qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_bom.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
      FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	  WHERE job_bom.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = i.seq_no AND job_bom.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #tbl_temp_for_op_seq t WHERE t.wo_id = i.wo_id)
  END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Wo_ValJobRteWithLineRte]
(@wo_id			STRING80 = NULL
,@upstream_ent_name	STRING80 = NULL OUTPUT
,@downstream_ent_name	STRING80 = NULL OUTPUT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		- sp_U_Wo_ValJobRteWithLineRte
-- Description		- The purpose of this stored procedure is to validate the current job route with the line route.  If they do not match, raise an exception to the caller.
--			  Validates only when the work order is assigned to a line.
-- Author			- Raghu G
-- Date Created		- 06/26/2014
-- Version			- 5.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--For example,
-- Line Route With Segments
---------------------------
--Line Structure	EntB	EntD
--		EntA	EntC	EntE	EntF

--CurrentColumnPosition		Entity		PreviousColumnPosition		EntityInPreviousColumnPosition
-- 2				EntB			1				EntA
-- 2				EntC			1				EntA
-- 3				EntD			2				EntB
-- 3				EntE			2				EntC
-- 4				EntF			3				EntD
-- 4				EntF			3				EntE

-- Line Route Without Segments
------------------------------
--Line Structure	EntB	EntD
--		EntA	EntC	EntE	EntF

--CurrentColumnPosition		Entity		PreviousColumnPosition		EntityInPreviousColumnPosition
-- 2				EntB			1				EntA
-- 2				EntC			1				EntA
-- 3				EntD			2				EntB
-- 3				EntD			2				EntC
-- 3				EntE			2				EntB
-- 3				EntE			2				EntC
-- 4				EntF			3				EntD
-- 4				EntF			3				EntE


SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

DECLARE @target_sched_line_id	INT32

BEGIN

	--If the supplied work order is null, return
	IF (@wo_id IS NULL) RETURN

	--Get the line_id to which this work order is assigned to.
	SELECT @target_sched_line_id = wo.target_sched_line_id
	FROM wo wo WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE wo.wo_id = @wo_id

	--If the work order is not assigned to a line, return
	IF (@target_sched_line_id IS NULL) RETURN

	--The purpose of setting up line entities CTE is to identify the entities in a sequence, starting from 1
	--, so that the upstream entities can be easily identified from this CTE to construct a line route
	; WITH line_entities (child_order, segment_no, column_position, ent_id,  prev_column_position) AS
	(SELECT lel.child_order, lel.segment_no, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lel.child_order) -- Identify the unique current column position
		, lel.ent_id
		, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY lel.child_order)-1  -- Identify the unique previous column position
	 FROM line_ent_link lel WITH (NOLOCK)
	 --Limit to the supplied line.
	 WHERE lel.line_id = @target_sched_line_id
	   AND lel.line_is_child = 0
	)
	--Constructs the line route similar to job route
	, line_route (child_order, segment_no, column_position, ent_id, prev_column_position, ent_id_in_prev_column_position) AS
	(SELECT le.child_order, le.segment_no, le.column_position, le.ent_id, le.prev_column_position, NULL
	 FROM line_entities le
	 --Limit to the first column position
	 WHERE le.column_position = 1
	UNION ALL
	--This section creates line routes for entities in a line, if the following conditions match:
	--(i)  the entities in the current column position are not segments
	--(ii) the entities in the current column position are segments, but the entities in the previous column position are not segments
	SELECT lr_current_pos.child_order, lr_current_pos.segment_no, lr_current_pos.column_position, lr_current_pos.ent_id, lr_prev_pos.column_position, lr_prev_pos.ent_id
	-- The lr_current_pos will have the information from the current column position (or child order)
	FROM line_entities lr_current_pos
	--The lr_prev_pos will have the information from the previous column position (or child order)
	INNER JOIN line_route lr_prev_pos ON lr_prev_pos.column_position = lr_current_pos.prev_column_position
	--child order positions with NO segments
	WHERE  (lr_current_pos.segment_no IS NULL
	  --The entities in the current line position are in segments, but the entities in the previous column position are not in segments
	  OR (lr_current_pos.segment_no IS NOT NULL AND lr_prev_pos.segment_no IS NULL))
	--child order positions with segments
	UNION ALL
	--This section creates line routes for entities in a line, if the following condition match:
	--(i)  the entities in the current column position are in segments AND the entities in the previous column position are in segments
	SELECT lr_current_pos.child_order, lr_current_pos.segment_no, lr_current_pos.column_position, lr_current_pos.ent_id, lr_prev_pos.column_position, lr_prev_pos.ent_id
	-- The line_route will have the information from the current column position (or child order)
	FROM line_entities lr_current_pos
	--The lr_prev_pos will have the information from the previous column position (or child order)
	INNER JOIN line_route lr_prev_pos ON lr_prev_pos.column_position = lr_current_pos.prev_column_position AND lr_prev_pos.segment_no = lr_current_pos.segment_no
	--The entities in the current column position are in segments AND the entities in the previous column position are in segments
	WHERE lr_current_pos.segment_no IS NOT NULL AND lr_prev_pos.segment_no IS NOT NULL
	)
	-- The purpose of constructing job routes CTE is to contruct the job route information that is similar to the line route information to compare between the route structures.
	, job_routes (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, column_position, target_sched_ent_id, prev_column_position, ent_id_in_prev_column_position) AS
	--Start with the first job in the work order
	(SELECT j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, 1, j.target_sched_ent_id, NULL, NULL FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND j.first_job = 1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT jr.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, jrs.column_position + 1, curr_job.target_sched_ent_id, jrs.column_position, prev_job.target_sched_ent_id
	FROM job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK)
	--Limit to the jobs that are in the current column position
	INNER JOIN job curr_job ON curr_job.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND curr_job.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND curr_job.seq_no = jr.seq_no
	INNER JOIN job_routes jrs ON jrs.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND jrs.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND jrs.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
	--Limit to the jobs that are in the previous column position
	INNER JOIN job prev_job WITH (NOLOCK) ON jr.wo_id = prev_job.wo_id AND jr.input_oper_id = prev_job.oper_id AND jr.input_seq_no = prev_job.seq_no
	WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
	)
	--Return the first offending upstream and downstream entities
	SELECT TOP 1 @upstream_ent_name = upstrm_ent.ent_name, @downstream_ent_name = downstrm_ent.ent_name
	FROM
		--Compare the job structure with the line structure.
		--This comparison should validate all the entities (upstream and downstream) in the work order align with the line structure (upstream and downstream)
		(SELECT liner_minus_jobr.*
		FROM
			(SELECT DISTINCT lr.column_position, lr.ent_id, lr.prev_column_position, lr.ent_id_in_prev_column_position FROM line_route lr WHERE lr.column_position > 1
			EXCEPT
			SELECT DISTINCT jrs.column_position, jrs.target_sched_ent_id AS ent_id, jrs.prev_column_position, jrs.ent_id_in_prev_column_position FROM job_routes jrs WHERE jrs.column_position > 1
			) liner_minus_jobr
		UNION
		--Compare the line structure with the job structure
		--This comparison should validate all the entities (upstream and downstream) in a line align with the job structure (upstream and downstream)
		--This comparison should catch if there are any additional jobs with entities that are NOT in a line, even though the job structure match the line structure
		SELECT jobr_minus_linr.*
		FROM
			(SELECT DISTINCT jrs.column_position, jrs.target_sched_ent_id AS ent_id, jrs.prev_column_position, jrs.ent_id_in_prev_column_position FROM job_routes jrs WHERE jrs.column_position > 1
			EXCEPT
			SELECT DISTINCT lr.column_position, lr.ent_id, lr.prev_column_position, lr.ent_id_in_prev_column_position FROM line_route lr WHERE lr.column_position > 1
			) jobr_minus_linr

		UNION
		--Return entities that are either scheduled to a job but not in a line, or the entities are in a line but they do not have jobs assigned to.
		SELECT DISTINCT NULL, ents.ent_id, NULL, ents.ent_id
		FROM
			(SELECT * FROM
				--Retrieve a list of entities from the line
				(SELECT le.ent_id FROM line_entities le
				UNION
				--Retrieve a list of scheduled entities in a work order
				SELECT j.target_sched_ent_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				) ents
			--Exclude the entities that are common between line and jobs
			--Return the entities from the jobs that are scheduled to entities that are not in a line
			--Or, the entities are in a line, but they do not have matching jobs to schedule to.
			EXCEPT
			SELECT * FROM
				(SELECT le.ent_id FROM line_entities le
				--Retrieve the entities that are common between line and job
				INTERSECT
				SELECT j.target_sched_ent_id FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
				) common_ents
			) ents
		) x
	INNER JOIN ent upstrm_ent ON x.ent_id_in_prev_column_position = upstrm_ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN ent downstrm_ent ON x.ent_id = downstrm_ent.ent_id
END

-- ================================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg
-- Description:	Returns the  quantity of a material to kg 
--
--eg. select [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] ('100000041475',.27,29)
-- ================================================================================================
-- Version		By		Date(yyyy-dd-mm)	Change Description
-- 1.0			AP		2023-23-02			Initial release
-- 1.1			YG		2024-02-09			Set the script body comment and nolock
-- ================================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyTokg] 
(
	@item_id       nvarchar(40)
,	@qty           float
,	@from_uom_id   int          = NULL
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @qty_conv float
	DECLARE @kg_UOM_id int=0
	
	-- Get the KG uom id
	SELECT  @kg_UOM_id=uom_id 
	from uom WITH (NOLOCK) 
	where   abbreviation ='KG'

	-- if UOM is not KG
	IF(@from_uom_id  <> @kg_UOM_id)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @qty_conv = @qty*factor 
		FROM uom_conv WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id=@item_id  and from_uom_id=@from_uom_id and to_uom_id=@kg_UOM_id
	END 
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @qty_conv=@qty
	END
	
	RETURN ISNULL(@qty_conv, 0)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Res_Exc]
  (@res_id int ,
   @start_time datetime ,
   @start_time_tz INT32 = NULL,
   @end_time datetime ,
   @end_time_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @qty_unavail float ,

   @mod_id varchar(30) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_U_Res_Exc
-- Description      - Update an existing row in the table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            - SP requires that all table fields be included
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--10/12/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--11/13/2009	Kishore		4.0	HF# 1432, Part of Date/Timezone Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
	  DECLARE @dbg_resp  INT32
	  SET @start_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_time_tz)
	  SET @end_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_time_tz)


      SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	-- TRACE
	EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Res_Exc', @src_key='on_entry',
						 @date_val1 = @start_time, @numeric_val1 = @start_time_tz,
						 @date_val2 = @end_time, @numeric_val2 = @end_time_tz

IF @start_time IS NOT NULL SET @start_time = DATEADD(mi, -@start_time_tz, @start_time)

UPDATE res_exc
SET end_time = DATEADD(mi, -@end_time_tz, @end_time),

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Std_OA_GetAvailAttrs]
(@oper_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Std_OA_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for an Operation (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific standard operation)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 11/03/2005
-- Version                  - 3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.visible_in_queue, attr.visible_in_inv
		,attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 7 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM std_oper_attr WHERE oper_id = @oper_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 7 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM std_oper_attr WHERE oper_id = @oper_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

-- Name:        [sp_S_ofi_item_cons_liquor_erp]
-- Description: This procedure reports liquor consumption
--
-- Version    Author    Date (yyyy-MM-dd)    Change description
-- 0.01.00    DS        2023-10-27          Initial Version
--===========================================================================================

 create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_item_cons_butter_erp_lk] 
 AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Temporary tables
    DECLARE @temp_00 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        row_id INT
    );

    DECLARE @temp_01 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        cons_qty_01 float,
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

	 DECLARE @temp_99 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        cons_qty_01 float,
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

    DECLARE @temp_02 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        cons_qty_01 float,
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

    DECLARE @cons_to_erp TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        cons_qty_01 float,
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

	DECLARE @cons_to_erp2f TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        cons_qty_01 float,
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

    -- Declare variables
    DECLARE 
        @total_qty_cons_00 float,
        @total_qty_prod_00 float,
        @ratio_00 float,
        @id_min INT,
        @id_max INT,
        @cons_qty_01 float,
        @item_01_class_id nvarchar(40);

    DECLARE 
        @total_wip_cons_01 float,
        @total_wip_prod_01 float,
        @ratio_01 float,
        @id_min1 INT,
        @id_max1 INT,
        @item_wip nvarchar(40),
        @sublot_wip nvarchar(40),
        @doRun int = 1,
        @wip_total float,
        @wip_ratio float,
        @wip_qty float,
		@id_min9 INT,
        @id_max9 INT,
		@total_rpt_qty float

    -- Step 1: Fetch all consumed records from Loadout
    INSERT INTO @temp_00  
    SELECT TOP 1 wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, lot_no, sublot_no, (qty_cons - qty_cons_erp) as qty_cons, row_id 
    FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE qty_cons > qty_cons_erp AND oper_id = 'ButterLoadout'  
    ORDER BY created_at_local DESC;

	--select * from @temp_00
	
    -- Check if the operation is 'ButterLoadout'
    IF ((SELECT TOP 1 oper_id FROM @temp_00) = 'ButterLoadout')
    BEGIN
        -- Step 1.1: Calculate total consumption from Loadout
        SELECT @total_qty_cons_00 = SUM(qty_cons) FROM @temp_00;
        
        -- Step 2: Fetch total produced qty from Blending for the same sublot
		/*
		 here we need to deduct the reported values

		 qty_prod - qty_prod_erp
		*/

        SELECT @total_qty_prod_00 = SUM(qty_prod- isnull(qty_prod_erp,0)) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) 
        WHERE sublot_no IN (SELECT sublot_no FROM @temp_00 GROUP BY sublot_no) AND oper_id in ( 'ButterFiltering','Degumming','Deodorizing')
        

        -- Step 3: Calculate the ratio
        SELECT @ratio_00 = case when  ROUND((@total_qty_cons_00 / @total_qty_prod_00) * 100, 8) >100 then 100 else  ROUND((@total_qty_cons_00 / @total_qty_prod_00) * 100, 8) end;

        -- Step 4: Fetch all consumption from Blending with matching fg_sublot_no
        INSERT @temp_01
        SELECT   wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_cons.item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, NULL, @ratio_00, item.item_class_id,item_cons.spare1, item_cons.row_id 
        FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) 
        INNER JOIN item ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
        WHERE fg_sublot_no IN (SELECT sublot_no FROM @temp_00 GROUP BY sublot_no) AND oper_id  in ( 'ButterFiltering','Degumming','Deodorizing')
		and (item_cons.qty_cons - (item_cons.qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(item_cons.spare1, '0') AS float)))>0.001
		--and item_cons.row_id in (396) -- 393, 394, 395, 396


		 -- Update consumption quantities in @temp_01 based on the ratio
        SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
        WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
        BEGIN
            --SELECT @cons_qty_01 = ROUND((qty_cons * @ratio_00) / 100, 8) FROM @temp_01 WHERE id = @id_min;
            SELECT @cons_qty_01 = case when (ROUND((qty_cons * @ratio_00) / 100, 8) +(qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float)))>qty_cons 
								 then 
									(qty_cons - (qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float)))
								 else
									ROUND((qty_cons * @ratio_00) / 100, 8)				
								end 
			FROM @temp_01 WHERE id = @id_min;


            UPDATE @temp_01 SET cons_qty_01 = @cons_qty_01 WHERE id = @id_min;
            SET @id_min = @id_min + 1;
        END

		--select * from @temp_01

		INSERT INTO @cons_to_erp2f
            SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
            FROM @temp_01  t1
            WHERE item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE'

		INSERT @temp_99 select  wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
						from  @temp_01 WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE'
		--process every row in the of @temp_99
		

		--select * from @cons_to_erp2f
		--select * from @temp_99

		 SELECT @id_min9 = MIN(id), @id_max9 = MAX(id) FROM @temp_99; -- 
		
		 WHILE (@id_min9 <= @id_max9)  -- it will run for first occurrence of intermediate material
					BEGIN
						  print @id_min9

						 

					DELETE FROM @temp_01;

					INSERT  @temp_01
					SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
					FROM @temp_99 WHERE id = @id_min9;


					WHILE (@doRun = 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @temp_01 WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE'))
					BEGIN
						--PRINT @doRun;
						SET @doRun = @doRun + 1; 

						-- Insert records into @temp_02 for INTERMEDIATE items
						DELETE FROM @temp_02; -- empty out everything 

						INSERT INTO @temp_02
						SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
						FROM @temp_01 
						WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE';

						--select * from @temp_02
						

						-- Process INTERMEDIATE items
						SELECT @id_min1 = MIN(id), @id_max1 = MAX(id) FROM @temp_02 GROUP BY item_id, sublot_no; --- always run for 1 time
            
						WHILE (@id_min1 <= @id_max1)
						--WHILE (@id_min1 <= 4) -- hardcoded, need to fix this
						BEGIN

							-- Clear @temp_01
							DELETE FROM @temp_01;

							SET @wip_ratio = 0;
							SELECT @wip_qty = cons_qty_01, @sublot_wip = sublot_no FROM @temp_02 WHERE id = @id_min1;
							
							delete FROM @temp_02 WHERE id = @id_min1;
							-- Insert records into @temp_01 for INTERMEDIATE items
							INSERT INTO @temp_01
							SELECT ic.wo_id, ic.oper_id, ic.seq_no, ic.item_id, ic.lot_no, ic.sublot_no, ic.fg_sublot_no, ic.qty_cons, ic.qty_cons_erp
							-- ROUND(((ic.qty_cons - ic.qty_cons_erp) * @ratio_00) / 100, 4) cons_qty_01
							--, (ic.qty_cons - ic.qty_cons_erp - ISNULL(cte1.cons_qty_01, 0)) cons_qty_01 -- check if there already exists in the record for calculation
							, (ic.qty_cons) cons_qty_01 
							, NULL, item.item_class_id,ic.spare1, ic.row_id 
							FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item ON ic.item_id = item.item_id
							LEFT JOIN @cons_to_erp cte1 ON ic.row_id = cte1.row_id
							WHERE ic.oper_id  in ( 'ButterFiltering','Degumming','Deodorizing')
							--AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp
							and (ic.qty_cons - (ic.qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(ic.spare1, '0') AS float)))>0.001
							AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @sublot_wip;

							SELECT @wip_total = SUM(cons_qty_01) FROM @temp_01;
							SET @wip_ratio =  case when ROUND(@wip_qty / @wip_total, 8)>1 then 1 else ROUND(@wip_qty / @wip_total, 8) end ;

							UPDATE @temp_01 SET cons_qty_01 = ROUND(cons_qty_01 * @wip_ratio, 8),wip_ratio = @wip_ratio;

							--UPDATE @temp_01 SET cons_qty_01 = 
							--		case when (ROUND((cons_qty_01 * @wip_ratio) / 100, 8)) +qty_cons>qty_cons 
							--	then 
							--	cons_qty_01
							--	else
							--	ROUND((cons_qty_01 * @wip_ratio) / 100, 8)				
							--end,wip_ratio = @wip_ratio;


							--SELECT * FROM @temp_01;

							 -- update should always come first otherwise new SFG will again add up
							UPDATE @cons_to_erp SET cons_qty_01 = cte1.cons_qty_01 + t1.cons_qty_01
								FROM @cons_to_erp cte1 INNER JOIN @temp_01 t1 ON cte1.row_id = t1.row_id AND t1.item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE';

							 -- Insert records into @cons_to_erp for non-INTERMEDIATE items
							INSERT INTO @cons_to_erp
								SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
								FROM @temp_01  t1
								WHERE item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE'
								AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @cons_to_erp cte2 WHERE cte2.row_id = t1.row_id);

								--delete sfg from temp01
								DELETE FROM @temp_01 WHERE item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE';

								INSERT INTO @temp_02
								SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
								FROM @temp_01 
								WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE';

								--select * from @temp_02
								--select * from @cons_to_erp

								SELECT  @id_max1 = MAX(id) FROM @temp_02 GROUP BY item_id, sublot_no;
								print @id_min1

							SET @id_min1 = @id_min1 + 1;

						END
					END

					---here you will get all the sfg material 

						--select * from @cons_to_erp						
						insert @cons_to_erp2f	select wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
												from @cons_to_erp;
		
						delete from @cons_to_erp;

						SET @id_min9 = @id_min9 + 1;

					END -- end loop of @temp99

			
			select * from @cons_to_erp2f 
			select @total_rpt_qty = sum(cons_qty_01) from @cons_to_erp2f;


        -- Uncomment the following lines to update item_cons table in MESDB

         UPDATE item_cons
         --SET spare1 = CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float) + s.cons_qty_01    
         --, qty_cons_erp = ic.qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(ic.spare1, '0') AS float) + s.cons_qty_01
		 SET spare1 = round(CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float) + s.cons_qty_01,3)
		 FROM item_cons ic
         INNER JOIN (select row_id, sum(cons_qty_01) cons_qty_01 from @cons_to_erp2f group by row_id) s ON ic.row_id = s.row_id;

         UPDATE item_cons 
		 --SET qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + t0.qty_cons
		 SET qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @total_rpt_qty
		 FROM item_cons ic INNER JOIN @temp_00 t0 ON ic.row_id = t0.row_id;


		-- update item_cons set spare1=0 where oper_id in( 'LiqBlend')

    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Attr_SetAttr]
(@ent_id	INT32
,@attr_id	INT32
,@attr_value	NVARCHAR(40)
,@job_pos	INT = 0
,@bom_pos	INT = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - SP_U_JOB_Attr_SetAttr
-- Description	      - To set the value of a job attribute given the entity on which the job is running
--			but not the actual job details. This facilitates capturing job attribute values
--			from the Factory Connector even if it doesn't know which job is currently running on an entity.
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 08/15/2002
-- Version	      - 1.3.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--10/26/2002    Tony                    1.5.0   Include job_pos as parameter and use it where relevant
--09/08/2005	Raghu			2.1.28	HD 6311, Adjusted this method such that entity attributes and bom_item attributes
--						will also be updated along with job attributes (depending upon attr.attr_grp)
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

BEGIN
DECLARE  @wo_id		STRING40
	,@oper_id	STRING40
	,@seq_no	INT32
	,@attr_grp	INT32

	SELECT @attr_grp = attr_grp FROM attr
	WHERE attr_id = @attr_id

	IF (@attr_grp = 1) BEGIN
		SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no FROM job_exec
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND job_pos = 0

		IF (@wo_id IS NULL OR @oper_id IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('There is currently NOT a job running on the specified entity.{3194}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom jb
				INNER JOIN item_attr ON jb.item_id = item_attr.item_id
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @job_pos AND attr_id = @attr_id) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},item attributes item_id and attr_id', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		UPDATE item_attr SET attr_value = @attr_value
		FROM job_bom jb
		WHERE item_attr.item_id = jb.item_id
		  AND wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @job_pos AND attr_id = @attr_id
	END
	ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 2) BEGIN -- Entity attributes
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM ent_attr WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND attr_id = @attr_id) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},entity attributes ent_id and attr_id', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		UPDATE ent_attr SET attr_value = @attr_value
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id AND attr_id = @attr_id
	END
	ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 5) BEGIN	-- Job attributes
		--Get WO_Id, Oper_ID, Seq_No from Job_exec for the input ent_id
		SELECT @wo_id = cur_wo_id, @oper_id = cur_oper_id, @seq_no = cur_seq_no
		FROM job_exec
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and job_pos = @job_pos

	--10/26/2002    Tony                    1.5.0     Include job_pos in WHERE clause
		--Raise Error if it is not a RUNNING JOB
		IF @wo_id IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR('There is currently NOT a job running on the specified entity.{3194}', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		IF UPPER(@WO_ID) = 'IDLE' BEGIN
			RAISERROR('Cannot Set the Attribute Value for the Idle Job', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		--Raise Err if attr_id doesnot exist in job_attr for the current wo_id, oper_id and seq_no
		--If Exist, Update attr_value for the wo_id, oper_id, seq_no and input attr_id
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1  FROM job_attr
			         WHERE job_attr.wo_id = @wo_id
				and job_attr.oper_id = @oper_id
				and job_attr.seq_no = @seq_no
				and job_attr.attr_id = @attr_id
			        ) BEGIN
			--RAISERROR('The attribute doesnot exist for this job', 16, 1)
			RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566},job attributes for the current job', 16, 1)
			RETURN -1
		END
		ELSE BEGIN
			UPDATE job_attr SET attr_value = @attr_value
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id
			    and  oper_id = @oper_id
			    and seq_no = @seq_no
			    and attr_id = @attr_id
		END
	END
END

Stored Procedure:		SP_S_MDRT_Config_UAttributes
Author:					Priyanka Randive
Created:				12/28/2017

Description:			To update MES Attributes
Called by:				Skelta Forms to edit MES Attributes 


Revision		Date			Who				    What
========		====			===				    ====
0.1				12/28/2017		PR					First version

**********************************************************************************/
--==================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDRT_Config_UAttributes]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
(
	@attr_id INT ,
	@attr_value nvarchar(80),
	@Mes_id nvarchar(80),
	@Mes_desc nvarchar(80),
	@grp_id Int,
	@wo_id  nvarchar(80),
	@oper_id  nvarchar(80),
	@seq_no  int,
	@process_id  nvarchar(80),
	@lot_no  nvarchar(80),
	@sublot_no  nvarchar(80)

)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @mod_id nvarchar(40)


if(@grp_id='1')
begin
 
	UPDATE item_attr
	SET 
		attr_value = @attr_value,
		last_edit_at=getdate()
      
	WHERE 	(attr_id = @attr_id ) and item_id = @Mes_id
      
end



if(@grp_id='2')
begin

	UPDATE ent_attr
	SET 
		attr_value = @attr_value,
		last_edit_at=getdate()
      
	WHERE 	(attr_id = @attr_id ) and ent_id = @Mes_id
     
end



if(@grp_id='3')
begin
UPDATE lot_attr
SET 
    attr_value = @attr_value,
	last_edit_at=getdate()
      
WHERE 	attr_id = @attr_id and item_id = @Mes_id and lot_no = @lot_no
 
end


if(@grp_id='4')
begin
UPDATE item_class_attr
SET 
    attr_value = @attr_value,
	last_edit_at=getdate()
      
WHERE 	attr_id = @attr_id and item_class_id = @Mes_id
 
end

if(@grp_id='5')
begin
UPDATE job_attr
SET 
    attr_value = @attr_value,
	last_edit_at=getdate()
      
WHERE 	attr_id = @attr_id and wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no


 
end



if(@grp_id='6')
begin
