/*--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation
-- Description:	Used to update active_su_ent_id by operation
--
-- Usage:		MDMStartJobWorkflow, MDMEndJobWorkflow
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2023-04-30			Initial version.
-- 0.02.00	YG				2023-05-23			Update Bug Fix #38 (Second Pre-BAT)
-- 0.03.00	YG				2023-05-26			Added new operations DownloadDestination and DownloadSource
--												Call logic for bom correction
-- 0.04.00	YG				2023-06-05			Set silo_seq to be null if the destinasion silo requested by the automations
--===========================================================================================*/

create Procedure [dbo].[sp_U_ofi_ActiveSiloByOperation_bck21_8_25] 
		@wo_id AS NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
		@seq_no AS INT = NULL,
		@old_silo_aut AS INT = NULL,
		@operation AS NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	-- Used for debugger
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 , @operation = 'Start'
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 , @operation = 'Stop'
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 ,@old_silo_aut = 500012, @operation = 'NextSource'
	--SELECT @wo_id = '1001016203' , @oper_id = 'BreakingWinnowing', @seq_no = 0 ,@old_silo_aut = 500031, @operation = 'NextDestination'

	--SELECT * FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
	--		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
	--		return

	DECLARE @Len INT,
			@Counter INT,
			@MinSeq INT,
			@SiloSeq INT,
			@JBItemId NVARCHAR(100),
			@SiloEntId INT, -- Primary Silo,
			@RowId INT,
			@SecondarySiloEntId INT,
			@SecondarySiloName NVARCHAR(100)

	-- Get Minimum Sequence used for Start and Download Destination operation
	DECLARE @MinSeqList TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		silo_seq INT,
		jb_item_id NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	-- Get Source Silo used for Start and Download Source operation
	DECLARE @SourceList TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		su_ent_id INT,
		jb_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
		row_id INT
	)
		
	IF (@operation = 'Start' or @operation = 'DownloadSilo')
	BEGIN
		---------- For Destination ----------------------
		IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null))
		BEGIN
			INSERT @MinSeqList
			SELECT min(silo_seq),jb_item_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
			GROUP By jb_item_id

			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @MinSeqList

			SET @Counter = 1
			WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @MinSeq=silo_seq, @JBItemId = jb_item_id FROM @MinSeqList
				WHERE id = @Counter

				UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = su_ent_id
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq = @MinSeq and jb_item_id = @JBItemId
				
				SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
			END
		END
		---------- End Logic For Destination ----------------------
		---------- For Source ----------------------
		IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null))
		BEGIN
			INSERT @SourceList
			SELECT su_ent_id,jb_item_id,row_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1 AND is_chk = 1 AND active_su_ent_id is null

			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceList

			SET @Counter = 1

			WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @SiloEntId=su_ent_id, @JBItemId = jb_item_id, @RowId = row_id FROM @SourceList
				WHERE id = @Counter

				UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = su_ent_id
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and row_id=@RowId

				SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
			END
		END
	END
	IF (@operation = 'Stop')
	BEGIN
		---------- For Destination and Source ----------------------
		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null))
		BEGIN
			UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = NULL
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null
		END
	END
	IF (@operation = 'NextSource')
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @SiloEntId = ent_id FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' and attr_grp = 2)
			  AND attr_value = CAST(@old_silo_aut as NVARCHAR(100))

		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId))
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SecondarySiloEntId=secondary_silo_ent_id, @SecondarySiloName = secondary_silo FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId

			IF NOT (@SecondarySiloEntId = 0 AND (@SecondarySiloName = '' OR @SecondarySiloName IS NULL))
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Silo Source Available'

				UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = @SecondarySiloEntId
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Secondary Silo Source Not Available'
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			PRINT 'Silo Source Not Registered'
		END
	END
	IF (@operation = 'NextDestination')
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @SiloEntId = ent_id FROM ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE attr_id = (SELECT attr_id FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
						 WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' and attr_grp = 2)
			  AND attr_value = CAST(@old_silo_aut as NVARCHAR(100))

		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				   WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId))
		BEGIN
			SELECT @JBItemId=jb_item_id, @SiloSeq = silo_seq FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and su_ent_id=@SiloEntId

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq > @SiloSeq and jb_item_id =@JBItemId )
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Silo Dest Available'
				SELECT TOP 1 @SecondarySiloEntId = su_ent_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq > @SiloSeq and jb_item_id =@JBItemId

				SELECT @MinSeq = min(silo_seq) FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and jb_item_id =@JBItemId

				-- Disable previous silo v0.02.00
				UPDATE ofi_su_selection
				SET active_su_ent_id = NULL, is_chk = NULL
				, silo_seq = NULL --0.04.00
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 
				and jb_item_id = @JBItemId 
				and su_ent_id = @SiloEntId

				-- Enable next silo v0.02.00
				UPDATE ofi_su_selection 
				SET active_su_ent_id = @SecondarySiloEntId
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
				--and silo_seq = @MinSeq 
				and su_ent_id = @SecondarySiloEntId
				and jb_item_id = @JBItemId
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'Secondary Silo Destination N\A'

			END
		END
	END

	IF (@operation = 'DownloadDestination')
	BEGIN
		IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null))
		BEGIN
			INSERT @MinSeqList
			SELECT min(silo_seq),jb_item_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
			GROUP By jb_item_id

			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @MinSeqList

			SET @Counter = 1
			WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @MinSeq=silo_seq, @JBItemId = jb_item_id FROM @MinSeqList
				WHERE id = @Counter

				UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = su_ent_id
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq = @MinSeq and jb_item_id = @JBItemId
				
				SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
			END
		END
	END

	IF (@operation = 'DownloadSource')
	BEGIN
		INSERT @SourceList
		SELECT su_ent_id,jb_item_id,row_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1 AND is_chk = 1 AND active_su_ent_id is null

		SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceList

		SET @Counter = 1

		WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SiloEntId=su_ent_id, @JBItemId = jb_item_id, @RowId = row_id FROM @SourceList
			WHERE id = @Counter

			UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = su_ent_id
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and row_id=@RowId

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
		END

	END

	IF (@operation = 'DownloadSilo')
	BEGIN
		--Source Chamge
		INSERT @SourceList
		SELECT su_ent_id,jb_item_id,row_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND dest_type = 1 AND is_chk = 1 AND active_su_ent_id is null

		SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceList

		SET @Counter = 1

		WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SiloEntId=su_ent_id, @JBItemId = jb_item_id, @RowId = row_id FROM @SourceList
			WHERE id = @Counter

			UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = su_ent_id
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1 and row_id=@RowId

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
		END

		-- Dest Change
		IF NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and active_su_ent_id is not null))
		BEGIN
			INSERT @MinSeqList
			SELECT min(silo_seq),jb_item_id FROM ofi_su_selection WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 
			GROUP By jb_item_id

			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @MinSeqList

			SET @Counter = 1
			WHILE(@Len >= @Counter)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @MinSeq=silo_seq, @JBItemId = jb_item_id FROM @MinSeqList
				WHERE id = @Counter

				UPDATE ofi_su_selection SET active_su_ent_id = su_ent_id
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and dest_type = 2 and is_chk = 1 and silo_seq = @MinSeq and jb_item_id = @JBItemId
				
				SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
			END
		END
	END
	
	IF(@oper_id = 'cakeblending' and @operation = 'Start') --- This is to maintain history of base dosing to use in BOM Correction and update Job_bom cumulative on every correction
    BEGIN
        EXEC Sp_u_ofi_job_bom_cumulative @wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,null,null,'setup',0
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_OES_GetItemEntSpecs]
(@process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@ent_id		INT
,@item_id		NVARCHAR(40)
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_OES_GetItemEntSpecs
-- Description	      -	Given a process_id, oper_id, ent_id and item_id - this method lists all the item specs and entity specs
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	05/12/2004
-- Version	      - 2.0.0.34
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By   Ver     Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 12/19/2017		  Surya			6.0	    US:956690 As Peter I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @spec_ver_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@bom_ver_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @spec_ver_id = ver_id FROM oper_spec_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

	SELECT @bom_ver_id = ver_id FROM bom_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE parent_item_id = @item_id AND preferred_ver = 1

	SELECT process_id, oper_id, step_no, ent_id, NULL 'item_id', NULL 'item_desc',  NULL bom_ver_id, NULL bom_pos,
	  ver_id 'spec_ver_id', oper_ent_spec.spec_id, spec_value,
	  assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(oper_ent_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, 1 'entity_specs', spec.grp_id, spec.spec_desc, spec.units
	FROM oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON spec.spec_id = oper_ent_spec.spec_id
	WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id AND ver_id = @spec_ver_id
	UNION
	SELECT process_id, oper_id, step_no, NULL ent_id, item.item_id, item.item_desc, bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id 'bom_ver_id', bom_item_oper_spec.bom_pos,
	  spec_ver_id, bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id, spec_value,
	  assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(bom_item_oper_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type, comments, min_value, max_value, access_level, 0 'entity_specs', spec.grp_id, spec.spec_desc, spec.units
	FROM bom_item_oper_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON spec.spec_id = bom_item_oper_spec.spec_id
	INNER JOIN (SELECT bi.parent_item_id, bi.ver_id, bi.bom_pos, bi.item_id, i.item_desc
			FROM bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item i WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.item_id = i.item_id
			WHERE bi.parent_item_id = @item_id) item
		ON bom_item_oper_spec.item_id = item.parent_item_id
		AND bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id = item.ver_id
		AND bom_item_oper_spec.bom_pos = item.bom_pos
	WHERE bom_item_oper_spec.item_id = @item_id AND bom_item_oper_spec.ver_id = @bom_ver_id
	  AND process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id

END

  -- Name:			sp_SA_ofi_GETAvailabilityLoss  -
  -- Description:	    Get All the utilization and avilability percentage
  --
  -- Usage:			OFIPerformanceDashboard (01.00.00) from used to display the dashbaord
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- Version			Authour			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)				Change Description
  -- 0.01.00			Siva			2022-08-01						Find the utilization and avilablity percentage
  -- 0.01.01			Veervar			2024-01-31						Cleanup and Logic comments
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- *************************************************************************************************************************

CREATE     procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_GetTop5DowntimeLoss]  @ent_id as INT 
AS

 BEGIN
 SET NOCOUNT ON

--GET TOP 5 REASON CODES FOR ENTITY BY DOWNTIME DURATION
select   top 5 substring(R.reas_desc, 1, 27) 'Reason',
G.reas_grp_desc 'ReasonCode',
Round(cast(
SUM(
CASE 
	WHEN ( u.event_end_time_utc = GETUTCDATE() and u.event_time_utc < e.cur_shift_start_time_utc) -- If the event is going on from the last shift but not finished . 
	OR
	u.event_time_utc < e.cur_shift_start_time_utc AND  u.event_end_time_utc > e.cur_shift_start_time_utc--If the event is going on from the last shift and finished .
		THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,e.cur_shift_start_time_utc, u.event_end_time_utc)
	WHEN  u.event_end_time_utc = GETUTCDATE() and u.event_time_utc > e.cur_shift_start_time_utc
		THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND,u.event_time_utc, u.event_end_time_utc)
	ELSE u.duration 
END) as float) , 2)AS Duration 
, 1000 as Losses 
from util_log u with (NOLOCK)
INNER join util_reas r with (NOLOCK) on U.reas_cd = R.reas_cd 
inner join util_reas_grp g with (nolock) on r.reas_grp_id = g.reas_grp_id 
INNER JOIN ent e  with (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id =u.ent_id  and  
	(u.event_time_utc between e.cur_shift_start_time_utc and e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	OR
	u.event_end_time_utc between e.cur_shift_start_time_utc and e.cur_shift_end_time_utc
	)
where 
	u.runtime = 0 and 
	e.ent_id=@ent_id
group by
    R.reas_desc,
    G.reas_grp_desc 
order by
    sum(duration) desc 
End

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Bom_Ver_Copy]
  (@existing_parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @existing_ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @new_parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @new_ver_id nvarchar(40),
   @new_ver_comments NVARCHAR(80),
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0 ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) OUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_I_Bom_Ver_Copy
-- Description	      - To copy an existing BOM version in the database supplying a new Item ID and/or a new BOM version ID.
--			HD# 2017
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 01/03/2003
-- Version	      - 2.1.0.20
--

--

-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--01/07/2003	  Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 2192) Cloning BOMs should update date with current dates
--01/09/2003	  Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--01/10/2003	  Raghu		1.5.5	(HD# 2181) Copying/Cloning BOM Ver should update the description (ver_comments) with clone of something
--01/20/2003	  Vijay		1.5.6	(HD# 2279) After Copying BOM Ver, if there is no preferred version, it should be marked as preferred
-- 06-06-2003     Sheetal Jain  1600  	Oracle migration changes - SET @<variable> = (SELECT ...)
--10/02/2003	  Raghu		1.6.26	(HD# 3773, 3739) Added a check while cloning BOM 0 for record exist; if exist, then update else insert
--10/20/2003	  Raghu		2.0.6	(HD# 3888) If BOM_VER. comments IS NULL, store it as null, do not default data to comments field
--06/15/2004	  Raghu		2.1.0	Included last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields in the insert statement
-- 03/03/2005     SJ            2115    HD#5394 - Cloning a BOM writes records to the  bom_item_oper_link table
-- 04/29/2005     SJ            2120    HD#5596 - Clone BOM to different item
--08/08/2005	Raghu		2.1.25	HD# 6083, Bom_Ver.Ver_Date should be a local date and not a GMT date.
--09/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/04/2007     KRF           3.2.1   HD# 8314, 9232 - Include def_sublot_no and serial_no_source when copying BOM_Item records
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007	AML			3.3.4	HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET XACT_ABORT ON
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @preferred_count INTEGER
  ,@last_edit_by   STRING40
  ,@last_edit_at   DATETIME
  ,@ver_date	DATETIME

BEGIN
	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM bom_ver
			WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id) BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Cant Copy. Source BOM_VER not found{3321}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  IF EXISTS (SELECT * from bom_ver where parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id) BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Cant Copy. Target BOM_VER exists{3322}', 16, 1)
    RETURN -1
  END

  EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
  SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = GETUTCDATE()
ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @ver_date)
SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @ver_date )

  INSERT INTO bom_ver (parent_item_id, ver_id, ver_date, ver_comments, preferred_ver, disassembly, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, @ver_date, @new_ver_comments, 0, disassembly, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM bom_ver
	WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id
  IF @@error <> 0
  BEGIN
    RAISERROR('SQL ERROR updating the row in Bom_Ver table{3323}', 16, 1, @@error)
    RETURN -1
  END

  --VRB
  --If there are no preferred versions after moving this version to a new item, then mark the version as preferred
  SELECT @preferred_count = COUNT(*) FROM bom_ver WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and preferred_ver=1
  IF @preferred_count=0
  BEGIN
    UPDATE bom_ver set preferred_ver = 1 where parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id
  END
  -- Return timestamp
  SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) FROM bom_ver
    WHERE (parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id AND ver_id = @new_ver_id)

  IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM bom_item WHERE parent_item_id = @new_parent_item_id and ver_id = @new_ver_id and bom_pos = 0)
  BEGIN
    UPDATE bom_item SET item_id = bi.item_id, reqd_grade_cd = bi.reqd_grade_cd, instruction = bi.instruction
			, qty_per_parent_item = bi.qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item = bi.max_qty_per_parent_item
			, min_qty_per_parent_item = bi.min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv =  bi.update_inv
			, backflush = bi.backflush, def_reas_cd = bi.def_reas_cd, def_lot_no = bi.def_lot_no, def_sublot_no = bi.def_sublot_no
			, def_storage_ent_id = bi.def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id = bi.def_reject_ent_id
			, scaling_factor = bi.scaling_factor
			, must_consume_from_inv = bi.must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc = bi.may_choose_alt_inv_loc
			, may_create_new_lots = bi.may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip = bi.must_consume_from_wip
			, must_consume_before_prod =  bi.must_consume_before_prod, serial_no_source = bi.serial_no_source
			, spare1 = bi.spare1, spare2 = bi.spare2, spare3 = bi.spare3, spare4 = bi.spare4
	FROM (SELECT @new_parent_item_id 'parent_item_id', @new_ver_id 'ver_id', bom_pos
			, @new_parent_item_id 'item_id', reqd_grade_cd, instruction
			, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
			, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
			, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
			, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, serial_no_source
			, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4
		FROM bom_item
		  WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id and bom_pos = 0) bi
	  WHERE bom_item.parent_item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND bom_item.ver_id = bi.ver_id AND bom_item.bom_pos = bi.bom_pos
  END
  ELSE
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO bom_item (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
		, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
		, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
		, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
		, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
		, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, @new_parent_item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
		, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
		, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
		, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
		, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
		, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	  FROM bom_item
	    WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id and bom_pos = 0
  END

  INSERT INTO bom_item (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
	, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
	, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
	, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
	, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
	, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    SELECT @new_parent_item_id, @new_ver_id, bom_pos, item_id, reqd_grade_cd, instruction
	, qty_per_parent_item, max_qty_per_parent_item, min_qty_per_parent_item, update_inv
	, backflush, def_reas_cd, def_lot_no, def_sublot_no, def_storage_ent_id, def_reject_ent_id, scaling_factor
	, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots
	, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, est_time, serial_no_source
	, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
      FROM bom_item
	WHERE parent_item_id = @existing_parent_item_id and ver_id = @existing_ver_id and bom_pos <> 0
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Audit_Trail_SetContxtInfo]
(@session_id INT32
,@region_id  STRING80_NULL = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -  Rohit Pandya
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By Ver  Changes
-- 12/21/2009     DonT             Added region_id
-- 01/03/2013	  Ravi Teja		   CR L00124413 (HF Merge L00124330) - String operation should support unicode characters.
-- 12/10/2013	  Ibrahim		   CR 129729 fix. Region_id and CONTEXT_INFO are updated only if there is change in their value.
-- 08/21/2014	  Ibrahim	  5.0  User Story #375850: code changes to handle the session IDs containing negative numbers.
--								   -1 to -9 are reserved for custom implementations.� Starting from -10 and below should be used to resolve the row_id in the user_name table.�
--								   For example, -10 represents row ID 0 (i.e. ABS(-10)-10 = 0) in the user_name table;
--								   -11 represents row ID 1 (i.e. ABS(-11)-10 =1) in the user_name table; -12 represents row ID 2 in the user_name table, and so on.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

if @session_id is null return -1
DECLARE @bin_session varbinary(10)
DECLARE @BinVar varbinary(128)
DECLARE @context_region_id VARCHAR(80)
DECLARE @context_sess_id INT

IF @session_id >= 0 BEGIN
	select @context_region_id = region_id from sessn with(nolock) where session_id = @session_id
	IF (@context_region_id  IS NULL OR @context_region_id <> @region_id) BEGIN
		update sessn set region_id = @region_id where session_id = @session_id
	END
END
ELSE BEGIN
	-- checks @session_id is between -9 and -1 which are reserved for custom implementations.
	IF @session_id >= -9 BEGIN
		-- if our session_id is in unacceptable range, then we can use the region_id to find another session that we can borrow
        -- this will just be for the next call and is almost alsways a sp_S* call. We just need to
        -- provide a region context for anyone doing a fn_TZ_GetLocalDate()
		SELECT @session_id = isnull(max(session_id),-1) FROM sessn WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE region_id = @region_id
	END
END
select @context_sess_id = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO())
IF (@context_sess_id IS NULL OR @context_sess_id <> @session_id) BEGIN
 -- Insert the session_id as CONTEXT_INFO
 SET @bin_session = CONVERT(varbinary,@session_id)
 SET @BinVar = CAST( REPLICATE( CAST(@bin_session AS NVARCHAR), 128 ) AS varbinary(128) )
 SET CONTEXT_INFO  @BinVar
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_DLG_GetAvailGroups]
(@wo_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@oper_id	STRING40_NULL = NULL
,@seq_no	INT32_NULL = NULL
,@step_no	INT32_NULL = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_DLG_GETAVAILGROUPS
-- Description          - Returns an available set of data_log_groups for the given job/step.
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 12/12/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 12/12/2007		AML				3.4.1		Initial Version
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN

DECLARE	 @run_ent_id				INT32
	,@data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp	LOGICAL

	SET @data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp = 0

	IF (@step_no IS NULL) BEGIN
		SELECT @run_ent_id = j.run_ent_id
		FROM job j WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  j.oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  j.seq_no = @seq_no

		SELECT @data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp = 1
		FROM data_entry_sched des WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON des.key_id = j.row_id
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  j.oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  j.seq_no = @seq_no AND
			  j.state_cd = 3 AND
			  des.key_type = 6 AND
			  des.category = 'DataLog Group'

		SELECT dlg.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc, dlg.max_value, MAX(dlg.collect_data) AS collect_data, MAX(dlg.certify) AS certify
		        FROM (
		            SELECT	dlgjl.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc, dlg.max_value
		                ,	dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollectionReqd(dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, NULL, NULL, @data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp) AS collect_data
		                ,	dbo.fn_DL_IsCertificationReqd(dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, NULL, NULL, dlgjl.cert_name) AS certify
		            FROM data_log_grp_job_link dlgjl
						INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dlgjl.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		            WHERE dlgjl.wo_id = @wo_id
		              AND dlgjl.oper_id = @oper_id
		              AND dlgjl.seq_no = @seq_no
		            UNION
		            SELECT	dlgel.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc, dlg.max_value
		                ,	dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollectionReqd(	dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, NULL, NULL, @data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp) AS collect_data
		                ,	dbo.fn_DL_IsCertificationReqd(dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, NULL, NULL, NULL) AS certify
		            FROM data_log_grp_ent_link dlgel
						INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dlgel.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
		            WHERE dlgel.ent_id = @run_ent_id
		        ) dlg
		GROUP BY dlg.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc, dlg.max_value
	END
	ELSE BEGIN

	            SELECT @run_ent_id = j.run_ent_id
	            FROM job j
	            WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id
	              AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
	              AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

	            SELECT @data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp = 1
	            FROM data_entry_sched des
					INNER JOIN job_step js ON des.key_id = js.row_id
					INNER JOIN job j ON js.wo_id = j.wo_id AND js.oper_id = j.oper_id AND js.seq_no = j.seq_no
	            WHERE js.wo_id = @wo_id
	              AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
	              AND js.seq_no = @seq_no
	              AND js.step_no = @step_no
	              AND j.state_cd = 3
	              AND des.key_type = 7 -- job step
	              AND des.category = 'Datalog Group'

	        SELECT	dlg.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc, dlg.max_value
				,	MAX(dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollectionReqd(dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, NULL, NULL, @data_collect_reqd_for_this_grp)) AS collect_data
	            ,	MAX(dbo.fn_DL_IsCertificationReqd(dlg.grp_id, dlg.max_value, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @step_no, NULL, NULL, dlgjsl.cert_name)) AS certify

	          AND dlgjsl.seq_no = @seq_no
	          AND dlgjsl.step_no = @step_no
	        GROUP BY dlg.grp_id, dlg.grp_desc, dlg.max_value

	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Update_Specific]
  (@table_name NVARCHAR(40)
  ,@setters_xml NVARCHAR(MAX)
  ,@where_xml NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      -	sp_Update_Specific
-- Description      -	Update rows from the specified table based on the information supplied in the setters XML and the where XML.
--						The settrs XML has the following format:
--						<setters>
--							<setter name="col1" value="val1"/>
--							<setter name="col2" value="val2"/>
--							...
--							<setter name="coln" value="valn"/>
--						The where clause XML has the following format
--						<where_clauses>
--							<clause name="col1" op="NE" value="val1"/>
--							<clause name="col2" value="val2"/>
--							...
--							<clause name="coln" value="valn"/>
--						<where_clauses>
--						The op attribute is optional and defaults to equals if not supplied.  Valid values are
--						E	- Equals
--						NE  - Not Equals
--						GT	- Greater Than
--						GTE - Greater Than or Equal
--						LT	- Less Than
--						LTE - Less Than or Equal
--						If the op attribute has any other value, it will default to equals
-- Author			-	Rich Boyle
-- Date Created	    -	09/20/2017
-- Version			-	6.0
--
-- Copyright (c) AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes            -
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Version      Changes
-- 09/26/2019         Srinivasa        6.2          US#1227601(Merge CR#L00155165 for HF-CR#L00154725: The customer as recently migrated
--                                                    from MES 2014R3 to 2017. Upon doing so, they cannot set the Job states to ready.))
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ***************************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @sSQL				NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@setter_clause			NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@setter_clauses		XML
		,@setter_clause_used	BIT
		,@where_clause			NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@where_clauses			XML
		,@where_clause_used		BIT
		,@column_name			NVARCHAR(100)
		,@column_type			NVARCHAR(100)
		,@op					NVARCHAR(100)
		,@column_value			NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@column_count			INT
		,@err_msg				NVARCHAR(1000)

	CREATE TABLE #values_table (column_count INT, value NVARCHAR(MAX))

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(@table_name) AND type in (N'U')) BEGIN
		RAISERROR('The table is not an MES table{136}', 16, 1)
		RETURN - 1
	END

	SELECT @setter_clauses = @setters_xml, @where_clauses = @where_xml, @sSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @table_name, @setter_clause = ' SET', @where_clause = ' WHERE', @where_clause_used = 0, @column_count = 0

	IF (@setters_xml IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		DECLARE setter_cursor  CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT  x.v.value('@name[1]', 'NVARCHAR(100)') AS dimtype ,
				x.v.value('@value[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS dimvalue
			FROM @setter_clauses.nodes('/setters/setter') x(v)
		OPEN setter_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM setter_cursor INTO @column_name, @column_value
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @column_type = NULL
			SELECT @column_type = LOWER(DATA_TYPE) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = @table_name AND COLUMN_NAME = @column_name
			IF @column_type IS NULL BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Column %1 not found.{6235},' + @column_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				CLOSE setter_cursor
				DEALLOCATE setter_cursor
				DROP TABLE #values_table
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF (@setter_clause_used = 1)
				SET @setter_clause = @setter_clause + ','
			IF (@column_value <> '') BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #values_table VALUES(@column_count, @column_value)
				IF @column_type = 'datetime'
					SET @setter_clause =  @setter_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT CONVERT(datetime, value, 120) FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE IF @column_type = 'datetime2'
					SET @setter_clause =  @setter_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT CONVERT(datetime2, value, 120) FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE
					SET @setter_clause =  @setter_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT value FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @setter_clause =  @setter_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = NULL'
			END
			SELECT @setter_clause_used = 1, @column_count = @column_count + 1
		END
		CLOSE setter_cursor
		DEALLOCATE setter_cursor

	END

	IF (@where_xml IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		DECLARE where_cursor  CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT  x.v.value('@name[1]', 'NVARCHAR(100)') AS dimtype ,
				x.v.value('@op[1]', 'NVARCHAR(100)') AS dimop ,
				x.v.value('@value[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') AS dimvalue
			FROM @where_clauses.nodes('/where_clauses/clause') x(v)
		OPEN where_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM where_cursor INTO @column_name, @op, @column_value
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			SET @column_type = NULL
			SELECT @column_type = LOWER(DATA_TYPE) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = @table_name AND COLUMN_NAME = @column_name
			IF @column_type IS NULL BEGIN
				SET @err_msg = 'Column %1 not found.{6235},' + @column_name
				RAISERROR(@err_msg, 16, 1)
				CLOSE where_cursor
				DEALLOCATE where_cursor
				DROP TABLE #values_table
				RETURN -1
			END
			IF (@where_clause_used = 1)
				SET @where_clause = @where_clause + ' AND'
			IF @op IS NULL OR @op = 'E' SET @op = ' = '
			ELSE IF @op = 'NE' SET @op = ' <> '
			ELSE IF @op = 'GT' SET @op = ' > '
			ELSE IF @op = 'GTE' SET @op = ' >= '
			ELSE IF @op = 'LT' SET @op = ' < '
			ELSE IF @op = 'LTE' SET @op = ' <= '
			ELSE SET @op = ' = '
			IF (@column_value <> '') BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #values_table VALUES(@column_count, @column_value)
				IF @column_type = 'datetime'
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT CONVERT(datetime, value, 120) FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE IF @column_type = 'datetime2'
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' = ' + '(SELECT CONVERT(datetime2, value, 120) FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE if @column_type = 'timestamp'
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, ' + @column_name + '))) = ' + '(SELECT value FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
				ELSE
					SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + @op + '(SELECT value FROM #values_table WHERE column_count = ' + CAST(@column_count AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ')'
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SET @where_clause =  @where_clause + ' ' + @column_name + ' IS NULL'
			END
			SELECT @where_clause_used = 1, @column_count = @column_count + 1
		END
		CLOSE where_cursor
		DEALLOCATE where_cursor
	END

	if (@setter_clause_used = 1) BEGIN
		SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @setter_clause
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		RAISERROR('There are no dependant fields supplied for the Update.{4836}', 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	IF (@where_clause_used = 1) SET @sSQL = @sSQL + @where_clause

	--PRINT @sSQL
	SET NOCOUNT OFF
	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @sSQL
	DROP TABLE #values_table
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_TZ_GetLocalOffset]
(
	@site_ent_id	INT32 = NULL
,	@in_local		TDATETIME_NULL = NULL
,	@out_tz_bias	INT32 = NULL OUTPUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      Helper routine that will fill in any NULL Input/Output params.
--					  If a value is passed in for inout_tz_bias, it will be ignored.
--                    Pass a site_ent_id if you want to work with an Entity Local offset.
--                    Pass NULL for site_ent_id to work with a Client Local offset.
-- Author             -
-- Date Created	      -	12/16/2009
-- Version		      - 4.0.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE @tmp_utc datetime
	DECLARE @tmp_tz_bias int

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SET @tmp_utc = NULL
	SET @tmp_tz_bias = NULL
	IF (@site_ent_id IS NOT NULL OR @in_local IS NOT NULL)
		EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo @site_ent_id, @tmp_utc, @in_local, @tmp_tz_bias OUTPUT
	ELSE
		SET @tmp_tz_bias = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(NULL) -- this will generate a client local offset based on current utc

	SET @out_tz_bias = @tmp_tz_bias
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_GetLocaleStringMsg]
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@string NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@grp_id INT = NULL
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @target_langId INT
	declare @eng_langId int
	DECLARE @eng_string_id int

	select @eng_langId = lang_id from language where string  = 'Default (English)'

	SELECT @target_langId=attr_value FROM system_attr WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE attr_desc like '%Default language%'

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	SELECT @eng_string_id= string_id FROM language WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lang_id=@eng_langId and string=@string and (@grp_id is null or @grp_id=grp_id)

	SELECT @Result= string FROM language WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE lang_id=@target_langId and string_id=@eng_string_id and (@grp_id is null or @grp_id=grp_id)

	if @Result is null  
	 begin 
		set @Result = @string
	 end
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @Result

END

-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE  @temp_entities TABLE (ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		parent_ent_id INT)

	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id)

	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_link el ON el.child_ent_id = soel.ent_id

		INNER JOIN ent_link el on el.child_ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
		WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)

		IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
	END
	-- Add in the root entities
	INSERT INTO @temp_entities (ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id)
	SELECT distinct te.parent_ent_id, e.ent_name, null FROM @temp_entities te
	INNER JOIN ent e on e.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
	WHERE te.parent_ent_id NOT IN (SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities)

	SELECT DISTINCT ent_id, ent_name FROM @temp_entities ORDER BY ent_name
/*

	DECLARE  @entities TABLE (root_ent_id INT, ent_id INT, ent_name NVARCHAR(80),
		parent_ent_id INT, child_level INT, ent_tree VARCHAR(4000))

		,@ent_id			INT32
		,@root_ent_id  			INT32

	DECLARE ent_tree_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT ent_id FROM @temp_entities WHERE parent_ent_id IS NULL ORDER BY ent_id

	OPEN ent_tree_cursor

	WHILE (1 = 1)
	BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM ent_tree_cursor INTO @root_ent_id
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		SELECT @child_level = 1, @ent_id = @root_ent_id

		INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level)
		SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, NULL, @child_level FROM ent e
		WHERE e.ent_id = @ent_id

		SET @child_level = 2
		WHILE (1=1)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @entities (root_ent_id, ent_id, ent_name, parent_ent_id, child_level, ent_tree)
			SELECT @root_ent_id, e.ent_id, e.ent_name, te.parent_ent_id, @child_level
				,x.ent_tree
			FROM @temp_entities te
			INNER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON te.ent_id = e.ent_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ent_id, CASE WHEN ent_tree IS NULL THEN CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id)
					ELSE ent_tree + '-' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), ent_id) END ent_tree
				FROM @entities
				WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id) x ON x.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id
			WHERE  te.parent_ent_id IN
				(SELECT ent_id FROM @entities WHERE child_level = @child_level -1 AND root_ent_id = @root_ent_id)

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <= 0) BREAK
			SET @child_level = @child_level + 1
		END
	END
	CLOSE ent_tree_cursor
	DEALLOCATE ent_tree_cursor

	SELECT te.root_ent_id, te.ent_id, te.ent_name, te.parent_ent_id,
		e.ent_name as parent_ent_name, te.child_level, te.ent_tree
	FROM @entities te
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e ON e.ent_id = te.parent_ent_id

*/

-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_item_cons_butter_erp]
-- Description:This will be used in WEI to report the Butter consumption in Butter Loadout


-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 MP            	  2023-09-014		Intial Version

-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_item_cons_butter_erp_mahesh] 


AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  DECLARE 
@total_qty_cons_00 float,
@total_qty_prod_00 float,
@ratio_00 float,
@total_qty_cons_01 float,
@total_qty_prod_01 float,
@total_qty_cons_02 float,
@total_qty_prod_02 float,
@ratio_01 float,
@ratio_02 float,
@id_mIN INt,
@id_max INt,
@cons_qty_01 float,
@cons_qty_02 float,
@cons_qty_03 float,
@item_01_class_id nvarchar(40),
@item_02_class_id nvarchar(40),
@item_03_class_id nvarchar(40)

 DECLARE
  @cons_to_erp TABLE 
  (
   id INt IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
   wo_id nvarchar(40),
   oper_id nvarchar(40),
   seq_no INt,
   item_id nvarchar(40),
   lot_no nvarchar(40),
   sublot_no nvarchar(40),
   qty_cons float,
   qty_cons_erp float,
   row_id INt
  )


 DECLARE
  @temp_00 TABLE 
  (
   id INt IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
   wo_id nvarchar(40),
   oper_id nvarchar(40),
   seq_no INt,
   lot_no nvarchar(40),
   sublot_no nvarchar(40),
   qty_cons float
  )

  INSERT INTO @temp_00  
  SELECT wo_id,oper_id,seq_no,lot_no,sublot_no,qty_cons FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE created_at_utc =(SELECT TOP 1 created_at_utc FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY  created_at_utc DESC)

IF((SELECT TOP 1 oper_id from @temp_00)='ButterLoadout')
BEGIN
  --SELECT *FROM @temp_00

  SELECT @total_qty_cons_00=SUM(qty_cons) FROM @temp_00
  SELECT @total_qty_prod_00=SUM(qty_prod) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sublot_no IN (SELECT sublot_no FROM @temp_00 GROUP BY sublot_no)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @first_oper  bit  ,
 @final_oper  bit  ,
 @check_inv  bit  ,
 @sched_to_ent_id  int  ,
 @oper_type  nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare1 nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare2 nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare3 nvarchar(80) ,
 @spare4 nvarchar(80) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--07/16/2007  Raghu           3.3.1   HD# 10048, Add rework_cd before notes.
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT oper.process_id
            ,oper.oper_id
            ,process.process_desc
            ,oper.oper_desc
            ,oper.def_reject_rate
            ,oper.first_oper
            ,oper.final_oper
            ,oper.display_seq
            ,oper.check_inv
            ,oper.sched_to_ent_id
            ,oper.oper_type
            ,oper.oper_cost
            ,oper.deviation_above
            ,oper.deviation_below
            ,oper.assoc_file
 	    ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(oper.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
			,oper.rework_cd
            ,oper.notes
--            ,dlgol.grp_id
            ,oper.spare1
            ,oper.spare2
            ,oper.spare3
            ,oper.spare4
            ,oper.last_edit_comment
            ,oper.last_edit_by
            ,oper.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper.mod_id))) mod_id
			,oper.row_id
  FROM oper oper WITH (NOLOCK)
       INNER JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper.process_id = process.process_id
--	LEFT OUTER JOIN data_log_grp_oper_link dlgol ON dlgol.process_id = oper.process_id AND dlgol.oper_id = oper.oper_id
WHERE ((oper.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper.oper_desc = @oper_desc OR @oper_desc IS NULL) AND
       (oper.first_oper = @first_oper OR @first_oper IS NULL) AND
       (oper.final_oper = @final_oper OR @final_oper IS NULL) AND
       (oper.check_inv = @check_inv OR @check_inv IS NULL) AND
       (oper.sched_to_ent_id = @sched_to_ent_id OR @sched_to_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper.oper_type = @oper_type OR @oper_type IS NULL)  AND
       (oper.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY oper.display_seq, oper.oper_id

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_std_oper_ent_spec_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[std_oper_ent_spec]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_std_oper_ent_spec_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on std_oper_ent_spec table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 09/27/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/08/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Maintain std_oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically.
--10/25/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
			,@current_time	TDATETIME
			,@use_GMT	INT32
			,@last_edit_at		DATETIME
			,@assoc_file_type STRING20
			,@assoc_file STRING254

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	-- Make sure the assoc_file_type is set to the extension for the assoc_file
	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM inserted i
		JOIN deleted d ON i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.step_no = d.step_no AND i.ent_id = d.ent_id AND i.ver_id = d.ver_id AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
		WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) BEGIN

		IF Exists(SELECT TOP 1 1
			FROM inserted i
			WHERE i.assoc_file IS NOT NULL AND dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) IS NULL) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The file_ext  should not be null.{3339},file_ext', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END

		UPDATE std_oper_ent_spec SET assoc_file_type = dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(x.assoc_file)
		FROM (SELECT i.assoc_file, i.oper_id, i.step_no, i.ent_id, i.ver_id, i.spec_id
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.step_no = d.step_no AND i.ent_id = d.ent_id AND i.ver_id = d.ver_id AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE std_oper_ent_spec.oper_id = x.oper_id AND std_oper_ent_spec.step_no = x.step_no AND std_oper_ent_spec.ent_id = x.ent_id AND std_oper_ent_spec.ver_id = x.ver_id AND std_oper_ent_spec.spec_id = x.spec_id

		INSERT INTO file_type
		(file_ext, edit_level, view_level, print_level, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
		SELECT DISTINCT x.file_ext, 1, 1, 1, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
		FROM (SELECT dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(i.assoc_file) as file_ext
				FROM inserted i
				JOIN deleted d ON i.oper_id = d.oper_id AND i.step_no = d.step_no AND i.ent_id = d.ent_id AND i.ver_id = d.ver_id AND i.spec_id = d.spec_id
				WHERE (ISNULL(i.assoc_file, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file, '')) OR (ISNULL(i.assoc_file_type, '') <> ISNULL(d.assoc_file_type, ''))) x
		WHERE x.file_ext IS NOT NULL AND x.file_ext NOT IN (SELECT file_ext FROM file_type WITH (NOLOCK))
	END

	UPDATE std_oper_ent_spec SET std_oper_ent_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, std_oper_ent_spec.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE std_oper_ent_spec.oper_id = i.oper_id AND std_oper_ent_spec.step_no = i.step_no
	  AND std_oper_ent_spec.ent_id = i.ent_id AND std_oper_ent_spec.ver_id = i.ver_id
	  AND std_oper_ent_spec.spec_id = i.spec_id

	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF (@use_GMT = 1) SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

	UPDATE std_oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( @current_time )
	WHERE oper_id + ' - ' + ver_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT (oper_id + ' - ' + ver_id) FROM inserted i)
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_EI_MM_Attr] (@item_id NVARCHAR(40))

      FROM   item i WITH (nolock)
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia1 WITH (nolock)

             INNER JOIN attr a1 WITH (nolock)

                        AND a1.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia2 WITH (nolock)

             INNER JOIN attr a3 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a3.attr_id = ia3.attr_id
                        AND a3.attr_desc = 'LanguageKey'
                        AND a3.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia4 WITH (nolock)
                     ON ia4.item_id = i.item_id
             INNER JOIN attr a4 WITH (nolock)
                     ON a4.attr_id = ia4.attr_id
                        AND a4.attr_desc = 'PlantCode'
                        AND a4.attr_grp = 1
             INNER JOIN item_attr ia5 WITH (nolock)

                        AND a5.attr_grp = 1

  (@sender nvarchar(80) ,
   @sent datetime ,
   @recipient nvarchar(40) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value int = 0)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.

-- 10/06/2005	Raghu		2.1.30	Changed such that all times are stored in GMT.
-- 12/22/2009	Eswar		4.0		HF1432 - Removed conversion to local time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
SET @sent = DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @sent)

SELECT message.sender
          ,message.subject
          ,message.sent as sent
          ,message.recipient
          ,message.rcvd as rcvd
          ,message.message
          ,message.ver_recpt
          ,message.cc
          ,message.category
          ,message.priority
          ,message.save_till as save_till
          ,message.read_at as read_at
          ,message.last_edit_comment
          ,message.last_edit_by
          ,message.last_edit_at
  FROM message message
WHERE (message.sender = @sender AND
       message.sent = @sent AND
       message.recipient = @recipient)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_i_ofi_BinCons_audittrail]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ent_id INT,
	@wo_id nvarchar(40),
	@collectionStartTime nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@collectionEndTime nvarchar(50)=NULL,
	@item nvarchar(40)=NULL,
	@originArea nvarchar(50)=NULL,	
	@recordtype NVARCHAR(20)='CONS' ,--PROD, CONS
	@consMode NVARCHAR(20)=NULL,
	@qty NVARCHAR(10)=0,
	@active INT,
	@user_name NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
--VARIABLE DECLARATION
	
	DECLARE @auditTrailParameters ofi_AUDITTRAILPARAMETERS
		,@strModuleName NVARCHAR(80) = 'ReworkBinConsumption'
		,@strFunctionName NVARCHAR(80) = 'UI'
		,@strActivityMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''
		,@strCommentMsg NVARCHAR(200) = ''

		,@keyField1 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL

		,@keyField4 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField5 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		,@keyField6 NVARCHAR(200) = NULL	
		,@column_name NVARCHAR(50) = '[Status]'
		,@log_id INT
		,@logged_at DATETIME = GETDATE()
		,@audit_utc DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		,@user_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
		,@change_type INT = 1
		,@table_name NVARCHAR(80)='[bins_cons]'
		,@row_id INT
		,@audit_category NVARCHAR(80) = 'Info'
		,@linestatus NVARCHAR(20)
	    DECLARE @newval NVARCHAR(max)
		,@oldVal NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@prevLineStatus NVARCHAR(100)
		,@newlineEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStoragesrcEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@newStoragedestEntId NVARCHAR(50)
		,@errorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@transfertype nvarchar(120)
		,@ent_name NVARCHAR(80)
		DECLARE @audit_comments NVARCHAR(254) = @strModuleName + '$' + @strFunctionName

		--GET REWORK EQUIPMENT NAME
		SELECT @ent_name=ent_name FROM ent WHERE ent_id=@ent_id 

		--select *from ent
		SELECT @row_id = max(row_id)
		FROM item_cons --where wo_id=@wo_id and ent_id=@ent_id -- commented as it was failingthe workflow as wo_id and ent_id didnt exist

		select @newlineEntId=ISNULL(description,ent_name) from ent with (nolock) where ent_id=@ent_id
	---------	Automation
		if( @consMode='AUTOMATION')
		BEGIN
					IF ((ISNULL(@active,0))= 1)
					BEGIN
						SET @linestatus='Started'
						SET @prevLineStatus='Stopped'
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @linestatus='Stopped'
						SET @prevLineStatus='Started'
					END
				

					SET @newval =  ' Status: ' + @linestatus
					SET @oldVal =  ' Status: ' + @prevLineStatus
			--------automation

					EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
					,@logged_at
					,@user_name
					,@change_type
					,@table_name
					,@row_id
					,@column_name
					,@oldVal
					,@newval
					,@audit_comments
					,@delete_detail;
			---automation
				UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
				SET origin = @strFunctionName
				WHERE log_id = @log_id;
				SET @newval = 'Line: ' + @newlineEntId + ' WO: ' + @wo_id + ' Item: ' + @item + ' Status: ' + @linestatus + ' Mode: AUTOMATED'
				SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Updated Values: ' + @newval + ''
			---automation
				SET @strActivityMsg = 'Updated'

				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
					log_id
					,keyField1
					,keyField2
					,keyField3
					,keyField4
					,module_id
					,function_id
					,spare1
					,spare2
					,spare3
					,spare4
					,spare5
					,spare6
					,audit_category
					,activity
					,comments
					,created_at_utc
					,created_at_local
					,created_by
					)
				VALUES (
					@log_id
					,@newlineEntId
					,@wo_id
					,@item
					,@linestatus
					,@strModuleName
					,@strFunctionName
					,@keyField1
					,@keyField2
					,@keyField3
					,@keyField4
					,@keyField5
					,@keyField6
					,@audit_category
					,@strActivityMsg
					,@strCommentMsg
					,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
					,@logged_at
					,@user_name
					);
		END
		if( @consMode='MANUAL')
		BEGIN
					
					set @column_name ='[Cons_Qty]'
					

					SET @newval =  ' Quantity: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@qty)
				
		

					EXEC [dbo].[sp_i_audit_trail] @log_id OUTPUT
					,@logged_at
					,@user_name
					,@change_type
					,@table_name
					,@row_id
					,@column_name
					,@oldVal
					,@newval
					,@audit_comments
					,@delete_detail;
			
				UPDATE [dbo].[audit_trail]
				SET origin = @strFunctionName
				WHERE log_id = @log_id;


				SET @newval = 'Line: ' + @newlineEntId + ' WO: ' + @wo_id + ' Item: ' + @item + ' Quantity: ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@qty) + ' Mode: MANUAL'
				SELECT @strCommentMsg = 'Updated Values: ' + @newval + ''
			---automation
				SET @strActivityMsg = 'Insert'

				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_audit_trail_ext] (
					log_id
					,keyField1
					,keyField2
					,keyField3
					,keyField4
					,module_id
					,function_id
					,spare1
					,spare2
					,spare3
					,spare4
					,spare5
					,spare6
					,audit_category
					,activity
					,comments
					,created_at_utc
					,created_at_local
					,created_by
					)
				VALUES (
					@log_id
					,@newlineEntId
					,@wo_id
					,@item
					,@linestatus
					,@strModuleName
					,@strFunctionName
					,@keyField1
					,@keyField2
					,@keyField3
					,@keyField4
					,@keyField5
					,@keyField6
					,@audit_category
					,@strActivityMsg
					,@strCommentMsg
					,ISNULL(@audit_utc, GETUTCDATE())
					,@logged_at

		END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Std_OES_GetEntSpecs]
(@oper_id		NVARCHAR(40)
,@ent_id		INT
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Std_OES_GetEntSpecs
-- Description	      -	Given an oper_i and ent_id, this method lists all the available entity specs
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      -	11/08/2005
-- Version	      - 3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver      Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 12/19/2017	  Surya			6.0	     US:956690 As Peter I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/12/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @spec_ver_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@bom_ver_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN

	SELECT @spec_ver_id = ver_id FROM std_oper_spec_ver WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id AND preferred_ver = 1

	SELECT std_oper_ent_spec.oper_id
		,std_oper_ent_spec.step_no
		,std_oper_ent_spec.ent_id
		,std_oper_ent_spec.ver_id
		,std_oper_ent_spec.spec_id
		,std_oper_ent_spec.spec_value
		,std_oper_ent_spec.assoc_file
		,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(std_oper_ent_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
		,std_oper_ent_spec.comments
		,std_oper_ent_spec.min_value
		,std_oper_ent_spec.max_value
		,std_oper_ent_spec.access_level
		,spec.grp_id
        ,spec.spec_desc
		,spec.units
	FROM std_oper_ent_spec std_oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON spec.spec_id = std_oper_ent_spec.spec_id
	WHERE oper_id = @oper_id
	  AND ent_id = @ent_id
	  AND ver_id = @spec_ver_id
END
