		cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

	 DECLARE @temp_99 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        --cons_qty_01 float,
		cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

    DECLARE @temp_02 TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        --cons_qty_01 float,
		cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

    DECLARE @cons_to_erp TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        --cons_qty_01 float,
		cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT
    );

	DECLARE @cons_to_erp2f TABLE 
    (
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
        wo_id nvarchar(40),
        oper_id nvarchar(40),
        seq_no INT,
        item_id nvarchar(40),
        lot_no nvarchar(40),
        sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        fg_sublot_no nvarchar(40),
        qty_cons float,
        qty_cons_erp float,
        --cons_qty_01 float,
		cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
        wip_ratio float,
        item_class nvarchar(40),
		spare1 nvarchar(40),
        row_id INT,
		adjusted_diff  DECIMAL(10, 3), -- taking the final upto 3 decimal point
		adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01  DECIMAL(10, 3)
    );

	DECLARE @cons_to_erp2f_adjusted TABLE 
		(
        id INT IDENTITY (1, 1) NOT NULL,
		row_id INT,
		cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
		total_sum DECIMAL(10, 4),
		rounded_cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
		adjusted_diff  DECIMAL(10, 3), -- taking the final upto 3 decimal point
		adjusted_val DECIMAL(10, 3),
		adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01  DECIMAL(10, 3)
		);

    -- Declare variables
    DECLARE 
        @total_qty_cons_00 float,
        @total_qty_prod_00 float,
        @ratio_00 float,
        @id_min INT,
        @id_max INT,
        --@cons_qty_01 float,
		@cons_qty_01 DECIMAL(10, 4),
        @item_01_class_id nvarchar(40);

    DECLARE 
        @total_wip_cons_01 float,
        @total_wip_prod_01 float,
        @ratio_01 float,
        @id_min1 INT,
        @id_max1 INT,
        @item_wip nvarchar(40),
        @sublot_wip nvarchar(40),
        @doRun int = 1,
        @wip_total float,
        @wip_ratio float,
        @wip_qty float,
		@id_min9 INT,
        @id_max9 INT,
		@total_rpt_qty float

    -- Step 1: Fetch all consumed records from Loadout
    INSERT INTO @temp_00  
    SELECT TOP 1 wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, lot_no, sublot_no, (qty_cons - qty_cons_erp) as qty_cons, row_id 
    FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) 
    WHERE qty_cons > qty_cons_erp AND oper_id = 'LiqLoad'  
    ORDER BY created_at_local DESC;

	--select * from @temp_00
	
    -- Check if the operation is 'LiqLoad'
    IF ((SELECT TOP 1 oper_id FROM @temp_00) = 'LiqLoad')
    BEGIN
        -- Step 1.1: Calculate total consumption from Loadout
        SELECT @total_qty_cons_00 = SUM(qty_cons) FROM @temp_00;
        
		
        -- Step 2: Fetch total produced qty from Blending for the same sublot
		/*
		 here we need to deduct the reported values

		 qty_prod - qty_prod_erp
		*/

        SELECT @total_qty_prod_00 = SUM(qty_prod- isnull(qty_prod_erp,0)) FROM item_prod WITH (NOLOCK) 
        WHERE sublot_no IN (SELECT sublot_no FROM @temp_00 GROUP BY sublot_no) AND oper_id = 'LiqBlend';
        
		
        -- Step 3: Calculate the ratio
        SELECT @ratio_00 = case when  ROUND((@total_qty_cons_00 / @total_qty_prod_00) * 100, 8) >100 then 100 else  ROUND((@total_qty_cons_00 / @total_qty_prod_00) * 100, 8) end;

        -- Step 4: Fetch all consumption from Blending with matching fg_sublot_no
        INSERT @temp_01
        SELECT   wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_cons.item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, NULL, @ratio_00, item.item_class_id,item_cons.spare1, item_cons.row_id 
        FROM item_cons WITH (NOLOCK) 
        INNER JOIN item ON item_cons.item_id = item.item_id
        WHERE fg_sublot_no IN (SELECT sublot_no FROM @temp_00 GROUP BY sublot_no) AND oper_id = 'LiqBlend'
		and (item_cons.qty_cons - (item_cons.qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(item_cons.spare1, '0') AS float)))>0.001
		--and item_cons.row_id in (396) -- 393, 394, 395, 396


		 -- Update consumption quantities in @temp_01 based on the ratio
        SELECT @id_min = MIN(id), @id_max = MAX(id) FROM @temp_01;
        WHILE (@id_min <= @id_max)
        BEGIN
            --SELECT @cons_qty_01 = ROUND((qty_cons * @ratio_00) / 100, 8) FROM @temp_01 WHERE id = @id_min;
            SELECT @cons_qty_01 = case when (ROUND((qty_cons * @ratio_00) / 100, 8) +(qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float)))>qty_cons 
								 then 
									(qty_cons - (qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float)))
								 else
									ROUND((qty_cons * @ratio_00) / 100, 8)				
								end 
			FROM @temp_01 WHERE id = @id_min;


            UPDATE @temp_01 SET cons_qty_01 = @cons_qty_01 WHERE id = @id_min;
            SET @id_min = @id_min + 1;
        END

		--select * from @temp_01

		INSERT INTO @cons_to_erp2f
            SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id,NULL,NULL
            FROM @temp_01  t1
            WHERE item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE'

		INSERT @temp_99 select  wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
						from  @temp_01 WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE'
		--process every row in the of @temp_99
		

		--select * from @cons_to_erp2f
		--select * from @temp_99

		 SELECT @id_min9 = MIN(id), @id_max9 = MAX(id) FROM @temp_99; -- 
		
		 WHILE (@id_min9 <= @id_max9)  -- it will run for first occurrence of intermediate material
					BEGIN
						  print @id_min9

						 

					DELETE FROM @temp_01;

					INSERT  @temp_01
					SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
					FROM @temp_99 WHERE id = @id_min9;


					WHILE (@doRun = 1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @temp_01 WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE'))
					BEGIN
						--PRINT @doRun;
						SET @doRun = @doRun + 1; 

						-- Insert records into @temp_02 for INTERMEDIATE items
						DELETE FROM @temp_02; -- empty out everything 

						INSERT INTO @temp_02
						SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
						FROM @temp_01 
						WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE';

						--select * from @temp_02
						

						-- Process INTERMEDIATE items
						SELECT @id_min1 = MIN(id), @id_max1 = MAX(id) FROM @temp_02 GROUP BY item_id, sublot_no; --- always run for 1 time
            
						WHILE (@id_min1 <= @id_max1)
						--WHILE (@id_min1 <= 4) -- hardcoded, need to fix this
						BEGIN

							-- Clear @temp_01
							DELETE FROM @temp_01;

							SET @wip_ratio = 0;
							SELECT @wip_qty = cons_qty_01, @sublot_wip = sublot_no FROM @temp_02 WHERE id = @id_min1;
							
							delete FROM @temp_02 WHERE id = @id_min1;
							-- Insert records into @temp_01 for INTERMEDIATE items
							INSERT INTO @temp_01
							SELECT ic.wo_id, ic.oper_id, ic.seq_no, ic.item_id, ic.lot_no, ic.sublot_no, ic.fg_sublot_no, ic.qty_cons, ic.qty_cons_erp
							-- ROUND(((ic.qty_cons - ic.qty_cons_erp) * @ratio_00) / 100, 4) cons_qty_01
							--, (ic.qty_cons - ic.qty_cons_erp - ISNULL(cte1.cons_qty_01, 0)) cons_qty_01 -- check if there already exists in the record for calculation
							, (ic.qty_cons) cons_qty_01 
							, NULL, item.item_class_id,ic.spare1, ic.row_id 
							FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
							INNER JOIN item ON ic.item_id = item.item_id
							LEFT JOIN @cons_to_erp cte1 ON ic.row_id = cte1.row_id
							WHERE ic.oper_id = 'LiqBlend'
							--AND ic.qty_cons > ic.qty_cons_erp
							and (ic.qty_cons - (ic.qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(ic.spare1, '0') AS float)))>0.001
							AND ic.fg_sublot_no = @sublot_wip;

							SELECT @wip_total = SUM(cons_qty_01) FROM @temp_01;
							SET @wip_ratio =  case when ROUND(@wip_qty / @wip_total, 8)>1 then 1 else ROUND(@wip_qty / @wip_total, 8) end ;

							UPDATE @temp_01 SET cons_qty_01 = ROUND(cons_qty_01 * @wip_ratio, 8),wip_ratio = @wip_ratio;

							--UPDATE @temp_01 SET cons_qty_01 = 
							--		case when (ROUND((cons_qty_01 * @wip_ratio) / 100, 8)) +qty_cons>qty_cons 
							--	then 
							--	cons_qty_01
							--	else
							--	ROUND((cons_qty_01 * @wip_ratio) / 100, 8)				
							--end,wip_ratio = @wip_ratio;


							--SELECT * FROM @temp_01;

							 -- update should always come first otherwise new SFG will again add up
							UPDATE @cons_to_erp SET cons_qty_01 = cte1.cons_qty_01 + t1.cons_qty_01
								FROM @cons_to_erp cte1 INNER JOIN @temp_01 t1 ON cte1.row_id = t1.row_id AND t1.item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE';

							 -- Insert records into @cons_to_erp for non-INTERMEDIATE items
							INSERT INTO @cons_to_erp
								SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
								FROM @temp_01  t1
								WHERE item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE'
								AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @cons_to_erp cte2 WHERE cte2.row_id = t1.row_id);

								--delete sfg from temp01
								DELETE FROM @temp_01 WHERE item_class <> 'INTERMEDIATE';

								INSERT INTO @temp_02
								SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id 
								FROM @temp_01 
								WHERE item_class = 'INTERMEDIATE';

								--select * from @temp_02
								--select * from @cons_to_erp

								SELECT  @id_max1 = MAX(id) FROM @temp_02 GROUP BY item_id, sublot_no;
								print @id_min1

							SET @id_min1 = @id_min1 + 1;

						END
					END

					---here you will get all the sfg material 

						--select * from @cons_to_erp						
						insert @cons_to_erp2f	select wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, item_id, lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no, qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, cons_qty_01, wip_ratio, item_class,spare1, row_id , NULL,NULL
												from @cons_to_erp;
		
						delete from @cons_to_erp;

						SET @id_min9 = @id_min9 + 1;

					END -- end loop of @temp99

			
			select @total_qty_cons_00;
			-- this is report qty
			--select @total_rpt_qty = sum(cons_qty_01) from @cons_to_erp2f;

			--SELECT @total_rpt_qty;

				
				-- rounding adjustment->

					WITH RoundedValues AS (
						SELECT
							row_id,
							cons_qty_01,
							ROUND(cons_qty_01, 3) AS rounded_cons_qty_01
						FROM
							@cons_to_erp2f
					),
					TotalSum AS (
						SELECT
							SUM(rounded_cons_qty_01) AS total_sum
						FROM
							RoundedValues
					),
					AdjustedValues As(
					SELECT
						row_id,
						cons_qty_01,
						rounded_cons_qty_01,
						(SELECT total_sum FROM TotalSum ) as total_sum,
						ROUND(@total_qty_cons_00 - (SELECT total_sum FROM TotalSum ),3) as diff_val
					FROM
						RoundedValues )
						
						insert into @cons_to_erp2f_adjusted  --- inserted into new table
						select  row_id,
						cons_qty_01,
						rounded_cons_qty_01,
						total_sum,
						diff_val,
						CASE WHEN row_id = (SELECT MAX(row_id) FROM RoundedValues) AND ABS(diff_val)>0  THEN diff_val  ELSE 0 END AS adjusted_val,
						 ROUND(
							rounded_cons_qty_01 + 
							CASE WHEN row_id = (SELECT MAX(row_id) FROM RoundedValues) AND abs(diff_val)>0  THEN diff_val  ELSE 0 END,
							3
						) AS adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01
						from AdjustedValues
						ORDER BY ROW_ID ASC;

					select * from @cons_to_erp2f 
					select * from @cons_to_erp2f_adjusted



        -- Uncomment the following lines to update item_cons table in MESDB

		
         UPDATE item_cons
         --SET spare1 = CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float) + s.cons_qty_01    
         --, qty_cons_erp = ic.qty_cons_erp + CAST(ISNULL(ic.spare1, '0') AS float) + s.cons_qty_01

		 --SET spare1 = round(CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS float) + s.adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01,3)

		 SET spare1 = CAST(ISNULL(spare1, '0') AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) + s.adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01
		 FROM item_cons ic
         INNER JOIN (select row_id, sum(adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01) adjusted_rounded_cons_qty_01 from @cons_to_erp2f_adjusted group by row_id) s ON ic.row_id = s.row_id;

         UPDATE item_cons 
		 
		 --SET qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp + @total_rpt_qty

		 SET qty_cons_erp =  CAST(ISNULL(qty_cons_erp, '0') AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) + CAST(ISNULL(@total_qty_cons_00, '0') AS DECIMAL(10, 3)) 
		 FROM item_cons ic INNER JOIN @temp_00 t0 ON ic.row_id = t0.row_id;
		 
		 
		-- update item_cons set spare1=0 where oper_id in( 'LiqBlend')

    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_MDRT_LINE_OEE]
-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ent_id INT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @OEE FLOAT
	DECLARE @Avaliability FLOAT = 0.85
	DECLARE @Performance FLOAT = 0.85
	DECLARE @Quality FLOAT = 0.85

	-- Add OEE calculation here
	SET @OEE = @Avaliability * @Performance * @Quality;

	SELECT
		@OEE * 100 AS          'OEE'

	  , @Avaliability * 100 AS 'avaliability'
	  , @Quality * 100 AS      'quality';
END

AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_bom_step_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on job_bom_step table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2018 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
--02/28/2018    Varun		6.0	    Merge CR L00148196(HF L00147697) -  Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item of
--													job_bom_step table. Added nolock hint to job_bom and item tables.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE job_bom_step SET job_bom_step.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item
		,job_bom_step.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_bom_step.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.wo_id = jb.wo_id AND i.oper_id = jb.oper_id AND i.seq_no = jb.seq_no AND i.bom_pos = jb.bom_pos
	INNER JOIN item it WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE job_bom_step.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_bom_step.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_bom_step.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_bom_step.bom_pos = i.bom_pos AND job_bom_step.step_no = i.step_no
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Oee_Exec]
  (@ent_id int
  ,@get_current_oee LOGICAL = 1)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By Version Changes
-- 01/21/2008       Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
-- 05/17/2013	    Raghu		4.6	    UserStory:178630 - configure normalized production rates
-- 02/22/2016		RaghuG		5.2	    UserStory: 592936 - CR L00139963 - There is a performance issue with web API calls when there is load on the system from UCOs and OCOs.
-- 10/11/2016	    Raghu		5.3	    UserStory/Requirement: 613919, 613918 - Modify SPs to work with new schema
-- 06/07/2017	    Raghu		6.1	    UserStory: 816528 - As Lenka, I want statistics to be optionally calculated and defaulted to TRUE when sp_SA_Oee_Exec, sp_S_Oee_Exec, sp_SA_Util_Exec, and sp_S_Util_Exec is called
-- 03/05/2018	    Surya		6.1     US#978286 - As SE, I want to fix CR L00146485 so that the MES Web portal entity monitor page doesn't break when shown with an entity that cannot capture OEE data
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
DECLARE @job_ent_id		INT32
	,@util_ent_id		INT32
	,@basis			INT32
	,@current_perf	TFLOAT = NULL
	,@current_qual	TFLOAT = NULL
	,@current_oee	TFLOAT = NULL

	--Default to 1, oee will be calculated by default.
	SET @get_current_oee = COALESCE(@get_current_oee, 1)

	IF (@get_current_oee = 1) BEGIN--If the request is to return the KPI values, call the SP to return the KPI values
		SELECT @job_ent_id = oee.job_ent_id, @util_ent_id = oee.util_ent_id, @basis = oee.basis
		FROM oee_exec oee WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE oee.ent_id = @ent_id


        IF NOT (@job_ent_ID IS NULL OR @util_ent_id IS NULL) -- Check whether the supplied entity is capable of tracking OEE
        -- Call the SP to return the KPI values
		EXEC sp_SA_OEE_Exec_GetCurrentKPIs @ent_id=@ent_id, @job_ent_id=@job_ent_id, @util_ent_id=@util_ent_id, @basis=@basis
			, @quality=@current_qual OUTPUT, @performance=@current_perf OUTPUT, @oee=@current_oee OUTPUT
	END

	SELECT oee_exec.ent_id
	  ,oee_exec.job_ent_id
	  ,oee_exec.util_ent_id
	  ,oee_exec.target_perf
	  ,@current_perf AS current_perf
	  ,oee_exec.target_qual
	  ,@current_qual AS current_qual
	  ,oee_exec.def_prod_rate
	  ,oee_exec.prod_uom
	  ,oee_exec.batch_size
	  ,oee_exec.std_item_id
	  ,oee_exec.target_oee
	  ,@current_oee AS current_oee
	  ,oee_exec.basis
	  ,oee_exec.last_edit_comment
	  ,oee_exec.last_edit_by
	  ,oee_exec.last_edit_at
	FROM oee_exec oee_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE (oee_exec.ent_id = @ent_id)
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_attr_aft_del] ON [dbo].[attr]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_attr_aft_del
-- Description        -  This trigger removes all the dynamic attribute columns from the queue_item_attr table.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 11/11/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--12/05/2005	Raghu		3.1.5	The second condition visible_in_queue ought to be visible_in_inv.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@attr_id		INT32
		,@attr_grp		INT32
		,@visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@visible_in_inv		LOGICAL
		,@ent_id		STRING80
		,@ent_desc		STRING80
		,@err_desc		STRING1700

	DECLARE attr_del_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT attr_id, attr_grp, visible_in_queue, visible_in_inv FROM deleted

	OPEN attr_del_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM attr_del_cursor INTO @attr_id, @attr_grp, @visible_in_queue, @visible_in_inv
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@visible_in_queue = 1) BEGIN
			--Make sure this attribute is NOT selected as the SORT order column in the queue window.
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_sched_exec
				WHERE sort_order LIKE '%=attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '%') BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('This attribute cannot be deleted, because this attribute is used as a sort column for the job queue.', 16, 1)
				SELECT TOP 1 @ent_id = ent_id FROM job_sched_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE sort_order LIKE '%=attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '%'
				SELECT @ent_desc = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
				SET @err_desc = 'This attribute cannot be deleted, because the entity %1 uses this attribute as a sort column in the job queue window.{4765},' + @ent_desc
				RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1)
				RETURN
			END
			IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
				EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id, 1
			ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 5)	-- Jobs
				EXEC sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr NULL, NULL, NULL, @attr_id, 1
		END
		--EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id, 1

		IF (@visible_in_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
				EXEC sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id, 1
			ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 3)	--Lots
				EXEC sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr NULL, NULL, @attr_id, 1

(@ent_id		int32
,@sample_name		nvarchar(80) = NULL
,@wo_id			nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@oper_id		nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@seq_no		int = NULL
,@context_ent_id	int32 = NULL
,@item_id		nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@item_category_id	int32 = NULL
,@process_id		nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@context_oper_id	nvarchar(40) = NULL
,@freq_id		int32 = NULL
,@plan_id      int32 = NULL
,@requested_time_local  datetime
,@requested_time_tz INT32 = NULL
,@expiry_time_local	datetime = NULL
,@expiry_time_tz INT32 = NULL
,@warning_time_local	datetime = NULL
,@warning_time_tz INT32 = NULL
,@spare1		nvarchar(80) = NULL
,@spare2		nvarchar(80) = NULL
,@spare3		nvarchar(80) = NULL
,@spare4		nvarchar(80) = NULL
,@last_edit_comment nvarchar(254)  = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value	int32 = NULL
,@last_edit_at		tdatetime OUT
,@sample_id		INT OUT
)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - sp_I_Sample_To_Go
-- Description        - Insert a row into the table
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created       - 10/17/2002
-- Version            - 1.6.0.8
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
-- Notes                    -
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @requested_time_utc	DATETIME
	,@expiry_time_utc	DATETIME
	,@warning_time_utc	DATETIME
	,@tz_temp		INT32
	,@last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)

BEGIN

	SET @requested_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@requested_time_tz)
	SET @requested_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@requested_time_local, @requested_time_tz)

	SET @expiry_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@expiry_time_tz)
	SET @expiry_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@expiry_time_local, @expiry_time_tz)

	SET @warning_time_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@warning_time_tz)
	SET @warning_time_local = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@warning_time_local, @warning_time_tz)

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	SET @tz_temp = -@requested_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @requested_time_local, @tz_temp, @requested_time_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@expiry_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @expiry_time_local, @tz_temp, @expiry_time_utc OUTPUT

	SET @tz_temp = -@warning_time_tz
	EXEC sp_S_GetUtcDate @warning_time_local, @tz_temp, @warning_time_utc OUTPUT

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

   INSERT INTO sample_to_go (ent_id, sample_name, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, context_ent_id, item_id, item_category_id,
		process_id, context_oper_id, freq_id, plan_id, requested_time_utc, requested_time_local,
		expiry_time_utc, expiry_time_local, warning_time_utc, warning_time_local,
		spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	VALUES (@ent_id, @sample_name, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, @context_ent_id, @item_id, @item_category_id,
		@process_id, @context_oper_id, @freq_id, @plan_id, @requested_time_utc, @requested_time_local,
		@expiry_time_utc, @expiry_time_local, @warning_time_utc, @warning_time_local,
		@spare1, @spare2, @spare3, @spare4, @last_edit_comment, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at)

	SET @sample_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

END

-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_SA_Std_OES_GetSpecs

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Attr]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40),
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40),
 @attr_id  int = NULL,
 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(1700),
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @mod_id  varchar(30)
 )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 09/19/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 04/13/2006	  Raghu		    3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 7

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT oper_attr.process_id
            ,oper_attr.oper_id
            ,oper_attr.attr_id
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,oper_attr.attr_value
            ,oper_attr.notes
            ,oper_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_attr.last_edit_by
            ,oper_attr.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM oper_attr oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
WHERE ((oper_attr.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_attr.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (oper_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_attr.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
ORDER BY attr.attr_desc
END

-- Version			Author :  			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)    Change description  
-- 0.01.00 TB Toshali/Ajeet/Chinmay      2023-01-10            Initial version.  
-- ==========================================================================================================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_get_Reclass_Dropdown]
(  
     @item_id   nvarchar(50)
)   
AS BEGIN
    declare @item_att_id int, @item_attr_value nvarchar(40), @attr_id int, @class_attr_id int    
	
	select @attr_id=attr_id 
    from attr with(nolock)
    where attr_desc='ItemGroup'     

	select @class_attr_id=attr_id 
    from attr with(nolock)
    where attr_desc='Classification'    

	select distinct @item_att_id = attr_id, @item_attr_value= attr_value 
    from item_attr with(nolock)
    where item_id =@item_id and attr_id=@attr_id


    ;with cte as(
    select distinct ia.item_id as item_id
    , i.item_desc as item_description
    from item_attr  ia with(nolock)
    inner join item i with(nolock) on ia.item_id=i.item_id    
    inner join attr a with(nolock) on a.attr_id=ia.attr_id and a.attr_desc='ItemGroup' 
    where  (ia.attr_id=@item_att_id and ia.attr_value=@item_attr_value ) OR ia.attr_id > isnull(@item_att_id,0)
    )


    select item_id, item_description from cte
    except

    select c.item_id, c.item_description  from cte c
    inner join item_attr(nolock) ia on c.item_id=ia.item_id

    where ia.attr_id =@class_attr_id and ia.attr_value is not null 

END

--										table when linking an item to the process, when inserting an item into the BOM_Item_Oper_Link
--										table, or when setting the produced item for an operation.  This refactoring addressed
--										an issue where an item being linked to a process was not taking into account that an
--										item already linked to the process may share BOM components with the new item.  It was
--										also not taking into account the fact that item may have multiple versions.
-- 12/18/2020		Anwar		6.2		HF IMS_CR-690874:The stored procedure "sp_I_Item_Process_Link" takes a very long time to execute and eventually times out.
--										As part of the fix we replaced a physical table with a temporary table to imrove the performance.
-- 11/19/2021		Abhay P		6.2		HF-IMS_1626643 : "Execution Timeout Expired" error while setting as produced item from configure operation output option for an operation. 
-- 02/08/2022		Anwar P		6.2		HF-IMS_1698736 : As part of the fix, To restrict the deletion of operation applied filtering with the process_id while preparing the 
--										list of operations to remove (added extra condition process_id).
-- 04/26/2022		JAE			6.2		HF IMS-1860171: Error when changing Produced Item.  Updated temp table definition for oper_id column
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @child_level		INT,
  @next_oper_id		STRING40,
  @bills_produced	INT,
  @items_produced	INT,
  @qty_per_parent_item	FLOAT,
  @reqd_start_pct	FLOAT,
  @V_Item0              STRING40,
  @V_Id0                STRING40,
  @V_Ver0               STRING40,
  @V_Status             CHAR(1),
  @V_Error              NVARCHAR(2000),
  @V_Item               STRING40,
  @V_Ver                STRING40,
  @V_Count              INT,
  @V_Next_Item          STRING40,
  @V_Next_Ver           STRING40,
  @V_Next_Oper          STRING40,
  @V_Oper               STRING40,
  @last_edit_by		STRING40,
  @last_edit_at		DATETIME

BEGIN
	--if it is the final operation, donot allow modification
	IF @old_item_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND final_oper = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @V_Error = N'Item being produced at the final operation can not be changed.{4104}'
		RAISERROR( @V_Error, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- If we are not replacing an existing item, then we must be adding a new item to the process, so only allow the
	-- item if it is procuced by the process.
	IF @old_item_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_process_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND item_id = @new_item_id)
	BEGIN
		SET @V_Error = N'Specified item is not attached to this process.{4631}'
		RAISERROR( @V_Error, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

	-- If we are not replacing an existing item, then we must be adding a new item to the process, so only allow the
	-- final operation to be set.
	IF @old_item_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM oper WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id and final_oper = 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @V_Error = N'A new item can only be added to the final operation in the process{???}'
		RAISERROR( @V_Error, 16, 1)
		RETURN -1
	END

    EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
    SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	DECLARE @oper_route TABLE (oper_id NVARCHAR(40), oper_order INT)

	SELECT @reqd_start_pct = CAST(attr_value AS FLOAT) / 100.0 FROM system_attr WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 203

	-- Build the route by first adding the supplied operation with the order set to zero
	INSERT INTO @oper_route VALUES (@oper_id, 0)

	-- Next insert all the operations that preceed the supplied route	
	DECLARE @distinct_oper_route TABLE (input_oper_id nvarchar(40), oper_id nvarchar(40))
	INSERT INTO @distinct_oper_route
	SELECT DISTINCT input_oper_id, oper_id FROM oper_ent_route where process_id = @process_id
	;WITH upstream_oper_route
	AS (
	SELECT @process_id as process_id, input_oper_id, -1 AS oper_order 
	FROM @distinct_oper_route WHERE oper_id = @oper_id

	UNION ALL
	
	SELECT @process_id as process_id, oer.input_oper_id AS oper_id, opr.oper_order -1 as child_level 
	FROM @distinct_oper_route oer
	JOIN upstream_oper_route opr ON opr.input_oper_id = oer.oper_id
	)
	INSERT INTO @oper_route
	SELECT input_oper_id, oper_order
	FROM upstream_oper_route

	-- Next insert all the operations that follow the supplied route
	DECLARE @oper_ent_route_details TABLE (oper_id nvarchar(40), input_oper_id nvarchar(40))
	INSERT INTO @oper_ent_route_details
	SELECT DISTINCT  oper_id,input_oper_id FROM oper_ent_route WITH (NOLOCK) where process_id = @process_id
	;WITH downstream_oper_route
	AS (
		SELECT @process_id as process_id, oper_id, 1 AS oper_order
		FROM @oper_ent_route_details
		WHERE input_oper_id = @oper_id

		UNION ALL

		SELECT @process_id as process_id, oer.oper_id AS oper_id, opr.oper_order + 1 as child_level 
		FROM @oper_ent_route_details oer
		JOIN downstream_oper_route opr ON  opr.oper_id = oer.input_oper_id
	)
	INSERT INTO @oper_route
	SELECT oper_id, oper_order
	FROM downstream_oper_route

	-- Figure out the BOM tree for the new item
	DECLARE @new_bom_tree TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), component BIT)
	;WITH
	bom_components
	AS (
		SELECT item_id
		FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE parent_item_id = @new_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0

		UNION ALL

		SELECT bi.item_id
		FROM bom_item bi WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN bom_components bc ON bi.parent_item_id = bc.item_id AND bom_pos <> 0
	)
	INSERT INTO @new_bom_tree
	SELECT item_id, null, 1
	FROM bom_components

	;WITH
	parent_items
	AS (
		SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id 
		FROM bom_item WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE item_id = @new_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0

		UNION ALL

		SELECT bi.parent_item_id, bi.ver_id
		FROM bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN parent_items pi ON bi.item_id = pi.parent_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0
	)
	INSERT INTO @new_bom_tree
	SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id, 0
	FROM parent_items

	-- Get opeations that should be removed from consideration
	DECLARE @ops_to_remove TABLE (oper_id NVARCHAR(40))

	-- Get any operation already making the specfied new item
	INSERT INTO @ops_to_remove
	SELECT oper_id
	FROM bom_item_oper_link WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE parent_item_id = @new_item_id AND ver_id = @new_ver_id AND process_id = @process_id  

	-- Get any downstream operations that are producing a component of the supplied new item that is not the supplied old item
	INSERT INTO @ops_to_remove
	SELECT biol.oper_id FROM @oper_route opr
	JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol WITH (NOLOCK) ON opr.oper_id = biol.oper_id
	JOIN @new_bom_tree bt ON biol.parent_item_id = bt.item_id
	WHERE oper_order < 0 AND bt.component = 1 AND process_id = @process_id

	-- Get any upstream operations that are producing a item for which the supplied new item is a component and is not the old item
	DECLARE @upstream_ops_to_remove TABLE (oper_id NVARCHAR(40))
	INSERT INTO @ops_to_remove
	SELECT biol.oper_id FROM @oper_route opr
	JOIN bom_item_oper_link biol WITH (NOLOCK) ON opr.oper_id = biol.oper_id
	JOIN @new_bom_tree bt ON biol.parent_item_id = bt.item_id
	WHERE oper_order > 0 AND bt.component = 0 AND process_id = @process_id

	-- Determine all the items that will need to be inserted into the bom_item_oper_link table
	DECLARE @items_to_insert TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40))
	INSERT INTO @items_to_insert
	SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id
	FROM bom_item WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE parent_item_id = @new_item_id AND bom_pos = 0 AND (ver_id = @new_ver_id OR @new_ver_id IS NULL)  

	-- If we are replacing a component that is shared by all top-level items with a component that is not shared by all top-level items
	-- then we need to determine what items should be produced at the operations at which the new item will be produced for the top-level
	-- items that do not contain the new item in their BOM tree.
	IF @old_item_id IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		-- Figure out what consumes the old item
		DECLARE @old_bom_tree TABLE (item_id NVARCHAR(40), ver_id NVARCHAR(40), component BIT)
		;WITH
		old_parent_items
		AS (
			SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id 
			FROM bom_item WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE item_id = @old_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0

			UNION ALL

			SELECT bi.parent_item_id, bi.ver_id
			FROM bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN old_parent_items opi ON bi.item_id = opi.parent_item_id AND bom_pos <> 0
		)
		INSERT INTO @old_bom_tree
		SELECT parent_item_id, ver_id, 0
		FROM old_parent_items

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1
				  FROM item_process_link ipl WITH (NOLOCK)
				  LEFT JOIN @new_bom_tree bt ON ipl.item_id = bt.item_id
				  LEFT JOIN @old_bom_tree obt ON ipl.item_id = obt.item_id
				  WHERE process_id = @process_id AND bt.item_id IS NULL AND obt.item_id IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			--SELECT MAX(oper_order) + 1 FROM @oper_route
			--SELECT oper_id FROM @oper_route WHERE oper_order = (SELECT MAX(oper_order) + 1 FROM @oper_route WHERE oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @ops_to_remove))
			INSERT INTO @items_to_insert
			SELECT DISTINCT biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id
			FROM bom_item_oper_link biol WITH (NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN @new_bom_tree bt ON biol.parent_item_id = bt.item_id
				  LEFT JOIN @old_bom_tree obt ON biol.parent_item_id = obt.item_id
			WHERE process_id = @process_id AND
			oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @oper_route WHERE oper_order = (SELECT MAX(oper_order) + 1 FROM @oper_route WHERE oper_id NOT IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @ops_to_remove)))
			AND bt.item_id IS NULL AND obt.item_id IS NOT NULL
			AND biol.parent_item_id <> @new_item_id
		END
	END

	-- Remove the operations that have ben flagged from the temporary oper_route table
	DELETE FROM @oper_route
	WHERE oper_id IN (SELECT oper_id FROM @ops_to_remove)

	-- Remove the BOM_Item_Oper_Link records for the operations in the process that should be replaced by the new item
	-- if we are changing an old item
	IF @old_item_id IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		;WITH
		extra_bom_components
		AS (
			SELECT item_id
			FROM bom_item WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE parent_item_id in (SELECT item_id FROM @items_to_insert WHERE item_id <> @new_item_id) AND bom_pos <> 0

			UNION ALL

			SELECT bi.item_id
			FROM bom_item bi WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN extra_bom_components ebc ON bi.parent_item_id = ebc.item_id AND bom_pos <> 0
		)
		INSERT INTO @new_bom_tree
		SELECT item_id, null, 1
		FROM extra_bom_components

		DELETE biol
		FROM bom_item_oper_link biol WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN @new_bom_tree bt ON biol.parent_item_id = bt.item_id AND biol.ver_id = @old_ver_id
		WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id in (SELECT oper_id FROm @oper_route)
	END

	-- Create the new BOM_Item_Oper_Link records
	INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_link (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, update_inv, backflush, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT iti.item_id, iti.ver_id, 0, @process_id, oper_id, 1, @reqd_start_pct, bi.update_inv, bi.backflush, bi.must_consume_from_inv, bi.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, bi.may_create_new_lots, bi.must_consume_from_wip, bi.must_consume_before_prod, bi.constant_qty, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
	FROM @oper_route opr
	CROSS JOIN
	@items_to_insert iti
	JOIN bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK) ON bi.parent_item_id = iti.item_id AND bi.ver_id = iti.ver_id AND bi.bom_pos = 0

	-- For any item that is only produced in one operation
	-- add the components for that item to the operation
	DELETE iti
	FROM @items_to_insert iti
	JOIN (SELECT biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id, COUNT(*) oper_count
	FROM bom_item_oper_link biol WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN @items_to_insert iti ON biol.parent_item_id = iti.item_id AND biol.ver_id = iti.ver_id
	WHERE process_id = @process_id
	GROUP BY biol.parent_item_id, biol.ver_id) x ON x.parent_item_id = iti.item_id AND x.ver_id = iti.ver_id
	WHERE x.oper_count > 1

	INSERT INTO bom_item_oper_link (parent_item_id, ver_id, bom_pos, process_id, oper_id, qty_per_parent_item, reqd_start_pct, update_inv, backflush, must_consume_from_inv, may_choose_alt_inv_loc, may_create_new_lots, must_consume_from_wip, must_consume_before_prod, constant_qty, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
	SELECT iti.item_id, iti.ver_id, bom_pos, @process_id, @oper_id, bi.qty_per_parent_item, @reqd_start_pct, bi.update_inv, bi.backflush, bi.must_consume_from_inv, bi.may_choose_alt_inv_loc, bi.may_create_new_lots, bi.must_consume_from_wip, bi.must_consume_before_prod, bi.constant_qty, @last_edit_by, @last_edit_at
    FROM @items_to_insert iti
	JOIN bom_item bi WITH (NOLOCK) ON iti.item_id = bi.parent_item_id AND iti.ver_id = bi.ver_id
	WHERE bom_pos <> 0
		
	-- Delete all the records of the formerly-selected version
	DELETE FROM bom_item_oper_link
	WHERE parent_item_id = @old_item_id AND
	  ver_id = @old_ver_id AND
	  process_id = @process_id AND
	  oper_id = @oper_id

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_S_EI_Item_UOM_CONV
-- Description:  Selects the item
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-14      Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Lk          2024-05-10      Updated logic for WIP UOM Conv.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_EI_MM_UOM_CONV] (@item_id     NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @plant_code  NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @item_status NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @from_uom    NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @to_uom      NVARCHAR(40),
                                               @numerator   FLOAT,
                                               @denominator FLOAT)
AS
  BEGIN
      DECLARE @wip_item_id nvarchar(50)=null
	  SELECT @wip_item_id=i.item_id
			from item i with(nolock)
			inner join item_attr ia with(nolock)
			on i.item_id=ia.item_id 
			WHERE i.item_id=@item_id
			AND ia.attr_value like '%LIQUOR%'			
			AND ia.attr_id in(select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='ItemGroup')
			IF @wip_item_id is not null
			BEGIN
					SELECT  @wip_item_id=REPLACE(@wip_item_id,'10000','50000')
					EXEC SP_U_EI_MM_UOM_CONV @wip_item_id,@plant_code,@item_status,@from_uom,@to_uom,@numerator,@denominator
			END

      SELECT item_id
      FROM   item WITH (nolock)
      WHERE  item_id = @item_id

  END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_u_ei_hu_stock_receipt_child
-- Description:  Updates the inventory for the given Main HU and Sub HU combination
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-12-07		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Karthik		2023-07-13			Added Blend ratio. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-08-08			Handled storage locations for Melting. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ei_hu_stock_receipt_child] @order_number varchar(100),@qty float,@uom varchar(10),
@pallet_id varchar(100),@sender_plant varchar(50),@receiving_plant varchar(50),@receiving_storage_locn varchar(50),
@sender_storage_locn varchar(50),@nestdChild_HU varchar(50),@material_no_child_HU varchar(50),@batch_no_child_HU varchar(50),
@qty_child_HU varchar(50),@usage_decsn_child_HU varchar(10),@blend_ratio VARCHAR(100)
as
begin
	Declare
	@ent_id int , -- receiving storage location
	@attr_id int,
	@frm_ent_id int,	--sender storage location
	@cur_ent_id int,
	@item_id nvarchar(40),
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) , --- Batch_no_child Hu
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40) , --- generated using new sp
	@grade_cd int , --- item_grade state code 0
	@status_cd int , --- item_state normal state code
	@cur_status_cd int,
	@qty_left float ,@qty_left_erp float ,-- qty_left
	@uom_id int,@date_in_local datetime,@date_out_local datetime,@expiry_date datetime,	@last_edit_at datetime,	@row_id int,
	@rc int,@item_group varchar(100)

	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION

	SET @lot_no = @batch_no_child_HU
	SET @item_id = @material_no_child_HU
	SET @qty_left = @qty_child_HU
	SET @qty_left_erp = @qty_child_HU
	SET @date_in_local = GETDATE()
	SET @date_out_local = GETDATE()
	SET @last_edit_at = GETDATE()


	--SELECT @attr_id = attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation'
	--SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @receiving_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id
	--SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @sender_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id

	--(KN 8Aug23 Made the below changes to handle HU stock receipt for Melting)
	--Start of change

	IF @receiving_storage_locn <> 'MELT'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @receiving_storage_locn
		SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @sender_storage_locn
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		SELECT @item_group = attr_value from item_attr with (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
		IF @item_group like '%Liquor%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorMelting_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Butter%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'ButterMelting_A'

	END

	--End of change


	SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd from item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) where item_grade_desc = 'ACCEPTABLE'
	IF LEN(@usage_decsn_child_HU) > 0 
		SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted' -- Status cd 3
	ELSE
		SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Restricted'	--- Status cd 5

	SELECT @uom_id = uom_id from uom WITH (NOLOCK) where description = @uom
	SELECT @row_id = row_id,@sublot_no = sublot_no,@cur_status_cd = status_cd,@cur_ent_id = ent_id,@last_edit_at = last_edit_at from item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
	where spare2 = @pallet_id and spare3 = @nestdChild_HU
	
	

	IF @cur_ent_id = @ent_id	--Pallet exist in MES, Receiving Storage Location is same as in item_inv, then just update the UD in item_inv
		BEGIN
			PRINT 'Pallet ID exists in same location'
			IF @cur_status_cd <> @status_cd	--Update UD only if it is different
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'UD is different - updating item_inv'

					Exec sp_U_Item_Inv
					@row_id = @row_id,@ent_id= @ent_id,@item_id = @item_id,@lot_no = @batch_no_child_HU,@sublot_no = @sublot_no,
					@grade_cd = @grade_cd,@status_cd = @status_cd,@qty_left = @qty_left,@qty_left_erp = @qty_left,@uom_id = @uom_id,
					@date_in_local = @date_in_local,@date_in_tz = NULL,@date_out_local = @date_out_local,@date_out_tz = NULL,@expiry_date = NULL,
					@wo_id = NULL, @oper_id = NULL,@seq_no = NULL,@spare1 = NULL,@spare2 = @pallet_id,@spare3 = @nestdChild_HU,@spare4 = '',
					@spare5 = '',@spare6 = '',@last_edit_comment ='HU Stock Receipt - (UD Update - Child)',@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at,
					@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@date_in_utc = NULL,@date_out_utc = NULL,@expiry_date_utc = NULL
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'UD is same'
					Update item_inv set last_edit_comment = 'HU Stock Receipt - (UD is same - Child)' where row_id = @row_id
				END
		END
	ELSE						--Pallet exist in MES but Receiving Storage Location is different in item_inv
		BEGIN
			PRINT 'Pallet ID received in different storage location. Moving Inventory'

			Exec sp_U_Item_Inv_Move 
			@from_row_id			= @row_id
			,@from_last_edit_at		= NULL
			,@from_ent_id           = @frm_ent_id
			,@transfer_qty   		= @qty_left
			,@transfer_qty_erp		= @qty_left
			,@in_to_ent_id			= @ent_id
			,@in_to_item_id			= @item_id
			,@in_to_lot_no			= @lot_no
			,@in_to_sublot_no		= @sublot_no
			,@in_to_grade_cd		= @grade_cd
			,@in_to_status_cd		= @status_cd
			,@in_to_uom_id			= @uom_id
			,@in_to_expiry_date		= NULL
			,@in_to_expiry_date_tz	= NULL
			,@in_to_expiry_date_utc		= NULL
			,@in_to_wo_id			= NULL
			,@in_to_oper_id			= NULL
			,@in_to_seq_no			= NULL
			,@in_transfer_option	= NULL
			,@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job	= NULL
			,@in_transfer_comments	= 'HU Stock Receipt (Inventory Transfer - Child)'
			,@in_log_transfer	 = 1
			,@time_zone_bias_value	= NULL

			Update item_inv set last_edit_comment = 'HU Stock Receipt (Inventory Transfer - Child)' where row_id = @row_id
		END
	
	--KN 13Jul23 Added logic to include blend ratio
	
	--IF NOT ISNULL(@blend_ratio,0) = 0 
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @mod_id varchar(30)
		Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio'

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from lot_attr with (nolock) WHERE lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id)
			EXEC sp_I_Lot_Attr @item_id,@lot_no,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id output

			BEGIN
				SELECT @mod_id = CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),mod_id) from lot_attr with (nolock) where lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id

			END	END
	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_attr_aft_ins] ON [dbo].[attr]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_attr_aft_ins
-- Description        -  This trigger removes all the dynamic attribute columns from the queue_item_attr table.
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 11/11/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.1
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--02/16/2006	Raghu		3.1.10	HD# 7489, Selecting visible_in_inv property for an attribute in lots group does not automatically populate inv_lot_attr_table
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@attr_id		INT32
		,@attr_grp		INT32
		,@visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@visible_in_inv		LOGICAL

	DECLARE attr_ins_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT attr_id, attr_grp, visible_in_queue, visible_in_inv FROM inserted

	OPEN attr_ins_cursor
	WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
		FETCH NEXT FROM attr_ins_cursor INTO @attr_id, @attr_grp, @visible_in_queue, @visible_in_inv
		IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
		IF (@visible_in_queue = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
				EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id
			ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 5)	-- Jobs
				EXEC sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr NULL, NULL, NULL, @attr_id
		END

		IF (@visible_in_inv = 1) BEGIN
			IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
				EXEC sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id
			ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 3)	-- Lots
				EXEC sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr NULL, NULL, @attr_id
		END
	END
	CLOSE attr_ins_cursor
	DEALLOCATE attr_ins_cursor
END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Session]
(
	@session_id 			INT32 OUT,
	@client_type 			INT32 ,
	@client_address 		STRING40_NULL ,
	@reqd_events 			STRING2000_NULL,
	@time_zone_bias_value		INT32 = 0,
	@db_version			STRING40 = NULL OUT,
	@sp_version			STRING40 = NULL OUT,
	@def_data_version		STRING40 = NULL OUT
)

AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 11/20/2002		Raghu			1.5.0		Included db_version, mw_db_user, sp_version and def_data_version parameters
--												to return db version info values
-- 06/29/2004		Raghu			2.1.0		Changed GETDATE() TO GMT Date
-- 03/07/2006		Tony  			3.1.11		If client type = FC then set user_id to configured default background user as
--												in sp_I_SessionBG
-- 07/25/2007		AML				3.3.0		DB Changes; Added parameter for std_time flag.  Added tz_bias and std_time values
--												to insert statement.
-- 05/14/2015		KRF				5.02		User story 470542.  Accommodate new structure of db_status table, which now doesn't
--												have sp_version or def_data_version fields.  Return db_version for both of these.
-- 05/14/2015		Malleswara		5.03		User story 594198.  Removing the tz_bias, std_time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
-- Always default session_start and last_heartbeat to Now, user_id to Null at start of session
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE	@last_heartbeat TDATETIME
	,	@user_id 		STRING40

SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

BEGIN
	-- Default to user_id = null for the default case
	SET @user_id = NULL

	--Use the defalut user_id configured in the system_attribute table only if the client type is 39 (FC)
	IF @client_type = 39 BEGIN
		-- Get the User_ID from System_Attr for 199
		SELECT @user_id = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 199

		--Throw an exception to the caller if the user_id in the system_attribute table is null
		IF @user_id IS NULL BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The system attribute table does not have a default user_id.{4814}',16,1)
			RETURN
		END
	END
	IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @last_heartbeat = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @last_heartbeat = GETUTCDATE()

	INSERT INTO sessn (client_type, session_start, last_heartbeat, user_id, client_address, reqd_events)
	VALUES (@client_type, @last_heartbeat, @last_heartbeat, @user_id, @client_address, @reqd_events)

	-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
	-- select @session_id = (select max(session_id) from session)
	SELECT @session_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	-- User story 470542.  Accommodate new structure of db_status table, which now doesn't have sp_version or def_data_version fields.  Return db_version for both of these.
	SELECT @db_version = db_version, @sp_version = db_version, @def_data_version = db_version FROM db_status WITH (NOLOCK)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Std_Oper]
(@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_desc  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @check_inv  bit  ,
 @sched_to_ent_id  int  ,
 @oper_type  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare1  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare2  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare3  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @spare4  nvarchar(80)  ,
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @last_edit_at  datetime )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Std_Oper
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      	Changes
--07/11/2006	Raghu		3.1.19	HD# 7793, Added entity_exists column to the resultset to identify whether there are any entities linked to the standard operation.
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

SELECT std_oper.oper_id
       ,std_oper.oper_desc
       ,std_oper.def_reject_rate
       ,std_oper.check_inv
       ,std_oper.sched_to_ent_id
       ,std_oper.oper_type
       ,std_oper.oper_cost
       ,std_oper.deviation_above
       ,std_oper.deviation_below
       ,std_oper.assoc_file
       ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(std_oper.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
       ,std_oper.notes
        ,COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM std_oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oper_id = std_oper.oper_id), 0) AS entity_exists
       ,std_oper.spare1
       ,std_oper.spare2
       ,std_oper.spare3
       ,std_oper.spare4
       ,std_oper.last_edit_comment
       ,std_oper.last_edit_by
       ,std_oper.last_edit_at
       ,std_oper.row_id
FROM std_oper std_oper WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((std_oper.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.oper_desc = @oper_desc OR @oper_desc IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.check_inv = @check_inv OR @check_inv IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.sched_to_ent_id = @sched_to_ent_id OR @sched_to_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.oper_type = @oper_type OR @oper_type IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.spare1 = @spare1 OR @spare1 IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.spare3 = @spare3 OR @spare3 IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.spare4 = @spare4 OR @spare4 IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Attr_GetAttrs]
(@process_id	STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Oper_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description	      - Raghu
-- Author	      - Get all attributes that are associated to a process/operation.
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--09/28/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
  SELECT oper_attr.process_id
	 ,oper_attr.oper_id
            ,oper_attr.attr_id
            ,attr.attr_desc
	    ,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,oper_attr.attr_value
            ,oper_attr.notes
            ,oper_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_attr.last_edit_by
            ,oper_attr.last_edit_at
	,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id) <=
		(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal
			INNER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cal.cert_name = cul.cert_name
			WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id AND cul.user_id = @user_id AND cul.cert_level >= cal.cert_level)
		THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		editable
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM oper_attr oper_attr WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id
  WHERE oper_attr.process_id = @process_id AND oper_attr.oper_id = @oper_id AND attr.attr_grp = 7
--	AND (CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_attr.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
  ORDER BY attr.attr_desc

-- Module Name        - tg_std_oper_step_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on std_oper_step table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 09/27/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE std_oper_step SET std_oper_step.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, std_oper_step.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i

										,@UserId
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,@minID
										,null
										)
				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @DestSilos WHERE id > @minID
			END
		END
	END
	*/
	SELECT @defaultUoMId = uom_id FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description = @defaultUoMDesc
 
	DECLARE @SourceSilos TABLE (
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
		dest_type int,
		storage_ent_id int,
		mes_silo_id NVARCHAR(50),
		parent_item_id NVARCHAR(100),
		silo_item_id int,
		mes_item_id NVARCHAR(50),
		ratio float,
		silo_item_group NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
		bom_pos INT  NULL
	)
 
	-- v.0.05.00 Begin 
	DECLARE @Jb_Corr_Details TABLE (
		[wo_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[oper_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[seq_no] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
		[bom_pos] [dbo].[INT32] NOT NULL,
		[item_id] [dbo].[STRING40] NOT NULL,
		[qty_per_parent_item] [dbo].[TFLOAT] NOT NULL,
		[qty_reqd] [dbo].[TFLOAT_NULL] NULL,
		[reqd_grade_cd] [dbo].[INT32] NULL
	)
 
	-- Job Bom Correction Detail table will have data on job_start or bom_correction step
	IF (@oper_id = 'CakeBlending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no ))
	BEGIN
		declare @CurrentDosingStep INT = (SELECT MAX(dosing_step) FROM job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK) 
										WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no )
 
		INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
		SELECT jbc.wo_id, jbc.oper_id, jbc.seq_no, jbc.bom_pos, jbc.item_id, jbc.qty_per_parent_item,jbc.qty_reqd,jb.reqd_grade_cd from job_bom_correction_details jbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id = jbc.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = jbc.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = jbc.seq_no AND jb.item_id = jbc.item_id
		WHERE jbc.wo_id = @wo_id AND jbc.oper_id = @oper_id AND jbc.seq_no = @seq_no AND jbc.dosing_step =  @CurrentDosingStep
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT @Jb_Corr_Details
		SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, bom_pos, item_id, qty_per_parent_item,qty_reqd,reqd_grade_cd from job_bom with (nolock)
		WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no 
	END
 
	-- v.0.05.00 End
		--SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		--INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
		--								AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		--WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id

	--	if @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically =0
	--if not exists(select * from ofi_su_selection where wo_id=@wo_id and oper_id=@oper_id and seq_no=@seq_no and dest_type=1 and su_ent_id=@st_ent_id)
		--begin
	INSERT @SourceSilos
	SELECT 
		dest_type,
		ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
		case 
			when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
			when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
			else osu.su_ent_id 
		end,
		j.item_id,
		aut_item_id,
		case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,
		--jb.qty_per_parent_item*(osu.ratio/100.0) ratio,
		CASE dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) 
			WHEN 1000.00 THEN 1 
			ELSE ISNULL(dbo.[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom](osu.jb_item_id,jb.qty_per_parent_item,jbi.uom_id,@defaultUoMId,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL)*(osu.ratio/100) ,1)
		END  ratio,
		NULL,
		NULL
	FROM 
	ofi_su_selection osu WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON osu.wo_id = j.wo_id and osu.oper_id = j.oper_id and osu.seq_no = j.seq_no
	LEFT OUTER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
														AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
														AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
														AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id AND jb.reqd_grade_cd = jb_grade_cd
														AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	--LEFT OUTER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id = j.wo_id							-- v.0.05.00 Update
	--													AND jb.oper_id = j.oper_id
	--													AND jb.seq_no = j.seq_no
	--													AND jb.item_id = osu.jb_item_id
	--													AND jb.bom_pos > 0
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].item jbi WITH (NOLOCK) ON jb.item_id = jbi.item_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON case 
															when (osu.dest_type = 1 and latest_aut_silo=0) then osu.secondary_silo_ent_id 
															when (osu.dest_type = 2)					   then osu.su_ent_id 
															else osu.su_ent_id 
													   end = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																		FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																		WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2) -- Add attribute group =2 (entity)
	CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(case when jb_item_id is not null then jb_item_id else j.item_id end,1)
	WHERE osu.wo_id  = @wo_id and osu.oper_id = @oper_id and osu.seq_no = @seq_no and osu.dest_type = 1 and is_chk = 1
	ORDER by created_at_utc
	--end
	print @oper_id
	-- Auto insert source silo
	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @SourceSilos))
	BEGIN
		-- Get Attribute IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		SELECT @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically=oa.attr_value FROM oper_attr oa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN attr a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_id = oa.attr_id 
										AND a.attr_desc = 'IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically'
		WHERE oa.oper_id = @oper_id
 
		
		print @IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically
		IF (@IsSourceSiloSelectedAutomatically = 1)
		BEGIN
			SET	@minID = 1
 
			SELECT @target_sched_ent_id = target_sched_ent_id FROM job 
			WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no
 
			INSERT @SourceSilos
			SELECT TOP 1 1 dest_type,
					ea.attr_value as aut_silo_id,
					oea.storage_ent_id,
					j.item_id,
					aut_item_id,
					jb.item_id,
					1.0 ratio,
					oea.item_group,
					jb.bom_pos
			FROM Job j WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN ofi_ent_item_storage_link oea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.type = 'Source' and oea.ent_id = j.target_sched_ent_id
			--LEFT OUTER JOIN item_inv iv WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = iv.ent_id -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			INNER JOIN job_bom jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 --and jb.reqd_grade_cd=iv.grade_cd -- Get only for the consumable material
			--INNER JOIN @Jb_Corr_Details jb ON jb.wo_id  = j.wo_id and jb.oper_id = j.oper_id and jb.seq_no = j.seq_no and jb.bom_pos > 0 -- Get only for the consumable material
			--OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE oea.storage_ent_id = ent_id AND item_id = jb.item_id order by date_in_local ASC) iv -- v0.03.00 Added
			--INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no AND cj.state_cd = 4 -- only take inventory who job completed
			INNER JOIN job cj WITH (NOLOCK) ON cj.wo_id = iv.wo_id AND cj.oper_id = iv.oper_id AND cj.seq_no = iv.seq_no  -- only take inventory who job completed
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON oea.storage_ent_id = ea.ent_id 
														AND ea.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id
																			FROM attr WITH (NOLOCK) 
																			WHERE attr_desc = 'SUNumberInAUT' AND attr_grp = 2)
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].ufn_ofi_mes_aut_itemid(jb.item_id,1)
			--CROSS APPLY [dbo].fn_chkStorageValidity(oea.storage_ent_id, 'Source', NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL) -- v0.03.00 Disabled
			CROSS APPLY [dbo].[fn_chKSourceValidity](oea.storage_ent_id,'source',iv.item_id,iv.grade_cd,jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd ,@wo_id,@oper_id,@seq_no,j.target_sched_ent_id,null)
			WHERE j.wo_id  = @wo_id and j.oper_id = @oper_id and j.seq_no = @seq_no 
			AND isNotValidEnt=0   
			--AND (iv.ent_id IS NOT NULL OR iv.qty_left > 0.00) -- Get only for filled silo => Disabled because handled by silo validity
			order by cj.act_finish_time_local,iv.date_in_local ASC
			SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos
 
			DECLARE @Len INT 
			SELECT @Len = COUNT(*) FROM @SourceSilos
 
			UPDATE @SourceSilos SET ratio = ratio/@Len -- Update ratio
 
			WHILE (@minID IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @id=ID,@dest_type=dest_type,@storage_ent_id=mes_silo_id,@parent_item_id=parent_item_id,@ratio=ratio,@silo_item_group =silo_item_group,
				@silo_item_id = mes_item_id
				FROM @SourceSilos WHERE ID = @minID
				print '@storage_ent_id'
				print @storage_ent_id
				SELECT @jb_grade_cd = reqd_grade_cd from job_bom WITH (nolock)
				WHERE wo_id = @wo_id and oper_id = @oper_id and seq_no = @seq_no and item_id = @silo_item_id
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[ofi_su_selection]
										(
										 [wo_id]									
										,[oper_id]							
										,[seq_no]					
										,[parent_item_id]
										,[ent_id]
										,[jb_item_id] 	
										,[jb_item_group] 
										,[jb_grade_cd] 								
										,[dest_type]							
										,[is_chk]
										,[su_ent_id]
										,[is_active]
										,[ratio]
										,[created_at_utc]
										,[created_at_local]
										,[created_by]
										,[last_edit_at_utc]
										,[last_edit_at_local]
										,[last_edit_by]
										,[active_su_ent_id]
										,[silo_seq]
										)
								VALUES
										(
										 @wo_id
										,@oper_id
										,@seq_no
										,@parent_item_id
										,@target_sched_ent_id
										,@silo_item_id
										,@silo_item_group
										,@jb_grade_cd
										,1
										,1
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										,@ratio*100.00
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,GETUTCDATE()
										,GETDATE()
										,@UserId
										,@storage_ent_id
										,1
										)
				SELECT @minID = MIN(id) FROM @SourceSilos WHERE id > @minID
			END
		END
	END
	--if @oper_id like '%Rework%'
	if exists (select 1 from oper_attr with(nolock) where oper_id=@oper_id and attr_id in(select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc='def_source_su'))
	BEGIN
		declare @mes_ent_id int	
		select @storage_ent_id=TRY_CONVERT(INT,ea.attr_value),@mes_ent_id=ea.ent_id from ent_attr ea -- 0.11.00 adding TRY_CONVERT to be able to assign nvarchar value to int
		inner join attr a on ea.attr_id=a.attr_id
		inner join ent e on e.ent_id=ea.ent_id
		where e.ent_name in (select attr_value from oper_attr oa
		inner join attr a  on a.attr_id=oa.attr_id where
		attr_desc='def_source_su'
		and oper_id=@oper_id) and attr_desc='SUNumberInAUT'

		insert into @SourceSilos(dest_type,storage_ent_id,mes_silo_id,ratio)
		values(1,@storage_ent_id,@mes_ent_id,1)

	END
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos = 0
	UNION
	SELECT TOP 1 * FROM @DestSilos where bom_pos < 0
	UNION 
	SELECT * FROM @SourceSilos where ratio > 0

END
