--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    sp_s_ei_get_consumption
-- Description:  Returns the consumption for SAP
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-09-02		   Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  Karthik     2022-09-05		   Added additional fields in the select
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-02-09		   Refer to the comments in the SP on this date	
-- 0.01.03	AP			2023-02-23		   Added logic for sending beans consumption when nibs is consumed
-- 0.01.04	Karthik		2023-06-28		   Added wo_id to the join condition to ofi_wo_item_ext. Refer notes below of the date
-- 0.01.05	Karthik		2023-07-03		   Updated condition to include Intermediate class id with NIBS. Modified join condition of ofi_wo_item_ext to left join
-- 0.01.06	LP  		2023-07-03		   Updated condition to check spare1 value for nibs consumption  and changed on update command to update spare1 value
-- 0.01.07	Karthik		2023-07-21		   Updated condition to ignore reporting items with attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set
-- ===========================================================================================


CREATE               PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ei_get_consumption_copy] as
begin
    Declare @row_id int, @ent_id int, @storage_locn VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@error_severity INT,
			@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON


	BEGIN TRY
	declare @itemgrp nvarchar(40), @nibslot nvarchar(40), @nibsSublot nvarchar(40), @nibsConsQty float, @nibsOrder nvarchar(40),@nibsTotalCons float

	SET @ent_id = -1


	--Ap: 22-Feb-2023 - added filter for pack class, also beans are excluded, it will be reported as part of nibs.
    SELECT TOP 1	@row_id = ic.row_id,
					@ent_id = ic.from_ent_id, 
					@itemgrp=ia.attr_value, 
					@nibslot=ic.lot_no, 
					@nibsSublot=ic.sublot_no, 
					@nibsTotalCons = qty_cons,
					@nibsConsQty=qty_cons - ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0),
					@nibsOrder = ic.wo_id
	  
	  FROM				item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
	  INNER join		item i								on ic.item_id = i.item_id
	  INNER JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia with(nolock)			ON ia.item_id=i.item_id 
															AND ia.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
															AND ia.attr_value not like '%BEANS'
    -- LEFT JOIN		ITEM_ATTR ia1 with(nolock)			ON ia1.item_id=i.item_id	-- (KN 21Jul23 - Get only items which don't have the attribute SkipConsumptionReporting set for them)
														--	AND ia1.attr_id=(Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc = 'SkipConsumptionReporting')
	 LEFT JOIN ofi_wo_item_ext ie WITH (NOLOCK)
															ON ie.item_id = i.item_id 
															AND ie.wo_id = ic.wo_id	--(KN 28Jun23 - Added join condition to return rows based on work order)

		WHERE	qty_cons_erp < qty_cons 
				AND i.item_class_id <> UPPER('PACK')
				AND (
				(UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('WIP') OR (UPPER(i.item_class_id) = UPPER('INTERMEDIATE')) AND IA.attr_VALUE LIKE '%NIBS' )
				or  (UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('WIP') AND UPPER(i.item_class_id) <> UPPER('INTERMEDIATE'))
				)	---Pick WIP item only if it is NIBS
				AND ISNULL(ie.backflush,0) <> 1  AND ic.from_ent_id IS NOT NULL
				
	 
		ORDER by ic.created_at_local asc



	 if @ent_id <> -1 and @ent_id is not NULL
		Begin
			SET @storage_locn = NULL
			SELECT @storage_locn = attr_value from ent_attr with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with(nolock) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation')
			IF @storage_locn is NULL
				SELECT @storage_locn = ent_name from ent with(nolock) where ent_id = @ent_id
		
			BEGIN TRANSACTION;

			--(KN - 19-Feb-23 - Pick all operations for which NotCosumeToSAP has not been set)

			IF @itemgrp<>'NIBS'
			BEGIN

					print 'not nibs';


					WITH ConsToSAPOpers as(
						Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotConsumeToSAP') and attr_value <> 1
						union
						Select oper_id from oper_attr where attr_id <> (Select attr_id from attr where attr_desc='NotConsumeToSAP')
						union 
						Select oper_id from oper where oper_id not in (select oper_id from oper_attr)
					)

					Select wo_id Order_Number,
						   [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,
						   lot_no Batch_Number,
						   IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,ic.item_id,ia.attr_value) Material, --(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists)
						   qty_cons-ISNULL(qty_cons_erp,0) Quantity,
						   u.description UOM,
						   '261' Movement_Type,
						   format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
				format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime,
						   @storage_locn Storage_Location,--e.ent_name Storage_Location,
						   '' Document_Number,
						   '' Message,
						   '' Message
					  from item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
					 inner join item i WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.item_id = i.item_id
					inner join item_class icl on i.item_class_id = icl.item_class_id	--(KN - 09/02/23 - Exclude items with Intermediate class id)
					inner join ConsToSAPOpers cs on cs.oper_id = ic.oper_id --(KN - 09/02/23 - Include only those operations where the NotConsumeToSAP has not been set)
					   --and i.spare1 is null --(KN - 05/09/22) Don't report SFG Material available only in MES
					left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
										on i.item_id = ia.item_id	--(KN 	02/02/23 Check and return the SAP Material ID if it exists. If there are diff type of butter exists, only SAP butter will be reported to SAP)
					  left join uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
						on i.uom_id   = u.uom_id
					  left join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
						on e.ent_id   = ic.ent_id
					 where ic.row_id = @row_id and UPPER(icl.item_class_desc) <> UPPER('Intermediate') --(KN - 09/02/23 - Exclude items with Intermediate class id)
	

						Update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id = @row_id
	
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN

					print 'nibs'

					----------------
					--AP: 23-FEB; BEANS Reporting on nibs consumption
					------------
					DECLARE  @NibsProdQty float,@NibsConsPercent float, @beansRowId int=-1, @beansQty float,@qty_cons_erp float,@beans_already_reported float
					
					SET @beansRowId = -1;
					--select @nibsConsQty=qty_cons-qty_cons_erp from item_cons where row_id=@row_id
					Declare @totalBeanCons float

					select @totalBeanCons= Sum(ic.qty_cons),@beans_already_reported=sum(qty_cons_erp) from item_cons ic with(nolock) -- (KN 21-Apr Finding Beans consumption from item_cons)
					where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot--and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp

					PRINT 'Total BEANS - ' +  CAST(isnull(@totalBeanCons,0) as varchar)

					select top 1 @beansRowId=row_id,@beansQty = qty_cons,@qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp from item_cons ic with(nolock) -- (KN 21-Apr Finding Beans consumption from item_cons)
					where  ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot and qty_cons > qty_cons_erp
					--and CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS float) < CAST(@nibsTotalCons as float)  -- @nibsTotalCons 	
					and CAST (isnull(ic.spare1,'0') AS float) < CAST(@totalBeanCons as float)  -- @totalBeanCons 	
					order by created_at_local asc

					PRINT 'BEANS row id - ' +  CAST(isnull(@beansRowId,-1) as varchar)  + ' - ' + CAST(isnull(@beansQty,0) as varchar) +'-'+CAST(@nibsConsQty as varchar)

					IF @beansRowId<>-1
					BEGIN
						PRINT 'BEANS FOUND FOR  NIBS'

						
						declare @spare1 float

						select @NibsProdQty = sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),  @NibsConsPercent = case when round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),3)>1 then 1 
						else round(@nibsConsQty/sum(qty_prod-qty_prod_erp),3) end
						from item_prod ip with(nolock)
						where ip.lot_no=@nibslot and ip.sublot_no=@nibsSublot


						declare @beansQtyToBeReported float

						set @spare1= round(@totalBeanCons * @NibsConsPercent,3)
						SET @beansQtyToBeReported = round(@totalBeanCons * @NibsConsPercent,3)
						IF (@beansQty - @qty_cons_erp)<@spare1
						BEGIN
						 SET @beansQtyToBeReported=@beansQty-@qty_cons_erp
						END
						/*ELSE
						BEGIN
						SET @beansQtyToBeReported=@beansQty
						END*/

				       print 'Qty Cons Reported:'+CAST(@beansQtyToBeReported as varchar)
						print '@NibsConsPercent:'+CAST(@NibsConsPercent as varchar)
						Select top 1 @nibsOrder Order_Number,
						   [dbo].[fn_S_ofi_PlantCode]() Plant,
						   lot_no Batch_Number,						 
						   IIF(ia.attr_value is NULL,ic.item_id,ia.attr_value) Material, 
						   @beansQtyToBeReported Quantity,
						   --qty_cons *  @NibsConsPercent Quantity,
						   u.description UOM,
						   '261' Movement_Type,
						   format(created_at_local,'yyyyMMdd') Posting_Date,
							format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') File_GenerationDate,format(GETDATE(),'hhmmss') File_GenerationTime,
						   @storage_locn Storage_Location,
						   '' Document_Number,
						   '' Message,
						   '' Message
					  from item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
						inner join item i WITH (NOLOCK) on ic.item_id = i.item_id and ic.fg_lot_no=@nibslot and ic.fg_sublot_no=@nibsSublot
										
					  	left join (Select item_id,attr_value from item_attr with (nolock) where attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'sap_item_id')) ia 
							on i.item_id = ia.item_id	
						left join uom u WITH (NOLOCK)
							on i.uom_id   = u.uom_id
						left join ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
							on e.ent_id   = ic.ent_id

						where ic.row_id = @beansRowId 

						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp+ @beansQtyToBeReported,spare1=(@spare1-@beansQtyToBeReported) where row_id=@beansRowId

						SET @spare1=@spare1-@beansQtyToBeReported
						---update roasting consumption@beansQty
						declare @nibsPercReported float,@nibsReported float

						--select @qty_cons_erp=qty_cons_erp,@qty_cons=qty_cons from item_cons where row_id=@row_id
						SET @nibsPercReported=ROUND((@beansQtyToBeReported+@beans_already_reported)/@totalBeanCons,3)
						SET @nibsReported=@nibsPercReported*@nibsConsQty

						print '@spare1'+cast(@spare1 as varchar) +' @beansQtyToBeReported'+cast(@beansQtyToBeReported as varchar) +' @nibsPercReported'+cast(@nibsPercReported as varchar) +' @nibsReported'+cast(@nibsReported as varchar)

						IF @spare1<@beansQtyToBeReported
						BEGIN
						print '@beansQty*1000:'+CAST(@beansQty*1000 as varchar)+' @beans_already_reported:'+CAST(@beans_already_reported as varchar)
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons_erp+@nibsReported where row_id=@row_id						
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
						update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id=@row_id
						END
					
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						-- If there are no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty
						--Update item_cons set qty_cons_erp = qty_cons  where row_id = @row_id
						PRINT 'no more beans to be reported for the consumed NIBS then update the nibs erp qty'
					END
						--end of beans cons reporting
	
			END


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	End

	 END TRY

	 BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

-- Name:    sp_u_ei_hu_stock_receipt_main
-- Description:  Updates the inventory in cases where there are no child HUs
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Karthik     2022-12-07			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01	Karthik		2023-07-13			Added Blend ratio. Refer to comments of the same date below
-- 0.01.02	Karthik		2023-08-08			Handled storage locations for Melting. Refer to comments of the same date below

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_u_ei_hu_stock_receipt_main] @order_number varchar(100),@material_no varchar(50),
@batch_no varchar(50),@qty varchar(50),@uom varchar(50),@pallet_id varchar(50),@sender_plant varchar(50),@sender_storage_locn varchar(50),
@receiving_plant varchar(50),@receiving_storage_locn varchar(50),@usage_decsn varchar(50),@blend_ratio VARCHAR(100)
As
begin
	Declare
	@ent_id int , -- receiving storage location
	@cur_ent_id int,
	@attr_id int,
	@frm_ent_id int,	--sender storage location
	@item_id nvarchar(40),
	@lot_no nvarchar(40) , --- Batch_no_child Hu
	@sublot_no nvarchar(40) , 
	@grade_cd int , --- item_grade state code 0
	@status_cd int , --- item_state normal state code
	@cur_status_cd int,
	@qty_left float ,@qty_left_erp float ,-- qty_left
	@uom_id int,@date_in_local datetime,@date_out_local datetime,@expiry_date datetime,	@last_edit_at datetime,	@row_id int,
	@mod_id varchar(30),@trans_id int,@spare3 varchar(100),@item_group varchar(100)

	DECLARE @error_msg  NVARCHAR(MAX),@error_severity INT,@error_state INT

    SET NOCOUNT ON

	BEGIN TRY
	BEGIN TRANSACTION

	SET @lot_no = @batch_no
	SET @item_id = @material_no
	SET @qty_left = @qty
	SET @qty_left_erp = @qty

	SET @date_in_local = GETDATE()
	SET @date_out_local = GETDATE()
	SET @last_edit_at = GETDATE()

	--SELECT @attr_id = attr_id from attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'SAPLocation'
	--SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @receiving_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id
	--SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from ent_attr WITH (NOLOCK) where attr_value = @sender_storage_locn and attr_id = @attr_id

	--(KN 8Aug23 Made the below changes to handle HU stock receipt for Melting)
	--Start of change

	IF @receiving_storage_locn <> 'MELT'
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @receiving_storage_locn
		SELECT @frm_ent_id = ent_id from vw_get_sap_locations with (NOLOCK) where sap_locn = @sender_storage_locn
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT @item_group = attr_value from item_attr with (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
		IF @item_group like '%Liquor%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorMelting_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Butter%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'ButterMelting_A'
		/*
		SELECT @item_group = attr_value from item_attr with (NOLOCK) where item_id = @item_id and attr_id = (Select attr_id from attr with (NOLOCK) where attr_desc = 'ItemGroup')
		IF @item_group like 'Liquor' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorButterRework_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Liquor (Packed)%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'LiquorMelting_A'
		ELSE IF @item_group like '%Butter (Packed)%' 
			SELECT @ent_id = ent_id from ent with (NOLOCK) where ent_name = 'ButterMelting_A'
		*/
	END

	--End of change


	SELECT @grade_cd = item_grade_cd from item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) where item_grade_desc = 'ACCEPTABLE'
	IF LEN(@usage_decsn) > 0 
		SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Unrestricted' -- Status cd 3
	ELSE
		SELECT @status_cd = item_status_cd from item_state WITH (NOLOCK) where item_status_desc = 'Restricted'	--- Status cd 5

	SELECT @uom_id = uom_id from uom WITH (NOLOCK) where description = @uom

	SELECT @row_id = row_id,@sublot_no = sublot_no,@cur_status_cd = status_cd,@cur_ent_id = ent_id,@spare3 = spare3 from item_inv WITH (NOLOCK) 
	where spare2 = @pallet_id 

	PRINT 'Row ID-' + cast(isnull(@row_id,'') as varchar) + '/ENT ID-' +  cast(ISNULL(@ent_id,'') as varchar)

	IF @cur_ent_id = @ent_id	--Pallet exist in MES, Receiving Storage Location is same as in item_inv, then just update the UD in item_inv
			BEGIN
				IF @cur_status_cd <> @status_cd	--Update UD only if it is different
					BEGIN
						Exec sp_U_Item_Inv
						@row_id = @row_id,@ent_id= @ent_id,@item_id = @item_id,@lot_no = @lot_no,@sublot_no = @sublot_no,
						@grade_cd = @grade_cd,@status_cd = @status_cd,@qty_left = @qty_left,@qty_left_erp = @qty_left,@uom_id = @uom_id,
						@date_in_local = @date_in_local,@date_in_tz = NULL,@date_out_local = @date_out_local,@date_out_tz = NULL,@expiry_date = NULL,
						@wo_id = NULL, @oper_id = NULL,@seq_no = NULL,@spare1 = NULL,@spare2 = @pallet_id,@spare3 = @spare3,@spare4 = '',
						@spare5 = '',@spare6 = '',@last_edit_comment ='HU Stock Receipt (UD update - Main)',@last_edit_at = @last_edit_at,
						@time_zone_bias_value = NULL,@date_in_utc = NULL,@date_out_utc = NULL,@expiry_date_utc = NULL
					END
				ELSE
					Update item_inv set last_edit_comment = 'HU Stock Receipt (Same UD No Changes - Main)' where row_id = @row_id
			END
		ELSE						--Pallet exist in MES but Receiving Storage Location is differentin item_inv
			BEGIN
					
				Exec sp_U_Item_Inv_Move 
				@from_row_id			= @row_id
				,@from_last_edit_at		= NULL
				,@from_ent_id           = @frm_ent_id
				,@transfer_qty   		= @qty_left
				,@transfer_qty_erp		= @qty_left
				,@in_to_ent_id			= @ent_id
				,@in_to_item_id			= @item_id
				,@in_to_lot_no			= @lot_no
				,@in_to_sublot_no		= @sublot_no
				,@in_to_grade_cd		= @grade_cd
				,@in_to_status_cd		= @status_cd
				,@in_to_uom_id			= @uom_id
				,@in_to_expiry_date		= NULL
				,@in_to_expiry_date_tz	= NULL
				,@in_to_expiry_date_utc		= NULL
				,@in_to_wo_id			= NULL
				,@in_to_oper_id			= NULL
				,@in_to_seq_no			= NULL
				,@in_transfer_option	= NULL
				,@in_move_inv_to_dwnstrm_job	= NULL
				,@in_transfer_comments	= 'HU Stock Receipt (Inventory Transfer - Main)'
				,@in_log_transfer	 = 1
				,@time_zone_bias_value	= NULL
			END

			--KN 13Jul23 Added logic to include blend ratio

			PRINT @blend_ratio
			SET @blend_ratio = ROUND(@blend_ratio,2)
			PRINT @blend_ratio

			PRINT 'About update blend ratio ' + CAST(ISNULL(@blend_ratio,0) AS VARCHAR)

			--IF NOT ISNULL(CAST(@blend_ratio AS VARCHAR),0) = 0 
			BEGIN
				Select @attr_id = attr_id from attr with (nolock) where attr_desc = 'MaxBlendRatio'

				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 from lot_attr with (nolock) WHERE lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id)
					EXEC sp_I_Lot_Attr @item_id,@lot_no,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id output
				ELSE
					BEGIN
					PRINT 'Updating Lot Attr'
						SELECT @mod_id = CAST(mod_id AS VARCHAR) from lot_attr with (nolock) where lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id
						PRINT  @mod_id
						--EXEC sp_U_Lot_Attr @item_id,@lot_no,@attr_id,@blend_ratio,'','ADDED BY EI',@mod_id
						Update lot_attr set attr_value = @blend_ratio where lot_no = @lot_no and attr_id = @attr_id
					END
			END

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		SELECT @error_msg = Error_message(),@error_severity = Error_severity(),@error_state = Error_state();
		RAISERROR(@error_msg,@error_severity,@error_state)
	END CATCH
end

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_bom_subst_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[job_bom_subst]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_bom_subst_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on job_bom_subst table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--08/04/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Disallow update if substitution item is the same item as the main job bom item
--05/10/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	IF UPDATE(item_id) BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_bom jb WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN inserted i
			ON jb.wo_id = i.wo_id AND jb.oper_id = i.oper_id AND jb.seq_no = i.seq_no AND jb.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
			AND jb.item_id = i.item_id) BEGIN
			RAISERROR('The substitute item cannot be the same item as the main item in job_bom{2945}', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE job_bom_subst SET job_bom_subst.qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,job_bom_subst.max_qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.max_qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,job_bom_subst.min_qty_per_parent_item = ROUND(i.min_qty_per_parent_item, it.num_decimals)
		,job_bom_subst.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_bom_subst.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE job_bom_subst.wo_id = i.wo_id AND job_bom_subst.oper_id = i.oper_id AND job_bom_subst.seq_no = i.seq_no
	  AND job_bom_subst.bom_pos = i.bom_pos AND job_bom_subst.alt_no = i.alt_no
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_attr_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[attr]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_attr_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on attr table to update
--			 update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/11/2005	Raghu		3.1.2	HD# 6192, Update queue_item_attr, queue_job_attr table automatically
--11/22/2005	Raghu		3.1.3	HD# 6192, Automatically propogate attribute descriptions to *_attr tables.
--12/31/2007	AML			3.4.0	Replaced CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [DATE_TIME_VALUE], 120) with
--									dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [DATE_TIME_VALUE] )
--01/25/2011	Ibrahim		3.5.0   HF# 2353/CR L00110262, call sp_U_Attr_UpdateDescs only if the attr desc is updated.
--04/14/2011    PradeepS    4.0 SP2 CR L00111360 SR 19911575  A problem in Configurator using
-- the Attributes Lot tab feature. It appears they have found some limit and now get errors deleting, adding and modifying the Data type field. [HF 2353]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by		NVARCHAR(40)
		,@attr_id		INT32
		,@attr_desc		STRING80
		,@attr_grp		INT32
		,@visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@old_visible_in_queue	LOGICAL
		,@remove_visible_attr	LOGICAL
		,@visible_in_inv	LOGICAL
		,@old_visible_in_inv	LOGICAL
		,@ent_id		STRING80
		,@ent_desc		STRING80
		,@err_desc		STRING1700
		,@old_attr_desc   STRING80

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE attr SET attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, last_edit_at =  dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE i.attr_id = attr.attr_id

	IF UPDATE(attr_desc) OR UPDATE(visible_in_queue) OR UPDATE(visible_in_inv) BEGIN
		DECLARE attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT i.attr_id, i.attr_desc, i.attr_grp, i.visible_in_queue, i.visible_in_inv FROM inserted i

		OPEN attr_cursor
		WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
			FETCH NEXT FROM attr_cursor INTO @attr_id, @attr_desc, @attr_grp, @visible_in_queue, @visible_in_inv
			IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK
			--Fix For CR L00110262/HF 2353
			--Fix For CR L00111360
			SELECT @old_attr_desc = attr_desc, @old_visible_in_queue = visible_in_queue, @old_visible_in_inv = visible_in_inv FROM deleted WHERE attr_id = @attr_id

			IF (@old_visible_in_queue <> @visible_in_queue) BEGIN
				SET @remove_visible_attr = 0
				IF (@visible_in_queue = 0) SET @remove_visible_attr = 1
				IF (@remove_visible_attr = 1) BEGIN
					--Make sure this attribute is NOT selected as the SORT order column in the queue window.
					IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM job_sched_exec
						WHERE sort_order LIKE '%=attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '%') BEGIN
						SELECT TOP 1 @ent_id = ent_id FROM job_sched_exec WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE sort_order LIKE '%=attr' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(40), @attr_id) + '%'
						SELECT @ent_desc = ent_name FROM ent WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
						SET @err_desc = 'The visible in queue state for this attribute cannot be changed, because the entity %1 uses this attribute as a sort column in the job queue window.{4765},' + @ent_desc
--						RAISERROR('The visible in queue state for this attribute cannot be changed, because this attribute is used as a sort column for the job queue.', 16, 1)
						RAISERROR(@err_desc, 16, 1)
						RETURN
					END
				END
				IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
					EXEC sp_U_Queue_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id, @remove_visible_attr
				ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 5)	-- Jobs
					EXEC sp_U_Queue_Job_Attr NULL, NULL, NULL, @attr_id, @remove_visible_attr
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF @old_attr_desc <> @attr_desc BEGIN --Fix For CR L00110262/HF 2353 /CR L00111360
					IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
						EXEC sp_U_Attr_UpdateDescs @attr_id, @attr_desc, @visible_in_queue
					ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 5)	-- Jobs
						EXEC sp_U_Attr_UpdateDescs @attr_id, @attr_desc, 0, @visible_in_queue
				END
			END

			IF (@old_visible_in_inv <> @visible_in_inv) BEGIN
				SET @remove_visible_attr = 0
				IF (@visible_in_inv = 0) SET @remove_visible_attr = 1
				IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
					EXEC sp_U_Inv_Item_Attr NULL, @attr_id, @remove_visible_attr
				ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 3)	--Lots
					EXEC sp_U_Inv_Lot_Attr NULL, NULL, @attr_id, @remove_visible_attr
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				IF @old_attr_desc <> @attr_desc BEGIN --Fix For CR L00110262/HF 2353 /CR L00111360
					IF (@attr_grp = 1)	--Items
						EXEC sp_U_Attr_UpdateDescs @attr_id, @attr_desc, 0, 0, @visible_in_inv
					ELSE IF (@attr_grp = 3)	-- Lots
						EXEC sp_U_Attr_UpdateDescs @attr_id, @attr_desc, 0, 0, 0, @visible_in_inv
				END
			END

		END
		CLOSE attr_cursor
		DEALLOCATE attr_cursor
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_SessionBG]
  (@session_id 		INT32 OUT,
   @client_type 	INT32 ,
   @client_address 	STRING40_NULL,
   @reqd_events 	STRING2000_NULL,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = 0) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
-- 03/01/2004	Raghu		2.0.27	If any background session exists, return the same session to the user.
--					if the same session is not updated in the last 3 mins, then return err
--06/29/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Changed GetDate to GMT Date
--07/14/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	Default client_type to 53. Ignore background session check if client_type is other than 53
--10/10/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--10/20/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Language string ID added.
--05/14/2015	Malleswara	5.03	User story 594198.  Removing the tz_bias, std_time.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE @user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@return		INT
	,@last_heartbeat	DATETIME
	,@current_time		DATETIME

SELECT	@time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)

SET NOCOUNT ON

-- Always default session_start and last_heartbeat to Now, user_id to Null at start of session
-- Get the User_ID from System_Attr for 199
SELECT @user_id = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 199
IF @user_id IS NULL BEGIN
--	RAISERROR('Cannot start the service. System Attribute does not have a default user_id',16,1, @return)
	RAISERROR('Can not start the Wonderware MES Service. The system attribute table does not have a default user_id for a Wonderware MES Service.{4720}',16,1, @return)
	RETURN -1
END

IF @client_type IS NULL SET @client_type = 53
IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE()

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE client_type = @client_type) AND @client_type = 53 BEGIN
	SELECT @session_id = MIN(session_id), @last_heartbeat = MIN(last_heartbeat)
	FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE client_type = 53
	IF (DATEADD(mi, -3, @current_time) < @last_heartbeat) BEGIN
--		RAISERROR('The service is already running',16,1, @return)
		RAISERROR('The Wonderware MES Service is already running.{4721}',16,1, @return)
		RETURN -1
	END
	ELSE RETURN
END

INSERT INTO sessn
 (client_type,
  session_start,
  last_heartbeat,
  user_id,
  client_address,
  reqd_events)
VALUES
  (@client_type,
   @current_time,
   @current_time,
   @user_id,
   @client_address,
   @reqd_events)
-- Auto Identifer table - return the id of the record created
-- select @session_id = (select max(session_id) from session)
SELECT @session_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Result_Attr_AddOrUpdXML] (
@sample_id     int32,
@char_id       int32,
@value_no      int32,
@result_attrs        nvarchar(MAX)
/*
Example XML
<result_attrs>
<result_attr attr_desc="Room Temperature" value="my context data" notes="my notes data" />
<result_attr attr_desc="Scale Offset" value="my context data" notes="my notes data" />
</result_attr>
*/

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                    - SP_U_Result_attr_AddOrUpdXML
-- Description                    - Inserts or Updates sample Attributes from xml
-- Author                         - JA
-- Date Created                   - 6/24/2011
-- Version (last edit)            - 6.2.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc - All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver      Changes
-- 02/05/2020     Jim O'Hearn  6.2.0    Removed ntext type in favor of NOTES; see US 1232760
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
   @attr_id int ,
   @attr_value nvarchar(1700) ,
   @notes nvarchar(max) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime,
   @doc_handle  int
BEGIN

   EXEC sp_xml_preparedocument @doc_handle OUTPUT, @result_attrs

   DECLARE result_attr_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
      SELECT   attr.attr_id, value ,notes
      FROM OPENXML (@doc_handle, '/result_attrs/result_attr')
         WITH (
                attr_desc nvarchar(80),
                value nvarchar(1700),
                notes NOTES
                ) s
      INNER JOIN attr ON s.attr_desc=attr.attr_desc
      INNER JOIN char_attr_link ON attr.attr_id=char_attr_link.attr_id
      AND char_attr_link.char_id=@char_id
      WHERE attr.attr_grp=11

   OPEN result_attr_cursor
   WHILE (1=1) BEGIN
      FETCH NEXT FROM result_attr_cursor INTO @attr_id,@attr_value,@notes
      IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BREAK

      EXECUTE sp_I_Result_Attr_RecordData @sample_id, @char_id, @value_no, @attr_id, @attr_value, @notes

   END
   CLOSE result_attr_cursor
   DEALLOCATE result_attr_cursor
   EXEC sp_xml_removedocument @doc_handle
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Std_Oper_Attr]

 @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
 @attr_value  nvarchar(80),
 @last_edit_by  nvarchar(40),
 @last_edit_at datetime
 )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Std_Oper_Attr
-- Description      - Select multiple rows filtered by any included column values
-- Date Created     - 10/17/2002
-- Version          - 1.5.0.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 11/07/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	attr_desc, predefined, data_type, entry_type, visible_in_queue, etc.. columns are included
-- 01/19/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 7

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT std_oper_attr.oper_id
       ,std_oper_attr.attr_id
            ,attr.attr_desc
	,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
       ,std_oper_attr.attr_value
       ,std_oper_attr.notes
       ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_comment
       ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_by
FROM std_oper_attr std_oper_attr
INNER JOIN attr attr ON attr.attr_id = std_oper_attr.attr_id
WHERE ((std_oper_attr.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper_attr.attr_id = @attr_id OR @attr_id IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper_attr.attr_value = @attr_value OR @attr_value IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper_attr.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (std_oper_attr.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Job_Bom_UpdateDefLots]
(@wo_id		STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@seq_no	INT32
,@bom_pos	INT32
,@def_lot_no	STRING80
) AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -	sp_U_Job_Bom_UpdateDefLots
-- Description	      - Update default_lot_no to the supplied job and propogate the def_lot_no to the downstream jobs.
-- Date Created	      - 12/05/2005
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Version	      - 3.1.5
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Ver	Changes
--12/27/2005	Raghu		3.1.6	Per Tony's mail, added bom_pos parameter to the last update statement to update
--					all downstream jobs for the supplied bom position.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

DECLARE  @downstream_jobs	TABLE(wo_id NVARCHAR(80), oper_id NVARCHAR(80), seq_no INT, downstream_level INT)
DECLARE  @rowcount		INT32
	,@downstream_level	INT32

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON

	--default the downstream level to 0; meaning this is the current level. Also default the current rowcount to 0.
	SELECT @downstream_level = 1, @rowcount = 0

	--Get the next downstream job(s) from the supplied job.
	INSERT INTO @downstream_jobs (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, downstream_level)
	SELECT wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, @downstream_level
	FROM job_route
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND input_oper_id = @oper_id AND input_seq_no = @seq_no

	--Check the no. of rows that are inserted.
	SET @rowcount = @@ROWCOUNT

	--Loop thru the descendent jobs ONLY if there are > 1 jobs.
	WHILE (@rowcount > 0) BEGIN
		SET @downstream_level = @downstream_level + 1

		INSERT INTO @downstream_jobs (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, downstream_level)
		SELECT jr.wo_id, jr.oper_id, jr.seq_no, @downstream_level
		FROM job_route jr
		INNER JOIN @downstream_jobs dj ON dj.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND dj.oper_id = jr.input_oper_id AND dj.seq_no = jr.input_seq_no
		WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
		  AND dj.downstream_level = @downstream_level - 1

		SET @rowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
		IF (@rowcount <= 0) BREAK
	END

	--Update the def_lot_no with the supplied job (with bom_pos)
	UPDATE job_bom SET def_lot_no = @def_lot_no
	WHERE wo_id = @wo_id AND oper_id = @oper_id AND seq_no = @seq_no AND bom_pos = @bom_pos

	--Propogate the def_lot_no to all downstream jobs.
	UPDATE job_bom SET def_lot_no = @def_lot_no
	FROM @downstream_jobs dj
	WHERE job_bom.wo_id = dj.wo_id AND job_bom.oper_id = dj.oper_id AND job_bom.seq_no = dj.seq_no AND job_bom.bom_pos = @bom_pos

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Attr_GetAvailAttrs]
(@process_id	STRING80
,@oper_id	STRING80
,@user_id	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Oper_Attr_GetAvailAttrs
-- Description	      - Get Available attributes for an Operation (ie, the attributes that are not assigned for a specific Operation)
-- Author	      - Raghu
-- Date Created	      - 06/27/2005
-- Version                  - 2.1.22
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--10/31/2005	Raghu		2.1.31/3.1.0	HD# 6624, Sort attributes by attr_desc.
--11/14/2005	Raghu		3.1.1	Entry_type column is included.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	SELECT DISTINCT attr.attr_id, attr.predefined, attr.data_type, attr.attr_desc, attr.attr_grp
		,attr.filtr, attr.entry_type, attr.last_edit_comment, attr.last_edit_by, attr.last_edit_at
	FROM attr attr
	INNER JOIN (
	SELECT a.attr_id, a.predefined, a.data_type, a.attr_desc, a.attr_grp, cal.cert_name attr_cert_name, cal.cert_level cert_attr_level,
	cul.cert_name user_cert_name, cul.user_id, cul.cert_level user_cert_level
	FROM attr a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
	WHERE a.attr_grp = 7 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM oper_attr WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id)
	) x ON attr.attr_id = x.attr_id
	--WHERE attr.attr_id <> (CASE WHEN x.attr_cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (x.user_cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level) THEN x.attr_id ELSE -111 END)
	WHERE x.attr_id NOT IN (
		SELECT a.attr_id
		FROM attr a
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_attr_link cal ON cal.attr_id = a.attr_id
		LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_user_link cul ON cul.cert_name = cal.cert_name AND (cul.user_id IS NULL OR cul.user_id = @user_id)
		WHERE a.attr_grp = 7 AND a.attr_id NOT IN (SELECT attr_id FROM oper_attr WHERE process_id = @process_id AND oper_id = @oper_id)
		  AND cal.cert_name IS NOT NULL AND (cul.cert_name IS NULL OR ISNULL(x.user_cert_level, -999) < x.cert_attr_level))
	ORDER BY attr.attr_desc

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_InterlockManagement]
AS
BEGIN

	WITH CTE AS (
    SELECT 
        DISTINCT sl.storage_ent_id,       
        sl.item_group     
    FROM 
        ofi_ent_item_storage_link sl with (nolock)
		UNION 
		SELECT 
        DISTINCT st.storage_ent_id,       
        st.item_group      
    FROM 
        ofi_st_trans_mapping st with (nolock)     
		
),
CTE_COMB AS (
SELECT  storage_ent_id,
    ent_name,
    item_group,
    last_edit_at_local,
    OFS.last_edit_by,
	  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.storage_ent_id, C.item_group ORDER BY ofs.last_edit_at_local DESC) AS RowNum
	FROM CTE C
	LEFT JOIN ent e with (nolock) ON e.ent_id = C.storage_ent_id
	LEFT JOIN ofi_su_mes_states_mapping ofs with (nolock) ON ofs.su_ent_id = C.storage_ent_id
		)
		
SELECT 
    storage_ent_id,
    ent_name,
    item_group,
    last_edit_at_local,
    last_edit_by
FROM CTE_COMB
WHERE RowNum = 1;



END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_JE_GetItmsProdByDSTRMJob]
(
		@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@seq_no					INT32_NULL = NULL
	,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@lot_no					STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@sublot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
	,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32 = 0

) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name    -   SP_SA_JE_GETITMSPRODBYDSTRMJOB
-- Description    - Returns a list of items that are produced by the immediate downstream job.
-- Author         - Raghu
-- Date Created   -    05/08/2007
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By  Ver.       Changes
-- 08/31/2007		AML			3.3.0		Ported to Sql Server 2000 from Oracle.  DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

    SELECT ip.wo_id, ip.oper_id, ip.seq_no,
		ip.shift_start_utc, ip.shift_start_local,
		DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ip.shift_start_utc ) AS shift_start,
		ip.item_id, ip.lot_no, ip.rm_lot_no, ip.sublot_no, ip.rm_sublot_no, ip.reas_cd, ip.user_id, ip.ent_id,
		ip.shift_id, ip.grade_cd, ip.status_cd, ip.to_ent_id, ip.good_prod, ip.qty_prod, ip.qty_prod_erp, ip.processed_flag,
		ip.byproduct, ip.ext_ref, ip.move_status, ip.spare1, ip.spare2, ip.spare3, ip.spare4, ip.last_edit_comment,
		ip.last_edit_by, ip.last_edit_at,
		ip.created_at_utc, ip.created_at_local,
		DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, ip.created_at_utc ) AS created_at, ip.row_id
    FROM item_prod ip WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN job_route jr WITH (NOLOCK) ON ip.wo_id = jr.wo_id AND ip.oper_id = jr.oper_id AND ip.seq_no = jr.seq_no
    WHERE jr.wo_id = @wo_id
      AND jr.input_oper_id = @oper_id
      AND jr.input_seq_no = @seq_no
      AND (ip.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
      AND (ip.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
      AND (ip.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_Oper_Attr]
  (@process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @attr_id int = NULL,
   @attr_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL
   )
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (C) 2020 AVEVA Software, LLC. and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver     Changes
-- 09/19/2005	  Raghu		    3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
-- 01/18/2018	  Surya		    6.0     US#805004 - As Bruce, I want to be able to query for attribute values based on names instead of internal IDs so I don't have to make so many API calls to return a value.
-- 06/11/2020	  Eswar H	    6.2     US 1319676 - Filter on attribute group to retrieve attribute from attribute description.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************

BEGIN

  IF (@attr_id IS NULL AND @attr_desc IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_id = a.attr_id FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE a.attr_desc = @attr_desc AND a.attr_grp = 7

	IF (@attr_id IS NULL)
		SET @attr_id = -1
  END

SELECT oper_attr.process_id
          ,oper_attr.oper_id
          ,oper_attr.attr_id
          ,oper_attr.attr_value
          ,oper_attr.notes
          ,oper_attr.last_edit_comment
          ,oper_attr.last_edit_by
          ,oper_attr.last_edit_at
          ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_attr.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM oper_attr oper_attr
WHERE (oper_attr.process_id = @process_id AND
       oper_attr.oper_id = @oper_id AND
       oper_attr.attr_id = @attr_id)
END

-- ==========================================================================================												
-- Name:			sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry									
-- Description:		Insert into MESDB.dbo.user_name and/or user_grp_link table										
-- Author:			AKM/AKP												
-- Usage:			Add the user if not avaialbe in the table 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry_LK]	
	@user_id NVARCHAR(40) OUT
AS												
BEGIN			
	SET NOCOUNT ON;			
 
	DECLARE @mod_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @last_edit_at DATETIME
	DECLARE @grp_id INT
 
	DECLARE @grp_name TABLE
	(
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		grp_id INT,
		grp_desc NVARCHAR(80),
		auth_method INT
	)
 
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE user_id = @user_id)
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_User_Name] 
		   @user_id
		  ,NULL
		  ,'N.A.'
		  ,1
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,NULL
		  ,@mod_id OUTPUT
		  ,@last_edit_at OUTPUT
	END
 
	-- Get all the stored AD groups in MES and use it to loop thru and determine if the user is assigned to the group.
	-- In the case the user is assigned to the AD group it must exist in MES as well
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @grp_id AND user_id = @user_id)
	BEGIN
			EXECUTE AS LOGIN = @user_id
			INSERT INTO @grp_name
			SELECT
				grp_id,
				grp_desc,
				auth_method
			FROM [dbo].grp_name(NOLOCK)
			WHERE auth_method = 2
			AND IS_MEMBER (grp_desc) = 1
			REVERT
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE AS LOGIN = @user_id
			INSERT INTO @grp_name
			SELECT
				grp_id,
				grp_desc,
				auth_method
			FROM [dbo].grp_name(NOLOCK)
			WHERE auth_method = 2
			AND IS_MEMBER (grp_desc) = 1
			REVERT
		delete from user_grp_link where user_id = @user_id and grp_id not in (select grp_id from @grp_name)
 
						
	END
 
	DECLARE 
		@max_rows INT,
		@cur_row INT = 1
 
	-- Loop the MES groups and insert if not linked in MES
--	SET @max_rows = @@ROWCOUNT			@@ROWCOUNT is always 1, count the rows in the table instead
	SELECT @max_rows = count(*) from @grp_name
 
  	WHILE (@cur_row <= @max_rows)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @grp_id = grp_id FROM @grp_name WHERE id = @cur_row
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @grp_id AND user_id = @user_id)
		BEGIN
		print @grp_id
		print @user_id
			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_User_Grp_Link] 
			   @grp_id
			  ,@user_id
			  ,NULL
			  ,@last_edit_at OUTPUT
		END
		SET @cur_row = @cur_row + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_DL_GetDataLogDataForJob]
(
	@grp_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id 					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id 				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no 		        INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id 				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@row_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = NULL

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_DL_GETDATALOGDATAFORAJOB
-- Description          - Gets a recordset of data_log_16 or data_log_48 records
-- Author				- Raghu
-- Date Created         - 12/12/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver		Changes
-- 12/12/2007		AML				3.4.1	Initial Sql Server Version
--02/04/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074426; L00074427; L00074701; L00074692; Collect data is not returning whether a data_log_n group requires a data collection or not.
--02/06/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074426; L00074427; L00074701; L00074692; Collect data is not returning whether a data_log_n group requires a data collection or not.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @max_value				INT32
		,	@value_name				STRING80
		,	@verify_data_collect	LOGICAL
		,	@grp_desc		STRING80

	SELECT	@verify_data_collect = 0
		,	@time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	SELECT @max_value = dlg.max_value, @grp_desc = dlg.grp_desc
	FROM data_log_grp dlg WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE dlg.grp_id = @grp_id

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1
		FROM data_entry_sched des WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON des.key_id = j.row_id
		WHERE j.wo_id = @wo_id AND
			  j.oper_id = @oper_id AND
			  j.seq_no = @seq_no AND
			  j.state_cd = 3 AND
			  des.key_type = 6 AND
			  des.category = 'Datalog Group' AND
			  des.value_name = @grp_desc)
		SET @verify_data_collect = 1

	IF (@max_value = 16) BEGIN

        SELECT dl16.grp_id
              ,dlg.grp_desc
	          ,dl16.sample_time_utc
              ,dl16.sample_time_local
              ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, dl16.sample_time_utc ) sample_time
	          ,dl16.wo_id
	          ,wo.wo_desc
	          ,dl16.oper_id
	          ,dl16.seq_no
	          ,j.job_desc
	          ,dl16.step_no
	          ,NULL AS step_desc
	          ,dl16.item_id
	          ,i.item_desc
	          ,dl16.lot_no
              ,dl16.sublot_no
	          ,dl16.shift_start_utc
              ,dl16.shift_start_local
              ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, dl16.shift_start_utc ) shift_start
	          ,dl16.shift_id
	          ,s.shift_desc
	          ,dl16.ent_id
              ,dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisRow(dl16.row_id, dl16.grp_id, 16, @verify_data_collect) AS collect_data
              ,dbo.fn_DL_IsCertReqdForThisDlRow(dl16.row_id, dl16.grp_id, j.wo_id, j.oper_id, j.seq_no, NULL, NULL, NULL, dlgjl.cert_name) AS certify
              ,dlgjl.cert_name
              ,ct.signoff_notes
              ,ct.comments_reqd
		,dl16.genealogy_id
		,dl16.segment_requirement_id
		,dl16.segment_response_id
              ,dl16.value1
              ,dl16.value2
              ,dl16.value3
              ,dl16.value4
              ,dl16.value5
              ,dl16.value6
              ,dl16.value7
              ,dl16.value8
              ,dl16.value9
              ,dl16.value10
              ,dl16.value11
              ,dl16.value12
              ,dl16.value13
              ,dl16.value14
              ,dl16.value15
              ,dl16.value16
              ,dl16.last_edit_comment
              ,dl16.last_edit_by
              ,dl16.last_edit_at
              ,dl16.row_id
        FROM data_log_16 dl16
			INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dl16.grp_id = dlg.grp_id

-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0	 Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  2.0.0.24 (HD# 4395) Maintain BOM_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
--03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SET XACT_ABORT ON

  IF (@disallow_delete = 1)

AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr]
(
	@User nvarchar(40) OUTPUT
,	@client_type STRING40 OUTPUT

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			- sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr
-- Description          - Used to ALTER  reference in audit trail table
-- Author               - Rohit Pandya
-- Date Created			- 07/01/2002
-- Version (last edit)  - 1.3.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 08/06/2002		Rohit Pandya				- Added new output parameter and logic to get the client type based on the session_id
-- 11/20/2002		TC				1.5.0		- Removed WHERE clause when reading from db_status as it is likely to be missed
--												  in future upgrades and there should only be 1 row anyway
-- 12/18/2002		Rohit			1.5.0		- Changed current_user to SYSTEM_USER
-- 07/07/2007		Raghu			3.1.18		- HD# 8100, Using multiple middlewares against the same database
-- 10/02/2008		AML				3.5			- Added (NOLOCK) hint to select from sessn.
-- 08/21/2014	    Ibrahim			5.0			- User Story #375850: code changes to handle the session IDs containing negative numbers.
--												  -1 to -9 are reserved for custom implementations.� Starting from -10 and below should be used to resolve the row_id in the user_name table.�
--												  For example, -10 represents row ID 0 (i.e. ABS(-10)-10 = 0) in the user_name table;
--												  -11 represents row ID 1 (i.e. ABS(-11)-10 =1) in the user_name table; -12 represents row ID 2 in the user_name table, and so on.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE	@context_info int32

	--Default the user and the client type to NULL
	SELECT @User = NULL, @client_type = NULL

	-- Get the sessionId from the sysprocesses table
	SELECT @context_info = CONVERT(INT, CONTEXT_INFO) FROM MASTER.DBO.SYSPROCESSES WHERE spid =  @@spid

	IF @context_info >= 0 BEGIN
		--Retrieve the current user from the session context.
		SELECT @User = user_id, @client_type = CONVERT(NVARCHAR, client_type) FROM sessn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE session_id = @context_info
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF @context_info < -9 BEGIN
			SELECT @User = user_id FROM user_name WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE row_id = ABS(@context_info)-10
		END
	END
	--Verify whether the retrieved user is a valid user; if the current user is not identified, then default the user to system user/DB user.
	SELECT @User = COALESCE(@User, SYSTEM_USER), @client_type = COALESCE(@client_type, 0)
END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterName]
-- Description: Get printer Print Name based on wo, operation and Seq
--
-- Usage:	To get In-line printer printer name  
 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-03			Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  AML, XPM    2026-04-14          Added Area filter.
-- ===========================================================================================*/
 
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterName] 
( 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(500)

	
		declare  @raw_ent_id int
				,@actl_ent_id int
				,@raw_attr_value nvarchar(50) ;

		SELECT @raw_ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
		FROM JOB j WITH(NOLOCK)
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no


		select @raw_attr_value=ea.attr_value
		from ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
		where ea.ent_id=@raw_ent_id and ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
										   from attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
										   where a.attr_desc = 'EntityType')

		IF(@raw_attr_value ='Segment')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @actl_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id
			FROM ent e with(nolock)
			where e.ent_id=@raw_ent_id
		END
		ELSE IF(@raw_attr_value ='Line') OR (@raw_attr_value = 'Area')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @actl_ent_id=@raw_ent_id
		END

		SELECT @Result=ea.attr_value 
		FROM ent_attr ea with(nolock)
		where ea.ent_id=@actl_ent_id AND ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
														from attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
														where a.attr_desc = 'LinePrinterName')

	 
	RETURN @Result 

END

--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_SA_Std_Oper_Attr_GetAttrs
-- Description	      - Raghu
-- Author	      - Get all the attributes that are associated to this std_operation
-- Date Created	      - 11/03/2005
-- Version                  - 3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver	Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
  SELECT std_oper_attr.oper_id
            ,std_oper_attr.attr_id
            ,attr.attr_desc
	,attr.predefined
            ,attr.data_type
            ,attr.entry_type
            ,attr.visible_in_queue
            ,attr.visible_in_inv
            ,std_oper_attr.attr_value
	,std_oper_attr.notes
            ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_comment
            ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_by
            ,std_oper_attr.last_edit_at
	,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cert_attr_link cal WHERE cal.attr_id = attr.attr_id) <=

  INNER JOIN attr attr WITH (NOLOCK) ON std_oper_attr.attr_id = attr.attr_id

			BEGIN TRANSACTION @TranName;
		ELSE
			SAVE TRANSACTION @SavePointName;

		EXEC [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_aut_int_buff_GetByID]
			@ObjectName = @object_name,
			@InterfaceType = @interface_type,
			@ID = @ID_JRSU_local,
			@Data = @Data_local OUTPUT,
			@ErrorCode = @Error_local OUTPUT;

		IF @Data_local IS NOT NULL AND @Error_local = 0
		BEGIN

			-- Process data here
			DECLARE @wo_id NVARCHAR(40),
					@item_id NVARCHAR(80) = NULL, 
					@seq_no INT,													
					@storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
					@last_su_number NVARCHAR(40), 
					@message_type INT, 	
					@recorded_timestamp DATETIME,	
					@debug INT = 0,
					@current_timestamp DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	
			-- Split the data field into local variables
			SELECT	 @wo_id = wo_id
					,@item_id = item_id
					,@seq_no = seq_no
					,@storage_unit = storage_unit
					,@last_su_number = last_su_number
					,@message_type = message_type
					,@recorded_timestamp = recorded_timestamp
			FROM OPENJSON(@Data_local)
			WITH (
				wo_id NVARCHAR(40) '$.wo_id',
				item_id NVARCHAR(80) '$.item_id',
				seq_no INT '$.seq_no',	
				storage_unit NVARCHAR(40) '$.storage_unit',
				last_su_number NVARCHAR(40) '$.last_su_number', 
				message_type INT '$.message_type', 	
				recorded_timestamp DATETIME '$.recorded_timestamp' 
			);
	
			-- Declare all internal variables needed for the check:
			DECLARE  @mes_parent_name NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_parent_ent_id INT
					,@mes_wo_id NVARCHAR(80)
					,@mes_oper_id NVARCHAR(80)

			-- Set the expected parent object (segment based)
			SET @mes_parent_name = LEFT(@object_name, CHARINDEX('_' + @interface_type, @object_name) - 1)

			-- Get the production unit ent_id
			SELECT TOP 1 @mes_parent_ent_id = ent_id
			FROM ent e WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE e.ent_name = @mes_parent_name

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid processing unit is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_parent_ent_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT: sp_s_ofi_Get_OrderId_AUT
			-- Get the MES work order id
			SELECT	 @mes_wo_id = w.wo_id
					,@mes_oper_id = wa.output_operid
			FROM ufn_ofi_mes_aut_orderid(@wo_id,@seq_no,@mes_parent_ent_id) wa
				LEFT OUTER JOIN wo w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.wo_id = wa.output_woid

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid wo_id is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_wo_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if an invalid job is suplied; then give this as error
			IF @mes_oper_id IS NULL 
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			
			-- debug: check all INPUT values!
			IF @debug = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT @interface_type as interface_type, @object_name as 'object_name'
				,@mes_parent_name as parent_name
				,@mes_parent_ent_id as 'parent_ent_id'
				,@wo_id as 'wo_id'
				,@mes_wo_id as 'mes_wo_id'
				,@mes_oper_id as 'mes_oper_id'
				,@seq_no as 'seq_no'				
				,@recorded_timestamp as 'recorded_timestamp'
			END

			-- Declare the outputs 
			 DECLARE	
				 @data_wo_state_cd INT
				,@data_job_state_cd	INT
				,@data_job_pos	INT 
				

			--Get Current wo_state
			SELECT	@data_wo_state_cd = state_cd 
					--,@data_process_id = process_id
			FROM wo WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE wo_id = @mes_wo_id

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if WO is CLOSED, EXIT
			IF @data_wo_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_wo_state_cd = 3 -- 3 = closed
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_state, qty prod and qty req
			SELECT	 @data_job_state_cd = j.state_cd
					--,@data_job_qty_prod = j.qty_prod
					--,@data_job_qty_reqd = j.qty_reqd
			FROM job j WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE j.wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND j.oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND j.seq_no = @seq_no

			-- CHECK FOR ERROR --
			-- if JOB is new or ready ERROR; Else is not RUNNING (3) (nor new nor Ready) then WARNING  -- ,7,8,9
			IF @data_job_state_cd IS NULL OR @data_job_state_cd IN (1,2)-- 1 NEW, 2 READY/RELEASED, 7, 8, 9 -- Avoid errors -- 4,5 COMPLETED == WARNING
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END
			ELSE IF @data_job_state_cd IN (4,5,6,7,8,9)
			BEGIN
								
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			--Get Current job_pos
			SELECT @data_job_pos = job_pos 
			FROM job_exec WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id 
				AND cur_wo_id = @mes_wo_id 
				AND cur_oper_id = @mes_oper_id 
				AND cur_seq_no = @seq_no
			
			-- if the job is not currently running: set it to -1
			SET @data_job_pos = ISNULL(@data_job_pos, -1)

			IF @data_job_pos = -1
			BEGIN
				
				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			-- GET USER ID
			DECLARE @mes_user_id AS NVARCHAR(180)
			SET @mes_user_id = SUSER_NAME()

			
			IF @message_type NOT IN (1, 2, 5, 8) --1 new source, 2 destination Main Item, 5 Destination co-product, 8 all destinations
			BEGIN
				

				GOTO Exit_Tree;
			END

			DECLARE @job_command_local INT = 16

			IF @message_type = 1
			BEGIN
				SET @job_command_local = 8
			END

			-- Do the final part prior to exiting the process
			Finishing_OK:

			PRINT 'Finishing OK'
			
			DECLARE @Cur_time DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
					,@RC INT

			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_I_ofi_aut_int_buff_InsertJobOutData] 
			   @wo_id = @mes_wo_id
			  ,@oper_id = @mes_oper_id
			  ,@seq_no = @seq_no
			  ,@ent_id = @mes_parent_ent_id
			  ,@job_command = @job_command_local
			  ,@job_pos = @data_job_pos
			  ,@recorded_timestamp = @Cur_time
			  ,@current_timestamp = @Cur_time
			  ,@object_name = @mes_parent_name
			  ,@interface_type = 'JOB_OUT'
			  ,@return_code = @RC OUTPUT
			  ,@row_id_output =  @ID_local OUTPUT
						
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF @Error_local <> 0
			BEGIN
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
			END
		END

		-- Exit place
		Exit_Tree:

		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output

		 IF @TranCounter = 0
            COMMIT TRANSACTION @TranName;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @error INT, @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
        SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		
		-- SET the row_id from the record that has been processed
		SET @row_id_output = @ID_local
	

		SET @TranCounter = @@TRANCOUNT

	

		--output dataset
		SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				

		BEGIN TRY
			---- ADDed extras v1.03  ==> if state is -1 then we just need to rollback all
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = -1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @TranName;
			IF @xstate = 1 and @TranCounter > 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @SavePointName;
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH
		
			PRINT 'FIXING_MESSAGE:row_id_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),@row_id_output)+';status_output:'+TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),7)+';message_output:'
			--output dataset
			SELECT @row_id_output as row_id_output
				
			--ROLLBACK;
			RETURN 0;
		END CATCH
	END CATCH
END;

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_job_exec_aft_upd] ON [dbo].[job_exec]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_job_exec_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on job_exec table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 06/07/2004
-- Version (last edit)   -  2.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
-- 04/07/2016		RWB			5.3.0	For story 617325, added code to set the apply_post_exec_fc_counts column to false.
-- 08/05/2019		RWB			6.2.0	Story 1191970: Make sure the that configuration columns are maintained in lock step
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE	@last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)
	DECLARE	@last_edit_at	DATETIME
	DECLARE @line_id INT32

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
	SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

	IF UPDATE(next_job_only) OR UPDATE(item_based_desc) OR UPDATE(job_end_confirm_msg) OR UPDATE(def_to_ent_id) OR
	   UPDATE(def_reject_ent_id) OR UPDATE(def_from_ent_id) OR UPDATE(def_prod_reas_cd) OR UPDATE(def_cons_reas_cd) OR
	   UPDATE(def_lot_no) OR UPDATE(def_sublot_no) OR UPDATE(autoload_job_specs) OR UPDATE(auto_seq_start_option) OR
	   UPDATE(auto_job_start_option) OR UPDATE(auto_job_end_option) OR UPDATE(incl_class_reas) OR UPDATE(must_complete_steps) OR
	   UPDATE(must_prod_reqd_qty) OR UPDATE(local_movable_cons_ent) OR UPDATE(local_movable_prod_ent) OR
	   UPDATE(run_without_operator) OR UPDATE(suppress_start_qty_prompt) OR
	   UPDATE(allow_zero_qty_split) OR UPDATE(auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job) OR UPDATE(spare1) OR UPDATE(spare2) OR
	   UPDATE(spare3) OR UPDATE(spare4) BEGIN
	   UPDATE job_exec
	   SET	job_exec.next_job_only = i.next_job_only,
			job_exec.item_based_desc = i.item_based_desc,
			job_exec.job_end_confirm_msg = i.job_end_confirm_msg,
			job_exec.def_to_ent_id = i.def_to_ent_id,
			job_exec.def_reject_ent_id = i.def_reject_ent_id,
			job_exec.def_from_ent_id = i.def_from_ent_id,
			job_exec.def_prod_reas_cd = i.def_prod_reas_cd,
			job_exec.def_cons_reas_cd = i.def_cons_reas_cd,
			job_exec.def_lot_no = i.def_lot_no,
			job_exec.def_sublot_no = i.def_sublot_no,
			job_exec.autoload_job_specs = i.autoload_job_specs,
			job_exec.auto_seq_start_option = i.auto_seq_start_option,
			job_exec.auto_job_start_option = i.auto_job_start_option,
			job_exec.auto_job_end_option = i.auto_job_end_option,
			job_exec.incl_class_reas = i.incl_class_reas,
			job_exec.must_complete_steps = i.must_complete_steps,
			job_exec.must_prod_reqd_qty = i.must_prod_reqd_qty,
			job_exec.local_movable_cons_ent = i.local_movable_cons_ent,
			job_exec.local_movable_prod_ent = i.local_movable_prod_ent,
			job_exec.run_without_operator = i.run_without_operator,
			job_exec.suppress_start_qty_prompt = i.suppress_start_qty_prompt,
			job_exec.allow_zero_qty_split = i.allow_zero_qty_split,
			job_exec.auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job = i.auto_alloc_qty_to_running_job,
			job_exec.spare1 = i.spare1,
			job_exec.spare2 = i.spare2,
			job_exec.spare3 = i.spare3,
			job_exec.spare4 = i.spare4,
			job_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by,
			job_exec.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
	   FROM inserted i
	   JOIN (SELECT ent_id, MAX(job_pos) AS job_pos FROM inserted GROUP BY ent_id) x ON i.ent_id = x.ent_id AND i.job_pos = x.job_pos
	   WHERE job_exec.ent_id = i.ent_id
	END

		UPDATE job_exec SET apply_post_exec_fc_counts = 0, job_exec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, job_exec.last_edit_at = @last_edit_at
		FROM inserted i
		WHERE job_exec.ent_id = i.ent_id AND job_exec.job_pos = i.job_pos
END

-- ==========================================================================================												
-- Name:			sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry									
-- Description:		Insert into MESDB.dbo.user_name and/or user_grp_link table										
-- Author:			AKM/AKP												
-- Usage:			Add the user if not avaialbe in the table 
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_OFI_MESUserName_Entry_ADCHECK]	
	@user_id NVARCHAR(40) OUT
AS												
BEGIN			
	SET NOCOUNT ON;			
 
	DECLARE @mod_id NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @last_edit_at DATETIME
	DECLARE @grp_id INT
    DECLARE @grp_name_loop nvarchar(200)
	DECLARE @grp_name TABLE
	(
		id INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		grp_id INT,
		grp_desc NVARCHAR(80),
		auth_method INT
