CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_DL_GetDataLogDataForStep]
(
	@grp_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@wo_id					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@oper_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@seq_no					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@step_no				INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@item_id				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@lot_no					STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@sublot_no				STRING40_NULL = NULL
,	@ent_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@row_id					INT32_NULL = NULL
,	@time_zone_bias_value	INT32_NULL = 0

)
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name          - SP_SA_DL_GETDATALOGDATAFORSTEP
-- Description          - Gets a recordset of data_log_16 or data_log_48 records
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created          -    12/07/2007
-- Version              - 3.4.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver    Changes
--02/04/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074426; L00074427; L00074701; L00074692; Collect data is not returning whether a data_log_n group requires a data collection or not.
--02/06/2008	Raghu		3.4	L00074426; L00074427; L00074701; L00074692; Collect data is not returning whether a data_log_n group requires a data collection or not.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @max_value				INT32
		,	@value_name				STRING80
		,	@verify_data_collect	LOGICAL
		,	@grp_desc	STRING80

	SELECT	@time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )
		,	@verify_data_collect = 0

	SELECT @max_value = dlg.max_value, @grp_desc = dlg.grp_desc
    FROM data_log_grp dlg
    WHERE dlg.grp_id = @grp_id

   IF EXISTS  (SELECT TOP 1 1
		    FROM data_entry_sched des WITH (NOLOCK)
				INNER JOIN job_step js WITH (NOLOCK) ON des.key_id = js.row_id
				INNER JOIN job_step_data jsd WITH (NOLOCK) ON js.wo_id = jsd.wo_id AND js.oper_id = jsd.oper_id AND js.seq_no = jsd.seq_no AND js.step_no = jsd.step_no
		    WHERE js.wo_id = @wo_id
		      AND js.oper_id = @oper_id
		      AND js.seq_no = @seq_no
		      AND js.step_no = @step_no
		      AND jsd.state_cd = 3
		      AND des.key_type = 7 -- job_step
		      AND des.category = 'Datalog Group'
		    AND des.value_name = @grp_desc)
		SET @verify_data_collect = 1

	IF (@max_value = 16) BEGIN

        SELECT dl16.grp_id
              ,dlg.grp_desc
              ,dl16.sample_time_utc
              ,dl16.sample_time_local
              ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, dl16.sample_time_utc) sample_time
              ,dl16.wo_id
              ,wo.wo_desc
              ,dl16.oper_id
              ,dl16.seq_no
              ,j.job_desc
              ,dl16.step_no
              ,js.step_desc
              ,dl16.item_id
              ,i.item_desc
              ,dl16.lot_no
              ,dl16.sublot_no
              ,dl16.shift_start_utc
              ,dl16.shift_start_local
              ,DATEADD(mi, @time_zone_bias_value, dl16.shift_start_utc) shift_start
              ,dl16.shift_id
              ,s.shift_desc
              ,dl16.ent_id
              ,dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisRow(dl16.row_id, dl16.grp_id, 16, @verify_data_collect) AS collect_data
              ,dbo.fn_DL_IsCertReqdForThisDlRow(dl16.row_id, dl16.grp_id, dl16.wo_id, dl16.oper_id, dl16.seq_no, dl16.step_no, dl16.lot_no, dl16.sublot_no, dlgjsl.cert_name) AS certify
              ,dlgjsl.cert_name
              ,ct.signoff_notes
              ,ct.comments_reqd
	      ,dl16.genealogy_id
	      ,dl16.segment_requirement_id
	      ,dl16.segment_response_id
              ,dl16.value1
              ,dl16.value2
              ,dl16.value3
              ,dl16.value4
              ,dl16.value5
              ,dl16.value6
              ,dl16.value7
              ,dl16.value8
              ,dl16.value9
              ,dl16.value10
              ,dl16.value11
              ,dl16.value12
              ,dl16.value13
              ,dl16.value14
              ,dl16.value15
              ,dl16.value16
              ,dl16.last_edit_comment
              ,dl16.last_edit_by
              ,dl16.last_edit_at
              ,dl16.row_id
        FROM data_log_16 dl16
			INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dl16.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
			INNER JOIN job_step js ON js.wo_id = dl16.wo_id AND js.oper_id = dl16.oper_id AND js.seq_no = dl16.seq_no AND js.step_no = dl16.step_no
			INNER JOIN job j ON js.wo_id = j.wo_id AND js.oper_id = j.oper_id AND js.seq_no = j.seq_no
			INNER JOIN wo wo ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
			INNER JOIN item i ON dl16.item_id = i.item_id
			INNER JOIN shift s ON dl16.shift_id = s.shift_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN data_log_grp_job_step_link dlgjsl ON dlgjsl.grp_id = dlg.grp_id AND dlgjsl.wo_id = js.wo_id AND dlgjsl.oper_id = js.oper_id AND dlgjsl.seq_no = js.seq_no AND dlgjsl.step_no = js.step_no
			LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_type ct ON dlgjsl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
        WHERE dl16.grp_id = @grp_id
          AND dl16.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND dl16.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND dl16.seq_no = @seq_no
          AND (dl16.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
          AND (dl16.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
          AND (dl16.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
          AND (dl16.step_no = @step_no)
          AND (dl16.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
          AND (dl16.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL);
    END ELSE BEGIN

        SELECT dl48.grp_id
              ,dlg.grp_desc
              ,dl48.sample_time_utc
              ,dl48.sample_time_local
              ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, dl48.sample_time_utc) sample_time
              ,dl48.wo_id
              ,wo.wo_desc
              ,dl48.oper_id
              ,dl48.seq_no
              ,j.job_desc
              ,dl48.step_no
              ,js.step_desc
              ,dl48.item_id
              ,i.item_desc
              ,dl48.lot_no
              ,dl48.sublot_no
              ,dl48.shift_start_utc
              ,dl48.shift_start_local
              ,DATEADD( mi, @time_zone_bias_value, dl48.shift_start_utc ) shift_start
              ,dl48.shift_id
              ,s.shift_desc
              ,dl48.ent_id
              ,dbo.fn_DL_IsDataCollReqdForThisRow(dl48.row_id, dl48.grp_id, 48, @verify_data_collect) AS collect_data
              ,dbo.fn_DL_IsCertReqdForThisDlRow(dl48.row_id, dl48.grp_id, dl48.wo_id, dl48.oper_id, dl48.seq_no, dl48.step_no, dl48.lot_no, dl48.sublot_no, dlgjsl.cert_name) AS certify
              ,dlgjsl.cert_name
              ,ct.signoff_notes
              ,ct.comments_reqd
			  ,dl48.genealogy_id
	          ,dl48.segment_requirement_id
			  ,dl48.segment_response_id
              ,dl48.value1
              ,dl48.value2
              ,dl48.value3
              ,dl48.value4
              ,dl48.value5
              ,dl48.value6
              ,dl48.value7
              ,dl48.value8
              ,dl48.value9
              ,dl48.value10
              ,dl48.value11
              ,dl48.value12
              ,dl48.value13
              ,dl48.value14
              ,dl48.value15
              ,dl48.value16
              ,dl48.value17
              ,dl48.value18
              ,dl48.value19
              ,dl48.value20
              ,dl48.value21
              ,dl48.value22
              ,dl48.value23
              ,dl48.value24
              ,dl48.value25
              ,dl48.value26
              ,dl48.value27
              ,dl48.value28
              ,dl48.value29
              ,dl48.value30
              ,dl48.value31
              ,dl48.value32
              ,dl48.value33
              ,dl48.value34
              ,dl48.value35
              ,dl48.value36
              ,dl48.value37
              ,dl48.value38
              ,dl48.value39
              ,dl48.value40
              ,dl48.value41
              ,dl48.value42
              ,dl48.value43
              ,dl48.value44
              ,dl48.value45
              ,dl48.value46
              ,dl48.value47
              ,dl48.value48
              ,dl48.last_edit_comment
              ,dl48.last_edit_by
              ,dl48.last_edit_at
              ,dl48.row_id
        FROM data_log_48 dl48
        INNER JOIN data_log_grp dlg ON dl48.grp_id = dlg.grp_id
        INNER JOIN job_step js ON js.wo_id = dl48.wo_id AND js.oper_id = dl48.oper_id AND js.seq_no = dl48.seq_no AND js.step_no = dl48.step_no
        INNER JOIN job j ON js.wo_id = j.wo_id AND js.oper_id = j.oper_id AND js.seq_no = j.seq_no
        INNER JOIN wo wo ON j.wo_id = wo.wo_id
        INNER JOIN item i ON dl48.item_id = i.item_id
        INNER JOIN shift s ON dl48.shift_id = s.shift_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN data_log_grp_job_step_link dlgjsl ON dlgjsl.grp_id = dlg.grp_id AND dlgjsl.wo_id = js.wo_id AND dlgjsl.oper_id = js.oper_id AND dlgjsl.seq_no = js.seq_no AND dlgjsl.step_no = js.step_no
        LEFT OUTER JOIN cert_type ct ON dlgjsl.cert_name = ct.cert_name
        WHERE dl48.grp_id = @grp_id
          AND dl48.wo_id = @wo_id
          AND dl48.oper_id = @oper_id
          AND dl48.seq_no = @seq_no
          AND (dl48.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL)
          AND (dl48.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)
          AND (dl48.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL)
          AND (dl48.step_no = @step_no)
          AND (dl48.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL)
          AND (dl48.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL)
    END
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_biosl_aft_del]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_step_link]
AFTER DELETE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       	--  tg_bom_item_oper_step_link_aft_del
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_step_link table. Fires AFTER any row is deleted in this table
--			   (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value	FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM process p INNER JOIN deleted d ON p.process_id = d.process_id
				WHERE process_status = 3) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not delete this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4737},bom_item_oper_step_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	WHERE process_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT process_id FROM deleted)

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterPrintQty]
-- Description: Get printer Print quantity based on wo, operation and Seq
--
-- Usage:	To get In-line printer print quantity
 
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2022-11-03			Initial version.  
-- ===========================================================================================*/
 
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_lm_getPrinterPrintQty] 
( 
	 @wo_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@oper_id NVARCHAR(100)
	,@seq_no INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN 
	DECLARE @Result INT

	
		declare  @raw_ent_id int
				,@actl_ent_id int
				,@raw_attr_value nvarchar(50) ;

		SELECT @raw_ent_id=target_sched_ent_id
		FROM JOB j WITH(NOLOCK)
		where j.wo_id=@wo_id and j.oper_id=@oper_id and j.seq_no=@seq_no


		select @raw_attr_value=ea.attr_value
		from ent_attr ea WITH(NOLOCK)
		where ea.ent_id=@raw_ent_id and ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
										   from attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
										   where a.attr_desc like '%EntityType%')

		IF(@raw_attr_value ='Segment')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @actl_ent_id=e.parent_ent_id
			FROM ent e with(nolock)
			where e.ent_id=@raw_ent_id
		END
		ELSE IF(@raw_attr_value ='Line')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @actl_ent_id=@raw_ent_id
		END

		SELECT @Result=ea.attr_value 
		FROM ent_attr ea with(nolock)
		where ea.ent_id=@actl_ent_id AND ea.attr_id IN (select a.attr_id
														from attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
														where a.attr_desc like '%LinePrinterPrintQuantity%')

	 
	RETURN @Result 

END

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		[sp_S_ofi_CB_SAPBOM_SiloSelect]
-- Description:	The stored procedure will fetch recipe details for source for CB BOM COrrection only
--				based on SAP BOM, removing Asditives.
-- Usage:		
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author	Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01		JSC		2025-11-04			Needed the ofi_wo_ext_item table instead of job_bom. Based on: sp_S_ofi_recipeinfo_siloselec. 0.09		DS				2024-07-11			setting the composite item id as item id in case of bypass grade validation
-- 0.02		JSC		2025-11-05			Fixed when SAP BOM and JOB BOM had the same item!
-- 0.02.01	JSC		2025-11-10			Added first check on the job_exec default consumtion reason for the grade
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_S_ofi_CB_SAPBOM_SiloSelect]
	(
		--declare
		@silo_selection INT          = 1, -- 1 for source , 2 from destination
		@ver_id         NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@wo_id          NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
		@oper_id        NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
		@seq_no         INT          = NULL,
		@ent_id         INT          = NULL, --
		@recipeId       NVARCHAR(80) =NULL )
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @process                 NVARCHAR(80),
			@job_state_cd            INT,
			@jobrequiredQty          FLOAT,
			@qty_prod                FLOAT,
			@isbatchprocess          INT,
			@bypass_grade_validation INT

	DECLARE @defaultUOMID INT
	
	DECLARE @JobBomResult TABLE (
									bom_pos INT,
									item_id NVARCHAR(40),
									item_desc NVARCHAR(80),
									qty_per_parent_item FLOAT,
									grade_code INT,
									grade_desc NVARCHAR(80),
									qty_reqd FLOAT,
									uom_description NVARCHAR(40),
									recipe_id NVARCHAR(100),
									item_group NVARCHAR(1700),
									item_qty_required FLOAT,
									is_batchprocess INT,
									selected_item_qty NVARCHAR(50),
									selected_percentage NVARCHAR(50),
									selection_complete NVARCHAR(50),
									silo_selected NVARCHAR(50),
									subs_itemlist NVARCHAR(MAX),
									grade_color NVARCHAR(40),
									comp_item_id NVARCHAR(45)
								);


	SELECT @defaultUOMID = uom_id
	FROM uom WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE description            = 'KG';
	
	-- v2.01 Pick default CONSUMPTION grade for the entity
	DECLARE @default_grade INT

	-- v2.02 try job_exec 1st
	SELECT TOP 1 @default_grade = ir.item_grade_cd
	FROM job_exec je WITH (NOLOCK)
		JOIN item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) ON je.def_cons_reas_cd = ir.reas_cd		
		JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = @wo_id 
										AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
										AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
										AND j.run_ent_id = je.ent_id

	-- try ent_attr 2nd
	IF (@default_grade IS NULL or @default_grade < 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @default_grade = ig.item_grade_cd
		FROM attr a WITH (NOLOCK)
			JOIN ent_attr ea WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.attr_desc = 'default_grade' 
												AND ea.attr_id = a.attr_id
			JOIN item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ig.item_grade_desc = ea.attr_value
			JOIN job j WITH (NOLOCK) ON j.wo_id = @wo_id 
											AND j.oper_id = @oper_id
											AND j.seq_no = @seq_no
											AND j.run_ent_id = ea.ent_id
		
	END	
		
	-- just in case... try standard 3rd
	SELECT TOP 1  @default_grade = ISNULL(@default_grade,ig.item_grade_cd)
	FROM item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) 			
	WHERE ig.item_grade_desc = 'STANDARD'

	SELECT @job_state_cd         = state_cd,
		@jobrequiredQty          = qty_reqd,
		@qty_prod                = qty_prod,
		@isbatchprocess          = ISNULL(oa.attr_value,0),
		@bypass_grade_validation = ISNULL(ola.attr_value,0)
	FROM job WITH(NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN oper_attr oa WITH(NOLOCK) ON job.oper_id = oa.oper_id
			AND oa.attr_id                                 =
			(   SELECT attr_id
				FROM attr WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE attr_desc ='IsBatchProcess' )
		LEFT JOIN oper_attr ola WITH(NOLOCK) ON job.oper_id = ola.oper_id
			AND ola.attr_id                                 =
			(   SELECT attr_id
				FROM attr WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE attr_desc ='bypass_grade_validation' ) --0.09
	WHERE job.wo_id     = @wo_id
		AND job.oper_id = @oper_id
		AND job.seq_no  = @seq_no
		
	SET @jobrequiredQty  = CASE
								WHEN (@jobrequiredQty - @qty_prod) > 0
									THEN (@jobrequiredQty - @qty_prod)
								ELSE
									0
							END
	-- Only source selection for Cakeblending
	IF (@silo_selection = 1) -- source silo selection
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @JobBomResult
		SELECT jb.bom_pos 																AS bom_pos,
			jb.item_id 																	AS item_id,
			item.item_desc 																AS item_desc,
			ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id
															,jb.qty_per_parent_item
															,item.uom_id
															,@defaultUOMID
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL) * 100, 3)            AS qty_per_parent_item,
			jb.reqd_grade_cd                                                          	AS grade_code,
			item_grade.item_grade_desc                                               	AS grade_desc,
			jb.qty_reqd 																AS qty_reqd, -- this has to be changed ds comment on 27-Sep-2023; this should be same as item_qty_required				
			uom.[description]					                                        AS uom_description,
			jb.spare1                                                                	AS recipe_id,
			ia.attr_value                                                            	AS item_group,
			ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id
															,(jb.qty_per_parent_item*@jobrequiredQty)
															,item.uom_id
															,@defaultUOMID
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL), 3) 					AS item_qty_required,
			@isbatchprocess                                                          	AS is_batchprocess,
			''                                                                       	AS selected_item_qty,
			''                                                                       	AS selected_percentage,
			''                                                                      	AS selection_complete,
			''                                                                       	AS silo_selected,
			subs.subs_itemlist                                                          AS subs_itemlist,
			dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color)                                	AS grade_color, --0.06  passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
			CASE
				WHEN @bypass_grade_validation = 1
					THEN jb.item_id --0.09
				ELSE
					CONCAT(jb.item_id,jb.reqd_grade_cd)
			END                                                                      	AS comp_item_id
		FROM job_bom jb WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK)        ON item.item_id  = jb.item_id
			INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK)	ON uom.uom_id	 = item.uom_id
			LEFT JOIN item_grade WITH(NOLOCK)   ON item_grade_cd = jb.reqd_grade_cd
			LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id    = item.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK)      ON a.attr_id     = ia.attr_id
				AND a.attr_desc                                  = 'ItemGroup'					
			LEFT JOIN
				(
					-- distinct is required because multiple entries can exist item_id in table -item_subst - item can be substitue 2 for 2 parent(orig) material;
					--	here we are fecthing the list of substitute material based on original material
					SELECT DISTINCT is1.item_id,
						STUFF(
						(   SELECT ',' + CONCAT(is2.orig_item_id,is2.reqd_grade_cd)
							FROM item_subst is2 WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
					FROM item_subst                                                      is1 ) AS subs ON subs.item_id = jb.item_id
		WHERE jb.wo_id                 	= @wo_id
			AND jb.oper_id             	= @oper_id
			AND seq_no                 	= @seq_no
			AND jb.bom_pos          	> 0
			AND jb.backflush 			<> 1
			-- AND ia.attr_value <> 'additives' -- needed to keep bom_pos sequential kepp job bom as IS
		ORDER BY jb.bom_pos ASC	
		
		-- get the current MAX bom POS; and add 1 for the new
		DECLARE @MaxBOMPos INT		
		SELECT @MaxBOMPos = MAX(bom_pos)
		FROM @JobBomResult

		INSERT INTO @JobBomResult
		SELECT @MaxBOMPos + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY jb.bom_pos)						AS bom_pos,
			jb.item_id 																	AS item_id,
			item.item_desc 																AS item_desc,
			ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id
															,jb.qty_per_parent_item
															,item.uom_id
															,@defaultUOMID
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL) * 100, 3)            AS qty_per_parent_item,
			@default_grade                                                          	AS grade_code,
			item_grade.item_grade_desc                                               	AS grade_desc,
			@jobrequiredQty																AS qty_reqd, -- this has to be changed ds comment on 27-Sep-2023; this should be same as item_qty_required				
			uom.[description]					                                        AS uom_description,
			@recipeId                                                                	AS recipe_id,
			ia.attr_value                                                            	AS item_group,
			ROUND([dbo].[fn_ofi_ConvertQtyByItemIdAndUom] (item.item_id
															,(jb.qty_per_parent_item*@jobrequiredQty)
															,item.uom_id
															,@defaultUOMID
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL
															,NULL), 3) 					AS item_qty_required,
			@isbatchprocess                                                          	AS is_batchprocess,
			''                                                                       	AS selected_item_qty,
			''                                                                       	AS selected_percentage,
			''                                                                      	AS selection_complete,
			''                                                                       	AS silo_selected,
			subs.subs_itemlist                                                          AS subs_itemlist,
			dbo.fn_GetHexaColorCode(item_grade.color)                                	AS grade_color, --0.06  passing the int color code and fetching Hexadecimal color code.
			CASE
				WHEN @bypass_grade_validation = 1
					THEN jb.item_id --0.09
				ELSE
					CONCAT(jb.item_id,@default_grade)
			END                                                                      	AS comp_item_id
		FROM ofi_wo_item_ext jb WITH(NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN item WITH(NOLOCK)        ON item.item_id  = jb.item_id
			INNER JOIN uom uom WITH (NOLOCK)	ON uom.uom_id	 = item.uom_id
			LEFT JOIN item_grade WITH(NOLOCK)   ON item_grade_cd = @default_grade
			LEFT JOIN item_attr ia WITH(NOLOCK) ON ia.item_id    = item.item_id
			INNER JOIN attr a WITH(NOLOCK)      ON a.attr_id     = ia.attr_id
				AND a.attr_desc                                  = 'ItemGroup'
			LEFT JOIN
				(
					-- distinct is required because multiple entries can exist item_id in table -item_subst - item can be substitue 2 for 2 parent(orig) material;
					--	here we are fecthing the list of substitute material based on original material
					SELECT DISTINCT is1.item_id,
						STUFF(
						(   SELECT ',' + CONCAT(is2.orig_item_id,is2.reqd_grade_cd)
							FROM item_subst is2 WITH(NOLOCK)
							WHERE is2.item_id = is1.item_id FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS subs_itemlist
					FROM item_subst                                                      is1 ) AS subs ON subs.item_id = jb.item_id
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @JobBomResult jbr ON jbr.item_id = jb.item_id
		WHERE jb.wo_id                 	= @wo_id
			--AND jb.oper_id             	= @oper_id
			--AND seq_no                 	= @seq_no
			AND jb.bom_pos          	> 0
			AND jb.backflush 			<> 1
			AND ia.attr_value <> 'additives' -- needed to keep bom_pos sequential
			AND jbr.item_id IS NULL -- v0.02 to avoid getting duplicated items when they are in job_bom
		ORDER BY jb.bom_pos ASC
			
	END	

	SELECT *
	FROM @JobBomResult
	WHERE item_group <> 'additives'
END

(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @ent_id  int ,
 @parent_contingent_ent bit ,
 @child_contingent_ent bit ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--09/19/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	Part of DB Changes
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
--01/21/2008	Raghu		3.4		L00073299; Entry of Production Rates is cumbersome,...
--13/01/2014	Arun		4.6	    Fix for the CR L00127767
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
/*
SELECT oper_ent_link.process_id
            ,oper_ent_link.oper_id
            ,oper_ent_link.ent_id
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,process.process_desc
            ,oper_ent_link.est_fixed_lab
            ,oper_ent_link.est_lab_rate
            ,oper_ent_link.est_setup_time
            ,oper_ent_link.est_teardown_time
            ,oper_ent_link.est_prod_rate
            ,oper_ent_link.batch_size
            ,oper_ent_link.est_transfer_time
            ,oper_ent_link.init_prod_pct
            ,oper_ent_link.parent_contingent_ent
            ,oper_ent_link.child_contingent_ent
            ,oper_ent_link.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_ent_link.last_edit_by
            ,oper_ent_link.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_link.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM oper_ent_link oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,process process WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,ent ent WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((oper_ent_link.ent_id *= ent.ent_id)AND
       (oper_ent_link.process_id *= process.process_id)AND
       (oper_ent_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_link.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_link.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)  AND
       (oper_ent_link.parent_contingent_ent = @parent_contingent_ent OR @parent_contingent_ent IS NULL)  AND
       (oper_ent_link.child_contingent_ent = @child_contingent_ent OR @child_contingent_ent IS NULL)  AND
       (oper_ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, process.process_desc, oper_ent_link.oper_id
*/

SELECT oper_ent_link.process_id
            ,oper_ent_link.oper_id
            ,oper_ent_link.ent_id
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,process.process_desc
            ,oper_ent_link.est_fixed_lab
            ,oper_ent_link.est_lab_rate
            ,oper_ent_link.est_setup_time
            ,oper_ent_link.est_teardown_time
            ,oper_ent_link.est_prod_rate
	,oper_ent_link.prod_uom
            ,oper_ent_link.batch_size
            ,oper_ent_link.est_transfer_time
            ,oper_ent_link.init_prod_pct
            ,oper_ent_link.parent_contingent_ent
            ,oper_ent_link.child_contingent_ent
            ,oper_ent_link.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_ent_link.last_edit_by
            ,oper_ent_link.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_link.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM oper_ent_link oper_ent_link WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_link.process_id = process.process_id
INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_link.ent_id = ent.ent_id
WHERE ((oper_ent_link.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_link.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_link.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL)  AND
       (oper_ent_link.parent_contingent_ent = @parent_contingent_ent OR @parent_contingent_ent IS NULL)  AND
       (oper_ent_link.child_contingent_ent = @child_contingent_ent OR @child_contingent_ent IS NULL)  AND
       (oper_ent_link.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_link.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, process.process_desc,process.process_id, oper_ent_link.oper_id

AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name        - tg_std_oper_step_file_aft_upd
-- Description        -  This trigger fires AFTER any update is made on std_oper_step_file table to update
--			 last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields
-- Author             - Raghu
-- Date Created         - 09/27/2005
-- Version (last edit)   -  3.1.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By   Ver 	Changes
--11/01/2018	RWB			6.1.0	Story 1084807 - ensure that the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
BEGIN
	DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL

	-- Makes sure the assoc_file_type matches the extension of the assoc_file
	UPDATE std_oper_step_file SET assoc_file_type = x.extension
	FROM (SELECT oper_id, assoc_file, dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(assoc_file) as extension, assoc_file_type FROM inserted) x

	UPDATE std_oper_step_file SET std_oper_step_file.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by, std_oper_step_file.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	WHERE std_oper_step_file.oper_id = i.oper_id AND std_oper_step_file.step_no = i.step_no
	  AND std_oper_step_file.assoc_file = i.assoc_file
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Bom_Ver]
  (@parent_item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_date datetime ,
   @ver_date_tz INT32 =NULL ,
   @ver_comments nvarchar(80) ,
   @preferred_ver bit ,
   @disassembly bit,
   @start_eff datetime ,
   @start_eff_tz INT32 = NULL,
   @end_eff datetime ,
   @end_eff_tz INT32 = NULL ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) ,
   @time_zone_bias_value INT32 = NULL)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name			-
-- Description			-
-- Author				-
-- Date Created			- 10/21/2002
-- Version				- 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Ver			Changes
-- 02/09/2004		Sheetal Jain	2.0.0.24	(HD# 4395) Maintain BOM_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
-- 09/19/2005		Raghu			3.1.0		Part of DB Changes
-- 11/16/2009		Ajay			4.0.0		HD#1432, Part of Date/TimeZone changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
BEGIN
	DECLARE @dbg_resp INT
	--SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL( @time_zone_bias_value, 0 )

	SET @start_eff_tz			= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@start_eff_tz)
	SET @start_eff				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@start_eff, @start_eff_tz)
	SET @end_eff_tz				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@end_eff_tz)
	SET @end_eff				= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateLocalDate(@end_eff, @end_eff_tz)
	SET @time_zone_bias_value	= dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)

	--check if version date is null
	IF (@ver_date IS NULL)
		IF (@time_zone_bias_value = 0) SET @ver_date = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) ELSE SET @ver_date = GETUTCDATE()
	ELSE SET @ver_date =  DATEADD(mi, -@ver_date_tz, @ver_date)

	-- TRACE
	exec @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_U_Bom_Ver', @src_key='sp_U_Bom_Ver', @date_val1 = @ver_date, @numeric_val1 = @ver_date_tz, @date_val2 = @start_eff, @numeric_val2 = @start_eff_tz

	-- Added the next two lines 07/20/2009 RWB
	SET @start_eff =  DATEADD(mi, - @start_eff_tz, @start_eff)
	SET @end_eff   =  DATEADD(mi, - @end_eff_tz, @end_eff)

	UPDATE bom_ver

	SET ver_date = @ver_date, ver_comments = @ver_comments, preferred_ver = @preferred_ver,
		disassembly = @disassembly, start_eff = @start_eff, end_eff = @end_eff,
		last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment

	WHERE	(parent_item_id = @parent_item_id AND ver_id = @ver_id AND
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id)

	--Unset the preferrred versions for other versions under this parent item
	-- if this version set as the preferred version.

	IF @preferred_ver = 1 BEGIN
		UPDATE bom_ver SET preferred_ver = 0 WHERE ver_id <> @ver_id and parent_item_id = @parent_item_id
	END

END

	-- In the case the user is assigned to the AD group it must exist in MES as well
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT user_id FROM dbo.user_grp_link WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE grp_id = @grp_id AND user_id = @user_id)
	BEGIN

	DECLARE

	SELECT @max_rows = count(*) from @grp_name
    --select *from  @grp_name
  	WHILE (@cur_row <= @max_rows)

		SET @cur_row = @cur_row + 1
		
		select @grp_name_loop=value from STRING_SPLIT(@grp_name_loop,'\')[1]
		--select @grp_name_loop

		BEGIN

			EXECUTE [dbo].[sp_D_User_Grp_Link]

	--Query Active directory for user group

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_biosl_aft_ins]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_step_link]
AFTER INSERT
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_bom_item_oper_step_link_aft_ins
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_step_link table. Fires AFTER any row is inserted in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/20/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/20/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
--06/21/2004	Raghu		2.1.0	GETDATE() is changed to GETUTCDATE(). Cursor Loop is removed
--05/12/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--08/10/2016    Varun		5.3.0   CR L00141976 Merge Changes (HF CR#L00141911): Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item
--									of bom_item_oper_step_link table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @attr_value		NVARCHAR(1)
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id
				FROM bom_item_oper_step_link a INNER JOIN inserted b
				ON a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
				AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos AND a.process_id = b.process_id
				AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no))
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},bom_item_oper_step_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	WHERE process_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_step_link a INNER JOIN inserted b
				ON a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id
				AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos AND a.process_id = b.process_id
				AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no)

	UPDATE bom_item_oper_step_link SET bom_item_oper_step_link.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item -- CR L00141976
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.parent_item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE bom_item_oper_step_link.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bom_item_oper_step_link.ver_id = i.ver_id
	  AND bom_item_oper_step_link.bom_pos = i.bom_pos AND bom_item_oper_step_link.process_id = i.process_id
	  AND bom_item_oper_step_link.oper_id = i.oper_id AND bom_item_oper_step_link.step_no = i.step_no

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_D_Bom_Item_Oper_Spec]
  (@item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @bom_pos int ,
   @process_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @oper_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @step_no int,
   @spec_ver_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @spec_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @mod_id varchar(30) )
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      - sp_D_Bom_Item_Oper_Spec
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -
-- Version            - 2.0.0.24
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver    Changes
-- 09/10/2002	  Raghu		1.4    Disallow deletes if sys param is set for bom item oper spec data (sys param = 195)
-- 12/04/2002	  Raghu		1.5.0  Mod Id Changes (Datetime to Money type)
-- 02/09/2004     Sheetal Jain  20024  HD# 4414 Maintain oper_spec_ver.ver_date automatically & XACT_ABORT
--03/10/2004	Raghu		2.0.28	(HD# 3940) Handles DeleAll for SCC
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
SET XACT_ABORT ON
DECLARE   @disallow_delete	INT
	,@current_time	TDATETIME
	,@use_GMT	INT32

BEGIN
  SELECT @disallow_delete = attr_value FROM SYSTEM_ATTR WHERE attr_id = 195
  IF (@disallow_delete = 1) BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Deleting data from %1 is not allowed{3863},Bom_Item_Oper_Spec', 16, 1)
	RETURN -1
  END

  DELETE bom_item_oper_spec WHERE (item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND (ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND (bom_pos = @bom_pos OR @bom_pos IS NULL)
    AND (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND (step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL)
    AND (spec_ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR @spec_ver_id IS NULL)   AND (spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL)
    AND (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19,4), CONVERT(MONEY, mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL)
--       CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DATETIME, mod_id), 13) = @mod_id)

	EXEC sp_SA_System_Attr_UseGMT @use_GMT OUTPUT
	IF @use_GMT = 1 SET @current_time = GETUTCDATE() ELSE SET @current_time = dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL)

  --update spec version date automatically
  UPDATE oper_spec_ver SET ver_date = @current_time WHERE (process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND (oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL)
    AND (ver_id = @spec_ver_id OR @spec_ver_id IS NULL)
END

,	@oper_id		STRING40_NULL = NULL

)

AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_S_DLG_Std_Oper_Step_Link
-- Description      - Select a single existing row identified by the primary key
-- Date Created     - 10/31/2007
-- Version          - 3.4.0
-- Notes            -

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified	Modified_By		Version		Changes
-- 01/19/2008		AML				3.4.0		Updated to add fields from data_entry_sched.

	   ,	dlgsosl.step_no
	   ,	dlgsosl.cert_name
	   ,	des.key_id
	   ,	des.key_type
	   ,	des.category
	   ,	des.trigger_type
	   ,	des.trigger_period
	   ,	des.entries_reqd
	   ,	des.display_seq

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_ofi_Split
-- Description:	Function splits provided string based on provided delimiter character
--
-- Usage:	sp_SA_ofi_WO_GetByFilter,sp_SA_ofi_WO_GetByFilterbAK
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	 AVEVA         	  2023-03-23		Intial Version
-- 0.02.01   Veervar		  2024-02-05		Header comment and formatting.
-- ===========================================================================================

CREATE Function [dbo].[fn_ofi_Split]( 
@String varchar(8000), 
@Delimiter char(1)) 
returns @temptable TABLE (items varchar(8000)) 
as 
begin 
	declare @idx int 
	declare @slice varchar(8000) 

	select @idx = 1 
	--RETURN IF STRING IS NULL
	if len(@String) < 1 or @String is null 
		return 

	while @idx!= 0 
		begin 
			set @idx = charindex(@Delimiter,@String) 
			if @idx!=0 
				set @slice = left(@String,@idx - 1) 
			else 
				set @slice = @String 
			if(len(@slice) > 0) 
				insert into @temptable(Items) values(@slice) 
			set @String = right(@String,len(@String) - @idx) 
			if len(@String) = 0 
				break 
		end 
	return 
end

 IF @additive IS null SET @additive = 0

  --SET @start_time =  DATEADD(mi, -@time_zone_bias_value, @start_time)

--* Return timestamp

start_time = @start_time)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ADDPEMDATA](
 @event_type            nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@event_time_local      datetime  =  NULL
,@wo_id                 nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@oper_id               nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@seq_no                INT32  =  NULL
,@item_id               nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@lot_no                nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@sublot_no             nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@ent_name              nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@site_name             nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@genealogy_id          nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@segment_requirement_id   nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@segment_response_id   nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@subsegment_id         nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@quantity              TFLOAT_NULL  =  NULL
,@item_uom              nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@comments              nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@production_schedule_id   nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@location_name         nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@location_site_name    nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@personnel_list        nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@serial_no_list        nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@event_name            nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@equipment_id          nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@grp_desc              nvarchar(1000)  =  NULL
,@extended_attrs      	nvarchar(MAX)   =  NULL
,@bom_pos				INT32 = NULL
,@ref_row_id            INT32  =  NULL
,@material_type		nvarchar(1000) = NULL
,@time_zone_bias_value   INT32  =  NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name                    - SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ADDPEMDATA
-- Description                    - Logs PEM data and its corresponding extended production attribute data.
-- Author                        - Raghu
-- Date Created                    - 11/09/2009
-- Version (last edit)            - 4.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By        Ver            Changes
--02/07/2012       Praveen kumar P     4.0 SP2        Modified for the CRL00105555 Changed the condition ir.item_status_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE
	  @ent_id				INT32
	, @row_id				INT32
	, @from_ent_id			INT32
	, @epa_row_id			INT32
	, @reas_cd				INT32
	, @grade_cd				INT32
	, @status_cd			INT32
	, @scrapped				bit
	, @distinct_cons		bit
	, @event_time_utc		TDATETIME
	, @last_edit_by			nvarchar(80)
	, @v_client_info		nvarchar(80)
	, @shift_start_utc		TDATETIME
	, @shift_start_local	TDATETIME
	, @shift_id             INT32
	, @dummy1				TDATETIME
	, @tz_temp				INT32

BEGIN

	SET @time_zone_bias_value = ISNULL(@time_zone_bias_value, 0)
    SET @seq_no = COALESCE(@seq_no, 0)
	SET @tz_temp = -@time_zone_bias_value
	SET @row_id = @ref_row_id

	--Get the entity ID to which this data is logged.
    SET @ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID( @ent_name, @site_name)

    --Verify whether this entity exists in the database or not if not, raise an error to the caller.
    IF (@ent_id IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the entity does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR('The specified %1 does not exist in the database{3566}', 16, 1, @ent_id)
		RETURN -1
    END
	--Get the local time and the UTC time.
	EXEC sp_TZ_GetDateInfo NULL, @event_time_utc OUTPUT, @event_time_local OUTPUT, @time_zone_bias_value OUTPUT


    --Verify whether this entity exists in the database or not if not, raise an error to the caller.
    IF (@event_type IS NULL) BEGIN
        --raise an error if the entity does not exist in the database.
		RAISERROR('The %1 must be supplied to record PEM data. {4677}', 16, 1, @event_type)
		RETURN -1
    END

	--Get the user who is making this call.
    EXEC dbo.sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, @v_client_info OUTPUT

	IF (@event_type = 'Material Consumable Actual') BEGIN

        --Handle Material Consumable
        --Get the entity ID to which this data is logged.
        SET @from_ent_id = dbo.fn_GetEntityID(@location_name, @location_site_name)
	SET @row_id = NULL

        SELECT @reas_cd = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sa.attr_id = 215
		IF (@reas_cd IS NULL) BEGIN
             --The system_attribute does not exist.
			RAISERROR('The specified system attribute identifying the reason code for consumption does not exist in the database.{3566}',16,1)
			RETURN -1
        END

		SELECT @grade_cd = ir.item_grade_cd, @status_cd = ir.item_status_cd, @scrapped = ig.scrapped
			FROM item_reas ir WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN item_grade ig WITH (NOLOCK) ON ir.item_grade_cd = ig.item_grade_cd
			WHERE reas_cd = @reas_cd
		IF(@@ROWCOUNT <1) BEGIN
			--The item reason does not exist.
			RAISERROR('The specified reason code for consumption does not exist in the database.{3566}',16,1)
			RETURN -1
		END

		--Verify whether distinct consumption records ought to be maintained.
        SELECT @distinct_cons = sa.attr_value FROM system_attr sa WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE attr_id = 325
		IF (@distinct_cons IS NULL) BEGIN
			--Incase of an exception, default to 'No'.
			SET @distinct_cons = COALESCE(@distinct_cons, 0)
		END

		--Get the shift details related to this transaction.
		SELECT @shift_start_utc = MIN(sh.shift_start_utc), @shift_start_local = MIN(sh.shift_start_local)
				, @shift_id = MIN(sh.shift_id)
			FROM shift_history sh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE sh.ent_id = @ent_id
				--shift start time must be earlier or equal to the the supplied event time
				AND sh.shift_start_utc <= @event_time_utc
				--shift end time must be later than the supplied event time or it could be null; representing the current shift.
				AND (sh.shift_end_utc >= @event_time_utc OR sh.shift_end_utc IS NULL)

		SELECT @shift_start_utc = COALESCE(@shift_start_utc, @event_time_utc)
			, @shift_start_local = COALESCE(@shift_start_local, @event_time_local)
			, @shift_id = COALESCE(@shift_id, 0)

		IF (@distinct_cons <> 1) BEGIN
             --Create a new item_cons row if the system attribute is defined to create new consumption row each time.

		SELECT @row_id = ic.row_id FROM item_cons ic WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE (ic.wo_id = @wo_id OR (ic.wo_id IS NULL AND @wo_id IS NULL))
              AND (ic.oper_id = @oper_id OR (ic.oper_id IS NULL AND @oper_id IS NULL))
              AND (ic.seq_no = @seq_no OR (ic.seq_no IS NULL AND @seq_no IS NULL))
              AND ic.shift_start_utc = @shift_start_utc
              AND ic.item_id = @item_id
              AND (ic.lot_no = @lot_no OR (ic.lot_no IS NULL AND @lot_no IS NULL))
              --AND (ic.fg_lot_no = @fg_lot_no OR (fg_lot_no IS NULL AND @cur_fg_lot_no IS NULL))
              AND (ic.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR (ic.sublot_no IS NULL AND @sublot_no IS NULL))
              --AND (fg_sublot_no = @cur_fg_sublot_no OR (fg_sublot_no IS NULL AND @cur_fg_sublot_no IS NULL))
              AND ic.reas_cd = @reas_cd
              AND ic.user_id = @last_edit_by
              AND (ic.from_ent_id = @from_ent_id OR (ic.from_ent_id IS NULL AND @from_ent_id IS NULL))
              AND (ic.genealogy_id = @genealogy_id OR (ic.genealogy_id IS NULL AND @genealogy_id IS NULL))
              --AND (upstream_event_id = @upstream_event_id OR (ic.upstream_event_id IS NULL AND @upstream_event_id IS NULL))
              AND (ic.segment_requirement_id = @segment_requirement_id OR (ic.segment_requirement_id IS NULL AND @segment_requirement_id IS NULL))
              AND (ic.segment_response_id = @segment_response_id OR (ic.segment_response_id IS NULL AND @segment_response_id IS NULL));

		IF (@row_id IS NOT NULL)
		UPDATE item_cons SET qty_cons = qty_cons + COALESCE(@quantity, 0) WHERE row_id = @row_id
		ELSE SET @distinct_cons = 1
		END


		IF(@distinct_cons = 1) BEGIN
			--Get the next consumption row ID
	      INSERT INTO item_cons (wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, shift_start_utc, shift_start_local,
                    item_id, lot_no, fg_lot_no, sublot_no, fg_sublot_no,
                    reas_cd, user_id, item_scrapped,
                    ent_id, shift_id,
                    grade_cd, status_cd, from_ent_id,
                    qty_cons, qty_cons_erp, ext_ref, transaction_type,
                    genealogy_id, upstream_event_id, segment_requirement_id, segment_response_id,
                    comments, spare1, spare2, spare3, spare4,
                    last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at,
                    created_at_utc, created_at_local)
                VALUES (@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no,
                    @shift_start_utc, @shift_start_local,
                    @item_id, @lot_no, NULL, @sublot_no, NULL,
                    @reas_cd, @last_edit_by, @scrapped,
                    @ent_id, @shift_id,
                    @grade_cd, @status_cd,@from_ent_id,
                    COALESCE(@quantity, 0), 0, NULL, 0,
                    @genealogy_id, NULL, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id,
                    @comments, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
                    NULL, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()),
                    @event_time_utc, @event_time_local)
			SET @row_id = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		END
	END
	ELSE BEGIN
		IF (@event_type NOT IN ('Material Produced Actual', 'Material Consumed Actual', 'Production Data', 'Personnel Actual', 'Equipment Actual')) BEGIN
	        RAISERROR('The correct event_type must be supplied to record PEM data.{4677}', 16,1)
			RETURN -1
		END
    END
	--Insert the EPA's if EPA's are supplied.
    IF (@extended_attrs IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
        --EPA's are supplied.
        EXEC SP_U_JOB_EXEC_ADDPEMEPADATA @grp_desc, @event_time_local
            ,@wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no
            ,@item_id, @lot_no, @sublot_no
            ,@ent_id, @genealogy_id
            ,@segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id
            ,@extended_attrs, @last_edit_by
            ,@time_zone_bias_value
            ,@epa_row_id OUTPUT
    END

	 --Insert the data into job_event table.
    INSERT INTO job_event (event_time_utc, event_time_local, wo_id, oper_id, seq_no, step_no, event_type,
        ent_id, bom_pos, lot_no, sublot_no, item_id, cert_name, done_by_user_id, checked_by_user_id,
        source_row_id, spec_id, genealogy_id, segment_requirement_id,
        segment_response_id, subsegment_id, quantity, comments,
        value1, value2, value3, value4, value5, value6, value7,
        value8, value9, value10, last_edit_comment, last_edit_by, last_edit_at)
    VALUES (@event_time_utc, @event_time_local, @wo_id, @oper_id, @seq_no, NULL, @event_type,
        @ent_id, @bom_pos, @lot_no, @sublot_no,@item_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, @row_id, NULL,
		@genealogy_id, @segment_requirement_id, @segment_response_id, @subsegment_id,
        @quantity, @comments,
	    @production_schedule_id,  --value1
        @location_name,          --value2
        @event_name,             --value3
        @personnel_list,          --value4
        @serial_no_list,           --value5
        @epa_row_id,                --value6
        @item_uom,                  --value7
        @equipment_id,               --value8
        @material_type, 		--value9
	NULL, NULL, @last_edit_by, dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime(GETUTCDATE()))

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Ent_Route]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @ent_id  int  ,
 @input_oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @input_ent_id  int  ,
 @input_percent  float  ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime,
 @mod_id  varchar(30) )
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--04/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
/*SELECT oper_ent_route.process_id
            ,oper_ent_route.oper_id
            ,oper_ent_route.ent_id
            ,oper_ent_route.input_oper_id
            ,oper_ent_route.input_ent_id
            ,process.process_desc
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,ent1.ent_name as input_ent_name
            ,oper_ent_route.input_percent
            ,oper_ent_route.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_ent_route.last_edit_by
            ,oper_ent_route.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_route.mod_id))) mod_id
  FROM oper_ent_route oper_ent_route WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,process process WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,ent ent WITH (NOLOCK)
       ,ent ent1  WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ((oper_ent_route.input_ent_id *= ent1.ent_id)AND
       (oper_ent_route.ent_id *= ent.ent_id)AND
       (oper_ent_route.process_id *= process.process_id)AND
       (oper_ent_route.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.input_oper_id = @input_oper_id OR @input_oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.input_ent_id = @input_ent_id OR @input_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.input_percent = @input_percent OR @input_percent IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_route.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))
*/
SELECT oper_ent_route.process_id
            ,oper_ent_route.oper_id
            ,oper_ent_route.ent_id
            ,oper_ent_route.input_oper_id
            ,oper_ent_route.input_ent_id
            ,process.process_desc
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,ent1.ent_name as input_ent_name
            ,oper_ent_route.input_percent
            ,oper_ent_route.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_ent_route.last_edit_by
            ,oper_ent_route.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_route.mod_id))) mod_id
FROM oper_ent_route oper_ent_route WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_route.process_id = process.process_id
INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_route.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN ent ent1  WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_route.input_ent_id = ent1.ent_id
WHERE ((oper_ent_route.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.input_oper_id = @input_oper_id OR @input_oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.input_ent_id = @input_ent_id OR @input_ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.input_percent = @input_percent OR @input_percent IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_route.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL) AND
       (CONVERT(varchar(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_route.mod_id))) = @mod_id OR @mod_id IS NULL))

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

BEGIN

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:		sp_SA_ofi_Item_GetByFilter
-- Description:	The stored procedure will get record to the item table
-- 
-- Usage:		AddMaterialMaster
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	YG				2022-08-12			Initial version.
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Item_GetByFilter]
(@item_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@item_desc NVARCHAR(80) = NULL,
@item_class_id NVARCHAR(40) = NULL,
@template_name NVARCHAR(40) = NULL
) 
AS
BEGIN 
	SELECT i.item_id		as item_id,
		i.item_desc			as item_desc,
		i.item_class_id		as item_class_id,
		ic.item_class_desc	as item_class_desc,
		u.abbreviation		as uom_desc,
		u.uom_id			as uom_id,
		i.num_decimals		as num_decimals,
		ia.attr_value		as template_name,
		ISNULL(i.spare1,0)	as spare1,
		i.last_edit_comment as last_edit_comment
	FROM item i WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN uom u WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.uom_id = u.uom_id
	INNER JOIN item_class ic WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_class_id = ic.item_class_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN item_attr ia WITH (NOLOCK) ON i.item_id = ia.item_id AND ia.attr_id = (SELECT attr_id 
																						   FROM attr WHERE attr_desc = 'ItemGroup' and attr_grp = 1)
	WHERE 
		(i.item_id like '%' + @item_id + '%' OR @item_id IS NULL)
		AND (i.item_desc like '%' + @item_desc + '%' OR @item_desc IS NULL)
		AND (i.item_class_id  like '%' +  @item_class_id  + '%' OR @item_class_id IS NULL)
		AND (ia.attr_value like '%' + @template_name + '%' OR @template_name IS NULL)
	ORDER BY i.item_id 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_I_Cert_Item_Link]
  (@cert_name nvarchar(40) ,
   @item_id nvarchar(40) ,
   @cert_level int ,
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at DATETIME OUT)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	  -
-- Description	  -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	  -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 6.2.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2020 AVEVA Group plc and its subsidiaries. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Change Date	Change By	Ver.	Changes
-- 01/18/2007	KRF		3.2.1	HD# 8434 - Make conversion of current datetime back to a datetime type explicit
-- 10/24/2007		AML				3.3.4		HD# 8434, Replacing CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), [date_time_value], 120) with
--												dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( [date_time_value] ).
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
DECLARE  @last_edit_by	NVARCHAR(40)

EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @last_edit_by OUTPUT, NULL
SET @last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )

 IF @cert_level IS null SET @cert_level = 1

 INSERT INTO cert_item_link
 (cert_name,
  item_id,
  cert_level,
  last_edit_comment,
  last_edit_by,

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_biosl_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[bom_item_oper_step_link]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name		-- tg_bom_item_oper_step_link_aft_upd
-- Description       	-- Trigger on bom_item_oper_step_link table. Fires AFTER any row is updated in this table
--			    (HD# 925). Donot Modify or Delete Components of a Certified Process
-- Author	 	-- Raghu
-- Date Created      	-- 12/10/2002
-- Version (last edit)  -- 1.5.2
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified Modified_By	Ver	Changes
--12/11/2002	Raghu		1.5.2	(HD# 1769). Any change in this table should update process.last_editor and process.last_edit_at fields.
-- 01/09/2003	Rohit		1.5.2	Added string Id reference to err messages.
-- 06/07/2004	Raghu		 20100	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
--					Also, cursor loop is removed
--05/12/2005	Raghu		2.1.21	HD# 5371, Force rounding to num decimals.
--10/17/2005	Raghu		3.1.0	HD# 5678, Part of DB Changes
--08/10/2016    Varun	    5.3.0   CR L00141976 Merge Changes (HF CR#L00141911): Removed rounding on column qty_per_parent_item
--									of bom_item_oper_step_link table.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE  @process_id		NVARCHAR(40)
	,@attr_value		BIT
	,@process_status	INT
	,@user_id		NVARCHAR(40)
BEGIN
	SELECT @attr_value = attr_value FROM system_attr
	WHERE attr_id = 207

	IF (@attr_value = '1') BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 'X' FROM process WHERE process_status = 3 AND process_id IN
				(SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_step_link a, inserted b
				WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
				      AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no)) BEGIN
			RAISERROR ('Can not modify this %1 record that is currently attached to a certified process.{4738},bom_item_oper_step_link', 16, 1)
			RETURN
		END
	END

	EXEC sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @user_id OUTPUT, NULL

	UPDATE process SET last_editor = @user_id, last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM (SELECT DISTINCT b.process_id FROM bom_item_oper_step_link a, inserted b
		WHERE a.parent_item_id = b.parent_item_id AND a.ver_id = b.ver_id AND a.bom_pos = b.bom_pos
		      AND a.process_id = b.process_id AND a.oper_id = b.oper_id AND a.step_no = b.step_no) biosl
	WHERE process.process_id = biosl.process_id

	UPDATE bom_item_oper_step_link SET bom_item_oper_step_link.qty_per_parent_item = i.qty_per_parent_item -- CR L00141976
		,bom_item_oper_step_link.last_edit_by = @user_id, bom_item_oper_step_link.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
	FROM inserted i
	INNER JOIN item it ON i.parent_item_id = it.item_id
	WHERE bom_item_oper_step_link.parent_item_id = i.parent_item_id AND bom_item_oper_step_link.ver_id = i.ver_id AND bom_item_oper_step_link.bom_pos = i.bom_pos
	      AND bom_item_oper_step_link.process_id = i.process_id AND bom_item_oper_step_link.oper_id = i.oper_id AND bom_item_oper_step_link.step_no = i.step_no

END

/*
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Name:		fn_ofi_su_get_mes_status
-- Description:	get_inv_details
--
-- Usage:	get_inv_details
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-03-24			Initial version. 
-- 0.01.01	Veervar		2024-02-06			Logic comments and formatting
-- ===========================================================================================*/
--select dbo.fn_ofi_su_get_mes_status (149)
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_ofi_su_get_mes_status] 
(	
	@ent_id INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(200)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @lckFrOutId int
	,@lckFrOutVal Nvarchar(50) ,@lckOutput nvarchar(100)=N''
	,@lckFrInId int
	,@lckFrInVal Nvarchar(50) ,@lckInput nvarchar(100)=N''
	,@lckFrQalId int
	,@lckFrQalVal Nvarchar(50)	,@lckQuality nvarchar(100)=N''
	,@result nvarchar(500)


	--GET LockForOutput VALUE FOR SELECTED ENTITY
	select @lckFrOutId=a.attr_id
	from attr a
	where a.attr_desc='LockForOutput'

	select @lckFrOutVal= ea.attr_value 
	from ent_attr ea
	where ea.attr_id = @lckFrOutId and ea.ent_id=@ent_id
	
	----------------------------
	--GET LockForInput VALUE FOR SELECTED ENTITY
	select @lckFrInId=a.attr_id
	from attr a
	where a.attr_desc='LockForInput'

	select @lckFrInVal= ea.attr_value 
	from ent_attr ea
	where ea.attr_id = @lckFrInId and ea.ent_id=@ent_id
	------------------------------------------------------
	--GET BlockForQuality VALUE FOR SELECTED ENTITY
	select @lckFrQalId=a.attr_id
	from attr a
	where a.attr_desc='BlockForQuality'

	select @lckFrQalVal= ea.attr_value 
	from ent_attr ea
	where ea.attr_id = @lckFrQalId and ea.ent_id=@ent_id

	--SET VARIABLE VALUE
	if(@lckFrInVal is not null and @lckFrInVal = 1)
	BEGIN
		select @lckInput=' LockForInput '
	END
	if(@lckFrOutVal is not null and @lckFrOutVal = 1 )
	BEGIN
		select @lckOutput=' LockForOutput '
	END
	if(@lckFrQalVal is not null and @lckFrQalVal=1)
	BEGIN
		select @lckQuality=' BlockForQuality '
	END

	--CONCAT ALL VALUES WITH COMMA SEPARATOR
	select @result= concat(
	(select case when @lckInput='' or @lckInput is null then ''
	            else @lckInput+',' 
				end as input),
	(select case when @lckOutput='' or @lckOutput is null then ''
	            else @lckOutput+',' 
				end as output),
	(select case when @lckQuality='' or @lckQuality is null then ''
	            else @lckQuality+',' 
				end as quality));

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN  CASE
	WHEN right(rtrim(@result),1) = ',' THEN substring(rtrim(@result),1,len(rtrim(@result))-1)
	ELSE @result END   

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Std_Oper_GetByFilter]
(@filter_option	INT32
,@filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
,@criteria	STRING80 = NULL
) AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name      - sp_SA_Std_Oper_GetByFilter
-- Description      - Return a recordset of standard operations optionally filtered by the supplied filter criteria.
-- Author	    - Raghu
-- Date Created     - 11/02/2005
-- Version          - 3.1.0
-- Notes            -
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified      Modified_By      Changes
--11/30/2005	Raghu		3.1.4	HD# 6474, Attributes should be ANDed instead of ORed.
--05/05/2006	Raghu		3.1.15	HD# 8173, 8174, Supply time_zone_bias_value to sp_SA_GetTempSQLByFilter
--07/21/2015	RWB			6.0.0	Story 811323 - Removed hardcoded users supplied values from the dynamic SQL to prevent
--									SQL Injection.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @temp_SQL	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@SQL_WHERE	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@temp_filter	NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@SQL		NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@start		INT
	,@end		INT
	,@separator		NVARCHAR(4)
	,@oper_id		NVARCHAR(100)
	,@value			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@ent_id		int
BEGIN

	CREATE TABLE #attr_filter (filter_count INT, attr_id INT, attr_value NVARCHAR(100))
	SET @separator = '$$'
	--$$OPER_ID=$$$$ENTITY=$$$$SHOW_STEPS=1$$$$SHOW_SPECS=1$$$$($$$$8317=$$$$7001=$$$$)$$
	IF (@filter_option IS NULL) SET @filter_option = 0

	IF (@filter_option = 0) BEGIN
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT sop.oper_id,sop.oper_desc,soel.ent_id,e.ent_name,e.description '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FROM std_oper sop WITH (NOLOCK) '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN std_oper_ent_link soel WITH (NOLOCK) ON sop.oper_id=soel.oper_id '
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'LEFT OUTER JOIN ent e WITH (NOLOCK) ON e.ent_id=soel.ent_id '
	END

	IF (@filter IS NOT NULL) BEGIN
		SET @temp_SQL = ''
		SET @SQL_WHERE = 'WHERE (NULL IS NULL)'
		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filter, 'OPER_ID=', @separator, @oper_id OUTPUT
		IF (@oper_id <> '') BEGIN
			SET @temp_SQL = ' AND UPPER(sop.oper_id)'
			IF (CHARINDEX('%', @oper_id) > 0) OR (CHARINDEX('_', @oper_id) > 0)
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' LIKE @oper_id'
			ELSE
				SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + '= @oper_id'
		END

		EXEC sp_SA_ExtractFilterVals @filter, 'ENTITY=', @separator, @value OUTPUT
		IF (@value <> '')  BEGIN
			SET @ent_id = CAST(@value AS INT)
			SET @temp_SQL = @temp_SQL + ' AND e.ent_id = @ent_id'
		END

		IF (@temp_SQL <> '') SET @SQL_WHERE = @SQL_WHERE + @temp_SQL

		SET @temp_SQL = ''
		SET @start = CHARINDEX('$$($$', @filter, 1)  --Get Attribute ( starting position
		IF @start > 0 BEGIN
			SET @end = CHARINDEX('$$)$$', @filter, @start)
			IF @end = 0 SET @end = LEN(@filter) ELSE SET @end = @end + 5
		END
		ELSE SET @end = 0	-- Get Attribute ) End Position
		IF @end > 0 BEGIN
			DECLARE @counter INT
			DECLARE @temp_where NVARCHAR(MAX)
			DECLARE @attr_value NVARCHAR(MAX)
			DECLARE @pos INT

			SET @temp_filter = SUBSTRING(@filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- temp_filter contains set of attribute conditions
			SET @start = 8	-- Starting position of attribute
			SET @counter = 1
			SET @end = CHARINDEX(@separator, @temp_filter, @start)	--End position of the first attribute
			WHILE (@end > 0) BEGIN
				SET @temp_WHERE = SUBSTRING(@temp_filter, @start, (@end - @start))	-- Attribute: eg: 1000=jack
				SET @pos = CHARINDEX('=', @temp_WHERE)	--Get = position to split left and right
				SET @value = REPLACE(@temp_WHERE, LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos), '')

				IF @value <> '' BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #attr_filter VALUES(@counter, CAST(LEFT(@temp_WHERE, @pos - 1) AS INT), UPPER(@value))

					SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN #attr_filter af' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' ON af' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.filter_count = ' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10))
					SET @SQL = @SQL + ' JOIN std_oper_attr soa' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' WITH (NOLOCK) ON sop.oper_id = soa' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.oper_id AND af' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id = soa' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_id AND af' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value = soa' + CAST(@counter AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '.attr_value'
					SET @counter = @counter + 1
				END
				SET @start = @end + 4
				SELECT @end = CHARINDEX('$$$$', @temp_filter, @start)
			END
		END

		IF (@temp_SQL <> '') BEGIN
			SET @SQL = @SQL + @temp_SQL
		END
		SET @SQL = @SQL + ' ' + @SQL_WHERE
	END
	SET @SQL = @SQL + ' ORDER BY sop.oper_id,sop.oper_desc,e.ent_name'

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL, N'@oper_id NVARCHAR(100), @ent_id INT', @oper_id, @ent_id

	DROP TABLE #attr_filter
END
