-- Usage:	GetPreconfiguredOverlay/Or already saved data, Is getting used in Overlay form, gets executed while packing WO is released
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version	Author		Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description
-- 0.01.00	CK			2023-02-17			Initial version. 
   0.01.01	CK			2023-03-09			Added @active_cust_msg
-- ===========================================================================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_s_ofi_lm_get_preoverlayConfig] 	
	@wo_id NVARCHAR(100) = NULL
   ,@oper_id NVARCHAR(500) = NULL
   ,@seq_no INT = 0

AS
BEGIN	 --code start
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @owe_count INT=0
		   ,@cust_count INT=0 
		   ,@cust_name NVARCHAR(200)=NULL
		   ,@active_cust INT=0
		   ,@is_customer_active NVARCHAR(200) = NULL
		   ,@content_type INT=0
		   ,@label_overlay_data NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
		   ,@recCount INT=0
		   ,@conType INT=0
		   ,@active_cust_msg NVARCHAR(100)=[dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100012 ,NULL,NULL);
	  
	SELECT @recCount=count(1)
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
						 FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
						 WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details')
	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	SELECT @conType=count(1)
	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
						 FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
						 WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent')	
	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no
	
	--IF((@recCount > 0) AND (@conType > 0))
	--BEGIN	-- check if already configured start
	--	SELECT @label_overlay_data = ja.attr_value
	--	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	--	WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
	--						 FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	--						 WHERE a.attr_desc = 'job_label_details')
	--	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	--	SELECT @content_type= ja.attr_value
	--	FROM job_attr ja WITH(NOLOCK)
	--	WHERE ja.attr_id IN (SELECT a.attr_id 
	--						 FROM attr a WITH(NOLOCK)
	--						 WHERE a.attr_desc = 'TypeOfLblContent')	
	--	AND ja.wo_id=@wo_id AND ja.oper_id=@oper_id AND ja.seq_no=@seq_no

	--	--SELECT @label_overlay_data AS overlay_data, @content_type AS content_type
	--END	-- check if already configured end
	--ELSE
	--BEGIN --if not already configured check in SAP table start
	SELECT @owe_count=count(1)
	FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
	where owe.wo_id = @wo_id

	IF(@owe_count = 1)
	BEGIN
	SELECT @cust_count = ISNULL(count(owe.ship_to_customer),0)
	FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
	where owe.wo_id = @wo_id

		IF(@cust_count = 1)
		BEGIN	-- cust exist start
			SELECT @active_cust_msg=[dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100013,NULL,NULL)
			SELECT @cust_name = owe.ship_to_customer 
			FROM ofi_wo_ext owe WITH(NOLOCK)
			where owe.wo_id = @wo_id

			SELECT @active_cust = count(1)
			FROM ofi_lm_customer_info olci WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE olci.cust_name=@cust_name 
			AND olci.is_active=1
			AND olci.is_deleted=0
			
			IF(@active_cust = 1)
			BEGIN -- active cust exist start
				SELECT @active_cust_msg= [dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100014 ,NULL,NULL)

				SELECT @content_type = olci1.type_of_content
					FROM ofi_lm_customer_info olci1 WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE olci1.cust_name=@cust_name 
					AND olci1.is_active=1
					AND olci1.is_deleted=0

				IF(@content_type = 1)	-- content type 1 Image
				BEGIN -- content type start
					SELECT @label_overlay_data = olci2.cust_img_path
					FROM ofi_lm_customer_info olci2 WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE olci2.cust_name=@cust_name 
					AND olci2.is_active=1
					AND olci2.is_deleted=0
				END
				ELSE IF(@content_type = 2)-- content type 2 RichTextbox
				BEGIN
					SELECT @label_overlay_data = olci2.cust_info
					FROM ofi_lm_customer_info olci2 WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE olci2.cust_name=@cust_name 
					AND olci2.is_active=1
					AND olci2.is_deleted=0
				END -- content type end				
			END	 -- active cust exist end
		END	-- cust exist end
	 END	--if not already configured check in SAP table end
   -- END

   if(@label_overlay_data = ' ' or @label_overlay_data = '')
	begin
	select @label_overlay_data=NULL
	end
	

	SELECT ISNULL(@label_overlay_data,[dbo].fn_s_ofi_getLangString (100015 ,NULL,NULL)) AS overlay_data, ISNULL(@content_type,'2') AS content_type,@active_cust_msg as Customer_info




END --code end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_Oper_Ent_Spec]
(@process_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @step_no int,
 @ent_id  int  ,
 @ver_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
 @spec_id  nvarchar(40) ,
 @grp_id nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
 @last_edit_at datetime)
  AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name	      -
-- Description	      -
-- Author	      -
-- Date Created	      -	10/21/2002
-- Version	      - 1.5.0.0
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified    Modified_By     Ver	Changes
-- 06/30/2003	    Raghu		    1.7.0	Added grp_id as an optional filter; added grp_id in the Select clause -- New BR reqd doc from Rich B
-- 12/02/2003	    Rch Boyle		        Appended the spare field from spec to the record set
-- 04/13/2006	    Raghu		    3.1.14	HD# 7577, Change join compatibilities
-- 12/19/2017		Surya			6.0	    US:956690 As Peter I want to have a description field for my specification definition so I can further describe the specification
-- 11/09/2018	Raghu		6.1	UserStory:1105532-As Terry, I want the �File� tables to return the extension of the file for the file type rather than the value in the column that represents the file type, so that there is no chance that the file�s extension and file�s type get get out of sync
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT oper_ent_spec.process_id
            ,oper_ent_spec.oper_id
            ,oper_ent_spec.step_no
            ,oper_ent_spec.ent_id
            ,oper_ent_spec.ver_id
            ,oper_ent_spec.spec_id
            ,oper_ent_spec.spec_value
	        ,spec.grp_id
            ,oper_ent_spec.assoc_file
            ,dbo.fn_GetFileExtn(oper_ent_spec.assoc_file) AS assoc_file_type
            ,oper_ent_spec.comments
            ,oper_ent_spec.min_value
            ,oper_ent_spec.max_value
            ,oper_ent_spec.access_level
            ,ent.ent_name
            ,process.process_desc
            ,spec.spec_desc
	        ,spec.units
  	        ,spec.spare1
  	        ,spec.spare2
  	        ,spec.spare3
  	        ,spec.spare4
            ,oper_ent_spec.last_edit_comment
            ,oper_ent_spec.last_edit_by
            ,oper_ent_spec.last_edit_at
            ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), CONVERT(DECIMAL(19, 4), CONVERT(MONEY, oper_ent_spec.mod_id))) mod_id
            ,spec.data_type data_type
FROM oper_ent_spec oper_ent_spec WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_spec.ent_id = ent.ent_id
INNER JOIN process process WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_spec.process_id = process.process_id
INNER JOIN spec spec WITH (NOLOCK) ON oper_ent_spec.spec_id = spec.spec_id
WHERE ((oper_ent_spec.step_no = @step_no OR @step_no IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.process_id = @process_id OR @process_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.ver_id = @ver_id OR @ver_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.spec_id = @spec_id OR @spec_id IS NULL) AND
       (spec.grp_id = @grp_id OR @grp_id IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
       (oper_ent_spec.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL))
ORDER BY oper_ent_spec.spec_id

CREATE TRIGGER [tg_storage_exec_aft_upd]
ON [dbo].[storage_exec]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
--- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       - tg_storage_exec_aft_upd
-- Description       -
-- Author	     - Raghu
-- Date Created      -
-- Version           - 1.6.32
--
-- Copyright (c) 2017 Schneider Electric Software, LLC. All rights reserved.
--
-- THIS CODE AND INFORMATION ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY
-- KIND, EITHER EXPRESSED OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE
-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By	Ver   Changes
-- 11/20/2003     Sheetal Jain  1632  (HD#1236) Option to Log transaction when Changing state of a Storage Location
-- 06/08/2004	Raghu		 2.1.00	Automatically update last_edit_by and last_edit_at fields as soon as any update is made on this table
-- 03/13/2006	Raghu		3.1.11	HD# 5695, Track changes to storage entities
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE
  @ent_id			INT32,
  @allow_neg_qty		BIT,
  @log_state_transitions        LOGICAL,
  @status                       INT32,
  @audit_log                    INT32,
  @ext_user_id                  STRING40,
  @client_type                  STRING40,
  @log_storage_changes		NVARCHAR(1)

BEGIN
  SET @audit_log = 0

      EXECUTE sp_S_DB_Status_GetAudTrailUsr @ext_user_id OUTPUT, @client_type OUTPUT

  SELECT @log_storage_changes = attr_value FROM system_attr WHERE attr_id = 333 AND attr_value = '1'
  SET @log_storage_changes = ISNULL(@log_storage_changes, '0')

  --Open a cursor to fetch all the rows, one at a time
  DECLARE storage_exec_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
    SELECT b.ent_id, b.allow_neg_qty, b.log_state_transitions, b.status
      FROM storage_exec a, inserted b WHERE a.ent_id = b.ent_id

  OPEN storage_exec_cursor
  WHILE (1=1)
  BEGIN
    FETCH NEXT FROM storage_exec_cursor INTO @ent_id, @allow_neg_qty, @log_state_transitions, @status
    IF (@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)   BREAK
    IF UPDATE(ALLOW_NEG_QTY)   BEGIN
      IF @allow_neg_qty = 0  BEGIN
	IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ITEM_INV WHERE ent_id = @ent_id and qty_left < 0)  BEGIN
		SET @audit_log = 0
		RAISERROR('Negative quantity already exists{4209}', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
      END
    END

    IF UPDATE(STATUS) OR UPDATE(STORAGE_ENT_ID) OR UPDATE(SPARE1) OR UPDATE(SPARE2)
	OR UPDATE(SPARE3) OR UPDATE(SPARE4) BEGIN
	    IF (@log_storage_changes = '1') BEGIN
		INSERT INTO storage_ent_transfer (ent_id, to_storage_ent_id, to_status, to_spare1, to_spare2, to_spare3, to_spare4,
			from_storage_ent_id, from_status, from_spare1, from_spare2, from_spare3, from_spare4, transfer_by, transfer_time_utc, transfer_time_local)
		SELECT i.ent_id, i.storage_ent_id, i.status, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare1), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare2), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare3),
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare4), d.storage_ent_id, d.status, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare1), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare2),
			CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare3), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare4), @ext_user_id,
			dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ),
			dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( dbo.fn_TZ_GetLocalDate(NULL) )
		FROM inserted i INNER JOIN deleted d ON i.ent_id = d.ent_id
		WHERE (i.status <> d.status) OR (ISNULL(i.storage_ent_id, -999) <> ISNULL(d.storage_ent_id, -999))
		  OR (ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare1), '') <> ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare1), ''))
		  OR (ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare2), '') <> ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare2), ''))
		  OR (ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare3), '') <> ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare3), ''))
		  OR (ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), i.spare4), '') <> ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(80), d.spare4), ''))
	--	WHERE i.movable = 1 AND d.movable = 1
	    END
    END

/* RWB: This change was made for CR L00085757, but it is being rolled back until Sidus 3 Rewire.
    IF UPDATE(type) OR UPDATE(max_capacity) OR UPDATE(uom_id) OR UPDATE(tare) OR UPDATE(tare_uom_id) OR UPDATE(auto_del_zero_inv) OR
	  UPDATE(allow_neg_qty) OR UPDATE(scannable_id) OR UPDATE(allow_multiple_items) OR UPDATE(allow_multiple_lots) OR UPDATE(movable) OR
	  UPDATE(storage_ent_id) OR UPDATE(allow_dirty_state) OR UPDATE(log_state_transitions) OR UPDATE(indistinguishable_lots) OR
	  UPDATE(unlisted) OR UPDATE(spare_int1) OR UPDATE(spare_int2) OR UPDATE(spare_int3) OR UPDATE(spare_int4) OR UPDATE(spare1) OR
	  UPDATE(spare2) OR UPDATE(spare3) OR UPDATE(spare4) BEGIN
*/
		UPDATE storage_exec SET storage_exec.last_edit_by = @ext_user_id, storage_exec.last_edit_at = dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() )
		WHERE ent_id = @ent_id
/*
    END
*/

    --if audit triggers donot exist log changing state of storage location
    IF @audit_log = 0 AND NOT EXISTS
      (SELECT 1 FROM sysobjects WHERE OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsTrigger') = 1 AND OBJECTPROPERTY(id,'ExecIsUpdateTrigger') = 1
         AND name = 'tr_storage_exec_after_upd') AND UPDATE(STATUS) AND @log_state_transitions = 1
    BEGIN
      SET @audit_log = 1
      -- Establish if this action is initiated by our middleware (in which case we need the actual user)
      -- or directly on the database. Call SP to return actual user for all triggers
    END  --End of NOT EXISTS ...
  END
  CLOSE storage_exec_cursor
  DEALLOCATE storage_exec_cursor

  --Log audit trail records for status
  IF @audit_log = 1
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO audit_trail (logged_at, user_id, change_type, table_name, row_id, column_name, old_value, new_value, origin, comments, delete_detail)
      SELECT dbo.fn_StripMilliSecsFromDateTime( GETUTCDATE() ), @ext_user_id, 2, 'storage_exec', i.ent_id, 'status', o.status, i.status, @client_type, '', ''
        FROM inserted i INNER JOIN deleted o ON i.ent_id = o.ent_id
          WHERE ISNULL(i.status,0) <> ISNULL(o.status,0)
  END
END

-- Module Name        - sp_SA_ofi_Item_Inv
-- Description        - Get all Item Inventory details fro provided parameters
-- Usage			- Inventory Management
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Version		Author			Date (yyyy-MM-dd)	Change description  
-- 0.01.00		SSB				2023-01-24			Initial version.  
-- 0.01.01		Veervar			2024-02-09			Header comments.
-- 0.01.02      AML, XPM        2026-02-10          Create the material and qty concatenated			
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_SA_ofi_Item_Inv]
(
	@row_id int,
	@ent_id  int  ,
	@item_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@lot_no  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@sublot_no	nvarchar(40) ,
	@grade_cd  int  ,
	@status_cd  int  ,
	@uom_id int ,
	@date_in_utc datetime,
	@date_in_local datetime,
	@date_in_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@date_out_utc datetime,
	@date_out_local datetime,
	@date_out_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@expiry_date  datetime  ,
	@expiry_date_tz INT32 = NULL,
	@wo_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@oper_id  nvarchar(40)  ,
	@seq_no  int ,
	@last_edit_by nvarchar(40) ,
	@last_edit_at datetime ,
	@time_zone_bias_value int = NULL,
	@spare2 nvarchar(40)
)

AS

BEGIN

DECLARE @tz_temp		INT,
		@dbg_resp		INT32

--SET DATE FOR TIMZONE
SET @date_in_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_in_tz)
SET @date_out_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@date_out_tz)
SET @expiry_date_tz = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@expiry_date_tz)

SET @time_zone_bias_value = dbo.fn_TZ_ValidateOffset(@time_zone_bias_value)


  EXEC @dbg_resp = sp_DBG_LogTrace @src_sp='sp_SA_Item_Inv', @src_key='on_entry',
					 @date_val1 = @date_in_local, @numeric_val1 = @date_in_tz
					 , @date_val2 = @date_out_local, @numeric_val2 = @date_out_tz
					 , @date_val3 = @expiry_date, @numeric_val3 = @expiry_date_tz

--SET EXPIRY DATE VARIABLE
IF @expiry_date IS NOT NULL 
	SET @expiry_date = DATEADD(mi, -@expiry_date_tz, @expiry_date)

SELECT	item_inv.row_id
	,	item_inv.ent_id
	,	item_inv.item_id
	,   ISNULL(item_inv.item_id, '') + ' - ' + ISNULL(item.item_desc, '') AS material
	,	item_inv.lot_no
	,	item_inv.sublot_no
	,	item_inv.grade_cd
	,	item_inv.status_cd
	,	ent.ent_name
	,	item.item_desc
	,	item.uom_id item_uom_id
	,	item.inv_unique_by_job
	,	item_grade.item_grade_desc
	,	item_grade.color grade_color
	,	item_state.item_status_desc
	,	item_state.color state_color
	,	item_inv.qty_left
	,   CAST(CAST(ISNULL(item_inv.qty_left, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + 
		ISNULL(
            CASE
			    WHEN item_inv.uom_id IS NULL THEN (SELECT description FROM uom WHERE uom_id = item.uom_id)
			    ELSE (SELECT description FROM uom WHERE uom_id = item_inv.uom_id)
		    END, ''
        ) AS qty_uom
	,	item_inv.qty_left_erp
	,	item_inv.uom_id
	,	item_inv.date_in_utc
	,	item_inv.date_in_local
	,	DATEADD(mi, @date_in_tz, item_inv.date_in_utc) AS date_in
	,	item_inv.date_out_utc
	,	item_inv.date_out_local
	,	DATEADD(mi, @date_out_tz, item_inv.date_out_utc) AS date_out
	,	item_inv.expiry_date
	,	item_inv.wo_id
	,	item_inv.oper_id
	,	item_inv.seq_no
	,	item_inv.spare1
	,	item_inv.spare2
	,	item_inv.spare3
	,	item_inv.spare4
	,	item_inv.spare5
	,	item_inv.spare6
	,	item.num_decimals
	,	item_inv.last_edit_comment
	,	item_inv.last_edit_by
	,	item_inv.last_edit_at

	,	 ISNULL(
    CASE 
        WHEN item_inv.uom_id IS NULL THEN (SELECT description FROM uom WHERE uom_id = item.uom_id)
        ELSE (SELECT description FROM uom WHERE uom_id = item_inv.uom_id)
		END,  '') AS uom_desc
	,	ISNULL(
			(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item_grade i_grade ON ISNULL(item.min_grade, -1) = i_grade.item_grade_cd
				WHERE ii.item_id = item_inv.item_id AND (ii.lot_no = item_inv.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND item_inv.lot_no IS NULL))						
					AND item_grade.pref <= ISNULL(i_grade.pref, item_grade.pref)), 0) AS shippable_grade_h
	,	ISNULL(
			(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM item_inv ii WITH (NOLOCK)
				LEFT OUTER JOIN item_state i_state ON ISNULL(item.min_state, -1) = i_state.item_status_cd
				WHERE ii.item_id = item_inv.item_id AND (ii.lot_no = item_inv.lot_no OR (ii.lot_no IS NULL AND item_inv.lot_no IS NULL))				
				AND item_state.pref <= ISNULL(i_state.pref, item_state.pref)), 0) AS shippable_state_h
FROM item_inv item_inv WITH (NOLOCK)
-- ... (Resto de los JOINs y WHERE igual que antes)
	INNER JOIN ent ent WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.ent_id = ent.ent_id
	INNER JOIN item item WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.item_id = item.item_id
	INNER JOIN item_grade item_grade WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.grade_cd = item_grade.item_grade_cd
	INNER JOIN item_state item_state WITH (NOLOCK) ON item_inv.status_cd = item_state.item_status_cd
WHERE ((item_inv.row_id = @row_id OR @row_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.ent_id = @ent_id OR @ent_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.item_id = @item_id OR @item_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.lot_no = @lot_no OR @lot_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.sublot_no = @sublot_no OR @sublot_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.grade_cd = @grade_cd OR @grade_cd IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.status_cd = @status_cd OR @status_cd IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.uom_id = @uom_id OR @uom_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.date_in_local >= @date_in_local OR @date_in_local IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.date_out_local >= @date_out_local OR @date_out_local IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.expiry_date >= @expiry_date OR @expiry_date IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.wo_id = @wo_id OR @wo_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.oper_id = @oper_id OR @oper_id IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.seq_no = @seq_no OR @seq_no IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.last_edit_by = @last_edit_by OR @last_edit_by IS NULL) AND
		(item_inv.last_edit_at >= @last_edit_at OR @last_edit_at IS NULL)) AND
		(item_inv.spare2 = @spare2 OR @spare2 IS NULL) 
ORDER BY ent.ent_name, item.item_desc, item_grade.item_grade_desc
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_U_Cause_Grp]
  (@cause_grp_id int ,
   @cause_grp_desc nvarchar(80) ,
   @display_seq int ,
   @spare1 nvarchar(80),
   @spare2 nvarchar(80),
   @spare3 nvarchar(80),
   @spare4 nvarchar(80),
   @last_edit_comment nvarchar(254) ,
   @last_edit_at datetime)
AS
-- ***********************************************************************************************************************
-- Module Name       -
-- Description       -
-- Author         -

-- Version        -
--

-- IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND/OR FITNESS FOR A
-- PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Date_Modified  Modified_By      Changes
--
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- *************************************************************************************************************************
UPDATE cause_grp
SET cause_grp_desc = @cause_grp_desc,
    display_seq = @display_seq,
    spare1 = @spare1,
    spare2 = @spare2,
    spare3 = @spare3,
    spare4 = @spare4,
    last_edit_comment = @last_edit_comment
WHERE   (cause_grp_id = @cause_grp_id AND
        last_edit_at = @last_edit_at)

--===========================================================================================
-- Name:    SP_S_EI_PRO_Create_Wo
-- Description:  Checks the work order details exists or not
--
-- Usage:  This will be used by EI
-- ===========================================================================================
-- Version  Author      Date (yyyy-MM-dd)  Change description
-- 0.01.00  Sk          2022-07-26         Initial version.
-- 0.01.01  LK          2024-03-04         Deleting the existing Job Bom for the wo to insert fresh value on update
-- ===========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_S_EI_PRO_Create_Wo] (@module     NVARCHAR(40),
                                             @plant_code NVARCHAR(40),
											 @wo_id      NVARCHAR(40),
											 @erp_wo_status NVARCHAR(40),
											 @spare1     NVARCHAR(200),
                                             @spare2     NVARCHAR(200),
                                             @spare3     NVARCHAR(200),
                                             @spare4     NVARCHAR(200))
AS
  BEGIN
       delete from job_bom where wo_id=@wo_id and bom_pos<>0 -- 0.01.01
       SELECT TOP 1 1
	   FROM   wo WITH (nolock)
	   WHERE  wo_id = @wo_id 
      
  END
